bible.translation: Chinese TTVR (現代台語譯本羅馬字版)

chapter.verse: Khí-thâu, Siōng-tè chhòng-chō thiⁿ kap tōe.
Tōe sī hūn-tūn, iáu-bē chiâⁿ-hêng; chhim-ian ê téng-bīn o͘-o͘-àm-àm; Siōng-tè ê sîn ūn-hêng tī chúi-bīn.
Siōng-tè kóng “Tio̍h ū kng”, chiū ū kng.
Siōng-tè khòaⁿ kng sī hó; Siōng-tè chiong kng kap àm pun-khui.
Siōng-tè kiò kng chòe Ji̍t--sî, kiò àm chòe Mî--sî. Ū ē-hng ū chá-khí, sī thâu chi̍t ji̍t.
Siōng-tè kóng, “Chiah-ê chúi ê tiong-kan tio̍h ū kiong-chhong, chiong chúi téng-ē keh-khui.”
Siōng-tè chiū chō kiong-chhong, chiong kiong-chhong ē-bīn ê chúi kap kiong-chhong téng-bīn ê chúi pun-khui; tāi-chì chiū án-ni oân-sêng.
Siōng-tè kiò kiong-chhong chòe Thiⁿ. Ū ē-hng ū chá-khí, sī tē-jī ji̍t.
Siōng-tè kóng, “Thiⁿ ē-bīn chiah-ê chúi tio̍h chi̍p-tiong tī chi̍t só͘-chāi, hō͘ ta-tōe chhut-hiān.” Tāi-chì chiū án-ni oân-sêng.
Siōng-tè kiò ta-tōe chòe Tōe, kiò chi̍p-tiong ê chúi chòe Hái; Siōng-tè khòaⁿ che chòe hó.
Siōng-tè kóng, “Tōe tio̍h ū si̍t-bu̍t: Ōe kiat-chí ê chhài-soe, kap ōe kiat ké-chí lāi-bīn ū chí ê chhiū; kok chiàu in ê chióng-lūi.” Tāi-chì chiū án-ni oân-sêng.
Tōe chiū chiàu chióng-lūi siⁿ-chhut si̍t-bu̍t, chiū-sī ōe kiat-chí ê chhài-soe, kap ū chéng-chí ê ké-chí-chhiū; Siōng-tè khòaⁿ che chòe hó.
Ū ē-hng ū chá-khí, sī tē-saⁿ ji̍t.
Siōng-tè kóng, “Thiⁿ-téng ê kiong-chhong tio̍h ū kng-thé, lâi hun-pia̍t ji̍t kap mî, mā chòe kùi-choeh, ji̍t, nî ê kì-hō,
koh tī kiong-chhong hoat-kng chiò tōe-bīn.” Tāi-chì chiū án-ni oân-sêng.
Siōng-tè chiū chō nn̄g ê tōa ê kng-thé, tōa--ê koán ji̍t--sî, sòe--ê koán mî--sî; mā chō chhiⁿ-sîn.
Siōng-tè chiong in hē tī thiⁿ-téng ê kiong-chhong, hō͘ in chiò tōe-bīn,
mā koán ji̍t kap mî, hun-pia̍t kng kap àm; Siōng-tè khòaⁿ che chòe hó.
Ū ē-hng ū chá-khí, sī tē-sì ji̍t.
Siōng-tè kóng, “Chúi-lāi tio̍h siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe seng-bu̍t; tōe ê téng-bīn, thiⁿ--ni̍h ê kiong-chhong tio̍h ū chiáu-á teh pe.”

Siōng-tè chiū chhòng-chō hái--ni̍h ê tōa-hî, kap chúi-lāi siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe ê seng-bu̍t, kok chiàu in ê chióng-lūi; koh chhòng-chō ta̍k-khoán pe-chiáu, kok chiàu in ê chióng-lūi; Siōng-tè khòaⁿ che chòe hó.
Siōng-tè sù-hok in, kóng, “Tio̍h siⁿ-thòaⁿ, tio̍h ke-thiⁿ, hō͘ hái--ni̍h chhiong-móa seng-bu̍t, hō͘ tōe-chiūⁿ ê chiáu-á siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe.”
Ū ē-hng ū chá-khí, sī tē-gō͘ ji̍t.
Siōng-tè kóng, “Tōe tio̍h siⁿ-chhut seng-bu̍t, kok chiàu in ê chióng-lūi; ū cheng-siⁿ, teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t, cháu-siù, kok chiàu in ê chióng-lūi.” Tāi-chì chiū án-ni oân-sêng.
Siōng-tè chiū chiàu in ê chióng-lūi chō tōe-chiūⁿ ê cháu-siù, cheng-siⁿ, kap it-chhè teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t; Siōng-tè khòaⁿ che chòe hó.

Siōng-tè kóng, “Lán tio̍h chiàu lán ê hêng-siōng, chiàu lán ê khoán-sit chō lâng, hō͘ in koán-lí hái--ni̍h ê hî, thiⁿ--ni̍h ê chiáu, tōe-chiūⁿ ê cheng-siⁿ kap iá-siù, í-ki̍p tī tōe-chiūⁿ teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t.”
Siōng-tè chiū chiàu I ka-kī ê hêng-siōng chhòng-chō lâng; I chiàu I ê hêng-siōng chhòng-chō in, ū lâm ū lú.

Siōng-tè sù-hok in, tùi in kóng, “Tio̍h siⁿ-thòaⁿ, ke-thiⁿ chin chōe, chhiong-móa choân-tōe, koh tī-lí choân-tōe, mā tio̍h koán-lí hái--ni̍h ê hî, thiⁿ--ni̍h ê chiáu, kap tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ōe tín-tāng ê seng-bu̍t.”
Siōng-tè koh kóng, “Góa chiong choân-tōe só͘-ū ōe kiat-chí ê chhài-soe, kap it-chhè ū chéng-chí ê ké-chí-chhiū, lóng hō͘ lín chòe chia̍h-mi̍h.

Tōe-chiūⁿ ta̍k-chióng ê cháu-siù, khong-tiong it-chhè ê chiáu-á, kap tī tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū teh pê ê oa̍h-mi̍h, góa chiong chhiⁿ-sek ê chhài-soe hō͘ in chòe chia̍h-mi̍h.” Tāi-chì chiū án-ni oân-sêng.
Siōng-tè khòaⁿ I só͘ chō ê it-chhè chin hó. Ū ē-hng ū chá-khí, sī tē-la̍k ji̍t.
Thiⁿ tōe kap bān-siōng í-keng chhòng-chō oân-sêng.
Tī tē-chhit ji̍t, Siōng-tè oân-sêng I ê kang-chok, chiū tī hit-ji̍t hioh-khùn.
Siōng-tè sù-hok tē-chhit ji̍t, tēng chit-ji̍t chòe sèng-ji̍t; in-ūi tī chit-ji̍t, Siōng-tè thêng I it-chhè chhòng-chō ê kang, chiū an-hioh.
Che chiū-sī thiⁿ kap tōe chhòng-chō ê kè-thêng. Chú Siōng-tè chō thiⁿ kap tōe ê sî,
tāi-tōe iáu-bē ū chháu-ba̍k, chhân-iá iáu-bē siⁿ chhài-soe; in-ūi Chú Siōng-tè bô lo̍h-hō͘, mā iáu-bē ū lâng thang chèng-choh.
Chóng-sī ū chúi tùi tōe chhèng--chhut-lâi, lūn-te̍k tōe-bīn.
Chú Siōng-tè ēng tōe-chiūⁿ ê thô͘-hún lia̍p-chō lâng, tùi i ê phīⁿ-khang pûn sìⁿ-miā ê khùi; lâng chiū chiâⁿ-chòe ū sìⁿ-miā ê lâng.
Chú Siōng-tè tī tang-hng ê I-tiân khai-khún chi̍t ê hn̂g, chiong só͘ chō ê lâng hē tī hit lāi-bīn.
Chú Siōng-tè hō͘ tōe hoat ta̍k-chióng hó-khòaⁿ ê chhiū-á, kap hó-chia̍h ê ké-chí; tī hn̂g ê tiong-kan mā ū oa̍h-miā-chhiū, kap ōe hō͘ lâng hun-pia̍t siān-ok ê chhiū.
Ū chi̍t tiâu hô tùi I-tiân lâu--chhut-lâi, koàn-ak hit-ê hn̂g; tùi hia hun-chòe sì tiâu.
Thâu chi̍t tiâu kiò-chòe Pí-sùn-hô, se̍h Hap-hui-la choân-tōe; hia chhut-sán kim,
sī siōng-hó ê kim; koh chhut-sán tin-kùi ê phang-liāu kap âng-bé-ló.
Tē-jī tiâu kiò-chòe Ki-hùn-hô, se̍h Kó͘-si̍t choân-tōe.
Tē-saⁿ tiâu kiò-chòe Tí-kek-lí-su-hô, lâu tùi A-su̍t ê tang-pêng. Tē-sì tiâu chiū-sī Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô.
Chú Siōng-tè chiong hit-ê lâng an-tùn tī I-tiân-hn̂g, hō͘ i chèng-choh, kò͘-siú hit-ê hn̂g.
Chú Siōng-tè hoan-hù hit-ê lâng kóng, “Hn̂g-lāi ta̍k-chióng chhiū ê ké-chí, lí lóng thang chia̍h.
M̄-kú hit-châng ōe hō͘ lâng hun-pia̍t siān-ok ê chhiū, i ê ké-chí lí bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h; lí nā chia̍h, hit-ji̍t lí it-tēng ōe sí.”
Chú Siōng-tè kóng, “Hit-ê lâng ka-kī chi̍t ê tòa m̄ hó; góa beh kā i chō chi̍t ê pang-chān-chiá lâi phit-phòe i.”

Chú Siōng-tè ēng thô͘ chòe iá-tōe ta̍k-khoán ê cháu-siù, í-ki̍p khong-tiong ta̍k-khoán ê pe-chiáu. Chú Siōng-tè kā hiah-ê tōng-bu̍t chhōa-lâi hit-ê lâng ê bīn-chêng, hō͘ i kā in hō-miâ; hit-ê lâng kā ta̍k-khoán tōng-bu̍t hō ê miâ, chiū chiâⁿ-chòe hit-ê tōng-bu̍t ê miâ.
Hit-ê lâng chiū kā só͘-ū ê cheng-siⁿ, khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu, kap iá-tōe it-chhè ê cháu-siù hō-miâ, m̄-kú chhē bô chi̍t ê thang chòe i ê pang-chān-chiá lâi phit-phòe i.
Chú Siōng-tè hō͘ hit-ê lâng khùn tāng-bîn, i chiū khùn. Chú Siōng-tè tùi hit-ê lâng the̍h chi̍t ki hia̍p-kut, koh hō͘ hit-ūi ê bah ha̍p--khí-lâi.
Chú Siōng-tè chiū ēng hit-ki hia̍p-kut chō chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-lâng, chhōa i lâi kàu hit-ê lâng hia.
Hit-ê lâng kóng, “Chit-ê chiah sī góa kut-lāi ê kut, bah-lāi ê bah; thang chheng i chòe cha-bó͘-lâng, in-ūi i sī tùi ta-po͘-lâng the̍h-chhut--ê.”
Án-ni, lâng beh lī-khui i ê pē-bú, kap i ê bó͘ kiat-liân, nn̄g lâng chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé.
Ang-bó͘ nn̄g lâng chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, bô kám-kak kiàn-siàu.

Chú Siōng-tè só͘ chō iá-tōe it-chhè ê tōng-bu̍t, chôa siōng khúi-khiat. Chôa tùi hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Siōng-tè kiám ū-iáⁿ kóng, hn̂g-lāi só͘-ū ê ké-chí lín lóng bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h?”
Hū-jîn-lâng tùi chôa kóng, “Hn̂g-lāi só͘-ū ê ké-chí goán lóng thang chia̍h,
chí-ū hn̂g-tiong hit-châng chhiū ê ké-chí, Siōng-tè bat kóng, ‘Lín m̄-thang chia̍h, mā m̄-thang bong; lín nā m̄ thiaⁿ, lín ōe sí.’”
Chôa tùi hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Lín bô it-tēng ōe sí.
Siōng-tè chai, lín chia̍h ê sî, lín ê ba̍k-chiu chiū ōe khui, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè hun-pia̍t siān-ok.”

Hū-jîn-lâng khòaⁿ hit-châng chhiū ê ké-chí hó-chia̍h, kah-ba̍k, koh ōe hō͘ lâng ū tì-hūi, chiū chin him-siān. I chiū bán hit-ê ké-chí lâi chia̍h, sòa hō͘ kap i chòe-hé ê tiōng-hu chia̍h, i ê tiōng-hu mā chia̍h.
In nn̄g ê lâng ê ba̍k-chiu chiū khui, chiah chai ka-kī sī chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, chiū pīⁿ bû-hoa-kó chhiū-hio̍h chòe kûn hâ--teh.

Hông-hun liâng-léng ê sî, hit-ê lâng kap i ê hū-jîn-lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Chú Siōng-tè tī hn̂g-lāi teh kiâⁿ ê siaⁿ, chiū bih tī hn̂g--ni̍h ê chhiū-á lāi, siám-pī Chú Siōng-tè ê bīn.
Chú Siōng-tè kiò hit-ê lâng, kóng, “Lí tī tó-ūi?”
Hit-ê lâng chiū kóng, “Góa tī hn̂g-lāi thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê siaⁿ chiū chin kiaⁿ, in-ūi góa chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, chiū bih--khí-lâi.”
Chú Siōng-tè chiū mn̄g, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng kā lí kóng lí chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé? Lí sī m̄-sī chia̍h góa hoan-hù lí m̄-thang chia̍h hit-châng chhiū ê ké-chí?”
Hit-ê lâng kóng, “Lí hō͘ góa kap góa chòe-hé hit-ê cha-bó͘-lâng, i the̍h hit-châng chhiū ê ké-chí hō͘ góa, góa chiū chia̍h.”
Chú Siōng-tè tùi hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Lí ná ōe án-ni chòe?” Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Chôa kā góa ín-iú, góa chiū chia̍h.”

Chú Siōng-tè tùi chôa kóng, “Lí kì-jiân chòe chit-ê tāi-chì, tī it-chhè ê cheng-siⁿ kap iá-tōe ê cháu-siù, lí te̍k-pia̍t tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘; lí beh ēng pak-tó͘ kiâⁿ-lō͘, it-seng chia̍h thô͘-hún.
Góa beh hō͘ lí kap hū-jîn-lâng kiat oan-siû, lí ê hō͘-tāi kap i ê hō͘-tāi mā kiat oan-siû; i beh siong lí ê thâu-khak, lí beh siong i ê kha-āu-tiⁿ.”
Koh tùi hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Góa beh tōa-tōa ke-thiⁿ lí hoâi-īn ê thòng-khó͘; lí beh chhui-chūn thòng-khó͘ chiah siⁿ-kiáⁿ; lí beh loân-bō͘ lí ê tiōng-hu, i beh koán-hat lí.”

Chú Siōng-tè mā tùi A-tong kóng, “Lí kì-jiân thiaⁿ-thàn lí ê bó͘ ê ōe, chia̍h góa hoan-hù lí m̄-thang chia̍h hit-châng chhiū ê ké-chí, só͘-í thó͘-tōe in-ūi lí ê iân-kò͘ siū chiù-chó͘; lí tio̍h chi̍t-sì-lâng lô-khó͘, chiah ōe-tàng tùi thó͘-tōe tit-tio̍h chia̍h-mi̍h.
Thó͘-tōe beh in-ūi lí hoat chhì-phè kap chi̍t-lê; lí beh chia̍h iá-tōe ê chhài-soe.
Lí tio̍h kōaⁿ-lâu-móa-bīn chiah ū thang chia̍h, kàu lí kui-thó͘, in-ūi lí sī tùi thô͘ lia̍p-chō--ê; lí pún sī thô͘-hún, mā beh kui tī thô͘-hún.”
Hit-ê lâng kā i ê bó͘ hō-miâ kiò-chòe Hā-oa; in-ūi i sī jîn-lūi ê lāu-bú.
Chú Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h A-tong kap i ê bó͘ ēng phê chòe saⁿ hō͘ in chhēng.

Chú Siōng-tè kóng, “Taⁿ, chit-ê lâng í-keng kap lán siâng-khoán, ōe hun-pia̍t siān-ok; i nā chhun-chhiú khì bán oa̍h-miā-chhiū ê ké-chí lâi chia̍h, chiū ōe oa̍h kàu éng-oán.”
Chú Siōng-tè chiū chiong i kóaⁿ-chhut I-tiân-hn̂g, hō͘ i khì chèng-choh thó͘-tōe; i sī tùi thô͘ lia̍p-chō--chhut-lâi--ê.

Chú Siōng-tè chiong hit-ê lâng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì í-āu, tī I-tiân-hn̂g ê tang-pêng siat sì-bīn tńg-se̍h hoat hé-iām ê kiàm, phài thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek hông-siú khì oa̍h-miā-chhiū ê lō͘.
Hit-ê lâng kap i ê bó͘ Hā-oa tâng-pâng, Hā-oa chiū hoâi-īn siⁿ Kai-ún, kóng, “Góa tùi Siōng Chú ê pang-chān tit-tio̍h chi̍t ê hāu-siⁿ.”
Āu-lâi Hā-oa koh siⁿ Kai-ún ê sió-tī A-pek. A-pek sī kò͘-iûⁿ--ê, Kai-ún sī choh-sit--ê.
Kè chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan, Kai-ún the̍h chi̍t-kóa thó͘-tōe ê chhut-sán hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
A-pek mā chiong iûⁿ-kûn tiong thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ koh pûi ê iûⁿ hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. Siōng Chú ì-ài A-pek kap i ê lé-mi̍h,
m̄-kú bô kah-ì Kai-ún kap i ê lé-mi̍h. Kai-ún chiū chin siū-khì, pìⁿ-bīn.
Siōng Chú tùi Kai-ún kóng, “Lí sī teh siū-khì sím-mi̍h? Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ pìⁿ-bīn?
Lí nā hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t, kiám m̄-sī ōe tit-tio̍h chiap-la̍p? Nā bô, chōe tī mn̂g-kháu tng-tán lí; i beh khòng-chè lí, lí tio̍h kā i chè-ho̍k.”
Kai-ún tùi i ê sió-tī A-pek kóng, “Lán lâi-khì iá-tōe.” Tī iá-tōe ê sî, Kai-ún kong-kek i ê sió-tī, kā i thâi-sí.
Siōng Chú tùi Kai-ún kóng, “Lí ê sió-tī A-pek tī tó-ūi?” I kóng, “Góa m̄ chai. Góa kiám sī teh kò͘-siú góa ê sió-tī ê lâng?”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí ná ōe chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì? Lín sió-tī ê huih tùi tōe--ni̍h tùi góa ai-kiò.
Lí thâi-sí lín sió-tī, tōe khui-chhùi chiap-siū i ê huih. Taⁿ lí beh tùi thó͘-tōe siū chiù-chó͘.
Lí chèng-choh, bōe-tàng tit-tio̍h siu-sêng; lí beh tī tōe-chiūⁿ liû-lî-sit-só͘.”
Kai-ún tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa ê hêng-hoa̍t siuⁿ tāng, góa tam-tng bōe khí.
Lí kin-á-ji̍t kóaⁿ góa lī-khui chit-ê tōe, bōe-tàng koh kìⁿ lí ê bīn; góa sì-kòe phiau-liû, tú-tio̍h góa--ê ōe kā góa thâi-sí.”

Siōng Chú tùi i kóng, “Kì-jiân án-ni, thâi-sí Kai-ún --ê, ōe siū chhit pē ê pò-èng.” Siōng Chú chiū kā Kai-ún chòe chi̍t ê kì-hō, chiah bián tú-tio̍h i ê lâng kā i thâi-sí.
Kai-ún chiū lī-khui Siōng Chú, khì tòa tī I-tiân ê tang-pêng Lô-tek ê tōe-khu.
Kai-ún kap i ê bó͘ tâng-pâng; i ê bó͘ hoâi-īn siⁿ Í-lo̍k. Āu-lâi Kai-ún khí chi̍t chō siâⁿ, ēng i ê kiáⁿ ê miâ kā hit-chō siâⁿ hō-miâ kiò-chòe Í-lo̍k.
Í-lo̍k siⁿ Í-ná, Í-ná siⁿ Bí-hō͘-ngá-lī, Bí-hō͘-ngá-lī siⁿ Má-thó͘-sat-lī, Má-thó͘-sat-lī siⁿ La-be̍k.
La-be̍k chhōa nn̄g ê bó͘; chi̍t ê kiò-chòe A-tāi, chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Sé-la.
A-tāi siⁿ Ngá-pat, sī iû-bo̍k bîn-cho̍k ê chó͘-sian.
I ê sió-tī Iû-pat, sī tôaⁿ-khîm pûn-siau ê lâng ê chó͘-sian.
Sé-la siⁿ Thó͘-pat Kai-ún, sī chè-chō tâng, thih ta̍k-khoán khì-khū ê lâng ê chó͘-sian; Thó͘-pat Kai-ún ê sió-bē sī Ná-má.
La-be̍k tùi i nn̄g ê bó͘ kóng: A-tāi kap Sé-la, thiaⁿ góa kóng; La-be̍k ê bó͘, tio̍h sòe-jī thiaⁿ: Lâng siong góa, góa beh thâi i; siàu-liân-lâng hāi góa, góa beh hō͘ i sí.
Thâi Kai-ún ê pò-èng nā-sī chhit pē, thâi-sí La-be̍k ê pò-èng it-tēng chhit-cha̍p-chhit pē.

A-tong koh kap i ê bó͘ tâng-pâng; i ê bó͘ siⁿ-kiáⁿ, kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Sài-te̍k; in-ūi i kóng, “Siōng-tè koh sù góa chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, lâi tāi-thòe hō͘ Kai-ún thâi-sí ê A-pek.”
Sài-te̍k āu-lâi mā siⁿ-kiáⁿ, kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Í-ná-sū; hit-sî lâng chiah khai-sí kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê miâ.
Ē-bīn sī A-tong ê hō͘-tāi. Siōng-tè chhòng-chō lâng ê sî, sī chiàu I ka-kī ê khoán-sit chhòng-chō.
I chhòng-chō in ū lâm ū lú; tī in siū chhòng-chō ê sî, sù in hok-khì, chheng in chòe Jîn-lūi.
A-tong chi̍t-pah saⁿ-cha̍p hè ê sî siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, kap i ê hêng-siōng khoán-sit chin sio-siâng, kā i hō-miâ kiò Sài-te̍k.
A-tong siⁿ Sài-te̍k liáu-āu, koh oa̍h poeh-pah nî; chit tiong-kan ū koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
A-tong chóng-kiōng oa̍h káu-pah saⁿ-cha̍p hè chiah sí.
Sài-te̍k chi̍t-pah khòng gō͘ hè ê sî siⁿ Í-ná-sū.
Sài-te̍k siⁿ Í-ná-sū liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h poeh-pah khòng chhit nî; hit tiong-kan ū koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Sài-te̍k chóng-kiōng oa̍h káu-pah cha̍p-jī hè chiah sí.
Í-ná-sū káu-cha̍p hè ê sî siⁿ Kai-lâm.
Í-ná-sū siⁿ Kai-lâm liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h poeh-pah cha̍p-gō͘ nî; hit tiong-kan ū koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Í-ná-sū chóng-kiōng oa̍h káu-pah khòng gō͘ hè chiah sí.
Kai-lâm chhit-cha̍p hè ê sî siⁿ Má-le̍k-lia̍t.
Kai-lâm siⁿ Má-le̍k-lia̍t liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h poeh-pah sì-cha̍p nî; hit tiong-kan ū koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Kai-lâm chóng-kiōng oa̍h káu-pah cha̍p hè chiah sí.
Má-le̍k-lia̍t la̍k-cha̍p gō͘ hè ê sî siⁿ Ngá-lia̍t.
Má-le̍k-lia̍t siⁿ Ngá-lia̍t liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h poeh-pah saⁿ-cha̍p nî; hit tiong-kan ū koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Má-le̍k-lia̍t chóng-kiōng oa̍h poeh-pah káu-cha̍p gō͘ hè chiah sí.
Ngá-lia̍t chi̍t-pah la̍k-cha̍p jī hè ê sî siⁿ Í-lo̍k.
Ngá-lia̍t siⁿ Í-lo̍k liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h poeh-pah nî; hit tiong-kan ū koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Ngá-lia̍t chóng-kiōng oa̍h káu-pah la̍k-cha̍p jī hè chiah sí.
Í-lo̍k la̍k-cha̍p gō͘ hè ê sî siⁿ Má-thó͘-sat-la.
Í-lo̍k siⁿ Má-thó͘-sat-la liáu-āu, kap Siōng-tè tâng-kiâⁿ saⁿ-pah nî; hit tiong-kan ū koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Í-lo̍k chóng-kiōng oa̍h saⁿ-pah la̍k-cha̍p gō͘ hè.
Í-lo̍k kap Siōng-tè tâng-kiâⁿ; Siōng-tè chiap i khì, lâng chiū bōe-tàng koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h i.
Má-thó͘-sat-la chi̍t-pah poeh-cha̍p chhit hè ê sî siⁿ La-be̍k.
Má-thó͘-sat-la siⁿ La-be̍k liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h chhit-pah poeh-cha̍p jī nî; hit tiong-kan ū koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Má-thó͘-sat-la chóng-kiōng oa̍h káu-pah la̍k-cha̍p káu hè chiah sí.
La-be̍k chi̍t-pah poeh-cha̍p jī hè ê sî siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ,
kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Ná-a; i kóng, “Chit-ê kiáⁿ beh an-ùi lán, in-ūi Siōng Chú bat chiù-chó͘ tōe, hō͘ lán tio̍h chòe kang lô-khó͘.”
La-be̍k siⁿ Ná-a liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h gō͘-pah káu-cha̍p gō͘ nî; hit tiong-kan ū koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
La-be̍k chóng-kiōng oa̍h chhit-pah chhit-cha̍p-chhit hè chiah sí.
Ná-a gō͘-pah hè í-āu, ū siⁿ Siám, Hâm, kap Ngá-hut.
Jîn-lūi tī tōe-chiūⁿ lâng-gia̍h ná ke-thiⁿ, mā ū siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ khòaⁿ-tio̍h lâng ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ súi, chiū kéng ka-kī ì-ài--ê lâi chòe bó͘.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Lâng kì-jiân sio̍k ōe-sí ê jio̍k-thé, góa ê sîn chiū bô beh éng-oán tòa tī in lāi-bīn, in ê hè-siū ōe-tàng kàu chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p hè.”
Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ kap lâng ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tâng-pâng siⁿ-kiáⁿ; tùi hit-sî khí, sè-kan chiū ū tōa-hàn-lâng, in sī kó͘-chá chhut-miâ ê eng-hiông.
Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lâng tī sè-kan hoān-chōe chin tāng, ta̍k-ji̍t ê sim-su ì-liām lóng sī siâ-ok,
chiū in-ūi I chō lâng tī sè-kan, kám-kak ûi-hām, sim kan-khó͘.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh tùi sè-kan châu-bia̍t góa só͘ chhòng-chō ê lâng, mā beh siau-bia̍t cháu-siù, teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t, kap pe-chiáu, in-ūi góa chō in liáu-āu kám-kak ûi-hām.”
Chí-ū Ná-a tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê un-tián.
Ē-bīn sī iú-koan Ná-a ê kì-sū. Ná-a sī gī-lâng, tī hit sè-tāi ê lâng tiong-kan sī sûn-choân chèng-ti̍t ê lâng; Ná-a kap Siōng-tè tâng-kiâⁿ.
Ná-a ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Siám, Hâm, kap Ngá-hut.
Sè-kài tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng pāi-hoāi, chhiong-móa kiông-pō.
Siōng-tè khòaⁿ sè-kài lóng pāi-hoāi, in-ūi lâng tī sè-kan ê kiâⁿ-chòe siâ-ok.
Siōng-tè tùi Ná-a kóng, “Góa koat-tēng beh siau-bia̍t só͘-ū ê oa̍h-mi̍h, in-ūi in ê kiông-pō chhiong-móa sè-kan, góa beh chiong in kap tāi-tōe chòe-chi̍t-ē húi-bia̍t.
Lí tio̍h ēng chhêng-pek-chhâ chòe tōa-chûn, chûn-lāi keh pâng-keng, lāi-gōa kô͘ táⁿ-má-ka.
Lí tio̍h án-ni chō tōa-chûn: Tn̂g chi̍t-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-saⁿ kong-chhioh, khoah jī-cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh, koân cha̍p-saⁿ kong-chhioh.
Tio̍h chòe thiⁿ-thang, koân sì-cha̍p-sì kong-hun; mn̂g choh tī chûn-piⁿ; chûn tio̍h chòe saⁿ chàn, hun siōng, tiong, hā.
Góa beh hō͘ tāi-tōe tōa-chúi hoàn-lām, húi-bia̍t thiⁿ-ē só͘-ū ê oa̍h-mi̍h; tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ê seng-bu̍t lóng ōe sí.
M̄-kú góa beh kap lí li̍p-iok. Lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ, lí ê bó͘, lí ê sin-pū lóng tio̍h ji̍p-khì tōa-chûn lāi-bīn.
Só͘-ū ê oa̍h-mi̍h, ta̍k-chióng chi̍t tùi, chi̍t chiah kang--ê, chi̍t chiah bú--ê, lí tio̍h tòa in ji̍p tōa-chûn, hō͘ in kap lín chòe-hé pó-choân sìⁿ-miā.
Pe-chiáu, cheng-siⁿ, kap teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t, kok chiàu in ê chióng-lūi, chi̍t-tùi chi̍t-tùi chhōa-ji̍p chûn, pó-choân in ê sìⁿ-miā.
Lí tio̍h ūi-tio̍h lín kap hiah-ê tōng-bu̍t chek-chū ta̍k-khoán ê chia̍h-mi̍h.”
Ná-a chiū lóng chiàu Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng khì chòe.
Siōng Chú tùi Ná-a kóng, “Lí kap lín choân-ke lóng tio̍h ji̍p tōa-chûn; in-ūi chit sè-tāi ê lâng kan-ta lí tī góa ê bīn-chêng sī gī-lâng.
Só͘-ū lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì ê cheng-siⁿ, lí tio̍h tòa chhit chiah kang--ê, chhit chiah bú--ê; bô chheng-khì ê cheng-siⁿ, lí tio̍h tòa chi̍t chiah kang--ê, chi̍t chiah bú--ê.
Pe-chiáu mā tio̍h tòa chhit chiah kang--ê, chhit chiah bú--ê, thang tī choân-tōe thoân-chéng.
Koh kè chhit ji̍t, góa beh lo̍h-hō͘ sì-cha̍p mî sì-cha̍p ji̍t, chiong góa só͘ chō it-chhè ê oa̍h-mi̍h lóng tùi tōe-chiūⁿ châu-bia̍t.”
Ná-a chiū lóng chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng khì chòe.
Tōa-chúi tī tōe-chiūⁿ hoàn-lām ê sî, Ná-a la̍k-pah hè.
Ná-a kap i ê kiáⁿ, i ê bó͘, i ê sin-pū, lóng ji̍p tōa-chûn, siám-pī tōa-chúi.
Lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì ê cheng-siⁿ kap bô chheng-khì ê cheng-siⁿ, pe-chiáu, kap tōe-chiūⁿ teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t,
lóng chi̍t-tùi chi̍t-tùi, ū kang--ê ū bú--ê, khì Ná-a hia, chiàu Siōng-tè tùi Ná-a ê bēng-lēng chìn-ji̍p tōa-chûn.
Chhit ji̍t āu, tōa-chúi tī tōe-chiūⁿ hoàn-lām.
Ná-a la̍k-pah hè hit-nî ê jī-ge̍h cha̍p-chhit hit-ji̍t, chhim-ian ê chúi-goân li̍h--khui, thiⁿ-téng ê chúi-mn̂g lóng phah-khui.
Hō͘ lo̍h sì-cha̍p mî sì-cha̍p ji̍t.
Chiū tī hit-ji̍t, Ná-a kap i ê kiáⁿ, Siám, Hâm, Ngá-hut, kap Ná-a ê bó͘, í-ki̍p i saⁿ ê sin-pū lóng ji̍p tōa-chûn;
só͘-ū ê iá-siù, cheng-siⁿ, teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t, ū-si̍t ê oa̍h-mi̍h, í-ki̍p pe-chiáu, kok chiàu in ê chióng-lūi, lóng kap Ná-a choân-ke chìn-ji̍p tōa-chûn.
It-chhè ū sìⁿ-miā ê oa̍h-mi̍h lóng chi̍t-tùi chi̍t-tùi khì Ná-a hia, chìn-ji̍p tōa-chûn.
Só͘-ū ji̍p tōa-chûn ê tōng-bu̍t, chiàu Siōng-tè tùi Ná-a ê bēng-lēng, ū kang--ê ū bú--ê; Siōng Chú chiū kā tōa-chûn ê mn̂g koaiⁿ--khí-lâi.
Chúi tī tōe-chiūⁿ hoàn-lām sì-cha̍p ji̍t; chúi tiòng-koân, chiong tōa-chûn thìⁿ--khí-lâi, hō͘ chûn tùi tōe-bīn phû--khí-lâi.
Chúi-sè chin tōa, tī tōe-chiūⁿ ti̍t-ti̍t tiòng--khí-lâi; chûn tī chúi-bīn phiau-liû.
Chúi jú-tiòng jú-koân, kā thiⁿ-ē ê koân-soaⁿ lóng im--kè.
Chúi pí soaⁿ koân chhit kong-chhioh; soaⁿ-thâu lóng hō͘ chúi im-liáu-liáu.
Tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ê oa̍h-mi̍h, pau-koat pe-chiáu, cheng-siⁿ, iá-siù, kui-kûn teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t, í-ki̍p só͘-ū ê lâng, lóng sí.
Só͘-ū tī tōe-chiūⁿ ēng phīⁿ-khang chhoán-khùi ê oa̍h-mi̍h lóng sí.

Tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ê oa̍h-mi̍h lóng siū siau-bia̍t; lâng kap cheng-siⁿ, teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t, í-ki̍p khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu, lóng tùi tōe-chiūⁿ siau-bia̍t; chí-ū chhun Ná-a í-ki̍p hiah-ê kap i tī tōa-chûn lāi-bīn--ê iáu oa̍h--teh.
Tōa-chúi tī tōe-chiūⁿ hoàn-lām chi̍t-pah gō͘-cha̍p ji̍t.
Siōng-tè bô bōe-kì-tit Ná-a, í-ki̍p kap Ná-a tī tōa-chûn lāi-bīn ê cheng-siⁿ kap iá-siù; Siōng-tè hō͘ hong chhe tāi-tōe, chúi chiū chiām-chiām siau-thè.
Chhim-ian ê chúi-goân kap thiⁿ-téng ê chúi-mn̂g lóng koaiⁿ-ba̍t; thiⁿ bô koh lo̍h-hō͘.
Chúi tùi tōe-chiūⁿ chiām-chiām thè--khì; chi̍t-pah gō͘-cha̍p ji̍t āu, chúi ti̍t-ti̍t siau-thè.
Chhit-ge̍h cha̍p-chhit, chûn tiâu tī A-la-la̍h-soaⁿ.
Chúi koh chiām-chiām thè, it-ti̍t kàu cha̍p--ge̍h. Cha̍p-ge̍h chhoe-it, soaⁿ-thâu chiah chhut-hiān.
Kè sì-cha̍p ji̍t, Ná-a khui i só͘ chòe tōa-chûn ê thang-á,
pàng chi̍t chiah o͘-a chhut--khì; o͘-a pe--lâi koh pe--khì, it-ti̍t kàu tāi-tōe ê chúi siau-thè.
I koh pàng chi̍t chiah hún-chiáu chhut--khì, beh khòaⁿ chúi tùi tōe-bīn siau-thè á bē.
M̄-kú hún-chiáu chhē bô hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi, chiū pe tńg-lâi tōa-chûn Ná-a hia, in-ūi choân-tōe iáu ū chúi. Ná-a chhun-chhiú chiap i, tòa-ji̍p tōa-chûn.
Chhit ji̍t āu, Ná-a koh pàng hún-chiáu chhut--khì.
Kàu ē-hng, hún-chiáu tò-lâi i hia, chhùi kā chi̍t hio̍h sin ê kaⁿ-ná-chhiū-hio̍h; Ná-a chiah chai, chúi í-keng siau-thè.
I koh thèng-hāu chhit ji̍t, pàng hún-chiáu chhut--khì; hún-chiáu chiū bô koh tò--lâi.
Kàu Ná-a la̍k-pah khòng chi̍t hè, chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-it, tōe-bīn ê chúi lóng ta; Ná-a phah-khui tōa-chûn ê kòa, khòaⁿ-tio̍h tōe-bīn í-keng ta.
Jī-ge̍h jī-chhit, thó͘-tōe lóng ta lah.
Siōng-tè tùi Ná-a kóng,
“Lí kap lí ê bó͘, lí ê kiáⁿ, lí ê sin-pū lóng tio̍h chhut tōa-chûn.
Lí mā tio̍h hō͘ hiah-ê ū jio̍k-thé ê oa̍h-mi̍h, pau-koat pe-chiáu, cheng-siⁿ, kap teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t lóng chhut--lâi, hō͘ in tī tōe-chiūⁿ siⁿ-thòaⁿ, ke-thiⁿ chin chōe.”
Ná-a chiū kap i ê kiáⁿ, i ê bó͘, i ê sin-pū lóng chhut--lâi;
só͘-ū ê cháu-siù, pe-chiáu, teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t, kap tōe-chiūⁿ it-chhè ê oa̍h-mi̍h, kok chiàu in ê chióng-lūi mā lóng chhut tōa-chûn.
Ná-a ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ; tùi lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì ê cheng-siⁿ kap pe-chiáu tiong-kan, tòa chi̍t-pō͘-hūn lâi tī chè-tôaⁿ téng hiàn-chòe sio-hòa-chè.

Siōng Chú phīⁿ-tio̍h chè-mi̍h ê phang-bī, sim-lāi chiū kóng, “Góa bô beh koh in-ūi lâng ê iân-kò͘ chiù-chó͘ thó͘-tōe, sui-jiân lâng tùi sòe-hàn sim só͘ siūⁿ--ê lóng sī pháiⁿ; góa bô beh koh chiàu góa í-chêng só͘ chòe--ê húi-bia̍t só͘-ū ê oa̍h-mi̍h.
Tāi-tōe nā iáu chûn-chāi, chai-chèng siu-sêng, kôaⁿ joa̍h, tang-thiⁿ hē-thiⁿ, ji̍t--sî mî--sî, lóng ōe kè-sio̍k.”
Siōng-tè sù-hok Ná-a kap i ê kiáⁿ, tùi in kóng, “Tio̍h siⁿ-thòaⁿ, ke-thiⁿ chin chōe, chhiong-móa choân-tōe.
Tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ê iá-siù, thiⁿ-téng ê pe-chiáu, tōe-bīn teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t, kap hái--ni̍h ê hî-lūi lóng ōe kiaⁿ lín, ùi lín, siū lín koán-lí.
Góa chiong só͘-ū oa̍h ê tōng-bu̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhài-soe kâng-khoán hō͘ lín chòe chia̍h-mi̍h.
M̄-kú ū sìⁿ-miā ê bah, chiū-sī ū kâⁿ-huih ê bah, lín m̄-thang chia̍h.
Lâu lín ê huih ê lâng, chiū-sī sat-hāi lín sìⁿ-miā ê lâng, góa beh kā in chhú-sí; góa beh chiong hāi lín sìⁿ-miā ê iá-siù, lâng, sīm-chì lín ê tông-pau chhú-sí.
Só͘-ū lâu lâng ê huih ê lâng, lâng mā beh lâu i ê huih; in-ūi Siōng-tè chiàu I ka-kī ê hêng-siōng chō lâng.
Lín tio̍h siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe, tī tōe-chiūⁿ heng-ōng, ke-thiⁿ chin chōe.”
Siōng-tè kā Ná-a kap i ê kiáⁿ kóng,
“Taⁿ, góa kap lín í-ki̍p lín ê hō͘-tāi li̍p-iok;
mā kap hiah-ê kap lín chòe-hé, tùi tōa-chûn chhut--lâi ê oa̍h-mi̍h, pau-koat pe-chiáu, cheng-siⁿ, iá-siù li̍p-iok.
Góa kap lín li̍p-iok: Só͘-ū ū jio̍k-thé ê seng-bu̍t, bōe koh hō͘ tōa-chúi siau-bia̍t, mā bōe koh ū tōa-chúi húi-hoāi choân-tōe.”
Siōng-tè koh kóng, “Góa beh kap lín, í-ki̍p só͘-ū kap lín chòe-hé ê seng-bu̍t li̍p éng-oán ê iok; góa beh hō͘ khēng chhut-hiān tī hûn--ni̍h, chòe li̍p-iok ê kì-hō.
Góa hō͘ hûn jia tōe, khēng chhut-hiān tī hûn--ni̍h ê sî,
góa chiū kì-liām góa kap lín í-ki̍p ta̍k-khoán ū jio̍k-thé ê seng-bu̍t só͘ li̍p ê iok, bōe koh hō͘ chúi hoàn-lām, húi-bia̍t só͘-ū ê seng-bu̍t.
Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h khēng tī hûn--ni̍h chhut-hiān, chiū kì-liām góa kap tōe-chiūⁿ ta̍k-khoán ū jio̍k-thé ê seng-bu̍t só͘ li̍p éng-oán ê iok.”
Siōng-tè tùi Ná-a kóng, “Che chiū-sī góa kap tōe-chiūⁿ ta̍k-khoán ū jio̍k-thé ê seng-bu̍t li̍p-iok ê kì-hō.”
Ná-a ê kiáⁿ, tùi tōa-chûn chhut--lâi-ê, chiū-sī Siám, Hâm, Ngá-hut; Hâm sī Ka-lâm ê lāu-pē.
Chit saⁿ ê sī Ná-a ê kiáⁿ; in ê hō͘-tāi hun-sòaⁿ khì choân sè-kài.
Ná-a sī tē-it ê chai-chèng phû-tô ê choh-sit-lâng.
Ná-a lim chiú-chùi, tī pò͘-pîⁿ lāi chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé.
Ka-lâm ê lāu-pē Hâm khòaⁿ-tio̍h in lāu-pē chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, khì kā tī gōa-bīn nn̄g ê hiaⁿ-tī kóng.
Siám kap Ngá-hut the̍h chi̍t niá saⁿ, khòa tī in ê keng-thâu téng, tò-thè kiâⁿ, jia in lāu-pē ê seng-khu; in ê bīn ǹg gōa-bīn, bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h in lāu-pē chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé.
Ná-a chiú-chùi chhíⁿ, chiah chai sòe-hàn-kiáⁿ ê só͘-chòe,
chiū kóng: Ka-lâm tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘; i beh chòe i ê hiaⁿ-tī siōng pi-chiān ê lô͘-lē.
Ná-a koh kóng: Tio̍h o-ló Siōng Chú — Siám ê Siōng-tè; Ka-lâm beh chòe Siám ê lô͘-lē.
Goān Siōng-tè hō͘ Ngá-hut khok-tián, hō͘ i tòa tī Siám ê pò͘-pîⁿ; Ka-lâm chòe in ê lô͘-lē.
Tōa-chúi liáu-āu, Ná-a iáu oa̍h saⁿ-pah gō͘-cha̍p nî.
Ná-a chóng-kiōng oa̍h káu-pah gō͘-cha̍p hè chiah sí.
Ē-bīn sī Ná-a ê kiáⁿ Siám, Hâm, Ngá-hut ê hō͘-tāi. Tōa-chúi í-āu, in ū siⁿ kiáⁿ-jî-sun.
Ngá-hut ê kiáⁿ sī Ko-bia̍t, Má-kok, Má-tāi, Ngá-oân, Thó͘-pa, Bí-siat, Thê-la.
Ko-bia̍t ê kiáⁿ sī A-si̍t-ki-ná, Lī-hoat, Tô-ka-má.
Ngá-oân ê kiáⁿ sī Í-lī-sa, Tha-si, Ki-thê -lâng, Lô-tek -lâng.
Chiah-ê lâng ê hō͘-tāi, kok chiàu in ê gú-giân, chong-cho̍k, pang-kok, hun-sòaⁿ khiā-khí tī iân-hái tōe-khu.
Hâm ê kiáⁿ sī Kó͘-si̍t, Ai-ki̍p, Hut, Ka-lâm.
Kó͘-si̍t ê kiáⁿ sī Se-pa, Hap-hui-la, Sat-hut-tha, La-má, Sat-hut-thê-ka. La-má ê kiáⁿ sī Sī-pa, Tí-tān.
Kó͘-si̍t koh siⁿ Lêng-lio̍k; i sī sè-kan tē-it ê ióng-sū.

I in-ūi Siōng Chú ê pang-chān chiâⁿ-chòe gâu phah-la̍h ê ióng-sū; só͘-í sio̍k-gú kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú hō͘ lí chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê chhin-chhiūⁿ Lêng-lio̍k hiah-ni̍h gâu phah-la̍h ê ióng-sū.”
Lêng-lio̍k thóng-tī ê hoān-ûi tāi-seng sī Sī-ná tōe-khu, pau-koat Pa-pia̍t, Í-le̍k, A-kah, kap Kah-nî,
āu-lâi khok-tián kàu A-su̍t. I ū khí-chō Nî-nî-bî, Lī-hô-pek, Ka-la,
í-ki̍p tī Nî-nî-bî kap Ka-la tiong-kan ê tōa-siâⁿ Lī-sián.
Ai-ki̍p siⁿ Lō͘-te -lâng, A-ná-bí -lâng, Lī-hap-pí -lâng, Ná-hut-thó͘-hi -lâng,
Phà-su-ló͘-sòe -lâng, Ka-su-lō͘-hi -lâng, kap Ka-hui-thok -lâng; Hui-lī-sū -lâng sī chit-cho̍k ê hō͘-tāi.
Ka-lâm siⁿ tōa-kiáⁿ Se-tùn, kap Hek,
Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Kek-ka-sat -lâng,
Hi-bī -lâng, A-ki -lâng, Se-nî -lâng,
A-óa-tí -lâng, Sé-má-lī -lâng, kap Hap-má -lâng; āu-lâi Ka-lâm chiah-ê cho̍k hun-sòaⁿ chin khoah.
Ka-lâm ê kéng-kài sī tùi Se-tùn ǹg Ki-la-ní ê lō͘, kàu Ka-sat; koh ǹg Só͘-to-má, Gô-mô͘-la, Ap-má, Sé-pián ê lō͘, kàu La-sa.
Che chiū-sī Hâm ê hō͘-tāi, kok chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, gú-giân, thó͘-tōe, pang-kok khiā-khí.
Ngá-hut ê hiaⁿ-ko Siám sī Hi-pek choân-cho̍k ê chó͘-sian, mā ū siⁿ kiáⁿ-jî-sun.
Siám ê kiáⁿ sī Í-lân, A-su̍t, A-hoat-sat, Lō͘-tek, kap A-lân.
A-lân ê kiáⁿ sī O͘-su, Hō͘-le̍k, Ki-thiap, kap Bí-siat.
A-hoat-sat siⁿ Sa-la; Sa-la siⁿ Hi-pek.
Hi-pek siⁿ nn̄g ê kiáⁿ; chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Hoat-le̍k, in-ūi tī i ê sî-tāi lâng hun-sòaⁿ tī ta̍k só͘-chāi khiā-khí; Hoat-le̍k ê sió-tī kiò-chòe Iok-tan.
Iok-tan siⁿ A-mô͘-tap, Sa-lia̍t, Hap-sat-má-hui, Iâ-la,
Hap-to-lân, O͘-sat, Tek-la,
Gô-pa-lō͘, A-pí-má-lī, Sī-pa,
Gô-hui, Hap-hui-la, Iok-pa; chiah-ê lóng sī Iok-tan ê kiáⁿ.
In khiā-khí tī Bí-sa kàu Se-hoat tang-pêng ê soaⁿ-khu.
Chiah-ê sī Siám ê hō͘-tāi; in chiàu ka-kī ê chong-cho̍k, gú-giân, thó͘-tōe, pang-kok khiā-khí.
Chiah-ê lóng sī Ná-a ê kiáⁿ ê chong-cho̍k, kok chiàu in ê sè-hē, kiàn-li̍p ka-kī ê kok-ka; tōa-chúi í-āu, in tī tōe-chiūⁿ pun-chòe chin chōe pang-kok.
Hit-sî, thiⁿ-ē ê khiuⁿ-kháu kap gú-giân lóng kâng-khoán.
In ǹg tang-pêng chhian-sóa ê sî, tī Sī-ná -tōe hoat-kiàn chi̍t phiàn pêng-goân, chiū tī hia khiā-khí.
In hō͘-siōng chham-siông kóng, “Lâi! Lán tio̍h lâi chòe chng-á, sio hō͘ thàu.” In chiū ēng chng-á tāi-thòe chio̍h-thâu, ēng táⁿ-má-ka tāi-thòe he-thô͘.
In koh kóng, “Lâi! Lán tio̍h lâi khí-siâⁿ chō-thah, thah-téng thàng thiⁿ, hō͘ lán chhut-miâ, chiah bián lán sì-sòaⁿ tī choân-tōe.”
Siōng Chú lo̍h--lâi, beh khòaⁿ sè-kan-lâng khí-chō ê siâⁿ kap thah.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, in sī kâng chi̍t ê bîn-cho̍k, kóng siâng chi̍t ê gú-giân. Taⁿ, in í-keng khai-sí chòe chit-ê sū, í-āu in beh chòe--ê, lóng bōe-tàng kā in chó͘-tòng.
Lâi! Lán lo̍h--lâi-khì, phah-loān in ê gú-giân, hō͘ in ê ōe bōe siong-thong.”
Siōng Chú chiū hō͘ in tùi hia hun-sòaⁿ tī choân-tōe; in chiū thêng-kang, bô khí hit-chō siâⁿ.
Só͘-í hit-ê siâⁿ kiò-chòe Pa-pia̍t, in-ūi Siōng Chú tī hia phah-loān thiⁿ-ē ê gú-giân, koh tùi hia hō͘ lâng hun-sòaⁿ tī choân-tōe.
Ē-bīn sī Siám ê hō͘-tāi: Tōa-chúi í-āu nn̄g nî, Siám chi̍t-pah hè siⁿ A-hoat-sat.
Siám siⁿ A-hoat-sat liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h gō͘-pah nî, koh ū siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
A-hoat-sat saⁿ-cha̍p gō͘ hè siⁿ Sa-la.
A-hoat-sat siⁿ Sa-la liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h sì-pah khòng saⁿ nî, koh ū siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Sa-la saⁿ-cha̍p hè siⁿ Hi-pek.
Sa-la siⁿ Hi-pek liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h sì-pah khòng saⁿ nî, koh ū siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Hi-pek saⁿ-cha̍p sì hè siⁿ Hoat-le̍k.
Hi-pek siⁿ Hoat-le̍k liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h sì-pah saⁿ-cha̍p nî, koh ū siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Hoat-le̍k saⁿ-cha̍p hè siⁿ La-ngô͘.
Hoat-le̍k siⁿ La-ngô͘ liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h nn̄g-pah khòng káu nî, koh ū siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
La-ngô͘ saⁿ-cha̍p jī hè siⁿ Se-lo̍k.
La-ngô͘ siⁿ Se-lo̍k liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h nn̄g-pah khòng chhit nî, koh ū siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Se-lo̍k saⁿ-cha̍p hè siⁿ Ná-ho̍k.
Se-lo̍k siⁿ Ná-ho̍k liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h nn̄g-pah nî, koh ū siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Ná-ho̍k jī-cha̍p káu hè siⁿ Tha-la.
Ná-ho̍k siⁿ Tha-la liáu-āu, iáu oa̍h chi̍t-pah cha̍p-káu nî, koh ū siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Tha-la chhit-cha̍p hè siⁿ A-pek-lân, Ná-ho̍k, Hap-lân.
Ē-bīn sī Tha-la ê hō͘-tāi: Tha-la siⁿ A-pek-lân, Ná-ho̍k, Hap-lân; Hap-lân siⁿ Lô-tek.
Hap-lân tī i ê lāu-pē Tha-la iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî, sí tī kò͘-hiong Pa-pí-lûn ê Ngô͘-ní -siâⁿ.

A-pek-lân kap Ná-ho̍k lóng ū chhōa-bó͘. A-pek-lân ê bó͘ kiò-chòe Sa-lâi; Ná-ho̍k ê bó͘ kiò-chòe Bi̍t-ka, sī Hap-lân ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; Hap-lân sī Bi̍t-ka ê lāu-pē, mā-sī Ia̍h-ka ê lāu-pē.
Sa-lâi bōe seng-io̍k, bô siⁿ-kiáⁿ.

Tha-la chhōa i ê kiáⁿ A-pek-lân kap sun Lô-tek, chiū-sī Hap-lân ê kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p i ê sin-pū Sa-lâi, chiū-sī A-pek-lân ê bó͘, chòe-hé lī-khui Pa-pí-lûn ê Ngô͘-ní -siâⁿ, beh khì Ka-lâm -tōe; in kàu Hap-lân chiū tòa tī hia.
Tha-la oa̍h nn̄g-pah khòng gō͘ hè, sí tī Hap-lân.
Siōng Chú tùi A-pek-lân kóng, “Lí tio̍h lī-khui pún-tōe, pún-cho̍k, lín lāu-pē ê ke, khì góa beh chí-sī lí ê tōe.
Góa beh hō͘ lí chiâⁿ-chòe tōa-kok, beh sù-hok lí, hō͘ lí ê miâ siū kèng-tiōng, lí mā beh hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h hok-khì.
Chiok-hok lí--ê, góa beh sù-hok hō͘ in; chiù-chó͘ lí--ê, góa beh chiù-chó͘ i; tōe-chiūⁿ bān-cho̍k beh in-ūi lí tit-tio̍h hok-khì.”
A-pek-lân chiàu Siōng Chú ê hoan-hù, chiū chhut--khì, Lô-tek mā kap i khì. A-pek-lân lī-khui Hap-lân ê sî chhit-cha̍p gō͘ hè.

A-pek-lân chhōa i ê bó͘ Sa-lâi kap i ê ti̍t-á Lô-tek chhut-hoat, koh tòa in tī Hap-lân só͘ chek-chū ê châi-bu̍t, tit--tio̍h ê po̍k-jîn lú-pī, beh khì Ka-lâm -tōe. In lâi kàu Ka-lâm -tōe,
A-pek-lân kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ, lâi kàu Sī-kiàm ê Mô͘-lī siōng-chhiū hia; hit-sî Ka-lâm -lâng tòa tī hit-ê tōe.
Siōng Chú tùi A-pek-lân hián-hiān, kóng, “Góa beh chiong chit-ê tōe siúⁿ-sù lí ê hō͘-tāi.” I chiū tī hia ūi-tio̍h tùi i hián-hiān ê Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ.

I koh tùi hia sóa kàu Pek-te̍k-lī tang-pêng ê soaⁿ-khu, tah pò͘-pîⁿ, tī hia ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō tôaⁿ, kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê miâ; hit-ê só͘-chāi sai-pêng sī Pek-te̍k-lī, tang-pêng sī Ai.
A-pek-lân chiām-chiām sóa-khì lâm-pêng ê Nî-kek-hu.
Hit-ê tōe ki-hng chin giâm-tiōng. A-pek-lân lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p, kià-ku tī hia.
Teh-beh kàu Ai-ki̍p ê sî, A-pek-lân tùi i ê bó͘ Sa-lâi kóng, “Góa chai lí sī siⁿ-chòe chin súi ê hū-jîn-lâng;
Ai-ki̍p -lâng nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí, ōe kóng, ‘Chit-ê sī i ê bó͘.’ In ōe kā góa thâi-sí, hō͘ lí oa̍h--teh.
Pài-thok lí kóng lí sī góa ê sió-bē, hō͘ góa thang in-ūi án-ni pêng-an bô-sū, bián hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.”
A-pek-lân kàu Ai-ki̍p ê sî, Ai-ki̍p -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng ū-kàu súi.
Hoat-ló ê jîn-sîn khòaⁿ-tio̍h i, chiū tī Hoat-ló ê bīn-chêng o-ló i ê súi. Hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng chiū hō͘ lâng tòa ji̍p-khì Hoat-ló ê ông-kiong.
Hoat-ló in-ūi chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng hó khoán-thāi A-pek-lân; A-pek-lân chiū tit-tio̍h gû, iûⁿ, kang ê lû, bú ê lû, lo̍k-tô, í-ki̍p po̍k-jîn kap lú-pī.
Siōng Chú in-ūi A-pek-lân ê bó͘ Sa-lâi ê iân-kò͘, kàng tōa chai-hō tī Hoat-ló kap i ê choân-ke.
Hoat-ló chiū kiò A-pek-lân lâi, kóng, “Lí ná tùi góa chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì? Bô kā góa kóng i sī lí ê bó͘?
Sī-án-chóaⁿ lí kóng i sī lí ê sió-bē, soah hāi góa kā i chhōa-lâi chòe bó͘? Taⁿ lí ê bó͘ tī chia, chhōa--tńg-khì.”
Hoat-ló chiū bēng-lēng pō͘-hā sàng A-pek-lân, i ê bó͘, kap i it-chhè só͘ ū--ê lī-khui.
A-pek-lân chhōa i ê bó͘ kap i só͘-ū--ê, tùi Ai-ki̍p khì Nî-kek-hu, Lô-tek mā chòe-hé khì.
A-pek-lân ê cheng-siⁿ, kim, gûn chin chōe.
I tùi Nî-kek-hu chiām-chiām ǹg Pek-te̍k-lī chhian-sóa, kàu Pek-te̍k-lī kap Ai ê tiong-kan, chiū-sī i í-chêng tah pò͘-pîⁿ,
khí chè-tôaⁿ ê só͘-chāi. A-pek-lân tī hia kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê miâ.
Kap A-pek-lân chòe-hé khì ê Lô-tek mā ū gû-kûn, iûⁿ-kûn, pò͘-pîⁿ,
tì-kàu hit-ê tōe-khu bô-kàu thang hō͘ in chòe-hé khiā-khí; in-ūi in ê châi-bu̍t chin chōe, bōe-tàng chòe-hé khiā-khí.
A-pek-lân ê bo̍k-chiá kap Lô-tek ê bo̍k-chiá siông-siông oan-ke. Tng-sî Ka-lâm -lâng kap Pí-lī-sé -lâng tòa tī hit-ê tōe-khu.
A-pek-lân kā Lô-tek kóng, “Lán m̄-thang oan-ke, lí ê bo̍k-chiá kap góa ê bo̍k-chiá mā m̄-thang oan-ke, in-ūi lán sī chi̍t-ke-lâng.
Choân-tōe lóng tī lí ê ba̍k-chiu-chêng, chhiáⁿ lí lī-khui góa; lí nā khì tò-pêng, góa chiū khì chiàⁿ-pêng; lí nā khì chiàⁿ-pêng, góa chiū khì tò-pêng.”

Lô-tek gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ Iok-tàn-hô ǹg Só-ní hong-hiòng it-phiàn ê pêng-goân, chúi-goân chhiong-chiok, hit-ê tōe tī Siōng Chú húi-bia̍t Só͘-to-má kap Gô-mô͘-la í-chêng, chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú ê hn̂g, chhin-chhiūⁿ Ai-ki̍p ê tōe.
Lô-tek chiū kéng Iok-tàn-hô hit-phiàn pêng-goân, chhian-sóa khì tang-pêng; in nn̄g ke chiū hun-khui.
A-pek-lân tòa tī Ka-lâm -tōe; Lô-tek tòa tī pêng-goân chiah-ê siâⁿ, chiām-chiām chhian-sóa khì kàu Só͘-to-má.
Só͘-to-má -lâng hui-siông siâ-ok, tōa-tōa tek-chōe Siōng Chú.
Lô-tek lī-khui liáu-āu, Siōng Chú tùi A-pek-lân kóng, “Lí gia̍h-thâu, tùi lí khiā ê só͘-chāi ǹg tang sai lâm pak khòaⁿ.
Lí só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h it-chhè ê tōe, góa beh éng-oán sù hō͘ lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi.
Góa mā beh hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi chhin-chhiūⁿ tōe-chiūⁿ ê thô͘-soa hiah chōe; lâng nā ōe-tàng sǹg tōe-chiūⁿ ê thô͘-soa, chiah ōe-tàng sǹg lí ê hō͘-tāi.
Lí khí-lâi kiâⁿ-thàu chit-ê tōe ta̍k só͘-chāi, góa beh chiong chit-ê tōe sù hō͘ lí.”
A-pek-lân chiū chhian-sóa khì Hi-pek-lûn, kàu óa-kūn Bān-lī hiah-ê siōng-chhiū ê só͘-chāi khiā-khí; tī hia i ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ.
Tī Àm-la-hui chòe Sī-ná -ông, A-lio̍k chòe Í-la-sat -ông, Ki-tāi-ló-má chòe Í-lân -ông, Thê-ta̍t chòe Ko-ìn -ông ê sî,
in liân-ha̍p lâi kong-táⁿ Só͘-to-má -ông Pí-la, Gô-mô͘-la -ông Pí-sa, Ap-má -ông Sī-la̍p, Sé-pián -ông Siān-í-pia̍t, í-ki̍p Pí-la -ông (Pí-la chiū-sī Só-ní).
Hit sì ê ông lóng lâi Se-tèng Soaⁿ-kok hōe-ha̍p; Se-tèng Soaⁿ-kok chiū-sī hiān-chāi ê Iâm-hái.
In hō͘ Ki-tāi-ló-má thóng-tī cha̍p-jī nî kú; kàu tē-cha̍p-saⁿ nî pōe-poān.

Tē-cha̍p-sì nî, Ki-tāi-ló-má chhōa hiah-ê kap i kiat-bêng ê ông, kàu A-su-tha-lio̍k Ka-lêng thâi-iâⁿ Lī-hoa̍t-im -lâng, tī Hap-be̍k thâi-iâⁿ So͘-se -lâng, tī Ki-lia̍t-têng Pêng-goân thâi-iâⁿ Í-bí -lâng,
tī Í-tong soaⁿ-khu thâi-iâⁿ Hô-lī -lâng, it-ti̍t kàu óa-kūn khòng-iá ê I-le̍k Pa-lân.
In tò-tńg kàu Ún Bi̍t-pa, chiū-sī Ka-te-su, kong-táⁿ A-má-le̍k choân tōe-khu, kap tòa tī Hap-sé-sùn Tha-má ê A-mô͘-lī -lâng.
Tùi án-ni, Só͘-to-má -ông, Gô-mô͘-la -ông, Ap-má -ông, Sé-pián -ông, Pí-la -ông (Pí-la chiū-sī Só-ní), lóng lâi Se-tèng Soaⁿ-kok pâi-tīn, beh kap in kau-chiàn,
chiū-sī kap Í-lân -ông Ki-tāi-ló-má, Ko-ìn -ông Thê-ta̍t, Sī-ná -ông Àm-la-hui, Í-la-sat -ông A-lio̍k kau-chiàn; sì ê ông tùi-khòng gō͘ ê ông.
Se-tèng Soaⁿ-kok ū chin chōe táⁿ-má-ka-khiⁿ; Só͘-to-má kap Gô-mô͘-la chit nn̄g ê siâⁿ ê ông tô-cháu, poa̍h lo̍h-khì hit lāi-bīn; kî-tha ê lâng tô-cháu khì soaⁿ-téng.
Hit sì ê ông chiong Só͘-to-má kap Gô-mô͘-la ê châi-bu̍t í-ki̍p niû-si̍t lóng chhiúⁿ-cháu, chòe in khì.
Koh chiong A-pek-lân ê ti̍t-á Lô-tek kap i ê châi-bu̍t lóng chhiúⁿ--khì; hit-sî Lô-tek tòa tī Só͘-to-má.

Ū chi̍t ê tô-cháu ê lâng lâi kā Hi-pek-lâi -lâng A-pek-lân pò-kò chit-ê siau-sit. Hit-sî, A-pek-lân tòa tī A-mô͘-lī -lâng Bān-lī ê siōng-chhiū hia; Bān-lī, Í-si̍t-kok, kap A-nái lóng sī chhin-cho̍k, ū kap A-pek-lân kiat-bêng.
A-pek-lân thiaⁿ-tio̍h i ê ti̍t-á hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì, chiū chhōa hiah-ê tī in tau chhut-sì, siū hùn-liān ê chòng-teng saⁿ-pah cha̍p-poeh lâng, tui-jip hit sì ê ông kàu Tān.
Kàu àm-sî, i kap i ê po̍k-jîn hun-tūi kong-kek tùi-te̍k, kā in jip kàu Tāi-má-sū-kek pak-pêng ê Hô-pa.

I chiong só͘-ū hō͘ in chhiúⁿ--khì ê châi-bu̍t chhiúⁿ tò-tńg, mā chiong i ê ti̍t-á Lô-tek kap Lô-tek ê châi-bu̍t, hū-lú, í-ki̍p kî-tha siū-lia̍h ê lâng lóng chhiúⁿ--tńg-lâi.
A-pek-lân thâi-iâⁿ Ki-tāi-ló-má í-ki̍p kap i kiat-bêng ê ông tò--lâi ê sî, Só͘-to-má -ông lâi Sa-bî Soaⁿ-kok gêng-chiap i; Sa-bî Soaⁿ-kok chiū-sī Ông ê Soaⁿ-kok.
Chì-koân Siōng-tè ê chè-si Sat-léng -ông Be̍k-ki-sé-tek mā tòa piáⁿ kap chiú lâi,
kā A-pek-lân chiok-hok, kóng: Goān chhòng-chō thiⁿ-tōe, Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè sù-hok hō͘ A-pek-lân!
Goān hō͘ A-pek-lân thâi-iâⁿ tùi-te̍k ê Chì-koân Siōng-tè tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn! A-pek-lân chiong lóng-chóng só͘ tit--tio̍h-ê ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t sàng hō͘ Be̍k-ki-sé-tek.
Só͘-to-má -ông kā A-pek-lân kóng, “Lâng kau hō͘ góa, châi-bu̍t lóng hō͘ lí.”
A-pek-lân kā Só͘-to-má -ông kóng, “Góa kí Siōng Chú — chhòng-chō thiⁿ-tōe, Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè chiù-chōa,
lí só͘-ū ê mi̍h, liân chi̍t tiâu sòaⁿ, chi̍t tiâu ôe-tòa góa lóng m̄ the̍h, chiah bián lí kóng, ‘Góa hō͘ A-pek-lân hó-gia̍h.’
M̄-kú, chòng-teng ê niû-si̍t lí tio̍h pó͘--góa; kap góa chòe-hé khì ê A-nái, Í-si̍t-kok, Bān-lī èng-tit ê hūn, tio̍h chhut-chāi in the̍h.”
Chiah-ê tāi-chì í-āu, Siōng Chú tī īⁿ-siōng tiong tùi A-pek-lân kóng, “ A-pek-lân, m̄-bián kiaⁿ! Góa sī lí ê pó-hō͘-chiá, góa ōe hō͘ lí hong-hù ê pò-siúⁿ.”
A-pek-lân kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, lí beh hō͘ góa sím-mi̍h? Góa it-ti̍t bô kiáⁿ; beh kè-sêng góa ê châi-sán--ê, sī Tāi-má-sū-kek -lâng Í-lī-í-siā.”
A-pek-lân koh kóng, “Lí bô hō͘ góa hō͘-sû; chhut-sì tī góa ke-lāi ê po̍k-jîn ōe kè-sêng góa ê châi-sán.”
Siōng Chú tùi i kóng, “Lí ê kè-sêng-jîn m̄-sī chit-ê lâng; lí chhin-siⁿ--ê, chiah sī lí ê hō͘-sû.”
Siōng Chú chiū chhōa i chhut-khì gōa-bīn, kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ thiⁿ, sǹg hiah-ê chhiⁿ. Lí kiám sǹg ōe liáu? Lí ê hō͘-tāi mā ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni.”
A-pek-lân sìn Siōng Chú, Siōng Chú chiū kā i sǹg chòe gī.
Siōng Chú koh tùi i kóng, “Góa sī Siōng Chú. Góa chhōa lí lī-khui Pa-pí-lûn ê Ngô͘-ní -siâⁿ, sī beh chiong chit-ê tōe sù lí chòe sán-gia̍p.”
A-pek-lân kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, góa beh án-chóaⁿ chai ōe tit-tio̍h chit-ê tōe chòe sán-gia̍p?”

Siōng Chú kā i kóng, “Lí khì lia̍h chi̍t chiah saⁿ-hè ê gû-bú, chi̍t chiah saⁿ-hè ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú, chi̍t chiah saⁿ-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng, chi̍t chiah pan-kah, chi̍t chiah hún-chiáu-á-kiáⁿ lâi.”
I chiū khì lia̍h hiah-ê tōng-bu̍t lâi, ta̍k-chiah tùi tiong-ng phòa-chòe nn̄g pêng, nn̄g pêng pâi sio-tùi; chí-ū chiáu-á bô phòa-khui.
Ū thuh-thâu-eng pe lo̍h-lâi thêng tī cheng-siⁿ si-thé ê téng-bīn, A-pek-lân kā in kóaⁿ-cháu.
Ji̍t beh lo̍h ê sî, A-pek-lân khùn tāng-bîn; hut-jiân ū hō͘ lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ê tōa o͘-àm tà-óa.
Siōng Chú tùi A-pek-lân kóng, “Lí it-tēng tio̍h chai, lí ê hō͘-tāi ōe kià-ku tī pa̍t-lâng ê tōe, chòe hia ê lâng ê lô͘-lē, siū-khó͘ sì-pah nî.
Khi-ap in ê kok-ka, góa ōe kā i sím-phòaⁿ; āu-lâi in ōe tòa chin chōe châi-bu̍t tùi hia chhut--lâi.
Lí ōe chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū, hō͘ lâng an-chòng, pêng-pêng-an-an tńg-khì lín chó͘-sian hia.
Kàu tē-sì tāi, in ōe tò-lâi chia, in-ūi A-mô͘-lī -cho̍k ê chōe iáu-bē koàn-boán.”
Ji̍t lo̍h thiⁿ àm, hut-jiân ū chhut-ian ê lô͘, kap teh to̍h ê hé-pé, tùi hiah-ê phòa-pêng ê bah ê tiong-kan keng-kè.
Hit-ji̍t Siōng Chú kap A-pek-lân li̍p-iok, kóng, “Góa beh chiong tùi Ai-ki̍p ê pian-kài kàu Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô chit-ê tōe sù hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi,
chiū-sī chiong Ki-nî -lâng, Ki-nî-sé -lâng, Kah-mô͘-nî -lâng,
Hek -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Lī-hoa̍t-im -lâng,
A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Ka-lâm -lâng, Kek-ka-sat -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng in ê tōe sù hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi.”
A-pek-lân ê bó͘ Sa-lâi bô siⁿ-kiáⁿ; i ū chi̍t ê lú-pī Hā-kah sī Ai-ki̍p -lâng.

Sa-lâi kā A-pek-lân kóng, “Siōng Chú hō͘ góa bōe siⁿ. Chhiáⁿ lí kap góa ê lú-pī tâng-pâng, kiám-chhái góa ōe-tàng tùi i tit-tio̍h chi̍t ê hāu-siⁿ.” A-pek-lân thiaⁿ-thàn Sa-lâi ê ōe.
A-pek-lân ê bó͘ Sa-lâi chiū chiong i ê lú-pī Ai-ki̍p -lâng Hā-kah hō͘ i ê tiōng-hu A-pek-lân chòe bó͘; hit-sî A-pek-lân í-keng tòa tī Ka-lâm -tōe cha̍p nî.
I kap Hā-kah tâng-pâng, Hā-kah chiū hoâi-īn. Hā-kah chai ka-kī ū-sin, chiū khòaⁿ-khin lú-chú-lâng.

Sa-lâi kā A-pek-lân kóng, “Góa siū úi-khut lóng sī lí hāi--ê. Góa chiong góa ê lú-pī sàng hō͘ lí chòe bó͘; i chi̍t-ē chai ka-kī ū-sin, chiū khòaⁿ-khin góa. Goān Siōng Chú tī lí góa ê tiong-kan chú-chhî kong-tō.”
A-pek-lân tùi Sa-lâi kóng, “I sī lí ê lú-pī, lí ōe-tàng chiàu lí ê ì-sù tùi-thāi i.” Sa-lâi kā i khó͘-to̍k, i chiū tô-cháu lī-khui Sa-lâi.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tī khòng-iá ê chúi-chôaⁿ piⁿ tú-tio̍h Hā-kah; hit-ê chúi-chôaⁿ sī tī beh khì Su-ní ê lō͘-tiong.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tùi i kóng, “ Sa-lâi ê lú-pī Hā-kah, lí tùi tó-ūi lâi, beh khì tó-ūi?” I kóng, “Góa tùi góa ê lú-chú-lâng Sa-lâi hia tô-cháu--chhut-lâi.”
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tùi i kóng, “Lí tio̍h tńg-khì lí ê lú-chú-lâng hia, sūn-ho̍k i.”
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá koh tùi i kóng, “Góa beh hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi chōe kah bōe-sǹg--tit.”
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá koh tùi i kóng: Taⁿ lí hoâi-īn, beh siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ; tio̍h kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Í-si̍t-má-lī, in-ūi Siōng Chú thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê khó͘-chêng.
I ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-lû; i beh kong-kek lâng, lâng mā beh kong-kek i; i beh kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī chòe tùi-thâu.
Hā-kah chiū chheng-ho͘ hit-ūi tùi i kóng-ōe ê Siōng Chú chòe “Khòaⁿ-kò͘ ê Siōng-tè”; i kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè, góa kèng-jiân iáu oa̍h--teh!”
Só͘-í chit-ê chíⁿ chiū kiò-chòe Pí-ní La-hái Lâi; chit-ê chíⁿ tī Ka-te-su kap Pa-lia̍t ê tiong-kan.
Āu-lâi, Hā-kah kā A-pek-lân siⁿ chi̍t ê hāu-siⁿ, A-pek-lân kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Í-si̍t-má-lī.
Hā-kah kā A-pek-lân siⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī ê sî, A-pek-lân poeh-cha̍p-la̍k hè.
A-pek-lân káu-cha̍p-káu hè ê sî, Siōng Chú tùi i hián-hiān, kā i kóng, “Góa sī Choân-lêng ê Siōng-tè, lí tī góa ê bīn-chêng kiâⁿ-chòe tio̍h oân-choân.
Góa beh kap lí li̍p-iok, beh hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi ke-thiⁿ ke̍k-kî chōe.”
A-pek-lân phak tī thô͘-kha; Siōng-tè koh tùi i kóng,
“Góa kap lí li̍p ê iok sī án-ni: Lí beh chòe chin chōe pang-kok ê lāu-pē.
Tùi taⁿ í-āu, lí ê miâ bô koh kiò-chòe A-pek-lân, beh kiò-chòe A-pek-la-hán, in-ūi góa beh hō͘ lí chòe chin chōe kok ê lāu-pē.
Góa beh hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi ke-thiⁿ ke̍k-kî chōe, kiàn-li̍p chin chōe kok, chhut chin chōe kun-ông.
“Góa beh kian-li̍p góa kap lí, í-ki̍p lí sè-sè-tāi-tāi ê kiáⁿ-sun só͘ li̍p éng-oán ê iok, beh chòe lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi ê Siōng-tè.
Góa beh chiong lí hiān-chāi kià-ku ê Ka-lâm choân-tōe, siúⁿ-sù lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi chòe éng-oán ê sán-gia̍p; góa mā beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè.”
Siōng-tè koh tùi A-pek-la-hán kóng, “Lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ-sun sè-sè-tāi-tāi tio̍h chun-siú góa ê iok.
Lín tiong-kan só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng lóng tio̍h siū kat-lé; che chiū-sī góa kap lí í-ki̍p lí ê kiáⁿ-sun só͘ li̍p ê iok, lín it-tēng tio̍h chun-siú.
Lín tio̍h koah lín ê pau-phê; che beh chòe góa kap lín li̍p-iok ê kì-hō.
Lín ta̍k sè-tāi ê ta-po͘-eⁿ, bô-lūn ka-kī siⁿ--ê, á-sī tùi gōa-cho̍k-lâng bóe--lâi-ê, chhut-sì tē-poeh ji̍t, lóng tio̍h siū kat-lé.
Lí ke-lāi siⁿ--ê kap ēng gûn bóe--ê, lóng it-tēng tio̍h siū kat-lé; án-ni góa kap lín só͘ li̍p éng-oán ê iok chiū tī lín ê sin-chiūⁿ chòe kì-hō.
Bô siū kat-lé ê ta-po͘-lâng, it-tēng tio̍h tùi góa ê chú-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut, in-ūi i bô koah pau-phê, ûi-pōe góa ê iok.”
Siōng-tè koh tùi A-pek-la-hán kóng, “Lí m̄-thang koh kiò lí ê bó͘ chòe Sa-lâi, tio̍h kiò i chòe Sa-la.
Góa beh sù-hok i, hō͘ lí tùi i tit-tio̍h chi̍t ê kiáⁿ; góa beh sù-hok i, hō͘ i chòe chin chōe kok ê lāu-bú, chhut chin chōe kun-ông.”
A-pek-la-hán phak tī thô͘-kha teh chhiò, sim-lāi siūⁿ, “Chi̍t-pah-hè ê lâng kiám ōe siⁿ-kiáⁿ? Sa-la í-keng káu-cha̍p hè, ná iáu ōe siⁿ?”
A-pek-la-hán tùi Siōng-tè kóng, “Hō͘ Í-si̍t-má-lī chòe góa ê kè-sêng-jîn chiū hó.”

Siōng-tè kóng, “M̄-sī án-ni, lí ê bó͘ Sa-la beh kā lí siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, lí tio̍h kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Í-sat; góa beh kian-li̍p góa kap i í-ki̍p i ê kiáⁿ-sun só͘ li̍p éng-oán ê iok.

Koan-hē Í-si̍t-má-lī, góa mā thiaⁿ lí ê kî-kiû. Góa beh sù-hok i, góa ōe hō͘ i heng-ōng, ke-thiⁿ ke̍k-kî chōe. I ōe siⁿ cha̍p-jī ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, góa mā beh hō͘ i chiâⁿ-chòe tōa-kok.
Kàu mê-nî chit-ê sî, Sa-la ōe kā lí siⁿ Í-sat; góa beh kap i li̍p-iok.”
Siōng-tè kap A-pek-la-hán kóng soah, chiū lī-khui i chiūⁿ--khì.

Tú-tú hit-ji̍t, A-pek-la-hán chiàu Siōng-tè kóng ê ōe, kā i ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī kap ke-lāi só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng, bô-lūn sī ke-lāi siⁿ--ê á-sī bóe--lâi-ê, lóng kā in kiâⁿ kat-lé.
A-pek-la-hán siū kat-lé ê sî káu-cha̍p-káu hè;
i ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī siū kat-lé ê sî cha̍p-saⁿ hè.
Tú-tú hit-ji̍t, A-pek-la-hán kap i ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī chòe-hé siū kat-lé.
Só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng, bô-lūn sī ke-lāi siⁿ--ê, á-sī tùi gōa-cho̍k-lâng bóe--ê, lóng kap i chòe-hé siū kat-lé.
Siōng Chú tī Bān-lī ê siōng-chhiū hia tùi A-pek-la-hán hián-hiān; hit-sî ji̍t tng joa̍h, A-pek-la-hán chē tī pò͘-pîⁿ ji̍p-kháu.
A-pek-la-hán gia̍h-thâu chù-ì khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h saⁿ ê lâng tī tùi-bīn teh khiā. I chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū tùi pò͘-pîⁿ-kháu cháu-khì gêng-chiap in,
phak tī thô͘-kha tùi in kóng, “Góa ê chú, nā bô khì-hiâm, chhiáⁿ tiàm chia sió hioh--chi̍t-ē.
Chhiáⁿ tiàm chhiū-á kha hioh-khùn, tán góa the̍h chi̍t-kóa chúi hō͘ lín sóe-kha,

the̍h tām-po̍h piáⁿ hō͘ lín ke-thiⁿ goân-khì, āu-lâi chiah koh kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ. Lín kì-jiân lâi kàu po̍k-jîn chia, chhiáⁿ chiap-siū góa ê khoán-thāi.” In kóng, “Chiàu lí kóng--ê khì chòe.”
A-pek-la-hán kóaⁿ-kín ji̍p-khì pò͘-pîⁿ, kā Sa-la kóng, “Lí kóaⁿ-kín nóa saⁿ táu iù mī-hún, chòe piáⁿ.”
A-pek-la-hán koh cháu-khì gû-kûn hia, khan chi̍t chiah chíⁿ koh hó ê gû-á-kiáⁿ, kau hō͘ siàu-liân po̍k-jîn kóaⁿ-kín khì chún-pī.
A-pek-la-hán koh the̍h chhì-jù, gû-lin, kap liāu-lí hó ê gû-á-kiáⁿ lâi, pâi tī chit saⁿ ê lâng ê bīn-chêng; ka-kī tī chhiū-kha kā in sū-hāu, in chiū chia̍h.
In mn̄g i, “Lí ê bó͘ Sa-la tī tó-ūi?” I kóng, “Tī pò͘-pîⁿ lāi.”

In tiong-kan ê chi̍t ê kóng, “Mê-nî chit-ê sî-chūn góa it-tēng ōe koh lâi lí chia; lí ê bó͘ Sa-la ōe siⁿ chi̍t ê hāu-siⁿ.” Sa-la tī hit-ê lâng āu-bīn ê pò͘-pîⁿ-kháu ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe.
A-pek-la-hán kap Sa-la í-keng lāu; Sa-la í-keng bô ge̍h-keng.
Sa-la sim-lāi chhiò kóng, “Góa í-keng soe-lám, góa ê chú-lâng mā lāu lah, kiám iáu ū chit-khoán hoaⁿ-hí ê tāi-chì?”
Siōng Chú tùi A-pek-la-hán kóng, “ Sa-la sī-án-chóaⁿ thau-thau-á chhiò kóng, ‘Góa í-keng lāu, kiám ū-iáⁿ ōe siⁿ-kiáⁿ?’
Siōng Chú kiám ū bōe-tàng chòe ê tāi-chì? Kàu mê-nî chit-ê sî, góa ōe koh lâi lí chia, Sa-la ōe siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ.”
Sa-la kiaⁿ, m̄-káⁿ sêng-jīn, kóng, “Góa bô chhiò.” Hit-ê lâng kóng, “Ū, lí chin-chiàⁿ ū chhiò.”
Hit saⁿ ê lâng tùi hia chhut-hoat khì Só͘-to-má; A-pek-la-hán kap in chòe-hé kiâⁿ, beh sàng in chi̍t chām.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh chòe ê tāi-chì, kiám bô beh hō͘ A-pek-la-hán chai?
A-pek-la-hán it-tēng ōe chiâⁿ-chòe tōa koh kiông ê kok-ka; tōe-chiūⁿ bān-kok beh in-ūi i tit-tio̍h hok-khì.

Góa kéng-soán i, sī beh hō͘ i bēng-lēng i ê kiáⁿ-sun kap chiong-lâi ê ka-sio̍k, tio̍h chun-siú Siōng Chú ê kà-sī, péng-kong-hêng-gī, thang hō͘ Siōng Chú tùi A-pek-la-hán ê èng-ún lóng si̍t-hiān.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “ Só͘-to-má kap Gô-mô͘-la chōe-tāi-ok-ke̍k, khòng-kò in ê siaⁿ chin tōa.
Taⁿ góa beh lo̍h--khì, khòaⁿ in ê só͘-chòe sī m̄-sī chhin-chhiūⁿ góa só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê án-ni; nā m̄-sī án-ni, góa mā ōe chai.”
Tiong-kan nn̄g ê lâng tùi hia oa̍t-tńg-sin khì Só͘-to-má; A-pek-la-hán iáu khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.
A-pek-la-hán kiâⁿ chìn-chêng kóng, “Gī-lâng kap pháiⁿ-lâng, lí lóng beh chòe-hé châu-bia̍t sī--bô?
Siâⁿ-lāi nā ū gō͘-cha̍p ê gī-lâng, lí iû-goân beh châu-bia̍t chit-ê siâⁿ sī--bô? Bô beh ūi-tio̍h siâⁿ-lāi chit gō͘-cha̍p ê gī-lâng sià-bián in sī--bô?

Lí choa̍t-tùi bōe chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì, chiong gī-lâng kap pháiⁿ-lâng chòe-chi̍t-ē thâi-sí, soah hō͘ gī-lâng kap pháiⁿ-lâng lóng siâng-khoán. Lí choa̍t-tùi bōe. Sím-phòaⁿ choân-tōe ê Chú kiám m̄-sī tio̍h chiàu kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ?”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa nā tī Só͘-to-má siâⁿ-lāi chhē ōe tio̍h gō͘-cha̍p ê gī-lâng, góa chiū ūi-tio̍h in ê iân-kò͘ khoan-sià chit-ê siâⁿ.”
A-pek-la-hán koh kóng, “Góa put-kò sī hé-hu thô͘-hún, m̄-kú chhiáⁿ iông-ún góa tùi góa ê Chú kóng-ōe.

Chit gō͘-cha̍p ê gī-lâng nā kiám gō͘ ê, lí kiám beh in-ūi chha gō͘ ê, iû-goân beh châu-bia̍t choân-siâⁿ?” Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa nā tī hia chhē ū sì-cha̍p-gō͘ ê, mā bōe kā i châu-bia̍t.”
A-pek-la-hán koh tùi I kóng, “Tī hia nā chhē ū sì-cha̍p ê leh?” I kóng, “Ūi-tio̍h chit sì-cha̍p ê ê iân-kò͘, góa mā bōe chòe chit-ê tāi-chì.”

A-pek-la-hán koh kóng, “Kiû Chú m̄-thang siū-khì. Góa beh koh kóng, tī hia nā chhē ū saⁿ-cha̍p ê leh?” I kóng, “Tī hia nā chhē ū saⁿ-cha̍p ê, góa mā bōe chòe chit-ê tāi-chì.”
A-pek-la-hán kóng, “Chhiáⁿ iông-ún góa tùi góa ê Chú kóng, tī hia nā chhē ū jī-cha̍p ê leh?” I kóng, “Ūi-tio̍h chit jī-cha̍p ê ê iân-kò͘, góa mā bô beh kā in châu-bia̍t.”

A-pek-la-hán koh kóng, “Góa ê Chú ah, chhiáⁿ m̄-thang siū-khì, góa koh kóng chòe-āu chi̍t piàn, tī hia nā chhē ū cha̍p ê leh?” I kóng, “Ūi-tio̍h chit cha̍p ê ê iân-kò͘, góa mā bô beh kā in châu-bia̍t.”
Siōng Chú kap A-pek-la-hán kóng soah, chiū lī-khui. A-pek-la-hán mā tò-khì i ê só͘-chāi.
Hông-hun ê sî, hit nn̄g ê sù-chiá lâi kàu Só͘-to-má; Lô-tek chē tī Só͘-to-má ê siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu. Lô-tek khòaⁿ-tio̍h in, chiū khí-lâi gêng-chiap, phak tī thô͘-kha,

kóng, “Góa ê chú, chhiáⁿ oat lâi po̍k-jîn ê chhù hioh-mî, sóe-kha; bîn-á-chài khah chá khí--lâi, chiah koh kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ.” In kóng, “M̄-bián. Goán beh tiàm siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu ê kóng-tiûⁿ kè-mî.”
Lô-tek kian-koat kā in iau-chhiáⁿ, in chiah oa̍t-tńg-sin ji̍p-khì i ê chhù. Lô-tek ūi-tio̍h in chún-pī chhe-chhau, hang bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ, in chiū chia̍h.
In iáu-bē khì khùn, siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū ê Só͘-to-má -lâng, tùi lāu kàu siàu-liân, lâi ûi Lô-tek ê chhù,
kā i hoah kóng, “Ē-hng-àm lâi lín chia ê lâng tī tó-ūi? Kiò in chhut--lâi, goán beh kap in kau-ha̍p.”
Lô-tek chhut-lâi mn̂g-gōa, chiong mn̂g koaiⁿ--teh, khì chèng-lâng hia,
tùi in kóng, “Pêng-iú ah, chhiáⁿ lín mài chòe chit-khoán pháiⁿ tāi-chì.

Góa ū nn̄g ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, iáu-sī chāi-sek-lú; góa chhōa in chhut--lâi, chhut-chāi lín tùi-thāi in. M̄-kú chit nn̄g ê lâng, in sī góa ê lâng-kheh, chhiáⁿ lín m̄-thang tùi in chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì.”

Hiah-ê lâng kóng, “Lí siám-khui.” Koh kóng, “Lí chit-ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng lâi tòa goán chia, soah beh chòe goán ê sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ! Taⁿ goán beh hāi lí pí hāi in koh-khah chhám.” In chiū ǹg Lô-tek chhiong--khì, beh lòng-khui mn̂g.
M̄-kú hit nn̄g ê lâng kā Lô-tek khiú--ji̍p-khì, chiong mn̂g koaiⁿ--khí-lâi;
koh hō͘ mn̂g-gōa ê lâng, tùi tōa kàu sòe, ba̍k-chiu bū, khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h, chhē bô mn̂g.

Hit nn̄g ê lâng tùi Lô-tek kóng, “Lí tī chia iáu ū sím-mi̍h-lâng? Bô-lūn sī hāu-siⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kiáⁿ-sài, í-ki̍p siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū ê chhin-cho̍k, lí tio̍h chhōa in lī-khui chit-ê só͘-chāi.
Goán beh châu-bia̍t chit-ê siâⁿ, in-ūi khòng-kò in ê siaⁿ chin tōa, Siōng Chú ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h; I chhe goán lâi châu-bia̍t chit-ê siâⁿ.”
Lô-tek chhut--khì, tùi i ê kiáⁿ-sài kóng, “Lín kóaⁿ-kín lī-khui chia, in-ūi Siōng Chú beh châu-bia̍t chit-ê siâⁿ.” I ê kiáⁿ-sài lia̍h-chòe i sī teh kóng-chhiò.

Thiⁿ-kng-chá, Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá chhui-pek Lô-tek, kóng, “Khí--lâi, kóaⁿ-kín chhōa lí ê bó͘ kap nn̄g ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chhut--khì, chiah bián in-ūi chit-ê siâⁿ ê chōe-ok siū châu-bia̍t.”
Lô-tek tiû-tû; hit nn̄g ê lâng in-ūi Siōng Chú lîn-bín Lô-tek, chiū khan i, i ê bó͘, kap i nn̄g ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ê chhiú, chiong in chhōa chhut-khì siâⁿ-gōa.

Chhōa in chhut-khì liáu, kî-tiong chi̍t ê sù-chiá kā Lô-tek kóng, “Kóaⁿ-kín tô-miā! M̄-thang oa̍t-thâu, mā m̄-thang tòa tī pêng-goân; tio̍h cháu-khì soaⁿ--ni̍h, chiah bián siū siau-bia̍t.”
Lô-tek kóng, “Góa ê chú, m̄-thang án-ni.

Lí ê po̍k-jîn í-keng tùi lí tit-tio̍h un-tián, lí mā tùi góa hián-chhut ke̍k-tōa ê jîn-chû, kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā; góa cháu bōe kàu soaⁿ--ni̍h, kiaⁿ-liáu iáu-bē cháu kàu hia, chai-hō chiū lîm-kàu góa, góa chiū bô-miā.
Khòaⁿ leh, bô jōa hn̄g ê só͘-chāi ū chi̍t ê sió-siâⁿ, góa cháu ōe kàu; chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa cháu-khì hit-ê sió só͘-chāi, pó-choân góa ê sìⁿ-miā.”
Sù-chiá tùi i kóng, “Góa tah-èng lí; hit-ê siâⁿ góa bōe kā i húi-bia̍t.
Kín cháu! Lí iáu-bē kàu hia, góa bōe-tàng tāng-chhiú.” In-ūi án-ni, hit-ê siâⁿ kiò-chòe Só-ní.
Lô-tek cháu kàu Só-ní ê sî, ji̍t-thâu í-keng chhut.
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú chiong liû-hông kap hé, tùi thiⁿ-téng Siōng Chú hia kàng-lo̍h tī Só͘-to-má kap Gô-mô͘-la,
chiong hiah-ê siâⁿ, kui-ê pêng-goân, siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū ê chū-bîn, í-ki̍p tōe-chiūⁿ seng-tióng ê mi̍h lóng húi-bia̍t.
Lô-tek ê bó͘ tī āu-bīn, chi̍t-ē oa̍t-thâu khòaⁿ, chiū pìⁿ-chòe chi̍t ki iâm-thiāu.
A-pek-la-hán keh-ji̍t thàu-chá khí--lâi, kàu i í-chêng khiā tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ê só͘-chāi,
ǹg Só͘-to-má, Gô-mô͘-la, kap pêng-goân ê hong-hiòng khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit só͘-chāi hé-ian chhèng-koân, chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-lô͘ ê ian.
Siōng-tè siau-bia̍t pêng-goân chiah-ê siâⁿ, húi-bia̍t Lô-tek khiā-khí ê siâⁿ ê sî, I tài-liām A-pek-la-hán, kiù Lô-tek thoat-lī sí-bông.
Lô-tek m̄-káⁿ tòa tī Só-ní, chiū kap i nn̄g ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ sóa-khì soaⁿ--ni̍h, tòa tī soaⁿ-tōng.
Tōa cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tùi sió-bē kóng, “Lán lāu-pē lāu lah, chit só͘-chāi koh bô ta-po͘-lâng thang chiàu lé-sio̍k kap lán kiat-ha̍p.
Lán tio̍h hō͘ lāu-pē lim-chiú, kap i chòe-hé khùn, thang tùi i tit-tio̍h gín-á.”
Hit-mî in hō͘ in ê lāu-pē lim-chiú; tōa cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chiū ji̍p-khì kap i chòe-hé khùn; tōa cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ sím-mi̍h sî khì khùn, sím-mi̍h sî khí--lâi, lāu-pē lóng m̄ chai.

Keh-ji̍t, tōa cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kā sió-bē kóng, “Góa chā-mî kap lāu-pē chòe-hé khùn; kim-mî lán koh hō͘ i lim-chiú, lí thang ji̍p-khì kap i chòe-hé khùn. Án-ni, lán thang tùi lāu-pē tit-tio̍h hō͘-tāi.”
Hit-mî, in koh hō͘ lāu-pē lim-chiú, sòe-hàn cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ji̍p-khì kap lāu-pē khùn; cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ sím-mi̍h sî khì khùn, sím-mi̍h sî khí--lâi, lāu-pē mā lóng m̄ chai.
Án-ni, Lô-tek nn̄g ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ lóng tùi in ê lāu-pē hoâi-īn.
Tōa--ê siⁿ-kiáⁿ, kā i hō-miâ Mô͘-ap, chiū-sī hiān-kim Mô͘-ap -lâng ê chó͘-sian.
Sòe--ê mā siⁿ-kiáⁿ, kā i hō-miâ Piān A-bí, chiū-sī hiān-kim A-bûn -lâng ê chó͘-sian.
A-pek-la-hán tùi hia chiām-chiām sóa-khì Nî-kek-hu, kià-ku tī Ka-te-su kap Su-ní tiong-kan ê Ki-la-ní.
A-pek-la-hán kóng-kàu i ê bó͘ Sa-la ê sî, lóng kóng “I sī góa ê sió-bē”. Ki-la-ní -ông A-pí-bí-le̍k phài lâng chiong Sa-la chhōa--khì.
Mî--sî, tī bîn-bāng tiong, Siōng-tè lâi kā A-pí-bí-le̍k kóng, “Lí kai-sí! Lí chhōa--lâi hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng sī pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘.”
A-pí-bí-le̍k iáu-bē chhin-kūn Sa-la, chiū kóng, “Chú ah, bû-ko͘ ê jîn-bîn lí mā beh siau-bia̍t o͘h?
Hit-ê lâng kiám m̄-sī ka-kī kóng ‘I sī góa ê sió-bē’? Hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng mā kóng ‘I sī góa ê hiaⁿ-ko’. Góa chòe chit-ê tāi-chì, sī sim toan-chèng, chhiú chheng-khì.”

Siōng-tè tī A-pí-bí-le̍k ê bîn-bāng tiong tùi i kóng, “Góa chai-iáⁿ lí chòe chit-ê sū sim toan-chèng, só͘-í góa chó͘-tòng lí, chiah bián lí tek-chōe góa; góa put-chún lí bong-tio̍h i.
Taⁿ, lí tio̍h chiong chit-ê lâng ê bó͘ hêng i. I sī sian-ti, ōe thòe lí kî-tó, hō͘ lí oa̍h--teh. Lí nā m̄ hêng i, lí tio̍h chai, lí kap lí só͘-ū ê lâng it-tēng ōe sí.”
A-pí-bí-le̍k thàu-chá khí--lâi, tiàu-chi̍p só͘-ū ê jîn-sîn, chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì kóng hō͘ in thiaⁿ; hiah-ê jîn-sîn lóng chin kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.

A-pí-bí-le̍k kiò A-pek-la-hán lâi, tùi i kóng, “Lí ná tùi goán chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì? Góa tó-ūi tek-chōe lí? Lí kèng-jiân hō͘ góa kap góa ê jîn-bîn hām-lo̍h tāng-chōe. Lí bô eng-kai tùi góa chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì.”
A-pí-bí-le̍k koh tùi A-pek-la-hán kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ beh chòe chit-ê tāi-chì?”
A-pek-la-hán ìn kóng, “Góa siūⁿ-kóng chit só͘-chāi ê lâng lóng bô teh kiaⁿ Siōng-tè, ōe in-ūi góa ê bó͘ ê iân-kò͘ kā góa thâi-sí;
koh i si̍t-chāi sī góa ê sió-bē, kâng-pē bô kâng-bú, āu-lâi chòe góa ê bó͘.

Tng Siōng-tè kiò góa lī-khui lāu-pē ê ke, sì-kòe phiau-liû ê sî, góa kā góa ê bó͘ kóng, ‘Í-āu lán bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, lí tio̍h kā lâng kóng, góa sī lí ê hiaⁿ-ko. Che sī lí hō͘ góa ê un-chêng.’”
A-pí-bí-le̍k chiong gû, iûⁿ, po̍k-jîn, lú-pī sàng hō͘ A-pek-la-hán, koh chiong i ê bó͘ Sa-la hêng i.
A-pí-bí-le̍k koh kóng, “Góa ê tōe lóng tī lí ê bīn-chêng, lí ài tòa tó-ūi chiū thang tòa tī hia.”
I koh kā Sa-la kóng, “Góa ū hō͘ lí ê hiaⁿ-ko chi̍t-chheng tè gûn, chòe góa tùi lín choân-ke ê pó͘-sióng, chèng-si̍t lí sī chheng-pe̍k.”
A-pek-la-hán ǹg Siōng-tè kî-tó, Siōng-tè chiū i-hó A-pí-bí-le̍k, i ê bó͘ kap lú-pī, in chiū ōe siⁿ-kiáⁿ.
In-ūi Siōng Chú ūi-tio̍h A-pek-la-hán ê bó͘ Sa-la ê iân-kò͘, í-keng hō͘ A-pí-bí-le̍k ke-lāi ê hū-jîn-lâng bōe seng-io̍k.
Siōng Chú chiàu I í-chêng só͘ kóng ê ōe koàn-kò͘ Sa-la, si̍t-hiān I tùi Sa-la ê èng-ún.
A-pek-la-hán nî-lāu, kàu Siōng-tè tùi i kóng ê ji̍t-kî, Sa-la hoâi-īn, kā i siⁿ chi̍t ê hāu-siⁿ.
A-pek-la-hán kā Sa-la ūi i siⁿ ê kiáⁿ hō-miâ kiò-chòe Í-sat.
Í-sat chhut-sì tē-poeh ji̍t, A-pek-la-hán chiàu Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, kā Í-sat kiâⁿ kat-lé.
Í-sat chhut-sì ê sî, A-pek-la-hán tú-tú chi̍t-pah hè.
Sa-la kóng, “Siōng-tè hō͘ góa hoaⁿ-hí chhiò; só͘-ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h góa siⁿ-kiáⁿ ê lâng, mā ōe kap góa chòe-hé chhiò.”
Koh kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng sū-sian kā A-pek-la-hán kóng ‘ Sa-la ōe hō͘ gín-á chia̍h-lin’? M̄-kú tī A-pek-la-hán nî-lāu ê sî, góa kā i siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ.”
Gín-á chiām-chiām tōa-hàn, chiū tn̄g-lin. Í-sat tn̄g-lin hit-ji̍t, A-pek-la-hán pān-toh chhiáⁿ lâng-kheh.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Sa-la khòaⁿ-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p -lâng Hā-kah ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī teh kā i ê kiáⁿ Í-sat kún-chhiò,
chiū tùi A-pek-la-hán kóng, “Tio̍h kā chit-ê lú-pī kap i ê kiáⁿ kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; in-ūi lú-pī ê kiáⁿ bōe-tàng kap góa ê kiáⁿ Í-sat chòe-hé kè-sêng ke-gia̍p.”
Chit-hāng tāi-chì hō͘ A-pek-la-hán hui-siông khó͘-náu, in-ūi Í-si̍t-má-lī mā-sī i ê kiáⁿ.

Siōng-tè kā A-pek-la-hán kóng, “Lí m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h Í-si̍t-má-lī kap lí ê lú-pī Hā-kah khó͘-náu. Sa-la tùi lí kóng ê ōe, lí tio̍h thiaⁿ, in-ūi tùi Í-sat siⁿ--ê, chiah beh chheng-chòe lí ê hō͘-tāi.
Kóng-tio̍h lí ê lú-pī ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī, góa mā beh hō͘ i chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t kok, in-ūi i mā-sī lí siⁿ--ê.”

A-pek-la-hán thàu-chá khí--lâi, the̍h piáⁿ kap chi̍t phê-tē ê chúi hō͘ Hā-kah, hē tī i ê keng-thâu téng, kiò i kap gín-á lóng chhut--khì. Hā-kah chiū chhut--khì, kàu Pia̍t-sī-pa ê khòng-iá soah bê-lō͘.
Phê-tē lāi ê chúi lim-liáu, Hā-kah chiū chiong gín-á pàng tī sòe châng chhiū-kha.

I ka-kī kiâⁿ lī-khui, tāi-iok ū siā chi̍t ki chìⁿ ê hn̄g, kap gín-á saⁿ-tùi-bīn chē--teh. I kóng, “Góa m̄-kam khòaⁿ gín-á sí.” I chē tī gín-á ê tùi-bīn, chhut-siaⁿ tōa thî-khàu.

Siōng-tè thiaⁿ-tio̍h gín-á ê siaⁿ; Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá tùi thiⁿ kiò Hā-kah, kóng, “ Hā-kah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ leh? M̄-bián kiaⁿ! Siōng-tè í-keng thiaⁿ-tio̍h gín-á teh háu ê siaⁿ.
Khí--lâi, mā kā lí ê gín-á phō--khí-lâi; góa beh hō͘ i chiâⁿ-chòe tōa-kok.”
Siōng-tè khui Hā-kah ê ba̍k-chiu, i chiū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chúi-chíⁿ. Hā-kah khì kàu chíⁿ-piⁿ, chiong phê-tē ji̍p-chúi ji̍p kàu móa, koh hō͘ gín-á lim.
Siōng-tè kap gín-á tông-chāi; i chiām-chiām tōa-hàn, tòa tī khòng-iá, chiâⁿ-chòe chin gâu siā-chìⁿ ê lâng.
I tòa tī Pa-lân ê khòng-iá; i ê lāu-bú tùi Ai-ki̍p kā i chhōa chi̍t ê bó͘.
Hit-sî, A-pí-bí-le̍k kap i ê kun-tiúⁿ Hui-kok lâi kā A-pek-la-hán kóng, “Lí bô-lūn chòe sím-mi̍h, Siōng-tè lóng kā lí chiok-hok.

Lí hiān-chāi tio̍h kí Siōng-tè tùi góa chiù-chōa, m̄-thang khi-hū góa, góa ê kiáⁿ, kap góa ê hō͘-tāi; góa án-chóaⁿ hó khoán-thāi lí, lí mā tio̍h án-ni hó khoán-thāi góa, í-ki̍p lí só͘ kià-ku chit-ê tōe.”
A-pek-la-hán kóng, “Hó, góa chiù-chōa.”
Í-chêng A-pí-bí-le̍k ê po̍k-jîn bat pà-chiàm chi̍t kháu chúi-chíⁿ, A-pek-la-hán ūi-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì chek-pī A-pí-bí-le̍k.
A-pí-bí-le̍k kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng chòe chit-ê tāi-chì, góa m̄ chai; lí mā m̄-bat kā góa kóng, kin-á-ji̍t góa chiah chai.”
A-pek-la-hán chiū chiong gû kap iûⁿ sàng hō͘ A-pí-bí-le̍k; nn̄g ê lâng chiū li̍p-iok.
A-pek-la-hán koh chiong chhit chiah bú ê iûⁿ-ko lēng-gōa ûi tī pa̍t-ê só͘-chāi.
A-pí-bí-le̍k mn̄g A-pek-la-hán kóng, “Lí chiong chhit chiah bú ê iûⁿ-ko lēng-gōa ûi--teh, sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù?”
A-pek-la-hán ìn kóng, “Lí tio̍h chiap-siū góa chit chhit chiah bú ê iûⁿ-ko, chèng-si̍t chit-kháu chíⁿ sī góa ó͘--ê.”
Só͘-í hit-ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Pia̍t-sī-pa, in-ūi in nn̄g ê lâng tī hia li̍p-iok.
In tī Pia̍t-sī-pa li̍p-iok; A-pí-bí-le̍k chiū kap i ê kun-tiúⁿ Hui-kok tńg-khì Hui-lī-sū -tōe.
A-pek-la-hán tī Pia̍t-sī-pa chai chi̍t châng liú-chhiū, koh tī hia kiû-kiò Siōng Chú — éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê miâ.
A-pek-la-hán tī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tōe kià-ku chin kú.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, Siōng-tè khó-giām A-pek-la-hán, kiò i kóng, “ A-pek-la-hán.” I ìn kóng, “Góa tī chia.”
Siōng-tè kóng, “Lí chhōa lí to̍k-it ê kiáⁿ, lí só͘ thiàⁿ ê Í-sat, khì Mô͘-lī-a tōe-khu, tī góa beh chí-sī lí ê chi̍t chō soaⁿ chiong i hiàn-chòe sio-hòa-chè.”

Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, A-pek-la-hán kā lû-á pa̍k oaⁿ, chhōa nn̄g ê po̍k-jîn kap i ê kiáⁿ Í-sat, kā sio-hòa-chè beh ēng ê chhâ phòa hó-sè, chhut-hoat khì Siōng-tè chí-sī i ê só͘-chāi.
Kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t, A-pek-la-hán gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ-tio̍h hn̄g-hn̄g hit-ê só͘-chāi.
A-pek-la-hán tùi i ê po̍k-jîn kóng, “Lín kap lû-á tiàm chia thèng-hāu, góa kap góa ê kiáⁿ khì hia kèng-pài, āu-lâi ōe tńg-lâi lín chia.”
A-pek-la-hán chiong sio-hòa-chè ê chhâ hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ Í-sat phāiⁿ, ka-kī chhiú the̍h to kap hé-chéng; jiân-āu nn̄g ê lâng chòe-hé khì.
Í-sat kā i ê lāu-pē A-pek-la-hán kóng, “A-pa.” I kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ, góa tī chia.” Í-sat kóng, “Hé-chéng kap chhâ lán lóng ū, m̄-kú hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê iûⁿ-á tī tó-ūi?”
A-pek-la-hán kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ, Siōng-tè ōe ka-kī chún-pī sio-hòa-chè ê iûⁿ-á.” Nn̄g ê lâng chiū koh chòe-hé kiâⁿ.

In kàu Siōng-tè chí-sī i ê só͘-chāi. A-pek-la-hán tī hia khí chè-tôaⁿ, chiong chhâ pâi tī chè-tôaⁿ téng. I kā i ê kiáⁿ Í-sat pa̍k--teh, hē tī chè-tôaⁿ hiah-ê chhâ ê téng-bīn.
A-pek-la-hán chiū kā to gia̍h--khí-lâi, beh thâi i ê kiáⁿ.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tùi thiⁿ-téng kiò i kóng, “ A-pek-la-hán! A-pek-la-hán!” I ìn kóng, “Góa tī chia.”
Sù-chiá kóng, “M̄-thang hē-chhiú, m̄-thang siong-hāi chit-ê gín-á. Taⁿ góa chai lí kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, bōe chiong lí to̍k-it ê kiáⁿ lâu--teh, m̄ hō͘ góa.”

A-pek-la-hán gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h āu-bīn ū chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-káng, kak tîⁿ tī kui-phō ê chhiū-á. A-pek-la-hán chiū khì kā hit-chiah iûⁿ-káng lia̍h--lâi, tāi-thòe i ê kiáⁿ hiàn chòe sio-hòa-chè.
A-pek-la-hán kā hit-ê só͘-chāi hō-miâ chòe “Siōng Chú Í-le̍k”; kàu kin-á-ji̍t lâng iáu-teh kóng, “Tī Siōng Chú ê soaⁿ I ōe khòaⁿ-kò͘.”
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tē-jī piàn tùi thiⁿ-téng kiò A-pek-la-hán, kóng,
“Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Lí í-keng chòe chit-ê tāi-chì, bô lâu lí to̍k-it ê kiáⁿ m̄ hō͘ góa, só͘-í góa li̍p-sè,
góa it-tēng beh ka-pē sù-hok lí, hō͘ lí ê kiáⁿ-sun lâng-gia̍h ke-thiⁿ chin chōe, chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ, hái-piⁿ ê soa; lí ê hō͘-tāi beh chiàm-léng tùi-te̍k ê siâⁿ.
Tōe-chiūⁿ bān-kok beh tùi lí ê hō͘-tāi tit-tio̍h hok-khì, in-ūi lí thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe.’”
A-pek-la-hán tò-lâi i ê po̍k-jîn hia, in chiū chòe-hé chhut-hoat khì Pia̍t-sī-pa. A-pek-la-hán chiū tòa tī Pia̍t-sī-pa.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, ū lâng kā A-pek-la-hán kóng, “ Bi̍t-ka kā lí ê sió-tī Ná-ho̍k siⁿ-kiáⁿ:
Tōa-kiáⁿ O͘-su, tē-jī kiáⁿ Pò͘-su, A-lân ê lāu-pē Ki-bō͘-lī,
Ki-siat, Hap-só, Pit-ta̍t, Ek-la,
kap Lē-pek-ka ê lāu-pē Pí-thó͘-lī; chit poeh ê lóng sī Bi̍t-ka kā A-pek-la-hán ê sió-tī Ná-ho̍k siⁿ--ê.
Ná-ho̍k ê sòe-î Liû-má siⁿ Thê-pat, Ka-hâm, Tha-hat, kap Má-ka.”
Sa-la it-seng hióng-siū chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-chhit hè.
Sa-la sí tī Ka-lâm -tōe ê Ki-lia̍t A-pa, chiū-sī Hi-pek-lûn. A-pek-la-hán ūi-tio̍h i ai-siong thî-khàu.
A-pek-la-hán lī-khui khǹg Sa-la si-thé ê só͘-chāi, khì kā Hek -lâng kóng,
“Góa sī kià-ku tī lín chia ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, chhiáⁿ lín hō͘ góa chi̍t tè bōng-tōe, thang an-chòng góa ê bó͘.”
Hek -lâng ìn A-pek-la-hán, kóng,

“Sian-siⁿ, chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ: Lí tī goán chia sī siōng chun-kùi ê jîn-bu̍t; chhut-chāi lí tī goán ê bōng-tōe kéng chi̍t tè siōng-hó ê tōe, an-chòng lí ê bó͘. Goán bô chi̍t ê lâng ōe hoán-tùi lí tī goán ê bōng-tōe an-chòng lí ê bó͘.”
A-pek-la-hán khí--lâi, tùi hit só͘-chāi ê Hek -lâng phak tī thô͘-kha kiâⁿ-lé,
tùi in kóng, “Lín nā khéng hō͘ góa an-chòng góa ê bó͘, chiū chhiáⁿ thòe góa chhéng-kiû Só-hat ê kiáⁿ Í-hut-lûn,
chiong i thó͘-tōe bé-liu ê Be̍k-pí-la-tōng bōe hō͘ góa; i thang chiàu chiok-gia̍h ê kè-siàu bōe góa, hō͘ góa tī lín tiong-kan ū thó͘-tōe thang chòe bōng-tōe.”
Hit-chūn Í-hut-lûn kap kî-tha ê Hek -lâng chē tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu; i tī tāi-ke ê bīn-chêng ìn A-pek-la-hán, chèng-lâng lóng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h. I kóng,

“M̄-thang án-ni, sian-siⁿ, chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ góa kóng. Hit-tè tōe góa sàng lí, liân lāi-bīn ê tōng-hia̍t mā hō͘ lí. Góa tī góa tông-pau ê bīn-chêng sàng hō͘ lí, hō͘ lí bâi-chòng lí ê bó͘.”
A-pek-la-hán chiū phak tī thô͘-kha kā tong-tōe ê lâng kiâⁿ-lé,

tī tāi-ke ê bīn-chêng ìn Í-hut-lûn, chèng-lâng lóng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h. I kóng, “Chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ góa kóng. Góa beh kā lí bóe hit-tè tōe, chhiáⁿ lí tio̍h kā góa siu chîⁿ, hō͘ góa thang tī hia an-chòng góa ê bó͘.”
Í-hut-lûn ìn A-pek-la-hán kóng,
“Sian-siⁿ, chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ góa kóng. Hit-tè tōe ta̍t sì-pah tè gûn, chit-ê kè-siàu tùi lán nn̄g ê kiám ū sǹg sím-mi̍h? Lí thang an-chòng lí ê bó͘.”
A-pek-la-hán thiaⁿ Í-hut-lûn ê ōe, chiàu i tī Hek -lâng ê bīn-chêng só͘ kóng--ê, chiong bóe-bōe thong-iōng ê gûn, sǹg sì-pah tè hō͘ Í-hut-lûn.

Tùi hit-sî khí, Í-hut-lûn tī Bān-lī tùi-bīn Be̍k-pí-la-tōng hit-tè tōe, pau-koat hit-khu hn̂g, hit lāi-bīn ê tōng-hia̍t, kap sì-ûi só͘-ū ê chhiū-ba̍k lóng kui-sio̍k A-pek-la-hán.
Tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu ê Hek -lâng lóng choh-chèng, hit-tè tōe kui-sio̍k A-pek-la-hán.
Āu-lâi, A-pek-la-hán chiong i ê bó͘ Sa-la an-chòng tī Ka-lâm -tōe Bān-lī tùi-bīn Be̍k-pí-la chhân-iá ê tōng-hia̍t; Bān-lī chiū-sī Hi-pek-lûn.
Tùi án-ni, hit-khu hn̂g kap hn̂g--ni̍h ê tōng-hia̍t, tùi Hek -lâng î-choán hō͘ A-pek-la-hán chòe su-jîn bōng-tōe.
A-pek-la-hán nî-lāu, tn̂g-hè-siū; i it-seng só͘ chòe ê sū lóng tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú chiok-hok.
A-pek-la-hán tùi i chu-chhim ê koán-ke kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chiong lí ê chhiú hē tī góa ê tōa-thúi-ē,
lí tio̍h kí Siōng Chú — thiⁿ kap tōe ê Siōng-tè chiù-chōa, m̄-thang kā góa chhōa chia ê Ka-lâm lú-chú chòe sin-pū.
Lí tio̍h khì góa ê pún-tōe pún-cho̍k, kā góa ê kiáⁿ Í-sat chhōa chi̍t ê bó͘.”
Hit-ê koán-ke ìn kóng, “Hit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á nā m̄-khéng tè góa lâi lán chia, góa kiám thang chiong lí ê kiáⁿ chhōa tńg-khì lí ê kò͘-hiong?”
A-pek-la-hán kā i kóng, “Lí choa̍t-tùi m̄-thang kā góa ê kiáⁿ chhōa tò-khì hia;

Siōng Chú — thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè bat chhōa góa lī-khui goán lāu-pē ê ke kap pún-cho̍k ê tōe, koh tùi góa li̍p-sè èng-ún, kóng, ‘Góa beh chiong chit-ê tōe siúⁿ-sù lí ê hō͘-tāi.’ I ōe chhe I ê sù-chiá kā lí ín-chhōa, hō͘ lí thang tùi hia kā góa ê kiáⁿ chhōa-bó͘.
Hit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á nā m̄-khéng tè lí lâi, chit-ê chiù-chōa chiū kap lí bô koan-hē; m̄-kú chhian-bān m̄-thang kā góa ê kiáⁿ chhōa tńg-khì hia.”
Koán-ke chiū chiong chhiú hē tī i ê chú-lâng A-pek-la-hán ê tōa-thúi-ē, ūi-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì chiù-chōa.
Hit-ê koán-ke tùi i chú-lâng ê lo̍k-tô soán cha̍p chiah, koh tòa i chú-lâng ta̍k-khoán ê châi-pó, chhut-hoat khì Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a, kàu Ná-ho̍k ê siâⁿ.
I hō͘ lo̍k-tô kūi tī siâⁿ-gōa ê chíⁿ-piⁿ; hit-sî tú-tú hông-hun, hū-lú chhut-lâi chhiūⁿ-chúi.
I kóng, “Siōng Chú — góa ê chú-lâng A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí si-un hō͘ góa ê chú-lâng A-pek-la-hán, hō͘ góa kin-á-ji̍t ū hó ki-hōe.
Góa taⁿ khiā tī chíⁿ-piⁿ, siâⁿ-lāi ê cha-bó͘ gín-á chhut-lâi chhiūⁿ-chúi;

góa nā tùi kî-tiong chi̍t ê cha-bó͘ gín-á kóng ‘Chhiáⁿ pàng-lo̍h lí ê chúi-pân, hō͘ góa lim-chúi’, i nā kóng ‘Chhiáⁿ lim, góa mā beh hō͘ lí ê lo̍k-tô lim’, goān i chiū-sī lí só͘ soán beh hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn Í-sat chòe bó͘ ê cha-bó͘ gín-á; án-ni, góa chiū chai lí si-un hō͘ góa ê chú-lâng.”
Ōe iáu-bē kóng soah, Lē-pek-ka keng-thâu téng hē chúi-pân chhut--lâi; i sī Pí-thó͘-lī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; Pí-thó͘-lī sī A-pek-la-hán ê sió-tī Ná-ho̍k ê bó͘ Bi̍t-ka ê kiáⁿ.
Hit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á bīn-māu hui-siông súi, sī chāi-sek-lú, iáu m̄-bat ū ta-po͘-lâng kap i chòe-hé khùn. I lo̍h-khì chíⁿ-piⁿ, kā chúi-pân tóe-móa chiū khí--lâi.
Koán-ke cháu-khì tùi i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí chiong pân--ni̍h ê chúi chi̍t-sut-á hō͘ góa lim.”
Cha-bó͘ gín-á kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, chhiáⁿ lim.” I chiū kóaⁿ-kín pàng-lo̍h chúi-pân, khòa tī chhiú--ni̍h, hō͘ hit-ê koán-ke lim.
Hō͘ koán-ke lim-liáu, koh kóng, “Góa mā beh hō͘ lí ê lo̍k-tô lim kàu pá.”
I chiū kóaⁿ-kín chiong pân-lāi ê chúi piàⁿ tī chô--ni̍h, koh cháu-khì chíⁿ-piⁿ ūi lo̍k-tô chhiūⁿ-chúi.
Hit-ê koán-ke chù-ì kā khòaⁿ, tiām-tiām bô kóng-ōe, ài chai Siōng Chú sī m̄-sī ōe hō͘ i ê jīm-bū sūn-lī oân-sêng.
Lo̍k-tô lim-liáu, hit-ê lâng chiū the̍h chi̍t ê la̍k kong-khek ê kim phīⁿ-khoân, chi̍t tùi chi̍t-pah cha̍p-sì kong-khek ê kim chhiú-khoân hō͘ chit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á,
tùi i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ mn̄g, lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ? Lín lāu-pē ê chhù kiám ū só͘-chāi hō͘ goán hioh-mî?”
Lē-pek-ka chiū kā i kóng, “Góa sī Pí-thó͘-lī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; goán lāu-pē sī Bi̍t-ka kā Ná-ho̍k siⁿ ê kiáⁿ.
Goán ū chhiong-chiok ê chháu-liāu bí-niû, mā ū só͘-chāi thang hō͘ lín hioh-mî.”
Hit-ê koán-ke chiū kūi lo̍h-khì kèng-pài Siōng Chú, kóng,

“Góa beh chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — góa ê chú-lâng A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè; I it-ti̍t ēng chû-ài sìn-si̍t tùi-thāi góa ê chú-lâng, chi̍t-lō͘ ín-chhōa góa lâi kàu góa ê chú-lâng hiaⁿ-tī ê ke.”
Cha-bó͘ gín-á cháu--tò-khì, chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì kā in lāu-bú choân-ke ê lâng kóng.

Lē-pek-ka ū chi̍t ê hiaⁿ-ko La-pan, i chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h in sió-bē sin-chiūⁿ ê phīⁿ-khoân kap chhiú-khoân, koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h Lē-pek-ka kóng “Hit-ê lâng tùi góa kóng án-ni, án-ni”, chiū cháu-khì chíⁿ-piⁿ, kìⁿ hit-ê lâng. I kàu ê sî, hit-ê lâng iáu khiā tī chúi-chíⁿ piⁿ lo̍k-tô hia.
