I kā hit-ê lâng kóng, “Lí sī Siōng Chú sù-hok ê lâng, ná iáu khiā tī gōa-bīn? Chhiáⁿ lâi goán tau. Lí ê pâng-keng kap lo̍k-tô hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi, góa í-keng chún-pī hó-sè.”

Hit-ê koán-ke chiū ji̍p-khì La-pan ê chhù. Ū lâng lâi tháu lo̍k-tô chài ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, ēng chháu-liāu niû-si̍t chhī lo̍k-tô, koh phâng chúi hō͘ hit-ê koán-ke í-ki̍p kap i chòe-hé lâi ê lâng sóe-kha.

Ū lâng chiong chia̍h-mi̍h pâi tī koán-ke bīn-chêng, beh chhiáⁿ i chia̍h, m̄-kú i kóng, “Thèng-hāu góa chiong góa lâi ê bo̍k-te̍k kóng chheng-chhó, góa chiah chia̍h.” La-pan kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kóng.”
I chiū kóng, “Góa sī A-pek-la-hán ê po̍k-jîn.
Siōng Chú ū tōa-tōa sù-hok góa ê chú-lâng, hō͘ i chin hó-gia̍h, koh hō͘ i gû, iûⁿ, kim, gûn, po̍k-jîn, lú-pī, lo̍k-tô kap lû-á.
Góa ê chú-lâng ê bó͘ Sa-la nî-lāu ê sî, kā i siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ; góa ê chú-lâng mā chiong i só͘-ū--ê hō͘ chit-ê kiáⁿ.
Góa ê chú-lâng kah góa chiù-chōa, kóng, ‘M̄-thang kā góa chhōa chia ê Ka-lâm lú-chú chòe sin-pū.
Lí tio̍h khì góa ê lāu-pē ê ke, góa pún-cho̍k hia, kā góa ê kiáⁿ chhōa chi̍t ê bó͘.’
Góa tùi góa ê chú-lâng kóng, ‘Hit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á nā m̄-khéng tè góa lâi lán chia, beh án-chóaⁿ?’

I chiū kā góa kóng, ‘Góa ho̍k-sāi ê Siōng Chú ōe chhe I ê sù-chiá kap lí chòe-hé khì, hō͘ lí chi̍t-lō͘ sūn-lī, lí chiū thang tùi góa ê chong-cho̍k, goán lāu-pē ê ke, kā góa ê kiáⁿ chhōa-bó͘.
Lí nā ū khì kàu góa pún-cho̍k hia, chiū sǹg ū chiàu chiù-chōa chòe; bān-it in m̄ chiong hit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á kau hō͘ lí, chit-ê chiù-chōa chiū kap lí bô koan-hē.’
“Kin-á-ji̍t góa kàu chíⁿ-piⁿ, kî-tó kóng: Siōng Chú — góa chú-lâng A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí hō͘ góa chi̍t-lō͘ sūn-lī.
Góa taⁿ khiā tī chíⁿ-piⁿ, tùi chhut-lâi chhiūⁿ-chúi ê chi̍t ê cha-bó͘ gín-á kóng ‘Chhiáⁿ lí chiong chúi-pân ê chúi chi̍t-sut-á hō͘ góa lim’,
i nā kóng ‘Chhiáⁿ lim, góa mā beh hō͘ lí ê lo̍k-tô lim’, goān i chiū-sī Siōng Chú só͘ soán beh hō͘ góa chú-lâng ê kiáⁿ chòe bó͘ ê cha-bó͘ gín-á.
Góa sim-lāi ê ōe kóng iáu-bē liáu, Lē-pek-ka chiū chhut--lâi, keng-thâu téng hē chúi-pân; lo̍h-khì chíⁿ-piⁿ chhiūⁿ-chúi; góa kā i kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ lí hō͘ góa lim.’
I chiū kóaⁿ-kín tùi keng-thâu téng pàng-lo̍h chúi-pân, kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ lim, góa mā beh hō͘ lí ê lo̍k-tô lim.’ Góa chiū lim, i mā hō͘ góa ê lo̍k-tô lim.

Góa koh mn̄g i, ‘Lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ?’ I kóng, ‘Góa sī Pí-thó͘-lī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; goán lāu-pē sī Bi̍t-ka kā Ná-ho̍k siⁿ ê kiáⁿ.’ Góa chiū chiong phīⁿ-khoân kòa tī i ê phīⁿ, chhiú-khoân kòa tī i ê chhiú.

Góa kūi lo̍h-khì kèng-pài Siōng Chú, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — góa ê chú-lâng A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, in-ūi I ín-chhōa góa chi̍t-lō͘ sūn-lī, hō͘ góa chhē-tio̍h góa chú-lâng ê sió-tī ê cha-bó͘-sun lâi hō͘ i chòe sin-pū.
Taⁿ lín nā beh ēng chû-ài sìn-si̍t tùi-thāi góa ê chú-lâng, chiū kā góa kóng; nā m̄, mā kā góa kóng, hō͘ góa thang koat-tēng koh-lâi beh án-chóaⁿ.”
La-pan kap Pí-thó͘-lī ìn kóng, “Chit-ê tāi-chì kì-jiân Siōng Chú án-ni an-pâi, goán bōe-tàng tùi lí kóng sím-mi̍h.
Taⁿ, Lē-pek-ka tī chia, lí thang chhōa i khì, chiàu Siōng Chú ê an-pâi, hō͘ lí ê chú-lâng ê kiáⁿ chòe bó͘.”
A-pek-la-hán ê koán-ke thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe, chiū phak tī thô͘-kha kèng-pài Siōng Chú.
Hit-ê koán-ke khí--lâi, the̍h kim-khì, gûn-khì, kap i-ho̍k sàng Lē-pek-ka, koh chiong kùi-tiōng ê lé-mi̍h sàng hō͘ i ê hiaⁿ-ko kap lāu-bú.
Hit-ê koán-ke kap tè i ê lâng chit-sî chiah lim-chia̍h hioh-mî. Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, koán-ke tùi in kóng, “Chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa tò-khì góa ê chú-lâng hia.”
Lē-pek-ka ê hiaⁿ-ko kap lāu-bú kóng, “Chhiáⁿ hō͘ cha-bó͘ gín-á kap goán tòa kúi-ji̍t-á, siōng chió cha̍p ji̍t, i chiah kap lín khì.”
I tùi in kóng, “Chhiáⁿ m̄-thang kā góa lâu. Siōng Chú í-keng hō͘ góa chi̍t-lō͘ sūn-lī, chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa kóaⁿ-kín tò-khì góa ê chú-lâng hia.”
In kóng, “Goán kiò cha-bó͘ gín-á lâi, thàm i ê ōe-ì.”
In chiū kiò Lē-pek-ka lâi, mn̄g i kóng, “Lí kiám beh kap chit-ê koán-ke chòe-hé khì?” Lē-pek-ka ìn kóng, “Góa beh.”
In chiū sàng sió-bē Lē-pek-ka kap i ê lin-bú, tè A-pek-la-hán ê koán-ke kap kun-sûi i ê lâng khì.
In kā Lē-pek-ka chiok-hok, kóng: Goán ê sió-bē, goān lí ê kiáⁿ-sun chheng-chheng-bān-bān; goān lí ê hō͘-tāi chiàm-léng tùi-te̍k ê siâⁿ.
Lē-pek-ka kap i ê lú-pī khiâ lo̍k-tô tè hit-ê koán-ke khì; koán-ke chiū chhōa Lē-pek-ka tńg--khì.
Hit-sî, Í-sat sóa-khì Pí-ní La-hái Lâi, tòa tī Nî-kek-hu.
Hông-hun ê sî, Í-sat chhut-lâi iá-gōa sàn-pō͘, gia̍h-thâu chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h lo̍k-tô teh lâi.
Lē-pek-ka khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sat, chiū tùi lo̍k-tô lo̍h--lâi.
I mn̄g hit-ê koán-ke kóng, “Tī iá-tōe ǹg lán chia kiâⁿ--lâi-ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?” Hit-ê koán-ke kóng, “Sī góa ê chú-lâng.” Lē-pek-ka chiū ēng phè jia bīn.
Koán-ke chiong i só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì lóng kā Í-sat pò-kò.
Í-sat chiū khan Lē-pek-ka ji̍p-khì i ê lāu-bú Sa-la ê pò͘-pîⁿ, chhōa i chòe bó͘. Í-sat chin thiàⁿ Lē-pek-ka; i tùi lāu-bú sí liáu-āu, kàu chit-sî chiah tit-tio̍h an-ùi.
A-pek-la-hán koh chhōa Ki-thó͘-la chòe bó͘.
Ki-thó͘-la kā i siⁿ Sim-lân, Iok-san, Bí-tān, Bí-tiân, I-si-pa, kap Su-a.
Iok-san siⁿ Sī-pa kap Tí-tān. Tí-tān ê hō͘-tāi sī A-su-lī -lâng, Lī-to͘-sī -lâng, kap Lī-o͘-bí -lâng.
Bí-tiân ê kiáⁿ sī Í-hoat, Í-hut, Í-lo̍k, A-pí-tāi, Í-le̍k-tāi; chiah-ê lóng sī Ki-thó͘-la ê hō͘-tāi.
A-pek-la-hán chiong i it-chhè só͘ ū--ê hō͘ Í-sat.
A-pek-la-hán mā thàn i iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî, chiong châi-bu̍t pun hō͘ i ê sòe-î hiah-ê kiáⁿ, koh kiò in lī-khui i ê kiáⁿ Í-sat khì tang-pêng ê tōe.
A-pek-la-hán it-seng oa̍h chi̍t-pah chhit-cha̍p gō͘ hè.
A-pek-la-hán chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū, pêng-pêng-an-an tńg-khì i ê chó͘-sian hia.

I ê kiáⁿ Í-sat kap Í-si̍t-má-lī chiong i an-chòng tī Bān-lī tùi-bīn ê Be̍k-pí-la tōng-hia̍t, sī tī A-pek-la-hán tùi Hek -lâng Só-hat ê kiáⁿ Í-hut-lûn bóe--lâi hit-khu hn̂g ê lāi-bīn. A-pek-la-hán kap i ê bó͘ Sa-la lóng bâi-chòng tī hia.
A-pek-la-hán sí liáu-āu, Siōng-tè sù-hok hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ Í-sat; Í-sat tòa tī Pí-ní La-hái Lâi hù-kūn.
Ē-bīn sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī ê hō͘-tāi: Í-si̍t-má-lī sī Sa-la ê lú-pī Ai-ki̍p -lâng Hā-kah kā A-pek-la-hán siⁿ ê kiáⁿ.
Í-si̍t-má-lī chiah-ê kiáⁿ chiàu in chhut-sì ê sūn-sū siá tī ē-bīn: Í-si̍t-má-lī ê tōa-kiáⁿ Nî-pài-iok, koh ū Ki-ta̍t, A-tek-pia̍t, Bí-pí-san,
Bí-si-má, Tō͘-má, Má-sat,
Hap-tāi, Thê-má, I-tu̍t, Ná-hui-si, Ki-tí-má;
chiah-ê lóng sī Í-si̍t-má-lī ê kiáⁿ, chòe cha̍p-jī cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ. In tòa ê chng-siā kap iâⁿ-tōe, lóng chiàu in ê miâ lâi hō.
Í-si̍t-má-lī oa̍h chi̍t-pah saⁿ-cha̍p chhit hè chiū kè-sin, tńg-khì i ê chó͘-sian hia.
I ê hō͘-tāi tòa tī tùi Hap-hui-la kàu Ai-ki̍p tang-pêng ê Su-ní, beh khì A-su̍t ê lō͘ hit-ê tōe-khu; khiā-khí tī i chhin-cho̍k ê tùi-bīn.
Ē-bīn sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ Í-sat ê hō͘-tāi: A-pek-la-hán siⁿ Í-sat;
Í-sat sì-cha̍p hè ê sî chhōa Lē-pek-ka chòe bó͘. Lē-pek-ka sī Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a ê A-lân -lâng Pí-thó͘-lī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, La-pan ê sió-bē.
Í-sat in-ūi i ê bó͘ bōe siⁿ, chiū ūi-tio̍h i kî-kiû Siōng Chú; Siōng Chú èng-ún i ê khún-kiû, i ê bó͘ Lē-pek-ka chiū hoâi-īn.
Nn̄g ê siang-siⁿ-á tī Lē-pek-ka ê pak-tó͘ lāi sio-khoeh, hō͘ i chin kan-khó͘; i chiū kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ góa tio̍h chiah kan-khó͘?” I chiū mn̄g Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú kā i kóng: Nn̄g kok tī lí ê pak-tó͘ lāi; nn̄g cho̍k beh tùi lí ê seng-khu chhut; chi̍t cho̍k beh pí lēng-gōa chi̍t cho̍k khah kiông; tōa--ê beh ho̍k-sāi sòe--ê.
Seng-sán ê sî kàu, kó-jiân pak-tó͘ lāi sī siang-siⁿ-á.
Tāi-seng chhut--lâi-ê, seng-khu âng-âng, kui seng-khu hoat mn̂g chhin-chhiūⁿ chhēng phê-saⁿ; chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Í-sò.
Tè-āu, i ê sió-tī koh chhut--lâi, chhiú giú Í-sò ê kha-āu-tiⁿ; chiū kā hō-miâ kiò Ngá-kok. Nn̄g ê kiáⁿ chhut-sì ê sî, Í-sat tú-á la̍k-cha̍p hè.
Nn̄g ê gín-á chiām-chiām tōa-hàn; Í-sò gâu phah-la̍h, siông-siông tī soaⁿ-iá; Ngá-kok kò-sèng an-chēng, siông-siông tī pò͘-pîⁿ lāi.
Í-sat thiàⁿ Í-sò, in-ūi siông-siông chia̍h Í-sò phah--lâi ê iá-bī. Lē-pek-ka thiàⁿ Ngá-kok.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t Ngá-kok teh khòng-thng, Í-sò tùi soaⁿ-iá tò--lâi, seng-khu chin thiám.
Í-sò kā Ngá-kok kóng, “Góa thiám kah beh sí, pài-thok lí chiong hit-ê âng-âng ê thng hō͘ góa chia̍h.” In-ūi án-ni, Í-sò mā kiò-chòe Í-tong.
Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí seng chiong tōa-kiáⁿ ê bêng-hūn bōe hō͘ góa.”
Í-sò kóng, “Góa to iau kah beh sí ah, chit-ê tōa-kiáⁿ ê bêng-hūn tùi góa ū siáⁿ lō͘-ēng?”
Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí tio̍h seng chiù-chōa.” Í-sò chiū tùi i chiù-chōa, chiong tōa-kiáⁿ ê bêng-hūn bōe hō͘ i.
Ngá-kok chiū chiong piáⁿ kap âng-tāu-thng hō͘ Í-sò; i chiū chia̍h, chia̍h-liáu chiū chòe i khì. Án-ni, Í-sò khòaⁿ-khin i tōa-kiáⁿ ê bêng-hūn.
Í-sat tòa ê só͘-chāi, tī A-pek-la-hán chāi-siⁿ ê sî bat hoat-seng ki-hng, hiān-chāi koh ū ki-hng. Í-sat chiū khì Ki-la-ní, kàu Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê ông A-pí-bí-le̍k hia.
Siōng Chú tùi Í-sat hián-hiān, kóng, “Lí m̄-thang lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p, tio̍h tòa tī góa chí-sī lí ê tōe.

Lí tio̍h kià-ku tī chia, góa beh kap lí tông-chāi, sù-hok lí; in-ūi góa beh chiong chit-ê tōe lóng hō͘ lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi; góa mā beh kian-li̍p góa li̍p-sè tùi lí ê lāu-pē A-pek-la-hán só͘ li̍p ê iok.

Góa beh hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi jîn-sò͘ ke-thiⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ hiah chōe; koh beh chiong chiah-ê tōe lóng sù hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi; beh hō͘ tōe-chiūⁿ bān-cho̍k in-ūi lí ê hō͘-tāi tit-tio̍h hok-khì,
che sī in-ūi A-pek-la-hán ū thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe, chun-siú góa ê hoan-hù, bēng-lēng, kui-lē, kap kà-sī.”
Í-sat tòa tī Ki-la-ní.

Hit só͘-chāi ê lâng kóng-tio̍h i ê bó͘, i chiū kóng “Sī góa ê sió-bē”, m̄-káⁿ kóng “Sī góa ê bó͘”. I sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng, “In-ūi Lē-pek-ka siⁿ-chòe chin súi, kiaⁿ-liáu hit só͘-chāi ê lâng ūi-tio̍h i ê iân-kò͘ kā góa thâi.”
I tī hia tòa chin kú. Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Hui-lī-sū -ông A-pí-bí-le̍k tùi thang-á khòaⁿ--chhut-khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sat kap i ê bó͘ Lē-pek-ka teh saⁿ chhin-jia̍t.
A-pí-bí-le̍k kiò Í-sat lâi, kā i kóng, “I bêng-bêng sī lí ê bó͘, lí ná ōe kóng ‘I sī góa ê sió-bē’?” Í-sat kóng, “Góa siūⁿ-kóng góa ōe in-ūi i hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.”
A-pí-bí-le̍k kóng, “Lí ná ōe tùi goán chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì? Jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan hiám-hiám ū lâng kap lí ê bó͘ chòe-hé khùn; lí chiū hāi goán hoān-chōe.”
A-pí-bí-le̍k chiū bēng-lēng jîn-bîn, kóng, “Nā ū lâng kha̍p-tio̍h chit-ê lâng kap i ê bó͘, it-tēng beh hō͘ i sí.”
Í-sat tī hit só͘-chāi chèng-choh, hit-nî tit-tio̍h pah-pē ê siu-sêng, in-ūi Siōng Chú sù-hok i.
I ê ke-gia̍p put-toān cheng-ka, hui-siông hó-gia̍h.
I ê gû iûⁿ chin chōe, koh ū chin chōe po̍k-jîn; Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiū oàn-tò͘ i.
I ê lāu-pē A-pek-la-hán oa̍h--teh ê sî, po̍k-jîn khui ê chíⁿ, Hui-lī-sū -lâng lóng kā in that--teh, ēng thô͘ thūn--khí-lâi.
A-pí-bí-le̍k tùi Í-sat kóng, “Lí tio̍h lī-khui goán, in-ūi lí pí goán ke chiok kiông-sēng.”
Í-sat chiū lī-khui hia, khì Ki-la-ní ê soaⁿ-kok tah pò͘-pîⁿ khiā-khí.

I ê lāu-pē A-pek-la-hán chāi-siⁿ ê sî khui ê chíⁿ, lóng hō͘ Hui-lī-sū -lâng thūn--khì. Í-sat têng-chài khui hiah-ê chíⁿ, chiàu in lāu-pē só͘ hō ê miâ kā hiah-ê chíⁿ hō-miâ.
Í-sat ê po̍k-jîn tī soaⁿ-kok ó͘ chíⁿ, ó͘-tio̍h chi̍t kháu oa̍h-chúi ê chíⁿ.
Ki-la-ní ê bo̍k-chiá kap Í-sat ê bo̍k-chiá saⁿ-chiⁿ, kóng, “Chit-kháu chíⁿ sī goán ê.” Í-sat chiū kā hit-kháu chíⁿ hō-miâ kiò-chòe Ai-sek; in-ūi in kap i saⁿ-chiⁿ.
Í-sat ê po̍k-jîn koh ó͘ chi̍t kháu chíⁿ, in koh ūi-tio̍h chit-kháu chíⁿ saⁿ-chiⁿ; Í-sat chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Se-thê-ná.

Í-sat lī-khui hia, koh khì khui chi̍t kháu chíⁿ; in bô koh ūi-tio̍h chit-kháu chíⁿ saⁿ-chiⁿ. Í-sat chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Lī-hô-pek; i kóng, “Taⁿ Siōng Chú hō͘ goán khui-khoah ê tōe thang hoat-tián; goán beh tī chit-ê tōe heng-ōng.”
Í-sat tùi hia chiūⁿ-khì Pia̍t-sī-pa.

Hit-mî, Siōng Chú tùi i hián-hiān, kóng, “Góa sī lí ê lāu-pē A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè. M̄-bián kiaⁿ, in-ūi góa kap lí tông-chāi; góa beh ūi-tio̍h góa ê po̍k-jîn A-pek-la-hán ê iân-kò͘ sù-hok lí, hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi heng-ōng.”
Í-sat chiū tī hia khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, kèng-pài Siōng Chú, tah pò͘-pîⁿ khiā-khí. I ê po̍k-jîn tī hia ó͘ chi̍t kháu chíⁿ.
A-pí-bí-le̍k chhōa i ê kò͘-būn A-hō͘-sat kap goân-sòe Hui-kok, tùi Ki-la-ní lâi kìⁿ Í-sat.
Í-sat tùi in kóng, “Lín kì-jiân oàn-hūn góa, kā góa kóaⁿ-cháu, sī-án-chóaⁿ koh lâi chhē góa?”
In kóng, “Goán chheng-chhó chai Siōng Chú kap lí tông-chāi, só͘-í goán siūⁿ, lán siang-hong lâi chiù-chōa, li̍p-iok.
Lí m̄-thang siong-hāi goán, chhin-chhiūⁿ goán m̄-bat kha̍p-tio̍h lí; í-chêng goán hó khoán-thāi lí, koh sàng lí an-choân lī-khui. Taⁿ Siōng Chú ū sù-hok lí.”
Í-sat pān-toh chhiáⁿ in, in chiū chòe-hé lim-chia̍h.
Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, in hō͘-siōng chiù-chōa. Í-sat sàng in khí-sin, in chiū pêng-an lī-khui.
Siâng hit-ji̍t, Í-sat ê po̍k-jîn lâi, chiong in khui-chíⁿ ê sū kā i pò-kò, kóng, “Goán ó͘-tio̍h chúi lah.”
Í-sat chiū kā hit-kháu chíⁿ kiò-chòe Sī-pa; só͘-í kàu kin-á-ji̍t, hit-ê siâⁿ kiò-chòe Pia̍t-sī-pa.
Í-sò sì-cha̍p hè ê sî chhōa Hek -lâng Pī-lī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Iû-tek, kap Hek -lâng Í-lûn ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Pa-si̍t-boat chòe bó͘.
Chit nn̄g ê hū-jîn-lâng siông-siông hō͘ Í-sat kap Lē-pek-ka sim-lāi iu-būn chhau-hoân.
Í-sat nî-lāu, ba̍k-chiu hoe, bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū kiò i ê tōa-kiáⁿ Í-sò lâi, kā i kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ ah.” I ìn kóng, “Góa tī chia.”
Í-sat kóng, “Góa chin lāu lah, m̄ chai tó chi̍t ji̍t beh sí.
Taⁿ gia̍h lí phah-la̍h ê ke-si, chiū-sī chìⁿ-tē kap keng, khì iá-tōe kā góa phah-la̍h,
chiàu góa ài ê kháu-bī chú lâi hō͘ góa chia̍h, hō͘ góa tī iáu-bē sí í-chêng kā lí chiok-hok.”
Lē-pek-ka ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sat tùi i ê kiáⁿ Í-sò kóng ê ōe. Í-sò chhut-khì iá-tōe phah-la̍h, beh tòa la̍h-bu̍t tò--lâi;
Lē-pek-ka tùi i ê kiáⁿ Ngá-kok kóng, “Góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín lāu-pē kā lí ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-sò kóng,
‘Lí khì lia̍h la̍h-bu̍t tò--lâi, chú hō͘ hó-chia̍h, phâng-lâi hō͘ góa; góa beh tī iáu-bē sí í-chêng, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kā lí chiok-hok.’
Taⁿ, góa ê kiáⁿ, lí tio̍h thiaⁿ góa ê ōe, chiàu góa kā lí kóng--ê khì chòe.
Lí khì iûⁿ-kûn hia, lia̍h nn̄g chiah pûi ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ lâi; góa beh chiàu lín lāu-pē kah-ì ê kháu-bī chú hō͘ i chia̍h.
Lí phâng-khì hō͘ lín lāu-pē chia̍h, thang hō͘ i tī iáu-bē sí í-chêng kā lí chiok-hok.”
Ngá-kok tùi i ê lāu-bú Lē-pek-ka kóng, “M̄-kú góa ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-sò seng-khu ū mn̂g, góa ê phê-hu kng-ku̍t.
Góa ê lāu-pē nā bong-tio̍h góa, ōe chai góa teh kā i phiàn; góa m̄-nā bōe-tàng tit-tio̍h i ê chiok-hok, tian-tò siū i chiù-chó͘.”
I ê lāu-bú kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, lí nā siū chiù-chó͘, góa lâi sêng-tam. Chòe lí thiaⁿ góa ê ōe, khì lia̍h iûⁿ-á lâi hō͘ góa.”
Ngá-kok chiū khì lia̍h iûⁿ-á lâi hō͘ i ê lāu-bú; i ê lāu-bú chiū chiàu i ê lāu-pē kah-ì ê kháu-bī liāu-lí.
Lē-pek-ka koh hiahⁿ tōa-kiáⁿ Í-sò siu tī chhù-lāi siōng-hó ê saⁿ, hō͘ i ê sòe-hàn-kiáⁿ Ngá-kok chhēng.
I koh ēng soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á ê phê, pau Ngá-kok ê chhiú kap ām-kún kng-ku̍t ê só͘-chāi.
Jiân-āu, chiong i chú ê liāu-lí kap piáⁿ, kau hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ Ngá-kok.
Ngá-kok khì in lāu-pē hia, kóng, “A-pa.” Í-sat kóng, “Góa tī chia. Góa ê kiáⁿ, lí sī tó chi̍t ê?”

Ngá-kok tùi i ê lāu-pē kóng, “Góa sī lí ê tōa-kiáⁿ Í-sò. Góa í-keng chiàu lí hoan-hù--ê khì chòe. Chhiáⁿ khí-lâi chē, chia̍h góa phah--tio̍h ê la̍h-bu̍t; chia̍h-pá thang kā góa chiok-hok.”
Í-sat tùi i ê kiáⁿ kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ, lí ná ōe chiah kín chiū phah--tio̍h?” Ngá-kok ìn kóng, “In-ūi Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè hō͘ góa chin hó-ūn.”
Í-sat kā Ngá-kok kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ, kiâⁿ khah óa--lâi; góa beh bong lí, khòaⁿ lí kiám chin-chiàⁿ sī góa ê kiáⁿ Í-sò?”
Ngá-kok chiū óa-kūn i ê lāu-pē Í-sat. Í-sat chiū bong i, kóng, “Siaⁿ, sī Ngá-kok ê siaⁿ; chhiú, sī Í-sò ê chhiú.”
Í-sat hun bōe chheng-chhó, in-ūi Ngá-kok ê chhiú ū mn̂g, chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-sò, chiū kā i chiok-hok.
Koh kóng, “Lí kiám chin-chiàⁿ sī góa ê kiáⁿ Í-sò?” Ngá-kok kóng, “Góa sī.”
Í-sat kóng, “Lí phah--tio̍h ê la̍h-bu̍t phâng-lâi hō͘ góa chia̍h, góa thang kā lí chiok-hok.” Ngá-kok chiū phâng hō͘ i chia̍h, koh the̍h chiú hō͘ i lim.
I ê lāu-pē Í-sat tùi i kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ, óa-lâi kā góa chim.”
Ngá-kok chiū chìn-chêng chim i ê lāu-pē; i ê lāu-pē phīⁿ-tio̍h i ê saⁿ ê bī, chiū kā i chiok-hok kóng: Góa ê kiáⁿ ê bī, chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú sù-hok ê chhân-hn̂g ê bī.
Goān Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lí thiⁿ-téng ê kam-lō͘, hō͘ lí ê thó͘-tōe pûi-súi, ngó͘-kok kap sin-chiú chin chōe.

Goān bān-bîn ho̍k-sāi lí, lia̍t-kok kūi-pài lí; goān lí thóng-tī lí ê hiaⁿ-tī, lí ê lāu-bú ê kiáⁿ kūi-pài lí; chiù-chó͘ lí--ê siū chiù-chó͘, chiok-hok lí--ê siū chiok-hok.
Í-sat kā Ngá-kok chiok-hok liáu, Ngá-kok tùi i ê lāu-pē Í-sat hia chhut--lâi ê sî, i ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-sò tú-tú phah-la̍h tò--lâi.
I mā chú hó-chia̍h ê liāu-lí, phâng-lâi hō͘ i ê lāu-pē, kóng, “A-pa, chhiáⁿ khí-lâi chia̍h kiáⁿ phah--tio̍h ê la̍h-bu̍t, chia̍h-pá thang kā góa chiok-hok.”
I ê lāu-pē Í-sat kā i kóng, “Lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?” I kóng, “Góa sī lí ê tōa-kiáⁿ Í-sò.”

Í-sat tōa kiaⁿ, phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, kóng, “Tú-chiah hit-ê sī siáⁿ-lâng? Hit-ê lâng tī lí iáu-bē lâi í-chêng, phâng la̍h-bu̍t hō͘ góa chia̍h, góa chia̍h-liáu chiū kā i chiok-hok; i it-tēng ōe tit-tio̍h hok-khì.”
Í-sò chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h lāu-pē ê ōe, khui-siaⁿ kiò-khó͘ tōa khàu, tùi i ê lāu-pē kóng, “A-pa, lí mā tio̍h kā góa chiok-hok.”
Í-sat kóng, “Lí ê sió-tī í-keng ēng khúi-kè chhiúⁿ lí ê hok-hūn.”

Í-sò kóng, “I kiò-chòe Ngá-kok, kiám m̄-sī chin ha̍h? I phiàn góa nn̄g piàn: Chhiúⁿ góa tōa-kiáⁿ ê bêng-hūn, chit-piàn koh chhiúⁿ góa ê hok-hūn.” Í-sò koh kóng, “Lí kiám bô koh ū sím-mi̍h thang kā góa chiok-hok?”

Í-sat ìn Í-sò kóng, “Góa í-keng siat-li̍p i chòe lí ê chú, hō͘ i ê chhin-cho̍k ho̍k-sāi i; koh ēng ngó͘-kok sin-chiú iúⁿ-chhī i. Góa ê kiáⁿ, góa iáu ōe-tàng kā lí chòe sím-mi̍h?”
Í-sò kā i ê lāu-pē kóng, “A-pa, lí ê chiok-hok kiám kan-ta chi̍t chióng? A-pa, góa, lí mā tio̍h kā góa chiok-hok.” Í-sò khui-siaⁿ tōa khàu.
I ê lāu-pē Í-sat ìn i, kóng: Lí bô pûi-súi ê thó͘-tōe thang khiā-khí, mā bô thiⁿ-téng ê kam-lō͘ thang lūn-te̍k.
Lí beh óa-khò to-kiàm tō͘-oa̍h, koh beh ho̍k-sāi lí ê sió-tī; kàu lí kiông-sēng ê ji̍t, beh tùi lí ê ām-kún hàiⁿ-tiāu i ê taⁿ.

Í-sò in-ūi Ngá-kok tit-tio̍h lāu-pē ê chiok-hok, chiū oàn-hūn Ngá-kok; sim-lāi kóng, “Goán lāu-pē teh-beh kè-sin, tán song-sū pān-liáu, góa beh thâi-sí góa ê sió-tī Ngá-kok.”

Ū lâng chiong tōa-kiáⁿ Í-sò ê kè-ōe kā Lē-pek-ka kóng, Lē-pek-ka chiū chhe lâng khì kiò i ê sòe-hàn-kiáⁿ Ngá-kok lâi, kā i kóng, “Lín hiaⁿ-ko Í-sò beh thâi lí, siau i ê oàn-hūn.
Taⁿ, góa ê kiáⁿ, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa ê ōe; kóaⁿ-kín cháu-khì Hap-lân lín a-kū La-pan hia;
kap i tòa chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan, thèng-hāu lín hiaⁿ-ko ê siū-khì siau.
Kàu lín hiaⁿ-ko siū-khì soah, bōe-kì-tit lí tùi i só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì, hit-sî góa chiah chhe lâng khì chhōa lí tò--lâi. Góa ná tio̍h chi̍t ji̍t lāi sit-khì nn̄g ê kiáⁿ?”

Lē-pek-ka tùi Í-sat kóng, “Góa in-ūi Í-sò chhōa chit nn̄g ê Hek -lâng ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, oa̍h kah chin kan-khó͘. Ngá-kok nā koh chhōa chit só͘-chāi Hek -lâng ê cha-bó͘ gín-á, góa oa̍h--teh ū siáⁿ ì-sù?”
Í-sat kiò Ngá-kok lâi, kā i chiok-hok, hoan-hù i kóng, “Lí m̄-thang chhōa Ka-lâm ê cha-bó͘ gín-á chòe bó͘.
Lí sûi-sî khì Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a, khì lín gōa-kong Pí-thó͘-lī hia, chhōa lín bú-kū La-pan ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chòe bó͘.
Goān Choân-lêng ê Siōng-tè sù-hok lí, hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi ke-thiⁿ ke̍k-kî chōe, chiâⁿ-chòe chin chōe cho̍k.

Goān Siōng-tè chiong I beh hō͘ A-pek-la-hán ê hok-khì sù hō͘ lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi, hō͘ lí sêng-chiap lí hiān-chāi kià-ku ê tōe chòe sán-gia̍p, chiū-sī Siōng-tè hō͘ A-pek-la-hán ê tōe.”
Í-sat kiò Ngá-kok chhut-hoat, Ngá-kok chiū khì Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a, A-lân -lâng Pí-thó͘-lī ê kiáⁿ La-pan hia; La-pan sī Lē-pek-ka ê hiaⁿ-ko, Ngá-kok kap Í-sò ê bú-kū.

Í-sò khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sat kā Ngá-kok chiok-hok, kiò i khì Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a, tùi hia chhōa-bó͘; koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sat chiok-hok Ngá-kok ê sî, hoan-hù i m̄-thang kap Ka-lâm ê cha-bó͘ gín-á kiat-hun;
koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h Ngá-kok thiaⁿ pē-bú ê ōe khì Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a,
chiū chai i ê lāu-pē Í-sat bô kah-ì i chhōa Ka-lâm ê cha-bó͘ gín-á chòe bó͘.
Í-sò chiū khì Í-si̍t-má-lī hia, tī i hiah-ê bó͘ í-gōa koh chhōa Má-hap-la; Má-hap-la sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, Nî-pài-iok ê sió-bē.
Ngá-kok lī-khui Pia̍t-sī-pa, beh khì Hap-lân.
Kàu chi̍t ê só͘-chāi, in-ūi ji̍t lo̍h, chiū tī hia hioh-mî; i the̍h chi̍t tè chio̍h-thâu chòe chím-thâu, tī hia khùn.
I bāng-kìⁿ ū chi̍t ê thui chhāi tī tōe--ni̍h, thui ê téng-bīn tú-thiⁿ, ū Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá tī thui--ni̍h khí-khí-lo̍h-lo̍h.

Hit-sî, Siōng Chú khiā tī thui-téng, kóng, “Góa sī Siōng Chú — lí ê a-kong A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, mā-sī Í-sat ê Siōng-tè. Góa beh chiong lí hiān-chāi khùn ê tōe siúⁿ-sù lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi.

Lí ê hō͘-tāi ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ tōe-chiūⁿ ê thô͘-soa hiah-ni̍h chōe; lí ōe ǹg tang, sai, lâm, pak hoat-tián; tōe-chiūⁿ bān-cho̍k ōe in-ūi lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi tit-tio̍h hok-khì.
Lí bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, góa beh kap lí tông-chāi, pó-hō͘ lí; mā beh chhōa lí tò-lâi chit-ê só͘-chāi, lóng bōe pàng-sak lí, ti̍t-kàu góa si̍t-hiān tùi lí kóng ê èng-ún.”
Ngá-kok tùi bîn-bāng chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, chiū kóng, “Siōng Chú chin-chiàⁿ tī chia, góa kèng-jiân m̄ chai.”
I chin kiaⁿ, kóng, “Chit-ê só͘-chāi ū-kàu khó-phàⁿ! Chia chin-chiàⁿ sī Siōng-tè ê chhù, sī thiⁿ ê mn̂g.”
Ngá-kok thàu-chá khí--lâi, chiong i chòe chím-thâu ê chio̍h chhāi chòe thiāu, koh tò iû tī hit téng-bīn.
I kā hit-ê só͘-chāi hō-chòe Pek-te̍k-lī; chit-ê siâⁿ pún-lâi kiò-chòe Lō͘-su.
Ngá-kok hē-goān kóng, “Siōng-tè nā kap góa tông-chāi, chi̍t-lō͘ pó-hō͘ góa, koh hō͘ góa ū mi̍h thang chia̍h, ū saⁿ thang chhēng,
hō͘ góa pêng-an tò-lâi goán lāu-pē ê chhù, góa chiū chun Siōng Chú lí chòe góa ê Siōng-tè.
Góa chhāi khí-lâi chòe thiāu chit-tè chio̍h-thâu beh chòe Siōng-tè ê chhù. Só͘-ū lí siúⁿ-sù góa--ê, góa it-tēng beh hiàn cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t hō͘ lí.”
Ngá-kok kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ, khì kàu tang-hng ê lâng ê tōe.
I khòaⁿ-tio̍h iá-tōe ū chi̍t kháu chíⁿ, ū saⁿ tīn iûⁿ tó tī hia; lâng lóng chhiūⁿ hit-kháu chíⁿ ê chúi hō͘ iûⁿ lim. Chíⁿ ēng tōa tè chio̍h khàm--teh.
Pêng-sî, iûⁿ-kûn chū-chi̍p tī hia, kò͘-iûⁿ--ê chiong chio̍h-thâu sóa-khui, chhiūⁿ-chúi hō͘ iûⁿ lim, chiah koh chiong chio̍h-thâu sóa tò-khì goân-ūi.
Ngá-kok tùi in kóng, “Pêng-iú ah, lín tùi tó-ūi lâi?” In kóng, “Goán tùi Hap-lân lâi.”
I mn̄g in, “Lín kiám bat Ná-ho̍k ê sun La-pan?” In kóng, “Goán bat.”
Ngá-kok koh kóng, “I ū hó-sè hó-sè bô?” In kóng, “Ū. Lí khòaⁿ, i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Lúi-kiat chhōa i ê iûⁿ-kûn teh lâi.”
Ngá-kok kóng, “Ji̍t-thâu iáu chiah tōa, iáu-bē kàu kóaⁿ iûⁿ tńg--khì ê sî-kan, ná m̄ hō͘ iûⁿ lim-chúi, koh khì chia̍h-chháu?”
In kóng, “Goán iáu bōe-tàng, tio̍h thèng-hāu só͘-ū ê iûⁿ-kûn lóng kàu, bo̍k-chiá kā chio̍h-thâu sóa-khui, chiah ōe-tàng hō͘ iûⁿ lim-chúi.”
Ngá-kok teh kap in kóng-ōe ê sî, Lúi-kiat chhōa in lāu-pē ê iûⁿ lâi, in-ūi sī i teh kò͘.
Ngá-kok khòaⁿ-tio̍h bú-kū La-pan ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Lúi-kiat kap La-pan ê iûⁿ-kûn, chiū chìn-chêng chiong chio̍h-thâu sóa-khui, hō͘ La-pan ê iûⁿ-kûn lim.
Ngá-kok chim Lúi-kiat, kā i chhéng-an, koh tōa-siaⁿ háu.
Ngá-kok kā Lúi-kiat kóng, i sī in lāu-pē ê gōe-seng-á, sī Lē-pek-ka ê kiáⁿ; Lúi-kiat chiū cháu tńg-khì kā in lāu-pē kóng.
La-pan thiaⁿ-tio̍h gōe-seng-á Ngá-kok ê siau-sit, chiū cháu-khì chiap i, kā i lám--teh, kā i chim, chhōa i khì in tau; Ngá-kok chiong tāi-chì ê keng-kè kā La-pan kóng.
La-pan kā Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí chin-chiàⁿ sī góa ê kut-jio̍k chì-chhin.” Ngá-kok chiū kap i tòa chi̍t ge̍h-ji̍t.
La-pan kā Ngá-kok kóng, “Lán sui-jiân sī chhin-chiâⁿ, góa ná thang hō͘ lí pe̍h-pe̍h kā góa chòe kang? Lí tio̍h kā góa kóng, góa tio̍h hō͘ lí jōa-chōe kang-chîⁿ.”
La-pan ū nn̄g ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, tōa--ê kiò-chòe Lē-a, sòe--ê kiò-chòe Lúi-kiat.
Lē-a ba̍k-chiu súi, Lúi-kiat sin-châi hó, siⁿ-chòe súi.
Ngá-kok ài Lúi-kiat, chiū kóng, “Góa goān-ì ūi-tio̍h lí ê sòe-hàn cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Lúi-kiat chòe kang chhit nî.”
La-pan kóng, “Kā i kè hō͘ lí, pí kè hō͘ pa̍t-lâng khah hó. Lí kap góa tòa.”
Ngá-kok chiū ūi-tio̍h Lúi-kiat kā La-pan chòe kang chhit nî; in-ūi chhim-chhim ài i, chhit nî ká-ná chhin-chhiūⁿ kúi-ji̍t-á.
Ngá-kok tùi La-pan kóng, “Chhit nî móa lah, chhiáⁿ lí chiong góa ê bó͘ hō͘ góa, góa thang kap i kiat-hun.”
La-pan pān-toh chhiáⁿ hit só͘-chāi ê lâng.
Kàu ji̍t àm, La-pan chiong i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Lē-a sàng-lâi hō͘ Ngá-kok, i chiū kap Lē-a tâng-pâng.
La-pan chiong i ê lú-pī Sek-phà hō͘ i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Lē-a chòe lú-pī.

Kàu thiⁿ-kng, Ngá-kok chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h sī Lē-a, chiū tùi La-pan kóng, “Lí ná ōe án-ni tùi-thāi góa? Góa kā lí chòe kang, kiám m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h Lúi-kiat? Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ khi-phiàn góa?”
La-pan kóng, “Iáu-bē kè tōa--ê, seng kè sòe--ê, tī goán chia bô chit-ê lē.
Lí kap Lē-a chhit ji̍t ê hí-sū liáu-āu, goán chiū chiong Lúi-kiat kè hō͘ lí, m̄-kú lí tio̍h koh kā góa chòe kang chhit nî.”
Ngá-kok chiū chiàu án-ni chòe. I kap Lē-a chòe-hé chhit ji̍t liáu-āu, La-pan chiū chiong i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Lúi-kiat hō͘ Ngá-kok chòe bó͘.
La-pan chiong i ê lú-pī Phek-la hō͘ Lúi-kiat chòe lú-pī.
Ngá-kok mā kap Lúi-kiat tâng-pâng; i khah thiàⁿ Lúi-kiat, chiū koh kā La-pan chòe kang chhit nî.
Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-tio̍h Lē-a bô siū thiàⁿ-sioh, chiū hō͘ i hoâi-īn; m̄-kú Lúi-kiat bōe siⁿ.
Lē-a hoâi-īn siⁿ-kiáⁿ, chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Lū-piān; i kóng, “Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê khó͘-chêng; taⁿ góa ê tiōng-hu ōe thiàⁿ góa.”
I koh hoâi-īn siⁿ tē-jī ê kiáⁿ; i kóng “Siōng Chú thiaⁿ-kìⁿ góa bô siū thiàⁿ-sioh, só͘-í koh hō͘ góa chit-ê kiáⁿ”, chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Se-biān.
I koh hoâi-īn siⁿ tē-saⁿ ê kiáⁿ, kóng “Góa kā tiōng-hu siⁿ saⁿ ê kiáⁿ, i ōe kap góa kiat-liân”, chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Lī-bī.
I koh hoâi-īn siⁿ tē-sì ê kiáⁿ, kóng “Chit-piàn góa beh chheng-chàn Siōng Chú”, chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Iû-tāi; Lē-a chiū bô koh siⁿ.
Lúi-kiat khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ka-kī bô kā Ngá-kok siⁿ-kiáⁿ, chiū oàn-tò͘ i ê tōa-chí. I tùi Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí tio̍h kiáⁿ hō͘ góa; nā bô, góa beh sí.”
Ngá-kok tùi Lúi-kiat siū-khì, kóng, “Hō͘ lí bōe siⁿ--ê sī Siōng-tè, góa kiám ōe-tàng tāi-thòe Siōng-tè?”
Lúi-kiat kóng, “Góa ê lú-pī Phek-la tī chia; lí khì kap i tâng-pâng, hō͘ i thòe góa siⁿ-kiáⁿ; góa chiū thang tùi i tit-tio̍h kiáⁿ.”
Lúi-kiat chiong i ê lú-pī Phek-la hō͘ Ngá-kok chòe bó͘; Ngá-kok chiū kap i tâng-pâng.
Phek-la hoâi-īn, kā Ngá-kok siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ.
Lúi-kiat kóng “Siōng-tè thòe góa chú-chhî kong-tō, thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó, hō͘ góa ū kiáⁿ”, chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Tān.
Lúi-kiat ê lú-pī Phek-la koh hoâi-īn, kā Ngá-kok siⁿ tē-jī ê kiáⁿ;
Lúi-kiat kóng “Góa kap góa ê tōa-chí saⁿ-chiⁿ, góa khah iâⁿ”, chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Ná-hut-tha-lī.
Lē-a khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ka-kī bô koh siⁿ, chiū chiong i ê lú-pī Sek-phà hō͘ Ngá-kok chòe bó͘.
Lē-a ê lú-pī Sek-phà kā Ngá-kok siⁿ-kiáⁿ.
Lē-a kóng, “Hó-ka-chài!” I chiū kā gín-á hō-miâ kiò-chòe Ka-tek.
Lē-a ê lú-pī Sek-phà koh kā Ngá-kok siⁿ tē-jī ê kiáⁿ.
Lē-a kóng, “Góa ū hok-khì! Chèng lú-chú ōe kóng góa sī ū hok-khì ê cha-bó͘-lâng.” I chiū kā gín-á hō-miâ kiò-chòe A-siat.

Siu-koah sió-be̍h ê sî, Lū-piān tī hn̂g--ni̍h tit-tio̍h chhui-chêng-kó, the̍h-lâi hō͘ i ê lāu-bú Lē-a. Lúi-kiat tùi Lē-a kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chiong lí ê kiáⁿ ê chhui-chêng-kó hō͘ góa.”

Lē-a tùi i kóng, “Lí chhiúⁿ góa ê tiōng-hu, kiám iáu bô-kàu? Beh koh chhiúⁿ góa ê kiáⁿ ê chhui-chêng-kó sī--bô?” Lúi-kiat kóng, “Ūi-tio̍h lí ê kiáⁿ ê chhui-chêng-kó, kim-mî hō͘ Ngá-kok kap lí chòe-hé khùn.”

Ji̍t àm, Ngá-kok tùi hn̂g--ni̍h tò--lâi; Lē-a chhut-khì chiap i, kā i kóng, “Lí tio̍h kap góa khùn, in-ūi lí sī góa ēng góa ê kiáⁿ ê chhui-chêng-kó kau-ōaⁿ--lâi-ê.” Hit-mî Ngá-kok chiū kap i chòe-hé khùn.
Siōng-tè thiaⁿ Lē-a ê kî-tó, i chiū hoâi-īn, kā Ngá-kok siⁿ tē-gō͘ ê kiáⁿ.
Lē-a kóng “Siōng-tè pò-siúⁿ góa, in-ūi góa chiong lú-pī hō͘ góa ê tiōng-hu”, chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Í-sat-ka.
Lē-a koh hoâi-īn, kā Ngá-kok siⁿ tē-la̍k ê kiáⁿ.
Lē-a kóng, “Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù góa pó-kùi ê lé-mi̍h; góa ê tiōng-hu beh khòaⁿ-tāng góa, in-ūi góa kā i siⁿ la̍k ê kiáⁿ.” Lē-a chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Se-pò͘-lûn.
Āu-lâi, Lē-a siⁿ chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Tí-ná.
Siōng-tè siàu-liām Lúi-kiat, thiaⁿ i ê kî-tó, hō͘ i ōe siⁿ.
I chiū hoâi-īn siⁿ-kiáⁿ; kóng “Siōng-tè tû-khì góa ê kiàn-siàu”,
chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Iok-sek, kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú koh ke-thiⁿ góa chi̍t ê kiáⁿ.”
Lúi-kiat siⁿ Iok-sek liáu-āu, Ngá-kok tùi La-pan kóng, “Chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa tò-khì góa ê kò͘-hiong,
mā chhiáⁿ lí chiong góa ho̍k-sāi lí só͘ tit--tio̍h ê bó͘-kiáⁿ lóng hō͘ góa, hō͘ goán tò--khì; góa án-chóaⁿ chhut-la̍t ho̍k-sāi lí, lí lóng chai.”
La-pan kā i kóng, “Lí nā khòaⁿ góa ū-kàu-tāng, chhiáⁿ kè-sio̍k kap góa tòa, in-ūi góa tùi pok-kòa chai, Siōng Chú in-ūi lí ê iân-kò͘ ū sù-hok góa.”
I koh kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kā góa kóng, góa tio̍h hō͘ lí jōa-chōe kang-chîⁿ, góa chiū hō͘ lí.”
Ngá-kok kā i kóng, “Góa án-chóaⁿ ho̍k-sāi lí, góa án-chóaⁿ chiàu-kò͘ lí ê cheng-siⁿ, lí lóng chai.

Góa iáu-bē lâi í-chêng, lí só͘-ū--ê chin chió, hiān-chāi ke-thiⁿ chin chōe; góa bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, Siōng Chú lóng tè teh kā lí chiok-hok. Taⁿ, tī-sî góa chiah ōe-tàng ūi-tio̍h góa ka-kī ê ka-têng kiàn-tì ke-gia̍p?”

La-pan kóng, “Góa tio̍h sím-mi̍h hō͘ lí?” Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí sím-mi̍h lóng m̄-bián hō͘ góa. Ū chi̍t hāng tāi-chì lí nā tah-èng, góa chiū iû-goân kò͘-siú, chhī lí ê iûⁿ-kûn.

Kin-á-ji̍t hō͘ góa sûn lí só͘-ū ê iûⁿ-kûn, chiong mî-iûⁿ tiong-kan ū-tiám ū-pan--ê, kap o͘-sek ê mî-iûⁿ-á, í-ki̍p soaⁿ-iûⁿ tiong ū-pan ū-tiám--ê, lóng pun chhut-lâi chòe góa ê kang-chîⁿ.

Í-āu lí lâi khòaⁿ góa só͘ tit ê kang-chîⁿ, nā soaⁿ-iûⁿ bô-pan bô-tiám--ê, mî-iûⁿ-á m̄-sī o͘-sek--ê, chiū sǹg sī góa thau--ê; ēng án-ni lâi chèng-bêng góa ê sêng-si̍t.”
La-pan kóng, “Hó, chiàu lí kóng--ê.”
Hit-ji̍t, La-pan chiū chiong ū-pan ū-tiâu-bûn ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, ū-pan ū-tiám chhap-tio̍h pe̍h-sek ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú, í-ki̍p o͘-sek ê mî-iûⁿ-á, lóng pun chhut-lâi kau hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ.
I hō͘ ka-kī kap Ngá-kok saⁿ-lī ū saⁿ ji̍t ê lō͘-thêng; Ngá-kok chiū kò͘ La-pan kî-tha ê iûⁿ.
Ngá-kok the̍h iông-chhiū, hēng-chhiū, kap png-chhiū chhiⁿ koh nńg ê ki, pak chi̍t-pō͘-hūn ê phê, hō͘ lāi-bīn pe̍h-sek ê tiâu-bûn lō͘-chhut.
I chiong pak-phê ê ki chhah tī iûⁿ lim-chúi ê chúi-kau kap chúi-chô, hō͘ in kap iûⁿ saⁿ-tùi; iûⁿ lâi lim-chúi ê sî, kang-bú kau-ha̍p.
Iûⁿ tī ki ê tùi-bīn kau-ha̍p, chiū siⁿ ū-pan, ū-tiám, ū-tiâu-bûn--ê.

Ngá-kok chiong mî-iûⁿ-á pun--chhut-lâi, hō͘ in bīn ǹg La-pan ū-tiâu-bûn kap o͘-sek ê iûⁿ. I chiong ka-kī ê iûⁿ lēng-gōa pàng tī chi̍t ê só͘-chāi, bô kap La-pan ê iûⁿ chham-chhap.
Ióng-chòng ê iûⁿ kau-ha̍p ê sî, Ngá-kok ēng chhiū-ki chhah tī chúi-kau lāi, hō͘ iûⁿ bīn-tùi chhiū-ki kau-ha̍p.
M̄-kú siau-sán ê iûⁿ kau-ha̍p ê sî, i chiū bô chhah chhiū-ki; án-ni, siau-sán--ê kui La-pan, ióng-chòng--ê kui Ngá-kok.
Tùi án-ni, Ngá-kok hui-siông hó-gia̍h, ū chin chōe iûⁿ-kûn, lú-pī, po̍k-jîn, lo̍k-tô, kap lû.
Ngá-kok ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h La-pan ê kiáⁿ teh kóng, “ Ngá-kok chiong lán lāu-pē só͘-ū--ê lóng chhiúⁿ--khì, lī-iōng lán lāu-pē ê châi-bu̍t tit-tio̍h it-chhè ê châi-hù.”
Ngá-kok khòaⁿ-tio̍h La-pan ê thài-tō͘ bô chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng hiah-ni̍h hó.
Siōng Chú tùi Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí tio̍h tò-khì lí chó͘-sian ê tōe, khì lí ê chhin-cho̍k hia; góa beh kap lí tông-chāi.”
Ngá-kok chhe lâng khì kiò Lúi-kiat kap Lē-a lâi iá-tōe ê iûⁿ-kûn hia,
tùi in kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín lāu-pē ê thài-tō͘ bô chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng hiah-ni̍h hó; m̄-kú góa ê lāu-pē ê Siōng-tè kap góa tông-chāi.
Lín chai, góa ū chīn góa só͘-ū ê khùi-la̍t thòe lín lāu-pē chòe kang,
sī lín lāu-pē phiàn góa, bat cha̍p piàn kái-piàn góa ê kang-chîⁿ, m̄-kú Siōng-tè m̄ iông-ún i hāi góa.
I nā kóng ū-tiám--ê hō͘ góa chòe kang-chîⁿ, iûⁿ-kûn siⁿ--ê chiū lóng ū tiám; i nā kóng ū-tiâu-bûn--ê hō͘ góa chòe kang-chîⁿ, iûⁿ-kûn siⁿ--ê chiū lóng ū tiâu-bûn.
Án-ni, Siōng-tè chiong lín lāu-pē ê cheng-siⁿ the̍h kè-lâi sù hō͘ góa.
“Iûⁿ kau-ha̍p ê sî, góa tī bāng-tiong gia̍h-thâu chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h phah iûⁿ-bú ê iûⁿ-káng lóng sī ū-tiám, ū-tiâu-bûn, ū-hoe-pan--ê;
Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá tī bāng-tiong tùi góa kóng, ‘ Ngá-kok.’ Góa kóng, ‘Góa tī chia.’
I kóng, ‘Lí gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, phah iûⁿ-bú ê iûⁿ-káng lóng sī ū-tiám, ū-tiâu-bûn, ū-hoe-pan--ê. La-pan tùi lí só͘ chòe--ê, góa lóng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h.
Góa sī Pek-te̍k-lī ê Siōng-tè, lí bat tī hia ēng iû tò tī chio̍h-thiāu téng, tùi góa hē-goān. Taⁿ, lí tio̍h khí--lâi, lī-khui chit-ê só͘-chāi, tò-khì lí ê kò͘-hiong.’”
Lúi-kiat kap Lē-a ìn i kóng, “Tī goán lāu-pē ê ke, kiám iáu ū goán thang tit ê ke-hé kap sán-gia̍p?
Goán kiám m̄-sī í-keng hō͘ i khòaⁿ-chòe gōa-lâng? I bōe goán, thun-chia̍h goán ê kè-chîⁿ.
Siōng-tè tùi goán lāu-pē the̍h--khì hiah-ê châi-bu̍t, chiū-sī goán kap goán ê kiáⁿ ê. Taⁿ, lí tio̍h chiàu Siōng-tè hoan-hù lí--ê khì chòe.”
Ngá-kok chiū sûi-sî hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ kap bó͘ lóng khiâ lo̍k-tô,
koh tòa i tī Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a tit--tio̍h ê cheng-siⁿ kap chek-chū ê châi-bu̍t chhut-hoat, beh tńg-khì Ka-lâm -tōe i ê lāu-pē Í-sat hia.
Hit-sî La-pan khì chián iûⁿ-mn̂g; Lúi-kiat thau-the̍h in lāu-pē chhù-lāi ê ka-cho̍k-sîn-siōng.
Ngá-kok bô kā A-lân -lâng La-pan kóng chiū thau-thau-á lī-khui.
I tòa i it-chhè só͘ ū--ê tô-cháu, chin kín kè Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô, ǹg Ki-lia̍t-soaⁿ khì.
Kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t, ū lâng kā La-pan kóng Ngá-kok tô-cháu lah.
La-pan chiū chhōa i ê chhin-cho̍k chòe-hé khì tui-jip; jip chhit ji̍t, kàu Ki-lia̍t-soaⁿ chiah jip--tio̍h.
Mî--sî, Siōng-tè tī A-lân -lâng La-pan ê bîn-bāng tiong tùi i hián-hiān, kā i kóng, “Lí tio̍h sòe-jī, m̄-thang kā Ngá-kok kha̍p--tio̍h.”
La-pan jip-tio̍h Ngá-kok, Ngá-kok í-keng tī Ki-lia̍t-soaⁿ tah pò͘-pîⁿ; La-pan kap i ê chhin-cho̍k mā tī hit-chō soaⁿ tah pò͘-pîⁿ.
La-pan kā Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí ná ōe chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì? Lí môa-phiàn góa, chiong góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chhiúⁿ-cháu, chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng to teh ah hu-ló͘.
Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ bô kā góa kóng chiū tiām-tiām-á thau-cháu, bô thang hō͘ góa chhiùⁿ-koa, phah-kó͘, tôaⁿ-khîm kā lí hoan-sàng,
hāi góa soah bô ki-hōe thang chim góa ê sun, góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kap in saⁿ-sî? Lí si̍t-chāi ū-kàu gōng.
Góa pún-lâi ōe-tàng siong-hāi lín, m̄-kú lín lāu-pē ê Siōng-tè chā-àm tùi góa kóng, ‘Lí tio̍h sòe-jī, m̄-thang kā Ngá-kok kha̍p--tio̍h.’
Lí siàu-liām lín lāu-pē ê ke, ko͘-put-chiong tio̍h tńg--khì, m̄-kú sī-án-chóaⁿ thau-the̍h góa ê sîn-bêng?”
Ngá-kok ìn La-pan kóng, “In-ūi góa kiaⁿ lí ōe chiong lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chhiúⁿ--khì.

Lí ê sîn-bêng, lí tùi siáⁿ-lâng chhiau--tio̍h, hit-ê lâng chiū kai-sí. Tī lán chhin-cho̍k ê bīn-chêng, lí jīn-khòaⁿ góa chia ū sím-mi̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ sī lí ê, lóng the̍h--khì.” Ngá-kok m̄ chai Lúi-kiat ū thau-the̍h hiah-ê sîn-siōng.
La-pan chiū ji̍p-khì Ngá-kok, Lē-a, kap nn̄g ê lú-pī ê pò͘-pîⁿ, chhiau lóng bô, chiū tùi Lē-a ê pò͘-pîⁿ chhut--lâi, ji̍p-khì Lúi-kiat ê pò͘-pîⁿ.
Lúi-kiat the̍h hiah-ê sîn-siōng, khǹg tī lo̍k-tô ê oaⁿ-ē, lâng chē tī hit téng-bīn. La-pan tī i ê pò͘-pîⁿ lāi sì-kòe chhiau, mā chhiau lóng bô.

Lúi-kiat tùi i ê lāu-pē kóng, “Góa keng-kî tú-á kàu, bô hong-piān tī lí ê bīn-chêng khí--lâi; chhiáⁿ hū-chhin tāi-jîn m̄-thang siū-khì.” La-pan sì-kòe chhē sîn-siōng, chhē lóng bô.
Ngá-kok chiū siū-khì, kap La-pan kè-kàu, kóng, “Góa kiám ū chòe sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h, hoān sím-mi̍h chōe, lí kèng-jiân pek góa chiah ân?
Lí chhiau góa só͘-ū ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, kiám ū chhiau-tio̍h sím-mi̍h sī lí ê? Nā ū, tio̍h hē tī lán ê chhin-cho̍k bīn-chêng, hō͘ in kā lán nn̄g ê chhâi-koat.
Góa kap lí tòa chit jī-cha̍p nî ê tiong-kan, lí ê mî-iûⁿ-bú, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú m̄-bat làu-the; góa mā m̄-bat chia̍h lí hiah-ê iûⁿ-káng ê bah.
Hō͘ iá-siù siong-hāi--ê, góa m̄-bat tòa-lâi hō͘ lí, lóng sī góa ka-kī sêng-tam. Iûⁿ bô-lūn ji̍t--sî mî--sî hō͘ lâng thau lia̍h--khì, lí lóng iau-kiû góa pê-siông.
Góa ji̍t--sî hō͘ ji̍t pha̍k, mî--sî hō͘ sng tàng, siông-siông bô khùn, put-sî lóng án-ni.

Góa chit jī-cha̍p nî tī lín tau, ūi-tio̍h beh chhōa lí nn̄g ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kā lí chòe kang cha̍p-sì nî; ūi-tio̍h beh tit-tio̍h lí ê iûⁿ-kûn chòe kang la̍k nî; lí cha̍p piàn kái-piàn góa ê kang-chîⁿ.

Nā m̄-sī góa ê chó͘-sian A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, Í-sat só͘ kiaⁿ-ùi ê Siōng-tè, kap góa tông-chāi, lí it-tēng ōe hō͘ góa khang-chhiú lī-khui. Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê khó͘-chêng kap góa ê lô-lo̍k, chiah tī chā-mî kā lí chek-pī.”

La-pan ìn Ngá-kok kóng, “Chiah-ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ sī góa ê, chiah-ê gín-á sī góa ê, chiah-ê iûⁿ-kûn mā-sī góa ê; lí khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, lóng sī góa ê. Góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kap in siⁿ ê gín-á, góa kin-á-ji̍t iáu ōe-tàng kā in án-chóaⁿ?
Taⁿ, lán nn̄g ê lâi li̍p-iok, chòe lí kap góa tiong-kan ê chèng-kù.”
Ngá-kok chhú chi̍t tè chio̍h, khiā chòe thiāu.
Ngá-kok tùi hiah-ê chhin-cho̍k kóng, “Lín tio̍h khì khioh chio̍h-thâu lâi chia.” In chiū chiong chio̍h-thâu khioh lâi thia̍p kui-tui. In tī hit-tui chio̍h-thâu ê piⁿ--á lim-chia̍h.
La-pan chiū chiong hit-tui chio̍h-thâu kiò-chòe I-ka-ní Sat-hap-tō͘-tha; Ngá-kok kā i kiò-chòe Ka-lūi-tek.
La-pan kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t chit-ê chio̍h-tui chòe lí góa tiong-kan li̍p-iok ê chèng-kù.” Chit-ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Ka-lūi-tek,
mā kiò-chòe Bí-su-pa, in-ūi La-pan kóng, “Lán hun-khui liáu-āu, goān Siōng Chú tī lí góa ê tiong-kan kàm-chhat.
Lí nā ge̍k-thāi góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, koh lēng-gōa chhōa pa̍t-lâng choh-bó͘, sui-jiân góa m̄ chai, lí tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, Siōng-tè tī lí góa ê tiong-kan choh-chèng.”
La-pan koh tùi Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, góa hē tī lí góa tiong-kan ê chit-tui chio̍h-thâu kap chit-ki chio̍h-thiāu,
che sī beh choh-chèng thê-chhíⁿ lán, góa bô beh kè chit-tui chio̍h-thâu khì hāi lí, lí mā bōe-ēng-tit kè chit-tui chio̍h-thâu kap chit-ki chio̍h-thiāu lâi hāi góa.

Goān A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, Ná-ho̍k ê Siōng-tè, in chó͘-sian ê Siōng-tè, tī lí góa ê tiong-kan chhâi-koat.” Ngá-kok chiū kí in lāu-pē Í-sat só͘ kiaⁿ-ùi ê Siōng-tè chiù-chōa.
Ngá-kok tī soaⁿ--ni̍h hiàn-chè, chhiáⁿ i hiah-ê chhin-cho̍k chòe-hé lim-chia̍h; in chia̍h-liáu, chiū tī soaⁿ--ni̍h hioh-mî.
La-pan thàu-chá khí--lâi, chim i ê sun, i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kap in saⁿ-sî, kā in chiok-hok, jiân-āu tò-khì ka-kī ê só͘-chāi.
Ngá-kok kè-sio̍k i ê hêng-thêng, Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá tú-tio̍h i.
Ngá-kok khòaⁿ-tio̍h in, chiū kóng, “Chia sī Siōng-tè ê iâⁿ-tōe. ” I chiū kā hit-ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Má-hap-liām.
Ngá-kok phài lâng seng khì Í-tong tōe-khu, chiū-sī Se-ní, kìⁿ i ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-sò.
Ngá-kok kau-tài in kóng, “Lín tio̍h kā góa ê chú Í-sò kóng, ‘Lí ê po̍k-jîn Ngá-kok án-ni kóng: Góa tī La-pan hia kià-ku, tòa kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Góa ū gû, lû, iûⁿ-kûn, po̍k-jîn, lú-pī. Taⁿ góa phài lâng lâi tùi góa ê chú pò-kò, ǹg-bāng tùi lí tit-tio̍h un-tián.’”
Phài--khì ê lâng tò-lâi kā Ngá-kok pò-kò, “Goán ū khì lí ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-sò hia, i í-keng lâi beh khòaⁿ lí, koh chhōa sì-pah ê lâng chòe-hé lâi.”
Ngá-kok tōa kiaⁿ koh hoân-ló. I chiong kap i chòe-hé ê lâng, í-ki̍p iûⁿ-kûn, gû-kûn, lo̍k-tô pun-chòe nn̄g tūi,
siūⁿ-kóng, “ Í-sò nā lâi kong-kek chit-tūi, chhun--ê hit-tūi iáu thang tô-cháu.”

I kî-tó kóng, “Góa ê a-kong A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, góa ê lāu-pē Í-sat ê Siōng-tè, Siōng Chú ah, lí bat kā góa kóng, ‘Lí tio̍h tò-khì lí ê pún-tōe pún-cho̍k, góa it-tēng beh hó khoán-thāi lí.’
Lí ê po̍k-jîn chin pi-bî, bōe-kham-tit niá-siū lí ê chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t. Góa í-chêng kan-ta gia̍h koáiⁿ-á kè Iok-tàn-hô, taⁿ góa í-keng tòa nn̄g tūi jîn-má tò--lâi.
Kiû lí kiù góa bián siū góa ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-sò ê siong-hāi; góa chin kiaⁿ i lâi thâi-sí góa kap góa ê bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Lí mā bat kóng, ‘Góa it-tēng beh hó khoán-thāi lí, hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-piⁿ ê soa chōe kah sǹg bōe liáu.’”
Hit-àm Ngá-kok tī hia hioh-mî, chiū tùi i ê cheng-siⁿ kéng lé-mi̍h, beh sàng i ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-sò:
Soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú nn̄g-pah chiah, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng jī-cha̍p chiah, mî-iûⁿ-bú nn̄g-pah chiah, mî-iûⁿ-káng jī-cha̍p chiah,
lo̍k-tô-bú kap in chia̍h-lin ê lo̍k-tô-kiáⁿ saⁿ-cha̍p chiah, gû-bú sì-cha̍p chiah, gû-káng cha̍p chiah, lû-bú jī-cha̍p chiah, lû-káng cha̍p chiah.
I chiong chiah-ê cheng-siⁿ pun-chòe chi̍t-tūi chi̍t-tūi, kau-tài i ê po̍k-jîn; i kā po̍k-jîn kóng, “Lín choh-chêng khì, hō͘ ta̍k-tūi pó-chhî kū-lī.”

I koh hoan-hù chhōa-thâu ê po̍k-jîn, kóng, “Góa ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-sò tú-tio̍h lín ê sî, i nā mn̄g kóng, ‘Lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng ê po̍k-jîn, beh khì tó-ūi? Lí thâu-chêng hiah-ê cheng-siⁿ sī sím-mi̍h-lâng ê?’
Lí tio̍h kóng, ‘Chiah-ê sī lí ê po̍k-jîn Ngá-kok ê, sī beh sàng góa ê chú Í-sò ê lé-mi̍h. I pún-sin mā tī goán āu-bīn.’”
Ngá-kok koh hoan-hù tē-jī tē-saⁿ, kap só͘-ū kóaⁿ ta̍k-tūi cheng-siⁿ ê po̍k-jîn, kóng, “Lín tú-tio̍h Í-sò ê sî, mā tio̍h chiàu án-ni kā i kóng.

Koh lín mā tio̍h kóng, ‘Lí ê po̍k-jîn Ngá-kok tī goán āu-bīn.’” Ngá-kok ka-kī phah-sǹg kóng, “Góa ēng thâu-chêng hiah-ê lé-mi̍h lâi kái i ê oàn-hūn, āu-lâi góa chiah kìⁿ i, khó-lêng i ōe chiap-la̍p góa.”
Āu-lâi, i hō͘ hiah-ê po̍k-jîn tòa lé-mi̍h seng kiâⁿ; hit-mî Ngá-kok hioh tī iâⁿ-tiong.
Ngá-kok mî--sî khí--lâi, chhōa i nn̄g ê bó͘, nn̄g ê lú-pī, kap cha̍p-it ê kiáⁿ, lóng kè Ngá-phok-hô ê tō͘-thâu.
I tāi-seng hō͘ in kè-hô, mā hō͘ i kî-tha só͘-ū--ê kè--khì;
chí-ū chhun Ngá-kok ka-kī lâu tī hia. Hit-sî ū chi̍t ê lâng lâi kap i sio-ián, ián kàu thiⁿ phú-kng.
Hit-ê lâng khòaⁿ ián bōe iâⁿ Ngá-kok, chiū siàn i ê tōa-thúi-khū; sio-ián ê sî, Ngá-kok ê tōa-thúi-khū thu̍t-lûn.
Hit-ê lâng kóng, “Thiⁿ beh kng lah, tio̍h pàng góa khì.” Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí nā bô kā góa chiok-hok, góa m̄ pàng lí khì.”
Hit-ê lâng kóng, “Lí hō-chòe sím-mi̍h miâ?” I kóng, “Góa kiò-chòe Ngá-kok.”
Hit-ê lâng kóng, “Lí bô beh koh kiò-chòe Ngá-kok, beh kiò-chòe Í-sek-lia̍t, in-ūi lí kap Siōng-tè kap lâng piàⁿ su-iâⁿ lóng khah iâⁿ.”
Ngá-kok kā i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kā góa kóng lí ê miâ.” Hit-ê lâng ìn kóng, “Lí bô eng-kai mn̄g góa ê miâ.” I chiū tī hia kā Ngá-kok chiok-hok.
Ngá-kok chiū kā hit-ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Pí-ló͘-i-le̍k, kóng, “Góa tng-thâu-tùi-bīn kìⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè, góa iáu bô sí.”
Ngá-kok lī-khui Pí-ló͘-i-le̍k ê sî, ji̍t-thâu chiò-tio̍h i. Ngá-kok pái-kha, in-ūi tōa-thúi í-keng thu̍t-khū.
Só͘-í Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kàu kin-á-ji̍t bô chia̍h tōa-thúi-khū ê kun, in-ūi hit-ê lâng kā Ngá-kok siàn tōa-thúi-khū ê kun.
Ngá-kok gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sò lâi, koh ū sì-pah ê lâng kap i chòe-hé, chiū chiong hiah-ê gín-á pun-khui, kau hō͘ Lē-a kap Lúi-kiat, í-ki̍p nn̄g ê lú-pī.
Ngá-kok chiong lú-pī kap in ê kiáⁿ pâi-chòe thâu-chêng, Lē-a kap i ê kiáⁿ pâi tī āu-bīn, Lúi-kiat kap Iok-sek pâi tī lō͘-bé.
I pún-sin kiâⁿ-khì in ê thâu-chêng, liân-liân chhit piàn phak tī thô͘-kha pài, óa-kūn i ê hiaⁿ-ko.
Í-sò cháu-lâi gêng-chiap i, kā i lám--teh, koh lám i ê ām-kún kā i chim; nn̄g ê lóng tōa-siaⁿ háu.

Í-sò gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ-tio̍h hiah-ê hū-jîn-lâng kap gín-á, chiū mn̄g, “Chiah-ê kap lí chòe-hé--ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?” Ngá-kok kóng, “Chiah-ê gín-á sī Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn--ê.”
Kóng-liáu, nn̄g ê lú-pī kap in ê gín-á chìn-chêng lâi pài.
Lē-a kap i ê gín-á mā chìn-chêng lâi pài; lō͘-bé, Iok-sek kap Lúi-kiat mā chìn-chêng lâi pài.
Í-sò kóng, “Góa tú--tio̍h hit-tīn cheng-siⁿ, sī beh chòe sím-mi̍h?” Ngá-kok kóng, “Sī ǹg-bāng tùi góa ê chú tit-tio̍h un-tián.”
Í-sò kóng, “Sió-tī, góa ê í-keng ū-kàu chōe ah, lí ê lí lâu--teh.”

Ngá-kok kóng, “M̄-thang án-ni. Góa nā tùi lí tit-tio̍h un-tián, chhiáⁿ lí tio̍h chiap-siū góa ê lé-mi̍h. Lí hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p góa, góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê bīn, chhin-chhiūⁿ kìⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê bīn.
Chhiáⁿ chiap-siū góa tòa-lâi sàng lí ê lé-mi̍h; in-ūi Siōng-tè un-thāi góa, hō͘ góa ta̍k-hāng chhiong-chiok.” Ngá-kok chài-saⁿ pài-thok, Í-sò chiū chiap-siū.
Í-sò kóng, “Lán lâi-khì, góa chòe thâu-chêng chhōa-lō͘.”
Ngá-kok tùi i kóng, “Góa ê chú, lí chai chiah-ê gín-á nńg-chiáⁿ, gû iûⁿ mā tú-á siⁿ; nā kui-ji̍t lóng teh kóaⁿ-lō͘, kui-kûn iûⁿ lóng ōe sí.
Chhiáⁿ góa ê chú seng kiâⁿ, lí ê po̍k-jîn tè āu-bīn; cheng-siⁿ kap gín-á ōe-tàng kiâⁿ jōa kín, goán chiū kiâⁿ jōa kín. Goán ōe kàu Í-tong góa ê chú hia.”
Í-sò kóng, “Nā-sī án-ni, góa lâu chi̍t-kóa góa ê lâng kap lí chòe-tīn.” Ngá-kok kóng, “Chhian-bān m̄-thang. Góa ê chú tùi góa í-keng ū-kàu hó lah.”
Hit-ji̍t Í-sò chhut-hoat, chiàu goân-lō͘ tò-khì Í-tong.
Ngá-kok kiâⁿ kàu So͘-kat, tī hia ūi ka-kī khí-chhù, ūi cheng-siⁿ tah chháu-liâu-á; i kā hit-ê só͘-chāi hō-miâ kiò-chòe So͘-kat.
Ngá-kok tùi Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a pêng-an tò-lâi kàu Ka-lâm -tōe ê Sī-kiàm -siâⁿ, tī siâⁿ ê tùi-bīn tah pò͘-pîⁿ.
I tah pò͘-pîⁿ hit-tè tōe, sī i ēng chi̍t-pah tè gûn tùi Sī-kiàm ê khai-thok-chiá Hap-boat ê hō͘-tāi bóe--ê.
Ngá-kok tī hia khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe I-le̍k I-lô-i Í-sek-lia̍t.
Lē-a kā Ngá-kok siⁿ ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Tí-ná chhut-khì beh kap hit só͘-chāi ê cha-bó͘ gín-á sio-chhē.
Hit só͘-chāi ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ Hi-bī -lâng Hap-boat ê kiáⁿ Sī-kiàm khòaⁿ-tio̍h i, chiū kā i khiú--teh, kap i khùn, kā i bú-jio̍k.
Sī-kiàm loân-bō͘ Ngá-kok ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Tí-ná; i ài chit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á, tùi i thò͘-lō͘ chin-chêng.
Sī-kiàm kā i ê lāu-pē Hap-boat kóng, “Kā góa chhōa chit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á hō͘ góa chòe bó͘.”

Ngá-kok thiaⁿ-tio̍h i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Tí-ná siū Sī-kiàm bú-jio̍k, chēng-chēng bô chhut-siaⁿ, in-ūi hit-sî i hiah-ê kiáⁿ kap cheng-siⁿ lóng iáu tī iá-tōe; i beh thèng-hāu in tò--lâi.
Sī-kiàm ê lāu-pē Hap-boat lâi kìⁿ Ngá-kok, beh kap i kóng koan-hē Tí-ná ê tāi-chì.

Ngá-kok hiah-ê kiáⁿ tùi iá-tōe tò--lâi, chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì, ta̍k-ê hui-siông thòng-sim siū-khì, in-ūi Sī-kiàm tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -ke chòe m̄ eng-kai chòe ê kiàn-siàu-tāi, kā Ngá-kok ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ bú-jio̍k.
Hap-boat kap in chham-siông kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ Sī-kiàm loân-bō͘ lín cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, chhiáⁿ chiong i hō͘ góa ê kiáⁿ choh-bó͘.
Lín kap goán kiat-chhin; lín thang chiong lín ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè goán, lín mā thang chhōa goán ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Lín kap goán chòe-hé tòa tiàm chia; thó͘-tōe chiah khoah, lín thang tòa tī chia, chòe seng-lí, kiàn-tì sán-gia̍p.”
Sī-kiàm tùi cha-bó͘ gín-á ê lāu-pē kap i ê hiaⁿ-ko kóng, “Lín nā bô khì-hiâm, lín iau-kiû sím-mi̍h, goán lóng beh hō͘ lín.
Bô-lūn jōa-chōe phèng-kim kap lé-mi̍h, goán it-tēng chiàu lín ê iau-kiû hō͘ lín; chí-ū chhiáⁿ lín chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ góa.”
Ngá-kok hiah-ê kiáⁿ in-ūi Sī-kiàm bú-jio̍k in ê sió-bē Tí-ná, chiū khi-phiàn Sī-kiàm kap i ê lāu-pē Hap-boat,
kóng, “Chiong goán sió-bē kè hō͘ bô siū kat-lé ê lâng, chit-khoán tāi-chì goán chòe bōe kàu; in-ūi che tùi goán lâi kóng sī kiàn-siàu-sū.
Chí-ū chi̍t ê tiâu-kiāⁿ, lín só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng nā lóng kap goán siâng-khoán siū kat-lé, goán chiū tah-èng lín;
goán chiong goán ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ lín, goán mā chhōa lín ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ choh-bó͘; goán tòa tiàm lín chia, chiâⁿ-chòe kâng chi̍t cho̍k.
Lín nā m̄ thiaⁿ goán ê ōe siū kat-lé, goán chiū chhōa goán sió-bē lī-khui chia.”
Hap-boat kap i ê kiáⁿ Sī-kiàm hoaⁿ-hí chiap-siū chit-ê tiâu-kiāⁿ.
Hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng sûi-sî chiàu in ê ōe khì chòe, in-ūi i loân-bō͘ Ngá-kok ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ. I sī in lāu-pē ê ke siōng siū chun-tiōng--ê.
Hap-boat kap i ê kiáⁿ Sī-kiàm lâi kàu siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu, kā siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng kóng,

“Chiah-ê lâng sī lán ê pêng-iú; lán ê thó͘-tōe chin khoah, ū-kàu thang hō͘ in khiā-khí, chòe seng-lí; lán thang chhōa in ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ choh-bó͘, mā thang chiong lán ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ in.
M̄-kú in ū chi̍t ê tiâu-kiāⁿ, chiū-sī lán só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng lóng tio̍h kap in siâng-khoán siū kat-lé, in chiah beh kap lán chòe-hé tòa, chiâⁿ-chòe kâng chi̍t cho̍k.
Lán nā chiap-siū in ê tiâu-kiāⁿ, in chiū ōe kap lán chòe-hé tòa, án-ni, in ê cheng-siⁿ, châi-sán, kap in só͘-ū--ê, kiám m̄-sī lóng ōe pìⁿ-chòe lán ê?”
Chit-ê siâⁿ ê chū-bîn lóng chiap-siū Hap-boat kap i ê kiáⁿ Sī-kiàm ê ōe; án-ni, choân-siâⁿ ê ta-po͘-lâng lóng siū kat-lé.

Kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t, só͘-ū ê lâng tú thiàⁿ kah chin kan-khó͘ ê sî, Ngá-kok nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, Tí-ná ê hiaⁿ-ko Se-biān kap Lī-bī, lóng gia̍h to, thàn in bô hông-pī, ji̍p-siâⁿ thâi-sí lóng-chóng ê ta-po͘-lâng.
In thâi-sí Hap-boat kap i ê kiáⁿ Sī-kiàm, kā Tí-ná tùi Sī-kiàm ê chhù chhōa--chhut-lâi, chiū lī-khui.
Ngá-kok kî-tha ê kiáⁿ ūi-tio̍h in sió-bē siū bú-jio̍k, chiū lâi kàu siū thâi ê lâng hia, chhiúⁿ siâⁿ-lāi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ,
chiū-sī gû-kûn, iûⁿ-kûn, lû, í-ki̍p siâⁿ-lāi kap chhân-iá só͘-ū--ê.
In koh chiong só͘-ū ê châi-hù, gín-á kap hū-jîn-lâng, í-ki̍p chhù-lāi só͘-ū ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ lóng chhiúⁿ--khì.

Ngá-kok kā Se-biān kap Lī-bī kóng, “Lín liân-lūi góa, ōe hāi góa hō͘ chit só͘-chāi ê Ka-lâm -lâng kap Pí-lī-sé -lâng oàn-chhoeh. Koh lán ê lâng chió, in nā liân-ha̍p lâi kong-kek lán, góa kap lán choân-ke lóng ōe bia̍t-bông.”
In ìn kóng, “In ná thang khoán-thāi goán sió-bē chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiong-ki?”

Siōng-tè kā Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí tio̍h chhut-hoat khì Pek-te̍k-lī, tòa tī hia, koh tī hia ūi Siōng-tè khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, chiū-sī lí tô-pī lí ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-sò ê sî, tùi lí hián-hiān hit-ūi Siōng-tè.”
Ngá-kok chiū kā ke-lāi ê lâng í-ki̍p só͘-ū kun-tè i ê lâng kóng, “Lín tio̍h chiong lín tiong-kan gōa-pang ê sîn-bêng tû-tiāu, mā tio̍h kiat-chēng ka-kī, ōaⁿ-saⁿ.

Lán tio̍h chhut-hoat lâi-khì Pek-te̍k-lī; góa beh tī hia khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè, chiū-sī góa tī hoān-lān ê sî, èng-ún beh chi̍t-lō͘ kap góa tông-chāi Hit-ūi.”
Tāi-ke chiū chiong in ê hī-kau kap gōa-pang ê sîn-bêng lóng kau hō͘ Ngá-kok; Ngá-kok chiong hiah-ê tâi tī Sī-kiàm ê siōng-chhiū kha.
In chiū chhut-hoat. Siōng-tè hō͘ chiu-ûi hiah-ê siâⁿ ê lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ khióng-hông; hiah-ê siâⁿ ê lâng chiū bô tui-jip Ngá-kok ê chèng-kiáⁿ.
Ngá-kok í-ki̍p só͘-ū kap i chòe-tīn ê lâng lâi kàu Ka-lâm -tōe ê Lō͘-su, chiū-sī Pek-te̍k-lī.
I tī hia khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, chiū kā hit-ê só͘-chāi hō-miâ kiò-chòe I-le̍k Pek-te̍k-lī; in-ūi i tô-pī i ê hiaⁿ-ko ê sî, Siōng-tè tī hia tùi i hián-hiān.
Lē-pek-ka ê lin-bú Tí-pho-la sí, bâi-chòng tī Pek-te̍k-lī lâm-pêng ê siōng-chhiū kha; só͘-í hit-ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe A-lûn Pa-kó͘.
Ngá-kok tùi Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a tò--lâi í-āu, Siōng-tè koh tùi i hián-hiān, sù-hok hō͘ i.
Siōng-tè kā i kóng, “Lí ê miâ sī Ngá-kok, taⁿ bô koh án-ni kiò lí; lí beh kiò-chòe Í-sek-lia̍t.” Siōng-tè chiū kā i kái-miâ chòe Í-sek-lia̍t.

Siōng-tè koh kā i kóng, “Góa sī Choân-lêng ê Siōng-tè; lí tio̍h siⁿ-thòaⁿ, tio̍h ke-thiⁿ; chiong-lâi ū chi̍t kok, m̄-nā ū chi̍t kok, sī chin chōe kok ōe tùi lí chhut, mā ū chōe-chōe kun-ông tùi lí chhut.
Góa sù hō͘ A-pek-la-hán kap Í-sat ê tōe, mā beh sù hō͘ lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi.”
Siōng-tè chiū tùi kap Ngá-kok kóng-ōe ê só͘-chāi chiūⁿ--khì.
Ngá-kok tī hia chhāi chi̍t ki chio̍h-thiāu, tī hit téng-bīn tò chiú kap kaⁿ-ná-iû hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè.
Ngá-kok chiū chiong Siōng-tè kap i kóng-ōe ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Pek-te̍k-lī.
In tùi Pek-te̍k-lī chhut-hoat, lī-khui Í-hoat-tha iáu ū chi̍t chām lō͘ ê sî, Lúi-kiat chhui-chūn, m̄-kú lân-sán.
Tī i siⁿ kah chin kan-khó͘ ê sî, sán-pô tùi i kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ, lí koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ lah.”
I lîm-chiong khùi beh tn̄g ê sî, kā chit-ê gín-á hō-miâ kiò-chòe Piān Gô-nî; m̄-kú gín-á ê lāu-pē kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Piān-ngá-bín.
Lúi-kiat sí, bâi-chòng tī khì Í-hoat-tha ê lō͘-piⁿ; Í-hoat-tha chiū-sī Pek-lī-hêng.
Ngá-kok tī Lúi-kiat ê bōng-téng khiā bōng-pâi, kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu tī hia.
Ngá-kok koh chhut-hoat, khì tòa tī Í-tek-thah.
Ngá-kok tòa tī Í-tek-thah ê sî, Lū-piān khì kap i lāu-pē ê sòe-î Phek-la chòe-hé khùn; Ngá-kok mā thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì.
Ngá-kok lóng-chóng ū cha̍p-jī ê kiáⁿ. Lē-a ê kiáⁿ ū Ngá-kok ê tōa-kiáⁿ Lū-piān, í-ki̍p Se-biān, Lī-bī, Iû-tāi, Í-sat-ka, Se-pò͘-lûn;
Lúi-kiat ê kiáⁿ ū Iok-sek kap Piān-ngá-bín;
Lúi-kiat ê lú-pī Phek-la ê kiáⁿ ū Tān kap Ná-hut-tha-lī;
Lē-a ê lú-pī Sek-phà ê kiáⁿ ū Ka-tek kap A-siat. Chiah-ê sī Ngá-kok tī Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a siⁿ ê kiáⁿ.
Ngá-kok lâi Ki-lia̍t A-pa ê Bān-lī, i ê lāu-pē Í-sat hia; Ki-lia̍t A-pa chiū-sī Hi-pek-lûn, A-pek-la-hán kap Í-sat bat tī hia kià-ku.
Í-sat it-seng oa̍h chi̍t-pah poeh-cha̍p hè.
Í-sat nî-hè lāu, chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū, pêng-pêng-an-an tńg-khì i ê chó͘-sian hia; i nn̄g ê kiáⁿ Í-sò kap Ngá-kok kā i bâi-chòng.
Ē-bīn sī Í-sò ê hō͘-tāi; Í-sò chiū-sī Í-tong.

Í-sò chhōa Ka-lâm -tōe ê cha-bó͘ gín-á chòe bó͘; in chiū-sī Hek -lâng Í-lûn ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ A-tāi, kap Hi-bī -lâng Chè-piān ê cha-bó͘-sun A-ná ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ A-hô-lī-pa-má.
I koh chhōa Í-si̍t-má-lī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, Nî-pài-iok ê sió-bē Pa-si̍t-boat.
A-tāi kā Í-sò siⁿ Í-lī-hoat; Pa-si̍t-boat siⁿ Liû-ní;
A-hô-lī-pa-má siⁿ Iâ-o͘-si, Ngá-lân, Khó-la. Chiah-ê sī Í-sò tī Ka-lâm -tōe siⁿ ê kiáⁿ.

Í-sò chhōa i ê bó͘, kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kap ke-lāi lóng-chóng ê lâng, koh tòa só͘-ū ê cheng-siⁿ, í-ki̍p i tī Ka-lâm -tōe só͘ tit--tio̍h it-chhè ê châi-bu̍t, lī-khui i ê sió-tī Ngá-kok, khì pa̍t-ê só͘-chāi.
In-ūi in nn̄g ê lâng ê gû, iûⁿ, châi-bu̍t chin chōe, hit só͘-chāi bô-kàu khoah, bōe-tàng hō͘ in chòe-hé tòa.
Í-sò khì tòa tī Se-ní-soaⁿ. Í-sò chiū-sī Í-tong.
Ē-bīn sī Í-sò ê hō͘-tāi: Í-sò chiū-sī Se-ní soaⁿ-khu hiah-ê Í-tong -lâng ê chó͘-sian.
Í-sò ê kiáⁿ ê miâ kì tī ē-bīn: Í-sò ê bó͘ A-tāi siⁿ Í-lī-hoat, Í-sò ê bó͘ Pa-si̍t-boat siⁿ Liû-ní.
Í-lī-hoat ê kiáⁿ ū Thê-bān, O-boat, Sé-po, Ka-thán, Ki-la̍p-su.
Í-sò ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-hoat ê sòe-î Têng-la̍p kā Í-lī-hoat siⁿ A-má-le̍k. Chiah-ê sī Í-sò ê bó͘ A-tāi ê hō͘-tāi.
Liû-ní ê kiáⁿ ū Ná-hap, Siā-la, Sa-má, Bí-sat; chiah-ê sī Í-sò ê bó͘ Pa-si̍t-boat ê hō͘-tāi.
Í-sò ê bó͘ A-hô-lī-pa-má sī Chè-piān ê cha-bó͘-sun, A-ná ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; i kā Í-sò siⁿ Iâ-o͘-si, Ngá-lân, Khó-la.
Ē-bīn sī Í-sò ê hō͘-tāi chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ--ê: Í-sò ê tōa-kiáⁿ Í-lī-hoat ê kiáⁿ ū Thê-bān, O-boat, Sé-po, Ki-la̍p-su,
Khó-la, Ka-thán, kap A-má-le̍k; chiah-ê sī Í-lī-hoat tī Í-tong tōe-khu só͘ siⁿ ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, sī A-tāi ê hō͘-tāi.

Í-sò ê kiáⁿ Liû-ní ê hō͘-tāi chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ--ê ū Ná-hap, Siā-la, Sa-má, kap Bí-sat; chiah-ê sī Liû-ní tī Í-tong tōe-khu só͘ siⁿ ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, lóng sī Í-sò ê bó͘ Pa-si̍t-boat ê hō͘-tāi.
Í-sò ê bó͘ A-hô-lī-pa-má ê hō͘-tāi chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ--ê ū Iâ-o͘-si, Ngá-lân, kap Khó-la; chiah-ê sī Í-sò ê bó͘ A-ná ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ A-hô-lī-pa-má ê hō͘-tāi.
Í-siōng lóng sī Í-sò ê hō͘-tāi tiong-kan chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ--ê; Í-sò chiū-sī Í-tong.

Í-tong tōe-khu goân-lâi ê chū-bîn Hô-lī -lâng Se-ní ê hō͘-tāi kì tī ē-bīn: Lô-tan, Sok-pa, Chè-piān, A-ná, Tí-sūn, Í-chhat, Tí-san; chiah-ê sī Í-tong tōe-khu ê Hô-lī -lâng Se-ní hō͘-tāi chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ--ê.
Lô-tan ê kiáⁿ ū Hô-lī kap Hi-bān; Lô-tan ê sió-bē sī Têng-la̍p.
Sok-pa ê kiáⁿ ū A-le̍k-bûn, Má-ná-hat, Í-pa-lō͘, Sī-po, kap O-lâm.
Chè-piān ê kiáⁿ ū Ài-a kap A-ná; A-ná teh chhī in lāu-pē Chè-piān ê lû-á ê sî, ū tī khòng-iá chhē-tio̍h un-chôaⁿ.
A-ná ê kiáⁿ sī Tí-sūn, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ sī A-hô-lī-pa-má.
Tí-sūn ê kiáⁿ ū Him-tān, I-sī-pan, Ek-lân, kap Ki-lân.
Í-chhat ê kiáⁿ ū Phek-hán, Sat-hoan, kap A-kan.
Tí-san ê kiáⁿ ū O͘-su kap A-lân.
Ē-bīn sī Í-tong tōe-khu ê Hô-lī -lâng ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ: Lô-tan, Sok-pa, Chè-piān, A-ná, Tí-sūn, Í-chhat, kap Tí-san.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng iáu-bē ū kun-ông thóng-tī ê sî, Í-tong tōe-khu ê chu-ông ū:
Pí-ní ê kiáⁿ Pí-la, i ê kiaⁿ-siâⁿ kiò-chòe Têng-hap-pa.
Pí-la sí-liáu, Pho-su-la -lâng Siā-la ê kiáⁿ Iok-pa sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iok-pa sí, Thê-bān -tōe ê lâng Hō͘-san sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Hō͘-san sí, Pí-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Hap-ta̍t sòa-chiap i choh-ông; i tī Mô͘-ap tōe-khu thâi-iâⁿ Bí-tiân -lâng. I ê siâⁿ kiò-chòe A-bī-tek.
Hap-ta̍t sí, Má-sū-lī-ka -lâng Song-la sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Song-la sí, Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô ê Lī-hô-pek -lâng Sò-lô sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Sò-lô sí, A-kek-pho ê kiáⁿ Pa-le̍k Hap-lâm sòa-chiap i choh-ông.

A-kek-pho ê kiáⁿ Pa-le̍k Hap-lâm sí, Hap-ta̍t sòa-chiap i choh-ông; i ê siâⁿ kiò-chòe Pa-o͘; i ê bó͘ kiò-chòe Bí-hi-tha-pia̍t, sī Bí Sat-ha̍p ê cha-bó͘-sun, Má-te̍k-lia̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Í-sò ê hō͘-tāi chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ--ê, chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, tōe-khu, miâ-jī, kì tī ē-bīn: Têng-la̍p, A-le̍k-óa, Iâ-thiap,
A-hô-lī-pa-má, Í-la, Pí-lūn,
Ki-la̍p-su, Thê-bān, Bí-pí-sat,
Má-ki-tia̍p, kap Í-lân. In lóng sī Í-tong ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, tī in tit-tio̍h chòe ke-gia̍p ê tōe khiā-khí. Í-sò sī Í-tong -lâng ê chó͘-sian.
Ngá-kok khiā-khí tī i ê lāu-pē kià-ku ê Ka-lâm -tōe.

Ē-bīn sī Ngá-kok ê ka-têng ê kì-sū. Iok-sek cha̍p-chhit hè ê sî kap i ê hiaⁿ-ko chòe-hé khì kò͘-iûⁿ; i sī chi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng, siông-siông kā i lāu-pē ê sòe-î Phek-la kap Sek-phà ê kiáⁿ tàu-kha-chhiú. Iok-sek ōe chiong hiaⁿ-ko ê pháiⁿ phín-hēng kā in lāu-pē pò-kò.
Tī só͘-ū ê kiáⁿ tiong-kan, Ngá-kok siōng thiàⁿ Iok-sek, in-ūi Iok-sek sī i nî-lāu ê sî siⁿ--ê; i kā Iok-sek chòe chi̍t niá tn̂g-chhiú-ńg ê gōa-phàu.
Iok-sek ê hiaⁿ-ko khòaⁿ-tio̍h in lāu-pē khah thiàⁿ Iok-sek, chiū oàn-tò͘ i, bô beh kap i hó-hó-á kóng-ōe.
Iok-sek bāng-kìⁿ chi̍t ê bāng, kā i hiah-ê hiaⁿ-ko kóng; in chiū koh-khah oàn-tò͘ i.
Iok-sek kā in kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lín thiaⁿ góa kóng góa bāng-tio̍h sím-mi̍h.
Lán tī hn̂g--ni̍h hâ be̍h-khún; hut-jiân, góa hâ ê be̍h-khún khí-lâi khiā--teh, lín hâ--ê ûi-teh pài góa ê be̍h-khún.”
I ê hiaⁿ-ko ìn i kóng, “Lí kiám chin-chiàⁿ beh chòe goán ê ông? Chin-chiàⁿ beh koán goán?” In chiū in-ūi i ê bāng kap i ê ōe koh-khah oàn-tò͘ i.

Āu-lâi, Iok-sek koh bāng-tio̍h chi̍t ê bāng, koh kā i ê hiaⁿ-ko kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, góa koh bāng-tio̍h chi̍t ê bāng; ji̍t-thâu, ge̍h-niû, kap cha̍p-it lia̍p chhiⁿ lóng teh kā góa pài.”

Iok-sek chiong chit-ê bāng kā i ê lāu-pē kap hiaⁿ-ko kóng; i ê lāu-pē chiū kā i chek-pī, kóng, “Lí o͘-pe̍h bāng. Kiám kóng góa kap lín lāu-bú, lín hiaⁿ-tī-á, lóng beh phak-pài lí?”
I ê hiaⁿ-ko lóng oàn-tò͘ i; i ê lāu-pē chiong chit-ê sū kì tī sim-lāi.
Iok-sek ê hiaⁿ-ko khì Sī-kiàm chhī in lāu-pē ê iûⁿ.
Ngá-kok kā Iok-sek kóng, “Lín hiaⁿ-ko tī Sī-kiàm chhī iûⁿ. Lí lâi, góa siūⁿ-beh kiò lí khì in hia.” I ìn kóng, “Hó, góa lâi-khì.”

Ngá-kok kā i kóng, “Lí khì khòaⁿ lín hiaⁿ-ko ū pêng-an, iûⁿ-kûn ū hó-sè á bô; tò-lâi kā góa kóng.” Ngá-kok chiū tī Hi-pek-lûn soaⁿ-kok sàng i chhut-hoat; i chiū khì kàu Sī-kiàm.
Ū lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-sek tī iá-tōe bê-lō͘, chiū mn̄g i kóng, “Lí teh chhē sím-mi̍h?”
I kóng, “Góa teh chhē góa ê hiaⁿ-ko. Chhiáⁿ kā góa kóng, in tī tó-ūi teh chhī iûⁿ.”
Hit-ê lâng kā i kóng, “In í-keng lī-khui chia, in-ūi góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h in teh kóng, ‘Lán lâi-khì To-tan.’” Iok-sek chiū jip-khì chhē in hiaⁿ-ko; tī To-tan chhē-tio̍h in.
In tī hn̄g-hn̄g khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-sek; i iáu-bē kàu in hia, in chiū kè-bô͘ beh hāi-sí i.
In hō͘-siōng kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, hit-ê choh-bāng--ê lâi lah.
Hō͘-lâi! Lâi kā thâi--sí, kā i hiat tiàm khiⁿ--ni̍h, kóng i hō͘ iá-siù chia̍h--khì; lán chiah khòaⁿ i ê bāng chiong-lâi án-chóaⁿ.”
Lū-piān thiaⁿ--tio̍h, siūⁿ-beh kiù Iok-sek, chiū kóng, “Lán m̄-thang hāi i ê sìⁿ-miā.”

Lū-piān koh kā in kóng, “M̄-thang hō͘ i lâu-huih. Lán thang kā i hiat tī chit-ê khòng-iá ê khiⁿ--ni̍h, m̄-thang siong-hāi i.” I án-ni kóng, ì-sù sī beh kiù Iok-sek thoat-lī in ê chhiú, hō͘ i tò-khì in lāu-pē hia.
Iok-sek kàu i ê hiaⁿ-ko hia, in sûi-sî pak i chhēng--teh hit-niá tn̂g-chhiú-ńg ê gōa-phàu,
kā i lia̍h--teh, hiat-lo̍h khiⁿ; hit-ê khiⁿ khang-khang, lāi-bīn bô chúi.

In chē-teh chia̍h-piáⁿ ê sî, gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t tīn tùi Ki-lia̍t lâi ê Í-si̍t-má-lī -lâng ê siong-tūi; in ê lo̍k-tô chài hiuⁿ-liāu, jú-hiuⁿ, bu̍t-io̍h beh lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p.
Iû-tāi tùi chiah-ê hiaⁿ-tī kóng, “Lán thâi-sí lán sió-tī, am-khàm lán ê chōe, ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek?
Lán lâi kā i bōe hō͘ Í-si̍t-má-lī -lâng; m̄-thang hē-chhiú hāi i, in-ūi i sī lán ê sió-tī, lán ê kut-jio̍k.” Hiaⁿ-tī lóng tông-ì.

Hiah-ê Bí-tiân ê seng-lí-lâng tùi hia kè ê sî, Iok-sek ê hiaⁿ-ko kā i tùi khiⁿ--ni̍h giú--khí-lâi, ēng jī-cha̍p ê gûn chiong i bōe hō͘ Í-si̍t-má-lī -lâng. Hiah-ê lâng chiū tòa Iok-sek khì Ai-ki̍p.
Lū-piān tò-tńg-lâi khiⁿ hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-sek bô tī lāi-bīn, chiū thiah-li̍h ka-kī ê saⁿ,
tò-khì i ê sió-tī hia, kóng, “Siàu-liân--ê bô--khì ah; góa leh, góa beh án-chóaⁿ?”
In chiū thâi chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, chiong Iok-sek hit-niá gōa-phàu kō huih,
phài lâng the̍h hit-niá saⁿ khì in lāu-pē hia, kóng, “Goán chhē-tio̍h chit-niá, chhiáⁿ jīn khòaⁿ sī m̄-sī lín kiáⁿ ê gōa-phàu.”
Ngá-kok jīn-tio̍h hit-niá saⁿ, chiū kóng, “Che sī góa ê kiáⁿ ê gōa-phàu. Iok-sek it-tēng hō͘ iá-siù chia̍h--khì, hō͘ iá-siù thiah-chhùi lah!”
Ngá-kok chiū thiah-li̍h gōa-saⁿ, io hâ môa-pò͘, ūi-tio̍h i ê kiáⁿ Iok-sek ai-siong chōe-chōe ji̍t.
I ê kiáⁿ kap cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ lóng kā i an-ùi; i m̄-khéng siū an-ùi, kóng, “Góa lêng-khó ai-siong lo̍h-khì Im-hú, khì góa ê kiáⁿ hia.” Ngá-kok ūi-tio̍h Iok-sek thî-khàu.
Bí-tiân -lâng tòa Iok-sek khì kàu Ai-ki̍p, chiong i bōe hō͘ Hoat-ló ê jîn-sîn sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Pho-thê-hoa̍t.
Tāi-iok hit-ê sî, Iû-tāi lī-khui i ê hiaⁿ-tī, khì tòa tī A-tō͘-lân -lâng Hi-la ê chhù hù-kūn.
Iû-tāi tī hia khòaⁿ-tio̍h Ka-lâm -lâng Su-a ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, chiū chhōa i, kap i tâng-pâng.
I chiū hoâi-īn siⁿ-kiáⁿ; Iû-tāi kā gín-á hō-miâ kiò-chòe Ní.
I koh hoâi-īn siⁿ-kiáⁿ; eⁿ-á ê lāu-bú kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Gô-lâm.
I koh siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Sī-la; Sī-la chhut-sì ê sî, Iû-tāi tú-á tī Ki-sek.
Iû-tāi kā i ê tōa-kiáⁿ Ní chhōa Tha-má chòe bó͘.
Iû-tāi ê tōa-kiáⁿ Ní chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, Siōng Chú chiū hō͘ i sí.
Iû-tāi kā Gô-lâm kóng, “Lí tio̍h kap lí ê hiaⁿ-só tâng-pâng, tùi i chīn lí chòe sió-tī ê pún-hūn, kā lí ê hiaⁿ-ko siⁿ hō͘-sû.”
Gô-lâm chai, i siⁿ ê kiáⁿ bōe-tàng kui i ka-kī, só͘-í tâng-pâng ê sî, siā-cheng tī thô͘-kha, bô beh hō͘ i ê hiaⁿ-ko ū hō͘-sû.
I ê só͘-chòe, Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ; Siōng Chú mā hō͘ i sí.

Iû-tāi kiaⁿ Sī-la ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ i nn̄g ê hiaⁿ-ko kâng-khoán sí, chiū tùi i ê sin-pū Tha-má kóng, “Lí tò-khì lín lāu-pē hia chiú-kóaⁿ, thèng-hāu góa ê kiáⁿ Sī-la tōa-hàn.” Tha-má chiū tò-khì in āu-thâu-chhù.
Kè chin kú, Iû-tāi ê bó͘, Su-a ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ sí; song-kî kè-liáu, Iû-tāi kap i ê pêng-iú A-tō͘-lân -lâng Hi-la khì Têng-ná, khì kā Iû-tāi chián iûⁿ-mn̂g ê lâng hia.
Ū lâng kā Tha-má kóng, “Lín ta-koaⁿ khì Têng-ná chián i iûⁿ-kûn ê mn̂g.”

Tha-má khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sī-la í-keng tōa-hàn, iáu-bē lâi chhōa i choh-bó͘, chiū thǹg i chiú-kóaⁿ ê saⁿ, ēng phè tà bīn, ēng kun moa seng-khu, chē tī beh khì Têng-ná ê lō͘ I-ná-ìn ê siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu.
Iû-tāi khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tha-má, lia̍h-chún i sī chhiong-ki, in-ūi i ū tà-bīn.

Iû-tāi chiū oat-khì lō͘-piⁿ Tha-má hia, kā i kóng, “Lâi, hō͘ góa kap lí chòe-hé khùn.” Iû-tāi m̄ chai hū-jîn-lâng sī i ê sin-pū. Tha-má ìn i kóng, “Lí beh kap góa khùn, beh sím-mi̍h hō͘ góa?”
Iû-tāi kóng, “Góa ōe tùi iûⁿ-kûn lia̍h chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á sàng hō͘ lí.” Tha-má kóng, “Lí sàng--lâi í-chêng, tio̍h ū mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ góa tau--teh.”

Iû-tāi kóng, “Góa tio̍h ēng sím-mi̍h hō͘ lí tau--teh?” Tha-má kóng, “Lí ê ìn, ìn-á-tòa, kap chhiú--ni̍h ê koáiⁿ-á.” Iû-tāi chiū hō͘ i, kap i khùn; i chiū tùi Iû-tāi hoâi-īn.
Tha-má chiū tńg--khì, chiong bīn-phè the̍h--khí-lâi, koh chhēng i goân-lâi chiú-kóaⁿ ê saⁿ.

Iû-tāi thok i ê pêng-iú A-tō͘-lân -lâng Hi-la sàng chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á khì hō͘ hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng, beh chiong hō͘ i tau--teh ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ the̍h tò-tńg; m̄-kú chhē bô hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng.
Hi-la chiū mn̄g hit só͘-chāi ê lâng, kóng, “ I-ná-ìn lō͘-piⁿ sī-biō ê ki-lú tī tó-ūi?” In kóng, “Chia bô sī-biō ê ki-lú.”
I tò-khì kā Iû-tāi kóng, “Góa chhē bô i; hia ê lâng mā kóng in hia bô sī-biō ê ki-lú.”
Iû-tāi kóng, “Góa beh kā chit-chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á sàng hō͘ i, lí soah chhē bô i. I tau--teh ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, kù-chāi i lâu--teh, chiah bián lán hō͘ lâng chhiò.”
Tāi-iok kè saⁿ ge̍h-ji̍t, ū lâng kā Iû-tāi kóng, “Lí ê sin-pū Tha-má chòe ki-lú; koh in-ūi kiâⁿ-îm hoâi-īn.” Iû-tāi kóng, “Kā i thoa chhut-lâi sio.”

Tha-má hō͘ lâng thoa--chhut-lâi ê sî, i kiò lâng khì kìⁿ i ê ta-koaⁿ, kóng, “Chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ sī sím-mi̍h-lâng ê, góa chiū-sī tùi i hoâi-īn. Chhiáⁿ lí jīn, khòaⁿ chit-ê ìn-á, ìn-á-tòa, kap koáiⁿ-á sī sím-mi̍h-lâng ê.”
Iû-tāi ōe-jīn--tit, chiū kóng, “I pí góa khah ū-lí, in-ūi góa bô chiong i kè hō͘ góa ê kiáⁿ Sī-la.” Tùi hit-chūn khí, Iû-tāi bô koh kap i chòe-hé khùn.
Tha-má teh-beh siⁿ, kèng-jiân pak-tó͘ lāi sī siang-siⁿ.
I siⁿ ê sî, ū chi̍t ê eⁿ-á chhun chi̍t ki chhiú chhut--lâi; sán-pô the̍h âng-sòaⁿ pa̍k tī i ê chhiú, kóng, “Chit-ê sī seng chhut-sì--ê.”
Āu-lâi i ê chhiú kiu--ji̍p-khì; i ê hiaⁿ-tī chhut-sì, sán-pô kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ chông--chhut-lâi?” In-ūi i chông--chhut-lâi, só͘-í i ê miâ kiò-chòe Hoat-le̍k-su.
Āu-lâi, hit-ê chhiú pa̍k âng-sòaⁿ--ê siⁿ--chhut-lâi, i ê miâ kiò-chòe Siā-la.
Iok-sek hō͘ lâng tòa lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p; ū chi̍t ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng, chiū-sī Hoat-ló ê jîn-sîn sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Pho-thê-hoa̍t, tùi hiah-ê Í-si̍t-má-lī -lâng chiong Iok-sek bóe--khì.
Siōng Chú kap Iok-sek tông-chāi, hō͘ i sū-sū sūn-lī; i tòa tī chú-lâng Ai-ki̍p -lâng Pho-thê-hoa̍t in tau.
I ê chú-lâng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú kap Iok-sek tông-chāi, koh Siōng Chú hō͘ Iok-sek só͘ chòe ê sū lóng sūn-lī,
chiū kah-ì Iok-sek, hō͘ Iok-sek tī seng-khu piⁿ ho̍k-sāi. Chú-lâng phài Iok-sek koán-lí i ê ke, chiong só͘-ū--ê lóng siū-koân hō͘ i.
Tùi hit-sî khai-sí, Siōng Chú in-ūi Iok-sek ê iân-kò͘, sù-hok hō͘ hit-ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê ke; Siōng Chú chiok-hok hit-ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê ka-têng kap chhân-hn̂g só͘-ū--ê.
Hit-ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng chiong i it-chhè só͘ ū--ê lóng siū-koân hō͘ Iok-sek; i só͘ chia̍h ê mi̍h í-gōa, i lóng bô teh koán. Iok-sek siⁿ-chòe iân-tâu thé-keh hó.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì í-āu, Iok-sek ê lú-chú-lâng kā i sái-ba̍k-bé, tùi i kóng, “Lâi kap góa khùn.”
Iok-sek m̄-khéng, tùi i ê lú-chú-lâng kóng, “Lí chai, chú-lâng í-keng chiong i só͘-ū--ê kau-tài góa; ū góa tī chia, chú-lâng chiū lóng m̄-bián chhau-hoân.

Tī chit-ê ke, bô lâng pí góa khah tōa; lí í-gōa, i bô chi̍t hāng bô kau hō͘ góa, in-ūi lí sī i ê bó͘. Án-ni, góa ná thang chòe chit-khoán ke̍k-pháiⁿ ê sū tek-chōe Siōng-tè?”
Lú-chú-lâng sui-jiân ta̍k-ji̍t án-ni kā Iok-sek ín-iú, m̄-kú Iok-sek m̄-khéng thiaⁿ i ê ōe, lóng bô kap i chòe-hé khùn, mā bô beh kap i chòe-hé.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Iok-sek ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi pān tāi-chì; chhù-lāi lóng bô lâng.
Lú-chú-lâng khiú i ê saⁿ, kóng, “Lí lâi kap góa khùn.” Iok-sek chiong saⁿ pàng tī i ê chhiú, cháu chhut-khì gōa-bīn.
Lú-chú-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-sek chiong saⁿ pàng hō͘ i, koh cháu chhut-khì gōa-bīn,

chiū kiò ke-lāi ê lâng lâi, kā in kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ leh, chú-lâng kā chi̍t ê Hi-pek-lâi -lâng chhōa ji̍p-lâi lán chhù-lāi hì-lāng lán; i lâi góa chia, beh kap góa khùn, góa chiū tōa-siaⁿ hoah.
I thiaⁿ-tio̍h góa chhut-siaⁿ hoah, chiū chiong i ê saⁿ pàng tī góa chia, cháu chhut-khì gōa-bīn.”
Hū-jîn-lâng chiong Iok-sek ê saⁿ siu tī i hia, thèng-hāu Iok-sek ê chú-lâng tò--lâi.
I tùi i ê tiōng-hu kóng chiah-ê tāi-chì, kóng, “Lí tòa-lâi lán chia hit-ê Hi-pek-lâi lô͘-lē ji̍p-lâi góa chia, beh hì-lāng góa;
góa chi̍t-ē tōa-siaⁿ hoah, i chiū chiong i ê saⁿ pàng tī góa chia, cháu chhut-khì gōa-bīn.”
Iok-sek ê chú-lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h i ê bó͘ tùi i kóng “Lí ê lô͘-lē án-ni án-ni tùi-thāi góa”, chiū hui-siông siū-khì.
Iok-sek ê chú-lâng chiong i koaiⁿ tī teh koaiⁿ ông ê hoān-lâng ê kaⁿ-ga̍k. Tùi án-ni, Iok-sek chiū tī hia chē-kaⁿ.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú kap Iok-sek tông-chāi, si-un hō͘ i, hō͘ kaⁿ-ga̍k-tiúⁿ kah-ì i.
Kaⁿ-ga̍k-tiúⁿ chiū chiong kaⁿ-ga̍k lāi-bīn ê hoān-lâng lóng kau hō͘ Iok-sek koán-lí; kaⁿ-ga̍k lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê tāi-chì, lóng sī i teh chhú-lí.
Só͘-ū kau hō͘ Iok-sek pān-lí ê tāi-chì, kaⁿ-ga̍k-tiúⁿ oân-choân sìn-jīm, in-ūi Siōng Chú kap Iok-sek tông-chāi, hō͘ i sū-sū sūn-lī.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì í-āu, Ai-ki̍p -ông ê chiú-chèng-tiúⁿ kap tû-pâng-tiúⁿ tek-chōe in ê chú Ai-ki̍p -ông.
Ai-ki̍p -ông tùi chit nn̄g ê jîn-sîn hui-siông siū-khì,
chiong in koaiⁿ tī sī-ōe-tiúⁿ hú-lāi ê kaⁿ, chiū-sī koaiⁿ Iok-sek ê só͘-chāi.
Sī-ōe-tiúⁿ chiong in kau-tài Iok-sek, Iok-sek chiū sū-hāu in; in tī kaⁿ--ni̍h í-keng ū chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan.
Hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ--ni̍h ê chiú-chèng-tiúⁿ kap tû-pâng-tiúⁿ, kâng chi̍t mî kok chòe chi̍t ê bāng; in ê bāng lóng ū bô siâng ê ì-sù.
Kàu thiⁿ-kng, Iok-sek ji̍p-khì in hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in iu-thâu-kat-bīn.
Iok-sek chiū mn̄g kap i chòe-hé koaiⁿ tī chú-lâng hú-lāi kaⁿ--ni̍h hit nn̄g ê jîn-sîn, kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t lín ná ōe bīn-tài-iu-iông?”

In kā i kóng, “Goán nn̄g ê lóng ū bāng-tio̍h bāng, bô lâng ōe-hiáu kā goán kái-bāng.” Iok-sek kā in kóng, “Kái-bāng ê châi-lêng sī Siōng-tè só͘ sù--ê. Chhiáⁿ kā góa kóng lín ê bāng.”
Chiú-chèng-tiúⁿ chiū tùi Iok-sek kóng i ê bāng, kóng, “Góa bāng-tiong khòaⁿ-kìⁿ tī góa ê bīn-thâu-chêng ū chi̍t châng phû-tô-chhiū;
chhiū-téng ū saⁿ ki chhiū-oe, phah-m̂, khui-hoe, chiū kiat kui-pha sêng-se̍k ê phû-tô.
Góa the̍h Ai-ki̍p -ông ê poe, koh the̍h phû-tô, tīⁿ chiap tī poe--ni̍h, chiong poe phâng hō͘ ông.”
Iok-sek kā i kóng, “Lí ê bāng ê ì-sù sī án-ni: Saⁿ ki chhiū-oe chiū-sī saⁿ ji̍t.
Saⁿ ji̍t lāi, Ai-ki̍p -ông beh chiong lí tùi kaⁿ-ga̍k chhōa--chhut-khì, kā lí ho̍k-chit; lí beh koh phâng i ê chiú-poe, hôe-ho̍k í-chêng chòe chiú-chèng-tiúⁿ ê chit-ūi.
Lí heng-thong ê sî, chhiáⁿ lí tio̍h ōe-kì-tit góa, hó khoán-thāi góa; tī ông ê bīn-chêng thòe góa kóng--chi̍t-siaⁿ, kiù góa chhut-kaⁿ.
Góa si̍t-chāi sī tùi Hi-pek-lâi -lâng ê só͘-chāi hō͘ lâng bōe--lâi-ê; góa tī chia mā bô chòe sím-mi̍h tāi-chì thang hō͘ in kā góa koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ-lô.”
Tû-pâng-tiúⁿ khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-sek kái-bāng kái liáu chin hó, chiū kā Iok-sek kóng, “Góa mā ū bāng-tio̍h tī góa ê thâu-khak téng ū saⁿ nâ ê pe̍h mī-pau;
téng-bīn hit-ê nâ-á ū tóe Ai-ki̍p -ông beh chia̍h ê ta̍k-khoán mi̍h-kiāⁿ; ū chiáu-á lâi tok góa thâu-khak téng nâ-á lāi ê chia̍h-mi̍h.”
Iok-sek ìn i kóng, “Lí ê bāng ê ì-sù sī án-ni: Saⁿ ê nâ chiū-sī saⁿ ji̍t.
Saⁿ ji̍t lāi, Ai-ki̍p -ông beh chiong lí tùi kaⁿ-ga̍k chhōa--chhut-khì, chām lí ê thâu, koh kā lí tiàu tī chhâ-kè, pe-chiáu ōe lâi tok lí seng-khu ê bah.”

Kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t, tú-tú sī Ai-ki̍p -ông ê siⁿ-ji̍t, i pān-toh chhiáⁿ só͘-ū ê jîn-sîn. Ông chiong chiú-chèng-tiúⁿ kap tû-pâng-tiúⁿ tùi kaⁿ-ga̍k tòa--chhut-lâi, hō͘ in khiā tī chèng jîn-sîn ê bīn-chêng.
Ai-ki̍p -ông kā chiú-chèng-tiúⁿ ho̍k-chit, hō͘ i iû-goân phâng-poe ho̍k-sāi Ai-ki̍p -ông,
m̄-kú chiong tû-pâng-tiúⁿ tiàu--sí, lóng chiàu Iok-sek só͘ kā in kóng--ê.
Chóng-sī chiú-chèng-tiúⁿ bô siūⁿ-tio̍h Iok-sek, kèng-jiân kā i bōe-kì--tit.
Nn̄g nî āu, Ai-ki̍p -ông choh-bāng. I bāng-kìⁿ i khiā tī Nî-lô hô-piⁿ,
khòaⁿ-tio̍h chhit chiah pûi koh súi ê gû-bú tùi hô--ni̍h khí--lâi, tī lô͘-tek-á lāi teh chia̍h-chháu.
Tè-āu, ū chhit chiah sán koh pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ ê gû-bú tùi hô--ni̍h khí--lâi; kap thâu-chêng hiah-ê gû-bú chòe-hé khiā tī hô-piⁿ.
Chiah-ê sán koh pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ ê gû-bú kā hit chhit chiah pûi koh súi ê gû-bú chia̍h-liáu-liáu. Ai-ki̍p -ông chiū chhíⁿ--khí-lâi.
I koh khùn, koh bîn-bāng, bāng-tio̍h chi̍t châng be̍h-á chhut chhit sūi pá-chúi koh hó-khòaⁿ ê be̍h-sūi.
Āu-lâi, i koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-châng be̍h-á chhut chhit sūi be̍h-sūi, phàⁿ-phàⁿ koh hō͘ tang-hong chhe kah chhàu-ta.
Chiah-ê phàⁿ ê be̍h-sūi kā hit chhit sūi pá-chúi koh hó-khòaⁿ ê be̍h-sūi thun--lo̍h-khì. Ai-ki̍p -ông chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, chiah chai sī bîn-bāng.

Kàu thiⁿ-kng, Ai-ki̍p -ông sim-lāi chhau-hoân put-an, chiū phài lâng tiàu Ai-ki̍p só͘-ū ê su̍t-sū kap ū tì-hūi ê lâng lâi. Ông chiū chiong i ê bāng kā in kóng; m̄-kú in bô hoat-tō͘ kā ông kái-bāng.
Hit-sî chiú-chèng-tiúⁿ tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, “Góa kin-á-ji̍t chiah siūⁿ-tio̍h góa ū sit-chhò.
