Khah-chá, ông tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn hoat siū-khì, chiong góa kap tû-pâng-tiúⁿ koaiⁿ tī sī-ōe-tiúⁿ hú-lāi ê kaⁿ-lô.
Goán nn̄g ê kâng chi̍t mî choh-bāng, ū bô siâng-khoán ê ì-sù.
Ū chi̍t ê Hi-pek-lâi ê siàu-liân-lâng chiū-sī sī-ōe-tiúⁿ ê lô͘-lē, kap goán koaiⁿ chòe-hé; goán kā i kóng goán ê bāng, i chiū kā goán kái-bāng.
Āu-lâi goán nn̄g ê lâng ê kiat-kó, lóng chiàu i só͘ kā goán kóe-seh--ê, ông kā góa ho̍k-chit, tû-pâng-tiúⁿ siū tiàu--sí.”
Ai-ki̍p -ông phài lâng khì tiàu Iok-sek lâi, in chiū kóaⁿ-kín tòa i chhut-kaⁿ. Iok-sek chiū chián thâu-mn̂g siu-bīn, ōaⁿ-saⁿ, lâi kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông.
Ai-ki̍p -ông kā Iok-sek kóng, “Góa bāng-tio̍h chi̍t ê bāng, bô lâng ōe-tàng kā góa kóe-seh. Ū lâng kā góa kóng, lí thiaⁿ-tio̍h bāng chiū ōe kái-bāng.”
Iok-sek ìn kóng, “Che m̄-sī chāi-tī góa, sī Siōng-tè beh chiong pêng-an hok-khì ê lō͘ chí-sī Ai-ki̍p -ông.”
Ai-ki̍p -ông kā Iok-sek kóng, “Góa bāng-tio̍h góa khiā tī Nî-lô hô-piⁿ,
ū chhit chiah pûi koh súi ê gû-bú tùi hô--ni̍h khí--lâi, tī lô͘-tek-á lāi teh chia̍h-chháu.
Tè-āu, ū chhit chiah sán koh pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ ê gû-bú khí--lâi; tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe, góa iáu m̄-bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ni̍h bái ê gû.
Chiah-ê sán koh pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ ê gû-bú kā hit chhit chiah pûi ê gû-bú chia̍h-liáu-liáu;
thun-lo̍h pak liáu-āu, hit chhit chiah sán koh pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ ê gû-bú, khòaⁿ bōe chhut ū sím-mi̍h koh-iūⁿ, iû-goân hiah-ni̍h sán koh pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ; góa chiū chhíⁿ--khí-lâi.
Góa koh bāng-tio̍h chi̍t châng be̍h-á, chhut chhit sūi pá-chúi koh hó-khòaⁿ ê be̍h-sūi.
Āu-lâi, hit-châng be̍h-á koh chhut chhit sūi be̍h-sūi, phàⁿ-phàⁿ koh hō͘ tang-hong chhe kah chhàu-ta.
Chiah-ê phàⁿ ê be̍h-sūi kā hit chhit sūi hó ê be̍h-sūi thun--lo̍h-khì. Góa chiong chiah-ê bāng kóng hō͘ su̍t-sū thiaⁿ, m̄-kú in bô hoat-tō͘ kā góa kóe-seh.”
Iok-sek tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, “Ông ê bāng kî-si̍t sī chi̍t ê; Siōng-tè chiong I beh chòe ê sū chí-sī ông.
Chhit chiah súi ê gû-bú kap chhit sūi hó ê be̍h-sūi sī chí chhit nî; chit nn̄g ê bāng sī kâng chi̍t ê ì-sù.

Hiah-ê tè-āu khí--lâi ê chhit chiah sán koh pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ ê gû-bú, kap chhit sūi phàⁿ koh hō͘ tang-hong chhe chhàu-ta ê be̍h-sūi, mā-sī chí chhit nî, tāi-piáu chhit nî ê ki-hng.
Che sī góa tùi ông só͘ kóng--ê: Siōng-tè chiong I beh chòe ê sū, tùi ông hián-sī.
Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe ōe ū chhit nî hó nî-tang;
āu-lâi ōe ū chhit nî pháiⁿ nî-tang, sīm-chì Ai-ki̍p choân-kok lóng bōe-kì-tit í-chêng ê hong-siu, choân-tōe ōe hō͘ ki-hng húi-hoāi;
in-ūi āu-lâi ê ki-hng chin siong-tiōng, soah bōe-kì-tit í-chêng bat ū hong-siu.
Ông nn̄g piàn ê bîn-bāng, sī Siōng-tè teh chí-sī I koat-tēng beh chòe, koh chin kín beh oân-sêng ê sū.
“Só͘-í ông tio̍h kéng chi̍t ê chhong-bêng koh ū tì-hūi ê lâng, phài i koán-lí Ai-ki̍p choân-kok.
Ông koh tio̍h phài koaⁿ-oân koán-lí choân-kok; tī chhit nî hó nî-tang, Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe ê siu-sêng tio̍h gō͘ hūn thiu chi̍t hūn.
Chhiáⁿ ông bēng-lēng in siu-chi̍p hó nî-tang siu-sêng ê ngó͘-kok, chek-chū tī chhek-chhng, phài lâng koán-lí, thang chòe ta̍k-ê siâⁿ ê niû-si̍t.
Chek-chū--khí-lâi ê niû-si̍t, thang chòe Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe chiong-lâi chhit nî ki-hng ê lō͘-ēng, chiah bián chit-ê kok-ka in-ūi ki-hng bia̍t-bông.”
Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i só͘-ū ê jîn-sîn lóng chàn-sêng chit-ê kè-ōe.
Ai-ki̍p -ông tùi i ê jîn-sîn kóng, “Lán kiám ōe-tàng chhē-tio̍h chi̍t ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-ê lâng ū Siōng-tè ê sîn tī i ê lāi-bīn?”
Ai-ki̍p -ông tùi Iok-sek kóng, “Siōng-tè í-keng chiong chit-ê tāi-chì lóng chí-sī lí, khó-kiàn bô lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ lí chiah-ni̍h chhong-bêng ū tì-hūi.
Lí thang koán-lí góa ê tiâu-têng; góa ê jîn-bîn lóng tio̍h ho̍k-chiông lí, hō͘ lí koán-lí; chí-ū chē tī ông-ūi ê góa pí lí khah tōa.”
Ai-ki̍p -ông koh kā Iok-sek kóng, “Góa phài lí koán-lí Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe.”
Ai-ki̍p -ông chiū chiong i chòe ìn-kàm ê chhiú-chí pak--khí-lâi, kòa tī Iok-sek ê chńg-thâu-á; kā i chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ, chiong kim phoa̍h-liān kòa tī i ê ām-kún.
Ông koh hō͘ Iok-sek chē tiâu-têng ê tē-jī hō chhia; khui-tō--ê kiò kóng, “Siám-khui!” Án-ni, Ai-ki̍p -ông phài Iok-sek koán-lí Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe.
Ai-ki̍p -ông tùi Iok-sek kóng, “Góa sī ông, nā bô lí ún-chún, tī Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe, put-chún lâng sûi-piān pān tāi-chì.”

Ai-ki̍p -ông kā Iok-sek hō-miâ kiò-chòe Sat-hoat-ná-te̍k Pa-lōe-a, koh chiong Hi-lī-pho-lí -siâⁿ ê chè-si Pho-thê Hui-la ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ A-se-la̍p hō͘ i choh-bó͘. Iok-sek chiū tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhut-sûn.
Iok-sek khai-sí ho̍k-sāi Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sî saⁿ-cha̍p hè. I lī-khui Ai-ki̍p -ông, khì Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe sûn-sī.
Chhit ê hó nî-tang, tōe ê chhut-sán tōa hong-siu.
Iok-sek siu-chi̍p Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhit ê hó nî-tang só͘-ū ê ngó͘-kok, chek-chū tī ta̍k-ê siâⁿ; ta̍k-ê siâⁿ chiu-ûi chhân-tōe ê niû-si̍t, lóng chek-chū tī hù-kūn ê siâⁿ-lāi.
Iok-sek chek-chū ngó͘-kok, chōe kah chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-piⁿ ê soa, bô hoat-tō͘ sǹg, in-ūi sǹg bōe liáu.
Pháiⁿ nî-tang iáu-bē kàu í-chêng, Hi-lī-pho-lí -siâⁿ ê chè-si Pho-thê Hui-la ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ A-se-la̍p kā Iok-sek siⁿ nn̄g ê kiáⁿ.
Iok-sek kā tōa-kiáⁿ hō-miâ kiò-chòe Má-ná-se; i kóng, “Siōng-tè hō͘ góa bōe-kì-tit góa só͘-ū ê khùn-khó͘, kap su-liām góa ê lāu-pē choân-ke ê khó͘-chêng.”
I kā tē-jī ê kiáⁿ hō-miâ kiò-chòe Í-hoat-liân; i kóng, “Siōng-tè hō͘ góa tī góa siū-khó͘ ê só͘-chāi heng-ōng.”
Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhit nî hó nî-tang chi̍t-ē kè--khì,
chhit nî ki-hng chiū lâi, tú-tú chiàu Iok-sek só͘ kóng--ê; ta̍k-kok lóng ū ki-hng, kan-ta Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe ū bí-niû.

Kàu Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe niû-si̍t bô-kàu ê sî, jîn-bîn lâi tùi ông ai-kiû bí-niû; ông tùi Ai-ki̍p ê jîn-bîn kóng, “Lín khì chhē Iok-sek, i kā lín kóng sím-mi̍h, lín lóng chiàu án-ni khì chòe.”
Hit-sî ta̍k-kok lóng ū ki-hng, Ai-ki̍p -tōe mā chin siong-tiōng; Iok-sek khui ta̍k só͘-chāi ê chhek-chhng, bōe bí-niû hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -lâng.
Ta̍k-kok ki-hng chin giâm-tiōng, ta̍k só͘-chāi ê lâng lóng khì Ai-ki̍p, khì Iok-sek hia bóe bí-niû.
Ngá-kok thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p ū ngó͘-kok, chiū kā i hiah-ê kiáⁿ kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ iáu-teh sio-siòng.”
Koh kóng, “Góa thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p ū ngó͘-kok, lín tio̍h lo̍h-khì hia, bóe chi̍t-kóa niû-si̍t, hō͘ lán thang tō͘-oa̍h, chiah bián sí.”
Iok-sek cha̍p ê hiaⁿ-ko chiū lóng lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p bóe bí-niû.
M̄-kú Ngá-kok bô hō͘ Iok-sek ê sió-tī Piān-ngá-bín kap in hiaⁿ-ko chòe-hé khì, in-ūi i kiaⁿ Piān-ngá-bín tú-tio̍h siong-hāi.
Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ kap hiah-ê lâi bóe bí-niû ê lâng chòe-hé lâi, in-ūi Ka-lâm -tōe mā ū ki-hng.
Hit-sî teh tī-lí Ai-ki̍p -tōe--ê sī Iok-sek, bōe bí-niû hō͘ hit só͘-chāi ê jîn-bîn--ê, mā-sī i; Iok-sek hiah-ê hiaⁿ-ko lâi, phak-lo̍h pài i.
Iok-sek khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ê hiaⁿ-ko, ōe-jīn-tit in, m̄-kú ké m̄ bat, ēng giâm-hat ê kháu-khì mn̄g in, “Lín tùi tó-ūi lâi?” In ìn kóng, “Goán tùi Ka-lâm -tōe lâi beh bóe bí-niû.”
Iok-sek ōe-jīn-tit i hiah-ê hiaⁿ-ko, m̄-kú in bōe-jīn-tit i.
Iok-sek siūⁿ-khí í-chêng bāng-kìⁿ koan-hē in ê bāng, chiū tùi in kóng, “Lín sī cheng-thàm, lâi thàm-cha goán chia bô siat-hông ê só͘-chāi.”
In tùi Iok-sek kóng, “Goán ê chú, m̄-sī án-ni, lí ê po̍k-jîn sī lâi beh bóe niû-si̍t.
Goán lóng kâng lāu-pē, sī láu-si̍t-lâng; lí ê po̍k-jîn m̄-sī cheng-thàm.”
Iok-sek kā in kóng, “M̄-sī! Lín lâi sī beh thàm-cha goán chia bô siat-hông ê só͘-chāi.”
In kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn lóng-chóng ū cha̍p-jī ê hiaⁿ-tī, kâng lāu-pē, tòa tī Ka-lâm -tōe; siōng-sòe--ê hiān-chāi kap goán lāu-pē chòe-hé; ū chi̍t ê bô--khì lah.”
Iok-sek kā in kóng, “Góa tú-chiah kóng lín sī cheng-thàm, si̍t-chāi bô m̄-tio̍h.
Góa ài lín chèng-bêng lín sī láu-si̍t. Góa kí Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sìⁿ-miā chiù-chōa, lín soah-bé sió-tī nā bô chhōa-lâi chia, lín it-tēng bōe-tàng lī-khui chit-ê só͘-chāi.

Lín tio̍h phài chi̍t ê tńg-khì chhōa lín sió-tī lâi, kî-tha--ê lóng koaiⁿ tī chia, án-ni chèng-bêng lín ū láu-si̍t; nā bô, góa kí Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sìⁿ-miā chiù-chōa, lín khak-si̍t sī cheng-thàm.”
Iok-sek chiū chiong in koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ--ni̍h saⁿ ji̍t.
Kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t, Iok-sek tùi in kóng, “Góa sī kiaⁿ-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng; lín nā chiàu góa ê ōe chòe, chiū bián sí.
Lín nā chin-chiàⁿ sī láu-si̍t-lâng, lín hiaⁿ-tī ê tiong-kan tio̍h lâu chi̍t ê koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ--ni̍h, kî-tha ê lâng thang tòa bí-niû tò-khì kiù lín ke-lāi iau-gō ê lâng.
Lín nā chiong soah-bé sió-tī chhōa-lâi góa chia, chiū thang chèng-bêng lín kóng-ōe láu-si̍t, lín mā bián sí.” In chiū chiàu án-ni chòe.

In hō͘-siōng kóng, “Lán si̍t-chāi tùi lán ê sió-tī hoān chin tōa ê chōe; lán khòaⁿ-tio̍h i thòng-khó͘ kā lán ai-kiû ê sî, mā bô chhap i, só͘-í lán siū pò-èng, tú-tio̍h chiah tōa ê chai-lān.”
Lū-piān ìn in kóng, “Góa kiám bô kā lín kóng, m̄-thang siong-hāi hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng, m̄-kú lín lóng m̄ thiaⁿ. Só͘-í lâu i ê huih ê chōe, hiān-chāi teh kā lán thó.”
In m̄ chai Iok-sek thiaⁿ ū in teh kóng ê ōe, in-ūi tī in ê tiong-kan ū hoan-e̍k-koaⁿ teh hoan-e̍k.
Iok-sek oa̍t-tńg-sin lī-khui in khì háu, āu-lâi koh tńg-lâi kap in kóng-ōe. Iok-sek tùi in tiong-kan kéng Se-biān, tī in ba̍k-chiu chêng kā i pa̍k--khí-lâi.

Iok-sek hoan-hù lâng chiong ngó͘-kok kā in ê pò͘-tē tóe-móa-móa, chiong in ta̍k-ê lâng ê gûn hêng in, hē tī in ê tē-á lāi, koh ēng lō͘-tiong su-iàu ê chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ in; hiah-ê lâng chiū chiàu án-ni chòe.
Iok-sek ê hiaⁿ-ko chiong bí-niû hē tī lû-á téng, lī-khui hia tò--khì.
Kàu hioh-mî ê só͘-chāi, in tiong-kan ū chi̍t ê tháu-khui i ê tē-á, beh the̍h chhī-liāu hō͘ lû-á chia̍h, chiah khòaⁿ-tio̍h gûn iáu tī tē-á lāi, hē tī pò͘-tē kháu.

I chiū kā i ê hiaⁿ-tī kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ! Góa ê gûn koh tò-tńg--lâi, iû-goân tī góa ê tē-á lāi.” In chiū kiaⁿ kah sîn-put-hū-thé, ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah, hō͘-siōng kóng, “Siōng-tè ná án-ni tùi-thāi lán?”
In tò-khì Ka-lâm -tōe, kàu in lāu-pē Ngá-kok hia, chiong tú--tio̍h ê sū lóng kā i kóng,
“Hit só͘-chāi ê chú-lâng kā goán kóng chin giâm-hat ê ōe, kā goán tòng-chòe sī cheng-thàm.
Goán kā i kóng, ‘Goán sī láu-si̍t-lâng, m̄-sī cheng-thàm.
Goán ū cha̍p-jī ê hiaⁿ-tī, lóng kâng lāu-pē; ū chi̍t ê bô--khì, siōng-sòe ê sió-tī hiān-chāi kap goán lāu-pē tī Ka-lâm -tōe.’

Hit só͘-chāi ê chú-lâng kā goán kóng, ‘Lín nā beh hō͘ góa siong-sìn lín sī láu-si̍t-lâng, lín tio̍h lâu chi̍t ê hiaⁿ-tī tī góa chia, kî-tha ê lâng thang tòa bí-niû tò--khì, kiù lín ke-lāi iau-gō ê lâng;

lín chhōa soah-bé sió-tī lâi góa chia, góa chiū chai lín m̄-sī cheng-thàm, sī láu-si̍t-lâng; án-ni, góa chiū chiong lín ê hiaⁿ-tī kau hêng lín, lín mā thang tī chia chū-iû hêng-tōng.’”
Āu-lâi, in chiong in ê tē-á tò--chhut-lâi, bô phah-sǹg, in ta̍k-ê lâng ê chîⁿ-tē-á lóng tī in ê pò͘-tē lāi; in kap in lāu-pē khòaⁿ-tio̍h chîⁿ-tē-á lóng kiaⁿ-chi̍t-tiô.

In ê lāu-pē Ngá-kok kā in kóng, “Lín hō͘ góa sit-khì góa ê kiáⁿ; Iok-sek bô--khì, Se-biān mā bô--khì, lín koh beh chhōa Piān-ngá-bín khì. Chiah-ê tāi-chì ná ōe lóng hoat-seng tī góa sin-chiūⁿ!”

Lū-piān kā i ê lāu-pē kóng, “Góa nā bô chhōa Piān-ngá-bín tò-lâi kau hō͘ lí, lí thang thâi góa nn̄g ê kiáⁿ. Chòe lí chiong Piān-ngá-bín kau-tài góa, góa it-tēng ōe kā i chhōa tò-lâi hō͘ lí.”

Ngá-kok kóng, “Góa bô beh hō͘ góa ê kiáⁿ kap lín khì; i ê hiaⁿ-ko í-keng sí, chí-ū chhun i chi̍t ê. I nā tī lō͘-tiong tú-tio̍h chai-hāi, chiū-sī lín hāi góa pe̍h-thâu-mn̂g chhiⁿ-chhám lo̍h Im-kan.”
Ka-lâm tōe-khu ê ki-hng chin giâm-tiōng.
Ngá-kok hiah-ê kiáⁿ tùi Ai-ki̍p tòa--tńg-lâi ê ngó͘-kok í-keng chia̍h-liáu, in lāu-pē kā in kóng, “Lín koh khì kā lán bóe chi̍t-kóa bí-niû.”
Iû-tāi tùi i ê lāu-pē kóng, “Hit-ê lâng giâm-giâm kā goán kéng-kò, kóng, ‘Lín nā bô chhōa lín sió-tī lâi, chiū bián siūⁿ-beh kìⁿ góa.’
Lí nā hō͘ goán sió-tī chòe-hé khì, goán chiū lo̍h-khì kā lí bóe bí-niû.
Lí nā m̄ hō͘ i kap goán chòe-hé khì, goán chiū bô beh lo̍h--khì; in-ūi hit-ê lâng kā goán kóng, ‘Lín nā bô chhōa lín sió-tī lâi, chiū bián siūⁿ-beh kìⁿ góa.’”
Ngá-kok kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ án-ni hāi góa, kā hit-ê lâng kóng lín iáu ū sió-tī?”

In ìn kóng, “Hit-ê lâng it-ti̍t kā goán mn̄g goán kap chhin-cho̍k ê tāi-chì, kóng, ‘Lín lāu-pē iáu oa̍h--teh bô? Lín iáu ū hiaⁿ-tī bô?’ Goán lóng chiàu-si̍t kóng, goán ná ōe chai i ōe kóng ‘Tio̍h chhōa lín sió-tī lâi’.”
Iû-tāi koh kā i ê lāu-pē Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí chiong chit-ê gín-á kau hō͘ góa, goán chiū sûi-sî chhut-hoat, thang hō͘ lán chi̍t ke tōa-sòe lóng oa̍h--lo̍h-khì, bián iau--sí.
Góa kā i tam-pó, lí thang tùi góa thó lâng; góa nā bô chhōa i tò-lâi kau hō͘ lí, góa goān it-seng taⁿ chit-ê chōe.
Lán nā bô án-ni iân-tî, goán í-keng tē-jī piàn tò--lâi lah.”

In lāu-pē Ngá-kok kā in kóng, “Nā sī án-ni, lín tio̍h tòa lán chia siōng-hó ê thó͘-sán: Chi̍t-kóa jú-hiuⁿ kap phang-bi̍t, í-ki̍p hiuⁿ-liāu, bu̍t-io̍h, khai-sim-kó, hēng-jîn, chòe lé-mi̍h, sàng hō͘ hit-ê lâng.
Lín koh tio̍h tòa têng-pē ê gûn, chiong lín tī pò͘-tē kháu hoat-kiàn ê gûn tòa tńg-khì hêng i; hit-ê khó-lêng sī sit-chhò.
Lín thang chhōa lín sió-tī chhut-hoat, khì kìⁿ hit-ê lâng.

Goān Choân-lêng ê Siōng-tè hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h hit-ê lâng lîn-bín, hō͘ lín hit-ê hiaⁿ-tī kap Piān-ngá-bín ōe-tàng tò--lâi; góa nā sit-lo̍h góa ê kiáⁿ, góa mā tio̍h chiap-siū.”
In chiū tòa hiah-ê lé-mi̍h kap têng-pē ê gûn, koh chhōa Piān-ngá-bín chhut-hoat lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p, khiā tī Iok-sek ê bīn-chêng.

Iok-sek khòaⁿ-tio̍h Piān-ngá-bín kap in chòe-hé lâi, chiū tùi koán-ke kóng, “Chhōa chiah-ê lâng khì chhù-lāi, koh thâi cheng-siⁿ, chún-pī iàn-se̍k; tiong-tàu, chiah-ê lâng beh kap góa chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g.”
Koán-ke chiū chiàu Iok-sek ê hoan-hù khì chòe, chhōa in ji̍p-khì Iok-sek ê chhù-lāi.

Hiah-ê lâng hō͘ koán-ke chhōa ji̍p-khì Iok-sek ê chhù, chiū chin kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kóng, “Chhōa lán lâi chia, it-tēng sī in-ūi thâu chi̍t piàn tī pò͘-tē kháu hêng lán gûn, beh chhē lán ê khang-phāng, hē-chhiú hāi lán, kiông-pek lán chòe lô͘-lē, chhiúⁿ lán ê lû.”
In chiū kiâⁿ-óa Iok-sek ê koán-ke, tī mn̂g-kháu tùi i
kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, goán téng-piàn lo̍h--lâi, chin-chiàⁿ sī beh bóe niû-si̍t;

āu-lâi kàu hioh-mî ê só͘-chāi, khui goán ê tē-á, bô phah-sǹg, goán ta̍k-ê lâng ê gûn goân-hong-put-tōng tī ta̍k-ê lâng ê pò͘-tē kháu; taⁿ goán ū koh tòa-lâi beh hêng lín. Goán lēng-gōa ū koh tòa gûn beh lâi bóe bí-niû.
Goán m̄ chai sím-mi̍h-lâng chiong goán ê gûn hē tī goán ê pò͘-tē lāi.”

Hit-ê koán-ke kóng, “Chòe lín an-sim, bián kiaⁿ; sī lín ê Siōng-tè, mā-sī lín lāu-pē ê Siōng-tè, chiong châi-pó khǹg tī lín ê pò͘-tē lāi; lín ê gûn góa í-keng siu--tio̍h.” Jiân-āu i chiū chhōa Se-biān chhut-lâi kau hō͘ in.
Koán-ke chhōa hiah-ê lâng ji̍p-khì Iok-sek ê chhù, phâng chúi hō͘ in sóe-kha, koh the̍h chháu-liāu chhī in ê lû-á.
In chiū chún-pī hiah-ê lé-mi̍h, thèng-hāu Iok-sek tiong-tàu tò--lâi; in-ūi in thiaⁿ-tio̍h in beh tī hia chia̍h-pn̄g.
Iok-sek tò-lâi kàu chhù, in chiū chiong tòa ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi ê lé-mi̍h the̍h chhut-lâi sàng i, koh phak tī thô͘-kha pài i.
Iok-sek kā in chhéng-an, koh mn̄g in, kóng, “Lín só͘ kóng hit-ê nî-lāu ê lāu-pē ū pêng-an bô? I ū hó-sè hó-sè bô?”
In ìn kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn goán lāu-pē ū pêng-an, iáu oa̍h--teh.” In chiū àⁿ-thâu pài i.

Iok-sek gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ i kâng lāu-bú ê sió-tī Piān-ngá-bín, chiū kóng, “Lín kā góa kóng ê soah-bé sió-tī sī chit-ê sī--bô?” Koh kóng, “Siàu-liân-lâng, goān Siōng-tè si-un hō͘ lí.”
Iok-sek thiàⁿ sió-tī ê chêng tōa kek-tōng, kóaⁿ-kín beh chhē chi̍t ê só͘-chāi háu, chiū ji̍p-khì i ê pâng-keng thî-khàu.
Āu-lâi i sóe-bīn liáu chhut--lâi, bián-kióng lún--teh, hoan-hù khui-toh.

In ūi-tio̍h Iok-sek lēng-gōa pâi chi̍t tè toh, ūi i ê hiaⁿ-tī koh pâi chi̍t-tè, mā ūi hiah-ê kap Iok-sek chòe-hé chia̍h ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng lēng-gōa pâi chi̍t-tè; in-ūi Ai-ki̍p -lâng khòaⁿ kap Hi-pek-lâi -lâng chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g chòe kìm-khī.
Iok-sek ê hiaⁿ-tī chē tī i ê tùi-bīn, in ê chē-ūi chiàu tōa-sòe ê chhù-sū an-pâi; in lóng chin gông-ngia̍h, hō͘-siōng khòaⁿ-lâi-khòaⁿ-khì.
Iok-sek chiong i bīn-chêng ê chia̍h-mi̍h pun hō͘ in, m̄-kú Piān-ngá-bín tit--tio̍h-ê pí pa̍t-lâng gō͘ pē chōe; in kap Iok-sek chòe-hé lim-chiú iàn-lo̍k.

Iok-sek kau-tài koán-ke kóng, “Lí tio̍h chiàu in tòa ōe khì ê hūn-liōng, chiong niû-si̍t kā in ta̍k-ê lâng ê pò͘-tē ji̍p hō͘ tīⁿ, koh chiong ta̍k-ê lâng ê gûn lok tī in ê pò͘-tē kháu.
Chiong góa gûn ê chiú-poe hē tī hit-ê siōng siàu-liân--ê ê pò͘-tē kháu; i bóe ngó͘-kok ê gûn mā sòa hē--lo̍h-khì.” Koán-ke chiū chiàu Iok-sek ê hoan-hù khì chòe.
Thiⁿ chi̍t-ē kng, hia ê lâng sàng Iok-sek ê hiaⁿ-tī kap in ê lû-á lī-khui.
In chhut-siâⁿ kiâⁿ bô jōa hn̄g, Iok-sek kā koán-ke kóng, “Kóaⁿ-kín khì tui-jip hiah-ê lâng, jip--tio̍h, chiū kā in kóng, ‘Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ ēng pháiⁿ pò hó?
Lín ná thau-the̍h goán chú-lâng ê gûn-poe? Che sī i lim-chiú ēng ê poe-á, mā-sī pok-kòa teh ēng--ê. Lín án-ni chòe chin m̄-tio̍h.’”
Koán-ke jip-tio̍h in, chiong chiah-ê ōe kā in kóng.
In ìn kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, lí ná ōe án-ni kóng? Lí ê po̍k-jîn choa̍t-tùi bōe chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì.
Goán í-chêng tī pò͘-tē kháu khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê gûn to tùi Ka-lâm -tōe tòa-lâi hêng lín, goán ná ōe tùi lín chú-lâng ê ke thau-the̍h kim-gûn?
Lí ê po̍k-jîn tiong-kan bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng hō͘ lí chhiau--tio̍h, chiū hō͘ i sí, goán mā beh chòe lí ê lô͘-lē.”
Koán-ke kóng, “Hó, chiàu lín ê ōe chòe, tī sím-mi̍h-lâng hia chhiau--tio̍h, hit-ê lâng chiū chòe góa ê lô͘-lē; kî-tha ê lâng bô chōe.”
In kóaⁿ-kín chiong pò͘-tē poaⁿ lo̍h-lâi thô͘-kha, ta̍k-ê lâng chiong in ê pò͘-tē tháu-khui.
Koán-ke chiū tùi tōa--ê khai-sí chhiau, chhiau kàu sòe--ê; hit-ê gûn-poe kèng-jiân tī Piān-ngá-bín ê pò͘-tē lāi chhiau--tio̍h.
Khòaⁿ-tio̍h án-ni, in chiū thiah-li̍h saⁿ, chiong mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ lû chài, tò-khì siâⁿ-lāi.
Iû-tāi kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī kàu Iok-sek ê chhù, Iok-sek iáu tī hia, in chiū phak-lo̍h thô͘-kha pài i.
Iok-sek kā in kóng, “Lín ná ōe chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì? Lín kiám m̄ chai, góa chit-khoán lâng ōe-hiáu pok-kòa?”

Iû-tāi kóng, “Goán iáu ōe-tàng tùi góa ê chú kóng sím-mi̍h? Goán bô ōe thang kóng, mā bô thang piān-kái. Siōng-tè í-keng cha-chhut lí ê po̍k-jîn ê chōe-kò, goán kap hit-ê hō͘ lí chhiau-tio̍h gûn-poe--ê, lóng beh chòe lí ê lô͘-lē.”

Iok-sek kóng, “Góa choa̍t-tùi bōe án-ni chòe; tī sím-mi̍h-lâng hia chhiau-tio̍h gûn-poe, hit-ê lâng chiū tio̍h chòe góa ê lô͘-lē. Lín kî-tha ê lâng lóng thang pêng-an tńg-khì lín lāu-pē hia.”
Iû-tāi kiâⁿ chìn-chêng tùi Iok-sek kóng, “Góa ê chú, chhiáⁿ ún-chún lí ê po̍k-jîn kóng chi̍t kù ōe, m̄-thang siū-khì; lí kap Ai-ki̍p -ông pîⁿ ū koân-pèng.
Góa ê chú lí bat mn̄g goán kóng, ‘Lín ū lāu-pē, ū hiaⁿ-tī bô?’

Goán ìn kóng, ‘Goán ū lāu-pē, í-keng nî-lāu; koh ū i nî-lāu chiah siⁿ ê soah-bé-kiáⁿ; i ê chhin-siⁿ hiaⁿ-ko í-keng sí, in lāu-bú kan-ta pàng i chi̍t ê, koh in lāu-pē siōng thiàⁿ i.’
Lí kā lí ê po̍k-jîn kóng, ‘Chhōa i lâi góa chia, hō͘ góa chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h i.’
Goán kā góa ê chú kóng, ‘Gín-á bōe-tàng lī-khui i ê lāu-pē; nā lī-khui, i ê lāu-pē ōe sí.’
Lí kā lí ê po̍k-jîn kóng, ‘Lín ê soah-bé sió-tī nā bô kap lín chòe-hé lo̍h--lâi, lín chiū bián siūⁿ-beh kìⁿ góa.’
“Goán tò-khì lí ê po̍k-jîn goán lāu-pē hia, chiū chiong lí ê ōe kā i kóng.
Goán lāu-pē kóng, ‘Lín koh khì kā lán bóe chi̍t-kóa bí-niû.’

Goán chiū kóng, ‘Goán bōe-tàng lo̍h--khì; lí nā hō͘ goán soah-bé sió-tī chòe-hé khì, goán chiū lo̍h--khì; in-ūi soah-bé sió-tī nā bô kap goán khì, goán chiū bōe-tàng kìⁿ hit-ê lâng.’
Lí ê po̍k-jîn goán ê lāu-pē kā goán kóng, ‘Lín chai góa ê bó͘ kā góa siⁿ nn̄g ê kiáⁿ;
chi̍t ê lī-khui góa, i it-tēng hō͘ iá-siù thiah-chhùi lah! Kàu taⁿ góa iáu m̄-bat koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h i.
Taⁿ, lín koh chiong chit-ê chhōa--khì, lī-khui góa; nā i tú-tio̍h chai-hāi, chiū-sī lín hāi góa pe̍h-thâu-mn̂g chhiⁿ-chhám lo̍h Im-kan.’

“Goán lāu-pē ê sìⁿ-miā kap chit-ê gín-á ê sìⁿ-miā kat saⁿ-liân. Taⁿ goán tò-khì lí ê po̍k-jîn goán lāu-pē hia, nā chit-ê gín-á bô kap goán chòe-hé, goán lāu-pē khòaⁿ bô i, goán lāu-pē it-tēng ōe sí,
án-ni chiū-sī goán hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn goán lāu-pē pe̍h-thâu-mn̂g chhiⁿ-chhám lo̍h Im-kan.
Lí ê po̍k-jîn ū tùi góa ê lāu-pē pó chit-ê gín-á, kóng, ‘Góa nā bô chhōa i tò-lâi kau hō͘ lí, góa goān it-seng taⁿ chit-ê chōe.’
Taⁿ kiû lí ún-chún lí ê po̍k-jîn lâu--teh, thòe chit-ê gín-á chòe lí ê lô͘-lē; hō͘ i kap i ê hiaⁿ-ko chòe-hé tńg--khì.
I nā bô kap góa chòe-hé tńg--khì, góa ná káⁿ khì kìⁿ goán lāu-pē? Góa put-jím-sim khòaⁿ-tio̍h goán lāu-pē tú-tio̍h chit-khoán chai-hō.”
Iok-sek lún bōe tiâu, tùi hiah-ê tī i sin-piⁿ ho̍k-sāi ê lâng hoah kóng, “Lín lóng chhut--khì!” Iok-sek tùi i ê hiaⁿ-tī piáu-pe̍k sin-hūn ê sî, bô pa̍t-lâng chāi-tiûⁿ.
I chhut-siaⁿ tōa khàu; Ai-ki̍p -lâng thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, siau-sit mā thoân kàu Ai-ki̍p -ông ê ông-kiong.
Iok-sek kā i ê hiaⁿ-tī kóng, “Góa sī Iok-sek! Góa ê lāu-pē iáu ióng-ióng bô?” I ê hiaⁿ-tī lóng kiaⁿ kah gāng--khì, m̄ chai beh án-chóaⁿ ìn i.
Iok-sek koh kā i ê hiaⁿ-tī kóng, “Khah óa-lâi góa chia leh.” In chiū óa--khì. I kóng, “Góa sī lín ê sió-tī, hō͘ lín bōe lâi Ai-ki̍p ê Iok-sek.
Lín m̄-bián in-ūi bōe góa lâi chia sim kan-khó͘, chū-chek; che sī Siōng-tè phài góa tāi-seng lín lâi, thang pó-choân tāi-ke ê sìⁿ-miā.
Taⁿ, ki-hng í-keng nn̄g nî, iáu ū gō͘ nî bōe-tàng chèng-choh, bô thang siu-sêng.
Siōng-tè phài góa tāi-seng lín lâi, sī beh lâu lín ê hō͘-tāi tī sè-kan; koh beh kái-kiù lín, pó-choân lín ê sìⁿ-miā.

Án-ni khòaⁿ--khí-lâi, phài góa lâi chia--ê, m̄-sī lín, sī Siōng-tè; I koh hō͘ góa chiâⁿ-chòe Ai-ki̍p -ông ê siú-se̍k kò͘-būn, chòe Ai-ki̍p ê cháiⁿ-siòng, koán-lí choân-kok.
“Lín tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín khì kā lāu-pē kóng, ‘Lí ê kiáⁿ Iok-sek án-ni kóng: Siōng-tè hō͘ góa chòe Ai-ki̍p ê cháiⁿ-siòng, chhiáⁿ lo̍h-lâi góa chia, m̄-thang iân-tî.
Lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ, lí ê sun, kap gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn, í-ki̍p it-chhè só͘ ū--ê, lóng thang lâi tòa tī lī góa bô jōa hn̄g ê Ko-san tōe-khu.
Góa beh tī hia hōng-thāi lí; in-ūi iáu ū gō͘ nî ê ki-hng, chiah bián lí kap choân-ke, í-ki̍p it-chhè só͘ ū--ê pháiⁿ kè-ji̍t.’”
Iok-sek koh kóng, “Taⁿ, lín kap sió-tī Piān-ngá-bín lóng ū chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa, koh kap góa kóng-ōe.
Lín tio̍h chiong góa tī Ai-ki̍p it-chhè ê êng-kng, kap lín só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê sū, lóng kā lāu-pē kóng; koh tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín chiap lāu-pē lâi góa chia.”
Kóng soah, Iok-sek phak tī i ê sió-tī ê ām-kún thî-khàu, Piān-ngá-bín mā phak tī Iok-sek ê ām-kún thî-khàu.
Iok-sek koh kap hiah-ê hiaⁿ-ko saⁿ-chim, lám-teh háu; āu-lâi i ê hiaⁿ-tī chiū kap i kóng-ōe.
Chit-ê hong-siaⁿ thoân kàu Ai-ki̍p -ông ê kiong-lāi, kóng, “ Iok-sek ê hiaⁿ-tī lâi lah.” Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i ê jîn-sîn lóng chin hoaⁿ-hí.
Ai-ki̍p -ông kā Iok-sek kóng, “Lí tio̍h kā lí ê hiaⁿ-tī kóng, ‘Lín tio̍h chiong mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ cheng-siⁿ chài, chhut-hoat tò-khì Ka-lâm -tōe,
chiong lín ê lāu-pē kap lín ê ka-koàn lóng chiap-lâi góa chia; góa beh chiong Ai-ki̍p -tōe siōng-hó ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ lín, lín mā thang chia̍h chit só͘-chāi ê san-tin-hái-bī.’
Taⁿ góa bēng-lēng lí, tio̍h tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe phài chhia khì, chiong in ê bó͘, in ê gín-á, kap lín lāu-pē lóng chiap--lâi.
Kiò in m̄-thang tin-sioh chhù-lāi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, in-ūi Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe ê hó-mi̍h, in lóng thang hióng-siū.”
Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ-jî chiū chiàu án-ni khì chòe. Iok-sek chiàu Ai-ki̍p -ông ê hoan-hù, hō͘ in chhia kap lō͘-tiong su-iàu ê chia̍h-mi̍h;
koh hō͘ in ta̍k-ê lâng chi̍t thò i-ho̍k; m̄-kú hō͘ Piān-ngá-bín saⁿ-pah tè gûn, i-ho̍k gō͘ thò.

Iok-sek sàng hō͘ in lāu-pē ê lé-mi̍h ū kang ê lû-á cha̍p chiah, chài Ai-ki̍p ê hó-mi̍h; bú ê lû-á cha̍p chiah, chài ngó͘-kok, piáⁿ, kap chia̍h-mi̍h, hō͘ lāu-pē lō͘--ni̍h thang ēng.
Iok-sek sàng in hiaⁿ-tī tò--khì, koh kā in kóng, “Lín tī lō͘--ni̍h m̄-thang oan-ke.”
In tùi Ai-ki̍p tò-khì kàu Ka-lâm -tōe in lāu-pē Ngá-kok hia.
In tùi Ngá-kok kóng, “ Iok-sek iáu oa̍h--teh, koh choh cháiⁿ-siòng, tī-lí Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe.” Ngá-kok lóng bô hoán-èng, m̄ sìn in ê ōe.
In chiū chiong Iok-sek kā in kóng ê ōe, lóng tùi in lāu-pē Ngá-kok kóng; Ngá-kok khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-sek phài-lâi beh chài i ê chhia, sim chiū oa̍h--khí-lâi.
Ngá-kok kóng, “Ū-kàu hó! Góa ê kiáⁿ Iok-sek iáu oa̍h--teh, thàn góa iáu-bē sí, góa beh khì khòaⁿ i.”
Ngá-kok chhōa choân-ke chhut-hoat, khì kàu Pia̍t-sī-pa, tī hia hiàn-chè hō͘ i ê lāu-pē Í-sat ê Siōng-tè.
Mî--sî Siōng-tè tī īⁿ-siōng tiong kā Ngá-kok kóng, “ Ngá-kok! Ngá-kok!” I kóng, “Góa tī chia.”
Siōng-tè kóng, “Góa sī Siōng-tè, sī lí ê lāu-pē ê Siōng-tè. Lí beh lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p, m̄-bián kiaⁿ, in-ūi góa beh hō͘ lí tī hia chiâⁿ-chòe tōa-cho̍k.
Góa beh kap lí chòe-hé lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p, mā it-tēng ōe chhōa lí tò--lâi. Lí kè-sin ê sî, Iok-sek ōe tī lí ê sin-piⁿ sū-hāu lí, kā lí an-chòng.”
Ngá-kok tùi Pia̍t-sī-pa chhut-hoat; Ngá-kok hiah-ê kiáⁿ, hō͘ in ê lāu-pē Ngá-kok, kap in ê kiáⁿ-jî, in ê bó͘ lóng chē tī Ai-ki̍p -ông phài-lâi beh chài in ê chhia.
Ngá-kok kap i lóng-chóng ê kiáⁿ-sun, tòa in ê cheng-siⁿ, í-ki̍p tī Ka-lâm -tōe só͘ tit--tio̍h ê châi-bu̍t, lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p.
Ngá-kok tòa i ê hāu-siⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, ta-po͘-sun, cha-bó͘-sun, kap i só͘-ū ê hō͘-tāi, lóng khì Ai-ki̍p.
Ē-bīn sī lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, Ngá-kok hō͘-tāi ê miâ-toaⁿ: Ngá-kok ê tōa-kiáⁿ Lū-piān.
Lū-piān ê kiáⁿ Í-lo̍k, Hoat-lō͘, Hi-su-lûn, Ka-bí.
Se-biān ê kiáⁿ Iâ-bō͘-lī, Ngá-bín, O-hat, Ngá-kun, Só-hat; kap Ka-lâm lú-chú só͘ siⁿ ê kiáⁿ Sò-lô.
Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ Kek-sūn, Ko-hat, Bí-la-lī.
Iû-tāi ê kiáⁿ Ní, Gô-lâm, Sī-la, Hoat-le̍k-su, Siā-la; Ní kap Gô-lâm sí tī Ka-lâm -tōe. Hoat-le̍k-su ê kiáⁿ Hi-su-lûn, Hap-bō͘-le̍k.
Í-sat-ka ê kiáⁿ Tô-la, Phó͘-óa, Iok-pek, Sin-lûn.
Se-pò͘-lûn ê kiáⁿ Se-lia̍t, Í-lûn, Ngá-lī.
Í-siōng sī Lē-a tī Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a kā Ngá-kok siⁿ ê kiáⁿ; koh ū i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Tí-ná; Ngá-kok kap Lē-a siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-sun, lâm-lú kiōng saⁿ-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng.
Ka-tek ê kiáⁿ Sé-hui-ûn, Hap-ki, Su-nî, Í-su-pún, Í-lī, A-lô-tí, A-lia̍t-lī.
A-siat ê kiáⁿ Im-ná, E̍k-si-óa, E̍k-si-úi, Pí-lī-a; koh in ê sió-bē Se-la. Pí-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Hi-pek, Má-kiat.
Í-siōng sī La-pan hō͘ i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Lē-a ê lú-pī Sek-phà kā Ngá-kok siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-sun, kiōng cha̍p-la̍k lâng.
Ngá-kok ê bó͘ Lúi-kiat ê kiáⁿ Iok-sek kap Piān-ngá-bín.
Iok-sek tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe siⁿ Má-ná-se kap Í-hoat-liân, chiū-sī Hi-lī-pho-lí -siâⁿ ê chè-si Pho-thê Hui-la ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ A-se-la̍p kā Iok-sek siⁿ--ê.
Piān-ngá-bín ê kiáⁿ Pí-la, Pí-kiat, A-si̍t-pia̍t, Ki-la, Nái-bān, Í-hi, Lô-si̍t, Bō͘-pêng, Hō͘-pêng, A-le̍k.
Í-siōng sī Lúi-kiat kā Ngá-kok siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-sun, kiōng cha̍p-sì lâng.
Tān ê kiáⁿ sī Hō͘-sin.
Ná-hut-tha-lī ê kiáⁿ Ngá-sih, Ko͘-nî, Iâ-sek, Sī-léng.
Í-siōng sī La-pan hō͘ i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Lúi-kiat ê lú-pī Phek-la kā Ngá-kok siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-sun, kiōng chhit lâng.
Kap Ngá-kok chòe-hé khì Ai-ki̍p ê kiáⁿ-sun, sin-pū bô sǹg, kiōng la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k lâng.
Koh ū Iok-sek tī Ai-ki̍p siⁿ ê nn̄g ê kiáⁿ; Ngá-kok ê ke lâi kàu Ai-ki̍p --ê, chóng-kiōng chhit-cha̍p lâng.
Ngá-kok chhe Iû-tāi seng khì kìⁿ Iok-sek, chhiáⁿ i kā in kóng beh án-chóaⁿ khì Ko-san; in chiū lâi kàu Ko-san.
Iok-sek kā chhia chún-pī hó-sè, khì Ko-san gêng-chiap i ê lāu-pē Ngá-kok. In chi̍t-ē kìⁿ-tio̍h bīn, Iok-sek chiū phak tī lāu-pē ê ām-kún khàu chin kú.
Ngá-kok kā Iok-sek kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê bīn, chai lí iáu oa̍h--teh, taⁿ góa sí mā kam-goān.”

Iok-sek kā i ê hiaⁿ-tī kap in lāu-pē choân-ke ê lâng kóng, “Góa tio̍h khì tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông pò-kò, kóng, ‘Góa ê hiaⁿ-tī kap góa ê lāu-pē choân-ke ê lâng, lóng í-keng tùi Ka-lâm -tōe lâi kàu góa chia.
In sī chhī iûⁿ, sī chiàu-kò͘ cheng-siⁿ ê lâng; in chiong gû-kûn, iûⁿ-kûn, kap it-chhè só͘ ū--ê lóng tòa--lâi.’
Ai-ki̍p -ông nā tiàu lín, mn̄g lín kóng, ‘Lín sī chòe sím-mi̍h kang-chok--ê?’

Lín tio̍h kóng, ‘Lí ê po̍k-jîn tùi siàu-liân kàu taⁿ, kap goán ê chó͘-sian lóng sī teh chhī cheng-siⁿ.’ Án-ni lín chiū ōe-tàng tòa tī Ko-san tōe-khu; in-ūi Ai-ki̍p -lâng thó-ià chhī cheng-siⁿ ê lâng.”

Iok-sek ji̍p-khì kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông, tùi i pò-kò, kóng, “Góa ê lāu-pē kap góa ê hiaⁿ-tī, tòa in ê gû-kûn, iûⁿ-kûn, kap it-chhè só͘ ū--ê, tùi Ka-lâm -tōe lâi tī Ko-san -tōe.”
Iok-sek tùi i ê hiaⁿ-tī tiong-kan kéng gō͘ ê, chhōa in chòe-hé khì kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông.

Ai-ki̍p -ông mn̄g Iok-sek ê hiaⁿ-tī kóng, “Lín teh chòe sím-mi̍h kang-chok?” In tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn sī chhī iûⁿ ê lâng; goán kap goán ê chó͘-sian lóng teh chhī iûⁿ.”

In koh tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, “ Ka-lâm -tōe ki-hng chin siong-tiōng, lí ê po̍k-jîn ê iûⁿ-kûn bô chháu thang chia̍h, só͘-í goán lâi, ǹg-bāng ōe-tàng kià-ku tī chia. Taⁿ kiû lí ún-chún lí ê po̍k-jîn tòa tī Ko-san tōe-khu.”
Ai-ki̍p -ông kā Iok-sek kóng, “Lí ê lāu-pē kap lí ê hiaⁿ-tī lâi kàu lí chia;

Ai-ki̍p -tōe lóng sī lí teh koán-lí, lí thang hō͘ lí ê lāu-pē kap lí ê hiaⁿ-tī tòa tī siōng-hó ê tōe-khu; in thang tòa tī Ko-san tōe-khu. Lí nā chai in tiong-kan sím-mi̍h-lâng khah ū châi-tiāu, thang phài in koàn-kò͘ góa ê cheng-siⁿ.”
Iok-sek chhōa i ê lāu-pē Ngá-kok ji̍p-khì khiā tī Ai-ki̍p -ông ê bīn-chêng; Ngá-kok chiū kā Ai-ki̍p -ông chiok-hok.
Ai-ki̍p -ông mn̄g Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí hiān-chāi kúi hè?”
Ngá-kok tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, “Góa hiān-chāi chi̍t-pah saⁿ-cha̍p hè. Góa ê jîn-seng ê sòe-goa̍t té koh kan-khó͘, put-pí góa ê chó͘-sian chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū.”
Ngá-kok koh kā Ai-ki̍p -ông chiok-hok liáu-āu, chiū lī-khui Ai-ki̍p -ông chhut--khì.
Iok-sek chiàu Ai-ki̍p -ông ê hoan-hù, hō͘ i ê lāu-pē kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī tòa tī Ai-ki̍p siōng-hó ê tōe-khu Lân-sài ê tōe, koh chiong hit-ê tōe-khu hō͘ in chòe sán-gia̍p.
Iok-sek ēng bí-niû hōng-thāi i ê lāu-pē, koh kiong-kip i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kap in lāu-pē só͘-ū ê ka-sio̍k, liân siōng sòe-hàn ê gín-á mā chāi-lāi.
Ki-hng chin giâm-tiōng, choân-tōe lóng bô bí-niû; Ai-ki̍p -tōe kap Ka-lâm -tōe in-ūi ki-hng hong-hòe.
Iok-sek chiong Ai-ki̍p -tōe kap Ka-lâm -tōe ê lâng lâi bóe bí-niû ê gûn siu-chi̍p--khí-lâi, lóng sàng kàu Ai-ki̍p ông-kiong.

Ai-ki̍p -lâng kap Ka-lâm -tōe ê lâng ê gûn lóng ēng-liáu; Ai-ki̍p jîn-bîn lâi kìⁿ Iok-sek, kóng, “Goán ê gûn lóng ēng-liáu-liáu lah. Kiû lí hō͘ goán niû-si̍t; chiah bián hō͘ lí khòaⁿ-tio̍h goán gō-sí.”
Iok-sek kóng, “Lín nā gûn lóng ēng-liáu, thang khan cheng-siⁿ lâi ōaⁿ bí-niû.”
In chiū chiong cheng-siⁿ kóaⁿ-lâi Iok-sek hia; Iok-sek ēng bí-niû ōaⁿ in ê bé, gû-kûn, iûⁿ-kûn, kap lû-á; in ēng só͘-ū ê cheng-siⁿ ōaⁿ bí-niû, chiū án-ni tō͘-kè hit-nî.

Tē-jī nî, in koh lâi kìⁿ Iok-sek, kóng, “Goán ê chú, goán bô phiàn lí, goán ê gûn lóng ēng-liáu, cheng-siⁿ mā lóng bōe hō͘ lí; tû-liáu goán ê seng-khu kap goán ê chhân-tōe í-gōa, lí mā chai, goán lóng bô-pòaⁿ-hāng lah.

Lí kiám jím-sim khòaⁿ goán lâng sí, tōe pha-hng? Kiû lí ēng bí-niû bóe goán kap goán ê tōe, goán kap goán ê tōe chiū lóng kui-sio̍k Ai-ki̍p -ông. Koh kiû lí hō͘ goán chéng-chí, goán chiah ōe-tàng tō͘-oa̍h, bián sí, thó͘-tōe mā bián hong-hòe.”

Tùi án-ni, Iok-sek ūi Ai-ki̍p -ông bóe choân-kok ê thó͘-tōe. Ai-ki̍p -lâng in-ūi ki-hng giâm-tiōng, ko͘-put-chiong tio̍h bōe in ê chhân-tōe; hiah-ê tōe chiū lóng kui-sio̍k Ai-ki̍p -ông.
Iok-sek hō͘ Ai-ki̍p choân-kok ta̍k só͘-chāi ê jîn-bîn lóng chiâⁿ-chòe lô͘-lē.
M̄-kú Ai-ki̍p -ông bô bóe chè-si ê tōe; in-ūi chè-si ū tit-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p -ông kiong-kip ê niû-si̍t, só͘-í in bô bōe in ê tōe.
Iok-sek kā jîn-bîn kóng, “Góa kin-á-ji̍t ūi Ai-ki̍p -ông bóe lín kap lín ê tōe. Taⁿ, góa chiong chéng-chí hō͘ lín, lín thang khì chèng-choh.

Kàu siu-sêng ê sî, lín tio̍h la̍p gō͘-hūn-chi̍t hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông; sì hūn kui lín, chòe hn̂g--ni̍h ê chéng-chí, koh chòe lín kap lín choân-ke, í-ki̍p lín ê gín-á ê chia̍h-mi̍h.”
In kóng, “Goán ê sìⁿ-miā sī lí kiù--ê, goán chin kám-kek, goān-ì chòe Ai-ki̍p -ông ê lô͘-lē.”

Án-ni, Iok-sek ūi Ai-ki̍p chè-tēng chi̍t ê tiâu-lē, kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu-teh si̍t-si, chiū-sī siu-sêng ê gō͘-hūn-chi̍t tio̍h la̍p hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông, m̄-kú chè-si ê tōe bô kui Ai-ki̍p -ông.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa tī Ai-ki̍p ê Ko-san tōe-khu, tī hia kiàn-tì ke-gia̍p, siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe.
Ngá-kok tòa tī Ai-ki̍p cha̍p-chhit nî. I it-seng oa̍h chi̍t-pah sì-cha̍p-chhit hè.

Ngá-kok chai i sí ê ji̍t kūn lah, chiū kiò i ê kiáⁿ Iok-sek lâi, kóng, “Lí nā chin-chiàⁿ iú-hàu góa, chhiáⁿ chiong lí ê chhiú hē tī góa ê tōa-thúi-ē chiù-chōa, tiong-sêng tah-èng góa, bô kā góa bâi-chòng tī Ai-ki̍p.
Góa tńg-khì góa ê chó͘-sian hia ê sî, lí tio̍h chiong góa tòa lī-khui Ai-ki̍p, bâi-chòng tī in an-chòng ê só͘-chāi.” Iok-sek kóng, “Góa ōe chiàu lí kóng--ê khì chòe.”
Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí tio̍h tùi góa chiù-chōa.” Iok-sek chiū tùi i chiù-chōa. Tùi án-ni Ngá-kok óa chhn̂g-thâu kèng-pài.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, ū lâng kā Iok-sek kóng, “Lí ê lāu-pē teh phòa-pīⁿ.” Iok-sek chiū chhōa i nn̄g ê kiáⁿ Má-ná-se, Í-hoat-liân chòe-hé khì thàm Ngá-kok.
Ū lâng thong-ti Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí ê kiáⁿ Iok-sek lâi beh khòaⁿ lí.” Ngá-kok bián-kióng khí-lâi chē tī bîn-chhn̂g.
Ngá-kok kā Iok-sek kóng, “Choân-lêng ê Siōng-tè bat tī Ka-lâm -tōe ê Lō͘-su tùi góa hián-hiān, sù-hok góa,
koh kā góa kóng, ‘Góa beh hō͘ lí siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe, chiâⁿ-chòe chin chōe cho̍k; koh beh chiong chit-ê tōe siúⁿ-sù lí ê hō͘-tāi, chòe in éng-oán ê sán-gia̍p.’

“Góa iáu-bē lâi Ai-ki̍p lí chia í-chêng, lí tī Ai-ki̍p siⁿ ê nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, Í-hoat-liân kap Má-ná-se, tùi hiān-chāi khí beh sǹg-chòe sī góa ê kiáⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ Lū-piān, Se-biān sī góa ê kiáⁿ.
Lí í-āu siⁿ ê kiáⁿ chiū-sī lí ê, in thang sêng-chiap Í-hoat-liân kap Má-ná-se ê sán-gia̍p.

Góa tùi Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a tò-tńg-lâi Ka-lâm -tōe ê sî, tī lī-khui Í-hoat-tha iáu ū chi̍t chām lō͘ ê lō͘-tiong, lí ê lāu-bú Lúi-kiat sí, góa hui-siông siong-sim, kā i bâi-chòng tī beh khì Í-hoat-tha ê lō͘-piⁿ.” (Í-hoat-tha chiū-sī Pek-lī-hêng.)
Ngá-kok khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-sek nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, chiū kóng, “In sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?”
Iok-sek tùi i ê lāu-pē kóng, “In sī góa ê kiáⁿ, sī Siōng-tè tī chia siúⁿ-sù góa--ê.” Ngá-kok kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kā in chhōa-lâi góa chia, góa beh kā in chiok-hok.”
Ngá-kok nî-lāu, ba̍k-chiu hoe, khòaⁿ bōe chheng-chhó; Iok-sek chhōa hit nn̄g ê kiáⁿ óa-kūn Ngá-kok, Ngá-kok chiū kā in chim, kā in lám--teh.
Ngá-kok kā Iok-sek kóng, “Góa siūⁿ bōe kàu ōe-tàng koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí; hiān-chāi Siōng-tè koh hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê kiáⁿ.”
Iok-sek chiong nn̄g ê kiáⁿ tùi Ngá-kok kha-thâu-u ê tiong-kan chhōa--chhut-lâi, jiân-āu phak tī thô͘-kha pài--i.
Āu-lâi Iok-sek koh khan hit nn̄g ê kiáⁿ óa-kūn Ngá-kok; chiàⁿ-chhiú khan Í-hoat-liân khì i ê tò-pêng, tò-chhiú khan Má-ná-se khì i ê chiàⁿ-pêng.
Ngá-kok siang-chhiú phah-chhe, chhun chiàⁿ-chhiú hōaⁿ sòe-hàn-kiáⁿ Í-hoat-liân ê thâu-khak, tò-chhiú hōaⁿ tōa-kiáⁿ Má-ná-se ê thâu-khak.
I chiū kā Iok-sek chiok-hok kóng, “Goān góa ê chó͘-sian A-pek-la-hán kap Í-sat ho̍k-sāi ê Siōng-tè, chiū-sī koàn-kò͘ góa it-seng ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t ê Siōng-tè,

goān kiù-sio̍k góa thoat-lī só͘-ū ê chai-lān hit-ūi thiⁿ-sài, sù-hok hō͘ chit nn̄g ê gín-á. Goān góa ê miâ, í-ki̍p góa ê chó͘-sian A-pek-la-hán kap Í-sat ê miâ thong-kè in liû-thoân tī sè-kan; goān in tī tōe-chiūⁿ siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe.”

Iok-sek khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ê lāu-pē ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú hōaⁿ Í-hoat-liân ê thâu-khak, chiū bô hoaⁿ-hí. I chiong lāu-pē ê chiàⁿ-chhiú tháⁿ--khí-lâi, beh tùi Í-hoat-liân sóa kàu Má-ná-se ê thâu-khak.
Iok-sek tùi i ê lāu-pē kóng, “A-pa, m̄-sī án-ni lah! Chit-ê chiah sī tōa-kiáⁿ, chhiáⁿ kā lí ê chiàⁿ-chhiú hōaⁿ tī i ê thâu-khak.”

I ê lāu-pē m̄-khéng, kóng, “Góa chai, góa ê kiáⁿ, góa chai. Má-ná-se mā beh chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t cho̍k, koh kiông-sēng; m̄-kú i ê sió-tī Í-hoat-liân chiong-lâi ōe pí i khah kiông, chiâⁿ-chòe tōa-cho̍k.”

Hit-ji̍t, Ngá-kok kā in chiok-hok kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng beh ēng lín kā lâng chiok-hok, kóng, ‘Goān Siōng-tè hō͘ lí chhin-chhiūⁿ Í-hoat-liân kap Má-ná-se kâng-khoán.’” Ngá-kok kā Í-hoat-liân pâi tī Má-ná-se ê thâu-chêng.
Ngá-kok koh kā Iok-sek kóng, “Góa koh chia̍h bô-jōa-kú lah. M̄-kú Siōng-tè ōe kap lín tông-chāi, ōe chhōa lín tò-khì lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê tōe.
Góa í-chêng ēng keng ēng to, tùi A-mô͘-lī -lâng chhiúⁿ--lâi ê Sī-kiàm hit-tè tōe, góa beh hō͘ lí, hō͘ lí tit--tio̍h-ê pí lí ê hiaⁿ-tī khah chōe.”
Ngá-kok kiò i só͘-ū ê kiáⁿ lâi, kóng, “Lín lóng chū-chi̍p óa--lâi, góa beh chiong lín í-āu ōe tú--tio̍h ê sū kā lín kóng:
Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ, tio̍h chū-chi̍p lâi thiaⁿ, thiaⁿ lín lāu-pē Í-sek-lia̍t ê ōe.
“ Lū-piān, lí sī góa ê tōa-kiáⁿ, góa ê cheng-le̍k, sī góa ióng-chòng ê sî siⁿ ê tē-it ê kiáⁿ, eng-kai ke̍k-kî chun-êng, khùi-la̍t chhiau-kûn.

M̄-kú lí chhin-chhiūⁿ sì-kòe chhiong ê tōa-chúi, bōe-tàng koh tī hiaⁿ-tī tiong choh-tōa; in-ūi lí peh-chiūⁿ lín lāu-pē ê bîn-chhn̂g, peh-khí-khì góa ê chhn̂g-pho͘, kā i phah lâ-sâm.
“ Se-biān kap Lī-bī sī hiaⁿ-tī; in ê to-kiàm sī chân-jím ê bú-khì.
Góa ê sim-sîn, m̄-thang kap in kiōng-bô͘; góa ê sîn-hûn, m̄-thang kap in chham-siông; in-ūi in tī siū-khì tiong thâi-sí lâng, loān-sú koah-tn̄g gû ê tōa-thúi-kun.
In ê siū-khì béng-lia̍t, ōe siū chiù-chó͘; in ê tōa siū-khì chân-jím, ōe siū chiù-chó͘; góa beh hun-sòaⁿ in tī Ngá-kok -ke, phah-sòaⁿ in tī Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k.
“ Iû-tāi, lí ê hiaⁿ-tī beh o-ló lí; lí ê chhiú beh chhi̍h tùi-te̍k ê ām-kún; lí ê lāu-pē ê kiáⁿ beh khut-ho̍k tī lí bīn-chêng.
Iû-tāi sī sòe-chiah sai; góa ê kiáⁿ, lí lia̍h-tio̍h la̍h-bu̍t chiū tò-khì tōng-hia̍t. Iû-tāi phak--teh chhin-chhiūⁿ sai-kang, tó--teh chhin-chhiūⁿ sai-bú, siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ jiá i?
Ông-koân bô lī-khui Iû-tāi, i ê hō͘-tāi kú-tn̂g thóng-tī; bān-kok ōe lâi chìn-kòng; bān-bîn lóng lâi kui-sūn.
Iû-tāi pa̍k sòe-chiah lû-á tī phû-tô-chhiū, pa̍k lû-á-kiáⁿ tī siōng-hó ê phû-tô-chhiū; i ēng phû-tô-chiú sóe saⁿ, ēng phû-tô-chiap sóe i-ho̍k.
I ê ba̍k-chiu in-ūi lim-chiú âng, i ê chhùi-khí in-ūi lim-lin pe̍h.
“ Se-pò͘-lûn beh khiā-khí tī hái-piⁿ, beh chòe pha-chûn ê káng-kháu; i ê kéng-kài ōe kàu Se-tùn.
“ Í-sat-ka sī ióng-chòng ê lû, tó tī i phāiⁿ ê nn̄g kha tē-á tiong-kan.
I ài an-chēng khiā-khí, lâu tī pûi-súi ê thó͘-tōe; i àⁿ keng-thâu taⁿ tāng-tàⁿ, chiâⁿ-chòe chòe khó͘-kang ê lô͘-lē.
“ Tān beh ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê jîn-bîn chú-chhî kong-tō, chhin-chhiūⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t pa̍t-ê chi-cho̍k.
Tān beh chòe lō͘--ni̍h ê chôa, chòe lō͘-tiong ê to̍k-chôa, kā bé ê kha-āu-tiⁿ, hō͘ khiâ-bé ê lâng tò-siàng-hiàⁿ siak--lo̍h-khì.
“Siōng Chú ah, góa teh thèng-hāu lí ê chín-kiù.
“ Ka-tek beh hō͘ tùi-te̍k tui-kóaⁿ, m̄-kú i tian-tò beh tui-jip in ê kha-āu-tiⁿ.
“ A-siat ê bu̍t-sán hong-hù, thang chòe ông-sek ê hó chia̍h-mi̍h.
“ Ná-hut-tha-lī sī tháu-pàng ê lo̍k-bú, siⁿ khó-ài ê lo̍k-á-kiáⁿ.
“ Iok-sek chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi-chôaⁿ piⁿ ê iá-lû, chhin-chhiūⁿ soaⁿ-lûn-á téng ê iá-bé.
Siā-chìⁿ ê lâng béng-lia̍t kong-kek i, ēng chìⁿ siā i, tui-jip i;
m̄-kú i óa-khò Ngá-kok ê Tāi-lêng-chiá, i ê keng iû-goân ân; i óa-khò Í-sek-lia̍t ê Bo̍k-chiá kap Chio̍h-pôaⁿ, i ê chhiú iáu ū-la̍t.

Lí ê lāu-pē ê Siōng-tè beh pang-chān lí; Choân-lêng-chiá beh sù-hok lí. I beh siúⁿ-sù lí thiⁿ-téng ê hok-khì, chhim-ian ún-chông ê hok-khì; hō͘ lí kiáⁿ-sun chin chōe, cheng-siⁿ heng-ōng.

Lí ê lāu-pē ê chiok-hok iâⁿ-kè éng-oán soaⁿ-niá ê hok-khì, chhiau-kè chū-kó͘ í-lâi ê soaⁿ-lûn-á ê hó-mi̍h; chiah-ê hok-khì beh kàng-lo̍h tī Iok-sek ê thâu-khak, lîm-kàu tī tùi hiaⁿ-tī tiong-kan kéng-soán--chhut-lâi hit-ê lâng ê sin-chiūⁿ.
“ Piān-ngá-bín sī hiong-béng ê chhâi-lông; chá-khí-sî thun-chia̍h i ê la̍h-bu̍t, ē-hng-sî pun i chhiúⁿ--tio̍h-ê.”
Chiah-ê sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê cha̍p-jī chi-cho̍k; in ê lāu-pē chiàu in ta̍k-ê lâng eng-kai tit--tio̍h ê hok-hūn kā in chiok-hok.

Ngá-kok hoan-hù i ê kiáⁿ, kóng, “Góa beh tò-khì góa ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, lín tio̍h chiong góa kap góa ê chó͘-sian tâi chòe-hé, bâi-chòng tī Hek -lâng Í-hut-lûn chhân-iá ê tōng-hia̍t;
chiū-sī tī Ka-lâm -tōe Bān-lī ê tùi-bīn, Be̍k-pí-la chhân-iá ê tōng-hia̍t, sī A-pek-la-hán tùi Hek -lâng Í-hut-lûn bóe lâi chòe bōng-tōe ê sán-gia̍p.
Tī hia ū bâi-chòng A-pek-la-hán kap i ê bó͘ Sa-la, koh ū bâi-chòng Í-sat kap i ê bó͘ Lē-pek-ka; góa mā tī hia bâi-chòng Lē-a.
Hit-khu hn̂g kap hit lāi-bīn ê tōng-hia̍t sī tùi Hek -lâng bóe--ê.”
Ngá-kok tùi i hiah-ê kiáⁿ kau-tài chheng-chhó liáu-āu, kha kiu--khí-lâi, tó tī bîn-chhn̂g, khùi chiū tn̄g, tò-khì i ê chó͘-sian hia.
Iok-sek phak tī i ê lāu-pē Ngá-kok ê bīn thî-khàu, kā i chim.
Iok-sek hoan-hù sū-hāu i ê i-seng, ēng hiuⁿ-liāu boah i ê lāu-pē; i-seng chiū boah Ngá-kok.
I-seng chiàu kui-tēng ēng hiuⁿ-liāu boah Ngá-kok ê sin-si sì-cha̍p ji̍t kú. Ai-ki̍p -lâng ūi Ngá-kok ai-khàu chhit-cha̍p ji̍t.
Ūi-tio̍h Ngá-kok ai-khàu ê ji̍t-kî kè-liáu, Iok-sek tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông tiâu-têng ê koaⁿ-oân kóng, “Góa nā tùi lín tit-tio̍h un-tián, chhiáⁿ tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông choán-ta̍t,

góa ê lāu-pē kiò góa chiù-chōa, tio̍h tī i sí liáu-āu, chiong i an-chòng tī Ka-lâm -tōe, tī i ūi-tio̍h ka-kī chún-pī ê bōng. Chhiáⁿ thòe góa chhéng-kiû ông ún-chún góa chiūⁿ-khì bâi-chòng góa ê lāu-pē, āu-lâi góa ōe koh tò-tńg--lâi.”
Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, “Lí thang chiàu lí chiù-chōa--ê khì an-chòng lí ê lāu-pē.”
Iok-sek chiū khì bâi-chòng i ê lāu-pē; kap i chòe-hé khì--ê ū Ai-ki̍p -ông ê jîn-sîn, Ai-ki̍p -ông tiâu-têng ê goân-ló, kap Ai-ki̍p -kok só͘-ū ê tiúⁿ-ló,
koh ū Iok-sek choân-ke, i ê hiaⁿ-tī, í-ki̍p i ê lāu-pē ê ka-koàn; chí-ū in ê gín-á, kap gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn lâu tī Ko-san tōe-khu.
Lēng-gōa ū chin chōe chiàn-chhia kap bé-peng chòe-hé khì. Sàng-chòng ê tiûⁿ-bīn hui-siông sēng-tāi.
In kàu Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng A-ta̍t ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ, chiū tī hia tōa thî-khàu, tōa ai-siong; Iok-sek ūi-tio̍h i ê lāu-pē ai-siong tui-tō chhit ji̍t.

Ka-lâm -tōe ê chū-bîn khòaⁿ-tio̍h A-ta̍t ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ ê ai-khàu, chiū kóng, “Che sī Ai-ki̍p -lâng chi̍t tiûⁿ sēng-tāi ê chòng-sek.” Hit-ê só͘-chāi chiū kiò-chòe A-pek Be̍k-se, sī tī Iok-tàn-hô ê tang-pêng.
Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ chiàu in ê lāu-pē ê hoan-hù,

chiong i ūn kàu Ka-lâm -tōe, an-chòng tī Bān-lī ê tùi-bīn, Be̍k-pí-la chhân-iá ê tōng-hia̍t, chiū-sī A-pek-la-hán tùi Hek -lâng Í-hut-lûn bóe lâi chòe bōng-tōe ê sán-gia̍p.
Iok-sek an-chòng i ê lāu-pē liáu-āu, chiū kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, í-ki̍p só͘-ū kap i chòe-hé khì bâi-chòng i ê lāu-pē ê lâng, lóng tò-tńg-khì Ai-ki̍p.
Ngá-kok sí liáu-āu, Iok-sek hiah-ê hiaⁿ-ko chiū kóng, “ Iok-sek nā iáu oàn-hūn lán, it-tēng ōe chiàu lán í-chêng án-chóaⁿ pháiⁿ khoán-thāi i kā lán pò-ho̍k.”
In chiū pài-thok lâng khì kā Iok-sek kóng, “Lí ê lāu-pē teh-beh sí í-chêng ū kau-tài kóng,

‘Lín tio̍h kā Iok-sek án-ni kóng: Í-chêng lí ê hiaⁿ-ko pháiⁿ khoán-thāi lí, lí tio̍h sià-bián in ê kè-sit kap chōe-ok.’ Taⁿ, goán sī lí ê lāu-pē ê Siōng-tè ê po̍k-jîn, kiû lí sià-bián goán ê chōe-ok.” In tùi Iok-sek kóng chiah-ê ōe, Iok-sek chiū khàu--chhut-lâi.
I ê hiaⁿ-ko koh lâi phak tī i ê bīn-chêng kóng, “Goán sī lí ê po̍k-jîn.”
Iok-sek tùi in kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ; góa ná ōe-tàng tāi-thòe Siōng-tè?
Í-chêng lín tùi góa ê ì-liām sī pháiⁿ, m̄-kú Siōng-tè ê ì-sù sī hó, kin-á-ji̍t chiah ōe-tàng ū chiah chōe lâng oa̍h--teh.
Taⁿ lín m̄-bián kiaⁿ; góa ōe chiàu-kò͘ lín kap lín ê kiáⁿ-jî.” Iok-sek ēng jîn-chû ê ōe an-ùi in, hō͘ in an-sim.
Iok-sek kap i ê lāu-pē ê ka-koàn lóng tòa tī Ai-ki̍p. Iok-sek chia̍h pah-it hè.
Iok-sek ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-hoat-liân tē-saⁿ tāi ê sun, mā jīn Má-ná-se ê sun Má-kiat ê kiáⁿ chòe kè-sêng-jîn.

Iok-sek tùi i ê hiaⁿ-tī kóng, “Góa koh chia̍h bô-jōa-kú lah; m̄-kú Siōng-tè it-tēng ōe chiàu-kò͘ lín, chhōa lín tùi chia chiūⁿ-khì kàu I li̍p-sè èng-ún beh hō͘ A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok ê tōe.”
Iok-sek kiò Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ-sun chiù-chōa, Iok-sek kóng, “Siōng-tè it-tēng ōe chiàu-kò͘ lín, lín tio̍h chiong góa ê kut-hâi ūn tò-tńg-khì Ka-lâm -tōe.”
Iok-sek sí, tú-á pah-it hè; lâng ēng hiuⁿ-liāu kā i boah, chiong i khǹg tī koan-bo̍k, thêng tī Ai-ki̍p.
Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ-jî ta̍k-ê chhōa in ê ka-koàn, kap Ngá-kok chòe-hé lâi kàu Ai-ki̍p, in ê miâ sī:
Lū-piān, Se-biān, Lī-bī, Iû-tāi,
Í-sat-ka, Se-pò͘-lûn, Piān-ngá-bín,
Tān, Ná-hut-tha-lī, Ka-tek, kap A-siat.
Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi lóng-chóng chhit-cha̍p lâng; Iok-sek í-keng tī Ai-ki̍p.
Iok-sek kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, í-ki̍p in hit-tāi ê lâng lóng sí.
M̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe, hui-siông kiông-sēng, piàn-móa hit-ê tōe.
Āu-lâi, Ai-ki̍p ū m̄ bat Iok-sek ê sin ê ông khí-lâi thóng-tī.
I kā i ê jîn-bîn kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, Í-sek-lia̍t bîn-cho̍k pí lán khah chōe, koh-khah kiông;
lán tio̍h siūⁿ chi̍t ê hó pān-hoat lâi tùi-hù in, chiah bián in jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ, chiàn-cheng hoat-seng ê sî, liân-ha̍p lán ê tùi-te̍k kā lán kong-kek, lī-khui chit-ê tōe.”
Ai-ki̍p -lâng chiū phài tok-kang koán-hat in, kiông-pek in chòe khó͘-kang ap-pek in, hō͘ in tī Pí-tong kap Lân-sài ūi Ai-ki̍p -ông khí tún-chek bu̍t-chu ê siâⁿ.
M̄-kú Ai-ki̍p -lâng jú kā in ap-pek, in jîn-kháu jú chōe, khok-tián jú khoah. Tùi án-ni, Ai-ki̍p -lâng jú kiaⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Ai-ki̍p -lâng kiông-pek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe khó͘-kang,
hō͘ in seng-oa̍h khùn-khó͘; bô-lūn chhiau liâm-thô͘, chòe chng, á-sī tī iá-tōe chòe kang, Ai-ki̍p -lâng lóng giâm-hat tùi-thāi in.
Ai-ki̍p -ông bēng-lēng Hi-pek-lâi ê sán-pô, chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Si-hut-la, chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Phó͘-a,
kóng, “Lín kā Hi-pek-lâi ê hū-jîn-lâng chiap-seng, in beh siⁿ ê sî, lín nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h ta-po͘--ê, tio̍h hō͘ i sí; nā-sī cha-bó͘--ê, chiū hō͘ i oa̍h.”
M̄-kú sán-pô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, bô chiàu Ai-ki̍p -ông ê bēng-lēng khì chòe; in lâu ta-po͘ eⁿ-á ê sìⁿ-miā.
Ai-ki̍p -ông kiò sán-pô lâi, kā in kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ lâu ta-po͘ eⁿ-á ê sìⁿ-miā?”
Sán-pô tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, “ Hi-pek-lâi hū-jîn-lâng kap Ai-ki̍p hū-jîn-lâng bô kâng-khoán; in khah ióng, sán-pô iáu-bē kàu, in chiū siⁿ lah.”
Siōng-tè hó khoán-thāi chit nn̄g ê sán-pô; Í-sek-lia̍t bîn-cho̍k jîn-kháu jú chōe, jú kiông-sēng.
Chit nn̄g ê sán-pô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, Siōng-tè chiū hō͘ in kiàn-li̍p ka-têng.
Ai-ki̍p -ông bēng-lēng só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn kóng, “Tio̍h kā Hi-pek-lâi -lâng siⁿ ê ta-po͘ eⁿ-á tàn lo̍h-khì Nî-lô-hô, kan-ta hō͘ in ê cha-bó͘ eⁿ-á oa̍h--teh.”
Ū chi̍t ê Lī-bī chi-cho̍k ê ta-po͘-lâng chhōa kâng chi-cho̍k ê lú-chú chòe bó͘.
Chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng hoâi-īn, siⁿ chi̍t ê hāu-siⁿ, khòaⁿ i chin kó͘-chui, chiū kā i chhàng saⁿ ge̍h-ji̍t.

Āu-lâi, hū-jîn-lâng bô hoat-tō͘ koh chhàng, chiū the̍h chi̍t ê pô͘-chháu chòe ê nâ-á, ēng táⁿ-má-ka kap pek-iû kô͘ hō͘ i bōe sia̍p-chúi, chiong eⁿ-á khǹg tī lāi-bīn, jiân-āu chiong nâ-á khǹg tī Nî-lô hô-piⁿ ê lô͘-úi tiong-kan.
Eⁿ-á ê tōa-chí khiā tī hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi, ài-beh chai i ōe tú-tio̍h sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.

Ai-ki̍p -ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ lâi kàu Nî-lô hô-piⁿ beh sóe seng-khu; i hiah-ê kiong-lú tī hô-piⁿ kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì. Kong-chú khòaⁿ-tio̍h lô͘-úi tiong-kan ū chi̍t ê nâ-á, chiū chhe kiong-lú khì the̍h hit-ê nâ-á.
I chi̍t-ē phah-khui, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê eⁿ-á; ah, ta-po͘ eⁿ-á teh háu. I chin m̄-kam, kóng, “Chit-ê it-tēng sī Hi-pek-lâi -lâng ê eⁿ-á.”
Eⁿ-á ê a-chí lâi tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kóng, “Góa lâi ūi lí tī Hi-pek-lâi hū-jîn-lâng ê tiong-kan chhē chi̍t ê lin-bú, kā lí io chit-ê gín-á hó--bô?”
Ai-ki̍p -ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ìn kóng, “Hó, lí khì.” Cha-bó͘ gín-á chiū khì kiò eⁿ-á ê lāu-bú lâi.
Ai-ki̍p -ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kā eⁿ-á ê lāu-bú kóng, “Lí kā chit-ê eⁿ-á phō-khì io, góa ōe hō͘ lí kang-chîⁿ.” Hū-jîn-lâng chiū kā chit-ê eⁿ-á phō--khì, kā i io.

Chit-ê eⁿ-á tōa-hàn, hū-jîn-lâng kā i chhōa-khì hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ. Ai-ki̍p -ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chiū siu chit-ê gín-á chòe kiáⁿ, kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Mô͘-se, kóng, “Góa kā i tùi chúi--ni̍h khiú--chhut-lâi”.
Āu-lâi, Mô͘-se tōa-hàn; i chhut-khì i ê tông-pau Hi-pek-lâi -lâng hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in teh chòe khó͘-kang; koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng teh phah Hi-pek-lâi -lâng.
Mô͘-se khòaⁿ piⁿ--á lóng bô lâng, chiū phah-sí hit-ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng, ēng soa kā i khàm--teh.
Keh-ji̍t, Mô͘-se koh chhut--khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h nn̄g ê Hi-pek-lâi -lâng teh sio-phah. I tùi hit-ê bô-lí--ê kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ phah ka-kī ê tông-pau?”

Hit-ê lâng kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng phài lí chòe siú-léng lâi sím-phòaⁿ goán? Lí àn-sǹg beh kā góa phah--sí, chhin-chhiūⁿ phah-sí hit-ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng sī--bô?” Mô͘-se kiaⁿ-chi̍t-tiô, siūⁿ-kóng “Chit-ê tāi-chì lâng it-tēng chai lah”.
Ai-ki̍p -ông thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì, beh thâi Mô͘-se. Mô͘-se siám-pī Ai-ki̍p -ông, cháu-khì Bí-tiân, tòa tī hia. Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Mô͘-se chē tī chíⁿ-piⁿ;
Bí-tiân ê chè-si ū chhit ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; in lâi chhiūⁿ-chúi, kā chúi-chô tò-tīⁿ, beh hō͘ in lāu-pē ê iûⁿ-kûn lim.
Ū kò͘-iûⁿ--ê lâi, kā in kóaⁿ-cháu; Mô͘-se chiū khí-lâi kā in kái-kiù, hō͘ in ê iûⁿ-kûn lim-chúi.
In tńg-lâi in lāu-pē Ia̍p-te̍k-lô hia, in lāu-pē kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t lín ná hiah chá chiū tò--lâi?”
In ìn kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng kái-kiù goán, kā hiah-ê khi-hū goán ê kò͘-iûⁿ--ê kóaⁿ-cháu, sīm-chì koh chhiūⁿ-chúi hō͘ iûⁿ-kûn lim.”
Lāu-pē tùi i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kóng, “Hit-ê lâng tī tó-ūi? Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ kā i pàng tī hia? Khì chhiáⁿ i lâi chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g.”
Mô͘-se chiap-siū iau-chhiáⁿ, hoaⁿ-hí kap Ia̍p-te̍k-lô tòa chòe-hé. Ia̍p-te̍k-lô chiong i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Se-pho-la kè hō͘ Mô͘-se.
Se-pho-la siⁿ chi̍t ê hāu-siⁿ; Mô͘-se kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Kek-sūn, kóng, “Góa kià-ku tī gōa-pang.”
Kúi-nā nî āu, Ai-ki̍p -ông sí. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng in-ūi chòe khó͘-kang, thó͘-khùi ai-kiò. In chòe khó͘-kang ai-kiò ê siaⁿ thàu kàu Siōng-tè hia.
Siōng-tè thiaⁿ-tio̍h in haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan ê siaⁿ, chiū siūⁿ-khí I kap A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok só͘ li̍p ê iok.
Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-kò͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, mā koan-sim in.
Mô͘-se thòe i ê tiūⁿ-lâng, Bí-tiân ê chè-si Ia̍p-te̍k-lô kò͘-iûⁿ. I chhōa iûⁿ-kûn ji̍p-khì khòng-iá ê sai-pêng, kàu Siōng-tè ê soaⁿ, chiū-sī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tī chhì-phè ê hé-iām tiong tùi i hián-hiān. I chù-ì khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chhì-phè hō͘ hé sio, m̄-kú chhì-phè bô sio--khì.
Mô͘-se sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng, “Góa tio̍h oat kè-khì hia khòaⁿ chit-ê kî-koài ê kéng-siōng, sī-án-chóaⁿ chhì-phè bô sio--khì?”
Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-tio̍h Mô͘-se oat kè-lâi beh khòaⁿ, Siōng-tè chiū tùi chhì-phè lāi-bīn kiò i, kóng, “ Mô͘-se, Mô͘-se.” Mô͘-se ìn kóng, “Góa tī chia.”
Siōng-tè kóng, “Lí m̄-thang koh kiâⁿ óa--lâi; tio̍h kā lí ê ôe thǹg--khí-lâi, in-ūi lí khiā ê só͘-chāi sī sîn-sèng ê tōe.”
I koh kóng, “Góa sī lí ê chó͘-sian ê Siōng-tè, A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, Í-sat ê Siōng-tè, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè.” Mô͘-se chiū jia i ê bīn, m̄-káⁿ khòaⁿ Siōng-tè.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa khak-si̍t ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê chú-bîn tī Ai-ki̍p só͘ siū ê khó͘-chhó͘, ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h in siū tok-kang ap-pek só͘ hoat-chhut ê ai-kiò. In ê thòng-khó͘ góa lóng chai.

Taⁿ góa beh lo̍h-lâi kái-kiù in thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê chhiú, chhōa in lī-khui hit-ê tōe, khì pûi-súi koh khoan-khoah, lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe, chiū-sī Ka-lâm -lâng, Hek -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng hiah-ê cho̍k ê só͘-chāi.
Hiān-chāi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê ai-kiò í-keng thàu kàu góa ê hī-khang, góa mā ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p -lâng án-chóaⁿ ap-pek in.
Taⁿ, lí tio̍h khì, góa beh phài lí khì Ai-ki̍p -ông hia, chhōa góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut--lâi.”
Mô͘-se tùi Siōng-tè kóng, “Góa sī siáⁿ-lâng, ná káⁿ khì kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông, chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut--lâi?”

Siōng-tè kóng, “Góa ōe kap lí tông-chāi, che sī góa phài lí khì ê chèng-kù. Lí chhōa góa ê chú-bîn tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut--lâi liáu-āu, lín tio̍h lâi chit-ê soaⁿ kèng-pài Siōng-tè.”

Mô͘-se tùi Siōng-tè kóng, “Góa khì Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hia, tùi in kóng ‘Lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè ū phài góa lâi lín chia’, in nā mn̄g góa kóng ‘I kiò-chòe sím-mi̍h miâ’, góa beh án-chóaⁿ kā in ìn?”
Siōng-tè tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa sī Chū-iú-éng-iú--ê. Lí tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, ‘Chū-iú-éng-iú--ê phài góa lâi lín chia.’”

Siōng-tè koh kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng án-ni kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, Í-sat ê Siōng-tè, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè phài góa lâi lín chia.’ Chit-ê éng-oán sī góa ê miâ, sè-sè-tāi-tāi chòe góa ê chheng-ho͘.

Lí khì tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiúⁿ-ló, kā in kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè, tùi góa hián-hiān, kóng: Góa si̍t-chāi koàn-kò͘ lín; lín tī Ai-ki̍p tú--tio̍h ê sū, góa lóng ū teh koan-sim.

Góa it-tēng beh kiù lín thoat-chhut tī Ai-ki̍p siū ê kan-khó͘, chhōa lín khì kàu Ka-lâm, Hek, A-mô͘-lī, Pí-lī-sé, Hi-bī, Iâ-pò͘-su hiah-ê cho̍k khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, chiū-sī lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe.’

“ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ōe thiaⁿ lí ê ōe; lí kap in ê tiúⁿ-ló tio̍h khì kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông, kā i kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Hi-pek-lâi -lâng ê Siōng-tè ū tùi goán hián-hiān. Taⁿ, chhiáⁿ ún-chún goán kiâⁿ saⁿ ji̍t ê lō͘-thêng, khì khòng-iá tùi Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè hiàn-chè.’
Góa chai, nā bô ēng kiông-lia̍t ê chhiú-tōaⁿ, Ai-ki̍p -ông bōe hō͘ lín lī-khui.
Góa beh chhut-chhiú, kiâⁿ kî-sū kong-kek Ai-ki̍p, án-ni, i chiah ōe pàng lín lī-khui.
“Góa beh hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -lâng hó khoán-thāi chit-ê jîn-bîn, bōe hō͘ in khang-chhiú lī-khui;

lín ta̍k-ê hū-jîn-lâng beh tùi chhù-piⁿ, í-ki̍p kià-ku tī hia ê hū-jîn-lâng thó kim-khì, gûn-khì, kap i-ho̍k, thang hō͘ lín ê hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ēng; án-ni lín chiū kā Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê châi-bu̍t chhiúⁿ--lâi.”
Mô͘-se ìn kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bōe siong-sìn góa, mā bōe thiaⁿ góa ê ōe; in ōe kóng, ‘Siōng Chú m̄-bat tùi lí hián-hiān.’”
Siōng Chú tùi i kóng, “Lí ê chhiú gia̍h sím-mi̍h?” I kóng, “Koáiⁿ-á.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Kā koáiⁿ-á hiat tiàm thô͘-kha.” Mô͘-se chi̍t-ē kā koáiⁿ-á hiat-lo̍h thô͘-kha, koáiⁿ-á chiū pìⁿ-chòe chôa, i chiū siám-cháu.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Chhun-chhiú lia̍h chôa-bé.” Mô͘-se chiū chhun-chhiú khì lia̍h, chôa chiū tī i ê chhiú--ni̍h pìⁿ-chòe koáiⁿ-á.

Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Góa hō͘ lí ū chit-khoán lêng-le̍k, sī beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sìn Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, Í-sat ê Siōng-tè, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè, ū tùi lí hián-hiān.”

Siōng Chú koh tùi i kóng, “Chhiú chhun ji̍p-khì saⁿ-á lāi.” I chiū kā chhiú chhun--ji̍p-khì; chhiú chi̍t-ē chhun--chhut-lâi, chhiú í-keng tì giâm-tiōng ê phê-hu-pīⁿ, pe̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ seh.
Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Koh kā lí ê chhiú chhun--ji̍p-khì.” I chiū koh chhun--ji̍p-khì; chhiú chi̍t-ē chhun--chhut-lâi, phê-hu í-keng ho̍k-goân, kap kui seng-khu ê phê-hu kâng-khoán.
Siōng Chú kóng, “In nā m̄ siong-sìn lí, mā bô beh siong-sìn tē-it ê sîn-jiah, in ōe siong-sìn tē-jī ê sîn-jiah.
Chit nn̄g ê sîn-jiah in nā lóng m̄ sìn, koh m̄ thiaⁿ lí ê ōe, lí tio̍h tùi Nî-lô-hô iúⁿ-chúi, tò tī thô͘-kha, hiah-ê chúi chiū ōe pìⁿ-chòe huih.”
Mô͘-se tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa ê Chú ah, góa m̄-sī gâu kóng-ōe ê lâng; lí kap lí ê po̍k-jîn kóng-ōe liáu-āu mā-sī án-ni; góa sī chhùi-chi̍h tūn ê lâng.”
Siōng Chú tùi i kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng hō͘ lâng kháu-châi? Sím-mi̍h-lâng hō͘ lâng bōe kóng-ōe, bōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, ba̍k-kim á-sī sit-bêng? Kiám m̄-sī góa Siōng Chú?
Taⁿ, lí tio̍h khì, góa beh sù lí kháu-châi, beh kà lí kóng lí tio̍h kóng ê ōe.”
Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa ê Chú ah, kiû lí phài pa̍t-lâng khì.”

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se hoat siū-khì, kóng, “ Lī-bī -lâng A-lûn kiám m̄-sī lí ê hiaⁿ-ko? Góa chai i chin gâu kóng-ōe. Hiān-chāi i lâi beh chiap lí; i khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí, sim-lāi ōe chin hoaⁿ-hí.
Lí tio̍h chiong eng-kai kóng ê ōe kau-tài i; góa ōe sù lí kap i kháu-châi, koh kà lín chòe eng-kai chòe ê sū.
I ōe thòe lí tùi jîn-bîn kóng-ōe; i chòe lí ê tāi-giân-jîn, lí chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê Siōng-tè, chí-sī i eng-kai kóng ê ōe.
Lí tio̍h gia̍h chit-ki koáiⁿ-á lâi kiâⁿ sîn-jiah.”

Mô͘-se chiū tò-khì i ê tiūⁿ-lâng Ia̍p-te̍k-lô hia, tùi i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa tò-khì Ai-ki̍p, khòaⁿ góa ê chhin-lâng iáu oa̍h--teh bô.” Ia̍p-te̍k-lô kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí thang pêng-an khì.”
Siōng Chú tī Bí-tiân tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h tò-khì Ai-ki̍p, in-ūi beh hāi lí ê sìⁿ-miā hiah-ê lâng lóng sí lah.”
Mô͘-se chhōa i ê bó͘ kap nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, hō͘ in khiâ lû-á, tò-khì Ai-ki̍p; Mô͘-se chhiú gia̍h Siōng-tè ê koáiⁿ-á.

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tò-khì Ai-ki̍p ê sî, it-tēng tio̍h ēng góa sù hō͘ lí ê lêng-le̍k, tī Ai-ki̍p -ông ê bīn-chêng kiâⁿ kî-sū; m̄-kú góa beh hō͘ i ê sim ngī, m̄-khéng pàng chit-ê bîn-cho̍k lī-khui.
Lí tio̍h kā Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Í-sek-lia̍t sī góa ê tōa-kiáⁿ.
Góa bat kā lí kóng, tio̍h pàng góa ê kiáⁿ lī-khui, khì ho̍k-sāi góa; m̄-kú lí kū-choa̍t, só͘-í, góa beh thâi-sí lí ê tōa-kiáⁿ.’”
Mô͘-se tī lō͘-tiong hioh-mî ê só͘-chāi, Siōng Chú tú-tio̍h i, beh thâi i.
Se-pho-la the̍h chio̍h-to koah i ê kiáⁿ ê pau-phê, ù Mô͘-se ê kha, kóng, “Lí sī góa huih ê tiōng-hu.”
Siōng Chú chiū pàng i soah. Se-pho-la kóng, “Lí sī kiâⁿ kat-lé lâu-huih ê sin-lông.”
Siōng Chú tùi A-lûn kóng, “Lí ǹg khòng-iá ê hong-hiòng khì gêng-chiap Mô͘-se.” I chiū khì, tī Siōng-tè ê soaⁿ tú-tio̍h Mô͘-se, kā i chim, kā i chhéng-an.
Mô͘-se chiong Siōng Chú hoan-hù i ê ōe, kap bēng-lēng i tio̍h kiâⁿ ê sîn-jiah, lóng kā A-lûn kóng.
Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chiū khì chio-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiúⁿ-ló.
A-lûn chiong Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng ê ōe lóng kā in kóng, koh tī jîn-bîn ê bīn-chêng kiâⁿ hiah-ê sîn-jiah.
Jîn-bîn chiū siong-sìn; in thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú koàn-kò͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, koh chai-iáⁿ in ê khùn-khó͘, chiū kūi lo̍h-khì kèng-pài Siōng Chú.
Āu-lâi, Mô͘-se kap A-lûn khì kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông, tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Tio̍h hō͘ góa ê chú-bîn khì khòng-iá siú-choeh kèng-pài góa.’”
Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, “Siōng Chú sī siáⁿ-lâng? Góa ná tio̍h thiaⁿ I ê ōe, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui? Góa m̄ bat I, mā put-chún Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui.”

Mô͘-se kap A-lûn kóng, “ Hi-pek-lâi -lâng ê Siōng-tè tùi goán hián-hiān; chhiáⁿ hō͘ goán kiâⁿ saⁿ ji̍t ê lō͘-thêng khì khòng-iá, ǹg Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè hiàn-chè, chiah bián I ēng un-e̍k kap to-kiàm siong-hāi goán.”
Ai-ki̍p -ông kā in kóng, “ Mô͘-se, A-lûn, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ kiò chit-ê peh-sìⁿ mài choh-kang? Tńg-khì choh-kang!”
Ai-ki̍p -ông koh kóng, “Hiān-chāi, chit-ê bîn-cho̍k lâng chiah chōe, lín kèng-jiân kiò in thêng-kang.”
Hit-ji̍t, Ai-ki̍p -ông bēng-lēng Ai-ki̍p ê tok-kang kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê kang-thâu, kóng,
“Lín mài koh chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng khoán be̍h-kó hō͘ chit-ê peh-sìⁿ chòe chng-á; be̍h-kó, hō͘ in ka-kī khì khioh.
Tio̍h iau-kiû in chòe kap í-chêng kâng-khoán sò͘-bo̍k ê chng-á, liân chi̍t tè to bōe-kiám--tit. In pîn-tōaⁿ, só͘-í tōa-siaⁿ iau-kiû beh chhut-khì ǹg in ê Siōng-tè hiàn-chè.
Tio̍h hō͘ chiah-ê lâng chòe khah tāng ê kang-chok, hō͘ in thiám kah bōe khì thiaⁿ lâng sái-lōng.”
Ai-ki̍p ê tok-kang kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê kang-thâu tùi jîn-bîn soan-pò͘, “ Ai-ki̍p -ông án-ni kóng, ‘Góa bô beh koh be̍h-kó hō͘ lín.
Lín ka-kī khì chhē, ka-kī khì khioh, m̄-kú lín kau--chhut-lâi ê chng-á bōe-ēng-tit kiám-chió.’”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū sì-sòaⁿ khì Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe, khioh be̍h-châng ê thâu tāi-thòe be̍h-kó.
Tok-kang ap-pek in, kóng, “Lín ta̍k-ji̍t kau--chhut-lâi ê chng-á ê sò͘-bo̍k, tio̍h kap ū hō͘ lín be̍h-kó ê sî siâng-khoán.”
Ai-ki̍p -ông ê tok-kang phah in phài-khì koán-lí Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê kang-thâu, kóng, “Chit kúi ji̍t lín ná bô chiàu í-chêng kui-tēng ê sò͘-bo̍k kau chng-á?”
Í-sek-lia̍t ê kang-thâu chiū lâi kā Ai-ki̍p -ông ai-kiû, kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ án-ni tùi-thāi goán?
Tok-kang bô be̍h-kó hō͘ goán, koh iau-kiû goán tio̍h kau siâng-khoán sò͘-bo̍k ê chng-á. Goán hō͘ lâng phah, lóng sī lín Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê m̄-tio̍h.”
Ông kóng, “Lín si̍t-chāi pîn-tōaⁿ, ū-kàu pîn-tōaⁿ, chiah iau-kiû beh khì kā Siōng Chú hiàn-chè.
Hiān-chāi, lín tio̍h tńg-khì choh-kang; be̍h-kó m̄ hō͘ lín, chng-á ê sò͘-liōng bōe-ēng-tit kiám.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê kang-thâu thiaⁿ-tio̍h ta̍k-ji̍t kau chng-á ê sò͘-liōng bōe-kiám--tit, chiū chai-iáⁿ chhám ah.
In tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông hia chhut--lâi ê sî, tú-tio̍h Mô͘-se kap A-lûn teh tán in. In chiū kā Mô͘-se kap A-lûn kóng,
“Goān Siōng Chú kàm-chhat, kā lín hêng-hoa̍t, in-ūi lín hāi goán hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i ê jîn-sîn oàn-chhoeh, hō͘ in ū lí-iû thâi goán.”
Mô͘-se tò-tńg-khì Siōng Chú hia, kóng, “Chú ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ pháiⁿ khoán-thāi chit-ê bîn-cho̍k? Sī-án-chóaⁿ phài góa?
Tùi góa tē-it piàn khì kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông, hōng lí ê miâ tùi i kóng-ōe khai-sí, i chiū ap-pek chit-ê bîn-cho̍k; lí chi̍t-sut-á to bô kiù lí ê chú-bîn.”

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Taⁿ, lí ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa án-chóaⁿ tùi-hù Ai-ki̍p -ông; góa beh ēng tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú, pek i pàng góa ê chú-bîn chhut--khì, kā in kóaⁿ lī-khui i ê tōe.”
Siōng-tè koh tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa sī Siōng Chú.
Góa sī Choân-lêng ê Siōng-tè, bat tùi A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok hián-hiān, m̄-kú góa m̄-bat hō͘ in chai góa ê miâ sī Siōng Chú.
Góa bat kap in li̍p-iok, èng-ún beh chiong in kià-ku ê Ka-lâm -tōe siúⁿ-sù hō͘ in.
Góa mā ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Ai-ki̍p chòe khó͘-kang só͘ hoat-chhut haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan ê siaⁿ, chiū ōe-kì-tit góa kap in chó͘-sian só͘ li̍p ê iok.

Só͘-í lí tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, ‘Góa sī Siōng Chú. Góa beh kiù lín thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê ap-pek, hō͘ lín m̄-bián koh chòe in ê lô͘-lē, góa koh beh chhut-chhiú giâm-giâm hêng-hoa̍t in lâi kiù-sio̍k lín.

Góa beh chiap-la̍p lín chòe góa ê chú-bîn, góa beh chòe lín ê Siōng-tè. Góa kiù lín thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê ap-pek ê sî, lín ōe jīn-bat góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Góa só͘ li̍p-sè èng-ún beh hō͘ A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok hit-tè tōe, góa beh chhōa lín ji̍p--khì, chiong hit-ê tōe siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p. Góa sī Siōng Chú.’”
Mô͘-se chiong chiah-ê ōe kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, m̄-kú in in-ūi chòe khó͘-kang, sit-chì, thiaⁿ bōe ji̍p--khì.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí khì kā Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló kóng, tio̍h pàng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui i ê tōe.”
Mô͘-se tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng to m̄ thiaⁿ góa, Ai-ki̍p -ông ná ōe thiaⁿ góa chit-ê han-bān kóng-ōe ê lâng?”
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se kap A-lûn khì Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Ai-ki̍p -ông hia, chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhōa--chhut-lâi.
Ē-bīn sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ: Ngá-kok ê tōa-kiáⁿ Lū-piān ê kiáⁿ sī Í-lo̍k, Hoat-lō͘, Hi-su-lûn, kap Ka-bí; chiah-ê sī Lū-piān ê chong-cho̍k.
Se-biān ê kiáⁿ sī Iâ-bō͘-lī, Ngá-bín, O-hat, Ngá-kun, Só-hat, í-ki̍p kap Ka-lâm ê lú-chú só͘ siⁿ ê Sò-lô; chiah-ê sī Se-biān ê chong-cho̍k.
Ē-bīn sī Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ ê miâ, chiàu in ê ka-phó͘ sī Kek-sūn, Ko-hat, kap Bí-la-lī; Lī-bī oa̍h chi̍t-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-chhit hè.
Kek-sūn ê kiáⁿ, chiàu in ê ka-cho̍k, sī Li̍p-nî kap Sī-múi.
Ko-hat ê kiáⁿ sī Àm-lân, Í-su-hap, Hi-pek-lûn, O͘-siat; Ko-hat oa̍h chi̍t-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-saⁿ hè.
Bí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ sī Boat-lī kap Bō͘-sī. Chiah-ê sī Lī-bī chiàu in ê ka-phó͘ só͘ kì-chài ê chong-cho̍k.
Àm-lân chhōa i ê a-ko͘ Iok-ki-pia̍t choh-bó͘, siⁿ A-lûn kap Mô͘-se; Àm-lân oa̍h chi̍t-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-chhit hè.
Í-su-hap ê kiáⁿ sī Khó-la, Nî-húi, kap Sè-ki-lī.
O͘-siat ê kiáⁿ sī Bí-sa-lī, Í-lī-sat-hoán, kap Se-thê-lī.
A-lûn chhōa A-bí-ná-ta̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, Ná-sūn ê sió-bē Í-lī-sa-pa choh-bó͘, siⁿ Ná-tap, A-pí-hō͘, Í-lī-a-sat, kap Í-tha-má.
Khó-la ê kiáⁿ sī A-sioh, Í-lī-ka-ná, kap A-pí-a-sat; chiah-ê sī Khó-la ê ka-cho̍k.
A-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat chhōa Phó͘-thiat chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ choh-bó͘, siⁿ Hui-nî-hap; chiah-ê sī Lī-bī -lâng ta̍k-ê ka-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ.
A-lûn kap Mô͘-se chiū-sī Siōng Chú bat tùi in kóng “Tio̍h chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chi̍t-tūi chi̍t-tūi lī-khui Ai-ki̍p -tōe” hit nn̄g ê lâng.
Tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló kóng beh chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p --ê, mā-sī Mô͘-se kap A-lûn.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Siōng Chú tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe tùi Mô͘-se kóng-ōe.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa sī Siōng Chú. Góa tùi lí kóng ê ōe, lí lóng tio̍h kā Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló kóng.”
Mô͘-se tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa sī han-bān kóng-ōe ê lâng, Ai-ki̍p -ông ná ōe thiaⁿ góa?”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa beh hō͘ lí tī Ai-ki̍p -ông ê bīn-chêng chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè; lí ê hiaⁿ-ko A-lûn beh chòe lí ê tāi-giân-jîn.
Góa bēng-lēng lí--ê, lí lóng tio̍h kóng; lí ê hiaⁿ-ko A-lûn tio̍h kā Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, tio̍h pàng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui i ê tōe.
Góa beh hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim ngī, koh beh tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe kiâⁿ chin chōe sîn-jiah kî-sū.
M̄-kú Ai-ki̍p -ông bô beh thiaⁿ lín, góa chiū beh kong-kek Ai-ki̍p, giâm-giâm hêng-hoa̍t in, chhōa góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t chi̍t-tūi chi̍t-tūi chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe.
Góa chhun-chhiú kong-kek Ai-ki̍p, chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi in tiong-kan chhut--lâi ê sî, Ai-ki̍p -lâng chiū ōe chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê hoan-hù khì chòe.
In kap Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng-ōe ê sî, Mô͘-se poeh-cha̍p hè, A-lûn poeh-cha̍p-saⁿ hè.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kap A-lûn kóng,
“ Ai-ki̍p -ông nā kā lín kóng ‘Kiâⁿ chi̍t kiāⁿ kî-sū lâi khòaⁿ-bāi--leh’, lí tio̍h kiò A-lûn kā i ê koáiⁿ-á tàn tī Ai-ki̍p -ông ê bīn-chêng, koáiⁿ-á ōe pìⁿ-chòe chôa.”

Mô͘-se kap A-lûn ji̍p-khì kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông, chiàu Siōng Chú ê hoan-hù chòe; A-lûn chiong i ê koáiⁿ-á hiat tī Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i ê jîn-sîn ê bīn-chêng, koáiⁿ-á chiū pìⁿ-chòe chôa.
Ai-ki̍p -ông chiū tiàu ū tì-hūi ê lâng kap hoat-su lâi; chiah-ê Ai-ki̍p ê su̍t-sū ēng in ê hoat-su̍t mā án-ni chòe.
In ta̍k-ê lâng chiong koáiⁿ-á hiat--lo̍h-khì, koáiⁿ-á lóng pìⁿ-chòe chôa; m̄-kú A-lûn ê koáiⁿ-á thun-chia̍h in ê koáiⁿ-á.
Chóng-sī Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim ngī, m̄ thiaⁿ in ê ōe, tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú kóng--ê.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “ Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim kò͘-chip, m̄-khéng pàng góa ê chú-bîn lī-khui.
Bîn-á-chá-khí, Ai-ki̍p -ông ōe khì Nî-lô-hô; lí tio̍h gia̍h hit-ki bat pìⁿ-chòe chôa ê koáiⁿ-á, tī hô-piⁿ tán i.

Lí tio̍h tùi i kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Hi-pek-lâi -lâng ê Siōng-tè phài góa lâi tùi lí kóng: Tio̍h pàng góa ê chú-bîn lī-khui, hō͘ in khì khòng-iá kèng-pài góa; m̄-kú kàu taⁿ lí lóng m̄ thiaⁿ.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh ēng góa ê koáiⁿ-á phah Nî-lô-hô ê hô-chúi, chúi ōe pìⁿ-chòe huih; án-ni, lí chiū ōe chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
Hô--ni̍h ê hî ōe sí, chúi ōe chhàu; Ai-ki̍p -lâng bōe-tàng koh lim Nî-lô-hô ê chúi.’”

Siōng Chú koh tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h kā A-lûn kóng, ‘Gia̍h lí ê koáiⁿ-á, kí Ai-ki̍p ê hô kap khoe, chúi-tî kap thiok-chúi-tî, hō͘ só͘-ū ê chúi lóng pìⁿ-chòe huih; Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe, liân chúi-tháng kap chio̍h-àng ê chúi mā lóng pìⁿ-chòe huih.’”

Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng khì chòe. A-lûn tī Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i ê jîn-sîn bīn-chêng gia̍h koáiⁿ-á phah Nî-lô-hô ê chúi; hô--ni̍h ê chúi lóng pìⁿ-chòe huih.
Hô--ni̍h ê hî lóng sí, hô-chúi siⁿ chhàu-bī, Ai-ki̍p -lâng bōe-tàng lim hô--ni̍h ê chúi; Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe lóng ū huih.
Ai-ki̍p ê su̍t-sū ēng in ê hoat-su̍t mā án-ni chòe. Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim ngī, m̄ thiaⁿ Mô͘-se kap A-lûn, tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú kóng--ê.
Ai-ki̍p -ông tò-tńg-khì ông-kiong, bô chiong chit-ê sū khǹg tī sim-lāi.
Só͘-ū ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng tī Nî-lô-hô hô-piⁿ ó͘ khut-á chhē chúi lim, in-ūi hô ê chúi bōe-lim--tit.
Siōng Chú phah Nî-lô-hô liáu-āu, chit-ê chai-lān kè-sio̍k chhit ji̍t.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí khì Ai-ki̍p -ông hia, kā i kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Pàng góa ê chú-bîn lī-khui, hō͘ in thang kèng-pài góa.
Lí nā m̄ pàng in khì, góa beh ēng chúi-koe jiáu-loān lín choân-kok.

Nî-lô-hô beh siⁿ chiok chōe chúi-koe, in beh tùi hô--ni̍h khí--lâi, ji̍p-khì lí ê kiong-tiān, lí ê pâng-keng, peh-chiūⁿ lí ê bîn-chhn̂g, koh beh chìn-ji̍p lí ê jîn-sîn ê chhù, thiàu-chiūⁿ lí ê jîn-bîn ê seng-khu, chìn-ji̍p lí ê chàu kap chhiau mī-hún ê khì-khū.
Chúi-koe koh beh thiàu-chiūⁿ lí, lí ê jîn-bîn, kap só͘-ū jîn-sîn ê seng-khu.’”
Siōng Chú koh tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí kā A-lûn kóng, ‘Gia̍h lí ê koáiⁿ-á kí Nî-lô-hô, khoe, kap chúi-tî, hō͘ chúi-koe peh khí-lâi Ai-ki̍p -tōe.’”
A-lûn chhun-chhiú kí Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe ê chúi; chúi-koe chiū thiàu--khí-lâi, khàm-móa Ai-ki̍p -tōe.
Ai-ki̍p ê su̍t-sū ēng in ê hoat-su̍t mā án-ni chòe, hō͘ chúi-koe chiūⁿ-lâi Ai-ki̍p -tōe.

Ai-ki̍p -ông kiò Mô͘-se kap A-lûn lâi, kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lín kiû Siōng Chú hō͘ chiah-ê chúi-koe lī-khui góa kap góa ê jîn-bîn; góa chiū beh hō͘ chit-ê bîn-cho̍k lī-khui, khì ǹg Siōng Chú hiàn-chè.”

Mô͘-se tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, “Hó! Chhiáⁿ kā góa kóng, sím-mi̍h sî thang ūi-tio̍h lí, lí ê jîn-sîn, kap jîn-bîn kî-tó, chiong chúi-koe tùi lí kap ông-kiong tû-bia̍t, hō͘ chúi-koe chí-ū lâu tī Nî-lô-hô.”
I kóng, “Bîn-á-chài.” Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa ōe chiàu lí ê iau-kiû chòe, án-ni lí chiū chai, bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kap Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè pí.
Chúi-koe ōe lī-khui lí kap ông-kiong, lī-khui lí ê jîn-sîn kap jîn-bîn, chí-ū lâu tī Nî-lô-hô.”
Mô͘-se kap A-lûn lī-khui Ai-ki̍p -ông chhut--khì; Mô͘-se ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú phài-lâi sún-hoāi Ai-ki̍p -ông ê chúi-koe, kiû-kiò Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú chiàu Mô͘-se ê khún-kiû khì chòe, hō͘ tī chhù-lāi, tiâⁿ--ni̍h, kap chhân-iá ê chúi-koe lóng sí.
Lâng kā in khioh chi̍t-tui chi̍t-tui; Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe lóng sī chhàu-bī.
Ai-ki̍p -ông khòaⁿ-tio̍h tāi-chì ū kái-koat, chiū ngī i ê sim, m̄ thiaⁿ Mô͘-se kap A-lûn ê ōe; tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú só͘ kóng--ê.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h kā A-lûn kóng, ‘Gia̍h lí ê koáiⁿ-á phah thô͘-hún, hō͘ Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe ê thô͘-hún pìⁿ-chòe sat-bú.’”
In chiū án-ni chòe; A-lûn gia̍h koáiⁿ-á phah thô͘-hún, lâng kap cheng-siⁿ ê seng-khu chiū lóng ū sat-bú. Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe ê thô͘-hún lóng pìⁿ-chòe sat-bú.
Lâng kap cheng-siⁿ ê seng-khu lóng ū sat-bú. Su̍t-sū ēng in ê hoat-su̍t mā beh hō͘ thô͘-hún pìⁿ-chòe sat-bú, m̄-kú bô hoat-tō͘.
Su̍t-sū tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, “Che sī Siōng-tè ê chok-ûi.” M̄-kú Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim ngī, m̄ thiaⁿ Mô͘-se kap A-lûn ê ōe; tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú kóng--ê.

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Bîn-á-chá-khí, Ai-ki̍p -ông ōe khì Nî-lô-hô; lí tio̍h khiā tī i ê bīn-chêng, tùi i kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Pàng góa ê chú-bîn lī-khui, khì kèng-pài góa.

Lí nā m̄-khéng, góa beh phài kui-kûn hô͘-sîn pe-lâi lí chia, tī lí ê jîn-sîn kap jîn-bîn ê sin-chiūⁿ, koh ji̍p ông-kiong; Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê chhù, kap in tòa ê só͘-chāi, mā beh ū kui-kûn ê hô͘-sîn.

Hit-ji̍t, góa beh chiong góa ê chú-bîn khiā-khí ê Ko-san tōe-khu hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi; tī hia bô kui-kûn hô͘-sîn. Góa án-ni chòe, sī beh hō͘ lí chai góa Siōng Chú sī choân-tōe ê Chú.
Góa beh chiong góa ê chú-bîn kap lí ê jîn-bîn hun-khui; bîn-á-chài chit-ê sîn-jiah it-tēng ōe hoat-seng.’”
Siōng Chú chiū án-ni chòe. Hô͘-sîn kui-tīn pe-ji̍p Ai-ki̍p -ông ê kiong-tiān kap i ê jîn-sîn ê chhù; Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe lóng in-ūi kui-kûn ê hô͘-sîn hong-hòe.
Ai-ki̍p -ông chiū kiò Mô͘-se kap A-lûn lâi, kóng, “Lín khì, tī góa ê kéng-lāi ǹg lín ê Siōng-tè hiàn-chè.”

Mô͘-se ìn i kóng, “Án-ni chòe bōe thong; in-ūi goán beh hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ê chè-mi̍h, Ai-ki̍p -lâng khòaⁿ-chòe kìm-khī. Goán nā tī Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê bīn-chêng ēng in khòaⁿ-chòe kìm-khī ê mi̍h hiàn-chè, in kiám bōe ēng chio̍h-thâu kā goán tìm--sí?
Goán beh kiâⁿ saⁿ ji̍t ê lō͘-thêng khì khòng-iá, chiàu Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng hiàn-chè hō͘ I.”
Ai-ki̍p -ông kóng, “Góa ún-chún lín lī-khui, hō͘ lín tī khòng-iá ǹg Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè hiàn-chè, m̄-kú bōe-ēng-tit khì siuⁿ hn̄g. Koh lín tio̍h thòe góa kî-tó.”

Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa beh tùi lí chia chhut--khì, ǹg Siōng Chú kî-tó, kiû I hō͘ kui-tīn hô͘-sîn bîn-á-chài lī-khui Ai-ki̍p -ông kap lí ê jîn-sîn, í-ki̍p jîn-bîn. M̄-kú Ai-ki̍p -ông m̄-thang koh phiàn goán, m̄-chún chit-ê bîn-cho̍k lī-khui khì hiàn-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú.”
Mô͘-se chiū tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông hia chhut--khì, ǹg Siōng Chú kî-tó.
Siōng Chú chiū chiàu Mô͘-se ê khún-kiû, hō͘ hô͘-sîn lóng lī-khui Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i ê jîn-sîn, í-ki̍p jîn-bîn, bô lâu pòaⁿ-chiah.
Chit-piàn Ai-ki̍p -ông koh ngī i ê sim, m̄ pàng chit-ê bîn-cho̍k lī-khui.

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí khì kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông, kā i kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Hi-pek-lâi -lâng ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Tio̍h pàng góa ê chú-bîn lī-khui, hō͘ in thang kèng-pài góa.
