Lí nā m̄ pàng in khì, iû-goân beh kiông-pek in lâu--teh,
Siōng Chú chiū beh ēng I ê koân-lêng kàng giâm-tiōng ê un-e̍k tī lí chhân-iá ê cheng-siⁿ, bé, lû, lo̍k-tô, gû-kûn, iûⁿ-kûn.
Siōng Chú beh hun-pia̍t Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê cheng-siⁿ kap Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê cheng-siⁿ; só͘-ū sio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê cheng-siⁿ, liân chi̍t chiah to bōe sí.’”
Siōng Chú chiū siat-tēng beh kàng un-e̍k ê sî-kan, kóng, “Bîn-á-chài Siōng Chú beh tī chit-ê tōe chòe chit-hāng sū.”
Keh-ji̍t Siōng Chú chiū chòe chit-ê sū; Ai-ki̍p ê cheng-siⁿ lóng sí, m̄-kú, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê cheng-siⁿ liân chi̍t chiah to bô sí.
Ai-ki̍p -ông phài lâng khì khòaⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê cheng-siⁿ liân chi̍t chiah to bô sí. M̄-kú Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim kò͘-chip, m̄ pàng chit-ê bîn-cho̍k lī-khui.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kap A-lûn kóng, “Lín tio̍h phóng kui-phóng hé-lô͘ ê hé-hu; Mô͘-se tio̍h tī Ai-ki̍p -ông ê bīn-chêng chiong hé-hu ǹg thiⁿ iā--khì.
Hé-hu ōe tī Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe pìⁿ-chòe tîn-ai, lak tī Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe ê lâng kap cheng-siⁿ ê seng-khu, siⁿ lia̍p-á, chiâⁿ-chòe chhng.”
In nn̄g lâng chiū phóng hé-hu, khì tī Ai-ki̍p -ông ê bīn-chêng; Mô͘-se ǹg thiⁿ iā--khì, lâng kap cheng-siⁿ ê seng-khu chiū siⁿ lia̍p-á, chiâⁿ-chòe chhng.
Su̍t-sū bô hoat-tō͘ tī Mô͘-se bīn-chêng chòe chit-ê sū; in kap só͘-ū ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng lóng siⁿ lia̍p-á.
Siōng Chú hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim ngī, m̄ thiaⁿ Mô͘-se kap A-lûn ê ōe; tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng--ê.

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Bîn-á-chài lí tio̍h thàu-chá khí--lâi, khì khiā tī Ai-ki̍p -ông ê bīn-chêng, tùi i kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Hi-pek-lâi -lâng ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Tio̍h pàng góa ê chú-bîn lī-khui, hō͘ in thang kèng-pài góa.
Chit-piàn, góa beh hō͘ koh-khah giâm-tiōng ê chai-lān lîm-kàu lí kap lí ê jîn-sîn, í-ki̍p jîn-bîn, hō͘ lí chai, tī phó͘-thiⁿ-ē bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kap góa pí.
Hiān-chāi, góa nā chhun-chhiú ēng un-e̍k kong-kek lí kap lí ê jîn-bîn, lí chiū ōe tùi tōe-chiūⁿ siū siau-bia̍t;
chóng-sī ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lí khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê koân-lêng, hō͘ góa ê miâ tī choân sè-kài siū soan-iông, góa chiah lâu lí ê sìⁿ-miā.
M̄-kú lí iû-goân chó͘-tòng góa ê chú-bîn, m̄ pàng in lī-khui.
Taⁿ, bîn-á-chài chit-ê sî, góa beh kàng ke̍k-tōa ê peng-pha̍uh, tùi Ai-ki̍p khai-kok í-lâi m̄-bat hoat-seng--kè.

Hiān-chāi lí tio̍h phài lâng, chiong lí só͘-ū tī chhân-iá ê lâng kap cheng-siⁿ lóng tòa-khì an-choân ê só͘-chāi; hiah-ê lâu tī sek-gōa--ê, bô-lūn lâng á-sī cheng-siⁿ, lóng ōe hō͘ peng-pha̍uh tìm--sí.’”
Ai-ki̍p -ông hiah-ê kiaⁿ-ùi Siōng Chú ê ōe ê jîn-sîn, chiū chiong in ê lô͘-po̍k kap cheng-siⁿ tòa kàu an-choân ê só͘-chāi.
M̄-kú hiah-ê bô chiong Siōng Chú ê ōe khòaⁿ-chòe iàu-kín--ê, chiū chiong in ê lô͘-po̍k kap cheng-siⁿ lâu tī chhân-iá.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí ǹg thiⁿ chhun-chhiú, Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe chiū ōe ū peng-pha̍uh lo̍h tī lâng, cheng-siⁿ, kap chhân-iá só͘-ū ê chhài-soe.”
Mô͘-se gia̍h i ê koáiⁿ-á kí thiⁿ, Siōng Chú chiū hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -tōe ū lûi-kong-sih-nà, lo̍h peng-pha̍uh;
pha̍uh teh lo̍h, koh ū sih-nà, chêng-hêng hui-siông giâm-tiōng; tùi Ai-ki̍p khai-kok í-lâi m̄-bat hoat-seng--kè.
Tī Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe, peng-pha̍uh phah só͘-ū tī chhân-iá ê lâng kap cheng-siⁿ, koh húi-hoāi hn̂g--ni̍h ê chhài-soe, phah-tn̄g iá-tōe ê chhiū-ba̍k.
Chí-ū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khiā-khí ê Ko-san tōe-khu bô lo̍h-pha̍uh.
Ai-ki̍p -ông phài lâng kiò Mô͘-se kap A-lûn lâi, tùi in kóng, “Chit-piàn góa hoān-chōe lah. Siōng Chú sī kong-gī, góa kap góa ê jîn-bîn chòe m̄-tio̍h.
Siōng-tè ê lûi kap peng-pha̍uh í-keng kàu-gia̍h lah. Chhiáⁿ ūi-tio̍h goán kî-kiû Siōng Chú. Góa beh chún lín lī-khui; lín m̄-bián koh lâu tī chia.”

Mô͘-se tùi i kóng, “Góa chi̍t-ē chhut-siâⁿ, chiū beh gia̍h siang-chhiú ǹg Siōng Chú kî-tó; lûi beh soah, peng-pha̍uh ōe thêng, án-ni beh hō͘ lí chai, tāi-tōe lóng sio̍k tī Siōng Chú.
M̄-kú góa chai, lí kap lí ê jîn-sîn iáu bô chin-chiàⁿ kiaⁿ-ùi Chú Siōng-tè.”
Hit-sî, môa kap tōa-be̍h lóng siū sún-hoāi, in-ūi tōa-be̍h í-keng chhut-sūi, môa mā khui-hoe.
M̄-kú sió-be̍h kap chho͘-be̍h bô siū sún-hoāi, in-ūi iáu-bē tōa-châng.
Mô͘-se lī-khui Ai-ki̍p -ông chhut-siâⁿ, gia̍h siang-chhiú ǹg Siōng Chú kî-tó, lûi kap peng-pha̍uh chiū thêng-chí, hō͘ mā bô koh piàⁿ-lo̍h tōe-bīn.
Ai-ki̍p -ông khòaⁿ-tio̍h hō͘, peng-pha̍uh, kap lûi lóng thêng-chí, chiū koh hoān-chōe; i kap i ê jîn-sîn lóng ngī in ê sim.
Ai-ki̍p -ông sim ngī, m̄ pàng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui, tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng--ê.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí khì kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông. Góa beh hō͘ i kap i ê jîn-sîn ê sim ngī, thang hō͘ góa tī in tiong-kan kiâⁿ sîn-jiah;
mā beh hō͘ lí tùi lín ê kiáⁿ, lín ê sun kóng-khí góa án-chóaⁿ hì-lāng Ai-ki̍p -lâng, í-ki̍p góa tī in tiong-kan kiâⁿ ê sîn-jiah, hō͘ lín chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”

Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chiū khì kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông, tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú — Hi-pek-lâi -lâng ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lí kàu taⁿ iáu m̄-khéng tī góa ê bīn-chêng khut-ho̍k. Tio̍h pàng góa ê chú-bîn chhut--khì, hō͘ in thang kèng-pài góa.
Lí nā m̄-khéng pàng góa ê chú-bîn lī-khui, bîn-á-chài, góa beh hō͘ chháu-meh chìn-ji̍p lí ê kéng-lāi;
in beh jia-khàm tōe-bīn, tì-kàu lâng khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h tōe; in koh beh chia̍h peng-pha̍uh phah chhun lâu hō͘ lín--ê, mā beh chia̍h iá-tōe ê chhiū-ba̍k.

Lí ê ông-kiong, lí ê jîn-sîn kap só͘-ū Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê chhù, chi̍t-sì-kòe lóng ū chháu-meh; chū-kó͘ í-lâi, m̄-bat ū lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h án-ni.’” Kóng-liáu, Mô͘-se chiū oa̍t-tńg-sin, lī-khui Ai-ki̍p -ông chhut--khì.

Ai-ki̍p -ông ê jîn-sîn tùi ông kóng, “Chit-ê lâng chhē mâ-hoân hāi lán beh kàu tī-sî? Tio̍h pàng chit-ê bîn-cho̍k khì kèng-pài Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè. Ai-ki̍p í-keng teh-beh bia̍t-bông lah, lí kiám m̄ chai?”
Tùi án-ni, Ai-ki̍p -ông tiàu Mô͘-se kap A-lûn tò-tńg--lâi, tùi in kóng, “Lín thang khì kèng-pài Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, m̄-kú sī sím-mi̍h-lâng beh khì?”

Mô͘-se kóng, “Goán lóng beh khì; goán ê siàu-liân-lâng kap lāu-lâng, goán ê hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, goán ê gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn lóng beh chòe-hé khì; in-ūi goán tio̍h siú-choeh kèng-pài Siōng Chú.”

Ai-ki̍p -ông tùi in kóng, “Khì ah, góa nā pàng lín ê gín-á kap hū-jîn-lâng tè lín khì, goān Siōng Chú kā lín pó-pì lah! Lín tio̍h chai, chai-hō í-keng tī lín ê ba̍k-chiu chêng.
M̄-kú bōe-ēng--tit! Góa kan-ta chún lín ta-po͘-lâng khì kèng-pài Siōng Chú, lín pún-lâi chiū-sī án-ni iau-kiû.” Ai-ki̍p -ông chiū kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.
Siōng Chú kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí chhun-chhiú kí Ai-ki̍p -tōe, hō͘ chháu-meh khàm-móa choân-kok, chia̍h peng-pha̍uh phah chhun ê si̍t-bu̍t.”
Mô͘-se gia̍h i ê koáiⁿ-á kí Ai-ki̍p -tōe, Siōng Chú chiū hō͘ tang-hong kui-mî kui-ji̍t chhe Ai-ki̍p -tōe; kàu keh-ji̍t chá-khí, tang-hong chiong chháu-meh chhe--lâi.
Chháu-meh chhim-hoān Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe, hioh tī Ai-ki̍p sù-kéng; chháu-meh chiah-ni̍h chōe, sò͘-liōng khong-chiân-choa̍t-hō͘.

Chháu-meh jia-khàm tōe-bīn, tì-kàu choân-tōe lóng o͘-àm; in koh chia̍h tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū hō͘ peng-pha̍uh phah chhun ê chhài-soe kap chhiū-téng ê ké-chí. Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe, bô-lūn chhiū-ba̍k, á-sī hn̂g--ni̍h ê chhài-soe, liân chi̍t-sut-á chhiⁿ-chhùi ê mi̍h to bô lâu--teh.
Ai-ki̍p -ông kóaⁿ-kín kiò Mô͘-se kap A-lûn lâi, kóng, “Góa ū tek-chōe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, mā tek-chōe lín.
Taⁿ, chhiáⁿ lín kî-kiû Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, koh chi̍t piàn sià-bián góa ê chōe, hō͘ góa thoat-lī chit-piàn tì-kàu sí-bông ê chai-lān.”
Mô͘-se chiū lī-khui Ai-ki̍p -ông, khì kî-kiû Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú chiū thàu chin kiông ê sai-hong, chiong chháu-meh chhe lo̍h-khì Âng-hái; Ai-ki̍p sù-kéng liân chi̍t chiah chháu-meh to bô lâu--teh.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim ngī, m̄ pàng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui.
Siōng Chú koh kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí chhun-chhiú kí thiⁿ, hō͘ o͘-àm jia-khàm Ai-ki̍p -tōe, àm kah tio̍h ēng bong--ê chiah ōe-kiâⁿ--tit.”
Mô͘-se chhun-chhiú kí thiⁿ, Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe chiū saⁿ ji̍t kú o͘-o͘-àm-àm;
saⁿ ji̍t kú lâng hō͘-siōng khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h, mā bōe-tàng lī-khui chhù; m̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi lóng ū kng-bêng.

Ai-ki̍p -ông chiū kiò Mô͘-se lâi, kóng, “Lín khì kèng-pài Siōng Chú, lín ê gín-á kap hū-jîn-lâng mā thang kap lín chòe-hé khì, m̄-kú lín ê gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn tio̍h lâu--lo̍h-lâi.”
Mô͘-se ìn i kóng, “Lí tio̍h chiong chè-mi̍h kap sio-hòa-chè ê mi̍h hō͘ goán, hō͘ goán thang ǹg Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè hiàn-chè.

Goán ê cheng-siⁿ mā tio̍h kap goán khì, liân chi̍t chiah to bōe-tàng lâu--teh, in-ūi goán iáu m̄ chai tio̍h ēng sím-mi̍h cheng-siⁿ ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè; kàu hia goán chiah ōe chai.”
M̄-kú Siōng Chú hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim ngī, m̄-khéng pàng in lī-khui.
Ai-ki̍p -ông kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí kā góa chhut--khì! Lí tio̍h sòe-jī, m̄-thang koh hō͘ góa khòaⁿ--tio̍h; hō͘ góa khòaⁿ--tio̍h hit-ji̍t, lí ōe sí.”
Mô͘-se kóng, “Chiàu lí kóng--ê, góa bô beh koh kìⁿ lí ê bīn.”

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa beh koh kàng chi̍t ê chai-lān hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông kap Ai-ki̍p, āu-lâi i chiah ōe pàng lín lī-khui chia; i pàng lín lī-khui ê sî, ōe pek lín kóaⁿ-kín tùi chia chhut--khì.
Lí tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, bô-lūn lâm-lú, ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tio̍h tùi in ê chhù-piⁿ thó kim-khì, gûn-khì.”

Siōng Chú hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tit-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê hó khoán-thāi; koh Mô͘-se chit-ê lâng tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe, mā siū Ai-ki̍p -ông ê jîn-sîn kap jîn-bîn khòaⁿ-chòe úi-tāi.
Mô͘-se kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Ē-hng-àm pòaⁿ-mî, góa beh tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe kiâⁿ-thàu-thàu.
Só͘-ū Ai-ki̍p -tōe ê tōa-kiáⁿ, tùi chē ông-ūi ê Ai-ki̍p -ông kàu oe-bō ê lú-pī ê tōa-kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p lóng-chóng thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê cheng-siⁿ, lóng ōe sí.
Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe beh ū ai-siong thî-khàu ê siaⁿ, í-chêng m̄-bat ū, chiong-lâi mā bōe koh ū.

M̄-kú tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tōe-khu ōe chin pêng-chēng, liân káu-á to bōe kā lâng á-sī cheng-siⁿ pūi; án-ni beh hō͘ lín chai, Siōng Chú ū hun-pia̍t Ai-ki̍p -lâng kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.’

Lí só͘-ū ê jîn-sîn beh lâi kìⁿ góa, phak tī góa ê bīn-chêng, kóng, ‘Pài-thok lí kap kun-tè lí ê jîn-bîn lóng lī-khui.’ Āu-lâi góa chiah beh lī-khui.” Kóng soah, Mô͘-se khì-phut-phut lī-khui Ai-ki̍p -ông chhut--khì.
Siōng Chú bat tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “ Ai-ki̍p -ông bōe thiaⁿ lí ê ōe, só͘-í góa beh tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe kiâⁿ koh-khah chōe ê sîn-jiah.”
Mô͘-se kap A-lûn tī Ai-ki̍p -ông ê bīn-chêng kiâⁿ che it-chhè ê kî-sū; m̄-kú Siōng Chú hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim ngī, m̄ pàng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui i ê tōe.
Siōng Chú tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe tùi Mô͘-se kap A-lûn kóng,
“Lín tio̍h ēng chit kò-ge̍h chòe lín ê chiaⁿ--ge̍h, chòe ta̍k-nî ê thâu chi̍t kò-ge̍h.
Lín tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê choân-thé hōe-chiòng kóng, ‘Chit kò-ge̍h chhoe-cha̍p, ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h chiàu ka-têng chún-pī iûⁿ-á, chi̍t ke chi̍t chiah.
Nā chhù--ni̍h ê lâng chió, chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-á chia̍h bōe liáu, tio̍h kap keh-piah chhù-piⁿ chòe-hé chún-pī; chiàu jîn-sò͘, chiàu ta̍k-ê lâng chia̍h ê hūn-liōng chún-pī.
Lín tio̍h tùi mî-iûⁿ á-sī soaⁿ-iûⁿ soán chi̍t chiah chi̍t hè, bô khoat-tiám ê kang ê iûⁿ.
Lín tio̍h kā iûⁿ-á lâu kàu pún-ge̍h cha̍p-sì; tī hông-hun ê sî, Í-sek-lia̍t choân-thé hōe-chiòng tio̍h thâi iûⁿ-á.
In tio̍h the̍h chi̍t-kóa huih, boah tī in chia̍h iûⁿ-á hit-keng chhù siang-pêng ê mn̂g-khiā kap mn̂g-bâi.
Hit-àm tio̍h chia̍h iûⁿ-á ê bah; bah ēng hé hang, kap bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ, khó͘-chhài chòe-hé chia̍h.
Bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h chhiⁿ--ê kap ēng chúi chú--ê; bah tio̍h kap thâu, kha, pak-lāi chòe-hé hang lâi chia̍h.
Chiah-ê lóng m̄-thang lâu kàu keh-chá-khí; nā lâu kàu keh-chá-khí, tio̍h ēng hé sio-tiāu.
Lín chia̍h ê sî, io tio̍h hâ--teh, ôe tio̍h chhēng--teh, chhiú tio̍h gia̍h koáiⁿ-á, mā tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín chia̍h. Che sī Siōng Chú ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.
“‘Hit-mî, góa beh kiâⁿ-thàu Ai-ki̍p -tōe, phah-sí só͘-ū ê thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ--ê, bô-lūn sī lâng á-sī cheng-siⁿ; koh beh sím-phòaⁿ Ai-ki̍p só͘-ū ê sîn-bêng. Góa sī Siōng Chú.

Lín nā ū tī lín ê chhù boah-huih chòe kì-hō; góa chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê huih, chiū ōe tùi lín hia pôaⁿ--kè-khì; góa phah Ai-ki̍p -tōe ê sî, húi-bia̍t ê chai-lān bōe lîm-kàu lín.’”
Lín tio̍h ōe-kì-tit chit-ji̍t sī Siōng Chú ê choeh-ji̍t, tāi-tāi siú chit-ê choeh-ji̍t chòe éng-oán ê kui-lē.

Lín tio̍h chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ chhit ji̍t; thâu chi̍t ji̍t tio̍h tùi chhù-lāi chiong kàⁿ-bú chheng chheng-khì. Tùi thâu chi̍t ji̍t kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, só͘-ū chia̍h ū-kàⁿ ê mi̍h ê lâng, lóng tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan kek-chhut.
Thâu chi̍t ji̍t kap tē-chhit ji̍t, lín tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe; chit nn̄g ji̍t, chún-pī chia̍h ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ í-gōa, kî-tha ê kang-chok lín lóng bōe-ēng-tit chòe.
Lín tio̍h siú Tû-kàⁿ-choeh, in-ūi tī chit-ji̍t góa chhōa lín ê kun-tūi tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhut--lâi; só͘-í lín tio̍h siú chit-ji̍t chòe sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.
Tùi chiaⁿ-ge̍h cha̍p-sì ē-hng kàu jī-it ē-hng, lín tio̍h chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ.

Chit chhit ji̍t lāi, lín ta̍k-ê lâng ê chhù-lāi bōe-ēng-tit ū kàⁿ; chia̍h ū-kàⁿ ê mi̍h ê lâng, bô-lūn sī lín ê tông-pau á-sī gōa-cho̍k-lâng, lóng tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng ê tiong-kan kek-chhut.
Ū-kàⁿ ê mi̍h, lín lóng bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h; tī chit-ê choeh-kî lāi, lín bô-lūn tòa tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, tio̍h chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ.
Mô͘-se tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t só͘-ū ê tiúⁿ-ló, tùi in kóng, “Lín tio̍h ūi lín ê ka-cho̍k kéng iûⁿ-á, thâi lâi kè Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.
Tio̍h the̍h chi̍t pé gû-chhek-chháu, ùn phûn-lāi ê huih, boah mn̂g-bâi kap siang-pêng ê mn̂g-khiā; thiⁿ-kng í-chêng, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng lóng m̄-thang chhut-mn̂g.

Siōng Chú beh kiâⁿ-thàu choân-kok, phah-sí Ai-ki̍p -lâng; I khòaⁿ-tio̍h mn̂g-bâi kap siang-pêng mn̂g-khiā ê huih, chiū ōe pôaⁿ-kè hit-ê mn̂g, put-chún húi-bia̍t-chiá ji̍p lín ê chhù kā lín phah--sí.
Lín tio̍h chun-siú chit-ê kui-tēng, chòe lín kap lín ê hō͘-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.
Chiong-lâi lín chìn-ji̍p Siōng Chú só͘ èng-ún beh sù hō͘ lín hit-ê tōe, lín tio̍h chun-siú chit-ê kui-lē.
Lín ê kiáⁿ-jî nā mn̄g lín, ‘Sī-án-chóaⁿ beh siú chit-ê kui-lē?’

Lín tio̍h kóng, ‘Che sī hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê chè-mi̍h. Siōng Chú phah-sí Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê sî, I pôaⁿ-kè tòa tī Ai-ki̍p ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chhù, kái-kiù lán ta̍k-ê ka-cho̍k.’” Jîn-bîn chiū phak tī thô͘-kha kèng-pài Siōng Chú.
Jiân-āu, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui, chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kap A-lûn ê bēng-lēng khì chòe.

Tī pòaⁿ-mî, Siōng Chú thâi-sí Ai-ki̍p -tōe só͘-ū thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ--ê; tùi chē ông-ūi ê Ai-ki̍p -ông ê tōa-kiáⁿ kàu koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ-ga̍k ê hoān-lâng ê tōa-kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p cheng-siⁿ ê thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ--ê, lóng siū thâi-sí.
Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i só͘-ū ê jîn-sîn, í-ki̍p choân-pō͘ ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng, lóng tī pòaⁿ-mî khí--lâi; tī Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe ū tōa thî-khàu ê siaⁿ, in-ūi bô chi̍t ke bô sí-lâng.

Ai-ki̍p -ông pòaⁿ-mî tiàu Mô͘-se, A-lûn lâi, kóng, “Chhut--khì! Lín kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tio̍h lī-khui góa ê jîn-bîn chhut-chhut--khì! Chiàu lín só͘ kóng--ê, khì kèng-pài Siōng Chú;
mā chiàu lín ê iau-kiû, liân gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn lóng tòa-tòa--khì. M̄-kú lín tio̍h kā góa chiok-hok.”
Ai-ki̍p -lâng kóaⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín lī-khui, kóng, “Goán lóng teh-beh sí lah.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū the̍h iáu-bē khǹg kàⁿ ê mī-oân, hē tī chhiau mī-hún ê khì-khū lāi, ēng saⁿ pau--khí-lâi, khǹg tī keng-thâu téng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàu Mô͘-se ê ōe, tùi Ai-ki̍p -lâng thó kim-khì, gûn-khì, kap i-ho̍k.
Siōng Chú hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tit-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p -lâng hó ê tùi-thāi, in iau-kiû sím-mi̍h, Ai-ki̍p -lâng lóng hō͘ in. Án-ni, in chiū chhiúⁿ-toa̍t Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê châi-bu̍t.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui Lân-sài, ǹg So͘-kat chhut-hoat, gín-á hū-jîn-lâng bô sǹg, kiâⁿ-lō͘ ê chòng-teng tāi-iok ū la̍k-cha̍p-bān.
Koh ū chin chōe hūn-cha̍p ê kûn-chiòng, í-ki̍p gû-kûn, iûⁿ-kûn, chin chōe cheng-siⁿ kap in chòe-hé chhut--khì.
In ēng tùi Ai-ki̍p tòa--chhut-lâi bô hoat-kàⁿ ê mī-oân hang chòe piáⁿ, in-ūi in siū kóaⁿ lī-khui Ai-ki̍p, chin kín-kip, bōe-tàng ūi ka-kī chún-pī chia̍h-mi̍h.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa tī Ai-ki̍p sì-pah saⁿ-cha̍p nî kú.
Sì-pah saⁿ-cha̍p nî chi̍t-ē móa, tú-tú hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú chhōa I ê kun-tūi tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhut--lâi.
Chit-mî Siōng Chú kui-mî kò͘-siú in, chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tio̍h sè-sè-tāi-tāi tī chit-mî ǹg Siōng Chú siú-iā.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se, A-lûn kóng, “Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê kui-lē sī án-ni: Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê chia̍h-mi̍h, gōa-cho̍k-lâng lóng m̄-thang chia̍h,
m̄-kú ēng gûn bóe--lâi ê lô͘-lē, nā ū siū kat-lé chiū thang chia̍h;
kià-ku--ê kap chhiàⁿ--lâi ê kang-lâng lóng m̄-thang chia̍h.
Tio̍h tī chhù-lāi chia̍h, liân chi̍t tè to m̄-thang the̍h chhut-khì gōa-bīn; iûⁿ-á ê kut liân chi̍t ki to m̄-thang kòng-tn̄g.
Í-sek-lia̍t só͘-ū ê hōe-chiòng lóng tio̍h án-ni siú-choeh.

Nā ū kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, ài-beh siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh kèng-pài Siōng Chú, in ke-lāi ê ta-po͘-lâng tio̍h siū kat-lé, chiah thang kap pún-cho̍k ê lâng kâng-khoán siú-choeh; m̄-kú bô siū kat-lé ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng lóng bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h.
Pún-cho̍k-lâng kap kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, siâng-khoán lóng tio̍h siú chit-ê kui-lē.”
Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chiū chiàu Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se, A-lûn ê ōe khì chòe.
Chiū tī hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chi̍t-tūi chi̍t-tūi chhut Ai-ki̍p.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tio̍h chiong thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê lâng kap cheng-siⁿ, lóng hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng kui hō͘ góa; in-ūi in sī góa ê.”

Mô͘-se tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Lín tio̍h ōe-kì-tit chit-ji̍t, in-ūi Siōng Chú tī chit-ji̍t ēng tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú kā lín tùi Ai-ki̍p chòe lô͘-châi ê ke chhōa--chhut-lâi; ū-kàⁿ ê piáⁿ lóng m̄-thang chia̍h.
Lín tī A-pit-ge̍h ê chit-ji̍t lī-khui Ai-ki̍p.

Chiong-lâi Siōng Chú ōe chhōa lín chìn-ji̍p Ka-lâm -lâng, Hek -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng khiā-khí ê tōe, chit-ê tōe sī I tùi lín ê chó͘-sian li̍p-sè beh siúⁿ-sù hō͘ lín lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe, hit-sî lín tio̍h tī ta̍k-nî ê chit kò-ge̍h chun-siú ē-bīn chit-ê kui-lē:
Tio̍h chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ chhit ji̍t; tē-chhit ji̍t sī kèng-pài Siōng Chú ê choeh-ji̍t.
Chit chhit ji̍t lín tio̍h chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ; tī lín kéng-lāi bōe-ēng-tit ū kàⁿ-bú kap ū-kàⁿ ê piáⁿ.
Tī chit-ji̍t, lín tio̍h kà-sī lín ê kiáⁿ, kóng, ‘Che sī beh kì-liām Siōng Chú tī góa chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî, ūi-tio̍h góa só͘ chòe ê sū.’

Lín tio̍h tī lín ê chhiú kap thâu-hia̍h chòe kì-hō, hō͘ lín siông-siông àm-liām Siōng Chú ê lu̍t-hoat; in-ūi Siōng Chú ū ēng tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p.
Só͘-í, ta̍k-nî chit-ji̍t nā kàu, lín tio̍h siú chit-ê kui-lē.”
“Siōng Chú chhōa lín chìn-ji̍p I tùi lín kap lín ê chó͘-sian li̍p-sè, beh siúⁿ-sù hō͘ lín ê Ka-lâm -tōe,
hit-sî, lín tio̍h chiong tōa-kiáⁿ kap só͘-ū thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ kang ê cheng-siⁿ hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; in-ūi chiah-ê lóng sio̍k Siōng Chú.
Thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê lû-á, tio̍h hiàn iûⁿ-á sio̍k-hôe; nā bô beh sio̍k-hôe, chiū tio̍h kòng-tn̄g lû-á ê ām-kún; m̄-kú lín ê tōa-kiáⁿ lóng tio̍h sio̍k-hôe.

Í-āu lín ê kiáⁿ nā mn̄g lín kóng, ‘Sī-án-chóaⁿ beh án-ni chòe?’ Lín tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Siōng Chú ēng tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú chhōa goán tùi Ai-ki̍p chòe lô͘-châi ê ke chhut--lâi.

Hit-sî Ai-ki̍p -ông kò͘-chip m̄ pàng goán lī-khui, Siōng Chú chiū chiong Ai-ki̍p só͘-ū lâng ê tōa-kiáⁿ kap cheng-siⁿ ê thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ--ê, lóng thâi-sí; só͘-í, góa chiong thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ kang ê cheng-siⁿ hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; chiong tōa-kiáⁿ sio̍k-hôe.
Lí tio̍h tī lí ê chhiú kap thâu-hia̍h chòe kì-hō, kì-liām Siōng Chú ēng tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú chhōa goán chhut Ai-ki̍p.’”

Ai-ki̍p -ông pàng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui ê sî, Siōng-tè bô chhōa in kiâⁿ hit-tiâu keng-kè Hui-lī-sū -tōe khah-kūn ê lō͘; in-ūi Siōng-tè kóng, “Kiaⁿ-liáu chiah-ê jîn-bîn tú-tio̍h chiàn-cheng, chiū hō͘-hóe koh tò-tńg-khì Ai-ki̍p.”
Só͘-í Siōng-tè chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng oat tùi Âng-hái khòng-iá hit-tiâu lō͘; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng bú-chong, tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhut--khì.

Mô͘-se tòa Iok-sek ê kut-hâi lī-khui, in-ūi Iok-sek ū kiò Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiù tāng-chōa, tùi in kóng, “Siōng-tè it-tēng ōe chiàu-kò͘ lín, lín tio̍h tòa góa ê kut-hâi chòe-hé tò--khì.”
In tùi So͘-kat chhut-hoat, tī khòng-iá ê pian-kài Í-thóng chat-iâⁿ.
Siōng Chú kiâⁿ tī in ê thâu-chêng, ji̍t--sî ēng hûn-thiāu kā in chhōa-lō͘, mî--sî ēng hé-thiāu kā in chiò-kng, hō͘ in ji̍t--sî mî--sî lóng ōe-tàng kiâⁿ-lō͘.
Ji̍t--sî ê hûn-thiāu, mî--sî ê hé-thiāu, lóng bô lī-khui Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng oa̍t tò-tńg, tī Bi̍t-toa̍t kap hái tiong-kan ê Pí Hap-hi-lio̍k thâu-chêng, Pa-le̍k Sé-hun tùi-bīn ê hái-piⁿ chat-iâⁿ.
Ai-ki̍p -ông ōe siūⁿ-kóng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bê-lō͘, kiâⁿ bōe chhut khòng-iá.

Góa beh hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim ngī, tui-jip lín; m̄-kú góa beh phah-pāi Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i ê choân-kun, hián-chhut góa ê êng-kng. Án-ni, Ai-ki̍p -lâng chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.” Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū chiàu án-ni chòe.

Ū lâng lâi kā Ai-ki̍p -ông pò-kò, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tô-cháu lah!” Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i ê jîn-sîn chiū kái-piàn sim-ì, kóng, “Lán ná ōe chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì? Sī-án-chóaⁿ beh pàng hit-ê bîn-cho̍k lī-khui bô koh ho̍k-sāi lán?”
Ai-ki̍p -ông chiū chún-pī chiàn-chhia, chhōa i ê kun-peng chòe-hé khì;
i chhōa Ai-ki̍p só͘-ū ê chiàn-chhia, pau-koat la̍k-pah tâi te̍k-soán ê chiàn-chhia chhut--khì, ta̍k-tâi chhia lóng ū chiàn-chhia-tiúⁿ.
Siōng Chú hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông ê sim ngī, tui-jip Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ióng-kám tōa-táⁿ lī-khui ê sî,

Ai-ki̍p -lâng tui-jip in; Ai-ki̍p -ông só͘-ū ê chiàn-bé, chiàn-chhia, bé-peng, kap kun-tūi, tī Pí Hap-hi-lio̍k thâu-chêng, Pa-le̍k Sé-hun tùi-bīn ê hái-piⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chat-iâⁿ ê só͘-chāi, jip-tio̍h in.
Ai-ki̍p -ông óa-kūn ê sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p -lâng jip óa--lâi, chiū chin kiaⁿ, ai-kiû Siōng Chú.
In kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Sī Ai-ki̍p bô bōng-tōe, lí chiah chhōa goán chhut-lâi sí tī khòng-iá sī--bô? Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ án-ni tùi-thāi goán, chhōa goán chhut Ai-ki̍p?
Goán tī Ai-ki̍p kiám bô kā lí kóng ‘Mài chhap--goán, chhut-chāi goán ho̍k-sāi Ai-ki̍p -lâng’? Goán lêng-khó ho̍k-sāi Ai-ki̍p -lâng, pí sí tī khòng-iá khah hó.”

Mô͘-se kā jîn-bîn kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ, khiā hō͘ chāi, khòaⁿ Siōng Chú kin-á-ji̍t án-chóaⁿ kái-kiù lín. Lín kin-á-ji̍t khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng, it-tēng éng-oán bōe koh khòaⁿ--tio̍h.
Siōng Chú beh ūi lín kau-chiàn; lín tio̍h an-chēng.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ tùi góa âu-kiò? Tio̍h kiò Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hiòng-chêng kiâⁿ.
Lí gia̍h koáiⁿ-á chhun-chhiú kí hái, kā hái pun-khui; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ōe tī hái-tiong kiâⁿ ta-tōe.
Góa beh hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê sim ngī, in beh tè lín lo̍h--khì; góa beh phah-pāi Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i ê choân-kun, chiàn-chhia, bé-peng, hián-chhut góa ê êng-iāu.
Góa phah-pāi Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i ê chiàn-chhia, bé-peng, tit-tio̍h êng-iāu ê sî, Ai-ki̍p -lâng chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá pún-lâi kiâⁿ tī Í-sek-lia̍t tāi-tūi ê thâu-chêng, hit-sî sóa-khì in āu-bīn, hûn-thiāu mā tùi in ê thâu-chêng sóa-khì āu-bīn,
lâi tī Ai-ki̍p iâⁿ kap Í-sek-lia̍t iâⁿ ê tiong-kan; Ai-ki̍p iâⁿ hō͘ hûn tà--teh pìⁿ-chòe o͘-àm, m̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t iâⁿ mî--sî ū kng; nn̄g pêng kui-mî bōe-tàng chiap-kūn.
Mô͘-se chhun-chhiú kí hái, Siōng Chú hō͘ chin kiông ê tang-hong chhe kui-mî, hō͘ hái-chúi thè--khì, hái chiâⁿ-chòe ta-tōe, chúi pun-chòe nn̄g pêng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lo̍h hái-tiong kiâⁿ ta-tōe, chúi tī in ê siang-pêng chiâⁿ-chòe chhiûⁿ-piah.
Ai-ki̍p -lâng tui-jip in; Ai-ki̍p -ông só͘-ū ê chiàn-bé, chiàn-chhia, kap bé-peng lóng tè in lo̍h-khì hái-tiong.
Kàu thiⁿ beh kng ê sî, Siōng Chú tùi hûn-thiāu kap hé-thiāu tiong-kan àⁿ-lo̍h khòaⁿ Ai-ki̍p ê kun-tūi, phah-loān in ê tūi-ngó͘,
hō͘ in ê chiàn-chhia ê lián-á kā-tiâu--teh, kiâⁿ bōe khì; Ai-ki̍p -lâng chiū kóng, “Lán tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín cháu, lī-khui Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, Siōng Chú ūi-tio̍h in lâi phah lán.”
Siōng Chú kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí chhun-chhiú kí hái, hō͘ chúi tò-tńg-lâi im Ai-ki̍p -lâng, in ê chiàn-chhia, kap in ê bé-peng.”
Mô͘-se chiū chhun-chhiú kí hái; kàu thiⁿ chi̍t-ē kng, hái-chúi hôe-ho̍k goân-chōng. Ai-ki̍p -lâng tô-cháu, m̄-kú Siōng Chú chiong in chhia-lo̍h hái.
Hái-chúi lâu tò-tńg, kā chiàn-chhia kap bé-peng im-ba̍t; jip Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lo̍h-khì hái-tiong ê Ai-ki̍p -ông choân-kun, bô chi̍t ê oa̍h--teh.
Chóng-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī hái-tiong kiâⁿ ta-tōe, chúi tī in ê siang-pêng chiâⁿ-chòe chhiûⁿ-piah.
Hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú án-ni kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê chhiú; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p -lâng lóng sí tī hái-piⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú ēng tōa khùi-la̍t tùi-hù Ai-ki̍p -lâng só͘ chòe ê sū, chiū kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, koh sìn-ho̍k Siōng Chú kap I ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se.
Hit-sî, Mô͘-se kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ chit-siú si-koa: Góa beh tùi Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ-koa, in-ūi I tōa sèng-lī; I chiong chiàn-bé kap bé-peng chhia-lo̍h hái.

Siōng Chú sī góa ê khùi-la̍t, góa beh chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn, I kā góa kái-kiù. I sī góa ê Siōng-tè, góa beh chheng-chàn I; I sī góa lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, góa beh chun-chông I.
Siōng Chú sī chiàn-sū; Siōng Chú sī I ê chheng-ho͘.
Ai-ki̍p -ông ê chiàn-chhia kap kun-peng, Siōng Chú kā in hiat tī hái--ni̍h; Ai-ki̍p -ông te̍k-soán ê kun-koaⁿ, lóng tîm-lo̍h Âng-hái.
Tōa-éng thun-bia̍t in; in chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-thâu tîm kàu chhim ê só͘-chāi.
Siōng Chú, lí ê chiàⁿ-chhiú ū bô-pí ê koân-lêng; Siōng Chú, lí ê chiàⁿ-chhiú phah-chhùi tùi-te̍k.
Lí hoat-chhut tōa ui-le̍k, chhia-tó hiah-ê khí-lâi kong-kek lí--ê; lí hoat-chhut tōa siū-khì, sio-húi in chhin-chhiūⁿ sio be̍h-kó.
Lí phīⁿ-khang ê khì hō͘ chúi chhèng-koân, hō͘ tōa-chúi thia̍p kui-tui; hái chin chhim ê chúi kian-tàng.
Tùi-te̍k kóng, “Góa beh tui in, beh jip-tio̍h in; góa beh pun chiàn-lī-phín lâi chiok góa ê sim-goān; góa beh pu̍ih to kā in siau-bia̍t.”
Lí chi̍t-ē pûn-hong, hái-chúi chiū kā in im-sí; in chhin-chhiūⁿ iân tîm-lo̍h tōa-chúi.
Siōng Chú ah, chèng sîn-bêng tó chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kap lí pí? Tó chi̍t ê chhin-chhiūⁿ lí sîn-sèng ui-giâm, thang kiaⁿ-ùi, siū chheng-chàn, kiâⁿ kî-sū?
Lí chhun-chhut chiàⁿ-chhiú, tōe chiū kā in thun-bia̍t.
Lí ēng chû-ài chhōa lí kiù-sio̍k ê chú-bîn; lí ēng koân-lêng chhōa in chìn-ji̍p lí sèng ê só͘-chāi.
Lia̍t-pang thiaⁿ--kìⁿ chiū ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah; tòa tī Hui-lī-sū -tōe--ê hō͘ thòng-khó͘ pau-ûi.
Hit-sî, Í-tong ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; Mô͘-ap ê eng-hiông phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah; tòa tī Ka-lâm -tōe--ê kiaⁿ kah phòa-táⁿ.

Gông-ngia̍h kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ pau-ûi in; Siōng Chú, in-ūi lí ê tōa koân-lêng, in chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-thâu bōe tín-tāng, thèng-hāu lí ê chú-bîn keng-kè, thèng-hāu lí sio̍k-hôe ê chú-bîn kè--khì.

Lí beh chhōa in ji̍p-khì lí sán-gia̍p ê soaⁿ, kā in chai-pôe; Siōng Chú, hia sī lí ūi ka-kī chún-pī beh khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, Chú ah, chiū-sī lí ê chhiú só͘ kiàn-li̍p ê sèng-só͘.
Siōng Chú beh choh-ông, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.

Ai-ki̍p -ông ê chiàn-bé, chiàn-chhia, kap bé-peng poa̍h-lo̍h hái ê sî, Siōng Chú hō͘ hái-chúi hôe-ho̍k goân-chōng kā in im-ba̍t; m̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī hái-tiong kiâⁿ ta-tōe.
A-lûn ê tōa-chí, lú sian-ti Bí-lī-an, chhiú the̍h lin-long-kó͘; chèng hū-lú mā the̍h lin-long-kó͘, tè i ná phah-kó͘ ná thiàu-bú.
Bí-lī-an hôe-èng, chhiùⁿ kóng: Lín tio̍h chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, in-ūi I tōa sèng-lī; I chiong chiàn-bé kap bé-peng chhia-lo̍h hái.
Mô͘-se chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Âng-hái hiòng-chêng kiâⁿ, kàu Su-ní ê khòng-iá; in tī khòng-iá kiâⁿ saⁿ ji̍t, chhē bô chúi.
Kàu Má-la ê sî, Má-la ê chúi ōe khó͘, bōe-lim--tit; in kā hit-ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Má-la.
Jîn-bîn bâi-oàn Mô͘-se, kóng, “Goán beh lim siáⁿ?”

Mô͘-se chiū kiû-kiò Siōng Chú. Siōng Chú chí-sī i chi̍t châng chhiū-á, i chiong hit-châng chhiū-á hiat tī chúi--ni̍h, chúi chiū pìⁿ kam. Siōng Chú tī hia ūi-tio̍h in tēng kui-lē kap bēng-lēng, tī hia kā in khó-giām.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Lín nā chù-ì thiaⁿ góa Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe chèng-ti̍t ê sū, chin-chiàⁿ thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê kài-bēng, chun-siú góa só͘-ū ê kui-lē, góa chiū bōe hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -lâng tì--tio̍h ê pīⁿ tī lín ê sin-chiūⁿ hoat-seng, in-ūi góa sī i-tī lín ê Siōng Chú.”
In kàu Í-lîm, tī hia ū cha̍p-jī ê chúi-chôaⁿ, chhit-cha̍p châng ê chang-chhiū; in chiū tī hia ê chúi-piⁿ chat-iâⁿ.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng choân-thé hōe-chiòng tùi Í-lîm chhut-hoat, tī lī-khui Ai-ki̍p liáu-āu tē-jī kò-ge̍h ê cha̍p-gō͘ ji̍t, lâi kàu Í-lîm kap Se-nāi tiong-kan ê Sìn ê khòng-iá.
In tī hia bâi-oàn Mô͘-se, A-lûn.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kā in kóng, “Goán lêng-khó tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe sí tī Siōng Chú ê chhiú-thâu. Hit-sî, goán ū kui-tiáⁿ ê bah, ū piáⁿ thang chia̍h kàu pá. Lín kā goán chhōa-lâi kàu chit-ê khòng-iá, sī beh hō͘ goán só͘-ū ê hōe-chiòng lóng gō-sí sī--bô!”

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa beh tùi thiⁿ lo̍h bí-niû hō͘ lín. In ta̍k-ê lâng ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h chhut-khì khioh hit chi̍t ji̍t ê hūn; góa beh án-ni chhì-giām in, khòaⁿ in ū beh chun-hêng góa ê bēng-lēng á bô.
Kàu tē-la̍k ji̍t, in tio̍h chún-pī nn̄g ji̍t ê chia̍h-mi̍h, khioh pêng-sî ê têng-pē.”
Mô͘-se, A-lûn tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng kóng, “Kim-mî lín chiū ōe chai, chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe--ê sī Siōng Chú.
Bîn-á-chá-khí lín ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê êng-iāu, in-ūi Siōng Chú ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín tùi I ê oàn-giân. Goán sǹg sím-mi̍h, lín kèng-jiân bâi-oàn goán!”

Mô͘-se koh kóng, “Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ lín àm-sî ū bah thang chia̍h, chá-khí-sî ū bí-niû thang chia̍h kàu pá; in-ūi lín tùi Siōng Chú ê oàn-giân, I lóng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h. Goán sǹg siáⁿ; lín m̄-sī bâi-oàn goán, sī teh bâi-oàn Siōng Chú.”
Mô͘-se kā A-lûn kóng, “Lí tio̍h kiò Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng choân-thé hōe-chiòng lâi kàu Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, in-ūi I í-keng thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê oàn-giân.”
A-lûn tú-teh tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng choân-thé hōe-chiòng kóng-ōe ê sî, in khòaⁿ-kìⁿ khòng-iá ū Siōng Chú ê êng-kng tī hûn-tiong hián-hiān.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,

“Góa í-keng thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê oàn-giân; lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Kàu hông-hun, lín beh ū bah thang chia̍h, chá-khí-sî ū bí-niû thang chia̍h kàu pá, án-ni lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.’”
Àm-thâu-á, ū ian-chhun pe--lâi, khàm-móa kui-ê iâⁿ-tōe; thàu-chá, iâⁿ-tōe sì-ûi ū chi̍t têng lō͘-chúi.
Lō͘-chúi ta--khì, in khòaⁿ-tio̍h khòng-iá ê tōe-bīn ū sòe-sòe îⁿ-îⁿ ê mi̍h, iù-iù chhin-chhiūⁿ sng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h, m̄ chai sī sím-mi̍h, hō͘-siōng kóng-lâi-kóng-khì, “Che sī sím-mi̍h?” Mô͘-se kā in kóng, “Che chiū-sī Siōng Chú hō͘ lín chia̍h ê bí-niû.
Siōng Chú án-ni hoan-hù: Lín tio̍h khioh ta̍k-ê lâng ōe-tàng chia̍h ê hūn-liōng, chi̍t ê lâng nn̄g kong-seng, chiàu ke-lāi ê jîn-sò͘ khì khioh.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàu án-ni khì chòe, ū-ê khioh chōe, ū-ê khioh chió.
Kàu ēng khì-khū niû ê sî, khioh chōe--ê bô chhun, khioh chió--ê mā bô khiàm; ta̍k-ê lâng lóng chiàu in chia̍h ê hūn-liōng khì khioh.
Mô͘-se kā in kóng, “M̄-thang chiong chhun--ê lâu kàu keh-chá-khí.”
M̄-kú ū lâng m̄ thiaⁿ Mô͘-se ê ōe, chiong chhun--ê lâu kàu keh-chá-khí, chiū siⁿ-thâng chhàu--khì; Mô͘-se chiū tùi in hoat siū-khì.
In ta̍k chá-khí chiàu ta̍k-ê lâng chia̍h ê hūn-liōng khì khioh; ji̍t-thâu chi̍t-ē chhut, hiah-ê niû-si̍t chiū iûⁿ--khì.
Kàu tē-la̍k ji̍t, in khioh têng-pē ê hūn, ta̍k-ê lâng sì kong-seng; choân hōe-chiòng ê léng-siù chiong chit-hāng sū kā Mô͘-se pò-kò.

Mô͘-se kā in kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Bîn-á-chài sī an-hioh ê ji̍t-chí, sī Siōng Chú sèng ê An-hioh-ji̍t; lín ài hang--ê kin-á-ji̍t chiū seng hang--khí-lâi, ài chú--ê chiū kin-á-ji̍t chú--khí-lâi; chhun--ê, tio̍h siu--teh, lâu kàu keh-chá-khí.’”
In chiū chiàu Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù kā chhun ê chia̍h-mi̍h lâu kàu keh-chá-khí; chiah-ê chia̍h-mi̍h bô chhàu--khì, mā bô siⁿ-thâng.
Mô͘-se koh kóng, “Lín kin-á-ji̍t chiū chia̍h chiah-ê, in-ūi kin-á-ji̍t sī Siōng Chú ê An-hioh-ji̍t; kin-á-ji̍t lín tī iá-tōe chhē bô bí-niû.
La̍k ji̍t, lín thang khì khioh, tē-chhit ji̍t sī An-hioh-ji̍t, chit-ji̍t lín bô chia̍h-mi̍h thang khioh.”
Tē-chhit ji̍t, ū lâng chhut-khì khioh, chhē lóng bô.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lín m̄-khéng chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng kap kà-sī, beh kàu tī-sî?

Lín tio̍h chai, Siōng Chú í-keng chiong An-hioh-ji̍t sù hō͘ lín, só͘-í tē-la̍k ji̍t I hō͘ lín nn̄g ji̍t ê bí-niû, tē-chhit ji̍t ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h tiàm tī ka-kī ê só͘-chāi, m̄-thang chhut--khì.”
Jîn-bîn chiū tī tē-chhit ji̍t an-hioh.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiong chit-ê mi̍h kiò-chòe má-ná; i chhin-chhiūⁿ iân-sui ê chí, sek-tì sī pe̍h--ê, chu-bī chhin-chhiūⁿ chham-bi̍t ê po̍h-piáⁿ.

Mô͘-se kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni hoan-hù, ‘Tio̍h tóe nn̄g kong-seng tīⁿ-tīⁿ ê má-ná, lâu hō͘ lín ê hō͘-tāi. Hō͘ in khòaⁿ góa chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî tī khòng-iá hō͘ lín chia̍h ê bí-niû.’”
Mô͘-se kā A-lûn kóng, “Lí the̍h chi̍t ê àng-á, tóe nn̄g kong-seng tīⁿ-tīⁿ ê má-ná, khǹg tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, lâu hō͘ lán ê hō͘-tāi.”
A-lûn chiàu Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se ê ōe, chiong má-ná lâu-teh chòe kiàn-chèng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chia̍h má-ná lóng-chóng sì-cha̍p nî kú, it-ti̍t kàu in lâi tī ū lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi. In chia̍h má-ná, ti̍t-kàu in lâi kàu Ka-lâm -tōe ê pian-kài.
Tng-sî niû mi̍h-kiāⁿ phiau-chún ê tan-ūi sī jī-cha̍p kong-seng.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng choân-thé hōe-chiòng sūn-thàn Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, tùi Sìn ê khòng-iá chi̍t-chām chi̍t-chām hiòng-chêng kiâⁿ. In tī Lī-hui-tèng chat-iâⁿ, tī hia bô chúi thang lim.
Jîn-bîn kā Mô͘-se chhá, “Hō͘ goán chúi lim!” Mô͘-se kā in kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ teh kā góa chhá, sī-án-chóaⁿ teh chhì-thàm Siōng Chú?”

Jîn-bîn tī hia chin chhùi-ta, ài-beh lim-chúi, chiū bâi-oàn Mô͘-se, kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ chhōa goán tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut--lâi, sī beh hō͘ goán kap goán ê kiáⁿ-jî, cheng-siⁿ lóng chhùi-ta--sí sī--bô?”
Mô͘-se chiū kiû-kiò Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi chiah-ê jîn-bîn? In chha-put-to beh ēng chio̍h-thâu kā góa tìm-sí lah.”
Siōng Chú kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t kúi ê tiúⁿ-ló, kiâⁿ-khì jîn-bîn ê thâu-chêng; lí ê chhiú tio̍h gia̍h chìn-chêng phah Nî-lô-hô ê koáiⁿ-á.

Lí khì, góa beh tī Hô-lia̍t ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ hia khiā tī lí ê bīn-chêng. Lí phah hit-ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ, chúi ōe tùi hia lâu--chhut-lâi, hō͘ jîn-bîn lim.” Mô͘-se chiū tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiúⁿ-ló ê bīn-chêng án-ni chòe.
I kā hit-ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Má-sat, mā kiò-chòe Bí-lī-pa; in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kā i chhá, koh chhì-thàm Siōng Chú, kóng, “Siōng Chú kiám ū tī goán tiong-kan?”
A-má-le̍k -lâng lâi Lī-hui-tèng kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Mô͘-se kā Iok-su-a kóng, “Lí tio̍h soán lâng khì kap A-má-le̍k -lâng kau-chiàn. Bîn-á-chài góa beh gia̍h Siōng-tè ê koáiⁿ-á, khiā tī soaⁿ-téng.”
Iok-su-a chiū chiàu Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng khì kap A-má-le̍k -lâng kau-chiàn; Mô͘-se, A-lûn, kap Hō͘-ní lóng peh-chiūⁿ soaⁿ-téng.
Mô͘-se chhiú gia̍h--khí-lâi ê sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū thâi-iâⁿ; chhiú sûi--lo̍h-khì ê sî, A-má-le̍k -lâng chiū thâi-iâⁿ.

M̄-kú Mô͘-se chhiú sng, A-lûn kap Hō͘-ní chiū sóa chio̍h-thâu lâi hē tī i ê ē-bīn, hō͘ i chē--teh; in hû i ê chhiú, chi̍t ê tī chiàⁿ-pêng, chi̍t ê tī tò-pêng; i ê chhiú chiū bô sûi--lo̍h-lâi, it-ti̍t kàu ji̍t lo̍h.
Iok-su-a ēng to thâi-iâⁿ A-má-le̍k -lâng.

Siōng Chú kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa beh chiong A-má-le̍k ê miâ tùi thiⁿ-ē oân-choân chhat-siau. Lí tio̍h chiong chit-ê sū kì-lio̍k tī chheh--ni̍h thang thê-chhíⁿ hō͘-tāi, koh tha̍k hō͘ Iok-su-a thiaⁿ.”
Mô͘-se khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe “Siōng Chú Nî-se”;
koh kóng, “Tio̍h gia̍h Siōng Chú ê kun-kî! Siōng Chú beh tāi-tāi kap A-má-le̍k -lâng kau-chiàn.”

Mô͘-se ê tiūⁿ-lâng Bí-tiân ê chè-si Ia̍p-te̍k-lô, thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h Mô͘-se kap I ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ chòe ê sū, chiū-sī Siōng Chú chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sū.
Ia̍p-te̍k-lô chhōa Mô͘-se ê hū-jîn-lâng Se-pho-la lâi; Mô͘-se í-chêng bat sàng i tò-khì āu-thâu-chhù.
Ia̍p-te̍k-lô mā chhōa Mô͘-se nn̄g ê kiáⁿ lâi, chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Kek-sūn, in-ūi Mô͘-se kóng “Góa kià-ku tī gōa-pang”;
chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Í-lī-í-siā, in-ūi Mô͘-se kóng “Góa ê chó͘-sian ê Siōng-tè pang-chān góa, kiù góa bián sí tī Ai-ki̍p -ông ê to-ē”.
Mô͘-se ê tiūⁿ-lâng Ia̍p-te̍k-lô chhōa Mô͘-se nn̄g ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hū-jîn-lâng lâi kàu Siōng-tè ê soaⁿ, Mô͘-se tī khòng-iá chat-iâⁿ ê só͘-chāi.
I chhiáⁿ lâng khì kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa sī lí ê tiūⁿ-lâng Ia̍p-te̍k-lô, chhōa lí ê hū-jîn-lâng kap nn̄g ê kiáⁿ lâi lí chia.”
Mô͘-se chhut-khì gêng-chiap i ê tiūⁿ-lâng, phak lo̍h-khì pài i, kā i chim; in hō͘-siōng chhéng-an, ji̍p-khì pò͘-pîⁿ.

Mô͘-se chiong Siōng Chú ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông kap Ai-ki̍p -lâng só͘ chòe lóng-chóng ê sū, í-ki̍p in tī lō͘-tiong só͘ tú-tio̍h it-chhè ê khùn-lân, kap Siōng Chú án-chóaⁿ kái-kiù in, lóng siông-sè kóng hō͘ i ê tiūⁿ-lâng thiaⁿ.
Ia̍p-te̍k-lô in-ūi Siōng Chú hó khoán-thāi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kiù in thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê chhiú, chiū chin hoaⁿ-hí.
Ia̍p-te̍k-lô kóng, “Siōng Chú eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! I ū kiù lín thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p -lâng kap Ai-ki̍p -ông ê chhiú.
Taⁿ, in-ūi Siōng Chú ū kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê ap-pek, góa chai Siōng Chú pí só͘-ū ê sîn-bêng koh-khah tōa.”

Mô͘-se ê tiūⁿ-lâng Ia̍p-te̍k-lô chiong sio-hòa-chè kap chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè; A-lûn kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló lóng lâi, kap Mô͘-se ê tiūⁿ-lâng tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng chòe-hé chia̍h.
Keh-ji̍t, Mô͘-se chē-teh chhú-lí jîn-bîn ê àn-kiāⁿ; jîn-bîn kui-ji̍t khiā tī Mô͘-se ê piⁿ--á.

Mô͘-se ê tiūⁿ-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h i tùi jîn-bîn án-ni chòe, chiū kóng, “Lí ná án-ni tùi-thāi jîn-bîn? Ná ōe ka-kī chi̍t ê chē-teh chhú-lí, hō͘ jîn-bîn tī lí ê piⁿ--á khiā kui-ji̍t?”
Mô͘-se tùi i ê tiūⁿ-lâng kóng, “Che sī in-ūi jîn-bîn lâi góa chia beh kiû-mn̄g Siōng-tè.
In ū àn-kiāⁿ lâi góa chia, góa chiū kā in phòaⁿ-koat, koh hō͘ in chai Siōng-tè ê kui-lē kap lu̍t-hoat.”
Mô͘-se ê tiūⁿ-lâng kā i kóng, “Lí án-ni chòe m̄ hó.
Lí kap lí ê jîn-bîn lóng ōe chin thiám. Chit-ê kang-chok siuⁿ tāng, lí ka-kī chi̍t ê chòe bōe khì.
Taⁿ lí tio̍h thiaⁿ góa ê ōe. Góa kā lí kiàn-gī, goān Siōng-tè kap lí tông-chāi. Lí tio̍h tāi-piáu jîn-bîn kàu Siōng-tè bīn-chêng, chiong àn-kiāⁿ chhéng-būn Siōng-tè;
koh tio̍h chiong kui-lē kap lu̍t-hoat kà-sī in, chí-sī in só͘ tio̍h kiâⁿ ê tō-lō͘, tio̍h chòe ê sū.

Put-kò, lí mā tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn tiong-kan kéng ū châi-lêng, kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, tiong-si̍t khó-khò, oàn-hūn put-gī-chi-châi ê lâng, siat-li̍p in chòe koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, ū-ê koán chi̍t-chheng lâng, ū-ê koán chi̍t-pah lâng, ū-ê koán gō͘-cha̍p lâng, ū-ê koán cha̍p ê lâng;

hō͘ in sûi-sî chhâi-koat jîn-bîn ê àn-kiāⁿ; sió ê àn-kiāⁿ in ka-kī chhâi-koat, tōa ê àn-kiāⁿ chiah sàng-lâi lí chia; án-ni, in ōe-tàng kā lí hun-tam, lí ê hū-tam chiū ōe khah khin.
Lí nā án-ni chòe, sū-si̍t Siōng-tè mā án-ni hoan-hù lí, lí chiū chih-chài ōe tiâu, chiah-ê jîn-bîn mā ōe-tàng an-sim tò-khì in tau.”
Mô͘-se thiaⁿ-liáu chiū chiàu i tiūⁿ-lâng ê ōe khì chòe.

Mô͘-se tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan kéng ū châi-lêng ê lâng, siat-li̍p in chòe koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, ū-ê koán chi̍t-chheng lâng, ū-ê koán chi̍t-pah lâng, ū-ê koán gō͘-cha̍p lâng, ū-ê koán cha̍p ê lâng.
In sûi-sî chhâi-koat jîn-bîn ê àn-kiāⁿ; sió ê àn-kiāⁿ in ka-kī chhâi-koat, khùn-lân--ê chiah sàng-khì Mô͘-se hia.
Āu-lâi Mô͘-se sàng i ê tiūⁿ-lâng chhut-hoat, Ia̍p-te̍k-lô chiū tò-khì i ê pún só͘-chāi.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe liáu-āu, tī tē-saⁿ kò-ge̍h ê chhoe-it lâi kàu Se-nāi ê khòng-iá.
In lī-khui Lī-hui-tèng lâi kàu Se-nāi ê khòng-iá, chiū tī hit-ê soaⁿ ê tùi-bīn chat-iâⁿ.
Mô͘-se chiūⁿ-soaⁿ tiâu-kìⁿ Siōng-tè. Siōng Chú tùi soaⁿ--ni̍h kiò Mô͘-se, kóng, “Lí tio̍h tùi Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘,
‘Góa tùi Ai-ki̍p -lâng só͘ chòe ê sū, lín lóng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h; mā chai góa án-chóaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu ēng si̍t chài lín, chhōa lín lâi kui tī góa.
Taⁿ, lín nā chhiat-si̍t thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe, chun-siú góa ê iok, chiū ōe tī lia̍t-kok tiong chiâⁿ-chòe góa ê chú-bîn. Choân-tōe lóng sī góa ê,
m̄-kú lín sī kui-sio̍k góa--ê, sī chè-si ê kok-tō͘, sèng-kiat ê kok-bîn. Lí tio̍h chiong chiah-ê ōe tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng.’”
Mô͘-se chiū khì tiàu-chi̍p jîn-bîn ê tiúⁿ-ló, chiong Siōng Chú bēng-lēng ê ōe lóng kā in kóng.
Jîn-bîn chôe-siaⁿ ìn kóng, “Siōng Chú só͘ kóng--ê goán lóng beh chun-thàn.” Mô͘-se chiū chiong jîn-bîn ê ōe hôe-ho̍k Siōng Chú.

Siōng Chú kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa beh tī ba̍t-hûn ê tiong-kan lâi lí chia, hō͘ jîn-bîn thiaⁿ-kìⁿ góa kap lí kóng-ōe, thang éng-oán sìn-jīm lí.” Mô͘-se chiong jîn-bîn ê ōe tùi Siōng Chú kóng,
Siōng Chú koh kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí khì jîn-bîn hia, hoan-hù in tī kin-á-ji̍t kap bîn-á-chài tio̍h kiat-chēng ka-kī, koh kiò in sóe-saⁿ,
chún-pī gêng-chiap tē-saⁿ ji̍t. Tē-saⁿ ji̍t, Siōng Chú beh tī só͘-ū jîn-bîn ê bīn-chêng, kàng-lîm tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ.

Lí tio̍h tī soaⁿ ê chiu-ûi kā jîn-bîn tēng kài-hān, kóng, ‘Lín tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang chiūⁿ-soaⁿ, mā m̄-thang chhim-hoān soaⁿ ê pian-kài; nā ū lâng chhim-hoān chit-ê soaⁿ ê pian-kài, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí;

m̄-thang kā i bong--tio̍h, tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí, á-sī ēng chìⁿ kā siā--sí. Só͘-ū chhim-hoān pian-kài--ê, bô-lūn sī lâng á-sī cheng-siⁿ, lóng bōe-ēng-tit hō͘ i oa̍h.’ Kàu sàu-kak ê siaⁿ thoa-tn̂g ê sî, in chiah thang chiūⁿ-soaⁿ.”
Mô͘-se lo̍h-soaⁿ khì jîn-bîn hia, hoan-hù in tio̍h kiat-chēng ka-kī, koh kiò in sóe-saⁿ.
I tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Tio̍h chún-pī gêng-chiap tē-saⁿ ji̍t; m̄-thang chhin-kūn hū-jîn-lâng.”
Kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t chheng-chá, soaⁿ-téng lûi-kong sih-nà, o͘-hûn-bi̍t-pò͘, hō-kak ê siaⁿ tōa tân; iâⁿ-lāi ê jîn-bîn lóng ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah.
Mô͘-se chhōa jîn-bîn lī-khui iâⁿ-tōe, gêng-chiap Siōng-tè; in lóng khiā tī soaⁿ-kha.
Kui-ê Se-nāi-soaⁿ lóng sī hé-ian, in-ūi Siōng Chú tī hé-tiong kàng-lîm tī soaⁿ-téng; soaⁿ ê hé-ian chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-lô͘ ê ian chhèng-koân, kui-ê soaⁿ tōa tín-tāng.
Sàu-kak ê siaⁿ ná tân ná tōa, Mô͘-se kóng-ōe, Siōng-tè tân-lûi kā i ìn-tap.
Siōng Chú kàng-lîm tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ soaⁿ-téng; Siōng Chú tiàu Mô͘-se chiūⁿ soaⁿ-téng, Mô͘-se chiū peh-chiūⁿ soaⁿ.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí lo̍h-khì kéng-kài jîn-bîn, kiò in m̄-thang chhiau-kè kài-sòaⁿ beh lâi chia khòaⁿ Siōng Chú, tì-kàu ōe ū chin chōe lâng sí.
Chhin-kūn Siōng Chú ê chè-si mā tio̍h kiat-chēng ka-kī, chiah bián góa kā in hêng-hoa̍t.”
Mô͘-se tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Jîn-bîn bōe-tàng chiūⁿ Se-nāi-soaⁿ, in-ūi lí í-keng kéng-kài goán, kóng, ‘Tio̍h tī soaⁿ ê chiu-ûi siat kài-hān, kā soaⁿ hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng.’”

Siōng Chú kā i kóng, “Lí lo̍h--khì, chiah koh kap A-lûn chòe-hé chiūⁿ--lâi; m̄-kú chè-si kap jîn-bîn m̄-thang chhiau-kè kài-hān beh lâi Siōng Chú chia, chiah bián góa kā in hêng-hoa̍t.”
Mô͘-se chiū lo̍h-soaⁿ khì jîn-bîn hia, kā in soan-pò͘.
Siōng-tè hoan-hù chiah-ê it-chhè ê ōe, kóng,
“Góa sī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè, ū chiong lí tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe, chòe lô͘-châi ê ke chhōa--chhut-lâi.
“Góa í-gōa lí m̄-thang ū pa̍t-ê Siōng-tè.
“M̄-thang ūi ka-kī tiau-khek ngó͘-siōng, bô-lūn thiⁿ-téng, tōe-chiūⁿ, kap tōe-ē chúi-lāi só͘-ū ê mi̍h, lóng m̄-thang chō in ê siōng;

m̄-thang kā in kūi-pài, mā m̄-thang ho̍k-sāi in, in-ūi góa Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè sī iau-kiû choân-chêng ho̍k-sāi ê Siōng-tè; oàn-hūn góa ê lâng, góa tui-kiù in ê chōe, tùi pē kàu kiáⁿ, kàu saⁿ sì tāi;
thiàⁿ góa, chun-siú góa kài-bēng ê lâng, góa si-un hō͘ in, ti̍t-kàu chheng tāi.
“M̄-thang lām-iōng Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ê miâ; in-ūi lām-iōng Siōng Chú ê miâ ê lâng, góa Siōng Chú it-tēng bô kā i tòng-chòe bô-chōe.
“Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit An-hioh-ji̍t, siú chòe sèng-ji̍t.
La̍k ji̍t lāi tio̍h phah-piàⁿ chòe lí só͘-ū ê khang-khè,

m̄-kú tē-chhit ji̍t sī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè siat-li̍p ê An-hioh-ji̍t; chit-ji̍t, lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lô͘-po̍k, lú-pī, cheng-siⁿ, í-ki̍p kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan ê lâng, lóng m̄-thang chòe kang,

in-ūi la̍k ji̍t kú, Siōng Chú chhòng-chō thiⁿ, tōe, hái, kap hit tiong-kan ê bān-mi̍h, tē-chhit ji̍t chiū hioh-khùn; só͘-í Siōng Chú sù-hok An-hioh-ji̍t, siat-li̍p chit-ji̍t chòe sèng-ji̍t.
“Tio̍h hàu-kèng lí ê lāu-pē, lí ê lāu-bú, thang hō͘ lí tī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lí ê tōe kú-tn̂g khiā-khí.
“M̄-thang hāi-sí lâng.
“M̄-thang kan-îm.
“M̄-thang thau-the̍h.
“M̄-thang choh gūi-chèng hām-hāi lí ê chhù-piⁿ.
“M̄-thang tham lí ê chhù-piⁿ ê chhù, mā m̄-thang tham lí ê chhù-piⁿ ê bó͘, lô͘-po̍k, lú-pī, gû, lû, á-sī lí ê chhù-piⁿ jīm-hô ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ.”
Só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn khòaⁿ-tio̍h sih-nà, thiaⁿ-tio̍h lûi-tân kap sàu-kak ê siaⁿ, koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h soaⁿ-téng chhèng-ian, chiū ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah, hn̄g-hn̄g khiā--teh,
tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kā goán kóng chiū hó, goán it-tēng beh thiaⁿ; m̄-thang hō͘ Siōng-tè tùi goán kóng-ōe, goán chiah bián sí.”
Mô͘-se tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ; Siōng-tè kàng-lîm sī beh khó-giām lín, hō͘ lín siông-siông kèng-ùi I, chiah bián lín hoān-chōe.”
Jîn-bîn hn̄g-hn̄g khiā--teh; Mô͘-se kiâⁿ-óa ba̍t-hûn, khì Siōng-tè hia.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng án-ni kóng, ‘Lín í-keng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa tùi thiⁿ-téng kap lín kóng-ōe.
M̄-thang ūi ka-kī chō jīm-hô kim á-sī gûn ê sîn-siōng lâi kap góa pí-phēng.

Tio̍h ēng thô͘ kā góa khí chè-tôaⁿ, tī hit téng-bīn hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè, í-ki̍p lí ê gû, lí ê iûⁿ; só͘-ū kèng-pài góa ê só͘-chāi, góa beh lâi hia sù-hok lí.
Lí nā ēng chio̍h-thâu kā góa khí chè-tôaⁿ, m̄-thang ēng phah--kè ê chio̍h-thâu khí; chio̍h-thâu nā ēng ke-si phah--kè, chiū siū phah lâ-sâm.
M̄-thang chō kiā-á-chàn kiâⁿ-chiūⁿ góa ê chè-tôaⁿ, chiah bián lō͘-hiān lí ê hā-thé.’”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h ūi jîn-bîn tēng chiah-ê kui-lē:
“Lí nā bóe Hi-pek-lâi -lâng chòe lô͘-lē, i thang ho̍k-sāi lí la̍k nî kú, tē-chhit nî i ōe-tàng bián hù sio̍k-kim chū-iû lī-khui.
I nā toaⁿ-sin lâi, chiū toaⁿ-sin lī-khui; i nā ū chhōa bó͘ lâi, i ê bó͘ chiū kap i chòe-hé lī-khui.
I ê chú-lâng nā kā i chhōa-bó͘, bó͘ kā i siⁿ-kiáⁿ á-sī cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, bó͘ kap kiáⁿ-jî tio̍h kui chú-lâng; i tio̍h toaⁿ-sin chhut--khì.
Lô͘-lē nā bêng-bêng kóng, ‘Góa thiàⁿ góa ê chú-lâng, góa ê bó͘, kap góa ê kiáⁿ-jî, bô ài chhut-khì chòe chū-iû-jîn.’
I ê chú-lâng chiū tio̍h chhōa i khì sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ hia, hō͘ i óa mn̂g á-sī mn̂g-khiā, ēng chǹg-á chǹg i ê hī-á; i chiū éng-oán ho̍k-sāi chú-lâng.
“Nā ū lâng bōe cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chòe lô͘-lē, cha-bó͘ gín-á sio̍k-sin ê tiâu-lē kap ta-po͘ lô͘-lē bô siâng.
Chú-lâng nā chhōa i, āu-lâi bô kah-ì, tio̍h chún i sio̍k-sin; chú-lâng kì-jiân bô siú sìn-iōng, chiū bô koân chiong i bōe hō͘ gōa-cho̍k-lâng.
Chú-lâng nā kā i chhōa-lâi chòe sin-pū, chiū tio̍h kā i tòng-chòe cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ khoán-thāi.
Chú-lâng ê kiáⁿ nā koh chhōa, hit-ê lú lô͘-lē ê chia̍h, chhēng, kap choh-bó͘ ê koân-lī, iû-goân bōe-ēng-tit kiám-chió.
Nā bô tùi i chīn chit saⁿ hāng gī-bū, i chiū thang bián hù sio̍k-kim chū-iû lī-khui.”
“Phah-sí lâng--ê, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí.
Nā m̄-sī kò͘-ì thâi-lâng, sī Siōng-tè iông-ún chit-kiāⁿ sū hoat-seng, góa chiū kā lín siat chi̍t ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ hit-ê lâng thang cháu-khì hia.
Lâng nā ok-ì ēng kè-bô͘ hāi-sí lâng, chiū-sī cháu-khì kàu góa ê chè-tôaⁿ hia, mā tio̍h kā i lia̍h khí-lâi chhú-sí.
“Phah pē-bú--ê, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí.
“Koái-iú lâng--ê, bô-lūn kā bōe--khì, á-sī iáu tī i ê chhiú, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí.
“Chiù-chó͘ pē-bú--ê, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí.
“Lâng nā oan-ke, chit-ê ēng chio̍h-thâu á-sī kûn-thâu-bú phah hit-ê, bô kā phah-sí, m̄-kú hō͘ i siū-siong tó tī bîn-chhn̂g;

nā hit-ê lâng ōe koh khí--lâi, gia̍h koáiⁿ-á kiâⁿ-lō͘, chit-ê phah i--ê, thang sǹg bô-chōe; m̄-kú tio̍h pê-siông i bōe-tàng chòe kang ê sún-sit, mā tio̍h hū-chek kā i i kàu hó.
“Lâng nā ēng kùn kòng i ê lô͘-lē, lô͘-lē bô-lūn sī lâm--ê á-sī lú--ê, nā liâm-piⁿ sí, chú-lâng it-tēng tio̍h siū hêng-hoa̍t;
nā kè chi̍t nn̄g ji̍t chiah sí, i chiū bián siū hêng-hoa̍t, in-ūi lô͘-lē sī i ê châi-sán.

“Lâng nā sio-phah, siong-hāi ū-sin ê hū-jîn-lâng, tì-kàu liû-sán, m̄-kú bô pa̍t-hāng ê siong-hāi, hit-ê lâng tio̍h chiàu hū-jîn-lâng ê tiōng-hu ê iau-kiû, keng-kè sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ ê chhâi-koat, pê-siông.
Nā ū kî-tha ê siong-hāi, hit-ê lâng tio̍h ēng miā pê miā,
ba̍k-chiu pê ba̍k-chiu, chhùi-khí pê chhùi-khí, chhiú pê chhiú, kha pê kha,
sio-siong pê sio-siong, siong-hāi pê siong-hāi, phah-siong pê phah-siong.
“Lâng nā kā i ê lô͘-lē phah-pháiⁿ chi̍t lúi ba̍k-chiu, lô͘-lē bô-lūn sī lâm--ê á-sī lú--ê, chú-lâng tio̍h in-ūi hit-lúi ba̍k-chiu pàng i chū-iû.
Nā kā lô͘-lē phah-tn̄g chi̍t ki chhùi-khí, lô͘-lē bô-lūn sī lâm--ê á-sī lú--ê, chú-lâng tio̍h in-ūi hit-ki chhùi-khí pàng i chū-iû.”
“Gû nā tak-sí ta-po͘-lâng á-sī hū-jîn-lâng, tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu kā hit-chiah gû tìm-sí, m̄-kú m̄-thang chia̍h i ê bah; gû ê chú-lâng sǹg bô chōe.

Hit-chiah gû nā pêng-sî chiū ōe tak--lâng, ū lâng kā gû ê chú-lâng kéng-kò, chú-lâng kèng-jiân bô kā gû pa̍k hó-sè, soah hō͘ hit-chiah gû tak-sí lâng, chiū tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm-sí hit-chiah gû; gû ê chú-lâng mā tio̍h sí.
Nā-sī chhâi-koat ōe-tàng ēng gûn sio̍k-hôe hit-ê chú-lâng ê sìⁿ-miā, i tio̍h chiàu só͘ chhâi-koat ê chîⁿ-gia̍h kiáu-la̍p.
Gû bô-lūn tak-tio̍h lâng ê kiáⁿ á-sī cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, tio̍h chiàu chit-ê kui-lē pān-lí.

Gû nā tak-tio̍h lô͘-lē, bô-lūn sī lâm--ê á-sī lú--ê, gû ê chú-lâng tio̍h ēng saⁿ-pah sì-cha̍p kong-khek ê gûn hō͘ lô͘-lē ê chú-lâng; gû mā tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm-sí.
“Lâng nā sóa-khui chíⁿ-kòa, á-sī khui-chíⁿ bô khàm-kòa, soah hāi gû á-sī lû-á poa̍h-lo̍h hit lāi-bīn,
chíⁿ ê chú-lâng tio̍h ēng gûn pê-siông cheng-siⁿ ê chú-lâng; sí ê cheng-siⁿ kui chíⁿ ê chú-lâng.
“Lâng ê gû nā tak-sí pa̍t-lâng ê gû, oa̍h ê gû tio̍h bōe-tiāu, bōe ê kè-chîⁿ kap sí ê gû lóng tio̍h tùi-pòaⁿ pun.
Chú-lâng nā chai i ê gû pêng-sî ōe tak--lâng, kèng-jiân bô kā gû pa̍k hó-sè, i chiū tio̍h ēng gû pê gû; sí ê gû kui i ka-kī.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lâng nā thau-khan gû á-sī iûⁿ, bô-lūn sī lia̍h-khì thâi á-sī khan-khì bōe, chi̍t chiah gû tio̍h pê gō͘ chiah, chi̍t chiah iûⁿ tio̍h pê sì chiah.

Chha̍t it-tēng tio̍h pê-siông; nā bô thang pê, i tio̍h bōe-sin lâi pê i thau ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ. I só͘ thau ê gû, lû, á-sī iûⁿ, nā iáu oa̍h--teh, i chiū tio̍h pê têng-pē. Chha̍t nā tī mî--sî ó͘-khang thau-the̍h, hō͘ lâng tú--tio̍h, koh hō͘ lâng phah-sí, phah-sí lâng--ê bô sǹg ū-chōe. Nā ji̍t-thâu í-keng chhut, phah-sí lâng--ê chiū ū-chōe.

“Lâng pàng cheng-siⁿ tī ka-kī ê hn̂g á-sī phû-tô-hn̂g chia̍h-chháu, nā chhut-chāi in chia̍h pa̍t-lâng hn̂g--ni̍h ê mi̍h, tio̍h ēng ka-kī hn̂g--ni̍h á-sī phû-tô-hn̂g siōng-hó ê chhut-sán pê-siông.
“Lâng nā khí-hé sio chhì-phè, thòaⁿ kàu koah-liáu ê be̍h-tui, á-sī iáu-bē koah ê be̍h-á, á-sī chhân-hn̂g, khí-hé ê lâng it-tēng tio̍h pê-siông.
“Lâng chiong gûn á-sī mi̍h-kiāⁿ kià chhù-piⁿ pó-koán, chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ tī pó-koán ê lâng in tau nā tio̍h-chha̍t-thau, chha̍t-á nā ū lia̍h--tio̍h, chha̍t-á tio̍h pê têng-pē;
chha̍t-á nā bô lia̍h--tio̍h, hit-ê hō͘ lâng kià ê lâng tio̍h khì sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ hia, chèng-bêng i bô the̍h chhù-piⁿ ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ.

“Koan-hē chhim-chiàm gû, lû, iûⁿ, i-ho̍k, á-sī phah-m̄-kìⁿ mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê sò͘-siōng, nā ū lâng kóng ‘Che sī góa ê’, soah ín-khí hun-cheng, siang-hong tio̍h khì sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ hia; sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ nā chhâi-koat sím-mi̍h-lâng ū-chōe, hit-ê lâng tio̍h têng-pē pê i ê chhù-piⁿ.
“Lâng nā chiong gû, iûⁿ, lû, á-sī pa̍t-khoán cheng-siⁿ kià chhù-piⁿ chiàu-kò͘, cheng-siⁿ nā sí--khì, á-sī siū-siong, á-sī hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì, m̄-kú bô lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h,

nn̄g ê lâng tio̍h kàu Siōng Chú bīn-chêng chiù-chōa; siū-thok ê lâng piáu-bêng i bô tāng-tio̍h chhù-piⁿ ê cheng-siⁿ, goân-chú chiū tio̍h chiap-siū, siū-thok ê lâng m̄-bián pê.
Nā khak-si̍t chai cheng-siⁿ sī hō͘ lâng thau-khan--khì, siū-thok ê lâng tio̍h pê goân-chú.
Nā-sī hō͘ iá-siù thiah-chhùi, siū-thok ê lâng tio̍h tòa hit-ê si-thé lâi chòe chèng-kù, i chiū m̄-bián pê.
“Lâng kā chhù-piⁿ chioh cheng-siⁿ khì sú-iōng, cheng-siⁿ nā ū siū-siong á-sī sí--khì, goân-chú bô chāi-tiûⁿ, chioh ê lâng it-tēng tio̍h pê.
Goân-chú nā ū chāi-tiûⁿ, chioh ê lâng chiū m̄-bián pê; nā-sī cho͘--ê, sún-sit tùi cho͘-kim tú.”
“Lâng nā ín-iú iáu-bē tēng-hun ê chhù-lú kap i chòe-hé khùn, hit-ê lâng tio̍h hù phèng-kim chhōa i chòe bó͘.
Cha-bó͘ gín-á ê lāu-pē nā kian-chhî m̄ chiong i kè hō͘ hit-ê lâng, chhù-lú ê phèng-kim hit-ê lâng tio̍h chiàu la̍p.
“Chòe ang-î--ê, m̄-thang hō͘ i oa̍h.
“Kap siù kau-ha̍p--ê, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí.
“Tû-liáu Siōng Chú í-gōa, koh kā pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng hiàn-chè ê lâng, tio̍h kā i tû-bia̍t.
“M̄-thang khi-hū kià-ku ê lâng, mā m̄-thang ap-chè in; in-ūi lín mā bat kià-ku tī Ai-ki̍p.
M̄-thang pháiⁿ khoán-thāi ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū.
Lín nā chin-chiàⁿ pháiⁿ khoán-thāi in, in ai-kiò góa, góa it-tēng ōe thiaⁿ in ê ai-kiò,
beh tùi lín hoat tōa siū-khì, ēng to thâi lín, hō͘ lín ê bó͘ chòe kóaⁿ-hū, lín ê kiáⁿ-jî chòe ko͘-jî.
“Lí nā chîⁿ chioh hō͘ góa ê chú-bîn tiong-kan ê sàn-chhiah-lâng, m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ pàng-lī ê lâng kā in the̍h lī-sek.
Lí nā the̍h chhù-piⁿ ê gōa-phàu chòe tí-ah, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng tio̍h hêng i;
i chí-ū chit-niá saⁿ thang kah; nā bô, i beh án-chóaⁿ khùn? I nā tùi góa ai-kiû, góa beh thiaⁿ, in-ūi góa sī chû-pi--ê.
“M̄-thang siat-to̍k Siōng-tè; mā m̄-thang chiù-mē jîn-bîn ê léng-siù.
“Lí tio̍h chiong siu-sêng ê ngó͘-kok, sin-iû kap sin-chiú hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, m̄-thang iân-tî. “Lí tio̍h chiong tōa-kiáⁿ hiàn hō͘ góa;
thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê gû kap iûⁿ mā tio̍h chiàu án-ni chòe; chhut-sì liáu thang tè i ê bú chhit ji̍t, tē-poeh ji̍t tio̍h kui hō͘ góa.
“Lín tio̍h chòe góa sèng-kiat ê chú-bîn; tī iá-gōa hō͘ iá-siù thiah-li̍h ê bah, lín m̄-thang chia̍h, tio̍h hiat hō͘ káu chia̍h.”
“M̄-thang sàn-pò͘ iâu-giân; m̄-thang kap pháiⁿ-lâng tàu-khang choh gūi-chèng.
M̄-thang tè to-sò͘ lâng chòe pháiⁿ; tī sò͘-siōng, m̄-thang phian-óa tōa-pêng, choh-chèng oai-khiok chèng-ti̍t.
Tī sò͘-siōng, m̄-thang phian-thán sàn-chhiah-lâng.
“Nā tú-tio̍h lí ê tùi-te̍k ê gû á-sī lû bê-lō͘, it-tēng tio̍h khan tò-lâi kau i.
Nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h oàn-hūn lí ê lâng ê lû chài siuⁿ tāng tó--lo̍h-khì, m̄-thang kiâⁿ-khui, tio̍h kap i chòe-hé chiong lû chài ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ pàng--lo̍h-lâi.
“Sàn-chhiah-lâng ê àn-kiāⁿ, lí m̄-thang oai-khiok chèng-gī.
M̄-thang bû-kò lâng; m̄-thang hāi-sí bô-chōe kap chèng-ti̍t ê lâng; in-ūi góa it-tēng bōe kā pháiⁿ-lâng khòaⁿ-chòe chèng-ti̍t.
M̄-thang siu hóe-lō͘, in-ūi hóe-lō͘ ōe hō͘ ba̍k-kim ê lâng pìⁿ-chòe chhiⁿ-mî, koh ōe oai-khiok chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ê chèng-sû.
“M̄-thang ap-chè kià-ku ê lâng; in-ūi lín bat kià-ku tī Ai-ki̍p, liáu-kái chhut-gōa-lâng ê kám-siū.”
“La̍k nî lāi lí tio̍h keng-choh, tio̍h siu-sêng lông-chok-bu̍t.

Tē-chhit nî, tio̍h hō͘ thó͘-tōe hioh-khùn bô keng-choh, lí ê jîn-bîn tiong-kan ê sàn-chhiah-lâng thang chia̍h thó͘-tōe chū-jiân chhut-sán ê mi̍h; in chia̍h chhun--ê thang hō͘ iá-siù chia̍h. Lí ê phû-tô-hn̂g kap kaⁿ-ná-hn̂g mā tio̍h án-ni chòe.
“La̍k ji̍t lāi lí tio̍h chòe kang, tē-chhit ji̍t tio̍h an-hioh, hō͘ gû lû hioh-khùn, hō͘ lô͘-lē kap kià-ku--ê lóng thang hôe-ho̍k goân-khì.
“Góa bēng-lēng lín--ê, lín tio̍h chun-siú; pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng ê miâ, m̄-thang thê-khí, mā m̄-thang kóng hō͘ lâng thiaⁿ.”
“Chi̍t nî saⁿ piàn, lí tio̍h siú-choeh ho̍k-sāi góa.

Tio̍h siú Tû-kàⁿ-choeh, chiàu góa ê bēng-lēng, tī A-pit-ge̍h só͘ chí-tēng ê ji̍t-kî, chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ chhit ji̍t kú, in-ūi lí tī chit kò-ge̍h chhut Ai-ki̍p. Lí m̄-thang khang-chhiú lâi kèng-pài góa.

“Lí tī hn̂g--ni̍h lô-lo̍k chai-chèng, siu-sêng thâu-chúi thó͘-sán ê sî, tio̍h siú Siu-koah-choeh. “Lí tī chhiu-kùi siu-khǹg tùi hn̂g--ni̍h lô-khó͘ tit--tio̍h ê lông-chok-bu̍t ê sî, tio̍h siú Siu-khǹg-choeh.
Chi̍t nî saⁿ piàn, só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng tio̍h lâi kèng-pài Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú.
“Ū-kàⁿ ê piáⁿ bōe-ēng-tit kap seng-lé chòe-hé hiàn; choeh-kî só͘ hiàn seng-lé ê iû bōe-ēng-tit lâu kàu keh-chá-khí.
“Thó͘-tōe thâu-chúi siōng-hó ê siu-sêng, tio̍h sàng kàu Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ê chhù. “M̄-thang ēng soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú ê lin chú i ê kiáⁿ.”
“Góa beh chhe-phài sù-chiá tī lō͘--ni̍h pó-hō͘ lín, chhōa lín khì góa ūi-tio̍h lín chún-pī ê tōe.
Lín tī i ê bīn-chêng tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng i ê bēng-lēng; lín nā ûi-pōe i, i bô beh sià-bián lín ê kè-sit; in-ūi i tāi-piáu góa.
Lín nā chin-chiàⁿ thiaⁿ-thàn i ê ōe, chiàu góa só͘ bēng-lēng lín--ê khì chòe, lín ê tùi-te̍k chiū-sī góa ê tùi-te̍k, góa beh tí-te̍k lín ê te̍k-jîn.
Góa ê sù-chiá beh kiâⁿ tī lín ê thâu-chêng, chhōa lín khì A-mô͘-lī, Hek, Pí-lī-sé, Ka-lâm, Hi-bī, Iâ-pò͘-su hiah-ê cho̍k ê tōe; góa beh kā in siau-bia̍t.
Lín m̄-thang kūi-pài ho̍k-sāi in ê sîn-bêng, mā m̄-thang o̍h in ê só͘-chòe; tio̍h kā hiah-ê sîn-siōng choân-pō͘ húi-hoāi, phah-chhùi tiau-khek ê thiāu-siōng.
Lín tio̍h ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè; góa it-tēng beh chiong bí-niû kap chúi siúⁿ-sù lín, koh hō͘ só͘-ū ê pīⁿ lóng lī-khui lín.
Góa mā beh hō͘ lín kéng-lāi ê hū-jîn-lâng lóng ōe seng-io̍k, bōe liû-sán, hō͘ lín chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū.
“Góa beh tī lín ê thâu-chêng hián-chhut ui-giâm; lín bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, góa beh hō͘ hiah-ê jîn-bîn lóng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, hō͘ lín ê tùi-te̍k oa̍t-tńg-sin tô-cháu.
Góa beh kàng un-e̍k tī in tiong-kan, kā Hi-bī -lâng, Ka-lâm -lâng, Hek -lâng lóng kóaⁿ-cháu.
M̄-kú góa bōe tī chi̍t nî lāi chiong in choân-pō͘ kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, chiah bián thó͘-tōe hong-hòe, iá-siù cheng-ka soah siong-hāi lín.
Góa beh ūi-tio̍h lín chiām-chiām chiong in kóaⁿ-cháu, thèng-hāu lín jîn-kháu cheng-ka, kàu ōe-tàng sêng-chiap hit-ê tōe chòe sán-gia̍p.

Góa beh kā lín tēng kok-kài, tùi Âng-hái kàu Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô, tùi khòng-iá kàu Tōe-tiong-hái; góa beh chiong hit-ê tōe khiā-khí ê jîn-bîn kau tī lín ê chhiú, hō͘ lín chiong in lóng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.
M̄-thang kap hia ê lâng í-ki̍p in ê sîn-bêng li̍p-iok.
M̄-thang hō͘ in tòa tī lín ê tōe, chiah bián in ín-iú lín tek-chōe góa; lín nā ho̍k-sāi in ê sîn-bêng, che beh chiâⁿ-chòe hāi lín ê lô-bāng.”

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí kap A-lûn, Ná-tap, A-pí-hō͘, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t chhit-cha̍p ê tiúⁿ-ló, tio̍h chiūⁿ-lâi góa chia, tùi hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi phak lo̍h-khì pài góa.
Chí-ū Mô͘-se thang chiū-kūn Siōng Chú, kî-tha ê lâng m̄-thang óa--lâi, jîn-bîn mā m̄-thang kap lí chòe-hé chiūⁿ-soaⁿ.”
Mô͘-se lo̍h-soaⁿ, chiong Siōng Chú só͘-ū ê bēng-lēng kap kui-lē lóng kóng hō͘ jîn-bîn thiaⁿ; jîn-bîn chôe-siaⁿ ìn kóng, “Siōng Chú kóng ê ōe, goán lóng beh chun-thàn.”

Mô͘-se chiong Siōng Chú ê ōe lóng siá--khí-lâi. Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, Mô͘-se tī soaⁿ-kha khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t cha̍p-jī chi-cho̍k, chhāi cha̍p-jī ki chio̍h-thiāu.
I koh phài Í-sek-lia̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng khì hiàn sio-hòa-chè, mā hiàn gû hō͘ Siōng Chú chòe pêng-an-chè.
Mô͘-se chiong huih ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ tóe tī phûn--ni̍h, lēng-gōa chi̍t-pòaⁿ hiù tī tôaⁿ-téng.
Mô͘-se koh the̍h li̍p-iok ê chheh tha̍k hō͘ jîn-bîn thiaⁿ, jîn-bîn ìn kóng, “Siōng Chú kóng ê ōe, goán lóng beh chun-thàn.”
Mô͘-se chiong phûn--ni̍h ê huih hiù tī jîn-bîn ê sin-chiūⁿ, kóng, “Che chiū-sī li̍p-iok ê huih; chit-ê iok sī Siōng Chú chiàu I ê ōe kap lín kiàn-li̍p--ê.”
Mô͘-se, A-lûn, Ná-tap, A-pí-hō͘, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t chhit-cha̍p ê tiúⁿ-ló lóng chiūⁿ-khì soaⁿ--ni̍h.
In khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè; I ê kha-ē chhin-chhiūⁿ pho͘ nâ-pó-chio̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ hiah-ni̍h kng-liāng thàu-bêng.
Siōng-tè bô chhut-chhiú siong-hāi Í-sek-lia̍t ê léng-siù; in lóng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè, tī hia ia̍h-chia̍h-ia̍h-lim.
Siōng Chú kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí chiūⁿ-soaⁿ lâi góa chia, lâu tiàm chia, góa beh chiong góa só͘ siá, beh kà-sī jîn-bîn ê lu̍t-hoat kap kài-bēng ê chio̍h-pán hō͘ lí.”
Mô͘-se kap i ê chō͘-chhiú Iok-su-a chiū chhut-hoat; Mô͘-se peh-chiūⁿ Siōng-tè ê soaⁿ.
Mô͘-se kā hiah-ê tiúⁿ-ló kóng, “Lín tiàm chia tán goán, thèng-hāu goán tò-tńg--lâi. A-lûn kap Hō͘-ní ū kap lín chòe-hé; bîn-chiòng nā ū tāi-chì, thang khì chhē in.”
Mô͘-se chiūⁿ-soaⁿ; soaⁿ ū hûn khàm--teh.
Siōng Chú ê êng-kng thêng tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ; hûn jia soaⁿ la̍k ji̍t kú. Tē-chhit ji̍t, Siōng Chú tùi hûn-tiong kiò Mô͘-se.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê êng-kng hián-hiān, chhin-chhiūⁿ hé tī soaⁿ-téng teh to̍h.
Mô͘-se chiūⁿ-soaⁿ ji̍p hûn-tiong; i lâu tī soaⁿ-téng sì-cha̍p mî sì-cha̍p ji̍t.
Siōng Chú kā Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hōng-hiàn lé-mi̍h hō͘ góa; só͘-ū kam-sim hōng-hiàn ê mi̍h, lín lóng thang siu--khí-lâi.
Ē-bīn sī lín thang tùi in siu ê lé-mi̍h: kim, gûn, tâng,
nâ-sek chí-sek chu-âng-sek ê se, iù-môa, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-mn̂g,
ní-chòe âng-sek ê iûⁿ-káng ê phê, siōng-téng ê phê, kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k,
tiám-teng ê iû, chè-chō thang boah ê sèng-iû kap phang-hiuⁿ ê phang-liāu,
âng-bé-ló, í-ki̍p beh siuⁿ tī í-hut-tek kap heng-tē ê pó-chio̍h.
In tio̍h ūi góa khí chi̍t ê sèng ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ góa thang tiàm tī in tiong-kan.
In tio̍h chiàu góa chí-sī lí ê khoán-sit, khí-chō hōe-bō͘, chè-chō lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê khì-khū.”
“Tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe chi̍t ê kūi, tn̂g chi̍t-pah cha̍p kong-hun, khoah la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun, koân la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun.
Lí tio̍h ēng sûn-kim pau chit-ê kūi, lāi-gōa lóng tio̍h pau; sì-piⁿ tio̍h siuⁿ kim-sòaⁿ.
Lí tio̍h chù sì ê kim-khoân, an tī i ê sì ki kha; chit-pêng nn̄g ê, hit-pêng nn̄g ê.
Tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe nn̄g ki kǹg, ēng kim pau--teh.
Tio̍h chiong kǹg chhng tī iok-kūi piⁿ ê khoân--ni̍h, ēng lâi kng kūi;
chiah-ê kǹg tio̍h put-sî chhng tī kūi ê khoân--ni̍h, m̄-thang thiu--chhut-lâi.
Tio̍h chiong góa beh siúⁿ-sù lí chòe kiàn-chèng ê chio̍h-pán hē tī kūi ê lāi-bīn.
“Tio̍h ēng sûn-kim chòe iok-kūi ê kòa, tn̂g chi̍t-pah cha̍p kong-hun, khoah la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun.
Tio̍h ēng kim phah nn̄g ê thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek, an tī kòa ê siang-thâu,
chi̍t thâu chi̍t ê; siang-thâu ê ki-lō͘-pek, tio̍h kap kòa liân-chòe kui-tè.
Nn̄g ê ki-lō͘-pek tio̍h bīn sio-tùi, ǹg iok-kūi ê kòa; si̍t thí koân, jia iok-kūi ê kòa.
Tio̍h chiong kòa an tī kūi ê téng-bīn, koh chiong góa só͘ beh siúⁿ-sù lí ê chio̍h-pán hē tī kūi-lāi.
Góa beh tī hia kap lí siong-hōe, koh beh tī iok-kūi téng-bīn ê kòa, nn̄g ê ki-lō͘-pek tiong-kan, tùi lí kóng góa beh bēng-lēng lí thoân hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘-ū ê sū.”
“Lí tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe chi̍t tè toh, tn̂g poeh-cha̍p-poeh kong-hun, khoah sì-cha̍p-sì kong-hun, koân la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun.
Tio̍h ēng sûn-kim pau chit-tè toh, sì-ûi siuⁿ kim-sòaⁿ.
Toh-bīn sì ê piⁿ kok chòe chhit-tiám-gō͘ kong-hun khoah ê kîⁿ, kîⁿ ê chiu-ûi siuⁿ kim-sòaⁿ.
Lí tio̍h chòe sì ê kim-khoân, an tī toh-á sì ki kha ê kak-thâu téng-bīn.
An khoân ê só͘-chāi tio̍h óa-kūn hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ, thang chhng kǹg lâi kng toh.
Tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe nn̄g ki kǹg, ēng kim pau--teh, thang ēng lâi kng toh.
Koh tio̍h ēng sûn-kim chòe tóe hiuⁿ-liāu ê pôaⁿ kap phiat-á, í-ki̍p hiàn tiān-chiú-chè beh ēng ê ô͘ kap poe.
Toh-téng tio̍h ū hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ, pâi tī góa ê bīn-chêng.”
“Lí tio̍h ēng sûn-kim phah chi̍t ê teng-tâi; teng-tâi ê chō, tiong-thiāu, poe, go̍k, hoe, lóng liân-chòe kui-chō.
Teng-tâi ê siang-pêng tio̍h chhun-chhut la̍k ki ki, chi̍t pêng saⁿ ki;
múi chi̍t ki ū saⁿ ê poe, hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ hēng-hoe, ū go̍k ū hoe; teng-tâi ê la̍k ki ki lóng sī án-ni.
Teng-tâi-thiāu ū sì ê poe, hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ hēng-hoe, ū go̍k kap hoe.
Tio̍h tī saⁿ tùi saⁿ-liân ê ki ē-bīn kap thiāu sio-chiap ê só͘-chāi chòe go̍k; teng-tâi ê la̍k ki ki lóng sī án-ni.
Hiah-ê go̍k kap ki lóng kap thiāu liân-chòe chi̍t ê, lóng sī ēng sûn-kim phah--ê.
Tio̍h chòe chhit ê teng-chóaⁿ, tiám-to̍h, hō͘ i sio-tùi chiò-kng;
koh tio̍h chòe teng-chián kap teng-pôaⁿ, lóng ēng sûn-kim chòe.
Tio̍h ēng saⁿ-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-kun ê sûn-kim chō teng-tâi kap chiah-ê só͘-ū ê khì-khū.
Lí tio̍h chiàu góa tī soaⁿ-téng chí-sī lí ê khoán-sit, sòe-jī chòe chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ.”

“Lí tio̍h ēng cha̍p pak pò͘ chòe hōe-bō͘; chiah-ê pò͘ sī ēng so--kè ê iù-môa, kap nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se chit--ê, téng-bīn tio̍h ēng chin-iù ê chhiú-lō͘ siù ki-lō͘-pek.
Múi-pak pò͘ tn̂g tio̍h cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh, khoah nn̄g kong-chhioh; ta̍k-pak ê chhùn-chhioh lóng siâng-khoán.
Tio̍h chiong gō͘ pak pò͘ chiap chòe chi̍t cho͘; lēng-gōa gō͘ pak mā tio̍h án-ni.
Koh tī ta̍k-cho͘ saⁿ-chiap ê pò͘, lō͘-bé hit-pak ê piⁿ--á tio̍h chòe nâ-sek ê liú-khoân.

Tio̍h tī chit-cho͘ pò͘ chòe gō͘-cha̍p ê liú-khoân; tī tē-jī cho͘ pò͘ lō͘-bé hit-pak ê piⁿ--á, mā chòe gō͘-cha̍p ê liú-khoân; nn̄g cho͘ ê liú-khoân lóng tio̍h nn̄g-ê nn̄g-ê sio-tùi.
Koh tio̍h chòe gō͘-cha̍p ê kim kau-á, ēng kau-á chiong nn̄g cho͘ pò͘ liân chòe-hé, chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê hōe-bō͘.”
“Lí tio̍h ēng soaⁿ-iûⁿ-mn̂g chit cha̍p-it pak tiùⁿ, chòe khàm hōe-bō͘ ê pò͘-phâng;
múi-pak tiùⁿ tn̂g cha̍p-saⁿ kong-chhioh, khoah nn̄g kong-chhioh; cha̍p-it pak ê chhùn-chhioh lóng siâng-khoán.
Tio̍h chiong gō͘ pak tiùⁿ liân-chòe chi̍t cho͘, lēng-gōa la̍k pak mā liân-chòe chi̍t cho͘; hit-ê tē-la̍k pak ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ tio̍h sûi-lo̍h tī pò͘-phâng ê thâu-chêng.
Tī ta̍k-cho͘ sio-chiap ê tiùⁿ, lō͘-bé hit-pak ê piⁿ--á tio̍h chòe gō͘-cha̍p ê liú-khoân.
Koh tio̍h chòe gō͘-cha̍p ê tâng ê kau-á, kau tī liú-khoân, hō͘ pò͘-phâng liân-chòe chi̍t ê.
Pò͘-phâng ê tiùⁿ ke--chhut-lâi hit pòaⁿ-pak, tio̍h sûi tī hōe-bō͘ ê āu-bīn.
Khàm hōe-bō͘ ê pò͘-phâng nn̄g pêng ke--chhut-lâi ê gō͘-cha̍p kong-hun, tio̍h sûi tī hōe-bō͘ ê siang-pêng.
“Lí tio̍h ēng ní-chòe âng-sek ê iûⁿ-káng ê phê khàm pò͘-phâng, koh ēng siōng-hó ê phê khàm tī siōng téng-bīn.
“Lí tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe hōe-bō͘ ê piah-pang.
Piah-pang tio̍h tn̂g sì kong-chhioh, khoah la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun.
Ta̍k-tè pang tio̍h ū nn̄g ê sún thang saⁿ-chiap; hōe-bō͘ só͘-ū ê pang lóng tio̍h chiàu án-ni chòe.
Lâm-pêng ê piah-pang tio̍h chòe jī-cha̍p tè.
Chit jī-cha̍p tè pang ê ē-bīn, tio̍h chòe sì-cha̍p ê gûn ê chō; ta̍k-tè pang ê ē-bīn ū nn̄g ê khang thang tàu in ê sún.
Hōe-bō͘ ê tē-jī bīn, chiū-sī pak-pêng, mā tio̍h chòe jī-cha̍p tè piah-pang,
kap sì-cha̍p ê gûn ê chō; ta̍k-tè pang ê ē-bīn ū nn̄g ê khang.
Hōe-bō͘ ê āu-bīn, chiū-sī sai-pêng, tio̍h chòe la̍k tè pang.
Hōe-bō͘ āu-bīn ê kak-thâu, tio̍h chòe nn̄g tè pang,
ē-bīn thí-khui, téng-bīn saⁿ-liân ti̍t-kàu téng-bīn tē-it ê khoân; nn̄g pêng lóng sī án-ni, beh chòe kak-thâu ê lō͘-ēng.
Tio̍h ū poeh tè pang, kap cha̍p-la̍k ê gûn ê chō; ta̍k-tè pang ê ē-bīn ū nn̄g ê sún-khang.
“Lí tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe hoâiⁿ-kông; lâm-pêng kap pak-pêng kok gō͘ ki, hōe-bō͘ ê āu-bīn, chiū-sī sai-pêng, mā gō͘ ki.
Piah-pang tùi-tiong hit-ki hoâiⁿ-kông, tio̍h tùi chit-thâu thàng kàu hit-thâu.
Piah-pang tio̍h ēng kim pau--teh, koh chòe kim-khoân thang thò hoâiⁿ-kông; hoâiⁿ-kông mā tio̍h ēng kim pau.
Lí tio̍h chiàu góa tī soaⁿ-téng chí-sī lí ê khoán-sit kā hōe-bō͘ tah--khí-lâi.
“Lí tio̍h ēng nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap so--kè ê iù-môa chit tiùⁿ-lî; chit-ê tiùⁿ-lî tio̍h ēng chin-iù ê chhiú-lō͘ siù ki-lō͘-pek.
Lí tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe sì ki thiāu, ēng kim pau--teh, koh ū kim-kau-á; thiāu tàu tī sì ê ū sún-khang ê gûn ê chō téng-bīn;
tiùⁿ-lî tio̍h tiàu tī kim-kau-á. Lí tio̍h chiong iok-kūi kng-ji̍p tiùⁿ-lî lāi; chit-ê tiùⁿ-lî sī ūi-tio̍h lín, chiong sèng-só͘ kap Chì-sèng-só͘ keh-khui.
Koh tio̍h chiong si-un-chō an tī Chì-sèng-só͘ lāi-bīn ê iok-kūi téng-bīn.
Lí tio̍h chiong pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê toh hē tī tiùⁿ-lî gōa-bīn ê pak-pêng; teng-tâi hē tī lâm-pêng, kap toh sio-tùi.
“Lí tio̍h ēng nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap so--kè ê iù-môa, ēng chhiah-siù ê chhiú-lō͘ chòe hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-lî.

Tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe gō͘ ki thiāu tiàu mn̂g-lî; thiāu tio̍h ēng kim pau--teh; thiāu ê kau-á tio̍h ēng sûn-kim chòe. Koh tio̍h ūi thiāu chù gō͘ ê ū sún-khang ê tâng ê chō.”
“Lí tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe chè-tôaⁿ, tn̂g kap khoah lóng nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun, sī sù-hong--ê; koân chi̍t kong-chhioh saⁿ-cha̍p kong-hun.
Tio̍h tī tôaⁿ ê sì kak-thâu chòe sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak, kap tôaⁿ liân chòe-hé; kui-chō chè-tôaⁿ tio̍h ēng tâng pau--teh.
Tio̍h chòe siu chè-mi̍h ê hu ê tháng, koh chòe thuh-á, óaⁿ, bah-chhe, hé-tiáⁿ; tôaⁿ ê khì-khū lóng tio̍h ēng tâng chòe.
Tio̍h ūi chè-tôaⁿ chòe chi̍t ê tâng ê bāng, bāng ê sì kak-thâu chòe sì ê tâng-khoân.
Bāng an tī chè-tôaⁿ sì-bīn ûi-io-pán ê ē-pòaⁿ-pêng, hō͘ bāng tùi tôaⁿ ê pòaⁿ-io chhun kàu ē-tóe.
Tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k kā chè-tôaⁿ chòe kǹg, ēng tâng pau--teh.
Kǹg tio̍h chhng tī chè-tôaⁿ siang-pêng ê khoân lāi-bīn, thang kng chè-tôaⁿ.
Tio̍h ēng pang chòe chè-tôaⁿ, tiong-ng khang-khak, lóng tio̍h chiàu góa tī soaⁿ-téng chí-sī lí ê khoán-sit.”
“Lí tio̍h ēng so--kè ê iù-môa kā hōe-bō͘ ûi chi̍t ê tiâⁿ; lâm-pêng ê ûi tn̂g sì-cha̍p-sì kong-chhioh.
Tiâⁿ ê lâm-pêng tio̍h ū jī-cha̍p ki thiāu, jī-cha̍p ê ū sún-khang ê tâng-chō; thiāu ê kau-á kap hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ lóng tio̍h ēng gûn chòe.
Tiâⁿ ê pak-pêng mā tio̍h ū ûi, tn̂g sì-cha̍p-sì kong-chhioh, thiāu jī-cha̍p ki, tâng-chō jī-cha̍p ê; thiāu ê kau-á kap hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ lóng tio̍h ēng gûn chòe.
Tiâⁿ ê sai-pêng tio̍h ū ûi, khoah jī-cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh, thiāu cha̍p ki, tâng-chō cha̍p ê.
Tiâⁿ tang-pêng ê ûi khoah jī-cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh;
ji̍p-kháu ê siang-pêng, ûi ê tn̂g lóng tio̍h la̍k kong-chhioh la̍k-cha̍p kong-hun, tiàu ûi ê thiāu kok saⁿ ki, ū sún-khang ê tâng-chō kok saⁿ ê.

Tiâⁿ ê ji̍p-kháu tio̍h ū mn̂g-lî, khoah káu kong-chhioh, ēng nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap so--kè ê iù-môa, ēng chhiah-siù ê chhiú-lō͘ siù--ê; thiāu sì ki, chō sì ê.
Tiâⁿ sì-ûi só͘-ū ê thiāu, lóng tio̍h ēng gûn ê hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ liân-chiap--khí-lâi; ēng gûn chòe kau-á, ēng tâng chòe chō.
Tiâⁿ ê tn̂g sì-cha̍p-sì kong-chhioh, khoah jī-cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh, koân nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun; ûi tio̍h ēng so--kè ê iù-môa chòe, chō lóng tio̍h ēng tâng chòe.
Hōe-bō͘ kèng-pài ēng ê khì-khū kap só͘-ū ê khi̍t-á, í-ki̍p tiâⁿ só͘-ū ê khi̍t-á, lóng tio̍h ēng tâng chòe.”
“Lí tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiong chiⁿ--chhut-lâi siōng-hó ê kaⁿ-ná-iû the̍h-lâi hō͘ lí, chòe tiám-teng ê lō͘-ēng, hō͘ hōe-bō͘ ê teng put-sî tiám--teh.

A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ tio̍h tī hōe-bō͘ lāi-bīn iok-kūi chêng ê tiùⁿ-lî gōa, tùi ē-hng kàu chá-khí, tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng chiàu-kò͘ koán-lí teng-hé. Che beh chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tāi-tāi tio̍h siú ê kui-lē.”
“Lí tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan, kiò lí ê hiaⁿ-ko A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ Ná-tap, A-pí-hō͘, Í-lī-a-sat, Í-tha-má lâi lí chia, chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi góa.
Lí tio̍h kā lí ê hiaⁿ-ko A-lûn chòe sèng ê lé-ho̍k, hō͘ i ū êng-kng kap ui-giâm.
Hiah-ê tit-tio̍h góa tì-hūi ê sîn chhiong-móa ê gâu ê sai-hū, lí tio̍h hoan-hù in kā A-lûn chòe lé-ho̍k, hō͘ i hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi góa.

Chiah-ê lé-ho̍k pau-koat heng-tē, í-hut-tek, gōa-phàu, kè-siù ê lāi-phàu, lé-bō, kap io-tòa. In tio̍h kā lí ê hiaⁿ-ko A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ chòe sèng ê lé-ho̍k, hō͘ in chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi góa.
Lé-ho̍k tio̍h ēng kim-sòaⁿ, kap nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, í-ki̍p iù-môa chòe.
“In tio̍h ēng kim-sòaⁿ, kap nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, í-ki̍p so--kè ê iù-môa, ēng kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘ chòe í-hut-tek.
Tio̍h chòe nn̄g tiâu keng-tòa liân tī í-hut-tek.

Í-hut-tek ê io-tòa tio̍h kap í-hut-tek kâng-khoán ēng kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘, ēng kim-sòaⁿ kap nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, í-ki̍p so--kè ê iù-môa chit--khí-lâi, hō͘ i kap í-hut-tek liân-chòe chi̍t ê.
Tio̍h the̍h nn̄g tè âng-bé-ló, khek Ngá-kok cha̍p-jī ê kiáⁿ ê miâ;
chiàu in chhut-sì ê sūn-sū, la̍k ê khek tī chi̍t tè, la̍k ê khek tī lēng-gōa chi̍t tè.
Tio̍h ēng khek ìn-á ê chhiú-lō͘, chiong Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ ê miâ khek tī pó-chio̍h, siuⁿ tī kim-kheng--ni̍h.

Tio̍h chiong chit nn̄g tè pó-chio̍h an tī í-hut-tek ê keng-tòa, chòe Í-sek-lia̍t cha̍p-jī chi-cho̍k ê kì-liām-chio̍h. A-lûn tio̍h tī nn̄g ê keng-thâu phāiⁿ in ê miâ, chiong in tòa-lâi Siōng Chú bīn-chêng, hō͘ Siōng Chú ōe-kì--tit.
Tio̍h ēng kim chòe nn̄g ê kheng,
