koh ēng sûn-kim phah nn̄g tiâu liān-á, chhin-chhiūⁿ ká soh-á, jiân-āu an tī kim-kheng.”

“Lí tio̍h chòe chi̍t ê phòaⁿ-toàn ê heng-tē, ēng kap chòe í-hut-tek kâng-khoán kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘, ēng kim-sòaⁿ kap nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, í-ki̍p so--kè ê iù-môa chòe.
Heng-tē tio̍h sù-hong--ê, áu siang-têng; tn̂g khoah lóng jī-cha̍p-jī kong-hun.
Lí tio̍h tī heng-tē téng-bīn siuⁿ sì chōa pó-chio̍h; tē-it chōa sī âng-pó-chio̍h, n̂g-ge̍k, chhiah-ge̍k;
tē-jī chōa sī le̍k-pó-chio̍h, nâ-pó-chio̍h, kim-kong-chio̍h;
tē-saⁿ chōa sī chí-bé-ló, pe̍h-bé-ló, chí-sek ê chúi-chiⁿ;
tē-sì chōa sī chhiⁿ-ge̍k, âng-bé-ló, phek-ge̍k; chiah-ê lóng tio̍h siuⁿ tī kim-kheng.
Chiah-ê pó-chio̍h chiàu Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ ê miâ, kiōng cha̍p-jī tè, ēng khek ìn-á ê chhiú-lō͘, ta̍k-tè khek chi̍t ê miâ, tāi-piáu cha̍p-jī chi-cho̍k.
Koh ēng sûn-kim chhin-chhiūⁿ ká soh-á án-ni phah nn̄g tiâu liān-á, an tī heng-tē.
Heng-tē ê siang-thâu tio̍h chòe nn̄g ê kim-khoân,
chiong hit nn̄g tiâu kim-liān-á liân tī heng-tē siang-thâu nn̄g ê khoân,
koh ēng nn̄g tiâu liān-á ê siang-thâu liân tī nn̄g ê kheng, an tī í-hut-tek keng-tòa ê thâu-chêng.
Lí tio̍h chòe nn̄g ê kim-khoân, an tī heng-tē siang-thâu ê kîⁿ, kūn í-hut-tek ǹg lāi-bīn hit-pêng.
Koh tio̍h chòe nn̄g ê kim-khoân, an tī í-hut-tek thâu-chêng ê keng-tòa ē-bīn, óa-kūn saⁿ-liân ê só͘-chāi, ēng kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘ chit ê í-hut-tek ê tòa téng-bīn.

In tio̍h ēng nâ-sek ê iù-tòa, chiong heng-tē ê khoân kap í-hut-tek ê khoân pa̍k chòe-hé, tah tī ēng kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘ chit ê í-hut-tek ê tòa, chiong heng-tē kap í-hut-tek kò͘-tēng--teh.

“ A-lûn ji̍p sèng-só͘ ê sî, tio̍h chiong ū khek Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ ê miâ hit-ê phòaⁿ-toàn ê heng-tē kòa tī heng-chêng, tòa-lâi Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, hō͘ Siōng Chú ōe-kì--tit.

Lí tio̍h chiong O͘-lêng kap Thó͘-bêng, hē tī phòaⁿ-toàn ê heng-tē lāi-bīn. A-lûn kàu Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ê sî, tio̍h chiong chiah-ê hē tī i ê heng-chêng. Án-ni, A-lûn siông-siông tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe phòaⁿ-toàn.”
“Lí tio̍h chòe chhēng tī í-hut-tek lāi-bīn ê gōa-phàu, kui-niá sī nâ-sek--ê.
Phàu téng-bīn ê tùi-tiong, tio̍h ūi-tio̍h thâu-khak lâu chi̍t ê khang, niá-iân tio̍h chit hō͘ ióng, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiàn-kah ê niá-khang, chiah bián phòa-li̍h.
Phàu ê ē-kha-pô͘ tio̍h ēng nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se chòe sia̍h-liû. Tio̍h chòe kim ê giang-lêng-á hē tī sia̍h-liû kap sia̍h-liû ê tiong-kan;
phàu kui-ê ē-kha-pô͘, chi̍t ê giang-lêng-á chi̍t lia̍p sia̍h-liû, chi̍t ê giang-lêng-á chi̍t lia̍p sia̍h-liû.

A-lûn ho̍k-sāi ê sî, tio̍h chhēng gōa-phàu. I ji̍p sèng-só͘ kàu Siōng Chú bīn-chêng, í-ki̍p chhut--lâi ê sî, tio̍h ōe-tàng hō͘ lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h giang-lêng-á ê siaⁿ, chiah bián siū thâi-sí.
“Tio̍h ēng sûn-kim chòe chi̍t tè pâi, ēng khek ìn-á ê chhiú-lō͘ khek ‘Sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú’.
Tio̍h ēng chi̍t tiâu nâ-sek ê tòa, chiong hit-tè pâi pa̍k tī lé-bō ê thâu-chêng.

Chit-tè pâi tio̍h siông-siông tī A-lûn ê thâu-hia̍h, hō͘ A-lûn tam-tng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hōng-hiàn sèng ê lé-mi̍h ê sî só͘ hoān ê chōe, hō͘ hiah-ê chè-mi̍h tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê chiap-la̍p.
“Tio̍h ēng iù-môa chit lāi-phàu, ēng iù-môa-pò͘ chòe lé-bō, ēng chhiah-siù ê chhiú-lō͘ chòe io-tòa.
“Lí tio̍h ūi A-lûn ê kiáⁿ chòe lāi-phàu, io-tòa, kap thâu-kun, hō͘ in ū êng-kng kap ui-giâm.
Chiah-ê tio̍h hō͘ lí ê hiaⁿ-ko A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ chhēng, kā in boah-iû, siū-chit, kā in hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, hō͘ in chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi góa.
Tio̍h ēng iù-môa-pò͘ kā in chòe lé-khò͘, tùi io kàu tōa-thúi, jia in ê hā-thé.

A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ ji̍p hōe-bō͘, á-sī lâi sèng-só͘ óa-kūn chè-tôaⁿ ho̍k-sāi ê sî, tio̍h chhēng lé-khò͘, chiah bián in siū hêng-hoa̍t lâi sí. Che beh chòe A-lûn kap i ê hō͘-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.”
“Lí kā A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, hō͘ in chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi góa ê sî, tio̍h án-ni chòe: Tio̍h khan chi̍t chiah kang ê gû-á, nn̄g chiah bô hâ-chhû kang ê mî-iûⁿ,
koh tio̍h the̍h ēng iù mī-hún chòe ê bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ, chhiau-iû ê bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ, kap boah-iû ê bô-kàⁿ po̍h-piáⁿ.
Chiah-ê piáⁿ tio̍h hē tī chi̍t kha nâ-á tòa--lâi, koh khan hit-chiah gû-káng-á kap nn̄g chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng lâi, hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
“Tio̍h hō͘ A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ lâi kàu hōe-bō͘ ê ji̍p-kháu, ēng chúi kā in sóe.
Tio̍h kā A-lûn chhēng lāi-phàu, kòa í-hut-tek ê gōa-phàu, í-hut-tek, heng-tē, chiong ēng kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘ chit ê í-hut-tek ê tòa kā i hâ--teh;
koh kā i tì lé-bō, chiong hit-tè khek ‘Sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú’ ê kim-pâi pa̍k tī lé-bō ê téng-bīn,
jiân-āu, ēng thang boah ê sèng-iû tò tī i ê thâu-khak, kā i àn-li̍p.
“Tio̍h kiò A-lûn ê kiáⁿ lâi, kā in chhēng lāi-phàu,
hâ io-tòa, pau thâu-kun, in chiū tam-tng chè-si ê chit-hūn. Che chiū chiâⁿ-chòe éng-oán ê kui-lē. “Lí tio̍h án-ni kā A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ siū-chit.
“Lí tio̍h kā hit-chiah kang ê gû-á khan-lâi hōe-bō͘ thâu-chêng; A-lûn kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ tio̍h hōaⁿ-chhiú tī gû ê thâu-khak.
Lí tio̍h tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, tī hōe-bō͘ ê ji̍p-kháu, thâi hit-chiah gû,
ēng chńg-thâu-á ùn huih, boah tī chè-tôaⁿ téng-bīn sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak; chiong chhun ê huih tò tī chè-tôaⁿ kha.
Tio̍h chiong pak-lāi só͘-ū ê iû, koaⁿ ê bāng-se, nn̄g lia̍p io-chí, í-ki̍p io-chí téng-bīn ê iû, lóng hē tī tôaⁿ-téng sio.
M̄-kú gû ê bah, phê, kap pùn, lóng tio̍h tī iâⁿ-gōa sio-tiāu. Che sī sio̍k-chōe-chè.
“Lí tio̍h khan chi̍t chiah kang ê mî-iûⁿ lâi; A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ tio̍h hōaⁿ-chhiú tī hit-chiah iûⁿ ê thâu-khak.
Tio̍h thâi hit-chiah iûⁿ, chiong iûⁿ ê huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.
Tio̍h chiong iûⁿ chhiat chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè, kā pak-lāi kap thúi sóe chheng-khì, kap kui-tè kui-tè ê bah í-ki̍p thâu hē chòe-hé.
Tio̍h chiong kui-chiah iûⁿ hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng sio; che sī hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê sio-hòa-chè, sī ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h.
“Lí tio̍h kā tē-jī chiah kang ê mî-iûⁿ khan--lâi; A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ tio̍h hōaⁿ-chhiú tī iûⁿ ê thâu-khak.

Lí tio̍h thâi hit-chiah iûⁿ, the̍h chi̍t-kóa huih, boah tī A-lûn kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ chiàⁿ-pêng ê hī-chu, koh boah tī in chiàⁿ-chhiú kap chiàⁿ-kha ê tōa-thâu-bú; chiong chhun ê huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.

Lí tio̍h the̍h chi̍t-kóa tôaⁿ-téng ê huih kap thang boah ê sèng-iû, hiù tī A-lûn kap i ê saⁿ, koh hiù tī i ê kiáⁿ kap in ê saⁿ; án-ni, A-lûn kap i ê saⁿ, i hiah-ê kiáⁿ kap in ê saⁿ, chiū lóng sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú.

“Lí tio̍h chhú hit-chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng ê iû, pûi ê bé, pak-lāi ê iû, koaⁿ ê bāng-se, nn̄g lia̍p io-chí kap io-chí ê iû, í-ki̍p chiàⁿ-thúi; chit-chiah sī siū-chit ê sî só͘ hiàn ê kang ê mî-iûⁿ.
Lí tio̍h koh tùi hit-kha hē tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng tóe bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ ê nâ-á, the̍h chi̍t tè piáⁿ, chi̍t tè kiáu-iû ê piáⁿ, kap chi̍t tè po̍h-piáⁿ,
hē tī A-lûn kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ ê chhiú, hō͘ in tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng iô-iô--leh chòe chè-mi̍h.
Lí tio̍h tùi in ê chhiú chiap--kè-lâi, hē tī tôaⁿ-téng sio-hòa-chè ê téng-bīn sio, chòe phang-phang ê chè hiàn hō͘ góa. Che sī ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h.
“ A-lûn siū-chit ê sî só͘ hiàn kang ê mî-iûⁿ, lí tio̍h the̍h i ê heng-khám-bah, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng iô-iô--leh chòe chè-mi̍h; chit-hūn chè-bah sī lí ê.

“Siū-chit ê sî só͘ hiàn kang ê mî-iûⁿ tiong-kan, iô--kè hōng-hiàn ê heng-khám-bah, kap the̍h-koân hōng-hiàn ê tōa-thúi, lí tio̍h kā in sèng-hòa. Chit-hūn chè-bah sī A-lûn kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ ê.

Chiah-ê pō͘-hūn sī A-lûn kap i ê hō͘-tāi tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tit--tio̍h ê hūn-gia̍h; chit-ê tio̍h chòe éng-oán ê kui-lē. Che sī tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pêng-an-chè ê tiong-kan, the̍h chhut-lâi chòe hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê lé-mi̍h.
“ A-lûn sèng ê lé-ho̍k tio̍h lâu hō͘ i ê hō͘-tāi, hō͘ in tī siū boah-iû kap chiap-siū chè-si ê chit-hūn ê sî thang chhēng.
Sòa-chiap i chòe chè-si hit-ê kiáⁿ, ta̍k-piàn ji̍p hōe-bō͘ tī sèng-só͘ ho̍k-sāi ê sî, tio̍h chhēng lé-ho̍k chhit ji̍t kú.
“Siū-chit ê sî só͘ hiàn kang ê mî-iûⁿ ê bah, lí tio̍h tī hōe-bō͘ ê tiâⁿ chú.
A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ tio̍h tī hōe-bō͘ ê ji̍p-kháu chia̍h chit-chiah iûⁿ ê bah kap nâ-á lāi ê piáⁿ.

In beh chiap-siū chit-ê chit-hūn, siū hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, tio̍h chia̍h hiah-ê ūi-tio̍h in sio̍k-chōe ê mi̍h; m̄-kú kî-tha ê lâng m̄-thang chia̍h, in-ūi chiah-ê chia̍h-mi̍h sī sèng--ê.
Siū-chit ê sî só͘ hiàn ê bah kap piáⁿ, nā lâu kàu keh-chá-khí, tio̍h ēng hé sio-tiāu; m̄-thang chia̍h, in-ūi sī sèng ê mi̍h.
“Lí tio̍h chiàu góa ê hoan-hù, ūi-tio̍h A-lûn kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ kú-hêng siū-chit ê lé-gî chhit ji̍t kú;
ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah kang ê gû chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Mā tio̍h ūi chè-tôaⁿ kiâⁿ kiat-chēng-lé, hō͘ i chheng-khì; koh kā i boah-iû hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng.
Lí tio̍h ūi chè-tôaⁿ kiâⁿ kiat-chēng-lé chhit ji̍t kú, kā tôaⁿ hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, tôaⁿ chiū chiâⁿ-chòe chì-sèng; só͘-ū bong-tio̍h tôaⁿ--ê lóng chiâⁿ-chòe sèng.”
“Lí ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h tī chè-tôaⁿ hōng-hiàn nn̄g chiah chi̍t-hè ê iûⁿ-káng-á;
chá-khí-sî hiàn chi̍t chiah, hông-hun ê sî koh hiàn chi̍t chiah.

Lí tio̍h ēng chi̍t kong-kun ê iù mī-hún kap chiⁿ--chhut-lâi chi̍t kong-seng ê kaⁿ-ná-iû chhiau chòe-hé, kap tē-it chiah iûⁿ-á chòe-hé hiàn, koh ēng chi̍t kong-seng ê chiú chòe tiān-chiú-chè.

Lí tī hông-hun hiàn lēng-gōa hit-chiah iûⁿ-á ê sî, tio̍h kap chá-khí-sî kâng-khoán hiàn sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè, lóng ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi, tio̍h chiàu-sî tī hōe-bō͘ ê ji̍p-kháu hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú; góa beh tī hia kap lín siong-hōe, kap lí kóng-ōe.
Góa beh tī hia kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siong-hōe, hōe-bō͘ chiū in-ūi góa ê êng-kng chiâⁿ-chòe sèng.
Góa beh kā hōe-bō͘ kap chè-tôaⁿ hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng; mā beh kā A-lûn kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, hō͘ in chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi góa.
Góa beh tiàm tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan, chòe in ê Siōng-tè.
In ōe chai, góa sī Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè! Góa chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p, só͘-í góa beh tòa tī in tiong-kan. Góa sī Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè.”
“Lí tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe chi̍t chō sio-hiuⁿ ê tôaⁿ,
sī sù-hong--ê, tn̂g kap khoah lóng sì-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-hun, koân káu-cha̍p kong-hun. Tôaⁿ hit sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak tio̍h kap tôaⁿ liân-chiap chòe chi̍t tè.
Tôaⁿ ê téng-bīn, sì-ûi, í-ki̍p hiah-ê kak, lóng tio̍h ēng sûn-kim pau--teh; mā tio̍h tī tôaⁿ ê sì-ûi siuⁿ kim-sòaⁿ.
Lí tio̍h tī kim-sòaⁿ ê ē-bīn, tôaⁿ ê siang-pêng, nn̄g ki hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ ê téng-bīn, chòe nn̄g ê kim-khoân, thang chhng kǹg kng tôaⁿ.
Tio̍h ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe kǹg, ēng kim pau--teh.
Lí tio̍h chiong hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ khǹg tī iok-kūi chêng ê tiùⁿ-lî thâu-chêng, kap iok-kūi téng-bīn ê kòa sio-tùi, hia sī góa kap lí siong-hōe ê só͘-chāi.
A-lûn ta̍k chá-khí chéng-lí teng-hé ê sî, tio̍h tī tôaⁿ-téng sio phang-phang ê hiuⁿ.
Kàu hông-hun A-lûn tiám-teng ê sî, mā tio̍h sio-hiuⁿ. Lín tio̍h sè-sè-tāi-tāi tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng put-toān án-ni sio-hiuⁿ.
M̄-thang tī chit-ê tôaⁿ sio pa̍t-khoán ê hiuⁿ, mā m̄-thang tī chia hiàn sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè.

A-lûn tio̍h chi̍t nî chi̍t piàn, ēng sio̍k-chōe-chè ê huih boah tôaⁿ-téng ê sì ki kak, kā hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ kiâⁿ kiat-chēng-lé. Lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi tio̍h án-ni chòe. Chit-ê tôaⁿ tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng sī chì-sèng--ê.”
Siōng Chú koh tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tiâu-cha Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng jîn-kháu ê sî, in ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h ūi ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā hiàn sio̍k-kim hō͘ Siōng Chú, chiah bián tī phó͘-cha ê sî chai-hō lîm-kàu in.
Só͘-ū tiám-sǹg--kè ê lâng, ta̍k-ê tio̍h chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kong-chhìn the̍h la̍k kong-khek ê gûn hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Só͘-ū tiám-sǹg--kè jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng ê lâng, tio̍h chiong chit la̍k kong-khek ê gûn hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Hó-gia̍h-lâng m̄-bián chhut khah chōe, sàn-chhiah-lâng m̄-thang chhut khah chió; ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tio̍h hiàn la̍k kong-khek ê gûn hō͘ Siōng Chú, chòe sìⁿ-miā ê sio̍k-kim.

Lí tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siu chit-ê sio̍k-kim, chòe hōe-bō͘ ê lō͘-ēng, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng tit-tio̍h kì-liām, che sī lín sìⁿ-miā ê sio̍k-kim.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h ēng tâng chòe sóe-tn̄g ê phûn kap phûn-chō, hē tī hōe-bō͘ kap chè-tôaⁿ ê tiong-kan, lāi-bīn tóe chúi.
A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ beh tī hia sóe chhiú, sóe kha.
In ji̍p hōe-bō͘, á-sī óa tôaⁿ-chêng ho̍k-sāi, hiàn ēng hé sio ê chè-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú ê sî, tio̍h ēng chúi sóe, chiah bián sí.
In tio̍h án-ni sóe chhiú sóe kha, chiah bián sí; che beh chòe A-lûn kap i ê hō͘-tāi sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.”
Siōng Chú koh tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h chhú siōng-téng ê hiuⁿ-liāu, chiū-sī liû-chit ê bu̍t-io̍h la̍k kong-kun, phang ê jio̍k-kùi saⁿ kong-kun, phang ê chhiong-pô͘ saⁿ kong-kun,
kùi-phê la̍k kong-kun, lóng chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kong-chhìn, í-ki̍p kaⁿ-ná-iû sì kong-seng,
chiàu chòe hiuⁿ-liāu ê hong-hoat tiâu-hô, chòe thang boah ê sèng-iû.
Tio̍h ēng chit-ê iû boah hōe-bō͘ kap iok-kūi,
toh kap toh-téng só͘-ū ê khì-khū, teng-tâi kap teng-tâi ê khì-khū, hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ,
sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ kap tôaⁿ só͘-ū ê khì-khū, í-ki̍p sóe-tn̄g ê phûn kap phûn-chō.
Lí tio̍h kā in hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, hō͘ in chiâⁿ-chòe chì-sèng; só͘-ū bong-tio̍h chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ--ê lóng chiâⁿ-chòe sèng.
Lí tio̍h kā A-lûn kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ boah-iû, hō͘ in hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi góa.
Lí tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, ‘Chit-ê iû beh tī lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi chòe góa ê sèng-iû.
M̄-thang tò tī it-poaⁿ-lâng ê seng-khu, mā m̄-thang ēng chit-ê tiâu-hô ê hong-hoat chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-khoán ê iû. Chit-ê iû sī sèng--ê, lín mā tio̍h kā i tòng-chòe sèng.
Só͘-ū chè-chō kap sèng-iû kâng-khoán ê iû, á-sī ēng lâi boah chè-si í-gōa ê lâng--ê, tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kā in kek-chhut.’”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h the̍h so͘-ha̍p-hiuⁿ, hiuⁿ-lê, pe̍k-siông-hiuⁿ chiah-ê hiuⁿ-liāu, kap sûn ê jú-hiuⁿ, ta̍k-hāng pîⁿ tāng,
ēng chè-chō phang-liāu ê hong-hoat chòe hiuⁿ, koh ēng iâm tiâu-hô, hō͘ i chheng-khì sèng-hòa.
Lí tio̍h the̍h chi̍t-sut-á chit-ê hiuⁿ, géng-chòe hún, hē tī hōe-bō͘ lāi iok-kūi chêng; góa beh tī hia kap lí siong-hōe; lín tio̍h khòaⁿ che chòe chì-sèng.
Lín m̄-thang chiàu chit-ê hong-hoat ūi-tio̍h ka-kī chòe hiuⁿ; tio̍h khòaⁿ i chòe sèng, kui hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Nā ū lâng chè-chō kâng-khoán ê hiuⁿ beh phīⁿ-phang, tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kā i kek-chhut.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Góa í-keng tùi Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k kéng-soán Hō͘-ní ê sun, O͘-lī ê kiáⁿ Pí-sat-lia̍t.
Góa ēng Siōng-tè ê sîn kā i chhiong-móa, hō͘ i ū tì-hūi, chhong-bêng kap tì-sek, gâu chòe ta̍k-khoán ê kang-gē;
gâu siat-kè tô͘-àn, ēng kim, gûn, tâng chòe mi̍h-kiāⁿ;
koh gâu khek beh siuⁿ ê pó-chio̍h, gâu ēng bo̍k-châi khek ta̍k-khoán kang-gē-phín.

Góa koh tùi Tān chi-cho̍k, phài A-hi-sat-boat ê kiáⁿ A-hô-lī-a-pek kap Pí-sat-lia̍t tâng-kang. Hiah-ê ū tì-hūi ê lâng, góa beh sù in châi-lêng, hō͘ in ōe-tàng chòe góa kau-tài in chòe ê kang-chok,
chiū-sī hōe-bō͘, iok-kūi kap iok-kūi téng-bīn ê kòa, hōe-bō͘ it-chhè ê khì-khū,
toh kap toh-téng ê khì-khū, sûn-kim ê teng-tâi kap teng-tâi it-chhè ê khì-khū, hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ,
sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ kap tôaⁿ it-chhè ê khì-khū, sóe-tn̄g ê phûn kap phûn-chō,
iù-kang chòe ê lé-ho̍k, chiū-sī chè-si A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi teh chhēng sèng ê lé-ho̍k,
í-ki̍p thang boah ê sèng-iû kap sèng-só͘ teh ēng phang-phang ê hiuⁿ. In tio̍h chiàu góa só͘ bēng-lēng lí--ê khì chòe.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,

“Lí tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, ‘Lín it-tēng tio̍h siú góa ê An-hioh-ji̍t, in-ūi che sī góa kap lín tiong-kan sè-sè-tāi-tāi ê kì-hō, hō͘ lín chai góa sī kā lín hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê Siōng Chú.

Só͘-í lín tio̍h siú An-hioh-ji̍t chòe lín ê sèng-ji̍t. Bô chun-siú chit-ji̍t chòe sèng-ji̍t ê lâng, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí; tī chit-ji̍t choh-kang ê lâng, tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kā i tû-bia̍t.
La̍k ji̍t tio̍h chòe kang, m̄-kú tē-chhit ji̍t sī hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú sèng ê An-hioh-ji̍t, tio̍h oân-choân hioh-khùn; tī An-hioh-ji̍t choh-kang--ê, it-tēng tio̍h kā i chhú-sí.’
Só͘-í, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tio̍h siú An-hioh-ji̍t, sè-sè-tāi-tāi chun-siú An-hioh-ji̍t chòe éng-oán ê iok.
Che sī góa kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan éng-oán ê kì-hō; in-ūi Siōng Chú tī la̍k ji̍t ê tiong-kan chhòng-chō thiⁿ tōe, tē-chhit ji̍t chiū thêng-kang hioh-khùn.”

Siōng Chú tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ kap Mô͘-se kóng-ōe kóng soah, chiū chiong nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán kau hō͘ Mô͘-se; chit nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán téng-bīn ê kài-bēng sī Siōng-tè chhin-chhiú siá--ê.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khòaⁿ Mô͘-se it-ti̍t bô lo̍h-soaⁿ, chiū lóng óa-khì A-lûn hia, kā i kóng, “Taⁿ, lí tio̍h kā goán chō sîn-bêng, thang kā goán chhōa-lō͘; in-ūi hit-ê chhōa goán chhut Ai-ki̍p ê Mô͘-se, m̄-chai tú-tio̍h sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.”
A-lûn kā in kóng, “Lín ê bó͘, lín ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ê kim hī-kau lóng pak khí-lâi hō͘ góa.”
Jîn-bîn chiū chiong in ê kim hī-kau lóng pak lo̍h-lâi hō͘ A-lûn.
A-lûn chiū chòe chi̍t ê bô͘, chiong chiah-ê kim-á chù chòe chi̍t chiah gû-á. Jîn-bîn chiū kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, chit-ê chiū-sī chhōa lán chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sîn-bêng.”
A-lûn khòaⁿ-liáu, chiū tī kim gû-á ê bīn-chêng khí chè-tôaⁿ. I soan-pò͘ kóng, “Bîn-á-chài sī Siōng Chú ê choeh-ji̍t, tāi-ke tio̍h lóng lâi khèng-chiok.”
Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, jîn-bîn khí-lâi hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè; in chē-teh tōa-chia̍h tōa-lim, khí-lâi thiàu-bú kún-chhiò.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Kóaⁿ-kín! Lí kóaⁿ-kín lo̍h-soaⁿ. Lí tùi Ai-ki̍p chhōa--chhut-lâi ê jîn-bîn í-keng tūi-lo̍h.

In chin kín phian-lī góa bēng-lēng in ê tō-lō͘, ūi ka-kī chù chi̍t chiah gû-á, kā i kūi-pài, hiàn-chè, koh kóng, ‘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, che chiū-sī chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sîn-bêng.’”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ chit-ê bîn-cho̍k chin-chiàⁿ sī sim-ngī kò͘-chip.
Taⁿ lí tio̍h chhut-chāi góa, góa beh tùi in hoat tōa siū-khì, kā in siau-bia̍t; góa beh hō͘ lí chiâⁿ-chòe tōa-kok.”

Mô͘-se chiū tùi Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè kiû-chêng, kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ beh tùi lí ê chú-bîn hoat tōa siū-khì? In kiám m̄-sī lí ēng tōa khùi-la̍t tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú, tùi Ai-ki̍p chhōa--chhut-lâi--ê?

Lí kiám beh hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -lâng kóng ‘I chhōa in chhut--khì, sī beh hāi in, tī soaⁿ--ni̍h kā in thâi--sí, hō͘ in tùi tōe-chiūⁿ siau-bia̍t’? Kiû lí hôe-sim-tńg-ì, m̄-thang tùi lí ê chú-bîn hoat tōa siū-khì, m̄-thang kàng chai-hō hō͘ in.

Kiû lí ōe-kì-tit lí ê po̍k-jîn A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok; lí bat kí ka-kī tùi in li̍p-sè, kóng, ‘Góa beh hō͘ lín ê hō͘-tāi chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ hiah chōe; koh chiong góa só͘ èng-ún hit-ê tōe, choân-pō͘ siúⁿ-sù hō͘ lín ê hō͘-tāi, chòe in éng-oán ê sán-gia̍p.’”
Tùi án-ni, Siōng Chú chiū kái-piàn sim-ì, bô chiong só͘ kóng ê chai-hō kàng hō͘ I ê chú-bîn.
Mô͘-se oa̍t-tńg-sin lo̍h-soaⁿ, chhiú the̍h nn̄g tè siang-bīn ū siá-jī ê chio̍h-pán.
Chio̍h-pán sī Siōng-tè chòe--ê, kài-bēng sī Siōng-tè siá--ê, khek tī chio̍h-pán.
Iok-su-a chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h jîn-bîn soan-hoa ê siaⁿ, chiū tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Tī iâⁿ-lāi ū sio-thâi ê siaⁿ.”
Mô͘-se kóng, “Che m̄-sī thâi-iâⁿ hoan-ho͘ ê siaⁿ, mā m̄-sī thâi-su ai-kiò ê siaⁿ; góa thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê sī chhiùⁿ-koa ê siaⁿ.”

Mô͘-se kiâⁿ kūn iâⁿ-tōe, khòaⁿ-tio̍h kim gû-á, koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h lâng teh thiàu-bú, chiū hui-siông siū-khì, kā chhiú--ni̍h hit nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán hiat-lo̍h soaⁿ-kha, chio̍h-pán chhùi--khì.
I koh chiong in chù ê gû-á-siōng ēng hé sio, géng-chòe hún, iā tī chúi-bīn, kiò Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lim.
Mô͘-se kā A-lûn kóng, “Chit-ê jîn-bîn sī kā lí án-chóaⁿ, lí kèng-jiân hō͘ in hoān chiah tōa ê chōe?”
A-lûn kóng, “Góa ê chú, chhiáⁿ lí mài hiah-ni̍h siū-khì. Lí chai, chit-ê jîn-bîn koat-sim chòe pháiⁿ.
In tùi góa kóng, ‘Lí tio̍h kā goán chō chi̍t ê sîn-bêng, thang kā goán chhōa-lō͘, in-ūi hit-ê chhōa goán chhut Ai-ki̍p ê Mô͘-se, m̄-chai tú-tio̍h sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.’
Góa kā in kóng, ‘Só͘-ū ê kim-á lóng pak lo̍h-lâi hō͘ góa.’ Góa kā kim-á hiat lo̍h hé--ni̍h, chit-chiah gû-á chiū chhut-hiān.”
Mô͘-se khòaⁿ-tio̍h jîn-bîn hòng-chhiòng, A-lûn koh chhut-chāi in, tì-kàu in siū tùi-te̍k thí-chhiò,
chiū khiā tī iâⁿ-tōe mn̂g-kháu, kóng, “Beh khiā Siōng Chú chit-pêng--ê, tio̍h lâi góa chia.” Lī-bī -lâng chiū lóng chū-chi̍p lâi i hia.

I tùi Lī-bī -lâng kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lín ta̍k-ê lâng io tio̍h chhah to, tùi chit-ê mn̂g kàu hit-ê mn̂g, sûn-sī choân-iâⁿ, thâi-sí hiaⁿ-tī, chhù-piⁿ, kap pêng-iú.’”
Lī-bī -lâng chiū chiàu Mô͘-se ê ōe chòe. Hit-ji̍t, jîn-bîn siū thâi-sí--ê tāi-iok ū saⁿ-chheng lâng.
Mô͘-se kóng, “Lín chiong ka-kī hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, ta̍k-ê lâng kong-kek ka-kī ê kiáⁿ kap hiaⁿ-tī, kin-á-ji̍t Siōng Chú ōe sù-hok lín.”
Keh-ji̍t, Mô͘-se tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Lín ū hoān tāng-chōe; hiān-chāi góa beh chiūⁿ-khì Siōng Chú hia, kiám-chhái ōe-tàng ūi lín sio̍k-chōe.”
Mô͘-se chiū tò-tńg-khì Siōng Chú hia, kóng, “Ài! Chit-ê jîn-bîn hoān tāng-chōe, ūi ka-kī chō kim ê sîn-siōng.
Taⁿ, khún-kiû lí sià-bián in ê chōe; lí nā m̄, kiû lí tùi lí kì-lio̍k ê chheh, kā góa ê miâ chhat-siau.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng tek-chōe góa, góa chiū beh tùi góa ê chheh chhat-siau i ê miâ.
Taⁿ, lí tio̍h chhōa chit-ê jîn-bîn khì góa kā lí chí-sī ê só͘-chāi. Góa ê sù-chiá beh kā lí chhōa-lō͘; m̄-kú kàu góa sím-phòaⁿ ê ji̍t, góa beh pān in ê chōe.”
Siōng Chú kàng chai-hō hō͘ jîn-bîn, in-ūi in kap A-lûn chòe-hé chō kim gû-á.

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí kap lí tùi Ai-ki̍p chhōa--chhut-lâi ê jîn-bîn, tio̍h tùi chia chhut-hoat khì hit-ê góa tùi A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok li̍p-sè, èng-ún beh siúⁿ-sù in ê hō͘-tāi ê thó͘-tōe.
Góa beh chhe sù-chiá tī lí ê thâu-chêng, beh chiong Ka-lâm, A-mô͘-lī, Hek, Pí-lī-sé, Hi-bī, Iâ-pò͘-su hiah-ê cho̍k kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.

Lín tio̍h chìn-ji̍p hit-ê lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe, m̄-kú góa bô beh chhin-sin kap lín chòe-hé khì, in-ūi lín sī sim-ngī kò͘-chip ê bîn-cho̍k, chiah bián góa tī lō͘--ni̍h kā lín siau-bia̍t.”
Jîn-bîn thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê pháiⁿ siau-sit, chiū hui-siông siong-sim, bô lâng chng-thāⁿ táⁿ-pān.

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, ‘Lín sī sim-ngī kò͘-chip ê bîn-cho̍k. Góa nā kap lín chòe-hé, chiū-sī chi̍t-sî-á-kú, it-tēng ōe kā lín siau-bia̍t. Taⁿ, lín tio̍h chiong seng-khu ê chong-sek-phín pak--lo̍h-lâi, góa ōe koat-tēng beh án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lín.’”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi lī-khui Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ í-āu, chiū chiong seng-khu ê chong-sek-phín lóng pak--lo̍h-lâi.

Mô͘-se tī iâⁿ-gōa ū hiah--hn̄g-ah ê só͘-chāi tah chi̍t ê pò͘-pîⁿ. I kā chit-ê pò͘-pîⁿ kiò-chòe hōe-bō͘; só͘-ū chhē-kiû Siōng Chú ê lâng, thang khì iâⁿ-gōa ê hōe-bō͘ hia.
Mô͘-se beh khì hōe-bō͘ hia ê sî, só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn lóng khí-lâi khiā tī ka-kī pò͘-pîⁿ ê mn̂g-kháu, khòaⁿ Mô͘-se chìn-ji̍p hōe-bō͘.
Mô͘-se ji̍p hōe-bō͘ ê sî, hûn-thiāu kàng-lo̍h tī hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-kháu; Siōng Chú chiū kap Mô͘-se kóng-ōe.
Só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn khòaⁿ-tio̍h hûn-thiāu kàng-lo̍h tī hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-kháu, chiū lóng khí--lâi, tī ta̍k-ê lâng ê pò͘-pîⁿ mn̂g-kháu kūi-pài.

Siōng Chú kap Mô͘-se bīn-tùi-bīn kóng-ōe, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng teh kap pêng-iú kóng-ōe. Mô͘-se tò-tńg-lâi iâⁿ-lāi ê sî, kun-sûi Mô͘-se ê siàu-liân-lâng Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a bô lī-khui hōe-bō͘.

Mô͘-se tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Siōng Chú, lí ū kau-tài góa, tio̍h chhōa chit-ê jîn-bîn khì hit-ê só͘-chāi, m̄-kú lí bô hō͘ góa chai, beh phài sím-mi̍h-lâng kap góa chòe-hé khì. Lí chí-ū kā góa kóng, lí chí-miâ kéng-tiàu góa, koh chin ì-ài góa.
Lí nā chin-chiàⁿ ì-ài góa, kiû lí chiong lí ê tō-lō͘ chí-sī góa, hō͘ góa jīn-bat lí, thang tit-tio̍h lí ê un-tián; kiû lí ōe-kì-tit chit-ê bîn-cho̍k sī lí ê chú-bîn.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh chhin-sin kap lí khì, hō͘ lí an-sim.”
Mô͘-se tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí nā bô beh chhin-sin kap góa khì, chiū m̄-thang kiò goán tùi chia chiūⁿ-khì hit-ê só͘-chāi.

Goán beh án-chóaⁿ chai, lí ū hó khoán-thāi góa kap lí ê chú-bîn? Kiám m̄-sī in-ūi lí ū kap goán chòe-hé khì, hō͘ góa kap lí ê chú-bîn, kap tōe-chiūⁿ bān-cho̍k ū hun-pia̍t?”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí kóng ê chit-hāng tāi-chì, góa ōe chòe, in-ūi góa ì-ài lí, koh chí-miâ kéng-tiàu lí.”
Mô͘-se kóng, “Kiû lí hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê êng-kng.”

Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh tī lí ê bīn-chêng hián-sī góa it-chhè ê súi, it-chhè ê hó, koh beh tùi lí soan-pò͘ Siōng Chú ê miâ. Góa beh lîn-bín góa ài lîn-bín--ê, thé-thiap góa ài thé-thiap--ê.”
I koh kóng, “Lí bōe-ēng-tit khòaⁿ góa ê bīn, in-ūi bô lâng ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa iáu ōe oa̍h.”
Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Lí lâi khiā tiàm góa piⁿ--á chit-tè chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng.
Góa ê êng-kng keng-kè ê sî, góa beh kā lí hē tī chio̍h-pôaⁿ ê phāng, ēng góa ê chhiú-tôe kā lí jia--teh, thèng-hāu góa kè--khì;
jiân-āu góa beh kā góa ê chhiú kiu--tńg-lâi, lí chiū ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê ka-chiah-phiaⁿ, m̄-kú bōe-tàng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê bīn.”

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h phah nn̄g tè kap í-chêng kâng-khoán ê chio̍h-pán; lí í-chêng siak-phòa ê chio̍h-pán téng-bīn ê ōe, góa beh koh siá tī chit nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán téng-bīn.
Bîn-á-chá-khí lí tio̍h chún-pī hó-sè; thàu-chá chiūⁿ Se-nāi-soaⁿ, tī siōng-koân ê só͘-chāi tiâu-kìⁿ góa.
M̄-thang ū lâng kap lí chòe-hé lâi; kui-chō soaⁿ m̄-thang ū lâng, soaⁿ-kha mā m̄-thang ū gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn tī hia chia̍h-chháu.”
Mô͘-se chiū phah nn̄g tè kap í-chêng kâng-khoán ê chio̍h-pán. Mô͘-se thàu-chá khí--lâi, chiàu Siōng Chú ê hoan-hù, chhiú the̍h nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán chiūⁿ Se-nāi-soaⁿ.
Siōng Chú tī hûn-tiong kàng-lîm, kap Mô͘-se khiā chòe-hé, soan-pò͘ Siōng Chú ê miâ.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bīn-chêng keng-kè, soan-pò͘ kóng, “Siōng Chú, Siōng Chú, ū jîn-chû un-tián ê Siōng-tè, bô khoài siū-khì, koh ū hong-sēng ê chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t;

chhî-siú chû-ài kàu chheng bān tāi, sià-bián chōe-gia̍t, kè-sit, kap chōe-kò; it-tēng bōe kā ū-chōe--ê phòaⁿ-chòe bô-chōe, beh tui-kiù lâng ê chōe, tùi pē kàu kiáⁿ, kàu saⁿ sì tāi.”
Mô͘-se chiū sûi-sî phak-lo̍h thô͘-kha kèng-pài, kóng,

“Chú ah, góa nā tùi lí tit-tio̍h un-tián, Chú ah, kiû lí kap goán chòe-hé kiâⁿ. Goán sī sim-ngī kò͘-chip ê bîn-cho̍k, kiû lí sià-bián goán ê chōe-gia̍t kap chōe-kò, chiap-la̍p goán chòe lí ê chú-bîn.”

Siōng Chú kóng, “Taⁿ, góa beh kap lí li̍p-iok. Góa beh tī lí choân-thé jîn-bîn ê bīn-chêng chòe kî-biāu ê sū, sī tī thiⁿ-ē bān-cho̍k ê tiong-kan iáu m̄-bat chòe--kè-ê. Án-ni, lí chiu-ûi ê bîn-cho̍k chiū beh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú thong-kè lí só͘ chòe ê sū sī jōa-ni̍h thang kiaⁿ-ùi.

Góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lí--ê, lí tio̍h chun-siú. Góa beh tùi lí ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-chhut A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Ka-lâm -lâng, Hek -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, kap Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng.
Lí tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang kap lí beh khì hit-ê só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn li̍p-iok, chiah bián in chiâⁿ-chòe hāi lín ê lô-bāng.
Lí tio̍h thiah-húi in ê chè-tôaⁿ, kòng-chhùi in ê chio̍h-thiāu-siōng, chhò-tn̄g in ê A-sià-la lú-sîn ê sîn-siōng.
“M̄-thang kèng-pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, in-ūi Siōng Chú sī iau-kiû lâng choân-chêng ho̍k-sāi I ê Siōng-tè, bô iông-ún ū pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng kap I pí-phēng.

Só͘-í, lí bōe-ēng-tit kap hit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn li̍p-iok, chiah bián in ho̍k-sāi in ê sîn-bêng kiâⁿ siâ-îm, hiàn-chè hō͘ in ê sîn-bêng ê sî, lí siū iau-chhiáⁿ, chiū khì chia̍h in ê chè-mi̍h;

chiah bián hō͘ lí ê hāu-siⁿ chhōa in ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, tī in ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ho̍k-sāi in ê sîn-bêng kiâⁿ siâ-îm ê sî, ín-iú lí ê hāu-siⁿ chòe-hé ho̍k-sāi in ê sîn-bêng kiâⁿ siâ-îm.
“Lí m̄-thang ūi ka-kī chù-chō sîn-siōng.
“Lí tio̍h siú Tû-kàⁿ-choeh, chiàu góa ê bēng-lēng, tī A-pit-ge̍h só͘ chí-tēng ê ji̍t-kî, chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ chhit ji̍t kú, in-ūi lí tī A-pit-ge̍h chhut Ai-ki̍p.
“Só͘-ū thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ--ê lóng sī góa ê; bô-lūn sī gû, iûⁿ, thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê kang--ê lóng sī góa ê.

Thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê lû-á, tio̍h ēng iûⁿ-á sio̍k-hôe; nā bô beh sio̍k-hôe, chiū tio̍h kòng-tn̄g lû-á ê ām-kún. Lín ê tōa-kiáⁿ lóng tio̍h sio̍k-hôe. “Lí m̄-thang khang-chhiú lâi kèng-pài góa.
“La̍k ji̍t lāi tio̍h chòe kang, tē-chhit ji̍t tio̍h hioh-khùn; chai-chèng siu-koah ê sî mā tio̍h án-ni.
“Chho͘-se̍k ê sió-be̍h siu-sêng ê sî, tio̍h siú Chhit-chhit Siu-koah-choeh. Koh tio̍h tī nî-bé siú Siu-khǹg-choeh.
“Lín só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng, tio̍h chi̍t nî saⁿ piàn lâi kèng-pài Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.

Góa beh tùi lí ê bīn-chêng chiong gōa-cho̍k-lâng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, khok-tián lí ê léng-thó͘; lí chi̍t nî saⁿ piàn lâi kìⁿ Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ê sî, it-tēng bô lâng ōe chhim-hoān lí ê thó͘-tōe.
“M̄-thang chiong seng-lé ê huih kap ū-kàⁿ ê mi̍h chòe-hé hiàn hō͘ góa; Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê chè-mi̍h mā m̄-thang lâu kàu keh-chá-khí.
“Thó͘-tōe thâu-chúi siōng-hó ê siu-sêng, tio̍h sàng kàu Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ê chhù. “M̄-thang ēng soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú ê lin chú i ê kiáⁿ.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h chiong chiah-ê ōe siá--khí-lâi, in-ūi góa sī chiàu chiah-ê ōe kap lí í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng li̍p-iok.”
Mô͘-se kap Siōng Chú tī hia sì-cha̍p mî-ji̍t, bô chia̍h-pn̄g bô lim-chúi. I chiong chit-ê iok ê ōe, chiū-sī cha̍p-tiâu-kài, siá tī hit nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán.
Mô͘-se lo̍h Se-nāi-soaⁿ ê sî, chhiú the̍h hit nn̄g tè iok-pán; in-ūi Siōng Chú ū kap i kóng-ōe, i ê bīn hoat-kng, m̄-kú i ka-kī m̄ chai.
A-lûn kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Mô͘-se, khòaⁿ leh, i ê bīn hoat-kng; in chiū chin kiaⁿ, m̄-káⁿ óa-kūn i.
Mô͘-se kiò in lâi, A-lûn kap hōe-chiòng ê léng-siù chiah lóng tò-tńg-khì i hia; Mô͘-se chiū kap in kóng-ōe.
Jiân-āu Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng lóng chìn-chêng óa--lâi; Mô͘-se chiū chiong Siōng Chú tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ tùi i kóng it-chhè ê ōe, lóng hoan-hù in.
Mô͘-se kap in kóng-ōe liáu-āu, chiū ēng phè tà bīn.

M̄-kú Mô͘-se ji̍p-khì kìⁿ Siōng Chú kap Siōng Chú kóng-ōe ê sî, bīn-phè chiū the̍h--khí-lâi, kàu i chhut--lâi. I chhut--lâi, chiū chiong Siōng Chú só͘ hoan-hù--ê kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Mô͘-se ê bīn hoat-kng; Mô͘-se ēng phè tà bīn, thèng-hāu kàu i ji̍p-khì kap Siōng Chú kóng-ōe chiah the̍h--khí-lâi.
Mô͘-se tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng, tùi in kóng, “Ē-bīn sī Siōng Chú bēng-lēng lín tio̍h chun-hêng ê sū.
La̍k ji̍t tio̍h chòe kang, tē-chhit ji̍t sī sèng-ji̍t, sī hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê An-hioh-ji̍t, tio̍h oân-choân hioh-khùn; nā ū lâng tī chit-ji̍t chòe kang, tio̍h hō͘ i sí.
An-hioh-ji̍t, lín ta̍k kháu-chàu m̄-thang khí-hé.”
Mô͘-se tùi Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng kóng, “Che sī Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng:
Tio̍h hōng-hiàn lé-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú; só͘-ū kam-sim hōng-hiàn ê lâng, lóng thang tòa lé-mi̍h lâi hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, chiū-sī kim, gûn, tâng,
nâ-sek chí-sek chu-âng-sek ê se, iù-môa, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-mn̂g,
ní-chòe âng-sek ê iûⁿ-káng ê phê, siōng-téng ê phê, kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k,
tiám-teng ê iû, chè-chō thang boah ê sèng-iû kap phang-hiuⁿ ê phang-liāu,
âng-bé-ló, í-ki̍p beh siuⁿ tī í-hut-tek kap heng-tē ê pó-chio̍h.”
“Lín tiong-kan gâu ê sai-hū lóng tio̍h lâi chòe Siōng Chú só͘ hoan-hù ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, chiū-sī
hōe-bō͘, pau-koat i ê pò͘-phâng kap téng-bīn ê kòa, í-ki̍p kau-á, pán, hoâiⁿ-kông, thiāu, ū sún-khang ê chō,
iok-kūi kap i ê kǹg, iok-kūi ê kòa kap jia i ê tiùⁿ-lî,
pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê toh kap i ê kǹg, toh-téng ê khì-khū kap hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ,
teng-tâi kap i ê khì-khū, teng-chóaⁿ kap teng-iû,
hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ kap i ê kǹg, thang boah ê sèng-iû kap phang ê hiuⁿ-liāu, hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-lî,
sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ kap i tâng ê bāng-á, chè-tôaⁿ ê kǹg kap tôaⁿ só͘-ū ê khì-khū, sóe-tn̄g ê phûn kap phûn-chō,
tiâⁿ ê tiùⁿ-ûi kap i ê thiāu, ū sún-khang ê chō kap tiâⁿ ê mn̂g-lî,
hōe-bō͘ kap tiâⁿ ê khi̍t-á kap soh-á,
í-ki̍p iù-kang chòe ê lé-ho̍k, chiū-sī chè-si A-lûn tī sèng-só͘ chhēng lâi ho̍k-sāi ê sèng ê lé-ho̍k, kap i ê kiáⁿ chòe chè-si teh chhēng ê lé-ho̍k.”
Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng tùi Mô͘-se ê bīn-chêng chhut--khì.
Só͘-ū siū kám-tōng, sim hoaⁿ-hí ê lâng, lóng tòa lé-mi̍h lâi hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; chiah-ê lé-mi̍h thang ēng lâi chòe hōe-bō͘ ta̍k-chióng ê khì-khū kap sèng ê lé-ho̍k.

Só͘-ū kam-sim hōng-hiàn ê ta-po͘-lâng kap hū-jîn-lâng lóng chiong kim-khì, chiū-sī heng-chêng ê pín-chiam, hī-kau, chòe ìn-á ê chhiú-chí, chhiú-khoân the̍h--lâi, iô-iô--leh chòe lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
In nā ū nâ-sek chí-sek chu-âng-sek ê se, iù-môa, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-mn̂g, ní-chòe âng-sek ê iûⁿ-káng ê phê, kap siōng-hó ê phê, mā lóng the̍h--lâi.

Só͘-ū ōe-tàng hōng-hiàn gûn kap tâng ê lâng, lóng tòa-lâi chòe lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; só͘-ū ū kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k thang chòe ta̍k-khoán lō͘-ēng--ê, mā lóng tòa--lâi.
Chhiú-gē chin gâu ê hū-lú, chiong chhin-chhiú pháng ê nâ-sek chí-sek chu-âng-sek ê se kap iù-môa, lóng the̍h--lâi.
Chhiú-gē chin hó, sim siū kám-tōng ê hū-lú, chiū pháng soaⁿ-iûⁿ-mn̂g.
Hiah-ê léng-siù mā chiong ōe-tàng siuⁿ tī í-hut-tek kap heng-tē ê âng-bé-ló, kap ta̍k-chióng pó-chio̍h the̍h--lâi.
In koh chiong iû kap phang-liāu tòa-lâi chòe teng-iû kap thang boah ê sèng-iû, í-ki̍p phang-hiuⁿ.

Ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se só͘ tio̍h chòe ê kang, só͘-ū siū kám-tōng sim hoaⁿ-hí ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, bô-lūn lâm-lú, lóng chiong lé-mi̍h tòa-lâi hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Mô͘-se tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Siōng Chú í-keng tùi Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k kéng-soán Hō͘-ní ê sun, O͘-lī ê kiáⁿ Pí-sat-lia̍t;
koh ēng Siōng-tè ê sîn kā i chhiong-móa, hō͘ i ū tì-hūi, chhong-bêng kap tì-sek, gâu chòe ta̍k-khoán ê kang-gē;
gâu siat-kè tô͘-àn, ēng kim, gûn, tâng chòe mi̍h-kiāⁿ;
koh gâu khek beh siuⁿ ê pó-chio̍h, gâu ēng bo̍k-châi khek ta̍k-khoán kang-gē-phín.
Siōng Chú koh hō͘ i kap Tān chi-cho̍k, A-hi-sat-boat ê kiáⁿ A-hô-lī-a-pek, tit-tio̍h châi-lêng, thang thoân-siū châi-gē.

Chiah-ê lâng Siōng Chú chiong tì-hūi chhiong-móa in, hō͘ in ōe chòe ta̍k-khoán ê kang-gē, bô-lūn sī tiau-khek, tô͘-àn siat-kè, ēng nâ-sek chí-sek chu-âng-sek ê se kap iù-môa chhiah-siù, pian-chit; in chin gâu chòe kang-gē, mā chin gâu siat-kè tô͘-àn.”

Pí-sat-lia̍t kap A-hô-lī-a-pek, í-ki̍p só͘-ū tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú siúⁿ-sù in tì-hūi chhong-bêng, hō͘ in chai án-chóaⁿ khí-chō sèng-só͘ ta̍k-khoán kang-thêng ê sai-hū, lóng chiàu Siōng Chú bēng-lēng in--ê khì chòe.
Mô͘-se tiàu-chi̍p Pí-sat-lia̍t, A-hô-lī-a-pek, kap só͘-ū siū kám-tōng, tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú siúⁿ-sù in tì-hūi, hoaⁿ-hí lâi chòe kang ê sai-hū.
In tùi Mô͘-se the̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ūi-tio̍h khí-chō sèng-só͘ só͘ hiàn ê lé-mi̍h. Jîn-bîn ta̍k chá-khí kè-sio̍k chiong kam-sim hōng-hiàn ê lé-mi̍h tòa-lâi hō͘ Mô͘-se.
Só͘-í hiah-ê gâu khí-chō sèng-só͘ ê sai-hū, lóng chiām-thêng in goân-lâi ê khang-khè,
lâi tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Jîn-bîn hōng-hiàn ê lé-mi̍h hui-siông chōe, chhiau-kè Siōng Chú bēng-lēng beh khí-chō ê kang-thêng só͘ tio̍h ēng--ê.”

Tùi án-ni, Mô͘-se hā-lēng, in chiū tī choân-iâⁿ soan-pò͘, kóng, “Bô-lūn lâm-lú, lóng m̄-thang koh ūi-tio̍h sèng-só͘ ê kang-thêng hōng-hiàn lé-mi̍h.” Án-ni jîn-bîn chiah bô koh hōng-hiàn.
In hōng-hiàn ê châi-liāu, í-keng ū-kàu chòe só͘-ū ê kang-thêng, koh ū chhun.

In tiong-kan só͘-ū gâu ê sai-hū, ēng cha̍p pak ê pò͘ chòe hōe-bō͘; chiah-ê pò͘ sī ēng so--kè ê iù-môa, kap nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se chit--ê, téng-bīn koh ēng chin-iù ê chhiú-lō͘ siù ki-lō͘-pek.
Múi-pak pò͘ tn̂g cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh, khoah nn̄g kong-chhioh; ta̍k-pak ê chhùn-chhioh lóng siâng-khoán.
In chiong gō͘ pak pò͘ chiap chòe chi̍t cho͘; lēng-gōa gō͘ pak mā án-ni.
Koh tī ta̍k-cho͘ saⁿ-chiap ê pò͘, lō͘-bé hit-pak ê piⁿ--á chòe nâ-sek ê liú-khoân.
In tī chit-cho͘ pò͘ chòe gō͘-cha̍p ê liú-khoân; tī tē-jī cho͘ pò͘ lō͘-bé hit-pak ê piⁿ--á, mā chòe gō͘-cha̍p ê liú-khoân; nn̄g cho͘ ê liú-khoân lóng nn̄g-ê nn̄g-ê sio-tùi.
In koh chòe gō͘-cha̍p ê kim kau-á, ēng kau-á chiong nn̄g cho͘ pò͘ liân chòe-hé, chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê hōe-bō͘.
In ēng soaⁿ-iûⁿ-mn̂g chit cha̍p-it pak tiùⁿ, chòe khàm hōe-bō͘ ê pò͘-phâng;
múi-pak tiùⁿ tn̂g cha̍p-saⁿ kong-chhioh, khoah nn̄g kong-chhioh; cha̍p-it pak ê chhùn-chhioh lóng siâng-khoán.
In chiong gō͘ pak tiùⁿ liân-chòe chi̍t cho͘, lēng-gōa la̍k pak mā liân-chòe chi̍t cho͘.
Tī ta̍k-cho͘ sio-chiap ê tiùⁿ, lō͘-bé hit-pak ê piⁿ--á chòe gō͘-cha̍p ê liú-khoân.
In koh chòe gō͘-cha̍p ê tâng ê kau-á, hō͘ pò͘-phâng liân-chòe chi̍t ê.
In ēng ní-chòe âng-sek ê iûⁿ-káng ê phê khàm pò͘-phâng, koh ēng siōng-hó ê phê khàm tī siōng téng-bīn.
In ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe hōe-bō͘ ê piah-pang.
Piah-pang tn̂g sì kong-chhioh, khoah la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun.
Ta̍k-tè pang ū nn̄g ê sún thang saⁿ-chiap; hōe-bō͘ só͘-ū ê pang lóng chiàu án-ni chòe.
Lâm-pêng ê piah-pang chòe jī-cha̍p tè.
Chit jī-cha̍p tè pang ê ē-bīn, chòe sì-cha̍p ê gûn ê chō; ta̍k-tè pang ê ē-bīn ū nn̄g ê khang thang tàu in ê sún.
Hōe-bō͘ ê tē-jī bīn, chiū-sī pak-pêng, mā chòe jī-cha̍p tè piah-pang,
kap sì-cha̍p ê gûn ê chō; ta̍k-tè pang ê ē-bīn ū nn̄g ê khang.
Hōe-bō͘ ê āu-bīn, chiū-sī sai-pêng, chòe la̍k tè pang.
Hōe-bō͘ āu-bīn ê kak-thâu, chòe nn̄g tè pang,
ē-bīn thí-khui, téng-bīn saⁿ-liân ti̍t-kàu téng-bīn tē-it ê khoân; nn̄g pêng lóng sī án-ni, beh chòe kak-thâu ê lō͘-ēng.
Ū poeh tè pang, kap cha̍p-la̍k ê gûn ê chō; ta̍k-tè pang ê ē-bīn ū nn̄g ê sún-khang.
In ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe hoâiⁿ-kông; lâm-pêng kap pak-pêng kok gō͘ ki, hōe-bō͘ ê āu-bīn, chiū-sī sai-pêng, mā gō͘ ki.
Piah-pang tùi-tiong hit-ki hoâiⁿ-kông, tùi chit-thâu thàng kàu hit-thâu.
Piah-pang ēng kim pau--teh, koh chòe kim-khoân thang thò hoâiⁿ-kông; hoâiⁿ-kông mā ēng kim pau.
In koh ēng nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap so--kè ê iù-môa chit tiùⁿ-lî; chit-ê tiùⁿ-lî ēng chin iù ê chhiú-lō͘ siù ki-lō͘-pek.
In ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe sì ki thiāu, ēng kim pau--teh, koh ū kim-kau-á; thiāu tàu tī sì ê ū sún-khang ê gûn ê chō téng-bīn.
In koh ēng nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap so--kè ê iù-môa, ēng chhiah-siù ê chhiú-lō͘ chòe hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-lî.
In chòe gō͘ ki thiāu, thiāu ū kau-á tiàu mn̂g-lî; thiāu-táu kap hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ ēng kim pau--teh; hit gō͘ ê ū sún-khang ê chō sī tâng--ê.
Pí-sat-lia̍t ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe chi̍t ê iok-kūi, tn̂g chi̍t-pah cha̍p kong-hun, khoah la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun, koân la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun;
ēng sûn-kim pau chit-ê kūi, lāi-gōa lóng pau--teh; sì-piⁿ siuⁿ kim-sòaⁿ;
koh kā i chù sì ê kim-khoân, an tī i ê sì ki kha; chit-pêng nn̄g ê, hit-pêng nn̄g ê.
I ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe nn̄g ki kǹg, ēng kim pau--teh,
chiong kǹg chhng tī iok-kūi piⁿ ê khoân--ni̍h, ēng lâi kng kūi.
I koh ēng sûn-kim chòe iok-kūi ê kòa, tn̂g chi̍t-pah cha̍p kong-hun, khoah la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun.
Koh ēng kim phah nn̄g ê thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek, an tī kòa ê siang-thâu,
chi̍t thâu chi̍t ê; siang-thâu ê ki-lō͘-pek kap kòa liân-chòe kui-tè.
Nn̄g ê ki-lō͘-pek bīn sio-tùi, ǹg iok-kūi ê kòa; si̍t thí koân, jia iok-kūi ê kòa.
I ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe chi̍t tè toh, tn̂g poeh-cha̍p-poeh kong-hun, khoah sì-cha̍p-sì kong-hun, koân la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun;
ēng sûn-kim pau--teh, sì-ûi siuⁿ kim-sòaⁿ.
Toh-bīn sì ê piⁿ kok chòe chhit tiám gō͘ kong-hun khoah ê kîⁿ, kîⁿ ê chiu-ûi siuⁿ kim-sòaⁿ.
I chòe sì ê kim-khoân, an tī toh-á sì ki kha ê kak-thâu téng-bīn.
An khoân ê só͘-chāi óa-kūn hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ, thang chhng kǹg lâi kng toh.
Ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe nn̄g ki kǹg, ēng kim pau--teh, thang ēng lâi kng toh.
Koh ēng sûn-kim chòe toh-téng ê khì-khū, chiū-sī pôaⁿ kap phiat-á, í-ki̍p hiàn tiān-chiú-chè beh ēng ê ô͘ kap poe.
I ēng sûn-kim phah chi̍t ê teng-tâi; teng-tâi ê chō, tiong-thiāu, poe, go̍k, hoe, lóng liân-chòe kui-chō.
Teng-tâi ê siang-pêng chhun-chhut la̍k ki ki, chi̍t pêng saⁿ ki;
múi chi̍t ki ū saⁿ ê poe, hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ hēng-hoe, ū go̍k ū hoe; teng-tâi ê la̍k ki ki lóng sī án-ni.
Teng-tâi-thiāu ū sì ê poe, hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ hēng-hoe, ū go̍k kap hoe.
I tī saⁿ tùi saⁿ-liân ê ki ē-bīn kap thiāu sio-chiap ê só͘-chāi chòe go̍k; teng-tâi ê la̍k ki ki lóng sī án-ni.
Hiah-ê go̍k kap ki lóng kap thiāu liân-chòe chi̍t ê, lóng sī ēng sûn-kim phah--ê.
I ēng sûn-kim chòe chhit ê teng-chóaⁿ, teng-chián, kap teng-pôaⁿ.
I ēng saⁿ-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-kun ê sûn-kim chō teng-tâi kap chiah-ê só͘-ū ê khì-khū.

I ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe chi̍t chō sio-hiuⁿ ê tôaⁿ, sī sù-hong--ê, tn̂g kap khoah lóng sì-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-hun, koân káu-cha̍p kong-hun. Tôaⁿ hit sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak kap tôaⁿ liân-chiap chòe chi̍t tè.
Tôaⁿ ê téng-bīn, sì-ûi, í-ki̍p hiah-ê kak lóng ēng sûn-kim pau--teh; koh tī tôaⁿ ê sì-ûi siuⁿ kim-sòaⁿ.
I tī kim-sòaⁿ ê ē-bīn, tôaⁿ ê siang-pêng, nn̄g ki hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ ê téng-bīn, chòe nn̄g ê kim-khoân, thang chhng kǹg lâi kng tôaⁿ.
I ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe kǹg, ēng kim pau--teh.
I koh chiàu chòe hiuⁿ-liāu ê hong-hoat chòe thang boah ê sèng-iû kap sûn ê phang-hiuⁿ.
Pí-sat-lia̍t ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ; tn̂g kap khoah lóng nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun, sī sù-hong--ê; koân chi̍t kong-chhioh saⁿ-cha̍p kong-hun.
Tī tôaⁿ ê sì kak-thâu chòe sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak, kap tôaⁿ liân chòe-hé; kui-chō chè-tôaⁿ ēng tâng pau--teh.
I koh ēng tâng chòe tôaⁿ só͘-ū ê khì-khū, chiū-sī tháng-á, thuh-á, óaⁿ, bah-chhe, kap hé-tiáⁿ.
I ūi chè-tôaⁿ chòe chi̍t ê tâng ê bāng, an tī chè-tôaⁿ sì-bīn ûi-io-pán ê ē-pòaⁿ-pêng, hō͘ bāng tùi tôaⁿ ê pòaⁿ-io chhun kàu ē-tóe.
I tī tâng ê bāng ê sì kak-thâu chù sì ê tâng-khoân, chòe chhng kǹg ê lō͘-ēng.
I ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe kǹg, ēng tâng pau--teh,
chiong kǹg chhng tī chè-tôaⁿ siang-pêng ê khoân lāi-bīn, thang kng chè-tôaⁿ; ēng pang chòe chè-tôaⁿ, tiong-ng sī khang--ê.
I ēng tâng chòe sóe-tn̄g ê phûn kap phûn-chō; sī ēng tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu ho̍k-sāi ê hū-jîn-lâng ê tâng-kiàⁿ chòe--ê.
I ēng so--kè ê iù-môa kā hōe-bō͘ ûi chi̍t ê tiâⁿ; lâm-pêng ê ûi tn̂g sì-cha̍p-sì kong-chhioh.
Ûi ū jī-cha̍p ki thiāu, jī-cha̍p ê ū sún-khang ê tâng-chō; thiāu ê kau-á kap hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ lóng ēng gûn chòe.
Pak-pêng ê ûi tn̂g sì-cha̍p-sì kong-chhioh, thiāu jī-cha̍p ki, tâng-chō jī-cha̍p ê; thiāu ê kau-á kap hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ lóng ēng gûn chòe.
Tiâⁿ sai-pêng ê ûi jī-cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh, thiāu cha̍p ki, tâng-chō cha̍p ê; thiāu ê kau-á kap hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ lóng ēng gûn chòe.
Tiâⁿ tang-pêng ê ûi khoah jī-cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh.
Ji̍p-kháu ê siang-pêng, ûi ê tn̂g lóng la̍k kong-chhioh la̍k-cha̍p kong-hun, tiàu ûi ê thiāu kok saⁿ ki, ū sún-khang ê tâng-chō kok saⁿ ê.
Tiâⁿ sì-bīn ê ûi lóng sī ēng so--kè ê iù-môa chòe--ê.
Thiāu ê chō sī tâng--ê, thiāu ê kau-á kap hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ sī gûn--ê; thiāu-táu sī ēng gûn pau--ê; tiâⁿ só͘-ū ê thiāu lóng ēng gûn ê hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ liân-chiap--teh.

Tiâⁿ ji̍p-kháu ê mn̂g-lî sī ēng chhiah-siù ê chhiú-lō͘, ēng nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap so--kè ê iù-môa siù--ê; khoah káu kong-chhioh, koân-tō͘ kap tiâⁿ ê ûi kâng-khoán nn̄g kong-chhioh.
Tiàu mn̂g-lî ê thiāu ū sì ki, ū sún-khang ê tâng-chō ū sì ê; thiāu ê kau-á sī gûn--ê, thiāu-táu kap hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ ēng gûn pau--teh.
Hōe-bō͘ kap tiâⁿ chiu-ûi ê khi̍t-á lóng sī tâng--ê.
Ē-bīn chiah-ê sī Lī-bī -lâng chiàu Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng, keng-kè chè-si A-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-tha-má ê chí-tō, chheng-tiám khǹg iok-kūi ê hōe-bō͘ lāi-bīn khì-khū ê kì-lio̍k.
Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k, Hō͘-ní ê sun, O͘-lī ê kiáⁿ Pí-sat-lia̍t, ū oân-sêng Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se só͘ tio̍h chòe--ê.
I ê tâng-kang Tān chi-cho̍k, A-hi-sat-boat ê kiáⁿ A-hô-lī-a-pek sī tiau-khek-su, mā-sī siat-kè-su, chin gâu ēng nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap iù-môa chhiah-siù.
Ūi-tio̍h sèng-só͘ só͘-ū ê kang-thêng hōng-hiàn ê kim-á, chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kong-chhìn, lóng-chóng ū chi̍t-chheng kong-kun.
Hōe-chiòng tiong-kan tiám-sǹg--kè ê lâng só͘ hiàn ê gûn, chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kong-chhìn, ū saⁿ-chheng sì-pah saⁿ-cha̍p kong-kun.
Jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng ū teng-kì--ê, chóng-kiōng la̍k-cha̍p-bān saⁿ-chheng gō͘-pah gō͘-cha̍p lâng; chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kong-chhìn, ta̍k-ê lâng hōng-hiàn la̍k kong-khek ê gûn.
In ēng saⁿ-chheng sì-pah kong-kun ê gûn, chù sèng-só͘ kap tiùⁿ-lî ū sún-khang ê chō, chóng-kiōng chi̍t-pah ê; ta̍k-ê chō saⁿ-cha̍p-sì kong-kun.
Hiah-ê chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê saⁿ-cha̍p kong-kun ê gûn, Pí-sat-lia̍t ēng lâi chòe thiāu ê kau-á, pau téng-bīn ê thiāu-táu, chòe hoâiⁿ-koaiⁿ.
Hōe-chiòng hōng-hiàn ê tâng ū nn̄g-chheng sì-pah jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-kun.
In ēng chiah-ê tâng chòe hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu ū sún-khang ê chō, chè-tôaⁿ, chè-tôaⁿ ê tâng-bāng, kap chè-tôaⁿ só͘-ū ê khì-khū,
í-ki̍p tiâⁿ sì-ûi ê chō kap tiâⁿ ê mn̂g ê chō, hōe-bō͘ kap tiâⁿ sì-ûi lóng-chóng ê khi̍t-á.
Chiah-ê sai-hū chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù, ēng nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, ēng iù-kang chòe A-lûn tī sèng-só͘ ho̍k-sāi beh chhēng ê sèng ê lé-ho̍k.
In ēng kim-sòaⁿ, kap nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, í-ki̍p so--kè ê iù-môa chòe í-hut-tek;
chiū-sī chiong kim-á phah hō͘ po̍h-po̍h-po̍h, chián chòe sòaⁿ, chham tī nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap iù-môa, ēng kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘ chit chòe-hé.
In koh chòe keng-tòa, kap í-hut-tek ê siang-pêng liân chòe-hé.

Í-hut-tek ê io-tòa kap í-hut-tek kâng-khoán ēng kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘, ēng kim-sòaⁿ kap nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, í-ki̍p so--kè ê iù-môa chit--khí-lâi, kap í-hut-tek liân-chòe chi̍t ê, lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.
In koh tok nn̄g tè âng-bé-ló, siuⁿ tī kim-kheng--ni̍h, ēng khek ìn-á ê chhiú-lō͘ chiong Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ ê miâ khek tī hit téng-bīn;
an tī í-hut-tek ê keng-tòa, chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê kì-liām-chio̍h; lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.

In chòe chi̍t ê phòaⁿ-toàn ê heng-tē, ēng kap chòe í-hut-tek kâng-khoán kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘, ēng kim-sòaⁿ kap nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, í-ki̍p so--kè ê iù-môa chòe.
Heng-tē sī sù-hong--ê, áu siang-têng; tn̂g khoah lóng jī-cha̍p-jī kong-hun.
Heng-tē téng-bīn siuⁿ sì chōa pó-chio̍h; tē-it chōa sī âng-pó-chio̍h, n̂g-ge̍k, chhiah-ge̍k;
tē-jī chōa sī le̍k-pó-chio̍h, nâ-pó-chio̍h, kim-kong-chio̍h;
tē-saⁿ chōa sī chí-bé-ló, pe̍h-bé-ló, chí-sek ê chúi-chiⁿ;
tē-sì chōa sī chhiⁿ-ge̍k, âng-bé-ló, phek-ge̍k; chiah-ê lóng siuⁿ tī kim-kheng.
Chiah-ê pó-chio̍h chiàu Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ ê miâ, kiōng cha̍p-jī tè, ēng khek ìn-á ê chhiú-lō͘, ta̍k-tè khek chi̍t ê miâ, tāi-piáu cha̍p-jī chi-cho̍k.
In ēng sûn-kim phah nn̄g tiâu liān-á, chhin-chhiūⁿ ká soh-á, an tī heng-tē.
In koh chòe nn̄g ê kim ê kheng kap nn̄g ê kim-khoân, chiong chit nn̄g ê khoân an tī heng-tē ê siang-thâu,
chiong hit nn̄g tiâu kim-liān-á liân tī heng-tē siang-thâu nn̄g ê khoân,
ēng nn̄g tiâu liān-á ê siang-thâu liân tī nn̄g ê kheng, an tī í-hut-tek keng-tòa ê thâu-chêng.
In chòe nn̄g ê kim-khoân, an tī heng-tē siang-thâu ê kîⁿ, kūn í-hut-tek ǹg lāi-bīn hit-pêng.
Koh chòe nn̄g ê kim-khoân, an tī í-hut-tek thâu-chêng ê keng-tòa ē-bīn, óa-kūn saⁿ-liân ê só͘-chāi, ēng kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘ chit ê í-hut-tek ê tòa téng-bīn.

In ēng nâ-sek ê iù-tòa, chiong heng-tē ê khoân kap í-hut-tek ê khoân pa̍k chòe-hé, tah tī ēng kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘ chit ê í-hut-tek ê tòa, chiong heng-tē kap í-hut-tek kò͘-tēng--teh. Chiah-ê lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.
In ēng chit-pò͘ ê hong-hoat chòe chhēng tī í-hut-tek lāi-bīn ê gōa-phàu, kui-niá sī nâ-sek--ê.
Phàu téng-bīn ê tùi-tiong, ūi-tio̍h thâu-khak lâu chi̍t ê khang, chiu-ûi chit niá-iân, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiàn-kah ê niá-khang, chiah bián phòa-li̍h.
Phàu ê ē-kha-pô͘ ēng nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se chòe sia̍h-liû.
Koh ēng sûn-kim chòe giang-lêng-á, hē tī sia̍h-liû kap sia̍h-liû ê tiong-kan;

phàu kui-ê ē-kha-pô͘, chi̍t ê giang-lêng-á chi̍t lia̍p sia̍h-liû, chi̍t ê giang-lêng-á chi̍t lia̍p sia̍h-liû, thang chhēng lâi ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú. Chiah-ê lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.
In ēng chit-pò͘ ê hong-hoat ūi A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ chòe iù-môa ê lāi-phàu,
lé-bō, kap thâu-kun, ēng so--kè ê iù-môa chòe lé-khò͘.
Koh ēng so--kè ê iù-môa, kap nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, ēng chhiah-siù ê chhiú-lō͘ chòe io-tòa; chiah-ê lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.
In ēng sûn-kim chòe lé-bō ê pâi, ēng khek ìn-á ê chhiú-lō͘ khek “Sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú”.
Koh ēng chi̍t tiâu nâ-sek ê tòa, chiong hit-tè pâi pa̍k tī lé-bō ê thâu-chêng; chiah-ê lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.
Án-ni, hōe-bō͘ ê pò͘-pîⁿ só͘-ū ê kang-thêng lóng oân-sêng. Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se só͘ tio̍h chòe--ê, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng chiàu án-ni chòe.
In chiong hōe-bō͘, chiū-sī pò͘-phâng kap só͘-ū ê khì-khū sàng-khì Mô͘-se hia, ū kau-á, pán, hoâiⁿ-kông, thiāu, ū sún-khang ê chō,
khàm pò͘-phâng ní-chòe âng-sek ê iûⁿ-káng ê phê kap siōng-téng ê phê, jia iok-kūi ê kòa ê tiùⁿ-lî,
iok-kūi kap i ê kǹg, i ê kòa,
pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê toh kap i ê khì-khū, hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ,
sûn-kim ê teng-tâi kap i ê teng-chóaⁿ, teng-tâi ê khì-khū kap tiám-teng ê iû,
kim ê hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ, thang boah ê sèng-iû kap phang ê hiuⁿ-liāu, hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-lî,
tâng ê chè-tôaⁿ kap tâng ê bāng-á, chè-tôaⁿ ê kǹg kap tôaⁿ só͘-ū ê khì-khū, sóe-tn̄g ê phûn kap phûn-chō,
tiâⁿ sì-ûi ê ûi kap i ê thiāu, ū sún-khang ê chō kap tiâⁿ ê mn̂g-lî, khi̍t-á kap soh-á, pò͘-phâng kap hōe-bō͘ lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê khì-khū,
í-ki̍p iù-kang chòe ê lé-ho̍k, chiū-sī chè-si A-lûn tī sèng-só͘ chhēng lâi ho̍k-sāi ê sèng ê lé-ho̍k, kap i ê kiáⁿ chòe chè-si teh chhēng ê lé-ho̍k.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se só͘ tio̍h chòe--ê, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng chiàu án-ni chòe.
Mô͘-se khòaⁿ-tio̍h só͘-ū ê kang-thêng, lóng ū chiàu Siōng Chú ê hoan-hù oân-sêng, chiū kā in chiok-hok.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se, kóng,
“Chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-it, lí tio̍h chiong hōe-bō͘ ê pò͘-pîⁿ tah--khí-lâi.
Tio̍h chiong iok-kūi hē tī hit lāi-bīn, ēng tiùⁿ-lî kā i keh-khui;
chiong pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê toh poaⁿ--ji̍p-khì, kā toh-téng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ pâi hó-sè; mā chiong teng-tâi poaⁿ--ji̍p-khì, kā teng tiám-to̍h.
Tio̍h chiong sio-hiuⁿ ê kim-tôaⁿ hē tī iok-kūi ê thâu-chêng, jiân-āu kòa hōe-bō͘ ji̍p-kháu ê mn̂g-lî;
chiong sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ hē tī hōe-bō͘ ê pò͘-pîⁿ mn̂g-kháu;
chiong sóe-tn̄g ê phûn hē tī hōe-bō͘ kap chè-tôaⁿ ê tiong-kan, lāi-bīn tóe chúi.
Sèng-só͘ ê sì-ûi tio̍h ū tiâⁿ, tiâⁿ ê ji̍p-kháu tio̍h kòa mn̂g-lî.
“Lí tio̍h ēng sèng-iû boah hōe-bō͘ kap lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê khì-khū, chiong hōe-bō͘ kap lóng-chóng ê khì-khū hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, chiah-ê chiū lóng chiâⁿ-chòe sèng.
Koh boah sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ kap i lóng-chóng ê khì-khū, kā tôaⁿ hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, tôaⁿ chiū chiâⁿ-chòe chì-sèng;
mā tio̍h boah sóe-tn̄g ê phûn kap phûn-chō, kā in hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng.
“Lí tio̍h chhōa A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ lâi hōe-bō͘ ê ji̍p-kháu, ēng chúi kā in sóe.
Mā tio̍h kā A-lûn chhēng sèng ê lé-ho̍k, kā i boah-iû, hō͘ i hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi góa.
Koh chhōa A-lûn ê kiáⁿ lâi, kā in chhēng lāi-phàu,
kā in boah-iû, chhin-chhiūⁿ kā in lāu-pē boah-iû kâng-khoán, hō͘ in chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi góa; in siū boah-iû, chiū sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán tit-tio̍h chè-si ê chit-hūn.”
Chiah-ê, Mô͘-se lóng chiàu Siōng chú ê hoan-hù chòe.
Tē-jī nî chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-it, hōe-bō͘ chiū tah--khí-lâi.
Mô͘-se tah hōe-bō͘, hē hiah-ê chō, khiā hiah-ê pán, chhng hiah-ê hoâiⁿ-kông, chhāi hiah-ê thiāu.
I tī hōe-bō͘ ê téng-bīn khàm pò͘-phâng, tī pò͘-phâng ê téng-bīn koh khàm siōng-téng ê phê, lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.
I koh chiong hoat-pán hē tī iok-kūi lāi-bīn, kā kǹg chhng tī iok-kūi siang-pêng, chiong kòa khàm tī iok-kūi téng-bīn,
kng iok-kūi ji̍p hōe-bō͘, kòa keh-khui ê tiùⁿ-lî jia iok-kūi, lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.
Mô͘-se chiong pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê toh poaⁿ-ji̍p hōe-bō͘, hē tī pò͘-pîⁿ ê pak-pêng, tī tiùⁿ-lî gōa-bīn;
toh-téng pâi hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê piáⁿ, lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.
I koh chiong teng-tâi hē tī hōe-bō͘ lāi, tī hōe-bō͘ ê lâm-pêng, toh ê tùi-bīn,
tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng tiám-teng; lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.
I koh chiong kim ê hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ hē tī hōe-bō͘ lāi-bīn, tiùⁿ-lî ê thâu-chêng;
tī hit téng-bīn sio phang-phang ê hiuⁿ; lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.

I tī hōe-bō͘ ê pò͘-pîⁿ ê ji̍p-kháu kòa mn̂g-lî, tī mn̂g-lî ê thâu-chêng hē sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ, tī hit téng-bīn hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap sò͘-chè; lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.
I chiong sóe-tn̄g ê phûn hē tī hōe-bō͘ kap chè-tôaⁿ ê tiong-kan, phûn-lāi tóe chúi.
Mô͘-se, A-lûn kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ ji̍p hōe-bō͘ á-sī óa-kūn tôaⁿ ê sî, seng tī hia sóe-chhiú, sóe-kha; lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù chòe.
Chòe-āu, Mô͘-se tī hōe-bō͘ kap chè-tôaⁿ ê chiu-ûi siat tiâⁿ, tī tiâⁿ ê ji̍p-kháu kòa mn̂g-lî. Án-ni, Mô͘-se chiū oân-sêng tah hōe-bō͘ ê kang-chok.
Hit-sî, hûn jia-khàm hōe-bō͘, Siōng Chú ê êng-kng chhiong-móa pò͘-pîⁿ.
Mô͘-se bōe-tàng ji̍p hōe-bō͘, in-ūi hûn thêng tī hit téng-bīn, koh Siōng Chú ê êng-kng chhiong-móa pò͘-pîⁿ.
Hûn tùi hōe-bō͘ seng-koân ê sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū chhut-hoat hiòng-chêng kiâⁿ.
Hûn nā thêng--teh, in chiū bô chhut-hoat, thèng-hāu kàu hûn seng-koân.
Ji̍t--sî, Siōng Chú ê hûn thêng tī hōe-bō͘ téng, mî--sî hûn-tiong ū hé; tī Í-sek-lia̍t choân-ke kui-ê hêng-thêng, in lóng ū chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h.
Siōng Chú tùi hōe-bō͘ kiò Mô͘-se, bēng-lēng i
tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pan-pò͘ ē-bīn ê tiâu-lē: Lín nā ū lâng beh hiàn cheng-siⁿ chòe lé-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú, tio̍h tùi gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn ê tiong-kan chhú-lâi hiàn.
I nā beh hiàn gû chòe sio-hòa-chè, tio̍h khan chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê gû-káng lâi, tī hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-kháu hiàn, chiū ōe tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú chiap-la̍p.
I tio̍h hōaⁿ-chhiú tī sio-hòa-chè ê cheng-siⁿ ê thâu-khak téng, án-ni sio-hòa-chè chiū siū chiap-la̍p, thòe i sio̍k-chōe.

I tio̍h tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng thâi hit-chiah gû-káng-á; A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi chòe chè-si--ê tio̍h hiàn hiah-ê huih, chiong huih hiù tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.
Hit-ê lâng tio̍h chiong sio-hòa-chè ê cheng-siⁿ ê phê pak--khí-lâi, kā bah chhiat-chòe chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè.
A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi chòe chè-si--ê tio̍h tī chè-tôaⁿ téng khí-hé, kā chhâ pâi tī hé ê téng-bīn,
koh chiong bah, thâu, iû pâi tī tôaⁿ-téng teh to̍h ê chhâ téng-bīn.

Hōng-hiàn ê lâng tio̍h chiong chè-mi̍h ê pak-lāi kap thúi ēng chúi sóe chheng-khì, chè-si chiū chiong kui-ê chè-mi̍h lóng hē tī tôaⁿ-téng chòe sio-hòa-chè, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Lâng nā beh hiàn mî-iûⁿ á-sī soaⁿ-iûⁿ chòe sio-hòa-chè, tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê iûⁿ-káng.
I tio̍h tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, tī chè-tôaⁿ ê pak-pêng thâi hit-chiah iûⁿ; A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi chòe chè-si--ê tio̍h chiong iûⁿ ê huih hiù tī tôaⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.
Hit-ê lâng tio̍h kā hit-chiah iûⁿ chhiat-chòe chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè. Āu-lâi, chè-si chiong hiah-ê bah liân thâu kap iû, pâi tī chè-tôaⁿ teh to̍h ê chhâ téng-bīn.

Hōng-hiàn ê lâng tio̍h chiong chè-mi̍h ê pak-lāi kap thúi ēng chúi sóe chheng-khì, chè-si chiū chiong kui-ê chè-mi̍h lóng hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Lâng nā beh hiàn chiáu-á chòe sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, tio̍h hiàn pan-kah á-sī hún-chiáu-á-kiáⁿ.
Chè-si tio̍h tòa chiáu-á lâi chè-tôaⁿ chêng, chūn-tn̄g i ê thâu, kā thâu sio tī tôaⁿ-téng; hō͘ chiáu-á ê huih tih tī tôaⁿ-piⁿ.
Koh tio̍h chiong chiáu-á ê kui kap lāi-bīn ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, hiat tī tôaⁿ-piⁿ ê tang-pêng piàⁿ hé-hu ê só͘-chāi.

Tio̍h kā chiáu-á nn̄g ki si̍t the̍h--teh, chiong chiáu-á thiah-khui, m̄-kú m̄-thang thiah-tn̄g; chè-si tio̍h chiong chiáu-á pâi tī chè-tôaⁿ teh to̍h ê chhâ téng-bīn, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Nā ū lâng beh hiàn sò͘-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, tio̍h ēng iù mī-hún chòe chè-mi̍h; tio̍h thîn iû tī mī-hún téng-bīn, koh hē jú-hiuⁿ.

I tio̍h chiong chiah-ê tòa-khì A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi chòe chè-si--ê hia; chè-si tio̍h mi chi̍t tōa-pé iù mī-hún, the̍h chi̍t-kóa iû kap só͘-ū ê jú-hiuⁿ, hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng, tāi-piáu só͘ hiàn ê sò͘-chè, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Sò͘-chè só͘ chhun--ê tio̍h kui hō͘ A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun; che sī chì-sèng--ê, in-ūi sī tùi ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h lâu--lo̍h-lâi--ê.
Lí nā beh hiàn hé-lô͘ hang--kè ê chè-mi̍h chòe sò͘-chè, tio̍h ēng chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chòe ê bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ, á-sī boah-iû ê bô-kàⁿ po̍h-piáⁿ.
Nā beh hiàn chian-pôaⁿ chian--kè ê chè-mi̍h chòe sò͘-chè, tio̍h ēng chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chian ê bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ.
Tio̍h kā i peh chòe sòe-tè sòe-tè, thîn iû tī téng-bīn; che sī sò͘-chè.
Nā beh hiàn tiáⁿ-á chian ê chè-mi̍h chòe sò͘-chè, tio̍h ēng chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chòe.
Tio̍h chiong chiah-ê sò͘-chè tòa-khì Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, kau-tài chè-si, hō͘ i tòa kàu chè-tôaⁿ.
Chè-si tio̍h tùi sò͘-chè ê tiong-kan the̍h chi̍t-pō͘-hūn hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng, tāi-piáu só͘ hiàn ê sò͘-chè, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Sò͘-chè só͘ chhun--ê tio̍h kui hō͘ A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun; che sī chì-sèng--ê, in-ūi sī tùi ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h lâu--lo̍h-lâi--ê.
Lín beh hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê sò͘-chè m̄-thang chham kàⁿ; in-ūi kàⁿ kap bi̍t lóng bōe-ēng-tit ēng hé sio chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Chiah-ê mi̍h lín thang hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú chòe khí-thâu-se̍k ê chè-mi̍h, m̄-kú m̄-thang tī chè-tôaⁿ téng kā i sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Sò͘-chè tio̍h ēng iâm tiâu-hô; só͘-ū ê sò͘-chè lóng tio̍h lām iâm, in-ūi iâm sī Siōng-tè kap lín li̍p-iok ê kì-hō. Só͘-ū ê chè-mi̍h lóng tio̍h ū iâm.
Lín nā ēng khí-thâu-se̍k ê ngó͘-kok chòe sò͘-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, tio̍h ēng hang--kè sin ê be̍h-sūi, á-sī lún--kè sin ê ngó͘-kok.
Tio̍h thîn iû tī hit téng-bīn, koh hē jú-hiuⁿ; che sī sò͘-chè.

Chè-si chiū tùi hit tiong-kan the̍h chi̍t-pō͘-hūn lún--kè sin ê ngó͘-kok, kap iû, í-ki̍p só͘-ū ê jú-hiuⁿ, tāi-piáu só͘ hiàn ê sò͘-chè, ēng hé sio chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Nā ū lâng beh hiàn gû chòe pêng-an-chè, tio̍h tùi gû-kûn ê tiong-kan chhú chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê gû-káng á-sī gû-bú, kā i khan-lâi Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.

Hit-ê lâng tio̍h hōaⁿ-chhiú tī hit-chiah gû ê thâu-khak téng, tī hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-kháu kā thâi. A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi chòe chè-si--ê, tio̍h chiong huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.

Hōng-hiàn ê lâng tio̍h tùi pêng-an-chè ê chè-mi̍h, chiong pak-lāi kap i téng-bīn ê iû, nn̄g lia̍p io-chí kap in piⁿ--á ê iû, í-ki̍p koaⁿ kap i ê bāng-se lóng the̍h--khí-lâi, ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
A-lûn ê kiáⁿ-sun chiū kā chiah-ê hē tī tôaⁿ--ni̍h teh to̍h ê chhâ téng-bīn, kap sio-hòa-chè chòe-hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h, hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Nā ū lâng beh hiàn iûⁿ chòe pêng-an-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, tio̍h tùi iûⁿ-kûn ê tiong-kan chhú chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê iûⁿ-káng á-sī iûⁿ-bú, kā i khan--lâi.
Hit-ê lâng nā beh hiàn mî-iûⁿ-á, tio̍h khan-lâi Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng,
hōaⁿ-chhiú tī hit-chiah iûⁿ-á ê thâu-khak téng, tī hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-kháu kā thâi. A-lûn ê kiáⁿ-sun tio̍h chiong huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.

Hōng-hiàn ê lâng tio̍h tùi pêng-an-chè ê chè-mi̍h chhú iû, chiū-sī chiong bé-tâng-kut í-hā kui-ki pûi ê bé, pak-lāi kap i téng-bīn ê iû, nn̄g lia̍p io-chí kap in piⁿ--á ê iû, í-ki̍p koaⁿ kap i ê bāng-se lóng the̍h--khí-lâi, thang chòe ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h.
Chè-si tio̍h chiong chiah-ê hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng, ēng hé sio chòe chia̍h-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Nā ū lâng beh hiàn soaⁿ-iûⁿ chòe chè-mi̍h, tio̍h khan-lâi Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng,
hōaⁿ-chhiú tī hit-chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ ê thâu-khak téng, tī hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-kháu kā thâi. A-lûn ê kiáⁿ-sun tio̍h chiong huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.

Hōng-hiàn ê lâng tio̍h chiong pak-lāi kap i téng-bīn ê iû, nn̄g lia̍p io-chí kap in piⁿ--á ê iû, í-ki̍p koaⁿ kap i ê bāng-se lóng the̍h--khí-lâi, thang chòe ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h.
Chè-si tio̍h chiong chiah-ê hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chia̍h-mi̍h. Só͘-ū ê iû lóng tio̍h kui Siōng Chú.
Lín bô-lūn tòa tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, iû kap huih lóng m̄-thang chia̍h; che beh chòe lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.
Siōng Chú koh bēng-lēng Mô͘-se

tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Nā ū lâng bô-ì-tiong hoān-chōe, ûi-hoān jīm-hô chi̍t hāng Siōng Chú só͘ bēng-lēng bōe-ēng-tit chòe ê sū, i tio̍h chiàu ē-bīn ê tiâu-lē pān-lí:
Tōa-chè-si nā hoān-chōe, liân-lūi jîn-bîn, chiū tio̍h in-ūi só͘ hoān ê chōe ēng bô hâ-chhû ê gû-káng-á hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè.
I tio̍h kā hit-chiah gû-káng-á khan-lâi Siōng Chú ê hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, hōaⁿ-chhiú tī gû-káng-á ê thâu-khak téng, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kā thâi.
Tōa-chè-si tio̍h kā chi̍t-kóa gû-káng-á ê huih the̍h-lâi hōe-bō͘,
ēng chńg-thâu-á ùn huih, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng tùi sèng-só͘ ê tiùⁿ-lî hiù chhit piàn.

I koh tio̍h ēng chi̍t-kóa huih, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng boah tī hōe-bō͘ lāi hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ ê sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak; jiân-āu chiong gû-káng-á chhun ê huih lóng tò tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ kha.
I tio̍h tùi hit-chiah sio̍k-chōe-chè ê gû-káng-á chhú iû, chiū-sī chiong pak-lāi kap i téng-bīn ê iû,
nn̄g lia̍p io-chí kap in piⁿ--á ê iû, í-ki̍p koaⁿ kap i ê bāng-se lóng the̍h--khí-lâi,
kap tùi pêng-an-chè ê gû-káng-á the̍h--khí-lâi ê choh-hoat kâng-khoán. I tio̍h chiong chiah-ê hē tī hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ téng sio.
Gû-káng-á ê phê, só͘-ū ê bah, í-ki̍p i ê thâu, thúi, pak-lāi, kap pùn,
chiū-sī kui-chiah gû-káng-á, tio̍h tòa chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa teh piàⁿ hé-hu, lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì ê só͘-chāi, hē tī teh to̍h ê chhâ téng-bīn sio.
Í-sek-lia̍t choân-thé hōe-chiòng nā bô-ì-tiong hoān-chōe, ûi-hoān jīm-hô chi̍t hāng Siōng Chú só͘ bēng-lēng bōe-ēng-tit chòe ê sū, m̄-kú hōe-chiòng iáu-bē hoat-kiàn,
kàu in chi̍t-ē chai ka-kī ū hoān-chōe, chiū tio̍h khan chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á lâi kàu hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu hiàn chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè.
Hōe-chiòng ê tiúⁿ-ló tio̍h tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, hōaⁿ-chhiú tī hit-chiah gû-káng-á ê thâu-khak téng, tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu kā thâi.
Tōa-chè-si tio̍h kā chi̍t-kóa gû-káng-á ê huih tòa-lâi hōe-bō͘,
ēng chńg-thâu-á ùn huih, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng tùi sèng-só͘ ê tiùⁿ-lî hiù chhit piàn.

I koh tio̍h ēng chi̍t-kóa huih, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng boah tī hōe-bō͘ lāi hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ ê sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak; jiân-āu chiong chhun ê huih lóng tò tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ kha.
I tio̍h chiong só͘-ū ê iû the̍h--khí-lâi, hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng sio.

Chit-chiah gû-káng-á chhú-lí ê hong-hoat, kap ūi-tio̍h tōa-chè-si sio̍k-chōe hit-chiah gû-káng-á ê choh-hoat kâng-khoán; tōa-chè-si tio̍h án-ni thòe in sio̍k-chōe, in chiū beh tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Chè-si tio̍h chiong gû-káng-á tòa chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa sio, chhin-chhiūⁿ sio thâu chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á án-ni. Che sī hōe-chiòng ê sio̍k-chōe-chè.
Nā ū koaⁿ-tiúⁿ bô-ì-tiong hoān-chōe, ûi-hoān jīm-hô chi̍t hāng Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè só͘ bēng-lēng bōe-ēng-tit chòe ê sū,
kàu i chi̍t-ē chai ka-kī ū hoān-chōe, chiū tio̍h khan chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe chè-mi̍h.

I tio̍h tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, hōaⁿ-chhiú tī soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng ê thâu-khak téng, tī thâi sio-hòa-chè ê cheng-siⁿ ê só͘-chāi thâi hit-chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng. Che sī sio̍k-chōe-chè.

Chè-si tio̍h ēng chńg-thâu-á ùn sio̍k-chōe-chè ê huih, boah tī hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak, koh chiong chhun ê huih lóng tò tī hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ kha.
Iûⁿ-káng-á só͘-ū ê iû tio̍h hē tī tôaⁿ-téng sio, kap chhú-lí pêng-an-chè ê iû ê choh-hoat kâng-khoán; chè-si án-ni ūi hit-ê lâng sio̍k-chōe, i chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Tòa tī chit-ê tōe ê jîn-bîn nā ū lâng bô-ì-tiong hoān-chōe, ûi-hoān jīm-hô chi̍t hāng Siōng Chú só͘ bēng-lēng bōe-ēng-tit chòe ê sū,
kàu i chi̍t-ē chai ka-kī ū hoān-chōe, chiū tio̍h ūi-tio̍h i ê chōe, hiàn chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú chòe chè-mi̍h.
I tio̍h hōaⁿ-chhiú tī hit-chiah sio̍k-chōe cheng-siⁿ ê thâu-khak téng, tī thâi sio-hòa-chè ê cheng-siⁿ ê só͘-chāi thâi hit-chiah sio̍k-chōe ê cheng-siⁿ.
Chè-si tio̍h ēng chńg-thâu-á ùn soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú ê huih, boah tī hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak; chhun ê huih lóng tio̍h tò tī chè-tôaⁿ kha.

Hōng-hiàn ê lâng tio̍h chiong só͘-ū ê iû the̍h--khí-lâi, kap the̍h pêng-an-chè cheng-siⁿ ê iû kâng-khoán. Chè-si tio̍h tī tôaⁿ-téng sio hiah-ê iû, chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. Chè-si án-ni ūi hit-ê lâng sio̍k-chōe, i chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Lâng nā beh hiàn mî-iûⁿ chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè ê chè-mi̍h, tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû bú ê mî-iûⁿ.
I tio̍h hōaⁿ-chhiú tī hit-chiah sio̍k-chōe cheng-siⁿ ê thâu-khak téng, tī thâi sio-hòa-chè ê cheng-siⁿ ê só͘-chāi thâi hit-chiah sio̍k-chōe ê cheng-siⁿ.
Chè-si tio̍h ēng chńg-thâu-á ùn mî-iûⁿ-bú ê huih, boah tī hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak; chhun ê huih lóng tio̍h tò tī chè-tôaⁿ kha.

Hōng-hiàn ê lâng tio̍h chiong só͘-ū ê iû lóng the̍h--khí-lâi, kap the̍h pêng-an-chè cheng-siⁿ ê iû kâng-khoán. Chè-si tio̍h tī tôaⁿ-téng ēng hé sio hiah-ê iû chòe chè-mi̍h, hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. Chè-si án-ni ūi hit-ê lâng sio̍k-chōe, i chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián.

Nā ū lâng siū iau-kiû tī kong-chiòng ê bīn-chêng, ūi-tio̍h só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h, só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiù-chōa ê sū choh-chèng, m̄-kú i m̄-khéng, i chiū ū chōe, tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.
Nā ū lâng bong-tio̍h bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h, bô-lūn sī iá-siù, cheng-siⁿ, á-sī thâng-thōa ê sin-si, sui-jiân i m̄ chai, i mā-sī bô chheng-khì, iû-goân ū chōe.
Nā ū lâng bong-tio̍h jīm-hô hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h, sui-jiân i m̄ chai, kàu i chi̍t-ē chai, chiū ū chōe.
Nā ū lâng sûi-piān chiù-chōa, bô-lūn chhut tī siān-ì á-sī ok-ì, sui-jiân i bô ì-sek-tio̍h ka-kī sûi-piān chiù-chōa, kàu i chi̍t-ē chai, chiū ū chōe.
Nā ū lâng hoān-tio̍h í-siōng chiah-ê sū ê jīm-hô chi̍t hāng, chiū tio̍h sêng-jīn ka-kī hoān--tio̍h ê chōe;

mā tio̍h in-ūi só͘ hoān ê chōe, chiong pê-chōe-chè ê chè-mi̍h tòa-lâi Siōng Chú bīn-chêng, chiū-sī tùi iûⁿ-kûn ê tiong-kan kéng chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-bú á-sī soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Chè-si tio̍h ūi-tio̍h hit-ê lâng sio̍k-chōe.

I nā bô-kàu-la̍t thang hiàn iûⁿ-á, chiū tio̍h in-ūi ka-kī hoān ê chōe, ēng nn̄g chiah pan-kah á-sī nn̄g chiah hún-chiáu-á-kiáⁿ, tòa-lâi kàu Siōng Chú bīn-chêng chòe pê-chōe-chè; chi̍t chiah chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, chi̍t chiah chòe sio-hòa-chè.
I tio̍h chiong chiah-ê tòa-khì chè-si hia; chè-si tio̍h seng hiàn sio̍k-chōe-chè, chūn-tn̄g chiáu-á ê ām-kún, m̄-kú m̄-thang hō͘ thâu lī-khui seng-khu.
Koh tio̍h chiong chiáu-á ê huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ piⁿ, hō͘ chhun ê huih tih tī chè-tôaⁿ kha. Che sī sio̍k-chōe-chè.
Sòa-chiap, i tio̍h chiàu kui-lē hiàn tē-jī chiah chòe sio-hòa-chè. Chè-si án-ni ūi hit-ê lâng sio̍k-chōe, i chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián.

I nā bô-kàu-la̍t thang hiàn nn̄g chiah pan-kah á-sī nn̄g chiah hún-chiáu-á-kiáⁿ, chiū tio̍h in-ūi i só͘ hoān ê chōe, hiàn chi̍t kong-kun ê iù mī-hún chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè; m̄-thang hē iû, mā m̄-thang chham jú-hiuⁿ, in-ūi che sī sio̍k-chōe-chè.

I tio̍h chiong chè-mi̍h tòa-khì chè-si hia; chè-si tio̍h mi chi̍t tōa-pé hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng, tāi-piáu só͘ hiàn ê sio̍k-chōe-chè, ēng hé sio chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. Che sī sio̍k-chōe-chè.

I tī chit kúi hāng sū ê tiong-kan ū hoān-tio̍h chi̍t hāng, chè-si tio̍h án-ni kā i sio̍k-chōe, i chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián; kap sò͘-chè siâng-khoán, só͘ hiàn chhun ê iù mī-hún lóng kui hō͘ chè-si.
Siōng Chú koh bēng-lēng Mô͘-se pan-pò͘ í-hā chiah-ê tiâu-lē:

Nā ū lâng m̄-sī thiau-kò͘-ì, bô hiàn eng-kai hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h tì-kàu hoān-chōe, tio̍h tùi iûⁿ-kûn tiong hōng-hiàn chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê mî-iûⁿ-káng, á-sī kun-kù sèng-só͘ ê kong-chhìn, hiàn kap hit-chiah iûⁿ kâng-khoán kè-ta̍t ê gûn chòe pê-chōe-chè;

koh in-ūi i tī beh hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h hoān-chōe, tio̍h ke gō͘-hūn-chi̍t kau hō͘ chè-si, pó͘ i ê kè-sit. Chè-si tio̍h ēng pê-chōe-chè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng thòe i sio̍k-chōe, i chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián.

Nā ū lâng bô-ì-tiong hoān-chōe, ûi-hoān jīm-hô chi̍t hāng Siōng Chú só͘ bēng-lēng bōe-ēng-tit chòe ê sū, i sui-jiân m̄ chai, mā ū chōe, chiū tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.

I tio̍h chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kui-tēng, tùi iûⁿ-kûn tiong chhú chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê mî-iûⁿ-káng lâi, kau hō͘ chè-si chòe pê-chōe-chè, in-ūi i bô-ì-tiong hoān-chōe. Chè-si tio̍h thòe i sio̍k-chōe, i chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Che sī pê-chōe-chè, in-ūi i ū ûi-hoān Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng.
Siōng Chú koh bēng-lēng Mô͘-se pan-pò͘ í-hā chiah-ê tiâu-lē:

Nā ū lâng hoān-chōe tek-chōe Siōng Chú, bô-lūn tī tông-pau kià mi̍h-kiāⁿ á-sī tí-ah mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê sū bô siú sìn-iōng, á-sī chhiúⁿ lâng ê châi-bu̍t, á-sī khi-ap tông-pau,
á-sī khioh-tio̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ, phiàn--lâng koh chiù-chōa kóng sī i ê; lâng nā ū chòe jīm-hô chi̍t hāng chiah-ê sū, i chiū ū chōe.
I kì-jiân hoān-tio̍h téng-bīn chiah-ê chōe, chiū tio̍h chiong só͘ chhiúⁿ--ê, khi-ap tit--tio̍h-ê, lâng kià i--ê, khioh--tio̍h-ê,
pe̍h-chha̍t chiù-chōa tit--tio̍h-ê, choân-pō͘ hêng lâng, lēng-gōa koh ke gō͘-hūn-chi̍t; tī hō͘ lâng chhâ-chhut i ū kè-sit ê ji̍t, tio̍h hêng goân-lâi ê chú-lâng.

I mā tio̍h tùi iûⁿ-kûn tiong chhú chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê mî-iûⁿ-káng, á-sī chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kong-chhìn kó͘-kè iûⁿ ê kè-ta̍t, kau hō͘ chè-si, chòe pê-chōe-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Chè-si tio̍h tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng thòe i sio̍k-chōe; i só͘ chòe jīm-hô chi̍t hāng kè-sit, lóng ōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Siōng Chú koh bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
hoan-hù A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun pan-pò͘ sio-hòa-chè ê tiâu-lē: Sio-hòa-chè tio̍h tī chè-tôaⁿ téng sio; m̄-thang hō͘ tôaⁿ-téng ê hé hoa--khì, tio̍h kui-mî sio kàu thiⁿ-kng.
Chè-si tio̍h chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ kap khò͘, chiong chè-tôaⁿ sio sio-hòa-chè ê hé-hu siu--khí-lâi, hē tī tôaⁿ-piⁿ.
Āu-lâi tio̍h ōaⁿ-saⁿ, chiong hé-hu tòa chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa, tò tī lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì ê só͘-chāi.

Tôaⁿ-téng ê hé tio̍h put-sî hō͘ to̍h, m̄-thang hoa--khì. Chè-si tio̍h ta̍k chá-khí tī tôaⁿ-téng thiⁿ chhâ, koh chiong sio-hòa-chè pâi tī teh to̍h ê chhâ téng-bīn, mā tī hit téng-bīn sio pêng-an-chè ê iû.
Tôaⁿ-téng ê hé tio̍h put-sî hō͘ to̍h, m̄-thang hoa--khì.
Ē-bīn sī sò͘-chè ê tiâu-lē: A-lûn ê kiáⁿ-sun tio̍h chiong sò͘-chè the̍h-lâi chè-tôaⁿ chêng, hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.

I tio̍h tùi sò͘-chè mi chi̍t tōa-pé iù mī-hún, the̍h chi̍t-kóa iû kap só͘-ū ê jú-hiuⁿ, hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng sio, tāi-piáu só͘ hiàn ê sò͘-chè, chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun tio̍h chia̍h hiàn chhun ê sò͘-chè; m̄-thang chham kàⁿ chia̍h, koh tio̍h tī sèng ê só͘-chāi, chiū-sī hōe-bō͘ ê tiâⁿ chia̍h.
Hang-piáⁿ m̄-thang chham kàⁿ. Sò͘-chè ēng hé sio hōng-hiàn lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê chè-mi̍h, góa siúⁿ-sù hō͘ chè-si; kap sio̍k-chōe-chè, pê-chōe-chè kâng-khoán sī chì-sèng.

Chiah-ê ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi só͘-ū ê ta-po͘ kiáⁿ-sun lóng thang chia̍h, che sī in sè-sè-tāi-tāi èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h. Só͘-ū chiap-chhiok-tio̍h chiah-ê chè-mi̍h--ê, lóng beh chiâⁿ-chòe sèng.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se,

tī A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun siū boah-iû siat-li̍p chòe chè-si ê sî, tio̍h chiàu ta̍k-ji̍t teh hiàn ê sò͘-chè, hōng-hiàn chi̍t kong-kun ê iù mī-hún hō͘ Siōng Chú; chá-khí-sî chi̍t-pòaⁿ, ē-hng-sî chi̍t-pòaⁿ.
Iù mī-hún tio̍h tī chian-pôaⁿ chhiau-iû, chhiau hō͘ chiâu, the̍h-khì hang, pun-chòe chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè, hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú chòe phang-phang ê sò͘-chè.
A-lûn ê kiáⁿ-sun sòa-chiap i siū boah-iû siat-li̍p chòe tōa-chè-si--ê, tio̍h hiàn chit-ê chè, choân-pō͘ ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. Che sī éng-oán ê kui-lē.
Chè-si hōng-hiàn ê sò͘-chè tio̍h choân-pō͘ sio, bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se

tio̍h hoan-hù A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun pan-pò͘ sio̍k-chōe-chè ê tiâu-lē: Tio̍h tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, tī chè-tôaⁿ ê pak-pêng, thâi sio-hòa-chè cheng-siⁿ ê só͘-chāi, thâi sio̍k-chōe-chè ê cheng-siⁿ; che sī chì-sèng ê chè-mi̍h.
