Hiàn sio̍k-chōe-chè ê chè-si tio̍h tī sèng ê só͘-chāi, chiū-sī tī hōe-bō͘ ê tiâⁿ chia̍h chè-mi̍h.
Só͘-ū chiap-chhiok-tio̍h chiah-ê chè-mi̍h--ê, lóng chiâⁿ-chòe sèng. Nā ū saⁿ tih-tio̍h cheng-siⁿ ê huih, tio̍h tī hōe-bō͘ lāi sóe.
Nā ēng chho͘-hûi chú chè-bah, chú-liáu tio̍h kā kòng-phòa; nā ēng tâng ê khì-khū chú, chú-liáu chit-ê khì-khū tio̍h lù--kè, koh ēng chúi sóe--kè.
Chè-si ka-sio̍k ê ta-po͘-lâng lóng thang chia̍h chè-bah; che sī chì-sèng ê mi̍h.
M̄-kú sio̍k-chōe-chè ê huih nā tòa-ji̍p hōe-bō͘ ê sèng-só͘ chòe sio̍k-chōe ê lō͘-ēng, hiah-ê chè-bah m̄-thang chia̍h, tio̍h ēng hé sio.
Ē-bīn sī pê-chōe-chè ê tiâu-lē: Pê-chōe-chè sī chì-sèng--ê.
Tio̍h tī thâi sio-hòa-chè ê cheng-siⁿ ê só͘-chāi thâi pê-chōe-chè ê cheng-siⁿ; kā i ê huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.
I ê iû tio̍h lóng hiàn; kui-ki pûi ê bé, pak-lāi kap i téng-bīn ê iû,
nn̄g lia̍p io-chí kap in piⁿ--á ê iû, í-ki̍p koaⁿ kap i ê bāng-se tio̍h lóng the̍h--khí-lâi.
Chè-si tio̍h chiong chiah-ê hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng sio, chòe hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h. Che sī pê-chōe-chè.
Chè-si ka-sio̍k ê ta-po͘-lâng lóng thang tī hōe-bō͘ ê tiâⁿ chia̍h chè-bah; che sī chì-sèng--ê.
Pê-chōe-chè kap sio̍k-chōe-chè ê tiâu-lē siâng-khoán, chè-mi̍h kui tī hiàn chiah-ê chè ê chè-si.
Kâng-khoán, sio-hòa-chè ê cheng-siⁿ ê phê kui tī hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê chè-si.
Só͘-ū tī hé-lô͘ hang--ê, tī tiáⁿ-á á-sī chian-pôaⁿ chian ê sò͘-chè, lóng kui tī hiàn chit-ê chè ê chè-si.
Ū chhiau-iû--ê, kap bô chhiau-iû ê sò͘-chè, lóng tio̍h kui A-lûn ê kiáⁿ-sun, tāi-ke pîⁿ-pun.
Ē-bīn sī hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê pêng-an-chè ê tiâu-lē:

Nā ū lâng ūi-tio̍h kám-siā beh hiàn-chè, tio̍h ēng chhiau-iû ê bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ, boah-iû ê bô-kàⁿ po̍h-piáⁿ, kap chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chòe ê piáⁿ, kap siā-un-chè ê cheng-siⁿ chòe-hé hiàn.
Koh tio̍h hiàn ū-kàⁿ ê piáⁿ, kap ūi-tio̍h kám-siā hiàn ê pêng-an-chè chòe-hé hiàn.
Tio̍h tùi ta̍k-hāng beh hiàn ê piáⁿ the̍h chi̍t hūn gia̍h-koân chòe lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; chiah-ê mi̍h tio̍h kui tī hiù pêng-an-chè ê huih ê chè-si.
Ūi-tio̍h kám-siā hiàn ê pêng-an-chè ê bah, tio̍h tī hiàn-chè hit-ji̍t chia̍h, chi̍t-tiám-á to m̄-thang lâu kàu keh-chá-khí.
Nā ū lâng ūi-tio̍h siā-goān á-sī kam-sim hiàn-chè, hiàn ê chè-mi̍h tio̍h tī hiàn-chè hit-ji̍t chia̍h; chhun--ê keh-ji̍t iáu thang chia̍h,
m̄-kú chhun ê chè-bah kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t tio̍h sio-tiāu.

Nā ū lâng kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t iáu-teh chia̍h pêng-an-chè ê bah, i hiàn ê chè bōe siū Siōng-tè chiap-la̍p, mā bô sǹg i ū hiàn chit-ê chè; chiah-ê bah bô chheng-khì, chia̍h ê lâng tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.
Chè-bah nā kha̍p-tio̍h bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h, chiū m̄-thang chia̍h, tio̍h ēng hé sio-tiāu. Kî-tha ê chè-bah, lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì ê lâng lóng thang chia̍h.
Nā ū lâng pún-sin bô chheng-khì, koh chia̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê pêng-an-chè ê bah, chit-ê lâng tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut.

Nā ū lâng bong-tio̍h bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h, bô-lūn sī bô chheng-khì ê lâng, á-sī bô chheng-khì ê cheng-siⁿ, á-sī jīm-hô bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h, koh chia̍h-tio̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê pêng-an-chè ê bah, chit-ê lâng tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn tiong-kan kek-chhut.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Bô-lūn sī gû, mî-iûⁿ, soaⁿ-iûⁿ ê iû, lóng m̄-thang chia̍h.
Chū-jiân sí ê cheng-siⁿ ê iû, hō͘ iá-siù thiah-li̍h ê cheng-siⁿ ê iû, thang chòe pa̍t-hāng ê lō͘-ēng, m̄-kú chhian-bān m̄-thang chia̍h.
Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng chia̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ēng hé sio ê cheng-siⁿ ê iû, hit-ê lâng tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn tiong-kan kek-chhut.
Lín bô-lūn tòa tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, lóng m̄-thang chia̍h chiáu-á á-sī iá-siù ê huih.
Nā ū lâng chia̍h huih, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h huih, hit-ê lâng tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn tiong-kan kek-chhut.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Nā ū lâng beh hiàn pêng-an-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, tio̍h tùi i ê pêng-an-chè ê chè-mi̍h the̍h chi̍t-pō͘-hūn lâi hiàn.

I tio̍h chhin-chhiú tòa cheng-siⁿ ê iû kap heng-khám-bah, ēng hé sio chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, chiong heng-khám-bah tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng iô-iô--leh chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ I.
Chè-si tio̍h chiong iû hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng sio; heng-khám-bah kui tī A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun.
Lín tio̍h tùi lín ê pêng-an-chè the̍h chiàⁿ-pêng ê tōa-thúi gia̍h-koân chòe lé-mi̍h, kui hō͘ chè-si.
A-lûn ê kiáⁿ-sun tiong-kan, hiàn pêng-an-chè ê huih kap iû ê chè-si, thang tit-tio̍h chit-ê chiàⁿ-pêng ê tōa-thúi chòe in ê hūn-gia̍h.

Góa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pêng-an-chè ê tiong-kan, chiong chit-ê iô--kè ê heng-khám-bah kap the̍h-koân ê chiàⁿ-pêng tōa-thúi, hō͘ chè-si A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun, chòe in tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê hūn-gia̍h.

Chiah-ê chè-bah sī tùi ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h the̍h--chhut-lâi, chòe A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h, tùi in chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú ê ji̍t khai-sí.
Che chiū-sī lí kā in boah-iû siat-li̍p hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú bēng-lēng beh hō͘ in ê hūn-gia̍h, chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.
Í-siōng sī sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, sio̍k-chōe-chè, pê-chōe-chè, siat-li̍p chè-si ê chè, kap pêng-an-chè ê tiâu-lē.
Chiah-ê sī Mô͘-se tī Se-nāi ê khòng-iá hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hiàn chè-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú ê sî, Siōng Chú tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ bēng-lēng Mô͘-se --ê.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se, kóng,

“Lí tio̍h chhōa A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ lâi góa chia, mā tòa lé-ho̍k, thang boah ê sèng-iû, sio̍k-chōe-chè ê gû-káng chi̍t chiah, kap mî-iûⁿ-káng nn̄g chiah, bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ chi̍t nâ lâi.
Koh tiàu-chi̍p choân-thé hōe-chiòng lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu.”
Mô͘-se chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chòe, hōe-chiòng chiū chū-chi̍p tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu.
Mô͘-se kā hōe-chiòng kóng, “Ē-bīn sī Siōng Chú bēng-lēng lán tio̍h chòe ê sū.”
Mô͘-se chhōa A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ lâi, ēng chúi kā in sóe.

Mô͘-se kā A-lûn chhēng lāi-phàu, hâ io-tòa, chhēng gōa-phàu, tha̍h í-hut-tek, chiong ēng kî-khá ê chhiú-lō͘ chit ê í-hut-tek ê tòa kā i hâ, kā í-hut-tek pa̍k tī i ê seng-khu;
koh kā i tha̍h heng-tē, chiong O͘-lêng kap Thó͘-bêng hē tī heng-tē lāi-bīn,
kā i tì lé-bō, tī lé-bō ê téng-bīn an kim-pâi, hō͘ lé-bō chiâⁿ-chòe sèng-bō. Mô͘-se lóng chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng án-ni chòe.
Mô͘-se ēng thang boah ê sèng-iû boah hōe-bō͘ kap lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê khì-khū, kā in hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng;
koh ēng hit-ê iû hiù chè-tôaⁿ ê téng-bīn chhit piàn, boah chè-tôaⁿ kap i só͘-ū ê khì-khū, sóe-tn̄g ê phûn kap phûn-chō, kā in hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng;
koh ēng sèng-iû tò tī A-lûn ê thâu-khak téng, kā i àn-li̍p, hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng.
Mô͘-se chhōa A-lûn ê kiáⁿ lâi, kā in chhēng lāi-phàu, hâ io-tòa, pau thâu-kun. Mô͘-se lóng chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng án-ni chòe.
Mô͘-se khan sio̍k-chōe-chè ê gû-káng-á lâi; A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ hōaⁿ-chhiú tī hit-chiah gû-káng-á ê thâu-khak.

Mô͘-se chiū thâi hit-chiah gû, jiân-āu ēng chńg-thâu-á ùn huih, boah tī chè-tôaⁿ téng-bīn sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak, hō͘ tôaⁿ chheng-khì; chiong chhun ê huih tò tī chè-tôaⁿ kha, hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, kā i kiat-chēng.
Mô͘-se koh chiong gû-káng-á pak-lāi só͘-ū ê iû, koaⁿ ê bāng-se, nn̄g lia̍p io-chí, í-ki̍p io-chí téng-bīn ê iû, lóng hē tī tôaⁿ-téng sio.
Gû-káng-á ê phê, bah, kap pùn, i lóng tòa chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa sio. Mô͘-se lóng chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng án-ni chòe.
Mô͘-se khan sio-hòa-chè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng lâi; A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ hōaⁿ-chhiú tī hit-chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng ê thâu-khak.
Mô͘-se chiū thâi hit-chiah iûⁿ-káng, chiong iûⁿ ê huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ sì-chiu-ûi,
kā iûⁿ chhiat chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè; chiong thâu, kap kui-tè kui-tè ê bah, í-ki̍p iû lóng the̍h-khì sio.

I koh kā pak-lāi kap thúi ēng chúi sóe chheng-khì, chiong kui-chiah iûⁿ hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng sio; che sī sio-hòa-chè, sī ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h. Mô͘-se lóng chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chòe.
Mô͘-se koh khan tē-jī chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng lâi, chòe chè-si siū-chit-lé ê lō͘-ēng; A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ hōaⁿ-chhiú tī iûⁿ ê thâu-khak.
Mô͘-se chiū thâi hit-chiah iûⁿ-káng, the̍h chi̍t-kóa huih boah tī A-lûn chiàⁿ-pêng ê hī-chu, koh boah tī i chiàⁿ-chhiú kap chiàⁿ-kha ê tōa-thâu-bú.

I koh chhōa A-lûn ê kiáⁿ lâi, ēng chi̍t-kóa huih boah tī in chiàⁿ-pêng ê hī-chu, chiàⁿ-chhiú kap chiàⁿ-kha ê tōa-thâu-bú; jiân-āu chiong chhun ê huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.
I koh chhú iû, pûi ê bé, pak-lāi ê iû, koaⁿ ê bāng-se, nn̄g lia̍p io-chí kap io-chí ê iû, í-ki̍p chiàⁿ-thúi.

Koh tùi hit-kha hē tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng tóe bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ ê nâ-á, the̍h chi̍t tè bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ, chi̍t tè kiáu-iû ê piáⁿ, kap chi̍t tè po̍h-piáⁿ, hē tī iû kap chiàⁿ-pêng tōa-thúi ê téng-bīn.
Mô͘-se chiong chiah-ê hē tī A-lûn kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ ê chhiú, hō͘ in tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng iô-iô--leh chòe chè-mi̍h.
Mô͘-se tùi in ê chhiú chiap--kè-lâi, hē tī tôaⁿ-téng sio-hòa-chè ê téng-bīn sio. Che sī tī siū-chit-lé, ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h.

Mô͘-se the̍h iûⁿ ê heng-khám-bah, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng iô-iô--leh chòe chè-mi̍h; che sī siū-chit-lé ê iûⁿ ê tiong-kan, Mô͘-se èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h. Mô͘-se lóng chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chòe.
Mô͘-se the̍h thang boah ê sèng-iû kap chi̍t-kóa tôaⁿ-téng ê huih, hiù tī A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p in ê saⁿ, kā in kap in ê saⁿ hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng.

Mô͘-se tùi A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ kóng, “Lín tio̍h chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, tī hōe-bō͘ ê ji̍p-kháu chú chiah-ê bah, kap chè-si siū-chit-lé nâ-á lāi ê piáⁿ tī hia chòe-hé chia̍h.
Chia̍h chhun ê bah kap piáⁿ, lín tio̍h sio-tiāu.
Lín chhit ji̍t kú lóng m̄-thang lī-khui hōe-bō͘, ti̍t-kàu lín siū-chit-lé ê ji̍t-kî móa, in-ūi siū-chit-lé su-iàu chhit ji̍t.
Lín kin-á-ji̍t só͘ chòe--ê, sī chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, ūi-tio̍h beh kā lín sio̍k-chōe.
Chhit ji̍t kú lín tio̍h lâu tī hōe-bō͘ ji̍p-kháu, mî-ji̍t lóng tī hia; chun-siú Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, lín chiah bián sí. Siōng Chú án-ni bēng-lēng góa.”
A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ chiū chun-hêng Siōng Chú thong-kè Mô͘-se hō͘ in ê bēng-lēng.
Kàu tē-poeh ji̍t, chiū-sī siū-chit-lé liáu-āu ê keh-ji̍t, Mô͘-se tiàu A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló lâi.
Mô͘-se tùi A-lûn kóng, “Lí tio̍h khan chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio-hòa-chè, lóng tio̍h bô hâ-chhû--ê, hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.

Lí mā tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tio̍h chhú chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, koh chhú bô hâ-chhû chi̍t-hè ê gû-á-kiáⁿ kap mî-iûⁿ-á kok chi̍t chiah chòe sio-hòa-chè.

Koh tio̍h chhú chi̍t chiah gû-káng kap chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng chòe pêng-an-chè, kap chhiau-iû ê sò͘-chè chòe-hé hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. Kin-á-ji̍t Siōng Chú beh tùi lín hián-hiān.”
Án-ni, in chiàu Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng chiong chiah-ê tòa-lâi hōe-bō͘ thâu-chêng; choân-thé hōe-chiòng lóng óa-lâi khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.
Mô͘-se kóng, “Che sī Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, lín chiàu án-ni chòe, I ê êng-kng chiū beh tùi lín hián-hiān.”

Mô͘-se tùi A-lûn kóng, “Lí tio̍h lâi chè-tôaⁿ chêng, chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng hiàn lí ê sio̍k-chōe-chè kap sio-hòa-chè, ūi lí ka-kī kap jîn-bîn sio̍k-chōe, koh hiàn jîn-bîn ê chè-mi̍h ūi in sio̍k-chōe.”
A-lûn chiū lâi kàu tôaⁿ-chêng, thâi hit-chiah ūi i ka-kī chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè ê gû-káng-á.
A-lûn hiah-ê kiáⁿ phâng huih hō͘ i, i chiū ēng chńg-thâu-á ùn huih, boah tī chè-tôaⁿ téng-bīn sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak; chiong chhun ê huih tò tī chè-tôaⁿ kha.
I koh chiàu Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se --ê, chiong sio̍k-chōe-chè ê iû, io-chí, kap koaⁿ ê bāng-se, hē tī tôaⁿ-téng sio;
koh chiong bah kap phê the̍h-khì iâⁿ-gōa sio.
A-lûn koh thâi sio-hòa-chè ê cheng-siⁿ; i hiah-ê kiáⁿ phâng huih hō͘ i, i chiū chiong huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.
In koh chiong sio-hòa-chè cheng-siⁿ ê thâu kap chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè ê bah the̍h hō͘ A-lûn; i chiū kā chiah-ê hē tī tôaⁿ-téng sio.
I koh sóe pak-lāi kap tōa-thúi, hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng sio-hòa-chè ê téng-bīn sio.

A-lûn koh ūi-tio̍h jîn-bîn hiàn-chè. I khan hit-chiah ūi jîn-bîn chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng lâi, kā thâi, jiân-āu hiàn-chòe chè-mi̍h; choh-hoat kap hiàn thâu-chêng hit-chiah siâng-khoán.
I mā chiàu kui-lē hiàn sio-hòa-chè.
Chá-khí-sî ê sio-hòa-chè í-gōa, A-lûn koh hiàn sò͘-chè, tùi hit tiong-kan mi chi̍t pé mī-hún hē tī tôaⁿ-téng sio.
I koh thâi gû-káng kap mî-iûⁿ-káng, ūi jîn-bîn hiàn chòe pêng-an-chè; A-lûn hiah-ê kiáⁿ phâng huih hō͘ i, i chiū chiong huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.
In koh the̍h gû-káng kap mî-iûⁿ-káng ê iû, pûi ê bé, pak-lāi ê iû, io-chí, kap koaⁿ ê bāng-se hō͘ i.
In chiong chiah-ê iû hē tī heng-khám-bah téng-bīn, A-lûn chiū tī tôaⁿ-téng kā iû sio-tiāu.
A-lûn chiong chiah-ê heng-khám-bah kap chiàⁿ-pêng ê tōa-thúi, iô-iô--leh chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; lóng chiàu Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng chòe.
A-lûn hiàn sio̍k-chōe-chè, sio-hòa-chè, pêng-an-chè liáu-āu, ǹg jîn-bîn gia̍h siang-chhiú, kā in chiok-hok. I chiū tùi chè-tôaⁿ lo̍h--lâi.
Mô͘-se kap A-lûn ji̍p-khì hōe-bō͘ lāi, koh chhut-lâi kā jîn-bîn chiok-hok; Siōng Chú ê êng-kng tùi jîn-bîn hián-hiān.
Ū hé tùi Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng chhut--lâi, sio tôaⁿ-téng ê sio-hòa-chè kap iû; choân-thé jîn-bîn khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū hoan-ho͘, phak tī thô͘-kha kèng-pài.
A-lûn ê kiáⁿ Ná-tap kap A-pí-hō͘, the̍h in ka-kī ê hiuⁿ-lô͘, tóe hé kap hiuⁿ, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng hiàn bô sîn-sèng ê hé, m̄-sī Siōng Chú bēng-lēng in--ê.
Ū hé tùi Siōng Chú hoat-chhut, kā in sio-sí tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.

Mô͘-se tùi A-lûn kóng, “Siōng Chú bat án-ni kóng, ‘Chhin-kūn góa ê lâng tio̍h chun góa chòe sèng; tī choân-thé jîn-bîn ê bīn-chêng, góa beh tit-tio̍h êng-kng.’” A-lûn tiām-tiām bô kóng-ōe.
Mô͘-se kiò A-lûn ê a-chek O͘-siat ê kiáⁿ Bí-sa-lī kap Í-lī-sat-hoán lâi, kā in kóng, “Lín lâi, kā lín chit nn̄g ê chhin-lâng tùi sèng-só͘ lêng chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa.”
In nn̄g lâng chiū lâi, chiàu Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù, giú hit nn̄g ê si-thé ê phàu, kā in lêng chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa.

Mô͘-se tùi A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat, Í-tha-má kóng, “Lín m̄-thang kā thâu-mn̂g phah-sàm, m̄-thang thiah-li̍h saⁿ ai-siong, lín chiah bián sí, koh bián hō͘ Siōng Chú tùi hōe-chiòng hoat siū-khì; m̄-kú lín ê tông-pau Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thang ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú hoat-chhut ê hé ai-khàu.
Lín mā m̄-thang lī-khui hōe-bō͘, lín chiah bián sí, in-ūi lín sī hō͘ Siōng Chú boah-iû siat-li̍p--ê.” In chiū chiàu Mô͘-se ê ōe chòe.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù A-lûn kóng,
“Lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ ji̍p hōe-bō͘ ê sî, po̍h-chiú kāu-chiú lóng m̄-thang lim, lín chiah bián sí; che beh chòe lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē,
hō͘ lín thang hun-pia̍t sèng á-sī sio̍k, chheng-khì á-sī bô chheng-khì;
koh hō͘ lín thang chiong Siōng Chú thong-kè Mô͘-se bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng it-chhè ê kui-lē kà-sī in.”

Mô͘-se tùi A-lûn kap i só͘ chhun ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat kap Í-tha-má kóng, “Lín ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê sò͘-chè só͘ chhun--ê, tio̍h tī chè-tôaⁿ piⁿ chia̍h chiah-ê bô chham kàⁿ ê piáⁿ, in-ūi che sī chì-sèng--ê.

Lín tio̍h tī sèng ê só͘-chāi, chiū-sī hōe-bō͘ ê tiâⁿ chia̍h, in-ūi che sī ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h tiong-kan, lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h; che sī Siōng Chú hō͘ góa ê bēng-lēng.

Iô--kè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê heng-khám-bah kap gia̍h-koân hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê tōa-thúi, lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ lóng thang tī lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì ê só͘-chāi chòe-hé chia̍h; in-ūi chiah-ê sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pêng-an-chè ê tiong-kan, lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h.

In tio̍h chiong gia̍h-koân ê tōa-thúi, iô--kè ê heng-khám-bah, kap ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h ê iû chòe-hé tòa--lâi, iô-iô--leh hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; chiah-ê éng-oán chòe lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h; che sī Siōng Chú hō͘ góa ê bēng-lēng.”

Āu-lâi, Mô͘-se kip beh chhē hit-chiah chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng. Ná chai, í-keng sio--khì lah. Mô͘-se chiū tùi A-lûn iáu oa̍h--teh ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat kap Í-tha-má hoat siū-khì, kóng,

“Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ bô tī sèng ê só͘-chāi chia̍h chit-ê sio̍k-chōe-chè? Chit-ê sī chì-sèng--ê. Siōng Chú í-keng chiong chit-ê hō͘ lín, beh tû-khì hōe-chiòng ê chōe-kò, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kā in sio̍k-chōe.
Kì-jiân chè-mi̍h ê huih bô tòa-ji̍p sèng-só͘, lín chiū tio̍h chiàu góa ê bēng-lēng chia̍h.”

A-lûn tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t in tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng hiàn sio̍k-chōe-chè kap sio-hòa-chè, m̄-kú góa ū tú-tio̍h pi-chhám ê tāi-chì, nā chia̍h sio̍k-chōe-chè, Siōng Chú kiám ōe hoaⁿ-hí?”
Mô͘-se thiaⁿ-liáu, mā kám-kak ha̍p-lí.
Siōng Chú koh bēng-lēng Mô͘-se kap A-lûn
tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū pun-tôe koh hoan-chháu ê cheng-siⁿ, lín lóng thang chia̍h.
M̄-kú, lín m̄-thang chia̍h lo̍k-tô, chio̍h-hoan, kap thò͘-á, in-ūi in ū hoan-chháu bô pun-tôe, tùi lín sī bô chheng-khì.
Ti, ū pun-tôe, m̄-kú bô hoan-chháu, tùi lín sī bô chheng-khì.
Chiah-ê tōng-bu̍t ê bah lín m̄-thang chia̍h; in ê si-thé mā m̄-thang bong; chiah-ê tùi lín sī bô chheng-khì.
Chúi-tiong, bô-lūn sī hái--ni̍h á-sī hô--ni̍h, ū-kî ū-lân--ê, lín lóng thang chia̍h.
M̄-kú chúi-tiong, bô-lūn sī hái--ni̍h á-sī hô--ni̍h, bô-kî bô-lân--ê, lín lóng tio̍h khòaⁿ-chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê mi̍h.
Hiah-ê tùi lín thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê mi̍h, lín m̄-thang chia̍h in ê bah; in ê si-thé mā m̄-thang bong.
Só͘-ū chúi-lāi bô-kî bô-lân--ê, lín lóng tio̍h khòaⁿ-chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê.
Ē-bīn chiah-ê chiáu-lūi lín tio̍h khòaⁿ-chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê, lóng m̄-thang chia̍h: eng, hiau, tiau,
iân, sió-eng kap i ê lūi,
o͘-a kap i ê lūi,
tô-chiáu, iā-eng, hî-eng, chhiok-eng kap i ê lūi,
àm-kong-chiáu, lô͘-chî, ko͘-n̂g,
niau-thâu-eng, thê-ô͘, chhàu-thâu-eng,
ho̍h, pe̍h-lēng-si kap i ê lūi, tì-kè-chiáu, kap bi̍t-pô.
Só͘-ū ū-si̍t koh ēng sì kha teh pê--ê, sī thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê.
M̄-kú ū-si̍t, ēng sì kha teh pê, koh ū kha-thúi tī tōe-bīn teh thiàu--ê, lín thang chia̍h;
pau-koat chháu-meh, chháu-meh-kong, tō͘-peh-á, sih-sut-á, kap in ê lūi, lín lóng thang chia̍h.
M̄-kú ū-si̍t koh ēng sì kha teh pê--ê, lín m̄-thang chia̍h.
Ē-bīn chiah-ê lóng ōe hō͘ lín bô chheng-khì: Só͘-ū bong-tio̍h si-thé--ê, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng lóng bô chheng-khì.
Nā ū lâng poaⁿ-sóa si-thé, tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng lóng bô chheng-khì.
Só͘-ū ū pun-tôe bô hoan-chháu ê cheng-siⁿ, tùi lín sī bô chheng-khì; kā in bong--tio̍h-ê mā bô chheng-khì.
Só͘-ū ū sì kha, ēng kha-chiúⁿ teh kiâⁿ ê cháu-siù, tùi lín sī bô chheng-khì; bong-tio̍h in ê si-thé--ê, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng mā lóng bô chheng-khì.
Poaⁿ-sóa chiah-ê cháu-siù ê si-thé--ê, tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng lóng bô chheng-khì. Chiah-ê tùi lín lóng bô chheng-khì.
Ē-bīn chiah-ê tī tōe-chiūⁿ teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t, tùi lín sī bô chheng-khì--ê: chîⁿ-chhú, niáu-chhú, tō͘-tēng kap i ê lūi,
piah-hó͘, liông-chú, siān-lâng-á, siâ-i, piàn-sek-liông.
Í-siōng chiah-ê teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t, tùi lín sī bô chheng-khì; só͘-ū bong-tio̍h in ê si-thé--ê, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng lóng bô chheng-khì.
In ê si-thé nā lak tī ēng chhâ, pò͘, phê chòe ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, á-sī môa-tē, chiah-ê khì-khū chiū bô chheng-khì; tio̍h kā in chìm tī chúi--ni̍h, kàu ji̍t lo̍h chiah chheng-khì.
Chiah-ê si-thé nā lak tī chho͘-hûi lāi-bīn, hit lāi-bīn bô-lūn ū sím-mi̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ, chiū lóng bô chheng-khì; tio̍h chiong hit-ê chho͘-hûi phah-phòa.
Chia̍h-mi̍h nā bak-tio̍h bô chheng-khì ê khì-khū lāi-bīn ê chúi, hiah-ê chia̍h-mi̍h chiū bô chheng-khì, khì-khū lāi-bīn ōe-lim--tit ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ mā bô chheng-khì.

Hiah-ê si-thé ê chi̍t-pō͘-hūn nā lak tī sím-mi̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ, hit-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chiū bô chheng-khì; liân hang-lô͘ á-sī chàu mā tio̍h kòng-phòa, in-ūi í-keng bô chheng-khì, tùi lín mā bô chheng-khì.
Put-kò, chúi-chôaⁿ á-sī thiok-chúi-tî lāi-bīn nā ū si-thé, chúi iû-goân chheng-khì; m̄-kú kha̍p-tio̍h hit-ê si-thé--ê, chiū bô chheng-khì.
Si-thé ê chi̍t-pō͘-hūn nā lak tī beh iā ê chéng-chí, hiah-ê chéng-chí iû-goân chheng-khì.
Nā chúi í-keng kā hiah-ê chéng-chí phah-tâm, si-thé ê chi̍t-pō͘-hūn koh lak tī hit téng-bīn, hiah-ê chéng-chí tùi lín sī bô chheng-khì.
Lín thang chia̍h ê cheng-siⁿ nā sí, ū lâng bong-tio̍h i ê si-thé, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng lóng bô chheng-khì.

Nā ū lâng chia̍h hit-ê bah, tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng lóng bô chheng-khì; poaⁿ-sóa sí ê cheng-siⁿ--ê mā tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng lóng bô chheng-khì.
Só͘-ū tī tōe-chiūⁿ teh pê ê oa̍h-mi̍h, bô-lūn sī ēng pak-tó͘ sô--ê, ēng sì kha á-sī khah chōe kha teh kiâⁿ--ê, sī thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê, lóng m̄-thang chia̍h.
Lín m̄-thang in-ūi teh pê ê oa̍h-mi̍h, tì-kàu ka-kī chiâⁿ-chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê; mā m̄-thang hō͘ chiah-ê phah lâ-sâm, tì-kàu ka-kī bô chheng-khì.
Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, só͘-í lín tio̍h hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, in-ūi góa sī sèng; lín m̄-thang in-ūi tōe-chiūⁿ teh pê ê oa̍h-mi̍h hō͘ ka-kī bô chheng-khì.
Góa sī chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p ê Siōng Chú, beh chòe lín ê Siōng-tè; lín tio̍h sèng-kiat, in-ūi góa sī sèng-kiat.
Í-siōng sī koan-hē iá-siù, pe-chiáu, chúi-tiong ê oa̍h-mi̍h, í-ki̍p tī tōe-chiūⁿ teh pê ê oa̍h-mi̍h ê tiâu-lē.
Tio̍h hun-pia̍t chheng-khì--ê kap bô chheng-khì--ê, ōe-chia̍h--tit kap bōe-chia̍h--tit ê oa̍h-mi̍h.
Siōng Chú koh bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Nā ū hū-jîn-lâng hoâi-īn siⁿ hāu-siⁿ, i chiū bô chheng-khì chhit ji̍t, kap keng-kî lāi lâ-sâm ê ji̍t bô chheng-khì kâng-khoán.
Tē-poeh ji̍t, hit-ê eⁿ-á tio̍h siū kat-lé.
Hū-jîn-lâng iáu-teh lâu-huih, tio̍h tòa tī chhù--ni̍h saⁿ-cha̍p-saⁿ ji̍t; kiat-chēng ê ji̍t móa í-chêng, m̄-thang bong sèng ê mi̍h, mā m̄-thang ji̍p sèng-só͘.

I nā siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, chiū bô chheng-khì cha̍p-sì ji̍t, kap keng-kî ê sî bô chheng-khì kâng-khoán. I iáu-teh lâu-huih, tio̍h tòa tī chhù--ni̍h la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k ji̍t, chiah chheng-khì.

Kàu kiat-chēng ê ji̍t móa, bô-lūn siⁿ hāu-siⁿ á-sī cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, i tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah chi̍t-hè ê iûⁿ-á chòe sio-hòa-chè, chi̍t chiah hún-chiáu-á-kiáⁿ á-sī pan-kah chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè; tòa-lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, kau hō͘ chè-si.

Chè-si tio̍h chiong chiah-ê hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, ūi i sio̍k-chōe; i chiū bô koh in-ūi lâu-huih bô chheng-khì. Che chiū-sī hū-jîn-lâng siⁿ hāu-siⁿ á-sī cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ê tiâu-lē.

I nā bô-kàu-la̍t thang hiàn chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-á, chiū tio̍h ēng nn̄g chiah pan-kah á-sī hún-chiáu-á-kiáⁿ, chi̍t-chiah chòe sio-hòa-chè, chi̍t-chiah chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè; chè-si tio̍h thòe i sio̍k-chōe, i chiū chheng-khì.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kap A-lûn kóng:
Lâng ê phê-hu nā chéng, á-sī siⁿ-sián, á-sī piàn-sek, khó-lêng pìⁿ-chòe bâ-hong-pīⁿ, tio̍h kā i chhōa-khì chè-si A-lûn, á-sī A-lûn ê kiáⁿ-sun tiong chòe chè-si--ê hia.

Chè-si tio̍h giām hit-ê lâng phê-hu ê chèng-thâu; ū chèng-thâu ê só͘-chāi, mn̂g nā í-keng pìⁿ-pe̍h, chèng-thâu chhim ji̍p-khì bah-lāi, che chiū-sī bâ-hong-pīⁿ; chè-si kā i kiám-cha liáu, tio̍h soan-pò͘ i bô chheng-khì.
Hit-ê lâng ê phê-hu nā ū pe̍h-sek ê pan, khòaⁿ--khí-lâi bô chhim ji̍p-khì bah-lāi, i ê mn̂g mā bô pìⁿ-pe̍h, chè-si tio̍h chiong hit-ê lâng keh-lī chhit ji̍t.
Kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, chè-si tio̍h koh kā i kiám-cha; nā chèng-thâu bô thòaⁿ-khui, chè-si tio̍h koh kā i keh-lī chhit ji̍t.

Kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, chè-si tio̍h koh giām i; nā chèng-thâu khah siau, bô koh thòaⁿ-khui, chè-si tio̍h soan-pò͘ i chheng-khì, sī sián nā-tiāⁿ. Hit-ê lâng tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, chiū sǹg-chòe chheng-khì.
M̄-kú i hō͘ chè-si giām--kè, soan-pò͘ chheng-khì liáu-āu, sián nā thòaⁿ-khui, i tio̍h koh khì hō͘ chè-si kiám-cha.
Chè-si kā i kiám-cha, hoat-kiàn sián í-keng thòaⁿ-khui, chiū tio̍h soan-pò͘ i bô chheng-khì, sī bâ-hong.
Nā ū lâng í-keng ū bâ-hong ê chèng-thâu, chiū tio̍h chhōa i khì chè-si hia.
Chè-si tio̍h kā i kiám-cha; phê-hu nā ū só͘-chāi chéng koh pe̍h-pe̍h, mn̂g mā pìⁿ-pe̍h, tī chéng ê só͘-chāi siⁿ sin ê bah;
che chiū-sī bān-sèng ê bâ-hong. Chè-si tio̍h soan-pò͘ i bô chheng-khì, m̄-bián koh kā i keh-lī koan-chhat.
Bâ-hong nā thòaⁿ-khui, chè-si khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h ê só͘-chāi lóng thòaⁿ-khui,
chè-si tio̍h kā i siông-sè kiám-cha; nā hoat-kiàn i choân-sin ê phê-hu lóng pìⁿ-pe̍h, chiū tio̍h soan-pò͘ i chheng-khì.
I ê seng-khu nā chi̍t-ē chhut-hiān sin ê bah, i chiū bô chheng-khì.
Chè-si nā giām-tio̍h hit-ê lâng ū sin ê bah, tio̍h soan-pò͘ i bô chheng-khì, in-ūi sin ê bah sī bô chheng-khì, sī bâ-hong.
M̄-kú, sin ê bah nā ho̍k-goân pìⁿ-pe̍h, hit-ê lâng tio̍h lâi kìⁿ chè-si.
Chè-si tio̍h kā i kiám-cha; nā hoat-kiàn kám-jiám ê só͘-chāi í-keng pìⁿ-pe̍h, chè-si chiū tio̍h soan-pò͘ hit-ê lâng chòe chheng-khì; hit-ê lâng chiū chheng-khì.
Lâng nā siⁿ lia̍p-á ū i-hó,
āu-lâi siⁿ lia̍p-á ê só͘-chāi chéng koh pe̍h-pe̍h, á-sī pìⁿ hún-âng-á-sek, chiū tio̍h hō͘ chè-si giām.
Chè-si tio̍h kā i kiám-cha; nā hoat-kiàn chèng-thâu thòaⁿ-ji̍p bah-lāi, mn̂g pìⁿ-pe̍h, chè-si tio̍h soan-pò͘ i bô chheng-khì, sī bâ-hong siⁿ tī lia̍p-á lāi.
Chè-si kā i kiám-cha, nā hoat-kiàn hit téng-bīn ê mn̂g bô pìⁿ-pe̍h, mā bô thòaⁿ-ji̍p bah-lāi, koh ū khah siau, chè-si chiū tio̍h kā i keh-lī chhit ji̍t.
Chè-si nā hoat-kiàn pīⁿ ū tī phê-hu thòaⁿ-khui, chè-si tio̍h soan-pò͘ i bô chheng-khì, i ū tì-pīⁿ.
Hún-âng-á-sek ê pan nā bô thòaⁿ-khui, sī lia̍p-á ê jiah, chè-si chiū tio̍h soan-pò͘ i chheng-khì.
Nā ū lâng phê-hu hō͘ hé sio--tio̍h, sio--tio̍h ê só͘-chāi siⁿ sin ê bah, bah ū piàn-sek, bô-lūn sī pe̍h-sek tài hún-âng-á-sek, á-sī choân-pō͘ pe̍h-sek,

chè-si chiū tio̍h kā i kiám-cha; nā hoat-kiàn piàn-sek ê phê-hu ê mn̂g pìⁿ-pe̍h, koh chhim ji̍p-khì phê-hu lāi, che sī bâ-hong tī hé sio--tio̍h ê só͘-chāi hoat--khí-lâi, chè-si tio̍h soan-pò͘ i bô chheng-khì.
Chè-si kiám-cha liáu, nā piàn-sek ê só͘-chāi bô pe̍h-mn̂g, mā bô chhim ji̍p-khì phê-hu lāi, koh ū khah siau, chè-si chiū tio̍h kā i keh-lī koan-chhat chhit ji̍t.
Kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, chè-si tio̍h koh kā i kiám-cha; nā í-keng thòaⁿ-khui, sī tì-tio̍h bâ-hong, chè-si chiū tio̍h soan-pò͘ i bô chheng-khì.

Pe̍h-sek ê pan nā iáu tī goân-lâi ê só͘-chāi, bô thòaⁿ-khui, koh ū khah siau, sī hō͘ hé sio--tio̍h chéng--khí-lâi--ê, put-kò sī hé sio--tio̍h ê jiah, chè-si tio̍h soan-pò͘ i chheng-khì.
Bô-lūn lâm-lú, nā tī thâu-khak á-sī ē-hâi ū tì chèng-thâu,

chè-si tio̍h kā i kiám-cha; chèng-thâu nā chhim ji̍p-khì bah-lāi, hit-ūi ê mn̂g khah n̂g khah se, chè-si tio̍h soan-pò͘ i bô chheng-khì; che sī sián, chiū-sī thâu-khak á-sī ē-hâi ê bâ-hong.
Chè-si kiám-cha hit-ê sián, nā bô chhim ji̍p-khì bah-lāi, hit só͘-chāi mā bô o͘ ê thâu-mn̂g á-sī chhùi-chhiu, chè-si tio̍h kā hit-ê lâng keh-lī koan-chhat chhit ji̍t.
Kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, chè-si tio̍h koh kiám-cha chèng-thâu, sián nā bô thòaⁿ-khui, hit-ê só͘-chāi bô n̂g-sek ê thâu-mn̂g á-sī chhùi-chhiu, sián koh bô chhim ji̍p-khì bah-lāi,
hit-ê lâng tio̍h thì thâu-mn̂g á-sī chhùi-chhiu, m̄-kú m̄-thang thì-tio̍h sián; chè-si tio̍h koh kā i keh-lī chhit ji̍t.

Kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, chè-si tio̍h koh kiám-cha hit-ê sián; nā bô thòaⁿ-khui, mā bô chhim ji̍p-khì bah-lāi, chè-si chiū tio̍h soan-pò͘ i chheng-khì; hit-ê lâng tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, i chiū chheng-khì.
M̄-kú i chheng-khì í-āu, sián nā thòaⁿ-khui,
chè-si tio̍h koh kā i kiám-cha; sián nā í-keng thòaⁿ-khui, m̄-bián koh chhē n̂g ê thâu-mn̂g á-sī chhùi-chhiu, in-ūi hit-ê lâng í-keng bô chheng-khì.

Chiàu chè-si ê koan-chhat, sián nā bô thòaⁿ-khui, hit só͘-chāi ū hoat o͘ ê thâu-mn̂g á-sī chhùi-chhiu, sián í-keng hó, hit-ê lâng sī chheng-khì--ê; chè-si chiū tio̍h soan-pò͘ i chòe chheng-khì.
Bô-lūn lâm-lú, phê-hu nā khí pe̍h-pan,
chè-si tio̍h kā i kiám-cha; pe̍h-pan nā-sī hé-hu-sek, che sī pe̍h-tiō, hit-ê lâng sī chheng-khì--ê.
Nā ū lâng lak thâu-mn̂g, bô-lūn sī thuh-thâu á-sī thuh-hia̍h, iáu-sī chheng-khì.
Thuh-thâu á-sī thuh-hia̍h ê só͘-chāi nā chhut-hiān hún-âng-á-sek, sī bâ-hong siⁿ tī thâu-khak.
Chè-si tio̍h kā i kiám-cha; nā hoat-kiàn i ê thâu-khak bô mn̂g ê só͘-chāi chhut-hiān hún-âng-á-sek koh chéng-chéng, kap bâ-hong ê chèng-thâu kâng-khoán,
hit-ê lâng chiū-sī tì-tio̍h bâ-hong, sī bô chheng-khì; chè-si tio̍h soan-pò͘ i bô chheng-khì; i ê chèng-thâu siⁿ tī thâu-khak.
Tì-tio̍h bâ-hong ê lâng, saⁿ tio̍h thiah-li̍h, thâu-mn̂g tio̍h phah-sàm, ng-chhùi, hoah kóng, “Bô chheng-khì! Bô chheng-khì!”
I ê seng-khu nā iáu ū chèng-thâu, i chiū-sī bô chheng-khì; kì-jiân bô chheng-khì, i tio̍h tī iâⁿ-gōa ka-kī tòa.
Saⁿ nā siⁿ-ko͘, bô-lūn sī iûⁿ-mn̂g chhiah--ê, á-sī môa-se chit--ê, á-sī phê kap ēng phê chòe ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ,
nā siⁿ chhiⁿ-sek á-sī âng-sek ê ko͘, tio̍h hō͘ chè-si giām.
Chè-si tio̍h kā i kiám-cha, chiong siⁿ-ko͘ ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ lēng-gōa siu-khǹg chhit ji̍t.
Kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, chè-si tio̍h koh kā i kiám-cha; ko͘ nā tī chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ thòaⁿ-khui, sī siⁿ ok-sèng ê ko͘, lóng sī bô chheng-khì.

Hiah-ê siⁿ-ko͘ ê saⁿ, bô-lūn sī iûⁿ-mn̂g chhiah--ê, môa-se chit--ê, phê chòe--ê, á-sī ēng phê chòe ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, lóng tio̍h sio-tiāu; che sī ok-sèng ê ko͘, it-tēng tio̍h ēng hé sio-tiāu.
Chè-si koh kā i kiám-cha; ko͘ nā bô tī iûⁿ-mn̂g chhiah ê saⁿ, môa-se chit ê saⁿ, phê chòe ê saⁿ, á-sī tī ēng phê chòe ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ thòaⁿ-khui,
chè-si tio̍h hoan-hù lâng sóe hiah-ê siⁿ-ko͘ ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, koh kā in hun-khui siu-khǹg chhit ji̍t.

Siⁿ-ko͘ ê só͘-chāi sóe liáu-āu, chè-si tio̍h koh kā i kiám-cha; nā siⁿ-ko͘ ê só͘-chāi sek bô piàn, sui-jiân bô thòaⁿ-khui, hiah-ê iû-goân bô chheng-khì; bô-lūn ok-sèng ê ko͘ siⁿ tī lāi-bīn á-sī gōa-bīn, kui-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ lóng tio̍h ēng hé sio-tiāu.

M̄-kú sóe liáu-āu, chè-si kā i kiám-cha; nā sek ū khah chhián, chè-si tio̍h chiong siⁿ-ko͘ ê só͘-chāi tùi saⁿ, bô-lūn sī iûⁿ-mn̂g chhiah--ê á-sī môa-se chit--ê, á-sī phê chòe--ê, kā thiah--khí-lâi.
Nā saⁿ iáu ū ko͘, bô-lūn sī chit--ê, chhiah--ê, á-sī phê chòe ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, tio̍h ēng hé sio hiah-ê siⁿ-ko͘ ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ.
Lí sóe--kè ê saⁿ, bô-lūn sī chit--ê á-sī chhiah--ê, á-sī phê chòe ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, nā ko͘ í-keng bô--khì, tio̍h koh-chài sóe, chiū chheng-khì.
Í-siōng sī iú-koan ēng iûⁿ-mn̂g chhiah á-sī môa-se chit ê saⁿ, á-sī ēng phê chòe ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ siⁿ-ko͘ ê tiâu-lē, ēng lâi phòaⁿ-toàn chheng-khì á-sī bô chheng-khì.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se, kóng:
Bâ-hong pīⁿ-lâng tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê sî, tio̍h chiàu ē-bīn ê tiâu-lē chòe: Tio̍h kā i chhōa-khì kìⁿ chè-si.
Chè-si tio̍h chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa kā i kiám-cha; pīⁿ-lâng ê chèng-thâu nā í-keng hó,

chè-si tio̍h hoan-hù lâng ūi-tio̍h hit-ê beh tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê lâng, chhú nn̄g chiah lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì oa̍h-oa̍h ê chiáu, pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap gû-chhek-chháu;
koh hoan-hù lâng tī tóe oa̍h-chúi ê chho͘-hûi khì-khū téng-bīn thâi kî-tiong ê chi̍t chiah chiáu-á.

Jiân-āu, chè-si tio̍h lia̍h hit-chiah oa̍h-chiáu, kap pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ, chu-âng-sek ê se, í-ki̍p gû-chhek-chháu, chìm tī hit-chiah tī oa̍h-chúi téng-bīn thâi ê chiáu-á ê huih lāi-bīn.
I tio̍h chiong huih tī hit-ê beh tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê lâng ê seng-khu téng hiù chhit piàn, chiū soan-pò͘ i sī chheng-khì, koh kā hit-chiah oa̍h-chiáu pàng-khì iá-gōa.

Beh tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê lâng tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, chiong mn̂g lóng thì--khí-lâi, sóe seng-khu, i chiū chheng-khì. Jiân-āu, i thang ji̍p iâⁿ, m̄-kú tio̍h seng tī ka-kī ê pò͘-pîⁿ gōa tòa chhit ji̍t.
Kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, i tio̍h chiong kui seng-khu ê mn̂g thì--khí-lâi, pau-koat thâu-mn̂g, chhùi-chhiu, ba̍k-bâi, koh sóe-saⁿ, sóe seng-khu; án-ni i chiū oân-choân chheng-khì.

Tē-poeh ji̍t, i tio̍h tòa nn̄g chiah bô hâ-chhû ê iûⁿ-káng-á, kap chi̍t chiah chi̍t hè bô hâ-chhû ê iûⁿ-bú-á, koh the̍h saⁿ kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún, kap saⁿ-hūn-chi-it kong-seng ê iû lâi.
Chú-chhî kiat-chēng-lé ê chè-si tio̍h chhōa hit-ê beh tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê lâng, tòa hiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, khiā tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng.
Chè-si tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-káng-á kap saⁿ-hūn-chi-it kong-seng ê iû chòe pê-chōe-chè, kā iô-iô--leh chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.

I tio̍h tī thâi sio̍k-chōe-chè kap sio-hòa-chè cheng-siⁿ ê só͘-chāi, thâi hit-chiah iûⁿ-káng-á. Pê-chōe-chè kap sio̍k-chōe-chè kâng-khoán tio̍h kui hō͘ chè-si; che sī chì-sèng--ê.
Chè-si tio̍h the̍h chi̍t-kóa pê-chōe-chè ê huih, boah tī beh tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê lâng chiàⁿ-pêng ê hī-chu, í-ki̍p chiàⁿ-kha kap chiàⁿ-chhiú ê tōa-thâu-bú;
koh tùi hit saⁿ-hūn-chi-it kong-seng ê iû tò chi̍t-kóa tī ka-kī tò-chhiú ê chhiú-sim,
ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú chi̍t ki chńg-thâu-á ùn tò-pêng chhiú-sim ê iû, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng hiù iû chhit piàn.

Āu-lâi, i tio̍h koh ùn chhiú-sim ê iû, boah tī hit-ê beh tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê lâng chiàⁿ-pêng ê hī-chu, í-ki̍p chiàⁿ-kha kap chiàⁿ-chhiú ê tōa-thâu-bú, chiū-sī boah tī tú-chiah boah-kè pê-chōe-chè ê huih ê téng-bīn.
Chè-si tio̍h chiong chhiú-sim chhun ê iû, boah tī hit-ê beh tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê lâng ê thâu-khak téng. Chè-si chiū án-ni tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kā hit-ê lâng sio̍k-chōe.
Chè-si tio̍h ūi-tio̍h hit-ê beh tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê lâng hiàn sio̍k-chōe-chè, kā i sio̍k-chōe, jiân-āu thâi hit-chiah sio-hòa-chè ê cheng-siⁿ.
Chè-si tio̍h tī chè-tôaⁿ téng hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap sò͘-chè, ūi-tio̍h i sio̍k-chōe; i chiū chheng-khì.

Nā ū lâng sàn-chhiah, bōe-tàng chún-pī hiah chōe, chiū tio̍h tòa chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-káng-á chòe pê-chōe-chè, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng iô-iô--leh ūi i sio̍k-chōe; koh tio̍h tòa chi̍t kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún kap saⁿ-hūn-chi-it kong-seng ê iû chòe sò͘-chè;
koh chiàu ka-kī ê châi-le̍k chhú nn̄g chiah pan-kah á-sī hún-chiáu-á-kiáⁿ, chi̍t chiah chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, chi̍t chiah chòe sio-hòa-chè.
Tē-poeh ji̍t, i tio̍h chiong chiah-ê tòa-lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kau hō͘ chè-si, thang tit-tio̍h chheng-khì.
Chè-si tio̍h the̍h pê-chōe-chè ê iûⁿ-á kap saⁿ-hūn-chi-it kong-seng ê iû, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng iô-iô--leh chòe chè-mi̍h.

Chè-si tio̍h thâi pê-chōe-chè ê iûⁿ-á, the̍h chi̍t-kóa pê-chōe-chè ê huih, boah tī beh tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê lâng chiàⁿ-pêng ê hī-chu, í-ki̍p chiàⁿ-kha kap chiàⁿ-chhiú ê tōa-thâu-bú;
koh tò chi̍t-kóa iû tī ka-kī tò-chhiú ê chhiú-sim,
ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú chi̍t ki chńg-thâu-á ùn tò-pêng chhiú-sim ê iû, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng hiù chhit piàn.

Āu-lâi, i tio̍h koh ùn chhiú-sim ê iû, boah tī hit-ê beh tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê lâng chiàⁿ-pêng ê hī-chu, í-ki̍p chiàⁿ-kha kap chiàⁿ-chhiú ê tōa-thâu-bú, chiū-sī boah tī tú-chiah boah-kè pê-chōe-chè ê huih ê téng-bīn.
Chè-si tio̍h chiong chhiú-sim chhun ê iû, boah tī hit-ê beh tit-tio̍h chheng-khì ê lâng ê thâu-khak téng. I chiū án-ni tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kā hit-ê lâng sio̍k-chōe.
Hit-ê lâng tio̍h chiàu ka-kī ê châi-le̍k hiàn chi̍t chiah pan-kah á-sī hún-chiáu-á-kiáⁿ,

chiū-sī chiàu i ê khùi-la̍t, chi̍t chiah chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, chi̍t chiah chòe sio-hòa-chè, kap sò͘-chè chòe-hé hiàn. Chè-si chiū án-ni tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kā hit-ê lâng sio̍k-chōe.
Í-siōng sī ū lâng tì-tio̍h bâ-hong, ài tit-tio̍h chheng-khì, m̄-kú bô châi-le̍k chiàu kui-tēng hōng-hiàn lé-mi̍h só͘ tēng ê tiâu-lē.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se kap A-lûn, kóng:
Lín khì kàu góa siúⁿ-sù lín chòe ke-gia̍p ê Ka-lâm -tōe ê sî, góa hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h chòe ke-gia̍p ê tōe ê chhù nā siⁿ-ko͘,
chhù ê chú-lâng tio̍h khì kā chè-si pò-kò, kóng, “Goán chhù ká-ná ū siⁿ-ko͘.”

Chè-si ji̍p-khì hit-keng chhù kiám-cha í-chêng, tio̍h hoan-hù lâng chiong chhù piàⁿ-khang, chiah bián chhù-lāi só͘-ū ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ pìⁿ-chòe bô chheng-khì; āu-lâi i chiah ji̍p-khì kiám-cha hit-keng chhù.
Chè-si tio̍h kiám-cha hit-keng chhù siⁿ-ko͘ ê chêng-hêng; nā hoat-kiàn hit-keng chhù ê piah ū le̍k-sek á-sī âng-sek lap--lo̍h-khì ê hûn-jiah, chhim-ji̍p piah-lāi,
i tio̍h chhut-khì mn̂g-gōa, kā hit-keng chhù hong chhit ji̍t.
Tē-chhit ji̍t, chè-si tio̍h koh khì kiám-cha; nā hoat-kiàn siⁿ-ko͘ ê hûn-jiah ū thòaⁿ-khui,
i tio̍h hoan-hù lâng chiong hiah-ê siⁿ-ko͘ ê chio̍h-thâu ó͘--khí-lâi, hiat tī siâⁿ-gōa bô chheng-khì ê só͘-chāi;
koh hoan-hù lâng khau chhù-lāi sì-chiu-ûi ê piah; chiong khau--lo̍h-lâi ê he-thô͘ piàⁿ tī siâⁿ-gōa bô chheng-khì ê só͘-chāi;
jiân-āu ēng pa̍t só͘-chāi ê chio̍h-thâu, tāi-thòe hiah-ê ó͘--chhut-lâi ê chio̍h-thâu, koh ēng he-thô͘ boah hit-keng chhù.
Hit-keng chhù tī ó͘ chio̍h-thâu, khau piah, boah he-thô͘ liáu-āu, nā hoat-kiàn koh ū siⁿ-ko͘,
chè-si tio̍h koh ji̍p-khì kiám-cha; siⁿ-ko͘ ê chêng-hêng nā thòaⁿ kàu kui-keng chhù, hit-keng chhù sī jiám-tio̍h ok-sèng ê ko͘, sī bô chheng-khì.
Hit-keng chhù tio̍h thiah-tiāu, hiah-ê chio̍h-thâu, chhâ-liāu, kap só͘-ū ê he-thô͘ lóng tio̍h poaⁿ chhut-khì siâⁿ-gōa bô chheng-khì ê só͘-chāi.
Hit-keng chhù hong-ba̍t ê kî-kan, nā ū lâng ji̍p--khì, i tī ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
Tī hit-keng chhù khùn--kè, lim-chia̍h ê lâng lóng tio̍h sóe in ê saⁿ.

Hit-keng chhù boah he-thô͘ liáu-āu, chè-si tio̍h ji̍p-khì kiám-cha; siⁿ-ko͘ ê chêng-hêng nā bô thòaⁿ-khui, chè-si chiū tio̍h soan-pò͘ hit-keng chhù sī chheng-khì, in-ūi siⁿ-ko͘ ê chêng-hêng í-keng siau-sit.
Ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ hit-keng chhù tit-tio̍h chheng-khì, tio̍h chhú nn̄g chiah chiáu-á, pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap gû-chhek-chháu;
tio̍h tī tóe oa̍h-chúi ê chho͘-hûi ê khì-khū téng-bīn thâi kî-tiong ê chi̍t chiah chiáu-á.

Jiân-āu, chè-si tio̍h the̍h pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ, gû-chhek-chháu, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap hit-chiah oa̍h-chiáu, chìm tī hit-chiah thâi-sí ê chiáu-á ê huih kap oa̍h-chúi lāi-bīn, kā hit-keng chhù hiù chhit piàn.
I tio̍h ēng hit-chiah chiáu-á ê huih, oa̍h-chúi, oa̍h-chiáu, pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ, gû-chhek-chháu, kap chu-âng-sek ê se, kiat-chēng hit-keng chhù.
M̄-kú i tio̍h chiong hit-chiah oa̍h-chiáu pàng-khì siâⁿ-gōa ê iá-tōe; án-ni, i kā hit-keng chhù kiâⁿ kiat-chēng-lé, hit-keng chhù chiū chheng-khì.
Í-siōng sī iú-koan bâ-hong-pīⁿ, lia̍p-á,
saⁿ kap chhù siⁿ-ko͘,
phê-hu chéng, siⁿ-sián, pe̍h-pan só͘ li̍p ê tiâu-lē,
ēng lâi kàu-tō lâng chai sím-mi̍h sī chheng-khì, sím-mi̍h sī bô chheng-khì. Che sī koan-hē bâ-hong-pīⁿ ê tiâu-lē.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se kap A-lûn
tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kóng: Nā ū ta-po͘-lâng tì-tio̍h hā-siau, i chiū bô chheng-khì.
I in-ūi hā-siau, bô-lūn iáu-teh lâu, á-sī í-keng thêng-chí, lóng sī bô chheng-khì.
Tì-tio̍h hā-siau ê lâng, tó--kè ê bîn-chhn̂g kap chē--kè ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ lóng sī bô chheng-khì.
Bong-tio̍h i ê bîn-chhn̂g--ê, tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, koh sóe seng-khu, tī ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
Chē-tio̍h i chē--kè ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ--ê, tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, koh sóe seng-khu, tī ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
Bong-tio̍h i ê seng-khu--ê, tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, koh sóe seng-khu, tī ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
Chheng-khì ê lâng nā hō͘ i phùi-tio̍h chhùi-nōa, tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, koh sóe seng-khu, tī ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
I chē--kè ê oaⁿ mā-sī bô chheng-khì.

Bong-tio̍h i chē--kè ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ--ê, tī ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì. The̍h hiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ--ê, tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, koh sóe seng-khu, tī ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
I iáu-bē sóe-chhiú í-chêng hō͘ i bong--tio̍h ê lâng, tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, koh sóe seng-khu, tī ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
I bong--tio̍h ê chho͘-hûi tio̍h kòng hō͘ phòa; chhâ ê khì-khū tio̍h ēng chúi sóe.
Hā-siau ê lâng nā í-keng hó, ūi-tio̍h beh kiat-chēng ka-kī, tio̍h tán chhit ji̍t; i tio̍h sóe ka-kī ê saⁿ, ēng oa̍h-chúi sóe seng-khu, chiū tit-tio̍h chheng-khì.
Tē-poeh ji̍t, i tio̍h chiong nn̄g chiah pan-kah á-sī hún-chiáu-á-kiáⁿ, tòa-lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kau hō͘ chè-si.
Chè-si tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, chi̍t chiah chòe sio-hòa-chè; chè-si tio̍h ūi-tio̍h chit-ê lâng hā-siau ê pīⁿ tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kā i sio̍k-chōe.
Lâng nā sia̍p-cheng, tio̍h sóe seng-khu, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
Bak-tio̍h cheng-e̍k ê saⁿ á-sī phê ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, tio̍h ēng chúi sóe, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
Nā lâm-lú ū sèng-koan-hē, nn̄g ê lâng tio̍h sóe seng-khu, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
Lú-chú nā ge̍h-keng lâi, i it-tēng bô chheng-khì chhit ji̍t kú; só͘-ū bong-tio̍h i ê lâng, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
Tī i bô chheng-khì ê kî-kan, só͘-ū i tó--kè kap chē--kè ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ lóng sī bô chheng-khì.
Só͘-ū bong-tio̍h i ê bîn-chhn̂g--ê, tio̍h sóe-saⁿ, sóe seng-khu, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
Só͘-ū bong-tio̍h i chē--kè ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ--ê, tio̍h sóe-saⁿ, sóe seng-khu, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
Bô-lūn bong-tio̍h hit-ê lú-chú ê bîn-chhn̂g á-sī i chē--kè ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê lâng, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng lóng sī bô chheng-khì.
Ta-po͘-lâng nā kap ge̍h-keng lâi ê lú-chú ū sèng-koan-hē, bak-tio̍h i ê ge̍h-keng, tio̍h bô chheng-khì chhit ji̍t kú, tó--kè ê bîn-chhn̂g mā bô chheng-khì.
Lú-chú nā tī keng-kî í-gōa lâu-huih chin chōe ji̍t, á-sī keng-kî āu iáu-teh lâu-huih, i lâu-huih ê kî-kan kap tī keng-kî kâng-khoán bô chheng-khì.
Tī lâu-huih ê kî-kan, i tó--kè ê bîn-chhn̂g kap chē--kè ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ lóng bô chheng-khì, kap tī keng-kî tiong-kan ê bô chheng-khì kâng-khoán.
Só͘-ū bong-tio̍h hiah-ê mi̍h ê lâng chiū bô chheng-khì; tio̍h sóe i ê saⁿ, sóe seng-khu, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng sī bô chheng-khì.
Lú-chú hiat-lāu nā í-keng hó, ka-kī tio̍h sǹg chhit ji̍t, i chiah chheng-khì.
Tē-poeh ji̍t, i tio̍h tòa nn̄g chiah pan-kah á-sī hún-chiáu-á-kiáⁿ kàu hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, kau hō͘ chè-si.

Chè-si tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, chi̍t chiah chòe sio-hòa-chè; chè-si tio̍h ūi-tio̍h chit-ê lú-chú hiat-lāu ê bô chheng-khì, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kā i sio̍k-chōe.
Lín tio̍h kéng-kài Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng m̄-thang ûi-hoān kiat-chēng ê tiâu-lē, chiah bián in chiong góa tī in tiong-kan ê hōe-bō͘ phah lâ-sâm, tì-kàu in in-ūi bô chheng-khì sí.
Í-siōng sī koan-hē sia̍p-lāu tì-kàu bô chheng-khì ê tiâu-lē, pau-koat hā-siau kap sia̍p-cheng ê ta-po͘-lâng,
ge̍h-keng lâi ê lú-chú, kap tì-tio̍h sia̍p-lāu ê lâm-lú, í-ki̍p kap ge̍h-keng lâi ê lú-chú ū sèng-koan-hē ê lâng ê tiâu-lē.
A-lûn nn̄g ê kiáⁿ in-ūi bô chiàu kui-lē óa-kūn Siōng Chú, sí--khì; āu-lâi, Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se,

kóng: Tio̍h kā lí ê hiaⁿ-ko A-lûn kóng, m̄-thang tī kui-tēng ê sî-kan í-gōa ji̍p-khì sèng-só͘ ê tiùⁿ-lî lāi, kàu iok-kūi téng-bīn si-un-chō ê thâu-chêng, chiah bián sí; in-ūi góa beh tī si-un-chō téng-bīn ê hûn-tiong hián-hiān.
A-lûn beh ji̍p sèng-só͘ tio̍h chiàu án-ni chòe: Tòa chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio-hòa-chè.
I tio̍h sóe seng-khu, jiân-āu chhēng chè-si sèng ê lé-ho̍k, chiū-sī iù-môa-pò͘ ê lāi-phàu kap khò͘, hâ iù-môa-pò͘ ê tòa, tì iù-môa-pò͘ ê lé-bō.
A-lûn tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng ê tiong-kan chhú nn̄g chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio-hòa-chè.
I tio̍h ūi ka-kī kap i ê ka-cho̍k hiàn chi̍t chiah gû-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè,
koh chiong hit nn̄g chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng khan-lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.
A-lûn tio̍h ūi-tio̍h hit nn̄g chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng thiu-chhiam; chi̍t ki chhiam siá “Kui hō͘ Siōng Chú”, lēng-gōa chi̍t ki siá “Kui hō͘ A-sat-sià-le̍k ”.
A-lûn tio̍h chiong hit-chiah thiu--tio̍h kui hō͘ Siōng Chú ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, hiàn chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè.
Hit-chiah thiu--tio̍h kui hō͘ A-sat-sià-le̍k ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, tio̍h oa̍h-oa̍h khan-lâi Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, ēng lâi sio̍k-chōe, kā i pàng-khì khòng-iá kui hō͘ A-sat-sià-le̍k.
A-lûn tio̍h chiong hit-chiah beh ūi ka-kī kap i ê ka-cho̍k hiàn chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè ê gû-káng-á khan-lâi thâi;
koh tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ê chè-tôaⁿ the̍h tóe-móa teh to̍h ê hé-thòaⁿ ê hiuⁿ-lô͘, tòa chi̍t phóng géng kah iù-iù ê hiuⁿ-liāu, ji̍p-khì sèng-só͘ ê tiùⁿ-lî lāi;
jiân-āu tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng sio hiuⁿ-liāu, hō͘ hiuⁿ-ian jia iok-kūi téng ê si-un-chō, chiah bián i khòaⁿ--tio̍h lâi sí.
I tio̍h the̍h chi̍t-kóa gû-káng-á ê huih, ēng chńg-thâu-á ùn huih hiù si-un-chō ê tang-pêng, koh tùi si-un-chō ê chiàⁿ-bīn hiù chhit piàn.

A-lûn tio̍h koh thâi hit-chiah ūi-tio̍h jîn-bîn chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, tòa i ê huih ji̍p-khì tiùⁿ-lî lāi, chiong huih hiù tī si-un-chō ê téng-bīn kap thâu-chêng, kap hiù gû-káng ê huih kâng-khoán.

Koh tio̍h in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bô chheng-khì kap pōe-poān, chiū-sī in só͘-ū ê chōe, kā sèng-só͘ kiat-chēng; mā tio̍h chiàu án-ni kā hōe-bō͘ kiat-chēng, in-ūi hōe-bō͘ ū hō͘ in ê bô chheng-khì bak--tio̍h.

A-lûn ji̍p-khì sèng-só͘ sio̍k-chōe iáu-bē chhut--lâi í-chêng, hōe-bō͘ lāi m̄-thang ū lâng; i tio̍h tī sèng-só͘ lāi-bīn ūi-tio̍h ka-kī, i ê ka-cho̍k, kap Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng sio̍k-chōe.

Jiân-āu, i chhut-lâi Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ê chè-tôaⁿ hia, kā chè-tôaⁿ kiat-chēng. I tio̍h the̍h chi̍t-kóa gû-káng-á kap soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng ê huih, boah tī chè-tôaⁿ téng hit sì ki khiàu--khí-lâi ê kak;
koh tio̍h ēng chńg-thâu-á ùn huih tùi chè-tôaⁿ hiù chhit piàn, kā i kiat-chēng, thoat-lī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bô chheng-khì, koh kā i hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng.
A-lûn ūi-tio̍h sèng-só͘, hōe-bō͘, chè-tôaⁿ kiâⁿ kiat-chēng-lé liáu-āu, tio̍h khan hit-chiah oa̍h ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng lâi.

A-lûn tio̍h siang-chhiú hōaⁿ tī iûⁿ ê thâu-khak téng, sêng-jīn Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘-ū ê chōe-gia̍t kap pōe-poān, hō͘ in só͘ hoān ê chōe lóng kui tī hit-chiah iûⁿ ê thâu-khak, jiân-āu phài lâng kā i sàng-khì khòng-iá.
Hit-chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng beh tòa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘-ū ê chōe khì kàu bô lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi; hit-chiah iûⁿ chiū pàng tī khòng-iá.
Āu-lâi, A-lûn tio̍h ji̍p hōe-bō͘, chiong i ji̍p sèng-só͘ ê sî só͘ chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê lé-ho̍k thǹg--khí-lâi, lâu tī hia;
koh tio̍h tī hōe-bō͘ ê tiâⁿ sóe seng-khu, chhēng i ka-kī ê saⁿ chhut--lâi, hiàn i kap jîn-bîn ê sio-hòa-chè, ūi-tio̍h ka-kī kap jîn-bîn sio̍k-chōe.
Sio̍k-chōe-chè ê iû tio̍h tī chè-tôaⁿ téng sio.
Hit-ê pàng soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng kui hō͘ A-sat-sià-le̍k ê lâng, tio̍h sóe i ê saⁿ, sóe seng-khu, chiah thang ji̍p iâⁿ-lāi.

Chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè ê gû-káng kap soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, in ê huih tòa-ji̍p Chì-sèng-só͘ sio̍k-chōe liáu-āu, tio̍h kā in poaⁿ chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa, chiong phê, bah, kap pùn ēng hé sio-tiāu.
Sio chiah-ê mi̍h ê lâng tio̍h sóe i ê saⁿ, sóe seng-khu, chiah thang ji̍p iâⁿ-lāi.

Múi-nî ê chhit-ge̍h chhoe-cha̍p, lín tio̍h kìm-chia̍h khek-khó͘, bô-lūn sī chāi-tōe-lâng, á-sī kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, jīm-hô ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe; che beh chòe lín éng-oán ê kui-lē.
Tī chit-ji̍t beh kā lín sio̍k-chōe; lín beh tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng tit-tio̍h chheng-khì, só͘-ū ê chōe lóng tit-tio̍h kiat-chēng.
Chit-ji̍t lín tio̍h kā i khòaⁿ-chòe oân-choân hioh-khùn ê An-hioh-ji̍t, tio̍h kìm-chia̍h khek-khó͘; che beh chòe lín éng-oán ê kui-lē.
Hit-ê siū boah-iû siat-li̍p, sòa-chiap i ê lāu-pē chòe tōa-chè-si--ê, tio̍h chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ sèng ê lé-ho̍k, chip-hêng sio̍k-chōe-lé.
I tio̍h ūi-tio̍h Chì-sèng-só͘, hōe-bō͘ kap chè-tôaⁿ kiâⁿ kiat-chēng-lé, koh ūi-tio̍h chè-si kap choân-thé hōe-chiòng sio̍k-chōe.

Che tio̍h chòe lín éng-oán ê kui-lē, in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘-ū ê chōe, chi̍t nî chi̍t piàn beh tit-tio̍h kiat-chēng. A-lûn chiū chiàu Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se --ê khì chòe.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se, kóng,
“Lí tio̍h tùi A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng soan-pò͘ Siōng Chú bēng-lēng ê tiâu-lē:
Só͘-ū Í-sek-lia̍t -ke ê lâng, bô-lūn tī iâⁿ-lāi iâⁿ-gōa thâi gû-káng, mî-iûⁿ á-sī soaⁿ-iûⁿ,

nā bô seng khan-lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, tī Siōng Chú hōe-bō͘ ê thâu-chêng hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú chòe lé-mi̍h, thâi cheng-siⁿ ê chōe beh kui tī hit-ê lâng, in-ūi i ū lâu in ê huih; hit-ê lâng tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn tiong-kan kek-chhut.
In-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bat tī iá-gōa thâi cheng-siⁿ hiàn-chè; taⁿ tio̍h chiong cheng-siⁿ tòa-lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, kau hō͘ chè-si, hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú chòe pêng-an-chè.
Chè-si tio̍h chiong huih hiù tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu Siōng Chú ê chè-tôaⁿ, chiong iû sio chòe phang-phang ê chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng m̄-thang koh hiàn-chè hō͘ in kiâⁿ siâ-îm kèng-pài ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-kúi-mô͘. Che beh chòe lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.
“Lí tio̍h kā in hoan-hù, só͘-ū Í-sek-lia̍t -ke ê lâng, á-sī kià-ku tī in tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, hiàn sio-hòa-chè á-sī chè-mi̍h,
nā bô tòa-lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, hit-ê lâng tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut.”

Siōng Chú kóng, “Só͘-ū sio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t -ke ê lâng, á-sī kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, nā chia̍h huih, góa beh tùi hit-ê lâng pìⁿ-bīn, kā i tùi jîn-bîn tiong-kan kek-chhut.
Tōng-bu̍t ū huih chiah ū sìⁿ-miā; góa chiong huih hō͘ lín, sī beh ēng chit-ê huih tī chè-tôaⁿ téng ūi lín ê sìⁿ-miā sio̍k-chōe; in-ūi huih sī sìⁿ-miā, ōe-tàng sio̍k-chōe.
Só͘-í góa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng: Lín lóng bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h huih, kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng mā bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h huih.

“Só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, á-sī kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, nā phah-la̍h tit-tio̍h ōe-chia̍h--tit ê pe-chiáu kap cháu-siù, tio̍h kā i pàng huih, ēng thô͘ kā huih khàm--khí-lâi.

Só͘-ū ê tōng-bu̍t, huih sī i ê sìⁿ-miā, só͘-í góa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng: Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h tōng-bu̍t ê huih, lín lóng bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h. In-ūi tōng-bu̍t ū huih chiah ū sìⁿ-miā; chia̍h huih ê lâng it-tēng tio̍h siū kek-chhut.

“Nā ū lâng chia̍h chū-jiân sí á-sī hō͘ iá-siù thiah-li̍h ê tōng-bu̍t, bô-lūn sī chāi-tōe-lâng á-sī gōa-cho̍k-lâng lóng sī bô chheng-khì, tio̍h sóe i ê saⁿ, sóe seng-khu, kàu ji̍t lo̍h chiah chheng-khì.
M̄-kú i nā bô sóe-saⁿ, bô sóe seng-khu, tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.”
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.

Lín bat tòa-kè Ai-ki̍p, hia ê lâng ê hêng-ûi lín m̄-thang o̍h. Góa beh chhōa lín chìn-ji̍p Ka-lâm -tōe, hia ê lâng ê hêng-ûi lín m̄-thang chòe, mā m̄-thang tè in ê hong-sio̍k.
Lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng góa ê bēng-lēng kap kui-lē. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Lín tio̍h chun-siú góa ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng; lâng nā chun-siú chiah-ê, chiū ōe tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
Lín lóng m̄-thang kap kūn-chhin ū sèng-koan-hē. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
M̄-thang kap lāu-bú ū sèng-koan-hē, lâi lêng-jio̍k lí ê lāu-pē; i sī lí ê lāu-bú, m̄-thang lō͘-hiān i ê hā-thé.
M̄-thang kap lí ê lāu-pē kî-tha ê bó͘ ū sèng-koan-hē, lâi lêng-jio̍k lí ê lāu-pē.
M̄-thang kap lí ê chí-bē ū sèng-koan-hē, bô-lūn sī kâng-pē--ê á-sī kâng-bú--ê, tī chhù-lāi á-sī gōa-bīn siⁿ--ê, lóng m̄-thang lō͘-hiān in ê hā-thé.
M̄-thang kap lí ê cha-bó͘-sun, bô-lūn sī lāi-sun á-sī gōa-sun ū sèng-koan-hē, in-ūi in ê hā-thé sī lí ka-kī ê hā-thé.
M̄-thang kap kâng-pē bô kâng-bú ê chí-bē ū sèng-koan-hē.
M̄-thang kap lí ê a-ko͘ ū sèng-koan-hē; i sī lí ê lāu-pē ê kut-jio̍k chì-chhin.
M̄-thang kap lí ê a-î ū sèng-koan-hē; i sī lí ê lāu-bú ê kut-jio̍k chì-chhin.
M̄-thang kap lí ê a-ḿ, a-chím ū sèng-koan-hē.
M̄-thang kap lí ê sin-pū ū sèng-koan-hē.
M̄-thang kap lí ê hiaⁿ-só, tē-hū ū sèng-koan-hē.

Kap lí ū sèng-koan-hē ê cha-bó͘-lâng, lí m̄-thang koh kap i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ū sèng-koan-hē, mā m̄-thang chhōa hit-ê cha-bó͘-lâng ê cha-bó͘-sun chòe bó͘; in sī i ê kut-jio̍k chì-chhin. Che sī loān-lûn kiàn-siàu ê sū.
Bó͘ iáu oa̍h--teh, m̄-thang chhōa i ê chí-bē lâi chòe i ê tùi-thâu.
Hū-jîn-lâng keng-kî tiong bô chheng-khì ê sî, m̄-thang kap i ū sèng-koan-hē.
M̄-thang kap pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘ ū sèng-koan-hē lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī.
M̄-thang hiàn lí ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō͘ Mô͘-lo̍k. M̄-thang siat-to̍k lí ê Siōng-tè ê miâ. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
M̄-thang kap ta-po͘-lâng ū sèng-koan-hē, chhin-chhiūⁿ kap hū-jîn-lâng kâng-khoán; che sī chin thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê tāi-chì.
M̄-thang kap jīm-hô cheng-siⁿ kau-ha̍p lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī; hū-jîn-lâng mā m̄-thang kap cheng-siⁿ kau-ha̍p; che sī ûi-hoán chū-jiân ê tāi-chì.

Lín m̄-thang chòe í-siōng kìm-chí ê sū lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī; in-ūi góa teh-beh tī lín bīn-chêng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, ū chòe chiah-ê sū lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī.
In án-ni chòe mā ù-jiám thó͘-tōe, só͘-í góa hêng-hoa̍t thó͘-tōe, hō͘ thó͘-tōe chiong hiah-ê chū-bîn thò͘--chhut-khì.

Só͘-í lín tio̍h chun-siú góa ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng; chiah-ê thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, bô-lūn sī chāi-tōe-lâng, á-sī kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng lóng m̄-thang chòe.
Tī lín í-chêng chit-ê thó͘-tōe ê chū-bîn ū chòe chiah-ê thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, tōe soah siū ù-jiám.
Lín m̄-thang ù-jiám hit-ê thó͘-tōe, chiah bián tōe chiong lín thò͘--chhut-khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiong lín í-chêng ê chū-bîn thò͘--chhut-khì kâng-khoán.
Nā ū lâng chòe í-siōng kìm-chí ê sū, hit-ê lâng tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut.
Lín tio̍h chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng, chiah bián lín khì tè í-chêng ê chū-bîn thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê hong-sio̍k, soah phah lâ-sâm ka-kī. Góa chiū-sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Siōng Chú koh bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t choân-thé hōe-chiòng soan-pò͘: Lín tio̍h hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, in-ūi góa Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sī sèng.
Lín ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tio̍h kèng-tiōng lín ê lāu-bú lín ê lāu-pē. Lín tio̍h siú góa ê An-hioh-ji̍t. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Lín m̄-thang khì-sak góa khì pài ngó͘-siōng, mā m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h ka-kī chù-chō sîn-siōng. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Lín thâi cheng-siⁿ hiàn chòe pêng-an-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú ê sî, tio̍h chiàu kui-lē hiàn chè-mi̍h thang hō͘ Siōng Chú chiap-la̍p.
Chè-mi̍h tio̍h tī hōng-hiàn hit-ji̍t á-sī keh-ji̍t chia̍h; kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t nā iáu ū chhun, tio̍h ēng hé sio-tiāu.
Lâu kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t ê chè-mi̍h sī bô chheng-khì; nā ū lâng chia̍h, i ê hōng-hiàn chiū bōe tit-tio̍h chiap-la̍p.
Chia̍h ê lâng, lóng tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm; in-ūi i siat-to̍k hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê mi̍h; hit-ê lâng tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut.
Lín siu-sêng ngó͘-kok, hn̂g-piⁿ--ê m̄-thang koah-liáu-liáu, lak--lo̍h-lâi--ê mā m̄-thang khioh.
Siu-sêng phû-tô, m̄-thang bán-liáu-liáu, lak--lo̍h-lâi--ê mā m̄-thang khioh; tio̍h lâu hō͘ sàn-chhiah-lâng kap chhut-gōa-lâng. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
M̄-thang thau-the̍h; m̄-thang chà-khi; m̄-thang kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.
M̄-thang hōng góa ê miâ chiù ké-chōa lâi siat-to̍k lí ê Siōng-tè ê miâ. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
M̄-thang khi-ap lí ê tông-pau; m̄-thang chhiúⁿ-toa̍t in ê mi̍h; m̄-thang kā kang-lâng ê kang-chîⁿ lâu keh-mî.
M̄-thang chiù-mē hī-khang bô thiaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng. M̄-thang hē mi̍h-kiāⁿ tī sit-bêng ê lâng ê thâu-chêng hāi i poa̍h-tó. Tio̍h kèng-ùi lí ê Siōng-tè. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
Lín sím-phòaⁿ m̄-thang bô kong-tō; m̄-thang phian-thán sàn-chhiah-lâng, mā m̄-thang khòaⁿ ū koân-sè ê lâng ê bīn-sek; tio̍h chiàu kong-tō sím-phòaⁿ lí ê tông-pau.
M̄-thang sì-kòe chō-iâu tiòng-siong lâng; m̄-thang chòe gūi-chèng hāi-sí lâng. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
M̄-thang sim-lāi oàn-hūn chhù-piⁿ; tio̍h sêng-khún chí-chek i ê chhò-gō͘, chiah bián tio̍h ūi i ê chōe hū chek-jīm.
M̄-thang kā lí ê tông-pau pò-ho̍k, mā m̄-thang khioh-hūn; tio̍h thiàⁿ chhù-piⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī. Góa sī Siōng Chú.

Tio̍h chun-siú góa ê kui-lē. M̄-thang hō͘ bô kâng-lūi ê cheng-siⁿ kau-phòe; m̄-thang chiong nn̄g khoán chéng-chí iā tī kâng chi̍t khu hn̂g; m̄-thang chhēng nn̄g khoán pò͘-liāu chit ê saⁿ.

Lú-pī iáu-bē siū-sio̍k tit-tio̍h chū-iû, m̄-kú í-keng tēng-hun, nā ū lâng kap i su-thong, nn̄g ê lâng tio̍h siū hêng-hoa̍t; m̄-kú m̄-thang kā in chhú-sí, in-ūi hit-ê lú-pī iáu-bē tit-tio̍h chū-iû.
Hit-ê ta-po͘-lâng tio̍h hiàn pê-chōe-chè, khan chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, chòe pê-chōe-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Chè-si tio̍h ēng pê-chōe-chè ê iûⁿ-káng, tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng kā i sio̍k-chōe; hit-ê lâng hoān ê chōe chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Lín chìn-ji̍p Ka-lâm -tōe liáu-āu, chai-chèng ta̍k-chióng ké-chí-chhiū, saⁿ nî lāi, tio̍h khòaⁿ hiah-ê ké-chí chòe bô chheng-khì, bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h.
Tē-sì nî só͘ kiat ê ké-chí lóng tio̍h hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, piáu-sī tùi Siōng Chú ê kám-siā.
Kàu tē-gō͘ nî, lín thang chia̍h hiah-ê ké-chí, hō͘ chhiū thang kiat khah chōe ké-chí. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
M̄-thang chia̍h kâⁿ-huih ê mi̍h. M̄-thang kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t, mā m̄-thang pok-kòa.
Pìn-piⁿ ê mn̂g m̄-thang thì, chhùi-chhiu mā m̄-thang siu.
M̄-thang ūi sí-lâng koah-siong ka-kī ê seng-khu; seng-khu mā m̄-thang chhiah-jī. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
M̄-thang bú-jio̍k lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, hō͘ i chòe sī-biō ê chhiong-ki, chiah bián lín khì pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, hō͘ chit-ê tōe chhiong-móa îm-loān.
Lín tio̍h siú góa ê An-hioh-ji̍t, kèng-tiōng góa ê sèng-só͘. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
M̄-thang khì chhē khan-bông--ê, mā m̄-thang khì mn̄g tâng-ki, toh-thâu, lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Tī lāu-tōa-lâng ê bīn-chêng, tio̍h khiā--khí-lâi, mā tio̍h chun-kèng in; koh tio̍h kèng-ùi lí ê Siōng-tè. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
M̄-thang khi-hū kià-ku tī lín ê tōe ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng;

tio̍h tùi-thāi in chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-thāi lín Í-sek-lia̍t tông-pau, thiàⁿ in chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī; in-ūi lín mā bat chòe gōa-cho̍k-lâng kià-ku tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
M̄-thang ēng bô kong-tō ê chhioh, táu, chhìn-á phiⁿ--lâng.
Tio̍h ēng kong-tō ê chhìn-á, pōng-chí, kap táu. Góa sī chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p ê Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng góa ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú koh bēng-lēng Mô͘-se

tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Bô-lūn sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, á-sī kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, nā ū lâng chiong ka-kī ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hiàn hō͘ Mô͘-lo̍k, it-tēng tio̍h kā i chhú-sí; hit só͘-chāi ê lâng tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí.

Góa mā beh tùi hit-ê lâng pìⁿ-bīn, kā i tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut, in-ūi i chiong kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hiàn hō͘ Mô͘-lo̍k, phah lâ-sâm góa ê sèng-só͘, siat-to̍k góa ê sèng-miâ.
Hit só͘-chāi ê lâng nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê lâng hiàn kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō͘ Mô͘-lo̍k, m̄-kú tìⁿ m̄ chai, bô kā i chhú-sí,
góa beh tùi hit-ê lâng kap i ê ka-cho̍k pìⁿ-bīn, chiong i kap tè i khì pài Mô͘-lo̍k kiâⁿ siâ-îm ê lâng, lóng tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut.
Nā ū lâng khì chhē khan-bông--ê á-sī tâng-ki toh-thâu, tè in khì pài ngó͘-siōng kiâⁿ siâ-îm, góa beh tùi hit-ê lâng pìⁿ-bīn, kā i tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut.
Só͘-í lín tio̍h hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, chiâⁿ-chòe sèng-kiat, in-ūi góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng góa ê kui-lē. Góa sī kā lín hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê Siōng Chú.
Nā ū lâng chiù-chó͘ pē-bú, it-tēng tio̍h kā i chhú-sí; i tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.
Nā ū lâng kap pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘ su-thong, it-tēng tio̍h kā hit nn̄g ê lâng chhú-sí.
Kap lāu-pē ê bó͘ su-thong, chiū-sī bú-jio̍k ka-kī ê lāu-pē, it-tēng tio̍h kā hit nn̄g ê lâng chhú-sí; in tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.
Nā ū lâng kap sin-pū su-thong, it-tēng tio̍h kā in chhú-sí; in chòe loān-lûn ê tāi-chì, tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.

Nā ū ta-po͘-lâng kap ta-po͘-lâng ū sèng-koan-hē, chhin-chhiūⁿ kap hū-jîn-lâng kâng-khoán, chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, it-tēng tio̍h kā in chhú-sí; in tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.

Nā ū lâng chhōa-bó͘, koh chhōa i ê tiūⁿ-ḿ, che sī loān-lûn kiàn-siàu ê sū; chit saⁿ ê lâng, tio̍h kā in sio-sí, chiah bián lín tiong-kan ū chit-khoán loān-lûn kiàn-siàu ê sū.
Nā ū lâng kap cheng-siⁿ kau-ha̍p, it-tēng tio̍h kā i chhú-sí, mā tio̍h kā hit-chiah cheng-siⁿ thâi-sí.
Nā ū hū-jîn-lâng kap cheng-siⁿ kau-ha̍p, it-tēng tio̍h kā i kap hit-chiah cheng-siⁿ chhú-sí; in tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.

Lâng nā chhōa ka-kī ê chí-bē, bô-lūn kâng-pē--ê á-sī kâng-bú--ê, che sī kiàn-siàu ê tāi-chì; tio̍h chiong in tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut. I kap ka-kī ê chí-bē ū loān-lûn ê koan-hē, tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.
Nā ū lâng kap keng-kî tiong ê hū-jîn-lâng ū sèng-koan-hē, tio̍h chiong in tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut, in-ūi in ûi-hoān kiat-chēng ê tiâu-lē.
M̄-thang kap a-î á-sī a-ko͘ ū sèng-koan-hē, che sī bú-jio̍k kut-jio̍k chì-chhin; in tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.
Nā ū lâng kap i ê a-chím á-sī a-ḿ ū sèng-koan-hē, chiū-sī bú-jio̍k i ê a-chek á-sī a-peh; in tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm, chi̍t-sì-lâng bô hō͘-sû.
Nā ū lâng chhōa ka-kī hiaⁿ-tī ê bó͘, che sī bú-jio̍k i ê hiaⁿ-tī, sī thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū; in it-tēng bô hō͘-sû.
Lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng góa só͘-ū ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng, chiah bián góa chhōa lín ji̍p-khì khiā-khí ê tōe kā lín thò͘--chhut-lâi.
Góa tī lín ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì ê jîn-bîn, lín m̄-thang o̍h in ê hong-sio̍k; in-ūi in ū chòe chiah-ê sū, só͘-í góa iàm-ò͘ⁿ in.

Góa bat kā lín kóng, góa beh chiong chit-tè lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe sù hō͘ lín, hō͘ lín sêng-chiap chòe sán-gia̍p. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, tùi bān-cho̍k ê tiong-kan kā lín hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi.

Só͘-í, lín tio̍h hun-pia̍t chheng-khì kap bô chheng-khì ê cháu-siù kap chiáu-lūi. Góa tēng-chòe bô chheng-khì--ê, bô-lūn sī cháu-siù, chiáu-lūi, á-sī tī thô͘-kha teh pê ê tōng-bu̍t, lín m̄-thang in-ūi in hō͘ ka-kī chiâⁿ-chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê.
Lín tio̍h kui-sio̍k góa chiâⁿ-chòe sèng, in-ūi góa Siōng Chú sī sèng, ū chiong lín tùi bān-cho̍k ê tiong-kan hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi, chòe góa ê chú-bîn.
Khan-bông--ê, á-sī tâng-ki toh-thâu, bô-lūn sī lâm sī lú, it-tēng tio̍h kā in chhú-sí, ēng chio̍h-thâu kā in tìm-sí; in tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se tùi A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi chòe chè-si--ê soan-pò͘: Jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan nā ū lâng sí, chè-si m̄-thang in-ūi i phah lâ-sâm ka-kī,

chí-ū thang ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê pē-bú, kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, hiaⁿ-tī, í-ki̍p iáu-bē chhut-kè ê chāi-sek-lú chí-bē, chiah-ê kut-jio̍k chì-chhin, bong in ê si-thé lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī.
Chè-si nā í-keng kiat-hun, m̄-thang in-ūi bó͘ ê āu-thâu-chhù ū lâng sí lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī, hō͘ ka-kī bô chheng-khì.
Chè-si m̄-thang thâu-khak thì-kng-kng; m̄-thang siu chhùi-chhiu; m̄-thang koah-siong ka-kī ê seng-khu.
Tio̍h sèng-hòa kui Siōng-tè; m̄-thang siat-to̍k Siōng-tè ê miâ; in-ūi in ēng hé sio chia̍h-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè, só͘-í in tio̍h chiâⁿ-chòe sèng.
M̄-thang chhōa chòe ki-lú phah lâ-sâm ka-kī ê hū-jîn-lâng; m̄-thang chhōa lî-hun--kè ê hū-jîn-lâng; in-ūi chè-si í-keng sèng-hòa kui Siōng-tè.

Jîn-bîn tio̍h khòaⁿ chè-si chòe sèng, in-ūi hōng-hiàn hō͘ lín ê Siōng-tè ê chia̍h-mi̍h sī in hiàn--ê. Góa sī kā lín hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê Siōng Chú, sī sèng; lín tio̍h khòaⁿ chè-si chòe sèng.
Chè-si ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ nā chòe ki-lú phah lâ-sâm ka-kī, sī bú-jio̍k i ê lāu-pē, tio̍h ēng hé kā i sio-sí.
Tī hiaⁿ-tī ê tiong-kan chòe tōa-chè-si--ê, sī siū boah-iû siat-li̍p, chhēng lé-ho̍k, tam-tng sèng-chit; m̄-thang kā thâu-mn̂g phah-sàm, mā m̄-thang thiah-li̍h saⁿ.
M̄-thang óa-kūn si-thé, sīm-chì ka-kī ê pē-bú sí, mā m̄-thang óa-kūn lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī.
M̄-thang lī-khui sèng-só͘ khì chham-ka song-lé, chiah bián siat-to̍k Siōng-tè ê sèng-só͘, in-ūi i ê seng-khu ū Siōng-tè boah-iû siat-li̍p ê kì-hō. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
I tio̍h chhōa chāi-sek-lú chòe bó͘.
M̄-thang chhōa kóaⁿ-hū, á-sī lî-hun ê hū-jîn-lâng, á-sī chòe ki-lú phah lâ-sâm ka-kī ê hū-jîn-lâng, chí-ū thang chhōa pún-cho̍k ê chāi-sek-lú,
chiah bián i ê hō͘-tāi tī jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan siū bú-jio̍k, in-ūi góa sī kā i hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se
tùi A-lûn kóng: Lí ta̍k sè-tāi ê kiáⁿ-sun sin-thé ū khoat-hām--ê, lóng m̄-thang chìn-chêng hōng-hiàn chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ in ê Siōng-tè.
Sin-thé ū khoat-hām, bô-lūn sī sit-bêng, kha-pái, nah-phīⁿ, kî-hêng,
tn̄g-kha tn̄g-chhiú,
ún-ku, óe-lâng, ba̍k-chiu ū mô͘-pīⁿ, siⁿ-sián, siⁿ-chhng, á-sī lān-hu̍t siū-siong, chit-khoán lâng lóng m̄-thang lâi kàu Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng hiàn-chè.

Chè-si A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi, seng-khu ū khoat-hām--ê, lóng m̄-thang ēng hé sio chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, in-ūi i ū hâ-chhû, bōe-ēng-tit hōng-hiàn chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ in ê Siōng-tè.
Hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè ê chia̍h-mi̍h, bô-lūn sī chì-sèng--ê, á-sī sèng--ê, i lóng thang chia̍h.
In-ūi i ū khoat-hām, só͘-í m̄-thang lâi kàu tiùⁿ-lî chêng, mā m̄-thang óa-kūn chè-tôaⁿ, chiah bián siat-to̍k góa ê sèng-só͘. Góa sī kā in hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê Siōng Chú.
Mô͘-se chiū chiàu án-ni tùi A-lûn kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se
tùi A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ soan-pò͘: Tio̍h kín-sīn chhú-lí Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng kui hō͘ góa ê chè-mi̍h, chiah bián siat-to̍k góa ê sèng-miâ; góa sī Siōng Chú.

Lín ta̍k sè-tāi ê kiáⁿ-sun, nā ū lâng seng-khu bô chheng-khì, bong-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng kui hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h, hit-ê lâng chiū éng-oán bōe-ēng-tit tī góa ê bīn-chêng sū-hōng góa. Góa sī Siōng Chú.

A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi, nā ū lâng tì-tio̍h bâ-hong á-sī hā-siau, tī i kiat-chēng í-chêng m̄-thang chia̍h sèng ê chè-mi̍h. Nā ū lâng bong-tio̍h hō͘ si-thé bak--tio̍h chiâⁿ-chòe bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h, á-sī bong-tio̍h sia̍p-cheng ê lâng,
á-sī bong-tio̍h teh pê bô chheng-khì ê oa̍h-mi̍h, á-sī bong-tio̍h jīm-hô ōe hō͘ i bô chheng-khì ê lâng;
só͘-ū bong-tio̍h chiah-ê ê lâng, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng lóng sī bô chheng-khì; in nā bô sóe seng-khu, chiū m̄-thang chia̍h sèng ê chè-mi̍h.
Kàu ji̍t lo̍h, in chiah chheng-khì, jiân-āu thang chia̍h chè-mi̍h; in-ūi che sī in ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Chū-jiân sí--ê, á-sī hō͘ iá-siù thiah-li̍h--ê, lóng m̄-thang chia̍h, in-ūi che ōe hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
Chè-si lóng tio̍h chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng, chiah bián in siat-to̍k chè-mi̍h, hoān-chōe lâi sí. Góa sī kā in hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê Siōng Chú.
It-poaⁿ-lâng bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h sèng ê chè-mi̍h, liân chè-si ê lâng-kheh á-sī chhiàⁿ-kang mā bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h.
M̄-kú, chè-si bóe--lâi ê lô͘-lē, kap tī in tau chhut-sì ê lâng thang chia̍h chè-si ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Chè-si ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ nā kè hō͘ chè-si ka-cho̍k í-gōa ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, m̄-thang chia̍h gia̍h-koân hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú sèng ê chè-mi̍h.

M̄-kú chè-si ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ nā chiú-kóaⁿ, á-sī lî-hun, bô kiáⁿ-jî, koh tò-lâi āu-thâu-chhù, chiū kap i siàu-liân ê sî kâng-khoán, thang chia̍h in lāu-pē ê chia̍h-mi̍h. Chóng-sī, it-poaⁿ ê lâng m̄-thang chia̍h sèng ê chè-mi̍h.
Nā ū lâng bô chù-ì chia̍h-tio̍h sèng ê chè-mi̍h, tio̍h chiàu hiah-ê chè-mi̍h ke gō͘-hūn-chi̍t kau hō͘ chè-si.

M̄-thang sûi-piān hō͘ lâng chia̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú sèng ê chè-mi̍h, chiah bián in in-ūi siat-to̍k sèng ê chè-mi̍h tì-kàu hoān-chōe; góa sī kā in hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se

tùi A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng soan-pò͘: Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, á-sī kià-ku tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, nā hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, bô-lūn chhut tī hē-goān á-sī kam-sim hiàn-chè,
tio̍h hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê gû-káng, mî-iûⁿ-káng, á-sī soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, chiah ōe hō͘ Siōng Chú hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p.
M̄-thang hiàn ū hâ-chhû--ê, in-ūi che bōe tit-tio̍h chiap-la̍p.

Nā ū lâng beh kam-sim hiàn-chè, á-sī ūi-tio̍h te̍k-pia̍t ê sū siā-goān, hiàn pêng-an-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, tio̍h soán kiān-khong, bô hâ-chhû ê gû á-sī iûⁿ chòe chè-mi̍h, chiah ōe tit-tio̍h chiap-la̍p.
Só͘-ū chhiⁿ-mî, tio̍h-siong, chân-hòe, phê-hu teh nōa, siⁿ-sián, siⁿ-chhng ê tōng-bu̍t, lóng m̄-thang tī chè-tôaⁿ téng ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Gû-káng á-sī iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ nā chi-thé ū ke ū kiám, thang chòe kam-sim hiàn ê chè; m̄-kú nā chòe siā-goān ê chè chiū bōe tit-tio̍h chiap-la̍p.
Tōng-bu̍t ê lān-hu̍t nā siū-siong, teh-chhùi, phòa-li̍h, á-sī iam--khí-lâi, lóng m̄-thang hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. Tī lín ê thó͘-tōe, í-siōng chiah-ê sū lín lóng m̄-thang chòe.

Lín mā m̄-thang tùi gōa-cho̍k-lâng chiap-siū chit-khoán cheng-siⁿ chòe hiàn hō͘ lín ê Siōng-tè ê chia̍h-mi̍h, in-ūi in ū khoat-hām, ū hâ-chhû, só͘-í bōe tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú chiap-la̍p.
Siōng Chú koh tùi Mô͘-se kóng,

“Gû, mî-iûⁿ, á-sī soaⁿ-iûⁿ chhut-sì liáu thang tè i ê bú chhit ji̍t; tē-poeh ji̍t í-āu, chiū thang ēng hé sio chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, án-ni chiah ōe tit-tio̍h chiap-la̍p.
Bô-lūn gû á-sī iûⁿ, m̄-thang kâng hit-ji̍t thâi bú kap kiáⁿ.
Hiàn siā-un-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, tio̍h chiàu kui-lē hiàn chè-mi̍h thang hō͘ I chiap-la̍p.
Chè-mi̍h tio̍h tī hiàn hit-ji̍t chia̍h, liân chi̍t-sut-á to m̄-thang lâu kàu keh-chá-khí. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
“Lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng góa ê kài-bēng. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
M̄-thang siat-to̍k góa ê sèng-miâ; góa beh tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan siū chun chòe sèng. Góa sī kā lín hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê Siōng Chú,
bat chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p, chiâⁿ-chòe lín ê Siōng-tè. Góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘ góa ê choeh-ji̍t. Lín tī Siōng Chú ê choeh-ji̍t, tio̍h chū-chi̍p kú-hêng sèng-hōe.

La̍k ji̍t tio̍h chòe kang, tē-chhit ji̍t sī tio̍h oân-choân hioh-khùn ê An-hioh-ji̍t. Chit-ji̍t, lín bô-lūn tòa tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, jīm-hô ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe, tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe; in-ūi chit-ji̍t sī Siōng Chú ê An-hioh-ji̍t.
“Ē-bīn chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú ê choeh-kî, lín tio̍h chiàu-sî chū-chi̍p kú-hêng sèng-hōe.”
“Chiaⁿ-ge̍h cha̍p-sì hông-hun ê sî, sī Siōng Chú ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.
Chit kò-ge̍h ê cha̍p-gō͘ sī Siōng Chú ê Tû-kàⁿ-choeh; lín tio̍h chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ chhit ji̍t.
Thâu chi̍t ji̍t tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe, jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe.
Chhit ji̍t kú tio̍h ēng hé sio chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; tē-chhit ji̍t tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe, jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe.”
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Lín chìn-ji̍p góa siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe, siu-sêng ngó͘-kok ê sî, tio̍h chiong thâu-chúi ê ngó͘-kok chi̍t khún tòa-lâi kau hō͘ chè-si.
Chè-si tio̍h tī An-hioh-ji̍t ê keh-ji̍t chiong chit-khún tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng iô-iô--leh, hō͘ Siōng Chú chiap-la̍p.
Hiàn chit-khún ngó͘-kok hit-ji̍t, lín tio̍h chiong chi̍t chiah chi̍t hè, bô hâ-chhû, kang ê mî-iûⁿ-á chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.

Sòa-chiap koh hiàn sò͘-chè, chiū-sī ēng nn̄g kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; jiân-āu koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t kong-seng ê chiú chòe tiān-chiú-chè.

Bô-lūn sī piáⁿ, pē--kè ê ngó͘-kok, á-sī sin siu-sêng ê be̍h-sūi, kàu lín tòa-lâi hiàn hō͘ lín ê Siōng-tè hit-ji̍t chiah thang chia̍h. Lín bô-lūn tòa tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, chiah-ê beh chòe lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.
Lín tio̍h tùi Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh An-hioh-ji̍t ê keh-ji̍t, chiū-sī tùi iô be̍h-khún chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú hit-ji̍t khai-sí sǹg, móa chhit ê An-hioh-ji̍t,
kàu tē-chhit ê An-hioh-ji̍t ê keh-ji̍t, chiū-sī tē-gō͘-cha̍p ji̍t, tio̍h hiàn sin ê sò͘-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Ta̍k-ê ka-têng tio̍h the̍h nn̄g kong-kun ê iù mī-hún, chham kàⁿ lo̍h-khì hang, chòe nn̄g tè piáⁿ, kā iô-iô--leh chòe khí-thâu-se̍k ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.

Hit nn̄g tè piáⁿ í-gōa, koh tio̍h ēng chhit chiah chi̍t-hè bô hâ-chhû ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á, kap chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á, í-ki̍p nn̄g chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; mā tio̍h ēng sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Lín tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, nn̄g chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-á chòe pêng-an-chè.

Chè-si tio̍h chiong hit nn̄g chiah iûⁿ-á kap ēng khí-thâu-se̍k ê be̍h hang ê piáⁿ, chòe-hé tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng iô-iô--leh hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, kui hō͘ chè-si.

Siâng hit-ji̍t, tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe, jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe. Lín bô-lūn tòa tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, chiah-ê beh chòe lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.

Lín siu-sêng ngó͘-kok, hn̂g-piⁿ--ê m̄-thang koah-liáu-liáu, lak--lo̍h-lâi--ê mā m̄-thang khioh; tio̍h lâu hō͘ sàn-chhiah-lâng kap chhut-gōa-lâng. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Chhit-ge̍h chhoe-it, lín tio̍h oân-choân hioh-khùn, kú-hêng sèng-hōe, pûn sàu-kak chòe kì-liām.
Jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe; tio̍h ēng hé sio chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú koh tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Chhit-ge̍h chhoe-cha̍p sī Sio̍k-chōe-ji̍t. Lín tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe, kìm-chia̍h khek-khó͘, mā tio̍h ēng hé sio chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
