Hit-ji̍t, jīm-hô ê khang-khè lóng m̄-thang chòe; in-ūi hit-ji̍t sī Sio̍k-chōe-ji̍t, beh tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng kā lín sio̍k-chōe.
Siâng chit-ji̍t, bô kìm-chia̍h khek-khó͘ ê lâng, tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kā i kek-chhut.
Tī hit-ji̍t choh-kang--ê, góa beh tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kā i siau-bia̍t.
Jīm-hô kang-chok lín lóng m̄-thang chòe; lín bô-lūn tòa tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, che beh chòe lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.
Lín tio̍h kìm-chia̍h khek-khó͘ siú chit-ji̍t chòe oân-choân hioh-khùn ê An-hioh-ji̍t. Chit kò-ge̍h chhoe-káu ê hông-hun kàu keh-ji̍t ê hông-hun, lín tio̍h siú An-hioh-ji̍t.”
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se
tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Chhit-ge̍h cha̍p-gō͘ sī Tah-liâu-choeh. Lín tio̍h tùi chit-ji̍t khí liân-sòa chhit ji̍t ǹg Siōng Chú siú-choeh.
Thâu chi̍t ji̍t tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe, jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe.

Lín tio̍h chhit ji̍t kú ēng hé sio chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; tē-poeh ji̍t mā tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe, ēng hé sio chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. Chit-ê sī giâm-siok-hōe, jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe.

Í-siōng sī Siōng Chú ê choeh-kî; lín tio̍h chū-chi̍p kú-hêng sèng-hōe, chiàu ji̍t-kî chiong sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap kî-tha ê chè-mi̍h, í-ki̍p tiān-chiú-chè ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Chiah-ê sī lín tī Siōng Chú ê An-hioh-ji̍t só͘ hiàn ê lé-mi̍h, siā-goān ê chè, í-ki̍p kam-sim hiàn ê chè í-gōa, tio̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè.
Lín siu-sêng thó͘-tōe chhut-sán ê sî, tùi chhit-ge̍h cha̍p-gō͘ khí, tio̍h siú Siōng Chú ê choeh-kî chhit ji̍t; thâu chi̍t ji̍t kap tē-poeh ji̍t tio̍h oân-choân hioh-khùn.

Thâu chi̍t ji̍t tio̍h the̍h tōa-châng hó-khòaⁿ ê chhiū-á ê ké-chí, chang-chhiū ê ki, chin ām ê chhiū ê chhiū-oe, kap khoe-piⁿ liú-chhiū ê ki, tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng khèng-chiok chhit ji̍t.
Ta̍k-nî ê chhit--ge̍h, lín tio̍h ǹg Siōng Chú siú chit-ê choeh chhit ji̍t; che sī lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.
Lín tio̍h tòa tī chháu-liâu-á chhit ji̍t; só͘-ū chāi-tōe ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng tio̍h tòa tī chháu-liâu-á,
thang hō͘ lín ta̍k sè-tāi ê lâng chai, góa chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî, ū hō͘ in tòa tī chháu-liâu-á. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Mô͘-se chiū chiong Siōng Chú chí-tēng ê choeh-kî tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng:
Lí tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa sûn ê kaⁿ-ná-iû lâi kau hō͘ lí, thang tiám-to̍h hōe-bō͘ lāi ê teng, hō͘ teng put-sî tiám--teh.

Tùi ē-hng kàu chá-khí, A-lûn tio̍h tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, chiong hōe-bō͘ lāi-bīn iok-kūi chêng ê tiùⁿ-lî gōa ê teng tiám hō͘ to̍h; che beh chòe lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.
A-lûn tio̍h tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, siông-siông chiàu-kò͘ koán-lí sûn-kim teng-tâi téng-bīn ê teng-hé.
Lí tio̍h ēng iù mī-hún hang cha̍p-jī tè piáⁿ, ta̍k-tè nn̄g kong-kun.
Tio̍h chiong piáⁿ pâi chòe nn̄g chōa, múi-chōa la̍k tè, pâi tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng sûn-kim ê toh téng-bīn.
Koh tio̍h ēng sûn ê jú-hiuⁿ sám tī ta̍k-chōa piáⁿ ê téng-bīn, tāi-piáu ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê lé-mi̍h.
Ta̍k-ê An-hioh-ji̍t, A-lûn tio̍h chiong chiah-ê piáⁿ pâi tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, m̄-thang làng-chām; che sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng éng-oán tio̍h siú ê iok.

Chiah-ê piáⁿ tio̍h kui hō͘ A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun. In tio̍h tī hōe-bō͘ ê tiâⁿ chia̍h, in-ūi che sī ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h tiong-kan chì-sèng ê pō͘-hūn, chòe chè-si éng-oán tit--tio̍h ê hūn-gia̍h.

Ū chi̍t ê lâng, i ê lāu-pē sī Ai-ki̍p -lâng, lāu-bú sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, sī Tān chi-cho̍k Tí-pek-lī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Sī-lô-bi̍t. Ū chi̍t ji̍t, i tī iâⁿ-lāi kap chi̍t ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng oan-ke, siat-to̍k koh chiù-chó͘ Siōng Chú ê miâ. Ū lâng kā i tòa-khì Mô͘-se hia.
In kā i koaiⁿ--khí-lâi, thèng-hāu Siōng Chú chí-sī.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,

“Tio̍h chiong hit-ê lâng tòa-khì iâⁿ-gōa, hō͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h i chiù-chó͘ ê lâng hōaⁿ-chhiú tī i ê thâu-khak téng, kiàn-chèng i ū-chōe; choân hōe-chiòng tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí.
Lí tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Nā ū lâng chiù-chó͘ Siōng-tè, tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.
Nā ū lâng siat-to̍k Siōng Chú ê miâ, bô-lūn sī chāi-tōe-lâng á-sī gōa-cho̍k-lâng, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí; choân hōe-chiòng tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí.
“Nā ū lâng phah-sí lâng, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí.
Nā phah-sí cheng-siⁿ, tio̍h pê cheng-siⁿ, ēng miā pê miā.
“Nā ū lâng siong-hāi tông-pau, i án-chóaⁿ kā lâng siong-hāi, mā tio̍h án-ni tùi-thāi i:
Ēng siong pê siong, ēng ba̍k-chiu pê ba̍k-chiu, ēng chhùi-khí pê chhùi-khí; i án-chóaⁿ kā lâng siong-hāi, chiū án-ni pān i.
Phah-sí cheng-siⁿ--ê, tio̍h pê cheng-siⁿ; phah-sí lâng--ê, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí.
Bô-lūn sī gōa-cho̍k-lâng á-sī chāi-tōe-lâng, lóng tio̍h chiàu kâng-khoán ê hoat-lu̍t chhú-lí. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.”

Mô͘-se chiū kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, in chiū chiong hit-ê chiù-chó͘ Siōng Chú ê lâng tòa-khì iâⁿ-gōa, ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàu Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se ê ōe khì chòe.
Siōng Chú tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ hoan-hù Mô͘-se
tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Lín chìn-ji̍p góa siúⁿ-sù lín hit-ê tōe liáu-āu, thó͘-tōe tī tē-chhit nî tio̍h ūi Siōng Chú siú an-hioh, bōe-ēng-tit chèng-choh.
La̍k nî kú, chhân-hn̂g thang chèng-choh, phû-tô-hn̂g thang siu-chéng, chhut-sán thang siu-sêng.
Tē-chhit nî, thó͘-tōe tio̍h oân-choân hioh-khùn, ūi Siōng Chú siú an-hioh-nî; chhân-hn̂g m̄-thang chèng-choh, phû-tô-hn̂g m̄-thang siu-chéng.
Ka-kī hoat ê ngó͘-kok m̄-thang siu-koah, bô siu-chéng--kè ê phû-tô-chhiū mā m̄-thang siu-sêng; chit-nî sī thó͘-tōe ê an-hioh-nî.
An-hioh-nî thó͘-tōe ê chhut-sán lóng beh hō͘ lí kap lí ê po̍k-jîn, lú-pī, chhiàⁿ-kang, kià-ku tī lín hia ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng,
kap cheng-siⁿ, í-ki̍p tī lí ê thó͘-tōe ê cháu-siù chòe chia̍h-mi̍h.
Lí tio̍h sǹg chhit ê chhit nî, chiū-sī chhit ê an-hioh-nî, chóng-kiōng sì-cha̍p-káu nî.
Hit-nî ê chhit-ge̍h chhoe-cha̍p, chiū-sī Sio̍k-chōe-ji̍t, lí tio̍h phài lâng tī choân-tōe pûn sàu-kak.

Lín tio̍h kā tē-gō͘-cha̍p nî hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, tī choân-tōe ǹg só͘-ū ê chū-bîn soan-pò͘ chū-iû; chit-nî sī Un-hūi ê Nî. Lín bóe--lâi ê thó͘-tōe tio̍h hêng hō͘ goân-chú, bóe--lâi ê lô͘-lē tio̍h hō͘ i tńg-khì i ka-kī ê ka-têng.
Tē-gō͘-cha̍p nî beh chòe lín Un-hūi ê Nî, m̄-thang chèng-choh; tōe ka-kī hoat--ê, m̄-thang siu-koah; bô siu-chéng ê phû-tô-chhiū, m̄-thang siu-sêng.
In-ūi hit-nî sī Un-hūi ê Nî, lín tio̍h kā i hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng; lín thang chia̍h thó͘-tōe ka-kī chhut ê thó͘-sán.
Chit-ê Un-hūi ê Nî, lín ta̍k-ê lâng bóe--lâi ê thó͘-tōe tio̍h hêng hō͘ goân-chú.
Lín tông-pau ê tiong-kan hō͘-siōng bóe-bōe thó͘-tōe, m̄-thang sio-phiⁿ.

Nā tùi tông-pau bóe, Un-hūi ê Nî kè-liáu ê nî-sò͘ thang kiám--khí-lâi; bōe-chú tio̍h chiàu lī ē chi̍t piàn Un-hūi ê Nî iáu ū kúi nî thang siu-sêng ê nî-sò͘ bōe hō͘ lí.
Nî-sò͘ jú chōe kè-siàu jú koân, nî-sò͘ jú chió kè-siàu jú kē, sī chiàu siu-sêng ê chóng-gia̍h bōe.
Lín m̄-thang sio-phiⁿ, chí-ū tio̍h kèng-ùi lín ê Siōng-tè. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng góa ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng, chiū ōe-tàng tī hit-ê tōe an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p.
Tōe mā ōe chhut thó͘-sán, hō͘ lín chia̍h kàu pá, tī hit-ê tōe kú-tn̂g khiā-khí.
Nā ū lâng kóng, “Goán tī tē-chhit nî bô chèng-choh, bô siu-sêng, án-ni beh chia̍h sím-mi̍h?”
Góa it-tēng ōe tī tē-la̍k nî sù hok-khì hō͘ lín, hō͘ lín tī chit-nî ū saⁿ nî ê siu-sêng.
Tē-poeh nî lín tio̍h chèng-choh, m̄-kú iáu ū kū ê siu-sêng thang chia̍h. Kàu tē-káu nî, lín siu-sêng ê sî mā iáu-teh chia̍h kū ê bí-niû.
Thó͘-tōe m̄-thang éng-oán bōe-tn̄g, in-ūi tōe sī góa--ê; lín tī góa ê bīn-chêng sī chhut-gōa-lâng, sī kià-ku--ê.
Lín tit-tio̍h chòe sán-gia̍p ê choân-pō͘ thó͘-tōe, tio̍h ún-chún lâng ōe-tàng sio̍k-hôe.
Lí ê chhin-cho̍k nā ū lâng sàn-chhiah, bōe i chi̍t-pō͘-hūn ê thó͘-tōe, i ê chì-chhin tio̍h kā i bōe--chhut-khì ê thó͘-tōe sio̍k-hôe.
Nā bô chì-chhin thang kā thó͘-tōe sio̍k-hôe, i ka-kī āu-lâi nā koh ū chîⁿ, ū-kàu thang sio̍k-hôe,
chiū tio̍h kè-sǹg bōe--chhut-khì ê nî-sò͘, chiong kàu ē chi̍t piàn Un-hūi ê Nî só͘ chhun nî-sò͘ ê chîⁿ-gia̍h hêng hō͘ bóe-chú, i ka-kī chiū thang sio̍k-hôe i ê sán-gia̍p.

Hit-ê lâng nā bōe-tàng sio̍k-hôe i ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe, bōe--chhut-khì ê thó͘-tōe iû-goân lâu tī bóe--khì ê lâng ê chhiú; Un-hūi ê Nî kàu, thó͘-tōe tio̍h kau--chhut-khì, hêng hō͘ goân-lâi ê tōe-chú.
Lēng-gōa, nā ū lâng bōe siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ lāi ê chhù, chi̍t nî lāi i ū koân thang kā chhù sio̍k-hôe.
Chi̍t nî lāi nā bô sio̍k-hôe, hit-keng chhù chiū éng-oán kui bóe-chú kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun; tī Un-hūi ê Nî mā bōe-tàng sio̍k-hôe.
M̄-kú tī bô siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ chng-siā ê chhù, kap chng-siā ê thó͘-tōe kâng-khoán thang sio̍k-hôe; kàu Un-hūi ê Nî, bóe ê lâng tio̍h hêng hō͘ goân-lâi ê tōe-chú.
Lī-bī -lâng tī in chòe sán-gia̍p ê siâⁿ ê chhù, put-koán-sî lóng ōe-tàng sio̍k-hôe.

Nā ū lâng bóe Lī-bī -lâng ê siâⁿ ê chhù, Lī-bī -lâng bô sio̍k-hôe, kàu Un-hūi ê Nî tio̍h hêng hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng, in-ūi he sī in tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong pun--tio̍h ê sán-gia̍p.
M̄-kú Lī-bī -lâng ê siâⁿ chiu-ûi ê chháu-tiûⁿ m̄-thang bōe, in-ūi he sī in éng-oán ê sán-gia̍p.
Lí ê tông-pau nā pìⁿ sàn-chhiah, bōe-tàng ka-kī seng-oa̍h, lí tio̍h kiong-kip i, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh pang-chān gōa-cho̍k-lâng kap kià-ku--ê, hō͘ i kap lí chòe-hé seng-oa̍h.
M̄-thang kā i the̍h lī-sek, koh-khah m̄-thang the̍h tāng-lī; tio̍h kèng-ùi lí ê Siōng-tè, hō͘ lí ê tông-pau kap lí chòe-hé seng-oa̍h.
Lí chioh i chîⁿ m̄-thang kā i the̍h lī-sek, lí chioh i bí-niû mā m̄-thang the̍h khah ke.
Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, ū chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p, chiong Ka-lâm -tōe siúⁿ-sù lín, koh beh chòe lín ê Siōng-tè.
Lí ê tông-pau nā sàn kah chiong ka-kī bōe hō͘ lí, m̄-thang hō͘ i chhin-chhiūⁿ lô͘-lē ho̍k-sāi lí.
I tòa lí hia, lí tio̍h tùi-thāi i chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-thāi chhiàⁿ-kang kap kià-ku--ê siâng-khoán, hō͘ i ho̍k-sāi lí kàu Un-hūi ê Nî.
Hit-sî i thang lī-khui, kap i ê kiáⁿ-jî chòe-hé tò-khì i ê pún-ke, tò-khì in chó͘-sian ê thó͘-tōe hia.
In-ūi in sī góa ê po̍k-jîn, sī góa tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhōa--chhut-lâi--ê, m̄-thang kā i bōe chòe lô͘-lē.
M̄-thang chân-jím koán-hat i, tio̍h kiaⁿ-ùi lí ê Siōng-tè.
Lí nā su-iàu lâm lú lô͘-lē, ōe-tàng tùi chiu-ûi ê kok-ka bóe,
mā ōe-tàng bóe kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, á-sī in ê ka-koàn tī lín hia siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-jî; in beh chòe lí ê ke-gia̍p.

Lín thang lâu in chòe lín ê kiáⁿ-sun ê ke-gia̍p, hō͘ in chi̍t-sì-lâng chòe lô͘-lē ho̍k-sāi lín ê kiáⁿ-sun; m̄-kú lín ê tông-pau Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, lín m̄-thang chân-jím tùi-thāi in.
Tòa tī lín chia ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng nā pìⁿ hó-gia̍h, m̄-kú lí ê tông-pau pìⁿ sàn-chhiah, chiong ka-kī bōe hō͘ hiah-ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng á-sī in ê ka-cho̍k,
hō͘ lâng bóe--khì chit-ê lâng ū sio̍k-hôe ê koân-lī. I ê hiaⁿ-tī ōe-tàng kā i sio̍k-hôe,
i ê a-chek a-peh, á-sī chek-peh hiaⁿ-tī, á-sī chhin-chiâⁿ mā thang kā i sio̍k-hôe; i ka-kī nā ū-kàu chîⁿ chiū thang sio̍k-hôe ka-kī.
I tio̍h kap bóe-chú sǹg-siàu, tùi bōe ka-kī hit-nî khí sǹg kàu Un-hūi ê Nî, khòaⁿ nî-sò͘ ê chōe-chió, chiàu chhiàⁿ-kang ê kang-chu kap bóe-chú sǹg.
I tio̍h chiàu só͘ chhun nî-sò͘ ê chōe-chió, sǹg sio̍k-hôe ê kè-chîⁿ hêng hō͘ bóe-chú.
Bóe-chú m̄-thang chân-jím koán-hat i, tio̍h tùi-thāi i chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-thāi ta̍k-nî chhiàⁿ ê kang-lâng kâng-khoán.
Chit-ê lâng nā bōe-tàng chiàu án-ni siū-sio̍k, kàu Un-hūi ê Nî, i kap i ê kiáⁿ-jî chiū thang chū-iû lī-khui.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sī góa ê po̍k-jîn, sī góa tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe kā in chhōa--chhut-lâi--ê. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.

M̄-thang ūi ka-kī chō jīm-hô sîn-siōng, m̄-thang chhāi tiau-khek ê ngó͘-siōng á-sī thiāu-siōng, mā m̄-thang tī lín ê kéng-lāi an chio̍h-siōng kūi-pài. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Lín tio̍h siú góa ê An-hioh-ji̍t, kèng-tiōng góa ê sèng-só͘. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
Lín nā chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng góa ê kui-lē kap kài-bēng,
Góa ōe chiàu-sî kā lín lo̍h-hō͘, hō͘ thó͘-tōe seng-sán, hō͘ chhân-iá ê chhiū-ba̍k kiat ké-chí.
Lín siu-sêng ngó͘-kok beh siu kàu bán phû-tô ê sî, bán phû-tô beh bán kàu iā-chéng ê sî; koh lín ōe ū bí-niû chia̍h kàu pá, tī lín ê thó͘-tōe an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p.
Góa beh hō͘ lín sù-kéng-pêng-an; lín tó-teh khùn, bô lâng kā lín heh-kiaⁿ. Góa beh chiong hiong-ok ê iá-siù tùi lín ê tōe kóaⁿ-cháu, koh hō͘ lín bōe tú-tio̍h chiàn-loān.
Lín beh kā tùi-te̍k kóaⁿ-cháu; in beh sí tī lín ê to-ē.
Lín gō͘ ê lâng beh kóaⁿ-cháu chi̍t-pah ê, chi̍t-pah ê lâng beh kóaⁿ-cháu chi̍t-bān ê; tùi-te̍k beh sí tī lín ê to-ē.
Góa beh khòaⁿ-kò͘ lín, hō͘ lín siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe, mā beh kian-li̍p kap lín li̍p ê iok.
Lín kū ê bí-niû chia̍h iáu-bē liáu, chiū tio̍h kā i sóa-cháu lâi siu-khǹg sin ê niû-si̍t.
Góa beh tī lín tiong-kan kiàn-li̍p góa ê hōe-bō͘, góa bōe iàm-ò͘ⁿ lín.
Góa beh put-sî kap lín tông-chāi. Góa beh chòe lín ê Siōng-tè, lín beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn.

Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, ū chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe, hō͘ lín bô koh chòe Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê lô͘-lē. Góa bat kòng-tn̄g lín ê taⁿ, hō͘ lín gia̍h-thâu théng-sin hiòng-chêng kiâⁿ.
Lín nā m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe, bô chun-siú góa ê kài-bēng,
khì-sak góa ê kui-lē, iàm-ò͘ⁿ góa ê bēng-lēng, bô beh si̍t-hêng góa lóng-chóng ê kài-bēng, ûi-pōe góa ê iok,

góa chiū beh án-ni tùi-thāi lín: Góa it-tēng beh hō͘ lín kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, tio̍h hì-lô, jia̍t-pīⁿ, tì-kàu sit-bêng, lâng soe-lám; lín iā-chéng bô-chhái-kang, tùi-te̍k ōe kā lín ê siu-sêng chia̍h-liáu-liáu.
Góa beh tùi lín pìⁿ-bīn, hō͘ tùi-te̍k kā lín phah-pāi, hō͘ oàn-hūn lín--ê kā lín koán-hat; bô lâng kā lín jip, lín mā beh tô-cháu.
Lín tú-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì nā iáu-kú m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe, góa chiū beh chiàu lín ê chōe chhit pē chek-hoa̍t lín.
Góa beh chiong lín khoa-kháu ê sè-le̍k phah-chhùi, koh beh hō͘ lín ê thiⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ thih bōe lo̍h-hō͘, tōe chhin-chhiūⁿ tâng bōe-tàng chèng-choh.
Lín ê lô-khó͘ tio̍h-bôa lóng beh lo̍k-khong, in-ūi lín ê thó͘-tōe bōe seng-sán, chhiū-ba̍k bōe kiat ké-chí.
Lín kiâⁿ-ta̍h nā kap góa choh-tùi, m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn góa, góa chiū beh chiàu lín ê chōe kàng chhit pē chai-hō hō͘ lín.
Góa beh pàng iá-siù khì lín hia, kā-sí lín ê kiáⁿ-jî, thun-chia̍h lín ê cheng-siⁿ, hō͘ lín ê jîn-kháu kiám-chió, lō͘ hong-hòe.
Án-ni lín nā iáu m̄ siū-kà lâi kui-ǹg góa, kiâⁿ-ta̍h kap góa choh-tùi,
góa mā beh kap lín choh-tùi, beh chiàu lín ê chōe chhit pē táⁿ-kek lín.
Góa beh hō͘ lín tú-tio̍h chiàn-loān, pò-èng lín pōe-iok ê chōe. Lín nā bih tī siâⁿ-lāi, góa beh kàng un-e̍k hō͘ lín, koh chiong lín kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k.
Góa bô beh koh kiong-kip bí-niû hō͘ lín; hit-sî cha̍p ê hū-jîn-lâng beh kong-ke ēng chi̍t ê hang-lô͘ hang-piáⁿ, chiàu phòe-kip pun hō͘ lín; lín chia̍h, m̄-kú chia̍h bōe pá.
Keng-kè chiah-ê tāi-chì, lín nā iáu m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn góa, kiâⁿ-ta̍h iáu-kú kap góa choh-tùi,
góa chiū beh hoat tōa siū-khì, kap lín choh-tùi, beh koh chiàu lín ê chōe ke chhit pē táⁿ-kek lín.
Lín ōe iau kah chia̍h lín ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ê bah.
Góa beh húi-hoāi lín ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, phò-hoāi lín ê hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ, chiong lín ê sin-si hiat tī siū húi-hoāi ê ngó͘-siōng téng-bīn; góa mā beh iàm-ò͘ⁿ lín.
Góa beh hō͘ lín ê siâⁿ pha-hng, hō͘ lín ê sèng-só͘ hong-hòe; góa bô beh phīⁿ lín ê chè-mi̍h ê phang-bī.
Góa beh hō͘ lín ê tōe hong-hòe, kā lín chiàm-léng ê tùi-te̍k beh in-ūi án-ni tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Góa beh chiong lín kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ khì lia̍t-kok, mā beh pu̍ih to tui-kóaⁿ lín; hō͘ lín ê tōe hong-hòe, hō͘ lín ê siâⁿ pha-hng.
Lín liû-bông khì lia̍t-kok ê sî, lín ê thó͘-tōe beh in-ūi pha-hng tit-tio̍h an-hioh.
Án-ni, thó͘-tōe chiū oân-choân hioh-khùn, hióng-siū lín tòa tī hia ê sî bô hō͘ i ê an-hioh.

Lín tiong-kan só͘ chhun ê lâng, góa beh hō͘ in tī tùi-te̍k ê thó͘-tōe sim-lāi kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; liân chhiū-hio̍h hō͘ hong chhe tín-tāng ê siaⁿ, mā ōe hō͘ in kiaⁿ kah tô-cháu. Bô lâng kā in jip, in mā ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ teh tô-siám to-kiàm, cháu kah poa̍h-tó.
Bô lâng kā in tui-kóaⁿ, in mā ōe sio-khoeh poa̍h-tó, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng beh kā in thâi; lín ōe hō͘ tùi-te̍k oân-choân phah-pāi.
Lín ōe tùi lia̍t-kok ê tiong-kan siau-sit, hō͘ tùi-te̍k ê tōe thun-bia̍t.
Lín tòa tī tùi-te̍k ê tōe chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng, ōe in-ūi ka-kī kap chó͘-sian ê chōe soe-bî.
M̄-kú in nā jīn ka-kī kap chó͘-sian ê chōe, chiū-sī sêng-jīn in ū pōe-poān góa, kap góa choh-tùi,
tì-kàu góa kap in choh-tùi, hō͘ in siū-lia̍h khì tùi-te̍k ê tōe; hit-sî in kiau-ngō͘ kò͘-chip ê sim nā khiam-pi--lo̍h-lâi, kam-goān siū hêng-hoa̍t,
góa chiū ōe siūⁿ-tio̍h góa kap A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok só͘ li̍p ê iok, mā ōe put-sî siūⁿ-tio̍h hit-tè thó͘-tōe.

In pàng-sak hit-tè thó͘-tōe, hit-tè tōe tian-tò tī pha-hng ê tiong-kan hióng-siū an-hioh. In kam-goān ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê chōe siū hêng-hoa̍t, in-ūi in khì-sak góa ê bēng-lēng, iàm-ò͘ⁿ góa ê kui-lē.

M̄-kú, in hō͘ tùi-te̍k lia̍h--khì ê sî, góa iáu-kú bô pàng-sak in, iàm-ò͘ⁿ in, kā in oân-choân siau-bia̍t, tì-kàu ûi-pōe góa ka-kī kap in li̍p ê iok; in-ūi góa sī Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè.

Góa beh éng-oán ōe-kì-tit góa kap in ê chó͘-sian só͘ li̍p ê iok. Ūi-tio̍h beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè, góa hō͘ gōa-cho̍k-lâng chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa chiong in tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhōa--chhut-lâi. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
Í-siōng chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ, thong-kè Mô͘-se tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pan-pò͘ ê kui-lē, bēng-lēng, kap kà-sī.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Nā ū lâng hē te̍k-pia̍t ê goān beh hiàn-sin hō͘ Siōng Chú, i tio̍h chiàu lí só͘ kó͘-kè hit-ê lâng ê kè-chîⁿ hōng-hiàn.

Chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kui-tēng: jī-cha̍p-hè kàu la̍k-cha̍p-hè, ta-po͘-lâng gō͘-pah gō͘-cha̍p kong-khek ê gûn, cha-bó͘-lâng saⁿ-pah sì-cha̍p-jī kong-khek ê gûn; gō͘-hè kàu jī-cha̍p-hè, ta-po͘ gín-á nn̄g-pah jī-cha̍p-poeh kong-khek ê gûn, cha-bó͘ gín-á chi̍t-pah cha̍p-sì kong-khek ê gûn; móa-ge̍h kàu gō͘-hè, ta-po͘ gín-á gō͘-cha̍p-chhit kong-khek ê gûn, cha-bó͘ gín-á saⁿ-cha̍p-sì kong-khek ê gûn; la̍k-cha̍p-hè í-siōng, ta-po͘-lâng chi̍t-pah chhit-cha̍p-it kong-khek ê gûn, cha-bó͘-lâng chi̍t-pah cha̍p-sì kong-khek ê gûn.
Hē-goān ê lâng nā sàn-chhiah, bōe-tàng chiàu kui-tēng ê kè-chîⁿ hōng-hiàn, chiū tio̍h khì chè-si hia, hō͘ chè-si chiàu hit-ê lâng ê châi-le̍k kā i kó͘-kè.
Nā ū lâng hiàn cheng-siⁿ chòe lé-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú, tio̍h kā hit-chiah cheng-siⁿ hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng,
m̄-thang ēng pa̍t-chiah thòe-ōaⁿ, bô-lūn sī ēng hó--ê ōaⁿ bái--ê, á-sī ēng bái--ê ōaⁿ hó--ê; nā ēng cheng-siⁿ thòe-ōaⁿ cheng-siⁿ, nn̄g chiah lóng tio̍h hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng.
Lâng hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú chòe lé-mi̍h ê cheng-siⁿ nā bô chheng-khì, chiū tio̍h tòa hit-chiah cheng-siⁿ khì chè-si hia,
chè-si tio̍h chiàu cheng-siⁿ ê hó bái kó͘-kè; chè-si kó͘-kè jōa-chōe chiū-sī jōa-chōe.
Hit-ê lâng nā it-tēng beh sio̍k-hôe, chiū tio̍h tī kó͘-kè ê kè-chîⁿ í-gōa ke-thiⁿ gō͘-hūn-chi̍t.
Nā ū lâng kā chhù hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, chè-si tio̍h chiàu chhù ê hó bái kó͘-kè; chè-si kó͘-kè jōa-chōe chiū-sī jōa-chōe.
Kā hit-keng chhù hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê lâng nā beh sio̍k-hôe, chiū tio̍h tī kó͘-kè ê kè-chîⁿ í-gōa ke-thiⁿ gō͘-hūn-chi̍t, chhù chiah thang hêng i.

Nā ū lâng chiong kè-sêng ê thó͘-tōe ê chi̍t-pō͘-hūn hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, tio̍h chiàu hit-tè tōe ōe-tàng iā jōa-chōe chéng-chí lâi kó͘-kè; nā ōe-tàng iā tōa-be̍h jī-cha̍p kong-kun, kè-chîⁿ chiū-sī gō͘-pah chhit-cha̍p kong-khek ê gûn.
I nā tī Un-hūi ê Nî chiong tōe hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, hit-tè tōe ê kè-ta̍t chiū-sī chiàu lí kó͘-kè ê kè-chîⁿ.
I nā tī Un-hūi ê Nî í-āu hōng-hiàn, chè-si tio̍h chiàu hit-nî kàu āu-piàn Un-hūi ê Nî só͘ chhun ê nî-sò͘, tùi goân-lâi só͘ kó͘-kè--ê khàu--khí-lâi.
Hōng-hiàn ê lâng nā it-tēng beh sio̍k-hôe, chiū tio̍h tī kó͘-kè ê kè-chîⁿ í-gōa ke-thiⁿ gō͘-hūn-chi̍t, tōe chiah thang hêng i.
I nā bô beh sio̍k-hôe hit-tè tōe, á-sī bōe hō͘ pa̍t-lâng, chiū bōe-tàng koh sio̍k-hôe.
Kàu Un-hūi ê Nî, hit-tè tōe tio̍h éng-oán kui Siōng Chú, chòe chè-si ê sán-gia̍p.
Nā-sī i hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê tōe sī bóe--lâi-ê, m̄-sī kè-sêng--ê,
chè-si tio̍h chiàu hit-nî kàu Un-hūi ê Nî ê nî-sò͘, kó͘-kè hit-tè tōe ê kè-chîⁿ; hit-ji̍t i tio̍h chiàu kó͘-kè ê kè-chîⁿ hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Kàu Un-hūi ê Nî, hit-tè tōe tio̍h kui hō͘ goân-chú, chiū-sī kè-sêng hit-tè tōe ê lâng.
Chè-si tio̍h chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kong-chhìn kó͘-kè.
Thâu-chi̍t-the ê cheng-siⁿ, bô-lūn sī gû á-sī iûⁿ, í-keng kui hō͘ Siōng Chú, bōe-ēng-tit koh hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.

Nā-sī thâu-chi̍t-the ê cheng-siⁿ bô chheng-khì, chiū tio̍h chiàu kó͘-kè ê kè-chîⁿ ke gō͘-hūn-chi̍t sio̍k-hôe; nā bô beh sio̍k-hôe, chiū tio̍h chiàu kó͘-kè ê kè-chîⁿ kā bōe-tiāu.

Nā ū lâng chiong i só͘ ū--ê éng-oán hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, bô-lūn sī lâng, sī cheng-siⁿ, á-sī kè-sêng ê thó͘-tōe, lóng bōe-ēng-tit bōe, mā bōe-ēng-tit sio̍k-hôe; i hiàn--ê sī chì-sèng, éng-oán kui Siōng Chú.
Hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú tio̍h oân-choân húi-bia̍t ê lâng, bōe-ēng-tit sio̍k-hôe; i it-tēng tio̍h siū chhú-sí.
Thó͘-tōe chhut-sán ê mi̍h, bô-lūn sī ngó͘-kok, á-sī chhiū-téng ê ké-chí, cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t lóng sī Siōng Chú ê, sī sèng--ê.
Nā ū lâng beh sio̍k-hôe chit cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê mi̍h, tio̍h ke gō͘-hūn-chi̍t.
Gû-kûn kap iûⁿ-kûn keng-kè bo̍k-chiá koáiⁿ-á ē, ta̍k-piàn sǹg kàu tē-cha̍p chiah, hit-chiah tio̍h hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Bô-lūn hó bái, lóng m̄-thang thòe-ōaⁿ; nā thòe-ōaⁿ, nn̄g chiah lóng tio̍h hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, bōe-ēng-tit sio̍k-hôe.
Í-siōng chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ thong-kè Mô͘-se tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pan-pò͘ ê bēng-lēng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe liáu-āu, tē-jī nî jī-ge̍h chhoe-it, Siōng Chú tī Se-nāi ê khòng-iá, tī hōe-bō͘ hoan-hù Mô͘-se kóng,

“Lí kap A-lûn tio̍h chiàu chong-cho̍k, ka-cho̍k tiám-sǹg Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng ê jîn-sò͘, teng-lio̍k jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng, ōe-tàng chhut-khì kau-chiàn ê ta-po͘-teng ê miâ, kā in phian-tūi, thóng-kè jîn-sò͘.
Ta̍k-ê chi-cho̍k tio̍h ū chi̍t ê lâng, chiū-sī in ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ hia̍p-chō͘ lín.

Ē-bīn sī hia̍p-chō͘ lín ê lâng ê miâ-toaⁿ: Lū-piān chi-cho̍k, Sī-tiu-ní ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-siok Se-biān chi-cho̍k, So͘-lī-sa-tāi ê kiáⁿ Sī-lō͘-bi̍t Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k, A-bí-ná-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Ná-sūn Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k, So͘-ap ê kiáⁿ Ná-thán-gia̍p Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k, Hi-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-ap Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi nn̄g ê chi-cho̍k: Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k, A-bí-hut ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-sa-má; Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k, Pí-tāi-siok ê kiáⁿ Ka-má-lia̍t Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k, Ki-to-nî ê kiáⁿ A-pí-tān Tān chi-cho̍k, A-bí-sa-tāi ê kiáⁿ A-hi-í-siā A-siat chi-cho̍k, Gô-lân ê kiáⁿ Phà-kiat Ka-tek chi-cho̍k, Tiu-ní ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-ngá-sat sxxNá-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k, Í-lâm ê kiáⁿ A-hi-la
Chiah-ê sī tùi hōe-chiòng soán-chhut ta̍k-ê chi-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, lóng chòe Í-sek-lia̍t kun-tūi ê chí-hui-koaⁿ.”
Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chiū chhōa hiah-ê ū tī miâ-toaⁿ ê lâng,
tī jī-ge̍h chhoe-it tiàu-chi̍p choân-thé hōe-chiòng, chiàu chong-cho̍k, ka-cho̍k, teng-lio̍k jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng ê ta-po͘-teng ê miâ.
Mô͘-se chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, tī Se-nāi ê khòng-iá kā in tiám-sǹg.

Ē-bīn sī Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi, chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, ka-cho̍k, kap lâng-miâ ê sò͘-bo̍k, jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng ōe-tàng chhut-khì kau-chiàn ê ta-po͘-teng ê jîn-sò͘: Lū-piān chi-cho̍k, sì-bān la̍k-chheng gō͘-pah miâ Se-biān chi-cho̍k, gō͘-bān káu-chheng saⁿ-pah miâ Ka-tek chi-cho̍k, sì-bān gō͘-chheng la̍k-pah gō͘-cha̍p miâ Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k, chhit-bān sì-chheng la̍k-pah miâ Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k, gō͘-bān sì-chheng sì-pah miâ Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k, gō͘-bān chhit-chheng sì-pah miâ Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi nn̄g ê chi-cho̍k: Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k, sì-bān khòng gō͘-pah miâ Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k, saⁿ-bān nn̄g-chheng nn̄g-pah miâ Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k, saⁿ-bān gō͘-chheng sì-pah miâ Tān chi-cho̍k, la̍k-bān nn̄g-chheng chhit-pah miâ A-siat chi-cho̍k, sì-bān chi̍t-chheng gō͘-pah miâ Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k, gō͘-bān saⁿ-chheng sì-pah miâ 44Í-siōng chiah-ê sī Mô͘-se, A-lûn, kap Í-sek-lia̍t cha̍p-jī ê siú-léng tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘; chiah-ê siú-léng ta̍k-ê tāi-piáu in ê chi-cho̍k. 45Í-sek-lia̍t-lâng chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, tùi jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng ōe-tàng chhut-khì kau-chiàn ê lâng, 46teng-lio̍k ê jîn-sò͘ chóng-kiōng la̍k-cha̍p-bān saⁿ-chheng gō͘-pah gō͘-cha̍p miâ. 47M̄-kú Lī-bī-lâng bô chiàu in chó͘-sian ê chong-cho̍k teng-lio̍k chāi-lāi. 48In-ūi Siōng Chú bat hoan-hù Mô͘-se, kóng, 49“Lī-bī chi-cho̍k lí m̄-thang tiám-sǹg, m̄-thang tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong sǹg in ê jîn-kháu. 50Lí tio̍h phài Lī-bī-lâng koán-lí hōe-bō͘ kap lāi-bīn ê khì-khū, pau-koat kng hōe-bō͘ kap lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê khì-khū, chéng-lí hōe-bō͘, tī hōe-bō͘ ê chiu-ûi chat-iâⁿ. 51Hōe-bō͘ beh chhut-hoat ê sî, Lī-bī-lâng hū-chek thiah hōe-bō͘; beh an-tì hōe-bō͘ ê sî, Lī-bī-lâng hū-chek tah; nā ū kî-tha ê lâng óa-kūn hōe-bō͘, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí. 52Í-sek-lia̍t-lâng ta̍k-ê tio̍h tī in só͘ sio̍k chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî ē-bīn, chiàu in ê pō͘-tūi chat-iâⁿ. 53M̄-kú Lī-bī-lâng tio̍h tī hōe-bō͘ ê chiu-ûi chat-iâⁿ, hū-chek kò͘-siú hōe-bō͘, chiah bián góa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng hoat tōa siū-khì.” 54Siōng Chú án-chóaⁿ hoan-hù Mô͘-se, Í-sek-lia̍t-lâng lóng chiàu án-ni chòe.
Siōng Chú koh hoan-hù Mô͘-se kap A-lûn, kóng,
“ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng tio̍h chiàu ka-kī chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî kap chong-cho̍k ê kì-hō, tī hōe-bō͘ ê chiu-ûi ǹg hōe-bō͘ chat-iâⁿ.
“Tang-pêng, ǹg ji̍t chhut ê hong-hiòng, chhāi Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî, Iû-tāi ê kun-tūi tī hia chat-iâⁿ; A-bí-ná-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Ná-sūn chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ chhit-bān sì-chheng la̍k-pah miâ.
Tī in piⁿ--á chat-iâⁿ--ê sī Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k, So͘-ap ê kiáⁿ Ná-thán-gia̍p chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ gō͘-bān sì-chheng sì-pah miâ.
Koh-lâi sī Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k, Hi-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-ap chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ gō͘-bān chhit-chheng sì-pah miâ.
Sio̍k Iû-tāi khu ê jîn-sò͘ chóng-kiōng cha̍p-poeh-bān la̍k-chheng sì-pah miâ. In choh-thâu chhut-hoat.
“Lâm-pêng, chhāi Lū-piān chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî, Lū-piān ê kun-tūi tī hia chat-iâⁿ, Sī-tiu-ní ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-siok chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ kiōng sì-bān la̍k-chheng gō͘-pah miâ.
Tī in piⁿ--á chat-iâⁿ--ê sī Se-biān chi-cho̍k, So͘-lī-sa-tāi ê kiáⁿ Sī-lō͘-bi̍t chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ kiōng gō͘-bān káu-chheng saⁿ-pah miâ.
Koh-lâi sī Ka-tek chi-cho̍k, Tiu-ní ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-ngá-sat chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ kiōng sì-bān gō͘-chheng la̍k-pah gō͘-cha̍p miâ.
Sio̍k Lū-piān khu ê jîn-sò͘ chóng-kiōng cha̍p-gō͘-bān chi̍t-chheng sì-pah gō͘-cha̍p miâ. In chòe tē-jī tōa-tūi chhut-hoat.

“Hōe-bō͘ kap Lī-bī -lâng tio̍h tī chêng nn̄g tōa-tūi kap āu nn̄g tōa-tūi ê tiong-kan. In án-chóaⁿ chat-iâⁿ, chiū chiàu hit-ê chhù-sū khí-sin; ta̍k chi-cho̍k tio̍h tè in ka-kī chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî chiân-chìn.
“Sai-pêng, chhāi Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî, Í-hoat-liân ê kun-tūi tī hia chat-iâⁿ, A-bí-hut ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-sa-má chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ kiōng sì-bān khòng gō͘-pah miâ.
Tī in piⁿ--á-ê sī Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k, Pí-tāi-siok ê kiáⁿ Ka-má-lia̍t chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ kiōng saⁿ-bān nn̄g-chheng nn̄g-pah miâ.
Koh-lâi sī Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k, Ki-to-nî ê kiáⁿ A-pí-tān chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ kiōng saⁿ-bān gō͘-chheng sì-pah miâ.
Sio̍k Í-hoat-liân khu, jîn-sò͘ chóng-kiōng cha̍p-bān poeh-chheng chi̍t-pah miâ. In chòe tē-saⁿ tōa-tūi chhut-hoat.
“Pak-pêng, chhāi Tān chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî, Tān ê kun-tūi tī hia chat-iâⁿ, A-bí-sa-tāi ê kiáⁿ A-hi-í-siā chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ kiōng la̍k-bān nn̄g-chheng chhit-pah miâ.
Tī in piⁿ--á-ê sī A-siat chi-cho̍k, Gô-lân ê kiáⁿ Phà-kiat chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ kiōng sì-bān chi̍t-chheng gō͘-pah miâ.
Koh-lâi sī Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k, Í-lâm ê kiáⁿ A-hi-la chòe siú-léng,
jîn-sò͘ kiōng gō͘-bān saⁿ-chheng sì-pah miâ.
Sio̍k Tān hit-khu, jîn-sò͘ chóng-kiōng cha̍p-gō͘-bān chhit-chheng la̍k-pah miâ. Chit tōa-tūi tio̍h tè in ê tōa-kî chòe-āu chhut-hoat.”
Í-siōng sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, tī iâⁿ-lāi chiàu in ê pō͘-tūi thóng-kè ê jîn-sò͘, chóng-kiōng la̍k-cha̍p-bān saⁿ-chheng gō͘-pah gō͘-cha̍p miâ.
M̄-kú Lī-bī -lâng bô sǹg chāi-lāi, sī chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, ka-cho̍k, tè in ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî chat-iâⁿ, chhut-hoat, lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng.
Ē-bīn chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ tùi Mô͘-se kóng-ōe ê sî, A-lûn kap Mô͘-se ê hō͘-tāi:
A-lûn ū sì ê kiáⁿ: tōa-kiáⁿ Ná-tap, koh ū A-pí-hō͘, Í-lī-a-sat, Í-tha-má;
in lóng siū boah-iû siat-li̍p chòe chè-si, hū-chek chè-si ê chit-hūn.

Ná-tap kap A-pí-hō͘ tī Se-nāi ê khòng-iá, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng hiàn bô sîn-sèng ê hé, chiū hō͘ Siōng Chú phah-sí; in bô kiáⁿ-jî. Í-lī-a-sat kap Í-tha-má tī in lāu-pē A-lûn oa̍h--teh ê sî, chiū tam-jīm chè-si.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí kiò Lī-bī chi-cho̍k lâi góa chia, lâi hia̍p-chō͘ chè-si A-lûn.
In tio̍h thòe A-lûn kap hōe-chiòng tī hōe-bō͘ chêng chip-hêng jīm-bū, pān-lí hōe-bō͘ ê sū.
In tio̍h kò͘-siú hōe-bō͘ só͘-ū ê khì-khū, ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chip-hêng jīm-bū, pān-lí hōe-bō͘ ê sū.
Lí tio̍h chí-phài Lī-bī -lâng hia̍p-chō͘ A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ; che sī in tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan siū chí-phài î-it ê jīm-bū.
Lí tio̍h hun-phài A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ chip-hêng chè-si ê chit-bū; kî-tha ê lâng nā kūn-óa--lâi, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí.”
Siōng Chú koh hoan-hù Mô͘-se kóng,
“Góa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan kéng Lī-bī -lâng, tāi-thòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘-ū thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê tōa-kiáⁿ; Lī-bī -lâng sī góa ê,

in-ūi it-chhè ê tōa-kiáⁿ lóng sī góa ê. Góa phah-sí Ai-ki̍p -lâng só͘-ū thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ--ê hit-ji̍t, chiū chiong Í-sek-lia̍t tiong só͘-ū thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ--ê, bô-lūn sī lâng á-sī cheng-siⁿ, lóng hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng kui-sio̍k góa; in sī góa ê. Góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Siōng Chú tī Se-nāi ê khòng-iá hoan-hù Mô͘-se, kóng,
“Lí tio̍h chiàu Lī-bī -lâng ê chong-cho̍k, ka-cho̍k tiám-sǹg in ê jîn-kháu; móa-ge̍h í-siōng ê ta-po͘ gín-á lóng tio̍h sǹg chāi-lāi.”
Mô͘-se chiū chiàu Siōng Chú tùi i ê bēng-lēng, tiám-sǹg Lī-bī -lâng ê jîn-kháu.
Lī-bī ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ, chiū-sī Kek-sūn, Ko-hat, kap Bí-la-lī.
Kek-sūn ê kiáⁿ, chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, ū Li̍p-nî kap Sī-múi.
Ko-hat ê kiáⁿ, chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, ū Àm-lân, Í-su-hap, Hi-pek-lûn, kap O͘-siat.
Bí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ, chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, ū Boat-lī kap Bō͘-sī. In sī Lī-bī chi-cho̍k ta̍k chong-cho̍k ê chó͘-sian.
Kek-sūn ê chong-cho̍k ū Li̍p-nî kap Sī-múi nn̄g ê ka-cho̍k.
In móa-ge̍h í-siōng ê ta-po͘-lâng tiám-sǹg liáu, jîn-sò͘ kiōng chhit-chheng gō͘-pah miâ.
Kek-sūn ê chong-cho̍k tio̍h tī hōe-bō͘ ê sai-pêng, chiū-sī hōe-bō͘ ê āu-bīn chat-iâⁿ.
Kek-sūn chong-cho̍k ê siú-léng sī La-i-le̍k ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-ngá-sat.
Kek-sūn ê kiáⁿ-sun tio̍h hū-chek kò͘-siú hōe-bō͘, pò͘-phâng, pò͘-phâng ê kòa, hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-lî,
hōe-bō͘ kap chè-tôaⁿ chiu-ûi ê tiâⁿ ê ûi kap mn̂g-lî, í-ki̍p teh ēng ê soh.
Ko-hat chong-cho̍k ū Àm-lân, Í-su-hap, Hi-pek-lûn, kap O͘-siat sì ê ka-cho̍k.
In tio̍h hū-chek chéng-lí sèng-só͘; móa-ge̍h í-siōng ê ta-po͘-lâng tiám-sǹg liáu, jîn-sò͘ kiōng poeh-chheng la̍k-pah miâ.
Ko-hat chong-cho̍k tio̍h tī hōe-bō͘ ê lâm-pêng chat-iâⁿ.
Ko-hat chong-cho̍k ê siú-léng sī O͘-siat ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-sat-hoán.

Ko-hat ê kiáⁿ-sun tio̍h hū-chek kò͘-siú iok-kūi, pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê toh, teng-tâi, chè-tôaⁿ kap hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ, chè-si tī sèng-só͘ lāi-bīn teh ēng ê khì-khū, mn̂g-lî, kap só͘-ū teh ēng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ.
Chè-si A-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat chòe Lī-bī ta̍k chong-cho̍k ê siú-léng ê thâu, hū-chek kàm-tok só͘-ū kò͘-siú sèng-só͘ ê lâng.
Bí-la-lī chong-cho̍k ū Boat-lī kap Bō͘-sī nn̄g ê ka-cho̍k.
In móa-ge̍h í-siōng ê ta-po͘-lâng tiám-sǹg liáu, jîn-sò͘ kiōng la̍k-chheng nn̄g-pah miâ.
Bí-la-lī chong-cho̍k ê siú-léng sī A-pí-hâi ê kiáⁿ So͘-lia̍t; in tio̍h tī hōe-bō͘ ê pak-pêng chat-iâⁿ.
Bí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ-sun tio̍h hū-chek kò͘-siú hōe-bō͘ ê pán, hoâiⁿ-kông, thiāu, ū sún-khang ê chō, só͘-ū ê khì-khū, kap só͘-ū teh ēng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ;
koh tio̍h kò͘-siú tiâⁿ chiu-ûi ê thiāu, ū sún-khang ê chō, í-ki̍p khi̍t-á kap soh-á.

Tī hōe-bō͘ ê tang-pêng, chiū-sī tī hōe-bō͘ ǹg ji̍t chhut hit-pêng, Mô͘-se, A-lûn kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ tī hia chat-iâⁿ; in tāi-thòe só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hū-chek kò͘-siú sèng-só͘; kî-tha ê lâng nā kūn-óa--lâi, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i sí.
Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng tiám-sǹg Lī-bī -lâng; chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, móa-ge̍h í-siōng ê ta-po͘-lâng jîn-sò͘ kiōng nn̄g-bān nn̄g-chheng miâ.
Siōng Chú kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h tiám-sǹg Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng móa-ge̍h í-siōng thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê ta-po͘-lâng ê jîn-sò͘, chō in ê miâ-chheh.

Góa sī Siōng Chú. Lí tio̍h kéng-soán Lī-bī -lâng kui-sio̍k góa, tāi-thòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘-ū ê tōa-kiáⁿ; mā chhú Lī-bī -lâng ê cheng-siⁿ, tāi-thòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ ū thâu-chúi kang ê cheng-siⁿ.”
Mô͘-se chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, tiám-sǹg Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘-ū ê tōa-kiáⁿ.
Chiàu miâ-chheh, móa-ge̍h í-siōng ê tōa-kiáⁿ, jîn-sò͘ kiōng nn̄g-bān nn̄g-chheng nn̄g-pah chhit-cha̍p-saⁿ miâ.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se, kóng,

“Lí tio̍h kéng-soán Lī-bī -lâng tāi-thòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘-ū ê tōa-kiáⁿ, koh chhú Lī-bī -lâng ê cheng-siⁿ tāi-thòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê cheng-siⁿ; án-ni, Lī-bī -lâng chiū kui-sio̍k góa. Góa sī Siōng Chú.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tōa-kiáⁿ pí Lī-bī -lâng ke nn̄g-pah chhit-cha̍p-saⁿ ê, lí tio̍h kā in sio̍k-hôe;
chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kong-chhìn, chi̍t ê lâng ê sio̍k-kim sī gō͘-cha̍p-chhit kong-khek ê gûn.
Hiah-ê ke--chhut-lâi ê lâng ê sio̍k-kim, lí tio̍h kau hō͘ A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ.”
Mô͘-se chiū tùi hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng sio̍k-hôe í-gōa hiah-ê ke--chhut-lâi ê lâng the̍h sio̍k-kim.
Tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tōa-kiáⁿ the̍h ê sio̍k-kim, chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kong-chhìn, tāi-iok ū gûn cha̍p-gō͘ kong-kun.
Mô͘-se chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, chiong chiah-ê sio̍k-kim kau hō͘ A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se kap A-lûn, kóng,
“Lín tio̍h chiàu chong-cho̍k kap ka-cho̍k, tiám-sǹg Lī-bī -lâng Ko-hat ê hō͘-tāi, tùi saⁿ-cha̍p hè kàu gō͘-cha̍p hè tī hōe-bō͘ tng-chit choh-kang ê lâng ê jîn-sò͘.
Ko-hat ê hō͘-tāi tio̍h hū-chek koán-lí hōe-bō͘ lāi-bīn chì-sèng ê mi̍h.
“Beh sóa-iâⁿ ê sî, A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ tio̍h ji̍p-khì hōe-bō͘, chiong jia-cha̍h ê tiùⁿ-lî pak lo̍h-lâi khàm iok-kūi;
koh tio̍h ēng siōng-téng ê phê khàm tī téng-bīn, jiân-āu khàm sûn-nâ ê pò͘, chiah kā iok-kūi chhng kǹg.

“In tio̍h ēng nâ-sek ê pò͘ chhu tī pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê toh; chiong chiah-ê pôaⁿ, phiat-á, tiān-chiú-chè ê ô͘ kap poe, pâi tī hit téng-bīn; hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ tio̍h lâu tī toh-téng.
Pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê toh tio̍h khàm chu-âng-sek ê pò͘, koh khàm siōng-téng ê phê, chiah kā toh-á chhng kǹg.
“In tio̍h the̍h nâ-sek ê pò͘ khàm teng-tâi, teng-tâi ê poe, teng-chián, teng-pôaⁿ, í-ki̍p só͘-ū tóe iû ê khì-khū.
Koh tio̍h chiong teng-tâi, kap teng-tâi só͘-ū ê khì-khū, ēng siōng-téng ê phê pau hó-sè, hē tī ūn-poaⁿ ê kè téng-bīn.
“In tio̍h chhu nâ-sek ê pò͘ tī kim chè-tôaⁿ téng-bīn, koh ēng siōng-téng ê phê khàm--teh, chiah kā tôaⁿ chhng kǹg.
Mā tio̍h ēng nâ-sek ê pò͘ pau sèng-só͘ lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê khì-khū, chiah ēng siōng-téng ê phê khàm--teh, hē tī ūn-poaⁿ ê kè téng-bīn.
In tio̍h chiong chè-tôaⁿ ê hé-hu chheng hō͘ chheng-khì, ēng chí-sek ê pò͘ khàm tī chè-tôaⁿ téng-bīn.
Koh tio̍h chiong chè-tôaⁿ teh ēng ê hé-tiáⁿ, bah-chhe, thuh-á, pôaⁿ hē tī chè-tôaⁿ téng-bīn, jiân-āu ēng siōng-téng ê phê khàm tī hit téng-bīn, chiah kā tôaⁿ chhng kǹg.

“Beh sóa-iâⁿ ê sî, A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ chiong sèng-só͘ kap só͘-ū ê khì-khū pau hó-sè, jiân-āu Ko-hat ê kiáⁿ-sun lâi kng; m̄-kú in m̄-thang bong-tio̍h sèng ê mi̍h, chiah bián sí; hōe-bō͘ lāi-bīn chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ sī Ko-hat ê kiáⁿ-sun tio̍h kng--ê.

“Chè-si A-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat tio̍h hū-chek koán-lí tiám-teng ê iû, hiuⁿ-liāu, siông-siông hiàn ê sò͘-chè, kap thang boah ê sèng-iû; mā tio̍h kò͘-siú hōe-bō͘ kap lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, í-ki̍p sèng-só͘ kap sèng-só͘ só͘-ū ê khì-khū.”
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se kap A-lûn, kóng,
“Lín m̄-thang hō͘ Ko-hat chong-cho̍k tùi Lī-bī -lâng ê tiong-kan siū siau-bia̍t.

A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ tio̍h ji̍p-khì hōe-bō͘ chí-phài in ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h chòe ê kang-chok, tio̍h kng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, thang hō͘ in tī óa-kūn chì-sèng ê mi̍h ê sî, iáu ōe oa̍h, bián sí.
In bōe-ēng-tit ji̍p-khì khòaⁿ sèng-mi̍h ūn-poaⁿ ê ū-pī kang-chok, chiah bián sí.”
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se, kóng,
“Lí tio̍h chiàu chong-cho̍k kap ka-cho̍k tiám-sǹg Kek-sūn ê hō͘-tāi,
saⁿ-cha̍p hè kàu gō͘-cha̍p hè tī hōe-bō͘ tng-chit choh-kang ê lâng ê jîn-sò͘.
Kek-sūn ê chong-cho̍k tio̍h pān-lí ê kang-chok, tio̍h kng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ sī chiah-ê:
In tio̍h kng hōe-bō͘ hiah-ê tiùⁿ-bō͘, hōe-bō͘, hōe-bō͘ ê kòa, hit téng-bīn siōng-téng ê phê chòe ê kòa, hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g-lî,
hōe-bō͘ kap chè-tôaⁿ chiu-ûi ê tiâⁿ ê pò͘-ûi kap mn̂g-lî, soh-á, kap in teh ēng só͘-ū ê khì-khū; kap chiah-ê khì-khū iú-koan ê kang-chok, in lóng tio̍h hū-chek.
Kek-sūn ê hō͘-tāi tio̍h chiàu A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun ê bēng-lēng kng mi̍h-kiāⁿ, pān-lí sū-bū; in beh kng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, lín tio̍h kau-tài in hū-chek.
Í-siōng sī Kek-sūn chong-cho̍k tī hōe-bō͘ ê chit-chek; in tio̍h siū chè-si A-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-tha-má kàm-tok.”
“Lí tio̍h chiàu chong-cho̍k kap ka-cho̍k tiám-sǹg Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi,
saⁿ-cha̍p hè kàu gō͘-cha̍p hè tī hōe-bō͘ tng-chit choh-kang ê lâng ê jîn-sò͘.
In tī hōe-bō͘ lāi tio̍h hū-chek ê chit-bū, chiū-sī kng hōe-bō͘ ê pán, hoâiⁿ-kông, thiāu, ū sún-khang ê chō,
tiâⁿ chiu-ûi ê thiāu, thiāu ê chō, khi̍t-á kap soh-á, í-ki̍p teh ēng ê khì-khū; ta̍k-hāng tio̍h kng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, lóng tio̍h ū chí-tēng ê lâng hū-chek.
Í-siōng sī Bí-la-lī chong-cho̍k tī hōe-bō͘ ê chit-chek; in tio̍h siū chè-si A-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-tha-má kàm-tok.”
Mô͘-se, A-lûn, kap hōe-chiòng ê siú-léng, chiàu chong-cho̍k kap ka-cho̍k tiám-sǹg Ko-hat ê hō͘-tāi,
saⁿ-cha̍p hè kàu gō͘-cha̍p hè tī hōe-bō͘ tng-chit choh-kang ê lâng ê jîn-sò͘,
kiōng nn̄g-chheng chhit-pah gō͘-cha̍p miâ.
Che sī Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng, tiám-sǹg Ko-hat chong-cho̍k tī hōe-bō͘ tng-chit choh-kang ê lâng ê jîn-sò͘.
Kek-sūn ê hō͘-tāi, chiàu chong-cho̍k kap ka-cho̍k, tiám-sǹg
saⁿ-cha̍p hè kàu gō͘-cha̍p hè tī hōe-bō͘ tng-chit choh-kang ê lâng ê jîn-sò͘,
kiōng nn̄g-chheng la̍k-pah saⁿ-cha̍p miâ.
Che sī Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng, tiám-sǹg Kek-sūn chong-cho̍k tī hōe-bō͘ tng-chit choh-kang ê lâng ê jîn-sò͘.
Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi, chiàu chong-cho̍k kap ka-cho̍k tiám-sǹg
saⁿ-cha̍p hè kàu gō͘-cha̍p hè tī hōe-bō͘ tng-chit choh-kang ê lâng ê jîn-sò͘,
kiōng saⁿ-chheng nn̄g-pah miâ.
Che sī Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng, tiám-sǹg Bí-la-lī chong-cho̍k ê jîn-sò͘.
Mô͘-se, A-lûn, kap Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng ê siú-léng, chiàu chong-cho̍k kap ka-cho̍k tiám-sǹg Lī-bī -lâng,
saⁿ-cha̍p hè kàu gō͘-cha̍p hè tī hōe-bō͘ tng-chit chòe kang, kng mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê lâng ê jîn-sò͘,
chóng-kiōng poeh-chheng gō͘-pah poeh-cha̍p miâ.
Mô͘-se chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chí-phài ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h pān ê sū-bū, tio̍h kng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ. In lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng án-ni teng-lio̍k.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiong só͘-ū tì-tio̍h giâm-tiōng ê phê-hu-pīⁿ, hā-siau, kap bong-tio̍h si-thé tì-kàu bô chheng-khì ê lâng sàng chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa.
Bô-lūn lâm-lú, lín lóng tio̍h kā in sàng chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa, chiah bián in phah lâ-sâm chit-ê iâⁿ-tōe, in-ūi góa tòa tī chia.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū chiàu án-ni, kā bô chheng-khì ê lâng sàng chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa; Siōng Chú án-ni bēng-lēng Mô͘-se, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū chiàu án-ni chòe.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se
tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Nā ū lâng khek-khui lâng tek-chōe Siōng Chú, bô-lūn lâm-lú, hit-ê lâng chiū ū chōe.
I tio̍h jīn-chōe, pê choân-pō͘ ê sún-sit koh ke gō͘-hūn-chi̍t hō͘ siū-hāi ê lâng.

Hit-ê siū-hāi ê lâng nā bô chhin-lâng thang chiap-siū pê-siông, kā lâng khek-khui hit-ê lâng tio̍h chiong pê-siông ê chîⁿ hêng hō͘ Siōng Chú, kui tī chè-si; lēng-gōa, i tio̍h koh hiàn chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-káng ūi ka-kī sio̍k-chōe, mā kui hō͘ chè-si.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa-lâi chè-si hia hōng-hiàn ê sèng-mi̍h tiong-kan, só͘-ū gia̍h-koân hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê, lóng tio̍h kui hō͘ chè-si.
Lâng hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê lé-mi̍h, lóng tio̍h kui hō͘ chè-si; lâng bô-lūn ēng sím-mi̍h sàng hō͘ chè-si, lóng tio̍h kui hō͘ chè-si.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se

tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Nā ū lâng hoâi-gî i ê bó͘ tùi i put-tiong, àm-tiong kap lâng hoat-seng sèng-koan-hē, phah lâ-sâm ka-kī, i m̄ chai, tāi-chì mā bô po̍k-lō͘, bô lâng choh-chèng, koh bô hō͘ lâng lia̍h--tio̍h; put-koán i ê bó͘ ū phah lâ-sâm ka-kī, ín-khí i hoâi-gî oàn-tò͘, á-sī i ê bó͘ bô phah lâ-sâm ka-kī, m̄-kú i hoâi-gî oàn-tò͘;

hit-ê lâng tio̍h chhōa i ê bó͘ khì chè-si hia, koh tòa chi̍t kong-kun bô lām iû kap jú-hiuⁿ ê tōa-be̍h-hún chòe lé-mi̍h, che sī ūi-tio̍h hoâi-gî oàn-tò͘ só͘ hiàn ê sò͘-chè, beh hō͘ lâng ōe-kì-tit chōe-kò.
Chè-si tio̍h hō͘ hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng óa--lâi, khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.
Chè-si tio̍h ēng sèng ê chúi tóe tī chho͘-hûi, koh tùi hōe-bō͘ ê thô͘-kha the̍h chi̍t-tiám-á thô͘-hún, chham tī chúi-tiong.

Chè-si tio̍h hō͘ hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, phah-sàm hū-jîn-lâng ê thâu-mn̂g, chiong hō͘ lâng ōe-kì-tit chōe-kò ê sò͘-chè, chiū-sī hoâi-gî oàn-tò͘ ê sò͘-chè, hē tī hū-jîn-lâng ê chhiú; chè-si tio̍h phóng chiù-chó͘ ê khó͘-chúi,

kiò hū-jîn-lâng chiù-chōa, tùi i kóng, “Lí í-keng kè hō͘ lí ê tiōng-hu, nā bô kap pa̍t-lâng hoat-seng sèng-koan-hē, phah lâ-sâm ka-kī, lí chiū bōe siū-tio̍h chit-ê khó͘-chúi ê chiù-chó͘.
M̄-kú lí nā tùi lí ê tiōng-hu put-tiong, kap tiōng-hu í-gōa ê lâng hoat-seng sèng-koan-hē,
goān Siōng Chú hō͘ lí ê tōa-thúi siau-sán, pak-tó͘ tiòng--khí-lâi, hō͘ lí chiâⁿ-chòe jîn-bîn chiù-chó͘ ê ōe-pìⁿ.
Koh chit-ê chiù-chó͘ ê chúi beh ji̍p-khì lí ê seng-khu, hō͘ lí ê pak-tó͘ tiòng--khí-lâi, tōa-thúi siau-sán.” Hū-jîn-lâng tio̍h ìn kóng, “Amen, Amen.”
Chè-si tio̍h chiong chiah-ê chiù-chó͘ ê ōe siá tī chheh-kǹg, khǹg ji̍p-khì khó͘-chúi lāi-bīn sóe-tiāu.
Hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng nā lim chit-ê chiù-chó͘ ê khó͘-chúi, chit-ê chúi ji̍p-khì i ê seng-khu, ōe hō͘ i thòng-khó͘.
Chè-si tio̍h tùi hū-jîn-lâng ê chhiú chiap hoâi-gî oàn-tò͘ ê sò͘-chè, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng iô-iô--leh, tòa-khì chè-tôaⁿ chêng;
koh tio̍h mi chi̍t pé tōa-be̍h-hún, tāi-piáu só͘ hiàn ê sò͘-chè, hē tī tôaⁿ-téng sio, jiân-āu hō͘ hū-jîn-lâng lim chit-ê chúi.

Hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng lim chit-ê chiù-chó͘ ê khó͘-chúi, i nā chin-chiàⁿ ū phah lâ-sâm ka-kī, tùi tiōng-hu put-tiong, chit-ê chúi ji̍p-khì i ê seng-khu, ōe hō͘ i thòng-khó͘, pak-tó͘ tiòng--khí-lâi, tōa-thúi siau-sán; hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng ōe hō͘ tông-pau chiù-chó͘.
M̄-kú i nā bô phah lâ-sâm ka-kī, si̍t-chāi sī chheng-pe̍k, chiū bōe siū chit-khoán chai-hō, ōe koh hoâi-īn.
Í-siōng sī hoâi-gî bó͘ put-tiong ê chhú-lí pān-hoat. Bó͘ í-keng kè hō͘ tiōng-hu, nā tùi tiōng-hu put-tiong phah lâ-sâm ka-kī,
á-sī tiōng-hu oàn-tò͘ hoâi-gî i ê bó͘, chiū tio̍h hō͘ i ê bó͘ khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng; chè-si tio̍h chiàu chit-ê pān-hoat chhú-lí.
Án-ni, ta-po͘-lâng bô chōe, hū-jîn-lâng tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se
tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Nā ū lâng, bô-lūn lâm-lú, hē te̍k-pia̍t ê goān beh chòe Ná-sè-ní-lâng, chiong ka-kī hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú,
án-ni, i po̍h-chiú kap kāu-chiú, í-ki̍p ēng po̍h-chiú kāu-chiú chòe ê chhò͘, lóng m̄-thang lim, mā m̄-thang lim phû-tô-chiap, m̄-thang chia̍h phû-tô kap phû-tô-koaⁿ.
Tī hē-goān kî-kan, phû-tô-chhiū só͘ chhut--ê, sīm-chì chí kap phê, lóng m̄-thang chia̍h.

I tī hē-goān chòe Ná-sè-ní-lâng kî-kan, m̄-thang thì-thâu; kàu i chiong ka-kī hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê ji̍t-kî móa í-chêng, tio̍h hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, chhut-chāi thâu-mn̂g hoat-tn̂g.
Tī i chòe Ná-sè-ní-lâng hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê kî-kan, m̄-thang óa-kūn sin-si.
Chiū-sī pē-bú, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē sí, i mā m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h in ê sin-si hō͘ ka-kī bô chheng-khì, in-ūi i ê thâu-khak ū chòe Ná-sè-ní-lâng hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè ê kì-hō.
Tī i chòe Ná-sè-ní-lâng ê kî-kan, i sī kui hō͘ Siōng Chú chòe sèng.
I ê sin-piⁿ nā hut-jiân ū lâng sí, tì-kàu phah lâ-sâm i hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê thâu-khak, i tio̍h tī chheng-khì ê ji̍t, chiū-sī tī tē-chhit ji̍t thì-thâu.
Tē-poeh ji̍t, i tio̍h tòa nn̄g chiah pan-kah á-sī hún-chiáu-á-kiáⁿ lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, kau hō͘ chè-si.

Chè-si tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, chi̍t chiah chòe sio-hòa-chè, ūi-tio̍h hit-ê lâng in-ūi bak-tio̍h sin-si ín-khí ê bô chheng-khì sio̍k-chōe, koh tio̍h tī hit-ji̍t hō͘ i ê thâu-khak têng-sin chòe sèng.

I tio̍h koh soán chi̍t ji̍t, chiong ka-kī hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; koh tio̍h khan chi̍t chiah chi̍t-hè ê iûⁿ-káng-á chòe pê-chōe-chè; m̄-kú í-chêng hit kúi ji̍t bô chún-sǹg, in-ūi i chòe Ná-sè-ní-lâng hit tiong-kan í-keng bak-tio̍h lâ-sâm.
Hōng-hiàn chòe Ná-sè-ní-lâng ê kî-hān nā kàu, tio̍h chiàu ē-bīn eng-kai chun-siú ê tiâu-lē chòe: I tio̍h hō͘ lâng chhōa kàu hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu,

hiàn lé-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú, chiū-sī chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á chòe sio-hòa-chè, chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-bú-á chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, kap chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê mî-iûⁿ-káng chòe pêng-an-chè;
koh hiàn kui-nâ ēng chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chòe ê bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ, í-ki̍p boah-iû ê bô-kàⁿ po̍h-piáⁿ, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè.
Chè-si tio̍h the̍h chiah-ê lé-mi̍h, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng hiàn-chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè kap sio-hòa-chè,
mā tio̍h chiong hit-chiah iûⁿ-káng kap hit-nâ bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú chòe pêng-an-chè, koh hiàn sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè.
Ná-sè-ní-lâng tio̍h tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu thì-thâu, chiong i hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê thâu-mn̂g hē tī pêng-an-chè ê ē-bīn sio.

Ná-sè-ní-lâng thì i hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê thâu-mn̂g liáu-āu, chè-si tio̍h chhú chú--kè ê iûⁿ-káng chi̍t ki chêng-thúi, koh tùi nâ-á lāi the̍h chi̍t tè bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ kap chi̍t tè bô-kàⁿ po̍h-piáⁿ, hē tī hit-ê lâng ê chhiú.

Chè-si tio̍h chiong chiah-ê lé-mi̍h tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng iô-iô--leh; chiah-ê kap iô--kè ê heng-khám-bah, gia̍h-koân ê chiàⁿ-pêng tōa-thúi lóng chòe sèng-mi̍h, kui hō͘ chè-si; jiân-āu Ná-sè-ní-lâng chiah thang lim-chiú.
Í-siōng sī Ná-sè-ní-lâng eng-kai chun-siú ê tiâu-lē. I nā iáu ū khùi-la̍t thang hiàn kui-tēng í-gōa ê lé-mi̍h, tio̍h chiàu i hē ê goān hiàn chè-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se,
tio̍h tùi A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ soan-pò͘: Lín tio̍h án-ni kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiok-hok, kóng,
“Goān Siōng Chú sù-hok lí, pó-hō͘ lí;
Goān Siōng Chú ê bīn ê kng chiò lí, si-un hō͘ lí;
Goān Siōng Chú hoaⁿ-hí ê bīn khòaⁿ lí, siúⁿ-sù lí pêng-an.”
Án-ni, in nā hōng góa ê miâ kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiok-hok, góa chiū beh sù-hok Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.

Mô͘-se khí hōe-bō͘ oân-sêng liáu-āu, chiū kā hōe-bō͘ boah-iû hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, pau-koat lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê khì-khū, chè-tôaⁿ kap chè-tôaⁿ ê khì-khū, lóng kā in boah-iû hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng.
Hit-ji̍t Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k, ta̍k chong-cho̍k hū-chek jîn-kháu-phó͘-cha ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ lóng tòa lé-mi̍h lâi hōng-hiàn.

In múi nn̄g ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ hōng-hiàn chi̍t tâi ū khàm pò͘-phâng ê chhia, ta̍k-ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ hōng-hiàn chi̍t chiah gû-káng, chiong chit la̍k tâi chhia kap cha̍p-jī chiah gû-káng sàng kàu hōe-bō͘ Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.
Siōng Chú kā Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h kā hiah-ê siu--khí-lâi, chòe hōe-bō͘ ê lō͘-ēng, chiàu Lī-bī -lâng sū-hōng ê chit-chek, kau hō͘ in.”
Mô͘-se chiū siu hiah-ê chhia kap gû, kau hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng.
Chiàu Kek-sūn ê kiáⁿ-sun sū-hōng ê chit-chek, Mô͘-se chiong nn̄g tâi chhia, sì chiah gû kau hō͘ in.
Chiàu Bí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ-sun sū-hōng ê chit-chek, chiong sì tâi chhia, poeh chiah gû kau hō͘ in. Chit nn̄g ê ka-cho̍k lóng siū chè-si A-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-tha-má kàm-tok.
M̄-kú chhia kap gû bô kau hō͘ Ko-hat ê kiáⁿ-sun, in-ūi in sū-hōng ê chit-chek sī tio̍h ēng keng-thâu kng sèng-mi̍h.
Kā chè-tôaⁿ boah-iû hōng-hiàn chè-tôaⁿ ê sî, chèng siú-léng lóng tī chè-tôaⁿ chêng hōng-hiàn lé-mi̍h.
Siōng Chú kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Hōng-hiàn chè-tôaⁿ ê kî-kan, ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h ū chi̍t ê siú-léng lâi hōng-hiàn lé-mi̍h.”
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se
tùi A-lûn kóng, “Lí tiám-teng ê sî, chhit chóaⁿ teng lóng tio̍h chiò ǹg thâu-chêng.”
A-lûn chiū chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng, tiám-teng chiò-kng teng-tâi ê thâu-chêng.
Chit-ê teng-tâi lóng ēng kim phah, liân i ê chō kap hoe mā án-ni, sī chiàu Siōng Chú chí-sī Mô͘-se ê hêng-thé chō--ê.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h chiong Lī-bī -lâng tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi, kā in kiat-chēng.
Lí tio̍h án-ni kā in kiat-chēng: Ēng tû-khì chōe ê chúi hiù tī in ê seng-khu, koh kah in ēng thì-thâu-to thì choân seng-khu ê mn̂g, sóe-saⁿ, án-ni kiat-chēng ka-kī.
Āu-lâi, in tio̍h chhú chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á, kap chhiau iû ê iù mī-hún ê sò͘-chè; lí mā tio̍h lēng-gōa chhú chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè.
Lí tio̍h chhōa Lī-bī -lâng lâi kàu hōe-bō͘ chêng, koh chū-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng;
lí chhōa Lī-bī -lâng lâi Siōng Chú bīn-chêng, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kā in hōaⁿ-chhiú.

A-lûn tio̍h chiong Lī-bī -lâng tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi, chòe te̍k-pia̍t ê lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, án-ni in chiah thang pān-lí Siōng Chú ê sū-bū.

Lī-bī -lâng tio̍h hōaⁿ-chhiú tī hiah-ê gû-káng-á ê thâu-khak téng; lí tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, chi̍t chiah chòe sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, ūi Lī-bī -lâng sio̍k-chōe.
“Lí tio̍h hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng khiā tī A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ ê bīn-chêng, chiong in chòe te̍k-pia̍t ê lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Án-ni, lí chiong in tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi, Lī-bī -lâng chiū kui-sio̍k góa.
Lí kā in kiat-chēng, hiàn-chòe te̍k-pia̍t ê lé-mi̍h; tùi hit-sî khí, in chiū thang ji̍p-khì hōe-bō͘ sū-hōng.
In sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan oân-choân hiàn hō͘ góa--ê; góa hō͘ in kui-sio̍k góa, tāi-thòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘-ū ê thâu-chiūⁿ-kiáⁿ.

In-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t tiong só͘-ū thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê lâng á-sī cheng-siⁿ, lóng sī góa ê. Góa tī Ai-ki̍p phah-sí in it-chhè thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ--ê hit-ji̍t, í-keng chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng kui-sio̍k góa.
Taⁿ góa kéng Lī-bī -lâng tāi-thòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘-ū ê thâu-chiūⁿ-kiáⁿ.

Góa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan chí-phài Lī-bī -lâng, pang-chān A-lûn kap i ê hō͘-tāi, tī hōe-bō͘ lāi ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sū-hōng, koh ūi in sio̍k-chōe, chiah bián Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng in-ūi óa-kūn sèng-só͘, ū chai-hō lîm-kàu in.”

Mô͘-se, A-lûn, kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng choân hōe-chiòng, chiū tùi Lī-bī -lâng án-ni chòe. Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se só͘ kóng koan-hē Lī-bī -lâng ê bēng-lēng, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng chiàu án-ni chòe.
Lī-bī -lâng chiū kiat-chēng ka-kī, sóe in ê saⁿ; A-lûn chiong in chòe te̍k-pia̍t ê lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, koh ūi in sio̍k-chōe kā in kiat-chēng.

Jiân-āu, Lī-bī -lâng ji̍p--khì, siū A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ ê chí-tō tī hōe-bō͘ sū-hōng; Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se só͘ kóng koan-hē Lī-bī -lâng ê bēng-lēng, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng chiàu án-ni chòe.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Ē-bīn sī koan-hē Lī-bī -lâng ê kui-tēng: In jī-cha̍p-gō͘ hè í-siōng tio̍h lâi hōe-bō͘ sū-hōng,
kàu gō͘-cha̍p hè chiū thè-hiu;
thè-hiu liáu-āu thang tī hōe-bō͘ hia̍p-chō͘ in ê hiaⁿ-tī pān-lí sū-bū, m̄-bián koh hū-chek kang-chok. Koan-hē Lī-bī -lâng ê kui-tēng, lí tio̍h chiàu án-ni pān-lí.”
Chhut Ai-ki̍p tē-jī nî chiaⁿ--ge̍h, Siōng Chú tī Se-nāi ê khòng-iá bēng-lēng Mô͘-se kóng,
“ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tio̍h tī chí-tēng ê ji̍t-kî siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh;
chiū-sī tī chit kò-ge̍h ê cha̍p-sì, chiàu chí-tēng ê sî-kan, tùi hông-hun ê sî khí, chiàu só͘-ū ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng chun-siú.”
Mô͘-se chiū bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.
Chiaⁿ-ge̍h cha̍p-sì hông-hun ê sî, in chiū tī Se-nāi ê khòng-iá siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh. Só͘-ū Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se --ê, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng chiàu án-ni chòe.
Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng in-ūi bong-tio̍h lâng ê si-thé chiâⁿ-chòe bô chheng-khì, bōe-tàng tī hit-ji̍t siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh; hit-ji̍t in khì kìⁿ Mô͘-se kap A-lûn,
kóng, “Goán in-ūi bong-tio̍h si-thé chiâⁿ-chòe bô chheng-khì, sī-án-chóaⁿ chiū bōe-ēng-tit tī chí-tēng ê sî-kan, kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe-hé hiàn lé-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú?”
Mô͘-se kā in kóng, “Lín tiàm chia tán--chi̍t-ē, góa beh thiaⁿ Siōng Chú tùi lín ū sím-mi̍h chí-sī.”
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se

tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘, “Lín á-sī lín ê hō͘-tāi nā ū lâng hō͘ si-thé bak lâ-sâm, á-sī chhut-gōa khì hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi, iû-goân tio̍h siú Siōng Chú ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.
In tio̍h bān chi̍t kò-ge̍h, tī jī-ge̍h cha̍p-sì hông-hun ê sî siú-choeh, chia̍h iûⁿ-ko, bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ, kap khó͘-chhài,
liân chi̍t-tiám-á to m̄-thang lâu kàu keh-chá-khí, iûⁿ-á ê kut liân chi̍t ki mā m̄-thang phah-tn̄g. In tio̍h chiàu Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh só͘-ū ê kui-lē siú chit-ê choeh.

Nā ū lâng sī chheng-khì mā bô chhut-gōa, m̄-kú bô siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, tio̍h kā i tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut, in-ūi i tī chí-tēng ê ji̍t bô hiàn lé-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú, i tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.

“Nā ū gōa-cho̍k-lâng kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan, ài-beh siú Siōng Chú ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, i tio̍h chun-siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng; chhut-gōa-lâng kap pún-tōe-lâng lóng tio̍h chun-siú kâng chi̍t ê kui-lē.”
Tah hōe-bō͘ hit-ji̍t, ū hûn jia-khàm hōe-bō͘, chiū-sī iok-kūi ê tiùⁿ-bō͘; tùi hông-hun kàu chá-khí, ū khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ hé ê hûn khàm tī hōe-bō͘ téng-bīn.
Hûn put-sî jia-khàm hōe-bō͘, mî--sî khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ hé.
Hûn sím-mi̍h sî tùi hōe-bō͘ seng-koân, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū chhut-hoat; hûn thêng tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū tī hia chat-iâⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng khí-kiâⁿ, mā chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chat-iâⁿ; hûn thêng tī hōe-bō͘ téng jōa kú, in chiū tī hia chat-iâⁿ hiah kú.
Hûn tī hōe-bō͘ téng thêng chōe-chōe ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng bô khí-kiâⁿ.
Ū-sî hûn tī hōe-bō͘ téng thêng bô kúi ji̍t, in chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng iû-goân thêng-liû tī hia, mā chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng khí-kiâⁿ.
Ū-sî hûn tùi ē-hng kàu chá-khí jia--teh, keh-chá-khí hûn chi̍t-ē seng-koân, in chiū chhut-hoat; bô-lūn ji̍t--sî á-sī mî--sî hûn seng-koân, in chiū chhut-hoat.

Hûn thêng tī hōe-bō͘ téng-bīn, bô-lūn sī nn̄g ji̍t, sī chi̍t ge̍h-ji̍t, sī chi̍t nî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng iû-goân thêng-liû tī hia, bô khí-kiâⁿ; m̄-kú hûn chi̍t-ē seng-koân, in chiū khí-kiâⁿ.
In chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chat-iâⁿ, mā chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng khí-kiâⁿ; in lóng chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè Mô͘-se ê chí-sī, chun-siú Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se, kóng,
“Lí tio̍h ēng gûn phah nn̄g ki lat-pah, hō͘ lí ēng lâi tiàu-chi̍p hōe-chiòng, mā thang kiò ta̍k-ê iâⁿ chhut-hoat.
Nn̄g ki lat-pah chòe-hé pûn ê sî, choân-thé hōe-chiòng tio̍h khì lí hia, tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu chū-chi̍p.
Nā kan-ta pûn chi̍t ki, chèng siú-léng, chiū-sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, tio̍h khì lí hia chū-chi̍p.
Pûn kín-kip té-im ê sî, chat-iâⁿ tī tang-pêng ê chi-cho̍k lóng tio̍h khí-kiâⁿ.
Tē-jī piàn pûn kín-kip té-im ê sî, chat-iâⁿ tī lâm-pêng ê chi-cho̍k tio̍h khí-kiâⁿ; beh kiò in khí-kiâⁿ, it-tēng tio̍h pûn kín-kip té-im.
Nā beh chū-chi̍p hōe-chiòng, lín tio̍h pûn lat-pah, m̄-kú m̄-thang pûn kín-kip té-im.
A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi chòe chè-si--ê, tio̍h hū-chek pûn hiah-ê lat-pah; che beh chòe lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.

Lín kap chhim-hoān lín ê thó͘-tōe ê tùi-te̍k kau-chiàn ê sî, tio̍h ēng lat-pah pûn kín-kip té-im, án-ni Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chiū ōe-kì-tit lín, koh beh kái-kiù lín thoat-lī lín ê tùi-te̍k.

Lín kú-hêng khèng-tián, tī choeh-kî kap ta̍k ge̍h-ji̍t ê chhoe-it, hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè ê sî, mā tio̍h pûn lat-pah, án-ni lín ê Siōng-tè chiū ōe-kì-tit lín. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.”
Tē-jī nî jī-ge̍h jī-cha̍p, hûn tùi khǹg iok-kūi ê hōe-bō͘ seng-koân,
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū chiàu in ê hêng-thêng tùi Se-nāi ê khòng-iá chhut-hoat; hûn thêng tī Pa-lân ê khòng-iá.
Che sī in chiàu Siōng Chú hō͘ Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng, tē-it piàn khí-thêng.
Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî chòe thâu-chêng, pō͘-tūi chi̍t-tūi chiap chi̍t-tūi hiòng-chêng kiâⁿ; Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k pō͘-tūi ê thóng-léng sī A-bí-ná-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Ná-sūn.
Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k pō͘-tūi ê thóng-léng sī So͘-ap ê kiáⁿ Ná-thán-gia̍p.
Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k pō͘-tūi ê thóng-léng sī Hi-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-ap.
Hōe-bō͘ chiū thiah--khí-lâi; Kek-sūn kap Bí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ-sun kng hōe-bō͘ chhut-hoat.
Chiàu pō͘-tūi ê sūn-sū, sòa-chiap chhut-hoat--ê sī Lū-piān chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî; pō͘-tūi ê thóng-léng sī Sī-tiu-ní ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-siok.
Se-biān chi-cho̍k pō͘-tūi ê thóng-léng sī So͘-lī-sa-tāi ê kiáⁿ Sī-lō͘-bi̍t.
Ka-tek chi-cho̍k pō͘-tūi ê thóng-léng sī Tiu-ní ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-ngá-sat.
Ko-hat chong-cho̍k kng sèng-só͘ lāi-bīn ê sèng-mi̍h khí-kiâⁿ; hōe-bō͘ tio̍h tī in kàu-ūi í-chêng tah hó.
Chiàu pō͘-tūi ê sūn-sū, sòa-chiap chhut-hoat--ê sī Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî; pō͘-tūi ê thóng-léng sī A-bí-hut ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-sa-má.
Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k pō͘-tūi ê thóng-léng sī Pí-tāi-siok ê kiáⁿ Ka-má-lia̍t.
Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k pō͘-tūi ê thóng-léng sī Ki-to-nî ê kiáⁿ A-pí-tān.
Chòe-āu sī Tān chi-cho̍k ê tōa-kî chhōa-tūi, chiàu pō͘-tūi ê sūn-sū, A-bí-sa-tāi ê kiáⁿ A-hi-í-siā chòe Tān chi-cho̍k ê thóng-léng.
A-siat chi-cho̍k pō͘-tūi ê thóng-léng sī Gô-lân ê kiáⁿ Phà-kiat.
Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k pō͘-tūi ê thóng-léng sī Í-lâm ê kiáⁿ A-hi-la.
Í-siōng sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pō͘-tūi chiap pō͘-tūi hiòng-chêng kiâⁿ ê sūn-sū.

Mô͘-se tùi i ê tiūⁿ-lâng Bí-tiân -lâng Liû-ní ê kiáⁿ Hô-pa kóng, “Goán beh khì Siōng Chú èng-ún beh siúⁿ-sù goán ê tōe; chhiáⁿ lí kap goán chòe-hé lâi-khì, goán ōe hó khoán-thāi lí; Siōng Chú í-keng èng-ún sù-hok hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.”
I ìn kóng, “Góa m̄ khì. Góa beh tò-khì góa ê kò͘-hiong, góa ê chhin-cho̍k hia.”
Mô͘-se kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí m̄-thang pàng-sak goán! Lí chai, goán tio̍h tī khòng-iá chhē só͘-chāi chat-iâⁿ, lí ōe-tàng kā goán chí-tō.
Lí nā kap goán chòe-hé khì, Siōng Chú sù goán ê hok-khì, goán it-tēng lóng ōe kap lí hun-hióng.”
In lī-khui Siōng Chú ê soaⁿ, chhut-hoat kiâⁿ saⁿ ji̍t ê lō͘-thêng; Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi tī thâu-chêng kiâⁿ saⁿ ji̍t ê lō͘-thêng, kā in chhē hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi.
In thiah in ê pò͘-pîⁿ chhut-hoat; ji̍t--sî Siōng Chú ê hûn tī in ê téng-bīn.
Iok-kūi khí-thêng ê sî, Mô͘-se chiū kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí khí--lâi! Goān lí kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ lí ê tùi-te̍k! Goān oàn-hūn lí ê lâng tī lí ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu!”
Iok-kūi thêng ê sî, Mô͘-se chiū kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí tò--lâi, tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t chheng-chheng-bān-bān ê lâng tiong-kan!”

Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn hoat oàn-giân, in ê put-boán thoân kàu Siōng Chú hia; Siōng Chú thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū hoat tōa siū-khì. Siōng Chú kàng hé tī in tiong-kan, sio iâⁿ-tōe ê gōa-ûi.
Jîn-bîn tùi Mô͘-se ai-kiû, Mô͘-se chiū kî-kiû Siōng Chú; hé chiū hoa.
Hit-ê só͘-chāi chiū kiò-chòe Tha-pī-la, in-ūi Siōng Chú tī hia kàng hé sio in.
In tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng siàu-siūⁿ beh chia̍h hó-mi̍h; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng mā thî-khàu kóng, “Nā ū bah thang chia̍h m̄-chai jōa hó leh?
Goán ōe-kì-tit tī Ai-ki̍p chia̍h hî bián chîⁿ, koh ū chhì-koe, si-koe, kú-chhài, chhang-thâu, soàn-thâu.
Goán í-keng bô goân-khì lah, in-ūi má-ná í-gōa, goán lóng bô mi̍h-kiāⁿ thang chia̍h.”
Má-ná chhin-chhiūⁿ iân-sui-chí, sek-tì chhin-chhiūⁿ chin-chu.
Jîn-bîn sì-kòe khì khioh, ū-ê ēng chio̍h-thûi géng, ū-ê ēng cheng-khū cheng, ēng e-á chú, choh-chòe piáⁿ; chu-bī chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiau-iû ê piáⁿ.
Mî--sî má-ná kap lō͘-chúi chòe-hé lo̍h tī iâⁿ-lāi.
Mô͘-se thiaⁿ-tio̍h jîn-bîn ke-ke-hō͘-hō͘ tī pò͘-pîⁿ-kháu teh háu. Siōng Chú chin siū-khì, Mô͘-se mā bô hoaⁿ-hí.

Mô͘-se tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ pháiⁿ khoán-thāi lí ê po̍k-jîn? Góa sī-án-chóaⁿ bô tit-tio̍h lí ê un-tián, lí kèng-jiân chiong só͘-ū jîn-bîn ê tàⁿ hē tī góa ê keng-thâu téng?

Chit-ê jîn-bîn kiám sī góa hoâi-īn--ê? Kiám sī góa siⁿ--ê? Lí kèng-jiân kiò góa tio̍h kā in phō tī heng-chêng, chhin-chhiūⁿ lāu-pē teh io-chhī chia̍h-lin ê eⁿ-á, kàu in chìn-ji̍p lí soan-sè beh siúⁿ-sù in chó͘-sian ê tōe?
Góa beh khì tó-ūi the̍h bah lâi hō͘ só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn chia̍h? In-ūi in lóng khàu-lōa góa, kóng, ‘Hō͘ goán ū bah thang chia̍h!’
Chit-ê jîn-bîn ê tàⁿ siuⁿ tāng, góa ka-kī tam-tng bōe khí.
Lí nā án-ni tùi-thāi góa, góa nā tùi lí tit-tio̍h un-tián, kiû lí sûi-sî kā góa thâi-sí, hō͘ góa bián koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h ka-kī án-chóaⁿ siū-khó͘.”

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h tiàu-chi̍p chhit-cha̍p ê tiúⁿ-ló, chiū-sī lí só͘ bat, chòe jîn-bîn ê tiúⁿ-ló kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ--ê lâi, hō͘ in kap lí khiā tī hōe-bō͘ thâu-chêng.

Góa beh kàng-lîm tī hia kap lí kóng-ōe, mā beh chiong kàng-lo̍h tī lí sin-chiūⁿ ê sîn pun hō͘ in; in chiū kap lí hun-tam koán-lí jîn-bîn ê tàⁿ, chiah bián lí ka-kī chi̍t ê tam-tng.

Lí mā tio̍h kā jîn-bîn kóng, ‘Lín tio̍h ka-kī hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, chún-pī bîn-á-chài chia̍h-bah, in-ūi Siōng Chú ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín thî-khàu, kóng: Hō͘ goán ū bah thang chia̍h! Goán tī Ai-ki̍p chin hó. Só͘-í Siōng Chú beh hō͘ lín ū bah thang chia̍h.
Lín m̄-sī kan-ta chia̍h chi̍t ji̍t, nn̄g ji̍t, gō͘ ji̍t, cha̍p ji̍t, jī-cha̍p ji̍t;

I beh hō͘ lín chia̍h kui kò-ge̍h, chia̍h kàu bah tùi lín ê phīⁿ-khang phùn--chhut-lâi, chia̍h kah ùi; in-ūi lín khì-sak tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê Siōng Chú, kā I khàu-lōa kóng: Goán ná tio̍h chhut Ai-ki̍p?’”
Mô͘-se kóng, “Chiah-ê kap góa chòe-hé ê jîn-bîn, kan-ta kiâⁿ-lō͘ ê ta-po͘-lâng chiū ū la̍k-cha̍p-bān, lí kóng, ‘Góa beh hō͘ in kui kò-ge̍h lóng ū bah thang chia̍h.’
Kiám ū kàu-gia̍h ê gû-kûn, iûⁿ-kûn thang thâi lâi hō͘ in chia̍h? Kā tōa-hái só͘-ū ê hî lóng lia̍h--lâi, kiám ū-kàu in chia̍h?”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí sī khòaⁿ Siōng Chú ê khùi-la̍t bô-kàu sī--bô? Taⁿ lí beh khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê ōe si̍t-hiān.”
Mô͘-se chhut--khì, chiong Siōng Chú ê ōe kā jîn-bîn kóng, koh tiàu-chi̍p jîn-bîn tiong-kan ê tiúⁿ-ló chhit-cha̍p lâng, hō͘ in khiā tī hōe-bō͘ ê sì-chiu-ûi.

Siōng Chú tī hûn-tiong kàng-lîm, tùi Mô͘-se kóng-ōe, koh chiong kàng-lo̍h tī i sin-chiūⁿ ê sîn, pun hō͘ hit chhit-cha̍p ê tiúⁿ-ló. Siōng Chú ê sîn lîm-kàu in ê sî, in chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ sian-ti ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe; í-āu chit-ê sū bô koh hoat-seng.

Ū nn̄g ê tī miâ-toaⁿ lāi-bīn ê tiúⁿ-ló, I-lī-ta̍t kap Bí-ta̍t, iû-goân lâu tī iâⁿ-lāi. In bô khì hōe-bō͘ hia, m̄-kú Siōng Chú ê sîn mā lîm-kàu in, in chiū tī iâⁿ-lāi kóng sian-ti ê ōe.
Ū chi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng cháu-lâi kā Mô͘-se pò-kò, “ I-lī-ta̍t kap Bí-ta̍t tī iâⁿ-lāi ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe.”
Tùi siàu-liân chiū chòe Mô͘-se ê chō͘-chhiú, Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a, kóng, “Chhiáⁿ góa ê chú Mô͘-se kā in kìm-chí.”
Mô͘-se kā i kóng, “Lí ūi-tio̍h góa teh oàn-tò͘ in sī--bô? Khó͘-bōe-tit Siōng Chú chiong I ê sîn sù hō͘ I só͘-ū ê chú-bîn, hō͘ in lóng chòe sian-ti.”
Āu-lâi, Mô͘-se kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló chiū tò-khì iâⁿ-lāi.

Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chūn hong, tùi hái--ni̍h kā ian-chhun chhe-lâi tī iâⁿ-tōe chiu-ûi, sì-kho͘-lìn-tńg ū chi̍t ji̍t ê lō͘-thêng hiah khoah, lī tōe-bīn tāi-iok chi̍t kong-chhioh koân.
Jîn-bîn kui-mî kui-ji̍t kap tē-jī ji̍t kui-ji̍t, lóng khí-lâi lia̍h ian-chhun; lia̍h siōng chió--ê mā ū cha̍p tui, lóng pâi tī iâⁿ-tōe sì-ûi.
Bah iáu tī in ê chhùi-lāi teh pō͘, Siōng Chú chiū tùi in hoat siū-khì, kàng tōa un-e̍k phah in.
Hit-ê só͘-chāi chiū kiò-chòe Ki-phok-lô Hap-tha-óa, in-ūi in tī hia bâi-chòng hiah-ê tham-io̍k ê lâng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Ki-phok-lô Hap-tha-óa khì kàu Hap-sé-lio̍k, chiū tòa tī hia.
Bí-lī-an kap A-lûn phoe-phêng Mô͘-se, in-ūi i chhōa Kó͘-si̍t lú-chú chòe bó͘. In kóng,
“Siōng Chú kiám kan-ta thong-kè Mô͘-se kóng-ōe? Kiám bô mā thong-kè goán kóng-ōe?” Chiah-ê ōe Siōng Chú ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h.
Mô͘-se choh-lâng hui-siông khiam-pi, iâⁿ-kè sè-kan só͘-ū ê lâng.
Hut-jiân, Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se, A-lûn, kap Bí-lī-an kóng, “Lín saⁿ ê lóng chhut-lâi hōe-bō͘ chia.” In saⁿ ê chiū chhut--lâi.
Siōng Chú tī hûn-thiāu tiong kàng-lîm, khiā tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, kiò A-lûn kap Bí-lī-an; in nn̄g ê chiū kiâⁿ chìn-chêng.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Lín tio̍h thiaⁿ góa ê ōe. Lín tiong-kan nā ū sian-ti, góa Siōng Chú sī ēng īⁿ-siōng hō͘ in bat góa, thong-kè bîn-bāng kap in kóng-ōe.
M̄-kú góa ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se m̄-sī án-ni; góa ū chiong góa ê choân-ke kau-tài i.
Góa sī kap i bīn-tùi-bīn kóng-ōe; bêng-bêng kóng, i m̄-bián ioh. I sīm-chì ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê hêng-chōng. Lín ná káⁿ phoe-phêng góa ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se?”
Siōng Chú tùi in siū-khì, chiū lī-khui.

Hûn tùi hōe-bō͘ ê téng-bīn sóa-khui; Bí-lī-an hut-jiân khí giâm-tiōng ê phê-hu-pīⁿ, i ê phê-hu chhin-chhiūⁿ seh hiah pe̍h. A-lûn khòaⁿ-tio̍h Bí-lī-an khí giâm-tiōng ê phê-hu-pīⁿ,
chiū tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa ê chú ah, kiû lí m̄-thang in-ūi goán gû-gōng hoān-chōe, hō͘ goán siū hêng-hoa̍t.
Kiû lí m̄-thang hō͘ i chhin-chhiūⁿ chhut bú-thai chiū nōa chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê sí-the.”
Mô͘-se chiū ai-kiû Siōng Chú, kóng, “Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí i-hó Bí-lī-an.”

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “I ê lāu-pē nā kā i phùi chhùi-nōa tī bīn--ni̍h, i kiám m̄-bián kiàn-siàu chhit ji̍t? Taⁿ tio̍h kā i keh-lī tī iâⁿ-gōa chhit ji̍t, jiân-āu chiah thang hō͘ i tńg--lâi.”
Tùi án-ni, Bí-lī-an chiū hō͘ lâng keh-lī tī iâⁿ-gōa chhit ji̍t; jîn-bîn bô khí-thêng, thèng-hāu kàu Bí-lī-an tò--lâi.
Āu-lâi, jîn-bîn tùi Hap-sé-lio̍k khí-thêng, kàu Pa-lân ê khòng-iá chat-iâⁿ.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se, kóng,
“Lí tio̍h tùi ta̍k-ê chi-cho̍k soán chi̍t ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, phài in khì thàm-cha góa beh sù hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê Ka-lâm -tōe.”
Mô͘-se chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, phài ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ tùi Pa-lân ê khòng-iá chhut-hoat.
Chiah-ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ ê miâ kì tī ē-bīn: Lū-piān chi-cho̍k sī Sat-khek ê kiáⁿ Sa-bō͘-a
Se-biān chi-cho̍k sī Hô-lī ê kiáⁿ Sa-hoat
Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k sī Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k
Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k sī Iok-sek ê kiáⁿ Í-ka
Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k sī Lūn ê kiáⁿ Hô-se-a
Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k sī La-hu ê kiáⁿ Phà-thê
Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k sī So-tí ê kiáⁿ Ka-tia̍p
Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k sī So͘-se ê kiáⁿ Ka-tí
Tān chi-cho̍k sī Ki-má-lī ê kiáⁿ A-bí-lī
A-siat chi-cho̍k sī Bí-ka-le̍k ê kiáⁿ Se-thiap
Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k sī Po̍k-se ê kiáⁿ Ná-pí
Ka-tek chi-cho̍k sī Má-ki ê kiáⁿ Kiū-lī
Í-siōng sī Mô͘-se phài-khì thàm-cha hit-ê tōe ê lâng ê miâ. Mô͘-se kā Lūn ê kiáⁿ Hô-se-a hō-miâ chòe Iok-su-a.
Mô͘-se phài in khì thàm-cha Ka-lâm -tōe ê sî, tùi in kóng, “Lín khì Nî-kek-hu, peh-chiūⁿ soaⁿ,
khòaⁿ hit-ê tōe siⁿ-chòe sím-mi̍h khoán: Hia ê chū-bîn sī kiông á-sī jio̍k, jîn-sò͘ chōe á-sī chió,
tòa ê tōe sī hó á-sī bái, tòa ê só͘-chāi sī bô siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê iâⁿ-tōe á-sī kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ.

Koh khòaⁿ hit-ê thó͘-tōe sī pûi á-sī sán, ū chhiū-ba̍k á bô. Lín tio̍h ióng-kám, chiong hit só͘-chāi ê ké-chí tòa chi̍t-kóa tò--lâi.” Hit-sî tú-á sī phû-tô chho͘-se̍k ê sî.
In chiū khì thàm-cha, tùi Sîm ê khòng-iá kàu Lī-ha̍p ê tōe-khu, ti̍t-kàu Hap-má ài-kháu.

In koh tùi Nî-kek-hu chiūⁿ-khì Hi-pek-lûn; chit-ê siâⁿ pí Ai-ki̍p ê Só-an -siâⁿ khah chá chhit nî khí-chō, ū A-la̍p -cho̍k ê A-hi-bān -lâng, Sī-su -lâng, Ta̍t-mái -lâng tòa tī hia.
In kàu Í-si̍t-kok Soaⁿ-kok, chhò chi̍t ki phû-tô chhiū-oe, téng-bīn ū chi̍t pha phû-tô, su-iàu nn̄g ê lâng kng; koh tòa chi̍t-kóa sia̍h-liû kap bû-hoa-kó tò--lâi.
In-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi hia chhò chi̍t pha phû-tô, hit-ê só͘-chāi chiū kiò-chòe Í-si̍t-kok Soaⁿ-kok.
In thàm-cha hit-ê tōe sì-cha̍p ji̍t kú, chiah tò--lâi.
In lâi kàu Pa-lân khòng-iá ê Ka-te-su, kìⁿ Mô͘-se, A-lûn, kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê hōe-chiòng, kā in hôe-pò kui-ê hêng-thêng, koh hō͘ in khòaⁿ hit só͘-chāi ê ké-chí.
In tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí phài goán khì thàm-cha hit-ê tōe-khu, kó-jiân sī lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe; chiah-ê chiū-sī hit-ê só͘-chāi ê ké-chí.
M̄-kú hit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn chin ióng, siâⁿ tōa koh kian-kò͘; goán tī hia mā khòaⁿ-tio̍h A-la̍p -cho̍k.
A-má-le̍k -lâng tòa tī Nî-kek-hu tōe-khu; Hek -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng tòa tī soaⁿ-tōe; Ka-lâm -lâng tòa tī hái-piⁿ kap Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ.”
Ka-le̍k tī Mô͘-se ê bīn-chêng hō͘ jîn-bîn an-chēng--lo̍h-lâi, kóng, “Lán kóaⁿ-kín lâi-khì kong-chiàm hit-ê só͘-chāi; lán it-tēng ōe iâⁿ.”
M̄-kú hiah-ê kap i chòe-hé khì ê lâng kóng, “Lán bô hoat-tō͘ kong-kek hiah-ê jîn-bîn; in pí lán khah ióng.”

Hiah-ê khì thàm-cha ê lâng tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sàn-pò͘ iâu-giân, kóng, “Goán thàm-cha kiâⁿ--kè ê tōe sī thun-chia̍h lâng ê tōe, koh khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê chū-bîn lóng chin tōa-hàn.
Goán khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê A-la̍p -cho̍k ê lâng chiū-sī tōa-hàn-lâng, in sī tōa-hàn-lâng ê hō͘-tāi; kap in pí--khí-lâi, lán chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh, in khòaⁿ lán mā-sī án-ni.”
Choân hōe-chiòng chiū chhut-siaⁿ, bâi-oàn. Hit-mî in lóng thî-khàu.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bâi-oàn Mô͘-se kap A-lûn, tùi in kóng, “Khó͘-bōe-tit goán sí tī Ai-ki̍p! Khó͘-bōe-tit sí tiàm chit-ê khòng-iá!
Siōng Chú ná beh chhōa goán lâi kàu chia, hāi goán hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, bó͘ kiáⁿ mā hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì. Goán tò-khì Ai-ki̍p kiám bô khah hó?”
In hō͘-siōng kóng-lâi-kóng-khì, “Lán tio̍h soán chi̍t ê siú-léng, chhōa lán tò-khì Ai-ki̍p.”
Mô͘-se kap A-lûn phak-lo̍h tī Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng ê bīn-chêng.
Thàm-cha hit-ê tōe ê lâng tiong-kan, Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a kap Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k, thiah-li̍h in ê saⁿ,
tùi Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng kóng, “Goán thàm-cha keng-kè ê tōe sī chin pûi koh súi ê tōe.
Siōng Chú nā ì-ài lán, chiū ōe chhōa lán ji̍p-khì hit-ê tōe, chiong hit-ê lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe siúⁿ-sù lán.

M̄-kú lín m̄-thang pōe-poān Siōng Chú, mā m̄-bián kiaⁿ hit só͘-chāi ê lâng, in ōe hō͘ lán thun-bia̍t. Kā in pó-pì--ê lóng í-keng lī-khui; Siōng Chú kap lán tông-chāi, m̄-bián kiaⁿ in.”
Choân-thé hōe-chiòng kóng beh ēng chio̍h-thâu kā in tìm-sí hit-sî, Siōng Chú ê êng-kng tī hōe-bō͘ tùi só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hián-hiān.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Chit-ê chú-bîn biáu-sī góa beh kàu tī-sî? Góa tī in tiong-kan kiâⁿ hiah chōe sîn-jiah, in kàu tī-sî chiah ōe sìn góa?
Góa beh ēng un-e̍k phah in, hō͘ in bōe-tàng sêng-chiap chit-ê ke-gia̍p. M̄-kú góa beh hō͘ lí chiâⁿ-chòe tōa-kok, pí in khah kiông-sēng.”
Mô͘-se tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí nā án-ni chòe, Ai-ki̍p -lâng it-tēng ōe chai, in-ūi lí bat ēng lí ê koân-lêng chhōa chiah-ê jîn-bîn tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut--lâi.

Ai-ki̍p -lâng ōe tùi chit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn kóng chit-ê sū. Chit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn mā í-keng chai, Siōng Chú lí kap chiah-ê jîn-bîn tông-chāi; lí ê hûn tī in ê téng-bīn, tī hit tiong-kan lí tùi in hián-hiān, hō͘ in chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--kìⁿ; ji̍t--sî ēng hûn-thiāu, mî--sî ēng hé-thiāu ín-chhōa in.
Taⁿ lí nā chi̍t-ē-chhiú thâi-sí chiah-ê jîn-bîn, hiah-ê thiaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê miâ-siaⁿ ê lia̍t-kok ōe kóng,
‘In-ūi Siōng Chú bōe-tàng chiong chit-ê jîn-bîn chhōa ji̍p-khì I tùi in li̍p-sè èng-ún ê tōe, chiū tī khòng-iá kā in châu-bia̍t.’
Taⁿ kiû góa ê Chú chiàu lí só͘ èng-ún--ê, hián-chhut lí ê tōa koân-lêng; lí bat kóng:

Siōng Chú bô khoài siū-khì, koh ū hong-sēng ê chû-ài; sià-bián chōe-gia̍t kap kè-sit; it-tēng bōe kā ū-chōe--ê phòaⁿ-chòe bô-chōe, beh tui-kiù lâng ê chōe, tùi pē kàu kiáⁿ, kàu saⁿ sì tāi.
Kiû lí chiàu lí ê tōa chû-ài sià-bián chit-ê jîn-bîn ê chōe-gia̍t. Chhin-chhiūⁿ lí tùi chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p kàu taⁿ, siông-siông sià-bián in kâng-khoán.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh chiàu lí ê ōe sià-bián in.
M̄-kú, góa kí góa ê oa̍h-miā kap góa chhiong-móa choân-tōe ê êng-kng li̍p-sè:
