Chiah-ê lâng sui-jiân ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê êng-kng, koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa tī Ai-ki̍p kap khòng-iá kiâⁿ--kè ê sîn-jiah, iáu chhì-thàm góa cha̍p piàn, m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê bēng-lēng,
só͘-í in it-tēng bōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa tùi in ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè èng-ún ê tōe; só͘-ū biáu-sī góa--ê lóng bōe-tàng khòaⁿ--tio̍h.

M̄-kú góa ê po̍k-jîn Ka-le̍k, góa beh chhōa i ji̍p-khì i kiâⁿ--kè ê tōe, i ê hō͘-tāi mā beh tit-tio̍h hit-ê tōe chòe ke-gia̍p, in-ūi i ū kap pa̍t-lâng bô kâng-khoán ê sim-chì, choân-sim kun-tè góa.
Bîn-á-chài lín tio̍h choán hong-hiòng, tùi Âng-hái ê lō͘ khì khòng-iá, in-ūi A-má-le̍k -lâng kap Ka-lâm -lâng tòa tī soaⁿ-kok.”
Siōng Chú koh tùi Mô͘-se kap A-lûn kóng,
“Chit-ê pháiⁿ ê hōe-chiòng tùi góa hoat oàn-giân beh kàu tī-sî? Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi góa ê oàn-giân, góa lóng ū thiaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Tio̍h kā in kóng Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Góa kí góa ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè: Góa beh chiàu lín só͘ kóng ê oàn-giân tùi-thāi lín.
Lín ê sin-si ōe tó tī chit-ê khòng-iá. Lín tiong-kan ū teng-lio̍k, jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng, tùi góa hoat oàn-giân ê lâng,
it-tēng bōe-tàng ji̍p-khì góa li̍p-sè èng-ún beh hō͘ lín khiā-khí ê tōe; chí-ū Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k kap Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a chiah ōe-tàng ji̍p--khì.
M̄-kú lín só͘ teh siūⁿ ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì ê gín-á, góa beh chhōa in ji̍p--khì, in ōe tit-tio̍h lín só͘ khì-sak hit-ê tōe.
Lín leh, lín ê sin-si ōe tó tī chit-ê khòng-iá.
Lín ê kiáⁿ-jî ōe tī khòng-iá liû-lōng sì-cha̍p nî, tam-tng lín bô tiong-si̍t ê chōe, ti̍t-kàu lín tī khòng-iá oân-choân siau-bia̍t.

Lín thàm-cha hit-ê tōe ê ji̍t-chí kiōng sì-cha̍p ji̍t, chi̍t nî tú chi̍t ji̍t, lín tio̍h tùi lín hoān ê chōe-gia̍t hù-chhut tāi-kè sì-cha̍p nî; lín chiū chai hoán-tùi góa ê kiat-kó sī án-chóaⁿ.’
Góa Siōng Chú í-keng kóng, góa beh án-ni tùi-thāi só͘-ū chū-chi̍p tùi-te̍k góa ê pháiⁿ hōe-chiòng; in beh tī chit-ê khòng-iá siau-sit, sí tī chia.”
Mô͘-se phài-khì thàm-cha hit-ê tōe ê lâng, tò-tńg-lâi pò hit só͘-chāi ê pháiⁿ siau-sit, tì-kàu choân hōe-chiòng tùi Mô͘-se hoat oàn-giân;
hiah-ê pò pháiⁿ siau-sit ê lâng lóng tú-tio̍h un-e̍k, sí tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.
Khì thàm-cha hit só͘-chāi ê lâng tiong-kan, chí-ū Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a kap Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k iáu oa̍h--teh.
Mô͘-se chiong chiah-ê ōe kā Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng kóng, jîn-bîn chiū chin pi-siong.
In thàu-chá khí--lâi, chiūⁿ-khì soaⁿ-téng, kóng, “Goán ū hoān-chōe. Taⁿ goán tī chia, goán beh chiūⁿ-khì Siōng Chú èng-ún goán ê tōe.”
Mô͘-se kóng, “Lín ná beh ûi-pōe Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng? Lín án-ni chòe bōe sêng-kong.
M̄-thang khì, in-ūi Siōng Chú bô kap lín tông-chāi, khióng-kiaⁿ lín hō͘ tùi-te̍k phah-pāi.
A-má-le̍k -lâng kap Ka-lâm -lâng lóng tī lín ê thâu-chêng, lín ōe sí tī in ê to-ē; in-ūi lín bô tè Siōng Chú, só͘-í Siōng Chú bô beh kap lín tông-chāi.”
In kian-chhî beh chiūⁿ soaⁿ-téng; m̄-kú Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi kap Mô͘-se bô chhut iâⁿ-tōe.
Tùi án-ni, A-má-le̍k -lâng kap tòa tī soaⁿ--ni̍h ê Ka-lâm -lâng lóng lo̍h-lâi kong-kek in, kā in phah-pāi, kā in kóaⁿ kàu Hô-ní-má.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng: Lín khì kàu góa siúⁿ-sù lín khiā-khí ê tōe,

nā beh tùi gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn tiong-kan chhú-lâi chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h, ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, bô-lūn sī sio-hòa-chè á-sī pa̍t-khoán ê chè, sī siā-goān á-sī kam-sim hiàn ê chè, á-sī choeh-kî ê chè,

ta̍k-chiah iûⁿ-á tio̍h phòe ēng chi̍t kong-kun iù mī-hún chhiau chi̍t kong-seng iû chòe ê sò͘-chè, í-ki̍p chi̍t kong-seng ê chiú chòe tiān-chiú-chè. Bô-lūn sī sio-hòa-chè á-sī pa̍t-khoán ê chè, hōng-hiàn ê lâng lóng tio̍h chiàu án-ni hiàn chè-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Hiàn mî-iûⁿ-káng, tio̍h phòe ēng nn̄g kong-kun ê iù mī-hún chhiau chi̍t kong-seng-pòaⁿ ê iû chòe ê sò͘-chè;
koh ēng chi̍t kong-seng-pòaⁿ ê chiú chòe tiān-chiú-chè, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Lí nā hiàn gû-káng-á chòe sio-hòa-chè á-sī pa̍t-khoán ê chè, lâi siā-goān á-sī chòe pêng-an-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú,
tio̍h ēng saⁿ kong-kun ê iù mī-hún chhiau nn̄g kong-seng ê iû chòe sò͘-chè, kap gû-káng-á chòe-hé hiàn;
koh ēng nn̄g kong-seng ê chiú chòe tiān-chiú-chè, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Hiàn múi chi̍t chiah gû-káng, mî-iûⁿ-káng, mî-iûⁿ-á, á-sī soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á, lóng tio̍h chiàu án-ni hōng-hiàn.
Bô-lūn lí hōng-hiàn kúi chiah, múi chi̍t chiah tio̍h chiàu án-ni pān-lí.
Ta̍k-ê chāi-tōe chhut-sì ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, nā beh hiàn ēng hé sio ê phang-phang ê chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, lóng tio̍h chiàu án-ni pān-lí.

Nā ū gōa-cho̍k-lâng lâi tòa tī lín tiong-kan, put-koán in sī chiām-sî, á-sī sè-sè-tāi-tāi tòa tī lín tiong-kan, in nā beh hiàn ēng hé sio ê phang-phang ê chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, lín án-chóaⁿ hiàn, in mā tio̍h chiàu án-ni chòe.

Koan-hē hōe-chiòng, bô-lūn sī lín á-sī tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, lóng tio̍h siú kâng-khoán ê kui-lē, che beh chòe lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē; tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, lín án-chóaⁿ pān-lí, in mā tio̍h chiàu án-ni chòe.
Lín kap tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, tio̍h chun-siú siâng-khoán ê lu̍t-hoat, siâng-khoán ê kui-lē.
Siōng Chú koh bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng: Lín khì kàu Siōng Chú chhōa lín ji̍p-khì hit-ê tōe,
chia̍h hit só͘-chāi ê bí-niû, tio̍h hiàn lé-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú.

Lín tio̍h chiong tē-it tè hang--chhut-lâi ê piáⁿ, gia̍h-koân chòe lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, chhin-chhiūⁿ tī ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ chiong chho͘-se̍k ê ngó͘-kok gia̍h-koân lâi hiàn kâng-khoán.
Lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi tio̍h chiàu án-ni chòe, hiàn lé-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Lín nā bô-ì-tiong hoān-tio̍h Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se ê jīm-hô kài-bēng,
chiū-sī Siōng Chú thong-kè Mô͘-se bēng-lēng lín--ê, tùi Siōng Chú bēng-lēng lín hit-ji̍t, kàu í-āu ta̍k sè-tāi,

nā ū lâng hoān--tio̍h, m̄-kú bô lâng chai, hōe-chiòng tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á chòe sio-hòa-chè, koh chiàu hiàn-chè ê kui-lē phòe sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè, chòe-hé chòe phang-phang ê chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè.

Chè-si tio̍h ūi Í-sek-lia̍t choân-thé hōe-chiòng sio̍k-chōe, in chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián; in sī bô-ì-tiong hoān-chhò, mā ū ūi-tio̍h in ê chhò-gō͘, tòa ēng hé sio ê chè-mi̍h kap sio̍k-chōe-chè kàu Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng hiàn hō͘ I.
Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng kap tòa tī in tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, chiū beh tit-tio̍h sià-bián, in-ūi che sī jîn-bîn bô-ì-tiong hoān--tio̍h ê chōe.
Nā ū lâng bô-ì-tiong hoān-chōe, i tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah chi̍t-hè ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè.
Chè-si tio̍h ūi bô-ì-tiong hoān-chōe hit-ê lâng tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng sio̍k-chōe, i chiū beh tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Chāi-tōe ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap tòa tī in tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, nā bô-ì-tiong hoān-chōe, tio̍h chiàu siâng-khoán ê kui-lē pān-lí.
Nā ū lâng kò͘-ì hoān-chōe siat-to̍k Siōng Chú, bô-lūn sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng á-sī tòa tī in tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, tio̍h chiong i tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kek-chhut.
Hit-ê lâng biáu-sī Siōng Chú ê ōe, ûi-pōe I ê bēng-lēng, i tio̍h siū kek-chhut, ūi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī khòng-iá ê sî, ū chi̍t ê lâng tī An-hioh-ji̍t khioh-chhâ.
Hiah-ê hoat-kiàn i khioh-chhâ ê lâng, kā i tòa-khì Mô͘-se, A-lûn, kap choân-thé hōe-chiòng hia.
In kā i koaiⁿ--khí-lâi, iáu-bē khak-tēng beh án-chóaⁿ pān i.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “It-tēng tio̍h kā hit-ê lâng chhú-sí; hōe-chiòng tio̍h tī iâⁿ-gōa ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí.”
Hōe-chiòng kā hit-ê lâng chhōa-khì iâⁿ-gōa, ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí, sī chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se
tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng: In tio̍h sè-sè-tāi-tāi tī saⁿ-á-kîⁿ chòe chhiu, koh tī chhiu ê téng-bīn tioh chi̍t tiâu nâ-sek ê iù-tòa.

Chiah-ê chhiu sī beh hō͘ lín khòaⁿ--tio̍h, ōe-kì-tit chun-hêng Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, chiah bián lín hòng-chhiòng ka-kī ê sim kap ba̍k-chiu ê io̍k-bōng, tì-kàu lín tùi góa put-tiong.
Án-ni, lín chiah ōe-kì-tit si̍t-hêng góa só͘-ū ê bēng-lēng, hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng kui lín ê Siōng-tè.
Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, bat chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe, beh chòe lín ê Siōng-tè. Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Lī-bī ê cheng-sun, Ko-hat ê sun, Í-su-hap ê kiáⁿ Khó-la, kap Lū-piān ê hō͘-tāi Í-lī-ap ê kiáⁿ Tāi-tan, A-pí-lân, kap Pí-le̍k ê kiáⁿ An,
in khí-lâi hoán-khòng Mô͘-se, chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p ê ū bêng-bōng, siū hōe-chiòng soán-chhut ê léng-siù, chòe-hé khì chhē Mô͘-se.

In liân-ha̍p kong-kek Mô͘-se kap A-lûn, kóng, “Lín siuⁿ kè-hūn lah! Choân-thé hōe-chiòng ta̍k-ê lâng lóng sī sèng, Siōng Chú mā tī in tiong-kan; lín sī-án-chóaⁿ chū-ko, khòaⁿ ka-kī pí Siōng Chú ê hōe-chiòng khah koân?”
Mô͘-se thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê ōe chiū phak tī thô͘-kha,

tùi Khó-la kap in hit-tīn lâng kóng, “Bîn-á-chá-khí, Siōng Chú beh chí-sī sím-mi̍h-lâng sī sio̍k I ê, sím-mi̍h-lâng sī sèng, chiū ōe kiò hit-ê lâng chiū-kūn I; Siōng Chú beh hō͘ I kéng-soán ê lâng chhin-kūn I.
Lín tio̍h án-ni chòe: Khó-la kap lín chit-tīn lâng, tio̍h the̍h hiuⁿ-lô͘ lâi;

bîn-á-chài lín tio̍h tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng, tī hiuⁿ-lô͘ lāi-bīn tóe hé, téng-bīn hē hiuⁿ. Siōng Chú kéng--tio̍h ê lâng, i chiah sī sèng. Lín chiah-ê Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ-sun chiah sī siuⁿ kè-hūn lah!”
Mô͘-se koh tùi Khó-la kóng, “ Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ-sun, chù-ì thiaⁿ!

Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè kā lín tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê hōe-chiòng hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi, hō͘ lín chhin-kūn I, pān-lí Siōng Chú hōe-bō͘ ê sū, koh khiā tī hōe-chiòng bīn-chêng ho̍k-sāi, che kiám sī sió-khóa tāi-chì?
Siōng-tè koh hō͘ lí, kap lí ê chhin-cho̍k Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ-sun chòe-hé chhin-kūn I, lín iáu beh iau-kiû chè-si ê chit-hūn sī--bô?
Lí kap lín chit-tīn lâng liân-ha̍p, sī teh kong-kek Siōng Chú. A-lûn sī siáⁿ-lâng, lín kèng-jiân tùi i hoat oàn-giân?”
Mô͘-se chhe lâng khì kiò Í-lī-ap ê kiáⁿ Tāi-tan kap A-pí-lân; in kóng, “Goán m̄ khì!
Lí kā goán tùi lâu lin kap bi̍t ê Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhōa--chhut-lâi, hāi goán sí tī khòng-iá, koh beh ka-kī choh-ông koán-hat goán sī--bô?

Lí m̄-nā bô chhōa goán khì kàu lí só͘ kóng lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe, bô hō͘ goán ū chhân-hn̂g kap phû-tô-hn̂g chòe ke-gia̍p, koh beh ó͘ chiah-ê lâng ê ba̍k-chiu sī--bô? Goán bô beh khì lí hia.”
Mô͘-se chiū hui-siông siū-khì, tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Kiû lí m̄-thang chiap-la̍p in ê chè-mi̍h. Góa m̄-bat khan-kè in chi̍t chiah lû, mā m̄-bat hāi-kè in chi̍t ê lâng.”
Mô͘-se tùi Khó-la kóng, “Lí kap lín chit-tīn lâng, kap A-lûn, bîn-á-chài lóng tio̍h lâi khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.
Lín nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p lâng ta̍k-ê tio̍h tòa hiuⁿ-lô͘, lāi-bīn tóe hiuⁿ, lâi kàu Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng; lí kap A-lûn tio̍h ka-kī tòa hiuⁿ-lô͘ lâi.”
In ta̍k-ê lâng chiū the̍h hiuⁿ-lô͘, lāi-bīn tóe hé, téng-bīn hē hiuⁿ; in kap Mô͘-se, A-lûn khiā tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu.
Khó-la chio-chi̍p choân-thé hōe-chiòng lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, kong-kek Mô͘-se, A-lûn. Hit-sî, Siōng Chú ê êng-kng ǹg hōe-chiòng hián-hiān.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se kap A-lûn kóng,
“Lín tio̍h lī chiah-ê hōe-chiòng khah hn̄g leh, góa beh tī chi̍t-ba̍k-nih-kú ê tiong-kan kā in siau-bia̍t.”

Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chiū phak tī thô͘-kha, kóng, “Siōng-tè ah, siúⁿ-sù sìⁿ-miā hō͘ sè-kan-lâng ê Siōng-tè, chi̍t ê lâng hoān-chōe, lí chiū tùi choân hōe-chiòng hoat tōa siū-khì sī--bô?”
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se khì kā hōe-chiòng kóng, “Lín tio̍h lī-khui Khó-la, Tāi-tan, A-pí-lân pò͘-pîⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi.”
Mô͘-se khì Tāi-tan, A-pí-lân hia, Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló mā tè i khì.
I hoan-hù hōe-chiòng kóng, “Lín tio̍h lī-khui chiah-ê pháiⁿ-lâng ê pò͘-pîⁿ. In ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ lóng m̄-thang bong, chiah bián lín kap in chòe-hé siau-bia̍t.”

Hōe-chiòng chiū lī-khui Khó-la, Tāi-tan, A-pí-lân pò͘-pîⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi. Tāi-tan, A-pí-lân kap in ê bó͘, kiáⁿ-jî, in ê sòe-kiáⁿ, lóng chhut-lâi khiā tī in ka-kī ê pò͘-pîⁿ mn̂g-kháu.
Mô͘-se kóng, “Sī Siōng Chú chhe góa chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì, só͘-í lín tio̍h chai, m̄-sī góa chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù teh chòe.
Chiah-ê lâng nā kap it-poaⁿ-lâng kâng-khoán chū-jiân sí, tú-tio̍h kap it-poaⁿ-lâng kâng-khoán ê cho-gū, chiū-sī Siōng Chú bô chhe góa.

Siōng Chú nā chòe chi̍t hāng sin ê sū, hō͘ tōe khui-chhùi, chiong in kap hit-tīn lâng lóng thun--lo̍h-khì, hō͘ in oa̍h-oa̍h siak-lo̍h Im-kan, lín chiū chai chiah-ê lâng biáu-sī Siōng Chú.”
Mô͘-se ōe tú-á kóng soah, Tāi-tan kap A-pí-lân ē-bīn ê tōe chiū li̍h--khui.
Tōe li̍h--khui, chiong in kap in ê ka-koàn, í-ki̍p só͘-ū sio̍k Khó-la ê lâng, châi-bu̍t lóng thun--lo̍h-khì.
Hiah-ê lâng kap só͘-ū sio̍k in--ê lóng oa̍h-oa̍h lo̍h Im-kan; tōe tī in ê téng-bīn koh ha̍p-óa, in chiū tùi hōe-chiòng tiong-kan siau-bia̍t.
Tī in sì-chiu-ûi ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h in âu-kiò, chiū lóng tô-cháu, kóng, “Lán mā ōe hō͘ tōe thun--lo̍h-khì!”
Koh ū hé tùi Siōng Chú hia hoat-chhut, thun-bia̍t hit nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p ê hiàn-hiuⁿ ê lâng.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se

hoan-hù chè-si A-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat, kā hiah-ê hiuⁿ-lô͘ tùi hé-tiong khioh--khí-lâi, koh kā hiah-ê teh to̍h ê hé-thòaⁿ the̍h-khì khah-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi iā hō͘ sòaⁿ; hiah-ê hiuⁿ-lô͘ í-keng sī sèng.

Hiah-ê hiuⁿ-lô͘ í-keng hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, só͘-í sī sèng--ê. Lí tio̍h chiong hiah-ê hoān-chōe hāi ka-kī sìⁿ-miā ê lâng ê hiuⁿ-lô͘, tûi-chòe kui-phìⁿ, tah tī chè-tôaⁿ, thang chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê kàm-kài.
Chè-si Í-lī-a-sat chiū kā hiah-ê lâng só͘ hiàn tâng ê hiuⁿ-lô͘ the̍h--lâi, tûi-chòe kui-phìⁿ, kā chè-tôaⁿ pau--teh,

hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe kàm-kài; chiah bián m̄-sī sio̍k A-lûn hō͘-tāi ê gōa-lâng tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng sio-hiuⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ Khó-la kap in hit-tīn lâng siū siau-bia̍t; che sī chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè Mô͘-se tùi Í-lī-a-sat ê bēng-lēng.
Keh-ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng choân-thé hōe-chiòng lóng bâi-oàn Mô͘-se kap A-lûn, kóng, “Lín hāi-sí Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn.”
Hōe-chiòng chū-chi̍p kong-kek Mô͘-se kap A-lûn ê sî, hut-jiân khòaⁿ-kìⁿ hōe-bō͘ ū hûn khàm--teh, Siōng Chú ê êng-kng hián-hiān.
Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chiū lâi hōe-bō͘ thâu-chêng,
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se, kóng,
“Lín tio̍h lī-khui chit-ê hōe-chiòng, hō͘ góa thang tī chi̍t-ba̍k-nih-kú ê tiong-kan kā in siau-bia̍t.” In nn̄g ê lâng chiū phak tī thô͘-kha.

Mô͘-se tùi A-lûn kóng, “Khì the̍h lí ê hiuⁿ-lô͘, chiong chè-tôaⁿ téng ê hé hē tī hit lāi-bīn, téng-bīn hē hiuⁿ, khah kín tòa-khì hōe-chiòng hia, kā in sio̍k-chōe; in-ūi Siōng Chú í-keng hoat tōa siū-khì, un-e̍k thòaⁿ-khui lah.”

A-lûn chiàu Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù, the̍h hiuⁿ-lô͘ cháu ji̍p-khì hōe-chiòng tiong-kan. Ài ah! Un-e̍k í-keng tī jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan teh thòaⁿ lah. A-lûn chiū chiong hiuⁿ hē tī hé ê téng-bīn, kā jîn-bîn sio̍k-chōe.
I khiā tī oa̍h-lâng kap sí-lâng ê tiong-kan, un-e̍k chiū thêng-chí.
Tû-liáu in-ūi Khó-la ê sū-kiāⁿ sí--ê í-gōa, tú-tio̍h un-e̍k sí--ê kiōng chi̍t-bān sì-chheng chhit-pah lâng.
Un-e̍k thêng-chí liáu-āu, A-lûn chiū tò-lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu Mô͘-se hia.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê siú-léng lóng tio̍h gia̍h in ê koáiⁿ-á lâi, lóng-chóng cha̍p-jī ki. Lí tio̍h tī in ê koáiⁿ-á siá in ê miâ.
Lī-bī chi-cho̍k hit-ki koáiⁿ-á tio̍h siá A-lûn ê miâ; in-ūi ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ lóng ū chi̍t ki koáiⁿ-á.
Lí tio̍h chiong hiah-ê koáiⁿ-á the̍h-lâi hōe-bō͘, hē tī iok-kūi ê thâu-chêng, chiū-sī góa kap lín siong-hōe ê só͘-chāi.
Góa só͘ kéng hit-ê lâng, i ê koáiⁿ-á ōe puh-gê; án-ni góa beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bōe koh bâi-oàn lín.”

Mô͘-se chiong chiah-ê ōe kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, ta̍k-ê chi-cho̍k ê siú-léng chiū chiong in ê koáiⁿ-á kau hō͘ Mô͘-se; chi̍t ê chi-cho̍k chi̍t ki, kiōng cha̍p-jī ki; A-lûn ê koáiⁿ-á mā tī hit tiong-kan.
Mô͘-se chiū chiong hiah-ê koáiⁿ-á the̍h ji̍p-khì khǹg iok-kūi ê tiùⁿ-bō͘ lāi-bīn, hē tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.
Keh-ji̍t, Mô͘-se ji̍p-khì khǹg iok-kūi ê tiùⁿ-bō͘, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Lī-bī chi-cho̍k A-lûn ê koáiⁿ-á í-keng puh-gê, siⁿ hoe-m̂, khui-hoe, kiat hēng-jîn.
Mô͘-se tùi Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng gia̍h hiah-ê koáiⁿ-á chhut--lâi, khì Í-sek-lia̍t ê chèng-lâng hia, hō͘ in khòaⁿ; ta̍k-ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ chiū khì gia̍h ka-kī ê koáiⁿ-á.

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Chiong A-lûn ê koáiⁿ-á khǹg tò-khì iok-kūi bīn-chêng, chòe chiah-ê pōe-ge̍k ê lâng ê kàm-kài. Án-ni in chiū bōe koh tùi góa hoat oàn-giân, mā bōe in-ūi án-ni lâi sí.”
Mô͘-se chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chòe.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Chhám ah! Goán ōe sí, ōe bia̍t-bông, goán ōe sí-liáu-liáu.
Só͘-ū óa-kūn Siōng Chú ê hōe-bō͘--ê lóng ōe sí. Án-ni, goán ún sí--ê!”

Siōng Chú tùi A-lûn kóng, “Lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ-jî, í-ki̍p lí ê chhin-cho̍k, tio̍h sêng-tam sèng-só͘ siū chhim-hoān ê chōe; lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ-jî tio̍h sêng-tam chè-si chit-hūn siū chhim-hoān ê chōe.
Lí tio̍h chhōa Lī-bī chi-cho̍k ê lâng lâi, tī lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ-jî tī hōe-bō͘ ho̍k-sāi ê sî hia̍p-chō͘ lín.
In tio̍h chòe lí ê chō͘-chhiú, chòe hōe-bō͘ ê khang-khè; m̄-kú m̄-thang óa-kūn sèng-só͘ ê khì-khū kap chè-tôaⁿ, chiah bián in kap lín lóng sí.
In tio̍h kap lí chòe-hé tī hōe-bō͘ ho̍k-sāi, chòe hōe-bō͘ só͘-ū ê kang-chok; m̄-kú m̄-thang hō͘ pa̍t-ê chi-cho̍k ê lâng óa-kūn lín.
Lín tio̍h hū-chek chip-hêng sèng-só͘ kap chè-tôaⁿ ê kang-chok, chiah bián góa ê siū-khì koh lîm-kàu Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Góa ū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan kéng lín ê chhin-cho̍k Lī-bī -lâng siúⁿ-sù lín, kui hō͘ Siōng Chú, thang pān-lí hōe-bō͘ ê kang-chok.

Lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ-jî tio̍h tī chè-tôaⁿ kap hōe-bō͘ lāi-bīn, chīn lín chòe chè-si ê chit-hūn; chit-ê chè-si ê chit-hūn sī góa hō͘ lín ê lé-mi̍h. Nā ū pa̍t-ê chi-cho̍k ê lâng óa-kūn lín, tio̍h hō͘ i sí.”

Siōng Chú koh kā A-lûn kóng, “Góa chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng hiàn hō͘ góa ê lé-mi̍h kau-tài lí; chiah-ê mi̍h lóng sù hō͘ lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi chòe éng-oán ê hūn-gia̍h.
Jîn-bîn hiàn hō͘ góa chì-sèng ê sò͘-chè, sio̍k-chōe-chè, pê-chōe-chè tiong-kan, bô tī chè-tôaⁿ ēng hé sio ê chè-mi̍h lóng kui hō͘ lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi.
Chiah-ê sī chì-sèng ê mi̍h, lí tio̍h sīn-tiōng lâi chia̍h; ta-po͘-lâng lóng thang chia̍h; lí tio̍h khòaⁿ chiah-ê mi̍h chòe sèng.

“ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ hiàn gia̍h-koân á-sī iô--kè ê chè-mi̍h, góa mā lóng sù hō͘ lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi chòe éng-oán ê hūn-gia̍h; lí chhù-lāi só͘-ū chheng-khì ê lâng lóng thang chia̍h.
“ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hiàn hō͘ góa Siōng Chú chho͘-se̍k ê mi̍h, chiū-sī siōng-hó ê iû, chiú, kap ngó͘-kok, góa lóng siúⁿ-sù lí.
Chiah-ê lóng kui hō͘ lí; lí chhù-lāi só͘-ū lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì ê lâng lóng thang chia̍h.
“ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng éng-oán hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê mi̍h, lóng beh kui hō͘ lí.

“Só͘-ū hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ--ê, bô-lūn sī lâng á-sī cheng-siⁿ, lóng kui hō͘ lí; m̄-kú tōa-kiáⁿ it-tēng tio̍h sio̍k-hôe; bô chheng-khì ê cheng-siⁿ thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ--ê, mā tio̍h sio̍k-hôe.
Beh sio̍k-hôe móa-ge̍h í-siōng--ê, tio̍h chiàu sèng-só͘ ê kong-chhìn, la̍p gō͘-cha̍p-chhit kong-khek ê gûn.

M̄-kú thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê gû, mî-iûⁿ, soaⁿ-iûⁿ, lí m̄-thang sio̍k-hôe; chiah-ê sī sèng, in ê huih tio̍h hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ, iû tio̍h ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Hiah-ê bah, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiàⁿ-thúi í-ki̍p iô--kè ê heng-khám-bah, siâng-khoán lóng kui hō͘ lí.

“ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng gia̍h-koân hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú sèng ê chè-mi̍h, góa lóng sù hō͘ lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi chòe éng-oán ê hūn-gia̍h. “Chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú kap lí, lí ê hō͘-tāi só͘ li̍p éng-oán bōe hòe-tû ê iok.”
Siōng Chú tùi A-lûn kóng, “Lí tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê kéng-lāi bô sán-gia̍p, tī jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan bô hūn-gia̍h. Góa chiū-sī lí ê hūn-gia̍h, lí ê sán-gia̍p.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t hōng-hiàn, góa í-keng sù hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng chòe sán-gia̍p, pò-tap in tī hōe-bō͘ ho̍k-sāi ê lô-khó͘.
Kî-tha ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng m̄-thang koh óa-kūn hōe-bō͘, chiah bián in hoān-chōe lâi sí.

Lī-bī -lâng chòe hōe-bō͘ ê kang-chok, tio̍h sêng-tam in ka-kī ê chōe; che beh chòe lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē. In tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan m̄-thang ū sán-gia̍p.

In-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiong chhut-sán ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t chòe te̍k-pia̍t ê lé-mi̍h hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, góa chiong chiah-ê sù hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng chòe sán-gia̍p, só͘-í góa hoan-hù in, tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan m̄-thang ū sán-gia̍p.”
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se

hoan-hù Lī-bī -lâng: Siōng Chú ū chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hiàn hō͘ I cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê hōng-hiàn, sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p; lín tio̍h tùi hit cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê tiong-kan koh the̍h cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t, chòe te̍k-pia̍t ê lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Chit-ê te̍k-pia̍t ê lé-mi̍h tú chhin-chhiūⁿ choh-sit-lâng só͘ hiàn chho͘-se̍k ê be̍h-á, kap chiú-khut ê sin-chiú.
Án-ni, lín tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tit--tio̍h ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t, the̍h-lâi chòe te̍k-pia̍t ê lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, chiong chiah-ê kui hō͘ chè-si A-lûn.
Lín tio̍h tùi só͘ tit--tio̍h it-chhè ê lé-mi̍h, chiong siōng-hó--ê hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng chòe te̍k-pia̍t ê lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Lí tio̍h tùi Lī-bī -lâng kóng: Lín í-keng tùi hit tiong-kan hōng-hiàn siōng-hó ê lé-mi̍h, che tú chhin-chhiūⁿ hiàn chho͘-se̍k ê be̍h-á, kap chiú-khut ê sin-chiú.
Lín kap lín ê ka-koàn thang tī ta̍k só͘-chāi chia̍h lín hōng-hiàn só͘ chhun--ê; che sī lín eng-kai tit--tio̍h-ê, pò-tap lín tī hōe-bō͘ chòe kang ê lô-khó͘.

Lín nā hōng-hiàn siōng-hó ê lé-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú, jiân-āu chia̍h hōng-hiàn só͘ chhun--ê chiū bô chōe; nā bô seng hōng-hiàn siōng-hó ê lé-mi̍h, lín chiū-sī siat-to̍k Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê sèng-mi̍h, tio̍h siū chhú-sí.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kap A-lûn kóng,

“Siōng Chú só͘ bēng-lēng ê lu̍t-hoat ū chi̍t tiâu án-ni kóng: Lí tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khan chi̍t chiah kiān-khong, bô hâ-chhû, m̄-bat kòa taⁿ ê chhiah-sek gû-bú lâi lí chia.
Tio̍h chiong i kau hō͘ chè-si Í-lī-a-sat, tòa chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa, tī Í-lī-a-sat ê bīn-chêng kā i thâi-sí.
Chè-si Í-lī-a-sat tio̍h ēng chńg-thâu-á ùn huih, ǹg hōe-bō͘ thâu-chêng hiù chhit piàn.
Tio̍h ū chi̍t ê lâng tī chè-si ê ba̍k-chiu chêng sio chit-chiah gû-bú, mā chiong i ê phê, bah, huih, kap pùn sio-tiāu.
Chè-si tio̍h chiong pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ, gû-chhek-chháu, chu-âng-sek ê se, lóng hiat tī sio gû ê hé-tiong.
Āu-lâi chè-si tio̍h sóe i ê saⁿ, sóe seng-khu, chiah thang ji̍p iâⁿ-tōe; kàu ji̍t lo̍h í-āu chiah chheng-khì.
Sio gû-bú ê lâng mā tio̍h sóe i ê saⁿ, sóe seng-khu; kàu ji̍t lo̍h í-āu chiah chheng-khì.

Tio̍h ū chi̍t ê chheng-khì ê lâng siu-si̍p gû-bú ê hu, pó-chûn tī iâⁿ-gōa lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì ê só͘-chāi, lâu-teh chòe kiat-chēng ê chúi ê lō͘-ēng, thang kā Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng ê chōe tû--khì.
Siu-si̍p gû-bú ê hu ê lâng tio̍h sóe i ê saⁿ; kàu ji̍t lo̍h í-āu chiah chheng-khì. Che beh chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap kià-ku tī in tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng éng-oán ê kui-lē.”
Nā ū lâng bong-tio̍h lâng ê si-thé, chiū ōe chhit ji̍t kú bô chheng-khì.

Hit-ê lâng kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t, tio̍h ēng hit-ê chham chhiah-sek gû-bú ê hu ê chúi kiat-chēng ka-kī, kàu tē-chhit ji̍t chiah chheng-khì; i nā tī tē-saⁿ ji̍t bô kiat-chēng ka-kī, kàu tē-chhit ji̍t iáu-sī bô chheng-khì.

Nā ū lâng bong-tio̍h lâng ê si-thé, koh bô kiat-chēng ka-kī, chiū-sī phah lâ-sâm Siōng Chú ê hōe-bō͘, chit-ê lâng tio̍h kā i tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan kek-chhut; in-ūi i ê seng-khu bô hiù kiat-chēng ê chúi, i iáu bô chheng-khì.
Ē-bīn sī iú-koan lâng sí tī pò͘-pîⁿ lāi kiat-chēng ê tiâu-lē: Ji̍p-khì hit-ê pò͘-pîⁿ, í-ki̍p só͘-ū tī pò͘-pîⁿ lāi ê lâng, chhit ji̍t kú lóng bô chheng-khì.
Pò͘-pîⁿ lāi bô khàm-kòa ê khì-khū mā-sī bô chheng-khì.
Nā ū lâng tī iá-gōa bong-tio̍h hō͘ lâng thâi-sí á-sī chū-jiân sí ê si-thé, á-sī lâng ê kut-thâu, á-sī bōng, chhit ji̍t kú lóng bô chheng-khì.
Tio̍h ūi bô chheng-khì ê lâng the̍h chi̍t-kóa chhiah-sek gû-bú ê hu, hē tī khì-khū lāi, tò oa̍h-chúi tī hit lāi-bīn.

Tio̍h ū chi̍t ê lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì ê lâng the̍h gû-chhek-chháu ùn chit-ê chúi, hiù pò͘-pîⁿ, só͘-ū ê khì-khū, kap pò͘-pîⁿ lāi-bīn ê lâng, koh hiù hiah-ê bong-tio̍h bōng, kut-thâu, chū-jiân sí ê lâng, í-ki̍p bong-tio̍h si-thé ê lâng.

Tē-saⁿ ji̍t kap tē-chhit ji̍t, chheng-khì ê lâng tio̍h kā hiah-ê bô chheng-khì ê lâng hiù chúi, hō͘ in kàu tē-chhit ji̍t tit-tio̍h chheng-khì. Hiah-ê lâng tio̍h sóe-saⁿ, sóe seng-khu; kàu ji̍t lo̍h í-āu chiah chheng-khì.

Hit-ê bô chheng-khì koh bô khì kiat-chēng ka-kī ê lâng, tio̍h tùi hōe-chiòng ê tiong-kan kā i kek-chhut, in-ūi i phah lâ-sâm Siōng Chú ê sèng-só͘; kiat-chēng ê chúi bô hiù tī i ê seng-khu, i sī bô chheng-khì ê lâng.

Che beh chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng éng-oán ê kui-lē. Hit-ê kā lâng hiù kiat-chēng ê chúi ê lâng tio̍h sóe i ê saⁿ; nā ū lâng bong-tio̍h kiat-chēng ê chúi, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng i sī bô chheng-khì.
Hō͘ bô chheng-khì ê lâng bong--tio̍h ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ sī bô chheng-khì; bong-tio̍h hiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê lâng, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng lóng bô chheng-khì.
Chiaⁿ--ge̍h, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng choân-thé hōe-chiòng lâi kàu Sîm ê khòng-iá, tī Ka-te-su chat-iâⁿ. Bí-lī-an sí tī hia, chiū an-chòng tī hia.
Hōe-chiòng bô chúi thang lim, chiū chū-chi̍p kong-kek Mô͘-se kap A-lûn.
In khì kā Mô͘-se chhá, kóng, “Khó͘-bōe-tit goán ê tông-pau sí tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ê sî, goán mā chòe-hé sí-sí--leh.
Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ kā Siōng Chú ê hōe-chiòng chhōa-lâi chit-ê khòng-iá, sī beh hō͘ goán kap goán ê cheng-siⁿ sí tī chia sī--bô?

Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ chhōa goán chhut Ai-ki̍p, lâi kàu chit-ê pháiⁿ só͘-chāi? Goán tī chia bô só͘-chāi thang iā-chéng, thang chèng bû-hoa-kó, phû-tô, sia̍h-liû, koh bô chúi thang lim.”
Mô͘-se kap A-lûn lī-khui hōe-chiòng, khì hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, phak tī thô͘-kha; Siōng Chú ê êng-kng tùi in hián-hiān.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,

“Lí khì kā iok-kūi thâu-chêng hit-ki koáiⁿ-á gia̍h--lâi, kap lí ê hiaⁿ-ko A-lûn tiàu-chi̍p hōe-chiòng, tī in ê ba̍k-chiu chêng bēng-lēng chio̍h-pôaⁿ chhut-chúi, chúi chiū ōe tùi chio̍h-pôaⁿ lâu--chhut-lâi, hō͘ hōe-chiòng kap in ê cheng-siⁿ lim.”
Mô͘-se chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, kā koáiⁿ-á gia̍h--lâi.
Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chio hōe-chiòng khì chio̍h-pôaⁿ hia; Mô͘-se tùi in kóng, “Lín chiah-ê pōe-ge̍k ê lâng thiaⁿ leh, goán kiám tio̍h hō͘ chio̍h-pôaⁿ chhut-chúi hō͘ lín lim?”
Mô͘-se gia̍h chhiú--ni̍h ê koáiⁿ-á, kā chio̍h-pôaⁿ kòng nn̄g ē, chiū ū chin chōe chúi lâu--chhut-lâi; hōe-chiòng kap in ê cheng-siⁿ lóng lim.

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kap A-lûn kóng, “In-ūi lín m̄ sìn góa, bô tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê ba̍k-chiu chêng chun góa chòe sèng, só͘-í lín bōe-tàng chhōa chiah-ê hōe-chiòng ji̍p-khì góa beh sù hō͘ in ê tōe.”
Chiah-ê chúi chiū kiò-chòe Bí-lī-pa chúi-chôaⁿ; in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kā Siōng Chú chhá; Siōng Chú chiū tùi in hián-bêng ka-kī sī sèng.
Mô͘-se tùi Ka-te-su chhe sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Í-tong -ông, kóng, “Lí ê chhin-cho̍k Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng án-ni kóng: Lí chai goán ū tú-tio̍h chin chōe kan-khó͘.
Goán ê chó͘-sian lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p, tòa tī hia kúi-nā nî; Ai-ki̍p -lâng ap-pek goán kap goán ê chó͘-sian.
Goán ai-kiû Siōng Chú, I thiaⁿ goán ê siaⁿ, chiū phài sù-chiá chhōa goán lī-khui Ai-ki̍p. Hiān-chāi goán tī lí pian-kài ê siâⁿ Ka-te-su.

Taⁿ, chhiáⁿ ún-chún goán keng-kè lí ê tōe. Goán bōe tùi lín ê chhân-hn̂g kap phû-tô-hn̂g kè, mā bōe lim chíⁿ-chúi; chí-ū kiâⁿ tōa-lō͘, bōe phian-chó-phian-iū, it-ti̍t kàu kè lí ê pian-kài.”
Í-tong -ông kóng, “Lín bōe-ēng-tit tùi góa chia kè; nā it-tēng beh kè, góa beh phài peng kong-kek lín.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kā i kóng, “Goán ōe tùi tōa-lō͘ kè--khì. Goán kap cheng-siⁿ nā lim lí ê chúi, goán ōe chiàu kè-siàu hō͘ lí. Pài-thok, chhiáⁿ ún-chún hō͘ goán kè.”
Í-tong -ông kóng, “Put-chún lín kè.” I chiū chhōa chi̍t tōa-tīn bú-chong pō͘-tūi chhut-lâi kong-kek in.
Án-ni, Í-tong -ông m̄-chún Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi in ê thó͘-tōe keng-kè; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū oat tùi pa̍t-ê hong-hiòng khì.
Í-sek-lia̍t choân-thé hōe-chiòng tùi Ka-te-su chhut-hoat khì kàu Hô-ní-soaⁿ.
Tī Í-tong pian-kài ê Hô-ní-soaⁿ, Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se kap A-lûn, kóng,
“ A-lûn liâm-piⁿ ōe sí; i bōe-tàng ji̍p-khì góa beh sù hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tōe, in-ūi tī Bí-lī-pa chúi-chôaⁿ ê sū-kiāⁿ lín ûi-pōe góa ê bēng-lēng.
Lí tio̍h chhōa A-lûn kap i ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat chiūⁿ Hô-ní-soaⁿ,
kā A-lûn ê saⁿ thǹg khí-lâi hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat chhēng; A-lûn ōe sí tī hia.”
Mô͘-se chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chòe. In saⁿ ê lâng tī hōe-chiòng ê ba̍k-chiu chêng chiūⁿ Hô-ní-soaⁿ.
Mô͘-se chiong A-lûn ê saⁿ thǹg--khí-lâi, chhēng tī i ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat sin-chiūⁿ, A-lûn chiū sí tī soaⁿ-téng. Mô͘-se kap Í-lī-a-sat lo̍h-soaⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t choân-ke chai A-lûn í-keng sí, chiū ūi A-lûn thî-khàu saⁿ-cha̍p ji̍t.
Tòa tī Nî-kek-hu ê Ka-lâm -lâng A-la-tek -ông, thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi A-tha-lîm ê lō͘ lâi, chiū kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn, lia̍h in kúi-nā ê lâng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Siōng Chú hē-goān kóng, “Lí nā chin-chiàⁿ hō͘ goán thâi-iâⁿ chiah-ê jîn-bîn, goán chiū beh chiong in ê siâⁿ oân-choân húi-bia̍t.”

Siōng Chú thiaⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê khún-kiû, chiong Ka-lâm -lâng kau tī in ê chhiú, in chiū chiong Ka-lâm -lâng kap in ê siâⁿ thiat-tóe siau-bia̍t; hit-ê só͘-chāi chiū kiò-chòe Hô-ní-má.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Hô-ní-soaⁿ chhut-hoat, se̍h-kè Í-tong ê tōe, ǹg Âng-hái ê lō͘ kiâⁿ; tī lō͘--ni̍h, in ê sim chin hoân,

chiū bâi-oàn Siōng-tè kap Mô͘-se, kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ chhōa goán chhut Ai-ki̍p, hō͘ goán lâi sí tī chit-ê khòng-iá? Chia bô chia̍h-mi̍h, bô chúi, goán mā bô ài koh chia̍h chit-ê pe̍h-chiáⁿ-bô-bī ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ.”
Siōng Chú chiū phài hé-chôa ji̍p-khì jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan, kā in; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sí chin chōe.

Jîn-bîn chiū khì kā Mô͘-se kóng, “Goán ū hoān-chōe, in-ūi goán kóng-ōe kong-kek Siōng Chú kap lí; chhiáⁿ lí kiû Siōng Chú kā chiah-ê chôa kóaⁿ lī-khui goán.” Mô͘-se chiū ūi jîn-bîn kî-kiû.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí chù chi̍t bé chôa, tiàu tī kî-koaⁿ téng; só͘-ū hō͘ chôa kā--tio̍h-ê, chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ chiū ōe oa̍h.”
Mô͘-se chiū chù chi̍t bé tâng-chôa, tiàu tī kî-koaⁿ téng; só͘-ū hō͘ chôa kā--tio̍h-ê, chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ chit-bé tâng-chôa, chiū oa̍h.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut-hoat, chat-iâⁿ tī O-pek.
Koh tùi O-pek chhut-hoat, chat-iâⁿ tī Mô͘-ap tang-pêng khòng-iá lāi-bīn ê Í-iâ A-pa-lîm.
Tùi hia chhut-hoat, chat-iâⁿ tī Sat-lia̍t ê khoe-kok.
Tùi hia chhut-hoat, chat-iâⁿ tī Mô͘-ap kap A-mô͘-lī ê kau-kài, sio̍k A-mô͘-lī ê A-lūn khoe-kok hit-pêng hōaⁿ, óa-kūn A-mô͘-lī ê khòng-iá.
Só͘-í, Siōng Chú ê Chiàn-kì án-ni kì-chài: So͘-hoat ê Oa-hap-pek, A-lūn hiah-ê khoe-kok,
í-ki̍p hiah-ê khoe-kok ê kiā, it-ti̍t kàu A-ní tōe-khu, óa-kūn Mô͘-ap ê pian-kài.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi hia khì Pí-ní; Siōng Chú bat tùi Mô͘-se kóng “Lí chū-chi̍p jîn-bîn, góa beh chúi hō͘ in”, só͘ kóng--ê chiū-sī chit-kháu chíⁿ.
Hit-sî Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhiùⁿ-koa kóng: Chíⁿ ah, chhèng chúi chhut--lâi! Lán tio̍h tùi i chhiùⁿ-koa!
Che sī kùi-cho̍k ēng chàu-pán khui--ê, sī bîn-kan ê léng-siù ēng koáiⁿ-á ku̍t--ê. In tùi khòng-iá khì Má-tha-ná,
koh tùi Má-tha-ná khì Ná-hap-lia̍t, tùi Ná-hap-lia̍t khì Pa-boa̍t,
tùi Pa-boa̍t kàu Mô͘-ap tōe-khu ê soaⁿ-kok; tùi chia khòaⁿ--lo̍h-khì, ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h khòng-iá ê Pí-su-ka-soaⁿ ê soaⁿ-chiam.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng phài sù-chiá khì kìⁿ A-mô͘-lī -lâng ê ông Se-hông, kóng,
“Chhiáⁿ ún-chún goán keng-kè lí ê tōe. Goán bōe oat ji̍p-khì chhân-hn̂g kap phû-tô-hn̂g, mā bōe lim chíⁿ-chúi; chí-ū kiâⁿ tōa-lō͘, it-ti̍t kàu kè lí ê pian-kài.”
Se-hông m̄-chún Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng keng-kè i ê tōe, chiū chū-chi̍p i ê jîn-bîn chhut-lâi khòng-iá, beh kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; tī Ngá-cha̍p kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ēng to thâi in, chiàm A-lūn-hô kap Ngá-phok-hô tiong-kan ê tōe, ti̍t-ti̍t kàu A-bûn -lâng hia; in-ūi A-bûn -lâng ê pian-kài hông-siú giâm-bi̍t.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàm-léng A-mô͘-lī -lâng só͘-ū ê siâⁿ, pau-koat Hi-si̍t-pún kap chiu-ûi ê chng-siā.
Hi-si̍t-pún sī A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông ê siâⁿ; Se-hông bat kong-táⁿ í-chêng ê Mô͘-ap -ông, chiàm-léng i só͘-ū ê thó͘-tōe, ti̍t-kàu A-lūn-hô.
Só͘-í si-jîn liām-si, kóng: Tio̍h lâi Hi-si̍t-pún; goān Se-hông ê siâⁿ tiông-kiàn koh kian-kò͘.
Ū hé tùi Hi-si̍t-pún hoat, ū hé-iām tùi Se-hông ê siâⁿ chhut, sio-húi Mô͘-ap ê A-ní, sio-bia̍t A-lūn-hô ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ.

Mô͘-ap ah, lí ū chai-hō lah! Pài Ki-boat sîn-bêng ê lâng ah, lín bia̍t-bông lah! Ki-boat hāi i ê ta-po͘-lâng tô-bông, hāi i ê cha-bó͘-lâng hō͘ A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông lia̍h--khì.
Goán tùi Hi-si̍t-pún kàu Tí-pún kā in oân-choân siau-bia̍t; goán hō͘ tōe hong-hòe, ti̍t-kàu Lô-hoat, koh kàu Bí-tí-pa.
Án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū tòa tī A-mô͘-lī -lâng ê tōe.
Mô͘-se phài lâng khì thàm-cha Ngá-siā; in chiàm hiah-ê chng-siā, chiong hiah-ê A-mô͘-lī -lâng kóaⁿ-cháu.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū oat tùi ǹg Pa-san ê hong-hiòng khì; Pa-san -ông Go̍k kap i ê kun-peng chhut-lâi tī Í-tek-lâi kap in kau-chiàn.

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ i, in-ūi góa í-keng chiong i kap i ê kun-peng, í-ki̍p i ê thó͘-tōe lóng kau tī lí ê chhiú; lí tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-hù tòa tī Hi-si̍t-pún ê A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông án-ni tùi-hù i.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū thâi-sí Go̍k kap i ê kiáⁿ-jî, í-ki̍p i ê jîn-bîn, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh, koh chiàm-léng i ê tōe.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng koh chhut-hoat, tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng, Iâ-lī-ko tùi-bīn ê Mô͘-ap pêng-goân chat-iâⁿ.
Se-phoat ê kiáⁿ Pa-le̍k thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi A-mô͘-lī -lâng só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū.
Mô͘-ap -lâng chai Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chin chōe, chiū chin kiaⁿ, hui-siông tio̍h-kip.

Mô͘-ap -lâng kā Bí-tiân ê tiúⁿ-ló kóng, “Taⁿ chit-tīn lâng beh chiong lán sì-chiu-ûi só͘-ū--ê chia̍h-liáu-liáu, chhin-chhiūⁿ gû chia̍h iá-tōe ê chháu kâng-khoán.” Hit-sî Se-phoat ê kiáⁿ Pa-le̍k chòe Mô͘-ap ê ông.

I phài sù-chiá khì Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô ê Pí-toa̍t, Pí-ní ê kiáⁿ Pa-lân ê kò͘-hiong, iau-chhiáⁿ i lâi, kóng, “Ū chi̍t cho̍k ê lâng tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut--lâi; in lâng chōe kah khàm-móa tōe-bīn, hiān-chāi tòa tī góa ê tùi-bīn.

In pí goán khah kiông, só͘-í chhiáⁿ lí lâi, thòe góa chiù-chó͘ hiah-ê lâng, góa chiah ū khó-lêng thâi-iâⁿ, kā in kóaⁿ-chhut chit-ê tōe. Góa chai, lí chiok-hok--ê, ōe tit-tio̍h chiok-hok; lí chiù-chó͘--ê, ōe siū chiù-chó͘.”
Mô͘-ap ê tiúⁿ-ló kap Bí-tiân ê tiúⁿ-ló chiū tòa pok-kòa ê lé-kim chhut-hoat, khì Pa-lân hia, chiong Pa-le̍k ê ōe kā i kóng.
Pa-lân tùi in kóng, “Ē-hng-àm lín tòa chia; góa ōe chiong Siōng Chú hoan-hù góa--ê kā lín hôe-ho̍k.” Mô͘-ap ê koaⁿ-oân chiū tòa tī Pa-lân hia.
Siōng-tè lâi Pa-lân hia, mn̄g i kóng, “Lâi tòa lí chia--ê sī siáⁿ-lâng?”
Pa-lân ìn Siōng-tè kóng, “Sī Se-phoat ê kiáⁿ Mô͘-ap -ông Pa-le̍k phài lâng lâi góa chia, kóng,
‘Ū jîn-bîn tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut--lâi, lâng chōe kah khàm-móa tōe-bīn. Chhiáⁿ lí lâi, thòe góa kā in chiù-chó͘, góa chiah ū khó-lêng thâi-iâⁿ, kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.’”
Siōng-tè tùi Pa-lân kóng, “Lí m̄-thang kap in khì, mā m̄-thang kā chit-ê jîn-bîn chiù-chó͘, in-ūi in sī góa só͘ chiok-hok--ê.”
Keh-chá-khí Pa-lân khí--lâi, tùi Pa-le̍k ê koaⁿ-oân kóng, “Lín tò--khì, in-ūi Siōng Chú m̄-chún góa kap lín chòe-hé khì.”
Mô͘-ap ê koaⁿ-oân chiū chhut-hoat, tò-khì kā Pa-le̍k pò-kò, kóng, “ Pa-lân m̄-khéng kap goán lâi.”
Pa-le̍k koh phài khah-chōe, khah-tōa ê koaⁿ-oân.
In kàu Pa-lân hia, tùi i kóng, “ Se-phoat ê kiáⁿ Pa-le̍k án-ni kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ lí it-tēng tio̍h lâi góa chia.
Góa beh hō͘ lí kàu-gia̍h ê pò-siúⁿ; bô-lūn lí iau-kiû sím-mi̍h, góa lóng ōe hō͘ lí; só͘-í chhiáⁿ lí lâi, thòe góa kā chit-ê jîn-bîn chiù-chó͘.’”
Pa-lân tùi Pa-le̍k ê koaⁿ-oân kóng, “ Pa-le̍k chiū-sī kui chhù-keng ê kim-gûn hō͘ góa, góa chi̍t-sut-á to m̄-káⁿ ûi-pōe Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng.
Chhiáⁿ lín ē-hng-àm koh hioh tiàm chia, thèng-hāu góa chai Siōng Chú beh koh kā góa kóng sím-mi̍h.”
Hit-mî Siōng-tè lâi Pa-lân hia, kā i kóng, “Kì-jiân chiah-ê lâng koh lâi iau-chhiáⁿ lí, lí chiū kap in khì; m̄-kú góa kā lí kóng--ê, lí tio̍h chiàu án-ni chòe.”
Pa-lân thàu-chá khí--lâi, chún-pī lû, kap Mô͘-ap ê koaⁿ-oân chòe-hé khì.

Siōng-tè in-ūi Pa-lân kap Pa-le̍k ê koaⁿ-oân chòe-hé khì chiū siū-khì. Pa-lân khiâ-lû, ū nn̄g ê po̍k-jîn tè i; Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá lâi khiā tī lō͘--ni̍h, kā i chó͘-tòng.
Lû khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá khiā tī lō͘--ni̍h, chhiú gia̍h pu̍ih--chhut-lâi ê to, chiū tùi lō͘--ni̍h siám ji̍p hn̂g; Pa-lân phah lû, beh hō͘ i tńg-lâi goân-lō͘.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá lâi khiā tī phû-tô-hn̂g ê oe̍h-lō͘, siang-pêng lóng ū chhiûⁿ.
Lû khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá, chiū siám óa chi̍t pêng chhiûⁿ, kā Pa-lân ê kha khoeh--tio̍h, Pa-lân chiū koh phah i.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kiâⁿ chìn-chêng, khiā tī khah-oe̍h ê só͘-chāi, siang-pêng bô lō͘ thang oat.
Lû khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá, chiū phak tī Pa-lân ê ē-tóe; Pa-lân hoat siū-khì, ēng koáiⁿ-á phah lû.
Siōng Chú khui lû ê chhùi, lû chiū tùi Pa-lân kóng, “Lí ná bô-tāi-bô-chì kā góa phah saⁿ piàn?”
Pa-lân tùi lû kóng, “In-ūi lí chhòng-tī góa; góa hūn-bōe-tit ū to kā lí thâi--sí.”
Lû tùi Pa-lân kóng, “Lí chêng siàu-liân chiū khiâ góa, góa kiám bat tùi lí án-ni chòe?” Pa-lân kóng, “M̄-bat.”
Hit-sî Siōng Chú khui Pa-lân ê ba̍k-chiu, i chiū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá khiā tī lō͘--ni̍h, chhiú gia̍h pu̍ih--chhut-lâi ê to; Pa-lân chiū àⁿ-thâu phak tī thô͘-kha.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tùi i kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ saⁿ piàn phah lí ê lû? Góa lâi chó͘-tòng lí, in-ūi lí ê só͘-chòe ûi-pōe góa.
Lû khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa, chiū siám góa saⁿ piàn; i nā bô siám, góa chá chiū kā lí thâi--sí, hō͘ lû oa̍h--teh.”
Pa-lân tùi Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kóng, “Góa ū chōe lah. Góa m̄ chai lí khiā tī lō͘--ni̍h chó͘-tòng góa; lí nā bô ài góa khì, góa chiū tńg--khì.”
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tùi Pa-lân kóng, “Lí kap in khì; m̄-kú lí kan-ta ōe-ēng-tit kóng góa ài lí kóng ê ōe.” Pa-lân chiū kap Pa-le̍k ê koaⁿ-oân chòe-hé khì.
Pa-le̍k thiaⁿ-tio̍h Pa-lân lâi, chiū khì Mô͘-ap -siâⁿ gêng-chiap i; chit-ê siâⁿ sī tī pian-kài ê A-lūn hô-piⁿ.
Pa-le̍k tùi Pa-lân kóng, “Góa chêng-piàn chiū jia̍t-chhiat iau-chhiáⁿ lí, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ bô lâi? Lí siūⁿ-kóng góa bōe hō͘ lí kàu-gia̍h ê pò-siúⁿ sī--bô?”
Pa-lân ìn Pa-le̍k kóng, “Góa to í-keng lâi ah. M̄-kú góa bōe-tàng beh kóng sím-mi̍h chiū kóng sím-mi̍h. Góa kan-ta ōe-tàng kóng Siōng-tè kau-tài góa ê ōe.”
Pa-le̍k chhōa Pa-lân khì Ô͘-só -siâⁿ.
Pa-le̍k thâi gû iûⁿ hiàn-chè, chiong chè-bah sàng hō͘ Pa-lân í-ki̍p khì chiap i lâi ê koaⁿ-oân.
Keh-chá-khí, Pa-le̍k chhōa Pa-lân khì Pa-boa̍t Pa-le̍k; Pa-lân tùi hia ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn hun-sòaⁿ kàu tó-ūi.
Pa-lân tùi Pa-le̍k kóng, “Lí tī chia kā góa khí chhit chō chè-tôaⁿ, koh chún-pī chhit chiah gû-káng, chhit chiah iûⁿ-káng.”
Pa-le̍k chiū chiàu Pa-lân ê ōe chòe; Pa-le̍k kap Pa-lân tī ta̍k-chō tôaⁿ hiàn chi̍t chiah gû-káng kap chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-káng.

Pa-lân tùi Pa-le̍k kóng, “Lí chhiáⁿ khiā tī lí ê sio-hòa-chè ê piⁿ--á, góa beh khì thâu-chêng, bô-it-tēng Siōng Chú ōe tùi góa hián-hiān. I kā góa chí-sī sím-mi̍h, góa ōe kā lí kóng.” Pa-lân chiū chiūⁿ-khì khah koân bô chháu-ba̍k ê só͘-chāi.
Siōng-tè tùi Pa-lân hián-hiān, Pa-lân tùi I kóng, “Góa í-keng chún-pī chhit chō chè-tôaⁿ, tī ta̍k-chō tôaⁿ hiàn chi̍t chiah gû-káng kap chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-káng.”
Siōng Chú chiong Pa-lân eng-kai kóng ê ōe kau-tài i, koh kā i kóng, “Lí tò-khì Pa-le̍k hia, tio̍h án-ni kā i kóng.”
I chiū tò-khì Pa-le̍k hia; khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pa-le̍k kap Mô͘-ap ê koaⁿ-oân iáu khiā tī sio-hòa-chè ê piⁿ--á.

Pa-lân chiū liām-si, kóng: Pa-le̍k chhōa góa tùi Sū-lī-a lâi, Mô͘-ap -ông chhōa góa chhut tang-pêng ê soaⁿ. I kóng, “Lâi, kā góa chiù-chó͘ Ngá-kok; lâi, lóe-mē Í-sek-lia̍t.”
Siōng-tè bô chiù-chó͘--ê, góa ná thang chiù-chó͘? Siōng Chú bô lóe-mē--ê, góa ná thang lóe-mē?
Góa tùi soaⁿ-giâm khòaⁿ, tùi soaⁿ-téng koan-khòaⁿ; chit-ê jîn-bîn ka-kī khiā-khí, bô kap lia̍t-kok pâi chòe-hé.

Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kè-sǹg Ngá-kok ê thô͘-soa? Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng tiám-sǹg Í-sek-lia̍t ê thô͘-hún? Goān góa ê sí chhin-chhiūⁿ gī-lâng ê sí, góa ê kiat-kio̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ in ê kiat-kio̍k.
Pa-le̍k tùi Pa-lân kóng, “Lí sī teh chhòng siáⁿ? Góa kiò lí lâi chiù-chó͘ góa ê tùi-te̍k, lí kèng-jiân kā in chiok-hok!”
I ìn kóng, “Siōng Chú kau-tài góa kóng ê ōe, góa ná káⁿ bô chiàu-si̍t kóng?”

Pa-le̍k tùi Pa-lân kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kap góa khì pa̍t-ūi, tī hia lí ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h in; lí chí-ū ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h in ê chi̍t-pō͘-hūn, bōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h in choân-pō͘. Lí tio̍h tī hia thòe góa kā in chiù-chó͘.”
I chiū chhōa Pa-lân khì Só-hui ê iá-tōe, chiūⁿ Pí-su-ka soaⁿ-téng, khí chhit chō chè-tôaⁿ, ta̍k-chō tôaⁿ hiàn chi̍t chiah gû-káng kap chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-káng.
Pa-lân tùi Pa-le̍k kóng, “Lí chhiáⁿ tiàm chia, khiā tī lí ê sio-hòa-chè ê piⁿ--á, thèng-hāu góa khì hia kìⁿ Siōng Chú.”
Siōng Chú tùi Pa-lân hián-hiān, chiong i eng-kai kóng ê ōe kau-tài i; koh kóng, “Lí tò-khì Pa-le̍k hia, tio̍h chiàu án-ni kóng.”
Pa-lân chiū tò-khì Pa-le̍k hia; khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pa-le̍k kap Mô͘-ap ê koaⁿ-oân iáu khiā tī sio-hòa-chè ê piⁿ--á. Pa-le̍k mn̄g i kóng, “Siōng Chú tùi lí kóng sím-mi̍h?”
Pa-lân chiū liām-si, kóng: Pa-le̍k, chù-ì thiaⁿ! Se-phoat ê kiáⁿ, thiaⁿ leh!
Siōng-tè bōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, mā bōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ōe hoán-hóe. I kiám ōe kóng-liáu bô chòe, kiám ōe kóng chhut-chhùi bô si̍t-hiān?
Góa hōng-bēng chiok-hok; Siōng Chú ê chiok-hok, góa bōe kā i kái-piàn.
Tī Ngá-kok khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h chai-lān, tī Í-sek-lia̍t khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h chai-hō, Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè kap in tông-chāi; tī in tiong-kan ū o-ló Siōng Chú — in ê Ông ê siaⁿ.
Siōng-tè chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p; ūi-tio̍h in, I hoat-chhut chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-gû ê khùi-la̍t.

Ngá-kok bô su-iàu khòaⁿ tiāu-thâu, Í-sek-lia̍t bô su-iàu pok-kòa; sî-kan chi̍t-ē kàu, lâng kóng-tio̍h Ngá-kok it-tēng ōe kóng: Siōng-tè í-keng ūi Í-sek-lia̍t oân-sêng hiah tōa ê sū!
Chit-ê bîn-cho̍k heng-khí chhin-chhiūⁿ sai-bú, théng-sin chhin-chhiūⁿ sai-kang; i bô chia̍h la̍h-bu̍t, bô lim la̍h-bu̍t ê huih, it-tēng bô beh hioh-khùn.
Pa-le̍k tùi Pa-lân kóng, “Lí bô kā in chiù-chó͘ to hāi ah, ná koh kā in chiok-hok?”
Pa-lân ìn Pa-le̍k kóng, “Góa kiám bô kā lí kóng ‘Siōng Chú kau-tài góa ê ōe, góa it-tēng tio̍h chiàu án-ni kóng’?”
Pa-le̍k tùi Pa-lân kóng, “Lâi, góa chhōa lí lâi pa̍t-ūi, khó-lêng Siōng-tè ài lí tī hia thòe góa kā in chiù-chó͘.”
Pa-le̍k chiū chhōa Pa-lân khì Pí-ní-soaⁿ ê soaⁿ-chiam, tùi hia khòaⁿ--lo̍h-khì, ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h khòng-iá.
Pa-lân tùi Pa-le̍k kóng, “Lí tī chia kā góa khí chhit chō chè-tôaⁿ, koh chún-pī chhit chiah gû-káng, chhit chiah iûⁿ-káng.”
Pa-le̍k chiū chiàu Pa-lân ê ōe chòe, tī ta̍k-chō tôaⁿ hiàn chi̍t chiah gû-káng kap chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-káng.
Pa-lân chai Siōng Chú hoaⁿ-hí sù-hok hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t, chiū bô chhin-chhiūⁿ téng nn̄g piàn khì khòaⁿ tiāu-thâu. Pa-lân bīn ǹg khòng-iá,
khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàu chi-cho̍k chat-iâⁿ, Siōng-tè ê sîn lîm-kàu i.
I chiū liām-si, kóng: Pí-ní ê kiáⁿ Pa-lân ê ū-giân, ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ chheng-chhó ê lâng ê ū-giân;
ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè ê ōe, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Choân-lêng-chiá ê īⁿ-siōng, phak--teh, ba̍k-chiu kim-kim ê lâng ê ū-giân:
Ngá-kok ah, lí ê pò͘-pîⁿ ná ōe hiah súi! Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí ê tiùⁿ-bō͘ ná hiah hó-khòaⁿ!
In chhin-chhiūⁿ sio-liân-sòa ê chang-chhiū, chhin-chhiūⁿ khoe-piⁿ ê hoe-hn̂g, chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú chai-chèng ê tîm-hiuⁿ-chhiū, chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi-piⁿ ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū.
Chúi beh tùi in ê chúi-tháng móa-chhut; in ê chéng-chí beh iā tī chúi-goân chhiong-chiok ê thó͘-tōe. In ê ông beh pí Ko-kek khah úi-tāi; i ê kok beh heng-khí.
Siōng-tè chhōa i chhut Ai-ki̍p; ūi-tio̍h i, I hoat-chhut chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-gû ê khùi-la̍t. I beh siau-bia̍t tùi-te̍k ê kok, kòng-tn̄g in ê kut-thâu, ēng chìⁿ siā-thàng in.
I chhin-chhiūⁿ phak--teh ê sai-kang, chhin-chhiūⁿ tó--teh ê sai-bú, siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ jiá i? Chiok-hok lín--ê, goān in siū chiok-hok; chiù-chó͘ lín--ê, goān in siū chiù-chó͘.
Pa-le̍k khì-phut-phut, kûn-thâu-bú tīⁿ-ân-ân tùi Pa-lân kóng, “Góa kiò lí lâi kā góa ê tùi-te̍k chiù-chó͘, lí kèng-jiân liân-sòa saⁿ piàn lóng kā in chiok-hok.
Lí sûi-sî kā góa tńg--khì! Góa pún-lâi siūⁿ-beh hō͘ lí kàu-gia̍h ê pò-siúⁿ, m̄-kú Siōng Chú chó͘-tòng, hō͘ lí tit bōe tio̍h.”
Pa-lân tùi Pa-le̍k kóng, “Góa kiám bô tùi lí phài-khì góa hia ê sù-chiá kóng,

‘ Pa-le̍k chiū-sī kui chhù-keng ê kim-gûn hō͘ góa, góa mā m̄-káⁿ ûi-pōe Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù chòe tāi-chì. Siōng Chú ài góa kóng sím-mi̍h, góa chiū án-ni kóng.’”
Pa-lân koh tùi Pa-le̍k kóng, “Taⁿ góa beh tńg-khì góa ê kò͘-hiong. Lâi, góa kā lí kóng, chiong-lâi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ōe án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lí ê jîn-bîn.”
I chiū liām-si, kóng: Pí-ní ê kiáⁿ Pa-lân ê ū-giân, ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ chheng-chhó ê lâng ê ū-giân;
ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè ê ōe, tit-tio̍h Chì-koân-chiá ê tì-sek, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Choân-lêng-chiá ê īⁿ-siōng, phak--teh, ba̍k-chiu kim-kim ê lâng ê ū-giân:

Góa khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê, m̄-sī hiān-kim ê sū; góa koan-chhat--ê, sī chiong-lâi ê tāi-chì. Ū chi̍t lia̍p chhiⁿ tùi Ngá-kok chhut--lâi; ū chi̍t ê thóng-tī-chiá tùi Í-sek-lia̍t heng-khí. I ōe chhim-ji̍p Mô͘-ap ê pian-kài, ōe chiàm-léng Sài-te̍k ê léng-thó͘.
I beh cheng-ho̍k tùi-te̍k Í-tong, hō͘ in chiâⁿ-chòe i ê sán-gia̍p. Í-sek-lia̍t ōe jú lâi jú kiông.
Ū chi̍t ê thóng-tī-chiá ōe tùi Ngá-kok chhut--lâi; i beh châu-bia̍t siâⁿ-lāi só͘ chhun--ê.
Pa-lân koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ A-má-le̍k -lâng, chiū liām-si, kóng: A-má-le̍k sī lia̍t-kok ê thâu, m̄-kú i chòe-āu ōe bia̍t-bông.
Pa-lân koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Ki-nî -lâng, chiū liām-si, kóng: Lín khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi kian-kò͘, lín choh-siū tī soaⁿ-giâm.
M̄-kú Ki-nî ōe soe-bî, chòe-āu hō͘ A-su̍t lia̍h--khì.
Pa-lân koh liām-si, kóng: Ài ah, Siōng-tè chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng oa̍h--lo̍h-khì?
Ū chiàn-chûn tùi Ki-thê lâi, chhim-hoān A-su̍t, kong-kek Hi-pek; in mā ōe éng-oán bia̍t-bông.
Pa-lân chiū khí-sin, tò-khì i ê kò͘-hiong; Pa-le̍k mā tńg--khì.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Si̍p-têng chat-iâⁿ ê sî, jîn-bîn kap Mô͘-ap ê lú-chú kiâⁿ-îm.
Mô͘-ap ê lú-chú hiàn-chè hō͘ in ê sîn-bêng ê sî, chhiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lâi chham-ka, chia̍h in ê chè-mi̍h, kūi-pài in ê sîn-bêng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pài Pí-ní ê sîn-bêng Pa-le̍k; Siōng Chú chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoat siū-khì.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Chiong jîn-bîn só͘-ū ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, tng-thâu-pe̍h-ji̍t tī góa ê bīn-chêng kā in tiàu-sí, hō͘ góa bô koh tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoat siū-khì.”
Mô͘-se chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ kóng, “Lín ê chhin-cho̍k nā ū lâng pài Pí-ní ê Pa-le̍k, tio̍h lóng kā in thâi--sí.”

Mô͘-se kap Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng tú-á tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu teh khàu ê sî, hut-jiân ū chi̍t ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tī in ê ba̍k-chiu chêng chhōa chi̍t ê Bí-tiân ê lú-chú ji̍p-khì i ê pò͘-pîⁿ.
Chè-si A-lûn ê sun, Í-lī-a-sat ê kiáⁿ Hui-nî-hap khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū khí--lâi, lī-khui hōe-chiòng, gia̍h chhiuⁿ,
tè hit-ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ji̍p pò͘-pîⁿ, chha̍k thàng-kè hit nn̄g ê lâng ê pak-tó͘; án-ni, kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê un-e̍k chiū thêng-chí.
Hit-sî, in-ūi un-e̍k sí--ê ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se kóng,

“Chè-si A-lûn ê sun, Í-lī-a-sat ê kiáⁿ Hui-nî-hap hō͘ góa bô koh tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoat siū-khì, in-ūi i ū thé-hōe góa iau-kiû choân-chêng ho̍k-sāi góa ê sim, hō͘ góa bô kā in siau-bia̍t.
Só͘-í lí tio̍h soan-pò͘: Góa beh kap i li̍p pêng-an ê iok,
hō͘ i kap i ê hō͘-tāi éng-oán chòe chè-si, in-ūi i bô iông-ún ū jīm-hô sîn-bêng kap góa pí-phēng, koh ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sio̍k-chōe.”
Hit-ê kap Bí-tiân ê lú-chú chòe-hé siū thâi-sí ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiò-chòe Sim-lī, sī Se-biān chi-cho̍k chi̍t ê chong-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ Sat-lō͘ ê kiáⁿ.
Hit-ê hō͘ lâng thâi-sí ê Bí-tiân lú-chú kiò-chòe Ko-su-pí, sī Bí-tiân -lâng chi̍t ê chong-cho̍k ê siú-léng So͘-ní ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h khì kong-kek Bí-tiân -lâng, kā in phah-pāi;

in-ūi in tī Pí-ní ê sū-kiāⁿ kap in ê tông-pau Ko-su-pí ê tāi-chì, ēng khúi-khiat ê kè-bô͘ hām-hāi lín; Ko-su-pí sī Bí-tiân -lâng chi̍t ê siú-léng ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, i in-ūi Pí-ní ê sū-kiāⁿ tī un-e̍k liû-hêng ê sî hō͘ lâng chha̍k--sí.”
Un-e̍k kè-liáu, Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se kap chè-si A-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat kóng,
“Tio̍h chiong Í-sek-lia̍t choân-thé hōe-chiòng tiong-kan, jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng, ōe-tàng chhut-khì kau-chiàn ê ta-po͘-lâng, chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k tiám-sǹg chóng-sò͘.”

Mô͘-se kap chè-si Í-lī-a-sat chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, tī Iâ-lī-ko tùi-bīn, Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ ê Mô͘-ap pêng-goân, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-pò͘: Lín tio̍h tiám-sǹg jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng ê ta-po͘-lâng ê jîn-sò͘. Tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut--lâi ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ū:
Í-sek-lia̍t ê tōa-kiáⁿ sī Lū-piān; Lū-piān ê hō͘-tāi ū Í-lo̍k, Hoat-lō͘,
Hi-su-lûn, kap Ka-bí chiah-ê chong-cho̍k.
In keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ ū sì-bān saⁿ-chheng chhit-pah saⁿ-cha̍p miâ.
Hoat-lō͘ ê hō͘-tāi ū Í-lī-ap;

Í-lī-ap siⁿ Nî-bō͘-lī, Tāi-tan, kap A-pí-lân; Tāi-tan kap A-pí-lân sī hōe-chiòng soán-chhut ê léng-siù; Khó-la hit-tīn lâng hoán-khòng Siōng Chú ê sî, in mā chham-ú kong-kek Mô͘-se kap A-lûn.
Hit-sî tōe li̍h--khui, chiong in kap Khó-la thun-bia̍t; koh ū hé sio-sí nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p ê lâng; in chiâⁿ-chòe jîn-bîn ê kéng-kài.
M̄-kú Khó-la hiah-ê kiáⁿ bô sí.
Se-biān ê hō͘-tāi ū Nî-bō͘-lī, Ngá-bín, Ngá-kun,
Siā-la, kap Sò-lô chiah-ê chong-cho̍k,
kiōng nn̄g-bān nn̄g-chheng nn̄g-pah miâ.
Ka-tek ê hō͘-tāi ū Sé-hun, Hap-ki, Su-nî,
A-su-nî, Í-lī,
A-lu̍t, kap A-lia̍t-lī chiah-ê chong-cho̍k.
In keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ kiōng sì-bān khòng gō͘-pah miâ.
Iû-tāi ê kiáⁿ tiong-kan, Ní kap Gô-lâm sí tī Ka-lâm -tōe.
Iû-tāi kî-tha ê hō͘-tāi ū Sī-la, Hoat-le̍k-su, kap Siā-la chiah-ê chong-cho̍k.
Hoat-le̍k-su ê hō͘-tāi ū Hi-su-lûn kap Hap-bō͘-le̍k chiah-ê ka-cho̍k.
Chiah-ê sī Iû-tāi ê chong-cho̍k; in keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ kiōng chhit-bān la̍k-chheng gō͘-pah miâ.
Í-sat-ka ê hō͘-tāi ū Tô-la, Phó͘-óa,
Ngá-su̍t, kap Sin-lûn chiah-ê chong-cho̍k.
In keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ kiōng la̍k-bān sì-chheng saⁿ-pah miâ.
Se-pò͘-lûn ê hō͘-tāi ū Se-lia̍t, Í-lûn, kap Ngá-lī chiah-ê chong-cho̍k.
In keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ kiōng la̍k-bān khòng gō͘-pah miâ.
Iok-sek ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ Má-ná-se kap Í-hoat-liân, in chiâⁿ-chòe nn̄g ê chi-cho̍k.
Má-ná-se ê kiáⁿ sī Má-kiat; Má-kiat ê kiáⁿ sī Ki-lia̍t;
Ki-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi ū I-í-siā, Hi-le̍k,
A-su-lia̍t, Sī-kiàm,
Sī-bí-tāi, kap Hi-hut chiah-ê chong-cho̍k.
Hi-hut ê kiáⁿ Se-lô-hui-hap bô kiáⁿ, chí-ū cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, chiū-sī Má-la, Ná-a, Hat-la, Bi̍t-ka, Tek-sat.
Chiah-ê sī Má-ná-se ê ka-cho̍k. In keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ kiōng gō͘-bān nn̄g-chheng chhit-pah miâ.
Í-hoat-liân ê hō͘-tāi ū Su-thê-la, Pí-kiat, kap Tha-hán chiah-ê chong-cho̍k.
Su-thê-la ê hō͘-tāi ū Í-lân ka-cho̍k.
In keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ kiōng saⁿ-bān nn̄g-chheng gō͘-pah miâ. Chit nn̄g ê chi-cho̍k sī Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi.
Piān-ngá-bín ê hō͘-tāi ū Pí-la, A-si̍t-pia̍t, A-hi-lân,
Su-hoán, kap Hō͘-hoán chiah-ê chong-cho̍k.
Pí-la ê hō͘-tāi ū A-le̍k kap Nái-bān nn̄g ê chong-cho̍k.
In keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ kiōng sì-bān gō͘-chheng la̍k-pah miâ.
Tān ê hō͘-tāi ū Su-hâm chong-cho̍k.
In keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ kiōng la̍k-bān sì-chheng sì-pah miâ.
A-siat ê hō͘-tāi ū Im-ná, E̍k-si-úi, kap Pí-lī-a.
Pí-lī-a ê hō͘-tāi ū Hi-pek kap Má-kiat chiah-ê chong-cho̍k.
A-siat ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kiò-chòe Se-la.
In keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ kiōng gō͘-bān saⁿ-chheng sì-pah miâ.
Ná-hut-tha-lī ê hō͘-tāi ū Ngá-sih, Ko͘-nî,
Iâ-sek, kap Sī-léng chiah-ê chong-cho̍k.
In keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ kiōng sì-bān gō͘-chheng sì-pah miâ.
Í-siōng chiah-ê lóng sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi. In keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ kiōng la̍k-cha̍p-bān chi̍t-chheng chhit-pah saⁿ-cha̍p miâ.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se, kóng,
“Lí tio̍h chiàu kok chi-cho̍k ê jîn-sò͘ pun thó͘-tōe hō͘ in chòe sán-gia̍p.
Lâng chōe ê chi-cho̍k, pun khah-tōa ê thó͘-tōe, lâng chió ê chi-cho̍k, pun khah-sòe ê thó͘-tōe; ēng thiu-chhiam ê hong-sek pun hō͘ in.”
Lī-bī ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Kek-sūn, Ko-hat, kap Bí-la-lī. Chiàu chong-cho̍k tiám-sǹg,
Lī-bī ê hō͘-tāi ū Li̍p-nî, Hi-pek-lûn, Boat-lī, Bō͘-sī, kap Khó-la chiah-ê chong-cho̍k. Ko-hat siⁿ Àm-lân;
Àm-lân ê bó͘ kiò-chòe Iok-ki-pia̍t, sī Lī-bī tī Ai-ki̍p siⁿ ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; i tùi Àm-lân siⁿ A-lûn, Mô͘-se, kap in ê tōa-chí Bí-lī-an.
A-lûn siⁿ Ná-tap, A-pí-hō͘, Í-lī-a-sat, Í-tha-má.
Ná-tap kap A-pí-hō͘ tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng hiàn bô sîn-sèng ê hé ê sî, sí--khì.

Lī-bī -lâng móa-ge̍h í-siōng, keng-kè tiám-sǹg ê ta-po͘-lâng kiōng nn̄g-bān saⁿ-chheng miâ. Tī tiám-sǹg Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê sî, bô kā in sǹg chāi-lāi, in-ūi tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan, in bô pun-tio̍h sán-gia̍p.
Í-siōng sī Mô͘-se kap chè-si Í-lī-a-sat tī Iâ-lī-ko tùi-bīn, Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ ê Mô͘-ap pêng-goân, tiám-sǹg ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng jîn-kháu.
Mô͘-se kap chè-si A-lûn tī Se-nāi khòng-iá tē-it piàn tiám-sǹg ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, hiān-chāi bô chi̍t ê oa̍h--teh.
Koan-hē hiah-ê lâng, Siōng Chú bat kóng, “In it-tēng ōe sí tī khòng-iá.” Só͘-í, Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k, kap Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a í-gōa, hiah-ê lâng bô chi̍t ê oa̍h--teh.

Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k tiong-kan, ū Má-ná-se ê goân-sun, Má-kiat ê cheng-sun, Ki-lia̍t ê sun, Hi-hut ê kiáⁿ Se-lô-hui-hap ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, chiū-sī Má-la, Ná-a, Hat-la, Bi̍t-ka, Tek-sat;
in lâi hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, khiā tī Mô͘-se, chè-si Í-lī-a-sat, kap chèng siú-léng, í-ki̍p hōe-chiòng ê bīn-chêng, kóng,
“Goán lāu-pē sí tī khòng-iá, m̄-sī in-ūi kap Khó-la hit-tóng ê lâng tàu-tīn kong-kek Siōng Chú; sī tī ka-kī ê chōe-tiong sí; m̄-kú i bô hāu-siⁿ.
Sī-án-chóaⁿ in-ūi goán lāu-pē bô hāu-siⁿ, chiū chiong i ê miâ tùi i ê chong-cho̍k the̍h-tiāu? Chhiáⁿ tùi goán lāu-pē ê hiaⁿ-tī pun sán-gia̍p hō͘ goán.”
Mô͘-se chiū chiong in ê àn-kiāⁿ the̍h kàu Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se, kóng,
“ Se-lô-hui-hap ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kóng-liáu ū-lí; lí it-tēng tio̍h tùi in lāu-pē ê hiaⁿ-tī pun thó͘-tōe hō͘ in chòe sán-gia̍p, hō͘ in kè-sêng in lāu-pē ê sán-gia̍p.
Lí mā tio̍h hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kóng, ‘Lâng nā sí, bô hāu-siⁿ, chiū tio̍h chiong i ê sán-gia̍p pun hō͘ i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
I nā koh bô cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, chiū tio̍h chiong i ê sán-gia̍p hō͘ i ê hiaⁿ-tī.
I nā koh bô hiaⁿ-tī, chiū tio̍h chiong i ê sán-gia̍p hō͘ i ê lāu-pē ê hiaⁿ-tī.

I ê lāu-pē nā koh bô hiaⁿ-tī, chiū tio̍h chiong i ê sán-gia̍p hō͘ i ka-cho̍k ê chì-chhin kè-sêng.’” Chit-ê sī Mô͘-se chiàu Siōng Chú ê hoan-hù, beh chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí chiūⁿ A-pa-lîm-soaⁿ, khì khòaⁿ góa sù hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tōe.
Lí khòaⁿ-liáu, chiū beh kap lí ê hiaⁿ-ko A-lûn kâng-khoán, tńg-khì lí ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia.

In-ūi tī Sîm ê khòng-iá, hōe-chiòng teh kā góa chhá ê sî, lín ûi-pōe góa ê bēng-lēng; tī chhèng-chhut chúi ê só͘-chāi, hōe-chiòng ê bīn-chêng, bô chun góa chòe sèng.” (Chit-ê chúi sī chí Sîm ê khòng-iá, Ka-te-su ê Bí-lī-pa chúi-chôaⁿ.)
Mô͘-se tùi Siōng Chú kóng,
“Siōng Chú, lí sī siúⁿ-sù sìⁿ-miā hō͘ sè-kan-lâng ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí siat-li̍p chi̍t ê lâng lâi tī-lí hōe-chiòng,
tī in tiong-kan chhut-ji̍p, chhōa in kau-chiàn, hō͘ Siōng Chú ê hōe-chiòng bōe chhin-chhiūⁿ bô bo̍k-chiá ê iûⁿ-kûn.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “ Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a lāi-bīn ū Siōng-tè ê sîn, lí chhōa i lâi, kā i àn-chhiú,
hō͘ i khiā tī chè-si Í-lī-a-sat kap choân-thé hōe-chiòng ê bīn-chêng, chiong chit-chek kau-tài i.
Koh chiong lí ê chun-êng koân-pèng pun hō͘ i, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê choân-thé hōe-chiòng lóng ho̍k-chiông i.

I tio̍h khiā tī chè-si Í-lī-a-sat ê bīn-chêng, chhiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat ēng O͘-lêng ǹg Siōng Chú chhéng-sī; i kap Í-sek-lia̍t choân-thé hōe-chiòng tio̍h chiàu Í-lī-a-sat ê chí-sī chhut-ji̍p kau-chiàn.”
Mô͘-se chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chhōa Iok-su-a lâi, hō͘ i khiā tī chè-si Í-lī-a-sat kap hōe-chiòng ê bīn-chêng,
koh chiàu Siōng Chú tùi i ê bēng-lēng, kā Iok-su-a àn-chhiú, chiong chit-chek kau-tài i.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se
bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kóng, “Lín tio̍h chiàu-sî sīn-tiōng hōng-hiàn chè-mi̍h hō͘ góa, ēng hé sio, chòe góa só͘ ì-ài phang-phang ê chia̍h-mi̍h.”
Lí koh tio̍h kā in kóng, “Lín ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h hiàn nn̄g chiah bô hâ-chhû chi̍t-hè ê iûⁿ-káng-á chòe sio-hòa-chè, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú;
chá-khí-sî kap hông-hun ê sî kok hiàn chi̍t chiah.
Koh tio̍h chiong chi̍t kong-kun ê iù mī-hún kap chiⁿ--chhut-lâi chi̍t kong-seng ê kaⁿ-ná-iû chhiau chòe-hé, hiàn chòe sò͘-chè.
Che sī tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ chè-tēng, ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú phang-phang ê sio-hòa-chè.
Hiàn tē-it chiah iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, mā tio̍h tī sèng-só͘ ēng chi̍t kong-seng ê kāu-chiú chòe tiān-chiú-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.

Hông-hun hiàn lēng-gōa hit-chiah iûⁿ-á ê sî, tio̍h kap chá-khí-sî kâng-khoán hiàn sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè, lóng ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.”
“An-hioh-ji̍t tio̍h hiàn nn̄g chiah chi̍t hè bô hâ-chhû ê iûⁿ-káng-á, koh hiàn nn̄g kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chòe sò͘-chè, í-ki̍p tiān-chiú-chè.
Che sī ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa, múi chi̍t ê An-hioh-ji̍t tio̍h koh hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè.”

“Ta̍k kò-ge̍h chhoe-it, lín tio̍h hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, chiū-sī hiàn nn̄g chiah gû-káng-á, chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, chhit chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á; chiah-ê lóng tio̍h bô hâ-chhû--ê.
Hiàn gû-káng ê sî, mā tio̍h hiàn saⁿ kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chòe sò͘-chè; hiàn mî-iûⁿ-káng ê sî, mā tio̍h hiàn nn̄g kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chòe sò͘-chè.

Hiàn ta̍k-chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, mā tio̍h hiàn chi̍t kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chòe sò͘-chè. Che sī sio-hòa-chè, ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h.

Hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê sî, mā tio̍h hiàn tiān-chiú-chè: Chi̍t chiah gû-káng phòe-ha̍p nn̄g kong-seng ê chiú, chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-káng phòe-ha̍p chi̍t kong-seng-pòaⁿ ê chiú, chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng-á phòe-ha̍p chi̍t kong-seng ê chiú. Chiah-ê sī chi̍t nî tiong-kan ta̍k kò-ge̍h chhoe-it tio̍h hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè.
Tû-liáu ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa, tio̍h ēng chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.”
“Chiaⁿ-ge̍h cha̍p-sì sī Siōng Chú ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.
Chit kò-ge̍h ê cha̍p-gō͘ khí sī choeh-kî, tio̍h chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ chhit ji̍t kú.
Thâu chi̍t ji̍t tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe, jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe.
Lí tio̍h hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê nn̄g chiah gû-káng-á, chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, chhit chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á chòe sio-hòa-chè, ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.

Hiàn ta̍k-chiah gû-káng ê sî, tio̍h phòe-ha̍p saⁿ kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chòe sò͘-chè; hiàn hit-chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng ê sî, tio̍h phòe-ha̍p nn̄g kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún.
Hiàn chhit chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, ta̍k-chiah tio̍h phòe-ha̍p chi̍t kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún.
Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, kā lín sio̍k-chōe.
Lín ta̍k chá-khí hiàn sio-hòa-chè í-gōa, tio̍h koh hiàn í-siōng chiah-ê chè.
Kâng-khoán, ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa, liân-liân chhit ji̍t, tio̍h chiàu kui-lē ēng hé sio, chiong phang-phang ê chia̍h-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Tē-chhit ji̍t tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe, jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe.”

“Chhit-chhit Siu-koah-choeh, chiū-sī lín chiong chho͘-se̍k ê ngó͘-kok chòe sò͘-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú hit-ji̍t, tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe; jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe.
Lín tio̍h hiàn phang-phang ê sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, chiū-sī hiàn nn̄g chiah gû-káng-á, chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, chhit chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á.

Lín hiàn ta̍k-chiah gû-káng ê sî, tio̍h phòe-ha̍p saⁿ kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chòe sò͘-chè; hiàn hit-chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng ê sî, tio̍h phòe-ha̍p nn̄g kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún;
hiàn hit chhit chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, ta̍k-chiah tio̍h phòe-ha̍p chi̍t kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún.
Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, kā lín sio̍k-chōe.
Ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè kap sò͘-chè í-gōa, lín tio̍h hiàn chiah-ê bô hâ-chhû ê chè-mi̍h kap tiān-chiú-chè.”
“Chhit-ge̍h chhoe-it, lín tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe, jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe; che sī lín pûn sàu-kak ê ji̍t.
Lín tio̍h hiàn phang-phang ê sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, chiū-sī hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á, chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, chhit chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á.
Hiàn sò͘-chè ê sî, tio̍h ēng chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún: Chi̍t chiah gû-káng phòe-ha̍p saⁿ kong-kun, chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng phòe-ha̍p nn̄g kong-kun;
hit chhit chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng-á, ta̍k-chiah phòe-ha̍p chi̍t kong-kun.
Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè, kā lín sio̍k-chōe.

Tû-liáu ta̍k kò-ge̍h chhoe-it ê sio-hòa-chè kap chòe-hé hiàn ê sò͘-chè, í-ki̍p ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè kap sò͘-chè, í-ki̍p chiàu kui-lē hiàn ê tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa, í-siōng hiah-ê lóng tio̍h ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.”
“Chhit-ge̍h chhoe-cha̍p, lín tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe, khek-khó͘ kìm-chia̍h, jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe.
Lín tio̍h hiàn phang-phang ê sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, chiū-sī bô hâ-chhû ê chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á, chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, kap chhit chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á.
Hiàn sò͘-chè ê sî, tio̍h ēng chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún: Hiàn gû-káng ê sî, tio̍h phòe-ha̍p saⁿ kong-kun; hiàn mî-iûⁿ-káng ê sî, tio̍h phòe-ha̍p nn̄g kong-kun;
hiàn hit chhit chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, ta̍k-chiah tio̍h phòe-ha̍p chi̍t kong-kun.

Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Chiah-ê sī sio̍k-chōe-chè, ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè kap sò͘-chè, í-ki̍p tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa tio̍h hiàn ê chè.”
“Chhit-ge̍h cha̍p-gō͘, lín tio̍h kú-hêng sèng-hōe kèng-pài Siōng Chú; jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe, chhit ji̍t kú siú-choeh khèng-chiok.

Lín tio̍h hiàn sio-hòa-chè, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, chiū-sī hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê cha̍p-saⁿ chiah gû-káng-á, nn̄g chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, cha̍p-sì chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á.

Hiàn cha̍p-saⁿ chiah gû-káng-á ê sî, ta̍k-chiah tio̍h phòe-ha̍p saⁿ kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún chòe sò͘-chè; hiàn nn̄g chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng ê sî, ta̍k-chiah tio̍h phòe-ha̍p nn̄g kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún;
hiàn cha̍p-sì chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, ta̍k-chiah tio̍h phòe-ha̍p chi̍t kong-kun chhiau-iû ê iù mī-hún.
Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Chiah-ê sī ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa tio̍h hiàn ê chè.
“Tē-jī ji̍t, tio̍h hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê cha̍p-jī chiah gû-káng-á, nn̄g chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, cha̍p-sì chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á.
Hiàn gû-káng-á, mî-iûⁿ-káng, kap mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, mā tio̍h chiàu sò͘-bo̍k kap kui-lē hiàn sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè.
Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Chiah-ê sī ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa tio̍h hiàn ê chè.
“Tē-saⁿ ji̍t, tio̍h hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê cha̍p-it chiah gû-káng-á, nn̄g chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, cha̍p-sì chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á.
Hiàn gû-káng-á, mî-iûⁿ-káng, kap mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, mā tio̍h chiàu sò͘-bo̍k kap kui-lē hiàn sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè.
Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Chiah-ê sī ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa tio̍h hiàn ê chè.
“Tē-sì ji̍t, tio̍h hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê cha̍p chiah gû-káng-á, nn̄g chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, cha̍p-sì chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á.
Hiàn gû-káng-á, mî-iûⁿ-káng, kap mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, mā tio̍h chiàu sò͘-bo̍k kap kui-lē hiàn sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè.
Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Chiah-ê sī ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa tio̍h hiàn ê chè.
“Tē-gō͘ ji̍t, tio̍h hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê káu chiah gû-káng-á, nn̄g chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, cha̍p-sì chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á.
Hiàn gû-káng-á, mî-iûⁿ-káng, kap mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, mā tio̍h chiàu sò͘-bo̍k kap kui-lē hiàn sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè.
Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Chiah-ê sī ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa tio̍h hiàn ê chè.
“Tē-la̍k ji̍t, tio̍h hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê poeh chiah gû-káng-á, nn̄g chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, cha̍p-sì chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á.
Hiàn gû-káng-á, mî-iûⁿ-káng, kap mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, mā tio̍h chiàu sò͘-bo̍k kap kui-lē hiàn sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè.
Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Chiah-ê sī ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa tio̍h hiàn ê chè.
“Tē-chhit ji̍t, tio̍h hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê chhit chiah gû-káng-á, nn̄g chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, cha̍p-sì chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á.
Hiàn gû-káng-á, mî-iûⁿ-káng, kap mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, mā tio̍h chiàu sò͘-bo̍k kap kui-lē hiàn sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè.
Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Chiah-ê sī ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa tio̍h hiàn ê chè.
“Tē-poeh ji̍t, lín tio̍h kú-hêng giâm-siok-hōe, jīm-hô ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe.

Lín tio̍h hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á, chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, chhit chiah chi̍t-hè ê mî-iûⁿ-káng-á, ēng hé sio chòe phang-phang ê sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Hiàn gû-káng-á, mî-iûⁿ-káng, kap mî-iûⁿ-káng-á ê sî, mā tio̍h chiàu sò͘-bo̍k kap kui-lē hiàn sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè.
Koh tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Chiah-ê sī ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè í-gōa tio̍h hiàn ê chè.

“Í-siōng chiah-ê sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, tiān-chiú-chè, kap pêng-an-chè, lín tio̍h tī só͘ tēng ê choeh-kî hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, che sī lín chhut tī só͘ hē ê goān kap kam-sim hiàn--ê í-gōa só͘ tio̍h hiàn--ê.”
Mô͘-se chiū lóng chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Mô͘-se hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k-ê chi-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, kóng, “Chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng:
Lâng nā tùi Siōng Chú hē-goān, á-sī chiù-chōa, tio̍h iok-sok ka-kī, m̄-thang sit-sìn, tio̍h chiàu i só͘ kóng--ê khì chòe.
“Iáu tòa tī lāu-pē ê chhù ê siàu-lú, nā tùi Siōng Chú hē-goān beh iok-sok ka-kī,
i ê lāu-pē thiaⁿ-tio̍h i hē ê goān kap iok-sok ka-kī ê ōe, nā bô piáu-sī hoán-tùi, i hē ê goān kap iok-sok ka-kī ê ōe chiū sêng-li̍p.
I ê lāu-pē thiaⁿ--tio̍h hit-ji̍t, nā bô ún-chún, i hē ê goān kap iok-sok ka-kī ê ōe chiū bô sêng-li̍p; Siōng Chú ōe sià-bián i, in-ūi i ê lāu-pē bô ún-chún.
“Siàu-lú chhut-kè, nā í-keng ū hē-goān, á-sī chi̍t-sî chhiong-tōng kóng-chhut iok-sok ka-kī ê ōe,
i ê tiōng-hu thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê sî, nā bô piáu-sī hoán-tùi, i hē ê goān kap iok-sok ka-kī ê ōe chiū sêng-li̍p.
I ê tiōng-hu thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê sî, nā bô tông-ì, chiū hòe-tû i hē ê goān kap i chi̍t-sî chhiong-tōng só͘ kóng-chhut iok-sok ka-kī ê ōe; Siōng Chú mā ōe sià-bián i.
“Kóaⁿ-hū á-sī lî-hun ê hū-jîn-lâng só͘ hē ê goān kap iok-sok ka-kī ê ōe, lóng sêng-li̍p.
“Hū-jîn-lâng tī tiōng-hu ê chhù hē-goān, á-sī chiù-chōa beh iok-sok ka-kī,
tiōng-hu thiaⁿ--tio̍h, nā tiām-tiām bô kóng-ōe, bô hoán-tùi, i hē ê goān kap iok-sok ka-kī ê ōe chiū sêng-li̍p.

M̄-kú, tiōng-hu thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê sî, nā kā i hē ê goān kap iok-sok ka-kī ê ōe hòe-tû, i kóng-chhut ê ōe chiū bô-hāu, in-ūi i ê tiōng-hu hoán-tùi; Siōng Chú mā ōe sià-bián i.
I nā hē-goān á-sī chiù-chōa beh khek-khó͘ ka-kī, i ê tiōng-hu ū koân tông-ì á-sī hòe-tû.

I ê tiōng-hu thiaⁿ--tio̍h liáu-āu, kúi ji̍t kú bô piáu-sī hoán-tùi, i hē ê goān kap iok-sok ka-kī ê ōe chiū sêng-li̍p, in-ūi i ê tiōng-hu tī thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê sî tiām-tiām bô kóng-ōe.
Āu-lâi, i ê tiōng-hu nā kā i hē ê goān hòe-tû, chiū tio̍h tam-tng hū-jîn-lâng bô chiàu iok-sok ê chōe.”
Í-siōng chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se koan-hē tiōng-hu kap i ê bó͘, lāu-pē kap tòa tī i chhù--ni̍h ê siàu-lú tiong-kan só͘ tēng ê kui-lē.
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h khì kong-táⁿ Bí-tiân -lâng, thòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pò-siû; āu-lâi lí ōe tò-khì lí ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia.”
Mô͘-se chiū bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kóng, “Lín tio̍h phài lâng tòa kun-khì khì kong-táⁿ Bí-tiân -lâng, ūi Siōng Chú pò-siû.
Lín ta̍k chi-cho̍k tio̍h phài chi̍t-chheng lâng chhut-khì kau-chiàn.”
Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k chiū soán chi̍t-chheng lâng, kiōng chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng lâng, tòa kun-khì beh khì kau-chiàn.
Mô͘-se phài chè-si Í-lī-a-sat ê kiáⁿ Hui-nî-hap tòa sèng-só͘ ê khì-khū kap lat-pah, chhōa chiah-ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut-khì kau-chiàn.
In chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng, khì kap Bí-tiân -lâng kau-chiàn, chiong Bí-tiân ê ta-po͘-lâng choân-pō͘ thâi-sí,
pau-koat Í-bī, Lī-kim, So͘-ní, Hō͘-ní, Lī-pa chit gō͘ ê Bí-tiân -lâng ê ông, mā thâi-sí Pí-ní ê kiáⁿ Pa-lân.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lia̍h Bí-tiân ê hū-lú kap gín-á, chhiúⁿ in só͘-ū ê cheng-siⁿ, gû iûⁿ, kap châi-bu̍t,
pàng-hé sio in khiā-khí ê siâⁿ-tìn kap iâⁿ-tōe.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiong in lia̍h--tio̍h ê lâng, chhiúⁿ--lâi ê cheng-siⁿ, kap só͘-ū ê chiàn-lī-phín,
tòa-lâi Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ, Iâ-lī-ko tùi-hōaⁿ ê Mô͘-ap pêng-goân ê iâⁿ-tōe, kau hō͘ Mô͘-se, chè-si Í-lī-a-sat, kap Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng.
Mô͘-se kap chè-si Í-lī-a-sat, í-ki̍p hōe-chiòng só͘-ū ê siú-léng lóng khì iâⁿ-gōa gêng-chiap Í-sek-lia̍t ê pō͘-tūi.
Mô͘-se tùi kau-chiàn tńg--lâi ê kun-koaⁿ, chiū-sī hiah-ê chhōa chi̍t-chheng ê lâng kap chi̍t-pah ê lâng ê kun-koaⁿ, hoat siū-khì,
kā in kóng, “Lín beh hō͘ chiah-ê cha-bó͘-lâng oa̍h--teh sī--bô?

Lín kiám bōe-kì--tit, chiū-sī chiah-ê cha-bó͘-lâng chiàu Pa-lân ê kè-bô͘, tī Pí-ní ín-iú Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pōe-poān Siōng Chú, hō͘ un-e̍k lîm-kàu Siōng Chú ê hōe-chiòng?
Hiān-chāi, lín tio̍h kā só͘-ū ê ta-po͘ gín-á, í-ki̍p hiah-ê bat kap ta-po͘-lâng ū sèng-koan-hē ê cha-bó͘-lâng lóng thâi--sí.
Hiah-ê m̄-bat kap ta-po͘-lâng ū sèng-koan-hē ê cha-bó͘ gín-á, lín ōe-ēng-tit ūi ka-kī lâu in ê sìⁿ-miā.

Lín kap hiah-ê hu-ló͘ tio̍h lâu tī iâⁿ-gōa chhit ji̍t. Nā ū lâng thâi-sí lâng, á-sī bong-tio̍h si-thé, tio̍h tī tē-saⁿ ji̍t kap tē-chhit ji̍t kiat-chēng ka-kī; hiah-ê hu-ló͘ mā tio̍h án-ni chòe.
Lín koh tio̍h kiat-chēng ta̍k-niá saⁿ, í-ki̍p só͘-ū ēng phê, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-mn̂g, chhâ chòe ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ.”
Chè-si Í-lī-a-sat tùi kau-chiàn tò--lâi ê kun-peng kóng, “Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se ê lu̍t-hoat, ū chi̍t ê tiâu-lē án-ni kóng:

Ōe-kham-tit hé sio ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ kim, gûn, tâng, thih, siah, iân, tio̍h ēng hé kā in sio, jiân-āu koh ēng kiat-chēng ê chúi sóe, hō͘ in chheng-khì. Kî-tha bōe-kham-tit hé sio ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, tio̍h ēng chúi kiat-chēng.
Tē-chhit ji̍t, tio̍h sóe lín ê saⁿ, lín chiah chheng-khì, thang ji̍p iâⁿ-tōe.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí kap chè-si Í-lī-a-sat, í-ki̍p hōe-chiòng ê léng-siù, tio̍h kè-sǹg lia̍h--lâi ê hu-ló͘ kap chhiúⁿ--lâi ê cheng-siⁿ ê chóng-sò͘.
Kā lia̍h--lâi-ê pun-chòe nn̄g hūn, chi̍t-pòaⁿ hō͘ chhut-khì kau-chiàn ê ióng-sū, chi̍t-pòaⁿ hō͘ hōe-chiòng.
Koh tùi beh pun hō͘ kun-peng ê hu-ló͘, gû, lû, iûⁿ ê tiong-kan, múi gō͘-pah thiu chi̍t hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú;
chiong chiah-ê kau hō͘ chè-si Í-lī-a-sat, chòe te̍k-pia̍t ê lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Koh tio̍h tùi beh pun hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hit chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê hu-ló͘, gû, lû, iûⁿ, gō͘-cha̍p thiu chi̍t kau hō͘ hū-chek kò͘-siú Siōng Chú hōe-bō͘ ê Lī-bī -lâng.”
Mô͘-se kap chè-si Í-lī-a-sat chiū chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng chòe.
Kun-peng ka-kī lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê chiàn-lī-phín í-gōa, ū iûⁿ la̍k-cha̍p-chhit-bān gō͘-chheng chiah,
gû chhit-bān nn̄g-chheng chiah,
lû la̍k-bān chi̍t-chheng chiah,
m̄-bat kap ta-po͘-lâng ū sèng-koan-hē ê lú-chú saⁿ-bān nn̄g-chheng lâng.
