Chhut-khì kau-chiàn hiah-ê kun-peng tit-tio̍h hit chi̍t-pòaⁿ, kiōng ū iûⁿ saⁿ-cha̍p-saⁿ-bān chhit-chheng gō͘-pah chiah,
tùi hit tiong-kan chhú-lâi hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê, la̍k-pah chhit-cha̍p-gō͘ chiah;
gû ū saⁿ-bān la̍k-chheng chiah, kî-tiong hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê, chhit-cha̍p-jī chiah;
lû ū saⁿ-bān khòng gō͘-pah chiah, kî-tiong hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê la̍k-cha̍p-it chiah;
lâng ū chi̍t-bān la̍k-chheng ê, tùi hit tiong-kan chhú-lâi hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê saⁿ-cha̍p-jī lâng.
Mô͘-se chiàu Siōng Chú tùi i ê bēng-lēng, chiong chiah-ê kau hō͘ chè-si Í-lī-a-sat, chòe te̍k-pia̍t ê lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Mô͘-se chiong hiah-ê kun-peng chhiúⁿ--lâi ê chiàn-lī-phín pun hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê hit chi̍t-pòaⁿ,
ū iûⁿ saⁿ-cha̍p-saⁿ-bān chhit-chheng gō͘-pah chiah,
gû saⁿ-bān la̍k-chheng chiah,
lû saⁿ-bān khòng gō͘-pah chiah,
kap lâng chi̍t-bān la̍k-chheng ê.
Bô-lūn lâng á-sī cheng-siⁿ, Mô͘-se lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi i ê bēng-lēng, gō͘-cha̍p thiu chi̍t, kau hō͘ hū-chek kò͘-siú Siōng Chú hōe-bō͘ ê Lī-bī -lâng.
Chhōa chi̍t-chheng ê kap chhōa chi̍t-pah ê kun-peng ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ lâi kìⁿ Mô͘-se,
tùi i kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn í-keng tiám-sǹg chiah-ê kun-peng ê chóng-sò͘, liân chi̍t ê to bô chiàn-sí.

Taⁿ, goán chiong ta̍k-ê lâng tit--tio̍h ê kim-khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ kha-liān-á, chhiú-khoân, phah-chòe ìn-á ê chhiú-chí, hī-kau, phoa̍h-liān, lóng tòa-lâi hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, thang ūi goán ka-kī sio̍k-chōe.”
Mô͘-se kap chè-si Í-lī-a-sat chiū chiap-siū in phah-chòe ta̍k-khoán chong-sek-phín ê kim-á.
Chiah-ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú chòe te̍k-pia̍t lé-mi̍h ê kim-á, chóng-kiōng tāi-iok ū nn̄g-pah kong-kun.
Ta̍k-ê kun-peng chhiúⁿ--tio̍h ê chiàn-lī-phín, lóng kui hō͘ in ka-kī.
Mô͘-se kap chè-si Í-lī-a-sat chiong chiah-ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ hōng-hiàn ê kim-á tòa-ji̍p hōe-bō͘, hō͘ Siōng Chú put-sî ōe-kì-tit Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Lū-piān kap Ka-tek nn̄g chi-cho̍k ê cheng-siⁿ hui-siông chōe. In khòaⁿ-tio̍h Ngá-siā kap Ki-lia̍t nn̄g ê tōe-khu sek-ha̍p chhī in ê cheng-siⁿ,
chiū khì kìⁿ Mô͘-se, chè-si Í-lī-a-sat, kap hōe-chiòng ê siú-léng, kóng,

“Siōng Chú hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kong-chiàm ê A-tha-lio̍k, Tí-pún, Ngá-siā, Lêng-la, Hi-si̍t-pún, Í-lī-a-lī, Sī-pan, Nî-pho, kap Pí-ún, sī chin sek-ha̍p chhī cheng-siⁿ ê só͘-chāi. Lí ê po̍k-jîn tú-tú ū chin chōe cheng-siⁿ.”
In koh kóng, “Goán nā tit-tio̍h lí ê un-hūi, chhiáⁿ lí chiong chit-ê tōe-khu hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn chòe sán-gia̍p, hō͘ goán m̄-bián kè Iok-tàn-hô.”
Mô͘-se ìn Ka-tek kap Lū-piān ê kiáⁿ-sun kóng, “Lín kiám beh pàng lín ê hiaⁿ-tī kè-khì kau-chiàn, ka-kī lâu tiàm chia?
Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoe-sim sit-chì, m̄-káⁿ kè Iok-tàn-hô, ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú sù hō͘ in ê tōe?
Tī Ka-te-su Pa-nî-a ê sî, góa phài lín lāu-pē hit-tāi ê lâng khì thàm-cha hit-ê tōe, in mā-sī án-ni.
In khì kàu Í-si̍t-kok Soaⁿ-kok, thàm-cha chit-ê tōe liáu-āu tńg--lâi, chiū hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoe-sim sit-chì, hāi in bô beh ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú sù hō͘ in ê tōe.
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú hoat tōa siū-khì, li̍p-sè kóng,

‘Só͘-ū tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut--lâi, jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng ê lâng, it-tēng bōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa tùi A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok li̍p-sè beh sù hō͘ in ê tōe; in-ūi in bô it-sim-it-ì kun-tè góa;
chí-ū Ki-nî-sé chong-cho̍k Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k kap Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a ōe-tàng ji̍p--khì, in-ūi in it-sim-it-ì kun-tè góa.’
Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoat siū-khì, hō͘ in tī khòng-iá liû-lōng sì-cha̍p nî, thèng-hāu kàu ûi-pōe Siōng Chú hit-tāi lóng sí-liáu.
Taⁿ, lín chit-tīn chōe-jîn kèng-jiân beh sòa-chiap lín lāu-pē hit-tāi, ke-thiⁿ Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê siū-khì.
Lín nā oa̍t-cháu bô beh sūn-thàn Siōng Chú, I chiū ōe kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pàng tī khòng-iá, án-ni, lín ōe hō͘ chit-ê bîn-cho̍k lóng bia̍t-bông.”
Chit nn̄g ê chi-cho̍k ê lâng kiâⁿ-óa Mô͘-se, tùi i kóng, “Goán tī chia sī kan-ta beh ūi cheng-siⁿ tah iûⁿ-tiâu, ūi goán ê bó͘-kiáⁿ khí siâⁿ,

goán ōe gia̍h kun-khì, chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê sian-hong, chhōa in khì kàu pun hō͘ in ê tōe. Put-kò, goán ê bó͘-kiáⁿ tio̍h tòa tī kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, chiah bián siū chit só͘-chāi ê lâng chhim-hoān.
Tī só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng tit-tio̍h in ê sán-gia̍p í-chêng, goán bōe tńg-lâi goán ê chhù.
Koh goán kap in kè Iok-tàn-hô, bōe khì pun sán-gia̍p, in-ūi goán ê sán-gia̍p chiū-sī tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng.”
Mô͘-se chiū tùi in kóng, “Lín nā beh án-ni chòe, beh tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng tòa kun-khì khì kau-chiàn,
lín só͘-ū tòa kun-khì ê lâng tio̍h tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng kè Iok-tàn-hô, ti̍t-kàu Siōng Chú chiong I ê tùi-te̍k kóaⁿ--chhut-khì,

kàu I cheng-ho̍k hit-ê tōe, lín chiah thang tò--lâi. Án-ni, lín tùi Siōng Chú, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chek-jīm chiū sǹg oân-sêng, chit-tè tōe tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng chiah hō͘ lín chòe sán-gia̍p.
Lín nā bô án-ni chòe, chiū-sī tek-chōe Siōng Chú; lín tio̍h chai, lín ōe in-ūi lín ê chōe siū hêng-hoa̍t.
Taⁿ, lín thang ūi-tio̍h lín ê bó͘-kiáⁿ khí siâⁿ, ūi-tio̍h iûⁿ-kûn tah iûⁿ-tiâu, m̄-kú lín tio̍h chiàu lín só͘ kóng--ê khì chòe.”
Ka-tek kap Lū-piān nn̄g chi-cho̍k ê lâng tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn beh chiàu goán ê chú ê bēng-lēng khì chòe.
Goán ê bó͘, kiáⁿ, iûⁿ-kûn, cheng-siⁿ, lóng beh lâu tī Ki-lia̍t chiah-ê siâⁿ.
Lí ê po̍k-jîn, só͘-ū ōe tòa kun-khì khì sio-thâi--ê, lóng beh chiàu goán ê chú só͘ kóng ê ōe, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kè-hô khì kau-chiàn.”
Mô͘-se chiū ūi-tio̍h in hoan-hù chè-si Í-lī-a-sat, Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ,

kóng, “ Ka-tek kap Lū-piān nn̄g chi-cho̍k só͘-ū tòa kun-khì--ê, nā kap lín chòe-hé tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kè Iok-tàn-hô khì kau-chiàn, lín cheng-ho̍k hit-ê tōe liáu-āu, tio̍h chiong Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu hō͘ in chòe sán-gia̍p.
M̄-kú, in nā bô beh tòa kun-khì kap lín chòe-hé kè-hô, in kan-ta ōe-tàng tī Ka-lâm -tōe kap tāi-ke chòe-hé pun sán-gia̍p.”
Ka-tek kap Lū-piān nn̄g chi-cho̍k ê lâng ìn kóng, “Siōng Chú án-chóaⁿ bēng-lēng goán chiah-ê po̍k-jîn, goán chiū chiàu án-ni chòe.
Goán beh tòa kun-khì tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kè-hô ji̍p-khì Ka-lâm -tōe, m̄-kú Iok-tàn-hô chit-pêng ê tōe tio̍h hō͘ goán chòe sán-gia̍p.”

Mô͘-se chiong A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông kap Pa-san -ông Go̍k ê kok, chiū-sī in ê kok-thó͘ kap kéng-lāi ê siâⁿ, pun hō͘ Ka-tek kap Lū-piān nn̄g ê chi-cho̍k, í-ki̍p Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k.
Ka-tek ê hō͘-tāi tiông-kiàn Tí-pún, A-tha-lio̍k, A-lô-ní,
A-tha-lio̍k Sok-hoán, Ngá-siā, Iok-pí-hap,
Pek Lêng-la, Pek Hap-lân chiah-ê kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, koh khí iûⁿ-tiâu.
Lū-piān ê hō͘-tāi tiông-kiàn Hi-si̍t-pún, Í-lī-a-lī, Ki-lia̍t-têng,
Nî-pho, Pa-le̍k Bián (chit nn̄g ê siâⁿ ê miâ ū kái--kè), kap Se-pí-má. In kā chiah-ê tiông-kiàn ê siâⁿ hō sin ê miâ.
Má-ná-se ê kiáⁿ Má-kiat ê hō͘-tāi khì Ki-lia̍t, chiàm-léng hit-ê tōe-khu, chiong goân-lâi tòa tī hia ê A-mô͘-lī -lâng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.
Mô͘-se chiū chiong Ki-lia̍t hō͘ Má-ná-se ê hō͘-tāi Má-kiat chong-cho̍k; in chiū tī hia khiā-khí.
Má-ná-se ê hō͘-tāi Gâi-ní khì kong-chhú Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu ê chng-siā, kā hiah-ê chng-siā hō-chòe Hap-o-te̍k Gâi-ní.
Ná-pa kong-chiàm Ki-la̍p kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā; ēng ka-kī ê miâ kā hit-ê só͘-chāi hō-chòe Ná-pa.
Ē-bīn sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Mô͘-se kap A-lûn ê léng-tō hā, chiàu kun-tūi ê chhù-sū, chhut Ai-ki̍p liáu-āu só͘ kiâⁿ ê lō͘-thêng.
Mô͘-se chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, chiong in ta̍k-chām hêng-thêng ê khí-tiám kì-lio̍k--lo̍h-lâi, í-hā sī hêng-thêng ê khí-tiám:
Chiaⁿ-ge̍h cha̍p-gō͘, Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh keh-ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Lân-sài khí-thêng, tī Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê bīn-chêng ióng-kám bô-kiaⁿ kiâⁿ--chhut-khì.
Hit-sî Ai-ki̍p -lâng tú-teh bâi-chòng in hō͘ Siōng Chú phah-sí ê tōa-kiáⁿ; Siōng Chú mā sím-phòaⁿ Ai-ki̍p ê sîn-bêng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Lân-sài chhut-hoat, tī So͘-kat chat-iâⁿ.
Tùi So͘-kat chhut-hoat, tī khòng-iá pian-kài ê Í-thóng chat-iâⁿ.
Tùi Í-thóng chhut-hoat, oat-khì Pa-le̍k Sé-hun tang-pêng ê Pí Hap-hi-lio̍k, tī Bi̍t-toa̍t ê tùi-bīn chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Pí Hap-hi-lio̍k khí-thêng, keng-kè Âng-hái, chìn-ji̍p khòng-iá; tī Í-thóng ê khòng-iá kiâⁿ saⁿ ji̍t, chiū tī Má-la chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Má-la chhut-hoat, lâi kàu Í-lîm; hia ū cha̍p-jī ê chúi-chôaⁿ, chhit-cha̍p châng chang-chhiū; chiū tī hia chat-iâⁿ.
In lī-khui Í-lîm í-āu, tī Âng-hái hù-kūn chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Âng-hái hù-kūn chhut-hoat, tī Sìn ê khòng-iá chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Sìn ê khòng-iá chhut-hoat, tī Thoat-ka chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Thoat-ka chhut-hoat, tī A-lio̍k chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi A-lio̍k chhut-hoat, tī Lī-hui-tèng chat-iâⁿ; tī hia in bô chúi thang lim.
In tùi Lī-hui-tèng chhut-hoat, tī Se-nāi khòng-iá chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Se-nāi khòng-iá chhut-hoat, tī Ki-phok-lô Hap-tha-óa chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Ki-phok-lô Hap-tha-óa chhut-hoat, tī Hap-sé-lio̍k chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Hap-sé-lio̍k chhut-hoat, tī Lī-thê-má chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Lī-thê-má chhut-hoat, tī Lîm-bûn Phà-lia̍t chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Lîm-bûn Phà-lia̍t chhut-hoat, tī Li̍p-ná chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Li̍p-ná chhut-hoat, tī Le̍k-sat chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Le̍k-sat chhut-hoat, tī Ki-hi-la-tha chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Ki-hi-la-tha chhut-hoat, tī Sa-húi-soaⁿ chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Sa-húi-soaⁿ chhut-hoat, tī Hap-la-tāi chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Hap-la-tāi chhut-hoat, tī Má-kiat-hi-lio̍k chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Má-kiat-hi-lio̍k chhut-hoat, tī Tha-hap chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Tha-hap chhut-hoat, tī Tha-la chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Tha-la chhut-hoat, tī Bi̍t-ka chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Bi̍t-ka chhut-hoat, tī Hap-mô͘-ná chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Hap-mô͘-ná chhut-hoat, tī Mô͘-se-lio̍k chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Mô͘-se-lio̍k chhut-hoat, tī Pí-nî A-kan chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Pí-nî A-kan chhut-hoat, tī Hat Hap-ki̍p-kah chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Hat Hap-ki̍p-kah chhut-hoat, tī Iok-pa-tha chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Iok-pa-tha chhut-hoat, tī A-phok-ná chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi A-phok-ná chhut-hoat, tī Í-sûn Ka-pia̍t chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Í-sûn Ka-pia̍t chhut-hoat, tī Sîm ê khòng-iá, chiū-sī Ka-te-su, chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Ka-te-su chhut-hoat, tī Í-tong tōe-khu ê pian-kài Hô-ní-soaⁿ chat-iâⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p liáu-āu tē-sì-cha̍p nî gō͘-ge̍h chhoe-it, chè-si A-lûn chiàu Siōng Chú ê chí-sī, chiūⁿ Hô-ní-soaⁿ, sí tī hia.
A-lûn sí tī Hô-ní-soaⁿ ê sî, sī chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-saⁿ hè.
Tòa tī Ka-lâm -tōe Nî-kek-hu ê Ka-lâm -lâng A-la-tek -ông thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lâi lah.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Hô-ní-soaⁿ chhut-hoat, tī Sat-mô͘-ná chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Sat-mô͘-ná chhut-hoat, tī Phó͘-lūn chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Phó͘-lūn chhut-hoat, tī O-pek chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi O-pek chhut-hoat, tī Mô͘-ap pian-kài ê Í-iâ A-pa-lîm chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Í-iâ A-pa-lîm chhut-hoat, tī Tí-pún Ka-tek chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi Tí-pún Ka-tek chhut-hoat, tī A-bûn Te-pí-la-thài-im chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi A-bûn Te-pí-la-thài-im chhut-hoat, tī Nî-pho-soaⁿ tùi-bīn ê A-pa-lîm-soaⁿ chat-iâⁿ.
In tùi A-pa-lîm-soaⁿ chhut-hoat, tī Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ, Iâ-lī-ko tùi-bīn ê Mô͘-ap pêng-goân chat-iâⁿ.
In tī Mô͘-ap pêng-goân, sūn Iok-tàn-hô, tùi Pek Iâ-se-boa̍t kàu A-pek Si̍p-têng ê tiong-kan chat-iâⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ, Iâ-lī-ko tùi-bīn ê Mô͘-ap pêng-goân ê sî, Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng: Lín kè Iok-tàn-hô chìn-ji̍p Ka-lâm -tōe ê sî,
tio̍h chiong hit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn lóng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, húi-hoāi in só͘-ū ēng chio̍h-thâu tiau-khek kap ēng kim-sio̍k chù ê sîn-siōng, thiah-húi in it-chhè ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ.
Lín tio̍h chiàm-léng hit-ê tōe, tòa hia khiā-khí, in-ūi góa í-keng chiong chit-ê tōe sù hō͘ lín chòe sán-gia̍p.

Lín tio̍h chiàu chong-cho̍k thiu-chhiam hun-phòe thó͘-tōe chòe sán-gia̍p; lâng chōe--ê chiū pun khah chōe, lâng chió--ê chiū pun khah chió; khòaⁿ tó chi̍t ê chong-cho̍k pun-tio̍h tó-ūi, hit-ê tōe chiū kui hō͘ hit-ê chong-cho̍k chòe sán-gia̍p.

Lín nā bô chiong hit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, hiah-ê lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê chū-bîn chiū ōe chiâⁿ-chòe lín ba̍k-chiu lāi ê chhì, hia̍p-ē ê chhì-phè, koh ōe tī lín khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi kā lín jiáu-loān;
góa án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi in, mā ōe án-ni tùi-thāi lín.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tùi in kóng: Lín chìn-ji̍p góa sù hō͘ lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê Ka-lâm -tōe í-āu, lín ê tōe-kài sī án-ni:
Lín lâm-pêng ê tōe-kài sī tùi Sîm ê khòng-iá, sūn Í-tong ê pian-kài, chiū-sī tùi Iâm-hái tang-pêng ê chīn-thâu,
se̍h-kè A-khek-la-pin -kiā ê lâm-pêng, keng-kè Sîm thàng kàu Ka-te-su Pa-nî-a ê lâm-pêng, koh ǹg sai-pak kàu Hap-sat A-ta̍t, jiân-āu khì kàu Ap-bûn,
tùi Ap-bûn choán-ǹg Ai-ki̍p pian-kài ê khoe-kok kàu Tōe-tiong-hái ûi-chí.
“Sai-pêng ê tōe-kài sī Tōe-tiong-hái.
“Pak-pêng ê tōe-kài tùi Tōe-tiong-hái khai-sí ōe kài-sòaⁿ, ōe kàu Hô-ní-soaⁿ,
koh kàu Hap-má ài-kháu, thàng kàu Se-ta̍t-ta̍t
kap Se-húi-lûn, kàu Hap-sat Í-lân ûi-chí.
“Tang-pêng ê tōe-kài tùi Hap-sat Í-lân khai-sí, ōe kàu Sī-hoan,
jiân-āu lo̍h-khì kàu A-in tang-pêng ê Lī-pí-la, koh sòa kàu Ka-lī-lī-ô͘ ê tang-pêng,
sūn Iok-tàn-hô, thàng kàu Iâm-hái ûi-chí. “Í-siōng chiū-sī lín ê léng-thó͘ sì pêng ê tōe-kài.”
Mô͘-se koh bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Che chiū-sī lín beh thiu-chhiam pun-chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe, mā-sī Siōng Chú bēng-lēng beh hō͘ lín káu-ê-pòaⁿ ê chi-cho̍k ê tōe.

Lū-piān kap Ka-tek nn̄g ê chi-cho̍k, í-ki̍p Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k í-keng chiàu chong-cho̍k hun-phòe, tit-tio̍h Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng, Iâ-lī-ko tùi-bīn hōaⁿ ê thó͘-tōe chòe sán-gia̍p.”
Siōng Chú koh tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Chiah-ê sī beh kā lín pun thó͘-tōe chòe sán-gia̍p ê lâng: Chè-si Í-lī-a-sat kap Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a;
lēng-gōa, lín tio̍h tùi ta̍k chi-cho̍k kéng chi̍t ê léng-siù, hia̍p-chō͘ in hun-phòe thó͘-tōe.
Chiah-ê léng-siù sī: Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k,
Se-biān chi-cho̍k A-bí-hut ê kiáⁿ Sat-bó-ní,
Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k Ki-su-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-ta̍t,
Tān chi-cho̍k Iok-lī ê kiáⁿ Pò͘-ki,
Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k Í-hut ê kiáⁿ Hàn-nî-gia̍p,
Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k Si̍p-hut-tān ê kiáⁿ Ki-bō͘-lī,
Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k Phà-la̍p ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-sat-hoán,
Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k A-sàn ê kiáⁿ Phà-thiat,
A-siat chi-cho̍k Sī-lô-bí ê kiáⁿ A-hi-hut,
Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k A-bí-hut ê kiáⁿ Pí-tāi-hek.”
Í-siōng chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú jīm-bēng chiong Ka-lâm -tōe pun hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe sán-gia̍p ê léng-siù.
Siōng Chú tī Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ, Iâ-lī-ko tùi-bīn ê Mô͘-ap pêng-goân tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tùi in tit--tio̍h ê sán-gia̍p pun kúi ê siâⁿ-tìn í-ki̍p chiu-ûi ê chháu-po͘ hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng.
Hiah-ê siâⁿ-tìn beh hō͘ in khiā-khí, chháu-po͘ beh hō͘ in chhī gû, iûⁿ, cheng-siⁿ, kap in só͘-ū ê tōng-bu̍t.
Lín hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng ê chháu-po͘, sī tùi siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ niû khí, ǹg gōa niû sì-pah gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh;

chiū-sī ēng siâⁿ chòe tiong-sim, tang sai lâm pak ta̍k-pêng kok ū káu-pah kong-chhioh ê sì-kak-hêng khu-he̍k; siâⁿ-tìn chiu-ûi ê tōe beh hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng chòe chhī cheng-siⁿ ê só͘-chāi.

Lín hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng ê siâⁿ-tìn tiong-kan, tio̍h siat-li̍p la̍k ê chòe pī-lān-siâⁿ, hō͘ thâi-sí-lâng--ê ōe-tàng tô-lān khì hia. Chit la̍k ê siâⁿ-tìn í-gōa, lín tio̍h koh hō͘ in sì-cha̍p-jī ê siâⁿ-tìn.
Lín tio̍h hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng sì-cha̍p-poeh ê siâⁿ-tìn, pau-koat in chiu-ûi ê chháu-po͘ lóng tio̍h hō͘ in.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi sán-gia̍p ê tiong-kan pun hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng ê siâⁿ-tìn, thó͘-tōe tōa ê chi-cho̍k chiū chhut khah chōe, thó͘-tōe sió ê chi-cho̍k chiū chhut khah chió; ta̍k chi-cho̍k chiàu ka-kī tit--tio̍h sán-gia̍p ê chōe-chió, chiong siâⁿ-tìn pun hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng.”
Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng,
“Lí tio̍h án-ni bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng: Lín kè Iok-tàn-hô, chìn-ji̍p Ka-lâm -tōe,
tio̍h chí-tēng kúi ê siâⁿ chòe pī-lān-siâⁿ, hō͘ gō͘-sat-lâng--ê thang cháu-khì hia.
Chiah-ê siâⁿ thang chòe lín tô-pī pò oan-siû ê lâng ê siâⁿ, hō͘ gō͘-sat-lâng--ê tī hōe-chiòng bīn-chêng siū sím-phòaⁿ í-chêng, bōe hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.
Lín tio̍h chí-tēng la̍k chō siâⁿ chòe pī-lān-siâⁿ;
Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng saⁿ chō, Ka-lâm -tōe saⁿ chō.
Chit la̍k chō siâⁿ beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kap chiām-sî á-sī tn̂g-kî tòa tī in tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, chòe pī-lān-siâⁿ, hō͘ gō͘-sat-lâng--ê thang tô-cháu khì hia.
“Nā ū lâng ēng thih-khì kā lâng phah-sí, i chiū-sī kò͘-ì thâi-lâng; kò͘-ì thâi lâng--ê, it-tēng tio̍h kā i chhú-sí.
Nā ū lâng ēng ōe hō͘ lâng sí ê chio̍h-thâu phah-sí lâng, i chiū-sī kò͘-ì hoān-chōe; kò͘-ì phah-sí lâng--ê, it-tēng tio̍h kā i chhú-sí.
Nā the̍h ōe hō͘ lâng sí ê chhâ-khì kā lâng phah-sí, i chiū-sī kò͘-ì phah-sí lâng; kò͘-ì phah-sí lâng--ê, it-tēng tio̍h kā i chhú-sí.
Hō͘ lâng phah--sí hit-ê lâng ê chì-chhin tio̍h chhin-sin kā hiong-siú thâi--sí; chi̍t-ē tú-tio̍h i, chiū thang hō͘ i sí.
“Nā ū lâng in-ūi oàn-hūn lâng kā lâng chhia-tó, á-sī kò͘-ì ēng mi̍h-kiāⁿ kā lâng tìm, hō͘ hit-ê lâng sí;

á-sī in-ūi khioh-hūn ēng chhiú kā lâng phah-sí, i chiū-sī kò͘-ì phah-sí lâng; kò͘-ì phah-sí lâng--ê it-tēng tio̍h kā i chhú-sí. Hō͘ lâng phah--sí hit-ê lâng ê chì-chhin chi̍t-ē tú-tio̍h hiong-siú, chiū thang hō͘ i sí.
“M̄-kú, nā ū lâng bô-ì-tiong kā lâng chhia-tó, á-sī ēng mi̍h-kiāⁿ tìm-tio̍h lâng,
á-sī tī bô khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê sî, á-sī kap tùi-hong bô oan-siû, mā bô ì-sù beh hāi-sí tùi-hong, m̄-kú soah ēng ōe hō͘ lâng sí ê chio̍h-thâu kā lâng tìm-sí,
hōe-chiòng tio̍h chiàu kui-lē, tī phah-sí-lâng--ê kap pò oan-siû--ê tiong-kan sím-phòaⁿ.

Hōe-chiòng tio̍h kiù hit-ê gō͘-sat-lâng--ê thoat-lī sí-chiá ê chì-chhin, kā i sàng tò-khì i cháu-khì bih ê pī-lān-siâⁿ, tī siū boah-iû siat-li̍p ê tōa-chè-si sí í-chêng hō͘ i tòa tī hia.
M̄-kú gō͘-sat-lâng--ê it-tàn lī-khui pī-lān-siâⁿ,
hō͘ lâng phah--sí hit-ê lâng ê chì-chhin nā tī siâⁿ-gōa tú-tio̍h i, kā i phah-sí, bô sǹg ū-chōe.
In-ūi hit-ê gō͘-sat-lâng--ê tio̍h tī tōa-chè-si sí í-chêng, lóng tòa tī pī-lān-siâⁿ. Tōa-chè-si sí í-āu, i chiah thang tńg-khì i ka-kī ke-gia̍p ê tōe.
Bô-lūn lín tòa tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, che beh chòe lín sè-sè-tāi-tāi éng-oán ê kui-lē.

“Nā ū lâng siū khòng-kò thâi-sí lâng, tio̍h ū nn̄g ê í-siōng ê chèng-jîn choh-chèng, chiah thang kā i chhú-sí; nā chí-ū chi̍t ê chèng-jîn, m̄-thang kā i soan-phòaⁿ sí-chōe.
Phòaⁿ sí-chōe ê hiong-siú bōe-ēng-tit ēng sio̍k-kim sio̍k-hôe sìⁿ-miā; it-tēng tio̍h kā i chhú-sí.
Nā ū lâng cháu-khì pī-lān-siâⁿ, bōe-ēng-tit siu sio̍k-kim hō͘ i tī tōa-chè-si sí í-chêng tò-khì i ê pún-tōe khiā-khí.

Lín m̄-thang phah lâ-sâm lín khiā-khí ê tōe; in-ūi lâu lâng ê huih chiū-sī phah lâ-sâm thó͘-tōe. Nā ū lâng thâi-sí lâng, tio̍h ēng i ê miā pê miā lâu i ê huih, hit-ê tōe chiah ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h kiat-chēng.
Lín m̄-thang phah lâ-sâm lín khiā-khí ê thó͘-tōe, in-ūi góa Siōng Chú mā tiàm tī chit-ê tōe, tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan.”
Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi, Má-ná-se ê sun Má-kiat ê kiáⁿ, Ki-lia̍t chong-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ lâi kìⁿ Mô͘-se kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ta̍k chong-cho̍k ê léng-siù,

kóng, “Siōng Chú ū bēng-lēng góa ê chú ēng thiu-chhiam ê hong-sek pun thó͘-tōe hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe sán-gia̍p, góa ê chú mā chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chiong goán ê chhin-cho̍k Se-lô-hui-hap ê ke-gia̍p pun hō͘ i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.

M̄-kú in nā kè hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t pa̍t chi-cho̍k ê lâng, in ê ke-gia̍p chiū ōe tùi goán chó͘-kong ê sán-gia̍p poah-kè hō͘ in ê tiōng-hu hit-pêng ê chi-cho̍k, án-ni goán thiu--tio̍h ê sán-gia̍p chiū ōe kiám-chió.
Kàu Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng Un-hūi ê Nî, chiah-ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ê ke-gia̍p chiū ōe ke tī in ê tiōng-hu hit-pêng ê chi-cho̍k; goán chó͘-kong chi-cho̍k ê sán-gia̍p chiū kiám-chió.”
Mô͘-se chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “ Iok-sek hō͘-tāi ê chi-cho̍k kóng-liáu ū-lí.
Koan-hē Se-lô-hui-hap ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, Siōng Chú án-ni hoan-hù: In thang soán-te̍k in kah-ì ê lâng, m̄-kú tio̍h kè hō͘ kâng chi-cho̍k, kâng chong-cho̍k ê lâng.

Án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê sán-gia̍p chiū bōe tùi chit-ê chi-cho̍k poah-khì hō͘ pa̍t-ê chi-cho̍k. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ta̍k-ê tio̍h siú-tiâu in ka-kī chó͘-sian chi-cho̍k ê sán-gia̍p.
Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k só͘-ū kè-sêng sán-gia̍p ê lú-chú, tio̍h kè hō͘ kâng chi-cho̍k ê lâng, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ōe-tàng kè-sêng in chó͘-sian ê sán-gia̍p.
Án-ni, sán-gia̍p chiah bōe tùi chit-cho̍k choán-khì pa̍t-ê chi-cho̍k; Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê lâng tio̍h siú-tiâu in ka-kī ê sán-gia̍p.”
Se-lô-hui-hap gō͘ ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, Má-la, Tek-sat, Hat-la, Bi̍t-ka kap Ná-a, lóng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng chòe, kè hō͘ in ê chek-peh hiaⁿ-tī.
In lóng kè hō͘ Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi, Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k ê ka-têng; in ê ke-gia̍p lâu tī in lāu-pē ê chong-cho̍k lāi-bīn.
Í-siōng sī Siōng Chú tī Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ, Iâ-lī-ko tùi-bīn ê Mô͘-ap pêng-goân, thong-kè Mô͘-se hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bēng-lēng kap kui-lē.

Ē-bīn sī Mô͘-se tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng ê khòng-iá, So͘-hut tùi-bīn ê A-la-pa, chiū-sī tī Pa-lân kap Tô-hut, La-pan, Hap-sé-lio̍k, Tí-sat-hap ê tiong-kan, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn kóng ê ōe.
Tùi Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ keng-kè Se-ní-soaⁿ kàu Ka-te-su Pa-nî-a, su-iàu cha̍p-it ji̍t ê lō͘-thêng.
Tī chhut Ai-ki̍p liáu-āu tē-sì-cha̍p nî, cha̍p-it-ge̍h chhoe-it, Mô͘-se chiong Siōng Chú kau-tài i tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘-ū ê bēng-lēng, lóng kā in kóng.
Hit-sî, Mô͘-se í-keng thâi-iâⁿ tòa tī Hi-si̍t-pún ê A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông, kap tòa tī Í-tek-lâi, A-su-tha-lio̍k ê Pa-san -ông Go̍k.
Mô͘-se tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng ê Mô͘-ap -tōe, khai-sí káng-kái Siōng Chú ê lu̍t-hoat, kóng:
Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè tī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ kā lán hoan-hù kóng, “Lín tī chit-ê soaⁿ í-keng tòa ū-kàu kú ah;

tio̍h khí-sin oat-khì A-mô͘-lī ê soaⁿ-tōe, í-ki̍p hit hù-kūn ê A-la-pa, soaⁿ-tōe, soaⁿ-po͘, Nî-kek-hu, Tōe-tiong-hái iân-hái it-tài, Ka-lâm -lâng ê tōe-khu, kap Lê-pa-lūn, ti̍t-kàu Tōa-hô, chiū-sī Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô.

Taⁿ, góa chiong chit-ê tōe sù hō͘ lín, lín tio̍h ji̍p-khì sêng-chiap; chit-ê tōe sī Siōng Chú tùi lín ê chó͘-sian, A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok li̍p-sè èng-ún, beh siúⁿ-sù in kap in ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun ê thó͘-tōe.”
Hit-sî, góa ū kā lín kóng, “Koán-lí lín ê chek-jīm, góa ka-kī chi̍t ê tam-tng bōe khí.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè hō͘ lín jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ, kàu kin-á-ji̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ hiah chōe.
Goān Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè chiàu I tùi lín ê èng-ún sù-hok lín, hō͘ lín ê jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ chheng pē.
Koán-lí lín ê tāng-tàⁿ kap chek-jīm, í-ki̍p chhú-lí lín ê sò͘-siōng, góa ka-kī chi̍t ê ná tam-tng ōe khí?
Lín tio̍h tùi ta̍k chi-cho̍k kéng ū tì-hūi, ū châi-lêng, ū keng-giām ê lâng, góa chiū siat-li̍p in chòe lín ê léng-siù.”
Lín ìn góa kóng, “Lí kóng beh chòe ê tāi-chì chin hó.”

Góa chiū chiong lín ta̍k chi-cho̍k soán--chhut-lâi ū tì-hūi, ū keng-giām ê lâng, siat-li̍p in chòe koán-lí lín ê léng-siù, ū-ê koán chi̍t-chheng lâng, ū-ê koán chi̍t-pah lâng, ū-ê koán gō͘-cha̍p lâng, ū-ê koán cha̍p lâng, koh siat-li̍p kî-tha ê koaⁿ-oân.

Tng-sî góa hoan-hù lín ê sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, kóng, “Lín chhâi-koat sio-kò ê sū, bô-lūn sī tông-pau tiong-kan ê àn-kiāⁿ, á-sī kap tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng ê àn-kiāⁿ, tio̍h chiàu kong-tō phòaⁿ-koat.

Lín chhâi-koat ê sî, m̄-thang phian-thán, sio-kò ê lâng bô-lūn sī chun-kùi á-sī pi-bî lóng tio̍h kong-pêng tùi-thāi. M̄-thang kiaⁿ jīm-hô-lâng, in-ūi lín sī thòe Siōng-tè sím-phòaⁿ. Khùn-lân kái-koat ê àn-kiāⁿ, tio̍h sàng-lâi góa chia, góa ōe chhâi-koat.”
Hit-sî, góa mā chiong lín eng-kai chòe ê sū lóng kā lín hoan-hù.

Lán chiàu Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, tùi Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ chhut-hoat, keng-kè lín só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h hit-ê khoah koh thang-kiaⁿ ê khòng-iá, kiâⁿ ǹg A-mô͘-lī -lâng ê soaⁿ-khu. Lán kàu Ka-te-su Pa-nî-a ê sî,
góa kā lín kóng, “Lín í-keng kàu Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù hō͘ lán ê A-mô͘-lī -lâng ê soaⁿ-tōe.

Taⁿ, Siōng Chú í-keng chiong hit-ê tōe sù hō͘ lín, lín tio̍h chiàu Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè tùi lín ê èng-ún, chiūⁿ-khì sêng-chiap hit-ê tōe; m̄-thang kiaⁿ, m̄-thang lún.”

Hit-sî lín lóng lâi góa chia, kā góa kóng, “Lán tio̍h phài lâng seng khì thàm-cha hit-ê tōe, kā lán pò-kò, khòaⁿ lán tio̍h tùi tó chi̍t tiâu lō͘, tó chi̍t ê siâⁿ ji̍p--khì.”
Góa khòaⁿ án-ni chòe chin hó, chiū tùi lín tiong-kan kéng cha̍p-jī ê lâng, múi chi̍t chi-cho̍k chi̍t ê.
In chiū chhut-hoat chiūⁿ soaⁿ-khu, khì Í-si̍t-kok Soaⁿ-kok thàm-cha.
In tòa hit só͘-chāi ê ké-chí tńg-lâi lán chia, kā lán pò-kò, kóng, “Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù hō͘ lán--ê, sī chin súi ê tōe.”
M̄-kú lín ûi-pōe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, m̄-khéng ji̍p-khì hit-ê tōe,
koh tī lín ê pò͘-pîⁿ lāi bâi-oàn kóng, “In-ūi Siōng Chú oàn-hūn lán, só͘-í chhōa lán chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe, beh chiong lán kau hō͘ A-mô͘-lī -lâng, kā lán châu-bia̍t.

Taⁿ lán sī beh khì sím-mi̍h khoán só͘-chāi? Lán ê hiaⁿ-tī hō͘ lán sit-chì; in kā lán kóng, ‘Hia ê jîn-bîn pí lán khah ióng khah lò, siâⁿ khoah-tōa koh kian-kò͘, koân kàu tú-thiⁿ; goán koh tī hia khòaⁿ-tio̍h A-la̍p -cho̍k ê lâng.’”
Góa chiū kā lín kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ, mā m̄-bián lún in.
Kiâⁿ tī lín thâu-chêng ê Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe ūi lín kau-chiàn, chhin-chhiūⁿ I tī Ai-ki̍p ūi-tio̍h lín só͘ chòe--ê kâng-khoán.

Lín tī khòng-iá teh kiâⁿ ê sî, ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè án-chóaⁿ kā lín iúⁿ-chhī chiàu-kò͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng teh ióng-io̍k kiáⁿ-jî, ti̍t-kàu lín lâi kàu chit-ê só͘-chāi.”
Sui-jiân án-ni, lín m̄ sìn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè;
I chi̍t-lō͘ kiâⁿ tī lín ê thâu-chêng, kā lín chhē an-iâⁿ ê só͘-chāi; mî--sî ēng hé, ji̍t--sî ēng hûn, chí-sī lín tio̍h kiâⁿ ê lō͘.
Siōng Chú thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín bâi-oàn ê siaⁿ chiū siū-khì, li̍p-sè kóng,
“Chit-ê pháiⁿ sè-tāi ê lâng choa̍t-tùi bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa só͘ li̍p-sè èng-ún siúⁿ-sù lín lia̍t-chó͘ chit-tè súi ê tōe;
chí-ū Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k ōe-tàng khòaⁿ--tio̍h; koh góa beh chiong i ta̍h--kè ê tōe sù hō͘ i kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun, in-ūi i choan-sim sìn-khò Siōng Chú.”
Siōng Chú mā in-ūi lín ê iân-kò͘ tùi góa siū-khì, kóng, “Lí mā bōe-tàng ji̍p-khì hit-tè thó͘-tōe;
kun-sûi lí ê Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a ōe ji̍p--khì; lí tio̍h kā i kó͘-lē, in-ūi i beh chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ji̍p-khì sêng-chiap hit-ê tōe.”

Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Lín ê gín-á, chiū-sī lín teh siūⁿ ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì, kin-á-ji̍t iáu bōe-hiáu hun-pia̍t hó-pháiⁿ ê kiáⁿ-jî, ōe ji̍p-khì hia; góa beh chiong hit-ê tōe sù hō͘ in chòe sán-gia̍p.
Lín leh, lín tio̍h oa̍t tò-tńg, ǹg Âng-hái ê hong-hiòng khì khòng-iá.”

Lín hôe-tap góa, kóng, “Goán ū tek-chōe Siōng Chú; taⁿ goán beh chiàu Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng chiūⁿ-khì kau-chiàn.” Lín ta̍k-ê lâng chiū tōa-chú-tōa-ì, tòa kun-khì chiūⁿ-khì soaⁿ-khu.
Siōng Chú kā góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h kiò in m̄-thang chhut--khì, m̄-thang khì kau-chiàn, in-ūi góa bô kap lín tông-chāi, chiah bián lín thâi-su tùi-te̍k.”
Góa chiū kā lín kóng, m̄-kú lín m̄ thiaⁿ, pōe-ge̍k Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, tōa-chú-tōa-ì peh-chiūⁿ soaⁿ-khu.
Tòa tī hia ê A-mô͘-lī -lâng chiū chhut-lâi kong-kek lín, chhin-chhiūⁿ phang kā lín tui-kóaⁿ, tī Í-tong soaⁿ-khu ê Hô-ní-má kā lín phah-pāi.
Lín chiū koh tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng thî-khàu, m̄-kú Siōng Chú m̄ thiaⁿ lín ê siaⁿ, bô beh chhap lín.
Lín chiū tī Ka-te-su tòa chi̍t tōaⁿ chin kú ê sî-kan.
Āu-lâi, lán oa̍t tò-tńg, chiàu Siōng Chú tùi góa ê bēng-lēng, ǹg Âng-hái ê hong-hiòng khì khòng-iá; lán se̍h Se-ní-soaⁿ chin chōe ji̍t.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Lín í-keng se̍h chit-ê soaⁿ-khu chin kú lah, tio̍h oat tùi pak-pêng khì.
Lí tio̍h hoan-hù jîn-bîn kóng, ‘Lín ê hiaⁿ-tī Í-sò ê hō͘-tāi tòa tī Í-tong; lín beh keng-kè in ê kéng-kài, in ōe kiaⁿ lín, só͘-í lín tio̍h hui-siông kín-sīn.
M̄-thang jiá in; in ê tōe liân kha ōe-tàng ta̍h hiah-ni̍h sòe ê ūi góa to bô beh hō͘ lín, in-ūi góa í-keng chiong Í-tong hō͘ Í-sò chòe ke-gia̍p.
Lín tio̍h ēng gûn kā in bóe niû-si̍t lâi chia̍h, bóe chúi lâi lim.’”

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tī lín chòe ê ta̍k-hāng sū lóng sù-hok lín; lín kiâⁿ chit-ê khoah-tōa ê khòng-iá, I lóng kā lín khòaⁿ-kò͘; chit sì-cha̍p nî, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kap lín tông-chāi, lín lóng bô khiàm-kheh sím-mi̍h.

Só͘-í, lán chiū se̍h-kè Í-tong, chiū-sī lán ê hiaⁿ-tī Í-sò ê hō͘-tāi tòa ê tōe-khu; tùi A-la-pa ê lō͘ keng-kè Í-la-tha, Í-sûn Ka-pia̍t, oat tùi ǹg Mô͘-ap khòng-iá ê hong-hiòng khì.

Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng, “M̄-thang jiá Mô͘-ap -lâng, m̄-thang chhim-hoān in; in ê tōe góa mā bô beh hō͘ lín chòe sán-gia̍p, in-ūi góa í-keng chiong A-ní -siâⁿ hō͘ Lô-tek ê hō͘-tāi chòe ke-gia̍p.”
Í-chêng, Í-bí -lâng tòa tī hit-ê tōe-khu; in jîn-kháu chōe koh kiông, chhin-chhiūⁿ A-la̍p -cho̍k ê lâng hiah lò.
In mā kap A-la̍p -cho̍k ê lâng kâng-khoán hō͘ lâng kiò-chòe Lī-hoa̍t-im -lâng; m̄-kú Mô͘-ap -lâng kiò in chòe Í-bí -lâng.

Che tú chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-chêng Hô-lī -lâng tòa tī Í-tong, m̄-kú Í-sò ê hō͘-tāi mā kā in siau-bia̍t, sòa-chiap in tòa tī hia; mā chhin-chhiūⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Siōng Chú siúⁿ-sù in chòe ke-gia̍p ê tōe, chiong goân-lâi ê chū-bîn kóaⁿ-cháu siâng-khoán.
Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Lín tio̍h khí--lâi, kè Sat-lia̍t-khoe.” Tùi án-ni, lán chiū kè hit-tiâu khoe.

Lán tùi lī-khui Ka-te-su Pa-nî-a, kàu kè Sat-lia̍t-khoe, keng-kè saⁿ-cha̍p-poeh nî kú; ti̍t-kàu hit-tāi ê chiàn-sū lóng sí tī kun-iâⁿ, tú chiàu Siōng Chú tùi in só͘ li̍p-sè--ê.
Siōng Chú ê chhiú kong-kek in, tùi kun-iâⁿ tiong kā in oân-choân siau-bia̍t.
Jîn-bîn tiong-kan ê chiàn-sū lóng sí--khì liáu-āu,
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Kin-á-ji̍t lín beh tùi Mô͘-ap ê pian-kài A-ní -siâⁿ keng-kè;

lín kiâⁿ-óa A-bûn -lâng ê sî, m̄-thang jiá in, m̄-thang chhim-hoān in; in-ūi A-bûn -lâng ê tōe góa bô beh hō͘ lín chòe sán-gia̍p, góa í-keng chiong hit-tè tōe sù hō͘ Lô-tek ê hō͘-tāi chòe sán-gia̍p.”
Hit-ê tōe-khu mā sǹg-chòe Lī-hoa̍t-im -lâng ê tōe. Í-chêng Lī-hoa̍t-im -lâng tòa tī hia; A-bûn -lâng kiò in chòe Sàn-cho͘-bêng -lâng;
in jîn-kháu chōe koh kiông, chhin-chhiūⁿ A-la̍p -cho̍k ê lâng hiah lò; m̄-kú Siōng Chú kā in siau-bia̍t, A-bûn -lâng chiū chiàm-léng in ê tōe, sòa-chiap in tòa tī hia;
tú chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú ūi-tio̍h tòa tī Í-tong ê Í-sò hō͘-tāi siau-bia̍t Hô-lī -lâng, hō͘ in sòa-chiap tòa tī chit-ê tōe ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t siâng-khoán.
Tùi Ka-hui-thok chhut-lâi ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng mā siâng-khoán, siau-bia̍t tòa tī Ka-sat kap hù-kūn chng-siā ê A-ōe -lâng, sòa-chiap in tòa tī hia.

Taⁿ, lín tio̍h khí--lâi, chhut-hoat kè A-lūn Soaⁿ-kok. Khòaⁿ leh! Góa í-keng chiong A-mô͘-lī -lâng Hi-si̍t-pún -ông Se-hông kap i ê thó͘-tōe, kau tī lín ê chhiú; lín tio̍h kap i kau-chiàn, chiàm-léng i ê thó͘-tōe.
Tùi kin-á-ji̍t khí, góa beh hō͘ thiⁿ-ē bān-bîn lóng kiaⁿ lín, lún lín; hō͘ in thiaⁿ-tio̍h koan-hē lín ê hong-siaⁿ lóng hoân-ló, phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.
Góa tùi Ki-tí-bo̍k ê khòng-iá, phài sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Hi-si̍t-pún -ông Se-hông, ēng hó-ōe tùi i kóng,
“Chhiáⁿ lí ún-chún goán keng-kè lí ê tōe; goán ōe kiâⁿ tōa-lō͘, bōe phian-chó, bōe phian-iū.
Goán ōe ēng gûn kā lín bóe niû-si̍t chia̍h, bóe chúi lim, chí-ū pài-thok lí chún goán kiâⁿ--kè-khì;

chhin-chhiūⁿ tòa tī Í-tong ê Í-sò hō͘-tāi, kap tòa tī A-ní -siâⁿ ê Mô͘-ap -lâng tùi-thāi goán kâng-khoán; ti̍t-kàu goán kè Iok-tàn-hô, chìn-ji̍p Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù hō͘ goán ê tōe.”

M̄-kú Hi-si̍t-pún -ông Se-hông m̄-khéng hō͘ lán tùi i ê tōe keng-kè, in-ūi Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè hō͘ i kò͘-chip ngī-sim, ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lán kā i phah-pāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ kin-á-ji̍t lán só͘ chai--ê án-ni.
Siōng Chú kā góa kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, góa í-keng chiong Se-hông kap i ê thó͘-tōe kau hō͘ lí, taⁿ lí tio̍h khì chiàm-léng i ê thó͘-tōe chòe lín ê sán-gia̍p.”
Hit-sî Se-hông kap i ê kun-peng chhut-lâi tī Ngá-cha̍p kap lán kau-chiàn.
Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè chiong i kau hō͘ lán, lán chiū chiong i kap i ê kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p só͘-ū ê kun-peng lóng phah-sí.
Lán koh kong-chhú i lóng-chóng ê siâⁿ, chiong siâⁿ-lāi ê ta-po͘-lâng, cha-bó͘-lâng, kap gín-á lóng châu-bia̍t, bô lâu pòaⁿ-ê;
chí-ū lâu cheng-siⁿ kap tùi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ chhiúⁿ--lâi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chòe ka-kī ê chiàn-lī-phín.

Tùi A-lūn Soaⁿ-kok piⁿ ê A-lô-ní, kap soaⁿ-kok tiong ê siâⁿ, ti̍t-kàu Ki-lia̍t, bô chi̍t ê siâⁿ kian-kò͘ kah lán bô hoat-tō͘ kong-phòa, in-ūi Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè chiong chiah-ê siâⁿ lóng kau hō͘ lán.
Chí-ū A-bûn -lâng ê tōe, Ngá-phok hô-piⁿ ê tōe, kap soaⁿ-khu chiah-ê siâⁿ, lán bô khì kong-táⁿ, in-ūi Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè kìm-chí lán.
Āu-lâi, lán chiū oat tùi ǹg Pa-san ê hong-hiòng khì; Pa-san -ông Go̍k kap i ê kun-peng chhut-lâi tī Í-tek-lâi kap lán kau-chiàn.

Siōng Chú kā góa kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ i, in-ūi góa í-keng chiong i kap i ê kun-peng, í-ki̍p i ê thó͘-tōe lóng kau tī lí ê chhiú; lí tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-hù tòa tī Hi-si̍t-pún ê A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông án-ni tùi-hù i.”
Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè chiū chiong Pa-san -ông Go̍k kap i ê kun-peng lóng kau hō͘ lán; lán kā in phah-sí, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu.

Hit-sî, lán kong-chhú i só͘-ū ê siâⁿ, bô chi̍t chō siâⁿ bô hō͘ lán chiàm-léng; án-ni, lán kong-chiàm Pa-san -ông Go̍k só͘ thóng-tī A-ní-ko-pek tōe-khu choân-pō͘ ê la̍k-cha̍p chō siâⁿ.
Chiah-ê lóng sī kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, ū koân ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, ū mn̂g ū chhòaⁿ; í-gōa iáu ū chin chōe bô siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê chng-siā.
Lán oân-choân kā in siau-bia̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng tùi-thāi Hi-si̍t-pún -ông Se-hông án-ni, chiong siâⁿ-lāi ê ta-po͘-lâng, cha-bó͘-lâng, kap gín-á lóng châu-bia̍t;
chí-ū lâu cheng-siⁿ kap tùi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ chhiúⁿ--lâi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chòe ka-kī ê chiàn-lī-phín.
Hit-sî, lán tùi nn̄g ê A-mô͘-lī -ông ê chhiú chhiúⁿ-toa̍t in tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng ê tōe, tùi A-lūn Soaⁿ-kok kàu Hek-bûn-soaⁿ.
Chit-ê Hek-bûn-soaⁿ, Se-tùn -lâng kā i kiò-chòe Se-liân; A-mô͘-lī -lâng kiò i chòe Sī-nî-ní.
Lán mā kong-chhú pêng-goân só͘-ū ê siâⁿ, Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu kap Pa-san tōe-khu, ti̍t-kàu Sat-ka kap Í-tek-lâi; chiah-ê lóng sī Pa-san -ông Go̍k ê siâⁿ.

Pa-san -ông Go̍k sī Lī-hoa̍t-im -lâng chòe-āu chi̍t ê lâng. I ê bîn-chhn̂g sī thih --ê, tn̂g tāi-iok sì kong-chhioh, khoah nn̄g kong-chhioh. Hiān-chāi tī A-bûn -lâng ê La-pa iáu ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-téng bîn-chhn̂g.

Lán tit-tio̍h chit-tè thó͘-tōe liáu-āu, góa chiong A-lūn Soaⁿ-kok hù-kūn ê A-lô-ní -siâⁿ, kap Ki-lia̍t soaⁿ-khu ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ, í-ki̍p kî-tiong hiah-ê siâⁿ, lóng hō͘ Lū-piān -lâng kap Ka-tek -lâng;
chiong Ki-lia̍t kî-tha ê tōe, kap Pa-san -ông Go̍k choân-pō͘ ê thó͘-tōe, lóng hō͘ Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k. Pa-san ê A-ní-ko-pek tōe-khu, mā kiò-chòe Lī-hoa̍t-im -lâng ê tōe.

Má-ná-se ê hō͘-tāi Gâi-ní chiàm-léng A-ní-ko-pek choân tōe-khu, ti̍t-kàu Ki-su̍t -lâng kap Má-ka -lâng ê pian-kài; i ēng ka-kī ê miâ kiò Pa-san tōe-khu chòe Hap-o-te̍k Gâi-ní, kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu ēng chit-ê miâ.
Góa chiong Ki-lia̍t pun hō͘ Má-kiat chong-cho̍k.
Góa pun hō͘ Lū-piān chi-cho̍k kap Ka-tek chi-cho̍k ê tōe sī: Tùi Ki-lia̍t kàu A-lūn Soaⁿ-kok, ēng soaⁿ-kok chòe kài, ti̍t-kàu A-bûn -lâng ê pian-kài ê Ngá-phok-hô,
pau-koat A-la-pa kap óa-kūn Iok-tàn-hô ê tōe, tùi Ka-lī-lī-ô͘ kàu A-la-pa-hái, chiū-sī Iâm-hái, í-ki̍p Pí-su-ka soaⁿ-kha tang-pêng ê tōe.

Hit-sî góa hoan-hù in, kóng, “Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè í-keng chiong chit-ê tōe hō͘ lín chòe ke-gia̍p; lín tiong-kan ê ióng-sū lóng tio̍h tòa kun-khì, chòe lín tông-pau ê sian-hong kè-hô.
M̄-kú lín ê bó͘, lín ê gín-á, kap lín ê cheng-siⁿ — góa chai lín ê cheng-siⁿ chin chōe — thang tòa tī góa só͘ hō͘ lín ta̍k-ê siâⁿ,

kàu Siōng Chú hō͘ lín ê tông-pau kap lín siâng-khoán, tī Iok-tàn-hô hit-pêng tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù in an-ún khiā-khí ê tōe, jiân-āu lín chiah thang tò-lâi góa só͘ siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe.”

Hit-sî, góa hoan-hù Iok-su-a, kóng, “Lí ū chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè tùi chit nn̄g ê ông só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū, Siōng Chú mā beh chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni tùi-thāi lín kè-hô liáu-āu tú--tio̍h ê kok-ka.
Lín m̄-bián kiaⁿ in, in-ūi ūi lín kau-chiàn--ê sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.”
Hit-sî góa khún-kiû Siōng Chú, kóng,

“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, lí í-keng hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê úi-tāi, lí ê koân-lêng. Tī thiⁿ-téng, tī tōe-chiūⁿ, bô jīm-hô sîn-bêng ōe-tàng chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ lí só͘ chòe tōa koân-lêng ê chok-ûi.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa kè Iok-tàn-hô, khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-pêng pûi ê tōe, súi ê soaⁿ, kap Lê-pa-lūn.”
M̄-kú Siōng Chú in-ūi lín ê iân-kò͘ tùi góa siū-khì, m̄ thiaⁿ góa ê khún-kiû. Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Hó ah lah, lí m̄-thang koh tùi góa thê-khí chit-ê sū.
Lí tio̍h chiūⁿ Pí-su-ka ê soaⁿ-téng, gia̍h-thâu ǹg tang sai lâm pak siông-sè khòaⁿ, in-ūi lí bōe-tàng kè Iok-tàn-hô.
M̄-kú lí tio̍h hoan-hù Iok-su-a, kā i kó͘-lē, hō͘ i kian-kiông; in-ūi i beh chhōa chiah-ê jîn-bîn kè--khì, hō͘ in sêng-chiap lí beh khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê tōe.”
Tùi án-ni, lán chiū lâu tī Pek Pí-ní tùi-bīn ê soaⁿ-kok tiong.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, taⁿ góa kà-sī lín ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng, lín tio̍h thiaⁿ-siū chun-thàn, lín chiah ōe oa̍h, chìn-ji̍p Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù hō͘ lín ê tōe, sêng-chiap chòe sán-gia̍p.
Góa hoan-hù lín ê ōe, chiū-sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, tio̍h chun-siú, m̄-thang ke-thiⁿ, mā m̄-thang kiám-chió.

Siōng Chú in-ūi Pa-le̍k Pí-ní ê tāi-chì só͘ chòe ê sū, lín ū chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h; só͘-ū pài Pí-ní ê sîn-bêng Pa-le̍k ê lâng, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè lóng chiong in tùi lín tiong-kan tû-bia̍t.
Chí-ū lín chiah-ê tiong-sêng kun-tè Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê lâng, kin-á-ji̍t lóng iáu oa̍h--teh.

Lín tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, góa ū chiàu Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ê hoan-hù, chiong kui-lē kap bēng-lēng kà-sī lín, hō͘ lín tī beh ji̍p-khì sêng-chiap chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe chun-hêng.

Só͘-í lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng, án-ni lín chiū ōe tī lia̍t-kok bīn-chêng hián-chhut lín ê tì-hūi chhong-bêng; in chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê só͘-ū ê kui-lē, chiū ōe kóng, “Chit-ê úi-tāi ê kok-ka ê jîn-bîn chin-chiàⁿ sī ū tì-hūi chhong-bêng.”
Ū tó chi̍t ê tōa-kok ê sîn-bêng kap i ê jîn-bîn chhin-kūn, chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè kap lán chiah-ni̍h chhin-kūn, hō͘ lán thang sûi-sî kiû-kiò I?
Ū tó chi̍t ê tōa-kok ū kong-chèng ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa kin-á-ji̍t thoân hō͘ lín ê lu̍t-hoat án-ni?

Só͘-í tio̍h kín-sīn, mā tio̍h chhiat-si̍t pó-siú lín ê sim, chiah bián lín bōe-kì-tit lín chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê tāi-chì, chiah bián chiah-ê tāi-chì tī lín oa̍h--teh ê sî lī-khui lín ê sim; mā tio̍h ēng chiah-ê kà-sī lín ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun.

Lín tī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ khiā tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Lí kā góa chio-chi̍p jîn-bîn, góa beh hō͘ in thiaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê ōe, hō͘ in oa̍h tī sè-kan ê ji̍t, thang ha̍k-si̍p kèng-ùi góa, koh kà-sī in ê hō͘-tāi.”
Hit-sî lín lóng kūn-óa--lâi, khiā tī soaⁿ-kha; soaⁿ--ni̍h ū hé-iām chhèng kàu thiⁿ-téng, koh ū o͘-hûn tà-óa.
Siōng Chú tī hé-iām tiong tùi lín kóng-ōe; lín ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ kóng-ōe ê siaⁿ, m̄-kú bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h sím-mi̍h hêng-siōng; chí-ū siaⁿ nā-tiāⁿ.
I chiong bēng-lēng lín tio̍h siú ê iok chí-sī lín, chiū-sī cha̍p-tiâu-kài, koh siá tī nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán.
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú koh hoan-hù góa chiong kui-lē kap bēng-lēng kà-sī lín, hō͘ lín tī beh kè-khì tit-tio̍h chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe chun-hêng.
Lín tio̍h te̍k-pia̍t kín-sīn, in-ūi Siōng Chú tī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ tùi hé-tiong kā lín kóng-ōe hit-sî, lín lóng bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h sím-mi̍h hêng-siōng;
só͘-í, lín m̄-thang tūi-lo̍h, ūi ka-kī chō jīm-hô hêng-chōng ê ngó͘-siōng, bô-lūn sī lâm sī lú,
tōe-chiūⁿ ê cháu-siù á-sī khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu,
tōe-chiūⁿ teh sô ê tōng-bu̍t á-sī chúi-tiong ê hî-lūi, lóng m̄-thang chō in ê siōng.

Lín gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ-tio̍h thiⁿ-téng ê ji̍t, ge̍h, chhiⁿ-sîn, mā m̄-thang siū ín-iú kèng-pài ho̍k-sāi in, in-ūi chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h thiⁿ-ē bān-bîn pâi-siat ê thian-thé.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú chiong lín tùi chù-thih ê hé-lô͘ Ai-ki̍p kái-kiù--chhut-lâi, chòe I ê chú-bîn, I ê sán-gia̍p, chhin-chhiūⁿ kin-á-ji̍t án-ni.

Siōng Chú koh in-ūi lín ê iân-kò͘ tùi góa siū-khì, li̍p-sè m̄ hō͘ góa kè Iok-tàn-hô, mā m̄ hō͘ góa chìn-ji̍p Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê hó thó͘-tōe.
Góa tio̍h sí tī chia, bōe-tàng kè Iok-tàn-hô; m̄-kú lín ōe kè-khì chiàm-léng hit-ê hó ê tōe.

Lín tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bián lín bōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kap lín li̍p ê iok, ûi-pōe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng, ūi ka-kī tiau-khek jīm-hô hêng-chōng ê ngó͘-siōng.
In-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sī thun-bia̍t ê hé, sī iau-kiû choân-chêng ho̍k-sāi I ê Siōng-tè.

Lín tī hit-ê tōe tòa chin kú, siⁿ-kiáⁿ thoân-sun, nā tūi-lo̍h, chō ta̍k-khoán hêng-chōng ê ngó͘-siōng, chòe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, jiá I siū-khì,

góa kin-á-ji̍t chiū kiò thiⁿ kiò tōe chhut-lâi choh-chèng khòng-kò lín, lín ōe tī kè Iok-tàn-hô tit-tio̍h chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe chin kín bia̍t-bông; lín tī hit-ê tōe bōe kú-tn̂g, ōe thiat-tóe siū siau-bia̍t.
Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ lín sì-sòaⁿ tī bān-cho̍k ê tiong-kan; tī Siōng Chú kóaⁿ lín khì hiah-ê kok, lín chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng chin chió.
Tī hia, lín ōe ho̍k-sāi lâng ê chhiú ēng chhâ ēng chio̍h chō ê sîn-bêng; in bōe khòaⁿ, bōe thiaⁿ, bōe chia̍h, bōe phīⁿ.
M̄-kú lín tī hia beh chhē Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, nā choân-sim choân-chêng chhē I, chiū ōe chhē--tio̍h.
Chiong-lâi lín tú-tio̍h ta̍k-khoán khó͘-lān ê sî, lín ōe kui-ǹg Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, sūn-ho̍k I;
in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sī lîn-bín ê Siōng-tè, bōe pàng-sak lín, bōe châu-bia̍t lín, mā bōe bōe-kì-tit I li̍p-sè kap lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ só͘ li̍p ê iok.

Lín cha-khó choân sè-kài, tùi í-chêng, chiū-sī tùi Siōng-tè chhòng-chō jîn-lūi tī sè-kan í-lâi, kiám bat ū chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-khoán ê tōa-sū hoat-seng? Lín kiám bat thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chit-khoán tāi-chì?
Kiám ū tó chi̍t ê bîn-cho̍k bat thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè tùi hé-tiong kóng-ōe ê siaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, m̄-kú iáu oa̍h--teh?

Kiám ū tó chi̍t ê sîn-bêng chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, tùi bān-cho̍k ê tiong-kan kéng-soán chi̍t cho̍k chòe ka-kī ê chú-bîn, koh chhun-chhut tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú, ēng chai-lān, sîn-jiah, kî-sū, chiàn-cheng, tī Ai-ki̍p ūi-tio̍h lín chòe tōa koh thang-kiaⁿ ê sū?
Siōng Chú án-ni tùi lín hián-hiān, hō͘ lín chai I sī Siōng-tè, í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê.
I tùi thiⁿ hō͘ lín thiaⁿ-kìⁿ I ê siaⁿ, ūi-tio̍h beh kà-sī lín; koh tī tōe-chiūⁿ hō͘ lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h I ê tōa-hé, thiaⁿ-tio̍h I tùi hé-tiong kā lín kóng ê ōe.
In-ūi I thiàⁿ lín ê lia̍t-chó͘, só͘-í kéng-soán in ê hō͘-tāi, chhin-sin ēng tōa koân-lêng tùi Ai-ki̍p chhōa lín chhut--lâi;
tùi lín ê bīn-chêng chiong pí lín khah kiông-tāi ê bîn-cho̍k kóaⁿ-cháu, chhōa lín ji̍p-khì in ê tōe, chiong chit-ê tōe sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p, chhin-chhiūⁿ kin-á-ji̍t án-ni.
Só͘-í, kin-á-ji̍t lín tio̍h chai, tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, thiⁿ-téng tōe-ē chí-ū Siōng Chú sī Siōng-tè, í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê.

Góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín I ê kui-lē kap kài-bēng, lín tio̍h chun-siú, hō͘ lín kap lín ê hō͘-tāi thang tit-tio̍h hok-khì, tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe éng-oán sán-gia̍p ê tōe kú-tn̂g khiā-khí.
Āu-lâi, Mô͘-se tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng chí-tēng saⁿ ê siâⁿ,
hō͘ hiah-ê bô oan-siû, bô-ì-tiong gō͘-sat lâng ê lâng tô-cháu khì hia, thang pó-choân sìⁿ-miā;
sio̍k Lū-piān -lâng--ê sī tī khòng-iá pêng-goân ê Pí-sek, sio̍k Ka-tek -lâng--ê sī Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, sio̍k Má-ná-se -lâng--ê sī Pa-san ê Ko-lân.
Ē-bīn sī Mô͘-se tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pan-pò͘ ê lu̍t-hoat,
sī Mô͘-se tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p liáu-āu, thoân hō͘ in ê kà-sī, kui-lē, kap bēng-lēng.

I pan-pò͘ lu̍t-hoat ê tōe-tiám tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng, Pek Pí-ní tùi-bīn ê soaⁿ-kok tiong, sio̍k tòa tī Hi-si̍t-pún ê A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông ê tōe; Mô͘-se kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p liáu-āu thâi-sí Se-hông.
In chiàm-léng A-mô͘-lī -lâng nn̄g ê ông, Se-hông kap Pa-san -ông Go̍k tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng ê tōe,
tùi A-lūn Soaⁿ-kok piⁿ ê A-lô-ní, ti̍t-kàu Se-liân-soaⁿ, chiū-sī Hek-bûn-soaⁿ;
í-ki̍p Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng ê A-la-pa tōe-khu, ti̍t-kàu A-la-pa-hái, chiap-kūn Pí-su-ka-soaⁿ soaⁿ-kha ê tōe.

Mô͘-se tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tùi in kóng: Í-sek-lia̍t ah, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ góa kin-á-ji̍t kā lín hoan-hù ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng, lín tio̍h ha̍k-si̍p, chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng.
Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè tī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ kap lán li̍p-iok.
Chit-ê iok, Siōng Chú m̄-sī kap lán ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p--ê, sī kap kin-á-ji̍t lán só͘-ū iáu oa̍h--teh, khiā tī chia ê lâng li̍p--ê.
Siōng Chú tī soaⁿ-téng, tùi hé-tiong bīn-tùi-bīn kap lín kóng-ōe.
Hit-sî góa khiā tī Siōng Chú kap lín ê tiong-kan, beh chiong Siōng Chú ê ōe thoân hō͘ lín, in-ūi lín kiaⁿ hit-ê hé, m̄-káⁿ chiūⁿ-soaⁿ. Siōng Chú kóng,
“Góa sī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè, ū chiong lí tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe, chòe lô͘-châi ê ke chhōa--chhut-lâi.
“Góa í-gōa lí m̄-thang ū pa̍t-ê Siōng-tè.
“M̄-thang ūi ka-kī tiau-khek ngó͘-siōng, bô-lūn thiⁿ-téng, tōe-chiūⁿ, kap tōe-ē chúi-lāi só͘-ū ê mi̍h, lóng m̄-thang chō in ê siōng;

m̄-thang kā in kūi-pài, mā m̄-thang ho̍k-sāi in, in-ūi góa Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè sī iau-kiû choân-chêng ho̍k-sāi ê Siōng-tè; oàn-hūn góa ê lâng, góa tui-kiù in ê chōe, tùi pē kàu kiáⁿ, kàu saⁿ sì tāi;
thiàⁿ góa, chun-siú góa kài-bēng ê lâng, góa si-un hō͘ in, ti̍t-kàu chheng tāi.
“M̄-thang lām-iōng Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ê miâ; in-ūi lām-iōng Siōng Chú ê miâ ê lâng, góa Siōng Chú it-tēng bô kā i tòng-chòe bô-chōe.
“Tio̍h chiàu Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, siú An-hioh-ji̍t chòe sèng-ji̍t.
La̍k ji̍t lāi tio̍h phah-piàⁿ chòe lí só͘-ū ê khang-khè,

m̄-kú tē-chhit ji̍t sī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè siat-li̍p ê An-hioh-ji̍t; chit-ji̍t, lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lô͘-po̍k, lú-pī, gû, lû, cheng-siⁿ, í-ki̍p kià-ku tī lín tiong-kan ê lâng, lóng m̄-thang chòe kang, hō͘ lí ê lô͘-po̍k, lú-pī, thang kap lí siâng-khoán an-hioh.

Tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, lín í-chêng bat tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe chòe lô͘-châi, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chhun-chhut tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú, chhōa lín tùi hia chhut--lâi; in-ūi án-ni, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè bēng-lēng lín tio̍h siú An-hioh-ji̍t.

“Tio̍h chiàu Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, hàu-kèng lí ê lāu-pē, lí ê lāu-bú, thang hō͘ lí tī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lí ê tōe kú-tn̂g khiā-khí, hióng-siū hok-khì.
“M̄-thang hāi-sí lâng.
“M̄-thang kan-îm.
“M̄-thang thau-the̍h.
“M̄-thang choh gūi-chèng hām-hāi lí ê chhù-piⁿ.
“M̄-thang tham lí ê chhù-piⁿ ê bó͘, mā m̄-thang tham lí ê chhù-piⁿ ê chhù, chhân-hn̂g, lô͘-po̍k, lú-pī, gû, lû, á-sī lí ê chhù-piⁿ jīm-hô ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ.”

Chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú tī soaⁿ-téng, tùi hé-iām, ba̍t-hûn, o͘-àm ê tiong-kan, tōa-siaⁿ tùi lín choân-thé hōe-chiòng pan-pò͘ ê kài-bēng, bô koh ke-thiⁿ kî-tha ê ōe. I koh chiong chiah-ê kài-bēng siá tī nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán, kau hō͘ góa.
Hit-sî, soaⁿ--ni̍h ū hé teh to̍h, lín thiaⁿ-kìⁿ ū siaⁿ tùi o͘-àm tiong chhut--lâi, lín ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê léng-siù kap tiúⁿ-ló lóng lâi góa chia.

Lín kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè hō͘ goán khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I ê êng-kng kap úi-tāi; goán koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ I ê siaⁿ tùi hé-tiong hoat-chhut; kin-á-ji̍t goán chiah chai, Siōng-tè tùi lâng kóng-ōe, lâng iáu ōe oa̍h.
Chit-ê tōa-hé ōe kā goán sio-sí; goán nā koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ê siaⁿ, it-tēng ōe sí, goán ná tio̍h mō͘ sìⁿ-miā ê gûi-hiám?
Kiám ū lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ goán thiaⁿ-kìⁿ éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè tùi hé-tiong kóng-ōe ê siaⁿ, iáu ōe-tàng oa̍h--teh?

Lí tio̍h chìn-chêng khì thiaⁿ Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè só͘-ū beh tùi goán kóng ê ōe; chiong Siōng Chú tùi lí kóng ê ōe, lóng kā goán kóng; goán beh thiaⁿ, mā beh si̍t-hêng.”
Lín tùi góa kóng ê ōe, Siōng Chú lóng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h. I tùi góa kóng, “Góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê lâng tùi lí kóng ê ōe; in kóng-liáu chin tio̍h.
Ǹg-bāng in chûn chit-khoán sim, kèng-ùi góa, siông-siông siú góa ê kài-bēng, hō͘ in kap in ê kiáⁿ-sun éng-oán tit-tio̍h hok-khì.
Lí khì kā in kóng, ‘Lín tò-khì ka-kī ê pò͘-pîⁿ.’

Mô͘-se, lí tio̍h khiā tiàm góa chia, góa beh chiong lí só͘ tio̍h kà-sī in ê kài-bēng, kui-lē, bēng-lēng lóng kā lí kóng, hō͘ in thang tī góa siúⁿ-sù in chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe si̍t-hêng.”
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, m̄-thang phian-chó-phian-iū.
Lín lóng tio̍h kiâⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè bēng-lēng lín ê lō͘, hō͘ lín tī beh khì chiàm-léng ê tōe hióng-siū hok-khì, kú-tn̂g khiā-khí.
Ē-bīn sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè hoan-hù góa tio̍h kà-sī lín ê kài-bēng, kui-lē, bēng-lēng, hō͘ lín tī beh khì chiàm-léng ê tōe chun-hêng,
thang hō͘ lín kap lín ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun it-seng kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, chun-siú góa só͘ bēng-lēng it-chhè ê kui-lē kap kài-bēng, hō͘ lín tn̂g-hè-siū.

Í-sek-lia̍t ah, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ, tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng, hō͘ lín thang chiàu Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè ê èng-ún, tī lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe tit-tio̍h hok-khì, lâng-gia̍h ke-thiⁿ chin chōe.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ, Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè sī to̍k-it ê Siōng Chú.
Lín tio̍h choân-sim, choân-chêng, choân-le̍k thiàⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Góa kin-á-ji̍t bēng-lēng lín chiah-ê ōe tio̍h kì tī sim-lāi,
mā tio̍h un-khûn kà-sī lín ê kiáⁿ-jî. Bô-lūn tī chhù-lāi chē, tī lō͘--ni̍h kiâⁿ, tó--teh á-sī khí--lâi, lóng tio̍h liām hō͘ in thiaⁿ;
koh tio̍h pa̍k tī chhiú--ni̍h chòe kì-hō, pa̍k tī thâu-hia̍h thê-chhíⁿ;
tio̍h siá tī chhù ê mn̂g-khiā, mā tio̍h siá tī siâⁿ-mn̂g.

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè beh chhōa lín chìn-ji̍p I tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘, A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok, li̍p-sè beh hō͘ lín ê tōe; tī hia ū khoah-tōa koh súi ê siâⁿ, m̄-sī lín khí-chō--ê;

ū chhù tóe chin chōe hó-mi̍h, m̄-sī lín chek-chū--ê; ū ó͘ hó-sè ê chúi-chíⁿ, m̄-sī lín ó͘--ê; ū phû-tô-hn̂g, kaⁿ-ná-chhiū, m̄-sī lín chai-chèng--ê. Kàu lín ta̍k-hāng hù-chiok ê sî,
tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bián lín bōe-kì-tit chhōa lín tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe, tùi chòe lô͘-châi ê ke chhut--lâi ê Siōng Chú.
Lín kan-ta tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, ho̍k-sāi I, hōng I ê miâ chiù-chōa;
m̄-thang pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, chiū-sī lín sì-ûi ê gōa-cho̍k teh pài ê sîn-bêng,

chiah bián Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tùi lín hoat tōa siū-khì, kā lín tùi tōe-chiūⁿ siau-bia̍t, in-ūi kap lín tông-chāi ê Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, sī iau-kiû choân-chêng ho̍k-sāi I ê Siōng-tè.
Lín m̄-thang chhì-thàm Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín bat tī Má-sat chhì-thàm I chi̍t-iūⁿ.
Tio̍h khak-si̍t chun-siú Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng, kap I bēng-lēng lín ê kà-sī, kui-lē.

Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe chèng-ti̍t, khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê, lín tio̍h si̍t-hêng; lín chiū ōe sū-sū sūn-lī, koh ji̍p-khì chiàm-léng Siōng Chú li̍p-sè beh hō͘ lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ súi ê tōe;
lín mā tio̍h chiàu Siōng Chú ê èng-ún chiong lín só͘-ū ê tùi-te̍k kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.
Chiong-lâi lín ê kiáⁿ-sun mn̄g lín kóng, “Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè só͘ bēng-lēng lín chiah-ê kà-sī, kui-lē, bēng-lēng sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù?”
Lín tio̍h kā lín ê kiáⁿ-sun án-ni kóng, “Chá-chêng goán tī Ai-ki̍p chòe Ai-ki̍p -ông ê lô͘-châi, Siōng Chú ēng tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú chhōa goán chhut Ai-ki̍p.
Siōng Chú tī goán ê ba̍k-chiu chêng kiâⁿ tōa koh lī-hāi ê sîn-jiah kî-sū, tùi-hù Ai-ki̍p -lâng, Hoat-ló kap i ê choân-ke,
chhōa goán tùi hia chhut--lâi, hō͘ goán ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú tùi lán ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè beh siúⁿ-sù lán ê tōe.

Siōng Chú hoan-hù lán, tio̍h chun-hêng chiah-ê só͘-ū ê kui-lē, tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè, hō͘ lán it-seng sū-sū sūn-lī, tit-tio̍h I pó-choân lán ê sìⁿ-miā, chhin-chhiūⁿ kin-á-ji̍t án-ni.
Lán nā chiàu Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè ê hoan-hù, tī I ê bīn-chêng chun-hêng I it-chhè ê kài-bēng, I ōe hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p lán.”

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe chhōa lín ji̍p-khì lín beh chiàm-léng ê tōe, tùi lín ê bīn-chêng chiong chhit ê pí lín khah kiông-tāi ê bîn-cho̍k kóaⁿ-cháu, chiū-sī Hek -lâng, Kek-ka-sat -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Ka-lâm -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng.

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chiong in kau tī lín ê chhiú, hō͘ lín kā in phah-pāi. Hit-sî, lín tio̍h kā in thiat-tóe siau-bia̍t, m̄-thang kap in li̍p-iok, mā m̄-thang chhiú-hā-liû-chêng.
M̄-thang kap in thong-hun; lín ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ m̄-thang kè hō͘ in ê hāu-siⁿ, mā m̄-thang hō͘ lín ê hāu-siⁿ chhōa in ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
In-ūi in ōe hō͘ lín ê kiáⁿ-jî oa̍t-cháu bô kèng-pài Siōng Chú, khì ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, tì-kàu Siōng Chú tùi lín hoat tōa siū-khì, chin kín kā lín siau-bia̍t.

Só͘-í lín tio̍h án-ni tùi-thāi in: Thiah-húi in ê chè-tôaⁿ, kòng-chhùi in ê chio̍h-thiāu-siōng, chhò-tn̄g in ê A-sià-la lú-sîn ê sîn-siōng, ēng hé sio in tiau-khek ê ngó͘-siōng.
In-ūi lín sī kui-sio̍k Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sèng-kiat ê chú-bîn; Siōng Chú ū tùi tōe-chiūⁿ bān-bîn ê tiong-kan kéng-soán lín, chòe I te̍k-pia̍t ê chú-bîn.
Siōng Chú thiàⁿ lín, kéng lín, m̄-sī in-ūi lín ê lâng-gia̍h pí pa̍t-cho̍k khah chōe; kî-si̍t lín ê lâng-gia̍h sī bān-cho̍k tiong siōng chió--ê;

sī in-ūi Siōng Chú thiàⁿ lín, koh beh si̍t-hiān I tùi lín lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè ê èng-ún, I chiah ēng tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú chhōa lín chhut--lâi, kiù-sio̍k lín thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló ê chhiú, thoat-lī chòe lô͘-châi ê ke.

Só͘-í lín tio̍h chai, chí-ū Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sī Siōng-tè, sī sìn-si̍t ê Siōng-tè; tùi thiàⁿ I, chun-siú I kài-bēng ê lâng, I ōe siú-iok, si chû-ài hō͘ in ti̍t-kàu chheng tāi.
Só͘-ū kū-choa̍t I ê lâng, I ōe kā in pò-èng, kā in siau-bia̍t; I tùi kū-choa̍t I ê lâng ōe chin kín tng-bīn kā in pò-èng.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ hoan-hù lín ê kài-bēng, kui-lē, bēng-lēng.
Lín nā chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng chiah-ê bēng-lēng, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chiū ōe siú I tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè só͘ li̍p ê iok, tùi lín si chû-ài.

I ōe thiàⁿ lín, sù-hok lín, hō͘ lín heng-ōng; mā ōe tī I tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè beh siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe, hō͘ lín siⁿ-thòaⁿ chōe-chōe, koh hō͘ lín thó͘-tōe ê chhut-sán, ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú kap sin-iû, gû-á-kiáⁿ kap iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ ke-thiⁿ chin chōe.
Lín tit--tio̍h ê hok-khì ōe chhiau-kè bān-cho̍k; lín ê lâm-lú bô chi̍t ê bōe siⁿ, lín ê cheng-siⁿ bô chi̍t chiah bōe siⁿ-thòaⁿ.
Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ pīⁿ-thiàⁿ lī-khui lín; lín só͘ chai Ai-ki̍p ta̍k-khoán ê pháiⁿ chèng-thâu, I bōe kàng hō͘ lín, chí-ū ōe kàng hō͘ só͘-ū oàn-hūn lín ê lâng.

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kau hō͘ lín ê bîn-cho̍k, lín tio̍h lóng kā in siau-bia̍t, m̄-thang tùi in chhiú-hā-liû-chêng; lín m̄-thang ho̍k-sāi in ê sîn-bêng, in-ūi án-ni ōe tì-kàu lín siū chai-lān.
Lín nā sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng, “Chiah-ê kok pí goán khah kiông, goán ná ōe-tàng kā in kóaⁿ-cháu?”
Lín m̄-bián kiaⁿ in; it-tēng tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông kap lóng-chóng ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng só͘ chòe ê sū,

chiū-sī lín ū chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê tōa chai-lān, sîn-jiah, kî-sū, koh Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chhun-chhut tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú chhōa lín chhut--lâi; I mā ōe án-ni tùi-thāi lín só͘ kiaⁿ ê bîn-cho̍k.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè beh kàng un-e̍k tī in tiong-kan, ti̍t-kàu hiah-ê chhun--lo̍h-lâi cháu-khì bih ê lâng tī lín ê bīn-chêng siau-bia̍t.
Lín m̄-bián kiaⁿ in, in-ūi kap lín tông-chāi ê Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, sī úi-tāi koh thang kiaⁿ-ùi ê Siōng-tè.

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe tī lín ê bīn-chêng chiām-chiām chiong chiah-ê bîn-cho̍k kóaⁿ-cháu; lín m̄-thang chin kín kā in siau-bia̍t, chiah bián iá-siù ke-thiⁿ chin chōe soah siong-hāi tio̍h lín.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe chiong chiah-ê bîn-cho̍k kau tī lín ê chhiú, hō͘ in tōa-kiaⁿ jiáu-loān, ti̍t-kàu in bia̍t-bông;
koh ōe chiong in hiah-ê ông kau tī lín ê chhiú, hō͘ in tùi sè-kan siau-sit; bô chi̍t ê lâng ōe-tàng tùi-khòng lín, ti̍t-kàu lín kā in siau-bia̍t.

Lín tio̍h chiong in tiau-khek ê sîn-siōng ēng hé sio-tiāu; m̄-thang tham sîn-siōng sin-chiūⁿ ê kim-gûn, mā m̄-thang the̍h-lâi chòe ka-kī ê, chiah bián lín in-ūi án-ni siū chai-lān; in-ūi chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê.

Jīm-hô ngó͘-siōng, lín lóng m̄-thang tòa-ji̍p lín ê chhù, chiah bián lín kap hiah-ê mi̍h siâng-khoán chiâⁿ-chòe tio̍h húi-bia̍t--ê. Lín tio̍h thiat-tóe iàm-ò͘ⁿ chiah-ê mi̍h, in-ūi chiah-ê sī tio̍h húi-bia̍t--ê.

Kin-á-ji̍t góa só͘ bēng-lēng lín it-chhè ê kài-bēng, lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng, hō͘ lín thang oa̍h, jîn-sò͘ ke-thiⁿ chin chōe, ji̍p-khì sêng-chiap Siōng Chú li̍p-sè èng-ún beh hō͘ lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê tōe.

Lín mā tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chit sì-cha̍p nî chhōa lín tī khòng-iá kiâⁿ--kè ê lō͘, hō͘ lín khiam-pi, kā lín khó-giām, beh chai lín ū tùi sim-tóe chun-siú I ê kài-bēng á bô.

I kā lín bôa-liān, hō͘ lín iau-gō, ēng lín kap lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ lóng m̄-bat ê má-ná iúⁿ-chhī lín, sī beh hō͘ lín chai, lâng teh oa̍h m̄-nā óa-khò piáⁿ, sī óa-khò tùi Siōng Chú ê chhùi só͘ chhut ê ta̍k-kù ōe.
Chit sì-cha̍p nî lín ê saⁿ-á-khò͘ bô phòa, lín ê kha mā bô phòng-phā.
Lín tio̍h chai, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè koán-kàu lín, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng teh koán-kàu i ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Só͘-í lín tio̍h chun-siú Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng, kiâⁿ I ê tō-lō͘, kèng-ùi I.
In-ūi, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chhōa lín ji̍p-khì hit-ê súi ê tōe, hia ū khoe, ū chúi-chôaⁿ, koh ū tōe-hā-chúi tùi soaⁿ-kok kap soaⁿ-téng lâu--chhut-lâi;
hia ū chhut-sán tōa-be̍h, sió-be̍h, phû-tô, bû-hoa-kó, sia̍h-liû, koh chhut-sán kaⁿ-ná-iû kap bi̍t.
Lín tī hia chia̍h-mi̍h chhiong-chiok, liân chi̍t hāng to bô khiàm; tī hia ê chio̍h-thâu ū thih, soaⁿ-lāi ōe-tàng ó͘-tio̍h tâng.
Lín ōe chia̍h kàu pá, tio̍h in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè só͘ siúⁿ-sù lín hù-chiok ê tōe o-ló I.
Lín tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bián bōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, bô chun-siú góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ hoan-hù Siōng Chú ê kài-bēng, bēng-lēng, kap kui-lē.
Lín chia̍h-pá, ū hó ê chhù thang khiā,
gû, iûⁿ, kim, gûn, í-ki̍p lín só͘-ū--ê lóng ke-thiⁿ chin chōe ê sî,
tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bián lín chū-ko kiau-ngō͘, soah bōe-kì-tit kā lín tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chòe lô͘-châi ê ke chhōa--chhut-lâi ê Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.

I chhōa lín keng-kè hit-ê tōa koh thang-kiaⁿ ê khòng-iá, sī ta-sò bô chúi ê tōe; hia ū to̍k-chôa, giat-á-thâng. I ū ūi-tio̍h lín hō͘ chúi tùi tēng ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ lâu--chhut-lâi.
I koh tī khòng-iá, ēng lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ m̄-bat ê má-ná iúⁿ-chhī lín, sī beh khó-giām lín, hō͘ lín khiam-pi, kàu-bé sī beh hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h hok-khì;
chiah bián lín sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng, “Góa khò ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t, lêng-le̍k tit-tio̍h chiah-ê sán-gia̍p.”

Lín tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, lín tit-tio̍h sán-gia̍p ê khùi-la̍t sī I hō͘ lín--ê, sī beh si̍t-hiān I tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè siat-li̍p ê iok, kap kin-á-ji̍t siâng-khoán.

Lín nā chin-chiàⁿ bōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, khì tè pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, ho̍k-sāi kèng-pài in, góa kin-á-ji̍t giâm-giâm kā lín kéng-kò, lín it-tēng ōe bia̍t-bông.
Siōng Chú hō͘ lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h I án-chóaⁿ siau-bia̍t hiah-ê bîn-cho̍k, lín mā ōe án-ni bia̍t-bông, in-ūi lín m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Lín kin-á-ji̍t beh kè Iok-tàn-hô, khì cheng-ho̍k hiah-ê pí lín khah kiông-tāi ê kok; in ê siâⁿ tōa koh kian-kò͘, koân kàu tú-thiⁿ.
In ê jîn-bîn ko-chhiâng-tōa-hàn, sī lín só͘ chai ê A-la̍p -lâng; lín bat thiaⁿ lâng kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng tùi-khòng A-la̍p -lâng?”

Kin-á-ji̍t lín tio̍h chai, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe tī lín ê thâu-chêng kè--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ thun-bia̍t ê hé, beh kā in siau-bia̍t, hō͘ in khut-ho̍k tī lín ê bīn-chêng; lín tio̍h chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, kín-kín kā in siau-bia̍t.

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h lín chiong in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì liáu-āu, lín sim-lāi m̄-thang siūⁿ-kóng, “Siōng Chú chhōa goán cheng-ho̍k chit-tè tōe, sī in-ūi goán ê kong-tek.” Kî-si̍t, Siōng Chú sī in-ūi hiah-ê kok siâ-ok, chiah kā in kóaⁿ-cháu.

Lín ji̍p-khì chiàm-léng in ê tōe, pèng m̄-sī in-ūi lín ū sím-mi̍h kong-tek, mā m̄-sī in-ūi lín ê sim chèng-ti̍t, sī in-ūi chiah-ê kok siâ-ok, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chiah kā in kóaⁿ-cháu; koh in-ūi Siōng Chú beh si̍t-hiān I tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok, li̍p-sè ê èng-ún.
Lín tio̍h chai, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ēng súi ê tōe siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p, m̄-sī in-ūi lín ê kong-tek, kî-si̍t lín sī sim-ngī kò͘-chip ê bîn-cho̍k.

Lín tio̍h kì hō͘ tiâu, m̄-thang bōe-kì--tit, lín tī khòng-iá jiá Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siū-khì; tùi lín chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe hit-ji̍t, kàu lín lâi kàu chit-ê só͘-chāi, lín siông-siông pōe-ge̍k Siōng Chú.
Lín tī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ koh jiá Siōng Chú siū-khì, tì-kàu Siōng Chú hoat siū-khì beh kā lín siau-bia̍t.
Hit-sî góa í-keng chiūⁿ-soaⁿ, beh niá-siū Siōng Chú kap lín li̍p-iok ê chio̍h-pán; góa tī soaⁿ--ni̍h sì-cha̍p mî-ji̍t, bô chia̍h bô lim.

Siōng Chú chiong I chhin-chhiú siá ê nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán kau hō͘ góa; hit téng-bīn siá--ê, sī Siōng Chú tī lín kú-hêng tāi-hōe ê ji̍t, tī soaⁿ-téng ê hé-iām tiong tùi lín só͘ kóng it-chhè ê ōe.
Sì-cha̍p mî-ji̍t liáu-āu, Siōng Chú ēng hit nn̄g tè ū siá bêng-iok ê chio̍h-pán kau-tài góa.

Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Khí--lâi, kóaⁿ-kín tùi chia lo̍h--khì, lí tùi Ai-ki̍p chhōa--chhut-lâi ê jîn-bîn í-keng tūi-lo̍h; in chin-kín phian-lī góa bēng-lēng in ê tō-lō͘, ūi ka-kī chù chi̍t sian ngó͘-siōng.”
Siōng Chú koh kā góa kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ chit-ê bîn-cho̍k chin-chiàⁿ sī sim-ngī kò͘-chip ê bîn-cho̍k.
Lí chhut-chāi góa, góa beh kā in siau-bia̍t, tùi thiⁿ-ē chhat-siau in ê miâ; góa beh hō͘ lí chiâⁿ-chòe pí in khah kiông, lâng khah chōe ê kok-ka.”
Góa siang-chhiú the̍h nn̄g tè iok-pán, oa̍t-tńg-sin lo̍h-soaⁿ; soaⁿ ū hé teh sio.
Góa chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín í-keng tek-chōe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, ūi ka-kī chù chi̍t chiah gû-á, chin kín phian-lī Siōng Chú só͘ bēng-lēng lín ê tō-lō͘.
Góa chiū chiong hit nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán hiat--lo̍h-khì, tī lín ê ba̍k-chiu chêng siak kah chhùi-chhùi.

In-ūi lín só͘ hoān it-chhè ê chōe, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, jiá I siū-khì, góa koh chi̍t piàn phak tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng sì-cha̍p mî-ji̍t, bô chia̍h bô lim.
Hit-sî Siōng Chú tōa-tōa siū-khì, beh kā lín siau-bia̍t, góa chiū hui-siông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; m̄-kú Siōng Chú koh chi̍t piàn thiaⁿ góa ê khún-kiû.
Siōng Chú mā tùi A-lûn hui-siông siū-khì, sīm-chì beh hō͘ i sí; siâng hit-sî góa chiū ūi-tio̍h A-lûn kî-tó.

Góa the̍h lín hoān-chōe ê mi̍h, chiū-sī lín chù ê gû-á-siōng, ēng hé sio, kā i kòng-chhùi, géng kah chhin-chhiūⁿ thô͘-hún hiah-ni̍h iù, koh kā chiah-ê iā tī tùi soaⁿ-téng lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê khoe--ni̍h.
Lín tī Tha-pī-la, Má-sat, Ki-phok-lô Hap-tha-óa, koh kek Siōng Chú siū-khì.

Siōng Chú bēng-lēng lín lī-khui Ka-te-su Pa-nî-a, kóng, “Lín khì chiàm-léng góa siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe.” Hit-sî lín ûi-pōe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, m̄ siong-sìn I, m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn I ê ōe.
Tùi góa bat lín ê ji̍t khí, lín siông-siông pōe-ge̍k Siōng Chú.
Góa in-ūi Siōng Chú kóng beh siau-bia̍t lín, chiū sì-cha̍p mî-ji̍t phak tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.

Góa tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, kiû lí m̄-thang siau-bia̍t lí ê chú-bîn, lí ê sán-gia̍p; in sī lí ēng tōa koân-lêng kā in kiù-sio̍k, ēng tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú kā in tùi Ai-ki̍p chhōa--chhut-lâi ê chú-bîn.
Kiû lí ōe-kì-tit lí ê po̍k-jîn A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok; m̄-thang khòaⁿ chit-ê chú-bîn ê ngī-sim, siâ-ok, kap in ê chōe-kò,
chiah bián Ai-ki̍p -lâng kóng, ‘Siōng Chú bô hoat-tō͘ chhōa in ji̍p-khì I èng-ún in ê tōe, koh in-ūi oàn-hūn in, só͘-í chhōa in chhut--khì, beh tī khòng-iá kā in siau-bia̍t.’
M̄-kú in sī lí ê chú-bîn, lí ê sán-gia̍p; lí ū ēng tōa koân-lêng, koh chhun-chhut tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú kā in chhōa--chhut-lâi.”
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú kā góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h phah nn̄g tè kap í-chêng kâng-khoán ê chio̍h-pán, chiūⁿ-soaⁿ lâi góa chia, koh ēng bo̍k-châi chòe chi̍t ê kūi.
Lí téng-hôe siak-phòa ê chio̍h-pán téng-bīn ê ōe, góa beh koh siá tī chit nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán téng-bīn; lí tio̍h kā in hē tī hit-ê iok-kūi lāi-bīn.”
Góa chiū ēng kim-ha̍p-hoan-bo̍k chòe chi̍t ê kūi, koh phah nn̄g tè kap í-chêng kâng-khoán ê chio̍h-pán, jiân-āu chhin-chhiú the̍h chit nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán chiūⁿ-soaⁿ.

Siōng Chú chiong I tī tāi-hōe ê ji̍t, tī soaⁿ-téng ê hé-iām tiong tùi lín kóng ê cha̍p-tiâu-kài, chiàu í-chêng só͘ siá--ê siá tī hit nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán; Siōng Chú chiū chiong chiah-ê kau-tài góa.
Góa oa̍t-tńg-sin lo̍h-soaⁿ, chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, chiong chio̍h-pán hē tī góa chòe ê iok-kūi lāi-bīn; kàu hiān-chāi iáu tī hia.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi A-kan -lâng ê chúi-chíⁿ hia chhut-hoat, lâi kàu Mô͘-se-la. A-lûn sí tī hia, mā an-chòng tī hia; i ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat sòa-chiap i tam-jīm chè-si.
In tùi hia chhut-hoat, keng-kè Kok-ko-tāi, kàu Iok-pa-tha, tī hia ū chin chōe tiâu khoe.
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú kéng-soán Lī-bī chi-cho̍k kng Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi, khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng ho̍k-sāi I, hōng I ê miâ chiok-hok, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Só͘-í Lī-bī chi-cho̍k tī in tông-pau ê tiong-kan bô pun-tio̍h sán-gia̍p; chiàu Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kā in kóng--ê, Siōng Chú chiū-sī in ê sán-gia̍p.
Góa koh chi̍t piàn tī soaⁿ-téng sì-cha̍p mî-ji̍t; chit-piàn Siōng Chú koh thiaⁿ góa ê khún-kiû, bô kā lín siau-bia̍t.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Lí khí--lâi, chhōa chiah-ê jîn-bîn chìn-chêng, ji̍p-khì chiàm-léng góa tùi in ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè beh hō͘ in ê tōe.”

Í-sek-lia̍t ah, che chiū-sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tùi lín ê iau-kiû: Chí-ū kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, kiâⁿ I ê tō-lō͘, thiàⁿ I, choân-sim choân-chêng ho̍k-sāi I,
chun-siú góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ pan-pò͘ Siōng Chú ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē, hō͘ lín thang tit-tio̍h hok-khì.
Khòaⁿ leh, thiⁿ kap chì-koân ê thiⁿ, tōe kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê bān-mi̍h, lóng sio̍k Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Siōng Chú chí-ū ì-ài lín ê lia̍t-chó͘, thiàⁿ in, tī bān-bîn tiong kéng-soán in ê hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī lín, chhin-chhiūⁿ kin-á-ji̍t án-ni.
Só͘-í lín tio̍h kā lín ê sim kiâⁿ kat-lé, m̄-thang koh ngī-sim kò͘-chip.

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sī bān-sîn ê Sîn, bān-chú ê Chú, sī chì-tōa, koân-lêng, thang kiaⁿ-ùi ê Siōng-tè. I bōe khòaⁿ lâng ê sin-hūn tùi-thāi lâng, mā bōe siu hóe-lō͘;
I ūi-tio̍h ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū sin-oan, koh thiàⁿ chhut-gōa-lâng, hō͘ in chia̍h hō͘ in chhēng.
Lín tio̍h thiàⁿ chhut-gōa-lâng, in-ūi lín mā bat tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe chòe chhut-gōa-lâng.
Lín tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, ho̍k-sāi I, tiong-sêng kun-tè I, hōng I ê miâ chiù-chōa.
Lín tio̍h chheng-chàn I, I sī lín ê Siōng-tè; lín bat chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h I ūi-tio̍h lín chòe tōa koh thang-kiaⁿ ê sū.
Lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p ê sî chí-ū chhit-cha̍p lâng, hiān-chāi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè hō͘ lín chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ hiah-ni̍h chōe.
Lín tio̍h thiàⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, siông-siông chun-siú I só͘ hoan-hù--ê, I ê kui-lē, bēng-lēng, kài-bēng.

Lín tio̍h chai, góa kin-á-ji̍t sī tùi lín, m̄-sī tùi lín ê kiáⁿ-jî kóng-ōe, in m̄ chai, mā bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê koán-kàu, úi-tāi, I tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú kap chhun--chhut-lâi ê chhiú-kut,
í-ki̍p I tī Ai-ki̍p tùi Hoat-ló kap Ai-ki̍p choân-kok só͘ kiâⁿ ê sîn-jiah,
kap I án-chóaⁿ tùi-hù Ai-ki̍p ê kun-peng, chiàn-bé kap chiàn-chhia; chiū-sī tī in tui-jip lín ê sî, án-chóaⁿ hō͘ Âng-hái ê chúi kā in im-sí, thiat-tóe kā in siau-bia̍t;
koh lín lâi kàu chit-ê só͘-chāi í-chêng, I tī khòng-iá án-chóaⁿ khoán-thāi lín,

koh I án-chóaⁿ tùi-hù Lū-piān ê hō͘-tāi Í-lī-ap ê kiáⁿ Tāi-tan kap A-pí-lân; tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bīn-chêng hō͘ tōe khui-chhùi thun-bia̍t in, in ê ka-sio̍k, in ê pò͘-pîⁿ, í-ki̍p in só͘-ū ê lô͘-po̍k kap cheng-siⁿ.
Chí-ū lín ū chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú só͘ chòe it-chhè úi-tāi ê chok-ûi.
Lín tio̍h chun-siú góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín it-chhè ê kài-bēng, lín chiah ū khùi-la̍t ji̍p-khì chiàm-léng lín beh kè-khì sêng-chiap ê tōe;
koh hō͘ lín ōe-tàng kú-tn̂g khiā-khí tī Siōng Chú li̍p-sè beh siúⁿ-sù lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ kap in ê hō͘-tāi ê tōe, chiū-sī hit-ê lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe.
Lín beh ji̍p-khì sêng-chiap ê tōe, kap lín tùi hia chhut--lâi ê Ai-ki̍p -tōe bô kâng-khoán; lín tī hia ê chhài-hn̂g tio̍h iā chéng-chí, ta̍h chúi-chhia koàn-khài;
m̄-kú lín beh ji̍p-khì sêng-chiap ê tōe sī ū soaⁿ, ū soaⁿ-kok, koh ū hō͘-chúi lūn-te̍k ê thó͘-tōe;
sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kui-nî-thàng-thiⁿ teh chiàu-kò͘, ba̍k-chiu siông-siông teh khòaⁿ-kò͘ ê tōe.
Lín nā chin-chiàⁿ thiaⁿ-thàn góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín ê kài-bēng, thiàⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, choân-sim choân-chêng ho̍k-sāi I,
I chiū beh chiàu-sî ūi-tio̍h lín ê thó͘-tōe lo̍h chhun-lîm chhiu-ú, hō͘ lín thang siu-sêng ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, kap sin-iû,
mā hō͘ lín ê chhân-iá hoat-chháu, thang chhī cheng-siⁿ; án-ni lín chiū beh tit-tio̍h pá-chiok.
Tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bián lín ê sim siū bê-he̍k, lī-khui Siōng Chú khì ho̍k-sāi kèng-pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng,
tì-kàu Siōng Chú tùi lín hoat tōa siū-khì, chiong thiⁿ koaiⁿ-ba̍t bô lo̍h-hō͘, tōe bô chhut-sán, lín chiū ōe chin kín tī Siōng Chú só͘ siúⁿ-sù lín súi ê tōe bia̍t-bông.
Lín tio̍h chiong góa ê ōe kì tī lín ê sim-lāi, chûn tī lín ê ì-liām, mā tio̍h pa̍k tī chhiú--ni̍h chòe kì-hō, pa̍k tī thâu-hia̍h thê-chhíⁿ;
koh tio̍h kà-sī lín ê kiáⁿ-jî, bô-lūn tī chhù-lāi chē, tī lō͘--ni̍h kiâⁿ, tó--teh á-sī khí--lâi, lóng tio̍h liām hō͘ in thiaⁿ;
tio̍h siá tī chhù ê mn̂g-khiā, mā tio̍h siá tī siâⁿ-mn̂g;
án-ni, lín kap lín ê kiáⁿ-sun chiū thang tī Siōng Chú tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè siúⁿ-sù in ê thó͘-tōe kú-tn̂g khiā-khí, chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ tōe chûn-chāi hiah kú.
Lín nā chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng góa só͘ bēng-lēng lín it-chhè ê kài-bēng, thiàⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, kiâⁿ I ê tō-lō͘, tiong-sêng kun-tè I,
Siōng Chú chiū beh tī lín bīn-chêng chiong chiah-ê jîn-bîn kóaⁿ-cháu, lín mā beh cheng-ho̍k chiah-ê pí lín khah kiông-tāi ê kok.

Lín ê kha ta̍h--kè ê tōe lóng beh chòe lín ê sán-gia̍p; tùi lâm-pêng ê khòng-iá kàu pak-pêng ê Lê-pa-lūn, tùi tang-pêng ê Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô kàu sai-pêng ê Tōe-tiong-hái, lóng beh chiâⁿ-chòe lín ê léng-thó͘.
Bô chi̍t ê lâng ōe-tàng tùi-khòng lín; Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè beh chiàu I tùi lín ê èng-ún, hō͘ lín ta̍h--kè ê tōe ê chū-bîn lóng kiaⁿ lín, lún lín.
Khòaⁿ leh, góa kin-á-ji̍t chiong chiok-hok kap chiù-chó͘ pâi tī lín ê bīn-chêng;
lín nā chun-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng, chiū-sī góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín--ê, chiū ōe tit-tio̍h chiok-hok;

lín nā m̄ sūn-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng, phian-lī góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín tio̍h kiâⁿ ê tō-lō͘, khì kun-tè lín m̄-bat ê sîn-bêng, chiū ōe siū chiù-chó͘.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chhōa lín ji̍p-khì chiàm-léng hiah-ê tōe ê sî, lín tio̍h tī Ki-lī-sim-soaⁿ soan-pò͘ chiok-hok, tī Í-pa-lō͘-soaⁿ soan-pò͘ chiù-chó͘.

Chit nn̄g ê soaⁿ sī tī Iok-tàn-hô sai-pêng ji̍t lo̍h ê só͘-chāi, chiū-sī tī Ka-lâm -lâng khiā-khí ê A-la-pa tōe-khu, kap Kiat-kah sio-tùi, óa-kūn Mô͘-lī siōng-chhiū ê só͘-chāi.
Lín teh-beh kè Iok-tàn-hô, ji̍p-khì tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù hō͘ lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe, tī hia khiā-khí.
Lín tio̍h un-khûn chun-hêng góa kin-á-ji̍t pan-pò͘ hō͘ lín it-chhè ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng.
Lín tòa tī Siōng Chú — lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe ê sî, tio̍h chun-siú ē-bīn chiah-ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng.
Lín beh chiàm-léng ê kok-ka, in ê jîn-bîn teh ho̍k-sāi sîn-bêng ê só͘-chāi, bô-lūn tī koân-soaⁿ, tī sió-soaⁿ, tī chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū ē-bīn, lóng tio̍h kā húi-hoāi;
