lín mā tio̍h thiah-húi in ê chè-tôaⁿ, kòng-chhùi in ê chio̍h-thiāu-siōng, ēng hé sio in ê A-sià-la lú-sîn ê sîn-siōng, chhò-tn̄g in tiau-khek ê ngó͘-siōng, hō͘ lâng bōe koh khì hiah-ê só͘-chāi kèng-pài.
Lín m̄-thang o̍h in ê hong-sek ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Chí-ū thang tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chiong-lâi tùi lín ê chi-cho̍k kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi kèng-pài I, chhē-kiû I;

chiong lín ê sio-hòa-chè, pa̍t-khoán ê chè-mi̍h, cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê hōng-hiàn, kî-tha ê lé-mi̍h, siā-goān ê chè, kam-sim hiàn ê chè, í-ki̍p thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê gû kap iûⁿ, lóng tòa-khì hia.
Tī hia, lín kap lín ê ka-koàn tio̍h tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng lim-chia̍h, ūi-tio̍h I tī lín só͘ chòe ê it-chhè kā lín sù-hok lâi hoaⁿ-hí.

Lán kin-á-ji̍t iáu-bē khì kàu Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lán an-hioh kap chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe, ta̍k-ê lâng chiàu ka-kī khòaⁿ-chòe tio̍h--ê khì chòe, chiong-lâi ji̍p-khì liáu-āu chiū m̄-thang án-ni.
Lín kè Iok-tàn-hô, khì tòa tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè hō͘ lín sêng-chiap ê tōe, koh hō͘ lín bô siū sì-ûi tùi-te̍k ê kiáu-jiáu, tit-tio̍h thài-pêng, an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p;

hit-sî, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe kéng-soán chi̍t ê hō͘ lín thang kèng-pài I ê só͘-chāi, lín tio̍h chiàu góa ê bēng-lēng, chiong sio-hòa-chè, pa̍t-khoán ê chè-mi̍h, cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê hōng-hiàn, kî-tha ê lé-mi̍h, í-ki̍p lín tùi Siōng Chú hē-goān beh hiàn ê hó-mi̍h, lóng tòa-khì hia hiàn hō͘ I.

Lín kap lín ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lô͘-po̍k, lú-pī, lóng tio̍h kap tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê Lī-bī -lâng, tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí; tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, Lī-bī -lâng tī lín tiong-kan bô pun-tio̍h sán-gia̍p.
Lín tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang tī lín khòaⁿ kah-ì ê só͘-chāi hiàn sio-hòa-chè;
chí-ū thang tī Siōng Chú só͘ kéng-soán bó͘ chi̍t ê chi-cho̍k ê só͘-chāi hiàn sio-hòa-chè, koh tī hia chiàu góa só͘ bēng-lēng lín ê it-chhè khì chòe.

Lín tī lín tòa ê só͘-chāi, thang chiàu Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín ê hok-hūn, chiàu lín ê ì-sù thâi cheng-siⁿ chia̍h-bah; bô-lūn lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì á-sī bô chheng-khì ê lâng lóng thang chia̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chia̍h lêng-iûⁿ kap lo̍k.
M̄-kú huih m̄-thang chia̍h, tio̍h piàⁿ tī thô͘-kha, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh piàⁿ-chúi.

Lín ê ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, sin-iû, cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê hōng-hiàn, thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê gû iûⁿ, hē-goān beh hiàn ê mi̍h, kam-sim hiàn ê chè, á-sī kî-tha ê lé-mi̍h, lóng m̄-thang tī lín tòa ê só͘-chāi chia̍h;

chí-ū thang tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi, kap lí ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lô͘-po̍k, lú-pī, í-ki̍p tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê Lī-bī -lâng, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng chòe-hé lim-chia̍h, chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí, hióng-siū lín ê chhiú só͘ chòe ê sêng-kó.
Tio̍h kín-sīn, lín tòa tī lín ê thó͘-tōe, tio̍h éng-oán chiàu-kò͘ Lī-bī -lâng.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chiàu I ê èng-ún hō͘ lín ê thó͘-tōe khok-tián ê sî, lín nā siūⁿ-kóng beh chia̍h-bah, chiū thang chiàu lín ê ì-sù chia̍h.

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán beh chòe lín kèng-pài I ê só͘-chāi nā lī lín chin hn̄g, lín thang chiàu góa ê bēng-lēng, chiong Siōng Chú siúⁿ-sù ê gû, iûⁿ, chiàu lín só͘ ài, tī lín tòa ê só͘-chāi thâi lâi chia̍h.
Lín lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì kap bô chheng-khì ê lâng thang chòe-hé chia̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chia̍h lêng-iûⁿ kap lo̍k.
M̄-kú choa̍t-tùi m̄-thang chia̍h huih, in-ūi huih sī sìⁿ-miā; lín m̄-thang bah kap sìⁿ-miā chòe-hé chia̍h.
Huih m̄-thang chia̍h, tio̍h piàⁿ tī thô͘-kha, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh piàⁿ-chúi.
M̄-thang chia̍h huih, lín kap lín ê hō͘-tāi chiū ōe tit-tio̍h hok-khì, in-ūi lín án-ni chòe sī Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe tio̍h ê sū.
Lín ê chè-mi̍h kap siā-goān ê chè, lóng tio̍h tòa-khì Siōng Chú beh kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi.

Lín ê sio-hòa-chè ê bah kap huih, tio̍h hiàn tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê chè-tôaⁿ téng; kî-tha ê chè-mi̍h, huih tio̍h piàⁿ tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê tôaⁿ-téng; bah, lín thang chia̍h.

Góa só͘ bēng-lēng lín chiah-ê ōe, lín lóng tio̍h chun-siú thiaⁿ-thàn, chòe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe hó, khòaⁿ-chòe tio̍h ê sū; án-ni lín kap lín ê hō͘-tāi chiū ōe éng-oán tit-tio̍h hok-khì.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tī lín ê bīn-chêng chiong hiah-ê kok ê jîn-bîn kóaⁿ-cháu, siau-bia̍t, hō͘ lín chiàm-léng in ê tōe, tī hia khiā-khí;

hit-sî, lín tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang tī in siau-bia̍t liáu-āu o̍h in, soah hām-lo̍h in ê lô-bāng; m̄-thang thàm-thiaⁿ in pài sîn-bêng ê sū, kóng, “Chiah-ê jîn-bîn án-chóaⁿ teh ho̍k-sāi in ê sîn-bêng, goán mā beh án-ni chòe.”

Lín m̄-thang ēng in ê hong-sek ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, in-ūi in ho̍k-sāi in ê sîn-bêng ê sî, chòe Siōng Chú thòng-hūn iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, sīm-chì sio in ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hiàn hō͘ in ê sîn-bêng.
Góa bēng-lēng lín--ê, lín lóng tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng; m̄-thang ke-thiⁿ, mā m̄-thang kiám-chió.
Lín tiong-kan nā ū sian-ti á-sī choh-bāng--ê chhut-hiān, kiâⁿ sîn-jiah kî-sū hō͘ lín khòaⁿ,
tùi lín kóng, “Lán lâi-khì kèng-pài ho̍k-sāi lín m̄-bat ê sîn-bêng.” Sui-jiân in só͘ kiâⁿ ê sîn-jiah kî-sū ū si̍t-hiān,
lín mā m̄-thang thiaⁿ-thàn hit-ê sian-ti á-sī choh-bāng--ê ê ōe; in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè teh khó-giām lín, ài chai lín sī m̄-sī choân-sim choân-chêng thiàⁿ I.
Lín tio̍h sūn-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, kèng-ùi I, chun-siú I ê kài-bēng, thiaⁿ-thàn I ê ōe, ho̍k-sāi I, tiong-sêng kun-tè I.

Hit-ê sian-ti á-sī choh-bāng--ê tio̍h kā i chhú-sí, in-ūi i ín-iú lín pōe-poān chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p, kiù-sio̍k lín thoat-lī chòe lô͘-châi ê ke ê Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, hō͘ lín phian-lī I bēng-lēng lín tio̍h kiâⁿ ê tō-lō͘; án-ni, chiū tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì hit-ê siâ-ok ê sū.

Lín kâng-bú ê hiaⁿ-tī, á-sī lín ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lín só͘ thiàⁿ ê bó͘, chhin-bi̍t ê pêng-iú, nā ū lâng àm-tiong ín-iú lín, kóng, “Lán lâi-khì pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng.” Hiah-ê sîn-bêng sī lín kap lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ m̄ bat--ê,
sī sì-ûi ê bîn-cho̍k, put-koán lī-khui lín hn̄g á-sī kūn, á-sī tī chit-ê tōe jīm-hô só͘-chāi teh pài--ê.
Lín m̄-thang thiaⁿ-thàn i, m̄-thang tông-chêng, m̄-thang sioh i, mā m̄-thang am-hō͘ i.
Lín it-tēng tio̍h kā i chhú-sí; lín tio̍h seng hē-chhiú, jiân-āu chèng-lâng hē-chhiú hō͘ i sí.
Lín tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu kā tìm-sí, in-ūi i siūⁿ-beh ín-iú lín phian-lī chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p, thoat-lī chòe lô͘-châi ê ke ê Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū ōe kiaⁿ, bô lâng káⁿ koh chòe chit-khoán khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.
Tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín khiā-khí ê siâⁿ, lín nā thiaⁿ-kìⁿ
ū pháiⁿ-lâng chhut-lâi ín-iú siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng, kóng, “Lán lâi-khì ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng.” Chiah-ê sîn-bêng sī lín m̄ bat--ê;
lín chiū tio̍h thàm-thiaⁿ, tiâu-cha, siông-sè chhâ-mn̄g; lín tiong-kan nā chin-chiàⁿ ū chit-khoán khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū,
lín it-tēng tio̍h ēng to thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi ê chū-bîn, kap siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū--ê, í-ki̍p in ê cheng-siⁿ.

Lín tio̍h chiong hit-ê siâⁿ ê châi-bu̍t thia̍p tī kóng-tiûⁿ, ēng hé sio siâⁿ kap lóng-chóng ê châi-bu̍t, kui hō͘ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, hō͘ hit-ê siâⁿ éng-oán hong-hòe, bōe-ēng-tit tiông-kiàn.

Só͘-ū eng-kai húi-bia̍t ê mi̍h, liân chi̍t hāng to m̄-thang the̍h, án-ni Siōng Chú chiū ōe hôe-sim-tńg-ì, bô hoat tōa siū-khì, tian-tò si-un hō͘ lín, lîn-bín lín, chiàu I tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ só͘ li̍p-sè--ê, hō͘ lín lâng-gia̍h ke-thiⁿ;

in-ūi lín thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, chun-siú góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín I it-chhè ê kài-bēng, chòe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe tio̍h ê sū.
Lín sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn, m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h sí-lâng koah-siong ka-kī ê seng-khu, á-sī thâu-hia̍h thì-kng-kng,
in-ūi lín sī kui-sio̍k Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sèng-kiat ê chú-bîn; Siōng Chú ū tùi tōe-chiūⁿ bān-bîn ê tiong-kan kéng-soán lín, chòe I te̍k-pia̍t ê chú-bîn.
Só͘-ū thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê mi̍h, lín lóng m̄-thang chia̍h.
Ē-bīn sī lín thang chia̍h ê cheng-siⁿ: gû, mî-iûⁿ, soaⁿ-iûⁿ,
lo̍k, lêng-iûⁿ, chhiah-lo̍k, iá-soaⁿ-iûⁿ, bî-lo̍k, chhiah-iûⁿ, kiuⁿ-á.
Só͘-ū pun-tôe koh hoan-chháu ê cheng-siⁿ, lín lóng thang chia̍h.

M̄-kú, kan-ta ū hoan-chháu, á-sī kan-ta ū pun-tôe ê cheng-siⁿ, lín m̄-thang chia̍h, chiū-sī: lo̍k-tô, thò͘-á, chio̍h-hoan, in-ūi in ū hoan-chháu bô pun-tôe, tùi lín sī bô chheng-khì.
Ti, ū pun-tôe, m̄-kú bô hoan-chháu, tùi lín mā-sī bô chheng-khì. Chiah-ê tōng-bu̍t ê bah lín m̄-thang chia̍h; in ê si-thé mā m̄-thang bong.
Chúi-tiong ū-kî ū-lân--ê, lín lóng thang chia̍h;
só͘-ū bô-kî bô-lân--ê, lín m̄-thang chia̍h, in-ūi in tùi lín sī bô chheng-khì.
Chheng-khì ê chiáu, lín lóng thang chia̍h.
M̄-thang chia̍h--ê sī: eng, hiau, tiau,
iân, sió-eng, bā-hio̍h kap i ê lūi,
o͘-a kap i ê lūi,
tô-chiáu, iā-eng, hî-eng, chhiok-eng kap i ê lūi,
àm-kong-chiáu, ko͘-n̂g, niau-thâu-eng,
thê-ô͘, chhàu-thâu-eng, lô͘-chî,
ho̍h, pe̍h-lēng-si kap i ê lūi, tì-kè-chiáu, kap bi̍t-pô.
Só͘-ū ū-si̍t koh ōe-sô--ê, tùi lín sī bô chheng-khì, lín m̄-thang chia̍h;
m̄-kú ōe pe koh chheng-khì--ê, lín lóng thang chia̍h.

Chū-jiân sí ê tōng-bu̍t, lín lóng m̄-thang chia̍h, m̄-kú thang hō͘ lín siâⁿ-lāi kià-ku ê lâng chia̍h, á-sī bōe hō͘ gōa-cho̍k-lâng; in-ūi lín sī kui hō͘ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sèng-kiat ê chú-bîn. M̄-thang ēng soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú ê lin chú i ê kiáⁿ.
Ta̍k-nî, lín tio̍h tùi iā-chéng só͘ siu-sêng chhân-hn̂g ê chhut-sán, cha̍p hūn thiu chi̍t hūn.

Lín tio̍h tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán hō͘ lín ho̍k-sāi I ê só͘-chāi, tī I ê bīn-chêng chia̍h só͘ hōng-hiàn cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê ngó͘-kok, chiú, iû, kap thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê gû iûⁿ; án-ni lín thang ha̍k-si̍p siông-siông kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sù-hok lín, I só͘ kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi nā lī lín siuⁿ hn̄g, lín bōe-tàng tòa beh hōng-hiàn ê chè-mi̍h khì hia,
lín thang ōaⁿ chòe gûn, kā i pau--khí-lâi, the̍h tī chhiú--ni̍h, khì Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán hō͘ lín kèng-pài I ê só͘-chāi.

Lín thang chiàu lín ê ì-sù ēng chiah-ê gûn bóe gû, iûⁿ, po̍h-chiú, kāu-chiú, á-sī kî-tha lín khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê mi̍h; tī hia, lín kap lín ê ka-koàn tio̍h tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng chòe-hé lim-chia̍h hoaⁿ-hí.
Lín tio̍h chiàu-kò͘ tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê Lī-bī -lâng, in-ūi in tī lín tiong-kan bô pun-tio̍h sán-gia̍p.
Múi saⁿ nî, tio̍h chiong tē-saⁿ nî siu-sêng ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t, ūn-lâi khǹg tī siâⁿ-lāi;

lín tiong-kan bô pun-tio̍h sán-gia̍p ê Lī-bī -lâng, í-ki̍p tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê chhut-gōa-lâng, ko͘-jî, kap kóaⁿ-hū, lóng thang lâi chia̍h kàu pá; án-ni, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe in-ūi lín só͘ chòe chiah-ê it-chhè ê sū, sù hok-khì hō͘ lín.
Ta̍k-piàn móa chhit nî, lín tio̍h bián-tû it-chhè ê chè-bū.

Ē-bīn sī bián-tû chè-bū ê kui-lē: Chè-chú chioh hō͘ chhù-piⁿ--ê, tio̍h bián-tû in ê chè-bū; m̄-thang tùi lín ê chhù-piⁿ, chiū-sī lín ê tông-pau, thó in khiàm--lín-ê; in-ūi Siōng Chú í-keng soan-pò͘ chè-bū bián-tû.
Gōa-cho̍k-lâng lín thang kā in thó; m̄-kú lín chioh hō͘ tông-pau--ê, tio̍h kā in bián-tû.

Lín nā chin-chiàⁿ thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, chun-hêng góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín it-chhè ê kài-bēng, lín chiū bōe ū sàn-chhiah-lâng; in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe tī I siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe tōa-tōa sù-hok lín.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe chiàu I ê èng-ún sù-hok lín; lín ōe chioh hō͘ chin chōe kok, m̄-bián kā in chioh; lín ōe koán-hat chin chōe kok, in bōe kā lín koán-hat.
Tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe, bô-lūn tó chi̍t ê siâⁿ, nā ū sàn-chhiah ê tông-pau, lín m̄-thang ngī-sim, chhiú kiu--khí-lâi bô beh pang-chān i;
lín it-tēng tio̍h chhun-chhiú pang-chān i, chiàu i ê su-iàu chioh i, pó͘ i ê khiàm-kheh.

Tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bián lín sim-lāi ū pháiⁿ liām-thâu, kóng “Tē-chhit nî, bián-tû chè-bū ê nî teh-beh kàu lah”, chiū tùi lín sàn-chhiah ê tông-pau tàng-sng, m̄ hō͘ i; i nā ūi-tio̍h lín ê iân-kò͘ kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, lín chiū ū chōe.
Lín it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i, hō͘ i ê sî tio̍h kam-sim, in-ūi tùi chit-ê sū, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe tī lín it-chhè ê kang-chok kap lín ê só͘-chòe sù-hok lín.

Tī hit-ê só͘-chāi, siông-siông ōe ū sàn-chhiah-lâng, só͘-í góa bēng-lēng lín, tī lín khiā-khí ê tōe, it-tēng tio̍h chhun-chhiú pang-chān lín sàn-chhiah khùn-khó͘ ê tông-pau.
Lí ê Í-sek-lia̍t tông-pau bô-lūn lâm lú, bōe hō͘ lí chòe lô͘-lē, ho̍k-sāi lí la̍k nî, kàu tē-chhit nî, lí tio̍h kā i tháu-pàng hō͘ i chū-iû lī-khui.
Lí tháu-pàng i ê sî, m̄-thang hō͘ i khang-chhiú lī-khui;
tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lí ê iûⁿ, ngó͘-kok, chiú the̍h chi̍t-pō͘-hūn, hō͘ i siang-chhiú móa-móa chhut--khì.
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit lín bat tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe chòe lô͘-châi, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ū kiù-sio̍k lín, só͘-í, góa kin-á-ji̍t chiong chit-ê sū bēng-lēng lín.
Lí ê lô͘-lē nā tùi lí kóng “Góa bô beh lī-khui lí”, in-ūi i thiàⁿ lí kap lí ê ke, koh chin ài kap lí chòe-hé tòa;
lí tio̍h hō͘ i óa mn̂g-sìⁿ, ēng chǹg-á kā i ê hī-á chǹg-khang, i chiū éng-oán chòe lí ê lô͘-lē. Lí mā tio̍h án-ni tùi-thāi lí ê lú-pī.

Lí kā i tháu-pàng hō͘ i chū-iû lī-khui ê sî, m̄-thang m̄ kam-goān, in-ūi i ho̍k-sāi lí la̍k nî, i só͘ chòe ê kang sī chhiàⁿ--lâi ê kang-lâng ê têng-pē; Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe tī lí só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū, sù-hok lí.

Só͘-ū thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ kang ê gû iûⁿ, tio̍h hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng kui Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè; thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê gû m̄-thang choh-kang, thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê iûⁿ m̄-thang kā chián-mn̂g.
Lín kap lín ê ka-koàn, ta̍k-nî tio̍h tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi, tī I ê bīn-chêng chia̍h chiah-ê gû iûⁿ ê bah.
Nā ū phòa-siùⁿ, bô-lūn sī kha-pái, sit-bêng, á-sī ū sím-mi̍h giâm-tiōng ê hâ-chhû, lóng m̄-thang chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.

Chit-khoán gû iûⁿ ê bah, lín thang tī lín tòa ê só͘-chāi chia̍h, bô-lūn lé-gî-siōng chheng-khì á-sī bô chheng-khì ê lâng lóng thang chia̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chia̍h lêng-iûⁿ kap lo̍k.
M̄-kú huih m̄-thang chia̍h, tio̍h piàⁿ tī thô͘-kha, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh piàⁿ-chúi.
Lín tio̍h tī A-pit-ge̍h siú Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh; in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tī A-pit-ge̍h ê chi̍t ê àm-mî chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p.
Tio̍h tī Siōng Chú kéng-soán hō͘ lín ho̍k-sāi I ê só͘-chāi, ǹg Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè hiàn gû kap iûⁿ chòe Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê chè-mi̍h.

Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê chia̍h-mi̍h m̄-thang ū kàⁿ. Lín tio̍h chia̍h bô-kàⁿ ê piáⁿ chhit ji̍t, in-ūi lín lī-khui Ai-ki̍p -tōe ê sî chin kóaⁿ-kín, chia̍h--ê sī bô-kàⁿ ê piáⁿ. Chit-chióng piáⁿ mā kiò-chòe khùn-khó͘ ê piáⁿ, lín tio̍h chia̍h, hō͘ lín it-seng kì-liām chhut Ai-ki̍p, thoat-lī khó͘-lān ê ji̍t.
Tī lín ê kéng-lāi, chhit ji̍t kú ta̍k-ê lâng ê chhù lóng m̄-thang ū kàⁿ; thâu chi̍t ji̍t ē-hng só͘ hiàn ê chè-bah, m̄-thang lâu kàu thiⁿ-kng.
Lín m̄-thang tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín jīm-hô chi̍t ê siâⁿ hiàn Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê chè,
chí-ū thang tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán hō͘ lín ho̍k-sāi I ê só͘-chāi hiàn; tio̍h tī ji̍t lo̍h ê sî hiàn, in-ūi lín tī ji̍t lo̍h ê sî chhut Ai-ki̍p.
Tio̍h tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi hang lâi chia̍h; keh-chá-khí chiah tò-khì lín tau.
Lín tio̍h chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ la̍k ji̍t; tē-chhit ji̍t kú-hêng giâm-siok-hōe kèng-pài Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, m̄-thang chòe kang.
Lín tio̍h tùi ēng liâm-le̍k-á siu-koah ê ji̍t khai-sí, sǹg chhit ê chhit ji̍t,
siú Chhit-chhit Siu-koah-choeh kèng-pài Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, chiàu I sù-hok hō͘ lín ê siu-sêng, kam-sim hiàn lé-mi̍h hō͘ I.

Lín kap lín ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lô͘-po̍k, lú-pī, kap tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê Lī-bī -lâng, kap gōa-cho̍k-lâng, í-ki̍p ko͘-jî, kóaⁿ-hū, lóng tio̍h tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán hō͘ lín ho̍k-sāi I ê só͘-chāi, tī I ê bīn-chêng chòe-hé khèng-chiok.
Lín tio̍h ōe-kì-tit lín bat tī Ai-ki̍p chòe lô͘-châi; lín tio̍h chun-hêng chiah-ê kui-lē.
Lín siu-khǹg ngó͘-kok kap sin-chiú liáu-āu, tio̍h siú Tah-liâu-choeh chhit ji̍t.

Tī choeh-kî tiong, lín kap lín ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lô͘-po̍k, lú-pī, kap tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê Lī-bī -lâng, gōa-cho̍k-lâng, í-ki̍p ko͘-jî, kóaⁿ-hū, lóng tio̍h chòe-hé khèng-chiok.

Lín tio̍h tī Siōng Chú kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi, siú-choeh chhit ji̍t kèng-pài I. Tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí siú-choeh, in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ū sù-hok lín, hō͘ lín hong-siu, sū-sū sūn-lī.

Lín só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng lóng tio̍h chi̍t nî saⁿ piàn, tī Tû-kàⁿ-choeh, Chhit-chhit Siu-koah-choeh, Tah-liâu-choeh, kàu Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi kèng-pài I; m̄-thang khang-chhiú kìⁿ Siōng Chú.
Ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h chiàu Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín ê hok-hūn, chīn ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t hōng-hiàn.
Lín tio̍h tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín khiā-khí ê siâⁿ, ūi-tio̍h ta̍k chi-cho̍k jīm-bēng sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ kap koaⁿ-oân; in tio̍h chiàu kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ jîn-bîn.

Lín sím-phòaⁿ m̄-thang tian-tò sī-hui, m̄-thang phian-thán, mā m̄-thang chiap-siū hóe-lō͘; in-ūi hóe-lō͘ ōe hō͘ tì-hūi ê lâng pìⁿ-chòe chhiⁿ-mî, koh ōe oai-khiok chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ê chèng-sû.
Lín tio̍h tui-kiû kong-pêng chèng-gī, hō͘ lín tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe kú-tn̂g khiā-khí.
Lín ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè khí chè-tôaⁿ, m̄-thang tī piⁿ--á chhāi A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng;
mā m̄-thang chhāi chio̍h-thiāu-siōng; chiah-ê lóng sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè thòng-hūn iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê.
Só͘-ū phòa-siùⁿ, á-sī ū hâ-chhû ê gû iûⁿ, lín m̄-thang hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, in-ūi án-ni chòe sī Siōng Chú só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê.
Tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín ê siâⁿ, nā ū lâng, bô-lūn lâm lú, chòe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, ûi-pōe I ê iok,
khì ho̍k-sāi kèng-pài Siōng Chú só͘ kìm-chí hiah-ê sîn-bêng, kap ji̍t-thâu, ge̍h-niû, thiⁿ-téng ê bān-siōng;

nā ū lâng kā lín kóng ū lâng chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì, lín mā í-keng thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū tio̍h siông-sè tiâu-cha; nā kó-jiân sī sū-si̍t, chin-chiàⁿ tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan ū chit-khoán khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū,
lín tio̍h chiong hit-ê lâng thoa-khì kóng-tiûⁿ, ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí.
Nā ū nn̄g ê á-sī saⁿ ê lâng chhut-lâi choh-chèng, tio̍h hō͘ hit-ê lâng sí; nā kan-ta chi̍t ê chèng-jîn, chiū m̄-thang hō͘ i sí.
Chèng-jîn tio̍h seng chhut-chhiú tìm i, jiân-āu chèng-lâng hē-chhiú hō͘ i sí; án-ni chiū tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì chit-khoán siâ-ok ê sū.
Lín siâⁿ-lāi nā ū oh-tit phòaⁿ-toàn ê àn-kiāⁿ, bô-lūn sī thâi-lâng, á-sī sio-kò, á-sī siong-hāi, lín tio̍h khì Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi,
chhéng-būn Lī-bī -lâng chòe chè-si--ê, kap ti̍t-pan ê sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, in ōe chí-tō lín tio̍h án-chóaⁿ phòaⁿ-koat.
In tī Siōng Chú kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi chí-tō lín--ê, lín tio̍h chiàu án-ni chòe; in kà-sī lín--ê, tio̍h chiàu án-ni chun-hêng.
In tùi lín ê chí-tō, kap tùi lín kóng ê phòaⁿ-koat, lín lóng tio̍h chiàu án-ni chòe, m̄-thang phian-chó-phian-iū.

Nā ū lâng kiau-ngō͘ m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú ê chè-si, á-sī sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, hit-ê lâng tio̍h hō͘ i sí; án-ni lín chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan tû-khì chit-khoán siâ-ok ê sū;
chèng-lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū ōe kiaⁿ, bô lâng káⁿ koh kiau-ngō͘ m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn.
Lín chìn-ji̍p Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè hō͘ lín chiàm-léng ê tōe, tī hia khiā-khí, nā koat-tēng beh chhin-chhiūⁿ sì-ûi ê lia̍t-kok siat-li̍p ông tī-lí lín,

lín it-tēng tio̍h siat-li̍p Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán ê lâng choh-ông; tio̍h tùi lín ê tông-pau siat-li̍p ông tī-lí lín; m̄-thang hō͘ m̄-sī lín tông-pau ê gōa-kok-lâng tī-lí lín.

Ông m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ke-thiⁿ chin chōe bé, mā m̄-thang in-ūi ài-beh khah chōe bé, hō͘ jîn-bîn tò-khì Ai-ki̍p; in-ūi Siōng Chú bat bēng-lēng lín, kóng, “Lín m̄-thang koh tò-khì hit-tiâu lō͘.”
Ông mā m̄-thang chhōa chin chōe pîn-hui, chiah bián i ê sim siū ín-iú lī-khui Siōng Chú; i mā m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h ka-kī lúi-chek chin chōe kim-gûn.
Ông khai-sí chē-ūi ê sî, tio̍h chiàu Lī-bī -lâng chòe chè-si--ê só͘ pó-chûn ê Lu̍t-hoat-su, ūi ka-kī chhau-siá chi̍t hūn.
Chit-hūn tio̍h hē tī ông hia, hō͘ ông chi̍t-sì-lâng tha̍k, thang ha̍k-si̍p kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè, chun-hêng chit-ê lu̍t-hoat it-chhè ê ōe kap só͘-ū ê lu̍t-lē;
chiah bián i chū-ko khòaⁿ-khin tông-pau, lī-khui chit-ê kài-bēng, phian-chó-phian-iū; thang hō͘ i kap i ê hō͘-tāi kú-tn̂g tī-lí Í-sek-lia̍t -kok.

Lī-bī -lâng chòe chè-si--ê, kap choân Lī-bī chi-cho̍k, tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan bô pun-tio̍h sán-gia̍p; in thang chia̍h ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h, chiah-ê sī in ê hūn-gia̍h.
In tī in ê tông-pau tiong-kan bô pun-tio̍h sán-gia̍p; chiàu Siōng Chú tùi in ê èng-ún, Siōng Chú chiū-sī in ê sán-gia̍p.
Ē-bīn sī chè-si tùi jîn-bîn eng-kai tit--tio̍h ê hūn-gia̍h: Lâng hiàn gû iûⁿ chòe chè-mi̍h, tio̍h chiong chêng-thúi, nn̄g ê chhùi-phóe, kap tō͘, hō͘ chè-si.
Khí-thâu siu-sêng ê ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, sin-iû, kap tú-tú chián ê iûⁿ-mn̂g, mā lóng tio̍h hō͘ in.
In-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tùi lín ê chi-cho̍k tiong-kan kéng-soán in, hō͘ in kap in ê hō͘-tāi, hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ éng-oán khiā tī I ê bīn-chêng sū-hōng.
Nā ū Lī-bī -lâng, bô-lūn in tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t kéng-lāi tó chi̍t chō siâⁿ, it-sim-it-ì beh lī-khui hia khì Siōng Chú kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi ho̍k-sāi,
in thang chhin-chhiūⁿ kâng chong-cho̍k ê hiaⁿ-tī, hōng Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè ê miâ khiā tī I ê bīn-chêng sū-hōng.
Tû-liáu bōe chó͘-sán tit--tio̍h-ê í-gōa, in iû-goân thang tit-tio̍h kâng-khoán hūn-gia̍h ê chè-mi̍h.
Lín nā chìn-ji̍p Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe, m̄-thang o̍h hiah-ê bîn-cho̍k khó-ò͘ⁿ ê hong-sio̍k.
Lín m̄-thang sio ka-kī ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hiàn-chòe chè, kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t, pok-kòa, khòaⁿ-miā, chòe sai-kong,
ōe-hû, chòe tâng-ki, chòe toh-thâu, khan-bông;
só͘-ū chòe chiah-ê sū ê lâng, lóng sī Siōng Chú só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ; hiah-ê bîn-cho̍k in-ūi chòe chiah-ê sū, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tùi lín ê bīn-chêng kā in kóaⁿ-cháu.
Lín tio̍h tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng, chòe bô hâ-chhû ê lâng.
Lín só͘ beh kóaⁿ-chhut hiah-ê kok ê jîn-bîn, lóng thiaⁿ-thàn pok-kòa--ê, kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t--ê; lín leh, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kìm-chí lín án-ni chòe.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè beh tùi lín ê tông-pau tiong-kan, heng-khí chi̍t ê chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ê sian-ti, lín tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn i.

Lín tī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ chū-hōe ê sî, tùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè khún-kiû, kóng, “M̄-thang hō͘ goán koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ê siaⁿ, mā m̄-thang hō͘ goán koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú tī hé-iām tiong hián-hiān, chiah bián goán lóng sí.”
Siōng Chú chiū tùi góa kóng, “In kóng-liáu chin tio̍h.
Góa beh tī in tông-pau tiong-kan, heng-khí chi̍t ê chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ê sian-ti. Góa beh chiong góa ê ōe kau-tài i; i beh chiong góa ê bēng-lēng thoân-ta̍t hō͘ jîn-bîn.
I hōng góa ê miâ thoân-ta̍t ê ōe, lâng nā m̄ thiaⁿ, góa beh kā in hêng-hoa̍t.
M̄-kú sian-ti nā tōa-chú-tōa-ì ēng góa ê miâ kóng góa bô bēng-lēng i kóng ê ōe, á-sī hōng pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng ê miâ kóng-ōe, hit-ê sian-ti tio̍h sí.”
Lín khó-lêng ōe siūⁿ, “Goán ná ōe chai, chit-ê sian-ti kóng ê ōe m̄-sī Siōng Chú só͘ kau-tài--ê?”
Sian-ti hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ thoân-ta̍t ê ōe, nā bô si̍t-hiān, bô èng-giām, che chiū m̄-sī Siōng Chú ê ōe, sī hit-ê sian-ti tōa-chú-tōa-ì kóng--ê, lín m̄-bián kiaⁿ i.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siau-bia̍t hiah-ê kok, chiong in ê tōe siúⁿ-sù lín, hō͘ lín khiā-khí tī in ê siâⁿ kap in ê chhù í-āu,

lín tio̍h chiong Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe, pun-chòe saⁿ khu, múi chi̍t khu siat chi̍t ê siâⁿ, koh khui-lō͘ thàng kàu hia, hō͘ thâi-sí-lâng--ê lóng thang cháu-khì hia.
Nā ū lâng bô-ì-tiong thâi-sí kap i kè-khì bô oan-siû ê lâng, i thang cháu-khì pī-lān-siâⁿ pó-choân sìⁿ-miā.

Phì-jū kóng, lâng kap i ê chhù-piⁿ khì chhiū-nâ chhò-chhâ; chhiú gia̍h pó͘-thâu chi̍t-ē chhò, pó͘-thâu-bah lut--khì, siong-tio̍h chhù-piⁿ, chhù-piⁿ soah sí--khì, chit-ê lâng tio̍h cháu-khì jīm-hô chi̍t chō pī-lān-siâⁿ, thang pó-choân sìⁿ-miā;

chiah bián in-ūi lō͘ chin hn̄g, pò oan-siû--ê sim-hé to̍h, jip-tio̍h hit-ê thâi-lâng ê lâng kā i thâi-sí; kî-si̍t i m̄ eng-kai sí, in-ūi i kap hit-ê siū gō͘-sat ê lâng bô oan-siû.
Só͘-í góa bēng-lēng lín, tio̍h siat-li̍p saⁿ chō pī-lān-siâⁿ.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè nā chiàu I tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ só͘ li̍p-sè--ê, hō͘ lín ê thó͘-tōe khok-tián, chiong èng-ún beh siúⁿ-sù lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê choân-tōe hō͘ lín,

lín nā chun-hêng góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín it-chhè ê kài-bēng, thiàⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, siông-siông kiâⁿ I ê tō-lō͘, chit saⁿ chō siâⁿ í-gōa, tio̍h koh siat-li̍p saⁿ chō siâⁿ;
chiah bián bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih lâu tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe, tì-kàu lín tio̍h sêng-tam bû-ko͘ ê lâng siū thâi-sí ê chōe.
Nā ū lâng oàn-hūn chhù-piⁿ, bâi-ho̍k kong-kek i, kā i thâi-sí, āu-lâi cháu-khì pī-lān-siâⁿ;
hit-ê lâng pún-siâⁿ ê tiúⁿ-ló tio̍h phài lâng tùi hia kā i lia̍h--chhut-lâi, kau hō͘ pò oan-siû ê lâng, kā i chhú-sí.
Lín m̄-thang khó-lîn i; tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t tiong tû-khì sat-hāi bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê chōe, hō͘ lín sū-sū sūn-lī.
Tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê thó͘-tōe, lín m̄-thang î-sóa chhù-piⁿ ê kài-chí; hit-ê sī í-chêng ê lâng só͘ tēng--ê.
Nā ū lâng chòe sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h, hoān sím-mi̍h chōe, m̄-thang kan-ta thiaⁿ chi̍t ê lâng ê chèng-sû, tio̍h ū nn̄g ê á-sī saⁿ ê chèng-jîn, chiah thang kā i tēng-chōe.
Nā ū lâng ok-ì choh gūi-chèng, khòng-kò bó͘-lâng pōe-poān Siōng Chú,
chit nn̄g ê lâng tio̍h khì Siōng Chú só͘ kéng-soán kèng-pài I ê só͘-chāi, khiā tī ti̍t-pan ê chè-si kap sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ ê bīn-chêng;
sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ tio̍h siông-sè chhâ-mn̄g. Nā hoat-kiàn chèng-jîn choh gūi-chèng, beh hāi i ê tông-pau,
lín tio̍h chiàu i siūⁿ-beh tùi-hù i ê tông-pau án-ni kā i chhú-hoa̍t; án-ni lín chiū tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì chit-khoán siâ-ok ê sū.
Kî-tha ê lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū ōe kiaⁿ, bô lâng káⁿ koh chòe chit-khoán khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.
Lín m̄-thang khó-lîn i; tio̍h ēng miā pê miā, ba̍k-chiu pê ba̍k-chiu, chhùi-khí pê chhùi-khí, chhiú pê chhiú, kha pê kha.

Lín chhut-khì kap tùi-te̍k kau-chiàn, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in ê chiàn-bé, chiàn-chhia, í-ki̍p kun-peng pí lín khah chōe, m̄-bián kiaⁿ in, in-ūi chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe ê Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kap lín tông-chāi.
Lín pâi-tīn ê sî, chè-si tio̍h tī kun-peng ê bīn-chêng soan-pò͘,
kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Kin-á-ji̍t lín beh kap tùi-te̍k kau-chiàn. M̄-bián kiaⁿ, m̄-bián lún, m̄-bián khióng-hông, m̄-thang in-ūi in phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah,
in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe kap lín chòe-hé khì, ūi-tio̍h lín kap tùi-te̍k kau-chiàn, hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h sèng-lī.”

Hiah-ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ mā tio̍h tùi kun-peng soan-pò͘, kóng, “Nā ū lâng khí sin-chhù iáu-bē kú-hêng hōng-hiàn-lé, i thang tò-khì in tau, chiah bián i sí tī chiàn-tiûⁿ, pa̍t-lâng thòe i hōng-hiàn.
Nā ū lâng chèng phû-tô, iáu-bē siu-sêng, i thang tò-khì in tau, chiah bián i sí tī chiàn-tiûⁿ, pa̍t-lâng hióng-siū i ê ké-chí.
Nā ū lâng tēng-hun, iáu-bē chhōa, i thang tò-khì in tau, chiah bián i sí tī chiàn-tiûⁿ, pa̍t-lâng chhōa i ê bī-hun-chhe.”
Koaⁿ-tiúⁿ tio̍h koh tùi kun-peng soan-pò͘, kóng, “Nā ū lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ khióng-hông, i thang tò-khì in tau, chiah bián i éng-hióng choân-kun ê sū-khì.”
Koaⁿ-tiúⁿ tùi kun-peng soan-pò͘ liáu-āu, tio̍h chí-phài kun-koaⁿ chòe thâu chhōa kun-peng.
Lín óa-kūn siâⁿ beh kong-táⁿ ê sî, tio̍h hō͘ siâⁿ-lāi ê chū-bîn ū ki-hōe tâu-hâng.
In nā chiap-siū, khui siâⁿ-mn̂g, in só͘-ū ê chū-bîn lóng tio̍h chòe khó͘-kang lâi ho̍k-sāi lín.
In nā m̄ tâu-hâng, beh kap lín kau-chiàn, lín tio̍h kā in ûi-khùn.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe chiong in kau tī lín ê chhiú, lín tio̍h ēng to thâi-sí in só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng;

m̄-kú hū-lú, gín-á, cheng-siⁿ, kap siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū ê mi̍h, lín thang chhiúⁿ-lâi chòe chiàn-lī-phín; lín chhiúⁿ--lâi ê mi̍h, sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín--ê, lín thang the̍h-khì chia̍h, the̍h-khì ēng.
Hiah-ê lī-khui lín chin hn̄g, m̄-sī hù-kūn kok-ka ê siâⁿ, lín tio̍h án-ni tùi-thāi in.
Hiah-ê tòa tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe ê bîn-cho̍k, só͘-ū ōe chhoán-khùi--ê, lín m̄-thang hō͘ in oa̍h--teh.
Tio̍h chiàu Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, chiong Hek -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Ka-lâm -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, choân-pō͘ siau-bia̍t;
chiah bián in kà lín chòe ta̍k-khoán khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, hō͘ lín o̍h in kèng-pài in ê sîn-bêng, tì-kàu lín tek-chōe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.

Lín nā ûi-khùn chi̍t ê siâⁿ, ài chin kú chiah ōe kā i kong-phòa, m̄-thang ēng pó͘-thâu chhò ké-chí-chhiū. Lín thang chia̍h in ê ké-chí, m̄-thang kā chhò--khí-lâi, in-ūi iá-gōa ê chhiū-ba̍k m̄-sī lín ê tùi-te̍k.

M̄-kú lín nā chai-iáⁿ hiah-ê chhiū bōe kiat ōe-chia̍h--tit ê ké-chí, chiū thang kā chhò--khí-lâi, the̍h-lâi chòe kong-siâⁿ ê khì-khū, kong-kek kap lín kau-chiàn ê siâⁿ, ti̍t-kàu kā siâⁿ kong-phòa.
Tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe, nā ū lâng m̄-chai hō͘ siáⁿ-lâng thâi-sí, tó tī iá-gōa,
lín ê tiúⁿ-ló kap sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ tio̍h tùi hit-ê lâng siū-thâi ê só͘-chāi, niû kàu sì-ûi hiah-ê siâⁿ;
lī-khui si-thé siōng kūn hit-ê siâⁿ ê tiúⁿ-ló, tio̍h tùi gû-kûn chhú chi̍t chiah m̄-bat chòe kang, m̄-bat kòa taⁿ ê sòe-chiah gû-bú;
hit-ê siâⁿ ê tiúⁿ-ló tio̍h khan hit-chiah gû-bú kàu ū chúi teh lâu, m̄-bat chèng-choh ê soaⁿ-kok, tī hia kòng-tn̄g hit-chiah gû-bú ê ām-kún.

Lī-bī -lâng ê hō͘-tāi chòe chè-si--ê mā tio̍h lâi hia, in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ū kéng-soán in lâi ho̍k-sāi I, hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ chiok-hok, chhâi-koat só͘-ū sio-kò kap siong-hāi ê àn-kiāⁿ.
Lī-khui si-thé siōng kūn hit-ê siâⁿ só͘-ū ê tiúⁿ-ló, tio̍h tī hit-chiah tī soaⁿ-kok tiong ām-kún kòng-tn̄g ê sòe-chiah gû-bú ê téng-bīn sóe-chhiú,
seng-bêng kóng, “Goán ê chhiú bô lâu chit-ê lâng ê huih, goán ê ba̍k-chiu mā bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h siáⁿ-lâng thâi i.

Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí sià-bián lí só͘ kái-kiù ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t, m̄-thang hō͘ goán sêng-tam lâu bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih ê chōe.” Án-ni, lâu hit-ê huih ê chōe chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Lín chiàu án-ni chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe tio̍h ê sū, chiū ōe tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì lâu bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih ê chōe.
Lín khì kap tùi-te̍k kau-chiàn, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè nā hō͘ lín thâi-iâⁿ, lia̍h in chòe hu-ló͘;
hit-sî, tī hu-ló͘ ê tiong-kan, nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h bīn-māu hó-khòaⁿ ê lú-chú, chin kah-ì, beh chhōa i chòe bó͘,
chiū thang chhōa ji̍p-mn̂g; i tio̍h thì thâu-mn̂g, siu chńg-kah,

thǹg-khì siū-lia̍h ê sî chhēng ê saⁿ, tī lí ê chhù ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê pē-bú ai-khàu chi̍t ge̍h-ji̍t, jiân-āu lí thang kap i tâng-pâng; lí chiū chòe i ê tiōng-hu, i chòe lí ê bó͘.
Āu-lâi lí nā bô ài i, tio̍h hō͘ i lī-khui, tit-tio̍h chū-iû; choa̍t-tùi m̄-thang kā i bōe, m̄-thang kā i tòng-chòe lú-pī khoán-thāi; in-ūi lí bat kiông-pek i kap lí kiat-hun.
Lâng nā ū nn̄g ê bó͘, chi̍t ê i khah ài, chi̍t ê khah bô ài, nn̄g ê lóng ū kā i siⁿ-kiáⁿ; tōa-kiáⁿ sī khah bô ài ê bó͘ siⁿ--ê.
Pun châi-sán ê sî, m̄-thang chiong khah ài ê bó͘ siⁿ ê kiáⁿ tòng-chòe tōa-kiáⁿ, bô hō͘ khah bô ài ê bó͘ siⁿ ê kiáⁿ chòe tōa-kiáⁿ.

Tio̍h sêng-jīn khah bô ài ê bó͘ siⁿ ê kiáⁿ chòe tōa-kiáⁿ, chiong só͘-ū ê châi-sán pun siang-hūn hō͘ i; in-ūi i sī lāu-pē ióng-chòng ê sî siⁿ ê thâu-chiūⁿ-kiáⁿ, tōa-kiáⁿ ê bêng-hūn sī i ê.
Lâng nā ū kiáⁿ ngó͘-ge̍k put-hàu, m̄ thiaⁿ pē-bú ê ōe; in kā i kéng-kài, i iû-goân m̄ thiaⁿ,
i ê pē-bú tio̍h kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, thoa-khì hit-ê siâⁿ ê kóng-tiûⁿ kìⁿ tiúⁿ-ló,
kā hiah-ê tiúⁿ-ló kóng, “Goán chit-ê kiáⁿ ngó͘-ge̍k put-hàu, m̄ thiaⁿ goán ê ōe, tham-chia̍h, hò͘ⁿ-chiú.”
Hit-ê siâⁿ ê lâng lóng tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí; án-ni chiū tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì chit-khoán siâ-ok ê sū. Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū ōe kiaⁿ.
Lâng nā hoān sí-chōe, siū chhú-sí tiàu tī chhâ-kè,

i ê sin-si m̄-thang tiàu tī chhâ-kè kè-mî, it-tēng tio̍h tī hit-ji̍t kā i bâi-chòng, in-ūi siū tiàu-sí ê lâng sī Siōng-tè chiù-chó͘--ê. M̄-thang kā Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe phah lâ-sâm.
Lín nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h tông-pau ê gû á-sī iûⁿ bê-lō͘, m̄-thang tìⁿ bô khòaⁿ--tio̍h, it-tēng tio̍h hō͘ i tò-tńg-khì lín ê tông-pau hia.
Lín ê tông-pau nā lī lín chin hn̄g, á-sī lín m̄ bat--i, chiū tio̍h khan tńg-khì lín tau, lâu tī lín hia, thèng-hāu lín ê tông-pau lâi chhē, chiah hêng i.
Lín ê tông-pau nā phah-m̄-kìⁿ lû, á-sī saⁿ, á-sī kî-tha ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, m̄-thang tìⁿ-chòe bô khòaⁿ--tio̍h; lín nā khioh--tio̍h, lóng tio̍h chiàu án-ni chòe.
Lín nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h tông-pau ê lû á-sī gû tī lō͘--ni̍h poa̍h-tó, m̄-thang tìⁿ bô khòaⁿ--tio̍h, it-tēng tio̍h pang-chān chú-lâng kā cheng-siⁿ giú--khí-lâi.
Hū-jîn-lâng m̄-thang chhēng ta-po͘-lâng ê saⁿ, ta-po͘-lâng mā m̄-thang chhēng hū-jîn-lâng ê saⁿ; só͘-ū án-ni chòe ê lâng, sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê.

Lín nā tī lō͘--ni̍h khòaⁿ-tio̍h chiáu-á-siū, bô-lūn tī chhiū-téng á-sī tī thô͘-kha, lāi-bīn ū chiáu-á-kiáⁿ á-sī chiáu-á-nn̄g, chiáu-bú teh áⁿ chiáu-á-kiáⁿ á-sī pū-nn̄g, lín m̄-thang lia̍h chiáu-á-kiáⁿ sòa lia̍h chiáu-bú;
lín thang lia̍h chiáu-á-kiáⁿ, m̄-kú it-tēng tio̍h pàng chiáu-bú khì; án-ni lín chiū thang hióng-siū hok-khì, chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū.
Lín nā khí sin-chhù, tio̍h tī chhù-téng chòe lân-kan, chiah bián ū lâng tùi hia poa̍h--lo̍h-lâi siak-sí, lín chiū tio̍h sêng-tam chek-jīm.
M̄-thang tī phû-tô-hn̂g iā tē-jī chióng chéng-chí; nā án-ni chòe, phû-tô kap só͘ iā chéng-chí ê siu-sêng lóng kui sèng-só͘, bōe-tàng ka-kī ēng.
M̄-thang ēng gû kap lû kòa kâng chi̍t ê taⁿ lôe-chhân.
M̄-thang chhēng iûⁿ-mn̂g kap iù-môa ha̍p chòe-hé chit ê saⁿ.
Lín moa ê gōa-saⁿ, tio̍h tī sì kak-thâu chòe chhiu.
Lâng nā chhōa-bó͘, kap i tâng-pâng, āu-lâi bô ài i,
kā i húi-pòng, phò-hoāi i ê miâ-siaⁿ, kóng, “Góa chhōa chit-ê cha-bó͘, kap i tâng-pâng, hoat-kiàn i m̄-sī chāi-sek-lú.”
Cha-bó͘ gín-á ê pē-bú tio̍h the̍h cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chāi-sek-lú ê chèng-kù chhut--lâi, tòa-khì hit-ê siâⁿ kóng-tiûⁿ ê tiúⁿ-ló hia;
cha-bó͘ gín-á ê lāu-pē tio̍h tùi tiúⁿ-ló kóng, “Góa chiong góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō͘ chit-ê lâng choh-bó͘, i bô ài i.

I húi-pòng góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kóng ‘Góa hoat-kiàn lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ m̄-sī chāi-sek-lú’. Lín khòaⁿ, che sī goán cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chāi-sek-lú ê chèng-kù.” Pē-bú chiū chiong hit-tè pò͘ pâi tī hit-ê siâⁿ tiúⁿ-ló ê bīn-chêng.
Hit-ê siâⁿ ê tiúⁿ-ló tio̍h kā hit-ê lâng lia̍h-lâi chhú-hoa̍t;

mā tio̍h kā i hoa̍t chi̍t-chheng chi̍t-pah sì-cha̍p kong-khek ê gûn, kau hō͘ cha-bó͘ gín-á ê lāu-pē; in-ūi i ū phò-hoāi Í-sek-lia̍t ê chāi-sek-lú ê miâ-siaⁿ; cha-bó͘ gín-á iû-goân chòe i ê bó͘, hit-ê lâng chi̍t-sì-lâng bōe-ēng-tit kā i lî-hun.
Chit-ê lâng khòng-kò--ê nā-sī sū-si̍t, cha-bó͘ gín-á bô chāi-sek-lú ê chèng-kù,

in tio̍h lia̍h hit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á khì in lāu-pē ê chhù ê mn̂g-kháu, siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí; in-ūi i tī Í-sek-lia̍t chòe kiàn-siàu ê sū, tī in lāu-pē ê ke kiâⁿ îm-loān; án-ni chiū tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì hit-ê siâ-ok ê sū.
Nā ū lâng kap pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘ khùn, hit-ê ta-po͘ kap hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng lóng tio̍h hō͘ sí; án-ni chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiong-kan tû-khì hit-ê siâ-ok ê sū.
Nā ū chāi-sek-lú í-keng kap lâng tēng-hun, ū ta-po͘-lâng tī siâⁿ-lāi tú-tio̍h i, kap i khùn,

lín tio̍h lia̍h chit nn̄g ê lâng khì kóng-tiûⁿ, ēng chio̍h-thâu kā in tìm-sí; in-ūi chit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á tī siâⁿ-lāi bô hoah-kiù-lâng, chit-ê ta-po͘-lâng lêng-jio̍k pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘. Án-ni, lín chiū tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì hit-ê siâ-ok ê sū.
Nā ū ta-po͘-lâng tī iá-gōa tú-tio̍h í-keng tēng-hun ê cha-bó͘ gín-á, kā i kiông-kan; kan-ta hit-ê kā i kiông-kan ê lâng tio̍h sí.

M̄-kú m̄-thang pān hit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á, in-ūi i bô eng-kai sí. Chit-ê ta-po͘-lâng chòe ê tāi-chì sī chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng khí-lâi kong-kek i ê chhù-piⁿ, kā i thâi-sí kâng-khoán;
i tī iá-gōa tú-tio̍h hit-ê í-keng tēng-hun ê cha-bó͘ gín-á, cha-bó͘ gín-á sui-jiân hoah-kiù-lâng, mā bô lâng kiù i.
Nā ū ta-po͘-lâng tú-tio̍h iáu-bē tēng-hun ê chāi-sek-lú, kā i lia̍h--teh, kiông-kan, hō͘ lâng hoat-kiàn,

hit-ê kā i kiông-kan ê ta-po͘-lâng tio̍h the̍h gō͘-pah chhit-cha̍p kong-khek ê gûn, kau hō͘ cha-bó͘ gín-á ê lāu-pē, koh tio̍h chhōa i chòe bó͘, chi̍t-sì-lâng bōe-ēng-tit kā i lî-hun, in-ūi hit-ê ta-po͘-lâng í-keng kā i lêng-jio̍k.
Lâng m̄-thang chhōa lāu-pē ê bó͘, phah lâ-sâm i ê lāu-pē ê bîn-chhn̂g.
Sèng-khì-koan siū-siong á-sī iam--khí-lâi ê lâng, bōe-ēng-tit ka-ji̍p Siōng Chú ê hōe.
Su-seng-chú bōe-ēng-tit ka-ji̍p Siōng Chú ê hōe; i ê kiáⁿ-sun kàu tē-cha̍p tāi, mā bōe-ēng-tit ka-ji̍p.
A-bûn -lâng kap Mô͘-ap -lâng bōe-ēng-tit ka-ji̍p Siōng Chú ê hōe; sīm-chì kàu tē-cha̍p tāi, mā bōe-ēng-tit ka-ji̍p,

in-ūi lín chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî, in bô tī lō͘--ni̍h ēng chia̍h-mi̍h kap chúi gêng-chiap lín; koh chhiàⁿ Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a ê Pí-toa̍t -lâng, Pí-ní ê kiáⁿ Pa-lân lâi kā lín chiù-chó͘.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè bô thiaⁿ Pa-lân, in-ūi Siōng Chú thiàⁿ lín, chiong hit-ê chiù-chó͘ pìⁿ-chòe chiok-hok.
Lín éng-oán m̄-thang pang-chān in tit-tio̍h pêng-an kap hoân-êng.
M̄-thang oàn-hūn Í-tong -lâng, in-ūi in sī lín ê chhin-cho̍k; m̄-thang oàn-hūn Ai-ki̍p -lâng, in-ūi lín bat kià-ku tī hia;
in ê kiáⁿ-sun kàu tē-saⁿ tāi thang ka-ji̍p Siōng Chú ê hōe.
Lín chhut-khì chat-iâⁿ beh kong-kek tùi-te̍k ê sî, tio̍h pī-bián hō͘ lín tì-kàu lé-gî-siōng bô chheng-khì ê sū.
Lín tiong-kan nā ū lâng bōng-siat tì-kàu bô chheng-khì, i tio̍h chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa, m̄-thang koh ji̍p-lâi iâⁿ-lāi;
kàu beh àm ê sî, i tio̍h ēng chúi sóe seng-khu, kàu ji̍t lo̍h chiah thang koh ji̍p iâⁿ.
Lín tī iâⁿ-gōa tio̍h kui-ōe chi̍t ê só͘-chāi chòe piān-só͘.
Lín ê chong-pī tio̍h ū thuh-á, hō͘ lín tī gōa-bīn tāi-siáu-piān ê sî, ēng lâi ó͘ thô͘, khàm lín só͘ pàng--ê;

in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tī lín ê iâⁿ-lāi kap lín tông-chāi, beh pó-hō͘ lín, chiong tùi-te̍k kau hō͘ lín, só͘-í lín ê peng-iâⁿ tio̍h pó-chhî sèng-kiat; chiah bián I khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lín tiong-kan ū ù-òe, chiū lī-khui lín.
Nā ū lô͘-lē tô-thoat, cháu-khì lín hia, lín m̄-thang chiong i kau tńg-khì hō͘ i ê chú-lâng;
lín tio̍h hō͘ i tòa tī i só͘ ài ê só͘-chāi, só͘ kéng ê siâⁿ, kap lín chòe-hé khiā-khí; lín m̄-thang kā i khi-hū.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê lâm-lú m̄-thang ū lâng tī sī-biō chòe ki-lú á-sī loân-tông.

Sī-biō ê ki-lú kap loân-tông thàn ê chîⁿ, m̄-thang tòa ji̍p-lâi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān siā-goān; in-ūi chit nn̄g hāng lóng sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê.
Lín ê tông-pau bô-lūn kā lín chioh chîⁿ-gûn, chia̍h-mi̍h, á-sī ōe siⁿ lī-sek ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, lóng m̄-thang the̍h lī-sek;

gōa-cho̍k-lâng nā kā lín chioh, lín thang the̍h lī-sek, m̄-kú chioh hō͘ lín ê tông-pau chiū m̄-thang kā i the̍h; án-ni, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe tī lín beh ji̍p-khì chiàm-léng ê tōe, tī lín só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū, sù-hok lín.
Lín tùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè hē-goān, siā-goān m̄-thang iân-tî, in-ūi Siōng Chú it-tēng ōe kā lín thó; lín nā bô siā-goān, chiū ū chōe.
Lín nā bô hē-goān, tian-tò bô chōe.
Lín só͘-ū chhin-chhùi tùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kam-sim hē ê goān, tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-siú.
Lín ji̍p-khì chhù-piⁿ ê phû-tô-hn̂g, thang chiàu lín só͘ ài bán lâi chia̍h, m̄-kú m̄-thang tóe tī khì-khū lāi.
Lín ji̍p-khì chhù-piⁿ iáu-bē siu-koah ê be̍h-hn̂g, thang ēng chhiú tiah be̍h-sūi, m̄-kú m̄-thang ēng liâm-le̍k-á koah.
Nā ū lâng chhōa-bó͘ liáu-āu, chai bó͘ ū kiàn-siàu-sū, bô ài i, chiū thang siá lî-hun-su hō͘ i, kiò i lī-khui.
I lī-khui hit-ê ke liáu-āu, thang kè pa̍t-lâng.
Nā-sī i āu-lâi ê tiōng-hu bô ài i, koh siá lî-hun-su hō͘ i, kah i lī-khui; á-sī hit-ê tiōng-hu sí--khì,

hit-ê í-chêng kah i lī-khui ê tiōng-hu bōe-ēng-tit tī i siū phah lâ-sâm liáu-āu, kiò i tńg--lâi, koh chhōa i choh-bó͘, in-ūi che sī Siōng Chú iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê; m̄-thang tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe hoān-chōe.
Tú chhōa-bó͘ ê lâng m̄-thang khì kau-chiàn, mā m̄-thang hō͘ i tam-jīm kong-bū; tio̍h hō͘ i tī ke-lāi chheng-êng chi̍t nî, hō͘ i ê bó͘ hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
M̄-thang the̍h pa̍t-lâng ê chio̍h-bō, á-sī chio̍h-bō ê téng-tún chòe tí-ah; in-ūi che chiū-sī the̍h lâng ê sìⁿ-miā chòe tí-ah.

Nā hoat-kiàn ū lâng kiap Í-sek-lia̍t tiong chi̍t ê tông-pau, kā i tòng-chòe lô͘-lē tùi-thāi, á-sī kā i bōe--khì, hit-ê kiap-lâng ê lâng tio̍h hō͘ sí; án-ni, chiū tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì hit-ê siâ-ok ê sū.
Tùi bâ-hong-pīⁿ, lín tio̍h te̍k-pia̍t sòe-jī; Lī-bī -lâng chòe chè-si--ê só͘ kà-sī lín, chiū-sī góa só͘ bēng-lēng lín--ê, tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng.
Tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, lín chá-chêng chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tī lō͘--ni̍h án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi Bí-lī-an.
Lín bô-lūn ū sím-mi̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ chioh chhù-piⁿ, m̄-thang ji̍p-khì in tau the̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ tí-ah;
tio̍h khiā tī gōa-bīn, thèng-hāu kā lín chioh ê lâng the̍h tí-ah ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chhut-lâi hō͘ lín.
Hit-ê lâng nā sàn-chhiah, lín m̄-thang the̍h i ê gōa-saⁿ chòe tí-ah tau kè-mî;

ji̍t lo̍h ê sî, it-tēng tio̍h chiong hit-ê tí-ah ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ hêng i, hō͘ i thang ēng i ê gōa-saⁿ kah-teh khùn; i ōe kā lín chiok-hok, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè mā ōe khòaⁿ chit-hāng sū chòe lín ê hó tek-hēng.
Khùn-khó͘ sàn-chhiah ê kang-lâng, bô-lūn sī lín ê tông-pau, á-sī tòa tī lín siâⁿ-lāi ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, lín m̄-thang kā in khi-hū.
In ê kang-chîⁿ, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng tio̍h hō͘ in, in-ūi in sàn-chhiah, khò hit-ê chîⁿ teh tō͘-oa̍h; chiah bián in in-ūi lín ê só͘-chòe kā Siōng Chú tâu, lín chiū ū chōe.
M̄-thang in-ūi kiáⁿ-jî ê só͘-chòe kā lāu-pē chhú-sí, mā m̄-thang in-ūi lāu-pē ê só͘-chòe kā kiáⁿ-jî chhú-sí; ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe sí.
Lín sím-phòaⁿ, m̄-thang oan-óng gōa-cho̍k-lâng kap ko͘-jî, mā m̄-thang the̍h kóaⁿ-hū ê gōa-saⁿ chòe tí-ah.
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit lín bat tī Ai-ki̍p chòe lô͘-châi, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ū kā lín tùi hia kiù--chhut-lâi; só͘-í góa bēng-lēng lín tio̍h án-ni chòe.

Lín tī hn̂g--ni̍h siu ngó͘-kok, nā ū chi̍t khún bōe-kì--tit, iáu pàng tī hn̂g--ni̍h, m̄-thang oat tńg-khì the̍h, tio̍h lâu hō͘ gōa-cho̍k-lâng kap ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū; án-ni, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe tī lín só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū, sù-hok lín.
Lín phah lín ê kaⁿ-ná-chhiū liáu-āu, m̄-thang koh sûn hiah-ê chhiū-ki; tio̍h lâu hō͘ gōa-cho̍k-lâng kap ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū.
Lín bán phû-tô liáu-āu, chhun--ê m̄-thang koh bán; tio̍h lâu hō͘ gōa-cho̍k-lâng kap ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū.
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit lín bat tī Ai-ki̍p chòe lô͘-châi, só͘-í góa bēng-lēng lín tio̍h án-ni chòe.
Lâng nā ū cheng-chip, thê-chhut sò͘-siōng, sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ tio̍h tēng chèng-ti̍t--ê chòe bô-chōe, tēng choh-pháiⁿ--ê chòe ū-chōe;
ū-chōe ê lâng nā eng-kai siū-phah, tio̍h hō͘ hit-ê lâng tī sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ ê bīn-chêng phak tī thô͘-kha, chiàu i hoān-chōe ê thêng-tō͘ kā i phah;
m̄-kú siōng chōe thang phah sì-cha̍p ē, m̄-thang phah kè-thâu; nā chhiau-kè sì-cha̍p ē, chiū-sī bú-jio̍k chit-ê hiaⁿ-tī.
Gû teh lún ngó͘-kok, m̄-thang kā i kòa chhùi-lam.

Hiaⁿ-tī tòa chòe-hé, nā kî-tiong chi̍t ê bô kiáⁿ chiū sí, kè-sin ê lâng ê bó͘ m̄-thang kè gōa-lâng, i tiōng-hu ê hiaⁿ-tī tio̍h chhōa i choh-bó͘, kap i tâng-pâng, chīn hiaⁿ-tī ê pún-hūn.
I siⁿ ê tōa-kiáⁿ, tio̍h sòa-chiap i sí--khì ê tiōng-hu ê bêng-hūn, chiah bián hit-ê tiōng-hu ê miâ tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong siū tû--khì.

Hit-ê lâng nā bô beh chhōa i sí--khì ê hiaⁿ-tī ê bó͘, hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng chiū tio̍h khì kóng-tiûⁿ ê tiúⁿ-ló hia, tùi in kóng, “Góa tiōng-hu ê hiaⁿ-tī m̄-khéng tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong kā i sí--khì ê hiaⁿ-tī lâu hō͘-sû, bô beh chīn hiaⁿ-tī ê pún-hūn.”
Tī kóng-tiûⁿ ê tiúⁿ-ló tio̍h kiò hit-ê lâng lâi, kā i khó͘-khǹg; i nā kian-chhî bô beh kā chhōa,

hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng tio̍h tī tiúⁿ-ló ê bīn-chêng kiâⁿ-óa i, kā thǹg-ôe, koh phùi chhùi-nōa tī i ê bīn, kóng, “Só͘-ū bô beh ūi-tio̍h hiaⁿ-tī lâu hō͘-sû ê lâng, tio̍h án-ni kā bú-jio̍k.”
Tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan, hit-ê lâng ê ka-têng beh kiò-chòe “Hō͘ lâng thǹg-ôe ê ke”.
Nā ū nn̄g ê lâng sio-phah, kî-tiong chi̍t ê lâng ê bó͘ óa-lâi kiù i ê tiōng-hu, chhun-chhiú lia̍h-tiâu lēng-gōa hit-ê lâng ê hā-thé,
chiū tio̍h chām-tn̄g hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng ê chhiú, m̄-thang khó-lîn i.
Lín ê tē-á lāi m̄-thang ū tōa-lia̍p kap sòe-lia̍p ê nn̄g khoán chhìn-thûi;
chhù-lāi mā m̄-thang ū tōa kap sòe ê nn̄g khoán táu.
Tio̍h ēng chún-khak kong-tō ê chhìn-thûi kap táu, thang hō͘ lín tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū;
só͘-ū chòe bô kong-tō ê tāi-chì ê lâng, lóng sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit lín chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî, A-má-le̍k -lâng tī lō͘--ni̍h án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lín.
In tī lō͘--ni̍h kong-kek lín; tng-tán lín ià-siān bô-la̍t ê sî, kong-kek lín āu-bīn loán-jio̍k ê lâng; in lóng bô teh kiaⁿ Siōng-tè.

Só͘-í, kàu Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kiù lín thoat-lī sì-ûi ê tùi-te̍k, hō͘ lín chiàm-léng I siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe, hióng-siū thài-pêng, hit-sî, lín tio̍h chiong A-má-le̍k ê miâ, tùi thiⁿ-ē chhat-siau. M̄-thang bōe-kì--tit!
Lín sêng-chiap Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe lâi khiā-khí ê sî,

tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe, chiong só͘ siu-sêng ta̍k-hāng khí-thâu-se̍k ê thó͘-sán, the̍h chi̍t-kóa hē tī nâ-á, khì Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán hō͘ lín ho̍k-sāi I ê só͘-chāi.

Lín tio̍h khì kìⁿ ti̍t-pan ê chè-si, kā i kóng, “Góa kin-á-ji̍t tùi Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè soan-jīn, góa í-keng lâi kàu Siōng Chú tùi goán ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè siúⁿ-sù goán ê tōe.”
Chè-si chiū chiong lí ê nâ-á chiap--khì, hē tī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ê chè-tôaⁿ chêng.

Lí tio̍h tī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng kò-pe̍k kóng, “Góa ê chó͘-sian sī chi̍t ê sì-kòe liû-lōng ê A-lân -lâng, lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p, tī hia kià-ku, lâng-gia̍h chió-chió; āu-lâi tī hia chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê tōa koh kiông, lâng-gia̍h chōe ê bîn-cho̍k.
Ai-ki̍p -lâng khó͘-chhó͘ goán, khi-ap goán, kiông-pek goán chòe khó͘-kang,
goán chiū ai-kiû Siōng Chú — goán lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè. Siōng Chú thiaⁿ-kìⁿ goán ê siaⁿ, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ goán ê khùn-kéng, goán ê lô-khó͘, goán siū ê ap-pek,
Siōng Chú chiū chhun-chhut tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú, ēng tōa koh thang-kiaⁿ ê sū kap sîn-jiah kî-sū, chhōa goán chhut Ai-ki̍p;
koh chhōa goán kàu chit só͘-chāi, chiong chit-ê lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe siúⁿ-sù goán.

Taⁿ, Siōng Chú, lí siúⁿ-sù hō͘ góa chit-ê tōe khí-thâu-se̍k ê thó͘-sán, góa í-keng tòa-lâi hōng-hiàn hō͘ lí.” Liáu-āu, lí tio̍h chiong hiah-ê chè-mi̍h hē tī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng, tī hia kèng-pài I.
Lí kap Lī-bī -lâng, í-ki̍p lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, tio̍h in-ūi Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lí kap lí ê ka-koàn it-chhè ê hok-hūn lâi khèng-chiok.

Ta̍k-piàn kàu tē-saⁿ nî, chiū-sī hōng-hiàn cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê nî, tio̍h chiong it-chhè thó͘-sán ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t pun hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng, gōa-cho̍k-lâng, kap ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū, hō͘ in tī lí ê siâⁿ-tìn thang tit-tio̍h pá-chiok,

án-ni lí thang tùi Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè kóng, “Góa í-keng chiàu lí só͘ bēng-lēng góa it-chhè ê kài-bēng, tùi góa ê ke chiong hōng-hiàn ê mi̍h the̍h-chhut, hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng, gōa-cho̍k-lâng, kap ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū; lí ê kài-bēng góa bô ûi-pōe, mā bô bōe-kì--tit.

Chhù-lāi ū song-sū ê sî, góa bô chia̍h hōng-hiàn ê mi̍h; lé-gî-siōng bô chheng-khì ê sî, góa bô kā chiah-ê the̍h--chhut-khì, mā bô chiong chiah-ê hiàn hō͘ sí-lâng; góa ū chun-siú Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè só͘-ū bēng-lēng góa ê ōe.

Kiû lí tùi thiⁿ-téng, lí khiā-khí ê sèng-só͘, àⁿ-lo̍h khòaⁿ, sù-hok lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t kap lí siúⁿ-sù goán ê tōe, chiū-sī lí tùi goán ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè só͘ hō͘ goán chit-ê lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe.”
Kin-á-ji̍t Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè hoan-hù lín chun-siú chiah-ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng, só͘-í lín tio̍h chīn-sim chīn-sèng chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng.
Kin-á-ji̍t lín í-keng soan-jīn Siōng Chú chòe lín ê Siōng-tè, beh kiâⁿ I ê tō-lō͘, chun-siú I ê kui-lē, kài-bēng, kap bēng-lēng, koh beh thiaⁿ-thàn I ê ōe.
Siōng Chú kin-á-ji̍t mā chiàu I tùi lín ê èng-ún, sêng-jīn lín chòe I te̍k-pia̍t ê chú-bîn, hō͘ lín siú I it-chhè ê kài-bēng;

koh beh chiàu I ê èng-ún, hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h o-ló, miâ-siaⁿ, chun-kùi, chhiau-kè I só͘ chhòng-chō ê bān-cho̍k, hō͘ lín chiâⁿ-chòe kui-sio̍k Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sèng-kiat ê chú-bîn.
Mô͘-se kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng tiúⁿ-ló bēng-lēng jîn-bîn, kóng: Lín tio̍h chun-siú góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ hoan-hù lín it-chhè ê kài-bēng.
Lín kè Iok-tàn-hô, khì kàu Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe hit-ji̍t, tio̍h chhāi kúi tè tōa chio̍h, téng-bīn boah chio̍h-he,

chiong lu̍t-hoat só͘-ū ê ōe khek tī tōa chio̍h téng-bīn. Lín ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe, chiū-sī I tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ só͘ èng-ún lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe,
kè Iok-tàn-hô hit-pêng hōaⁿ liáu-āu, tio̍h chiàu góa kin-á-ji̍t ê bēng-lēng, tī Í-pa-lō͘-soaⁿ chhāi hiah-ê chio̍h-thâu, téng-bīn boah chio̍h-he.
Tī hia, lín tio̍h ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ēng chio̍h-thâu khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ; hiah-ê chio̍h-thâu m̄-thang ēng thih ê kang-khū phah--kè.
Tio̍h ēng bô phah--kè ê chio̍h-thâu khí Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê tôaⁿ; tī hit téng-bīn hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ I,
mā tī hia hiàn pêng-an-chè; koh tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng hoaⁿ-hí lim-chia̍h.
Lín tio̍h chiong chit-ê lu̍t-hoat it-chhè ê ōe, chheng-chheng-chhó-chhó khek tī hiah-ê chio̍h-thâu.

Mô͘-se kap Lī-bī -lâng chòe chè-si--ê koh hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng, kóng: Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tio̍h chēng-chēng, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Kin-á-ji̍t lín chiâⁿ-chòe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn,
tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, chun-hêng góa só͘ pan-pò͘ ê Siōng Chú ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē.
Hit-ji̍t, Mô͘-se koh hoan-hù jîn-bîn kóng:
Lín kè Iok-tàn-hô liáu-āu, Lī-bī -lâng chiok-hok jîn-bîn ê sî, Se-biān, Lī-bī, Iû-tāi, Í-sat-ka, Iok-sek, Piān-ngá-bín chiah-ê chi-cho̍k, tio̍h khiā tī Ki-lī-sim-soaⁿ;
soan-pò͘ chiù-chó͘ ê sî, Lū-piān, Ka-tek, A-siat, Se-pò͘-lûn, Tān, Ná-hut-tha-lī chiah-ê chi-cho̍k, tio̍h khiā tī Í-pa-lō͘-soaⁿ.
Jiân-āu, Lī-bī -lâng tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng tōa-siaⁿ soan-pò͘:

Chè-chō Siōng Chú só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sîn-siōng, bô-lūn sī tiau-khek--ê, á-sī chù-chō--ê, koh hō͘ lâng àm-tiong chè-pài, hit-ê sai-hū tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h ìn kóng, “Amen!”
Tùi pē-bú put-hàu--ê, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h kóng, “Amen!”
Î-sóa chhù-piⁿ ê kài-chí--ê, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h kóng, “Amen!”
Hō͘ sit-bêng ê lâng kiâⁿ m̄-tio̍h lō͘--ê, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h kóng, “Amen!”
Pak-toa̍t gōa-cho̍k-lâng kap ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū ê koân-lī--ê, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h kóng, “Amen!”
Kap lāu-pē ê bó͘ chòe-hé khùn--ê, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘, in-ūi i ū phah lâ-sâm i lāu-pē ê bîn-chhn̂g. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h kóng, “Amen!”
Kap tōng-bu̍t kau-ha̍p--ê, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h kóng, “Amen!”
Kap kâng-pē ê chí-bē, á-sī kâng-bú ê chí-bē, chòe-hé khùn--ê, hit-ê lâng tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h kóng, “Amen!”
Kap tiūⁿ-ḿ chòe-hé khùn--ê, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h kóng, “Amen!”
Àm-sat chhù-piⁿ--ê, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h kóng, “Amen!”
Chiap-siū hóe-lō͘ hāi-sí bû-ko͘ ê lâng--ê, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h kóng, “Amen!”
Bô chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng chiah-ê lu̍t-hoat ê ōe--ê, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h kóng, “Amen!”

Lín nā chin-chiàⁿ thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, chun-hêng góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín I it-chhè ê kài-bēng, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè beh hō͘ lín pí thiⁿ-ē bān-kok koh-khah kiông-sēng.
Lín nā thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, chiah-ê hok-khì chiū beh hong-hong-hù-hù lîm-kàu lín:
Lín tī siâⁿ-tìn, tī hiong-chhoan, beh tit-tio̍h chiok-hok.
Lín siⁿ ê jî-lú, thó͘-tōe chhut-sán--ê, cheng-siⁿ siⁿ--ê, í-ki̍p gû-á-kiáⁿ, iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ, lóng beh tit-tio̍h chiok-hok.
Lín ê nâ-á kap chhiau mī-hún ê phûn, lóng beh tit-tio̍h chiok-hok.
Lín chhut, lín ji̍p, lóng beh tit-tio̍h chiok-hok.
Hiah-ê kong-kek lín ê tùi-te̍k, Siōng Chú beh hō͘ lín kā in phah-pāi; in tùi chi̍t tiâu lō͘ lâi kong-kek, beh tī lín ê bīn-chêng tùi chhit tiâu lō͘ tô-cháu.
Siōng Chú beh hō͘ lín ê chhek-chhng móa-móa, sū-sū heng-thong. Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè beh tī siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe sù-hok lín.
Lín nā chun-siú Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng, kiâⁿ I ê tō-lō͘, Siōng Chú beh chiàu I tùi lín li̍p-sè--ê, siat-li̍p lín chòe I sèng-kiat ê chú-bîn;
thiⁿ-ē bān-cho̍k khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lín sio̍k tī Siōng Chú, chiū ōe kiaⁿ-ùi lín.
Siōng Chú beh tī I tùi lín lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè siúⁿ-sù lín ê tōe, hō͘ lín só͘ siⁿ--ê, cheng-siⁿ siⁿ--ê, thó͘-tōe chhut-sán--ê, chhiong-chiok ū-chhun.

Siōng Chú beh kā lín khui I thiⁿ-téng ê pó-khò͘, chiàu kùi-choeh lo̍h-hō͘ hō͘ lín ê thó͘-tōe, hō͘ lín sū-sū heng-thong; lín beh chioh hō͘ chin chōe kok, m̄-kú m̄-bián kā lâng chioh.

Lín nā thiaⁿ-thàn góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng, chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng, bô phian-chó-phian-iū, lī-khui góa só͘ bēng-lēng lín chiah-ê ōe, khì ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, Siōng Chú chiū beh hō͘ lín tī lia̍t-kok tiong choh-thâu, bô siū chi-phòe.

Lín nā bô thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, bô chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín I it-chhè ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē, chiah-ê chiù-chó͘ chiū ōe chin kín lîm-kàu lín:
Lín tī siâⁿ-tìn, tī hiong-chhoan, ōe siū chiù-chó͘.
Lín ê nâ-á kap chhiau mī-hún ê phûn, ōe siū chiù-chó͘.
Lín só͘ siⁿ--ê, thó͘-tōe chhut-sán--ê, í-ki̍p gû-á-kiáⁿ, iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ, lóng ōe siū chiù-chó͘.
Lín chhut, lín ji̍p, lóng ōe siū chiù-chó͘.
In-ūi lín chòe pháiⁿ khì-sak góa, Siōng Chú beh hō͘ lín só͘ chòe ê sū siū chiù-chó͘, jiáu-loān, chek-hoa̍t, ti̍t-kàu lín chin kín oân-choân siū húi-bia̍t.
Siōng Chú beh hō͘ un-e̍k khó͘-chhó͘ lín, tī lín ji̍p-khì sêng-chiap ê tōe kā lín siau-bia̍t.
Siōng Chú beh ēng hì-lô, jia̍t-pīⁿ, hoat-iām, to̍k-jia̍t, khòng-hān, hé-sio-hong, pīⁿ-hāi kong-kek lín; chiah-ê lóng ōe tui-jip lín, ti̍t-kàu lín bia̍t-bông.
Lín thâu-khak téng ê thiⁿ ōe pìⁿ-chòe tâng bōe lo̍h-hō͘, kha-ē ê tōe ōe pìⁿ-chòe thih hiah-ni̍h tēng.
Siōng Chú beh hō͘ thô͘-soa-hún tāi-thòe hō͘-chúi, lo̍h tī lín sin-chiūⁿ, ti̍t-kàu I kā lín siau-bia̍t.

Siōng Chú beh hō͘ lín tī tùi-te̍k ê bīn-chêng thâi-su; lín tùi chi̍t tiâu lō͘ chhut-khì kong-kek in, ōe tùi chhit tiâu lō͘ tô-cháu; thiⁿ-ē bān-kok khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê chêng-hêng ōe tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Lín ê sin-si ōe chiâⁿ-chòe khong-tiong pe-chiáu kap tōe-chiūⁿ cháu-siù ê chia̍h-mi̍h, bô lâng kā in kóaⁿ-cháu.
Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ lín chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-chêng Ai-ki̍p -lâng siⁿ-chhng, koh siⁿ tī-chhng, sip-chín, sián, bōe-i--tit.
Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ lín lia̍h-kông, chhiⁿ-mî, tio̍h-kiaⁿ.

Lín tī ji̍t tiong-tàu, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ sit-bêng ê lâng tī o͘-àm tiong bong-lâi-bong-khì; lín chòe ê sū bōe heng-thong, siông-siông siū ap-pek, siū chhiúⁿ-toa̍t, bô lâng kiù lín.
Lín kap cha-bó͘ gín-á tēng-hun, pa̍t-lâng ōe kap i chòe-hé khùn; lín khí-chhù, bô thang tòa; lín chai-chèng phû-tô-hn̂g, mā bô thang chia̍h hiah-ê ké-chí.

Lín ê gû tī lín ê bīn-chêng hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, m̄-kú lín chia̍h bōe tio̍h bah; lín ê lû tī lín ê bīn-chêng hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì, koh thó bōe tńg--lâi; lín ê iûⁿ hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì, bô lâng pang-chān lín.
Lín ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ōe tī lín ê bīn-chêng hō͘ pa̍t-cho̍k lia̍h--khì; lín ê ba̍k-chiu kui-ji̍t kim-kim khòaⁿ, tán in tńg--lâi, m̄-kú lín bû-lêng-ûi-le̍k.
Lín ê thó͘-sán, kap lín lô-khó͘ tit--tio̍h-ê, ōe hō͘ lín m̄-bat ê bîn-cho̍k chia̍h-liáu-liáu. Lín ōe siông-siông hō͘ lâng khi-hū, siū ap-chè,
ti̍t-kàu lín in-ūi tú--tio̍h ê kéng-hóng lia̍h-kông.
Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ lín tùi kha-tóe, kha-thâu-u, kha-thúi, kàu thâu-khak téng, jiám-tio̍h bōe-i--tit ê to̍k-chhng.

Siōng Chú ōe chiong lín kap lín só͘ siat-li̍p koán-hat lín ê ông, chhian-sóa khì lín kap lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ m̄-bat ê kok-ka; tī hia lín beh ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, sī ēng chhâ kap chio̍h-thâu chō--ê.
Lín tī Siōng Chú kóaⁿ lín khì ê lia̍t-kok tiong, lâng ōe chiong lín tòng-chòe chhiàu-tâm, kā lín thí-chhiò, koh in-ūi lín tú--tio̍h ê chêng-hêng tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Lín tī hn̂g--ni̍h iā chin chōe chéng-chí, m̄-kú siu-sêng chin chió, in-ūi chháu-meh lâi chia̍h.
Lín chai-chèng koh siu-chéng phû-tô-hn̂g, m̄-kú bô chiú thang lim, bô ké-chí thang bán, in-ūi thâng lâi chia̍h.
Lín choân-kok chèng kaⁿ-ná-chhiū, m̄-kú bô iû thang boah seng-khu, in-ūi kaⁿ-ná lak-liáu-liáu.
Lín ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ bōe-tàng lâu tī seng-khu piⁿ, in-ūi in ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì.
Lín ê chhiū-ba̍k kap thó͘-tōe ê chhut-sán, ōe hō͘ chháu-meh chia̍h-liáu-liáu.
Tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng ōe jú lâi jú chun-kùi, lín ōe jú lâi jú pi-bî;
in ū thang chioh lín, lín bô thang chioh in; in ōe choh-thâu koán lín, lín ōe choh-bé.

Chiah-ê chiù-chó͘ lóng ōe lîm-kàu lín, tui-jip lín, kā lín lia̍h-tiâu-tiâu, ti̍t-kàu lín bia̍t-bông, in-ūi lín bô thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, bô siú I só͘ bēng-lēng lín ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē.
Chiah-ê chiù-chó͘ ōe lîm-kàu lín kap lín ê hō͘-tāi, éng-oán chiâⁿ-chòe kì-hō kap kéng-kài.
Lín bô tī ta̍k-hāng hù-jū ê sî, kam-sim lo̍k-ì ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè,

só͘-í lín ōe chòe Siōng Chú chhe-lâi kong-kek lín ê tùi-te̍k ê lô͘-lē, tì-kàu iau-gō, chhùi-ta, thǹg-theh, it-bû-só͘-iú. In ōe ēng thih ê taⁿ kòa tī lín ê ām-kún, ti̍t-kàu lín bia̍t-bông.
Siōng Chú beh tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi heng-khí chi̍t kok, chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu chin kín chhiong lo̍h-lâi kong-kek lín; hit-kok ê ōe lín thiaⁿ bô,
in ê lâng bīn hiông-kài-kài, bōe chun-kèng lāu-lâng, bōe thiàⁿ-sioh gín-á;

in ōe thun-chia̍h lín ê cheng-siⁿ só͘ siⁿ--ê, kap lín ê thó͘-tōe chhut-sán--ê, ti̍t-kàu lín bia̍t-bông; koh chiong lín ê ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, sin-iû, gû-á-kiáⁿ kap iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ, chia̍h kah bô chhun pòaⁿ-hāng, ti̍t-kàu lín gō-sí.

In beh tī choân-kok ta̍k-ê siâⁿ ûi-khùn lín, ti̍t-kàu lín só͘ óa-khò koân-tōa koh kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ lóng tó-hoāi. In beh chiong lín ûi-khùn tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè só͘ siúⁿ-sù lín choân-kok ta̍k-ê siâⁿ.
Lín tī khún-pek khùn-khó͘ ê tiong-kan, beh chia̍h ka-kī ê chhin-siⁿ-kiáⁿ, chiū-sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lín ê hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ê bah.
Lín tiong-kan un-hô, ū tông-chêng-sim ê lâng, ōe léng-tām tùi-thāi i ê hiaⁿ-tī, i só͘ thiàⁿ ê bó͘, kap chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê gín-á,
bô beh chiong ka-kī só͘ chia̍h chhin-siⁿ-kiáⁿ ê bah, pun chi̍t-tiám-á hō͘ in; in-ūi lín tī ta̍k-ê siâⁿ siū tùi-te̍k ûi-khùn, siū khún-pek, lóng bô chhun pòaⁿ-hāng.
Lín tiong-kan un-hô, ū tông-chêng-sim, pêng-sî m̄-káⁿ thǹg-chhiah-kha ta̍h-thô͘ ê hū-jîn-lâng, ōe léng-tām tùi-thāi i só͘ thiàⁿ ê tiōng-hu, kap i ê hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ;
thau-thau-á chia̍h i siⁿ--lo̍h-lâi ê thai-pôaⁿ, sīm-chì chia̍h ka-kī siⁿ ê jî-lú, in-ūi lín tī ta̍k-ê siâⁿ siū tùi-te̍k ûi-khùn, siū khún-pek, lóng bô chhun pòaⁿ-hāng.
Lín nā bô chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng chit-pún chheh só͘ kì-chài lu̍t-hoat ê ōe, bô kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè êng-kng thang kiaⁿ-ùi ê miâ,
Siōng Chú chiū ōe ēng lín siūⁿ bōe kàu ê chai-hō, chiū-sī tōa koh kú-tn̂g ê chai-lān, giâm-tiōng koh tn̂g-kî ê pīⁿ, kàng-lo̍h hō͘ lín kap lín ê hō͘-tāi.
I mā ōe hō͘ lín só͘ kiaⁿ Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê pīⁿ lóng lîm-kàu lín, kā lín tîⁿ--teh, éng-oán i bōe hó;
liân chit-pún lu̍t-hoat ê chheh bô kì-chài ê pīⁿ kap chai-hō, Siōng Chú mā ōe hō͘ in lîm-kàu lín, ti̍t-kàu lín bia̍t-bông.

Lín í-chêng sui-jiân chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ hiah-ni̍h chōe, m̄-kú lín bô thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, só͘-í lín chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê jîn-kháu tōa-tōa kiám-chió.

Í-chêng Siōng Chú ì-ài hó khoán-thāi lín, hō͘ lín jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ, m̄-kú í-āu Siōng Chú ì-ài kā lín húi-hoāi, kā lín siau-bia̍t; lín mā ōe tùi ji̍p-khì sêng-chiap ê tōe siū pu̍ih-chhut.

Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ lín sì-sòaⁿ tī bān-kok tiong, tùi tōe ê chit-pêng kàu tōe ê hit-pêng; lín ōe tī hia ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, sī ēng chhâ ēng chio̍h tiau-khek, lín kap lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ m̄-bat ê sîn-bêng.
Tī hiah-ê kok, lín bōe-tàng ū an-tēng ê seng-oa̍h, bô tēng-ku ê só͘-chāi; Siōng Chú mā beh hō͘ lín tī hia sim-sîn put-an, ba̍k-sîn bô chheng-chhái, cheng-sîn soe-pāi;
lín ê sìⁿ-miā bô an-choân, mî-ji̍t thê-sim-tiàu-táⁿ, sìⁿ-miā lân-pó.
Lín ōe in-ūi sim-lāi ê kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kap ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, chá-khí-sî beh kóng, “Thiⁿ ná iáu-bē àm!” Àm-sî beh kóng, “Thiⁿ ná iáu-bē kng!”

Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ lín chē-chûn tò-khì Ai-ki̍p, kiâⁿ hit-tiâu góa bat hoan-hù lín m̄-thang koh tò--khì ê lō͘; tī hia, lín ōe bōe ka-kī hō͘ tùi-te̍k chòe lô͘-po̍k lú-pī, m̄-kú bô lâng beh bóe.
Siōng Chú tī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng li̍p-iok í-āu, koh tī Mô͘-ap -tōe bēng-lēng Mô͘-se kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng li̍p-iok. Ē-bīn sī li̍p-iok ê lōe-iông.

Mô͘-se tiàu Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng lâi, tùi in kóng: Siōng Chú tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe, tùi Hoat-ló kap i ê chèng jîn-sîn, í-ki̍p in choân-kok só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū, lín lóng chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h,
chiū-sī lín só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê tōa chai-lān, sîn-jiah, kap tōa kî-sū.
M̄-kú kàu kin-á-ji̍t, Siōng Chú iáu-bē hō͘ lín ōe bêng-pe̍k ê sim, ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê ba̍k-chiu, ōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ ê hī-á.
Góa chhōa lín tī khòng-iá sì-cha̍p nî, lín ê saⁿ-á-khò͘ bô phòa, ôe mā bô pháiⁿ--khì;
lín bô piáⁿ thang chia̍h, bô po̍h-chiú, kāu-chiú thang lim, m̄-kú Siōng Chú kiong-kip lín só͘ su-iàu ê it-chhè, hō͘ lín chai I chiū-sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Lín lâi kàu chit só͘-chāi, Hi-si̍t-pún -ông Se-hông, Pa-san -ông Go̍k chhut-lâi kap lán kau-chiàn;
lán kā in phah-pāi, kong-chhú in ê tōe, chiong hit-ê tōe pun hō͘ Lū-piān kap Ka-tek nn̄g ê chi-cho̍k, í-ki̍p Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k chòe sán-gia̍p;
só͘-í lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng chit-ê iok ê ōe, thang hō͘ lín sū-sū heng-thong.

Kin-á-ji̍t lín ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, tiúⁿ-ló, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t ê lâm-hū-ló-iù, í-ki̍p tòa tī lín tiong-kan kā lín phòa-chhâ, chhiūⁿ-chúi ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, lóng khiā tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng,
lín tio̍h chiap-siū Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè li̍p-sè kap lín li̍p ê iok,
hō͘ I chiàu I tùi lín ê èng-ún, mā chiàu I tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok li̍p-sè--ê, kin-á-ji̍t siat-li̍p lín chòe I ê chú-bîn, I chòe lín ê Siōng-tè.
Siōng Chú m̄-sī kan-ta kap lín li̍p-sè li̍p chit-ê iok,
sī kap kin-á-ji̍t kap lán chòe-hé khiā tī Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng ê lâng, í-ki̍p iáu-bē chhut-sì ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun li̍p-iok.
Lín chai, lán bat tòa tī Ai-ki̍p, mā ū tùi lia̍t-kok keng-kè;
lín koh ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h in tiong-kan hiah-ê ēng chhâ, chio̍h, kim, gûn chè-chō, thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng;

tio̍h kín-sīn, lín kin-á-ji̍t khiā tī chia ê lâng, bô-lūn ta-po͘-lâng, cha-bó͘-lâng, ka-cho̍k, chi-cho̍k, m̄-thang ûi-pōe Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè, khì ho̍k-sāi hiah-ê bîn-cho̍k ê sîn-bêng, chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi pháiⁿ ê kun siⁿ-chhut to̍k-chhài kap khó͘-chháu;

chit-khoán lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê chiù-chó͘ ê ōe, sim-lāi iáu-kú ka-kī an-ùi, kóng, “Góa sui-jiân kò͘-chip chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì, liân-lūi só͘-ū ê lâng, góa iû-goân ū pêng-an.”

Siōng Chú bōe sià-bián chit-khoán lâng; Siōng Chú ê tōa siū-khì ōe kā i sio-bia̍t, chiong kì-chài tī chit-pún chheh ê chiù-chó͘, lóng kàng-lo̍h tī i sin-chiūⁿ; Siōng Chú koh ōe tùi thiⁿ-ē chhat-siau i ê miâ;

Siōng Chú mā ōe chiàu chit-ê lu̍t-hoat ê chheh só͘ kì-chài ê iok lāi-bīn ê chiù-chó͘, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k ê tiong-kan kā i hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi, hō͘ i siū chai-hō.
Í-āu, lín ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun kap tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú hō͘ chit-ê tōe tú--tio̍h ê chai-lān kap pīⁿ-chèng,

chiū-sī chit-ê tōe ta̍k só͘-chāi ū liû-hông, ū iâm, hō͘ hé sio--kè, bōe-tàng chèng-choh, bô chhut-sán, bōe hoat-chháu, chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú tī tōa siū-khì tiong húi-hoāi Só͘-to-má, Gô-mô͘-la, Ap-má, Sé-pián án-ni;
in lóng ōe mn̄g, “Siōng Chú ná ōe tùi chit-ê tōe án-ni chòe? I ê siū-khì ná ōe hiah béng-lia̍t?”
Lâng ōe tùi in kóng, “Sī in-ūi chit só͘-chāi ê lâng khì-sak Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî kap in li̍p ê iok;
in khì pài in m̄ bat, mā-sī Siōng Chú kìm-chí in pài ê sîn-bêng;
só͘-í Siōng Chú hoat tōa siū-khì, chiong chit-pún chheh só͘ kì-chài it-chhè ê chiù-chó͘, lóng kàng-lo̍h tī chit-ê tōe.
Siōng Chú hui-siông siū-khì, tī tōa siū-khì tiong chiong in tùi chit-ê tōe pu̍ih-chhut, kā in hiat tī gōa-pang, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.”
Ū chi̍t-kóa tāi-chì Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè bô kā lán khé-sī; m̄-kú I ū khé-sī chit-ê lu̍t-hoat, hō͘ lán kap lán ê kiáⁿ-sun éng-oán chun-hêng.

Chiong-lâi, góa só͘ kā lín kóng ê chiok-hok kap chiù-chó͘ hoat-seng tī lín ê sin-chiūⁿ, lín tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kā lín liû-hòng--khì ê lia̍t-kok tiong, siūⁿ-khí chiah-ê sū,
hit-sî, lín kap lín ê kiáⁿ-sun nā choân-sim choân-chêng kui-ǹg Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, chiàu góa kin-á-ji̍t ê hoan-hù, chun-thàn I it-chhè ê ōe,

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chiū ōe lîn-bín lín, hō͘ lín siū-lia̍h ê lâng tò-tńg--lâi. I ōe hôe-sim-tńg-ì, chiong I kā lín sì-sòaⁿ tī lia̍t-kok ê lâng chū-chi̍p, chhōa--tńg-lâi.
Lín nā ū lâng siū kóaⁿ-tio̍k, chiū-sī tī thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè mā ōe kā lín chū-chi̍p, tùi hia chhōa lín tò--lâi.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe chhōa lín sêng-chiap lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ chiàm-léng ê tōe, hó khoán-thāi lín, hō͘ lín ê jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ, pí lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ khah chōe.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe kiat-chēng lín kap lín hō͘-tāi ê sim, hō͘ lín it-sim-it-ì thiàⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, hō͘ lín tī chit-ê tōe éng-oán khiā-khí.
Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe chiong chiah-ê chiù-chó͘ kàng-lo̍h tī lín ê tùi-te̍k, kap oàn-hūn lín, khún-pek lín ê lâng ê sin-chiūⁿ.
Lín ōe koh thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú ê ōe, chun-siú góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín I it-chhè ê kài-bēng.

Lín nā thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, chun-siú chit-ê lu̍t-hoat só͘ kì-chài ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē, koh choân-sim choân-chêng kui-ǹg Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, I ōe hō͘ lín sū-sū heng-thong, hō͘ lín só͘ siⁿ--ê, cheng-siⁿ siⁿ--ê, thó͘-tōe chhut-sán--ê, chhiong-chiok ū-chhun; in-ūi Siōng Chú ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng ì-ài lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ án-ni, hó khoán-thāi lín, sù-hok lín.
Góa kin-á-ji̍t só͘ bēng-lēng lín ê kài-bēng, m̄-sī lín chòe bōe kàu--ê, lī lín mā bô hn̄g;
m̄-sī tī thiⁿ-téng, lín m̄-bián mn̄g, kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng ūi-tio̍h lán khì thiⁿ-téng, chiong chit-ê kà-sī tòa--lo̍h-lâi, hō͘ lán thiaⁿ--kìⁿ lâi si̍t-hêng?”
Mā m̄-sī tī hái ê hit-pêng, lín m̄-bián mn̄g, kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng ūi-tio̍h lán kè-hái, chiong chit-ê kà-sī tòa--lâi, hō͘ lán thiaⁿ--kìⁿ lâi si̍t-hêng?”
Chit-ê kài-bēng lī lín chin kūn, sī tī lín ê chhùi-lāi, tī lín ê sim-tiong, hō͘ lín ōe-tàng si̍t-hêng.
Tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, góa kin-á-ji̍t chiong siⁿ-sí hō-hok kā lín kóng, hō͘ lín soán-te̍k.

Góa kin-á-ji̍t hoan-hù lín, tio̍h thiàⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, kiâⁿ I ê tō-lō͘, siú I ê kài-bēng, kui-lē, bēng-lēng, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè chiū ōe hō͘ lín tī beh ji̍p-khì chiàm-léng ê tōe kú-tn̂g khiā-khí, jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ, tit-tio̍h hok-khì.
Lín nā ûi-pōe Siōng Chú koh m̄ sūn-thàn, siū ín-iú khì kèng-pài ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng,
góa kin-á-ji̍t bêng-bêng kā lín kóng, lín it-tēng ōe bia̍t-bông, bōe-tàng tī lín kè Iok-tàn-hô beh ji̍p-khì chiàm-léng ê tōe kú-tn̂g khiā-khí.

Góa kin-á-ji̍t kiò thiⁿ kiò tōe lâi tùi lín choh-chèng: Góa chiong siⁿ kap sí, chai-hō kap hok-khì pâi tī lín ê bīn-chêng; tio̍h kéng sìⁿ-miā, lín kap lín ê hō͘-tāi chiū ōe-tàng kè-sio̍k seng-chûn;

tio̍h thiàⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, thiaⁿ-thàn I ê ōe, tiong-sêng kun-tè I; I sī lín ê oa̍h-miā, lín tio̍h khò I chiah ōe-tàng kè-sio̍k seng-chûn; án-ni lín chiū thang tī Siōng Chú tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok, li̍p-sè beh siúⁿ-sù in ê tōe kú-tn̂g khiā-khí.
Mô͘-se kè-sio̍k tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng,
“Góa í-keng chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p hè, bōe-tàng koh léng-tō lín. Siōng Chú bat tùi góa kóng, ‘Lí bōe-tàng kè Iok-tàn-hô.’

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe tī lín ê bīn-chêng chhōa lín kè--khì, siau-bia̍t chiah-ê cho̍k, hō͘ lín chiàm-léng in ê thó͘-tōe. Chiàu Siōng Chú só͘ kóng--ê, Iok-su-a ōe chhōa lín kè--khì.

Siōng Chú ōe tùi-thāi chiah-ê cho̍k, chhin-chhiūⁿ I í-chêng tùi-thāi A-mô͘-lī -lâng nn̄g ê ông, Se-hông kap Go̍k, í-ki̍p tùi-thāi in ê kok-ka kâng-khoán, kā in oân-choân siau-bia̍t.
Siōng Chú ōe chiong in kau hō͘ lín; lín tio̍h chiàu góa só͘ hoan-hù lín it-chhè ê bēng-lēng tùi-thāi in.
Lín tio̍h ióng-kám chòng-táⁿ, m̄-bián kiaⁿ in, m̄-bián in-ūi in khióng-hông; in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe kap lín chòe-hé khì, bōe lī-khui lín, bōe pàng-sak lín.”

Mô͘-se kiò Iok-su-a lâi, tī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng tùi i kóng, “Lí tio̍h ióng-kám chòng-táⁿ, in-ūi chiū-sī lí beh chhōa chit-ê jîn-bîn ji̍p-khì sêng-chiap Siōng Chú tùi in ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè beh hō͘ in ê tōe.
Siōng Chú beh kiâⁿ tī lí ê thâu-chêng, kap lí tông-chāi, bōe lī-khui lí, mā bōe pàng-sak lí. Lí m̄-bián kiaⁿ, mā m̄-bián lún.”
Mô͘-se chiong lu̍t-hoat ê chheh siá hó, chiū kau hō͘ kng Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê Lī-bī -lâng chòe chè-si--ê, kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló.
Mô͘-se bēng-lēng in, kóng, “Ta̍k-piàn móa chhit nî, tī bián-tû chè-bū hit-nî ê Tah-liâu-choeh,

Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng lâi kàu Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè só͘ kéng-soán kèng-pài I ê só͘-chāi, hit-sî, lín tio̍h tī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng tōa-siaⁿ tha̍k chit-ê lu̍t-hoat hō͘ in thiaⁿ.

Tio̍h chū-chi̍p jîn-bîn, bô-lūn ta-po͘, cha-bó͘, gín-á, í-ki̍p lín siâⁿ-lāi ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, hō͘ in lóng thiaⁿ, hō͘ in ha̍k-si̍p, thang kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng chit-ê lu̍t-hoat múi chi̍t kù ōe;

mā hō͘ hiah-ê iáu m̄ bat lu̍t-hoat ê hō͘-tāi lóng ōe-tàng thiaⁿ--tio̍h, thang tī kè Iok-tàn-hô khì sêng-chiap chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe, chi̍t-sì-lâng ha̍k-si̍p kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.”

Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí bô-jōa-kú ōe lī-khui sè-kan. Lí kiò Iok-su-a lâi, kap lí chòe-hé khiā tiàm hōe-bō͘ lāi; góa beh kau-tài i jīm-bū.” Mô͘-se chiū kap Iok-su-a khì khiā tī hōe-bō͘ lāi.
Siōng Chú tī hōe-bō͘ lāi, tī hûn-thiāu tiong hián-hiān; hûn-thiāu thêng tī hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu ê téng-bīn.

Siōng Chú koh tùi Mô͘-se kóng, “Lí teh-beh tńg-khì lí ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia. Lí sí í-āu, chiah-ê jîn-bîn ōe tī in ji̍p--khì ê só͘-chāi, ho̍k-sāi hit só͘-chāi ê gōa-cho̍k sîn-bêng kiâⁿ siâ-îm; khì-sak góa, ûi-pōe kap góa li̍p ê iok.

Hit-sî, góa ōe tùi in hoat siū-khì, khì-sak in, bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ khòaⁿ in; in ōe siū thun-bia̍t, tú-tio̍h chin chōe chai-hō hoān-lān; hit-ji̍t in chiū ōe mn̄g, kóng, ‘Lán tú-tio̍h chai-hō hoān-lān, sī m̄-sī in-ūi lán ê Siōng-tè bô kap lán tông-chāi?’
Hit-ji̍t in-ūi in pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, chok-ok-to-toan, só͘-í góa it-tēng bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ khòaⁿ in.
“Taⁿ, lí tio̍h siá chit-siú koa, kà jîn-bîn chhiùⁿ, ēng lâi kà-sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi, chòe góa chí-chek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê kiàn-chèng.
