Góa chhōa in chìn-ji̍p góa tùi in ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè beh hō͘ in hit-ê lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe liáu-āu, in ōe chia̍h kah pûi-chut-chut, phian-ǹg pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng ho̍k-sāi in, soah khòaⁿ-khin góa, ûi-pōe góa ê iok.

Kàu in tú-tio̍h chai-hō hoān-lān ê sî, chit-siú koa ōe chòe góa chí-chek in ê kiàn-chèng; in ê hō͘-tāi ōe kè-sio̍k chhiùⁿ chit-siú koa, bōe bōe-kì--tit. Sui-jiân góa iáu-bē chhōa in chìn-ji̍p góa li̍p-sè beh sù hō͘ in ê tōe, m̄-kú góa í-keng chai in ê sim-su liām-thâu.”
Hit-ji̍t, Mô͘-se chiū siá chit-siú koa, ēng lâi kà-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.

Siōng Chú hoan-hù Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a, kóng, “Lí tio̍h ióng-kám chòng-táⁿ, in-ūi lí beh chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ji̍p-khì góa li̍p-sè beh hō͘ in ê tōe; góa beh kap lí tông-chāi.”
Mô͘-se chiong chit-ê lu̍t-hoat ê chheh siá chheng-chhó,
chiū hoan-hù kng Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê Lī-bī -lâng, kóng,
“Chit-ê lu̍t-hoat ê chheh tio̍h hē tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi piⁿ, thang chòe chí-chek lín ê kiàn-chèng.
Góa chai lín sī pōe-ge̍k, sim-ngī kò͘-chip ê bîn-cho̍k; góa kin-á-ji̍t iáu oa̍h--teh kap lín chòe-hé, lín to ōe pōe-ge̍k Siōng Chú, hô-hòng góa sí liáu-āu!
Tio̍h chū-chi̍p lín só͘-ū chi-cho̍k ê tiúⁿ-ló kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ lâi góa chia, góa beh chiong chiah-ê ōe kóng hō͘ in thiaⁿ, mā beh kiò thiⁿ kiò tōe lâi chèng-si̍t lín ê m̄-tio̍h.

Góa chai, góa sí liáu-āu, lín ōe thiat-tóe pāi-hoāi, phian-lī góa só͘ bēng-lēng lín tio̍h kiâⁿ ê tō-lō͘; chiong-lâi lín ōe tú-tio̍h chai-hō, in-ūi lín ōe chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, jiá I siū-khì.”
Mô͘-se chiong chit-siú koa, tùi thâu kàu bé liām hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng thiaⁿ.
Thiⁿ ah, tio̍h àⁿ hī-khang, góa beh kóng-ōe; tōe ah, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ góa só͘ kóng ê ōe.

Góa ê kà-sī beh chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘-chúi kàng-lo̍h, góa ê ōe beh chhin-chhiūⁿ lō͘-chúi tih-lo̍h; chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘-mn̂g-á lo̍h tī iù-iù ê chháu, chhin-chhiūⁿ ki̍p-sî ê hō͘-chúi lo̍h tī chhài-soe.
Góa beh soan-iông Siōng Chú ê miâ; lín tio̍h chun lán ê Siōng-tè chòe tōa.
Siōng Chú sī Chio̍h-pôaⁿ, I ê só͘-chòe oân-choân, kong-pêng; I sī sìn-si̍t ê Siōng-tè, lóng bô put-gī; I kong-gī koh chèng-ti̍t.
Chit-ê oan-khiau pāi-hoāi ê sè-tāi, in pōe-ge̍k, bōe-kham-tit chòe I ê kiáⁿ.
Gû-gōng bû-ti ê jîn-bîn, lín ná ōe án-ni pò-tap Siōng Chú? I kiám m̄-sī lín ê lāu-pē, lín ê Chhòng-chō-chú, ū kiàn-li̍p lín ê kok-ka?
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit kó͘-chá ê ji̍t, hôe-sióng le̍k-tāi ê nî; mn̄g lí ê lāu-pē, i ōe chí-sī lí; mn̄g lí ê sī-tōa, in ōe kā lí kóng.
Chì-koân-chiá pun thó͘-tōe hō͘ bān-kok chòe sán-gia̍p, chiong sè-kan-lâng pun-khui; chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê jîn-sò͘, tēng bān-cho̍k ê kéng-kài.
Siōng Chú ê hūn-gia̍h sī I ê chú-bîn; Ngá-kok sī I ê sán-gia̍p.
Siōng Chú tī khòng-iá chhē-tio̍h i, tī pha-hng iá-siù teh háu ê tōe tú-tio̍h i; Siōng Chú lám i, chiàu-kò͘ i, pó-hō͘ i chhin-chhiūⁿ pó-hō͘ ba̍k-chiu-jîn.
Koh chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu lā i ê siū, ia̍t-si̍t kà sòe-chiah eng-á o̍h pe; thí-khui si̍t-kó͘ sîn i, chài tī si̍t-kó͘ téng.
Chí-ū Siōng Chú ín-chhōa I ê chú-bîn, bô kî-tha sîn-bêng ê pang-chān.
Siōng Chú hō͘ in thóng-tī tōe koân ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ in chia̍h chhân-iá ê thó͘-sán, tùi chio̍h-phāng suh bi̍t, tùi chio̍h-thâu tōe tit-tio̍h kaⁿ-ná-iû;
koh chia̍h gû-lin chòe ê chhì-jù, iûⁿ-lin, iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ ê iû, Pa-san ê mî-iûⁿ-káng, soaⁿ-iûⁿ, kap siōng-hó ê sió-be̍h, mā lim phû-tô-chiú.
Í-sek-lia̍t pûi chiū sáng-sè; lí í-keng tōa-kho͘ koh chho͘-ló͘, phê-bah kim-ku̍t, chiū khì-sak chhòng-chō lí ê Siōng-tè, khòaⁿ-khin kái-kiù lí ê Chio̍h-pôaⁿ.
In ēng pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng kek I oàn-tò͘, pài khó-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng jiá I siū-khì.
In chè-pài kúi-sîn, chiah-ê kúi-sîn m̄-sī Siōng-tè, sī in m̄-bat ê sîn-bêng, sī sin--ê, kūn-lâi chiah ū--ê, sī lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ bô teh kiaⁿ--ê.
Siⁿ lín ê Chio̍h-pôaⁿ, lín bô khòaⁿ-tāng I; siⁿ lín ê Siōng-tè, lín bōe-kì-tit I.
Siōng Chú khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū pàng-sak in, in-ūi I ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ jiá I siū-khì.
I chiū kóng: Góa bô beh koh chhap in, beh khòaⁿ in ê kiat-kio̍k án-chóaⁿ; in sī khúi-khiat ê sè-tāi, bô tiong-si̍t ê kiáⁿ-jî.

In pài m̄-sī Siōng-tè ê sîn-bêng, kek góa oàn-tò͘; in pài ngó͘-siōng, jiá góa siū-khì; góa chiū ēng m̄-chiâⁿ bîn-cho̍k ê jîn-bîn, kek in oàn-tò͘, ēng gû-gōng ê kok-bîn, jiá in siū-khì.
Góa siū-khì ê hé teh to̍h, to̍h kàu Im-kan ke̍k-chhim ê só͘-chāi, sio-bia̍t tāi-tōe kap it-chhè ê thó͘-sán, thun-bia̍t soaⁿ ê kun-ki.
Siōng Chú koh kóng: Góa beh put-toān ēng chai-hō kong-kek in, ēng góa chìⁿ-tē lāi só͘-ū ê chìⁿ siā in.
In in-ūi ki-hng siau-sán, hō͘ iām-jia̍t kap un-e̍k thun-bia̍t, hō͘ iá-siù kā--tio̍h, siū to̍k-chôa kong-kek.
Gōa-bīn ū to-kiàm, lāi-bīn ū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, hō͘ siàu-liân-lâng kap chāi-sek-lú, chia̍h-lin ê eⁿ-á kap pe̍h thâu-mn̂g ê lāu-lâng lóng bia̍t-bông.
Góa goân-pún beh thiat-tóe siau-bia̍t in, hō͘ sè-kan-lâng bōe-kì-tit in ê miâ.
M̄-kú, góa kiaⁿ in ê tùi-te̍k chū-khoa, kiaⁿ-liáu in gō͘-hōe, kiaⁿ-liáu in ōe kóng, “Sī goán phah-pāi Í-sek-lia̍t, m̄-sī Siōng Chú ê chok-ûi.”
In sī bōe-hiáu siūⁿ ê bîn-cho̍k, bô chi̍t-sut-á tì-sek.
Khó͘-bōe-tit in ū tì-hūi, ōe bêng-pe̍k chit-ê sū, ōe-hiáu siūⁿ ka-kī ê kiat-kio̍k.
Nā m̄-sī in ê Chio̍h-pôaⁿ kā in bōe hō͘ lâng, nā m̄-sī Siōng Chú khì-sak in, in ê tùi-te̍k ná ōe chi̍t ê phah-pāi in chi̍t-chheng ê, nn̄g ê hō͘ in chi̍t-bān ê tô-cháu?
In ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ bô chhin-chhiūⁿ lán ê Chio̍h-pôaⁿ, lán ê tùi-te̍k mā án-ni sêng-jīn.
Tùi-te̍k ê phû-tô-chhiū sī Só͘-to-má ê chéng, tùi Gô-mô͘-la ê hn̂g sóa--lâi-ê; in ê phû-tô sī to̍k phû-tô, kui-pha lóng sī khó͘--ê.
In ê chiú sī tōa-bé chôa ê to̍k, sī to̍k-chôa tì-miā ê to̍k.
Siōng Chú chiong tùi-te̍k só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ, lóng hong-ba̍t tī I ê hú-khò͘.
Sin-oan pò-èng chāi-tī Siōng Chú, sî-ki chi̍t-ē kàu I ōe kā in pò-èng; in tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê ji̍t kūn lah, ōe chin-kín siū hêng-hoa̍t.

Siōng Chú beh ūi-tio̍h I ê chú-bîn sin-oan, beh lîn-bín I ê po̍k-jîn, in-ūi I khòaⁿ-kìⁿ in khùi-la̍t í-keng bô--khì, chū-iû--ê kap bô chū-iû--ê, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh.
I beh kóng: In ê sîn-bêng tī tó-ūi? In óa-khò ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ tī tó-ūi?
Hiah-ê chia̍h in hiàn-chè ê iû, lim in tiān-chiú-chè ê chiú ê sîn-bêng, taⁿ tio̍h khí-lâi pang-chān in, pó-hō͘ in.

Taⁿ, lín tio̍h chai, chí-ū góa sī Siōng-tè, góa í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng; góa hō͘ lâng sí, mā hō͘ lâng oa̍h; góa phah-siong lâng, mā i-tī lâng; bô lâng ōe-tàng tùi góa ê chhiú-thâu kái-kiù in.
Góa ǹg thiⁿ gia̍h-chhiú, ēng góa éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè, kóng:
Góa beh chiong góa kim-siak-siak ê to bôa-lāi, chip-hêng sím-phòaⁿ, pò-ho̍k góa ê tùi-te̍k, pò-èng oàn-hūn góa ê lâng.
Góa beh hō͘ góa ê chìⁿ lim-huih, lim hiah-ê siū-thâi siū-lia̍h chiàn-sū ê huih; góa ê to beh chia̍h-bah, chia̍h tùi-te̍k hiah-ê tn̂g thâu-mn̂g ê léng-siù ê bah.

Lia̍t-kok ah, tio̍h kap Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn chòe-hé hoan-ho͘; Siōng Chú beh ūi-tio̍h I ê po̍k-jîn só͘ lâu ê huih sin-oan, pò-ho̍k I ê tùi-te̍k, sio̍k-hôe I ê tōe kap I ê chú-bîn.
Mô͘-se kap Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a chòe-hé lâi, chiong chit-siú koa liām hō͘ hōe-chiòng thiaⁿ.
Mô͘-se chiong chiah-ê ōe lóng kóng hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng thiaⁿ liáu-āu,
koh tùi in kóng, “Góa kin-á-ji̍t kéng-kài lín ê ōe, lín tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, mā tio̍h hoan-hù lín ê hō͘-tāi chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng chit-ê lu̍t-hoat it-chhè ê ōe;
in-ūi chit-ê lu̍t-hoat tùi lín m̄-sī khang-khang bô lō͘-ēng, sī lín ê sìⁿ-miā; chit-ê lu̍t-hoat ōe hō͘ lín tī kè Iok-tàn-hô beh chiàm-léng ê tōe kú-tn̂g khiā-khí.”
Hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se, kóng,
“Lí tio̍h khì Iâ-lī-ko tùi-bīn ê Mô͘-ap -tōe, chiūⁿ-khì A-pa-lîm soaⁿ-khu ê Nî-pho-soaⁿ, khòaⁿ góa beh siúⁿ-sù hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe ke-gia̍p ê Ka-lâm -tōe.
Lí ōe sí tī lí chiūⁿ--khì ê soaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ê hiaⁿ-ko A-lûn sí tī Hô-ní-soaⁿ, tò-khì lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia.
In-ūi lín nn̄g ê tī Sîm ê khòng-iá, Ka-te-su ê Bí-lī-pa chúi-chôaⁿ, tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan tek-chōe góa, bô chun góa chòe sèng.
Lí thang khòaⁿ tùi-bīn hit-ê tōe, m̄-kú bōe-tàng ji̍p-khì góa siúⁿ-sù hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tōe.”
Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng Mô͘-se beh sí í-chêng, kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiok-hok. Chiok-hok ê ōe kì tī ē-bīn:

Siōng Chú tùi Se-nāi-soaⁿ lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t-thâu tùi Í-tong khí--lâi, tùi Pa-lân-soaⁿ chiò-kng; I chhōa chheng-chheng-bān-bān thiⁿ-sài lâi, chiàⁿ-chhiú the̍h hoat-kng ê lu̍t-hoat hō͘ in.
Siōng Chú si̍t-chāi thiàⁿ bān-bîn, koàn-kò͘ I sèng ê chú-bîn. In chē tī lí ê kha-ē, thiaⁿ-siū lí ê kà-sī.
Mô͘-se ēng lu̍t-hoat thoân hō͘ lán, chòe Ngá-kok hōe-chiòng pó-kùi ê sán-gia̍p.
Siōng Chú choh-ông thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t, jîn-bîn ê léng-siù kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k chū-chi̍p khèng-chiok.
Lū-piān chi-cho̍k sui-jiân lâng-gia̍h chió, goān in kè-sio̍k seng-chûn bô toān-choa̍t.
Koan-hē Iû-tāi, i kóng: Goān Siōng Chú thiaⁿ Iû-tāi ê kî-kiû, chhōa in kap pa̍t-ê chi-cho̍k têng-sin liân-ha̍p; in ūi ka-kī kau-chiàn, goān lí pang-chān in phah-pāi tùi-te̍k.

Koan-hē Lī-bī, i kóng: Goān Siōng Chú chiong Thó͘-bêng sù hō͘ Lī-bī, chiong O͘-lêng sù hō͘ tùi lí tiong-sêng ê lâng; lí tī Má-sat khó-giām in, tī Bí-lī-pa chúi-chôaⁿ kap in cheng-lūn.
In tiong-sêng chun-hêng lí ê ōe, kian-siú lí ê iok, chhiau-kè khòaⁿ-kò͘ pē-bú, tiōng-sī hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, chiàu-kò͘ kiáⁿ-jî.

In beh ēng lí ê kui-lē kà-sī Ngá-kok, ēng lí ê lu̍t-hoat kà-sī Í-sek-lia̍t; in beh tī lí ê bīn-chêng sio-hiuⁿ kèng-pài, tī chè-tôaⁿ hiàn kui-chiah cheng-siⁿ chòe sio-hòa-chè.

Goān Siōng Chú sù-hok in ê sán-gia̍p, chiap-la̍p in ê chhiú só͘ chòe ê kang-chok; hiah-ê khí-lâi kong-kek in, oàn-hūn in ê lâng, goān lí phah-tn̄g in ê io, hō͘ in bōe-tàng koh khí--lâi.
Koan-hē Piān-ngá-bín, i kóng: Goān Siōng Chú hō͘ I só͘ thiàⁿ--ê tī I ê sin-piⁿ an-jiân khiā-khí; Siōng Chú kui-ji̍t pó-hō͘ in, hō͘ in tī I ê heng-chêng hióng-siū an-hioh.
Koan-hē Iok-sek, i kóng: Goān in ê thó͘-tōe tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú sù-hok, tit-tio̍h thiⁿ-téng ê kam-lō͘, tōe-ē ê chúi-chôaⁿ;
goān in tùi ji̍t-thâu tit-tio̍h hong-siu, tùi ge̍h-niû siu-sêng thó͘-sán,
tùi kó͘-chá chiū ū ê soaⁿ tit-tio̍h pó-mi̍h, tùi éng-oán khiā-chāi ê soaⁿ-niá tit-tio̍h pó-pòe;

goān in tit-tio̍h thó͘-tōe kap chhut-sán ê pó-mi̍h, í-ki̍p lîm-chāi tī chhì-phè ê Siōng Chú ê un-hūi. Goān chiah-ê lóng sù hō͘ Iok-sek, kui tī hiaⁿ-tī tiong siū kéng-soán chòe léng-siù ê Iok-sek.

Goān i chhin-chhiūⁿ thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê gû-káng, ū tōa ui-giâm; i nn̄g ki kak chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-gû ê kak, chiong bān-kok tak kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak; chit nn̄g ki kak sī Í-hoat-liân bān-bān ê cheng-peng, kap Má-ná-se chheng-chheng ê ióng-sū.
Koan-hē Se-pò͘-lûn, i kóng: Goān Se-pò͘-lûn hoaⁿ-hí chhut-gōa; goān Í-sat-ka khoài-lo̍k tiàm chhù-lāi.
In beh tiàu-chi̍p bān-cho̍k lâi soaⁿ--ni̍h, tī hia hiàn kong-gī ê chè; in beh khip-siu hái--ni̍h hong-hù ê chu-goân, kap chhàng tī soa--ni̍h ê pó-pòe.
Koan-hē Ka-tek, i kóng: Tio̍h chheng-chàn khok-tián Ka-tek léng-thó͘ ê Siōng Chú! Goān Ka-tek chhin-chhiūⁿ bih--teh ê sai-bú, thiah-li̍h la̍h-bu̍t ê chêng-thúi kap thâu-khak.

I ūi ka-kī soán-te̍k siōng-hó ê thó͘-tōe, sī chiáng-koân-chiá ê hūn-gia̍h; i kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê léng-siù chòe-hé, si̍t-hêng Siōng Chú ê kong-gī, chip-hêng Siōng Chú ūi Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ chòe ê phòaⁿ-toàn.
Koan-hē Tān, i kóng: Tān sī siàu-chòng ê sai, tùi Pa-san thiàu--chhut-lâi.
Koan-hē Ná-hut-tha-lī, i kóng: Ná-hut-tha-lī, lí tit-tio̍h chhiong-chiok ê un-hūi, tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú móa-móa ê sù-hok; goān lí tit-tio̍h sai-pêng kap lâm-pêng ê tōe.
Koan-hē A-siat, i kóng: A-siat sī Siōng Chú siōng chiok-hok ê kiáⁿ-jî; goān i tit-tio̍h hiaⁿ-tī ê hoaⁿ-hí, kaⁿ-ná-iû im i ê kha-ba̍k.
Lí siâⁿ-mn̂g ê chhòaⁿ sī thih--ê, tâng--ê; lí ōe kú-tn̂g hióng-siū thài-pêng.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kap Siōng-tè pí; I tùi thiⁿ-téng pang-chān lí, I chē hûn hián-chhut I ê êng-kng.
Tùi kó͘-chá chiū ū ê Siōng-tè sī pī-lān-só͘, I ê chhiú éng-oán hû-chhî lí; I tī lí ê bīn-chêng chiong tùi-te̍k kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, koh kóng, “Kā in siau-bia̍t!”
Í-sek-lia̍t thang hióng-siū thài-pêng, Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi tòa tī chhut-sán ngó͘-kok kap sin-chiú ê tōe; thiⁿ mā kàng-lo̍h lō͘-chúi hō͘ i.

Í-sek-lia̍t, lí chin ū hok-khì! Lí sī Siōng Chú chín-kiù ê chú-bîn, ū tó chi̍t ê bîn-cho̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ lí? I sī pó-hō͘ lí ê tún-pâi, sī lí tek-sèng ê to-kiàm; lí beh cheng-ho̍k tùi-te̍k, beh ta̍h in ê ka-chiah-phiaⁿ.
Mô͘-se tùi Mô͘-ap pêng-goân chiūⁿ Nî-pho-soaⁿ, kàu Iâ-lī-ko tùi-bīn ê Pí-su-ka soaⁿ-téng. Siōng Chú chiong choân-tōe hō͘ i khòaⁿ: Tùi Ki-lia̍t kàu Tān,
Ná-hut-tha-lī tōe-khu, Í-hoat-liân kap Má-ná-se tōe-khu, Iû-tāi tōe-khu kàu Tōe-tiong-hái,
lâm-pêng ê Nî-kek-hu, kap Chang-chhiū-siâⁿ Iâ-lī-ko ê pêng-goân, kàu Só-ní.

Siōng Chú kā i kóng, “Chit-ê tōe sī góa tùi A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok li̍p-sè, èng-ún beh siúⁿ-sù in ê hō͘-tāi ê tōe. Taⁿ, góa hō͘ lí chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tōe, m̄-kú lí bōe-tàng ji̍p-khì hia.”
Chiàu Siōng Chú só͘ kóng, Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se sí tī Mô͘-ap tōe-khu.
Siōng Chú chiong i bâi-chòng tī Mô͘-ap tōe-khu, Pek Pí-ní tùi-bīn ê soaⁿ-kok; kàu kin-á-ji̍t bô lâng chai i bâi-chòng ê só͘-chāi.
Mô͘-se sí ê sî chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p hè, ba̍k-chiu bô hoe, cheng-le̍k bô soe-thè.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Mô͘-ap pêng-goân ūi-tio̍h Mô͘-se pi-siong ai-khàu móa saⁿ-cha̍p ji̍t.
Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a tit-tio̍h tì-hūi ê sîn chhiong-móa, in-ūi Mô͘-se bat kā i hōaⁿ-chhiú. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sūn-thàn Iok-su-a, chiàu Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se ê ōe chòe.
Āu-lâi, Siōng Chú bô koh tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan heng-khí chhin-chhiūⁿ Mô͘-se ê sian-ti; Mô͘-se sī Siōng Chú bīn-tùi-bīn jīn-bat--ê.
Siōng Chú chhe i tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe, tùi Hoat-ló kap lóng-chóng ê jîn-sîn, í-ki̍p Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe kiâⁿ chin chōe sîn-jiah kî-sū;
koh tī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng ê ba̍k-chiu chêng, hō͘ i ū tōa khùi-la̍t chòe tōa koh thang-kiaⁿ ê sū.
Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se sí liáu-āu, Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê chō͘-chhiú, Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a, kóng,
“Góa ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se í-keng sí; taⁿ lí kap só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn tio̍h chún-pī hó-sè, kè Iok-tàn-hô, khì góa só͘ beh siúⁿ-sù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tōe.
Chiàu góa tùi Mô͘-se ê èng-ún, lín ê kha ta̍h--kè ê tōe, góa lóng beh sù hō͘ lín.

Lín ê léng-thó͘ beh tùi lâm-pêng ê khòng-iá kàu pak-pêng ê Lê-pa-lūn, tùi tang-pêng ê Tōa-hô, chiū-sī Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô, Hek -lâng ê choân-tōe, ti̍t-kàu ji̍t lo̍h hit-pêng ê Tōe-tiong-hái.
Lí chi̍t-sì-lâng bô lâng ōe-tàng iâⁿ-kè lí; góa án-chóaⁿ kap Mô͘-se tông-chāi, mā beh án-ni kap lí tông-chāi; góa it-tēng bōe lī-khui lí, mā bōe pàng-sak lí.
Lí tio̍h ióng-kám chòng-táⁿ, in-ūi lí beh chhōa chit-ê jîn-bîn cheng-ho̍k góa tùi in ê chó͘-sian li̍p-sè beh sù hō͘ in ê tōe.

Lí it-tēng tio̍h ióng-kám chòng-táⁿ, chun-hêng góa ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se só͘ bēng-lēng lí it-chhè ê lu̍t-hoat, m̄-thang phian-chó-phian-iū. Án-ni, lí bô-lūn khì tó-ūi lóng ōe sū-sū sūn-lī.

Lí tio̍h siông-siông tha̍k chit-ê lu̍t-hoat ê chheh, mî-ji̍t ia̍h tha̍k ia̍h siūⁿ, hō͘ lí chun-hêng chit-pún chheh só͘ kì it-chhè ê ōe; án-ni lí ê lō͘ chiū ōe pîⁿ-tháⁿ, sū-sū heng-thong.
Góa bēng-lēng lí: Tio̍h ióng-kám chòng-táⁿ, m̄-thang kiaⁿ, m̄-thang lún; in-ūi lí bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè it-tēng kap lí tông-chāi.”
Tùi án-ni, Iok-su-a bēng-lēng jîn-bîn ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ,

khì iâⁿ-tiong ta̍k só͘-chāi hoan-hù jîn-bîn, kóng, “Tio̍h chún-pī niû-si̍t, in-ūi saⁿ ji̍t lāi, lín beh kè Iok-tàn-hô, ji̍p-khì sêng-chiap Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè beh sù hō͘ lín ê tōe.”
Iok-su-a hoan-hù Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng, kóng,
“Lín tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se bēng-lēng lín ê ōe: Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè beh chiong lín tī chia an-ún khiā-khí ê tōe siúⁿ-sù lín.

Lín ê bó͘, gín-á, kap lín ê cheng-siⁿ, lóng thang tòa tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng, Mô͘-se hun-phòe hō͘ lín ê tōe; m̄-kú lín tiong-kan só͘-ū kiông-béng ê ióng-sū, lóng tio̍h tòa kun-khì, chòe lín tông-pau ê sian-hong kè-hô, kap in chòe-hé chok-chiàn,

ti̍t-kàu Siōng Chú hō͘ lín ê tông-pau kap lín siâng-khoán, tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù in an-ún khiā-khí ê tōe. Hit-sî lín chiah thang tò-lâi lín só͘ tit--tio̍h chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe, chiū-sī Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se hun-phòe hō͘ lín tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng ê tōe.”
In ìn Iok-su-a kóng, “Lí hoan-hù goán--ê, goán lóng beh chiàu án-ni chòe; lí phài goán khì tó-ūi, goán lóng beh khì;
goán í-chêng án-chóaⁿ sūn-thàn Mô͘-se, mā beh án-ni sūn-thàn lí. Goān Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè kap lí tông-chāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ kap Mô͘-se tông-chāi kâng-khoán.
Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng ûi-pōe lí ê bēng-lēng, bô beh sūn-thàn lí ê ōe, tio̍h hō͘ i sí. Lí it-tēng tio̍h ióng-kám chòng-táⁿ!”

Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a tùi Si̍p-têng àm-tiong phài nn̄g ê cheng-thàm, kā in kóng, “Lín khì thàm-cha hit-ê tōe, te̍k-pia̍t sī Iâ-lī-ko.” In chiū khì, kàu chi̍t ê chhiong-ki Lat-ha̍p ê chhù, chiū hioh tī hia.
Ū lâng khì kā Iâ-lī-ko -ông thong-pò kóng, “Kim-àm ū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lâi thàm-cha lán chit-ê tōe.”
Iâ-lī-ko -ông chiū phài lâng khì Lat-ha̍p hia, kóng, “Hiah-ê lâi lín chhù ê lâng, lí tio̍h kā in kau--chhut-lâi; in lâi sī beh thàm-cha lán ê thó͘-tōe.”
Lat-ha̍p chiong hit nn̄g ê lâng chhàng--khí-lâi, chiū ìn kóng, “Khak-si̍t ū lâng lâi góa chia, m̄-kú in tùi tó-ūi lâi, góa m̄ chai;
ji̍t àm beh koaiⁿ siâⁿ-mn̂g ê sî, in chhut--khì, khì tó-ūi góa mā m̄ chai. Lín kóaⁿ-kín khì jip, chiū ōe jip--tio̍h.”
M̄-kú, hū-jîn-lâng í-keng kā hit nn̄g ê lâng chhōa-chiūⁿ chhù-téng, ēng pâi tī chhù-téng ê môa-kó kā in khàm--teh.
Hiah-ê lâng chiū tùi beh khì Iok-tàn-hô hit-tiâu lō͘ jip in, jip kàu tō͘-kháu; jip in ê lâng chi̍t-ē chhut--khì, siâⁿ-mn̂g chiū koaiⁿ--khí-lâi.
Hit nn̄g ê lâng iáu-bē khì khùn, hū-jîn-lâng chiūⁿ chhù-téng khì chhē in,
tùi in kóng, “Góa chai Siōng Chú í-keng chiong chit-ê tōe siúⁿ-sù lín, goán kap chit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín, lóng kiaⁿ kah phòa-táⁿ.

In-ūi goán ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî, Siōng Chú án-chóaⁿ ūi-tio̍h lín hō͘ Âng-hái ê chúi ta--khì; koh lín án-chóaⁿ tùi-hù Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng nn̄g ê A-mô͘-lī -ông, Se-hông kap Go̍k, kā in húi-bia̍t.
Goán chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì chiū sit-táⁿ, in-ūi lín ê iân-kò͘ kiaⁿ kah sîn-put-hū-thé; in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sī thiⁿ-téng tōe-ē ê Siōng-tè.
Taⁿ, góa ū hó khoán-thāi lín, chhiáⁿ lín kí Siōng Chú tùi góa chiù-chōa, beh hó khoán-thāi goán lāu-pē ê ke; koh hō͘ góa chi̍t ê khak-si̍t ê pó-chèng,
thang pó-hō͘ góa ê lāu-pē lāu-bú, góa ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, kap goán ka-cho̍k ê sìⁿ-miā, hō͘ goán bián sí.”

Hit nn̄g ê lâng ìn i kóng, “Goán ēng goán ê sìⁿ-miā pó-chèng. Lí nā bô lāu-sia̍p goán ê hêng-chong, kàu Siōng Chú chiong chit-ê tōe siúⁿ-sù goán ê sî, goán beh ēng chin-sêng jîn-chû khoán-thāi lí.”
Lat-ha̍p chiū ēng soh-á kā in tùi thang-á lūi--lo̍h-khì; in-ūi i ê chhù khí tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, i mā tòa tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng.
I tùi in kóng, “Lín tio̍h ǹg soaⁿ hit-pêng khì, chiah bián hō͘ tui-jip ê lâng tú--tio̍h; tī hia bih saⁿ ji̍t, thèng-hāu tui-jip ê lâng tò--lâi, chiah thang tò-tńg--khì.”
Hit nn̄g ê lâng tùi i kóng, “Goán it-tēng ōe chiàu lí kah goán chiù-chōa--ê khì chòe, m̄-kú lí tio̍h chiàu goán ê ōe chòe.

Goán lâi kong-kek chit só͘-chāi ê sî, lí tio̍h chiong chit-tiâu chu-âng-sek ê soh pa̍k tī lí kā goán lūi--lo̍h-khì ê thang-á, mā tio̍h kiò lí ê lāu-pē lāu-bú, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, kap lí ê ka-cho̍k lóng chū-chi̍p lâi lí ê chhù-lāi.

Nā ū lâng tùi lí ê chhù chhut-khì koe-lō͘, hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, sī i ka-kī chòe-tit-lâi--ê, bô goán ê chek-jīm; m̄-kú, tī lí ê chhù-lāi nā ū lâng hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, chit-ê chōe chiū kui tī goán.
Chóng-sī lí nā lāu-sia̍p goán ê hêng-chong, lí kah goán chiù-chōa--ê chiū kap goán bô koan-hē.”
Lat-ha̍p tah-èng in, jiân-āu sàng in lī-khui. I chiū ēng chu-âng-sek ê soh pa̍k tī thang-á.
Hit nn̄g ê lâng khì kàu soaⁿ--ni̍h, tī hia bih saⁿ ji̍t, thèng-hāu tui-jip ê lâng tò--khì; tui-jip ê lâng iân-lō͘ chhē in, mā chhē bô.
Hit nn̄g ê lâng lo̍h-soaⁿ, kè-hô, kàu Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a hia, tùi i pò-kò in só͘ tú-tio̍h it-chhè ê sū.
In koh tùi Iok-su-a kóng, “Siōng Chú chin-chiàⁿ chiong hit-ê tōe lóng kau tī lán ê chhiú; hit só͘-chāi só͘-ū ê chū-bîn, chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h lán, lóng kiaⁿ kah phòa-táⁿ.”
Keh-ji̍t, Iok-su-a thàu-chá khí--lâi, kap só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui Si̍p-têng, lâi kàu Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ; in tī hia chat-iâⁿ, thèng-hāu kè-hô.
Kè saⁿ ji̍t, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kàu iâⁿ-tiong ta̍k só͘-chāi,

hoan-hù jîn-bîn, kóng, “Lín nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h Lī-bī -lâng chòe chè-si--ê kng Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi, tio̍h khí-sin lī-khui lín ê só͘-chāi, tè tī iok-kūi ê āu-bīn,
hō͘ lín chai tio̍h kiâⁿ tó chi̍t tiâu lō͘, in-ūi lín iáu m̄-bat kiâⁿ chit-tiâu lō͘; m̄-kú lín kap iok-kūi tāi-iok tio̍h lī chi̍t kong-lí hn̄g, m̄-thang óa siuⁿ kūn.”
Iok-su-a tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Lín tio̍h kā ka-kī hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, in-ūi bîn-á-chài Siōng Chú beh tī lín tiong-kan kiâⁿ kî-sū.”
Iok-su-a koh tùi chè-si kóng, “Lín kng iok-kūi khí--lâi, kiâⁿ tī jîn-bîn ê thâu-chêng.” In chiū chiong iok-kūi kng--khí-lâi, kiâⁿ tī jîn-bîn ê thâu-chêng.

Siōng Chú tùi Iok-su-a kóng, “Tùi kin-á-ji̍t khí, góa beh hō͘ lí tit-tio̍h só͘-ū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chun-kèng, hō͘ in chai góa kap lí tông-chāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng kap Mô͘-se tông-chāi kâng-khoán.
Lí tio̍h hoan-hù kng iok-kūi ê chè-si, kóng, ‘Lín kàu Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ ê sî, chiū thêng tī hia.’”
Iok-su-a tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Lín khiā chìn-chêng, thiaⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe.”

Iok-su-a koh kóng, “I beh tī lín ê thâu-chêng chiong Ka-lâm -lâng, Hek -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Kek-ka-sat -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; án-ni lín chiū ōe chai éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè tī lín tiong-kan.
Choân-tōe ê Chú ê iok-kūi beh tī lín ê thâu-chêng kiâⁿ-ji̍p Iok-tàn-hô.
Hiān-chāi lín tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chi-cho̍k tiong kéng cha̍p-jī lâng, múi chi-cho̍k chi̍t ê.

Kng Choân-tōe ê Chú — Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê chè-si ê kha chi̍t-ē ta̍h-tio̍h Iok-tàn-hô ê chúi, Iok-tàn-hô siōng-liû ê chúi ōe chiâⁿ-chòe chúi-chhiûⁿ, bōe koh lâu--lo̍h-lâi.”
Jîn-bîn lī-khui pò͘-pîⁿ, beh kè Iok-tàn-hô ê sî, chè-si kng iok-kūi kiâⁿ tī in ê thâu-chêng.
Hit-sî sī siu-sêng ê kî, Iok-tàn-hô ê chúi siông-siông lâu-kè khoe-hōaⁿ. Chè-si kng iok-kūi lâi kàu Iok-tàn-hô, in ê kha chi̍t-ē ùn-tio̍h chúi,

siōng-liû ê chúi chiū bô koh lâu--lo̍h-lâi, tī lī chin hn̄g ê Sat-la-tàn hù-kūn ê A-tong -siâⁿ chiâⁿ-chòe chúi-chhiûⁿ; bô koh ū chúi lâu-ji̍p A-la-pa-hái, chiū-sī Iâm-hái. Jîn-bîn chiū tùi Iâ-lī-ko ê tùi-bīn kè Iok-tàn-hô.
Kng Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê chè-si tī Iok-tàn-hô ê ta-tōe khiā-tiāⁿ-tiāⁿ; Í-sek-lia̍t choân-thé jîn-bîn lóng kiâⁿ ta-tōe kè Iok-tàn-hô.
Choân-thé jîn-bîn í-keng kè Iok-tàn-hô, Siōng Chú hoan-hù Iok-su-a, kóng,
“Tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan kéng cha̍p-jī lâng, múi chi-cho̍k chi̍t ê lâng;
bēng-lēng in tùi Iok-tàn hô-tiong, chè-si khiā ê só͘-chāi, chhú cha̍p-jī tè chio̍h, tòa--kè-khì, hē tī lín kim-mî beh hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi.”
Iok-su-a chiū chiong i tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ soán-chhut hit cha̍p-jī lâng, múi chi-cho̍k chi̍t ê, lóng tiàu-chi̍p óa--lâi.

Iok-su-a kā in kóng, “Lín khì Iok-tàn hô-tiong, kàu Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè iok-kūi ê thâu-chêng, chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t chi-cho̍k ê sò͘-bo̍k, ta̍k-ê lâng chhú chi̍t tè chio̍h-thâu giâ tī keng-thâu téng;
chiah-ê chio̍h-thâu thang tī lín tiong-kan chòe kì-hō; chiong-lâi lín ê kiáⁿ-sun nā mn̄g lín, ‘Chiah-ê chio̍h-thâu tùi lín ū sím-mi̍h ì-sù?’

Lín thang tùi in kóng, ‘Sī in-ūi í-chêng Iok-tàn-hô ê chúi tī Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi chêng chia̍t-tn̄g; iok-kūi kè Iok-tàn-hô ê sî, Iok-tàn-hô ê chúi bô koh lâu; chiah-ê chio̍h-thâu beh chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng éng-oán ê kì-liām.’”

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thiaⁿ Iok-su-a ê bēng-lēng, chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chi-cho̍k ê sò͘-bo̍k, tùi Iok-tàn hô-tiong chhú cha̍p-jī tè chio̍h-thâu. In chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Iok-su-a ê hoan-hù, tòa hiah-ê chio̍h-thâu kè-hô, hē tī in hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi.
Iok-su-a lēng-gōa ēng cha̍p-jī tè chio̍h-thâu thia̍p tī Iok-tàn hô-tiong, tī kng iok-kūi ê chè-si khiā--teh ê só͘-chāi; kàu kin-á-ji̍t, hiah-ê chio̍h-thâu iáu tī hia.

Kng iok-kūi ê chè-si khiā tī Iok-tàn hô-tiong, it-ti̍t kàu Siōng Chú thong-kè Iok-su-a tùi jîn-bîn ê bēng-lēng lóng oân-sêng, tú chiàu Mô͘-se hoan-hù Iok-su-a ê ōe. Jîn-bîn chin kín kè--khì.
Choân-thé jîn-bîn chi̍t-ē kè-hô, Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi kap chè-si chiū tī jîn-bîn ê bīn-chêng kè--khì.
Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng, lóng chiàu Mô͘-se tùi in kóng ê ōe, tòa kun-khì tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê thâu-chêng kè--khì;
in iok-lio̍k ū sì-bān lâng tòa kun-khì tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kè--khì, kàu Iâ-lī-ko pêng-goân, chún-pī hó-sè beh kau-chiàn.
Hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chun Iok-su-a chòe tōa; i it-seng siū jîn-bîn kèng-ùi, chhin-chhiūⁿ in kèng-ùi Mô͘-se án-ni.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Iok-su-a, kóng,
“Lí bēng-lēng kng iok-kūi ê chè-si tùi Iok-tàn-hô khí--lâi.”
Iok-su-a chiū án-ni bēng-lēng chè-si.

Kng Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê chè-si tùi Iok-tàn-hô khí--lâi; chè-si ê kha chi̍t-ē ta̍h chiūⁿ-hōaⁿ, Iok-tàn-hô ê chúi chiū hôe-ho̍k goân-chōng, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng tiòng-móa siang-pêng hōaⁿ.
Chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-cha̍p, Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn tùi Iok-tàn-hô chiūⁿ--lâi, tī Iâ-lī-ko tang-pêng ê Kiat-kah chat-iâⁿ.
Iok-su-a chiong in tùi Iok-tàn-hô chhú--lâi hit cha̍p-jī tè chio̍h-thâu, thia̍p tī Kiat-kah,
jiân-āu tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Chiong-lâi lín ê kiáⁿ-sun nā mn̄g in ê lāu-pē, ‘Chiah-ê chio̍h-thâu sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù?’
Hit-sî tio̍h hō͘ lín ê kiáⁿ-sun chai, kóng, ‘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bat kiâⁿ ta-tōe, kè chit-ê Iok-tàn-hô.’

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tī lín ê thâu-chêng hō͘ Iok-tàn-hô ê chúi ta--khì, thèng-hāu lín kè hô, chhin-chhiūⁿ I chá-chêng tī Âng-hái chòe--ê chi̍t-iūⁿ, chiū-sī hō͘ hô tī goán ê thâu-chêng ta--khì, thèng-hāu goán kè--lâi;
beh hō͘ choân jîn-lūi lóng chai, Siōng Chú ê chhiú ū tōa lêng-le̍k; mā beh hō͘ lín éng-oán kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.”

Iok-tàn-hô sai-pêng ê A-mô͘-lī chu-ông kap óa Tōe-tiong-hái ê Ka-lâm chu-ông, thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bīn-chêng hō͘ Iok-tàn-hô ê chúi ta--khì, koh thèng-hāu in kè--khì; chiah-ê ông ê sim lóng in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê iân-kò͘ kiaⁿ kah sîn-put-hū-thé.
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú tùi Iok-su-a kóng, “Lí tio̍h ēng hé-chio̍h bôa-chòe to, tē-jī piàn kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiâⁿ kat-lé.”
Iok-su-a chiū chè-chō hé-chio̍h-to, tī Kat-lé-soaⁿ kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiâⁿ kat-lé.
Iok-su-a kā in kiâⁿ kat-lé ê goân-in sī án-ni: Tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut--lâi hiah-ê ōe kau-chiàn ê ta-po͘-lâng lóng sí tī khòng-iá ê lō͘--ni̍h,
in lóng ū siū kat-lé; m̄-kú chhut Ai-ki̍p í-āu tī khòng-iá chhut-sì ê jîn-bîn lóng iáu-bē siū kat-lé.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī khòng-iá kiâⁿ sì-cha̍p nî, chhut Ai-ki̍p ê chiàn-sū in-ūi bô thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú ê ōe, lóng siū siau-bia̍t; Siōng Chú bat tùi in soan-sè, m̄ hō͘ in khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú tùi in ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè beh siúⁿ-sù in ê tōe, chiū-sī lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe.
In ê kiáⁿ-sun, chiū-sī Siōng Chú só͘ heng-khí sin ê chi̍t tāi, lóng iáu-bē siū kat-lé, in-ūi tī lō͘--ni̍h bô lâng kā in kiâⁿ kat-lé, Iok-su-a chiah kā in kiâⁿ.
Só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng siū kat-lé liáu-āu, chiū lâu tī iâⁿ-lāi, thèng-hāu hôe-ho̍k.
Siōng Chú tùi Iok-su-a kóng, “Góa kin-á-ji̍t í-keng tû-khì lín tī Ai-ki̍p só͘ siū ê kiàn-siàu.” Só͘-í, hit só͘-chāi chiū kiò-chòe Kiat-kah, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Hit-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Kiat-kah chat-iâⁿ; hit-ge̍h cha̍p-sì àm, in tī Iâ-lī-ko pêng-goân siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.
Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh keh-ji̍t, in chiū chia̍h hit só͘-chāi ê thó͘-sán, chiū-sī bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ kap hang ê ngó͘-kok.
In chia̍h hit só͘-chāi ê thó͘-sán hit-ji̍t khí, má-ná bô koh kàng-lo̍h; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū bô koh ū má-ná. Hit-nî in khai-sí chia̍h Ka-lâm -tōe ê thó͘-sán.

Iok-su-a chiap-kūn Iâ-lī-ko ê sî, hut-jiân khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū chi̍t ê lâng gia̍h chi̍t ki pu̍ih--khí-lâi ê to, khiā tī i ê tùi-bīn; Iok-su-a kiâⁿ chìn-chêng, mn̄g i kóng, “Lí sī ūi goán chit-pêng--ê, á-sī ūi goán ê tùi-te̍k hit-pêng?”

I ìn kóng, “Lóng m̄-sī. Góa sī Siōng Chú kun-tūi ê thóng-sòe. Taⁿ góa lâi lah!” Iok-su-a chiū phak tī thô͘-kha pài i, kóng, “Góa ê Chú tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn ū sím-mi̍h hoan-hù?”
Siōng Chú kun-tūi ê thóng-sòe tùi Iok-su-a kóng, “Chiong lí kha--ni̍h ê ôe thǹg--khí-lâi, in-ūi lí khiā ê só͘-chāi sī sèng--ê.” Iok-su-a chiū chiàu án-ni chòe.
Iâ-lī-ko ê siâⁿ-mn̂g, in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê iân-kò͘ koaiⁿ-tiâu-tiâu, bô lâng chhut-ji̍p.
Siōng Chú tùi Iok-su-a kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, góa í-keng chiong Iâ-lī-ko kap i ê ông, i kiông-béng ê ióng-sū, lóng kau tī lí ê chhiú.
Lín só͘-ū ê chiàn-sū tio̍h se̍h chit-ê siâⁿ, chi̍t ji̍t chi̍t piàn, se̍h la̍k ji̍t;
chhit ê chè-si tio̍h gia̍h chhit ki iûⁿ-kak ê sàu-kak kiâⁿ tī iok-kūi ê thâu-chêng; kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, lín tio̍h se̍h siâⁿ chhit piàn, chè-si mā tio̍h pûn sàu-kak.

Lín chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h sàu-kak thoa-tn̂g ê siaⁿ, só͘-ū ê lâng tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ hoah, siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ chiū ōe tó kah pîⁿ-pîⁿ-pîⁿ, ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tio̍h kè-sio̍k chìn-chêng, chhiong-ji̍p siâⁿ.”
Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a tiàu-chi̍p chè-si, tùi in kóng, “Lín tio̍h kng iok-kūi, chhit ê chè-si gia̍h chhit ki iûⁿ-kak ê sàu-kak, kiâⁿ tī Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê thâu-chêng.”
I koh kā jîn-bîn kóng, “Lín tio̍h chìn-chêng khì se̍h siâⁿ, tòa kun-khì--ê tio̍h kiâⁿ tī Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê thâu-chêng.”
Iok-su-a tùi jîn-bîn kóng soah, chhit ê chè-si gia̍h chhit ki iûⁿ-kak ê sàu-kak, kiâⁿ tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng pûn sàu-kak; Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi tè tī in ê āu-bīn.
Tòa kun-khì ê sian-hong-tūi kiâⁿ tī pûn sàu-kak ê chè-si thâu-chêng, āu-tūi tè iok-kūi kiâⁿ; chè-si ná kiâⁿ ná pûn sàu-kak.

Iok-su-a bēng-lēng jîn-bîn, kóng, “Lín m̄-thang hoah, m̄-thang hō͘ lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê siaⁿ, liân chi̍t kù to m̄-thang hoah chhut-chhùi, thèng-hāu góa hoan-hù lín hoah ê sî, lín chiah thang hoah.”
Án-ni, Iok-su-a hō͘ Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi se̍h siâⁿ se̍h chi̍t lìn; jiân-āu, in tò-lâi iâⁿ-tōe hioh-mî.
Iok-su-a thàu-chá khí--lâi, chè-si koh kng Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi.

Gia̍h iûⁿ-kak ê sàu-kak ê chhit ê chè-si, kiâⁿ tī Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê thâu-chêng pûn sàu-kak; tòa kun-khì ê sian-hong-tūi kiâⁿ tī chè-si ê thâu-chêng, āu-tūi tè tī Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê āu-bīn, chè-si ná kiâⁿ ná pûn sàu-kak.
Tē-jī ji̍t in mā se̍h siâⁿ se̍h chi̍t lìn, jiân-āu tò-lâi iâⁿ-tōe. La̍k ji̍t lóng án-ni chòe.
Tē-chhit ji̍t thiⁿ phú-kng ê sî, in chiū khí--lâi, chiàu kâng-khoán ê hong-sek se̍h siâⁿ, m̄-kú chit-ji̍t se̍h siâⁿ se̍h chhit lìn.
Kàu tē-chhit piàn, chè-si pûn sàu-kak ê sî, Iok-su-a tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ hoah, in-ūi Siōng Chú í-keng chiong chit-ê siâⁿ kau hō͘ lín lah!

Chit-ê siâⁿ kap lāi-bīn só͘-ū--ê, lóng tio̍h oân-choân húi-bia̍t hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; chí-ū chhiong-ki Lat-ha̍p, í-ki̍p só͘-ū tiàm tī i chhù-lāi ê lâng, tio̍h lâu in ê sìⁿ-miā; in-ūi i ū chhàng lán phài--khì ê cheng-thàm.

Lín tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang the̍h eng-kai húi-bia̍t ê mi̍h, chiah bián lín siū chiù-chó͘; lín nā the̍h eng-kai húi-bia̍t ê mi̍h, Í-sek-lia̍t choân-iâⁿ chiū ōe chiâⁿ-chòe eng-kai húi-bia̍t--ê, jiá-khí chai-hō.
M̄-kú kim, gûn, í-ki̍p tâng kap thih ê khì-khū, lóng tio̍h hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng kui hō͘ Siōng Chú, siu-ji̍p Siōng Chú ê hú-khò͘.”

Jîn-bîn chiū tōa-siaⁿ hoah, chè-si pûn sàu-kak. Jîn-bîn thiaⁿ-tio̍h sàu-kak ê siaⁿ, chiū koh-khah tōa-siaⁿ hoah, siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ chiū tó kah pîⁿ-pîⁿ-pîⁿ, jîn-bîn chiū chhiong--ji̍p-khì, toa̍t-chhú hit-ê siâⁿ.
Jîn-bîn chiong siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū--ê, bô-lūn lâm-hū-ló-iù, gû, iûⁿ, kap lû, choân-pō͘ ēng to kā in siau-bia̍t.

Iok-su-a kā hit nn̄g ê thàm-cha hit-ê tōe ê lâng kóng, “Lín ji̍p-khì hit-ê chhiong-ki ê chhù, chiàu lín tùi i chiù-chōa--ê, chhōa hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng kap só͘-ū sio̍k i ê lâng chhut--lâi.”

Hit nn̄g ê chòe cheng-thàm ê siàu-liân-lâng chiū ji̍p--khì, chhōa Lat-ha̍p kap i ê lāu-pē lāu-bú, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, í-ki̍p só͘-ū sio̍k i ê lâng chhut--lâi. In kā Lat-ha̍p ê chhin-chiâⁿ lóng chhōa chhut-lâi tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê iâⁿ-gōa.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū ēng hé sio hit-ê siâⁿ kap lāi-bīn só͘-ū--ê; m̄-kú kim, gûn, í-ki̍p tâng kap thih ê khì-khū, lóng siu-ji̍p tī Siōng Chú chhù-lāi ê hú-khò͘.

Iok-su-a pó-choân chhiong-ki Lat-ha̍p, i ê lāu-pē ê ka-sio̍k, kap só͘-ū sio̍k i ê lâng ê sìⁿ-miā. In chiū tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan kàu kin-á-ji̍t, in-ūi Lat-ha̍p ū chhàng Iok-su-a phài-lâi thàm-cha Iâ-lī-ko ê cheng-thàm.

Hit-sî, Iok-su-a chiù-chōa kéng-kò kóng, “Nā ū lâng tiông-kiàn Iâ-lī-ko -siâⁿ, ōe siū Siōng Chú chiù-chó͘: Hē tōe-ki ê sî, ōe sí tōa-kiáⁿ; an siâⁿ-mn̂g ê sî, ōe sí soah-bé-kiáⁿ.”
Siōng Chú kap Iok-su-a tông-chāi; Iok-su-a ê miâ-siaⁿ thoân-piàn choân-tōe.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī eng-kai húi-bia̍t hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê mi̍h ū hoān-chōe. Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k tiong, Siā-la ê cheng-sun, Sat-tí ê sun, Ka-bí ê kiáⁿ A-kan the̍h eng-kai húi-bia̍t ê mi̍h; Siōng Chú chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoat siū-khì.
Iok-su-a tùi Iâ-lī-ko phài lâng khì Pek-te̍k-lī tang-pêng, Pek A-bûn hù-kūn ê Ai -siâⁿ, hoan-hù in, kóng, “Lín khì thàm-cha hit-ê tōe.” In chiū khì thàm-cha Ai -siâⁿ.

In tò-lâi Iok-su-a hia, tùi i kóng, “M̄-bián hō͘ só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn lóng khì, kan-ta nn̄g-saⁿ-chheng lâng khì phah Ai -siâⁿ chiū hó; m̄-bián lô-tōng só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn, in-ūi hia ê lâng chin chió.”
Só͘-í tāi-iok ū saⁿ-chheng lâng khì kong-táⁿ, m̄-kú soah hō͘ Ai -siâⁿ ê lâng phah-pāi.
Ai -siâⁿ ê lâng tùi siâⁿ-mn̂g chêng tui-jip in, kàu Sī-pa-lîm lo̍h-kiā ê só͘-chāi phah-sí iok-lio̍k saⁿ-cha̍p-la̍k ê lâng. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū lóng kiaⁿ kah sîn-put-hū-thé.
Iok-su-a chiū thiah-li̍h saⁿ; i kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló tī Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê thâu-chêng phak tī thô͘-kha, koh ēng thô͘-hún sám thâu-khak, kàu ē-hng.

Iok-su-a kóng, “Ài ah, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ chhōa chiah-ê jîn-bîn kè Iok-tàn-hô, chiong goán kau hō͘ A-mô͘-lī -lâng, hō͘ in kā goán siau-bia̍t? Goán lêng-khó lâu tiàm Iok-tàn-hô hit-pêng.
Chú ah, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kì-jiân tī tùi-te̍k bīn-chêng oa̍t-tńg-sin tô-cháu, góa iáu ū sím-mi̍h ōe thang kóng?
Ka-lâm -lâng kap chit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn nā thiaⁿ--tio̍h, it-tēng ōe lâi pau-ûi goán, kā goán ê miâ tùi tōe-chiūⁿ tû--khì; hit-sî lí beh án-chóaⁿ ûi-hō͘ lí ê tōa-miâ?”
Siōng Chú kā Iok-su-a kóng, “Khí--lâi, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ phak tī thô͘-kha?
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoān-chōe, ûi-pōe góa bēng-lēng in ê iok, the̍h eng-kai húi-bia̍t hiàn hō͘ góa ê mi̍h; in thau-the̍h, khi-phiàn, chhàng tī in ê khì-khū lāi.

In-ūi án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thâi bōe iâⁿ tùi-te̍k; in tī tùi-te̍k ê bīn-chêng oa̍t-tńg-sin tô-cháu, sī in-ūi in chiâⁿ-chòe eng-kai húi-bia̍t--ê. Lín nā bô chiong eng-kai húi-bia̍t hiàn hō͘ góa ê mi̍h, tùi lín tiong-kan tû--khì, góa chiū bô koh kap lín tông-chāi.

Khí--lâi! Tio̍h hō͘ jîn-bîn hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, kā in kóng, ‘Lín tio̍h ka-kī hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, ūi-tio̍h bîn-á-chài chún-pī. Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, lín tiong-kan ū eng-kai húi-bia̍t ê mi̍h, nā bô kau--chhut-lâi, lín it-tēng bōe-tàng tí-khòng tùi-te̍k.’

Bîn-á-chá-khí, lín tio̍h chiàu chi-cho̍k lâi góa chia; Siōng Chú hō͘ tó chi̍t ê chi-cho̍k thiu-tio̍h chhiam, in ê chong-cho̍k tio̍h chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê lâi góa chia; Siōng Chú hō͘ tó chi̍t ê chong-cho̍k thiu-tio̍h chhiam, in ê ka-cho̍k tio̍h chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê lâi góa chia; Siōng Chú hō͘ tó chi̍t ê ka-cho̍k thiu-tio̍h chhiam, in ê ta-po͘-lâng tio̍h chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê lâi góa chia.

Siōng Chú hō͘ i thiu-tio̍h chhiam ê lâng, chiū-sī ū eng-kai húi-bia̍t ê mi̍h tī i hia; i kap i só͘-ū--ê lóng tio̍h ēng hé kā in sio-bia̍t, in-ūi i ū ûi-pōe Siōng Chú ê iok, koh tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong chòe gû-gōng ê tāi-chì.”
Keh-ji̍t, Iok-su-a thàu-chá khí--lâi, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàu chi-cho̍k lâi i hia, thiu-tio̍h Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k;
chiū hō͘ Iû-tāi chiàu chong-cho̍k lâi i hia, thiu-tio̍h Siā-la ê chong-cho̍k; chiū hō͘ Siā-la chiàu ka-cho̍k lâi i hia, thiu-tio̍h Sat-tí ê ka-cho̍k;
chiū hō͘ Sat-tí ka-cho̍k ê ta-po͘-lâng chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê lâi i hia, chiū thiu-tio̍h A-kan; i sī Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k Siā-la ê cheng-sun, Sat-tí ê sun, Ka-bí ê kiáⁿ.

Iok-su-a tùi A-kan kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ, góa khǹg lí tio̍h êng-iāu Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, tī I ê bīn-chêng jīn-chōe, chiong lí só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì kā góa kóng, m̄-thang tùi góa ún-môa.”
A-kan ìn Iok-su-a kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi ū tek-chōe Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè. Góa só͘ chòe ê sū sī án-ni:

Góa tī chhiúⁿ--lâi ê châi-bu̍t tiong khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t niá Pa-pí-lûn ê súi-saⁿ, nn̄g kong-kun ê gûn, pòaⁿ kong-kun ê kim-tiâu; góa tham-tio̍h chiah-ê mi̍h, chiū the̍h--lâi. Hiān-chāi hiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ tâi tī góa pò͘-pîⁿ lāi-bīn ê thô͘-kha, gûn tī siōng ē-tóe.”
Iok-su-a chiū phài lâng cháu-khì A-kan ê pò͘-pîⁿ; hiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ kó-jiân chhàng tī i ê pò͘-pîⁿ lāi, gûn tī siōng ē-tóe.
In chiū chiong hiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ tùi pò͘-pîⁿ the̍h--chhut-lâi, tòa-lâi Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn hia, hē tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.

Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn chiong Siā-la ê cheng-sun A-kan, kap hiah-ê gûn, hit-niá saⁿ, kim-tiâu, kap i ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, gû, lû, iûⁿ, pò͘-pîⁿ, kap i só͘-ū--ê, lóng tòa-khì A-kat Soaⁿ-kok.

Iok-su-a kóng, “Lí ná ōe hāi goán tú-tio̍h chiah-ni̍h tōa ê chai-hō? Kin-á-ji̍t Siōng Chú mā beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ lí.” Tùi án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ēng chio̍h-thâu kā A-kan tìm-sí, ēng hé sio i só͘-ū--ê, jiân-āu ēng chio̍h-thâu hiat tī hit téng-bīn.

Chèng-lâng tī A-kan si-thé ê téng-bīn thia̍p chi̍t-tōa-tui chio̍h-thâu, kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu tī hia. Tùi án-ni, Siōng Chú siu-hôe I ê tōa siū-khì. Só͘-í hit só͘-chāi kiò-chòe A-kat Soaⁿ-kok, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.

Siōng Chú tùi Iok-su-a kóng, “M̄-thang kiaⁿ, m̄-thang lún. Lí khí--lâi, chhōa lóng-chóng ê chiàn-sū khì kong-kek Ai -siâⁿ; góa í-keng chiong Ai -siâⁿ ê ông, kap i ê jîn-bîn, i ê siâⁿ, i ê thó͘-tōe lóng kau hō͘ lí lah.

Lí án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi Iâ-lī-ko kap i ê ông, mā tio̍h án-ni tùi-thāi Ai -siâⁿ kap i ê ông; m̄-kú lín chhiúⁿ--tio̍h ê châi-bu̍t kap cheng-siⁿ, thang chòe lín ê chiàn-lī-phín. Lí tio̍h phài peng bâi-ho̍k tī siâⁿ ê āu-bīn.”
Tùi án-ni, Iok-su-a kap choân-thé ê chiàn-sū lóng khí--lâi, beh khì kong-chhú Ai -siâⁿ. Iok-su-a kéng saⁿ-bān ê kiông-béng ê ióng-sū, phài in mî--sî khì,
hoan-hù in, kóng, “Lín tio̍h bâi-ho̍k tī siâⁿ ê āu-bīn, m̄-thang lī siâⁿ siuⁿ hn̄g; lóng tio̍h chún-pī hó-sè.
Góa kap góa chhōa ê chiàn-sū beh ǹg siâⁿ chìn-kong; in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ téng-piàn chhut-lâi kong-kek goán, hit-sî goán chiū beh tī in ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu.

In ōe chhut-lâi tui-jip goán, siūⁿ-kóng, ‘Chiah-ê lâng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ téng-piàn tī goán ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu.’ Só͘-í goán beh tī in ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu, kàu goán ín-iú in lī-khui siâⁿ.
Hit-sî lín tio̍h tùi bâi-ho̍k ê só͘-chāi khí--lâi, toa̍t-chhú hit-ê siâⁿ, in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe chiong chit-ê siâⁿ kau tī lín ê chhiú.
Lín chiàm-léng chit-ê siâⁿ liáu-āu, tio̍h ēng hé sio siâⁿ, chiàu Siōng Chú ê ōe khì chòe. Chù-ì, che sī góa ê bēng-lēng.”
Iok-su-a phài in khì, in chiū khì bâi-ho̍k tī Ai -siâⁿ ê sai-pêng, Pek-te̍k-lī kap Ai -siâⁿ ê tiong-kan. Hit-mî, Iok-su-a kap chiàn-sū chòe-hé tī kun-iâⁿ hioh-khùn.
Keh-ji̍t, Iok-su-a thàu-chá khí--lâi, tiám-sǹg chiàn-sū; i kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló tī jîn-bîn ê thâu-chêng chhut-hoat khì Ai -siâⁿ.
Kap i chòe-hé ê chiàn-sū, lóng pek-kūn siâⁿ ê thâu-chêng, tī Ai -siâⁿ ê pak-pêng chat-iâⁿ; tī i kap Ai -siâⁿ ê tiong-kan ū keh chi̍t ê soaⁿ-kok.
I ū kéng tāi-iok gō͘-chheng lâng bâi-ho̍k tī Ai -siâⁿ ê sai-pêng, Pek-te̍k-lī kap Ai -siâⁿ ê tiong-kan.
Iok-su-a pò͘-tì chiàn-sū, chú-le̍k-kun tī Ai -siâⁿ ê pak-pêng, bâi-ho̍k ê peng tī siâⁿ ê sai-pêng. Hit-mî Iok-su-a chìn-ji̍p soaⁿ-kok.

Ai -siâⁿ ê ông khòaⁿ--tio̍h, i kap siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng thàu-chá kóaⁿ-kín chhut-hoat, chhut-khì kàu A-la-pa thâu-chêng ê chiàn-tiûⁿ, beh kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn; m̄-kú ông m̄ chai tī siâⁿ ê āu-bīn ū peng bâi-ho̍k.
Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê chiàn-sū tī in ê thâu-chêng ké thâi-su, tùi khòng-iá ê lō͘ tô-cháu.
Ai -siâⁿ só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn lóng tiàu-chi̍p óa-lâi tui-jip in. In tui-jip Iok-su-a, chiū siū ín-iú lī-khui in ê siâⁿ.
Ai -siâⁿ kap Pek-te̍k-lī -siâⁿ choân-pō͘ ê lâng lóng chhut-khì tui-jip Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; siâⁿ-mn̂g pàng-khui-khui, khì tui-jip Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Siōng Chú tùi Iok-su-a kóng, “Lí chhun-chhut chhiú--ni̍h ê chhiuⁿ kí Ai -siâⁿ; góa beh chiong i kau hō͘ lí.” Iok-su-a chiū chhun-chhut chhiú--ni̍h ê chhiuⁿ kí hit-ê siâⁿ.
I chi̍t-ē chhun-chhiú, bâi-ho̍k ê peng chiū tùi in ê só͘-chāi sûi-sî khí--lâi, ji̍p-khì chiàm-léng hit-ê siâⁿ, sûi-sî pàng-hé sio.

Ai -siâⁿ ê lâng oa̍t-thâu chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ; khòaⁿ-tio̍h siâⁿ-lāi hé-ian chhèng-chiūⁿ thiⁿ, chiū sì-kòe chông, m̄-chai beh cháu-khì tó-ūi. Hiah-ê ké-su cháu-khì khòng-iá ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiū hoan-thâu lâi kong-kek tui-jip in.
Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê chiàn-sū khòaⁿ-tio̍h bâi-ho̍k ê peng í-keng chhú siâⁿ, siâⁿ-lāi hé-ian chhèng-chiūⁿ koân, chiū hoán-kek thâi-sí Ai -siâⁿ ê lâng.
Bâi-ho̍k ê peng mā chhut-lâi kong-kek in; in siū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pau-ûi, lóng hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thâi-sí; bô chi̍t ê oa̍h--teh, bô chi̍t ê tô-cháu.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng oa̍h-lia̍h Ai -siâⁿ ê ông, ah i khì Iok-su-a hia.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī chhân-iá, tī khòng-iá thâi-sí só͘-ū jip in ê Ai -siâⁿ chiàn-sū; in koh tò-tńg-lâi Ai -siâⁿ, ēng to thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng.
Hit-ji̍t Ai -siâⁿ só͘-ū ê lâng lóng hō͘ in thâi-sí, lâm-lú kiōng chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng lâng.
Ai -siâⁿ só͘-ū ê lâng lóng siū châu-bia̍t, Iok-su-a chiah siu-hôe i gia̍h-chhiuⁿ ê chhiú.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū chiàu Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Iok-su-a ê ōe, chiong siâⁿ-lāi ê cheng-siⁿ kap châi-bu̍t, lóng chhiúⁿ-lâi chòe ka-kī ê chiàn-lī-phín.
Iok-su-a chiong Ai -siâⁿ pàng-hé sio, hō͘ i éng-oán chòe thô͘-tui, kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu hong-hòe.

I koh chiong Ai -siâⁿ ê ông tiàu tī chhiū-téng, kàu hông-hun; ji̍t lo̍h ê sî, i hā-lēng, lâng chiah tùi chhiū-téng siu sin-si lo̍h--lâi, hiat tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu; tī hit téng-bīn thia̍p chi̍t-tōa-tui chio̍h-thâu, kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu lâu--teh.
Hit-sî, Iok-su-a tī Í-pa-lō͘-soaⁿ, ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ,

sī chiàu Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bēng-lēng, chiàu Mô͘-se lu̍t-hoat ê chheh kì-chài--ê, ēng bô keng-kè thih-khì phah--kè ê kui-lia̍p chio̍h-thâu khí--ê; in tī chit-ê tôaⁿ-téng hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Iok-su-a tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bīn-chêng chiong Mô͘-se ê lu̍t-hoat chhau-siá tī chio̍h-thâu téng.

Só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, bô-lūn sī pún-cho̍k-lâng á-sī gōa-cho̍k-lâng, lóng kap in ê tiúⁿ-ló, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, í-ki̍p sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, khiā tī iok-kūi ê siang-pêng, bīn ǹg kng Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê Lī-bī -lâng chòe chè-si--ê, chi̍t-pòaⁿ biān-tùi Ki-lī-sim-soaⁿ, chi̍t-pòaⁿ biān-tùi Í-pa-lō͘-soaⁿ. Iok-su-a chiàu Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se í-chêng só͘ bēng-lēng--ê, kā Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn chiok-hok.
Jiân-āu, Iok-su-a soan-tho̍k lu̍t-hoat ê chheh só͘ kì-chài lóng-chóng chiok-hok kap chiù-chó͘ ê ōe.

Mô͘-se só͘ bēng-lēng it-chhè ê ōe, Iok-su-a tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê choân-thé hōe-chiòng, kap hū-jîn-lâng, gín-á, í-ki̍p in tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng ê bīn-chêng, bô chi̍t kù bô tha̍k.

Tòa tī Iok-tàn-hô sai-pêng ê soaⁿ-khu, soaⁿ-po͘, í-ki̍p Tōe-tiong-hái iân-hōaⁿ kàu Lê-pa-lūn tōe-khu ê Hek -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Ka-lâm -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, chiah-ê ông chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thâi-iâⁿ ê siau-sit,
chiū lóng chū-chi̍p, tâng-sim-ha̍p-ì, beh kap Iok-su-a, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn.
Ki-piàn ê chū-bîn thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-su-a án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi Iâ-lī-ko kap Ai -siâⁿ,
chiū siat kè-bô͘, ké-chòe sù-chiá, ēng lû-á chài tóe mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê kū pò͘-tē, kap pó͘--kè ê kū chiú-tē;
chhēng pó͘--kè ê kū-ôe kap kū-saⁿ, tòa ta koh chhùi-chhùi ê piáⁿ.
In lâi kàu Kiat-kah ê iâⁿ-tōe kìⁿ Iok-su-a, tùi i kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Goán sī tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi--ê; taⁿ chhiáⁿ kap goán li̍p-iok.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi chiah-ê Hi-bī -lâng kóng, “Lín khó-lêng sī chit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn, goán ná ōe-tàng kap lín li̍p-iok?”
Ki-piàn -lâng tùi Iok-su-a kóng, “Goán sī lí ê lô͘-po̍k.” Iok-su-a mn̄g in kóng, “Lín sī sím-mi̍h-lâng, sī tùi tó-ūi lâi--ê?”
In tùi i kóng, “Lí ê lô͘-po̍k tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi; goán ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ê miâ-siaⁿ, chiū-sī I tī Ai-ki̍p it-chhè ê só͘-chòe,
í-ki̍p I tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng tùi A-mô͘-lī nn̄g ê ông, Hi-si̍t-pún -ông Se-hông kap tòa tī A-su-tha-lio̍k ê Pa-san -ông Go̍k, it-chhè ê só͘-chòe.

Goán ê léng-siù kap goán hia ê lâng lóng kā goán kóng, ‘Lín tio̍h tòa lō͘-tiong su-iàu ê chia̍h-mi̍h khì gêng-chiap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kā in kóng: Goán sī lín ê lô͘-po̍k, chhiáⁿ kap goán li̍p-iok.’
Goán chhut-hoat beh lâi lín chia ê sî, tòa--chhut-lâi ê piáⁿ iáu sio-sio, m̄-kú taⁿ í-keng lóng ta koh chhùi-chhùi--khì lah;
in-ūi lō͘ chin hn̄g, chiah-ê chiú-tē, tóe chiú ê sî iáu-sī sin--ê, m̄-kú taⁿ í-keng phòa-li̍h; goán ê saⁿ kap ôe mā lóng kū--khì lah.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiám-cha in ê chia̍h-mi̍h, bô mn̄g Siōng Chú.
Iok-su-a chiū kap in tēng hô-pêng tiâu-iok, bô thâi in; hōe-chiòng ê léng-siù mā tùi in chiù-chōa.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap in li̍p-iok liáu-āu, kè saⁿ ji̍t, chiah chai in goân-lâi tòa tī hù-kūn.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut-hoat, tē-saⁿ ji̍t lâi kàu in tòa ê siâⁿ; hiah-ê siâⁿ chiū-sī Ki-piàn, Ki-hui-la, Pí-lio̍k, Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm.

In-ūi hōe-chiòng ê léng-siù í-keng chí Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè tùi in chiù-chōa, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū bô kā in thâi; in-ūi án-ni, bîn-chiòng chiū put-boán in ê léng-siù.
Hiah-ê léng-siù tùi bîn-chiòng kóng, “Goán í-keng chí Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè tùi in chiù-chōa, só͘-í lán m̄-thang kā in kha̍p--tio̍h.
Lán tio̍h lâu in ê sìⁿ-miā, chiah bián lán in-ūi ûi-pōe chiù-chōa, hō͘ Siōng-tè kā lán hêng-hoa̍t.”
Léng-siù koh tùi in kóng, “Tio̍h hō͘ in oa̍h--teh.” Tùi án-ni, Ki-piàn -lâng chiū chiàu léng-siù kóng ê ōe, ūi-tio̍h bîn-chiòng phòa-chhâ chhiūⁿ-chúi.
Iok-su-a kiò in lâi, kā in kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ phiàn goán kóng ‘Goán sī tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi--ê’? Kî-si̍t lín sī chit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn.
Só͘-í lín tio̍h siū Siōng Chú chek-hoa̍t, lín tiong-kan put-toān ū lâng ōe chòe lô͘-lē, ūi-tio̍h goán Siōng-tè ê chhù chòe phòa-chhâ chhiūⁿ-chúi--ê.”

In ìn Iok-su-a kóng, “In-ūi khak-si̍t ū lâng kā lí ê lô͘-po̍k kóng, Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ū èng-ún I ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se, beh chiong chit-ê choân-tōe siúⁿ-sù lín, koh tī lín ê thâu-chêng châu-bia̍t chit-ê tōe só͘-ū ê chū-bîn; goán in-ūi kiaⁿ hō͘ lín thâi-sí chiah án-ni chòe.
Taⁿ goán tī lí ê chhiú-thâu; lí thang chiàu lí khòaⁿ-chòe hó, khòaⁿ-chòe tio̍h--ê tùi-thāi goán.”
Iok-su-a chiū án-ni tùi-thāi in, kiù in bián hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thâi-sí.
Tùi hit-ji̍t khí, Iok-su-a chiū hō͘ in tī Siōng Chú só͘ kéng-soán ê só͘-chāi, ūi-tio̍h bîn-chiòng kap chè-tôaⁿ phòa-chhâ chhiūⁿ-chúi, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -ông A-to-nî Sé-tek thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-su-a kong-chhú Ai -siâⁿ, thâi-sí Ai -siâⁿ ê ông, kā in oân-choân châu-bia̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng tùi-thāi Iâ-lī-ko kap i ê ông siâng-khoán; koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ki-piàn ê chū-bîn kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tēng hô-pêng tiâu-iok, kap in khiā-khí,
chiū chin kiaⁿ; in-ūi Ki-piàn pí Ai -siâⁿ khah tōa, chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t ê kiaⁿ-siâⁿ, koh siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng lóng gâu sio-thâi.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -ông A-to-nî Sé-tek chiū phài lâng khì kìⁿ Hi-pek-lûn -ông Hô-hâm, Iâ-boa̍t -ông Pí-lân, La-kiat -ông Ngá-hui-a, kap I-ki-lûn -ông Tí-phek, kóng,
“Chhiáⁿ lín lâi oān-chō͘ góa; lán tàu-tīn lâi-khì kong-táⁿ Ki-piàn, in-ūi in kap Iok-su-a í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t tēng hô-iok.”

Tùi án-ni, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -ông, Hi-pek-lûn -ông, Iâ-boa̍t -ông, La-kiat -ông, I-ki-lûn -ông, chit gō͘ ê A-mô͘-lī -ông lóng chhōa in ê kun-tūi, chū-chi̍p chat-iâⁿ tī Ki-piàn ê tùi-bīn, beh chìn-kong.

Ki-piàn -lâng chiū phài lâng khì Kiat-kah iâⁿ-tōe kìⁿ Iok-su-a, kóng, “Lí m̄-thang kiu-chhiú pàng-sak lí ê lô͘-po̍k; kiû lí kóaⁿ-kín lâi kái-kiù goán, pang-chān goán; in-ūi tòa tī soaⁿ-khu hiah-ê A-mô͘-lī -ông, lóng chū-chi̍p lâi beh kong-kek goán.”
Iok-su-a chiū kap i só͘-ū ê chiàn-sū, í-ki̍p kiông-béng ê ióng-sū, tùi Kiat-kah chhut-hoat.
Siōng Chú tùi Iok-su-a kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ in, in-ūi góa í-keng chiong in kau tī lí ê chhiú; in bô chi̍t ê lâng ōe-tàng tí-khòng lí.”
Iok-su-a tùi Kiat-kah thàu-mî chiūⁿ--khì, tu̍t-kek A-mô͘-lī -lâng.

Siōng Chú hō͘ in tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bīn-chêng khí hūn-loān, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū tī Ki-piàn kā in tōa-tōa phah-pāi, tui-jip in kàu Pek Hô-lûn chiūⁿ-kiā ê lō͘, kā in phah kàu A-se-ka kap Má-ki-tāi.

In tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu; tī Pek Hô-lûn lo̍h-kiā ê só͘-chāi, Siōng Chú tùi thiⁿ lo̍h tōa-pha̍uh phah in, ti̍t-kàu A-se-ka, kā in phah-sí. Hiah-ê hō͘ pha̍uh phah--sí-ê, pí hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ēng to thâi--sí-ê khah chōe.

Siōng Chú chiong A-mô͘-lī -lâng kau hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hit-ji̍t, Iok-su-a tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bīn-chêng tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Ji̍t ah, tio̍h thêng tī Ki-piàn ê téng-bīn; ge̍h ah, tio̍h thêng tī A-ngá-lûn Soaⁿ-kok.”

Ji̍t-thâu chiū tiāⁿ-tiāⁿ, ge̍h chiū bô tín-tāng, ti̍t-kàu Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng phah-pāi in ê tùi-te̍k. Chit-ê sū ū kì-chài tī Ngá-soah-ní-kì. Ji̍t-thâu thêng tī thiⁿ ê tiong-ng, bô kín-kín lo̍h--khì, tāi-iok ū chi̍t ji̍t kú.
Hit chi̍t ji̍t Siōng Chú thiaⁿ lâng ê kî-tó, í-chêng í-āu lóng bô koh chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni hoat-seng, sī in-ūi Siōng Chú ūi Í-sek-lia̍t kau-chiàn.
Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng tò-lâi Kiat-kah ê iâⁿ-tōe.
Hit gō͘ ê ông tô-cháu, bih tī Má-ki-tāi ê soaⁿ-tōng lāi.
Ū lâng khì kā Iok-su-a pò-kò, kóng, “Hit gō͘ ê ông í-keng chhē--tio̍h lah, lóng bih tī Má-ki-tāi ê soaⁿ-tōng lāi.”
Iok-su-a kóng, “Sóa tōa tè chio̍h kā tōng-kháu that--khí-lâi, phài lâng tiàm hia kò͘-siú;

m̄-kú lín tio̍h kè-sio̍k tui-jip lín ê tùi-te̍k, tùi āu-bīn kā in kong-kek, m̄-thang hō͘ in ji̍p in ê siâⁿ; in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè í-keng chiong in kau tī lín ê chhiú.”
Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kā in phah-pāi, kā in thiat-tóe siau-bia̍t; chí-ū chhun chi̍t-kóa lâng cháu ji̍p-khì kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ;
Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng an-choân tò-lâi Má-ki-tāi ê iâⁿ-tōe, kàu Iok-su-a hia. Í-āu, bô chi̍t ê lâng káⁿ chhut-siaⁿ hoán-tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Iok-su-a kóng, “Phah-khui tōng-kháu, kā hit gō͘ ê ông lia̍h chhut-lâi góa chia.”
In chiū chiong hit gō͘ ê ông: Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -ông, Hi-pek-lûn -ông, Iâ-boa̍t -ông, La-kiat -ông, I-ki-lûn -ông, tùi tōng-lāi lia̍h--chhut-lâi, tòa-khì i hia.

In lia̍h hiah-ê ông chhut-lâi kàu Iok-su-a hia ê sî, Iok-su-a kiò Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng lâi, tùi hiah-ê kap i chòe-hé khì ê kun-koaⁿ kóng, “Lín lâi thâu-chêng, kha ta̍h chiah-ê ông ê ām-kún.” In chiū lâi thâu-chêng, ēng kha ta̍h tī hiah-ê ông ê ām-kún.
Iok-su-a tùi in kóng, “Lín m̄-thang kiaⁿ, m̄-thang lún. Tio̍h ióng-kám chòng-táⁿ, in-ūi Siōng Chú ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni tùi-thāi só͘-ū lín beh kong-kek ê tùi-te̍k.”
Āu-lâi Iok-su-a thâi-sí hit gō͘ ê ông, kā in tiàu tī gō͘ châng chhiū téng-bīn kàu hông-hun.

Ji̍t lo̍h ê sî, Iok-su-a chhut-lēng, tùi chhiū-téng kā in ê sin-si siu--lo̍h-lâi, hiat tī in bih ê soaⁿ-tōng, ēng kúi-nā tè tōa tè chio̍h-thâu thia̍p tī tōng-kháu. Hiah-ê chio̍h-thâu kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu tī hia.

Siâng hit-ji̍t, Iok-su-a kong-chhú Má-ki-tāi, ēng to thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū ê lâng kap in ê ông, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh. I tùi-thāi Má-ki-tāi ê ông, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng tùi-thāi Iâ-lī-ko -ông kâng-khoán.
Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng tùi Má-ki-tāi khì kong-táⁿ Li̍p-ná.

Siōng Chú chiong chit-ê siâⁿ kap i ê ông kau tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chhiú. Iok-su-a ēng to thâi-sí hit-ê ông kap siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū ê chū-bîn, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh. I tùi-thāi Li̍p-ná ê ông, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng tùi-thāi Iâ-lī-ko -ông kâng-khoán.
Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng tùi Li̍p-ná khì La-kiat, chat-iâⁿ tī siâⁿ ê tùi-bīn, beh kong-táⁿ chit-ê siâⁿ.

Siōng Chú chiong La-kiat kau tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chhiú; keh-ji̍t in kong-chhú chit-ê siâⁿ, ēng to thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū ê chū-bîn, chhin-chhiūⁿ in tùi-thāi Li̍p-ná kâng-khoán.
Hit-sî, Ki-sek ê ông Hô-lân lâi beh oān-chō͘ La-kiat; Iok-su-a chiū phah-sí i kap i ê jîn-bîn, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh.
Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng tùi La-kiat khì I-ki-lûn, tī siâⁿ ê tùi-bīn chat-iâⁿ, beh kong-táⁿ chit-ê siâⁿ.
Kâng hit-ji̍t, in kong-chhú chit-ê siâⁿ, ēng to thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ in tùi-thāi La-kiat kâng-khoán.
Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng tùi I-ki-lûn khì kong-táⁿ Hi-pek-lûn.

In kong-chhú chit-ê siâⁿ, ēng to thâi-sí in ê ông kap siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh; koh kong-chhú hù-kūn ê siâⁿ, châu-bia̍t in só͘-ū ê chū-bîn, chhin-chhiūⁿ in tùi-thāi I-ki-lûn kâng-khoán.
Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng tò-lâi kong-táⁿ Tí-phek.

In kong-chhú chit-ê siâⁿ, lia̍h in ê ông, koh kong-chhú hù-kūn ê siâⁿ, ēng to thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū ê chū-bîn, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng tùi-thāi Hi-pek-lûn kap Li̍p-ná kâng-khoán.

Án-ni, Iok-su-a cheng-ho̍k chit-ê tōe-khu: Soaⁿ-khu, lâm-pêng ê tōe, soaⁿ-po͘, soaⁿ-pho-tōe, í-ki̍p chit-ê tōe-khu ê chu-ông; só͘-ū ōe chhoán-khùi--ê lóng châu-bia̍t, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh, lóng chiàu Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng.
Tùi Ka-te-su Pa-nî-a kàu Ka-sat, Ko-san tōe-khu, í-ki̍p Ki-piàn, lóng hō͘ Iok-su-a cheng-ho̍k.
Hiah-ê ông kap in ê thó͘-tōe, Iok-su-a tī chi̍t piàn chhut-cheng chiū lóng kā in cheng-ho̍k, in-ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ūi Í-sek-lia̍t kau-chiàn.
Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chiū tò-lâi Kiat-kah ê iâⁿ-tōe.
Hā-só -ông Iâ-pin thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì, chiū phài lâng khì kìⁿ Má-tùn -ông Iok-pa, Sin-lûn -ông, kap Ap-soah -ông;
koh kàu pak-pêng ê soaⁿ-khu, Ka-lī-lī-ô͘ lâm-pêng ê A-la-pa Soaⁿ-kok, soaⁿ-po͘, kap sai-pêng To-ní ê soaⁿ-tōe, kìⁿ hiah-ê ông.

I koh khì kìⁿ Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng kap sai-pêng ê Ka-lâm -lâng, í-ki̍p tòa tī soaⁿ-khu ê A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Hek -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, kap Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, í-ki̍p Hek-bûn soaⁿ-kha Bí-su-pa -tōe ê Hi-bī -lâng.
Chiah-ê ông kap in ê kun-peng lóng chhut--lâi, lâng-gia̍h chōe kah chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-piⁿ ê soa; koh ū chin chōe chiàn-bé kap chiàn-chhia.
In lóng lâi Bí-lûn khoe-piⁿ chū-chi̍p, chòe-hé chat-iâⁿ, beh kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn.

Siōng Chú kā Iok-su-a kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ in. Bîn-á-chài chha-put-to chit-ê sî, góa beh chiong in lóng kau hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kā in thâi-sí. Lí tio̍h chām-tn̄g in ê bé ê kha-kun, ēng hé sio in ê chiàn-chhia.”
Iok-su-a kap lóng-chóng ê chiàn-sū lâi kàu Bí-lûn khoe-piⁿ, kā in tu̍t-kek.

Siōng Chú chiong in kau tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chhiú. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kong-kek in, kā in jip kàu Se-tùn tōa-siâⁿ, kàu Bí-su-lī-hut Má-im, ti̍t-kàu tang-pêng ê Bí-su-pa pêng-goân, thâi-sí in, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh.
Iok-su-a chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng tùi-thāi in, chām-tn̄g in ê bé ê kha-kun, ēng hé sio in ê chiàn-chhia.
Āu-lâi, Iok-su-a oa̍t tńg-lâi kong-chhú Hā-só, ēng to thâi-sí Hā-só ê ông; kè-khì, Hā-só sī chiah-ê kok ê thâu.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ēng to thâi-sí hit siâⁿ-lāi ê chū-bîn, thiat-tóe kā in châu-bia̍t; só͘-ū ōe chhoán-khùi--ê bô lâu chi̍t ê oa̍h--teh, koh pàng-hé sio Hā-só.
Iok-su-a cheng-ho̍k só͘-ū ê siâⁿ, lia̍h in ê ông, ēng to thâi-sí in, thiat-tóe kā in châu-bia̍t, sī chiàu Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se só͘ bēng-lēng--ê.
Hiah-ê khí tī soaⁿ-lûn-á téng ê siâⁿ, Hā-só í-gōa, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bô kā in pàng-hé sio; chí-ū Hā-só hō͘ Iok-su-a sio--khì.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi hiah-ê siâⁿ chhiúⁿ ê mi̍h kap cheng-siⁿ, lóng chhú chòe ka-kī ê; m̄-kú in ēng to thâi-sí só͘-ū ê lâng, ōe chhoán-khùi--ê liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh.

Siōng Chú án-chóaⁿ bēng-lēng I ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se, Mô͘-se chiàu án-ni bēng-lēng Iok-su-a, Iok-su-a chiū chiàu án-ni chòe; Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se --ê, Iok-su-a bô chi̍t hāng bô chiàu án-ni chòe.
Án-ni, Iok-su-a chiàm-léng hit-ê tōe-khu, pau-koat soaⁿ-khu, lâm-pêng choân-tōe, Ko-san choân-tōe kap soaⁿ-po͘, A-la-pa Soaⁿ-kok, Í-sek-lia̍t ê soaⁿ-tōe kap pêng-goân;
tùi Se-ní ê Hap-la-soaⁿ, chiūⁿ kàu Hek-bûn soaⁿ-kha Lê-pa-lūn Soaⁿ-kok ê Pa-le̍k Ka-tek, koh lia̍h hit tōe-khu só͘-ū ê ông, kā in thâi-sí.
Iok-su-a kap chiah-ê ông kau-chiàn chin kú;
Ki-piàn ê Hi-bī -lâng í-gōa, bô chi̍t ê siâⁿ kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tēng hô-pêng tiâu-iok, só͘-í Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ēng bú-le̍k chiàm-léng chiah-ê tōe.

In-ūi Siōng Chú hō͘ hiah-ê siâⁿ ê lâng sim ngī, kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn, hō͘ in siū châu-bia̍t, bô siū lîn-bín; chiàu Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se ê ōe, in lóng oân-choân siū siau-bia̍t.
Āu-lâi, Iok-su-a siau-bia̍t tòa tī Hi-pek-lûn, Tí-phek, kap A-ná-pek soaⁿ-khu, í-ki̍p Iû-tāi kap Í-sek-lia̍t soaⁿ-khu ê A-la̍p -lâng; Iok-su-a chiong in kap in ê siâⁿ lóng húi-bia̍t.
Tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, A-la̍p -cho̍k ê lâng, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh, m̄-kú tī Ka-sat, Ka-te̍k, kap A-si̍t-tu̍t iáu ū chhun chi̍t-kóa.

Án-ni, Iok-su-a cheng-ho̍k hit-ê choân-tōe, tú chiàu Siōng Chú èng-ún Mô͘-se ê ōe; koh chiong hit-ê tōe pun hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k, ta̍k chong-cho̍k chòe ke-gia̍p. Tùi án-ni, choân-kéng thài-pêng, bô koh ū chiàn-cheng.
Tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng, tùi A-lūn Soaⁿ-kok kàu Hek-bûn-soaⁿ kap tang-pêng ê A-la-pa choân tōe-khu, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ phah-pāi ê ông kap só͘ kong-chhú ê tōe kì tī ē-bīn:

Chi̍t ê sī tòa tī Hi-si̍t-pún ê A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông, i koán-hat ê tōe-khu, tùi A-lūn Soaⁿ-kok piⁿ ê A-lô-ní, kap soaⁿ-kok tiong ê siâⁿ, í-ki̍p Ki-lia̍t ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ, ti̍t-kàu A-bûn -lâng ê pian-kài Ngá-phok-hô;
koh pau-koat tang-pêng ê A-la-pa kàu Ka-lī-lī-ô͘, ǹg tang keng-kè Pek Iâ-se-boa̍t ê lō͘, kàu A-la-pa-hái, chiū-sī Iâm-hái; koh ǹg lâm, ti̍t-kàu Pí-su-ka ê soaⁿ-pho-tōe ē-bīn.
Koh ū Pa-san -ông Go̍k; i sī chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê Lī-hoa̍t-im -lâng, tòa tī A-su-tha-lio̍k kap Í-tek-lâi.

I koán-hat ê tōe-khu sī Hek-bûn-soaⁿ, Sat-ka, Pa-san choân tōe-khu, kàu Ki-su̍t -lâng kap Má-ka -lâng ê pian-kài, í-ki̍p Ki-lia̍t ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ, ti̍t-kàu Hi-si̍t-pún -ông Se-hông ê pian-kài.

Chit nn̄g ê ông lóng hō͘ Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng phah-pāi. Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se chiong in ê tōe hō͘ Lū-piān chi-cho̍k, Ka-tek chi-cho̍k, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k chòe ke-gia̍p.

Iok-su-a kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng phah-pāi Iok-tàn-hô sai-pêng ê ông, tùi Lê-pa-lūn Soaⁿ-kok ê Pa-le̍k Ka-tek, chiūⁿ kàu Se-ní ê Hap-la-soaⁿ. Iok-su-a chiong hit-ê tōe chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h, pun hō͘ in chòe ke-gia̍p;

chiū-sī Hek -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Ka-lâm -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng khiā-khí ê soaⁿ-khu, soaⁿ-po͘, A-la-pa, soaⁿ-pho-tōe, khòng-iá, kap lâm-pêng ê tōe. Chiah-ê ông chiū-sī:
Iâ-lī-ko -ông, Pek-te̍k-lī hù-kūn Ai -siâⁿ ê ông,
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -ông, Hi-pek-lûn -ông,
Iâ-boa̍t -ông, La-kiat -ông,
I-ki-lûn -ông, Ki-sek -ông,
Tí-phek -ông, Ki-tek -ông,
Hô-ní-má -ông, A-la-tek -ông,
Li̍p-ná -ông, A-tō͘-lân -ông,
Má-ki-tāi -ông, Pek-te̍k-lī -ông,
Tha-phó͘-a -ông, Hi-hut -ông,
A-hut -ông, Sa-lûn -ông,
Má-tùn -ông, Hā-só -ông,
Sin-lûn Bí-lûn -ông, Ap-soah -ông,
Tha-la̍p -ông, Bí-kiat-to -ông,
Ki-te-su -ông, Ka-bi̍t hù-kūn ê Iok-liām -ông,
To-ní soaⁿ-thâu ê To-ní -ông, Kiat-kah ê Ko-ìn -ông,
Tek-sat -ông, chóng-kiōng saⁿ-cha̍p-it ê ông.
Iok-su-a í-keng chin lāu, Siōng Chú tùi i kóng, “Lí í-keng nî-lāu, eng-kai cheng-ho̍k ê tōe iáu chin chōe,
chiū-sī Hui-lī-sū -lâng kap Ki-su̍t -lâng ê choân tōe-khu;

tùi Ai-ki̍p pian-kài ê Se-hat-hô, ǹg pak kàu Í-kek-lûn ê pian-kài, che goân-lâi sī Ka-lâm -lâng ê tōe; tī hia ū Hui-lī-sū -lâng gō͘ ê siú-léng koán-hat ê Ka-sat -lâng, A-si̍t-tu̍t -lâng, A-si̍t-ki-lûn -lâng, Ka-te̍k -lâng, Í-kek-lûn -lâng; koh ū lâm-pêng sio̍k A-ōe -cho̍k ê lâng,
Ka-lâm -lâng ê choân-tōe, Se-tùn -lâng ê Bí-a-la, kàu A-hut, ti̍t-kàu A-mô͘-lī -lâng ê pian-kài;
koh ū Ka-pa-le̍k -lâng ê tōe, í-ki̍p Lê-pa-lūn ê tang-pêng choân-tōe, tùi Hek-bûn soaⁿ-kha ê Pa-le̍k Ka-tek, ti̍t-kàu Hap-má ài-kháu;

tùi Lê-pa-lūn-soaⁿ kàu Bí-su-lī-hut Má-im só͘-ū tòa tī soaⁿ-khu ê Se-tùn -lâng, góa beh tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bīn-chêng kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; lí thang chiàu góa ê bēng-lēng, chiong hiah-ê tōe thiu-chhiam pun hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe ke-gia̍p.
Taⁿ lí tio̍h chiong chit-ê tōe pun hō͘ kî-tha káu ê chi-cho̍k kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k chòe ke-gia̍p.”
Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se í-keng chiong Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng ê thó͘-tōe pun hō͘ Lū-piān kap Ka-tek nn̄g chi-cho̍k, í-ki̍p Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k chòe ke-gia̍p.
Chiah-ê tōe chiū-sī tùi A-lūn Soaⁿ-kok piⁿ ê A-lô-ní, kap soaⁿ-kok tiong ê siâⁿ-chhī, í-ki̍p Bí-tí-pa pêng-goân, ti̍t-kàu Tí-pún;
koh ū tī Hi-si̍t-pún chòe ông ê A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông koán-hat ê siâⁿ-chhī, ti̍t-kàu A-bûn -lâng ê kau-kài;
koh ū Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu, Ki-su̍t -lâng kap Má-ka -lâng ê tōe-khu, kap Hek-bûn-soaⁿ choân-pō͘, í-ki̍p Pa-san choân tōe-khu, ti̍t-kàu Sat-ka;
koh ū tī A-su-tha-lio̍k kap Í-tek-lâi chòe ông ê Pa-san -ông Go̍k choân-kok; Go̍k sī chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê Lī-hoa̍t-im -lâng. Chiah-ê lóng hō͘ Mô͘-se phah-pāi, kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.
M̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bô chiong Ki-su̍t -lâng kap Má-ka -lâng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; kàu kin-á-ji̍t in iáu tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan.

Mô͘-se bô pun ke-gia̍p hō͘ Lī-bī chi-cho̍k; chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se só͘ kóng--ê, in ê ke-gia̍p chiū-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè ê chè-mi̍h.
Mô͘-se chiàu Lū-piān chi-cho̍k ê ta̍k chong-cho̍k pun ke-gia̍p hō͘ in.
In ê kéng-kài sī A-lūn Soaⁿ-kok piⁿ ê A-lô-ní kap soaⁿ-kok tiong ê siâⁿ-chhī, í-ki̍p Bí-tí-pa hù-kūn choân-pō͘ ê pêng-goân,
koh ū Hi-si̍t-pún kap só͘ sio̍k ê pêng-goân hiah-ê siâⁿ-chhī, Tí-pún, Pa-boa̍t Pa-le̍k, Pek Pa-le̍k Bián,
Ngá-cha̍p, Ki-tí-bo̍k, Bí-hoat-ap,
Ki-lia̍t-têng, Se-pí-má, kap soaⁿ-kok tiong soaⁿ-lûn-á ê Sè-lia̍t Sa-hat,
Pek Pí-ní, Pí-su-ka ê soaⁿ-phiâⁿ, Pek Iâ-se-boa̍t;

koh ū pêng-goân hiah-ê siâⁿ, í-ki̍p tī Hi-si̍t-pún chòe ông ê A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông ê choân-kok. Mô͘-se ū chiong Se-hông kap i só͘ koán-hat, tòa tī hit só͘-chāi ê Bí-tiân léng-siù, Í-bī, Lī-kim, So͘-ní, Hō͘-ní, Lī-pa lóng thâi-sí.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thâi hiah-ê lâng ê sî, mā ēng to thâi-sí Pí-ní ê kiáⁿ, pok-kòa ê Pa-lân.
Lū-piān chi-cho̍k ê sai-pêng ēng Iok-tàn-hô chòe pian-kài. Í-siōng ê siâⁿ-chhī kap chng-siā sī Lū-piān -lâng chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k só͘ tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.
Mô͘-se chiàu Ka-tek chi-cho̍k ê ta̍k chong-cho̍k pun ke-gia̍p hō͘ in.
In ê kéng-kài sī Ngá-siā kap Ki-lia̍t só͘-ū ê siâⁿ-chhī, kap A-bûn -lâng chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê tōe-khu, kàu La-pa thâu-chêng ê A-lô-ní,
tùi Hi-si̍t-pún kàu La-boa̍t Bí-su-pa kap Pí-to-lêng, koh tùi Má-hap-liām kàu Tí-phek ê pian-kài,

kap Hi-si̍t-pún -ông Se-hông kok-lāi só͘ chhun soaⁿ-kok tiong ê Pek Hap-lân, Pek Lêng-la, So͘-kat, Sat-hun, í-ki̍p Iok-tàn-hô kap hô-piⁿ ê tōe, ti̍t-kàu Ka-lī-lī-ô͘ ê lâm-pêng-hōaⁿ, Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng ê tōe-khu.
Í-siōng ê siâⁿ-chhī kap chng-siā sī Ka-tek -lâng chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k só͘ tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.
Mô͘-se chiàu Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê ta̍k chong-cho̍k pun ke-gia̍p hō͘ in.
In ê kéng-kài sī tùi Má-hap-liām khí, pau-koat Pa-san -ông Go̍k ê choân-kok, kap Pa-san, Gâi-ní só͘-ū ê chng-siā, chóng-kiōng la̍k-cha̍p ê;

koh chiong Ki-lia̍t ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ, í-ki̍p Pa-san -ông Go̍k thóng-tī ê A-su-tha-lio̍k kap Í-tek-lâi nn̄g ê siâⁿ, pun hō͘ Má-ná-se ê kiáⁿ Má-kiat chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê kiáⁿ-sun chòe ke-gia̍p.
Í-siōng sī Mô͘-se tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng, Iâ-lī-ko tùi-bīn ê Mô͘-ap pêng-goân, pun hō͘ nn̄g ê pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê ke-gia̍p.
M̄-kú, Mô͘-se bô pun ke-gia̍p hō͘ Lī-bī chi-cho̍k, in-ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè sī in ê ke-gia̍p, chiàu Siōng Chú só͘ kā in kóng--ê.

Ē-bīn sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Ka-lâm -tōe, chiū-sī Iok-tàn-hô sai-pêng, só͘ tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p, sī chè-si Í-lī-a-sat kap Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, pun hō͘ in--ê.
In chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng, thiu-chhiam hun-phòe hō͘ káu ê chi-cho̍k koh pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê thó͘-tōe.
Mô͘-se tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng, í-keng chiong nn̄g ê chi-cho̍k koh pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê ke-gia̍p pun hō͘ in, m̄-kú bô pun ke-gia̍p hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng;

Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi hun-chòe Má-ná-se kap Í-hoat-liân nn̄g ê chi-cho̍k. Sui-jiân Mô͘-se bô chiong thó͘-tōe pun hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng chòe ke-gia̍p, m̄-kú hō͘ in siâⁿ-tìn thang tòa, chháu-po͘ thang chhī cheng-siⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàu Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Mô͘-se ê ōe hun-phòe hit-ê tōe.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Iû-tāi -lâng lâi Kiat-kah kìⁿ Iok-su-a, Ki-nî-sé -lâng Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú tī Ka-te-su Pa-nî-a, tùi Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng Mô͘-se só͘ kóng koan-hē lí kap góa ê tāi-chì, lí lóng chai.
Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se tùi Ka-te-su Pa-nî-a phài góa lâi thàm-cha chit-ê tōe ê sî, góa tú-á sì-cha̍p hè; góa chiàu góa sim-lāi só͘ khak-sìn--ê kā i pò-kò.
M̄-kú kap góa chòe-hé khì thàm-cha ê hiaⁿ-tī ê pò-kò hō͘ jîn-bîn kiaⁿ kah sîn-put-hū-thé, chí-ū góa tiong-si̍t sìn-khò Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè.

Hit-ji̍t, Mô͘-se chiù-chōa kóng, ‘Lí ê kha só͘ ta̍h ê tōe, it-tēng beh hō͘ lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi chòe éng-oán ê ke-gia̍p, in-ūi lí tiong-si̍t sìn-khò Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè.’

Tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī khòng-iá phiau-liû, Siōng Chú kā Mô͘-se kóng chiah-ê ōe ê sî kàu taⁿ, í-keng kè sì-cha̍p-gō͘ nî. Lí khòaⁿ, Siōng Chú chiàu I ê èng-ún, hō͘ góa iáu oa̍h--teh, hiān-chāi góa í-keng poeh-cha̍p-gō͘ hè lah.

Kin-á-ji̍t góa iáu ióng-kiāⁿ, kap Mô͘-se phài góa khì thàm-cha ê sî kâng-khoán; bô-lūn sī kau-chiàn, sī chhut-chhut-ji̍p-ji̍p, góa ê khùi-la̍t hit-sî án-chóaⁿ, hiān-chāi mā án-ni.

Chhiáⁿ lí chiong Siōng Chú hit-ji̍t só͘ èng-ún ê soaⁿ-khu hō͘ góa. Hit-ji̍t lí mā ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h, tī hia ū A-la̍p -cho̍k ê lâng, in ê siâⁿ tōa koh kian-kò͘; nā Siōng Chú kap góa tông-chāi, chiàu I ê èng-ún, góa chiū ōe kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.”
Iok-su-a chiū kā Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k chiok-hok, ēng Hi-pek-lûn hō͘ i chòe ke-gia̍p.
Só͘-í, Hi-pek-lûn sī Ki-nî-sé -lâng Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k ê ke-gia̍p, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t; in-ūi i tiong-si̍t sìn-khò Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.
Hi-pek-lûn í-chêng kiò-chòe Ki-lia̍t A-pa. A-pa sī A-la̍p -cho̍k siōng úi-tāi ê lâng. Tùi án-ni, hit-ê tōe thài-pêng, bô koh ū chiàn-cheng.
Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k thiu-chhiam tit--tio̍h ê tōe-khu, sī tī siōng lâm-pêng, sūn Í-tong ê pian-kài ǹg lâm ti̍t-kàu Sîm ê khòng-iá.
In lâm-pêng ê kéng-kài, sī tùi Iâm-hái siōng lâm-pêng,
thàng kàu A-khek-la-pin soaⁿ-phiâⁿ ê lâm-pêng, keng-kè Sîm, kàu Ka-te-su Pa-nî-a ê lâm-pêng, koh kè Hi-su-lûn, chiūⁿ kàu A-ta̍t-ní, se̍h-kè Kah-ka,
keng-kè Ap-bûn, thàng kàu Ai-ki̍p ê khoe-kok, kàu Tōe-tiong-hái ûi-chí. Che chiū-sī Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k lâm-pêng ê pian-kài.
Tang-pêng ê pian-kài sī Iâm-hái, chiūⁿ kàu Iok-tàn-hô ê chhut-kháu. Pak-pêng ê pian-kài sī tùi Iok-tàn-hô ê chhut-kháu khai-sí,
chiūⁿ kàu Pek Hat-la, keng-kè Pek A-la-pa ê pak-pêng, chiūⁿ kàu Pho-hán ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ (Pho-hán sī Lū-piān ê kiáⁿ);

hit-ê pian-kài koh tùi A-kat Soaⁿ-kok chiūⁿ kàu Tí-phek, ǹg pak chiūⁿ-khì A-to͘-bêng soaⁿ-phiâⁿ ê tùi-bīn, hô ê lâm-pêng ê Kiat-kah; koh keng-kè Ún Sī-be̍k ê chúi-chôaⁿ, kàu Ún Lô-kiat;

chit-ê pian-kài koh keng-kè Him-lūn-chú Soaⁿ-kok, chiūⁿ kàu Iâ-pò͘-su soaⁿ-pho-tōe ê lâm-pêng (Iâ-pò͘-su chiū-sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng); hit-ê pian-kài koh chiūⁿ kàu Him-lūn Soaⁿ-kok sai-pêng tùi-bīn ê soaⁿ-téng, chiū-sī Lī-hoa̍t-im Soaⁿ-kok ê siōng pak-pêng;
hit-ê pian-kài koh tùi soaⁿ-téng kàu Nî-hut-to-a ê chúi-chôaⁿ, thàng kàu Í-hut-lûn-soaⁿ hiah-ê siâⁿ-chhī, koh kàu Pa-la (Pa-la chiū-sī Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm);
hit-ê pian-kài koh tùi Pa-la ǹg sai-pêng se̍h-kè Í-tong-soaⁿ, kàu Iâ-lîm soaⁿ-piⁿ ê pak-pêng (Iâ-lîm chiū-sī Ki-sat-lûn), koh lo̍h-khì kàu Pek Sī-be̍k, keng-kè Têng-ná;
hit-ê pian-kài koh thàng kàu Í-kek-lûn soaⁿ-phiâⁿ ê pak-pêng, sòa kàu Si-ki-lûn, keng-kè Pa-la-soaⁿ, thàng kàu Ngá-pí-liap, kàu Tōe-tiong-hái ûi-chí.
Tōe-tiong-hái chiū-sī Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k sai-pêng ê pian-kài. Che sī Iû-tāi -lâng, chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k só͘ tit--tio̍h ê tōe sì-ûi ê pian-kài.

Iok-su-a chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, chiong Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k tiong chi̍t hūn ê thó͘-tōe, chiū-sī Ki-lia̍t A-pa, hō͘ Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k chòe ke-gia̍p; Ki-lia̍t A-pa chiū-sī Hi-pek-lûn. (A-pa sī A-la̍p -cho̍k ê chó͘-sian.)
Ka-le̍k tùi hia kóaⁿ-chhut A-la̍p saⁿ ê kiáⁿ, Sī-su, A-hi-bān, kap Ta̍t-mái ê hō͘-tāi.
Koh tùi hia khì kong-kek Tí-phek ê chū-bîn. Tí-phek í-chêng kiò-chòe Ki-lia̍t Se-hut.
Ka-le̍k kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng kong-chhú Ki-lia̍t Se-hut, góa chiū chiong góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Ap-sat hō͘ i choh-bó͘.”
Ka-le̍k ê sió-tī Ki-la̍p-su ê kiáⁿ Gô-tô-liap kong-chhú chit-ê siâⁿ, Ka-le̍k chiū chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Ap-sat hō͘ i choh-bó͘.
Ap-sat chhut-kè hit-ji̍t, Gô-tô-liap kiò i tio̍h kā i ê lāu-pē thó chi̍t khu hn̂g. Ap-sat tùi lû-á lo̍h--lâi; Ka-le̍k mn̄g i kóng, “Lí beh ài sím-mi̍h?”

Ap-sat kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí hō͘ góa chi̍t hūn lé-mi̍h. Lí ū hō͘ góa chi̍t tè lâm-pêng ê ta-tōe, chhiáⁿ koh hō͘ góa chúi-chôaⁿ.” Ka-le̍k chiū chiong téng-ē nn̄g ê chúi-chôaⁿ lóng hō͘ i.
Ē-bīn sī Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k ta̍k-ê chong-cho̍k só͘ tit--tio̍h ê sán-gia̍p:
Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k siōng lâm-pêng óa-kūn Í-tong pian-kài ê siâⁿ-tìn, ū Kah-sih, Í-tek, Ngá-ko͘-ní,
Ki-ná, Tí-mô͘-ná, A-tāi-ta̍t,
Ki-te-su, Hā-só, Í-thê-lâm,
Se-hut, Thê-liān, Pí-a-lio̍k,
Hā-só Hap-tāi-tha, Ka-lio̍k Hi-su-lûn (chiū-sī Hā-só),
A-bān, Sī-má, Mô͘-la-tāi,
Hap-sat Ka-tāi, Hek-si̍t-bûn, Pek Phà-lia̍t,
Hap-sat Su-a, Pia̍t-sī-pa, Pí-su-iok-tha,
Pa-la, Í-in, Í-sim,
I-le̍k-to-la̍h, Ki-sit, Hô-ní-má,
Sé-kek-la, Be̍k-má-ná, Sam-sat-ná,
Lī-pa-bu̍t, Si̍t-him, A-in, Lîm-bûn, kiōng jī-cha̍p-káu chō siâⁿ, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Tī soaⁿ-po͘ ū Í-si̍t-tô, Só-la, A-si̍t-ná,
Sat-ná-a, Ún Kan-lêng, Tha-phó͘-a, Í-lâm,
Iâ-boa̍t, A-tō͘-lân, So-ko, A-se-ka,
Sa-la-im, A-tí-tha-im, Ki-tí-la, Ki-tí-lô-tha-im, kiōng cha̍p-sì chō siâⁿ, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Koh ū Sé-lâm, Hap-tāi-sa, Be̍k-tāi Ka-tek,
Tí-liân, Bí-su-pa, Iok-thiap,
La-kiat, Pho-su-ka, I-ki-lûn,
Ka-pún, La-bān, Ki-thê-lī,
Ki-te-lô, Pek Tāi-kún, Ná-má, Má-ki-tāi, kiōng cha̍p-la̍k chō siâⁿ, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Koh ū Li̍p-ná, Í-thiap, A-san,
Iâ-hut-tha, A-si̍t-ná, Nî-sek,
Ki-i-la, A-kek-sek, Má-lī-sa, kiōng káu chō siâⁿ, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Koh ū Í-kek-lûn í-ki̍p chiu-ûi ê hiong-tìn kap chng-siā,
Í-kek-lûn ǹg sai só͘-ū óa-kūn A-si̍t-tu̍t ê tōe-khu, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Koh ū A-si̍t-tu̍t kap chiu-ûi ê hiong-tìn í-ki̍p chng-siā, Ka-sat kap chiu-ûi ê hiong-tìn í-ki̍p chng-siā, ti̍t-kàu Ai-ki̍p khoe-kok, kap Tōe-tiong-hái, í-ki̍p iân-hái tōe-khu.
Tī soaⁿ-khu ū Sa-bi̍t, Ngá-thê-ní, So-ko,
Tāi-ná, Ki-lia̍t Sat-ná (chiū-sī Tí-phek),
A-ná-pek, Í-si̍t-thê-bo̍k, A-liām,
Ko-san, Hô-lûn, Ki-lô, kiōng cha̍p-it chō siâⁿ, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Koh ū A-la, Tō͘-má, Í-san,
Ngá-lông, Pek Tha-phó͘-a, A-hui-ka,
Hông-tha, Ki-lia̍t A-pa (chiū-sī Hi-pek-lûn), Sé-ní, kiōng káu chō siâⁿ, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Koh ū Má-hûn, Ka-bi̍t, Se-hut, Ù-tha,
Iâ-su-lia̍t, Iok-tiân, Sat-ná-a,
Kai-ún, Ki-pí-a, Têng-ná, kiōng cha̍p chō siâⁿ, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Koh ū Hap-hut, Pek Siok, Ki-to,
Má-la̍h, Pek A-lo̍k, Í-le̍k-thê-kun, kiōng la̍k chō siâⁿ, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Koh ū Ki-lia̍t Pa-le̍k (chiū-sī Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm), La-pa, kiōng nn̄g chō siâⁿ, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Tī khòng-iá ū Pek A-la-pa, Bi̍t-teng, Se-ka-ka,
Le̍k-san, Iâm -siâⁿ, Ún Ki-tí, kiōng la̍k chō siâⁿ, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
