Tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, Iû-tāi -lâng bô hoat-tō͘ kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng chòe-hé tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.

Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi thiu-chhiam só͘ tit--tio̍h ê tōe, sī tùi óa-kūn Iâ-lī-ko ê Iok-tàn-hô khí, ēng Iâ-lī-ko tang-pêng ê hô-chúi chòe pian-kài, ǹg pak keng-kè khòng-iá, ti̍t-kàu Pek-te̍k-lī ê soaⁿ-khu;
koh tùi Pek-te̍k-lī kàu Lō͘-su, keng-kè A-ki -lâng ê kéng-kài, kàu A-tha-lio̍k;
koh ǹg sai lo̍h-khì kàu Ap-lī-thê -lâng ê kéng-kài, keng-kè Ē Pek Hô-lûn ê kéng-kài, kàu Ki-sek, thàng kàu Tōe-tiong-hái ûi-chí.
Chiah-ê chiū-sī Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi Má-ná-se kap Í-hoat-liân só͘ tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.
Ē-bīn sī Í-hoat-liân ê hō͘-tāi chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k só͘ tit--tio̍h thó͘-tōe ê pian-kài: Tang-pêng tùi A-tha-lio̍k A-ta̍t-ní kàu Téng Pek Hô-lûn;
chit-ê pian-kài ǹg sai thàng kàu Tōe-tiong-hái. Pak-pêng tùi Bi̍t-bí-tha ǹg tang se̍h kàu Tha-la̍p Sī-lô, keng-kè A-ná ê tang-pêng,
tùi A-ná ǹg lâm lo̍h-khì kàu A-tha-lio̍k, koh kàu Ná-la, thàng kàu Iâ-lī-ko, ti̍t-kàu Iok-tàn-hô ûi-chí.
Chit-ê pian-kài tùi Tha-phó͘-a ǹg sai, sūn Ka-ná-khoe, thàng kàu Tōe-tiong-hái ûi-chí. Che chiū-sī Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k, chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.
Lēng-gōa tī Má-ná-se -lâng ê kéng-lāi, chiong kúi ê siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā pun hō͘ Í-hoat-liân -lâng.

Í-hoat-liân -lâng bô hoat-tō͘ chiong tòa tī Ki-sek ê Ka-lâm -lâng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; Ka-lâm -lâng tòa tī Í-hoat-liân -lâng ê tiong-kan chòe khó͘-kang ho̍k-sāi in, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.

Ē-bīn sī Iok-sek ê tōa-kiáⁿ Má-ná-se ê hō͘-tāi thiu-chhiam tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p: Má-kiat sī Má-ná-se ê tōa-kiáⁿ, Ki-lia̍t ê khai-thok-chiá; Má-kiat sī ióng-sū, tit-tio̍h Ki-lia̍t kap Pa-san.

Iok-sek ê kiáⁿ Má-ná-se kî-tha ê hāu-siⁿ, chiū-sī A-pí-í-siā, Hi-le̍k, A-su-lia̍t, Sī-kiàm, Hi-hut, Sī-bí-tāi, in ê kiáⁿ-sun chiàu chong-cho̍k mā thiu-chhiam tit-tio̍h thó͘-tōe.
Má-ná-se ê goân-sun, Má-kiat ê cheng-sun, Ki-lia̍t ê sun, Hi-hut ê kiáⁿ Se-lô-hui-hap bô kiáⁿ, chí-ū cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, chiū-sī Má-la, Ná-a, Hat-la, Bi̍t-ka, kap Tek-sat.

In lâi kàu chè-si Í-lī-a-sat kap Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a, í-ki̍p chèng léng-siù ê bīn-chêng, kóng, “Siōng Chú ū bēng-lēng Mô͘-se, tio̍h hō͘ goán kap goán ê chhin-cho̍k siâng-khoán pun-tio̍h ke-gia̍p.” Iok-su-a chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, hō͘ in kap in ê a-peh a-chek kâng-khoán pun-tio̍h ke-gia̍p.
Tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng ê Ki-lia̍t kap Pa-san tōe-khu í-gōa, Má-ná-se koh thiu-chhiam tit-tio̍h cha̍p hūn ê ke-gia̍p,
in-ūi Má-ná-se hiah-ê cha-bó͘-sun, tī i ê kiáⁿ-sun tiong tit-tio̍h ke-gia̍p. Ki-lia̍t -tōe pun hō͘ Má-ná-se kî-tha ê hō͘-tāi.
Má-ná-se ê tōe-kài, tùi A-siat khí, kàu Sī-kiàm tang-pêng ê Bi̍t-bí-tha, ǹg lâm kàu Ún Tha-phó͘-a ê chū-bîn hia.
Tha-phó͘-a tōe-khu kui Má-ná-se; m̄-kú Má-ná-se pian-kài ê Tha-phó͘-a -siâⁿ sio̍k Í-hoat-liân ê hō͘-tāi.

Chit-ê tōe-kài tùi hia lo̍h-khì kàu Ka-ná-khoe; khoe lâm-pêng ê siâⁿ-tìn sui-jiân tī Má-ná-se kéng-lāi, m̄-kú sio̍k Í-hoat-liân; Má-ná-se ê tōe-kài sūn Ka-ná-khoe ê pak-pêng, thàng kàu Tōe-tiong-hái ûi-chí.
Í-hoat-liân tī lâm-pêng, Má-ná-se tī pak-pêng; Tōe-tiong-hái sī in sai-pêng ê tōe-kài; A-siat tī sai-pak-pêng, Í-sat-ka tī tang-pak-pêng.

Má-ná-se tī Í-sat-ka kap A-siat ê kéng-lāi ū Pek Siān, Í-pek-liân, kap To-ní, í-ki̍p in hù-kūn ê chng-siā; koh ū Ún To-ní, Tha-la̍p, Bí-kiat-to chit saⁿ khu, í-ki̍p in ê chū-bîn kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
M̄-kú Má-ná-se -lâng bô hoat-tō͘ chiong hiah-ê siâⁿ ê chū-bîn kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; Ka-lâm -lâng kian-chhî beh tòa tī hia.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiông-sēng ê sî, chiū hō͘ Ka-lâm -lâng chòe khó͘-kang, bô lóng chiong in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.
Iok-sek ê kiáⁿ-sun tùi Iok-su-a kóng, “Siōng Chú ū sù-hok goán, hō͘ goán chiâⁿ-chòe tōa-cho̍k, lí ná kan-ta hō͘ goán thiu chi̍t ki chhiam, pun chi̍t hūn chòe ke-gia̍p?”
Iok-su-a ìn in kóng, “Lín nā lâng chōe, hiâm Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu siuⁿ oe̍h, lín thang khì Pí-lī-sé -lâng kap Lī-hoa̍t-im -lâng tōe-khu ê chhiū-nâ khai-khún.”
Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi kóng, “Hit-ê soaⁿ-khu bô-kàu goán tòa; koh tòa tī Pek Siān kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, í-ki̍p Iâ-su-lia̍t Soaⁿ-kok ê Ka-lâm -lâng lóng ū thih ê chiàn-chhia.”
Iok-su-a tùi Iok-sek -ke, chiū-sī Í-hoat-liân -lâng kap Má-ná-se -lâng, kóng, “Lín lâng chōe koh kiông-sēng, eng-kai m̄-nā chi̍t ki chhiam ê hūn hō͘ lín.

Kui-ê soaⁿ-khu lóng sī lín ê; hit-ê tōe-khu sui-jiân ū chhiū-nâ, lín thang khai-khún, kàu pian-kài chiū lóng sio̍k lín. Ka-lâm -lâng sui-jiân ū thih ê chiàn-chhia, koh kiông-sēng, lín mā ōe-tàng kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng í-keng cheng-ho̍k choân-tōe, choân-thé hōe-chiòng chiū lâi Sī-lô chū-chi̍p, tī hia siat-li̍p hōe-bō͘.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan ū chhit ê chi-cho̍k iáu-bē pun-tio̍h in ê ke-gia̍p.
Iok-su-a chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè í-keng ū siúⁿ-sù lín thó͘-tōe, lín beh thoa-iân kàu tī-sî chiah khì kong-chhú?
Lín ta̍k chi-cho̍k tio̍h kéng saⁿ ê lâng, góa beh phài in kiâⁿ-thàu choân-tōe; chiàu ta̍k chi-cho̍k èng-tit ê thó͘-tōe ōe-chòe tōe-tô͘, chiah tò-lâi góa chia.
In tio̍h chiong choân-tōe pun-chòe chhit hūn; Iû-tāi iû-goân tòa tī lâm-pêng ê kéng-lāi, Iok-sek -ke tòa tī pak-pêng ê kéng-lāi.
Lín chiong hit chhit hūn thó͘-tōe oân-sêng chè-tô͘ liáu-āu, the̍h-lâi góa chia, góa beh tī Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng ūi-tio̍h lín thiu-chhiam.

Lī-bī -lâng tī lín tiong-kan bô pun thó͘-tōe, in-ūi chòe chè-si ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú chiū-sī in ê ke-gia̍p. Ka-tek, Lū-piān, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k, Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se í-keng chiong Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng ê thó͘-tōe pun hō͘ in chòe ke-gia̍p.”

Hiah-ê lâng beh chhut-hoat ê sî, Iok-su-a bēng-lēng in, kóng, “Lín khì kiâⁿ-thàu choân-tōe, ōe-chòe tōe-tô͘ liáu-āu, koh tò-tńg-lâi góa chia; góa beh tī Sī-lô, tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ūi-tio̍h lín thiu-chhiam.”
In chiū khì, kiâⁿ-thàu choân-tōe, ōe-chòe tōe-tô͘, chiong siâⁿ-tìn pun-chòe chhit hūn, kì tī chheh--ni̍h, tò-tńg-lâi Sī-lô iâⁿ-tiong, kau hō͘ Iok-su-a.
Iok-su-a chiū tī Sī-lô Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, ūi-tio̍h in thiu-chhiam; tī hia, chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chong-cho̍k pun thó͘-tōe hō͘ in.
Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k thiu-chhiam tit--tio̍h ê tōe, sī tī Iû-tāi kiáⁿ-sun kap Iok-sek kiáⁿ-sun ê tiong-kan.
In pak-pêng ê tōe-kài, tùi Iok-tàn-hô khí, ǹg pak kàu Iâ-lī-ko hù-kūn, koh ǹg sai pôaⁿ-kè soaⁿ, ti̍t-ti̍t kàu Pek A-bûn ê khòng-iá;
koh tùi hia ǹg lâm keng-kè Lō͘-su hù-kūn (Lō͘-su chiū-sī Pek-te̍k-lī), koh lo̍h-khì A-tha-lio̍k A-ta̍t-ní, kàu óa-kūn Ē Pek Hô-lûn lâm-pêng ê soaⁿ.

Chit-ê pian-kài tùi hia ǹg sai chhun--khì, koh oat lo̍h-lâm, tùi Pek Hô-lûn thâu-chêng lâm-pêng ê soaⁿ, ti̍t-kàu Iû-tāi -lâng ê siâⁿ Ki-lia̍t Pa-le̍k (chiū-sī Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm). Che sī in sai-pêng ê pian-kài.
Lâm-pêng tùi Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm ê pian-kài khí, kàu Nî-hut-to-a ê chúi-chôaⁿ,

koh lo̍h-khì kàu Him-lūn-chú Soaⁿ-kok tùi-bīn ê soaⁿ-kha, chiū-sī Lī-hoa̍t-im Soaⁿ-kok ê pak-pêng; koh tùi hia keng-kè Him-lūn Soaⁿ-kok, Iâ-pò͘-su (chiū-sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng) ê lâm-pêng, lo̍h-khì kàu Ún Lô-kiat;
koh ǹg pak keng-kè Ún Sī-be̍k, chhut-khì kàu A-to͘-bêng soaⁿ-phiâⁿ tùi-bīn ê Ki-lī-lio̍k, koh lo̍h-khì kàu Pho-hán ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ (Pho-hán sī Lū-piān ê kiáⁿ).
Koh ǹg pak keng-kè A-la-pa ê pian-kài, lo̍h-khì kàu A-la-pa,
koh keng-kè Pek Hat-la pak-pêng ê kau-kài, ti̍t-ti̍t kàu Iâm-hái pak-pêng ê hái-oan, chiū-sī Iok-tàn-hô lâm-pêng ê hô-kháu. Che sī Piān-ngá-bín lâm-pêng ê pian-kài;
tang-pêng ê pian-kài kàu Iok-tàn-hô. Che sī Piān-ngá-bín -lâng chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, sūn sì-ûi ê pian-kài pun--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.
Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k pun--tio̍h ê siâⁿ, chiū-sī Iâ-lī-ko, Pek Hat-la, I-be̍k Ki-sek,
Pek A-la-pa, Sé-má-lián, Pek-te̍k-lī,
A-ōe, Pa-la, Gô-hut-la,
Ki-hoat A-mô͘-nî, Gô-hut-nî, kap Ka-pa, kiōng cha̍p-jī chō siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Koh ū Ki-piàn, La-má, Pí-lio̍k,
Bí-su-pa, Ki-hui-la, Mô͘-sat,
Lī-kim, I-lī-pí-le̍k, Tha-la-la,

Sé-la, Í-lī-hut, Iâ-pò͘-su (chiū-sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng), Ki-pí-a, kap Ki-lia̍t, kiōng cha̍p-sì chō siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā. Che sī Piān-ngá-bín -lâng chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k pun--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.
Se-biān chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k thiu-tio̍h tē-jī chhiam, in ê ke-gia̍p sī tī Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k ê ke-gia̍p kéng-lāi.
In tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p chiū-sī: Pia̍t-sī-pa (á-sī Sī-pa), Mô͘-la-tāi,
Hap-sat Su-a, Pa-la, Í-sim,
I-le̍k-to-la̍h, Pí-thó͘-le̍k, Hô-ní-má,
Sé-kek-la, Pek Má-ka-phok, Hap-sat So͘-sat,
Pek Lī-pa-bu̍t, Sa-ló͘-hiám, kiōng cha̍p-saⁿ chō siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā;
koh ū A-in, Lîm-bûn, Í-thiap, A-san, kiōng sì chō siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā;
í-ki̍p chiah-ê siâⁿ sì-ûi it-chhè ê chng-siā, ti̍t-kàu Pa-la Pí-ní, chiū-sī lâm-pêng ê La-boa̍t. Che sī Se-biān chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.

Se-biān -lâng ê ke-gia̍p sī tùi Iû-tāi -lâng ê ke-gia̍p pun--chhut-lâi--ê; in-ūi Iû-tāi -lâng pun--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p siuⁿ chōe, só͘-í Se-biān -lâng tī Iû-tāi -lâng ê ke-gia̍p tiong tit-tio̍h ke-gia̍p.
Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k thiu-tio̍h tē-saⁿ chhiam. In ê ke-gia̍p ê pian-kài sī tùi Sat-li̍p,
ǹg sai kàu Má-la-la, keng-kè Tāi-pa-siat, thàng kàu Iok-liām tang-pêng ê khoe;
koh tùi Sat-li̍p ǹg tang, ǹg ji̍t chhut ê hong-hiòng, kàu Kiat-su-lio̍k Tha-po̍k ê kau-kài; koh thàng kàu Tāi-pí-la, chiūⁿ kàu Ngá-hui-a.
Tùi hia koh ǹg tang khì kàu Ka-te̍k Hi-hut, koh keng-kè Í-te̍k Ka-sìn, chhut-khì Lîm-bûn, oat-khì kàu Nî-a.
Hit-ê pian-kài tùi Nî-a koh ǹg pak-pêng se̍h-kè Hap-ná-tùn, thàng kàu Iâ-hut-tha I-le̍k ê soaⁿ-kok ûi-chí;
iáu ū Ka-tha, Ná-hap-la, Sin-lûn, Í-tāi-la, kap Pek-lī-hêng, kiōng cha̍p-jī chō siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Chiah-ê siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, chiū-sī Se-pò͘-lûn -lâng chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.
Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k thiu-tio̍h tē-sì chhiam.
In ê tōe-kài pau-koat Iâ-su-lia̍t, Ki-so͘-lu̍t, Su-liām,
Hap-hut-liân, Sī-àn, A-ná-hap-la,
La-phek, Ki-siān, A-pia̍t,
Lī-bia̍t, Ún Kan-lêng, Ún Hap-tāi, kap Pek Phà-siat;
hit-ê pian-kài kàu Tha-po̍k, Sa-hap-sé-má, Pek Sī-be̍k; in ê pian-kài kàu Iok-tàn-hô ûi-chí, kiōng cha̍p-la̍k chō siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Chiah-ê siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, chiū-sī Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.
A-siat chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k thiu-tio̍h tē-gō͘ chhiam.
In ê tōe-kài sī Hek-kah, Hap-lī, Pí-tiân, Ap-soah,
A-la-bí-le̍k, A-boa̍t, kap Bí-sa-le̍k; ǹg sai keng-kè Ka-bi̍t, kàu Se-hat Li̍p-la̍p;
ǹg tang keng-kè Pek Tāi-kún, thàng kàu Se-pò͘-lûn; ǹg pak keng-kè Iâ-hut-tha I-le̍k Soaⁿ-kok, kàu Pek Í-be̍k kap Nî-gia̍p, thàng kàu Ka-pō͘-le̍k ê pak-pêng,
koh kàu Gī-pek-lûn, Lī-ha̍p, Hap-bûn, Ka-ná, ti̍t-kàu Se-tùn tōa-siâⁿ.
Hit-ê pian-kài oat tùi La-má, kap kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ Thài-ní, koh se̍h-kè Hô-sat; kàu Má-hek-la, A-kek-sek tōe-khu, ti̍t-kàu Tōe-tiong-hái ûi-chí.
Koh ū O͘-má, A-hut, Lī-ha̍p, kiōng jī-cha̍p-jī chō siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Chiah-ê siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, chiū-sī A-siat chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.
Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k thiu-tio̍h tē-la̍k chhiam.
In ê pian-kài tùi Hi-lī-hut, keng-kè Sat-ná-im ê siōng-chhiū, A-tāi-bí Nî-kiat, kap Ngá-pí-liap, ti̍t-kàu La-kiōng, thàng kàu Iok-tàn-hô;
ǹg sai, keng-kè A-su-la̍p Tha-po̍k, thàng kàu Hō͘-kat; lâm-pêng kàu Se-pò͘-lûn, sai-pêng kàu A-siat, tang-pêng kàu Iok-tàn-hô.
Kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ ū Se-teng, Chhek-ní, Hap-boa̍t, La-kah, Ki-nî-lia̍t;
A-tāi-má, La-má, Hā-só;
Ki-te-su, Í-tek-lâi, Ún Hā-só;
Í-lī-ún, Bi̍t-tāi I-le̍k, Hô-liân, Pek A-la̍p, kap Pek Sī-be̍k, kiōng cha̍p-káu chō siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Chiah-ê siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, chiū-sī Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.
Tān chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k thiu-tio̍h tē-chhit chhiam.
In pun--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p pau-koat Só-la, Í-si̍t-tô, I-ní Sī-be̍k,
Sa-la-pin, A-ngá-lûn, I-thê-la,
Í-lûn, Têng-ná, Í-kek-lûn,
I-lī-thê-ki, Ki-pí-tùn, Pa-la,
I-ô͘-tek, Pí-nî Pí-la, Ka-te̍k Lîm-bûn,
Bí Iâ-khun, La-khun, kap Iok-phà tùi-bīn ê tōe-khu.

Tng Tān ê hō͘-tāi sit-khì in ê thó͘-tōe ê sî, chiū khì kong-táⁿ Lī-siān, ēng to thâi siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng. In chiàm-léng hit-ê siâⁿ, tòa tī hia, ēng in chó͘-sian ê miâ kiò Lī-siān chòe Tān.
Chiah-ê siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, chiū-sī Tān chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k tit--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàu tōe-kài hun-phòe thó͘-tōe oân-sêng liáu-āu, chiū chiong in tiong-kan ê chi̍t tè tōe hō͘ Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a chòe ke-gia̍p.
In chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, chiong Iok-su-a só͘ iau-kiû ê siâⁿ hō͘ i, chiū-sī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ê Têng-ná Se-la; i chiū khí-chō hit-ê siâⁿ, tòa tī hia.

Í-siōng chiah-ê chiū-sī chè-si Í-lī-a-sat, kap Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, tī Sī-lô hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu, Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, thiu-chhiam pun hō͘ ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê ke-gia̍p. Án-ni, in chiū oân-sêng thó͘-tōe ê hun-phòe.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Iok-su-a kóng,
“Tio̍h bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiàu góa thong-kè Mô͘-se kā lín kóng--ê, ūi lín ka-kī siat-li̍p pī-lān-siâⁿ,
hō͘ bô-ì-tiong gō͘-sat-lâng--ê thang cháu-khì hia. Hiah-ê siâⁿ thang chòe lín siám-pī pò oan-siû ê lâng ê só͘-chāi.

Gō͘-sat-lâng--ê thang cháu-khì hiah-ê siâⁿ, khiā tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu, chiong i ê sū-chêng kóng hō͘ hit-ê siâⁿ ê tiúⁿ-ló thiaⁿ; in chiū thang chiap i ji̍p-siâⁿ, hō͘ i chi̍t ê só͘-chāi, tòa tī in tiong-kan.

Pò oan-siû ê lâng nā jip kàu hit-ê siâⁿ, siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng bōe-ēng-tit chiong thâi-sí-lâng--ê kau--chhut-khì; in-ūi i sī bô-ì-tiong thâi-sí lâng, kap sí--khì ê lâng bô oan-siû.
I tio̍h tòa tī hit-ê siâⁿ, tī hōe-chiòng ê bīn-chêng siū sím-phòaⁿ. Kàu hit-sî ê tōa-chè-si sí, i chiah thang tò-khì i cháu--chhut-lâi ê pún-siâⁿ pún-ke.”

In chiū koat-tēng siat-li̍p pī-lān-siâⁿ tī Ná-hut-tha-lī soaⁿ-khu Ka-lī-lī ê Ki-te-su, kap tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ê Sī-kiàm, í-ki̍p tī Iû-tāi soaⁿ-khu ê Ki-lia̍t A-pa, chiū-sī Hi-pek-lûn.

Koh tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng siat-li̍p pī-lān-siâⁿ, tī Iâ-lī-ko tang-pêng sio̍k Lū-piān chi-cho̍k ê khòng-iá pêng-goân ê Pí-sek, kap sio̍k Ka-tek chi-cho̍k Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, í-ki̍p sio̍k Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k Pa-san ê Ko-lân.

Chiah-ê sī ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng, kap tòa tī in tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng siat-li̍p ê pī-lān-siâⁿ, hō͘ bô-ì-tiong gō͘-sat-lâng--ê lóng thang cháu-khì hia, bián hō͘ pò oan-siû ê lâng thâi-sí, thèng-hāu i kong-khai siū sím-phòaⁿ.
Lī-bī -lâng ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ lâi kìⁿ chè-si Í-lī-a-sat, kap Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ,
tī Ka-lâm -tōe ê Sī-lô tùi in kóng, “Í-chêng Siōng Chú ū bēng-lēng Mô͘-se, tio̍h hō͘ goán ū siâⁿ thang tòa, ū chháu-po͘ thang chhī cheng-siⁿ.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, tùi ka-kī ê ke-gia̍p chiong ē-bīn só͘ kì chiah-ê siâⁿ-tìn kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘, hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng.

Lī-bī chi-cho̍k ê Ko-hat chong-cho̍k thiu-tio̍h thâu chi̍t ki chhiam; chè-si A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi tùi Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k, Se-biān chi-cho̍k, kap Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k tit-tio̍h cha̍p-saⁿ chō siâⁿ.
Ko-hat kî-tha ê hō͘-tāi tùi Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k, Tān chi-cho̍k, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k, thiu-tio̍h cha̍p chō siâⁿ.
Kek-sūn chong-cho̍k tùi Í-sat-ka, A-siat, Ná-hut-tha-lī saⁿ ê chi-cho̍k, kap tī Pa-san ê Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h cha̍p-saⁿ chō siâⁿ.
Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, tùi Lū-piān, Ka-tek, Se-pò͘-lûn saⁿ ê chi-cho̍k, tit-tio̍h cha̍p-jī chō siâⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè Mô͘-se só͘ bēng-lēng--ê, chiong chiah-ê siâⁿ-tìn kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘, thiu-chhiam pun hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k, Se-biān chi-cho̍k, chiong ē-bīn chiah-ê siâⁿ-tìn
pun hō͘ Lī-bī chi-cho̍k, Ko-hat chong-cho̍k, A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi, in-ūi in thiu-tio̍h tē-it chhiam;
in tit--tio̍h ê siâⁿ-tìn ū Iû-tāi soaⁿ-khu ê Ki-lia̍t A-pa (hiān-chāi kiò-chòe Hi-pek-lûn), kap hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘; A-pa sī A-la̍p -cho̍k ê chó͘-sian.
M̄-kú hit-ê siâⁿ ê chhân-hn̂g kap chng-siā, í-keng pun hō͘ Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k chòe ke-gia̍p.
Chè-si A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi koh pun-tio̍h ūi gō͘-sat-lâng--ê siat ê pī-lān-siâⁿ Hi-pek-lûn, í-ki̍p Li̍p-ná,
Ngá-thê-ní, Í-si̍t-thê-bo̍k,
Hô-lûn, Tí-phek,
A-in, Ù-tha, Pek Sī-be̍k kiōng káu chō Iû-tāi kap Se-biān nn̄g chi-cho̍k ê siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘;
koh tùi Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k ê tōe-khu pun-tio̍h Ki-piàn, Ka-pa,
A-ná-tu̍t, A-le̍k-bûn kiōng sì chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi chòe chè-si--ê lóng-chóng pun-tio̍h cha̍p-saⁿ chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Lī-bī -lâng Ko-hat ê chong-cho̍k kî-tha ê kiáⁿ-sun, thiu-chhiam pun-tio̍h Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k tōe-khu ê siâⁿ-tìn,
chiū-sī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ūi gō͘-sat-lâng--ê siat ê pī-lān-siâⁿ Sī-kiàm, í-ki̍p Ki-sek,
Ki-pek-sian, Pek Hô-lûn, kiōng sì chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Koh tùi Tān chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h I-lī-thê-ki, Ki-pí-tùn,
A-ngá-lûn, Ka-te̍k Lîm-bûn, kiōng sì chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Koh tùi Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h Tha-la̍p kap Ka-te̍k Lîm-bûn nn̄g chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Ko-hat chong-cho̍k kî-tha ê kiáⁿ-sun, lóng-chóng pun-tio̍h cha̍p chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.

Lī-bī -lâng Kek-sūn ê chong-cho̍k tùi Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h ūi gō͘-sat-lâng--ê siat ê pī-lān-siâⁿ Pa-san ê Ko-lân, í-ki̍p Pí Si-thê-la, kiōng nn̄g chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Koh tùi Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h Ki-siān, Tāi-pí-la,
Iâ-boa̍t, Ún Kan-lêng, kiōng sì chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Koh tùi A-siat chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h Bí-sa-le̍k, A-pek-tùn,
Hek-kah, Lī-ha̍p, kiōng sì chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.

Koh tùi Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h ūi gō͘-sat-lâng--ê siat ê pī-lān-siâⁿ Ka-lī-lī ê Ki-te-su, í-ki̍p Hap-boa̍t To-ní, Ka-ní-thán, kiōng saⁿ chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Kek-sūn -lâng chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, lóng-chóng pun-tio̍h cha̍p-saⁿ chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Kî-tha ê Lī-bī -lâng, chiū-sī Bí-la-lī ê chong-cho̍k tùi Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h Iok-liām, Ka-ní-tha,
Teng-ná, Ná-hap-la, kiōng sì chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Koh tùi Lū-piān chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h Pí-sek, Ngá-cha̍p,
Ki-tí-bo̍k, Bí-hoat-ap, kiōng sì chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Koh tùi Ka-tek chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h ūi gō͘-sat-lâng--ê siat ê pī-lān-siâⁿ Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, í-ki̍p Má-hap-liām,
Hi-si̍t-pún, Ngá-siā, kiōng sì chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Lī-bī -lâng Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k, thiu-chhiam pun-tio̍h cha̍p-jī chō siâⁿ-tìn.
Lī-bī -lâng tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê ke-gia̍p lóng-chóng pun-tio̍h sì-cha̍p-poeh chō siâⁿ-tìn, kap in hù-kūn ê chháu-po͘.
Chiah-ê siâⁿ-tìn chiu-ûi lóng ū chháu-po͘, ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-tìn lóng sī án-ni.

Án-ni, Siōng Chú chiàu I í-chêng tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè èng-ún--ê, chiong choân-tōe kau hō͘ in; in chiū tit-tio̍h chit-ê tōe chòe ke-gia̍p, tòa hia khiā-khí.

Siōng Chú chiàu I tùi in ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè èng-ún--ê, siúⁿ-sù in sù-kéng-pêng-an, bô chi̍t ê tùi-te̍k ōe-tàng tùi-khòng in; Siōng Chú chiong in ê tùi-te̍k lóng kau tī in ê chhiú.
Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -ke só͘-ū ê chiok-hok, bô chi̍t kù lo̍k-khong, lóng ū si̍t-hiān.
Hit-sî, Iok-su-a tiàu-chi̍p Lū-piān chi-cho̍k, Ka-tek chi-cho̍k, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng,
tùi in kóng, “Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se bēng-lēng lín--ê, lín lóng ū chun-siú; góa bēng-lēng lín--ê, lín mā ū thiaⁿ-thàn.
It-ti̍t kàu kin-á-ji̍t, lín chiah-ni̍h kú lóng bô pàng-sak lín ê tông-pau; lín ū chun-siú Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè só͘ bēng-lēng lín--ê.

Taⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ū chiàu I ê èng-ún, hō͘ lín ê tông-pau hióng-siū thài-pêng; hiān-chāi lín thang tò-tńg-khì lín tau, tńg-khì Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng sù hō͘ lín chòe ke-gia̍p ê tōe.

M̄-kú lín it-tēng tio̍h kín-sīn, chun-hêng Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se só͘ bēng-lēng lín ê kài-bēng kap lu̍t-hoat, thiàⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, kiâⁿ I it-chhè ê tō-lō͘, siú I ê kài-bēng, tiong-sêng bô lī-khui I, choân-sim choân-ì ho̍k-sāi I.”
Iok-su-a kā in chiok-hok, sàng in khì; in chiū tò-khì in tau.

Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k í-keng tī Pa-san tùi Mô͘-se pun-tio̍h ke-gia̍p; lēng-gōa pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k, tī Iok-tàn-hô sai-pêng kap in ê hiaⁿ-tī chòe-hé tùi Iok-su-a pun-tio̍h ke-gia̍p. Iok-su-a sàng in tò--khì ê sî, kā in chiok-hok,

hoan-hù in kóng, “Lín tio̍h chiong chhiúⁿ--tio̍h ê chiàn-lī-phín, chiū-sī chin chōe ê cheng-siⁿ, kim, gûn, tâng, thih, kap hui-siông chōe ê i-ho̍k, the̍h tò-khì lín tau, pun hō͘ lín ê tông-pau.”

Tùi án-ni, Lū-piān chi-cho̍k, Ka-tek chi-cho̍k, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng, chiū tùi Ka-lâm -tōe ê Sī-lô chhut-hoat, kap kî-tha ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng saⁿ-sî, tò-khì in tit--tio̍h ê Ki-lia̍t -tōe; chiū-sī Mô͘-se chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, pun hō͘ in chòe ke-gia̍p ê tōe.
Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng, tī Ka-lâm -tōe ê Iok-tàn-hô tōe-khu, óa-kūn hô ê só͘-chāi, khí chi̍t chō tōa koh hiáⁿ-ba̍k ê chè-tôaⁿ.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng tī Ka-lâm -tōe tùi-bīn Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t pian-kài, khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ,
Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng chiū tī Sī-lô chū-chi̍p, beh khì kā in kong-táⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng phài chè-si Í-lī-a-sat ê kiáⁿ Hui-nî-hap khì Ki-lia̍t -tōe Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng hia;
kap i chòe-hé khì--ê ū cha̍p ê chi-cho̍k ê léng-siù, in mā-sī Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chong-cho̍k ta̍k ka-cho̍k ê sī-tōa.
In kàu Ki-lia̍t -tōe, kìⁿ Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng, tùi in kóng,

“Siōng Chú ê choân hōe-chiòng án-ni kóng, ‘Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ pōe-poān Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè? Kin-á-ji̍t lín oa̍t-thâu bô tè Siōng Chú, ūi ka-kī khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, pōe-ge̍k Siōng Chú, hoān chiah tōa ê chōe!
Í-chêng lán tī Pí-ní hoān-chōe, un-e̍k lîm-kàu Siōng Chú ê hōe-chiòng, kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu-bē kiat-chēng, lán iáu khòaⁿ-chòe bô iàu-kín sī--bô?
Lín kèng-jiân oa̍t-thâu bô tè Siōng Chú! Lín kin-á-ji̍t pōe-ge̍k I, bîn-á-chài I ōe tùi Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng hoat tōa siū-khì.

Lín nā siūⁿ-kóng só͘ tit--tio̍h chòe ke-gia̍p ê tōe bô chheng-khì, thang kè-lâi Siōng Chú ê tōe, chiū-sī ū Siōng Chú hōe-bō͘ ê só͘-chāi, chiū ōe tī goán tiong-kan tit-tio̍h ke-gia̍p; chóng-sī m̄-thang pōe-ge̍k Siōng Chú, mā m̄-thang pōe-poān goán, m̄-thang tī Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè ê chè-tôaⁿ í-gōa, koh ūi ka-kī khí chè-tôaⁿ.

Í-chêng Siā-la ê kan-á-sun A-kan kiám m̄-sī tī hit-ê eng-kai húi-bia̍t ê mi̍h hoān-chōe, Siōng Chú ê siū-khì chiū lîm-kàu Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng? In-ūi i hoān-chōe, sí ê lâng m̄-sī kan-ta i chi̍t ê lâng.’”
Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng ìn Í-sek-lia̍t chong-cho̍k ê sī-tōa kóng,

“Tōa koân-lêng ê Chú Siōng-tè! Tōa koân-lêng ê Chú Siōng-tè! I chai, goān Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng mā chai, goán nā ū pōe-poān á-sī pōe-ge̍k Siōng Chú, kin-á-ji̍t chiū hō͘ goán sí.
Goán nā ūi ka-kī khí chè-tôaⁿ, oa̍t-thâu bô tè Siōng Chú, á-sī tī tôaⁿ-téng hiàn sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, pêng-an-chè, goān Siōng Chú kā goán hêng-hoa̍t.

M̄-kú m̄-sī án-ni! Goán chòe chit-ê tāi-chì sī kiaⁿ-liáu ū chi̍t ji̍t, lín ê hō͘-tāi tùi goán ê hō͘-tāi kóng, ‘Lín kap Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ū sím-mi̍h koan-hē?

Siōng Chú siat chit-ê Iok-tàn-hô chòe lín kap goán tiong-kan ê keh-kài; Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, lín bô koân thang chòe Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn.’ Án-ni, lín ê kiáⁿ-sun ōe hāi goán ê kiáⁿ-sun bô koh kèng-ùi Siōng Chú.
Só͘-í, goán chiū koat-tēng beh ūi ka-kī khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h hiàn sio-hòa-chè á-sī kî-tha ê chè;

sī ūi-tio̍h beh tī lín kap goán, í-ki̍p lín ê hō͘-tāi kap goán ê hō͘-tāi tiong-kan chòe chèng-kù, goán thang tī Siōng Chú ê hōe-bō͘ hiàn sio-hòa-chè, pêng-an-chè, kap pa̍t-khoán ê chè lâi ho̍k-sāi I; chiah bián lín ê kiáⁿ-sun chiong-lâi tùi goán ê kiáⁿ-sun kóng, ‘Lín bô koân thang chòe Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn.’

Só͘-í goán kóng, ‘Chiong-lâi in nā tùi goán á-sī goán ê hō͘-tāi án-ni kóng, goán thang ìn kóng: Lín khòaⁿ goán lia̍t-chó͘ khí ê chè-tôaⁿ kap Siōng Chú ê chè-tôaⁿ hêng-thé oân-choân kâng-khoán; m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h beh hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap kî-tha ê chè, sī ūi-tio̍h beh chòe lín goán tiong-kan ê chèng-kù.’

Kin-á-ji̍t, goán choa̍t-tùi bô chit-ê ì-sù, beh tī Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè hōe-bō͘ thâu-chêng ê chè-tôaⁿ í-gōa, koh lēng-gōa khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ hiàn sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap kî-tha ê chè, lâi pōe-ge̍k Siōng Chú, oa̍t-thâu bô sūn-thàn I.”

Chè-si Hui-nî-hap kap hōe-chiòng ê léng-siù, í-ki̍p kap i chòe-hé khì hiah-ê Í-sek-lia̍t chong-cho̍k ê sī-tōa, thiaⁿ-tio̍h Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, kap Má-ná-se -lâng só͘ kóng ê ōe, chiū lóng chin boán-ì.

Chè-si Í-lī-a-sat ê kiáⁿ Hui-nî-hap tùi Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, kap Má-ná-se -lâng kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t, goán chai Siōng Chú kap lán tông-chāi, in-ūi lín bô hoān chit-ê pōe-ge̍k ê chōe lâi tek-chōe I; lín si̍t-chāi ū kiù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thoat-lī Siōng Chú ê hêng-hoa̍t.”

Chè-si Í-lī-a-sat ê kiáⁿ Hui-nî-hap kap hiah-ê léng-siù, lī-khui Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu ê Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, tò-khì Ka-lâm -tōe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hia, kā in pò-kò chit-ê sū.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng chin boán-ì, chiū chheng-chàn Siōng-tè, bô koh thê-khí beh kong-táⁿ Lū-piān -lâng kap Ka-tek -lâng, húi-hoāi in khiā-khí ê tōe.
Lū-piān -lâng kap Ka-tek -lâng chiū kā chit-ê chè-tôaⁿ kiò-chòe “Kiàn-chèng ê tôaⁿ”, sī kóng, “Chit-ê tôaⁿ tī lán tiong-kan kiàn-chèng Siōng Chú sī Siōng-tè.”
Siōng Chú hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hióng-siū thài-pêng, bô siū sì-ûi tùi-te̍k ê kong-kek. Keng-kè chi̍t tōaⁿ chin tn̂g ê sî-kan, Iok-su-a nî-lāu;
i tiàu-chi̍p choân Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló, cho̍k-tiúⁿ, sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, tùi in kóng, “Góa í-keng nî-lāu lah.
Lín ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h lín tùi hiah-ê kok só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū; in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ūi lín kau-chiàn.

Góa só͘ siau-bia̍t hiah-ê kok-ka ê thó͘-tōe, tùi Iok-tàn-hô kàu sai-pêng Tōe-tiong-hái, pau-koat iáu-bē cheng-ho̍k ê kok, góa í-keng thiu-chhiam pun hō͘ lín ta̍k chi-cho̍k chòe ke-gia̍p.

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè beh ūi-tio̍h lín chiong in kóaⁿ-cháu lī-khui lín; lín chiū ōe chiàu Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè tùi lín ê èng-ún, tit-tio̍h in ê thó͘-tōe chòe ke-gia̍p.
Só͘-í lín tio̍h ka-pē ióng-kám, tiong-si̍t chun-hêng Mô͘-se lu̍t-hoat ê chheh só͘-ū ê kì-chài, m̄-thang phian-chó-phian-iū.

Lín tiong-kan iáu-bē hō͘ lín cheng-ho̍k ê kok, lín m̄-thang kap in kau-chhap, m̄-thang thê-khí in ê sîn-bêng ê miâ, m̄-thang kí in chiù-chōa, m̄-thang ho̍k-sāi in, m̄-thang kūi-pài in.
Lín tio̍h tiong-sêng bô lī-khui Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín kè-khì kàu hiān-chāi lóng án-ni chòe.
In-ūi Siōng Chú í-keng chiong tōa koh kiông ê kok tùi lín ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-cháu; kàu kin-á-ji̍t bô chi̍t ê lâng ōe-tàng tùi-khòng lín.
Lín chi̍t ê lâng ōe-tàng kóaⁿ-cháu chi̍t-chheng lâng, in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe chiàu I tùi lín ê èng-ún ūi lín kau-chiàn.
Lín tio̍h kín-sīn, tio̍h thiàⁿ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Lín nā oa̍t-cháu lī-khui Siōng Chú, kap tī lín tiong-kan lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê jîn-bîn kau-chhap, kap in thong-hun, óng-lâi;

lín tio̍h khak-si̍t chai, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè it-tēng bô beh chiong hiah-ê jîn-bîn tùi lín ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-cháu; in ōe chiâⁿ-chòe lín ê lô-bāng khoân-thò, phah lín ê piⁿ, ba̍k-chiu lāi ê chhì, ti̍t-kàu lín tùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sù hō͘ lín chit-ê súi ê thó͘-tōe siau-bia̍t.

“Taⁿ, góa beh kiâⁿ sè-kan-lâng lóng tio̍h kiâⁿ ê lō͘. Lín khak-si̍t chai, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè èng-ún beh hō͘ lín ê hok-khì, bô chi̍t hāng lo̍k-khong, lóng si̍t-hiān tī lín sin-chiūⁿ.

Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè só͘ èng-ún it-chhè ê hok-khì án-chóaⁿ lîm-kàu lín, Siōng Chú mā ōe án-ni hō͘ ta̍k-khoán ê chai-hō kàu tī lín, ti̍t-kàu Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kā lín tùi I siúⁿ-sù lín chit-ê súi ê thó͘-tōe tû-bia̍t.

Lín nā ûi-pōe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè só͘ bēng-lēng lín ê iok, khì ho̍k-sāi kūi-pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, Siōng Chú ōe tùi lín hoat siū-khì, lín ōe chin kín tùi I siúⁿ-sù hō͘ lín chit-ê súi ê tōe bia̍t-bông.”

Iok-su-a chū-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k kàu Sī-kiàm. I tiàu Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló, cho̍k-tiúⁿ, sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, í-ki̍p koaⁿ-tiúⁿ lâi; in chiū khiā tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng.

Iok-su-a tùi só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Kó͘-chá, lín ê chó͘-sian Tha-la, chiū-sī A-pek-la-hán kap Ná-ho̍k ê lāu-pē tòa tī Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hit-pêng, ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng.
Góa chhōa lín ê chó͘-sian A-pek-la-hán tùi Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hit-pêng chhut--lâi, kiâⁿ-thàu Ka-lâm choân-tōe; koh hō͘ i ū chin chōe kiáⁿ-sun: Góa chiong Í-sat siúⁿ-sù i,
koh ēng Ngá-kok kap Í-sò siúⁿ-sù Í-sat. Góa chiong Í-tong soaⁿ-khu siúⁿ-sù Í-sò chòe ke-gia̍p, hō͘ Ngá-kok kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p.
Góa chhe-phài Mô͘-se kap A-lûn, kàng chai-hō kong-kek Ai-ki̍p, jiân-āu chhōa lín chhut--lâi.
Góa chhōa lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ chhut Ai-ki̍p, lâi kàu Âng-hái; Ai-ki̍p -lâng phài chiàn-chhia kap bé-peng tui-jip lín ê lia̍t-chó͘.

Lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, góa chiū ēng o͘-àm keh-khui lín kap Ai-ki̍p -lâng, koh ēng hái-chúi kā Ai-ki̍p -lâng im-sí. Góa tī Ai-ki̍p só͘ chòe ê sū lín lóng chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. “‘Āu-lâi lín tòa tī khòng-iá chin kú.

Góa chhōa lín kàu Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng A-mô͘-lī -lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi khiā-khí; in kap lín kau-chiàn, góa chiong in kau tī lín ê chhiú, hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h in ê tōe; góa ūi-tio̍h lín kā in châu-bia̍t.
Hit-sî, Mô͘-ap -ông Se-phoat ê kiáⁿ Pa-le̍k khí-lâi kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn, koh phài lâng khì kiò Pí-ní ê kiáⁿ Pa-lân lâi kā lín chiù-chó͘.
Góa m̄ thiaⁿ Pa-lân ê ōe, tian-tò hō͘ i liân-sòa kā lín chiok-hok; án-ni, góa chiū kiù lín thoat-lī i ê chhiú.

Lín kè Iok-tàn-hô, kàu Iâ-lī-ko; Iâ-lī-ko -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Ka-lâm -lâng, Hek -lâng, Kek-ka-sat -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, lóng kap lín kau-chiàn; góa chiong in kau tī lín ê chhiú.
Góa kàng un-e̍k tī in tiong-kan, chiong A-mô͘-lī -lâng nn̄g ê ông tùi lín ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; m̄-sī ēng lín ê to, mā m̄-sī ēng lín ê keng.

Góa siúⁿ-sù lín ê thó͘-tōe, m̄-sī lín ka-kī khai-khún--ê; siâⁿ, mā m̄-sī lín khí-chō--ê; lín tòa tī hit lāi-bīn, chia̍h m̄-sī lín chai-chèng ê phû-tô-hn̂g kap kaⁿ-ná-hn̂g ê ké-chí.’

“Taⁿ, lín tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, sêng-sim-si̍t-ì ho̍k-sāi I, chiong lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ tī Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hit-pêng kap tī Ai-ki̍p ho̍k-sāi ê sîn-bêng tû--khì, lâi ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.

Nā-sī lín bô ài ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú, kin-á-ji̍t lín tio̍h kéng lín ài-beh ho̍k-sāi--ê; khòaⁿ sī lín lia̍t-chó͘ tī Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hit-pêng só͘ ho̍k-sāi ê sîn-bêng, á-sī lín khiā-khí chit-ê tōe ê A-mô͘-lī -lâng ê sîn-bêng. Lūn-kàu góa kap góa ê ke, goán koat-toàn beh ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.”
Jîn-bîn hôe-tap kóng, “Goán it-tēng bô beh khì-sak Siōng Chú, khì ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng.

In-ūi Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ū chhōa goán kap goán ê lia̍t-chó͘ tùi Ai-ki̍p chòe lô͘-châi ê ke chhut--lâi, tī goán ê ba̍k-chiu chêng kiâⁿ hiah-ê tōa ê sîn-jiah; tī goán kiâⁿ--kè ê lō͘, keng-kè ê ta̍k-kok, I lóng ū kā goán pó-hō͘.
Siōng Chú koh ūi-tio̍h goán kóaⁿ-chhut tòa tī chit só͘-chāi ê A-mô͘-lī -lâng kap lia̍t-kok ê lâng, só͘-í goán mā beh ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú, in-ūi I sī goán ê Siōng-tè.”

M̄-kú, Iok-su-a tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Lín bōe-tàng ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú, in-ūi I sī sèng ê Siōng-tè, sī iau-kiû choân-chêng ho̍k-sāi I ê Siōng-tè, bōe sià-bián lín ê kè-sit, lín ê chōe-ok.
Lín nā lī-khui Siōng Chú khì ho̍k-sāi gōa-pang ê sîn-bêng, Siōng Chú tī sù hok-khì hō͘ lín liáu-āu, ōe oa̍t tńg-lâi kàng chai-hō kā lín siau-bia̍t.”
Jîn-bîn ìn Iok-su-a kóng, “Bōe, goán bōe lī-khui Siōng Chú! Goán it-tēng beh ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.”
Iok-su-a tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Lín kéng beh ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú, lín ka-kī tio̍h chòe ka-kī ê chèng-jîn.” In ìn kóng, “Hó, goán goān-ì choh-chèng.”
Iok-su-a kóng, “Taⁿ lín tio̍h chiong lín tiong-kan gōa-pang ê sîn-bêng tû--khì, hō͘ lín choan-sim kui-ǹg Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.”
Jîn-bîn ìn Iok-su-a kóng, “Goán it-tēng beh ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè, thiaⁿ-thàn I ê ōe.”
Hit-ji̍t Iok-su-a chiū chhōa jîn-bîn kap Siōng Chú li̍p-iok, tī Sī-kiàm ūi in chè-tēng kui-chek kap tiâu-lē.
Iok-su-a chiong chiah-ê ōe lóng siá tī Siōng-tè lu̍t-hoat ê chheh, koh chiong chi̍t tè tōa chio̍h-thâu chhāi tī Siōng Chú sèng-só͘ piⁿ--á ê siōng-chhiū kha.

Iok-su-a tùi só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, chit-tè chio̍h-thâu beh kā lán choh-chèng. Chit-tè chio̍h-thâu ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú só͘-ū hoan-hù lán ê ōe, beh tùi lín choh-chèng, chiah bián lín pōe-ge̍k lín ê Siōng-tè.”
Iok-su-a kái-sàn jîn-bîn, in chiū tò-khì ka-kī pun--tio̍h ê thó͘-tōe.
Chiah-ê sū í-āu, Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn, Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a sí, hióng-liân chi̍t-pah cha̍p hè.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kā i an-chòng tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu, Ka-si̍t-soaⁿ pak-pêng ê Têng-ná Se-la i pun--tio̍h ê thó͘-tōe.

Iok-su-a oa̍h--teh ê sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú; i sí liáu-āu, hiah-ê chai-iáⁿ Siōng Chú ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū ê tiúⁿ-ló iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî, jîn-bîn iû-goân ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiong in tùi Ai-ki̍p tòa--tò-lâi Iok-sek ê kut-hâi an-chòng tī Sī-kiàm, chiū-sī Ngá-kok chá-chêng ēng chi̍t-pah tè gûn tùi Sī-kiàm ê khai-thok-chiá Hap-boat ê hō͘-tāi bóe--lâi ê tōe; chit-tè tōe chòe Iok-sek hō͘-tāi ê ke-gia̍p.
A-lûn ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat mā sí; in chiong i an-chòng tī i ê kiáⁿ Hui-nî-hap só͘ tit--tio̍h Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ê soaⁿ-lûn-á téng.
Iok-su-a sí liáu-āu, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhéng-būn Siōng Chú, kóng, “Goán tó chi̍t ê chi-cho̍k tio̍h tāi-seng khì kong-táⁿ Ka-lâm -lâng?”
Siōng Chú kóng, “ Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k seng khì. Góa í-keng chiong hit-ê tōe kau tī in ê chhiú.”

Iû-tāi -lâng tùi in ê chhin-cho̍k Se-biān -lâng kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lín kap goán chòe-hé khì goán thiu--tio̍h ê thó͘-tōe, kap Ka-lâm -lâng kau-chiàn; goán mā ōe án-ni kap lín khì lín thiu--tio̍h ê tōe chòe-hé kau-chiàn.” Se-biān -lâng chiū kap in chòe-hé khì.
Iû-tāi -lâng chiū chhut-chiàn; Siōng Chú chiong Ka-lâm -lâng kap Pí-lī-sé -lâng kau tī in ê chhiú; in tī Pí-sek thâi-sí chi̍t-bān lâng.
In tī Pí-sek tú-tio̍h A-to-nî Pí-sek, kap i kau-chiàn, thâi-iâⁿ Ka-lâm -lâng kap Pí-lī-sé -lâng.
A-to-nî Pí-sek tô-cháu, in tui-jip i, kā i lia̍h--tio̍h, chām-tn̄g i ê chhiú kap i ê kha ê tōa-thâu-bú.

A-to-nî Pí-sek kóng, “Í-chêng ū chhit-cha̍p ê ông, kha chhiú ê tōa-thâu-bú lóng hō͘ góa chām--khí-lâi, tī góa ê toh-kha khioh chia̍h-mi̍h; taⁿ Siōng-tè chiàu góa só͘ chòe--ê pò-èng góa.” Iû-tāi -lâng tòa i khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; i chiū sí tī hia.
Iû-tāi -lâng kong-chhú Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, ēng to thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng, koh pàng-hé sio siâⁿ.
Āu-lâi, in koh lo̍h-khì kong-táⁿ tòa tī soaⁿ-khu, Nî-kek-hu, kap soaⁿ-po͘ ê Ka-lâm -lâng.
Iû-tāi -lâng koh kong-táⁿ hiah-ê tòa tī Hi-pek-lûn ê Ka-lâm -lâng, thâi-sí Sī-su, A-hi-bān, Ta̍t-mái; Hi-pek-lûn í-chêng kiò-chòe Ki-lia̍t A-pa.
Iû-tāi -lâng tùi hia khì kong-kek Tí-phek ê chū-bîn. Tí-phek í-chêng kiò-chòe Ki-lia̍t Se-hut.
Ka-le̍k kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng kong-chhú Ki-lia̍t Se-hut, góa chiū chiong góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Ap-sat hō͘ i choh-bó͘.”
Ka-le̍k ê sió-tī Ki-la̍p-su ê kiáⁿ Gô-tô-liap kong-chhú chit-ê siâⁿ, Ka-le̍k chiū chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Ap-sat hō͘ i choh-bó͘.
Ap-sat chhut-kè hit-ji̍t, Gô-tô-liap kiò i tio̍h kā i ê lāu-pē thó chi̍t khu hn̂g. Ap-sat tùi lû-á lo̍h--lâi; Ka-le̍k mn̄g i kóng, “Lí beh ài sím-mi̍h?”

Ap-sat kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí hō͘ góa chi̍t hūn lé-mi̍h. Lí ū hō͘ góa chi̍t tè lâm-pêng ê ta-tōe, chhiáⁿ koh hō͘ góa chúi-chôaⁿ.” Ka-le̍k chiū chiong téng-ē nn̄g ê chúi-chôaⁿ lóng hō͘ i.

Mô͘-se ê tiūⁿ-lâng sī Ki-nî -lâng, i ê hō͘-tāi kap Iû-tāi ê hō͘-tāi tùi Chang-chhiū-siâⁿ Iâ-lī-ko chòe-hé khì A-la-tek lâm-pêng Iû-tāi ê khòng-iá, kap hia ê lâng chòe-hé tòa.
Iû-tāi -lâng kap in ê chhin-cho̍k Se-biān -lâng chòe-hé phah-pāi tòa tī Sé-hoat ê Ka-lâm -lâng, chiong siâⁿ oân-choân húi-bia̍t; hit-ê siâⁿ chiū kiò-chòe Hô-ní-má.
Iû-tāi -lâng koh kong-chhú Ka-sat, A-si̍t-ki-lûn, Í-kek-lûn kap in chiu-ûi ê thó͘-tōe.

Siōng Chú kap Iû-tāi -lâng tông-chāi, in chiū chiàm-léng soaⁿ-khu; m̄-kú in bōe-tàng kā tòa tī iân-hái pîⁿ-tōe ê chū-bîn kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, in-ūi hiah-ê lâng ū thih ê chiàn-chhia.
In chiàu Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù, chiong Hi-pek-lûn hō͘ Ka-le̍k, i chiū tùi hia kóaⁿ-chhut A-la̍p hō͘-tāi saⁿ ê cho̍k.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng bô chiong Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; in chiū kap Piān-ngá-bín -lâng chòe-hé tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Iok-sek -ke, chiū-sī Í-hoat-liân kap Má-ná-se nn̄g ê chi-cho̍k, kong-táⁿ Pek-te̍k-lī; Siōng Chú kap in tông-chāi.
In phài lâng khì thàm-cha Pek-te̍k-lī; hit-ê siâⁿ í-chêng kiò-chòe Lō͘-su.
Cheng-thàm khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê lâng tùi siâⁿ-lāi chhut--lâi, chiū tùi i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kā goán kóng, beh án-chóaⁿ ji̍p chit-ê siâⁿ; goán ōe hó-hó-á tùi-thāi lí.”
Hit-ê lâng chiū pò in ji̍p-siâⁿ ê lō͘. In thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi ê chū-bîn, chí-ū pàng hit-ê lâng kap i choân-ke.
Hit-ê lâng khì Hek -lâng ê tōe-khu, khí chi̍t chō siâⁿ, kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Lō͘-su; kàu kin-á-ji̍t chit-ê siâⁿ iáu kiò chit-ê miâ.

Má-ná-se -lâng bô kóaⁿ-chhut Pek Siān, Tha-la̍p, To-ní, Í-pek-liân, Bí-kiat-to, kap chiah-ê siâⁿ hù-kūn chng-siā ê chū-bîn; Ka-lâm -lâng kian-chhî kè-sio̍k tòa tī chiah-ê só͘-chāi.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiông-sēng ê sî, chiū hō͘ Ka-lâm -lâng chòe khó͘-kang, bô choân-pō͘ kā in kóaⁿ-cháu.
Í-hoat-liân -lâng bô kā tòa tī Ki-sek ê Ka-lâm -lâng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; Ka-lâm -lâng kè-sio̍k kap in tòa tī Ki-sek.
Se-pò͘-lûn -lâng bô kā tòa tī Ki-lûn kap Ná-hap-la ê lâng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì. Ka-lâm -lâng kè-sio̍k kap in chòe-hé tòa, chòe khó͘-kang.
A-siat -lâng bô kóaⁿ-chhut A-kho, Se-tùn, A-hek-la, A-kek-sek, Hek-pa, A-hut-kek, kap Lī-ha̍p ê chū-bîn.
A-siat -lâng kap Ka-lâm -lâng chòe-hé tòa, bô kā in kóaⁿ-cháu.

Ná-hut-tha-lī -lâng bô kóaⁿ-chhut Pek Sī-be̍k kap Pek A-la̍p ê chū-bîn. In kap hit só͘-chāi ê Ka-lâm -lâng chòe-hé tòa; m̄-kú Pek Sī-be̍k kap Pek A-la̍p ê chū-bîn lóng ūi in chòe khó͘-kang.
A-mô͘-lī -lâng kiông-pek Tān ê lâng tòa tī soaⁿ-khu, put-chún in lo̍h-khì pêng-goân.
A-mô͘-lī -lâng kè-sio̍k tòa tī Hi-lia̍t-su-soaⁿ, A-ngá-lûn kap Sa-pin; Iok-sek -ke kiông-sēng ê sî, chiū hō͘ in chòe khó͘-kang.
A-mô͘-lī -lâng ê tōe-kài, tùi A-khek-la-pin soaⁿ-phiâⁿ kàu Se-la pak-pêng.

Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tùi Kiat-kah lâi kàu Pho-kim, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Góa hō͘ lín tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut--lâi, chhōa lín lâi kàu góa tùi lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè èng-ún ê tōe; góa bat kóng, ‘Góa kap lín li̍p ê iok, góa éng-oán bōe ûi-pōe;
lín mā m̄-thang kap chit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn li̍p-iok; tio̍h thiah-húi in ê chè-tôaⁿ.’ Lín kèng-jiân m̄ thiaⁿ góa ê ōe! Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ án-ni chòe?
In-ūi án-ni, góa kā lín kóng, ‘Góa bô beh tùi lín ê bīn-chêng kā in kóaⁿ-cháu; in beh chiâⁿ-chòe lín ê tùi-te̍k, in ê sîn-bêng beh chiâⁿ-chòe hāi lín ê lô-bāng.’”
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu, Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chiū tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu.
In kā hit só͘-chāi hō-miâ kiò-chòe Pho-kim; in tī hia hiàn-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Iok-su-a kái-sàn Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; in chiū tò-khì ka-kī pun--tio̍h ê ke-gia̍p, chiàm-léng hiah-ê thó͘-tōe.

Iok-su-a oa̍h--teh ê sî, jîn-bîn ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú; i sí liáu-āu, hiah-ê chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ chòe úi-tāi ê sū ê tiúⁿ-ló iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî, jîn-bîn iû-goân ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn, Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a sí, hióng-liân chi̍t-pah cha̍p hè.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kā i an-chòng tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu, Ka-si̍t-soaⁿ pak-pêng ê Têng-ná Se-la i pun--tio̍h ê thó͘-tōe.
Hit-tāi ê lâng lóng sí-liáu; āu chi̍t tāi ê lâng khí--lâi, in m̄ bat Siōng Chú, mā m̄ chai I ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ chòe ê sū.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, khì ho̍k-sāi Pa-le̍k.
In khì-sak chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p ê Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, khì tè sì-ûi gōa-cho̍k ê sîn-bêng, kā in kūi-pài, jiá Siōng Chú siū-khì.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khì-sak Siōng Chú, khì ho̍k-sāi Pa-le̍k kap A-su-tha-lio̍k.
Siōng Chú tùi in hoat tōa siū-khì, chiong in kau hō͘ chhiúⁿ-lia̍h in ê lâng; I koh chiong in kau hō͘ sì-ûi ê tùi-te̍k, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū bōe-tàng tí-khòng in ê tùi-te̍k.
In ta̍k-piàn chhut-chiàn, Siōng Chú lóng chiàu I só͘ kóng só͘ li̍p-sè--ê, kàng chai-hō kong-kek in; in chiū hui-siông khùn-khó͘.
Siōng Chú heng-khí sū-su, sū-su chiū kái-kiù jîn-bîn thoat-lī chhiúⁿ-lia̍h in ê lâng ê chhiú.

M̄-kú in bô thiaⁿ-thàn in ê sū-su, kèng-jiân pōe-poān Siōng Chú, khì tè pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng kā in kūi-pài; in ê lia̍t-chó͘ sūn-thàn Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng só͘ kiâⁿ ê lō͘, in chin-kín phian-lī, bô chiàu án-ni kiâⁿ.

Siōng Chú ta̍k-piàn ūi-tio̍h in heng-khí sū-su, I lóng kap sū-su tông-chāi; tī sū-su iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî, Siōng Chú kiù jîn-bîn thoat-lī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú. In siū ap-chè, ai-chhan thó͘-khùi ê sî, Siōng Chú chiū lîn-bín in.

Sū-su sí liáu-āu, in oa̍t tńg-khì choh-pháiⁿ, pí in ê lia̍t-chó͘ koh-khah giâm-tiōng; tè pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, kā in ho̍k-sāi kūi-pài, ngī-sim m̄ hòng-khì só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ kap pāi-hoāi ê hêng-ûi.
Siōng Chú chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siū-khì, kóng, “Chit-ê chú-bîn ûi-pōe góa bēng-lēng in ê lia̍t-chó͘ eng-kai siú ê iok, m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe,
só͘-í, Iok-su-a sí ê sî lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, góa liân chi̍t cho̍k to bô beh kā in kóaⁿ-cháu;
ēng chiah-ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng lâi chhì-giām Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, khòaⁿ in khéng chhin-chhiūⁿ in ê lia̍t-chó͘ chun-hêng Siōng Chú ê tō-lō͘ á bô.”
Só͘-í, Siōng Chú lâu chiah-ê cho̍k, bô chiong in kau hō͘ Iok-su-a, mā bô tī Iok-su-a sí liáu-āu chin kín kā in kóaⁿ-cháu.
Siōng Chú lâu chiah-ê cho̍k, sī beh chhì-giām hiah-ê m̄-bat keng-le̍k Ka-lâm chiàn-cheng ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng;
beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī hiah-ê m̄-bat keng-le̍k chiàn-cheng ê lâng, chai koh ha̍k-si̍p kau-chiàn.

Lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê cho̍k, ū gō͘ ê Hui-lī-sū ê léng-siù, só͘-ū ê Ka-lâm -lâng, Se-tùn -lâng, kap tòa tī Pa-le̍k Hek-bûn-soaⁿ kap Hap-má ài-kháu tiong-kan ê Lê-pa-lūn-soaⁿ ê Hi-bī -lâng.
Lâu chiah-ê sī beh ēng in lâi chhì-giām Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, khòaⁿ in khéng thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú thong-kè Mô͘-se bēng-lēng in lia̍t-chó͘ ê kài-bēng á bô.
Tùi án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa tī Ka-lâm -lâng, Hek -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng ê tiong-kan;
chhōa in ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ choh-bó͘; mā chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ in ê kiáⁿ, sòa khì ho̍k-sāi in hiah-ê sîn-bêng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, bōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè, khì ho̍k-sāi chiah-ê Pa-le̍k kap A-sià-la.
Siōng Chú chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoat tōa siū-khì, chiong in kau hō͘ Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a -ông Kó͘-san Lī-sat-tiân; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ho̍k-sāi Kó͘-san Lī-sat-tiân poeh nî.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, Siōng Chú chiū ūi-tio̍h in heng-khí chi̍t ê chín-kiù-chiá kái-kiù in, chiū-sī Ka-le̍k ê sió-tī Ki-la̍p-su ê kiáⁿ Gô-tô-liap.

Siōng Chú ê sîn lîm-kàu i, i chiū chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su. I chhut-khì kau-chiàn, Siōng Chú chiong Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a -ông Kó͘-san Lī-sat-tiân kau tī i ê chhiú, i chiū thâi-iâⁿ Kó͘-san Lī-sat-tiân.
Hit-ê tōe-khu chiū thài-pêng sì-cha̍p nî. Āu-lâi, Ki-la̍p-su ê kiáⁿ Gô-tô-liap sí.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng koh chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū. In-ūi in án-ni chòe, Siōng Chú hō͘ Mô͘-ap -ông I-ki-lûn kiông-sēng, kong-táⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
I-ki-lûn tiàu-chi̍p A-bûn -lâng kap A-má-le̍k -lâng lâi i hia, khì kong-táⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiàm Chang-chhiū-siâⁿ Iâ-lī-ko.
Tùi án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ho̍k-sāi Mô͘-ap -ông I-ki-lûn cha̍p-poeh nî.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, Siōng Chú chiū ūi-tio̍h in heng-khí chi̍t ê chín-kiù-chiá, chiū-sī Piān-ngá-bín -lâng Ki-la ê kiáⁿ Í-hut; i koàn-sì ēng tò-chhiú. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng phài i khì kā Mô͘-ap -ông I-ki-lûn chìn-kòng.
Í-hut phah chi̍t ki siang-bīn-lāi ê kiàm, tn̂g pòaⁿ kong-chhioh, pa̍k tī chiàⁿ-thúi ēng saⁿ khàm--teh.
I tòa lé-mi̍h khì kìⁿ Mô͘-ap -ông I-ki-lûn; I-ki-lûn chin tōa-kho͘.
Í-hut hiàn lé-mi̍h liáu-āu, chiū kiò kng lé-mi̍h ê lâng tò--khì.

I ka-kī tùi óa-kūn Kiat-kah phah chio̍h-siōng ê só͘-chāi oa̍t tò-tńg lâi tùi ông kóng, “Ông, góa ū pì-bi̍t ê sū beh kā lí pò-kò.” Ông kóng, “Hôe-pī!” Hiah-ê sū-hāu ông ê lâng chiū lóng thè-chhut.
Hit-sî ông ka-kī chi̍t ê chē tī chheng-liâng ê lâu-téng; Í-hut kiâⁿ óa--khì, tùi i kóng, “Siōng-tè ū ōe kau-tài góa kā lí kóng.” Ông chiū tùi chō-ūi khiā--khí-lâi.
Í-hut chiū chhun tò-chhiú, tùi chiàⁿ-thúi pu̍ih kiàm chhut--lâi, chha̍k-ji̍p ông ê pak-tó͘,
liân kiàm ê pìⁿ mā sòa chha̍k--ji̍p-khì; kiàm hō͘ iû kā-tiâu. Í-hut bô chiong kiàm tùi ông ê pak-tó͘ pu̍ih--chhut-lâi, ông ê sái lâu--chhut-lâi.
Í-hut chhut-lâi cháu-lông, chiong lâu-téng ê mn̂g koaiⁿ--khí-lâi, só--teh.
I chhut-khì liáu, ông ê pō͘-hā lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h lâu-téng ê mn̂g koaiⁿ--teh koh só--teh, chiū kóng, “I it-tēng sī tī chheng-liâng ê lâu-téng teh tāi-piān.”
In thèng-hāu kàu sim tio̍h-kip, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i bô khui lâu-téng ê mn̂g, chiū gia̍h só-sî lâi khui. Ài ah, in ê chú-lâng kèng-jiân tó tī thô͘-kha, sí tī hia.
Tī in thoa-iân ê sî, Í-hut í-keng tô-cháu, kè phah chio̍h-siōng ê só͘-chāi, cháu kàu Se-i-la.
Í-hut kàu Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ê Se-i-la, chiū pûn sàu-kak; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi soaⁿ-khu lo̍h-khì tè i, i chiū kiâⁿ tī in ê thâu-chêng léng-tō in.

I tùi in kóng, “Lín lâi tè góa, in-ūi Siōng Chú í-keng chiong lín ê tùi-te̍k Mô͘-ap -lâng kau tī lín ê chhiú.” In tè i lo̍h--khì, kong-chhú Mô͘-ap tùi-bīn ê Iok-tàn-hô tō͘-thâu, m̄-chún lâng kè hô.
Hit-ji̍t, in thâi-sí Mô͘-ap -lâng tāi-iok chi̍t-bān, lóng sī kiông-béng ê ióng-sū, bô chi̍t ê tô-thoat.
Tùi án-ni, Mô͘-ap -lâng chiū siū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chè-ho̍k; hit-ê tōe-khu thài-pêng poeh-cha̍p nî.
Í-hut í-āu, A-ná ê kiáⁿ San-ka ēng kóaⁿ-gû ê chhì-kùn phah-sí la̍k-pah ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng. I mā kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Í-hut sí liáu-āu, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng koh chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū.
Siōng Chú chiong in kau hō͘ thóng-tī Hā-só ê Ka-lâm -ông Iâ-pin; i ê goân-sòe sī Se-se-la, tòa tī Hā-lô-siat Hap-ko-ìn.
Iâ-pin -ông ū thih ê chiàn-chhia káu-pah tâi; i chân-jím khi-ap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng jī-cha̍p nî. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ai-kiû Siōng Chú kái-kiù.
Hit-sî ū chi̍t ê lú sian-ti Tí-pho-la, chiū-sī La-pí-to ê bó͘, chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su.
I tòa tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu, La-má kap Pek-te̍k-lī ê tiong-kan, Tí-pho-la ê chang-chhiū kha; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng khì i hia thiaⁿ i ê phòaⁿ-koat.

Tí-pho-la phài lâng khì Ná-hut-tha-lī ê Ki-te-su kiò A-pí-lô-am ê kiáⁿ Pa-la lâi, tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè kiám bô bēng-lēng lí, ‘Lí tio̍h chhōa Ná-hut-tha-lī -lâng kap Se-pò͘-lûn -lâng chi̍t-bān kap lí khì Tha-po̍k-soaⁿ.
Góa beh hō͘ Iâ-pin ê goân-sòe Se-se-la kap i ê chiàn-chhia, i ê choân-kun lâi kàu Ki-sūn-hô lí chia; góa beh chiong in kau tī lí ê chhiú.’”
Pa-la kā i kóng, “Lí nā beh kap góa chòe-hé khì, góa chiū beh khì; lí nā m̄, góa chiū m̄ khì.”

I kóng, “Góa it-tēng ōe kap lí chòe-hé khì, m̄-kú lí chit-piàn chhut-cheng bōe hō͘ lí tit-tio̍h êng-kng, in-ūi Siōng Chú beh chiong Se-se-la kau tī chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng ê chhiú.” Tí-pho-la chiū kap Pa-la chòe-hé khì Ki-te-su.
Pa-la tiàu-chi̍p Se-pò͘-lûn -lâng kap Ná-hut-tha-lī -lâng kàu Ki-te-su; tè i khì--ê ū chi̍t-bān lâng. Tí-pho-la mā kap i chòe-hé khì.
Hit-sî, Mô͘-se ê tiūⁿ-lâng Hô-pa ê hō͘-tāi Ki-nî -lâng Hi-pek, lī-khui kî-tha ê Ki-nî -lâng, lâi tī Ki-te-su hù-kūn ê Sat-ná-im siōng-chhiū piⁿ tah pò͘-pîⁿ tòa tī hia.
Ū lâng kā Se-se-la kóng, “ A-pí-lô-am ê kiáⁿ Pa-la í-keng chiūⁿ-khì Tha-po̍k-soaⁿ.”
Se-se-la chiū tiàu-chi̍p i lóng-chóng thih ê chiàn-chhia káu-pah tâi kap choân-kun, tùi Hā-lô-siat Hap-ko-ìn lâi kàu Ki-sūn-hô.

Tí-pho-la tùi Pa-la kóng, “Chìn-kong! Kin-á-ji̍t Siōng Chú chiong Se-se-la kau tī lí ê chhiú lah. Siōng Chú tī lí ê thâu-chêng teh chhōa lí.” Pa-la chiū tùi Tha-po̍k-soaⁿ lo̍h--lâi; tè i--ê ū chi̍t-bān lâng.
Siōng Chú hō͘ Se-se-la, í-ki̍p i só͘-ū ê chiàn-chhia kap kun-tūi, siū Pa-la kong-kek, hūn-loān sì-sòaⁿ; Se-se-la lo̍h-chhia, khí-kha tô-cháu.
Pa-la tui-jip hiah-ê chiàn-chhia kap kun-tūi, kàu Hā-lô-siat Hap-ko-ìn; Se-se-la ê choân-kun lóng siū thâi-sí, bô lâu kah pòaⁿ-ê.
Se-se-la khí-kha tô-cháu, cháu kàu Ki-nî -lâng Hi-pek ê bó͘ Ngá-ek ê pò͘-pîⁿ, in-ūi Hā-só -ông Iâ-pin kap Ki-nî -lâng Hi-pek ê ke koan-hē chin hó.
Ngá-ek chhut-lâi gêng-chiap Se-se-la, tùi i kóng, “Góa ê chú, chhiáⁿ ji̍p-lâi góa chia, m̄-bián kiaⁿ.” Se-se-la chiū ji̍p-khì i ê pò͘-pîⁿ. Ngá-ek chiū ēng thán-á kā i kah--teh.
Se-se-la kā i kóng, “Góa chhùi-ta, chhiáⁿ lí ēng chi̍t-kóa chúi hō͘ góa lim.” Ngá-ek chiū khui tóe lin ê phê-tē hō͘ i lim; iû-goân koh kā i kah--teh.
Se-se-la koh kā i kóng, “Lí khiā tiàm pò͘-pîⁿ mn̂g-kháu, nā ū lâng lâi mn̄g lí, ‘Ū lâng lâi lí chia bô?’ Lí tio̍h kóng ‘Bô.’”

Se-se-la ià-siān khùn tāng-bîn; Hi-pek ê bó͘ Ngá-ek the̍h pò͘-pîⁿ ê khi̍t-á, chhiú gia̍h thûi-á, ēng liam--ê kiâⁿ-khì i hia, ēng khi̍t-á tùi i ê pìn-piⁿ tèng--ji̍p-khì, thàng kàu thô͘-kha; i chiū sí.

Hit-sî, Pa-la tui-jip Se-se-la, Ngá-ek chhut-lâi gêng-chiap i, tùi i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lâi, góa hō͘ lí khòaⁿ lí teh chhē ê lâng.” Pa-la chiū kap i ji̍p--khì. Pa-la khòaⁿ-tio̍h Se-se-la í-keng tó tī thô͘-kha, sí tī hia, khi̍t-á iáu tèng tī i ê pìn-piⁿ.
Tùi án-ni, Siōng-tè hō͘ Ka-lâm -ông Iâ-pin siū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chè-ho̍k.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng jú lâi jú kiông-sēng, iâⁿ-kè Ka-lâm -ông Iâ-pin, chòe-āu chiong Ka-lâm -ông Iâ-pin siau-bia̍t.
Hit-ji̍t, Tí-pho-la kap A-pí-lô-am ê kiáⁿ Pa-la chhiùⁿ-koa, kóng:
Í-sek-lia̍t tiong ū léng-siù chhōa-thâu, jîn-bîn kam-goān hi-seng, lín tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Kun-ông ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ! Thóng-tī-chiá ah, tio̍h àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ! Góa beh ǹg Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ-koa; góa beh chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.
Siōng Chú lí tùi Se-ní chhut-hoat, tùi Í-tong ê tōe chiân-chìn; hit-sî tāi-tōe iô-choah, thiⁿ piàⁿ-chúi, hûn lo̍h tōa-hō͘.
Chèng-soaⁿ tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ ê Siōng Chú bīn-chêng tōng-iâu, tī Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng iô-choah.
Tī A-ná ê kiáⁿ San-ka ê sî, tī Ngá-ek ê ji̍t, siong-tūi bô koh tùi hia keng-kè, lú-hêng ê lâng oat-khì kiâⁿ sió-lō͘.
Í-sek-lia̍t lông-chhoan pha-hng, lóng bô lâng tòa, kàu góa Tí-pho-la khí--lâi, khí-lâi chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê lāu-bú.
Í-sek-lia̍t kéng sin ê sîn-bêng, chiàn-cheng chiū lâi kàu in ê siâⁿ-mn̂g. Hit-sî Í-sek-lia̍t sì-bān lâng ê tiong-kan, khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h tún-pâi kap chhiuⁿ.
Góa ê sim ì-hiòng Í-sek-lia̍t ê léng-siù, ì-hiòng kam-goān hi-seng ê jîn-bîn. Lín tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Khiâ pe̍h-sek lû-bú--ê, chē bé-oaⁿ--ê, lú-hêng ê lâng, lín lóng tio̍h pò-iông.

Chhiūⁿ-chúi ê só͘-chāi, ū chhiùⁿ-koa ê lâng ê koa-siaⁿ, in teh kóng-khí Siōng Chú kong-gī ê só͘-chòe, chiū-sī I kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t lông-bîn ê chok-ûi. Hit-sî, Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn lo̍h-khì kàu siâⁿ-mn̂g hoan-ho͘:
Tí-pho-la, tio̍h heng-khí, heng-khí! Tio̍h chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, chhíⁿ--khí-lâi! Tio̍h chhiùⁿ-koa! Pa-la, tio̍h khí--lâi! A-pí-lô-am ê kiáⁿ, tio̍h lia̍h lí ê hu-ló͘ lâi!
Hit-sî, só͘ chhun ê kùi-cho̍k lo̍h--lâi, Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn chhin-chhiūⁿ ióng-sū ūi góa chhut-cheng.
Tùi Í-hoat-liân lâi--ê, chìn-ji̍p soaⁿ-kok; tè tī Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k ê āu-bīn. Ū léng-siù tùi Má-kiat lo̍h--lâi; ū chí-hui-koaⁿ tùi Se-pò͘-lûn chhut--lâi.
Í-sat-ka ê léng-siù kap Tí-pho-la chòe-hé lâi; Í-sat-ka tè tī Pa-la āu-bīn, kap i chòe-hé chhiong-ji̍p soaⁿ-kok. Lū-piān sim tiû-tû bô koat-toàn.
In sī-án-chóaⁿ lâu tī iûⁿ-tiâu, thiaⁿ kò͘-iûⁿ ê lâng pûn phín-á? Lū-piān sim tiû-tû bô koat-toàn.
Ka-tek tòa tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng; Tān sī-án-chóaⁿ lâu tī chûn-téng? A-siat thêng-liû tī hái-piⁿ, an-ku tī káng-kháu.
Se-pò͘-lûn sī piàⁿ-miā m̄ kiaⁿ sí ê jîn-bîn; Ná-hut-tha-lī tī chiàn-tiûⁿ mā-sī án-ni.
Kun-ông lóng lâi chham-chiàn; hit-sî Ka-lâm chu-ông tī Bí-kiat-to chúi-piⁿ ê Tha-la̍p kau-chiàn, m̄-kú bô chhiúⁿ-tio̍h gûn.
Chhiⁿ-sîn mā tùi thiⁿ chham-chiàn, tùi in ê khúi-tō kong-kek Se-se-la.
Ki-sūn-hô kā in chhiong-cháu; Ki-sūn-hô ê chúi kiông koh tōa. Góa ê sim ah, tio̍h hùn-ióng chiân-chìn!
Ióng-chòng ê bé phun-pháu chhin-chhiūⁿ teh pe; bé-tôe ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ lûi hiah-ni̍h hiáng.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kóng, “Tio̍h chiù-chó͘ Bí-lô-su, tāng-tāng chiù-chó͘ hia ê chū-bîn; in-ūi in bô lâi pang-chān Siōng Chú, bô pang-chān Siōng Chú kong-kek tùi-te̍k.”
Ki-nî -lâng Hi-pek ê bó͘ Ngá-ek pí só͘-ū ê hū-jîn-lâng khah thang o-ló, pí tòa tī chhù--ni̍h ê hū-jîn-lâng khah thang o-ló.
Se-se-la thó chúi, Ngá-ek hō͘ i gû-lin, ēng kùi-tiōng ê pôaⁿ phâng chhì-jù hō͘ i.
Ngá-ek chhiú the̍h khi̍t-á, chiàⁿ-chhiú gia̍h kang-lâng ê thûi-á, kòng Se-se-la, phah-chhùi i ê thâu, chha̍k-thàng i ê pìn-piⁿ.
Tī i ê kha-chêng, Se-se-la lek--lo̍h-khì, tó-ti̍t-ti̍t, tī i ê kha-chêng lek--lo̍h-khì, bōe tín-tāng; Se-se-la tī hia lek--lo̍h-khì, sí--khì.

Se-se-la ê lāu-bú tùi thang-á khòaⁿ--chhut-khì, tī thang-á piⁿ kho̍k-kho̍k-siòng, kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ i ê chiàn-chhia iáu-bē tńg--lâi? Sī-án-chóaⁿ iáu-bē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chhia-lián ê siaⁿ?”
I chhong-bêng ê kiong-lú hôe-tap i, i mā ka-kī án-ni kóng,

“In it-tēng sī teh pun chiàn-lī-phín; ta̍k-ê ióng-sū pun-tio̍h chi̍t nn̄g ê cha-bó͘ gín-á. Se-se-la it-tēng pun-tio̍h chhái-sek ê saⁿ, chhái-sek siù-hoe ê saⁿ, nn̄g niá chhái-sek siù-hoe ê saⁿ, phoa̍h tī ām-kún chòe chiàn-lī-phín.”
Siōng Chú ah, goān lí ê tùi-te̍k lóng án-ni bia̍t-bông. Goān thiàⁿ lí ê lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t-thâu chhut-hiān kng-iàⁿ-iàⁿ. Í-āu hit-ê tōe-khu thài-pêng sì-cha̍p nî.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng koh chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, Siōng Chú chiū chiong in kau tī Bí-tiân -lâng ê chhiú chhit nî.
Bí-tiân -lâng pí Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khah kiông; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ūi-tio̍h beh tô-pī Bí-tiân -lâng, chiū tī soaⁿ--ni̍h ó͘ soaⁿ-tōng, khí iàu-sài.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ta̍k-piàn iā-chéng liáu-āu, Bí-tiân -lâng, A-má-le̍k -lâng, kap tang-pêng ê pō͘-cho̍k lóng lâi kong-kek in,
tī hia chat-iâⁿ, chiong hit só͘-chāi kàu Ka-sat kui-ê tōe-khu ê lông-chok-bu̍t lóng húi-hoāi, mā bô lâu gû, iûⁿ, lû, kap chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
In tòa cheng-siⁿ kap pò͘-pîⁿ lâi, lâng-gia̍h kap lo̍k-tô sǹg bōe liáu; in chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-kûn chháu-meh húi-hoāi hit-ê tōe-khu.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng in-ūi Bí-tiân -lâng ê iân-kò͘, chhiⁿ-chhám-lo̍k-phek, chiū kiû-kiò Siōng Chú.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng in-ūi Bí-tiân -lâng ê iân-kò͘ kiû-kiò Siōng Chú,
Siōng Chú chiū chhe sian-ti khì in hia, tùi in kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Góa ū chhōa lín tùi Ai-ki̍p chòe lô͘-châi ê ke chhut--lâi.
Góa kiù lín thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p -lâng kap só͘-ū ap-chè lín ê lâng ê chhiú, tī lín ê bīn-chêng kā in kóaⁿ-cháu, chiong in ê thó͘-tōe sù hō͘ lín.

Góa mā bat tùi lín kóng: Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, só͘-í lín sui-jiân tòa tī A-mô͘-lī -lâng ê tōe, m̄-kú m̄-thang pài in ê sîn-bêng; chóng-sī lín m̄-khéng thiaⁿ góa ê ōe.’”

Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kàu Gô-hut-la, chē tī A-pí-í-siā chong-cho̍k ê lâng Iok-a-si ê siōng-chhiū kha; hit-sî Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ Ki-tiân tī chiú-khut hia teh phah-be̍h, m̄-ài hō͘ Bí-tiân -lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tùi Ki-tiân hián-hiān, tùi i kóng, “Kiông-béng ê ióng-sū, Siōng Chú kap lí tông-chāi.”

Ki-tiân tùi i kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, Siōng Chú nā kap goán tông-chāi, sī-án-chóaⁿ goán ōe chiah-ni̍h chhiⁿ-chhám? Goán ê chó͘-sian só͘ kā goán kóng ‘Siōng Chú chhōa goán chhut Ai-ki̍p ’ hiah-ê kî-sū tī tó-ūi? Taⁿ Siōng Chú í-keng pàng-sak goán, chiong goán kau hō͘ Bí-tiân -lâng.”
Siōng Chú tùi Ki-tiân kóng, “Lí tio̍h ēng lí ê khùi-la̍t khì kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thoat-lī Bí-tiân -lâng ê chhiú. Góa hiān-chāi chiū chhe-phài lí khì.”
Ki-tiân ìn I kóng, “Chú ah, góa ná ū hoat-tō͘ kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t? Goán ê chong-cho̍k sī Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k tiong siōng pi-bî--ê, góa sī goán tau siōng sòe--ê.”
Siōng Chú tùi i kóng, “Góa beh kap lí tông-chāi; lí beh phah-pāi Bí-tiân -lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh phah chi̍t ê lâng.”
Ki-tiân kóng, “Góa nā tùi lí tit-tio̍h un-tián, kiû lí hō͘ góa chi̍t ê chèng-kù, hō͘ góa chai kap góa kóng-ōe--ê chiū-sī Siōng Chú lí.
Chhiáⁿ lí m̄-thang lī-khui chia, thèng-hāu góa tò--lâi, tòa lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ lí.” Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa ōe thèng-hāu lí tò--lâi.”
Ki-tiân chiū khì chún-pī chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á, ēng cha̍p kong-kun mī-hún chòe bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ; bah hē tī nâ-á, ēng e-á tóe thng, tòa kàu siōng-chhiū kha hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá tùi i kóng, “Bah kap bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ hē tī chit-ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng, thng tò--chhut-lâi.” I chiàu án-ni chòe.

Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá chhun-chhut chhiú--ni̍h gia̍h ê koáiⁿ-á, ēng koáiⁿ-á-bé tu̍h bah kap bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ, chiū ū hé tùi chio̍h-pôaⁿ to̍h--khí-lâi, chiong bah kap bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ lóng sio--khì; Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá chiū tùi Ki-tiân ê ba̍k-chiu chêng siau-sit.
Ki-tiân chai i sī Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá, chiū kóng, “Chhám ah! Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, góa tng-bīn khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá.”
Siōng Chú tùi i kóng, “An-sim, m̄-bián kiaⁿ; lí bōe sí.”
Ki-tiân chiū tī hia kā Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, hō-miâ kiò-chòe “Siōng Chú Sa-liông”. Chit-ê tôaⁿ kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu tī A-pí-í-siā -cho̍k ê Gô-hut-la.

Hit-mî, Siōng Chú hoan-hù Ki-tiân, kóng, “Lí khan lín lāu-pē ê gû-káng, chiū-sī i lēng-gōa chi̍t chiah chhit-hè ê gû-káng lâi, koh thiah-húi lín lāu-pē ūi Pa-le̍k khí ê chè-tôaⁿ, chhò tôaⁿ-piⁿ ê A-sià-la thiāu-siōng,

tī chit-ê iàu-sài téng-bīn, chiàu kui-tēng, ūi Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè khí chi̍t chō tôaⁿ, hiàn hit-chiah gû chòe sio-hòa-chè, ēng lí só͘ chhò ê A-sià-la thiāu-siōng chòe khí-hé ê chhâ-liāu.”

Ki-tiân chiū chhōa cha̍p ê po̍k-jîn, chiàu Siōng Chú ê hoan-hù khì chòe; i in-ūi kiaⁿ ka-cho̍k kap siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng, m̄-káⁿ tī ji̍t--sî chòe chit-ê tāi-chì, chiū tī àm-sî chòe.

Siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng thàu-chá khí--lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pa-le̍k ê tôaⁿ í-keng thiah-húi, tôaⁿ-piⁿ ê A-sià-la thiāu-siōng hō͘ lâng chhò-tiāu, tē-jī chiah gû hiàn tī sin-khí ê chè-tôaⁿ.
In kóng-lâi-kóng-khì, “Che sím-mi̍h-lâng chòe--ê?” In chhâ-mn̄g liáu-āu, chiū kóng, “Che sī Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ Ki-tiân chòe--ê.”
Siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng tùi Iok-a-si kóng, “Kā lí ê kiáⁿ kau--chhut-lâi, hō͘ i sí, in-ūi i thiah-húi Pa-le̍k ê tôaⁿ, chhò tôaⁿ-piⁿ ê A-sià-la thiāu-siōng.”

Iok-a-si kā só͘-ū kong-kek i ê lâng kóng, “Lín beh ūi Pa-le̍k piān-hō͘ sī--bô? Lín beh kiù i sī--bô? Nā ū lâng ūi Pa-le̍k piān-hō͘, thiⁿ iáu-bē kng í-chêng tio̍h hō͘ hit-ê lâng sí. Pa-le̍k nā-sī sîn, tio̍h hō͘ i ka-kī ūi-tio̍h i ê tôaⁿ siū thiah-húi piān-hō͘.”
Tùi hit-ji̍t khí, lâng kā Ki-tiân kiò-chòe Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k, ì-sù sī “Hō͘ Pa-le̍k kap i cheng-piān”, in-ūi i húi-hoāi Pa-le̍k ê tôaⁿ.
Hit-sî Bí-tiân -lâng, A-má-le̍k -lâng, kap tang-pêng ê pō͘-cho̍k lóng chū-chi̍p, kè Iok-tàn-hô, tī Iâ-su-lia̍t Soaⁿ-kok chat-iâⁿ.
Siōng Chú ê sîn lîm-kàu Ki-tiân, i chiū pûn sàu-kak; A-pí-í-siā chong-cho̍k ê lâng lóng chū-chi̍p kun-tè i.

I phài sù-chiá khì Má-ná-se choân tōe-khu, Má-ná-se -lâng chiū chū-chi̍p lâi tè i. I koh lēng-gōa phài sù-chiá khì A-siat, Se-pò͘-lûn, Ná-hut-tha-lī tōe-khu, chiah-ê chi-cho̍k ê lâng mā lóng lâi hōe-ha̍p.
Ki-tiân tùi Siōng-tè kóng, “Lí nā chin-chiàⁿ èng-ún beh thong-kè góa kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t,
góa ōe hē kui-niá iûⁿ-mn̂g tī ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ; nā kan-ta iûⁿ-mn̂g ū lō͘-chúi, thô͘-kha lóng ta-ta, góa chiū chai lí beh chiàu lí ê èng-ún, ēng góa kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t.”
Tāi-chì kó-jiân án-ni hoat-seng. Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, Ki-tiân khí--lâi, chūn iûⁿ-mn̂g, tùi iûⁿ-mn̂g chūn chi̍t óaⁿ tīⁿ-tīⁿ ê lō͘-chúi chhut--lâi.

Ki-tiân koh tùi Siōng-tè kóng, “Khún-kiû lí m̄-thang siū-khì, góa koh kiû chi̍t piàn chiū hó. Kiû lí hō͘ góa koh ēng iûⁿ-mn̂g chhì chi̍t piàn, chit-piàn chí-ū hō͘ iûⁿ-mn̂g ta-ta, thô͘-kha lóng ū lō͘-chúi.”
Hit-mî Siōng-tè mā án-ni chòe, iûⁿ-mn̂g ta-ta, thô͘-kha lóng sī lō͘-chúi.

Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k, chiū-sī Ki-tiân, kap só͘-ū tè i ê lâng thàu-chá khí--lâi, tī Hap-lu̍t chúi-chôaⁿ piⁿ chat-iâⁿ; Bí-tiân -lâng tī in ê pak-pêng, óa-kūn Mô͘-lī-soaⁿ ê soaⁿ-kok chat-iâⁿ.

Siōng Chú tùi Ki-tiân kóng, “Tè lí ê lâng siuⁿ chōe, góa bōe-tàng chiong Bí-tiân -lâng kau tī lín ê chhiú, chiah bián Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi góa khoa-kháu, kóng, ‘Sī goán khò ka-kī thâi-iâⁿ--ê.’
Lí tio̍h tùi jîn-bîn soan-pò͘, ‘Nā ū lâng kiaⁿ-sí, thang lī-khui Ki-lia̍t-soaⁿ tò--khì.’” Án-ni, chiū ū nn̄g-bān nn̄g-chheng lâng tò--khì, iáu chhun chi̍t-bān lâng.

Siōng Chú tùi Ki-tiân kóng, “Lâng iáu siuⁿ chōe. Lí tio̍h chhōa in lo̍h-khì kàu chúi-piⁿ, góa beh tī hia ūi-tio̍h lí kéng chi̍t-kóa lâng. Góa kā lí kóng tó chi̍t ê lâng thang kap lí khì, hit-ê lâng chiū ōe-tàng kap lí khì; góa kā lí kóng tó chi̍t ê m̄-thang khì, hit-ê lâng chiū m̄-thang kap lí khì.”

Ki-tiân chiū chhōa jîn-bîn khì kàu chúi-piⁿ; Siōng Chú tùi Ki-tiân kóng, “Hiah-ê chhin-chhiūⁿ káu ēng chi̍h chī-chúi ê lâng, khiā chi̍t pêng; kūi lo̍h-khì lim-chúi ê lâng, khiā lēng-gōa chi̍t pêng.”
Ēng chhiú phóng-chúi khí-lâi chī--ê, ū saⁿ-pah lâng; kî-tha hiah-ê lóng kūi lo̍h-khì lim-chúi.

Siōng Chú kā Ki-tiân kóng, “Góa beh ēng chiah-ê phóng-chúi khí-lâi chī ê saⁿ-pah lâng kái-kiù lín, chiong Bí-tiân -lâng kau tī lí ê chhiú; kî-tha ê lâng lóng thang tò-khì in tau.”

Án-ni, lâu--lo̍h-lâi hit saⁿ-pah lâng tùi kî-tha ê lâng chiap niû-si̍t kap sàu-kak; Ki-tiân chiū kái-sàn kî-tha ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, hō͘ in tò-khì in tau. Bí-tiân -lâng chat-iâⁿ tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ē-bīn ê soaⁿ-kok.
Hit-mî, Siōng Chú kā Ki-tiân kóng, “Khí--lâi, lo̍h-khì kong-táⁿ hit-ê peng-iâⁿ, in-ūi góa í-keng chiong in kau tī lí ê chhiú.
Lí nā m̄-káⁿ chìn-kong, lí kap lí ê po̍k-jîn Phó͘-la tio̍h lo̍h-khì in ê peng-iâⁿ,
chù-ì thiaⁿ in teh kóng sím-mi̍h, chiū ū tám-liōng lo̍h-khì kong-kek.” I chiū kap i ê po̍k-jîn Phó͘-la lo̍h-khì bú-chong pō͘-tūi ê iâⁿ-piⁿ.
Kui-ê soaⁿ-kok lóng sī Bí-tiân -lâng, A-má-le̍k -lâng, kap tang-pêng ê pō͘-cho̍k, in chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh hiah chōe; in ê lo̍k-tô chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-piⁿ ê soa sǹg bōe liáu.

Ki-tiân kàu ê sî, ū chi̍t ê Bí-tiân ê peng-á kā i ê tâng-phōaⁿ kóng i ê bāng, kóng, “Góa bāng-kìⁿ chi̍t ê bāng. Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê tōa-be̍h-piáⁿ kō-ji̍p Bí-tiân ê peng-iâⁿ, kā chi̍t ê pò͘-pîⁿ lòng-tó, pò͘-pîⁿ péng-lìn-tńg, tó kah pîⁿ-pîⁿ.”
I ê tâng-phōaⁿ ìn kóng, “Che it-tēng sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ Ki-tiân ê to; Siōng-tè í-keng chiong Bí-tiân -lâng kap choân-kun kau tī i ê chhiú.”

Ki-tiân thiaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê lâng ê bāng kap kóe-seh, chiū kūi-pài Siōng-tè. I tò-lâi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê peng-iâⁿ, hoah kóng, “Khí--lâi! Siōng Chú í-keng chiong Bí-tiân ê kun-tūi kau tī lín ê chhiú lah.”
I chiū chiong hit saⁿ-pah lâng pun-chòe saⁿ tūi, chiong sàu-kak kap khang àng-á kau hō͘ in ta̍k-ê lâng, àng-á lāi khǹg hé-pé.
I kā in kóng, “Lín tio̍h khòaⁿ góa án-chóaⁿ chòe. Góa kàu iâⁿ-piⁿ ê sî án-chóaⁿ chòe, lín tio̍h chiàu án-ni chòe.
Góa kap hiah-ê kap góa chòe-hé khì ê lâng pûn sàu-kak ê sî, lín tio̍h tī iâⁿ ê sì-ûi pûn sàu-kak, koh hoah, ‘Ūi Siōng Chú, ūi Ki-tiân!’”
Tī pòaⁿ-mî í-chêng, ōe-peng tú-á ōaⁿ-pan liáu-āu, Ki-tiân kap tè i ê chi̍t-pah lâng lâi kàu iâⁿ-piⁿ. In chiū pûn sàu-kak, kòng-phòa chhiú--ni̍h ê àng-á;
saⁿ tūi ê lâng lóng pûn sàu-kak, kòng-phòa àng-á, tò-chhiú gia̍h hé-pé, chiàⁿ-chhiú gia̍h sàu-kak; in tōa-siaⁿ hoah kóng, “Ūi Siōng Chú gia̍h to, ūi Ki-tiân gia̍h to.”
In tī peng-iâⁿ ê sì-ûi, ta̍k-ê lâng khiā tī ka-kī ê só͘-chāi; choân-iâⁿ ê te̍k-kun ná hoah ná tô-cháu.

Hit saⁿ-pah ê lâng pûn sàu-kak ê sî, Siōng Chú hō͘ Bí-tiân choân-iâⁿ ê lâng hō͘-siōng thâi-lâi-thâi-khì. Choân-iâⁿ ê lâng lóng tô-cháu khì Se-lī-la ê Pek Sī-tha, it-ti̍t kàu óa-kūn Tha-pa ê A-pek Bí-hô-la.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Ná-hut-tha-lī, A-siat, kap Má-ná-se só͘-ū ê tōe-khu chū-chi̍p, lâi tui-jip Bí-tiân -lâng.

Ki-tiân phài sù-chiá kàu Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ta̍k só͘-chāi, kóng, “Lín lo̍h-lâi tui-jip Bí-tiân -lâng, kò͘-siú Iok-tàn-hô ê tō͘-kháu, it-ti̍t kàu Pek Pa-la, hông-chí Bí-tiân -lâng kè-hô.” Tùi án-ni, Í-hoat-liân -lâng chiū chū-chi̍p, kò͘-siú Iok-tàn-hô tō͘-kháu, ti̍t-kàu Pek Pa-la.

In lia̍h-tio̍h Bí-tiân nn̄g ê léng-siù, Gô-li̍p kap Se-i-pek, tī Gô-li̍p ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ thâi Gô-li̍p, tī Se-i-pek ê chiú-khut thâi Se-i-pek; in koh tui-jip Bí-tiân -lâng, chiong Gô-li̍p kap Se-i-pek ê thâu-khak tòa-khì Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng, kau hō͘ Ki-tiân.
Í-hoat-liân -lâng tùi Ki-tiân kóng, “Lí khì kap Bí-tiân -lâng kau-chiàn, ná bô kiò goán? Lí ná án-ni tùi-thāi goán?” In chiū kiông-lia̍t chí-chek Ki-tiân.

Ki-tiân tùi in kóng, “Góa só͘ chòe--ê kap lín bōe-pí--tit. Í-hoat-liân khioh chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê phû-tô, kiám bô pí goán A-pí-í-siā -cho̍k ê lâng siu-sêng ê phû-tô khah hó?

Siōng-tè í-keng chiong Bí-tiân nn̄g ê léng-siù Gô-li̍p kap Se-i-pek kau tī lín ê chhiú; góa só͘ chòe--ê kap lín kiám ōe-pí--tit?” Ki-tiân kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu, in chiū bô koh siū-khì.
Ki-tiân kap tè i ê saⁿ-pah lâng kè Iok-tàn-hô; sui-jiân chin thiám, m̄-kú iáu kè-sio̍k tui-jip.
Ki-tiân tùi So͘-kat -lâng kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lín the̍h chi̍t-kóa piáⁿ hō͘ tè góa ê kun-peng, in-ūi in chin ià-siān, góa mā teh tui-jip Bí-tiân nn̄g ê ông, Se-pa kap Sat-bō͘-ná.”
So͘-kat hiah-ê léng-siù ìn kóng, “Lí to iáu-bē lia̍h-tio̍h Se-pa kap Sat-bō͘-ná, goán ná tio̍h ēng piáⁿ hō͘ lí ê kun-tūi?”
Ki-tiân kóng, “Siōng Chú hō͘ góa lia̍h-tio̍h Se-pa kap Sat-bō͘-ná liáu-āu, góa chiū beh ēng khòng-iá ê chhì-phè kap tîn-tiâu kā lín sut.”
I tùi hia khì kàu Pí-ló͘-i-le̍k, mā tùi in thê-chhut siâng-khoán ê iau-kiû; Pí-ló͘-i-le̍k -lâng mā ēng kap So͘-kat -lâng kâng-khoán ê ōe ìn i.
I tùi Pí-ló͘-i-le̍k -lâng kóng, “Góa pêng-an tò--lâi ê sî, góa beh thiah chit-ê siâⁿ-lâu.”

Hit-sî, Se-pa kap Sat-bō͘-ná, í-ki̍p in ê kun-tūi lóng tī Ka-kok, tāi-iok ū chi̍t-bān gō͘-chheng lâng, lóng sī tang-pêng ê pō͘-cho̍k chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê kun-peng; in gia̍h-to ê chiàn-sū í-keng sí cha̍p-jī-bān lâng.
Ki-tiân tùi Ná-pa kap Iok-pí-hap tang-pêng, sūn siong-tūi ê lō͘ chiūⁿ--khì, thàn Bí-tiân ê kun-tūi bô teh kéng-kak ê sî kā in tu̍t-kek.
Se-pa kap Sat-bō͘-ná chit nn̄g ê ông tô-cháu, Ki-tiân tui-jip in, lia̍h-tio̍h in, in ê kun-tūi pāi-thè sì-sòaⁿ.
Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ Ki-tiân tùi chiàn-tiûⁿ, sūn Hi-lia̍t-su ê soaⁿ-phiâⁿ tò--lâi ê sî,
lia̍h-tio̍h chi̍t ê So͘-kat ê siàu-liân-lâng, kā i cha-mn̄g; i chiū chiong So͘-kat chhit-cha̍p-chhit ê léng-siù kap tiúⁿ-ló ê miâ siá chhut-lâi kau hō͘ Ki-tiân.

Ki-tiân kàu So͘-kat, tùi hia ê lâng kóng, “Lín í-chêng kā góa thí-chhiò, kóng, ‘Lí to iáu-bē lia̍h-tio̍h Se-pa kap Sat-bō͘-ná, goán ná tio̍h ēng piáⁿ hō͘ lín ià-siān ê kun-peng?’ Taⁿ lín khòaⁿ, Se-pa kap Sat-bō͘-ná tī chia.”
I chiū lia̍h siâⁿ-lāi ê tiúⁿ-ló, ēng khòng-iá ê chhì-phè kap tîn-tiâu kà-sī So͘-kat -lâng;
koh thiah Pí-ló͘-i-le̍k ê siâⁿ-lâu, thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng.

Ki-tiân mn̄g Se-pa kap Sat-bō͘-ná kóng, “Lín tī Tha-po̍k-soaⁿ thâi ê lâng siⁿ-chòe sím-mi̍h khoán?” In ìn kóng, “Chhin-chhiūⁿ lí, ta̍k-ê lâng khòaⁿ--khí-lâi lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ ông-chú.”
Ki-tiân kóng, “In sī góa kâng-bú ê hiaⁿ-tī. Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, lín nā ū lâu in ê sìⁿ-miā, góa chiū bōe thâi lín.”
I chiū kā i ê tōa-kiáⁿ Ek-thiap kóng, “Kā in thâi-sí!” M̄-kú Ek-thiap kiaⁿ, m̄-káⁿ pu̍ih to, in-ūi i iáu siàu-liân.

Se-pa kap Sat-bō͘-ná kā Ki-tiân kóng, “Lí ka-kī tāng-chhiú. Lí chiah ū-kàu la̍t.” Ki-tiân chiū khí-lâi thâi-sí Se-pa kap Sat-bō͘-ná, chiong in ê lo̍k-tô ām-kún ge̍h-bâi-hêng ê chng-thāⁿ the̍h--khì.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Ki-tiân kóng, “Lí í-keng kiù goán thoat-lī Bí-tiân -lâng, chhiáⁿ lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ, lí ê sun thóng-tī goán.”
Ki-tiân kóng, “Góa bô beh thóng-tī lín, góa ê kiáⁿ mā bô beh thóng-tī lín; chí-ū Siōng Chú chiah sī lín ê thóng-tī-chiá.”

Ki-tiân koh tùi in kóng, “Góa ū chi̍t hāng iau-kiû, chhiáⁿ lín ta̍k-ê lâng chiong chhiúⁿ--tio̍h ê hī-khoân hō͘ góa.” (In ê tùi-te̍k Í-si̍t-má-lī -lâng ū chit-khoán kim ê hī-khoân.)
In kóng, “Goán chin hoaⁿ-hí hō͘ lí.” In chiū chhu chi̍t niá gōa-saⁿ, ta̍k-ê lâng chiong chhiúⁿ--lâi ê hī-khoân hiat tī hit téng-bīn.

Jîn-bîn hō͘ Ki-tiân ê kim hī-khoân, tāi-iok jī-cha̍p kong-kun; í-gōa koh ū Bí-tiân -ông ge̍h-bâi-hêng ê chng-thāⁿ, hī-tūi, chí-sek ê gōa-phàu, kap lo̍k-tô ām-kún ê liān-á.

Ki-tiân ēng chiah-ê kim-á chè-chō chi̍t ê í-hut-tek, hē tī i ê pún-siâⁿ Gô-hut-la; āu-lâi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng khì hia pài hit-ê í-hut-tek pōe-poān Siōng-tè; chit-ê tāi-chì chiâⁿ-chòe Ki-tiân kap i choân-ke ê lô-bāng.
Án-ni, Bí-tiân -lâng siū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chè-ho̍k, bô-la̍t thang koh hoán-khòng. Tī Ki-tiân oa̍h--teh ê ji̍t, hit-ê tōe-khu thài-pêng sì-cha̍p nî.
Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ Ki-tiân tò-khì tòa tī i ka-kī ê chhù.
Ki-tiân chhōa chin chōe bó͘, ū siⁿ chhit-cha̍p ê kiáⁿ.
I tī Sī-kiàm ê sòe-î mā kā i siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, i kā hō-miâ kiò-chòe A-pí-bí-le̍k.
Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ Ki-tiân nî-lāu hè-siū chōe, chiū sí; lâng kā i an-chòng tī A-pí-í-siā -cho̍k ê Gô-hut-la, in lāu-pē Iok-a-si ê bōng.
Ki-tiân sí liáu-āu, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pōe-poān Siōng-tè, khì pài Pa-le̍k, ēng Pa-le̍k Pí-lī-thó͘ chòe in ê sîn-bêng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bōe-kì-tit kái-kiù in thoat-lī sì-ûi tùi-te̍k ê Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè,
mā bô in-ūi Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k, chiū-sī Ki-tiân, ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe ê hó-sū, hó khoán-thāi i ê ka-têng.
Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k ê kiáⁿ A-pí-bí-le̍k khì Sī-kiàm i ê bú-kū hia, tùi in kap i ê gōa-kong choân-ke ê lâng kóng,

“Chhiáⁿ lín mn̄g Sī-kiàm ê chèng-lâng, khòaⁿ sī Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k chhit-cha̍p ê kiáⁿ thóng-tī lín, á-sī chi̍t ê lâng kā lín thóng-tī khah hó? Lín mā tio̍h tài-liām góa sī lín ê kut-jio̍k.”
I hiah-ê bú-kū chiū chiong chiah-ê ōe kóng hō͘ Sī-kiàm ê lâng thiaⁿ; in chiū ióng-hō͘ A-pí-bí-le̍k, kóng, “I sī lán ê hiaⁿ-tī.”
In tùi Pa-le̍k Pí-lī-thó͘ ê biō the̍h chhit-cha̍p ê gûn-á hō͘ A-pí-bí-le̍k; i chiū ēng chiah-ê gûn-á chhiàⁿ chi̍t-kóa húi-lūi lâi tè i.

I khì Gô-hut-la in lāu-pē ê chhù, chiong i ê hiaⁿ-tī, chiū-sī Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k ê chhit-cha̍p ê kiáⁿ, lóng thâi-sí tī chi̍t tè chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng; chí-ū Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k ê soah-bé-kiáⁿ Iok-thán ū cháu-khì bih, bô sí.
Sī-kiàm -lâng kap Pek Bí-lô -lâng lóng chū-chi̍p, tī Sī-kiàm siōng-chhiū piⁿ--á ê thiāu-siōng hia, siat-li̍p A-pí-bí-le̍k choh-ông.

Iok-thán chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì, chiū khì khiā tī Ki-lī-sim soaⁿ-téng, tùi Sī-kiàm -lâng tōa-siaⁿ hoah, kóng, “ Sī-kiàm -lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa kóng, Siōng-tè chiū ōe thiaⁿ lín.
Ū chi̍t piàn, chhiū-á beh siat-li̍p chi̍t châng chhiū chòe in ê ông. In khì kā kaⁿ-ná-chhiū kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ lí chòe goán ê ông.’
Kaⁿ-ná-chhiū ìn in kóng, ‘Góa ná thang thêng-chí seng-sán hō͘ Siōng-tè kap lâng tit-tio̍h êng-kng ê iû, khì tī lín ê téng-bīn tián-ui?’
Chiah-ê chhiū khì kā bû-hoa-kó-chhiū kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ lí chòe goán ê ông.’
Bû-hoa-kó-chhiū ìn in kóng, ‘Góa ná thang thêng-chí seng-sán góa tiⁿ koh hó-chia̍h ê ké-chí, khì tī lín ê téng-bīn tián-ui?’
Chiah-ê chhiū khì kā phû-tô-chhiū kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ lí chòe goán ê ông.’
Phû-tô-chhiū ìn in kóng, ‘Góa ná thang thêng-chí seng-sán hō͘ Siōng-tè kap lâng hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k ê sin-chiú, khì tī lín ê téng-bīn tián-ui?’
Chiah-ê chhiū tùi chhì-phè kóng, ‘Lí chòe goán ê ông.’
