Chhì-phè ìn in kóng, ‘Lín nā chin-chiàⁿ beh siat-li̍p góa chòe lín ê ông, tio̍h lâi góa ê ìm-ńg-ē hō͘ góa pó-hō͘; nā m̄, hé chiū ōe tùi chhì-phè hoat-chhut, sio-húi Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū.’
“Lín nā sêng-sim-si̍t-ì siat-li̍p A-pí-bí-le̍k choh-ông, nā chiàu Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k ūi-tio̍h lín só͘ chòe--ê, kong-tō tùi-thāi i kap i ê ke —
góa ê lāu-pē bat bô kò͘ sìⁿ-miā ūi-tio̍h lín kau-chiàn, kiù lín thoat-lī Bí-tiân -lâng ê chhiú;

lín kin-á-ji̍t kèng-jiân kong-kek goán lāu-pē ê ke, tī chi̍t tè chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng thâi-sí i chhit-cha̍p ê kiáⁿ, koh siat-li̍p i lú-pī ê kiáⁿ, lín ê hiaⁿ-tī A-pí-bí-le̍k chòe Sī-kiàm -lâng ê ông;
lín kin-á-ji̍t nā chin-sêng kong-tō tùi-thāi Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k kap i ê ke, góa chiok lín kap A-pí-bí-le̍k lóng hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k;
nā bô, goān hé tùi A-pí-bí-le̍k hoat-chhut, sio-bia̍t Sī-kiàm -lâng kap Pek Bí-lô -lâng; goān hé mā tùi Sī-kiàm -lâng kap Pek Bí-lô -lâng hoat-chhut, sio-sí A-pí-bí-le̍k.”
Iok-thán in-ūi kiaⁿ i ê hiaⁿ-tī A-pí-bí-le̍k, chiū tô-cháu khì bih tī Pí-ní, tòa tī hia.
A-pí-bí-le̍k thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t saⁿ nî.
Siōng-tè phài pháiⁿ-sîn khì tī A-pí-bí-le̍k kap Sī-kiàm -lâng ê tiong-kan, hō͘ Sī-kiàm -lâng pōe-poān A-pí-bí-le̍k,
lâi pò-èng A-pí-bí-le̍k, in-ūi i thâi-sí Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k chhit-cha̍p ê kiáⁿ; mā pò-ho̍k Sī-kiàm -lâng, in-ūi in pang-chān A-pí-bí-le̍k chân-hāi i ê hiaⁿ-tī.
Sī-kiàm -lâng hoán-tùi A-pí-bí-le̍k, chiū tī soaⁿ-téng bâi-ho̍k, chhiúⁿ só͘-ū keng-kè hit-tiâu lō͘ ê lâng; ū lâng chiong chit-hāng tāi-chì kā A-pí-bí-le̍k pò-kò.
Í-pia̍t ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī lâi kàu Sī-kiàm; Sī-kiàm -lâng lóng sìn-jīm i.
In chhut-khì hn̂g--ni̍h siu phû-tô, ta̍h chiú, khèng-chiok, tī in ê sîn-biō ia̍h-chia̍h-ia̍h-lim, chiù-chó͘ A-pí-bí-le̍k.

Í-pia̍t ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k kóng, “ A-pí-bí-le̍k sǹg siáⁿ? Lán Sī-kiàm -lâng sī sím-mi̍h khoán lâng, ná tio̍h ho̍k-sāi i? I put-kò sī Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k ê kiáⁿ; Se-pò͘-le̍k put-kò sī i ê pō͘-hā. Lán tio̍h ho̍k-sāi lán Sī-kiàm ê khai-thok-chiá Hap-boat ê hō͘-tāi, ná beh ho̍k-sāi A-pí-bí-le̍k?
Chiah-ê jîn-bîn nā hō͘ góa chí-hui, góa chiū ōe kā A-pí-bí-le̍k siau-bia̍t.” I chiū kā A-pí-bí-le̍k chhiàng-siaⁿ, “Ke phài lí ê kun-peng, chhut-lâi su-iâⁿ!”
Chhī-tiúⁿ Se-pò͘-le̍k thiaⁿ-tio̍h Í-pia̍t ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k ê ōe, hui-siông siū-khì,
chiū àm-tiong phài lâng khì kā A-pí-bí-le̍k pò-kò, kóng, “ Í-pia̍t ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī lâi Sī-kiàm, siàn-tōng siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng hoán-khòng lí;
só͘-í, lí kap lí ê pō͘-hā tio̍h thàu-mî chhut-hoat, tī iá-gōa bâi-ho̍k;
ji̍t tú-á chhut ê sî, lí tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín kong-siâⁿ; Ka-le̍k kap tè i ê lâng chhut-lâi kong-kek lí, lí tio̍h choân-le̍k tùi-hù in.”
A-pí-bí-le̍k kap i ê pō͘-hā mî--sî chhut-hoat, pun-chòe sì tūi, tī Sī-kiàm hù-kūn bâi-ho̍k.
Í-pia̍t ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k chhut--khì, khiā tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu; A-pí-bí-le̍k kap i ê pō͘-hā tùi bâi-ho̍k ê só͘-chāi chhut--lâi.
Ka-le̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h hiah-ê lâng, chiū tùi Se-pò͘-le̍k kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, ū lâng tùi soaⁿ-téng lo̍h--lâi.” Se-pò͘-le̍k kóng, “He sī soaⁿ ê iáⁿ, lí soah khòaⁿ-chòe sī lâng.”
Ka-le̍k koh kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, ū lâng tùi koân ê só͘-chāi lo̍h--lâi, koh ū chi̍t tūi tùi Bí-ok-nî-nî siōng-chhiū ê lō͘ kè--lâi.”

Se-pò͘-le̍k tùi i kóng, “Lí bat kóng, ‘ A-pí-bí-le̍k sǹg siáⁿ? Lán ná tio̍h ho̍k-sāi i?’ Lí kóng ê tōa-siaⁿ ōe tī tó-ūi? Chiah-ê lâng kiám m̄-sī lí biáu-sī ê jîn-bîn? Taⁿ lí tio̍h chhut-khì kap in kau-chiàn.”
Ka-le̍k chiū chhōa Sī-kiàm -lâng chhut--khì, kap A-pí-bí-le̍k kau-chiàn.
A-pí-bí-le̍k tui-jip Ka-le̍k, Ka-le̍k chiū tô-cháu; sí-siong ê lâng chin chōe, tó kah móa-sì-kòe, it-ti̍t kàu siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu.
A-pí-bí-le̍k tòa tī A-ló͘-má; Se-pò͘-le̍k kóaⁿ Ka-le̍k kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, m̄-chún in tiàm tī Sī-kiàm.
Keh-ji̍t, Sī-kiàm -lâng chhut-khì iá-gōa; ū lâng kā A-pí-bí-le̍k kóng.
I chiū chiong i ê pō͘-hā pun-chòe saⁿ tūi, bâi-ho̍k tī iá-gōa; khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sī-kiàm -lâng tùi siâⁿ-lāi chhut--lâi, chiū khí-lâi kong-kek in, thâi in.
A-pí-bí-le̍k kap tè i hit-tūi chhiong chìn-chêng, cha̍h tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu; lēng-gōa hit nn̄g tūi ti̍t-ti̍t chhiong khì iá-gōa, thâi-sí hiah-ê lâng.
A-pí-bí-le̍k kui-ji̍t kong-siâⁿ. I kong-chhú hit-ê siâⁿ liáu-āu, thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng, kā siâⁿ thiah-húi, koh iā iâm tī téng-bīn.
Tòa tī Sī-kiàm siâⁿ-lâu ê lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū cháu ji̍p-khì Pa-le̍k Pí-lī-thó͘ -biō ê tōe-hia̍t.
Ū lâng kā A-pí-bí-le̍k kóng, “ Sī-kiàm siâⁿ-lâu ê lâng lóng chi̍p-tiong tī chi̍t só͘-chāi.”

A-pí-bí-le̍k kap tè i ê lâng chiū lóng chiūⁿ Sat-bûn-soaⁿ; A-pí-bí-le̍k chhiú gia̍h pó͘-thâu, chhò chi̍t ki chhiū-oe, giâ tī keng-thâu téng. I kā tè i ê lâng kóng, “Góa án-chóaⁿ chòe, lín tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín tè góa chòe.”

Só͘-ū ê lâng chiū lóng chhò chhiū-oe, tè A-pí-bí-le̍k khì kàu tōe-hia̍t hia, chiong chhiū-oe thia̍p tī hit téng-bīn, pàng-hé sio, Sī-kiàm siâⁿ-lâu ê lâng lóng sí; lâm-lú tāi-iok chi̍t-chheng lâng.
A-pí-bí-le̍k khì kàu Thê-pī-su, tī hia chat-iâⁿ, kong-chhú hit-chō siâⁿ.
Siâⁿ-lāi ū chi̍t chō kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ-lâu; siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng, bô-lūn lâm-lú, lóng cháu-khì hia, koaiⁿ-mn̂g, chiūⁿ lâu-téng.
A-pí-bí-le̍k lâi kàu siâⁿ-lâu ê mn̂g-chêng, beh pàng-hé sio siâⁿ-lâu.
Ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng chiong chio̍h-bō ê téng-bīn-chō tàn--lo̍h-khì, tàn-tio̍h A-pí-bí-le̍k ê thâu-khak, lòng-phòa i ê thâu-khak-óaⁿ.

I kóaⁿ-kín kiò thòe i gia̍h kun-khì ê siàu-liân-lâng, kā i kóng, “Pu̍ih to kā góa thâi-sí, chiah bián lâng kóng góa hō͘ cha-bó͘-lâng thâi-sí.” Siàu-liân-lâng chiū kā i chha̍k-sí.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h A-pí-bí-le̍k sí, chiū lóng tò-khì ta̍k-ê lâng ka-kī ê chhù.
Án-ni, Siōng-tè pò-èng A-pí-bí-le̍k tùi i ê lāu-pē só͘ chòe siâ-ok ê sū, chiū-sī thâi-sí i chhit-cha̍p ê hiaⁿ-tī.
Siōng-tè mā pò-èng Sī-kiàm -lâng só͘ chòe lóng-chóng ê pháiⁿ-sū. Iâ-lō͘-pa-le̍k ê kiáⁿ Iok-thán chiù-chó͘ ê ōe lóng chiàu án-ni hoat-seng.
A-pí-bí-le̍k sí liáu-āu, ū Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k ê lâng Tó-to ê sun, Phó͘-óa ê kiáⁿ, Tô-la heng-khí, kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; i tòa tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ê Sa-bi̍t.
I chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su jī-cha̍p-saⁿ nî. I sí, lâng kā i an-chòng tī Sa-bi̍t.
Tô-la sí liáu-āu, Ki-lia̍t -lâng Gâi-ní heng-khí, chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su jī-cha̍p-jī nî.
I ū saⁿ-cha̍p ê kiáⁿ, khiâ saⁿ-cha̍p chiah lû-á, koh ū saⁿ-cha̍p chō siâⁿ, lóng tī Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu; chiah-ê siâⁿ kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu kiò-chòe Hap-o-te̍k Gâi-ní.
Gâi-ní sí, lâng kā i an-chòng tī Ka-bûn.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng koh chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, khì ho̍k-sāi Pa-le̍k kap A-su-tha-lio̍k, í-ki̍p Sū-lī-a, Se-tùn, Mô͘-ap, A-bûn -lâng, kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê sîn-bêng; in khì-sak Siōng Chú, bô ho̍k-sāi I.
Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoat siū-khì, chiong in kau hō͘ Hui-lī-sū -lâng kap A-bûn -lâng.
In jiáu-loān koh ap-chè tòa tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng kéng-lāi, Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ū cha̍p-poeh nî kú.
A-bûn -lâng koh kè Iok-tàn-hô, khì kong-kek Iû-tāi, Piān-ngá-bín, kap Í-hoat-liân chiah-ê chi-cho̍k, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū hui-siông khùn-khó͘.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ai-kiû Siōng Chú, kóng, “Goán ū tek-chōe lí, in-ūi goán khì-sak goán ê Siōng-tè, khì ho̍k-sāi Pa-le̍k.”
Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Góa kiám bô chiong lín tùi Ai-ki̍p -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, A-bûn -lâng, kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú kái-kiù--chhut-lâi?
Se-tùn -lâng, A-má-le̍k -lâng, kap Má-hûn -lâng ap-chè lín, lín ai-kiû góa, góa mā ū kái-kiù lín thoat-lī in ê chhiú.
Taⁿ lín kèng-jiân pàng-sak góa, khì ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, só͘-í góa bô beh koh kiù lín.
Lín khì ai-kiû lín só͘ kéng ê sîn-bêng, hō͘ in tī lín hoān-lān ê sî kái-kiù lín.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Goán ū hoān-chōe, chhut-chāi lí ê ì-sù tùi-thāi goán; m̄-kú khún-kiû lí kin-á-ji̍t kái-kiù goán.”
In chiū chiong in tiong-kan ê gōa-pang sîn-bêng tû--khì, chí-ū ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú; Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê khùn-khó͘ chin put-jím-sim.
A-bûn -lâng koh chū-chi̍p, tī Ki-lia̍t chat-iâⁿ; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng mā chū-chi̍p, chat-iâⁿ tī Bí-su-pa.
Ki-lia̍t ê kun-peng kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ chham-siông koat-tēng, kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng seng khì kong-kek A-bûn -lâng, i chiū chòe Ki-lia̍t chū-bîn ê léng-siù.”
Ki-lia̍t -lâng Iâ-hut-tha sī kiông-béng ê ióng-sū; i ê lāu-bú sī ki-lú, lāu-pē sī Ki-lia̍t.

Ki-lia̍t ê bó͘ mā kā i siⁿ kúi-nā ê kiáⁿ; chiah-ê kiáⁿ tōa-hàn, chiū kā Iâ-hut-tha kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, kóng, “Lí bōe-ēng-tit pun goán lāu-pē ê châi-sán, in-ūi lí sī ki-lú siⁿ--ê.”
Iâ-hut-tha chiū cháu-siám i ê hiaⁿ-tī, khì tòa tī Tô-pek tōe-khu; ū chi̍t-kóa húi-lūi óa-lâi Iâ-hut-tha hia, tè i chhut-ji̍p.
Kè chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan, A-bûn -lâng kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn.
A-bûn -lâng kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn ê sî, Ki-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló khì Tô-pek tōe-khu chhiáⁿ Iâ-hut-tha tò--lâi.
In tùi Iâ-hut-tha kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí tò-lâi chòe goán ê chí-hui-koaⁿ, chhōa goán kap A-bûn -lâng kau-chiàn.”

Iâ-hut-tha ìn Ki-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló kóng, “Lín í-chêng kiám m̄-sī thó-ià góa, kā góa tùi goán lāu-pē ê ke kóaⁿ--chhut-lâi? Hiān-chāi lín tú-tio̍h hoān-lān, sī-án-chóaⁿ lâi chhē góa?”

Ki-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló tùi Iâ-hut-tha kóng, “Chiū-sī in-ūi án-ni, goán hiān-chāi tò-tńg-lâi chhē lí. Lí nā kap goán chòe-hé khì kap A-bûn -lâng kau-chiàn, lí chiū thang chòe goán ê léng-siù, koán-hat Ki-lia̍t só͘-ū ê chū-bîn.”
Iâ-hut-tha tùi Ki-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló kóng, “Lín nā ài góa tò-khì kap A-bûn -lâng kau-chiàn, Siōng Chú koh chiong in kau hō͘ góa, góa chiū beh chòe lín ê léng-siù.”
Ki-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló ìn Iâ-hut-tha kóng, “Siōng Chú choh-chèng, goán it-tēng chiàu lí ê ōe chòe.”

Iâ-hut-tha kap Ki-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló tò--khì, jîn-bîn chiū siat-li̍p i chòe léng-siù, chòe chí-hui-koaⁿ. Iâ-hut-tha tī Bí-su-pa chiong chiah-ê it-chhè ê ōe tùi Siōng Chú kóng chi̍t piàn.
Iâ-hut-tha chhe sù-chiá khì kìⁿ A-bûn -lâng ê ông kóng, “Góa kap lí ū sím-mi̍h oan-siû, lí kèng-jiân lâi chhim-chiàm goán ê tōe?”

A-bûn -lâng ê ông ìn Iâ-hut-tha ê sù-chiá kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Ai-ki̍p chiūⁿ--lâi ê sî, chiàm góa ê tōe, tùi A-lūn-hô kàu Ngá-phok-hô, koh kàu Iok-tàn-hô. Taⁿ lín tio̍h koai-koai-á chiong chiah-ê tōe hêng góa.”
Iâ-hut-tha koh chhe sù-chiá khì kìⁿ A-bûn -lâng ê ông,
kā i kóng, “ Iâ-hut-tha án-ni kóng, ‘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pèng bô chiàm Mô͘-ap -lâng kap A-bûn -lâng ê tōe.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Ai-ki̍p chiūⁿ--lâi ê sî, sī keng-kè khòng-iá kàu Âng-hái, lâi kàu Ka-te-su;

hit-sî Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhe sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Í-tong -ông, chhiáⁿ i ún-chún in keng-kè i ê tōe, m̄-kú Í-tong -ông m̄-khéng. In koh chhe sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Mô͘-ap -ông, i mā m̄-chún; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū tòa tī Ka-te-su.

In koh keng-kè khòng-iá, se̍h-kè Í-tong -tōe kap Mô͘-ap -tōe ê gōa-bīn, lâi kàu Mô͘-ap -tōe ê tang-pêng, tī A-lūn-hô hit-pêng chat-iâⁿ; bô ji̍p Mô͘-ap ê kéng-lāi, in-ūi A-lūn-hô sī Mô͘-ap ê pian-kài.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng koh chhe lâng khì kìⁿ A-mô͘-lī -lâng Hi-si̍t-pún ê ông Se-hông, chhiáⁿ i ún-chún in keng-kè i ê tōe, khì in ka-kī ê só͘-chāi.
M̄-kú Se-hông bô sìn-jīm Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, m̄ hō͘ in keng-kè i ê kéng-kài, tian-tò chū-chi̍p i ê jîn-bîn, tī Ngá-cha̍p chat-iâⁿ, kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn.

Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè chiong Se-hông kap i ê jîn-bîn kau tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chhiú, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū kā in phah-pāi; tùi án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū tit-tio̍h hit tōe-khu A-mô͘-lī -lâng ê choân-tōe chòe sán-gia̍p.
In tit-tio̍h A-mô͘-lī -lâng só͘-ū ê thó͘-tōe, tùi A-lūn-hô kàu Ngá-phok-hô, tùi khòng-iá kàu Iok-tàn-hô.
“‘Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h I ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t chiong A-mô͘-lī -lâng kóaⁿ-cháu, lí mā beh chiàm chit-tè tōe sī--bô?
Lí eng-kai khì chiàm-léng lí ê sîn-bêng Ki-boat sù hō͘ lí ê tōe. Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù goán ê tōe, goán beh kò͘-siú.
Lí kiám pí Mô͘-ap -ông Se-phoat ê kiáⁿ Pa-le̍k khah kiông? I m̄-káⁿ kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kè-kàu, mā m̄-káⁿ kap in kau-chiàn.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa tī Hi-si̍t-pún, A-lô-ní, kap in hù-kūn ê chng-siā, í-ki̍p A-lūn hô-piⁿ hiah-ê siâⁿ, í-keng ū saⁿ-pah nî; hit-sî lín ná bô kā in chhiúⁿ--tńg-lâi?
Góa bô tek-chōe lí, lí tian-tò beh kap góa kau-chiàn. Goān sím-phòaⁿ ê Siōng Chú kin-á-ji̍t tī Í-sek-lia̍t kap A-bûn ê tiong-kan chhâi-koat.’”
M̄-kú A-bûn -lâng ê ông m̄-khéng thiaⁿ Iâ-hut-tha phài--khì ê lâng tùi i kóng ê ōe.
Siōng Chú ê sîn lîm-kàu Iâ-hut-tha, i chiū keng-kè Ki-lia̍t kap Má-ná-se ê tōe-khu, tò-lâi Ki-lia̍t ê Bí-su-pa, koh tùi Bí-su-pa khì kàu A-bûn -lâng hia.
Iâ-hut-tha tùi Siōng Chú hē-goān, kóng, “Lí nā chiong A-bûn -lâng kau tī góa ê chhiú,

góa tùi A-bûn -lâng hia pêng-an tò--lâi ê sî, tùi goán tau ê mn̂g chhut-lâi gêng-chiap góa--ê, bô-lūn siáⁿ-lâng, góa it-tēng beh kā i hiàn chòe sio-hòa-chè kui Siōng Chú.”
Iâ-hut-tha khì kap A-bûn -lâng kau-chiàn, Siōng Chú chiong in kau tī i ê chhiú.

I chiong A-bûn -lâng thiat-tóe phah-pāi, tùi A-lô-ní kàu Bí-le̍k, ti̍t-kàu A-pek Ki-la-bêng, lóng-chóng kong-chhú jī-cha̍p chō siâⁿ, thâi-sí chin chōe lâng. Tùi án-ni, A-bûn -lâng chiū siū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chè-ho̍k.
Iâ-hut-tha tò-lâi Bí-su-pa kàu ka-kī ê chhù, hit-sî, i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ gia̍h lin-long-kó͘ thiàu-bú chhut-lâi gêng-chiap i; chit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á sī i ko͘-siⁿ ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.

Iâ-hut-tha khòaⁿ-tio̍h i, chiū thiah-li̍h saⁿ, kóng, “Ài ah, góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lí hō͘ góa chin ûi-lân, hō͘ góa chin kan-khó͘-sim; in-ūi góa í-keng tùi Siōng Chú kóng chhut-chhùi, bōe-tàng siu-hôe.”

I ìn kóng, “A-pa, lí í-keng tùi Siōng Chú hē-goān, tio̍h chiàu lí só͘ kóng--ê tùi góa án-ni chòe; in-ūi Siōng Chú í-keng tī lí ê tùi-te̍k A-bûn -lâng sin-chiūⁿ thòe lí pò-siû.”

I koh tùi i ê lāu-pē kóng, “Ū chi̍t hāng tāi-chì kiû lí ún-chún, chhiáⁿ iông-ún góa nn̄g kò-ge̍h, hō͘ góa kap góa ê tâng-phōaⁿ khì soaⁿ--ni̍h, ūi-tio̍h góa tio̍h chi̍t-sì-lâng chòe chāi-sek-lú thî-khàu.”
Iâ-hut-tha kóng, “Hó, lí khì!” Iâ-hut-tha chiū chún i khì nn̄g kò-ge̍h, kap i ê tâng-phōaⁿ tī soaⁿ--ni̍h ūi-tio̍h i chi̍t-sì-lâng chòe chāi-sek-lú thî-khàu.
Nn̄g ge̍h-ji̍t āu, i tò-lâi i ê lāu-pē hia, i ê lāu-pē chiū chiàu só͘ hē ê goān tùi-thāi i; i lóng bô kiat-hun. Āu-lâi, Í-sek-lia̍t ū chi̍t ê hong-sio̍k:
Ta̍k-nî ū sì ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ōe chhut-khì tui-tō Ki-lia̍t -lâng Iâ-hut-tha ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.

Í-hoat-liân -lâng tī Sat-hun chū-chi̍p, tùi Iâ-hut-tha kóng, “Lí khì kap A-bûn -lâng kau-chiàn, sī-án-chóaⁿ bô tiàu-chi̍p goán chham-ka? Goán beh ēng hé sio lí kap lí ê chhù.”
Iâ-hut-tha kā in kóng, “Góa kap góa ê kun-peng kap A-bûn -lâng tōa kau-chiàn ê sî, góa chio lín lâi, lín m̄-khéng lâi kiù góa thoat-lī in ê chhiú;
góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín bô lâi kiù góa, chiū piàⁿ-miā chìn-chêng kong-kek A-bûn -lâng; Siōng Chú chiong in kau tī góa ê chhiú. Kin-á-ji̍t lín sī-án-chóaⁿ lâi beh kong-kek góa?”

Iâ-hut-tha chiū tiàu-chi̍p Ki-lia̍t ê kun-peng kap Í-hoat-liân -lâng kau-chiàn. Ki-lia̍t -lâng phah-pāi Í-hoat-liân -lâng. Í-hoat-liân -lâng bat kóng, “Lín Ki-lia̍t -lâng tī Í-hoat-liân kap Má-ná-se ê tiong-kan, sī Í-hoat-liân ê tô-peng.”

Ki-lia̍t -lâng kò͘-siú Iok-tàn-hô ê tō͘-kháu, m̄ hō͘ Í-hoat-liân -lâng kè--khì; tô-cháu ê Í-hoat-liân -lâng nā kóng, “Chhiáⁿ hō͘ goán kè--khì.” Ki-lia̍t -lâng chiū mn̄g i kóng, “Lí kiám sī Í-hoat-liân -lâng?”

I nā kóng, “M̄-sī.” In chiū kiò i kóng Sī-pò͘-lia̍t; i ōe kóng chòe Se-pò͘-lia̍t, in-ūi Í-hoat-liân -lâng ê hoat-im kóng bōe chiàⁿ; Ki-lia̍t -lâng chiū lia̍h i, tī Iok-tàn-hô ê tō͘-kháu kā i thâi-sí. Hit-sî ū sì-bān nn̄g-chheng ê Í-hoat-liân -lâng siū thâi-sí.
Iâ-hut-tha chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su la̍k nî. Ki-lia̍t -lâng Iâ-hut-tha sí, lâng kā i an-chòng tī Ki-lia̍t ê chi̍t chō siâⁿ.
Iâ-hut-tha sí liáu-āu, Pek-lī-hêng -lâng Í-pí-chàn chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su.

I ū saⁿ-cha̍p ê kiáⁿ, saⁿ-cha̍p ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; i chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ pa̍t-ê chong-cho̍k, mā ūi-tio̍h i ê hāu-siⁿ tùi pa̍t-ê chong-cho̍k chhōa saⁿ-cha̍p ê sin-pū. I chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su chhit nî.
Í-pí-chàn sí, lâng kā i an-chòng tī Pek-lī-hêng.
Í-pí-chàn sí liáu-āu, Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k ê lâng Í-lûn chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su cha̍p nî.
Í-lûn sí, lâng kā i an-chòng tī Se-pò͘-lûn tōe-khu ê A-ngá-lûn.
Í-lûn sí liáu-āu, Pí-la-tùn -lâng Hi-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ A-pek-tùn chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su.
I ū sì-cha̍p ê kiáⁿ, saⁿ-cha̍p ê sun; in khiâ chhit-cha̍p chiah lû-á. I chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su poeh nî.
Pí-la-tùn -lâng Hi-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ A-pek-tùn sí, lâng kā i an-chòng tī A-má-le̍k -lâng ê soaⁿ-tōe, Í-hoat-liân tōe-khu ê Pí-la-tùn.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng koh chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū; Siōng Chú kā in kau tī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú sì-cha̍p nî.
Hit-sî, ū chi̍t ê Tān chi-cho̍k ê Só-la -lâng, kiò-chòe Má-ná-a; i ê bó͘ bô hoâi-īn, bô siⁿ.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tùi hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng hián-hiān, kā i kóng, “Lí í-chêng bōe hoâi-īn, bōe siⁿ-kiáⁿ, m̄-kú hiān-chāi lí beh hoâi-īn siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ.
Só͘-í lí tio̍h sòe-jī, po̍h-chiú kāu-chiú m̄-thang lim, lu̍t-hoat kui-tēng bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h lóng m̄-thang chia̍h.

Lí beh hoâi-īn siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, m̄-thang kā i thì-thâu; in-ūi chit-ê gín-á tùi thai--ni̍h chiū kui Siōng-tè chòe Ná-sè-ní-lâng; i beh khai-sí kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thoat-lī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú.”

Hū-jîn-lâng khì kā i ê tiōng-hu kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng lâi góa chia, i ê iông-māu chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá, hō͘ lâng kiaⁿ-ùi. Góa bô mn̄g i tùi tó-ūi lâi, i mā bô kā góa kóng i ê miâ;

m̄-kú i tùi góa kóng, ‘Lí beh hoâi-īn siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, só͘-í po̍h-chiú kāu-chiú m̄-thang lim, bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h lóng m̄-thang chia̍h, in-ūi chit-ê gín-á tùi thai--ni̍h kàu i sí hit-ji̍t, beh kui Siōng-tè chòe Ná-sè-ní-lâng.’”

Má-ná-a chiū kiû Siōng Chú kóng, “Chú ah, kiû lí hō͘ lí só͘ chhe Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng koh lâi goán chia, thang kàu-tō goán án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi chit-ê teh-beh chhut-sì ê gín-á.”
Siōng-tè thiaⁿ Má-ná-a ê khún-kiû. Hū-jîn-lâng chē tī hn̂g--ni̍h ê sî, Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá koh lâi i hia; m̄-kú i ê tiōng-hu Má-ná-a bô kap i chòe-hé.
Hū-jîn-lâng kóaⁿ-kín cháu-khì pò i ê tiōng-hu, kā i kóng, “Hit-ji̍t lâi góa chia hit-ê lâng koh tùi góa hián-hiān.”
Má-ná-a kóaⁿ-kín tè i ê bó͘ khì hit-ê lâng hia, tùi i kóng, “Lí kiám sī tùi goán bó͘ kóng-ōe hit-ê lâng?” I kóng, “Sī.”
Má-ná-a kóng, “Lí ê ōe si̍t-hiān liáu-āu, goán tio̍h án-chóaⁿ kà chit-ê gín-á? I tio̍h siú sím-mi̍h kui-kú?”
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tùi Má-ná-a kóng, “Góa kā chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng ê tāi-chì, i lóng tio̍h kín-sīn;
só͘-ū phû-tô-chhiū chhut ê mi̍h m̄-thang chia̍h, po̍h-chiú kāu-chiú m̄-thang lim, it-chhè bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h mā m̄-thang chia̍h. Góa kā i hoan-hù--ê, i lóng tio̍h chun-siú.”
Má-ná-a tùi Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lâu--lo̍h-lâi, hō͘ goán thang chún-pī chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á chhiáⁿ lí.”

Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kā Má-ná-a kóng, “Lí kā góa lâu--lo̍h-lâi, góa mā bōe chia̍h lí ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ. Lí nā beh hiàn sio-hòa-chè, tio̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.” Má-ná-a m̄ chai i sī Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá.
Má-ná-a tùi Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kā góa kóng lí ê tōa miâ. Lí ê ōe si̍t-hiān ê sî, goán thang pò-tap lí.”
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kā i kóng, “Lí bô eng-kai mn̄g góa ê miâ. Góa ê miâ sī kî-biāu, oh-tit lí-kái.”
Má-ná-a chiong chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á kap sò͘-chè, tī chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; hit-sî, Má-ná-a kap i ê bó͘ khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t hāng kî-biāu ê sū.

Hé-iām tùi tôaⁿ-téng chhèng-chiūⁿ thiⁿ ê sî, Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá mā tùi chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng ê hé-iām tiong chiūⁿ--khì. Má-ná-a kap i ê bó͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū phak tī thô͘-kha.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá bô koh chhut-hiān hō͘ Má-ná-a kap i ê bó͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, Má-ná-a chiah chai i sī Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá.
Má-ná-a kā i ê bó͘ kóng, “Lán it-tēng ōe sí, in-ūi lán ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè.”

I ê bó͘ kā i kóng, “Siōng Chú nā beh hō͘ lán sí, it-tēng bōe chiap-la̍p lán hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè kap sò͘-chè, bōe hō͘ lán khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chiah-ê tāi-chì, mā bōe tī chit-chūn hō͘ lán thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe.”
Āu-lâi, hū-jîn-lâng siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Chham-sun; gín-á tōa-hàn, Siōng Chú sù-hok i.
Tī Só-la kap Í-si̍t-tô tiong-kan ê Má-hap-nî Tān, Siōng Chú ê sîn khai-sí chhiong-móa i.
Chham-sun lo̍h-khì Têng-ná, tī hia khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê lú-chú, sī Hui-lī-sū ê cha-bó͘ gín-á.
Chham-sun tò-khì kā in lāu-pē lāu-bú kóng, “Góa tī Têng-ná khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê lú-chú, sī Hui-lī-sū ê cha-bó͘ gín-á; chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa chhōa i choh-bó͘.”

I ê pē-bú kā i kóng, “Tī lán ê chong-cho̍k kap tông-pau ê tiong-kan, kiám bô cha-bó͘ gín-á? Lí ná beh chhōa bô siū kat-lé ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê cha-bó͘ gín-á?” Chham-sun kā i ê lāu-pē kóng, “Góa kah-ì i, góa beh chhōa i.”
I ê pē-bú m̄ chai chit-ê tāi-chì chhut tī Siōng Chú, in-ūi Siōng Chú chhē ki-hōe beh kong-kek Hui-lī-sū -lâng. Hit-sî, Hui-lī-sū -lâng koán-hat Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Chham-sun kap i ê pē-bú lo̍h-khì Têng-ná. Chham-sun kàu Têng-ná ê phû-tô-hn̂g ê sî, hut-jiân tú-tio̍h chi̍t chiah siàu-chòng ê sai tùi i tōa-siaⁿ háu.
Siōng Chú ê sîn tōa-tōa chhiong-móa Chham-sun; i khang-chhiú kā sai thiah-li̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh thiah-li̍h soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á. Chit-hāng tāi-chì Chham-sun bô kā i ê pē-bú kóng.
Chham-sun lo̍h-khì kap hit-ê lú-chú kóng-ōe, chin kah-ì i.

Kè chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan, i tò-khì beh chhōa hit-ê lú-chú chòe bó͘; i oat tùi lō͘-piⁿ beh khòaⁿ hit-chiah i phah-sí ê sai, khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū chi̍t siū phang kap bi̍t tī sai ê sin-si lāi-bīn.
I óe bi̍t hē tī chhiú--ni̍h, ná kiâⁿ ná chia̍h; lâi kàu i ê pē-bú hia, pun hō͘ in chia̍h, m̄-kú bô kā in kóng bi̍t sī tùi sai ê sin-si óe--lâi-ê.
I ê lāu-pē lo̍h-khì hit-ê lú-chú hia. Chham-sun chiàu hit só͘-chāi choh sin-lông ê koàn-lē, tī hia pān-toh chhiáⁿ lâng-kheh.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Chham-sun lâi, chiū chhōa saⁿ-cha̍p ê lâng lâi pôe-phōaⁿ i.

Chham-sun kā in kóng, “Góa hiān-chāi beh chhut chi̍t ê bī-chhai hō͘ lín; lín tī iàn-se̍k ê chhit ji̍t lāi nā chhai ōe chhut, góa chiū beh hō͘ lín saⁿ-cha̍p niá iù-môa-pò͘ ê lāi-saⁿ, saⁿ-cha̍p thò lé-ho̍k;
lín nā ioh bōe chhut--lâi, lín tio̍h hō͘ góa saⁿ-cha̍p niá iù-môa-pò͘ ê lāi-saⁿ, saⁿ-cha̍p thò lé-ho̍k.” In kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kóng lí ê bī-chhai hō͘ goán ioh.”
Chham-sun chiū kóng, “Chia̍h-mi̍h tùi thun-chia̍h--ê chhut; tiⁿ-mi̍h tùi kiông-béng--ê chhut.” In saⁿ ji̍t kú ioh bōe chhut.

Kàu tē-sì ji̍t, in kā Chham-sun ê bó͘ kóng, “Lí tio̍h kā lí ê tiōng-hu làu-ōe, hō͘ goán chai bī-chhai ê ì-sù; nā bô, goán beh pàng-hé sio lí kap lín lāu-pē ê chhù. Lín chhiáⁿ goán lâi, sī beh chhiúⁿ goán sī--bô?”

Chham-sun ê bó͘ phak tī i ê keng-thâu téng thî-khàu kóng, “Lí sī oàn-hūn góa, m̄-sī thiàⁿ góa; in-ūi lí chhut bī-chhai hō͘ goán pún-cho̍k ê lâng, khiok bô kā góa kóng tap-àn.” I ìn kóng, “Góa liân pē-bú to bô kā in kóng, ná thang kā lí kóng?”

Chham-sun ê bó͘ tī i ê bīn-chêng thî-thî-khàu-khàu kàu iàn-se̍k ê tē-chhit ji̍t, Chham-sun bōe-kham-tit i pek, chiū kā i kóng; i ê bó͘ chiū chiong tap-àn kā i pún-cho̍k ê lâng kóng.

Kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng, siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng lâi kā Chham-sun kóng, “Ū sím-mi̍h pí bi̍t khah tiⁿ? Ū sím-mi̍h pí sai khah kiông?” Chham-sun kā in hôe-tap kóng, “Nā bô ēng góa ê sòe-chiah gû-bú lôe-chhân, lín choa̍t-tùi ioh bōe chhut tap-àn.”

Siōng Chú ê sîn tōa-tōa chhiong-móa Chham-sun, i chiū lo̍h-khì A-si̍t-ki-lûn, thâi-sí saⁿ-cha̍p lâng, chhiúⁿ in ê saⁿ, the̍h hō͘ ioh-tio̍h bī-chhai ê lâng. Chham-sun khì-phut-phut, tò-khì in lāu-pē hia.
Chham-sun ê bó͘ soah kè hō͘ i ê phōaⁿ-chhōa--ê tiong-kan ê chi̍t ê.

Kè chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan, kàu koah be̍h-á ê sî, Chham-sun tòa chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á khì chhē i ê bó͘. I tùi i ê tiūⁿ-lâng kóng, “Góa beh ji̍p-khì pâng-keng chhē goán bó͘.” I ê tiūⁿ-lâng m̄-chún i ji̍p--khì.
Tiūⁿ-lâng kóng, “Góa siūⁿ lí chiok chhoeh--i, só͘-í góa chiong i kè hō͘ lí ê phōaⁿ-chhōa--ê. I ê sió-bē pí i khah súi, lí thang chhōa i.”
Chham-sun kā in kóng, “Chit-piàn góa ū chèng-tong ê lí-iû tùi-hù Hui-lī-sū -lâng.”
Chham-sun chiū khì lia̍h saⁿ-pah chiah hô͘-lî, chiong in nn̄g-chiah nn̄g-chiah ê bé pa̍k chòe-hé, koh chiong hé-pé pa̍k tī hô͘-lî-bé ê tiong-kan.

I chiong hé-pé tiám-to̍h, pàng hô͘-lî ji̍p-khì Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê be̍h-hn̂g, chiong koah hó chhāi tī hia, kap iáu-bē koah ê be̍h-á lóng sio-liáu-liáu, liân phû-tô-hn̂g kap kaⁿ-ná-chhiū mā lóng sio--khì.

Hui-lī-sū -lâng kóng, “Che sī siáⁿ-lâng chòe--ê?” Ū lâng kóng, “Sī Têng-ná -lâng ê kiáⁿ-sài Chham-sun, in-ūi i ê tiūⁿ-lâng chiong i ê bó͘ kè hō͘ i ê phōaⁿ-chhōa--ê.” Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiū khì pàng-hé sio hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng kap i ê lāu-pē.
Chham-sun tùi Hui-lī-sū -lâng kóng, “Lín kì-jiân chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì, góa it-tēng beh pò-siû, m̄ pàng lín soah.”
Chham-sun chiū chhut tāng-chhiú kong-kek in, thâi-sí chin chōe lâng. Āu-lâi, i lo̍h-khì tòa tī Í-thán ê chio̍h-tōng lāi.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng khì chat-iâⁿ tī Iû-tāi, tī Lī-hi pâi-tīn.
Iû-tāi -lâng kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ chiūⁿ-lâi kong-kek goán?” In kóng, “Goán lâi sī beh lia̍h Chham-sun; i án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi goán, goán mā beh án-ni tùi-thāi i.”

Tùi án-ni, saⁿ-chheng ê Iû-tāi -lâng chiū khì Í-thán ê chio̍h-tōng hia, kā Chham-sun kóng, “Lí kiám m̄ chai Hui-lī-sū -lâng ap-chè lán? Lí ná kā goán jiá chiah tōa ê mâ-hoân?” Chham-sun ìn kóng, “In án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi góa, góa mā án-ni tùi-thāi in.”
Iû-tāi -lâng kā i kóng, “Goán lâi beh kā lí pa̍k khí-lâi kau hō͘ Hui-lī-sū -lâng.” Chham-sun kā in kóng, “Lín tio̍h chiù-chōa, lín bōe hāi góa.”

In tùi i kóng, “Goán it-tēng bōe hāi lí, kan-ta beh kā lí pa̍k khí-lâi kau hō͘ Hui-lī-sū -lâng.” In chiū ēng nn̄g tiâu sin ê soh pa̍k Chham-sun, tùi chio̍h-tōng kā i tòa--chhut-lâi.

Chham-sun kàu Lī-hi; Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiū kiâⁿ óa--khì, tùi i tōa-siaⁿ hoah. Siōng Chú ê sîn tōa-tōa chhiong-móa i, pa̍k i ê chhiú ê soh chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ hé sio--kè ê môa-soh, tùi i ê chhiú lak--lo̍h-khì.
I khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t tè iáu-bē ta ê lû-á ê chhùi-phóe-kut, chiū khioh--khí-lâi, ēng lâi phah-sí chi̍t-chheng lâng.
Chham-sun kóng, “Góa ēng lû ê chhùi-phóe-kut phah-sí chi̍t-chheng lâng; góa ēng lû ê chhùi-phóe-kut phah-sí lâng, chi̍t-tui koh chi̍t-tui.”
Kóng soah, chiū chiong chhiú--ni̍h ê chhùi-phóe-kut hiat-ka̍k; hit só͘-chāi chiū kiò-chòe La-boa̍t Lī-hi.

Chham-sun hui-siông chhùi-ta, chiū kiû-kiò Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí kì-jiân hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn tōa sèng-lī, ná thang hō͘ góa chhùi-ta kah beh sí, hō͘ bô siū kat-lé ê lâng lia̍h--khì?”

Siōng-tè chiū hō͘ Lī-hi lap-o ê só͘-chāi li̍h--khui, chúi tùi hia chhèng--chhut-lâi. Chham-sun lim-liáu, goân-khì hôe-ho̍k; hit-ê chúi-chôaⁿ chiū kiò-chòe Ún Hap-ko-lī, kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu tī Lī-hi.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hō͘ Hui-lī-sū -lâng ap-chè ê sî, Chham-sun chòe sū-su jī-cha̍p nî.
Chham-sun lâi Ka-sat, tī hia khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê ki-lú, chiū kap i khùn.
Ū lâng kā Ka-sat -lâng kóng, “ Chham-sun lâi kàu lán chia.” In chiū thàu-mî kā i pau-ûi, kui-mî chēng-chēng tī siâⁿ-mn̂g bâi-ho̍k; in kóng, “Thiⁿ-kng lán chiū thang thâi i.”

Chham-sun khùn kàu pòaⁿ-mî, khí--lâi, chiong siâⁿ-mn̂g ê mn̂g-sìⁿ, nn̄g ki mn̂g-khiā, kap mn̂g-kông, lóng thiah--khí-lâi, hē tī keng-thâu, giâ-khì Hi-pek-lûn tùi-bīn ê soaⁿ-téng.
Āu-lâi, Chham-sun tī So-lia̍t Soaⁿ-kok ài-tio̍h chi̍t ê lú-chú Tāi-lī-la.

Hui-lī-sū -lâng hiah-ê siú-léng khì chhē hit-ê lú-chú, kā i kóng, “Lí tio̍h kā Chham-sun làu-ōe, khòaⁿ i sī-án-chóaⁿ chiah-ni̍h ū khùi-la̍t; goán tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe, chiah ōe-tàng khah iâⁿ i, kā i pa̍k--khí-lâi, kā i chè-ho̍k. Goán ta̍k-ê lâng chiū hō͘ lí chi̍t-chheng chi̍t-pah tè gûn.”
Tāi-lī-la chiū kā Chham-sun kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kā góa kóng, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ chiah-ni̍h ū khùi-la̍t; tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chiah ōe-tàng kā lí pa̍k--khí-lâi, kā lí chè-ho̍k.”
Chham-sun ìn kóng, “Lâng nā ēng chhit tiâu iáu-bē ta ê soh-á kā góa pa̍k, góa chiū kap phó͘-thong-lâng siâng-khoán bô khùi-la̍t.”
Hui-lī-sū -lâng hiah-ê siú-léng chiū the̍h chhit tiâu iáu-bē ta ê soh-á hō͘ Tāi-lī-la, i chiū ēng che kā Chham-sun pa̍k--khí-lâi.

Hit-sî í-keng ū lâng tī i ê lāi-pâng teh tng-tán; i hoah kóng, “ Chham-sun, Hui-lī-sū -lâng lâi beh lia̍h--lí!” Chham-sun chiū chhoah-tn̄g soh, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhoah-tn̄g hé sio--kè ê môa-si; án-ni, i tōa khùi-la̍t ê pì-bi̍t lâng iû-goân m̄ chai.
Tāi-lī-la kā Chham-sun kóng, “Lí kā góa phiàn, kóng pe̍h-chha̍t. Taⁿ lí tio̍h kā góa kóng, án-chóaⁿ chiah ōe-tàng kā lí pa̍k--khí-lâi.”
Chham-sun ìn kóng, “Lâng nā ēng m̄-bat ēng--kè ê sin soh-á kā góa pa̍k, góa chiū kap phó͘-thong-lâng siâng-khoán bô khùi-la̍t.”

Tāi-lī-la chiū ēng sin ê soh-á kā i pa̍k--khí-lâi, tùi i kóng, “ Chham-sun ah, Hui-lī-sū -lâng lâi beh lia̍h--lí!” Hit-sî, bâi-ho̍k ê lâng bih tī lāi-pâng; Chham-sun chiū chhoah-tn̄g pa̍k tī i chhiú-kut ê soh, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhoah-tn̄g chi̍t tiâu sòaⁿ.

Tāi-lī-la kā Chham-sun kóng, “Lí kàu taⁿ iáu phiàn góa, kóng pe̍h-chha̍t. Chhiáⁿ lí kā góa kóng, án-chóaⁿ chiah ōe-tàng kā lí pa̍k--khí-lâi?” Chham-sun ìn kóng, “Lí nā chiong góa chhit kó͘ ê thâu-mn̂g kap chit-pò͘ ê sòaⁿ chit chòe-hé, ēng khi̍t-á tèng--teh, chiū ōe-tàng.”

Tāi-lī-la thàn Chham-sun teh khùn ê sî, chiong i ê thâu-mn̂g kap chit-pò͘ ê sòaⁿ chit chòe-hé, ēng khi̍t-á kò͘-tēng, jiân-āu hoah kóng, “ Chham-sun ah, Hui-lī-sū -lâng lâi beh lia̍h--lí!” Chham-sun chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, chiong khi̍t-á, chit-pò͘-ki ê so kap sòaⁿ, chòe-chi̍t-ē pu̍ih--chhut-lâi.
Tāi-lī-la kā i kóng, “Lí bô chin-chiàⁿ sìn-jīm góa, ná ōe-tàng kóng lí ài góa? Lí í-keng phiàn góa saⁿ piàn, bô kā góa kóng, lí ê khùi-la̍t tùi tó-ūi lâi.”
Tāi-lī-la ta̍k-ji̍t ēng ōe kā chhui kā pek, hō͘ i ê sim hoân kah beh sí.

Chham-sun chiū chiong sim-lāi ê pì-bi̍t lóng kā i kóng, “Góa ê thâu-mn̂g lóng m̄-bat ēng thì-thâu-to thì--kè, in-ūi góa tùi chhut-sì chiū hōng-hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè chòe Ná-sè-ní-lâng. Nā kā góa ê thâu-mn̂g thì--khí-lâi, góa ê khùi-la̍t chiū sit--khì, góa chiū bô la̍t, kap phó͘-thong-lâng siâng-khoán.”

Tāi-lī-la chai-iáⁿ Chham-sun chiong sim-lāi ê pì-bi̍t lóng kā i kóng, chiū chhe lâng khì kā Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê siú-léng kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lín koh lâi chi̍t piàn, in-ūi i í-keng chiong sim-lāi ê pì-bi̍t lóng kā góa kóng lah.” Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê siú-léng chiū tòa gûn khì Tāi-lī-la hia.
Tāi-lī-la hō͘ Chham-sun khùn tī i ê kha-thâu-u, kiò chi̍t ê lâng lâi kā Chham-sun chhit kó͘ ê thâu-mn̂g thì--khí-lâi. Án-ni, Tāi-lī-la hō͘ Chham-sun sit-khì khùi-la̍t.

Tāi-lī-la hoah kóng, “ Chham-sun ah, Hui-lī-sū -lâng lâi beh lia̍h--lí!” Chham-sun chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, siūⁿ-kóng, “Góa beh chhin-chhiūⁿ chêng hit kúi piàn ka-kī keng-khui.” M̄-kú, i m̄ chai Siōng Chú í-keng lī-khui i.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, ó͘ i ê ba̍k-chiu, tòa i khì Ka-sat, ēng tâng-liān kā i liān--teh, hō͘ i tī kaⁿ--ni̍h oe-bō.
Chóng-sī i ê thâu-mn̂g thì--khí-lâi liáu-āu, koh chiām-chiām tn̂g--khí-lâi.

Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê siú-léng chū-chi̍p, beh hiàn tōa chè-sū hō͘ in ê sîn-bêng Tāi-kún, hoaⁿ-hí khèng-chiok; in kóng, “Lán ê sîn-bêng í-keng chiong lán ê tùi-te̍k Chham-sun kau tī lán ê chhiú.”

Jîn-bîn khòaⁿ-tio̍h Chham-sun, chiū o-ló in ê sîn-bêng, kóng, “Lán ê tùi-te̍k húi-hoāi lán ê thó͘-tōe, thâi-sí chiok chōe lán ê lâng, taⁿ lán ê sîn-bêng í-keng chiong i kau tī lán ê chhiú.”

In hui-siông khoài-lo̍k ê sî, kóng, “Kiò Chham-sun chhut--lâi, hō͘ lán hì-lāng thit-thô.” In chiū kā Chham-sun tùi kaⁿ--ni̍h ah--chhut-lâi; i chiū hō͘ lâng hì-lāng; in hō͘ i khiā tī nn̄g ki thiāu ê tiong-kan.
Chham-sun kā khan i ê chhiú ê gín-á kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí hō͘ góa bong-tio̍h thìⁿ biō ê thiāu, hō͘ góa óa--in.”

Hit-sî biō-lāi lâm-lú khoeh kah móa-móa, Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê siú-léng mā lóng tī hia; tī biō-téng ê pîⁿ-tâi teh khòaⁿ Chham-sun hō͘ lâng hì-lāng ê lâm-lú, tāi-iok ū saⁿ-chheng lâng.

Chham-sun tùi Siōng Chú kiû-kiò, kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, kiû lí ōe-kì-tit góa. Siōng-tè ah, chit chi̍t piàn chiū hó, kiû lí sù góa khùi-la̍t, hō͘ góa ūi-tio̍h nn̄g lúi ba̍k-chiu tùi Hui-lī-sū -lâng pò-siû.”
Chham-sun chiū lám thìⁿ biō ê nn̄g ki tiong-thiāu, chiàⁿ-chhiú lám chi̍t ki, tò-chhiú lám chi̍t ki.

Chham-sun kóng, “Hō͘ góa kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng chòe-hé sí.” I khut-sin chhut tōa-la̍t, biō chiū tó, teh-sí hiah-ê siú-léng kap lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê lâng. Án-ni, Chham-sun chòe-āu thâi-sí ê lâng, pí oa̍h--teh ê sî thâi--sí-ê koh-khah chōe.

Chham-sun ê hiaⁿ-tī kap i lāu-pē ê chhin-cho̍k, lóng lo̍h-lâi siu i ê sin-si, kā i kng chiūⁿ-khì an-chòng tī Só-la kap Í-si̍t-tô ê tiong-kan, in lāu-pē Má-ná-a ê bōng. Chham-sun chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su jī-cha̍p nî.
Ū chi̍t ê lâng kiò-chòe Bí-ka, tòa tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu.

I tùi lāu-bú kóng, “Lí chi̍t-chheng chi̍t-pah tè gûn hō͘ lâng thau-the̍h--khì, lí kā hit-ê lâng chiù-chó͘, koh kóng hō͘ góa thiaⁿ. Lí khòaⁿ, hiah-ê gûn tī góa chia, sī góa the̍h--ê.” I ê lāu-bú kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú sù-hok góa ê kiáⁿ.”

I chiū chiong hit chheng-it tè gûn hêng i ê lāu-bú. Āu-lâi i ê lāu-bú kóng, “Góa beh chiong chiah-ê gûn hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, hō͘ góa ê kiáⁿ thang khek chi̍t sian sîn-siōng, koh chù chi̍t sian sîn-siōng. Taⁿ góa chiong chiah-ê gûn kau lí.”

Bí-ka koh chiong hiah-ê gûn hêng i ê lāu-bú. I ê lāu-bú chiū ēng nn̄g-pah tè gûn hō͘ phah-kim sai-hū, chō tiau-khek ê sîn-siōng kap chù ê sîn-siōng. Chiah-ê sîn-siōng hē tī Bí-ka ê chhù.
Bí-ka ū chi̍t keng sîn-biō, koh chō í-hut-tek kap ka-cho̍k sîn-siōng; i koh kā i chi̍t ê kiáⁿ siat-li̍p chòe chè-si.
Hit-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bô ông, ta̍k-ê lâng lóng chiàu i khòaⁿ-chòe tio̍h--ê khì chòe.
Iû-tāi ê Pek-lī-hêng ū chi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng; i sī Lī-bī -lâng, chiām-sî tòa tī Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k ê tōe-khu.
I lī-khui Iû-tāi ê Pek-lī-hêng -siâⁿ, beh chhē chi̍t ê thang khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi. I lâi kàu Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu Bí-ka ê chhù.
Bí-ka mn̄g i kóng, “Lí tùi tó-ūi lâi?” I ìn kóng, “Góa sī Lī-bī -lâng, tùi Iû-tāi ê Pek-lī-hêng lâi, beh chhē chi̍t ê thang khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.”

Bí-ka kā i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lâi kap góa tòa, chòe góa ê su-hū, chòe góa ê chè-si; góa ta̍k-nî hō͘ lí cha̍p tè gûn, chi̍t thò lé-ho̍k, kap chia̍h-mi̍h.” Lī-bī -lâng chiū ji̍p--khì.
Lī-bī -lâng tah-èng kap Bí-ka chòe-hé tòa. Bí-ka chiong chit-ê siàu-liân-lâng khòaⁿ-chòe ka-kī ê kiáⁿ.
Bí-ka kā Lī-bī -lâng siat-li̍p chòe chè-si, i chiū tòa tī Bí-ka ê chhù.
Bí-ka kóng, “Taⁿ góa chai Siōng Chú beh hó khoán-thāi góa, in-ūi góa ū chi̍t ê Lī-bī -lâng chòe chè-si.”

Hit-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bô ông; Tān chi-cho̍k teh chhē thó͘-tōe chòe khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, in-ūi kàu hit-ji̍t, in tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan, iáu-bē tit-tio̍h pun hō͘ in chòe sán-gia̍p ê thó͘-tōe.

Tān ê lâng tùi Só-la kap Í-si̍t-tô, chhe in pún-cho̍k gō͘ ê ióng-sū khì siông-sè cheng-thàm hit-ê tōe-khu, hoan-hù in, kóng, “Lín khì cheng-thàm hit-ê tōe-khu.” In lâi kàu Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu, ji̍p Bí-ka ê chhù, chiū tī hia hioh-mî.

In tī Bí-ka ê chhù hù-kūn jīn-tio̍h hit-ê siàu-liân Lī-bī -lâng ê kháu-im, chiū ji̍p-khì mn̄g i, “Siáⁿ-lâng chhōa lí lâi chia? Lí tī chia teh chòe sím-mi̍h? Lí tī chia ū tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h hó-chhù?”
I kóng, “ Bí-ka khoán-thāi góa án-ni, án-ni; i koh chhiàⁿ góa chòe i ê chè-si.”
In kā i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí mn̄g Siōng-tè, hō͘ goán chai, goán ê jīm-bū ōe sūn-lī ta̍t-sêng bōe?”
Chè-si kā in kóng, “Lín thang pêng-an khì; Siōng Chú ōe pang-chān lín oân-sêng jīm-bū.”

Hit gō͘ ê lâng chiū chhut-hoat, lâi kàu La-ek, khòaⁿ-tio̍h hia ê chū-bîn pêng-an khiā-khí, chhin-chhiūⁿ Se-tùn -lâng bô khiàm-kheh, bô siū lâng kiáu-jiáu; in lī-khui Se-tùn -lâng chin hn̄g, bô kap jīm-hô-lâng lâi-óng.
In tò-lâi kàu tī Só-la kap Í-si̍t-tô tiong-kan kâng chi-cho̍k ê lâng hia; hiah-ê lâng mn̄g in kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ-liáu án-chóaⁿ?”

In ìn kóng, “Lâi, lán kóaⁿ-kín lâi kong-kek in. Goán í-keng thàm-cha--kè; hit-ê só͘-chāi si̍t-chāi chin hó. Lín m̄-thang tiàm chia thèng-hāu, tio̍h sûi-sî lâi kong-chiàm hit-ê thó͘-tōe chòe lán ê sán-gia̍p.
Lín kàu hia, chiū ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h an-jiân khiā-khí ê jîn-bîn, thó͘-tōe khui-khoah, bu̍t-sán koh hong-hù; Siōng-tè í-keng chiong hit-ê só͘-chāi kau tī lán ê chhiú.”
Tùi án-ni, Tān chi-cho̍k la̍k-pah ê lâng tòa kun-khì, tùi Só-la kap Í-si̍t-tô chhut-hoat.
In tī Iû-tāi ê Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm sai-pêng chat-iâⁿ; só͘-í hit-ê só͘-chāi kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu kiò-chòe Má-hap-nî Tān.
In tùi hia keng-kè Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu lâi kàu Bí-ka in tau.

Hit gō͘ ê khì cheng-thàm La-ek tōe-khu ê lâng, kā in kâng chi-cho̍k ê lâng kóng, “Lín kiám chai chiah-ê chhù lāi-bīn ū í-hut-tek, ka-cho̍k sîn-siōng, tiau-khek ê sîn-siōng, kap chù ê sîn-siōng? Taⁿ lín tio̍h phah-sǹg, khòaⁿ beh án-chóaⁿ chòe.”
In chiū oat-khì Bí-ka ê chhù, ji̍p-khì hit-ê siàu-liân ê Lī-bī -lâng ê chhù-lāi, kā i chhéng-an.
Tān chi-cho̍k hit la̍k-pah ê tòa kun-khì ê lâng lóng khiā tī mn̂g-kháu.

Cheng-thàm hit-ê tōe ê gō͘ ê lâng ji̍p--khì, chiong tiau-khek ê sîn-siōng, í-hut-tek, ka-cho̍k sîn-siōng, kap chù ê sîn-siōng lóng the̍h--khì; chè-si kap tòa kun-khì hit la̍k-pah ê lâng chòe-hé khiā tī mn̂g-kháu.
Hit gō͘ ê lâng ji̍p-khì Bí-ka ê chhù, the̍h tiau-khek ê sîn-siōng, í-hut-tek, ka-cho̍k sîn-siōng, kap chù ê sîn-siōng ê sî, chè-si mn̄g in kóng, “Lín teh chhòng siáⁿ?”

In kā i kóng, “Tiām-tiām, m̄-thang kóng-ōe, tè goán lâi-khì, chòe goán ê su-hū, goán ê chè-si. Lí chòe chi̍t ê ka-cho̍k ê chè-si khah hó, á-sī chòe Í-sek-lia̍t chi̍t ê chi-cho̍k chi̍t ê chong-cho̍k ê chè-si khah hó?”
Chè-si chin hoaⁿ-hí, chiū the̍h í-hut-tek, ka-cho̍k sîn-siōng, kap tiau-khek ê sîn-siōng, kap hiah-ê lâng chòe-hé khì.
In chiū chhut-hoat lī-khui hia, hō͘ gín-á, cheng-siⁿ, châi-bu̍t chòe thâu-chêng.
Lī-khui Bí-ka ê chhù í-keng chin hn̄g, Bí-ka chū-chi̍p i ê chhù-piⁿ, tui-jip Tān ê lâng.
In tōa-siaⁿ hoah Tān ê lâng. Tān ê lâng oa̍t-thâu, mn̄g Bí-ka kóng, “Lí chū-chi̍p chiah-ê lâng beh chhòng sím-mi̍h?”
I kóng, “Góa chō ê sîn-bêng, chhiàⁿ ê chè-si, lín lóng kā góa tòa-tòa--khì, góa iáu chhun sím-mi̍h? Lín ná iáu-teh mn̄g góa kóng ‘Lí beh chhòng sím-mi̍h’?”
Tān ê lâng kā Bí-ka kóng, “Lí kā góa tiām--khì, chiah bián pháiⁿ sèng-tē ê lâng kā lí kong-kek, lí kap lín choân-ke lóng ōe bô-miā.”
Tān ê lâng chiū chòe in khì. Bí-ka khòaⁿ-tio̍h in pí i khah kiông, chiū oa̍t-tńg-sin tò-khì in tau.
Tān ê lâng tòa Bí-ka chō ê sîn-siōng kap i ê chè-si lâi kàu La-ek, ēng to thâi-sí hiah-ê pêng-an khiā-khí ê chū-bîn, koh pàng-hé sio chit-ê siâⁿ.
Chit-ê siâⁿ tī Pek Lī-ha̍p Soaⁿ-kok hù-kūn, lī Se-tùn chin hn̄g, koh bô kap jīm-hô-lâng lâi-óng, só͘-í bô lâng lâi kā in kái-kiù.

Tān ê lâng chiū tiông-kiàn chit-ê siâⁿ, tī hia khiā-khí. In kā chit-ê siâⁿ hō-miâ kiò-chòe Tān, sī ēng in ê chó͘-sian Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ Tān ê miâ hō--ê; chit-ê siâⁿ khah-chá ê miâ sī La-ek.

Tān ê lâng chiū tī hia ūi ka-kī chhāi hit-ê tiau-khek ê sîn-siōng. Mô͘-se ê sun, Kek-sūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan, kap i ê hō͘-tāi, chòe Tān chi-cho̍k ê chè-si, it-ti̍t kàu Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siū-lia̍h hit-ji̍t.
Siōng-tè ê hōe-bō͘ tī Sī-lô hit-tōaⁿ kî-kan, Tān ê lâng mā ūi ka-kī chhāi Bí-ka tiau-khek ê sîn-siōng.
Í-sek-lia̍t bô ông ê sî, ū chi̍t ê Lī-bī -lâng tòa tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu phian-phiah ê só͘-chāi. I chhōa chi̍t ê Iû-tāi Pek-lī-hêng ê lú-chú chòe sòe-î.
Chit-ê sòe-î siū-khì i ê tiōng-hu, chiū lī-khui tiōng-hu, tò-khì āu-thâu-chhù, tī hia tòa sì ge̍h-ji̍t kú.

I ê tiōng-hu tòa chi̍t ê lô͘-po̍k kap nn̄g chiah lû chhut-hoat khì chhē i, beh kā i ko͘-chiâⁿ, chhōa i tò--khì. I ê tiōng-hu kàu-ūi, i chiū chhōa i ê tiōng-hu ji̍p-khì lāu-pē ê chhù. Lī-bī -lâng ê tiūⁿ-lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū hoan-gêng i.
Hit-ê tiūⁿ-lâng kā i lâu--lo̍h-lâi; i chiū tī hia tòa saⁿ ji̍t, chòe-hé lim-chia̍h.
Kàu tē-sì ji̍t, in thàu-chá khí--lâi, Lī-bī -lâng beh chhut-hoat; hit-ê tiūⁿ-lâng kā kiáⁿ-sài kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí chia̍h chi̍t-kóa mi̍h-kiāⁿ, ke-thiⁿ khùi-la̍t, chiah chhut-hoat.”
Nn̄g ê lâng chiū chē--lo̍h-lâi, chòe-hé lim-chia̍h. Hit-ê tiūⁿ-lâng tùi i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí koh tòa chi̍t mî, koh pàng-sang--chi̍t-ē.”
Hit-ê lâng khí-lâi beh chhut-hoat, i ê tiūⁿ-lâng koh kiông-kiông lâu i; i chiū koh hioh chi̍t mî.

Kàu tē-gō͘ ji̍t, Lī-bī -lâng thàu-chá khí--lâi beh chhut-hoat, tiūⁿ-lâng kā i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ koh chia̍h chi̍t-kóa mi̍h-kiāⁿ, ke-thiⁿ khùi-la̍t, thèng-hāu kàu ji̍t beh lo̍h-soaⁿ.” I chiū lâu--lo̍h-lâi kap tiūⁿ-lâng chòe-hé chia̍h.

Hit-ê lâng kap i ê sòe-î, í-ki̍p lô͘-po̍k khí--lâi beh chhut-hoat; i ê tiūⁿ-lâng kā i kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, ji̍t beh àm ah, chhiáⁿ lí koh hioh chi̍t mî; ji̍t beh lo̍h lah, lí tio̍h hioh chia koh pàng-sang--chi̍t-ē; bîn-á-chài thàu-chá chiah khí-sin tò-khì lín tau.”
Hit-ê lâng m̄-ài koh hioh chi̍t mî, chiū chhōa i ê sòe-î kap nn̄g chiah chún-pī hó-sè ê lû chhut-hoat, lâi kàu Iâ-pò͘-su ê tùi-bīn; Iâ-pò͘-su chiū-sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
In kiâⁿ kūn Iâ-pò͘-su ê sî, ji̍t í-keng beh lo̍h-soaⁿ; lô͘-po̍k tùi chú-lâng kóng, “Lán oat ji̍p-khì Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng ê siâⁿ, tiàm hia hioh-mî hó--bô?”
I ê chú-lâng kóng, “Lán bô beh oat ji̍p-khì m̄-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng teh tòa ê gōa-pang-lâng ê siâⁿ; lán kè-lâi Ki-pí-a.”
I koh kā lô͘-po̍k kóng, “Lâi, lán khòaⁿ sī beh khì Ki-pí-a, á-sī La-má kè-mî.”
In chiū kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ; beh kàu Piān-ngá-bín ê Ki-pí-a ê sî, ji̍t-thâu í-keng lo̍h-soaⁿ.
In chiū oat--ji̍p-khì, beh tī Ki-pí-a hioh-mî. In ji̍p-siâⁿ, chē tī kóng-tiûⁿ, in-ūi bô lâng chiap-thāi in ji̍p-khì chhù--ni̍h hioh-mî.
Ji̍t àm, ū chi̍t ê lāu-lâng tùi iá-gōa chòe kang tò--lâi. I sī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ê lâng, tòa tī Ki-pí-a; Ki-pí-a sī Piān-ngá-bín -lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi.
Hit-ê lāu-lâng gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū chhut-gōa-lâng tī siâⁿ-lāi ê kóng-tiûⁿ, chiū mn̄g i kóng, “Lí tùi tó-ūi lâi, beh khì tó-ūi?”

I ìn kóng, “Goán tùi Iû-tāi ê Pek-lī-hêng lâi, beh khì Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu phian-phiah ê só͘-chāi; góa sī hia ê lâng, khì Iû-tāi ê Pek-lī-hêng, hiān-chāi beh tńg-khì goán tau; m̄-kú tī chia bô lâng chiap-thāi góa khì in tau.
Góa ū chháu-liāu hō͘ lû, mā ū piáⁿ kap chiú hō͘ góa, kap góa ê sòe-î, í-ki̍p sū-hāu góa ê siàu-liân-lâng, lóng bô khiàm sím-mi̍h.”
Lāu-lâng kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí hòng-sim! Lín khiàm-ēng--ê góa lóng ōe siat-hoat. Chhian-bān m̄-thang tiàm kóng-tiûⁿ kè-mî.”
I chiū chhōa in khì i ê chhù, chhī in ê lû; in chiū sóe-kha lim-chia̍h.

In tú-teh hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k ê sî, siâⁿ-lāi hiah-ê húi-lūi lâi ûi hit-keng chhù, ti̍t-ti̍t phah-mn̂g, tùi chhù-chú, hit-ê lāu-lâng, kóng, “Kā ji̍p-khì lín tau hit-ê ta-po͘-lâng chhōa--chhut-lâi, goán beh kap i kau-ha̍p.”

Hit-ê chhù-chú chhut--lâi, tùi in kóng, “Pêng-iú ah, mài án-ni lah, m̄-thang chòe chit-khoán pháiⁿ tāi-chì. Chit-ê lâng sī góa ê lâng-kheh, lín m̄-thang chòe chit-khoán kiàn-siàu-sū.

Góa ū chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, iáu-sī chāi-sek-lú, koh ū hit-ê lâng ê sòe-î; góa chhōa in chhut--lâi, lín thang kā in lêng-jio̍k, chhut-chāi lín ê ì-sù tùi-thāi in. M̄-kú, tùi chit-ê lâng lín m̄-thang chòe chit-khoán kiàn-siàu-sū.”

M̄-kú hiah-ê lâng m̄ thiaⁿ hit-ê lāu-lâng ê ōe; hit-ê Lī-bī -lâng chiū lia̍h i ê sòe-î kā i sak chhut-khì gōa-bīn hō͘ in. In chiū kā i kiông-kan, thong-mî lêng-jio̍k i, kàu keh-ji̍t thiⁿ beh kng ê sî, chiah pàng i khì.
Thiⁿ phú-kng ê sî, hū-jîn-lâng lâi kàu i ê tiōng-hu hioh-mî hit-keng chhù ê mn̂g-kháu, tó tī hia, ti̍t-kàu thiⁿ-kng.
I ê tiōng-hu thàu-chá khí--lâi, khui-mn̂g, beh chhut-hoat tò-khì in tau, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ê sòe-î tó tī mn̂g-kháu, nn̄g ki chhiú khòa tī hō͘-tēng.
I tùi i ê sòe-î kóng, “Khí--lâi, lán tńg--lâi-khì.” M̄-kú i bô hôe-èng, Lī-bī -lâng kā i hû-khí-khì lû-á téng, chiū chhut-hoat tò-khì in tau.
Tńg-khì kàu in chhù, i chiū the̍h to chiong i ê sòe-î chhiat-chòe cha̍p-jī tè, chhe lâng sàng-khì thong Í-sek-lia̍t ê choân-kéng.

Só͘-ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng lóng kóng, “Tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p kàu kin-á-ji̍t, chit-khoán tāi-chì iáu m̄-bat hoat-seng, mā m̄-bat khòaⁿ--kè. Taⁿ, lán tio̍h siūⁿ, tio̍h chham-siông, tio̍h koat-tēng beh án-chóaⁿ chòe.”

Tùi án-ni, só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tùi Tān kàu Pia̍t-sī-pa, kap tòa tī Ki-lia̍t ê lâng, lóng khiā--chhut-lâi, thoân-kiat it-tì, chū-chi̍p tī Bí-su-pa, Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.
Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k ê léng-siù lóng lâi khiā tī Siōng-tè chú-bîn ê hōe-tiong; gia̍h-to ê pō͘-peng ū sì-cha̍p-bān lâng.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng lâi tī Bí-su-pa. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng mn̄g, kóng, “Kā goán kóng, chit-ê pháiⁿ tāi-chì án-chóaⁿ hoat-seng--ê?”
Hit-ê Lī-bī -lâng, chiū-sī siū hāi-sí ê hū-jîn-lâng ê tiōng-hu, ìn kóng, “Góa kap góa ê sòe-î kàu Piān-ngá-bín ê Ki-pí-a hioh-mî.
Ki-pí-a -lâng khí-lâi kong-kek góa, mî--sî pau-ûi góa hioh-mî ê chhù, siūⁿ-beh hāi-sí góa; in koh kā góa ê sòe-î kiông-kan kàu sí.

Góa chiū chiong góa ê sòe-î chhiat-chòe chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè, chhiáⁿ lâng the̍h-khì Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khiā-khí ê só͘-ū tōe-khu; in-ūi Ki-pí-a -lâng tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan chòe îm-loān kap kiàn-siàu-sū.
Lín só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tio̍h chham-siông, chòe koat-tēng.”
Só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn lóng khí--lâi, thoân-kiat it-tì, kóng, “Goán bô chi̍t ê lâng ōe tńg-khì i ê pò͘-pîⁿ, mā bô chi̍t ê ōe tò-khì i ê chhù.
Taⁿ, goán tùi Ki-pí-a -lâng beh án-ni chhú-lí: Goán chiàu thiu ê chhiam khì kong-kek in.

Goán beh tī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k ê tiong-kan, chi̍t-pah lâng soán cha̍p lâng, chi̍t-chheng soán chi̍t-pah, chi̍t-bān soán chi̍t-chheng, kā kun-peng sàng niû-si̍t, hō͘ kun-peng kàu Piān-ngá-bín ê Ki-pí-a, chiàu Ki-pí-a -lâng tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū kā in pò-ho̍k.”
Tùi án-ni, só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thoân-kiat it-tì, kong-kek hit-ê siâⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t só͘-ū ê chi-cho̍k phài lâng khì Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k khiā-khí ê ta̍k só͘-chāi, kóng, “Lín chòe ê tāi-chì si̍t-chāi ū-kàu khó-ò͘ⁿ!

Taⁿ lín tio̍h chiong Ki-pí-a hiah-ê húi-lūi kau--chhut-lâi, goán beh hō͘ in sí, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan sàu-tû chit-ê siâ-ok.” M̄-kú Piān-ngá-bín -lâng m̄-khéng thiaⁿ in ê tông-pau Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê ōe.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng lóng tùi in ka-kī ê siâⁿ chhut--lâi, lâi Ki-pí-a chi̍p-ha̍p, beh kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng tùi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ tiàu-chi̍p nn̄g-bān la̍k-chheng ê gia̍h-to ê peng-sū, lēng-gōa iáu ū Ki-pí-a -lâng tiàu-chi̍p chhit-pah ê cheng-peng.
Choân-pō͘ ê kun-tūi tiong-kan ū chhit-pah ê te̍k-soán ê cheng-peng; in koàn-sì ēng tò-chhiú, ta̍k-ê ōe ēng soh hìⁿ chio̍h, chin chún, hun-hô-put-chha.
Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k, Piān-ngá-bín -lâng í-gōa, só͘ tiàu-chi̍p gia̍h-to ê chiàn-sū, chóng-kiōng sì-cha̍p-bān.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū khí--lâi, khì Pek-te̍k-lī kiû-mn̄g Siōng-tè kóng, “Goán tiong-kan tó chi̍t ê chi-cho̍k tio̍h seng khì kong-táⁿ Piān-ngá-bín -lâng?” Siōng Chú kóng, “ Iû-tāi seng khì.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thàu-chá khí--lâi, tī Ki-pí-a tùi-bīn chat-iâⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut--lâi, tī Ki-pí-a pâi-tīn beh kap Piān-ngá-bín -lâng kau-chiàn.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng mā tùi Ki-pí-a chhut--lâi; hit-ji̍t, thâi-sí Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng nn̄g-bān nn̄g-chheng.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khì kàu Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, thî-khàu kàu àm-sî, chhéng-būn Siōng Chú kóng, “Goán kiám tio̍h koh chìn-chêng kap goán ê tông-pau Piān-ngá-bín -lâng kau-chiàn?” Siōng Chú kóng, “Tio̍h chìn-chêng kong-kek.” Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū the̍h-chhut ióng-khì, iû-goân tī thâu chi̍t ji̍t pâi-tīn ê só͘-chāi koh pâi-tīn.
Tē-jī ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng koh chìn-chêng khì kong-kek Piān-ngá-bín -lâng.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng mā tī hit-ji̍t tùi Ki-pí-a chhut-lâi gêng-chiàn, koh thâi-sí Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chi̍t-bān poeh-chheng ê gia̍h-to ê chiàn-sū.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiū-sī só͘-ū ê kun-peng, lóng chiūⁿ-khì Pek-te̍k-lī, chē tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng thî-khàu. Hit-ji̍t, in kìm-chia̍h kàu ji̍t àm, koh tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè.

Hit-sî, Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi tī Pek-te̍k-lī. A-lûn ê sun, Í-lī-a-sat ê kiáⁿ Hui-nî-hap tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng ho̍k-sāi. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhéng-būn Siōng Chú, kóng, “Goán tio̍h koh khì kap goán ê tông-pau Piān-ngá-bín -lâng kau-chiàn, á-sī tio̍h soah?” Siōng Chú kóng, “Tio̍h khì, bîn-á-chài góa beh chiong in kau tī lín ê chhiú.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū phài peng tī Ki-pí-a ê sì-ûi bâi-ho̍k.
Tē-saⁿ ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng koh khì kong-kek Piān-ngá-bín -lâng, kap chêng nn̄g piàn siâng-khoán, tī Ki-pí-a pâi-tīn.

Piān-ngá-bín -lâng chhut-khì gêng-chiàn, siū ín-iú lī-khui siâⁿ. In tī nn̄g tiâu tōa-lō͘, chi̍t tiâu thàng Pek-te̍k-lī, chi̍t tiâu thàng Ki-pí-a ê iá-gōa, chhin-chhiūⁿ chêng nn̄g piàn, thâi-sí Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng iok-lio̍k saⁿ-cha̍p ê.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng kóng, “In ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng án-ni hō͘ lán phah-pāi.” M̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Lán lâi cháu, ín-iú in lī-khui siâⁿ kàu tōa-lō͘.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chú-le̍k-kun lâi Pa-le̍k Tha-má têng-sin pâi-tīn; Í-sek-lia̍t bâi-ho̍k ê peng-sū tùi Ki-pí-a ê sai-pêng chhiong--chhut-lâi.
Choân-pō͘ ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ū chi̍t-bān ê cheng-peng, chìn-chêng kong-kek Ki-pí-a; kau-chiàn ê sè-bīn chin béng-lia̍t, m̄-kú Piān-ngá-bín -lâng m̄ chai chai-hō kàu ah.
Siōng Chú hō͘ Piān-ngá-bín -lâng thâi-su; hit-ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thâi-sí nn̄g-bān gō͘-chheng chi̍t-pah ê Piān-ngá-bín gia̍h-to ê peng-sū.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng chai in í-keng thâi-su. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thiat-thè, sī in-ūi in sìn-jīm phài tī Ki-pí-a sì-ûi bâi-ho̍k ê chiàn-sū.
Bâi-ho̍k ê peng chin kín chhiong-ji̍p Ki-pí-a, ēng to thâi-sí choân-siâⁿ ê lâng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chú-le̍k-kun kap bâi-ho̍k ê peng ū iok-tēng chi̍t ê sìn-hō, khòaⁿ-tio̍h siâⁿ-lāi chhèng hé-hun ê sî,
in tio̍h oa̍t-tńg-sin hoán-kong. Tāi-seng, Piān-ngá-bín -lâng ū thâi-sí tāi-iok saⁿ-cha̍p ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiū kóng, “In ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng án-ni hō͘ lán phah-pāi.”
Ian-thiāu tùi siâⁿ-lāi chhèng koân ê sî, Piān-ngá-bín -lâng oa̍t-thâu khòaⁿ-tio̍h choân-siâⁿ ê hé-hun tú-thiⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng koh oa̍t-tńg-sin hoán-kong, Piān-ngá-bín -lâng chiū kiaⁿ kah gāng--khì, in-ūi chai chai-hō kàu lah.

In tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bīn-chêng oa̍t-tńg-sin ǹg khòng-iá ê lō͘ tô-cháu; m̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tui-jip in chin óa, in chiū hō͘ chú-le̍k-kun kap tùi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ chhut--lâi ê peng pau-ûi, siau-bia̍t.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pau-ûi Piān-ngá-bín -lâng, tui-jip in, kàu Ki-pí-a ê tang-pêng, chi̍t-lō͘ kā in tui-sat.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng sí chi̍t-bān poeh-chheng ê ióng-sū.
Kî-tha ê lâng oa̍t-tńg-sin ǹg khòng-iá tô-cháu, kàu Lîm-bûn-giâm. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng iân-lō͘ thâi-sí in gō͘-chheng lâng; tui-jip in kàu Ki-tùn, koh thâi-sí nn̄g-chheng lâng.
Hit-ji̍t, Piān-ngá-bín -lâng lóng-chóng sí nn̄g-bān gō͘-chheng ê gia̍h-to ê chiàn-sū.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng iáu chhun la̍k-pah ê chiàn-sū, in tô-cháu khì khòng-iá, tī Lîm-bûn-giâm bih sì kò-ge̍h.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng koh oa̍t-tńg kong-kek Piān-ngá-bín -lâng, ēng to thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi ê chū-bîn, cheng-siⁿ, kap só͘-ū tú--tio̍h ê lâng; in koh chi̍t-lō͘ pàng-hé sio hù-kūn ê siâⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Bí-su-pa bat chiù-chōa kóng, “Goán bô beh chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ Piān-ngá-bín -lâng chòe bó͘.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lâi kàu Pek-te̍k-lī, chē tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu kàu ē-hng,
kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, kin-á-ji̍t tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong-kan kiám chi̍t chi-cho̍k; goán Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ná ōe tú-tio̍h chit-khoán tāi-chì?”
Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, jîn-bîn khí--lâi, tī hia khí chi̍t chō tôaⁿ, hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Tī Í-sek-lia̍t chi-cho̍k tiong, siáⁿ-lâng bô chòe-hé lâi Siōng Chú chia chū-chi̍p?” In-ūi in chiù tāng-chōa, kóng, “Bô lâi Bí-su-pa Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng ê lâng, tio̍h hō͘ i sí.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ūi-tio̍h in ê tông-pau Piān-ngá-bín -lâng sim kan-khó͘, kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t Í-sek-lia̍t tiong toān-choa̍t chi̍t ê chi-cho̍k lah.
Lán í-keng kí Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, bô beh chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ in, taⁿ lán beh tùi tó-ūi ūi-tio̍h in só͘ chhun ê lâng chhē bó͘?”
In koh kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t chiah-ê chi-cho̍k tiong-kan, siáⁿ-lâng bô chiūⁿ-lâi Bí-su-pa Siōng Chú chia?” In chiū chhâ-chhut Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí -lâng bô chi̍t ê lâng lâi.
In-ūi in tiám-sǹg ê sî, bô chi̍t ê Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí -lâng tī hia.
Hōe-chiòng chiū chhe chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng ê ióng-sū, hoan-hù in kóng, “Lín khì Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí, ēng to thâi-sí só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng, hū-jîn-lâng, kap gín-á.
Lín tio̍h án-ni chòe: Tio̍h chiong só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng, kap kiat-hun--kè ê cha-bó͘-lâng lóng thâi-sí.”
In tī Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí -lâng tiong-kan tú-tio̍h sì-pah ê iáu-bē kiat-hun ê chāi-sek-lú, chiū kā in tòa kàu Ka-lâm -tōe Sī-lô ê kun-iâⁿ.
Choân-thé hōe-chiòng chiū phài lâng khì kap Lîm-bûn-giâm ê Piān-ngá-bín -lâng kóng-hô.
Hit-sî, Piān-ngá-bín -lâng tò--lâi; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū chiong só͘ lâu--lo̍h-lâi hiah-ê Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí -lâng ê cha-bó͘ gín-á hō͘ in chòe bó͘; m̄-kú iáu bô-kàu.
Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ūi-tio̍h Piān-ngá-bín -lâng sim kan-khó͘; in-ūi Siōng Chú hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê chi-cho̍k khih chi̍t kak.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló kóng, “ Piān-ngá-bín ê hū-lú kì-jiân í-keng siū châu-bia̍t, taⁿ lán beh án-chóaⁿ chhē bó͘ hō͘ hiah-ê oa̍h--teh ê lâng?”
Koh kóng, “ Piān-ngá-bín só͘ chhun ê lâng mā tio̍h ū ke-gia̍p hō͘ in, chiah bián Í-sek-lia̍t tiong chi̍t chi-cho̍k siū tû-bia̍t.

M̄-kú lán bōe-ēng-tit chiong ka-kī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō͘ in chòe bó͘, in-ūi lán Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ū chiù-chōa kóng, ‘Chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ Piān-ngá-bín -lâng--ê, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘.’”

In koh kóng, “ Sī-lô ta̍k-nî ū kú-hêng kèng-pài Siōng Chú ê choeh-kî.” Sī-lô sī tī Lī-pho-ná ê lâm-pêng, Pek-te̍k-lī ê pak-pêng, chiū-sī Pek-te̍k-lī ǹg Sī-kiàm ê tōa-lō͘ ê tang-pêng.
In chiū kà Piān-ngá-bín -lâng, kóng, “Lín tio̍h khì Sī-lô, bih tiàm phû-tô-hn̂g;

nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h in ê cha-bó͘ gín-á chhut-lâi thiàu-bú, tio̍h tùi phû-tô-hn̂g chhut--lâi, ta̍k-ê lâng chhiúⁿ chi̍t ê Sī-lô ê lú-chú chòe bó͘, chiah tò-khì Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu.

In ê lāu-pē á-sī hiaⁿ-tī nā lâi kā goán khòng-gī, goán ōe kā in kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ lín tài-liām goán, khoan-iông in; in-ūi kau-chiàn ê sî, goán bô lâu cha-bó͘ gín-á hō͘ in chòe bó͘. Taⁿ, m̄-sī lín chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō͘ in; nā sī, lín chiū ū chōe.’”
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng chiū chiàu án-ni chòe, chiàu in ê lâng-gia̍h, chhiúⁿ thiàu-bú ê cha-bó͘ gín-á choh-bó͘; jiân-āu tò-khì in pún-tōe, tiông-kiàn siâⁿ-tìn, tòa tī hia.
Siâng-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui hia, ta̍k-ê lâng tò-khì ka-kī ê chi-cho̍k, chong-cho̍k; ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tùi hia lī-khui, tò-khì in pún-tōe.
Hit-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bô ông, ta̍k-ê lâng lóng chiàu i khòaⁿ-chòe tio̍h--ê khì chòe.
Sū-su tī-lí Í-sek-lia̍t ê sî-tāi, Iû-tāi -tōe hoat-seng ki-hng. Ū chi̍t ê lâng chhōa i ê bó͘ kap nn̄g ê kiáⁿ tùi Iû-tāi ê Pek-lī-hêng poaⁿ-khì Mô͘-ap.

Chit-ê lâng miâ kiò-chòe Í-lī-bí-le̍k, i ê bó͘ miâ kiò-chòe Ná-o-bí, nn̄g ê kiáⁿ miâ kiò-chòe Má-lûn kap Ki-liân; in sī Iû-tāi ê Pek-lī-hêng chhut-sin ê Í-hoat-tha -lâng. In kàu Mô͘-ap -tōe chiū tòa tī hia.
Ná-o-bí ê tiōng-hu Í-lī-bí-le̍k sí--khì, pàng i kap nn̄g ê kiáⁿ.
Hit nn̄g ê kiáⁿ chhōa Mô͘-ap lú-chú chòe bó͘, chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Ngô͘-ní-pa, lēng-gōa chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Lō͘-tek. In tòa tī hia iok cha̍p nî kú liáu-āu,
Má-lûn kap Ki-liân nn̄g ê lâng mā sí--khì, chhun Ná-o-bí ka-kī chi̍t ê lâng, bô ang mā bô kiáⁿ thang khò.
Ná-o-bí iáu tī Mô͘-ap ê sî, thiaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú koàn-kò͘ I ê chú-bîn, hō͘ in hó siu-sêng, chiū kap i ê sin-pū lī-khui Mô͘-ap -tōe beh tò-khì Pek-lī-hêng.
I chiū tùi i tòa ê só͘-chāi chhut-hoat, beh tò-khì Iû-tāi -tōe, nn̄g ê sin-pū tè i khì.

Tī lō͘-tiong Ná-o-bí tùi nn̄g ê sin-pū kóng, “Lín tńg-khì ka-kī ê gōa-ke. Goān Siōng Chú si-un hō͘ lín, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ū hó khoán-thāi sí--khì ê lâng kap góa siâng-khoán.
Goān Siōng Chú sù-hok lín, hō͘ lín nn̄g ê chhē-tio̍h sin ê tùi-siōng, ū hó ê kui-sio̍k.” I chiū kā in chim, kap in saⁿ-sî; in tōa-siaⁿ háu,
tùi i kóng, “Goán it-tēng beh kap lí tńg-khì lín ê lâng hia.”
Ná-o-bí kóng, “Cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h tńg--khì! Sī-án-chóaⁿ beh tè góa? Góa kiám ōe koh siⁿ-kiáⁿ hō͘ lín chòe ang?
Cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h tńg--khì, khì lah. Góa í-keng lāu, bōe-tàng koh kè-ang; góa nā iáu ū ǹg-bāng, kim-mî ū tiōng-hu, koh siⁿ-kiáⁿ,
lín kiám ōe-tàng tán in tōa-hàn, bô khì kè pa̍t-lâng? Cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ah, mài lah, góa pí lín khah pháiⁿ-miā, in-ūi Siōng Chú chhun-chhiú kong-kek góa.”
In koh tōa-siaⁿ háu. Ngô͘-ní-pa chiū kā i ê ta-ke chim, kap i saⁿ-sî. M̄-kú Lō͘-tek pàng bōe lī ta-ke.
Ná-o-bí chiū kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, lín a-só í-keng tńg-khì in ê chhin-cho̍k kap in ê sîn-bêng hia, lí mā thang tè i tńg--khì.”

Lō͘-tek ìn kóng, “M̄-thang pek góa pàng-sak lí, lī-khui lí tò--khì. Lí khì tó-ūi, góa mā beh khì; lí tòa tó-ūi, góa mā beh tòa hia. Lí ê chhin-cho̍k chiū-sī góa ê chhin-cho̍k; lí ê Siōng-tè chiū-sī góa ê Siōng-tè.
Lí sí tī tó-ūi, góa mā beh sí tī hia, chòng tī hia. Chí-ū sí ōe hō͘ lí kap góa pun-khui, nā bô, goān Siōng Chú ka-pē chek-hoa̍t góa.”
Ná-o-bí khòaⁿ Lō͘-tek kian-koat beh tè i, chiū bô koh kóng sím-mi̍h.
In nn̄g lâng chiū kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ, lâi kàu Pek-lī-hêng. Kàu Pek-lī-hêng ê sî, choân-siâⁿ ūi-tio̍h in jiáu-tōng. Chèng hū-lú kóng, “Chit-ê lâng kiám chin-chiàⁿ sī Ná-o-bí?”
I kā in kóng, “M̄-thang kiò góa Ná-o-bí, tio̍h kiò góa Má-la, in-ūi Choân-lêng-chiá hō͘ góa siū tōa khó͘-lān.
Góa móa-móa chhut--khì, Siōng Chú hō͘ góa khang-khang tò--lâi. Sī-án-chóaⁿ kiò góa Ná-o-bí? Siōng Chú khó͘-chhó͘ góa, Choân-lêng-chiá hō͘ góa siū hoān-lān.”
Che chiū-sī Ná-o-bí kap i ê Mô͘-ap sin-pū Lō͘-tek tùi Mô͘-ap -tōe tńg--lâi ê keng-kè. In tī khai-sí siu-koah tōa-be̍h ê sî lâi kàu Pek-lī-hêng.
Ná-o-bí ū chi̍t ê chhin-chiâⁿ, miâ kiò-chòe Pho-a-su, sī tōa châi-chú, sī i ê tiōng-hu Í-lī-bí-le̍k ê chhin-cho̍k.

Mô͘-ap ê lú-chú Lō͘-tek tùi Ná-o-bí kóng, “Góa siūⁿ-beh khì hn̂g--ni̍h, thang tè tī tùi góa chhin-chhiat ê lâng āu-bīn khioh be̍h-sūi.” Ná-o-bí chiū tùi i kóng, “Cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ah, chòe lí khì.”
I chiū khì hn̂g--ni̍h, tè tī siu-koah ê lâng āu-bīn khioh be̍h-sūi. Chin tú-hó, chit-khu hn̂g sī Í-lī-bí-le̍k ê chhin-cho̍k Pho-a-su ê.
Tú hit-sî, Pho-a-su tùi Pek-lī-hêng lâi, i tùi siu-koah ê lâng kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú kap lín tông-chāi!” In chiū ìn i kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú sù-hok lí!”
Pho-a-su mn̄g siu-koah ê kang-thâu kóng, “Chit-ê siàu-liân cha-bó͘ gín-á sī sím-mi̍h-lâng in tau--ê?”
Siu-koah ê kang-thâu ìn kóng, “Chit-ê Mô͘-ap ê lú-chú sī tè Ná-o-bí tùi Mô͘-ap -tōe tńg--lâi-ê.
I ū kóng, ‘Chún góa tī siu-koah ê lâng āu-bīn khioh lak--lo̍h-lâi ê be̍h-sūi.’ I tùi chá-khí bô-êng kàu taⁿ, tú-á chiah tī liâu-á hioh-khùn chi̍t-sî-á nā-tiāⁿ.”
Pho-a-su chiū tùi Lō͘-tek kóng, “Cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ah, góa kā lí kóng, m̄-thang khì pa̍t-lâng ê hn̂g khioh, mā m̄-thang lī-khui chia, tio̍h tè góa ê lú-kang tè hō͘ tiâu.

Khòaⁿ kang-lâng tī tó chi̍t khu hn̂g teh siu-koah, tio̍h tè tī lú-kang āu-bīn khioh. Góa í-keng hoan-hù kang-lâng bōe-ēng-tit kā lí chhòng-tī. Lí chhùi-ta ê sî, khì chúi-tháng hia lim kang-lâng chhiūⁿ--lâi ê chúi.”
Lō͘-tek chiū phak--lo̍h-khì, kūi tī thô͘-kha, tùi i kóng, “Lí ná ōe tùi góa chiah-ni̍h hó, chiah-ni̍h koan-sim góa chit-ê gōa-kok-lâng?”

Pho-a-su ìn i kóng, “Lí ê tiōng-hu sí liáu-āu, lí tùi ta-ke só͘ chòe ê it-chhè, lâng lóng kā góa kóng lah. Lí lī-khui lí ê pē-bú kap kò͘-hiong, lâi tòa tī chit-ê siⁿ-hūn ê lâng tiong-kan.
Goān Siōng Chú chiàu lí só͘ chòe--ê pò-tap lí. Lí lâi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè si̍t-kó͘-ē pī-lān, goān lí tùi I tit-tio̍h móa-móa ê pò-siúⁿ.”
Lō͘-tek ìn kóng, “Lí tùi góa chiah-ni̍h hó; sui-jiân góa chòe lí ê lú-pī mā bōe-kham--tit, lí iáu-kú an-ùi góa, koh tùi góa — lí ê lú-pī khin-siaⁿ kóng hó-ōe.”

Chia̍h-pn̄g ê sî, Pho-a-su tùi i kóng, “Lâi chia, the̍h khí-lâi chia̍h, mī-pau ùn chhò͘ chia̍h.” Lō͘-tek chiū chē tī siu-koah ê lâng sin-piⁿ. Pho-a-su the̍h pē-hó ê be̍h-á hō͘ i. I chia̍h-pá, koh ū chhun.
I peh--khí-lâi, koh khì khioh be̍h-sūi. Pho-a-su chiū hoan-hù i ê kang-lâng, kóng, “I nā tī be̍h-khún tiong khioh, mā m̄-thang kā i tòng, hāi i kiàn-siàu.
Lín sīm-chì tio̍h tùi be̍h-khún tiong thiu chi̍t-kóa chhut-lâi hō͘ i khioh, m̄-thang kā i chek-pī.”
Lō͘-tek chiū tī hn̂g--ni̍h khioh be̍h-sūi, khioh kàu thiⁿ-àm. I phah só͘ khioh ê be̍h-sūi, tāi-iok ū jī-cha̍p-jī kong-seng ê tōa-be̍h.
I chiū phāiⁿ ji̍p-siâⁿ, the̍h hō͘ i ê ta-ke khòaⁿ, koh chiong chia̍h chhun--ê the̍h chhut-lâi hō͘ i ê ta-ke.

I ê ta-ke tùi i kóng, “Lí kin-á-ji̍t tī tó-ūi khioh be̍h-sūi? Lí tī tó-ūi kang-chok? Goān chù-ì tio̍h lí, hó khoán-thāi lí hit-ê lâng siū chiok-hok.” Lō͘-tek chiū kā ta-ke kóng i tī sím-mi̍h-lâng hia kang-chok, koh kóng hit-ê lâng miâ kiò-chòe Pho-a-su.

Ná-o-bí tùi sin-pū kóng, “Goān Pho-a-su tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú chiok-hok; Siōng Chú put-sî si-un hō͘ oa̍h-lâng kap sí-lâng.” Ná-o-bí koh tùi i kóng, “Chit-ê lâng sī lán ê chhin-chiâⁿ, sī ū gī-bū iân-sio̍k lán sè-hē ê chi̍t ê chì-chhin.”
Mô͘-ap ê lú-chú Lō͘-tek kóng, “I mā ū kā góa kóng, ‘Lí tio̍h tè tī góa ê kang-lâng sin-piⁿ kàu siu-koah soah.’”
Ná-o-bí chiū tùi i ê sin-pū Lō͘-tek kóng, “Góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ah, lí tio̍h kap i ê lú-kang chòe-hé, chiah bián tī pa̍t-lâng ê hn̂g--ni̍h hō͘ lâng chhòng-tī.”
Lō͘-tek chiū tè Pho-a-su ê lú-kang chòe-hé khioh ngó͘-kok, kàu tōa-be̍h sió-be̍h lóng siu-koah liáu. I kè-sio̍k kap i ê ta-ke tòa chòe-hé.
Lō͘-tek ê ta-ke Ná-o-bí kā i kóng, “Cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ah, góa eng-kai ūi-tio̍h lí chhē chi̍t ê hó ê kui-sio̍k, hō͘ lí ū ka-kī ê ke.
Lí ōe-kì--tit-bô, kap lí chòe-hé choh-kang hiah-ê lú-kang ê thâu-ke Pho-a-su, sī lán ê chhin-chiâⁿ? Góa kā lí kóng, kim-mî i ōe tī ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ pòa tōa-be̍h.
Lí tio̍h sóe seng-khu, boah phang-iû, chhēng súi-saⁿ, jiân-āu lo̍h-khì ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ; m̄-kú hit-ê lâng chia̍h pá lim soah í-chêng, m̄-thang hō͘ i jīn--tio̍h.
I tó lo̍h-khì khùn ê sî, tio̍h khòaⁿ chheng-chhó i tó ê só͘-chāi, jiân-āu óa--khì, hian-khui i khàm kha ê gōa-phàu, tó tī i sin-piⁿ. I ōe kā lí kóng lí tio̍h chòe ê sū.”
Lō͘-tek ìn i kóng, “Lí kā góa kóng--ê, góa lóng ōe khì chòe.”
I chiū lo̍h-khì ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ, chiàu ta-ke só͘ hoan-hù ê it-chhè khì chòe.
Pho-a-su chia̍h pá lim soah, kám-kak chin sóng-khoài, chiū khì tó tī be̍h-tui piⁿ. Lō͘-tek chiū liam-kha khì, hian-khui i khàm kha ê gōa-phàu, tó tī i ê sin-piⁿ.
Pòaⁿ-mî, Pho-a-su hoan-sin, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-lâng tó tī kha-piⁿ, tio̍h-chi̍t-kiaⁿ.

I mn̄g kóng, “Lí sī siáⁿ-lâng?” I ìn kóng, “Góa sī lí ê lú-pī Lō͘-tek, chhiáⁿ lí ēng gōa-saⁿ lâi khàm lí ê lú-pī, tì-ìm góa, in-ūi lí sī goán ê chì-chhin, ū gī-bū iân-sio̍k goán ê sè-hē.”

I kóng, “Cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, goān lí tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê chiok-hok. Lí hiān-chāi só͘ piáu-hiān ê tiong-sêng pí í-chêng koh-khah tōa; bô-lūn sàn-chhiah á-sī hó-gia̍h ê siàu-liân-lâng, lí lóng bô kap in kiâⁿ.
Taⁿ, góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, bián hoân-ló, lí só͘ kóng--ê góa lóng ōe thòe lí chòe, in-ūi choân-siâⁿ ê lâng lóng chai lí sī hó tek-hēng ê cha-bó͘-lâng.
Góa khak-si̍t sī lí ê chì-chhin, ū gī-bū iân-sio̍k lí ê sè-hē, m̄-kú ū chi̍t ê pí góa kap lín koh-khah chhin.

Kim-mî lí lâu tiàm chia, tán thiⁿ kng, i nā beh tùi lí chīn gī-bū, chin hó, hō͘ i chīn; i nā m̄, góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, góa it-tēng ōe chīn gī-bū. Lí tiàm chia khùn, kàu thiⁿ kng.”

Lō͘-tek chiū tī i ê kha-piⁿ khùn, kàu thiⁿ phú-kng. Tī lâng-bīn iáu jīn bōe chheng-chhó í-chêng, Lō͘-tek chiū khí--lâi, in-ūi Pho-a-su ū kóng, “M̄-thang hō͘ lâng chai ū cha-bó͘-lâng lâi ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ.”
Pho-a-su kóng, “Kā lí ê phoa̍h-kun the̍h--lâi, thí hō͘ khui.” I chiū thí-khui. Pho-a-su niû iok jī-cha̍p kong-kun ê tōa-be̍h, khǹg tī Lō͘-tek ê keng-thâu téng, i chiū ji̍p-siâⁿ.
Lō͘-tek lâi kàu i ê ta-ke hia. Ná-o-bí mn̄g i kóng, “Cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ah, tāi-chì siáⁿ-khoán?” Lō͘-tek chiū chiong hit-ê lâng tùi i só͘ chòe ê it-chhè lóng kā i kóng.
Lō͘-tek kóng, “Hit-ê lâng kā góa kóng, ‘Lí m̄-thang khang-chhiú tńg-khì lín ta-ke hia.’ I ū hō͘ góa chit jī-cha̍p kong-kun tōa-be̍h.”
Ná-o-bí chiū kóng, “Cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ah, tán khòaⁿ tāi-chì án-chóaⁿ hoat-tián. Kin-á-ji̍t tāi-chì nā bô pān hó-sè, hit-ê lâng it-tēng bōe an-sim.”
Pho-a-su lâi siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu, chē--lo̍h-khì; i só͘ kóng hit-ê chì-chhin tú-tú keng-kè. I chiū kóng, “Hiaⁿ-tī ah, chhiáⁿ kè-lâi chia chē.” Hit-ê lâng chiū oa̍t tńg-lâi chē.
Pho-a-su koh chhiáⁿ siâⁿ-lāi cha̍p ê tiúⁿ-ló lâi, kā in kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chia chē.” In chiū chē--teh.
Pho-a-su chiū tùi chit-ê chì-chhin kóng, “Tùi Mô͘-ap -tōe tńg--lâi ê Ná-o-bí beh bōe lán ê hiaⁿ-tī Í-lī-bí-le̍k hit-tè tōe.

Góa siūⁿ góa tio̍h kā lí kóng, lí tio̍h tī chē tī chia ê lâng kap bîn-kan ê tiúⁿ-ló bīn-chêng bóe--tńg-lâi. Lí nā beh chīn gī-bū kā i bóe--tńg-lâi, chiū hō͘ lí bóe; nā m̄, tio̍h kā góa kóng, hō͘ góa chai. In-ūi bô lâng pí lí koh-khah ū koân thang bóe--tńg-lâi, koh-lâi chiah lûn-tio̍h góa.” Hit-ê lâng chiū kóng, “Góa beh chīn gī-bū kā bóe--tńg-lâi.”

Pho-a-su kóng, “Lí tùi Ná-o-bí ê chhiú bóe tōe ê sî, mā tio̍h chhōa sí--khì ê lâng ê bó͘ Mô͘-ap lú-chú Lō͘-tek chòe bó͘, thang thòe chit-ê sí--khì ê lâng ê ka-cho̍k pó-liû chit-tè thó͘-tōe.”
Chit-ê chì-chhin chiū kóng, “Nā án-ni góa m̄ bóe, chiah bián óng-hùi góa ka-kī ê sán-gia̍p. Niū lí bóe, hō͘ lí chīn gī-bū, góa bô beh bóe.”

Chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t kó͘-chá ê hong-sio̍k, lâng beh khak-tēng sio̍k-hôe á-sī kau-ōaⁿ sán-gia̍p ê chhiú-sio̍k, tio̍h thǹg ôe kau hō͘ tùi-hong. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ēng án-ni chòe ha̍p-iok ê chèng-kù.
Hit-ê chì-chhin chiū kā Pho-a-su kóng, “Hō͘ lí bóe.” I chiū thǹg ôe hō͘ Pho-a-su.

Jiân-āu, Pho-a-su tùi chèng tiúⁿ-ló kap só͘-ū ê lâng kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t lín sī chèng-jîn, góa tùi Ná-o-bí ê chhiú bóe it-chhè sio̍k Í-lī-bí-le̍k, Má-lûn, kap Ki-liân ê sán-gia̍p.

Góa mā beh chhōa Má-lûn ê bó͘ Mô͘-ap lú-chú Lō͘-tek chòe bó͘, thang thòe sí--khì ê lâng pó-liû i ka-cho̍k ê sán-gia̍p, chiah bián i tùi ka-cho̍k kap pún-che̍k siū tû-miâ. Kin-á-ji̍t lín lóng sī chèng-jîn.”

Só͘-ū tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu ê lâng kap chèng tiúⁿ-ló lóng kóng, “Goán sī chèng-jîn. Goān Siōng Chú hō͘ lí chhōa ji̍p-mn̂g ê bó͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ Lúi-kiat kap Lē-a kiàn-li̍p Ngá-kok ê ke. Goān lí tī Í-hoat-tha chiâⁿ-chòe tōa châi-chú, tī Pek-lī-hêng ū hó miâ-siaⁿ.
Goān lí ê ke, chiū-sī Siōng Chú thong-kè chit-ê lú-chú siúⁿ-sù lí ê hō͘-tāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ Tha-má kap Iû-tāi só͘ siⁿ Hoat-le̍k-su ê ke siâng-khoán.”
Pho-a-su chiū chhōa Lō͘-tek chòe bó͘. Pho-a-su kap i tâng-pâng; Siōng Chú hō͘ i hoâi-īn, i chiū siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ.

Hū-jîn-lâng lóng lâi kā Ná-o-bí kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn, in-ūi I kin-á-ji̍t hō͘ lí chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kè-sêng lí ê sán-gia̍p koh chiàu-kò͘ lí ê lâng. Goān chit-ê gín-á tī Í-sek-lia̍t ū hó miâ-siaⁿ.
Goān i hôe-ho̍k lí ê goân-khì, tī lí nî-lāu ê sî kā lí hōng-ióng, in-ūi i sī thiàⁿ lí ê sin-pū siⁿ--ê. Chit-ê sin-pū pí chhit ê kiáⁿ khah hó.”
Ná-o-bí chiū phō chit-ê gín-á tī heng-chêng, chhiâⁿ i tōa-hàn.
Chhù-piⁿ ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “ Ná-o-bí tit-tio̍h chi̍t ê kiáⁿ lah.” In chiū kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Gô-pī-tek; i chiū-sī Iâ-se ê lāu-pē, Iâ-se sī Tāi-pi̍t ê lāu-pē.
Che sī Hoat-le̍k-su ê hō͘-tāi: Hoat-le̍k-su siⁿ Hi-su-lûn,
Hi-su-lûn siⁿ Lân, Lân siⁿ A-bí-ná-ta̍t,
A-bí-ná-ta̍t siⁿ Ná-sūn, Ná-sūn siⁿ Sat-bûn,
Sat-bûn siⁿ Pho-a-su, Pho-a-su siⁿ Gô-pī-tek,
Gô-pī-tek siⁿ Iâ-se, Iâ-se siⁿ Tāi-pi̍t.

Ū chi̍t ê lâng kiò-chòe Í-lī-ka-ná; i tòa tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu, So͘-hut chong-cho̍k teh tòa ê La-má; i sī Í-hoat-liân -lâng, So͘-hut ê goân-sun, Thok-hō͘ ê cheng-sun, Í-lī-hō͘ ê sun, Iâ-lô-hán ê kiáⁿ.
Í-lī-ka-ná ū nn̄g ê bó͘, chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Hap-ná, chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Pí-nî-ná; Pí-nî-ná ū kiáⁿ-jî, Hap-ná bô kiáⁿ.

Í-lī-ka-ná ta̍k-nî tùi i ê pún-siâⁿ chiūⁿ-khì Sī-lô kèng-pài Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, koh tùi I hiàn-chè. Í-lī nn̄g ê kiáⁿ Hô-hut-nî kap Hui-nî-hap tī hia chòe Siōng Chú ê chè-si.
Í-lī-ka-ná ta̍k-piàn hiàn-chè, lóng pun hiàn-chè ê bah hō͘ i ê bó͘ Pí-nî-ná kap i ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kok chi̍t hūn.
M̄-kú Í-lī-ka-ná hō͘ Hap-ná khah hó-hūn, in-ūi i thiàⁿ Hap-ná, khó-sioh Siōng Chú hō͘ i bô siⁿ-kiáⁿ.
In-ūi Siōng Chú hō͘ i bô siⁿ-kiáⁿ, kap i chòe tùi-thâu ê Pí-nî-ná put-sî kek i, hō͘ i gêng-sim.
Chit-khoán tāi-chì ta̍k-nî teh hoat-seng. Ta̍k-piàn Hap-ná chiūⁿ-khì Siōng Chú ê chhù ê sî, Pí-nî-ná chiàu-siông án-ni kek i; i chiū thî-khàu, chia̍h bōe lo̍h pn̄g.
I ê tiōng-hu Í-lī-ka-ná kā i kóng, “ Hap-ná, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ teh háu? Sī-án-chóaⁿ m̄ chia̍h? Sī-án-chóaⁿ teh siong-sim? Ū góa kiám bô pí ū cha̍p ê kiáⁿ khah hó?”
In tī Sī-lô lim-chia̍h liáu-āu, Hap-ná chiū khiā--khí-lâi; hit-sî chè-si Í-lī chē tī Siōng Chú ê tiān mn̂g-thiāu piⁿ ê chē-ūi.
Hap-ná ê sim kan-khó͘, tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó, ti̍t-ti̍t lâu ba̍k-sái.

Hap-ná hē-goān kóng, “Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, lí nā chin-chiàⁿ koan-sim lí lú-pī ê khó͘-chêng, koàn-kò͘ góa, bô bōe-kì-tit lí ê lú-pī, sù lí ê lú-pī siⁿ chi̍t ê hāu-siⁿ, góa beh kā i chi̍t-sì-lâng hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, lóng bōe kā i thì-thâu.”
Hap-ná tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó bô-thêng, Í-lī chù-ì khòaⁿ i ê chhùi.
Hap-ná chēng-chēng kî-kiû, chí-ū chhùi-tûn tín-tāng bô chhut-siaⁿ, só͘-í Í-lī siūⁿ-kóng i sī chiú-chùi.
Í-lī kā i kóng, “Lí beh chùi jōa kú? M̄-thang koh lim lah!”
Hap-ná ìn kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, góa bô teh chùi; góa sī chi̍t ê chin siong-sim ê cha-bó͘-lâng, po̍h-chiú kāu-chiú lóng bô lim, put-kò sī teh tùi Siōng Chú thò͘-chhut khó͘-chêng.
M̄-thang khòaⁿ lí ê lú-pī chòe pháiⁿ cha-bó͘. Góa kî-tó bô-thêng, in-ūi chin oàn-thàn, sim kan-khó͘.”
Í-lī ìn i kóng, “Lí pêng-an tò--khì. Goān Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè chiàu lí só͘ kiû--ê sù hō͘ lí.”
Hap-ná kóng, “Goān lí ê lú-pī tùi lí tit-tio̍h un-hūi.” Hap-ná tò--khì, chia̍h pá liáu-āu, chiū bô koh iu-thâu-kat-bīn.
Keh-ji̍t in chin chá khí--lâi, kèng-pài Siōng Chú liáu-āu, chiū tò-khì in tī La-má ê chhù. Í-lī-ka-ná kap Hap-ná tâng-pâng; Siōng Chú ōe-kì-tit Hap-ná.
Hap-ná chiū hoâi-īn, kàu-sî siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Sat-bó-ní, ì-sù sī, “I sī góa tùi Siōng Chú kiû--lâi-ê.”
Í-lī-ka-ná kap in choân-ke lóng chiūⁿ-khì Sī-lô, tùi Siōng Chú hiàn nî-chè, koh siā i só͘ hē ê goān.
M̄-kú Hap-ná bô chiūⁿ--khì, kā i ê tiōng-hu kóng, “Thèng-hāu gín-á tn̄g-lin, góa chiah chhōa i khì hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, chi̍t-sì-lâng tòa tī hia.”

I ê tiōng-hu Í-lī-ka-ná kā i kóng, “Lí nā khòaⁿ-chòe hó chiū án-ni khì chòe, thèng-hāu gín-á tn̄g-lin chiah khì; goān Siōng Chú si̍t-hiān I ê ōe.” Hū-jîn-lâng chiū tī chhù--ni̍h io kiáⁿ kàu i tn̄g-lin.

Gín-á tn̄g-lin liáu-āu, Hap-ná chiū chhōa i khì Sī-lô Siōng Chú ê chhù; koh tòa chi̍t chiah saⁿ-hè ê gû-káng, cha̍p kong-kun ê iù mī-hún, chi̍t phê-tē ê chiú. Hit-sî gín-á iáu sòe-hàn.
In chiū thâi hit-chiah gû-káng, chhōa gín-á khì Í-lī hia.
Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, góa khak-si̍t chiū-sī í-chêng khiā tī lí bīn-chêng tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng.
Góa tùi Siōng Chú kiû chit-ê gín-á, I ū chiàu góa só͘ kiû--ê hō͘ góa;
só͘-í góa chiong chit-ê gín-á hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, hō͘ i chi̍t-sì-lâng ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.” In chiū tī hia kèng-pài Siōng Chú.

Hap-ná kî-tó kóng: Góa ê sim in-ūi Siōng Chú hoaⁿ-hí; góa ê thâu in-ūi Siōng Chú gia̍h-koân-koân; góa ê chhùi káⁿ ǹg tùi-te̍k khoa-iāu, in-ūi lí ê chín-kiù hō͘ góa khoài-lo̍k.
Chí-ū Siōng Chú chì-sèng, lí í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê; lán ê Siōng-tè sī î-it ê pó-hō͘-chiá.
Lâng m̄-thang chū-ko kóng kiau-ngō͘ ê ōe; m̄-thang chū-khoa kóng tōa-ōe, in-ūi Siōng Chú sī bû-só͘-put-ti ê Siōng-tè, lâng ê hêng-ûi siū lí phêng-kàm.
Ióng-sū ê keng í-keng siū at-chi̍h; loán-jio̍k ê lâng tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t.
Hù-chiok--ê tio̍h hō͘ lâng chhiàⁿ chiah ū thang chia̍h; iau-gō--ê bô koh iau. Bōe seng-io̍k--ê siⁿ chhit ê; ū chin chōe kiáⁿ--ê kàu-bé bô chhun pòaⁿ-ê.
Siōng Chú hō͘ lâng sí, ia̍h hō͘ lâng oa̍h; hō͘ lâng lo̍h Im-kan, ia̍h hō͘ lâng khí--lâi.
