Siōng Chú hō͘ lâng sàn-chhiah, ia̍h hō͘ lâng hó-gia̍h; hō͘ lâng kàng-kē, ia̍h hō͘ lâng ko-seng.

I tùi tîn-ai thê-poa̍t khùn-khó͘ ê lâng, tùi pùn-sò-tui ko-seng khiàm-kheh ê lâng, hō͘ in kap chun-kùi ê lâng chē chòe-hé, hō͘ in chē tōa-ūi. Tāi-tōe ê kun-ki Siōng Chú kiàn-li̍p; I chiong sè-kài an-tì tī hit téng-bīn.
I pó-siú I tiong-sìn chú-bîn ê kha-pō͘, hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng tī o͘-àm tiong siau-sit; lâng bōe-tàng khò ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t khah iâⁿ.

Te̍k-tùi Siōng Chú ê lâng ōe siū phah-chhùi; I beh tùi thiⁿ ēng lûi kòng in. Siōng Chú beh sím-phòaⁿ choân sè-kài. I beh sù khùi-la̍t hō͘ I ê kun-ông, hō͘ I só͘ kéng-soán--ê thâu gia̍h-koân-koân.
Í-lī-ka-ná tò-khì i tī La-má ê chhù. Gín-á Sat-bó-ní siū chè-si Í-lī chí-tō, ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.
Í-lī nn̄g ê kiáⁿ sī húi-lūi, biáu-sī Siōng Chú,
bô siú chè-si chhú hiàn-chè ê bah ê kui-tēng. Lâng hiàn chè-bah teh chú ê sî, chè-si ê po̍k-jîn chiū lâi, gia̍h saⁿ jiáu ê bah-chhe,
chhah-ji̍p e-á tiáⁿ-á, chhiám--chhut-lâi ê bah chè-si chiū the̍h--khì. Hit-sî, chè-si tùi lâi Sī-lô hiàn-chè ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng án-ni chòe.

M̄-nā án-ni, bah-iû iáu-bē sio í-chêng, chè-si ê po̍k-jîn chiū lâi, kā hiàn-chè ê lâng kóng, “Bah chi̍t-kóa the̍h lâi-khì hō͘ chè-si hang; i bô ài chú--kè ê bah, ài chhiⁿ--ê.”

Hiàn-chè ê lâng nā kóng, “Iû sio-liáu, bah chiah chiàu lí só͘ ài--ê the̍h--khì.” Chè-si ê po̍k-jîn chiū kóng, “Bōe-ēng--tit, sûi-sî hō͘ góa; nā m̄, góa beh kiông the̍h--khì.”
Í-lī nn̄g ê kiáⁿ ê chōe tī Siōng Chú gán-tiong hui-siông giâm-tiōng, in-ūi in biáu-sī hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè-mi̍h.
Hit-sî Sat-bó-ní iáu sòe-hàn, chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê í-hut-tek chè-si-ho̍k teh ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.
I ê lāu-bú ta̍k-nî kā i chòe chi̍t niá sòe-niá gōa-phàu, kap i ê tiōng-hu chiūⁿ-lâi hiàn nî-chè ê sî, tòa-lâi hō͘ i.

Í-lī kā Í-lī-ka-ná kap i ê bó͘ chiok-hok, kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú tùi chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng koh sù lí kiáⁿ-jî, lâi pó͘ lí hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú chit-ê gín-á.” In chiū tò-khì in tau.
Siōng Chú sù-hok Hap-ná, hō͘ i koh siⁿ saⁿ ê hāu-siⁿ, nn̄g ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ. Gín-á Sat-bó-ní kè-sio̍k ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú, ji̍t-ji̍t tōa-hàn.
Í-lī í-keng chin lāu, thiaⁿ-tio̍h i ê kiáⁿ tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì, koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h in kap hōe-bō͘ mn̂g-kháu chòe kang ê hū-jîn-lâng chòe-hé khùn.
Í-lī kā in kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ chòe chit-khoán pháiⁿ tāi-chì? Góa tùi Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê pháiⁿ hêng-ûi.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, m̄-thang án-ni. Góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn tùi lín ê hong-phêng chin bái.

Lâng tek-chōe lâng, Siōng-tè ōe kā i sím-phòaⁿ; lâng nā tek-chōe Siōng Chú, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng thòe i piān-hō͘?” M̄-kú in m̄ thiaⁿ lāu-pē ê ōe, in-ūi Siōng Chú í-keng koat-tēng beh thâi in.
Gín-á Sat-bó-ní ji̍t-ji̍t tōa-hàn, Siōng Chú kap lâng ná thiàⁿ i.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t, ū chi̍t ê Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng lâi kìⁿ Í-lī, tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lín chó͘-sian chòe Ai-ki̍p -ông ê lô͘-lē ê sî, góa ū tùi in hián-hiān.

Góa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k kéng A-lûn ê ke chòe góa ê chè-si, tī góa ê chè-tôaⁿ hiàn-chè, sio-hiuⁿ, chhēng í-hut-tek chè-si-ho̍k ho̍k-sāi góa. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ēng hé sio hiàn hō͘ góa ê chè-mi̍h, góa lóng ū pun hō͘ lín chó͘-sian.

Góa só͘ bēng-lēng tī góa ê chhù hiàn ê seng-lé chè-mi̍h, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ kā in thún-ta̍h? Lí khòaⁿ-tāng lí ê kiáⁿ khah kè-thâu chun-tiōng góa; kèng-jiân chún in tùi góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t hiàn ê chè-mi̍h, the̍h siōng-hó ê hūn khì chia̍h kah pûi-chut-chut?’

“Só͘-í Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè kóng, ‘Góa sui-jiân bat èng-ún, lí ê ke kap lí ê chong-cho̍k ōe éng-oán ho̍k-sāi góa, m̄-kú hiān-chāi góa Siōng Chú koat-tēng bô beh chiàu án-ni tùi-thāi lín; in-ūi chun-tiōng góa--ê, góa beh chun-tiōng i; biáu-sī góa--ê, beh siū khòaⁿ-khin.
Khòaⁿ, ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, góa beh chām-tn̄g lí kap lí ê chong-cho̍k ê chhiú-kut, án-ni lí ê ka-cho̍k bô lâng ōe tn̂g-hè-siū.
Tī góa sù-hok hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê sî, lí tian-tò ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê chhù soe-pāi; lí ê ka-cho̍k bô lâng ōe tn̂g-hè-siū.
Góa ōe kā lí lâu chi̍t ê hō͘-tāi tī góa ê chè-tôaⁿ ho̍k-sāi, m̄-kú lí ê ba̍k-chiu ōe sit-bêng, sim choa̍t-bāng; kî-tha ê hō͘-tāi lóng ōe chá-sí.
Lí nn̄g ê kiáⁿ Hô-hut-nî kap Hui-nî-hap ōe kâng chi̍t ji̍t sí, che chèng-bêng góa tùi lí kóng ê ōe it-tēng si̍t-hiān.

Góa ōe ūi ka-kī siat-li̍p chi̍t ê tiong-si̍t ê chè-si, i ōe chiàu góa ê sim-ì chòe tāi-chì. Góa ōe ūi-tio̍h i kiàn-li̍p ún-kò͘ ê ke; i ōe chi̍t-sì-lâng ho̍k-sāi góa só͘ soán-li̍p ê ông.
Lí ê hō͘-tāi só͘ chhun ê lâng lóng ōe tùi i kiû-khit thó-chia̍h, kóng: Kiû lí hō͘ góa chham-ú chè-si ê kang-chok, hō͘ góa thang tō͘ saⁿ-tǹg.’”
Gín-á Sat-bó-ní siū Í-lī kàu-tō ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú. Tng-sî chin hán-tit ū tùi Siōng Chú lâi ê sìn-sit, bô siông-siông ū khé-sī.
Ū chi̍t mî, Í-lī tī ka-kī ê pâng-keng teh khùn; i ê ba̍k-chiu í-keng bū, khòaⁿ bōe bêng.
Sat-bó-ní tī khǹg Siōng-tè iok-kūi ê tiān-lāi mā teh khùn; thiⁿ iáu-bē kng, Siōng-tè ê teng iáu-teh to̍h.
Siōng Chú kiò Sat-bó-ní; Sat-bó-ní ìn kóng, “Góa tī chia.”
I chiū cháu-khì Í-lī hia, kóng, “Góa tī chia, lí kiò góa hō͘ⁿ?” Í-lī kóng, “Góa bô kiò lí, tò-khì khùn.” I chiū khì khùn.
Siōng Chú koh kiò Sat-bó-ní; Sat-bó-ní khí--lâi, khì Í-lī hia, kóng, “Góa tī chia, lí kiò góa hō͘ⁿ?” I ìn kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ, góa bô kiò lí, tò-khì khùn.”
Hit-chūn Sat-bó-ní m̄ bat Siōng Chú; Siōng Chú ê ōe iáu-bē tùi i khé-sī.
Siōng Chú tē-saⁿ piàn kiò Sat-bó-ní. Sat-bó-ní khí--lâi, khì Í-lī hia, kóng, “Góa tī chia, lí kiò góa hō͘ⁿ?” Í-lī chiah chai sī Siōng Chú teh kiò gín-á.
Í-lī chiū kā Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Lí koh khì khùn. I nā koh kiò lí, lí chiū kóng, ‘Siōng Chú ah, chhiáⁿ lí kóng, lí ê lô͘-po̍k teh thiaⁿ.’” Sat-bó-ní chiū koh tò-khì khùn.
Siōng Chú koh lâi khiā--teh, chhin-chhiūⁿ chêng kúi-nā piàn án-ni kiò, “ Sat-bó-ní, Sat-bó-ní.” Sat-bó-ní ìn kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kóng, lí ê lô͘-po̍k teh thiaⁿ.”
Siōng Chú kā Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Chù-ì thiaⁿ, góa beh tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan chòe chi̍t hāng tāi-chì, hō͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng lóng kiaⁿ-chi̍t-tiô.
Tī hit-ji̍t, koan-hē Í-lī ê ke góa só͘ kóng ê tāi-chì lóng ōe si̍t-hiān.
Góa ū kā i kóng, góa beh éng-oán sím-phòaⁿ in chit-ke; i chai i ê kiáⁿ ū hoān eng-kai siū chiù-chó͘ ê chōe, koh bô kā in khiàn-chek.
Só͘-í góa tùi Í-lī ê ke chiù-chōa, ‘ Í-lī in chit-ke ê chōe ēng seng-lé chè-mi̍h mā bōe-tàng tit-tio̍h sià-bián.’”
Sat-bó-ní khùn kàu thiⁿ-kng, khui Siōng Chú ê tiān-mn̂g. Sat-bó-ní m̄-káⁿ chiong īⁿ-siōng kā Í-lī kóng.
Í-lī kiò Sat-bó-ní, kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ Sat-bó-ní.” I ìn kóng, “Góa tī chia.”
Í-lī kóng, “Siōng Chú tùi lí kóng sím-mi̍h? Lí m̄-thang kā góa ún-môa; lí nā chiong I kā lí kóng--ê tùi góa am-khàm chi̍t kù, goān Siōng-tè ka-pē kā lí chek-hoa̍t.”
Sat-bó-ní chiū chiong hiah-ê ōe lóng kā Í-lī kóng, bô tùi i ún-môa. Í-lī kóng, “I sī Siōng Chú. Siōng Chú ōe chiàu I khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê khì chòe.”
Sat-bó-ní chiām-chiām tōa-hàn; Siōng Chú kap i tông-chāi, hō͘ i só͘ kóng ê ōe ta̍k-kù lóng si̍t-hiān.
Tùi Tān kàu Pia̍t-sī-pa, só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng chai Sat-bó-ní khak-si̍t sī Siōng Chú ê sian-ti.
Siōng Chú kè-sio̍k tī Sī-lô hián-hiān. Siōng Chú tī Sī-lô ēng I ê ōe khé-sī Sat-bó-ní.
Sat-bó-ní ê ōe thoân-piàn Í-sek-lia̍t. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut-khì beh kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng kau-chiàn; in tī Í-piān Í-siā hù-kūn chat-iâⁿ, Hui-lī-sū -lâng tī A-hut chat-iâⁿ.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng pâi-tīn kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, in thâi-iâⁿ, thâi-sí Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tāi-iok sì-chheng lâng.

Í-sek-lia̍t kun-tūi tò-lâi iâⁿ-lāi, in ê tiúⁿ-ló kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ Siōng Chú kin-á-ji̍t hō͘ lán thâi-su Hui-lī-sū -lâng? Lán lâi-khì Sī-lô kng Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi lâi lán chia, án-ni I tī lán tiong-kan, ōe kiù lán thoat-lī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú.”

In chiū phài lâng khì Sī-lô, chiong Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê iok-kūi kng--lâi, in-ūi Siōng Chú chē tī iok-kūi téng-bīn nn̄g ê thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek ê tiong-kan. Í-lī nn̄g ê kiáⁿ Hô-hut-nî, Hui-nî-hap, kap Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi chòe-hé lâi.
Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi lâi kàu iâⁿ-tiong ê sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tōa-siaⁿ hoah, tōe soah tín-tāng.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h hán-hoah ê siaⁿ, chiū kóng, “ Hi-pek-lâi iâⁿ-tiong hiah-ni̍h tōa-siaⁿ, sī teh hoah sím-mi̍h?” Āu-lâi chiah chai sī Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi kàu iâⁿ-tiong.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kóng, “Ū sîn-bêng lâi kàu in ê iâⁿ-tiong.” In kóng, “Chhám ah, lán chêng-kàu-taⁿ m̄-bat tú-tio̍h chit-khoán tāi-chì.

Lán chhám ah, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kiù lán thoat-lī chit-khoán tōa koân-lêng ê sîn-bêng? Í-chêng tī khòng-iá ēng ta̍k-khoán chai-hō phah-sí Ai-ki̍p -lâng--ê, chiū-sī chiah-ê sîn-bêng.

Hui-lī-sū -lâng ah, tio̍h ióng-kám, tio̍h chòe tāi-tiōng-hu, lín chiah bián chòe Hi-pek-lâi -lâng ê lô͘-lē, chhin-chhiūⁿ in í-chêng chòe lán ê lô͘-lē. Tio̍h chòe tāi-tiōng-hu kap in kau-chiàn.”
Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiū chhut-chiàn, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàn-pāi; pō͘-peng sí saⁿ-bān lâng, kî-tha--ê lóng tô-cháu tńg-khì in tau.
Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi hō͘ Hui-lī-sū -lâng chhiúⁿ--khì; Í-lī nn̄g ê kiáⁿ Hô-hut-nî kap Hui-nî-hap mā lóng sí.
Kâng hit-ji̍t, ū chi̍t ê Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k ê lâng tùi chiàn-tiûⁿ cháu-lâi Sī-lô, saⁿ thiah-li̍h, thâu-khak sám thô͘-hún piáu-sī ai-siong.
I kàu ê sî, tú-hó Í-lī tī lō͘-piⁿ chē tī i ê í-á teh khòaⁿ, in-ūi i teh khòa-lū Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi. Hit-ê lâng ji̍p-siâⁿ pò siau-sit, choân-siâⁿ ê lâng lóng âu-kiò.
Í-lī thiaⁿ-tio̍h âu-kiò ê siaⁿ, chiū mn̄g, “In teh hoah sím-mi̍h?” Hit-ê lâng kóaⁿ-kín lâi kā Í-lī pò-kò.
Hit-sî Í-lī í-keng káu-cha̍p-poeh hè, ba̍k-chiu chhâ-chhâ, bô khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Hit-ê lâng kā Í-lī kóng, “Góa tú-á tùi chiàn-tiûⁿ lâi, tùi chiàn-tiûⁿ tô-cháu--lâi.” Í-lī kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ, tāi-chì án-chóaⁿ?”

Pò siau-sit--ê ìn kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàn-pāi tô-cháu, hō͘ lâng thâi-sí--ê chin chōe. Lí nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, Hô-hut-nî kap Hui-nî-hap mā sí. Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì.”

Hit-ê lâng chi̍t-ē kóng-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi, Í-lī chiū tùi í-á tò-siàng-hiàⁿ, tó lo̍h-khì mn̂g-piⁿ, ām-kún chi̍h, chiū sí; in-ūi i nî-lāu koh tōa-kho͘. Í-lī chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su sì-cha̍p nî.

Í-lī ê sin-pū, Hui-nî-hap ê bó͘, hoâi-īn teh-beh siⁿ. I thiaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì, ta-koaⁿ kap tiōng-hu lóng sí ê siau-sit, hut-jiân chhui-chūn thàng-thiàⁿ, khut lo̍h-khì siⁿ-kiáⁿ.
I teh-beh sí ê sî, tī piⁿ--á teh chiàu-kò͘ ê hū-jîn-lâng kā i kóng, “Bián kiaⁿ, lí siⁿ ta-po͘--ê!” M̄-kú i tiām-tiām, bô hôe-èng.

I kā gín-á hō-miâ kiò “ Í-ka-phok ”, ì-sù sī Siōng-tè ê êng-iāu í-keng lī-khui Í-sek-lia̍t; in-ūi Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì, ta-koaⁿ kap tiōng-hu mā lóng sí.
I koh kóng, “Êng-iāu í-keng lī-khui Í-sek-lia̍t, in-ūi Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì.”
Hui-lī-sū -lâng kā Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi chhiúⁿ--khì, tùi Í-piān Í-siā ūn-khì A-si̍t-tu̍t.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng kā Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi ūn-khì Tāi-kún ê biō, kā i khǹg tī Tāi-kún ê piⁿ--á.

Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá A-si̍t-tu̍t -lâng khí--lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-kún tó tī Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi thâu-chêng, bīn phak tī thô͘-kha; chiū chiong Tāi-kún koh chhāi khí-lâi i ê goân-ūi.

Koh keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, in khí--lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-kún koh-chài tó tī Siōng Chú iok-kūi thâu-chêng, bīn phak tī thô͘-kha, thâu kap nn̄g ki chhiú-chiúⁿ lóng tn̄g--khì, lak tī hō͘-tēng téng-bīn; chí-ū chhun Tāi-kún ê seng-khu.
In-ūi án-ni, Tāi-kún ê chè-si kap só͘-ū ji̍p A-si̍t-tu̍t Tāi-kún -biō ê lâng, kàu kin-á-ji̍t lóng bô ta̍h Tāi-kún -biō ê hō͘-tēng.
Siōng Chú ê chhiú tāng-tāng phah A-si̍t-tu̍t -lâng kap chiu-ûi ê jîn-bîn, hō͘ in siⁿ to̍k-chhng, koh hō͘ in kiaⁿ.

A-si̍t-tu̍t -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h án-ni chiū kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi m̄-thang koh khǹg tī lán chia, in-ūi I ê chhiú tāng-tāng phah lán, mā phah lán ê sîn-bêng Tāi-kún.”

A-si̍t-tu̍t -lâng chiū phài lâng chhiáⁿ Hui-lī-sū ê siú-léng lâi, mn̄g in, kóng, “Goán tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chhú-lí Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi?” In ìn kóng, “Kā Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi ūn-khì Ka-te̍k.” In chiū chiong Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi ūn--khì.

Iok-kūi chi̍t-ē ūn kàu hia, ín-khí tōa khióng-hông, in-ūi Siōng Chú ê chhiú kong-kek hit-ê siâⁿ; koh phah siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng, hō͘ siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng bô-lūn tōa-sòe lóng siⁿ to̍k-chhng.

In chiū chiong Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi sàng-khì Í-kek-lûn. Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi chi̍t-ē kàu Í-kek-lûn, Í-kek-lûn -lâng hoah kóng, “In chiong Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi ūn-lâi lán chia, sī beh hāi-sí lán kap lán ê tông-pau.”

In chiū phài lâng khì chhiáⁿ Hui-lī-sū lóng-chóng ê siú-léng lâi, tùi in kóng, “Kā Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi sàng tò-khì goân-lâi ê só͘-chāi, chiah bián i hāi-sí lán kap lán ê tông-pau.” Choân-siâⁿ chhiong-móa sí-bông ê kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; in-ūi Siōng-tè ê chhiú tāng-tāng phah in.
Bô sí ê lâng lóng siⁿ to̍k-chhng; choân-siâⁿ thî-khàu ê siaⁿ thàu kàu thiⁿ-téng.
Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi thêng-liû tī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tōe chhit ge̍h-ji̍t kú.

Hui-lī-sū -lâng kiò hiah-ê chè-si kap pok-kòa--ê lâi mn̄g, “Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi goán tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chhú-lí? Chhiáⁿ chí-tiám goán beh án-chóaⁿ sàng i tò-khì goân-lâi ê só͘-chāi?”

In kóng, “Lín nā beh sàng Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi tò--khì, m̄-thang hō͘ i khang-chhiú khì, it-tēng tio̍h tòa pê-chōe ê lé-mi̍h; lín ê pīⁿ chiah ōe tit-tio̍h i-hó, lín chiah ōe chai sī-án-chóaⁿ Siōng-tè kè-sio̍k teh hêng-hoa̍t lín.”

Hui-lī-sū -lâng mn̄g, “Goán tio̍h ēng sím-mi̍h chòe pê-chōe ê lé-mi̍h?” Chè-si kap pok-kòa--ê ìn kóng, “Chiàu Hui-lī-sū siú-léng ê sò͘-bo̍k, lín tio̍h chō gō͘ lia̍p kim to̍k-chhng, gō͘ chiah kim niáu-chhú, in-ūi lín ê siú-léng lóng siū-tio̍h siâng-khoán ê chai-hō.

Lín tio̍h chō to̍k-chhng ê bô͘-hêng, kap húi-hoāi lín ê thó͘-tōe ê niáu-chhú ê bô͘-hêng; koh tio̍h chiong êng-kng kui hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè; bô-tiāⁿ-tio̍h I tùi lín, lín ê sîn-bêng, lín ê thó͘-tōe ōe chhiú-hā-liû-chêng.
Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ beh chhin-chhiūⁿ Ai-ki̍p -lâng kap Ai-ki̍p -ông hiah-ni̍h ngī-sim? Siōng-tè kiám m̄-sī giâm-giâm tùi-hù in, in chiah pàng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui?
Hiān-chāi, lín tio̍h chún-pī chi̍t tâi sin ê chhia, nn̄g chiah iáu-teh chhī-lin, m̄-bat kòa taⁿ ê gû-bú, chiong gû-bú thò tī chhia, kā gû-á-kiáⁿ khan tò-khì gû-tiâu;
koh chiong Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi hē tī chhia-téng, kā lí só͘ chō pê-chōe ê kim-khì khǹg tī iok-kūi piⁿ ê siuⁿ-á lāi sàng--khì.

Lín tio̍h chù-ì khòaⁿ, hit-tâi chhia nā tùi kau-kài ê lō͘ chiūⁿ kàu Pek Sī-be̍k, chiū chai kàng chit-ê tōa chai-hō hō͘ lán--ê si̍t-chāi sī Siōng Chú. Chhia nā m̄-sī ǹg hit-ê hong-hiòng khì, chiū chai phah lán--ê m̄-sī I, sī lán ngó͘-jiân tú--tio̍h-ê.”
Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiū chiàu án-ni chòe. In chiong nn̄g chiah iáu-teh chhī-lin ê gû-bú thò tī hit-tâi chhia, kā gû-á-kiáⁿ koaiⁿ tī gû-tiâu;
koh kā Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi, í-ki̍p khǹg kim niáu-chhú, kim to̍k-chhng ê bô͘-hêng ê siuⁿ-á, lóng hē tī chhia-téng.
Gû-bú ǹg Pek Sī-be̍k ê tōa-lō͘ ti̍t-ti̍t kiâⁿ--lo̍h-khì, ná kiâⁿ ná háu, bô phian chó-iū. Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê siú-léng tè tī āu-bīn, it-ti̍t kàu Pek Sī-be̍k ê pian-kài.
Hit-sî Pek Sī-be̍k -lâng tī soaⁿ-kok teh siu-koah be̍h-á; in gia̍h-thâu chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h iok-kūi chiū hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí.

Chhia kàu Pek Sī-be̍k -lâng Iok-su-a ê hn̂g, chiū thêng--teh; tī hia ū chi̍t tè tōa chio̍h, in phòa hit-tâi chhia ê chhâ, kā hit nn̄g chiah gû-bú chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.

Lī-bī -lâng chiong Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi, kap piⁿ--á tóe kim-khì ê siuⁿ-á the̍h--lo̍h-lâi, hē tī hit-tè tōa chio̍h ê téng-bīn. Pek Sī-be̍k -lâng tī hit-ji̍t hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pa̍t-khoán ê chè hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng gō͘ ê siú-léng lóng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū tī siâng hit-ji̍t tò-khì Í-kek-lûn.

Hui-lī-sū -lâng tòa gō͘ ê kim to̍k-chhng chòe pê-chōe-chè hêng hō͘ Siōng Chú; chi̍t ê ūi-tio̍h A-si̍t-tu̍t -siâⁿ, chi̍t ê ūi-tio̍h Ka-sat -siâⁿ, chi̍t ê ūi-tio̍h A-si̍t-ki-lûn -siâⁿ, chi̍t ê ūi-tio̍h Ka-te̍k -siâⁿ, chi̍t ê ūi-tio̍h Í-kek-lûn -siâⁿ.

Kim niáu-chhú ê sò͘-bo̍k chiàu Hui-lī-sū gō͘ ê siú-léng só͘ koán siat-hông ê siâⁿ kap bô siat-hông ê chng-siā lâi tēng. In hē Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi hit-tè tōa chio̍h, kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu tī Pek Sī-be̍k -lâng Iok-su-a ê hn̂g--ni̍h chòe chèng-kù.
Siōng Chú phah-sí chhit-cha̍p ê Pek Sī-be̍k -lâng, in-ūi in thau-khòaⁿ iok-kūi ê lāi-bīn. Jîn-bîn tōa ai-khàu, in-ūi Siōng Chú phah-sí hiah chōe lâng.
Pek Sī-be̍k -lâng kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú chit-ūi Chì-sèng ê Siōng-tè? Lán beh kā iok-kūi sàng-khì tó-ūi?”
In chiū chhe lâng khì kìⁿ Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm -lâng, kóng, “ Hui-lī-sū -lâng ū chiong Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi sàng--tò-lâi; chhiáⁿ lín lâi, kā i chiap-khì lín hia.”
Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm -lâng chiū lâi, chiap Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi khì soaⁿ-téng A-pí-ná-ta̍t ê chhù; in jīm-bēng i ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat kò͘-siú Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi.
Iok-kūi lâu tī Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm ū jī-cha̍p nî kú; Í-sek-lia̍t choân-ke thòng-hóe kui-ǹg Siōng Chú.

Sat-bó-ní tùi Í-sek-lia̍t choân-ke kóng, “Lín nā beh choan-sim kui-sūn Siōng Chú, tio̍h tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì gōa-cho̍k ê sîn-bêng kap A-su-tha-lio̍k lú-sîn, kian-koat kui-ǹg Siōng Chú, chí-ū ho̍k-sāi I, I ōe kiù lín thoat-lī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū tû-khì ta̍k só͘-chāi ê Pa-le̍k kap A-su-tha-lio̍k lú-sîn, chí-ū ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.
Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Tio̍h chū-chi̍p só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lâi Bí-su-pa, góa beh ūi-tio̍h lín ǹg Siōng Chú kî-tó.”

In chiū chū-chi̍p tī Bí-su-pa, chhiūⁿ-chúi tò tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng. Hit-ji̍t, in kìm-chia̍h, tī hia chhàm-hóe kóng, “Goán ū tek-chōe Siōng Chú.” Sat-bó-ní chiū tī Bí-su-pa chhâi-koat Í-sek-lia̍t bîn-kan ê àn-kiāⁿ.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Bí-su-pa chū-chi̍p, in ê siú-léng chiū chhut-peng kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū chin kiaⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kā Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kè-sio̍k ūi-tio̍h goán kiû-kiò Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè, kiû I kiù lán thoat-lī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú.”
Sat-bó-ní chiū ēng chi̍t chiah chia̍h-lin ê iûⁿ-á chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; Sat-bó-ní thòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiû-kiò Siōng Chú; Siōng Chú ū thiaⁿ i ê kî-tó.

Sat-bó-ní teh hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê sî, Hui-lī-sū -lâng pek óa-lâi beh kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng. Hit-ji̍t Siōng Chú tōa-siaⁿ tân-lûi kong-kek Hui-lī-sū -lâng, phah-loān in; in chiū thâi-su, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Bí-su-pa chhut--lâi, tui-kóaⁿ Hui-lī-sū -lâng, tui-sat in ti̍t-kàu Pek Kah hù-kūn.
Sat-bó-ní tī Bí-su-pa kap Siān ê tiong-kan chhāi chi̍t tè chio̍h, kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Í-piān Í-siā, kóng, “Kàu kin-á-ji̍t, Siōng Chú it-ti̍t ū teh pang-chān lán.”

Tùi hit-ji̍t khí, Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiū khut-ho̍k, m̄-káⁿ koh chhim-ji̍p Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê léng-thó͘. Sat-bó-ní oa̍h--teh ê sî, Siōng Chú ê chhiú chó͘-chí Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhim-hoān.

Tùi Í-kek-lûn kàu Ka-te̍k, Hui-lī-sū -lâng chhiúⁿ--khì ê siâⁿ lóng hêng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siu-hôe lóng-chóng ê léng-thó͘. Hit-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Ka-lâm -lâng hô-pêng siong-chhù.
Sat-bó-ní it-seng chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su.
Ta̍k-nî i sûn-sī Pek-te̍k-lī, Kiat-kah, Bí-su-pa chiah-ê só͘-chāi, chhâi-koat Í-sek-lia̍t bîn-kan ê àn-kiāⁿ.
I sûn-sī liáu-āu lóng ōe tò-khì i ê kò͘-hiong La-má, tī hia chòe sū-su. I mā tī hia ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ.
Sat-bó-ní í-keng lāu, chiū siat-li̍p i nn̄g ê kiáⁿ chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū-su.
Tōa-kiáⁿ Iok-ní kap tē-jī kiáⁿ A-pí-ngá lóng tī Pia̍t-sī-pa chòe sū-su.
M̄-kú in bô o̍h in lāu-pē ê bô͘-iūⁿ; in tham put-gī-chi-châi, siu hóe-lō͘, bô chiàu kong-tō chhâi-koat.
Tùi án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló lóng chū-chi̍p lâi La-má kìⁿ Sat-bó-ní,
kā i kóng, “Lí í-keng nî-lāu, lí nn̄g ê kiáⁿ bô o̍h lí ê bô͘-iūⁿ. Só͘-í tio̍h siat-li̍p chi̍t ê ông kā goán tī-lí, chhin-chhiūⁿ pa̍t-ê kok-ka kâng-khoán.”
Sat-bó-ní tùi in iau-kiû chi̍t ê ông ê sū bô hoaⁿ-hí. I chiū tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó.
Siōng Chú tùi Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Jîn-bîn ê iau-kiû, lí tio̍h chiap-siū. In m̄-sī khì-sak lí, sī khì-sak góa; in bô ài góa chòe in ê ông.
Tùi góa chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p kàu kin-á-ji̍t, in só͘ chòe--ê lóng sī lī-khui góa, khì ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, hiān-chāi in mā án-ni teh tùi-thāi lí.
Taⁿ in ê iau-kiû lí tio̍h chiap-siū, m̄-kú tio̍h giâm-giâm kā in kéng-kò, hō͘ in chai chiong-lâi in ê ông ōe án-chóaⁿ koán-hat in.”
Sat-bó-ní chiong Siōng Chú ê ōe lóng kā hiah-ê tùi i iau-kiû chi̍t ê ông ê jîn-bîn kóng,
“Chiong-lâi lín ê ông ōe án-ni koán-hat lín: I ōe tiàu lín ê kiáⁿ khì choh-peng, ū-ê chòe chiàn-chhia-peng, ū-ê chòe bé-peng; in cháu chòe-chêng, chòe ông ê sian-hong.
I ōe phài lâng chòe koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, ū-ê koán chi̍t-chheng, ū-ê koán gō͘-cha̍p; mā ōe phài lâng kā i choh-hn̂g, siu-sêng ngó͘-kok, chō kun-khì kap chiàn-chhia ê chong-pī.
I ōe tiàu lín ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kā i chè-chō phang-iû, chú-chia̍h, hang-piáⁿ.
I ōe kā lín siōng-hó ê chhân-hn̂g, phû-tô-hn̂g, kaⁿ-ná-hn̂g the̍h-khì hō͘ i ê jîn-sîn.
Lín ê ngó͘-kok kap phû-tô, i ōe chhú cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t hō͘ i ê koaⁿ-oân kap jîn-sîn.
I ōe lia̍h lín ê lô͘-po̍k, lú-pī, ióng-chòng ê siàu-liân-lâng, kap lín ê lû-á, kā i chòe kang.
Lín ê iûⁿ-kûn, i beh chhú cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t; lín mā ōe chòe i ê lô͘-lē.
Hit-sî, lín ōe in-ūi só͘ kéng ê ông ai-kiò, m̄-kú Siōng Chú m̄ chhap lín.”
M̄-kú jîn-bîn m̄ thiaⁿ Sat-bó-ní ê ōe, hoán-tńg ìn kóng, “Lí kóng--ê, goán bô chàn-sêng! Goán it-tēng beh ū chi̍t ê ông tī-lí goán.
Án-ni goán chiah ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ pa̍t-kok ū ka-kī ê ông kā goán tī-lí, chhōa goán khì kau-chiàn.”
Sat-bó-ní thiaⁿ-tio̍h jîn-bîn ê ōe liáu-āu, chiū kóng hō͘ Siōng Chú thiaⁿ.
Siōng Chú tùi Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Lí tio̍h thiaⁿ in ê iau-kiû, kā in siat-li̍p chi̍t ê ông.” Sat-bó-ní chiū kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Lín thang tò--khì.”
Ū chi̍t ê Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k ê lâng, kiò-chòe Ki-sū, sī A-pia̍t ê kiáⁿ, Sé-lô ê sun, Pí-ko-la ê cheng-sun, A-húi-a ê goân-sun; i sī hó-gia̍h-lâng.
I ū chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, kiò-chòe Sò-lô, ióng-chòng koh eng-chùn. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kap i pí; i pí pa̍t-lâng khah koân chi̍t lia̍p thâu.
Sò-lô ê lāu-pē Ki-sū phah-m̄-kìⁿ kúi-nā chiah lû-bú. Ki-sū kā Sò-lô kóng, “Lí chhōa chi̍t ê po̍k-jîn khì chhē hiah-ê lû-á.”
In kiâⁿ-thàu Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu, Sa-lī-sa tōe-khu, Sa-lîm tōe-khu, āu-lâi kàu Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu, lóng chhē bô.
In kàu So͘-hut tōe-khu ê sî, Sò-lô kā i ê po̍k-jîn kóng, “Lán tńg--lâi-khì. Nā bô, lāu-pē bô hoân-ló lû, soah hoân-ló lán.”

Po̍k-jîn kóng, “Tán leh, chit-ê chng-siā ū chi̍t ê Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng siū tāi-ke kèng-tiōng; i só͘ kóng--ê lóng ōe si̍t-hiān; lán lâi-khì chhē i; bô-tiāⁿ-tio̍h i ōe kā lán chí-sī khì tó-ūi chhē lû.”

Sò-lô kā po̍k-jîn kóng, “Lán nā beh khì kìⁿ i, ū sím-mi̍h thang sàng i? Lán tē-á lāi í-keng bô chia̍h-mi̍h, mā bô lé-mi̍h thang sàng hit-ê Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng. Lán iáu ū sím-mi̍h--bô?”
Po̍k-jîn koh ìn Sò-lô, “Góa ū chi̍t tè sòe-tè gûn-á, thang sàng hō͘ hit-ê Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, chhiáⁿ i kā lán kóng tī tó-ūi ōe chhē-tio̍h lû-á.”
(Í-chêng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng beh kiû-mn̄g Siōng-tè, ōe kóng, “Lán lâi-khì chhē sian-kiàn.” Khah-chá ê sian-kiàn kin-á-ji̍t kiò-chòe sian-ti.)
Sò-lô kā po̍k-jîn kóng, “Hó, lán lâi-khì.” In chiū khì Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng tòa ê siâⁿ.
In chiūⁿ soaⁿ-phiâⁿ beh ji̍p-siâⁿ ê sî, tú-tio̍h kúi-nā ê cha-bó͘ gín-á chhut-lâi beh chhiūⁿ-chúi, chiū mn̄g in, “Sian-kiàn ū tī chia bô?”
Cha-bó͘ gín-á ìn kóng, “Ū, i tī chia; tú tī lín thâu-chêng. Kín khì, i kin-á-ji̍t tú-hó lâi chit-ê siâⁿ, beh tī soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ ūi bîn-chiòng hiàn-chè.

Lín chi̍t-ē ji̍p-siâⁿ, tī i iáu-bē chiūⁿ soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ chia̍h chè-mi̍h í-chêng ōe chhē-tio̍h i. In-ūi bîn-chiòng bōe-tàng seng chia̍h, tio̍h tán i chiok-hok chè-mi̍h liáu-āu, siū chhiáⁿ ê lâng chiah ōe-tàng chia̍h. Lín chit-chūn khì, chiū ōe chhē-tio̍h i.”
Sò-lô kap i ê po̍k-jîn chiū kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ. In beh ji̍p-siâⁿ ê sî, Sat-bó-ní tú-tú ǹg in kiâⁿ--lâi, beh chhut-siâⁿ khì soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ.
Sò-lô iáu-bē kàu ê chêng chi̍t ji̍t, Siōng Chú í-keng kā Sat-bó-ní khé-sī kóng,

“Bîn-á-chài chit-ê sî-chūn, góa beh chhe chi̍t ê lâng tùi Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu lâi lí chia; lí tio̍h kā i boah-iû, siat-li̍p i chòe góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê thóng-tī-chiá; i ōe kiù góa ê chú-bîn thoat-lī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú. Góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê chú-bîn ê khùn-khó͘, thiaⁿ-tio̍h in ai-kiû ê siaⁿ.”
Sat-bó-ní chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sò-lô, Siōng Chú chiū tùi i kóng, “Chit-ê chiū-sī góa kā lí kóng beh tī-lí góa ê chú-bîn hit-ê lâng.”
Sò-lô tī siâⁿ-mn̂g lāi kiâⁿ-óa Sat-bó-ní, kā i mn̄g, “Chhiáⁿ mn̄g, sian-kiàn ê chhù tī tó-ūi?”

Sat-bó-ní ìn Sò-lô kóng, “Góa chiū-sī sian-kiàn. Lí seng chiūⁿ-khì soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ. Kin-á-ji̍t lín beh kap góa chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g; bîn-á-chá-khí góa ōe sàng lí tńg--khì; lí teh hoân-ló ê tāi-chì góa ōe kā lí kóng.

Lí saⁿ ji̍t chêng phah-m̄-kìⁿ hiah-ê lû-á, lí m̄-bián hoân-ló, í-keng chhē--tio̍h lah. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ teh khat-bō͘--ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng? Kiám m̄-sī lí kap lín lāu-pē ê ka-cho̍k?”

Sò-lô ìn kóng, “Góa sī Piān-ngá-bín -lâng, sio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siōng sòe ê chi-cho̍k; goán ka-cho̍k koh sī Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k tiong siōng sòe--ê. Lí ná kā góa kóng chiah-ê ōe?”
Sat-bó-ní chhōa Sò-lô kap i ê po̍k-jîn ji̍p-khì kheh-thiaⁿ, hō͘ in tī só͘ chhiáⁿ ê lâng tiong-kan chē tōa-ūi; só͘ chhiáⁿ ê lâng-kheh tāi-iok ū saⁿ-cha̍p ê.
Sat-bó-ní kā chú-chia̍h--ê kóng, “Góa kau-tài lí siu--khí-lâi hit-hūn thang phâng--chhut-lâi.”

Chú-chia̍h--ê chiū chiong te̍k-soán ê tōa-thúi phâng--chhut-lâi, hē tī Sò-lô bīn-chêng. Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Chit-hūn sī ūi-tio̍h lí lâu--ê, chhiáⁿ lí chia̍h. Tī góa iau-chhiáⁿ lâng-kheh ê sî, chiū ū-sian chún-pī, lâu kàu chit-ê sî-chūn.” Hit-ji̍t Sò-lô chiū kap Sat-bó-ní chòe-hé chia̍h.
In tùi soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ lo̍h--lâi, ji̍p-siâⁿ, Sat-bó-ní kap Sò-lô tī chhù-téng kóng-ōe.

Thàu-chá thiⁿ phú-kng ê sî, Sò-lô iáu tī chhù-téng teh khùn, Sat-bó-ní kiò i, “Khí--lâi, góa sàng lí tò--khì.” Sò-lô chiū khí--lâi; i kap Sat-bó-ní nn̄g lâng chhut-khì gōa-bīn.

In kiâⁿ kàu siâⁿ ê kak-thâu, Sat-bó-ní kā Sò-lô kóng, “Kiò po̍k-jîn seng khì.” Po̍k-jîn chiū khì. Sat-bó-ní koh kóng, “Tiàm chia sió tán--chi̍t-ē, góa beh kā lí thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè ê ōe.”
Sat-bó-ní the̍h chi̍t koàn iû, tò tī Sò-lô ê thâu-khak, kā i chim, kóng, “Siōng Chú ēng iû kā lí boah, siat-li̍p lí chòe I chú-bîn ê thóng-tī-chiá.

Kin-á-ji̍t lí lī-khui góa liáu-āu, khì Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu ê Siā-sat, óa-kūn Lúi-kiat ê bōng ê sî, ōe tú-tio̍h nn̄g ê lâng; in ōe kā lí kóng, ‘Lí teh chhē ê lû-á í-keng chhē--tio̍h. Chit-chūn lí ê lāu-pē bô teh hoân-ló lû-á, sī teh khòa-lū lí; i teh mn̄g: Góa ê kiáⁿ lóng bô siau-sit, beh án-chóaⁿ?’

Lí kè-sio̍k tùi hia khì, kàu Tha-po̍k ê siōng-chhiū hia, ōe tú-tio̍h saⁿ ê lâng, in beh khì Pek-te̍k-lī hiàn-chè hō͘ Siōng-tè, chi̍t ê tòa saⁿ chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á, chi̍t ê tòa saⁿ ê piáⁿ, chi̍t ê tòa chi̍t phê-tē ê chiú.
In ōe kā lí chhéng-an, hō͘ lí nn̄g ê piáⁿ; lí tio̍h chiap-siū.

Āu-lâi lí tio̍h khì Siōng-tè ê soaⁿ Ki-pí-a, tī hia ū Hui-lī-sū -lâng teh hông-siú; lí ji̍p-siâⁿ ê sî, ōe tú-tio̍h chi̍t tīn sian-ti tùi soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ lo̍h--lâi; ū lâng tôaⁿ-khîm tôaⁿ-sek, ū lâng phah-kó͘, ū lâng pûn phín-á; in lóng ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe.
Siōng Chú ê sîn ōe tōa-tōa chhiong-móa lí, lí ōe pìⁿ-chòe sin ê lâng, kap in siâng-khoán ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng ê sî, lí chiū chiàu só͘ siū ê kám-tōng khì chòe, in-ūi Siōng-tè kap lí tông-chāi.
Lí lo̍h-khì Kiat-kah, góa mā ōe khì hia hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè. Lí thèng-hāu chhit ji̍t, tán góa kàu lí hia chí-sī lí tio̍h chòe ê tāi-chì.”
Sò-lô oa̍t-tńg-sin lī-khui Sat-bó-ní ê sî, Siōng-tè hō͘ i sin ê sim. Tī hit-ji̍t, Sat-bó-ní kā i kóng ê tāi-chì lóng si̍t-hiān.

Sò-lô kap i ê po̍k-jîn lâi kàu Ki-pí-a, tú-tio̍h chi̍t tīn sian-ti tùi hia chhut--lâi. Hit-sî, Siōng-tè ê sîn tōa-tōa chhiong-móa i, i chiū kap in siâng-khoán ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe.
Chêng-kàu-taⁿ bat i ê lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h i tī sian-ti tiong ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe, chiū mn̄g-lâi-mn̄g-khì, “ Ki-sū ê kiáⁿ sī án-chóaⁿ? Sò-lô mā chòe sian-ti o͘h?”
Ū chi̍t ê hit só͘-chāi ê lâng kóng, “Hiah-ê lâng ê su-hū sī siáⁿ-lâng?” Tùi án-ni ū chi̍t kù sio̍k-gú kóng, “ Sò-lô mā chòe sian-ti o͘h?”
Sò-lô ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe liáu chiū chiūⁿ-khì soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ kèng-pài.
Sò-lô ê a-chek mn̄g Sò-lô kap i ê po̍k-jîn kóng, “Lín khì tó-ūi?” I ìn kóng, “Khì chhē lû-á; chhē bô, chiū khì Sat-bó-ní hia.”
Sò-lô ê a-chek kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kā góa kóng Sat-bó-ní tùi lín kóng sím-mi̍h.”
Sò-lô tùi i ê a-chek kóng, “I chheng-chhó kā goán kóng ‘Lû-á í-keng chhē--tio̍h lah.’” M̄-kú Sò-lô bô kā i ê a-chek thê-khí Sat-bó-ní kóng i beh choh-ông ê sū.
Sat-bó-ní tiàu-chi̍p jîn-bîn kàu Bí-su-pa lâi kìⁿ Siōng Chú.

I tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Góa chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t chhut Ai-ki̍p, kái-kiù lín thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê chhiú kap hiah-ê ap-chè lín ê lia̍t-kok.’

M̄-kú kin-á-ji̍t lín khì-sak chit-ūi kiù lín thoat-lī só͘-ū hoān-lān chai-hō ê Siōng-tè, iau-kiû góa kā lín siat-li̍p chi̍t ê ông thóng-tī lín. Taⁿ tio̍h chiàu lín ê chi-cho̍k, chong-cho̍k lâi khiā tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng.”
Sat-bó-ní kiò Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k chìn-chêng lâi, thiu-tio̍h Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k;

koh kiò Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k chìn-chêng lâi, thiu-tio̍h Má-te̍k-lī -cho̍k; tùi hit tiong-kan koh thiu-tio̍h Ki-sū ê kiáⁿ Sò-lô. Chèng-lâng chhē i, m̄-kú chhē lóng bô.
In chiū koh mn̄g Siōng Chú, “Hit-ê lâng ū lâi chia--bô?” Siōng Chú kóng, “I bih tī hit-tui hêng-lí lāi-bīn.”
In chiū cháu--khì, tùi hia kā Sò-lô chhōa--chhut-lâi; i lâi khiā tī chèng-lâng ê tiong-kan, pí pa̍t-lâng khah koân chi̍t lia̍p thâu.
Sat-bó-ní tùi bîn-chiòng kóng, “Lín ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h-bô? Siōng Chú só͘ kéng ê lâng, bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kap i pí.” Chèng-lâng chiū hoan-ho͘, “Ông bān-sòe!”

Sat-bó-ní chiong ông ê chek-jīm kap koân-lī tùi jîn-bîn soat-bêng, koh kì-chài tī chheh--ni̍h, hē tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng; jiân-āu Sat-bó-ní kái-sàn bîn-chiòng hō͘ in lóng tńg-khì in tau.
Sò-lô mā tò-khì Ki-pí-a i ka-kī ê chhù; ū chi̍t tīn sim siū Siōng-tè kám-tōng ê ióng-sū mā tè i khì.
M̄-kú ū chi̍t-kóa húi-lūi kóng, “Chit-ê lâng ná ōe kiù lán?” In biáu-sī Sò-lô, mā bô sàng i lé-mi̍h; Sò-lô lóng bô kóng sím-mi̍h.
A-bûn -lâng Ná-hat chiūⁿ-khì ûi-kong Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí. Ngá-pí -lâng kā Ná-hat kóng, “Lí kap goán chhiam-iok, goán chiū ho̍k-sāi lí.”
A-bûn -lâng Ná-hat ìn kóng, “Hō͘ góa ó͘ lín ta̍k-ê lâng ê chiàⁿ-ba̍k lâi bú-jio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, góa chiū kap lín chhiam-iok.”
Ngá-pí ê tiúⁿ-ló kā i kóng, “Kiû lí khoan-iông goán chhit ji̍t, goán thang phài lâng khì Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kéng; nā bô lâng beh kiù goán, goán chiū tâu-hâng.”
Só͘ phài ê lâng kàu Sò-lô tòa ê Ki-pí-a, chiong chit-ê siau-sit kóng hō͘ bîn-chiòng thiaⁿ, in chiū lóng tōa-siaⁿ khàu.
Sò-lô tú tùi hn̂g--ni̍h kóaⁿ gû tò--lâi; Sò-lô kóng, “Tāi-ke sī-án-chóaⁿ teh khàu?” In chiū chiong Ngá-pí -lâng ê tāi-chì kā i kóng.
Sò-lô thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê siau-sit, siū Siōng-tè ê sîn tōa-tōa chhiong-móa, hui-siông siū-khì.

I chiū chiong chi̍t tùi gû chhiat-chòe chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè, kau-tài sù-chiá sàng kàu Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kéng, kéng-kò kóng, “Bô chhut-lâi tè Sò-lô kap Sat-bó-ní ê lâng, in ê gû mā ōe án-ni hō͘ lâng chhiat-chòe chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè.” Siōng Chú hō͘ jîn-bîn hui-siông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, in chiū lóng tâng-sim chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t-lâng chhut-lâi èng-chiàn.
Sò-lô tī Pí-sek tiám-sǹg jîn-sò͘, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ū saⁿ-cha̍p-bān, Iû-tāi -lâng ū saⁿ-bān.

In kā phài--lâi ê lâng kóng, “Lín tio̍h án-ni hôe-ho̍k Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí -lâng, kóng, ‘Bîn-á-chài ji̍t tiong-tàu ê sî, lín ōe tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.’” Phài--lâi ê lâng tńg-khì kā Ngá-pí -lâng kóng, in chiū hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí.
Ngá-pí -lâng chiū kā A-bûn -lâng kóng, “Bîn-á-chài goán ōe chhut-lâi tâu-hâng, chhut-chāi lín tùi-thāi goán.”

Keh-ji̍t, Sò-lô kā jîn-bîn pun-chòe saⁿ tūi; thiⁿ teh-beh kng ê sî, in kong-ji̍p A-bûn -lâng ê kun-iâⁿ, it-ti̍t kàu ji̍t tiong-tàu, phah-sí chin chōe lâng; chhun ê lâng lóng sì-sòaⁿ, sûi-lâng tô-miā.
Jîn-bîn kā Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Sī siáⁿ-lâng kóng ‘ Sò-lô ná ōe-tàng tī-lí lán’? Kā in kau--chhut-lâi, goán beh kā thâi--sí.”
Sò-lô kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t chi̍t ê to m̄-thang thâi, in-ūi kin-á-ji̍t Siōng Chú ū chín-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t.”
Sat-bó-ní kā jîn-bîn kóng, “Lâi, lán lâi-khì Kiat-kah, tī hia chèng-sek khak-li̍p ông-koân.”

Choân-pō͘ ê jîn-bîn chiū khì Kiat-kah, tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng siat-li̍p Sò-lô choh-ông, koh hiàn pêng-an-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú. Sò-lô kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng hoaⁿ-hí khèng-chiok.
Sat-bó-ní kā só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, “Lín tùi góa ê iau-kiû, góa lóng ū thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū kā lín siat-li̍p chi̍t ê ông tī-lí lín.

Hiān-chāi lín ū chi̍t ê ông lâi léng-tō lín. Góa í-keng nî-lāu, thâu-mn̂g pe̍h; góa ê kiáⁿ mā lóng kap lín chòe-hé. Góa tùi siàu-liân kàu taⁿ, lóng it-ti̍t teh léng-tō lín.

Góa tī chia. Lín tio̍h tī Siōng Chú kap I só͘ soán-li̍p ê ông bīn-chêng choh-chèng. Góa kiám bat chhiúⁿ lâng ê gû, toa̍t lâng ê lû? Bat khi-hū siáⁿ-lâng, ap-chè siáⁿ-lâng? Bat kā lâng siu hóe-lō͘ chòe bô kong-pêng ê chhâi-koat? Nā ū, góa lóng beh hêng lín.”
In ìn kóng, “Lí m̄-bat khi-hū goán, m̄-bat ap-chè goán, mā m̄-bat tùi lâng the̍h sím-mi̍h.”

I kā in kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t, lín bōe-tàng chhē-tio̍h góa ū chòe sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h. Siōng Chú kap I só͘ soán-li̍p ê ông lóng ūi góa choh-chèng.” Jîn-bîn ìn kóng, “Siōng Chú choh-chèng.”
Sat-bó-ní kā jîn-bîn kóng, “Í-chêng Siōng Chú jīm-bēng Mô͘-se kap A-lûn, chhōa lín ê chó͘-sian chhut Ai-ki̍p.

Taⁿ lín tio̍h khiā hó-sè. Góa beh tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kā lín khòng-kò, kā lín thê-chhíⁿ, Siōng Chú ū ūi-tio̍h lín kap lín ê chó͘-sian chòe chin chōe chín-kiù ê tōa-sū.
Chá-chêng, Ngá-kok khì Ai-ki̍p liáu-āu, lín ê chó͘-sian ū kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, Siōng Chú chiū chhe Mô͘-se kap A-lûn chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p, hō͘ in tī chit-ê só͘-chāi tēng-ku.
M̄-kú in bōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè, I chiū kā in kau hō͘ Hā-só ê chiong-kun Se-se-la, Hui-lī-sū -lâng, kap Mô͘-ap -ông, chhut-chāi hiah-ê lâng lâi kong-kek.

In kiû-kiò Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Goán ū hoān-chōe, in-ūi goán lī-khui Siōng Chú khì ho̍k-sāi Pa-le̍k kap A-su-tha-lio̍k. Kiû lí kiù goán thoat-lī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú, goán chiū beh ho̍k-sāi lí.’
Siōng Chú chiū chhe Ki-tiân, Pa-la, Iâ-hut-tha, kap góa Sat-bó-ní, kiù lín thoat-lī sì-ûi tùi-te̍k ê chhiú, lín chiah ōe-tàng pêng-an khiā-khí.

M̄-kú, A-bûn -lâng ê ông Ná-hat chi̍t-ē lâi kong-kek lín, lín chiū tùi góa kóng, ‘Goán bô ài, goán it-tēng beh ū chi̍t ê ông kā goán thóng-tī.’ Kî-si̍t Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sī lín ê ông.
Taⁿ khòaⁿ leh, lín só͘ kéng só͘ kiû ê ông tī chia. Siōng Chú í-keng siat-li̍p chi̍t ê ông thóng-tī lín.
Lín nā kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, ho̍k-sāi I, thiaⁿ I ê ōe, bô ûi-pōe I ê bēng-lēng, lín kap tī-lí lín ê ông mā sūn-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, án-ni chiū chin hó.
Lín nā m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú ê ōe, ûi-pōe I ê bēng-lēng, Siōng Chú ê chhiú ōe kong-kek lín, chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-chêng kong-kek lín ê chó͘-sian siâng-khoán.
Taⁿ khiā hó-sè, lâi khòaⁿ Siōng Chú tī lín ba̍k-chiu-chêng beh chòe ê úi-tāi ê sū.

Kin-á-ji̍t kiám m̄-sī koah sió-be̍h bô hō͘-chúi ê sî? Góa beh kiû Siōng Chú, I ōe khí-lûi lo̍h-hō͘, hō͘ lín ia̍h chai ia̍h khòaⁿ-chhut lín ūi ka-kī iau-kiû siat-li̍p ông, tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng sī hoān tōa-chōe.”
Sat-bó-ní kî-kiû Siōng Chú, Siōng Chú chiū tī chit-ji̍t khí-lûi lo̍h-hō͘; chèng-lâng chiū kiaⁿ-ùi Siōng Chú kap Sat-bó-ní.

In kā Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí thòe lí ê po̍k-jîn kî-kiû Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè, goán chiah bián sí, in-ūi goán ūi ka-kī kiû chi̍t ê ông, chin-chiàⁿ sī chōe-siōng-ka-chōe.”
Sat-bó-ní kā jîn-bîn kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ, sui-jiân lín chòe chit-ê pháiⁿ tāi-chì, m̄-kú m̄-thang phian-lī bô tè Siōng Chú; chí-ū tio̍h choân-sim ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú;
m̄-thang phian-lī Siōng Chú khì tè hu-ké ê sîn-bêng, in-ūi in hu-ké bô lō͘-ēng, bōe-tàng kiù lín.
Kì-jiân Siōng Chú kéng-soán lín chòe I ê chú-bîn, ūi-tio̍h beh chhî-siú ka-kī chun-kùi ê miâ, I it-tēng bōe khì-sak lín.
Góa leh, góa it-tēng put-toān thòe lín kî-tó; nā bô, góa chiū tek-chōe Siōng Chú. Góa beh chí-sī lín hó koh chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘.
Lín chí-ū tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, sêng-sim-si̍t-ì ho̍k-sāi I; tio̍h ōe-kì-tit I ūi-tio̍h lín só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì jōa-á-ni̍h tōa.
Lín nā kè-sio̍k chòe pháiⁿ, lín kap lín ê ông it-tēng ōe chòe-chi̍t-ē bia̍t-bông.”
Sò-lô chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông nn̄g nî āu,

tùi Í-sek-lia̍t tiong kéng saⁿ-chheng lâng; nn̄g-chheng ê tè Sò-lô chū-chāi tī Bi̍t-boat kap Pek-te̍k-lī soaⁿ-khu, chi̍t-chheng ê tè Iok-ná-tan chū-chāi tī Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu ê Ki-pí-a; kî-tha ê lâng hō͘ in tò-khì ka-kī ê chhù.

Iok-ná-tan kong-kek tī Ka-pa ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê kun-iâⁿ; chit-ê siau-sit tī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tiong-kan thoân-khui. Sò-lô hoan-hù lâng tī choân-tōe pûn sàu-kak, kiò Hi-pek-lâi -lâng tio̍h chù-ì.

Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Sò-lô kong-kek Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê kun-iâⁿ, koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h Hui-lī-sū -lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, jîn-bîn chiū tè Sò-lô chū-chi̍p tī Kiat-kah.

Hui-lī-sū -lâng chū-chi̍p beh kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; ū chiàn-chhia saⁿ-bān tâi, bé-peng la̍k-chheng, pō͘-peng chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-soa hiah chōe. In chiūⁿ-lâi tī Pek A-bûn tang-pêng ê Bi̍t-boat chat-iâⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h kun-tūi siū pau-ûi, chêng-hêng gûi-kip, chiū khì bih tī soaⁿ-tōng, chhiū-nâ, chio̍h-hia̍t, pōng-khang, kap ta-chíⁿ.
Koh ū chi̍t-kóa lâng kè Iok-tàn-hô kàu Ka-tek kap Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu. Sò-lô iáu tī Kiat-kah; tè i ê lâng lóng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.
Sò-lô chiàu Sat-bó-ní koat-tēng ê ji̍t-kî, thèng-hāu chhit ji̍t. In-ūi Sat-bó-ní iáu-bē lâi kàu Kiat-kah, tè Sò-lô ê lâng chiū khai-sí sì-sòaⁿ.
Sò-lô kóng, “Chiong sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè ê chè-mi̍h the̍h-lâi góa chia.” I chiū hiàn sio-hòa-chè.
I hiàn sio-hòa-chè tú-á beh oân-sêng, Sat-bó-ní lâi kàu-ūi. Sò-lô chhut-khì gêng-chiap beh kā i chhéng-an.

Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Lí teh chòe sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?” Sò-lô kóng, “In-ūi góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h jîn-bîn sì-sòaⁿ lī-khui góa, lí mā bô chiàu koat-tēng ê ji̍t-kî lâi, koh Hui-lī-sū -lâng í-keng chū-chi̍p tī Bi̍t-boat;
só͘-í góa siūⁿ-kóng Hui-lī-sū -lâng teh-beh lâi kàu Kiat-kah kong-kek góa, koh góa iáu-bē kiû Siōng Chú si-un, góa chiah ko͘-put-chiong hiàn sio-hòa-chè.”

Sat-bó-ní tùi Sò-lô kóng, “Lí ná chiah hô͘-tô͘! Lí bô chun-siú Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ài lí siú ê kài-bēng. Lí nā ū siú, Siōng Chú ōe kian-kò͘ lí tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong ê ông-ūi kàu éng-oán.

Taⁿ lí ê ông-ūi bōe kú-tn̂g; Siōng Chú í-keng chhē-tio̍h chi̍t ê ha̍p I sim-ì ê lâng, koat-tēng beh hō͘ i chòe I chú-bîn ê léng-siù, in-ūi lí bô chun-siú Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng.”
Sat-bó-ní chiū chhut-hoat, tùi Kiat-kah chiūⁿ-khì Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu ê Ki-pí-a. Sò-lô tiám-sǹg tè i ê lâng, iok ū la̍k-pah lâng.
Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan, í-ki̍p tè in ê lâng lóng tiàm tī Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu ê Ka-pa. M̄-kú Hui-lī-sū -lâng tī Bi̍t-boat chat-iâⁿ.
Ū tu̍t-kek-tūi tùi Hui-lī-sū kun-iâⁿ chhut--lâi, pun-chòe saⁿ tūi, chi̍t tūi tùi Gô-hut-la ê lō͘ khì Su-a-le̍k tōe-khu;
chi̍t tūi tùi Pek Hô-lûn ê lō͘ khì; koh chi̍t tūi tùi khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h Sé-pho-im Soaⁿ-kok, thàng kàu khòng-iá hit-tiâu pian-kài ê lō͘ khì.
Hit-sî Í-sek-lia̍t choân-tōe bô phah-thih sai-hū, in-ūi Hui-lī-sū -lâng kiaⁿ Hi-pek-lâi -lâng chè-chō to kap chhiuⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng beh bôa tî-thâu, lôe, pó͘-thâu, ku̍t-á, lóng tio̍h lo̍h-khì Hui-lī-sū -lâng hia;
nā beh bôa tî-thâu, lôe, tio̍h nn̄g ê tâng-chîⁿ; bôa pó͘-thâu kap chhì-kùn, tio̍h chi̍t ê tâng-chîⁿ;
só͘-í kàu kau-chiàn ê sî, tè Sò-lô kap Iok-ná-tan ê lâng bô chi̍t ê chhiú--ni̍h ū to á-sī chhiuⁿ; chí-ū Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan ū.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng ū phài peng chhut-khì hông-siú Bi̍t-boat ê ài-kháu.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan kā gia̍h i ê kun-khì ê siàu-liân-lâng kóng, “Lán lâi-khì Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê kun-iâⁿ hit-pêng.” M̄-kú Iok-ná-tan bô kā i ê lāu-pē kóng.
Sò-lô tī Ki-pí-a ê kau-gōa, chē tī Bí-ki-lûn ê sia̍h-liû chhiū-kha; tè i ê lâng iok ū la̍k-pah.

Koh ū A-hi-tu̍t ê kiáⁿ A-hi-ngá tòa í-hut-tek lâi tī hia. I sī Í-ka-phok ê hiaⁿ-ko, Hui-nî-hap ê kiáⁿ, sī bat tī Sī-lô chòe Siōng Chú chè-si ê Í-lī ê sun. Bô lâng chai Iok-ná-tan í-keng lī-khui iâⁿ-tōe.
Iok-ná-tan beh khì Hui-lī-sū ê kun-iâⁿ tio̍h keng-kè ê ài-kháu, nn̄g pêng lóng sī chiam-chiam chin kiā ê chio̍h-piah, chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Pò͘-sih, chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Se-nî;
pak-pêng ê chio̍h-piah kap Bi̍t-boat sio-tùi, lâm-pêng ê chio̍h-piah kap Ka-pa sio-tùi.

Iok-ná-tan kā gia̍h i ê kun-khì ê siàu-liân-lâng kóng, “Lâi, lán lâi-khì bô siū kat-lé ê lâng ê kun-iâⁿ hia, khó-lêng Siōng Chú ōe pang-chān lán, in-ūi Siōng Chú hō͘ lâng tek-sèng m̄-sī chāi-tī lâng chōe lâng chió.”
Gia̍h kun-khì--ê kā i kóng, “Góa kap lí tâng-sim, lí chiàu lí só͘ ài--ê khì chòe; lí chòe chêng, góa tè lí.”
Iok-ná-tan kóng, “Lâi! Lán kè lâi-khì in hia, hō͘ in khòaⁿ-tio̍h lán;
in nā kā lán kóng ‘Khiā leh! Tán goán kè--khì’, lán chiū tiāⁿ-tiāⁿ khiā--teh, mài chiūⁿ--khì.
M̄-kú in nā kóng ‘Lâi goán chia’, lán chiū chiūⁿ--khì; che sī Siōng Chú chiong in kau tī lán ê chhiú ê kì-hō.”
In nn̄g lâng chiū thiau-kò͘-ì hō͘ Hui-lī-sū hông-siú ê peng khòaⁿ--tio̍h; Hui-lī-sū -lâng kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, Hi-pek-lâi -lâng tùi in bih ê tōng chhut--lâi lah.”

Hông-siú ê peng kā Iok-ná-tan kap gia̍h kun-khì ê lâng kóng, “Lín kè--lâi, goán beh hō͘ lín chai-sí.” Iok-ná-tan chiū kā gia̍h kun-khì--ê kóng, “Lí tè góa chiūⁿ--khì; in-ūi Siōng Chú í-keng chiong in kau tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chhiú.”
Iok-ná-tan chiū chhiú-khîⁿ-kha-lèng peh--khí-khì, gia̍h kun-khì--ê tè i. Iok-ná-tan phah-tó Hui-lī-sū -lâng, gia̍h kun-khì--ê tè āu-bīn thâi-sí in.
Tē-it piàn tu̍t-kek, Iok-ná-tan kap gia̍h kun-khì--ê tī sì-hūn-chi̍t kong-khéng lāi thâi-sí iok jī-cha̍p lâng.

Só͘-ū ê Hui-lī-sū kun-peng, bô-lūn tī kun-iâⁿ, tī iá-gōa; bô-lūn hông-ōe--ê, tu̍t-kek--ê, lóng kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah; tāi-tōe mā iô-tāng, che sī Siōng-tè kàng-lo̍h hō͘ in ê tōa khióng-pò͘.
Tī Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu ê Ki-pí-a, Sò-lô ê sàu-peng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Hui-lī-sū kun-peng sì-sòaⁿ, sì-kòe loān-chông.
Sò-lô kā tè i ê kun-peng kóng, “Lín tiám-sǹg, khòaⁿ siáⁿ-lâng tùi lán chia chhut--khì.” In sǹg liáu, chiū chai Iok-ná-tan kap kā i gia̍h kun-khì ê lâng bô tī hia.
Sò-lô kā A-hi-ngá kóng, “Lí chiong Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi kng--lâi.” Hit-chūn Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hia.
Sò-lô kap chè-si kóng-ōe ê sî, Hui-lī-sū iâⁿ-tiong hán-hoah ê siaⁿ jú lâi jú tōa. Sò-lô chiū kā chè-si kóng, “Bián lah! Bōe hù mn̄g lo͘h!”
Sò-lô kap tè i ê kun-peng lóng chū-chi̍p lâi kàu chiàn-tiûⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Hui-lī-sū -lâng hō͘-siōng chân-sat, tōa hūn-loān.
Í-chêng óa Hui-lī-sū -lâng, tùi ta̍k só͘-chāi lâi kàu in iâⁿ-tiong ê Hi-pek-lâi -lâng, hiān-chāi hoán-tò-tńg lâi pang-chān tè Sò-lô kap Iok-ná-tan ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Hiah-ê bih tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Hui-lī-sū -lâng tô-cháu, chiū chhut-lâi tui-sat in, kap in kau-chiàn.
Hit-ji̍t Siōng Chú hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t tek-sèng; chiàn-cheng iân-sio̍k kàu Pek A-bûn hit-pêng.

Hit-ji̍t Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng iau kah chin kan-khó͘, in-ūi Sò-lô ū chiù-chōa, bēng-lēng kun-peng kóng, “Bô tán kàu ji̍t àm, góa kā tùi-te̍k pò oan-siû liáu chiū chia̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê lâng tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘.” Só͘-í kun-peng lóng bô chia̍h sím-mi̍h.
In ji̍p chhiū-nâ, hoat-kiàn chit só͘-chāi thô͘-kha lóng ū bi̍t.
Kun-peng ji̍p chhiū-nâ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū bi̍t teh tih, m̄-kú bô lâng káⁿ ēng chńg-thâu-á uih lâi chia̍h, in-ūi kiaⁿ siū chiù-chó͘.
Iok-ná-tan bô thiaⁿ-tio̍h in lāu-pē ê chiù-chōa, só͘-í chhun koáiⁿ-á-bé tu̍h bi̍t-pô͘, jiân-āu ēng chńg-thâu-á uih lâi chia̍h, ba̍k-chiu chiū kim, hôe-ho̍k goân-khì.

Ū chi̍t ê kun-peng tùi i kóng, “Lí ê lāu-pē ū giâm-giâm chiù-chōa bēng-lēng kun-peng kóng, ‘Kin-á-ji̍t chia̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ--ê tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘.’ Só͘-í kun-peng chin ià-siān.”
Iok-ná-tan kóng, “Goán lāu-pē ū hāi-tio̍h lán chiah-ê kun-peng. Lín khòaⁿ, góa kan-ta tam chi̍t-tiám-á bi̍t, chiū hôe-ho̍k goân-khì;
kin-á-ji̍t nā chhut-chāi kun-peng chia̍h in kā tùi-te̍k chhiúⁿ--lâi ê chia̍h-mi̍h, kiám m̄-sī koh-khah ū-la̍t thang phah-sí khah chōe Hui-lī-sū -lâng?”
Hit-ji̍t, in phah-pāi Hui-lī-sū -lâng, tùi Bi̍t-boat kóaⁿ kàu A-ngá-lûn; kun-peng hui-siông ià-siān.
Kun-peng chông-khì lia̍h só͘ chhiúⁿ ê gû, iûⁿ, gû-á-kiáⁿ, chiū tī hia thâi, chia̍h kâⁿ-huih ê bah.

Ū lâng kā Sò-lô pò-kò, “Kun-peng ū hoān-chōe ûi-pōe Siōng Chú, in-ūi in chia̍h kâⁿ-huih ê bah.” Sò-lô tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Lín tek-chōe Siōng Chú lah! Taⁿ khì kō chi̍t tè tōa chio̍h lâi chia.”

Sò-lô koh kóng, “Lín tio̍h khì kiò ta̍k-ê kun-peng khan in ê gû kap iûⁿ lâi góa chia, tī chia thâi lâi chia̍h; m̄-thang chia̍h kâⁿ-huih ê bah lâi tek-chōe Siōng Chú.” Hit-mî kun-peng lóng khan in ka-kī ê gû khì hia thâi.
Sò-lô kā Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ; che sī i thâu chi̍t piàn kā Siōng Chú khí ê tôaⁿ.

Sò-lô kóng, “Taⁿ lán tio̍h thàu-mî lo̍h-khì jip Hui-lī-sū -lâng, kā in chhiúⁿ, ti̍t-kàu thiⁿ-kng, kā in lóng thâi-sí, liân chi̍t ê to m̄-thang lâu--teh.” Kun-peng kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê, chiū chiàu án-ni chòe.” Chè-si kóng, “Lán tio̍h tāi-seng mn̄g Siōng-tè.”
Sò-lô chiū mn̄g Siōng-tè, “Góa tio̍h lo̍h-khì jip Hui-lī-sū -lâng bô? Lí kiám ōe kā in kau hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng?” Hit-ji̍t Siōng-tè bô ìn i.
Sò-lô kóng, “Lín kun-tūi ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ lóng lâi góa chia, cha-bêng lán kin-á-ji̍t ū hoān-tio̍h sím-mi̍h chōe.
Góa kí hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t sèng-lī ê éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, ‘Hoān-chōe ê lâng lóng tio̍h sí, sīm-chì góa ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan, mā tio̍h sí.’” M̄-kú bô lâng ìn i.

I chiū kā Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng kóng, “Lín khiā hit-pêng, góa kap góa ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan khiā chit-pêng.” Kun-peng tùi Sò-lô kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê, chiū chiàu án-ni chòe.”
Sò-lô tùi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè kóng, “Kiû lí chí-sī si̍t-chêng, khòaⁿ siáⁿ-lâng ū chōe.” In chiū thiu-tio̍h Iok-ná-tan kap Sò-lô, kun-peng bô tāi-chì.
Sò-lô kóng, “Tio̍h tī góa kap góa ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan tiong-kan thiu khòaⁿ siáⁿ-lâng ū chōe.” In thiu-tio̍h Iok-ná-tan.
Sò-lô kā Iok-ná-tan kóng, “Lí kā góa kóng, lí ū chòe sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.” Iok-ná-tan kóng, “Góa khak-si̍t ū ēng koáiⁿ-á-bé uih chi̍t-tiám-á bi̍t lâi tam. Góa kam-goān sí.”
Sò-lô kóng, “ Iok-ná-tan, lí it-tēng tio̍h sí; nā bô, goān Siōng-tè ka-pē chek-hoa̍t góa.”

Kun-peng kā Sò-lô kóng, “ Iok-ná-tan ū hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t tit-tio̍h tōa sèng-lī, i kiám tio̍h sí? Choa̍t-tùi m̄-thang! Goán kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, i liân chi̍t ki thâu-mn̂g to bōe-ēng-tit hō͘ i lak-lo̍h thô͘-kha, in-ūi i kin-á-ji̍t só͘ chòe--ê ū Siōng-tè ê pang-chān.” Án-ni, kun-peng kiù Iok-ná-tan bián sí.
Sò-lô bô koh tui-jip Hui-lī-sū -lâng; Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiū tńg-khì in pún só͘-chāi.

Sò-lô khak-li̍p Í-sek-lia̍t ông-koân liáu-āu, khì kong-táⁿ chiu-ûi só͘-ū ê tùi-te̍k, chiū-sī Mô͘-ap -lâng, A-bûn -lâng, Í-tong -lâng, Hui-lī-sū -lâng, kap Só-pa ê chu-ông; i pek-chiàn-pek-sèng, phah kàu tó-ūi iâⁿ kàu tó-ūi.
Sò-lô hùn-ióng phah-pāi A-má-le̍k -lâng, kiù Í-sek-lia̍t thoat-lī chhiúⁿ-kiap in ê lâng ê chhiú.
Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ ū Iok-ná-tan, E̍k-si-úi, Be̍k-ki Su-a; i ū nn̄g ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, tōa--ê kiò-chòe Bí-la, sòe--ê kiò-chòe Bí-kah.
Sò-lô ê bó͘ kiò-chòe A-hi-loán, sī A-hi-má-su ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; i ê goân-sòe kiò-chòe Ap-nî-ní, sī Sò-lô ê a-chek Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ.
Sò-lô ê lāu-pē Ki-sū, Ap-nî-ní ê lāu-pē Nî-ní, lóng sī A-pia̍t ê kiáⁿ.
Sò-lô it-seng siông-siông kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng ū ke̍k-lia̍t ê kau-chiàn; i khòaⁿ-tio̍h kiông-béng ê lâng kap ióng-sū, lóng chio-chi̍p in ka-ji̍p i ê pō͘-tūi.

Sat-bó-ní kā Sò-lô kóng, “Siōng Chú chhe góa lâi kā lí boah-iû, siat-li̍p lí choh-ông, tī-lí I ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t. Só͘-í, lí tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú só͘ kóng ê ōe.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh hêng-hoa̍t A-má-le̍k -lâng, in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî, A-má-le̍k -lâng bat chó͘-gāi te̍k-tùi in.
Taⁿ lí tio̍h khì phah A-má-le̍k -lâng, kā in châu-bia̍t. Sím-mi̍h to m̄-thang lâu--teh; tio̍h chiong lâm, lú, gín-á, eⁿ-á, kap gû, iûⁿ, lo̍k-tô, lû, lóng thâi-sí.’”
Sò-lô chiū tiàu-chi̍p kun-peng tī Thê-liān, tiám-sǹg jîn-sò͘, pō͘-peng jī-cha̍p-bān, Iû-tāi -lâng chi̍t-bān.
Sò-lô lâi kàu A-má-le̍k ê siâⁿ, bâi-ho̍k tī soaⁿ-kok tiong.

Sò-lô kā Ki-nî -lâng kóng, “Lín lī-khui A-má-le̍k -lâng khì pa̍t-ūi, chiah bián góa kā lín kap in chòe-chi̍t-ē châu-bia̍t; in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî, lín bat hó khoán-thāi in.” Ki-nî -lâng chiū lī-khui A-má-le̍k -lâng.
Sò-lô kong-kek A-má-le̍k -lâng, tùi Hap-hui-la kàu Ai-ki̍p tang-pêng ê Su-ní.
I oa̍h-lia̍h A-má-le̍k -ông A-kah, thâi-sí i lóng-chóng ê jîn-bîn.

M̄-kú Sò-lô kap kun-peng lâu A-kah, kap siōng-hó ê gû, iûⁿ, gû-á, iûⁿ-á, í-ki̍p it-chhè ê hó-mi̍h, m̄-khéng kā in châu-bia̍t, chí-ū húi-bia̍t hiah-ê bô lō͘-ēng, bô kè-ta̍t ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ.
Siōng Chú tùi Sat-bó-ní kóng,
“Góa hō͘-hóe soán-li̍p Sò-lô choh-ông, in-ūi i pōe-poān góa, bô chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng.” Sat-bó-ní chin chhoeh-sim, kui-mî kiû-kiò Siōng Chú.
Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, Sat-bó-ní beh khì kìⁿ Sò-lô; ū lâng kā Sat-bó-ní kóng, “ Sò-lô í-keng khì Ka-bi̍t, tī hia ūi-tio̍h ka-kī khiā chio̍h-pi, āu-lâi oat-khì Kiat-kah.”
Sat-bó-ní kàu Sò-lô hia, Sò-lô kā i kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú sù-hok lí. Góa í-keng chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chòe lah.”
Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Án-ni o͘h? Góa ná ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h gû kap iûⁿ teh háu ê siaⁿ?”

Sò-lô kóng, “Hiah-ê sī góa ê kun-peng tùi A-má-le̍k -lâng hia lia̍h--lâi-ê; in-ūi in lâu siōng-hó ê gû, iûⁿ, beh hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè; kî-tha--ê goán lóng ū kā châu-bia̍t.”
Sat-bó-ní kā Sò-lô kóng, “Lí tiām--khì! Góa beh kā lí kóng chā-mî Siōng Chú kā góa kóng ê ōe.” Sò-lô kā i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kóng.”

Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Sui-jiân lí khòaⁿ ka-kī chòe bî-sòe, Siōng Chú kiám m̄-sī hō͘ lí chòe Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k ê léng-siù? Siōng Chú ēng iû boah lí choh-ông, lâi tī-lí Í-sek-lia̍t.
Siōng Chú koh phài lí khì, bēng-lēng lí kóng, ‘Lí khì kap siâ-ok ê A-má-le̍k -lâng kau-chiàn, tio̍h kā in lóng châu-bia̍t.’
Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ bô thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú ê ōe, chông-khì chhiúⁿ chiàn-lī-phín, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê tāi-chì?”
Sò-lô kā Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Góa ū thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, chiàu I ê chí-sī khì kau-chiàn, lia̍h A-má-le̍k -ông A-kah lâi, koh thâi-sí só͘-ū ê A-má-le̍k -lâng.
M̄-kú góa ê kun-peng tùi eng-kai tio̍h húi-bia̍t ê chiàn-lī-phín tiong-kan, lâu siōng-hó ê gû kap iûⁿ, tòa-lâi Kiat-kah beh hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè.”

Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Siōng Chú kiám ì-ài sio-hòa-chè kap chè-mi̍h, khah iâⁿ ì-ài lâng chun-thàn I ê ōe? Lí tio̍h chai, thiaⁿ-thàn pí hiàn-chè khah hó, sūn-thàn iâⁿ-kè iûⁿ-káng ê iû.
Pōe-poān chhin-chhiūⁿ kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t sī hoān-chōe; chū-ko chhin-chhiūⁿ pài ngó͘-siōng sī siâ-ok. In-ūi lí khì-sak Siōng Chú ê ōe, I mā khì-sak lí, m̄ hō͘ lí choh-ông.”
Sò-lô tùi Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Góa ū hoān-chōe, ûi-pōe Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng kap lí ê ōe, in-ūi góa kiaⁿ kun-peng, thiaⁿ in ê ōe.
Taⁿ, kiû lí sià-bián góa ê chōe, kap góa chòe-hé tò--khì, hō͘ góa thang kèng-pài Siōng Chú.”
Sat-bó-ní kā Sò-lô kóng, “Góa m̄ kap lí tò--khì; in-ūi lí khì-sak Siōng Chú ê ōe; Siōng Chú mā khì-sak lí, m̄ hō͘ lí chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông.”
Sat-bó-ní oa̍t-tńg-sin beh lī-khui, Sò-lô khiú i ê saⁿ-á-ku, saⁿ soah li̍h--khì.
Sat-bó-ní kā i kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t Siōng Chú hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -kok kap lí toān-choa̍t koan-hē, chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -kok kau hō͘ chi̍t ê tī lí sin-piⁿ, pí lí khah hó ê lâng.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê Tāi-lêng-chiá, bōe pe̍h-chha̍t, mā bōe kái-piàn sim-ì; in-ūi I m̄-sī sè-kan-lâng, I bōe kái-piàn sim-ì.”

Sò-lô kóng, “Góa ū hoān-chōe; chhiáⁿ lí tī hū-ló kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bīn-chêng chun-tiōng góa, kap góa chòe-hé tò--khì, hō͘ góa thang kèng-pài Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè.”
Sat-bó-ní chiū oa̍t-tńg-sin tè Sò-lô tò--khì; Sò-lô chiū kèng-pài Siōng Chú.
Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Lín chhōa A-má-le̍k -ông A-kah lâi góa chia.” A-kah chiū kiaⁿ-kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ-hiâⁿ lâi kàu Sat-bó-ní bīn-chêng; A-kah kóng, “Góa sí-kî kàu lah.”

Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Lí bat ēng to thâi-sí hū-jîn-lâng ê kiáⁿ, lín lāu-bú ê kiáⁿ mā ōe hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.” Sat-bó-ní tī Kiat-kah, tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng, chiong A-kah chām-chòe chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè.
Sat-bó-ní tò-khì La-má; Sò-lô tńg-khì Ki-pí-a i ê chhù.
Sat-bó-ní sí í-chêng, bô koh kap Sò-lô kìⁿ-bīn; i ūi-tio̍h Sò-lô iu-siong. Siōng Chú mā in-ūi ū siat-li̍p Sò-lô chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kan-khó͘-sim.

Siōng Chú kā Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Góa í-keng khì-sak Sò-lô, bô ài i koh choh Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, lí beh ūi-tio̍h i iu-siong jōa kú? Lí ēng iû kā kak tóe hō͘ móa, chún-pī chhut-hoat, góa beh chhe lí khì Pek-lī-hêng -lâng Iâ-se hia; góa tī i ê kiáⁿ tiong-kan í-keng kéng chi̍t ê beh choh-ông.”
Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Góa ná thang khì? Sò-lô nā thiaⁿ--tio̍h ōe thâi góa.” Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí tòa chi̍t chiah bú ê gû-á khì, kóng lí sī beh khì hiàn-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Lí tio̍h chhiáⁿ Iâ-se lâi hù chit-ê chè-sū; góa beh chí-sī lí eng-kai chòe ê sū; góa kā lí chí-sī hit-ê lâng, lí tio̍h thòe góa kā i boah-iû choh-ông.”
Sat-bó-ní chiàu Siōng Chú ê ōe khì chòe, khì kàu Pek-lī-hêng; siâⁿ-lāi ê tiúⁿ-ló lóng phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah chhut-lâi gêng-chiap i, kóng, “Lí kiám sī tòa pêng-an lâi?”

I kóng, “Sī, sī tòa pêng-an lâi. Góa lâi sī beh hiàn-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú. Lín tio̍h kiat-chēng ka-kī, kap góa chòe-hé hù chè-sū.” Sat-bó-ní chiū kā Iâ-se kap i ê kiáⁿ kiat-chēng, jiân-āu chhiáⁿ in chham-ka chè-sū.
In lâi ê sî, Sat-bó-ní khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-lī-ap, sim-lāi siūⁿ, “Khiā tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng chit-ê it-tēng sī I só͘ soán-li̍p ê lâng.”

M̄-kú Siōng Chú kā Sat-bó-ní kóng, “M̄-thang khòaⁿ i ê gōa-piáu, sin-châi tōa-hàn; góa kéng--ê m̄-sī chit-ê. Siōng Chú teh khòaⁿ bô chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng teh khòaⁿ; lâng khòaⁿ gōa-piáu, Siōng Chú khòaⁿ lāi-sim.”
Āu-lâi Iâ-se kiò A-pí-ná-ta̍t tùi Sat-bó-ní bīn-chêng kiâⁿ--kè; Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Siōng Chú mā bô kéng chit-ê.”
Iâ-se koh kiò Sa-má keng-kè; Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Siōng Chú mā bô kéng chit-ê.”
Iâ-se hō͘ i chhit ê kiáⁿ lóng tùi Sat-bó-ní bīn-chêng kiâⁿ--kè. Sat-bó-ní kā Iâ-se kóng, “Siōng Chú lóng bô kéng in.”

Sat-bó-ní koh kā Iâ-se kóng, “Lí ê kiáⁿ kiám lóng tī chia?” I ìn kóng, “Iáu ū chi̍t ê soah-bé-kiáⁿ, i chit-chūn teh chhī iûⁿ.” Sat-bó-ní kā Iâ-se kóng, “Lí chhe lâng khì kiò i lâi; i iáu-bē lâi, lán bô beh chē-toh.”
Iâ-se phài lâng khì kiò i lâi. I âng-ko-chhiah-chhi̍h, ba̍k-chiu ū-sîn, siⁿ-chòe eng-chùn. Siōng Chú kóng, “Chit-ê chiū-sī; lí kā i boah-iû.”

Sat-bó-ní chiū tī Tāi-pi̍t hiah-ê hiaⁿ-ko bīn-chêng ēng kak-lāi ê iû kā i boah. Tùi hit-ji̍t khí, Siōng Chú ê sîn oân-choân chi-phòe Tāi-pi̍t. Sat-bó-ní chiū chhut-hoat tò-khì La-má.
Siōng Chú ê sîn lī-khui Sò-lô, chiū ū pháiⁿ-sîn tùi Siōng Chú hia lâi hō͘ i khí kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Sò-lô ê jîn-sîn tùi i kóng, “Taⁿ ū pháiⁿ-sîn tùi Siōng-tè hia lâi hō͘ lí kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Chhiáⁿ ông bēng-lēng kun-sûi lí ê pō͘-hā chhē chi̍t ê gâu tôaⁿ-khîm ê lâng lâi, án-ni, tùi Siōng-tè hia lâi ê pháiⁿ-sîn lâi ê sî, kiò i tôaⁿ-khîm, lí chiū ōe hó.”
Sò-lô kā i ê jîn-sîn kóng, “Lín kā góa chhē chi̍t ê gâu tôaⁿ-khîm--ê, kā i chhōa-lâi góa chia.”

Ū chi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng kóng, “Góa bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pek-lī-hêng -lâng Iâ-se chi̍t ê kiáⁿ gâu tôaⁿ-khîm; i sī ióng-kám ê chiàn-sū, kháu-châi hó, gōa-piáu eng-chùn, koh ū Siōng Chú kap i tông-chāi.”
Sò-lô chhe sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Iâ-se, kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí khì kiò lí hit-ê teh kò͘-iûⁿ ê kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t lâi góa chia.”
Iâ-se chiū kiò i ê kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t ēng lû-á chài chin chōe piáⁿ, chi̍t phê-tē chiú, kap chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á, tòa-khì sàng Sò-lô.
Tāi-pi̍t kàu Sò-lô hia, kā i sū-hāu. Sò-lô chin thiàⁿ i, kéng i chòe sī-ōe, thòe Sò-lô gia̍h kun-khì.
Sò-lô chhe lâng khì kā Iâ-se kóng, “Góa chin kah-ì Tāi-pi̍t. Chhiáⁿ lí hō͘ i tī góa sin-piⁿ sū-hāu góa.”
Ta̍k-piàn, tùi Siōng-tè hia lâi ê pháiⁿ-sîn lîm-kàu Sò-lô ê sî, Tāi-pi̍t lóng ōe tôaⁿ-khîm, Sò-lô sim-chêng chiū khin-sang, hôe-ho̍k goân-khì; pháiⁿ-sîn chiū lī-khui i.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng chū-chi̍p kun-tūi beh kau-chiàn; in tī Iû-tāi ê So-ko chi̍p-ha̍p, tī So-ko kap A-se-ka tiong-kan ê Í-hut Tāi-bín chat-iâⁿ.
Sò-lô kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng mā chū-chi̍p, tī Í-la ê soaⁿ-kok chat-iâⁿ, pâi-tīn beh tùi-khòng Hui-lī-sū -lâng.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hun-pia̍t tī nn̄g pêng ê soaⁿ pâi-tīn, tiong-kan ū soaⁿ-kok keh-khui.
Ū chi̍t ê Hui-lī-sū ióng-sū Ka-te̍k -lâng Ko-lī-a tùi iâⁿ-lāi kiâⁿ--chhut-lâi, ǹg Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thiau-chiàn; i koân saⁿ kong-chhioh khah ke,
thâu-khak tì tâng ê thâu-khoe, seng-khu chhēng ū lân ê chiàn-kah, chiàn-kah tāng gō͘-cha̍p-chhit kong-kun,
tōa-thúi ēng tâng ê kah pó-hō͘, keng-thâu phāiⁿ chi̍t ki tâng ê chhiuⁿ;
chhiuⁿ ê pìⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-pò͘-ki ê chhia-sim hiah chho͘; kan-ta chhiuⁿ ê thâu ê thih chiū ū chhit kong-kun tāng; i ê thâu-chêng ū chi̍t ê lâng kā i giâ tún-pâi.
I khiā--teh, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t kun-tūi hoah kóng, “Lín pâi-tīn beh chhòng siáⁿ? Góa sī Hui-lī-sū ê ióng-sū, lín sī Sò-lô ê pō͘-hā. Lín kéng chi̍t ê lâng lo̍h-lâi chia,
i nā ū châi-tiāu kap góa tàu su-iâⁿ, koh kā góa thâi-sí, goán chiū chòe lín ê lô͘-châi; i nā hō͘ góa thâi-sí, lín chiū chòe goán ê lô͘-châi ho̍k-sāi goán.”
Hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng koh kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t góa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t kun-tūi chhiàng-siaⁿ; hó-táⁿ phài chi̍t ê kap góa piàⁿ siⁿ-sí!”
Sò-lô kap Í-sek-lia̍t kun-peng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiah-ê ōe, lóng chin lún, chin kiaⁿ.
Tāi-pi̍t sī Iû-tāi Pek-lī-hêng ê Í-hoat-tha -lâng Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ. Iâ-se ū poeh ê kiáⁿ. Sò-lô choh-ông ê sî, Iâ-se nî-hè chōe, í-keng lāu.
Iâ-se saⁿ ê khah tōa-hàn ê kiáⁿ lóng tè Sò-lô chhut-cheng; siōng-tōa--ê kiò-chòe Í-lī-ap, tē-jī--ê A-pí-ná-ta̍t, tē-saⁿ--ê Sa-má.
Tāi-pi̍t sī soah-bé-kiáⁿ; hit saⁿ ê hiaⁿ-ko kun-tè Sò-lô ê sî,
Tāi-pi̍t ūi-tio̍h beh chhī in lāu-pē ê iûⁿ-kûn, tī Pek-lī-hêng kap Sò-lô hia lâi-lâi-khì-khì.
Hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng chá-àm chhut-lâi thiau-chiàn, ū sì-cha̍p ji̍t kú.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Iâ-se kā i ê kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí kín chiong pē-hó ê be̍h-sūi cha̍p kong-kun, kap cha̍p ê piáⁿ the̍h-khì kun-iâⁿ hō͘ lín hiaⁿ-ko;
koh tòa cha̍p tè chhì-jù, sàng hō͘ in ê chí-hui-koaⁿ. Khì khòaⁿ lín hiaⁿ-ko ū pêng-an bô, sòa tòa chèng-kù tńg--lâi.
Sò-lô kap lín saⁿ ê hiaⁿ-ko, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng, tī Í-la ê soaⁿ-kok kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng teh kau-chiàn.”

Tē-jī ji̍t thàu-chá, Tāi-pi̍t chiong iûⁿ-kûn kau hō͘ pa̍t-lâng kò͘, chiū chiàu Iâ-se ê hoan-hù tòa chia̍h-mi̍h khì kàu kun-iâⁿ; hit-sî kun-tūi tú-á chhut-khì chiàn-tiûⁿ, hoah-siaⁿ beh kau-chiàn.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng lóng pâi-tīn sio-tùi.
Tāi-pi̍t kā mi̍h-kiāⁿ kau-tài kò͘-siú ê lâng, chiū cháu-khì chiàn-tiûⁿ, kā i ê hiaⁿ-ko chhéng-an.

I kap in kóng-ōe ê sî, khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê Hui-lī-sū ê ióng-sū Ka-te̍k -lâng Ko-lī-a tùi iâⁿ-lāi chhut--lâi, kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng kâng-khoán ê ōe; Tāi-pi̍t lóng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h.
Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê lâng chiū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ tô-cháu.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng-lâi-kóng-khì, “Hit-ê kiâⁿ--chhut-lâi ê lâng, lín ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h-bô? I chhut-lâi kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhiàng-siaⁿ. Kā i thâi-sí ê lâng, ông ū chi̍t tōa-pit chióng-kim beh hō͘ i, mā beh chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ i, koh hō͘ in lāu-pē choân-ke bián la̍p sè-kim, bián ho̍k-sāi ông.”

Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g khiā tī i sin-piⁿ hiah-ê lâng, “Thâi-sí hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng, sóe-tû Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiàn-siàu chit-ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h? Hit-ê bô siū kat-lé ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng sī siáⁿ-lâng, koh káⁿ kā éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê kun-tūi chhiàng-siaⁿ!”
Kun-peng chiū chiàu chêng ê ōe kā Tāi-pi̍t hôe-tap, kóng thâi-sí hit-ê lâng--ê, ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h pò-siúⁿ.

Tāi-pi̍t ê tōa-hiaⁿ Í-lī-ap thiaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t kap lâng kóng-ōe, chiū tùi i hoat siū-khì, kóng, “Lí ná lâi chia? Khòng-iá hit kúi chiah iûⁿ lí pàng hō͘ siáⁿ-lâng kò͘? Góa chai, lí ké-gâu; lí teh siūⁿ siáⁿ góa lóng chai. Lí lâi sī beh khòaⁿ lâng sio-thâi.”
Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa bô chòe sím-mi̍h, mn̄g chi̍t-ē iā bōe-ēng--tit o͘h?”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū lī-khui khì chhē pa̍t-lâng, mn̄g kâng-khoán būn-tôe, kun-peng mā ēng kâng-khoán ê ōe ìn i.
Ū lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t kóng ê ōe, chiū khì kā Sò-lô pò-kò; Sò-lô chiū phài lâng kiò Tāi-pi̍t lâi.
Tāi-pi̍t kā Sò-lô kóng, “Lán m̄-bián kiaⁿ hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng, chhiáⁿ hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn khì kap i koat-tàu.”
Sò-lô tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí bô hoat-tō͘ kap chit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng koat-tàu; lí iáu chió-hè, m̄-kú i tùi siàu-liân chiū chòe chiàn-sū.”
Tāi-pi̍t kā Sò-lô kóng, “Góa kā goán lāu-pē kò͘-iûⁿ ê sî, ū sai á-sī hîm lâi kā iûⁿ-á;
góa chiū kā jip, kā phah, chiong iûⁿ-á tùi in ê chhùi kiù--chhut-lâi. Sai á-sī hîm nā beh kā góa, góa chiū cháng i ê chhùi-chhiu, kā i phah-sí.
Góa bat phah-sí sai kap hîm; chit-ê bô siū kat-lé ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng, góa mā beh án-ni kā phah-sí, in-ūi i biáu-sī éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê kun-tūi.”

Tāi-pi̍t koh kóng, “Siōng Chú ū kiù góa thoat-lī sai kap hîm ê jiáu, I mā ōe kiù góa thoat-lī chit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú.” Sò-lô kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí khì, Siōng Chú kap lí tông-chāi.”
Sò-lô chiū ēng ka-kī ê kun-ho̍k hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t chhēng, ēng tâng ê thâu-khoe hō͘ i tì, koh hō͘ i chhēng chiàn-kah.

Tāi-pi̍t kā to hâ--teh. In-ūi i bô koàn-sì chhēng chiah-ê, chiū chhì kiâⁿ khòaⁿ-bāi leh, jiân-āu kā Sò-lô kóng, “Chhēng chiah-ê góa kiâⁿ bōe khì, in-ūi bōe koàn-sì.” Tāi-pi̍t chiū lóng thǹg--khí-lâi.

Tāi-pi̍t chhiú gia̍h koáiⁿ-á, khì khoe-piⁿ kéng gō͘ lia̍p kng-ku̍t ê chio̍h-thâu, khǹg tī i kò͘-iûⁿ teh ēng ê tē-á, chhiú the̍h hìⁿ-soh, jiân-āu kiâⁿ-óa hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng.
Siâng-sî, hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng mā kiâⁿ-óa Tāi-pi̍t; gia̍h tún-pâi ê peng kiâⁿ tī thâu-chêng.
Hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t, chiū khòaⁿ-khin i; in-ūi i siàu-liân, âng-ko-chhiah-chhi̍h, siⁿ-chòe eng-chùn.
Hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa kiám sī káu? Lí gia̍h koáiⁿ-á beh chhòng siáⁿ?” Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiū kí ka-kī ê sîn-bêng chiù-chó͘ Tāi-pi̍t.
Hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng koh kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lâi, góa beh ēng lí ê bah chhī chiáu-á kap iá-siù.”

Tāi-pi̍t tùi hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng kóng, “Lí sī gia̍h to, gia̍h tn̂g-chhiuⁿ, té-chhiuⁿ lâi kong-kek góa; góa sī hōng Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê miâ, chiū-sī lí só͘ biáu-sī Í-sek-lia̍t kun-tūi ê Siōng-tè, lâi kong-kek lí.

Kin-á-ji̍t Siōng Chú beh chiong lí kau tī góa ê chhiú; góa beh kā lí thâi-sí, kā lí chām-thâu. Kin-á-ji̍t góa beh ēng Hui-lī-sū kun-peng ê sin-si chhī chiáu-á kap iá-siù, hō͘ choân sè-kài ê lâng lóng chai Í-sek-lia̍t ū Siōng-tè;

koh hō͘ só͘-ū chū-chi̍p tī chia ê lâng lóng chai, Siōng Chú hō͘ lâng tek-sèng m̄-sī ēng to, m̄-sī ēng chhiuⁿ. Kau-chiàn ê sèng-pāi Siōng Chú teh koat-tēng; I beh chiong lín kau tī goán ê chhiú.”
Ko-lī-a kiâⁿ chìn-chêng beh kong-kek Tāi-pi̍t. Tāi-pi̍t kóaⁿ-kín cháu chìn-chêng khì gêng-chiàn.

Tāi-pi̍t tùi tē-á lāi the̍h chi̍t lia̍p chio̍h-thâu chhut--lâi, ēng hìⁿ-soh hìⁿ--khì, tìm-tio̍h Ko-lī-a ê thâu-hia̍h, chio̍h-thâu chǹg-ji̍p thâu-hia̍h, i chiū tó--lo̍h-khì, bīn phak tī tōe--ni̍h.
Án-ni, Tāi-pi̍t bô ēng to, chí-ū ēng hìⁿ-soh kap chio̍h-thâu chiū phah-sí Ko-lī-a.

Tāi-pi̍t cháu--khì, ta̍h tī Ko-lī-a ê seng-khu téng, jiân-āu chiong i ê to pu̍ih--chhut-lâi, kā i thâi-sí, chám-tn̄g i ê thâu. Hui-lī-sū -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h in ê ióng-sū í-keng sí, chiū lóng tô-cháu.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng chiū ná hoah-hiàm ná tui-sat Hui-lī-sū -lâng, tui kàu Ka-te̍k kap Í-kek-lûn ê siâⁿ-mn̂g; tùi Sa-la-im kàu Ka-te̍k kap Í-kek-lûn, iân-lō͘ lóng sī si-thé.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tui-sat Hui-lī-sū -lâng liáu-āu, tò-tńg-lâi chhiúⁿ-toa̍t in ê iâⁿ-tōe.
Tāi-pi̍t chiong Ko-lī-a ê thâu tòa kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, m̄-kú kā i ê kun-khì khǹg tī ka-kī ê pò͘-pîⁿ.

Sò-lô khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t khì gêng-chiàn Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê sî, mn̄g goân-sòe Ap-nî-ní kóng, “ Ap-nî-ní, hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng sī siáⁿ-lâng ê kiáⁿ?” Ap-nî-ní kóng, “Góa kí ông ê sìⁿ-miā chiù-chōa, góa m̄ chai.”
Ông kóng, “Lí khì mn̄g-khòaⁿ hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng sī siáⁿ-lâng ê kiáⁿ.”
Tāi-pi̍t phah-sí Ko-lī-a tò--lâi, Ap-nî-ní chiū chhōa i lâi kìⁿ Sò-lô, i ê chhiú iáu kōaⁿ Ko-lī-a ê thâu.
Sò-lô mn̄g i kóng, “Siàu-liân-lâng, lí sī siáⁿ-lâng ê kiáⁿ?” Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa sī lí ê po̍k-jîn Pek-lī-hêng -lâng Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ.”
Tāi-pi̍t kap Sò-lô ōe kóng soah. Iok-ná-tan kap Tāi-pi̍t sim kat saⁿ-liân; Iok-ná-tan thiàⁿ i chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.
Tùi hit-ji̍t khí, Sò-lô kā Tāi-pi̍t lâu tī sin-piⁿ, bô hō͘ i tò-tńg-khì in lāu-pē ê chhù.
Iok-ná-tan kap Tāi-pi̍t nn̄g lâng kiat-iok, in-ūi Iok-ná-tan thiàⁿ Tāi-pi̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.
Iok-ná-tan thǹg i ê gōa-saⁿ hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t, koh chiong kun-ho̍k, liân to, keng, io-tòa mā lóng hō͘ i.

Sò-lô bô-lūn phài Tāi-pi̍t khì tó-ūi, Tāi-pi̍t só͘ chòe--ê lóng sūn-lī, só͘-í Sò-lô phài i chòe pō͘-tūi ê chí-hui-koaⁿ; chèng-lâng kap Sò-lô ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ lóng chin boán-ì.

Tāi-pi̍t phah-sí Ko-lī-a tò--lâi ê sî, só͘-ū ê hū-lú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-chhī chng-siā chhut--lâi, chhiùⁿ-koa, thiàu-bú, phah lin-long-kó͘, tôaⁿ-khîm chok-ga̍k lâi gêng-chiap Sò-lô -ông.
Hiah-ê hū-lú thiàu-bú, ū-ê chhiùⁿ, ū-ê ìn, kóng: Sò-lô thâi-sí chheng-chheng; Tāi-pi̍t thâi-sí bān-bān.
Sò-lô hui-siông siū-khì, bô hoaⁿ-hí chit-ê ōe, chiū kóng, “Chiong bān-bān hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t, chheng-chheng hō͘ góa, chhun ông-ūi iáu-bē hō͘ i nā-tiāⁿ.”
Tùi hit-ji̍t khí, Sò-lô khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t chiū kā i gîn.

Keh-ji̍t, tùi Siōng-tè hia lâi ê pháiⁿ-sîn oân-choân khòng-chè Sò-lô, i chiū tī chhù-lāi khai-sí loān kóng-ōe. Tāi-pi̍t chiàu-siông ēng chhiú tôaⁿ-khîm; Sò-lô chhiú--ni̍h ū gia̍h chhiuⁿ,
chiū kā hit-ki chhiuⁿ siā--khì, siūⁿ-kóng, “Góa beh kā Tāi-pi̍t siā thàng-kè, kā i tèng tī piah--ni̍h.” Tāi-pi̍t ū nn̄g piàn siám-khui.
Sò-lô kiaⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, in-ūi Siōng Chú lī-khui i, kap Tāi-pi̍t tông-chāi.
In-ūi án-ni, Sò-lô hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t lī-khui, phài i chí-hui chi̍t-chheng ê peng. Tāi-pi̍t chiū chòe thâu léng-tō kun-tūi.
Tāi-pi̍t só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì lóng sêng-kong, in-ūi Siōng Chú kap i tông-chāi.
Sò-lô khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì lóng sêng-kong, chiū koh-khah kiaⁿ i.
M̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn lóng ióng-hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t, in-ūi i lóng chòe thâu léng-tō.

Sò-lô kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa ê tōa cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-la hō͘ lí chòe bó͘, m̄-kú lí tio̍h chòe góa chīn-tiong ê ióng-sū, ūi Siōng Chú kau-chiàn.” Sò-lô sim-lāi siūⁿ, “Góa m̄-thang chhin-chhiú hāi i, tio̍h chioh Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê to hō͘ i sí.”
Tāi-pi̍t kā Sò-lô kóng, “Góa sǹg sím-mi̍h? Góa ū sím-mi̍h sin-hūn? Goán ê ka-cho̍k tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong sǹg sím-mi̍h? Góa ná ū chu-keh thang chòe ông ê kiáⁿ-sài?”
Sò-lô ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-la eng-kai kap Tāi-pi̍t sêng-chhin ê sî kàu, Sò-lô kèng-jiân chiong i hō͘ Bí-hô-la -lâng A-tek-lia̍t chòe bó͘.
Sò-lô lēng-gōa chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-kah ài Tāi-pi̍t; ū lâng kā Sò-lô kóng, Sò-lô thiaⁿ-liáu chin hoaⁿ-hí.

Sò-lô sim-lāi kóng, “Góa chiong chit-ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ i, chòe lô-bāng, thang chioh Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú hāi-sí Tāi-pi̍t.” Sò-lô tē-jī piàn kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí thang chòe góa ê kiáⁿ-sài.”
Sò-lô chiū hoan-hù jîn-sîn kóng, “Lín su-hā kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, ‘Ông chin kah-ì lí; jîn-sîn mā chin ài lí, án-ni lí thang chòe ông ê kiáⁿ-sài.’”
Sò-lô ê jîn-sîn chiong chiah-ê ōe kóng hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t thiaⁿ; Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lín siūⁿ, chòe ông ê kiáⁿ-sài kiám sī sió-sū? Góa put-kò sī sòng-hiong pi-bî ê lâng.”
Sò-lô ê jîn-sîn chiong Tāi-pi̍t só͘ kóng--ê kā i hôe-ho̍k.

Sò-lô kóng, “Lín tio̍h kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, ông bô ài sím-mi̍h phèng-lé, chí-ū ài chi̍t-pah ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê pau-phê, thang thòe ông kā tùi-te̍k pò-ho̍k.” Sò-lô ê khì-tô͘ sī beh hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t sí tī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú-ē.
Sò-lô ê jîn-sîn chiong chiah-ê ōe kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, Tāi-pi̍t chiū goān-ì chòe ông ê kiáⁿ-sài. Chí-tēng ê ji̍t-kî kàu í-chêng,

Tāi-pi̍t chhōa pō͘-hā khì thâi-sí nn̄g-pah ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng. Tāi-pi̍t chiong hiah-ê pau-phê choân-sò͘ hiàn hō͘ ông, thang chòe ông ê kiáⁿ-sài. Sò-lô chiū chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-kah hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t chòe bó͘.
Sò-lô khòaⁿ-chhut Siōng Chú kap Tāi-pi̍t tông-chāi, koh chai cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-kah mā ài Tāi-pi̍t,
Sò-lô chiū koh-khah kiaⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, kui-sì-lâng kap Tāi-pi̍t choh-tùi.

Hui-lī-sū ê siú-léng siông-siông chhut-lâi kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; ta̍k-piàn kau-chiàn, Tāi-pi̍t ê chiàn-kó lóng pí Sò-lô ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ khah hui-hông. Tāi-pi̍t ê miâ-siaⁿ jú lâi jú hiáng.
Sò-lô iau-kiû i ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan kap só͘-ū ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ tio̍h thâi-sí Tāi-pi̍t. M̄-kú Iok-ná-tan chin ì-ài Tāi-pi̍t,
chiū kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa ê lāu-pē siūⁿ-beh thâi lí; lí tio̍h sòe-jī, bîn-á-chá-khí lí khì bih tiàm pì-bi̍t ê só͘-chāi.
Góa ōe khì iá-gōa lí bih ê só͘-chāi, khiā tī góa ê lāu-pē sin-piⁿ, kap i kóng-khí lí ê tāi-chì; góa nā chai-iáⁿ sím-mi̍h, ōe kā lí kóng.”

Iok-ná-tan tùi i ê lāu-pē thòe Tāi-pi̍t kóng hó-ōe, kóng, “Chhiáⁿ ông m̄-thang siong-hāi lí ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t, in-ūi i m̄-bat siong-hāi lí. I só͘ chòe--ê lóng tùi lí chin ū pang-chān.

I bat mō͘ sìⁿ-miā ê gûi-hiám, thâi-sí hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng. Siōng Chú ū hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tit-tio̍h tōa sèng-lī; chiah-ê tāi-chì lí lóng chai, mā chin hoaⁿ-hí. Taⁿ sī-án-chóaⁿ ông bô-iân-bô-kò͘ beh thâi Tāi-pi̍t, lâu bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih tek-chōe Siōng-tè?”
Sò-lô thiaⁿ Iok-ná-tan ê ōe, chiū kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, “Góa bōe thâi Tāi-pi̍t.”
Iok-ná-tan kiò Tāi-pi̍t lâi, chiong che it-chhè ê keng-kè lóng kā i kóng. Iok-ná-tan chhōa Tāi-pi̍t khì kìⁿ Sò-lô; Tāi-pi̍t chiū kè-sio̍k sū-hāu Sò-lô.
Chiàn-cheng koh po̍k-hoat; Tāi-pi̍t chhut-khì kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng kau-chiàn, kā in thiat-tóe phah-pāi, in chiū tô-cháu.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Sò-lô chē tī chhù-lāi, chhiú--ni̍h gia̍h chhiuⁿ, tùi Siōng Chú hia lâi ê pháiⁿ-sîn koh lîm-kàu i; hit-sî Tāi-pi̍t teh tôaⁿ-khîm.
Sò-lô ēng chhiuⁿ siā Tāi-pi̍t, beh kā i tèng tī piah--ni̍h; Tāi-pi̍t siám-khui, hit-ki chhiuⁿ chha̍k-ji̍p piah--ni̍h. Hit-mî, Tāi-pi̍t tô-cháu, lī-khui.

Sò-lô phài lâng khì Tāi-pi̍t ê chhù kàm-sī, àn-sǹg thàu-chá beh kā i thâi. Tāi-pi̍t ê bó͘ Bí-kah tùi i kóng, “Lí kim-àm nā bô tô-miā, bîn-á-chài it-tēng ōe hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.”
Bí-kah chiū tùi thang-á kā Tāi-pi̍t lūi--lo̍h-khì; i chiū tô-cháu khì bih.
Bí-kah ēng ka-cho̍k-sîn-siōng hē tī bîn-chhn̂g, ēng soaⁿ-iûⁿ-mn̂g khàm thâu-khak, ēng gōa-saⁿ kā i kah--teh.
Sò-lô phài lâng khì lia̍h Tāi-pi̍t; Bí-kah kā in kóng, “I teh phòa-pīⁿ.”
Sò-lô koh phài lâng khì, it-tēng beh khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t, kóng, “Liân bîn-chhn̂g sòa kng-lâi góa chia, góa beh hō͘ i sí.”
Sù-chiá ji̍p--khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h bîn-chhn̂g ū ka-cho̍k-sîn-siōng, thâu-khak khàm soaⁿ-iûⁿ-mn̂g.
Sò-lô tùi Bí-kah kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ phiàn góa, pàng góa ê tùi-te̍k tô-cháu?” Bí-kah ìn kóng, “I kā góa kóng, ‘Pàng góa cháu. Nā bô, góa beh kā lí thâi-sí.’”
