Tāi-pi̍t tô-cháu, khì La-má kìⁿ Sat-bó-ní, chiong Sò-lô tùi i só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì lóng kā Sat-bó-ní kóng. I kap Sat-bó-ní chiū khì tòa tī Ná-iok.
Ū lâng kā Sò-lô kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t tī La-má ê Ná-iok.”

Sò-lô phài sù-chiá khì lia̍h Tāi-pi̍t; in khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sat-bó-ní chòe thâu chhōa chi̍t tīn sian-ti ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe, Siōng-tè ê sîn lîm-kàu Sò-lô ê sù-chiá, in mā khai-sí ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe.
Ū lâng chiong chit-ê tāi-chì kā Sò-lô kóng, i koh phài sù-chiá khì, in mā ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe. Sò-lô tē-saⁿ piàn phài sù-chiá khì, in mā ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe.
Āu-lâi i pún-sin mā khì La-má, kàu Se-ko͘ ê hit-ê tōa kó͘-chíⁿ hia, mn̄g lâng, “ Sat-bó-ní kap Tāi-pi̍t tī tó-ūi?” Ū lâng kā i kóng, “In tī La-má ê Ná-iok.”
Sò-lô chiū khì Ná-iok; Siōng-tè ê sîn mā lîm-kàu i; i ná kiâⁿ ná ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe, it-ti̍t kàu Ná-iok.
I sīm-chì thǹg-saⁿ, tī Sat-bó-ní ê bīn-chêng ji̍p-sîn kóng-ōe, kui-mî kui-ji̍t thǹg-theh tó--teh. In-ūi án-ni, lâng kóng, “Liân Sò-lô mā teh chòe sian-ti o͘h?”

Tāi-pi̍t tùi La-má ê Ná-iok tô-cháu, khì kìⁿ Iok-ná-tan, kóng, “Góa ū chòe sím-mi̍h? Ū sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h? Ū tùi lín lāu-pē hoān-tio̍h sím-mi̍h chōe, i kèng-jiân beh tui-sat góa?”

Iok-ná-tan kā i kóng, “Bô chit-khoán tāi-chì! Lí choa̍t-tùi bōe sí. Góa ê lāu-pē chòe tāi-chì, bô-lūn tōa-sòe, lóng ōe hō͘ góa chai. Chit-hāng tāi-chì i ná tio̍h kā góa am-khàm? Choa̍t-tùi bōe!”

Tāi-pi̍t koh chiù-chōa kóng, “Lí ê lāu-pē bêng-bêng chai lí chin ì-ài góa, só͘-í sim-lāi siūⁿ, ‘M̄-thang hō͘ Iok-ná-tan chai, kiaⁿ-liáu i siong-sim.’ Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú kap lí ê sìⁿ-miā chiù-chōa, sí í-keng pek kàu gán-chêng lah.”
Iok-ná-tan kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí ài góa chòe sím-mi̍h, góa it-tēng ōe chòe.”
Tāi-pi̍t kā Iok-ná-tan kóng, “Bîn-á-chài sī chhoe-it, góa eng-kai tio̍h kap ông chia̍h-pn̄g. Nā ōe-ēng--tit, chhiáⁿ iông-ún góa khì bih tī iá-gōa, kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t àm-sî.
Lí ê lāu-pē nā hoat-kiàn góa bô tī hia, lí tio̍h kóng, ‘ Tāi-pi̍t ū tit-tio̍h góa ê ún-chún, tńg-khì kò͘-hiong Pek-lī-hêng, in choân-ke tī hia teh hiàn nî-chè.’
I nā kóng ‘Hó’, lí ê po̍k-jîn chiū pêng-an bô-sū; i nā siū-khì, lí chiū chai i koat-tēng beh hāi góa.

Taⁿ lí tio̍h sêng-sim tùi-thāi lí ê po̍k-jîn; chhiáⁿ lí siú lí kap góa tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng só͘ li̍p ê iok. Góa nā ū chōe, lí tio̍h chhin-sin thâi góa; ná tio̍h tán lí ê lāu-pē hē-chhiú?”
Iok-ná-tan kóng, “Góa it-tēng bōe án-ni chòe. Góa nā khak-si̍t chai góa ê lāu-pē koat-tēng beh hāi lí, góa kiám bōe kā lí kóng?”
Tāi-pi̍t kā Iok-ná-tan kóng, “Lí ê lāu-pē nā pháiⁿ siaⁿ-sàu ìn lí, sím-mi̍h-lâng beh pò góa chai?”
Iok-ná-tan kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lâi, lán lâi-khì iá-gōa.” In chiū chòe-hé khì.

Iok-ná-tan kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè choh-chèng: Bîn-á-chài á-sī āu--ji̍t chit-ê sî, góa ōe thàm goán lāu-pē ê ì-sù; i tùi lí ê hoán-èng nā hó, góa it-tēng ōe phài lâng pò lí chai.

Góa ê lāu-pē nā chûn-sim beh hāi lí, góa it-tēng ōe kā lí kóng, hō͘ lí pêng-an lī-khui; nā bô, goān Siōng Chú ka-pē chek-hoa̍t góa. Goān Siōng Chú kap lí tông-chāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng kap góa ê lāu-pē tông-chāi kâng-khoán.
Góa nā iáu oa̍h--teh, lí it-tēng tio̍h chiàu Siōng Chú ê chû-ài tùi-thāi góa. Góa nā sí,
koh Siōng Chú châu-bia̍t lí ê tùi-te̍k ê sî, lí mā tio̍h kâng-khoán éng-oán chiàu Siōng Chú ê chû-ài tùi-thāi góa ê ka-cho̍k.”
Iok-ná-tan chiū kap Tāi-pi̍t ê ke li̍p-iok, koh kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú ēng Tāi-pi̍t tùi-te̍k ê chhiú hêng-hoa̍t pōe-iok ê lâng.”
Iok-ná-tan in-ūi ài Tāi-pi̍t, chiū iau-kiû Tāi-pi̍t koh chiù-chōa; in-ūi i thiàⁿ Tāi-pi̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.
Iok-ná-tan kā i kóng, “Bîn-á-chài sī chhoe-it, chia̍h-pn̄g ê sî, lí bô chāi-tiûⁿ, lâng it-tēng ōe chù-ì--tio̍h.
Só͘-í, āu--ji̍t lí tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín lo̍h-khì chêng tú-tio̍h tāi-chì bih ê só͘-chāi, tī Í-sek ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ hia thèng-hāu;
góa ōe ēng chio̍h-pôaⁿ chòe bo̍k-phiau siā saⁿ ki chìⁿ.

Góa ōe chhe chi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng khì chhē chìⁿ. Góa nā kā hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng kóng ‘Chìⁿ tī lí ê āu-bīn, tio̍h khì khioh’, lí chiū thang tò--lâi. Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, lí pêng-an bô-sū.
Góa nā kā siàu-liân-lâng kóng ‘Chìⁿ tī lí ê thâu-chêng’, lí tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín cháu; in-ūi sī Siōng Chú ài lí lī-khui.
Lán nn̄g ê ê iok-tēng, ū Siōng Chú tī lí góa tiong-kan éng-oán choh-chèng.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū khì bih tī iá-gōa. Chhoe-it hit-ji̍t, ông chē-toh beh chia̍h.
Ông chiàu-siông chē i óa piah hit-ê ūi, tī Iok-ná-tan ê tùi-bīn, Ap-nî-ní chē tī Sò-lô sin-piⁿ; Tāi-pi̍t ê ūi khang--teh.
M̄-kú hit-ji̍t Sò-lô bô kóng sím-mi̍h; i siūⁿ-kóng Tāi-pi̍t tú-tio̍h tāi-chì hō͘ i bô chheng-khì, kàu hiān-chāi iáu-bē kiat-chēng.
Keh-ji̍t, chhoe-jī, Tāi-pi̍t ê ūi iû-goân khang-khang. Sò-lô mn̄g Iok-ná-tan, “ Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ sī-án-chóaⁿ chā-ji̍t kin-á-ji̍t lóng bô lâi chia̍h?”
Iok-ná-tan ìn Sò-lô kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t pek-chhiat kiû góa ún-chún i tò-khì Pek-lī-hêng.

I kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ lí ún-chún góa tò--khì, in-ūi goán tau tī siâⁿ-lāi ū chè-sū, góa ê hiaⁿ-ko hoan-hù góa tńg--khì; taⁿ lí tio̍h si-un hō͘ góa, chún góa khì kìⁿ góa ê hiaⁿ-ko.’ In-ūi án-ni Tāi-pi̍t bô lâi kap ông chē-toh.”

Sò-lô tùi Iok-ná-tan hoat sèng-tē, kā i kóng, “Lí chit-ê put-cheng pōe-ge̍k ê cha-bó͘-lâng siⁿ ê kiáⁿ, góa to chai lí khiā tī Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ hit-pêng, ka-kī chhú lêng-jio̍k, koh hō͘ lí ê lāu-bú siū-tio̍h thǹg-theh ê kiàn-siàu.
Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ nā oa̍h--teh, lí kap lí ê ông-koân it-tēng bōe ún-kò͘. Taⁿ tio̍h phài lâng khì kā lia̍h-lâi góa chia. I it-tēng tio̍h sí!”
Iok-ná-tan ìn kóng, “I sī-án-chóaⁿ tio̍h sí? I ū chòe sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h?”
Sò-lô gia̍h chhiuⁿ siā Iok-ná-tan, beh kā i chha̍k-sí. Iok-ná-tan chiū chai i ê lāu-pē koat-sim beh thâi Tāi-pi̍t.
Iok-ná-tan chin siū-khì, tùi chē-ūi khiā--khí-lâi, chhoe-jī hit-ji̍t lóng bô chia̍h sím-mi̍h. I ūi-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t sim kan-khó͘, in-ūi i ê lāu-pē bú-jio̍k Tāi-pi̍t.
Keh-chá-khí, Iok-ná-tan chiàu iok-tēng, chhut-khì iá-gōa beh kap Tāi-pi̍t kìⁿ-bīn; ū chi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng tè i khì.
Iok-ná-tan kā siàu-liân-lâng kóng, “Lí cháu-khì chhē góa siā ê chìⁿ.” Hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng chi̍t-ē cháu--khì, Iok-ná-tan chiū siā chi̍t ki chìⁿ, pe-kè siàu-liân-lâng.
Hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng cháu kàu Iok-ná-tan chìⁿ lak--lo̍h-khì ê só͘-chāi, Iok-ná-tan tī āu-bīn hoah kóng, “Chìⁿ tī lí ê thâu-chêng.”
Iok-ná-tan koh hoah, “Kóaⁿ-kín, kín khì, m̄-thang iân-chhiân.” Hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng chiū khioh hiah-ê chìⁿ tńg-lâi i ê chú-lâng hia,
m̄-kú i m̄ chai che sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù, chí-ū Iok-ná-tan kap Tāi-pi̍t chai.
Iok-ná-tan chiong keng kap chìⁿ kau hō͘ siàu-liân-lâng, hoan-hù kóng, “Lí the̍h tò-khì siâⁿ-lāi.”

Siàu-liân-lâng lī-khui liáu-āu, Tāi-pi̍t tùi chio̍h-thâu-tui āu-bīn chhut--lâi, phak tī thô͘-kha kā Iok-ná-tan pài saⁿ piàn; nn̄g lâng sio-chim, lám-teh khàu, Tāi-pi̍t khàu kah chin kek-tōng.

Iok-ná-tan kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí thang pêng-an khì; lán nn̄g lâng í-keng ū kí Siōng Chú ê miâ chiù-chōa kóng, ‘Goān Siōng Chú pang-chān lán éng-oán kian-siú lí kap góa, lí ê hō͘-tāi kap góa ê hō͘-tāi tiong-kan só͘ li̍p ê iok.’” Tāi-pi̍t chiū lī-khui, Iok-ná-tan mā tò-khì siâⁿ-lāi.
Tāi-pi̍t khì Ná-pek kìⁿ chè-si A-hi-bí-le̍k. A-hi-bí-le̍k kiaⁿ-kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ-hiâⁿ chhut-lâi kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, tùi i kóng, “Lí ná ka-kī chi̍t ê, bô lâng kap lí tàu-tīn?”
Tāi-pi̍t ìn kóng, “Ông hō͘ góa chi̍t ê jīm-bū, bēng-lēng kóng chit-ê jīm-bū m̄-thang hō͘ lâng chai. Góa í-keng phài pō͘-hā tī bó͘ chi̍t ê só͘-chāi thèng-hāu góa.
Taⁿ lí ū sím-mi̍h thang chia̍h, chhiáⁿ lí hō͘ góa gō͘ ê piáⁿ, á-sī pa̍t-hāng chia̍h-mi̍h.”
Chè-si ìn kóng, “Góa chhiú-lāi bô phó͘-thong ê piáⁿ, chí-ū hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê piáⁿ; lí ê pō͘-hā bô chhin-kūn hū-lú chiah thang chia̍h.”

Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Chòe-kūn goán lóng bô chhin-kūn hū-lú. Goán chhut-khì chip-hêng jīm-bū ê sî, chiah-ê kun-peng lóng ū kiat-chēng. Liân pêng-siông to án-ni, hô-hòng chit-piàn ê jīm-bū te̍k-pia̍t, kun-peng ê seng-khu koh-khah ū pó-chhî kiat-chēng.”

Chè-si chiū the̍h hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê piáⁿ hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t, in-ūi tī hia bô pa̍t-hāng piáⁿ, chí-ū hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ, sī hiàn sin-piáⁿ ê sî tùi Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ōaⁿ--lo̍h-lâi--ê.
Hit-ji̍t, tī hia ū chi̍t ê Sò-lô ê jîn-sîn lâu tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng; i sī Í-tong -lâng, kiò-chòe To-ek, sī Sò-lô ê bo̍k-chiá ê chóng-koán.
Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g A-hi-bí-le̍k kóng, “Lí chia ū chhiuⁿ á-sī to bô? In-ūi ông ê jīm-bū chin kín-kip, góa soah bô tòa to á-sī kî-tha ê bú-khì.”

Chè-si ìn, “Chia ū chi̍t ki to, sī lí í-chêng tī Í-la ê soaⁿ-kok só͘ thâi-sí ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng Ko-lī-a ê, ēng pò͘ pau--teh, khǹg tī í-hut-tek ê āu-bīn. Lí beh ēng chiū gia̍h--khì; chit-ki í-gōa bô pa̍t-ki.” Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Chit-ki to hō͘ góa, bô pa̍t-ki pí chit-ki khah hó.”
Hit-ji̍t Tāi-pi̍t lī-khui, cháu kàu Ka-te̍k -ông A-kiat hia, khì siám-pī Sò-lô.

A-kiat hiah-ê jîn-sîn tùi i kóng, “Chit-ê kiám m̄-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -kok ê ông Tāi-pi̍t? Kiám m̄-sī chèng hū-lú ná thiàu-bú ná chhiùⁿ kóng ‘ Sò-lô thâi-sí chheng-chheng; Tāi-pi̍t thâi-sí bān-bān’ hit-ê Tāi-pi̍t?”
Tāi-pi̍t thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe sim-lāi put-an, chin kiaⁿ Ka-te̍k -ông A-kiat,
só͘-í tī chèng-lâng bīn-chêng ké khí-siáu, tī siâⁿ-mn̂g ê mn̂g-sìⁿ loān-siá loān-ōe, chhùi-nōa-pho phùn kah kui chhùi-chhiu.
A-kiat kā i ê jîn-sîn kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, chit-ê lâng teh khí-siáu. Lín ná kā i chhōa-lâi góa chia?
Góa chia kiám ū khiàm siáu-lâng? Lín ná kā chhōa--lâi? M̄-thang hō͘ chit-ê lâng ji̍p góa ê chhù.”
Tāi-pi̍t lī-khui Ka-te̍k, cháu kàu A-tō͘-lân-tōng; i ê hiaⁿ-tī kap i ê lāu-pē choân-ke thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū lóng lo̍h-khì i hia.
Só͘-ū siū ap-pek--ê, khiàm-chè--ê, sim put-boán--ê, lóng chū-chi̍p lâi i hia, Tāi-pi̍t chiū chòe in ê thâu; khì óa i--ê, iok ū sì-pah lâng.
Tāi-pi̍t tùi hia khì Mô͘-ap ê Bí-su-pa, tùi Mô͘-ap -ông kóng, “Kiû lí ún-chún góa ê pē-bú lâi tiàm lín chia, thèng-hāu góa chai Siōng-tè án-chóaⁿ kā góa an-pâi.”
Tāi-pi̍t chhōa in kàu Mô͘-ap -ông hia. Tāi-pi̍t tòa tī iàu-sài hit-tōaⁿ sî-kan, i ê pē-bú lóng tòa tī Mô͘-ap -ông hia.
Āu-lâi, sian-ti Ka-tek kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “M̄-thang koh tòa tī iàu-sài, tio̍h khì Iû-tāi tōe-khu.” Tāi-pi̍t chiū lī-khui, khì Ha-lia̍t ê chhiū-nâ.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Sò-lô tī Ki-pí-a ê La-má, chē tī liú-chhiū kha, chhiú--ni̍h gia̍h chhiuⁿ, chèng sī-ōe khiā tī i chiu-ûi. Hit-sî, Sò-lô thiaⁿ-tio̍h ū lâng chai-iáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t kap tè i ê lâng tī tó-ūi,

chiū kā i ê sī-ōe kóng, “ Piān-ngá-bín -lâng ah, thiaⁿ leh. Lín siūⁿ-kóng Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ ōe hō͘ lín ta̍k-ê lâng chhân kap phû-tô-hn̂g o͘h? Ōe phài lín chòe koaⁿ-tiúⁿ chí-hui chi̍t-chheng ê, á-sī chi̍t-pah ê peng o͘h?

Lín kèng-jiân kiōng-bô͘ beh pōe-poān góa. Góa ka-kī ê kiáⁿ kap Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ kiat-bêng, lín bô lâng kā góa pò-kò; lín tiong-kan bô lâng koan-sim góa. Kin-á-ji̍t góa ê kiáⁿ sái-lōng góa ê pō͘-hā tng-tán beh hāi góa, lín lóng bô pò góa chai.”
Hit-sî Í-tong -lâng To-ek khiā tī Sò-lô sī-ōe ê tiong-kan, kā i kóng, “Góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ khì Ná-pek, kàu A-hi-tu̍t ê kiáⁿ A-hi-bí-le̍k hia.
A-hi-bí-le̍k thòe Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g Siōng Chú, koh hō͘ i chia̍h-mi̍h, mā gia̍h Hui-lī-sū -lâng Ko-lī-a ê to hō͘ i.”
Ông chiū phài lâng tiàu A-hi-tu̍t ê kiáⁿ chè-si A-hi-bí-le̍k, koh tiàu in lāu-pē choân-ke, chiū-sī tiàm tī Ná-pek hiah-ê chè-si lâi; in chiū lóng lâi ông hia.
Sò-lô kóng, “ A-hi-tu̍t ê kiáⁿ, thiaⁿ leh!” I ìn kóng, “Góa ê chú ah, góa tī chia.”
Sò-lô kā i kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ kap Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ kiōng-bô͘ pōe-poān góa, hō͘ i piáⁿ kap to, koh thòe i kiû-mn̄g Siōng-tè, tì-kàu i kin-á-ji̍t tng-tán beh hāi góa?”
A-hi-bí-le̍k ìn ông kóng, “Lí ê sī-ōe siáⁿ-lâng ōe pí Tāi-pi̍t khah chīn-tiong? I sī ông ê kiáⁿ-sài, koh sī lí ê sī-ōe-tiúⁿ, tī kiong-têng siū kèng-tiōng.

Góa kiám kin-á-ji̍t chiah thòe i kiû-mn̄g Siōng-tè? Choa̍t-tùi m̄-sī. Chhiáⁿ ông m̄-thang kā chōe kui hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn kap góa ê lāu-pē choân-ke; in-ūi pōe-poān ông chiah-ê tāi-chì, bô-lūn tōa-sòe hāng, lí ê po̍k-jîn lóng m̄ chai.”
Ông kóng, “ A-hi-bí-le̍k, lí kap lí ê lāu-pē choân-ke lóng tio̍h sí.”

Ông chiū bēng-lēng chó-iū ê sī-ōe kóng, “Lín khì, kā Siōng Chú ê chè-si lóng thâi-sí; in-ūi in óa Tāi-pi̍t, in chai Tāi-pi̍t tô-cháu koh bô pò góa chai.” M̄-kú ông ê sī-ōe m̄-khéng hē-chhiú thâi Siōng Chú ê chè-si.
Ông kā To-ek kóng, “Lí khì, khì thâi hiah-ê chè-si.” Í-tong -lâng To-ek chiū khì thâi chè-si; hit-ji̍t thâi-sí poeh-cha̍p-gō͘ ê chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ í-hut-tek ê lâng.
I koh ēng to thâi chè-si ê siâⁿ Ná-pek siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng, bô-lūn lâm-lú, gín-á, chia̍h-lin ê eⁿ-á, kap gû, lû, iûⁿ, lóng thâi-sí.
A-hi-tu̍t ê kiáⁿ A-hi-bí-le̍k ū chi̍t ê kiáⁿ kiò-chòe A-pí-a-tha, tô-cháu khì Tāi-pi̍t hia.
A-pí-a-tha chiong Sò-lô thâi-sí Siōng Chú ê chè-si ê tāi-chì kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng.

Tāi-pi̍t kā A-pí-a-tha kóng, “Hit-ji̍t góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-tong -lâng To-ek tī hia, chiū chai i it-tēng ōe kā Sò-lô pò-kò. Lí ê lāu-pē choân-ke sit-lo̍h sìⁿ-miā, lóng sī in-ūi góa ê iân-kò͘.
Lí lâi kap góa tòa, m̄-bián kiaⁿ, in-ūi siūⁿ-beh hāi lí sìⁿ-miā--ê mā beh hāi góa; lâi kap góa tòa, lí chiū an-choân.”
Ū lâng kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “ Hui-lī-sū -lâng teh kong-kek Ki-i-la -siâⁿ, chhiúⁿ ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ.”
Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g Siōng Chú, “Góa lâi-khì kong-kek hiah-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng hó--bô?” Siōng Chú kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí khì phah Hui-lī-sū -lâng, kái-kiù Ki-i-la.”
Kun-tè Tāi-pi̍t ê lâng kā i kóng, “Lán tī Iû-tāi -tōe to chin kiaⁿ Hui-lī-sū -lâng, hô-hòng khì Ki-i-la phah in ê kun-tūi?”
Tāi-pi̍t koh mn̄g Siōng Chú; Siōng Chú ìn kóng, “Lí khì, lo̍h-khì Ki-i-la, in-ūi góa beh chiong Hui-lī-sū -lâng kau tī lí ê chhiú.”
Tāi-pi̍t kap kun-tè i ê lâng khì Ki-i-la, kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng kau-chiàn; chhiúⁿ in ê cheng-siⁿ, thâi-sí in chin chōe lâng. Án-ni, Tāi-pi̍t ū kái-kiù Ki-i-la ê chū-bîn.
A-hi-bí-le̍k ê kiáⁿ A-pí-a-tha tô-cháu khì Ki-i-la kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t ê sî, chhiú--ni̍h ū tòa í-hut-tek khì.

Ū lâng kā Sò-lô kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t lâi kàu Ki-i-la.” Sò-lô kóng, “Siōng-tè í-keng chiong i kau tī góa ê chhiú, in-ūi i ji̍p-khì ū mn̂g ū chhòaⁿ ê siâⁿ, ka-kī koaiⁿ tī hit lāi-bīn.”
Sò-lô chiū tiàu-chi̍p só͘-ū ê kun-peng beh khì kong-táⁿ Ki-i-la, pau-ûi Tāi-pi̍t kap kun-tè i ê lâng.
Tāi-pi̍t chai Sò-lô siat kè-bô͘ beh hāi i, chiū kā chè-si A-pí-a-tha kóng, “Lí tòa í-hut-tek lâi.”
Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ah, lí ê po̍k-jîn ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Sò-lô beh lâi Ki-i-la, ūi-tio̍h góa ê iân-kò͘ châu-bia̍t chit-ê siâⁿ.

Ki-i-la -lâng ōe chiong góa kau tī i ê chhiú bōe? Sò-lô ōe chiàu lí ê po̍k-jîn só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê lo̍h--lâi á bōe? Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí chí-sī lí ê po̍k-jîn.” Siōng Chú kóng, “ Sò-lô ōe lo̍h--lâi.”
Tāi-pi̍t koh kóng, “ Ki-i-la -lâng ōe chiong góa kap tè góa ê lâng kau tī Sò-lô ê chhiú á bōe?” Siōng Chú kóng, “In ōe chiong lí kau hō͘ i.”

Tāi-pi̍t kap kun-tè i ê lâng iok ū la̍k-pah, sûi-sî lī-khui Ki-i-la, sì-kòe phiau-liû. Ū lâng kā Sò-lô kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t í-keng tùi Ki-i-la tô-cháu.” Sò-lô chiū bô chhut-peng.
Tāi-pi̍t bih tī Se-hut khòng-iá soaⁿ-khu ê iàu-sài. Sò-lô ta̍k-ji̍t tui-chhē Tāi-pi̍t, m̄-kú Siōng-tè bô chiong Tāi-pi̍t kau tī i ê chhiú.
Tāi-pi̍t chai Sò-lô í-keng chhut-lâi beh thâi i, hit-sî Tāi-pi̍t tiàm tī Se-hut khòng-iá ê Ha-lia̍t.
Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan chhut-hoat khì Ha-lia̍t kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, kó͘-lē i tio̍h sìn-khò Siōng-tè ê pó-hō͘,

kā i kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ, goán lāu-pē Sò-lô ê chhiú bô hoat-tō͘ siong-hāi lí. Lí ōe chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, góa kam-goān chē tē-jī ūi. Chit-ê sū góa ê lāu-pē Sò-lô í-keng chai.”
In nn̄g lâng chiū tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng li̍p-iok kiat-bêng. Tāi-pi̍t lâu tī Ha-lia̍t, Iok-ná-tan tò-khì i ê chhù.
Ū chi̍t-kóa Se-hut -lâng chiūⁿ-khì Ki-pí-a kìⁿ Sò-lô, kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t kiám m̄-sī bih tī goán kéng-lāi, Iok-su-bûn lâm-pêng Hap-ki-la-soaⁿ, Ha-lia̍t ê iàu-sài?
Ông ah, lí nā siūⁿ-beh lo̍h--khì, chhiáⁿ chit-chūn lâi-khì; goán ōe lia̍h i lâi kau tī ông ê chhiú.”
Sò-lô kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú sù-hok lín, in-ūi lín tùi góa chin hó.
Lín tò--khì, siông-sè tiâu-cha, khak-si̍t chai i tiàm tī tó-ūi, sím-mi̍h-lâng ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h i, in-ūi ū lâng kā góa kóng, i chin khúi-khiat.

Lín khì, chhâ-chhut i khak-si̍t bih ê só͘-chāi; nā chai-iáⁿ, tio̍h lâi kā góa pò-kò, góa chiū beh kap lín khì. I nā tī Iû-tāi kéng-lāi, góa beh tùi só͘-ū ê chong-cho̍k tiong kā i chhiau--chhut-lâi.”
Hiah-ê lâng chiū chhut-hoat, pí Sò-lô khah tāi-seng khì Se-hut. Tāi-pi̍t kap kun-tè i ê lâng bih tī Má-hûn ê khòng-iá, Iok-su-bûn lâm-pêng ê A-la-pa.

Sò-lô chhōa i ê pō͘-hā khì tui-chhē Tāi-pi̍t; ū lâng kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, i chiū lo̍h-khì Má-hûn khòng-iá ê soaⁿ-giâm hia. Sò-lô thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū tī Má-hûn ê khòng-iá tui-jip Tāi-pi̍t.

Sò-lô kap i ê pō͘-hā tī soaⁿ ê chit-pêng, Tāi-pi̍t kap kun-tè i ê lâng tī soaⁿ ê hit-pêng. Sò-lô kap i ê pō͘-hā pek-óa Tāi-pi̍t, teh-beh lia̍h--tio̍h. Tāi-pi̍t kóaⁿ-kín cháu, siám-pī Sò-lô.
Hit-sî, ū sù-chiá lâi pò Sò-lô kóng, “Lí tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín tò--lâi, in-ūi Hui-lī-sū -lâng chhim-hoān lán ê kok-kéng.”
Sò-lô chiū tò-khì tùi-khòng Hui-lī-sū -lâng, bô koh tui-jip Tāi-pi̍t; in-ūi án-ni, hit-ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Se-la Hap-má-hi-lô-kiat, ì-sù sī keh-lī ê soaⁿ-giâm.
Tāi-pi̍t lī-khui hia, chiū khì tiàm tī Ún Ki-tí ê iàu-sài.
Sò-lô tui-jip Hui-lī-sū -lâng tò--lâi ê sî, ū lâng kā i kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t tiàm tī Ún Ki-tí ê khòng-iá.”
Sò-lô chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t tiong chhōa te̍k-soán ê peng saⁿ-chheng, khì Iá-soaⁿ-iûⁿ Soaⁿ-giâm hia chhē Tāi-pi̍t kap kun-tè i ê lâng.
Sò-lô lâi kàu lō͘-piⁿ iûⁿ-tiâu hù-kūn ê soaⁿ-tōng, ji̍p-khì beh tāi-piān. Tāi-pi̍t kap kun-tè i ê lâng bih tī tōng-lāi khah chhim ê só͘-chāi.

Kun-tè Tāi-pi̍t ê lâng tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú bat kā lí kóng, ‘Góa beh chiong lí ê tùi-te̍k kau tī lí ê chhiú, lí thang chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù tùi-thāi i.’ Taⁿ ki-hōe lâi lah.” Tāi-pi̍t chiū tiām-tiām-á pê-khì koah Sò-lô gōa-saⁿ ê saⁿ-á-ku.
Āu-lâi, Tāi-pi̍t in-ūi koah Sò-lô ê saⁿ-á-ku sim-lāi put-an,

tùi kun-tè i ê lâng kóng, “I sī Siōng Chú só͘ boah-iû ê ông; góa choa̍t-tùi m̄-káⁿ tùi góa ê chú-lâng, chiū-sī Siōng Chú só͘ boah-iû--ê, chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì siong-hāi i.”
Tāi-pi̍t ēng chiah-ê ōe chó͘-tòng kun-tè i ê lâng, put-chún in kong-kek Sò-lô. Sò-lô peh--khí-lâi, tùi tōng-lāi chhut--khì, kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ i ê lō͘.
Tāi-pi̍t mā tùi tōng-lāi chhut--khì, tè tī Sò-lô ê āu-bīn, hoah kóng, “Góa ê chú, góa ê ông!” Sò-lô oa̍t-thâu khòaⁿ; Tāi-pi̍t chiū phak tī thô͘-kha pài i.
Tāi-pi̍t tùi Sò-lô kóng, “Ông ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ thiaⁿ lâng ê ōe, kóng ‘ Tāi-pi̍t siūⁿ-beh hāi lí’?

Kin-á-ji̍t lí ū chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h, lí tī tōng-lāi ê sî, Siōng Chú chiong lí kau tī góa ê chhiú. Ū lâng kiò góa thâi lí, m̄-kú góa put-jím-sim; góa kóng, ‘Góa bô beh chhut-chhiú hāi góa ê chú, in-ūi i sī Siōng Chú só͘ boah-iû--ê.’

Góa ê pē ah, lí khòaⁿ leh, lí gōa-saⁿ ê saⁿ-á-ku tī góa ê chhiú--ni̍h; góa chí-ū koah lí ê saⁿ-á-ku, bô kā lí thâi. Án-ni, lí ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-chhut góa ê chhiú bô chòe sím-mi̍h pōe-ge̍k lí ê pháiⁿ tāi-chì. Góa m̄-bat tek-chōe lí, m̄-kú lí tui-jip góa, beh ti̍h góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Goān Siōng Chú tī lí góa ê tiong-kan chhâi-koat. Goān Siōng Chú in-ūi lí ê só͘-chòe thòe góa pò-ho̍k; góa bōe chhut-chhiú hāi lí.
Kó͘-chá-lâng án-ni kóng, ‘Pháiⁿ-tāi tùi pháiⁿ-lâng chhut.’ Góa bōe chhut-chhiú hāi lí.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chhut-lâi beh lia̍h siáⁿ-lâng, beh tui-jip siáⁿ-lâng? Beh chhē sí-káu, lia̍h ka-cháu o͘h?
Goān Siōng Chú chòe phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, tī lí góa ê tiong-kan chhâi-koat. Goān I kàm-chhat, ūi-tio̍h góa ê àn-kiāⁿ piān-hō͘, kiù góa thoat-lī lí ê chhiú.”
Tāi-pi̍t tùi Sò-lô kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu, Sò-lô kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, che sī lí ê siaⁿ o͘h?” Sò-lô chiū tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu.
I kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí pí góa khah chiàⁿ, in-ūi lí tùi góa chin hó, góa soah tian-tò ēng pháiⁿ pò lí.
Kin-á-ji̍t lí ê só͘-chòe piáu-bêng lí ēng hó tùi-thāi góa, in-ūi Siōng Chú ū chiong góa kau tī lí ê chhiú, m̄-kú lí bô kā góa thâi-sí.
Lâng nā chhē-tio̍h i ê tùi-te̍k, kiám ōe pàng i cháu? Goān Siōng Chú in-ūi kin-á-ji̍t lí tùi góa ê só͘-chòe ēng hó pò lí.
Taⁿ góa chai lí it-tēng ōe choh-ông, Í-sek-lia̍t -kok it-tēng ōe tī lí ê thóng-tī-ē kian-li̍p.
Só͘-í lí tio̍h kí Siōng Chú tùi góa chiù-chōa, lí bōe châu-bia̍t góa ê hō͘-tāi, bōe chiong góa ê miâ tùi goán ê ka-cho̍k chhat-siau.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū tùi Sò-lô chiù-chōa. Jiân-āu, Sò-lô tò-khì i tòa ê só͘-chāi; Tāi-pi̍t kap kun-tè i ê lâng chiūⁿ-khì soaⁿ-khu ê iàu-sài.
Sat-bó-ní sí, Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chū-chi̍p, ūi-tio̍h i thî-khàu, kā i bâi-chòng tī i ê kò͘-hiong La-má. Tāi-pi̍t lo̍h-khì Pa-lân ê khòng-iá.
Tī Má-hûn ū chi̍t ê tōa hó-gia̍h-lâng, i ê sán-gia̍p tī Ka-bi̍t; i ū mî-iûⁿ saⁿ-chheng chiah, soaⁿ-iûⁿ chi̍t-chheng chiah. Hit-chūn, i tī Ka-bi̍t teh chián iûⁿ-mn̂g.
Hit-ê lâng sio̍k Ka-le̍k chong-cho̍k, kiò-chòe Ná-pà, i ê bó͘ Ài-pí-kai sī hiân-hūi koh súi ê hū-jîn-lâng. M̄-kú Ná-pà choh-lâng chho͘-ló͘ koh hiong-ok.
Tāi-pi̍t tī khòng-iá thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ná-pà teh chián iûⁿ-mn̂g,
chiū phài cha̍p ê siàu-liân-lâng, kiò in khì Ka-bi̍t kìⁿ Ná-pà, hoan-hù in ēng i ê miâ kā Ná-pà chhéng-an,
kóng, “Chiok lí tn̂g-hè-siū! Goān lín choân-ke pêng-an! Goān lí sū-sū sūn-lī!
Tāi-pi̍t ū thiaⁿ-kóng lí tī chia teh chián iûⁿ-mn̂g; lí ê kò͘-iûⁿ--ê kap goán chòe-hé tī Ka-bi̍t ê sî, goán m̄-bat khi-hū in, in mā m̄-bat sit-lo̍h sím-mi̍h.

Lí thang mn̄g lí ê kang-lâng, in ōe kā lí kóng. Tāi-pi̍t chhiáⁿ lí hó khoán-thāi goán chiah-ê siàu-liân-lâng, kin-á-ji̍t tú-tú sī choeh-ji̍t. Chhiáⁿ sûi-piān the̍h tām-po̍h hō͘ goán kap lí ê hō͘-pòe Tāi-pi̍t.”
Tāi-pi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng kàu-ūi, chiū tāi-piáu Tāi-pi̍t chiong chiah-ê ōe kā Ná-pà kóng. In kóng-liáu, chēng-chēng thèng-hāu.
Ná-pà ìn Tāi-pi̍t ê pō͘-hā kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t sī siáⁿ-lâng? Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ sī siáⁿ-lâng? Chòe-kūn put-sî ū po̍k-jîn pōe-poān chú-lâng.
Góa ê piáⁿ, góa ê chúi, kap beh hō͘ chián iûⁿ-mn̂g ê lâng chia̍h ê bah, kiám thang the̍h hō͘ m̄-chai tùi tó-ūi lâi ê lâng?”
Tāi-pi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng oa̍t-tńg-sin tùi goân-lō͘ tò--khì, chiong chiah-ê ōe kā Tāi-pi̍t pò-kò.

Tāi-pi̍t tùi kun-tè i ê lâng kóng, “Lín ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tio̍h tòa to.” In chiū lóng tòa to, Tāi-pi̍t mā tòa. Tè Tāi-pi̍t khì--ê iok ū sì-pah lâng, nn̄g-pah ê lâu-teh kò͘-siú pó͘-kip-phín.

Ná-pà ê kang-lâng ū chi̍t ê lâi kā Ná-pà ê bó͘ Ài-pí-kai kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t tùi khòng-iá chhe sù-chiá lâi kā goán chú-lâng chhéng-an, chú-lâng tian-tò tōa-siaⁿ kā in bú-jio̍k.
M̄-kú hiah-ê lâng tùi goán chin hó, goán tī iá-gōa kap in óng-lâi ê sî lóng bô siū siong-hāi, mā m̄-bat sit-lo̍h sím-mi̍h.
Goán tī in hia chhī iûⁿ ê sî, in mî-ji̍t lóng ū kā goán pó-hō͘.

Chhiáⁿ lí siông-sè siūⁿ, khòaⁿ tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe, in-ūi chai-hō it-tēng ōe lîm-kàu goán ê chú-lâng kap i ê choân-ke. Goán chú-lâng sèng-chêng hiong-ok, bô lâng káⁿ kap i kóng-ōe.”

Ài-pí-kai chiū kóaⁿ-kín chiong nn̄g-pah ê piáⁿ, nn̄g phê-tē chiú, gō͘ chiah hang-hó ê iûⁿ, cha̍p-chhit kong-kun pē-se̍k ê be̍h-á, chi̍t-pah lia̍p phû-tô-koaⁿ-oân, nn̄g-pah lia̍p bû-hoa-kó-koaⁿ-oân, hō͘ lû-á chài.
Jiân-āu i kā hiah-ê kang-lâng kóng, “Lín seng kiâⁿ, góa tè lín ê āu-bīn khì.” M̄-kú i bô kā i ê tiōng-hu Ná-pà kóng.
Ài-pí-kai chiū khiâ-lû lo̍h-soaⁿ, tùi soaⁿ hit-pêng oat--kè-lâi ê sî, tú-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t kap kun-tè i ê lâng tú-hó tùi tùi-bīn teh lâi.
Tāi-pi̍t tú-á teh kóng, “Chit-ê lâng tī khòng-iá só͘-ū ê it-chhè, góa kā i kò͘ kah bô sit-lo̍h pòaⁿ-hāng, si̍t-chāi bô-chhái-kang; i kèng-jiân ēng pháiⁿ pò hó!
Bîn-á-chài thiⁿ-kng í-chêng, góa nā bô chiong in tau só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng lóng thâi-sí, goān Siōng-tè ka-pē chek-hoa̍t góa.”
Ài-pí-kai khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t, kóaⁿ-kín tùi lû-á lo̍h--lâi, tī Tāi-pi̍t ê bīn-chêng phak tī thô͘-kha pài i.
Ài-pí-kai phak tī i ê kha-chêng, kóng, “Góa ê chú ah, lóng sī góa m̄-tio̍h. Kiû lí chún lí ê lú-pī kóng hō͘ lí thiaⁿ. Chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ lú-pī ê ōe.

Góa ê chú, mài chhap hit-ê sèng-chêng hiong-ok ê lâng; i kiò-chòe Ná-pà, bêng-hû-kî-si̍t sī gōng-lâng. M̄-kú góa, lí ê lú-pī, bô tú-tio̍h góa ê chú phài--lâi ê siàu-liân-lâng.

Góa ê chú ah, kì-jiân Siōng Chú chó͘-chí lí bô hoān thâi-sí lâng ê chōe, bô hō͘ lí chhin-chhiú thòe ka-kī pò-siû, góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú kap lí ê sìⁿ-miā chiù-chōa, ‘Goān góa ê chú ê tùi-te̍k kap kè-bô͘ beh hāi lí ê lâng lóng kap Ná-pà kâng-khoán.’
Taⁿ lí ê lú-pī tòa-lâi hō͘ góa ê chú ê lé-mi̍h, chhiáⁿ pun hō͘ kun-tè góa ê chú ê siàu-liân-lâng.

Kiû lí khoan-sià lí lú-pī ê chōe-kò. Siōng Chú it-tēng ōe kā góa ê chú kiàn-li̍p ún-kò͘ ê ông-tiâu, in-ūi góa ê chú ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú kau-chiàn, koh lí it-seng chhē bōe chhut ū sím-mi̍h kè-sit.

Sui-jiân ū lâng khí-lâi tui-jip lí, siàu-siūⁿ lí ê sìⁿ-miā, m̄-kú góa ê chú ê sìⁿ-miā ōe tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè pó-hō͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh pó-hō͘ ke̍k kùi-tiōng ê pó-mi̍h. Lí tùi-te̍k ê sìⁿ-miā ōe hō͘ Siōng Chú hiat-ka̍k, chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng hìⁿ-soh hìⁿ--chhut-khì.
Chiong-lâi Siōng Chú chiàu I tùi góa ê chú ê èng-ún sêng-chiū it-chhè hó-sū, soán-li̍p lí chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê léng-siù ê sî,

góa ê chú chiū m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h bô-iân-bô-kò͘ thâi-lâng, á-sī thòe ka-kī pò-siû, tì-kàu hō͘-hóe, chū-chek. Tng Siōng Chú sù-hok hō͘ góa ê chú ê sî, kiû lí ōe-kì-tit lí ê lú-pī.”
Tāi-pi̍t kā Ài-pí-kai kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè eng-kai siū chheng-chàn, in-ūi I kin-á-ji̍t chhe lí lâi kìⁿ góa.
Lí kap lí ê kiàn-sek lóng chin thang o-ló, in-ūi lí kin-á-ji̍t chó͘-chí góa bô chhin-chhiú pò-siû, hō͘ góa bô hoān-tio̍h thâi-sí lâng ê chōe.

Siōng Chú ū chó͘-chí góa bô siong-hāi lí. Tī Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng, góa káⁿ kóng, ka-chài lí ū sûi-sî kóaⁿ-lâi kìⁿ góa, nā bô, kàu bîn-á-chá-khí, só͘-ū sio̍k Ná-pà ê ta-po͘-lâng, it-tēng liân chi̍t ê to bōe oa̍h--teh.”
Jiân-āu, Tāi-pi̍t chiap-siū Ài-pí-kai tòa--lâi ê lé-mi̍h, chiū kā i kóng, “Lí thang pêng-an tò-khì lín tau; góa chai lí ê ì-sù. Góa tah-èng lí.”

Ài-pí-kai tńg-khì Ná-pà hia, Ná-pà tú tī chhù-lāi teh pān-toh, chhin-chhiūⁿ ông pâi-siat iàn-se̍k. Ná-pà sim-chêng hui-siông sóng-khoài, lim kah chùi-bâng-bâng. Só͘-í, hit-mî Ài-pí-kai bô chiong só͘-ū hoat-seng ê tāi-chì kā i kóng.
Keh-chá-khí, Ná-pà chiú thè, i ê bó͘ chiah chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì kā i kóng; i thiaⁿ-liáu sûi-sî sit-khì ì-sek, kui seng-khu bōe tín-tāng.
Tāi-iok cha̍p ji̍t āu, Siōng Chú phah Ná-pà, i chiū sí--khì.

Tāi-pi̍t thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ná-pà í-keng sí, chiū kóng, “Siōng Chú eng-kai siū chheng-chàn, in-ūi góa tùi Ná-pà siū ê bú-jio̍k, I ū thòe góa sin-oan, koh chó͘-chí góa bô khì chòe pháiⁿ; Siōng Chú chiàu Ná-pà só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ kā i hêng-hoa̍t.” Tāi-pi̍t chiū chhe lâng khì kā Ài-pí-kai kóng beh chhōa i chòe bó͘.
Tāi-pi̍t ê po̍k-jîn khì Ka-bi̍t kìⁿ Ài-pí-kai, kā i kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t chhe goán lâi kìⁿ lí, kóng beh chhōa lí chòe bó͘.”
Ài-pí-kai chiū khí--lâi, phak tī thô͘-kha, kóng, “Góa goān-ì chòe chhe-ēng, kā góa ê chú ê po̍k-jîn sóe-kha.”
Ài-pí-kai sûi-sî khí--lâi, khiâ-lû, chhōa gō͘ ê lú-pī tè Tāi-pi̍t ê sù-chiá chòe-hé khì; i chiū chòe Tāi-pi̍t ê bó͘.
Tāi-pi̍t í-keng ū chhōa Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng A-hi-loán; in nn̄g ê lâng lóng chòe i ê bó͘.
Sò-lô í-keng chiong i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-kah, chiū-sī Tāi-pi̍t ê bó͘, hō͘ Ka-lîm -lâng La-ek ê kiáⁿ Phà-thiat chòe bó͘.
Se-hut -lâng koh khì Ki-pí-a kā Sò-lô pò-kò, kóng Tāi-pi̍t bih tī Iok-su-bûn tang-pêng ê Hap-ki-la-soaⁿ.
Sò-lô chiū khí--lâi, chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t tiong te̍k-soán ê peng saⁿ-chheng, lo̍h-khì Se-hut ê khòng-iá beh chhē Tāi-pi̍t.
Sò-lô tī Iok-su-bûn tang-pêng ê Hap-ki-la-soaⁿ lō͘-piⁿ chat-iâⁿ. Tāi-pi̍t tiàm tī khòng-iá, thiaⁿ-tio̍h Sò-lô lâi khòng-iá beh tui-jip i,
chiū chhe kúi-nā ê cheng-thàm khì thàm, chiah chai Sò-lô chin-chiàⁿ lâi lah.

Tāi-pi̍t chiū chhut-hoat, khì Sò-lô chat-iâⁿ ê só͘-chāi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sò-lô kap Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ goân-sòe Ap-nî-ní khùn ê só͘-chāi, Sò-lô khùn tī kun-iâⁿ ê tiong-ng, pō͘-tūi tī i ê chiu-ûi chat-iâⁿ.

Tāi-pi̍t tùi Hek -lâng A-hi-bí-le̍k kap Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Iok-ap ê hiaⁿ-tī A-pí-su, kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng beh kap góa lo̍h-khì Sò-lô ê iâⁿ-lāi?” A-pí-su kóng, “Góa kap lí lo̍h--khì.”

Tāi-pi̍t kap A-pí-su thàu-mî kàu pō͘-tūi hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sò-lô tī kun-iâⁿ ê tiong-ng teh khùn; i ê chhiuⁿ tī thâu-khak piⁿ, chhah tī thô͘-kha; Ap-nî-ní kap kun-peng khùn tī i ê chiu-ûi.

A-pí-su tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t Siōng-tè chiong lí ê tùi-te̍k kau tī lí ê chhiú. Chhiáⁿ chún góa ēng chhiuⁿ kā i chha̍k thàng--kè, tèng tī thô͘-kha; chi̍t ē chiū hó, bián chha̍k nn̄g ē.”
Tāi-pi̍t kā A-pí-su kóng, “M̄-thang kā i thâi-sí! Siáⁿ-lâng siong-hāi Siōng Chú só͘ soán-li̍p ê ông koh ōe-tàng bô chōe?”
Tāi-pi̍t koh kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, Siōng Chú ōe kā i phah-sí, nā m̄-sī sí-kî kàu sí--khì, chiū-sī tī chiàn-tiûⁿ chiàn-sí.
Góa choa̍t-tùi m̄-káⁿ hē-chhiú phah Siōng Chú soán-li̍p ê ông; kan-ta the̍h i thâu-khak piⁿ ê chhiuⁿ kap chúi-pân, lán chiū cháu.”

Tāi-pi̍t chiū khì the̍h Sò-lô thâu-khak piⁿ ê chhiuⁿ kap chúi-pân. Nn̄g lâng lī-khui, bô lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h, bô lâng chai, mā bô lâng chhíⁿ; in lóng teh khùn, in-ūi Siōng Chú hō͘ in khùn tāng-bîn.
Āu-lâi, Tāi-pi̍t kè-khì lēng-gōa hit-pêng, khiā tī soaⁿ-téng, kap in saⁿ-lī put-chí hn̄g.
Tāi-pi̍t tùi kun-tūi kap Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ Ap-nî-ní hoah kóng, “ Ap-nî-ní ah, lí ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h-bô, lí ná m̄ ìn?” Ap-nî-ní kóng, “Lí sī siáⁿ-lâng, káⁿ kā ông chhá-chhíⁿ?”

Tāi-pi̍t tùi Ap-nî-ní kóng, “Lí kiám m̄-sī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong siōng-kiông ê ióng-sū? Sī-án-chóaⁿ lí bô pó-hō͘ lí ê chú lí ê ông? Tú-chiah ū chi̍t ê peng-á ji̍p-khì beh hāi lí ê ông lí ê chú.

Lí bô chīn chek-jīm. Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, lín lóng kai-sí, in-ūi bô pó-hō͘ lín ê chú, chiū-sī Siōng Chú só͘ soán-li̍p ê ông. Lí khòaⁿ-bāi leh, ông thâu-khak piⁿ ê chhiuⁿ kap chúi-pân tī tó-ūi?”
Sò-lô jīn-chhut sī Tāi-pi̍t ê siaⁿ, chiū kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, sī lí o͘h?” Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Ông, góa ê chú ah, sī góa!”
I koh kóng, “Góa ê chú sī-án-chóaⁿ teh tui-jip lí ê lô͘-po̍k? Góa ū chòe sím-mi̍h? Góa ū chòe sím-mi̍h pháiⁿ?

Ông, góa ê chú ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ lô͘-po̍k ê ōe. Nā-sī Siōng Chú kek-tōng lí kong-kek góa, goān I hoaⁿ-hí chiap-siū góa hiàn ê chè. Nā-sī lâng kā lí sái-lōng, goān in siū Siōng Chú chiù-chó͘, in-ūi in kin-á-ji̍t kā góa kóaⁿ-chhut Siōng Chú èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe, hāi góa tio̍h khì ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng.

Kiû lí m̄-thang hō͘ góa sí tī gōa-kok, lī-khui Siōng Chú bīn-chêng. Í-sek-lia̍t -ông ná tio̍h chhut-lâi chhē chi̍t chiah ka-cháu, ná tio̍h tī soaⁿ--ni̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ teh jip chi̍t chiah iá-chiáu!”

Sò-lô ìn kóng, “Góa m̄-tio̍h. Góa ê kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, lí thang tò--lâi. Góa bōe koh hāi lí, in-ūi kin-á-ji̍t lí ū khòaⁿ-tāng góa ê sìⁿ-miā. Góa si̍t-chāi chin hô͘-tô͘, hoān chiah-ni̍h tōa ê chhò-gō͘!”
Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Ông ah, lí ê chhiuⁿ tī chia, chhiáⁿ kiò chi̍t ê pō͘-hā kè-lâi gia̍h--tńg-khì.

Siōng Chú ōe chiàu ta̍k-ê lâng ê chèng-gī sìn-si̍t kā i pò-tap; kin-á-ji̍t Siōng Chú ū chiong lí kau tī góa ê chhiú, m̄-kú góa bô chhut-chhiú siong-hāi Siōng Chú soán-li̍p ê ông.
Góa kin-á-ji̍t khòaⁿ-tāng lí ê sìⁿ-miā, goān Siōng Chú mā án-ni khòaⁿ-tāng góa ê sìⁿ-miā, kiù góa thoat-lī só͘-ū ê hoān-lān.”

Sò-lô kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, goān lí tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê chiok-hok; lí ōe chòe tōa tāi-chì, só͘ chòe--ê it-tēng ōe sêng-kong.” Tāi-pi̍t chiū lī-khui, Sò-lô mā tò-tńg-khì i tòa ê só͘-chāi.

Tāi-pi̍t sim-lāi siūⁿ, “Chóng ū chi̍t ji̍t góa ōe sí tī Sò-lô ê chhiú, lêng-khó cháu-lâi Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tōe, án-ni Sò-lô chiū ōe sí-sim, bōe koh tī Í-sek-lia̍t kéng-lāi chhē góa, góa chiū ōe-tàng thoat-lī i ê chhiú.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū chhōa la̍k-pah ê pō͘-hā, kè-khì Ka-te̍k -ông, Má-gô ê kiáⁿ A-kiat hia.

Tāi-pi̍t kap i nn̄g ê bó͘, chiū-sī Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng A-hi-loán kap Ná-pà ê ûi-song Ka-bi̍t -lâng Ài-pí-kai, kap Tāi-pi̍t ê pō͘-hā í-ki̍p in ê ka-koàn, lóng tiàm tī Ka-te̍k -ông A-kiat hia.
Ū lâng kā Sò-lô kóng Tāi-pi̍t í-keng cháu-khì Ka-te̍k, Sò-lô chiū bô koh tui-jip i.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Tāi-pi̍t tùi A-kiat -ông kóng, “Lí nā khòaⁿ góa chòe pêng-iú, chhiáⁿ tī chng-kha sù góa chi̍t ê só͘-chāi thang tòa, lí ê lô͘-po̍k chiū bián kap lí tòa tī kiaⁿ-siâⁿ.”
Hit-ji̍t, A-kiat -ông chiong Sé-kek-la hō͘ i; in-ūi án-ni, Sé-kek-la sio̍k Iû-tāi -ông, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Tāi-pi̍t tiàm tī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tōe, kiōng chi̍t nî sì kò-ge̍h.
Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê pō͘-hā chiūⁿ-khì kong-táⁿ Ki-su̍t -lâng, Ki-sek -lâng, A-má-le̍k -lâng; chit kúi cho̍k í-keng tī Su-ní kàu Ai-ki̍p hit tiong-kan ê tōe-khu tòa chin kú.
Tāi-pi̍t bô-lūn kong-chiàm sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, lâm-lú lóng thâi-sí, bô lâu kah pòaⁿ-ê; koh chhiúⁿ in ê gû, iûⁿ, lû, lo̍k-tô, kap i-ho̍k, tò-tńg-lâi kìⁿ A-kiat.

A-kiat -ông ta̍k-piàn lóng ōe mn̄g i, “Lín kin-á-ji̍t khì kong-chiàm sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi?” Tāi-pi̍t ōe ìn kóng “Goán khì kong-chiàm Iû-tāi lâm-hng”, á-sī kóng “ Iâ-la-bia̍t -lâng ê lâm-hng”, á-sī kóng “ Ki-nî -lâng ê lâm-hng”.

Tāi-pi̍t ta̍k-piàn chiong lâm-lú lóng thâi-sí, liân chi̍t ê to bô tòa tńg-khì Ka-te̍k, chiah bián in chiong Tāi-pi̍t só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì pò lâng chai. Tāi-pi̍t tiàm tī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tōe ê sî lóng án-ni chòe.
A-kiat sìn-jīm Tāi-pi̍t, siūⁿ-kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t hō͘ i ê pún-cho̍k Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ, só͘-í i ōe éng-oán chòe góa ê lô͘-po̍k.”

Kè bô jōa kú, Hui-lī-sū -lâng tiàu-chi̍p kun-tūi beh kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng. A-kiat -ông tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí eng-kai chai, lí kap lí ê pō͘-hā tio̍h kap góa tàu-tīn chok-chiàn.”

Tāi-pi̍t ìn kóng, “Bô būn-tôe, góa sī lí ê lô͘-po̍k, lí chai góa ōe ūi-tio̍h lí chòe sím-mi̍h.” A-kiat -ông kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Án-ni, góa beh phài lí chòe góa chiong-sin ê sī-ōe.”

Hit-sî Sat-bó-ní í-keng sí, só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ūi-tio̍h i ai-khàu, kā i bâi-chòng tī i ê kò͘-hiong La-má. Sò-lô bat chiong ang-î kap kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t--ê lóng kóaⁿ-chhut kok-kéng.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng chū-chi̍p, hêng-kun kàu Su-liām chat-iâⁿ; Sò-lô chū-chi̍p só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Ki-lī-pho chat-iâⁿ.
Sò-lô khòaⁿ-tio̍h Hui-lī-sū ê kun-peng, chiū chin kiaⁿ, sim-koaⁿ pho̍k-pho̍k-chhéng.
Sò-lô mn̄g Siōng Chú; Siōng Chú lóng bô ēng bîn-bāng, bô ēng O͘-lêng, á-sī sian-ti, kā i ìn-tap.
Sò-lô hoan-hù i ê po̍k-jîn kóng, “Kā góa chhē chi̍t ê ang-î, góa thang khì mn̄g i.” Po̍k-jîn kóng, “Tī Ún To-ní ū chi̍t ê ang-î.”

Sò-lô chiū piàn-chong, chhēng pa̍t-khoán saⁿ; chhōa nn̄g ê lâng kap i chòe-hé khì. Tī mî--sî in khì hit-ê ang-î hia. Sò-lô kā i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí ēng khan-bông ê hoat-su̍t, khan góa kā lí kóng hit-ê lâng chhut--lâi.”
Ang-î tùi i kóng, “Lí chai Sò-lô ê só͘-chòe; i ū kā ang-î kap kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t--ê lóng kóaⁿ-chhut kok-kéng; lí sī-án-chóaⁿ siat-kè beh hāi góa ê sìⁿ-miā?”
Sò-lô kí Siōng Chú tùi i chiù-chōa, kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, lí bōe in-ūi chit-ê tāi-chì siū hêng-hoa̍t.”
Ang-î kóng, “Lí ài góa kā lí khan siáⁿ-lâng chhut--lâi?” I kóng, “Kā góa chhiáⁿ Sat-bó-ní chhut--lâi.”
Ang-î khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sat-bó-ní chiū tōa-siaⁿ ki--chhut-lâi, kā Sò-lô kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ phiàn góa? Lí sī Sò-lô!”
Ông tùi i kóng, “Bián kiaⁿ, lí khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sím-mi̍h?” Ang-î kā Sò-lô kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h sîn-hûn tùi tōe--ni̍h chhut--lâi.”
Sò-lô kóng, “I siⁿ-chòe siáⁿ-khoán?” Ang-î kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê lāu-lâng chhut--lâi, seng-khu moa tn̂g-saⁿ.” Sò-lô chai sī Sat-bó-ní, chiū phak tī thô͘-kha kā i pài.

Sat-bó-ní kā Sò-lô kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ kiáu-jiáu góa, khan góa chhut--lâi?” Sò-lô kóng, “Góa hui-siông thòng-khó͘, in-ūi Hui-lī-sū -lâng lâi kong-kek góa, Siōng-tè mā lī-khui góa, bô koh thong-kè sian-ti á-sī bîn-bāng ìn-tap góa. Só͘-í góa chhiáⁿ lí lâi, thang chí-sī góa tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe.”
Sat-bó-ní kóng, “Siōng Chú í-keng lī-khui lí, chòe lí ê tùi-te̍k; lí ná tio̍h mn̄g góa?
Siōng Chú ōe chiàu I kau-tài góa tùi lí kóng--ê si̍t-hiān; I í-keng chiong lí ê ông-koân pak khí-lâi kau hō͘ lí ê tâng-phōaⁿ Tāi-pi̍t.
In-ūi lí ûi-pōe Siōng Chú ê ōe, bô chiong A-má-le̍k -lâng kap in só͘-ū--ê lóng siau-bia̍t, só͘-í Siōng Chú kin-á-ji̍t tùi lí chòe chit-ê tāi-chì.

Siōng Chú beh chiong lí kap Í-sek-lia̍t kau tī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú. Bîn-á-chài lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ-jî ōe kap góa chòe-hé; Siōng Chú mā beh chiong Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-tūi kau tī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú.”
Sò-lô in-ūi Sat-bó-ní ê ōe hui-siông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, sûi-sî tó--lo̍h-khì, tó kah ti̍t-ti̍t-ti̍t; kui-mî kui-ji̍t bô chia̍h pòaⁿ-hāng, seng-khu lóng bô la̍t.

Hit-ê ang-î kiâⁿ óa-khì Sò-lô hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i hiah-ni̍h kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, chiū tùi i kóng, “Lí ê lú-pī thiaⁿ lí ê ōe, bô kò͘ ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā, ū chiàu lí ê iau-kiû khì chòe.
Taⁿ, chhiáⁿ lí thiaⁿ lú-pī ê ōe, ún-chún góa khoán tām-po̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ lí chia̍h, lí chiah ū khùi-la̍t chiūⁿ-lō͘.”
Sò-lô kū-choa̍t, kóng, “Góa m̄ chia̍h.” M̄-kú i ê po̍k-jîn kap ang-î kā i hó-chhùi khó͘-khǹg, i chiah thiaⁿ in ê ōe, tùi thô͘-kha khí--lâi, chē tī bîn-chhn̂g.
Ang-î kóaⁿ-kín khan chhù--ni̍h hit-chiah pûi gû-á khì thâi, koh chhiau mī-hún, hang bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ,
pâi tī Sò-lô kap i ê po̍k-jîn bīn-chêng, in chiū chia̍h. Hit-mî in khí-sin tò--khì.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng tiàu-chi̍p in só͘-ū ê kun-tūi kàu A-hut. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Iâ-su-lia̍t ê chúi-chôaⁿ piⁿ chat-iâⁿ.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê siú-léng tòa-peng chhut-tīn, ū-ê tòa pah-lâng, ū-ê tòa chheng-lâng. Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê pō͘-hā, í-ki̍p A-kiat -ông kiâⁿ tī āu-bīn.

Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chiòng-léng kóng, “Chiah-ê Hi-pek-lâi -lâng tī chia chhòng siáⁿ?” A-kiat -ông kā Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chiòng-léng kóng, “Chit-ê lâng sī Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Sò-lô ê chiòng-léng Tāi-pi̍t. I í-keng kap góa tòa nî-gōa; tùi i lâi tâu-hâng kàu kin-á-ji̍t, góa m̄-bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ū hoān sím-mi̍h kè-sit.”

Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chiòng-léng tùi A-kiat siū-khì, kā i kóng, “Hō͘ chit-ê lâng tò-khì lí kā i an-tì ê só͘-chāi, m̄-thang hō͘ i kap lán chhut-khì kau-chiàn, chiah bián i tī kau-chiàn ê sî pìⁿ-chòe lán ê tùi-te̍k. I beh ēng sím-mi̍h hôe-ho̍k i ê chú-lâng tùi i ê sìn-jīm? Kiám m̄-sī lán chiah-ê lâng ê thâu-khak?

Í-chêng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thiàu-bú ê sî, ū lâng chhiùⁿ, ū lâng ìn, kóng: Sò-lô thâi-sí chheng-chheng, Tāi-pi̍t thâi-sí bān-bān; in só͘ kóng--ê kiám m̄-sī chit-ê Tāi-pi̍t?”

A-kiat kiò Tāi-pi̍t lâi, kā i kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, lí sī sêng-si̍t ê lâng; lí tī góa ê kun-tūi ho̍k-ia̍h, góa chin boán-ì, in-ūi tùi lí lâi chia kàu kin-á-ji̍t, góa m̄-bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ū sím-mi̍h sit-chhò. M̄-kú kî-tha ê siú-léng bô kah-ì lí.
Taⁿ lí pêng-an tńg--khì, chiah bián chiah-ê siú-léng bô hoaⁿ-hí lí ê só͘-chòe.”

Tāi-pi̍t tùi A-kiat kóng, “Góa ū chòe sím-mi̍h tāi-chì? Tùi góa lâi lí chia kàu kin-á-ji̍t, lí tī lí lô͘-po̍k ê sin-chiūⁿ ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h sím-mi̍h tāi-chì, hō͘ lí ê lô͘-po̍k bōe-tàng kap ông — góa ê chú ê tùi-te̍k kau-chiàn?”
A-kiat ìn kóng, “Góa chai, góa khòaⁿ lí chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá hiah-ni̍h hó, m̄-kú Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chiòng-léng bô ài lí kap goán tàu-tīn khì kau-chiàn.
Só͘-í, bîn-á-chài thiⁿ chi̍t-ē kng, lí tio̍h chhōa só͘-ū lī-khui Sò-lô, tè lí lâi góa chia ê lâng lī-khui.”
Keh-chá-khí, Tāi-pi̍t kap tè i ê lâng thàu-chá chiū chhut-hoat, tò-khì Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tōe; siâng-sî, Hui-lī-sū -lâng ǹg Iâ-su-lia̍t chìn-kun.

Tē-saⁿ ji̍t, Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê pō͘-hā tò-khì Sé-kek-la. In kàu í-chêng, A-má-le̍k -lâng í-keng ū chhim-hoān Iû-tāi lâm-hng kap Sé-kek-la. A-má-le̍k -lâng pàng-hé sio Sé-kek-la,
lia̍h hū-lú kap siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng, bô-lūn tōa-sòe, chi̍t ê to bô thâi-sí, lóng kā in lia̍h--khì.
Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê pō͘-hā kàu hit-ê siâⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h siâⁿ í-keng sio--khì, in ê bó͘, kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lóng hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì.
Tāi-pi̍t kap tè i ê lâng chiū khui-siaⁿ háu, háu kah bô-la̍t thang koh háu.
Tāi-pi̍t nn̄g ê bó͘, chiū-sī Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng A-hi-loán kap Ná-pà ê ûi-song Ka-bi̍t -lâng Ài-pí-kai, mā hō͘ A-má-le̍k -lâng lia̍h--khì.

Tāi-pi̍t hui-siông tio̍h-kip, in-ūi i ê pō͘-hā ūi-tio̍h in ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ khó͘-thàng chhoeh-sim, kóng beh ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí. M̄-kú Tāi-pi̍t óa-khò Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t.
Tāi-pi̍t kā A-hi-bí-le̍k ê kiáⁿ chè-si A-pí-a-tha kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí tòa í-hut-tek lâi.” A-pí-a-tha chiū tòa í-hut-tek lâi hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t.
Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa tui-jip hiah-ê húi-tô͘, kiám jip ōe tio̍h?” Siōng Chú ìn kóng, “Khì jip, it-tēng ōe jip--tio̍h, mā it-tēng ōe-tàng kiù in tò--lâi.”

Tāi-pi̍t chiū chhōa i ê pō͘-hā la̍k-pah lâng chhut-hoat, lâi kàu Pí-so-khoe. Ū nn̄g-pah ê ià-siān, kiâⁿ bōe kè Pí-so-khoe, chiū lâu tī hia. Tāi-pi̍t kap sì-pah ê pō͘-hā kè-sio̍k khì tui-jip.
In tī iá-gōa tú-tio̍h chi̍t ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng, chiū tòa i khì Tāi-pi̍t hia; ēng piáⁿ hō͘ i chia̍h, ēng chúi hō͘ i lim;
koh hō͘ i chi̍t lia̍p bû-hoa-kó-koaⁿ-oân, nn̄g lia̍p phû-tô-koaⁿ-oân; i chia̍h-liáu, goân-khì hôe-ho̍k; in-ūi i saⁿ mî saⁿ ji̍t bô chia̍h bô lim.

Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g i kóng, “Lí ê chú-lâng sī siáⁿ-lâng? Lí tùi tó-ūi lâi?” I ìn kóng, “Góa sī Ai-ki̍p gín-á, sī A-má-le̍k -lâng ê lô͘-lē. Góa saⁿ ji̍t chêng phòa-pīⁿ, chiū hō͘ chú-lâng pàng-sak.
Goán chhim-hoān Iû-tāi lâm-pō͘ ê Ki-lī-thê kap Ka-le̍k tōe-khu, koh ēng hé sio Sé-kek-la.”

Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g i kóng, “Lí kiám khéng chhōa góa khì hiah-ê húi-tô͘ hia?” I ìn kóng, “Lí tio̍h kí Siōng-tè tùi góa chiù-chōa, pó-chèng bōe kā góa thâi-sí, mā bōe chiong góa kau hō͘ góa ê chú-lâng, góa chiū chhōa lí khì.”
I chhōa Tāi-pi̍t lo̍h--khì ê sî, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in hun-sòaⁿ chi̍t-sì-kòe teh lim-chia̍h thiàu-bú; in-ūi in tùi Hui-lī-sū -tōe kap Iû-tāi -tōe chhiúⁿ ê mi̍h chin chōe.
Tāi-pi̍t tùi thiⁿ-bē-kng kong-kek in kàu hông-hun-àm; chí-ū sì-pah ê khiâ lo̍k-tô ê siàu-liân-lâng cháu ū khì, í-gōa bô chi̍t ê cháu ū lī.
A-má-le̍k -lâng kiap--khì ê châi-bu̍t, Tāi-pi̍t lóng ū chhiúⁿ--tńg-lâi, mā ū kā i nn̄g ê bó͘ kiù--tò-lâi.
A-má-le̍k -lâng chhiúⁿ--khì-ê, bô-lūn tōa-sòe, kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, châi-bu̍t, Tāi-pi̍t lóng tòa--tńg-lâi, bô sit-lo̍h chi̍t hāng.
Tāi-pi̍t ê pō͘-hā chiong só͘-ū chhiúⁿ--lâi ê gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn, kóaⁿ tī kî-tha cheng-siⁿ ê thâu-chêng, tián kóng, “Chiah-ê sī Tāi-pi̍t ê chiàn-lī-phín.”

Tāi-pi̍t tńg-lâi kàu hiah-ê in-ūi ià-siān bô tè i khì, lâu tī Pí-so-khoe ê nn̄g-pah lâng hia. In chhut-lâi gêng-chiap Tāi-pi̍t kap ū tè i khì ê kun-peng ê sî, Tāi-pi̍t kiâⁿ chìn-chêng kā in chhéng-an.

Kap Tāi-pi̍t khì ê lâng tiong-kan ū chi̍t-kóa pháiⁿ-lâng húi-lūi án-ni kóng, “In bô kap lán khì, chiah-ê chiàn-lī-phín mài pun hō͘ in, kan-ta in ê bó͘, kiáⁿ-jî, hō͘ in chhōa--tńg-khì.”
Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Hiaⁿ-tī ah, Siōng Chú siúⁿ-sù hō͘ lán ê mi̍h, m̄-thang án-ni chhú-lí, in-ūi I ū pó-hō͘ lán, chiong kong-kek lán ê tùi-te̍k kau tī lán ê chhiú.
Lín chit-khoán chòe-hoat siáⁿ-lâng ōe tông-ì? Chhut-tīn ê lâng pun-tio̍h jōa-chōe, kò͘ pó͘-kip-phín ê lâng mā tio̍h pun hiah chōe; tāi-ke tio̍h kong-ke pun.”
Tùi hit-ji̍t khí, Tāi-pi̍t siat-li̍p chit-ê pān-hoat chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.

Tāi-pi̍t kàu Sé-kek-la ê sî, the̍h chi̍t-pō͘-hūn ê chiàn-lī-phín sàng hō͘ i ê pêng-iú, Iû-tāi ê tiúⁿ-ló. I kóng, “Chiah-ê sī tùi Siōng Chú ê tùi-te̍k chhiúⁿ--lâi-ê, sàng hō͘ lín chòe lé-mi̍h.”
I chiong lé-mi̍h sàng hō͘ tiàm tī Pek-te̍k-lī, Iû-tāi lâm-hng ê La-boa̍t, Ngá-thê-ní,
A-lô-ní, Sek-boa̍t, Í-si̍t-thê-bo̍k,
La-hap-le̍k, Iâ-la-bia̍t -lâng kap Ki-nî -lâng hiah-ê siâⁿ,
Hô-ní-má, Pho-la-san, A-that,
Hi-pek-lûn, í-ki̍p Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê pō͘-hā pêng-siông ū teh óng-lâi ê só͘-chāi ê tiúⁿ-ló.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiàn-pāi tô-cháu, tī Ki-lī-pho-soaⁿ sí chin chōe lâng.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng tui-jip Sò-lô kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ, thâi-sí Sò-lô saⁿ ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan, A-pí-ná-ta̍t, kap Be̍k-ki Su-a.
Sò-lô siū-tio̍h béng-lia̍t ê kong-kek; i hō͘ siā-chìⁿ ê lâng hoat-kiàn, siā--tio̍h, siū-siong chin siong-tiōng.

Sò-lô kā thòe i gia̍h kun-khì ê sī-ōe kóng, “Pu̍ih to kā góa chha̍k--sí, chiah bián góa hō͘ chiah-ê bô siū kat-lé ê lâng thâi-sí, kā góa lêng-jio̍k.” Hit-ê sī-ōe m̄-káⁿ, in-ūi i chin kiaⁿ. Sò-lô chiū ǹg to phak--lo̍h-khì, ka-kī chha̍k--sí.
Hit-ê sī-ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sò-lô í-keng sí, mā phak--lo̍h-khì, ka-kī chha̍k, kap Sò-lô chòe-hé sí.
Sò-lô kap i saⁿ ê kiáⁿ, gia̍h kun-khì--ê, kap só͘-ū kun-tè Sò-lô ê lâng kâng chi̍t ji̍t sí.

Tī Iâ-su-lia̍t Soaⁿ-kok hit-pêng kap tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in ê kun-tūi í-keng tô-cháu, Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ mā lóng chiàn-sí, chiū pàng siâⁿ tô-cháu. Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiū lâi chiàm hiah-ê siâⁿ, tī hia khiā-khí.
Keh-ji̍t, Hui-lī-sū -lâng lâi pak chiàn-sí ê lâng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sò-lô kap i saⁿ ê kiáⁿ sí tī Ki-lī-pho-soaⁿ,
chiū chām i ê thâu, thǹg i ê chiàn-kah, phài lâng khì Hui-lī-sū ta̍k só͘-chāi, chiong chit-ê siau-sit pò hō͘ in biō--ni̍h ê ngó͘-siōng kap jîn-bîn chai.
In chiong Sò-lô ê chiàn-kah hē tī A-su-tha-lio̍k ê biō-lāi, chiong i ê sin-si tèng tī Pek Siān ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng.
Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí ê chū-bîn thiaⁿ-tio̍h Hui-lī-sū -lâng tùi Sò-lô só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì,
in ê ióng-sū lóng khí--lâi, kui-mî hêng-kun, khì chiong Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ ê sin-si tùi Pek Siān ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ chhú--lo̍h-lâi, tòa kàu Ngá-pí, tī hia hé-hòa,
chiong in ê kut-hâi chòng tī Ngá-pí ê liú-chhiū kha, kìm-chia̍h chhit ji̍t.
Sò-lô sí liáu-āu, Tāi-pi̍t thâi-iâⁿ A-má-le̍k -lâng tò--lâi, tī Sé-kek-la tòa nn̄g ji̍t.
Tē-saⁿ ji̍t, hut-jiân ū chi̍t ê lâng tùi Sò-lô ê kun-iâⁿ lâi, saⁿ thiah-phòa, thâu-khak sám thô͘-hún, kàu Tāi-pi̍t hia, phak tī thô͘-kha pài i.
Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g i kóng, “Lí tùi tó-ūi lâi?” I ìn kóng, “Góa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-iâⁿ tô-cháu--lâi.”

Tāi-pi̍t koh mn̄g i, “Tāi-chì án-chóaⁿ? Kín kā góa kóng.” I ìn kóng, “Kun-tūi tùi chiàn-tiûⁿ thâi-su tô-cháu, chin chōe lâng chiàn-sí, liân Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan mā sí.”
Tāi-pi̍t kā hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng kóng, “Lí án-chóaⁿ chai Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan í-keng sí?”
Kā i pò-kò ê siàu-liân-lâng kóng, “Góa tú-hó khì Ki-lī-pho-soaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sò-lô óa tī i ê chhiuⁿ, ū chiàn-chhia bé-peng jip-óa i.
I oa̍t-thâu khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa, chiū kiò góa; góa ìn kóng, ‘Góa tī chia.’
I mn̄g góa, ‘Lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?’ Góa ìn kóng, ‘Góa sī A-má-le̍k -lâng.’
I koh kā góa kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ lâi góa piⁿ--á kā góa thâi-sí. Góa iáu oa̍h--teh, m̄-kú chin thòng-khó͘.’
Góa chiū óa--khì, kā i thâi-sí, in-ūi góa chai i tó--lo̍h-khì, it-tēng bōe oa̍h; góa chiū the̍h i thâu-khak ê ông-koan kap i ê chhiú-khoân, tòa-lâi góa ê chú chia.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū thiah-li̍h saⁿ, kun-tè i ê lâng mā án-ni.
In ūi-tio̍h Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan, Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ke, pi-ai thî-khàu, kìm-chia̍h kàu ji̍t àm, in-ūi in lóng sí tī to-ē.
Tāi-pi̍t kā tùi i pò-kò ê siàu-liân-lâng mn̄g kóng, “Lí sī tó-ūi ê lâng?” Ìn kóng, “Góa sī chhut-gōa-lâng ê kiáⁿ, A-má-le̍k -lâng.”
Tāi-pi̍t tùi i kóng, “Lí chhin-chhiú thâi-sí Siōng Chú soán-li̍p ê ông, ná bōe kiaⁿ?”
Tāi-pi̍t kiò chi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng, kóng, “Lâi, khì kā thâi-sí.” I chiū khì kā hit-ê A-má-le̍k -lâng thâi-sí.
Tāi-pi̍t kā i kóng, “Che sī lí ka-kī chòe-tit-lâi--ê, in-ūi lí chhin-chhùi choh-chèng kóng, ‘Góa thâi-sí Siōng Chú soán-li̍p ê ông.’”
Tāi-pi̍t choh ai-ko, tui-tō Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan.
I bēng-lēng lâng chiong chit-siú kiò-chòe “Keng-ko” ê si kà Iû-tāi -lâng chhiùⁿ. Chit-siú si ū kì-chài tī Ngá-soah-ní-kì:
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí ê chun-êng-chiá siū thâi tī soaⁿ-thâu; tōa eng-hiông kèng-jiân tó--lo̍h-khì!
M̄-thang tī Ka-te̍k soan-pò͘, m̄-thang tī A-si̍t-ki-lûn ê koe-lō͘ pò-iông, chiah bián Hui-lī-sū ê cha-bó͘ gín-á hoaⁿ-hí, bô siū kat-lé ê lâng ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ khoài-lo̍k.
Ki-lī-pho-soaⁿ ah, goān lí hia bô hō͘, bô lō͘-chúi, thó͘-tōe pha-hng bô chhut-sán; in-ūi tī lí hia ióng-sū ê tún-pâi siū hiat-ka̍k, Sò-lô ê tún-pâi bô koh boah-iû.
Iok-ná-tan ê keng bô suh-tio̍h tùi-te̍k ê huih bōe siu-hôe; Sò-lô ê to bô chia̍h-tio̍h ióng-sū ê iû bōe ji̍p-siù.
Sò-lô kap Iok-ná-tan lâng-lâng ì-ài, siū lâng kèng-tiōng; siⁿ bô hun-khui, sí bô saⁿ-lī. In pí eng-chiáu khah kín, pí sai khah kiông.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h ūi Sò-lô thî-khàu! I bat hō͘ lín chhēng chu-âng-sek ê súi-saⁿ, hō͘ lín ê i-ho̍k ū n̂g-kim chòe chng-thāⁿ.
Ióng-sū kèng-jiân tó tī chiàn-tiûⁿ! Iok-ná-tan siū-thâi tī lí ê soaⁿ-thâu!
Góa ê hiaⁿ-tī Iok-ná-tan ah, góa ūi lí ai-siong; lí kap góa siōng chhin. Lí tùi góa ê thiàⁿ chin kî-biāu, iâⁿ-kè hū-jîn-lâng ê thiàⁿ.
Ióng-sū kèng-jiân tó--lo̍h-khì! Bú-khì mā lóng húi-hoāi!

Āu-lâi, Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa chiūⁿ-khì Iû-tāi ê chi̍t ê siâⁿ hó--bô?” Siōng Chú kā i kóng, “Hó, thang khì.” Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa tio̍h chiūⁿ-khì tó chi̍t ê siâⁿ?” Siōng Chú kóng, “Khì Hi-pek-lûn.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū kap i nn̄g ê bó͘, chiū-sī Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng A-hi-loán kap Ka-bi̍t -lâng Ná-pà ê ûi-song Ài-pí-kai, lóng chiūⁿ-khì hia.
Tāi-pi̍t mā chhōa kun-tè i ê lâng kap in ê ka-koàn chòe-hé chiūⁿ--khì; in chiū tòa tī Hi-pek-lûn hiah-ê siâⁿ.
Iû-tāi -lâng lâi hia, ēng iû boah Tāi-pi̍t chòe Iû-tāi -ke ê ông. Ū lâng kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, bâi-chòng Sò-lô --ê sī Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí -lâng.

Tāi-pi̍t chiū chhe sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí -lâng, kā in kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú sù-hok lín, in-ūi lín ū ēng tiong-sêng tùi-thāi lín ê chú Sò-lô, kā i bâi-chòng.
Goān Siōng Chú ēng jîn-chû sêng-si̍t khoán-thāi lín; góa mā beh tap-siā lín, in-ūi lín ū chòe chit-ê tāi-chì.
Lín tio̍h kian-kiông ióng-kám, in-ūi lín ê chú Sò-lô í-keng sí. Taⁿ, Iû-tāi -ke mā í-keng ēng iû boah góa chòe in ê ông.”
Sò-lô ê goân-sòe, Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ Ap-nî-ní, chhōa Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ I-si Pho-siat kè-khì Má-hap-liām,
siat-li̍p i choh-ông tī-lí Ki-lia̍t, A-siat, Iâ-su-lia̍t, Í-hoat-liân, Piān-ngá-bín, kap só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ I-si Pho-siat sì-cha̍p hè chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, chē-ūi nn̄g nî. M̄-kú, Iû-tāi -ke tè Tāi-pi̍t.
Tāi-pi̍t tī Hi-pek-lûn chòe Iû-tāi -ke ê ông, chóng-kiōng chhit nî la̍k kò-ge̍h.
Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ Ap-nî-ní kap Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ I-si Pho-siat ê jîn-sîn, tùi Má-hap-liām khì Ki-piàn.

Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap kap Tāi-pi̍t ê jîn-sîn mā chhut--khì, kap in tī Ki-piàn ê chúi-tî piⁿ saⁿ-tú; chi̍t tūi chē tī chúi-tî ê chit-pêng, chi̍t tūi chē tī chúi-tî ê hit-pêng.
Ap-nî-ní tùi Iok-ap kóng, “Lán lâi kiò siàu-liân-lâng tī lán ê bīn-chêng koat-tàu.” Iok-ap kóng, “Hó, hō͘ in chhut--lâi.”
In chiū tiám jîn-sò͘, phài siàu-liân-lâng kè--khì; sio̍k Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ I-si Pho-siat ê Piān-ngá-bín -lâng cha̍p-jī miâ, Tāi-pi̍t ê pō͘-hā mā cha̍p-jī miâ.

In ta̍k-ê khiú tùi-hong ê thâu-khak, ēng to tu̍h-ji̍p tùi-hong ê hia̍p-ē; án-ni, jī-cha̍p-sì ê chòe-chi̍t-ē tó--lo̍h-khì, lóng sí. Só͘-í, Ki-piàn hit-ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Hi-lī-kah Hap-sò͘-lîm.
Hit-ji̍t ê kau-chiàn chin ke̍k-lia̍t; Ap-nî-ní kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t ê pō͘-hā phah-pāi.
Tī hia ū Sé-lō͘-ngá saⁿ ê kiáⁿ, Iok-ap, A-pí-su, A-sat-hek; A-sat-hek chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-lo̍k hiah-ni̍h gâu cháu.
A-sat-hek tui-jip Ap-nî-ní; ti̍t-ti̍t jip, bô phian-chó, bô phian-iū.
Ap-nî-ní oa̍t-thâu khòaⁿ, kóng, “ A-sat-hek ah, sī lí á m̄-sī?” Ìn kóng, “Tio̍h!”
Ap-nî-ní kā i kóng, “Lí oat-khì pa̍t-ūi, lia̍h chi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng, pak i ê kun-ho̍k.” M̄-kú A-sat-hek ti̍t-ti̍t kā tui, m̄-khéng oa̍t-cháu.
Ap-nî-ní koh kā i kóng, “Lí oa̍t-cháu m̄-thang jip góa. Góa ná tio̍h kā lí thâi-sí? Nā kā lí thâi-sí, góa ná ū bīn thang kìⁿ lín hiaⁿ-ko Iok-ap?”

A-sat-hek m̄-khéng oa̍t-cháu; Ap-nî-ní chiū ēng chhiuⁿ tò-chhah i ê pak-tó͘, chhiuⁿ thàng-kè i ê ka-chiah-phiaⁿ, i chiū tó--lo̍h-khì, sí tī hia. Só͘-ū lâi kàu A-sat-hek sí ê só͘-chāi ê lâng, lóng thêng lo̍h-lâi khiā tī hia.
Iok-ap kap A-pí-su tui Ap-nî-ní. Ji̍t lo̍h ê sî, in jip kàu thàng Ki-piàn khòng-iá ê lō͘-piⁿ, Ki-a tùi-bīn ê A-má-soaⁿ.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng chū-chi̍p tè Ap-nî-ní, chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t tīn, khiā tī soaⁿ-téng.

Ap-nî-ní kiò Iok-ap kóng, “Lán kiám thang éng-oán thâi bōe soah? Lí kiám m̄ chai kiat-kio̍k ōe chin thòng-khó͘? Lí kàu tī-sî chiah beh hō͘ kun-tè lí ê lâng tò--khì, bô koh jip in ê hiaⁿ-tī?”
Iok-ap kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè chiù-chōa, nā m̄-sī lí án-ni kóng, góa ê pō͘-hā chiū ōe jip in ê hiaⁿ-tī kàu thiⁿ-kng.”
Tùi án-ni, Iok-ap pûn sàu-kak, kun-tè ê lâng chiū thêng--teh, bô koh tui-jip Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, mā bô koh kau-chiàn.
Ap-nî-ní kap tè i ê lâng kui-mî hêng-kun, kiâⁿ-kè A-la-pa, kè Iok-tàn-hô, kiâⁿ kui chá-kí chiah kàu Má-hap-liām.
Iok-ap bô koh jip Ap-nî-ní, chiū tò--lâi, chū-chi̍p só͘-ū tè i ê lâng. A-sat-hek í-gōa, Tāi-pi̍t ê peng kiám cha̍p-káu lâng.
M̄-kú Tāi-pi̍t ê peng phah-sí Piān-ngá-bín -lâng kap tè Ap-nî-ní ê lâng, chóng-kiōng saⁿ-pah la̍k-cha̍p lâng.
In kng A-sat-hek khì Pek-lī-hêng, kā i bâi-chòng tī in lāu-pē ê bōng. Iok-ap kap tè i ê lâng kui-mî hêng-kun, kàu Hi-pek-lûn ê sî, thiⁿ tú-á kng.
Sò-lô ê ke kap Tāi-pi̍t ê ke kau-chiàn chin kú; Tāi-pi̍t ná kiông-sēng, Sò-lô ê ke ná soe-bî.
Tāi-pi̍t tī Hi-pek-lûn siⁿ la̍k ê kiáⁿ: tōa-kiáⁿ Àm-lūn, sī Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng A-hi-loán siⁿ--ê;
tē-jī ê Ki-lī-ap, sī Ka-bi̍t -lâng Ná-pà ê ûi-song Ài-pí-kai siⁿ--ê; tē-saⁿ ê Ap-sa-liông, sī Ki-su̍t -ông Ta̍t-mái ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Má-ka siⁿ--ê;
tē-sì ê A-to-nî-ngá, sī Hap-ki̍p siⁿ--ê; tē-gō͘ ê Sī-hoat-thê-ngá, sī A-pí-tha siⁿ--ê;
tē-la̍k ê Í-te̍k-liām, sī Tāi-pi̍t ê bó͘ Í-kek-la siⁿ--ê. Chiah-ê sī Tāi-pi̍t tī Hi-pek-lûn só͘ siⁿ ê kiáⁿ.
Sò-lô ê ke kap Tāi-pi̍t ê ke kè-sio̍k teh kau-chiàn, Ap-nî-ní tī Sò-lô ê ke chiáng-ak si̍t-koân.
Sò-lô ū chi̍t ê hui, miâ kiò Lī-su-pa, sī Ài-a ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ. I-si Pho-siat tùi Ap-nî-ní kóng, “Lí ná kap góa lāu-pē ê hui chòe-hé khùn?”

Ap-nî-ní in-ūi I-si Pho-siat ê ōe chiū chin siū-khì, kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ góa chòe Iû-tāi -ke ê káu-á-thâu sī--bô? Góa tiong-sêng tùi-thāi lín lāu-pē Sò-lô ê ke, kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, i ê pêng-iú, bô chiong lí kau tī Tāi-pi̍t ê chhiú, lí kin-á-ji̍t kèng-jiân in-ūi chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng chek-pī góa.

Góa nā bô chiàu Siōng Chú só͘ li̍p-sè tùi Tāi-pi̍t ê èng-ún lâi chòe, hòe-tû Sò-lô -ke ê ông-ūi, kiàn-li̍p Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-koân, hō͘ i tī-lí Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi, tùi Tān kàu Pia̍t-sī-pa, goān Siōng-tè ka-pē chek-hoa̍t góa Ap-nî-ní.”
I-si Pho-siat in-ūi kiaⁿ Ap-nî-ní, liân chi̍t kù ōe to m̄-káⁿ ìn.

Ap-nî-ní chhe sù-chiá tāi-piáu i khì kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, kóng, “Chit-ê kok sím-mi̍h-lâng teh thóng-tī?” Koh kóng, “Lí kap góa li̍p-iok, góa beh pang-chān lí, hō͘ choân Í-sek-lia̍t lóng kui-sūn lí.”

Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Hó, góa kap lí li̍p-iok. M̄-kú góa ū chi̍t ê iau-kiû, lí lâi kìⁿ góa ê sî, tio̍h chiong Sò-lô ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-kah chhōa--lâi; nā bô, it-tēng bōe-tàng kìⁿ góa ê bīn.”

Tāi-pi̍t chiū chhe sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ I-si Pho-siat, kóng, “Tio̍h chiong góa ê bó͘ Bí-kah hêng góa, i sī góa ēng chi̍t-pah ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê pau-phê chòe phèng-kim chhōa--lâi-ê.”
I-si Pho-siat chiū phài lâng tùi Bí-kah ê tiōng-hu, La-ek ê kiáⁿ Phà-thiat hia chhōa Bí-kah lâi.
I ê tiōng-hu tè tī i ê āu-bīn, ná kiâⁿ ná háu, kàu Pa-hō͘-lîm. Ap-nî-ní tùi Phà-thiat kóng, “Tò--khì lah.” I chiū tò--khì.
Ap-nî-ní kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló chham-siông, kóng, “Lín chá chiū ài Tāi-pi̍t choh-ông kā lín tī-lí,

taⁿ tio̍h chhái-chhú hêng-tōng. In-ūi Siōng Chú ū èng-ún kóng, ‘Góa beh ēng góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê chhiú, kiù góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t thoat-lī Hui-lī-sū -lâng kap só͘-ū tùi-te̍k ê chhiú.’”

Ap-nî-ní mā chiong chiah-ê ōe kóng hō͘ Piān-ngá-bín -lâng thiaⁿ. Āu-lâi i khì Hi-pek-lûn, chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Piān-ngá-bín choân-ke kiōng-tông ê koat-tēng, kóng hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t thiaⁿ.
Ap-nî-ní chhōa jī-cha̍p ê lâng lâi Hi-pek-lûn kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t. Tāi-pi̍t siat iàn-se̍k hoan-gêng in.

Ap-nî-ní kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa beh khì chio-chi̍p choân Í-sek-lia̍t lâi kìⁿ góa ê chú góa ê ông, hō͘ in kap lí li̍p-iok, lí chiū ōe-tàng choh-ông, chiàu lí ê sim-goān tī-lí choân-kok.” Tāi-pi̍t chiū sàng Ap-nî-ní, hō͘ i pêng-an lī-khui.
Hit-sî, Tāi-pi̍t ê peng tè Iok-ap chhut-chiàn tò--lâi, tòa chin chōe chiàn-lī-phín. Ap-nî-ní í-keng bô tī Hi-pek-lûn Tāi-pi̍t hia, in-ūi Tāi-pi̍t ū sàng i pêng-an lī-khui.
Iok-ap kap tè i ê choân-kun í-keng kàu, ū lâng kā Iok-ap kóng, “ Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ Ap-nî-ní ū lâi kìⁿ ông, ông mā sàng i pêng-an lī-khui.”
Iok-ap khì kìⁿ ông kóng, “Lí ná án-ni chòe? Ap-nî-ní lâi kìⁿ lí, lí ná pàng i khì, hō͘ i lī-khui?
Lí chai Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ Ap-nî-ní lâi sī beh phiàn lí, ài chai lí ê tōng-chēng, kap lí it-chhè só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì.”
Iok-ap tùi Tāi-pi̍t hia chhut--lâi, chiū phài lâng khì jip Ap-nî-ní. In chiū tùi Se-la ê chíⁿ kā i tòa--lâi; m̄-kú Tāi-pi̍t m̄ chai.

Ap-nî-ní tńg-lâi kàu Hi-pek-lûn ê sî, Iok-ap chhōa i kàu siâⁿ-mn̂g lāi ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ piⁿ, ké beh su-hā kap i kóng-ōe, chiū tùi i ê pak-tó͘ tu̍h--lo̍h-khì, i chiū sí. Che sī in-ūi i ū thâi-sí Iok-ap ê sió-tī A-sat-hek.
Āu-lâi Tāi-pi̍t thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū kóng, “Lâu Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ Ap-nî-ní ê huih chit-ê chōe, kap góa í-ki̍p góa ê kok bô koan-hē, goán tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng sī bû-ko͘--ê.

Goān hit-ê chōe Iok-ap kap in lāu-pē choân-ke ka-kī taⁿ; koh goān Iok-ap ê ke put-toān ū lâng tì-tio̍h hā-siau á-sī bâ-hong, ū lâng bô gia̍h koáiⁿ-á bōe-tàng kiâⁿ-lō͘, ū lâng hō͘ to thâi-sí, á-sī bô thang chia̍h.”
Iok-ap kap i ê sió-tī A-pí-su thâi-sí Ap-nî-ní, sī in-ūi Ap-nî-ní tī Ki-piàn kap in kau-chiàn ê sî, thâi-sí in ê hiaⁿ-tī A-sat-hek.
Tāi-pi̍t bēng-lēng Iok-ap kap tè i ê lâng kóng, “Lín tio̍h thiah-li̍h saⁿ, chhēng môa-saⁿ, ūi-tio̍h Ap-nî-ní thî-khàu.” Tāi-pi̍t -ông mā tè tī koaⁿ-chhâ āu-bīn.
In kā Ap-nî-ní bâi-chòng tī Hi-pek-lûn. Ông óa Ap-nî-ní ê bōng thî-khàu, chèng-lâng mā thî-khàu.
Ông ūi-tio̍h Ap-nî-ní chhiùⁿ ai-ko, kóng, “ Ap-nî-ní ná ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ gōng-lâng án-ni sí?
Lí ê chhiú bô siū khún-pa̍k, lí ê kha bô khàu só-liān; lí kèng-jiân sí tī pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhiú-thâu.” Chèng-lâng koh ūi-tio̍h Ap-nî-ní ai-khàu.

Ji̍t-thâu iáu-bē lo̍h-soaⁿ í-chêng, chèng-lâng lâi khǹg Tāi-pi̍t chia̍h-pn̄g, m̄-kú Tāi-pi̍t chiù-chōa kóng, “Góa nā tī ji̍t lo̍h í-chêng chia̍h-pn̄g á-sī chia̍h pa̍t-hāng mi̍h-kiāⁿ, goān Siōng-tè ka-pē chek-hoa̍t góa.”
Chèng-lâng chai-iáⁿ chit-ê tāi-chì, lóng kám-kak chin hó; ông só͘ chòe--ê, chèng-lâng lóng khòaⁿ-chòe hó.
Hit-ji̍t, kun-tè Tāi-pi̍t ê lâng kap só͘-ū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiah chai, thâi-sí Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ Ap-nî-ní m̄-sī chhut tī ông ê ì-sù.
Ông tùi i ê pō͘-hā kóng, “Lín kiám m̄ chai kin-á-ji̍t tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong, sí chi̍t ê úi-tāi ê chiòng-léng?

Góa sui-jiân siū boah-iû soán-li̍p choh-ông, m̄-kú kin-á-ji̍t iáu bô-kàu la̍t; Sé-lō͘-ngá hiah-ê kiáⁿ pí góa khah kiông. Goān Siōng Chú chiàu pháiⁿ-lâng só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ pò-èng in.”
Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ I-si Pho-siat thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ap-nî-ní sí tī Hi-pek-lûn, chiū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ sit-táⁿ. Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng mā kiaⁿ kah m̄-chai beh án-chóaⁿ.
I-si Pho-siat ū nn̄g ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, Pa-ná kap Lī-kah, sī Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k Pí-lio̍k -lâng Lîm-bûn ê kiáⁿ.
Pí-lio̍k -lâng chá-chêng cháu kàu Ki-tha-im, khiā-khí tī hia, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.

Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan ū chi̍t ê kiáⁿ nn̄g kha lóng pái, kiò-chòe Bí-hui-pho-siat. Sò-lô kap Iok-ná-tan sí ê siau-sit tùi Iâ-su-lia̍t thoân--lâi ê sî, i tú-á gō͘ hè; i ê lin-bú kā i phō-teh cháu; in-ūi cháu chin kín, gín-á poa̍h--lo̍h-khì, kha chiah pái.
Pí-lio̍k -lâng Lîm-bûn ê kiáⁿ Lī-kah kap Pa-ná chhut--khì, chha-put-to ji̍t tiong-tàu ê sî lâi I-si Pho-siat ê chhù. I tú-á teh khùn tiong-tàu.
In ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi ké-iáⁿ beh put be̍h-á, chiū tùi I-si Pho-siat ê pak-tó͘ tu̍h--lo̍h-khì; Lī-kah kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī Pa-ná chiū tô-cháu.

In ji̍p pâng-lāi ê sî, I-si Pho-siat tú-á tī pâng-keng tó tī bîn-chhn̂g teh khùn; in chiū kā i thâi-sí, koah i ê thâu-khak, kā thâu kōaⁿ--teh, ǹg A-la-pa ê hong-hiòng thàu-mî tô-cháu.

In tòa I-si Pho-siat ê thâu-khak khì Hi-pek-lûn Tāi-pi̍t hia, tùi ông kóng, “Chhiáⁿ khòaⁿ! Che sī Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ I-si Pho-siat ê thâu; lí ê tùi-te̍k Sò-lô bat siàu-siūⁿ lí ê sìⁿ-miā. Siōng Chú kin-á-ji̍t í-keng ū ūi-tio̍h góa ê chú góa ê ông tùi Sò-lô kap i ê hō͘-tāi pò-siû.”

Tāi-pi̍t ìn Pí-lio̍k -lâng Lîm-bûn ê kiáⁿ Lī-kah kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī Pa-ná, kóng, “Siōng Chú kiù-sio̍k góa ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī só͘-ū ê khó͘-lān, góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa;
í-chêng ū lâng lâi Sé-kek-la pò góa kóng, ‘ Sò-lô í-keng sí.’ I ka-kī lia̍h-chòe sī pò hó siau-sit, m̄-kú góa bô kā i chióng-lē, tian-tò kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, thâi-sí.

Hô-hòng lín chiah-ê pháiⁿ-lâng! Lín thàn bû-ko͘ ê lâng teh khùn ê sî, ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi kā i thâi-sí, góa kiám bô beh tùi lín ê chhiú thó lín lâu i ê huih ê chōe, tùi tōe-chiūⁿ kā lín tû-bia̍t?”

Tāi-pi̍t bēng-lēng pō͘-hā kā in thâi-sí, chām-tn̄g in ê kha-chhiú, kā in ê si-thé tiàu tī Hi-pek-lûn ê chúi-tî piⁿ, jiân-āu chiong I-si Pho-siat ê thâu-khak bâi-chòng tī Hi-pek-lûn Ap-nî-ní ê bōng.
Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k lâi Hi-pek-lûn kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, kóng, “Goán sī lí ê kut-jio̍k.

Khah-chá Sò-lô chòe goán ê ông ê sî, chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t khì kau-chiàn--ê sī lí; Siōng Chú mā bat kā lí kóng, ‘Lí ōe bo̍k-ióng góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t, mā ōe chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê thóng-tī-chiá.’”

Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló lóng lâi Hi-pek-lûn kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t -ông, ông chiū tī Hi-pek-lûn, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kap in li̍p-iok. In chiū ēng iû boah Tāi-pi̍t, siat-li̍p i chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông.
Tāi-pi̍t chē-ūi ê sî saⁿ-cha̍p hè, choh-ông sì-cha̍p nî kú.
I tī Hi-pek-lûn chòe Iû-tāi -ông chhit nî la̍k kò-ge̍h; tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe choân Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi ê ông saⁿ-cha̍p-saⁿ nî.

Ông kap tè i ê lâng khì kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, beh kong-kek tòa tī hia ê Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng. Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí bô khó-lêng kong--ji̍p-lâi! Goán liân sit-bêng--ê, kha-pái--ê to ōe-tàng kā lí phah-pāi.” In àn-sǹg Tāi-pi̍t it-tēng bōe-tàng kong--ji̍p-lâi.
M̄-kú Tāi-pi̍t ū kong-chhú Sek-an ê pó-lúi, chiū-sī hiān-chāi ê Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ.

Hit-ji̍t, Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lâng nā beh phah Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, tio̍h tùi ín-chúi ê pōng-khang chiūⁿ--khì, khì phah Tāi-pi̍t só͘ oàn-hūn hiah-ê kha-pái--ê, sit-bêng--ê.” Só͘-í ū sio̍k-gú kóng, “Sit-bêng--ê, kha-pái--ê bōe-ēng-tit ji̍p-khì Siōng-tè ê tiān.”
Tāi-pi̍t tòa tī pó-lúi, kā hit-ê só͘-chāi hō-chòe Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ. Tāi-pi̍t tùi Bí-lô ǹg lāi-bīn sì-ûi khí chhiûⁿ.
Tāi-pi̍t jú lâi jú kiông-sēng, in-ūi Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè kap i tông-chāi.
Thài-ní -ông Hi-lân phài sù-chiá tòa pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ, kap choh-ba̍k sai-hū, phah-chio̍h sai-hū khì Tāi-pi̍t hia, kā Tāi-pi̍t khí kiong-tiān.
Tāi-pi̍t chiū chai Siōng Chú kian-li̍p i chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, koh ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t hō͘ i ê kok kiông-sēng.
Tāi-pi̍t lī-khui Hi-pek-lûn liáu-āu, chhōa Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lú-chú chòe pîn-hui, koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ kap cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siⁿ ê kiáⁿ sī Sa-bō͘-a, Sok-pā, Ná-tan, Só͘-lô-bûn,
Ek-hat, Í-lī-su-a, Nî-húi, Ngá-hui-a,
Í-lī-sa-má, Í-lī-ngá-tāi, kap Í-lī-hoat-lia̍t.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t siū boah-iû soán-li̍p chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, chiū choân-le̍k chiūⁿ-lâi tui-chhē Tāi-pi̍t. Tāi-pi̍t thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū lo̍h-khì pó-lúi.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng lâi, piàn-móa Lī-hoa̍t-im Soaⁿ-kok.

Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa kiám thang chìn-kong Hui-lī-sū -lâng? Lí kiám beh chiong in kau tī góa ê chhiú?” Siōng Chú kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí khì, góa it-tēng ōe chiong Hui-lī-sū -lâng kau tī lí ê chhiú.”

Tāi-pi̍t lâi kàu Pa-le̍k Pí-la-sim, tī hia kā Hui-lī-sū -lâng phah-pāi, kóng, “Siōng Chú tī góa ê bīn-chêng kā góa ê tùi-te̍k chhiong-sòaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi kā thê-hōaⁿ chhiong-phòa.” In-ūi án-ni, hit-ê só͘-chāi chiū kiò-chòe Pa-le̍k Pí-la-sim.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng tô-cháu ê sî kā in ê ngó͘-siōng tàn tī hia; Tāi-pi̍t kap tè i ê lâng kā hiah-ê ngó͘-siōng khioh--khì.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng koh lâi, piàn-móa Lī-hoa̍t-im Soaⁿ-kok.
Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g Siōng Chú. Siōng Chú kóng, “M̄-thang chiàⁿ-bīn chìn-kong, tio̍h se̍h-khì in ê āu-bīn, tī sng-châi-chhiū-nâ ê thâu-chêng kā in kong-kek.
Lí thiaⁿ-tio̍h chhiū-bé ū hêng-kun ê siaⁿ, chiū tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín chìn-kong, in-ūi hit-sî Siōng Chú í-keng tī lí ê thâu-chêng kong-kek Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê kun-tūi.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng khì chòe, tùi Ka-pa kong-kek Hui-lī-sū -lâng, ti̍t-kàu Ki-sek.
Tāi-pi̍t koh chū-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan te̍k-soán ê saⁿ-bān lâng.

Tāi-pi̍t chhōa chiah-ê lâng chhut-hoat, khì Iû-tāi ê Pa-la, beh tùi hia chiong Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi chiap--lâi; chit-ê kūi sī hōng chē tī nn̄g ê thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek tiong-kan ê Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê miâ chheng-ho͘--ê.
In chiong Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi hē tī sin ê chhia, tùi soaⁿ-téng A-pí-ná-ta̍t ê chhù chài--chhut-lâi; A-pí-ná-ta̍t nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, O͘-sat kap A-hi-iok, kóaⁿ hit-tâi sin-chhia.
In chiong chhia kap Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi tùi soaⁿ-téng A-pí-ná-ta̍t ê chhù chài--chhut-lâi. A-hi-iok kiâⁿ tī kūi ê thâu-chêng.

Tāi-pi̍t kap Í-sek-lia̍t choân-ke, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng ēng siông-chhiū-chhâ só͘ chō ta̍k-khoán ê ga̍k-khì, kap khîm, sek, lin-long-kó͘, tōa-kó͘, poa̍h, lâi chàu-ga̍k khèng-chiok.
In kàu Ná-khong ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ, gû tio̍h-tak, O͘-sat chhun-chhiú hû Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi.
Siōng Chú tùi O͘-sat hoat tōa siū-khì; in-ūi i ê sit-chhò, Siōng Chú kā i phah, i chiū sí tī Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi piⁿ.
Tāi-pi̍t in-ūi Siōng Chú phah O͘-sat, chin bô hoaⁿ-hí, chiū chiong hit-ê só͘-chāi hō-chòe Pí-lia̍t-su O͘-sat, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Hit-ji̍t, Tāi-pi̍t kiaⁿ Siōng Chú, chiū kóng, “Góa ná thang chiong Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi ūn-lâi góa ê só͘-chāi?”
Tùi án-ni, Tāi-pi̍t m̄-khéng hō͘ Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi chhian-ji̍p Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ, kàu ka-kī ê só͘-chāi, chiū kā i sóa-khì Ka-te̍k -lâng Gô-pia̍t Í-tong ê chhù.
Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi thêng tī Ka-te̍k -lâng Gô-pia̍t Í-tong ê chhù saⁿ ge̍h-ji̍t kú, Siōng Chú sù-hok Gô-pia̍t Í-tong kap i ê choân-ke.

Ū lâng kā Tāi-pi̍t -ông pò-kò, “Siōng Chú in-ūi iok-kūi ê iân-kò͘, sù-hok Gô-pia̍t Í-tong kap in choân-ke ê lâng.” Tāi-pi̍t chiū hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí chiong Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi, tùi Gô-pia̍t Í-tong ê chhù chiap-lâi Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ.
Kng Siōng Chú iok-kūi ê lâng kiâⁿ la̍k pō͘, Tāi-pi̍t chiū hiàn chi̍t chiah gû kap chi̍t chiah pûi ê cheng-siⁿ chòe chè-sū.
Tāi-pi̍t chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê í-hut-tek tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng chīn-la̍t thiàu-bú.
Án-ni, Tāi-pi̍t kap Í-sek-lia̍t choân-ke chhut hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ, pûn sàu-kak, kng Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi chiūⁿ-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi ji̍p Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ ê sî, Sò-lô ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-kah tùi thang-á khòaⁿ--chhut-khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t -ông tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ia̍h-thiàu-ia̍h-tiô, chiū khòaⁿ-khin i.
In kng Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi ji̍p--khì, hē tī Tāi-pi̍t ūi-tio̍h iok-kūi tah ê pò͘-pîⁿ lāi-bīn; Tāi-pi̍t tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè.
Tāi-pi̍t hiàn chiah-ê chè liáu-āu, chiū hōng Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê miâ kā jîn-bîn chiok-hok.
I koh pun mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng, bô-lūn lâm-lú, ta̍k-ê lâng chi̍t tè piáⁿ, chi̍t tè bah, chi̍t lia̍p phû-tô-koaⁿ-oân. Chèng-lâng chiū lóng tò-khì in tau.

Tāi-pi̍t tò-khì beh kā i ê ka-sio̍k chiok-hok, Sò-lô ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-kah chhut-lâi chiap i, kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kin-á-ji̍t chin ū thé-biān! Kin-á-ji̍t tī jîn-sîn ê lú-pī ba̍k-chiu chêng bô chhēng-saⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t ê siáu-lâng lō͘-thé m̄-chai kiàn-siàu.”

Tāi-pi̍t kā Bí-kah kóng, “Góa sī tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng án-ni chòe. I ū kéng góa, bô kéng lí ê lāu-pē á-sī i ke-lāi ê lâng, soán-li̍p góa chòe Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê thóng-tī-chiá. Só͘-í góa ōe tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng kè-sio̍k thiàu-bú.
Góa beh pí kin-á-ji̍t án-ni koh-khah chho͘-sio̍k. Sui-jiân lí khòaⁿ góa chòe pi-chiān, m̄-kú lí só͘ kóng hiah-ê lú-pī ōe chun-tiōng góa.”
Tùi án-ni, Sò-lô ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-kah kàu sí lóng bô siⁿ-kiáⁿ.
Ông tòa tī ông-kiong, Siōng Chú hō͘ i bô siū sì-ûi tùi-te̍k ê kiáu-jiáu, hióng-siū thài-pêng.
Ông tùi sian-ti Ná-tan kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, góa tòa tī pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ ê kiong-tiān, m̄-kú Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi tiàm tī pò͘-pîⁿ.”
Ná-tan tùi ông kóng, “Lí siūⁿ-beh án-chóaⁿ, chiū thang khì chòe, in-ūi Siōng Chú kap lí tông-chāi.”
Hit-mî Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Ná-tan, kóng,
“Lí khì kā góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lí chin-chiàⁿ beh khí sèng-tiān hō͘ góa tòa sī--bô?
Tùi góa chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p kàu hiān-chāi, góa m̄-bat tòa tī tiān--ni̍h, lóng it-ti̍t tòa tī pò͘-pîⁿ á-sī hōe-bō͘, kap in chòe-hé kiâⁿ-sóa.

Góa kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tâng-kiâⁿ ê sî, kiám bat tùi tó chi̍t ê Í-sek-lia̍t chi-cho̍k ê léng-siù, chiū sī bo̍k-ióng góa ê chú-bîn--ê kóng: Lín ná bô kā góa khí pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ ê tiān?’

“Taⁿ lí tio̍h kā góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng: Góa tùi bo̍k-tiûⁿ kéng-tiàu lí, hō͘ lí bô koh chhī iûⁿ, sī beh hō͘ lí chòe góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê thóng-tī-chiá.

Lí bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, góa ōe kap lí tông-chāi, siau-bia̍t lí bīn-chêng só͘-ū ê tùi-te̍k. Góa it-tēng hō͘ lí ū tōa miâ-siaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ sè-kan ê úi-jîn hiah-ni̍h chhut-miâ.

Góa beh ūi-tio̍h góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t chún-pī chi̍t ê só͘-chāi, kā in an-tùn, hō͘ in khiā-khí tī ka-kī ê só͘-chāi, bô koh siū kiáu-jiáu, bô koh chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-chêng góa bēng-lēng sū-su koán-lí góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê sî-tāi, siū hiong-ok ê lâng khi-ap. Góa beh hō͘ lí thoat-lī it-chhè ê tùi-te̍k, tit-tio̍h thài-pêng. Góa koh soan-pò͘, góa Siōng Chú beh kiàn-li̍p lí ê ông-tiâu.
Kàu lí ê hè-siū móa, tńg-khì lí ê chó͘-sian hia ê sî, góa beh soán-li̍p lí ê hō͘-tāi, lí ê chhin-siⁿ-kiáⁿ, lâi sòa-chiap lí, koh beh hō͘ i ê kok ún-kò͘.
I beh ūi-tio̍h góa ê miâ khí sèng-tiān; góa beh kian-kò͘ i ê ông-ūi ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
Góa beh chòe i ê pē, i beh chòe góa ê kiáⁿ. I nā hoān-chōe, góa beh ēng lâng ê koáiⁿ, sè-kan-lâng ê piⁿ, chek-tok i.
M̄-kú góa ê chû-ài bōe lī-khui i, bōe chhin-chhiūⁿ góa hō͘ chû-ài lī-khui góa só͘ khì-sak ê Sò-lô.
Lí ê ke kap lí ê kok, ōe éng-oán kian-li̍p tī góa ê bīn-chêng; lí ê ông-ūi ōe kian-kò͘ kàu éng-oán.’”
Ná-tan chiū chiàu Siōng-tè khé-sī ê ōe lóng kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng.

Tāi-pi̍t -ông chiū ji̍p-khì hōe-bō͘, chē tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, góa sī siáⁿ-lâng, góa ê ke sǹg sím-mi̍h, lí kèng-jiân chhōa góa kàu chit-ê tōe-ūi?
M̄-nā án-ni, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, lí koh koàn-kò͘ lí lô͘-po̍k ê ke ê chiong-lâi; Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, che kiám sī it-poaⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng tú--tio̍h ê tāi-chì?
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, lí ê lô͘-po̍k lí siōng chheng-chhó, góa iáu ū sím-mi̍h ōe thang kóng?
Lí ū chòe chiah-ê tōa-sū, koh kàu-tō lí ê lô͘-po̍k; che lóng sī in-ūi lí ê èng-ún, chiàu lí ê chí-ì.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, lí chin úi-tāi! Chiàu goán só͘ thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kap lí pí, lí í-gōa bô Siōng-tè.

Sè-kan kiám ū chi̍t ê kok chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t? Siōng-tè lí ū kiù-sio̍k in, hō͘ in chiâⁿ-chòe lí ê chú-bîn, hō͘ lí ka-kī tit-tio̍h êng-iāu; koh ūi-tio̍h lí tùi Ai-ki̍p kái-kiù--chhut-lâi ê chú-bîn chòe tōa koh thang-kiaⁿ ê sū, chiong lia̍t-pang kap hiah-ê sîn-bêng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.
Lí ū kiàn-li̍p Í-sek-lia̍t éng-oán chòe lí ka-kī ê chú-bîn; Siōng Chú ah, lí koh chòe in ê Siōng-tè.
“Chú Siōng-tè, lí tùi lí ê lô͘-po̍k kap i ê ke ê èng-ún, goān lí chiàu lí só͘ kóng--ê si̍t-hiān, hō͘ i éng-oán ún-kò͘.
