Goān lâng éng-oán chun-chông lí ê miâ kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe sī tī-lí Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè!’ Koh lí ê lô͘-po̍k Tāi-pi̍t ê ke beh tī lí ê bīn-chêng kian-li̍p.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ah, in-ūi lí ū khé-sī lí ê lô͘-po̍k, kóng ‘Góa beh kiàn-li̍p lí ê ông-tiâu’, só͘-í lí ê lô͘-po̍k hó-táⁿ ēng chit-ê kî-tó tùi lí khún-kiû.
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, chí-ū lí sī Siōng-tè! Lí ê ōe chin-si̍t khó-khò; lí ēng chit-ê hok-khì èng-ún lí ê lô͘-po̍k.

Taⁿ, kiû lí hoaⁿ-hí sù-hok lí lô͘-po̍k ê ke, hō͘ i tī lí ê bīn-chêng éng-oán ún-kò͘. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, in-ūi lí ū èng-ún, goān lí lô͘-po̍k ê ke tùi lí tit-tio̍h hok-khì, kàu éng-oán.”
Āu-lâi, Tāi-pi̍t kong-kek Hui-lī-sū -lâng, hō͘ in hâng-ho̍k; koh tùi Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú the̍h-tio̍h kiaⁿ-siâⁿ ê khòng-chè-koân.

Tāi-pi̍t koh phah-pāi Mô͘-ap -lâng, kiò in tó tī thô͘-kha, ēng soh niû, niû nn̄g soh tn̂g--ê hō͘ i sí, niû chi̍t soh--ê hō͘ i oa̍h; Mô͘-ap -lâng chiū kui-sūn Tāi-pi̍t, koh chìn-kòng.
Lī-ha̍p ê kiáⁿ Só-pa -ông Hap-tāi-tí-siā khì Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô, beh hôe-ho̍k i ê thóng-tī-koân ê sî, Tāi-pi̍t kong-kek i,
lia̍h i ê bé-peng chi̍t-chheng chhit-pah, pō͘-peng nn̄g-bān, koh chām-tn̄g chiàn-chhia ê bé ê kha-kun; chí-ū lâu kàu-gia̍h thang thoa chi̍t-pah tâi chiàn-chhia ê bé.
Tāi-má-sū-kek ê Sū-lī-a -lâng lâi pang-chān Só-pa -ông Hap-tāi-tí-siā, Tāi-pi̍t chiū thâi-sí Sū-lī-a -lâng nn̄g-bān nn̄g-chheng.

Tùi án-ni, Tāi-pi̍t tī Tāi-má-sū-kek ê Sū-lī-a siat-li̍p kun-iâⁿ. Sū-lī-a -lâng chiū kui-sūn Tāi-pi̍t, koh chìn-kòng. Tāi-pi̍t bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, Siōng Chú lóng hō͘ i tek-sèng.
Tāi-pi̍t chiong Hap-tāi-tí-siā ê pō͘-hā só͘ ēng kim ê tún-pâi lóng tòa-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Tāi-pi̍t -ông koh tùi Hap-tāi-tí-siā ê siâⁿ Pí-tha kap Pí-lô-tha, the̍h chin chōe tâng.
Hap-má -ông Tô-í thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t phah-iâⁿ Hap-tāi-tí-siā ê choân-kun,

chiū chhe i ê kiáⁿ Iok-lân tòa kim-khì, gûn-khì, tâng-khì khì kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t -ông, kā i chhéng-an, chiok-hō i phah-iâⁿ Hap-tāi-tí-siā, in-ūi Hap-tāi-tí-siā kap Tô-í siông-siông kau-chiàn.

Tāi-pi̍t -ông chiū chiong chiah-ê mi̍h, kap í-chêng i thâi-iâⁿ lia̍t-kok só͘ tit--tio̍h ê kim-gûn, chiū-sī tùi Í-tong, Mô͘-ap, A-bûn -lâng, Hui-lī-sū -lâng, A-má-le̍k -lâng, í-ki̍p tùi Lī-ha̍p ê kiáⁿ Só-pa -ông Hap-tāi-tí-siā tit--tio̍h ê chiàn-lī-phín, lóng sèng-hòa hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Tāi-pi̍t tī Iâm ê Soaⁿ-kok phah-sí Í-tong -lâng chi̍t-bān poeh-chheng; tò--lâi ê sî, chiū tit-tio̍h tōa miâ-siaⁿ.
Tāi-pi̍t tī Í-tong choân-tōe siat kun-iâⁿ; Í-tong -lâng lóng kui-sūn i. Tāi-pi̍t bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, Siōng Chú lóng hō͘ i sèng-lī.
Tāi-pi̍t chòe choân Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông, ēng kong-pêng chèng-gī tī-lí i só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn.
Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap chòe goân-sòe, A-hi-lu̍t ê kiáⁿ Iok-sa-hoat chòe sú-koaⁿ.
A-hi-tu̍t ê kiáⁿ Sat-tok kap A-pí-a-tha ê kiáⁿ A-hi-bí-le̍k chòe chè-si; Se-lâi-ngá chòe su-kì;
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá choh-thâu chí-hui Ki-lī-thê -lâng kap Pí-lī-thê -lâng. Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ lóng chòe chè-si.
Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g kóng, “ Sò-lô ê ke iáu ū sím-mi̍h-lâng lâu--teh? Góa beh in-ūi Iok-ná-tan ê iân-kò͘ hó khoán-thāi i.”
Sò-lô ê ke ū chi̍t ê po̍k-jîn kiò-chòe Sé-pa, lâng kiò i khì Tāi-pi̍t hia; ông chiū mn̄g i, “Lí sī Sé-pa sī--bô?” I ìn kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn chiū-sī.”
Ông kóng, “ Sò-lô ê ke iáu chhun kúi ê lâng? Góa thang chiong Siōng-tè ê un si hō͘ i.” Sé-pa tùi ông kóng, “ Iok-ná-tan iáu ū chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, i ê siang-kha lóng pái.”
Ông mn̄g i, “I tī tó-ūi?” Sé-pa ìn ông kóng, “I tī Lô Tí-pa, tòa tī A-bí-lī ê kiáⁿ Má-kiat in tau.”
Tāi-pi̍t -ông chiū phài lâng khì Má-kiat in tau kā chhōa--lâi.
Sò-lô ê sun, Iok-ná-tan ê kiáⁿ Bí-hui-pho-siat lâi kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, phak lo̍h-khì pài i. Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “ Bí-hui-pho-siat.” I ìn kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn tī chia.”

Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ. Góa it-tēng beh in-ūi lí ê lāu-pē Iok-ná-tan ê iân-kò͘ hó khoán-thāi lí, chiong lí ê a-kong Sò-lô ê chhân-hn̂g lóng hêng lí, mā beh hō͘ lí siông-siông kap góa chòe-hé chia̍h.”
Bí-hui-pho-siat koh phak-teh pài i, kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn sǹg sím-mi̍h? Góa put-kò chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t chiah sí-káu, lí kèng-jiân án-ni chiàu-kò͘ góa!”
Ông kiò Sò-lô ê po̍k-jîn Sé-pa lâi, kā i kóng, “Góa í-keng chiong Sò-lô kap i ka-cho̍k só͘-ū ê châi-sán lóng hō͘ lí ê chú-lâng ê sun.

Lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ, lí ê po̍k-jîn tio̍h kā i chèng-choh, tòa chhân-hn̂g só͘ chhut-sán--ê hō͘ lí ê chú-lâng ê sun ū mi̍h thang chia̍h; lí chú-lâng ê sun Bí-hui-pho-siat ōe siông-siông kap góa chòe-hé chia̍h.” Sé-pa ū cha̍p-gō͘ ê kiáⁿ, jī-cha̍p ê po̍k-jîn.

Sé-pa tùi ông kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông hoan-hù--ê, lí ê po̍k-jîn lóng ōe chiàu án-ni chòe.” Só͘-í, Bí-hui-pho-siat chiū kap ông chòe-hé chia̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ ông ê kiáⁿ kâng-khoán.
Bí-hui-pho-siat ū chi̍t ê sòe-hàn kiáⁿ, kiò-chòe Bí-ka. Sé-pa in tau só͘-ū ê lâng lóng chòe Bí-hui-pho-siat ê po̍k-jîn.
Bí-hui-pho-siat nn̄g kha lóng pái, tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, siông-siông kap ông chòe-hé chia̍h.
Āu-lâi, A-bûn -lâng ê ông Ná-hat sí, i ê kiáⁿ Hap-lūn sòa-chiap i choh-ông.

Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa beh hó khoán-thāi Hap-lūn, chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê lāu-pē Ná-hat hó khoán-thāi góa án-ni.” Tāi-pi̍t in-ūi Hap-lūn ê lāu-pē sí, chiū phài jîn-sîn khì ùi-būn. Tāi-pi̍t ê jîn-sîn kàu A-bûn -lâng kéng-lāi ê sî,

A-bûn -lâng ê léng-siù kā in ê chú-lâng Hap-lūn kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t phài lâng lâi ùi-būn lí, lí siūⁿ-kóng i chin-chiàⁿ chun-kèng lí ê lāu-pē o͘h? Tāi-pi̍t phài i ê pō͘-hā lâi kìⁿ lí, kiám m̄-sī beh siông-sè cheng-thàm chit-ê siâⁿ, khòaⁿ beh án-chóaⁿ kā lán cheng-ho̍k?”
Hap-lūn chiū lia̍h Tāi-pi̍t ê jîn-sîn, kā in ê chhùi-chhiu thì chi̍t-pòaⁿ, koh chián-tn̄g in ê saⁿ ē-pòaⁿ-chat, hō͘ in lō͘-chhut hā-thé, jiân-āu kóaⁿ in tò--khì.

Ū lâng tùi Tāi-pi̍t pò-kò, Tāi-pi̍t chiū phài lâng khì chiap in, in-ūi in kám-kak hui-siông kiàn-siàu. Ông kóng, “Lâu tiàm Iâ-lī-ko, thèng-hāu chhùi-chhiu hoat-tn̂g chiah tò--lâi.”

A-bûn -lâng chai in jiá Tāi-pi̍t siū-khì, chiū chhe lâng khì chhiàⁿ Pek Lī-ha̍p kap Só-pa ê Sū-lī-a -lâng, pō͘-peng nn̄g-bān, kap Má-ka -ông ê lâng chi̍t-chheng, Tô-pek -lâng chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng.
Tāi-pi̍t thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū phài Iok-ap chhōa só͘-ū ióng-béng ê kun-tūi chhut--khì.
A-bûn -lâng chhut-lâi tī siâⁿ-mn̂g ê thâu-chêng pâi-tīn; Só-pa kap Lī-ha̍p ê Sū-lī-a -lâng, Tô-pek -lâng, kap Má-ka -lâng lēng-gōa tī iá-gōa pâi-tīn.

Iok-ap khòaⁿ-kìⁿ i ê chêng-āu lóng ū tùi-te̍k pâi-tīn, chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t cheng-peng ê tiong-kan koh-chài kéng chi̍t-kóa ióng-sū chhut--lâi, pâi-tīn beh tí-te̍k Sū-lī-a -lâng.
Iok-ap chiong kî-tha ê peng-sū kau hō͘ i ê sió-tī A-pí-su, in chiū biān-tùi A-bûn -lâng pâi-tīn.
Iok-ap tùi A-pí-su kóng, “ Sū-lī-a -lâng nā pí góa khah kiông, lí tio̍h lâi pang-chān góa; A-bûn -lâng nā pí lí khah kiông, góa ōe khì pang-chān lí.
Tio̍h kian-kiông! Tio̍h ūi lán ê tông-pau kap lán Siōng-tè ê siâⁿ ióng-kám chhut-chiàn. Siōng Chú ōe chiàu I khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê khì chòe.”
Iok-ap chhōa i ê kun-tūi chìn-chêng kap Sū-lī-a -lâng kau-chiàn; Sū-lī-a -lâng chiàn-pāi, chiū tī Iok-ap ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu.
A-bûn -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sū-lī-a -lâng tô-cháu, mā tī A-pí-su ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu ji̍p-siâⁿ. Iok-ap chiū tùi A-bûn -lâng hia tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Sū-lī-a -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h ka-kī thâi-su Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiū tiông-chéng kun-tūi.

Só-pa -ông Hap-tāi-tí-siā phài lâng khì Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hit-pêng tiàu Sū-lī-a ê kun-tūi lâi; in chiū lâi kàu Hi-lân. Hap-tāi-tí-siā ê chiong-kun Sok-hoat chhōa kun-tūi lâi.
Ū lâng pò-kò Tāi-pi̍t, i chiū tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kun kè Iok-tàn-hô, chìn-kun kàu Hi-lân. Sū-lī-a -lâng pâi-tīn, kap Tāi-pi̍t kau-chiàn.
Sū-lī-a -lâng thâi-su Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; Tāi-pi̍t thâi-sí Sū-lī-a ê chiàn-chhia-peng chhit-pah lâng, bé-peng sì-bān, koh chiong in ê chiong-kun Sok-hoat thâi-sí tī hia.

Hap-tāi-tí-siā sio̍k-hā hiah-ê ông khòaⁿ-tio̍h in thâi-su Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiū kap Í-sek-lia̍t kóng-hô, kui-sūn in. Tùi án-ni, Sū-lī-a -lâng chiū m̄-káⁿ koh pang-chān A-bûn -lâng.

Keh-nî chhun-thiⁿ, lia̍t-ông chhut-chiàn ê sî, Tāi-pi̍t phài Iok-ap kap i ê pō͘-hā, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kun chhut--khì. In thâi-iâⁿ A-bûn -lâng, ûi-kong La-pa -siâⁿ. Tāi-pi̍t lâu tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t hông-hun ê sî, Tāi-pi̍t tùi bîn-chhn̂g khí--lâi, tī ông-kiong ê chhù-téng kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì; tùi chhù-téng khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng teh sóe-e̍k; hū-jîn-lâng siⁿ-chòe chin súi.
Tāi-pi̍t chiū chhe lâng khì thàm-thiaⁿ hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng. Ū lâng kóng, “I sī Í-liân ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, Hek -lâng O͘-lī-a ê bó͘ Poa̍t-sī-pa.”
Tāi-pi̍t chhe sù-chiá khì chhōa Poa̍t-sī-pa lâi i hia. Hit-sî, hū-jîn-lâng ge̍h-keng tú-tú chheng-khì, Tāi-pi̍t kap i chòe-hé khùn. Āu-lâi, i chiū tò-khì in chhù.
Hū-jîn-lâng hoâi-īn, chiū chhe lâng kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa ū-sin lah.”
Tāi-pi̍t chhe lâng khì kā Iok-ap kóng, “Lí phài Hek -lâng O͘-lī-a lâi góa chia.” Iok-ap chiū chhe O͘-lī-a khì kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t.
O͘-lī-a lâi, Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g i Iok-ap hó--bô, kun-peng hó--bô, kau-chiàn hó-sè--bô.
Tāi-pi̍t kā O͘-lī-a kóng, “Lí tńg-khì lín tau hioh-khùn.” O͘-lī-a chhut ông-kiong liáu-āu, ông chiū sàng chi̍t hūn lé-mi̍h hō͘ i.
M̄-kú O͘-lī-a kap i chú-lâng ê pō͘-hā chòe-hé khùn tī ông-kiong mn̂g-kháu, bô tò-khì in tau.
Ū lâng kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng O͘-lī-a bô tńg-khì in tau. Tāi-pi̍t chiū mn̄g O͘-lī-a, “Lí kiám m̄-sī tùi chin hn̄g tńg--lâi, sī-án-chóaⁿ m̄ tò-khì lín tau?”

O͘-lī-a tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Iok-kūi, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi choân-kun lóng tiàm tī pò͘-pîⁿ; góa ê chú Iok-ap kap ông ê pō͘-hā tī iá-gōa chat-iâⁿ; góa ná thang tò-khì chhù--ni̍h lim-chia̍h, kap góa ê bó͘ tâng-pâng? Góa kí lí ê sìⁿ-miā chiù-chōa, góa choa̍t-tùi bô beh chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì.”
Tāi-pi̍t kā O͘-lī-a kóng, “Lí kin-á-ji̍t iû-goân tòa chia, bîn-á-chài góa phài lí tńg--khì.” O͘-lī-a tī hit-ji̍t kap keh-ji̍t lâu tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Tāi-pi̍t chhiáⁿ O͘-lī-a lâi chòe-hé lim-chia̍h, hō͘ i lim kah chùi. Thiⁿ àm, O͘-lī-a chhut-khì i chú-lâng ê pō͘-hā hia, khùn tī i ka-kī ê thán-á, bô tò-khì in tau.
Keh-chá-khí, Tāi-pi̍t siá chi̍t tiuⁿ phoe hō͘ Iok-ap, thok O͘-lī-a tòa--khì.
Phoe-lāi siá kóng, “Tio̍h phài O͘-lī-a khì chiân-sòaⁿ siōng gûi-hiám ê só͘-chāi; jiân-āu lín lóng thiat-thè, hō͘ i chiàn-sí.”
Iok-ap ûi siâⁿ ê sî, i chai tùi-te̍k hông-ōe siōng-kiông ê só͘-chāi tī tó-ūi, chiū phài O͘-lī-a khì hia.
Siâⁿ-lāi ê hông-ōe-kun chhut-lâi kap Iok-ap kau-chiàn; Tāi-pi̍t ê pō͘-hā sí kúi-nā lâng, Hek -lâng O͘-lī-a mā chiàn-sí.
Iok-ap phài lâng khì kā Tāi-pi̍t pò-kò kau-chiàn ê sū.
I hoan-hù sù-chiá kóng, “Lí siông-sè pò-kò kau-chiàn ê sū liáu-āu,
ông nā siū-khì, kóng, ‘Lín chìn-kong ê sî, ná ōe hiah óa siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ? Kiám m̄ chai tùi-te̍k ōe tùi siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng siā-chìⁿ?

Í-chêng sím-mi̍h-lâng phah-sí Ki-tiân ê kiáⁿ A-pí-bí-le̍k? Kiám m̄-sī chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng tùi chhiûⁿ-téng hiat chio̍h-bō ê téng-tún kòng-tio̍h i ê thâu-khak, hō͘ i sí tī Thê-pī-su? Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ hiah óa siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ?’ Lí tio̍h kóng, ‘Lí ê po̍k-jîn Hek -lâng O͘-lī-a mā sí.’”
Sù-chiá khì, chiàu Iok-ap só͘ bēng-lēng--ê kā Tāi-pi̍t pò-kò.
Sù-chiá tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Tùi-te̍k pí goán khah kiông, chhut-lâi iá-gōa kong-kek goán, goán kā in phah kàu siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu.
Siā-chìⁿ ê lâng tùi chhiûⁿ-téng siā lí ê pō͘-hā; ông ê pō͘-hā sí kúi-nā lâng, lí ê pō͘-hā Hek -lâng O͘-lī-a mā tī hia chiàn-sí.”

Tāi-pi̍t kā hit-ê sù-chiá kóng, “Lí tio̍h án-ni kā Iok-ap kóng, ‘M̄-bián ūi-tio̍h chit-ê sū sim kan-khó͘, in-ūi chiàn-cheng lóng ū lâng ōe sí tī to-ē; lí tio̍h chīn-la̍t kong-siâⁿ, kā siâⁿ kong-phòa.’ Lí tio̍h án-ni kā Iok-ap kó͘-lē.”
O͘-lī-a ê bó͘ thiaⁿ-tio̍h i ê tiōng-hu í-keng sí, chiū ūi i thî-khàu.

Song-sū kiat-sok, Tāi-pi̍t chiū chhe lâng chhōa Poa̍t-sī-pa ji̍p-kiong. I chiū chòe Tāi-pi̍t ê bó͘, kā Tāi-pi̍t siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ. Chóng-sī Siōng Chú tùi Tāi-pi̍t chòe chit-ê tāi-chì chin bô hoaⁿ-hí.
Siōng Chú chhe Ná-tan khì kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t; Ná-tan kàu i hia, kā i kóng, “Tī bó͘ chi̍t ê siâⁿ ū nn̄g ê lâng, chi̍t ê hó-gia̍h, chi̍t ê sàn-chhiah.
Hó-gia̍h--ê ū gû iûⁿ chin chōe;

sàn-chhiah--ê sím-mi̍h to bô, chí-ū chi̍t chiah i bóe lâi chhī ê iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ; i kā chhī, hō͘ hit-chiah iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ kap i ê kiáⁿ-jî chòe-hé tióng-tōa, chòe-hé chia̍h, chòe-hé lim, koh chòe-hé khùn, kā khòaⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ ka-kī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.

Ū chi̍t ê chhut-gōa-lâng lâi hó-gia̍h-lâng hia; hó-gia̍h-lâng m̄-kam tùi ka-kī ê iûⁿ-kûn gû-kûn tiong lia̍h chi̍t chiah lâi chiau-thāi lâng-kheh, tian-tò lia̍h sàn-chhiah-lâng hit-chiah iûⁿ-á chiau-thāi i.”
Tāi-pi̍t tùi hit-ê hó-gia̍h-lâng hoat tōa siū-khì, kā Ná-tan kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, chòe chit-ê tāi-chì ê lâng tio̍h sí;
i tio̍h pê sì pē ê iûⁿ-á, in-ūi i chòe chit-ê sū, bô lîn-bín ê sim.”

Ná-tan tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí chiū-sī hit-ê lâng! Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Góa soán-li̍p lí chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông, kiù lí thoat-lī Sò-lô ê chhiú.

Góa ēng lí chú-lâng ê chhù-the̍h hō͘ lí, mā chiong lí chú-lâng hiah-ê bó͘ kau hō͘ lí, koh chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -ke kap Iû-tāi -ke hō͘ lí; chiah-ê lí nā iáu hiâm bô kàu, góa ōe koh-khah chōe hō͘ lí.

Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ biáu-sī Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, kiâⁿ I khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê tāi-chì? Lí chioh A-bûn -lâng ê to thâi-sí Hek -lâng O͘-lī-a, hō͘ i sí tī chiàn-tiûⁿ, koh chhōa i ê bó͘ chòe lí ê bó͘.
Taⁿ to-kiàm beh éng-oán bô lī-khui lí ê ke, in-ūi lí biáu-sī góa, chhōa Hek -lâng O͘-lī-a ê bó͘ chòe lí ê bó͘.’

Siōng Chú koh án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh hō͘ chai-hō tùi lí ka-kī ê ke khí-lâi kong-kek lí; góa beh tī lí ê ba̍k-chiu-chêng, chiong lí hiah-ê bó͘ hō͘ lí sin-piⁿ ê lâng, i beh tī tng-thâu-pe̍h-ji̍t kap in chòe-hé khùn.
Lí tī àm-tiong chòe ê tāi-chì, góa beh tng-thâu-pe̍h-ji̍t, tī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng hō͘ chiah-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng.’”
Tāi-pi̍t kā Ná-tan kóng, “Góa ū tek-chōe Siōng Chú!” Ná-tan kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Siōng Chú í-keng tû-khì lí ê chōe, lí bōe tì-kàu sí.
Chóng-sī in-ūi lí chòe chit-ê tāi-chì, tōa-tōa biáu-sī Siōng Chú, só͘-í lí só͘ siⁿ hit-ê kiáⁿ it-tēng ōe sí.”
Ná-tan chiū tò-khì in tau. Siōng Chú phah Tāi-pi̍t kap O͘-lī-a ê bó͘ siⁿ ê eⁿ-á, eⁿ-á chiū phòa-pīⁿ chin siong-tiōng.
Tāi-pi̍t chiū ūi-tio̍h hit-ê kiáⁿ tùi Siōng-tè kî-tó. Tāi-pi̍t koh kìm-chia̍h, ji̍p-khì lāi-bīn thong-mî tó tī thô͘-kha.
I kiong-lāi hiah-ê tiúⁿ-ló khì kàu i ê sin-piⁿ, beh kā i hû--khí-lâi; m̄-kú i m̄-khéng, mā bô beh kap in chòe-hé chia̍h.

Kàu tē-chhit ji̍t gín-á sí; Tāi-pi̍t ê jîn-sîn m̄-káⁿ kā i kóng gín-á sí lah; in-ūi in kóng, “Gín-á iáu oa̍h--teh, lán khǹg i, i to m̄ thiaⁿ, nā kā i kóng gín-á sí--khì, i m̄-chai ōe án-chóaⁿ siong-hāi ka-kī?”
Tāi-pi̍t khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ê jîn-sîn teh chhi-bú-chhi-chhū, chiū chai gín-á í-keng sí. Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g i ê jîn-sîn kóng, “Gín-á sí ah sī--bô?” In kóng, “Sí--khì ah.”

Tāi-pi̍t chiū tùi thô͘-kha khí--lâi, sóe seng-khu, boah-iû, ōaⁿ-saⁿ, ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān kèng-pài. Jiân-āu i tò-khì i ê chhù, hoan-hù lâng the̍h chia̍h-mi̍h lâi, i chiū chia̍h.
Jîn-sîn mn̄g i, “Lí ná ōe án-ni chòe? Gín-á oa̍h--teh ê sî, lí kìm-chia̍h thî-khàu; gín-á sí, lí hoán-tńg khí-lâi chia̍h.”
Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Gín-á iáu oa̍h--teh, góa kìm-chia̍h thî-khàu, in-ūi góa siūⁿ-kóng, Siōng Chú ōe lîn-bín góa, hō͘ gín-á oa̍h--teh.
Taⁿ gín-á í-keng sí, góa kìm-chia̍h ū siáⁿ lō͘-ēng? Góa kiám ōe-tàng hō͘ i tò-tńg--lâi? Góa ōe khì i hia, m̄-kú i bōe-tàng tńg-lâi góa chia.”
Tāi-pi̍t an-ùi i ê bó͘ Poa̍t-sī-pa, kap i tâng-pâng, i chiū siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Só͘-lô-bûn; Siōng Chú thiàⁿ i,
chiū thok sian-ti Ná-tan kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Iâ-tí-tí-a.
Iok-ap kong-táⁿ A-bûn -lâng ê kiaⁿ-siâⁿ La-pa.
Iok-ap chhe sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa í-keng chhú-tio̍h La-pa ê chúi-goân-tōe.
Taⁿ lí tio̍h chū-chi̍p kî-tha ê kun-peng lâi ûi-kong chit-ê siâⁿ, kā i chiàm-léng; kiaⁿ-liáu góa chhú chit-ê siâⁿ, lâng ōe ēng góa ê miâ lâi kiò chit-ê siâⁿ.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū tiàu-chi̍p só͘-ū kun-peng khì La-pa, kā i kong-chhú.

I the̍h-tio̍h Bí-le̍k-kong thâu-khak téng ê ông-koan, sī ēng tāi-iok saⁿ-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-kun ê kim chō--ê, koh ū siuⁿ pó-chio̍h. Lâng chiong chit-téng ông-koan tì tī Tāi-pi̍t ê thâu-khak. Tāi-pi̍t tùi siâⁿ-lāi chhú chin chōe châi-bu̍t,

koh kā siâⁿ-lāi ê jîn-bîn lia̍h--chhut-lâi, hō͘ in ēng kù-á, thih-pê-á, kap thih ê pó͘-thâu chòe khó͘-kang, koh tī hiā-iô chòe khó͘-kang; Tāi-pi̍t lóng ēng chit-khoán hong-hoat tùi-thāi A-bûn hiah-ê siâⁿ ê lâng. Āu-lâi, Tāi-pi̍t kap só͘-ū ê kun-peng tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ Ap-sa-liông ū chi̍t ê chin súi ê sió-bē, kiò-chòe Tha-má; Tāi-pi̍t lēng-gōa chi̍t ê kiáⁿ Àm-lūn loân-bō͘ i.
Àm-lūn ài i ê sió-bē Tha-má ài kah phòa-pīⁿ; in-ūi i sī chāi-sek-lú, Àm-lūn ka-kī chai bōe-tàng tùi i chòe sím-mi̍h.
Àm-lūn ū chi̍t ê pêng-iú, kiò-chòe Iok-ná-ta̍t, sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hiaⁿ-ko Sī-bí-a ê kiáⁿ. Iok-ná-ta̍t chit-ê lâng chin kan-khiáu.

I tùi Àm-lūn kóng, “Ông ê kiáⁿ ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ chi̍t-ji̍t pí chi̍t-ji̍t siau-sán bô cheng-sîn? Kiám bōe-tàng kā góa kóng?” Àm-lūn kā i kóng, “Góa ài góa ê sió-tī Ap-sa-liông ê sió-bē Tha-má.”

Iok-ná-ta̍t chiū tùi i kóng, “Lí tio̍h tó tī bîn-chhn̂g, ké phòa-pīⁿ; lí ê lāu-pē nā lâi khòaⁿ lí, lí thang tùi i kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa ê sió-bē Tha-má lâi góa chia, tī góa khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h ê só͘-chāi chún-pī chia̍h-mi̍h, chhin-chhiú the̍h hō͘ góa chia̍h.’”

Àm-lūn chiū tó--teh, ké phòa-pīⁿ; ông lâi khòaⁿ i; Àm-lūn chiū tùi ông kóng, “Chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa ê sió-bē Tha-má lâi góa chia, kā góa chòe nn̄g tè piáⁿ, góa thang tùi i ê chhiú chiap-lâi chia̍h.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū phài lâng khì Tha-má ê chhù, kā i kóng, “Lí khì lín hiaⁿ-ko Àm-lūn hia, kā i chún-pī chia̍h-mi̍h.”
Tha-má chiū khì i ê hiaⁿ-ko Àm-lūn ê chhù; hit-sî Àm-lūn tó tī bîn-chhn̂g. Tha-má tī i khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h ê só͘-chāi nóa mī-hún, hang-piáⁿ.
Tha-má chiong kui-pôaⁿ ê piáⁿ hē tī Àm-lūn ê bīn-chêng, m̄-kú i m̄ chia̍h. Àm-lūn kiò só͘-ū ê lâng lóng chhut--khì, in chiū chhut--khì.
I kā Tha-má kóng, “Lí phâng piáⁿ ji̍p-lâi pâng-keng, chhin-chhiú the̍h hō͘ góa chia̍h.” Tha-má chiū phâng hiah-ê piáⁿ ji̍p-khì pâng-keng hō͘ i ê hiaⁿ-ko Àm-lūn.
I phâng-khì hō͘ Àm-lūn chia̍h ê sî, Àm-lūn kā khiú--teh, kóng, “Sió-bē ah, lâi kap góa khùn.”
I ìn kóng, “Góa ê hiaⁿ-ko, m̄-thang, m̄-thang kā góa bú-jio̍k. Tī Í-sek-lia̍t bô eng-kai chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì. Lí m̄-thang chòe chit-khoán kiàn-siàu-sū.
Góa, góa beh án-chóaⁿ sóe góa ê kiàn-siàu? Lí, lí tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong ōe chiâⁿ-chòe siâ-ok ê gōng-lâng. Góa kiû lí kā ông kóng, i bōe chó͘-chí góa kè hō͘ lí.”
Chóng-sī Àm-lūn m̄-khéng thiaⁿ i ê ōe; Àm-lūn pí i khah ū la̍t, chiū kā i kiông-pō.
Liáu-āu, Àm-lūn iàm-ò͘ⁿ Tha-má; hit-ê iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê thêng-tō͘, pí í-chêng tùi i ê ài koh-khah tōa. Àm-lūn kā i kóng, “Khí--lâi, chhut--khì!”
I kā Àm-lūn kóng, “M̄-thang án-ni, lí kā góa kóaⁿ--chhut-khì pí kā góa bú-jio̍k koh-khah siâ-ok.” M̄-kú Àm-lūn m̄ thiaⁿ,
kiò sū-hāu i ê po̍k-jîn lâi, kā i kóng, “Kā chit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; i chhut--khì liáu-āu, kā mn̂g chhòaⁿ--khí-lâi.”

Àm-lūn ê lô͘-po̍k chiū kā i thoa--chhut-khì; chhut-khì liáu, mn̂g chiū chhòaⁿ--teh. Hit-sî Tha-má chhēng chhái-sek ê saⁿ, in-ūi ông iáu-bē chhut-kè ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ lóng chhēng chit-khoán saⁿ.
Tha-má sám hé-hu tī thâu-khak, thiah-li̍h só͘ chhēng chhái-sek ê saⁿ, ēng chhiú mo͘h thâu-khak, ná kiâⁿ ná háu.

I ê chhin hiaⁿ-ko Ap-sa-liông mn̄g i kóng, “Lí ê hiaⁿ-ko Àm-lūn kā lí bú-jio̍k sī--bô? Sió-bē ah, chit-chūn lí tio̍h tiām-tiām, i sī lí ê hiaⁿ-ko, m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h chit-ê sū sim kan-khó͘.” Tha-má chiū ko͘-toaⁿ siong-sim tòa tī i ê hiaⁿ-ko Ap-sa-liông ê chhù.
Tāi-pi̍t -ông thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê sū, hui-siông siū-khì, m̄-kú bô kā Àm-lūn chek-pī, in-ūi i sī tōa-kiáⁿ, Tāi-pi̍t chin kā théng-sēng.
Ap-sa-liông in-ūi Àm-lūn bú-jio̍k i ê sió-bē Tha-má, chiū oàn-hūn Àm-lūn, bô kap i kóng-ōe.
Nn̄g nî āu, Ap-sa-liông tī Í-hoat-liân hù-kūn ê Pa-le̍k Hā-só, chhiàⁿ lâng kā i chián iûⁿ-mn̂g. I chhiáⁿ ông só͘-ū ê kiáⁿ lóng khì.
Ap-sa-liông lâi kìⁿ ông, kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn ū chhiàⁿ lâng teh chián iûⁿ-mn̂g, chhiáⁿ ông kap lí ê jîn-sîn, kap lí ê po̍k-jîn chòe-hé lâi khèng-chiok.”

Ông kā Ap-sa-liông kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, m̄-thang, goán m̄-thang lóng khì, chiah bián lí khai-hùi siuⁿ siong-tiōng.” Ap-sa-liông chài-saⁿ iau-chhiáⁿ, ông m̄ khì, kan-ta kā i chiok-hok.
Ap-sa-liông kóng, “Nā bô, chiū hō͘ góa ê hiaⁿ-ko Àm-lūn kap goán khì.” Ông kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ tio̍h ài i kap lí khì?”
Ap-sa-liông chài-saⁿ chhéng-kiû. Ông chiū ún-chún Àm-lūn kap ông só͘-ū ê kiáⁿ lóng khì.

Ap-sa-liông hoan-hù i ê pō͘-hā kóng, “Lín tio̍h chù-ì, khòaⁿ Àm-lūn lim-chiú lim kah chin sóng-khoài ê sî, góa chi̍t-ē hā-lēng thâi Àm-lūn, lín chiū kā i thâi-sí. M̄-bián kiaⁿ; it-chhè ê hō͘-kó góa hū-chek. Lín tio̍h hó-táⁿ ióng-kám khì chòe.”
Ap-sa-liông ê pō͘-hā chiàu Ap-sa-liông ê bēng-lēng thâi Àm-lūn; ông ê kiáⁿ-jî lóng peh--khí-lâi, khiâ ka-kī ê lô tô-cháu.
In iáu tī lō͘--ni̍h, chiū ū hong-siaⁿ thoân kàu Tāi-pi̍t, kóng, “ Ap-sa-liông thâi-sí ông só͘-ū ê kiáⁿ, bô lâu kah pòaⁿ-ê.”
Ông chiū khí--lâi thiah-li̍h saⁿ, tó tī thô͘-kha; ông ê jîn-sîn mā thiah-li̍h saⁿ, khiā tī i ê sin-piⁿ.

Tāi-pi̍t ê hiaⁿ-ko Sī-bí-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-ta̍t kā ông kóng, “Góa ê chú, m̄-thang siūⁿ-kóng ông ê kiáⁿ lóng hō͘ Ap-sa-liông thâi-sí; sí--ê kan-ta Àm-lūn nā-tiāⁿ, in-ūi tùi Àm-lūn bú-jio̍k i ê sió-bē Tha-má hit-ji̍t khí, i chiū í-keng ū chit-ê ì-sù.
Taⁿ góa ê chú góa ê ông, m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h ông ê kiáⁿ lóng sí chit-ê hong-siaⁿ sim kan-khó͘. Kî-si̍t chí-ū Àm-lūn sí nā-tiāⁿ.”
Hit-sî Ap-sa-liông í-keng tô-cháu. Siú-bōng ê lâng gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng tùi āu-bīn soaⁿ-pho ê lō͘ lo̍h--lâi.
Iok-ná-ta̍t kā ông kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, ông ê kiáⁿ lóng tńg--lâi lah, tú chiàu lí ê po̍k-jîn só͘ kóng--ê.”
Ōe tú-á kóng soah, ông hiah-ê kiáⁿ chiū kàu, khui-siaⁿ thî-khàu; ông kap jîn-sîn mā lóng tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu.
Ap-sa-liông cháu-khì A-bí-hut ê kiáⁿ Ki-su̍t -ông Ta̍t-mái hia. Tāi-pi̍t ta̍k-ji̍t ūi-tio̍h i ê kiáⁿ siong-sim.
Ap-sa-liông cháu-khì Ki-su̍t, tòa hia saⁿ nî.
Tùi Àm-lūn ê sí, Tāi-pi̍t -ông bô koh hiah-ni̍h pi-siong, chiū bô koh tùi Ap-sa-liông siū-khì.
Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap chai ông ê sim iáu-teh siūⁿ Ap-sa-liông,

chiū phài lâng khì Thê-ko-a, kiò chi̍t ê chhong-bêng ê hū-jîn-lâng lâi. Iok-ap kā i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí chng-chòe tòa-hà ê hū-jîn-lâng; chhēng môa-saⁿ, seng-khu m̄-thang boah-iû, ké-chòe í-keng ūi-tio̍h sí-lâng ai-siong kúi-nā ji̍t.
Jiân-āu lí ji̍p-khì kìⁿ ông, chiàu góa kau-tài lí--ê tùi ông kóng.” Iok-ap chiū chiong só͘ tio̍h kóng ê ōe kà hū-jîn-lâng.
Thê-ko-a ê hū-jîn-lâng lâi kìⁿ ông, bīn phak tī thô͘-kha pài, kóng, “Ông ah, kiù góa.”
Ông mn̄g i kóng, “Lí ū sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?” I ìn kóng, “Góa sī chi̍t ê kóaⁿ-hū, góa ê tiōng-hu í-keng sí.
Lú-pī ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, in nn̄g ê tī hn̂g--ni̍h sio-phah, bô lâng kā in pâi-kái; chi̍t ê phah-sí lēng-gōa chi̍t ê.

Hiān-chāi choân ka-cho̍k lóng teh kong-kek lí ê lú-pī, kóng, ‘Lí tio̍h chiong hit-ê phah-sí hiaⁿ-tī--ê kau--chhut-lâi, goán beh hō͘ i sí, pê i phah-sí hiaⁿ-tī ê sìⁿ-miā, choa̍t i ê hō͘-sû.’ Án-ni in beh chiong góa chhun ê hé-chéng phah-hoa, hō͘ góa ê tiōng-hu bōe-tàng lâu-miâ lâu hō͘-tāi tī sè-kan.”
Ông kā hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Lí thang tò--khì, góa ōe ūi-tio̍h lí hā-lēng.”
Thê-ko-a ê hū-jîn-lâng koh tùi ông kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông, goān chit-ê chōe kui tī góa kap góa ê ka-cho̍k; kap ông í-ki̍p ông-ūi lóng bô koan-hē.”
Ông kóng, “Nā ū lâng kā lí ke kóng-ōe, lí kā chhōa-lâi góa chia, i chiū bōe koh kāng lí.”

Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Goān ông kì-liām Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè, m̄-thang hō͘ goán chhin-cho̍k tiong pò hiat-siû--ê koh thâi-sí góa ê kiáⁿ, chiah bián in bia̍t-choa̍t góa ê hō͘-sû.” Ông kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, lí ê kiáⁿ, liân chi̍t ki thâu-mn̂g to bōe ka-la̍uh tī thô͘-kha.”
Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Kiû lí ún-chún lí ê lú-pī tùi góa ê chú góa ê ông koh kóng chi̍t kù ōe.” Ông kóng, “Chòe lí kóng.”

Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Ông sī-án-chóaⁿ án-ni kè-bô͘ beh kong-kek Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn? Ông nā bô hō͘ hit-ê tô-miā ê kiáⁿ tò--lâi, ông tú-chiah kóng ê ōe, piáu-sī ka-kī ū m̄-tio̍h.

Lán lóng it-tēng ōe sí, chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi phoah-lo̍h tōe, bōe-tàng koh siu tò-tńg; m̄-kú Siōng-tè bōe chhiúⁿ-toa̍t lâng ê sìⁿ-miā, ōe siat-hoat hō͘ tô-miā ê lâng bián éng-oán siū kóaⁿ-tio̍k lī-khui I.

Góa chiong chiah-ê ōe kā góa ê chú góa ê ông kóng, sī in-ūi ū lâng kā góa khióng-hat, só͘-í lú-pī siūⁿ-kóng tio̍h hō͘ ông chai, kiám-chhái ông ōe thiaⁿ lú-pī ê sò͘-kiû.
Ū lâng beh chiong góa kap góa ê kiáⁿ tùi Siōng-tè só͘ sù ê sán-gia̍p chòe-chi̍t-ē tû-bia̍t. M̄-kú ông ōe thiaⁿ, ōe kiù i ê lú-pī thoat-lī hit-ê lâng ê chhiú.

Lú-pī siūⁿ, góa ê chú góa ê ông ōe an-ùi góa, in-ūi góa ê chú góa ê ông chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá, ōe hun-pia̍t sī-hui. Goān Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè kap lí tông-chāi.”
Ông ìn hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Góa beh mn̄g lí--ê, lí tio̍h chiàu-si̍t kóng.” Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Chhiáⁿ góa ê chú góa ê ông kóng.”

Ông kóng, “Chiah-ê lóng sī Iok-ap kap lí thò-hó--ê sī--bô?” Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông, góa kí lí ê oa̍h-miā chiù-chōa, tú chiàu góa ê chú góa ê ông kóng--ê, sī, sī lí ê po̍k-jîn Iok-ap hoan-hù góa, kà góa kóng--ê.
Lí ê po̍k-jîn Iok-ap án-ni chòe, sī beh hō͘ chit-ê tāi-chì kái-piàn; góa ê chú ū chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè sù-chiá ê tì-hūi, ōe liáu-kái sè-kan só͘-ū ê sū.”
Āu-lâi, ông kā Iok-ap kóng, “Chit-kiāⁿ sū góa tah-èng lí. Taⁿ lí khì, kā hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng Ap-sa-liông chhōa--tò-lâi.”

Iok-ap phak tī thô͘-kha pài, kā ông chiok-hok. Iok-ap kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông ū tah-èng lí po̍k-jîn ê chhéng-kiû. Kin-á-ji̍t lí ê po̍k-jîn chai góa ū tit-tio̍h lí ê hoaⁿ-hí.”
Tùi án-ni Iok-ap chhut-hoat khì Ki-su̍t, chhōa Ap-sa-liông tńg-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Ông kóng, “Kiò i tò-khì i ê chhù, m̄-thang kìⁿ góa ê bīn.” Ap-sa-liông chiū tò-khì ka-kī ê chhù, bô kìⁿ ông ê bīn.
Tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong, bô lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ Ap-sa-liông hiah-ni̍h eng-chùn tit-tio̍h lâng o-ló; tùi kha-tóe kàu thâu-khak téng lóng bô khoat-tiám.
Ap-sa-liông ta̍k-nî tio̍h chián chi̍t piàn thâu-mn̂g, in-ūi i ê thâu-mn̂g chin tāng. I chián--khí-lâi ê thâu-mn̂g, chiàu ông ê chhìn, tāi-iok nn̄g kong-kun.
Ap-sa-liông siⁿ saⁿ ê kiáⁿ, chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ miâ kiò Tha-má, sī chi̍t ê chin súi ê cha-bó͘ gín-á.
Ap-sa-liông tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng móa nn̄g nî, bô kìⁿ-tio̍h ông ê bīn.
Ap-sa-liông phài lâng khì kiò Iok-ap, beh chhiáⁿ i khì kìⁿ ông, m̄-kú Iok-ap m̄-khéng lâi. Ap-sa-liông tē-jī piàn phài lâng khì kiò, i iû-goân m̄ lâi.

Ap-sa-liông tùi i ê pō͘-hā kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, Iok-ap ê hn̂g lī góa ê hn̂g chin kūn, ū chèng tōa-be̍h. Lín khì kā pàng-hé sio.” Ap-sa-liông ê pō͘-hā chiū khì pàng-hé sio Iok-ap ê hn̂g.
Iok-ap khì Ap-sa-liông ê chhù, mn̄g i kóng, “Lí ê pō͘-hā sī-án-chóaⁿ pàng-hé sio góa ê hn̂g?”

Ap-sa-liông kā Iok-ap kóng, “Góa phài lâng chhiáⁿ lí lâi, sī beh chhiáⁿ lí khì kìⁿ ông, kā i kóng góa ná tio̍h tùi Ki-su̍t tò--lâi; góa lêng-khó lâu tī hia. Taⁿ tio̍h hō͘ góa khì kìⁿ ông ê bīn; góa nā ū chōe, i thang thâi góa.”
Iok-ap chiū khì kìⁿ ông kā i choán-ta̍t. Ông kiò Ap-sa-liông lâi; Ap-sa-liông chiū lâi kìⁿ ông, tī ông ê bīn-chêng phak tī thô͘-kha. Ông chiū chim Ap-sa-liông.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, Ap-sa-liông ūi ka-kī chún-pī bé kap chiàn-chhia, koh phài gō͘-cha̍p ê peng tī thâu-chêng khui-lō͘.

Ap-sa-liông siông-siông chá-chá khí--lâi, khiā tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu ê lō͘-piⁿ; nā ū lâng ū àn-kiāⁿ beh hō͘ ông phòaⁿ-toàn, Ap-sa-liông chiū kiò i lâi, mn̄g i kóng, “Lí sī tó chi̍t ê siâⁿ ê lâng?” I ìn kóng, “Po̍k-jîn sī Í-sek-lia̍t bó͘ chi̍t ê chi-cho̍k ê lâng.”
Ap-sa-liông kā i kóng, “Lí ê àn-kiāⁿ ha̍p-chêng ha̍p-lí, m̄-kú ông bô kau-tài lâng chhú-lí lí ê àn-kiāⁿ.”

Ap-sa-liông koh kóng, “Khó-sioh bô lâng chí-phài góa chòe chit-ê tōe ê sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ; nā ū lâng ū sio-kò tio̍h sím-phòaⁿ ê àn-kiāⁿ, lâi góa chia, góa ōe chiàu kong-tō phòaⁿ-koat.”
Nā ū lâng lâi pài i, i chiū chhun-chhiú khan i, kā i chim.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan, nā ū lâng beh khì kìⁿ ông chhéng-kiû phòaⁿ-toàn, Ap-sa-liông lóng án-ni tùi-thāi in. Ap-sa-liông ēng án-ni àm-tiong tit-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê sim.
Sì nî āu, Ap-sa-liông tùi ông kóng, “Kiû lí chún góa khì Hi-pek-lûn, hō͘ góa thang tùi Siōng Chú siā-goān.
In-ūi po̍k-jîn tòa tī Sū-lī-a ê Ki-su̍t ê sî ū hē-goān kóng, ‘Siōng Chú nā hō͘ góa koh tò-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, góa beh khì Hi-pek-lûn ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.’”
Ông kā i kóng, “Lí thang pêng-an khì.” Ap-sa-liông chiū chhut-hoat, khì Hi-pek-lûn.
Ap-sa-liông àm-tiong phài sù-chiá khì Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k-ê chi-cho̍k, kóng, “Lín chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h sàu-kak ê siaⁿ, chiū hoah kóng, ‘ Ap-sa-liông tī Hi-pek-lûn choh-ông lah!’”
M̄-kú Ap-sa-liông tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘ chhiáⁿ kap i khì hit nn̄g-pah ê lâng, lóng m̄ chai tāi-chì ê thâu-bé.

Ap-sa-liông hiàn-chè ê sî, phài lâng khì Ki-lô -siâⁿ chhiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t ê chham-bô͘ A-hi-to-hut lâi; tùi án-ni, tè Ap-sa-liông ê lâng jú lâi jú chōe, hoán-poān ê sè-bīn ná lâi ná kiông.
Ū lâng lâi kā Tāi-pi̍t pò-kò kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê sim lóng kui-ǹg Ap-sa-liông lah.”

Tāi-pi̍t tùi hiah-ê kap i tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê jîn-sîn kóng, “Khí--lâi, lán tio̍h tô-cháu; nā bô, lán bōe-tàng tô-pī Ap-sa-liông. Tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín cháu, chiah bián i liâm-piⁿ jip-tio̍h lán, siong-hāi lán, thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng.”
Ông ê jîn-sîn kā ông kóng, “Goán ê chú goán ê ông só͘ koat-tēng--ê, lí ê po̍k-jîn lóng beh chiàu án-ni chòe.”
Ông chhut-siâⁿ, i ê ka-koàn lóng tè tī i ê āu-bīn, chí-ū lâu cha̍p ê pîn-hui kò͘ ông-kiong.
Siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng mā tè ông lī-khui; in kiâⁿ kàu siâⁿ ê chòe-āu chi̍t keng chhù thêng--teh.

Ông ê jîn-sîn lóng tī i ê bīn-chêng kiâⁿ--kè-khì; só͘-ū ê Ki-lī-thê -lâng, Pí-lī-thê -lâng, kap tùi Ka-te̍k tè i lâi hit la̍k-pah ê Ka-te̍k -lâng, mā lóng tī ông ê bīn-chêng kiâⁿ--kè-khì.
Ông kā Ka-te̍k -lâng Í-thài kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ beh kap goán khì? Tio̍h tò-khì óa sin-ông; lí sī gōa-kok-lâng, tùi lí ê pún-kok tô-lān lâi chia.

Lí chā-hng chiah lâi, kin-á-ji̍t góa ka-kī to m̄ chai beh khì tó-ūi, ná thang hō͘ lí kap goán chòe-hé phiau-liû? Tńg--khì, kā lí ê hiaⁿ-tī chòe-hé chhōa--tò-khì. Goān Siōng Chú ēng chû-ài sìn-si̍t tùi-thāi lí. ”

Í-thài ìn ông kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú tī góa ê chú góa ê ông bīn-chêng chiù-chōa, ông bô-lūn tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, lí ê po̍k-jîn bô-lūn sí oa̍h lóng ōe tī hia.”
Tāi-pi̍t kā Í-thài kóng, “Hó, lí chìn-chêng kiâⁿ.” Ka-te̍k -lâng Í-thài kap hiah-ê tè i ê lâng, kap só͘-ū ê gín-á chiū lóng kè--khì.
Kun-tè ông ê lâng kè--khì ê sî, só͘-ū ê lâng lóng tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu. Ông kè Khip-lûn Khoe-kok, jîn-bîn mā kè--khì, ǹg thàng khòng-iá ê lō͘ kiâⁿ--khì.

Khòaⁿ leh, chè-si Sat-tok lâi lah, só͘-ū tè i ê Lī-bī -lâng mā kng Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi lâi. In chiong Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi hē tī hia. A-pí-a-tha mā lâi kàu hia, thèng-hāu tùi siâⁿ-lāi chhut--lâi ê jîn-bîn lóng kè--khì.

Ông kā Sat-tok kóng, “Lí kng Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi tò-khì siâⁿ-lāi. Góa nā tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê un-tián, I ōe hō͘ góa tò--lâi, hō͘ góa koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h iok-kūi, kap khǹg iok-kūi ê só͘-chāi.
Siōng Chú nā kóng, ‘Góa bô kah-ì lí.’ Goān I chiàu I ê ì-sù tùi-thāi góa.”

Ông koh kā Sat-tok kóng, “Lí kiám m̄-sī sian-kiàn? Lí thang pêng-an tò-khì siâⁿ-lāi; lí ê kiáⁿ A-hi-má-su kap A-pí-a-tha ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan, lóng thang kap lí chòe-hé tò--khì.
Góa ōe tī khòng-iá ê tō͘-kháu thèng-hāu lín pò siau-sit hō͘ góa.”
Sat-tok kap A-pí-a-tha chiū kng Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; in chiū lâu tī hia.
Tāi-pi̍t tùi ǹg Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ ê lō͘ chiūⁿ--khì, khàm-thâu thǹg-chhiah-kha, ná kiâⁿ ná háu; tè i khì ê lâng mā khàm-thâu chiūⁿ--khì, ná kiâⁿ ná háu.
Ū lâng pò Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “ A-hi-to-hut mā tè Ap-sa-liông tī poān-tóng ê tiong-kan.” Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí hō͘ A-hi-to-hut ê kè-bô͘ lo̍k-khong.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiūⁿ kàu soaⁿ-téng kèng-pài Siōng-tè ê só͘-chāi ê sî, A-ki -lâng Hō͘-su thiah-li̍h saⁿ, thâu-khak sám thô͘-hún, lâi gêng-chiap i.
Tāi-pi̍t kā i kóng, “Lí nā kap góa khì, ōe thoa-lūi góa;

lí nā tò-khì siâⁿ-lāi, kā Ap-sa-liông kóng, ‘Ông ah, góa beh chòe lí ê po̍k-jîn; góa í-chêng chòe lí lāu-pē ê po̍k-jîn, taⁿ góa mā beh án-ni chòe lí ê po̍k-jîn.’ Án-ni lí chiū ōe-tàng thòe góa phò-hoāi A-hi-to-hut ê kè-bô͘.
Chè-si Sat-tok kap A-pí-a-tha mā ōe kap lí tī hia. Lí tī ông-kiong só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, tio̍h kā chè-si Sat-tok kap A-pí-a-tha kóng.
Sat-tok ê kiáⁿ A-hi-má-su, A-pí-a-tha ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan, mā kap in tī hia; lín só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, tio̍h kau-tài in lâi pò góa.”
Tùi án-ni, Ap-sa-liông ji̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sî, Tāi-pi̍t ê pêng-iú Hō͘-su mā ji̍p-siâⁿ.

Tāi-pi̍t kè soaⁿ-téng bô jōa hn̄g, Bí-hui-pho-siat ê po̍k-jîn Sé-pa lâi gêng-chiap; i khan nn̄g chiah kòa oaⁿ ê lû-á, chài nn̄g-pah tè piáⁿ, chi̍t-pah lia̍p phû-tô-koaⁿ-oân, chi̍t-pah lia̍p bû-hoa-kó-koaⁿ-oân, kap chi̍t phê-lông ê chiú.

Ông mn̄g Sé-pa kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ tòa chiah-ê lâi?” Sé-pa kóng, “Lû sī beh hō͘ ông ê ka-koàn khiâ, piáⁿ kap sek ê ké-chí beh hō͘ siàu-liân-lâng chia̍h, chiú beh hō͘ tī khòng-iá ià-siān ê lâng lim.”

Ông mn̄g kóng, “Lí ê chú-lâng Sò-lô ê sun tī tó-ūi?” Sé-pa ìn ông kóng, “I iáu tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, in-ūi i kóng, ‘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kin-á-ji̍t beh chiong góa ê a-kong ê kok hêng góa.’”
Ông kā Sé-pa kóng, “ Bí-hui-pho-siat só͘-ū--ê lóng sù hō͘ lí.” Sé-pa kóng, “Góa khiam-pi phak-pài; goān góa tit-tio̍h góa ê chú góa ê ông ê un-tián.”
Tāi-pi̍t -ông kàu Pa-hō͘-lîm ê sî, ū Sò-lô ka-cho̍k chi̍t ê lâng, Ki-la ê kiáⁿ Sī-múi chhut--lâi, ná kiâⁿ ná chiù-chó͘,
koh khioh chio̍h-thâu tìm Tāi-pi̍t -ông kap i ê jîn-sîn; hit-sî kun-tè ông ê lâng kap ióng-sū lóng tī ông ê chó-iū.
Sī-múi chiù-chó͘ kóng, “Lí chit-ê lâu lâng ê huih ê hiong-siú, lí chit-ê pháiⁿ-lâng, khì-sí!

Lí chhiúⁿ Sò-lô ê ông-ūi, Siōng Chú chiong lí lâu i ka-cho̍k ê huih ê chōe lóng kui tī lí, chiong chit-ê kok kau hō͘ lí ê kiáⁿ Ap-sa-liông. Taⁿ lí tú-tio̍h ok-pò, in-ūi lí sī lâu lâng ê huih ê hiong-siú.”
Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ A-pí-su kā ông kóng, “Chit-chiah sí-káu, ná thang hō͘ i chiù-chó͘ góa ê chú góa ê ông? Chún góa kè--khì, chām i ê thâu.”

Ông kóng, “Lín chiah-ê Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ, che bô lín ê tāi-chì. Chhut-chāi i chiù-chó͘, in-ūi sī Siōng Chú hoan-hù i chiù-chó͘ góa; só͘-í bô lâng ōe-tàng kóng i sī-án-chóaⁿ án-ni chòe.”

Tāi-pi̍t koh kā A-pí-su kap ông ê jîn-sîn kóng, “Góa ê chhin-siⁿ-kiáⁿ to siàu-siūⁿ góa ê sìⁿ-miā, hô-hòng chit-ê Piān-ngá-bín -lâng! Chhut-chāi i chiù-chó͘, in-ūi sī Siōng Chú kah i án-ni chòe.
Kiám-chhái Siōng Chú tài-liām góa ê khó͘-kéng, ōe si-un hō͘ góa lâi tāi-thòe kin-á-ji̍t ê chiù-chó͘.”
Tāi-pi̍t kap tè i ê lâng kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ. Sī-múi kiâⁿ tī tùi-bīn ê soaⁿ-phiâⁿ, ná kiâⁿ ná chiù-chó͘, koh tìm chio̍h-thâu, iā thô͘-hún.
Ông kap tè i ê lâng kàu chi̍t ê só͘-chāi; in lóng chin ià-siān, chiū tī hia hioh-khùn.
Ap-sa-liông kap tè i ê Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, A-hi-to-hut mā kap i chòe-hé.
Tāi-pi̍t ê pêng-iú A-ki -lâng Hō͘-su lâi Ap-sa-liông hia, tùi Ap-sa-liông kóng, “Goān ông bān-sòe! Goān ông bān-sòe!”
Ap-sa-liông kā Hō͘-su kóng, “Lí án-ni chòe, tùi lí ê pêng-iú kiám ū tiong-sêng? Lí ná bô kap lí ê pêng-iú chòe-hé khì?”
Hō͘-su kā Ap-sa-liông kóng, “M̄-sī án-ni, Siōng Chú kap Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn só͘ soán--ê, góa beh kui-sūn i, mā beh tè i.
Koh chi̍t hāng, góa tio̍h ho̍k-sāi siáⁿ-lâng? Kiám m̄-sī tio̍h ho̍k-sāi ông ê kiáⁿ? Góa án-chóaⁿ ho̍k-sāi lí ê lāu-pē, mā beh án-ni ho̍k-sāi lí.”
Ap-sa-liông kā A-hi-to-hut kóng, “Lín tio̍h chhut kè-chhek, khòaⁿ lán koh-lâi tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe.”

A-hi-to-hut kā Ap-sa-liông kóng, “Lí khì kap lí ê lāu-pē lâu--lo̍h-lâi kò͘ ông-kiong hiah-ê pîn-hui chòe-hé khùn; Í-sek-lia̍t ê chèng-lâng chai lí káⁿ jiá lí ê lāu-pē siū-khì, hiah-ê kui-sūn lí ê lâng ōe koh-khah kian-koat.”
In chiū kā Ap-sa-liông tī ông-kiong ê chhù-téng tah pò͘-pîⁿ. Ap-sa-liông chiū tī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng bīn-chêng ji̍p--khì, kap i ê lāu-pē ê pîn-hui khùn.
Hit-sî A-hi-to-hut só͘ thê-chhut ê kè-chhek, chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi Siōng-tè lâi ê ōe; in-ūi án-ni, A-hi-to-hut ê ì-kiàn lóng siū Tāi-pi̍t kap Ap-sa-liông chun-tiōng.
A-hi-to-hut tùi Ap-sa-liông kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chún góa kéng chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng lâng, kim-àm khí-sin tui-jip Tāi-pi̍t.
Góa thàn i ià-siān sit-chì, kā i kong-kek, hō͘ i kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ sit-táⁿ, tè i ê lâng lóng ōe tô-cháu. Góa kan-ta beh thâi-sí ông chi̍t ê lâng,
hō͘ jîn-bîn lóng kui-sūn lí. Lí só͘ beh thâi hit-ê lâng í-gōa, só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn lóng ōe pêng-an.”
Ap-sa-liông kap Í-sek-lia̍t só͘-ū ê tiúⁿ-ló lóng chàn-sêng chit-ê thê-gī.
Ap-sa-liông kóng, “Tiàu A-ki -lâng Hō͘-su lâi, lán mā lâi thiaⁿ i ê ì-kiàn.”
Hō͘-su kàu Ap-sa-liông hia, Ap-sa-liông tùi i kóng, “ A-hi-to-hut án-ni thê-gī, lán chiàu i kóng--ê khì chòe hó--bô? Nā bô, lí ū sím-mi̍h ì-kiàn?”
Hō͘-su tùi Ap-sa-liông kóng, “ A-hi-to-hut chit-piàn ê kè-chhek m̄ hó.”

Hō͘-su koh kóng, “Lí chai lí ê lāu-pē kap tè i ê lâng lóng sī ióng-sū. In gêng-sim lia̍h-kông, chhin-chhiūⁿ kiáⁿ hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì ê hîm-bú. Koh lí ê lāu-pē sī ū keng-giām ê chiàn-sū, it-tēng bōe kap kun-peng chòe-hé hioh-khùn.
Hiān-chāi i it-tēng bih tī soaⁿ-tōng á-sī pa̍t-ê só͘-chāi. Nā ū lâng tāi-seng hō͘ i thâi-sí, thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng ōe kóng, ‘Tè Ap-sa-liông ê kun-peng hō͘ lâng thâi-sí lah.’
Hit-sî, liân ióng-béng chhin-chhiūⁿ sai ê lâng, sim mā ōe siau-iûⁿ sit-táⁿ; in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng chai lí ê lāu-pē sī ióng-sū, tè i ê lâng mā lóng chin ióng-kám.
Só͘-í góa thê-gī, tio̍h hō͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-piⁿ ê soa hiah-ni̍h chōe ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tùi Tān kàu Pia̍t-sī-pa chū-chi̍p lâi lí chia, lí mā chhin-sin chhōa in chhut-chiàn.
Án-ni, lán bô-lūn tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi tú-tio̍h i, kā i tu̍t-kek, chhin-chhiūⁿ lō͘-chúi kàng-lo̍h tāi-tōe, hō͘ i kap tè i ê lâng bô lâu kah chi̍t ê.
I nā thiat-thè ji̍p chi̍t ê siâⁿ, só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ōe tòa soh khì hit-ê siâⁿ, kā siâⁿ thoa-lo̍h soaⁿ-kok, tī hia liân chi̍t tè chio̍h-thâu-á to chhē bô.”

Ap-sa-liông kap só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng kóng, “ A-ki -lâng Hō͘-su ê kè-chhek pí A-hi-to-hut --ê khah hó.” Siōng Chú koat-tēng beh phò-hoāi A-hi-to-hut hó ê kè-chhek, thang kàng chai-hō hō͘ Ap-sa-liông.
Hō͘-su kā chè-si Sat-tok kap A-pí-a-tha kóng, “ A-hi-to-hut kā Ap-sa-liông kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló chhut ê kè-bô͘ sī án-ni án-ni; góa chhut ê kè-chhek sī án-ni án-ni.

Hiān-chāi lín tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín phài lâng khì kā Tāi-pi̍t pò-kò, kim-àm m̄-thang tiàm tī khòng-iá ê tō͘-kháu, it-tēng tio̍h kè-hô, chiah bián ông kap tè i ê lâng lóng siū châu-bia̍t.”

Hit-sî Iok-ná-tan kap A-hi-má-su tiàm tī Ún Lô-kiat, m̄-káⁿ ji̍p-siâⁿ, kiaⁿ hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h; in teh thèng-hāu chi̍t ê lú-pī tùi siâⁿ-lāi chhut-lâi kā in thong-pò, hō͘ in thang tùi Tāi-pi̍t -ông pò-kò.

M̄-kú ū chi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h in, chiū khì kā Ap-sa-liông pò-kò; in nn̄g lâng kóaⁿ-kín cháu-khì Pa-hō͘-lîm bó͘ chi̍t ê lâng ê chhù; hit-ê lâng ê tiâⁿ ū chíⁿ, in nn̄g lâng chiū lo̍h-khì hia bih.
Hit-ke ê hū-jîn-lâng ēng kòa khàm chíⁿ-kháu, téng-bīn pho͘ be̍h-á, tāi-chì chiū bô lāu-sia̍p.

Ap-sa-liông ê pō͘-hā lâi kàu hū-jîn-lâng hit-keng chhù, mn̄g i kóng, “ A-hi-má-su kap Iok-ná-tan tī tó-ūi?” Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “In kè khoe khì lah.” Hiah-ê pō͘-hā khì chhē, chhē bô tio̍h, chiū tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

In lī-khui liáu, hit nn̄g ê lâng tùi chíⁿ--ni̍h khí--lâi, khì kā Tāi-pi̍t -ông thong-pò. In tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lín tio̍h khí--lâi, kóaⁿ-kín kè-hô, in-ūi A-hi-to-hut ū án-ni án-ni kè-bô͘ beh hāi lí.”
Tāi-pi̍t kap tè i ê lâng chiū khí--lâi, kè Iok-tàn-hô; kàu thiⁿ-kng, bô chi̍t ê bô kè Iok-tàn-hô.

A-hi-to-hut chai i ê kè-chhek bô siū chhái-la̍p, chiū khiâ-lû tò-khì i ê siâⁿ, kàu in tau. I kā chhù-lāi ê tāi-chì kau-tài hó-sè, chiū ka-kī tiàu--sí; lâng kā i bâi-chòng tī in lāu-pē ê bōng.
Tāi-pi̍t kàu Má-hap-liām ê sî, Ap-sa-liông kap tè i ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiah kè Iok-tàn-hô.

Ap-sa-liông siat-li̍p A-má-sat chòe goân-sòe tāi-thòe Iok-ap. A-má-sat sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng Í-te̍k-la ê kiáⁿ; Í-te̍k-la bat kap Ná-hat ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Ài-pí-kai tâng-pâng. Chit-ê Ài-pí-kai kap Iok-ap ê lāu-bú Sé-lō͘-ngá sī chí-bē.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Ap-sa-liông tī Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu chat-iâⁿ.
Tāi-pi̍t kàu Má-hap-liām hit-sî, A-bûn -cho̍k ê La-pa -lâng Ná-hat ê kiáⁿ Sok-pí, Lô Tí-pa -lâng A-bí-lī ê kiáⁿ Má-kiat, kap Ki-lia̍t ê Lô-ki-lîm -lâng Pa-se-lâi,
tòa chhn̂g-pho͘, phûn, hûi-khì, sió-be̍h, tōa-be̍h, mī-hún, pē-se̍k ê ngó͘-kok, tāu-á, âng-tāu, pē--kè ê tāu-á,
bi̍t, iû, gû-lin kap iûⁿ-lin chòe ê chia̍h-mi̍h, kiong-kip Tāi-pi̍t kap tè i ê lâng; in kóng, “Kun-peng tī khòng-iá it-tēng ōe iau, ōe ià-siān, chhùi-ta.”
Tāi-pi̍t tiàu-chi̍p tè i ê kun-peng, ēng chi̍t-chheng lâng kap chi̍t-pah lâng chòe tan-ūi, chiàu phian-chè siat-li̍p chí-hui-koaⁿ.

Tāi-pi̍t phài kun-peng chhut--khì, chiong saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t kau hō͘ Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap, saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t kau hō͘ Iok-ap ê hiaⁿ-tī A-pí-su, saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t kau hō͘ Ka-te̍k -lâng Í-thài. Ông tùi kun-peng kóng, “Góa it-tēng beh kap lín chòe-hé chhut-chiàn.”

M̄-kú kun-peng kóng, “Lí m̄-thang chhut--khì; goán nā thâi-su tô-cháu, tùi-te̍k bōe chù-ì goán; goán nā chi̍t-pòaⁿ tīn-bông, tùi-te̍k mā bōe khòaⁿ-chòe iàu-kín; lí chi̍t lâng pí goán chi̍t-bān lâng khah tiōng-iàu. Lí lâu tī siâⁿ-lāi pang-chān goán khah hó.”
Ông kā in kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê, góa chiàu án-ni chòe.” Ông chiū khiā tī siâⁿ-mn̂g piⁿ, kun-peng chi̍t-pah chi̍t-pah, chi̍t-chheng chi̍t-chheng, chiàu chhù-sū chhut--khì.

Ông bēng-lēng Iok-ap, A-pí-su, Í-thài, kóng, “Lín tio̍h tài-liām góa, m̄-thang siong-hāi hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng Ap-sa-liông.” Ông ūi Ap-sa-liông bēng-lēng hiah-ê siú-léng ê ōe, kun-peng lóng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h.
Kun-peng chiū chhut-khì iá-gōa, tī Í-hoat-liân ê chhiū-nâ kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn.
Tī hia, Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-tūi thâi-su Tāi-pi̍t ê pō͘-hā; hit-ji̍t chiàn-sí--ê chin chōe, ū nn̄g-bān lâng.
Kau-chiàn thòaⁿ kàu choân tōe-khu; hit-ji̍t tī chhiū-nâ lāi sí--ê, pí hō͘ to thâi-sí--ê khah chōe.

Ap-sa-liông khiâ lô, tú-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t ê pō͘-hā. Lô cháu tùi tōa-châng siōng-chhiū chin ām ê chhiū-oe ē-bīn keng-kè, i ê thâu-mn̂g kau-tio̍h siōng-chhiū-ki, lâng tiàu tī pòaⁿ-khong-tiong; só͘ khiâ ê lô chòe i khì.
Ū chi̍t ê peng-sū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, kā Iok-ap kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h Ap-sa-liông tiàu tī siōng-chhiū.”
Iok-ap kā pò i ê lâng kóng, “Siáⁿ? Lí ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h o͘h! Ná bô tng-tiûⁿ kā phah-sí? Lí nā án-ni chòe, góa chiū siúⁿ lí cha̍p tè gûn, kap chi̍t tiâu io-tòa.”

Hit-ê lâng tùi Iok-ap kóng, “Lí chiū-sī hō͘ góa chi̍t-chheng tè gûn, góa mā m̄-káⁿ tāng-chhiú hāi ông ê kiáⁿ; in-ūi goán ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h ông bēng-lēng lí kap A-pí-su, Í-thài, kóng, ‘Lín tio̍h sòe-jī, m̄-thang hāi hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng Ap-sa-liông.’
Góa nā káⁿ án-ni chòe hāi i ê sìⁿ-miā, ông it-tēng ōe chai, kàu-sî lí mā ōe m̄ chhap góa.”
Iok-ap kóng, “Góa bô sî-kan koh kap lí kóng.” Iok-ap chiū gia̍h saⁿ ki té-chhiuⁿ khì; hit-sî Ap-sa-liông tiàu tī siōng-chhiū iáu oa̍h--teh. Iok-ap chha̍k-thàng Ap-sa-liông ê sim.
Ūi Iok-ap gia̍h bú-khì ê cha̍p ê siàu-liân-lâng kā Ap-sa-liông ûi--teh, kā i thâi-sí.
Iok-ap pûn sàu-kak, kun-peng chiū tò--lâi, bô koh jip Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; in-ūi Iok-ap kā in chó͘-chí.
In chiong Ap-sa-liông hiat tī chhiū-nâ lāi chi̍t ê tōa chhim-khiⁿ, téng-bīn thia̍p chi̍t-tōa-tui chio̍h-thâu; só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng cháu tò-khì ka-kī ê chhù.

Ap-sa-liông oa̍h--teh ê sî, tī Ông ê Soaⁿ-kok ūi ka-kī chhāi chi̍t ki thiāu; i kóng i bô kiáⁿ thang lâu miâ, chiū kā hit-ki thiāu hō-chòe Ap-sa-liông. Kàu kin-á-ji̍t, lâng iáu chheng-ho͘ hit-ki thiāu chòe Ap-sa-liông Kì-liām-pi.
Sat-tok ê kiáⁿ A-hi-má-su kóng, “Chún góa cháu-khì tùi ông pò-kò, Siōng Chú í-keng ū kái-kiù i thoat-lī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú.”
Iok-ap kā i kóng, “Lí kin-á-ji̍t m̄-thang khì pò siau-sit, lēng-ji̍t chiah khì. Kin-á-ji̍t lí m̄-thang pò siau-sit, in-ūi ông ê kiáⁿ sí--khì.”
Iok-ap kā chi̍t ê Kó͘-si̍t lô͘-lē kóng, “Lí khì chiong lí só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê kā ông pò-kò.” Kó͘-si̍t -lâng tùi Iok-ap kiok-kiong chiū ēng cháu--ê khì.

Sat-tok ê kiáⁿ A-hi-má-su koh kā Iok-ap kóng, “Bô-lūn án-chóaⁿ, kiû lí chún góa tè Kó͘-si̍t -lâng ēng cháu--ê khì.” Iok-ap kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ, lí pò siau-sit bōe tit-tio̍h siúⁿ, sī-án-chóaⁿ beh khì?”
I ìn kóng, “Bô-lūn án-chóaⁿ, góa beh khì.” Iok-ap kóng, “Lí khì!” A-hi-má-su chiū tùi Iok-tàn pêng-goân ê lō͘ cháu--khì, jip-kè Kó͘-si̍t -lâng.

Tāi-pi̍t tú-á chē tī lāi siâⁿ-mn̂g kap gōa siâⁿ-mn̂g ê tiong-kan; siú-bōng ê lâng peh-chiūⁿ siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, kàu siâⁿ-mn̂g ê lâu-téng koan-khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê lâng toaⁿ-sin cháu--lâi.
Siú-bōng--ê tōa-siaⁿ hoah, tùi ông pò-kò. Ông kóng, “I nā ka-kī chi̍t ê lâi, it-tēng sī beh pò hó siau-sit.” Hit-ê lâng ná cháu ná kūn-óa.

Siú-bōng ê lâng koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h lēng-gōa chi̍t ê lâng cháu--lâi, siú-bōng--ê kā kò͘ siâⁿ-mn̂g ê lâng kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, koh ū chi̍t ê lâng toaⁿ-sin cháu--lâi.” Ông kóng, “Che mā-sī pò hó siau-sit--ê.”
Siú-bōng--ê kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ thâu-chêng teh cháu--ê chhin-chhiūⁿ Sat-tok ê kiáⁿ A-hi-má-su.” Ông kóng, “I sī hó lâng, lâi pò hó siau-sit.”

A-hi-má-su tùi ông kiò kóng, “Pêng-an!” Chiū tī ông ê bīn-chêng phak-pài, kóng, “Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! I í-keng chiong hiah-ê khí-chhiú kong-kek góa ê chú góa ê ông ê lâng phah-pāi lah.”

Ông kóng, “Siàu-liân-lâng Ap-sa-liông pêng-an á bô?” A-hi-má-su ìn kóng, “ Iok-ap phài ông ê po̍k-jîn, chiū sī lí ê po̍k-jîn lâi ê sî, góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h hūn-loān ê tiûⁿ-bīn, m̄ chai hoat-seng sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.”
Ông kóng, “Lí khiā tiàm piⁿ--á.” I chiū siám-khui, khiā--teh.
Kó͘-si̍t -lâng mā kàu; pò-kò kóng, “Ū hó siau-sit pò-kò góa ê chú góa ê ông. Siōng Chú kin-á-ji̍t ū thòe lí sin-oan, phah-pāi khí-lâi kong-kek lí ê lâng.”

Ông mn̄g Kó͘-si̍t -lâng kóng, “Siàu-liân-lâng Ap-sa-liông ū pêng-an bô?” Kó͘-si̍t -lâng ìn kóng, “Goān góa ê chú góa ê ông ê tùi-te̍k, kap só͘-ū khí-lâi kong-kek lí, beh hāi lí ê lâng, lóng kap hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng kâng-khoán.”

Ông chiū chin siong-sim. I chiūⁿ siâⁿ-mn̂g téng ê pâng-keng thî-khàu, ná kiâⁿ ná kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ Ap-sa-liông ah! Góa ê kiáⁿ, góa ê kiáⁿ, Ap-sa-liông ah! Góa khó͘-bōe-tit thòe lí sí. Ap-sa-liông ah, góa ê kiáⁿ, góa ê kiáⁿ!”
Ū lâng kā Iok-ap kóng, “Ông ūi-tio̍h Ap-sa-liông thî-khàu pi-ai.”
Hit-ji̍t ê sèng-lī pìⁿ-chòe choân-kun ê pi-ai, in-ūi hit-ji̍t kun-peng ū thiaⁿ-kóng ông ūi-tio̍h i ê kiáⁿ ai-siong.
Hit-ji̍t kun-peng thau-thau-á ji̍p-siâⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiàn-pāi tô-cháu kiàn-siàu ê peng-sū kâng-khoán.
Ông tà i ê bīn, tōa-siaⁿ háu, kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ Ap-sa-liông ah! Ap-sa-liông, góa ê kiáⁿ, góa ê kiáⁿ ah!”

Iok-ap ji̍p ông tòa ê só͘-chāi khì kìⁿ ông, kóng, “Lí kin-á-ji̍t hō͘ lí só͘-ū ê jîn-sîn bô thé-biān. In kin-á-ji̍t kiù lí ê sìⁿ-miā, kiù lí ê kiáⁿ kap cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, koh kiù lí ê hō͘-hui kap pîn-hui ê sìⁿ-miā.

Oàn-hūn lí--ê, lí thiàⁿ in; thiàⁿ lí--ê, lí oàn-hūn in. Lí kin-á-ji̍t bêng-bêng piáu-sī lí bô khòaⁿ hiah-ê chiòng-léng kap pō͘-hā chòe iàu-kín. Góa kin-á-ji̍t khòaⁿ-chhut, nā Ap-sa-liông oa̍h--teh, goán lóng sí, lí tian-tò hoaⁿ-hí.

Taⁿ lí tio̍h khí--lâi chhut-khì an-ùi lí ê pō͘-hā. Góa kí Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, lí nā bô chhut--khì, kim-mî bô chi̍t ê lâng ōe kap lí chòe-hé, pôe-phōaⁿ lí; chit-ê chai-hō pí lí tùi siàu-liân kàu hiān-chāi tú--tio̍h-ê koh-khah giâm-tiōng.”

Ông chiū khí--lâi, chē tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu; ū lâng kā kun-peng kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, ông chē tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu.” Kun-peng chiū lóng lâi kàu ông ê bīn-chêng. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng í-keng tô-cháu, ta̍k-ê lâng tò-khì in tau.

Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê lâng hun-hun gī-lūn, kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t -ông bat kái-kiù lán thoat-lī tùi-te̍k ê pek-hāi, koh tháu-pàng lán thoat-lī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê ap-pek; i in-ūi siám-pī Ap-sa-liông iáu tī gōa-bīn tô-bông.
Lán ū soán-li̍p Ap-sa-liông choh-ông tī-lí lán, i í-keng tīn-bông. Lín ná tìⁿ-tiām-tiām, m̄ chhiáⁿ ông tò--lâi?”

Tāi-pi̍t -ông phài lâng khì kìⁿ chè-si Sat-tok kap A-pí-a-tha, kóng, “Lín tio̍h kā Iû-tāi ê tiúⁿ-ló kóng, ‘Ông í-keng ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng beh chhiáⁿ ông tńg-lâi ông-kiong; lín ná iáu-bē beh chhiáⁿ ông tò--lâi?
Lín sī góa ê hiaⁿ-tī, góa ê kut-jio̍k; chhiáⁿ ông tò--lâi chit-ê tāi-chì, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ tè lâng bōe tio̍h?’

Lín mā tio̍h kā A-má-sat kóng, ‘Lí kiám m̄-sī góa ê kut-jio̍k? Góa beh hō͘ lí tùi hiān-chāi khí tāi-thòe Iok-ap chòe goân-sòe, nā bô, goān Siōng-tè ka-pē chek-hoa̍t góa.’”

Án-ni, Tāi-pi̍t chiū tit-tio̍h Iû-tāi chèng-lâng ê sim; in lóng tâng-sim chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t ê lâng. In chiū chhe lâng khì kìⁿ ông, kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kap lí ê chèng jîn-sîn tò--lâi.”
Ông chiū khí-sin tò--khì. I kàu Iok-tàn-hô ê sî, Iû-tāi -lâng lâi Kiat-kah gêng-chiap i, chhōa i kè hô.
Pa-hō͘-lîm ê Piān-ngá-bín -lâng, Ki-la ê kiáⁿ Sī-múi kóaⁿ-kín kap Iû-tāi -lâng lo̍h-lâi gêng-chiap Tāi-pi̍t -ông.
Kap i lâi--ê, ū chi̍t-chheng ê Piān-ngá-bín -lâng, ū Sò-lô -ke ê po̍k-jîn Sé-pa, kap i cha̍p-gō͘ ê kiáⁿ, jī-cha̍p ê po̍k-jîn, in lóng kóaⁿ-kín kè Iok-tàn-hô khì kìⁿ ông.
Ū lâng chiàu ông ê ì-sù, ēng chûn hō͘-sàng ông ê ka-koàn kè-hô. Ông teh-beh kè hô ê sî, Ki-la ê kiáⁿ Sī-múi lâi phak tī ông ê bīn-chêng,

tùi ông kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông lī-khui Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sî, lí ê po̍k-jîn ū pōe-ge̍k lí; taⁿ kiû góa ê chú m̄-thang tui-kiù góa ê chōe. Chhiáⁿ ông m̄-thang chiong chit-ê tāi-chì kì-tiâu-tiâu, khǹg tī lí ê sim-lāi.
Lí ê po̍k-jîn bêng-bêng chai ka-kī ū-chōe, só͘-í kin-á-ji̍t Iok-sek choân-ke góa tē-it tāi-seng lo̍h-lâi gêng-chiap góa ê chú góa ê ông.”
Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ A-pí-su kóng, “ Sī-múi bat chiù-chó͘ Siōng Chú só͘ boah-iû soán-li̍p--ê, kiám m̄-bián hō͘ i sí?”

Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “ Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ, che m̄-sī lín ê tāi-chì, góa lâi chhú-lí chiū hó; lín m̄-thang hoán-tùi. Kin-á-ji̍t Í-sek-lia̍t tiong kiám thang ū lâng siū chhú-sí? Góa kiám m̄ chai chit-chūn teh chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông--ê sī góa?”
Ông chiū kā Sī-múi kóng, “Lí m̄-bián sí.” Ông tùi i chiù-chōa.
Sò-lô ê sun Bí-hui-pho-siat mā lo̍h-khì gêng-chiap ông; i tùi ông lī-khui ê ji̍t kàu ông pêng-an tò--lâi, bô sóe-kha, bô siu chhùi-chhiu, mā bô sóe-saⁿ.
I tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng gêng-chiap ông ê sî, ông mn̄g i, “ Bí-hui-pho-siat, lí ná bô kap góa chòe-hé khì?”
I ìn kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông ah, hit-chūn lí ê po̍k-jîn ū chún-pī lû, siūⁿ-beh kap ông chòe-hé khì, m̄-kú góa sī pái-kha. Góa ê po̍k-jîn Sé-pa phiàn góa,
koh tī góa ê chú góa ê ông bīn-chêng húi-pòng góa. Góa ê chú góa ê ông chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá, chhiáⁿ ông chiàu lí khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê tùi-thāi góa.

Góa ê pē choân-ke, tī góa ê chú góa ê ông bīn-chêng lóng kai sí; m̄-kú ông iáu hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn kap ông chòe-hé chia̍h, góa ná ū koân thang koh tùi ông chhéng-kiû sím-mi̍h?”
Ông kā i kóng, “Lí m̄-bián koh kóng lí ê tāi-chì. Góa koat-tēng, lí kap Sé-pa pîⁿ-pun hiah-ê thó͘-tōe.”
Bí-hui-pho-siat tùi ông kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông í-keng pêng-an tò-lâi kiong-lāi, hiah-ê thó͘-tōe lóng hō͘ Sé-pa mā bô iàu-kín.”
Ki-lia̍t -lâng Pa-se-lâi tùi Lô-ki-lîm lo̍h--lâi, beh hō͘-sàng ông kè Iok-tàn-hô.
Pa-se-lâi sī poeh-cha̍p-hè ê lāu-lâng. I chin hó-gia̍h; ông tòa tī Má-hap-liām ê sî, i ū ēng chia̍h-mi̍h kiong-kip ông.
Ông tùi Pa-se-lâi kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kap góa chòe-hé kè--khì, kap góa tòa Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, góa beh chiàu-kò͘ lí.”
Pa-se-lâi tùi ông kóng, “Góa iáu ū kúi nî thang oa̍h, thang kap ông chòe-hé tòa Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng?

Góa í-keng poeh-cha̍p hè, í-keng bōe-hiáu hun-pia̍t súi bái, tam bōe chhut chia̍h-mi̍h ê chu-bī, thiaⁿ bōe chhut lâm-lú chhiùⁿ-koa ê siaⁿ-im. Po̍k-jîn ná thang thoa-lūi góa ê chú góa ê ông.
Lí ê po̍k-jîn chí-ū pôe-phōaⁿ ông kè Iok-tàn-hô chi̍t-tè-á lō͘; ông ná tio̍h án-ni un-thāi góa?

Kiû lí chún lí ê po̍k-jîn tò--khì, hō͘ góa thang sí tī góa ê kò͘-hiong, an-chòng tī góa ê pē-bú ê bōng hia. Taⁿ lí ê po̍k-jîn Kim-hán tī chia; chhiáⁿ góa ê chú góa ê ông hō͘ i kap lí chòe-hé kè--khì, chiàu lí só͘ khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê tùi-thāi i.”
Ông kóng, “ Kim-hán thang kap góa khì; góa ōe chiàu lí só͘ ǹg-bāng--ê khoán-thāi i; lí tùi góa chhéng-kiû--ê, góa kā lí tah-èng.”
Só͘-ū ê lâng lóng kè Iok-tàn-hô, ông mā kè--khì. Ông kā Pa-se-lâi chim, kā i chiok-hok; i chiū tò-khì i ê kò͘-hiong.
Ông kè hô, kàu Kiat-kah; Kim-hán mā kap i kè--khì; Iû-tāi lóng-chóng ê kun-peng kap Í-sek-lia̍t chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê kun-peng, mā lóng hō͘-sàng ông kè--khì.

Āu-lâi, Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn lâi kìⁿ ông, kā i kóng, “Goán ê hiaⁿ-tī Iû-tāi -lâng sī-án-chóaⁿ thau-thau-á kā lí chiap--khì, chhōa ông kap lí ê ka-sio̍k, í-ki̍p kun-tè lí ê lâng, kè Iok-tàn-hô?”

Iû-tāi chèng-lâng ìn Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kóng, “Ông kap goán sī kâng chi-cho̍k, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ ūi-tio̍h chit-ê sū teh siū-khì? Goán kiám bat tùi ông tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h hó-chhù? Ông kiám bat hō͘ goán sím-mi̍h lī-ek?”

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ìn Iû-tāi -lâng kóng, “Cha̍p-jī chi-cho̍k tiong, goán ū cha̍p chi-cho̍k, goán kap Tāi-pi̍t -ông pí lín khah ū koan-hē. Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ khòaⁿ-khin goán? Kiám m̄-sī goán seng kóng beh chhōa ông tò--lâi?” Chóng-sī, Iû-tāi -lâng ê ōe pí Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê ōe khah ngī.

Hit-sî ū chi̍t ê húi-lūi, kiò-chòe Sī-pa, sī Piān-ngá-bín -lâng Pí-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ. I pûn sàu-kak kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-kok lán bô hūn, Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ kap lán bô koan-hē. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, lín lóng tò-khì lín tau.”

Tùi án-ni, só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng lī-khui Tāi-pi̍t khì tè Pí-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Sī-pa; m̄-kú Iû-tāi -lâng, tùi Iok-tàn-hô kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, kui-chōa lō͘ lóng kā ông tè-tiâu-tiâu.

Tāi-pi̍t kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, ji̍p ông-kiong. I chiong chêng só͘ lâu-teh kò͘ ông-kiong ê cha̍p ê pîn-hui, kā in koaiⁿ-kìm tī pa̍t-keng chhù, kiong-kip in chia̍h, chhēng, ēng, bô kap in chhin-kūn; in siū koaiⁿ-kìm, chhin-chhiūⁿ kóaⁿ-hū, ti̍t-kàu in sí.
Ông tùi A-má-sat kóng, “Lí tio̍h tī saⁿ ji̍t lāi chio-chi̍p Iû-tāi -lâng lâi góa chia, lí mā tio̍h lâi.”
A-má-sat chiū khì chio-chi̍p Iû-tāi -lâng, m̄-kú i iân-chhiân chhiau-kè kî-hān.

Tāi-pi̍t kā A-pí-su kóng, “Taⁿ Pí-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Sī-pa tùi lán ê siong-hāi, ōe pí Ap-sa-liông khah giâm-tiōng. Lí tio̍h tòa lí chú-lâng ê kun-tūi kā i tui-jip, chiah bián i chiàm-tio̍h kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, chiâⁿ-chòe lán ê khùn-jiáu.”
Iok-ap ê pō͘-hā, kap Ki-lī-thê -lâng, Pí-lī-thê -lâng, í-ki̍p chèng ióng-sū, lóng tè A-pí-su tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chhut--khì, tui-jip Pí-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Sī-pa.

In kàu Ki-piàn ê tōa chio̍h-pôaⁿ hia, A-má-sat lâi kàu in ê bīn-chêng. Hit-sî Iok-ap chhēng chiàn-kah, hâ tòa to-kiàm ê io-tòa, to chhah tī siù-lāi. I kiâⁿ chìn-chêng ê sî, to tùi siù--ni̍h lak--chhut-lâi.
Iok-ap kā A-má-sat kóng, “Hiaⁿ-tī, pêng-an.” Iok-ap chiū ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú la̍k A-má-sat ê chhùi-chhiu, beh kā i chim.

A-má-sat bô chù-ì Iok-ap tò-chhiú gia̍h kiàm; Iok-ap ēng hit-ki kiàm chha̍k-ji̍p A-má-sat ê pak-tó͘, i ê tn̂g-á lâu chhut-lâi tī thô͘-kha; chi̍t to chiū sí. Iok-ap kap i ê sió-tī A-pí-su khì tui-jip Pí-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Sī-pa.
Ū chi̍t ê Iok-ap ê pō͘-hā khiā tī A-má-sat ê si-thé piⁿ--á, kóng, “Ióng-hō͘ Iok-ap, kui-sūn Tāi-pi̍t ê lâng lóng tio̍h tè Iok-ap khì.”

A-má-sat ê si-thé kō kah choân huih tó tī lō͘-tiong, Iok-ap hit-ê pō͘-hā khòaⁿ-tio̍h chèng-lâng lóng thêng-kha teh khòaⁿ, chiū chiong si-thé tùi lō͘-tiong sóa-khì hn̂g--ni̍h, ēng saⁿ kā i khàm--teh.
Sin-si tùi lō͘-tiong sóa-cháu í-āu, só͘-ū ê lâng chiū lóng tè Iok-ap, khì tui-jip Pí-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Sī-pa.
Sī-pa kiâⁿ-thàu Í-sek-lia̍t só͘-ū ê chi-cho̍k, kàu Pek Má-ka ê A-pek; Pí-ki-lī kâng chong-cho̍k ê lâng mā chū-chi̍p lâi tè i.
Iok-ap kap i ê kun-peng kàu Pek Má-ka ê A-pek, ûi-khùn chit-ê siâⁿ; biān-tùi siâⁿ ê gōa-chhiûⁿ khí thô͘-tui, koh lòng siâⁿ beh hō͘ i tó.
Ū chi̍t ê chhong-bêng ê hū-jîn-lâng tùi siâⁿ-téng kiò kóng, “Thiaⁿ leh, thiaⁿ leh. Lín khì kā Iok-ap kóng, chhiáⁿ i lâi chia, góa ū ōe beh kap i kóng.”
Iok-ap chiū kiâⁿ óa--khì. Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Lí sī Iok-ap sī--bô?” I ìn kóng, “Góa chiū-sī.” Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ lú-pī ê ōe.” I ìn kóng, “Góa teh thiaⁿ.”
Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Kó͘-chá-lâng ū án-ni kóng, ‘Ū tāi-chì tio̍h khì A-pek hia mn̄g, chiah ōe kái-koat.’

Goán tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong sī siōng hô-pêng siōng tiong-sêng ê chi̍t chō siâⁿ. Lí sī siūⁿ-beh húi-bia̍t Í-sek-lia̍t tiong chit-ê chiah-ni̍h iàu-kín ê siâⁿ, ài-beh thun-bia̍t Siōng Chú ê sán-gia̍p sī--bô?”
Iok-ap ìn kóng, “Góa choa̍t-tùi m̄-sī beh thun, á-sī beh bia̍t chit-ê siâⁿ.

Tāi-chì m̄-sī án-ni, sī in-ūi Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ū chi̍t ê lâng, Pí-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Sī-pa khí-chhiú kong-kek Tāi-pi̍t -ông. Lín chiong chit-ê lâng kau--chhut-lâi, góa chiū lī-khui chit-ê siâⁿ.” Hū-jîn-lâng kā Iok-ap kóng, “Hó! I ê thâu-khak góa ōe hiat-kè siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ hō͘ lí.”

Hū-jîn-lâng chiū ēng i ê tì-hūi sòe-ho̍k chèng-lâng. In chám Pí-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Sī-pa ê thâu-khak, hiat hō͘ Iok-ap. Iok-ap pûn sàu-kak, kun-peng chiū lī-khui siâⁿ kái-sàn, ta̍k-ê lâng tò-khì in tau. Iok-ap tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, khì ông hia.
Iok-ap chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê goân-sòe; Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá koán-hat Ki-lī-thê -lâng kap Pí-lī-thê -lâng.
A-to-lân koán-lí lô-ia̍h; A-hi-lu̍t ê kiáⁿ Iok-sa-hoat chòe sú-koaⁿ;
Sī-hoat chòe su-kì. Sat-tok kap A-pí-a-tha chòe chè-si;
Gâi-ní -lâng Í-la mā chòe Tāi-pi̍t ê chè-si.
Tāi-pi̍t chāi-ūi ê sî ū ki-hng liân-sòa saⁿ nî. Tāi-pi̍t chhéng-būn Siōng Chú. Siōng Chú kóng, “Sī in-ūi Sò-lô kap i ê ke thâi-sí Ki-piàn -lâng, lâu in ê huih.”

Ông chiū tiàu Ki-piàn -lâng lâi, tùi in kóng-ōe. (Ki-piàn -lâng pún-lâi m̄-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, sī A-mô͘-lī -lâng lâu--lo̍h-lâi--ê. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bat tùi in chiù-chōa, bô beh thâi in; m̄-kú Sò-lô in-ūi tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng ê jia̍t-sim, jia̍t-chhiat kah kè-bô͘ beh kā in siau-bia̍t.)
Tāi-pi̍t kā Ki-piàn -lâng kóng, “Góa tio̍h ūi lín chòe sím-mi̍h? Góa tio̍h án-chóaⁿ kā lín pó͘-sióng, thang hō͘ lín chiok-hok Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn?”

Ki-piàn -lâng kóng, “Goán kap Sò-lô í-ki̍p i ê ke ê tāi-chì m̄-sī ēng kim-gûn ōe-tàng kái-koat, mā m̄-thang in-ūi goán ê iân-kò͘ hāi-sí jīm-hô chi̍t ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.” I kóng, “Lín kóng án-chóaⁿ, góa chiū án-ni chòe.”
In tùi ông kóng, “ Sò-lô kè-bô͘ beh kā goán châu-bia̍t, hāi goán tī choân Í-sek-lia̍t kéng-lāi bô khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.

Chhiáⁿ chiong i chhit ê ta-po͘ ê kiáⁿ-sun kau hō͘ goán, goán beh tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kā in tiàu tī Ki-pí-a, chiū-sī Siōng Chú soán-li̍p choh-ông ê Sò-lô ê ka-hiong.” Ông kóng, “Góa ōe chiong in kau hō͘ lín.”
Tāi-pi̍t -ông in-ūi bat kap Sò-lô ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan kí Siōng Chú ê miâ chiù-chōa, só͘-í m̄-kam chiong Iok-ná-tan ê kiáⁿ Bí-hui-pho-siat kau hō͘ in.

Ông chiū chiong Ài-a ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Lī-su-pa kā Sò-lô siⁿ ê nn̄g ê kiáⁿ A-mô͘-nî kap Bí-hui-pho-siat, í-ki̍p Sò-lô ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-la kā Bí-hô-la -lâng Pa-se-lâi ê kiáⁿ A-tek-lia̍t siⁿ ê gō͘ ê kiáⁿ,

lóng kau hō͘ Ki-piàn -lâng. Ki-piàn -lâng chiū tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kā in tiàu tī soaⁿ-téng. Chit chhit ê lâng lóng chòe-hé sí, hit-sî tú sī khai-sí siu-koah tōa-be̍h ê sî.

Ài-a ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Lī-su-pa the̍h chho͘-môa-pò͘, tī chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng ūi ka-kī tah pîⁿ-á tòa tī hia; tùi khai-sí siu-koah kàu lo̍h chhiu-ú ak-tio̍h sin-si ê kî-kan, i ji̍t--sî m̄-chún pe-chiáu, mî--sî m̄-chún cháu-siù kha̍p-tio̍h hiah-ê sin-si.
Ū lâng chiong Ài-a ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, Sò-lô ê hui Lī-su-pa só͘ chòe ê sū kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng.

Tāi-pi̍t chiū khì Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí -lâng hia, chiong Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan ê kut-hâi the̍h--lâi. (Hui-lī-sū -lâng tī Ki-lī-pho thâi-sí Sò-lô ê sî, chiong Sò-lô kap Iok-ná-tan tiàu-sí tī Pek Siān ê kóng-tiûⁿ; Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí -lâng tùi hia thau-the̍h in ê si-thé.)
Tāi-pi̍t tùi hia tòa Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan ê kut-hâi tò--lâi, koh siu-si̍p hit chhit ê siū tiàu-sí ê lâng ê kut-hâi.

Lâng chiū chiong Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan ê kut-hâi bâi-chòng tī Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu ê Sé-la, Sò-lô ê lāu-pē Ki-sū ê bōng. In chiàu ông ê bēng-lēng chòe liáu-āu, Siōng-tè ū thiaⁿ in ūi choân-kok ê kî-tó.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng koh kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn. Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê kun-peng chòe-hé lo̍h-khì kong-táⁿ Hui-lī-sū -lâng, Tāi-pi̍t chiū chin ià-siān.
Ū chi̍t ê tōa-hàn-cho̍k ê lâng, kiò-chòe Í-si̍t Pí-lo̍k, i ê chhiuⁿ ê thâu ēng tâng chòe, tāng saⁿ kong-kun-pòaⁿ, koh pē sin ê to, beh thâi Tāi-pi̍t.

Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ A-pí-su pó-hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t, phah-sí hit-ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng. Āu-lâi tè Tāi-pi̍t ê lâng tùi i chiù-chōa kóng, “Tùi kin-á-ji̍t khí, lí m̄-thang koh kap goán chhut-chiàn, chiah bián Í-sek-lia̍t ê teng hoa--khì.”
Āu-lâi, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Ko-pek kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng kau-chiàn; hit-sî ū Hō͘-sa -lâng Se-pí-kai thâi-sí chi̍t ê tōa-hàn-cho̍k ê lâng, miâ kiò-chòe Sat-hut.

In koh tī Ko-pek kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng kau-chiàn; Pek-lī-hêng -lâng Gâi-ní ê kiáⁿ I-le̍k-hap-lân thâi-sí Ka-te̍k -lâng Ko-lī-a; i ê chhiuⁿ-pìⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-pò͘-ki ê chhia-sim hiah chho͘.

In koh tī Ka-te̍k kau-chiàn; tī hia ū chi̍t ê tōa-hàn-lâng, nn̄g ki chhiú kok ū la̍k ki chńg-thâu-á, nn̄g ki kha mā kok ū la̍k ki kha-chńg-thâu-á, kiōng ū jī-cha̍p-sì ki; i mā-sī tōa-hàn-cho̍k ê hō͘-tāi.
Chit-ê lâng tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-tūi chhiàng-siaⁿ ê sî, Tāi-pi̍t ê hiaⁿ-ko Sī-bí-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan kā i thâi-sí.
Chit sì ê lâng sī Ka-te̍k tōa-hàn-cho̍k ê hō͘-tāi; in lóng hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê kun-peng thâi-sí.
Siōng Chú kiù Tāi-pi̍t thoat-lī só͘-ū ê tùi-te̍k kap Sò-lô ê chhiú liáu-āu, i ǹg Siōng Chú liām chit-siú si:
Siōng Chú sī góa ê soaⁿ-giâm, góa ê iàu-sài, góa ê Chín-kiù-chiá;

sī góa ê Siōng-tè, góa ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ, góa beh óa-khò I; I sī góa ê tún-pâi, kiù góa ê khùi-la̍t, góa ê pó-lúi, góa ê pī-lān-só͘. Góa ê Chín-kiù-chiá, lí ū kiù góa thoat-lī kiông-pō.
Góa kiû-kiò eng-kai siū chheng-chàn ê Siōng Chú, góa chiū tit-tio̍h kái-kiù thoat-lī tùi-te̍k.
Sí-bông ê tōa-éng ûi-khùn góa; húi-bia̍t ê tōa-chúi hō͘ góa kiaⁿ.
Im-hú ê soh khún-pa̍k góa; Sí-bông ê lô-bāng bāng-tio̍h góa.
Góa tī khó͘-lān tiong kî-kiû Siōng Chú, tùi góa ê Siōng-tè kiû-kiò; I tī I ê tiān-lāi thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ; góa ê khún-kiû ū ji̍p I ê hī-khang.
I siū-khì, tōe chiū iô-choah; thiⁿ ê kun-ki mā tín-tāng iô koh choah.
Tùi I ê phīⁿ-khang ū ian chhèng-chhut; tùi I ê chhùi ū hé hoat-chhut, liân thô͘-thòaⁿ mā to̍h--khí-lâi.
I thí-khui thiⁿ, chhin-sin kàng-lîm; I kha-ē ū kāu-kāu ê o͘-hûn.
I khiâ thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek teh pe; I chē hong ê si̍t hián-hiān.
I ēng o͘-àm chòe I ún-ba̍t ê só͘-chāi, ēng chúi kap ba̍t-hûn ûi khí-lâi chòe tiùⁿ-pâng.
I hoat-chhut ê kng, hō͘ thòaⁿ to̍h--khí-lâi.
Siōng Chú tùi thiⁿ-téng tân-lûi, Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè chhut-siaⁿ.
I siā-chìⁿ, hō͘ tùi-te̍k sì-sòaⁿ; I hoat-chhut sih-nà, hō͘ in hūn-loān.
Siōng Chú chi̍t-ē chek-pī, phīⁿ-khang ê khùi chi̍t-ē chhut, hái-tóe chiū lō͘-chhut, tāi-tōe ê kun-ki mā lō͘-hiān.
I tùi téng-bīn chhun-chhiú khiú góa, tùi tōa-chúi kā góa kiù--chhut-lâi.
I kiù góa thoat-lī hiong-béng ê tùi-te̍k, thoat-lī oàn-hūn góa ê lâng; in-ūi in pí góa khah kiông.
Góa tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê sî, in lâi kong-kek góa; m̄-kú Siōng Chú sī góa ê óa-khò.
I chhōa góa kàu khui-khoah an-choân ê só͘-chāi; I kiù góa, in-ūi I ì-ài góa.
Siōng Chú in-ūi góa chèng-ti̍t pò-tap góa, in-ūi góa ê só͘-chòe chheng-khì pò-siúⁿ góa.
Góa chun-siú Siōng Chú ê tō-lō͘, m̄-bat choh-pháiⁿ lī-khui góa ê Siōng-tè.
I só͘-ū ê bēng-lēng góa ū chun-siú; I ê kui-lē góa m̄-bat pàng-sak.
Góa tī I ê bīn-chêng bô thang chí-chek; góa pó-siú ka-kī lī-khui chōe-ok.
In-ūi góa chèng-ti̍t, Siōng Chú pò-siúⁿ góa; tī I ê ba̍k-chiu chêng, góa ê só͘-chòe chheng-khì.
Chû-ài ê lâng, lí ēng chû-ài tùi-thāi i; sûn-choân ê lâng, lí ēng sûn-choân tùi-thāi i;
chheng-khì ê lâng, lí ēng chheng-khì tùi-thāi i; m̄-kú, kan-chà ê lâng, lí ēng oan-khiau tùi-thāi i.
Khùn-khó͘ ê lâng, lí kái-kiù i; chū-ko ê lâng, lí te̍k-sī i, kā i kàng-kē.
Siōng Chú, lí sī góa ê teng; Siōng Chú kā góa ê o͘-àm pìⁿ-chòe kng-bêng.
Góa in-ūi óa-khò lí, ōe-tàng kong-phòa te̍k-kun; óa-khò góa ê Siōng-tè, ōe-tàng thiàu-kè siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ.
Chit-ūi Siōng-tè, I ê tō-lō͘ oân-choân. Siōng Chú ê ōe ū kè hé thoàn-liān; óa-khò I--ê, I chòe tún-pâi pó-hō͘ in.
Siōng Chú í-gōa, kiám ū pa̍t-ê Siōng-tè? Goán ê Siōng-tè í-gōa, kiám ū chio̍h-pôaⁿ thang óa-khò?
Chit-ūi Siōng-tè sī góa kian-kò͘ ê iàu-sài; I ín-chhōa góa kiâⁿ an-choân ê lō͘.
I hō͘ góa ê kha chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k gâu cháu, koh hō͘ góa khiā-chāi tī koân ê só͘-chāi.
I hùn-liān góa ê chhiú gâu kau-chiàn, hō͘ góa ê chhiú ōe khui tâng ê keng.
Lí ēng tún-pâi kái-kiù góa; lí ê pang-chān hō͘ góa kian-kiông.
Lí hō͘ góa ta̍h ê tōe khui-khoah an-choân; góa ê kha m̄-bat ta̍h-thu̍t.
Góa tui góa ê tùi-te̍k kàu jip--tio̍h in; in bô bia̍t-bông, góa bōe tò-tńg.
Góa phah in thiám-thiám, hō͘ in peh bōe khí--lâi, kàu in tó tī góa ê kha-ē.
Lí sù góa khùi-la̍t hō͘ góa gâu kau-chiàn; lí hō͘ kong-kek góa ê lâng lóng hâng-ho̍k tī góa ē-bīn.
Lí hō͘ góa ê tùi-te̍k oa̍t-tńg-sin tô-cháu, koh hō͘ góa châu-bia̍t oàn-hūn góa ê lâng.
In kiû-kiò, bô lâng kiù in; kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, I mā bô ìn.
Góa kā in tûi kàu chhùi-chhùi, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōe-chiūⁿ ê thô͘-hún, kā in thún-ta̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ koe-lō͘ ê thô͘-bê.
Lí kiù góa thoat-lī hoán-poān góa ê jîn-bîn; lí pó-hō͘ góa, hō͘ góa chòe lia̍t-pang ê thâu. Góa m̄-bat ê jîn-bîn ōe ho̍k-sāi góa;
gōa-pang ê lâng khut-sin tâu-hâng, in chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê miâ chiū sūn-ho̍k.
Gōa-pang ê lâng sit-táⁿ, kiâⁿ-chhut in ê tīn-tōe, chún-pī beh chok-chiàn.
Siōng Chú éng-oán oa̍h--teh! Goān góa óa-khò ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ siū chheng-chàn; goān kiù góa ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ — Siōng-tè siū ko-kú.
I chiū-sī ūi góa sin-oan hit-ūi Siōng-tè; I hō͘ chèng-lâng hâng-ho̍k tī góa kha-ē.
I kiù góa thoat-lī góa ê tùi-te̍k. Lí thê-poa̍t góa koân-kè kong-kek góa ê lâng; lí kiù góa thoat-lī kiông-pō ê lâng.
Siōng Chú ah, in-ūi án-ni góa beh tī lia̍t-pang tiong kám-siā lí, chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí ê miâ.
Siōng Chú sù ke̍k-tōa ê kiù-un hō͘ I siat-li̍p ê ông, si-lo̍h chû-ài hō͘ I boah-iû soán-li̍p ê lâng, hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê hō͘-tāi, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
Ē-bīn sī Tāi-pi̍t ê ûi-giân. Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, chiū-sī tit-tio̍h ko-seng, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè só͘ soán-li̍p, Í-sek-lia̍t lâng-lâng ì-ài ê si-jîn kóng:
Siōng Chú ê sîn thong-kè góa thoân-ta̍t, I ê ōe tī góa ê chhùi.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ū kóng, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Chio̍h-pôaⁿ tùi góa kóng: Ēng kong-gī tī-lí, ēng kèng-ùi Siōng-tè lâi tī-lí ê lâng,
ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ bô hûn ê chheng-chá tú-á chhut ê ji̍t-kng, lo̍h-hō͘ liáu-āu tāi-tōe chhiⁿ-chháu hoán-siā ê kong-chhái.

Góa ê ke tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng kiám m̄-sī án-ni? I ū kap góa li̍p éng-oán ê iok, ta̍k-hāng an-pâi chiâu-chn̂g koh ún-kò͘. Góa só͘-ū ê chín-kiù kap só͘-ū ê goān-bōng, I lóng kā góa sêng-choân.
M̄-kú húi-lūi lóng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ lâng hiat-ka̍k ê chhì-á, lâng m̄-káⁿ ēng chhiú the̍h;
beh kha̍p in ê lâng, tio̍h ēng thih-khì kap chhiuⁿ-pìⁿ; tī hia chhì-á it-tēng hō͘ hé sio-bia̍t.

Tāi-pi̍t ê ióng-sū ê miâ-toaⁿ kì tī ē-bīn: Hap-kek-mô͘-nî -lâng Iok-siat Pa-siat, mā kiò-chòe I-su-nî -lâng A-tí-lô, sī saⁿ ê ióng-sū ê siú-léng, bat chi̍t piàn phah-sí poeh-pah ê lâng.

Tē-jī ê sī A-hô-a -lâng Tó-to ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat, i sī tè Tāi-pi̍t saⁿ ê ióng-sū ê chi̍t ê. Ū chi̍t piàn, Hui-lī-sū -lâng chū-chi̍p lâi kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thiat-thè, m̄-kú chit saⁿ ê ióng-sū tùi Hui-lī-sū -lâng chhiàng-siaⁿ.

Í-lī-a-sat khí-lâi phah Hui-lī-sū -lâng, phah kàu chhiú sng, chhiú liâm tī to-pìⁿ. Hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú hō͘ in tōa sèng-lī; kun-peng tò-tńg--lâi Í-lī-a-sat ê āu-bīn, kan-ta teh chhiúⁿ chiàn-lī-phín.
Tē-saⁿ ê sī Hap-la -lâng A-ki ê kiáⁿ Sa-má. Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Hui-lī-sū -lâng tī chi̍t khu âng-tāu-hn̂g chi̍p-ha̍p pâi-tīn; Í-sek-lia̍t kun-peng tô-cháu.
Sa-má khiā tī hn̂g-tiong hông-siú hit-khu hn̂g, phah Hui-lī-sū -lâng; Siōng Chú hō͘ i tōa sèng-lī.
Siu-koah ê sî, saⁿ-cha̍p ê siú-léng tiong ū saⁿ ê lo̍h-khì A-tō͘-lân-tōng kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t. Hui-lī-sū ê kun-tūi tī Lī-hoa̍t-im Soaⁿ-kok chat-iâⁿ.
Hit-sî, Tāi-pi̍t tī iàu-sài; Hui-lī-sū ê kun-tūi chū-chāi tī Pek-lī-hêng.
Tāi-pi̍t ēng chin khat-bō͘ ê kháu-khì kóng, “Nā ū lâng ōe-tàng khì the̍h Pek-lī-hêng siâⁿ-mn̂g piⁿ ê chíⁿ-chúi hō͘ góa lim, m̄-chai jōa-á-ni̍h hó!”

Chit saⁿ ê ióng-sū chiū chhiong-kè Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê iâⁿ-tōe, tùi Pek-lī-hêng siâⁿ-mn̂g piⁿ ê chíⁿ chhiūⁿ-chúi, kōaⁿ-lâi hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t. M̄-kú Tāi-pi̍t m̄ lim, tò chhut-lâi hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú,

kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, góa ná thang lim chit-ê chúi? Che kiám m̄-sī chiah-ê ēng sìⁿ-miā khì ōaⁿ--lâi ê lâng ê huih?” Só͘-í Tāi-pi̍t m̄ lim. Che sī chit saⁿ ê ióng-sū chòe ê tāi-chì.
Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Iok-ap ê sió-tī A-pí-su sī lēng-gōa saⁿ ê ióng-sū ê siú-léng; i bat gia̍h chhiuⁿ thâi-sí saⁿ-pah ê lâng, chiū tī saⁿ ê ióng-sū tiong ū-miâ.
I sī saⁿ ê ióng-sū tiong tē-it chhut-miâ--ê, só͘-í chòe in ê léng-siù; m̄-kú i iáu put-ki̍p chêng hit saⁿ ê ióng-sū.

Koh ū Kah-sih -lâng Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá; i sī ióng-sū, ū chòe chin chōe tōa-sū: I bat thâi-sí Mô͘-ap nn̄g ê kiông-béng ê ióng-sū; koh tī lo̍h-seh ê sî, lo̍h-khì khiⁿ-lāi thâi-sí chi̍t chiah sai;

koh thâi-sí chi̍t ê koân-tōa ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng. Hit-ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng chhiú gia̍h chhiuⁿ, Pí-ná-ngá chí-ū gia̍h kùn lo̍h-khì i hia, chhiúⁿ i ê chhiuⁿ, ēng hit-ki chhiuⁿ kā i thâi-sí.
Che sī Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá só͘ chòe ê sū, chiū tī saⁿ ê ióng-sū tiong ū-miâ.
I pí saⁿ-cha̍p ê ióng-sū khah ū bêng-bōng, m̄-kú put-ki̍p chêng hit saⁿ ê ióng-sū. Tāi-pi̍t ū siat-li̍p i chòe sī-ōe-tiúⁿ.
Saⁿ-cha̍p ê ióng-sū tiong ū: Iok-ap ê sió-tī A-sat-hek Pek-lī-hêng -lâng Tó-to ê kiáⁿ I-le̍k-hap-lân
Hap-lu̍t -lâng Sa-má kap Í-lī-ka
Phà-le̍k-thê -lâng Hi-lī-su Thê-ko-a -lâng Ek-kiat ê kiáⁿ Í-la
A-ná-tu̍t -lâng A-pí-í-siā Hō͘-sa -lâng Bí-pún-nái
A-hô-a -lâng Sat-bûn Nî-tô-hoat -lâng Má-hap-lâi
Nî-tô-hoat -lâng Pa-ná ê kiáⁿ Hi-li̍p Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k Ki-pí-a -lâng Lī-pài ê kiáⁿ Í-thài
Pí-la-tùn -lâng Pí-ná-ngá Ka-si̍t-khoe -lâng Hi-thài
A-la-pa -lâng A-pí A-pún Pa-ló͘-bí -lâng A-su-má-ui
Sa-pún -lâng Í-lī-ngá-hap-pa Ngá-siān ê chi̍t ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan
Hap-la -lâng Sa-má kap Sa-la ê kiáⁿ A-hi-àm
Má-ka -lâng A-hap-pài ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-hoat-lia̍t Ki-lô -lâng A-hi-to-hut ê kiáⁿ Í-liân
Ka-bi̍t -lâng Hi-su-lô A-pa -lâng Phà-lâi
Só-pa -lâng Ná-tan ê kiáⁿ Í-kah Ka-tek -lâng Pa-nî
A-bûn -lâng Sé-le̍k kā Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap gia̍h kun-khì ê Pí-lio̍k -lâng Ná-hap-lâi
Í-thiap -lâng Í-la kap Ka-li̍p
Hek -lâng O͘-lī-a kiōng saⁿ-cha̍p-chhit lâng.
Siōng Chú koh tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siū-khì, kek-tōng Tāi-pi̍t lâi tùi-hù in, kóng, “Khì tiâu-cha Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi ê jîn-kháu.”
Ông hoan-hù i sin-piⁿ ê goân-sòe Iok-ap kóng, “Lí khì Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k-ê chi-cho̍k, tùi Tān kàu Pia̍t-sī-pa, tiám-sǹg jîn-kháu, hō͘ góa chai choân-kok jîn-bîn ê sò͘-bo̍k.”

Iok-ap tùi ông kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè hō͘ choân-kok jîn-bîn cheng-ka pah-pē, koh hō͘ góa ê chú góa ê ông chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--kìⁿ; m̄-kú góa ê chú góa ê ông sī-án-chóaⁿ ài-beh chòe chit-ê tāi-chì?”
