Ông kian-chhî i ê bēng-lēng. Iok-ap kap hiah-ê kun-tiúⁿ chiū hōng-bēng chhut--khì, tiám-sǹg Í-sek-lia̍t ê jîn-kháu.
In kè Iok-tàn-hô, tī Ka-tek Soaⁿ-kok tiong A-lô-ní -siâⁿ ê lâm-pêng chat-iâⁿ, tùi hia khì Ngá-siā;
keng-kè Ki-lia̍t, kàu Tha-thêng Ha̍p-sī tōe-khu, koh kàu Tān Ngá-an, se̍h kàu Se-tùn;
koh kàu Thài-ní kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, kap só͘-ū Hi-bī -lâng í-ki̍p Ka-lâm -lâng ê siâⁿ; chòe-āu kàu Iû-tāi lâm-pêng ê Pia̍t-sī-pa.
In kiâⁿ-thàu choân-kok, keng-kè káu kò-ge̍h koh jī-cha̍p ji̍t, tò-tńg-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Iok-ap chiong tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ pò-kò hō͘ ông chai. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng gia̍h-to ê chiàn-sū ū poeh-cha̍p-bān, Iû-tāi -lâng ū gō͘-cha̍p-bān.

Tāi-pi̍t tiám-sǹg jîn-bîn ê sò͘-bo̍k liáu-āu, sim-lāi chū-chek. Tāi-pi̍t tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa chòe chit-ê tāi-chì hoān chin tōa ê chōe. Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí tû-khì lí lô͘-po̍k ê chōe, in-ūi góa án-ni chòe chin gōng.”
Tāi-pi̍t thàu-chá khí--lâi, Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Tāi-pi̍t ê sian-kiàn Ka-tek sian-ti, kóng,
“Lí khì kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa ēng saⁿ hāng chai-hō hō͘ lí kéng chi̍t hāng, góa chiū chiàu án-ni chòe.’”

Ka-tek lâi kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí ài lí ê kok ki-hng chhit nî? Á-sī hō͘ lí ê tùi-te̍k tui-sat saⁿ kò-ge̍h? Á-sī ài lí ê kok ū un-e̍k saⁿ ji̍t kú? Lí tio̍h chim-chiok siūⁿ, hō͘ góa thang hôe-ho̍k chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi.”

Tāi-pi̍t kā Ka-tek kóng, “Góa chin ûi-lân, m̄-kú lán lêng-khó hō͘ Siōng Chú ka-kī kā lán hêng-hoa̍t, in-ūi I ū hong-sēng ê lîn-bín; góa m̄-goān hām-lo̍h tī lâng ê chhiú.”
Siōng Chú chiū kàng un-e̍k tī Í-sek-lia̍t, tùi Tān kàu Pia̍t-sī-pa, tùi chheng-chá kàu ū-tēng ê sî, jîn-bîn chóng-kiōng sí chhit-bān lâng.

Tng thiⁿ-sài chhun-chhiú beh bia̍t Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sî, Siōng Chú kái-piàn sim-ì, bô beh kè-sio̍k kàng chit-ê chai-hō, chiū kā teh chip-hêng húi-bia̍t ê thiⁿ-sài kóng, “Thêng-chhiú! Kàu-gia̍h lah!” Hit-sî, Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tú tī Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng A-lô-ná ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ.

Tāi-pi̍t khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sat-hāi jîn-bîn ê thiⁿ-sài, chiū tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, góa ū hoān-chōe, pōe-ge̍k--ê sī góa; m̄-kú chiah-ê bû-ko͘ ê jîn-bîn ū chòe sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h? Kiû lí ê chhiú hêng-hoa̍t góa kap góa ê ka-cho̍k.”
Kâng hit-ji̍t, Ka-tek lâi kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, tùi i kóng, “Lí khì Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng A-lô-ná ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ, tī hia ūi Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū chiàu Siōng Chú hoan-hù Ka-tek ê ōe chiūⁿ--khì.
A-lô-ná khòaⁿ-tio̍h tùi-bīn ū ông kap i ê jîn-sîn teh lâi, chiū chhut--khì, phak tī thô͘-kha pài ông.

A-lô-ná kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông lâi po̍k-jîn chia ū sím-mi̍h kùi-sū?” Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa lâi sī beh bóe lí chit-ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ, ūi Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, hō͘ choân-kok ê un-e̍k thêng-chí.”

A-lô-ná tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông, chiàu lí só͘ khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê lóng the̍h-khì hiàn. Chia ū gû, thang chòe sio-hòa-chè, ū phah ngó͘-kok ê khì-khū kap gû-taⁿ thang chòe chhâ sio.
Ông ah, A-lô-ná chiong chiah-ê lóng sàng hō͘ ông.” A-lô-ná koh tùi ông kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè chiap-la̍p lí.”

Ông tùi A-lô-ná kóng, “M̄-thang, góa beh chiàu kè-chîⁿ kā lí bóe. Góa bô ài ēng pe̍h-pe̍h tit--tio̍h ê mi̍h chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè.” Tāi-pi̍t chiū ēng gō͘-pah chhit-cha̍p kong-khek ê gûn bóe hit-ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ kap gû.

Tāi-pi̍t tī hia ūi Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè. Án-ni, Siōng Chú thiaⁿ in ūi-tio̍h choân-kok ê kî-tó, un-e̍k chiū tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong thêng-chí.
Tāi-pi̍t -ông nî-lāu hè-sò͘ chōe, kah-phē mā kah bōe sio.

I ê jîn-sîn tùi i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ goán ê chú goán ê ông chún goán chhē chi̍t ê siàu-liân ê chāi-sek-lú, lâi hōng-thāi chiàu-kò͘ lí, khùn tī lí ê seng-khu piⁿ, hō͘ goán ê chú goán ê ông tit-tio̍h un-loán.”
In chiū tī Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kok chhē súi ê cha-bó͘ gín-á; chhē-tio̍h Su-liām chi̍t ê lú-chú, kiò-chòe Ngá-pí-sa, chhōa-lâi ông hia.
Chit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á chin súi; i hōng-thāi sū-hāu ông, m̄-kú ông bô kap i tâng-pâng.

Hit-sî, Tāi-pi̍t kap Hap-ki̍p siⁿ ê kiáⁿ A-to-nî-ngá siūⁿ-beh choh-tōa, kóng, “Góa beh choh-ông.” I ūi ka-kī chún-pī chiàn-chhia kap bé-peng, koh ū gō͘-cha̍p ê peng tī i thâu-chêng khui-lō͘.
I ê lāu-pē m̄-bat kā i chek-pī kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ án-ni chòe?” I tī Ap-sa-liông bé-āu chhut-sì, siⁿ-chòe put-chí eng-chùn.
A-to-nî-ngá kap Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap, koh kap chè-si A-pí-a-tha chham-siông, in chiū chi-chhî i.
M̄-kú chè-si Sat-tok, kap Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá, sian-ti Ná-tan, kap Sī-múi, Lī-í, kap Tāi-pi̍t ê ióng-sū, lóng bô ióng-hō͘ A-to-nî-ngá.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t, A-to-nî-ngá tī Ún Lô-kiat hù-kūn ê Só-hi-lia̍t chio̍h-pôaⁿ hia, thâi gû, iûⁿ, kap pûi ê cheng-siⁿ hiàn-chè, mā chhiáⁿ i ê chèng hiaⁿ-tī, chiū-sī ông ê kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p Iû-tāi só͘-ū ông ê jîn-sîn.
M̄-kú i bô chhiáⁿ sian-ti Ná-tan, Pí-ná-ngá, kap ióng-sū, í-ki̍p i ê sió-tī Só͘-lô-bûn.
Ná-tan kā Só͘-lô-bûn ê lāu-bú Poa̍t-sī-pa kóng, “ Hap-ki̍p ê kiáⁿ A-to-nî-ngá choh-ông lah, lí kiám bô thiaⁿ--tio̍h? Lán ê chú Tāi-pi̍t mā m̄ chai.
Taⁿ lí lâi, góa thòe lí phah-sǹg, thang pó-choân lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê sìⁿ-miā.

Lí ji̍p-khì kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t -ông, tùi i kóng, ‘Góa ê chú góa ê ông ah, lí kiám m̄-sī bat tùi lí ê lú-pī chiù-chōa kóng, góa ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn beh sòa-chiap lí choh-ông, beh chē lí ê ūi? Sī-án-chóaⁿ A-to-nî-ngá teh choh-ông?’
Lí tī hia kap ông kóng-ōe ê sî, góa ōe tè lí ê āu-bīn ji̍p--khì, lâi chèng-si̍t lí ê ōe.”
Poa̍t-sī-pa ji̍p-khì pâng-keng kìⁿ ông; ông chin lāu, Su-liām ê lú-chú Ngá-pí-sa teh kā i sū-hāu.
Poa̍t-sī-pa kiok-kiong pài ông; ông kóng, “Lí ài sím-mi̍h?”

I kā ông kóng, “Góa ê chú ah, lí bat kí Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè tùi lí ê lú-pī chiù-chōa kóng, ‘Lí ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn beh sòa-chiap góa choh-ông, i beh chē góa ê ūi.’
Taⁿ A-to-nî-ngá í-keng chū-chheng choh-ông, góa ê chú góa ê ông lí iáu m̄ chai.
I ū thâi chin chōe chiah gû, iûⁿ, kap pûi ê cheng-siⁿ hiàn-chè, koh chhiáⁿ ông ê chèng-kiáⁿ, chè-si A-pí-a-tha, kap goân-sòe Iok-ap; m̄-kú i bô chhiáⁿ lí ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn.
Góa ê chú góa ê ông ah, Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ê ba̍k-chiu lóng teh khòaⁿ lí, teh thèng-hāu lí kā in soan-pò͘, sím-mi̍h-lâng beh sòa-chiap góa ê chú góa ê ông chē ông-ūi.
Nā bô, góa ê chú góa ê ông tńg-khì lí ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia liáu-āu, góa kap góa ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn it-tēng ōe hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe poān-tô͘.”
Poa̍t-sī-pa iáu-teh kap ông kóng-ōe ê sî, sian-ti Ná-tan ji̍p--lâi.
Ū lâng kā ông pò-kò, “Sian-ti Ná-tan tī chia.” Ná-tan kàu ông ê bīn-chêng, phak tī thô͘-kha pài ông.
Ná-tan kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông, lí kiám bat kóng ‘ A-to-nî-ngá beh sòa-chiap góa choh-ông, beh chē góa ê ūi’?

I kin-á-ji̍t lo̍h--khì, thâi chin chōe gû, iûⁿ, kap pûi ê cheng-siⁿ hiàn-chè, koh chhiáⁿ ông ê chèng-kiáⁿ, kap chiah-ê kun-tiúⁿ, í-ki̍p chè-si A-pí-a-tha. In kap A-to-nî-ngá chòe-hé lim-chia̍h, kóng, ‘ A-to-nî-ngá -ông bān-sòe!’
M̄-kú i bô chhiáⁿ góa, mā bô chhiáⁿ chè-si Sat-tok, kap Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá, í-ki̍p ông ê po̍k-jîn Só͘-lô-bûn.
Che kiám sī góa ê chú góa ê ông ê ì-sù? Ông lí iáu m̄-bat tùi lí ê chèng jîn-sîn soan-pò͘, sím-mi̍h-lâng beh sòa-chiap góa ê chú góa ê ông chē lí ê ūi.”
Tāi-pi̍t -ông ìn kóng, “Kā góa kiò Poa̍t-sī-pa lâi.” Poa̍t-sī-pa chiū ji̍p--lâi, tī ông ê bīn-chêng khiā--teh.
Ông chiù-chōa kóng, “Góa kí kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī it-chhè hoān-lān, éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú kóng,

‘Góa kì-jiân ū kí Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè tùi lí chiù-chōa, lí ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn beh sòa-chiap góa choh-ông chē góa ê ūi, góa kin-á-ji̍t it-tēng beh chiàu án-ni chòe.’”
Poa̍t-sī-pa chiū kiok-kiong phak lo̍h-khì pài ông, kóng, “Goān góa ê chú Tāi-pi̍t -ông bān-bān-sòe!”
Tāi-pi̍t -ông koh kóng, “Tiàu chè-si Sat-tok, sian-ti Ná-tan, kap Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá lâi.” In chiū lóng lâi ông ê bīn-chêng.
Ông kā in kóng, “Tio̍h chhōa kiong-têng ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kap lín khì, hō͘ góa ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn khiâ góa ê lô lo̍h-khì Ki-hùn.
Tī hia, chè-si Sat-tok kap sian-ti Ná-tan tio̍h ēng iû boah i chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông. Lín mā tio̍h pûn sàu-kak soan-pò͘, ‘ Só͘-lô-bûn -ông bān-sòe!’
Jiân-āu lín tè i chiūⁿ--lâi, hō͘ i lâi chē góa ê ūi, sòa-chiap góa choh-ông; góa soán-li̍p i thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi.”
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá ìn ông kóng, “Amen! Goān Siōng Chú — góa ê chú góa ê ông ê Siōng-tè mā án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú án-chóaⁿ kap góa ê chú góa ê ông tông-chāi, goān I mā án-ni kap Só͘-lô-bûn tông-chāi, koh hō͘ i ê ông-koân pí góa ê chú Tāi-pi̍t -ông ê ông-koân koh-khah úi-tāi.”

Chè-si Sat-tok, sian-ti Ná-tan, Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá, Ki-lī-thê -lâng kap Pí-lī-thê -lâng, chiū lóng lo̍h--khì, hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn khiâ Tāi-pi̍t -ông ê lô, sàng i kàu Ki-hùn.
Chè-si Sat-tok chiū tùi hōe-bō͘ the̍h tóe-iû ê kak, ēng iû boah Só͘-lô-bûn; in chiū pûn sàu-kak, jîn-bîn lóng hoah kóng, “ Só͘-lô-bûn -ông bān-sòe!”
Jîn-bîn tè i chiūⁿ--lâi, koh pûn phín-á, hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí, hoan-ho͘ ê siaⁿ tōa kah tōe kiông-beh li̍h--khui.

A-to-nî-ngá í-ki̍p kap i chòe-hé ê lâng-kheh tú-á chia̍h-toh soah, thiaⁿ-kìⁿ hoan-ho͘ ê siaⁿ. Iok-ap thiaⁿ-tio̍h sàu-kak ê siaⁿ chiū mn̄g, “Siâⁿ-lāi sī-án-chóaⁿ ū hōa-hōa-háu ê siaⁿ?”
I iáu-teh kóng ê sî, chè-si A-pí-a-tha ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan lâi. A-to-nî-ngá kā i kóng, “Ji̍p--lâi, lí sī tiong-si̍t ê lâng, it-tēng sī beh pò hó siau-sit.”
Iok-ná-tan ìn A-to-nî-ngá kóng, “Lán ê chú Tāi-pi̍t -ông í-keng siat-li̍p Só͘-lô-bûn choh-ông.

Ông phài chè-si Sat-tok, sian-ti Ná-tan, Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá, Ki-lī-thê -lâng kap Pí-lī-thê -lâng, kap Só͘-lô-bûn chòe-hé khì; in hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn khiâ ông ê lô.

Chè-si Sat-tok kap sian-ti Ná-tan, í-keng tī Ki-hùn kā i boah-iû hō͘ i choh-ông; in lóng tùi hia hō͘-sàng i ji̍p-siâⁿ, kui-siâⁿ tōa-siaⁿ hoan-ho͘; che chiū-sī lín só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê siaⁿ.
Koh Só͘-lô-bûn mā í-keng chē ông-ūi.

Ông ê jîn-sîn lóng lâi kā lán ê chú Tāi-pi̍t -ông chiok-hok, kóng, ‘Goān lí ê Siōng-tè hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn ê miâ pí lí ê miâ koh-khah chun-kùi, hō͘ i ê ông-koân pí lí ê ông-koân koh-khah úi-tāi.’ Ông tī chhn̂g--ni̍h àⁿ lo̍h-khì kèng-pài,
kî-tó kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè eng-kai siū chheng-chàn, in-ūi I ū siúⁿ-sù chi̍t ê lâng kin-á-ji̍t chē góa ê ūi, hō͘ góa chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h.’”
Só͘-ū kap A-to-nî-ngá chòe-hé ê lâng-kheh lóng kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, sûi-lâng tô-cháu.
A-to-nî-ngá in-ūi hui-siông kiaⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn, chiū khì khîⁿ chè-tôaⁿ ê kak.

Ū lâng kā Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “ A-to-nî-ngá kiaⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn -ông, khì khîⁿ tī chè-tôaⁿ ê kak, kóng, ‘Kiû Só͘-lô-bûn -ông kin-á-ji̍t tùi góa chiù-chōa, it-tēng bô beh ēng to thâi-sí i ê po̍k-jîn.’”
Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “I nā tùi góa chīn-tiong, liân chi̍t ki thâu-mn̂g mā bōe lak tī thô͘-kha; i nā choh-ok, it-tēng tio̍h sí.”

Só͘-lô-bûn -ông chiū chhe lâng tùi chè-tôaⁿ kā i chhōa--lo̍h-lâi, A-to-nî-ngá chiū lâi tī Só͘-lô-bûn -ông bīn-chêng kūi-pài. Só͘-lô-bûn kā i kóng, “Lí tò-khì lín tau.”
Tāi-pi̍t lîm-chiong ê sî, kau-tài i ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn kóng,
“Góa teh-beh kiâⁿ sè-kan-lâng lóng tio̍h kiâⁿ ê lō͘; lí tio̍h kian-kiông, chòe tāi-tiōng-hu.

Lí tio̍h chun-siú Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè só͘ hoan-hù--ê, kiâⁿ I ê tō-lō͘; chiàu Mô͘-se lu̍t-hoat só͘ kì-chài, chun-siú I ê kui-lē, kài-bēng, bēng-lēng, kap kà-sī. Án-ni, lí bô-lūn chòe sím-mi̍h, bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, lóng ōe heng-thong;

Siōng Chú mā ōe si̍t-hiān I tùi góa ê èng-ún, ‘Lí ê kiáⁿ-sun nā kín-sīn seng-oa̍h, chīn-sim chīn-ì chin-sêng tī góa ê bīn-chêng kiâⁿ-chòe, lí ê hō͘-tāi chiū ōe chē Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông-ūi éng bô tn̄g.’

“Lí mā chai Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi góa. I ū thâi-sí Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ Ap-nî-ní kap Ek-thiap ê kiáⁿ A-má-sat chit nn̄g ê Í-sek-lia̍t ê goân-sòe; i tī thài-pêng ê sî ēng kau-chiàn ê chhiú-tōaⁿ thâi-sí in, lâu in ê huih, hō͘ huih bak-tio̍h i ê io-tòa kap ôe.
Só͘-í lí eng-kai chai tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe, m̄-thang hō͘ i pe̍h-thâu-mn̂g an-jiân lo̍h Im-kan.

Lí tio̍h hó khoán-thāi Ki-lia̍t -lâng Pa-se-lâi hiah-ê kiáⁿ, hō͘ in siông-siông kap lí chòe-hé chia̍h; in-ūi góa tô-pī lí ê hiaⁿ-ko Ap-sa-liông ê sî, in ū hó khoán-thāi góa.

Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Pa-hō͘-lîm ê Piān-ngá-bín -lâng Ki-la ê kiáⁿ Sī-múi; góa khì Má-hap-liām ê sî, i ū ēng ok-to̍k ê ōe chiù-chó͘ góa. M̄-kú i āu-lâi ū lo̍h-khì Iok-tàn-hô gêng-chiap góa, góa chiū kí Siōng Chú tùi i chiù-chōa kóng, ‘Góa bô beh ēng to thâi lí.’
Taⁿ lí m̄-thang pàng i soah. Lí sī chhong-bêng ê lâng, eng-kai chai tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe; tio̍h kā i thâi-sí, hō͘ i ê pe̍h-thâu-mn̂g bak-tio̍h huih lo̍h Im-kan.”
Tāi-pi̍t tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia liáu-āu, an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ.
Tāi-pi̍t choh-ông thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t kiōng sì-cha̍p nî: tī Hi-pek-lûn chhit nî, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng saⁿ-cha̍p-saⁿ nî.
Só͘-lô-bûn chē i lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-ūi; i ê kok hui-siông ún-kò͘.
Hap-ki̍p ê kiáⁿ A-to-nî-ngá khì kìⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê lāu-bú Poa̍t-sī-pa; Poa̍t-sī-pa mn̄g i kóng, “Lí ū tòa pêng-an lâi bô?” A-to-nî-ngá ìn kóng, “Ū tòa pêng-an.”
Koh kóng, “Góa ū tāi-chì beh tùi lí chhéng-kiû.” Poa̍t-sī-pa kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kóng.”

A-to-nî-ngá kóng, “Lí chai chit-ê kok pún-lâi sī góa ê, Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng mā lóng ài góa choh-ông; m̄-kú kok soah kui hō͘ góa ê sió-tī, in-ūi che sī Siōng Chú ê ì-sù.
Taⁿ góa ū chi̍t kiāⁿ sū chhéng-kiû lí, ǹg-bāng lí m̄-thang kā góa the-sî.” Poa̍t-sī-pa kóng, “Sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?”
I kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí tùi Só͘-lô-bûn -ông kóng, chiong Su-liām ê lú-chú Ngá-pí-sa sù góa chòe bó͘, in-ūi ông it-tēng ōe thiaⁿ lí ê ōe.”
Poa̍t-sī-pa kóng, “Hó, góa thòe lí kā ông kóng.”

Poa̍t-sī-pa chiū khì kìⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn -ông, beh thòe A-to-nî-ngá chhéng-kiû. Ông khí-lâi gêng-chiap i, tùi i kiok-kiong; ông koh tò-tńg-khì chē i ka-kī ê ūi, hoan-hù lâng ūi i ê lāu-bú an-pâi chē-ūi. Poa̍t-sī-pa chiū chē tī ông ê chiàⁿ-pêng,
kóng, “Góa ū chi̍t kiāⁿ sió-sū beh chhéng-kiû lí, chhiáⁿ m̄-thang kā góa the-sî.” Ông kā i kóng, “A-bú, chhiáⁿ lí kóng; góa bōe kā lí the-sî.”
I kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chiong Su-liām ê lú-chú Ngá-pí-sa hō͘ lí ê hiaⁿ-ko A-to-nî-ngá chòe bó͘.”

Só͘-lô-bûn -ông ìn i ê lāu-bú kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ thòe A-to-nî-ngá kiû Su-liām ê lú-chú Ngá-pí-sa? I sī góa ê hiaⁿ-ko, lí kui-khì thòe i kiû ông-ūi; i koh ū chè-si A-pí-a-tha, kap Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap teh kā ióng-hō͘.”
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông chiū kí Siōng Chú chiù-chōa kóng, “ A-to-nî-ngá kóng chiah-ê ōe, góa nā bô hō͘ i sí, goān Siōng-tè ka-pē chek-hoa̍t góa.

Siōng Chú soán-li̍p góa, hō͘ góa chē góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-ūi, chiàu I ê èng-ún kiàn-li̍p góa ê ke; góa kí chit-ūi éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, A-to-nî-ngá kin-á-ji̍t it-tēng tio̍h sí.”
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông chiū phài Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá khì kā A-to-nî-ngá thâi-sí.

Ông kā chè-si A-pí-a-tha kóng, “Lí tio̍h tò-khì A-ná-tu̍t lí ê ka-hiong. Lí eng-kai tio̍h sí, m̄-kú góa kin-á-ji̍t bô beh thâi lí, in-ūi lí bat tī góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê bīn-chêng kng Chì-koân Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi, koh kap góa ê lāu-pē tâng siū hoān-lān.”
Só͘-lô-bûn chiū pak A-pí-a-tha ê chit-ūi, put-chún i chòe Siōng Chú ê chè-si; án-ni chiū èng-giām Siōng Chú tī Sī-lô só͘ kóng iú-koan Í-lī ê ke ê ōe.

Chit-ê siau-sit thoân kàu Iok-ap, Iok-ap chiū tô-cháu, ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú ê hōe-bō͘, khîⁿ tī chè-tôaⁿ ê kak; in-ūi Iok-ap sui-jiân bô tè Ap-sa-liông, m̄-kú ū ióng-hō͘ A-to-nî-ngá.

Ū lâng kā Só͘-lô-bûn -ông pò-kò, Iok-ap cháu-khì Siōng Chú ê hōe-bō͘, khîⁿ tī chè-tôaⁿ ê kak; Só͘-lô-bûn chiū phài Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá beh khì kā i thâi-sí.

Pí-ná-ngá kàu Siōng Chú ê hōe-bō͘, kā Iok-ap kóng, “Ông kiò lí chhut--lâi.” Iok-ap ìn kóng, “M̄, góa beh sí tī chia.” Pí-ná-ngá khì kā ông hôe-ho̍k kóng, “ Iok-ap án-ni kóng, án-ni ìn góa.”
Ông kā i kóng, “Lí thang chiàu i ê ōe kā i thâi-sí, koh kā i bâi-chòng, hō͘ Iok-ap lâu bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih hit-ê chōe bô kui tī góa kap góa ê lāu-pē ê ke.

Siōng Chú beh hō͘ i ka-kī taⁿ bô͘-sat lâng ê chōe, in-ūi i bô hō͘ góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t chai, chiū khì thâi-sí pí i khah hó khah chèng-ti̍t ê nn̄g ê lâng, Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t ê goân-sòe Ap-nî-ní, kap Ek-thiap ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi ê goân-sòe A-má-sat.

Goān Iok-ap bô͘-sat lâng ê chōe éng-oán kui tī i kap i ê hō͘-tāi; m̄-kú Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê hō͘-tāi, i ê ke, í-ki̍p i ê ūi, beh éng-oán tùi Siōng Chú tit-tio̍h pêng-an hoân-êng.”
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá chiū chiūⁿ--khì, thâi-sí Iok-ap; lâng kā i bâi-chòng tī khòng-iá hù-kūn i ka-kī ê chhù.
Ông chiū siat-li̍p Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá tāi-thòe Iok-ap chòe goân-sòe; koh siat-li̍p chè-si Sat-tok tāi-thòe A-pí-a-tha.
Ông phài lâng kiò Sī-múi lâi, kā i kóng, “Lí tio̍h tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khí chhù, tòa tī hia, bōe-ēng-tit chhut-khì pa̍t-ūi.
Lí tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, lí kè Khip-lûn Khoe-kok hit-ji̍t it-tēng tio̍h sí, che sī lí ka-kī chòe-tit-lâi--ê.”
Sī-múi ìn ông kóng, “Án-ni hó. Góa ê chú góa ê ông só͘ kóng--ê, lí ê po̍k-jîn chun-bēng.” Sī-múi chiū tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chin kú.
Kè saⁿ nî, Sī-múi nn̄g ê lô͘-lē tô-cháu khì Má-ka ê kiáⁿ Ka-te̍k -ông A-kiat hia. Ū lâng kā Sī-múi kóng, “Lí ê lô͘-lē thau-cháu khì Ka-te̍k.”
Sī-múi chiū chún-pī lû, khì Ka-te̍k -ông A-kiat hia, chhē i ê lô͘-lē. Sī-múi khì Ka-te̍k chhōa i ê lô͘-lē tò--lâi.
Ū lâng kā Só͘-lô-bûn pò-kò, kóng, “ Sī-múi chhut Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khì Ka-te̍k koh tò-tńg--lâi.”

Ông chiū phài lâng kiò Sī-múi lâi, tùi i kóng, “Góa kiám m̄-sī kiò lí kí Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, koh kéng-kài lí kóng, ‘Lí tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, lí lī-khui Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hit-ji̍t it-tēng tio̍h sí.’ Lí ìn góa kóng, ‘Án-ni hó, chun-bēng.’
Taⁿ lí sī-án-chóaⁿ bô chun-siú tùi Siōng Chú só͘ chiù ê chōa, í-ki̍p góa kéng-kài lí ê bēng-lēng?”
Ông koh kā Sī-múi kóng, “Lí chin chheng-chhó, lí tùi góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t só͘ chòe it-chhè ê pháiⁿ, Siōng Chú beh in-ūi lí ê pháiⁿ kā lí hêng-hoa̍t.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú beh chiok-hok góa, koh Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-ūi ōe éng-oán ún-kò͘.”
Ông hā-lēng, Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá chiū chhut--khì, thâi-sí Sī-múi. Tùi án-ni Só͘-lô-bûn ê ông-kok chiū chin ún-kò͘.

Só͘-lô-bûn kap Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló kiat-chhin, chhōa Hoat-ló ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chòe bó͘; tī i ka-kī ê kiong-tiān, Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sì-ûi ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ iáu-bē khí-hó í-chêng, i hō͘ Hoat-ló ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tòa tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ.
Tng-sî iáu-bē ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê miâ khí sèng-tiān, só͘-í jîn-bîn iáu tī soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ hiàn-chè.
Só͘-lô-bûn thiàⁿ Siōng Chú, chun-hêng i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê bēng-lēng, m̄-kú iáu tī soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ hiàn-chè sio-hiuⁿ.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông khì Ki-piàn hiàn-chè, in-ūi hia ū siōng-tōa ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ; i tī tôaⁿ-téng hiàn chi̍t-chheng chiah cheng-siⁿ chòe sio-hòa-chè.
Tī Ki-piàn, ū chi̍t mî Siōng Chú tī bîn-bāng tiong tùi Só͘-lô-bûn hián-hiān; Siōng-tè kóng, “Lí ài góa sù lí sím-mi̍h, thang tùi góa kiû.”

Só͘-lô-bûn ìn kóng, “Lí bat si tōa-un hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn, góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t, in-ūi i ēng sêng-si̍t, kong-gī, chèng-ti̍t ê sim tī lí ê bīn-chêng seng-oa̍h. Lí koh siúⁿ-sù i put-piàn ê thiàⁿ, chiū-sī siúⁿ-sù i chi̍t ê kiáⁿ chē i ê ūi, tú chhin-chhiūⁿ kin-á-ji̍t án-ni.
Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè, taⁿ lí hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn sòa-chiap góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t choh-ông; m̄-kú góa iáu siàu-liân, m̄ chai tio̍h án-chóaⁿ tī-lí kok-ka.
Lí ê po̍k-jîn tòa tī lí só͘ kéng-soán ê chú-bîn tiong-kan, chiah-ê jîn-bîn chōe kàu bōe-sǹg--tit, mā sǹg bōe liáu.
Só͘-í, kiû lí sù lí ê po̍k-jîn bêng-piān ê sim, thang phòaⁿ-toàn sī-hui tī-lí lí ê chú-bîn; nā m̄-sī án-ni, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng tī-lí lí chiah chōe ê jîn-bîn?”
Chú chin hoaⁿ-hí Só͘-lô-bûn án-ni kiû.

Siōng-tè tùi i kóng, “Lí kì-jiân án-ni kiû, bô ūi ka-kī kiû tn̂g-hè-siū, bô kiû hó-gia̍h, mā bô kiû siau-bia̍t lí tùi-te̍k ê sìⁿ-miā, chí-ū kiû bêng-piān ê sim, ōe-hiáu hun-pia̍t sī-hui kong-chèng tī-lí.
Taⁿ, góa chiàu lí só͘ kiû--ê hō͘ lí. Góa siúⁿ-sù lí chhong-bêng tì-hūi ê sim; tī lí í-chêng bô lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ lí, tī lí í-āu mā bô lâng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lí.
Lí bô kiû--ê, góa mā beh hō͘ lí, chiū-sī hù-chiok, chun-êng; hō͘ lí tī sè-kan ê ji̍t-chí, bô chi̍t ê ông ōe-tàng kap lí pí.
Lí nā kiâⁿ góa ê tō-lō͘, chun-siú góa ê kui-lē kap kài-bēng, o̍h lí ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê só͘-chòe, góa chiū beh hō͘ lí tn̂g-hè-siū.”

Só͘-lô-bûn khùn-chhíⁿ, chai sī Siōng Chú tī bîn-bāng tiong tùi i kóng-ōe, chiū khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khiā tī Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi chêng, hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè; koh pān iàn-se̍k chhiáⁿ i ê jîn-sîn.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, nn̄g ê ki-lú lâi ông hia, khiā tī ông ê bīn-chêng.
Chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Góa ê chú ah, góa kap chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng tòa kâng keng chhù; góa siⁿ-kiáⁿ ê sî, i mā tī chhù-lāi.
Góa siⁿ liáu tē-saⁿ ji̍t, chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng mā siⁿ-kiáⁿ; goán nn̄g lâng í-gōa, bô pa̍t-lâng kap goán chòe-hé tòa.
Mî--sî, chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng teh khùn ê sî kā i ê kiáⁿ teh--sí.
I pòaⁿ-mî khí--lâi, thàn lí ê lú-pī teh khùn, tùi góa ê sin-piⁿ kā góa ê hāu-siⁿ phō-khì hē tī i ê heng-chêng, chiong i sí--khì ê hāu-siⁿ hē tī góa ê heng-chêng.
Thiⁿ kng, góa khí-lâi beh hō͘ góa ê hāu-siⁿ chia̍h-lin; bô phah-sǹg, gín-á í-keng sí; góa siông-sè khòaⁿ, hoat-kiàn m̄-sī góa siⁿ ê kiáⁿ.”

Lēng-gōa hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “M̄-sī, oa̍h--ê sī góa ê kiáⁿ, sí--ê chiah sī lí ê.” Tē-it ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Bô, sí--ê sī lí ê kiáⁿ, oa̍h--ê sī góa ê.” In tī ông ê bīn-chêng án-ni saⁿ-chìⁿ.
Ông kóng, “Chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng, ‘Oa̍h ê kiáⁿ sī góa ê, sí--ê sī lí ê.’ Hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng, ‘Bô, sí ê kiáⁿ sī lí ê, oa̍h--ê sī góa ê.’”
Ông koh kóng, “Kā góa gia̍h to lâi.” Sī-ōe chiū gia̍h to lâi ông ê bīn-chêng.
Ông kóng, “Chiong oa̍h ê gín-á phòa chòe nn̄g pêng, chi̍t pêng hō͘ hit-ê, chi̍t pêng hō͘ chit-ê.”

Oa̍h ê gín-á ê lāu-bú ūi-tio̍h thiàⁿ ka-kī ê kiáⁿ, sim chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh to̍h, chiū tùi ông kóng, “Góa ê chú ah, chiong oa̍h ê gín-á hō͘ hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng, chhian-bān m̄-thang kā i thâi-sí.” Lēng-gōa hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Kā i phòa-khui! Chit-ê gín-á m̄-bián hō͘ i, mā m̄-bián hō͘ góa.”
Ông chiū hā-lēng, “M̄-thang thâi! Chiong oa̍h ê gín-á hō͘ tē-it ê hū-jîn-lâng, in-ūi i chiah sī gín-á ê lāu-bú.”
Choân Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn thiaⁿ-tio̍h ông ê phòaⁿ-koat, chiū lóng kèng-ùi i, in-ūi in khòaⁿ-kìⁿ i phòaⁿ-toàn ê sî ū tùi Siōng-tè lâi ê tì-hūi.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông chòe choân Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông.
I ê jîn-sîn kì tī ē-bīn: Sat-tok ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá chòe chè-si;
Sī-sa nn̄g ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-hô-lia̍t kap A-hi-ngá chòe su-kì; A-hi-lu̍t ê kiáⁿ Iok-sa-hoat chòe sú-koaⁿ;
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá chòe goân-sòe; Sat-tok kap A-pí-a-tha chòe chè-si;
Ná-tan ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá chòe chóng-tok-tiúⁿ; Ná-tan ê kiáⁿ Sat-pò͘-tek chòe chè-si, kap ông ê kò͘-būn;
A-hi-soah chòe kiong-têng chóng-koán; Ap-tāi ê kiáⁿ A-to-nî-lân chòe kiông-chè-lô-kang ê kam-tok.
Só͘-lô-bûn tī Í-sek-lia̍t choân-tōe siat-li̍p cha̍p-jī ê chóng-tok, ūi-tio̍h ông kap ông ê ka-cho̍k pī-pān chia̍h-mi̍h, múi-nî ta̍k-ê lâng kiong-kip chi̍t kò-ge̍h.
In ê miâ kì tī ē-bīn: Piān Hō͘-ní tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu;
Piān Tí-kah tī Má-ka-su, Sa-pin, Pek Sī-be̍k, Í-lûn Pek Hap-lâm;
Piān Hi-sek tī A-ló͘-po̍k, mā koán-lí So-ko kap Hi-hut choân-tōe;
Piān A-pí-ná-ta̍t tī To-ní ê choân soaⁿ-tōe; i chhōa Só͘-lô-bûn ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Tha-hoat chòe bó͘;
A-hi-lu̍t ê kiáⁿ Pa-ná tī Tha-la̍p, Bí-kiat-to, kap óa-kūn Sat-la-tàn, Iâ-su-lia̍t ē-pêng ê Pek Siān choân-tōe, tùi Pek Siān kàu A-pek Bí-hô-la, kàu Iok-bián hit-pêng;

Piān Ki-pia̍t tī Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t -siâⁿ, i mā tī Ki-lia̍t ê Má-ná-se kiáⁿ-sun Gâi-ní hiah-ê siâⁿ, Pa-san ê A-ní-ko-pek -tōe ê tōa-siâⁿ, kiōng la̍k-cha̍p chō siâⁿ, lóng ū siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ kap tâng ê mn̂g-chhòaⁿ;
E̍k-to ê kiáⁿ A-hi-ná-ta̍t tī Má-hap-liām;
A-hi-má-su tī Ná-hut-tha-lī; i chhōa Só͘-lô-bûn lēng-gōa chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Pa-si̍t-boat chòe bó͘;
Hō͘-su ê kiáⁿ Pa-ná tī A-siat kap Pí-a-lio̍k;
Phà-lō͘-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-sa-hoat tī Í-sat-ka;
Í-la ê kiáⁿ Sī-múi tī Piān-ngá-bín;
O͘-lī ê kiáⁿ Ki-pia̍t tī Ki-lia̍t -tōe; chiū-sī í-chêng A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông kap Pa-san -ông Go̍k ê tōe. Lēng-gōa ū chi̍t ê chóng-tok-tiúⁿ koán-lí só͘-ū ê tōe-khu.
Iû-tāi kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê jîn-kháu chōe kah chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-piⁿ ê soa; in niû-si̍t chhiong-chiok, mā chin khoài-lo̍k.
Só͘-lô-bûn koán-hat tùi Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô kàu Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tōe, ti̍t-kàu Ai-ki̍p pian-kài hiah-ê kok; Só͘-lô-bûn chāi-siⁿ ê ji̍t, in lóng chìn-kòng kui-sūn i.
Só͘-lô-bûn ta̍k-ji̍t su-iàu ê niû-si̍t: Iù mī-hún gō͘-chheng kong-seng, chho͘ mī-hún chi̍t-bān kong-seng;
gû-tiâu lāi chhī ê pûi-gû cha̍p chiah, chháu-po͘ ê gû jī-cha̍p chiah, iûⁿ chi̍t-pah chiah, iáu ū lo̍k, lêng-iûⁿ, chhiah-lo̍k, kap pûi ê khîm-chiáu.
I thóng-tī Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô sai-pêng só͘-ū tōe-khu, chiū-sī tùi Thê-hut-sat kàu Ka-sat chiah-ê ông-kok; i só͘ koán-hat ê choân-tōe lóng hióng-siū thài-pêng.
Só͘-lô-bûn oa̍h--teh ê ji̍t, tùi Tān kàu Pia̍t-sī-pa ê Iû-tāi -lâng kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, lóng tī in ê phû-tô-chhiū kap bû-hoa-kó-chhiū kha an-jiân khiā-khí.
Só͘-lô-bûn ū sì-bān keng thoa chiàn-chhia ê bé ê bé-tiâu, koh ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng ê bé-peng.
Hiah-ê chóng-tok, ta̍k-ê chiàu in hū-chek ê ge̍h-hūn, ūi-tio̍h Só͘-lô-bûn -ông kap ông-kiong lāi ê lâng chún-pī chia̍h-mi̍h, liân chi̍t hāng to bô khiàm.
In koh chiàu in ê chit-chek, ūi-tio̍h chiàn-bé kap kî-tha iōng-tô͘ ê bé ūn-sàng tōa-be̍h kap chháu-liāu khì su-iàu ê só͘-chāi.
Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù Só͘-lô-bûn ke̍k-tōa ê tì-hūi chhong-bêng, hō͘ i ê lí-kái-le̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-piⁿ ê soa bōe-niû--tit.
Só͘-lô-bûn ê tì-hūi chhiau-kè só͘-ū tang-hng-lâng ê tì-hūi kap Ai-ki̍p -lâng it-chhè ê tì-hūi.
I ê tì-hūi iâⁿ-kè só͘-ū ê lâng, iâⁿ-kè Í-su-la -lâng Í-thàm, kap Má-hat ê kiáⁿ Hi-bān, Kah-kok, Ta̍t-tāi; i ê miâ-siaⁿ thoân kàu sì-ûi ta̍k-kok.
I chòe chim-giân saⁿ-chheng kù, si-koa chi̍t-chheng khòng gō͘ siú.
I káng-lūn chháu-ba̍k, tùi Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū kàu chhiûⁿ-á-téng hoat--khí-lâi ê gû-chhek-chháu; mā káng-lūn cháu-siù, pe-chiáu, thâng-thōa, hî-lūi.
Lia̍t-kok ê ông thiaⁿ-tio̍h Só͘-lô-bûn -ông ê tì-hūi, chiū lóng phài lâng khì thiaⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn tì-hūi ê ōe.
Thài-ní -ông Hi-lân thiaⁿ-tio̍h Só͘-lô-bûn sòa-chiap i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t, siū soán-li̍p choh-ông, chiū phài jîn-sîn khì kìⁿ i; Hi-lân it-ti̍t sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hó pêng-iú.
Só͘-lô-bûn mā phài lâng khì kìⁿ Hi-lân, kóng,

“Lí chai góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t bōe-tàng ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè ê miâ khí sèng-tiān, in-ūi i kap sì-ûi ê tùi-te̍k kau-chiàn, tio̍h tán kàu Siōng Chú hō͘ in lóng hâng-ho̍k.
Taⁿ Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè í-keng sù góa thian-hā thài-pêng, bô tùi-te̍k, bô chai-hō.

Só͘-í, góa beh ūi Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ê miâ khí sèng-tiān, sī chiàu Siōng Chú tùi góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê èng-ún, kóng, ‘Góa beh hō͘ lí ê kiáⁿ sòa-chiap lí, chē lí ê ūi, i beh ūi góa ê miâ khí sèng-tiān.’

Só͘-í chhiáⁿ lí bēng-lēng lâng, khì Lê-pa-lūn ūi góa chhò pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū; góa ê kang-lâng beh kap lí ê kang-lâng chòe-hé chòe kang; góa mā beh chiàu lí tēng ê kang-chîⁿ hō͘ lí ê kang-lâng; lí chai, goán bô lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ lín Se-tùn -lâng hiah-ni̍h gâu chhò-chhiū.”

Hi-lân thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê ōe, chin hoaⁿ-hí, chiū kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t Siōng Chú eng-kai siū chheng-chàn, in-ūi I siúⁿ-sù Tāi-pi̍t chi̍t ê ū tì-hūi ê kiáⁿ, tī-lí chin chōe ê jîn-bîn.”

Hi-lân phài lâng khì kìⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn, kóng, “Góa ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ lí thoân-ta̍t hō͘ góa ê ōe. Góa ōe chiàu lí ê su-iàu thê-kiong pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū kap siông-chhiū ê chhâ-liāu hō͘ lí.

Góa ê kang-lâng ōe tùi Lê-pa-lūn ūn bo̍k-châi lo̍h-hái, pa̍k-chòe kui-pâi phû tī hái--ni̍h, thoa kàu lí chí-tēng ê só͘-chāi, tī hia thiah-khui liáu-āu, kau hō͘ lí. Chhiáⁿ lí mā chiàu góa ê su-iàu kiong-kip niû-si̍t hō͘ góa ê ke.”
Hi-lân chiū chiàu Só͘-lô-bûn ê su-iàu kiong-kip pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū kap siông-chhiū ê chhâ-liāu hō͘ i.
Só͘-lô-bûn hō͘ Hi-lân nn̄g-chheng kong-tùn ê sió-be̍h, sì-cha̍p-bān kong-seng sûn ê kaⁿ-ná-iû, chòe i ke-lāi ê chia̍h-mi̍h. Só͘-lô-bûn ta̍k-nî lóng chiàu án-ni hō͘ Hi-lân.
Siōng Chú chiàu I ê èng-ún sù tì-hūi hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn. Hi-lân kap Só͘-lô-bûn pí-chhú li̍p-iok, hô-pêng siong-chhù.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông tùi Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn kiông-chè tiàu lâng-kang saⁿ-bān.
Ta̍k ge̍h-ji̍t lûn-liû phài chi̍t-bān lâng khì Lê-pa-lūn; in chi̍t kò-ge̍h tī Lê-pa-lūn, nn̄g kò-ge̍h tī chhù--ni̍h; A-to-nî-lân chòe kam-tok.
Só͘-lô-bûn ū ūn-poaⁿ ê kang-lâng chhit-bān, tī soaⁿ--ni̍h phah-chio̍h--ê ū poeh-bān.
Lēng-gōa, Só͘-lô-bûn ū tok-kang ê koaⁿ-oân saⁿ-chheng saⁿ-pah lâng, kàm-tok hiah-ê kang-lâng.
In chiàu ông ê bēng-lēng, phah tōa koh kùi-tiōng ê chio̍h-thâu, ūn-lâi hē chòe tiān ê tōe-ki.
Só͘-lô-bûn ê sai-hū kap Hi-lân ê sai-hū, í-ki̍p Ka-pa-le̍k -lâng, chòe-hé phah-chio̍h, chún-pī chhâ-liāu kap chio̍h-châi, lâi khí sèng-tiān.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p liáu-āu sì-pah poeh-cha̍p nî, Só͘-lô-bûn chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông tē-sì nî jī--ge̍h, chiū-sī Se-hut-ge̍h, i tāng-kang khí-chō Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông ūi Siōng Chú khí ê tiān, tn̂g jī-cha̍p-chhit kong-chhioh, khoah káu kong-chhioh, koân cha̍p-saⁿ kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.
Tiān-chêng ê cháu-lông chhim sì kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ, khoah káu kong-chhioh, kap tiān pîⁿ khoah.
I ūi-tio̍h sèng-tiān chòe lāi-bīn khoah gōa-bīn oe̍h ê thang-á.
I tī óa sèng-tiān, pau-koat chêng-tiān kap lōe-tiān ê gōa-piah sì-ûi khí siuⁿ-pâng;

tē-it chàn khoah nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun, tē-jī chàn khoah nn̄g kong-chhioh chhit-cha̍p kong-hun, tē-saⁿ chàn khoah saⁿ kong-chhioh cha̍p kong-hun; tī sèng-tiān ê gōa-piah sì-ûi koh chòe png-chhiûⁿ, chiah bián hō͘ îⁿ-á chhah-ji̍p tiān ê piah.
Khí-chō sèng-tiān ê chio̍h-châi í-keng lóng tī chio̍h-tiûⁿ phah hó, só͘-í khí-chō ê sî chiū bô thûi, pó͘-thâu, kap ta̍k-chióng thih-khì ê siaⁿ.
Siuⁿ-pâng tē-it chàn ê ji̍p-kháu tī sèng-tiān ê lâm-pêng; tùi tē-it chàn ū kńg-lê-thui chiūⁿ tē-jī chàn, tùi tē-jī chàn chiūⁿ kàu tē-saⁿ chàn.
I ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ chòe niû, ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ-pán chòe chhù-téng; án-ni, sèng-tiān chiū khí-hó.
Óa sèng-tiān ê piah khí ê siuⁿ-pâng, ta̍k-chàn koân nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun; pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ ê niû lóng khòa tī tiān ê png-chhiûⁿ.
Siōng Chú tùi Só͘-lô-bûn kóng,

“Koan-hē lí só͘ khí chit-keng sèng-tiān, lí nā chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng góa ê kui-lē, bēng-lēng, kap kài-bēng, góa chiū beh tùi lí si̍t-hiān góa èng-ún lí ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê ōe.
Góa beh tiàm tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan, it-tēng bōe pàng-sak góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t.”
Só͘-lô-bûn oân-sêng khí-chō sèng-tiān ê kang-chok.
I ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ-pán tah sèng-tiān lāi-bīn ê piah, tùi thô͘-kha kàu piah-téng; koh ēng siông-chhiū-pán pho͘ tiān ê thô͘-kha.
Koh tī tiān lāi-bīn ê āu-pêng keh chi̍t keng lōe-tiān chòe Chì-sèng-só͘, tn̂g káu kong-chhioh; tùi thô͘-kha kàu piah-téng ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ-pán keh--khí-lâi.
Chêng-tiān tn̂g cha̍p-poeh kong-chhioh.
Sèng-tiān lāi-bīn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ-pán lóng ū khek pû-á kap hoe-lúi; tiān-lāi lóng ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ pau--teh, liân chi̍t tè chio̍h-thâu to khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h.
Lōe-tiān chún-pī beh an-tì Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi.
Lōe-tiān, tn̂g, khoah, koân lóng káu kong-chhioh, lāi-bīn tah sûn-kim; hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ khàm--teh.
Só͘-lô-bûn ēng sûn-kim tah sèng-tiān ê lōe-pō͘, mā ēng sûn-kim tah lōe-tiān ê ji̍p-kháu, koh khan kim-liān-á.
Sèng-tiān ê lōe-pō͘ kap lōe-tiān chêng ê hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ lóng tah kim, kàu kui-keng sèng-tiān lóng tah móa.

Tī lōe-tiān ê lāi-bīn, Só͘-lô-bûn ēng kaⁿ-ná-chhâ chō nn̄g ê thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek, ta̍k-ê koân sì kong-chhioh sì-cha̍p kong-hun. Ki-lō͘-pek nn̄g pêng ê si̍t ta̍k-pêng tn̂g nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun; tùi chit-pêng ê si̍t-bé kàu hit-pêng ê si̍t-bé, iok sì kong-chhioh sì-cha̍p kong-hun. Lēng-gōa chi̍t ê ki-lō͘-pek mā siâng-khoán.

I chiong ki-lō͘-pek hē tī lōe-tiān ê lāi-bīn; ki-lō͘-pek ê si̍t thí-khui, tē-it ê ki-lō͘-pek chi̍t pêng ê si̍t tú-tio̍h chit-pêng ê piah, tē-jī ê chi̍t pêng ê si̍t tú-tio̍h hit-pêng ê piah; in lēng-gōa nn̄g ki si̍t tī tiān ê tiong-ng sio-kha̍p.
I koh ēng kim tah hiah-ê ki-lō͘-pek.
Sèng-tiān ê chêng-tiān kap lōe-tiān sì-ûi ê piah, lóng ū khek ki-lō͘-pek, chang-chhiū, kap hoe-lúi ê hêng-chōng.
Chêng-tiān kap lōe-tiān ê tōe-pán lóng tah kim.
Só͘-lô-bûn koh ēng kaⁿ-ná-chhâ chòe ji̍p lōe-tiān ê mn̂g; mn̂g-bâi kap mn̂g-khiā lóng sī gō͘-kak-hêng ê thiāu.
Tī ēng kaⁿ-ná-chhâ chō ê nn̄g ê mn̂g-sìⁿ khek ki-lō͘-pek, chang-chhiū, kap hoe-lúi, lóng tah kim; koh ēng kim siuⁿ tī ki-lō͘-pek kap chang-chhiū téng-bīn.
Koh tī chêng-tiān ê ji̍p-kháu ēng kaⁿ-ná-chhâ chòe sì-kak-hêng ê mn̂g-khiā.
Ēng siông-chhiū-chhâ chòe siang-pêng ê mn̂g-sìⁿ; nn̄g pêng ê mn̂g-sìⁿ kok ū nn̄g phìⁿ, ōe-áu--tit;
téng-bīn khek ki-lō͘-pek, chang-chhiū, kap hoe-lúi, lóng tah kim; koh chiong kim phah-pîⁿ, siuⁿ tī tiau-khek-bu̍t ê téng-bīn.
I koh ēng phah-hó ê chio̍h saⁿ pâi kap pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ chi̍t pâi lâi khí lāi-tiâⁿ.
Só͘-lô-bûn choh-ông tē-sì nî jī--ge̍h, chiū-sī Se-hut-ge̍h, hē Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê tōe-ki.
Kàu cha̍p-it nî poeh--ge̍h, chiū-sī Pò͘-le̍k-ge̍h, sèng-tiān só͘-ū ê kang-thêng lóng chiàu kè-ōe oân-sêng; khí-chō kiōng chhit nî kú.
Só͘-lô-bûn khí ka-kī ê kiong-tiān, khí cha̍p-saⁿ nî chiah oân-sêng.

I koh khí Lê-pa-lūn Lîm-kiong, tn̂g sì-cha̍p-sì kong-chhioh, khoah jī-cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh, koân cha̍p-saⁿ kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ; ū pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ ê thiāu sì chōa, thiāu-téng ū pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ ê niû.
Lāi-bīn ū sì-cha̍p-gō͘ ki thiāu, múi-chōa cha̍p-gō͘ ki, téng-bīn ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ khàm--teh.
Koh ū thang-á-mn̂g saⁿ chōa, thang-á kap thang-á sio-tùi; lóng-chóng ū saⁿ chàn.
Só͘-ū ê mn̂g kap mn̂g-khiā lóng sī sù-hong; ū thang-á-mn̂g saⁿ chōa, thang-á kap thang-á sio-tùi; saⁿ chàn lóng sī án-ni.
I koh khí ū thiāu ê tōa-thiaⁿ, tn̂g jī-cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh, khoah cha̍p-saⁿ kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ; thiāu ê thâu-chêng ū cháu-lông, cháu-lông ū ēng thiāu thuh--teh ê thian-pông.
Koh khí ông-ūi ê thiaⁿ, chiū-sī sím-phòaⁿ-thiaⁿ, ông tī hia sím-phòaⁿ àn-kiāⁿ; chit-ê thiaⁿ ê tōe-pán tùi chit-pêng kàu hit-pêng lóng pho͘ pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ.

Só͘-lô-bûn tī thiaⁿ āu-bīn ê tiâⁿ khí chi̍t keng ka-kī tòa ê kiong-tiān, khí-chō ê hong-hoat siâng-khoán. Só͘-lô-bûn lēng-gōa ūi i ê bó͘ Hoat-ló ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ khí chi̍t keng kap chit-ê thiaⁿ siâng-khoán ê kiong-tiān.

Chiah-ê kiong-tiān, tùi tōe-ki kàu piah-téng, tùi gōa-bīn kàu tōa-tiâⁿ, lóng sī ēng kùi-tiōng ê chio̍h khí--ê; chiah-ê chio̍h chiàu chhùn-chhioh phah hó, sì-bīn ēng kù-á siu-chéng--kè.
Tōe-ki sī ēng tōa tè kùi-tiōng ê chio̍h, tn̂g ū-ê saⁿ kong-chhioh pòaⁿ, ū-ê sì kong-chhioh.
Téng-bīn ū chiàu chhùn-chhioh phah-hó kùi-tiōng ê chio̍h, mā ū pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ.
Tōa-tiâⁿ chiu-ûi ū phah-hó ê chio̍h saⁿ chàn, pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ chi̍t chàn, lóng kap Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê lāi-tiâⁿ í-ki̍p tiān ê cháu-lông siâng-khoán.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông phài lâng tùi Thài-ní chhiáⁿ Hō͘-lân lâi.

I sī Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k chi̍t ê kóaⁿ-hū ê kiáⁿ; i ê lāu-pē sī Thài-ní -lâng, sī phah-tâng sai-hū. Hō͘-lân chin ū tì-hūi, chhong-bêng, kap ki-su̍t, gâu phah ta̍k-hāng tâng-khì. I lâi Só͘-lô-bûn -ông hia, chòe ông kau-tài i it-chhè ê kang.
Hō͘-lân chù-chō nn̄g ki tâng-thiāu, ta̍k-ki koân poeh kong-chhioh, thiāu ê chiu-ûi gō͘ kong-chhioh saⁿ-cha̍p kong-hun.
Koh ēng tâng chù nn̄g ê thiāu-táu hē tī thiāu-téng; ta̍k-ê thiāu-táu koân nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun.
Nn̄g ki tâng-thiāu téng-bīn ê thiāu-táu, lóng ū kòa chhit cho͘ chi̍t-ba̍k chi̍t-ba̍k ê bāng-á kap chi̍t-khoân chi̍t-khoân ê liān-á.
Koh chō nn̄g chōa sia̍h-liû ûi tī bāng-á ê chiu-ûi, lâi chng-thāⁿ thiāu-téng ê thiāu-táu; nn̄g pêng thiāu-táu lóng sī án-ni.
Cháu-lông thiāu-téng ê thiāu-táu koân chi̍t kong-chhioh poeh-cha̍p kong-hun, ū khek pek-ha̍p-hoe.
Nn̄g pêng tâng-thiāu ê thiāu-táu, óa bāng-á piⁿ phòng-îⁿ ê só͘-chāi, lóng ū sia̍h-liû nn̄g-pah lia̍p ûi--teh.
I khiā nn̄g ki thiāu tī sèng-tiān ê cháu-lông; chiàⁿ-pêng hit-ki kiò-chòe Ngá-kun, tò-pêng hit-ki kiò-chòe Pho-a-su.
Thiāu-téng ū khek pek-ha̍p-hoe; án-ni, chō thiāu ê kang-thêng chiū oân-sêng.
Hō͘-lân koh chù chi̍t ê îⁿ-hêng ê tâng-hái, chhim nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun, ti̍t-kèng sì kong-chhioh sì-cha̍p kong-hun, chiu-ûi cha̍p-saⁿ kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun.
Tâng-hái ê tûn ē-bīn ū pû-á ûi--teh, múi sì-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-hun cha̍p lia̍p, ū nn̄g pâi, sī chù tâng-hái ê sî siâng-sî chù--ê.
Tâng-hái an tī cha̍p-jī chiah tâng-gû ê téng-bīn; saⁿ chiah ǹg pak, saⁿ chiah ǹg sai, saⁿ chiah ǹg lâm, saⁿ chiah ǹg tang; gû-bé ǹg lāi-bīn.
Tâng-hái ê kāu-tō͘ chhit kong-hun-pòaⁿ; i ê tûn chhin-chhiūⁿ poe ê tûn, hêng chhin-chhiūⁿ pek-ha̍p-hoe; ōe-tàng tóe sì-bān kong-seng.

Hō͘-lân koh ēng tâng chè-chō cha̍p ê phûn-chō; ta̍k-ê chō tn̂g chi̍t kong-chhioh poeh-cha̍p kong-hun, khoah chi̍t kong-chhioh poeh-cha̍p kong-hun, koân chi̍t kong-chhioh saⁿ-cha̍p kong-hun.
Ta̍k-ê chō sì-ûi lóng ū tó͘-pang tàu tī kè--ni̍h.
Tó͘-pang ū sai, gû, kap ki-lō͘-pek; sai kap gû ê téng-bīn kap ē-bīn, lóng ū phû--chhut-lâi ê hoe-khoân tiau-khek.
Ta̍k-ê chō ū sì ê tâng-lián kap tâng ê chhia-lián-sim; chō ê sì kha lóng ū kè; kè chù tī phûn ê ē-bīn, sì-piⁿ ū hoe-khoân ê tiau-khek.
Chō tùi lāi-bīn kàu téng-bīn chhim sì-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-hun; i ê chhùi sī îⁿ--ê, ti̍t-kèng la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun, koh ū tiau-khek. Chō ê tó͘ sī sù-hong--ê, m̄-sī îⁿ--ê.
Sì ê lián tī tó͘ ê ē-bīn; chhia-lián-sim kap chō saⁿ-liân; ta̍k-ê lián koân la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k kong-hun.
Lián ê hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ chiàn-chhia-lián; i ê chhia-lián-sim, gōa-khoân, chí, kap lāi-khoân, lóng sī chù--ê.
Chō ê sì kak ū sì ê kè, kè kap chō liân-chòe chi̍t ê.
Chō ê téng-bīn ū îⁿ ê kho͘, koân jī-cha̍p-jī kong-hun; chō ê téng-bīn ū thuh-koáiⁿ kap tó͘-pang, lóng kap chō liân-chòe chi̍t ê;
thuh-koáiⁿ kap tó͘-pang téng-bīn ê khang-ūi, ū khek ki-lō͘-pek, sai, kap chang-chhiū; sì-ûi ū khek hoe-khoân.
I chiàu kâng-khoán ê choh-hoat chù cha̍p ê chō; chhùn-chhioh, hêng-chōng lóng siâng-khoán.

Hō͘-lân koh chō cha̍p ê tâng-phûn, ta̍k-ê phûn ti̍t-kèng chi̍t kong-chhioh poeh-cha̍p kong-hun, thang tóe poeh-pah kong-seng, cha̍p ê phûn-chō ê téng-bīn, múi chi̍t ê chō hē chi̍t ê phûn.
Hiah-ê chō, gō͘ ê hē tī sèng-tiān ê lâm-pêng, gō͘ ê hē tī pak-pêng; tâng-hái hē tī sèng-tiān ê tang-lâm-pêng.
Hō͘-lân koh chō phûn, thuh-á, kap óaⁿ. Án-ni, Hō͘-lân ūi-tio̍h Só͘-lô-bûn -ông oân-sêng Siōng Chú sèng-tiān it-chhè ê kang:
Nn̄g ki thiāu, thiāu-téng óaⁿ-hêng ê thiāu-táu, khàm óaⁿ-hêng thiāu-táu ê bāng-á;
sì-pah lia̍p sia̍h-liû, pun-chòe nn̄g pêng, chi̍t pêng nn̄g pâi, an tī nn̄g niá khàm óaⁿ-hêng thiāu-táu ê bāng-á;
cha̍p ê phûn-chō kap chō-téng cha̍p ê phûn;
chi̍t chō tâng-hái, tâng-hái ē-bīn cha̍p-jī chiah gû;
phûn, thuh-á, kap óaⁿ; í-siōng chiah-ê khì-khū lóng sī Hō͘-lân ūi-tio̍h Só͘-lô-bûn -ông khí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ēng kng-liāng ê tâng chòe--ê.
Chiah-ê khì-khū sī ông tī Iok-tàn pêng-goân, ēng So͘-kat kap Sat-la-tàn tiong-kan ê liâm-thô͘ chòe bô͘ chù-chō--ê.
In-ūi tâng chòe ê khì-khū siuⁿ chōe, Só͘-lô-bûn chiū lóng bô kè chhìn, tâng ê tāng-liōng bô hoat-tō͘ kè-sǹg.
Só͘-lô-bûn koh chō Siōng Chú tiān-lāi só͘-ū ê khì-khū: Kim-tôaⁿ, pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê kim-toh;
lōe-tiān thâu-chêng ê teng-tâi, chiàⁿ-pêng gō͘ ê, tò-pêng gō͘ ê, lóng ēng sûn-kim chòe; teng-tâi ê hoe, teng, giap-á, mā ēng kim chòe;

teng-tâi ê poe, teng-sim ê chián-to, pôaⁿ, khǹg hiuⁿ ê phiat-á, kap khǹg hé-thòaⁿ ê phûn sī sûn-kim chòe--ê; siōng lāi-bīn Chì-sèng-só͘ ê mn̂g kap chêng-tiān ê mn̂g ê mn̂g-liú, lóng sī kim--ê.

Án-ni, Só͘-lô-bûn -ông oân-sêng Siōng Chú sèng-tiān it-chhè ê kang. Só͘-lô-bûn chiong i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t só͘ hiàn ê kim, gûn, kap khì-khū lóng tòa ji̍p-khì hē tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê hú-khò͘.

Hit-sî, Só͘-lô-bûn tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló, ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê siú-léng, í-ki̍p ta̍k chong-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, beh gêng-chiap Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi, tùi Sek-an ê Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ ūn khí-lâi sèng-tiān.
Í-tha-liām-ge̍h, chiū-sī chhit--ge̍h, Tah-liâu-choeh ê sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng chū-chi̍p tī Só͘-lô-bûn -ông hia.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló lóng lâi, hiah-ê chè-si chiū kng iok-kūi khí--lâi.
Chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng chiong Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi, hōe-bō͘, í-ki̍p pò͘-pîⁿ lāi it-chhè sèng ê khì-khū kng-ji̍p sèng-tiān.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông kap chū-chi̍p tī i hia ê Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng, tī iok-kūi chêng hiàn gû, iûⁿ chòe chè-mi̍h, chè-mi̍h chōe kah bōe-sǹg--tit.
Chè-si kng Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi ji̍p lōe-tiān, chiū-sī Chì-sèng-só͘, hē tī chí-tēng ê só͘-chāi, thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek si̍t-kó͘ ē-bīn.
Ki-lō͘-pek tī hē iok-kūi só͘-chāi ê téng-bīn thí-khui in ê si̍t, jia-khàm iok-kūi kap kng iok-kūi ê kǹg.
Kǹg chin tn̂g, kǹg-bé tī lōe-tiān chêng ê sèng-só͘ khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h, tùi gōa-bīn chiū bōe-tàng khòaⁿ--tio̍h; kàu kin-á-ji̍t kǹg iáu tī hia.

Iok-kūi lāi-bīn chí-ū nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán, í-gōa lóng bô pa̍t-hāng mi̍h; chio̍h-pán sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe, Siōng Chú tī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ kap in li̍p-iok ê sî Mô͘-se só͘ hē--ê.
Tng chè-si tùi sèng-só͘ chhut--lâi ê sî, ū hûn chhiong-móa Siōng Chú ê tiān,
in-ūi án-ni, chè-si bōe-tàng khiā-teh ho̍k-sāi; Siōng Chú ê êng-kng chhiong-móa Siōng Chú ê tiān.
Hit-sî Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “Siōng Chú bat kóng, I beh tiàm tī ba̍t-hûn ê só͘-chāi.
Góa í-keng khí chi̍t keng tông-hông ê tiān, chòe lí éng-oán khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.”
Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng lóng khiā--teh, Só͘-lô-bûn -ông oa̍t kè-lâi kā in chiok-hok.
I kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè eng-kai tit-tio̍h o-ló! I chhin-chhùi tùi góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t èng-ún--ê, lóng chhin-chhiú si̍t-hiān.

Siōng Chú ū kóng, ‘Tùi góa chhōa góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t chhut Ai-ki̍p í-lâi, góa m̄-bat tī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k tiong-kan kéng chi̍t ê siâⁿ ūi góa ê miâ khí sèng-tiān; m̄-kú góa ū soán-li̍p Tāi-pi̍t lâi tī-lí góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t.’
“Góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t sim-lāi ū ì-sù beh ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ê miâ khí sèng-tiān.
Chóng-sī Siōng Chú tùi góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t kóng, ‘Lí ū ì-sù beh ūi góa ê miâ khí sèng-tiān, lí chit-ê sim-ì chin hó;
m̄-kú lí m̄-thang khí, lí chhin-siⁿ ê kiáⁿ ōe ūi góa ê miâ khí sèng-tiān.’

“Taⁿ Siōng Chú si̍t-hiān I só͘ kóng ê ōe; góa chiàu Siōng Chú ê ōe khí-lâi sòa-chiap góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t chē Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông-ūi, koh ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê miâ khí sèng-tiān.
Góa mā tī hia ūi iok-kūi chún-pī chi̍t ê só͘-chāi; kūi-lāi ū Siōng Chú ê iok, chiū-sī I chhōa lán ê lia̍t-chó͘ chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî kap in li̍p ê iok.”
Só͘-lô-bûn tng Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng ê bīn-chêng, khiā tī Siōng Chú ê chè-tôaⁿ chêng, gia̍h siang-chhiú ǹg thiⁿ, kóng,
“Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, thiⁿ-téng tōe-ē bô chi̍t ê sîn-bêng chhin-chhiūⁿ lí; lí tùi hiah-ê it-sim-it-ì sūn-ho̍k lí ê po̍k-jîn siú-iok si chû-ài.
Lí ū chip-siú tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê èng-ún; lí chhin-chhùi èng-ún--ê, kin-á-ji̍t lóng chhin-chhiú si̍t-hiān.

Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí si̍t-hiān tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê èng-ún; lí ū kóng, ‘Lí ê kiáⁿ-sun nā chhin-chhiūⁿ lí tī góa ê bīn-chêng kín-sīn seng-oa̍h, lí ê hō͘-tāi chiū ōe éng-oán chē Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông-ūi.’
Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, lí tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t só͘ kóng--ê, kiû lí si̍t-hiān.
“Siōng-tè ah, lí kiám chin-chiàⁿ tòa tī tōe-chiūⁿ? Thiⁿ kap thiⁿ-téng ê thiⁿ to bô-kàu thang hō͘ lí tòa, hô-hòng góa só͘ khí chit-keng sèng-tiān?
Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ lí ê po̍k-jîn ê kî-tó khún-kiû, thiaⁿ lí ê po̍k-jîn kin-á-ji̍t tī lí bīn-chêng ê kiû-kiò kî-tó.
Goān lí mî-ji̍t khòaⁿ-kò͘ chit-ê sèng-tiān, chiū-sī lí kóng lí beh lîm-chāi ê só͘-chāi. Lí ê po̍k-jîn ǹg chit-ê só͘-chāi kî-tó ê sî, kiû lí thiaⁿ.
Lí ê po̍k-jîn kap lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ǹg chit só͘-chāi kî-tó ê sî, goān lí tī thiⁿ-téng, lí tòa ê só͘-chāi, thiaⁿ goán ê kî-kiû, sià-bián goán.
“Lâng nā tek-chōe chhù-piⁿ, siū-pek tio̍h chiù-chōa, i lâi chit-keng tiān tī lí ê tôaⁿ-chêng chiù-chōa i sī bû-ko͘--ê,

kiû lí tī thiⁿ-téng àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ lâi pān-lí, sím-phòaⁿ lí chiah-ê po̍k-jîn: Tēng pháiⁿ-lâng chòe ū-chōe, chiàu i ê só͘-chòe kā i pò-èng; tēng bû-ko͘--ê chòe bô-chōe, chiàu i ê chèng-ti̍t kā i pò-siúⁿ.
“Lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t nā tek-chōe lí, hō͘ tùi-te̍k phah-pāi, in nā hoán-hóe kui-ǹg lí, soan-jīn lí ê miâ, koh tī chit-keng sèng-tiān tùi lí kî-tó khún-kiû,
kiû lí tī thiⁿ-téng àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ, sià-bián lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê chōe, hō͘ in tò-lâi lí só͘ siúⁿ-sù in lia̍t-chó͘ ê tōe.
“In nā tek-chōe lí, lí kā thiⁿ koaiⁿ-ba̍t bô lo̍h-hō͘; lí hêng-hoa̍t in ê sî, in nā ǹg chit só͘-chāi kî-tó, soan-jīn lí ê miâ, lī-khui in ê chōe-ok,

kiû lí tī thiⁿ-téng àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó, sià-bián lí ê po̍k-jîn kap lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê chōe, kà-sī in kiâⁿ chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘, koh lo̍h-hō͘ tī lí siúⁿ-sù in chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe.
“Chit-ê tōe nā ū ki-hng, un-e̍k, hé-sio-hong, pīⁿ-hāi, chháu-meh, chháu-meh-kong, á-sī tùi-te̍k ûi-khùn in ê siâⁿ, bô-lūn ū sím-mi̍h chai-hō, sím-mi̍h tōa-pīⁿ,
lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t tiong nā ū lâng ūi ka-kī ê chai-hō sim kan-khó͘, ǹg chit-ê sèng-tiān gia̍h-chhiú pek-chhiat khún-kiû,

kiû lí tī thiⁿ-téng, lí khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ lâi sià-bián in, pang-chān in; in-ūi lí chai in ê sim, mā chí-ū lí chai sè-kan-lâng ê sim, goān lí chiàu in ta̍k-ê lâng ê kiâⁿ-chòe tùi-thāi in,
hō͘ in tī lí siúⁿ-sù goán lia̍t-chó͘ ê tōe, chi̍t-sì-lâng kèng-ùi lí.

“Nā ū gōa-kok-lâng, m̄-sī sio̍k lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t --ê, in-ūi thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê tōa-miâ, tōa koân-lêng ê chok-ûi, kap lí kiù-chō͘ ê chhiú-kut, tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi, ǹg chit-ê tiān kî-tó,

kiû lí tī thiⁿ-téng, lí khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, thiaⁿ in ê kî-kiû, chiàu gōa-kok-lâng it-chhè tùi lí khún-kiû--ê lâi chòe, hō͘ thiⁿ-ē bān-bîn lóng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t siâng-khoán, bat lí ê miâ, kèng-ùi lí; koh hō͘ in chai chit-ê sèng-tiān sī kèng-pài kiû-kiò lí ê só͘-chāi.

“Lí ê chú-bîn hōng lí ê bēng-lēng, bô-lūn chhut-khì sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi kap tùi-te̍k kau-chiàn ê sî, nā ǹg lí só͘ kéng-soán ê siâⁿ, kap góa ūi-tio̍h lí ê miâ khí ê tiān, tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó,
kiû lí tī thiⁿ-téng thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó khún-kiû, hō͘ in tek-sèng.

“Sè-kan bô chi̍t ê lâng bô hoān-chōe, m̄-kú lí ê chú-bîn nā tek-chōe lí, lí tùi in siū-khì, chiong in kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k, kā in lia̍h-khì tùi-te̍k ê tōe, bô-lūn hn̄g á-sī kūn,
in nā tī hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì ê tōe hôe-sim-tńg-ì, koh tī in siū-lia̍h ê tōe hóe-kái, tùi lí ai-kiû, ‘Goán ū chōe, goán pōe-ge̍k, goán chòe pháiⁿ.’

In nā tī tùi-te̍k lia̍h in khì ê tōe, choân-sim choân-ì kui-sūn lí, koh ǹg lí siúⁿ-sù in lia̍t-chó͘ ê tōe, kap lí só͘ kéng-soán ê siâⁿ, í-ki̍p góa hōng lí ê miâ khí ê tiān, tùi lí kî-tó,
kiû lí tī thiⁿ-téng, lí khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó khún-kiû, chiàu kong-tō tùi-thāi in,
koh sià-bián hiah-ê tek-chōe lí ê chú-bîn, í-ki̍p in it-chhè ê chōe-kò, hō͘ in tùi lia̍h in ê lâng tit-tio̍h lîn-bín.
In-ūi in sī lí ê chú-bîn, lí ê sán-gia̍p, sī lí tùi Ai-ki̍p, tùi chù-thih ê hé-lô͘ tiong kiù--chhut-lâi--ê.

“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí khui ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ-kò͘; lí ê po̍k-jîn kap lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t bô-lūn sím-mi̍h sî tùi lí khún-kiû, kiû lí thiaⁿ. Lí bat tùi tōe-chiūⁿ bān-bîn ê tiong-kan hun-pia̍t goán ê lia̍t-chó͘ chòe lí ê sán-gia̍p, sī chiàu lí chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî, thong-kè lí ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se só͘ èng-ún--ê.”
Só͘-lô-bûn siang-kha kūi tī Siōng Chú ê tôaⁿ-chêng, gia̍h siang-chhiú ǹg thiⁿ, tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó khún-kiû soah, chiū khí--lâi.
I khiā--teh, tōa-siaⁿ chiok-hok Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng, kóng,

“Siōng Chú eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! I ū chiàu èng-ún sù thài-pêng hō͘ I ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t; I thong-kè I ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se só͘ èng-ún un-tián ê ōe, bô chi̍t kù bô si̍t-hiān.
Goān Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè kap lán tông-chāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ I kap lán ê lia̍t-chó͘ tông-chāi siâng-khoán. Goān I bô lī-khui lán, bô pàng-sak lán,
hō͘ lán ê sim kui-ǹg I, chun-hêng I it-chhè ê tō-lō͘, siú I só͘ hō͘ lán lia̍t-chó͘ ê kài-bēng, kui-lē, kap bēng-lēng.

Goān góa tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng só͘ kî-kiû chiah-ê ōe, mî-ji̍t thàu kàu Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng; koh chiàu ta̍k-ji̍t ê su-iàu pang-chān I ê po̍k-jîn kap I ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t.
Hō͘ tōe-chiūⁿ bān-bîn chai Siōng Chú í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê Siōng-tè.
Só͘-í lín tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè chûn sûn-choân ê sim, chun-thàn I ê kui-lē, siú I ê kài-bēng, kap kin-á-ji̍t kâng-khoán.”
Ông kap Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn chòe-hé tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng hiàn-chè.

Só͘-lô-bûn ǹg Siōng Chú hiàn pêng-an-chè, gû nn̄g-bān nn̄g-chheng chiah, iûⁿ cha̍p-jī-bān chiah. Án-ni, ông kap Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê tiān kú-hêng hōng-hiàn-lé.

Hit-ji̍t, ông in-ūi sèng-tiān thâu-chêng ê tâng-tôaⁿ siuⁿ sòe, bô-kàu thang tī hia hiàn sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap pêng-an-chè ê iû, chiū chiong Siōng Chú tiān-chêng ê tiâⁿ tiong-ng ê só͘-chāi hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, tī hia hiàn sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap pêng-an-chè ê iû.

Hit-sî, Só͘-lô-bûn kap Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn tī Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng siú-choeh, chhit ji̍t, koh chhit ji̍t, kiōng cha̍p-sì ji̍t; Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn tùi Hap-má ài-kháu kàu Ai-ki̍p ê khoe-kok lâi chham-ka, chiâⁿ-chòe sēng-hóng ê tāi-hōe.

Choeh-kî soah keh-ji̍t, ông kā jîn-bîn kái-sàn, hō͘ in tò-khì in tau, in chiū kā ông chiok-hok. Jîn-bîn in-ūi Siōng Chú tùi I ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t kap I ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ siúⁿ-sù it-chhè ê un-hūi, sim-lāi hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
Só͘-lô-bûn oân-sêng Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, ông-kiong, kap i só͘ ài khí ê kiàn-tio̍k liáu-āu,
Siōng Chú tē-jī piàn tùi Só͘-lô-bûn hián-hiān, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng tī Ki-piàn tùi i hián-hiān kâng-khoán.

Siōng Chú tùi i kóng, “Lí tī góa ê bīn-chêng kî-tó khún-kiû--ê, góa lóng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h. Góa í-keng chiong lí só͘ khí chit-keng tiān hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, chòe éng-oán kèng-pài góa ê só͘-chāi. Góa ê ba̍k-chiu, góa ê sim mā beh put-sî tī hia.
Lí nā chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t, tī góa ê bīn-chêng sim sûn-choân, só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe chèng-ti̍t, chun-thàn góa ê kài-bēng, chip-siú góa ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng,

góa chiū beh kian-kò͘ lí tī Í-sek-lia̍t -kok ê ông-ūi kàu éng-oán; chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ū èng-ún lí ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t kóng, ‘Lí ê hō͘-tāi ōe chē Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông-ūi éng bô tn̄g.’
Lín kap lín ê kiáⁿ-sun nā oa̍t-cháu lī-khui góa, bô chip-siú góa pan-pò͘ hō͘ lín ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē, khì ho̍k-sāi kèng-pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng,

góa chiū beh chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi góa siúⁿ-sù in ê tōe kā in siau-bia̍t, mā beh khì-sak chit-keng hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ēng lâi kèng-pài góa ê tiān, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī bān-kok tiong chòe chhiàu-tâm, siū lâng thí-chhiò.
Chit-keng sèng-tiān hiān-chāi sui-jiân tông-hông, kàu hit-sî, keng-kè ê lâng ōe tio̍h-kiaⁿ thí-chhiò, kóng, ‘Siōng Chú ná ōe án-ni tùi-thāi chit-ê tōe kap chit-keng tiān?’

Ū lâng ōe ìn kóng, ‘Sī in-ūi in khì-sak chhōa in ê lia̍t-chó͘ chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe ê Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè, khì sìn-hōng pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, kèng-pài ho̍k-sāi in, só͘-í Siōng Chú hō͘ chiah-ê it-chhè ê chai-hō lîm-kàu in.’”
Só͘-lô-bûn ēng jī-cha̍p nî khí Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān kap ông-kiong, chit nn̄g keng oân-kang ê sî,

Só͘-lô-bûn -ông chiong Ka-lī-lī -tōe jī-cha̍p ê siâⁿ hō͘ Thài-ní -ông Hi-lân; in-ūi Hi-lân ū chiàu Só͘-lô-bûn ê chhéng-kiû, ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ, siông-chhiū-chhâ, kap kim hō͘ i.
Hi-lân tùi Thài-ní chhut--lâi, khì khòaⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn hō͘ i ê siâⁿ, khòaⁿ-liáu bô kah-ì,
chiū kóng, “Góa ê hiaⁿ-tī, lí hō͘ góa chit-khoán ê siâⁿ o͘h?” I chiū kiò hiah-ê siâⁿ chòe Ka-pō͘-le̍k -tōe, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Hi-lân bat sàng kim tāi-iok sì-chheng kong-kun hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn -ông.

Só͘-lô-bûn -ông phài kiông-chè-lô-kang khí-chō Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, ka-kī ê ông-kiong, Bí-lô, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, kap Hā-só, Bí-kiat-to, í-ki̍p Ki-sek chiah-ê siâⁿ.

(Chá-chêng Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló chiūⁿ-lâi kong-chhú Ki-sek, pàng-hé sio siâⁿ, thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi ê Ka-lâm -lâng, chiong siâⁿ hō͘ i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, Só͘-lô-bûn ê bó͘, chòe kè-chng.)
Só͘-lô-bûn tiông-kiàn Ki-sek, Ē Pek Hô-lûn;
Pa-la, kap Iû-tāi khòng-iá ê Ta̍t-bo̍k.

Só͘-lô-bûn mā khí-chō chin chōe siâⁿ, tún-chek kun-iōng-phín, chiàn-chhia kap chiàn-bé; koh tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, Lê-pa-lūn, kap i tī-lí ê choân-tōe, khí-chō i só͘ ài khí ê kiàn-tio̍k.
Só͘-ū tòa tī kéng-lāi ê A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Hek -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê hō͘-tāi, m̄-sī sio̍k tī Í-sek-lia̍t,
bô hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siau-bia̍t--ê, Só͘-lô-bûn kiông-chè in chòe khó͘-kang, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
M̄-kú Só͘-lô-bûn bô hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe lô͘-lē; hō͘ in chòe i ê chiàn-sū, jîn-sîn, siú-léng, kun-tiúⁿ, chiàn-chhia-tiúⁿ, bé-peng-tiúⁿ.
Só͘-lô-bûn ê tok-kang ū gō͘-pah gō͘-cha̍p lâng, koán-lí choh-kang ê lâng.
Hoat-ló ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tùi Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ poaⁿ ji̍p-khì Só͘-lô-bûn ūi-tio̍h i khí ê kiong-tiān. Só͘-lô-bûn koh khí Bí-lô.

Só͘-lô-bûn ta̍k-nî saⁿ piàn tī i ūi Siōng Chú khí ê chè-tôaⁿ hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè; koh tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng sio-hiuⁿ. Án-ni, i oân-sêng khí-chō sèng-tiān ê kang-thêng.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông tī Í-tong tōe-khu ê Âng-hái hái-piⁿ, óa-kūn Í-lo̍k ê Í-sûn Ka-pia̍t chō chûn.
Hi-lân phài i ê pō͘-hā, chiū-sī keng-giām hong-hù ê chûn-oân, kap Só͘-lô-bûn ê pō͘-hā chòe-hé kiâⁿ-chûn.
In khì Gô-hui, tùi hia ūn-sàng kim chi̍t-bān sì-chheng kong-kun kàu Só͘-lô-bûn -ông hia.
Sī-pa ê lú-ông thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn in-ūi Siōng Chú ê miâ só͘ tit--tio̍h ê miâ-siaⁿ, chiū lâi beh ēng lân-tôe kā i khó.

I chhōa chin chōe jîn-sîn lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, koh ū lo̍k-tô chài hiuⁿ-liāu, chin chōe n̂g-kim kap pó-chio̍h. I kìⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê sî, chiū chiong sim-lāi só͘-ū ê lân-tôe kā i mn̄g.
Só͘-lô-bûn chiàu i só͘ mn̄g--ê it-it kā i hôe-tap, bô chi̍t hāng khùn-lân kah ông bōe-hiáu ìn.
Sī-pa lú-ông kiàn-sek-tio̍h Só͘-lô-bûn só͘-ū ê tì-hūi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i khí ê kiong-tiān,

toh-téng ê chia̍h-mi̍h, pâi-lia̍t chē--teh ê jîn-sîn, kun-sûi ho̍k-sāi ê lô͘-po̍k, kap in ê i-ho̍k, í-ki̍p thîn-chiú ê lô͘-po̍k, koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h i tī Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān só͘ hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè, chiū kui-ê lâng lóng gāng--khì.
Sī-pa lú-ông chiū tùi ông kóng, “Góa tī goán pún-kok só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h lí ê sū-chek kap lí ê tì-hūi, lóng sī chin--ê!

Pún-lâi góa m̄ sìn hiah-ê ōe, kàu góa chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiah siong-sìn. Lâng kā góa kóng--ê iáu bô sū-si̍t ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ; lí ê tì-hūi kap lí ê hù-chiok chhiau-kè góa só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê.
Lí ê pō͘-sio̍k chin ū hok-khì! Lí ê jîn-sîn chin ū hok-khì! In put-sî tī lí ê bīn-chêng thiaⁿ lí tì-hūi ê ōe.

Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! I ì-ài lí, hō͘ lí chē Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông-ūi; in-ūi Siōng Chú éng-oán thiàⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t, só͘-í soán-li̍p lí choh-ông, hō͘ lí thang péng-kong-hêng-gī.”

Sī-pa lú-ông chiong tāi-iok sì-chheng kong-kun ê kim, chin chōe hiuⁿ-liāu, kap pó-chio̍h sàng hō͘ ông; chêng-kàu-taⁿ m̄-bat ū lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ Sī-pa lú-ông sàng hiah chōe hiuⁿ-liāu hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn -ông.
Hi-lân ê chûn tùi Gô-hui ūn kim lâi, koh tòa chin chōe tôaⁿ-hiuⁿ-chhâ kap pó-chio̍h lâi.

Ông ēng chiah-ê tôaⁿ-hiuⁿ-chhâ chòe Siōng Chú ê tiān kap ông-kiong ê lân-kan, mā ūi chhiùⁿ-koa ê lâng chòe khîm kap sek; chêng-kàu-taⁿ m̄-bat ū lâng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ hiah chōe tôaⁿ-hiuⁿ-chhâ ūn--lâi.
Só͘-lô-bûn ēng chin chōe lé-mi̍h sàng Sī-pa lú-ông; í-gōa koh chiàu lú-ông só͘ ì-ài, só͘ iau-kiû--ê lóng sàng hō͘ i. Lú-ông kap i ê jîn-sîn chiū tò-khì in pún-kok.
Só͘-lô-bûn ta̍k-nî siu--tio̍h ê kim kiōng nn̄g-bān saⁿ-chheng kong-kun,
í-gōa iáu ū tùi seng-lí-lâng kap bō͘-e̍k-siong siu ê sè-kim, í-ki̍p tùi A-la-pek chiah-ê ông kap kok-lāi chiah-ê séng-tiúⁿ só͘ siu--ê.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông phah tōa tún-pâi nn̄g-pah bīn, múi chi̍t bīn ēng kim chhit kong-kun;
koh phah sió tún-pâi saⁿ-pah bīn, múi chi̍t bīn ēng kim nn̄g kong-kun. Ông chiong chiah-ê tún-pâi hē tī Lê-pa-lūn Lîm-kiong.
Ông koh ēng chhiūⁿ-gê chòe chi̍t ê tōa pó-chō, ēng sûn-kim tah--teh.
Pó-chō chêng ū la̍k chàn kiā-á; chō-ūi-the ê téng-bīn sī îⁿ--ê, siang-pêng ū chhiú-hōaⁿ, chhiú-hōaⁿ ê piⁿ--á kok ū chi̍t chō sai khiā--teh;
koh ū cha̍p-jī chō sai khiā tī la̍k chàn kiā-á ta̍k-chàn ê siang-pêng-piⁿ; pa̍t-ê ông-kok lóng m̄-bat án-ni chòe.

Só͘-lô-bûn -ông só͘-ū lim ê khì-khū lóng sī kim--ê; Lê-pa-lūn Lîm-kiong it-chhè ê khì-khū mā-sī sûn-kim--ê; tī Só͘-lô-bûn ê sî-tāi, gûn bô hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe chin ū kè-ta̍t.
Ông ū Tha-si ê chûn-tūi, kap Hi-lân ê chûn-tūi chòe-hé hâng-hái; chiah-ê Tha-si ê chûn-tūi ūn kim, gûn, chhiūⁿ-gê, kâu, khóng-chhiok, múi saⁿ nî tò-lâi chi̍t piàn.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông ê châi-hù kap tì-hūi iâⁿ-kè thian-hā chu-ông.
Choân sè-kài ê lâng lóng siūⁿ-beh lâi kìⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê bīn, thiaⁿ Siōng-tè sù hō͘ i ê tì-hūi.
In ta̍k-ê tòa chìn-kòng ê lé-mi̍h, chiū-sī kim-khì, gûn-khì, i-ho̍k, kun-khì, hiuⁿ-liāu, bé, kap lô; ta̍k-nî lóng ū it-tēng ê sò͘-liōng.

Só͘-lô-bûn -ông ū kiàn-li̍p kun-tūi, chiàn-chhia chi̍t-chheng sì-pah tâi, bé-peng chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng miâ; an-tì in tī hiah-ê tún chiàn-chhia ê siâⁿ, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ông hia.
Ông thóng-tī ê kî-kan, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê gûn chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-thâu hiah chōe, pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ chhin-chhiūⁿ soaⁿ-po͘ ê sng-châi-chhiū hiah chōe.
Só͘-lô-bûn ê bé lóng tùi Ai-ki̍p kap Kho-ui chìn-kháu, sī ông ê seng-lí-lâng tùi Kho-ui chiàu chhī-kè bóe--lâi-ê.

Tùi Ai-ki̍p chìn-kháu ê chiàn-chhia, ta̍k-tâi tāi-iok chhit kong-kun ê gûn; chiàn-bé ta̍k-chiah tāi-iok nn̄g kong-kun ê gûn. Só͘-lô-bûn ê seng-lí-lâng mā keng-chhiú chiong chiah-ê chhut-kháu bōe hō͘ Hek -lâng kap Sū-lī-a -lâng hiah-ê ông.
Hoat-ló ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ í-gōa, Só͘-lô-bûn -ông mā ài chin chōe gōa-pang ê cha-bó͘ gín-á, pau-hâm Mô͘-ap, A-bûn, Í-tong, Se-tùn, kap Hek -lâng ê cha-bó͘ gín-á.

Siōng Chú bat bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kóng, “Lín m̄-thang kap hiah-ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng thong-hun, in-ūi in ōe ín-iú lín ê sim khì tè pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng.” M̄-kú Só͘-lô-bûn tham-loân hiah-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á.
I ū chhōa chhit-pah ê kong-chú chòe bó͘, koh ū pîn-hui saⁿ-pah; chiah-ê lú-chú iú-he̍k i ê sim.
Só͘-lô-bûn nî-lāu ê sî, chiah-ê bó͘ iú-he̍k i khì tè pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng; i ê sim bô chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê sim oân-choân sūn-ho̍k Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè.
Só͘-lô-bûn khì tè Se-tùn -lâng ê lú-sîn A-su-tha-lio̍k, kap A-bûn -lâng thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sîn-bêng Mô͘-lo̍k.
Só͘-lô-bûn chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, bô chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t choân-sim sūn-ho̍k Siōng Chú.

Hit-sî, Só͘-lô-bûn ūi-tio̍h Mô͘-ap thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sîn-bêng Ki-boat, kap A-bûn -lâng thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sîn-bêng Mô͘-lo̍k, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tùi-bīn ê soaⁿ-téng khí soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ.
Hiah-ê gōa-pang ê bó͘ lóng tùi in ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ hiàn-chè; Só͘-lô-bûn mā ūi-tio̍h in án-ni chòe.
Siōng Chú tùi Só͘-lô-bûn siū-khì, in-ūi i ê sim lī-khui bat nn̄g piàn tùi i chhut-hiān ê Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè;
Siōng Chú bat bēng-lēng i m̄-thang pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng. M̄-kú Só͘-lô-bûn bô chun-siú Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng.

Siōng Chú chiū tùi Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “In-ūi lí í-keng chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì, bô chun-siú góa ê iok, kap góa bēng-lēng lí ê kui-lē, só͘-í góa it-tēng beh thiah-li̍h lí ê ông-kok, chiong i sù hō͘ lí ê jîn-sîn.
M̄-kú in-ūi lí ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê iân-kò͘, góa bōe tī lí oa̍h--teh ê sî chòe chit-ê tāi-chì; góa beh tùi lí ê kiáⁿ ê chhiú thiah-li̍h chit-ê kok.
Chóng-sī góa bô beh chiong choân-kok thiah-li̍h, ōe in-ūi góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t kap góa só͘ kéng ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê iân-kò͘, lâu chi̍t chi-cho̍k hō͘ lí ê kiáⁿ.”
Siōng Chú heng-khí chi̍t ê tùi-te̍k kong-kek Só͘-lô-bûn, chiū-sī Í-tong -lâng Hap-ta̍t, i sī Í-tong -ông ê hō͘-tāi.

Chá-chêng Tāi-pi̍t phah Í-tong ê sî, goân-sòe Iok-ap khì bâi-chòng chiàn-sí ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng. Iok-ap kap Í-sek-lia̍t kun-peng tiàm hia la̍k kò-ge̍h ê tiong-kan, thâi-sí Í-tong só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng.
Hit-sî Hap-ta̍t iáu koh sī gín-á. Hap-ta̍t kap i ê lāu-pē jîn-sîn tiong kúi-nā ê Í-tong -lâng, cháu-khì Ai-ki̍p.
In tùi Bí-tiân chhut-hoat khì Pa-lân; tùi Pa-lân tòa kúi-nā lâng kap in khì Ai-ki̍p, kàu Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló hia. Hoat-ló chiū kiong-kip chhù, bí-niû, kap thó͘-tōe hō͘ in.
Hap-ta̍t tī Hoat-ló bīn-chêng tit-tio̍h chin tōa ê un-hūi; Hoat-ló koh ēng ông-hō͘ Tap-pí-nî ê sió-bē hō͘ i chòe bó͘.

Tap-pí-nî ê sió-bē kā i siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, hō-miâ kiò-chòe Ki-ló͘-poa̍t. Tap-pí-nî tī Hoat-ló ê ông-kiong kā Ki-lô͘-poa̍t chhī tōa-hàn, koh hō͘ i kap Hoat-ló ê kiáⁿ-jî chòe-hé tòa tī ông-kiong.

Hap-ta̍t tī Ai-ki̍p thiaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, goân-sòe Iok-ap mā í-keng sí. Hap-ta̍t chiū tùi Hoat-ló kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chún góa lī-khui, hō͘ góa tò-khì góa ê pún-kok.”
Hoat-ló kā i kóng, “Lí tī góa chia kiám ū khiàm-kheh sím-mi̍h, lí ná siūⁿ-beh tò-khì lí pún-kok?” I ìn kóng, “Góa bô khiàm sím-mi̍h, m̄-kú chhiáⁿ chún góa tò--khì.”
Siōng-tè koh heng-khí chi̍t ê tùi-te̍k kong-kek Só͘-lô-bûn, chiū-sī Í-lī-ngá-tāi ê kiáⁿ Lī-sùn; i sī tùi i ê chú Só-pa -ông Hap-tāi-tí-siā hia tô-cháu--chhut-lâi.
Tāi-pi̍t thâi Só-pa -lâng ê sî, Lī-sùn chio-chi̍p chi̍t kûn lâng, chòe hit-tóng ê thâu-ba̍k khì tòa tī Tāi-má-sū-kek, tī Tāi-má-sū-kek choh-ông.
Só͘-lô-bûn oa̍h--teh ê sî, Lī-sùn kap Hap-ta̍t siâng-khoán chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê tùi-te̍k. Lī-sùn thóng-tī Sū-lī-a; i oàn-hūn Í-sek-lia̍t.

Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an mā khí-lâi hoán-poān ông; i sī Só͘-lô-bûn ê jîn-sîn, sī Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k ê Sé-lī-ta̍t -lâng; i ê lāu-bú sī kóaⁿ-hū, kiò-chòe Sé-ló͘-ngá.
I chhut-chhiú kong-kek ông ê goân-in sī án-ni: Só͘-lô-bûn khí-chō Bí-lô, siu-pó͘ i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ ê phòa-khiah.
Iâ-lô-pho-an chin ū châi-lêng. Só͘-lô-bûn khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê siàu-liân-lâng un-khûn, chiū phài i koán-lí Iok-sek -ke só͘-ū ê kang-thêng.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t Iâ-lô-pho-an lī-khui Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, Sī-lô -lâng sian-ti A-hi-ngá tī lō͘--ni̍h tú-tio̍h i. Hit-sî A-hi-ngá chhēng chi̍t niá sin-saⁿ; in nn̄g lâng tī chhân--ni̍h, í-gōa bô pa̍t-lâng.
A-hi-ngá the̍h i chhēng ê sin-saⁿ, thiah chòe cha̍p-jī tè,

kā Iâ-lô-pho-an kóng, “Lí thang the̍h cha̍p tè, in-ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lí khòaⁿ, góa beh tùi Só͘-lô-bûn ê chhiú thiah-li̍h i ê ông-kok, chiong cha̍p chi-cho̍k hō͘ lí.
M̄-kú in-ūi góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t, í-ki̍p góa tī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k tiong só͘ kéng ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê iân-kò͘, i iáu ū chi̍t chi-cho̍k.

In-ūi in khì-sak góa, khì pài Se-tùn -lâng ê sîn-bêng A-su-tha-lio̍k, Mô͘-ap ê sîn-bêng Ki-boat, kap A-bûn -lâng ê sîn-bêng Mô͘-lo̍k, bô chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t kiâⁿ góa ê tō-lō͘, chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe chèng-ti̍t ê sū, siú góa ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng.

M̄-kú, góa bô beh tùi i ê chhiú siu-hôe i choân-pō͘ ê ông-kok, iû-goân beh hō͘ i chi̍t-sì-lâng choh-ông, lóng sī in-ūi góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê iân-kò͘, i sī góa só͘ kéng-soán--ê, ū siú góa ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē.
Chóng-sī góa beh tùi i ê kiáⁿ siu-hôe ông-kok, ēng cha̍p chi-cho̍k hō͘ lí;

lâu chi̍t chi-cho̍k hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ, thang hō͘ góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t, tī góa só͘ kéng-soán hō͘ lâng lâi kèng-pài góa ê siâⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, put-sî ū chi̍t pha teng tī góa ê bīn-chêng.
Góa kéng-soán lí, chiàu lí só͘ ài--ê hō͘ lí chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông.

Lí nā chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t, thiaⁿ góa só͘-ū ê bēng-lēng, kiâⁿ góa ê tō-lō͘, chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe chèng-ti̍t ê sū, siú góa ê kui-lē kap kài-bēng, góa chiū kap lí tông-chāi, chiong Í-sek-lia̍t kau hō͘ lí, kā lí kiàn-li̍p ún-kò͘ ê ông-tiâu, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ūi Tāi-pi̍t só͘ chòe--ê siâng-khoán.
Góa beh in-ūi án-ni hêng-hoa̍t Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi, m̄-kú bōe kàu éng-oán.’”
Só͘-lô-bûn ài-beh thâi-sí Iâ-lô-pho-an, Iâ-lô-pho-an chiū tô-cháu khì Ai-ki̍p, kàu Ai-ki̍p -ông Sī-sat hia; i chiū tiàm tī Ai-ki̍p kàu Só͘-lô-bûn sí.
Só͘-lô-bûn kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê tì-hūi, lóng kì-chài tī Só͘-lô-bûn-kì.
Só͘-lô-bûn tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kok ê ông, kiōng sì-cha̍p nî.
Só͘-lô-bûn tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia liáu-āu, bâi-chòng tī i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê siâⁿ. I ê kiáⁿ Lô-pho-an sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Lô-pho-an khì Sī-kiàm, in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn beh tī hia siat-li̍p i choh-ông.
Í-chêng Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ūi-tio̍h siám-pī Só͘-lô-bûn -ông, cháu-khì tòa tī Ai-ki̍p. Iâ-lô-pho-an iáu tī Ai-ki̍p ê sî, thiaⁿ-tio̍h Lô-pho-an choh-ông ê siau-sit.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhe lâng khì chhiáⁿ i tò--lâi; Iâ-lô-pho-an chiū kap Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng lâi kìⁿ Lô-pho-an, tùi i kóng,
“Lí ê lāu-pē hō͘ goán pē tāng ê tàⁿ; kiû lí kiám-khin lí ê lāu-pē hē tī goán keng-thâu téng ê tāng-tàⁿ, kiám-chió goán ê khó͘-kang, goán chiū ho̍k-sāi lí.”
Lô-pho-an kā in kóng, “Lín tò--khì, saⁿ ji̍t āu chiah koh lâi.” Jîn-bîn chiū tò--khì.
Lô-pho-an ê lāu-pē Só͘-lô-bûn iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî, ū goân-ló ho̍k-sāi i; Lô-pho-an -ông chhéng-kàu in, kóng, “Lín ū sím-mi̍h kè-chhek, góa thang hôe-ho̍k chiah-ê jîn-bîn?”
In ìn i kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t lí nā goān-ì chòe chiah-ê jîn-bîn ê po̍k-jîn ho̍k-sāi in, ēng hó-ōe hôe-tap in, in chiū ōe éng-oán chòe lí ê po̍k-jîn.”
M̄-kú Lô-pho-an kū-choa̍t chiah-ê goân-ló hō͘ i ê kè-chhek, khì kap hiah-ê kap i chòe-hé tōa-hàn, ho̍k-sāi i ê siàu-liân-lâng chham-siông;

i kā in kóng, “Chiah-ê jîn-bîn ū tùi góa kóng, ‘Kiû lí kiám-khin lí ê lāu-pē hē tī goán keng-thâu téng ê tāng-tàⁿ.’ Taⁿ lín ū sím-mi̍h ì-kiàn hō͘ lán thang kā in hôe-ho̍k?”

Hiah-ê kap i chòe-hé tōa-hàn ê siàu-liân-lâng kā i kóng, “Chiah-ê jîn-bîn tùi ông kóng, ‘Kiû lí kiám-khin lí ê lāu-pē hē tī goán keng-thâu téng ê tāng-tàⁿ.’ Ông tio̍h án-ni ìn in kóng, ‘Góa ê bé-cháiⁿ pí góa ê lāu-pē ê io khah chho͘.
Góa ê lāu-pē hō͘ lín pē tāng ê tàⁿ, góa beh hō͘ lín koh-khah tāng ê tàⁿ; góa ê lāu-pē ēng piⁿ hêng-hoa̍t lín, góa beh ēng thih-chhì ê piⁿ hêng-hoa̍t lín.’”
Iâ-lô-pho-an kap chèng jîn-bîn chiàu Lô-pho-an -ông ê ōe, tī tē-saⁿ ji̍t tò-lâi kìⁿ i.
Ông ēng pháiⁿ siaⁿ-sàu ìn jîn-bîn; i m̄ thiaⁿ goân-ló hō͘ i ê kiàn-gī,

chiàu siàu-liân-lâng ê ì-kiàn tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Góa ê lāu-pē hō͘ lín pē tāng ê tàⁿ, góa beh hō͘ lín koh-khah tāng ê tàⁿ; góa ê lāu-pē ēng piⁿ hêng-hoa̍t lín, góa beh ēng thih-chhì ê piⁿ hêng-hoa̍t lín.”

Ông m̄-khéng thiaⁿ jîn-bîn ê chhéng-kiû, in-ūi chit-ê tāi-chì sī chhut tī Siōng Chú, beh si̍t-hiān Siōng Chú thong-kè Sī-lô -lâng A-hi-ngá tùi Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an só͘ kóng ê ōe.

Í-sek-lia̍t chèng jîn-bîn chi̍t-ē chai ông m̄-khéng thiaⁿ in ê chhéng-kiû, chiū tùi ông kóng: Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-kok goán bô hūn; Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ kap goán bô koan-hē. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, lín lóng tò-khì lín tau! Taⁿ, Tāi-pi̍t -ke, lín ka-kī kò͘ hō͘ hó! Tùi án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng tò-khì in tau.
M̄-kú Lô-pho-an iû-goân chòe tòa tī lâm-pō͘ Iû-tāi tōe-khu ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê ông.

Lô-pho-an -ông phài kàm-tok kiông-chè-lô-kang ê A-to-lân khì Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hia; Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí. Lô-pho-an -ông chiū kóaⁿ-kín chiūⁿ chiàn-chhia cháu tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Tùi án-ni, pak-pō͘ ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoán-poān Tāi-pi̍t -ke, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.

Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-lô-pho-an tò--lâi, chiū chhe lâng chhiáⁿ i khì choân hōe-chiòng bīn-chêng, siat-li̍p i chòe Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ê ông. Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k í-gōa, bô lâng tè Tāi-pi̍t -ke.

Lô-pho-an kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chiū chū-chi̍p Iû-tāi -ke kap Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k te̍k-soán ê chiàn-sū, kiōng cha̍p-poeh-bān lâng, beh kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ke kau-chiàn, hō͘ kui-ê ông-kok koh kui-sio̍k Só͘-lô-bûn ê hō͘-tāi.
M̄-kú Siōng-tè ê ōe lîm-kàu Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng Sī-má-ngá, kóng,
“Lí khì kā Só͘-lô-bûn ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông Lô-pho-an, Iû-tāi kap Piān-ngá-bín choân-ke, í-ki̍p kî-tha ê jîn-bîn kóng,

‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lín m̄-thang khì kap lín ê hiaⁿ-tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn; ta̍k-ê lâng tò-khì ka-kī ê chhù, in-ūi chit-ê tāi-chì chhut tī góa.’” In chiū thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú ê ōe tò-tńg--khì.
Iâ-lô-pho-an tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu tiông-kiàn Sī-kiàm, tòa tī hia; āu-lâi lī-khui Sī-kiàm, tiông-kiàn Pí-ló͘-i-le̍k.
Iâ-lô-pho-an sim-lāi kóng, “Taⁿ chit-ê kok m̄-chai ōe koh kui-sio̍k Tāi-pi̍t -ke bōe;

chiah-ê jîn-bîn nā chiūⁿ-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tī Siōng Chú ê tiān hiàn-chè, in ê sim ōe kui-ǹg in ê chú Iû-tāi -ông Lô-pho-an; in ōe kā góa thâi-sí, koh tò-khì kui-sio̍k Iû-tāi -ông Lô-pho-an.”

Ông kap lâng chham-siông liáu-āu, koat-tēng chù-chō nn̄g chiah kim ê gû-á, chiū tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Lín khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kèng-pài siuⁿ sin-khó͘. Í-sek-lia̍t, khòaⁿ leh, chiah-ê sī chhōa lín tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhut--lâi ê sîn-bêng.”
I hē chi̍t chiah tī Pek-te̍k-lī, chi̍t chiah tī Tān.
Chit-ê tāi-chì hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn hām-lo̍h chōe, in-ūi in khì Tān kap Pek-te̍k-lī pài kim-gû-á.
Ông tī soaⁿ-thâu khí tiān; siat-li̍p m̄-sī Lī-bī chi-cho̍k ê lâng chòe chè-si.

Iâ-lô-pho-an o̍h Iû-tāi tēng choeh-kî siú choeh, m̄-kú chiong ji̍t-kî tēng tī poeh-ge̍h cha̍p-gō͘; koh tī chè-tôaⁿ hiàn-chè. I chiong só͘ siat-li̍p soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ ê chè-si phài-khì Pek-te̍k-lī, ka-kī mā khì Pek-te̍k-lī hiàn-chè hō͘ i só͘ chù ê kim-gû-á.

I tī poeh-ge̍h cha̍p-gō͘, chiū-sī i chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù tēng ê ji̍t, khì Pek-te̍k-lī tī i só͘ khí-chō ê chè-tôaⁿ hiàn-chè; i kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tēng choeh-kî, koh tī chè-tôaⁿ hiàn-chè sio-hiuⁿ.
Hit-sî, ū chi̍t ê Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng chiàu Siōng Chú ê ōe tùi Iû-tāi lâi kàu Pek-te̍k-lī; Iâ-lô-pho-an tú-á khiā tī chè-tôaⁿ piⁿ teh sio-hiuⁿ.

Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng chiàu Siōng Chú ê ōe, tùi hit-ê chè-tôaⁿ tōa-siaⁿ hoah kóng, “Chè-tôaⁿ ah, chè-tôaⁿ ah, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Khòaⁿ leh, Tāi-pi̍t -ke ōe ū chi̍t ê kiáⁿ chhut-sì, kiò-chòe Iok-se-a, i beh chiong hiah-ê tī soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ sio-hiuⁿ ê chè-si thâi-sí tī lí téng-bīn; mā ōe tī lí téng-bīn sio lâng ê kut-thâu.’”

Siâng hit-ji̍t, i koh hō͘ Iâ-lô-pho-an chi̍t ê tiāu-thâu, kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, chit-ê chè-tôaⁿ beh siū thiah-húi, tôaⁿ-téng ê hé-hu beh iā kah kui thô͘-kha; che chiū-sī Siōng Chú só͘ kóng ê tiāu-thâu.”

Iâ-lô-pho-an -ông thiaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng tùi Pek-te̍k-lī ê chè-tôaⁿ só͘ kóng ê ōe, chiū tùi tôaⁿ-téng chhun-chhiú, kóng, “Kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi!” I chhun--chhut-lâi ê chhiú soah ngī--khì, bōe-tàng kiu tò-tńg;
tôaⁿ chiū phòa-li̍h, tôaⁿ-téng ê hé-hu mā iā kah kui thô͘-kha, tú chiàu Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng hōng Siōng Chú ê ōe só͘ kóng ê tiāu-thâu si̍t-hiān.

Ông tùi Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí ūi góa kî-kiû Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè si-un, hō͘ góa ê chhiú ho̍k-goân.” Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng kî-kiû Siōng Chú si-un, ông ê chhiú chiū ho̍k-goân.
Ông kā Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kap góa lâi-khì goán tau, chia̍h kóa mi̍h-kiāⁿ, hôe-ho̍k goân-khì; góa mā beh sàng lé-mi̍h hō͘ lí.”
Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng tùi ông kóng, “Lí chiū-sī chiong lí ông-kiong ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ hō͘ góa, góa mā bōe kap lí khì, mā bōe tī chia chia̍h-pn̄g lim-chúi.
