In-ūi Siōng Chú ū kā góa hoan-hù kóng, ‘Lí m̄-thang chia̍h-pn̄g, m̄-thang lim-chúi, mā m̄-thang tùi goân-lō͘ tò--khì.’”
Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng chiū kiâⁿ pa̍t-tiâu lō͘, bô tùi lâi Pek-te̍k-lī hit-tiâu tò--khì.

Pek-te̍k-lī ū chi̍t ê lāu sian-ti, i ê kiáⁿ lâi, chiong hit-ji̍t Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng tī Pek-te̍k-lī só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì, kap tùi ông kóng ê ōe, lóng kā in lāu-pē kóng.
Lāu-pē tùi in kóng, “I tùi tó chi̍t tiâu lō͘ tò--khì?” I ê kiáⁿ chiū pò in lāu-pē chai tùi Iû-tāi lâi Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng tò--khì ê lō͘.
I chiū hoan-hù i ê kiáⁿ kóng, “Lín kā góa chún-pī lû.” In chún-pī hó-sè, i chiū khiâ-lû

khì jip Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i chē tī siōng-chhiū kha, chiū mn̄g i kóng, “Lí sī tùi Iû-tāi lâi hit-ê Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng sī--bô?” I kóng, “Góa chiū-sī.”
Lāu sian-ti kā i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kap góa tò-khì goán tau chia̍h-pn̄g.”
Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng chiū kóng, “Góa bōe-tàng kap lí khì lín tau, mā bōe-tàng tī chit só͘-chāi kap lí chia̍h-pn̄g lim-chúi.
In-ūi Siōng Chú ê ōe hoan-hù góa kóng, ‘Lí tī hia m̄-thang chia̍h-pn̄g, m̄-thang lim-chúi, mā m̄-thang tùi lí khì hit-tiâu lō͘ tò--lâi.’”

Lāu sian-ti chiū kā i kóng, “Góa kap lí kâng-khoán sī sian-ti, ū thiⁿ-sài hōng Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng kā góa kóng, ‘Lí chhōa i kap lí tò-khì lín tau, hō͘ i chia̍h-pn̄g lim-chúi.’” Lāu sian-ti sī teh phiàn i.
I chiū kap i tò--khì, tī in tau chia̍h-pn̄g lim-chúi.
In nn̄g ê lâng chòe-hé chia̍h ê sî, Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu hit-ê chhōa i tò--lâi ê lāu sian-ti.

I chiū kā hit-ê tùi Iû-tāi lâi Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘In-ūi lí ū ûi-pōe Siōng Chú ê ōe, bô chun-siú Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè tùi lí ê bēng-lēng,
tò-lâi I kìm-chí lí m̄-thang chia̍h-pn̄g lim-chúi ê só͘-chāi lim-chia̍h, só͘-í lí ê sin-si bōe-tàng tâi tī lí lia̍t-chó͘ ê bōng.’”
Chia̍h-pn̄g lim-chúi liáu-āu, lāu sian-ti kā i tòa--tò-lâi ê sian-ti chún-pī lû.
Hit-ê sian-ti khiâ-lû lī-khui liáu-āu, tī lō͘--ni̍h tú-tio̍h chi̍t chiah sai, sai chiū kā i kā-sí; i ê sin-si tó tī lō͘--ni̍h, lû kap sai lóng khiā tī sin-si ê piⁿ--á.
Ū lâng tùi hia keng-kè, khòaⁿ-tio̍h sin-si tó tī lō͘--ni̍h, sai khiā tī sin-si ê piⁿ--á, chiū lâi lāu sian-ti só͘ tòa ê siâⁿ, kóng-khí chit-ê tāi-chì.

Hit-ê chhōa Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng tùi lō͘--ni̍h tò--lâi ê lāu sian-ti thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū kóng, “Chit-ê Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ûi-pōe Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, só͘-í Siōng Chú kiò sai lâi kā i; sai kā i thiah-li̍h, kā i kā-sí, tú chiàu Siōng Chú tùi i kóng ê ōe.”
Lāu sian-ti chiū hoan-hù i ê kiáⁿ kóng, “Lín kā góa chún-pī lû.” In chiū khì chún-pī.
I khiâ lû-á chhut--khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ê sin-si tó tī lō͘--ni̍h, lû kap sai khiā tī sin-si ê piⁿ--á, sai bô chia̍h sin-si, mā bô kā lû thiah-li̍h.
Lāu sian-ti chiū chiong Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ê sin-si hē tī lû ê téng-bīn, chài tò-lâi ka-kī ê siâⁿ, beh ūi-tio̍h i thî-khàu, kā i bâi-chòng.

Lāu sian-ti chiong Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ê sin-si chòng tī i ka-kī ê bōng, i kap i ê kiáⁿ chiū ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng thî-khàu, kóng, “Ài ah, góa ê hiaⁿ-tī ah!”

Bâi-chòng liáu-āu, i chiū kā i ê kiáⁿ kóng, “Góa sí liáu-āu, tio̍h kā góa tâi tī an-chòng Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ê bōng-lāi, hō͘ góa ê kut-thâu óa i kut-thâu ê piⁿ--á.
In-ūi i hōng Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, tùi Pek-te̍k-lī ê chè-tôaⁿ kap Sat-má-lī-a choân-siâⁿ só͘-ū ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ soan-pò͘ ê ōe, it-tēng si̍t-hiān.”

Chit-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, Iâ-lô-pho-an iû-goân bô beh lī-khui i ê pháiⁿ-lō͘, kè-sio̍k siat-li̍p it-poaⁿ-lâng chòe soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ ê chè-si; ū ì-goān--ê, chiū kā in hong-li̍p chòe chè-si.
Chit-ê tāi-chì hō͘ Iâ-lô-pho-an ông-tiâu hām-lo̍h chōe, tì-kàu in tùi tōe-chiūⁿ oân-choân siau-bia̍t.
Hit-sî, Iâ-lô-pho-an ê kiáⁿ A-pí-ngá phòa-pīⁿ;

Iâ-lô-pho-an kā i ê bó͘ kóng, “Lí khí-lâi piàn-chong, khì Sī-lô; mài hō͘ lâng chai lí sī Iâ-lô-pho-an ê bó͘. Sian-ti A-hi-ngá tòa tī hia; i bat ū-giân kóng góa beh chòe chiah-ê jîn-bîn ê ông.
Taⁿ lí tio̍h tòa cha̍p tè mī-pau, chi̍t-kóa piáⁿ, kap chi̍t koàn bi̍t, khì kìⁿ i; i ōe kā lí kóng lán ê kiáⁿ ōe án-chóaⁿ.”
Iâ-lô-pho-an ê bó͘ chiū chiàu án-ni chhut-hoat khì Sī-lô, lâi kàu A-hi-ngá in tau. A-hi-ngá in-ūi nî-lāu, ba̍k-chiu chhâ-chhâ bô khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.

Siōng Chú kā A-hi-ngá kóng, “ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê bó͘ lâi, beh ūi-tio̍h i phòa-pīⁿ ê kiáⁿ mn̄g lí; lí tio̍h án-ni án-ni kā i kóng. I lâi ê sî, ōe chng-chòe pa̍t-ê hū-jîn-lâng.”

I tú-á ji̍p mn̂g, A-hi-ngá thiaⁿ-tio̍h i ê kha-pō͘ siaⁿ, chiū kóng, “ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê bó͘, ji̍p--lâi! Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ chng-chòe pa̍t-ê hū-jîn-lâng? Góa beh kā lí pò chi̍t ê pháiⁿ siau-sit.

Lí tò-khì kā Iâ-lô-pho-an kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Góa tùi jîn-bîn tiong-kan thê-poa̍t lí, siat-li̍p lí chòe góa chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê thóng-tī-chiá,

tùi Tāi-pi̍t -ke chiong ông-kok hun-lia̍t siúⁿ-sù hō͘ lí; m̄-kú lí bô chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t chun-siú góa ê kài-bēng, choân-sim sūn-thàn góa, chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe chèng-ti̍t ê sū.
Lí kèng-jiân chòe pháiⁿ chhiau-kè só͘-ū lí í-chêng ê lâng, ūi ka-kī chō pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, chù ngó͘-siōng, kek góa siū-khì, chiong góa tàn tī lí ê ka-chiah-āu.

In-ūi án-ni, góa beh hō͘ chai-hō lîm-kàu Iâ-lô-pho-an ê ke, chiong Í-sek-lia̍t tiong sio̍k Iâ-lô-pho-an ê ta-po͘-lâng, bô-lūn chū-iû--ê á-sī bô chū-iû--ê, lóng kā in siau-bia̍t. Góa mā beh chiong Iâ-lô-pho-an ê ke lóng tû-bia̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh sio pùn-sò, kā i sio-chīn.
Só͘-ū sio̍k Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lâng, sí tī siâⁿ-lāi--ê, káu ōe kā chia̍h; sí tī iá-gōa--ê, khong-tiong ê chiáu ōe pe-lâi chia̍h. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.’
“Taⁿ lí tò-khì lín tau; lí ê kha chi̍t-ē ta̍h ji̍p-siâⁿ, lí ê kiáⁿ chiū ōe sí.

Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ōe ūi-tio̍h i thî-khàu, kā i bâi-chòng; sio̍k Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lâng, chí-ū i tit-tio̍h an-chòng, in-ūi tī Iâ-lô-pho-an ê ke, chí-ū i bat chòe chi̍t-kóa sū hō͘ Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí.
Siōng Chú beh ūi-tio̍h ka-kī heng-khí chi̍t ê ông, thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t; i beh siau-bia̍t Iâ-lô-pho-an ê ke. Sím-mi̍h sî ōe hoat-seng? Chiū-sī hiān-chāi!

Siōng Chú beh phah Í-sek-lia̍t, hō͘ in iô-tāng, chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi-tiong ê lô͘-úi; koh beh tùi I siúⁿ-sù in lia̍t-chó͘ ê hó thó͘-tōe kā in pu̍ih--chhut-lâi, hō͘ in sì-sòaⁿ tī Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô ê hit-pêng, in-ūi in chō A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng, kek Siōng Chú siū-khì.
Iâ-lô-pho-an pún-sin hoān-chōe, koh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe, só͘-í Siōng Chú beh khì-sak Í-sek-lia̍t.”
Iâ-lô-pho-an ê bó͘ khí-sin tò-khì Tek-sat; tú-á kàu chhù ê hō͘-tēng, i ê kiáⁿ chiū sí.
Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ūi-tio̍h i thî-khàu, kā i bâi-chòng, tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè I ê po̍k-jîn sian-ti A-hi-ngá só͘ kóng ê ōe.
Iâ-lô-pho-an kî-tha ê sū-chek, i án-chóaⁿ kau-chiàn, án-chóaⁿ choh-ông, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iâ-lô-pho-an choh-ông kiōng jī-cha̍p-jī nî, chiū tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia; i ê kiáⁿ Ná-tap sòa-chiap i choh-ông.

Só͘-lô-bûn ê kiáⁿ Lô-pho-an tī Iû-tāi choh-ông. Lô-pho-an chē-ūi ê sî sì-cha̍p-it hè. I tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-chhit nî; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sī Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k tiong kéng-soán hō͘ lâng lâi kèng-pài I ê siâⁿ. Lô-pho-an ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Ná-má, sī A-bûn -lâng.
Iû-tāi jîn-bîn chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, in hoān ê chōe pí in lia̍t-chó͘ só͘ hoān--ê koh-khah tāng, kek-tōng Siōng Chú oàn-tò͘.
In-ūi in tī ta̍k-ê koân ê soaⁿ-lûn-á, ta̍k-châng chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū ē-bīn, khí soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, chō chio̍h-thiāu-siōng kap A-sià-la lú-sîn.
Kok-lāi koh ū loân-tông; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng o̍h Siōng Chú tī in bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-chhut ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.
Lô-pho-an -ông tē-gō͘ nî, Ai-ki̍p -ông Sī-sat chiūⁿ-lâi kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng,
chiong Siōng Chú sèng-tiān kap ông-kiong ê pó-mi̍h lóng chhiúⁿ--khì, koh chhiúⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn só͘ chòe hiah-ê kim ê tún-pâi.
Lô-pho-an -ông chòe tâng ê tún-pâi tāi-thòe hiah-ê kim tún-pâi, kau hō͘ kò͘ ông-kiong tōa-mn̂g ê sī-ōe-tiúⁿ kò͘-siú.
Ông ta̍k-piàn ji̍p Siōng Chú ê tiān, sī-ōe chiū giâ chiah-ê tún-pâi, āu-lâi koh tòa tò-tńg hē tī sī-ōe-sek.
Lô-pho-an kî-tha ê sū-chek, kap i só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Lô-pho-an kap Iâ-lô-pho-an siông-siông kau-chiàn.

Lô-pho-an tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, kap i ê lia̍t-chó͘ an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ. I ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Ná-má, sī A-bûn -lâng. Lô-pho-an ê kiáⁿ A-pí-ngá sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iâ-lô-pho-an tē-cha̍p-poeh nî, A-pí-ngá chòe Iû-tāi -ông,
tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông saⁿ nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Má-ka, sī Ap-sa-liông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
A-pí-ngá chòe i ê lāu-pē í-chêng só͘ chòe it-chhè ê chōe-ok; i ê sim bô chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê a-chó͘ Tāi-pi̍t ê sim oân-choân sūn-ho̍k Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè in-ūi Tāi-pi̍t ê iân-kò͘, hō͘ i tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ū chi̍t pha teng, hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ sòa-chiap i ê ūi, koh hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kian-kò͘.
Tāi-pi̍t tī Hek -lâng O͘-lī-a hit-kiāⁿ sū í-gōa, lóng chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, it-seng bô ûi-pōe Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng.
Lô-pho-an kap Iâ-lô-pho-an siông-siông kau-chiàn.
A-pí-ngá kî-tha ê sū-chek, i só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú. A-pí-ngá mā bat kap Iâ-lô-pho-an kau-chiàn.
A-pí-ngá tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, lâng kā i an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ; i ê kiáⁿ A-sat sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iâ-lô-pho-an tē-jī-cha̍p nî, A-sat chòe Iû-tāi -ông.
I tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông sì-cha̍p-it nî; i ê a-má kiò-chòe Má-ka, sī Ap-sa-liông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
A-sat chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê chó͘ Tāi-pi̍t chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū,
tùi kok-lāi tû-khì loân-tông, í-ki̍p i ê chó͘-sian só͘ chō it-chhè ê ngó͘-siōng;
koh hòe-tû i ê a-má Má-ka thài-hō͘ ê ūi, in-ūi Má-ka ū chō A-sià-la khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sîn-siōng. A-sat chiong sîn-siōng chhò-tiāu, tī Khip-lûn Khoe-kok pàng-hé sio.
Sui-jiân hiah-ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ iáu-bē tû--khì, m̄-kú A-sat it-seng oân-choân sūn-ho̍k Siōng Chú.
I chiong i ê lāu-pē kap i pún-sin hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê kim, gûn, kap khì-khū, lóng tòa-ji̍p Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān.
A-sat kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pa-sa siông-siông kau-chiàn.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pa-sa lâi kong-kek Iû-tāi, siu-kiàn La-má -siâⁿ, beh chó͘-tòng lâng tī Iû-tāi -ông A-sat hia chhut-ji̍p.

A-sat chiū chiong Siōng Chú sèng-tiān kap ông-kiong ê hú-khò͘ chhun ê kim gûn, lóng kau hō͘ i ê jîn-sîn, phài in khì Tāi-má-sū-kek kìⁿ Sū-lī-a -ông, Hi-sûn ê sun, Tha-pek-lîm-bûn ê kiáⁿ Piān Hap-ta̍t, tùi i kóng,

“Lán lâi kiat-bêng, chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ê lāu-pē bat kap góa ê lāu-pē kiat-bêng. Taⁿ góa ēng kim-gûn chòe lé-mi̍h sàng lí, chhiáⁿ lí hòe-tû lí kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pa-sa li̍p ê iok, hō͘ i tùi Iû-tāi thiat-thè.”

Piān Hap-ta̍t tông-ì A-sat -ông ê ōe, chiū phài i ê kun-tiúⁿ khì kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t ê siâⁿ, kong-phòa Í-hûn, Tān, A-pek Pek Má-ka, Ka-lī-lī-ô͘ hù-kūn ê tōe-khu, Ná-hut-tha-lī tōe-khu.
Pa-sa thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê siau-sit, chiū thêng-kang bô koh siu-kiàn La-má, iû-goân tòa tī Tek-sat.

Tùi án-ni, A-sat -ông bēng-lēng Iû-tāi só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn, ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tio̍h ho̍k-chiông, chiong Pa-sa ēng lâi beh siu-kiàn La-má ê chio̍h-thâu kap chhâ-liāu, poaⁿ-khì tiông-kiàn Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu ê Ka-pa kap Bí-su-pa.
A-sat kî-tha ê sū-chek, i ê sêng-chiū, i só͘ chòe ê sū, kap i só͘ khí ê siâⁿ, lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú. A-sat nî-lāu ê sî, tì-tio̍h kha ê pīⁿ.
A-sat tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, kap i ê lia̍t-chó͘ an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ; i ê kiáⁿ Iok-sa-hoat sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iû-tāi -ông A-sat tē-jī nî, Iâ-lô-pho-an ê kiáⁿ Ná-tap chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông. I thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t nn̄g nî.
Ná-tap chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, kiâⁿ i lāu-pē ê lō͘, kap i ê lāu-pē kâng-khoán hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe.
Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k A-hi-ngá ê kiáⁿ Pa-sa pōe-poān Ná-tap. Ná-tap kap Í-sek-lia̍t kun-peng ûi-khùn Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê Ki-pí-tùn -siâⁿ ê sî, Pa-sa kā i thâi-sí.
Iû-tāi -ông A-sat tē-saⁿ nî, Pa-sa thâi-sí Ná-tap, chhoàn i ê ūi.

Pa-sa chi̍t-ē choh-ông, chiū thâi-sí Iâ-lô-pho-an choân-ke, chiong só͘-ū ōe chhoán-khùi--ê lóng châu-bia̍t, bô kā Iâ-lô-pho-an lâu chi̍t ê; tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè I ê po̍k-jîn Sī-lô -lâng A-hi-ngá só͘ kóng ê ōe.
Che sī in-ūi Iâ-lô-pho-an ū hoān-chōe, koh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe; i án-ni chòe ū kek-tōng Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè siū-khì.
Ná-tap kî-tha ê sū-chek, kap i só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
A-sat kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pa-sa siông-siông kau-chiàn.
Iû-tāi -ông A-sat tē-saⁿ nî, A-hi-ngá ê kiáⁿ Pa-sa tī Tek-sat chòe Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ê ông jī-cha̍p-sì nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, kiâⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lō͘, hō͘ só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe.
Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Hap-ná-nî ê kiáⁿ Iâ-hō͘, kiò i chek-pī Pa-sa, kóng,

“Góa ū tùi thô͘-hún ê tiong-kan thê-poa̍t lí, siat-li̍p lí chòe góa chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê thóng-tī-chiá, lí kèng-jiân kiâⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lō͘, hō͘ góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t hām-lo̍h chōe, kek góa siū-khì.
Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh tû-bia̍t lí kap lí ê ke, mā beh hō͘ lí ê ke kap Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê ke kâng-khoán.
Só͘-ū sio̍k Pa-sa ê lâng, sí tī siâⁿ-lāi--ê, káu ōe kā chia̍h; sí tī iá-gōa--ê, khong-tiong ê chiáu ōe pe-lâi chia̍h.”
Pa-sa kî-tha ê sū-chek, i só͘ chòe ê sū kap i ê sêng-chiū, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Pa-sa tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia liáu-āu, an-chòng tī Tek-sat; i ê kiáⁿ Í-la sòa-chiap i choh-ông.

Siōng Chú thong-kè Hap-ná-nî ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Iâ-hō͘ chek-pī Pa-sa kap i ê ke, in-ūi i kap Iâ-lô-pho-an ê ke kâng-khoán, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, koh in-ūi i thâi-sí Iâ-lô-pho-an choân-ke, kek-tōng Siōng Chú siū-khì.
Iû-tāi -ông A-sat tē-jī-cha̍p-la̍k nî, Pa-sa ê kiáⁿ Í-la tī Tek-sat choh-ông thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t nn̄g nî.
I ê jîn-sîn Sim-lī, chiū-sī chí-hui chiàn-chhia-tūi chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê kun-koaⁿ, pōe-poān i. Í-la tī Tek-sat, tī ông-kiong ê koán-ke A-cha̍p in tau chia̍h chiú-chùi ê sî,
Sim-lī ji̍p-khì kā i thâi-sí, chhoàn i ê ūi; che sī Iû-tāi -ông A-sat tē-jī-cha̍p-chhit nî ê sū.
Sim-lī chi̍t-ē chē-ūi thóng-tī, chiū thâi-sí Pa-sa choân-ke, pau-koat chhin-lâng pêng-iú, lóng bô lâu chi̍t ê ta-po͘-lâng.
Án-ni, Sim-lī tû-bia̍t Pa-sa choân-ke, tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè sian-ti Iâ-hō͘ kong-kek Pa-sa ê ōe.

Che sī in-ūi Pa-sa só͘-ū ê chōe, kap i ê kiáⁿ Í-la ê chōe; in nn̄g ê lâng hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe, khì pài hu-ké ê sîn-bêng, kek-tōng Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè siū-khì.
Í-la kî-tha ê sū-chek, kap i só͘ chòe ê sū, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iû-tāi -ông A-sat tē-jī-cha̍p-chhit nî, Sim-lī tī Tek-sat choh-ông chhit ji̍t; hit-sî kun-peng tú-á chat-iâⁿ ûi-kong Hui-lī-sū ê Ki-pí-tùn -siâⁿ.
Iâⁿ-tiong ê kun-peng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Sim-lī pōe-poān, koh thâi-sí ông, hit-ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn chiū tī iâⁿ-tiong siat-li̍p goân-sòe Àm-lī chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông.
Àm-lī kap Í-sek-lia̍t kun-peng tùi Ki-pí-tùn chiūⁿ--khì, ûi-khùn Tek-sat.
Sim-lī khòaⁿ-tio̍h siâⁿ í-keng phòa, chiū ji̍p ông-kiong lāi-bīn ê pó-lúi, pàng-hé sio ông-kiong, ka-kī sí tī lāi-bīn.
Che sī in-ūi i ū hoān-chōe, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, kiâⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lō͘, koh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe.
Sim-lī kî-tha ê sū-chek, kap i ê pōe-poān, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Hit-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn hun-chòe nn̄g pêng: chi̍t-pòaⁿ tè Ki-la̍p ê kiáⁿ Thê-pí-nî, beh siat-li̍p i choh-ông; chi̍t-pòaⁿ tè Àm-lī.
M̄-kú tè Àm-lī ê jîn-bîn pí tè Ki-la̍p ê kiáⁿ Thê-pí-nî ê lâng khah kiông; Thê-pí-nî sí, Àm-lī chiū choh-ông.
Iû-tāi -ông A-sat tē-saⁿ-cha̍p-it nî, Àm-lī chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, kiōng cha̍p-jī nî; chêng la̍k nî tī Tek-sat choh-ông.

Àm-lī ēng chhit-cha̍p kong-kun ê gûn tùi Sat-má bóe Sat-má-lī-a-soaⁿ, tī soaⁿ-téng khí-siâⁿ; chiū chiàu hit-ê soaⁿ ê tōe-chú Sat-má ê miâ, kā só͘ khí ê siâⁿ hō-miâ kiò-chòe Sat-má-lī-a.
Àm-lī kiâⁿ Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, pí í-chêng só͘-ū ê ông koh-khah pháiⁿ.
In-ūi i kiâⁿ Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lō͘, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe, khì pài hu-ké ê sîn-bêng, kek-tōng Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè siū-khì.
Àm-lī kî-tha ê sū-chek, kap i ê sêng-chiū, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Àm-lī tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia liáu-āu, an-chòng tī Sat-má-lī-a; i ê kiáⁿ A-hap sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iû-tāi -ông A-sat tē-saⁿ-cha̍p-poeh nî, Àm-lī ê kiáⁿ A-hap chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, tī Sat-má-lī-a choh-ông jī-cha̍p-jī nî.
Àm-lī ê kiáⁿ A-hap chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, pí í-chêng só͘-ū ê ông koh-khah pháiⁿ.

I hoān Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê chōe, m̄-kú iáu khòaⁿ che chòe sió-sū; i koh chhōa Se-tùn -ông Iat-pa-le̍k ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Iâ-sé-phek chòe bó͘, khì ho̍k-sāi kūi-pài Pa-le̍k.
I tī Sat-má-lī-a ūi-tio̍h Pa-le̍k khí biō, tī biō-lāi kā Pa-le̍k khí chè-tôaⁿ.
A-hap koh chō A-sià-la lú-sîn. A-hap ê só͘-chòe kek Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè siū-khì, pí í-chêng ê Í-sek-lia̍t lia̍t-ông koh-khah giâm-tiōng.

A-hap choh-ông ê sî, Pek-te̍k-lī -lâng Hi-i-le̍k tiông-kiàn Iâ-lī-ko -siâⁿ; i hē tōe-ki ê sî, sí tōa-kiáⁿ A-pí-lân, an mn̂g-sìⁿ ê sî, sí soah-bé-kiáⁿ Se-kat; tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a só͘ kóng ê ōe.

Tòa tī Ki-lia̍t ê Thê-su-pí -lâng Í-lī-a tùi A-hap kóng, “Góa kí góa só͘ ho̍k-sāi éng-oa̍h Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè chiù-chōa, ‘Chit kúi nî, góa nā bô kî-kiû, chiū bô lō͘-chúi, mā bōe lo̍h-hō͘.’”
Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Í-lī-a kóng,
“Lí tio̍h lī-khui chia, oat tùi tang-pêng khì, bih tiàm Iok-tàn-hô ê tang-sì Ki-li̍p khoe-piⁿ.
Lí beh lim hit-tiâu khoe ê chúi; góa í-keng bēng-lēng o͘-a tī hia kiong-kip lí.”
I chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê ōe, khì tiàm tī Iok-tàn tang-sì ê Ki-li̍p-khoe.
Ta̍k-ji̍t ê chá-khí-sî kap ji̍t lo̍h ê sî, o͘-a lóng tòa piáⁿ kap bah lâi hō͘ i; i lim khoe--ni̍h ê chúi.
Āu-lâi khoe-chúi ta, in-ūi hit-ê tōe-hng bô lo̍h-hō͘.
Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Í-lī-a, kóng,
“Khí--lâi, khì Se-tùn ê Sat-le̍k-hoat, tòa tiàm hia. Góa í-keng bēng-lēng hit só͘-chāi chi̍t ê kóaⁿ-hū kiong-kip lí.”

I chiū khí--lâi, khì Sat-le̍k-hoat; kàu siâⁿ-mn̂g ê sî, tú-hó ū chi̍t ê kóaⁿ-hū tī hia teh khioh-chhâ. Í-lī-a chiū kiò i, kóng, “Chhiáⁿ ēng khì-khū iúⁿ tām-po̍h chúi hō͘ góa lim.”
I khì iúⁿ-chúi ê sî, Í-lī-a koh kiò i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ sūn-chhiú the̍h tām-po̍h piáⁿ lâi hō͘ góa.”

Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè chiù-chōa, góa liân chi̍t tè piáⁿ to bô, tháng-á lāi chí-ū chi̍t-pé-á mī-hún, pân-lāi mā chí-ū chi̍t-sut-á iû. Lí khòaⁿ, góa khioh chit nn̄g ki chhâ, beh tò-khì ūi-tio̍h góa kap góa ê kiáⁿ chòe piáⁿ; goán chia̍h-liáu chiū beh tán sí.”
Í-lī-a kā i kóng, “Bián kiaⁿ! Lí khì, chiàu lí só͘ kóng--ê khì chòe; m̄-kú tāi-seng chòe chi̍t tè sòe-tè piáⁿ hō͘ góa, jiân-āu ūi-tio̍h lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ chòe piáⁿ.
In-ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Tháng-lāi ê mī-hún bōe kiám-chió, pân-lāi ê iû ēng bōe liáu, ti̍t-kàu Siōng Chú lo̍h-hō͘ hit-ji̍t.’”
Hū-jîn-lâng chiū chiàu Í-lī-a ê ōe chòe. Í-lī-a, hū-jîn-lâng, í-ki̍p i chhù-lāi ê lâng chia̍h chin chōe ji̍t,
tú chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè Í-lī-a só͘ kóng--ê, tháng-lāi ê mī-hún bô liáu, pân-lāi ê iû bô kiám.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, hit-ke ê lú-chú-lâng ê kiáⁿ phòa-pīⁿ, pīⁿ kah chin siong-tiōng, soah tn̄g-khùi.
Hū-jîn-lâng kā Í-lī-a kóng, “Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ah, góa kap lí ū sím-mi̍h koan-hē? Lí lâi góa chia soah hō͘ Siōng-tè siūⁿ-khí góa ê chōe, hāi góa ê kiáⁿ sí.”
Í-lī-a kā i kóng, “Chiong lí ê kiáⁿ kau hō͘ góa.” Í-lī-a tùi hū-jîn-lâng ê heng-chêng kā gín-á phō--khì, tòa-khì lâu-téng i ê pâng-keng, hē tī i ka-kī ê bîn-chhn̂g.
I kiû-kiò Siōng Chú kóng, “Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, góa tòa tī chit-ê kóaⁿ-hū ê chhù, lí ná beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ i, hāi-sí i ê kiáⁿ?”
Í-lī-a chiū phak tī gín-á ê seng-khu saⁿ piàn, kî-kiû Siōng Chú kóng, “Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí hō͘ chit-ê gín-á hôe-hûn.”
Siōng Chú thiaⁿ Í-lī-a ê kî-tó, hō͘ gín-á hôe-hûn, koh oa̍h--khí-lâi.
Í-lī-a chiū phō hit-ê gín-á tùi lâu-téng lo̍h--lâi, ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi kau hō͘ gín-á ê lāu-bú. Í-lī-a kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, lí ê kiáⁿ oa̍h lah.”
Hū-jîn-lâng tùi Í-lī-a kóng, “Taⁿ góa chai lí sī Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, Siōng Chú thong-kè lí só͘ kóng ê ōe lóng sī chin-si̍t.”
Keng-kè chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan, kàu tē-saⁿ nî, Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Í-lī-a kóng, “Lí khì kìⁿ A-hap; góa beh lo̍h-hō͘ tī tōe-bīn-chiūⁿ.”
Í-lī-a chiū khì, beh kìⁿ A-hap; hit-sî Sat-má-lī-a ki-hng chin giâm-tiōng.
A-hap chiū kiò i ê koán-ke Gô-pa-tí-a lâi. (Gô-pa-tí-a put-chí kèng-ùi Siōng Chú.

Iâ-sé-phek teh thâi Siōng Chú ê sian-ti ê sî, Gô-pa-tí-a chiong sian-ti chi̍t-pah lâng chhàng--khí-lâi, múi gō͘-cha̍p lâng chhàng tī chi̍t ê tōng-lāi, ēng piáⁿ kap chúi kiong-kip in.)

A-hap kā Gô-pa-tí-a kóng, “Lí tio̍h sì-kòe khì chhē, kàu só͘-ū ê chúi-chôaⁿ piⁿ kap khoe-piⁿ, khòaⁿ ōe-tàng chhē-tio̍h chhiⁿ-chháu bōe, thang hō͘ bé, lô oa̍h--teh, chiah bián cheng-siⁿ sí--khì.”
In chiū pun khu-he̍k khì chhē. A-hap kiâⁿ chi̍t tiâu lō͘, Gô-pa-tí-a ka-kī kiâⁿ lēng-gōa chi̍t tiâu lō͘.
Gô-pa-tí-a tī lō͘--ni̍h tú-tio̍h Í-lī-a; Gô-pa-tí-a jīn-tio̍h i, chiū phak--lo̍h-khì, kóng, “Lí sī góa ê chú Í-lī-a sī--bô?”
I ìn kóng, “Sī. Khì kā lí ê chú-lâng kóng, Í-lī-a tī chia.”
Gô-pa-tí-a kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn ū hoān sím-mi̍h chōe, lí kèng-jiân beh hāi góa hō͘ A-hap thâi-sí?

Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè chiù-chōa: Ta̍k-cho̍k, ta̍k-kok, góa ê chú lóng phài lâng khì teh chhē lí; in nā kóng ‘I bô tī chia’, chiū kiò hit-kok hit-cho̍k ê lâng chiù-chōa kóng, in si̍t-chāi chhē bōe tio̍h lí.
Taⁿ lí kóng, ‘Khì kā lí ê chú-lâng kóng: Í-lī-a tī chia.’

Góa chi̍t-ē lī-khui, Siōng Chú ê sîn m̄-chai beh kā lí tòa-khì sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi. Góa nā khì kā A-hap kóng lí tī chia, i lâi nā chhē bô lí, chiū ōe kā góa thâi-sí. M̄-kú lí ê po̍k-jîn tùi siàu-liân chiū kèng-ùi Siōng Chú.

Tng Iâ-sé-phek teh thâi Siōng Chú ê sian-ti ê sî, góa só͘ chòe--ê kiám bô lâng kā góa ê chú kóng? Góa ū chiong chi̍t-pah ê Siōng Chú ê sian-ti chhàng--khí-lâi, múi gō͘-cha̍p lâng chhàng tī chi̍t ê tōng-lāi, ēng piáⁿ kap chúi kiong-kip in.
Taⁿ lí kóng, ‘Khì kā lí ê chú-lâng kóng: Í-lī-a tī chia.’ I it-tēng ōe kā góa thâi-sí.”
Í-lī-a kóng, “Góa kí góa só͘ ho̍k-sāi ê Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chiù-chōa kóng, kin-á-ji̍t góa it-tēng beh hō͘ A-hap khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa.”
Gô-pa-tí-a chiū khì kìⁿ A-hap, kā i pò-kò. A-hap chiū lâi kìⁿ Í-lī-a.
A-hap khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-lī-a chiū kā i kóng, “Lí chit-ê hāi Í-sek-lia̍t chhiⁿ-chhám-lo̍k-phek--ê!”
Í-lī-a ìn kóng, “Hāi Í-sek-lia̍t chhiⁿ-chhám-lo̍k-phek--ê m̄-sī góa, sī lí kap lí ê lāu-pē ê ke; in-ūi lín khì-sak Siōng Chú ê kài-bēng, khì tè Pa-le̍k.

Taⁿ lí tio̍h phài lâng khì tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng, í-ki̍p chia̍h Iâ-sé-phek ê pn̄g ê Pa-le̍k sian-ti sì-pah gō͘-cha̍p lâng, kap A-sià-la ê sian-ti sì-pah lâng, kiò in lóng khì Ka-bi̍t-soaⁿ góa hia.”
A-hap chiū phài lâng khì Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng hia, tiàu-chi̍p sian-ti khì Ka-bi̍t-soaⁿ.

Í-lī-a kiâⁿ-óa chèng-lâng, tùi in kóng, “Lín sim chûn lióng-ì bô beh koat-toàn, beh kàu sím-mi̍h sî? Nā Siōng Chú sī Siōng-tè, chiū tio̍h sūn-thàn Siōng Chú; nā Pa-le̍k sī Siōng-tè, chiū tio̍h sūn-thàn Pa-le̍k.” Chèng-lâng chi̍t kù ōe to bô ìn.
Í-lī-a koh kā chèng-lâng kóng, “Siōng Chú ê sian-ti chí-ū chhun góa chi̍t ê, m̄-kú Pa-le̍k ê sian-ti ū sì-pah gō͘-cha̍p lâng.

Kā goán khan nn̄g chiah gû-káng-á lâi, Pa-le̍k ê sian-ti seng kéng chi̍t chiah, chhiat kui-tè kui-tè, hē tī chhâ-téng, m̄-thang khí-hé; góa mā ōe chún-pī lēng-gōa hit-chiah gû, hē tī chhâ-téng, mā bōe khí-hé.
Hō͘ Pa-le̍k ê sian-ti kiû-kiò in sîn-bêng ê miâ, góa kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê miâ. Tó chi̍t ê ēng hé hôe-èng kî-tó, hit-ê chiū-sī Siōng-tè.” Chèng-lâng lóng chàn-sêng.
Í-lī-a tùi Pa-le̍k ê sian-ti kóng, “Lín kéng chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á, seng khì chún-pī, in-ūi lín lâng khah chōe, lín kiû-kiò lín ê sîn-bêng ê miâ, m̄-kú m̄-thang khí-hé.”

Hiah-ê sian-ti chiong hō͘ in ê gû-káng-á chhoân hó-sè; tùi chá-khí kàu ji̍t-tàu kiû-kiò Pa-le̍k ê miâ, kóng, “Pa-le̍k ah, tio̍h ìn goán.” M̄-kú bô-siaⁿ-bô-seh, lóng bô ìn-tap; in tī só͘ khí ê tôaⁿ chiu-ûi tiô-thiàu.

Kàu tiong-tàu, Í-lī-a ki-chhì in kóng, “Hoah khah tōa-siaⁿ leh! I sī sîn-bêng, khó-lêng i sī teh be̍k-sióng, á-sī teh bô-êng, á-sī chhut-gōa khì lú-iû, á-sī teh khùn, lín tio̍h kā i kiò-chhíⁿ.”
In tōa-siaⁿ kiû-kiò, chiàu in ê gî-sek, ēng to phut, ēng chhiuⁿ chha̍k ka-kī, tì-kàu kui seng-khu lâu-huih.
Tùi kè-tàu kàu hiàn ē-hng-chè ê sî, in tōa-siaⁿ jióng, o͘-pe̍h hoah; m̄-kú lóng bô ìn-tap, bô tōng-chēng, mā bô sím-mi̍h hôe-èng.
Í-lī-a kā chèng-lâng kóng, “Lín óa-lâi góa chia.” Chèng-lâng chiū kūn-óa lâi i hia; i chiū chéng-siu tó-hoāi ê Siōng Chú ê chè-tôaⁿ.
Í-lī-a chiàu Ngá-kok kiáⁿ-sun cha̍p-jī chi-cho̍k ê sò͘-bo̍k the̍h cha̍p-jī tè chio̍h; Siōng Chú bat tùi Ngá-kok kóng, “Lí ê miâ beh kiò-chòe Í-sek-lia̍t.”
Í-lī-a ēng chiah-ê chio̍h-thâu, hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ khí chi̍t chō tôaⁿ, tī tôaⁿ ê chiu-ûi khui ōe-tóe-tit cha̍p-sì kong-seng chéng-chí ê kau.
Koh pâi chhâ, chiong gû chhiat chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè, hē tī chhâ-téng; kóng, “Ēng sì tháng tóe-tīⁿ-tīⁿ ê chúi, piàⁿ tī sio-hòa-chè kap chhâ ê téng-bīn.”
Koh kóng, “Piàⁿ tē-jī piàn.” In chiū piàⁿ tē-jī piàn; koh kóng, “Piàⁿ tē-saⁿ piàn.” In chiū piàⁿ tē-saⁿ piàn.
Chúi lâu tī tôaⁿ ê sì-ûi, kau mā ū chúi móa-móa.

Kàu hiàn ē-hng-chè ê sî, sian-ti Í-lī-a kiâⁿ-óa chè-tôaⁿ, kóng, “Siōng Chú — A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí kin-á-ji̍t hō͘ lâng chai lí sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, mā chai góa sī lí ê po̍k-jîn, koh chiàu lí ê ōe chòe chiah-ê it-chhè ê tāi-chì.
Siōng Chú ah, tio̍h ìn góa, tio̍h ìn góa, hō͘ chiah-ê jîn-bîn chai Siōng Chú lí chiū-sī Siōng-tè, hō͘ in ê sim oa̍t tò-tńg.”
Siōng Chú chiū kàng-hé, chiong sio-hòa-chè, chhâ, chio̍h-thâu, kap thô͘ sio-liáu-liáu, kau-lāi ê chúi lóng sio kah ta-ta.
Chèng-lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū phak tī thô͘-kha kóng, “Siōng Chú, I sī Siōng-tè! Siōng Chú, I sī Siōng-tè.”

Í-lī-a kā in kóng, “Kā Pa-le̍k ê sian-ti lia̍h--khí-lâi, liân chi̍t ê to m̄-thang hō͘ cháu--khì.” Chèng-lâng chiū lia̍h in; Í-lī-a chiū tòa in lo̍h-khì Ki-sūn khoe-piⁿ, tī hia kā in thâi-sí.
Í-lī-a kā A-hap kóng, “Taⁿ lí thang khì lim-chia̍h; in-ūi ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h tōa-hō͘ ê siaⁿ.”
A-hap chiū khì lim-chia̍h. Í-lī-a chiūⁿ-khì Ka-bi̍t-soaⁿ téng, kūi tī thô͘-kha, bīn àⁿ tī nn̄g ê kha-thâu-u ê tiong-ng.

Í-lī-a tùi i ê po̍k-jîn kóng, “Lí chiūⁿ--khì, khòaⁿ hái hit-pêng.” Po̍k-jîn chiū chiūⁿ-khì khòaⁿ, kóng, “Bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h sím-mi̍h.” Í-lī-a kóng, “Lí koh khì.” I liân-sòa kiò i khì khòaⁿ chhit piàn.

Kàu tē-chhit piàn, po̍k-jîn kā i kóng, “Ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h hûn tùi hái--ni̍h khí--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiú-pôaⁿ hiah sòe.” Í-lī-a kóng, “Lí khì tùi A-hap kóng, ‘Tio̍h chún-pī chhia lo̍h--khì, chiah bián hō͘ hō͘ chó͘-tòng.’”
Chi̍t-sî-á kú, thiⁿ in-ūi hong kap hûn piàn o͘-àm, lo̍h tōa-hō͘. A-hap chiū chē-chhia khì Iâ-su-lia̍t.
Siōng Chú ê khùi-la̍t lîm-kàu Í-lī-a, i chiū io-tòa pa̍k hó-sè, kui-chōa lō͘ cháu tī A-hap ê thâu-chêng, ti̍t-kàu Iâ-su-lia̍t ê siâⁿ-mn̂g.
A-hap chiong Í-lī-a só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū, kap i ēng to thâi-sí Pa-le̍k só͘-ū ê sian-ti ê tāi-chì, lóng kā Iâ-sé-phek kóng.

Iâ-sé-phek chiū phài sù-chiá khì kā Í-lī-a kóng, “Bîn-á-chài chit-ê sî, góa nā bô chhú lí ê sìⁿ-miā chhin-chhiūⁿ lí chhú in ta̍k-ê lâng ê sìⁿ-miā, goān sîn-bêng ka-pē chek-hoa̍t góa.”
Í-lī-a kiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū kóaⁿ-kín tô-miā, lâi kàu Iû-tāi ê Pia̍t-sī-pa, chiong po̍k-jîn lâu tī hia.

I ka-kī tī khòng-iá kiâⁿ chi̍t ji̍t, lâi kàu chi̍t châng lô-têng-chhiū kha, chiū chē tī hia kiû sí, kóng, “Kàu-gia̍h lah! Siōng Chú ah, taⁿ kiû lí chhú góa ê sìⁿ-miā, in-ūi góa bô pí góa ê lia̍t-chó͘ khah kiông.”
I chiū tó tī lô-têng-chhiū kha, khùn--khì; ū thiⁿ-sài lâi tah i, kóng, “Khí-lâi chia̍h.”
Í-lī-a chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h thâu-khak piⁿ ū ēng jia̍t ê chio̍h-thâu hang ê piáⁿ, koh ū chi̍t pân chúi; i chiū chia̍h chiū lim, koh tó lo̍h-khì khùn.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tē-jī piàn koh lâi kā tah, kóng, “Khí-lâi chia̍h, in-ūi lō͘ iáu chin hn̄g.”
I chiū khí-lâi chia̍h, khí-lâi lim; khò chit-piàn chia̍h ê la̍t, kiâⁿ sì-cha̍p mî, sì-cha̍p ji̍t, kàu Siōng-tè ê soaⁿ, chiū-sī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ.
I kàu hia, ji̍p-khì chi̍t ê tōng, tī hia kè-mî; hut-jiân, Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu i, tùi i kóng, “ Í-lī-a, lí tī chia teh chhòng sím-mi̍h?”

I ìn kóng, “Góa ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè tōa jia̍t-sim; in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khì-sak lí ê iok, húi-hoāi lí ê chè-tôaⁿ, ēng to thâi lí ê sian-ti, chí-ū chhun góa chi̍t lâng; in iáu siàu-siūⁿ góa ê sìⁿ-miā, beh thâi góa.”

Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí chhut-lâi khiā tiàm soaⁿ-téng, tī góa ê bīn-chêng.” Hit-sî, Siōng Chú keng-kè, tī I bīn-chêng ū tōa koh kiông ê hong, soaⁿ-pang chio̍h-li̍h, m̄-kú Siōng Chú bô tī hong ê lāi-bīn; hong liáu-āu ū tōe-tāng, Siōng Chú mā bô tī tōe-tāng ê tiong-kan;
tōe-tāng liáu-āu ū hé, Siōng Chú mā bô tī hé-tiong; hé liáu-āu, ū sòe koh khin ê siaⁿ.
Í-lī-a thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū ēng gōa-saⁿ ng-bīn, chhut-khì khiā tī tōng-kháu. Hut-jiân, ū siaⁿ lîm-kàu i kóng, “ Í-lī-a, lí tī chia teh chhòng sím-mi̍h?”

I kóng, “Góa ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè tōa jia̍t-sim; in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khì-sak lí ê iok, húi-hoāi lí ê chè-tôaⁿ, ēng to thâi lí ê sian-ti, chí-ū chhun góa chi̍t ê; in iáu siàu-siūⁿ góa ê sìⁿ-miā, beh thâi góa.”
Siōng Chú kā i kóng, “Lí khì, chiàu goân-lō͘ tò--khì, khì Tāi-má-sū-kek ê khòng-iá; kàu hia liáu-āu, tio̍h ēng iû boah Hap-sih chòe Sū-lī-a -ông,
boah Lêng-sī ê sun Iâ-hō͘ chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, koh boah A-pek Bí-hô-la -lâng Sa-hoat ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-sa chòe sian-ti sòa-chiap lí.
Chiong-lâi, bô hō͘ Hap-sih thâi-sí--ê, ōe hō͘ Iâ-hō͘ thâi-sí; bô hō͘ Iâ-hō͘ thâi-sí--ê, ōe hō͘ Í-lī-sa thâi-sí.
Chóng-sī, góa tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong ū lâu chhit-chheng lâng, in ê kha-thâu-u m̄-bat kūi-pài Pa-le̍k, m̄-bat ēng chhùi kā chim.”

Í-lī-a chiū lī-khui hia; āu-lâi, chhē-tio̍h Sa-hoat ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-sa. Í-lī-sa tú-teh lôe-chhân; tī i ê thâu-chêng ū cha̍p-jī tùi gû, i ka-kī kóaⁿ tē-cha̍p-jī tùi. Í-lī-a keng-kè hia, chiong ka-kī ê gōa-saⁿ phoa̍h tī Í-lī-sa ê sin-chiūⁿ.

Í-lī-sa chiū chiong hiah-ê gû pàng--teh, cháu-khì jip Í-lī-a, tùi i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa tāi-seng kap góa ê pē-bú saⁿ-sî, āu-lâi chiū lâi tè lí.” Í-lī-a kā i kóng, “Lí thang tò--khì. Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit góa ū tùi lí chòe sím-mi̍h.”
Í-lī-sa chiū tùi hia tò--khì, thâi chi̍t tùi gû, ēng thò gû ê khì-khū chòe chhâ chú bah, hō͘ chèng-lâng chia̍h. Āu-lâi, Í-lī-sa chiū khí-lâi tè Í-lī-a, ho̍k-sāi i.
Sū-lī-a -ông Piān Hap-ta̍t tiàu-chi̍p i ê choân-kun, ū saⁿ-cha̍p-jī ê ông kap i khì, ū bé, ū chiàn-chhia, chiūⁿ-khì ûi-kong Sat-má-lī-a.
Koh phài sù-chiá ji̍p-siâⁿ khì kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap, tùi i kóng, “ Piān Hap-ta̍t án-ni kóng,
‘Lí ê kim gûn lóng tio̍h kau hō͘ góa, lí hiah-ê bó͘ kap kiáⁿ-jî siōng-súi--ê mā lóng sī góa ê.’”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông ìn kóng, “Góa ê chú, góa ê ông, chiàu lí ê ōe, góa kap góa só͘-ū--ê lóng sī lí ê.”
Sù-chiá koh lâi kóng, “ Piān Hap-ta̍t án-ni kóng, ‘Góa í-keng ū phài lâng khì kā lí kóng, ài lí chiong lí ê kim, gûn, bó͘, kiáⁿ-jî, lóng kau hō͘ góa.
Bîn-á-chài chit-ê sî, góa beh koh phài góa ê jîn-sîn lâi lí chia, chhiau lí kap lí ê jîn-sîn ê chhù, só͘-ū lí kah-ì--ê, in lóng beh the̍h--khì.’”

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông tiàu-chi̍p kok-lāi ê tiúⁿ-ló, tùi in kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, chit-ê lâng tiau-tî chhē-phāng beh hāi góa; i ū phài lâng lâi góa chia, beh ài góa ê bó͘, kiáⁿ-jî, kap kim gûn, góa lóng bô kū-choa̍t.”
Tiúⁿ-ló kap chèng jîn-bîn lóng kā ông kóng, “Mài thiaⁿ i, mā m̄-thang tah-èng i.”

Só͘-í ông kā Piān Hap-ta̍t ê sù-chiá kóng, “Lín kā góa ê chú góa ê ông kóng, ‘Lí thâu chi̍t piàn phài lâng tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn iau-kiû--ê góa ōe hō͘ lí; m̄-kú chit-piàn ê iau-kiû góa chòe bōe kàu.’” Sù-chiá chiū tò-khì hôe-ho̍k.
Piān Hap-ta̍t koh phài lâng lâi, kóng, “ Sat-má-lī-a ê thô͘-hún, nā ū kàu hō͘ tè góa ê lâng ta̍k-ê mi chi̍t pé, goān sîn-bêng ka-pē chek-hoa̍t góa.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông ìn kóng, “Lín kā i kóng, ‘Tú-á chhēng chiàn-kah--ê, m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ thǹg chiàn-kah--ê khoa-kháu.’”
Piān Hap-ta̍t kap hiah-ê ông tī pò͘-pîⁿ lāi lim-chiú, thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe, chiū kā i ê jîn-sîn kóng, “Pâi-tīn chìn-kong!” In chiū pâi-tīn kong-siâⁿ.

Ū chi̍t ê sian-ti lâi kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap, kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lí ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit tōa-tīn lâng--bô? Khòaⁿ leh, kin-á-ji̍t góa beh chiong in kau tī lí ê chhiú, lí chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”

A-hap kóng, “Beh phài sím-mi̍h-lâng?” I ìn kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Ēng chiah-ê séng-tiúⁿ ê siàu-liân kun-peng.’” A-hap kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng beh chhōa-thâu chìn-kong?” I ìn kóng, “Chiū-sī lí.”
A-hap chiū tiám-sǹg séng-tiúⁿ ê siàu-liân kun-peng, ū nn̄g-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-jī miâ; āu-lâi i koh tiám-sǹg Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-peng, kiōng chhit-chheng miâ.
Ji̍t tiong-tàu, in chiū chhut-chiàn. Piān Hap-ta̍t kap hiah-ê lâi pang-chān i ê saⁿ-cha̍p-jī ê ông, tī pò͘-pîⁿ lāi lim chiú-chùi.
Hiah-ê séng-tiúⁿ ê siàu-liân kun-peng chòe thâu chhut--khì. Piān Hap-ta̍t phài lâng khì thàm-cha, in hôe-ho̍k kóng, “Ū lâng tùi Sat-má-lī-a chhut--lâi.”
I kóng, “Put-koán sī chhut-lâi beh kóng-hô, á-sī beh kau-chiàn, lóng kā in oa̍h-oa̍h lia̍h--khí-lâi.”
Hiah-ê séng-tiúⁿ ê siàu-liân kun-peng chhut-siâⁿ, kun-peng tè in;
ta̍k-ê lâng thâi-sí i ê tùi-te̍k. Sū-lī-a -lâng tô-cháu, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng jip in. Sū-lī-a -ông Piān Hap-ta̍t khiâ-bé, kap hiah-ê bé-peng tô-cháu.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chhut-siâⁿ, kong-kek hiah-ê chiàn-chhia kap chiàn-bé, thâi-sí chin chōe Sū-lī-a -lâng.
Hit-ê sian-ti lâi kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, tùi i kóng, “Lí tio̍h ka-kiông kun-le̍k, beh chòe sím-mi̍h tio̍h hó-hó kè-ōe; mê-nî chhun-thiⁿ, Sū-lī-a -ông ōe koh lâi kong-kek lí.”
Sū-lī-a -ông ê jîn-sîn tùi i kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê Siōng-tè sī soaⁿ-sîn, só͘-í in thâi-iâⁿ lán; m̄-kú nā tī pêng-goân kap in kau-chiàn, lán it-tēng ōe thâi-iâⁿ.
Chhiáⁿ lí án-ni chòe; kái-tû hiah-ê ông ê chit-bū, phài séng-tiúⁿ tāi-thòe in.

Koh chiàu lí sún-sit ê sò͘-bo̍k chio-bō͘ chi̍t tūi kun-peng, chiàn-bé pó͘ chiàn-bé, chiàn-chhia pó͘ chiàn-chhia. Lán tī pêng-goân kap in kau-chiàn, ún-tàng iâⁿ.” Ông chiū thiaⁿ in ê kiàn-gī khì chòe.
Keh-nî chhun-thiⁿ, Piān Hap-ta̍t tiám-sǹg Sū-lī-a -lâng, chiūⁿ-khì A-hut, beh kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kau-chiàn.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng mā tiàu-chi̍p kun-peng, chún-pī kun-niû, chhut-khì beh kap in kau-chiàn, tī in ê tùi-bīn chat-iâⁿ. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ nn̄g tūi sió-kûn ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á; m̄-kú Sū-lī-a -lâng piàn-móa tōe-bīn.

Ū chi̍t ê Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng lâi kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘In-ūi Sū-lī-a -lâng kóng Siōng Chú sī soaⁿ-sîn, m̄-sī pêng-goân ê sîn, só͘-í góa beh chiong chit tōa-tīn ê lâng lóng kau tī lí ê chhiú; lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Sū-lī-a -lâng sio-tùi chat-iâⁿ chhit ji̍t; kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, siang-pêng kun-peng kau-chiàn. Tī hit chi̍t ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thâi-sí Sū-lī-a -lâng pō͘-peng cha̍p-bān.

Kî-tha ê kun-peng tô-cháu ji̍p-khì A-hut -siâⁿ; hit-ê siâⁿ ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ tó, teh-sí só͘ chhun ê nn̄g-bān chhit-chheng lâng. Piān Hap-ta̍t cháu ji̍p-siâⁿ, bih tī chi̍t keng chhù ê ba̍t-pâng.

I ê jîn-sîn kā i kóng, “Goán thiaⁿ-kóng Í-sek-lia̍t -ke ê ông lóng chin jîn-chû; kiû lí ún-chún goán io hâ môa-pò͘, ām-kún thò-soh, chhut-khì tâu-hâng Í-sek-lia̍t -ông; kiám-chhái i ōe lâu lí ê sìⁿ-miā.”

In chiū io hâ môa-pò͘, ām-kún thò-soh, khì kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn Piān Hap-ta̍t kóng, ‘Kiû lí lâu góa ê sìⁿ-miā.’” A-hap kóng, “I iáu oa̍h--teh o͘h? I sī góa ê hiaⁿ-tī.”

Hiah-ê lâng chim-chiok thiaⁿ i ê kháu-khì, liâm-piⁿ sūn i ê ōe-bé kóng, “Sī, Piān Hap-ta̍t sī lí ê hiaⁿ-tī.” A-hap kóng, “Lín khì chhōa i lâi.” Piān Hap-ta̍t chhut-lâi kìⁿ ông, ông chiū chhiáⁿ i chē ông ê chhia.

Piān Hap-ta̍t tùi A-hap kóng, “Góa ê lāu-pē tùi lí ê lāu-pē chhiúⁿ--lâi ê siâⁿ, góa lóng beh hêng lí; koh lí thang tī Tāi-má-sū-kek siat siong-tiûⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ê lāu-pē tī Sat-má-lī-a siat--ê kâng-khoán.” A-hap kóng, “Góa chiàu chit-ê iok pàng lí tò--khì.” A-hap chiū kap i tēng tiâu-iok, pàng i tò--khì.
Ū chi̍t ê lâng, sī sian-ti ê ha̍k-seng, hōng Siōng Chú ê ōe kā i ê tâng-phōaⁿ kóng, “Phah góa!” Hit-ê lâng m̄-khéng kā i phah.

I chiū kā i ê tâng-phōaⁿ kóng, “In-ūi lí m̄ thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe, lí chi̍t-ē lī-khui góa, ōe hō͘ sai kā-sí.” Hit-ê lâng chi̍t-ē lī-khui, kó-jiân tú-tio̍h sai, hō͘ sai kā-sí.
I koh tú-tio̍h chi̍t ê lâng, kā i kóng, “Phah góa!” Hit-ê lâng chiū kā i phah, phah kàu tio̍h-siong.
Sian-ti chiū chiong thâu-kun khàm kàu ba̍k-chiu, kái-chong, tī lō͘--ni̍h thèng-hāu ông.

Ông tùi hia keng-kè ê sî, i tōa-siaⁿ tùi ông kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn chhut-chiàn ê sî, ū chi̍t ê lâng lia̍h chi̍t ê hu-ló͘ lâi kau góa, kóng, ‘Lí tio̍h kò͘-siú chit-ê lâng; i nā cháu--khì, lí ê sìⁿ-miā tio̍h thòe i ê sìⁿ-miā; nā bô, lí tio̍h kau-chhut saⁿ-cha̍p-sì kong-kun ê gûn.’
Lí ê po̍k-jîn bô-êng chit-hāng hit-hāng ê sî, hit-ê hu-ló͘ sòa cháu--khì.” Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kā i kóng, “Lí ê ōe í-keng kā ka-kī phòaⁿ-chōe ah.”
I kóaⁿ-kín chiong khàm ba̍k-chiu ê thâu-kun the̍h-tiāu; Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chiū jīn-chhut i sī chi̍t ê sian-ti.

I kā ông kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘In-ūi lí chiong góa koat-tēng beh húi-bia̍t ê lâng pàng hō͘ khì, só͘-í lí ê sìⁿ-miā tio̍h thòe i ê sìⁿ-miā, lí ê jîn-bîn tio̍h thòe i ê jîn-bîn siū húi-bia̍t.’”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chiū ut-chut bô hoaⁿ-hí, tò-khì Sat-má-lī-a i ê ông-kiong.
Āu-lâi koh ū tāi-chì hoat-seng. Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng Ná-pek tī Iâ-su-lia̍t ū chi̍t khu phû-tô-hn̂g, óa-kūn Sat-má-lī-a -ông A-hap ê ông-kiong.

A-hap kā Ná-pek kóng, “Lí ê phû-tô-hn̂g hō͘ góa chòe chhài-hn̂g, in-ūi chin kūn góa ê ông-kiong; góa beh ēng koh-khah hó ê hn̂g kā lí ōaⁿ; lí nā ài gûn, góa chiū chiàu kè-chîⁿ kā lí bóe.”
Ná-pek kā A-hap kóng, “Siōng Chú bōe ún-chún góa chiong chó͘-sian lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê sán-gia̍p hō͘ lí.”

A-hap in-ūi Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng Ná-pek kóng ê ōe, ut-chut bô hoaⁿ-hí, tò-khì ông-kiong; in-ūi Ná-pek ū kóng “Góa bōe-tàng ēng góa ê chó͘-gia̍p hō͘ lí”, A-hap chiū tó tī bîn-chhn̂g, bīn ǹg lāi-bīn, mā m̄ chia̍h.
Ông-hō͘ Iâ-sé-phek lâi i hia, mn̄g i kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ ut-chut m̄ chia̍h-pn̄g?”

I ìn kóng, “In-ūi góa tùi Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng Ná-pek kóng, ‘Lí ê phû-tô-hn̂g hō͘ góa, góa ēng gûn kā lí bóe; á-sī lí nā ài, góa chiū ēng phû-tô-hn̂g kap lí ōaⁿ.’ I kóng, ‘Góa ê phû-tô-hn̂g, góa bōe-tàng hō͘ lí.’”

Ông-hō͘ Iâ-sé-phek kā i kóng, “Lí chit-chūn kiám m̄-sī teh thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t -kok? Khí--lâi, hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí lâi chia̍h; góa beh chiong Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng Ná-pek ê phû-tô-hn̂g hō͘ lí.”
Iâ-sé-phek ēng A-hap ê miâ siá-phoe, khàm ông ê ìn, kià-phoe hō͘ hiah-ê kap Ná-pek tòa kâng-siâⁿ ê tiúⁿ-ló kap kùi-cho̍k.
Phoe-lāi siá kóng, “Lín tio̍h soan-pò͘ kìm-chia̍h, hō͘ Ná-pek chē tī jîn-bîn ê thâu-chêng;
koh kiò nn̄g ê húi-lūi chē tī i ê tùi-bīn, choh-chèng kò i kóng, ‘Lí siat-to̍k Siōng-tè kap bú-jio̍k ông.’ Jiân-āu kā i thoa--chhut-khì, ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm-sí.”
Hiah-ê kap Ná-pek tòa kâng-siâⁿ ê tiúⁿ-ló kap kùi-cho̍k, chiū chiàu Iâ-sé-phek kià hō͘ in ê phoe só͘ siá--ê khì chòe.
In soan-pò͘ kìm-chia̍h, hō͘ Ná-pek chē tī jîn-bîn ê thâu-chêng.

Koh kiò nn̄g ê húi-lūi lâi chē tī Ná-pek ê tùi-bīn, tng chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng choh-chèng kò Ná-pek, kóng, “ Ná-pek siat-to̍k Siōng-tè koh bú-jio̍k ông.” Chèng-lâng chiū kā i thoa chhut-khì siâⁿ-gōa, ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm-sí.
Tiúⁿ-ló kap kùi-cho̍k chiū chhe lâng khì kā Iâ-sé-phek kóng, “ Ná-pek í-keng hō͘ chio̍h-thâu tìm-sí lah.”

Iâ-sé-phek thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ná-pek hō͘ chio̍h-thâu tìm-sí, chiū kā A-hap kóng, “Lí khì chiap-siu Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng Ná-pek m̄-khéng bōe hō͘ lí ê phû-tô-hn̂g. I í-keng sí, bô-miā lah.”
A-hap thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ná-pek í-keng sí, chiū khí--lâi, lo̍h-khì beh chiap-siu Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng Ná-pek ê phû-tô-hn̂g.
Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Thê-su-pí -lâng Í-lī-a, kóng,
“Lí khí--lâi, khì kìⁿ tòa tī Sat-má-lī-a ê Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap; i chit-chūn lo̍h-khì Iâ-su-lia̍t beh chiap-siu Ná-pek ê phû-tô-hn̂g.

Lí tio̍h kā i kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lí ū thâi-sí lâng koh chiap-siu i ê sán-gia̍p.’ Koh kā i kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Káu tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi chī Ná-pek ê huih, mā beh tī hia chī lí ê huih, chiū-sī lí pún-sin ê huih.’”
A-hap tùi Í-lī-a kóng, “Góa ê tùi-thâu, lí teh chhē góa sī--bô?” I ìn kóng, “Góa teh chhē lí, in-ūi lí chhut-bōe ka-kī, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū.

Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Góa beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ lí, beh châu-bia̍t lí; só͘-ū tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong sio̍k A-hap ê ta-po͘-lâng, bô-lūn chū-iû--ê á-sī bô chū-iû--ê, góa lóng beh kā in siau-bia̍t.
Góa beh hō͘ lí ê ke kap Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê ke, í-ki̍p A-hi-ngá ê kiáⁿ Pa-sa ê ke kâng-khoán, in-ūi lí ū jiá góa siū-khì, koh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoān-chōe.’
Koan-hē Iâ-sé-phek, Siōng Chú mā ū kóng, ‘Káu beh tī Iâ-su-lia̍t ê gōa-siâⁿ chia̍h Iâ-sé-phek.
Sio̍k A-hap ê lâng, sí tī siâⁿ-lāi--ê, beh hō͘ káu chia̍h; sí tī iá-gōa--ê, khong-tiong ê chiáu mā ōe kā in chia̍h.’”
(Chêng-kàu-taⁿ bô lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ A-hap, i siū ông-hō͘ Iâ-sé-phek sái-lōng, chhut-bōe ka-kī, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū.
I chòe siōng khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, in-ūi i pài ngó͘-siōng, kap Siōng Chú tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-chhut ê A-mô͘-lī -lâng chòe kâng-khoán ê sū.)
A-hap thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe, chiū thiah-li̍h saⁿ, chhēng chho͘-môa-pò͘, kìm-chia̍h, chhēng chho͘-môa-pò͘ khùn, sit-chì ut-chut kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì.
Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Thê-su-pí -lâng Í-lī-a kóng,

“ A-hap tī góa ê bīn-chêng hiah-ni̍h khiam-pi, lí ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h-bô? In-ūi i tī góa ê bīn-chêng khiam-pi, só͘-í góa bô beh tī i chāi-siⁿ ê sî kàng chit-ê chai-hō; kàu i ê kiáⁿ choh-ông ê sî, góa chiah beh kàng chit-ê chai-hō hō͘ i ê ke.”
Í-sek-lia̍t kap Sū-lī-a saⁿ nî kú bô kau-chiàn.
Kàu tē-saⁿ nî, Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat lo̍h-khì Í-sek-lia̍t -ông hia.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông tùi i ê jîn-sîn kóng, “ Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t sī lán ê, lín chai--bô? Lán ná bô beh chhái-chhú hêng-tōng, tùi Sū-lī-a -ông ê chhiú the̍h--tò-lâi?”

A-hap tùi Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Lí beh kap góa chòe-hé khì kong-táⁿ Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t --bô?” Iok-sa-hoat tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kóng, “Góa ê chiū-sī lí ê, góa ê jîn-bîn chiū-sī lí ê jîn-bîn, góa ê bé chiū-sī lí ê bé.”
Iok-sa-hoat koh tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí seng mn̄g Siōng Chú ê ì-sù.”

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chiū tiàu-chi̍p sian-ti tāi-iok sì-pah lâng, mn̄g in kóng, “Góa thang khì kong-táⁿ Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, á-sī m̄-thang?” In ìn kóng, “Thang khì kong-táⁿ; Chú beh chiong chit-ê siâⁿ kau tī ông ê chhiú.”
Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Chia kiám bô koh ū Siōng Chú ê sian-ti hō͘ lán thang mn̄g?”

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kā Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Iáu ū chi̍t ê lâng, sī Im-la ê kiáⁿ Bí-kai-ngá, lán thang tùi i chhéng-būn Siōng Chú; m̄-kú góa oàn-hūn i, in-ūi i tùi góa kóng ê ū-giân bô chi̍t hāng hó, chí-ū kóng chai-hō.” Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Chhiáⁿ ông m̄-thang án-ni kóng.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chiū tiàu chi̍t ê koaⁿ-oân lâi, kóng, “Lí kóaⁿ-kín khì kiò Im-la ê kiáⁿ Bí-kai-ngá lâi.”

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kap Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat tī Sat-má-lī-a siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ, chhēng lé-ho̍k, chē tī in ê pó-chō; só͘-ū ê sian-ti lóng tī in ê bīn-chêng kóng ū-giân.
Ki-ná-ná ê kiáⁿ Se-tí-ka chòe thih ê kak, kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lí beh ēng chiah-ê thih-kak tak Sū-lī-a -lâng, tak kah in lóng siau-bia̍t.’”
Só͘-ū ê sian-ti lóng án-ni ū-giân kóng, “Thang khì kong-táⁿ Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, it-tēng tek-sèng, Siōng Chú beh chiong chit-ê siâⁿ kau tī ông ê chhiú.”
Hit-ê khì kiò Bí-kai-ngá ê sù-chiá kā i kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, só͘-ū ê sian-ti lóng tùi ông kóng hó-ōe, chhiáⁿ lí mā kap in siâng-khoán kóng hó-ōe.”
Bí-kai-ngá kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng sím-mi̍h, góa chiū tùi ông kóng sím-mi̍h.”

Bí-kai-ngá lâi kàu ông ê bīn-chêng, ông mn̄g i kóng, “ Bí-kai-ngá, goán thang khì kong-táⁿ Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, á-sī m̄-thang?” I ìn kóng, “Hó ah, chòe lí khì kong-táⁿ, it-tēng ōe sèng-lī; Siōng Chú beh chiong chit-ê siâⁿ kau tī ông ê chhiú.”
Ông tùi i kóng, “Góa tio̍h kiò lí chiù-chōa kúi piàn, lí chiah ōe hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ tùi góa kóng si̍t-chāi-ōe?”

Bí-kai-ngá kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ bô bo̍k-chiá ê iûⁿ sì-sòaⁿ tī soaⁿ--ni̍h; Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Chiah-ê lâng bô chú-lâng; ta̍k-ê lâng thang pêng-an tò-khì in tau.’”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông tùi Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Góa kiám bô kā lí kóng, chit-ê lâng tùi góa kóng ê ū-giân lóng bô hó-ōe, chí-ū kóng chai-hō.”
Bí-kai-ngá kè-sio̍k kóng, “Só͘-í, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe! Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú chē tī pó-chō, thiⁿ-téng ê bān-kun khiā tī I ê chiàⁿ-pêng tò-pêng.
Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Sím-mi̍h-lâng beh ín-iú A-hap, hō͘ i khì Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, sí tī hia?’ Chit-ê kóng án-ni, hit-ê kóng án-ni.
Āu-lâi ū chi̍t ê sîn chhut--lâi, khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, kóng, ‘Góa khì kā i ín-iú.’

Siōng Chú mn̄g i kóng, ‘Lí beh án-chóaⁿ kā ín-iú?’ I ìn kóng, ‘Góa beh chhut-khì chòe pe̍h-chha̍t ê sîn, hō͘ hiah-ê sian-ti kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.’ Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Lí kā i ín-iú, it-tēng ōe sêng-kong. Lí khì, chiàu án-ni chòe.’
Hiān-chāi Siōng Chú ū hō͘ pe̍h-chha̍t ê sîn ji̍p tī lí chiah-ê sian-ti ê chhùi; Siōng Chú soan-pò͘ beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ lí.”
Ki-ná-ná ê kiáⁿ Se-tí-ka kiâⁿ chìn-chêng, siàn Bí-kai-ngá ê chhùi-phóe, kóng, “Siōng Chú ê sîn sím-mi̍h sî lī-khui góa lâi tùi lí kóng-ōe?”
Bí-kai-ngá kóng, “Lí khì bih tī ba̍t-pâng hit-ji̍t chiū ōe chai.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kóng, “Chiong Bí-kai-ngá lia̍h--khí-lâi, kau hō͘ chhī-tiúⁿ A-bûn kap ông ê kiáⁿ Iok-a-si,
kā in kóng, ‘Ông kau-tài: Chiong chit-ê lâng koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ, hō͘ i chi̍t-sut-á piáⁿ kap chúi chiū hó, thèng-hāu góa pêng-an tò--lâi.’”
Bí-kai-ngá kóng, “Lí nā chin-chiàⁿ pêng-an tò--lâi, chiū-sī Siōng Chú bô thok góa kóng-ōe.” Koh kóng, “Lín tāi-ke, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit góa kóng ê ōe!”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap kap Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat khì chìn-kong Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông tùi Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Góa beh kái-chong chiūⁿ chiàn-tiûⁿ, lí thang chhēng lí ê ông-ho̍k.” Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chiū kái-chong chiūⁿ-tīn.
Sū-lī-a -ông ū hoan-hù i saⁿ-cha̍p-jī ê chiàn-chhia-tiúⁿ, kóng, “M̄-thang kap in ê sū-peng á-sī koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kau-chiàn, chí-ū kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kau-chiàn.”
Chiàn-chhia-tiúⁿ khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-sa-hoat chiū kóng, “Chit-ê it-tēng sī Í-sek-lia̍t -ông!” In chiū oat-khì beh kong-kek i. Iok-sa-hoat chiū hoah kiù-miā.
Chiàn-chhia-tiúⁿ chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h i m̄-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, chiū oa̍t-cháu bô koh tui i.

Ū chi̍t ê Sū-lī-a ê peng-á khui keng, bô phah-sǹg siā-ji̍p Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chiàn-kah ê kap-chōa. Ông kā sái-chhia--ê kóng, “Góa tio̍h tāng-siong. Kín se̍h hoan-thâu, tòa góa lī-khui chiàn-tiûⁿ.”

Hit-ji̍t, kau-chiàn hui-siông béng-lia̍t. Ū lâng hû ông hō͘ i khiā tī chhia--ni̍h, bīn ǹg Sū-lī-a -lâng; kàu hông-hun ông chiū sí, huih tùi tio̍h-siong ê khang-chhùi lâu kàu chhia-tóe.
Ji̍t beh lo̍h ê sî, ū siaⁿ thoân-piàn kun-iâⁿ, kóng, “Ta̍k-ê lâng tò-khì ka-kī ê pún-siâⁿ, tò-khì ka-kī ê pún-tōe.”
Ông sí, lâng chiong i tòa tò-khì Sat-má-lī-a; in chiong ông an-chòng tī hia.
Ū lâng tī Sat-má-lī-a ê chúi-tî piⁿ sóe i ê chhia (chhiong-ki mā tī hia sóe seng-khu), káu lâi chī i ê huih, tú chiàu Siōng Chú só͘ kóng ê ōe.
A-hap kî-tha ê sū-chek, kap i ê só͘-chòe, í-ki̍p i khí-chō chhiūⁿ-gê-kiong kap siâⁿ, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
A-hap tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia; i ê kiáⁿ A-hap-siā sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap tē-sì nî, A-sat ê kiáⁿ Iok-sa-hoat chòe Iû-tāi -ông.
Iok-sa-hoat chē-ūi ê sî saⁿ-cha̍p-gō͘ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông jī-cha̍p-gō͘ nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe A-so͘-pa, sī Sī-lī-hi ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Iok-sa-hoat kiâⁿ i lāu-pē A-sat ê lō͘, lóng bô phian-lī, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū; m̄-kú soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ iáu-bē hòe-tû, jîn-bîn iû-goân tī hia hiàn-chè sio-hiuⁿ.
Iok-sa-hoat kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ông hô-pêng siong-chhù.
Iok-sa-hoat kî-tha ê sū-chek, i ê sêng-chiū, í-ki̍p án-chóaⁿ kau-chiàn, lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
I ê lāu-pē A-sat lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê loân-tông, Iok-sa-hoat lóng tùi kok-lāi tû--khì.
Hit-sî Í-tong bô ông, Iok-sa-hoat phài chóng-tok tī-lí.
Iok-sa-hoat chō Tha-si ê chûn-tūi beh khì Gô-hui ūn kim lâi; m̄-kú khì bô sêng, in-ūi chûn tī Í-sûn Ka-pia̍t sit-sū.
A-hap ê kiáⁿ A-hap-siā tùi Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa ê pō͘-hā kap lí ê pō͘-hā chē-chûn chòe-hé khì.” M̄-kú Iok-sa-hoat m̄-khéng.
Iok-sa-hoat tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, kap i ê lia̍t-chó͘ an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ; i ê kiáⁿ Iok-lân sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat cha̍p-chhit nî, A-hap ê kiáⁿ A-hap-siā tī Sat-má-lī-a chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t nn̄g nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, kiâⁿ i ê lāu-pē kap lāu-bú ê lō͘, chiū-sī kiâⁿ Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lō͘, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe.
I kap i ê lāu-pē kâng-khoán ho̍k-sāi kèng-pài Pa-le̍k, kek Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè siū-khì.
A-hap sí-liáu, Mô͘-ap pōe-poān Í-sek-lia̍t.

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap-siā tī Sat-má-lī-a tùi ông-kiong lâu-téng ê lân-kan poa̍h--lo̍h-lâi, siū-siong; chiū chhe sù-chiá, tùi in kóng, “Lín khì mn̄g Í-kek-lûn ê sîn-bêng Pa-le̍k Se-pok, góa chit-ê siong ōe hó bōe?”

Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kā Thê-su-pí -lâng Í-lī-a kóng, “Lí khí--lâi, khì kìⁿ Sat-má-lī-a -ông ê sù-chiá, mn̄g in kóng, ‘Lín khì mn̄g Í-kek-lûn ê sîn-bêng Pa-le̍k Se-pok, sī in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t tiong bô Siōng-tè sī--bô?
Lín tio̍h khì kā ông kóng, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lí bōe-tàng koh tùi hiān-chāi teh tó ê bîn-chhn̂g khí--lâi; lí it-tēng ōe sí.’” Í-lī-a chiū khì.
Sù-chiá tò-khì kìⁿ ông, ông mn̄g in kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ tò--lâi?”

Sù-chiá ìn i kóng, “Goán tú-tio̍h chi̍t ê lâng, i kā goán kóng, ‘Lín tò-khì kìⁿ chhe lín ê ông, tùi i kóng, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lí chhe lâng khì mn̄g Í-kek-lûn ê sîn-bêng Pa-le̍k Se-pok, sī in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t tiong bô Siōng-tè sī--bô? Só͘-í lí bōe-tàng koh tùi hiān-chāi teh tó ê bîn-chhn̂g khí--lâi; lí it-tēng ōe sí.’”
Ông mn̄g in kóng, “Lâi tú-tio̍h lín, kā lín kóng chiah-ê ōe ê lâng sī sím-mi̍h khoán lâng?”
In ìn kóng, “I chhēng ū-mn̂g ê saⁿ, io hâ phê-tòa.” Ông kóng, “I it-tēng sī Thê-su-pí -lâng Í-lī-a.”

Ông chiū phài chi̍t ê koán gō͘-cha̍p lâng ê kun-koaⁿ chhōa hiah-ê pō͘-hā khì Í-lī-a hia. I peh-chiūⁿ soaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-lī-a chē tī soaⁿ-téng. Kun-koaⁿ kā Í-lī-a kóng, “Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, ông bēng-lēng lí lo̍h--lâi.”

Í-lī-a ìn kun-koaⁿ kóng, “Góa nā-sī Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, goān thiⁿ kàng-hé, sio lí kap lí hit gō͘-cha̍p ê lâng.” Chiū ū hé tùi thiⁿ lo̍h--lâi, sio-bia̍t i kap hit gō͘-cha̍p lâng.

Ông koh phài chi̍t ê koán gō͘-cha̍p lâng ê kun-koaⁿ chhōa hiah-ê pō͘-hā khì Í-lī-a hia. Kun-koaⁿ kā Í-lī-a kóng, “Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, ông bēng-lēng lí kóaⁿ-kín lo̍h--lâi.”

Í-lī-a ìn kóng, “Góa nā-sī Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, goān thiⁿ kàng-hé, sio lí kap lí hit gō͘-cha̍p ê lâng.” Chiū ū chin tōa ê hé tùi thiⁿ lo̍h--lâi, sio-bia̍t i kap hit gō͘-cha̍p lâng.

Ông tē-saⁿ piàn koh phài chi̍t ê koán gō͘-cha̍p lâng ê kun-koaⁿ chhōa hiah-ê pō͘-hā khì. Hit-ê tē-saⁿ tūi ê kun-koaⁿ peh-chiūⁿ soaⁿ, kūi tī Í-lī-a ê bīn-chêng, ai-kiû i, kóng, “Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, kiû lí khòaⁿ góa kap lí chit gō͘-cha̍p ê po̍k-jîn ê sìⁿ-miā chòe pó-pòe.
Í-keng ū hé tùi thiⁿ kàng-lo̍h, sio-bia̍t í-chêng nn̄g ê kun-koaⁿ, kap hit chi̍t-pah lâng. Taⁿ kiû lí khòaⁿ góa ê sìⁿ-miā chòe pó-pòe.”
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tùi Í-lī-a kóng, “Lí kap i lo̍h--khì, m̄-bián kiaⁿ i.” Í-lī-a chiū khí--lâi, kap i lo̍h-khì kìⁿ ông,

tùi ông kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lí phài lâng khì mn̄g Í-kek-lûn ê sîn-bêng Pa-le̍k Se-pok, sī in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t tiong bô Siōng-tè hō͘ lí thang mn̄g sī--bô? Só͘-í lí bōe-tàng koh tùi hiān-chāi teh tó ê bîn-chhn̂g khí--lâi, lí it-tēng ōe sí.’”

A-hap-siā chiū sí, tú chiàu Í-lī-a só͘ thoân-ta̍t Siōng Chú ê ōe. Ông bô kiáⁿ, i ê sió-tī Iok-hô-lân sòa-chiap i choh-ông; hit-sî sī Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat ê kiáⁿ Iok-lân choh-ông tē-jī nî.
A-hap-siā kî-tha ê sū-chek lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Siōng Chú teh-beh ēng kńg-lê-á-hong chiap Í-lī-a chiūⁿ-thiⁿ ê sî, Í-lī-a kap Í-lī-sa chòe-hé lī-khui Kiat-kah.

Í-lī-a tùi Í-lī-sa kóng, “Siōng Chú chhe góa khì Pek-te̍k-lī, lí tio̍h lâu tiàm chia.” Í-lī-sa kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú kap lí ê sìⁿ-miā chiù-chōa, góa it-tēng bô beh lī-khui lí.” In nn̄g ê lâng chiū chòe-hé lo̍h-khì Pek-te̍k-lī.

Pek-te̍k-lī hiah-ê sian-ti ê ha̍k-seng chhut-lâi kìⁿ Í-lī-sa, tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú kin-á-ji̍t beh chiap lí ê lāu-su lī-khui lí khì, lí chai--bô?” I kóng, “Góa chai, chhiáⁿ lín tiām-tiām.”

Í-lī-a kā i kóng, “ Í-lī-sa, Siōng Chú chhe góa khì Iâ-lī-ko, lí tio̍h lâu tiàm chia.” Í-lī-sa kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú kap lí ê sìⁿ-miā chiù-chōa, góa it-tēng bô beh lī-khui lí.” In chiū kàu Iâ-lī-ko.

Iâ-lī-ko hiah-ê sian-ti ê ha̍k-seng lâi Í-lī-sa hia, tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú kin-á-ji̍t beh chiap lí ê lāu-su lī-khui lí, lí chai--bô?” I kóng, “Góa chai, chhiáⁿ lín tiām-tiām.”

Í-lī-a tùi Í-lī-sa kóng, “Siōng Chú chhe góa khì Iok-tàn-hô, lí tio̍h lâu tiàm chia.” Í-lī-sa kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú kap lí ê sìⁿ-miā chiù-chōa, góa it-tēng bô beh lī-khui lí.” In nn̄g ê lâng chiū chòe-hé khì.
Ū gō͘-cha̍p ê sian-ti ê ha̍k-seng tè in khì, hn̄g-hn̄g khiā tī in ê tùi-bīn; in nn̄g lâng khiā tī Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ.
Í-lī-a chiong i ê gōa-saⁿ kńg--khí-lâi, phah hô-chúi, chúi chiū hun siang-pêng; in nn̄g lâng kiâⁿ ta-tōe kè--khì.

Kè-khì liáu, Í-lī-a tùi Í-lī-sa kóng, “Góa siū chiap lī-khui lí í-chêng, lí ài góa ūi-tio̍h lí chòe sím-mi̍h? Lí tio̍h kā góa kóng.” Í-lī-sa kóng, “Kiû lí chiong kám-tōng lí ê sîn ka-pē hō͘ góa.”
Í-lī-a kóng, “Lí só͘ kiû--ê chin khùn-lân. M̄-kú, góa siū chiap lī-khui lí ê sî, lí nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa, chiū ōe tit--tio̍h; nā bô, chiū tit bōe tio̍h.”
In ná kiâⁿ ná kóng ê sî, hut-jiân ū hé-chiàn-chhia hé-bé, chiong in nn̄g lâng keh-khui; Í-lī-a chiū chē kńg-lê-á-hong siū chiap chiūⁿ-thiⁿ.

Í-lī-sa khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū hoah kóng, “Su-hū ah, su-hū ah! Í-sek-lia̍t ê chiàn-chhia kap bé-peng ah!” Āu-lâi Í-lī-sa bô koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-lī-a; chiū chiong ka-kī ê saⁿ thiah chòe nn̄g pêng.
I khioh Í-lī-a ka-la̍uh--lo̍h-lâi ê gōa-saⁿ, tò-tńg-khì khiā tī Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ,
ēng hit-niá gōa-saⁿ phah hô-chúi, kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-lī-a ê Siōng-tè tī tó-ūi?” Phah chúi liáu-āu, chúi chiū pun-chòe nn̄g pêng, Í-lī-sa chiū kè--khì.

Í-lī-sa tùi-bīn hiah-ê Iâ-lī-ko sian-ti ê ha̍k-seng khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū kóng, “Kám-tōng Í-lī-a ê sîn lîm-chāi tī Í-lī-sa lah!” In chiū lâi gêng-chiap i, phak-lo̍h tī i ê bīn-chêng.

In tùi Í-lī-sa kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn chia ū gō͘-cha̍p ê ióng-sū; chhiáⁿ lí ún-chún in khì chhē lí ê lāu-su; khó-lêng Siōng Chú ê sîn tòa i khì, kā i hiat tī bó͘ chi̍t ê soaⁿ, á-sī bó͘ chi̍t ê soaⁿ-kok.” I kóng, “M̄-bián chhe lâng khì.”

In it-ti̍t kā Í-lī-sa ko͘-chiâⁿ, Í-lī-sa hō͘ in pek kah chin ûi-lân, chiū kóng, “Lín thang chhe hiah-ê ióng-sū khì.” In chiū chhe gō͘-cha̍p lâng khì, chhē saⁿ ji̍t, chhē lóng bô.
Í-lī-sa tī Iâ-lī-ko thèng-hāu; in tò--lâi liáu-āu, i kā in kóng, “Góa kiám bô kā lín kóng, m̄-bián khì chhē?”
Iâ-lī-ko -siâⁿ ê lâng tùi Í-lī-sa kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, chiàu lí só͘ chai chit-ê siâⁿ ê tōe-sè chin hó; m̄-kú chúi-chit chin bái, thó͘-tōe bōe seng-sán.”
Í-lī-sa kóng, “Lín ēng chi̍t tè sin ê óaⁿ, tóe iâm the̍h-lâi hō͘ góa.” In chiū the̍h-lâi hō͘ i.

I khì kàu chúi-chôaⁿ hia, chiong iâm tò tī chúi--ni̍h, kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa i-hó chit-ê chúi; chit-ê chúi bōe koh hō͘ lâng sí, mā bōe koh hō͘ tōe bô seng-sán.’”
Hit-ê chúi chiū pìⁿ-chòe hó-chúi, kàu kin-á-ji̍t; tú chiàu Í-lī-sa só͘ kóng ê ōe.

Í-lī-sa tùi hia chiūⁿ-khì Pek-te̍k-lī, tī lō͘--ni̍h teh kiâⁿ ê sî, ū siàu-liân-lâng tùi siâⁿ-lāi chhut--lâi, kā i thí-chhiò, kóng, “Thuh-thâu--ê, siám-cháu! Thuh-thâu--ê, siám-cháu!”
I oa̍t-thâu kā in khòaⁿ, hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ chiù-chó͘ in, chiū ū nn̄g chiah hîm-bú tùi chhiū-nâ chhut--lâi, thiah-li̍h in tiong-kan sì-cha̍p-jī ê siàu-liân-lâng.
I tùi hia chiūⁿ Ka-bi̍t-soaⁿ; koh tùi hia tò-khì Sat-má-lī-a.
Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat cha̍p-poeh nî, A-hap ê kiáⁿ Iok-hô-lân tī Sat-má-lī-a chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông cha̍p-jī nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, m̄-kú bô chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê pē-bú só͘ chòe--ê hiah-ni̍h pháiⁿ, in-ūi i ū chiong i ê lāu-pē só͘ chō Pa-le̍k ê thiāu-siōng tû--khì.
Iáu-kú i kap Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an kâng-khoán, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe, lóng bô thêng-chí.
Mô͘-ap -ông Bí-sa chhī chin chōe iûⁿ, bat ēng cha̍p-bān chiah iûⁿ-á, cha̍p-bān chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng ê mn̂g, ǹg Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chìn-kòng.
A-hap sí liáu-āu, Mô͘-ap -ông pōe-poān Í-sek-lia̍t -ông.
Hit-sî Iok-hô-lân -ông tùi Sat-má-lī-a chhut-hoat, tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t kun-peng.

Siâng-sî, i mā phài lâng khì kìⁿ Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat, kóng, “ Mô͘-ap -ông pōe-poān góa, lí kiám beh kap góa chòe-hé khì kong-táⁿ Mô͘-ap?” Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Góa goān-ì kap lí chòe-hé khì; góa ê chiū-sī lí ê, góa ê jîn-bîn chiū-sī lí ê jîn-bîn, góa ê bé chiū-sī lí ê bé.
Taⁿ lán beh tùi tó chi̍t tiâu lō͘ khì kong-táⁿ?” Iok-hô-lân kóng, “Tùi Í-tong khòng-iá ê lō͘.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kap Iû-tāi -ông, í-ki̍p Í-tong -ông chòe-hé chhut-hoat; in se̍h chi̍t-tōa-lìn kiâⁿ chhit ji̍t ê lō͘-chām, kun-tūi kap tè in ê cheng-siⁿ bô chúi thang lim.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kóng, “Chhám ah, Siōng Chú chū-chi̍p lán saⁿ ê ông, goân-lâi sī beh chiong lán kau tī Mô͘-ap -lâng ê chhiú.”

Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Chia kiám bô Siōng Chú ê sian-ti hō͘ lán thang chhéng-būn Siōng Chú?” Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chi̍t ê jîn-sîn ìn kóng, “Í-chêng teh ho̍k-sāi Í-lī-a, Sa-hoat ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-sa tī chia.”
Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “I it-tēng ū Siōng Chú ê ōe.” Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, Iok-sa-hoat, kap Í-tong -ông chiū lo̍h-khì kìⁿ i.

Í-lī-sa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kóng, “Góa kap lí ū sím-mi̍h koan-hē? Lí khì chhē lín lāu-pē lāu-bú ê sian-ti.” Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kā i kóng, “Mài án-ni kóng. Siōng Chú chū-chi̍p goán saⁿ ê ông, sī beh chiong goán kau tī Mô͘-ap -lâng ê chhiú sī--bô?”
Í-lī-sa kóng, “Góa kí góa só͘ sū-hōng Éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chiù-chōa, góa nā m̄-sī chun-tiōng Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat, chiū m̄ kìⁿ lí, m̄ chhap lí.
Taⁿ tio̍h kā góa kiò chi̍t ê khîm-su lâi chia.” Khîm-su tôaⁿ ê sî, Siōng Chú ê khùi-la̍t lîm-kàu Í-lī-sa.
I chiū kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lín tio̍h tī chit-ê soaⁿ-kok ta̍k só͘-chāi ó͘ kau.
In-ūi Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, sui-jiân lín bô khòaⁿ-kìⁿ hong, bô khòaⁿ-kìⁿ hō͘; iáu-kú chit-ê soaⁿ-kok beh ū chúi móa-móa, thang hō͘ lín kap lín ê gû iûⁿ cheng-siⁿ lim.’
Chit-ê sū tùi Siōng Chú lâi kóng iáu-sī sió-sū; I beh koh chiong Mô͘-ap -lâng kau tī lín ê chhiú.

Lín beh kong-phòa in ta̍k-ê kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ kap súi ê siâⁿ, chhò ta̍k-châng hó ê ké-chí-chhiū, that-tiâu lóng-chóng ê chúi-chôaⁿ, ēng chio̍h-thâu húi-hoāi só͘-ū hó ê chhân-hn̂g.”
Keh-chá-khí hiàn-chè ê sî, hut-jiân ū chúi tùi Í-tong lâu--lâi, ta̍k só͘-chāi ū chúi móa-móa.
Mô͘-ap -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit saⁿ ê ông chiūⁿ--lâi, beh kap in kau-chiàn, só͘-ū ōe-tàng gia̍h bú-khì--ê, tùi lāu kàu siàu-liân, lóng lâi pian-kài hông-siú.
Keh-chá-khí in chá-chá khí--lâi, ji̍t-thâu chiò tī chúi-bīn, in tùi hn̄g-hn̄g khòaⁿ, chúi âng chhin-chhiūⁿ huih.
Mô͘-ap -lâng chiū kóng, “Kui-ê lóng sī huih! Hiah-ê ông hō͘-siōng kong-kek, it-tēng lóng sí ah. Mô͘-ap -lâng ah, lán tio̍h lâi-khì chhiúⁿ chiàn-lī-phín.”
Mô͘-ap -lâng lâi kàu Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-iâⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khí-lâi kong-kek in, in chiū tô-cháu. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tui-sat in,

húi-hoāi in ê siâⁿ; ēng chio̍h-thâu thūn-móa só͘-ū hó ê chhân-hn̂g, that-tiâu lóng-chóng ê chúi-chôaⁿ, koh chhò in ta̍k-châng hó ê ké-chí-chhiū; chí-ū chhun Kiat-ní Hap-lia̍t-siat ê chio̍h-chhiûⁿ; hìⁿ-chio̍h ê peng sì-ûi kong-kek chit-ê siâⁿ.
Mô͘-ap -ông khòaⁿ-tio̍h kau-chiàn tùi i put-lī, chiū tòa chhit-pah ê gia̍h-to ê peng beh chhiong-chhut pau-ûi, khì Sū-lī-a -ông hia, m̄-kú bô hoat-tō͘.

I chiū chiong beh sòa-chiap i choh-ông ê tōa-kiáⁿ, tī siâⁿ-téng hiàn chòe sio-hòa-chè; ū tōa siū-khì lîm-kàu Í-sek-lia̍t. Hit saⁿ ê ông chiū lī-khui Mô͘-ap, tò-khì in pún-kok.

Ū chi̍t ê sian-ti ê ha̍k-seng ê bó͘, tùi Í-lī-sa ai-kiû kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn, góa ê tiōng-hu í-keng sí; lí chai i sī kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê lâng. Taⁿ chè-chú lâi beh lia̍h góa nn̄g ê kiáⁿ khì chòe lô͘-lē.”

Í-lī-sa mn̄g i kóng, “Lí ài góa kā lí chòe sím-mi̍h? Lí kā góa kóng, lí chhù-lāi ū sím-mi̍h?” I kóng, “Lí ê lú-pī chhù-lāi chhun chi̍t pân iû, í-gōa ta̍k-hāng lóng bô.”
Í-lī-sa kóng, “Lí khì kā chhù-piⁿ chioh khang ê khì-khū, jú-chōe jú-hó;
jiân-āu ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi, koaiⁿ-mn̂g, kap lí hiah-ê kiáⁿ tiàm lāi-bīn, thîn-iû tī só͘-ū ê khì-khū; thîn-móa--ê hē chi̍t pêng.”
Hū-jîn-lâng tńg--khì, koaiⁿ-mn̂g, kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ tiàm lāi-bīn; kiáⁿ tòa khì-khū lâi hō͘ i, i chiū thîn-iû.
Hiah-ê khì-khū lóng thîn-móa, i kā i ê kiáⁿ kóng, “Koh the̍h khì-khū lâi hō͘ góa.” Kiáⁿ kóng, “Í-keng bô khì-khū lah.” Iû chiū bô koh lâu--chhut-lâi.
Hū-jîn-lâng khì kā Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng pò-kò, i chiū tùi hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Lí khì bōe iû lâi hêng-chè; só͘ chhun--ê, lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ thang tō͘-oa̍h.”

Ū chi̍t ji̍t Í-lī-sa lâi kàu Su-liām, tī hia ū chi̍t ê hó-gia̍h ê hū-jîn-lâng, kiông-kiông lâu i chia̍h-pn̄g; āu-lâi Í-lī-sa ta̍k-piàn tùi hia keng-kè, chiū ji̍p-khì hia chia̍h-pn̄g.
Hū-jîn-lâng kā i ê tiōng-hu kóng, “Siông-siông tùi lán chia keng-kè hit-ê lâng, góa khòaⁿ i sī sèng-chiá, sī Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng.
Lán lâi tī chhù-téng khí chi̍t keng sòe keng pâng-keng, lāi-bīn hē bîn-chhn̂g, toh-á, í-á, teng-tâi, hō͘ i lâi lán chia ê sî, thang ji̍p-khì hioh-khùn.”
Ū chi̍t ji̍t Í-lī-sa lâi kàu hia, chiū ji̍p-khì hit-keng pâng-keng hioh-khùn.
Í-lī-sa kā i ê po̍k-jîn Ki-hap-se kóng, “Lí chhiáⁿ chit-ê Su-liām ê hū-jîn-lâng lâi.” I khì chhiáⁿ i lâi, hū-jîn-lâng chiū lâi.

Í-lī-sa kā i ê po̍k-jîn kóng, “Lí kā i kóng, ‘Lí ūi-tio̍h goán hùi chin chōe sim-su, taⁿ góa tio̍h ūi-tio̍h lí chòe sím-mi̍h? Lí ài góa thòe lí kā ông á-sī goân-sòe chhéng-kiû sím-mi̍h?’” Hū-jîn-lâng ìn kóng, “Góa kap góa ê tông-pau chòe-hé khiā-khí, bô khiàm sím-mi̍h.”
Í-lī-sa mn̄g Ki-hap-se, kóng, “Án-ni, góa ōe-tàng ūi-tio̍h i chòe sím-mi̍h?” Ki-hap-se kóng, “I bô kiáⁿ, i ê tiōng-hu mā lāu ah.”
Í-lī-sa koh kóng, “Chhiáⁿ i lâi.” Ki-hap-se chiū chhiáⁿ i lâi. Hū-jîn-lâng lâi khiā tī mn̂g-kháu.
Í-lī-sa kóng, “Mê-nî chit-ê sî, lí ōe phō chi̍t ê ta-po͘-kiáⁿ.” Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Góa ê chú, Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, mài kā góa phiàn.”
Hū-jîn-lâng kó-jiân hoâi-īn, kàu keh-nî chit-ê sî siⁿ chi̍t ê ta-po͘-eⁿ, tú chiàu Í-lī-sa só͘ kóng ê ōe.
Gín-á tōa-hàn; ū chi̍t ji̍t chhut-khì kàu i ê lāu-pē kap siu-koah ê lâng hia.
I tùi lāu-pē kóng, “Góa ê thâu-khak, góa ê thâu-khak!” I ê lāu-pē kā po̍k-jîn kóng, “Kín kā phō-khì in lāu-bú hia.”
Po̍k-jîn chiū kā phō-khì i ê lāu-bú hia; gín-á chē tī lāu-bú ê kha-thâu-u, kàu tiong-tàu chiū sí.
Lāu-bú phō i ê kiáⁿ peh-khí-khì lâu-téng, chiong i ê kiáⁿ hē tī Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ê bîn-chhn̂g, koaiⁿ-mn̂g chhut--lâi.
I kiò i ê tiōng-hu lâi, kā i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chhe chi̍t ê po̍k-jîn khan chi̍t chiah lû lâi góa chia; góa beh kóaⁿ-kín khì chhē Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, chiah tò--lâi.”
Tiōng-hu kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t m̄-sī chhoe-it, mā m̄-sī An-hioh-ji̍t, sī-án-chóaⁿ lí beh khì i hia?” Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Bô sím-mi̍h tāi-chì!”
Lû chún-pī hó-sè, i chiū kā po̍k-jîn kóng, “Kiâⁿ, kóaⁿ-kín lâi-khì! Góa nā bô kā lí kóng, m̄-thang bān--lo̍h-lâi.”

Hū-jîn-lâng chiū khì Ka-bi̍t-soaⁿ, Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng hia. Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng hn̄g-hn̄g khòaⁿ-tio̍h hū-jîn-lâng, kā i ê po̍k-jîn Ki-hap-se kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, Su-liām ê hū-jîn-lâng lâi ah.
Lí cháu-khì gêng-chiap i, mn̄g i kóng, ‘Lí pêng-an--bô? Lí ê tiōng-hu pêng-an--bô? Gín-á pêng-an--bô?’” Hū-jîn-lâng ìn kóng, “Lóng pêng-an.”

Hū-jîn-lâng chiūⁿ-soaⁿ, khì kàu Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng hia, kā Í-lī-sa ê kha mo͘h--teh. Ki-hap-se chìn-chêng beh kā i chhia-khui; Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng kóng, “Chhut-chāi i, in-ūi i sim-lāi thòng-khó͘; Siōng Chú tùi góa ún-môa chit-ê tāi-chì, bô kā góa kóng.”
Hū-jîn-lâng tùi Í-lī-sa kóng, “Góa kiám bat tùi góa ê chú kiû kiáⁿ? Góa kiám bô kóng mài kā góa phiàn?”

Í-lī-sa kā Ki-hap-se kóng, “Lí tio̍h chún-pī thang chhut-hoat, gia̍h góa ê koáiⁿ-á, kóaⁿ-kín khì. Nā tú-tio̍h lâng, m̄-thang kā in chhéng-an; lâng nā kā lí chhéng-an, mā m̄-thang ìn. Tio̍h chiong góa ê koáiⁿ-á hē tī gín-á ê bīn.”
Gín-á ê lāu-bú kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú kap lí ê sìⁿ-miā chiù-chōa, góa it-tēng bô beh lī-khui lí.” Í-lī-sa chiū khí--lâi, tè i khì.

Ki-hap-se tāi-seng kàu-ūi, chiong koáiⁿ-á hē tī gín-á ê bīn; m̄-kú gín-á bô chhut-siaⁿ, bô hoán-èng. Ki-hap-se tò-tńg--khì, tú-tio̍h Í-lī-sa, kā i kóng, “Gín-á bô chhíⁿ.”
Í-lī-sa kàu-ūi, ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h gín-á í-keng sí, hē tī i ê bîn-chhn̂g.
I ji̍p--khì, chiū koaiⁿ-mn̂g, chí-ū in nn̄g ê tī lāi-bīn; i chiū kî-tó Siōng Chú.

I peh-khí-khì bîn-chhn̂g phak tī gín-á ê seng-khu, chhùi tùi chhùi, ba̍k-chiu tùi ba̍k-chiu, chhiú tùi chhiú. I kui seng-khu àⁿ tī gín-á ê téng-bīn ê sî, gín-á chiām-chiām hôe-ho̍k thé-un.
I lo̍h--lâi, tī chhù-lāi kiâⁿ chi̍t lìn, koh peh--khí-khì, kui seng-khu àⁿ tī gín-á ê téng-bīn. Gín-á phah-ka-chhiùⁿ chhit piàn, ba̍k-chiu chiū thí-khui.
Í-lī-sa kiò Ki-hap-se, kóng, “Lí kiò chit-ê Su-liām ê hū-jîn-lâng lâi.” Ki-hap-se chiū khì kiò i. I chiū ji̍p--lâi, Í-lī-sa tùi i kóng, “Kā lí ê gín-á phō--khí-lâi.”
Hū-jîn-lâng phak tī Í-lī-sa ê kha-chêng, pài i, jiân-āu phō i ka-kī ê kiáⁿ chhut--khì.

Ū chi̍t piàn, kok-lāi hoat-seng ki-hng, Í-lī-sa tńg-lâi Kiat-kah. Sian-ti ê ha̍k-seng chē tī i ê bīn-chêng, i hoan-hù po̍k-jîn kóng, “Lí khí-hé, ēng tōa ê e-á chú chhài-thng hō͘ ha̍k-seng chia̍h.”

Ū chi̍t ê lâng khì hn̂g--ni̍h bán-chhài, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t châng iá-koe-tîn, chiū bán chin chōe iá-koe tò--lâi; chhiat-chhiat--leh lok tī chú chhài-thng ê e-á; in m̄ bat hit-ê sī sím-mi̍h.
Chú hó, tò chhut-lâi hō͘ tāi-ke chia̍h. In chia̍h ê sî, lóng hoah kóng, “Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, e-á lāi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chia̍h-liáu ōe sí.” In chiū m̄-káⁿ chia̍h.
Í-lī-sa kóng, “The̍h chi̍t-kóa mī-hún lâi.” I chiong mī-hún iā tī e--ni̍h, kóng, “Tò chhut-lâi hō͘ tāi-ke chia̍h.” E-á lāi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chiū bô koh ū to̍k.

Ū chi̍t ê lâng tùi Pa-le̍k Sa-lī-sa lâi, tòa chho͘-se̍k ê tōa-be̍h chòe ê piáⁿ jī-cha̍p ê, kap sin ê be̍h-sūi, tóe tī tē-á, sàng hō͘ Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng. Í-lī-sa kóng, “Chiong chiah-ê hō͘ tāi-ke chia̍h.”

I ê po̍k-jîn kóng, “Chiah-ê kiám ū kàu hō͘ chi̍t-pah ê lâng chia̍h?” Í-lī-sa kóng, “Chòe lí pun hō͘ tāi-ke chia̍h, in-ūi Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘In beh chia̍h kàu pá, koh ū chhun.’”
I ê po̍k-jîn chiū pun hō͘ tāi-ke. Chiàu Siōng Chú só͘ kóng ê ōe, in lóng chia̍h kah pá, koh ū chhun.

Sū-lī-a -ông ê goân-sòe Nái-bān, tī i ê chú-lâng bīn-chêng sī tiōng-iàu jîn-bu̍t, chin siū chun-tiōng, in-ūi Siōng Chú bat thong-kè i hō͘ Sū-lī-a tek-sèng. I sī kiông-béng ê ióng-sū; m̄-kú tì-tio̍h bâ-hong-pīⁿ.
Ū chi̍t piàn, Sū-lī-a -lâng kui-tīn chhut--khì, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe lia̍h chi̍t ê cha-bó͘ gín-á; i chiū sū-hāu Nái-bān ê bó͘.
Chit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á kā i ê lú-chú-lâng kóng, “Khó͘-bōe-tit góa ê chú-lâng ōe-tàng khì kìⁿ Sat-má-lī-a ê sian-ti; i it-tēng ōe-tàng i-hó chú-lâng ê bâ-hong-pīⁿ.”
Nái-bān khì tùi i ê chú-lâng kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t ê cha-bó͘ gín-á án-ni án-ni kóng.”

Sū-lī-a -ông kóng, “Lí thang khì, góa mā beh kià lí the̍h chi̍t tiuⁿ phoe hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông.” Nái-bān chiū chhut-hoat, tòa saⁿ-pah kong-kun ê gûn, chhit-cha̍p kong-kun ê kim, cha̍p thò i-ho̍k.
I koh chiong hit-tiuⁿ phoe the̍h hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông; phoe-lāi án-ni siá, “Góa phài góa ê jîn-sîn Nái-bān the̍h phoe khì kìⁿ lí, lí tio̍h i-hó i ê bâ-hong-pīⁿ.”

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông phoe khòaⁿ-liáu, chiū thiah-li̍h i ê saⁿ, kóng, “Góa kiám sī Siōng-tè, ōe-tàng hō͘ lâng sí, hō͘ lâng oa̍h? Chit-ê lâng kèng-jiân phài lâng lâi góa chia, kiò góa tio̍h i-hó i ê jîn-sîn ê bâ-hong-pīⁿ; chhiáⁿ lín chim-chiok siūⁿ, khòaⁿ chit-ê lâng án-chóaⁿ chhē-khang-chhē-phāng kong-kek góa.”

Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng Í-lī-sa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông thiah-li̍h i ê saⁿ, chiū chhe lâng khì kìⁿ ông kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ thiah-li̍h saⁿ? Hō͘ hit-ê lâng lâi góa chia, i chiū chai Í-sek-lia̍t tiong ū sian-ti.”
Nái-bān chiū tòa i ê bé-chhia-tūi lâi, thêng tī Í-lī-sa ê chhù mn̂g-kháu.
Í-lī-sa chhe chi̍t ê sù-chiá tùi Nái-bān kóng, “Lí khì Iok-tàn-hô sóe seng-khu sóe chhit piàn, lí ê bah ōe ho̍k-goân, lí chiū chheng-khì.”

Nái-bān chiū siū-khì, lī-khui, kóng, “Góa pún-lâi siūⁿ-kóng i it-tēng ōe chhut-lâi kìⁿ góa, khiā-teh kiû-kiò Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè ê miâ, tī hoān-tio̍h pīⁿ ê só͘-chāi iô-chhiú, i-hó góa ê bâ-hong-pīⁿ.

Tāi-má-sū-kek ê A-má-ná-hô kap Hoat-ní-hoat-hô, kiám bô pí Í-sek-lia̍t só͘-ū ê chúi khah hó? Góa tī hia sóe seng-khu kiám bōe tit-tio̍h chheng-khì?” I chiū siū-khì, oa̍t-tńg-sin chòe i khì.

I hiah-ê po̍k-jîn chìn-chêng, tùi i kóng, “Chú-lâng, sian-ti nā kah lí khì chòe khùn-lân ê tāi-chì, lí kiám bô beh chòe? Hô-hòng i kan-ta tùi lí kóng, khì sóe chiū chheng-khì?”
Nái-bān chiū chiàu Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ê ōe lo̍h-khì Iok-tàn-hô chìm chhit piàn; i ê bah ho̍k-goân chhin-chhiūⁿ gín-á ê bah, i chiū chheng-khì.

I kap só͘-ū tè i ê lâng tńg-lâi Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng hia, khiā tī i ê bīn-chêng kóng, “Taⁿ góa chai, choân sè-kài Í-sek-lia̍t í-gōa, bô Siōng-tè. Hiān-chāi chhiáⁿ lí siu lí ê po̍k-jîn ê lé-mi̍h.”
Í-lī-sa kóng, “Góa kí góa só͘ ho̍k-sāi éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, góa bô siu.” Nái-bān it-chài chhiáⁿ i siu, i lóng m̄-khéng.

Nái-bān kóng, “Lí nā bô beh chiap-siū, chhiáⁿ lí chiong nn̄g chiah lô ōe-tàng chài ê thô͘ hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn. Tùi hiān-chāi khí, lí ê po̍k-jîn bô beh koh tùi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng hiàn sio-hòa-chè á-sī pa̍t-khoán ê chè, chí-ū hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.

M̄-kú ū chi̍t hāng sū, goān Siōng Chú sià-bián lí ê po̍k-jîn, chiū-sī góa ê chú-lâng ji̍p Lîm-bûn -biō phak-pài ê sî, góa tio̍h sū-hāu i, só͘-í góa mā tio̍h tī Lîm-bûn -biō phak-pài; goān Siōng Chú tī chit-hāng sū sià-bián lí ê po̍k-jîn.”
Í-lī-sa chiū kā i kóng, “Lí thang pêng-an tò--khì.” Nái-bān lī-khui liáu, kiâⁿ chi̍t chām lō͘,

Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng Í-lī-sa ê po̍k-jîn Ki-hap-se siūⁿ-kóng, “Góa ê chú-lâng m̄-khéng chiap-siū chit-ê Sū-lī-a -lâng Nái-bān tòa--lâi ê lé-mi̍h; góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, góa beh cháu-khì jip i, tùi i the̍h--chi̍t-kóa.”
