Ki-hap-se chiū khì jip Nái-bān. Nái-bān khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū lâng teh jip i, chiū lo̍h-chhia gêng-chiap i, kóng, “Kiám ū sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?”

Ki-hap-se kóng, “Bô, bô te̍k-pia̍t ê tāi-chì. M̄-kú góa ê chú-lâng chhe góa lâi, kóng, ‘Tú-chiah ū sian-ti ê nn̄g ê siàu-liân ha̍k-seng, tùi Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu lâi góa chia; chhiáⁿ lí ēng gûn saⁿ-cha̍p kong-kun, i-ho̍k nn̄g thò hō͘ in.’”

Nái-bān kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chiap-siū la̍k-cha̍p kong-kun.” Nái-bān it-chài chhiáⁿ i siu. Nái-bān chiū chiong chng tī nn̄g ê tē-á hit la̍k-cha̍p kong-kun ê gûn, kap nn̄g thò i-ho̍k, kau hō͘ i nn̄g ê po̍k-jîn phāiⁿ--teh, kiâⁿ tī Ki-hap-se ê thâu-chêng.
In kàu soaⁿ-lûn-á, Ki-hap-se tùi in ê chhiú chiap mi̍h-kiāⁿ, hē ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi; chiū chhe in tńg--khì, in chiū tò--khì.
I ji̍p-khì khiā tī chú-lâng ê bīn-chêng. Í-lī-sa mn̄g i kóng, “ Ki-hap-se, lí tùi tó-ūi lâi?” Ki-hap-se ìn kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn bô khì tó-ūi.”

Í-lī-sa kā i kóng, “Hit-ê lâng lo̍h-chhia gêng-chiap lí ê sî, góa ê sim kiám bô kap lí tī hia? Che kiám sī chiap-siū gûn, chiap-siū i-ho̍k, kaⁿ-ná-hn̂g, phû-tô-hn̂g, gû, iûⁿ, po̍k-jîn, lú-pī ê sî?

In-ūi án-ni Nái-bān ê bâ-hong-pīⁿ beh thoân hō͘ lí kap lí ê hō͘-tāi, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.” Ki-hap-se tùi Í-lī-sa ê bīn-chêng thè--chhut-khì, chiū tì-tio̍h bâ-hong-pīⁿ, bah pe̍h kah chhin-chhiūⁿ seh.
Sian-ti ê ha̍k-seng tùi Í-lī-sa kóng, “Lāu-su, goán kap lí tòa ê só͘-chāi siuⁿ oe̍h.
Chhiáⁿ ún-chún goán khì Iok-tàn-hô, ta̍k-ê lâng tùi hia chhú chi̍t ki chhâ-liāu, tī hia khí tòa ê só͘-chāi.” Í-lī-sa kóng, “Hó, lín khì.”
Ū chi̍t ê kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kap po̍k-jîn chòe-hé lâi-khì.” Í-lī-sa ìn kóng, “Hó, góa kap lín khì.”
I chiū kap in chòe-hé khì. In kàu Iok-tàn-hô, chiū khai-sí chhò-chhiū.
Ū chi̍t ê lâng teh chhò ê sî, pó͘-thâu-bah lak lo̍h-khì chúi--ni̍h. I chiū kiò kóng, “Chhám ah! Lāu-su, chit-ki pó͘-thâu sī kā lâng chioh--ê.”

Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng kóng, “Lak tī tó-ūi?” I pò Í-lī-sa khòaⁿ lak--lo̍h-khì ê só͘-chāi. Í-lī-sa chiū chhò chi̍t ki chhâ tùi hia hiat--lo̍h-khì; pó͘-thâu-bah chiū phû--khí-lâi.
I kóng, “Khioh--khí-lâi.” Hit-ê lâng chiū chhun-chhiú kā khioh--khí-lâi.
Sū-lī-a -ông kap Í-sek-lia̍t kau-chiàn. I kap i ê jîn-sîn thó-lūn kóng, “Góa beh tī bó͘ só͘-chāi bó͘ só͘-chāi chat-iâⁿ.”
Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng chhe lâng khì kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, kóng, “Lí tio̍h sòe-jī, m̄-thang tùi bó͘ só͘-chāi keng-kè, in-ūi Sū-lī-a -lâng tī hia chat-iâⁿ.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông phài lâng khì kéng-kò Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng só͘ kóng hit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn, in chiū ka-kiông hông-pī. Kâng-khoán ê sū hoat-seng kúi-nā piàn.

Sū-lī-a -ông in-ūi chit-ê sū sim-lāi chin siū-khì, tiàu i ê jîn-sîn lâi, kā in kóng, “Lín tiong-kan siáⁿ-lâng lāu-sia̍p siau-sit hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, tio̍h láu-si̍t kā góa kóng.”
Ū chi̍t ê jîn-sîn kóng, “Góa ê chú, góa ê ông ah, m̄-sī goán. Sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê sian-ti Í-lī-sa chiong lí tī pâng-keng lāi kóng ê ōe kā Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kóng.”
Ông kóng, “Lín khì thàm-khòaⁿ i tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, góa thang phài lâng khì kā lia̍h.” Ū lâng tùi ông kóng, “I tī To-tan.”
Ông chiū phài bé, chiàn-chhia, kap chi̍t tōa-tūi kun-peng khì hia. In àm-sî kàu, pau-ûi hit-ê siâⁿ.

Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ê po̍k-jîn thàu-chá khí--lâi, chhut-khì gōa-bīn, khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū kun-peng, bé, kap chiàn-chhia kā siâⁿ pau-ûi--teh. Po̍k-jîn tùi Í-lī-sa kóng, “Chhám ah, lāu-su! Lán beh án-chóaⁿ?”
Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ! Kap lán chòe-hé--ê pí kap in chòe-hé--ê khah chōe.”

Í-lī-sa kî-tó kóng, “Siōng Chú, kiû lí khui i ê ba̍k-chiu, hō͘ i ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.” Siōng Chú chiū khui hit-ê po̍k-jîn ê ba̍k-chiu, i chiū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ kui-ê soaⁿ lóng sī hé-bé hé-chhia kā Í-lī-sa ûi--teh.

Sū-lī-a -lâng lo̍h-khì kàu Í-lī-sa hia, Í-lī-sa tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó kóng, “Kiû lí phah chiah-ê kun-peng, hō͘ in ba̍k-chiu bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.” Siōng Chú thiaⁿ Í-lī-sa ê kî-tó, hō͘ in bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Í-lī-sa tùi in kóng, “Lín kiâⁿ m̄-tio̍h lō͘, chhē m̄-tio̍h siâⁿ; tè góa lâi, góa chhōa lín khì lín beh chhē ê lâng hia.” Í-lī-sa chiū chhōa in kàu Sat-má-lī-a.

In ji̍p-khì Sat-má-lī-a, Í-lī-sa kî-tó kóng, “Siōng Chú, kiû lí khui chiah-ê lâng ê ba̍k-chiu, hō͘ in ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.” Siōng Chú khui in ê ba̍k-chiu, in chiū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, hoat-kiàn in lóng tī Sat-má-lī-a ê siâⁿ-lāi.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông khòaⁿ-tio̍h in, chiū mn̄g Í-lī-sa kóng, “Su-hū, góa kiám thang kā in thâi-sí? Kiám thang kā in thâi-sí?”

Í-lī-sa ìn kóng, “M̄-thang kā in thâi-sí. In kiám sī lí ēng to ēng keng lia̍h--lâi-ê, ná thang kā in thâi-sí? Tio̍h ēng piáⁿ kap chúi hō͘ in lim-chia̍h, hō͘ in thang tò-khì in ê chú-lâng hia.”

Ông ūi-tio̍h in chún-pī hong-sēng ê iàn-se̍k. In chia̍h-pá, ông kah in tò--khì; in chiū tò-khì in ê chú-lâng hia. Tùi án-ni, Sū-lī-a ê kun-peng bô koh chhim-hoān Í-sek-lia̍t ê kéng-kài.
Āu-lâi, Sū-lī-a -ông Piān Hap-ta̍t tiàu-chi̍p i ê choân-kun, chiūⁿ-lâi ûi-khùn Sat-má-lī-a.

Sat-má-lī-a ū tōa ki-hng; Sū-lī-a -lâng kè-sio̍k ûi-khùn siâⁿ, tì-kàu chi̍t ê lû-á ê thâu ta̍t gûn káu-pah kong-khek, nn̄g-pah kong-khek ê hún-chiáu-sái ta̍t la̍k-cha̍p kong-khek ê gûn-á.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông tùi siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng keng-kè ê sî, ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng tùi i kiû-kiò, kóng, “Góa ê chú, góa ê ông, pang-chān góa.”
Ông kóng, “Siōng Chú bô pang-chān lí, góa beh tùi tó-ūi pang-chān lí? Tùi ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ, á-sī tùi chiú-khut sī--bô?”

Ông koh kóng, “Lí ū sím-mi̍h kan-khó͘?” I ìn kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng tùi góa kóng, ‘Chiong lí ê kiáⁿ kau--chhut-lâi, lán kin-á-ji̍t chia̍h i; bîn-á-chài lán chia̍h góa ê kiáⁿ.’
Goán chiū chú góa ê kiáⁿ lâi chia̍h. Keh-ji̍t góa tùi i kóng, ‘Chiong lí ê kiáⁿ kau--chhut-lâi, lán chú lâi chia̍h.’ M̄-kú i chiong i ê kiáⁿ chhàng--khí-lâi.”
Ông thiaⁿ-tio̍h hū-jîn-lâng ê ōe, chiū thiah-li̍h saⁿ. I tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng keng-kè ê sî, jîn-bîn khòaⁿ-tio̍h i lāi-bīn chhēng chho͘-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ.
Ông kóng, “ Sa-hoat ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-sa ê thâu-khak kin-á-ji̍t nā iáu lâu tī i ê seng-khu, goān Siōng-tè ka-pē chek-hoa̍t góa.”

Hit-sî, Í-lī-sa chē tī chhù-lāi, tiúⁿ-ló mā kap i chòe-hé chē; ông seng phài chi̍t ê lâng khì. Sù-chiá iáu-bē kàu i hia, Í-lī-sa tùi tiúⁿ-ló kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, chit-ê hiong-siú ê kiáⁿ phài lâng lâi beh chhú góa ê thâu-khak. Tio̍h chù-ì, sù-chiá nā lâi, tio̍h koaiⁿ-mn̂g, kā i tòng tī mn̂g-gōa; i chú-lâng ê kha-pō͘ siaⁿ kiám bô tè tī i ê āu-bīn teh lâi?”
Í-lī-sa iáu-teh kap in kóng-ōe ê sî, ông lâi kàu i hia; ông kóng, “Chit-ê chai-hō sī tùi Siōng Chú lâi, góa ná tio̍h koh ǹg-bāng Siōng Chú pang-chān?”

Í-lī-sa kóng, “Lín tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe; Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Bîn-á-chài tāi-iok chit-ê sî, tī Sat-má-lī-a ê chhī-tiûⁿ, saⁿ kong-kun iù mī-hún ōe kan-ta bōe gûn cha̍p-it kong-khek, la̍k kong-kun tōa-be̍h mā chiah bōe gûn cha̍p-it kong-khek.’”

Ū chi̍t ê ông ê sī-ōe-koaⁿ ìn Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng kóng, “Siōng Chú chiū-sī khui thiⁿ-thang kàng-lo̍h ngó͘-kok, chit-ê tāi-chì mā bô khó-lêng hoat-seng.” Í-lī-sa kóng, “Lí beh chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h, m̄-kú chia̍h bōe tio̍h.”
Tī siâⁿ-mn̂g gōa ū sì ê bâ-hong-pīⁿ-lâng, in kóng-lâi-kóng-khì, “Lán ná tio̍h chē tī chia tán sí?

Lán nā ji̍p-siâⁿ, siâⁿ-lāi ū ki-hng, lán ōe sí tī hia; nā tiām-tiām chē tiàm chia, mā-sī sí. Lâi, lán lâi-khì tâu-hâng Sū-lī-a ê kun-tūi; in nā lâu lán ê sìⁿ-miā, lán chiū ōe oa̍h; in nā thâi lán, lán kâng-khoán mā-sī sí.”
Hông-hun ê sî, in chhut-hoat khì Sū-lī-a -lâng ê kun-iâⁿ. In kàu Sū-lī-a -lâng ê kun-iâⁿ piⁿ, kèng-jiân bô lâng tī hia.

In-ūi Chú hō͘ Sū-lī-a ê kun-tūi thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chiàn-chhia kap chiàn-bé ê siaⁿ, í-ki̍p tōa kun-tūi ê siaⁿ. In chiū hō͘-siōng kóng, “Che it-tēng sī Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chhiàⁿ Hek -lâng chu-ông kap Ai-ki̍p chu-ông lâi kong-kek lán.”
Só͘-í tī hông-hun ê sî in chiū pàng-sak in ê pò͘-pîⁿ, bé, lû, kun-iâⁿ, piàⁿ-miā tô-cháu.

Hiah-ê bâ-hong-pīⁿ-lâng lâi kàu kun-iâⁿ piⁿ, ji̍p chi̍t ê pò͘-pîⁿ, ia̍h-chia̍h-ia̍h-lim, koh tùi hia the̍h kim gûn kap i-ho̍k khì chhàng; āu-lâi koh ji̍p chi̍t ê pò͘-pîⁿ, mā tùi hia the̍h châi-bu̍t khì chhàng.

Hit-sî, in hō͘-siōng kóng, “Lán án-ni chòe m̄-tio̍h. Kin-á-ji̍t sī ū hó siau-sit ê ji̍t, m̄-kú lán soah tiām-tiām; nā thèng-hāu kàu thiⁿ-kng, lán chiū ū chōe. Kiâⁿ, lán lâi-khì pò ông-ka chai.”

In chiū khì kiò kò͘ siâⁿ-mn̂g ê lâng, kā in kóng, “Goán khì Sū-lī-a -lâng ê kun-iâⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h iâⁿ-lāi lóng bô lâng, bô-tōng-bô-chēng; chí-ū bé, lû pa̍k--teh, pò͘-pîⁿ lóng lâu--teh.”
Hiah-ê kò͘ siâⁿ-mn̂g ê lâng tōa-siaⁿ hoah, siau-sit chiū thoân kàu ông-ka.

Ông thàu-mî khí--lâi, kā i ê jîn-sîn kóng, “Góa kā lín kóng, che sī Sū-lī-a -lâng ê kè-bô͘. In chai lán iau-gō, só͘-í chhut kun-iâⁿ, bâi-ho̍k tī iá-gōa, kóng, ‘In chhut-siâⁿ ê sî, lán thang oa̍h-oa̍h lia̍h in, chiàm-léng chit-ê siâⁿ.’”

Ū chi̍t ê jîn-sîn tùi ông kóng, “Siâⁿ-lāi iáu ū chhun bé, chhiáⁿ lí phài lâng khan gō͘ chiah lâi, lán thang phài lâng khì thàm-cha; hoâiⁿ-ti̍t siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng kín-bān lóng ōe bia̍t-bông.”
In soán nn̄g tâi chiàn-chhia kap bé, ông chiū phài in khì thàm Sū-lī-a ê kun-tūi, kóng, “Lín khì thàm-cha.”
In tui-chong Sū-lī-a ê kun-tūi kàu Iok-tàn-hô, khòaⁿ-tio̍h iân-lō͘ lóng sī Sū-lī-a -lâng tô-cháu ê sî hiat-ka̍k ê i-ho̍k khì-khū. Sù-chiá chiū tò-lâi hôe-ho̍k ông.

Sat-má-lī-a ê chū-bîn chhut-khì chhiúⁿ Sū-lī-a -lâng ê kun-iâⁿ; án-ni, saⁿ kong-kun iù mī-hún bōe gûn cha̍p-it kong-khek, la̍k kong-kun tōa-be̍h bōe gûn cha̍p-it kong-khek; tú chiàu Siōng Chú só͘ kóng ê ōe.
Ông phài hit-ê sī-ōe-koaⁿ tī siâⁿ-mn̂g chí-hui, soah hō͘ chèng-lâng ta̍h-sí tī hia; tú chiàu Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng tī ông lo̍h-lâi kìⁿ i ê sî só͘ kóng ê ōe.

Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ū tùi ông kóng, “Bîn-á-chài tāi-iok chit-ê sî, tī Sat-má-lī-a ê chhī-tiûⁿ, la̍k kong-kun tōa-be̍h ōe kan-ta bōe gûn cha̍p-it kong-khek, saⁿ kong-kun iù mī-hún mā chiah bōe gûn cha̍p-it kong-khek.”

Hit-ê sī-ōe-koaⁿ tùi Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng kóng, “Siōng Chú chiū-sī khui thiⁿ-thang kàng-lo̍h ngó͘-kok, chit-ê tāi-chì mā bô khó-lêng hoat-seng.” Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng kóng, “Lí beh chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h, m̄-kú chia̍h bōe tio̍h.”
Chit-kù ōe kó-jiân hoat-seng tī hit-ê sī-ōe-koaⁿ sin-chiūⁿ, in-ūi chèng-lâng tī siâⁿ-mn̂g kā i ta̍h--sí.

Í-lī-sa bat hō͘ chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng ê kiáⁿ koh-oa̍h; i tùi chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Lí kap lí choân-ke kóaⁿ-kín khì tòa tī ōe-tàng seng-oa̍h ê só͘-chāi, in-ūi Siōng Chú beh hō͘ ki-hng lîm-kàu chit-ê só͘-chāi chhit nî kú.”
Hū-jîn-lâng chiū chiàu Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ê ōe, kap i choân-ke chhut-hoat khì Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tōe, tī hia tòa chhit nî.
Chhit nî móa, hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng tùi Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tōe tò--lâi. I ūi-tio̍h beh siu-hôe ka-kī ê chhù-the̍h chhân-hn̂g khì kìⁿ ông.
Hit-sî, ông kap Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ê po̍k-jîn Ki-hap-se teh kóng-ōe; ông kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí chiong Í-lī-sa só͘ chòe it-chhè ê tōa-sū kā góa kóng.”

Ki-hap-se teh kā ông kóng Í-lī-sa án-chóaⁿ hō͘ sí-lâng koh-oa̍h ê sî, tú-hó Í-lī-sa hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ koh-oa̍h ê hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng, ūi-tio̍h beh siu-hôe i ê chhù-the̍h chhân-hn̂g lâi kìⁿ ông. Ki-hap-se kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông, chit-ê chiū-sī hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng; hit-ê sī i ê kiáⁿ, Í-lī-sa ū hō͘ i koh-oa̍h.”

Ông mn̄g hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng, i chiū kā ông kóng; ông chiū ūi-tio̍h i phài chi̍t ê koaⁿ-oân, kóng, “Só͘-ū sio̍k chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng--ê lóng tio̍h hêng--i; tùi i lī-khui pún-tōe hit-ji̍t kàu kin-á-ji̍t, i ê chhân-hn̂g só͘ chhut-sán--ê, mā lóng tio̍h hêng--i.”
Í-lī-sa lâi kàu Tāi-má-sū-kek, tú-hó Sū-lī-a -ông Piān Hap-ta̍t teh phòa-pīⁿ; ū lâng tùi ông pò-kò, kóng, “Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng lâi tī chia.”
Ông chiū tùi Hap-sih kóng, “Lí tòa lé-mi̍h khì kìⁿ Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng, pài-thok i mn̄g Siōng Chú, khòaⁿ góa chit-ê pīⁿ ōe hó bōe?”

Hap-sih chiū khì kìⁿ Í-lī-sa. I ēng sì-cha̍p chiah lo̍k-tô chài Tāi-má-sū-kek ta̍k-khoán ê hó-mi̍h chòe lé-mi̍h, khiā tī Í-lī-sa ê bīn-chêng, kóng, “Lí ê kiáⁿ Sū-lī-a -ông Piān Hap-ta̍t phài góa lâi lí chia, chhiáⁿ-mn̄g lí, ‘Góa chit-ê pīⁿ kiám ōe hó?’”
Í-lī-sa kā i kóng, “Lí khì hôe-ho̍k i, kóng, ‘Lí ê pīⁿ it-tēng ōe hó.’ M̄-kú Siōng Chú chí-sī góa, i it-tēng ōe sí.”
Í-lī-sa ti̍t-ti̍t khòaⁿ Hap-sih, khòaⁿ kah i m̄-chai beh án-chóaⁿ. Í-lī-sa khai-sí háu.

Hap-sih kóng, “Góa ê chú, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ teh háu?” Í-lī-sa kóng, “In-ūi góa chai lí ōe án-chóaⁿ siong-hāi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; pàng-hé sio in ê pó-lúi, ēng to thâi-sí in ê siàu-liân-lâng, siak-sí in ê eⁿ-á, phòa-khui ū-sin ê hū-jîn-lâng.”

Hap-sih kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn sǹg siáⁿ, put-kò sī chi̍t chiah káu, ná ōe-tàng chòe chit-khoán tōa tāi-chì?” Í-lī-sa ìn kóng, “Siōng Chú chí-sī góa, lí ōe chòe Sū-lī-a -ông.”
Hap-sih lī-khui Í-lī-sa, tò-khì i ê chú-lâng hia; chú-lâng mn̄g i kóng, “ Í-lī-sa kā lí kóng sím-mi̍h?” I ìn kóng, “I kā góa kóng, lí ê pīⁿ it-tēng ōe hó.”
Keh-ji̍t Hap-sih the̍h kāu ê pò͘ ùn chúi, khàm ông ê bīn, kā i hip--sí. Hap-sih chiū sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
A-hap ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hô-lân tē-gō͘ nî, Iok-sa-hoat ê kiáⁿ Iok-lân khai-sí chòe Iû-tāi -ông.
Iok-lân chē-ūi ê sî saⁿ-cha̍p-jī hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông poeh nî.
I kiâⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t chu-ông ê lō͘, só͘-chòe kap A-hap -ke kâng-khoán; in-ūi i chhōa A-hap ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chòe bó͘, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū.

M̄-kú Siōng Chú in-ūi I ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê iân-kò͘, m̄-kam bia̍t Iû-tāi. Siōng Chú chiàu I tùi Tāi-pi̍t ê èng-ún, éng-oán siúⁿ-sù chi̍t pha teng hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun.
Iok-lân choh-ông ê sî, Í-tong pōe-poān Iû-tāi, thoat-lī Iû-tāi ê thóng-tī, siat-li̍p in ka-kī ê ông.

Iok-lân tòa só͘-ū ê chiàn-chhia kè-khì Sat-ek, soah siū pau-ûi. Iok-lân mî--sî khí--lâi, tu̍t-phòa pau-ûi i ê Í-tong -lâng kap chiàn-chhia-tiúⁿ; m̄-kú Iû-tāi kun-peng tô-cháu, ta̍k-ê tò-khì in tau.
Án-ni, Í-tong -lâng pōe-poān Iû-tāi, thoat-lī Iû-tāi ê thóng-tī kàu kin-á-ji̍t. Siâng hit-sî, Li̍p-ná mā pōe-poān.
Iok-lân kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê só͘-chòe, lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iok-lân tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, kap i ê lia̍t-chó͘ an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ. I ê kiáⁿ A-hap-siā sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
A-hap ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hô-lân cha̍p-jī nî, Iok-lân ê kiáⁿ A-hap-siā khai-sí chòe Iû-tāi -ông.
A-hap-siā chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-jī hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông chi̍t nî. I ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe A-tha-lī-ngá, sī Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Àm-lī ê cha-bó͘-sun.
I kiâⁿ A-hap -ke ê lō͘, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, kap A-hap -ke kâng-khoán; in-ūi i sī A-hap -ke ê kiáⁿ-sài.
A-hap-siā kap A-hap ê kiáⁿ Iok-hô-lân chòe-hé khì Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, kap Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih kau-chiàn; Sū-lī-a -lâng phah-siong Iok-hô-lân.

Iok-hô-lân -ông tò-khì Iâ-su-lia̍t, beh i-tī i tī La-boa̍t kap Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih kau-chiàn ê sî só͘ siū ê siong. Iok-lân ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông A-hap-siā lo̍h-khì Iâ-su-lia̍t, thàm-hóng A-hap ê kiáⁿ Iok-hô-lân, in-ūi i phòa-pīⁿ.
Sian-ti Í-lī-sa kiò chi̍t ê sian-ti ê ha̍k-seng lâi, kā i kóng, “Lí tio̍h chún-pī chhut-hoat, the̍h chit-pân iû, khì Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t.
Kàu hia, tio̍h chhē Lêng-sī ê sun, Iok-sa-hoat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-hō͘, tùi i tâng-phōaⁿ ê tiong-kan chhiáⁿ i chhut--lâi, chhōa i ji̍p lāi-pâng;
chiong pân-lāi ê iû tò tī i ê thâu-khak, kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa soán-li̍p lí chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông.’ Liáu-āu lí tio̍h khui-mn̂g, kóaⁿ-kín tô-cháu.”
Chit-ê siàu-liân ê sian-ti chiū khì Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t.

I kàu hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chèng kun-koaⁿ chòe-hé chē tī hia; i chiū kóng, “Chiong-kun, góa ū tāi-chì beh kā lí kóng.” Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “Lí beh kā goán tó chi̍t ê kóng?” Siàu-liân-lâng ìn kóng, “Chiong-kun, chiū-sī lí.”

Iâ-hō͘ chiū khí--lâi, ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi; siàu-liân-lâng ēng iû tò tī i ê thâu-khak, tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Góa soán-li̍p lí chòe Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông.
Lí tio̍h thâi-sí lí ê chú-lâng A-hap choân-ke, hō͘ góa thang pò-ho̍k Iâ-sé-phek lâu Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti kap kî-tha só͘-ū po̍k-jîn ê huih.
A-hap choân-ke lóng tio̍h bia̍t-bông; só͘-ū tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong sio̍k A-hap ê ta-po͘-lâng, bô-lūn sī chū-iû--ê á-sī bô chū-iû--ê, góa lóng beh kā in siau-bia̍t.
Góa beh hō͘ A-hap ê ke kap Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê ke kâng-khoán, mā kap A-hi-ngá ê kiáⁿ Pa-sa ê ke kâng-khoán.
Káu beh tī Iâ-su-lia̍t ê chhân-hn̂g chia̍h Iâ-sé-phek, mā bô lâng kā i bâi-chòng.’” Siàu-liân-lâng chiū khui-mn̂g tô-cháu.

Iâ-hō͘ chhut--khì, lâi kàu i chú-lâng ê kun-koaⁿ hia; ū chi̍t ê mn̄g i kóng, “Kiám ū sím-mi̍h tāi-chì? Sī-án-chóaⁿ chit-ê siáu--ê lâi chhē lí?” I kā in kóng, “Lín bat hit-ê lâng, mā chai i ōe kóng sím-mi̍h.”
In kóng, “Mài phiàn--goán, lí tio̍h kā goán kóng.” Iâ-hō͘ ìn kóng, “I kā góa kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa soán-li̍p lí chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông.’”
In ta̍k-ê lâng kóaⁿ-kín ēng ka-kī ê gōa-saⁿ pho͘ tī kiā-á ê téng-chàn, hō͘ Iâ-hō͘ khiā tī téng-bīn. In pûn sàu-kak soan-pò͘ kóng, “ Iâ-hō͘ choh-ông lah!”

Án-ni Lêng-sī ê sun, Iok-sa-hoat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-hō͘ pōe-poān Iok-hô-lân. Iok-hô-lân kap Í-sek-lia̍t kun-peng bat hông-siú Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, in-ūi Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t.

Āu-lâi, Iok-hô-lân -ông tò-khì Iâ-su-lia̍t, beh i-tī i kap Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih kau-chiàn ê sî siū ê siong. Iâ-hō͘ tùi hiah-ê kun-koaⁿ kóng, “Kì-jiân lín ióng-hō͘ góa choh-ông, tio̍h m̄-thang hō͘ lâng tô-cháu khì Iâ-su-lia̍t pò siau-sit.”
Iâ-hō͘ chiū sái chiàn-chhia khì Iâ-su-lia̍t, in-ūi Iok-hô-lân iáu tó tī chhn̂g--ni̍h. Iû-tāi -ông A-hap-siā í-keng khì tī hia thàm-hóng Iok-hô-lân.

Ū chi̍t ê siú-bōng--ê khiā tī Iâ-su-lia̍t siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng ê siú-bōng-tâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-hō͘ ê kun-tūi lâi, chiū kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t tīn kun-tūi.” Iok-hô-lân kóng, “Phài chi̍t ê bé-peng khì chiap i, sòa mn̄g i kóng, ‘Ū pêng-an--bô?’”

Hit-ê bé-peng khì gêng-chiap Iâ-hō͘, kóng, “Ông teh mn̄g, ū pêng-an--bô?” Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “Pêng-an bô pêng-an, bô lí ê tāi-chì. Tè góa āu-bīn!” Siú-bōng--ê pò-kò ông, kóng, “Sù-chiá kàu in hia, soah bô tò-tńg--lâi.”
Ông koh phài chi̍t ê bé-peng khì. I kàu in hia, kóng, “Ông teh mn̄g, ū sūn-lī--bô?” Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “Sūn-lī bô sūn-lī, bô lí ê tāi-chì. Tè góa āu-bīn!”
Siú-bōng--ê pò-kò ông kóng, “I khì in hia, mā bô tò-tńg--lâi; sái-chhia--ê chhiong chin hiông, khòaⁿ--khí-lâi ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ sī Lêng-sī ê sun Iâ-hō͘.”

Iok-hô-lân chiū kóng, “Chún-pī chiàn-chhia.” In chiū kā i chún-pī. Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hô-lân kap Iû-tāi -ông A-hap-siā chē ka-kī ê chiàn-chhia, chhut-khì kìⁿ Iâ-hō͘; in tī Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng Ná-pek ê hn̂g tú-tio̍h i.
Iok-hô-lân khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-hō͘ chiū kóng, “ Iâ-hō͘, ū pêng-an--bô?” Iâ-hō͘ ìn kóng, “Lí ê lāu-bú Iâ-sé-phek ê îm-hēng siâ-su̍t iáu hiah chōe, ná ōe pêng-an?”
Iok-hô-lân chiū kā chhia se̍h hoan-thâu tô-cháu, tùi A-hap-siā hoah kóng, “ A-hap-siā, hoán lah, hoán lah.”
Iâ-hō͘ chhut-la̍t khui keng, siā-tio̍h Iok-hô-lân ê ka-chiah-phiaⁿ, chìⁿ tùi i ê sim-chōng thàng--chhut-khì. I chiū lek--lo̍h-khì, sí tī chhia-lāi.

Iâ-hō͘ tùi i ê kun-koaⁿ Pit-kah kóng, “Kā i hiat tī Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng Ná-pek ê hn̂g--ni̍h. Lí tio̍h ōe-kì-tit lí kap góa chòe-hé chē-chhia tè i ê lāu-pē A-hap ê sî, Siōng Chú tùi A-hap ê ū-giân.

Siōng Chú ū kóng, ‘Góa chā-hng ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Ná-pek kap i ê kiáⁿ-jî ê huih. Góa li̍p-sè, góa beh tī chit-khu hn̂g pò-èng A-hap.’ Taⁿ tio̍h chiàu Siōng Chú ê ōe chiong Iok-hô-lân hiat tiàm chit-khu hn̂g.”

Iû-tāi -ông A-hap-siā khòaⁿ-tio̍h án-ni, chiū ǹg Pek Hap-kan ê lō͘ tô-cháu. Iâ-hō͘ jip i, hoah kóng, “Mā tio̍h kā phah-sí.” Chiap-kūn Í-pek-liân chiūⁿ Ko͘-ní ê soaⁿ-phiâⁿ ê sî, A-hap-siā tī chhia-lāi siū phah-siong. I tô-cháu khì Bí-kiat-to, chiū sí tī hia.
I ê jîn-sîn ēng chhia kā i ê si-thé chài-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, kā i an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ i ka-kī ê bōng, kap i ê lia̍t-chó͘ chòe-hé.
A-hap-siā chòe Iû-tāi -ông ê sî, sī tī A-hap ê kiáⁿ Iok-hô-lân cha̍p-it nî.
Iâ-hō͘ kàu Iâ-su-lia̍t, Iâ-sé-phek thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū soe-chng-táⁿ-pān, tùi thang-á khòaⁿ gōa-bīn.
Iâ-hō͘ ji̍p-siâⁿ ê sî, Iâ-sé-phek tùi i kóng, “Thâi-sí chú-lâng ê Sim-lī, lí ū pêng-an--bô?”
Iâ-hō͘ gia̍h-thâu ǹg thang-á khòaⁿ, kóng, “Ióng-hō͘ góa ê lâng tī tó-ūi?” Ū nn̄g saⁿ ê thài-kàm tùi thang-á àⁿ-teh khòaⁿ i.
Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “Kā i hiat--lo̍h-lâi.” In chiū chiong Iâ-sé-phek hiat--lo̍h-khì; i ê huih phùn-tio̍h chhiûⁿ-piah kap bé; Iâ-hō͘ sái chiàn-chhia kā i ê si-thé kauh--kè.
Iâ-hō͘ ji̍p--khì, ia̍h-chia̍h-ia̍h-lim, kóng, “Lín khì chhú-lí hit-ê siū chiù-chó͘ ê hū-jîn-lâng, sòa kā i bâi-chòng, in-ūi i mā-sī ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.”
M̄-kú in khì beh kā i bâi-chòng, kan-ta chhē-tio̍h i ê thâu-khak kap kha chhiú ê kut-thâu.

In tò-lâi kā Iâ-hō͘ pò-kò, i chiū kóng, “Che tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè i ê po̍k-jîn Thê-su-pí -lâng Í-lī-a só͘ kóng ê ōe, ‘Káu beh tī Iâ-su-lia̍t ê chhân-hn̂g chia̍h Iâ-sé-phek ê bah.
Iâ-sé-phek ê sin-si tī Iâ-su-lia̍t ê chhân-hn̂g ōe kap pùn siâng-khoán, bô lâng jīn ōe chhut.’”
A-hap ū chhit-cha̍p ê kiáⁿ-sun tī Sat-má-lī-a. Iâ-hō͘ siá-phoe khì Sat-má-lī-a, hō͘ hia ê siú-léng, tiúⁿ-ló, kap A-hap kiáⁿ-sun ê kàm-hō͘-jîn,
kóng, “Kì-jiân lín chú-lâng ê kiáⁿ-sun kap lín chòe-hé, lín koh ū chiàn-chhia, chiàn-bé, kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, kap bú-khì, chit-tiuⁿ phoe sàng kàu lín hia ê sî,

lín tio̍h tī lín chú-lâng kiáⁿ-sun ê tiong-kan, kéng chi̍t ê siōng-hó siōng sek-ha̍p--ê, hō͘ i sòa-chiap i ê lāu-pē choh-ông, lín mā thang ūi-tio̍h lín chú-lâng ê ke kau-chiàn.”
In hui-siông kiaⁿ, kóng, “Liân Iok-hô-lân kap A-hap-siā nn̄g ê ông to bōe-tàng tùi-khòng i, lán ná ū hoat-tō͘?”

Ông-kiong chóng-koán, chhī-tiúⁿ, kap tiúⁿ-ló, í-ki̍p ông kiáⁿ-sun ê kàm-hō͘-jîn, phài lâng khì kìⁿ Iâ-hō͘, kóng, “Goán sī lí ê po̍k-jîn, lí kā goán kóng--ê, goán lóng beh chiàu án-ni chòe. Goán bô beh siat-li̍p lâng choh-ông; chhiáⁿ chiàu lí ê ì-sù khì chòe.”

Iâ-hō͘ koh siá-phoe hō͘ in, kóng, “Lín nā kui-sūn góa, beh thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe, tio̍h chhú lín chú-lâng kiáⁿ-sun ê thâu-khak, bîn-á-chài chit-ê sî tòa-lâi Iâ-su-lia̍t hō͘ góa.” Hit-sî, ông ê kiáⁿ-sun chhit-cha̍p lâng lóng tòa tī siâⁿ-lāi kā in ióng-io̍k ê chun-kùi ê lâng in tau.
Iâ-hō͘ ê phoe chi̍t-ē kàu, in chiū chiong ông ê kiáⁿ-sun chhit-cha̍p lâng choân-pō͘ thâi-sí, chiong hiah-ê thâu-khak hē tī nâ-á lāi, sàng-khì Iâ-su-lia̍t Iâ-hō͘ hia.

Ū chi̍t ê sù-chiá lâi kā Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “In tòa ông hiah-ê kiáⁿ-sun ê thâu-khak lâi.” Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “Chiong in thia̍p chòe nn̄g tui, hē tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu, kàu bîn-á-chá-khí.”

Keh-chá-khí, Iâ-hō͘ chhut--lâi, khiā--teh, tùi chèng jîn-bîn kóng, “Lín lóng bô chōe. Sī góa hoán-poān Iok-hô-lân -ông, kā i thâi-sí, m̄-kú chiah-ê lâng sī siáⁿ-lâng kā in thâi-sí--ê?
Tùi án-ni thang chai, Siōng Chú iú-koan A-hap -ke só͘ kóng ê ōe, bô chi̍t kù lo̍k-khong; in-ūi Siōng Chú thong-kè I ê po̍k-jîn Í-lī-a kóng ê ōe, lóng ū si̍t-hiān.”
Sio̍k A-hap -ke tī Iâ-su-lia̍t chhun ê lâng, í-ki̍p i ê jîn-sîn, chhin-bi̍t ê pêng-iú, chè-si, Iâ-hō͘ lóng kā in thâi-sí, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh.
Iâ-hō͘ chhut-hoat, khì Sat-má-lī-a. Tī tiong-tô͘, i kàu bo̍k-chiá chián iûⁿ-mn̂g ê chhù,

tú-tio̍h Iû-tāi -ông A-hap-siā ê chhin-sio̍k, mn̄g in kóng, “Lín sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?” In ìn kóng, “Goán sī A-hap-siā ê chhin-sio̍k, tú-beh lo̍h-khì hóng-būn ông kap ông-hō͘ ê kiáⁿ.”

Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “Oa̍h-oa̍h kā in lia̍h--khí-lâi.” Iâ-hō͘ ê pō͘-hā chiū kā in lia̍h--khí-lâi, tī chián iûⁿ-mn̂g ê chhù ê chíⁿ-piⁿ thâi-sí in, kiōng sì-cha̍p-jī lâng, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu.

Iâ-hō͘ kè-sio̍k chìn-chêng, tú-tio̍h Lī-kah ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-ta̍t lâi gêng-chiap i; Iâ-hō͘ kā i chhéng-an, tùi i kóng, “Góa sêng-sim tùi-thāi lí, lí kiám mā án-ni tùi-thāi góa?” Iok-ná-ta̍t ìn kóng, “Sī.” Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “Nā-sī án-ni, lí ê chhiú chhun--chhut-lâi.” Iok-ná-ta̍t chiū chhun-chhiú hō͘ i. I chiū khan Iok-ná-ta̍t chiūⁿ-chhia.
Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “Kap góa chòe-hé lâi-khì, khòaⁿ góa án-chóaⁿ ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú jia̍t-sim chòe tāi-chì.” I chiū hō͘ Iok-ná-ta̍t chē i ê chhia.
Kàu Sat-má-lī-a, Iâ-hō͘ thâi-sí só͘-ū sio̍k A-hap -ke lâu tī Sat-má-lī-a ê lâng, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh, tú chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè Í-lī-a só͘ kóng ê ōe.
Iâ-hō͘ tiàu-chi̍p chèng jîn-bîn, kā in kóng, “ A-hap ho̍k-sāi Pa-le̍k iáu bô-kàu, Iâ-hō͘ beh koh-khah jia̍t-sim ho̍k-sāi i.

Só͘-í tio̍h tiàu-chi̍p Pa-le̍k só͘-ū ê sian-ti, chè-si, kap lóng-chóng pài Pa-le̍k ê lâng lâi góa chia, chi̍t ê to bōe-tàng bô lâi, in-ūi góa beh ūi Pa-le̍k kú-hêng tōa chè-sū; bô lâi--ê, beh hō͘ i sí.” Che sī Iâ-hō͘ ê khúi-kè, beh thâi-sí só͘-ū pài Pa-le̍k ê lâng.
Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “Tio̍h ūi Pa-le̍k tiàu-chi̍p giâm-siok-hōe.” In chiū soan-pò͘.

Iâ-hō͘ phài lâng khì Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k só͘-chāi soan-kò chit-ê siau-sit; pài Pa-le̍k ê lâng lóng chiâu kàu, bô chi̍t ê bô lâi. In chiū chìn-ji̍p Pa-le̍k ê biō; Pa-le̍k ê biō-lāi, lâng khoeh kah móa-móa-móa.
Iâ-hō͘ hoan-hù koán-lí lé-ho̍k ê lâng kóng, “Lé-ho̍k the̍h chhut-lâi hō͘ só͘-ū pài Pa-le̍k ê lâng chhēng.” Hit-ê lâng chiū the̍h lé-ho̍k chhut-lâi hō͘ in.

Iâ-hō͘ kap Lī-kah ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-ta̍t ji̍p Pa-le̍k ê biō, kā pài Pa-le̍k ê lâng kóng, “Lín tio̍h siông-sè so͘-cha, lín tiong-kan m̄-thang ū pài Siōng Chú ê lâng, chí-ū pài Pa-le̍k ê lâng ōe-tàng tī chia.”

In chiū ji̍p-khì beh hiàn chè-sū kap sio-hòa-chè. Iâ-hō͘ í-keng ū an-pâi poeh-cha̍p ê lâng tī biō ê gōa-bīn, koh tùi in kóng, “Góa chiong chiah-ê lâng kau hō͘ lín, nā ū lâng tô-cháu, pàng i cháu ê lâng tio̍h pê miā.”

Iâ-hō͘ hiàn sio-hòa-chè liáu-āu, tùi hō͘-ōe-peng kap kun-koaⁿ kóng, “Ji̍p--khì, chóng thâi! Chi̍t ê to m̄-thang hō͘ cháu--khì.” In chiū ēng to thâi-sí só͘-ū ê lâng, chiong sin-si tàn tī hia. Jiân-āu koh khì kàu Pa-le̍k-biō ê lōe-tiān,
chiong thiāu-siōng lóng the̍h chhut-lâi sio.
In húi-hoāi Pa-le̍k ê thiāu-siōng, thiah-húi Pa-le̍k ê biō, kā i kái-chòe piān-só͘, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Án-ni, Iâ-hō͘ tùi Í-sek-lia̍t siau-bia̍t Pa-le̍k chông-pài.
M̄-kú Iâ-hō͘ kap Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an kâng-khoán, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe, chiū-sī khì pài Pek-te̍k-lī kap Tān ê kim-gû.

Siōng Chú kā Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “In-ūi lí ū oân-sêng góa khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, chiàu góa ê sim-ì tùi-thāi A-hap -ke, lí ê kiáⁿ-sun beh sòa-chiap lí chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông kàu tē-sì tāi.”
M̄-kú Iâ-hō͘ bô choan-sim chun-siú Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ê lu̍t-hoat, kap Iâ-lô-pho-an kâng-khoán, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe.
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -kok khai-sí soe-bî; Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih phah-pāi Í-sek-lia̍t,

chiàm-léng Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng Ki-lia̍t choân-tōe, tùi A-lūn Soaⁿ-kok hù-kūn ê A-lô-ní khí, kàu Ki-lia̍t kap Pa-san, chiū-sī Ka-tek -lâng, Lū-piān -lâng, Má-ná-se -lâng ê tōe-khu.
Iâ-hō͘ kî-tha ê sū-chek, i ê só͘-chòe, kap i ê sêng-chiū, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iâ-hō͘ tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia liáu-āu, an-chòng tī Sat-má-lī-a. I ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-su sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iâ-hō͘ tī Sat-má-lī-a chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chóng-kiōng jī-cha̍p-poeh nî.
A-hap-siā ê lāu-bú A-tha-lī-ngá chi̍t-ē chai i ê kiáⁿ siū sat-hāi, chiū khí-lâi châu-bia̍t Iû-tāi ông-sek só͘-ū ê hō͘-tāi.

M̄-kú Iok-lân -ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, A-hap-siā ê sió-bē Iok-sī-pa, chiong A-hap-siā ê kiáⁿ Iok-a-si, tùi hiah-ê siū-thâi ê ông-chú tiong thau-phō-- chhut-lâi, chiong i kap i ê lin-bú chhàng tī sèng-tiān ê khùn-pâng, bô hō͘ A-tha-lī-ngá chai, hō͘ Iok-a-si bián siū sat-hāi.
A-tha-lī-ngá tī-lí Iû-tāi -kok ê sî, Iok-a-si kap i ê lin-bú chòe-hé bih tī Siōng Chú ê tiān la̍k nî kú.

Kàu tē-chhit nî, Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi phài lâng tiàu-chi̍p Ka-lī -lâng kap só͘-ū hō͘-ōe-peng ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, chhōa in ji̍p Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān lâi kàu i hia; i kap in li̍p-iok, hō͘ in tī Siōng Chú ê tiān chiù-chōa, koh hō͘ in khòaⁿ ông ê kiáⁿ.
Koh hoan-hù in kóng, “Lín tio̍h án-ni chòe: Lín tī An-hioh-ji̍t ti̍t-pan ê sî, tio̍h saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t kò͘-siú ông-kiong,
saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t kò͘-siú So͘-ní-mn̂g, saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t kò͘-siú hō͘-ōe-peng-īⁿ ê āu-mn̂g; án-ni lûn-liû kò͘-siú ông-kiong.
Lín tī An-hioh-ji̍t bô ti̍t-pan ê nn̄g tūi jîn-oân tio̍h kò͘-siú Siōng Chú ê tiān, pó-hō͘ ông.
Lín ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h tòa kun-khì, tī ông ê sì-ûi pó-hō͘; nā ū lâng kiông-beh ji̍p--lâi, tio̍h hō͘ i sí; ông bô-lūn tī tó-ūi, lín lóng tio̍h kun-sûi pó-hō͘ i.”

Só͘-ū ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ lóng chiàu chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê bēng-lēng khì chòe; ta̍k-ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ lóng tòa in ê pō͘-hā, bô-lūn An-hioh-ji̍t ū ti̍t-pan á-sī bô ti̍t-pan, lóng lâi chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi hia.
Chè-si chiū chiong khǹg tī Siōng Chú tiān-lāi Tāi-pi̍t -ông ê chhiuⁿ kap tún-pâi kau hō͘ hiah-ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ.
Hō͘-ōe-peng chhiú gia̍h bú-khì, tī chè-tôaⁿ kap sèng-tiān hia, tùi tiān ê lâm-pêng kàu pak-pêng, khiā tī ông ê sì-ûi pó-hō͘.

Chè-si chhōa Iok-a-si chhut--lâi, kā i tì ông-koan, chiong iú-koan ông-koân ê iok-su kau hō͘ i, kā i boah-iû, siat-li̍p i choh-ông; in chiū phah-pho̍k-á, hoah kóng, “Goān ông bān-sòe!”
A-tha-lī-ngá thiaⁿ-tio̍h hō͘-ōe-peng kap jîn-bîn ê siaⁿ, chiū khì chū-chi̍p tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê jîn-bîn hia,

khòaⁿ-tio̍h ông chiàu kui-lē khiā tī sèng-tiān ji̍p-kháu ê thiāu-piⁿ, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kap pûn lat-pah ê lâng khiā tī ông ê piⁿ--á, kok-lāi ê jîn-bîn lóng hoaⁿ-hí, pûn lat-pah. A-tha-lī-ngá chiū thiah-li̍h i ê saⁿ, hoah kóng, “Chō-hoán lah, chō-hoán lah!”

In-ūi chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi m̄-ài ū lâng tī Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, chiū bēng-lēng koán kun-tūi ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, kóng, “Kā i tùi tūi-ngó͘ ê tiong-kan kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; beh tè--i-ê, tio̍h hō͘ i sí.”
In siám-khui siang-pêng hō͘ A-tha-lī-ngá kè--khì; i kàu chìn-ji̍p ông-kiong ê Bé-mn̂g, chiū tī hia hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi hō͘ ông í-ki̍p jîn-bîn kap Siōng Chú li̍p-iok, chòe Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn; koh hō͘ ông kap jîn-bîn li̍p-iok.

Tùi án-ni, choân-kok ê jîn-bîn lóng kā Pa-le̍k ê biō thiah-húi, phah-chhùi chè-tôaⁿ kap ngó͘-siōng, koh tī tôaⁿ-chêng phah-sí Pa-le̍k ê chè-si Má-thán. Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi phài koaⁿ-oân kò͘-siú Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān.

I kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, Ka-lī -lâng, hō͘-ōe-peng, í-ki̍p choân-kok jîn-bîn, chhiáⁿ ông tùi Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān lo̍h--lâi, tùi hō͘-ōe-peng-īⁿ ê mn̂g chìn-ji̍p ông-kiong. Iok-a-si chiū chē ông-ūi.
Choân-kok jîn-bîn lóng hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, choân-siâⁿ lóng pêng-chēng; A-tha-lī-ngá í-keng tī ông-kiong hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.
Iok-a-si chē-ūi ê sî chiah chhit hè.
Iâ-hō͘ tē-chhit nî, Iok-a-si choh-ông, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông sì-cha̍p nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Se-pí-a, sī Pia̍t-sī-pa -lâng.
Iok-a-si in-ūi chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kàu-tō, it-seng chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū.
M̄-kú soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ iáu-bē hòe-tû, jîn-bîn iû-goân tī hia hiàn-chè sio-hiuⁿ.
Iok-a-si tùi chèng chè-si kóng, “Só͘-ū hiàn tī Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê chîⁿ, bô-lūn sī ta̍k-ê lâng eng-kai hiàn--ê, á-sī chū-goān hiàn ê chîⁿ,
á-sī ta̍k-ê chè-si tùi i só͘ bat ê lâng siu-chi̍p ê hōng-hiàn, tio̍h ēng lâi siu-lí sèng-tiān só͘-ū sún-hoāi ê só͘-chāi.”
M̄-kú kàu Iok-a-si -ông tē-jī-cha̍p-saⁿ nî, chè-si iáu-bē siu-lí sèng-tiān sún-hoāi ê só͘-chāi.

Só͘-í Iok-a-si -ông tiàu-chi̍p chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi kap kî-tha ê chè-si, tùi in kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ kàu taⁿ iáu-bē siu-lí sèng-tiān sún-hoāi ê só͘-chāi? Lín m̄-thang koh tùi lâng siu chîⁿ, tio̍h chiong chîⁿ kau--chhut-lâi, thang siu-lí sèng-tiān sún-hoāi ê só͘-chāi.”
Chèng chè-si tah-èng bô beh koh tùi jîn-bîn siu chîⁿ, mā bô beh hū-chek siu-lí sèng-tiān sún-hoāi ê só͘-chāi.

Chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi the̍h chi̍t ê kūi, tī téng-bīn ó͘ chi̍t khang, hē tī chè-tôaⁿ piⁿ, Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ji̍p-kháu ê chiàⁿ-pêng; siú-mn̂g ê chè-si kā lâi kèng-pài ê lâng só͘ hiàn ê chîⁿ lóng lok ji̍p-khì kūi-lāi.
Chè-si khòaⁿ-tio̍h kūi-lāi ê chîⁿ ū-kàu chōe ê sî, chiū chhiáⁿ ông ê su-kì kap tōa-chè-si lâi, chiong Siōng Chú sèng-tiān tit--tio̍h ê chîⁿ tiám-sǹg liáu pau--khí-lâi.

In chiū chiong tiám-sǹg--kè ê chîⁿ kau hō͘ kàm-tok chéng-siu Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê lâng. Kàm-tok ê lâng chiong chîⁿ hoat hō͘ siu-lí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê choh-ba̍k sai-hū kap kiàn-tio̍k kang-lâng,

thô͘-chúi sai-hū kap phah-chio̍h sai-hū; koh bóe chhâ-liāu kap phah-hó ê chio̍h, siu-lí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān sún-hoāi ê só͘-chāi, í-ki̍p chi-hù siu-lí sèng-tiān ta̍k-khoán ê khai-siau.
M̄-kú hōng-hiàn tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê chîⁿ bô ēng lâi chòe Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê gûn-poe, teng-sim ê chián-to, pôaⁿ, lat-pah, kap ta̍k-khoán kim-khì gûn-khì.
In chiong chîⁿ lóng kau hō͘ choh-kang ê lâng siu-lí Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān.
In m̄-bián kap hoat kang-chîⁿ ê lâng tùi-siàu, in-ūi hiah-ê lâng chòe tāi-chì sêng-si̍t.
M̄-kú pê-chōe-chè kap sio̍k-chōe-chè ê chîⁿ, bô tòa-ji̍p Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, lóng kui hō͘ chè-si.
Hit-sî, Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih chiūⁿ-khì kong-táⁿ Ka-te̍k, kā i kong-chhú. Hap-sih chiū koat-tēng beh chìn-kong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Iû-tāi -ông Iok-a-si chiong i ê chó͘-sian Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat, Iok-lân, A-hap-siā, kap i pún-sin só͘ hiàn sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú ê mi̍h, í-ki̍p Siōng Chú sèng-tiān kap ông-kiong ê hú-khò͘ só͘-ū ê kim, lóng sàng hō͘ Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih. Hap-sih chiū bô chìn-kong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Iok-a-si kî-tha ê sū-chek, i ê só͘-chòe, lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iok-a-si ê jîn-sîn khí-lâi pōe-poān, tī lo̍h-khì Sek-la lō͘-tiong ê Pek Bí-lô kā i thâi-sí.

Hiah-ê thâi-sí Iok-a-si ê jîn-sîn sī Sī-bí-ap ê kiáⁿ Iok-sat-kah, kap Sok-be̍k ê kiáⁿ Iok-sat-poa̍t. Iok-a-si kap i ê lia̍t-chó͘ chòe-hé an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ. I ê kiáⁿ A-má-siā sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iû-tāi -ông A-hap-siā ê kiáⁿ Iok-a-si choh-ông tē-jī-cha̍p-saⁿ nî, Iâ-hō͘ ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-su tī Sat-má-lī-a choh-ông, thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t cha̍p-chhit nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, tè Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê só͘-chòe, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe, lóng bô thêng-chí.
Siōng Chú chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoat siū-khì, kúi nā piàn chiong in kau tī Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih kap i ê kiáⁿ Piān Hap-ta̍t ê chhiú.
Iok-hap-su khún-kiû Siōng Chú, Siōng Chú thiaⁿ i ê kî-tó, in-ūi I ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siū Sū-lī-a -ông chè-ap.
Siōng Chú siúⁿ-sù Í-sek-lia̍t chi̍t ê chín-kiù-chiá, kiù in thoat-lī Sū-lī-a -lâng ê chhiú. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū iû-goân pêng-an tòa tī in ka-kī ê chhù.
M̄-kú in bô lī-khui Iâ-lô-pho-an ê ke só͘ kiâⁿ ê lō͘, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe, kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe; tī Sat-má-lī-a, A-sià-la ê thiāu-siōng iáu lâu--teh.

Sū-lī-a -ông phah-pāi Í-sek-lia̍t, thún-ta̍h in chhin-chhiūⁿ teh thún-ta̍h ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ ê thô͘-soa. Sū-lī-a -ông chí-ū ún-chún Iok-hap-su lâu bé-peng gō͘-cha̍p, chiàn-chhia cha̍p tâi, kap pō͘-peng chi̍t-bān.
Iok-hap-su kî-tha ê sū-chek, i só͘ chòe ê sū kap sêng-chiū, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iok-hap-su tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia liáu-āu, an-chòng tī Sat-má-lī-a; i ê kiáⁿ Iok-hôa-si sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iû-tāi -ông Iok-a-si saⁿ-cha̍p-chhit nî, Iok-hap-su ê kiáⁿ Iok-hôa-si tī Sat-má-lī-a choh-ông, chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông cha̍p-la̍k nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, bô lī-khui Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lō͘, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe, kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe.
Iok-hôa-si kî-tha ê sū-chek, i ê só͘-chòe, í-ki̍p i kap Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā kau-chiàn ióng-béng ê sū, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iok-hôa-si tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, kap Í-sek-lia̍t chiah-ê ông chòe-hé an-chòng tī Sat-má-lī-a. I ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an Jī-sè chē ông-ūi.
Í-lī-sa hoān-tio̍h tì-miā ê pīⁿ. Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si lo̍h-lâi khòaⁿ i, phak tī i ê bīn thî-khàu, kóng, “Su-hū ah, su-hū ah! Í-sek-lia̍t ê chiàn-chhia kap bé-peng ah!”
Í-lī-sa tùi i kóng, “Lí khì gia̍h keng-chìⁿ.” I chiū khì gia̍h keng kap chìⁿ lâi.
Í-lī-sa koh kā Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kóng, “Lí chún-pī khui keng.” I chiū chún-pī khui keng. Í-lī-sa kā ông ê chhiú hōaⁿ--teh, kóng,

“Lí phah-khui tang-pêng ê thang-á.” I chiū phah-khui. Í-lī-sa kóng, “Siā-chìⁿ!” I chiū siā-chìⁿ. Í-lī-sa kóng, “Che sī Siōng Chú sèng-lī ê chìⁿ, thâi-iâⁿ Sū-lī-a -lâng ê chìⁿ. Lí ōe tī A-hut kong-kek Sū-lī-a -lâng, thiat-tóe kā in siau-bia̍t.”
Í-lī-sa koh kóng, “Chìⁿ gia̍h--khí-lâi.” I chiū kā chìⁿ gia̍h--khí-lâi. Í-lī-sa koh kā ông kóng, “Phah thô͘-kha.” Ông phah saⁿ piàn chiū thêng--teh.

Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng tùi i siū-khì kóng, “Lí eng-kai tio̍h phah gō͘ la̍k piàn, chiah ōe-tàng phah-pāi Sū-lī-a, thiat-tóe kā i siau-bia̍t. Taⁿ, lí chí-ū ōe-tàng phah-pāi Sū-lī-a -lâng saⁿ piàn.”
Í-lī-sa sí, lâng kā i bâi-chòng. Ta̍k-nî chhun-thiⁿ, Mô͘-ap -lâng ōe lâi chhim-hoān Í-sek-lia̍t.

Ū chi̍t piàn, ū lâng tú-á teh bâi-chòng sí-lâng, hut-jiân khòaⁿ-tio̍h kui-tīn Mô͘-ap -lâng, chiū chiong sí-lâng hiat tī Í-lī-sa ê bōng-lāi, kóaⁿ-kín tô-cháu. Sí-lâng chi̍t-ē kha̍p-tio̍h Í-lī-sa ê kut-thâu, chiū koh-oa̍h, khiā--khí-lâi.
Iok-hôa-si ê lāu-pē Iok-hap-su chāi-ūi ê sî, Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih siông-siông chè-ap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú in-ūi I kap A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok só͘ li̍p ê iok, iû-goân si-un hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t, lîn-bín in, koàn-kò͘ in, m̄-kam kā in châu-bia̍t, m̄-kam kā in pàng-sak.
Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih sí, i ê kiáⁿ Piān Hap-ta̍t sòa-chiap i choh-ông.

Í-chêng Hap-sih kap Iok-hap-su kau-chiàn, tùi i ê chhiú kong-chhú kúi-nā ê siâⁿ; Iok-hap-su ê kiáⁿ Iok-hôa-si saⁿ piàn phah-pāi Hap-sih ê kiáⁿ Piān Hap-ta̍t, siu-hôe hiah-ê siâⁿ.
Iok-hap-su ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si tē-jī nî, Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ A-má-siā khai-sí chòe Iû-tāi -ông.
I chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-gō͘ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông jī-cha̍p-káu nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Iok-iâ-tān, sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng.
A-má-siā chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, m̄-kú bô chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t; i iû-goân chiàu i ê lāu-pē Iok-a-si ê só͘-chòe khì chòe,
bô thiah-húi soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ; jîn-bîn kè-sio̍k tī hia hiàn-chè sio-hiuⁿ.
A-má-siā ê ông-koân chi̍t-ē kian-kò͘, chiū chiong thâi-sí i lāu-pē Iû-tāi -ông hiah-ê jîn-sîn chhú-sí.

M̄-kú i bô thâi-sí hiah-ê jîn-sîn ê kiáⁿ-jî, sī chiàu Mô͘-se lu̍t-hoat ê chheh só͘ kì-chài Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng: M̄-thang in-ūi kiáⁿ-jî ê só͘-chòe kā lāu-pē chhú-sí, mā m̄-thang in-ūi lāu-pē ê só͘-chòe kā kiáⁿ-jî chhú-sí; ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe sí.
A-má-siā tī Iâm ê Soaⁿ-kok thâi-sí Í-tong -lâng chi̍t-bān, koh kong-chhú Se-la, kā i kái-miâ chòe Iok-thiap, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Hit-sî, A-má-siā phài sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Iâ-hō͘ ê sun, Iok-hap-su ê kiáⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si, kóng, “Lâi, lán lâi chiàn-tiûⁿ piàⁿ su-iâⁿ.”

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si phài sù-chiá khì kā Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā kóng, “ Lê-pa-lūn ê chháu-chhì chhe sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū, kóng, ‘Lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō͘ góa ê kiáⁿ chòe bó͘!’ Āu-lâi Lê-pa-lūn ū chi̍t chiah iá-siù keng-kè, kā chháu-chhì thún-ta̍h.

Lí í-keng thâi-iâⁿ Í-tong, sim chiū kiau-ngō͘ sáng-sè. Lí tiàm lín tau hióng-siū lí ê êng-kng chiū hó, ná beh jiá chai-hō, hō͘ lí pún-sin kap Iû-tāi -kok chòe-hé bia̍t-bông?”
M̄-kú A-má-siā thiaⁿ bōe lo̍h--khì. Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si chiū chiūⁿ--lâi, tī Iû-tāi ê Pek Sī-be̍k kap Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā kau-chiàn.
Iû-tāi hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t phah-pāi, ta̍k-ê lâng cháu tò-khì in tau.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si tī hia lia̍h-tio̍h Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā, koh lâi thiah-húi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, tùi Í-hoat-liân-mn̂g kàu Kak-mn̂g, iok nn̄g-pah kong-chhioh.
Iok-hôa-si chiong Siōng Chú sèng-tiān kap ông-kiong ê hú-khò͘ só͘-ū ê kim-gûn kap khì-khū lóng the̍h--khì, koh lia̍h lâng chòe jîn-chit, chiah tò-khì Sat-má-lī-a.
Iok-hôa-si kî-tha ê sū-chek, i ê só͘-chòe kap sêng-chiū, í-ki̍p kap Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā kau-chiàn ê sū, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iok-hôa-si tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, kap Í-sek-lia̍t chiah-ê ông chòe-hé an-chòng tī Sat-má-lī-a; i ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an Jī-sè sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iok-hap-su ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si sí-liáu, Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā koh-chài oa̍h cha̍p-gō͘ nî.
A-má-siā kî-tha ê sū-chek, lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ū lâng kè-bô͘ beh hāi A-má-siā, i chiū tô-cháu khì La-kiat. In phài lâng jip kàu La-kiat, tī hia kā i thâi-sí.
Lâng ēng bé chiong i ê si-thé chài tò-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chiong i an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ, lia̍t-chó͘ ê bōng-tōe.
Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn siat-li̍p O͘-se-a sòa-chiap i ê lāu-pē A-má-siā choh-ông, hit-sî i cha̍p-la̍k hè.
A-má-siā -ông tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia liáu-āu, O͘-se-a siu-hôe Í-la-tha kui-sio̍k Iû-tāi -kok, koh kā i siu-kiàn.
Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā tē-cha̍p-gō͘ nî, Iok-hôa-si ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an Jī-sè tī Sat-má-lī-a chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông; i choh-ông kiōng sì-cha̍p-it nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, bô lī-khui Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lō͘, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe.

I siu-hôe Í-sek-lia̍t pian-kài ê tōe, tùi Hap-má ài-kháu kàu Sí-hái, tú-tú chiàu Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè thong-kè I ê po̍k-jîn, Ka-te̍k Hi-hut -lâng A-bí-thài ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Iok-ná só͘ kóng ê ōe.
Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, bô-lūn sī chū-iû--ê á-sī bô chū-iû--ê, lóng siū ke̍k-tōa ê khó͘-lān, mā bô lâng pang-chān in.
Siōng Chú koat-ì bô beh tùi thiⁿ-ē chhat-siau Í-sek-lia̍t ê miâ, chiū thong-kè Iok-hôa-si ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an Jī-sè kái-kiù in.

Iâ-lô-pho-an Jī-sè kî-tha ê sū-chek, i ê só͘-chòe kap sêng-chiū, í-ki̍p i án-chóaⁿ kau-chiàn, án-chóaⁿ chiong í-chêng sio̍k Iû-tāi ê Tāi-má-sū-kek kap Hap-má siu-hôe kui-sio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iâ-lô-pho-an Jī-sè tńg-khì i ê chó͘-sian Í-sek-lia̍t hiah-ê ông hia, i ê kiáⁿ Sat-ka-lī-a sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iâ-lô-pho-an Jī-sè tē-jī-cha̍p-chhit nî, A-má-siā ê kiáⁿ O͘-se-a khai-sí chòe Iû-tāi -ông.
I chē-ūi ê sî cha̍p-la̍k hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông gō͘-cha̍p-jī nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Iâ-khó-lī-ngá, sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng.
O͘-se-a chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, chiàu i ê lāu-pē A-má-siā ê só͘-chòe khì chòe.
M̄-kú soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ iáu-bē hòe-tû, jîn-bîn iû-goân tī hia hiàn-chè sio-hiuⁿ.
Siōng Chú kàng chai-hō, hō͘ ông it-seng tì-tio̍h giâm-tiōng ê phê-hu-pīⁿ; i chiū tòa tī siū keh-lī ê chhù. I ê kiáⁿ Iok-thán koán-lí ông-ka ê sū, tī-lí kok-chèng.
O͘-se-a kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê só͘-chòe lóng kì tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
O͘-se-a tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, lâng kā i an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ, i ê chó͘-sian ê bōng. I ê kiáⁿ Iok-thán sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iû-tāi -ông O͘-se-a tē-saⁿ-cha̍p-poeh nî, Iâ-lô-pho-an Jī-sè ê kiáⁿ Sat-ka-lī-a tī Sat-má-lī-a choh-ông, thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t la̍k ge̍h-ji̍t kú.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, chiàu i ê chó͘-sian ê só͘-chòe, bô lī-khui Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lō͘, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe.
Ngá-pí ê kiáⁿ Sa-liông pōe-poān Sat-ka-lī-a, tī jîn-bîn ê bīn-chêng kā i thâi-sí, chhoàn i ê ūi.
Sat-ka-lī-a kî-tha ê sū-chek lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Siōng Chú bat tùi Iâ-hō͘ kóng, “Lí ê kiáⁿ-sun ōe chē Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông-ūi kàu tē-sì tāi.” Chit-ê ōe chiū án-ni si̍t-hiān.
Iû-tāi -ông O͘-se-a tē-saⁿ-cha̍p-káu nî, Ngá-pí ê kiáⁿ Sa-liông tī Sat-má-lī-a chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chi̍t ge̍h-ji̍t kú.
Ka-tí ê kiáⁿ Bí-ná-hiān tùi Tek-sat chiūⁿ-khì Sat-má-lī-a, thâi-sí Ngá-pí ê kiáⁿ Sa-liông, chhoàn i ê ūi.
Sa-liông kî-tha ê sū-chek, kap i pōe-poān ê im-bô͘, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.

Hit-sî, Bí-ná-hiān tùi Tek-sat khì kong-táⁿ Thê-húi-sat, kap siâⁿ-lāi ê chū-bîn í-ki̍p sì-ûi ê tōe-khu; in-ūi siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng m̄-khéng tâu-hâng, Bí-ná-hiān chiū kā in châu-bia̍t, sīm-chì phòa-khui só͘-ū ū-sin ê hū-jîn-lâng ê pak-tó͘.
Iû-tāi -ông O͘-se-a tē-saⁿ-cha̍p-káu nî, Ka-tí ê kiáⁿ Bí-ná-hiān choh-ông, tī Sat-má-lī-a thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t cha̍p nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, chi̍t-sì-lâng bô lī-khui Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lō͘, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe.
A-su̍t -ông Thê-kek-la Pí-lia̍t-sek lâi chhim-hoān Í-sek-lia̍t. Bí-ná-hiān sàng gûn saⁿ-bān sì-chheng kong-kun hō͘ A-su̍t -ông, kiû i pang-chān kian-kò͘ ông-koân.
Bí-ná-hiān kiông-pek Í-sek-lia̍t ê hó-gia̍h-lâng hū-tam chiah-ê gûn, ta̍k-ê lâng chhut gō͘-pah chhit-cha̍p kong-khek, sàng hō͘ A-su̍t -ông. A-su̍t -ông chiū tò-khì i pún-kok.
Bí-ná-hiān kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê só͘-chòe, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Bí-ná-hiān tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, i ê kiáⁿ Pí-ka-hat sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iû-tāi -ông O͘-se-a tē-gō͘-cha̍p nî, Bí-ná-hiān ê kiáⁿ Pí-ka-hat tī Sat-má-lī-a choh-ông, thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t nn̄g nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, bô lī-khui Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lō͘, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe.

I ê sī-ōe-koaⁿ, Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ Pí-ka pōe-poān, tī Sat-má-lī-a ông-kiong ê pó-lúi kā i thâi-sí, chhoàn i ê ūi; kiōng-bô͘ ê lâng ū A-ní-ko-pek, A-lī-iâ, í-ki̍p gō͘-cha̍p ê Ki-lia̍t -lâng.
Pí-ka-hat kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê só͘-chòe, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iû-tāi -ông O͘-se-a tē-gō͘-cha̍p-jī nî, Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ Pí-ka tī Sat-má-lī-a choh-ông, thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t jī-cha̍p nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, bô lī-khui Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê lō͘, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe.

Pí-ka chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông ê sî, A-su̍t -ông Thê-kek-la Pí-lia̍t-sek kong-chhú Í-hûn, A-pek Pek Má-ka, A-ná, Ki-te-su, kap Hā-só chiah-ê siâⁿ, Ki-lia̍t, Ka-lī-lī, í-ki̍p Ná-hut-tha-lī choân tōe-khu; koh chiong hiah-ê chū-bîn lóng lia̍h-khì A-su̍t.
O͘-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-thán tē-jī-cha̍p nî, Í-la ê kiáⁿ Hô-sè-a pōe-poān Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ Pí-ka, kā i thâi-sí, chhoàn i ê ūi.
Pí-ka kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê só͘-chòe, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pí-ka tē-jī nî, O͘-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-thán khai-sí chòe Iû-tāi -ông.
I chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-gō͘ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-la̍k nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Iâ-lō͘-sa, sī Sat-tok ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Iok-thán chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, chiàu i ê lāu-pē O͘-se-a ê só͘-chòe khì chòe.
M̄-kú soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ iáu-bē hòe-tû, jîn-bîn iû-goân tī hia hiàn-chè sio-hiuⁿ. Iok-thán khí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê Siōng-mn̂g.
Iok-thán kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê só͘-chòe, lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú khai-sí chhe Sū-lī-a -ông Lī-sìn kap Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pí-ka khì kong-kek Iû-tāi.
Iok-thán tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, an-chòng tī i ê chó͘ Tāi-pi̍t ê siâⁿ, i ê chó͘-sian ê bōng. I ê kiáⁿ A-hap-su sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pí-ka tē-cha̍p-chhit nî, Iok-thán ê kiáⁿ A-hap-su khai-sí chòe Iû-tāi -ông.
A-hap-su chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-la̍k nî; i bô chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t chòe Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū,
tian-tò khì kiâⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t hiah-ê ông ê lō͘, sīm-chì sio i ka-kī ê kiáⁿ hiàn-chòe chè, o̍h Siōng Chú tī in bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-chhut ê lia̍t-kok só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū;
koh tī soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, ta̍k-ê soaⁿ-lûn-á, ta̍k-châng chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū ē-bīn hiàn-chè sio-hiuⁿ.
Hit-sî, Sū-lī-a -ông Lī-sìn kap Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pí-ka chiūⁿ-lâi kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, ûi-khùn A-hap-su, m̄-kú phah bōe iâⁿ i.
Tng-sî Sū-lī-a -ông Lī-sìn siu-hôe Í-la-tha kui-sio̍k Sū-lī-a, kóaⁿ Iû-tāi -lâng chhut Í-la-tha. Í-tong -lâng chiū lâi Í-la-tha khiā-khí, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.

A-hap-su phài sù-chiá khì kìⁿ A-su̍t -ông Thê-kek-la Pí-lia̍t-sek, kóng, “Góa sī lí ê po̍k-jîn, lí ê kiáⁿ. Sū-lī-a -ông kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kong-kek góa, chhiáⁿ lâi kiù góa thoat-lī in ê chhiú.”
A-hap-su chiong Siōng Chú tiān-lāi kap ông-kiong hú-khò͘ só͘-ū ê kim gûn, chòe lé-mi̍h sàng hō͘ A-su̍t -ông.
A-su̍t -ông tah-èng, chiū khì kong-táⁿ Tāi-má-sū-kek, kong-chhú chit-ê siâⁿ, lia̍h hiah-ê chū-bîn khì Kiat-ní, koh thâi-sí Lī-sìn.

A-hap-su -ông khì Tāi-má-sū-kek beh gêng-chiap A-su̍t -ông Thê-kek-la Pí-lia̍t-sek; i tī Tāi-má-sū-kek khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chō tôaⁿ. A-hap-su -ông chiong hit-ê tôaⁿ ê khoán-sit, siông-sè ê tô͘-iūⁿ kap choh-hoat, kià hō͘ chè-si O͘-lī-a.
Chè-si O͘-lī-a chiū tī A-hap-su -ông iáu-bē tùi Tāi-má-sū-kek tńg-lâi í-chêng, chiàu A-hap-su -ông tùi Tāi-má-sū-kek kià--lâi ê tô͘-iūⁿ khí chi̍t chō tôaⁿ.
Ông tùi Tāi-má-sū-kek tò--lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h tôaⁿ, kiâⁿ óa--khì, tī hit téng-bīn hiàn-chè.
I hiàn sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè, chiong pêng-an-chè ê huih hiù tī tôaⁿ-téng.
I koh chiong Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ê tâng-tôaⁿ, chiū-sī tī sin ê tôaⁿ kap sèng-tiān tiong-kan ê tâng-tôaⁿ, tùi tiān ê thâu-chêng sóa-khì hē tī sin ê tôaⁿ ê pak-pêng.

A-hap-su -ông bēng-lēng chè-si O͘-lī-a kóng, “Chá-khí-sî ê sio-hòa-chè, ē-hng-sî ê sò͘-chè, ông ê sio-hòa-chè kap sò͘-chè, kok-lāi jîn-bîn ê sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap tiān-chiú-chè, lóng tio̍h tī tōa-tôaⁿ ê téng-bīn hiàn; sio-hòa-chè kap kî-tha seng-lé ê huih tio̍h hiù tī tōa-tôaⁿ ê téng-bīn. Tâng-tôaⁿ góa beh chòe kiû-mn̄g ê lō͘-ēng.”
Chè-si O͘-lī-a chiū chiàu A-hap-su -ông ê bēng-lēng khì chòe.

A-hap-su -ông thiah hiah-ê phûn-chō ê tó͘-pang, chiong phûn tùi hiah-ê phûn-chō sóa--lo̍h-lâi; koh chiong tâng-hái tùi cha̍p-jī chiah tâng-gû téng-bīn poaⁿ--lo̍h-lâi, hē tī pho͘ chio̍h-pán ê tōe-bīn.
I koh in-ūi A-su̍t -ông ê iân-kò͘, chiong sèng-tiān An-hioh-ji̍t ê cháu-lông, kap ông choan-iōng ji̍p-lâi sèng-tiān ê gōa-mn̂g, lóng thiah-tiāu.
A-hap-su kî-tha ê só͘-chòe lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
A-hap-su tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ, i ê chó͘-sian ê bōng. I ê kiáⁿ Hi-se-ka sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iû-tāi -ông A-hap-su tē-cha̍p-jī nî, Í-la ê kiáⁿ Hô-sè-a tī Sat-má-lī-a khai-sí choh-ông, thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t káu nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, m̄-kú bô chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng Í-sek-lia̍t chiah-ê ông.
A-su̍t -ông Sat-bān-í-sek chiūⁿ-lâi kong-kek. Hô-sè-a tâu-hâng, kā i chìn-kòng.

Āu-lâi, Hô-sè-a phài sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Ai-ki̍p -ông So, chhéng-kiû oān-chō͘, bô chhin-chhiūⁿ kè-khì múi-nî chìn-kòng A-su̍t -ông. A-su̍t -ông chai Hô-sè-a pōe-poān, chiū kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ--ni̍h.
A-su̍t -ông chiūⁿ-lâi kong-táⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t, ûi-khùn Sat-má-lī-a saⁿ nî kú.

Hô-sè-a tē-káu nî, A-su̍t -ông kong-chhú Sat-má-lī-a, koh chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lia̍h-khì A-su̍t, hō͘ in tòa tī Hap-la̍h, Ko-sàn tōe-khu ê Hap-phok hô-piⁿ, í-ki̍p Bí-tí-a -lâng ê siâⁿ.
Che sī in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tek-chōe Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè; I ū chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe, thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló ê chhiú, in khiok khì pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng,
khì tè hō͘ Siōng Chú tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-chhut ê lia̍t-kok kap Í-sek-lia̍t lia̍t-ông só͘ siat ê hong-sio̍k kui-lē.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng àm-tiong chòe m̄-tio̍h ê sū, tek-chōe Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè, tī in só͘-ū khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, tùi kan-ta ū siú-bōng-tâi ê chng-siā kàu ū pó-lúi ê siâⁿ, khí soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ.
In tī ta̍k-ê koân ê soaⁿ-lûn-á, ta̍k-châng chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū ē-bīn, chō chio̍h-thiāu-siōng kap A-sià-la lú-sîn;
koh tī ta̍k-ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ sio-hiuⁿ, o̍h hiah-ê hō͘ Siōng Chú tī in bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-chhut ê lia̍t-kok ê só͘-chòe, chòe siâ-ok ê sū kek Siōng Chú siū-khì;
koh pài Siōng Chú kìm-chí in pài ê ngó͘-siōng.

Siōng Chú bat chhe-khián chèng sian-ti kap sian-kiàn kéng-kài Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi, kóng, “Tio̍h lī-khui lín ê pháiⁿ hêng-ûi, chip-siú góa ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē; tio̍h chun-siú góa choân-pō͘ ê lu̍t-hoat, chiū-sī góa bēng-lēng lín ê lia̍t-chó͘, kap thong-kè góa ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti thoân hō͘ lín--ê.”
M̄-kú in m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn, chhin-chhiūⁿ in ê lia̍t-chó͘ ngī-sim kò͘-chip, m̄-khéng hóe-kái, m̄ sìn-ho̍k Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè.

In khì-sak Siōng Chú ê kui-lē, í-ki̍p I kap in ê lia̍t-chó͘ só͘ li̍p ê iok, m̄ thiaⁿ I ê kéng-kài, khì pài hu-ké ê sîn-bêng, tì-kàu ka-kī chiâⁿ-chòe khang-hu. Sui-jiân Siōng Chú bat bēng-lēng in m̄-thang o̍h chiu-ûi lia̍t-kok ê só͘-chòe, in iû-goân khì o̍h in.

In khì-sak Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè só͘-ū ê kài-bēng, ūi ka-kī chù-chō nn̄g chiah gû-á ê siōng, chòe A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng, kèng-pài thiⁿ-téng ê bān-siōng, ho̍k-sāi Pa-le̍k.
In sio in ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hiàn-chòe chè, koh thiu-chhiam pok-kòa, kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, lâi chhut-bōe ka-kī, kek Siōng Chú siū-khì.
Só͘-í Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoat tōa siū-khì, tùi I ê bīn-chêng kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; chí-ū chhun Iû-tāi chi̍t ê chi-cho̍k.
Iû-tāi mā bô chun-thàn Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, tian-tò o̍h Í-sek-lia̍t ê hong-sio̍k kui-lē.
Siōng Chú khì-sak Í-sek-lia̍t só͘-ū ê hō͘-tāi, kā in khó͘-chhó͘, chiong in kau hō͘ chhiúⁿ-toa̍t in ê lâng, chòe-āu tùi I ê bīn-chêng kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.

Í-sek-lia̍t tùi Tāi-pi̍t -ke hun-lia̍t chhut--khì, chiū siat-li̍p Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an choh-ông. Iâ-lô-pho-an ín-iú Í-sek-lia̍t, hō͘ in bô sūn-thàn Siōng Chú, hām-lo̍h tōa-chōe.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kè-sio̍k hoān Iâ-lô-pho-an lóng-chóng ê chōe.

Chòe-āu, Siōng Chú kā Í-sek-lia̍t tùi I ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, tú-tú chiàu I thong-kè I ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti só͘ kóng--ê. Án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t siū-lia̍h lī-khui in ê ka-hiong khì kàu A-su̍t, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.

A-su̍t -ông tùi Pa-pí-lûn, Kó͘-tha, A-óa, Hap-má, kap Se-hoat-óa-im, chhian-sóa lâng lâi tòa tī Sat-má-lī-a ta̍k-ê siâⁿ, tāi-thòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; in chiū chiàm-léng Sat-má-lī-a, tòa tī hiah-ê siâⁿ.
In tú-á tòa tī hia ê sî, bô pài Siōng Chú, só͘-í Siōng Chú chiū hō͘ sai ji̍p-khì in tiong-kan, kā-sí chi̍t-kóa lâng.

Ū lâng tùi A-su̍t -ông kóng, “Lí chhian-sóa khì tòa tī Sat-má-lī-a hiah-ê siâⁿ ê ta̍k-cho̍k ê lâng, m̄ chai hit só͘-chāi ê Siōng-tè ê kui-lē, só͘-í I hō͘ sai ji̍p-khì in tiong-kan, kā-sí in, in-ūi in m̄ chai hit só͘-chāi ê Siōng-tè ê kui-lē.”
A-su̍t -ông chiū bēng-lēng kóng, “Tio̍h hō͘ tùi hia lia̍h--lâi ê chi̍t ê chè-si tò--khì, hō͘ i tòa tī hia, ēng hit só͘-chāi ê Siōng-tè ê kui-lē kàu-tō in.”
Án-ni, chiū ū chi̍t ê tùi Sat-má-lī-a hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì ê chè-si tò--lâi, tòa tī Pek-te̍k-lī, kà in tio̍h án-chóaⁿ kèng-ùi Siōng Chú.
M̄-kú ta̍k-cho̍k ê lâng tī in khiā-khí ê siâⁿ chō in ka-hiong ê sîn-bêng, an-tì tī Sat-má-lī-a -lâng í-chêng chō ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ.
Pa-pí-lûn -lâng chō So͘-kat Pí-la̍p ê siōng, Kó͘-tha -lâng chō Le̍k-kah ê siōng, Hap-má -lâng chō A-sī-má ê siōng,
A-óa -lâng chō Le̍k-hap kap Tha-ní-tha ê siōng, Se-hoat-óa-im -lâng sio kiáⁿ-jî hiàn hō͘ Se-hoat-óa-im ê sîn-bêng A-tek-bí-le̍k kap A-ná-bí-le̍k.
In pài Siōng Chú, m̄-kú mā tùi in tiong-kan siat-li̍p lâng chòe soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ ê chè-si, thòe in tī soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ hiàn-chè.
In pài Siōng Chú, koh chiàu in ta̍k-kok ê hong-sio̍k kui-lē ho̍k-sāi ka-kī ê sîn-bêng.

Kàu kin-á-ji̍t, in iû-goân chiàu í-chêng ê hong-sio̍k teh chòe, bô kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, bô chun-thàn Siōng Chú hoan-hù Ngá-kok hō͘-tāi ê kui-lē, bēng-lēng, lu̍t-hoat, kap kài-bēng; Siōng Chú ū kā Ngá-kok hō-miâ kiò-chòe Í-sek-lia̍t.
Siōng Chú bat kap in li̍p-iok, hoan-hù in, kóng, “M̄-thang pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng; m̄-thang kūi-pài in, m̄-thang ho̍k-sāi in, mā m̄-thang kā in hiàn-chè.
Chí-ū hit-ūi chhun-chhut tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p ê Siōng Chú, lín tio̍h kèng-ùi I, kūi-pài I, tùi I hiàn-chè.
Góa siá hō͘ lín ê kui-lē, bēng-lēng, lu̍t-hoat, kap kài-bēng, lín eng-kai éng-oán chip-siú sūn-thàn; m̄-thang pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng.
Góa kap lín li̍p ê iok, lín m̄-thang bōe-kì--tit, mā m̄-thang pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng.
Chí-ū tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, I chiū ōe kiù lín thoat-lī lín it-chhè tùi-te̍k ê chhiú.”
M̄-kú in m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn, iû-goân chiàu í-chêng ê hong-sio̍k teh chòe.

Án-ni, chiah-ê tùi lia̍t-kok chhian-sóa--lâi ê lâng pài Siōng Chú, koh ho̍k-sāi in ê ngó͘-siōng; in ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun kàu kin-á-ji̍t mā lóng o̍h in ê chó͘-sian án-ni teh chòe.
Tng Í-la ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Hô-sè-a tē-saⁿ nî, A-hap-su ê kiáⁿ Hi-se-ka khai-sí chòe Iû-tāi -ông.
I chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-gō͘ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông jī-cha̍p-káu nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe A-pí-ngá, sī Sat-ka-lī-a ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Hi-se-ka chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, chiàu i ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t it-chhè ê só͘-chòe.

I hòe-tû soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, húi-hoāi chio̍h-thiāu, chhò A-sià-la ê thiāu-siōng, phah-chhùi Mô͘-se chō ê tâng-chôa; in-ūi hit-sî Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng iáu tùi tâng-chôa sio-hiuⁿ, kiò i chòe Nî-hut-sū-tān.
Hi-se-ka óa-khò Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè; tī i í-chêng kap í-āu ê Iû-tāi lia̍t-ông, bô lâng ōe-tàng kap i pí.
Hi-se-ka tùi Siōng Chú tiong-sêng, bô lī-khui I, chip-siú Siōng Chú só͘ bēng-lēng Mô͘-se ê kài-bēng.
Siōng Chú kap i tông-chāi, i bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, só͘ chòe--ê lóng sūn-lī; i pōe-poān A-su̍t -ông, bô koh ho̍k-sāi i.
I phah-pāi Hui-lī-sū -lâng, ti̍t-kàu Ka-sat kap sì-ûi ê tōe-khu, tùi kan-ta ū siú-bōng-tâi ê chng-siā kàu ū pó-lúi ê siâⁿ.
Hi-se-ka -ông tē-sì nî, chiū-sī Í-la ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Hô-sè-a tē-chhit nî, A-su̍t -ông Sat-bān-í-sek chiūⁿ-lâi ûi-kong Sat-má-lī-a.
Kàu tē-saⁿ nî nî-bé, chiū-sī Hi-se-ka tē-la̍k nî, Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Hô-sè-a tē-káu nî, Sat-má-lī-a siū kong-phòa.
A-su̍t -ông chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lia̍h-khì A-su̍t, hō͘ in tòa tī Hap-la̍h, Ko-sàn tōe-khu ê Hap-phok hô-piⁿ, í-ki̍p Bí-tí-a -lâng ê siâⁿ.
In-ūi in m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, ûi-pōe I ê iok; Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se só͘ bēng-lēng in--ê, in m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn, m̄ chun-siú.
Hi-se-ka -ông tē-cha̍p-sì nî, A-su̍t -ông Se-ná-ki-li̍p chiūⁿ-lâi kong-kek Iû-tāi só͘-ū kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, koh kā in chiàm-léng.

Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka phài lâng khì La-kiat kìⁿ A-su̍t -ông, kóng, “Góa ū tek-chōe lí, kiû lí thiat-kun lī-khui góa; lí bô-lūn iau-kiû sím-mi̍h, góa lóng tah-èng.” Tùi án-ni, A-su̍t -ông hoa̍t Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka gûn chi̍t-bān kong-kun, kim chi̍t-chheng kong-kun.
Hi-se-ka chiū chiong Siōng Chú sèng-tiān kap ông-kiong ê hú-khò͘ só͘-ū ê gûn lóng hō͘ i.
Hi-se-ka koh chiong Siōng Chú sèng-tiān mn̂g-téng ê kim kap i ka-kī pau tī thiāu-téng ê kim pak--lo̍h-lâi, kau hō͘ A-su̍t -ông.

A-su̍t -ông tùi La-kiat phài goân-sòe, chiong-kun, kap chóng-su-lēng, tòa tāi-kun khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Hi-se-ka -ông hia. In chiūⁿ-lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, khiā tī Siōng-tî ê chúi-kau piⁿ, tī Phiò-pò͘-tiûⁿ ê tōa-lō͘ hia.
In tōa-siaⁿ kiò ông, chiū ū Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ kiong-têng chóng-koán Í-lī-a-kèng, su-kì Sià-pek-ná, í-ki̍p A-sat ê kiáⁿ sú-koaⁿ Iok-a, chhut-lâi kìⁿ in.
Chóng-su-lēng tùi in kóng, “Khì kā Hi-se-ka kóng, A-su̍t tāi-ông án-ni kóng, ‘Lí teh khò-sè sím-mi̍h?
Lí siūⁿ-kóng ū chhek-lio̍k kap kun-le̍k, kî-si̍t sī phòng-hong ê ōe. Tàu-tóe lí sī khò siáⁿ-lâng, kèng-jiân káⁿ hoán-poān góa?
Lí só͘ óa-khò ê Ai-ki̍p sī chi̍t ki tn̄g--khì ê lô͘-tek-á-koáiⁿ; lâng nā khò i, chhiú ōe hō͘ i chha̍k--ji̍p-khì. Só͘-ū óa-khò Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló ê lâng lóng ōe án-ni.

Lín nā tùi góa kóng: Goán óa-khò Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè; Hi-se-ka kiám m̄-sī ū hòe-tû Siōng-tè ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ kap chè-tôaⁿ, koh kā Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng kóng: Lín it-tēng tio̍h tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chit-ê chè-tôaⁿ kèng-pài?’
Taⁿ lâi, lâi kap góa ê chú-lâng A-su̍t -ông sio-su. Góa hō͘ lín nn̄g-chheng chiah bé, lín kiám ū hoat-tō͘ chhē kàu-gia̍h ê lâng thang khiâ?
Nā bô hoat-tō͘, lín ná ōe-tàng phah-pāi góa ê chú siōng-sòe ê chi̍t ê pō͘-hā? Lín kiám beh koh óa-khò Ai-ki̍p ê chiàn-chhia kap bé-peng?

Hiān-chāi, góa lâi kong-kek húi-bia̍t chit-ê só͘-chāi, kiám m̄-sī Siōng Chú ê chí-ì? Siōng Chú chhin-sin kā góa kóng, ‘Chiūⁿ-khì kong-chhú chit-tè thó͘-tōe, kā i húi-bia̍t.’”

Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-kèng, Sià-pek-ná, kap Iok-a tùi chóng-su-lēng kóng, “Chhiáⁿ ēng A-lân-ōe tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn kóng, goán thiaⁿ ū. Chhiáⁿ m̄-thang ēng Hi-pek-lâi-ōe kóng, kiaⁿ-liáu hō͘ siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng ê jîn-bîn thiaⁿ--tio̍h.”

Chóng-su-lēng tùi in kóng, “Lín siūⁿ-kóng goán chú-lâng chhe góa kóng chiah-ê ōe, chí-ū beh hō͘ lín kap lín ê kok-ông thiaⁿ sī--bô? M̄-sī, góa mā beh kóng hō͘ siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng ê lâng thiaⁿ. In kap lín kâng-khoán tio̍h chia̍h ka-kī ê pùn, lim ka-kī ê jiō.”
Chóng-su-lēng koh khiā khí-lâi tōa-siaⁿ ēng Hi-pek-lâi-ōe hoah kóng, “Tio̍h thiaⁿ A-su̍t tāi-ông ê ōe.
Ông án-ni kóng, ‘M̄-thang hō͘ Hi-se-ka phiàn--khì, in-ūi i bōe-tàng kiù lín thoat-lī góa ê chhiú.
I kiò lín sìn-khò Siōng Chú, kóng: Siōng Chú it-tēng ōe kiù lán; chit-ê siâⁿ bōe hām-lo̍h tī A-su̍t -ông ê chhiú.’

M̄-thang thiaⁿ Hi-se-ka ê ōe. A-su̍t -ông án-ni kóng, ‘Kap góa kóng-hô, chhut-lâi tâu-hâng. Án-ni, lín ta̍k-ê lâng chiū ōe-tàng chia̍h ka-kī chèng ê phû-tô kap bû-hoa-kó, lim lín ka-kī ê chíⁿ-chúi,

thèng-hāu góa chhōa lín kàu chi̍t ê só͘-chāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ê thó͘-tōe, ū ngó͘-kok kap sin-chiú, ū bí-niû kap phû-tô-hn̂g, ū kaⁿ-ná-iû kap bi̍t, hō͘ lín oa̍h tn̂g-hè-siū. M̄-thang hō͘ Hi-se-ka phiàn--khì, i kóng: Siōng Chú it-tēng ōe kiù lán. Lín m̄-thang thiaⁿ i ê ōe.
Bān-kok ê chèng sîn-bêng, tó chi̍t ê bat kiù i ka-kī ê kok thoat-lī A-su̍t -ông ê chhiú?
Hap-má kap A-ní-poa̍t ê sîn-bêng tī tó-ūi? Se-hoat-óa-im, Hi-ná, Í-óa ê sîn-bêng tī tó-ūi? In kiám ū kái-kiù Sat-má-lī-a thoat-lī góa ê chhiú?
Chiah-ê kok-ka ê sîn-bêng ū tó chi̍t ê bat tùi góa ê chhiú kiù-chhut i ka-kī ê kok-ka? Án-ni, Siōng Chú ná ōe-tàng kiù Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng thoat-lī góa ê chhiú-thâu?’”
M̄-kú jîn-bîn lóng chēng-chēng, bô ìn pòaⁿ-kù ōe, in-ūi Hi-se-ka -ông ū kā in hoan-hù, “M̄-thang ìn i!”

Hit-sî, Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ kiong-têng chóng-koán Í-lī-a-kèng, su-kì Sià-pek-ná, kap A-sat ê kiáⁿ sú-koaⁿ Iok-a, lóng thiah-li̍h in ê saⁿ, tùi Hi-se-ka pò-kò A-su̍t ê chóng-su-lēng kā in kóng ê ōe.
Hi-se-ka -ông chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h in ê pò-kò, chiū thiah-li̍h i ê saⁿ, chhēng môa-saⁿ, ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān.
I phài kiong-têng chóng-koán Í-lī-a-kèng, su-kì Sià-pek-ná, kap chu-chhim ê chè-si, lóng chhēng môa-saⁿ, khì kìⁿ A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Í-sài-a.

In kā Í-sài-a kóng, “ Hi-se-ka án-ni kóng, ‘Kin-á-ji̍t sī hoān-lān ê ji̍t, sī siū chek-hoa̍t lêng-jio̍k ê ji̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ ū gín-á beh chhut-sì, m̄-kú bô-la̍t kā siⁿ--chhut-lâi.

A-su̍t -ông ū phài i ê pō͘-hā chóng-su-lēng lâi siat-to̍k éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè, kiám-chhái Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h, ōe chhú-hoa̍t kóng chiah-ê ōe ê lâng. Só͘-í, tio̍h thòe lâu tī chia ê lâng kî-tó.’”
Hi-se-ka -ông ê tāi-sîn lâi kìⁿ Í-sài-a ê sî,

Í-sài-a tùi in kóng, “Lín tio̍h án-ni kā lín ê chú-lâng kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: M̄-thang in-ūi lín só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h A-su̍t -ông ê pō͘-hā tùi góa ê húi-pòng lâi kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh jiáu-loān i ê sim, hō͘ i thiaⁿ-tio̍h hong-siaⁿ, tò-tńg-khì ka-kī ê kok-ka; góa beh hō͘ i tī hia hō͘ lâng thâi--sí.’”
Chóng-su-lēng thiaⁿ-tio̍h A-su̍t -ông í-keng lī-khui La-kiat khì kong-kek Li̍p-ná, chiū chhut-hoat khì Li̍p-ná kap ông hōe-ha̍p.
A-su̍t -ông thiaⁿ-kìⁿ I-soh-phit-a -ông Te̍k-hap-ka beh lâi kong-kek in, chiū phài sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Hi-se-ka, hoan-hù in
tùi Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka kóng, “M̄-thang hō͘ lín só͘ óa-khò ê Siōng-tè phiàn--khì, kóng: Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng bōe hām-lo̍h tī A-su̍t -ông ê chhiú-thâu.
Lín it-tēng ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h A-su̍t chu-ông tùi lia̍t-kok só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì; in kā lia̍t-kok lóng châu-bia̍t. Lín kiám ū hoat-tō͘ pī-bián?
Góa ê chó͘-sian húi-bia̍t ê kok-ka, Ko-sàn, Hap-lân, Lī-sek, í-ki̍p tòa tī Thê-la-sat ê Pek I-tiân -lâng, in ê sîn-bêng kiám ū kái-kiù in?
Hap-má ê ông, A-ní-poa̍t ê ông, Se-hoat-óa-im -siâⁿ ê ông, Hi-ná kap Í-óa ê ông tī tó-ūi?”
Hi-se-ka tùi sù-chiá ê chhiú chiap-tio̍h phoe, tha̍k liáu-āu, chiū chiūⁿ-khì Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng chiong phoe thí-khui.

Hi-se-ka ǹg Siōng Chú kî-tó kóng, “Chē tī thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek téng-bīn ê Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ah, chí-ū lí sī tōe-chiūⁿ bān-kok ê Siōng-tè. Lí chhòng-chō thiⁿ kap tōe.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ, khui lí ê ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ. Kiû lí thiaⁿ Se-ná-ki-li̍p chhe sù-chiá lâi kóng it-chhè siat-to̍k lí oa̍h-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê ōe.
Siōng Chú ah, A-su̍t chu-ông khak-si̍t ū hō͘ lia̍t-kok kap in ê thó͘-tōe lóng hong-hòe,
kā in ê sîn-bêng lóng hiat hō͘ hé sio-bia̍t, kî-si̍t hiah-ê m̄-sī sîn, put-kò sī lâng ê chhiú ēng chhâ ēng chio̍h chō--ê.
Taⁿ, Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kiù goán thoat-lī i ê chhiú, hō͘ tōe-chiūⁿ bān-kok lóng ōe chai chí-ū lí Siōng Chú sī Siōng-tè.”

A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ Í-sài-a chhe lâng khì kìⁿ Hi-se-ka, kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lí in-ūi A-su̍t -ông Se-ná-ki-li̍p ê sū tùi góa kî-tó, góa ū thiaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Koan-hē Se-ná-ki-li̍p, góa Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Chāi-sek-lú Sek-an khòaⁿ-khin lí, thí-chhiò lí; siàu-lú Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tùi lí iô-thâu.

Lí teh bú-jio̍k siáⁿ-lâng, siat-to̍k siáⁿ-lâng? Lí teh tùi siáⁿ-lâng tōa-siaⁿ? Lí teh tùi siáⁿ-lâng kiau-ngō͘, kā i khòaⁿ m̄ chiūⁿ-ba̍k? Kî-si̍t lí sī teh bû-sī góa Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè!

Lí ū thong-kè lí ê sù-chiá bú-bān Chú. Lí kóng: Góa sái chin chōe chiàn-chhia peh-chiūⁿ koân-soaⁿ, khì kàu Lê-pa-lūn siōng-koân ê soaⁿ-chiam. Góa tī hia chhò siōng-koân ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū, chhò siōng-hó ê siông-chhiū. Góa peh-kàu siōng-koân ê soaⁿ-chiam, chìn-ji̍p siōng bō͘-sēng ê chhiū-nâ.
Góa tī gōa-pang ó͘ chíⁿ, lim in ê chúi. Góa mā ēng kha lap Ai-ki̍p só͘-ū ê hô-liû, lap kah hô-liû lóng ta--khì.

“‘Lín kiám m̄-bat thiaⁿ--kìⁿ? Chin chá góa chòe chit-ê kè-ōe, kó͘-chá chiū koat-tēng, taⁿ í-keng si̍t-hiān, chiū-sī lí hō͘ kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ-pó lóng tó-hoāi, pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘ chio̍h-tui.
Hia ê chū-bîn lóng bô-la̍t; in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kiàn-siàu. In chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-tōe ê chháu, iù-nńg ê íⁿ, chhù-bé-téng ê chháu, iáu-bē tōa-châng chiū ta--khì.
“‘Lí tòa tó-ūi, lí chhut, lí ji̍p, lí tùi góa ê siū-khì, góa lóng chai.

In-ūi lí ū tùi góa hoat siū-khì, góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí chū-ko ê ōe; góa beh ēng kau-á kau lí ê phīⁿ, ēng bé-kā-kiuⁿ kòa tī lí ê chhùi, hō͘ lí tùi lâi hit-tiâu lō͘ tò-tńg--khì.’
“ Hi-se-ka, che beh hō͘ lí chòe kì-hō: Kin-nî, mê-nî, lín lóng ōe chia̍h iá-seng ê mi̍h; tē-saⁿ nî, lín ōe iā-chéng, siu-sêng, chai-chèng phû-tô, chia̍h só͘ kiat ê ké-chí.
Iû-tāi -ke tô-thoat só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ si̍t-bu̍t, ē-bīn tèng-kun, téng-bīn kiat ké-chí.

Tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng beh ū chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê chú-bîn chhut--lâi, tùi Sek-an-soaⁿ beh ū lâng tô-thoat--chhut-lâi. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê jia̍t-sêng it-tēng ōe sêng-choân chit-ê sū.

“Só͘-í, koan-hē A-su̍t -ông, Siōng Chú ū án-ni kóng, ‘I bōe chìn-ji̍p chit-ê siâⁿ, liân chi̍t ki chìⁿ mā bōe siā--ji̍p-lâi. I bōe giâ tún-pâi óa-kūn siâⁿ, mā bōe khí thô͘-tui kong siâⁿ.
I tùi tó chi̍t tiâu lō͘ lâi, mā ōe tùi hit-tiâu lō͘ tńg--khì; i bōe chìn-ji̍p chit-ê siâⁿ. Siōng Chú án-ni kóng.
Góa ūi-tio̍h góa ê iân-kò͘, mā ūi-tio̍h góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê iân-kò͘, beh pó-hō͘ kái-kiù chit-ê siâⁿ.’”
Hit-mî, Siōng Chú ê thiⁿ-sài khì A-su̍t kun-iâⁿ, thâi-sí cha̍p-poeh-bān gō͘-chheng ê lâng. Keh-chá-khí, lâng khí--lâi, hoat-kiàn ta̍k só͘-chāi lóng sī sin-si.
A-su̍t -ông Se-ná-ki-li̍p chiū thiat-iâⁿ, tò-tńg-khì Nî-nî-bî, tòa tī hia.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t, i tī Nî-su-lo̍k ê biō teh pài i ê sîn-bêng ê sî, i ê kiáⁿ A-tek-bí-le̍k kap Sa-lī-sek ēng to kā i thâi-sí, jiân-āu tô-cháu khì A-la-la̍h ê tōe; i lēng-gōa chi̍t ê kiáⁿ Í-sat Hap-tùn kè-sêng i choh-ông.

Hit-ê sî-chūn, Hi-se-ka phòa-pīⁿ, pīⁿ kah teh-beh sí. A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Í-sài-a lâi kìⁿ i, kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lí ê hō͘-sū tio̍h kau-tài hó-sè, in-ūi lí ōe sí, pīⁿ bōe hó.’”
Hi-se-ka chiū oa̍t-tńg-sin ǹg piah, tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó kóng,
“Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí tài-liām góa án-chóaⁿ tiong-sêng chīn-sim ho̍k-sāi lí, chòe lí khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū.” Hi-se-ka chiū tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu.
Í-sài-a chhut--khì, iáu-bē kàu tiong-tiâⁿ, Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu i, kóng,

“Lí oa̍t tò-tńg, tùi góa chú-bîn ê ông Hi-se-ka kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — lí ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê kî-tó, ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê ba̍k-sái. Khòaⁿ ah, góa beh kā lí i-hó; tē-saⁿ ji̍t, lí ōe chiūⁿ-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān.

Góa beh hō͘ lí ê hè-siū ke-thiⁿ cha̍p-gō͘ nî. Góa beh kái-kiù lí kap chit-ê siâⁿ thoat-lī A-su̍t -ông ê chhiú; góa ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê iân-kò͘, mā ūi-tio̍h góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê iân-kò͘, ōe pó-hō͘ chit-ê siâⁿ.’”
Í-sài-a kóng, “Tio̍h the̍h chi̍t tè bû-hoa-kó io̍h-ko lâi.” In chiū the̍h-lâi kā tah tī lia̍p-á, ông chiū hó--khí-lâi.
Hi-se-ka mn̄g Í-sài-a kóng, “Siōng Chú beh i-hó góa; tē-saⁿ ji̍t, góa ōe chiūⁿ-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān, ū sím-mi̍h tiāu-thâu?”

Í-sài-a kóng, “Siōng Chú beh si̍t-hiān I só͘ kóng ê tāi-chì, che chiū sī Siōng Chú hō͘ lí ê tiāu-thâu; lí beh ài ji̍t-kui ê ji̍t-iáⁿ chìn-chêng cha̍p tō͘, á-sī tò-thè cha̍p tō͘?”
Hi-se-ka ìn kóng, “Ji̍t-iáⁿ chìn-chêng cha̍p tō͘ khah kán-tan; góa ài ji̍t-iáⁿ tò-thè cha̍p tō͘.”
Sian-ti Í-sài-a kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, I chiū hō͘ A-hap-su só͘ chō ji̍t-kui ê ji̍t-iáⁿ tò-thè cha̍p tō͘.
Hit-sî, Pa-la-tān ê kiáⁿ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Bí-lô-ta̍t Pa-la-tān thiaⁿ-tio̍h Hi-se-ka phòa-pīⁿ, chiū chhe sù-chiá the̍h phoe kap lé-mi̍h khì thàm-hóng Hi-se-ka.

Hi-se-ka sūn sù-chiá ê iau-kiû, chiong i ê châi-pó-khò͘ lāi-bīn ê kim, gûn, hiuⁿ-liāu, kùi-khì ê iû, kap i só͘-ū ê kun-khì, í-ki̍p hú-khò͘ lāi ê it-chhè lóng hō͘ in khòaⁿ. I ê ông-kiong kap choân-kok só͘-ū ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ bô chi̍t hāng bô hō͘ in khòaⁿ

Jiân-āu sian-ti Í-sài-a lâi kìⁿ Hi-se-ka -ông, mn̄g i kóng, “Chiah-ê lâng tùi lí kóng sím-mi̍h? In tùi tó-ūi lâi kìⁿ lí?” Hi-se-ka kóng, “In tùi chi̍t ê chin hn̄g ê kok-ka Pa-pí-lûn lâi thàm góa.”

Í-sài-a kóng, “In tī lí ê ông-kiong ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h sím-mi̍h?” Hi-se-ka hôe-tap, “In ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ông-kiong lāi ta̍k-hāng mi̍h. Góa só͘-ū ê châi-pó bô chi̍t hāng bô hō͘ in khòaⁿ.”
Í-sài-a kā Hi-se-ka kóng, “Tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe:

Ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, ông-kiong lāi it-chhè lí ê chó͘-sian chek-chū kàu kin-á-ji̍t ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, lóng ōe hō͘ lâng poaⁿ-khì Pa-pí-lûn, bô lâu kah pòaⁿ-hāng. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Koh lí chhin-siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-sun, ū-ê ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê ông-kiong chòe thài-kàm.”
Hi-se-ka sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng “Góa chāi-siⁿ ê sî ū thài-pêng an-choân chiū hó”, chiū tùi Í-sài-a kóng, “Lí só͘ thoân-ta̍t Siōng Chú ê ōe chin hó.”
Hi-se-ka kî-tha ê sū-chek kap sêng-chiū, í-ki̍p i án-chóaⁿ ku̍t-tî khui-kau, ín-chúi ji̍p-siâⁿ, lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Hi-se-ka tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, i ê kiáⁿ Má-ná-se sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Má-ná-se chē-ūi ê sî cha̍p-jī hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông gō͘-cha̍p-gō͘ nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Hia̍p-se-pa.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, o̍h hiah-ê hō͘ Siōng Chú tī Í-sek-lia̍t bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-chhut ê lia̍t-kok só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.

I tiông-kiàn i ê lāu-pē Hi-se-ka só͘ húi-hoāi ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ; chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap ê só͘-chòe, ūi Pa-le̍k khí chè-tôaⁿ, chō A-sià-la ê thiāu-siōng, koh kèng-pài ho̍k-sāi thiⁿ-téng ê bān-siōng.
I tī Siōng Chú ê tiān-lāi ūi-tio̍h hiah-ê sîn-bêng khí kúi-nā ê tôaⁿ; Siōng Chú bat kí chit-ê sèng-tiān, kóng, “Góa ê miâ eng-kai tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siū kèng-hōng.”
Má-ná-se tī Siōng Chú ê tiān nn̄g ê tiâⁿ lāi-bīn, ūi-tio̍h thiⁿ-téng ê bān-siōng khí chè-tôaⁿ.
I sio i ê kiáⁿ hiàn-chòe chè, pok-kòa, kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t, mn̄g khan-bông--ê kap tâng-ki toh-thâu; chòe chin chōe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, kek Siōng Chú siū-khì.

Má-ná-se koh tī tiān-lāi chhāi i tiau-khek ê A-sià-la ê siōng.
