Koan-hē chit-keng sèng-tiān, Siōng Chú bat tùi Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “Chit-keng sèng-tiān kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, sī góa tī Í-sek-lia̍t chi-cho̍k tiong só͘ kéng-soán--ê, góa ê miâ tio̍h tī chia éng-oán siū kèng-hōng.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng nā thiaⁿ-thàn góa só͘-ū ê bēng-lēng, chun-hêng góa ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se só͘ hoan-hù in it-chhè ê lu̍t-hoat, góa chiū bô koh hō͘ in tùi góa só͘ siúⁿ-sù in lia̍t-chó͘ ê thó͘-tōe siū chhian-sóa.”
M̄-kú in bô thiaⁿ-thàn; Má-ná-se chhōa in chòe pháiⁿ, pí Siōng Chú tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bīn-chêng só͘ húi-bia̍t ê lia̍t-kok koh-khah giâm-tiōng.
Siōng Chú thok I ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti kóng,
“In-ūi Iû-tāi -ông Má-ná-se chòe chiah-ê khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, pí i í-chêng ê A-mô͘-lī -lâng ê só͘-chòe koh-khah pháiⁿ, koh ēng i ê ngó͘-siōng hō͘ Iû-tāi -lâng hām-lo̍h chōe,
só͘-í Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh kàng chai-hō tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi, hō͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng lóng kiaⁿ-chi̍t-tiô.

Góa beh ēng niû Sat-má-lī-a ê chîn-sòaⁿ kap A-hap -ke ê tūi-chîn, khan tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê téng-bīn; góa beh chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng teh chhit pôaⁿ-á án-ni chhit Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chhit-liáu chiū kā i tò-khap.
Góa beh khì-sak góa só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn, chiong in kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k, chiâⁿ-chòe la̍h-bu̍t hō͘ tùi-te̍k chhiúⁿ--khì.
In-ūi in tùi in ê lia̍t-chó͘ chhut Ai-ki̍p hit-ji̍t kàu kin-á-ji̍t, siông-siông chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, kek góa siū-khì.’”

Má-ná-se hō͘ Iû-tāi -lâng hoān-chōe, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū; chit-ê chōe í-gōa, i koh lâu chin chōe bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih, hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sì-kòe lóng sī huih.
Má-ná-se kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê só͘-chòe, í-ki̍p só͘ hoān ê chōe, lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Má-ná-se tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia liáu-āu, an-chòng tī i ka-kī kiong-lāi ê hn̂g, chiū-sī O͘-sat ê hn̂g. I ê kiáⁿ A-bûn sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
A-bûn chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-jī hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông nn̄g nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Bí-su-lī-bi̍t, sī Iok-thê-pa -lâng Hap-ló͘-su ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê lāu-pē Má-ná-se só͘ chòe--ê.
I kiâⁿ i ê lāu-pē só͘ kiâⁿ ê lō͘, ho̍k-sāi i ê lāu-pē só͘ ho̍k-sāi hiah-ê ngó͘-siōng,
khì-sak Siōng Chú — i ê chó͘-sian ê Siōng-tè, bô kiâⁿ Siōng Chú ê tō-lō͘.
A-bûn ê jîn-sîn pōe-poān i, tī ông-kiong lāi-bīn kā i thâi-sí.
M̄-kú kok-lāi ê jîn-bîn chiong hiah-ê pōe-poān A-bûn -ông ê lâng thâi-sí, siat-li̍p i ê kiáⁿ Iok-se-a sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
A-bûn kî-tha ê sū-chek lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Lâng kā i an-chòng tī O͘-sat ê hn̂g lāi-bīn i ka-kī ê bōng. I ê kiáⁿ Iok-se-a sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iok-se-a chē-ūi ê sî poeh hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông saⁿ-cha̍p-it nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Iâ-tí-tāi, sī Pho-su-ka -lâng A-tāi-ngá ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, kiâⁿ i ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t ê lō͘, bô phian-chó-phian-iū.
Iok-se-a -ông tē-cha̍p-poeh nî, i phài Bí-su-lân ê sun, A-sat-lī-ngá ê kiáⁿ su-kì Sa-hoan khì Siōng Chú ê tiān, hoan-hù i kóng,
“Lí khì kìⁿ tōa-chè-si Hi-le̍k-ka, chhiáⁿ i chiong sèng-tiān mn̂g-kháu ê siú-ōe tùi jîn-bîn siu--lâi, tòa-ji̍p Siōng Chú sèng-tiān hiah-ê gûn, tiám-sǹg chheng-chhó,

kau hō͘ koán-lí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê lâng, hō͘ in choán-kau Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ê kang-lâng, chiū-sī choh-ba̍k sai-hū, kiàn-tio̍k kang-lâng, kap thô͘-chúi sai-hū, khì bóe chhâ-liāu kap keh-keng ê chio̍h, thang siu-lí sèng-tiān sún-hoāi ê só͘-chāi.
M̄-kú m̄-bián kap hoat kang-chîⁿ ê lâng tùi-siàu, in-ūi in chòe tāi-chì sêng-si̍t.”

Tōa-chè-si Hi-le̍k-ka tùi su-kì Sa-hoan kóng, “Góa tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān lāi-bīn hoat-kiàn chi̍t kńg lu̍t-hoat ê chheh.” Hi-le̍k-ka chiong chheh kau hō͘ Sa-hoan, Sa-hoan chiū tha̍k hit-kńg chheh.
Su-kì Sa-hoan khì kìⁿ ông, hôe-ho̍k ông kóng, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn í-keng chiong tiān-lāi ê gûn piàⁿ--chhut-lâi, kau hō͘ koán-lí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê lâng.”
Su-kì Sa-hoan koh tùi ông kóng, “Tōa-chè-si Hi-le̍k-ka ū the̍h chi̍t kńg chheh hō͘ góa.” Sa-hoan chiū tī ông ê bīn-chêng tōa-siaⁿ tha̍k hit-kńg chheh.
Ông thiaⁿ-tio̍h Lu̍t-hoat-su ê ōe, chiū thiah-li̍h i ê saⁿ.
Ông hoan-hù tōa-chè-si Hi-le̍k-ka, Sa-hoan ê kiáⁿ A-hi-kam, Bí-kai-a ê kiáⁿ A-kek-pho, su-kì Sa-hoan, kap ông ê jîn-sîn A-sat-ngá, kóng,

“Lín khì, ūi góa kap choân-thé Iû-tāi jîn-bîn, chiong só͘ hoat-kiàn chit-kńg chheh ê ōe chhéng-būn Siōng Chú. In-ūi lán ê chó͘-sian bô thiaⁿ-thàn chit-kńg chheh ê ōe, bô chiàu só͘ kì-chài tùi lán ê kà-sī khì chòe, só͘-í Siōng Chú tùi lán hoat tōa siū-khì.”

Tùi án-ni, tōa-chè-si Hi-le̍k-ka, kap A-hi-kam, A-kek-pho, Sa-hoan, A-sat-ngá, chòe-hé khì kìⁿ lú sian-ti Hō͘-le̍k-tāi. I sī koán-lí lé-ho̍k hit-ê Sa-liông ê bó͘; Sa-liông sī Hap-ní-hap-su ê sun, Te̍k-óa ê kiáⁿ. Hō͘-le̍k-tāi tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sin ê siâⁿ-khu. In kā i chhéng-kàu.
I tùi in kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lín khì hôe-ho̍k chhe lín lâi kìⁿ góa ê lâng, kā i kóng
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh chiàu Iû-tāi -ông só͘ tha̍k hit-kńg chheh ê ōe, kàng chai-hō tī chit-ê só͘-chāi kap chia ê chū-bîn.
In-ūi in khì-sak góa, kā pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ, ēng in ê só͘-chòe kek góa siū-khì, só͘-í góa tùi chit-ê só͘-chāi hoat tōa siū-khì bô-soah.’
M̄-kú chhe lín lâi chhéng-būn Siōng Chú ê Iû-tāi -ông, lín tio̍h án-ni tùi i kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Lí thiaⁿ-tio̍h

góa beh hō͘ chit-ê só͘-chāi pha-hng, hō͘ chia ê chū-bîn siū chiù-chó͘, lí chiū chhàm-hóe, tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng khiam-pi, koh thiah-li̍h saⁿ, tī góa ê bīn-chêng thî-khàu, góa ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h. Siōng Chú kóng:

Só͘-í góa beh hō͘ lí pêng-an lī-khui sè-kan, tńg-khì lí ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia. Lí bōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa só͘ beh kàng-lo̍h tī chit só͘-chāi it-chhè ê chai-hō.’” In chiū tò--khì, chiong chiah-ê ōe tùi ông hôe-ho̍k.
Iok-se-a -ông phài lâng tiàu-chi̍p Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chèng tiúⁿ-ló.

Ông chiūⁿ-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān; Iû-tāi chèng-lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn, chè-si, sian-ti, kap só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn, bô-lūn tōa-sòe, mā lóng chiūⁿ--khì. Ông chiū chiong tī Siōng Chú tiān-lāi hoat-kiàn ê iok-su it-chhè ê ōe tha̍k hō͘ in thiaⁿ.

Ông khiā tī thiāu-piⁿ, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng li̍p-iok, beh choân-sim choân-ì sūn-thàn Siōng Chú, chun-siú I ê kài-bēng, kà-sī, kap kui-lē, si̍t-hêng chit-kńg chheh só͘ siá li̍p-iok ê ōe. Jîn-bîn mā lóng koat-sim beh chun-siú chit-ê iok.

Ông bēng-lēng tōa-chè-si Hi-le̍k-ka, hù-chè-si, kap sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe, chiong ūi Pa-le̍k, A-sià-la, kap thiⁿ-téng ê bān-siōng só͘ chō ê khì-khū, lóng tùi Siōng Chú ê tiān poaⁿ--chhut-khì, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng gōa-bīn, Khip-lûn Khoe-kok ê soaⁿ-phiâⁿ pàng-hé sio, koh chiong hé-hu piàⁿ tī Pek-te̍k-lī.

Í-chêng Iû-tāi lia̍t-ông só͘ siat-li̍p ê chè-si, chiū-sī tī Iû-tāi hiah-ê siâⁿ, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sì-ûi ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ sio-hiuⁿ pài ngó͘-siōng, ǹg Pa-le̍k sio-hiuⁿ, pài ji̍t, ge̍h, chhiⁿ-sîn, í-ki̍p thiⁿ-téng bān-siōng ê chè-si, Iok-se-a -ông lóng kā in hòe-tû.

I koh kā A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng tùi Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān poaⁿ--chhut-khì, kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng gōa-bīn ê Khip-lûn Khoe-kok, tī hia pàng-hé sio, tûi-chòe hé-hu, chiong hiah-ê hé-hu iā tī jîn-bîn ê kong-bōng.
Koh thiah-húi Siōng Chú tiān-lāi lâm-chhiong ê chhù, chiū-sī hū-lú ūi-tio̍h A-sià-la pian-chit mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê só͘-chāi.

Iok-se-a tùi Ka-pa kàu Pia̍t-sī-pa, chiong Iû-tāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ ê chè-si tiàu-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, phò-hoāi hiah-ê chè-si sio-hiuⁿ ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ. I koh thiah-húi Iok-su-a chhī-tiúⁿ só͘ khí pài soaⁿ-iûⁿ-kúi ê biō; chit-ê biō tī ji̍p siâⁿ-mn̂g ê tò-pêng.
M̄-kú soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ ê chè-si bô tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng Chú ê tôaⁿ ho̍k-sāi, chí-ū ōe-tàng kap kî-tha ê chè-si chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ.
Iok-se-a koh phò-hoāi tī Him-lūn-chú Soaⁿ-kok ê Tô-hui-te̍k -biō, chiah bián lâng tī hia sio in ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hiàn hō͘ Mô͘-lo̍k.

I koh chiong Iû-tāi lia̍t-ông hiàn hō͘ ji̍t-thâu hiah-ê bé sóa-cháu, sio-húi hiàn hō͘ ji̍t-thâu ê chiàn-chhia. Chiah-ê bé pún-lâi hē tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê mn̂g-piⁿ, óa-kūn thài-kàm Ná-tan Bí-le̍k ê chhù.

Iû-tāi lia̍t-ông tī A-hap-su ông-kiong chhù-téng só͘ khí ê chè-tôaⁿ, kap Má-ná-se tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān nn̄g ê tiâⁿ só͘ khí ê chè-tôaⁿ, Iok-se-a lóng kā in húi-hoāi, kòng-chhùi, chiong hiah-ê iù-á piàⁿ tī Khip-lûn Khoe-kok.

Í-chêng Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Só͘-lô-bûn tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê tang-pêng, tī Húi-bia̍t-soaⁿ ê lâm-pêng, ūi-tio̍h ho̍k-sāi Se-tùn -lâng khó-ò͘ⁿ ê A-su-tha-lio̍k, Mô͘-ap -lâng khó-ò͘ⁿ ê Ki-boat, A-bûn -lâng khó-ò͘ⁿ ê Mô͘-lo̍k só͘ khí ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, Iok-se-a -ông lóng kā in phò-hoāi.
I koh húi-hoāi chio̍h-thiāu, chhò A-sià-la ê thiāu-siōng, ēng sí-lâng ê kut-thâu kā hiah-ê só͘-chāi thūn-móa.

Iok-se-a húi-hoāi Pek-te̍k-lī ê chè-tôaⁿ, chiū-sī Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an só͘ khí, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t hoān-chōe ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, kā chè-tôaⁿ kap soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ kòng kah chhùi-chhùi, koh sio A-sià-la thiāu-siōng.

I oa̍t-thâu, khòaⁿ-tio̍h soaⁿ--ni̍h hiah-ê bōng, chiū phài lâng khì the̍h bōng-lāi ê kut-thâu, tiàm tôaⁿ-téng sio, phah lâ-sâm chè-tôaⁿ. Tú-tú èng-giām í-chêng Iâ-lô-pho-an tī choeh-kî khiā tī tôaⁿ-piⁿ ê sî, Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng só͘ soan-kò Siōng Chú ê ōe. Iok-se-a koh oa̍t-thâu khòaⁿ-tio̍h soan-kò chiah-ê ōe hit-ê Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ê bōng,

Iok-se-a mn̄g, “Góa khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng ê bōng-pâi?” Hit-ê siâⁿ ê lâng tùi i kóng, “Che sī Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ê bōng; i tùi Iû-tāi lâi, ū-giân ông tú-chiah kong-kek Pek-te̍k-lī ê tôaⁿ ê tāi-chì.”
I kóng, “Mài kā tín-tāng. M̄-thang sóa i ê kut-thâu.” In chiū bô khì tāng i ê kut-thâu, mā bô tāng-tio̍h tùi Sat-má-lī-a lâi hit-ê sian-ti ê kut-thâu.

Í-chêng Í-sek-lia̍t ê lia̍t-ông tī Sat-má-lī-a ta̍k-ê siâⁿ khí soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ kek Siōng Chú siū-khì, hiān-chāi Iok-se-a chhin-chhiūⁿ i tī Pek-te̍k-lī só͘ chòe--ê chiong hiah-ê lóng húi-hoāi;
koh tī tôaⁿ-téng thâi-sí só͘-ū soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ ê chè-si; tī tôaⁿ-téng sio lâng ê kut-thâu. Āu-lâi i tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Ông bēng-lēng choân-kok jîn-bîn, kóng, “Tio̍h chiàu chit-ê iok-su ê kì-chài, siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.”
Tùi sū-su tī-lí Í-sek-lia̍t, kàu Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi lia̍t-ông thóng-tī ê sî, in iáu m̄-bat chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.
Chí-ū kàu Iok-se-a -ông tē-cha̍p-poeh nî chiah tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ǹg Siōng Chú siú chit-ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.

Iû-tāi -tōe kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘-ū khan-bông--ê kap tâng-ki toh-thâu, ngó͘-siōng kap ka-cho̍k-sîn-siōng, í-ki̍p it-chhè khó-ò͘ⁿ ê mi̍h, Iok-se-a lóng kā in tû-tiāu, chiàu tōa-chè-si Hi-le̍k-ka tī Siōng Chú ê tiān só͘ hoat-kiàn ê Lu̍t-hoat-su só͘ kì-chài ê ōe khì chòe.
Tī Iok-se-a í-chêng bô ông chhin-chhiūⁿ i choân-sim choân-ì choân-le̍k kui-ǹg Siōng Chú, chun-hêng Mô͘-se só͘-ū ê lu̍t-hoat; tī i í-āu, mā bô ū chi̍t ê ông chhin-chhiūⁿ i.
M̄-kú, in-ūi Má-ná-se ê só͘-chòe ū kek Siōng Chú siū-khì, Siōng Chú bô thêng-chí I tùi Iû-tāi só͘ hoat béng-lia̍t ê tōa siū-khì.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh chiong Iû-tāi tùi góa ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-cháu, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa bat kóaⁿ-cháu Í-sek-lia̍t; góa beh khì-sak góa só͘ kéng chit-ê siâⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, kap chit-keng sèng-tiān, chiū-sī góa bat chí i kóng, ‘Góa ê miâ eng-kai tī hia siū kèng-hōng’ ê só͘-chāi.”
Iok-se-a kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê só͘-chòe, lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.

Iok-se-a chāi-ūi ê sî, Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló Nî-ko chiūⁿ Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô, pang-chān A-su̍t -ông, Iok-se-a -ông chhut-khì gêng-chiàn; Ai-ki̍p -ông tī Bí-kiat-to kap Iok-se-a kau-chiàn, tī hia kā Iok-se-a thâi-sí.

I ê jîn-sîn ēng chhia chài i ê si-thé, tùi Bí-kiat-to sàng tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chiong i an-chòng tī i ka-kī ê bōng. Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn ēng iû boah Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-su, siat-li̍p i choh-ông, sòa-chiap i ê lāu-pē.
Iok-hap-su chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-saⁿ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông saⁿ ge̍h-ji̍t kú. I ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Hap-bō͘-tha, sī Li̍p-ná -lâng Iâ-lī-bí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Iok-hap-su chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, chiàu i ê chó͘-sian ê só͘-chòe khì chòe.
Hoat-ló Nî-ko chiong i koaiⁿ tī Hap-má -tōe ê Lī-pí-la, put-chún i tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông; koh hoa̍t Iû-tāi -kok kim saⁿ-cha̍p-sì kong-kun, gûn saⁿ-chheng sì-pah kong-kun.

Ai-ki̍p -ông Nî-ko siat-li̍p Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-kèng sòa-chiap i ê lāu-pē Iok-se-a choh-ông, kā i kái-miâ chòe Iok-ngá-kèng; koh kā Iok-hap-su lia̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p, i chiū sí tī hia.
Iok-ngá-kèng chiàu Ai-ki̍p -ông ê bēng-lēng, chiong kim kap gûn kau hō͘ i; Iok-ngá-kèng tùi choân-kok jîn-bîn, chiàu in ê châi-le̍k teng-siu kim-gûn, kau hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông Nî-ko.
Iok-ngá-kèng chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-gō͘ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-it nî. I ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Se-pò͘-tāi, sī Ló͘-má -lâng Pí-tāi-ngá ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Iok-ngá-kèng chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, chiàu i ê chó͘-sian ê só͘-chòe khì chòe.
Iok-ngá-kèng chāi-ūi ê sî, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat lâi chhim-hoān Iû-tāi. Iok-ngá-kèng ho̍k-sāi i saⁿ nî, āu-lâi soah pōe-poān i.

Siōng Chú phài Pa-pí-lûn, Sū-lī-a, Mô͘-ap, kap A-bûn ê iû-kek-tūi lâi kong-kek Iok-ngá-kèng; koh chhe in kong-kek Iû-tāi beh kā i húi-bia̍t; tú chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè I ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti só͘ kóng ê ōe.

Chit-ê sū lîm-kàu Iû-tāi, si̍t-chāi sī chhut tī Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, beh chiong Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn tùi I ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-cháu; che lóng sī in-ūi Má-ná-se só͘ hoān it-chhè ê chōe;
i thâi bû-ko͘ ê lâng, hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sì-kòe lóng sī in ê huih; chit-ê chōe Siōng Chú m̄-khéng sià-bián.
Iok-ngá-kèng kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê só͘-chòe, lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iok-ngá-kèng tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, i ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kun sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Ai-ki̍p -ông bô koh chhut-peng kong-kek gōa-kok, in-ūi i só͘ koán ê tōe, tùi Ai-ki̍p pian-kài kàu Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô, lóng hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông chhiúⁿ--khì.
Iok-ngá-kun chē-ūi ê sî cha̍p-poeh hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông saⁿ kò-ge̍h. I ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Nî-hō͘-si-tha, sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng Í-lī-ná-tan ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Iok-ngá-kun chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, chiàu i lāu-pē ê só͘-chòe khì chòe.
Hit-sî, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat ê jîn-sîn chiūⁿ-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, ûi-khùn hit-ê siâⁿ.
Tng i ê jîn-sîn ûi-khùn siâⁿ ê sî, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat mā chhin-sin chiūⁿ--lâi.

Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kun kap i ê lāu-bú, jîn-sîn, chiòng-léng, koaⁿ-oân, lóng chhut-siâⁿ, ǹg Pa-pí-lûn -ông tâu-hâng. Pa-pí-lûn -ông chiong Iok-ngá-kun lia̍h--khí-lâi; hit-sî, sī Pa-pí-lûn -ông chē-ūi tē-poeh nî.

Pa-pí-lûn -ông koh chiong Siōng Chú tiān-lāi kap ông-kiong ê pó-mi̍h lóng tùi hia the̍h--khì, chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Só͘-lô-bûn só͘ chō Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ê kim-khì lóng pak--lo̍h-lâi; tú chiàu Siōng Chú só͘ kóng ê ōe.

I chiong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê jîn-bîn, chèng siú-léng, kap só͘-ū kiông-béng ê ióng-sū, kiōng chi̍t-bān lâng, liân só͘-ū ê choh-ba̍k sai-hū kap phah-thih sai-hū mā lóng lia̍h--khì; chí-ū lâu kok-lāi siōng sòng-hiong ê lâng.
I chiong Iok-ngá-kun kap i ê lāu-bú, pîn-hui, koaⁿ-oân, kok-lāi ê kùi-cho̍k lóng tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lia̍h kàu Pa-pí-lûn.
I koh chiong chhit-chheng ê ōe kau-chiàn ê ióng-sū, í-ki̍p chi̍t-chheng ê choh-ba̍k sai-hū kap phah-thih sai-hū, lóng lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông siat-li̍p Iok-ngá-kun ê a-chek Má-tha-nî sòa-chiap choh-ông, kā Má-tha-nî ōaⁿ-miâ chòe Se-tí-ka.
Se-tí-ka chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-it hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-it nî. I ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Hap-bō͘-tha, sī Li̍p-ná -lâng Iâ-lī-bí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, chiàu Iok-ngá-kèng ê só͘-chòe khì chòe.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi hoat-seng chiah-ê sū, sī in-ūi Siōng Chú hoat siū-khì, tùi I ê bīn-chêng kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì. Se-tí-ka pōe-poān Pa-pí-lûn -ông.

Se-tí-ka thóng-tī tē-káu nî, cha̍p-ge̍h chhoe-cha̍p, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chhōa i ê tāi-kun lâi kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tī siâⁿ ê tùi-bīn chat-iâⁿ, koh tī sì-ûi choh thô͘-tui kong-siâⁿ.
Siâⁿ siū ûi-khùn, it-ti̍t kàu Se-tí-ka -ông tē-cha̍p-it nî.
Sì-ge̍h chhoe-káu, siâⁿ-lāi ki-hng chin giâm-tiōng, chū-bîn lóng bô mi̍h thang chia̍h,

siâⁿ siū kong-phòa; só͘-ū ê peng-sū thàu-mî tùi ông-kiong hoe-hn̂g hù-kūn, nn̄g ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ tiong-kan ê mn̂g hit-tiâu lō͘ tô-cháu. Pa-pí-lûn kun-tūi iáu tī sì-ûi kong-siâⁿ ê sî, ông ǹg A-la-pa ê hong-hiòng tô-cháu.
Pa-pí-lûn ê kun-peng tui-jip Se-tí-ka -ông, tī Iâ-lī-ko ê pêng-goân jip-tio̍h i; i ê choân-kun lóng khì-sak i sì-sòaⁿ.
Pa-pí-lûn ê kun-peng lia̍h-tio̍h Se-tí-ka, kā i lia̍h-khì tī Lī-pí-la ê Pa-pí-lûn -ông hia, tī hia siū sím-phòaⁿ.
In thâi-sí Se-tí-ka ê kiáⁿ, hō͘ i chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h, koh ó͘ i nn̄g lúi ba̍k-chiu, ēng tâng-liān kā i liān--teh, tòa-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat tē-cha̍p-káu nî, gō͘-ge̍h chhoe-chhit, Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê jîn-sîn sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn chìn-ji̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng,
ēng hé sio Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, ông-kiong, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘-ū ê chhù, í-ki̍p só͘-ū kùi-cho̍k ê chhù.
Só͘-ū tè sī-ōe-tiúⁿ ê Pa-pí-lûn kun-peng, chiong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sì-ûi ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ lóng thiah-húi.
Hit-sî, sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn chiong lâu tī siâⁿ-lāi só͘ chhun ê jîn-bîn, kap tâu-hâng Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê lâng, í-ki̍p só͘ chhun ê lâng lóng lia̍h--khì.
M̄-kú sī-ōe-tiúⁿ ū lâu chi̍t-kóa siōng sòng-hiong--ê, hō͘ in tī phû-tô-hn̂g kap chhân-hn̂g chèng-choh.
Pa-pí-lûn -lâng chiong Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ê tâng-thiāu, phûn-chō, kap tâng-hái lóng phah-phòa, chiong hiah-ê tâng ūn-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
In mā chiong tiáⁿ, thuh-á, teng-sim ê chián-to, khǹg hiuⁿ ê phiat-á, kap sèng-tiān só͘-ū tâng ê khì-khū lóng poaⁿ--khì;
khǹg hé-thòaⁿ ê phûn, pôaⁿ, só͘-ū kim-khì ê kim, gûn-khì ê gûn, sī-ōe-tiúⁿ lóng the̍h--khì.
Koh chiong Só͘-lô-bûn -ông ūi Siōng Chú ê tiān só͘ chō nn̄g ki thiāu, chi̍t ê tâng-hái, kap hiah-ê phûn-chō tòa--khì; chiah-ê khì-khū ê tâng chōe kah bōe-chhìn--tit.

Chit nn̄g ki thiāu siâng-khoán, múi chi̍t ki koân poeh kong-chhioh, téng-bīn ū tâng ê thiāu-táu; thiāu-táu koân chi̍t kong-chhioh saⁿ-cha̍p kong-hun; thiāu-táu ê chiu-ûi ū tâng chòe ê bāng-á kap sia̍h-liû.
Sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn lia̍h tōa-chè-si Se-lâi-ngá, hù-chè-si Se-hoan-ngá, kap saⁿ ê sèng-tiān mn̂g-kháu ê siú-ōe;
koh tùi siâⁿ-lāi lia̍h chi̍t ê koán-peng ê koaⁿ-oân, ông ê gō͘ ê chhin-sìn, kap teng-bō͘ peng-sū ê hù-chí-hui-koaⁿ, í-ki̍p tī siâⁿ-lāi tú--tio̍h ê la̍k-cha̍p ê kok-bîn.
Sī-ōe-tiúⁿ chiong chiah-ê lâng tòa-khì tī Lī-pí-la ê Pa-pí-lûn -ông hia.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông tī Hap-má tōe-khu ê Lī-pí-la lóng kā in thâi-sí. Án-ni, Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn siū-lia̍h lī-khui in pún-tōe.

Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat siat-li̍p Sa-hoan ê sun, A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī chòe chóng-tok, tī-lí bô hō͘ Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông lia̍h--khì, lâu tī Iû-tāi só͘ chhun ê jîn-bîn.

Chèng kun-koaⁿ kap sio̍k in ê peng-sū, thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Pa-pí-lûn -ông siat-li̍p Ki-tāi-lī koán-hat in, Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī, Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân, Nî-tô-hoat -lâng Tan-hō͘-be̍k ê kiáⁿ Se-lâi-ngá, Má-ka -lâng ê kiáⁿ Ngá-sat-nî-a, kap sio̍k in ê peng-sū, chiū lóng lâi Bí-su-pa kìⁿ Ki-tāi-lī.

Ki-tāi-lī tùi in kap sio̍k in ê peng-sū chiù-chōa, kóng, “Lín m̄-bián kiaⁿ Pa-pí-lûn ê koaⁿ-oân; lín thang an-sim tòa tī chit-tè thó͘-tōe, ho̍k-sāi Pa-pí-lûn -ông, lín chiū ōe pêng-an bô-sū.”

Hit-nî ê chhit--ge̍h, ông-chhin Í-lī-sa-má ê sun, Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī, chhōa cha̍p ê lâng lâi Bí-su-pa, thâi-sí Ki-tāi-lī, koh thâi-sí kap i chòe-hé ê Iû-tāi -lâng kap Pa-pí-lûn -lâng.
Tùi án-ni, só͘-ū ê lâng bô-lūn tōa-sòe, kap hiah-ê kun-koaⁿ, in-ūi kiaⁿ Pa-pí-lûn -lâng chiū lóng tô-cháu khì Ai-ki̍p.

Pa-pí-lûn -ông Í-bī Bí-lô-ta̍t tī i chē-ūi hit-nî, chiū-sī Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kun siū-lia̍h liáu-āu tē-saⁿ-cha̍p-chhit nî, cha̍p-jī-ge̍h jī-cha̍p-chhit ji̍t, te̍k-sià Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kun, pàng i chhut-kaⁿ,
koh ēng hó-ōe an-ùi i, hō͘ i pí siū-lia̍h tī Pa-pí-lûn kî-tha kok-ka ê ông ū khah-koân ê tōe-ūi.
Iok-ngá-kun thǹg-khì kaⁿ-lāi só͘ chhēng ê saⁿ, chi̍t-sì-lâng kap Pa-pí-lûn -ông chòe-hé chia̍h.
Iok-ngá-kun oa̍h--teh ê sî, Pa-pí-lûn -ông siúⁿ-sù i só͘ su-iàu ê seng-oa̍h hùi-iōng.
A-tong, Sài-te̍k, Í-ná-sū;
Kai-lâm, Má-le̍k-lia̍t, Ngá-lia̍t;
Í-lo̍k, Má-thó͘-sat-la, La-be̍k;
Ná-a, Siám, Hâm, Ngá-hut.
Ngá-hut ê hō͘-tāi ū Ko-bia̍t, Má-kok, Má-tāi, Ngá-oân, Thó͘-pa, Bí-siat, Thê-la.
Ko-bia̍t ê hō͘-tāi ū A-si̍t-ki-ná, Lī-hoat, Tô-ka-má.
Ngá-oân ê hō͘-tāi ū Í-lī-sa, Tha-si, Ki-thê -lâng, Lô-tek -lâng.
Hâm ê hō͘-tāi ū Kó͘-si̍t, Ai-ki̍p, Hut, Ka-lâm.
Kó͘-si̍t ê hō͘-tāi ū Se-pa, Hap-hui-la, Sat-hut-tha, La-má, Sat-hut-thê-ka. La-má ê hō͘-tāi ū Sī-pa, Tí-tān.
Kó͘-si̍t koh siⁿ Lêng-lio̍k; i sī sè-kan tē-it ê ióng-sū.
Ai-ki̍p siⁿ Lō͘-te -lâng, A-ná-bí -lâng, Lī-hap-pí -lâng, Ná-hut-thó͘-hi -lâng,
Phà-su-ló͘-sòe -lâng, Ka-su-lō͘-hi -lâng, Ka-hui-thok -lâng; Hui-lī-sū -lâng sī chit-cho̍k ê hō͘-tāi.
Ka-lâm siⁿ tōa-kiáⁿ Se-tùn, kap Hek -lâng,
Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Kek-ka-sat -lâng,
Hi-bī -lâng, A-ki -lâng, Se-nî -lâng,
A-óa-tí -lâng, Sé-má-lī -lâng, kap Hap-má -lâng.
Siám ê hō͘-tāi ū Í-lân, A-su̍t, A-hoat-sat, Lō͘-tek, A-lân, O͘-su, Hō͘-le̍k, Ki-thiap, Bí-siat.
A-hoat-sat siⁿ Sa-la, Sa-la siⁿ Hi-pek.
Hi-pek siⁿ nn̄g ê kiáⁿ; chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Hoat-le̍k, in-ūi tī i ê sî-tāi lâng hun-sòaⁿ tī ta̍k só͘-chāi khiā-khí; Hoat-le̍k ê sió-tī kiò-chòe Iok-tan.
Iok-tan siⁿ A-mô͘-tap, Sa-lia̍t, Hap-sat-má-hui, Iâ-la,
Hap-to-lân, O͘-sat, Tek-la,
Gô-pa-lō͘, A-pí-má-lī, Sī-pa,
Gô-hui, Hap-hui-la, Iok-pa; chiah-ê lóng sī Iok-tan ê hō͘-tāi.
Siám, A-hoat-sat, Sa-la,
Hi-pek, Hoat-le̍k, La-ngô͘,
Se-lo̍k, Ná-ho̍k, Tha-la,
A-pek-lân, A-pek-lân chiū-sī A-pek-la-hán.
A-pek-la-hán ê hō͘-tāi ū Í-sat, Í-si̍t-má-lī.
Í-si̍t-má-lī ê hō͘-tāi kì tī ē-bīn: Í-si̍t-má-lī ê hō͘-tāi ū tōa-kiáⁿ Nî-pài-iok, koh ū Ki-ta̍t, A-tek-pia̍t, Bí-pí-san,
Bí-si-má, Tō͘-má, Má-sat, Hap-tāi, Thê-má,
I-tu̍t, Ná-hui-si, Ki-tí-má. Chiah-ê lóng sī Í-si̍t-má-lī ê kiáⁿ.
A-pek-la-hán ê sòe-î Ki-thó͘-la só͘ siⁿ ê kiáⁿ ū Sim-lân, Iok-san, Bí-tān, Bí-tiân, I-si-pa, kap Su-a. Iok-san ê kiáⁿ ū Sī-pa kap Tí-tān.
Bí-tiân ê kiáⁿ ū Í-hoat, Í-hut, Í-lo̍k, A-pí-tāi, Í-le̍k-tāi. Chiah-ê lóng sī Ki-thó͘-la ê kiáⁿ-sun.
A-pek-la-hán siⁿ Í-sat. Í-sat ê kiáⁿ ū Í-sò kap Í-sek-lia̍t.
Í-sò ê kiáⁿ ū Í-lī-hoat, Liû-ní, Iâ-o͘-si, Ngá-lân, Khó-la.
Í-lī-hoat ê kiáⁿ ū Thê-bān, O-boat, Sé-po, Ka-thán, Ki-la̍p-su, Têng-la̍p, kap A-má-le̍k.
Liû-ní ê kiáⁿ ū Ná-hap, Siā-la, Sa-má, kap Bí-sat.
Se-ní ê kiáⁿ ū Lô-tan, Sok-pa, Chè-piān, A-ná, Tí-sūn, Í-chhat, Tí-san.
Lô-tan ê kiáⁿ ū Hô-lī, Hi-bān; Lô-tan ê sió-bē sī Têng-la̍p.
Sok-pa ê kiáⁿ ū A-le̍k-bûn, Má-ná-hat, Í-pa-lō͘, Sī-po, O-lâm. Chè-piān ê kiáⁿ ū Ài-a kap A-ná.
A-ná ê kiáⁿ ū Tí-sūn. Tí-sūn ê kiáⁿ ū Him-tān, I-sī-pan, Ek-lân, Ki-lân.
Í-chhat ê kiáⁿ ū Phek-hán, Sat-hoan, A-kan. Tí-san ê kiáⁿ ū O͘-su kap A-lân.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng iáu-bē ū kun-ông thóng-tī ê sî, Í-tong tōe-khu ê chu-ông ū: Pí-ní ê kiáⁿ Pí-la; i ê kiaⁿ-siâⁿ kiò-chòe Têng-hap-pa.
Pí-la sí-liáu, Pho-su-la -lâng Siā-la ê kiáⁿ Iok-pa sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iok-pa sí, Thê-bān -tōe ê lâng Hō͘-san sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Hō͘-san sí, Pí-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Hap-ta̍t sòa-chiap i choh-ông; i tī Mô͘-ap tōe-khu thâi-iâⁿ Bí-tiân -lâng; i ê siâⁿ kiò-chòe A-bī-tek.
Hap-ta̍t sí, Má-sū-lī-ka -lâng Song-la sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Song-la sí, Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô ê Lī-hô-pek -lâng Sò-lô sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Sò-lô sí, A-kek-pho ê kiáⁿ Pa-le̍k Hap-lâm sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Pa-le̍k Hap-lâm sí, Hap-ta̍t sòa-chiap i choh-ông; i ê siâⁿ kiò-chòe Pa-o͘; i ê bó͘ kiò-chòe Bí-hi-tha-pia̍t, sī Bí Sat-ha̍p ê cha-bó͘-sun, Má-te̍k-lia̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Hap-ta̍t sí liáu-āu, Í-tong ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ ū Têng-la̍p, A-le̍k-óa, Iâ-thiap,
A-hô-lī-pa-má, Í-la, Pí-lūn,
Ki-la̍p-su, Thê-bān, Bí-pí-sat,
Má-ki-tia̍p, kap Í-lân. Chiah-ê lóng sī Í-tong ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ ū Lū-piān, Se-biān, Lī-bī, Iû-tāi, Í-sat-ka, Se-pò͘-lûn,
Tān, Iok-sek, Piān-ngá-bín, Ná-hut-tha-lī, Ka-tek, A-siat.
Iû-tāi ê kiáⁿ ū Ní, Gô-lâm, Sī-la; chit saⁿ ê sī Ka-lâm ê lú-chú Pa-su-a siⁿ--ê. Iû-tāi ê tōa-kiáⁿ Ní chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, Siōng Chú chiū hō͘ i sí.
Iû-tāi ê sin-pū Tha-má kā i siⁿ Hoat-le̍k-su kap Siā-la. Chit gō͘ ê sī Iû-tāi ê kiáⁿ.
Hoat-le̍k-su ê kiáⁿ ū Hi-su-lûn kap Hap-bō͘-le̍k.
Siā-la ū gō͘ ê kiáⁿ, Sim-lī, Í-thàm, Hi-bān, Kah-kok, kap Tāi-la.
Ka-bí ê kiáⁿ A-kan the̍h eng-kai tio̍h húi-bia̍t ê chiàn-lī-phín, liân-lūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Í-thàm ê kiáⁿ sī A-sat-lī-ngá.
Hi-su-lûn só͘ siⁿ ê kiáⁿ ū Iâ-la-bia̍t, Lân, kap Ka-le̍k.
Lân siⁿ A-bí-ná-ta̍t; A-bí-ná-ta̍t siⁿ Ná-sūn, Ná-sūn chòe Iû-tāi -lâng ê léng-siù.
Ná-sūn siⁿ Sat-bûn, Sat-bûn siⁿ Pho-a-su,
Pho-a-su siⁿ Gô-pī-tek; Gô-pī-tek siⁿ Iâ-se;
Iâ-se siⁿ tōa-kiáⁿ Í-lī-ap, tē-jī kiáⁿ A-pí-ná-ta̍t, tē-saⁿ kiáⁿ Sī-bí-a,
tē-sì kiáⁿ Ná-thán-gia̍p, tē-gō͘ kiáⁿ La-tāi,
tē-la̍k kiáⁿ O-sián, tē-chhit kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t.
In ê chí-bē sī Sé-lō͘-ngá kap Ài-pí-kai. Sé-lō͘-ngá ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ, A-pí-su, Iok-ap, kap A-sat-hek.
Ài-pí-kai siⁿ A-má-sat; A-má-sat ê lāu-pē sī Í-si̍t-má-lī -lâng Ek-thiap.
Hi-su-lûn ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k chhōa A-so͘-pa, mā kiò-chòe Iâ-lio̍k ê lú-chú chòe bó͘, siⁿ Iâ-siat, Sok-pā, Ap-tun.
A-so͘-pa sí liáu-āu, Ka-le̍k koh chhōa Í-hoat-tha, siⁿ Hō͘-ní.
Hō͘-ní siⁿ O͘-lī, O͘-lī siⁿ Pí-sat-lia̍t.
Āu-lâi, Hi-su-lûn la̍k-cha̍p hè chhōa Ki-lia̍t ê khai-thok-chiá Má-kiat ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chòe bó͘, siⁿ Se-kat,
Se-kat siⁿ Gâi-ní. Gâi-ní tī Ki-lia̍t -tōe ū jī-cha̍p-saⁿ ê siâⁿ.

Āu-lâi, Ki-su̍t kap A-lân cheng-ho̍k Hap-o-te̍k Gâi-ní, í-ki̍p Ki-la̍p kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, lóng-chóng la̍k-cha̍p ê siâⁿ. Chiah-ê chū-bîn lóng sī Ki-lia̍t ê khai-thok-chiá Má-kiat ê hō͘-tāi.
Hi-su-lûn tī Ka-le̍k Í-hoat-tha sí liáu-āu, i ê bó͘ A-pí-ngá kā i siⁿ A-si-hō͘, chiū-sī Thê-ko-a -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá.
Hi-su-lûn ê tōa-kiáⁿ Iâ-la-bia̍t siⁿ tōa-kiáⁿ Lân, koh siⁿ Pò͘-ná, O-liân, O-sián, A-hi-ngá.
Iâ-la-bia̍t koh chhōa A-tha-la chòe bó͘, siⁿ O-lâm.
Iâ-la-bia̍t ê tōa-kiáⁿ Lân ê kiáⁿ ū Má-su, Ngá-bín, kap Í-kiat.
O-lâm ê kiáⁿ ū Sa-mái kap Ngá-tāi; Sa-mái ê kiáⁿ ū Ná-tap kap A-pí-su̍t.
A-pí-su̍t chhōa A-pí-hâi chòe bó͘, siⁿ A-pān kap Mô͘-lī.
Ná-tap ê kiáⁿ ū Se-lia̍t kap A-piàn; Se-lia̍t bô kiáⁿ chiū sí.
A-piàn ê kiáⁿ sī Í-sī, Í-sī ê kiáⁿ sī Sī-san, Sī-san ê kiáⁿ sī A-lâi.
Sa-mái ê sió-tī Ngá-tāi ê kiáⁿ ū Ek-thiap kap Iok-ná-tan; Ek-thiap bô kiáⁿ chiū sí.
Iok-ná-tan ê kiáⁿ ū Pí-le̍k kap Sat-sat. Chiah-ê lóng sī Iâ-la-bia̍t ê hō͘-tāi.
Sī-san bô hāu-siⁿ, chí-ū cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ. Sī-san ū chi̍t ê po̍k-jîn, kiò-chòe Iâ-hap, sī Ai-ki̍p -lâng.
Sī-san chiong i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō͘ po̍k-jîn Iâ-hap chòe bó͘; in siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ kiò-chòe A-thài.
A-thài siⁿ Ná-tan, Ná-tan siⁿ Sat-poa̍t,
Sat-poa̍t siⁿ Í-hut-la, Í-hut-la siⁿ Gô-pī-tek,
Gô-pī-tek siⁿ Iâ-hō͘, Iâ-hō͘ siⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá,
A-sat-lī-ngá siⁿ Hi-lī-su, Hi-lī-su siⁿ Í-lī-a-sat,
Í-lī-a-sat siⁿ Se-su-mái, Se-su-mái siⁿ Sa-liông,
Sa-liông siⁿ Iâ-ka-bí-ngá, Iâ-ka-bí-ngá siⁿ Í-lī-sa-má.
Iâ-la-bia̍t ê sió-tī Ka-le̍k ê tōa-kiáⁿ kiò-chòe Bí-sa, Bí-sa siⁿ Se-hut; Se-hut siⁿ Má-lī-sa, Má-lī-sa siⁿ Hi-pek-lûn.
Hi-pek-lûn ê kiáⁿ ū Khó-la, Tha-phó͘-a, Lī-kim, kap Sī-má.
Sī-má sī La-hâm ê lāu-pē, Iok-kan ê a-kong. Lī-kim siⁿ Sa-mái,
Sa-mái siⁿ Má-hûn; Má-hûn sī Pek Siok ê lāu-pē.
Ka-le̍k ê sòe-î Í-hoat siⁿ Hap-lân, Mô͘-sat, Ka-siā; Hap-lân siⁿ Ka-siā.
Ngá-tāi ê kiáⁿ ū Lī-kiān, Iok-thán, Ki-san, Pí-le̍k, Í-hoat, kap Sa-a-hut.
Ka-le̍k lēng-gōa chi̍t ê sòe-î Má-ka siⁿ Sī-pia̍t, Te̍k-hap-ná.

Má-ka koh siⁿ Sa-a-hut kap Sī-hoat; Sa-a-hut sī Be̍k-má-ná -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá, Sī-hoat sī Boat-pí-ná -siâⁿ kap Ki-pí-a -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá; Ka-le̍k ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kiò-chòe Ap-sat.

Ē-bīn chiah-ê mā-sī Ka-le̍k ê hō͘-tāi: Hō͘-ní ê kiáⁿ ū Sok-pa, Sat-má, Hap-le̍k; Sok-pa khai-thok Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm -siâⁿ, Sat-má khai-thok Pek-lī-hêng -siâⁿ, Hap-le̍k khai-thok Pek Ka-tek -siâⁿ.
Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá Sok-pa siⁿ Hap-lô-í; Hap-lô-í chiū-sī Bí-ló͘-hap tōe-khu chi̍t-pòaⁿ chū-bîn ê chó͘-sian,

mā-sī tòa tī Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm hiah-ê chong-cho̍k — Í-thiap -lâng, Pò͘-te̍k -lâng, Su-má -lâng, Bi̍t-lâi -lâng ê chó͘-sian; Só-la -lâng kap Í-si̍t-tô -lâng sī chiah-ê chong-cho̍k ê hō͘-tāi.
Pek-lī-hêng -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá Sat-má sī Nî-tô-hoat -lâng kap A-tha-lio̍k Pek Iok-ap -lâng ê chó͘-sian, mā-sī tī Má-ná-hap ê Só-lī -cho̍k ê chó͘-sian.

Te̍k-la -lâng, Sī-bí-ap -lâng, So͘-kah -lâng sī chhau-siá bûn-kiāⁿ ê lâng ê chong-cho̍k; in tòa tī Ngá-pí-su -siâⁿ. In lóng sī Ki-nî -lâng, sī Lī-kah -cho̍k ê chó͘-sian Hap-boa̍t ê hō͘-tāi.
Tāi-pi̍t tī Hi-pek-lûn siⁿ ê kiáⁿ kì tī ē-bīn: tōa-kiáⁿ Àm-lūn, lāu-bú sī Iâ-su-lia̍t -lâng A-hi-loán; tē-jī kiáⁿ Tān-í-lí, lāu-bú sī Ka-bi̍t -lâng Ài-pí-kai;
tē-saⁿ kiáⁿ Ap-sa-liông, lāu-bú sī Ki-su̍t -ông Ta̍t-mái ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Má-ka; tē-sì kiáⁿ A-to-nî-ngá, lāu-bú sī Hap-ki̍p;
tē-gō͘ kiáⁿ Sī-hoat-thê-ngá, lāu-bú sī A-pí-tha; tē-la̍k kiáⁿ Í-te̍k-liām, sī Tāi-pi̍t ê bó͘ Í-kek-la siⁿ--ê.
Chit la̍k ê lóng sī Tāi-pi̍t tī Hi-pek-lûn siⁿ--ê; i tī hia choh-ông chhit nî la̍k ge̍h-ji̍t kú; tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông saⁿ-cha̍p-saⁿ nî.
Tāi-pi̍t tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ū siⁿ Sa-bō͘-a, Sok-pā, Ná-tan, Só͘-lô-bûn; chit sì ê sī A-bí-lī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Poa̍t-sī-pa siⁿ--ê;
koh ū Ek-hat, Í-lī-su-a, Í-lī-hoat-lia̍t,
Ná-ka, Nî-húi, Ngá-hui-a,
Í-lī-sa-má, Í-lī-ngá-tāi, Í-lī-hoat-lia̍t, kiōng káu ê.
Chiah-ê lóng sī Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ, í-gōa iáu ū pîn-hui ê kiáⁿ. Tha-má sī in ê chí-bē.
Só͘-lô-bûn ê kiáⁿ sī Lô-pho-an, Lô-pho-an ê kiáⁿ sī A-pí-ngá, A-pí-ngá ê kiáⁿ sī A-sat, A-sat ê kiáⁿ sī Iok-sa-hoat;
Iok-sa-hoat ê kiáⁿ sī Iok-lân, Iok-lân ê kiáⁿ sī A-hap-siā, A-hap-siā ê kiáⁿ sī Iok-a-si;
Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ sī A-má-siā, A-má-siā ê kiáⁿ sī O͘-se-a, O͘-se-a ê kiáⁿ sī Iok-thán;
Iok-thán ê kiáⁿ sī A-hap-su, A-hap-su ê kiáⁿ sī Hi-se-ka, Hi-se-ka ê kiáⁿ sī Má-ná-se;
Má-ná-se ê kiáⁿ sī A-bûn, A-bûn ê kiáⁿ sī Iok-se-a;
Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ, tōa--ê sī Iok-hap-lân, tē-jī--ê sī Iok-ngá-kèng, tē-saⁿ--ê Se-tí-ka, tē-sì--ê Sa-liông.
Iok-ngá-kèng ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, Iok-ngá-kun kap Se-tí-ka.
Ē-bīn sī siū-lia̍h khì Pa-pí-lûn ê Iok-ngá-kun ê hō͘-tāi. I ê kiáⁿ ū Sat-la-thiat,
Má-ki-lân, Pí-tāi-ngá, Sī-ná-sat, Iâ-ka-bí-ngá, Hô-sa-má, kap Nî-tāi-pí-ngá.
Pí-tāi-ngá ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, Só͘-lô-pa-pek kap Sī-múi. Só͘-lô-pa-pek ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, Bí-su-lân kap Hap-ná-nî-ngá, koh ū chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Sī-lô-bi̍t;
lēng-gōa koh ū gō͘ ê kiáⁿ, Hap-su-pa, O-hek, Pí-lī-ka, Hap-sat-tí, U-sa Hi-sek.
Hap-ná-nî-ngá ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, Pí-la-thê kap Í-sài-a; Í-sài-a siⁿ Lī-hoat-ngá, Lī-hoat-ngá siⁿ A-ní-lân, A-ní-lân siⁿ Gô-pa-tí-a, Gô-pa-tí-a siⁿ Sī-ka-nî.
Sī-ka-nî siⁿ Sī-má-ngá; Sī-má-ngá ū gō͘ ê kiáⁿ, Hap-tu̍t, Í-kah, Pa-lī-a, Nî-lī-ngá, Sa-hoat.
Nî-lī-ngá ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ, Í-lī-iok-nái, Hi-se-ka, A-su-lī-kan.
Í-lī-iok-nái ū chhit ê kiáⁿ, Hô-tāi-ngá, Í-lī-a-si̍t, Pí-lâi-ngá, A-kok, Iok-hap-lân, Tē-lâi-ngá, kap A-ná-nî.
Iû-tāi ê kiáⁿ sī Hoat-le̍k-su, Hi-su-lûn, Ka-bí, Hō͘-ní, kap Sok-pa.
Sok-pa ê kiáⁿ Lī-a-ngá siⁿ Ngá-hap, Ngá-hap siⁿ A-hō͘-mái kap La-hap; in sī Só-la -lâng ê chó͘-sian.

Hō͘-ní sī Ka-le̍k kap Í-hoat-tha ê tōa-kiáⁿ; i ê hō͘-tāi sī Pek-lī-hêng -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá. Hō͘-ní ê hō͘-tāi ū Í-thán, Pí-ló͘-i-le̍k, kap Í-siā-ní. Í-thán ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Iâ-su-lia̍t, I-si-má, kap I-tek-pa; koh ū chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kiò-chòe Hap-sek-le̍k-po-nî. Pí-ló͘-i-le̍k sī Ki-to -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá, Í-siā-ní sī Hō͘-sa -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá.
Thê-ko-a -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá A-si-hō͘ ū nn̄g ê bó͘, Hi-la kap Ná-la.
Ná-la kā i siⁿ sì ê kiáⁿ: A-hō͘-sat, Hi-hut, Thê-bí-nî, kap Hap-hat-su-tha-lī.
Hi-la kā i siⁿ saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Sé-lia̍t, Só-hat, kap I-thê-lâm.
Ko-su siⁿ A-lo̍k, Só-pí-pa; i mā-sī Hap-lûn ê kiáⁿ A-hap-hek chiah-ê chong-cho̍k ê chó͘-sian.
Ngá-pí-su pí i ê hiaⁿ-tī khah siū lâng kèng-tiōng; i ê lāu-bú kā i hō-miâ Ngá-pí-su, ì-sù sī “Góa siⁿ i chin kan-khó͘”.

Ngá-pí-su kiû Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, kóng, “Kiû lí tōa-tōa sù-hok góa, khok-tián góa ê kéng-kài. Goān lí siông-siông kap góa tông-chāi, pó-iū góa bô tú-tio̍h hoān-lān, bô siū thòng-khó͘.” Siōng-tè chiū chiàu i só͘ kiû--ê sù hō͘ i.
Su-hap ê hiaⁿ-tī Ki-lio̍k siⁿ Bí-hek, Bí-hek siⁿ I-si-tun.
I-si-tun siⁿ Pek La-pa, Pa-se-a, í-ki̍p Ná-hat -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá Thê-him-ná. Chiah-ê lóng sī Lī-ka -lâng.
Ki-la̍p-su ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ: Gô-tô-liap kap Se-lâi-ngá; Gô-tô-liap mā ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ: Hap-thah kap Bín-ná-thài.
Bín-ná-thài siⁿ Gô-hut-la. Se-lâi-ngá siⁿ Hā-la̍p-him Soaⁿ-kok ê khai-thok-chiá Iok-ap; in lóng sī sai-hū.
Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Í-lō͘, Í-la, kap Ná-an; Í-la siⁿ Ki-la̍p-su.
Iâ-hap-lī-le̍k ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Se-hut, Se-hoat, Thê-lī, kap A-sat-lia̍t.

Í-su-la ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Ek-thiap, Bí-lia̍t, Í-hut, kap Ngá-lûn. Bí-lia̍t chhōa Ai-ki̍p -ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Pí-thê-ngá chòe bó͘, siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-lī-an, hāu-siⁿ Sa-mái, kap Í-si̍t-thê-bo̍k -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá Ek-pa. Bí-lia̍t koh chhōa Iû-tāi -lâng chòe bó͘, siⁿ saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Ngá-lia̍t, Hi-pek, Iâ-kó͘-thiat; Ngá-lia̍t sī Ki-to -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá, Hi-pek sī So-ko -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá, Iâ-kó͘-thiat sī Sat-ná-a -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá.
Hô-tē-ngá chhōa Ná-hâm ê sió-bē, in ê hō͘-tāi sī tòa tī Ki-i-la -siâⁿ ê Ka-bí -cho̍k kap tòa tī Í-si̍t-thê-bo̍k -siâⁿ ê Má-ka -cho̍k ê chó͘-sian.
Sī-bûn ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Àm-lūn, Lîm-ná, Piān Hap-lâm, kap Thê-lûn. Í-sī ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ: So-hek kap Piān So-hek.

Iû-tāi ê kiáⁿ Sī-la ê hō͘-tāi ū Lī-ka -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá Ní, Má-lī-sa -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá La-tāi, í-ki̍p tòa tī Pek A-si̍t-pí -siâⁿ chit iù-môa-pò͘ chiah-ê chong-cho̍k;
iáu ū Iok-kèng, Ko-se-pa -lâng, Iok-a-si, koh ū chhōa Mô͘-ap ê lú-chú, tńg-lâi Pek-lī-hêng ê Sat-la. Che lóng sī kó͘-chá ê kì-chài.
Chiah-ê lâng lóng sī sio-hûi sai-hū, sī Nî-tha-èng kap Ki-tí-la ê chū-bîn; in kap ông tòa tī hia, ūi ông chòe kang.
Se-biān ū gō͘ ê kiáⁿ, Nî-bō͘-lī, Ngá-bín, Ngá-li̍p, Siā-la, Sò-lô;
Sò-lô siⁿ Sa-liông, Sa-liông siⁿ Bí-pí-san, Bí-pí-san siⁿ Bí-si-má.
Bí-si-má ê kiáⁿ sī Hap-bō͘-lī, sun sī Sat-khek, kan-á-sun sī Sī-múi.
Sī-múi ū cha̍p-la̍k ê kiáⁿ, la̍k ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; i ê hiaⁿ-tī ê kiáⁿ-jî bô chin chōe. Se-biān chi-cho̍k ê kiáⁿ-sun bô chhin-chhiūⁿ Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k hiah chōe.
Se-biān ê hō͘-tāi tòa tī Pia̍t-sī-pa, Mô͘-la-tāi, Hap-sat Su-a,
Phek-la, Í-sim, Tô-la̍h,
Pí-thó͘-lī, Hô-ní-má, Sé-kek-la,
Pek Má-ka-phok, Hap-sat So͘-sat, Pek Pí-lī, kap Sa-la-im. Chiah-ê siâⁿ, it-ti̍t kàu Tāi-pi̍t choh-ông ê sî, lóng sio̍k Se-biān chi-cho̍k.
In iáu ū Í-thán, A-in, Lîm-bûn, Tô-kiān, kap A-san gō͘ ê siâⁿ,
kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, ti̍t-kàu Pa-le̍k -siâⁿ. Chiah-ê sī in tòa ê só͘-chāi, in lóng ū kì-lio̍k tī ka-phó͘.

Ē-bīn só͘ kì-chài chiah-ê miâ lóng sī in chong-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ: Bí-só͘-pa, Ngá-bí-le̍k, A-má-siā ê kiáⁿ Iok-sa, Iok-ní, Iok-sī-pí ê kiáⁿ Iâ-hō͘ (Iok-sī-pí sī Se-lâi-ngá ê kiáⁿ, sī A-sih ê sun), Í-lī-iok-nái, Ngá-ko-pa, Iok-sok-hái, A-sat-ngá, A-tí-gia̍p, Iâ-se-bia̍t, Pí-ná-ngá; Sī-hui ê kiáⁿ Sè-sat (Sī-hui sī A-liông ê kiáⁿ, A-liông sī Iâ-tāi-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Iâ-tāi-ngá sī Sin-lī ê kiáⁿ, Sin-lī sī Sī-má-ngá ê kiáⁿ). In chiah-ê chong-cho̍k ê lâng-gia̍h ke-thiⁿ chin chōe,
chiū khì Ki-to ê ji̍p-kháu, kàu soaⁿ-kok ê tang-pêng, chhē chhī iûⁿ ê chháu-po͘.
In chhē-tio̍h pûi koh súi ê chháu-po͘, khoah, chheng-chēng koh an-choân; in-ūi chá-chêng ū Hâm -cho̍k ê lâng tòa tī hia.

Téng-bīn só͘ kì hiah-ê lâng, tī Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka ê sî, lâi kong-kek Hâm -cho̍k ê pò͘-pîⁿ, kap hia só͘-ū ê Bí-o͘-nî -lâng, chiong in thiat-tóe châu-bia̍t, chiū tòa tī chit-ê tōe-hng kàu kin-á-ji̍t; in-ūi hia ū chháu-po͘ thang chhī in ê iûⁿ-kûn.
Se-biān chi-cho̍k ū gō͘-pah lâng khì kàu Í-tong; in ê siú-léng sī Í-sī ê kiáⁿ Pí-la-thê, Nî-lī-ngá, Lī-hoat-ngá, kap O͘-siat.
In thâi-sí tô-cháu bōe lī chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê A-má-le̍k -lâng, chiū khiā-khí tī hia kàu kin-á-ji̍t.

Ngá-kok ê tōa-kiáⁿ Lū-piān, i pún-lâi sī tōa-kiáⁿ, in-ūi kap in lāu-pē ê sòe-î chòe-hé khùn, só͘-í tōa-kiáⁿ ê koân-lī chiū kui tī Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ Iok-sek; ka-phó͘ bô chiàu chhut-sì ê sūn-sū teng-lio̍k.
Iû-tāi pí i ê hiaⁿ-tī khah kiông-sēng, koh chhut kun-ông; m̄-kú tōa-kiáⁿ ê koân-lī kui tī Iok-sek.
Ngá-kok ê tōa-kiáⁿ Lū-piān ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Í-lo̍k, Hoat-lō͘, Hi-su-lûn, kap Ka-bí.
Iok-ní siⁿ Sī-má-ngá, Sī-má-ngá siⁿ Ko-kek, Ko-kek siⁿ Sī-múi,
Sī-múi siⁿ Bí-ka, Bí-ka siⁿ Lī-a-ngá, Lī-a-ngá siⁿ Pa-le̍k,
Pa-le̍k siⁿ Pī-la; Pī-la chòe Lū-piān chi-cho̍k ê léng-siù, hō͘ A-su̍t -ông Thê-kek-la Pí-lia̍t-sek lia̍h--khì.
Pī-la ê hiaⁿ-tī, chiàu chong-cho̍k ê ka-phó͘, chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ--ê, ū Iâ-lī, Sat-ka-lī-a,
kap Pí-la; Pí-la sī A-sat ê kiáⁿ, Sī-má ê sun, Iok-ní ê kan-á-sun; Iok-ní tòa tī A-lô-ní kàu Nî-pho kap Pa-le̍k Bián ê tōe-khu;
in tī Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu ê cheng-siⁿ chin chōe, chiū chiàm tang-pêng ê khòng-iá, it-ti̍t kàu Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô.
Sò-lô ê sî, Lū-piān chi-cho̍k kap Hā-kah -lâng kau-chiàn; Hā-kah -lâng sí tī in ê chhiú-ē, in chiū chhiúⁿ Hā-kah -lâng ê pò͘-pîⁿ, tòa tī Ki-lia̍t tang-pêng choân-tōe.
Ka-tek ê kiáⁿ-sun tòa tī Lū-piān ê tùi-bīn Pa-san tōe-khu it-ti̍t kàu Sat-ka;
Iok-ní chòe in ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, Sa-hoan chòe hù-cho̍k-tiúⁿ, koh ū tòa tī Pa-san ê Ngá-nái kap Sa-hoat.
Ka-tek chi-cho̍k kî-tha ê lâng lóng sio̍k ē-bīn chhit ê chong-cho̍k: Bí-ka-le̍k, Bí-su-lân, Sī-pa, Iok-nāi, Ngá-kan, Sè-a, kap Hi-pek.
Í-siōng chiah-ê lóng sī Hō͘-lī ê kiáⁿ A-pí-hâi ê hō͘-tāi; A-pí-hâi ê chó͘-sian tùi a-kong sǹg chiūⁿ--khì sī Iâ-lô-a, Ki-lia̍t, Bí-ka-le̍k, Iâ-sī-su, Iâ-hap-to, Pò͘-su.
Ko͘-nî ê sun, Ap-pí-thia̍p ê kiáⁿ A-hi mā chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ.
In tòa tī Ki-lia̍t, Pa-san, kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, í-ki̍p Sa-lûn ê chháu-po͘, ti̍t-kàu sì-ûi ê kau-kài.
Chiah-ê lâng tī Iû-tāi -ông Iok-thán kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iâ-lô-pho-an Jī-sè ê sî, lóng ū teng-lio̍k tī ka-phó͘.

Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng, ōe the̍h tún-pâi gia̍h to, khui keng siā-chìⁿ, chhut-cheng gâu sio-thâi ê ióng-sū, lóng-chóng ū sì-bān sì-chheng chhit-pah la̍k-cha̍p lâng.
In kap Hā-kah -lâng, I-tu̍t -lâng, Ná-hui-si -lâng, Ná-tap -lâng kau-chiàn.
In sìn-khò Siōng-tè, tī chiàn-tiûⁿ kî-kiû Siōng-tè pang-chān, I chiū thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó, chiong Hā-kah -lâng kap kun-tè in ê lâng lóng kau tī in ê chhiú.
In chhiúⁿ Hā-kah -lâng ê cheng-siⁿ, ū lo̍k-tô gō͘-bān chiah, iûⁿ jī-cha̍p-gō͘-bān chiah, lû nn̄g-chheng chiah, koh lia̍h lâng cha̍p-bān.
In thâi-sí chin chōe te̍k-jîn, in-ūi chit-ê kau-chiàn chhut-tī Siōng-tè. In chiū tòa tī hit-ê tōe-khu kàu in siū-lia̍h ê sî.
Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng khiā-khí tī chit-ê tōe-khu, tùi Pa-san sòa kàu Pa-le̍k Hek-bûn, Sī-nî-ní, kap Hek-bûn-soaⁿ; in ê jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ chin chōe.
In ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ chiū-sī Í-hut, Í-sī, Í-lī-gia̍p, A-su-lia̍t, Iâ-lī-bí, Hô-ta̍t-ui-ngá, kap Ngá-thia̍p, lóng sī kiông-béng ê ióng-sū, ū miâ-siaⁿ, mā chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ.

Lū-piān, Ka-tek, kap Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng pōe-poān in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, ho̍k-sāi hit só͘-chāi chū-bîn ê sîn-bêng, hiah-ê chū-bîn sī Siōng-tè tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bīn-chêng só͘ húi-bia̍t--ê.

Só͘-í Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè kek-tōng A-su̍t -ông Phó͘-le̍k, chiū-sī Thê-kek-la Pí-lia̍t-sek ê sim, chiong Lū-piān -lâng, Ka-tek -lâng, Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê lâng, lia̍h-khì Hap-la̍h, Hap-phok, Hap-la, kap Ko-sàn hô-piⁿ, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Lī-bī ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Kek-sūn, Ko-hat, kap Bí-la-lī.
Ko-hat ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Àm-lân, Í-su-hap, Hi-pek-lûn, O͘-siat.
Àm-lân ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ: A-lûn kap Mô͘-se, chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-lī-an. A-lûn ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Ná-tap, A-pí-hō͘, Í-lī-a-sat, kap Í-tha-má.
Í-lī-a-sat siⁿ Hui-nî-hap, Hui-nî-hap siⁿ A-pí-su,
A-pí-su siⁿ Pò͘-ki, Pò͘-ki siⁿ O͘-se,
O͘-se siⁿ Se-la-hi-ngá, Se-la-hi-ngá siⁿ Bí-la-iok,
Bí-la-iok siⁿ A-má-lī-ngá, A-má-lī-ngá siⁿ A-hi-tu̍t,
A-hi-tu̍t siⁿ Sat-tok, Sat-tok siⁿ A-hi-má-su,
A-hi-má-su siⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá, A-sat-lī-ngá siⁿ Iok-hap-lân,
Iok-hap-lân siⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá, chit-ê A-sat-lī-ngá tī Só͘-lô-bûn só͘ khí Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sèng-tiān tam-jīm chè-si.
A-sat-lī-ngá siⁿ A-má-lī-ngá, A-má-lī-ngá siⁿ A-hi-tu̍t,
A-hi-tu̍t siⁿ Sat-tok, Sat-tok siⁿ Sa-liông,
Sa-liông siⁿ Hi-le̍k-ka, Hi-le̍k-ka siⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá,
A-sat-lī-ngá siⁿ Se-lâi-ngá, Se-lâi-ngá siⁿ Iok-sat-ta̍t.
Siōng Chú ēng Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat ê chhiú lia̍h Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê jîn-bîn ê sî, chit-ê Iok-sat-ta̍t mā hō͘ i lia̍h--khì.
Lī-bī ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Kek-sūn, Ko-hat, kap Bí-la-lī.
Kek-sūn ê kiáⁿ kiò-chòe Li̍p-nî kap Sī-múi.
Ko-hat ê kiáⁿ sī Àm-lân, Í-su-hap, Hi-pek-lûn, kap O͘-siat.
Bí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ sī Boat-lī kap Bō͘-sī. Chiah-ê sī Lī-bī -lâng kok chong-cho̍k ê ka-phó͘.
Kek-sūn ê hō͘-tāi: Kek-sūn siⁿ Li̍p-nî, Li̍p-nî siⁿ Ngá-hap, Ngá-hap siⁿ Sin-má,
Sin-má siⁿ Iok-a, Iok-a siⁿ E̍k-to, E̍k-to siⁿ Siā-la, Siā-la siⁿ Iâ-te̍k-nāi.
Ko-hat ê hō͘-tāi: Ko-hat siⁿ A-bí-ná-ta̍t, A-bí-ná-ta̍t siⁿ Khó-la, Khó-la siⁿ A-sioh,
A-sioh siⁿ Í-lī-ka-ná, Í-lī-ka-ná siⁿ Í-pí-ngá-sat, Í-pí-ngá-sat siⁿ A-sioh,
A-sioh siⁿ Tha-hap, Tha-hap siⁿ O͘-lia̍t, O͘-lia̍t siⁿ O͘-se-a, O͘-se-a siⁿ Sò-lô.
Í-lī-ka-ná ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ: A-má-sài kap A-hi-mô͘.
A-hi-mô͘ siⁿ Í-lī-ka-ná, Í-lī-ka-ná siⁿ Só-hui, Só-hui siⁿ Ná-hap,
Ná-hap siⁿ Í-lī-ap, Í-lī-ap siⁿ Iâ-lô-hán, Iâ-lô-hán siⁿ Í-lī-ka-ná, Í-lī-ka-ná siⁿ Sat-bó-ní.
Sat-bó-ní ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ: Tōa-kiáⁿ Iok-ní, tē-jī kiáⁿ A-pí-ngá.
Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi: Bí-la-lī siⁿ Boat-lī, Boat-lī siⁿ Li̍p-nî, Li̍p-nî siⁿ Sī-múi, Sī-múi siⁿ O͘-sat;
O͘-sat siⁿ Sī-bí-a, Sī-bí-a siⁿ Hap-ki-ngá, Hap-ki-ngá siⁿ A-sat-ngá.
Iok-kūi an-tì hó-sè liáu-āu, Tāi-pi̍t phài lâng tī Siōng Chú ê chhù hū-chek hiàn-si ê kang-chok.
In tī hōe-bō͘ ê thâu-chêng lûn-pan tam-jīm chhiùⁿ-koa ê sū-hōng, it-ti̍t kàu Só͘-lô-bûn tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khí-chō Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān.
Hū-chek hiàn-si ê lâng kap in ê kiáⁿ-sun kì tī ē-bīn: Ko-hat ê kiáⁿ-sun tiong ū hiàn-si ê Hi-bān; Hi-bān sī Iok-ní ê kiáⁿ, Iok-ní sī Sat-bó-ní ê kiáⁿ,
Sat-bó-ní sī Í-lī-ka-ná ê kiáⁿ, Í-lī-ka-ná sī Iâ-lô-hán ê kiáⁿ, Iâ-lô-hán sī Í-lī-gia̍p ê kiáⁿ, Í-lī-gia̍p sī Tô-a ê kiáⁿ,
Tô-a sī So͘-hut ê kiáⁿ, So͘-hut sī Í-lī-ka-ná ê kiáⁿ, Í-lī-ka-ná sī Má-hap ê kiáⁿ, Má-hap sī A-má-sài ê kiáⁿ,
A-má-sài sī Í-lī-ka-ná ê kiáⁿ, Í-lī-ka-ná sī Iok-ní ê kiáⁿ, Iok-ní sī A-sat-lī-ngá ê kiáⁿ, A-sat-lī-ngá sī Se-hoan-ngá ê kiáⁿ,
Se-hoan-ngá sī Tha-hap ê kiáⁿ, Tha-hap sī A-sioh ê kiáⁿ, A-sioh sī Í-pí-ngá-sat ê kiáⁿ, Í-pí-ngá-sat sī Khó-la ê kiáⁿ,
Khó-la sī Í-su-hap ê kiáⁿ, Í-su-hap sī Ko-hat ê kiáⁿ, Ko-hat sī Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ, Lī-bī sī Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ.
Hi-bān ê chhin-chiâⁿ A-sat, tī Hi-bān ê chiàⁿ-pêng sū-hōng; A-sat sī Pí-lī-ka ê kiáⁿ, Pí-lī-ka sī Sī-bí-a ê kiáⁿ,
Sī-bí-a sī Bí-ka-le̍k ê kiáⁿ, Bí-ka-le̍k sī Pa-se-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Pa-se-ngá sī Má-ki-ngá ê kiáⁿ,
Má-ki-ngá sī I-te̍k-nî ê kiáⁿ, I-te̍k-nî sī Siā-la ê kiáⁿ, Siā-la sī A-tāi-ngá ê kiáⁿ,
A-tāi-ngá sī Í-thàm ê kiáⁿ, Í-thàm sī Sin-má ê kiáⁿ, Sin-má sī Sī-múi ê kiáⁿ,
Sī-múi sī Ngá-hap ê kiáⁿ, Ngá-hap sī Kek-sūn ê kiáⁿ, Kek-sūn sī Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ.
Tī tò-pêng sū-hōng--ê sī in ê hiaⁿ-tī Bí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ-sun, ū Ki-sī ê kiáⁿ Í-thàm; Ki-sī sī A-pek-tí ê kiáⁿ, A-pek-tí sī Má-lo̍k ê kiáⁿ,
Má-lo̍k sī Hap-sa-pí-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Hap-sa-pí-ngá sī A-má-siā ê kiáⁿ, A-má-siā sī Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ,
Hi-le̍k-ka sī Àm-se ê kiáⁿ, Àm-se sī Pa-nî ê kiáⁿ, Pa-nî sī Sa-be̍k ê kiáⁿ,
Sa-be̍k sī Boat-lī ê kiáⁿ, Boat-lī sī Bō͘-sī ê kiáⁿ, Bō͘-sī sī Bí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ, Bí-la-lī sī Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ.
In ê hiaⁿ-tī Lī-bī -lâng mā siū-phài chòe Siōng-tè ê chhù — hōe-bō͘ só͘-ū ê chit-bū.

A-lûn kap i ê hō͘-tāi tī chè-tôaⁿ hiàn sio-hòa-chè, tī hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ sio-hiuⁿ, chòe Chì-sèng-só͘ só͘-ū ê kang-chok, chiàu Siōng-tè ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se ê hoan-hù, thòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sio̍k-chōe.
A-lûn ê kiáⁿ-sun kì tī ē-bīn: I ê kiáⁿ sī Í-lī-a-sat, Í-lī-a-sat ê kiáⁿ sī Hui-nî-hap, Hui-nî-hap ê kiáⁿ sī A-pí-su,
A-pí-su ê kiáⁿ sī Pò͘-ki, Pò͘-ki ê kiáⁿ sī O͘-se, O͘-se ê kiáⁿ sī Se-la-hi-ngá,
Se-la-hi-ngá ê kiáⁿ sī Bí-la-iok, Bí-la-iok ê kiáⁿ sī A-má-lī-ngá, A-má-lī-ngá ê kiáⁿ sī A-hi-tu̍t,
A-hi-tu̍t ê kiáⁿ sī Sat-tok, Sat-tok ê kiáⁿ sī A-hi-má-su.
A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi khiā-khí ê tōe-khu kì tī ē-bīn: Ko-hat chong-cho̍k thiu-chhiam pun-tio̍h tē-it hūn,
chiū-sī Iû-tāi -tōe Hi-pek-lûn kap chiu-ûi ê chháu-po͘,
m̄-kú sio̍k Hi-pek-lûn ê chhân-hn̂g kap chng-siā lóng pun hō͘ Iâ-hu-nî ê kiáⁿ Ka-le̍k.
A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi koh pun-tio̍h pī-lān-siâⁿ Hi-pek-lûn, í-ki̍p Li̍p-ná kap i ê chháu-po͘, Ngá-thê-ní, Í-si̍t-thê-bo̍k kap i ê chháu-po͘,
Hi-lûn kap i ê chháu-po͘, Tí-phek kap i ê chháu-po͘,
A-san kap i ê chháu-po͘, Pek Sī-be̍k kap i ê chháu-po͘;

koh tùi Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k ê tōe-khu pun-tio̍h Ka-pa kap i ê chháu-po͘, A-la-bia̍t kap i ê chháu-po͘, A-ná-tu̍t kap i ê chháu-po͘. In chiah-ê chong-cho̍k tit--tio̍h ê siâⁿ ū cha̍p-saⁿ ê.
Ko-hat chong-cho̍k kî-tha ê ka-cho̍k thiu-chhiam pun-tio̍h Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k tōe-khu ê cha̍p ê siâⁿ.
Kek-sūn chong-cho̍k chiah-ê ka-cho̍k tùi Í-sat-ka, A-siat, Ná-hut-tha-lī saⁿ ê chi-cho̍k, kap tī Pa-san ê Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h cha̍p-saⁿ ê siâⁿ.
Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k thiu-chhiam tùi Lū-piān, Ka-tek, Se-pò͘-lûn saⁿ ê chi-cho̍k, tit-tio̍h cha̍p-jī ê siâⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiong chiah-ê siâⁿ kap chiu-ûi ê chháu-po͘, pun hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thiu-chhiam, tùi Iû-tāi, Se-biān, Piān-ngá-bín saⁿ ê chi-cho̍k tiong, chiong í-siōng kóng--tio̍h ê siâⁿ pun hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng.
Ko-hat chong-cho̍k tiong ū-ê ka-cho̍k pun-tio̍h Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k tōe-khu ê siâⁿ,
chiū-sī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ê pī-lān-siâⁿ Sī-kiàm kap i ê chháu-po͘, í-ki̍p Ki-sek kap i ê chháu-po͘,
Iok-bián kap i ê chháu-po͘, Pek Hô-lûn kap i ê chháu-po͘,
A-ngá-lûn kap i ê chháu-po͘, Ka-te̍k Lîm-bûn kap i ê chháu-po͘;
Ko-hat chong-cho̍k kî-tha ê ka-cho̍k tùi Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k tit-tio̍h A-nái kap i ê chháu-po͘, Pa-lân kap i ê chháu-po͘.
Kek-sūn ê hō͘-tāi pun-tio̍h Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k tī Pa-san ê Ko-lân kap i ê chháu-po͘, A-su-tha-lio̍k kap i ê chháu-po͘;
tùi Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h Ki-te-su kap i ê chháu-po͘, Tāi-pí-la kap i ê chháu-po͘,
La-boa̍t kap i ê chháu-po͘, A-liân kap i ê chháu-po͘;
tùi A-siat chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h Má-sa kap i ê chháu-po͘, A-pek-tùn kap i ê chháu-po͘,
Hō͘-kat kap i ê chháu-po͘, Lī-ha̍p kap i ê chháu-po͘;
tùi Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h Ka-lī-lī ê Ki-te-su kap i ê chháu-po͘, Hap-bûn kap i ê chháu-po͘, Ki-lia̍t-têng kap i ê chháu-po͘.
Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi tùi Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h Lîm-mô͘-ná kap i ê chháu-po͘, Tha-po̍k kap i ê chháu-po͘;
koh tī óa-kūn Iâ-lī-ko ê Iok-tàn-hô tang-hōaⁿ, tùi Lū-piān chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h khòng-iá ê Pí-sek kap i ê chháu-po͘, Ngá-cha̍p kap i ê chháu-po͘,
Ki-tí-bo̍k kap i ê chháu-po͘, Bí-hoat-ap kap i ê chháu-po͘;
koh tùi Ka-tek chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t kap i ê chháu-po͘, Má-hap-liām kap i ê chháu-po͘,
Hi-si̍t-pún kap i ê chháu-po͘, Ngá-siā kap i ê chháu-po͘.
Í-sat-ka ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Tô-la, Phó͘-óa, Ngá-su̍t, kap Sin-lûn.

Tô-la ū la̍k ê kiáⁿ: O͘-se, Lī-hoat-ngá, Iâ-le̍k, Ngá-mái, E̍k-pek-sàn, kap Sat-bó-ní, lóng sī Tô-la chong-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, tī in ê sè-tāi sī kiông-béng ê ióng-sū; tī Tāi-pi̍t ê sî-tāi, in ê jîn-sò͘ ū nn̄g-bān nn̄g-chheng la̍k-pah ê lâng.
O͘-se ū chi̍t ê kiáⁿ I-su-la-hi; I-su-la-hi kap i sì ê kiáⁿ Bí-ka-le̍k, Gô-pa-tí-a, Iok-ní, I-sī-ngá, lóng sī cho̍k-tiúⁿ.
In léng-tō ê lâng, chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k sè-hē, ōe-tàng kau-chiàn--ê ū saⁿ-bān la̍k-chheng; in-ūi in ê bó͘ kap kiáⁿ chin chōe.
In kâng Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k ê hiaⁿ-tī, ū teng-lio̍k tī ka-phó͘ kiông-béng ê ióng-sū, lóng-chóng ū poeh-bān chhit-chheng lâng.
Piān-ngá-bín ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Pí-la, Pí-kiat, Iâ-thia̍p.

Pí-la ū gō͘ ê kiáⁿ: Í-su-pún, O͘-se, O͘-siat, Iâ-lī-mô͘, kap Í-lī, lóng sī cho̍k-tiúⁿ; teng-lio̍k tī ka-phó͘ ê kiông-béng ióng-sū, lóng-chóng ū nn̄g-bān nn̄g-chheng khòng saⁿ-cha̍p-sì lâng.
Pí-kiat ū káu ê kiáⁿ: Sòe-bí-la, Iok-a-si, Í-lī-í-siā, Í-lī-iok-nái, Àm-lī, Iâ-lī-mô͘, A-pí-ngá, A-ná-tu̍t, kap A-la-bia̍t,
in lóng sī cho̍k-tiúⁿ; chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k sè-hē, kiông-béng ê ióng-sū ū nn̄g-bān khòng nn̄g-pah lâng.
Iâ-thia̍p ū chi̍t ê kiáⁿ Phek-hán, Phek-hán ū chhit ê kiáⁿ: Iâ-o͘-si, Piān-ngá-bín, Í-hut, Ki-ná-ná, Sòe-thán, Tha-si, kap A-hi-sa-hap.
In lóng sī Iâ-thia̍p ê hō͘-tāi, sī cho̍k-tiúⁿ, mā-sī kiông-béng ê ióng-sū; ōe-tàng kau-chiàn ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān chhit-chheng nn̄g-pah lâng.
Iáu ū Í-ní ê kiáⁿ Su-pêng kap Hō͘-pêng, í-ki̍p A-hek ê kiáⁿ Hō͘-sin.
Ná-hut-tha-lī ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Ngá-sih, Ko͘-nî, Iâ-sek, kap Sa-liông; in lóng sī Phek-la ê hō͘-tāi.
Má-ná-se ê sòe-î A-lân ê lú-chú kā i siⁿ A-su-lia̍t, kap Ki-lia̍t ê khai-thok-chiá Má-kiat.
Má-kiat kā Hō͘-pêng kap Su-pêng kok chhōa chi̍t ê bó͘; i ê sió-bē kiò-chòe Má-ka. Tē-jī ê kiáⁿ kiò-chòe Se-lô-hui-hap; Se-lô-hui-hap chí-ū siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Má-kiat ê bó͘ Má-ka siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, kiò-chòe Pí-lī-si. Pí-lī-si ū sió-tī kiò-chòe Sī-lī-si; Sī-lī-si ê kiáⁿ sī O͘-lân kap Lī-kim.
O͘-lân ê kiáⁿ sī Pí-tān. Chiah-ê lóng sī Ki-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi. Ki-lia̍t sī Má-kiat ê kiáⁿ, Má-kiat sī Má-ná-se ê kiáⁿ.
Ki-lia̍t ê sió-bē Hap-mô͘-lī-kiat siⁿ saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: I-si-hô, A-pí-í-siā, kap Má-la.
Sī-bí-tāi ū sì ê kiáⁿ: A-hiān, Sī-kiàm, Lī-khek-hi, kap A-nî-an.
Í-hoat-liân ê hō͘-tāi: Su-thê-la siⁿ Pa-lia̍t, Pa-lia̍t siⁿ Tha-hap, Tha-hap siⁿ Í-la-tāi, Í-la-tāi siⁿ Tha-hap;

Tha-hap siⁿ Sat-poa̍t, Sat-poa̍t siⁿ Su-thê-la. Í-hoat-liân koh siⁿ Í-siā-ní kap Í-lia̍t; chit nn̄g ê lâng lo̍h-khì beh chhiúⁿ Ka-te̍k -lâng ê cheng-siⁿ, sòa hō͘ hit só͘-chāi ê Ka-te̍k -lâng thâi-sí.
In lāu-pē Í-hoat-liân ūi-tio̍h in ai-siong chin chōe ji̍t, i ê hiaⁿ-tī lóng lâi an-ùi i.
Í-hoat-liân kap i ê bó͘ tâng-pâng, i ê bó͘ chiū hoâi-īn siⁿ-kiáⁿ; Í-hoat-liân kā i hō-miâ Pí-lī-a, in-ūi i ê ka-têng tú-tio̍h chai-lān.
I ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Sià-i-la khí-chō Téng Pek Hô-lûn, Ē Pek Hô-lûn, kap O͘-siān Sià-i-la saⁿ ê siâⁿ,
Í-hoat-liân koh siⁿ Lī-hoat, Lī-hoat siⁿ Lī-sek, Lī-sek siⁿ Tha-la, Tha-la siⁿ Tha-hán,
Tha-hán siⁿ La-tān, La-tān siⁿ A-bí-hut, A-bí-hut siⁿ Í-lī-sa-má,
Í-lī-sa-má siⁿ Lūn, Lūn siⁿ Iok-su-a.

Í-hoat-liân -lâng ê só͘-iú-tōe kap khiā-khí ê tōe-khu sī Pek-te̍k-lī kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, tang-pêng kàu Ná-lân, sai-pêng kàu Ki-sek kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, koh ū Sī-kiàm kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, Ai-ngá kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.

Koh ū óa-kūn Má-ná-se -lâng pian-kài ê Pek Siān kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, Tha-la̍p kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, Bí-kiat-to kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, To-ní kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā. Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi khiā-khí tī í-siōng chiah-ê tōe-khu.
A-siat ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Im-ná, E̍k-si-óa, E̍k-si-úi, kap Pí-lī-a, koh ū chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Se-la.
Pí-lī-a ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ: Hi-pek kap Má-kiat; Má-kiat sī Pí-sat-ui -siâⁿ ê khai-thok-chiá.
Hi-pek ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Ngá-hut-le̍k, Sok-be̍k, Hô-thán, kap cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Su-ngá.
Ngá-hut-le̍k ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Pa-sat, Pin-hap, kap A-si-hoat.
Sok-be̍k ū sì ê kiáⁿ: A-hi, Lô-ka, Iâ-hō͘-pa, kap A-lân.
Sok-be̍k ê hiaⁿ-tī Hô-thán ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Só-hoat, Im-ná, Sī-lī-su, kap A-boat.
Só-hoat ê kiáⁿ sī Su-a, Hap-nî-hut, Su-a-le̍k, Pí-lī, Im-la,
Pí-sek, Hô-tek, San-má, Si-sa, Ek-lân, kap Pí-la.
Ek-thiap ê kiáⁿ sī Iâ-hu-nî, Pí-su-pa, kap A-la.
O͘-la ê kiáⁿ sī A-la, Hàn-nî-gia̍p, kap Lī-siá.

Chiah-ê sī A-siat ê hō͘-tāi, lóng sī cho̍k-tiúⁿ, sī siū soán ê kiông-béng ióng-sū, mā-sī kia̍t-chhut ê siú-léng. Teng-lio̍k tī ka-phó͘, ōe-tàng kau-chiàn ê lâng lóng-chóng ū nn̄g-bān la̍k-chheng.
Piān-ngá-bín ū gō͘ ê kiáⁿ, chiàu sūn-sū sī Pí-la, A-si̍t-pia̍t, A-hap-la,
Ná-hap, kap La-hoat.
Pí-la ê kiáⁿ sī A-ta̍t-ní, Ki-la, A-pí-hut,
A-pí-su, Nái-bān, A-hô-a,
Ki-la, Sī-hu-sìn, kap Hō͘-lân.
Í-hut ê hō͘-tāi ū Nái-bān, A-hi-ngá, kap Ki-la, in sī Ka-pa chū-bîn ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, siū-pek chhian-sóa khì Má-ná-hat. Ki-la chhōa in kè--khì; i tī hia siⁿ O͘-sat kap A-hi-hut.
Sa-hap-liân lî i nn̄g ê bó͘ Hō͘-sin kap Pa-la liáu-āu, tī Mô͘-ap -tōe koh chhōa Hō-tek, siⁿ Iok-pa, Sé-pí-ngá, Bí-sa, Má-la-kan,
Iâ-o͘-su, Sa-ka, Bí-má; chiah-ê sī i ê kiáⁿ, lóng chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ.
Sa-hap-liân ū tùi i ê bó͘ Hō͘-sin siⁿ A-pí-tu̍t kap Í-lī-pa-le̍k.
Í-lī-pa-le̍k ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Hi-pek, Bí-san, kap Sa-be̍k; Sa-be̍k khí-chō O-ná kap Lô-tek nn̄g ê siâⁿ, í-ki̍p hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Pí-lī-a kap Sī-má sī A-ngá-lûn chū-bîn ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, ū chiong Ka-te̍k ê chū-bîn kóaⁿ-cháu.
Pí-lī-a ê hō͘-tāi ū A-hi-iok, Sa-soah, Iâ-lī-mô͘,
Se-pa-tē-ngá, A-la-tek, A-tek,
Bí-ka-le̍k, I-si-pa, kap Iok-hap.
Í-lī-pa-le̍k ê hō͘-tāi ū Se-pa-tē-ngá, Bí-su-lân, Hi-se-ki, Hi-pek, I-si-bí-lâi, I-su-lī-a, kap Iok-pa.
Sī-múi ê hō͘-tāi ū Ngá-kim, Sè-ki-lī, Sat-tí, Í-lī-nái, Sé-le̍k-thài, Í-lī-gia̍p, A-tāi-ngá, Pí-la-ngá, kap Sin-la.
Sa-soah ê hō͘-tāi ū I-si-pan, Hi-pek, Í-lī-gia̍p, A-pek-tùn, Sè-ki-lī, Hap-lân, Hap-ná-nî-ngá, Í-lân, An-tô-thê-ngá, I-hut-tí-ngá, kap Pí-ló͘-i-le̍k.
Iâ-lô-hán ê hō͘-tāi ū San-sī-lâi, Sī-hap-lī, A-tha-lī-ngá, Ngá-lī-se, Í-lī-a, kap Sè-ki-lī.
Í-siōng chiah-ê lâng chiàu in ê ka-phó͘ lóng sī cho̍k-tiúⁿ, khiā-khí tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Iâ-lī khai-chhòng Ki-piàn -siâⁿ, khiā-khí tī hia; i ê bó͘ kiò-chòe Má-ka.
I ê tōa-kiáⁿ sī A-pek-tùn, koh ū So͘-ní, Ki-sū, Pa-le̍k, Ná-tap,
Ki-to, A-hi-iok, Sat-ka, kap Bí-ki-lô.
Bí-ki-lô siⁿ Sī-bí-àm. Chiah-ê lâng lóng khiā-khí tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, kap in ê chhin-cho̍k tòa tùi-bīn.
Nî-ní siⁿ Ki-sū, Ki-sū siⁿ Sò-lô, Sò-lô ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Iok-ná-tan, Be̍k-ki Su-a, A-pí-ná-ta̍t, kap I-si-pa-le̍k.
Iok-ná-tan siⁿ Bí-le̍k Pa-le̍k, Bí-le̍k Pa-le̍k siⁿ Bí-ka.
Bí-ka ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Pí-tun, Bí-le̍k, Tha-lī-a, kap A-hap-su.
A-hap-su siⁿ Iâ-hô-a-ta̍t. Iâ-hô-a-ta̍t ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: A-la-bia̍t, A-su-má-ui, kap Sim-lī. Sim-lī siⁿ Mô͘-sat,
Mô͘-sat siⁿ Pí-nî-a, Pí-nî-a siⁿ La-hoat, La-hoat siⁿ Í-lī-a-sat, Í-lī-a-sat siⁿ A-sek.
A-sek ū la̍k ê kiáⁿ: A-su-lī-kan, Pho-ki-lō͘, Í-si̍t-má-lī, Sī-a-lī-ngá, Gô-pa-tí-a, kap Hap-lân.
A-sek ê sió-tī Í-siat ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: O͘-lân, Iâ-o͘-si, kap Í-lī-hoat-lia̍t.

O͘-lân ê kiáⁿ lóng sī kiông-béng gâu siā-chìⁿ ê ióng-sū; i ū chin chōe kiáⁿ kap sun, lóng-chóng chi̍t-pah gō͘-cha̍p lâng. Í-siōng chiah-ê lâng lóng sī Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k ê hō͘-tāi.
Só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiàu ka-phó͘, ū teng-lio̍k tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú. Iû-tāi -lâng in-ūi pōe-poān Siōng-tè, siū-lia̍h khì Pa-pí-lûn.
Tāi-seng tńg-lâi ka-kī ê siâⁿ, tòa tī ka-kī só͘-iú-tōe ê lâng, ū Í-sek-lia̍t ê pêng-bîn, chè-si, Lī-bī -lâng, sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng.
Iû-tāi, Piān-ngá-bín, Í-hoat-liân, Má-ná-se chiah-ê chi-cho̍k ê lâng tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k ū la̍k-pah káu-cha̍p ê ka-cho̍k tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. Iû-tāi ê kiáⁿ Hoat-le̍k-su ê hō͘-tāi ū O͘-thài; O͘-thài sī A-bí-hut ê kiáⁿ, A-bí-hut sī Àm-lī ê kiáⁿ, Àm-lī sī Im-lī ê kiáⁿ, Im-lī sī Pa-nî ê kiáⁿ. Sī-lô ê hō͘-tāi ū tōa-kiáⁿ A-sat-ngá, kap i ê chèng-kiáⁿ. Siā-la ê hō͘-tāi ū Iâ-o͘-lī kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī.
Piān-ngá-bín ê hō͘-tāi ū Sat-lō͘; Sat-lō͘ sī Bí-su-lân ê kiáⁿ, Hô-ta̍t-ui-ngá ê sun, Hap-se-ló͘-a ê kan-á-sun.

Koh ū I-pí-nî-ngá, I-pí-nî-ngá sī Iâ-lô-hán ê kiáⁿ; koh ū Í-la, Í-la sī O͘-se ê kiáⁿ, Bí-ki-lī ê sun; koh ū Bí-su-lân, Bí-su-lân sī Sī-hoat-thê-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Liû-ní ê sun, Í-pí-nî-ngá ê kan-á-sun.
Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k ū káu-pah gō͘-cha̍p-la̍k ê lâng, tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. Í-siōng chiah-ê lâng lóng sī ka-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, ū teng-lio̍k tī ka-phó͘.
Chè-si tiong ū Iâ-tāi-ngá, Iâ-hô-ngá-li̍p, Ngá-kun,

iáu ū Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê chóng-koán A-sat-lī-ngá; A-sat-lī-ngá sī Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ, Hi-le̍k-ka sī Bí-su-lân ê kiáⁿ, Bí-su-lân sī Sat-tok ê kiáⁿ, Sat-tok sī Bí-la-iok ê kiáⁿ, Bí-la-iok sī A-hi-tu̍t ê kiáⁿ.

Koh ū Iâ-lô-hán ê kiáⁿ A-tāi-ngá, Iâ-lô-hán sī Pa-si-hō͘-ní ê kiáⁿ, Pa-si-hō͘-ní sī Má-ki-ngá ê kiáⁿ; koh ū A-tí-gia̍p ê kiáⁿ Má-sài, A-tí-gia̍p sī Ngá-hi-sòe-la ê kiáⁿ, Ngá-hi-sòe-la sī Bí-su-lân ê kiáⁿ, Bí-su-lân sī Bí-si̍t-lī-bi̍t ê kiáⁿ, Bí-si̍t-lī-bi̍t sī Im-be̍k ê kiáⁿ.
Í-siōng chiah-ê lâng lóng chòe in ka-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, chin gâu chhú-lí Siōng-tè tiān-lāi ê sū-bū; in lóng-chóng ū chi̍t-chheng chhit-pah la̍k-cha̍p lâng.
Lī-bī -lâng Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi ū Hap-sa-pí-ngá ê kan-á-sun, A-su-lī-kan ê sun, Hap-su̍t ê kiáⁿ Sī-má-ngá.
Koh ū Poa̍t-pa-kah, Hek-le̍k-si, Ka-la, kap Má-tha-nî; Má-tha-nî sī A-sat ê kan-á-sun, Sè-ki-lī ê sun, Bí-ka ê kiáⁿ.
Koh ū Iâ-tō͘-tùn ê kan-á-sun, Ka-la ê sun, Sī-má-ngá ê kiáⁿ Gô-pa-tí-a. Koh ū Í-lī-ka-ná ê sun, A-sat ê kiáⁿ Pí-lī-ka. In lóng tòa tī Nî-tô-hoat -lâng ê chng-siā.
Sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe ū: Sa-liông, A-kok, Ta̍t-bûn, A-hi-bān, kap in ê hiaⁿ-tī; Sa-liông chòe in ê thâu.
In í-chêng kò͘-siú tang-pêng ông ê mn̂g; in khah-chá sī Lī-bī -cho̍k iâⁿ-tiong ê siú-ōe.

Khó-la ê kan-á-sun, Í-pí-ngá-sat ê sun, Khó-lī ê kiáⁿ Sa-liông, kap kâng-cho̍k ê hiaⁿ-tī Khó-la -lâng, lóng hū-chek sū-bū, koh khàn-siú hōe-bō͘ ê mn̂g; in ê chó͘-sian bat kò͘-siú Siōng Chú hōe-bō͘ iâⁿ-tōe ê ji̍p-kháu.
Í-chêng Í-lī-a-sat ê kiáⁿ Hui-nî-hap bat chòe in ê chóng-koán, Siōng Chú mā kap i tông-chāi.
Bí-si-lī-bí-ngá ê kiáⁿ Sat-ka-lī-a mā-sī hōe-bō͘ ji̍p-kháu ê siú-ōe.

Siū kéng-soán chòe hōe-bō͘ ji̍p-kháu siú-ōe ê lâng ū nn̄g-pah cha̍p-jī ê. In tī ka-kī ê chng-siā, ū teng-lio̍k tī in ê ka-phó͘. In siū Tāi-pi̍t kap sian-kiàn Sat-bó-ní chí-phài, hū-chek chit-ê chit-bū.
In kap in ê hō͘-tāi kè-sio̍k kò͘-siú Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê mn̂g, chiū-sī hōe-bō͘ ê ji̍p-kháu.
Tang sai lâm pak sì pêng ê ji̍p-kháu lóng ū siú-ōe.
In tiàm tī ta̍k chng-siā ê hiaⁿ-tī, múi chhit ji̍t lûn-liû hun-tam in ê kang-chok.
Chit sì ê ji̍p-kháu ê siú-ōe-tiúⁿ sī Lī-bī -lâng, chiàu in ê chit-chek, koán-lí Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê pâng-keng kap hú-khò͘.
In tī Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê chiu-ûi kè-mî, in-ūi in siū-thok khàn-siú sèng-tiān, ta̍k chá-khí hū-chek khui-mn̂g.
Lī-bī -lâng tiong-kan ū lâng koán-lí kèng-pài ēng ê khì-khū, the̍h-chhut the̍h-ji̍p lóng tio̍h tiám-sǹg.
Koh ū lâng siū phài koán-lí sèng-só͘ kî-tha só͘-ū ê khì-khū, í-ki̍p mī-hún, chiú, iû, jú-hiuⁿ, kap phang-liāu.
Chè-si ê hō͘-tāi koh ū lâng hū-chek tiâu-hô phang-liāu.
Lī-bī -lâng Má-tha-thê-ngá sī Khó-la -cho̍k Sa-liông ê tōa-kiáⁿ, siū phài hū-chek hang-piáⁿ ê kang-chok.
In kâng-cho̍k ê hiaⁿ-tī Ko-hat ê hō͘-tāi, ū lâng hū-chek chún-pī An-hioh-ji̍t hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ.
Hū-chek chhiùⁿ-koa ê lâng sī Lī-bī -lâng ka-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, tiàm tī sèng-tiān ê pâng-keng, bô chòe pa̍t-hāng khang-khè, in-ūi mî-ji̍t lóng tio̍h ài sū-hōng.
Í-siōng chiah-ê lâng, chiàu cho̍k-phó͘ ê kì-lio̍k, sī Lī-bī -lâng ka-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, lóng tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Iâ-lī khai-chhòng Ki-piàn -siâⁿ, khiā-khí tī hia; i ê bó͘ kiò-chòe Má-ka.
I ê tōa-kiáⁿ sī A-pek-tùn, koh ū So͘-ní, Ki-sū, Pa-le̍k, Nî-ní, Ná-tap,
Ki-to, A-hi-iok, Sat-ka-lī-a, kap Bí-ki-lô.
Bí-ki-lô siⁿ Sī-bí-àm. Chiah-ê lâng lóng khiā-khí tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, kap in ê chhin-cho̍k tòa tùi-bīn.
Nî-ní siⁿ Ki-sū, Ki-sū siⁿ Sò-lô, Sò-lô ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Iok-ná-tan, Be̍k-ki Su-a, A-pí-ná-ta̍t, kap I-si-pa-le̍k.
Iok-ná-tan siⁿ Bí-le̍k Pa-le̍k, Bí-le̍k Pa-le̍k siⁿ Bí-ka.
Bí-ka ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Pí-tun, Bí-le̍k, Tha-lī-a, kap A-hap-su.
A-hap-su siⁿ Ngá-la, Ngá-la ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: A-la-bia̍t, A-su-má-ui, kap Sim-lī. Sim-lī siⁿ Mô͘-sat,
Mô͘-sat siⁿ Pí-nî-a, Pí-nî-a siⁿ Lī-hoat-ngá, Lī-hoat-ngá siⁿ Í-lī-a-sat, Í-lī-a-sat siⁿ A-sek.
A-sek ū la̍k ê kiáⁿ: A-su-lī-kan, Pho-ki-lō͘, Í-si̍t-má-lī, Sī-a-lī-ngá, Gô-pa-tí-a, kap Hap-lân.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Ki-lī-pho-soaⁿ kau-chiàn; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sí chin chōe, chiàn-pāi tô-cháu.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng tui-jip Sò-lô kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ, thâi-sí Sò-lô saⁿ ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan, A-pí-ná-ta̍t, kap Be̍k-ki Su-a.
Sò-lô siū-tio̍h béng-lia̍t ê kong-kek; i hō͘ siā-chìⁿ ê lâng hoat-kiàn, siā--tio̍h, siū-siong chin siong-tiōng.

Sò-lô kā thòe i gia̍h kun-khì ê sī-ōe kóng, “Pu̍ih to kā góa chha̍k--sí, chiah bián góa hō͘ chiah-ê bô siū kat-lé ê lâng lêng-jio̍k.” Hit-ê sī-ōe m̄-káⁿ, in-ūi i chin kiaⁿ. Sò-lô chiū ǹg to phak--lo̍h-khì, ka-kī chha̍k--sí.
Hit-ê sī-ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sò-lô í-keng sí, mā phak--lo̍h-khì, ka-kī chha̍k--sí.
Án-ni, Sò-lô kap i saⁿ ê kiáⁿ lóng sí, choân-ke bia̍t-bông.

Tī Iâ-su-lia̍t Soaⁿ-kok hit-pêng ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h in ê kun-tūi í-keng tô-cháu, Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ mā lóng chiàn-sí, chiū pàng siâⁿ tô-cháu. Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiū lâi chiàm hiah-ê siâⁿ, tī hia khiā-khí.
Keh-ji̍t, Hui-lī-sū -lâng lâi pak chiàn-sí ê lâng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ sí tī Ki-lī-pho-soaⁿ,
chiū pak Sò-lô ê kun-ho̍k, the̍h i ê thâu-khak kap chiàn-kah, phài lâng khì Hui-lī-sū ta̍k só͘-chāi, chiong chit-ê siau-sit pò hō͘ in ê ngó͘-siōng kap jîn-bîn chai.
In chiong Sò-lô ê chiàn-kah hē tī in sîn-bêng ê biō-lāi, chiong i ê thâu-khak tiàu tī Tāi-kún ê biō.
Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-pí -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Hui-lī-sū -lâng tùi Sò-lô só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì,
in ê ióng-sū lóng khí--lâi, chiong Sò-lô kap i ê kiáⁿ ê sin-si tòa-khì Ngá-pí, chiong in ê kut-hâi chòng tī Ngá-pí ê siōng-chhiū kha, kìm-chia̍h chhit ji̍t.
Án-ni Sò-lô sí, in-ūi i pōe-poān Siōng Chú, bô siú Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, khì chhē ang-î, kiû i chí-tiám,
bô chhē-kiû Siōng Chú, só͘-í Siōng Chú kā i thâi-sí, chiong ông-ūi kau hō͘ Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t.
Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chū-chi̍p lâi Hi-pek-lûn kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, kóng, “Goán sī lí ê kut-jio̍k.

Khah-chá Sò-lô chòe goán ê ông ê sî, chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t khì kau-chiàn--ê sī lí; Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè mā bat kā lí kóng, ‘Lí ōe bo̍k-ióng góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t, mā ōe chòe góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê thóng-tī-chiá.’”

Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló lóng lâi Hi-pek-lûn kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t -ông, i chiū tī Hi-pek-lûn, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kap in li̍p-iok. In chiū ēng iû boah Tāi-pi̍t, siat-li̍p i chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông, chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè Sat-bó-ní kóng ê ōe.
Tāi-pi̍t kap só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khì kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tng-sî kiò-chòe Iâ-pò͘-su, in-ūi Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng tòa tī hia.
Khiā-khí tī Iâ-pò͘-su ê lâng kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí bô khó-lêng kong--ji̍p-lâi.” M̄-kú Tāi-pi̍t ū kong-chhú Sek-an ê pó-lúi, chiū-sī hiān-chāi ê Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ.
Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng seng kong-táⁿ Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, i beh chòe thâu, chòe goân-sòe.” Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap tāi-seng chiūⁿ--khì, chiū chòe goân-sòe.
Tāi-pi̍t tòa tī pó-lúi, só͘-í hit-ê pó-lúi kiò-chòe Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ.
I tùi Bí-lô khai-sí, khí sì-ûi ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, kî-tha ê pō͘-hūn kau hō͘ Iok-ap siu-kiàn.
Tāi-pi̍t jú lâi jú kiông-sēng, in-ūi Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kap i tông-chāi.

Ē-bīn chiah-ê sī Tāi-pi̍t ê ióng-sū ê léng-siù; in choân-le̍k ióng-hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t tit-tio̍h ông-koân, mā kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê èng-ún siat-li̍p i choh-ông.
Hiah-ê léng-siù ê miâ-toaⁿ kì tī ē-bīn: Hap-kek-mô͘-nî ê kiáⁿ Ngá-sok-pan sī chèng kun-koaⁿ ê siú-léng, bat chi̍t piàn ēng chhiuⁿ thâi-sí saⁿ-pah ê lâng.
Tē-jī ê sī A-hô-a -lâng Tó-to ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat, i sī saⁿ ê ióng-sū ê chi̍t ê.

I bat kap Tāi-pi̍t tī Pa-su Tāi-bín; Hui-lī-sū -lâng chū-chi̍p tī hia beh kau-chiàn. Hia ū chi̍t khu hn̂g, chèng chin chōe tōa-be̍h; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu.
I khiā tī hn̂g-tiong hông-siú hit-khu hn̂g, phah Hui-lī-sū -lâng. Siōng Chú hō͘ i tōa sèng-lī.
Saⁿ-cha̍p ê siú-léng tiong ū saⁿ ê lo̍h-khì A-tō͘-lân-tōng hù-kūn ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ hia kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t. Hui-lī-sū ê kun-tūi tī Lī-hoa̍t-im Soaⁿ-kok chat-iâⁿ.
Hit-sî, Tāi-pi̍t tī iàu-sài; Hui-lī-sū ê kun-tūi chū-chāi tī Pek-lī-hêng.
Tāi-pi̍t ēng chin khat-bō͘ ê kháu-khì kóng, “Nā ū lâng ōe-tàng khì the̍h Pek-lī-hêng siâⁿ-mn̂g piⁿ ê chíⁿ-chúi hō͘ góa lim, m̄-chai jōa-á-ni̍h hó!”

Chit saⁿ ê lâng chiū chhiong-kè Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê iâⁿ-tōe, tùi Pek-lī-hêng siâⁿ-mn̂g piⁿ ê chíⁿ chhiūⁿ-chúi, kōaⁿ-lâi hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t. M̄-kú Tāi-pi̍t m̄ lim, tò chhut-lâi hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú,

kóng, “Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, góa ná thang lim chit-ê chúi? Che kiám m̄-sī chiah-ê ēng sìⁿ-miā khì ōaⁿ--lâi ê lâng ê huih, góa ná káⁿ lim?” Só͘-í Tāi-pi̍t m̄ lim. Che sī chit saⁿ ê ióng-sū chòe ê tāi-chì.
Iok-ap ê sió-tī A-pí-su sī lēng-gōa saⁿ ê ióng-sū ê siú-léng; i bat gia̍h chhiuⁿ thâi-sí saⁿ-pah ê lâng, chiū tī saⁿ ê ióng-sū tiong ū-miâ.
I pí kî-tha nn̄g ê khah ū bêng-bōng, só͘-í chòe in ê léng-siù; m̄-kú i iáu put-ki̍p chêng hit saⁿ ê ióng-sū.

Koh ū Kah-sih -lâng Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá; i sī ióng-sū, ū chòe chin chōe tōa-sū: I bat thâi-sí Mô͘-ap nn̄g ê kiông-béng ê ióng-sū; koh tī lo̍h-seh ê sî, lo̍h-khì khiⁿ-lāi thâi-sí chi̍t chiah sai;

koh thâi-sí chi̍t ê nn̄g-pah gōa kong-hun koân-tōa ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng. Hit-ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng chhiú gia̍h chhiuⁿ, chhiuⁿ ê pìⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-pò͘-ki ê chhia-sim hiah chho͘. Pí-ná-ngá chí-ū gia̍h kùn lo̍h-khì i hia, chhiúⁿ i ê chhiuⁿ, ēng hit-ki chhiuⁿ kā i thâi-sí.
Che sī Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá só͘ chòe ê sū, chiū tī saⁿ ê ióng-sū tiong ū-miâ.
I pí saⁿ-cha̍p ê ióng-sū khah ū bêng-bōng, m̄-kú put-ki̍p chêng hit saⁿ ê ióng-sū. Tāi-pi̍t ū siat-li̍p i chòe sī-ōe-tiúⁿ.
Kun-tiong ê ióng-sū ū: Iok-ap ê sió-tī A-sat-hek Pek-lī-hêng -lâng Tó-to ê kiáⁿ I-le̍k-hap-lân
Hap-lu̍t -lâng Sa-má Pí-lûn -lâng Hi-lī-su
Thê-ko-a -lâng Ek-kiat ê kiáⁿ Í-la A-ná-tu̍t -lâng A-pí-í-siā
Hō͘-sa -lâng Se-pí-kai A-hô-a -lâng Í-lâi
Nî-tô-hoat -lâng Má-hap-lâi kap Pa-ná ê kiáⁿ Hi-li̍p
Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k Ki-pí-a -lâng Lī-pài ê kiáⁿ Í-thài Pí-la-tùn -lâng Pí-ná-ngá
Ka-si̍t-khoe -lâng Hō͘-lâi A-la-pa -lâng A-pia̍t
Pa-ló͘-bí -lâng A-su-má-ui Sa-pún -lâng Í-lī-ngá-hap-pa
Ki-sun -lâng Hap-chhim ê chèng-kiáⁿ Hap-la -lâng Sa-ki ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan
Hap-la -lâng Sa-kah ê kiáⁿ A-hi-àm Ngô͘-ní ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-hoat-le̍k
Bí-ki-la -lâng Hi-hut Pí-lûn -lâng A-hi-ngá
Ka-bi̍t -lâng Hi-su-lô I-su-pài ê kiáⁿ Ná-lâi
Ná-tan ê hiaⁿ-tī Iok-ní Hap-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Bí-pek-hap
A-bûn -lâng Sé-le̍k kā Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap gia̍h kun-khì ê Pí-lio̍k -lâng Ná-hap-lâi
Í-thiap -lâng Í-la kap Ka-li̍p
Hek -lâng O͘-lī-a A-lâi ê kiáⁿ Sat-poa̍t
Lū-piān -lâng Sī-sat ê kiáⁿ A-tē-ná (i sī Lū-piān chi-cho̍k tiong chi̍t ê léng-siù, chhōa saⁿ-cha̍p lâng)
Má-ka ê kiáⁿ Hap-lân Bî-te̍k-nî -lâng Iok-sa-hoat
A-si-tha-la -lâng O͘-se-a A-lô-ní -lâng Hô-thán ê kiáⁿ Sa-má kap Iâ-lī
Thê-sé -lâng Sin-lī ê kiáⁿ Iâ-thia̍p kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī Iok-hap
Má-hap-bī -lâng Í-lī-gia̍p I-lī-ná-an ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lī-pài kap Iok-sa-bī-ngá Mô͘-ap -lâng I-te̍k-má
Í-lī-gia̍p, Gô-pī-tek, kap Bí-só-pa -lâng Ngá-se-gia̍p.
Tāi-pi̍t ūi-tio̍h siám-pī Ki-sū ê kiáⁿ Sò-lô, bih tī Sé-kek-la ê sî, ē-bīn chiah-ê ióng-sū lâi kàu i hia, pang-chān i kau-chiàn.
In ōe ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú tò-chhiú siā-chìⁿ, hìⁿ chio̍h-thâu; lóng sī Piān-ngá-bín -lâng, sī Sò-lô ê chhin-cho̍k:
Chhōa-thâu--ê sī A-hi-í-siā, koh lo̍h--khì sī Iok-a-si, in lóng sī Ki-pí-a -lâng Sī-má ê kiáⁿ; koh ū A-su-má-ui ê kiáⁿ Iâ-sih kap Pí-le̍k, Pí-la-ka A-ná-tu̍t -lâng Iâ-hō͘
Ki-piàn -lâng I-si-má-ngá (saⁿ-cha̍p lâng tiong ê chi̍t ê ióng-sū, teh koán-lí hit saⁿ-cha̍p lâng), Iâ-lī-bí, Ngá-hap-sek, Iok-hap-lân Ki-tí-la -lâng Iok-sat-poa̍t,
I-lī-o͘-sài, Iâ-lī-mô͘, Pí-a-lī-ngá, Sī-má-lī-ngá Hap-lu̍t-hut -lâng Sī-hoat-thê-ngá
Khó-la -lâng Í-lī-ka-ná, I-sī-ngá, A-sat-lia̍t, Iok-í-siā, Ngá-sok-pan
Ki-to -lâng Iâ-lô-hán ê kiáⁿ Iû-la kap Se-pa-tē-ngá.

Ka-tek chi-cho̍k ū kúi-nā lâng lâi kàu khòng-iá ê iàu-sài, kui-sūn Tāi-pi̍t. In lóng sī ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū, giâ tún-pâi, gia̍h chhiuⁿ, gâu sio-thâi; in ê bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ sai ê bīn, gâu cháu chhin-chhiūⁿ soaⁿ--ni̍h ê lo̍k.
Thâu chi̍t ê Í-siā-ní, tē-jī Gô-pa-tí-a, tē-saⁿ Í-lī-ap,
tē-sì Bî-si-má-ná, tē-gō͘ Iâ-lī-bí,
tē-la̍k A-thài, tē-chhit Í-lī-gia̍p,
tē-poeh Iok-hap-lân, tē-káu Í-lī-sat-pa,
tē-cha̍p Iâ-lī-bí, tē-cha̍p-it Boa̍t-pa-nāi.
Chiah-ê lóng sī Ka-tek chi-cho̍k ê kun-koaⁿ; siōng-sòe--ê chi̍t ê tú chi̍t-pah, siōng-kiông--ê chi̍t ê tú chi̍t-chheng.
Chiaⁿ--ge̍h Iok-tàn-hô ê chúi tiòng-móa siang-pêng hōaⁿ ê sî, in kè hô, hō͘ só͘-ū tòa tī pêng-goân ê lâng kiaⁿ kah sì-sòaⁿ tô-cháu.
Koh ū Piān-ngá-bín -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng lâi Tāi-pi̍t ê iàu-sài.

Tāi-pi̍t chhut-khì gêng-chiap in, tùi in kóng, “Lín nā hó-ì lâi beh pang-chān góa, góa hoan-gêng lín kap góa liân-bêng; m̄-kú lín nā beh chiong góa chit-ê bô-chōe ê lâng chhut-bōe hō͘ tùi-te̍k, goān lán lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè kàm-chhat chek-hoa̍t.”

Hit-sî Siōng-tè ê sîn lîm-kàu chèng kun-koaⁿ ê siú-léng A-má-sài, i chiū kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t ah, goán sī kui-sūn lí--ê; Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ ah, goán sī chi-chhî lí--ê. Goān lí pêng-an sūn-lī, goān pang-chān lí--ê mā lóng pêng-an; in-ūi lí ê Siōng-tè pang-chān lí.” Tāi-pi̍t chiū chiap-la̍p in, siat-li̍p in chòe iû-kek-tūi ê tūi-tiúⁿ.

Tāi-pi̍t kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng chòe-hé beh kong-kek Sò-lô ê sî, ū chi̍t-kóa Má-ná-se -lâng lâi kui-sūn i. Āu-lâi in bô pang-chān Hui-lī-sū -lâng, in-ūi Hui-lī-sū ê léng-siù ū chham-siông, kiò Tāi-pi̍t tò--khì, kóng, “I chin ū khó-lêng the̍h lán ê thâu-khak khì kui-sūn i ê chú-lâng Sò-lô.”
Tāi-pi̍t khì Sé-kek-la ê sî, ū Má-ná-se -lâng ê chí-hui-koaⁿ, Ap-ná, Iok-sat-poa̍t, Iâ-thia̍p, Bí-ka-le̍k, Iok-sat-poa̍t, Í-lī-hō͘, Sé-le̍k-thài, lóng lâi kui-sūn i.
Chiah-ê lâng pang-chān Tāi-pi̍t tùi-khòng iû-kek-tūi, in lóng sī ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū, koh chòe kun-koaⁿ.
Hit-sî, ta̍k-ji̍t ū lâng lâi beh pang-chān Tāi-pi̍t, i ê kun-tūi chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè ê kun-tūi hiah-ni̍h kiông-tāi.
Ū bú-chong hó-sè ê chiàn-sū lâi Hi-pek-lûn kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t, beh chiàu Siōng Chú ê ōe chiong Sò-lô ê ông-ūi kau hō͘ i. Ē-bīn sī hiah-ê chiàn-sū ê sò͘-bo̍k:
Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k: Giâ tún-pâi, gia̍h-chhiuⁿ ê bú-chong chiàn-sū, ū la̍k-chheng poeh-pah lâng.
Se-biān chi-cho̍k: Ōe chhut-chiàn ê ióng-sū, ū chhit-chheng chi̍t-pah lâng.
Lī-bī chi-cho̍k: Sì-chheng la̍k-pah lâng;
A-lûn hō͘-tāi ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi kap tè-i--ê ū saⁿ-chheng chhit-pah lâng;
Ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū siàu-liân-lâng Sat-tok kap i ka-cho̍k ê léng-siù jī-cha̍p-jī lâng.
Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k: Sò-lô ê chhin-cho̍k ū saⁿ-chheng lâng; chêng-kàu-taⁿ, in tōa-pō͘-hūn ióng-hō͘ Sò-lô -ke.
Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k: Chhut-miâ ê ióng-béng chiàn-sū, ū nn̄g-bān khòng poeh-pah lâng.
Iok-tàn-hô sai-pêng ê Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k: Ū kì-lio̍k tī ka-phó͘--ê, chi̍t-bān poeh-chheng lâng, lóng ióng-hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t choh-ông.
Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k: Ū tì-sek, bat sî-sè, chai Í-sek-lia̍t tī sím-mi̍h sî tio̍h chòe sím-mi̍h ê léng-siù ū nn̄g-pah lâng; in ê chhin-cho̍k lóng thiaⁿ in ê bēng-lēng.
Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k: Ōe ēng ta̍k-chióng kun-khì chhut-tīn kau-chiàn, chin ū kì-lu̍t, tùi Tāi-pi̍t tiong-sêng--ê ū gō͘-bān lâng.
Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k: Ū chi̍t-chheng ê léng-siù; gia̍h chhiuⁿ, giâ tún-pâi tè in--ê, ū saⁿ-bān chhit-chheng lâng.
Tān chi-cho̍k: Ōe chhut-chiàn--ê, ū nn̄g-bān poeh-chheng la̍k-pah lâng.
A-siat chi-cho̍k: Ōe chhut-tīn kau-chiàn--ê, ū sì-bān lâng.
Tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-pêng, Lū-piān chi-cho̍k, Ka-tek chi-cho̍k, Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k: Gia̍h ta̍k-chióng kun-khì kau-chiàn--ê, ū cha̍p-jī-bān lâng.

Chiah-ê chiàn-sū lóng sûi-sî ōe-tàng chhut-chiàn, tùi Tāi-pi̍t tiong-sêng. In lâi kàu Hi-pek-lûn ióng-hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t chòe Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kok ê ông; kî-tha ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng mā tâng-sim ióng-hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t choh-ông.
In tī hia kap Tāi-pi̍t chòe-hé saⁿ ji̍t, ia̍h-chia̍h-ia̍h-lim, in-ūi in ê chhin-cho̍k lóng kā in pī-pān hó-sè.

In hù-kūn ê lâng, sīm-chì tùi Í-sat-ka, Se-pò͘-lûn, Ná-hut-tha-lī lâi ê lâng, lóng ēng lû, lo̍k-tô, lô, gû, chài chia̍h-mi̍h, ū mī-hún, bû-hoa-kó-koaⁿ-oân, phû-tô-koaⁿ-oân, chiú, iû, koh tòa gû iûⁿ lâi hia, ta̍k-hāng lóng chin chōe; in-ūi tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong ū tōa hoaⁿ-hí.
Tāi-pi̍t kap chí-hui-koaⁿ, kun-koaⁿ, í-ki̍p só͘-ū ê léng-siù chham-siông.
