Tāi-pi̍t tùi Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng kóng, “Lín nā khòaⁿ-chòe hó, koh sī chhut tī Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè ê ì-sù, lán tio̍h phài lâng khì Í-sek-lia̍t choân-tōe, khì kìⁿ bô tī lán chia ê chhin-cho̍k, í-ki̍p tòa tī ū chháu-po͘ ê siâⁿ ê chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, hō͘ in lóng chū-chi̍p lâi chia.
Lán chiū thang chiong lán ê Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi chhian-lâi chia; in-ūi tī Sò-lô choh-ông ê sî, lán bô chiong iok-kūi khòaⁿ-chòe iàu-kín.”
Choân hōe-chiòng lóng tông-ì án-ni chòe; jîn-bîn mā khòaⁿ chit-ê tāi-chì chòe tio̍h.
Tāi-pi̍t chiū tùi Ai-ki̍p pian-kài ê Se-hat-hô, kàu Hap-má ài-kháu tiàu-chi̍p só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, beh chiong Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi tùi Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm chiap--lâi.

Tāi-pi̍t kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chiū khì Pa-la, chiū-sī sio̍k Iû-tāi ê Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm, beh tùi hia chiong Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi chiap--lâi; chit-ê kūi sī hōng chē tī nn̄g ê thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek tiong-kan ê Siōng Chú ê miâ chheng-ho͘--ê.
In chiong Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi hē tī sin ê chhia, tùi A-pí-ná-ta̍t ê chhù chài--chhut-lâi; O͘-sat kap A-hi-iok kóaⁿ hit-tâi chhia.
Tāi-pi̍t kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng chīn-la̍t chhiùⁿ-koa, ēng khîm, sek, lô, kó͘, lat-pah, hoaⁿ-hí khèng-chiok.
In kàu Ki-tùn ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ, gû tio̍h-tak, O͘-sat chhun-chhiú kā iok-kūi hû--teh.
Siōng Chú tùi O͘-sat hoat tōa siū-khì, in-ūi i chhun-chhiú hû iok-kūi, chiū phah i; i chiū tī hia sí tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng.
Tāi-pi̍t in-ūi Siōng Chú phah O͘-sat, chin bô hoaⁿ-hí, chiū chiong hit-ê só͘-chāi hō-chòe Pí-lia̍t-su O͘-sat, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Hit-ji̍t, Tāi-pi̍t kiaⁿ Siōng-tè, chiū kóng, “Góa ná thang chiong Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi ūn-lâi góa ê só͘-chāi?”
Tùi án-ni, Tāi-pi̍t bô chiong iok-kūi chhian-ji̍p Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ, kàu ka-kī ê só͘-chāi, chiū kā i sóa-khì Ka-te̍k -lâng Gô-pia̍t Í-tong ê chhù.
Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi thêng tī Gô-pia̍t Í-tong ê chhù saⁿ ge̍h-ji̍t kú. Siōng Chú sù-hok Gô-pia̍t Í-tong ê ke kap i it-chhè só͘ ū--ê.
Thài-ní -ông Hi-lân phài sù-chiá tòa pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ, kap thô͘-chúi sai-hū, choh-ba̍k sai-hū khì Tāi-pi̍t hia, kā Tāi-pi̍t khí kiong-tiān.
Tāi-pi̍t chiū chai Siōng Chú kian-li̍p i chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, koh ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t hō͘ i ê kok kiông-sēng.
Tāi-pi̍t tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng koh chhōa kúi-nā ê bó͘. Tāi-pi̍t koh siⁿ hāu-siⁿ kap cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siⁿ ê kiáⁿ sī Sa-bō͘-a, Sok-pā, Ná-tan, Só͘-lô-bûn,
Ek-hat, Í-lī-su-a, Í-lī-hoat-lia̍t,
Ná-ka, Nî-húi, Ngá-hui-a,
Í-lī-sa-má, Pí-lī-ngá-tāi, Í-lī-hoat-lia̍t.

Hui-lī-sū -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t siū boah-iû soán-li̍p chòe choân Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông, chiū choân-le̍k chiūⁿ-lâi tui-chhē Tāi-pi̍t. Tāi-pi̍t thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū chhut-khì gêng-chiàn.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng lâi chhim-hoān Lī-hoa̍t-im Soaⁿ-kok.

Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g Siōng-tè kóng, “Góa kiám thang chìn-kong Hui-lī-sū -lâng? Lí kiám beh chiong in kau tī góa ê chhiú?” Siōng Chú kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí khì, góa ōe chiong in kau tī lí ê chhiú.”

Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiūⁿ-lâi Pa-le̍k Pí-la-sim, Tāi-pi̍t tī hia kā in phah-pāi; Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Siōng-tè ēng góa ê chhiú chhiong-sòaⁿ góa ê tùi-te̍k, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi kā thê-hōaⁿ chhiong-phòa.” In-ūi án-ni, hit-ê só͘-chāi chiū kiò-chòe Pa-le̍k Pí-la-sim.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng kā in ê ngó͘-siōng tàn tī hia; Tāi-pi̍t bēng-lēng lâng kā hiah-ê ngó͘-siōng pàng-hé sio.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng koh lâi chhim-hoān Lī-hoa̍t-im Soaⁿ-kok.
Tāi-pi̍t mn̄g Siōng-tè. Siōng-tè kā i kóng, “M̄-thang chiàⁿ-bīn chìn-kong; tio̍h se̍h-kè in ê āu-bīn, tī sng-châi-chhiū-nâ ê thâu-chêng kā in kong-kek.
Lí thiaⁿ-tio̍h chhiū-bé ū hêng-kun ê siaⁿ, chiū tio̍h chhut-peng chìn-kong, in-ūi Siōng-tè í-keng tī lí ê thâu-chêng kong-kek Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê kun-tūi.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū chiàu Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng khì chòe, tùi Ki-piàn kong-kek Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê kun-tūi, ti̍t-kàu Ki-sek.
Tāi-pi̍t ê miâ-siaⁿ thoân kàu bān-kok; Siōng Chú hō͘ lia̍t-kok lóng kiaⁿ i.
Tāi-pi̍t tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ ūi ka-kī khí kúi-nā keng kiong-tiān, koh ūi Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi chún-pī só͘-chāi, tah chi̍t ê pò͘-pîⁿ.
Hit-sî Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “ Lī-bī -lâng í-gōa, m̄-thang ū lâng kng Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi, in-ūi Siōng Chú kéng Lī-bī -lâng kng I ê iok-kūi, koh éng-oán ho̍k-sāi I.”
Tāi-pi̍t tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, beh chiong Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi kng-lâi i chún-pī ê só͘-chāi.
Tāi-pi̍t koh tiàu-chi̍p A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi kap Lī-bī -lâng:
Ko-hat ê hō͘-tāi ū siú-léng O͘-lia̍t kap i ê chhin-cho̍k chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p lâng.
Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi ū siú-léng A-sat-ngá kap i ê chhin-cho̍k nn̄g-pah jī-cha̍p lâng.
Kek-sūn ê hō͘-tāi ū siú-léng Iok-ní kap i ê chhin-cho̍k chi̍t-pah saⁿ-cha̍p lâng.
Í-lī-sat-hoán ê hō͘-tāi ū siú-léng Sī-má-ngá kap i ê chhin-cho̍k nn̄g-pah lâng.
Hi-pek-lûn ê hō͘-tāi ū siú-léng Í-lī-gia̍p kap i ê chhin-cho̍k poeh-cha̍p lâng.
O͘-siat ê hō͘-tāi ū siú-léng A-bí-ná-ta̍t kap i ê chhin-cho̍k chi̍t-pah cha̍p-jī lâng.
Tāi-pi̍t tiàu chè-si Sat-tok kap A-pí-a-tha, í-ki̍p Lī-bī -lâng O͘-lia̍t, A-sat-ngá, Iok-ní, Sī-má-ngá, Í-lī-gia̍p, kap A-bí-ná-ta̍t lâi.

Tùi in kóng, “Lín sī Lī-bī -lâng ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, lín kap lín ê chhin-cho̍k tio̍h ka-kī sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú, chiah thang chiong Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi, kng-lâi góa ūi-tio̍h i chún-pī ê só͘-chāi.
In-ūi lín chêng hit-piàn bô kng iok-kūi, lán mā bô chiàu kui-kú kiû-mn̄g I, só͘-í Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè siū-khì kong-kek lán.”
Tùi án-ni chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng ūi-tio̍h beh chiong Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi kng--lâi, chiū ka-kī sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú.
Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ-sun chiàu Siōng Chú hoan-hù Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng, ēng kǹg kng Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi tī keng-thâu téng.
Tāi-pi̍t hoan-hù Lī-bī ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ hun-phài in ê chhin-cho̍k hū-chek chhiùⁿ-koa, ēng khîm, sek, kap poa̍h chàu-ga̍k, tōa-siaⁿ hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa.
Lī-bī -lâng chiū phài Iok-ní ê kiáⁿ Hi-bān, i ê chhin-chiâⁿ Pí-lī-ka ê kiáⁿ A-sat, kap in ê chhin-cho̍k Bí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ-sun tiong Kó͘-sa-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-thàm.

Tē-jī pan ū in ê chhin-cho̍k Sat-ka-lī-a, Ngá-sih, Sī-bí-la-boa̍t, Iâ-hiat, O͘-nî, Í-lī-ap, Pí-ná-ngá, Má-se-ngá, Má-tha-thê-ngá, Í-lī-hui-lī-hō͘, Bî-khek-nî-ngá, í-ki̍p kò͘-mn̂g ê Gô-pia̍t Í-tong kap Iâ-lī.
Án-ni phài chhiùⁿ-koa ê Hi-bān, A-sat, Í-thàm, phah-poa̍h phōaⁿ-chhiùⁿ.
Koh phài Sat-ka-lī-a, Ngá-sih, Sī-bí-la-boa̍t, Iâ-hiat, O͘-nî, Í-lī-ap, Má-se-ngá, Pí-ná-ngá tôaⁿ-sek, tiāu ēng “siàu-lú”.
Koh phài Má-tha-thê-ngá, Í-lī-hui-lī-hō͘, Bî-khek-nî-ngá, Gô-pia̍t Í-tong, Iâ-lī, A-sat-se-ngá ēng khîm chí-hui, tiāu kàng poeh tō͘.
Lī-bī -lâng ê siú-léng Ki-ná-nî-ngá hū-chek im-ga̍k; i cheng-thong im-ga̍k, kà lâng chhiùⁿ-koa.
Pí-lī-ka kap Í-lī-ka-ná sī iok-kūi ê siú-ōe.

Chè-si Sī-pa-nî, Iok-sa-hoat, Ná-thán-gia̍p, A-má-sài, Sat-ka-lī-a, Pí-ná-ngá, Í-lī-í-siā, tī Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi chêng pûn lat-pah. Gô-pia̍t Í-tong kap Iâ-hi-a mā-sī iok-kūi ê siú-ōe.
Tùi án-ni, Tāi-pi̍t kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló, chí-hui-koaⁿ, lóng khì Gô-pia̍t Í-tong ê chhù, hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí chiong Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi tùi hia chiap--lâi.
Siōng-tè pang-chān kng iok-kūi ê Lī-bī -lâng, in chiū hiàn kang ê gû chhit chiah, kang ê iûⁿ chhit chiah.

Tāi-pi̍t kap kng iok-kūi ê Lī-bī -lâng, hū-chek im-ga̍k ê Ki-ná-nî-ngá, í-ki̍p chhiùⁿ-koa ê lâng lóng chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê tn̂g-saⁿ. Tāi-pi̍t koh chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê í-hut-tek.
Án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng hoan-ho͘, pûn sàu-kak, pûn lat-pah, phah-poa̍h, tôaⁿ-khîm, tôaⁿ-sek, kng Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi chiūⁿ--lâi.
Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi ji̍p Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ ê sî, Sò-lô ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Bí-kah tùi thang-á khòaⁿ--chhut-khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t -ông ia̍h-thiàu-ia̍h-tiô, chiū khòaⁿ-khin i.

Chiah-ê Lī-bī -lâng kng Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi ji̍p--khì, hē tī Tāi-pi̍t ūi-tio̍h iok-kūi tah ê pò͘-pîⁿ lāi-bīn, koh tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè.
Tāi-pi̍t hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè liáu-āu, chiū hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ kā jîn-bîn chiok-hok.
I koh pun mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng, bô-lūn lâm-lú, ta̍k-ê lâng chi̍t tè piáⁿ, chi̍t tè bah, chi̍t lia̍p phû-tô-koaⁿ-oân.
Tāi-pi̍t phài kúi-nā ê Lī-bī -lâng tī Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi chêng ho̍k-sāi, lâi khún-kiû, kám-siā, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.

Tūi-tiúⁿ sī A-sat, hù-tūi-tiúⁿ sī Sat-ka-lī-a, koh ū Ngá-sih, Sī-bí-la-boa̍t, Iâ-hiat, Má-tha-thê-ngá, Í-lī-ap, Pí-ná-ngá, Gô-pia̍t Í-tong, Iâ-lī, tôaⁿ-khîm tôaⁿ-sek; A-sat phah-poa̍h phōaⁿ-chàu.
Chè-si Pí-ná-ngá kap Ngá-hap-sek tī Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi chêng chiàu-sî pûn lat-pah.
Hit-ji̍t, Tāi-pi̍t tē-it piàn chí-phài A-sat kap i ê chhin-cho̍k kám-siā Siōng Chú.
Lín tio̍h kám-siā Siōng Chú, kiû-kiò I ê miâ, tī bān-bîn tiong pò-iông I ê chok-ûi.
Tio̍h tùi I gîm-si, ǹg I chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló, tâm-lūn I it-chhè kî-biāu ê só͘-chòe.
Tio̍h khoa-iāu I ê sèng-miâ. Goān chhē-kiû Siōng Chú ê lâng sim-lāi hoaⁿ-hí.
Tio̍h óa-khò Siōng Chú kap I ê koân-lêng, put-sî chhē-kiû kìⁿ I ê bīn.
I ê po̍k-jîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi, I só͘ kéng Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ-sun ah, lín tio̍h siàu-liām I kî-biāu ê chok-ûi, siàu-liām I ê sîn-jiah kap I só͘ kóng phòaⁿ-toàn ê ōe.
I sī Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè; I ê sím-phòaⁿ phó͘-ki̍p choân-tōe.
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit I ê iok ti̍t-kàu éng-oán, I ê èng-ún ti̍t-kàu bān-tāi.
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit I kap A-pek-la-hán li̍p ê iok, tùi Í-sat só͘ li̍p ê sè.
I chiong chit-ê iok hō͘ Ngá-kok chòe kui-lē, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t chòe éng-oán ê iok.
I kóng, “Góa beh chiong Ka-lâm -tōe sù hō͘ lí, chòe lí èng-tit ê sán-gia̍p.”
Tng-sî in ê jîn-kháu iú-hān, jîn-sò͘ chin chió; in tī hia chòe chhut-gōa-lâng.
In tùi chit-cho̍k kiâⁿ kàu hit-cho̍k, tùi chit-kok kàu hit-kok.
I bô iông-ún lâng ap-pek in; ūi-tio̍h in ê iân-kò͘, I khiàn-chek hiah-ê kun-ông.
I kóng, “M̄-thang kha̍p-tio̍h góa kéng-soán ê po̍k-jîn, mā m̄-thang khi-hū góa ê sian-ti.”
Choân-tōe lóng tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ-koa! Tio̍h ji̍t-ji̍t soan-pò͘ I chín-kiù ê hó siau-sit!
Tio̍h tùi bān-kok soan-iông I ê êng-iāu! Tio̍h tùi bān-bîn kóng-khí I úi-tāi ê chok-ûi!
In-ūi Siōng Chú chì-tōa, eng-kai siū ke̍k-tōa ê chheng-chàn; I pí só͘-ū ê sîn-bêng eng-kai koh-khah siū kèng-ùi.
In-ūi gōa-pang ê sîn-bêng put-kò sī ngó͘-siōng; m̄-kú Siōng Chú chhòng-chō chiah-ê thiⁿ.
Chun-kùi kap ui-giâm pau-ûi I; koân-lêng kap hí-lo̍k chhiong-móa I ê só͘-chāi.
Tōe-chiūⁿ bān-bîn lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Tio̍h chiong êng-iāu kap koân-lêng kui hō͘ I!
Tio̍h chiong Siōng Chú èng-tit ê êng-iāu kui hō͘ I! Tio̍h tòa chè-mi̍h lâi kàu I ê bīn-chêng! Tio̍h chhēng sèng-kiat chòe lé-ho̍k kèng-pài Siōng Chú!
Choân-tōe tio̍h tī I bīn-chêng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah! Sè-kài kian-kò͘ bōe tōng-iâu;
thiⁿ tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí, tōe tio̍h khoài-lo̍k! Tio̍h tùi bān-kok soan-pò͘, “Siōng Chú choh-ông!”
Hái kap hit lāi-bīn ê oa̍h-mi̍h lóng tio̍h chhut tōa-siaⁿ! Chhân-hn̂g kap kî-tiong só͘-ū--ê lóng tio̍h khoài-lo̍k!
Hit-sî, chhiū-nâ lāi ê chhiū-ba̍k lóng beh tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa, In-ūi I beh lâi sím-phòaⁿ phó͘-thiⁿ-ē.
Tio̍h kám-siā Siōng Chú, in-ūi I chì-siān; I ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán!

Tio̍h kóng, “Chín-kiù goán ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí chín-kiù goán, chū-chi̍p goán, kiù goán thoat-lī lia̍t-kok, hō͘ goán thang kám-siā lí ê sèng-miâ, ēng chheng-chàn lí chòe goán siōng-tōa ê hoaⁿ-hí.
Goān chheng-chàn kui hō͘ Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, tùi éng-oán kàu éng-oán.” Choân-thé jîn-bîn lóng kóng “Amen!” koh chheng-chàn Siōng Chú.
Tāi-pi̍t lâu A-sat kap i ê chhin-cho̍k tī Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi chêng, chiàu ta̍k-ji̍t eng-kai chòe ê kang-chok, kè-sio̍k tī iok-kūi chêng ho̍k-sāi.
Koh lâu Gô-pia̍t Í-tong kap i ê chhin-cho̍k la̍k-cha̍p-poeh lâng, í-ki̍p Iâ-tō͘-tùn ê kiáⁿ Gô-pia̍t Í-tong kap Hô-sat chòe iok-kūi ê siú-ōe.
Koh lâu chè-si Sat-tok kap i ê chhin-cho̍k chèng chè-si, tī Ki-piàn soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ Siōng Chú ê hōe-bō͘ chêng,
ta̍k-ji̍t chá-àm tī chè-tôaⁿ téng hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, lóng chiàu Siōng Chú bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê lu̍t-hoat só͘-ū ê kì-chài.
Iáu ū Hi-bān, Iâ-tō͘-tùn, kap kî-tha siū soán, miâ ū teng-lio̍k ê lâng, kap in chòe-hé chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, in-ūi I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
Hi-bān, Iâ-tō͘-tùn kap in chòe-hé ēng lat-pah, poa̍h, kap o-ló Siōng-tè ê ga̍k-khì chheng-chàn Siōng Chú; Iâ-tō͘-tùn ê hō͘-tāi chòe siú-ōe.
Āu-lâi, choân-thé jîn-bîn chiū tò-khì in tau; Tāi-pi̍t mā tò--khì, kā i ê ka-cho̍k chiok-hok.
Tāi-pi̍t tòa tī ông-kiong, i tùi sian-ti Ná-tan kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, góa tòa tī pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ ê kiong-tiān, m̄-kú Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi tiàm tī pò͘-pîⁿ.”
Ná-tan tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Lí siūⁿ-beh án-chóaⁿ, chiū thang khì chòe, in-ūi Siōng-tè kap lí tông-chāi.”
Hit-mî Siōng-tè ê ōe lîm-kàu Ná-tan, kóng,
“Lí khì kā Tāi-pi̍t góa ê po̍k-jîn kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lí m̄-thang khí sèng-tiān hō͘ góa tòa.

Tùi góa chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiūⁿ-lâi chia kàu hiān-chāi, góa m̄-bat tòa tī tiān--ni̍h, lóng sī tùi chit-ê pò͘-pîⁿ kàu hit-ê pò͘-pîⁿ, tùi chit-ê hōe-bō͘ kàu hit-ê hōe-bō͘.
Góa kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tâng-kiâⁿ ê sî, kiám bat tùi tó chi̍t ê bo̍k-ióng góa ê chú-bîn ê sū-su kóng: Lín ná bô kā góa khí pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ ê tiān?’

“Taⁿ lí tio̍h kā góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng: Góa tùi bo̍k-tiûⁿ kéng-tiàu lí, hō͘ lí bô koh chhī iûⁿ, sī beh hō͘ lí chòe góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê thóng-tī-chiá.
Lí bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, góa ōe kap lí tông-chāi, siau-bia̍t lí bīn-chêng só͘-ū ê tùi-te̍k. Góa it-tēng hō͘ lí ū miâ-siaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ sè-kan ê úi-jîn hiah-ni̍h chhut-miâ.

Góa beh ūi-tio̍h góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t chún-pī chi̍t ê só͘-chāi, kā in an-tùn, hō͘ in khiā-khí tī ka-kī ê só͘-chāi, bô koh siū kiáu-jiáu, bô koh chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-chêng góa bēng-lēng sū-su koán-lí góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê sî-tāi, siū hiong-ok ê lâng khi-ap. Góa beh hō͘ lí ê tùi-te̍k lóng hâng-ho̍k. Góa koh soan-pò͘, góa Siōng Chú beh kiàn-li̍p lí ê ông-tiâu.
Kàu lí ê hè-siū móa, tńg-khì lí ê chó͘-sian hia ê sî, góa beh soán-li̍p lí ê hō͘-tāi, lí ê chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, lâi sòa-chiap lí, koh beh hō͘ i ê kok ún-kò͘.
I beh ūi-tio̍h góa khí sèng-tiān; góa beh kian-kò͘ i ê ông-ūi ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
Góa beh chòe i ê pē, i beh chòe góa ê kiáⁿ. Góa bô beh hō͘ góa ê chû-ài lī-khui i, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa bat hō͘ chû-ài lī-khui lí chêng hit-ê ông.
Góa mā beh hō͘ i éng-oán tī-lí góa ê chú-bîn kap góa ê kok; i ê ông-ūi ōe kian-kò͘ kàu éng-oán.’”
Ná-tan chiū chiàu Siōng-tè khé-sī ê ōe lóng kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng.

Tāi-pi̍t -ông chiū ji̍p-khì hōe-bō͘, chē tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, kóng, “Chú Siōng-tè, góa sī siáⁿ-lâng, góa ê ke sǹg sím-mi̍h, lí kèng-jiân chhōa góa kàu chit-ê tōe-ūi?
M̄-nā án-ni, Siōng-tè ah, lí koh koàn-kò͘ lí lô͘-po̍k ê ke ê chiong-lâi; Chú Siōng-tè ah, lí khoán-thāi góa chhin-chhiūⁿ chun-kùi ê lâng.
Lí chin chheng-chhó lí ê lô͘-po̍k, lí hō͘ lí ê lô͘-po̍k tit--tio̍h ê chun-kùi, góa Tāi-pi̍t iáu ū sím-mi̍h ōe thang kóng?
Siōng Chú ah, in-ūi lí ê lô͘-po̍k ê iân-kò͘, koh chiàu lí ê chí-ì, lí ū chòe chiah-ê tōa-sū, koh hō͘ lâng chai chiah-ê úi-tāi ê só͘-chòe.
Siōng Chú ah, chiàu goán só͘ thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kap lí pí, lí í-gōa bô Siōng-tè.

Sè-kan kiám ū chi̍t ê kok chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t? Siōng-tè lí ū kiù-sio̍k in, hō͘ in chiâⁿ-chòe lí ê chú-bîn. Lí chòe ke̍k-tōa koh thang-kiaⁿ ê sū, hō͘ lí ka-kī tit-tio̍h êng-iāu, in-ūi lí ū kóaⁿ-tio̍k lia̍t-pang lī-khui lí tùi Ai-ki̍p kái-kiù--chhut-lâi ê chú-bîn.
Lí hō͘ lí ê jîn-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t éng-oán chòe lí ka-kī ê chú-bîn; Siōng Chú ah, lí koh chòe in ê Siōng-tè.
“Siōng Chú, lí tùi lí ê lô͘-po̍k kap i ê ke ê èng-ún, goān lí chiàu lí só͘ kóng--ê si̍t-hiān, hō͘ i éng-oán ún-kò͘.

Goān lí ê miâ éng-oán kian-kò͘, siū chun chòe tōa, kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, chin-chiàⁿ sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè!’ Koh lí ê lô͘-po̍k Tāi-pi̍t ê ke beh tī lí ê bīn-chêng kian-li̍p.
Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, in-ūi lí ū khé-sī lí ê lô͘-po̍k, lí beh kiàn-li̍p i ê ông-tiâu, só͘-í lí ê lô͘-po̍k hó-táⁿ tī lí ê bīn-chêng kî-tó.
“Siōng Chú, chí-ū lí sī Siōng-tè! Lí ēng chit-ê hok-khì èng-ún lí ê lô͘-po̍k.
Taⁿ, lí hoaⁿ-hí sù-hok lí lô͘-po̍k ê ke, hō͘ i tī lí ê bīn-chêng éng-oán ún-kò͘. Siōng Chú, in-ūi lí í-keng sù-hok, lí ōe éng-oán tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn!”
Āu-lâi, Tāi-pi̍t kong-kek Hui-lī-sū -lâng, hō͘ in hâng-ho̍k; koh tùi Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê chhiú chhú-tio̍h Ka-te̍k kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
Tāi-pi̍t koh phah-pāi Mô͘-ap -lâng, Mô͘-ap -lâng chiū kui-sūn Tāi-pi̍t, koh chìn-kòng.
Só-pa -ông Hap-tāi-tí-siā khì Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô, beh kian-kò͘ i ê thóng-tī-koân ê sî, Tāi-pi̍t kong-kek i, ti̍t-kàu Hap-má.

Tāi-pi̍t chhiúⁿ i ê chiàn-chhia chi̍t-chheng tâi, bé-peng chhit-chheng, pō͘-peng nn̄g-bān, koh chām-tn̄g chiàn-chhia ê bé ê kha-kun; chí-ū lâu kàu-gia̍h thang thoa chi̍t-pah tâi chiàn-chhia ê bé.
Tāi-má-sū-kek ê Sū-lī-a -lâng lâi pang-chān Só-pa -ông Hap-tāi-tí-siā, Tāi-pi̍t chiū thâi-sí Sū-lī-a -lâng nn̄g-bān nn̄g-chheng.

Tùi án-ni, Tāi-pi̍t tī Tāi-má-sū-kek ê Sū-lī-a siat-li̍p kun-iâⁿ. Sū-lī-a -lâng chiū kui-sūn Tāi-pi̍t, koh chìn-kòng. Tāi-pi̍t bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, Siōng Chú lóng hō͘ i tek-sèng.
Tāi-pi̍t chiong Hap-tāi-tí-siā ê pō͘-hā só͘ ēng kim ê tún-pâi lóng tòa-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Tāi-pi̍t -ông koh tùi Hap-tāi-tí-siā ê siâⁿ Thê-pa kap Kun, the̍h chin chōe tâng. Āu-lâi, Só͘-lô-bûn ēng chiah-ê chō tâng-hái, tâng-thiāu, kap só͘-ū ê tâng-khì.
Hap-má -ông Tô-í thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t phah-iâⁿ Hap-tāi-tí-siā ê choân-kun,

chiū chhe i ê kiáⁿ Iok-lân tòa kim-khì, gûn-khì, tâng-khì khì kìⁿ Tāi-pi̍t -ông, kā i chhéng-an, chiok-hō i phah-iâⁿ Hap-tāi-tí-siā, in-ūi Hap-tāi-tí-siā kap Tô-í siông-siông kau-chiàn.

Tāi-pi̍t -ông chiū chiong chiah-ê mi̍h, kap í-chêng i thâi-iâⁿ lia̍t-kok só͘ tit--tio̍h ê kim-gûn, chiū-sī tùi Í-tong, Mô͘-ap, A-bûn -lâng, Hui-lī-sū -lâng, A-má-le̍k -lâng tit--tio̍h-ê, lóng sèng-hòa hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ A-pí-su tī Iâm ê Soaⁿ-kok phah-sí Í-tong -lâng chi̍t-bān poeh-chheng.
Tāi-pi̍t tī Í-tong choân-tōe siat kun-iâⁿ; Í-tong -lâng lóng kui-sūn i. Tāi-pi̍t bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, Siōng Chú lóng hō͘ i sèng-lī.
Tāi-pi̍t chòe choân Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông, ēng kong-pêng chèng-gī tī-lí i só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn.
Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap chòe goân-sòe, A-hi-lu̍t ê kiáⁿ Iok-sa-hoat chòe sú-koaⁿ.
A-hi-tu̍t ê kiáⁿ Sat-tok kap A-pí-a-tha ê kiáⁿ A-hi-bí-le̍k chòe chè-si; Se-lâi-ngá chòe su-kì.
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá choh-thâu chí-hui Ki-lī-thê -lâng kap Pí-lī-thê -lâng. Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ lóng chòe ông-sek chham-bô͘.
Āu-lâi, A-bûn -lâng ê ông Ná-hat sí, i ê kiáⁿ Hap-lūn sòa-chiap i choh-ông.

Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa beh hó khoán-thāi Hap-lūn, in-ūi i ê lāu-pē Ná-hat í-chêng hó khoán-thāi góa.” Tāi-pi̍t in-ūi Hap-lūn ê lāu-pē sí, chiū chhe sù-chiá khì kā i ùi-būn. Tāi-pi̍t ê jîn-sîn kàu A-bûn -lâng ê kéng-lāi kìⁿ Hap-lūn, beh ùi-būn i.

M̄-kú A-bûn -lâng ê léng-siù tùi Hap-lūn kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t phài lâng lâi ùi-būn lí, lí siūⁿ-kóng i chin-chiàⁿ chun-kèng lí ê lāu-pē o͘h? I ê pō͘-hā lâi kìⁿ lí, kiám m̄-sī beh siông-sè cheng-thàm chit-ê siâⁿ, khòaⁿ beh án-chóaⁿ kā lán cheng-ho̍k?”
Hap-lūn chiū lia̍h Tāi-pi̍t ê jîn-sîn, kā in ê chhùi-chhiu thì--khí-lâi, koh chián-tn̄g in ê saⁿ ê ē-pòaⁿ-chat, hō͘ in lō͘-chhut hā-thé, jiân-āu kóaⁿ in tò--khì.

Ū lâng chiong chiah-ê lâng só͘ tú--tio̍h-ê tùi Tāi-pi̍t pò-kò, Tāi-pi̍t chiū phài lâng khì chiap in, in-ūi in kám-kak hui-siông kiàn-siàu. Ông kóng, “Lâu tiàm Iâ-lī-ko, thèng-hāu chhùi-chhiu hoat-tn̂g chiah tò--lâi.”

A-bûn -lâng chai in jiá Tāi-pi̍t siū-khì; Hap-lūn kap A-bûn -lâng chiū phài lâng tòa saⁿ-bān sì-chheng kong-kun ê gûn, khì Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a, Sū-lī-a Má-ka, Só-pa, chhiàⁿ chiàn-chhia kap bé-peng.

In chhiàⁿ saⁿ-bān nn̄g-chheng tâi ê chiàn-chhia, í-ki̍p Má-ka -ông kap i ê kun-peng; in chiū lâi chat-iâⁿ tī Bí-tí-pa ê thâu-chêng. A-bûn -lâng mā tùi in ê siâⁿ chhut--lâi, chū-chi̍p beh kau-chiàn.
Tāi-pi̍t thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū phài Iok-ap chhōa só͘-ū ióng-béng ê kun-tūi chhut--khì.
A-bûn -lâng chhut-lâi tī siâⁿ-mn̂g ê thâu-chêng pâi-tīn; kî-tha hiah-ê ông lēng-gōa tī iá-gōa pâi-tīn.

Iok-ap khòaⁿ-kìⁿ i ê chêng-āu lóng ū tùi-te̍k pâi-tīn, chiū tùi Í-sek-lia̍t cheng-peng ê tiong-kan koh-chài kéng chi̍t-kóa ióng-sū chhut--lâi, pâi-tīn beh tí-te̍k Sū-lī-a -lâng.
Iok-ap chiong kî-tha ê peng-sū kau hō͘ i ê sió-tī A-pí-su, in chiū biān-tùi A-bûn -lâng pâi-tīn.
Iok-ap tùi A-pí-su kóng, “ Sū-lī-a -lâng nā pí góa khah kiông, lí tio̍h lâi pang-chān góa; A-bûn -lâng nā pí lí khah kiông, góa ōe khì pang-chān lí.
Tio̍h kian-kiông! Tio̍h ūi lán ê tông-pau kap lán Siōng-tè ê siâⁿ ióng-kám chhut-chiàn. Siōng Chú ōe chiàu I khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê khì chòe.”
Iok-ap chhōa i ê kun-tūi chìn-chêng kap Sū-lī-a -lâng kau-chiàn; Sū-lī-a -lâng chiàn-pāi, chiū tī Iok-ap ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu.
A-bûn -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sū-lī-a -lâng tô-cháu, mā tī Iok-ap ê sió-tī A-pí-su bīn-chêng tô-cháu ji̍p-siâⁿ. Iok-ap chiū tò-tńg-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Sū-lī-a -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h ka-kī thâi-su Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiū phài sù-chiá khì Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hit-pêng tiàu Sū-lī-a ê kun-tūi lâi; Hap-tāi-tí-siā ê chiong-kun Sok-hoat chhōa kun-tūi lâi.
Ū lâng pò-kò Tāi-pi̍t, i chiū tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kun kè Iok-tàn-hô, biān-tùi Sū-lī-a -lâng pâi-tīn. Sū-lī-a -lâng chiū kap Tāi-pi̍t kau-chiàn.
Sū-lī-a -lâng thâi-su Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; Tāi-pi̍t thâi-sí Sū-lī-a ê chiàn-chhia-peng chhit-chheng lâng, pō͘-peng sì-bān, koh thâi-sí Sū-lī-a ê chiong-kun Sok-hoat.
Hap-tāi-tí-siā ê jîn-sîn khòaⁿ-tio̍h in thâi-su Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiū kap Tāi-pi̍t kóng-hô, kui-sūn i. Tùi án-ni, Sū-lī-a -lâng bô koh pang-chān A-bûn -lâng.

Keh-nî chhun-thiⁿ, lia̍t-ông chhut-chiàn ê sî, Iok-ap chhōa kun-peng kong-kek húi-hoāi A-bûn -lâng ê tōe, ûi-kong La-pa -siâⁿ; Tāi-pi̍t lâu tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. Iok-ap kong-chiàm La-pa, kā siâⁿ thiat-tóe phò-hoāi.

Tāi-pi̍t the̍h-tio̍h Bí-le̍k-kong thâu-khak téng ê ông-koan, sī ēng tāi-iok saⁿ-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-kun ê kim chō--ê, koh ū siuⁿ pó-chio̍h. Lâng chiong chit-téng ông-koan tì tī Tāi-pi̍t ê thâu-khak. Tāi-pi̍t tùi siâⁿ-lāi chhú chin chōe châi-bu̍t,

koh kā siâⁿ-lāi ê jîn-bîn lia̍h--chhut-lâi, hō͘ in ēng kù-á, thih-pê-á, kap pó͘-thâu chòe khó͘-kang; Tāi-pi̍t lóng ēng chit-khoán hong-hoat tùi-thāi A-bûn hiah-ê siâⁿ ê lâng. Āu-lâi, Tāi-pi̍t kap só͘-ū ê kun-peng tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Āu-lâi, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Ki-sek kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng kau-chiàn. Hō͘-sa -lâng Se-pí-kai thâi-sí chi̍t ê tōa-hàn-cho̍k ê hō͘-tāi, i ê miâ kiò-chòe Sè-phài; Hui-lī-sū -lâng chiū khut-ho̍k.

In koh kap Hui-lī-sū -lâng kau-chiàn, hit-sî Gâi-ní ê kiáⁿ I-le̍k-hap-lân thâi-sí Ka-te̍k -lâng Ko-lī-a ê hiaⁿ-tī La-hap-bí; chit-ê lâng ê chhiuⁿ-pìⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-pò͘-ki ê chhia-sim hiah chho͘.
In koh tī Ka-te̍k kau-chiàn. Tī hia ū chi̍t ê tōa-hàn-lâng, chhiú kap kha lóng ū la̍k ki chńg-thâu-á, kiōng jī-cha̍p-sì ki, i mā-sī tōa-hàn-cho̍k ê hō͘-tāi.
Chit-ê lâng tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-tūi chhiàng-siaⁿ ê sî, Tāi-pi̍t ê hiaⁿ-ko Sī-bí-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan kā i thâi-sí.
Chiah-ê lâng lóng sī Ka-te̍k tōa-hàn-cho̍k ê hō͘-tāi; lóng hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê kun-peng thâi-sí.
Sat-tàn khí-lâi kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kek-tōng Tāi-pi̍t tiâu-cha Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê jîn-kháu.
Tāi-pi̍t tùi Iok-ap kap kun-tūi ê léng-siù kóng, “Lín tùi Pia̍t-sī-pa kàu Tān tiám-sǹg Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê jîn-kháu, hō͘ góa chai choân-kok jîn-bîn ê sò͘-bo̍k.”

Iok-ap kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú hō͘ I ê chú-bîn pí hiān-chāi cheng-ka pah-pē. Góa ê chú góa ê ông, in kiám m̄-sī góa ê chú ê jîn-bîn? Góa ê chú sī-án-chóaⁿ ài-beh chòe chit-ê tāi-chì? Sī-án-chóaⁿ beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t hām-lo̍h chōe?”
Ông kian-chhî i ê bēng-lēng. Iok-ap chiū kiâⁿ-thàu Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kok tiâu-cha, āu-lâi tò-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Iok-ap chiong tiám-sǹg ê jîn-sò͘ pò-kò Tāi-pi̍t. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng gia̍h-to ê chiàn-sū ū chi̍t-pah-cha̍p-bān, Iû-tāi -lâng ū sì-cha̍p-chhit-bān.
M̄-kú Iok-ap bô tiám-sǹg Lī-bī chi-cho̍k kap Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k ê jîn-sò͘, in-ūi i iàm-ò͘ⁿ ông chit-ê bēng-lēng.
Tāi-pi̍t chòe ê chit-hāng tāi-chì Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ, chiū hêng-hoa̍t Í-sek-lia̍t.
Tāi-pi̍t tùi Siōng-tè kóng, “Góa chòe chit-ê tāi-chì hoān chin tōa ê chōe. Kiû lí tû-khì lí lô͘-po̍k ê chōe, in-ūi góa án-ni chòe chin gōng.”
Siōng Chú hoan-hù Tāi-pi̍t ê sian-kiàn Ka-tek, kóng,
“Lí khì kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa ēng saⁿ hāng chai-hō hō͘ lí kéng chi̍t hāng, góa chiū chiàu án-ni chòe.’”
Ka-tek lâi kā Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lí ka-kī kéng:

Saⁿ nî ê ki-hng; á-sī thâi-su tùi-te̍k, hō͘ tùi-te̍k tui-sat saⁿ kò-ge̍h; á-sī saⁿ ji̍t kú hō͘ Siōng Chú ēng I ê kiàm, chiū-sī un-e̍k, kàng-lîm tī Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kok, si-hêng húi-bia̍t.’ Taⁿ lí tio̍h siūⁿ, hō͘ góa thang hôe-ho̍k chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi.”
Tāi-pi̍t kā Ka-tek kóng, “Góa chin ûi-lân; góa lêng-khó hō͘ Siōng Chú ka-kī kā góa hêng-hoa̍t, in-ūi I ū hong-sēng ê lîn-bín; góa m̄-goān hām-lo̍h tī lâng ê chhiú.”
Siōng Chú chiū kàng un-e̍k tī Í-sek-lia̍t; Í-sek-lia̍t sí chhit-bān lâng.

Siōng-tè chhe chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng beh kā i húi-bia̍t. Tng thiⁿ-sài beh húi-bia̍t ê sî, Siōng Chú khòaⁿ--kìⁿ chiū kái-piàn sim-ì, bô beh kè-sio̍k kàng chit-ê chai-hō, chiū kā teh chip-hêng húi-bia̍t ê thiⁿ-sài kóng, “Thêng-chhiú! Kàu-gia̍h lah!” Hit-sî, Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá khiā tī Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng A-lô-ná ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ.

Tāi-pi̍t gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá khiā tī pòaⁿ-khong-tiong, chhiú gia̍h pu̍ih-chhut ê kiàm, chí ǹg Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. Tāi-pi̍t kap tiúⁿ-ló lóng chhēng môa-saⁿ, bīn phak tī thô͘-kha.

Tāi-pi̍t tùi Siōng-tè kóng, “Hā-lēng tiâu-cha hō͘-kháu--ê kiám m̄-sī góa? Hoān-chōe chòe chit-ê pháiⁿ tāi-chì--ê sī góa, chiah-ê bû-ko͘ ê jîn-bîn lóng bô chòe sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h. Kiû Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ê chhiú hêng-hoa̍t góa kap góa ê ka-cho̍k, m̄-thang kàng un-e̍k kong-kek lí ê chú-bîn.”
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá hoan-hù Ka-tek, kiò Tāi-pi̍t chiūⁿ-khì Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng A-lô-ná ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ, tī hia ūi Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ.
Tāi-pi̍t chiū chiàu Ka-tek hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ só͘ kóng ê ōe chiūⁿ--khì.
Hit-sî A-lô-ná teh phah-be̍h, oa̍t-thâu khòaⁿ-kìⁿ thiⁿ-sài; kap i chòe-hé tī hia ê sì ê kiáⁿ cháu-khì bih.
Tāi-pi̍t khì kàu A-lô-ná hia; A-lô-ná khòaⁿ-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t, chiū tùi ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ chhut-lâi gêng-chiap, phak tī thô͘-kha pài Tāi-pi̍t.

Tāi-pi̍t tùi A-lô-ná kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí chiong chit-ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ bōe góa, hō͘ góa thang tī chia ūi Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, hō͘ choân-kok ê un-e̍k thêng-chí. Góa ōe ēng choân-gia̍h ê kè-chîⁿ kā lí bóe.”

A-lô-ná tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Góa ê chú góa ê ông, chhiáⁿ lí the̍h-khì ēng, chiàu lí khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê khì chòe. Góa ēng gû hō͘ lí chòe sio-hòa-chè, ēng phah ngó͘-kok ê khì-khū chòe chhâ sio, be̍h-á chòe sò͘-chè; chiah-ê góa lóng sàng hō͘ ông.”

Tāi-pi̍t -ông tùi A-lô-ná kóng, “M̄-thang, góa it-tēng beh ēng choân-gia̍h ê kè-chîⁿ kā lí bóe. Góa bōe-ēng-tit the̍h lí ê mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, ēng pe̍h-pe̍h tit--tio̍h ê mi̍h hiàn chòe sio-hòa-chè.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiū ēng la̍k-chheng poeh-pah kong-khek ê n̂g-kim kā A-lô-ná bóe hit-tè tōe.

Tāi-pi̍t tī hia ūi Siōng Chú khí chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ, hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè, koh kiû-kiò Siōng Chú. Siōng Chú thiaⁿ i ê kî-tó, tùi thiⁿ kàng-hé sio chè-tôaⁿ ê chè-mi̍h.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng hit-ê sù-chiá, i chiū chiong kiàm siu--khí-lâi.
Tāi-pi̍t khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú ū tī Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng A-lô-ná ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ thiaⁿ i ê kî-tó, chiū tī hia hiàn-chè.
Mô͘-se tī khòng-iá só͘ chō Siōng Chú ê hōe-bō͘ kap sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ, hit-ê sî-chūn lóng tī Ki-piàn ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ.
M̄-kú Tāi-pi̍t m̄-káⁿ khì Ki-piàn kiû-mn̄g Siōng-tè, in-ūi kiaⁿ Siōng Chú sù-chiá ê kiàm.
Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Chú Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān beh khí tī chia; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng beh tī chia hiàn sio-hòa-chè.”
Tāi-pi̍t hā-lēng tiàu-chi̍p tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe ê gōa-kok-lâng, koh phài in ê phah-chio̍h sai-hū khì phah-chio̍h, ūi-tio̍h beh khí Siōng-tè ê tiān.
Tāi-pi̍t chún-pī chin chōe thih, chòe mn̂g-sìⁿ ê thih-teng kap mn̂g-liú; koh chún-pī chōe kah bōe-chhìn--tit ê tâng.
I mā ū sǹg bōe liáu ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ, in-ūi Se-tùn -lâng kap Thài-ní -lâng chài chin chōe pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t.

Tāi-pi̍t siūⁿ, “Góa ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn iáu siàu-liân bô keng-giām; Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān tio̍h khí chin tông-hông, hō͘ i ê miâ-siaⁿ êng-iāu thàu kàu bān-kok. Só͘-í, góa beh ūi-tio̍h chit-ê tiān chún-pī.” Tāi-pi̍t chiū tī iáu-bē sí í-chêng chún-pī chin chōe châi-liāu.
Tāi-pi̍t kiò i ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn lâi, kau-tài i tio̍h ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè khí sèng-tiān.
Tāi-pi̍t kā Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ, góa pún-lâi siūⁿ-beh ūi Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ê miâ khí sèng-tiān,

m̄-kú Siōng Chú kā góa kóng, ‘Lí put-sî kau-chiàn, thâi-sí chin chōe lâng, lâu chin chōe lâng ê huih; lí m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h góa ê miâ khí sèng-tiān, in-ūi góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí lâu chin chōe lâng ê huih tī tōe--ni̍h.

M̄-kú, lí ōe siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, góa beh hō͘ i it-seng thài-pêng, bô siū sì-ûi tùi-te̍k chhim-hoān. I ê miâ beh kiò-chòe Só͘-lô-bûn; tī i thóng-tī ê sî, góa beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t kok-thài-bîn-an.
I beh ūi-tio̍h góa ê miâ khí sèng-tiān. I beh chòe góa ê kiáⁿ, góa beh chòe i ê pē. Góa beh kian-li̍p i ê kok-koân, hō͘ i éng-oán thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t.’”
Tāi-pi̍t koh kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ, goān Siōng Chú kap lí tông-chāi, hō͘ lí sūn-lī heng-thong, chiàu I kā lí èng-ún--ê, khí Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān.
Goān Siōng Chú sù lí chhong-bêng tì-hūi, chun-thàn Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ê lu̍t-hoat lâi tī-lí Í-sek-lia̍t.
Lí nā kín-sīn chun-thàn Siōng Chú thong-kè Mô͘-se kà-sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng, chiū ōe heng-thong; lí tio̍h kian-kiông ióng-kám, m̄-thang kiaⁿ, m̄-thang lún.

Góa sin-sin-khó͘-khó͘ ūi Siōng Chú ê tiān chún-pī kim saⁿ-chheng sì-pah kong-tùn, gûn saⁿ-bān sì-chheng kong-tùn, chōe kah bōe-chhìn--tit ê tâng kap thih, koh ū chio̍h kap bo̍k-châi; chiah-ê í-gōa lí thang koh ke-thiⁿ.

Lí mā ū chin chōe sai-hū: Phah-chio̍h--ê, thô͘-chúi--ê, choh-ba̍k--ê, í-ki̍p chin chōe gâu ēng kim, gûn, tâng, thih chòe ta̍k-khoán kang-gē ê sai-hū. Lí tio̍h khí-lâi khai-sí chòe kang. Goān Siōng Chú kap lí tông-chāi!”
Tāi-pi̍t koh bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t só͘-ū ê koaⁿ-oân pang-chān i ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn, kóng,

“Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kiám bô kap lín tông-chāi? Kiám bô hō͘ lín kok-kéng pêng-an? Siōng Chú í-keng chiong chit-ê tōe ê chū-bîn kau hō͘ góa tī-lí, chit-ê tōe kap chū-bîn mā kui-sūn Siōng Chú kap I ê chú-bîn.

Taⁿ lín tio̍h choân-sim choân-chêng chhē-kiû Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, koh tio̍h khí-lâi khí-chō Chú Siōng-tè ê sèng-só͘, thang chiong Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi kap Siōng-tè sèng ê khì-khū, poaⁿ-ji̍p hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ beh khí-chō ê sèng-tiān.”
Tāi-pi̍t nî-lāu, hè-siū chiok, chiū siat-li̍p i ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông.
Tāi-pi̍t tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t ê chèng léng-siù, chè-si, kap Lī-bī -lâng.
Lī-bī -lâng saⁿ-cha̍p hè í-siōng ê ta-po͘-lâng, chóng-kiōng ū saⁿ-bān poeh-chheng.
Tāi-pi̍t hun-phòe kî-tiong nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng koán-lí Siōng Chú ê tiān ê sū-bū, la̍k-chheng lâng chòe koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kap su-hoat jîn-oân,
sì-chheng lâng chòe sèng-tiān mn̂g-kháu ê siú-ōe, koh sì-chheng lâng ēng Tāi-pi̍t só͘ chòe ê ga̍k-khì chheng-chàn Siōng Chú.
Tāi-pi̍t chiong Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ, Kek-sūn, Ko-hat, kap Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi hun-phòe pan-chhù.
Kek-sūn ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ: La-tān kap Sī-múi.
La-tān ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Tōa--ê sī Iâ-hiat, koh ū Se-thán kap Iok-ní.
In lóng chòe La-tān ka-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ. Sī-múi ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Sī-lô-bi̍t, Hap-sih, kap Hap-lân.
Sī-múi ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Ngá-hap, Sè-sat, Iâ-o͘-si, Pí-lī-a.
Ngá-hap sī tōa-kiáⁿ, tē-jī--ê sī Sè-sat; Iâ-o͘-si kap Pí-lī-a ê kiáⁿ-sun bô jōa-chōe, só͘-í sǹg-chòe chi̍t cho̍k.
Ko-hat ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Àm-lân, Í-su-hap, Hi-pek-lûn, kap O͘-siat.

Àm-lân ê kiáⁿ ū A-lûn kap Mô͘-se. A-lûn kap i ê hō͘-tāi siū soán-phài lâi sèng-hòa chì-sèng ê mi̍h, thang éng-oán tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng sio-hiuⁿ, ho̍k-sāi, hōng I ê miâ chiok-hok.
Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng Mô͘-se, i ê hō͘-tāi sio̍k Lī-bī chi-cho̍k.
Mô͘-se ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ: Kek-sūn kap Í-lī-í-siā.
Kek-sūn ê hō͘-tāi Sè-pò͘-gia̍p sī léng-siù.
Í-lī-í-siā chí-ū chi̍t ê kiáⁿ Lī-hap-pí-ngá, m̄-kú Lī-hap-pí-ngá ê hō͘-tāi chin chōe.
Í-su-hap ê kiáⁿ, tōa--ê sī Sī-lô-bi̍t.
Hi-pek-lûn ê kiáⁿ, tōa--ê sī Iâ-lī-ngá, tē-jī--ê sī A-má-lī-ngá, tē-saⁿ--ê sī Ngá-hap-sek, tē-sì--ê sī Iâ-ka-biān.
O͘-siat ê kiáⁿ, tōa--ê sī Bí-ka, tē-jī--ê sī I-sī-ngá.
Bí-la-lī ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ: Boat-lī kap Bō͘-sī; Boat-lī ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ: Í-lī-a-sat kap Ki-sū.
Í-lī-a-sat sí, bô kiáⁿ, chí-ū cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, i ê hiaⁿ-tī Ki-sū hiah-ê kiáⁿ chhōa in.
Bō͘-sī ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Boat-lī, Í-tek, kap Iâ-lī-mô͘.

Téng-bīn chiah-ê lâng chiàu in ê ka-cho̍k lóng sī Lī-bī ê hō͘-tāi; ta̍k-ê lâng chiàu in ê miâ teng-lio̍k chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ; jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng ê lâng tī Siōng Chú ê tiān chham-ú ho̍k-sāi ê kang-chok.
Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè í-keng hō͘ I ê chú-bîn an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p, koh I mā éng-oán tiàm tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Lī-bī -lâng m̄-bián koh kng hōe-bō͘ kap ho̍k-sāi ēng ê khì-khū.”
Chiàu Tāi-pi̍t chòe-āu ê hoan-hù, Lī-bī -lâng jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng lóng tio̍h teng-kì.

In ê chit-bū sī chòe A-lûn hō͘-tāi ê chō͘-chhiú, tī Siōng Chú ê tiān ho̍k-sāi, koán-lí chiah-ê tiâⁿ kap pâng-keng, chheng-kiat chiah-ê sèng ê khì-khū, lâi chòe Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê sū-bū,
koán-lí hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ, sò͘-chè ê mī-hún, bô-kàⁿ ê po̍h-piáⁿ, í-ki̍p ēng chian-pôaⁿ chian--ê kap ēng iû tiâu-hô ê mi̍h; koh koán-lí chè-mi̍h ê sò͘-liōng kap tōa-sòe.
In ta̍k-ji̍t chá àm lóng tio̍h kám-siā chheng-chàn Siōng Chú.
Koh tī An-hioh-ji̍t, ta̍k kò-ge̍h ê chhoe-it, kap choeh-kî, chiàu chè-mi̍h ê sò͘-liōng, kui-lē, hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Koh kau-tài in kò͘-siú hōe-bō͘ kap sèng-só͘; hia̍p-chō͘ in ê chhin-chiâⁿ A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi koán-lí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê sū-bū.
A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi pun-chòe kúi-nā ê pan-chhù. A-lûn ū sì ê kiáⁿ: Ná-tap, A-pí-hō͘, Í-lī-a-sat, Í-tha-má.
Ná-tap kap A-pí-hō͘ pí in lāu-pē khah chá sí, koh bô kiáⁿ; só͘-í Í-lī-a-sat, Í-tha-má tam-jīm chè-si.
Tāi-pi̍t kap Í-lī-a-sat ê hō͘-tāi Sat-tok, í-ki̍p Í-tha-má ê hō͘-tāi A-hi-bí-le̍k, chiàu chè-si ê jīm-bū kā in ê chhin-cho̍k pun pan-chhù.

Í-lī-a-sat ê hō͘-tāi chòe léng-siù--ê, pí Í-tha-má ê hō͘-tāi chòe léng-siù--ê khah chōe; Í-lī-a-sat ê hō͘-tāi chiū pun-chòe cha̍p-la̍k pan, Í-tha-má ê hō͘-tāi pun-chòe poeh pan.
In lóng chiàu thiu-chhiam kong-pêng hun-phài; Í-lī-a-sat ê hō͘-tāi kap Í-tha-má ê hō͘-tāi, lóng ū lâng tī sèng-só͘ kap Siōng-tè bīn-chêng chòe léng-tō-chiá.

Í-lī-a-sat kap Í-tha-má ê kiáⁿ-sun lûn-liû thiu-chhiam. Lī-bī -lâng Ná-thán-gia̍p ê kiáⁿ Sī-má-ngá chòe su-kì, tī ông kap hiah-ê siú-léng, chè-si Sat-tok, A-pí-a-tha ê kiáⁿ A-hi-bí-le̍k, í-ki̍p chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ bīn-chêng, teng-lio̍k hiah-ê léng-tō-chiá ê miâ.
Thiu-tio̍h tē-it--ê, sī Iâ-hô-ngá-li̍p, tē-jī Iâ-tāi-ngá,
tē-saⁿ Hap-lîm, tē-sì So-lîm,
tē-gō͘ Má-ki-ngá, tē-la̍k Bí-ngá-bîn,
tē-chhit Hap-ko-su, tē-poeh A-pí-ngá,
tē-káu Iâ-su-a, tē-cha̍p Sī-ka-nî,
tē-cha̍p-it Í-lī-a-si̍t, tē-cha̍p-jī Ngá-kim,
tē-cha̍p-saⁿ Ô͘-pa, tē-cha̍p-sì Iâ-sī-pí-ap,
tē-cha̍p-gō͘ Phek-ka, tē-cha̍p-la̍k Im-be̍k,
tē-cha̍p-chhit Hi-sek, tē-cha̍p-poeh Hap-pi̍t-sek,
tē-cha̍p-káu Pí-tha-hi-ngá, tē-jī-cha̍p Í-se-kiat,
tē-jī-cha̍p-it Ngá-kun, tē-jī-cha̍p-jī Ka-boa̍t,
tē-jī-cha̍p-saⁿ Tē-lâi-ngá, tē-jī-cha̍p-sì Má-se-a.

Chiah-ê lâng lóng chiàu in tī Siōng Chú ê tiān chip-hêng ê chit-bū teng-lio̍k; chiah-ê chit-bū sī in ê chó͘-sian A-lûn chiàu Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè hoan-hù ê kui-lē chè-tēng--ê.
Lī-bī kî-tha ê hō͘-tāi kì tī ē-bīn: Àm-lân ê hō͘-tāi ū Sè-pò͘-gia̍p, Sè-pò͘-gia̍p ê hō͘-tāi ū Iâ-hi-tí-a.
Lī-hap-pí-ngá ê kiáⁿ-sun tiong, I-sī-ngá chòe thâu.
Í-su-hap ê hō͘-tāi ū Sī-lô-mô͘; Sī-lô-mô͘ ê hō͘-tāi ū Ngá-hap.
Hi-pek-lûn ê kiáⁿ, tōa--ê sī Iâ-lī-ngá, tē-jī--ê sī A-má-lī-ngá, tē-saⁿ--ê sī Ngá-hap-sek, tē-sì--ê sī Iâ-ka-biān.
O͘-siat ê hō͘-tāi ū Bí-ka; Bí-ka ê hō͘-tāi ū Sa-bi̍t.
Bí-ka ê hiaⁿ-tī sī I-sī-ngá; I-sī-ngá ê hō͘-tāi ū Sat-ka-lī-a.
Bí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ sī Boat-lī kap Bō͘-sī; Ngá-se-ngá ê kiáⁿ ū Pí-ná.
Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi Ngá-se-ngá ê kiáⁿ-sun ū Pí-ná, Sok-hâm, Sat-khek, kap I-pí-lī.
Boat-lī ê kiáⁿ sī Í-lī-a-sat kap Ki-sū; Í-lī-a-sat bô kiáⁿ,
Ki-sū ê hō͘-tāi ū Iâ-la-bia̍t.
Bō͘-sī ū saⁿ ê kiáⁿ: Boat-lī, Í-tek, kap Iâ-lī-mô͘. Chiah-ê sī Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ-sun, chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k teng-lio̍k.

In kap in ê chhin-cho̍k A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi siâng-khoán, bô-lūn cho̍k-tiúⁿ á-sī siàu-liân-lâng lóng pîⁿ-pîⁿ tī Tāi-pi̍t -ông kap Sat-tok, A-hi-bí-le̍k, chè-si, í-ki̍p Lī-bī -lâng ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ bīn-chêng thiu-chhiam.

Tāi-pi̍t kap ho̍k-sāi thoân-tūi ê léng-siù tùi A-sat, Hi-bān, kap Iâ-tō͘-tùn ê hō͘-tāi hun-phài lâng chhiùⁿ Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit, ēng khîm, sek, kap nâ-poa̍h phōaⁿ-chàu. Chiàu sū-hōng ê chit-hūn, in ê miâ kap jîn-sò͘ kì tī ē-bīn:
A-sat ê sì ê kiáⁿ, Sat-khek, Iok-sek, Nî-thàm-ngá, kap A-sat-lī-la, siū A-sat chí-hui, chiàu ông ê chí-sī chhiùⁿ Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit.

Iâ-tō͘-tùn ê la̍k ê kiáⁿ, Ki-tāi-lī, Se-lī, Í-sài-a, Hap-sa-pí-ngá, Má-tha-thê-ngá, kap Sī-múi, siū in lāu-pē Iâ-tō͘-tùn chí-hui, tôaⁿ-khîm, chhiùⁿ Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit, kám-siā chheng-chàn Siōng Chú.

Hi-bān ê kiáⁿ ū Pò͘-ki-ngá, Má-tha-nî, O͘-siat, Sè-pò͘-gia̍p, Iâ-lī-mô͘, Hap-ná-nî-ngá, Hap-ná-nî, Í-lī-a-tha, Ki-tāi-lī-thê, Lô-bān-thê Í-siā, Iok-si-pí-ka-sa, Má-lô-thê, Hô-thê, kap Má-hap-siù;
in lóng sī Hi-bān ê kiáⁿ. Hi-bān tùi Siōng-tè ê èng-ún tit-tio̍h ko-kú, chòe ông ê sian-kiàn. Siōng-tè sù i cha̍p-sì ê kiáⁿ, saⁿ ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
In lóng siū in lāu-pē chí-tō, chiàu ông ê chí-sī, tī Siōng Chú ê tiān chhiùⁿ-koa, phah nâ-poa̍h, tôaⁿ-khîm, tôaⁿ-sek, ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè. A-sat, Iâ-tō͘-tùn, kap Hi-bān,
in kap in ê chhin-cho̍k siū kè hùn-liān, chin gâu siōng-chàn Siōng Chú ê, lóng-chóng ū nn̄g-pah poeh-cha̍p-poeh lâng.
In bô-lūn lāu á-sī siàu-liân, lāu-su á-sī ha̍k-seng, lóng pîⁿ-pîⁿ thiu-chhiam hun-phòe chit-bū.
Thiu-tio̍h thâu-ki chhiam--ê, sī A-sat ê kiáⁿ Iok-sek; tē-jī sī Ki-tāi-lī, i kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī kap i ê kiáⁿ, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-saⁿ sī Sat-khek, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-sì sī Se-lī, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-gō͘ sī Nî-thàm-ngá, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-la̍k sī Pò͘-ki-ngá, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-chhit sī A-sat-lī-la, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-poeh sī Í-sài-a, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-káu sī Má-tha-nî, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-cha̍p sī Sī-múi, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-cha̍p-it sī O͘-siat, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-cha̍p-jī sī Hap-sa-pí-ngá, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-cha̍p-saⁿ sī Sè-pò͘-gia̍p, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-cha̍p-sì sī Má-tha-thê-ngá, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-cha̍p-gō͘ sī Iâ-lī-mô͘, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-cha̍p-la̍k sī Hap-ná-nî-ngá, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-cha̍p-chhit sī Iok-si-pí-ka-sa, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-cha̍p-poeh sī Hap-ná-nî, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-cha̍p-káu sī Má-lô-thê, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-jī-cha̍p sī Í-lī-a-tha, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-jī-cha̍p-it sī Hô-thê, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-jī-cha̍p-jī sī Ki-tāi-lī-thê, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-jī-cha̍p-saⁿ sī Má-hap-siù, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng;
tē-jī-cha̍p-sì sī Lô-bān-thê Í-siā, i kap i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiōng cha̍p-jī lâng.
Kò͘-mn̂g ê pan-chhù kì tī ē-bīn: Khó-la -cho̍k A-sat ê kiáⁿ-sun tiong, ū Khó-lī ê kiáⁿ Bí-si-lī-bí-ngá.
Bí-si-lī-bí-ngá ū chhit ê kiáⁿ, tōa--ê sī Sat-ka-lī-a, tē-jī Iâ-thia̍p, tē-saⁿ Se-pa-tē-ngá, tē-sì Iâ-thê-lia̍p,
tē-gō͘ Í-lân, tē-la̍k Iok-hap-lân, tē-chhit Í-lī-iok-nái.
Gô-pia̍t Í-tong ū poeh ê kiáⁿ, tōa--ê sī Sī-má-ngá, tē-jī Iok-sat-poa̍t, tē-saⁿ Iok-a, tē-sì Sa-kah, tē-gō͘ Ná-thán-gia̍p,
tē-la̍k A-bí-lī, tē-chhit Í-sat-ka, tē-poeh Pí-o͘-lī-thài; Siōng-tè sù-hok Gô-pia̍t Í-tong.
I ê kiáⁿ Sī-má-ngá mā ū siⁿ kúi-nā ê kiáⁿ, lóng chin ū châi-lêng, koán-lí in lāu-pē ê ke.
Sī-má-ngá ū la̍k ê kiáⁿ: Gô-tek-nî, Lī-hoat-ek, Gô-pī-tek, Í-lī-sat-pa; Í-lī-sat-pa ū hiaⁿ-tī Í-lī-hō͘ kap Se-má-ka, lóng chin ū châi-lêng.
Chiah-ê sī Gô-pia̍t Í-tong ê hō͘-tāi, in kap in ê kiáⁿ in ê hiaⁿ-tī, lóng chin ū châi-lêng, gâu pān tāi-chì, Gô-pia̍t Í-tong ê kiáⁿ-sun kiōng la̍k-cha̍p-jī lâng.
Bí-si-lī-bí-ngá ê kiáⁿ kap hiaⁿ-tī lóng chin ū châi-lêng, kiōng cha̍p-poeh lâng.
Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi Hô-sat ū kúi-nā ê kiáⁿ, chòe thâu--ê sī Sin-lī, i sui-jiân m̄-sī tōa-kiáⁿ, m̄-kú in lāu-pē siat-li̍p i chòe thâu;
tē-jī Hi-le̍k-ka, tē-saⁿ Tí-pa-lī-ngá, tē-sì Sat-ka-lī-a; án-ni Hô-sat ê kiáⁿ kap hiaⁿ-tī kiōng cha̍p-saⁿ lâng.
Chiah-ê sī sèng-tiān siú-ōe ê pan-chhù, chiàu in ê pan-tiúⁿ hun-phài, kap in ê hiaⁿ-tī chòe-hé tī Siōng Chú ê tiān ho̍k-sāi.
In bô-lūn lāu á-sī siàu-liân, lóng chiàu in ê chong-cho̍k thiu-chhiam, kò͘-siú ta̍k-ê mn̂g.
Thiu-tio̍h kò͘-siú tang-mn̂g--ê sī Sī-lī-bí-ngá; i ê kiáⁿ Sat-ka-lī-a sī chin ū châi-lêng ê kò͘-būn, lâng kā i thiu-tio̍h kò͘-siú pak-mn̂g.
Gô-pia̍t Í-tong siú lâm-mn̂g; i ê kiáⁿ siú chhng-khò͘.
Su-pêng kap Hô-sat kò͘-siú sai-mn̂g kap tī chiūⁿ-kiā ê lō͘ ê Sa-lī-ki-mn̂g. Siú-ōe kap siú-ōe sio-tùi.
Tang-mn̂g ū la̍k ê Lī-bī -lâng, pak-mn̂g ta̍k-ji̍t ū sì ê lâng, lâm-mn̂g ta̍k-ji̍t ū sì ê lâng, chhng-khò͘ ū nn̄g-ê nn̄g-ê lûn-pan.
Sai-pêng cháu-lông ū sì ê lâng tī tōa-lō͘, nn̄g ê tī cháu-lông.
Chiah-ê sī Khó-la hō͘-tāi kap Bí-la-lī hō͘-tāi siú-ōe ê pan-chhù.
Lī-bī -lâng ê tiong-kan, A-hi-ngá koán-lí Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê hú-khò͘, kap sèng ê khì-khū ê hú-khò͘.
La-tān ê hō͘-tāi: Kek-sūn -cho̍k sio̍k La-tān chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ--ê ū Iâ-hi-i-lī.
Iâ-hi-i-lī ê kiáⁿ Se-thán kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī Iok-ní, koán-lí Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ê hú-khò͘.
Àm-lân ka-cho̍k, Í-su-hap ka-cho̍k, Hi-pek-lûn ka-cho̍k, O͘-siat ka-cho̍k ê lâng mā ū chit-bū.
Koh ū Mô͘-se ê kiáⁿ Kek-sūn ê hō͘-tāi Sè-pò͘-gia̍p koán-lí hú-khò͘.

Iáu ū i ê chhin-cho̍k Í-lī-í-siā: Í-lī-í-siā ê kiáⁿ Lī-hap-pí-ngá, Lī-hap-pí-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-sài-a, Í-sài-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-lân, Iok-lân ê kiáⁿ Sè-ki-lī, Sè-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Sī-lô-bi̍t.
Sī-lô-bi̍t kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī koán-lí hú-khò͘ lāi sèng ê khì-khū, chiū-sī Tāi-pi̍t -ông, ta̍k-ê chong-cho̍k ê léng-siù, kap kun-tūi ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ só͘ hiàn--ê.
In chiong chiàn-lī-phín sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú, ēng chòe siu-chéng Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê lō͘-ēng.

Sian-kiàn Sat-bó-ní, Ki-sū ê kiáⁿ Sò-lô, Nî-ní ê kiáⁿ Ap-nî-ní, Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap só͘ hiàn ê mi̍h, só͘-ū sèng-hòa hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè ê mi̍h, lóng kui Sī-lô-bi̍t kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī koán-lí.
Í-su-hap ka-cho̍k ū Ki-ná-nî-ngá kap i ê kiáⁿ-jî chòe koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kap sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, koán-lí Í-sek-lia̍t sèng-tiān í-gōa ê tāi-chì.

Hi-pek-lûn ka-cho̍k ū Hap-sa-pí-ngá kap i ê chhin-cho̍k, chi̍t-chheng chhit-pah lâng, lóng chin ū châi-lêng, tī Iok-tàn-hô sai-pêng kàm-tok Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pān-lí ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú kap ông ê sū.

Hi-pek-lûn ka-cho̍k chiàu in ê cho̍k-phó͘, Iâ-lī-ngá chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ. Tāi-pi̍t choh-ông tē-sì-cha̍p nî, tiâu-cha Hi-pek-lûn ka-cho̍k, hoat-kiàn kúi-nā ê ū châi-lêng ê lâng tòa tī Ki-lia̍t ê Ngá-siā.

Iâ-lī-ngá ê chhin-cho̍k ū nn̄g-chheng chhit-pah lâng, in chin ū châi-lêng, chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ; Tāi-pi̍t -ông phài in tī Lū-piān, Ka-tek, Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k ê tiong-kan, pān-lí Siōng-tè kap ông só͘-ū ê sū.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, chhōa chi̍t-chheng lâng ê kun-koaⁿ, chhōa chi̍t-pah lâng ê kun-koaⁿ, í-ki̍p koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, lóng chiàu pan-chhù hun-phòe; ta̍k-pan nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng, choân-nî chiàu ge̍h lûn-pan ho̍k-sāi ông.
Chiaⁿ--ge̍h, tē-it pan, pan-tiúⁿ sī Sat-pa-tē-gia̍p ê kiáⁿ Ngá-sok-pan; i ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng;
i sī Hoat-le̍k-su ê hō͘-tāi, chí-hui chiaⁿ--ge̍h só͘-ū ê kun-koaⁿ.
Jī--ge̍h, tē-jī pan, pan-tiúⁿ sī A-hô-a -lâng Tó-tāi, chham-bô͘-tiúⁿ sī Bí-ki-lô; Tó-tāi ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.
Saⁿ--ge̍h, tē-saⁿ pan, chí-hui-koaⁿ sī chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Pí-ná-ngá; i ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.
Pí-ná-ngá sī hit saⁿ-cha̍p ê ióng-sū tiong ê chi̍t ê, koán-lí hit saⁿ-cha̍p lâng; i ê pan-lāi koh ū i ê kiáⁿ Àm-bí-sat-poa̍t.
Sì--ge̍h, tē-sì pan, pan-tiúⁿ sī Iok-ap ê sió-tī A-sat-hek; sòa-chiap i--ê sī i ê kiáⁿ Se-pa-tē-ngá; i ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.
Gō͘--ge̍h, tē-gō͘ pan, pan-tiúⁿ sī I-su-la -lâng San-ha̍p; i ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.
La̍k--ge̍h, tē-la̍k pan, pan-tiúⁿ sī Thê-ko-a -lâng Ek-kiat ê kiáⁿ Í-la; i ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.
Chhit--ge̍h, tē-chhit pan, pan-tiúⁿ sī Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k Pí-lûn -lâng Hi-lī-su; i ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.
Poeh--ge̍h, tē-poeh pan, pan-tiúⁿ sī Siā-la chong-cho̍k Hō͘-sa -lâng Se-pí-kai; i ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.
Káu--ge̍h, tē-káu pan, pan-tiúⁿ sī Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k A-ná-tu̍t -lâng A-pí-í-siā; i ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.
Cha̍p--ge̍h, tē-cha̍p pan, pan-tiúⁿ sī Siā-la chong-cho̍k Nî-tô-hoat -lâng Má-hap-lâi; i ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.
Cha̍p-it--ge̍h, tē-cha̍p-it pan, pan-tiúⁿ sī Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k Pí-la-tùn -lâng Pí-ná-ngá; i ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.
Cha̍p-jī--ge̍h, tē-cha̍p-jī pan, pan-tiúⁿ sī Gô-tô-liap chong-cho̍k Nî-tô-hoat -lâng Hek-tāi; i ê pan-lāi ū nn̄g-bān sì-chheng lâng.

Koán-lí Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kì tī ē-bīn: Koán Lū-piān chi-cho̍k--ê sī Sè-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-í-siā; koán Se-biān chi-cho̍k--ê sī Má-ka ê kiáⁿ Sī-hoat-thê-ngá;
koán Lī-bī chi-cho̍k--ê sī Ki-bō͘-lī ê kiáⁿ Hap-sa-pí-ngá; koán A-lûn hō͘-tāi--ê sī Sat-tok;
koán Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k--ê sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-lī-hō͘; koán Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k--ê sī Bí-ka-le̍k ê kiáⁿ Àm-lī;
koán Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k--ê sī Gô-pa-tí-a ê kiáⁿ I-si-má-ngá; koán Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k--ê sī A-su-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lī-mô͘;
koán Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k--ê sī A-sat-se-ngá ê kiáⁿ Hô-sè-a; koán Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k--ê sī Pí-tāi-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ní;
koán Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu Má-ná-se pòaⁿ chi-cho̍k--ê sī Sat-ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ E̍k-to; koán Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k--ê sī Ap-nî-ní ê kiáⁿ Ngá-se-gia̍p;
koán Tān chi-cho̍k--ê sī Iâ-lô-hán ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lia̍t. Chiah-ê sī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k ê hêng-chèng koaⁿ-tiúⁿ.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng jī-cha̍p hè í-hā--ê, Tāi-pi̍t bô tiám-sǹg, in-ūi Siōng Chú ū èng-ún, I beh ke-thiⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ hiah chōe.

Sé-lō͘-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ap khai-sí tiám-sǹg; m̄-kú bô oân-sêng. In-ūi tiám-sǹg jîn-kháu chit-ê sū Siōng-tè ê siū-khì lîm-kàu Í-sek-lia̍t, sò͘-bo̍k mā bô kì tī Tāi-pi̍t-ông Chì-lio̍k.
Koán-lí ông hú-khò͘--ê sī A-tí-gia̍p ê kiáⁿ A-su-má-ui; koán-lí chhân-iá, siâⁿ-tìn, hiong-chhoan, siú-bōng-tâi ê hú-khò͘--ê sī O͘-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan.
Koán-lí keng-choh chhân-hn̂g--ê sī Ki-lio̍k ê kiáⁿ Í-su-lī.
Koán-lí phû-tô-hn̂g--ê sī La-má -lâng Sī-múi; koán-lí phû-tô-hn̂g ê chiú-tî--ê, sī Si̍t-hut-bí -lâng Sat-tí.
Koán-lí soaⁿ-po͘ ê kaⁿ-ná-chhiū kap sng-châi-chhiū--ê sī Ki-tē-lī -lâng Pa-le̍k Hap-lâm; koán-lí kaⁿ-ná-iû-khò͘--ê sī Iok-a-si.
Koán-lí Sa-lûn pêng-goân ê gû-kûn--ê sī Sa-lûn -lâng Si-thê-lâi; koán-lí soaⁿ-kok tiong ê gû-kûn--ê sī A-tē-lâi ê kiáⁿ Sa-hoat.
Koán-lí lo̍k-tô--ê sī Í-si̍t-má-lī -lâng A-pí-le̍k; koán-lí lû-kûn--ê sī Bí-lûn -lâng Iâ-hi-tí-a.
Koán-lí iûⁿ-kûn--ê sī Hā-kah -lâng Ngá-sek. Chiah-ê lóng sī koán-lí Tāi-pi̍t -ông sán-gia̍p ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ.
Tāi-pi̍t ê a-chek Iok-ná-tan chòe chham-bô͘, i chin chhong-bêng koh chòe su-kì; Hap-kek-mô͘-nî ê kiáⁿ Iâ-hiat chiàu-kò͘ ông ê kiáⁿ-jî.
A-hi-to-hut mā chòe ông ê chham-bô͘; A-ki -lâng Hō͘-su chòe ông ê kò͘-būn.
Sòa-chiap A-hi-to-hut ê lâng sī Pí-ná-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi kap A-pí-a-tha; Iok-ap chòe ông ê goân-sòe.

Tāi-pi̍t tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t ê léng-siù, kok chi-cho̍k ê siú-léng, kap lûn-pan ho̍k-sāi ông ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, koán-lí chi̍t-chheng lâng kap koán-lí chi̍t-pah lâng ê kun-koaⁿ, koán-lí ông kap ông kiáⁿ-jî ê sán-gia̍p kap cheng-siⁿ ê koaⁿ-oân, thài-kàm, ióng-sū, í-ki̍p tiōng-iàu jîn-sîn, lóng lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Tāi-pi̍t -ông chiū khiā--khí-lâi, kóng, “Kok-ūi hiong-chhin, kok-ūi tông-pau, chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ! Góa pún-lâi siūⁿ-beh khí-chō sèng-tiān lâi an-tì Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi, chiū-sī lán ê Siōng-tè ê kha-tiam; góa mā í-keng chún-pī hó-sè.
M̄-kú Siōng-tè tùi góa kóng, ‘Lí bōe-ēng-tit ūi-tio̍h góa ê miâ khí sèng-tiān, in-ūi lí sī chiàn-sū, ū thâi-sí chin chōe lâng.’

M̄-kú, Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè tùi goán lāu-pē choân ka-cho̍k kéng-soán góa choh-ông, éng-oán tī-lí Í-sek-lia̍t; in-ūi I kéng-soán Iû-tāi chòe léng-siù, koh tùi Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k kéng-soán goán lāu-pē ê ke, tī goán lāu-pē ê kiáⁿ-jî tiong te̍k-pia̍t ì-ài góa, soán-li̍p góa choh-ông, tī-lí choân Í-sek-lia̍t.
Siōng Chú siúⁿ-sù góa chin chōe kiáⁿ, tī góa ê kiáⁿ-jî tiong kéng-soán góa ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn, chē Siōng Chú ê kok ê ông-ūi, tī-lí Í-sek-lia̍t.
“Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng, ‘Lí ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn beh khí góa ê tiān, góa ê tiâⁿ; góa kéng-soán i chòe góa ê kiáⁿ, góa mā beh chòe i ê pē.
I nā chhin-chhiūⁿ kin-á-ji̍t kian-koat chun-siú góa ê kài-bēng kap bēng-lēng, góa chiū beh kian-kò͘ i ê kok-ūi, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.’

“Hiān-chāi, tī Siōng Chú ê tāi-hōe, Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng, lán ê Siōng-tè mā teh thiaⁿ, góa bēng-lēng lín tio̍h chun-hêng khat-bō͘ Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng; án-ni, lín chiū thang tit-tio̍h chit-tè hó ê thó͘-tōe, lâu hō͘ lín ê hō͘-tāi, éng-oán chòe sán-gia̍p.”

Tāi-pi̍t tùi Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn, lí tio̍h jīn-bat lí ê lāu-pē ê Siōng-tè, choân-sim hoaⁿ-hí ho̍k-sāi I; in-ūi Siōng Chú kàm-chhat ta̍k-ê lâng ê sim, chai in ê sim-su ì-liām. Lí nā chhē-kiû I, I ōe hō͘ lí chhē--tio̍h; lí nā pàng-sak I, I ōe éng-oán khì-sak lí.
Lí tio̍h kín-sīn, in-ūi Siōng Chú kéng-soán lí khí-chō sèng-tiān; lí tio̍h ióng-kám khì chòe.”
Tāi-pi̍t chiong sèng-tiān ê cháu-lông, pâng-keng, hú-khò͘, lâu-téng ê pâng-keng, lōe-tiān, kap si-un-chō ê só͘-chāi, só͘-ū ê siat-kè-tô͘, kau hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn;

chiong i tùi Siōng-tè ê sîn só͘ tit--tio̍h koan-hē Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ, sì-ûi ê pâng-keng, sèng-tiān ê hú-khò͘, kap khǹg sèng-mi̍h ê hú-khò͘ ê siat-kè-tô͘, lóng kau hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn.

Tāi-pi̍t koh kā Só͘-lô-bûn chí-sī án-chóaⁿ hun-phòe chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng ê pan-chhù, hō͘ in chip-hêng tī Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ho̍k-sāi ê chit-bū, í-ki̍p koán-lí Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ê khì-khū.

Tāi-pi̍t koh chí-sī i ēng jōa-chōe kim kap gûn chòe ta̍k-chióng ho̍k-sāi beh ēng ê kim-khì kap gûn-khì, kim kap gûn ê teng kap teng-tâi, khǹg hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê kim-toh kap gûn-toh;
koh chí-sī i tio̍h ēng jōa-chōe sûn-kim chòe bah-chhe, pôaⁿ, poe, óaⁿ, í-ki̍p ēng jōa-chōe gûn chòe gûn-óaⁿ;
koh chhìn liān--kè ê kim chòe hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ; mā chiàu siat-kè-tô͘ ēng kim chòe thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek ê chhia, in thí-khui si̍t, jia-khàm Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi.
Tāi-pi̍t kóng, “Téng-bīn chiah-ê siat-kè-tô͘, lóng sī chiàu Siōng Chú chhin-sin chí-sī góa siá--chhut-lâi--ê.”

Tāi-pi̍t koh kā i ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “Lí tio̍h kian-kiông ióng-kám khì chòe; m̄-thang kiaⁿ, m̄-thang lún; in-ūi Chú Siōng-tè, góa ê Siōng-tè, kap lí tông-chāi; I it-tēng bōe lī-khui lí, mā bōe pàng-sak lí, ti̍t-kàu lí oân-sêng Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê kang-thêng.

Lí khòaⁿ, hiah-ê chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng tī Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān ho̍k-sāi ê chit-bū í-keng hun-phòe hó-sè, mā ū chin chōe kang-hu chin hó ê sai-hū hoaⁿ-hí pang-chān lí, koh ū chin chōe koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kap choân-thé jîn-bîn lóng ōe thiaⁿ-thàn lí ê bēng-lēng.”

Tāi-pi̍t -ông tùi choân hōe-chiòng kóng, “Góa ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn sī Siōng-tè te̍k-pia̍t kéng-soán--ê, m̄-kú iáu siàu-liân, bô keng-giām. Chit-ê kang-thêng chin tōa, in-ūi chit-ê sèng-tiān m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h lâng, sī ūi-tio̍h Chú Siōng-tè khí--ê.

Góa ūi-tio̍h góa ê Siōng-tè ê tiān í-keng chīn-la̍t, ū chún-pī kim, gûn, tâng, thih, chhâ, beh chòe ta̍k-khoán khì-khū; koh ū chún-pī chin chōe âng-bé-ló, thang siuⁿ ê pó-chio̍h, kng-chio̍h, chhái-sek ê chio̍h, ta̍k-khoán ê pó-chio̍h, kap tāi-lí-chio̍h.

Góa ì-ài góa ê Siōng-tè ê tiān, chiū tī chún-pī khí sèng-tiān ê châi-liāu í-gōa, koh chiong góa chek-chū ê kim-gûn, lóng hiàn chòe khí góa Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê lō͘-ēng;
chiū-sī Gô-hui ê kim chi̍t-pah gōa kong-tùn, sûn-gûn nn̄g-pah sì-cha̍p gōa kong-tùn, lâi tah sèng-tiān ê piah;
í-ki̍p hō͘ sai-hū chòe kim-khì, gûn-khì, kap só͘-ū khì-khū ê lō͘-ēng. Kin-á-ji̍t iáu ū sím-mi̍h-lâng hoaⁿ-hí hōng-hiàn, hōng-hiàn i pún-sin hō͘ Siōng Chú?”

Án-ni, cho̍k-tiúⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê siú-léng, koán chi̍t-chheng lâng kap koán chi̍t-pah lâng ê kun-koaⁿ, í-ki̍p kàm-tok hiah-ê kā ông choh-kang ê lâng ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, lóng kam-sim hōng-hiàn.

In ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê kang-thêng, hōng-hiàn kim chi̍t-pah chhit-cha̍p gōa kong-tùn, gûn saⁿ-pah sì-cha̍p gōa kong-tùn, tâng iok la̍k-pah jī-cha̍p kong-tùn, kap thih saⁿ-chheng sì-pah kong-tùn.
Ū pó-chio̍h ê lâng lóng chiong pó-chio̍h the̍h-khì kau hō͘ Kek-sūn -lâng Iâ-hiat, sàng-ji̍p Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê hú-khò͘.
Jîn-bîn lóng chin hoaⁿ-hí hōng-hiàn, in-ūi in chīn-sim hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; Tāi-pi̍t -ông mā hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí.
Tāi-pi̍t tī choân hōe-chiòng ê bīn-chêng chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, kóng, “Siōng Chú — goán chó͘-sian Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè eng-kai siū chheng-chàn, tùi éng-oán kàu éng-oán.
Siōng Chú, lí chì-tōa, ū koân-lêng, êng-kng, sèng-lī, ui-giâm; thiⁿ-téng tōe-ē só͘-ū--ê lóng sī lí ê. Siōng Chú, kok sī lí ê, lí chì-koân, sī bān-iú ê chú-cháiⁿ.
Hù-jū chun-kùi lóng tùi lí lâi, lí mā chiáng-koán bān-iú; lí ū tōa koân-lêng tōa khùi-la̍t, hō͘ lâng úi-tāi kiông-sēng.
Goán ê Siōng-tè, taⁿ goán kám-siā lí, chheng-chàn lí êng-iāu ê miâ.
“Góa sǹg sím-mi̍h, góa ê chú-bîn sǹg sím-mi̍h, goán kèng-jiân ōe-tàng án-ni kam-sim hōng-hiàn? Bān-mi̍h lóng tùi lí lâi, goán put-kò ēng lí ê mi̍h hiàn hō͘ lí.
Goán tī lí ê bīn-chêng sī chhut-gōa-lâng, sī kià-ku--ê, kap goán ê chó͘-sian kâng-khoán. Goán tī sè-kan ê ji̍t-chí chhin-chhiūⁿ iáⁿ, bô sím-mi̍h ǹg-bāng.
Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ah, goán chún-pī chiah-ê só͘-ū ê châi-liāu, beh ūi-tio̍h lí ê sèng-miâ khí-chō sèng-tiān, chiah-ê lóng sī tùi lí lâi, mā lóng sī lí ê.

Góa ê Siōng-tè, góa chai lí kàm-chhat lâng ê sim, ì-ài chèng-ti̍t; góa ēng chèng-ti̍t ê sim kam-sim hōng-hiàn chiah-ê só͘-ū ê mi̍h. Hiān-chāi góa chin hoaⁿ-hí khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê chú-bîn tī chia, lóng kam-sim hōng-hiàn hō͘ lí.
Siōng Chú — goán lia̍t-chó͘ A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí hō͘ lí ê chú-bîn siông-siông chûn chit-khoán sim-su ì-liām, kian-koat kui-ǹg lí.
Koh kiû lí siúⁿ-sù góa ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn sûn-choân ê sim, thiat-tóe chun-siú lí ê kài-bēng, kà-sī, kui-lē, koh ēng góa chún-pī--ê khí-chō sèng-tiān.”

Tāi-pi̍t tùi choân hōe-chiòng kóng, “Lín tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.” Choân-thé hōe-chiòng chiū chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, àⁿ-thâu kūi-pài Siōng Chú kap ông.

Keh-ji̍t, in ǹg Siōng Chú hiàn-chè. In hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, kang ê gû chi̍t-chheng chiah, kang ê mî-iûⁿ chi̍t-chheng chiah, sòe-chiah iûⁿ-á chi̍t-chheng chiah, kap tiān-chiú-chè; koh ūi Í-sek-lia̍t ê jîn-bîn hiàn chin chōe chè-mi̍h.

Hit-ji̍t, in tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng lim-chia̍h, hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí. In tē-jī piàn siat-li̍p Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn choh-ông, tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng kā i boah-iû choh-ông; koh ēng iû boah Sat-tok chòe chè-si.
Só͘-lô-bûn chiū chē Siōng Chú só͘ siúⁿ-sù ê ông-ūi, sòa-chiap i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t choh-ông. I sū-sū sūn-lī, Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn lóng kui-sūn i.
Só͘-ū ê léng-siù kap ióng-sū, liân Tāi-pi̍t -ông lóng-chóng ê kiáⁿ-jî mā lóng sūn-ho̍k Só͘-lô-bûn -ông.
Siōng Chú hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn tī Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ê bīn-chêng siū chun chòe tōa; hō͘ i ū kok-ông ê ui-giâm, chhiau-kè Í-sek-lia̍t í-chêng só͘-ū ê ông.
Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t chòe choân Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông.
I choh-ông thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t kiōng sì-cha̍p nî: Tī Hi-pek-lûn chhit nî, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng saⁿ-cha̍p-saⁿ nî.
I hióng-siū êng-hôa-hù-kùi, chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū. I ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Tāi-pi̍t -ông it-seng ê sū-chek lóng kì-chài tī sian-kiàn Sat-bó-ní, sian-ti Ná-tan, í-ki̍p sian-kiàn Ka-tek ê chheh.
Chiah-ê chheh mā kì-chài i án-chóaⁿ tī-lí kok-chèng kap i ê sêng-chiū, koh kì-chài i kap Í-sek-lia̍t í-ki̍p sì-ûi kok-ka só͘ keng-le̍k ê sū.
Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn kian-kò͘ i tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê thóng-tī, Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè kap i tông-chāi, hō͘ i siū chun chòe tōa.

Só͘-lô-bûn tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng, chiū-sī koán chi̍t-chheng lâng kap koán chi̍t-pah lâng ê kun-koaⁿ, sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, í-ki̍p choân Í-sek-lia̍t ê léng-siù kap cho̍k-tiúⁿ,
chhōa in khì Ki-piàn ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ; tī hia ū Siōng-tè ê hōe-bō͘, sī Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se tī khòng-iá só͘ chō--ê.
Hit-sî Tāi-pi̍t í-keng chiong Siōng-tè ê iok-kūi tùi Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm sóa-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, khǹg tī i ūi-tio̍h iok-kūi tah ê pò͘-pîⁿ.
M̄-kú Hō͘-ní ê sun, O͘-lī ê kiáⁿ Pí-sat-lia̍t só͘ chō ê tâng-tôaⁿ iáu tī Ki-piàn Siōng Chú ê hōe-bō͘ chêng; Só͘-lô-bûn kap hōe-chiòng tī hia kiû-mn̄g Siōng Chú.
Só͘-lô-bûn tī hōe-bō͘ chêng kèng-pài Siōng Chú, tī tâng-tôaⁿ hiàn chi̍t-chheng chiah cheng-siⁿ chòe sio-hòa-chè.
Hit-mî, Siōng-tè tùi Só͘-lô-bûn hián-hiān, kā i kóng, “Lí ài góa sù lí sím-mi̍h, thang tùi góa kiû.”
Só͘-lô-bûn tùi Siōng-tè kóng, “Lí bat si tōa-un hō͘ góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t, koh hō͘ góa sòa-chiap i choh-ông.

Chú Siōng-tè, taⁿ kiû lí si̍t-hiān lí tùi góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê èng-ún, in-ūi lí siat-li̍p góa chòe chit-ê jîn-bîn ê ông, in chhin-chhiūⁿ tōe-chiūⁿ ê thô͘-soa hiah chōe.
Taⁿ kiû lí sù góa tì-hūi chhong-bêng, hō͘ góa thang léng-tō chit-ê kok-ka, tī-lí chiah-ê jîn-bîn; nā m̄-sī án-ni, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng tī-lí lí chiah chōe ê jîn-bîn?”

Siōng-tè tùi Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “Kì-jiân lí ê sim-ì sī án-ni, bô kiû chîⁿ-châi, hù-chiok, chun-êng, kap siau-bia̍t tùi-te̍k ê sìⁿ-miā, mā bô kiû tn̂g-hè-siū, chí-ū kiû tì-hūi chhong-bêng, thang tī-lí góa ê chú-bîn, chiū-sī lí siū siat-li̍p choh-ông tī-lí ê jîn-bîn.
Só͘-í góa beh sù lí tì-hūi chhong-bêng, mā beh sù lí chîⁿ-châi, hù-chiok, chun-êng; chhiau-kè lí í-chêng ê lia̍t-ông, tī lí í-āu mā bōe ū lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ lí án-ni.”
Só͘-lô-bûn tùi Ki-piàn soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ ê hōe-bō͘ tò-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, choh-ông tī-lí Í-sek-lia̍t.

Só͘-lô-bûn -ông ū kiàn-li̍p kun-tūi, chiàn-chhia chi̍t-chheng sì-pah tâi, bé-peng chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng miâ; kā in an-tì tī hiah-ê tún chiàn-chhia ê siâⁿ, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ông hia.
Ông thóng-tī kî-kan, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê kim-gûn chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-thâu hiah chōe, pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ chhin-chhiūⁿ soaⁿ-po͘ ê sng-châi-chhiū hiah chōe.
Só͘-lô-bûn ê bé lóng tùi Ai-ki̍p kap Kho-ui chìn-kháu, sī ông ê seng-lí-lâng tùi Kho-ui chiàu chhī-kè bóe--lâi-ê.

Tùi Ai-ki̍p chìn-kháu ê chiàn-chhia, ta̍k-tâi tāi-iok chhit kong-kun ê gûn; chiàn-bé ta̍k-chiah tāi-iok nn̄g kong-kun ê gûn. Só͘-lô-bûn ê seng-lí-lâng mā keng-chhiú, chiong chiah-ê chhut-kháu bōe hō͘ Hek -lâng kap Sū-lī-a -lâng hiah-ê ông.
Só͘-lô-bûn koat-tēng beh ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê miâ khí sèng-tiān, koh ūi ka-kī ê ông-kok khí kiong-tiān.
Só͘-lô-bûn chiū tiàu-chi̍p ūn-poaⁿ ê kang-lâng chhit-bān, tī soaⁿ--ni̍h phah-chio̍h--ê poeh-bān, tok-kang--ê saⁿ-chheng la̍k-pah.
Só͘-lô-bûn phài lâng khì kìⁿ Thài-ní -ông Hi-lân, kóng, “Lí bat ūn pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ hō͘ góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t khí kiong-tiān khiā-khí, chhiáⁿ lí mā án-ni tùi-thāi góa.

Hiān-chāi, góa beh ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ê miâ khí sèng-tiān, hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng hiàn hō͘ I, thang chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng éng-oán ê kui-lē, tī I ê bīn-chêng sio-hiuⁿ, siông-siông pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ, ta̍k chá-àm, An-hioh-ji̍t, chhoe-it, kap Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè só͘ tēng ê choeh-kî, hiàn sio-hòa-chè.
Góa só͘ beh khí ê sèng-tiān chin tōa, in-ūi goán ê Siōng-tè chin úi-tāi, iâⁿ-kè só͘-ū ê sîn-bêng.

Thiⁿ kap thiⁿ-téng ê thiⁿ to bô-kàu thang hō͘ I khiā-khí, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng ūi-tio̍h I khí sèng-tiān? Góa sǹg sím-mi̍h thang ūi-tio̍h I khí sèng-tiān? Góa put-kò sī khí chi̍t keng ōe-tàng tī I bīn-chêng sio-hiuⁿ hiàn-chè ê tiān nā-tiāⁿ.

Taⁿ chhiáⁿ lí phài chi̍t ê chin gâu ēng kim, gûn, tâng, thih, kap chí-sek, chu-âng-sek, nâ-sek ê se chòe kang-gē, koh chin gâu tiau-khek ê sai-hū lâi góa chia, thang kap góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t só͘ chún-pī tī Iû-tāi í-ki̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hiah-ê gâu ê sai-hū chòe-hé chòe kang.

Koh chhiáⁿ lí tùi Lê-pa-lūn ūn pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū, siông-chhiū, tôaⁿ-hiuⁿ-chhiū ê chhâ-liāu lâi hō͘ góa; góa chai lí ê kang-lâng gâu chhò Lê-pa-lūn ê chhiū. Góa ōe phài lâng khì hia̍p-chō͘ lí ê kang-lâng.
Chhiáⁿ ūi-tio̍h góa chún-pī khah chōe bo̍k-châi, in-ūi góa beh khí ê sèng-tiān chin tōa koh tông-hông.
Lí ê kang-lâng chhò-chhiū, góa ōe hō͘ in sió-be̍h nn̄g-chheng kong-tùn, tōa-be̍h nn̄g-chheng kong-tùn, chiú sì-cha̍p-bān kong-seng, iû sì-cha̍p-bān kong-seng.”
Thài-ní -ông Hi-lân kā Só͘-lô-bûn hôe-phoe, kóng, “In-ūi Siōng Chú thiàⁿ I ê chú-bîn, só͘-í siat-li̍p lí chòe in ê ông.”

Hi-lân koh kóng, “Chhòng-chō thiⁿ tōe ê Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! I siúⁿ-sù Tāi-pi̍t -ông chi̍t ê ū tì-hūi ê kiáⁿ, hō͘ i ū kiàn-sek chhong-bêng, thang ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú khí sèng-tiān, koh ūi ka-kī khí kiong-tiān.
Taⁿ góa phài chi̍t ê gâu koh chhong-bêng ê lâng khì, i sī góa ê sai-hū Hō͘-lân.

I sī Tān chi-cho̍k chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng ê kiáⁿ, lāu-pē sī Thài-ní -lâng; i chin gâu ēng kim, gûn, tâng, thih, chio̍h, chhâ, kap chí-sek, nâ-sek, iù-môa, chu-âng-sek ê se chòe kang-gē, mā chin gâu tiau-khek, koh ōe-hiáu siat-kè lâng kau hō͘ i ê ta̍k-khoán tô͘-àn; lí thang hō͘ i kap lí gâu ê sai-hū, í-ki̍p lí ê lāu-pē, góa ê chú Tāi-pi̍t, gâu ê sai-hū chòe-hé chòe kang.
Taⁿ góa ê chú só͘ kóng ê sió-be̍h, tōa-be̍h, iû, chiú, chhiáⁿ ūn-lâi hō͘ chiah-ê kang-lâng.
Goán ōe chiàu lí só͘ su-iàu--ê, tùi Lê-pa-lūn chhò-chhiū, pa̍k chòe kui-pâi phû tī hái--ni̍h, ūn kàu Iok-phà; lí chiū thang tùi hia ūn-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.”

Só͘-lô-bûn chiàu i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t só͘-chòe ê hō͘-kháu-phó͘-cha, koh tiám-sǹg tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe só͘-ū ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, lóng-chóng ū cha̍p-gō͘-bān saⁿ-chheng la̍k-pah lâng.
I hō͘ chhit-bān lâng chòe ūn-poaⁿ ê kang-lâng, poeh-bān lâng tī soaⁿ--ni̍h phah-chio̍h, saⁿ-chheng la̍k-pah lâng kàm-tok in chòe kang.

Só͘-lô-bûn tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Mô͘-lī-a-soaⁿ tāng-kang khí-chō Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān. Chit-ê só͘-chāi chá-chêng sī Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng A-lô-ná ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ; Siōng Chú bat tī chia tùi Só͘-lô-bûn ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t hián-hiān, só͘-í Tāi-pi̍t koat-tēng beh tī chia khí sèng-tiān.
Só͘-lô-bûn choh-ông tē-sì nî, jī-ge̍h chhoe-jī, khai-sí tāng-kang.
Só͘-lô-bûn beh khí ê Siōng-tè ê tiān ê tōe-ki, tn̂g jī-cha̍p-chhit kong-chhioh, khoah káu kong-chhioh.
Tiān-chêng ê cháu-lông khoah káu kong-chhioh, kap tiān pîⁿ khoah; koân gō͘-cha̍p-sì kong-chhioh; lāi-bīn tah sûn-kim.
Tōa-tiān ê piah ēng siông-chhiū-pán khàm, ēng sûn-kim tah; téng-bīn khek chó-chhiū kap liān-á.
Hit-keng tiān koh ēng pó-chio̍h kap Pa-óa-im ê kim chong-sek.
Tiān, pau-koat tiān ê niû, hō͘-tēng, chhiûⁿ-piah, mn̂g-sìⁿ lóng ēng kim tah; piah-téng khek thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek.
Koh khí Chì-sèng-só͘, tn̂g káu kong-chhioh, khoah kap sèng-tiān ê khoah sio-siâng káu kong-chhioh, lóng tah sûn-kim, kim ê tāng-liōng jī-cha̍p kong-tùn.
Kim teng-á tāng gō͘-pah chhit-cha̍p kong-khek. Téng-bīn ê pō͘-hūn mā lóng tah kim.
Chì-sèng-só͘ ê lāi-bīn tiau-khek chi̍t tùi thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek, gōa-bīn pau kim.

Nn̄g ê ki-lō͘-pek ê si̍t lóng-chóng tāi-iok káu kong-chhioh. Tē-it ê ki-lō͘-pek chi̍t pêng ê si̍t tú-tio̍h chit-pêng ê piah, tē-jī ê chi̍t pêng ê si̍t tú-tio̍h hit-pêng ê piah; in lēng-gōa nn̄g ki si̍t tī tiān ê tiong-ng sio-kha̍p; múi chi̍t ki si̍t tn̂g nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun.
Chit nn̄g ê ki-lō͘-pek thí-khui si̍t, lóng-chóng iok káu kong-chhioh; in ê kha khiā--teh, bīn ǹg ji̍p-kháu.
Koh ēng nâ-sek, chí-sek, chu-âng-sek ê se, kap iù-môa-pò͘ chòe tiùⁿ, siù ki-lō͘-pek tī hit téng-bīn.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông tī tiān-chêng chō nn̄g ki thiāu, koân cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ, múi chi̍t ki thiāu ê thiāu-táu koân nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun.
Koh chòe liān-á an tī thiāu-táu; koh chòe sia̍h-liû chi̍t-pah lia̍p, an tī liān-á téng.
Hit nn̄g ki thiāu chhāi tī tiān-chêng, chi̍t ki tī chiàⁿ-pêng, chi̍t ki tī tò-pêng; chiàⁿ-pêng hit-ki kiò-chòe Ngá-kun, tò-pêng hit-ki kiò-chòe Pho-a-su.
Só͘-lô-bûn koh chō chi̍t chō tâng-tôaⁿ, tn̂g káu kong-chhioh, khoah káu kong-chhioh, koân sì kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.
Koh chù chi̍t ê îⁿ-hêng ê tâng-hái, chhim nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun; ti̍t-kèng sì kong-chhioh sì-cha̍p kong-hun, chiu-ûi cha̍p-saⁿ kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun.
Tâng-hái ê tûn ē-bīn ū nn̄g pâi gû ûi--teh, múi sì-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-hun cha̍p chiah, sī chù tâng-hái ê sî siâng-sî chù--ê.
Tâng-hái an tī cha̍p-jī chiah tâng-gû ê téng-bīn, saⁿ chiah ǹg pak, saⁿ chiah ǹg sai, saⁿ chiah ǹg lâm, saⁿ chiah ǹg tang; gû-bé ǹg lāi-bīn.
Tâng-hái ê kāu-tō͘ chhit kong-hun-pòaⁿ; i ê tûn chhin-chhiūⁿ poe ê tûn, hêng chhin-chhiūⁿ pek-ha̍p-hoe; ōe-tàng tóe la̍k-bān kong-seng.
Koh chō cha̍p ê phûn, gō͘ ê hē tī lâm-pêng, gō͘ ê tī pak-pêng, lāi-bīn thang sóe hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê mi̍h. Tâng-hái kan-ta hō͘ chè-si sóe-tn̄g.
Koh chiàu kui-tēng ê khoán-sit chō cha̍p ê kim teng-tâi, hē tī tiān-lāi, gō͘ ê tī chiàⁿ-pêng, gō͘ ê tī tò-pêng;
koh chō cha̍p tè toh hē tī tiān-lāi, gō͘ tè tī chiàⁿ-pêng, gō͘ tè tī tò-pêng; koh chō chi̍t-pah tè kim-óaⁿ.
Koh chō chè-si-tiâⁿ, mā chō tōa-tiâⁿ, í-ki̍p tōa-tiâⁿ ê mn̂g; mn̂g-sìⁿ ēng tâng pau--teh.
Tâng-hái hē tī sèng-tiān ê tang-lâm-pêng.
Hō͘-lân koh chō phûn, thuh-á, kap óaⁿ. Án-ni, Hō͘-lân ūi-tio̍h Só͘-lô-bûn -ông oân-sêng Siōng-tè sèng-tiān it-chhè ê kang.
I só͘ chō--ê ū: Nn̄g ki thiāu, thiāu-téng óaⁿ-hêng ê thiāu-táu, khàm óaⁿ-hêng thiāu-táu ê bāng-á;
sì-pah lia̍p sia̍h-liû, pun-chòe nn̄g pêng, chi̍t pêng nn̄g pâi, an tī nn̄g niá khàm óaⁿ-hêng thiāu-táu ê bāng-á;
phûn-chō kap chō-téng ê phûn;
chi̍t chō tâng-hái, tâng-hái ē-bīn cha̍p-jī chiah gû;
phûn, thuh-á, kap bah-chhe; í-siōng chiah-ê khì-khū lóng sī sai-hū Hō͘-lân ūi-tio̍h Só͘-lô-bûn -ông khí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ēng kng-liāng ê tâng chòe--ê.
Chiah-ê khì-khū sī ông tī Iok-tàn pêng-goân, ēng So͘-kat kap Sat-la-tàn tiong-kan ê liâm-thô͘ chòe bô͘ chù-chō--ê.
Só͘-lô-bûn chō ê khì-khū hui-siông chōe, tâng ê tāng-liōng bô hoat-tō͘ kè-sǹg.
Só͘-lô-bûn koh chō Siōng-tè tiān-lāi só͘-ū ê khì-khū: kim-tôaⁿ, pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê toh,
chhāi tī Chì-sèng-só͘ thâu-chêng, chiàu kui-lē tiám-to̍h ê sûn-kim teng-tâi kap teng;
sûn-kim chòe ê teng-tâi ê hoe, teng, kap giap-á;

sûn-kim chòe ê teng-sim ê chián-to, pôaⁿ, khǹg hiuⁿ ê phiat-á, kap khǹg hé-thòaⁿ ê phûn; koh ū sèng-tiān ê mn̂g, chiū-sī Chì-sèng-só͘ ê mn̂g kap chêng-tiān ê mn̂g, lóng ēng kim pau--teh.

Án-ni, Só͘-lô-bûn -ông oân-sêng Siōng Chú sèng-tiān it-chhè ê kang. Só͘-lô-bûn chiong i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t só͘ hiàn ê kim, gûn, kap khì-khū lóng tòa ji̍p-khì hē tī Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê hú-khò͘.

Hit-sî, Só͘-lô-bûn tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló, ta̍k chi-cho̍k ê siú-léng, í-ki̍p ta̍k chong-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, beh gêng-chiap Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi, tùi Sek-an ê Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ ūn khí-lâi sèng-tiān.
Chhit-ge̍h ê choeh-kî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng chū-chi̍p tī ông hia.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló lóng lâi, hiah-ê Lī-bī -lâng chiū kng iok-kūi khí--lâi.
Chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng chiong iok-kūi, hōe-bō͘, í-ki̍p pò͘-pîⁿ lāi it-chhè sèng ê khì-khū kng-ji̍p sèng-tiān.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông kap chū-chi̍p tī i hia ê Í-sek-lia̍t choân hōe-chiòng, tī iok-kūi chêng hiàn gû, iûⁿ chòe chè-mi̍h, chè-mi̍h chōe kah bōe-sǹg--tit.
Chè-si kng Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi ji̍p lōe-tiān, chiū-sī Chì-sèng-só͘, hē tī chí-tēng ê só͘-chāi, thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek si̍t-kó͘ ē-bīn.
Ki-lō͘-pek tī hē iok-kūi ê só͘-chāi ê téng-bīn thí-khui in ê si̍t, jia-khàm iok-kūi kap kng iok-kūi ê kǹg.
Kǹg chin tn̂g, kǹg-bé tī lōe-tiān chêng ê sèng-só͘ khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h, tùi gōa-bīn chiū bōe-tàng khòaⁿ--tio̍h; kàu kin-á-ji̍t kǹg iáu tī hia.

Iok-kūi lāi-bīn chí-ū nn̄g tè chio̍h-pán, í-gōa lóng bô pa̍t-hāng mi̍h; chio̍h-pán sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe, Siōng Chú tī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ kap in li̍p-iok ê sî Mô͘-se só͘ hē--ê.
Só͘-ū tī sèng-tiān bô-lūn sio̍k tó chi̍t ê pan-chhù ho̍k-sāi ê chè-si, lóng í-keng kiat-chēng ka-kī. In tùi sèng-tiān chhut--lâi ê sî,

Lī-bī -lâng ê tiong-kan hū-chek hiàn-si--ê, chiū-sī A-sat, Hi-bān, Iâ-tō͘-tùn, í-ki̍p in ê hō͘-tāi kap chhin-cho̍k, lóng chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ, khiā tī chè-tôaⁿ ê tang-pêng, the̍h nâ-poa̍h, sek, kap khîm; koh ū pah-jī ê chè-si the̍h lat-pah kap in chòe-hé tī hia.

Hiah-ê pûn lat-pah--ê, chhiùⁿ-koa--ê, hô-hâi chôe-siaⁿ, chheng-chàn kám-siā Siōng Chú. In ēng lat-pah, nâ-poa̍h, ga̍k-khì phōaⁿ-chàu, tōa-siaⁿ chheng-chàn Siōng Chú kóng: Siōng Chú chì-siān, I ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán. Hit-sî, Siōng Chú ê tiān hō͘ hûn chhiong-móa;
in-ūi án-ni, chè-si bōe-tàng kè-sio̍k ho̍k-sāi; Siōng Chú ê êng-kng chhiong-móa Siōng-tè ê tiān.
Hit-sî Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “Siōng Chú bat kóng, I beh tiàm tī ba̍t-hûn ê só͘-chāi.
Góa í-keng khí chi̍t keng tông-hông ê tiān, chòe lí éng-oán khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.”
Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng lóng khiā--teh, Só͘-lô-bûn -ông oa̍t kè-lâi kā in chiok-hok.
I kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè eng-kai tit-tio̍h o-ló! I chhin-chhùi tùi góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t èng-ún--ê, lóng chhin-chhiú si̍t-hiān.

Siōng Chú ū kóng, ‘Tùi góa chhōa góa ê chú-bîn chhut Ai-ki̍p í-lâi, góa m̄-bat tī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k tiong-kan kéng chi̍t ê siâⁿ ūi góa ê miâ khí sèng-tiān, mā m̄-bat soán-li̍p lâng chòe góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê léng-siù;
m̄-kú góa ū kéng Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe góa beh lîm-chāi ê só͘-chāi, koh kéng Tāi-pi̍t tī-lí góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t.’
Góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t sim-lāi ū ì-sù beh ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ê miâ khí sèng-tiān.
Chóng-sī Siōng Chú tùi góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t kóng, ‘Lí ū ì-sù beh ūi góa ê miâ khí sèng-tiān, lí chit-ê sim-ì chin hó;
m̄-kú lí m̄-thang khí, lí chhin-siⁿ ê kiáⁿ ōe ūi góa ê miâ khí sèng-tiān.’

“Taⁿ Siōng Chú si̍t-hiān I só͘ kóng ê ōe; góa chiàu Siōng Chú ê ōe khí-lâi sòa-chiap góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t chē Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông-ūi, koh ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê miâ khí sèng-tiān.
Góa chiong iok-kūi an-tì tī hia; kūi-lāi ū Siōng Chú kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ li̍p ê iok.”
