Só͘-lô-bûn tng Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng ê bīn-chêng, khiā tī Siōng Chú ê chè-tôaⁿ chêng, siang-chhiú gia̍h--khí-lâi.

Só͘-lô-bûn ū chō chi̍t ê tâng-tâi, tn̂g nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun, khoah nn̄g kong-chhioh jī-cha̍p kong-hun, koân chi̍t kong-chhioh saⁿ-cha̍p kong-hun, hē tī tiâⁿ ê tiong-ng; i khiā tī tâi-téng, tī Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng bīn-chêng kūi--lo̍h-khì, gia̍h siang-chhiú ǹg thiⁿ,
kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, thiⁿ-téng tōe-ē bô chi̍t ê sîn-bêng chhin-chhiūⁿ lí; lí tùi hiah-ê it-sim-it-ì sūn-ho̍k lí ê po̍k-jîn siú-iok si chû-ài.
Lí ū chip-siú tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê èng-ún; lí chhin-chhùi èng-ún--ê, kin-á-ji̍t lóng chhin-chhiú si̍t-hiān.

Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí si̍t-hiān tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn góa ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê èng-ún; lí ū kóng, ‘Lí ê kiáⁿ-sun nā chhin-chhiūⁿ lí tī góa ê bīn-chêng kín-sīn seng-oa̍h, chun-hêng góa ê lu̍t-hoat, lí ê hō͘-tāi chiū ōe éng-oán chē Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông-ūi.’
Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, lí tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t só͘ kóng--ê, kiû lí si̍t-hiān.
“Siōng-tè ah, lí kiám chin-chiàⁿ beh kap sè-kan-lâng tòa tī tōe-chiūⁿ? Thiⁿ kap thiⁿ-téng ê thiⁿ to bô-kàu thang hō͘ lí tòa, hô-hòng góa só͘ khí chit-keng sèng-tiān?
Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ lí ê po̍k-jîn ê kî-tó khún-kiû, thiaⁿ lí ê po̍k-jîn tī lí bīn-chêng ê kiû-kiò kî-tó.
Goān lí mî-ji̍t khòaⁿ-kò͘ chit-ê sèng-tiān, chiū-sī lí kóng lí beh lîm-chāi ê só͘-chāi. Lí ê po̍k-jîn ǹg chit-ê só͘-chāi kî-tó ê sî, kiû lí thiaⁿ.
Lí ê po̍k-jîn kap lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ǹg chit só͘-chāi kî-tó ê sî, goān lí tùi thiⁿ-téng, lí tòa ê só͘-chāi, thiaⁿ goán ê kî-kiû, sià-bián goán.
“Lâng nā tek-chōe chhù-piⁿ, siū-pek tio̍h chiù-chōa, i lâi chit-keng tiān tī lí ê tôaⁿ-chêng chiù-chōa i sī bû-ko͘--ê,

kiû lí tùi thiⁿ-téng àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ lâi pān-lí, sím-phòaⁿ lí chiah-ê po̍k-jîn: Pháiⁿ-lâng, chiàu i ê pháiⁿ kā i pò-èng; bû-ko͘--ê, tēng i chòe bô-chōe, chiàu i ê chèng-ti̍t kā i pò-siúⁿ.
“Lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t nā tek-chōe lí, hō͘ tùi-te̍k phah-pāi, in nā hoán-hóe kui-ǹg lí, soan-jīn lí ê miâ, koh tī chit-keng sèng-tiān tùi lí kî-tó khún-kiû,
kiû lí tùi thiⁿ-téng àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ, sià-bián lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê chōe, hō͘ in tò-lâi lí só͘ siúⁿ-sù in kap in lia̍t-chó͘ ê tōe.
“In nā tek-chōe lí, lí kā thiⁿ koaiⁿ-ba̍t bô lo̍h-hō͘; lí hêng-hoa̍t in ê sî, in nā ǹg chit só͘-chāi kî-tó, soan-jīn lí ê miâ, lī-khui in ê chōe-ok,

kiû lí tùi thiⁿ-téng àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó, sià-bián lí ê po̍k-jîn kap lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê chōe, kà-sī in kiâⁿ chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘, koh lo̍h-hō͘ tī lí siúⁿ-sù in chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe.
“Chit-ê tōe nā ū ki-hng, un-e̍k, hé-sio-hong, pīⁿ-hāi, chháu-meh, chháu-meh-kong, á-sī tùi-te̍k ûi-khùn in ê siâⁿ, bô-lūn ū sím-mi̍h chai-hō, sím-mi̍h tōa-pīⁿ,
lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t tiong nā ū lâng chai ka-kī ê chai-hō khó͘-thàng, ǹg chit-ê sèng-tiān gia̍h-chhiú pek-chhiat khún-kiû,

kiû lí tùi thiⁿ-téng, lí khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ lâi sià-bián in; in-ūi lí chai in ê sim, mā chí-ū lí chai sè-kan-lâng ê sim, goān lí chiàu in ta̍k-ê lâng ê kiâⁿ-chòe tùi-thāi in,
hō͘ in tī lí siúⁿ-sù goán lia̍t-chó͘ ê tōe, chi̍t-sì-lâng kèng-ùi lí, kiâⁿ lí ê tō-lō͘.

“Nā ū gōa-kok-lâng, m̄-sī sio̍k lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t --ê, in-ūi thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê tōa-miâ, tōa koân-lêng ê chok-ûi, kap lí kiù-chō͘ ê chhiú-kut, tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi, ǹg chit-ê tiān kî-tó,

kiû lí tùi thiⁿ-téng, lí khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, thiaⁿ in ê kî-kiû, chiàu gōa-kok-lâng it-chhè tùi lí khún-kiû--ê lâi chòe, hō͘ thiⁿ-ē bān-bîn lóng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t siâng-khoán, bat lí ê miâ, kèng-ùi lí; koh hō͘ in chai chit-ê sèng-tiān sī kèng-pài kiû-kiò lí ê só͘-chāi.

“Lí ê chú-bîn hōng lí ê bēng-lēng, bô-lūn chhut-khì sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi kap tùi-te̍k kau-chiàn ê sî, nā ǹg lí só͘ kéng-soán ê siâⁿ, kap góa ūi-tio̍h lí ê miâ khí ê tiān tùi lí kî-tó,
kiû lí tùi thiⁿ-téng thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó khún-kiû, hō͘ in tek-sèng.
“Sè-kan bô chi̍t ê lâng bô hoān-chōe, m̄-kú lí ê chú-bîn nā tek-chōe lí, lí tùi in siū-khì, chiong in kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k, kā in lia̍h-khì gōa-tōe, bô-lūn hn̄g á-sī kūn,
in nā tī hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì ê tōe hôe-sim-tńg-ì, koh tī in siū-lia̍h ê tōe hóe-kái, tùi lí ai-kiû, ‘Goán ū chōe, goán pōe-ge̍k, goán chòe pháiⁿ.’

In nā tī tùi-te̍k lia̍h in khì ê tōe, choân-sim choân-ì kui-sūn lí, koh ǹg lí siúⁿ-sù in lia̍t-chó͘ ê tōe, kap lí só͘ kéng-soán ê siâⁿ, í-ki̍p góa hōng lí ê miâ khí ê tiān, tùi lí kî-tó,
kiû lí tùi thiⁿ-téng, lí khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó khún-kiû, chiàu kong-tō tùi-thāi in, koh sià-bián hiah-ê tek-chōe lí ê chú-bîn.
“Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, taⁿ kiû lí khui ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ, àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ tī chia só͘ hiàn ê kî-tó.

Chú Siōng-tè, kiû lí khí--lâi; lí kap lí ū khùi-la̍t ê iok-kūi chòe-hé ji̍p-khì lí hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi. Chú Siōng-tè, goān lí ê chè-si ēng kiù-un chòe saⁿ chhēng; goān lí sèng ê chú-bîn in-ūi tit-tio̍h hok-khì hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
Chú Siōng-tè, kiû lí m̄-thang khì-sak lí boah-iû kéng-soán ê kun-ông; tio̍h tài-liām lí si-lo̍h hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê chû-ài.”
Só͘-lô-bûn kî-tó soah, chiū ū hé tùi thiⁿ kàng-lo̍h, chiong sio-hòa-chè kap só͘-ū ê chè-mi̍h lóng sio-chīn; Siōng Chú ê êng-kng chhiong-móa sèng-tiān.
In-ūi Siōng Chú ê êng-kng chhiong-móa Siōng Chú ê tiān, só͘-í chè-si bōe-tàng ji̍p--khì.

Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h hé kàng-lo̍h, koh Siōng Chú ê êng-kng tà tī sèng-tiān téng-bīn, chiū tī pho͘-chio̍h ê só͘-chāi phak lo̍h-khì kèng-pài, kám-siā Siōng Chú, kóng: Siōng Chú chì-siān, I ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán.
Ông kap choân-thé jîn-bîn tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng hiàn-chè.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông hiàn gû nn̄g-bān nn̄g-chheng chiah, iûⁿ cha̍p-jī-bān chiah chòe chè; án-ni, ông kap choân-thé jîn-bîn ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê tiān kú-hêng hōng-hiàn-lé.

Chè-si chiàu in ka-kī ê chit-bū khiā-teh sū-hōng; Lī-bī -lâng the̍h í-chêng Tāi-pi̍t -ông só͘ chō ê ga̍k-khì, chhiùⁿ Tāi-pi̍t só͘ choh ê si, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú kóng, “I ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán.” Chè-si tī Lī-bī -lâng ê tùi-bīn pûn lat-pah; só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng khiā--teh.

Só͘-lô-bûn in-ūi i só͘ chō ê tâng-tôaⁿ siuⁿ sòe, bô-kàu thang tī hia hiàn sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap pêng-an-chè ê iû, chiū chiong Siōng Chú tiān-chêng ê tiâⁿ tiong-ng ê só͘-chāi hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, tī hia hiàn sio-hòa-chè, kap pêng-an-chè ê iû.

Hit-sî, Só͘-lô-bûn kap Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn chòe-hé siú-choeh chhit ji̍t; Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn tùi Hap-má ài-kháu kàu Ai-ki̍p ê khoe-kok lâi chham-ka, chiâⁿ-chòe sēng-hóng ê tāi-hōe.
Kàu tē-poeh ji̍t in kú-hêng giâm-siok-hōe; in siú chè-tôaⁿ ê hōng-hiàn-lé chhit ji̍t, koh siú-choeh chhit ji̍t.

Chhit-ge̍h jī-cha̍p-saⁿ ji̍t, ông kā jîn-bîn kái-sàn, hō͘ in tò-khì in tau. Jîn-bîn in-ūi Siōng Chú tùi Tāi-pi̍t, Só͘-lô-bûn, kap I ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ siúⁿ-sù ê un-hūi, sim-lāi hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
Só͘-lô-bûn oân-sêng Siōng Chú sèng-tiān kap ông-kiong ê kang-thêng; i sūn-lī oân-sêng sim-lāi só͘ kè-ōe it-chhè ê kiàn-tio̍k.
Mî--sî Siōng Chú tùi Só͘-lô-bûn hián-hiān, tùi i kóng, “Góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê kî-tó, mā kéng chit só͘-chāi chòe ǹg góa hiàn-chè ê sèng-tiān.
Góa nā kā thiⁿ koaiⁿ-ba̍t bô lo̍h-hō͘, á-sī bēng-lēng chháu-meh chia̍h lông-chok-bu̍t, á-sī kàng un-e̍k tī góa chú-bîn ê tiong-kan,
góa ê chú-bîn nā khiam-pi, kî-tó, hóe-kái, lī-khui in ê pháiⁿ hêng-ûi, góa chiū beh tùi thiⁿ-téng thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó, sià-bián in ê chōe, hō͘ thó͘-tōe koh-chài seng-sán.
Góa ê ba̍k-chiu beh khòaⁿ, hī-khang beh thiaⁿ tī chit só͘-chāi só͘ hiàn ê kî-tó.
Hiān-chāi góa í-keng kéng chit-ê tiān, kā i hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, chòe góa éng-oán lîm-chāi ê só͘-chāi; góa ê ba̍k-chiu, góa ê sim mā beh éng-oán tī chia.
Lí tī góa bīn-chêng ê kiâⁿ-chòe, nā chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t, chun-thàn góa ê kài-bēng, chip-siú góa ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng,
Góa chiū beh kian-kò͘ lí ê ông-ūi, chiàu góa kap lí ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t só͘ li̍p ê iok, kóng, ‘Lí ê hō͘-tāi ōe éng-oán thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t.’
“Lín nā oa̍t-cháu, khì-sak góa pan-pò͘ hō͘ lín ê kui-lē kap kài-bēng, khì ho̍k-sāi kèng-pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng,

góa chiū beh chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi góa siúⁿ-sù in ê tōe kā in pu̍ih--chhut-lâi, mā beh khì-sak chit-keng hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ēng lâi kèng-pài góa ê tiān, hō͘ i tī bān-kok tiong chòe chhiàu-tâm, siū lâng thí-chhiò.
“Chit-keng sèng-tiān sui-jiân siū lâng chun-chông, kàu hit-sî, keng-kè ê lâng ōe tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kóng, ‘Siōng Chú ná ōe án-ni tùi-thāi chit-ê tōe kap chit-keng tiān?’

Ū lâng ōe ìn kóng, ‘Sī in-ūi in khì-sak chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe ê Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, khì sìn-hōng pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, kèng-pài ho̍k-sāi in, só͘-í Siōng Chú hō͘ chiah-ê it-chhè ê chai-hō lîm-kàu in.’”
Só͘-lô-bûn ēng jī-cha̍p nî khí Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān kap ông-kiong, oân-kang í-āu,
Só͘-lô-bûn koh siu-kiàn Hi-lân -ông hō͘ i ê siâⁿ, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa tī hia.
Só͘-lô-bûn kong-chhú Hap-má Só-pa,
koh tiông-kiàn tī khòng-iá ê Ta̍t-bo̍k, tī Hap-má khí-chō tún-chek bu̍t-chu ê siâⁿ;
koh tiông-kiàn Téng Pek Hô-lûn kap Ē Pek Hô-lûn, chiâⁿ-chòe ū chhiûⁿ, ū mn̂g, ū mn̂g-chhòaⁿ ê kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ.

Só͘-lô-bûn koh khí-chō Pa-la -siâⁿ kap chin chōe tún-chek kun-iōng-phín ê siâⁿ, í-ki̍p hē chiàn-chhia ê siâⁿ kap hē chiàn-bé ê siâⁿ. Só͘-lô-bûn koh tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, Lê-pa-lūn, kap choân-kok ta̍k só͘-chāi, khí-chō i só͘ ài khí ê kiàn-tio̍k.
Só͘-ū tòa tī kéng-lāi ê Hek -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Hi-bī -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê hō͘-tāi, m̄-sī sio̍k tī Í-sek-lia̍t,
bô hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siau-bia̍t--ê, Só͘-lô-bûn kiông-chè in chòe khó͘-kang, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
M̄-kú Só͘-lô-bûn bô hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe lô͘-lē chòe khó͘-kang; i hō͘ in chòe i ê chiàn-sū, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, chiàn-chhia-tiúⁿ, bé-peng-tiúⁿ.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông ê tok-kang ū nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p lâng.

Só͘-lô-bûn chiong Ai-ki̍p -ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tùi Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ poaⁿ ji̍p-khì ūi-tio̍h i khí ê kiong-tiān; in-ūi Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “Góa ê bó͘ m̄-thang tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Tāi-pi̍t ê kiong-tiān; in-ūi Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi só͘ kàu ê só͘-chāi lóng sîn-sèng.”
Só͘-lô-bûn tī sèng-tiān cháu-lông thâu-chêng só͘ khí Siōng Chú ê chè-tôaⁿ, hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú;

chiàu Mô͘-se ê bēng-lēng, tī An-hioh-ji̍t, chhoe-it, kap ta̍k-nî saⁿ piàn ê choeh-kî, chiū-sī Tû-kàⁿ-choeh, Chhit-chhit Siu-koah-choeh, Tah-liâu-choeh, chiàu ta̍k-ji̍t eng-kai hiàn--ê lâi hiàn-chè.

Koh chiàu i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê kui-lē, hun-phòe chè-si ê pan-chhù kap chit-bū; mā hun-phòe Lī-bī -lâng ê chit-bū, hū-chek siōng-chàn, chiàu ta̍k-ji̍t ê kui-tēng hia̍p-chō͘ chè-si; koh hun-phài siú-ōe, chiàu pan-chhù tī ta̍k-ê mn̂g kò͘-siú. Chiah-ê lóng chiàu Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng Tāi-pi̍t ê bēng-lēng an-pâi.
Bô-lūn koán-lí hú-khò͘, á-sī chòe ta̍k-khoán chit-bū, hiah-ê chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng lóng bô ûi-ke̍h ông ê bēng-lēng.
Só͘-lô-bûn khí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê kang-sū, tùi hē tōe-ki hit-ji̍t kàu oân-kang, lóng sūn-lī chìn-hêng. Án-ni, Siōng Chú ê tiān chiū oân-sêng.
Hit-sî, Só͘-lô-bûn khì Í-tong tōe-khu ê hái-káng Í-sûn Ka-pia̍t kap Í-lo̍k.

Hi-lân phài i ê koaⁿ-oân, chiong chûn kap keng-giām hong-hù ê chûn-oân sàng hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn. In kap Só͘-lô-bûn ê chûn-oân khì Gô-hui, tùi hia ūn-sàng kim chi̍t-bān gō͘-chheng kong-kun kàu Só͘-lô-bûn -ông hia.

Sī-pa ê lú-ông thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê miâ-siaⁿ, chiū lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng beh ēng lân-tôe khó-giām Só͘-lô-bûn. I chhōa chin chōe kun-sûi lâi, koh ū lo̍k-tô chài hiuⁿ-liāu, chin chōe n̂g-kim kap pó-chio̍h. I kìⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê sî, chiū chiong sim-lāi só͘-ū ê lân-tôe kā i mn̄g.
Só͘-lô-bûn chiàu i só͘ mn̄g--ê it-it kā i hôe-tap, bô chi̍t hāng khùn-lân kah Só͘-lô-bûn bōe-hiáu ìn.
Sī-pa lú-ông kiàn-sek-tio̍h Só͘-lô-bûn ê tì-hūi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i khí ê kiong-tiān,

toh-téng ê chia̍h-mi̍h, pâi-lia̍t chē--teh ê jîn-sîn, kun-sûi ho̍k-sāi ê lô͘-po̍k kap in ê i-ho̍k, thîn-chiú ê lô͘-po̍k kap in chhēng ê saⁿ, koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h i tī Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān só͘ hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè, chiū kui-ê lâng lóng gāng--khì.
Sī-pa lú-ông chiū tùi ông kóng, “Góa tī goán pún-kok só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h lí ê sū-chek kap lí ê tì-hūi lóng sī chin--ê!

Pún-lâi góa m̄ sìn in ê ōe, kàu góa chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiah siong-sìn. Lâng kā góa kóng--ê iáu bô sū-si̍t ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ; lí ê tì-hūi kap lí ê hù-chiok chhiau-kè góa só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê.
Lí ê pō͘-sio̍k chin ū hok-khì! Lí ê jîn-sîn chin ū hok-khì! In put-sî tī lí ê bīn-chêng thiaⁿ lí tì-hūi ê ōe.

Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! I ì-ài lí, hō͘ lí tī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng chē-ūi choh-ông; in-ūi lí ê Siōng-tè thiàⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t, ài i éng-oán kian-li̍p, só͘-í soán-li̍p lí chòe in ê ông, hō͘ lí thang péng-kong-hêng-gī.”

Sī-pa lú-ông chiong tāi-iok sì-chheng kong-kun ê kim, chin chōe hiuⁿ-liāu, kap pó-chio̍h sàng hō͘ ông; chêng-kàu-taⁿ m̄-bat ū lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ Sī-pa lú-ông sàng hiah chōe hiuⁿ-liāu hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn -ông.
Hi-lân ê chûn-oân kap Só͘-lô-bûn ê chûn-oân tùi Gô-hui ūn kim lâi, koh tòa tôaⁿ-hiuⁿ-chhâ kap pó-chio̍h lâi.

Ông ēng chiah-ê tôaⁿ-hiuⁿ-chhâ ūi Siōng Chú ê tiān kap ông-kiong chòe gîm-á, mā ūi chhiùⁿ-koa ê lâng chòe khîm kap sek. Tī Iû-tāi -tōe, chêng-kàu-taⁿ m̄-bat ū lâng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ án-ni.

Só͘-lô-bûn -ông sàng hō͘ Sī-pa lú-ông ê hôe-lé, chhiau-kè lú-ông tòa--lâi ê lé-mi̍h, koh chiàu i só͘ ì-ài, só͘ iau-kiû--ê lóng sàng hō͘ i. Lú-ông kap i ê jîn-sîn chiū tò-khì in pún-kok.
Só͘-lô-bûn ta̍k-nî siu--tio̍h ê kim kiōng nn̄g-bān saⁿ-chheng kong-kun.
Í-gōa, i ū tùi seng-lí-lâng kap bō͘-e̍k-siong siu sè-kim; kok-lāi ê séng-tiúⁿ kap A-la-pek chiah-ê ông, lóng chìn-kòng kim-gûn hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông phah tōa tún-pâi nn̄g-pah bīn, múi chi̍t bīn ēng kim chhit kong-kun;
koh phah sió tún-pâi saⁿ-pah bīn, múi chi̍t bīn ēng kim saⁿ kong-kun. Ông chiong chiah-ê tún-pâi hē tī Lê-pa-lūn Lîm-kiong.
Ông koh ēng chhiūⁿ-gê chòe chi̍t ê tōa pó-chō, ēng sûn-kim tah--teh.
Pó-chō chêng ū la̍k chàn kiā-á, koh ū kim ê kha-tiam, kap pó-chō saⁿ-liân; siang-pêng ū chhiú-hōaⁿ, chhiú-hōaⁿ ê piⁿ--á kok ū chi̍t chō sai khiā--teh;
koh ū cha̍p-jī chō sai khiā tī la̍k chàn kiā-á ta̍k-chàn ê siang-pêng-piⁿ; pa̍t-ê ông-kok lóng m̄-bat án-ni chòe.

Só͘-lô-bûn -ông só͘-ū lim ê khì-khū lóng sī kim--ê; Lê-pa-lūn Lîm-kiong it-chhè ê khì-khū mā-sī sûn-kim--ê; tī Só͘-lô-bûn ê sî-tāi, gûn bô hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe chin ū kè-ta̍t.
Ông ê chûn-tūi kap Hi-lân ê chûn-oân chòe-hé khì Tha-si; chiah-ê Tha-si ê chûn-tūi ūn kim, gûn, chhiūⁿ-gê, kâu, khóng-chhiok, múi saⁿ nî tò-lâi chi̍t piàn.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông ê châi-hù kap tì-hūi iâⁿ-kè thian-hā chu-ông.
Thian-hā chu-ông lóng siūⁿ-beh lâi kìⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê bīn, thiaⁿ Siōng-tè sù hō͘ i ê tì-hūi.
In ta̍k-ê tòa chìn-kòng ê lé-mi̍h, chiū-sī kim-khì, gûn-khì, i-ho̍k, kun-khì, hiuⁿ-liāu, bé, kap lô; ta̍k-nî lóng ū it-tēng ê sò͘-liōng.
Só͘-lô-bûn ū bé-tiâu sì-chheng keng, koh ū bé-peng chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng miâ, koh an-tì chiàn-chhia tī hiah-ê tún chiàn-chhia ê siâⁿ, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ông hia.
Só͘-lô-bûn koán-hat só͘-ū ê ông, tùi Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô, kàu Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tōe, ti̍t-kàu Ai-ki̍p pian-kài.
Ông thóng-tī ê kî-kan, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê gûn chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-thâu hiah chōe, pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ chhin-chhiūⁿ soaⁿ-po͘ ê sng-châi-chhiū hiah chōe.
Ū lâng tùi Ai-ki̍p, tùi ta̍k só͘-chāi, chìn-kháu bé hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn.

Só͘-lô-bûn kî-tha ê sū-chek, tùi thâu kàu bé lóng kì-chài tī Sian-ti Ná-tan-sú, Sī-lô -lâng A-hi-ngá ê Ū-giân-su, kap sian-kiàn E̍k-to lūn Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ê Īⁿ-siōng-su.
Só͘-lô-bûn tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kok ê ông, kiōng sì-cha̍p nî.
Só͘-lô-bûn tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia liáu-āu, bâi-chòng tī i ê lāu-pē Tāi-pi̍t ê siâⁿ. I ê kiáⁿ Lô-pho-an sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Lô-pho-an khì Sī-kiàm, in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn beh tī hia siat-li̍p i choh-ông.
Í-chêng Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an ūi-tio̍h siám-pī Só͘-lô-bûn -ông, cháu-khì tòa tī Ai-ki̍p; Iâ-lô-pho-an thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì, chiū tùi Ai-ki̍p tò--lâi.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhe lâng khì chhiáⁿ i lâi; Iâ-lô-pho-an chiū kap Í-sek-lia̍t hōe-chiòng lâi kìⁿ Lô-pho-an, tùi i kóng,
“Lí ê lāu-pē hō͘ goán pē tāng ê tàⁿ; kiû lí kiám-khin lí ê lāu-pē hē tī goán keng-thâu téng ê tāng-tàⁿ, kiám-chió goán ê khó͘-kang, goán chiū ho̍k-sāi lí.”
Lô-pho-an kā in kóng, “Saⁿ ji̍t āu chiah koh lâi.” Jîn-bîn chiū tò--khì.
Lô-pho-an ê lāu-pē Só͘-lô-bûn iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî, ū goân-ló ho̍k-sāi i; Lô-pho-an -ông chhéng-kàu in, kóng, “Lín ū sím-mi̍h kè-chhek, góa thang hôe-ho̍k chiah-ê jîn-bîn?”
In ìn i kóng, “Lí nā hó khoán-thāi chiah-ê jîn-bîn, hō͘ in hoaⁿ-hí, ēng hó-ōe hôe-tap in, in chiū ōe éng-oán chòe lí ê po̍k-jîn.”
M̄-kú Lô-pho-an kū-choa̍t chiah-ê goân-ló hō͘ i ê kè-chhek, khì kap hiah-ê kap i chòe-hé tōa-hàn, ho̍k-sāi i ê siàu-liân-lâng chham-siông;

i kā in kóng, “Chiah-ê jîn-bîn ū tùi góa kóng, ‘Kiû lí kiám-khin lí ê lāu-pē hē tī goán keng-thâu téng ê tāng-tàⁿ.’ Taⁿ lín ū sím-mi̍h ì-kiàn hō͘ lán thang kā in hôe-ho̍k?”

Hiah-ê kap i chòe-hé tōa-hàn ê siàu-liân-lâng kā i kóng, “Chiah-ê jîn-bîn tùi ông kóng, ‘Kiû lí kiám-khin lí ê lāu-pē hē tī goán keng-thâu téng ê tāng-tàⁿ.’ Ông tio̍h án-ni ìn in kóng, ‘Góa ê bé-cháiⁿ pí góa ê lāu-pē ê io khah chho͘.
Góa ê lāu-pē hō͘ lín pē tāng ê tàⁿ, góa beh hō͘ lín koh-khah tāng ê tàⁿ; góa ê lāu-pē ēng piⁿ hêng-hoa̍t lín, góa beh ēng thih-chhì ê piⁿ hêng-hoa̍t lín.’”
Iâ-lô-pho-an kap chèng jîn-bîn chiàu Lô-pho-an -ông ê ōe, tī tē-saⁿ ji̍t tò-lâi kìⁿ i.
Ông ēng pháiⁿ siaⁿ-sàu ìn jîn-bîn; i m̄ thiaⁿ goân-ló hō͘ i ê kiàn-gī,

tian-tò chiàu siàu-liân-lâng ê ì-kiàn tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Góa ê lāu-pē hō͘ lín pē tāng ê tàⁿ, góa beh hō͘ lín koh-khah tāng ê tàⁿ; góa ê lāu-pē ēng piⁿ hêng-hoa̍t lín, góa beh ēng thih-chhì ê piⁿ hêng-hoa̍t lín.”

Ông m̄-khéng thiaⁿ jîn-bîn ê chhéng-kiû, in-ūi chit-ê tāi-chì sī chhut tī Siōng-tè, beh si̍t-hiān Siōng Chú thong-kè Sī-lô -lâng A-hi-ngá tùi Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an só͘ kóng ê ōe.

Í-sek-lia̍t chèng jîn-bîn chi̍t-ē chai ông m̄-khéng thiaⁿ in ê chhéng-kiû, chiū tùi ông kóng: Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-kok goán bô hūn; Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ kap goán bô koan-hē. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, lín lóng tò-khì lín tau! Taⁿ, Tāi-pi̍t -ke, lín ka-kī kò͘ hō͘ hó! Tùi án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng tò-khì in tau.
M̄-kú Lô-pho-an iû-goân chòe tòa tī lâm-pō͘ Iû-tāi tōe-khu ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê ông.

Lô-pho-an -ông phài kàm-tok kiông-chè-lô-kang ê A-to-lân khì Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hia; Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí. Lô-pho-an -ông chiū kóaⁿ-kín chiūⁿ chiàn-chhia cháu tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Tùi án-ni, pak-pō͘ ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoán-poān Tāi-pi̍t -ke, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.

Lô-pho-an kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chiū chū-chi̍p Iû-tāi -ke kap Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k te̍k-soán ê chiàn-sū, kiōng cha̍p-poeh-bān lâng, beh kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ke kau-chiàn, hō͘ kui-ê ông-kok koh kui-sio̍k i ka-kī.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng Sī-má-ngá, kóng,
“Lí khì kā Só͘-lô-bûn ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông Lô-pho-an, Iû-tāi kap Piān-ngá-bín ê jîn-bîn, kóng,

‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lín m̄-thang khì kap lín ê hiaⁿ-tī kau-chiàn; ta̍k-ê lâng tò-khì ka-kī ê chhù, in-ūi chit-ê tāi-chì chhut tī góa.’” In chiū thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú ê ōe tò--khì, bô khì kong-kek Iâ-lô-pho-an.
Lô-pho-an tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. I tī Iû-tāi -tōe khí kúi-nā ê kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ,
chiū-sī Pek-lī-hêng, Í-thán, Thê-ko-a,
Pek Siok, So-ko, A-tō͘-lân,
Ka-te̍k, Má-lī-sa, Se-hut,
A-to-lâi-im, La-kiat, A-se-ka,
Só-la, A-ngá-lûn, kap Hi-pek-lûn; chiah-ê lóng sī Iû-tāi kap Piān-ngá-bín kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ.
Lô-pho-an koh kiông-hòa hiah-ê kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, siat chí-hui-koaⁿ, tún-chek niû-si̍t, kaⁿ-ná-iû, kap chiú;
koh chún-pī tún-pâi kap chhiuⁿ, hō͘ chiah-ê siâⁿ koh-khah kian-kò͘. Iû-tāi kap Piān-ngá-bín lóng siū i thóng-tī.
Í-sek-lia̍t choân-tōe ê chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng lóng tùi ta̍k só͘-chāi lâi kui-sūn Lô-pho-an.

Lī-bī -lâng hòng-khì in ê chháu-po͘ kap sán-gia̍p, lâi kàu Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, in-ūi Iâ-lô-pho-an kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ m̄-chún in chip-hêng chè-si ê chit-bū, ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.
Iâ-lô-pho-an ūi soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-kúi, kap i só͘ chō ê gû-á-siōng, ka-kī siat-li̍p chè-si.

Í-sek-lia̍t kok chi-cho̍k, só͘-ū koat-sim beh chhē-kiû Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ê lâng, lóng tè Lī-bī -lâng khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, beh hiàn-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè.
Án-ni, in hō͘ Iû-tāi -kok ún-kò͘; saⁿ nî kú ióng-hō͘ Só͘-lô-bûn ê kiáⁿ Lô-pho-an, in-ūi in chun-hêng Tāi-pi̍t kap Só͘-lô-bûn ê lō͘ saⁿ nî kú.
Lô-pho-an chhōa Má-hap-la chòe bó͘; Má-hap-la ê lāu-pē sī Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lī-mô͘, lāu-bú sī Iâ-se ê cha-bó͘-sun, Í-lī-ap ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ A-pí-hâi.
Má-hap-la siⁿ saⁿ ê kiáⁿ, Iâ-o͘-si, Sī-má-lī-ngá, kap Sat-hán.
Āu-lâi Lô-pho-an koh chhōa Ap-sa-liông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Má-ka chòe bó͘; i siⁿ sì ê kiáⁿ, A-pí-ngá, A-thài, Sè-sat, kap Sī-lô-bi̍t.

Lô-pho-an ū cha̍p-poeh ê bó͘, la̍k-cha̍p ê hui, siⁿ jī-cha̍p-poeh ê kiáⁿ, la̍k-cha̍p ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; tī chiah-ê bó͘ kap hui ê tiong-kan, i siōng thiàⁿ Ap-sa-liông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Má-ka.
Lô-pho-an siat-li̍p Má-ka ê kiáⁿ A-pí-ngá chòe thài-chú, tī i ê hiaⁿ-tī tiong chòe thâu, beh siat-li̍p i sòa-chiap choh-ông.

Lô-pho-an chòe sū cheng-bêng, hun-phài i só͘-ū ê kiáⁿ khì Iû-tāi kap Piān-ngá-bín choân-tōe ta̍k-ê kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ; koh hō͘ in chhiong-chiok ê niû-si̍t, kā in chhōa chin chōe bó͘.
Lô-pho-an ê ông-kok chi̍t-ē ún-kò͘ kiông-sēng, i chiū khì-sak Siōng Chú ê lu̍t-hoat, só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng mā lóng tè i.
Lô-pho-an -ông tē-gō͘ nî, Ai-ki̍p -ông Sī-sat chiūⁿ-lâi kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tek-chōe Siōng Chú.
Sī-sat ū chiàn-chhia chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah tâi, bé-peng la̍k-bān; koh chhōa Lī-pí-a -lâng, So͘-ki -lâng, Kó͘-si̍t -lâng, tùi Ai-ki̍p chiūⁿ--lâi, lâng chōe kah sǹg bōe liáu.
I kong-chhú Iû-tāi kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Hit-sî, Iû-tāi ê léng-siù in-ūi Sī-sat ê iân-kò͘, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chū-chi̍p; sian-ti Sī-má-ngá lâi kìⁿ Lô-pho-an kap hiah-ê léng-siù, tùi in kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lín khì-sak góa, só͘-í góa khì-sak lín, chiong lín kau tī Sī-sat ê chhiú.’”
Í-sek-lia̍t hiah-ê léng-siù kap ông chiū khiam-pi jīn-chōe, kóng, “Siōng Chú sī kong-gī.”

Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-kìⁿ in ka-kī khiam-pi, Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Sī-má-ngá kóng, “In kì-jiân khiam-pi jīn-chōe, góa bô beh châu-bia̍t in, beh hō͘ in chiām-sî tit-tio̍h kái-kiù; góa bô beh thong-kè Sī-sat ê chhiú chiong góa ê siū-khì piàⁿ-lo̍h tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
M̄-kú in ōe chòe Sī-sat ê lô͘-po̍k, hō͘ in chai, ho̍k-sāi góa kap ho̍k-sāi tōe-chiūⁿ lia̍t-kok ū sím-mi̍h bô sio-siâng.”

Tùi án-ni, Ai-ki̍p -ông Sī-sat chiūⁿ-lâi kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chiong Siōng Chú sèng-tiān kap ông-kiong ê pó-mi̍h lóng chhiúⁿ--khì, koh chhiúⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn só͘ chòe hiah-ê kim ê tún-pâi.
Lô-pho-an -ông chòe tâng ê tún-pâi tāi-thòe hiah-ê kim ê tún-pâi, kau hō͘ kò͘ ông-kiong tōa-mn̂g ê sī-ōe-tiúⁿ kò͘-siú.
Ông ta̍k-piàn ji̍p Siōng Chú ê tiān, sī-ōe chiū giâ chiah-ê tún-pâi, āu-lâi koh tòa tò-tńg hē tī sī-ōe-sek.
Ông ka-kī khiam-pi ê sî, Siōng Chú chiū bô koh siū-khì, bô oân-choân kā i châu-bia̍t; Iû-tāi ê chêng-hêng mā ū kái-siān.

Lô-pho-an tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông, ka-kiông i ê thóng-tī. Lô-pho-an chē-ūi ê sî sì-cha̍p-it hè. I tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-chhit nî; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sī Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chèng chi-cho̍k tiong kéng-soán hō͘ lâng lâi kèng-pài I ê siâⁿ. Lô-pho-an ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Ná-má, sī A-bûn -lâng.
Lô-pho-an chòe siâ-ok ê sū; i bô kian-koat chhē-kiû Siōng Chú.
Lô-pho-an ê sū-chek, tùi thâu kàu bé lóng kì-chài tī sian-ti Sī-má-ngá kap sian-kiàn E̍k-to ê Giân-hêng-lio̍k. Lô-pho-an kap Iâ-lô-pho-an siông-siông kau-chiàn.
Lô-pho-an tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, lâng kā i an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ; i ê kiáⁿ A-pí-ngá sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iâ-lô-pho-an tē-cha̍p-poeh nî, A-pí-ngá chòe Iû-tāi -ông,
tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông saⁿ nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Bí-kai-a, sī Ki-pí-a -lâng O͘-lia̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ. A-pí-ngá kap Iâ-lô-pho-an siông-siông kau-chiàn.
A-pí-ngá chhōa sì-cha̍p-bān cheng-peng chhut-chiàn. Iâ-lô-pho-an mā chhōa poeh-cha̍p-bān te̍k-soán ê peng gêng-chiàn.
A-pí-ngá khiā tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu ê Sé-má-lián-soaⁿ, kóng, “ Iâ-lô-pho-an kap Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa kóng!
Lín eng-kai chai, Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ū kap Tāi-pi̍t li̍p bōe hòe-tû ê iok, chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -kok éng-oán sù hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun.
M̄-kú Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê jîn-sîn, Nî-pat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an, khí-lâi pōe-poān i ê chú-lâng.
I chio-chi̍p chi̍t-kóa bô lō͘-ēng ê húi-lūi, kong-jiân tùi-khòng Só͘-lô-bûn ê kiáⁿ Lô-pho-an; hit-sî Lô-pho-an iáu siàu-liân bô keng-giām, bōe-tàng tí-khòng in.
Taⁿ lín khò lín lâng chōe, siaⁿ-sè tōa, koh ū Iâ-lô-pho-an ūi lín chō ê kim-gû-á chòe sîn-bêng, beh hoán-khòng Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ-sun só͘ tī-lí Siōng Chú ê kok.

Lín kiám m̄-sī chiong Siōng Chú ê chè-si, A-lûn ê kiáⁿ-sun, kap Lī-bī -lâng kóaⁿ-cháu, chiàu gōa-kok-lâng ê choh-hoat ka-kī siat-li̍p chè-si? Sīm-chì bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng khan chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á kap chhit chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng lâi, lín chiū kā i siat-li̍p chòe só͘-ūi sîn-bêng ê chè-si.
“M̄-kú goán leh, Siōng Chú sī goán ê Siōng-tè, goán bô khì-sak I; goán ū chè-si, A-lûn ê kiáⁿ-sun, kap Lī-bī -lâng teh chip-hêng ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú ê chit-bū.

Ta̍k-ji̍t chá-àm, goán hiàn sio-hòa-chè, sio phang-hiuⁿ, tī sûn-kim ê toh pâi hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ hō͘ Siōng Chú; ta̍k ē-hng koh tiám kim teng-tâi ê teng; in-ūi goán chun-siú Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, m̄-kú lín khì-sak I.

Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng-tè kap goán tông-chāi, koh léng-tō goán; I ê chè-si mā tōa-siaⁿ pûn lat-pah beh kong-kek lín. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, m̄-thang kap Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè kau-chiàn, in-ūi lín it-tēng bōe iâⁿ.”
Iâ-lô-pho-an tiàu chi̍t-pō͘-hūn ê peng tī Iû-tāi -lâng ê āu-bīn bâi-ho̍k, i ê kun-tūi tùi chiàⁿ-bīn chìn-kong.
Iû-tāi -lâng oa̍t-thâu khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in chêng-āu siū pau-ûi, chiū kiû-kiò Siōng Chú; chè-si mā pûn lat-pah.
Iû-tāi -lâng chiū tōa-siaⁿ hoah chìn-kong. In tōa-siaⁿ hoah ê sî, Siōng-tè chiū tī A-pí-ngá kap Iû-tāi -lâng ê bīn-chêng phah-pāi Iâ-lô-pho-an kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-tūi.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Iû-tāi -lâng ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu; Siōng-tè chiong in kau tī Iû-tāi -lâng ê chhiú.
A-pí-ngá kap i ê kun-peng tōa sèng-lī; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng te̍k-soán ê peng siū thâi-sí--ê ū gō͘-cha̍p-bān.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siū chè-ho̍k; Iû-tāi -lâng tek-sèng, in-ūi in óa-khò Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè.
A-pí-ngá tui-jip Iâ-lô-pho-an, kong-chhú i kúi-nā ê siâⁿ, chiū-sī Pek-te̍k-lī, Iâ-sa-ná, Í-hut-lûn, í-ki̍p chiah-ê siâⁿ hù-kūn ê chng-siā.
A-pí-ngá chāi-ūi ê sî, Iâ-lô-pho-an bô koh-chài kiông-sēng; Siōng Chú phah Iâ-lô-pho-an, i chiū sí.
A-pí-ngá chiām-chiām kiông-sēng. I ū bó͘ cha̍p-sì ê, kiáⁿ jī-cha̍p-jī ê, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ cha̍p-la̍k ê.
A-pí-ngá kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe, lóng kì-chài tī sian-ti E̍k-to ê Phêng-lūn-chi̍p.
A-pí-ngá tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, lâng kā i an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ; i ê kiáⁿ A-sat sòa-chiap i choh-ông. A-sat chāi-ūi ê sî, choân-kok thài-pêng cha̍p nî kú.
A-sat chòe Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe hó, khòaⁿ-chòe chèng-ti̍t ê sū.
I hòe-tû gōa-pang sîn-bêng ê tôaⁿ kap soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, húi-hoāi chio̍h-thiāu, chhò A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng,
koh bēng-lēng Iû-tāi -lâng chhē-kiû Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, chun-thàn I ê lu̍t-hoat kài-bēng;
koh tī Iû-tāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ hòe-tû soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ kap hiuⁿ-tâi. Tī A-sat tī-lí ê sî, Iû-tāi -kok tit-tio̍h thài-pêng.
I tī Iû-tāi khí kúi-nā chō kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, in-ūi kok-ka thài-pêng. Tī hit kúi nî lóng bô chiàn-cheng, in-ūi Siōng Chú sù i pêng-an.

I tùi Iû-tāi -lâng kóng, “Lán tio̍h lâi kiông-hòa chiah-ê siâⁿ, sì-ûi khí chhiûⁿ kap siâⁿ-lâu, an siâⁿ-mn̂g kap mn̂g-chhòaⁿ. In-ūi lán ū chhē-kiû Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè, chit-tè thó͘-tōe iáu-sī lán ê; lán ū kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, I chiū sù lán sù-kéng-pêng-an.” In chiū siu-chō chiah-ê siâⁿ, sū-sū lóng sūn-lī.
A-sat ê kun-peng, giâ tún-pâi kap chhiuⁿ ê Iû-tāi -lâng ū saⁿ-cha̍p-bān, giâ tún-pâi khui-keng ê Piān-ngá-bín -lâng jī-cha̍p-poeh-bān; in lóng sī kiông-béng ê ióng-sū.
Kó͘-si̍t -ông Siā-la chhōa kun-peng chi̍t-pah-bān, chiàn-chhia saⁿ-pah tâi, lâi kong-kek Iû-tāi; in lâi kàu Má-lī-sa.
A-sat chhut-khì gêng-chiàn, siang-hong tī Má-lī-sa ê Sé-hoat Soaⁿ-kok pâi-tīn.

A-sat kiû-kiò Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, lí ōe-tàng pang-chān jio̍k-siáu--ê, mā ōe-tàng pang-chān kiông-tāi--ê. Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí pang-chān goán, in-ūi goán óa-khò lí, koh hōng lí ê miâ beh kap hiah-ê kiông-tāi ê kun-tūi kau-chiàn. Siōng Chú, lí sī goán ê Siōng-tè, m̄-thang hō͘ lâng khah iâⁿ lí.”
Siōng Chú chiū phah Kó͘-si̍t -lâng, hō͘ in tùi A-sat kap Iû-tāi -lâng ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu.

A-sat kap i ê kun-peng tui-jip in, ti̍t-kàu Ki-la-ní; Kó͘-si̍t -lâng sí-siong chin chōe, kun-le̍k bōe-tàng koh ho̍k-goân, in-ūi in hō͘ Siōng Chú kap I ê kun-tūi oân-choân phah-pāi. Iû-tāi -lâng tit-tio̍h chin chōe chiàn-lī-phín.
In koh kong-táⁿ Ki-la-ní chiu-ûi ê siâⁿ, in-ūi hiah-ê siâⁿ ê lâng lóng chin kiaⁿ Siōng Chú. Iû-tāi ê kun-tūi chhiúⁿ hia só͘-ū ê siâⁿ, in-ūi siâⁿ-lāi châi-bu̍t chin chōe.
In phò-hoāi cheng-siⁿ ê tiâu, chhiúⁿ chin chōe iûⁿ kap lo̍k-tô, chiū tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Siōng-tè ê sîn lîm-kàu Gô-tek ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá.

I chiū khì kìⁿ A-sat, tùi i kóng, “ A-sat kap Iû-tāi, Piān-ngá-bín ê jîn-bîn, chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ góa kóng. Lín nā sūn-thàn Siōng Chú, I chiū kap lín tông-chāi; lín nā chhē-kiû I, I ōe hō͘ lín chhē--tio̍h; m̄-kú lín nā khì-sak I, I mā ōe khì-sak lín.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng í-keng chin kú bô sìn chin Sîn, bô kàu-tō ê chè-si, bô lu̍t-hoat,
m̄-kú in tī hoān-lān ê sî kui-ǹg chhē-kiû Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, I chiū hō͘ in chhē--tio̍h.
Hit-sî, lia̍t-kok ê chū-bîn tú-tio̍h tōa jiáu-loān, lâng chhut-ji̍p bô pêng-an.
Kok kong-kek kok, siâⁿ kong-kek siâⁿ, Siōng-tè ēng ta̍k-khoán chai-lān jiáu-loān in.
Taⁿ lín tio̍h kian-kiông, m̄-thang sit-táⁿ, in-ūi lín ê só͘-chòe ōe tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ.”

A-sat thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe, kap Gô-tek ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá ê ū-giân, chiū kian-kiông--khí-lâi, tī Iû-tāi kap Piān-ngá-bín choân-tōe, í-ki̍p i só͘ kong-chhú Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu hiah-ê siâⁿ, hòe-tû só͘-ū khó-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng, koh siu-kiàn sèng-tiān cháu-lông thâu-chêng Siōng Chú ê chè-tôaⁿ.

I koh chū-chi̍p Iû-tāi -lâng, Piān-ngá-bín -lâng, í-ki̍p kià-ku tī in tiong-kan ê Í-hoat-liân -lâng, Má-ná-se -lâng, kap Se-biān -lâng; ū chin chōe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut-lâi kui-sūn A-sat, in-ūi in khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè kap i tông-chāi.
A-sat -ông tē-cha̍p-gō͘ nî saⁿ--ge̍h, in lóng chū-chi̍p tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Hit-ji̍t, in tùi tòa--lâi ê chiàn-lī-phín tiong-kan, hōng-hiàn chhit-pah chiah gû kap chhit-chheng chiah iûⁿ chòe chè hō͘ Siōng Chú.
In li̍p-iok, beh choân-sim choân-ì chhē-kiû Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè;
só͘-ū bô chhē-kiû Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ê lâng, bô-lūn lâm-lú tōa-sòe, lóng tio̍h chhú-sí.
In chiū tōa-siaⁿ hoan-ho͘, pûn sàu-kak kap lat-pah, tùi Siōng Chú chiù-chōa.

Iû-tāi jîn-bîn lóng chin hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi in choân-sim tùi Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, koh choân-ì chhē-kiû Siōng Chú, Siōng Chú chiū hō͘ in chhē--tio̍h, siúⁿ-sù in sù-kéng-pêng-an.

A-sat -ông hòe-tû i ê a-má Má-ka thài-hō͘ ê ūi, in-ūi Má-ka ū chō A-sià-la khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sîn-siōng. A-sat chiong sîn-siōng chhò-tiāu, phòa hō͘ chhùi-chhùi, tī Khip-lûn Khoe-kok pàng-hé sio.
Sui-jiân hiah-ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ iáu-bē tùi Í-sek-lia̍t tiong tû--khì, m̄-kú A-sat it-seng oân-choân sūn-ho̍k Siōng Chú.
I chiong i ê lāu-pē kap i pún-sin hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê kim, gûn, kap khì-khū, lóng tòa-ji̍p Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān.
Tùi hit-sî kàu A-sat choh-ông tē-saⁿ-cha̍p-gō͘ nî, lóng bô koh ū chiàn-cheng.
A-sat choh-ông tē-saⁿ-cha̍p-la̍k nî, Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pa-sa lâi kong-kek Iû-tāi, siu-kiàn La-má -siâⁿ, beh chó͘-tòng lâng tī Iû-tāi -ông A-sat hia chhut-ji̍p.
A-sat chiū tùi Siōng Chú sèng-tiān kap ông-kiong ê hú-khò͘ the̍h kim gûn, sàng hō͘ khiā-khí tī Tāi-má-sū-kek ê Sū-lī-a -ông Piān Hap-ta̍t, tùi i kóng,

“Lán lâi kiat-bêng, chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ê lāu-pē bat kap góa ê lāu-pē kiat-bêng. Taⁿ góa chiong kim gûn sàng lí, chhiáⁿ lí hòe-tû lí kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pa-sa só͘ li̍p ê iok, hō͘ i tùi Iû-tāi thiat-thè.”
Piān Hap-ta̍t tông-ì A-sat -ông ê ōe, chiū phài i ê kun-tiúⁿ khì kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t ê siâⁿ, kong-phòa Í-hûn, Tān, A-pek Pek Má-ka, kap Ná-hut-tha-lī só͘-ū tún-chek ê siâⁿ.
Pa-sa thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê siau-sit, chiū thêng-kang bô koh siu-kiàn La-má.
Tùi án-ni, A-sat -ông chhōa Iû-tāi jîn-bîn, chiong Pa-sa ēng lâi beh siu-kiàn La-má ê chio̍h-thâu kap chhâ-liāu, poaⁿ-khì tiông-kiàn Ka-pa kap Bí-su-pa.

Hit-sî, sian-kiàn Hap-ná-nî lâi kìⁿ Iû-tāi -ông A-sat, tùi i kóng, “In-ūi lí óa-khò Sū-lī-a -ông, bô óa-khò Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè, só͘-í Sū-lī-a -ông ê kun-peng ōe thoat-lī lí ê chhiú-thâu.

Kó͘-si̍t -lâng kap Lī-pí-a -lâng ê kun-tūi kiám m̄-sī chin kiông-tāi? In ê chiàn-chhia kap bé-peng kiám m̄-sī chin chōe? M̄-kú in-ūi lí óa-khò Siōng Chú, I chiū chiong in kau tī lí ê chhiú.

Siōng Chú ê ba̍k-chiu teh sûn-sī choân-tōe; só͘-ū choan-sim kui-ǹg I--ê, I ōe siúⁿ-sù in khùi-la̍t. Tī kap Sū-lī-a kiat-bêng chit-ê tāi-chì, lí chòe-liáu chin gōng; in-ūi án-ni, lí í-āu put-sî ōe ū chiàn-cheng.”
A-sat thiaⁿ-liáu hui-siông siū-khì, chiū chiong sian-kiàn koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ--ni̍h. Siâng-sî, A-sat mā ge̍k-thāi chi̍t-kóa jîn-bîn.
A-sat ê sū-chek, tùi thâu kàu bé lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi kap Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
A-sat -ông tē-saⁿ-cha̍p-káu nî, i ê kha tio̍h-pīⁿ, chèng-thâu chin siong-tiōng. Phòa-pīⁿ ê sî i bô kiû Siōng Chú, kan-ta chhē i-seng.
A-sat choh-ông sì-cha̍p-it nî chiū sí,

an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ, i ūi ka-kī phah-hó ê bōng. Lâng chiong i hē tī chhn̂g-pang; chhn̂g-pang téng khǹg chin chōe chiàu te̍k-pia̍t ê hong-hoat tiâu-hô ê ta̍k-chióng phang-liāu. Lâng koh khí chin tōa ê hé kì-liām i.
Iok-sa-hoat sòa-chiap i ê lāu-pē A-sat chòe Iû-tāi -ông, hùn-hoat chū-kiông, tùi-khòng Í-sek-lia̍t.
I phài kun-tūi chū-chāi tī Iû-tāi hiah-ê kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, koh tī Iû-tāi -tōe, kap i ê lāu-pē A-sat só͘ kong-chhú Í-hoat-liân hiah-ê siâⁿ phài peng hông-siú.
Siōng Chú kap Iok-sa-hoat tông-chāi, in-ūi i chiàu i ê lāu-pē chho͘-kî ê só͘-chòe khì chòe, bô pài Pa-le̍k;
chí-ū ho̍k-sāi i ê lāu-pē ê Siōng-tè, chun-hêng I ê kài-bēng, bô chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t chu-ông ê só͘-chòe khì chòe.
Só͘-í Siōng Chú kian-kò͘ Iok-sa-hoat ê thóng-tī; Iû-tāi jîn-bîn hiàn lé-mi̍h hō͘ i. I chiū ū chin chōe châi-hù koh chin siū lâng chun-kèng.
I ióng-kám kiâⁿ Siōng Chú ê tō-lō͘; koh tùi Iû-tāi hòe-tû soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ kap A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng.
I choh-ông tē-saⁿ nî phài i ê jîn-sîn Piān Hâi-i-le̍k, Gô-pa-tí-a, Sat-ka-lī-a, Ná-thán-gia̍p, Bí-kai-a, khì Iû-tāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ kàu-tō jîn-bîn.

Kap in chòe-hé khì--ê ū Lī-bī -lâng Sī-má-ngá, Nî-thàm-ngá, Se-pa-tē-ngá, A-sat-hek, Sī-bí-la-boa̍t, Iok-ná-tan, A-to-nî-ngá, To-pí-ngá, Tô Pa-to-nî-ngá, í-ki̍p chè-si Í-lī-sa-má kap Iok-lân.
In tòa Siōng Chú lu̍t-hoat ê chheh, kiâⁿ-thàu Iû-tāi só͘-ū ê siâⁿ, kà-sī jîn-bîn.
Iû-tāi chiu-ûi lia̍t-kok lóng chin kiaⁿ Siōng Chú, m̄-káⁿ kap Iok-sa-hoat kau-chiàn.
Hui-lī-sū -lâng ū-ê chìn-kòng gûn hō͘ Iok-sa-hoat; A-la-pek -lâng koh sàng mî-iûⁿ-káng kap soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng kok chhit-chheng chhit-pah chiah.
Iok-sa-hoat jú lâi jú kiông-sēng, tī Iû-tāi khí iàu-sài kap tún-chek ê siâⁿ.
I tī Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ ū chòe chin chōe kang-thêng; koh tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ū ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū.
In ê sò͘-bo̍k, chiàu chong-cho̍k kì tī ē-bīn: Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k tē-it ê chí-hui-koaⁿ sī Ap-ná, chhōa ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū saⁿ-cha̍p-bān;
tē-jī ê sī Iok-hap-lân, chhōa jī-cha̍p-poeh-bān;
tē-saⁿ ê sī Sè-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ A-má-su-ngá, i kam-goān hōng-hiàn ka-kī hō͘ Siōng Chú, chhōa jī-cha̍p-bān ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū.
Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k ê ióng-béng chiàn-sū Í-lī-ngá-tāi, chhōa gia̍h keng-chìⁿ kap tún-pâi ê chiàn-sū jī-cha̍p-bān;
tē-jī ê sī Iok-sat-poa̍t, chhōa bú-chong chiàn-sū cha̍p-poeh-bān.
Chiah-ê lóng teh sū-hāu ông; lēng-gōa iáu ū ông phài-chū tī Iû-tāi kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ ê kun-tūi.
Iok-sa-hoat ū chin chōe châi-hù koh chin siū chun-kèng; i kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap kiat-chhin.
Kè kúi-nā nî, i lo̍h-khì Sat-má-lī-a pài-hóng A-hap; A-hap ūi-tio̍h i kap i ê kun-sûi, thâi chin chōe gû, iûⁿ, sòe-ho̍k i chòe-hé khì kong-táⁿ Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t.

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap tùi Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Lí beh kap góa chòe-hé khì kong-táⁿ Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t --bô?” Iok-sa-hoat ìn kóng, “Góa ê chiū-sī lí ê, góa ê jîn-bîn chiū-sī lí ê jîn-bîn, goán beh kap lí chòe-hé khì kau-chiàn.”
Iok-sa-hoat koh tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí seng mn̄g Siōng Chú ê ì-sù.”

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chiū tiàu-chi̍p sian-ti sì-pah lâng, mn̄g in kóng, “Goán thang khì kong-táⁿ Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, á-sī m̄-thang?” In ìn kóng, “Thang khì kong-táⁿ; Siōng-tè beh chiong chit-ê siâⁿ kau tī ông ê chhiú.”
Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Chia kiám bô koh ū Siōng Chú ê sian-ti hō͘ lán thang mn̄g?”

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kā Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Iáu ū chi̍t ê lâng, sī Im-la ê kiáⁿ Bí-kai-ngá, lán thang tùi i chhéng-būn Siōng Chú; m̄-kú góa oàn-hūn i, in-ūi i tùi góa kóng ê ū-giân bô chi̍t hāng hó, siông-siông chí-ū kóng chai-hō.” Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Chhiáⁿ ông m̄-thang án-ni kóng.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chiū tiàu chi̍t ê koaⁿ-oân lâi, kóng, “Lí kóaⁿ-kín khì kiò Im-la ê kiáⁿ Bí-kai-ngá lâi.”

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kap Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat tī Sat-má-lī-a siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ, chhēng lé-ho̍k, chē tī in ê pó-chō; só͘-ū ê sian-ti lóng tī in ê bīn-chêng kóng ū-giân.
Ki-ná-ná ê kiáⁿ Se-tí-ka chòe thih ê kak, kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lí beh ēng chiah-ê thih-kak tak Sū-lī-a -lâng, tak kah in lóng siau-bia̍t.’”
Só͘-ū ê sian-ti lóng án-ni ū-giân kóng, “Thang khì kong-táⁿ Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, it-tēng tek-sèng, Siōng Chú beh chiong chit-ê siâⁿ kau tī ông ê chhiú.”
Hit-ê khì kiò Bí-kai-ngá ê sù-chiá kā i kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, só͘-ū ê sian-ti lóng tùi ông kóng hó-ōe. Chhiáⁿ lí mā kap in siâng-khoán kóng hó-ōe.”
Bí-kai-ngá kóng, “Góa kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, góa ê Siōng-tè kóng sím-mi̍h, góa chiū tùi ông kóng sím-mi̍h.”

Bí-kai-ngá lâi kàu ông ê bīn-chêng, ông mn̄g i kóng, “ Bí-kai-ngá, goán thang khì kong-táⁿ Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, á-sī m̄-thang?” I ìn kóng, “Hó ah, chòe lí khì kong-táⁿ, it-tēng ōe sèng-lī; chit-ê siâⁿ ōe kau tī lín ê chhiú.”
Ông tùi i kóng, “Góa tio̍h kiò lí chiù-chōa kúi piàn, lí chiah ōe hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ tùi góa kóng si̍t-chāi-ōe?”

Bí-kai-ngá kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ bô bo̍k-chiá ê iûⁿ sì-sòaⁿ tī soaⁿ--ni̍h; Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Chiah-ê lâng bô chú-lâng; ta̍k-ê lâng thang pêng-an tò-khì in tau.’”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông tùi Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Góa kiám bô kā lí kóng, chit-ê lâng tùi góa kóng ê ū-giân lóng bô hó-ōe, chí-ū kóng chai-hō.”
Bí-kai-ngá kè-sio̍k kóng, “Só͘-í, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe! Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú chē tī pó-chō, thiⁿ-téng ê bān-kun khiā tī I ê chiàⁿ-pêng tò-pêng.
Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Sím-mi̍h-lâng beh ín-iú Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap, hō͘ i khì Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, sí tī hia?’ Chit-ê kóng án-ni, hit-ê kóng án-ni.
Āu-lâi ū chi̍t ê sîn chhut--lâi, khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, kóng, ‘Góa khì kā i ín-iú.’ Siōng Chú mn̄g i kóng, ‘Lí beh án-chóaⁿ kā ín-iú?’
I ìn kóng, ‘Góa beh chhut-khì chòe pe̍h-chha̍t ê sîn, hō͘ hiah-ê sian-ti kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.’ Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Lí kā i ín-iú, it-tēng ōe sêng-kong. Lí khì, chiàu án-ni chòe.’
Hiān-chāi Siōng Chú ū hō͘ pe̍h-chha̍t ê sîn ji̍p tī lí chiah-ê sian-ti ê chhùi; Siōng Chú soan-pò͘ beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ lí.”
Ki-ná-ná ê kiáⁿ Se-tí-ka kiâⁿ chìn-chêng, siàn Bí-kai-ngá ê chhùi-phóe, kóng, “Siōng Chú ê sîn sím-mi̍h sî lī-khui góa lâi tùi lí kóng-ōe?”
Bí-kai-ngá kóng, “Lí khì bih tī ba̍t-pâng hit-ji̍t chiū ōe chai.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kóng, “Chiong Bí-kai-ngá lia̍h--khí-lâi, kau hō͘ chhī-tiúⁿ A-bûn kap ông ê kiáⁿ Iok-a-si,
kā in kóng, ‘Ông kau-tài: Chiong chit-ê lâng koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ, hō͘ i chi̍t-sut-á piáⁿ kap chúi chiū hó, thèng-hāu góa pêng-an tò--lâi.’”
Bí-kai-ngá kóng, “Lí nā chin-chiàⁿ pêng-an tò--lâi, chiū-sī Siōng Chú bô thok góa kóng-ōe.” Koh kóng, “Lín tāi-ke, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit góa kóng ê ōe!”
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap kap Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat khì chìn-kong Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ông tùi Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Góa beh kái-chong chiūⁿ chiàn-tiûⁿ, lí thang chhēng lí ê ông-ho̍k.” Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chiū kái-chong, in chiū chiūⁿ-tīn.
Sū-lī-a -ông ū hoan-hù i ê chiàn-chhia-tiúⁿ kóng, “M̄-thang kap in ê sū-peng á-sī koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kau-chiàn, chí-ū kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ông kau-chiàn.”

Chiàn-chhia-tiúⁿ khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-sa-hoat chiū kóng, “Chit-ê it-tēng sī Í-sek-lia̍t -ông!” In chiū oat-khì beh kong-kek i. Iok-sa-hoat chi̍t-ē hoah kiù-miā, Siōng Chú chiū pang-chān i. Siōng-tè hō͘ in lī-khui bô koh jip i.
Chiàn-chhia-tiúⁿ chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h i m̄-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, chiū oa̍t-cháu bô koh tui i.

Ū chi̍t ê Sū-lī-a ê peng-á khui keng, bô phah-sǹg siā-ji̍p Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chiàn-kah ê kap-chōa. Ông kā sái-chhia--ê kóng, “Góa tio̍h tāng-siong. Kín se̍h hoan-thâu, tòa góa lī-khui chiàn-tiûⁿ.”
Hit-ji̍t, kau-chiàn hui-siông béng-lia̍t. Ū lâng hû Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, hō͘ i khiā tī chhia--ni̍h, bīn ǹg Sū-lī-a -lâng; kàu ē-hng, chha-put-to ji̍t lo̍h ê sî, i chiū sí.
Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat pêng-an tò-khì kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê ông-kiong.

Hap-ná-nî ê kiáⁿ sian-kiàn Iâ-hō͘ chhut-lâi gêng-chiap Iok-sa-hoat -ông, kā i kóng, “Lí ná ōe khì pang-chān pháiⁿ-lâng, thiàⁿ oàn-hūn Siōng Chú ê lâng? In-ūi án-ni, Siōng Chú ê siū-khì ōe lîm-kàu lí.
M̄-kú lí iáu ū hó ê piáu-hiān; lí ū tùi chit-ê kok-ka hòe-tû A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng, koh kian-sim koat-ì chhē-kiû Siōng-tè.”
Iok-sa-hoat tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; āu-lâi koh khì bîn-kan sûn-sī, tùi Pia̍t-sī-pa kàu Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu, chhōa jîn-bîn kui-ǹg Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè.
I tī Iû-tāi choân-tōe ta̍k-ê kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ siat-li̍p sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ.

I tùi hiah-ê sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ kóng, “Lín pān-sū tio̍h kín-sīn, in-ūi lín sím-phòaⁿ m̄-sī ēng lâng ê koân-ui, sī hōng Siōng Chú ê koân-pèng; lín sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, Siōng Chú ōe kap lín tông-chāi.
Taⁿ lín tio̍h kiaⁿ-ùi Siōng Chú, kín-sīn pān-sū, in-ūi Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè bô iông-ún put-gī, bô phian-thán, bô siu hóe-lō͘.”

Iok-sa-hoat tùi Lī-bī -lâng, chè-si, kap Í-sek-lia̍t cho̍k-tiúⁿ ê tiong-kan soán-phài lâng, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ūi Siōng Chú phòaⁿ-koat àn-kiāⁿ, tiâu-kái hun-cheng. In lóng tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
I koh bēng-lēng in kóng, “Lín tio̍h kiaⁿ-ùi Siōng Chú, tiong-sim sêng-si̍t pān-lí tāi-chì.

Tòa tī ta̍k-ê siâⁿ ê tông-pau nā ū hun-cheng lâi chhē lín, bô-lūn sī ūi-tio̍h thâi-lâng, á-sī ūi-tio̍h lu̍t-hoat kap kài-bēng, kui-lē kap bēng-lēng chiah-ê tāi-chì, lín tio̍h kéng-kài in, m̄-thang tek-chōe Siōng Chú, chiah bián Siōng Chú ê siū-khì lîm-kàu lín kap lín ê tông-pau. Lín án-ni chòe, chiū bōe tì-kàu hoān-chōe.

Taⁿ, chong-kàu àn-kiāⁿ iû tōa-chè-si A-má-lī-ngá chòe chòe-āu ê chhâi-koat; bîn-sū àn-kiāⁿ iû Iû-tāi ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī ê kiáⁿ Se-pa-tē-ngá chòe chòe-āu ê chhâi-koat; Lī-bī -lâng chòe koaⁿ-tiúⁿ hia̍p-chō͘ lín. Lín tio̍h hó-táⁿ pān-sū. Goān Siōng Chú kap chèng-ti̍t ê lâng tông-chāi.”
Kè bô jōa kú, Mô͘-ap -lâng kap A-bûn -lâng, koh ū chi̍t-kóa Bí-o͘-nî -lâng, chòe-hé lâi beh kong-kek Iok-sa-hoat.
Ū lâng lâi pò-kò Iok-sa-hoat kóng, “Tùi hái hit-pêng Í-tong hia ū tōa kun-tūi lâi kong-kek. In hiān-chāi tī Hap-sé-sùn Tha-má (chiū-sī Ún Ki-tí).”
Iok-sa-hoat hui-siông kiaⁿ, koat-tēng beh khún-kiû Siōng Chú, soan-pò͘ Iû-tāi choân-tōe kìm-chia̍h.
Iû-tāi -lâng chiū chū-chi̍p, kiû Siōng Chú pang-chān; Iû-tāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ lóng ū lâng chhut-lâi chhē-kiû Siōng Chú.
Iok-sa-hoat chiū tī Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê tāi-hōe tiong, khiā tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān sin ê tiâⁿ ê thâu-chêng,

kî-tó kóng, “Siōng Chú — goán lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, lí kiám m̄-sī tī thiⁿ--ni̍h ê Siōng-tè? Lí kiám m̄-sī bān-pang bān-kok ê chú-cháiⁿ? Tī lí ê chhiú ū koân-lêng ū khùi-la̍t, bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng tùi-khòng lí.

Goán ê Siōng-tè, lí bat tī lí chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-chhut chit-ê tōe ê chū-bîn, chiong chit-ê tōe éng-oán sù hō͘ lí ê pêng-iú A-pek-la-hán ê hō͘-tāi.
In chiū tòa tī chit-ê tōe, koh ūi-tio̍h êng-iāu lí ê miâ tī chia khí sèng-tiān, kóng,

‘Nā ū chai-hō lîm-kàu goán, bô-lūn sī to-kiàm, chek-hoa̍t, un-e̍k, ki-hng, goán beh khiā tī chit-keng sèng-tiān ê thâu-chêng, tī lí ê bīn-chêng ūi-tio̍h goán ê hoān-lān kiû-kiò lí; lí beh thiaⁿ lâi kái-kiù, in-ūi lí lîm-chāi tī chit-keng tiān.’

“Chá-chêng, goán ê chó͘-sian chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe ê sî, lí put-chún in chhim-hoān A-bûn -lâng, Mô͘-ap -lâng, kap Í-tong -lâng ê thó͘-tōe, goán ê chó͘-sian chiū se̍h tùi pa̍t-tiâu lō͘, bô kā in siau-bia̍t.
Hiān-chāi, in lâi beh kóaⁿ-tio̍k goán lī-khui lí siúⁿ-sù hō͘ goán chòe sán-gia̍p ê thó͘-tōe; in kèng-jiân án-ni hôe-pò goán.

Goán ê Siōng-tè ah, lí bô beh chek-hoa̍t in sī--bô? Goán bô khùi-la̍t thang tùi-khòng chiah-ê lâi kong-kek goán ê tōa kun-tūi, mā m̄ chai tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe, m̄-kú goán beh gióng-bōng lí.”
Iû-tāi chèng-lâng, kap in ê sòe-hàn gín-á, in ê bó͘, in ê kiáⁿ-jî, lóng khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.

Hit-sî, Siōng Chú ê sîn tī tāi-hōe tiong lîm-kàu Ngá-hap-sek; i sī Lī-bī -lâng A-sat ê hō͘-tāi, Má-tha-nî ê goân-sun, Iâ-lī ê cheng-sun, Pí-ná-ngá ê sun, Sat-ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ.

I kóng, “ Iû-tāi chèng-lâng, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn, kap Iok-sa-hoat -ông, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Siōng Chú tùi lín án-ni kóng, ‘M̄-bián in-ūi chit-ê tōa kun-tūi kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ sit-táⁿ, in-ūi chiàn-cheng ê sèng-pāi put chāi-tī lín, sī chāi-tī Siōng-tè.
Bîn-á-chài lín tio̍h lo̍h-khì gêng-chiàn; in tùi Sé-su Soaⁿ-phiâⁿ chiūⁿ--lâi, lín ōe tī Iâ-ló͘-i-le̍k khòng-iá thâu-chêng ê soaⁿ-kok-kháu tú-tio̍h in.

Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng, chit-piàn lín m̄-bián chhut-chhiú kau-chiàn; lín chí-ū pâi-tīn khiā--teh, khòaⁿ Siōng Chú án-chóaⁿ kái-kiù lín. M̄-bián kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, m̄-bián sit-táⁿ! Bîn-á-chài chhut-khì gêng-chiàn, Siōng Chú ōe kap lín tông-chāi.’”
Iok-sa-hoat àⁿ-thâu phak tī thô͘-kha; Iû-tāi chèng-lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn mā phak tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, kèng-pài Siōng Chú.
Ko-hat chong-cho̍k kap Khó-la chong-cho̍k ê Lī-bī -lâng lóng khiā--khí-lâi, ēng ke̍k-tōa ê siaⁿ chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.

Keh-ji̍t in chá-chá khí--lâi, chhut-khì Thê-ko-a ê khòng-iá; chhut-khì ê sî, Iok-sa-hoat khiā--teh, kóng, “ Iû-tāi -lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn, thiaⁿ góa kóng, lín tio̍h sìn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, chiū ōe khiā-chāi; sìn I ê sian-ti chiū ōe tek-sèng.”

I kap jîn-bîn chham-siông liáu-āu, chiū siat-li̍p chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn Siōng Chú ê lâng, hō͘ in kiâⁿ tī kun-tūi ê thâu-chêng chheng-chàn sèng-kiat chun-kùi ê Siōng Chú, kóng, “Tio̍h kám-siā Siōng Chú, in-ūi i ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán.”
In chi̍t-ē chhiùⁿ-koa hoan-ho͘ ê sî, Siōng Chú phài bâi-ho̍k ê peng kong-kek hiah-ê lâi kong-táⁿ Iû-tāi ê A-bûn, Mô͘-ap, kap Í-tong -lâng; chiah-ê tùi-te̍k chiū siū phah-pāi.
A-bûn kap Mô͘-ap -lâng kong-kek Í-tong -lâng, chiong in choân-pō͘ châu-bia̍t; châu-bia̍t Í-tong -lâng liáu-āu, in nn̄g cho̍k koh hō͘-siōng chân-sat.
Iû-tāi -lâng kàu khòng-iá ê siú-bōng-tâi, beh khòaⁿ hiah-ê tōa kun-tūi; chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h sin-si tó kah móa-sì-kòe, bô chi̍t ê tô-thoat.

Iok-sa-hoat kap i ê kun-peng lâi chhiau chiàn-lī-phín, chhē-tio̍h chin chōe cheng-siⁿ, châi-bu̍t, i-ho̍k, pó-pòe, chōe kah tòa bōe khì. In chhiúⁿ saⁿ ji̍t, in-ūi mi̍h-kiāⁿ chin chōe.
Tē-sì ji̍t, in chū-chi̍p tī Pí-la-ka ê soaⁿ-kok; in tī hia chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, só͘-í hit só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Pí-la-ka Soaⁿ-kok, kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Iok-sa-hoat chhōa Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, in-ūi Siōng Chú hō͘ in thâi-iâⁿ tùi-te̍k.
In tôaⁿ-khîm, tôaⁿ-sek, pûn lat-pah, lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chìn-ji̍p Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān.
Chiu-ûi lia̍t-kok thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú thâi-iâⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t ê tùi-te̍k, chiū chin kiaⁿ Siōng-tè.
Án-ni Iok-sa-hoat ê kok thài-pêng, in-ūi i ê Siōng-tè sù i sù-kéng-pêng-an.
Iok-sa-hoat chē-ūi ê sî saⁿ-cha̍p-gō͘ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe Iû-tāi -ông jī-cha̍p-gō͘ nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe A-so͘-pa, sī Sī-lī-hi ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Iok-sa-hoat kiâⁿ i lāu-pē A-sat ê lō͘, lóng bô phian-lī, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū.
M̄-kú soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ iáu-bē hòe-tû, jîn-bîn mā iáu-bē kian-sim koat-ì kui-ǹg in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè.
Iok-sa-hoat kî-tha ê sū-chek, tùi thâu kàu bé lóng kì-chài tī Hap-ná-nî ê kiáⁿ Iâ-hō͘ ê chheh; chit-pún chheh mā siu tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Āu-lâi, Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat kap chok-ok-to-toan ê Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap-siā kiat-bêng.
Nn̄g ê ông chòe-hé tī Í-sûn Ka-pia̍t chō-chûn beh khì Tha-si.

Hit-sî, Má-lī-sa -lâng To-tāi-óa ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-í-siā, kóng ū-giân kong-kek Iok-sa-hoat, “In-ūi lí kap A-hap-siā kiat-bêng, Siōng Chú beh phò-hoāi lí chō ê chûn.” Chûn kó-jiân sit-sū, bōe-tàng khì Tha-si.
Iok-sa-hoat tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, kap i ê lia̍t-chó͘ an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ; i ê kiáⁿ Iok-lân sòa-chiap i choh-ông.

Iok-lân ū kúi-nā ê sió-tī, chiū-sī Iok-sa-hoat ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá, Iâ-hiat, Sat-ka-lī-a, A-sat-lia̍t-hu, Bí-ka-le̍k, Sī-hoat-thê-ngá; in lóng sī Iû-tāi -ông Iok-sa-hoat ê kiáⁿ.
In ê lāu-pē ēng chin chōe kim, gûn, pó-pòe, kap Iû-tāi -tōe kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ chòe lé-mi̍h hō͘ in, m̄-kú chiong kok-ūi kau hō͘ Iok-lân, in-ūi i sī tōa-kiáⁿ.
Iok-lân chi̍t-ē khí-lâi tī-lí i lāu-pē ê kok, chiū ka-kiông i ê thóng-tī, thâi-sí i só͘-ū ê sió-tī, kap Í-sek-lia̍t kúi-nā ê siú-léng.
Iok-lân chē-ūi ê sî saⁿ-cha̍p-jī hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông poeh nî.
I kiâⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t chu-ông ê lō͘, só͘ chòe--ê kap A-hap -ke kâng-khoán; in-ūi i chhōa A-hap ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chòe bó͘, chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú in-ūi I kap Tāi-pi̍t só͘ li̍p ê iok, m̄-kam bia̍t Tāi-pi̍t ê ke. Siōng Chú chiàu I ê èng-ún, éng-oán siúⁿ-sù chi̍t pha teng hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun.
Iok-lân choh-ông ê sî, Í-tong pōe-poān Iû-tāi, thoat-lī Iû-tāi ê thóng-tī, siat-li̍p in ka-kī ê ông.
Iok-lân chiū chhōa i ê kun-koaⁿ kap só͘-ū ê chiàn-chhia kè--khì. Í-tong -lâng kā in pau-ûi. Mî--sî Iok-lân kap chiàn-chhia-tiúⁿ khí-lâi hoán-kek.

Án-ni Í-tong -lâng pōe-poān Iû-tāi, thoat-lī Iû-tāi ê thóng-tī kàu kin-á-ji̍t. Siâng hit-sî, Li̍p-ná mā thoat-lī Iok-lân ê thóng-tī, in-ūi i khì-sak Siōng Chú — i lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè.
I koh tī Iû-tāi ê soaⁿ khí soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kiâⁿ siâ-îm, hō͘ Iû-tāi -lâng kiâⁿ phian-lō͘.

Sian-ti Í-lī-a siá-phoe hō͘ Iok-lân, kóng, “Siōng Chú — lí ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘In-ūi lí bô kiâⁿ Iû-tāi -ông, lí ê lāu-pē Iok-sa-hoat kap a-kong A-sat ê lō͘,

tian-tò khì kiâⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t chu-ông ê lō͘, koh hō͘ Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kiâⁿ siâ-îm, chhin-chhiūⁿ A-hap -ke ê só͘-chòe; lí koh thâi-sí lí lāu-pē ê ke hiah-ê pí lí khah-hó ê sió-tī.
Só͘-í Siōng Chú beh kàng tōa chai-hō phah lí ê jîn-bîn, kap lí ê kiáⁿ-jî, lí ê bó͘, í-ki̍p lí it-chhè só͘ ū--ê.
Lí ê tn̂g-á beh hoān-tio̍h tāng-pīⁿ, jú lâi jú giâm-tiōng, tì-kàu tūi--lo̍h-lâi.’”
Siōng Chú kek-tōng Hui-lī-sū -lâng kap óa-kūn Kó͘-si̍t ê A-la-pek -lâng, lâi kong-táⁿ Iok-lân.
In chiūⁿ-lâi kong-kek Iû-tāi, chhim-ji̍p kok-kéng, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t ông-kiong lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê châi-bu̍t, kap i ê kiáⁿ i ê bó͘; chí-ū lâu soah-bé-kiáⁿ A-hap-siā chi̍t ê.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì í-āu Siōng Chú phah Iok-lân, hō͘ i ê tn̂g-á hoān-tio̍h bōe-i--tit ê pīⁿ.
Án-ni thoa nn̄g nî, i ê tn̂g-á tūi--lo̍h-lâi, pīⁿ tāng chiū sí. I ê jîn-bîn bô khí-hé kì-liām i, bô chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng ūi-tio̍h i ê chó͘-sian só͘ chòe--ê.

Iok-lân chē-ūi ê sî saⁿ-cha̍p-jī hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông kiōng poeh nî. I lī-khui sè-kan bô lâng ūi-tio̍h i pi-ai; lâng chiong i an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ, m̄-kú bô kap lia̍t-ông tâi chòe-hé.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn siat-li̍p Iok-lân ê soah-bé-kiáⁿ A-hap-siā sòa-chiap i choh-ông; in-ūi kap A-la-pek -lâng chòe-hé lâi kong-siâⁿ ê kun-tūi, chiong A-hap-siā ê hiaⁿ-ko lóng thâi-sí. Án-ni Iû-tāi -ông Iok-lân ê kiáⁿ A-hap-siā chiū choh-ông.
A-hap-siā chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-jī hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông chi̍t nî. I ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe A-tha-lī-ngá, sī Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Àm-lī ê cha-bó͘-sun.
I mā kiâⁿ A-hap -ke ê lō͘; in-ūi i ê lāu-bú kà i chòe pháiⁿ.
I chhin-chhiūⁿ A-hap -ke chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū; in-ūi i ê lāu-pē sí liáu-āu, A-hap -ke ê lâng lâi kà i chòe pháiⁿ tì-kàu i bia̍t-bông.
I chiap-siū in ê kè-chhek, kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ông A-hap ê kiáⁿ Iok-hô-lân chòe-hé khì Ki-lia̍t ê La-boa̍t, kap Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih kau-chiàn; Sū-lī-a -lâng phah-siong Iok-hô-lân.

Iok-hô-lân tò-khì Iâ-su-lia̍t, beh i-tī i tī La-boa̍t kap Sū-lī-a -ông Hap-sih kau-chiàn ê sî só͘ siū ê siong. Iok-lân ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông A-hap-siā lo̍h-khì Iâ-su-lia̍t, thàm-hóng A-hap ê kiáⁿ Iok-hô-lân, in-ūi i phòa-pīⁿ.

A-hap-siā lâi khòaⁿ Iok-hô-lân, soah tú-tio̍h hām-hāi, che sī chhut tī Siōng-tè ê ì-sù. I tī hia ê sî, kap Iok-hô-lân chhut--khì, tú-tio̍h Lêng-sī ê sun Iâ-hō͘; Siōng Chú ū soán-li̍p Iâ-hō͘, beh hō͘ i siau-bia̍t A-hap -ke.

Iâ-hō͘ teh chip-hêng Siōng-tè ê sím-phòaⁿ, hêng-hoa̍t A-hap -ke ê sî, tú-tio̍h Iû-tāi hiah-ê léng-siù, kap A-hap-siā hiaⁿ-ko ê kiáⁿ — in lóng sī teh sū-hāu A-hap-siā; Iâ-hō͘ chiong in lóng thâi-sí.

A-hap-siā bih tī Sat-má-lī-a, Iâ-hō͘ phài lâng khì lia̍h i; lâng chhē-tio̍h i, kā i tòa-khì Iâ-hō͘ hia, chiong i thâi-sí. Lâng kā i bâi-chòng, in-ūi in kóng, “I sī hit-ê choan-sim chhē-kiû Siōng Chú ê Iok-sa-hoat ê sun.” Án-ni, A-hap-siā ê ke bô lâng ū lêng-le̍k î-chhî ông-koân.
A-hap-siā ê lāu-bú A-tha-lī-ngá chi̍t-ē chai i ê kiáⁿ siū sat-hāi, chiū khí-lâi châu-bia̍t Iû-tāi ông-sek só͘-ū ê hō͘-tāi.

M̄-kú Iok-lân -ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Iok-sī-pa, chiong A-hap-siā ê kiáⁿ Iok-a-si, tùi hiah-ê siū-thâi ê ông-chú tiong thau-phō--chhut-lâi, chiong i kap i ê lin-bú chhàng tī sèng-tiān ê khùn-pâng, bô hō͘ A-tha-lī-ngá chai, hō͘ Iok-a-si bián siū sat-hāi. Iok-sī-pa sī A-hap-siā ê sió-bē, chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê bó͘.
A-tha-lī-ngá tī-lí Iû-tāi -kok ê sî, Iok-a-si kap i ê lin-bú chòe-hé bih tī Siōng-tè ê tiān la̍k nî kú.

Tē-chhit nî, Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ióng-kám chhái-chhú hêng-tōng; tiàu-chi̍p chhōa chi̍t-pah ê peng ê kun-koaⁿ Iâ-lô-hán ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá, Iok-hap-lân ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī, Gô-pī-tek ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá, A-tāi-ngá ê kiáⁿ Má-se-ngá, Sè-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-sa-hoat, lâi kap i li̍p-iok.
In kiâⁿ-thàu Iû-tāi, tùi Iû-tāi hiah-ê siâⁿ chū-chi̍p Lī-bī -lâng kap Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chong-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Só͘-ū ê hōe-chiòng tī Siōng-tè ê tiān kap ông li̍p-iok. Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi tùi in kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, ông ê kiáⁿ tī chia! Chiàu Siōng Chú tùi Tāi-pi̍t hō͘-tāi ê èng-ún, i it-tēng tio̍h choh-ông.
Taⁿ, lín tio̍h án-ni chòe: Lín chiah-ê chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, tī An-hioh-ji̍t ti̍t-pan ê sî, tio̍h saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t kò͘-siú sèng-tiān só͘-ū ê mn̂g,
saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t kò͘-siú ông-kiong, saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t kò͘-siú Kun-ki-mn̂g; hōe-chiòng lóng tio̍h tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ.

Só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn lóng m̄-thang chìn-ji̍p Siōng Chú ê tiān; chí-ū chè-si kap teh ho̍k-sāi ê Lī-bī -lâng thang ji̍p--khì, in-ūi in ū sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú. Só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn tio̍h chun-siú Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng.
Lī-bī -lâng tio̍h tòa kun-khì, tī ông ê sì-ûi pó-hō͘; só͘-ū chìn-ji̍p sèng-tiān ê lâng tio̍h hō͘ i sí; ông bô-lūn tī tó-ūi, lín lóng tio̍h kun-sûi pó-hō͘ i.”

Lī-bī -lâng kap Iû-tāi chèng-lâng, lóng chiàu chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê bēng-lēng khì chòe; ta̍k-ê lâng tòa in ê pō͘-hā, bô-lūn An-hioh-ji̍t ti̍t-pan á-sī bô ti̍t-pan ê lâng lóng lâi; in-ūi chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi m̄-chún in lī-khui.
Chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi chiū chiong khǹg tī Siōng-tè sèng-tiān lāi-bīn Tāi-pi̍t -ông ê chhiuⁿ kap tōa sòe tún-pâi, kau hō͘ hiah-ê koán chi̍t-pah ê peng ê kun-koaⁿ.
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi koh chiong kun-khì pun hō͘ jîn-bîn; in tī chè-tôaⁿ kap sèng-tiān hia, tùi tiān ê lâm-pêng kàu pak-pêng, khiā tī ông ê sì-ûi pó-hō͘.

In chiū chhōa Iok-a-si chhut--lâi, kā i tì ông-koan, chiong iú-koan ông-koân ê iok-su kau hō͘ i; Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ kā i boah-iû, siat-li̍p i choh-ông; in hoah kóng, “Goān ông bān-sòe!”
A-tha-lī-ngá thiaⁿ-tio̍h jîn-bîn ná cháu ná o-ló ông ê siaⁿ, chiū khì kàu chū-chi̍p tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê jîn-bîn hia,

khòaⁿ-tio̍h ông khiā tī sèng-tiān ji̍p-kháu ê thiāu-piⁿ, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kap pûn lat-pah ê lâng khiā tī ông ê piⁿ--á; kok-lāi ê jîn-bîn lóng hoaⁿ-hí, pûn lat-pah; koh ū chhiùⁿ-koa--ê, ēng ta̍k-khoán ê ga̍k-khì chhōa jîn-bîn chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló. A-tha-lī-ngá chiū thiah-li̍h i ê saⁿ, hoah kóng, “Chō-hoán lah, chō-hoán lah!”

Chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi chhōa hiah-ê koán chi̍t-pah ê peng ê kun-koaⁿ chhut--lâi, in-ūi i m̄-ài ū lâng tī Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, chiū tùi in kóng, “Kā i tùi tūi-ngó͘ ê tiong-kan kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; beh tè--i-ê, tio̍h hō͘ i sí.”
In siám-khui siang-pêng hō͘ A-tha-lī-ngá kè--khì; i kàu chìn-ji̍p ông-kiong ê Bé-mn̂g, chiū tī hia hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi kap ông í-ki̍p jîn-bîn chòe-hé li̍p-iok, beh chòe Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn.
Tùi án-ni, choân-kok ê jîn-bîn lóng kā Pa-le̍k ê biō thiah-húi, phah-chhùi chè-tôaⁿ kap ngó͘-siōng, koh tī tôaⁿ-chêng phah-sí Pa-le̍k ê chè-si Má-thán.

Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi phài Lī-bī -lâng chòe chè-si--ê hū-chek kò͘-siú Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān. Chiah-ê chè-si sī chiàu Tāi-pi̍t í-chêng ê kui-tēng, teh hū-chek Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê chit-bū; chiàu Mô͘-se ê lu̍t-hoat, hoaⁿ-hí chheng-chàn, ǹg Siōng Chú hiàn sio-hòa-chè.
I mā phài lâng kò͘-siú Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ta̍k-ê mn̂g; bô-lūn sím-mi̍h iân-kò͘, lé-gî-siōng bô chheng-khì ê lâng lóng bōe-ēng-tit ji̍p--khì.

Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi koh chhōa kun-koaⁿ kap kùi-cho̍k, bîn-kan ê siú-léng kap choân-kok jîn-bîn, chhiáⁿ ông tùi Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān lo̍h--lâi; tùi chiàⁿ-mn̂g chìn-ji̍p ông-kiong, hō͘ i chē ông-ūi.
Choân-kok jîn-bîn lóng hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, choân-siâⁿ lóng pêng-chēng; A-tha-lī-ngá í-keng hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.
Iok-a-si choh-ông ê sî chiah chhit hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông sì-cha̍p nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Se-pí-a, sī Pia̍t-sī-pa -lâng.
Chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi oa̍h--teh ê sî, Iok-a-si chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū.
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi kā i chhōa nn̄g ê bó͘, i ū siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Āu-lâi Iok-a-si koat-tēng beh chéng-siu Siōng Chú ê tiān,

chiū tiàu-chi̍p chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, kā in kóng, “Lín tio̍h khì Iû-tāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng siu sè-kim, thang ta̍k-nî siu-lí Siōng-tè ê tiān. Lín tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín pān-lí chit-ê sū.” M̄-kú Lī-bī -lâng bô sûi-sî pān-lí.

Ông tiàu in ê léng-siù Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi lâi, tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê hōe-chiòng, ū ūi-tio̍h iok-kūi ê hōe-bō͘ kui-tēng tio̍h la̍p ê sè, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ lóng bô bēng-lēng Lī-bī -lâng tùi Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng teng-siu?”
In-ūi hit-ê pháiⁿ hū-jîn-lâng A-tha-lī-ngá kap tè-i--ê bat chhim-ji̍p Siōng-tè ê tiān, koh ēng Siōng Chú tiān-lāi sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú ê mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Pa-le̍k.
Ông chiū bēng-lēng lâng chòe chi̍t ê hōng-hiàn-kūi, hē tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê mn̂g-gōa.
I koh tùi Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê jîn-bîn soan-pò͘, tio̍h chiàu Siōng-tè ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se tī khòng-iá só͘ kui-tēng tio̍h hiàn ê sè-kim, tòa-lâi hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Só͘-ū ê siú-léng kap jîn-bîn lóng hoaⁿ-hí tòa-lâi lok tī hōng-hiàn-kūi, kàu tīⁿ--khí-lâi.

Lī-bī -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h hōng-hiàn-kūi í-keng tīⁿ, chiū tòa-khì hō͘ ông phài ê koaⁿ-oân; ông ê su-kì kap tōa-chè-si ê tāi-piáu chiū lâi, chiong lāi-bīn ê gûn siu--khí-lâi, chiah koh chiong hōng-hiàn-kūi hē tńg-khì goân-ūi. In ta̍k-ji̍t án-ni chòe, siu--tio̍h ê gûn chin chōe.

Ông kap Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi chiong chîⁿ kau hō͘ kàm-tok chéng-siu Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê lâng; in chiū chhiàⁿ phah-chio̍h, choh-ba̍k, phah-thih, kap phah-tâng ê sai-hū siu-lí Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān.
Chòe-kang ê lâng lóng jīn-chin chòe-kang, siu-lí ê kang-thêng chiū sūn-lī oân-sêng; Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān hôe-ho̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng, koh chin kian-kò͘.

Oân-kang liáu-āu, in chiong só͘ chhun ê chîⁿ kau hō͘ ông kap Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi, the̍h-lâi chō Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ê khì-khū, chiū-sī ho̍k-sāi kap hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê khì-khū; koh chō khǹg hiuⁿ ê phiat-á í-ki̍p kim-gûn ê khì-khū. Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi oa̍h--teh ê sî, lâng siông-siông tī Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān hiàn sio-hòa-chè.
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi nî-lāu, hè-siū chiok, chiū sí; sí ê sî chi̍t-pah saⁿ-cha̍p hè.
Lâng chiong i kap lia̍t-ông chòe-hé an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ; in-ūi i tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong ūi Siōng-tè kap Siōng-tè ê tiān ū chin tōa ê kòng-hiàn.
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi sí-liáu, Iû-tāi chèng siú-léng lâi tiâu-kìⁿ ông; ông chiap-siū in ê ì-kiàn.

Ông kap chèng siú-léng pàng-sak Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè ê tiān, khì ho̍k-sāi A-sià-la lú-sîn kap ngó͘-siōng. In hoān chit-ê chōe, Siōng-tè ê tōa siū-khì chiū lîm-kàu Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Sui-jiân Siōng Chú chhe sian-ti khì in hia beh chhōa in kui-ǹg Siōng Chú; sian-ti kā in kéng-kò, m̄-kú in m̄ thiaⁿ.

Hit-sî Siōng-tè ê sîn lîm-kàu chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ Sat-ka-lī-a; i khiā tī koân ê só͘-chāi tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ ûi-pōe Siōng Chú ê kài-bēng, tì-kàu bōe heng-thong hoân-êng? In-ūi lín khì-sak Siōng Chú, Siōng Chú mā khì-sak lín.’”
In kiōng-bô͘ beh hāi Sat-ka-lī-a, chiū chiàu ông ê bēng-lēng, tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ, ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm-sí.

Iok-a-si -ông bô tài-liām Sat-ka-lī-a ê lāu-pē Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi tùi i ê un-chêng, hāi-sí Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ. Sat-ka-lī-a sí ê sî, kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú kàm-chhat sin-oan!”

Nî-bé, Sū-lī-a ê kun-peng chiūⁿ-lâi kong-kek Iok-a-si, lâi kàu Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, thâi-sí jîn-bîn ê siú-léng, chiong só͘ chhiúⁿ ê chiàn-lī-phín ūn-khì Tāi-má-sū-kek -ông hia.

Sū-lī-a ê kun-peng chí-ū chi̍t sió-tūi ê lâng, m̄-kú Siōng Chú hō͘ in phah-pāi Iû-tāi tāi-kun, sī in-ūi Iû-tāi pàng-sak Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, chiah ēng án-ni chek-hoa̍t Iok-a-si.

Iok-a-si siū tāng-siong. Sū-lī-a ê kun-peng thiat-thè liáu-āu, Iok-a-si ê jîn-sîn pōe-poān i, ūi-tio̍h pò-ho̍k i sat-hāi chè-si Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi hiah-ê kiáⁿ, chiong i thâi-sí tī i ka-kī ê bîn-chhn̂g. Lâng chiong i an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ, m̄-kú bô kap lia̍t-ông tâi chòe-hé.
Pōe-poān i--ê sī A-bûn ê hū-jîn-lâng Sī-bí-ap ê kiáⁿ Sat-poa̍t, kap Mô͘-ap ê hū-jîn-lâng Sī-bí-lī ê kiáⁿ Iok-sat-poa̍t.

Iú-koan Iok-a-si hiah-ê kiáⁿ, kap tùi i ê ū-giân, í-ki̍p i chéng-siu Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê sū-chek, lóng kì-chài tī Lia̍t-ông Phêng-lūn-chi̍p. I ê kiáⁿ A-má-siā sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
A-má-siā chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-gō͘ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông jī-cha̍p-káu nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Iok-iâ-tān, sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng.
A-má-siā chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, m̄-kú sim bô choan-it.
I ê ông-koân chi̍t-ē kian-kò͘, chiū chiong thâi-sí i lāu-pē Iû-tāi -ông hiah-ê jîn-sîn chhú-sí.

M̄-kú i bô thâi-sí hiah-ê jîn-sîn ê kiáⁿ-jî, sī chiàu Mô͘-se lu̍t-hoat ê chheh só͘ kì-chài Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng: M̄-thang in-ūi kiáⁿ-jî ê só͘-chòe kā lāu-pē chhú-sí, mā m̄-thang in-ūi lāu-pē ê só͘-chòe kā kiáⁿ-jî chhú-sí; ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe sí.

A-má-siā tiàu-chi̍p Iû-tāi jîn-bîn, chiàu chong-cho̍k tī Iû-tāi kap Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k siat-li̍p chhōa chi̍t-chheng lâng á-sī chi̍t-pah lâng ê kun-koaⁿ. I tiám-sǹg jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng te̍k-soán ê peng ū saⁿ-cha̍p-bān lâng; in lóng ōe-tàng gia̍h chhiuⁿ, the̍h tún-pâi chhut-chiàn.
I koh ēng saⁿ-chheng sì-pah kong-kun ê gûn, tùi pak-kok Í-sek-lia̍t chhiàⁿ cha̍p-bān ê ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū.

Ū chi̍t ê Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng lâi kìⁿ i kóng, “Ông ah, m̄-thang hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-peng kap lí chòe-hé khì; in-ūi Siōng Chú bô kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiū-sī Í-hoat-liân ê hō͘-tāi tông-chāi.
Lí nā it-tēng beh án-ni chòe, bô-lūn lí án-chóaⁿ hùn-ióng chok-chiàn, Siōng-tè mā ōe hō͘ lí thâi-su; in-ūi Siōng-tè ōe-tàng hō͘ lâng iâⁿ, mā ōe-tàng hō͘ lâng su.”

A-má-siā mn̄g Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng kóng, “Góa í-keng ēng saⁿ-chheng sì-pah kong-kun ê gûn hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-tūi, hiah-ê gûn beh án-chóaⁿ?” Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng ìn kóng, “Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ lí koh-khah chōe.”
A-má-siā chiū kái-sàn tùi pak-kok Í-sek-lia̍t lâi ê kun-peng, kiò in tò-khì in tau; in tùi Iû-tāi -lâng chin siū-khì, khì-phut-phut tò-khì in tau.
A-má-siā kian-kiông--khí-lâi, chhōa i ê kun-peng chhut-khì kàu Iâm ê Soaⁿ-kok, thâi-sí chi̍t-bān ê Í-tong -lâng.
Iû-tāi -lâng koh oa̍h-lia̍h chi̍t-bān lâng, chiong in tòa kàu soaⁿ-khàm téng-bīn, tùi hia kā in chhia--lo̍h-khì, in lóng siak kah chhùi-kut-hun-si.

Hiah-ê hō͘ A-má-siā kái-sàn ê Í-sek-lia̍t kun-peng, soah kong-kek Sat-má-lī-a kap Pek Hô-lûn tiong-kan ê Iû-tāi siâⁿ-tìn, thâi-sí saⁿ-chheng lâng, koh chhiúⁿ chin chōe mi̍h-kiāⁿ.
A-má-siā thâi-iâⁿ Í-tong -lâng tò--lâi, tòa in ê sîn-siōng, chhāi chòe sîn-bêng, kā in kūi-pài sio-hiuⁿ.

In-ūi án-ni, Siōng Chú tùi A-má-siā hoat tōa siū-khì, chiū chhe chi̍t ê sian-ti khì kìⁿ i, kóng, “Hiah-ê gōa-cho̍k ê sîn-bêng to bōe-tàng kiù in ê jîn-bîn thoat-lī lí ê chhiú, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ kiû-mn̄g in?”

I kap ông kóng-ōe ê sî, ông kā i cha̍h-ōe kóng, “Tiām--khì! Siáⁿ-lâng siat-li̍p lí chòe ông ê chham-bô͘? Lí ài sí o͘h?” Sian-ti chiū tiām--khì, m̄-kú koh kóng, “Góa chai Siōng-tè koat-tēng beh kā lí siau-bia̍t, in-ūi lí chòe chit-ê tāi-chì, koh m̄ thiaⁿ góa ê khoàn-kài.”

Hit-sî, Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā kap i ê chham-bô͘ chham-siông liáu, phài sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Iâ-hō͘ ê sun, Iok-hap-su ê kiáⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si, kóng, “Lâi, lán lâi chiàn-tiûⁿ piàⁿ su-iâⁿ.”

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si phài sù-chiá khì kā Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā kóng, “ Lê-pa-lūn ê chháu-chhì chhe sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū, kóng, ‘Lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō͘ góa ê kiáⁿ chòe bó͘!’ Āu-lâi Lê-pa-lūn ū chi̍t chiah iá-siù keng-kè, kā chháu-chhì thún-ta̍h.

Lí í-keng thâi-iâⁿ Í-tong, sim chiū kiau-ngō͘ sáng-sè. Lí tiàm lín tau hióng-siū lí ê êng-kng chiū hó, ná beh jiá chai-hō, hō͘ lí pún-sin kap Iû-tāi -kok chòe-hé bia̍t-bông?”
M̄-kú A-má-siā thiaⁿ bōe lo̍h--khì; chit-ê tāi-chì sī chhut tī Siōng-tè, beh chiong in kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k, in-ūi in kiû-mn̄g Í-tong ê sîn-bêng.
Tùi án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si chiūⁿ--lâi, tī Iû-tāi ê Pek Sī-be̍k kap Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā kau-chiàn.
Iû-tāi hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t phah-pāi, ta̍k-ê lâng cháu tò-khì in tau.

Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si tī hia lia̍h-tio̍h Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā, i sī Iok-hap-su ê sun, Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ, kā i tòa kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, koh thiah-húi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, tùi Í-hoat-liân-mn̂g kàu Kak-mn̂g, iok nn̄g-pah kong-chhioh.

Iok-hôa-si chiong ông-kiong ê châi-pó, kap Gô-pia̍t Í-tong ê hō͘-tāi só͘ kò͘-siú Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê kim, gûn, khì-khū lóng the̍h--khì, koh lia̍h lâng chòe jîn-chit, chiah tò-khì Sat-má-lī-a.
Iok-hap-su ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iok-hôa-si sí-liáu, Iok-a-si ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông A-má-siā koh-chài oa̍h cha̍p-gō͘ nî.
A-má-siā kî-tha ê sū-chek, tùi thâu kàu bé lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi kap Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Tùi A-má-siā phian-lī bô tè Siōng Chú liáu-āu, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ū lâng kè-bô͘ beh hāi i, i chiū tô-cháu khì La-kiat. In phài lâng jip kàu La-kiat, tī hia kā i thâi-sí.
Lâng ēng bé chài i ê si-thé tò--lâi, chiong i an-chòng tī Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ, lia̍t-chó͘ ê bōng-tōe.
Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn siat-li̍p O͘-se-a sòa-chiap i ê lāu-pē A-má-siā choh-ông, hit-sî i cha̍p-la̍k hè.
A-má-siā -ông tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia liáu-āu, O͘-se-a siu-hôe Í-lo̍k kui-sio̍k Iû-tāi -kok, koh kā i siu-kiàn.
O͘-se-a chē-ūi ê sî cha̍p-la̍k hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông gō͘-cha̍p-jī nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Iâ-khó-lī-ngá, sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng.
O͘-se-a chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, chiàu i ê lāu-pē A-má-siā ê só͘-chòe khì chòe.
Kàu-tō lâng kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê Sat-ka-lī-a chāi-sè ê sî, O͘-se-a -ông chhē-kiû Siōng Chú. I chhē-kiû Siōng Chú ê nî-ji̍t, Siōng-tè hō͘ i heng-thong hoân-êng.
I chhut-khì kong-kek Hui-lī-sū -lâng, thiah-húi Ka-te̍k, Ngá-pí-nî, kap A-si̍t-tu̍t ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, tī A-si̍t-tu̍t tōe-khu kap tī Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê tiong-kan khí kúi-nā ê siâⁿ.
Siōng-tè pang-chān i phah-pāi Hui-lī-sū -lâng, kap tòa tī Ko͘-ní Pa-le̍k ê A-la-pek -lâng, í-ki̍p Bí-o͘-nî -lâng.
A-bûn -lâng kā O͘-se-a chìn-kòng; O͘-se-a ê miâ-siaⁿ thàu kàu Ai-ki̍p, in-ūi i hui-siông kiông-sēng.
O͘-se-a tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Kak-mn̂g, Soaⁿ-kok-mn̂g, kap siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ oat-kak ê só͘-chāi, khí kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ-lâu.

I tī khòng-iá khí siú-bōng-tâi, koh ó͘ chin chōe chúi-tî, in-ūi i tī soaⁿ-po͘ kap pêng-goân ū chin chōe cheng-siⁿ; koh tī soaⁿ-khu kap pûi ê thó͘-tōe chhiàⁿ lâng chèng-choh kap chéng-lí phû-tô-hn̂g, in-ūi i chin ài chèng-choh.

O͘-se-a ū chin chōe hùn-liān-iú-sò͘ ê kun-tūi; in lóng keng-kè su-kì Iâ-lī kap hù-koaⁿ Má-se-ngá tiám-sǹg, siū ông ê chiong-kun Hap-ná-nî-ngá chí-hui, ōe-tàng sûi-sî hun-tūi chhut-khì chok-chiàn.
Chiah-ê ióng-béng chiàn-sū ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ ū nn̄g-chheng la̍k-pah lâng.
Tī in ê chhiú-ē ū kun-peng saⁿ-cha̍p-bān chhit-chheng gō͘-pah lâng, lóng sī ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū, gâu sio-chiàn, pang-chān ông kong-kek tùi-te̍k.
O͘-se-a ūi-tio̍h choân-kun chún-pī tún-pâi, chhiuⁿ, thâu-khoe, chiàn-kah, kap keng, í-ki̍p beh hìⁿ ê chio̍h.

I koh tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chhiáⁿ gâu ê sai-hū siat-kè ki-khì, an tī siâⁿ-lâu kap siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê oat-kak, ēng lâi siā-chìⁿ, hìⁿ tōa tè chio̍h. O͘-se-a ê miâ-siaⁿ thoân kàu chin hn̄g, kok-ka chin kiông-sēng, in-ūi Siōng-tè pang-chān i.
O͘-se-a kiông-sēng liáu-āu sim chiū kiau-ngō͘, tì-kàu soe-pāi, tek-chōe Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè. I ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, beh tī hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ sio-hiuⁿ.
Chè-si A-sat-lī-ngá chhōa Siōng Chú ióng-kám ê chè-si poeh-cha̍p lâng tè O͘-se-a ji̍p--khì,

chó͘-tòng ông, kā i kóng, “ O͘-se-a, sio-hiuⁿ hō͘ Siōng Chú m̄-sī lí eng-kai chòe ê tāi-chì, sī chè-si A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi siū hun-pia̍t lâi chòe ê chit-bū. Lí tio̍h tùi sèng-tiān chhut--khì, in-ūi lí í-keng hoān-chōe, lí bōe-tàng tit-tio̍h Chú Siōng-tè hō͘ lí ê chun-êng.”

O͘-se-a chhiú the̍h hiuⁿ-lô͘ beh sio-hiuⁿ, chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū tùi khiā tī Siōng Chú tiān-lāi hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ piⁿ hiah-ê chè-si hoat siū-khì; hit-sî i ê thâu-hia̍h hut-jiân khí bâ-hong.

Tōa-chè-si A-sat-lī-ngá kap só͘-ū ê chè-si khòaⁿ-tio̍h i thâu-hia̍h khí bâ-hong, chiū kā i kóaⁿ-chhut sèng-tiān, i ka-kī mā kóaⁿ-kín lī-khui, in-ūi Siōng Chú kàng chai-hō hō͘ i.
