O͘-se-a -ông tì-tio̍h bâ-hong kàu i sí ê ji̍t, i in-ūi bâ-hong siū keh-lī, bōe-tàng koh chìn-ji̍p Siōng Chú ê tiān. I ê kiáⁿ Iok-thán koán-lí ông-ka ê sū, tī-lí kok-chèng.
O͘-se-a kî-tha ê sū-chek, tùi thâu kàu bé ū kì-chài tī A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Í-sài-a ê chheh.
O͘-se-a tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia; lâng kóng “I tì-tio̍h bâ-hong”, chiū chiong i an-chòng tī lia̍t-ông bōng-hn̂g piⁿ--á ê bōng-tōe. I ê kiáⁿ Iok-thán sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iok-thán chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-gō͘ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-la̍k nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Iâ-lō͘-sa, sī Sat-tok ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.

Iok-thán chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, chiàu i ê lāu-pē O͘-se-a ê só͘-chòe khì chòe, put-kò bô chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê lāu-pē ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān sio-hiuⁿ. Jîn-bîn ê só͘-chòe iû-goân pāi-hoāi.
Iok-thán khí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê Siōng-mn̂g, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Gô-hui-le̍k khok-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ,
koh tī Iû-tāi soaⁿ-tōe khí siâⁿ, tī chhiū-nâ lāi khí iàu-sài kap siú-bōng-tâi.

I kap A-bûn -lâng ê ông kau-chiàn, tit-tio̍h sèng-lī. Hit-nî, A-bûn -lâng chìn-kòng gûn saⁿ-chheng sì-pah kong-kun, tōa-be̍h kap sió-be̍h kok chi̍t-chheng kong-tùn; tē-jī nî, tē-saⁿ nî, mā án-ni chìn-kòng.
Iok-thán chiām-chiām kiông-sēng, in-ūi i kian-tēng sūn-ho̍k Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè.
Iok-thán kî-tha ê sū-chek, chiàn-cheng ê kì-lio̍k, kap i ê só͘-chòe, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
I chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-gō͘ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-la̍k nî.
Iok-thán tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ. I ê kiáⁿ A-hap-su sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
A-hap-su chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-la̍k nî; i bô chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū,
tian-tò khì kiâⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t hiah-ê ông ê lō͘, sīm-chì chù-chō Pa-le̍k ê sîn-siōng,
tī Him-lūn-chú Soaⁿ-kok sio-hiuⁿ, sio i ê kiáⁿ-jî hiàn-chòe chè, o̍h Siōng Chú tī in bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-chhut ê lia̍t-kok só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū;
koh tī soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, ta̍k-ê soaⁿ-lûn-á, ta̍k-châng chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū ē-bīn hiàn-chè sio-hiuⁿ.

A-hap-su hoān-chōe, Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè chiū chiong i kau tī Sū-lī-a -ông ê chhiú. Sū-lī-a -ông kā i phah-pāi, lia̍h i chin chōe ê jîn-bîn khì Tāi-má-sū-kek. Siōng Chú koh kā i kau tī Í-sek-lia̍t -ông ê chhiú, thâi-sí chin chōe Iû-tāi -lâng.
Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pí-ka chi̍t ji̍t ê tiong-kan thâi-sí cha̍p-jī-bān ê Iû-tāi cheng-peng; in-ūi in khì-sak Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè.
Ū chi̍t ê Í-sek-lia̍t ê ióng-sū Sè-ki-lī, thâi-sí ông ê kiáⁿ Má-se-ngá, koán-lí ông-kiong ê A-su-lī-kan, kap cháiⁿ-siòng Í-lī-ka-ná.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lia̍h in ê hiaⁿ-tī Iû-tāi -lâng, pau-koat hū-jîn-lâng, kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kiōng jī-cha̍p-bān; koh chhiúⁿ chin chōe chiàn-lī-phín, tòa-khì Sat-má-lī-a.

Tī Sat-má-lī-a, ū chi̍t ê Siōng Chú ê sian-ti kiò-chòe Gô-tek. I chhut-khì gêng-chiap hiah-ê tńg-lâi Sat-má-lī-a ê kun-peng, kā in kóng, “Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè tùi Iû-tāi siū-khì, só͘-í chiong in kau tī lín ê chhiú, lín kèng-jiân siū-khì tú-thiⁿ, thâi-sí in hiah chōe lâng.

Taⁿ lín siūⁿ-beh kiông-pek chiah-ê Iû-tāi -lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng, bô-lūn lâm-lú lóng chòe lín ê lô͘-lē, án-ni lín kiám m̄-sī tek-chōe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè?
Tio̍h thiaⁿ góa kóng, lín lia̍h--lâi-ê sī lín ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, tio̍h pàng in tò--khì, in-ūi Siōng Chú ê tōa siū-khì í-keng lîm-kàu lín.”

Tùi án-ni, ū kúi-nā ê Í-hoat-liân ê léng-siù, chiū-sī Iok-hap-lân ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá, Bí-si̍t-lī-boa̍t ê kiáⁿ Pí-lī-ka, Sa-liông ê kiáⁿ Hi-se-ka, kap Hap-tek-lâi ê kiáⁿ A-má-sat khí-lâi chó͘-chí hiah-ê tùi chiàn-tiûⁿ tò--lâi ê kun-peng,

tùi in kóng, “Lín m̄-thang chiong chiah-ê hu-ló͘ tòa-lâi chia. Lán í-keng tek-chōe Siōng Chú, lín siūⁿ-beh koh ke-thiⁿ lán ê chōe kap kè-sit sī--bô? Lán ê chōe í-keng chin tāng, ū Siōng Chú ê tōa siū-khì lîm-kàu Í-sek-lia̍t lah.”
Tùi án-ni, kun-peng chiū tī hiah-ê léng-siù kap hōe-chiòng ê bīn-chêng, chiong lia̍h--lâi ê lâng kap chiàn-lī-phín kau--chhut-lâi.

Téng-bīn hit sì ê léng-siù chiū khí--lâi, chiàu-kò͘ hiah-ê siū-lia̍h ê lâng; tùi chiàn-lī-phín the̍h saⁿ kap ôe hō͘ thǹg-theh--ê chhēng, koh hō͘ in lim-chia̍h, ēng iû kā in boah; hō͘ kiâⁿ bōe khì--ê khiâ-lû; chiong hiah-ê siū-lia̍h--ê sàng-khì Chang-chhiū-siâⁿ Iâ-lī-ko in ê tông-pau hia. Āu-lâi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū tò-khì Sat-má-lī-a.
Hit-sî, A-hap-su -ông phài sù-chiá khì kìⁿ A-su̍t hiah-ê ông, chhéng-kiû in oān-chō͘,
in-ūi Í-tong -lâng koh lâi phah Iû-tāi, lia̍h chin chōe lâng chòe hu-ló͘.

Hui-lī-sū -lâng mā lâi chhim-hoān sai-pêng soaⁿ-po͘ kap Iû-tāi lâm-pêng ê siâⁿ-tìn, kong-chiàm Pek Sī-be̍k, A-ngá-lûn, Ki-te-lô, í-ki̍p So-ko, Têng-ná, Kín-só chiah-ê siâⁿ kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, koh tòa tī hia.
Siōng Chú ūi-tio̍h Iû-tāi -ông A-hap-su ê iân-kò͘, hō͘ Iû-tāi soe-bî, in-ūi A-hap-su tī Iû-tāi lām-sám chòe, pōe-ge̍k Siōng Chú.
A-su̍t -ông Thê-kek-la Pí-lia̍t-sek chiūⁿ--lâi, bô pang-chān i, tian-tò kā i khi-ap.
A-hap-su tùi Siōng Chú ê tiān, ông-kiong, kap koaⁿ-oân ê ke the̍h châi-pó sàng hō͘ A-su̍t -ông, m̄-kú A-su̍t -ông bô beh lâi pang-chān i.
A-hap-su chit-ê ông tī gûi-kip ê sî, jú tek-chōe Siōng Chú.

I hiàn-chè hō͘ phah i ê Tāi-má-sū-kek ê sîn-bêng; i kóng, “In-ūi Sū-lī-a -ông ê sîn-bêng pang-chān in, góa mā beh ǹg chiah-ê sîn-bêng hiàn-chè, hō͘ in thang pang-chān góa.” M̄-kú hiah-ê sîn-bêng tian-tò hō͘ A-hap-su kap choân Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn soe-pāi.

A-hap-su chiong Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê khì-khū lóng chi̍p óa--lâi, kā in phah-chhùi; i koh chiong Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê mn̂g koaiⁿ--khí-lâi, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ta̍k-tiâu koe-lō͘ ê oat-kak khí chè-tôaⁿ.
I koh tī Iû-tāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ khí soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, sio-hiuⁿ hō͘ pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, jiá Siōng Chú — i ê lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè siū-khì.
A-hap-su kî-tha ê sū-chek kap i ê só͘-chòe, tùi thâu kàu bé lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi kap Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.
A-hap-su tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, lâng kā i an-chòng tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -siâⁿ, bô chòng tī Í-sek-lia̍t chiah-ê ông ê bōng. I ê kiáⁿ Hi-se-ka sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Hi-se-ka chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-gō͘ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông jī-cha̍p-káu nî; i ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe A-pí-ngá, sī Sat-ka-lī-a ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Hi-se-ka chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, chiàu i ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t it-chhè ê só͘-chòe.
Hi-se-ka choh-ông hit-nî ê chiaⁿ--ge̍h, i khui Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê mn̂g, chìn-hêng chéng-siu ê kang-chok.
I tiàu-chi̍p hiah-ê chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng lâi sèng-tiān tang-pêng ê kóng-tiûⁿ,

tùi in kóng, “ Lī-bī -lâng, thiaⁿ góa kóng. Lín tio̍h ka-kī sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú, mā tio̍h chiong Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè ê tiān hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, chiong sèng-tiān só͘-ū ê ù-òe piàⁿ chheng-khì.
In-ūi lán ê chó͘-sian ū hoān-chōe, chòe Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, khì-sak I, bô tì-ì Siōng Chú khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.
In koh koaiⁿ sèng-tiān cháu-lông ê mn̂g, bô tiám teng-hé, bô tī sèng-só͘ sio-hiuⁿ, bô hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.

Só͘-í Siōng Chú ê tōa siū-khì lîm-kàu Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, hō͘ in siū lâng thí-chhiò, hō͘ lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kám-kak khióng-pò͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê án-ni.
Só͘-í, lán ê chó͘-sian hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, lán ê bó͘-kiáⁿ mā hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì.
Hiān-chāi, góa koat-tēng beh kap Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè li̍p-iok, hō͘ I bô koh tùi lán hoat tōa siū-khì.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, m̄-thang koh pàng-gōa-gōa, in-ūi Siōng Chú ū kéng-soán lín khiā tī I ê bīn-chêng ho̍k-sāi, tùi I sio-hiuⁿ hiàn-chè.”

Tùi án-ni, ē-bīn chiah-ê Lī-bī -lâng lóng khí--lâi: Ko-hat chong-cho̍k: A-má-sài ê kiáⁿ Má-hap kap A-sat-lī-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-ní Bí-la-lī chong-cho̍k: A-pek-tí ê kiáⁿ Ki-sū kap Iâ-hap-lī-le̍k ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá Kek-sūn chong-cho̍k: Sin-má ê kiáⁿ Iok-a kap Iok-a ê kiáⁿ I-tiân
Í-lī-sat-hoán chong-cho̍k: Sin-lī kap Iâ-lī A-sat chong-cho̍k: Sat-ka-lī-a kap Má-tha-nî
Hi-bān chong-cho̍k: Iâ-hiat kap Sī-múi Iâ-tō͘-tùn chong-cho̍k: Sī-má-ngá kap O͘-siat
In chio-chi̍p in ê chhin-cho̍k kiat-chēng ka-kī, chiàu ông ê bēng-lēng, kun-kù Siōng Chú ê ōe, ji̍p-khì kiat-chēng Siōng Chú ê tiān.

Chè-si chiū ji̍p-khì kiat-chēng Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, chiong tiān-lāi só͘-ū ù-òe ê mi̍h tòa chhut-khì Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ; Lī-bī -lâng poaⁿ chiah-ê mi̍h khì hiat tī Khip-lûn Khoe-kok.

Kiat-chēng sèng-tiān ê kang-chok tùi chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-it khai-sí, chhoe-poeh chheng kàu Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê cháu-lông. In koh ēng poeh ji̍t kè-sio̍k kiat-chēng Siōng Chú ê tiān, kàu chiaⁿ-ge̍h cha̍p-la̍k chiū oân-sêng.

Tùi án-ni, Lī-bī -lâng chiū khì pò-kò Hi-se-ka -ông, kóng, “Goán í-keng chiong Siōng Chú kui-keng sèng-tiān, hiàn sio-hòa-chè ê chè-tôaⁿ kap tôaⁿ só͘-ū ê khì-khū, khǹg hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ ê toh kap só͘-ū ê khì-khū, lóng kiat-chēng oân-sêng.
A-hap-su choh-ông hoān-chōe ê sî só͘ khì-sak ê khì-khū, goán lóng têng-sin khoán hó-sè, sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú. Hiān-chāi lóng pâi tī Siōng Chú chè-tôaⁿ ê thâu-chêng.”
Hi-se-ka -ông thàu-chá khí--lâi, tiàu-chi̍p siâⁿ-lāi ê léng-siù lóng lâi Siōng Chú ê tiān.

In khan chhit chiah gû-káng, chhit chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, chhit chiah iûⁿ-ko, chhit chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, beh ūi-tio̍h kok-ka, sèng-tiān, kap Iû-tāi jîn-bîn hiàn chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Ông bēng-lēng A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi hiah-ê chè-si, chiong chiah-ê cheng-siⁿ hiàn tī Siōng Chú ê chè-tôaⁿ.
Chè-si seng thâi gû-káng, chiah thâi mî-iûⁿ-káng, koh thâi iûⁿ-ko, chiong múi chi̍t chiah ê huih hiù tī tôaⁿ--ni̍h.
Chòe-āu, in chiong beh hiàn-chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, khan-lâi ông kap hōe-chiòng ê bīn-chêng; ông kap hōe-chiòng chiū hōaⁿ-chhiú tī hit téng-bīn.

Chè-si thâi hiah-ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, ēng in ê huih chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè hiàn tī tôaⁿ--ni̍h, ūi Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng sio̍k-chōe; án-ni in chiàu ông ê bēng-lēng ūi Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap sio̍k-chōe-chè.

Hi-se-ka chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè Tāi-pi̍t -ông, ông ê sian-kiàn Ka-tek, kap sian-ti Ná-tan ê chí-sī, chiū-sī chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè chèng sian-ti só͘ hoan-hù--ê, phài Lī-bī -lâng the̍h poa̍h, khîm, sek tī Siōng Chú ê tiān.
Lī-bī -lâng the̍h Tāi-pi̍t ê ga̍k-khì, chè-si gia̍h lat-pah, chòe-hé khiā--teh.

Hi-se-ka bēng-lēng tī chè-tôaⁿ hiàn sio-hòa-chè. Sio-hòa-chè chi̍t-ē hiàn, in chiū chhiùⁿ chheng-chàn Siōng Chú ê koa, ēng lat-pah, ēng Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Tāi-pi̍t ê ga̍k-khì phōaⁿ-chàu.
Hōe-chiòng lóng kèng-pài, chhiùⁿ-koa--ê gîm-si, pûn lat-pah--ê phōaⁿ-chàu, it-ti̍t kàu hiàn sio-hòa-chè kiat-sok.
Hiàn-chè kiat-sok, ông kap só͘-ū chāi-tiûⁿ ê lâng lóng ǹg Siōng Chú phak-pài.

Hi-se-ka -ông kap hiah-ê léng-siù koh bēng-lēng Lī-bī -lâng, ēng Tāi-pi̍t kap sian-kiàn A-sat ê si chheng-chàn Siōng Chú; in chiū hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí siōng-chàn, àⁿ-thâu kèng-pài Siōng Chú.

Hi-se-ka tùi hōe-chiòng kóng, “Lín í-keng sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú, tio̍h chìn-chêng lâi, tòa chè-mi̍h kap siā-un-chè kàu Siōng Chú ê tiān.” Hōe-chiòng chiū tòa chè-mi̍h kap siā-un-chè lâi; mā ū lâng kam-sim lo̍k-ì tòa sio-hòa-chè lâi.
Hōe-chiòng só͘ hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè ū gû-káng chhit-cha̍p chiah, mî-iûⁿ-káng chi̍t-pah chiah, iûⁿ-ko nn̄g-pah chiah, chiah-ê lóng chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Koh ū hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê mi̍h, gû-káng la̍k-pah chiah, mî-iûⁿ saⁿ-chheng chiah.

M̄-kú chè-si siuⁿ chió, bōe-tàng pak só͘-ū sio-hòa-chè cheng-siⁿ ê phê, só͘-í in ê chhin-cho̍k Lī-bī -lâng pang-chān in kàu hiàn-chè ê sū kiat-sok, koh thèng-hāu hiah-ê chè-si kiat-chēng ka-kī. (Tùi kiat-chēng ka-kī ê sū, Lī-bī -lâng pí chè-si khah téng-chin.)
Sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè ê iû, í-ki̍p kap sio-hòa-chè chòe-hé hiàn ê tiān-chiú-chè chin chōe. Án-ni, Siōng Chú tiān-lāi kèng-pài ê sū koh-chài hôe-ho̍k.
Hi-se-ka kap choân-thé jîn-bîn lóng chin hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi Siōng-tè pang-chān in, hō͘ in chin kín oân-sêng chit-ê sū.

Hi-se-ka phài lâng khì Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi ta̍k só͘-chāi, koh siá-phoe hō͘ Í-hoat-liân kap Má-ná-se ê lâng, iau-chhiáⁿ in lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.
In-ūi ông kap i ê koaⁿ-oân, kap tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê hōe-chiòng, í-keng chham-siông hó, beh tī jī--ge̍h siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.
Chiaⁿ--ge̍h in bōe-tàng siú-choeh, in-ūi kiat-chēng ka-kī ê chè-si ê jîn-sò͘ iáu bô kàu-gia̍h, jîn-bîn mā iáu-bē chū-chi̍p tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Ông kap hōe-chiòng lóng chàn-sêng chit-ê kè-ōe,

chiū tī Í-sek-lia̍t choân-tōe, tùi Pia̍t-sī-pa kàu Tān soan-kò, chhiáⁿ jîn-bîn lóng lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè; in-ūi kè-khì chiàu só͘ siá ê lu̍t-hoat lâi siú-choeh ê lâng bô hiah-ni̍h chōe.

Sàng-phoe ê lâng tòa ông kap i hiah-ê koaⁿ-oân ê phoe, khì Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi choân-tōe, soan-tho̍k ông ê bēng-lēng, kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tio̍h kui-ǹg Siōng Chú — A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè, I chiū beh choán-ǹg lín, chiū-sī lín chiah-ê thoat-lī A-su̍t chu-ông ê chhiú só͘ chhun ê jîn-bîn.
Lín m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ kap lín ê tông-pau. Chiàu lín só͘ chai, in tek-chōe Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, tì-kàu I kā in siau-bia̍t.

Taⁿ m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ ngī-sim kò͘-chip; tio̍h kui-sūn Siōng Chú, chìn-ji̍p I éng-oán hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê sèng-tiān, koh tio̍h ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, hō͘ I bô koh tùi lín hoat tōa siū-khì.

Lín nā kui-ǹg Siōng Chú, lín ê tông-pau kap lín ê jî-lú ōe tùi lia̍h in ê lâng tit-tio̍h lîn-bín, koh tò-lâi chit-ê só͘-chāi, in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè sī chû-pi lîn-bín. Lín nā kui-ǹg I, I it-tēng ōe chiap-la̍p lín.”
Sàng-phoe ê lâng chi̍t-siâⁿ kè chi̍t-siâⁿ, kiâⁿ-thàu Í-hoat-liân, Má-ná-se, ti̍t-kàu Se-pò͘-lûn chiah-ê tōe-khu, m̄-kú hiah-ê lâng kā in thí-chhiò, bú-jio̍k.
A-siat, Má-ná-se, Se-pò͘-lûn tiong-kan ū chi̍t-kóa lâng ka-kī khiam-pi, lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Siōng-tè mā kám-tōng Iû-tāi -lâng, hō͘ in tâng-sim chi̍t-ì sūn-thàn Siōng Chú ê ōe, chiàu ông kap hiah-ê léng-siù ê bēng-lēng khì chòe.
Jī--ge̍h, ū chin chōe lâng chū-chi̍p tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chiâⁿ-chòe chin tōa ê tāi-hōe, beh siú Tû-kàⁿ-choeh.
In chiong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hiàn-chè sio-hiuⁿ ê tôaⁿ lóng sóa-cháu, hiat tī Khip-lûn Khoe-kok.
Jī-ge̍h cha̍p-sì, in thâi Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê iûⁿ-ko. Chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng kám-kak kiàn-siàu chū-chek, chiū kiat-chēng ka-kī, koh tòa sio-hòa-chè lâi Siōng Chú ê tiān.

In chiàu Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng Mô͘-se ê lu̍t-hoat ê kui-tēng, ta̍k-ê lâng khiā tī in sū-hōng ê só͘-chāi; chè-si chiong tùi Lī-bī -lâng chiap--kè-lâi ê huih hiù tī chè-tôaⁿ téng.
Hōe-tiong ū chin chōe lâng lé-gî-siōng bô chheng-khì, só͘-í thok Lī-bī -lâng thòe in thâi Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê iûⁿ-ko, hō͘ in tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng chiâⁿ-chòe chheng-khì.

Tùi Í-hoat-liân, Má-ná-se, Í-sat-ka, Se-pò͘-lûn tōe-khu lâi ê lâng, ū chin chōe bô chiàu kui-tēng kiat-chēng ka-kī, mā chia̍h Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê chè-mi̍h. Hi-se-ka thòe in kî-tó, kóng, “Khún-kiû chì-siān ê Siōng Chú sià-bián
só͘-ū bô chiàu kui-tēng kiat-chēng ka-kī ê lâng, in-ūi in choan-sim chhē-kiû Siōng-tè, chiū-sī Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè.”
Siōng Chú thiaⁿ Hi-se-ka ê kî-tó, chiū sià-bián jîn-bîn.

Tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí, siú Tû-kàⁿ-choeh chhit ji̍t kú; Lī-bī -lâng kap chè-si ta̍k-ji̍t ēng hiáng-liāng ê ga̍k-khì chheng-chàn Siōng Chú.
Hi-se-ka kó͘-lē só͘-ū gâu ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú ê Lī-bī -lâng. Chèng-lâng chia̍h iàn-se̍k chhit ji̍t, hiàn pêng-an-chè, koh kám-siā Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè.
Tāi-hōe choân-thé hōe-chiòng koat-tēng beh koh siú-choeh chhit ji̍t. In chiū hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí koh khèng-chiok chhit ji̍t.

Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka sàng tāi-hōe gû-káng chi̍t-chheng chiah, iûⁿ chhit-chheng chiah; chèng léng-siù mā sàng gû-káng chi̍t-chheng chiah, iûⁿ chi̍t-bān chiah; koh ū chin chōe chè-si kiat-chēng ka-kī.

Iû-tāi hōe-chiòng, chè-si, Lī-bī -lâng, kap tùi Í-sek-lia̍t lâi ê hōe-chiòng, í-ki̍p hiah-ê tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe lâi ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, kap tòa tī Iû-tāi ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, lóng hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
Án-ni, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chhiong-móa hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, in-ūi tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn í-āu, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng m̄-bat chiah-ni̍h hoaⁿ-hí.
Chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng khí-lâi kā jîn-bîn chiok-hok; in ê siaⁿ Siōng-tè ū thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, in ê kî-tó thàu kàu I thiⁿ--ni̍h ê sèng-só͘.

Chiah-ê tāi-chì kiat-sok liáu, tī hia ê Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chiū chhut--khì, khì Iû-tāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ phah-chhùi chio̍h-thiāu-siōng, kòng-tn̄g A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng; koh tī Iû-tāi, Piān-ngá-bín, Í-hoat-liân, kap Má-ná-se tōe-khu, thiah-húi só͘-ū ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ kap chè-tôaⁿ. Liáu-āu, Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng chiū tò-khì ka-kī ê só͘-chāi.

Hi-se-ka chiàu ta̍k-ê chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng ê chit-bū têng-sin cho͘-chit in ê pan-chhù, hō͘ in thang hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè, koh tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê mn̂g-lāi ho̍k-sāi, kám-siā, siōng-chàn.

Ông koh tùi i ê sán-gia̍p hōng-hiàn gû iûⁿ chòe sio-hòa-chè; chiū-sī tī ta̍k-ji̍t chá-àm, An-hioh-ji̍t, múi ge̍h chhoe-it, kap choeh-kî, chiàu Siōng Chú lu̍t-hoat ê kui-tēng hiàn sio-hòa-chè.
Hi-se-ka bēng-lēng Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kiong-kip chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng eng-kai tit--tio̍h ê hūn-gia̍h, hō͘ in choan-sim chip-hêng Siōng Chú lu̍t-hoat ê kui-tēng.

Bēng-lēng chi̍t-ē chhut, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiū tòa chin chōe thâu-chúi ê ngó͘-kok, chiú, iû, bi̍t, kap hn̂g--ni̍h ê chhut-sán lâi; koh tòa ta̍k-hāng mi̍h ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t lâi, sò͘-liōng chin chōe.

Tòa tī Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng, mā khan gû iûⁿ ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t lâi; koh tùi sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè ê mi̍h the̍h cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t, thia̍p chi̍t-tui chi̍t-tui.
Tùi saⁿ--ge̍h khí, in chiong hiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ thia̍p chòe-tui, kàu chhit--ge̍h chiah kiat-sok.
Hi-se-ka kap chèng siú-léng khòaⁿ-tio̍h hiah-ê tún-chek ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, chiū chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, chiok-hok I ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t.
Hi-se-ka tùi chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng chhâ-mn̄g koan-hē hiah-ê tún-chek ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê tāi-chì.

Sat-tok ê hō͘-tāi tōa-chè-si A-sat-lī-ngá ìn kóng, “Tùi jîn-bîn tòa lé-mi̍h kàu Siōng Chú ê tiān í-lâi, goán lóng ū-kàu thang chia̍h, koh chhun chin chōe, in-ūi Siōng Chú sù-hok I ê chú-bîn, só͘-í chhun chiah chōe.”
Hi-se-ka bēng-lēng tio̍h tī Siōng Chú ê tiān-lāi chún-pī chhng-khò͘, in chiū chún-pī.

In sêng-si̍t chiong lé-mi̍h kap cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê hōng-hiàn, í-ki̍p sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú ê mi̍h, lóng poaⁿ--ji̍p-lâi. Lī-bī -lâng Ko-lâm-ngá hū-chek chit-ê sū; i ê sió-tī Sī-múi chòe hù-chú-koán.

Hi-se-ka -ông kap koán-lí Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê A-sat-lī-ngá phài Iâ-hiat, A-sat-se-ngá, Ná-hap, A-sat-hek, Iâ-lī-mô͘, Iok-sat-poa̍t, Í-lī-gia̍p, I-su-má-ki-ngá, Má-hap, kap Pí-ná-ngá, hia̍p-chō͘ Ko-lâm-ngá kap i ê sió-tī Sī-múi.

Sèng-tiān Tang-mn̂g ê siú-ōe Lī-bī -lâng Im-ná ê kiáⁿ Khó-lī, hū-chek koán-lí kam-sim hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè ê mi̍h, koh hun-hoat hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê lé-mi̍h kap hiah-ê chì-sèng ê mi̍h.

Tī chè-si ê siâⁿ, ū I-tiân, Bí-ná-bîn, Iâ-su-a, Sī-má-ngá, A-má-lī-ngá, Sī-ka-nî chiah-ê lâng chòe i ê chō͘-chhiú, tiong-si̍t chiong jîn-bîn ê hōng-hiàn, chiàu in ê pan-chhù, bô-lūn tōa-sòe, hun-hoat hō͘ in ê chhin-cho̍k.
Ū teng-lio̍k tī ka-phó͘ saⁿ-cha̍p hè í-siōng ê ta-po͘-lâng, í-ki̍p ta̍k-ji̍t tī Siōng Chú ê tiān, chiàu in ê chit-bū kap pan-chhù teh ho̍k-sāi ê lâng, mā pun hō͘ in.
In koh pun hō͘ chiàu chong-cho̍k teng-lio̍k tī ka-phó͘ ê chè-si, í-ki̍p jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng, chiàu pan-chhù chip-hêng chit-bū ê Lī-bī -lâng.
In koh pun hō͘ choân-thé hōe-chiòng tiong-kan teng-lio̍k tī ka-phó͘, ū su-iàu hû-ióng ê ka-sio̍k — in ê bó͘, jî-lú; in-ūi in tiong-si̍t hun-pia̍t ka-kī chòe sèng.

Koh ūi-tio̍h tòa tī siâⁿ-gōa chháu-po͘ ê A-lûn hō͘-tāi ê chè-si, tī ta̍k-ê siâⁿ ū chí-phài lâng, chiong mi̍h-kiāⁿ pun hō͘ chè-si ka-cho̍k ê ta-po͘-lâng, í-ki̍p ū teng-lio̍k tī ka-phó͘ ê Lī-bī -lâng.
Hi-se-ka tī Iû-tāi choân-tōe lóng án-ni pān-lí; i chòe Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe hó, chèng-ti̍t, tiong-si̍t ê sū.
I só͘ chòe--ê, bô-lūn pān-lí Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê sū, chun-hêng lu̍t-hoat kap kài-bēng, lóng chhē-kiû i ê Siōng-tè, choan-sim khì chòe, chiū sū-sū heng-thong.
Hi-se-ka tiong-sêng chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì í-āu, A-su̍t -ông Se-ná-ki-li̍p chiūⁿ-lâi chhim-lio̍k Iû-tāi, ûi-khùn kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, siūⁿ-beh kong-chhú chiah-ê siâⁿ.
Hi-se-ka khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Se-ná-ki-li̍p í-keng lâi, chai-iáⁿ i it-tēng beh kong-táⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng,
chiū kap hiah-ê siú-léng í-ki̍p ióng-sū chham-siông, beh that-ba̍t siâⁿ-gōa ê chúi-goân; in lóng chi-chhî i.
Chin chōe jîn-bîn chū-chi̍p, that-ba̍t só͘-ū ê chúi-goân kap lâu-kè hit tōe-khu ê khoe, kóng, “Ná tio̍h hō͘ A-su̍t hiah-ê ông ū chin chōe chúi thang lim?”

Hi-se-ka hùn-hoat, siu-kiàn sún-hoāi ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, khí-chō siâⁿ-lâu, tī siâⁿ-gōa koh khí chi̍t chō chhiûⁿ, ka-kiông Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ ê Bí-lô, koh chè-chō chin chōe kun-khì kap tún-pâi.
Hi-se-ka ū siat-li̍p kun-sū chiòng-léng koán-lí jîn-bîn; i tiàu-chi̍p in lâi siâⁿ-mn̂g ê kóng-tiûⁿ, kek-lē in, kóng,
“Tio̍h kian-kiông ióng-kám, m̄-thang in-ūi A-su̍t -ông kap i ê tōa kun-tūi kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ sit-táⁿ; in-ūi kap lán tông-chāi--ê, pí kap in tông-chāi--ê khah kiông;

kap in tông-chāi--ê sī jio̍k-thé ê chhiú-kut, kap lán tông-chāi--ê sī Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè, I beh pang-chān lán, thòe lán kau-chiàn.” Jîn-bîn in-ūi Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka ê ōe tit-tio̍h chin tōa ê kó͘-lē.

Āu-lâi, A-su̍t -ông Se-ná-ki-li̍p kap i ê choân-kun kong-táⁿ La-kiat ê sî, phài i ê jîn-sîn khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kìⁿ Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka kap só͘-ū Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Iû-tāi -lâng, kóng,
“ A-su̍t -ông Se-ná-ki-li̍p án-ni kóng, ‘Lín teh khò sím-mi̍h, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siū ûi-khùn, lín iáu-teh siú?
Hi-se-ka kóng, Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe kiù lín thoat-lī A-su̍t -ông ê chhiú. I án-ni sī teh phiàn lín, kiat-kio̍k ōe hāi lín iau--sí, chhùi-ta--sí.

Chit-ê Hi-se-ka kiám m̄-sī ū hòe-tû Siōng-tè ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ kap chè-tôaⁿ, koh kā Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng kóng: Lín it-tēng tio̍h tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chit-ê chè-tôaⁿ kèng-pài sio-hiuⁿ?
Lín kiám m̄ chai góa kap góa ê lia̍t-chó͘ án-chóaⁿ tùi-hù lia̍t-kok ê jîn-bîn? Bān-kok ê chèng sîn-bêng kiám bat kiù ka-kī ê kok thoat-lī góa ê chhiú?

Góa ê lia̍t-chó͘ siau-bia̍t ê kok-ka, in ê sîn-bêng tó chi̍t ê ū kiù i ê jîn-bîn thoat-lī góa ê chhiú? Án-ni, lín ê Siōng-tè ná ōe-tàng kiù lín thoat-lī góa ê chhiú-thâu?

Só͘-í, m̄-thang hō͘ Hi-se-ka phiàn--khì, kā lín bê-he̍k, mā m̄-thang siong-sìn i; in-ūi bô jīm-hô chi̍t ê kok-ka ê sîn-bêng ōe kiù i ê jîn-bîn thoat-lī góa kap góa ê lia̍t-chó͘ ê chhiú; lín ê Siōng-tè, I mā it-tēng bōe-tàng kiù lín thoat-lī góa ê chhiú!’”
Se-ná-ki-li̍p ê jîn-sîn kóng chin chōe siat-to̍k Chú Siōng-tè kap I ê po̍k-jîn Hi-se-ka ê ōe.

Se-ná-ki-li̍p koh siá-phoe pòng-to̍k Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, ki-chhì I kóng, “Lia̍t-pang ê sîn-bêng kì-jiân bōe-tàng kiù in ê jîn-bîn thoat-lī góa ê chhiú, Hi-se-ka ê Siōng-tè mā bōe-tàng kiù I ê jîn-bîn thoat-lī góa ê chhiú.”
Se-ná-ki-li̍p ê jîn-sîn ēng Iû-tāi-ōe, tōa-siaⁿ tùi siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng kóng-ōe, kā in khióng-hat, jiáu-loān in ê sim, thang kong-chhú chit-ê siâⁿ.
In tâm-lūn Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Siōng-tè, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh kóng sè-kan-lâng ê chhiú só͘ chō ê sîn-bêng kâng-khoán.
Hi-se-ka -ông kap A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Í-sài-a ūi-tio̍h chit-ê sū kî-tó, ǹg Siōng-tè kiû-kiò.

Siōng Chú chiū chhe chi̍t ê sù-chiá ji̍p A-su̍t -ông ê iâⁿ-tiong, siau-bia̍t hiah-ê kiông-béng ê chiàn-sū, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, kap chiòng-léng. A-su̍t -ông móa-bīn kiàn-siàu tò-khì i ê pún-kok. Ū chi̍t ji̍t, i ji̍p-khì i ê sîn-bêng ê biō, hō͘ i kúi ê chhin-siⁿ-kiáⁿ ēng to kā i thâi-sí.
Án-ni, Siōng Chú kái-kiù Hi-se-ka kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn thoat-lī A-su̍t -ông Se-ná-ki-li̍p kap só͘-ū tùi-te̍k ê chhiú, koh hō͘ in sù-kéng-pêng-an.

Chit-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, Hi-se-ka tit-tio̍h lia̍t-kok ê chun-kèng. Ū chin chōe lâng tòa lé-mi̍h lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, koh tòa pó-pòe sàng Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka.
Hit-ê sî-chūn, Hi-se-ka pīⁿ kah teh-beh sí, chiū tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó; Siōng Chú kā i èng-ún, koh hō͘ i chi̍t ê tiāu-thâu.
M̄-kú Hi-se-ka in-ūi kiau-ngō͘, bô chiàu i só͘ tit--tio̍h ê un-tián pò-tap Siōng Chú; só͘-í Siōng Chú ê sím-phòaⁿ lîm-kàu i, Iû-tāi, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Āu-lâi, Hi-se-ka kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn ūi-tio̍h in ê kiau-ngō͘ khiam-pi jīn-chōe, Siōng Chú chiū bô tī Hi-se-ka oa̍h--teh ê ji̍t kā in sím-phòaⁿ.
Hi-se-ka ū chin chōe châi-hù, koh chin siū lâng chun-kèng. I ūi-tio̍h ka-kī khí hú-khò͘, siu-khǹg kim-gûn, pó-chio̍h, hiuⁿ-liāu, tún-pâi, kap ta̍k-khoán kùi-tiōng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ;
i koh khí chhng-khò͘ siu-khǹg ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, kap iû, mā ūi-tio̍h cheng-siⁿ tah gû-tiâu kap iûⁿ-tiâu.
I koh khí kúi-nā ê siâⁿ, mā ū chin chōe gû-kûn, iûⁿ-kûn, in-ūi Siōng-tè ū siúⁿ-sù i chin chōe châi-hù.
Hi-se-ka tī Ki-hùn-chôaⁿ ê chhut-kháu cha̍h-chúi, kā chúi ín lo̍h-lâi kàu Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ ê sai-pêng. Hi-se-ka só͘ chòe--ê ta̍k-hāng lóng sūn-lī.

M̄-kú, Pa-pí-lûn hiah-ê léng-siù chhe sù-chiá lâi i hia, beh liáu-kái Iû-tāi -kok só͘ hoat-seng ê kî-sū; tī chit-ê sū, Siōng-tè lī-khui i, beh khó-giām i, ài chai i ê sim-su ì-liām.
Hi-se-ka kî-tha ê sū-chek, kap i tùi Siōng Chú ê tiong-sêng, lóng kì-chài tī Iû-tāi kap Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú kap A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Í-sài-a ê Be̍k-sī-su.

Hi-se-ka tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, an-chòng tī Tāi-pi̍t kiáⁿ-sun ê bōng-tōe khah-koân ê só͘-chāi. I sí ê sî, Iû-tāi -lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn lóng ūi-tio̍h i ai-siong, kā i tì-kèng. I ê kiáⁿ Má-ná-se sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Má-ná-se chē-ūi ê sî cha̍p-jī hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông gō͘-cha̍p-gō͘ nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, o̍h hiah-ê hō͘ Siōng Chú tī Í-sek-lia̍t bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-chhut ê lia̍t-kok só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.
I tiông-kiàn i ê lāu-pē Hi-se-ka só͘ húi-hoāi ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, ūi Pa-le̍k khí chè-tôaⁿ, chō A-sià-la ê thiāu-siōng, koh kèng-pài ho̍k-sāi thiⁿ-téng ê bān-siōng.

I tī Siōng Chú ê tiān-lāi ūi-tio̍h hiah-ê sîn-bêng khí kúi-nā ê tôaⁿ; Siōng Chú bat kí chit-ê sèng-tiān, kóng, “Góa ê miâ eng-kai éng-oán tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siū kèng-hōng.”
Má-ná-se tī Siōng Chú ê tiān nn̄g ê tiâⁿ lāi-bīn, ūi-tio̍h thiⁿ-téng ê bān-siōng khí chè-tôaⁿ.

I tī Him-lūn-chú Soaⁿ-kok sio i ê kiáⁿ hiàn-chòe chè, pok-kòa, kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t, kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t, mn̄g khan-bông--ê kap tâng-ki toh-thâu, chòe chin chōe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, kek Siōng Chú siū-khì.

Má-ná-se koh tī Siōng-tè ê tiān-lāi chhāi tiau-khek ê ngó͘-siōng. Koan-hē chit-keng sèng-tiān, Siōng-tè bat tùi Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn kóng, “Chit-keng sèng-tiān kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, sī góa tī Í-sek-lia̍t chi-cho̍k tiong só͘ kéng-soán--ê, góa ê miâ tio̍h tī chia éng-oán siū kèng-hōng.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng nā thiaⁿ-thàn góa só͘-ū ê bēng-lēng, chiū-sī góa thong-kè Mô͘-se só͘ thoân it-chhè ê kà-sī, kui-lē, kap kài-bēng, góa chiū bô koh hō͘ in tùi góa só͘ siúⁿ-sù in lia̍t-chó͘ ê thó͘-tōe siū chhian-sóa.”
M̄-kú Má-ná-se chhōa Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn chòe pháiⁿ, pí Siōng Chú tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bīn-chêng só͘ húi-bia̍t ê lia̍t-kok koh-khah giâm-tiōng.
Siōng Chú kéng-kài Má-ná-se kap i ê jîn-bîn, m̄-kú in m̄ thiaⁿ.
Só͘-í Siōng Chú hō͘ A-su̍t -ông ê kun-tiúⁿ lâi kong-kek in, ēng kau-á kau Má-ná-se, ēng tâng-liān pa̍k i, kā i tòa-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
I tī khùn-khó͘ ê sî chiū khún-kiû Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè, koh tī i lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng hui-siông khiam-pi.
I kiû-kiò Siōng-tè, Siōng-tè chiū thiaⁿ i ê khún-kiû, hō͘ i tò-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, hôe-ho̍k i ê thóng-tī. Má-ná-se chiah chai Siōng Chú sī Siōng-tè.

Āu-lâi, Má-ná-se tī Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ ê siâⁿ-gōa, tùi Ki-hùn-chôaⁿ hù-kūn ê soaⁿ-kok, ǹg pak kàu Hî-mn̂g kap Gô-hui-le̍k tōe-khu, khí chin koân ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, koh siat-li̍p kun-tiúⁿ hông-siú Iû-tāi hiah-ê kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ.

I hòe-tû Siōng Chú sèng-tiān lāi-bīn hiah-ê gōa-cho̍k ê sîn-bêng kap ngó͘-siōng, thiah-húi i tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê soaⁿ kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khí ê tôaⁿ, chiong chiah-ê lóng hiat tī siâⁿ-gōa.
I koh siu-kiàn Siōng Chú ê chè-tôaⁿ, tī tôaⁿ-téng hiàn pêng-an-chè, siā-un-chè, bēng-lēng Iû-tāi -lâng ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.
Jîn-bîn iû-goân tī soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ hiàn-chè, m̄-kú chí-ū hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè.

Má-ná-se kî-tha ê sū-chek, i tùi Siōng-tè ê kî-tó, kap sian-kiàn hōng Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ê miâ tùi i kéng-kài ê ōe, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t Lia̍t-ông-sú.

I ê kî-tó, kap Siōng-tè tùi i ê ìn-tap, í-ki̍p i iáu-bē hóe-kái í-chêng ê chōe-kò kè-sit, kap i tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi khí soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, chhāi A-sià-la thiāu-siōng kap ngó͘-siōng, lóng kì-chài tī Hô-sài ê chheh.
Má-ná-se tńg-khì i ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia, lâng chiong i an-chòng tī i ka-kī ê kiong-lāi. I ê kiáⁿ A-bûn sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
A-bûn chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-jī hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông nn̄g nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê lāu-pē Má-ná-se só͘ chòe--ê. A-bûn tùi i ê lāu-pē Má-ná-se só͘ chō ê ngó͘-siōng hiàn-chè, koh ho̍k-sāi in.
I bô chhin-chhiūⁿ i ê lāu-pē Má-ná-se tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng ka-kī khiam-pi. Chit-ê A-bûn hoān-chōe jú lâi jú giâm-tiōng.
I ê jîn-sîn pōe-poān i, tī ông-kiong lāi-bīn kā i thâi-sí.
M̄-kú kok-lāi ê jîn-bîn chiong hiah-ê pōe-poān A-bûn -ông ê lâng thâi-sí, siat-li̍p i ê kiáⁿ Iok-se-a sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iok-se-a chē-ūi ê sî poeh hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông saⁿ-cha̍p-it nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū, kiâⁿ i ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t ê lō͘, bô phian-chó-phian-iū.

Iok-se-a choh-ông tē-poeh nî, iáu siàu-liân chiū chhē-kiû i ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t ê Siōng-tè; sì nî āu, khai-sí kiat-chēng Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, sàu-tû soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, A-sià-la thiāu-siōng, tiau-khek ê siōng, kap chù-chō ê siōng.

Jîn-bîn chiàu i ê bēng-lēng húi-hoāi Pa-le̍k ê tôaⁿ, chām-tn̄g tôaⁿ-téng koân-koân ê hiuⁿ-tâi; i koh chiong A-sià-la thiāu-siōng, tiau-khek ê siōng, kap chù-chō ê siōng phah-chhùi, géng-chòe hún, iā tī hiah-ê bat hiàn-chè hō͘ ngó͘-siōng ê lâng ê bōng;
chiong gōa-pang sîn-bêng ê chè-si ê kut-thâu hē tī in ê chè-tôaⁿ téng sio, ēng án-ni kiat-chēng Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Iok-se-a koh tī Má-ná-se, Í-hoat-liân, Se-biān, kap Ná-hut-tha-lī tōe-khu hiah-ê hong-hòe ê siâⁿ,
thiah-húi chè-tôaⁿ, phah-chhùi A-sià-la thiāu-siōng kap tiau-khek ê siōng, géng-chòe hún, chām-tn̄g Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k só͘-chāi ê hiuⁿ-tâi, chiū tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Iok-se-a choh-ông tē-cha̍p-poeh nî, thó͘-tōe kap sèng-tiān kiat-chēng liáu-āu, i phài A-sat-lī-ngá ê kiáⁿ Sa-hoan, chhī-tiúⁿ Má-se-ngá, Iok-hap-su ê kiáⁿ sú-koaⁿ Iok-a, khì chéng-siu Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè ê tiān.

In chiū khì kìⁿ tōa-chè-si Hi-le̍k-ka, chiong só͘-ū hiàn tī Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê gûn kau hō͘ i; chiah-ê gûn sī sèng-tiān mn̂g-kháu ê siú-ōe Lī-bī -lâng tùi Má-ná-se, Í-hoat-liân, kap Í-sek-lia̍t só͘-ū chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng, í-ki̍p Iû-tāi, Piān-ngá-bín, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê jîn-bîn siu--lâi-ê.

In chiong hiah-ê gûn kau hō͘ koán-lí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê lâng, hō͘ in choán-kau Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ê kang-lâng, chiū-sī choh-ba̍k sai-hū kap kiàn-tio̍k kang-lâng, khì bóe phah-hó ê chio̍h, chòe niû kap thiāu ê bo̍k-châi, thang siu-lí sèng-tiān lāi-bīn hō͘ hiah-ê Iû-tāi -ông sún-hoāi ê só͘-chāi.

Hiah-ê lâng chòe tāi-chì sêng-si̍t; kàm-kang--ê sī Lī-bī -lâng Bí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ-sun Ngá-hap kap Gô-pa-tí-a, tok-kang--ê sī Ko-hat ê kiáⁿ-sun Sat-ka-lī-a kap Bí-su-lân, koh ū chin gâu chàu-ga̍k ê Lī-bī -lâng.
In koán-lí hiah-ê ūn-poaⁿ ê kang-lâng, mā kàm-tok só͘-ū chòe ta̍k-khoán kang-chok ê lâng; Lī-bī -lâng ū-ê chòe su-kì, chòe koaⁿ-oân, kap siú-ōe.
In chiong hiàn tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê gûn poaⁿ--chhut-khì ê sî, tōa-chè-si Hi-le̍k-ka hoat-kiàn Mô͘-se só͘ thoân Siōng Chú lu̍t-hoat ê chheh.
Hi-le̍k-ka tùi su-kì Sa-hoan kóng, “Góa tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān lāi-bīn hoat-kiàn chi̍t kńg lu̍t-hoat ê chheh.” Hi-le̍k-ka chiong chheh kau hō͘ Sa-hoan.
Sa-hoan chiū tòa chit-kńg chheh khì ông hia, kā ông pò-kò kóng, “Ông kau-thok lí ê po̍k-jîn ê kang-chok, in lóng ū teh chòe.
Hōng-hiàn tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê gûn lóng piàⁿ--chhut-lâi, kau hō͘ tok-kang kap kang-lâng.”
Su-kì Sa-hoan koh tùi ông kóng, “Tōa-chè-si Hi-le̍k-ka ū the̍h chi̍t kńg chheh hō͘ góa.” Sa-hoan chiū tī ông ê bīn-chêng tōa-siaⁿ tha̍k hit-kńg chheh.
Ông thiaⁿ-tio̍h lu̍t-hoat ê ōe, chiū thiah-li̍h i ê saⁿ.
Ông hoan-hù Hi-le̍k-ka, Sa-hoan ê kiáⁿ A-hi-kam, Bí-ka ê kiáⁿ A-pek-tùn, su-kì Sa-hoan, kap ông ê jîn-sîn A-sat-ngá, kóng,

“Lín khì, ūi góa, ūi Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê jîn-bîn, chiong só͘ hoat-kiàn chit-kńg chheh ê ōe chhéng-būn Siōng Chú. In-ūi lán ê chó͘-sian bô chun-siú Siōng Chú ê ōe, bô chiàu chit-kńg chheh só͘ kì-chài ê kà-sī khì chòe, só͘-í Siōng Chú tùi lán hoat tōa siū-khì.”

Tùi án-ni, Hi-le̍k-ka kap ông só͘ phài ê lâng chòe-hé khì kìⁿ lú sian-ti Hō͘-le̍k-tāi. I sī koán-lí lé-ho̍k hit-ê Sa-liông ê bó͘; Sa-liông sī Hap-ní-hap-su ê sun, Te̍k-óa ê kiáⁿ. Hō͘-le̍k-tāi tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sin ê siâⁿ-khu. In kā i chhéng-kàu.
I tùi in kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lín khì hôe-ho̍k chhe lín lâi kìⁿ góa ê lâng, kā i kóng
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh chiàu tī Iû-tāi -ông bīn-chêng tha̍k ê chheh só͘ kì-chài ê chiù-chó͘, kàng chai-hō tī chit-ê só͘-chāi kap chia ê chū-bîn.
In-ūi in khì-sak góa, kā pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ, ēng in ê só͘-chòe kek góa siū-khì, só͘-í góa beh chiong tōa siū-khì piàⁿ-lo̍h tī chit-ê só͘-chāi bô-soah.’
M̄-kú chhe lín lâi chhéng-būn Siōng Chú ê Iû-tāi -ông, lín tio̍h án-ni tùi i kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Lí thiaⁿ-tio̍h

góa tùi chit-ê só͘-chāi kap chia ê chū-bîn kéng-kò ê ōe, lí chiū chhàm-hóe, tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng khiam-pi, koh thiah-li̍h saⁿ, tī góa ê bīn-chêng thî-khàu, góa ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h. Siōng Chú kóng:

Góa beh hō͘ lí pêng-an lī-khui sè-kan, tńg-khì lí ê lia̍t-chó͘ hia. Lí bōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa só͘ beh kàng-lo̍h tī chit só͘-chāi kap chia ê chū-bîn it-chhè ê chai-hō.’” In chiū tò--khì, chiong chiah-ê ōe tùi ông hôe-ho̍k.
Iok-se-a -ông phài lâng tiàu-chi̍p Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chèng tiúⁿ-ló.

Ông chiūⁿ-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān; Iû-tāi chèng-lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘-ū ê chū-bîn, chè-si, Lī-bī -lâng, kap só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn, bô-lūn tōa-sòe, mā lóng chiūⁿ--khì. Ông chiū chiong tī Siōng Chú tiān-lāi hoat-kiàn ê iok-su it-chhè ê ōe tha̍k hō͘ in thiaⁿ.

Ông khiā tī i ê ūi, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng li̍p-iok, beh choân-sim choân-ì sūn-thàn Siōng Chú, chun-siú I ê kài-bēng, kà-sī, kap kui-lē, si̍t-hêng chit-kńg chheh só͘ siá li̍p-iok ê ōe.

I hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Piān-ngá-bín só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn lóng tah-èng chun-siú chit-ê iok; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn chiū chun-hêng in kap in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè só͘ li̍p ê iok.

Iok-se-a chiong kok-lāi it-chhè khó-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng tû--khì, koh hō͘ só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè. Iok-se-a oa̍h--teh ê ji̍t, jîn-bîn sūn-thàn Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè, lóng bô phian-lī.
Iok-se-a tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú. Chiaⁿ-ge̍h cha̍p-sì, jîn-bîn thâi pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê iûⁿ-á.
Ông phài chè-si chip-hêng in ê chit-bū, koh bián-lē in pān-lí Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê kang-chok.

Koh tùi hiah-ê sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú, kàu-tō Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê Lī-bī -lâng kóng, “Lín tio̍h chiong sèng ê iok-kūi hē tī Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Só͘-lô-bûn só͘ khí ê sèng-tiān lāi-bīn, m̄-bián koh kng-lâi-kng-khì. Taⁿ lín tio̍h ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, kap I ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t.
Tio̍h chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê kui-tēng, chiàu lín ê chong-cho̍k, lín ê pan-chhù chún-pī hó-sè.
Lín Lī-bī -lâng tio̍h chiàu chong-cho̍k ê pâng-thâu, hun cho͘ ê ka-têng, khiā tī sèng-tiān ho̍k-bū lín ê hiaⁿ-tī.
Tio̍h chiàu Siōng Chú thong-kè Mô͘-se só͘ thoân ê ōe, thâi Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê iûⁿ-ko, kiat-chēng ka-kī, ūi-tio̍h lín ê chhin-cho̍k chún-pī hó-sè.”

Iok-se-a -ông tùi i ê sán-gia̍p the̍h-chhut mî-iûⁿ-á kap soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á kiōng saⁿ-bān chiah, gû-káng saⁿ-chheng chiah, hō͘ só͘-ū chāi-tiûⁿ ê jîn-bîn chòe Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê chè-mi̍h.

Ông ê tāi-sîn mā hoaⁿ-hí thê-kiong chè-mi̍h hō͘ jîn-bîn, chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng. Koán-lí Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê Hi-le̍k-ka, Sat-ka-lī-a, Iâ-hiat, ēng iûⁿ-á nn̄g-chheng la̍k-pah chiah, gû saⁿ-pah chiah, hō͘ chè-si chòe Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê chè-mi̍h.

Lī-bī -lâng ê léng-siù Ko-lâm-ngá, kap i nn̄g ê hiaⁿ-tī Sī-má-ngá kap Ná-thán-gia̍p, í-ki̍p Hap-sa-pí-ngá, Iâ-lī, Iok-sat-poa̍t, ēng iûⁿ-á gō͘-chheng chiah, gû gō͘-pah chiah, hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng chòe Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê chè-mi̍h.
Án-ni, ho̍k-sāi ê tāi-chì lóng chún-pī hó-sè, chiàu ông ê bēng-lēng, chè-si khiā tī in ê ūi, Lī-bī -lâng mā chiàu in ê pan-chhù khiā--teh.
Lī-bī -lâng thâi Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê iûⁿ-á, chè-si tùi in ê chhiú chiap huih lâi hiù; Lī-bī -lâng kā iûⁿ-á pak-phê,

chiong sio-hòa-chè ê chè-mi̍h chiàu chong-cho̍k ê pâng-thâu pun hō͘ jîn-bîn, hō͘ in chiàu Mô͘-se ê chheh só͘ siá--ê hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. Hiàn gû chòe chè-mi̍h mā-sī án-ni chòe.
In chiàu kui-tēng, ēng hé hang Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê iûⁿ-á, kî-tha ê chè-mi̍h ēng e-á, tiáⁿ, phûn chú; chú liáu-āu, kóaⁿ-kín pun hō͘ jîn-bîn.
Í-āu, Lī-bī -lâng chiah ūi ka-kī kap chè-si chún-pī bah, in-ūi A-lûn ê hō͘-tāi chòe chè-si--ê it-ti̍t teh hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap chè-mi̍h ê iû kàu àm-sî.

A-sat ê hō͘-tāi hū-chek chhiùⁿ-koa ê lâng, chiàu Tāi-pi̍t, A-sat, Hi-bān, kap ông ê sian-kiàn Iâ-tō͘-tùn ê kui-tēng, chiàu in ê chit-ūi khiā--teh; kò͘-mn̂g ê siú-ōe khàn-siú ta̍k-ê mn̂g; in m̄-bián lī-khui in ê chit-bū, in-ūi in ê chhin-cho̍k Lī-bī -lâng thòe in chún-pī chè-mi̍h.
Hit-ji̍t, ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú ê tāi-chì lóng chún-pī hó-sè, chiàu Iok-se-a -ông ê bēng-lēng siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, tī Siōng Chú ê tôaⁿ hiàn sio-hòa-chè.
Hit-sî, chāi-tiûⁿ ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe-hé siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, koh siú Tû-kàⁿ-choeh chhit ji̍t.

Tùi sian-ti Sat-bó-ní ê sî-tāi í-lâi, Í-sek-lia̍t m̄-bat chiah-ni̍h sēng-tāi siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh; Í-sek-lia̍t ê lia̍t-ông mā lóng m̄-bat án-ni siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, chhin-chhiūⁿ Iok-se-a, chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, í-ki̍p chāi-tiûⁿ ê Iû-tāi kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn án-ni siú-choeh.
Chit-piàn ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh tī Iok-se-a choh-ông tē-cha̍p-poeh nî kú-hêng.
Iok-se-a chéng-siu sèng-tiān liáu-āu, Ai-ki̍p -ông Nî-ko chiūⁿ--lâi, beh kong-táⁿ Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hô-piⁿ ê Ka-ki-bí-si. Iok-se-a -ông chhut-khì gêng-chiàn.

Nî-ko phài sù-chiá lâi kìⁿ Iok-se-a, kóng, “ Iû-tāi -ông, góa kap lí ū sím-mi̍h koan-hē? Góa kin-á-ji̍t lâi m̄-sī beh kong-kek lí, sī beh kong-kek kap góa kau-chiàn ê kok-ka; Siōng-tè bēng-lēng góa tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín chòe chit-ê sū. Lí m̄-thang hoán-tùi kap góa tông-chāi ê Siōng-tè, chiah bián I kā lí húi-bia̍t.”
M̄-kú Iok-se-a m̄ thiaⁿ Siōng-tè thong-kè Nî-ko só͘ kóng ê ōe, kian-chhî beh kap i kau-chiàn. Iok-se-a piàn-chong lâi kàu Bí-kiat-to pêng-goân, kap Nî-ko kau-chiàn.
Siā-chìⁿ ê lâng siā-tio̍h Iok-se-a -ông; ông tùi i ê jîn-sîn kóng, “Góa siū tāng-siong lah! Chài góa lī-khui chiàn-tiûⁿ.”

I ê jîn-sîn hû i chhut hit-tâi chhia, hō͘ i chē tē-jī tâi chhia, chài i tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; i chiū sí, lâng chiong i an-chòng tī i lia̍t-chó͘ ê bōng. Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng lóng ūi-tio̍h Iok-se-a ai-siong.

Iâ-lī-bí ūi-tio̍h Iok-se-a choh ai-ko; só͘-ū chhiùⁿ-koa ê lâm-lú kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu-teh chhiùⁿ chiah-ê ai-ko kì-liām Iok-se-a; chit-ê mā chiâⁿ-chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê koàn-lē. Chiah-ê ai-ko lóng siu-chi̍p tī Ai-ko-chi̍p.
Iok-se-a kî-tha ê sū-chek, pau-koat i tùi Siōng Chú lu̍t-hoat ê tiong-sêng,
kap i it-seng só͘-chòe ê sū, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú.
Iû-tāi jîn-bîn tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siat-li̍p Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-su choh-ông, sòa-chiap i ê lāu-pē.
Iok-hap-su chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-saⁿ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông saⁿ ge̍h-ji̍t kú.
Ai-ki̍p -ông tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hòe-tû i ê ông-ūi, koh hoa̍t Iû-tāi -kok kim saⁿ-cha̍p-sì kong-kun, gûn saⁿ-chheng sì-pah kong-kun.
Ai-ki̍p -ông siat-li̍p Iok-hap-su ê hiaⁿ-ko Í-lī-a-kèng chòe Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê ông, kā i kái-miâ chòe Iok-ngá-kèng. Nî-ko kā Iok-hap-su lia̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p.
Iok-ngá-kèng chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-gō͘ hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-it nî; i chòe Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chiūⁿ-lâi kong-táⁿ i, ēng tâng-liān kā i liān--teh, kā i lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat koh chiong Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ê khì-khū ūn-khì Pa-pí-lûn, hē tī Pa-pí-lûn i ê kiong-lāi.

Iok-ngá-kèng kî-tha ê sū-chek, kap i só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, í-ki̍p lâng tùi i ê chí-chek, lóng kì-chài tī Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi Lia̍t-ông-sú. I ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kun sòa-chiap i choh-ông.
Iok-ngá-kun chē-ūi ê sî cha̍p-poeh hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông saⁿ kò-ge̍h koh cha̍p ji̍t; i chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū.

Keh-tńg-nî, Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat phài lâng chiong i kap Siōng Chú tiān-lāi hiah-ê pó-pòe ê khì-khū tòa kàu Pa-pí-lûn, jiân-āu siat-li̍p i ê a-chek Se-tí-ka chòe Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê ông.
Se-tí-ka chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-it hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-it nî.
I chòe Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū; i bô khiam-pi thiaⁿ-thàn sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí só͘ thoân-ta̍t Siōng Chú ê ōe.

Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông bat kiông-pek Se-tí-ka kí Siōng-tè chiù-chōa tùi i tiong-sêng, m̄-kú Se-tí-ka pōe-poān i. Se-tí-ka kò͘-chip ngī-sim, m̄-khéng kui-ǹg Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.
Koh hiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap jîn-bîn mā hoān tōa-chōe, o̍h gōa-pang khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, phah lâ-sâm Siōng Chú tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê sèng-tiān.
Siōng Chú — in lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè lîn-bín I ê chú-bîn kap I khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, put-toān phài sù-chiá khì I ê chú-bîn hia,
m̄-kú in thí-chhiò Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá, biáu-sī I ê ōe, ki-chhì I ê sian-ti, tì-kàu Siōng Chú tùi I ê chú-bîn hoat tōa siū-khì, hō͘ in bô hoat-tō͘ tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.

Só͘-í, Siōng-tè chhōa Pa-pí-lûn -ông lâi kong-kek in, tī sèng-tiān ēng to thâi-sí siàu-liân-lâng, bô lîn-bín in ê siàu-lâm kap siàu-lú, lāu-lâng kap soe-jio̍k--ê; Siōng-tè chiong in lóng kau tī Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê chhiú.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông koh chiong Siōng-tè tiān-lāi tōa-sòe ê khì-khū kap châi-pó, í-ki̍p ông kap hiah-ê siú-léng ê châi-pó, lóng tòa-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
In koh sio Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān, thiah-húi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, ēng hé sio siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū ê kiong-tiān, húi-hoāi pó-pòe ê khì-khū.
Só͘-ū bô hō͘ lâng thâi--sí-ê, lóng siū-lia̍h khì Pa-pí-lûn, chòe Pa-pí-lûn -ông kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun ê lô͘-lē, ti̍t-kàu Pho-su -kok heng-khí.
Chit-ê sū teh si̍t-hiān Siōng Chú thong-kè Iâ-lī-bí só͘ kóng ê ōe, thó͘-tōe beh hong-hòe tit-tio̍h an-hioh, kàu móa chhit-cha̍p nî.

Pho-su hông-tè Sài-ló͘-sū goân-nî, Siōng Chú ūi-tio̍h beh si̍t-hiān I thong-kè Iâ-lī-bí ê chhùi só͘ kóng ê ōe, kám-tōng Pho-su hông-tè Sài-ló͘-sū, hō͘ i tùi choân-kok pan-pò͘ kóng,

“ Pho-su hông-tè Sài-ló͘-sū án-ni kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè chiong thian-hā bān-kok siúⁿ-sù góa, koh chí-phài góa tī Iû-tāi ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ūi-tio̍h I khí sèng-tiān. Lín tiong-kan só͘-ū chòe I chú-bîn--ê thang tńg--khì. Goān Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè kap in tông-chāi.’”

Pho-su hông-tè Sài-ló͘-sū goân-nî, Siōng Chú ūi-tio̍h beh si̍t-hiān I thong-kè Iâ-lī-bí ê chhùi só͘ kóng ê ōe, kám-tōng Pho-su hông-tè Sài-ló͘-sū, hō͘ i tùi choân-kok pan-pò͘ kóng,

“ Pho-su hông-tè Sài-ló͘-sū án-ni kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè chiong thian-hā bān-kok siúⁿ-sù góa, koh chí-phài góa tī Iû-tāi ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ūi-tio̍h I khí sèng-tiān.

Lín tiong-kan só͘-ū chòe I chú-bîn--ê, thang tńg-khì Iû-tāi ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, khí Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān; I sī tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siū kèng-pài ê Siōng-tè. Goān Siōng-tè kap in tông-chāi.

Só͘-ū chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng, bô-lūn tòa tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, hit só͘-chāi ê lâng tio̍h ēng kim, gûn, châi-bu̍t, cheng-siⁿ pang-chān in; mā tio̍h ūi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān, kam-sim hōng-hiàn.’”

Tùi án-ni, Iû-tāi kap Piān-ngá-bín ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, chè-si, Lī-bī -lâng, só͘-ū siū Siōng-tè kám-tōng ê lâng lóng chún-pī hó-sè, beh chiūⁿ-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khí-chō Siōng Chú ê tiān.
In ê chhù-piⁿ chiū ēng gûn-khì, kim, châi-bu̍t, cheng-siⁿ, pó-pòe, pang-chān in; lēng-gōa koh ūi sèng-tiān kam-sim hōng-hiàn.
Sài-ló͘-sū -ông mā chiong í-chêng Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chhiúⁿ--lâi, hē tī i ê sîn-biō hiah-ê Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ê khì-khū, the̍h chhut-lâi hêng in.
Pho-su hông-tè Sài-ló͘-sū chí-phài koán-lí hú-khò͘ ê Bí-thê-lī-ta̍t chiong chiah-ê khì-khū the̍h--chhut-lâi, tiám-sǹg, kau hō͘ Iû-tāi ê siú-léng Siat-pa-sat.
In ê sò͘-bo̍k kì tī ē-bīn: kim-pôaⁿ saⁿ-cha̍p tè gûn-pôaⁿ chi̍t-chheng tè to jī-cha̍p-káu ki
kim-óaⁿ saⁿ-cha̍p tè gûn-óaⁿ nn̄g-chheng sì-pah cha̍p tè kî-tha ê khì-khū chi̍t-chheng kiāⁿ
kim gûn ê khì-khū kiōng gō͘-chheng sì-pah kiāⁿ. Siū-lia̍h ê lâng tùi Pa-pí-lûn chiūⁿ-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sî, Siat-pa-sat chiong chiah-ê khì-khū lóng chòe-hé tòa--lâi.

Í-chêng tùi Iû-tāi -tōe hō͘ Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn ê jîn-bîn, hiān-chāi tùi hia tò-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi, tńg-khì ta̍k-ê lâng ê kò͘-hiong;

in kap Só͘-lô-pa-pek, Iâ-su-a, Nî-hi-bí, Se-lâi-ngá, Lī-lâi-ngá, Boa̍t-tí-kái, Pit-san, Bí-su-poa̍t, Pí-kek-óa-i, Lī-hông, Pa-ná chòe-hé tò--lâi. Í-hā sī chiah-ê tò--lâi ê Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ê jîn-sò͘:
Pa-lio̍k ê hō͘-tāi nn̄g-chheng chi̍t-pah chhit-cha̍p-jī lâng
Sī-hoat-thê-ngá ê hō͘-tāi saⁿ-pah chhit-cha̍p-jī lâng
A-la ê hō͘-tāi chhit-pah chhit-cha̍p-gō͘ lâng
Pa-hap Mô͘-ap ê hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī Iâ-su-a kap Iok-ap ê hō͘-tāi, nn̄g-chheng poeh-pah cha̍p-jī lâng
Í-lân ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p-sì lâng
Sat-thó͘ ê hō͘-tāi káu-pah sì-cha̍p-gō͘ lâng
Sat-kái ê hō͘-tāi chhit-pah la̍k-cha̍p lâng
Pa-nî ê hō͘-tāi la̍k-pah sì-cha̍p-jī lâng
Pí-pài ê hō͘-tāi la̍k-pah jī-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng
Ap-kah ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah jī-cha̍p-jī lâng
A-to-nî-kan ê hō͘-tāi la̍k-pah la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k lâng
Pí-kek-óa-i ê hō͘-tāi nn̄g-chheng khòng gō͘-cha̍p-la̍k lâng
A-teng ê hō͘-tāi sì-pah gō͘-cha̍p-sì lâng
A-te̍k ê hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī Hi-se-ka ê hō͘-tāi, káu-cha̍p-poeh lâng
Pí-sài ê hō͘-tāi saⁿ-pah jī-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng
Iok-la ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-pah cha̍p-jī lâng
Hap-sūn ê hō͘-tāi nn̄g-pah jī-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng
Kiat-pā-ní -lâng káu-cha̍p-gō͘ lâng
Pek-lī-hêng -lâng chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng
Nî-tô-hoat -lâng gō͘-cha̍p-la̍k lâng
A-ná-tu̍t -lâng chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-poeh lâng
A-su-má-ui -lâng sì-cha̍p-jī lâng
Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm -lâng, Ki-hui-la -lâng, kap Pí-lio̍k -lâng kiōng chhit-pah sì-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng
La-má -lâng kap Ka-pa -lâng kiōng la̍k-pah jī-cha̍p-it lâng
Be̍k-má -lâng chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-jī lâng
Pek-te̍k-lī -lâng kap Ai -lâng kiōng nn̄g-pah jī-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng
Nî-pho ê hō͘-tāi gō͘-cha̍p-jī lâng
Boa̍t-pit -lâng chi̍t-pah gō͘-cha̍p-la̍k lâng
lēng-gōa chi̍t ê Í-lân ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p-sì lâng
Hap-lîm ê hō͘-tāi saⁿ-pah jī-cha̍p lâng
Lô-tek -lâng, Hap-tē -lâng, O-ná -lâng kiōng chhit-pah jī-cha̍p-gō͘ lâng
Iâ-lī-ko -lâng saⁿ-pah sì-cha̍p-gō͘ lâng
Se-ná -lâng saⁿ-chheng la̍k-pah saⁿ-cha̍p lâng.
Chè-si: Iâ-su-a ê ke Iâ-tāi-ngá ê hō͘-tāi káu-pah chhit-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng
Im-be̍k ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-chheng khòng gō͘-cha̍p-jī lâng
Pa-si-hō͘-ní ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah sì-cha̍p-chhit lâng
Hap-lîm ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-chheng khòng cha̍p-chhit lâng.
Lī-bī -lâng: Hô-ta̍t-ui-ngá ê hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī Iâ-su-a kap Kah-bia̍t ê hō͘-tāi, chhit-cha̍p-sì lâng
hū-chek hiàn-si--ê, chiū-sī A-sat ê hō͘-tāi, chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-poeh lâng
sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe, chiū-sī Sa-liông, A-te̍k, Ta̍t-bûn, A-kok, Hap-tí-tāi, kap Sok-pài ê hō͘-tāi, kiōng chi̍t-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-káu lâng.
Sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng: Se-hap ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-so͘-pa ê hō͘-tāi, Tap-pa-gô ê hō͘-tāi,
Ki-lio̍k ê hō͘-tāi, Se-a ê hō͘-tāi, Pa-tùn ê hō͘-tāi,
Lī-pa-ná ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-ka-pa ê hō͘-tāi, A-kok ê hō͘-tāi,
Hap-kah ê hō͘-tāi, Sat-mái ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-lân ê hō͘-tāi,
Kiat-tek ê hō͘-tāi, Ka-hap ê hō͘-tāi, Lī-a-ngá ê hō͘-tāi,
Lī-sìn ê hō͘-tāi, Nî-ko-tāi ê hō͘-tāi, Ka-sàn ê hō͘-tāi,
O͘-sat ê hō͘-tāi, Pa-se-a ê hō͘-tāi, Pí-sài ê hō͘-tāi,
Ap-ná ê hō͘-tāi, Bí-o͘-lêng ê hō͘-tāi, Nî-phó͘-sim ê hō͘-tāi,
Pa-pok ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-kó͘-pa ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-hut ê hō͘-tāi,
Pa-sé-lu̍t ê hō͘-tāi, Bí-hi-tāi ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-sa ê hō͘-tāi,
Pa-kho ê hō͘-tāi, Se-se-la ê hō͘-tāi, Tap-má ê hō͘-tāi,
Nî-sè-a ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-thê-hoat ê hō͘-tāi.
Só͘-lô-bûn ê po̍k-jîn ê hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī Só-thài ê hō͘-tāi, Só-húi-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi, Pí-lō͘-tāi ê hō͘-tāi,
Ngá-la ê hō͘-tāi, Ta̍t-khun ê hō͘-tāi, Kiat-tek ê hō͘-tāi,
Sī-hoat-thê-ngá ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-thòe ê hō͘-tāi, Po-hek-lia̍t Hap-su-pa-im ê hō͘-tāi, A-bí ê hō͘-tāi.
Sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng kap Só͘-lô-bûn po̍k-jîn ê hō͘-tāi kiōng saⁿ-pah káu-cha̍p-jī lâng.
Tùi Te̍k Bí-la, Te̍k Hap-sat, Ki-lio̍k, A-tùn, Im-be̍k chiūⁿ--lâi, bōe-tàng chèng-bêng in ê chong-cho̍k sè-hē sī m̄-sī sio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng--ê:
Tē-lâi-ngá ê hō͘-tāi, To-pí-ngá ê hō͘-tāi, kap Nî-ko-tāi ê hō͘-tāi, kiōng la̍k-pah gō͘-cha̍p-jī lâng.

Chè-si ê hō͘-tāi tiong chhē bô sè-hē--ê, ū Hap-pa-ngá ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-ko-su ê hō͘-tāi, Pa-se-lâi ê hō͘-tāi (Pa-se-lâi chhōa Ki-lia̍t -lâng Pa-se-lâi ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chòe bó͘, só͘-í chhái-iōng Pa-se-lâi ê miâ); in bōe-tàng tam-jīm chè-si ê chit-hūn.
Séng-tiúⁿ kā in kóng, “M̄-thang chia̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè ê chè-mi̍h, thèng-hāu ōe-hiáu ēng O͘-lêng kap Thó͘-bêng ê chè-si chhut-hiān chiah lâi chhâi-koat.”
Tāi-hōe ê hōe-chiòng lóng-chóng ū sì-bān nn̄g-chheng saⁿ-pah la̍k-cha̍p lâng;
í-gōa iáu ū in ê lâm-po̍k lú-pī chhit-chheng saⁿ-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-chhit lâng, lâm-lú hiàn-si--ê ū nn̄g-pah lâng.
In ū bé chhit-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-la̍k chiah, lô nn̄g-pah sì-cha̍p-gō͘ chiah,
lo̍k-tô sì-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-gō͘ chiah, lû la̍k-chheng chhit-pah jī-cha̍p chiah.
Ū-ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê tiān kam-sim hōng-hiàn, beh tī goân-lâi ê só͘-chāi tiông-kiàn sèng-tiān.
In chiàu ka-kī ê lêng-le̍k hōng-hiàn kang-thêng su-iàu ê keng-hùi: kim gō͘-pah kong-kun; gûn nn̄g-chheng poeh-pah kong-kun, kap chè-si ê lé-ho̍k chi̍t-pah su.

Tùi án-ni, chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, í-ki̍p chi̍t-pō͘-hūn ê jîn-bîn, hū-chek hiàn-si--ê, sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe, kap sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng, lóng tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hù-kūn ê tōe-khu; kî-tha ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa tī ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong lóng an-tùn hó-sè. Chhit--ge̍h, jîn-bîn tâng-sim chi̍t-ì chū-chi̍p tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Iok-sat-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Iâ-su-a kap i ê chè-si tâng-phōaⁿ, Sat-la-thiat ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-pa-pek kap i ê chhin-cho̍k, lóng khí-lâi khí-chō Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê chè-tôaⁿ, beh chiàu Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng Mô͘-se ê lu̍t-hoat, tī chè-tôaⁿ téng-bīn hiàn sio-hòa-chè.
Sui-jiân in kiaⁿ tong-tōe ê chū-bîn, in iû-goân tī pún-lâi ê só͘-chāi tiông-kiàn chè-tôaⁿ, koh chá-àm tī hit téng-bīn hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú.
In mā chiàu lu̍t-hoat ê kì-chài siú Tah-liâu-choeh, ta̍k-ji̍t chiàu kui-tēng ê sò͘-bo̍k hiàn sio-hòa-chè.

Lēng-gōa, in hiàn keng-siông teh hiàn ê sio-hòa-chè, múi ge̍h chhoe-it ê chè, kap Siōng Chú hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê choeh-kî ê chè, í-ki̍p ta̍k-ê lâng kam-sim hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chè.
Sui-jiân Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān iáu-bē tiông-kiàn, m̄-kú tùi chhit-ge̍h chhoe-it khí, in chiū khai-sí hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú.

In ēng gûn hō͘ phah-chio̍h sai-hū kap choh-ba̍k sai-hū, koh ēng niû-si̍t, chiú, kap iû hō͘ Se-tùn -lâng kap Thài-ní -lâng, hō͘ in chiong pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū tùi Lê-pa-lūn ēng hái-ūn sàng kàu Iok-phà; chiah-ê tāi-chì lóng ū tit-tio̍h Pho-su hông-tè Sài-ló͘-sū ê hú-khó.

In kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê tē-jī nî jī--ge̍h, Sat-la-thiat ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-pa-pek, Iok-sat-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Iâ-su-a, kap kî-tha ê chè-si tâng-phōaⁿ, Lī-bī -lâng, í-ki̍p só͘-ū liû-hòng tò-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng, lóng khai-sí khí Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān; in phài jī-cha̍p hè í-siōng ê Lī-bī -lâng chòe tok-kang.

Tùi án-ni, Iû-tāi ê hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī Iâ-su-a kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ kap chhin-cho̍k, Kah-bia̍t kap i ê kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p Lī-bī -lâng Hi-ná-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ kap sun, kap in ê chhin-cho̍k, lóng chòe-hé hū-chek kàm-tok tiông-kiàn Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê kang-thêng.

Khí-chhù sai-hū hē Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê tōe-ki ê sî, chè-si chhēng lé-ho̍k pûn lat-pah, A-sat ê hō͘-tāi Lī-bī -lâng phah-poa̍h, lóng chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Tāi-pi̍t ê kui-tēng, khiā-teh chheng-chàn Siōng Chú.

In ū-ê chhiùⁿ ū-ê hô, o-ló kám-siā Siōng Chú, kóng: Siōng Chú chì-siān, I tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán. In chheng-chàn Siōng Chú ê sî, chèng-lâng tōa-siaⁿ hoah, in-ūi Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê tōe-ki í-keng hē hó-sè.

Ū chin chōe chè-si, Lī-bī -lâng, kap ta̍k-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, chiū-sī hiah-ê bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h í-chêng ê sèng-tiān ê lāu-lâng, hiān-chāi chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h hē chit-keng tiān ê tōe-ki, chiū tōa-siaⁿ háu; koh ū chin chōe lâng in-ūi hoaⁿ-hí tōa-siaⁿ hoah.
Jîn-bîn hun bōe chheng sī hoan-ho͘ ê siaⁿ á-sī thî-khàu ê siaⁿ; jîn-bîn tōa-siaⁿ hoah ê siaⁿ chin hn̄g lóng thiaⁿ ōe tio̍h.
Iû-tāi kap Piān-ngá-bín ê tùi-te̍k thiaⁿ-kìⁿ hiah-ê liû-hòng--tò-lâi ê lâng, ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè khí sèng-tiān,

chiū lâi kìⁿ Só͘-lô-pa-pek kap ta̍k-cho̍k ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, kā in kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chún goán kap lín chòe-hé khí, in-ūi goán kap lín kâng-khoán chhē-kiû lín ê Siōng-tè; tùi A-su̍t -ông Í-sat Hap-tùn tòa goán lâi kàu chia í-lâi, goán chiū siông-siông hiàn-chè hō͘ Siōng-tè.”

M̄-kú Só͘-lô-pa-pek, Iâ-su-a, kap Í-sek-lia̍t kî-tha ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ kā in kóng, “Goán khí goán ê Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān, bô su-iàu lín pang-chān. Goán sī chiàu Pho-su hông-tè Sài-ló͘-sū tùi goán ê bēng-lēng, beh ka-kī ūi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè khí sèng-tiān.”
Tùi án-ni, tong-tōe ê chū-bîn chiū tī Iû-thài -lâng khí-chō sèng-tiān ê sî kā in khióng-hat, chó͘-tòng in ê kang-thêng.
Chiah-ê lâng tùi Pho-su hông-tè Sài-ló͘-sū nî-kan, kàu Pho-su hông-tè Tāi-liû-sū chē-ūi ê sî, hóe-lō͘ koaⁿ-oân beh phò-hoāi Iû-thài -lâng khí sèng-tiān ê kè-ōe.
A-hap-sûi-ló͘ hông-tè khai-sí chip-chèng ê sî, ū lâng siá sò͘-chn̄g khòng-kò Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn.

Tī Pho-su hông-tè A-ta̍t-sih-se thóng-tī ê sî, Pí-si-lân, Bí-thê-lī-ta̍t, Tha-pí-le̍k, kap in ê tông-sū, koh siá-phoe hō͘ A-ta̍t-sih-se; phoe ēng A-lân-bûn siá, tha̍k ê sî chiah hoan-e̍k.
Chóng-tok Lī-hông, su-kì Sin-sòe mā khòng-kò Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng, siá-phoe hō͘ A-ta̍t-sih-se hông-tè,

“Chóng-tok Lī-hông, su-kì Sin-sòe, kap kî-tha kâng-tóng--ê, pau-koat hoat-koaⁿ, koaⁿ-oân, kun-koaⁿ, Pho-su koaⁿ-oân, Í-le̍k -lâng, Pa-pí-lûn -lâng, Su-san -lâng, chiū-sī Í-lân -lâng;
í-ki̍p hō͘ úi-tāi chun-kùi ê A-su-ná-pa chhian-sóa lâi tòa tī Sat-má-lī-a -siâⁿ kap Hô-se -séng ê jîn-bîn, chòe-hé siá-phoe siōng-chàu.”
Chàu-pún ê lōe-iông sī, “Lí ê po̍k-jîn, Hô-se -séng ê jîn-bîn siōng-chàu A-ta̍t-sih-se Pho-su hông-tè.

“Goān hông-siōng cha-bêng, tùi lí hia tò-khì Iû-tāi -tōe ê Iû-thài -lâng, í-keng kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tio̍k-chhiú tiông-kiàn chit-ê hoán-poān koh siâ-ok ê siâⁿ; in í-keng khí siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, hē tōe-ki.
Goān hông-siōng cha-bêng, chit-ê siâⁿ it-tàn khí hó, siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ oân-kang, in chiū bōe koh chìn-kòng, la̍p-sè, kiáu niû-si̍t; kok-khò͘ ê siu-ji̍p it-tēng ōe kiám-chió.
Goán siū hông-siōng ê kiong-kip, tio̍h chīn chek-jīm, m̄-ài khòaⁿ-kìⁿ hông-siōng sún-sit, só͘-í pín-pò hō͘ hông-siōng chai.

Chhiáⁿ chhâ-khó sian-hông ê kì-lio̍k, chiū ōe chai chit-ê siâⁿ sī pōe-poān ê siâⁿ, chiâⁿ-chòe lia̍t-ông kap ta̍k-séng ê siong-hāi. Tùi kó͘-chá, chit-ê siâⁿ siông-siông hoán-poān, só͘-í siū húi-bia̍t.
Goán kín-sīn khé-chàu hông-siōng, chit-ê siâⁿ nā koh khí-hó, siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ oân-kang, hông-siōng chiū ōe sit-khì Hô-se -séng.”
Hit-sî, hông-tè chiū hôe-ho̍k chóng-tok Lī-hông, su-kì Sin-sòe, í-ki̍p hiah-ê tòa tī Sat-má-lī-a kap Hô-se -séng ê tông-sū, kóng, “Goān lín pêng-an.
Lín ê siōng-chàu-bûn, góa ū siông-sè tha̍k--kè.
Góa í-keng hā-lēng chhâ-khó, chai chit-ê siâⁿ tùi kó͘-chá chiū pōe-poān lia̍t-ông, siông-siông ū bô͘-hoán pōe-ge̍k ê sū.
Í-chêng bat ū úi-tāi ê kun-ông thóng-tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, koán-lí choân-pō͘ Hô-se tōe-khu, kiò in chìn-kòng, la̍p-sè, kiáu niû-si̍t.
Taⁿ lín tio̍h bēng-lēng hiah-ê lâng thêng-kang, tû-liáu góa ū kàng-chí, bōe-ēng-tit tiông-kiàn chit-ê siâⁿ.
Lín tio̍h sûi-sî pān-lí chit-ê sū, m̄-thang so͘-hut, chiah bián hông-tè siū khah-tōa ê sún-sit.”

A-ta̍t-sih-se hông-tè ê phoe soan-tho̍k hō͘ chóng-tok Lī-hông, su-kì Sin-sòe, kap in ê tông-sū chai liáu-āu, in chiū kóaⁿ-kín khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, ēng sè-le̍k kiông-pek Iû-thài -lâng thêng-kang.
Tùi án-ni Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng-tè sèng-tiān tiông-kiàn ê kang-thêng chiū thêng-chí, thêng kàu Pho-su hông-tè Tāi-liû-sū chē-ūi ê tē-jī nî.
Hit-sî ū sian-ti Hap-kai, kap E̍k-to ê sun sian-ti Sat-ka-lī-a, hōng Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê miâ, tùi Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Iû-thài -lâng thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè ê ōe.

Sat-la-thiat ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-pa-pek, kap Iok-sat-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Iâ-su-a, chiū lóng khí-lâi tio̍k-chhiú tiông-kiàn Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān; ū Siōng-tè ê sian-ti kap in chòe-hé, pang-chān in.

Siâng hit-sî, Hô-se -séng ê chóng-tok Ta̍t-nái, kap Sī-tha Pho-su-nái, í-ki̍p in ê tông-sū, lâi mn̄g kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng hā-lēng hō͘ lín khí chit-keng tiān, oân-sêng chit-ê kang-thêng?”
In koh thó khí-chō sèng-tiān ê lâng ê miâ-toaⁿ.
M̄-kú Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-kò͘ Iû-tāi ê tiúⁿ-ló, hō͘ in bián siū chó͘-tòng thêng-kang. Hiah-ê koaⁿ-oân chiong chit-ê tāi-chì siōng-chàu Tāi-liû-sū, thèng-hāu i ê hôe-ho̍k.
Hô-se -séng ê chóng-tok Ta̍t-nái, kap Sī-tha Pho-su-nái, í-ki̍p i ê tông-sū, chiū-sī Hô-se -séng ê koaⁿ-oân, siōng-chàu Tāi-liû-sū -ông ê phoe kì tī ē-bīn:
Goān hông-tè Tāi-liû-sū bān-sū sūn-lī.

Goān hông-siōng cha-bêng. Goán khì Iû-tāi -séng, hoat-kiàn úi-tāi Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān tú-teh tiông-kiàn. Chit-ê tiān ēng tōa tè chio̍h khí-chō, niû chhah-ji̍p chhiûⁿ-lāi, kang-thêng chìn-hêng chin-kín koh sūn-lī.
Hit-sî, goán mn̄g hiah-ê tiúⁿ-ló, “Siáⁿ-lâng hā-lēng hō͘ lín khí chit-keng tiān, oân-sêng chit-ê kang-thêng?”
Koh mn̄g in ê siú-léng ê miâ, thang siōng-chàu hō͘ hông-siōng chai.

In án-ni ìn goán kóng, “Goán sī thiⁿ tōe ê Chú-cháiⁿ Siōng-tè ê po̍k-jîn. Goán hiān-chāi teh tiông-kiàn ê sèng-tiān, sī chin chōe nî chêng Í-sek-lia̍t chi̍t ūi úi-tāi ê ông khí-chō--ê.

M̄-kú goán ê lia̍t-chó͘ jiá thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè siū-khì, I chiong in kau tī Ka-le̍k-tí -lâng Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat ê chhiú; ông chiū thiah-húi chit-keng tiān, lia̍h jîn-bîn khì Pa-pí-lûn.
Sài-ló͘-sū chòe Pa-pí-lûn hông-tè tē-it nî, hā-lēng tiông-kiàn chit-keng Siōng-tè ê tiān.

Í-chêng Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān chhiúⁿ-khì hē tī Pa-pí-lûn sîn-biō ê kim gûn khì-khū, Sài-ló͘-sū -ông chiong hiah-ê the̍h--chhut-lâi, kau hō͘ i só͘ siat-li̍p ê Iû-tāi séng-tiúⁿ Siat-pa-sat,
tùi i kóng, ‘Tio̍h tòa chiah-ê khì-khū khì hē tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê tiān, mā tio̍h tī goân-ūi khí Siōng-tè ê tiān.’
Tùi án-ni, Siat-pa-sat chiū lâi hē Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê tōe-ki; chit-keng tiān tiông-kiàn ê kang-thêng tùi hit-sî kàu hiān-chāi iáu-bē oân-sêng.

“Taⁿ, hông-siōng nā khòaⁿ-chòe thò-tòng, chhiáⁿ cha-bêng Pa-pí-lûn ê hông-ka kì-lio̍k, khòaⁿ Sài-ló͘-sū -ông ū hā-lēng tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tiông-kiàn Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān á bô. Koan-hē chit-ê sū, chhiáⁿ hông-siōng chhâi-koat, kàng-chí chí-sī goán.”
Tāi-liû-sū -ông chiū kàng-chí, khì Pa-pí-lûn ê hú-khò͘ tiàu-oa̍t hông-ka kì-lio̍k.
Tī Bí-tí-a -séng A-má-tha -siâⁿ ê kiong-lāi, chhē-tio̍h chi̍t kńg kó͘-koàn, lāi-bīn án-ni kì-chài:

Sài-ló͘-sū -ông goân-nî, ông ūi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān kàng-chí: Tio̍h tiông-kiàn chit-keng tiān chòe hiàn-chè ê só͘-chāi, hē kian-kò͘ ê tōe-ki, tiān koân jī-cha̍p-chhit kong-chhioh, khoah mā jī-cha̍p-chhit kong-chhioh;
ēng tōa chio̍h saⁿ chàn, bo̍k-châi chi̍t chàn; keng-hùi iû ông-ka chi-hù.

Í-chêng Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān chhiúⁿ--khì, hē tī Pa-pí-lûn hiah-ê kim gûn ê khì-khū, tio̍h tòa tńg-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chiàu goân-ūi hē tī Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān.
Tùi án-ni, Tāi-liû-sū -ông hā-lēng: Hô-se -séng chóng-tok Ta̍t-nái, kap Sī-tha Pho-su-nái, í-ki̍p Hô-se -séng ê koaⁿ-oân, lín m̄-thang kan-sia̍p in,
m̄-thang chó͘-tòng Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê kang-thêng, tio̍h hō͘ Iû-tāi séng-tiúⁿ kap tiúⁿ-ló kè-sio̍k tī goân-ūi tiông-kiàn Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān.

Góa bēng-lēng lín tio̍h pang-chān Iû-tāi ê tiúⁿ-ló tiông-kiàn Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān; tùi ông ê hú-khò͘, Hô-se -séng ê sè-siu tiong poah chhiong-chiok ê keng-hùi hō͘ hiah-ê lâng, chiah bián kang-sū thêng-chí.

In ǹg thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè hiàn sio-hòa-chè só͘ su-iàu ê gû-káng-á, mî-iûⁿ-káng, iûⁿ-ko, í-ki̍p sió-be̍h, iâm, chiú, iû, lóng tio̍h chiàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chè-si só͘ kóng--ê, ta̍k-ji̍t kiong-kip hō͘ in, m̄-thang sit-gō͘;
thang hō͘ in hiàn phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hō͘ thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè; koh ūi-tio̍h ông kap ông ê kiáⁿ-jî-sun tn̂g-hè-siū kî-tó.

Góa koh kàng-chí, nā ū lâng kái-piàn chit-ê bēng-lēng, chiū beh tùi i ê chhù thiah chi̍t ki niû, chiong i tèng tī hit téng-bīn, kòa--khí-lâi, hō͘ i ê chhù ūi-tio̍h án-ni pìⁿ-chòe pùn-sò-tui.

Nā ū kun-ông kap jîn-bîn kái-piàn chit-ê bēng-lēng, húi-hoāi chit-keng Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān, goān kéng-soán Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hō͘ lâng lâi kèng-pài I ê hit-ūi Siōng-tè siau-bia̍t in. Góa Tāi-liû-sū chhut chit-ê bēng-lēng, tio̍h khak-si̍t chun-hêng.
Tùi án-ni, Hô-se -séng chóng-tok Ta̍t-nái, kap Sī-tha Pho-su-nái, í-ki̍p in ê tông-sū, chiū khak-si̍t chun-hêng Tāi-liû-sū -ông ê bēng-lēng.

Iû-tāi ê tiúⁿ-ló in-ūi sian-ti Hap-kai kap E̍k-to ê sun Sat-ka-lī-a só͘ thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè ê ōe, chiū tio̍k-chhiú tiông-kiàn, kang-thêng chìn-hêng sūn-lī. In chun-thàn Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, kap Pho-su hông-tè Sài-ló͘-sū, Tāi-liû-sū, kap A-ta̍t-sih-se ê bēng-lēng, oân-sêng tiông-kiàn.
Tāi-liû-sū -ông chē-ūi tē-la̍k nî, A-ta̍t-ge̍h chhoe-saⁿ, chit-keng sèng-tiān oân-kang.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, í-ki̍p kî-tha liû-bông tò--lâi ê lâng, lóng hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí kú-hêng hōng-hiàn Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê khèng-tián.

Ūi-tio̍h hōng-hiàn Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān, in hiàn gû-káng chi̍t-pah chiah, mî-iûⁿ-káng nn̄g-pah chiah, iûⁿ-ko sì-pah chiah. In koh chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t chi-cho̍k ê sò͘-bo̍k, hiàn soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng cha̍p-jī chiah chòe Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng ê sio̍k-chōe-chè.
In chiàu Mô͘-se ê chheh ê kì-chài, phài chè-si chiàu in ê cho͘-pia̍t, Lī-bī -lâng chiàu in ê pan-chhù, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè.
Chiaⁿ-ge̍h cha̍p-sì, liû-bông tò--lâi ê lâng siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.

Chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng lóng kiat-chēng ka-kī; ta̍k-ê lâng tī lé-gî-siōng lóng chheng-khì, chiū ūi-tio̍h liû-bông tò--lâi ê lâng, kap in ê chhin-cho̍k chèng chè-si, mā ūi-tio̍h ka-kī thâi Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê iûⁿ-ko.

Liû-bông tò--lâi ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, í-ki̍p lī-khui īⁿ-kàu kui-óa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, kèng-pài Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè hiah-ê lâng, lóng chia̍h Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê iûⁿ-ko.

In hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí siú Tû-kàⁿ-choeh chhit ji̍t; in chiah-ni̍h hoaⁿ-hí, sī in-ūi Siōng Chú hō͘ A-su̍t -ông ê sim tùi in iú-siān, chi-chhî in tiông-kiàn Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān.

Chiah-ê sū í-āu, Pho-su hông-tè A-ta̍t-sih-se chē-ūi ê sî, Í-su-la tùi Pa-pí-lûn tńg--lâi; i sī Se-lâi-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Se-lâi-ngá sī A-sat-lī-ngá ê kiáⁿ, A-sat-lī-ngá sī Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ,
Hi-le̍k-ka sī Sa-liông ê kiáⁿ, Sa-liông sī Sat-tok ê kiáⁿ, Sat-tok sī A-hi-tu̍t ê kiáⁿ,
A-hi-tu̍t sī A-má-lī-ngá ê kiáⁿ, A-má-lī-ngá sī A-sat-lī-ngá ê kiáⁿ, A-sat-lī-ngá sī Bí-la-iok ê kiáⁿ,
Bí-la-iok sī Se-la-hi-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Se-la-hi-ngá sī O͘-se ê kiáⁿ, O͘-se sī Pò͘-ki ê kiáⁿ,
Pò͘-ki sī A-pí-su ê kiáⁿ, A-pí-su sī Hui-nî-hap ê kiáⁿ, Hui-nî-hap sī Í-lī-a-sat ê kiáⁿ, Í-lī-a-sat sī tōa-chè-si A-lûn ê kiáⁿ.

Í-su-la tùi Pa-pí-lûn chiūⁿ--lâi; i sī keng-ha̍k-kàu-su, tùi Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè só͘ siúⁿ-sù Mô͘-se ê lu̍t-hoat hui-siông cheng-thong. In-ūi Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè sù-hok hō͘ i, i tùi hông-tè ê chhéng-kiû, lóng tit-tio̍h ún-chún.
A-ta̍t-sih-se choh-ông tē-chhit nî, ū chi̍t-kóa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, hiàn-si--ê, sèng-tiān siú-ōe, sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng, tńg-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Hit-nî ê gō͘--ge̍h, Í-su-la tńg-lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng;
chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-it, i tùi Pa-pí-lûn khí-sin, gō͘-ge̍h chhoe-it chiū kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, in-ūi i ê Siōng-tè si-un ê chhiú pang-chān i.
Í-su-la choan-sim gián-kiù koh si̍t-hêng Siōng Chú ê lu̍t-hoat, chiong kui-lē bēng-lēng kàu-tō Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Chè-si Í-su-la sī keng-ha̍k-kàu-su, cheng-thong Siōng Chú hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē. Ē-bīn sī A-ta̍t-sih-se -ông hō͘ Í-su-la ê chiàu-su:
Lia̍t-ông ê ông A-ta̍t-sih-se siá hō͘ chè-si Í-su-la, cheng-thong thiⁿ-téng Siōng-tè lu̍t-hoat ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su, goān lí pêng-an.
Góa kok-lāi ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, nā ū lâng goān-ì tńg-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, góa hā-lēng, ún-chún in kap lí chòe-hé khì;
Góa kap chhit ê chham-bô͘ chí-phài lí, tio̍h chiàu Siōng-tè kau-thok lí ê lu̍t-hoat sī-chhat Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Lí tio̍h tòa góa kap góa ê chham-bô͘ kam-sim hiàn hō͘ tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê kim-gûn;
koh tòa lí tī Pa-pí-lûn choân-séng só͘ tit--tio̍h ê kim-gûn, í-ki̍p jîn-bîn kap chè-si hoaⁿ-hí ūi-tio̍h Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng in ê Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān hōng-hiàn ê lé-mi̍h.
Lí tio̍h siān-iōng chiah-ê kim-gûn, bóe gû-káng-á, mî-iûⁿ-káng, iûⁿ-ko, ngó͘-kok, kap chiú, hiàn tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lín ê Siōng-tè tiān ê chè-tôaⁿ.
Chhun ê kim-gûn, tio̍h chiàu lín ê Siōng-tè ê chí-ì, ēng tī lí kap lí ê tông-sū khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê só͘-chāi.
Só͘-ū kau hō͘ lí, beh tī lí ê Siōng-tè tiān-lāi chòe ho̍k-sāi ê khì-khū, tio̍h lóng hē tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng.
Lí ê Siōng-tè ê tiān nā iáu khiàm-ēng sím-mi̍h, su-iàu lí siat-hoat--ê, thang tùi hông-tè ê hú-khò͘ chi-chhut.

Góa A-ta̍t-sih-se koh hā-lēng Hô-se -séng só͘-ū koán hú-khò͘ ê koaⁿ-oân: Cheng-thong thiⁿ-téng Siōng-tè lu̍t-hoat ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su, chè-si Í-su-la, i bô-lūn tùi lín iau-kiû sím-mi̍h, lín lóng tio̍h khak-si̍t pān-lí;
sò͘-liōng chòe ko thang kàu gûn saⁿ-chheng sì-pah kong-kun, be̍h chi̍t-bān kong-kun, chiú nn̄g-chheng kong-seng, iû nn̄g-chheng kong-seng, iâm bô-hān.

Thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè só͘ bēng-lēng--ê, lín tio̍h ūi thiⁿ-téng Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān chhiat-si̍t khì chòe, chiah bián Siōng-tè ê tōa siū-khì lîm-kàu góa kap góa ê kiáⁿ-sun ê kok.

Góa koh bēng-lēng lín, chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, hiàn-si--ê, sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe kap kang-lâng, í-ki̍p tī Siōng-tè ê tiān sū-hōng ê lâng, lóng m̄-thang iau-kiû in chìn-kòng, la̍p-sè, kiáu niû-si̍t.

Í-su-la, chiàu lí ê Siōng-tè siúⁿ-sù lí ê tì-hūi, chí-phài hiah-ê bat Siōng-tè lu̍t-hoat ê lâng chòe sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ kap koaⁿ-oân, tī-lí Hô-se -séng ê jîn-bîn, kàu-tō iáu m̄ bat lu̍t-hoat ê lâng.

Nā ū lâng bô beh chun-siú lí ê Siōng-tè ê lu̍t-hoat kap ông ê bēng-lēng ê lâng, tio̍h giâm-giâm kā in tēng-chōe; kā in phòaⁿ sí-hêng, liû-hòng, châi-sán chhiong-kong, á-sī koaiⁿ-kaⁿ.

Í-su-la kóng, “Siōng Chú — lán lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! In-ūi I hō͘ hông-tè ū chit-khoán ê sim-ì, hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān tit-tio̍h chun-êng.

I koh hō͘ góa tùi ông, i ê chham-bô͘, kap só͘-ū ū-koân ê koaⁿ-oân tit-tio̍h pang-chān. Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè sù góa ióng-khì, hō͘ góa ōe-tàng tiàu-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t ê siú-léng, kap góa chòe-hé tńg--lâi.”
Ē-bīn sī A-ta̍t-sih-se -ông chāi-ūi ê sî, kap góa tùi Pa-pí-lûn tò-tńg--lâi ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, kap in ê ka-phó͘:
Hui-nî-hap ê hō͘-tāi ū Kek-sūn, Í-tha-má ê hō͘-tāi ū Tān-í-lí, Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi ū Hap-tu̍t.
Sī-ka-nî ê hō͘-tāi; Pa-lio̍k ê hō͘-tāi ū Sat-ka-lī-a; kap i chòe-hé tńg--lâi, chiàu ka-phó͘ sǹg, ū ta-po͘-lâng chi̍t-pah gō͘-cha̍p miâ.
Pa-hap Mô͘-ap ê hō͘-tāi ū Se-la-hi-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-iok-nái; kap i chòe-hé--ê, ū ta-po͘-lâng nn̄g-pah miâ.
Sat-thó͘ ê hō͘-tāi ū Ngá-hap-sek ê kiáⁿ Sī-ka-nî; kap i chòe-hé--ê, ū ta-po͘-lâng saⁿ-pah miâ.
A-teng ê hō͘-tāi ū Iok-ná-tan ê kiáⁿ Í-pia̍t; kap i chòe-hé--ê, ū ta-po͘-lâng gō͘-cha̍p miâ.
Í-lân ê hō͘-tāi ū A-tha-lī-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-sài-a; kap i chòe-hé--ê, ū ta-po͘-lâng chhit-cha̍p miâ.
Sī-hoat-thê-ngá ê hō͘-tāi ū Bí-ka-le̍k ê kiáⁿ Se-pa-tē-ngá; kap i chòe-hé--ê, ū ta-po͘-lâng poeh-cha̍p miâ.
Iok-ap ê hō͘-tāi ū Iâ-hiat ê kiáⁿ Gô-pa-tí-a; kap i chòe-hé--ê, ū ta-po͘-lâng nn̄g-pah cha̍p-poeh miâ.
Pa-nî ê hō͘-tāi ū Iok-sè-húi ê kiáⁿ Sī-lô-bi̍t; kap i chòe-hé--ê, ū ta-po͘-lâng chi̍t-pah la̍k-cha̍p miâ.
Pí-pài ê hō͘-tāi ū Pí-pài ê kiáⁿ Sat-ka-lī-a; kap i chòe-hé--ê, ū ta-po͘-lâng jī-cha̍p-poeh miâ.
Ap-kah ê hō͘-tāi ū Hap-ka-thán ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân; kap i chòe-hé--ê, ū ta-po͘-lâng chi̍t-pah cha̍p miâ.
A-to-nî-kan ê hō͘-tāi khah bān tńg--lâi-ê ū Í-lī-hoat-lia̍t, Iâ-lī, Sī-má-ngá; kap in chòe-hé--ê, ū ta-po͘-lâng la̍k-cha̍p miâ.
Pí-kek-óa-i ê hō͘-tāi ū O͘-thài kap Sat-khek; kap in chòe-hé--ê, ū ta-po͘-lâng chhit-cha̍p miâ.

Góa tiàu-chi̍p chiah-ê lâng lâi kàu hit-tiâu lâu-ji̍p A-hap-óa -siâⁿ ê hô ê hô-piⁿ; goán tī hia chat-iâⁿ saⁿ ji̍t kú. Góa sûn-sī jîn-bîn kap chè-si, m̄-kú bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h Lī-bī -lâng.

Góa chiū chhe lâng khì tiàu hiah-ê léng-siù, chiū-sī Í-lī-í-siā, A-lī-i-le̍k, Sī-má-ngá, Í-lī-ná-tan, Ngá-li̍p, Í-lī-ná-tan, Ná-tan, Sat-ka-lī-a, Bí-su-lân; koh kàu-su Iok-ngá-li̍p kap Í-lī-ná-tan.

Góa chhe in khì Ka-se-húi-ngá tōe-khu kìⁿ hit só͘-chāi ê léng-siù E̍k-to, koh kà in tio̍h án-chóaⁿ tùi E̍k-to kap i ê tông-sū sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng kóng-ōe, thang hō͘ in phài lâng lâi lán ê Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān ho̍k-sāi.

Lán ê Siōng-tè si-un pang-chān goán, hō͘ in tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê cheng-sun, Lī-bī ê sun, Boat-lī ê hō͘-tāi tiong, tòa chi̍t ê ū châi-lêng ê lâng Sī-lī-pí lâi; i ê kiáⁿ kap i ê chhin-cho̍k kiōng cha̍p-poeh lâng mā chòe-hé lâi.
Koh tòa Hap-sa-pí-ngá; kap i chòe-hé--ê ū Bí-la-lī ê hō͘-tāi Í-sài-a, i ê chhin-cho̍k, kap in ê kiáⁿ, kiōng jī-cha̍p lâng.
Koh tòa nn̄g-pah jī-cha̍p ê sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng; in ê miâ lóng ū teng-lio̍k, in ê chó͘-sian siū Tāi-pi̍t kap hiah-ê tāi-sîn chí-phài lâi hia̍p-chō͘ Lī-bī -lâng.

Hit-sî, góa tī A-hap-óa-hô hô-piⁿ soan-pò͘ kìm-chia̍h, thang tī lán ê Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng khek-khó͘ khiam-pi, kiû Siōng-tè hō͘ goán, goán ê gín-á, kap goán it-chhè só͘ ū--ê, lóng chi̍t-lō͘ pêng-an.

Góa kám-kak chhéng-kiû hông-tè phài pō͘-peng bé-peng chi̍t-lō͘ pó-hō͘ goán, bián siū tùi-te̍k ê kong-kek, sī kiàn-siàu ê sū, in-ūi goán bat tùi hông-tè kóng, “Goán ê Siōng-tè ōe si-un pó-hō͘ só͘-ū kiû-kiò I ê lâng, m̄-kú I mā ōe hoat tōa siū-khì kong-kek khì-sak I ê lâng.”
Só͘-í, goán ūi-tio̍h chit-hāng sū kìm-chia̍h, khún-kiû goán ê Siōng-tè; I ū thiaⁿ goán ê kî-tó.
