Tùi án-ni, góa chí-phài cha̍p-jī ê chè-si-tiúⁿ, chiū-sī Sī-lī-pí, Hap-sa-pí-ngá, kap in cha̍p ê chhin-cho̍k,

chiong hông-tè kap i ê chham-bô͘, koaⁿ-oân, í-ki̍p tī hia ê Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng hōng-hiàn hō͘ lán ê Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān, hiah-ê kim, gûn kap khì-khū, lóng chhìn--kè, kau hō͘ hit cha̍p-jī ê chè-si.
Góa chhìn--kè kau hō͘ in--ê, ū gûn jī-cha̍p-jī kong-tùn, gûn-khì chhit-cha̍p kong-kun, kim saⁿ-chheng sì-pah kong-kun,
í-ki̍p kim-óaⁿ jī-cha̍p tè, tāng poeh tiám sì kong-kun; kim-sih-sih ê tâng-khì nn̄g tè, kùi-tiōng chhin-chhiūⁿ kim.

Góa tùi in kóng, “Lín í-keng sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú, chiah-ê khì-khū mā lóng sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú; chiah-ê kim-gûn sī jîn-bîn kam-sim hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè ê.

Lín tio̍h kéng-séng kò͘-siú, it-ti̍t kàu lín khì kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê khò͘-pâng, tī chè-si-tiúⁿ kap Lī-bī -lâng, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t cho̍k-tiúⁿ ê bīn-chêng chhìn--kè kau hō͘ in.”
Tùi án-ni, chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng chiong kè-chhìn ê kim-gûn kap khì-khū chiap--kè-lâi, beh tòa-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lán ê Siōng-tè ê tiān.

Chiaⁿ-ge̍h cha̍p-jī, goán tùi A-hap-óa ê hô-piⁿ chhut-hoat, beh khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; goán ê Siōng-tè chi̍t-lō͘ pó-hō͘ goán, kiù goán thoat-lī tùi-te̍k kap bâi-ho̍k ê lâng ê kong-kek.
Goán kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tī hia hioh-khùn saⁿ ji̍t.

Tē-sì ji̍t, goán kàu Siōng-tè ê tiān, chhìn hiah-ê kim gûn kap khì-khū, kau hō͘ chè-si O͘-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Bí-lī-boa̍t; kap i chòe-hé--ê ū Hui-nî-hap ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat, Lī-bī -lâng Iâ-su-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-sat-poa̍t, kap Pin-lōe ê kiáⁿ Ná-a-tí.
Ta̍k-hāng mi̍h-kiāⁿ lóng sǹg--kè, chhìn--kè, koh siông-sè kì-lio̍k.

Só͘-ū liû-hòng tò-tńg--lâi ê lâng lóng hiàn sio-hòa-chè hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè; in ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng hiàn gû-káng cha̍p-jī chiah, mî-iûⁿ-káng káu-cha̍p-la̍k chiah, mî-iûⁿ-á chhit-cha̍p-chhit chiah; koh hiàn soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng cha̍p-jī chiah lâi kiat-chēng ka-kī ê chōe. Chiah-ê lóng chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
In chiong hông-tè ê chiàu-su kau hō͘ i ê jîn-sîn kap Hô-se -séng ê chóng-tok; hiah-ê koaⁿ-oân chiū pang-chān jîn-bîn, kiong-kip Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān.

Chiah-ê tāi-chì oân-sêng liáu-āu, ū chi̍t-kóa Í-sek-lia̍t ê léng-siù lâi kìⁿ góa, kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn, chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, bô kap chit só͘-chāi ê Ka-lâm -lâng, Hek -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, A-bûn -lâng, Mô͘-ap -lâng, Ai-ki̍p -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng keh-lī, koh o̍h in chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.

In ūi-tio̍h ka-kī kap in ê kiáⁿ, chhōa gōa-cho̍k ê lú-chú chòe bó͘, tì-kàu Siōng Chú sèng-kiat ê chú-bîn kap chit só͘-chāi ê lâng chham-chhap; koh léng-siù kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ tī chit-hāng sū chhōa-thâu chòe pháiⁿ.”
Góa chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì, chiū thiah-li̍h saⁿ kap gōa-phàu, chhoah thâu-mn̂g kap chhùi-chhiu, tio̍h-kiaⁿ thòng-sim chē--teh.

In-ūi liû-hòng--tò-lâi ê lâng só͘ hoān ê chōe, só͘-ū ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê ōe ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah ê lâng lóng chū-chi̍p lâi góa chia; góa tio̍h-kiaⁿ thòng-sim chē--teh, kàu hiàn ē-hng-chè ê sî.
Hiàn ē-hng-chè ê sî, góa bô koh kìm-chia̍h, chiū chhēng thiah-li̍h ê saⁿ kap gōa-phàu, siang-kha kūi--lo̍h-khì, ǹg Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè gia̍h-khí siang-chhiú kî-tó,
kóng, “Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, góa hui-siông kiàn-siàu, m̄-káⁿ gia̍h-thâu ǹg góa ê Siōng-tè, in-ūi goán ê chōe im-kè thâu-khak, goán ê chōe-kò tú-thiⁿ.

Tùi goán lia̍t-chó͘ ê sî kàu kin-á-ji̍t, goán ê chōe-kò chin tāng; in-ūi goán ê chōe, lí chiong goán kap goán ê lia̍t-ông, chè-si, lóng kau tī gōa-pang lia̍t-ông ê chhiú, siū sat-hāi, siū lia̍h, siū chhiúⁿ-kiap, siū bú-jio̍k, chhin-chhiūⁿ kin-á-ji̍t án-ni.

Hiān-chāi, Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè tú-chiah si-un hō͘ goán, koh lâu goán chiah-ê chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng, hō͘ goán thang an-choân khiā-khí tī lí sèng ê só͘-chāi, thang koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h kng-bêng, tī siū ap-chè chòe lô͘-lē ê tiong-kan ū ho̍k-heng ê ki-hōe.

Goán sī lô͘-lē, m̄-kú chòe lô͘-lē ê sî, Siōng-tè lí bô khì-sak goán, hō͘ goán tùi Pho-su ê hông-tè tit-tio̍h un-tián, koh hō͘ goán ho̍k-heng, ōe-tàng tiông-kiàn Siōng-tè lí ê sèng-tiān, siu-lí húi-hoāi ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ goán tī Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ū siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ pó-hō͘.
“Goán ê Siōng-tè, kì-jiân lí si-un hō͘ goán, goán iáu ū sím-mi̍h ōe thang kóng, in-ūi goán í-keng khì-sak lí ê bēng-lēng.

Lí ū thong-kè lí ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti bēng-lēng goán, kóng, ‘Lín beh khì chiàm-léng chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe sī siū ù-jiám ê tōe, in-ūi hiah-ê kok ê jîn-bîn ê ù-òe, kap in só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, chit-ê tōe tùi chit-pêng kàu hit-pêng chhiong-móa ù-òe.

Lín nā beh kiông-sēng, hióng-siū chit-ê thó͘-tōe ê hó-mi̍h, koh lâu chit-ê tōe hō͘ lín ê kiáⁿ-sun chòe éng-oán ê sán-gia̍p, lín chiū m̄-thang hō͘ lín ê kiáⁿ í-ki̍p cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kap in thong-hun, éng-oán m̄-thang pang-chān in tit-tio̍h pêng-an hoân-êng.’

Goán tú-tio̍h chiah-ê chai-lān, lóng sī in-ūi goán ê pháiⁿ só͘-kiâⁿ kap goán ê tōa-chōe, m̄-kú, Siōng-tè, lí hêng-hoa̍t goán, pí goán eng-kai sêng-siū--ê khah khin, koh lâu goán chiah-ê chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng.

Goán kiám thang koh ûi-pōe lí ê bēng-lēng, kap chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū ê jîn-bîn thong-hun? Goán nā án-ni chòe, lí it-tēng ōe tùi goán hoat siū-khì, siau-bia̍t goán, hō͘ goán bô chi̍t ê lâu--lo̍h-lâi, bô chi̍t ê tô-thoat.

Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, lí sī kong-gī--ê, goán chiah-ê chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng chiah tit-tio̍h tô-thoat, chhin-chhiūⁿ kin-á-ji̍t án-ni. Taⁿ, goán tī lí ê bīn-chêng ū chōe; bô chi̍t ê lâng ōe-kham-tit khiā tī lí ê bīn-chêng.”

Í-su-la kî-tó, jīn-chōe, thî-khàu, phak tī Siōng-tè sèng-tiān thâu-chêng ê sî, ū chi̍t tōa-tīn Í-sek-lia̍t ê lâm-lú kap gín-á chū-chi̍p lâi i hia; in lóng khàu kah chin siong-sim.

Í-lân ê hō͘-tāi, Iâ-hiat ê kiáⁿ Sī-ka-nî tùi Í-su-la kóng, “Goán tùi lán ê Siōng-tè bô tiong-si̍t, in-ūi goán chhōa chit só͘-chāi gōa-cho̍k ê lú-chú chòe bó͘; sui-jiân sī án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng iáu-kú ū ǹg-bāng.

Hiān-chāi lán tio̍h kap lán ê Siōng-tè li̍p-iok, chiàu lí kap hiah-ê kiaⁿ-ùi Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng ê lâng só͘ koat-tēng, chiàu lu̍t-hoat, chiong chiah-ê bó͘ kap in só͘ siⁿ ê jî-lú lóng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.
Tio̍h chhái-chhú hêng-tōng, che sī lí eng-kai chòe ê sū. Goán beh chi-chhî lí, lí tio̍h ióng-kám khì chòe.”
Í-su-la chiū sûi-sî hō͘ chè-si ê léng-siù kap Lī-bī -lâng, í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng soan-sè, beh chiàu chiah-ê ōe khì chòe; in chiū án-ni soan-sè.

Í-su-la tùi Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê thâu-chêng khí--lâi, ji̍p-khì Í-lī-a-si̍t ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân ê chhù, tòa tī hia, bô chia̍h bô lim, ūi-tio̍h liû-hòng--tò-lâi tùi Siōng-tè bô tiong-si̍t ê lâng ai-siong.
In tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi choân-tōe soan-pò͘, bēng-lēng liû-hòng--tò-lâi ê lâng lóng tio̍h lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chū-chi̍p.

Nā ū lâng bô sūn-thàn hiah-ê siú-léng kap tiúⁿ-ló ê bēng-lēng, saⁿ ji̍t lāi bô lâi, chiū beh bu̍t-siu in ê châi-sán, chiong in tùi liû-hòng--tò-lâi ê lâng ê thoân-thé kek-chhut.

Iû-tāi kap Piān-ngá-bín chit nn̄g chi-cho̍k ê lâng chiū tī saⁿ ji̍t lāi lóng lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chū-chi̍p; hit-ji̍t sī káu-ge̍h jī-cha̍p, chèng-lâng lóng chē tī Siōng-tè sèng-tiān thâu-chêng ê kóng-tiûⁿ, ūi-tio̍h chit-ê sū, koh in-ūi lo̍h tōa-hō͘, lóng gi̍h-gi̍h-chhoah.
Chè-si Í-su-la khí--lâi, kā in kóng, “Lín tùi Siōng-tè bô tiong-si̍t, chhōa gōa-pang ê lú-chú chòe bó͘, ke-thiⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chōe.
Taⁿ tio̍h ǹg Siōng Chú — lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè jīn-chōe, chun-hêng I ê chí-ì, kap chāi-tōe ê jîn-bîn í-ki̍p gōa-cho̍k ê lú-chú keh-lī.”
Hōe-chiòng lóng tōa-siaⁿ ìn kóng, “Goán it-tēng beh chiàu lí só͘ kóng--ê khì chòe.

M̄-kú lâng chin chōe, koh tú-tio̍h tōa-hō͘, goán bô hoat-tō͘ it-ti̍t khiā tī gōa-bīn, koh che mā m̄-sī chi̍t ji̍t nn̄g ji̍t ōe-tàng kái-koat ê tāi-chì, in-ūi goán só͘ hoān ê chōe chin giâm-tiōng.

Taⁿ, chhiáⁿ lán ê léng-siù tāi-piáu choân-thé hōe-chiòng lâu tī chia, lán ta̍k-ê siâⁿ só͘-ū chhōa gōa-pang lú-chú chòe bó͘ ê lâng, tio̍h chiàu chí-tēng ê sî-kan, kap hit-ê siâⁿ ê tiúⁿ-ló í-ki̍p sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ chòe-hé lâi, pān-lí chiah-ê sū, ti̍t-kàu lán ê Siōng-tè siu-hôe tùi lán ê siū-khì.”
M̄-kú A-sat-hek ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-tan, Te̍k-óa ê kiáⁿ Ngá-hap-siā hoán-tùi chit-ê koat-tēng, in mā tit-tio̍h Bí-su-lân kap Lī-bī -lâng Sa-pí-thài ê chi-chhî.

Tùi liû-hòng ê tōe tò--lâi ê lâng chiàu Í-su-la ê ōe khì chòe. Chè-si Í-su-la chiū tùi cho̍k-tiúⁿ ê tiong-kan chí-phài chi̍t-kóa lâng, teng-kì in ê miâ, tùi cha̍p-ge̍h chhoe-it khai-sí tiâu-cha chit-ê sū.
Kàu chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-it, só͘-ū chhōa gōa-cho̍k lú-chú ê lâng ê miâ chiah tiâu-cha chheng-chhó.
Tī chè-si ê hō͘-tāi, chhâ-chhut ū chhōa gōa-cho̍k lú-chú ê lâng chiū-sī: Iok-sat-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Iâ-su-a kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī Má-se-ngá, Í-lī-í-siā, Ngá-li̍p, kap Ki-tāi-lī.
In li̍p-sè beh lî in ê bó͘; in-ūi in ū hoān-chōe, chiū hiàn chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng sio̍k in ê chōe.
Im-be̍k ê hō͘-tāi, ū Hap-ná-nî kap Se-pa-tē-ngá
Hap-lîm ê hō͘-tāi, ū Má-se-ngá, Í-lī-a, Sī-má-ngá, Iâ-hiat, kap O͘-se-a
Pa-si-hō͘-ní ê hō͘-tāi, ū Í-lī-iok-nái, Má-se-ngá, Í-si̍t-má-lī, Ná-thán-gia̍p, Iok-sat-poa̍t, kap Í-lī-a-sat
Lī-bī -lâng ê tiong-kan, ū Iok-sat-poa̍t, Sī-múi, Ki-la-ngá (chiū-sī Ki-lī-tha), Pí-tha-hi-ngá, Iû-tāi, kap Í-lī-í-siā
Hū-chek chhiùⁿ-koa ê lâng ê tiong-kan, ū Í-lī-a-si̍t Sèng-tiān siú-ōe ê tiong-kan ū Sa-liông, Thê-liān, kap O͘-lī
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng Pa-lio̍k ê hō͘-tāi tiong, ū La-bí, Iâ-se-ngá, Má-ki-ngá, Bí-ngá-bîn, Í-lī-a-sat, Má-ki-ngá, kap Pí-ná-ngá
Í-lân ê hō͘-tāi tiong, ū Má-tha-nî, Sat-ka-lī-a, Iâ-hiat, A-pek-tí, Iâ-lī-mô͘, kap Í-lī-a
Sat-thó͘ ê hō͘-tāi tiong, ū Í-lī-iok-nái, Í-lī-a-si̍t, Má-tha-nî, Iâ-lī-mô͘, Sat-poa̍t, kap A-se-sat.
Pí-pài ê hō͘-tāi tiong, ū Iok-hap-lân, Hap-ná-nî-ngá, Sat-pài, kap A-le̍k
Pa-nî ê hō͘-tāi tiong, ū Bí-su-lân, Má-lo̍k, A-tāi-ngá, Ngá-su̍t, Sī-ap, kap Iâ-lī-mô͘
Pa-hap Mô͘-ap ê hō͘-tāi tiong, ū A-tí-ná, Ki-la, Pí-ná-ngá, Má-se-ngá, Má-tha-nî, Pí-sat-lia̍t, Pin-lōe, kap Má-ná-se
Hap-lîm ê hō͘-tāi tiong, ū Í-lī-í-siā, I-sī-ngá, Má-ki-ngá, Sī-má-ngá, Se-biān,
Piān-ngá-bín, Má-lo̍k, kap Sī-má-lī-ngá
Hap-sūn ê hō͘-tāi tiong, ū Má-te̍k-nái, Má-ta̍t-tha, Sat-poa̍t, Í-lī-hoat-lia̍t, Iâ-lī-mái, Má-ná-se, kap Sī-múi
Pa-nî ê hō͘-tāi tiong, ū Má-tāi, Àm-lân, O͘-ek,
Pí-ná-ngá, Pí-tí-ngá, Ki-lo̍k,
Óa-nî-ngá, Bí-lī-boa̍t, Í-lī-a-si̍t,
Má-tha-nî, Má-te̍k-nái, kap Ngá-sò
Pin-lōe ê hō͘-tāi tiong, ū Sī-múi,
Sī-lī-bí-ngá, Ná-tan, A-tāi-ngá,
Má-ná-tí-pài, Sa-sài, Sa-nāi,
A-sat-lia̍t, Sī-lī-bí-ngá, Sī-má-lī-ngá,
Sa-liông, A-má-lī-ngá, kap Iok-sek
Nî-pho ê hō͘-tāi tiong, ū Iâ-lī, Má-tha-thê-ngá, Sat-poa̍t, Se-pí-ná, Ngá-tāi, Iok-ní, Pí-ná-ngá.
Chiah-ê lâng lóng chhōa gōa-cho̍k ê lú-chú chòe bó͘; kî-tiong mā ū lâng tùi chiah-ê lú-chú siⁿ-kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Ē-bīn sī Hap-ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Nî-hi-bí ê ōe: A-ta̍t-sih-se choh Pho-su hông-tè tē-jī-cha̍p nî Ki-su-liû-ge̍h, góa tī Pho-su ê kiaⁿ-siâⁿ Su-san.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t, góa chi̍t ê hiaⁿ-tī Hap-ná-nî, kap kúi-nā ê tùi Iû-tāi lâi ê lâng lâi chhē góa; góa tùi in thàm-thiaⁿ hiah-ê liû-hòng Pa-pí-lûn tò-tńg--khì ê Iû-thài -lâng, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chêng-hêng.

In kā góa kóng, “Hiah-ê liû-hòng tò-tńg--khì ê lâng, tī Iû-tāi -séng hia tú-tio̍h tōa chai-lān, siū lêng-jio̍k, koh Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ siū thiah-húi, siâⁿ-mn̂g hō͘ hé sio--khì.”
Góa thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe chiū chē--lo̍h-lâi, thî-khàu, ai-siong kúi-nā ji̍t; tī thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng kìm-chia̍h kî-tó, kóng,
“Siōng Chú, tī thiⁿ-téng chì-tōa thang kiaⁿ-ùi ê Siōng-tè ah, lí tùi hiah-ê thiàⁿ lí, chun-siú lí kài-bēng ê lâng siú-iok si jîn-ài.

Khún-kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ, khui ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ, thiaⁿ lí ê po̍k-jîn chit-chūn ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng mî-ji̍t tī lí bīn-chêng ê kî-tó, jīn goán Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pōe-poān lí ê chōe; góa kap góa ê chó͘-sian lóng ū chōe.
Goán ok-ì hoán-khòng lí, bô chun-siú lí thong-kè lí ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se só͘ pan-pò͘ ê kài-bēng, kui-lē, bēng-lēng.
Kiû lí ōe-kì-tit lí tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se èng-ún ê ōe, kóng, ‘Lín nā tùi góa bô tiong-si̍t, góa chiū beh chiong lín hun-sòaⁿ khì lia̍t-kok;

m̄-kú lín nā kui-ǹg góa, chun-hêng góa ê kài-bēng, lín chiū-sī siū kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ khì thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak, góa mā beh tùi hia kā lín chū-chi̍p óa--lâi, chhōa lín kàu góa só͘ kéng-soán hō͘ lâng lâi kèng-pài góa ê só͘-chāi.’
“In sī lí ê po̍k-jîn, lí ê chú-bîn, sī lí ēng tōa khùi-la̍t, tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú kiù-sio̍k--ê.

Chú ah, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ lí ê po̍k-jîn kap hiah-ê ì-ài kèng-ùi lí ê miâ ê po̍k-jîn ê kî-tó; koh kiû lí hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn kin-á-ji̍t heng-thong, tùi ông tit-tio̍h un-tián.” Hit-sî, góa chòe ông ê chiú-chèng.
A-ta̍t-sih-se -ông tē-jī-cha̍p nî Nî-sàn-ge̍h, ū chiú pâi tī ông ê bīn-chêng, góa chiū hōng chiú hō͘ i. Góa pêng-siông-sî tī i ê bīn-chêng m̄-bat ū iu-būn ê bīn-sek.
I mn̄g góa kóng, “Lí bô phòa-pīⁿ, bīn-sek ná chiah pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ? Lí it-tēng sim-chêng bô hó.” Góa chiū chin kiaⁿ.
Góa tùi ông kóng, “Goān hông-siōng bān-sòe! Góa ê bīn-sek ōe chiah-ni̍h pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ, sī in-ūi an-chòng goán chó͘-sian ê siâⁿ pha-hng, siâⁿ-mn̂g lóng hō͘ hé sio--khì.”
I mn̄g góa kóng, “Lí ài-beh kiû sím-mi̍h?” Tùi án-ni, góa tùi thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè kî-tó.

Góa chiū tùi ông kóng, “Hông-siōng nā khòaⁿ-chòe hó, lí ê po̍k-jîn nā tùi lí tit-tio̍h un-tián, kiû lí chhe góa khì Iû-tāi, khì an-chòng goán lia̍t-chó͘ ê siâⁿ, hō͘ góa thang tiông-kiàn hit-ê siâⁿ.”
Hit-sî ông-hō͘ chē tī ông ê piⁿ--á. Ông kā góa kóng, “Lí beh khì jōa kú? Sím-mi̍h sî ōe tò--lâi?” I hoaⁿ-hí chhe góa khì, góa chiū kap i iok-tēng chi̍t ê kî-hān.
Góa koh tùi i kóng, “Hông-siōng nā khòaⁿ-chòe hó, chhiáⁿ hoat chiàu-su hō͘ góa tòa-khì kau hō͘ Hô-se -séng hiah-ê séng-tiúⁿ, chún góa kè-kéng khì Iû-tāi;

koh hoat chi̍t hong chiàu-su hō͘ koán-lí hông-ka chhiū-nâ ê A-sat, kah i hō͘ góa chhâ-liāu, thang chòe siu-kiàn sèng-tiān piⁿ pó-lúi ê mn̂g, siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, kap góa só͘ beh tòa ê chhù ê lō͘-ēng.” I ún-chún góa ê chhéng-kiû, in-ūi góa ê Siōng-tè si-un ê chhiú pang-chān góa.
Ông phài kúi-nā ê kun-koaⁿ kap bé-peng hō͘-sàng góa khì. Góa kàu Hô-se -séng hiah-ê séng-tiúⁿ hia, chiong chiàu-su kau hō͘ in.
Hô-lûn -lâng Chham-pa-la, kap koaⁿ-oân A-bûn -lâng To-pí-ngá thiaⁿ-kìⁿ ū lâng lâi beh ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng cheng-chhú koân-ek, chiū chin bô hoaⁿ-hí.
Góa kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tī hia saⁿ ji̍t.

Āu-lâi, góa pòaⁿ-mî khí--lâi, ū kúi ê lâng kap góa chòe-hé chhut--khì. Góa ê Siōng-tè kám-tōng góa ê sim beh ūi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe ê sū, góa lóng bô kā lâng kóng; góa khiâ ê cheng-siⁿ í-gōa, bô tòa pa̍t-chiah chòe-hé khì.

Góa thàu-mî tùi Soaⁿ-kok-mn̂g chhut--khì, keng-kè Liông-chôaⁿ kàu Pùn-sò-mn̂g, koan-chhat Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ siū thiah-húi, siâⁿ-mn̂g hō͘ hé sio--khì.
Góa koh khì kàu Chôaⁿ-mn̂g kap Ông-tî; m̄-kú hia bô só͘-chāi hō͘ góa khiâ ê cheng-siⁿ kè--khì.
Góa chiū thàu-mî iân khoe chiūⁿ--khì, koan-chhat siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, jiân-āu chiàu goân-lō͘, keng-kè Soaⁿ-kok-mn̂g tò--lâi.

Hiah-ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ m̄ chai góa khì tó-ūi, chòe sím-mi̍h tāi-chì; góa iáu-bē kā Iû-thài ê jîn-bîn, chè-si, kùi-cho̍k, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, kap kî-tha beh chham-ú chit-ê kang-chok ê lâng kóng.

Āu-lâi góa kā in kóng, “Lán só͘ tú--tio̍h ê chai-lān, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng án-chóaⁿ pha-hng, siâⁿ-mn̂g hō͘ hé sio--khì, lín lóng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h. Lâi! Lán lâi tiông-kiàn Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, chiah bián lán koh siū lêng-jio̍k.”

Góa koh kā in kóng góa ê Siōng-tè ê chhiú án-chóaⁿ pang-chān góa, kap ông tùi góa kóng sím-mi̍h ōe. In chiū kóng, “Lán khí-lâi tiông-kiàn!” Tùi án-ni, in kian-kiông--khí-lâi, chòe chit-ê hó ê kang-thêng.

M̄-kú, Hô-lûn -lâng Chham-pa-la kap koaⁿ-oân A-bûn -lâng To-pí-ngá, í-ki̍p A-la-pek -lâng Ki-siān thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū thí-chhiò goán, khòaⁿ-khin goán, kóng, “Lín sī teh chòe sím-mi̍h? Sī beh pōe-poān ông sī--bô?”

Góa ìn in kóng, “Thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè ōe hō͘ goán sêng-kong. Goán sī I ê po̍k-jîn, beh khí-lâi tiông-kiàn; lín tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng bô-hūn, bô-koân, bô lâng ōe kā lín kì-liām.”

Hit-sî, tōa-chè-si Í-lī-a-si̍t kap i ê tông-sū khí-lâi tiông-kiàn Iûⁿ-mn̂g, an mn̂g-sìⁿ, chiong mn̂g sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú. In koh khí siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ kàu Hap-bí-a-lâu kap Hap-lâm-gia̍p-lâu, chiong i sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú.
Chiap-sòa khí-chō--ê, sī Iâ-lī-ko -lâng; chiap-sòa in--ê, sī Im-lī ê kiáⁿ Sat-khek.
Hap-se-ná hiah-ê kiáⁿ tiông-kiàn Hî-mn̂g, an-tì niû kap mn̂g-sìⁿ, mn̂g-chhòaⁿ kap mn̂g-só.

Chiap-sòa in siu-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ--ê, sī Hap-ko-su ê sun, O͘-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Bí-lī-boa̍t. Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Bí-sī-sat-pia̍t ê sun, Pí-lī-ka ê kiáⁿ Bí-su-lân. Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Pa-ná ê kiáⁿ Sat-tok.
Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Thê-ko-a -lâng; m̄-kú in ê kùi-cho̍k bô beh hū-chek siū chí-phài ê kang-chok.
Pa-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi, kap Pí-só͘-tāi ê kiáⁿ Bí-su-lân, siu-lí Kó͘-mn̂g, an-tì niû, mn̂g-sìⁿ, mn̂g-chhòaⁿ kap mn̂g-só.
Chiap-sòa in siu-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ--ê, sī Ki-piàn -lâng Bí-la-thê kap Bí-lûn -lâng Ngá-tùn, í-ki̍p Hô-se -séng séng-tiúⁿ só͘ koán ê Ki-piàn -lâng kap Bí-su-pa -lâng.
Chiap-sòa in--ê, sī phah-kim sai-hū Hap-hái-ngá ê kiáⁿ O͘-siat; chiap-sòa i--ê, sī chòe hiuⁿ-liāu ê Hap-ná-nî-ngá. Chiah-ê lâng siu-chō Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, kàu Khoah-chhiûⁿ.
Chiap-sòa in siu-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ--ê, sī Hō͘-ní ê kiáⁿ, koán-lí chi̍t-pòaⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siâⁿ-khu ê Lī-hoat-ngá.
Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Hap-lō͘-boat ê kiáⁿ Iâ-tāi-ngá; i siu-kiàn i ka-kī ê chhù tùi-bīn ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ. Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Hap-sa-nî ê kiáⁿ Hap-tu̍t.
Hap-lîm ê kiáⁿ Má-ki-ngá, kap Pa-hap Mô͘-ap ê kiáⁿ Hap-su̍t, siu-lí ē chi̍t tōaⁿ, í-ki̍p Lô͘-lâu.
Chiap-sòa in--ê, sī Hap-lô-hek ê kiáⁿ, koán-lí chi̍t-pòaⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siâⁿ-khu ê Sa-liông kap i hiah-ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.

Hap-lūn kap Sat-ná-a ê chū-bîn siu-lí Soaⁿ-kok-mn̂g; in chō siâⁿ-mn̂g, an-tì mn̂g-sìⁿ, mn̂g-chhòaⁿ kap mn̂g-só, koh siu-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ sì-pah sì-cha̍p kong-chhioh, kàu Pùn-sò-mn̂g.
Koán-lí Pek Hap-ki-lîm tōe-khu ê Lī-kah ê kiáⁿ Má-ki-ngá siu-kiàn Pùn-sò-mn̂g; chō siâⁿ-mn̂g, an-tì mn̂g-sìⁿ, mn̂g-chhòaⁿ kap mn̂g-só.

Koán-lí Bí-su-pa tōe-khu ê Kok Hô-se ê kiáⁿ Sa-lûn, siu-kiàn Chôaⁿ-mn̂g; chō siâⁿ-mn̂g, khàm chhù-téng, an-tì mn̂g-sìⁿ, mn̂g-chhòaⁿ kap mn̂g-só, koh siu-kiàn Hông-ka hoe-hn̂g hù-kūn ê Se-lô-a-tî ê chhiûⁿ, kàu hit-ê tùi Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ lo̍h--lâi ê kiā-á.

Chiap-sòa i siu-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ--ê, sī koán-lí chi̍t-pòaⁿ Pek Siok siâⁿ-khu ê Ap-pok ê kiáⁿ Nî-hi-bí; i siu-lí kàu Tāi-pi̍t hûn-bōng ê tùi-bīn, koh sòa kàu jîn-chō-tî, í-ki̍p Eng-hiông-koán.

Chiap-sòa i siu-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ--ê, sī Lī-bī -lâng Pa-nî ê kiáⁿ Lī-hông. Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī koán-lí chi̍t-pòaⁿ Ki-i-la tōe-khu ê Hap-sa-pí-ngá; i siu-kiàn i tī-lí ê tōe-khu.
Chiap-sòa i siu-kiàn--ê, sī in ê chhin-cho̍k Hi-ná-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Pa-óa-i; i koán-lí lēng-gōa chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê Ki-i-la tōe-khu.
Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Iâ-su-a ê kiáⁿ Í-siā-ní; i koán-lí Bí-su-pa, siu-kiàn chiūⁿ-khì bú-khì-khò͘ ê tùi-bīn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ oat-kak hit-tōaⁿ.
Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Sat-kái ê kiáⁿ Pa-lio̍k, chīn-la̍t siu-kiàn tùi siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ oat-kak kàu tōa-chè-si Í-lī-a-si̍t kong-koán ê mn̂g-kháu hit-tōaⁿ.
Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Hap-ko-su ê sun, O͘-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Bí-lī-boa̍t, siu-kiàn tùi Í-lī-a-si̍t kong-koán ê mn̂g-kháu, kàu kong-koán ê chīn-thâu hit-tōaⁿ.
Chiap-sòa i siu-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ--ê, sī tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hù-kūn tōe-khu hiah-ê chè-si.

Chiap-sòa in--ê, sī Piān-ngá-bín kap Hap-su̍t; in siu-kiàn in tau tùi-bīn hit-tōaⁿ. Chiap-sòa in--ê, sī A-lân-ngá ê sun, Má-se-ngá ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá; i siu-kiàn i ê chhù hù-kūn hit-tōaⁿ.
Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Hi-ná-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Pin-lōe; i siu-kiàn tùi A-sat-lī-ngá ê chhù, kàu siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê oat-kak, kàu siâⁿ-kak hit-tōaⁿ.
O͘-sài ê kiáⁿ Pa-la hū-chek siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ oat-kak ê tùi-bīn, óa-kūn kéng-ōe-tiâⁿ, hông-kiong téng-bīn ê siâⁿ-lâu hit-tōaⁿ. Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Pa-lio̍k ê kiáⁿ Pí-tāi-ngá,
kap tòa tī Gô-hui-le̍k sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng; in siu-kiàn tang-pêng ê Chúi-mn̂g tùi-bīn, kap khah-koân ê siâⁿ-lâu hit-tōaⁿ.
Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Thê-ko-a -lâng; in siu-kiàn tùi hit-ê khah-koân ê tōa siâⁿ-lâu tùi-bīn, kàu Gô-hui-le̍k ê chhiûⁿ hit-tōaⁿ.
Tùi Bé-mn̂g chiūⁿ pak hit-tōaⁿ, chè-si siu-kiàn in ka-kī ê chhù tùi-bīn ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ.
Chiap-sòa in--ê, sī Im-be̍k ê kiáⁿ Sat-tok; i siu-kiàn i ê chhù tùi-bīn ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ. Chiap-sòa i siu-kiàn--ê, sī Tang-mn̂g ê siú-ōe, Sī-ka-nî ê kiáⁿ Sī-má-ngá.

Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī Sī-lī-bí-ngá ê kiáⁿ Hap-ná-nî-ngá, kap Sat-la ê tē-la̍k kiáⁿ Hap-lūn; in koh siu-kiàn chi̍t tōaⁿ. Chiap-sòa in--ê, sī Pí-lī-ka ê kiáⁿ Bí-su-lân; i siu-kiàn ka-kī ê chhù tùi-bīn hit-tōaⁿ.

Chiap-sòa i--ê, sī phah-kim sai-hū Má-ki-ngá; i siu-kiàn kàu sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng kap seng-lí-lâng ê chhù hit-tōaⁿ, chiū-sī tùi Tiàu-chi̍p-mn̂g ê tùi-bīn kàu siâⁿ-kak ê lâu.
Phah-kim sai-hū kap seng-lí-lâng siu-kiàn tùi siâⁿ-kak ê lâu kàu Iûⁿ-mn̂g hit-tōaⁿ.
Chham-pa-la thiaⁿ-kìⁿ goán teh tiông-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, chiū chin siū-khì, hui-siông hùn-lō͘, thí-chhiò Iû-thài -lâng,

tī i ê tâng-phōaⁿ kap Sat-má-lī-a ê kun-peng bīn-chêng kóng, “Chiah-ê bô lō͘-ēng ê Iû-thài -lâng teh chòe sím-mi̍h? In beh tiông-kiàn chit-ê siâⁿ o͘h? Beh hiàn-chè o͘h? Beh chi̍t ji̍t chiū oân-sêng o͘h? Beh tùi thô͘-tui tiong the̍h-chhut sio--kè ê chio̍h-thâu lâi koh khí o͘h?”
A-bûn -lâng To-pí-ngá khiā tī i ê sin-piⁿ kóng, “In só͘ khí ê chio̍h-chhiûⁿ, nā ū chi̍t chiah hô͘-lî peh--khí-khì, chiū ōe pang--lo̍h-khì.”

Góa kî-tó kóng, “Goán ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí thiaⁿ, in-ūi goán hō͘ lâng thí-chhiò, kiû lí hō͘ in tùi goán ê bú-jio̍k kui tī in sin-chiūⁿ, hō͘ in chiâⁿ-chòe chiàn-lī-phín siū-lia̍h khì gōa-kok;
kiû lí m̄-thang jia-khàm in ê chōe, m̄-thang chhat-siau in tī lí bīn-chêng só͘ hoān ê chōe-kò; in-ūi in bú-jio̍k chiah-ê tiông-kiàn ê lâng.”
Án-ni, goán kè-sio̍k tiông-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ; bô-jōa-kú, siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ chiū lóng chiap chòe-hé, kàu chi̍t-pòaⁿ koân, in-ūi jîn-bîn choan-sim chòe kang.

Chham-pa-la, To-pí-ngá, A-la-pek -lâng, A-bûn -lâng, A-si̍t-tu̍t -lâng, thiaⁿ-kìⁿ tiông-kiàn Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê kang-thêng sūn-lī chìn-hêng, khai-sí siu-pó͘ phòa-khiah ê só͘-chāi, chiū chin siū-khì;
tāi-ke chòe-hé kè-bô͘ beh kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chè-chō hūn-loān.
Goán ǹg goán ê Siōng-tè kî-tó, koh in-ūi in ê iân-kò͘, phài lâng siú-bōng, mî-ji̍t hông-pī.
M̄-kú Iû-thài -lâng kóng: Choh-kang ê lâng khùi-la̍t chīn, chio̍h-thâu thô͘-soa kui tōa-tui, siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ oân-kang kàu hô-sî?
Goán ê tùi-te̍k koh kóng, “Thàn in m̄ chai, khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h ê sî, lán ji̍p-khì in tiong-kan, thâi-sí in, hō͘ in ê kang-thêng thêng-chí.”
Hiah-ê tòa tī tùi-te̍k hù-kūn ê Iû-thài -lâng, chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn kā goán kéng-kò, kóng, “Tùi-te̍k ōe tùi ta̍k só͘-chāi lâi kong-kek lín.”
Só͘-í góa hō͘ jîn-bîn chiàu in ka-kī ê chong-cho̍k gia̍h to, gia̍h chhiuⁿ, gia̍h keng, khiā tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ āu-bīn kē koh khòng-khoah ê só͘-chāi.

Góa sûn-sī liáu, chiū khí-lâi tùi kùi-cho̍k, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, kap kî-tha ê jîn-bîn kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ in! Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Chú sī chì-tōa thang kiaⁿ-ùi ê Siōng-tè; tio̍h ūi-tio̍h lín ê tông-pau, lín ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lín ê bó͘, lín ê chhù-the̍h kau-chiàn.”

Tùi-te̍k thiaⁿ-kìⁿ goán í-keng chai in ê kè-bô͘, koh Siōng-tè mā phò-hoāi in ê kè-bô͘, chiū bô lâi kong-kek goán, goán chiū lóng tò-tńg-lâi siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ hia, ta̍k-ê lâng kè-sio̍k chòe ka-kī ê kang-chok.

Tùi hit-ji̍t khí, góa ê pō͘-hā chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê lâng chòe kang, chi̍t-pòaⁿ gia̍h chhiuⁿ, the̍h tún-pâi, gia̍h keng, chhēng chiàn-kah; koaⁿ-tiúⁿ lóng choân-le̍k chi-chhî hiah-ê tiông-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê Iû-thài chèng-lâng.
Taⁿ mi̍h-kiāⁿ--ê, chi̍t-chhiú chòe kang, chi̍t-chhiú gia̍h bú-khì.
Kiàn-chō ê lâng, ta̍k-ê phāiⁿ to chiàu-siông kang-chok; pûn lat-pah--ê tī góa ê sin-piⁿ.
Góa kā chiah-ê kùi-cho̍k, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, kap kî-tha ê jîn-bîn kóng, “Chit-ê kang-thêng chin tōa, lán tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng hun-khui chin hn̄g;
lín bô-lūn tī tó-ūi thiaⁿ-tio̍h lat-pah ê siaⁿ, tio̍h sûi-sî chū-chi̍p lâi goán chia; lán ê Siōng-tè beh ūi lán kau-chiàn.”
Ta̍k-ji̍t tùi thiⁿ phú-kng kàu chhiⁿ chhut-hiān ê sî, goán chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê lâng chòe kang, chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê lâng gia̍h chhiuⁿ siú-ōe.
Hit-sî, góa koh tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Ta̍k-ê lâng kap i ê po̍k-jîn tio̍h tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siâⁿ-lāi hioh-mî, thang mî--sî khiā ōe-peng, ji̍t--sî chòe kang.”
Án-ni, góa kap góa ê chhin-cho̍k, pō͘-hā, kap ōe-peng, bô chi̍t ê thǹg-saⁿ khùn; ta̍k-ê lâng khì chhiūⁿ-chúi mā lóng gia̍h bú-khì.
Jîn-bîn kap in ê bó͘ tōa-siaⁿ bâi-oàn in ê Iû-thài tông-pau.
Ū lâng kóng, “Goán kap goán ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chiah chōe lâng, ūi-tio̍h beh seng-oa̍h su-iàu chin chōe niû-si̍t.”
Ū-ê kóng, “Goán í-keng chiong chhân-hn̂g, phû-tô-hn̂g, chhù-the̍h the̍h-khì tí-ah, chiah ōe-tàng tō͘-oa̍h.”
Ū-ê kóng, “Goán í-keng ēng chhân-hn̂g kap phû-tô-hn̂g chioh-chîⁿ, kā ông la̍p-sè.

Goán kap pa̍t-lâng kâng-khoán sī Iû-thài -lâng, goán ê kiáⁿ-jî mā bô khah su in ê kiáⁿ-jî; taⁿ goán ê kiáⁿ-jî tio̍h khì chòe lâng ê lô͘-lē, goán ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ū-ê í-keng khì chòe lô͘-lē, goán mā bōe-tàng chòe sím-mi̍h; in-ūi goán ê chhân-hn̂g kap phû-tô-hn̂g í-keng lóng hō͘ pa̍t-lâng the̍h--khì.”
Góa thiaⁿ-tio̍h in ê ai-kiò kap oàn-giân, chiū hui-siông siū-khì.

Góa keng-kè sīn-tiōng khó-lū, chiū chek-pī hiah-ê kùi-cho̍k kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, kā in kóng, “Lín ta̍k-ê lâng kèng-jiân kā tông-pau the̍h tāng-lī.” Tùi án-ni, góa tiàu-chi̍p tāi-hōe lâi chhú-lí in.

Góa kā in kóng, “Goán í-keng chīn-la̍t chiong bōe hō͘ gōa-pang-lâng ê Iû-thài tông-pau sio̍k-hôe, lín kèng-jiân bōe lín ê hiaⁿ-tī, beh koh hō͘ goán kā in sio̍k--tńg-lâi sī--bô?” In lóng tiām-tiām, bô ōe thang ìn.
Góa koh kóng, “Lín án-ni chòe m̄-tio̍h; lín chòe tāi-chì eng-kai tio̍h kèng-ùi lán ê Siōng-tè, chiah bián hō͘ lia̍t-kok lán ê tùi-te̍k thí-chhiò.
Góa kap góa ê ka-sio̍k, í-ki̍p góa ê pō͘-hā, mā ū chiong chîⁿ kap niû-si̍t chioh hō͘ jîn-bîn. Hiān-chāi lán mài koh kā in the̍h lī-sek.

Kin-á-ji̍t lín tio̍h chiong in tí-ah ê chhân-hn̂g, phû-tô-hn̂g, kaⁿ-ná-hn̂g, chhù-the̍h, í-ki̍p lín tùi in the̍h ê tāng-lī, chiū-sī chîⁿ-gûn, niû-si̍t, chiú, iû, lóng hêng in.”

Kùi-cho̍k kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kóng, “Goán it-tēng hêng in, bô koh tùi in iau-kiû sím-mi̍h, beh chiàu lí ê ōe chòe.” Góa chiū kiò chè-si lâi, hō͘ kùi-cho̍k kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ chiù-chōa, it-tēng chiàu só͘ kóng--ê khì chòe.

Góa chiū tháu-khui io-tòa, iāⁿ-iāⁿ--leh, kóng, “Bô chiàu chiù-chōa khì chòe ê lâng, goān Siōng-tè mā chiong in ê chhù-the̍h kap in lô-lo̍k tit--tio̍h-ê, iāⁿ kah khang-khang-khang.” Hōe-chiòng lóng ìn kóng, “Amen!” In koh chheng-chàn Siōng Chú. Jîn-bîn chiū lóng chiàu án-ni chòe.

Góa siū phài chòe Iû-tāi -tōe ê séng-tiúⁿ, tùi A-ta̍t-sih-se ông jī-cha̍p nî kàu saⁿ-cha̍p-jī nî, kiōng cha̍p-jī nî kú, góa kap góa ê ka-sio̍k lóng bô chia̍h séng-tiúⁿ èng-tit ê niû-si̍t.

Góa í-chêng hiah-ê séng-tiúⁿ hō͘ jîn-bîn ê hū-tam chin tāng; in tùi jîn-bîn iau-kiû ngó͘-kok kap chiú, í-ki̍p sì-pah gō͘-cha̍p-la̍k kong-khek ê gûn-á; sīm-chì in ê po̍k-jîn mā ap-chè jîn-bîn. M̄-kú góa bô án-ni chòe, in-ūi góa kèng-ùi Siōng-tè.
Góa choan-sim chòe tiông-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê kang-thêng, bô bóe chhân-hn̂g; góa só͘-ū ê pō͘-hā mā lóng chham-ka tiông-kiàn ê kang-chok.
Tû-liáu hiah-ê tùi sì-ûi kok-ka lâi góa chia ê lâng í-gōa, ū Iû-thài -lâng í-ki̍p koaⁿ-tiúⁿ chi̍t-pah gō͘-cha̍p lâng kap góa chòe-hé chia̍h.

Múi chi̍t ji̍t, góa tio̍h chún-pī chi̍t chiah gû-káng, la̍k chiah pûi ê iûⁿ; koh chún-pī chin chōe chiah koe; cha̍p ji̍t chi̍t piàn, chún-pī ta̍k-khoán ê chiú. Sui-jiân án-ni, góa mā bô niá séng-tiúⁿ èng-tit ê niû-si̍t, in-ūi jîn-bîn ê hū-tam chin tāng.
Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí ōe-kì-tit góa ūi-tio̍h jîn-bîn só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū, sù-hok góa.

Chham-pa-la, To-pí-ngá, A-la-pek -lâng Ki-siān, kap goán kî-tha ê tùi-te̍k thiaⁿ-tio̍h góa í-keng oân-sêng siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê tiông-kiàn, só͘-ū ê phòa-khiah lóng siu-pó͘ hó-sè; m̄-kú siâⁿ-mn̂g iáu-bē an mn̂g-sìⁿ.
Chham-pa-la kap Ki-siān chiū phài lâng lâi kā góa kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí lâi, lán tī O-ná pêng-goân chi̍t ê chng-siā kìⁿ-bīn.” Kî-si̍t in sī siūⁿ-beh hāi góa.

Góa chiū phài sù-chiá khì kā in kóng, “Góa chit-chūn teh chìn-hêng tōa ê kang-thêng, bōe-tàng khì; góa ná thang lī-khui chia khì kìⁿ lín, hō͘ chit-ê kang-thêng siū chó͘-tòng?”
In án-ni sì piàn phài lâng lâi kìⁿ góa, góa lóng ēng kâng-khoán ê ōe hôe-tap in.
Chham-pa-la tē-gō͘ piàn phài i ê pō͘-hā lâi kìⁿ góa, chhiú the̍h bô hong--khí-lâi ê phoe;

phoe-lāi án-ni siá: “Tī lia̍t-kok tiong ū hong-siaⁿ, Ki-siān mā chèng-si̍t kóng, lí kap Iû-thài -lâng siūⁿ-beh chō-hoán, só͘-í lí chiah teh siu-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ; kun-kù chiah-ê ōe, lí siūⁿ-beh chòe in ê ông.

Lí koh tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chí-phài sian-ti ūi-tio̍h lí soan-thoân kóng, ‘Tī Iû-tāi ū ông.’ Chiah-ê ōe it-tēng ōe thoân kàu ông hia; só͘-í chhiáⁿ lí lâi, lán chòe-hé chham-siông.”
Góa chiū chhe lâng khì kā i kóng, “Lí kóng ê tāi-chì bô-iáⁿ-bô-chiah, sī lí ka-kī liap-chō--ê.”
In siūⁿ-beh khióng-hat goán, hō͘ goán ê chhiú bô-la̍t thang oân-sêng chit-ê kang-thêng. Góa kî-tó kóng, “Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí hō͘ góa kian-kiông.”

Ū chi̍t ji̍t, góa khì Sī-má-ngá ê chhù beh kìⁿ i, i sī Bí-hi-tāi-pia̍t ê sun, Tē-lâi-ngá ê kiáⁿ; hit-sî i ka-kī koaiⁿ tī chhù-lāi. I tùi góa kóng, “Lán lâi-khì Siōng-tè ê chhù, ji̍p-khì tiān-lāi, chiong sèng-tiān ê mn̂g koaiⁿ--khí-lâi; in-ūi in beh lâi hāi lí, beh tī mî--sî thâi lí.”
Góa kóng, “Góa kiám sī hit-khoán ōe tô-siám ê lâng? Góa kiám thang bih tiàm sèng-tiān lāi pó-choân ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā? Góa m̄ ji̍p--khì.”
Hit-sî góa chiah chai, Siōng-tè pèng bô chhe i, sī To-pí-ngá kap Chham-pa-la kā i bóe-siu, kóng ū-giân kong-kek góa.
In bóe-siu i ê bo̍k-te̍k, sī beh kā góa heh-kiaⁿ, hō͘ góa chiàu in ê ōe khì chòe lâi hoān-chōe, lâu pháiⁿ miâ-siaⁿ hō͘ lâng thí-chhiò.
Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí m̄-thang bōe-kì-tit To-pí-ngá, Chham-pa-la, lú sian-ti Ná-a-tí, kap kî-tha hiah-ê sian-ti só͘ chòe kā góa heh-kiaⁿ ê tāi-chì, m̄-thang pàng in soah.
Keng-kè gō͘-cha̍p-jī ji̍t ê kang-chok, tī Í-lo̍k-ge̍h jī-cha̍p-gō͘ ji̍t, siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê tiông-kiàn chiū oân-sêng.

Goán sì-ûi lia̍t-kok hiah-ê tùi-te̍k thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū lóng tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kám-kak làu-khùi kiàn-siàu; in-ūi in lóng chai chit-ê kang-thêng ōe-tàng oân-sêng, sī chhut tī Siōng-tè ê pang-chān.
Tī hit-tōaⁿ kî-kan, Iû-tāi ê kùi-cho̍k siông-siông siá-phoe hō͘ To-pí-ngá, To-pí-ngá mā kā in hôe-phoe.

Tī Iû-tāi ū chin chōe lâng kap To-pí-ngá kiat-bêng, in-ūi i sī A-la ê kiáⁿ Sī-ka-nî ê kiáⁿ-sài; koh To-pí-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân chhōa Pí-lī-ka ê kiáⁿ Bí-su-lân ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chòe bó͘.
In siông-siông tī góa ê bīn-chêng kóng To-pí-ngá ê hó-ōe, mā chiong góa ê ōe thoân hō͘ i. To-pí-ngá koh siông-siông siá-phoe kā góa khióng-hat.
Siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ tiông-kiàn oân-sêng, góa chiū an-tì siâⁿ-mn̂g, koh chí-phài lâng hū-chek sèng-tiān siú-ōe, hiàn-si, kap kî-tha Lī-bī -lâng ê kang-chok.

Góa phài góa ê hiaⁿ-tī Hap-ná-nî kap pó-lúi ê chí-hui-koaⁿ Hap-ná-nî-ngá, koán-lí Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; Hap-ná-nî-ngá sī chi̍t ê tiong-sìn koh kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng, bô lâng ōe-tàng kap i pí.

Góa kā in hoan-hù kóng, “Kàu ji̍t chhut sio-lō ê sî, chiah thang khui Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-mn̂g; siú-ōe hā-pan í-chêng, tio̍h kā siâⁿ-mn̂g koaiⁿ--khí-lâi, chhòaⁿ hō͘ hó-sè. Tio̍h phài Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn, chiàu pan-chhù tī in ê chhù thâu-chêng kò͘-siú.”
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -siâⁿ khoah koh tōa, siâⁿ-lāi ê chū-bîn iáu chin chió, khí-hó ê chhù mā bô chōe.

Góa ê Siōng-tè kám-tōng góa, tiàu-chi̍p kùi-cho̍k, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, kap jîn-bîn lâi teng-kì in ê ka-phó͘. Góa chhē-tio̍h thâu chi̍t phoe liû-hòng hôe-hiong ê lâng ê ka-phó͘. Ē-bīn sī góa chhē--tio̍h ê chu-liāu:

Í-chêng tùi Iû-tāi -tōe hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat lia̍h--khì ê jîn-bîn, hiān-chāi tùi hia tò-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi, tńg-khì ta̍k-ê lâng ê kò͘-hiong;

in kap Só͘-lô-pa-pek, Iâ-su-a, Nî-hi-bí, A-sat-lī-ngá, La-bí, Ná-hap-má-nî, Boa̍t-tí-kái, Pit-san, Bí-su-pí-lia̍t, Pí-kek-óa-i, Nî-hông, Pa-ná chòe-hé tò--lâi. Í-hā sī chiah-ê tò--lâi ê Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ê jîn-sò͘:
Pa-lio̍k ê hō͘-tāi nn̄g-chheng chi̍t-pah chhit-cha̍p-jī lâng
Sī-hoat-thê-ngá ê hō͘-tāi saⁿ-pah chhit-cha̍p-jī lâng
A-la ê hō͘-tāi la̍k-pah gō͘-cha̍p-jī lâng
Pa-hap Mô͘-ap ê hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī Iâ-su-a kap Iok-ap ê hō͘-tāi, nn̄g-chheng poeh-pah cha̍p-poeh lâng
Í-lân ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p-sì lâng
Sat-thó͘ ê hō͘-tāi poeh-pah sì-cha̍p-gō͘ lâng
Sat-kái ê hō͘-tāi chhit-pah la̍k-cha̍p lâng
Pin-lōe ê hō͘-tāi la̍k-pah sì-cha̍p-poeh lâng
Pí-pài ê hō͘-tāi la̍k-pah jī-cha̍p-poeh lâng
Ap-kah ê hō͘-tāi nn̄g-chheng saⁿ-pah jī-cha̍p-jī lâng
A-to-nî-kan ê hō͘-tāi la̍k-pah la̍k-cha̍p-chhit lâng
Pí-kek-óa-i ê hō͘-tāi nn̄g-chheng khòng la̍k-cha̍p-chhit lâng
A-teng ê hō͘-tāi la̍k-pah gō͘-cha̍p-gō͘ lâng
A-te̍k ê hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī Hi-se-ka ê hō͘-tāi, káu-cha̍p-poeh lâng
Hap-sūn ê hō͘-tāi saⁿ-pah jī-cha̍p-poeh lâng
Pí-sài ê hō͘-tāi saⁿ-pah jī-cha̍p-sì lâng
Hap-la ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-pah cha̍p-jī lâng
Ki-piàn ê hō͘-tāi káu-cha̍p-gō͘ lâng
Pek-lī-hêng -lâng kap Nî-tô-hoat -lâng, kiōng chi̍t-pah poeh-cha̍p-poeh lâng
A-ná-tu̍t -lâng chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-poeh lâng
Pek A-su-má-ui -lâng sì-cha̍p-jī lâng
Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm -lâng, Ki-hui-la -lâng, kap Pí-lio̍k -lâng kiōng chhit-pah sì-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng
La-má -lâng kap Ka-pa -lâng kiōng la̍k-pah jī-cha̍p-it lâng
Be̍k-má -lâng chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-jī lâng
Pek-te̍k-lī -lâng kap Ai -lâng kiōng chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng
lēng-gōa chi̍t ê Nî-pho ê hō͘-tāi gō͘-cha̍p-jī lâng
lēng-gōa chi̍t ê Í-lân ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p-sì lâng
Hap-lîm ê hō͘-tāi saⁿ-pah jī-cha̍p lâng
Iâ-lī-ko -lâng saⁿ-pah sì-cha̍p-gō͘ lâng
Lô-tek -lâng, Hap-tē -lâng, O-ná -lâng kiōng chhit-pah jī-cha̍p-it lâng
Se-ná -lâng saⁿ-chheng káu-pah saⁿ-cha̍p lâng.
Chè-si: Iâ-su-a ê ke Iâ-tāi-ngá ê hō͘-tāi káu-pah chhit-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng
Im-be̍k ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-chheng khòng gō͘-cha̍p-jī lâng
Pa-si-hō͘-ní ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah sì-cha̍p-chhit lâng
Hap-lîm ê hō͘-tāi chi̍t-chheng khòng cha̍p-chhit lâng.
Lī-bī -lâng: Hô-ta̍t-ui-ngá ê hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī Iâ-su-a kap Kah-bia̍t ê hō͘-tāi, chhit-cha̍p-sì lâng
hū-chek hiàn-si--ê, chiū-sī A-sat ê hō͘-tāi, chi̍t-pah sì-cha̍p-poeh lâng
sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe, chiū-sī Sa-liông, A-te̍k, Ta̍t-bûn, A-kok, Hap-tí-tāi, kap Sok-pài ê hō͘-tāi, kiōng chi̍t-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-poeh lâng.
Sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng: Se-hap ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-so͘-pa ê hō͘-tāi, Tap-pa-gô ê hō͘-tāi,
Ki-lio̍k ê hō͘-tāi, Se-a ê hō͘-tāi, Pa-tùn ê hō͘-tāi,
Lī-pa-ná ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-ka-pa ê hō͘-tāi, Sat-mái ê hō͘-tāi,
Hap-lân ê hō͘-tāi, Kiat-tek ê hō͘-tāi, Ka-hap ê hō͘-tāi;
Lī-a-ngá ê hō͘-tāi, Lī-sìn ê hō͘-tāi, Nî-ko-tāi ê hō͘-tāi,
Ka-sàn ê hō͘-tāi, O͘-sat ê hō͘-tāi, Pa-se-a ê hō͘-tāi,
Pí-sài ê hō͘-tāi, Bí-o͘-lêng ê hō͘-tāi, Nî-phó͘-sim ê hō͘-tāi,
Pa-pok ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-kó͘-pa ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-hut ê hō͘-tāi,
Pa-sé-lu̍t ê hō͘-tāi, Bí-hi-tāi ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-sa ê hō͘-tāi,
Pa-kho ê hō͘-tāi, Se-se-la ê hō͘-tāi, Tap-má ê hō͘-tāi,
Nî-sè-a ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-thê-hoat ê hō͘-tāi.
Só͘-lô-bûn ê po̍k-jîn ê hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī Só-thài ê hō͘-tāi, Só-húi-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi, Pí-lō͘-tāi ê hō͘-tāi,
Ngá-la ê hō͘-tāi, Ta̍t-khun ê hō͘-tāi, Kiat-tek ê hō͘-tāi,
Sī-hoat-thê-ngá ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-thòe ê hō͘-tāi, Po-hek-lia̍t Hap-su-pa-im ê hō͘-tāi, A-bûn ê hō͘-tāi.
Sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng kap Só͘-lô-bûn po̍k-jîn ê hō͘-tāi kiōng saⁿ-pah káu-cha̍p-jī lâng.
Tùi Te̍k Bí-la, Te̍k Hap-sat, Ki-lio̍k, A-tùn, Im-be̍k chiūⁿ--lâi, bōe-tàng chèng-bêng in ê chong-cho̍k sè-hē sī m̄-sī sio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng--ê:
Tē-lâi-ngá ê hō͘-tāi, To-pí-ngá ê hō͘-tāi, kap Nî-ko-tāi ê hō͘-tāi, kiōng la̍k-pah sì-cha̍p-jī lâng.

Chè-si tiong chhē bô sè-hē--ê, ū Hap-pa-ngá ê hō͘-tāi, Hap-ko-su ê hō͘-tāi, Pa-se-lâi ê hō͘-tāi (Pa-se-lâi chhōa Ki-lia̍t -lâng Pa-se-lâi ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chòe bó͘, só͘-í chhái-iōng Pa-se-lâi ê miâ); in bōe-tàng tam-jīm chè-si ê chit-hūn.
Séng-tiúⁿ kā in kóng, “M̄-thang chia̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè ê chè-mi̍h, thèng-hāu ōe-hiáu ēng O͘-lêng kap Thó͘-bêng ê chè-si chhut-hiān chiah lâi chhâi-koat.”
Tāi-hōe ê hōe-chiòng lóng-chóng ū sì-bān nn̄g-chheng saⁿ-pah la̍k-cha̍p lâng;
í-gōa iáu ū in ê lâm-po̍k lú-pī chhit-chheng saⁿ-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-chhit lâng, lâm-lú hiàn-si--ê ū nn̄g-pah sì-cha̍p-gō͘ lâng.
In ū bé chhit-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-la̍k chiah, lô nn̄g-pah sì-cha̍p-gō͘ chiah, lo̍k-tô sì-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-gō͘ chiah, lû la̍k-chheng chhit-pah jī-cha̍p chiah.
Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng ūi-tio̍h kang-thêng chàn-chō͘: Séng-tiúⁿ koan poeh kong-kun ê kim hē tī hú-khò͘, óaⁿ gō͘-cha̍p tè, kap chè-si ê lé-ho̍k gō͘-pah saⁿ-cha̍p su;
ū ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ koan chi̍t-pah la̍k-cha̍p-poeh kong-kun ê kim, chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p kong-kun ê gûn, hē tī kang-thêng hú-khò͘;
ū chin chōe jîn-bîn koan chi̍t-pah la̍k-cha̍p-poeh kong-kun ê kim, chi̍t-chheng chi̍t-pah sì-cha̍p kong-kun ê gûn, kap chè-si ê lé-ho̍k la̍k-cha̍p-chhit su.

Tùi án-ni, chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe, hū-chek hiàn-si--ê, í-ki̍p chi̍t-pō͘-hūn ê jîn-bîn, sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng, kap Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-lâng, lóng tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hù-kūn ê tōe-khu. Kàu chhit--ge̍h, kî-tha ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa tī ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong.

Hit-sî, jîn-bîn lóng tâng-sim chi̍t-ì chū-chi̍p tī Chúi-mn̂g chêng ê kóng-tiûⁿ; in chhiáⁿ keng-ha̍k-kàu-su Í-su-la, chiong Siōng Chú thong-kè Mô͘-se pan-pò͘ hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê lu̍t-hoat ê chheh tòa--lâi.
Chhit-ge̍h chhoe-it, chè-si Í-su-la tòa lu̍t-hoat ê chheh lâi kàu hōe-chiòng bīn-chêng, kî-tiong ū lâm ū lú, kap só͘-ū thiaⁿ-liáu ōe bêng-pe̍k ê gín-á.

Í-su-la tī Chúi-mn̂g chêng ê kóng-tiûⁿ, tùi thiⁿ-kng kàu tiong-tàu, tī hōe-chiòng, chiū-sī hiah-ê lâm-lú kap thiaⁿ-liáu ōe bêng-pe̍k ê gín-á bīn-chêng tha̍k hit-kńg lu̍t-hoat ê chheh; jîn-bîn lóng chù-ì teh thiaⁿ.

Keng-ha̍k-kàu-su Í-su-la khiā tī in ūi-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì ēng chhâ te̍k-pia̍t chòe ê tâi-á téng; khiā tī i chiàⁿ-pêng--ê ū Má-tha-thê-ngá, Sī-má, A-nāi-ngá, O͘-lī-a, Hi-le̍k-ka, kap Má-se-ngá; khiā tī i tò-pêng--ê ū Pí-tāi-ngá, Bí-sa-lī, Má-ki-ngá, Hap-sūn, Hap-poa̍t-tāi-ná, Sat-ka-lī-a, kap Bí-su-lân.
Í-su-la khiā tī tâi-téng, tī jîn-bîn ê bīn-chêng thí-khui chit-kńg chheh; i chi̍t-ē thí-khui, tāi-ke chiū lóng khiā--khí-lâi.
Í-su-la chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — chì-tōa ê Siōng-tè; chèng jîn-bîn lóng gia̍h-chhiú, hôe-èng kóng, “Amen! Amen!” In lóng àⁿ-thâu phak tī thô͘-kha kèng-pài Siōng Chú.

Jîn-bîn lóng khiā--teh; Lī-bī -lâng Iâ-su-a, Pa-nî, Sī-lī-pí, Ngá-bín, A-kok, Sa-pí-thài, Hô-tē-ngá, Má-se-ngá, Ki-lī-tha, A-sat-lī-ngá, Iok-sat-poa̍t, Hap-lân, kap Pí-lâi-ngá, pang-chān jîn-bîn bêng-pe̍k lu̍t-hoat.
In tha̍k Siōng-tè lu̍t-hoat ê chheh, hoan-e̍k koh kóe-seh lāi-bīn ê ì-sù, jîn-bîn chiū bêng-pe̍k só͘ tha̍k--ê.

Séng-tiúⁿ Nî-hi-bí, kap chè-si mā-sī keng-ha̍k-kàu-su ê Í-su-la, í-ki̍p kàu-tō jîn-bîn ê Lī-bī -lâng, tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê sèng-ji̍t; m̄-thang pi-ai thî-khàu.” In-ūi choân-thé jîn-bîn thiaⁿ-tio̍h lu̍t-hoat ê ōe lóng thî-khàu.

Nî-hi-bí koh kā in kóng, “Lín khì chia̍h siōng-hó ê mi̍h, lim tiⁿ ê chiú; bô chún-pī chia̍h-mi̍h ê lâng, tio̍h pun hō͘ in. Kin-á-ji̍t sī lán ê Chú ê sèng-ji̍t, lín m̄-thang iu-siong, in-ūi tùi Siōng Chú tit--tio̍h ê hoaⁿ-hí sī lín ê khùi-la̍t.”
Tùi án-ni, Lī-bī -lâng hō͘ choân-thé jîn-bîn pêng-chēng--lo̍h-lâi, kóng, “Tio̍h an-chēng, m̄-thang iu-siong, in-ūi kin-á-ji̍t sī sèng-ji̍t.”
Jîn-bîn chiū khì lim-chia̍h, mā pun mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ lâng; tāi-ke lóng chin hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi in bêng-pe̍k kàu-tō in ê ōe.
Keh-ji̍t, jîn-bîn ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, chè-si, kap Lī-bī -lâng lóng chū-chi̍p lâi keng-ha̍k-kàu-su Í-su-la hia, beh ha̍k-si̍p lu̍t-hoat ê ōe.
In hoat-kiàn, lu̍t-hoat tiong ū kì-chài Siōng Chú thong-kè Mô͘-se bēng-lēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tio̍h tī chhit-ge̍h ê choeh-kî tòa tī chháu-liâu;

koh tio̍h tī ta̍k-ê siâⁿ kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng soan-thoân pò-kò, kóng, “Lín tio̍h chhut-khì soaⁿ--ni̍h, chhú kaⁿ-ná-chhiū, iá kaⁿ-ná-chhiū, tiông-chheng-chhiū, chang-chhiū, kap chhiū-hio̍h chin ām ê chhiū-ki, chiàu só͘ kì-chài--ê tah chháu-liâu-á.”

Jîn-bîn chiū chhut--khì, tòa chhiū-ki tńg--lâi, ta̍k-ê lâng tī ka-kī ê chhù-téng kap tiâⁿ, tī Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ, tī Chúi-mn̂g kap Í-hoat-liân-mn̂g ê kóng-tiûⁿ, tah chháu-liâu-á.

Hiah-ê siū-lia̍h koh tò--lâi ê hōe-chiòng chiū tah chháu-liâu-á, tòa tī hit lāi-bīn; tùi Lūn ê kiáⁿ Iok-su-a ê sî kàu chit-ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng m̄-bat án-ni chòe. In lóng hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
Tùi thâu chi̍t ji̍t kàu lō͘-bé ji̍t, Í-su-la ta̍k-ji̍t soan-tho̍k Siōng-tè ê lu̍t-hoat. Chèng-lâng siú-choeh chhit ji̍t, tē-poeh ji̍t, chiàu kui-lē kú-hêng giâm-siok-hōe.
Kâng hit-ge̍h jī-sì ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chū-chi̍p kìm-chia̍h, chhēng môa-saⁿ, sám thô͘-hún.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi kap só͘-ū ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng toān-choa̍t koan-hē; in lóng khiā-teh jīn ka-kī ê chōe, kap in lia̍t-chó͘ ê chōe-kò.
In khiā--teh, ēng saⁿ tiám-cheng tha̍k Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè lu̍t-hoat ê chheh, koh ēng saⁿ tiám-cheng jīn-chōe, kèng-pài Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè.
Lī-bī -lâng Iâ-su-a, Pa-nî, Kah-bia̍t, Sī-pa-nî, Pò͘-nî, Sī-lī-pí, Pa-nî, kap Ki-ná-nî khiā tī tâi-téng, tōa-siaⁿ ai-kiû Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè.

Lī-bī -lâng Iâ-su-a, Kah-bia̍t, Pa-nî, Hap-sa-nî, Sī-lī-pí, Hô-tē-ngá, Sī-pa-nî, Pí-tha-hi-ngá kóng, “Tio̍h khí--lâi, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, ti̍t-kàu éng-éng-oán-oán! Siōng Chú ah, goān lí êng-kng ê miâ tit-tio̍h o-ló, chhiau-kè it-chhè ê siōng-chàn kap o-ló.

“Siōng Chú ah, chí-ū lí sī Siōng Chú! Lí chhòng-chō thiⁿ, thiⁿ-téng ê thiⁿ, kap thiⁿ-téng ê bān-siōng, koh chhòng-chō tōe kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê bān-mi̍h, hái kap hái-tiong só͘-ū--ê; lí siúⁿ-sù sìⁿ-miā hō͘ bān-mi̍h; thian-kun mā kèng-pài lí.
Lí sī Chú Siōng-tè, ū kéng-soán A-pek-lân, chhōa i chhut Pa-pí-lûn ê Ngô͘-ní, kā i kái-miâ chòe A-pek-la-hán.

Lí chai i tùi lí tiong-si̍t, kap i li̍p-iok, èng-ún chiong Ka-lâm -lâng, Hek -lâng, A-mô͘-lī -lâng, Pí-lī-sé -lâng, Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng, Kek-ka-sat -lâng ê thó͘-tōe hō͘ i ê hō͘-tāi, koh si̍t-hiān lí ê ōe; in-ūi lí sī kong-gī--ê.
“Lí ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ goán ê lia̍t-chó͘ tī Ai-ki̍p siū-khó͘, thiaⁿ-kìⁿ in tī Âng-hái hái-piⁿ ê ai-kiû;

lí chai Ai-ki̍p -lâng ap-pek goán ê lia̍t-chó͘; lí kiâⁿ sîn-jiah kî-sū, kong-kek Hoat-ló, i ê jîn-sîn, kap i kok-lāi ê jîn-bîn; lí chiū tit-tio̍h miâ-siaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ kin-á-ji̍t án-ni.

Lí tī goán ê lia̍t-chó͘ bīn-chêng kā hái pun-khui, hō͘ in tùi hái-tiong kiâⁿ ta-tōe kè--khì; lí chiong tui-jip in--ê, hiat tī chhim-hái, chhin-chhiūⁿ kā chio̍h-thâu hiat-lo̍h tōa-éng.
Ji̍t--sî lí ēng hûn-thiāu chhōa in, mî--sî lí ēng hé-thiāu chiò-kng in tio̍h kiâⁿ ê lō͘.
Lí kàng-lîm tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ, tùi thiⁿ-téng kap in kóng-ōe, siúⁿ-sù in chèng-ti̍t ê bēng-lēng, chin-si̍t ê lu̍t-hoat, hó ê kui-lē kap kài-bēng;
lí hō͘ in chai lí an-hioh ê sèng-ji̍t, thong-kè lí ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se ēng kài-bēng, kui-lē, kap lu̍t-hoat kà-sī in.
“In iau ê sî, lí tùi thiⁿ siúⁿ-sù bí-niû; in chhùi-ta ê sî, lí hō͘ chio̍h-pôaⁿ chhut-chúi; koh kiò in tio̍h khì sêng-chiap lí li̍p-sè beh hō͘ in ê thó͘-tōe.
Tān-sī, goán ê lia̍t-chó͘ kiau-ngō͘ chū-tāi, ngī-sim m̄-khéng hóe-kái, bô thiaⁿ-thàn lí ê kài-bēng;

in m̄-khéng sūn-thàn, bô kì-liām lí tī in tiong-kan só͘ chòe ê kî-sū, kèng-jiân ngī-sim m̄-khéng hóe-kái, ka-kī siat-li̍p léng-siù, chûn-sim pōe-ge̍k, siūⁿ-beh oa̍t tò-khì in chòe lô͘-châi ê tōe. Chóng-sī, lí sī hoaⁿ-hí sià-bián lâng, ū un-tián, ū lîn-bín, bô khoài siū-khì, ū móa-móa chû-ài ê Siōng-tè; mā bô pàng-sak in.
In sui-jiân chù chi̍t chiah gû-á, kóng ‘Che sī chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p ê Siōng-tè’, án-ni tōa-tōa siat-to̍k lí;

m̄-kú lí ū ke̍k-tōa ê lîn-bín, bô pàng-sak in tī khòng-iá; ji̍t--sî, hûn-thiāu bô lī-khui in, chhōa in kiâⁿ lō͘; mî--sî, hé-thiāu mā bô lī-khui in, chiò-kng in tio̍h kiâⁿ ê lō͘.
Lí siúⁿ-sù lí liông-siān ê sîn lâi kà-sī in, bô siu-hôe lí ê má-ná hō͘ in bô mi̍h-kiāⁿ thang chia̍h; in chhùi-ta ê sî, iû-goân siúⁿ-sù in ū chúi thang lim.
Tī khòng-iá sì-cha̍p nî kú lí iúⁿ-chhī in, hō͘ in bô khiàm pòaⁿ-hāng; in ê saⁿ bô phòa, in ê kha bô phòng-phā.
“Lí chiong lia̍t-pang kap hiah-ê jîn-bîn kau hō͘ in, chiong chiu-ûi ê thó͘-tōe pun hō͘ in; in tit-tio̍h Hi-si̍t-pún -ông Se-hông ê tōe kap Pa-san -ông Go̍k ê tōe.
Lí hō͘ in ê kiáⁿ-sun chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ hiah-ni̍h chōe, chhōa in kàu lí èng-ún in lia̍t-chó͘ beh hō͘ in sêng-chiap ê tōe.

In ê kiáⁿ-sun ji̍p-khì sêng-chiap hit-ê tōe, lí tī in ê bīn-chêng chè-ho̍k hit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn Ka-lâm -lâng, chiong hit-ê tōe ê kun-ông kap chū-bîn lóng kau tī in ê chhiú, chhut-chāi in ê ì-sù tùi-thāi hiah-ê lâng.

In kong-chhú kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, pûi ê thó͘-tōe, tit-tio̍h khǹg-móa ta̍k-khoán hó-mi̍h ê chhù-the̍h, kap khui piān-piān ê chúi-chíⁿ, phû-tô-hn̂g, kaⁿ-ná-hn̂g, kap chin chōe ké-chí-chhiū. In tit-tio̍h chia̍h-pá, seng-khu pûi; in-ūi lí ê tōa-un sim-lāi khoài-lo̍k.
“M̄-kú in kèng-jiân m̄ sūn-thàn, pōe-ge̍k lí, chiong lí ê lu̍t-hoat hiat tī ka-chiah-āu; in thâi-sí khó͘-khǹg in kui-ǹg lí ê sian-ti, tōa-tōa siat-to̍k lí.

Só͘-í lí chiong in kau tī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú, hō͘ in siū khó͘-chhó͘; in tú-tio̍h khó͘-lān ê sî ai-kiû lí, lí chiū tùi thiⁿ-téng àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ, chiàu lí ke̍k-tōa ê lîn-bín, hō͘ in ū chín-kiù-chiá, kiù in thoat-lī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú.

In hióng-siū thài-pêng, soah koh tī lí ê bīn-chêng chòe pháiⁿ; lí khì-sak in, kā in kau tī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú, siū tùi-te̍k koán-hat; in oa̍t tò-tńg kiû-kiò lí ê sî, lí iû-goân tùi thiⁿ-téng àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ, chiàu lí ê lîn-bín chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn kái-kiù in.

Lí khoàn-kài in, ài in oa̍t-tńg sūn-thàn lí ê lu̍t-hoat; m̄-kú in kiau-ngō͘ chū-tāi, m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn lí ê kài-bēng, ûi-pōe lí ê bēng-lēng — lâng nā chun-hêng, chiū ōe tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā — keng-thâu oa̍t-cháu, ngī-sim kò͘-chip, m̄-khéng thiaⁿ-thàn.
Lí khoan-iông in chin chōe nî, lí ê sîn thong-kè lí ê sian-ti khoàn-kài in, in iû-goân m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn; só͘-í lí chiong in kau tī lia̍t-kok jîn-bîn ê chhiú.
M̄-kú chiàu lí ke̍k-tōa ê lîn-bín, lí bô siau-bia̍t in, bô khì-sak in; in-ūi lí sī ū un-tián, ū lîn-bín ê Siōng-tè.

“Taⁿ, goán ê Siōng-tè ah, lí sī chì-tōa, ū koân-lêng, thang kiaⁿ-ùi, siú-iok si jîn-ài ê Siōng-tè; goán ê kun-ông, léng-siù, chè-si, sian-ti, lia̍t-chó͘, kap lí ê chú-bîn, tùi A-su̍t lia̍t-ông ê sî kàu kin-á-ji̍t só͘ siū it-chhè ê khó͘-lān, kiû lí m̄-thang khòaⁿ-chòe sió-khóa.
Lí sī kong-gī, lí ê só͘-chòe sìn-si̍t; goán só͘ chòe--ê lóng sī pháiⁿ, só͘ tú--tio̍h-ê sī chōe-kai-èng-tit.
Goán ê kun-ông, léng-siù, chè-si, lia̍t-chó͘ lóng bô chun-siú lí ê lu̍t-hoat, m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn lí ê kài-bēng í-ki̍p lí khoàn-kài ê ōe.

In tī in ka-kī ê kok-ka, hióng-siū lí sù hō͘ in ê hok-khì, tòa tī lí só͘ siúⁿ-sù khoan-khoah pûi-súi ê tōe, in kèng-jiân bô ho̍k-sāi lí, mā bô oa̍t-tńg lī-khui ka-kī ê pháiⁿ só͘-kiâⁿ.
Goán kin-á-ji̍t chòe lô͘-lē! Lí siúⁿ-sù goán lia̍t-chó͘ chit-tè thó͘-tōe, hō͘ in thang hióng-siū ké-chí kap hó-mi̍h; goán kèng-jiân tī chia chòe lô͘-lē.

In-ūi goán ê chōe, chit-ê tōe chhut-sán ê mi̍h lóng kui tī lia̍t-ông; lí siat-li̍p in koán-hat goán, chhut-chāi in ê ì-sù koán-hat goán ê seng-khu kap goán ê cheng-siⁿ. Goán tī hoān-lān tiong chin kan-khó͘!”
Chiah-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, goán sīn-tiōng li̍p-iok, siá-chòe bûn-su; goán ê léng-siù, Lī-bī -lâng kap chè-si, lóng chhiam-miâ khàm-ìn.
Khàm-ìn ê lâng, ū Hap-ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ séng-tiúⁿ Nî-hi-bí, kap Se-tí-ka.
Koh ū chè-si Se-lâi-ngá, A-sat-lī-ngá, Iâ-lī-bí,
Pa-si-hō͘-ní, A-má-lī-ngá, Má-ki-ngá,
Hap-tu̍t, Sī-pa-nî, Má-lo̍k,
Hap-lîm, Bí-lī-boa̍t, Gô-pa-tí-a,
Tān-í-lí, Kūn-tùn, Pa-lio̍k,
Bí-su-lân, A-pí-ngá, Bí-ngá-bîn,
Má-se-a, Phek-kai, Sī-má-ngá.
Koh ū Lī-bī -lâng A-sàn-nî ê kiáⁿ Iâ-su-a, Hi-ná-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ Pin-lōe, Kah-bia̍t,
í-ki̍p in ê chhin-cho̍k Sī-pa-nî, Hô-tē-ngá, Ki-lī-tha, Pí-lâi-ngá, Hap-lân,
Bí-ka, Lī-ha̍p, Hap-sa-pí-ngá,
Sat-khek, Sī-lī-pí, Sī-pa-nî,
Hô-tē-ngá, Pa-nî, Pí-nî-ló͘.
Koh ū jîn-bîn ê léng-siù Pa-lio̍k, Pa-hap Mô͘-ap, Í-lân, Sat-thó͘, Pa-nî,
Pò͘-nî, Ap-kah, Pí-pài,
A-to-nî-ngá, Pí-kek-óa-i, A-teng,
A-te̍k, Hi-se-ka, Ap-sok,
Hô-tē-ngá, Hap-sūn, Pí-sài,
Hap-la, A-ná-tu̍t, Nî-pài,
Boat-pí-ap, Bí-su-lân, Hi-sek,
Bí-sī-sat-pia̍t, Sat-tok, Ap-tō͘-a,
Pí-la-thê, Hap-lân, A-nāi-ngá,
Hô-sè-a, Hap-ná-nî-ngá, Hap-su̍t,
Hap-lô-hek, Pí-lī-hap, Sok-pek,
Lī-hông, Hap-sa-ná, Má-se-ngá,
A-hi-ngá, Hap-lân, A-lân,
Má-lo̍k, Hap-lîm, Pa-ná.

Kî-tha ê jîn-bîn, chè-si, Lī-bī -lâng, sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe, hiàn-si--ê, sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng, í-ki̍p só͘-ū kap lia̍t-kok jîn-bîn toān-choa̍t koan-hē lâi kui-sūn Siōng-tè lu̍t-hoat ê lâng, kap in ê bó͘, in ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p ōe bêng-pe̍k tāi-chì--ê,

lóng chi-chhî hiah-ê chòe léng-siù ê tông-pau, chiù-chōa soan-sè beh chun-thàn Siōng-tè thong-kè I ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se só͘ thoân-siū ê lu̍t-hoat, beh chhî-siú chun-hêng Siōng Chú — goán ê Chú it-chhè ê kài-bēng, bēng-lēng, kap kui-lē.
Goán bô beh chiong goán ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ chit só͘-chāi ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, mā bô beh hō͘ goán ê kiáⁿ chhōa in ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.

An-hioh-ji̍t á-sī sèng-ji̍t, chit só͘-chāi ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng nā tòa siong-phín á-sī ngó͘-kok lâi bōe, goán bô beh kā in bóe. Múi tē-chhit nî, goán bô beh chèng-choh, mā bô beh thó khiàm--goán ê chè-bū.
Goán kui-tēng, múi-nî ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h hōng-hiàn sì kong-khek ê gûn, chòe Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê lō͘-ēng,

pau-koat hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ, keng-siông hiàn ê sò͘-chè kap sio-hòa-chè, An-hioh-ji̍t, chhoe-it, choeh-kî ê chè-mi̍h, kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sio̍k-chōe ê chè, í-ki̍p lán ê Siōng-tè tiān-lāi só͘-ū kang-chok ê hùi-iōng.

Chiàu lu̍t-hoat ê kì-chài, goán chiah-ê chè-si, Lī-bī -lâng, kap jîn-bîn thiu-chhiam koat-tēng, chiàu chong-cho̍k ta̍k-nî tēng-kî hiàn chhâ, thang tī chè-tôaⁿ sio chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè.
Ta̍k-nî, goán beh chiong tōe-chiūⁿ thâu-chúi ê ngó͘-kok, kap ta̍k-khoán chhiū chho͘-se̍k ê ké-chí, tòa kàu Siōng Chú ê tiān.

Goán beh chiàu lu̍t-hoat ê kui-tēng, chiong goán ê tōa-kiáⁿ, thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê gû iûⁿ kap cheng-siⁿ, tòa kàu Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān, kau hō͘ tī sèng-tiān teh ho̍k-sāi ê chè-si.

Goán beh chiong siōng-hó ê mī-hún, hōng-hiàn ê chè-mi̍h, kap ta̍k-khoán chhiū ê ké-chí, sin-chiú, kap sin-iû, kau hō͘ chè-si, khǹg tī Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê chhng-khò͘; koh chiong goán ê thó͘-tōe siu-sêng ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t hō͘ Lī-bī -lâng; Lī-bī -lâng ōe chhin-sin lâi goán chèng-choh ê siâⁿ siu chhut-sán ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t.

Lī-bī -lâng khì siu cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê sî, tio̍h ū A-lûn hō͘-tāi ê chi̍t ê chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng chòe-hé; Lī-bī -lâng mā tio̍h chiong cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t tòa-lâi sèng-tiān, siu-ji̍p hú-khò͘ lāi ê chhng-khò͘.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Lī-bī -lâng tio̍h chiong in hōng-hiàn ê ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, kap sin-iû, tòa-ji̍p siu-khǹg sèng-só͘ khì-khū ê chhng-khò͘; ti̍t-pan ê chè-si, siú-ōe, hiàn-si--ê, mā tiàm tī hia. Án-ni goán choa̍t-tùi bô beh khì-sak goán Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān.

Jîn-bîn ê léng-siù lóng tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; kî-tha ê jîn-bîn thiu-chhiam, múi cha̍p ê ka-têng ū chi̍t ê lâi tòa tī Sèng-siâⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, lēng-gōa hit káu ê tòa tī pa̍t-ê siâⁿ.
Só͘-ū chū-goān lâi tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng --ê, jîn-bîn lóng kā in chiok-hok.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chè-si, Lī-bī -lâng, sèng-tiān ê kang-lâng, kap Só͘-lô-bûn po̍k-jîn ê hō͘-tāi, lóng tòa tī in ka-kī tī Iû-tāi só͘-iú-tōe ê siâⁿ. Ē-bīn sī Iû-tāi -séng ê léng-siù tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng:

Ū chi̍t-kóa Iû-tāi kap Piān-ngá-bín ê hō͘-tāi tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. Sio̍k Iû-tāi --ê ū: Hoat-le̍k-su ê hō͘-tāi A-tha-ngá, i sī O͘-se-a ê kiáⁿ, O͘-se-a sī Sat-ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ, Sat-ka-lī-a sī A-má-lī-ngá ê kiáⁿ, A-má-lī-ngá sī Sī-hoat-thê-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Sī-hoat-thê-ngá sī Má-le̍k-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ;

koh ū Má-se-ngá, i sī Pa-lio̍k ê kiáⁿ, Pa-lio̍k sī Kok Hô-se ê kiáⁿ, Kok Hô-se sī Hap-sài-a ê kiáⁿ, Hap-sài-a sī A-tāi-ngá ê kiáⁿ, A-tāi-ngá sī Iok-ngá-li̍p ê kiáⁿ, Iok-ngá-li̍p sī Sat-ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ, Sat-ka-lī-a sī Sī-lô-nî ê kiáⁿ.
Hoat-le̍k-su ê hō͘-tāi tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng --ê, lóng-chóng ū sì-pah la̍k-cha̍p-poeh lâng; in lóng sī ióng-sū.

Sio̍k Piān-ngá-bín ê hō͘-tāi ū Sat-lō͘, i sī Bí-su-lân ê kiáⁿ, Bí-su-lân sī Iok-ia̍p ê kiáⁿ, Iok-ia̍p sī Pí-tāi-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Pí-tāi-ngá sī Ko-nāi-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Ko-nāi-ngá sī Má-se-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Má-se-ngá sī Í-thiat ê kiáⁿ, Í-thiat sī Í-sài-a ê kiáⁿ;
koh ū Sat-lō͘ ê chhin-cho̍k Ka-pài, Sat-lâi, kiōng káu-pah jī-cha̍p-poeh lâng.
Sè-ki-lī ê kiáⁿ Iok-ní sī in ê tiúⁿ-koaⁿ; Hap-se-ló͘-a ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi chòe hit-ê siâⁿ ê hù-chhī-tiúⁿ.
Chòe chè-si--ê ū Iok-ngá-li̍p ê kiáⁿ Iâ-tāi-ngá kap Ngá-kun;

iáu ū koán-lí Siōng-tè ê tiān ê Se-lâi-ngá, Se-lâi-ngá sī Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ, Hi-le̍k-ka sī Bí-su-lân ê kiáⁿ, Bí-su-lân sī Sat-tok ê kiáⁿ, Sat-tok sī Bí-la-iok ê kiáⁿ, Bí-la-iok sī A-hi-tu̍t ê kiáⁿ;

iáu ū in ê chhin-cho̍k tī sèng-tiān sū-hōng--ê, kiōng poeh-pah jī-cha̍p-jī lâng; koh ū A-tāi-ngá, i sī Iâ-lô-hán ê kiáⁿ, Iâ-lô-hán sī Pí-la-lī ê kiáⁿ, Pí-la-lī sī Àm-se ê kiáⁿ, Àm-se sī Sat-ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ, Sat-ka-lī-a sī Pa-si-hō͘-ní ê kiáⁿ, Pa-si-hō͘-ní sī Má-ki-ngá ê kiáⁿ;

iáu ū in ê chhin-cho̍k chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ--ê, kiōng nn̄g-pah sì-cha̍p-jī lâng; koh ū A-má-sòe, i sī A-sat-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ, A-sat-lia̍t sī A-hap-sài ê kiáⁿ, A-hap-sài sī Bí-si̍t-lī-boa̍t ê kiáⁿ, Bí-si̍t-lī-boa̍t sī Im-be̍k ê kiáⁿ;
iáu ū in ê chhin-cho̍k ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū, kiōng chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-poeh lâng; Hap-ki-to-lîm ê kiáⁿ Sat-pa-tē-gia̍p sī in ê tiúⁿ-koaⁿ.
Lī-bī -lâng ū Sī-má-ngá, i sī Hap-su̍t ê kiáⁿ, Hap-su̍t sī A-su-lī-kan ê kiáⁿ, A-su-lī-kan sī Hap-sa-pí-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Hap-sa-pí-ngá sī Pò͘-nî ê kiáⁿ;
koh ū Lī-bī -lâng ê léng-siù Sa-pí-thài kap Iok-sat-poa̍t, koán-lí Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê gōa-bū.

Chhōa kî-tó kám-siā--ê sī Má-tha-nî, i sī Bí-ka ê kiáⁿ, Bí-ka sī Sat-tí ê kiáⁿ, Sat-tí sī A-sat ê kiáⁿ; koh ū Má-tha-nî ê hiaⁿ-tī, kî-tiong Pat-pò͘-ka chòe hù-chhiú; iáu ū Ap-tāi, i sī Sa-bō͘-a ê kiáⁿ, Sa-bō͘-a sī Ka-la ê kiáⁿ, Ka-la sī Iâ-tō͘-tùn ê kiáⁿ.
Tòa tī Sèng-siâⁿ ê Lī-bī -lâng, lóng-chóng ū nn̄g-pah poeh-cha̍p-sì lâng.
Kò͘-mn̂g ê siú-ōe ū A-kok kap Ta̍t-bûn, í-ki̍p in ê chhin-cho̍k kiōng chi̍t-pah chhit-cha̍p-jī lâng.
Kî-tha ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chè-si, Lī-bī -lâng, tòa tī in ka-kī tī Iû-tāi só͘-iú-tōe ê siâⁿ.
M̄-kú sèng-tiān kang-lâng tòa tī Gô-hui-le̍k; Se-hap kap Ki-su-phà chòe in ê kam-tok.

Tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe Lī-bī -lâng ê kam-tok, koán-lí Siōng-tè sèng-tiān sū-bū--ê, sī hū-chek hiàn-si ê A-sat ê hō͘-tāi O͘-se, i sī Pa-nî ê kiáⁿ, Pa-nî sī Hap-sa-pí-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Hap-sa-pí-ngá sī Má-tha-nî ê kiáⁿ, Má-tha-nî sī Bí-ka ê kiáⁿ.
Ông ū kui-tēng hiàn-si ê lâng ta̍k-ji̍t eng-kai chòe ê chit-bū.
Pí-tha-hi-ngá tāi-piáu ông pān-lí Iû-tāi jîn-bîn it-chhè ê sū-bū; i sī Bí-sī-sat-pia̍t ê kiáⁿ, sī Iû-tāi ê kiáⁿ Siā-la ê hō͘-tāi.
Iû-tāi -lâng tòa ê chng-siā kap in ê chhân-hn̂g, ū Ki-lia̍t A-pa kap chiu-ûi ê chng-siā, Tí-pún kap chiu-ûi ê chng-siā, Ia̍p-kah-sih kap chiu-ûi ê chng-siā,
í-ki̍p Iâ-su-a, Mô͘-la-tāi, Pek Phà-lia̍t,
Hap-sat Su-a, Pia̍t-sī-pa kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā;
koh tī Sé-kek-la, Bí-ko-ná kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā;
koh tī Ún Lîm-bûn, Só-la, Iâ-boa̍t,
Sat-ná-a, A-tō͘-lân kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā, La-kiat kap hù-kūn ê chhân-hn̂g, A-se-ka kap hù-kūn ê chng-siā. In só͘ tòa ê tōe-khu, sī tùi Pia̍t-sī-pa kàu Him-lūn Soaⁿ-kok.
Piān-ngá-bín -lâng tòa tī Ka-pa, Bi̍t-boat, Ai-ngá, Pek-te̍k-lī kap chiu-ûi ê chng-siā,
A-ná-tu̍t, Ná-pek, A-lân-ngá,
Hā-só, La-má, Ki-tha-im,
Hap-tē, Sé-pho-im, Nî-pat-la,
Lô-tek, í-ki̍p O-ná, Hā-la̍p-him Soaⁿ-kok.
Ū chi̍t-kóa tòa tī Iû-tāi ê Lī-bī -lâng, siū chí-tēng kui tī Piān-ngá-bín.
Ē-bīn sī kap Sat-la-thiat ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-pa-pek, í-ki̍p Iâ-su-a chòe-hé tńg--lâi ê chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng: Se-lâi-ngá, Iâ-lī-bí, Í-su-la,
A-má-lī-ngá, Má-lo̍k, Hap-tu̍t,
Sī-ka-nî, Lī-hông, Bí-lī-boa̍t,
E̍k-to, Kūn-tùn, A-pí-ngá,
Bí-ngá-bîn, Má-tí-ngá, Phek-ka,
Sī-má-ngá, Iok-ngá-li̍p, Iâ-tāi-ngá,
Sat-lō͘, A-bo̍k, Hi-le̍k-ka, kap Iâ-tāi-ngá. Chiah-ê lâng tī Iâ-su-a chòe tōa-chè-si ê sî chòe chè-si, koh chòe in chhin-cho̍k ê léng-siù.
Lī-bī -lâng ū Iâ-su-a, Pin-lōe, Kah-bia̍t, Sī-lī-pí, Iû-tāi, Má-tha-nî; chit-ê Má-tha-nî kap i ê tông-sū hū-chek o-ló kám-siā ê si-koa.
In ê tông-sū Pat-pò͘-ka kap O͘-nî, chiàu pan-chhù, tī ho̍k-sāi ê sî kap in khiā sio-tùi.
Iâ-su-a siⁿ Iok-ngá-kim, Iok-ngá-kim siⁿ Í-lī-a-si̍t, Í-lī-a-si̍t siⁿ Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi,
Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi siⁿ Iok-ná-tan, Iok-ná-tan siⁿ Ap-tō͘-a.
Tī Iok-ngá-kim chòe tōa-chè-si ê sî, chè-si chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ--ê, Se-lâi-ngá -cho̍k ū Bí-la-ngá, Iâ-lī-bí -cho̍k ū Hap-ná-nî-ngá,
Í-su-la -cho̍k ū Bí-su-lân, A-má-lī-ngá -cho̍k ū Iok-hap-lân,
Bí-lī-kó͘ -cho̍k ū Iok-ná-tan, Sī-pa-nî -cho̍k ū Iok-sek,
Hap-lîm -cho̍k ū A-tí-ná, Bí-la-iok -cho̍k ū Hi-le̍k-khái,
E̍k-to -cho̍k ū Sat-ka-lī-a, Kūn-tùn -cho̍k ū Bí-su-lân,
A-pí-ngá -cho̍k ū Sè-ki-lī, Bí-ná-bîn -cho̍k ū bó͘-lâng, Mô͘-a-tí -cho̍k ū Pí-le̍k-thài,
Phek-ka -cho̍k ū Sa-bō͘-a, Sī-má-ngá -cho̍k ū Iok-ná-tan,
Iok-ngá-li̍p -cho̍k ū Má-te̍k-nái, Iâ-tāi-ngá -cho̍k ū O͘-se,
Sat-lâi -cho̍k ū Ka-lâi, A-bo̍k -cho̍k ū Hi-pek,
Hi-le̍k-ka -cho̍k ū Hap-sa-pí-ngá, Iâ-tāi-ngá -cho̍k ū Ná-thán-gia̍p.

Í-lī-a-si̍t, Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi, Iok-hap-lân, Ap-tō͘-a chòe tōa-chè-si ê sî, Lī-bī -lâng ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ kap chè-si lóng ū kì-miâ teng-lio̍k, it-ti̍t kàu Pho-su hông-tè Tāi-liû-sū ê sî.
Lī-bī -lâng chòe cho̍k-tiúⁿ--ê, ū kì-miâ tī le̍k-tāi ê nî-kàm, kì kàu Í-lī-a-si̍t ê sun Iok-hap-lân ê sî.

Lī-bī -lâng ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ Hap-sa-pí-ngá, Sī-lī-pí, Iâ-su-a, Pin-lōe, kap Kah-bia̍t tī ho̍k-sāi ê sî kap in ê tông-sū khiā sio-tùi; Lī-bī -lâng chiàu Siōng-tè ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê bēng-lēng, chi̍t-pan chi̍t-pan lûn-liû o-ló kám-siā Siōng-tè.
Má-tha-nî, Pat-pò͘-ka, Gô-pa-tí-a, Bí-su-lân, Ta̍t-bûn, A-kok kò͘-siú siâⁿ-mn̂g piⁿ ê chhng-khò͘.
In lóng sī tī Iok-sat-ta̍t ê sun, Iâ-su-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kim ê sî, í-ki̍p séng-tiúⁿ Nî-hi-bí kap chè-si keng-ha̍k-kàu-su Í-su-la ê sî tng-chit.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kú-hêng siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ hōng-hiàn-lé ê sî, jîn-bîn khì Lī-bī -lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi iau-chhiáⁿ in lâi chham-ka, ài in chhiùⁿ-koa kám-siā, ēng poa̍h, sek, khîm phōaⁿ-chàu, hoaⁿ-hí khèng-chiok kú-hêng hōng-hiàn-lé.
Hiàn-si--ê tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sì-ûi ê tōe-khu, kap Nî-tô-hoat ê hiong-tìn lâi chū-chi̍p;
koh tùi Pek Kiat-kah, tùi Ka-pa kap A-su-má-ui ê tōe-khu lâi; in-ūi hiàn-si--ê tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiu-ûi ū kiàn-li̍p in ka-kī ê chng-siā.
Chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng kiat-chēng ka-kī, kiat-chēng jîn-bîn, í-ki̍p siâⁿ-mn̂g kap siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ.
Góa chhōa Iû-tāi ê léng-siù chiūⁿ siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng, chiong o-ló kám-siā ê lâng pun-chòe nn̄g tōa-tūi. Tē-it tūi tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng tùi lâm-pêng ǹg Pùn-sò-mn̂g khì;
tè tī in āu-bīn--ê ū Hô-sa-ngá, kap Iû-tāi léng-siù ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ;
koh ū A-sat-lī-ngá, Í-su-la, Bí-su-lân,
Iû-tāi, Piān-ngá-bín, Sī-má-ngá, Iâ-lī-bí,

chiah-ê chè-si gia̍h lat-pah. Tè tī āu-bīn--ê ū Sat-ka-lī-a, i sī Iok-ná-tan ê kiáⁿ, Iok-ná-tan sī Sī-má-ngá ê kiáⁿ, Sī-má-ngá sī Má-tha-nî ê kiáⁿ, Má-tha-nî sī Bí-kai-a ê kiáⁿ, Bí-kai-a sī Sat-khek ê kiáⁿ, Sat-khek sī A-sat ê kiáⁿ;

Sat-ka-lī-a kap i ê tông-sū Sī-má-ngá, A-sat-lia̍t, Bí-la-lâi, Ki-la-lâi, Má-gāi, Ná-thán-gia̍p, Iû-tāi, kap Hap-ná-nî, lóng the̍h Siōng-tè ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê ga̍k-khì; keng-ha̍k-kàu-su Í-su-la chòe thâu-chêng.
In tī Chôaⁿ-mn̂g ê tùi-bīn, tùi Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ ê kiā-á chiūⁿ siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, keng-kè Tāi-pi̍t ông-kiong ê téng-bīn, ǹg tang-pêng khì kàu Chúi-mn̂g.

Tē-jī tūi o-ló kám-siā ê lâng kiâⁿ tò-péng hong-hiòng, khì kap tē-it tūi saⁿ-tú. Góa kap jîn-bîn ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ tè in ê āu-bīn, tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng, keng-kè Lô͘-lâu, khì kàu Khoah-chhiûⁿ;
koh kè Í-hoat-liân-mn̂g, Kó͘-mn̂g, Hî-mn̂g, Hap-lâm-gia̍p-lâu, Hap-bí-a-lâu, khì kàu Iûⁿ-mn̂g, tī Kéng-ōe-mn̂g thêng-kha.
Chit nn̄g tūi o-ló kám-siā ê lâng khiā tī Siōng-tè ê tiān, góa kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ mā khiā tī hia.
Chè-si Í-lī-a-kèng, Má-se-ngá, Bí-ná-bîn, Bí-kai-a, Í-lī-iok-nái, Sat-ka-lī-a, kap Hap-ná-nî-ngá, lóng gia̍h lat-pah;
in ê āu-bīn koh ū Má-se-ngá, Sī-má-ngá, Í-lī-a-sat, O͘-se, Iok-hap-lân, Má-ki-ngá, Í-lân, kap Í-siā. I-su-la-hi chhōa hiàn-si--ê tōa-siaⁿ chheng-chàn.

Hit-ji̍t, chèng-lâng hiàn chin chōe chè-mi̍h, mā chin hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi Siōng-tè hō͘ in hui-siông khoài-lo̍k; hū-jîn-lâng kap gín-á mā lóng hoaⁿ-hí khèng-chiok; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ tùi chin hn̄g chiū ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h.

Hit-ji̍t, ū chi̍t-kóa lâng siū chí-phài koán-lí hú-khò͘, in-ūi in ū chiàu lu̍t-hoat ê kui-tēng, ūi-tio̍h kiong-kip chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng, chiong ta̍k hiong-tìn ê chhân-hn̂g só͘ siu-sêng chho͘-se̍k ê ké-chí, cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê hōng-hiàn, kap ta̍k-khoán ê lé-mi̍h lóng khǹg tī hit lāi-bīn. Iû-tāi jîn-bîn tùi chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng ê ho̍k-sāi lóng chin boán-ì.
In chun-hêng Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, siú kiat-chēng-lé; hiàn-si--ê kap siú-ōe mā chiàu Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê bēng-lēng án-ni chòe.
Tī kó͘-chá Tāi-pi̍t kap A-sat ê sî-tāi, chiū ū hiàn-si--ê kap chí-hui, koh ū o-ló kám-siā Siōng-tè ê si-koa.

Tī Só͘-lô-pa-pek kap Nî-hi-bí ê sî-tāi, Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn chiong ta̍k-ji̍t èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h kiong-kip hiàn-si--ê kap siú-ōe, koh chiong beh kiong-kip Lī-bī -lâng ê hūn-gia̍h hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi; Lī-bī -lâng mā chiong beh kiong-kip A-lûn kiáⁿ-sun ê hūn-gia̍h hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi.
Hit-ji̍t, ū lâng tha̍k Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat-su hō͘ jîn-bîn thiaⁿ, tha̍k-tio̍h lāi-bīn ū án-ni kì-chài: A-bûn -lâng kap Mô͘-ap -lâng éng-oán bōe-ēng-tit ka-ji̍p Siōng-tè ê hōe,

in-ūi in m̄-nā bô ēng chia̍h-mi̍h kap chúi gêng-chiap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tian-tò chhiàⁿ Pa-lân khì chiù-chó͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; m̄-kú lán ê Siōng-tè hō͘ hit-ê chiù-chó͘ pìⁿ-chòe chiok-hok.
In thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-tōaⁿ lu̍t-hoat liáu-āu, chiū chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap hiah-ê ū gōa-cho̍k hiat-thóng ê lâng hun-khui.
Chit-ê tāi-chì í-chêng, koán-lí lán Siōng-tè sèng-tiān hú-khò͘ ê chè-si Í-lī-a-si̍t, kap A-bûn -lâng To-pí-ngá chin ū kau-chêng,

chiū ūi-tio̍h i chún-pī chi̍t keng tōa keng pâng. Chit-keng pâng-keng í-chêng teh siu-khǹg sò͘-chè, jú-hiuⁿ, sèng-tiān ê khì-khū, í-ki̍p chiàu kui-tēng kiong-kip Lī-bī -lâng, hiàn-si--ê, siú-ōe ê ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, kap sin-iû ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t, í-ki̍p gia̍h-koân hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, kui hō͘ chè-si ê mi̍h.
Chit-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng ê sî, góa bô tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; in-ūi Pa-pí-lûn -ông A-ta̍t-sih-se saⁿ-cha̍p-jī nî, góa tò-khì ông hia; kè bô jōa kú góa koh tùi ông chhéng-ká.
Góa kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiah chai Í-lī-a-si̍t só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ-tāi; i ūi-tio̍h To-pí-ngá tī Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ chún-pī chi̍t keng pâng.
Góa chiū chin siū-khì, chiong To-pí-ngá só͘-ū ê ka-khū lóng hiat--chhut-khì;
koh bēng-lēng lâng khì kiat-chēng pâng-keng, jiân-āu chiong Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê khì-khū, sò͘-chè, kap jú-hiuⁿ koh poaⁿ--ji̍p-khì.
Góa mā hoat-kiàn Lī-bī -lâng èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h bô hō͘ in, tng-chit ê Lī-bī -lâng kap hiàn-si--ê soah tio̍h tò-khì ka-kī ê chhân-hn̂g choh-sit.
Góa chiū chek-pī hiah-ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, kā in kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ Siōng-tè ê tiān pàng hō͘ hong-hòe?” Góa chiū chū-chi̍p Lī-bī -lâng, hō͘ in hôe-ho̍k chit-bū.
Tùi án-ni, Iû-tāi jîn-bîn chiong ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, kap sin-iû ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t tòa-ji̍p hú-khò͘.

Góa chí-phài chè-si Sī-lī-bí-ngá, keng-ha̍k-kàu-su Sat-tok, kap Lī-bī -lâng Pí-tāi-ngá koán-lí hú-khò͘; koh phài Má-tha-nî ê sun, Sat-khek ê kiáⁿ Hap-lân chòe chō͘-chhiú. In lóng chin tiong-si̍t, chīn-chit chiong mi̍h-kiāⁿ hun-hoat hō͘ in ê tông-sū.
Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kì-liām góa só͘ chòe chiah-ê sū, m̄-thang chhat-siau góa ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê tiān kap ho̍k-sāi I só͘ chòe ê hó-sū.

Tī hit-tōaⁿ kî-kan, góa tī Iû-tāi khòaⁿ-tio̍h lâng tī An-hioh-ji̍t ta̍h chiú-khut, poaⁿ be̍h-khún hō͘ lû chài, koh tī An-hioh-ji̍t chiong chiú, phû-tô, bû-hoa-kó, kap ta̍k-khoán hè-mi̍h ūn ji̍p-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; góa chiū tī in bóe-bōe hit-ji̍t chek-pī in.
Koh ū tòa tī hia ê Thài-ní -lâng, tòa hî kap ta̍k-chióng hè-mi̍h, tī An-hioh-ji̍t, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng bōe hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng.
Góa chiū chek-pī Iû-tāi hiah-ê kùi-cho̍k, kā in kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ chòe chit-khoán pháiⁿ tāi-chì kan-hoān An-hioh-ji̍t?

Í-chêng lín ê chó͘-sian kiám m̄-sī mā án-ni chòe, hō͘ lán ê Siōng-tè chiong che it-chhè ê chai-hō kàng-lo̍h tī lán kap chit-ê siâⁿ? Hiān-chāi lín iáu-kú kan-hoān An-hioh-ji̍t, it-tēng ōe hō͘ Siōng-tè tùi Í-sek-lia̍t hoat koh-khah tōa ê siū-khì!”

Tī An-hioh-ji̍t khai-sí, hông-hun ê sî, góa bēng-lēng lâng koaiⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-mn̂g, kàu An-hioh-ji̍t kè--khì í-chêng bōe-ēng-tit khui. Góa phài kúi-nā ê pō͘-hā koán-lí siâⁿ-mn̂g, chiah bián ū lâng tī An-hioh-ji̍t taⁿ hè-mi̍h ji̍p-siâⁿ.
Tùi án-ni, seng-lí-lâng kap hoàn-bōe ta̍k-hāng hè-mi̍h ê lâng, ū chi̍t nn̄g piàn tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-gōa kè-mî.
Góa chiū kéng-kò in, kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ gōa kè-mî? Nā koh án-ni, góa beh hē-chhiú lia̍h lín.” Tùi hit-sî í-āu, in tī An-hioh-ji̍t chiū bô koh lâi.

Góa bēng-lēng Lī-bī -lâng kiat-chēng ka-kī lâi kò͘-siú siâⁿ-mn̂g, hō͘ An-hioh-ji̍t hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng. Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kì-liām góa só͘ chòe chiah-ê sū, chiàu lí hong-sēng ê chû-ài lîn-bín góa.
Tī hit-tōaⁿ kî-kan, góa koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iû-thài -lâng chhōa A-si̍t-tu̍t -lâng, A-bûn -lâng, Mô͘-ap -lâng ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chòe bó͘.
In ê kiáⁿ-jî ū chi̍t-pòaⁿ kóng A-si̍t-tu̍t-ōe, á-sī pa̍t-cho̍k ê ōe, m̄-kú bōe-hiáu kóng Iû-tāi-ōe.

Góa chiū chek-pī in, kā in chiù-chó͘, phah kúi-nā ê lâng, chhoah in ê thâu-mn̂g, kah in kí Siōng-tè chiù-chōa, bô beh koh chiong in ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ gōa-cho̍k-lâng ê kiáⁿ, in kap in ê kiáⁿ mā bô beh chhōa gōa-cho̍k-lâng ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.

Góa kā in kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Só͘-lô-bûn kiám m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h chit-khoán tāi-chì hoān-chōe? Tī lia̍t-kok tiong, bô chi̍t ê ông chhin-chhiūⁿ i tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê thiàⁿ, koh tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè kā i siat-li̍p chòe Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kok ê ông; m̄-kú gōa-cho̍k ê bó͘ hō͘ i hoān-chōe.
Án-ni, goán ná thang chhut-chāi lín chòe chit-khoán giâm-tiōng ê pháiⁿ-tāi, chhōa gōa-cho̍k ê lú-chú, ngó͘-ge̍k lán ê Siōng-tè?”
Tōa-chè-si Í-lī-a-si̍t ê sun, Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi ê kiáⁿ, ū chi̍t ê sī Hô-lûn -lâng Chham-pa-la ê kiáⁿ-sài; góa chiū chiong Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi tùi góa chia kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.
Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí ōe-kì-tit in só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ-tāi; in-ūi in phah lâ-sâm chè-si ê chit-bū, ûi-pōe Lī-bī -lâng chòe chè-si--ê ê iok.
Án-ni, góa kā in kiat-chēng, hō͘ in thoat-lī gōa-cho̍k-lâng it-chhè ê ù-òe, koh hun-phài chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng ê pan-chhù, hō͘ in chip-hêng ka-kī ê chit-chek,
tēng-kî hōng-hiàn chhâ-liāu kap chho͘-se̍k ê ké-chí. Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kì-liām góa, si-un hō͘ góa.
Chit-ê sū hoat-seng tī A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ê sî-tāi. A-hap-sûi-ló͘ tī Su-san ông-kiong chē-ūi, thóng-tī chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-chhit séng, tùi Ìn-tō͘ kàu Kó͘-si̍t.
I chē-ūi tē-saⁿ nî, pān-toh chhiáⁿ só͘-ū ê léng-siù kap jîn-sîn; Pho-su kap Bí-tí-a ê chiòng-léng, kùi-cho̍k, kap ta̍k-séng ê léng-siù lóng lâi chham-ka.
I ēng chi̍t-pah poeh-cha̍p ji̍t hō͘ in khòaⁿ ông-kok ê hù-jū, kiông-sēng, kap i ke̍k-tōa ê chun-kùi.
Āu-lâi, ông koh ūi-tio̍h tòa tī Su-san -siâⁿ ê chū-bîn, bô-lūn chun-kùi pi-chiān, tī ông-kiong ê hoe-hn̂g pān-toh chhit ji̍t.

Hōe-tiûⁿ ū pe̍h-sek, nâ-sek ê pò͘-lî, ēng iù-môa kap chí-sek ê soh pa̍k tī tāi-lí-chio̍h-thiāu ê gûn-khoân; ū kim gûn chòe ê the-í, pâi tī ēng âng, pe̍h, n̂g, o͘ ê chio̍h-á pho͘ ê tōe-bīn.
Ông kiong-èng chin chōe chiú, ēng ta̍k-chióng bô kâng-khoán ê kim-poe hō͘ lâng lim.
Ông bēng-lēng kiong-lāi só͘-ū ê jîn-sîn, chiú chhut-chāi lâng lim, m̄-thang hān-chè.
Ông-hō͘ Hoa-si̍t-tì tī A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ê kiong-lāi mā pān-toh chhiáⁿ hū-lú.

Kàu tē-chhit ji̍t, ông lim-chiú lim kah chin khoài-lo̍k, chiū bēng-lēng teh sū-hāu i hit chhit ê thài-kàm Bí-hō͘-bān, Pí-su-tha, Hap-pho-ná, Pí-kek-tha, A-poa̍t-tha, Se-ta̍t, kap Kah-ka,
khì chhiáⁿ ông-hō͘ Hoa-si̍t-tì tì ông-hō͘ ê hoa-koan lâi ông ê bīn-chêng; in-ūi ông-hō͘ chin súi, ông ài-beh kā hiah-ê jîn-bîn kap jîn-sîn tián i ê bí-māu.
M̄-kú ông-hō͘ Hoa-si̍t-tì m̄-khéng lâi, m̄ chiàu thài-kàm só͘ thoân ông ê bēng-lēng, só͘-í, ông hui-siông siū-khì, sim-lāi chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh to̍h.
Ông ū chi̍t ê koàn-lē, koan-hē hoat-lēng kap chhâi-koat ê sū, ōe tāi-seng kap hiah-ê bat sî-sū ū tì-hūi ê lâng chham-siông.
Hit-sî tī ông ê chó-iū, siông-siông kap i kìⁿ-bīn--ê, ū Pho-su kap Bí-tí-a chhit ê tāi-sîn, Kah-sī-ná, Sī-ta̍t, Ap-má-tha, Tha-si, Bí-le̍k, Má-se-ná, Bí-bō͘-kan.
Ông mn̄g in kóng, “Ông-hō͘ Hoa-si̍t-tì bô chun-thàn thài-kàm só͘ thoân góa A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ê bēng-lēng, taⁿ chiàu lán ê hoat-lēng tio̍h án-chóaⁿ pān i?”

Bí-bō͘-kan tī ông kap hiah-ê tāi-sîn ê bīn-chêng hôe-tap kóng, “Ông-hō͘ Hoa-si̍t-tì ê só͘-chòe m̄-nā tek-chōe ông, mā tek-chōe A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ta̍k-séng ê koaⁿ-oân kap só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn;

in-ūi ông-hō͘ só͘ chòe ê sū, ōe thoân kàu choân-kok ê hū-lú, in ōe kóng, ‘ A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông tiàu ông-hō͘ Hoa-si̍t-tì khì ông ê bīn-chêng, m̄-kú i kū-choa̍t.’ Án-ni, in ōe ū-iūⁿ-khòaⁿ-iūⁿ biáu-sī ka-kī ê tiōng-hu.

Kin-á-ji̍t Pho-su kap Bí-tí-a chèng koaⁿ-oân ê hu-jîn thiaⁿ-tio̍h ông-hō͘ ê só͘-chòe, mā ōe siâng-khoán án-ni tùi-thāi in ê tiōng-hu, chiū ōe ín-khí chin chōe biáu-sī kap siū-khì.

Ông nā khòaⁿ-chòe thò-tòng, chhiáⁿ hā-lēng siá-chòe Pho-su kap Bí-tí-a bōe-tàng kái-piàn ê hoat-lēng, put-chún Hoa-si̍t-tì koh kìⁿ A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ê bīn; mā chhiáⁿ ông chiong ông-hō͘ ê ūi sù hō͘ pí i khah hó ê lâng.
Ông ê hoat-lēng chi̍t-ē soan-pò͘, chiah-ni̍h tōa ê kok-ka ta̍k só͘-chāi ê hū-lú, bô-lūn in ê tiōng-hu chun-kùi á-sī pi-chiān, lóng ōe chun-kèng ka-kī ê tiōng-hu.”
Ông kap hiah-ê tāi-sîn lóng khòaⁿ Bí-bō͘-kan ê ōe chòe thò-tòng; ông chiū chiap-siū i ê kiàn-gī.
Ông ê chiàu-su ēng ta̍k-séng ê bûn-jī, ta̍k bîn-cho̍k ê gú-giân hoat-pò͘, hō͘ bô-lūn kóng sím-mi̍h gú-giân ê lâng, tiōng-hu tī ke-lāi chòe chú.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì í-āu, A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ê siū-khì soah, chiū siūⁿ-khí Hoa-si̍t-tì kap i ê só͘-chòe, í-ki̍p ka-kī án-chóaⁿ pān i.
Sū-hāu ông ê jîn-sîn chiū chham-siông, beh ūi-tio̍h ông chhē súi ê chāi-sek-lú.

In tùi ông kóng, “Chhiáⁿ ông phài koaⁿ-oân khì choân-kok ta̍k-séng, chhē só͘-ū súi ê chāi-sek-lú; tiàu-chi̍p in lâi Su-san -siâⁿ ê hō͘-kiong, kau hō͘ koán-lí lú-chú ê thài-kàm Hi-kai, koh kiong-kip in hòa-chong-phín.
Ông kah-ì ê lú-chú, thang kā i siat-li̍p chòe ông-hō͘, tāi-thòe Hoa-si̍t-tì.” Ông hoaⁿ-hí chit-ê kiàn-gī, chiū án-ni chòe.
Su-san -siâⁿ ū chi̍t ê Iû-thài -lâng Boa̍t-tí-kái, sī Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k Ki-sū ê cheng-sun, Sī-múi ê sun, Gâi-ní ê kiáⁿ.
Í-chêng Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lia̍h Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kun kap jîn-bîn khì ê sî, Boa̍t-tí-kái mā tī hiah-ê liû-hòng ê lâng tiong-kan.

Boa̍t-tí-kái ū chi̍t ê chek-peh sió-bē Í-su-thiap, Hi-pek-lâi miâ Hap-tāi-sa, pē-bú í-keng kè-sin; Boa̍t-tí-kái siu i chòe ka-kī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kā i ióng-io̍k. Í-su-thiap ê bīn-māu súi, sin-châi hó-khòaⁿ.

Ông ê bēng-lēng kap hoat-lēng í-keng soan-pò͘, chiū ū chin chōe lú-chú sàng-lâi Su-san -siâⁿ, kau hō͘ koán-lí lú-chú ê Hi-kai. Hit-sî Í-su-thiap mā siū sàng-ji̍p hō͘-kiong, kau hō͘ Hi-kai.
