Hi-kai chin kah-ì Í-su-thiap, hó khoán-thāi i, kóaⁿ-kín chiong hòa-chong-phín kap eng-kai tit ê chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ i; koh tùi ông-kiong soán chhit ê kiong-lú kā i sū-hāu; chiong i kap hiah-ê kiong-lú sóa-khì hō͘-kiong siōng-hó ê pâng-keng.
Í-su-thiap thiaⁿ Boa̍t-tí-kái ê hoan-hù, m̄-bat kā lâng kóng i ê sin-sè kap chong-cho̍k.
Boa̍t-tí-kái ta̍k-ji̍t tī hō͘-kiong ê thâu-chêng kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì, ài chai Í-su-thiap ū pêng-an á bô, í-ki̍p i án-chóaⁿ teh seng-oa̍h.

Chiàu kui-tēng, chèng lú-chú beh kìⁿ A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông í-chêng, tio̍h ū chi̍t nî ê chún-pī, chiū-sī la̍k ge̍h-ji̍t ēng bu̍t-io̍h ê iû, la̍k ge̍h-ji̍t ēng phang-chúi kap hòa-chong-phín bí-iông, chiah chiàu chhù-sū chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê ji̍p-khì kìⁿ ông.
Lú-chú tùi hō͘-kiong ji̍p-khì ông-kiong kìⁿ ông ê sî, i ài sím-mi̍h lóng ōe hō͘ i tòa--khì;

ē-hng-sî ji̍p--khì, keh-chá-khí chiū hō͘ lâng chhōa-khì lēng-gōa chi̍t ê hō͘-kiong, kau hō͘ koán-lí pîn-hui ê thài-kàm Sa-kah; nā m̄-sī ông kah-ì, koh thê-khí i ê miâ tiàu i, chiū bōe-tàng koh ji̍p-khì kìⁿ ông.

Lûn kàu Í-su-thiap tio̍h ji̍p-khì kìⁿ ông ê sî, koán-lí lú-chú ê thài-kàm Hi-kai kau hō͘ i ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ í-gōa, i lóng bô thó pa̍t-hāng. Só͘-ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-su-thiap ê lâng lóng chin o-ló i; i sī Boa̍t-tí-kái ê a-chek A-pí-hâi ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, hō͘ Boa̍t-tí-kái siu-chòe cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông tē-chhit nî cha̍p--ge̍h, chiū-sī Thê-pia̍t-ge̍h, Í-su-thiap hō͘ lâng chhōa ji̍p-khì ông-kiong kìⁿ ông.

Ông ài Í-su-thiap chhiau-kè kî-tha ê lú-chú; i pí kî-tha ê chāi-sek-lú koh-khah tit-tio̍h ông ê thiàⁿ-sioh kap un-hūi. Só͘-í, ông ēng hō͘-koan tì tī i ê thâu-khak, siat-li̍p i chòe ông-hō͘ tāi-thòe Hoa-si̍t-tì.
Ông ēng Í-su-thiap ê miâ pān tōa iàn-se̍k iau-chhiáⁿ bûn-bú-pah-koaⁿ, soan-pò͘ choân-kok hiu-ká, koh khóng-khài sàng lé-mi̍h.
Hiah-ê chāi-sek-lú tē-jī piàn chū-chi̍p ê sî, Boa̍t-tí-kái chē tī ông-kiong ê mn̂g.

Í-su-thiap chiàu Boa̍t-tí-kái ê hoan-hù, m̄-bat kā lâng kóng i ê sin-sè kap chong-cho̍k. Í-su-thiap lóng ū thiaⁿ Boa̍t-tí-kái ê ōe, kap í-chêng siū i ióng-io̍k ê sî siâng-khoán.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Boa̍t-tí-kái chē tī ông-kiong ê mn̂g chip-hêng chit-bū ê sî, ū nn̄g ê kò͘-mn̂g ê thài-kàm, Phek-thàm kap Thê-lia̍t, oàn-hūn koh kè-bô͘ beh hāi A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông.
Boa̍t-tí-kái chai chit-ê tāi-chì, chiū kā ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap kóng; Í-su-thiap chiū ēng Boa̍t-tí-kái ê miâ chiong chit-ê sū tùi ông pò-kò.
Keng-kè tiâu-cha, chèng-si̍t ū chit-ê sū, hit nn̄g ê lâng chiū hō͘ lâng tiàu-sí tī chhâ-kè téng. Chit-ê sū ū tī ông ê bīn-chêng kì-ji̍p tāi-sū-lio̍k.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì í-āu, A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông thê-poa̍t A-kah -cho̍k Hap-bí-tāi-tha ê kiáⁿ Hap-bān, hō͘ i ê koaⁿ-ūi pí só͘-ū ê jîn-sîn khah koân.
Só͘-ū tī ông-kiong chip-hêng jīm-bū ê koaⁿ-oân, lóng chiàu ông ê bēng-lēng kā Hap-bān kūi-pài; m̄-kú Boa̍t-tí-kái m̄-kūi m̄-pài.
Tī ông-kiong chip-hêng jīm-bū ê koaⁿ-oân mn̄g Boa̍t-tí-kái kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ bô beh ho̍k-chiông ông ê bēng-lēng?”

In ta̍k-ji̍t kā i khó͘-khǹg, i lóng m̄ thiaⁿ; in-ūi i bat kā in kóng, i sī Iû-thài -lâng, só͘-í bô beh kā Hap-bān kūi-pài. In chiū kā Hap-bān kóng, beh khòaⁿ Boa̍t-tí-kái ōe-tàng kian-chhî jōa kú.
Hap-bān khòaⁿ-tio̍h Boa̍t-tí-kái m̄ tùi i kūi-pài; chiū móa-pak siū-khì.

In í-keng kā Hap-bān kóng Boa̍t-tí-kái sī Iû-thài -lâng; Hap-bān siūⁿ-kóng kan-ta thâi Boa̍t-tí-kái chi̍t ê lâng bô kàu-gia̍h, chiū kè-bô͘ beh siau-bia̍t A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông choân-kok ê Iû-thài -lâng, chiū-sī Boa̍t-tí-kái ê tông-pau.

A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông tē-cha̍p-jī nî chiaⁿ--ge̍h, chiū-sī Nî-sàn-ge̍h, Hap-bān bēng-lēng lâng thiu phó͘-ní, chiū-sī thiu-chhiam, koat-tēng beh hāi Iû-thài -lâng ê ji̍t-kî, thiu-tio̍h cha̍p-jī--ge̍h, chiū-sī A-ta̍t-ge̍h.

Hap-bān tùi A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông kóng, “Tī lí thóng-tī ê ông-kok ū chi̍t ê bîn-cho̍k, hun-sòaⁿ tī ta̍k-séng jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan khiā-khí; in ê lu̍t-lē kap kî-tha bîn-cho̍k bô kâng-khoán, mā bô chun-siú ông ê hoat-lēng; só͘-í nā iông-ún in, tùi ông bô lī-ek.
Ông nā khòaⁿ-chòe thò-tòng, chhiáⁿ hā-lēng kā in siau-bia̍t; góa goān-ì koan gûn saⁿ-cha̍p-sì-bān kong-kun, kau hō͘ hū-chek châi-chèng ê lâng siu-ji̍p ông ê hú-khò͘.”
Ông chiū pak i ê chhiú-chí hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng ê tùi-te̍k, A-kah -cho̍k Hap-bí-tāi-tha ê kiáⁿ Hap-bān.
Ông kā Hap-bān kóng, “Chiah-ê gûn sù hō͘ lí, hit-ê bîn-cho̍k mā kau hō͘ lí, chiàu lí ê ì-sù pān in!”

Chiaⁿ-ge̍h cha̍p-saⁿ, ông ê su-kì hōng-bēng, chiàu Hap-bān ê chí-sī, ēng ta̍k-séng ê bûn-jī, ta̍k bîn-cho̍k ê gú-giân, hêng-bûn hō͘ ông ê jîn-sîn, ta̍k-séng ê séng-tiúⁿ, kap ta̍k-cho̍k ê léng-siù. Chit-ê chiàu-su ēng A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ê bêng-gī, khàm ông ê chhiú-chí-ìn pan-pò͘.

Sàng-bûn-su--ê chiong chiàu-su sàng kàu choân-kok ta̍k-séng, bēng-lēng chiong Iû-thài -lâng, tùi siàu-liân kàu lāu, eⁿ-á, hū-jîn-lâng, tī cha̍p-jī--ge̍h, chiū-sī A-ta̍t-ge̍h cha̍p-saⁿ ji̍t, chi̍t ji̍t lāi kā in thâi-sí, oân-choân châu-bia̍t, koh chhiúⁿ in ê châi-sán.
Chiàu-su ê chhau-pún sàng hō͘ ta̍k-séng, tùi choân-kok jîn-bîn soan-pò͘, hō͘ in chún-pī, thèng-hāu hit-ji̍t.
Sàng-bûn-su--ê chiàu ông ê bēng-lēng, chin kín chiū chhut-hoat. Chiàu-su tī Su-san -siâⁿ kong-pò͘, choân-siâⁿ lóng khí hūn-loān. Hit-sî, ông kap Hap-bān chē-teh lim-chiú.
Boa̍t-tí-kái chai chit-ê tāi-chì, chiū thiah-li̍h saⁿ, chhēng môa-saⁿ, sám hé-hu, kiâⁿ-ji̍p siâⁿ, pi-ai thî-khàu tōa-siaⁿ háu,
kiâⁿ kàu ông-kiong mn̂g-kháu chiū thêng--teh, in-ūi só͘-ū chhēng môa-saⁿ ê lâng put-chún ji̍p ông-kiong.

Ông ê bēng-lēng kap chiàu-su sàng kàu ta̍k-séng ta̍k só͘-chāi, Iû-thài -lâng lóng kìm-chia̍h, thî-khàu, ai-kiò, hui-siông siong-sim; koh ū chin chōe lâng chhēng môa-saⁿ tó tī hé-hu.

Ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap ê kiong-lú kap i ê thài-kàm lâi kā i pò-kò Boa̍t-tí-kái ê tāi-chì. I chin kan-khó͘-sim, chiū kià i-ho̍k hō͘ Boa̍t-tí-kái chhēng, ài i thǹg môa-saⁿ, m̄-kú Boa̍t-tí-kái m̄ chiap-siū.
Í-su-thiap chiū tiàu ông phài-lâi sū-hāu i ê thài-kàm Hap-tha-kek lâi, kah i khì Boa̍t-tí-kái hia, ài-beh chai i ná beh án-ni chòe.
Hap-tha-kek chiū chhut-khì kàu ông-kiong mn̂g-chêng ê kóng-tiûⁿ, khì kìⁿ Boa̍t-tí-kái.
Boa̍t-tí-kái chiū chiong só͘ hoat-seng ê sū, í-ki̍p Hap-bān ūi-tio̍h châu-bia̍t Iû-thài -lâng goān-ì koan-hiàn tī ông ê hú-khò͘ ê gûn khak-si̍t ê sò͘-bo̍k, lóng kā i kóng;

koh chiong kong-pò͘ tī Su-san -siâⁿ, beh châu-bia̍t Iû-thài -lâng chiàu-su ê chhau-pún, the̍h hō͘ i kau hō͘ Í-su-thiap, sòa kā Í-su-thiap soat-bêng, koh hoan-hù i ji̍p-khì kìⁿ ông, tī ông ê bīn-chêng ūi ka-kī ê tông-pau khún-chhiat kiû-chêng.
Hap-tha-kek tò--lâi, chiong Boa̍t-tí-kái ê ōe tùi Í-su-thiap pò-kò.
Í-su-thiap koh hoan-hù Hap-tha-kek tùi Boa̍t-tí-kái kóng,

“Ông ê chèng jîn-sîn kap ta̍k-séng ê jîn-bîn, lóng chai chi̍t ê hoat-lēng, nā ū lâng bô siū ông tiàu-kiàn, ka-kī ji̍p kiong-lāi kìⁿ ông, bô-lūn lâm-lú, lóng tio̍h chhú-sí; tû-liáu ông ū tùi i chhun-chhut kim-koáiⁿ, i chiah bián-sí. Taⁿ góa í-keng ū saⁿ-cha̍p ji̍t kú bô siū ông tiàu-kiàn lah.”
In chiū chiong Í-su-thiap ê ōe kā Boa̍t-tí-kái kóng.
Boa̍t-tí-kái hoan-hù lâng kā Í-su-thiap kóng, “Lí m̄-thang siūⁿ-kóng lí tī ông-kiong lāi pí kî-tha ê Iû-thài -lâng khah an-choân.

Tī chit-khoán sî-chūn lí nā tiām-tiām m̄ kóng-ōe, Iû-thài -lâng ōe tùi pa̍t-ūi tit-tio̍h oān-chō͘, tit-tio̍h kái-kiù; lí kap lí ê chhin-cho̍k it-tēng ōe bia̍t-bông. Lí ōe-tàng chòe ông-hō͘ kiám m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h kin-á-ji̍t chit-ê gûi-ki?”
Í-su-thiap chiū hoan-hù lâng hôe-ho̍k Boa̍t-tí-kái kóng,

“Lí khì, khì chio-chi̍p Su-san só͘-ū ê Iû-thài -lâng, ūi-tio̍h góa kìm-chia̍h saⁿ mî saⁿ ji̍t, bô chia̍h bô lim; góa kap góa ê kiong-lú mā beh án-ni kìm-chia̍h; jiân-āu góa beh ûi-pōe hoat-lēng ji̍p-khì kìⁿ ông; góa nā tio̍h sí, chiū sí.”
Boa̍t-tí-kái chiū chiàu Í-su-thiap ê hoan-hù khì chòe.
Tē-saⁿ ji̍t, Í-su-thiap chhēng ông-hō͘ ê lé-ho̍k, khiā tī ông-kiong ê lāi-tiâⁿ, bīn ǹg ông-kiong; hit-sî ông tī ông-kiong lāi chē tī i ê ông-ūi, bīn ǹg ông-kiong ê mn̂g.
Ông khòaⁿ-tio̍h ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap khiā tī tiâⁿ--ni̍h, chiū tùi Í-su-thiap si-un, chiong chhiú-tiong ê kim-koáiⁿ ǹg i chhun-chhut, i chiū chìn-chêng, bong kim-koáiⁿ ê thâu.
Ông tùi i kóng, “Ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap, lí ū sím-mi̍h tāi-chì, beh kiû sím-mi̍h? Chiū-sī ông-kok ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ, góa mā ōe hō͘ lí.”
Í-su-thiap kóng, “Ông nā khòaⁿ-chòe hó, chhiáⁿ ông kap Hap-bān kin-á-ji̍t lâi hù góa ūi-tio̍h ông siat ê iàn-se̍k.”
Ông thiaⁿ Í-su-thiap ê ōe, tiàu Hap-bān kóaⁿ-kín lâi. Ông kap Hap-bān chiū khì hù Í-su-thiap ê iàn-se̍k.
Tī chiú-iàn ê tiong-kan, ông koh tùi Í-su-thiap kóng, “Lí ài sím-mi̍h, góa ōe hō͘ lí; lí beh kiû sím-mi̍h, chiū-sī ông-kok ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ, góa mā beh hō͘ lí.”
Í-su-thiap ìn kóng, “Góa ê chhéng-kiû sī án-ni:

Góa nā tit-tio̍h ông ê un-hūi, ông hoaⁿ-hí ún-chún góa ê chhéng-kiû, chiū chhiáⁿ ông kap Hap-bān bîn-á-ji̍t koh lâi hù góa ūi-tio̍h lín chún-pī ê iàn-se̍k; hit-sî góa chiah hôe-tap ông góa só͘ beh kiû--ê.”

Hit-ji̍t, Hap-bān hoaⁿ-hí sóng-khoài, lī-khui iàn-hōe; m̄-kú khòaⁿ-tio̍h Boa̍t-tí-kái tī ông-kiong ê mn̂g-kháu bô khiā--khí-lâi, bô tùi i piáu-sī chi̍t-sut-á kèng-ì, chiū tùi Boa̍t-tí-kái hui-siông siū-khì.
Hap-bān ka-kī bián-kióng lún--teh, tò-khì i ê chhù. I phài lâng kiò i ê pêng-iú kap i ê bó͘ Sè-lī-su lâi,
tùi in tián ka-kī ê êng-hôa-hù-kùi kap chin chōe kiáⁿ-jî, í-ki̍p ông ê thê-poa̍t, hō͘ i pí só͘-ū ê jîn-sîn kap léng-siù khah koân.
Hap-bān koh kóng, “Ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap kan-ta chhiáⁿ ông kap góa khì hù i ê iàn-se̍k; bîn-á-chài góa beh koh kap ông chòe-hé khì hō͘ i chhiáⁿ.
M̄-kú góa ta̍k-piàn khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iû-thài -lâng Boa̍t-tí-kái chē tī ông-kiong ê mn̂g-kháu, chiah-ê it-chhè chiū tùi góa lóng bô ì-gī.”

I ê bó͘ Sè-lī-su kap i ê pêng-iú kā i kóng, “Tio̍h chòe chi̍t ê jī-cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh koân ê chhâ-kè. Bîn-á-chá-khí, lí kiû ông chiong Boa̍t-tí-kái tiàu tī hit téng-bīn, jiân-āu chiū thang hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí kap ông chòe-hé khì hù iàn-se̍k.” Hap-bān khòaⁿ chit-ê ì-kiàn chin hó, chiū kiò lâng chòe chhâ-kè.
Hit-mî, ông khùn bōe khì, chiū kiò lâng the̍h i chāi-jīm ê tāi-sū-lio̍k, tha̍k hō͘ i thiaⁿ.
Chheh--ni̍h ū kì-chài kóng, ông kò͘-mn̂g ê thài-kàm Phek-thàm kap Thê-lia̍t nn̄g ê lâng, kè-bô͘ beh hāi A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông; Boa̍t-tí-kái tùi ông pò-kò chit-ê sū.
Ông kóng, “ Boa̍t-tí-kái chòe chit-ê sū, góa kiám ū sù i sím-mi̍h êng-ū kap tōe-ūi?” Sū-hāu ông ê jîn-sîn ìn kóng, “Bô sù i sím-mi̍h.”
Ông kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng tī tiâⁿ--ni̍h?” Hit-sî Hap-bān ji̍p ông-kiong gōa-bīn ê tiâⁿ, beh kiû ông chiong Boa̍t-tí-kái tiàu tī i chhāi hó ê chhâ-kè.
Ông ê jîn-sîn ìn kóng, “ Hap-bān khiā tī tiâⁿ--ni̍h.” Ông kóng, “Hō͘ i ji̍p--lâi.”

Hap-bān chiū ji̍p--khì; ông mn̄g i kóng, “Ông siūⁿ-beh sù êng-ū hō͘ chi̍t ê lâng, tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe?” Hap-bān sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng, “Ông beh sù êng-ū hō͘ i ê lâng, tong-jiân sī góa lo͘h!”
Hap-bān chiū ìn ông kóng, “Ông beh sù êng-ū hō͘ hit-ê lâng, tio̍h án-ni tùi-thāi i:
Ông tio̍h kiò lâng chiong ông só͘ chhēng ê phàu tòa--lâi, chiong só͘ khiâ tì hoa-koan ê bé khan--lâi;

thok chi̍t ê ke̍k chun-kùi ê tāi-sîn, kā hit-ê lâng chhēng ông-phàu, hō͘ i khiâ hit-chiah bé, se̍h siâⁿ ê kóng-tiûⁿ, koh tī i ê thâu-chêng hoah kóng, ‘Ông beh sù i êng-ū ê lâng, ông ōe án-ni tùi-thāi i.’”

Ông kā Hap-bān kóng, “Kóaⁿ-kín khì, chiong ông-phàu kap bé tòa--lâi, chiàu lí só͘ kóng--ê, tùi hit-ê chē tī ông-kiong mn̂g-chêng ê Iû-thài -lâng Boa̍t-tí-kái chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì; liân chi̍t hāng to m̄-thang kiám.”

Hap-bān chiū kā Boa̍t-tí-kái chhēng ông-phàu, hō͘ i khiâ-bé, se̍h siâⁿ ê kóng-tiûⁿ, koh tī i ê thâu-chêng soan-pò͘ kóng, “Ông beh sù i êng-ū ê lâng, ông ōe án-ni tùi-thāi i.”
Jiân-āu, Boa̍t-tí-kái tò-lâi ông-kiong ê mn̂g. Hap-bān iu-būn, khàm-thâu, kóaⁿ-kín tò-khì in tau.

Hap-bān chiong só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì lóng kā i ê bó͘ Sè-lī-su kap i ê pêng-iú kóng; i hiah-ê chham-bô͘ kap i ê bó͘ Sè-lī-su kā i kóng, “Lí it-tàn tùi khí-thâu chiū su Boa̍t-tí-kái, i nā chin-chiàⁿ sī Iû-thài -lâng, lí it-tēng bōe iâⁿ i, ōe thiat-tóe sit-pāi.”
In iáu-teh kóng-ōe ê sî, ông ê thài-kàm lâi, chhui Hap-bān kóaⁿ-kín khì hù Í-su-thiap só͘ siat ê iàn-se̍k.
Ông kap Hap-bān lâi hù ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap ê iàn-se̍k.

Ông tī tē-jī ji̍t ê chiú-iàn koh mn̄g Í-su-thiap, kóng, “Ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap, lí ài sím-mi̍h, góa ōe hō͘ lí; lí beh kiû sím-mi̍h, chiū-sī ông-kok ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ, góa mā beh hō͘ lí.”
Ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap ìn kóng, “Ông ah, góa nā tit-tio̍h ông ê un-hūi, ông nā khòaⁿ-chòe hó, goān lí ún-chún góa ê chhéng-kiû, kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā, kiù góa ê chong-cho̍k;

in-ūi góa kap góa ê tông-pau siū chhut-bōe, lâng beh kā goán châu-bia̍t, kā goán thâi-sí, hō͘ goán oân-choân bia̍t-bông. Goán nā kan-ta hō͘ lâng bōe chòe lô͘-lē, góa mā bô-ōe-kóng; in-ūi goán ê chai-lān bōe chō-sêng ông jōa tōa ê sún-sit. M̄-kú goán beh hō͘ lâng siau-bia̍t lah!”
A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông mn̄g ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap, “Siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì? Hit-ê lâng tī tó-ūi?”
Í-su-thiap ìn kóng, “Pek-hāi goán ê tùi-te̍k chiū-sī chit-ê pháiⁿ-lâng Hap-bān.” Hap-bān tī ông kap ông-hō͘ ê bīn-chêng kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.

Ông hui-siông siū-khì, lī-khui chiú-iàn, ji̍p-khì ông-kiong ê hoe-hn̂g. Hap-bān khòaⁿ ōe chhut ông koat-tēng beh hō͘ i sí, chiū lâu--teh, kiû ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap kiù i chi̍t miā.

Ông tùi ông-kiong ê hoe-hn̂g tò-tńg-lâi chiú-iàn ê só͘-chāi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Hap-bān phak tī Í-su-thiap ê the-í; ông kóng, “I kèng-jiân káⁿ tī kiong-lāi, tī góa ê bīn-chêng, lêng-jio̍k ông-hō͘!” Ông kóng-liáu, lâng chiū khàm Hap-bān ê bīn.

Sū-hāu ông ê thài-kàm Hap-pho-ná kóng, “ Hap-bān tī in tau chhāi chi̍t ê jī-cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh koân ê chhâ-kè, beh chiong kiù ông iú-kong ê Boa̍t-tí-kái tiàu-sí.” Ông chiū kóng, “Kā Hap-bān tiàu tī hit téng-bīn.”
Lâng chiū chiong Hap-bān tiàu tī i beh tiàu Boa̍t-tí-kái ê chhâ-kè téng. Ông ê siū-khì chiah soah.

Hit-ji̍t, A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông chiong Iû-thài -lâng ê tùi-te̍k Hap-bān ê ka-sán sù hō͘ ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap. Boa̍t-tí-kái mā lâi tī ông ê bīn-chêng, in-ūi Í-su-thiap í-keng tùi ông kóng, Boa̍t-tí-kái sī i ê chhin-lâng.
Ông kā tùi Hap-bān the̍h--tńg-lâi ê chhiú-chí, tùi ka-kī ê chhiú pak khí-lâi hō͘ Boa̍t-tí-kái; Í-su-thiap koh úi-jīm Boa̍t-tí-kái koán-lí Hap-bān ê ka-sán.
Āu-lâi, Í-su-thiap koh khì kìⁿ ông, phak tī i ê kha-chêng, lâu ba̍k-sái kiû ông chó͘-chí A-kah -cho̍k ê Hap-bān bô͘-hāi Iû-thài -lâng ê kè-ōe.
Ông ǹg Í-su-thiap chhun-chhut i ê kim-koáiⁿ, Í-su-thiap chiū khiā--khí-lâi,

tùi ông kóng, “Ông nā khòaⁿ-chòe hó, góa nā tit-tio̍h ông ê un-hūi, ông nā khòaⁿ chit-ê sū chòe thò-tòng, góa nā tit-tio̍h ông ê hoaⁿ-hí, khún-kiû ông hā chiàu-su, thiat-siau chêng A-kah -cho̍k Hap-bí-tāi-tha ê kiáⁿ Hap-bān kè-bô͘ beh siau-bia̍t ông ta̍k-séng ê Iû-thài -lâng ê chiàu-su.
Góa ná ōe jím-sim khòaⁿ ka-kī ê tông-pau siū hām-hāi? Ná ōe jím-sim khòaⁿ ka-kī ê chong-cho̍k siū siau-bia̍t?”

A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông chiū tùi ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap kap Iû-thài -lâng Boa̍t-tí-kái kóng, “In-ūi Hap-bān bô͘-hāi Iû-thài -lâng, góa í-keng chiong i ê ka-sán sù hō͘ Í-su-thiap, lâng mā chiong Hap-bān tiàu tī chhâ-kè téng.

Lín thang ēng ông ê miâ chiàu lín khòaⁿ-chòe thò-tòng--ê, siá chiàu-su hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng, ēng ông ê chhiú-chí khàm-ìn. Só͘-ū ēng ông ê miâ siá, koh ēng ông ê chhiú-chí khàm-ìn ê chiàu-su, bô lâng ōe-tàng chhú-siau.”

Saⁿ--ge̍h, chiū-sī Se-oan-ge̍h jī-cha̍p-saⁿ ji̍t, ông ê su-kì chiàu Boa̍t-tí-kái ê chí-sī, siá chiàu-su kià hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng, mā sàng hō͘ tùi Ìn-tō͘ kàu Kó͘-si̍t, kiōng chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-chhit séng ê chóng-tok, séng-tiúⁿ, kap jîn-sîn, ēng ta̍k-séng ê bûn-jī kap ta̍k-cho̍k ê gú-giân lâi siá; kià hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng--ê mā chiàu in ê bûn-jī kap gú-giân siá.

Boa̍t-tí-kái ēng A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ê bêng-gī siá chiàu-su, ēng ông ê chhiú-chí khàm-ìn, chiong hit-ê chiàu-su kau hō͘ sàng-bûn-su--ê, khiâ hông-ka khoài-má sàng kàu ta̍k só͘-chāi.

Tī chiàu-su ê lāi-bīn, ông ún-chún ta̍k-ê siâⁿ ê Iû-thài -lâng chū-chi̍p, khí-lâi pó-hō͘ in ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā; ta̍k-séng ta̍k-cho̍k nā ū kun-peng beh kong-kek in, in thang hoán-kek, sat-hāi, siau-bia̍t hiah-ê lâng, mā thang thâi-sí in ê gín-á kap hū-jîn-lâng, koh chhiúⁿ in ê châi-sán;
tī A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ê ta̍k-séng, Iû-thài -lâng tī cha̍p-jī--ge̍h, chiū-sī A-ta̍t-ge̍h cha̍p-saⁿ ji̍t hit-ji̍t ōe-tàng án-ni chòe.
Chiàu-su ê chhau-pún chiâⁿ-chòe hoat-lēng, tùi ta̍k-séng, ta̍k-cho̍k pan-pò͘, thang hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng chún-pī, thèng-hāu hit-ji̍t, tùi in ê tùi-te̍k pò-siû.
Hiah-ê sàng-bûn-su--ê hōng ông ê bēng-lēng kóaⁿ-kín khiâ hông-ka khoài-má chhut--khì; chit-ê chiàu-su mā tī Su-san -siâⁿ pan-pò͘.

Boa̍t-tí-kái chhēng nâ-sek pe̍h-sek ê tiâu-ho̍k, tì tōa-téng ê kim koan-bián, chhēng chí-sek iù-môa-pò͘ ê gōa-phàu, tùi ông ê bīn-chêng chhut--lâi. Su-san -siâⁿ chhiong-móa hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k ê siaⁿ.
Tùi Iû-thài -lâng lâi kóng, che sī kng-bêng, hoaⁿ-hí, khoài-lo̍k, chun-kùi ê sū.

Ông ê chiàu-su kap bēng-lēng sàng kàu ê ta̍k-séng ta̍k-siâⁿ, Iû-thài -lâng lóng hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, pān-toh khèng-chiok, tēng hit-ji̍t chòe choeh-ji̍t. Ta̍k só͘-chāi ū chin chōe lâng in-ūi kiaⁿ Iû-thài -lâng, chiū kái-chong chòe Iû-thài -lâng.

Cha̍p-jī--ge̍h, chiū-sī A-ta̍t-ge̍h cha̍p-saⁿ ji̍t, ông ê bēng-lēng kap chiàu-su teh-beh chip-hêng, chit-ê ji̍t goân-lâi sī Iû-thài -lâng ê tùi-te̍k ǹg-bāng beh ap-chè in ê ji̍t, m̄-kú Iû-thài -lâng tian-tò chè-ho̍k só͘-ū oàn-hūn in ê lâng.
Hit-ji̍t, tī A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ê ta̍k-séng, Iû-thài -lâng tī in ê siâⁿ chū-chi̍p, kong-kek hiah-ê beh hāi in ê lâng; bô lâng ōe-tàng tí-khòng, in-ūi jîn-bîn lóng kiaⁿ in.
Ta̍k-séng ê léng-siù — chóng-tok, séng-tiúⁿ, kap hêng-chèng koaⁿ-oân — lóng lâi pang-chān Iû-thài -lâng, in-ūi in kiaⁿ Boa̍t-tí-kái.
Boa̍t-tí-kái tī tiâu-têng chin siū chun-tiōng, miâ-siaⁿ thoân kàu ta̍k-séng; i ê koân-le̍k jú lâi jú tōa.
Iû-thài -lâng chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù tùi-thāi oàn-hūn in ê lâng; ēng to thâi-sí in, kā in châu-bia̍t.
Tī Su-san -siâⁿ, Iû-thài -lâng thâi-sí gō͘-pah lâng;
koh thâi-sí Pa-san-tāi-tha, Ta̍t-hun, A-su-phà-tha,
Phò-la-tha, A-tāi-lī-ngá, A-lī-tāi-tha,
Phà-má-su-tha, A-lī-sài, A-lī-tāi, kap Óa-iâ-sat-tha;
chit cha̍p ê lâng lóng sī Hap-bí-tāi-tha ê sun, Iû-thài -lâng ê tùi-te̍k Hap-bān ê kiáⁿ; m̄-kú Iû-thài -lâng bô chhiúⁿ in ê châi-sán.
Hit-ji̍t, lâng chiong Su-san -siâⁿ siū-thâi ê jîn-sò͘ tùi ông thêng-pò.

Ông tùi ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap kóng, “ Iû-thài -lâng tī Su-san -siâⁿ thâi-sí tùi-te̍k gō͘-pah lâng, koh thâi-sí Hap-bān cha̍p ê kiáⁿ; tī kî-tha ta̍k-séng m̄ chai chòe-liáu án-chóaⁿ. Taⁿ lí ài sím-mi̍h, góa ōe hō͘ lí; lí kiû sím-mi̍h, góa mā beh hō͘ lí.”

Í-su-thiap chiū kóng, “Ông nā khòaⁿ-chòe hó, kiû lí ún-chún Su-san ê Iû-thài -lâng, bîn-á-chài mā chiàu kin-á-ji̍t ê chiàu-su lâi chòe, koh chiong Hap-bān cha̍p ê kiáⁿ ê si-thé tiàu tī chhâ-kè téng.”
Ông chiū bēng-lēng chiàu án-ni chip-hêng; hit-ê chiàu-su tī Su-san pan-pò͘, lâng chiū chiong Hap-bān cha̍p ê kiáⁿ tiàu--khí-lâi.
A-ta̍t-ge̍h cha̍p-sì ji̍t, Su-san ê Iû-thài -lâng koh chū-chi̍p, khí-lâi thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi saⁿ-pah lâng; m̄-kú bô chhiúⁿ in ê châi-sán.

Tī ông ta̍k-séng kî-tha ê Iû-thài -lâng mā lóng chū-chi̍p, khí-lâi pó-hō͘ ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā, thoat-lī tùi-te̍k, tit-tio̍h pêng-an. In lóng-chóng thâi-sí chhit-bān gō͘-chheng ê oàn-hūn in ê lâng, m̄-kú bô chhiúⁿ in ê châi-sán.
A-ta̍t-ge̍h cha̍p-saⁿ ji̍t chòe chit-ê sū; cha̍p-sì ji̍t hioh-khùn, tī chit-ji̍t pān-toh, hoaⁿ-hí khèng-chiok.
M̄-kú, Su-san ê Iû-thài -lâng tī cha̍p-saⁿ cha̍p-sì chit nn̄g ji̍t chū-chi̍p, pó-hō͘ ka-kī; cha̍p-gō͘ ji̍t hioh-khùn, tī chit-ji̍t pān-toh, hoaⁿ-hí khèng-chiok.
In-ūi án-ni, tòa tī bô siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê chng-siā ê Iû-thài -lâng, ēng A-ta̍t-ge̍h cha̍p-sì ji̍t chòe choeh-ji̍t pān-toh, hoaⁿ-hí khèng-chiok, koh hō͘-siōng sàng lé-mi̍h.
Boa̍t-tí-kái kì-lio̍k chiah-ê sū, koh siá-phoe hō͘ A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ta̍k-séng hn̄g-kūn só͘-ū ê Iû-thài -lâng,
hoan-hù in ta̍k-nî tio̍h siú A-ta̍t-ge̍h cha̍p-sì cha̍p-gō͘ nn̄g ji̍t chòe choeh-ji̍t.

Chit nn̄g ji̍t sī Iû-thài -lâng thoat-lī tùi-te̍k, tit-tio̍h pêng-an ê ji̍t; hit-ge̍h sī iu-būn pìⁿ-chòe hoaⁿ-hí, pi-ai pìⁿ-chòe khoài-lo̍k ê ge̍h; in tio̍h tī chit nn̄g-ji̍t pān-toh khèng-chiok, hō͘-siōng sàng lé-mi̍h, koh chín-chè sàn-chhiah-lâng.
Iû-thài -lâng tah-èng beh chun-siú Boa̍t-tí-kái ê chí-sī, chiàu khai-sí ê sî só͘ chòe--ê, ta̍k-nî siú chit-ê choeh-ji̍t.

Iû-thài -lâng ê tùi-te̍k, A-kah -cho̍k Hap-bí-tāi-tha ê kiáⁿ Hap-bān, siat kè-bô͘ beh siau-bia̍t Iû-thài -lâng, thiu phó͘-ní, chiū-sī thiu-chhiam, ūi-tio̍h beh sat-hāi, châu-bia̍t in;

m̄-kú Í-su-thiap chiong chit-ê tāi-chì tùi ông pò-kò, ông chiū pan-pò͘ chiàu-su, hō͘ Hap-bān kè-bô͘ beh hāi Iû-thài -lâng ê pháiⁿ-tāi, pò-èng tī i ka-kī ê sin-chiūⁿ, koh i kap i hiah-ê kiáⁿ hō͘ lâng tiàu tī chhâ-kè téng.
Tùi án-ni, Iû-thài -lâng chiàu phó͘-ní ê miâ kiò hiah-ê ji̍t chòe Phó͘-ní-ji̍t. In in-ūi Boa̍t-tí-kái chit-tiuⁿ phoe í-ki̍p in chhin-sin ê keng-le̍k,
chiū ūi-tio̍h in, in ê hō͘-tāi, í-ki̍p só͘-ū kui-hòa kái-chong ê lâng, koat-tēng beh éng-oán tī ta̍k-nî chiàu kui-tēng, siú chit nn̄g ji̍t chòe choeh-kî;
koh beh sè-sè-tāi-tāi, ke-ke-hō͘-hō͘, ta̍k-séng ta̍k-siâⁿ, siú Phó͘-ní-ji̍t, tī Iû-thài -lâng ê tiong-kan éng-kiú kì-liām.
A-pí-hâi ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap kap Iû-thài -lâng Boa̍t-tí-kái, choân-koân siá tē-jī tiuⁿ phoe khak-tēng Phó͘-ní-ji̍t.
In ēng hô-pêng, sêng-si̍t ê ōe, siá chit-tiuⁿ phoe hō͘ A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông kok-lāi chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-chhit séng ê Iû-thài -lâng,

chiàu Iû-thài -lâng Boa̍t-tí-kái kap ông-hō͘ Í-su-thiap ê chí-sī, siat-li̍p Phó͘-ní-ji̍t; chhin-chhiūⁿ Iû-thài -lâng ūi ka-kī kap in ê hō͘-tāi kui-tēng kìm-chia̍h ai-khàu ê ji̍t siâng-khoán.
Í-su-thiap bēng-lēng tio̍h siú Phó͘-ní-ji̍t ê sū, mā ū kì-lio̍k tī chheh-kǹg--ni̍h.
A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông tùi kok-lāi kap iân-hái it-tài ê jîn-bîn siu sè-kim.
I ēng koân-pèng lêng-le̍k só͘ chòe ê sū, í-ki̍p thê-poa̍t Boa̍t-tí-kái ê keng-kè, lóng kì-chài tī Bí-tí-a kap Pho-su ê Lia̍t-ông-sú.

In-ūi Iû-thài -lâng Boa̍t-tí-kái chòe A-hap-sûi-ló͘ -ông ê cháiⁿ-siòng, tī Iû-thài -lâng ê tiong-kan chòe siōng tōa, tit-tio̍h i tông-pau ê chun-kèng, ūi-tio̍h i ê tông-pau cheng-chhú hok-lī, hō͘ in ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun tit-tio̍h hēng-hok.
O͘-su tōe-khu bat ū chi̍t ê lâng kiò-chòe Iok-pek, i sûn-choân chèng-ti̍t, kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, bô chòe pháiⁿ-tāi.
I ū chhit ê kiáⁿ, saⁿ ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
I ê châi-sán ū chhit-chheng chiah iûⁿ, saⁿ-chheng chiah lo̍k-tô, gō͘-pah tùi gû, gō͘-pah chiah lû-bú; koh ū chin chōe po̍k-jîn. I sī tang-hng tē-it hó-gia̍h--ê.
I hiah-ê kiáⁿ siông-siông lûn-liû tī in ka-kī ê chhù pān chhe-chhau, mā chhiáⁿ in saⁿ ê chí-bē chòe-hé lim-chia̍h.

Múi chi̍t piàn in lûn-liû pān chhe-chhau liáu, Iok-pek ōe chhe lâng kiò in tio̍h kiat-chēng ka-kī. I thàu-chá khí--lâi, chiàu in ê jîn-sò͘ thòe in hiàn sio-hòa-chè. Iok-pek chiàu-siông án-ni chòe, in-ūi i siūⁿ-kóng, i ê kiáⁿ khó-lêng ū hoān-chōe, siat-to̍k Siōng-tè.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Siōng-tè ê chèng sù-chiá lâi khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, Sat-tàn mā chòe-hé lâi.
Siōng Chú mn̄g Sat-tàn, “Lí khì tó-ūi?” Sat-tàn ìn Siōng Chú, “Góa tī tōe-chiūⁿ sì-kòe kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì.”

Siōng Chú tùi Sat-tàn kóng, “Lí ū chù-ì tio̍h góa ê po̍k-jîn Iok-pek --bô? Sè-kan bô lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ i hiah-ni̍h sûn-choân chèng-ti̍t, kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, bô chòe pháiⁿ-tāi.”
Sat-tàn ìn Siōng Chú, “ Iok-pek kèng-ùi Siōng-tè kiám bô lí-iû?
Lí kiám m̄-sī ū ēng lî-pa kā i ûi--teh, pó-hō͘ i, i ê ka-têng, kap i só͘ ū ê it-chhè? I só͘ chòe--ê, lí sù-hok i, hō͘ i ê cheng-siⁿ chōe kah bōe-sǹg--tit.
I só͘-ū--ê lí chhin-chhiú kā i kha̍p chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-bāi leh, i it-tēng ōe tng-bīn kā lí chiù-chó͘.”
Siōng Chú tùi Sat-tàn kóng, “Hó, i it-chhè só͘ ū--ê lóng tī lí ê chhiú-thâu, m̄-kú m̄-thang siong-hāi tio̍h i pún-sin.” Sat-tàn chiū tùi Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng chhut--khì.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t Iok-pek ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tú-á tī in tōa-hiaⁿ ê chhù teh chia̍h teh lim ê sî,
ū chi̍t ê sù-chiá lâi kā Iok-pek kóng, “Gû teh lôe-chhân, lû-bú tī piⁿ--á chia̍h-chháu ê sî,
Sī-pa -lâng hut-jiân lâi kong-kek, kā gû kap lû lóng chhiúⁿ--khì, koh ēng to thâi-sí hiah-ê po̍k-jîn; chí-ū góa chi̍t ê cháu ū lī lâi pò lí.”
I kóng iáu-bē soah, koh ū chi̍t ê lâi, kóng, “Siōng-tè ê hé tùi thiⁿ kàng-lo̍h, sio-sí iûⁿ-kûn kap hiah-ê po̍k-jîn; chí-ū góa chi̍t ê cháu ū lī lâi pò lí.”

I kóng iáu-bē soah, koh ū chi̍t ê lâi, kóng, “ Ka-le̍k-tí -lâng pun-chòe saⁿ tūi hut-jiân lâi kong-kek, kā lo̍k-tô lóng chhiúⁿ--khì, koh ēng to thâi-sí hiah-ê po̍k-jîn; chí-ū góa chi̍t ê cháu ū lī lâi pò lí.”
I kóng iáu-bē soah, koh ū chi̍t ê lâi, kóng, “Lí ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, tī in tōa-hiaⁿ ê chhù teh chia̍h teh lim ê sî,
hut-jiân ū tōa-hong tùi khòng-iá thàu--lâi, sàu chhù ê sì-kak-thâu, chhù tó, teh-sí hiah-ê siàu-liân-lâng; chí-ū góa chi̍t ê cháu ū lī lâi pò lí.”
Iok-pek chiū khiā--khí-lâi, thiah-li̍h gōa-saⁿ, thì-thâu, phak tī thô͘-kha pài,
kóng, “Góa thǹg-theh chhut bú-thai, mā ōe thǹg-theh tò--khì; Siōng Chú siúⁿ-sù, Siōng Chú the̍h--khì. Goān Siōng Chú ê miâ siū chheng-chàn!”
Sui-jiân tú-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì, Iok-pek pèng bô hoān-chōe chí-chek Siōng-tè.
Koh ū chi̍t ji̍t, Siōng-tè ê chèng sù-chiá lâi khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, Sat-tàn mā chòe-hé lâi khiā tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng.
Siōng Chú tùi Sat-tàn kóng, “Lí khì tó-ūi?” Sat-tàn ìn Siōng Chú, “Góa tī tōe-chiūⁿ sì-kòe kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì.”

Siōng Chú tùi Sat-tàn kóng, “Lí ū chù-ì tio̍h góa ê po̍k-jîn Iok-pek --bô? Sè-kan bô lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ i hiah-ni̍h sûn-choân chèng-ti̍t, kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, bô chòe pháiⁿ-tāi. Lí sui-jiân kek góa kong-kek i, bô lí-iû húi-hoāi i, i iáu-kú chhî-siú i ê sûn-choân chèng-ti̍t.”
Sat-tàn ìn Siōng Chú, “Ēng phê ōaⁿ phê! Lâng ōe ūi-tio̍h kò͘ ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā kam-goān pàng-sak i ê it-chhè só͘ ū.
M̄-kú lí nā chhun-chhiú kha̍p-tio̍h i ê kut, i ê bah, i it-tēng ōe tng-bīn kā lí chiù-chó͘.”
Siōng Chú tùi Sat-tàn kóng, “Hó, i tī lí ê chhiú-thâu, m̄-kú tio̍h lâu i ê sìⁿ-miā.”
Sat-tàn chiū tùi Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng chhut--khì, kong-kek Iok-pek, hō͘ i tùi kha-tóe kàu thâu-khak téng siⁿ to̍k-chhng.
Iok-pek chiū chē tī hé-hu téng, ēng phòa--khì ê hiā-phìⁿ pê seng-khu.
I ê bó͘ tùi i kóng, “Lí iáu-teh chhî-siú lí ê chèng-ti̍t o͘h? Tio̍h chiù-chó͘ Siōng-tè, khì sí-sí--leh.”

M̄-kú Iok-pek tùi i kóng, “Lí kóng-ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hiah-ê m̄-chai kiàn-siàu ê cha-bó͘-lâng. Lán tùi Siōng-tè tit-tio̍h hok-khì, kiám bô mā tùi I siū chai-hō?” Sui-jiân tú-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì, Iok-pek iû-goân bô kóng chi̍t kù tek-chōe Siōng-tè ê ōe.

Iok-pek saⁿ ê pêng-iú — Thê-bān -lâng Í-lī-hoat, Su-a -lâng Pí-le̍k-ta̍t, Ná-má -lâng Só-hoat — thiaⁿ-tio̍h i tú-tio̍h chiah-ê chai-hō, chiū sio-chio tùi in ê só͘-chāi lâi piáu-sī tông-chêng, kā i an-ùi.
In hn̄g-hn̄g khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-pek, bōe-jīn--tit, chiū tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu; ta̍k-ê thiah-li̍h gōa-saⁿ, ǹg thiⁿ iā thô͘-hún tī ka-kī ê thâu-khak téng.
In chhit mî chhit ji̍t kap i chē tī thô͘-kha, bô kap i kóng chi̍t kù ōe, in-ūi in khòaⁿ-tio̍h i só͘ siū ê thòng-khó͘ si̍t-chāi chin tōa.
Āu-lâi Iok-pek khui-chhùi, chiù-chó͘ i chhut-sì ê ji̍t.
Iok-pek kóng:
Goān góa chhut-sì hit-ji̍t siau-sit; goān kóng “Ū hoâi-īn ta-po͘-kiáⁿ” hit-mî mā siau-sit.
Goān hit-ji̍t pìⁿ-chòe o͘-àm; goān thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè bô khòaⁿ-kò͘ i, kng mā bô chiò i.
Goān o͘-àm kap sí-ìm kā hit-ji̍t chhú--khì; goān ba̍t-hûn khàm tī hit téng-bīn; goān ji̍t-thâu choân-si̍t phah-kiaⁿ i.
Goān hit-mî hō͘ o͘-àm thun--khì, tùi nî-le̍k san-tû, bô khǹg tī ge̍h-le̍k lāi-bīn.
Goān hit-mî bô lâng siⁿ-kiáⁿ, bô thiaⁿ-tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ.
Goān hiah-ê liām hû-chiù, ōe-hiáu ho͘-hoàn hái-siù --ê, khí-lâi chiù-chó͘ hit-ji̍t.
Goān khé-bêng-chhiⁿ pìⁿ-chòe o͘-àm, só͘ kî-thāi ê thiⁿ-kng bōe chhut-hiān, mā khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h chheng-chá ê ji̍t-kng;
in-ūi i bô koaiⁿ-ba̍t góa ê lāu-bú ê chú-kiong, tì-kàu góa ê ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ-tio̍h chin chōe hoān-lān.
Góa ná ōe bô tī thai--ni̍h chiū sí, ná ōe bô chhut pak-tó͘ chiū tn̄g-khùi?
Sī-án-chóaⁿ ū kha-thâu-u kā góa chiap, ū lin hō͘ góa suh?
Nā bô, góa í-keng an-jiân kè-sin, í-keng chēng-chēng khùn--khì,
kap tōe-chiūⁿ ūi-tio̍h ka-kī tiông-kiàn hong-hòe ê kiong-tiān ê kun-ông siú-léng chòe-hé teh khùn;
á-sī kap kim-gûn châi-pó móa chhù ê ông-chú chòe-hé khùn,
ná bô chhin-chhiūⁿ liû-sán chiū kā tâi ê eⁿ-á, chhin-chhiūⁿ bô kìⁿ-tio̍h kng ê thai-jî.
Tī hia pháiⁿ-lâng bōe koh jiáu-loān; ià-siān ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h an-lêng.
Tī hia siû-hoān lóng tit-tio̍h an-hioh, bōe koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h tok-kang ê siaⁿ.
Bô-lūn tōa-sòe kùi-chiān lóng tī hia; lô͘-lē mā thoat-lī chú-lâng ê koán-chè, tit-tio̍h chū-iû.
Siōng-tè sī-án-chóaⁿ sù kng-bêng hō͘ siū-khó͘ ê lâng, sī-án-chóaⁿ sù sìⁿ-miā hō͘ sim-sîn thòng-khó͘ ê lâng?
In ài-beh sí, koh sí bōe khì; chhē sí pí chhē chhàng--teh ê pó-pòe khah pek-chhiat.
In chi̍t-ē chhē-tio̍h hûn-bōng chiū khoài-lo̍k, hoaⁿ-hí kàu bōe-kò͘--tit.
Lâng ê lō͘ í-keng hō͘ Siōng-tè cha̍h--teh, cháu-tâu-bô-lō͘, ná koh sù i kng-bêng?
Góa ēng thó͘-khùi chòe pn̄g chia̍h; tōa-siaⁿ háu, chhin-chhiūⁿ choh tōa-chúi.
Góa teh kiaⁿ--ê, kèng-jiân hoat-seng, só͘ kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ--ê, phian-phian lîm-kàu.
Góa bô pêng-an, bô pêng-chēng, bô tit-tio̍h an-hioh, chí-ū chai-lān put-toān lîm-kàu góa.
Thê-bān -lâng Í-lī-hoat ìn Iok-pek kóng:
Lâng beh kap lí kóng-ōe, lí ōe hiâm mâ-hoân bōe? Kiám ū lâng ōe-tàng lún--teh bô kóng-ōe?
Lí bat kà-sī chin chōe lâng, hō͘ loán-jio̍k ê chhiú kian-kiông.
Poa̍h-tó--ê, lí ēng ōe kā i hû--khí-lâi; kha-thâu-u sng-nńg--ê, lí hō͘ i ióng-kiāⁿ.
Chóng-sī chai-lān chi̍t-ē hoat-seng, lí chiū bōe-tàng jím-siū; chi̍t-ē kha̍p-tio̍h lí, lí chiū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Lí kiám m̄-sī tùi kèng-ùi Siōng-tè tit-tio̍h khak-sìn? Kiám m̄-sī tùi sûn-choân ê hêng-ûi tit-tio̍h ǹg-bāng?
Siūⁿ-khòaⁿ leh, bû-ko͘ ê lâng ná ōe bia̍t-bông? Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng kiám ōe húi-bia̍t?
Góa khòaⁿ, lâng nā chai-chèng chōe-kò, iā siâ-ok ê chéng-chí, it-tēng ōe siu-sêng kâng-lūi ê ké-chí.
Siōng-tè pûn-khùi, in chiū bia̍t-bông; I hoat tōa siū-khì, in chiū siau-bia̍t,
sai teh háu, béng-sai tián-ui ê siaⁿ lóng soah, sai-á-thûn ê chhùi-khí mā lóng kòng-tn̄g;
sai in-ūi bô thang chia̍h sí--khì, sai-á-kiáⁿ mā lóng sì-sòaⁿ.
Ū ōe tiām-tiām-á thoân kàu góa chia; góa ê hī-khang ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h i sòe-sòe ê siaⁿ.
Mî--sî lâng khùn tāng-bîn, siū ok-bāng kiáu-jiáu ê sî,
kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ lîm-kàu góa, hō͘ góa kui seng-khu phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.
Ū chi̍t chūn hong tùi góa ê bīn chhe--kè; góa kui seng-khu ê mn̂g chhàng--khí-lâi.
I thêng--teh, m̄-kú góa khòaⁿ bōe chhut i ê hêng-chōng. Ū hêng-siōng tī góa ba̍k-chiu chêng; sì-ûi chēng-chēng-chēng, góa thiaⁿ-tio̍h ū siaⁿ kóng:
Ōe-sí ê lâng tī Siōng-tè gán-tiong kiám sī gī-lâng? Lâng tī Chhòng-chō-chú bīn-chêng kiám ōe-tàng sǹg-chòe bô-chōe?
Siōng-tè bô sìn-jīm ka-kī ê po̍k-jîn, mā ōe chí-chek I sù-chiá ê chhò-gō͘.
Hiah-ê tòa tī thô͘-kak-chhù ê lâng koh-khah bián-kóng; in ê pún-chit sī thô͘-hún, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiù-thâng hō͘ lâng chi̍t-ē jôe chiū sí.
In chá-khí-sî oa̍h--teh, ē-hng-sî chiū siū húi-bia̍t, éng-oán bô--khì, bô lâng ōe-kì--tit.
In pò͘-pîⁿ ê soh khiú--khí-lâi chiū tó--lo̍h-khì, sí kah bô-bêng-bô-pe̍k.
Taⁿ chòe lí kiû-kiò, khòaⁿ ū siáⁿ-lâng ōe kā lí ìn? Chiah-ê sù-chiá ê tiong-kan, lí beh tùi tó chi̍t ê kiû?
Siū-khì ōe hāi-sí gōng-lâng; oàn-tò͘ ōe thâi-sí han-bān ê lâng.
Góa bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h gōng-lâng heng-ōng, m̄-kú chai-lān hut-jiân lîm-kàu i ê ke.
I ê kiáⁿ-jî bô lâng pó-hō͘, sit-khì an-ún; tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu chhâi-koat ê sî siū khi-ap, bô lâng ūi in chú-chhî kong-tō.
I só͘ siu-sêng--ê, hō͘ iau ê lâng chia̍h--khì, liân tī chhì-phè lāi--ê mā chhiúⁿ--khì, chhùi-ta ê lâng thun i ê châi-hù.
In-ūi chai-hō m̄-sī tùi thô͘ puh--chhut-lâi, hoān-lān mā m̄-sī tùi tōe hoat--chhut-lâi.
Lâng chhut-sì it-tēng ū hoān-lān, chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-chhiⁿ chhèng chin koân.
Nā-sī góa, góa beh kiû-kiò Siōng-tè; chiong góa ê àn-kiāⁿ kau-tài I.
I chòe ê tāi-chì tōa kah bōe chhek-to̍k--tit; I kiâⁿ ê kî-sū chōe kah sǹg bōe liáu.
I lo̍h-hō͘ tī tōe-bīn, sù hō͘-chúi lūn-te̍k chhân-hn̂g;
I ko-seng pi-bî ê lâng, sù an-choân hí-lo̍k hō͘ pi-chhám ê lâng.
I phò-hoāi khúi-khiat ê lâng ê kè-bô͘, hō͘ in ê chhiú só͘ chòe--ê bōe sêng-kong.
I hō͘ khiáu-lâng tiòng-tio̍h ka-kī ê khúi-kè, hō͘ kan-chà ê lâng ê kè-bô͘ chin kín sit-pāi.
In ji̍t--sî tú-tio̍h o͘-àm, ji̍t tiong-tàu chhin-chhiūⁿ mî--sî sì-kòe bong.
Siōng-tè kiù sàn-chhiah-lâng thoat-lī siong-hāi in ê lâng ê chi̍h, í-ki̍p koân-le̍k-chiá ê chhiú.
Tùi án-ni, sàn-chhiah-lâng ū ǹg-bāng; pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhùi siū that-ba̍t.
Siū Siōng-tè koán-kàu ê lâng chin ū hok-khì; só͘-í, m̄-thang khòaⁿ-khin Choân-lêng-chiá ê tok-chek.
I kā lâng phah-siong, m̄-kú mā kā i pau-chat; I kā lâng siong-hāi, m̄-kú mā kā i i-hó.
Lí tú-tio̍h la̍k piàn ê chai-lān, I ōe kiù lí; sīm-chì chhit piàn, chai-hāi mā bōe kha̍p--tio̍h-lí.
Ki-hng ê sî, I ōe kiù lí thoat-lī sí-bông; kau-chiàn ê sî, I ōe kiù lí thoat-lī to-kiàm.
Lí ōe tit-tio̍h pó-hō͘, bián siū chhùi-chi̍h ê kong-kek; chai-hō kàu ê sî, lí mā bián kiaⁿ.
Chai-hāi kap ki-hng, lí beh kā in thí-chhiò; tōe-chiūⁿ ê iá-siù, lí mā bián kiaⁿ.
Lí lôe-chhân ê sî bōe lôe-tio̍h chio̍h-thâu; iá-siù ōe kap lí hô-hó.
Lí ōe chai lí ê pò͘-pîⁿ an-choân; lí sûn iûⁿ-tiâu, bô-pòaⁿ-chiah sit-lo̍h.
Lí ōe chai lí ê kiáⁿ-sun chin chōe, lí ê hō͘-tāi chhin-chhiūⁿ tōe-chiūⁿ ê chhiⁿ-chháu hiah ōng-sēng.
Lí ōe hè-siū móa chiah kè-óng, chhin-chhiūⁿ be̍h-khún sî kàu chiah siu-khǹg.
Khòaⁿ leh, chiah-ê tāi-chì goán ū chhâ chheng-chhó, si̍t-chāi sī án-ni. Tio̍h thiaⁿ, tio̍h chiap-la̍p!
Iok-pek ìn Í-lī-hoat kóng:
Góa ê iu-būn nā keng-kè chhìn-tāng, góa só͘-ū ê chai-hāi nā hē tī thian-phêng,
it-tēng pí hái--ni̍h ê soa khah tāng; só͘-í góa nā kóng kè-thâu, m̄-thang kám-kak kî-koài.
Choân-lêng-chiá ê chìⁿ siā-tio̍h góa, góa kui-ê lâng khip-tio̍h chìⁿ ê to̍k. Siōng-tè ê khióng-pò͘ pâi-tīn kong-kek góa.
Iá-lû ū chháu thang chia̍h, kiám ōe chhut-siaⁿ? Gû ū chhiⁿ-chháu, kiám ōe háu?
Chia̍h-mi̍h bô chham iâm, kiám ōe-chia̍h--tit? Nn̄g-chheng kiám ū chu-bī?
Chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ góa bô ūi-kháu, khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiū siūⁿ-beh thò͘, góa bô ài kā kha̍p--tio̍h.
Goān góa tit-tio̍h só͘ kiû--ê; góa só͘ ì-ài--ê, goān Siōng-tè hō͘ góa.
Goān Siōng-tè kā góa teh-chhùi, hē-chhiú choa̍t góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Án-ni, góa chiū tit-tio̍h an-ùi, tī ke̍k-tōa ê thòng-khó͘ tiong iáu ōe hoaⁿ-hí tiô-thiàu, in-ūi góa bô ûi-pōe Chì-sèng ê Siōng-tè ê ōe.
Góa ū sím-mi̍h khùi-la̍t, hō͘ góa iáu-teh ǹg-bāng? Góa ū sím-mi̍h bo̍k-te̍k, hō͘ góa iáu-teh thun-lún?
Góa ê khùi-la̍t kiám ū chio̍h-thâu hiah-ni̍h kian-tēng? Góa ê seng-khu kiám sī tâng chòe--ê?
Góa só͘-ū ê chu-goân lóng ēng-chīn, iáu ū sím-mi̍h khùi-la̍t thang pang-chān ka-kī?
Lâng choa̍t-bāng ê sî, pêng-iú nā bô ēng jîn-chû tùi-thāi i, chiū-sī bô kèng-ùi Choân-lêng-chiá.
Góa ê tâng-phōaⁿ chhut-bōe góa, chhin-chhiūⁿ khoe-lâu, chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi lâu-liáu ta--khì ê khoe-tóe;
peng iûⁿ--khì, khoe-chúi chiū lô-lô; seh iûⁿ--khì, khoe-chúi chiū tiòng--khí-lâi;
thiⁿ-khì sio-joa̍h, peng iûⁿ--khì; khoe-chúi lâu-liáu-liáu, hô-chhn̂g ta-khok-khok;
iân khoe teh kiâⁿ ê siong-tūi soah bê-lō͘, kiâⁿ kàu phian-phiah ê só͘-chāi chiū sí--khì.
Thê-má ê siong-tūi teh chhē chúi; Sī-pa ê seng-lí-lâng teh thèng-hāu khoe-lâu.
In ê ǹg-bāng lóng lo̍k-khong, kàu-ūi chin sit-bāng.
Taⁿ lín tùi góa mā-sī án-ni, khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa tú--tio̍h ê chai-lān chiū kiaⁿ.
Góa kiám bat kóng: Chhiáⁿ lín sàng mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ góa, ēng lín ê châi-sán thòe góa sàng hóe-lō͘?
Á-sī kóng: Kái-kiù góa thoat-lī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú, sio̍k-hôe góa thoat-lī ap-pek góa ê lâng ê chhiú?
Chhiáⁿ lín kà-sī góa, góa ōe tiām-tiām-thiaⁿ, hō͘ góa bêng-pe̍k góa tó-ūi chòe m̄-tio̍h.
Sêng-si̍t ê ōe jōa-á-ni̍h ū-la̍t! M̄-kú lín ê chí-chek sī teh chí-chek sím-mi̍h?
Choa̍t-bāng ê lâng kóng ê ōe kiám m̄-sī chhin-chhiūⁿ hong, lín ná teh chí-chek góa kóng ê ōe?
Lín sīm-chì thiu-chhiam pun ko͘-jî, ēng pêng-iú chòe siong-phín bóe-bōe.
Lín kā góa khòaⁿ chheng-chhó, góa kiám ōe tng lín ê bīn kóng pe̍h-chha̍t?
Lín chim-chiok siūⁿ, m̄-thang bô kong-tō. Koh siūⁿ-khòaⁿ leh, góa ê li̍p-tiûⁿ chèng-khak.
Góa kiám ū kóng m̄-tio̍h? Góa kiám bōe-hiáu hun-pia̍t sī-hui?
Lâng tī sè-kan kiám m̄-sī it-tēng ū lô-khó͘? I ê ji̍t-chí kiám m̄-sī chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ lâng chhiàⁿ ê kang-lâng?
Chhin-chhiūⁿ lô͘-po̍k teh pek-chhiat kî-thāi ji̍t lo̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ chòe-kang-lâng tán beh niá kang-chîⁿ?
Góa mā chù-tiāⁿ tio̍h kè khang-hu ê sòe-goa̍t, tio̍h keng-kè iu-khó͘ ê àm-mî.
Góa beh khùn ê sî siūⁿ-kóng: Mî hiah tn̂g, sím-mi̍h sî chiah thang khí-chhn̂g? Góa hoan-lâi-hoan-khì kàu thiⁿ-kng.
Góa kui seng-khu siⁿ-thâng, kian-phí, lok-lâng; phê phòa, lâu lâng.
Góa ê ji̍t-chí teh kè pí chit-pò͘ ê so khah kín; ji̍t-chí kè-liáu lóng bô ǹg-bāng.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kì-tit góa ê sìⁿ-miā ná chhoán chi̍t ê khùi; góa bōe-tàng koh kìⁿ-tio̍h hó ji̍t-chí.
Hiān-chāi lí ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa, m̄-kú bōe-tàng koh khòaⁿ--kìⁿ; lí beh chhē góa, góa í-keng bô chûn-chāi.
Hûn siau-sòaⁿ chiū bô--khì, án-ni, lâng lo̍h Im-kan mā bōe koh khí--lâi.
I bōe koh tò-lâi ka-kī ê chhù; i pún só͘-chāi ê lâng mā bōe koh jīn-tit i.
Só͘-í góa m̄ koh tiām-tiām; góa ê sim iu-khó͘, góa beh kóng--chhut-lâi. Góa ê sîn khó͘-thàng, góa beh sin-sò͘.
Góa kiám sī tōa-hái, á-sī hái-koài, lí kèng-jiân phài lâng kàm-sī góa?
Góa nā kóng: Góa ê bîn-chhn̂g ōe an-ùi góa, góa ê chhn̂g-pho͘ ōe kiám-khin góa ê khó͘-thàng,
lí chiū ēng bîn-bāng hō͘ góa kiaⁿ, ēng ok-bāng hō͘ góa chhoah.
Góa lêng-khó hō͘ lâng chhui--sí, mā khah iâⁿ oa̍h kah chiah-ni̍h kan-khó͘.
Góa iàm-ò͘ⁿ sìⁿ-miā, bô ài éng-oán oa̍h--teh; lí mài chhap--góa, in-ūi góa ê ji̍t-chí lóng bô ì-gī.
Lâng sǹg sím-mi̍h, lí hiah-ni̍h khòaⁿ-tāng i, hiah-ni̍h chiàu-kò͘ i?
Lí ta̍k chá-khí kàm-chhat i, ta̍k-ji̍t chhì-giām i?
Lí tī-sî chiah beh oa̍t-cháu bô khòaⁿ góa, tiap-á-kú mài chhap--góa, hō͘ góa thun-nōa chi̍t-ē?
Kàm-chhat lâng ê Chú ah, góa nā ū chōe, sī gāi-tio̍h lí sím-mi̍h? Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ ēng góa chòe âng-sim siā? Sī-án-chóaⁿ khòaⁿ góa chòe lí ê tāng-tàⁿ?
Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ m̄ sià-bián góa ê kè-sit, m̄ tû-khì góa ê chōe-kò? Taⁿ góa teh-beh kui-thó͘ lah, lí beh chhē góa, mā chhē bô.
Su-a -lâng Pí-le̍k-ta̍t ìn kóng:
Chit-khoán tāi-chì lí beh kóng jōa kú? Lí só͘ kóng ê ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ kông-hong!
Siōng-tè kiám ōe oai-khiok chèng-ti̍t? Choân-lêng-chiá kiám ōe oai-khiok kong-gī?
Lí ê kiáⁿ-jî ū tek-chōe I, I chiah chiàu in ê chōe-kò hō͘ in siū èng-tit ê pò-èng.
Lí nā chhē-kiû Siōng-tè, tùi Choân-lêng-chiá kiû-un,
lí nā sûn-kiat chèng-ti̍t, I ōe khí-lâi pang-chān lí, kā lí koh-chài khí-chō pêng-an khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.
Lí khí-thâu sui-jiân bî-sòe, kàu-bé ōe chin hoat-ta̍t.
Lí khì mn̄g chêng sè-tāi ê lâng, khòaⁿ in ū tùi lia̍t-chó͘ o̍h-tio̍h sím-mi̍h.
Lán chā-hng chiah chhut-sì, m̄ chai pòaⁿ-hāng; lán tī sè-kan ê ji̍t-chí put-kò chhin-chhiūⁿ iáⁿ;
in kà-sī lí, kā lí kóng, kóng-chhut in sim-lāi ê ōe.
Bô thô͘-bê, pô͘-chháu kiám ōe seng-tióng? Bô chúi, lô͘-úi kiám ōe tōa-châng?
In iáu chíⁿ, iáu-bē koah--khí-lâi, chiū pí kî-tha ê chháu khah chá ta--khì.
Só͘-ū bōe-kì-tit Siōng-tè ê lâng ê kiat-kio̍k mā-sī án-ni; bô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng ê ǹg-bāng ōe bô--khì.
In só͘ i-óa--ê sī chin khoài tn̄g ê si, só͘ óa-khò--ê sī ti-tu-bāng.
In óa-khò ti-tu-bāng, m̄-kú khò put chū, khîⁿ-tiâu bāng, m̄-kú tòng bōe tiâu.
In chhin-chhiūⁿ si̍t-bu̍t ū ji̍t chiò chiū chhiⁿ-chhùi, tîn soan kah móa-hn̂g.
In ê kun khûn tī chio̍h-thâu-tui, chǹg-ji̍p chio̍h-thâu phāng.
In nā hō͘ lâng khau--khí-lâi, ōe hō͘ i ka-kī ê só͘-chāi hó͘-jīn, kóng: Góa m̄ bat lín.
In it-tēng ōe tī lō͘-piⁿ nōa--khì, āu-lâi ū sin ê íⁿ tùi tōe--ni̍h koh puh--chhut-lâi.
Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng-tè it-tēng bōe pàng-sak sûn-choân ê lâng, mā bōe pang-chān chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng.
I ōe hō͘ lí koh-chài chhiò-gī-gī, hō͘ lí ê chhùi chhut hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ.
Oàn-hūn lí ê lâng ōe ēng kiàn-siàu chòe saⁿ chhēng; pháiⁿ-lâng ê pò͘-pîⁿ ōe bô--khì.
Iok-pek ìn Pí-le̍k-ta̍t kóng:
Góa chai tāi-chì khak-si̍t sī án-ni; lâng tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng ná ōe-tàng sǹg-chòe gī?
Lâng nā beh kap I cheng-lūn, chheng hāng mā bô hoat-tō͘ ìn chi̍t hāng.
Siōng-tè ū tì-hūi, I ê khùi-la̍t chin tōa; siáⁿ-lâng tùi-khòng I, bōe siū siong-hāi?
I kā soaⁿ sóa-cháu, soaⁿ mā iáu m̄ chai; I chi̍t-ē siū-khì, soaⁿ chiū pang--lo̍h-khì.
I hō͘ tōe tín-tāng lī-khui goân-ūi; tāi-tōe ê thiāu mā iô-choah.
I bēng-lēng ji̍t-thâu, ji̍t-thâu chiū bô chhut--lâi; I hong-ba̍t chhiⁿ-sîn, chhiⁿ-sîn chiū bô hoat-kng.
I ka-kī thí-khui thiⁿ, kiâⁿ tī hái-éng ê téng-bīn.
I chhòng-chō Pak-táu, Chham-chhiⁿ, Báu-chhiⁿ, kap lâm-hng ê seng-chō.
I chòe ê tāi-chì tōa kah bōe chhek-to̍k--tit; I kiâⁿ ê kî-sū chōe kah sǹg bōe liáu.
I tùi góa chia keng-kè, góa bô khòaⁿ--tio̍h; I kiâⁿ--kè-khì, góa mā m̄ chai.
I the̍h--khì, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng chó͘-tòng? Siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ mn̄g I: Lí teh chòe sím-mi̍h?
Siōng-tè bōe siu-hôe I ê siū-khì; liân hû-chō͘ hái-koài La-hap-pek --ê, mā khut-ho̍k tī I ē-bīn.
Án-ni, góa ná káⁿ ìn I, á-sī ēng sím-mi̍h ōe kap I cheng-piān?
Góa sui-jiân bû-ko͘, mā m̄-káⁿ ìn I, chí-ū tùi sím-phòaⁿ góa--ê kiû-un.
Góa nā kiû-kiò I, chiū-sī-kóng I ū ìn góa, góa mā m̄ sìn I ōe thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ.
In-ūi I ēng tōa-hong phah-chhùi góa, bô-iân-bô-kò͘ ke-thiⁿ góa ê chhòng-siong.
I m̄-chún góa chhoán chi̍t ê khùi, hō͘ góa siū-chīn khó͘-chhó͘.
Beh kóng khùi-la̍t, i siōng kiông-béng; beh kóng sím-phòaⁿ, siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ thoân I chhut-têng?
Góa sui-jiân bû-ko͘, góa ka-kī ê chhùi mā ōe tēng góa ê chōe; góa sui-jiân bô thang chí-chek, I mā ōe chèng-bêng góa chhò-gō͘.
Góa sui-jiân chheng-pe̍k, ū sím-mi̍h lō͘-ēng? Góa oa̍h--lo̍h-khì mā bô sím-mi̍h ì-sù.
Sím-mi̍h lóng siâng-khoán; só͘-í góa kóng: Chèng-ti̍t--ê kap choh-pháiⁿ--ê, I lóng châu-bia̍t.
Lâng nā in-ūi chai-hō hut-jiân sí, bû-ko͘ ê lâng nā tú-tio̍h chai-lān, I kā in thí-chhiò.
Siōng-tè chiong sè-kài kau tī pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhiú; I ng sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ ê ba̍k-chiu; che nā m̄-sī I chòe--ê, bô sī siáⁿ-lâng?
Góa ê ji̍t-chí teh kè chin kín, chin kín kè--khì, bô hióng-siū tio̍h sím-mi̍h hok-khì;
chin kín kè--khì chhin-chhiūⁿ khoài-théng; chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu chin kín chhiong lo̍h-khì la̍k chia̍h-mi̍h.
Góa nā kóng beh chiong góa ê ai-oàn pàng bōe-kì--tit, chiong iu-iông pìⁿ-chòe chhiò-iông,
góa iû-goân ūi-tio̍h góa chiah-ê khó͘-lān kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; in-ūi góa chai lí bōe khòaⁿ góa chòe bô-chōe.
Góa kì-jiân ōe siū tēng-chōe, góa ná tio̍h khang-khang tio̍h-bôa?
Góa nā ēng sat-bûn sóe seng-khu, ēng kiⁿ sóe-chhiú,
lí it-tēng ōe kā góa hiat-lo̍h khiⁿ-kau, liân góa ê saⁿ to ōe iàm-ò͘ⁿ góa.
Siōng-tè kap góa bô siâng-khoán, I m̄-sī sè-kan-lâng; góa bōe-tàng ìn I, kap I khì hoat-têng tùi-chí.
Goán tiong-kan bô chhâi-phòaⁿ-chiá, thang hō͘ goán siang-hong lóng ōe ho̍k.
Goān Siōng-tè bô koh ēng koáiⁿ-á hêng-hoa̍t góa, bô ēng I ê ui-giâm hō͘ góa kiaⁿ;
góa chiū bô kiaⁿ, tōa-táⁿ hoat-giân; chóng-sī góa chai góa m̄-sī chit-khoán lâng.
Góa oa̍h kah chin siān; góa beh chīn-chêng thò͘-lō͘, kóng-chhut sim-lāi ê khó͘-thàng.
Góa beh tùi Siōng-tè kóng: M̄-thang kā góa tēng-chōe, tio̍h hō͘ góa chai, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ khòng-kò góa.
Lí ap-chè, khòaⁿ-khin lí ka-kī ê chhiú só͘ chō--ê, tian-tò kah-ì pháiⁿ-lâng ê kè-bô͘; lí án-ni chòe tùi lí ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek?
Lí ê ba̍k-chiu kiám sī lâng ê ba̍k-chiu? Lí teh khòaⁿ kiám chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng teh khòaⁿ?
Lí ê ji̍t-chí kiám chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ê ji̍t-chí? Lí ê nî kiám chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ê nî?
Lí ná ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng tiâu-cha góa ê kè-sit, tui-kiù góa ê chōe-kò?
Lí chai góa bô-chōe, mā chai bô lâng ōe-tàng kiù góa thoat-lī lí ê chhiú.
Lí ê chhiú chhòng-chō góa, sok-chō góa, soah chhin-chhiú beh húi-bia̍t góa.
Kiû lí kì--tit, lí ū ēng thô͘ chō góa; lí beh koh hō͘ góa kui tī thô͘-hún sī--bô?
Lí hō͘ góa ê lāu-pē ū cheng-le̍k siⁿ góa, hō͘ góa tī lāu-bú ê pak-tó͘ lāi sêng-thai.
Lí ēng phê kap bah hō͘ góa chhēng, ēng kut kap kun kā góa liân-chiap.
Lí sù oa̍h-miā kap chû-ài hō͘ góa; lí koàn-kò͘ pó-choân góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Chiah-ê sū lí lóng chhàng tī sim-lāi, m̄-kú góa chai che sī lí ê ì-sù:
Góa nā hoān-chōe, lí ū teh chù-ì, bōe khòaⁿ góa chòe bô-chōe.
Góa nā chòe pháiⁿ, chiū ū chai-hō; góa nā bû-ko͘, mā m̄-káⁿ gia̍h-thâu--khí-lâi; góa siū-chīn khó͘-lān, móa-sim kiàn-siàu.
Góa chi̍t-ē gia̍h-thâu, lí chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ sai tui-sat góa, koh-chài tùi góa hián-chhut lí khó-phàⁿ ê ui-le̍k.
Lí koh kiò sin ê chèng-jîn khòng-kò góa, chhin-chhiūⁿ kun-peng chi̍t-tūi sòa chi̍t-tūi kong-kek góa, ke-thiⁿ lí tùi góa ê siū-khì.
Sī-án-chóaⁿ lí hō͘ góa chhut bú-thai? Góa lêng-khó iáu-bē hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiū sí--khì.
Án-ni góa tùi khí-thâu chiū ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ bô chûn-chāi, chi̍t-ē chhut bú-thai chiū sàng-ji̍p bōng.
Góa koh oa̍h mā bô-jōa-kú; kiû lí mài chhap--góa, hō͘ góa ū chi̍t-si-á an-lêng.
Góa bô kú chiū beh lī-khui, beh khì sí-ìm ê só͘-chāi, hia o͘-o͘-àm-àm, hūn-hūn-tūn-tūn, liân kng to o͘-àm; góa chi̍t-ē khì chiū bōe koh tńg--lâi.
Ná-má -lâng Só-hoat ìn Iok-pek kóng:
Lí kóng kah chiah chōe, kiám m̄-bián kā lí ìn? Ōe kóng chōe kiám chiū ū-lí?
Lí teh o͘-pe̍h tián, lâng kiám tio̍h ho̍k lí? Lí teh kā lâng thí-chhiò, kiám bô lâng kā lí chek-pī?
Lí kóng: Góa ê tō-lí chèng-khak, góa tī lí ê gán-tiong chheng-pe̍k.
Chóng-sī goān Siōng-tè kóng-ōe, khui-chhùi hoán-pok lí,
goān I chí-sī lí tì-hūi ê ò-pì, in-ūi tì-hūi ū kúi-nā khoán chok-iōng. Tio̍h chai, Siōng-tè bô sǹg lí lóng-chóng ê chōe-kò.
Lí kiám ōe-tàng bêng-pe̍k Siōng-tè ê ò-pì? Lí kiám ōe-tàng thiat-tóe liáu-kái Choân-lêng-chiá?
I ê tì-hūi pí thiⁿ khah koân, lí ōe-tàng chòe sím-mi̍h? Pí Im-kan khah chhim, lí ōe-tàng chai sím-mi̍h?
I ê tì-hūi pí tōe khah tn̂g, pí hái khah khoah.
I keng-kè ê sî, kā lí lia̍h--khí-lâi; I khui-têng sím-phòaⁿ, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kā I chó͘-tòng?
In-ūi I chai siáⁿ-lâng sī hu-ké; I khòaⁿ-tio̍h siâ-ok kiám ōe khòaⁿ-chòe bô iàu-kín?
Iá-lû chhut-sì nā ōe koai-sūn, gû-gōng ê lâng mā ōe ū tì-hūi.
Lí nā choan-sim gióng-bōng Siōng-tè, gia̍h-khí chhiú tùi I kî-tó;
lí nā pàng-sak lí ê chōe-kò, bô iông-ún siâ-ok tòa tī chhù-lāi;
hit-sî, lí chiū ōe-tàng m̄-bián kiàn-siàu, hó-táⁿ biān-tùi sè-kài.
Khó͘-thàng lí ōe lóng bōe-kì--tit, chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi lâu--kè lóng siau-sit.
Lí ê it-seng ōe pí ji̍t tiong-tàu khah kng-bêng, àm-mî pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-khí-sî.
Lí ōe an-ún, in-ūi ū ǹg-bāng; lí ōe tit-tio̍h pó-hō͘, thang an-sim hioh-khùn.
Lí tó--teh bōe siū heh-kiaⁿ, koh ū chin chōe lâng lâi kiû lí pang-chān.
Chóng-sī pháiⁿ-lâng ê ba̍k-chiu ōe sit-bêng; in bô lō͘ thang tô-cháu, in ê ǹg-bāng put-kò sī chòe-āu chi̍t-kháu-khùi.
Iok-pek ìn Só-hoat kóng:
Ū-iáⁿ, lín chin-chiàⁿ sī gâu-lâng! Lín sí, tì-hūi mā kap lín chòe-hé sí.
Góa kap lín kâng-khoán ōe-hiáu siūⁿ; góa bô khah su lín. Lín kóng chiah-ê tāi-chì siáⁿ-lâng m̄ chai?
Góa kiû-kiò Siōng-tè, I ū ìn góa, m̄-kú góa siū tâng-phōaⁿ ki-chhì; chèng-ti̍t bô thang chí-chek ê lâng mā ōe siū lâng ki-chhì.
Seng-oa̍h hó-kè ê lâng thí-chhiò siū-tio̍h chai-lān ê lâng; chai-hō teh tng-tán lâng poa̍h-tó sit-pāi.
Kiông-tō ê ke heng-ōng; jiá Siōng-tè siū-khì ê lâng pêng-an bô-sū; in óa-khò--ê sī ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t.
Khì mn̄g cháu-siù, in ōe kà lí; khì mn̄g khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu, in ōe kā lí kóng;
khì mn̄g tōe-chiūⁿ ê chhiū-ba̍k, in ōe kà lí; hái-tiong ê hî mā ōe kā lí soat-bêng.
Chiah-ê it-chhè, in lóng chai, sī Siōng Chú ê chhiú só͘ chō.
It-chhè tōng-bu̍t ê sìⁿ-miā kap só͘-ū jîn-lūi ê oa̍h-miā, lóng tī I chhiú-lāi.
Lán ēng hī-khang thiaⁿ ōe, ēng chi̍h chhì chu-bī.
Nî-hè chōe--ê ū tì-hūi; hè-siū tn̂g--ê ū kiàn-sek.
Tì-hūi kap lêng-le̍k lóng chāi-tī Siōng-tè; I ū kè-chhek kap kiàn-sek.
I thiah-húi--ê, lâng bōe-tàng koh khí-chō; I koaiⁿ-kìm--ê, lâng bōe-tàng koh tháu-pàng.
I bô lo̍h-hō͘, tōe chiū khòng-hān; I lo̍h-hō͘, chúi chiū hoàn-lām.
Koân-lêng kap tì-hūi lóng chāi-tī I; siū bê-he̍k kap bê-he̍k lâng--ê, mā lóng sio̍k tī I.
I hō͘ chham-bô͘ siū-lia̍h, thǹg-theh sī-chiòng, hō͘ sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ pìⁿ-chòe gōng-lâng.
I kái-tû kun-ông ê koân-le̍k, ēng io-tòa kā in pa̍k--khí-lâi.
I hō͘ chè-si siū-lia̍h, thǹg-theh sī-chiòng, koh thui-hoan ū koân-le̍k ê lâng.
I kìm-chí ū tōe-ūi ê lâng kóng-ōe, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t tiúⁿ-ló ê chhâi-koat-koân.
I hō͘ kùi-cho̍k siū lêng-jio̍k, kái-tû koân-le̍k-chiá ê koân-pèng.
I tùi o͘-àm hián-sī ò-pì, tùi sí-ìm hoat-chhut kng-bêng.
I hō͘ kok-ka heng-ōng, mā kā i húi-bia̍t; I hō͘ kok-ka khok-tián, mā hō͘ i soe-bî.
I hō͘ jîn-bîn ê léng-siù sit-khì kiàn-sek, hō͘ in tī khòng-iá phiau-liû, kiâⁿ bô lō͘.
In bô kng, tī o͘-àm tiong bong-lâi-bong-khì; I hō͘ in chhin-chhiūⁿ chiú-chùi ê lâng tian-lâi-tian-khì.
Chiah-ê it-chhè góa ê ba̍k-chiu lóng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, góa ê hī-khang lóng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h, mā bêng-pe̍k.
Lín chai--ê, góa mā chai; góa bô khah su lín.
Góa si̍t-chāi ài kap Choân-lêng-chiá kóng-ōe, chin ài kap Siōng-tè lí-lūn.
Lín ēng pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe am-khàm ka-kī ê bû-ti; lín lóng sī bô lō͘-ēng ê i-seng.
Khó͘-bōe-tit lín lóng tiām-tiām; tiām-tiām chiah sī ū tì-hūi.
Chhiáⁿ lín thiaⁿ góa lí-lūn, chù-ì thiaⁿ góa sin-sò͘.
Lín sī beh ūi Siōng-tè kóng bô-iáⁿ-chiah ê ōe, ūi I kóng pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe sī--bô?
Lín kiám m̄-sī teh phian-thán Siōng-tè, beh ūi I piān-hō͘?
I nā kā lín chhâ-giām, lín kiám ōe bô tāi-chì? Lín kiám ōe-tàng chhin-chhiūⁿ phiàn--lâng án-ni phiàn Siōng-tè?
Lín nā àm-àm-á phian-thán, I it-tēng ōe kā lín chek-pī.
I ê ui-giâm kiám bōe hō͘ lín kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ? I ê khióng-pò͘ kiám bōe lîm-kàu lín?
Lín só͘ kì-tit ê chim-giân chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-hu bô lō͘-ēng; lín ê piān-hō͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ thô͘-bê bōe-khò--tit.
Lín tiām-tiām, ōaⁿ góa kóng, chhut-chāi i lâi, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h góa lóng sêng-tam.
Góa koat-tēng beh mō͘ sìⁿ-miā ê gûi-hiám, kap I piàⁿ su-iâⁿ.
Góa í-keng bô ǹg-bāng, Siōng-tè beh thâi góa, góa mā m̄ kiaⁿ; góa beh tī I bīn-chêng ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê só͘-chòe piān-hō͘.
Góa án-ni chòe, khó-lêng ōe khioh-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā; in-ūi bô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng m̄-káⁿ biān-tùi Siōng-tè.
Tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ góa ê ōe, hō͘ góa ê sin-sò͘ ji̍p lín ê hī-khang.
Khòaⁿ leh, góa í-keng chún-pī hó-sè; góa chai góa it-tēng ōe sèng-sò͘.
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kap góa piān-lūn? Nā ū, góa chiū bô koh sin-sò͘, kam-goān sí.
Kiû lí chún góa nn̄g hāng chhéng-kiû, góa chiū bōe tùi lí ê bīn-chêng bih--khí-lâi:
Kiû lí ê chhiú kiu tò-tńg, bô hêng-hoa̍t góa, bô ēng lí ê ui-giâm kā góa khióng-hat.
Án-ni, lí lâi kò, góa lâi ìn; á-sī góa sím-mn̄g, lí tap-piān.
Góa ê kè-sit kap chōe-kò ū jōa-chōe? Kiû lí hō͘ góa chai góa ū sím-mi̍h chōe-kò, sím-mi̍h kè-sit.
Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ ng lí ê bīn, khòaⁿ góa chòe lí ê tùi-te̍k?
Hō͘ hong chhe-cháu ê hio̍h-á, lí kiám tio̍h koh kā i heh-kiaⁿ? Ta--khì ê chháu-iù-á, lí kiám tio̍h koh kā i tui-jip?
Lí kèng-jiân siá giâm-hat ê khí-sò͘-su lâi pān góa, liân góa siàu-liân ê sî ê chōe-kò, lí iáu m̄ pàng góa soah.
Lí ēng kha-khàu khàu góa ê kha, kàm-sī góa it-chhè ê hêng-ûi, hān-chè góa ê hêng-tōng.
Lâng pāi-hoāi chhin-chhiūⁿ nōa--khì ê mi̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ chiù-thâng chia̍h--khì ê saⁿ.
Hū-jîn-lâng só͘ siⁿ--ê, ji̍t-chí té, hoān-lān chōe.
I chhin-chhiūⁿ hoe, khui-liáu chiū siā--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ iáⁿ, chin kín chiū siau-sit bô lâu sím-mi̍h.
Chit-khoán ê lâng, lí kiám ōe kā i chù-ì, koh kā i sím-phòaⁿ?
Kiám ū lâng ōe-tàng hō͘ chheng-khì ê mi̍h tùi bô chheng-khì--ê chhut--lâi? Bô lâng ōe.
Lâng ê siū-miā í-keng chù-tiāⁿ; i ê sòe-goa̍t, lí teh chi-phòe. Lí siat ê kài-hān, bô lâng ōe-tàng pôaⁿ--kè.
Kiû lí ba̍k-chiu oa̍t-cháu bô khòaⁿ, mài kā i koán, hō͘ i chhin-chhiūⁿ chòe-kang-lâng kang chòe-liáu thang hoaⁿ-hí.
Chhò--khí-lâi ê chhiū ū ǹg-bāng koh puh-íⁿ; iù-nńg ê ki ōe kè-sio̍k hoat--chhut-lâi.
Sui-jiân i ê kun tī thô͘-tóe it-ti̍t lāu--khì, chhiū-thâu tī thô͘--ni̍h khai-sí nōa,
chúi chi̍t-ē lūn-te̍k chiū koh hoat-íⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ sin chai-chèng ê chhiū-á hoat-ki.
M̄-kú lâng sí chiū tó-ti̍t-ti̍t; khùi chi̍t-ē tn̄g, i tī tó-ūi?
Ô͘ ê chúi ōe ta--khì, kang-hô ê chúi ōe tn̄g--khì;
lâng mā-sī án-ni, tó--lo̍h-khì bōe koh peh--khí-lâi, kàu thiⁿ bô--khì, mā bōe cheng-sîn, éng-oán khùn--khì kiò bōe chhíⁿ.
Góa jōa-á-ni̍h ǹg-bāng lí kā góa khǹg tī Im-kan, kā góa chhàng tī ún-ba̍t ê só͘-chāi, thèng-hāu lí ê siū-khì soah, kā góa tēng kî-hān thang koh koàn-kò͘ góa.
Lâng kiám ōe koh oa̍h--khí-lâi? Chóng-sī tī lô-khó͘ ê ji̍t góa beh thèng-hāu, ti̍t-kàu góa tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.
Hit-sî, lí kiò góa, góa chiū ìn lí; lí ōe chin ài khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí só͘ chō ê góa.
Sui-jiân lí iáu-teh kàm-sī góa ê kiâⁿ-ta̍h, m̄-kú bōe koh tui-kiù góa ê chōe.
Góa ê kè-sit lí ōe hong-ba̍t tī tē-á lāi; góa ê chōe-kò lí ōe chhat-siau.
Soaⁿ pang, tó-hoāi; tōa chio̍h lī-khui goân-ūi.
Teh lâu ê chúi kā chio̍h-thâu bôa-sún, tōa-chúi kā thô͘ chhiong-cháu; lí mā án-ni choa̍t lâng ê ǹg-bāng.
Lí éng-oán khah iâⁿ i, i chiū siau-sit; lí hō͘ i sí--khì, bīn-māu kái-piàn.
I ê kiáⁿ-jî tit-tio̍h êng-ū, i m̄ chai; in sit-pāi kiàn-siàu, i mā m̄ chai.
I chí-ū kám-kak ka-kī seng-khu ê thàng-thiàⁿ, kan-ta ūi-tio̍h ka-kī iu-siong.
Thê-bān -lâng Í-lī-hoat ìn Iok-pek kóng:
Tì-hūi ê lâng kiám ōe ēng khang-hu ê tì-sek ìn-tap, á-sī móa-chhùi lóng kóng phòng-hong-ōe?
I kiám ōe ēng bô lī-ek, á-sī bô lō͘-ēng ê ōe ka-kī piān-hō͘?
Lí sī teh khì-sak kèng-ùi ê sim, chó͘-tòng lâng tùi Siōng-tè kî-tó.
Lí ê chōe éng-hióng lí kóng-ōe; lí ê ōe lóng sī khúi-chà.
Tēng lí ê chōe--ê sī lí ê chhùi, m̄-sī góa; lí ê chhùi-tûn chèng-si̍t lí m̄-tio̍h.
Lí sī thâu chi̍t ê chhut-sì ê lâng sī--bô? Lí pí chiah-ê soaⁿ khah tāi-seng siū-chō sī--bô?
Lí kiám sī Siōng-tè ê chham-bô͘, chai I ê kè-ōe? Tì-hūi kiám kan-ta lí chiah ū?
Ū sím-mi̍h lí chai, goán m̄ chai? Á-sī lí liáu-kái, goán bô liáu-kái?
Goán tiong-kan ū pe̍h thâu-mn̂g--ê kap nî-lāu--ê, pí lí ê lāu-pē koh-khah lāu.
Siōng-tè ê an-ùi kap un-hô khó͘-khǹg lí ê ōe, lí khòaⁿ-chòe bô iàu-kín sī--bô?
Lí ê sim ná ōe hiah-ni̍h kek-tōng, lí ê ba̍k-chiu ná ōe gîn-ò͘ⁿ-ò͘ⁿ,
hō͘ lí tí-te̍k Siōng-tè, hō͘ lí ê chhùi kóng hiah-ê ōe?
Lâng sǹg sím-mi̍h, kiám ū khó-lêng chheng-khì? Hū-jîn-lâng só͘ siⁿ--ê kiám ōe-tàng sǹg-chòe gī?
Siōng-tè liân I ê chhe-sài to bô sìn-jīm, thiⁿ tī I gán-tiong mā bô chheng-khì,
hô-hòng khó-ò͘ⁿ hú-pāi ê lâng! In lim chōe-ok chhin-chhiūⁿ teh lim-chúi.
Góa beh kā lí chí-sī, lí tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ; góa só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, góa beh kā lí kóng.
Chiū-sī ū tì-hūi ê lâng tùi chó͘-sian só͘ niá-siū, bô ún-ba̍t thoân hō͘ góa--ê.
Chit-ê èng-ún ê tōe chí-ū sù hō͘ lán ê chó͘-sian, m̄-bat siū gōa-cho̍k chhim-chiàm.
Pháiⁿ-lâng it-seng siū-chīn khó͘-chhó͘, khi-ap lâng--ê mā ōe án-ni.
Khióng-pò͘ ê siaⁿ siông-siông tī i ê hī-khang-piⁿ; an-ún ê sî, kiông-tō ōe lâi chhiúⁿ-toa̍t i.
I bô siong-sìn ōe-tàng tùi o͘-àm thoat-lī; to-kiàm put-sî teh tng-tán i.
I sì-kòe liû-lōng thó-chia̍h, kóng: Tó-ūi ū chia̍h-mi̍h? I chai o͘-àm ê ji̍t-chí í-keng kàu.
Hoān-lān khùn-khó͘ hō͘ i kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ kun-ông chún-pī kong-kek ê khì-sè ap-tó i.
In-ūi i chhut-chhiú kong-kek Siōng-tè, chū-ko chū-tāi tùi Choân-lêng-chiá tián-ui.
I ām-kún kek ngī, giâ kāu ê tún-pâi, chhiong-khì beh kong-kek Siōng-tè.
I ê bīn pûi-lut-lut, pak-tó͘ pûi-chut-chut.
I tòa ê siâⁿ bô kú ōe hong-hòe, tòa ê chhù chù-tiāⁿ pìⁿ-chòe thô͘-tui, bô lâng khiā-khí.
I bōe koh hó-gia̍h, châi-hù lâu bōe kú-tn̂g, sán-gia̍p bōe-tàng tī tōe-chiūⁿ khok-tián.
I bōe-tàng thoat-lī o͘-àm, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ iù-ki hō͘ hé sio-ta, chhin-chhiūⁿ hoe hō͘ hong chhe-sòaⁿ.
I m̄-thang óa-khò hu-ké lâi khi-phiàn ka-kī; in-ūi hu-ké ōe chiâⁿ-chòe i ê pò-èng.
Sî iáu-bē kàu, i ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chang-chhiū ta--khì; i ê ki bōe koh chhiⁿ-chhùi.
I ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ phû-tô-chhiū, phû-tô iáu-bē sek chiū hō͘ lâng iô lak--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ kaⁿ-ná-chhiū, hoe chi̍t-ē khui chiū hō͘ lâng phah hìⁿ-sak.
Bô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê cho̍k-lūi it-tēng bô hō͘-tāi; khò hóe-lō͘ khí-chō ê chhù-the̍h ōe hō͘ hé sio--khì.
In hoâi-īn to̍k-hāi, siⁿ-chhut siâ-ok; in kui-ê pak-tó͘ lóng sī khúi-chà.
Iok-pek ìn Í-lī-hoat kóng:
Chit-khoán ōe, góa í-keng thiaⁿ chin chōe; lín ê an-ùi tian-tò hō͘ lâng kan-khó͘.
Chit-khoán liâng-khiang-ōe, lí kóng soah--bē? Sī sím-mi̍h kek lí ìn bōe thêng?
Lín nā tiàm tī góa ê chhù-kéng, góa mā ōe-hiáu kóng lín chit-khoán ōe, mā ōe kóng kui-kōaⁿ ê ōe kong-kek lín, koh ōe tùi lín hàiⁿ-thâu.
M̄-kú góa ōe ēng chhùi kā lín kó͘-lē, ēng chhùi-tûn kā lín an-ùi, kiám-khin lín ê khó͘-thàng.
Góa nā kóng-ōe, khó͘-thàng iû-goân bōe kiám-khin; góa nā chēng-chēng, khó͘-thàng kiám ōe lī-khui góa?
Taⁿ Siōng-tè ah, lí hō͘ góa iu-khó͘ ià-siān, hō͘ góa ka-phò-jîn-bông.
Lí ûi-khùn góa, te̍k-tùi góa, hō͘ góa siau-sán-lo̍h-bah, hō͘ lâng tng-bīn chí-chek góa ū-chōe.
Lí tùi góa hoat siū-khì, thiah-chhùi góa, khún-pek góa, tùi góa kā-gê-chhiat-chhí; góa ê tùi-te̍k ēng chha̍k--lâng ê ba̍k-sîn gîn góa.
In khui-chhùi thí-chhiò góa, siàn góa ê chhùi-phóe bú-jio̍k góa, liân-ha̍p kong-kek góa.
Siōng-tè kā góa kau hō͘ put-gī ê lâng, chiong góa hiat hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng.
Góa pêng-an bô-sū ê sî, I hut-jiân kā góa kòng-chhùi, tīⁿ góa ê ām-kún, kā góa siak kah chhùi-chhùi, koh chhāi góa chòe I siā-chìⁿ ê bo̍k-phiau.
I chân-jím ēng chìⁿ tùi sì-bīn siā góa, siā-phòa góa ê chōng-hú; táⁿ-chiap phùn kah móa-sì-kòe.
I chhin-chhiūⁿ ióng-sū chhiong-lâi kong-kek góa, chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn phah-siong góa.
Góa kā môa-saⁿ chhēng-tiâu-tiâu; góa ê thâu-hia̍h phak tī thô͘-kha.
Góa ê ba̍k-chiu khàu kah ham-ham, ba̍k-chiu-phê tńg o͘;
m̄-kú góa ê chhiú bô hoān kiông-pō, góa ê kî-tó sûn-chin.
Tōe ah, m̄-thang khàm-ba̍t góa só͘ lâu ê huih, m̄-thang chó͘-chí góa ê âu-kiò.
Khòaⁿ ah, taⁿ góa ê chèng-jîn tī thiⁿ--ni̍h; góa ê pó-chèng tī téng-bīn.
Góa ê pêng-iú thí-chhiò góa; góa ǹg Siōng-tè ba̍k-sái lâu bōe thêng.
Góa jōa-á-ni̍h ǹg-bāng tī Siōng-tè kap lâng ê tiong-kan ū chhâi-phòaⁿ-chiá, chhin-chhiūⁿ ū lâng tī lâng kap i ê chhù-piⁿ tiong-kan choh chhâi-phòaⁿ.
In-ūi koh kè bô kúi nî, góa ōe kiâⁿ-ji̍p bōe koh tò-tńg ê lō͘.
Góa ê khùi beh tn̄g lah, ji̍t-chí teh-beh soah lah; góa ê bōng chō hó lah.
Góa ê chiu-ûi lóng sī thí-chhiò góa ê lâng; góa só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng lóng teh kek góa siū-khì.
Kiû lí chhin-sin chòe góa ê tam-pó, nā bô, siáⁿ-lâng khéng chòe góa ê pó-chèng?
Lí hong-ba̍t in ê sim, hō͘ in bô bêng-lí, só͘-í lí bōe hō͘ in khah iâⁿ góa.
Lâng ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê lī-ek chhut-bōe pêng-iú, i ê kiáⁿ-sun ba̍k-chiu ōe sit-bêng.
Góa chiâⁿ-chòe lâng-lâng ê chhiàu-tâm; in tùi góa ê bīn phùi chhùi-nōa.
Góa in-ūi iu-siong ba̍k-chiu bū; góa ê seng-khu siau-sán-lo̍h-bah.
Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ; bô-chōe ê lâng ōe tùi bô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng hoat siū-khì.
Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ōe kian-siú ka-kī só͘ kiâⁿ ê lō͘; chhiú chheng-khì ê lâng khùi-la̍t ōe ná ke-thiⁿ.
Lín lóng koh tńg--lâi; lín tiong-kan góa chhē bô chi̍t ê ū tì-hūi ê lâng.
Góa ê ji̍t-chí í-keng kè--khì; góa ê kè-ōe kap sim só͘ ì-ài--ê lóng siau-sit.
In kóng mî--sî sī ji̍t--sî, kng í-keng kūn; kî-si̍t góa iáu tī o͘-àm tiong.
Góa nā kî-thāi Im-hú chòe góa ê chhù, tī o͘-àm ê só͘-chāi pho͘ bîn-chhn̂g,
góa nā tùi hûn-bōng kóng “lí sī góa ê lāu-pē”, tùi thâng kóng “lí sī góa ê lāu-bú, góa ê chí-bē”,
án-ni góa ê ǹg-bāng tī tó-ūi? Góa ê ǹg-bāng siáⁿ-lâng khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h?
Ǹg-bāng kiám ōe lo̍h-khì Im-hú? I kiám ōe kap góa chòe-tīn tī thô͘-tóe?
Su-a -lâng Pí-le̍k-ta̍t ìn Iok-pek kóng:
Lí chhē goán ê ōe-phāng beh chhē jōa kú? Lí léng-chēng siūⁿ khòaⁿ-bāi, jiân-āu goán chiah kóng.
Goán sī-án-chóaⁿ hō͘ lí khòaⁿ-chòe cheng-siⁿ, hō͘ lí khòaⁿ-chòe gû-gōng?
Lí chit-ê lâng, lí hoat tōa siū-khì siong-hāi ka-kī, tōe kiám ōe in-ūi lí pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘? Tōa chio̍h kiám ōe sóa-lī goân-ūi?
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê teng ōe sit--khì; i ê hé-iām ōe hoa--khì.
I pò͘-pîⁿ lāi ê kng ōe àm--khì, tiàu tī téng-bīn ê teng ōe sit--khì.
I ún-kiān ê kha-pō͘ khai-sí iô-choah; i ê kè-bô͘ ōe hāi-tio̍h ka-kī.
I ka-kī kiâⁿ-ji̍p hām-khiⁿ; i ê kha ta̍h-tio̍h oa̍h-tauh.
Khoân-thò ōe tîⁿ-tio̍h i ê kha-āu-tiⁿ; lô-bāng ōe lia̍h-tio̍h i.
Liù-soh ūi-tio̍h i khàm tī thô͘--ni̍h; hām-chíⁿ ūi-tio̍h i siat tī lō͘--ni̍h.
Sì-ûi ū khióng-pò͘ teh tng-tán, kā i tè-tiâu-tiâu.
I ê khùi-la̍t in-ūi iau-gō soe-bî; chai-hō put-sî tè tī sin-piⁿ.
Ōe tì-kàu sí ê pīⁿ thòaⁿ kah kui seng-khu, hō͘ kha-chhiú lóng nōa--khì.
I ōe tùi só͘ óa-khò ê pò͘-pîⁿ hō͘ lâng khiú--chhut-lâi, thoa kàu khióng-pò͘ ê ông bīn-chêng.
I ê pò͘-pîⁿ hō͘ hé sio--khì; ū liû-hông iā tī i khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.
Tī ē-tóe, i ê kun sí--khì; tī téng-bīn, i ê ki ta--khì.
Tī tōe-chiūⁿ, bô lâng ōe koh kì-tit i; koe-thâu-hāng-bé, bô lâng ōe koh thê-khí i ê miâ.
I ōe tùi kng-bêng tiong siū kóaⁿ-ji̍p o͘-àm, koh siū kóaⁿ-chhut sè-kài.
Tī pún-cho̍k tiong-kan i bô kiáⁿ bô sun; tī khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi i bô lâu pòaⁿ-lâng.
I ê cho-gū hō͘ sai-pêng ê lâng gông-ngia̍h, hō͘ tang-pêng ê lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Che chiū-sī pháiⁿ-lâng ê miā-ūn, m̄ bat Siōng-tè ê lâng ê kiat-kio̍k.
Iok-pek ìn Pí-le̍k-ta̍t kóng:
Lín hō͘ góa ê sim iu-khó͘, ēng ōe teh-chhùi góa, beh kàu tī-sî?
Lín chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn lêng-jio̍k góa, pháiⁿ khoán-thāi góa mā bōe kám-kak kiàn-siàu.
Góa nā chin-chiàⁿ ū kè-sit, kè-sit góa ka-kī sêng-tam.
Lín khoa-kháu ka-kī pí góa khah hó, koh ēng góa ê put-hēng chèng-si̍t góa ū-chōe.
Tio̍h chai, Siōng-tè óng-khut góa, I ēng lô-bāng ûi góa.
Góa tōa-siaⁿ hoah “Oan-óng o͘h!” m̄-kú bô lâng ìn góa; âu-kiò, mā bô lâng chú-chhî kong-tō.
I cha̍h góa ê lō͘, hō͘ góa bōe-tàng kè--khì, ēng o͘-àm jia-khàm góa beh khì ê lō͘.
I pak-toa̍t góa ê chun-êng, liù-khì góa thâu-khak téng ê hoa-koan.
I tùi sì-bīn kong-kek góa, kā góa siau-bia̍t; I kā góa ê ǹg-bāng pu̍ih--khí-lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh pu̍ih chhiū.
I hoat tōa siū-khì kong-kek góa, khòaⁿ góa chòe I ê tùi-te̍k.
I ê kun-tūi chòe-chi̍t-ē chhiong--lâi, khui-lō͘ lâi kong-kek góa, tī góa pò͘-pîⁿ ê sì-ûi chat-iâⁿ.
I hō͘ góa ê chhin-cho̍k oán-lī góa, hō͘ pêng-iú kap góa so͘-oán.
Góa ê chhin-lâng kap góa toān-choa̍t koan-hē; góa ê ti-kí lóng bōe-kì-tit góa.
Góa ê lâng-kheh, góa ê lú-pī khòaⁿ góa chòe gōa-lâng; in lóng khòaⁿ góa chòe siⁿ-hūn-lâng.
Góa kiò góa ê lô͘-po̍k, in m̄ ìn; góa tio̍h chhin-chhùi kā in ko͘-chiâⁿ.
Góa ê khùi hō͘ góa ê bó͘ iàm-chiān; góa ê chhin hiaⁿ-tī mā iàm-ò͘ⁿ góa ê chhàu-bī.
Liân gín-á to khòaⁿ-khin góa; in khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiū thí-chhiò góa.
Góa siōng chhin-bi̍t ê pêng-iú lóng iàm-chiān góa; góa siōng-thiàⁿ ê lâng pìⁿ-bīn hoán-tùi góa.
Góa sán kah phê-pau-kut; góa chí-ū chhun chi̍t-kháu-khùi.
Góa ê pêng-iú ah, lín tio̍h khó-lîn góa, khó-lîn góa, in-ūi Siōng-tè ê chhiú kong-kek góa.
Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè khún-pek góa? Lín beh khó͘-chhó͘ góa kàu sím-mi̍h sî?
Góa jōa-á-ni̍h ǹg-bāng chiong góa ê ōe siá--khí-lâi, kì tī chheh--ni̍h;
ēng thih-chām-á khek tī chio̍h-thâu, ēng iân koàn-chù lâu kàu éng-oán.
Chóng-sī góa chai, góa ê Kiù-sio̍k-chiá oa̍h--teh; chòe-āu I ōe khí-lâi thòe góa piān-hō͘.
Sui-jiân góa ê phê nōa--khì, góa ê jio̍k-sin iáu ōe kìⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè.
Góa ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h I khiā tī góa sin-piⁿ; góa ōe chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h, m̄-sī pa̍t-lâng. Góa ê sim-tn̂g án-ni khat-bō͘ kàu hūn--khì.
Lín nā kóng: Lán beh án-chóaⁿ kā i khún-pek? In-ūi būn-tôe ê kun-goân chāi-tī i.
Lín tio̍h kiaⁿ to-kiàm, in-ūi Siōng-tè siū-khì, lín ōe siū to-kiàm ê hêng-hoa̍t. Lín tio̍h chai, it-tēng ū sím-phòaⁿ!
Ná-má -lâng Só-hoat ìn Iok-pek kóng:
Góa thiaⁿ-tio̍h lêng-jio̍k góa ê chek-pī, góa ê sim tio̍h-kip; góa bô kā lí ìn bōe-ēng--tit, góa ê tì-hūi kà góa tio̍h án-chóaⁿ ìn.
Lí kiám m̄ chai, tùi kó͘-chá, tùi ū lâng tī sè-kan í-lâi,
pháiⁿ-lâng tek-ì bô kú-tn̂g; bô kèng-khiân ê lâng ê hoaⁿ-hí ba̍k-nih-kú.
Sui-jiân i kiau-ngō͘ koân kah tú-thiⁿ, thâu-khak kha̍p-tio̍h hûn,
kàu-bé mā ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ ka-kī ê pùn éng-oán siau-sit. Bat i ê lâng ōe kóng: I tī tó-ūi?
I ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ bîn-bāng pe--khì, chhē bōe tio̍h, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ mî--sî ê hoàn-siōng siau-sit.
Bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ê lâng bōe-tàng koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h i; mā bōe-tàng tī i tòa ê só͘-chāi koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h i.
I ê kiáⁿ-jî tio̍h pê-siông sàn-chhiah-lâng; i tio̍h chhin-chhiú kau-chhut ka-kī ê châi-hù;
I sui-jiân ū siàu-liân ióng-chòng ê kut-keh, bô kú mā ōe kui-thó͘.
Sui-jiân siâ-ok tī i ê chhùi-lāi sī tiⁿ--ê, i put-sî chhàng tī chi̍h-ē,
m̄-kam phùi--chhut-lâi, lóng kâm tī chhùi-lāi;
m̄-kú hit-ê chia̍h-mi̍h ji̍p-khì pak-lāi chiū pháiⁿ--khì, tī lāi-bīn pìⁿ-chòe to̍k-chôa ê to̍k.
I thun-chia̍h châi-pó, ōe koh thò͘--chhut-lâi; Siōng-tè beh tùi i ê pak-tó͘ jîm--chhut-lâi.
I ōe suh to̍k-chôa ê to̍k; chôa ê to̍k-gê ōe hāi-sí i.
I bōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h kang-hô, khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h lâu lin kap bi̍t ê khoe.
I lô-khó͘ tit--tio̍h-ê thun bōe lo̍h--khì, tio̍h hêng lâng, bōe-tàng hióng-siū thàn--lâi ê châi-hù.
In-ūi i ap-chè koh khì-sak sàn-chhiah-lâng, kiông-chiàm pa̍t-lâng khí ê chhù.
In-ūi i tham-chia̍h, m̄-chai boán-chiok; i só͘ ài--ê bô chi̍t hāng lâu ōe tiâu.
Bô chi̍t hāng bô hō͘ i thun--lo̍h-khì; só͘-í i ê hoân-êng bōe kú-tn̂g.
I hó-gia̍h chhiong-chiok ê sî, só͘-ū ê khó͘-lān chai-hō lóng ōe lîm-kàu i.
I pak-tó͘ tiùⁿ-pá ê sî, Siōng-tè ōe kàng-lo̍h béng-lia̍t ê siū-khì, ōe kàng-lo̍h tōa siū-khì tī i téng-bīn.
I nā siám ōe khui thih ê kiàm, mā ōe hō͘ tâng ê chìⁿ-thâu siā thàng--kè.
Chìⁿ siā-thàng i ê seng-khu, kim-sih-sih ê chìⁿ-thâu siā-kè i ê táⁿ, ū huih chha̍p-chha̍p-tih, hō͘ i kiaⁿ kah beh sí.
I chek-chū ê châi-pó lóng ōe siū húi-bia̍t, m̄-sī lâng ê chhiú só͘ tiám ê hé ōe sio-bia̍t i, lâu tī i pò͘-pîⁿ lāi--ê mā ōe siū sio-húi.
Thiⁿ ōe po̍k-lō͘ i ê chōe-kò; tōe ōe khí-lâi kong-kek i.
Tī Siōng-tè tōa siū-khì ê ji̍t, i ê ke-hé lóng ōe hō͘ tōa-chúi chhiong bô--khì.
Che chiū-sī pháiⁿ-lâng ê miā-ūn, sī Siōng-tè chù-tiāⁿ hō͘ in ê kiat-kio̍k.
Iok-pek ìn Só-hoat kóng:
Chhiáⁿ chù-ì thiaⁿ góa kóng-ōe; che chiah sī lín ōe-tàng hō͘ góa ê an-ùi.
Chhiáⁿ nāi-sim thiaⁿ góa kóng; góa kóng-liáu, chiah chhut-chāi lín ki-chhì.
Kiám kóng góa sī teh tùi lâng oàn-thàn? Góa tio̍h-kip kiám bô lí-iû?
Lín chù-ì khòaⁿ góa, chiū ōe kiaⁿ--tio̍h, ēng chhiú ng-chhùi tiām--khì.
Góa nā siūⁿ--tio̍h chiū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kui seng-khu phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.
Pháiⁿ-lâng sī-án-chóaⁿ oa̍h--teh, chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū, koh ū-koân ū-sè?
In kiáⁿ-sun boán-tông, koh chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h hō͘-tāi ê sêng-chiū.
In ê ka-têng an-ún bô kiaⁿ, Siōng-tè ê koáiⁿ mā bô phah in.
In ê gû-káng thoân-chéng bô tn̄g, gû-bú siⁿ-kiáⁿ mā bô liû-sán.
In hō͘ gín-á chū-iû thit-thô, chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-kûn; in ê kiáⁿ-jî sì-kòe tiô-thiàu.
In hô lin-long-kó͘ kap khîm chhiùⁿ-koa, tè phín-á kap siau ê siaⁿ hoan-ho͘.
In it-seng hēng-hok, sū-sū heng-thong, koh pêng-an lo̍h Im-hú.
In tùi Siōng-tè kóng: Mài chhap--goán! Goán bô ài chai lí ê tō-lō͘.
Choân-lêng-chiá sī siáⁿ-lâng, goán ná tio̍h ho̍k-sāi I? Goán tùi I kî-kiû ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek?
In chú-tiuⁿ hoân-êng sī khò ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t tit--tio̍h-ê. Pháiⁿ-lâng ê ì-liām si̍t-chāi oh liáu-kái.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê teng kiám bat hoa--khì? Chai-hō ū jōa-chōe piàn lîm-kàu in? Siōng-tè ê siū-khì kiám bat hō͘ in kan-khó͘?
In ū jōa-chōe piàn chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ hong chhe-sòaⁿ ê chháu-á-iù? Chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ kông-hong chhe--khì ê chho͘-khng?
Lín kóng: Siōng-tè in-ūi lāu-pē ê chōe-kò hêng-hoa̍t i ê kiáⁿ-jî. M̄-kú góa siūⁿ, m̄-ta̍t-tio̍h i pún-sin siū pò-èng, hō͘ i chai ka-kī ê chōe;
hō͘ i chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ka-kī pāi-hoāi, pún-sin sêng-siū Choân-lêng-chiá ê siū-khì.
Lâng it-tàn sí--khì, kiám ōe-tàng koh koan-sim ke-lāi ê tāi-chì?
Liân thiⁿ-téng ê sù-chiá to siū Siōng-tè sím-phòaⁿ, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng chiong tì-sek kà-sī I?
Ū lâng kàu sí kiān-khong ióng-chòng, it-seng pêng-an bô-sū;
i ê cheng-le̍k chhiong-chiok, kun-kut ióng-chòng.
Ū lâng kàu sí, sim-sîn thòng-khó͘, it-seng m̄-bat hióng-siū hok-khì.
In lóng siâng-khoán kui-thó͘, hō͘ thâng khàm-ba̍t.
Góa chai lín teh siūⁿ sím-mi̍h, mā chai lín hām-hāi góa ê im-bô͘.
Lín mn̄g: Tōa-jîn-bu̍t ê chhù tī tó-ūi? Pháiⁿ-lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi tī tó-ūi?
Lín kiám m̄-bat mn̄g kè-lō͘ ê lâng? Kiám bô chiap-siū in só͘ kóng--ê?
Pháiⁿ-lâng tī chai-lān ê sî pêng-an bô-sū, tī tōa siū-khì ê ji̍t tit-tio̍h tô-thoat.
I só͘ kiâⁿ--ê, siáⁿ-lâng ōe tng-bīn kā i chí-chek? I só͘ chòe--ê, siáⁿ-lâng ōe kā i pò-èng?
I ōe hō͘ lâng kng-khì bōng-tōe, koh ū lâng kò͘-siú i ê bōng.
Bâi-chòng ê thô͘ tùi i mā kam-tiⁿ; sàng-chòng ê lâng chêng-kiâⁿ-āu-tè sǹg bōe liáu.
Lín ê an-ùi lóng sī hu-ké; lín ê ìn-tap lóng bô ì-sù.
Thê-bān -lâng Í-lī-hoat ìn Iok-pek kóng:
Lâng tùi Siōng-tè ū sím-mi̍h lō͘-ēng? Tì-hūi ê lâng tùi I ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek?
Lí chòe lâng kong-gī, kiám ōe hō͘ Choân-lêng-chiá hoaⁿ-hí? Lí ê hêng-ûi oân-choân, kiám ōe hō͘ I tit-tio̍h lī-ek?
I kiám ōe in-ūi lí kèng-ùi I, lâi chek-pī lí, sím-phòaⁿ lí?
Lí ê chōe-ok kiám m̄-sī chin tōa? Lí ê chōe-kò si̍t-chāi bû-kiông-chīn.
Lí bô-lí-bô-iû the̍h hiaⁿ-tī ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ choh tí-ah, pak in ê saⁿ, hō͘ in chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé.
Ià-siān ê lâng, lí bô ēng chúi hō͘ in lim; iau-gō ê lâng, lí bô the̍h pn̄g hō͘ in chia̍h.
Sui-jiân lí ū koân-sè tit-tio̍h thó͘-tōe, ū tōe-ūi tòa tī hit lāi-bīn,
m̄-kú lí hō͘ kóaⁿ-hū khang-chhiú tò--khì, at-chi̍h ko͘-jî ê chhiú-kut.
Só͘-í oa̍h-tauh sì-bīn ûi lí; khióng-pò͘ hut-jiân lîm-kàu lí.
O͘-àm hō͘ lí bōe-tàng khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, tōa-chúi im-ba̍t lí.
Siōng-tè kiám m̄-sī tī thiⁿ ke̍k-koân ê só͘-chāi? Lí khòaⁿ chhiⁿ-sîn ê ke̍k-thâu hiah-ni̍h koân;
lí soah kóng, “Siōng-tè chai sím-mi̍h? I ná ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-thàu o͘-àm lâi sím-phòaⁿ?
Ba̍t-hûn jia-cha̍h I, hō͘ I bōe-tàng khòaⁿ--kìⁿ; I tī kiong-chhong ê téng-bīn kiâⁿ-iû.”
Lí kiám beh kiâⁿ í-chêng siâ-ok ê lâng kiâⁿ--kè ê lō͘?
In ê sî iáu-bē kàu chiū siau-sit; in ê tōe-ki hō͘ tōa-chúi chhiong bô--khì.
In tùi Siōng-tè kóng, “Mài chhap--goán! Choân-lêng-chiá ōe kā goán án-chóaⁿ?”
Iáu-kú Siōng-tè ēng hó-mi̍h tóe-móa in ê chhù. Pháiⁿ-lâng ê ì-liām si̍t-chāi oh liáu-kái.
Gī-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h pháiⁿ-lâng ê kiat-kio̍k chiū hoaⁿ-hí; bô-chōe ê lâng beh kā in thí-chhiò, kóng,
“Khí-lâi kong-kek goán ê lâng kó-jiân siū siau-bia̍t; in só͘ chhun--ê lóng hō͘ hé sio--khì.”
Tio̍h sūn-ho̍k Siōng-tè, kap I hô-hó, hok-khì chiū ōe lîm-kàu lí.
Tio̍h chiap-siū I ê chhùi só͘ kóng ê kà-sī, chiong I ê ōe khǹg tī lí ê sim-lāi.
Lí nā khiam-pi oa̍t tńg-lâi kui-ǹg Choân-lêng-chiá, tùi lí ê chhù-lāi tû-khì siâ-ok;
lí nā khòaⁿ n̂g-kim chòe thô͘-hún, khòaⁿ sûn-kim chòe khoe--ni̍h ê chio̍h-thâu,
hō͘ Choân-lêng-chiá chòe lí ê n̂g-kim, chòe lí kùi-tiōng ê gûn,
án-ni, lí chiū ōe gióng-bōng Siōng-tè, ōe in-ūi Choân-lêng-chiá lâi hoaⁿ-hí.
Lí tùi I kî-tó, I ōe thiaⁿ lí; lí mā ōe siā lí ê goān.
Lí kè-ōe beh chòe ê tāi-chì, I ōe hō͘ lí oân-sêng, mā ū kng chiò lí ê lō͘.
Siōng-tè hō͘ kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng kàng-kē, koh chín-kiù khiam-pi ê lâng.
Siōng-tè ōe kiù bû-ko͘ ê lâng; lí ê chhiú nā chheng-khì, I ōe kái-kiù lí.
Iok-pek ìn Í-lī-hoat kóng:
Góa kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu tōa-siaⁿ bâi-oàn; góa haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan, Siōng-tè ê chhiú iáu koh kā góa chhi̍h-tiâu-tiâu.
Góa jōa-á-ni̍h ài chai tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chiah ōe-tàng chhē-tio̍h Siōng-tè, thang kàu I ê chō-ūi!
Góa beh tùi I pâi-lia̍t góa ê àn-kiāⁿ, ūi-tio̍h góa ka-kī sin-sò͘.
Góa ài chai I ōe án-chóaⁿ ìn góa, ài bêng-pe̍k I beh tùi góa kóng sím-mi̍h.
I kiám ōe ēng tōa koân-lêng tùi-hù góa? Bōe! I ōe thiaⁿ góa sin-sò͘.
