Tī hia chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ōe-tàng kap I piān-lūn; án-ni, góa chiū éng-oán bián siū sím-phòaⁿ-chiá tēng-chōe.
M̄-kú, góa ǹg tang khì chhē, I bô tī hia, ǹg sai, mā bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h I;
chiūⁿ pak, khì I teh chòe tāi-chì hia, bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h I; lo̍h lâm, mā bô khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I ê iáⁿ.
Chóng-sī I chai góa só͘ kiâⁿ ê lō͘; I khó-giām góa liáu-āu, góa ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ thoàn-liān--kè ê kim.
Góa it-ti̍t tè I ê kha-pō͘, chip-siú I ê lō͘, m̄-bat phian-lī.
Góa m̄-bat ûi-pōe I hoat-chhut ê bēng-lēng; góa tin-sioh I ê ōe, put-sî kì tī sim-lāi.
I chi̍t-ē koat-tēng, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kā I kái-piàn? I chiàu I só͘ ài--ê khì chòe.
I ōe chiàu I ūi-tio̍h góa an-pâi--ê khì chòe; I iáu ū chin chōe chit-khoán ê kè-ōe.
Só͘-í góa tī I ê bīn-chêng phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah; Góa siūⁿ--tio̍h chiū kiaⁿ.
In-ūi Siōng-tè hō͘ góa sit-táⁿ, Choân-lêng-chiá hō͘ góa phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah;
sui-jiân tōa o͘-àm jia-khàm góa ê bīn, góa iáu-kú m̄ tiām-tiām bô kóng-ōe.
Choân-lêng-chiá sī-án-chóaⁿ bô beh tēng sím-phòaⁿ ê ji̍t? Bat I ê lâng sī-án-chóaⁿ khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h I ê ji̍t?
Ū lâng î-sóa tōe-kài, chhiúⁿ kui-kûn ê cheng-siⁿ khì chhī.
In kā ko͘-jî ê lû khan--khì, lia̍h kóaⁿ-hū ê gû chòe tí-ah.
In pak-toa̍t sàn-chhiah-lâng ê koân-lī; pek kan-khó͘-lâng tô-bông bih--khí-lâi.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ hong-po͘ ê iá-lû, ūi-tio̍h kiáⁿ-jî phah-piàⁿ chhē-chia̍h;
in tī pa̍t-lâng ê hn̂g koah niû-chháu, tī pháiⁿ-lâng ê phû-tô-hn̂g khioh chhun ê phû-tô.
In kui-mî bô saⁿ thang chhēng, thǹg-theh teh khùn, kôaⁿ mā bô thang kah.
In tī soaⁿ--ni̍h hō͘ tōa-hō͘ ak-tâm, in-ūi bô jia-cha̍h chiū mo͘h tī chio̍h-piah.
Ū lâng tùi lāu-bú ê heng-chêng kā bô-pē ê kiáⁿ chhiúⁿ--khì; koh lia̍h sàn-chhiah-lâng ê gín-á tú-siàu.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng bô saⁿ thang chhēng, thǹg-theh chòe kang, iau pak-tó͘ thòe lâng taⁿ be̍h-khún.
In tī pháiⁿ-lâng chi̍t-pâi chi̍t-pâi ê kaⁿ-ná-chhiū tiong chiⁿ-iû, ta̍h phû-tô choh-chiú, ka-kī iáu-kú chhùi-ta.
Siâⁿ-lāi ū teh-beh sí ê lâng haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan, siū-siong ê lâng ai-kiò kiû pang-chān, m̄-kú Siōng-tè lóng bô teh koan-sim.
Ū lâng khì-sak kng, m̄ chai i ê lō͘, bô ài kiâⁿ kng-bêng ê lō͘.
Thiⁿ iáu-bē kng, thâi-lâng--ê chiū khí--lâi, khì thâi sàn-chhiah khùn-khó͘ ê lâng; mî--sî koh khì choh-chha̍t thau-the̍h.
Kan-îm ê lâng pek-chhiat thèng-hāu thiⁿ-àm, siūⁿ-kóng “Bô lâng ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa”, koh am ka-kī ê bīn.
Chha̍t-á mî--sî ó͘ piah-khang, ji̍t--sî bih--khí-lâi; in bô ài kng.
In khòaⁿ àm-mî chòe ji̍t--sî, in-ūi in khòaⁿ o͘-àm ê khióng-pò͘ chòe pêng-iú.
Pháiⁿ-lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi-pho, chin kín siau-sit; in pun--tio̍h ê thó͘-tōe siū chiù-chó͘, bô lâng koh kiâⁿ-khì in ê phû-tô-hn̂g.
Khòng-hān kap iām-jia̍t hō͘ seh iûⁿ--khì, hō͘ chúi siau-sit, Im-kan mā án-ni thun-bia̍t ū-chōe ê lâng.
Liân siⁿ in ê lāu-bú mā bōe-kì-tit in, thâng kā in chia̍h-liáu-liáu; pháiⁿ-lâng bô lâng siàu-liām in, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū siū at-chi̍h.
In khi-hū bô hoâi-īn bô siⁿ-kiáⁿ ê hū-jîn-lâng, bô hó khoán-thāi kóaⁿ-hū.
Siōng-tè ēng I ê koân-le̍k siau-bia̍t kiông-pō ê lâng; in sui-jiân heng-khí, I hō͘ in sìⁿ-miā lân-pó.
Siōng-tè hō͘ in chiām-sî pêng-an bô-sū; I ê ba̍k-chiu put-sî kàm-sī in ê só͘-chòe.
In sui-jiân heng-ōng, m̄-kú chi̍t-sî-á-kú chiū siau-sit; in ōe soe-bî, kap pa̍t-lâng kâng-khoán hō͘ lâng siu-si̍p, chhin-chhiūⁿ be̍h-sūi hō͘ lâng koah--khí-lâi.
Án-ni, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kā góa hoán-pok, chèng-bêng góa só͘ kóng--ê m̄-tio̍h?
Su-a -lâng Pí-le̍k-ta̍t ìn Iok-pek kóng:
Chú-koân kap ui-giâm lóng chāi-tī Siōng-tè; I tī ke̍k-koân ê só͘-chāi si-hêng hô-pêng.
I ê kun-tūi kiám sǹg ōe liáu? I ê kng chi̍t-ē hoat-chhut, siáⁿ-lâng bô hō͘ i chiò--tio̍h?
Án-ni, tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng lâng ná ōe-tàng sǹg-chòe gī? Hū-jîn-lâng só͘ siⁿ--ê kiám ū khó-lêng chheng-khì?
Tī I gán-tiong, ge̍h bô-kàu kng, chhiⁿ mā bô-kàu bêng.
Hô-hòng, lâng sī thâng, sè-kan-lâng sī tō͘-ún.
Iok-pek ìn Pí-le̍k-ta̍t kóng:
Bô khùi-la̍t--ê, lí ū kā i pang-chān jōa-chōe? Chhiú-kut nńg--ê, lí án-chóaⁿ kā i kái-kiù?
Lí án-chóaⁿ kà-sī bô tì-hūi ê lâng, lâi chèng-si̍t lí ū jōa-chōe hó ê kè-chhek?
Lí tùi tó-ūi tit-tio̍h lêng-kám, khò siáⁿ-lâng teh kóng chiah-ê ōe?
Im-hûn thòng-khó͘ phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, tī chúi-ē kap tī chúi-lāi khiā-khí--ê mā án-ni.
Tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng Im-kan lō͘-hiān, bia̍t-bông ê só͘-chāi bô khàm-kòa.
I thí-khui kiong-chhong tī hūn-tūn ê téng-bīn, kiàn-li̍p tāi-tōe, kā i tiàu tī khang-hu ê téng-bīn.
I ēng ba̍t-hûn pau chúi, chúi ê tāng-liōng mā bōe hō͘ ba̍t-hûn piak-li̍h.
I chiong ge̍h-niû khàm--khí-lâi, ēng hûn pho͘ tī hit téng-bīn.
I tī chúi-bīn ōe kài-hān, ōe kng kap àm ê kau-kài.
Thiⁿ ê thiāu iô-choah, in-ūi I ê chek-pī tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
I ēng lêng-le̍k chè-ap tōa-hái, ēng kè-tì phah-pāi hái-koài La-hap-pek.
I pûn-khùi hō͘ thiⁿ chheng-chhái, ēng chhiú chām-tn̄g teh tô-cháu ê tōa-chôa.

Chiah-ê put-kò sī I só͘ chòe ê chi̍t sió pō͘-hūn, lán thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê sī I sòe-sòe ê siaⁿ, chóng-sī I tōa koân-lêng ê chok-ûi chhin-chhiūⁿ teh tân tōa-lûi, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng liáu-kái?
Iok-pek kè-sio̍k kóng:
Siōng-tè kū-choa̍t góa ê koân-lī; Choân-lêng-chiá hō͘ góa sim-sîn thòng-khó͘. Góa chí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè chiù-chōa:
Góa ê oa̍h-miā nā iáu tī góa ê lāi-bīn, Siōng-tè ê khùi nā iáu tī góa ê phīⁿ-khang,
góa ê chhùi-tûn choa̍t-tùi m̄ kóng put-gī, góa ê chi̍h m̄ kóng khúi-chà.
Góa choa̍t-tùi m̄ khòaⁿ lín chòe tio̍h; góa kàu sí mā kian-chhî ka-kī sûn-choân chèng-ti̍t.
Góa kian-chhî góa sī tio̍h, m̄ hòng-khì; góa ê liông-sim chi̍t-sì-lâng bōe chek-pī góa.
Te̍k-tùi góa--ê tio̍h siū pháiⁿ-lâng ê cho-gū; kong-kek góa--ê tio̍h siū put-gī ê lâng ê pò-èng.
Bô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng siū siau-bia̍t, sìⁿ-miā hō͘ Siōng-tè chhú--khì ê sî, iáu ū sím-mi̍h ǹg-bāng?
Hoān-lān lîm-kàu ê sî, Siōng-tè kiám ōe thiaⁿ i ê kiû-kiò?
I kiám ōe in-ūi Choân-lêng-chiá lâi hoaⁿ-hí, kiám ōe sî-siông kiû-kiò Siōng-tè?
Góa beh kà-sī lín Siōng-tè koân-lêng ê chok-ûi; Choân-lêng-chiá ê só͘-chòe, góa bōe am-khàm.
Chiah-ê, lín lóng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, ná iáu-teh kóng hiah-ê gōng-ōe?
Che sī Siōng-tè hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng ê pò-èng, sī Choân-lêng-chiá pun hō͘ kiông-pō ê lâng ê sán-gia̍p.
Sui-jiân i ê kiáⁿ-jî chin chōe, in lóng ōe sí tī to-ē; i ê hō͘-tāi bô thang chia̍h kàu pá.
Só͘ chhun ê lâng in-ūi un-e̍k siū bâi-chòng; in ê kóaⁿ-hū beh khàu, mā khàu bōe chhut--lâi.
In sui-jiân chek-chū gûn chhin-chhiūⁿ thô͘-hún hiah chōe, thia̍p saⁿ-á-khò͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ thô͘-tui hiah koân;
chòe in thia̍p, gī-lâng beh chhēng in ê saⁿ, bû-ko͘ ê lâng beh pun in ê gûn.
In khí ê chhù chhin-chhiūⁿ ti-tu ê bāng, chhin-chhiūⁿ siú-bōng ê lâng tah ê liâu-á.
In khì khùn ê sî hó-gia̍h, châi-hù iáu tī--teh, chi̍t-ē khùn-chhíⁿ ta̍k-hāng lóng bô--khì.
Khióng-pò͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi tī ji̍t--sî kā in chhiong--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-hong tī mî--sî kā in sàu--khì.
Tang-hong chi̍t-ē chhe, in chiū bô--khì, kā in chhe lī-khui pún só͘-chāi.
Kông-hong kā in sàu, lóng bô liû-chêng; in piàⁿ-miā tô-cháu beh thoat-lī i ê ui-le̍k.
Kông-hong tùi in phah-pho̍k-á, kā in thí-chhiò, kóaⁿ in lī-khui pún só͘-chāi.
Gûn ū gûn-khòng; kim ū thê-liān ê só͘-chāi.
Thih sī tùi tōe--ni̍h ó͘--chhut-lâi; tâng sī tùi khòng-chio̍h thê-liān--chhut-lâi.
Lâng lo̍h-khì ke̍k-chhim ê só͘-chāi, tī o͘-àm tiong chhē khòng-chio̍h.
In khì chin hn̄g bô lâng khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, ó͘-khang ó͘ kah chin chhim, ēng soh-á kā seng-khu pa̍k--teh, lūi-lo̍h khang-lāi tōng-tōng-hàiⁿ.
Tōe-chiūⁿ chhut thó͘-sán; tōe-ē ū iām-hé ká--khí-lâi;
kî-tiong ū nâ-pó-chio̍h, mā ū kim-soa.
Khòng-khiⁿ hit-tiâu lō͘ eng-chiáu m̄ bat, sió-eng ê ba̍k-chiu mā khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h;
hiong-ok ê iá-siù m̄-bat kiâⁿ--kè, béng-sai mā m̄-bat kàu.
Lâng chhun-chhiú phah tēng-chio̍h, kui-lia̍p soaⁿ kā i péng--khí-lâi.
In tī chio̍h-pôaⁿ tiong khui-kau, chù-ì chhē ta̍k-khoán pó-mi̍h.
In kā chúi-goân that--khí-lâi, hō͘ ún-ba̍t ê mi̍h lō͘-hiān.
Chóng-sī tì-hūi beh khì tó-ūi chhē? Chhong-bêng tī tó-ūi?
Tì-hūi ê kè-ta̍t bô lâng chai, tī oa̍h-lâng ê só͘-chāi mā chhē bōe tio̍h.
Chhim-ian kóng: Bô tī chia. Tōa-hái kóng: Bô tī goán chia.
Tì-hūi bōe-tàng ēng n̂g-kim bóe--tio̍h, bōe-tàng ēng gûn tēng i ê kè-ta̍t.
Sûn-kim bōe-tàng kap i phēng, pó-kùi ê âng-bé-ló kap nâ-pó-chio̍h mā bōe-tàng.
N̂g-kim, chúi-chiⁿ lóng kap i bōe-pí--tit; hó-kim ê khì-khū bōe-tàng kap i kau-ōaⁿ.
San-ô͘ kap phek-ge̍k mā bián-kóng; in-ūi tì-hūi iâⁿ-kè chin-chu.
Kó͘-si̍t ê n̂g-ge̍k kap i bōe-pí--tit; sûn-kim m̄-ta̍t-tio̍h i.
Án-ni tì-hūi tùi tó-ūi lâi? Chhong-bêng tī tó-ūi?
Tì-hūi tùi só͘-ū oa̍h-mi̍h ê ba̍k-chiu ún-ba̍t, khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu mā khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h.
Húi-bia̍t kap Sí-bông kóng: Goán chí-ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h i ê hong-siaⁿ.
Chí-ū Siōng-tè chai tì-hūi ê lō͘, chai i tī tó-ūi.
In-ūi Siōng-tè ōe khòaⁿ kàu tōe ê ke̍k-thâu, piàn-khòaⁿ phó͘-thiⁿ-ē.
I tēng hong ê khin-tāng, niû chúi ê chōe-chió.
I kā hō͘-chúi tēng kùi-choeh, kā lûi kap sih-nà tēng lō͘-sòaⁿ;
I khòaⁿ-tio̍h tì-hūi, kā kàm-tēng, chiū soan-pò͘ koh khak-tēng.
I tùi lâng kóng: Kèng-ùi Chú chiū-sī tì-hūi; lī-khui pháiⁿ chiū-sī chhong-bêng.
Iok-pek kè-sio̍k kóng:
Góa jōa-á-ni̍h ài tò-tńg-khì í-chêng ê sòe-goa̍t, Siōng-tè pó-siú góa ê ji̍t-chí.
Hit-sî I ê teng chiò tī góa ê thâu-khak, góa khò I ê kng kiâⁿ-kè o͘-àm.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ góa chòng-liân ê sî, Siōng-tè kap góa chhin-bi̍t khiā-khí.
Hit-sî Choân-lêng-chiá iáu kap góa tông-chāi, góa ê kiáⁿ-jî tī góa ê sì-ûi;
hit-sî góa kiâⁿ--kè ê lō͘ ū lin lim bōe chīn, chio̍h-pôaⁿ ūi-tio̍h góa chhut iû chhin-chhiūⁿ khoe-chúi teh lâu.
Hit-sî góa kiâⁿ kàu siâⁿ-mn̂g, tī chhī-tiûⁿ-kháu chē góa ê chō-ūi,
siàu-liân-lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiū siám-khui, lāu-lâng peh khí-lâi khiā.
Léng-siù thêng-chí kóng-ōe, ēng chhiú ng in ê chhùi;
kùi-cho̍k bô chhut-siaⁿ, tiām-tiām bô kóng-ōe.
Thiaⁿ-kìⁿ góa kóng-ōe--ê, lóng chheng-chàn góa; khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa--ê, lóng o-ló góa.
Góa kái-kiù ai-kiû ê sàn-chhiah-lâng, pang-chān bô i-óa ê ko͘-jî.
Teh-beh sí ê lâng kā góa chiok-hok; góa hō͘ kóaⁿ-hū ê sim hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa.
Góa ēng kong-gī chòe saⁿ chhēng, ēng chèng-ti̍t chòe gōa-phàu moa, chòe bō tì.
Góa chòe bông-jîn ê ba̍k-chiu, chòe kha-pái ê lâng ê kha.
Góa chòe sàn-chhiah-lâng ê pē kā in chiàu-kò͘, ūi-tio̍h siⁿ-hūn-lâng piān-hō͘.
Góa phah-chhùi pháiⁿ-lâng ê gê-chô, chhiúⁿ in ê chhùi-khí só͘ kā ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Góa chiū kóng, “Góa ōe sí tī ka-kī ê chhù-lāi; góa ê ji̍t-chí ōe ke-thiⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ soa hiah chōe.
Góa ê kun chhun kàu chúi-piⁿ, lō͘-chúi kui-mî lo̍h tī góa ê ki.
Góa ê cheng-le̍k put-sî móa-móa; góa ê keng tī góa ê chhiú put-sî ân-ân.”
Lâng pek-chhiat thèng-hāu góa kóng-ōe, chēng-chēng tán góa ê chí-tō.
Góa kóng-liáu, in chiū lóng tiām--khì; góa ê ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ kam-lō͘ tih tī in téng-bīn.
In thèng-hāu góa chhin-chhiūⁿ thèng-hāu hō͘-chúi; in ê chhùi tōa khui chhin-chhiūⁿ him-bō͘ chhun-thiⁿ ê hō͘.
In sit-bāng ê sî, góa kā in an-ùi; góa ê chhiò-iông hō͘ in tit-tio̍h kó͘-lē.
Góa chòe siú-léng chí-sī in tio̍h kiâⁿ ê lō͘; góa chhin-chhiūⁿ ông teh chhōa i ê kun-tūi, tī in ai-siong ê sî kā in an-ùi.
Hiān-chāi pí góa khah siàu-liân ê lâng thí-chhiò góa; kî-si̍t hiah-ê lâng ê lāu-pē, góa liân hō͘ in kap góa kò͘-iûⁿ ê káu tàu-tīn to bô ài.
In tùi góa lóng bô lō͘-ēng; in ê cheng-le̍k í-keng soe-thè.
In in-ūi khiàm-kheh, iau-gō, siau-sán-lo̍h-bah, àm-mî tī hong-hòe chhiⁿ-chhìn ê só͘-chāi chia̍h-hong pō͘-thô͘.
In tī chháu-phō bán kiâm-chháu chòe chhài chia̍h, ēng khó͘ koh siap ê chhiū-kun chòe chia̍h-mi̍h.
In tùi jîn-kûn ê tiong-kan hō͘ lâng kóaⁿ-cháu; lâng tī āu-bīn hoah in, ná teh hoah chha̍t.
In soah tio̍h tòa tī soaⁿ-kok gûi-hiám ê só͘-chāi, tī thô͘-khang kap chio̍h-tōng ê lāi-bīn.
In tī chhiū-nâ lāi chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-siù teh háu, tī chhì-phè ē-bīn khoeh chòe-hé.
In sī gōng-lâng, hā-chiān ê bô-miâ-sió-chut, siū piⁿ-phah, khu-tio̍k chhut-kéng.
Taⁿ, chiah-ê lâng chhiùⁿ-koa hì-lāng góa, ēng góa chòe ōe-pìⁿ thí-chhiò.
In iàm-ò͘ⁿ góa, siám-khui góa hn̄g-hn̄g, tú-tio̍h góa chiū kā góa phùi chhùi-nōa.
In-ūi Siōng-tè pak-toa̍t góa ê bú-khì, khó͘-chhó͘ góa, chhut-chāi lâng kā góa bú-jio̍k.
Chiah-ê húi-lūi khí-lâi kong-kek góa, siat lô-bāng hō͘ góa poa̍h-tó, pek góa kiâⁿ bia̍t-bông ê lō͘.
In chhiat-tn̄g góa tô-cháu ê lō͘, pek góa oân-choân siau-bia̍t, iáu-kú bô lâng kā in chó͘-tòng.
In chhin-chhiūⁿ kun-tūi kong-phòa siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, tùi phòa-khiah chi̍t-pho chi̍t-pho chhiong--ji̍p-lâi.
Khióng-pò͘ kā góa ap-tó; góa ê chun-giâm chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ hong sàu-chīn; góa ê hoân-êng ná hûn siau-sòaⁿ.
Taⁿ, góa ê sim pi-siong kàu beh sí; chai-lān ta̍k-ji̍t kā góa khîⁿ-tiâu-tiâu.
Mî--sî góa ê kut-thâu chhin-chhiūⁿ chhì teh chha̍k, put-sî thiàⁿ kah tòng bōe tiâu.
Siōng-tè tōa-la̍t chang góa ê gōa-saⁿ, chhui góa ê ām-kún.
I kā góa hiat tī thô͘-bê tiong; góa liân thô͘-hún hé-hu to m̄-ta̍t.
Góa kiû-kiò lí, lí bô ìn góa; góa tùi lí kî-tó, lí m̄ chhap góa.
Lí pìⁿ-bīn chân-jím tùi-hù góa, tāng-tāng khó͘-chhó͘ góa.
Lí hō͘ hong kā góa kńg-lâi-kńg-khì, ēng pō-hong kā góa siau-bia̍t.
Góa chai lí beh chhōa góa khì sí-bông ê só͘-chāi, kàu ūi-tio̍h ōe sí ê lâng chún-pī ê chhù.
Lâng tú-tio̍h chai-lān hoah-kiù-lâng, lí kiám bōe chhun-chhiú kā kiù?
Lâng tú-tio̍h hoān-lān, góa kiám bô ūi-tio̍h i thî-khàu? Lâng sàn-chhiah, góa ê sim kiám bô ūi-tio̍h i iu-būn?
Góa ǹg-bāng hok-khì, chai-lān chiū kàu; góa thèng-hāu kng-bêng, o͘-àm chiū lâi.
Góa ê sim-tn̂g kún-ká bô-thêng; khó͘-lān ê ji̍t-chí chhiong-kek góa.
Góa iu-ut kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì, bô lâng an-ùi; góa tī chū-hōe tiong khiā khí-lâi âu-kiò kiû pang-chān.
Góa kap chhâi-lông chòe hiaⁿ-tī, kap tô-chiáu chòe tâng-phōaⁿ.
Góa ê phê-hu hoán-o͘ liù-phê; góa ê kut-thâu in-ūi hoat-sio chhàu-hé-ta.
Góa ê khîm tôaⁿ pi-ai ê tiāu; góa ê siau kā thî-khàu ê lâng phōaⁿ-chàu.
Góa kap góa ê ba̍k-chiu li̍p-iok, bô beh ēng siâ-liām khòaⁿ cha-bó͘ gín-á.
Siōng-tè tùi thiⁿ-téng chí-tēng ê hūn-gia̍h sī sím-mi̍h? Choân-lêng-chiá tùi téng-bīn hun-phòe ê sán-gia̍p sī sím-mi̍h?
Kiám m̄-sī hō͘ chai-lān lîm-kàu put-gī ê lâng, chai-hō kàng hō͘ chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng?
Siōng-tè kiám m̄-sī teh kàm-chhat góa ê lō͘, sǹg góa múi chi̍t ê kha-pō͘?
Góa nā ū kap hu-ké tàu-tīn kiâⁿ, kha kip beh tè khúi-chà,
Siōng-tè thang ēng kong-pîⁿ ê thian-phêng chhìn góa, I chiū chai góa ê sûn-choân.
Góa ê kha-pō͘ nā phian-lī chiàⁿ-lō͘, góa ê sim in-ūi ba̍k-chiu só͘ khòaⁿ--ê siū bê-he̍k, góa ê chhiú bak-tio̍h lâ-sâm,
goān góa só͘ iā--ê, hō͘ lâng chia̍h--khì, só͘ chèng--ê, hō͘ lâng khau--khì.
Góa ê sim nā hō͘ pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘ ín-iú--khì, á-sī góa bih tī chhù-piⁿ ê mn̂g teh tán,
goān góa ê bó͘ kā lâng oe-bō, pa̍t-lâng kap i tâng-pâng;
in-ūi án-ni chòe sī chin kiàn-siàu ê tāi-chì, sī sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ eng-kai pān ê chōe;
che sī sio kàu Bia̍t-bông ê tōa-hé, chiong góa siu-sêng--ê lóng sio-liáu-liáu.
Góa ê lâm-po̍k lú-pī ài góa ūi-tio̍h in chú-chhî kong-tō, góa nā m̄ chhap in,
Siōng-tè khí-lâi sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, góa beh án-chóaⁿ? I sím-mn̄g, góa beh án-chóaⁿ ìn?
Siōng-tè chō góa, kiám m̄-sī mā chō in? Chō góa kap in tī bú-thai--ê kiám m̄-sī kâng chi̍t ūi?
Góa nā bû-sī sàn-chhiah-lâng ê su-iàu, á-sī hō͘ kóaⁿ-hū khàu kah ba̍k-chiu hoe,
góa nā ka-kī chia̍h, bô pun hō͘ ko͘-jî —
kî-si̍t, tùi siàu-liân ê sî góa chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ lāu-pē ū teh iúⁿ-chhī ko͘-jî, tùi chhut bú-thai góa chiū ū teh chiàu-kò͘ kóaⁿ-hū —
góa nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h lâng kôaⁿ kah beh sí, sàn-chhiah-lâng bô gōa-phàu thang kah;
góa nā bô the̍h góa ê iûⁿ-mn̂g hō͘ lâng moa thang tit-tio̍h un-loán, hō͘ i tùi sim-tóe kā góa kám-siā;
góa nā chai ka-kī tī hoat-têng ū koân-sè, chiū khí-chhiú kong-kek ko͘-jî;
goān góa ê chhiú-kut tùi keng-kah-thâu lut--lo̍h-khì, chhiú ê ē-chat tùi chhiú-āu-khiau tn̄g--khì.
In-ūi tùi Siōng-tè lâi ê chai-hō hō͘ góa kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; I ê ui-giâm hō͘ góa m̄-káⁿ chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì.
Góa nā óa-khò n̂g-kim, ēng sûn-kim chòe khò-soaⁿ;
góa nā in-ūi châi-bu̍t hù-jū, thàn tōa-chîⁿ lâi hoaⁿ-hí;
góa nā in-ūi ji̍t hoat-kng, ge̍h bêng-liāng,
soah àm-tiong siū ín-iú, ēng in chòe ngó͘-siōng lâi pài;
che mā-sī sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ eng-kai pān ê chōe, in-ūi án-ni chòe sī pōe-poān thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè.
Góa m̄-bat in-ūi khòaⁿ-tio̍h oàn-hūn góa ê lâng siū chai-lān lâi hoaⁿ-hí, ūi-tio̍h in tú-tio̍h chai-hō lâi tek-ì.
Góa m̄-bat iông-ún góa ê chhùi hoān-chōe, chiù-chó͘ in sí.
Goán chhù-lāi ê lâng lóng án-ni kóng: “M̄-bat ū lâng lâi Iok-pek chia bô chia̍h kàu pá.”
Góa m̄-bat hō͘ chhut-gōa-lâng tī gōa-kháu khùn, mn̂g put-sî khui-khui beh chiap-thāi in.
Góa m̄-bat chhin-chhiūⁿ it-poaⁿ-lâng am-khàm kè-sit, kā góa ê chōe-kò chhàng tī sim-lāi.
Góa m̄-bat ūi-tio̍h kiaⁿ kong-chiòng ê phoe-phêng, kiaⁿ chhin-cho̍k ê ki-chhì, soah bô chhut-siaⁿ, m̄-káⁿ chhut-mn̂g.

Góa jōa-á-ni̍h ǹg-bāng ū chi̍t ūi ōe thiaⁿ góa kóng! Che sī góa chòe-āu ê sin-sò͘; goān Choân-lêng-chiá ìn-tap góa! Nā bô, khòng-kò-chiá tio̍h chhut-lâi siá góa ê chōe-chn̄g,
góa it-tēng beh kā phāiⁿ tī keng-kah-thâu, chòe hoa-koan tì tī thâu-khak téng.
Góa beh tùi Siōng-tè soat-bêng góa it-chhè ê kiâⁿ-ta̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ ông-chú ióng-kám khiā tī I bīn-chêng.
Góa ê chhân-hn̂g nā chhut-siaⁿ kò góa, lôe-kau chòe-hé thî-khàu;
góa nā bô la̍p-chîⁿ pe̍h-pe̍h chia̍h chhân-hn̂g ê chhut-sán, á-sī hāi hn̂g-chú gêng--sí,
goān chhì-á hoat-siⁿ tāi-thòe sió-be̍h, cha̍p-chháu hoat-siⁿ tāi-thòe tōa-be̍h. Iok-pek ê ōe kàu chia kiat-sok.
Chit saⁿ ê lâng chiū thêng-chí, bô koh ìn Iok-pek, in-ūi i kian-chhî ka-kī bô-chōe.
Hit-sî ū Pò͘-su -lâng, sio̍k tī Lân ê cho̍k, Pa-la-ka ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-hō͘, chin siū-khì; siū-khì Iok-pek, in-ūi Iok-pek khòaⁿ ka-kī pí Siōng-tè khah tio̍h.
I mā siū-khì Iok-pek saⁿ ê pêng-iú, in-ūi in bô ōe thang ìn, iáu-kú kā Iok-pek tēng-chōe.
Í-lī-hō͘ beh kap Iok-pek kóng-ōe, iáu-teh thèng-hāu, sī in-ūi in saⁿ ê pí i khah chōe hè.
Í-lī-hō͘ khòaⁿ chit saⁿ ê lâng bô ōe thang ìn, chiū tōa siū-khì.
Pò͘-su -lâng Pa-la-ka ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-hō͘ hôe-èng kóng: Góa siàu-liân, lín nî-lāu, só͘-í góa pháiⁿ-sè, m̄-káⁿ tùi lín hoat-piáu góa ê ì-kiàn.
Góa kóng: Tio̍h hō͘ nî-hè chōe--ê seng kóng, hō͘ nî-kí tōa--ê ēng tì-hūi kà-sī lâng.
M̄-kú lâng ê lāi-bīn ū sim-lêng, chiū-sī Choân-lêng-chiá ê khùi, ōe hō͘ lâng bêng-lí.
Khah sī-tōa--ê bô lóng ū tì-hūi; khah nî-lāu--ê bô lóng ōe-hiáu hun-piān sī-hui.
Só͘-í góa kóng, lín tio̍h thiaⁿ; góa beh hoat-piáu góa ê ì-kiàn.
Khòaⁿ ah, góa ū teh thiaⁿ lín kóng-ōe, chù-ì thiaⁿ lín ê piān-lūn, kî-thāi lín chhē-tio̍h sek-tòng ê ōe.
Góa ū chù-ì thiaⁿ lín kóng, m̄-kú lín bô lâng ōe-tàng piān-tó Iok-pek, bô chi̍t ê ōe-hiáu ìn i ê ōe.
Lín m̄-thang kóng: Goán ū tì-hūi; ōe iâⁿ i--ê sī Siōng-tè, m̄-sī lâng.
Iok-pek m̄-sī teh kap góa piān-lūn, góa mā bōe ēng lín ê kóng-hoat kā i ìn.
Iok-pek ah, in gāng-gāng bô koh ìn, bô ōe thang kóng.
In bô kóng-ōe, tiām-tiām khiā--teh, bô koh ìn, góa kiám tio̍h koh thèng-hāu?
Góa mā beh kóng góa eng-kai kóng ê ōe, hoat-piáu góa ê ì-kiàn.
Góa ū chin chōe ōe beh kóng, ū chi̍t pak khùi tī góa lāi-bīn teh ká-kún.
Góa ê pak-lāi chhin-chhiūⁿ ū hong-ba̍t-ba̍t ê chiú, chhin-chhiūⁿ sin ê phê-tē teh-beh piak-li̍h.
Góa beh kóng--chhut-lâi, thang tháu-khùi; góa beh khui-chhùi lâi ìn.
Góa bōe khòaⁿ lâng ê sin-hūn tùi-thāi lâng, mā bōe phô͘-tháⁿ lâng.
Góa bōe-hiáu kā lâng phô͘-tháⁿ; nā ōe, góa ê Chhòng-chō-chiá chin kín chiū kā góa chhú-hoa̍t.
Taⁿ, Iok-pek, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa kóng, chù-ì thiaⁿ góa beh kóng ê ōe.
Góa beh khui-chhùi; góa ê ōe tī chhùi-kháu teh-beh chhut--lâi.
Góa beh sêng-si̍t tùi sim-lāi kóng-chhut; góa beh láu-si̍t kóng góa só͘ chai--ê.
Siōng-tè ê sîn chhòng-chō góa; Choân-lêng-chiá ê khùi hō͘ góa oa̍h-miā.
Lí nā ōe, tio̍h ìn góa; khí-lâi piān-bêng lí ê li̍p-tiûⁿ.
Góa tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng kap lí kâng-khoán, sī ēng thô͘ chō--ê.
Góa bô sím-mi̍h thang hō͘ lí kiaⁿ, mā bōe hō͘ lí tōa ê ap-le̍k.
Lí só͘ kóng--ê, góa khak-si̍t ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h, ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê ōe, kóng,
“Góa chheng-khì, bô kè-sit; góa chheng-pe̍k, bô-chōe.
Siōng-tè chhē lí-iû kong-kek góa, khòaⁿ góa chòe I ê tùi-te̍k.
I ēng kha-khàu khàu góa ê kha, kàm-sī góa it-chhè ê hêng-ûi.”
Góa kā lí kóng: Lí kóng chiah-ê lóng m̄-tio̍h, in-ūi Siōng-tè pí lâng khah tōa.
Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ kap I cheng-lūn, kóng “I lóng bô ìn-tap góa ê sin-sò͘”?
Kî-si̍t Siōng-tè it-chài soat-bêng, m̄-kú lâng bô tì-ì thiaⁿ.
Mî--sî lâng tó tī bîn-chhn̂g khùn tāng-bîn ê sî, Siōng-tè ēng bîn-bāng kap īⁿ-siōng
tùi in kóng-ōe, kā in kéng-kò, hō͘ in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ,
beh hō͘ lâng lī-khui pháiⁿ hêng-ûi, hō͘ lâng bōe kiau-ngō͘,
hō͘ i ê sìⁿ-miā bián lo̍h Chhim-khiⁿ, mā bián hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí.
Ū lâng tó tī bîn-chhn̂g siū-tio̍h thàng-thiàⁿ ê chek-hoa̍t, kut-thâu thiàⁿ kah tòng bōe tiâu,
tì-kàu thó-ià chia̍h-mi̍h, liân siōng-ài ê chia̍h-mi̍h to iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
I siau-sán-lo̍h-bah, pêng-sî khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h ê kut-thâu lóng thóng--chhut-lâi.
I ê sìⁿ-miā kūn-óa Chhim-khiⁿ, chiap-kūn Sí-bông ê kài-sòaⁿ.
Chi̍t-chheng ê thiⁿ-sài tiong-kan nā ū chi̍t ê chòe tiong-kan-jîn, chiong lâng eng-kai chòe--ê kā i chí-sī,
thiⁿ-sài chiū lîn-bín i, kóng, “I bián lo̍h Chhim-khiⁿ, góa í-keng ūi-tio̍h i chhē-tio̍h sio̍k-hôe ê tāi-kè.”
I ê bah ōe pí gín-á ê bah khah iù-nńg; i ōe ho̍k-tò siàu-liân ê ji̍t-chí.
I kî-tó Siōng-tè, Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí kā i chiap-la̍p; i ōe hoaⁿ-hí kìⁿ Siōng-tè ê bīn; Siōng-tè ōe koh khòaⁿ i chòe gī.
I ōe tī lâng ê bīn-chêng tōa-siaⁿ kóng, “Góa ū hoān-chōe, ū tian-tò sī-hui, m̄-kú bô siū eng-kai siū ê hêng-hoa̍t.
Siōng-tè kiù-sio̍k góa ê sìⁿ-miā bián lo̍h sí-bông ê Chhim-khiⁿ; góa ê sìⁿ-miā ōe kìⁿ-tio̍h kng.”
Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng-tè chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn ūi-tio̍h lâng teh chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì,
beh kiù lâng thoat-lī Chhim-khiⁿ, hō͘ sìⁿ-miā ê kng chiò i.
Iok-pek ah, lí chù-ì thiaⁿ góa ê ōe, chēng-chēng thiaⁿ góa kóng.
Lí nā ū ōe beh kóng, tio̍h kóng; chòe lí kóng, góa chin ài lí sī tio̍h.
Lí nā bô beh kóng, tio̍h chēng-chēng thiaⁿ góa kóng; góa beh chiong tì-hūi thoân-siū hō͘ lí.
Í-lī-hō͘ koh kóng:
Lín ū tì-hūi ê lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa ê ōe; ū tì-sek ê lâng tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ.
Lán ēng hī-khang thiaⁿ-chhut ì-sù, ēng chi̍h chhì-chhut chu-bī.
Lán tio̍h piān-pia̍t sím-mi̍h sī tio̍h, bêng-pe̍k sím-mi̍h sī hó.
In-ūi Iok-pek kóng, “Góa bô m̄-tio̍h, Siōng-tè khiok kū-choa̍t góa ê sin-sò͘.
Góa bô m̄-tio̍h, I iáu khòaⁿ góa chòe pe̍h-chha̍t; góa bô kè-sit, iáu-kú siū-tio̍h bōe-i--tit ê siong.”
Siáⁿ-lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ Iok-pek móa-chhùi thí-chhiò, ká-ná teh lim-chúi?
I kap siâ-ok ê lâng tàu-tīn, kap pháiⁿ-lâng lâi-óng;
in-ūi i bat kóng, “Lâng in-ūi chhin-kūn Siōng-tè lâi hoaⁿ-hí, lóng bô lī-ek.”
Só͘-í, lín bêng-lí ê lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa ê ōe. Siōng-tè choa̍t-tùi bōe chòe pháiⁿ; Choân-lêng-chiá it-tēng bōe kiâⁿ put-gī.
I ōe chiàu lâng ê hêng-ûi kā i pò-èng, chiàu lâng ê kiâⁿ-chòe kā i tùi-thāi.
Siōng-tè it-tēng bōe chòe m̄-tio̍h; Choân-lêng-chiá bōe tian-tò sī-hui.
Kiám ū lâng chí-phài Siōng-tè chiáng-koán tāi-tōe? Kiám ū lâng chiong choân sè-kài kau-tài I?
Siōng-tè nā chiong I ê sîn kap khùi siu-hôe,
só͘-ū ê lâng lóng ōe bia̍t-bông, lâng lóng ōe kui-thó͘.
Lí nā bêng-lí, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa kóng, àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa beh kóng ê ōe:
Siōng-tè nā iàm-ò͘ⁿ kong-pêng, I kiám ōe-tàng tī-lí? I sī kong-gī koh ū koân-lêng, lí kiám ōe-tàng kā I tēng-chōe?
Siōng-tè ōe-tàng tùi kun-ông kóng “Lí sī pháiⁿ-lâng”, tùi kùi-cho̍k kóng “Lín chin ok-to̍k”.
I tùi-thāi ū koân-sè ê lâng bōe phian-su, mā bōe tiōng-hù-kheng-pîn, in-ūi in lóng sī I ê chhiú só͘ chō--ê.
In tī pòaⁿ-mî hut-jiân sí--khì; Siōng-tè tī hūn-loān tiong kā in siau-bia̍t. I m̄-bián ēng lâng ê chhiú chiū ōe châu-bia̍t ū koân-le̍k ê lâng.
Siōng-tè ê ba̍k-chiu chù-ì khòaⁿ ta̍k-ê lâng ê lō͘, kàm-chhat in ê kha-pō͘.
O͘-àm á-sī sí-ìm, lóng bōe-tàng hō͘ chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng bih.
Siōng-tè m̄-bián tēng sî-kan, sûi-sî ōe-tàng tiàu lâng lâi siū I sím-phòaⁿ.
I m̄-bián chhâ-mn̄g chiū ōe-tàng thiat-tóe táⁿ-tó ū koân-le̍k ê lâng, siat-li̍p pa̍t-lâng lâi chiap in ê ūi.
In-ūi I chai in ê hêng-ûi; it-iā-chi-kan kā in chhia-tó, in chiū bia̍t-bông.
I tī chèng-lâng ê ba̍k-chiu chêng phah in, in-ūi in ê chōe kā in hêng-hoa̍t.
In phian-lī bô tè I, bô ài kiâⁿ I ê tō-lō͘,
tì-kàu sàn-chhiah-lâng âu-kiò ê siaⁿ thàu kàu I ê bīn-chêng; I ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h khùn-khó͘ ê lâng ê âu-kiò.

Siōng-tè nā tiām-tiām, siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ kā I chí-chek? I nā bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ chhap lán, siáⁿ-lâng ōe tit-tio̍h I koàn-kò͘? Bô-lūn kok-ka á-sī kò-jîn, Siōng-tè lóng ū teh kàm-chhat,
chiah bián bô kèng-ùi I ê lâng chòe thóng-tī-chiá, hām-hāi jîn-bîn.
Lí kiám ū tùi Siōng-tè kóng “Góa í-keng siū hêng-hoa̍t, bōe koh hoān-chōe;
góa khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h--ê, kiû lí chí-sī; góa nā ū chòe m̄-tio̍h, góa bōe koh chòe”?
Kiám sī Siōng-tè só͘ chòe--ê bô chiàu lí ê ì-sù, lí chiah m̄ hóe-kái? Tio̍h koat-tēng--ê sī lí, m̄-sī góa; lí chai--ê, chòe lí kóng.
Bêng-lí ê lâng tùi góa kóng; tì-hūi ê lâng thiaⁿ góa ê ōe chiū kóng,
“ Iok-pek kóng--ê bô tì-sek, I ê ōe bô tì-hūi.
Iok-pek tio̍h thiat-tóe siū chhì-giām, in-ūi i ê ìn-tap chhin-chhiūⁿ siâ-ok ê lâng.
I chōe-siōng-ka-chōe, tī lán tiong-kan chè-chō khùn-jiáu, koh kóng chin chōe ōe te̍k-tùi Siōng-tè.”
Í-lī-hō͘ koh kóng:
Lí kóng, “Góa tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng sī bû-ko͘.” Lí án-ni kóng kiám ū tō-lí?
Lí kóng, “Góa nā bô hoān-chōe, tùi góa ū sím-mi̍h hó-chhù?” Lí án-ni kóng kiám ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek?
Góa beh tùi lí kap lí hiah-ê pêng-iú ìn-tap.
Lí gia̍h-ba̍k khòaⁿ thiⁿ, khòaⁿ hit-ê pí lí khah-koân ê kiong-chhong.
Lí nā hoān-chōe, ōe hāi-tio̍h Siōng-tè sím-mi̍h? Lí ê chōe-kò nā ke-thiⁿ, tùi I ū sím-mi̍h éng-hióng?
Lí nā chèng-ti̍t, ōe-tàng hō͘ I sím-mi̍h? Á-sī I ōe tùi lí ê chhiú tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h?
Lí ê pháiⁿ hêng-ûi kan-ta ōe hāi-tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ lí chit-khoán lâng; lí ê hó hêng-ûi mā kan-ta ōe lī-ek sè-kan-lâng.
Lâng siū tōa ap-pek chiū âu-kiò, siū koân-le̍k-chiá ap-chè chiū hoah-kiù.

M̄-kú bô lâng mn̄g, “Góa ê Chhòng-chō-chú, hō͘ lâng mî--sî chhiùⁿ-koa, kà-sī lán ū tì-hūi chhiau-kè tōe-chiūⁿ ê cháu-siù, hō͘ lán iâⁿ-kè khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu, hit-ūi Siōng-tè tī tó-ūi?”
Lâng âu-kiò, Siōng-tè bô kā in ìn-tap, in-ūi in pháiⁿ koh kiau-ngō͘.
Lām-sám ê ho͘-kiû, Siōng-tè m̄ thiaⁿ; Choân-lêng-chiá mā m̄ chhap in.
Lí kóng, lí khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h Siōng-tè; tio̍h nāi-sim thèng-hāu, in-ūi lí ê àn-kiāⁿ í-keng tī I bīn-chêng.
Taⁿ in-ūi I bô hoat siū-khì kā lí hêng-hoa̍t, mā bô chhap lí ê chōe-kò,
só͘-í, Iok-pek lí chiah khui-chhùi o͘-pe̍h kóng, kóng chin chōe bô tì-sek ê ōe.
Í-lī-hō͘ koh sòa-chiap kóng:
Lí tán--chi̍t-ē, góa beh chí-sī lí, in-ūi góa iáu ū ōe beh thòe Siōng-tè kóng.
Góa beh tùi sì-hng chhú tì-sek, chèng-bêng góa ê Chhòng-chō-chú sī tio̍h.
Góa ê ōe si̍t-chāi, bô pe̍h-chha̍t, ū tì-sek chiâu-pī--ê khiā tī lí bīn-chêng.
Siōng-tè ū tōa koân-lêng, bô khòaⁿ-khin lâng; I ê tì-hūi koân, lêng-le̍k tōa.
I bô hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng oa̍h--lo̍h-khì; I kong-pêng tùi-thāi khùn-khó͘ ê lâng.
I ê ba̍k-chiu put-sî khòaⁿ-kò͘ gī-lâng, hō͘ in kap kun-ông chòe-hé chē ông-ūi, tit-tio̍h chun-êng kàu éng-oán.
Lâng nā hō͘ só-liān liān--teh, hō͘ khó͘-lān ê soh tîⁿ--tio̍h,
án-ni sī Siōng-tè teh chí-sī in chai ka-kī ê só͘-chòe, í-ki̍p in só͘ hoān ê tāng-chōe.
I koh khui in ê hī-khang siū kà-sī, chí-sī in tio̍h hóe-kái, lī-khui chōe-ok.
In nā sūn-thàn lâi ho̍k-sāi I, chiū ōe ji̍t-ji̍t heng-thong, nî-nî an-lo̍k.
In nā m̄ sūn-thàn, ōe hō͘ to-kiàm thâi, in-ūi bû-ti lâi sí.
Sim-lāi bô Siōng-tè ê lâng put-sî teh siū-khì; in siū chek-hoa̍t mā m̄ kiû Siōng-tè pang-chān.
In ōe tī siàu-liân ê sî chiū sí, tī kiàn-siàu tiong tn̄g-khùi.
Siōng-tè thong-kè khó͘-lān kái-kiù siū-khó͘ ê lâng, ēng chai-lān hō͘ in chhíⁿ-ngō͘.
Siōng-tè ài-beh kiù lí thoat-chhut chai-lān, chhōa lí kàu khui-khoah chū-iû ê só͘-chāi, koh pâi-móa hong-sēng ê chia̍h-mi̍h tī lí ê toh-téng.
Chóng-sī pháiⁿ-lâng èng-tit ê hêng-hoa̍t taⁿ lîm-kàu lí; lí bōe-tàng thoat-lī kong-gī ê sím-phòaⁿ.
M̄-thang in-ūi siū-khì tì-kàu lí bú-bān Siōng-tè, mā m̄-thang in-ūi châi-hù ê ín-iú kiâⁿ phian--khì.
Lí ê châi-hù tùi lí kiám ū lī-ek? Lí ê koân-le̍k tùi lí kiám ū pang-chān?
M̄-thang khat-bō͘ àm-mî, in-ūi hit-sî lâng tī in tòa ê só͘-chāi siū siau-bia̍t.
Tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang choán-ǹg chōe-ok, in-ūi lí soán-te̍k chōe-ok chiah siū-tio̍h khó͘-lān.
Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng-tè ê koân-lêng hiah-ni̍h úi-tāi; ū tó chi̍t ê tō-su chhin-chhiūⁿ I?
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng chí-tēng I tio̍h chòe ê sū? Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kā I kóng “Lí chòe m̄-tio̍h”?
Lâng lóng chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló I, lí mā tio̍h ōe-kì-tit chheng-chàn I ê chok-ûi.
Só͘-ū ê lâng lóng ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h I ê só͘-chòe, m̄-kú in chí-ū ōe-tàng tùi hn̄g-hn̄g khòaⁿ.
Siōng-tè si̍t-chāi úi-tāi, lán bô hoat-tō͘ liáu-kái; I ê hè-siū bû-kiông-chīn.
I khip chi̍t-tih chi̍t-tih ê chúi, hō͘ in pìⁿ-chòe hûn-bū, kek-hō͘,
chiū tùi thiⁿ lo̍h chhiong-chiok ê hō͘-chúi, hō͘ sè-kan chèng-lâng.
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe bêng-pe̍k hûn án-chóaⁿ thí-khui, lûi ê siaⁿ án-chóaⁿ tùi Siōng-tè khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi hoat-chhut?
I tùi I ê chiu-ûi hoat-chhut sih-nà, siā kàu hái-tóe.
I ēng chiah-ê tī-lí sè-kan-lâng, koh sù in hong-sēng ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
I chhiú--ni̍h the̍h sih-nà, bēng-lēng i siā beh siā ê bo̍k-phiau.
Lûi ê siaⁿ piáu-bêng I beh lâi, liân cheng-siⁿ to chai I teh-beh lâi.
In-ūi án-ni góa ê sim pho̍k-pho̍k-chhéng, sim-chōng kiông-beh thiàu--chhut-lâi.
Tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ Siōng-tè ê siaⁿ, thiaⁿ I ê chhùi só͘ chhut chhin-chhiūⁿ lûi teh tân ê siaⁿ.
I ê sih-nà tùi thiⁿ chit-pêng siā kàu hit-pêng; sih-nà ê kng chiò kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak;
sòa-chiap ū lōng-lōng-háu ê siaⁿ; I ui-giâm ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ lûi teh tân, sih-nà it-ti̍t sih bô-thêng.
Siōng-tè hoat-chhut tōa koh kî-īⁿ ê siaⁿ; I chòe tōa-sū, lán bōe-tàng liáu-kái.
I bēng-lēng seh lo̍h tī tōe-chiūⁿ, mā kiò tōa-hō͘ piàⁿ-lo̍h tāi-tōe.
I kiò lâng lóng thêng-chí kang-chok, hō͘ lâng thang chai I ê chok-ûi.
Pah-siù lóng ji̍p hia̍t, bih tī in ê tōng-lāi.
Tōa-hong tùi lâm-pêng thàu--lâi; peng-léng ê khì tùi pak-hng chhe--lâi.
Siōng-tè pûn-khùi, chúi chiū kian-tàng; kang-hô ê chúi lóng kiat-peng.
I hō͘ ba̍t-hûn chek-móa sip-khì, tùi hûn siā-chhut sih-nà.
I chiàu ka-kī ê kè-ōe hō͘ hûn tńg-se̍h, hō͘ in tī tōe-chiūⁿ oân-sêng I chí-tēng ê kang-chok.
I hō͘ chiah-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng, lóng sī ūi-tio̍h beh chek-hoa̍t á-sī hián-sī chû-ài.
Iok-pek ah, chù-ì thiaⁿ, an-chēng lâi siūⁿ Siōng-tè kî-biāu ê chok-ûi.
Siōng-tè án-chóaⁿ bēng-lēng chiah-ê hûn, án-chóaⁿ hō͘ sih-nà tùi hûn siā--chhut-lâi, lí kiám chai?
Hûn án-chóaⁿ tī khong-tiong chek chòe-tui teh pe, hit-ūi Choân-tì-chiá kî-biāu ê chok-ûi, lí kiám chai?
Lâm-hong án-chóaⁿ hō͘ tāi-tōe tiām-chēng, kā lí chhēng ê saⁿ hip-sio, lí kiám chai?
Lí kiám ōe-tàng kap Siōng-tè chòe-hé pho͘ kiong-chhong, hō͘ i chhin-chhiūⁿ chù--chhut-lâi ê tâng-kiàⁿ hiah tēng?
Goán chin han-bān, bōe-hiáu sin-sò͘, lí tio̍h kà goán eng-kai tùi I kóng sím-mi̍h.
Kiám ū lâng káⁿ tùi I kóng beh kap I kóng-ōe? Bô lâng hiah gōng ka-kī beh thó-sí.
Taⁿ, lâng khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h kiong-chhong chhàn-lān ê kng; hong chi̍t-ē chhe--kè, thiⁿ chiū chheng-chhái.
Chhàn-lān ê kng tùi pak-hng chhut--lâi; Siōng-tè ui-giâm thang kiaⁿ-ùi.
Choân-lêng-chiá, lán chhē bōe tio̍h; I ū tōa lêng-le̍k koh ū kong-pêng, chhiong-móa kong-gī, bōe ap-chè lâng.
Só͘-í, lâng kèng-ùi I; I bōe khòaⁿ-tāng hiah-ê ka-kī siūⁿ-chòe ū tì-hūi ê lâng.
Hit-sî Siōng Chú tùi kńg-lê-á-hong tiong-kan ìn Iok-pek:
Lí sī siáⁿ-lâng, káⁿ ēng bû-ti ê ōe hō͘ góa ê chí-ì bū-bū bô-bêng?
Tio̍h chún-pī hó-sè, chòe chi̍t ê tāi-tiōng-hu; góa mn̄g lí, lí tio̍h ìn góa.
Góa hē tāi-tōe ê tōe-ki, hit-sî lí tī tó-ūi? Lí nā chai, kóng lâi thiaⁿ-khòaⁿ leh.
Sī sím-mi̍h-lâng koat-tēng tāi-tōe ê tōa sòe? Sī sím-mi̍h-lâng ēng chîn-sòaⁿ niû tāi-tōe, lí chai bô?
Tāi-tōe ê tōe-ki kiàn-li̍p tī sím-mi̍h téng-bīn, tiōng-iàu ê ki-chio̍h sī sím-mi̍h-lâng an-tì--ê, lí kiám chai?
Hit-sî, thàu-chá ê chhiⁿ-sîn chòe-hé chhiùⁿ-koa, Siōng-tè ê chèng sù-chiá mā lóng hoan-ho͘.
Tōa-hái tùi tōe ê bú-thai chhiong--chhut-lâi ê sî, siáⁿ-lâng ēng mn̂g kā i koaiⁿ--khí-lâi?
Góa ēng hûn chòe saⁿ kā i chhēng, ēng ba̍t-hûn chòe pò͘ kā i pau.
Góa kā hái siat-tēng kài-hān, kā i siat mn̂g kap mn̂g-chhòaⁿ,
kóng: Lí kàu chia bōe-ēng-tit pôaⁿ--kè; lí chhiong-kông ê éng kàu chia ûi-chí.
Lí kiám bat bēng-lēng ji̍t-thâu khí--lâi, hō͘ lê-bêng chai i ê chit-hūn,
kah i khiú tōe ê sì-kak-thâu, chiong pháiⁿ-lâng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì?
Án-ni, tōe-bīn chiū oân-choân kái-koan, hián-chhut ta̍k-khoán ê hêng-thé, to-iūⁿ ê sek-chhái.
Pháiⁿ-lâng bōe tit-tio̍h kng, gia̍h-koân tián-ui ê chhiú-kut siū kòng-tn̄g.
Lí kiám bat ji̍p-khì kàu hái ê goân-thâu, bat kiâⁿ-kè chhim-ian ò-pì ê só͘-chāi?
Lâng kiám bat pò lí Sí-bông ê ji̍p-kháu? Lí kiám bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h Im-hú ê mn̂g?
Tāi-tōe jōa khoah lí kiám bat chhek-liōng--kè? Nā bat, chòe lí kóng.
Lí kiám chai kng tùi tó-ūi lâi, àm tòa tó-ūi,
thang chhōa in tńg-khì in tau? Lí kiám chai khì in chhù ê lō͘?
Lí eng-kai chai, in-ūi hit-sî lí í-keng chhut-sì, chit-chūn lí í-keng chin lāu lah!
Lí kiám bat ji̍p-khì seh ê chhng-khò͘, kiám bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h pha̍uh ê khò͘-pâng?
Chiah-ê lóng sī góa ūi-tio̍h hoān-lān ê sî, ūi-tio̍h sio-thâi kap chiàn-cheng ê ji̍t chún-pī--ê.
Sih-nà tùi sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi siā--chhut-khì? Tang-hong tùi tó-ūi sàu-kè tāi-tōe?
Siáⁿ-lâng kā tōa-hō͘ khui chúi-lō͘, kā lûi-tiān koat-tēng lō͘-sòaⁿ?
Siáⁿ-lâng hō͘ hō͘ lo̍h tī khòng-iá, lo̍h tī bô lâng khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi,
hō͘ pha-hng hong-hòe ê thó͘-tōe tit-tio̍h chhiong-chiok ê hō͘-chúi, hō͘ chhiⁿ-chháu puh-gê hoat-íⁿ?
Hō͘-chúi kiám ū lāu-pē? Lō͘-chúi siáⁿ-lâng siⁿ--ê?
Peng tùi siáⁿ-lâng ê thai chhut--lâi? Thiⁿ-téng ê sng siáⁿ-lâng siⁿ--ê?
Siáⁿ-lâng hō͘ chúi pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-thâu hiah-ni̍h tēng, hō͘ chhim-ian ê piáu-bīn kiat-peng?
Lí kiám ōe-tàng kā Báu-chhiⁿ pa̍k--khí-lâi, kā Chham-chhiⁿ ê tòa tháu-khui?
Lí kiám ōe-tàng hō͘ chhiⁿ-sîn chiàu kùi-choeh chhut-hiān, tòa Pak-táu kap i ê chhiⁿ-kûn chhut--lâi?
Lí kiám chai thiⁿ ê tēng-lu̍t, kiám ōe hō͘ i ū koân thang koán-hat tōe?
Lí kiám ōe-tàng chhut tōa-siaⁿ bēng-lēng hûn, hō͘ tōa-chúi im-ba̍t lí?
Lí kiám ōe-tàng kiò sih-nà siā--chhut-khì, hō͘ in kóng “Goán tī chia, chhiáⁿ chí-sī”?
Siáⁿ-lâng hō͘ âng-lō͘-chiáu ū tì-hūi chai Nî-lô-hô sím-mi̍h sî ōe hoàn-lām, hō͘ koe-kak-á ū chhong-bêng chai sím-mi̍h sî ōe lo̍h-hō͘?
Siáⁿ-lâng ū tì-hūi thang sǹg hûn ê sò͘-bo̍k, ōe-tàng chiong thiⁿ ê chúi lóng piàⁿ-khang,
hō͘ thô͘-hún pìⁿ-chòe lō͘-kô͘-bê, hō͘ thô͘ kiat kui-oân?
Sai-á-kiáⁿ tī tōng-lāi khut-teh tán, tī bih ê só͘-chāi bâi-ho̍k ê sî, lí kiám ōe-tàng thòe sai-bú lia̍h chia̍h-mi̍h, hō͘ in chia̍h kàu pá?
Sòe-chiah o͘-a bô thang chia̍h pe-lâi-pe-khì, tùi Siōng-tè ai-kiû ê sî, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng ūi-tio̍h in chún-pī chia̍h-mi̍h?
Soaⁿ-giâm tiong ê iá soaⁿ-iûⁿ tī-sî siⁿ-kiáⁿ, lí chai bô? Lo̍k-bú siⁿ-kiáⁿ ê sî, lí bat khòaⁿ--tio̍h bô?
In hoâi-thai tī-sî kàu-ge̍h, lí ōe-hiáu sǹg bōe? In tī-sî seng-sán, lí chai bô?
In khut--lo̍h-khì, kā kiáⁿ siⁿ--chhut-lâi;
in ê kiáⁿ tī soaⁿ-iá chiām-chiām tióng-tōa ióng-chòng, lī-khui chiū bô koh tńg--lâi.
Siáⁿ-lâng pàng iá-lû chū-iû? Siáⁿ-lâng tháu-khui soaⁿ-lû ê soh?
Góa ēng khòng-iá hō͘ in chòe chhù, ēng kiâm ê tōe hō͘ in tòa.
Iá-lû thí-chhiò siâⁿ-lāi ê soan-hoa, mā bián koh thiaⁿ kóaⁿ lû-á ê lâng hoah-hiàm.
Tōa-soaⁿ sió-soaⁿ lóng sī in ê chháu-po͘; in chhē ta̍k-khoán chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chháu lâi chia̍h.
Iá-gû kiám beh kā lí chòe kang, kiám beh tī lí ê tiâu-lāi kè-mî?
Lí kiám ōe-tàng ēng soh pa̍k iá-gû lâi lôe-chhân? I kiám ōe tè lí khì kā soaⁿ-kok ê tōe pê hō͘ pîⁿ?
Lí kiám thang in-ūi i la̍t tōa chiū khò i, kiám thang chiong lí ê khang-khè lóng kau-tài i?
Lí kiám ōe-tàng sìn-jīm i chiong lí ê siu-sêng tòa--tńg-lâi, siu-chi̍p tī ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ?
Tô-chiáu phah-piàⁿ ia̍t-si̍t, mā bōe-tàng chhin-chhiūⁿ ho̍h pe--khí-lâi.
I kā nn̄g pàng tī thô͘-kha, hō͘ thô͘ ê sio-khì pū;
bô siūⁿ-tio̍h kha ōe lap--tio̍h, iá-siù ōe ta̍h--tio̍h.
I bô hó-hó chiàu-kò͘ i ê kiáⁿ, ká-ná m̄-sī ka-kī siⁿ--ê; i ê lô-khó͘ bô sêng-kó mā bô iàu-kín.
In-ūi Siōng-tè bô hō͘ i tì-hūi, mā bô hō͘ i lêng-khiáu.
M̄-kú i chi̍t-ē théng-sin cháu, chiū thí-chhiò bé kap khiâ-bé--ê.
Bé ê la̍t kiám sī lí hō͘ i--ê? I ām-kún ê chang kiám sī lí kā i chhēng--ê?
Lí kiám ū hō͘ i chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh hiah gâu thiàu, hō͘ i tián-ui phn̍gh-phn̍gh-háu hō͘ lâng kiaⁿ?
I tī soaⁿ-kok tiong chhut-la̍t pê thô͘, tián i ê ui-le̍k beh chhut-hoat èng-chiàn.
I bô teh kiaⁿ, bô teh lún, biān-tùi to-kiàm lóng bô hôe-thâu.
Seng-khu téng ê chìⁿ-tē khiang-khiang-kiò; tn̂g-chhiuⁿ, té-chhiuⁿ siám-sih hoat-kng.
I thiaⁿ-tio̍h lat-pah ê siaⁿ chiū tòng bōe tiâu, heng-hùn kek-tōng, hiòng-chêng ti̍t-chhiong.
Lat-pah chi̍t-ē tân, i chiū phǹg-phǹg-kiò; i tùi hn̄g-hn̄g chiū phīⁿ-tio̍h kau-chiàn ê bī, thiaⁿ-tio̍h kun-tiúⁿ ê hō-lēng kap sio-thâi ê hoah-hiàm.
Bā-hio̍h thí-si̍t pe-khì lâm-pêng, kiám sī khò lí ê tì-hūi?
Eng-chiáu chhèng-koân, tī koân ê só͘-chāi choh-siū, kiám sī chiàu lí ê bēng-lēng?
I tiàm tī soaⁿ-giâm, tòa tī soaⁿ-chiam an-ún ê só͘-chāi,
tùi hia ba̍k-chiu kim-kim siòng hn̄g-hn̄g, sì-kòe chhē chia̍h-mi̍h.
Si-thé tī tó-ūi, eng-chiáu chiū tī hia, eng-á-kiáⁿ khîⁿ óa-khì suh huih.
Siōng Chú koh tùi Iok-pek kóng:
Hò͘ⁿ-piān ê lâng kiám thang kap Choân-lêng-chiá cheng-lūn? Ài chí-chek Siōng-tè ê, taⁿ lí tio̍h ìn.
Iok-pek chiū ìn Siōng Chú kóng:
Góa chin bî-sòe, góa ōe-tàng ìn-tap lí sím-mi̍h? Góa ēng chhiú ng góa ê chhùi.
Góa í-keng kóng chi̍t piàn, bô ōe thang ìn; góa í-keng kóng chhiau-kè, m̄-thang koh kóng.
Siōng Chú chiū tùi kńg-lê-á-hong tiong-kan ìn Iok-pek:
Tio̍h chún-pī hó-sè, chòe chi̍t ê tāi-tiōng-hu; góa mn̄g lí, lí tio̍h ìn góa.
Lí sī beh hó͘-tēng góa ê chhâi-koat, chí-chek góa m̄-tio̍h, lâi chèng-bêng lí ka-kī sī tio̍h o͘h?
Lí kiám ū chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè hiah ū-la̍t ê chhiú-kut? Lí kiám ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ góa hoat-chhut lûi lōng-lōng-háu ê siaⁿ?
Án-ni, tio̍h ēng chun-êng ui-giâm lâi chng-thāⁿ, ēng êng-kng chun-kùi chòe saⁿ chhēng.
Tio̍h piàⁿ-chhut lí móa-pak ê siū-khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h it-chhè kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng, tio̍h hō͘ in khut-kē.
Khòaⁿ-tio̍h it-chhè kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng, tio̍h kā in khiú--lo̍h-lâi, tī pháiⁿ-lâng ê tōe-pôaⁿ kā in thún-ta̍h.
Tio̍h kā in chòe-chi̍t-ē tâi tī thô͘-tóe, kā in lóng koaiⁿ tī Im-kan.
Án-ni, liân góa mā ōe sêng-jīn, lí ū khùi-la̍t kiù lí ka-kī.
Lí khòaⁿ hô-bé, góa chō lí, mā chō i; i chhin-chhiūⁿ gû chia̍h-chháu.
I ê khùi-la̍t chāi-tī io; i ê la̍t chāi-tī pak-tó͘-kun.
I ê bé-liu khiàu--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū; i ê tōa-thúi-kun chho͘-ióng;
i ê kut-thâu chhin-chhiūⁿ tâng ê kóng; i ê sù-chi chhin-chhiūⁿ thih ê thiāu.
I sī Siōng-tè ê kia̍t-chok; chí-ū i ê Chhòng-chō-chiá ōe-tàng kā i chè-ho̍k.
Tōa-soaⁿ sió-soaⁿ kiong-kip i chia̍h-mi̍h; chhân-iá ê pah-siù tī hia thit-thô.
I tó tī liân-hoe-hio̍h kha, khùn tī kui-phō lô͘-tek ê chúi-khut lāi.
Liân-hoe-hio̍h kā i jia--teh; khoe-piⁿ ê liú-chhiū kā i ûi--teh.
Hô-chúi hoàn-lām, i mā m̄ kiaⁿ; Iok-tàn-hô tiòng kàu i ê chhùi, i mā chū-chāi.
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng tī i ba̍k-chiu kim-kim ê sî kā i lia̍h--tio̍h, á-sī ēng kau-á kǹg-kè i ê phīⁿ?
Lí kiám ōe-tàng ēng kau-á thoa hái-siù khí--lâi, á-sī ēng soh liù i ê chi̍h?
Lí kiám ōe-tàng ēng soh chhng-kè i ê phīⁿ, á-sī ēng kau-á chǹg-kè i ê gê-chô?
I kiám ōe it-ti̍t kiû lí lîn-bín, á-sī tùi lí kóng un-jiû ê ōe?
I kiám ōe kap lí li̍p-iok, éng-oán chòe lí ê lô͘-po̍k?
Lí kiám ōe kā i khòaⁿ-chòe chiáu-á kap i thit-thô, á-sī kā i pa̍k--teh, hō͘ lí ê cha-bó͘ gín-á khan-teh kiâⁿ?
Seng-lí-lâng kiám ōe kā i tòng-chòe siong-phín phah-bōe? In kiám ōe kā i chhiat chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè sòaⁿ-sòaⁿ-á bōe?
Lí kiám ōe-tàng ēng hî-pio kā i kui seng-khu chha̍k-thàu-thàu, á-sī ēng hî-chhe chha̍k-thàu i ê thâu-khak?
Lí kā kha̍p khòaⁿ-bāi leh! Lí choa̍t-tùi m̄-káⁿ koh kap i piàⁿ!
Siūⁿ-beh kā chè-ho̍k, choa̍t-tùi bô khó-lêng; lâng chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiū kiaⁿ kah phòa-táⁿ.
Bô lâng hiah hó-táⁿ káⁿ jiá i. Án-ni, siáⁿ-lâng tī góa ê bīn-chêng khiā ōe tiâu?
Siáⁿ-lâng tùi-khòng góa, góa choa̍t-tùi bōe pàng i soah. Thiⁿ-kha-ē it-chhè lóng sī góa ê.
Góa bōe-tàng bô kóng chit-ê hái-siù ê seng-khu, bô kóng i kut-keh ê súi kap i ê khùi-la̍t.
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng pak i ê gōa-saⁿ? Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng ji̍p-khì i gê-chô ê tiong-kan?
Siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ khui i ê chhùi? I sì-kho͘-lìn-tńg ê chhùi-khí lóng chin khióng-pò͘.
Teh pó-hō͘ i--ê sī chi̍t-pâi chi̍t-pâi ê lân, ha̍p--khí-lâi chiū hong-ba̍t-ba̍t;
chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè thia̍p chòe-hé, liân hong to chǹg bōe ji̍p--khì;
lóng liân chòe-hé, liâm chòe chi̍t ê, bô lâng ōe-tàng kā in phah-khui.
I phah-ka-chhiùⁿ ōe siā-chhut kng; i ê ba̍k-chiu chhin-chhiūⁿ thàu-chá ê ji̍t-kng.
I ê chhùi thò͘-chhut hé-iām, phùn-chhut hé-chhiⁿ.
I ê phīⁿ-khang chhèng-ian, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-tiáⁿ teh bo̍k-bo̍k-kún.
I ê khì ōe tiám-to̍h thô͘-thòaⁿ, ū hé-iām tùi i ê chhùi siā-chhut.
I ê ām-kún ū-la̍t; tú-tio̍h i--ê lóng kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.
I ê pak-tó͘-bah kiat-si̍t, liâm tī seng-khu, bōe-tàng kā i tín-tāng.
I ê heng-khám tēng kah chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-thâu, chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-bō hiah tēng.
I chi̍t-ē khí--lâi, ióng-sū lóng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kiaⁿ kah sit-sîn.
Lâng ēng kiàm chha̍k bōe ji̍p--khì, ēng chhiuⁿ, pio, chìⁿ mā lóng bōe.
I khòaⁿ thih chòe ta-chháu, khòaⁿ tâng chòe àu--khì ê chhâ.
Keng-chìⁿ bōe-tàng kā i heh-kiaⁿ kóaⁿ-cháu; i khòaⁿ hìⁿ-soh ēng ê chio̍h-thâu chòe chháu-iù-á.
I khòaⁿ kùn-á chòe be̍h-kó, thí-chhiò chhiuⁿ khiang-khiang-kiò ê siaⁿ.
I ê pak-tó͘-ē chhin-chhiūⁿ lāi ê hiā-phìⁿ; i kiâⁿ--kè ê só͘-chāi chhin-chhiūⁿ thih-pê pê--kè ê nōa-thô͘.
I hō͘ chhim-ian chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-tiáⁿ bo̍k-bo̍k-kún, hō͘ hái chhin-chhiūⁿ teh kún ê iû-tiáⁿ.
I kiâⁿ--kè ê lō͘ hoat-kng, siû--kè ê chúi lóng khí pe̍h-pho.
Tōe-chiūⁿ bô chi̍t ê siū-chō-bu̍t ōe-tàng kap i pí; i sím-mi̍h lóng m̄ kiaⁿ.
I khòaⁿ-khin it-chhè kiông-béng ê tōng-bu̍t; i sī pah-siù chi ông.
Iok-pek ìn Siōng Chú kóng:
Góa chai lí ta̍k-hāng lóng ōe; lí ê kè-ōe bô lâng ōe-tàng chó͘-tòng.
Lí mn̄g, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng ēng bû-ti ê ōe hō͘ góa ê chí-ì bū-bū bô-bêng?” Góa khak-si̍t ū kóng ka-kī bô liáu-kái ê ōe, chiah-ê tāi-chì chin kî-biāu, góa bô bêng-pe̍k.
Chhiáⁿ lí thiaⁿ, góa beh kóng; góa chhéng-būn lí, chhiáⁿ kā góa chí-sī.
Góa chêng bat thiaⁿ-kìⁿ lí, taⁿ góa chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí.
Só͘-í, góa iàm-ò͘ⁿ ka-kī, chē tī tîn-ai kap hé-hu téng chhàm-hóe.

Siōng Chú tùi Iok-pek kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu, tùi Thê-bān -lâng Í-lī-hoat kóng, “Góa tùi lí kap lí nn̄g ê pêng-iú hoat siū-khì, in-ūi lín gī-lūn góa, bô chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ê po̍k-jîn Iok-pek só͘ kóng--ê hiah ha̍p-lí.

Taⁿ lín tio̍h khan chhit chiah gû-káng, chhit chiah iûⁿ-káng, khì góa ê po̍k-jîn Iok-pek hia, ūi ka-kī hiàn sio-hòa-chè; góa ê po̍k-jîn Iok-pek ōe thòe lín kî-tó; góa ōe chiap-la̍p i, chiah bián góa chiàu lín ê gû-gōng tùi-thāi lín, in-ūi lín gī-lūn góa, bô chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ê po̍k-jîn Iok-pek só͘ kóng--ê hiah ha̍p-lí.”
Án-ni, Thê-bān -lâng Í-lī-hoat, Su-a -lâng Pí-le̍k-ta̍t, Ná-má -lâng Só-hoat, chiàu Siōng Chú bēng-lēng in--ê khì chòe; Siōng Chú chiū chiap-la̍p Iok-pek ê kî-tó.
Iok-pek thòe i ê pêng-iú kî-tó liáu-āu, Siōng Chú hō͘ i hôe-ho̍k kè-khì ê hoân-êng, chiàu i í-chêng só͘-ū--ê têng-pē hō͘ i.

Hit-sî i ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, kap í-chêng se̍k-sāi ê lâng lóng lâi khòaⁿ i, tī i ê chhù chòe-hé lim-chia̍h. In ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú só͘ kàng-lo̍h hō͘ i ê chai-hō pi-siong, koh kā i an-ùi; ta̍k-ê lâng sàng i chi̍t tè gûn, chi̍t ê kim-khoân.
Án-ni, Siōng Chú sù-hok hō͘ Iok-pek, hō͘ i ê boán-kéng pí i khí-chho͘ khah hó; i ū iûⁿ chi̍t-bān sì-chheng, lo̍k-tô la̍k-chheng, gû chi̍t-chheng tùi, lû-bú chi̍t-chheng.
I koh ū chhit ê kiáⁿ, saⁿ ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
I kā tōa cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō-miâ kiò-chòe Iâ-bí-má, tē-jī ê kiò-chòe Ki-sé-a, tē-saⁿ ê kiò-chòe Ki-liân Hap-phok.
Choân-tōe chhē bô chhin-chhiūⁿ Iok-pek ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hiah-ni̍h súi ê lú-chú. Iok-pek hō͘ chiah-ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kap in ê hiaⁿ-tī pîⁿ-pîⁿ tit-tio̍h châi-sán.
Āu-lâi Iok-pek koh chia̍h chi̍t-pah sì-cha̍p hè, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ê kiáⁿ, i ê sun, kàu sì tāi.
Chòe-āu, Iok-pek chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū, nî-lāu chiah sí.

Bô thàn pháiⁿ-lâng ê kè-bô͘, bô kiâⁿ chōe-jîn ê lō͘, bô chē siat-to̍k-chiá ê ūi, chí-ū ài-bō͘ Siōng Chú ê Lu̍t-hoat, mî-ji̍t ia̍h tha̍k ia̍h siūⁿ I ê Lu̍t-hoat, chit-khoán lâng chin ū hok-khì!
I chhin-chhiūⁿ ké-chí-chhiū chai tī khoe-piⁿ, chiàu-sî kiat ké-chí, hio̍h mā bōe ta--khì; i só͘ chòe ê it-chhè lóng heng-ōng.
Pháiⁿ-lâng chiū m̄-sī án-ni; i chhin-chhiūⁿ chho͘-khng hō͘ hong chhe sòaⁿ--khì.
Só͘-í sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, pháiⁿ-lâng tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng khiā bōe tiâu; chōe-jîn tī gī-lâng ê hōe-tiong mā-sī án-ni.
In-ūi gī-lâng ê tō-lō͘ Siōng Chú teh khòaⁿ-kò͘; pháiⁿ-lâng chí-ū bia̍t-bông chi̍t tiâu lō͘.
Lia̍t-kok sī-án-chóaⁿ teh chō siaⁿ-sè? Bān-bîn sī-án-chóaⁿ kè-ōe khang-khang ê im-bô͘?
Tōe-chiūⁿ ê kun-ông teh pâi-tīn, thóng-tī-chiá tàu-tīn kè-bô͘, beh tùi-khòng Siōng Chú kap I soán-li̍p ê ông.
In kóng, “Lán lâi kòng-chhùi ap-chè lán ê taⁿ, chhoah-tn̄g khún-pa̍k lán ê soh.”
Siōng Chú chē tī thiⁿ-téng teh chhiò, teh thí-chhiò in ê im-bô͘.
I siū-khì kā in kéng-kò, hoat sèng-tē hō͘ in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
I kóng, “Tī góa ê sèng-soaⁿ Sek-an, góa í-keng siat-li̍p só͘ kéng-soán--ê choh-ông.”
Ông kóng, “Góa beh soan-kò Siōng Chú ê sèng-chí. I kā góa kóng, ‘Lí sī góa ê kiáⁿ, góa kin-á-ji̍t siⁿ lí.
Tùi góa kiû, góa chiū chiong lia̍t-kok hō͘ lí chòe léng-thó͘, chiong choân-tōe hō͘ lí chòe sán-gia̍p.
Lí beh ēng thih-koáiⁿ kā in kòng, chhin-chhiūⁿ kòng-chhùi hûi-khì.’”
Chèng kun-ông ah, tio̍h kín-sīn! Thóng-tī-chiá ah, tio̍h chiap-siū kéng-kài!
Tio̍h ēng kèng-ùi ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú, ēng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ khut-ho̍k tī I kha-ē,
chiah bián I khí sèng-tē, hō͘ lín tī lō͘-tiong bia̍t-bông, in-ūi I ōe sûi-sî hoat siū-khì. Chhē Siōng Chú chòe pī-lān-só͘ ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Siōng Chú ah, góa ê tùi-te̍k ná hiah chōe! Hiah chōe lâng khí-lâi kong-kek góa.
In tùi góa kóng, “Siōng-tè bōe pang-chān lí.”
M̄-kú, Siōng Chú, lí sī pó-hō͘ góa ê tún-pâi, góa ê êng-kng; lí hō͘ góa ê thâu-khak gia̍h ōe khí--lâi.
Góa chhut-siaⁿ kiû-kiò Siōng Chú; I ōe tùi I ê sèng-soaⁿ ìn góa.
Góa tó--teh, góa teh khùn, góa cheng-sîn, Siōng Chú lóng teh pó-hō͘ góa.
Chiū-sī-kóng ū chheng-bān lâng pau-ûi kong-kek góa, góa mā m̄ kiaⁿ.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí khí--lâi; góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí chín-kiù góa. In-ūi lí ū siàn góa tùi-te̍k ê chhùi-phóe, ū kòng-tn̄g pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhùi-khí.
Chín-kiù tùi Siōng Chú lâi; goān lí sù-hok hō͘ lí ê chú-bîn.
Ūi góa piān-hō͘ ê Siōng-tè ah, góa kiû-kiò ê sî, kiû lí ìn góa. Góa khùn-khó͘ ê sî, lí ū kā góa tháu-pàng; taⁿ kiû lí lîn-bín góa, thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó.
Lín chiah-ê lâng ah, lín chiong góa ê chun-êng pìⁿ-chòe kiàn-siàu beh jōa kú? Lín ì-ài khang-hu, tui-chhē hu-ké, beh kàu tī-sî?
Tio̍h chai Siōng Chú í-keng hun-pia̍t kèng-khiân ê lâng chòe I ka-kī ê; góa kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, I ōe thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ.
Tio̍h kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, m̄-thang hoān-chōe; tī bîn-chhn̂g hioh-khùn ê sî, sim tio̍h an-chēng chū-séng.
Tio̍h hiàn ha̍h Siōng-tè sim-ì ê chè; mā tio̍h óa-khò Siōng Chú.
Chin chōe lâng teh mn̄g, “Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng hō͘ goán tit-tio̍h hok-khì?” Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí ēng lí bīn ê kng chiò goán.
Lí hō͘ góa sim-lāi ū hoaⁿ-hí, iâⁿ-kè lâng tit-tio̍h chin chōe ngó͘-kok kap sin-chiú.
Góa beh an-jiân tó-teh khùn, in-ūi chí-ū Siōng Chú lí ōe hō͘ góa an-ún khiā-khí.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa kóng, chai góa ê khó͘-chêng.
Góa ê Ông, góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa kiû-kiò ê siaⁿ, in-ūi góa tùi lí kî-tó.
Siōng Chú ah, chá-khí-sî kiû lí thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ; chá-khí-sî góa tùi lí khún-kiû, koh thèng-hāu.
In-ūi lí m̄-sī ì-ài chōe-ok ê Siōng-tè; siâ-ok, lí bōe iông-ún.
Kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng bōe-tàng khiā tī lí bīn-chêng; chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng lóng sī lí só͘ oàn-hūn.
Kóng pe̍h-chha̍t--ê, lí beh bia̍t in; thâi-lâng kap kan-chà--ê, lóng sī Siōng Chú só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
M̄-kú in-ūi lí hong-sēng ê chû-ài, góa ōe-tàng ji̍p lí ê tiān, sim chûn kèng-ùi, tī lí ê sèng-tiān kèng-pài.
Siōng Chú ah, tùi-te̍k teh tng-tán góa, kiû lí chiàu lí ê kong-gī, chhōa góa kiâⁿ chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘.
In ê chhùi bô láu-si̍t, in ê sim ok-to̍k móa-móa, in ê nâ-âu sī khui-khui ê bōng, in ê chi̍h gâu phô͘-tháⁿ.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí tēng in ê chōe, hō͘ in hām-lo̍h ka-kī ê kè-bô͘; in-ūi in pōe-poān lí, chōe-kò chin tāng, kiû lí kā in kóaⁿ-chhut.

Só͘-ū chhē lí chòe pī-lān-só͘--ê, kiû lí hō͘ in hoaⁿ-hí, hō͘ in hoaⁿ-hí chhut-siaⁿ bô-thêng, in-ūi lí pì-iū in. Goān hiah-ê ì-ài lí ê miâ ê lâng lóng in-ūi lí hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
Siōng Chú ah, lí beh sù-hok hō͘ gī-lâng; lí beh ēng un-hūi, chhin-chhiūⁿ tún-pâi sì-bīn ûi in.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí m̄-thang siū-khì chek-pī góa, m̄-thang hoat tōa siū-khì chek-hoa̍t góa.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí khó-lîn góa, in-ūi góa soe-lám; Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí i-tī góa, in-ūi góa ê kut-thâu gi̍h-gi̍h-chùn.
Góa ê sim hui-siông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; Siōng Chú ah, lí tī-sî chiah beh kiù góa?
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí oa̍t tò-tńg lâi kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā, kiû lí in-ūi lí ê chû-ài, chín-kiù góa.
In-ūi sí-lâng bōe kì-liām lí; tī Im-hú, siáⁿ-lâng ōe kám-siā lí?
Góa in-ūi haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan ià-siān; góa ta̍k-mî lâu ba̍k-sái im góa ê bîn-chhn̂g, sip-tâm góa ê chhn̂g-pho͘.
Góa in-ūi iu-būn ba̍k-chiu phah-pháiⁿ, in-ūi tùi-te̍k chōe, ba̍k-chiu hoe.
Lín chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng lóng tio̍h lī-khui góa, in-ūi Siōng Chú ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ góa thî-khàu ê siaⁿ.
Siōng Chú ū thiaⁿ góa ê khún-kiû; Siōng Chú beh chiap-la̍p góa ê kî-tó.
Góa ê tùi-te̍k lóng ōe kiàn-siàu tōa kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; in ōe hut-jiân kiàn-siàu thiat-thè.
Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí chòe góa ê pī-lān-só͘ pó-hō͘ góa; kiû lí kái-kiù góa thoat-lī it-chhè tui-kóaⁿ góa ê lâng!
Nā bô, in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ sai thiah-li̍h góa, thiah kah chhùi-kô͘-kô͘ mā bô lâng thang kiù góa.

Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, góa ê chhiú nā ū chòe m̄-tio̍h, ū tùi pêng-iú ēng pháiⁿ pò hó, á-sī bô-iân-bô-kò͘ chhiúⁿ-toa̍t te̍k-tùi góa ê lâng; góa nā ū chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì,
chiū chhut-chāi tùi-te̍k jip góa, kàu lia̍h-tio̍h góa, chiong góa ê sìⁿ-miā ta̍h tī thô͘-kha, chiong góa ê chun-giâm pìⁿ-chòe thô͘-hún.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí khí--lâi, hoat-chhut siū-khì, khiā khí-lâi tùi-hù góa tùi-te̍k ê tōa siū-khì; kiû lí ūi-tio̍h góa chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, chiàu lí ê chí-ì sím-phòaⁿ.
Goān bān-bîn lóng chū-chi̍p tī lí chiu-ûi; goān lí chē tī pó-chō tī-lí in.
Siōng Chú sím-phòaⁿ bān-bîn. Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí chhâi-phòaⁿ, phòaⁿ góa chòe gī, tēng góa bô chōe.
Kiû lí hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng bōe koh chòe pháiⁿ, hō͘ gī-lâng khiā-chāi; in-ūi kong-gī ê Siōng-tè kàm-chhat lâng ê sim-tn̂g.
Siōng-tè sī góa ê tún-pâi; I chín-kiù sim chèng-ti̍t ê lâng.
Siōng-tè sī kong-gī ê sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ; I ta̍k-ji̍t tùi put-gī ê lâng hoat siū-khì.
Lâng nā m̄ hoán-hóe, I ōe bôa I ê to, giú-khui I ê keng chún-pī hó-sè.
I chún-pī tì-miā ê bú-khì; I siā--ê sī hé ê chìⁿ.
Lí khòaⁿ, pháiⁿ-lâng tô͘-bô͘ siâ-ok, hoâi-īn to̍k-hāi, siⁿ-chhut kan-chà.
I ó͘ khut, ku̍t hō͘ i chhim, kèng-jiân poa̍h-lo̍h ka-kī siat ê hām-chíⁿ.
I ê to̍k-hāi ōe tò-tńg kàu ka-kī ê thâu-khak; i ê kiông-pō ōe lak tī ka-kī ê thâu-khak téng.
Góa beh in-ūi Siōng Chú ê kong-gī kám-siā I; góa beh chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — Chì-koân Siōng-tè ê miâ.
Siōng Chú — goán ê Chú ah, lí ê ui-giâm phó͘-ki̍p choân-tōe! Chheng-chàn lí ê siaⁿ thàu kàu thiⁿ-téng,
tùi gín-á kap eⁿ-á ê chhùi chhiùⁿ--chhut-lâi. Lí khí-chō iàu-sài hông-pī te̍k-jîn, beh siau-bia̍t tùi-te̍k, siau-tû oan-siû.
Khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí chhin-chhiú chhòng-chō ê thiⁿ, lí só͘ an-pâi ê ge̍h-niû, chhiⁿ-sîn,
ah, lâng sǹg sím-mi̍h, lí hiah-ni̍h koan-sim? Sè-kan-lâng sǹg sím-mi̍h, lí hiah-ni̍h chiàu-kò͘?
Lí hō͘ i pí thiⁿ-sài sió-khóa khah kē; lí sù êng-kng chun-kùi chòe hoa-koan kā i tì.
Lí chí-phài i koán-lí lí chhin-chhiú chhòng-chō ê bān-mi̍h; lí hō͘ i ū koân-pèng chi-phòe it-chhè:
It-chhè ê iûⁿ kap gû, soaⁿ-iá ê cháu-siù,
khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu, hái-iûⁿ ê hî-lūi kap oa̍h-mi̍h.
Siōng Chú — goán ê Chú ah, lí ê ui-giâm phó͘-ki̍p choân-tōe!
Siōng Chú ah, góa beh choân-sim kám-siā lí; góa beh pò-iông lí it-chhè kî-biāu ê chok-ûi.
Góa beh in-ūi lí hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k; Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè ah, góa beh chheng-chàn lí ê miâ.
Góa ê tùi-te̍k oa̍t-tńg-sin thiat-thè poa̍h-tó, lóng tī lí ê bīn-chêng bia̍t-bông.
Lí ū thòe góa sin-oan, thòe góa piān-hō͘; lí chē tī pó-chō, chiàu kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ.
Lí chek-pī lia̍t-pang, hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng bia̍t-bông; lí éng-oán chhat-siau in ê miâ.
Tùi-te̍k siū húi-bia̍t, éng-oán hong-hòe; lí húi-hoāi in ê siâⁿ, bô lâng koh ōe-kì-tit in.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú chē-ūi choh-ông kàu éng-oán; I í-keng an-tì I ê pó-chō beh sím-phòaⁿ.
I beh chiàu kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ sè-kan, chiàu chèng-ti̍t chhâi-phòaⁿ bān-bîn.
Siōng Chú sī siū ap-pek ê lâng ê iàu-sài, sī in hoān-lān ê sî ê pī-lān-só͘.
Bat lí ê miâ ê lâng ōe óa-khò lí; in-ūi Siōng Chú, lí m̄-bat khì-sak chhē-kiû lí ê lâng.
Tio̍h chheng-chàn tī Sek-an choh-ông ê Siōng Chú, chiong I ê chok-ûi pò-iông tī bān-bîn ê tiong-kan.
In-ūi I bô bōe-kì-tit khùn-khó͘ ê lâng, ūi lâng sin-oan ê Siōng-tè ōe thiaⁿ in ê ai-kiû.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí lîn-bín góa, lí ū tùi sí-bông ê mn̂g kiù góa chhut--lâi; kiû lí kàm-chhat oàn-hūn góa ê lâng án-chóaⁿ teh khó͘-chhó͘ góa,
hō͘ góa thang kóng-khí lí it-chhè thang o-ló ê tāi-chì. Góa beh tī Sek-an ê siâⁿ-mn̂g ūi-tio̍h lí ê chín-kiù hoan-ho͘.
Lia̍t-pang poa̍h-lo̍h ka-kī só͘ ku̍t ê hām-khiⁿ; in ê kha tîⁿ tī in pì-bi̍t tiuⁿ ê lô-bāng.
Siōng Chú í-keng hián-bêng ka-kī, si-hêng sím-phòaⁿ; pháiⁿ-lâng hō͘ ka-kī chhiú ê só͘-chòe tîⁿ--tio̍h.
Pháiⁿ-lâng lóng ōe lo̍h Im-hú; m̄ jīn Siōng-tè ê lia̍t-pang mā ōe án-ni.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng it-tēng bōe éng-oán hō͘ Siōng-tè bōe-kì--tit; khùn-khó͘-lâng ê ǹg-bāng it-tēng bōe éng-oán bô--khì.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí khí--lâi, m̄-thang hō͘ lâng khah iâⁿ; kiû lí hō͘ lia̍t-pang tī lí ê bīn-chêng siū sím-phòaⁿ.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí hō͘ in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, hō͘ lia̍t-pang chai ka-kī put-kò sī ōe-sí ê lâng nā-tiāⁿ.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ná ōe khiā-hn̄g-hn̄g? Hoān-lān ê sî, lí ná ōe bih--teh m̄ chhap goán?
Pháiⁿ-lâng kiau-ngō͘ hong-kông, kā khùn-khó͘ ê lâng jip-tiâu-tiâu; tio̍h hō͘ in hām-lo̍h ka-kī só͘ siat ê kè-bô͘.
Pháiⁿ-lâng khoa-kháu in sim-lāi ê io̍k-bōng; tham-sim ê lâng siat-to̍k Siōng Chú, biáu-sī I.
Pháiⁿ-lâng kiau-ngō͘, sim-tiong bô Siōng-tè, kóng, “Siōng Chú bōe tui-kiù.”
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê só͘-chòe sū-sū sūn-lī; Siōng-tè ê sím-phòaⁿ, in bô khàn-chāi-gán-lāi. Só͘-ū ê tùi-te̍k, in lóng biáu-sī.
Pháiⁿ-lâng sim-lāi kóng, “Goán it-tēng bōe sit-pāi, sè-sè-tāi-tāi bōe tú-tio̍h chai-lān.”
Pháiⁿ-lâng móa-chhùi chiù-mē, kan-chà, khióng-hat; in ê chi̍h ok-to̍k, hu-ké.
In tī chng-lāi bâi-ho̍k teh tng-tán, ba̍k-chiu ti̍t-ti̍t teh siòng bô i-óa ê lâng; in bih tī ún-ba̍t ê só͘-chāi beh sat-hāi bû-ko͘ ê lâng.
In bâi-ho̍k tī ún-ba̍t ê só͘-chāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ sai bih tī hia̍t--ni̍h, tng-tán beh lia̍h sàn-chhiah-lâng, ēng bāng kā in bāng--teh thoa--khì.
In khut-teh tng-tán, hō͘ bô i-óa ê lâng hām-lo̍h in ê jiáu-gê.
In sim-lāi kóng, “Siōng-tè bōe-kì--tit; I ng I ê bīn, éng-oán bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.”
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí khiā--khí-lâi, Siōng-tè ah, gia̍h-khí lí ê chhiú; m̄-thang bōe-kì-tit sàn-chhiah-lâng.
Pháiⁿ-lâng sī-án-chóaⁿ biáu-sī Siōng-tè, sim-lāi kóng I bōe tui-kiù?

Siōng Chú, lí ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, ok-to̍k, oàn-tò͘, lí lóng ū teh kàm-chhat; lí beh ēng lí ê chhiú pò-èng. Bô i-óa ê lâng chiong pún-sin kau-tài lí; lí it-ti̍t ū teh pang-chān ko͘-jî.
Goān lí phah-tn̄g pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhiú-kut; goān lí thiat-tóe tui-kiù in ê pháiⁿ.
Siōng Chú choh-ông, tùi éng-oán kàu éng-oán; lia̍t-pang lóng tùi I ê tōe siau-bia̍t.
Siōng Chú ah, sàn-chhiah-lâng ê sim-goān, lí ōe thiaⁿ; lí beh chòng in ê táⁿ, àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ in ê kî-kiû.
Lí beh thòe ko͘-jî kap siū ap-pek ê lâng sin-oan, hō͘ sè-kan-lâng bô koh khióng-hat in.
Siōng Chú sī góa ê pī-lān-só͘; lín sī-án-chóaⁿ tùi góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ chiáu pe-khì soaⁿ-lāi.
Khòaⁿ ah, pháiⁿ-lâng áu-keng, an in ê chìⁿ tī keng-hiân, beh àm-tiong siā sim chèng-ti̍t ê lâng.
Tōe-ki pang--khì, gī-lâng iáu ōe-tàng chòe sím-mi̍h?”
Siōng Chú tī I ê sèng-tiān; Siōng Chú ê pó-chō tī thiⁿ--ni̍h. I ê ba̍k-chiu teh khòaⁿ, kim-kim teh kàm-chhat sè-kan-lâng.
Siōng Chú khó-giām gī-lâng; pháiⁿ-lâng kap ài kiông-pō ê lâng, I iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
I hō͘ teh to̍h ê hé-thòaⁿ kàng-lo̍h tī pháiⁿ-lâng sin-chiūⁿ, ēng hé-iām, liû-hông, kap iām-jia̍t ê hong chòe in èng-siū ê pò-èng.
Siōng Chú kong-gī, I ài kong-gī; chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ōe kìⁿ-tio̍h I ê bīn.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí chín-kiù. Khiân-sêng ê lâng bô--khì lah; sè-kan tiong-sìn ê lâng choa̍t-bia̍t lah.
Lâng-lâng tùi chhù-piⁿ kóng pe̍h-chha̍t; in kóng phô͘-tháⁿ ê ōe, chhùi kóng chi̍t khoán, sim siūⁿ chi̍t khoán.
Kiû Siōng Chú hong-ba̍t phô͘-tháⁿ ê chhùi-tûn, koah-tn̄g kóng tōa-ōe ê chi̍h.
In kóng, “Goán beh khò chhùi-chi̍h khah iâⁿ; chhùi-tûn sī goán ê, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kā goán khòng-chè?”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Ūi-tio̍h khùn-khó͘-lâng ê óng-khut, kap sàn-chhiah-lâng ê thó͘-khùi, taⁿ góa beh khí--lâi, kā in an-tì tī in chhiat-chhiat him-bō͘ an-choân ê só͘-chāi.”
Siōng Chú ê ōe sûn-choân, chhin-chhiūⁿ gûn tī thô͘ chō ê hé-lô͘ liān chhit piàn.

Bô lō͘-ēng ê lâng hō͘ sè-kan-lâng khòaⁿ-tāng; pháiⁿ-lâng ta̍k só͘-chāi ui-hong sáng-sè. Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí pó-hō͘ goán, pì-iū goán éng-oán thoat-lī chit sè-tāi ê lâng.
Siōng Chú ah, lí bōe-kì-tit góa beh jōa kú? Kàu éng-oán sī--bô? Lí bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ khòaⁿ góa beh jōa kú?
Góa jím-siū khó͘-thàng, kui-ji̍t sim iu-siong tio̍h kàu jōa kú? Góa ê tùi-te̍k ko-seng iâⁿ-kè góa tio̍h kàu jōa kú?
Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí khòaⁿ-kò͘ góa, ìn-tap góa, hō͘ góa ê ba̍k-chiu kim-kim, chiah bián góa khùn kàu sí--khì,
chiah bián góa ê tùi-te̍k kóng “Góa khah iâⁿ i”, chiah bián góa ê te̍k-jîn tī góa sit-pāi ê sî hoaⁿ-hí.
M̄-kú góa óa-khò lí ê chû-ài; góa ê sim in-ūi lí ê chín-kiù khoài-lo̍k.
Góa beh chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, in-ūi I ēng hong-sēng ê un-tián tùi-thāi góa.
Gōng-lâng sim-lāi kóng, “Bô Siōng-tè!” In lóng hú-pāi, chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê tāi-chì, bô kah chi̍t ê chòe hó.
Siōng Chú tùi thiⁿ àⁿ lo̍h-lâi khòaⁿ sè-kan-lâng, beh khòaⁿ ū bêng-lí, ū chhē-kiû Siōng-tè ê lâng á bô.
In lóng kiâⁿ bê-lō͘, pîⁿ-pîⁿ pìⁿ-chòe ù-òe; bô lâng chòe hó, liân chi̍t ê to bô.
Chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng kiám lóng m̄ chai? In thun-chia̍h góa ê chú-bîn chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chia̍h-pn̄g; in bô kiû-kiò Siōng Chú.
Chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng ōe tōa kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; in-ūi Siōng-tè tī gī-lâng ê tiong-kan.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng ê kè-ōe, lín hō͘ in sit-pāi, m̄-kú Siōng Chú sī in ê pī-lān-só͘.
Goān Í-sek-lia̍t ê chín-kiù tùi Sek-an chhut! Goān Siōng Chú chhōa I siū-lia̍h ê chú-bîn tò-tńg--lâi! Hit-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t ōe hoaⁿ-hí, Ngá-kok ōe khoài-lo̍k!
Siōng Chú ah, sím-mi̍h khoán lâng ōe-tàng tòa tī lí ê pò͘-pîⁿ? Sím-mi̍h khoán lâng ōe-tàng khiā-khí tī lí ê sèng-soaⁿ?
Chiū-sī hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t, choh-sū kong-gī, tùi sim-tóe kóng chin-si̍t ê lâng.
I bô ēng chhùi-chi̍h tiòng-siong lâng; i bô hām-hāi pêng-iú, bô sì-kòe chō-iâu húi-pòng chhù-piⁿ.
I ê ba̍k-chiu biáu-sī choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng, m̄-kú chun-tiōng kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê lâng. I chiù-chōa, sui-jiân ka-kī khek-khui mā bô kái-piàn.
I chîⁿ chioh--lâng m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h lī-sek; i bô siu hóe-lō͘ hām-hāi bû-ko͘ ê lâng. Chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì ê lâng ōe éng-oán khiā-chāi.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí pó-hō͘ góa, in-ūi lí sī góa ê pī-lān-só͘.
Góa bat tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí sī góa ê Chú; chí-ū lí sī góa hēng-hok ê goân-thâu.”
Tōe-chiūⁿ ê sèng-tô͘ si̍t-chāi chin chun-kùi; kap in chòe-hé sī góa siōng-tōa ê hoaⁿ-hí.
Khì tè pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng ê lâng it-tēng ke-thiⁿ thòng-khó͘! Góa m̄ chham-ú in ê hiàn-chè, mā m̄ kèng-pài in ê sîn-bêng.
Siōng Chú, lí sī góa ê sán-gia̍p, góa ê hok-poe; lí kò͘-siú góa èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h.
Lí chiong chin súi ê thó͘-tōe pun hō͘ góa; góa tit--tio̍h ê sán-gia̍p si̍t-chāi chin hó!
Góa beh chheng-chàn kà-sī góa ê Siōng Chú; mî--sî, góa ê sim chí-tiám góa.
Góa put-sî kám-siū Siōng Chú ê tông-chāi; I tī góa ê chiàⁿ-pêng, góa bōe tōng-iâu.
Só͘-í, góa ê sim hoaⁿ-hí, góa ê sîn khoài-lo̍k; góa ê jio̍k-thé an-jiân chū-chāi.
In-ūi lí bōe kā góa pàng-sak tī Im-hú, mā bōe hō͘ lí tiong-sêng ê chú-bîn lo̍h-khì Chhim-ian.
Lí ōe chí-sī góa oa̍h-miā ê tō-lō͘. Tī lí bīn-chêng, góa ū móa-móa ê hoaⁿ-hí; tī lí chiàⁿ-pêng, góa ū éng-oán ê khoài-lo̍k.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ kong-tō ê sò͘-kiû, liû-sim thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó. Góa bô ēng kan-chà ê chhùi-tûn kî-tó, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang lâi thiaⁿ.
Kiû lí ēng ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ-chhut sī-hui; kiû lí phòaⁿ góa bô chōe.
Lí ū khó-giām góa ê sim, liân mî--sî mā kàm-chhat góa; lí ēng hé thoàn-liān góa, bô chhē-tio̍h sím-mi̍h pháiⁿ. Góa li̍p-chì bô hō͘ góa ê chhùi ū kè-sit.
Góa chun-thàn lí só͘ kóng ê ōe, bô chhin-chhiūⁿ pa̍t-lâng ê kiâⁿ-chòe; góa kín-sīn bô kiâⁿ kiông-pō ê lâng ê lō͘.
Góa ê kha it-ti̍t kiâⁿ lí ê lō͘, m̄-bat phian-lī.
Siōng-tè ah, góa kiû-kiò lí, in-ūi lí ōe ìn góa; kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó.
Kiû lí hián-chhut lí kî-biāu put-piàn ê thiàⁿ, ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú kiù óa-khò lí ê lâng thoat-lī in ê tùi-te̍k.
Kiû lí pó-hō͘ góa, chhin-chhiūⁿ pó-hō͘ ba̍k-chiu-jîn, jia-khàm góa tī lí si̍t-ē.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa thoat-lī chhiúⁿ-kiap góa ê pháiⁿ-lâng, thoat-lī ûi-khùn góa beh hāi góa sìⁿ-miā ê tùi-te̍k.
In that-ba̍t lîn-bín ê sim; in ê chhùi kóng kiau-ngō͘ chū-tāi ê ōe.
In tui-jip góa, hiān-chāi ûi-khùn góa; in ti̍t-ti̍t siòng beh kā góa siak-tó tī thô͘-kha.
In chhin-chhiūⁿ sai siàu-siūⁿ beh thiah-chhùi góa, chhin-chhiūⁿ béng-sai bâi-ho̍k teh tng-tán.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí khí-lâi tùi-hù góa ê tùi-te̍k, hō͘ in khut-ho̍k, ēng lí ê to kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī pháiⁿ-lâng.

Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí ēng lí ê chhiú kiù góa thoat-lī sè-kan-lâng, thoat-lī tī hiān-sè hióng-lo̍k ê sè-kan-lâng. Lí ēng lí ê châi-bu̍t tiùⁿ-móa in ê pak-tó͘, liân in ê kiáⁿ-jî mā tiùⁿ kah pá-pá, koh ū chhun, thang lâu hō͘ in ê kiáⁿ-sun.
Nā-sī góa, góa ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê bīn, in-ūi góa ê hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t; góa khùn-chhíⁿ ê sî, lí ê lîm-chāi ōe hō͘ góa boán-chiok.
Siōng Chú — góa ê khùi-la̍t ah, góa kèng-ài lí.

Siōng Chú sī góa ê soaⁿ-giâm, góa ê iàu-sài, góa ê Chín-kiù-chiá; sī góa ê Siōng-tè, góa ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ, góa beh óa-khò I; I sī góa ê tún-pâi, kiù góa ê khùi-la̍t, góa ê pó-lúi.
Góa kiû-kiò eng-kai siū chheng-chàn ê Siōng Chú, góa chiū tit-tio̍h kái-kiù thoat-lī tùi-te̍k.
Sí-bông ê soh tîⁿ góa; húi-bia̍t ê tōa-chúi hō͘ góa kiaⁿ.
Im-hú ê soh khún-pa̍k góa; Sí-bông ê lô-bāng bāng-tio̍h góa.
Góa tī khó͘-lān tiong kî-kiû Siōng Chú, tùi góa ê Siōng-tè kiû-kiò; I tī I ê tiān-lāi thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ; góa tī I bīn-chêng ê khún-kiû ū ji̍p I ê hī-khang.
I siū-khì, tōe chiū iô-choah; soaⁿ ê tōe-ki mā tín-tāng iô koh choah.
Tùi I ê phīⁿ-khang ū ian chhèng-chhut; tùi I ê chhùi ū hé hoat-chhut, liân thô͘-thòaⁿ mā to̍h--khí-lâi.
I thí-khui thiⁿ, chhin-sin kàng-lîm; I kha-ē ū kāu-kāu ê o͘-hûn.
I khiâ thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek teh pe; I chē hong ê si̍t chhiong--lo̍h-lâi.
I ēng o͘-àm chòe I ún-ba̍t ê só͘-chāi, ēng chúi kap ba̍t-hûn ûi khí-lâi chòe tiùⁿ-pâng.
Peng-pha̍uh kap teh to̍h ê thòaⁿ tùi I lîm-chāi ê kng siā--chhut-lâi, tu̍t-phòa o͘-àm ê ba̍t-hûn.
Siōng Chú tùi thiⁿ-téng tân-lûi, Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè chhut-siaⁿ; koh ū lo̍h-pha̍uh kap teh to̍h ê thòaⁿ.
I siā-chìⁿ, hō͘ tùi-te̍k sì-sòaⁿ; I hoat-chhut sih-nà, hō͘ in hūn-loān.
Siōng Chú, lí chi̍t-ē chek-pī, lí phīⁿ-khang ê khùi chi̍t-ē chhut, hái-tóe chiū lō͘-chhut, tāi-tōe ê kun-ki mā lō͘-hiān.
I tùi téng-bīn chhun-chhiú khiú góa, tùi tōa-chúi kā góa kiù--chhut-lâi.
I kiù góa thoat-lī hiong-béng ê tùi-te̍k, thoat-lī oàn-hūn góa ê lâng; in-ūi in pí góa khah kiông.
Góa tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê sî, in lâi kong-kek góa; m̄-kú Siōng Chú sī góa ê óa-khò.
I chhōa góa kàu khui-khoah an-choân ê só͘-chāi; I kiù góa, in-ūi I ì-ài góa.
Siōng Chú in-ūi góa chèng-ti̍t pò-tap góa, in-ūi góa ê só͘-chòe chheng-khì pò-siúⁿ góa.
Góa chun-siú Siōng Chú ê tō-lō͘, m̄-bat choh-pháiⁿ lī-khui góa ê Siōng-tè.
I só͘-ū ê bēng-lēng góa ū chun-siú; I ê kui-lē góa m̄-bat pàng-sak.
Góa tī I ê bīn-chêng bô thang chí-chek; góa pó-siú ka-kī lī-khui chōe-ok.
In-ūi góa chèng-ti̍t, Siōng Chú pò-siúⁿ góa; tī I ê ba̍k-chiu chêng, góa ê só͘-chòe chheng-khì.
Chû-ài ê lâng, lí ēng chû-ài tùi-thāi i; sûn-choân ê lâng, lí ēng sûn-choân tùi-thāi i;
chheng-khì ê lâng, lí ēng chheng-khì tùi-thāi i; m̄-kú, kan-chà ê lâng, lí ēng oan-khiau tùi-thāi i.
Khùn-khó͘ ê lâng, lí kái-kiù i; chū-ko ê lâng, lí kā i kàng-kē.
Lí tiám-to̍h góa ê teng; Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè kā góa ê o͘-àm pìⁿ-chòe kng-bêng.
Góa in-ūi óa-khò lí, ōe-tàng kong-phòa te̍k-kun; óa-khò góa ê Siōng-tè, ōe-tàng thiàu-kè siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ.
Chit-ūi Siōng-tè, I ê tō-lō͘ oân-choân. Siōng Chú ê ōe ū kè hé thoàn-liān; óa-khò I--ê, I chòe tún-pâi pó-hō͘ in.
Siōng Chú í-gōa, kiám ū pa̍t-ê Siōng-tè? Goán ê Siōng-tè í-gōa, kiám ū chio̍h-pôaⁿ thang óa-khò?
Chit-ūi Siōng-tè ēng khùi-la̍t chòe tòa hâ góa ê io; I ín-chhōa góa kiâⁿ an-choân ê lō͘.
I hō͘ góa ê kha chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k gâu cháu, koh hō͘ góa khiā-chāi tī koân ê só͘-chāi.
I hùn-liān góa ê chhiú gâu kau-chiàn, hō͘ góa ê chhiú ōe khui tâng ê keng.
Lí ēng tún-pâi kái-kiù góa, ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú hû-chhî góa. Lí koàn-kò͘ góa, hō͘ góa ko-seng chòe tōa.
Lí hō͘ góa ta̍h ê tōe khui-khoah an-choân; góa ê kha m̄-bat ta̍h-thu̍t.
Góa tui góa ê tùi-te̍k kàu jip--tio̍h in; in bô bia̍t-bông, góa bōe tò-tńg.
Góa phah in thiám-thiám, hō͘ in peh bōe khí--lâi, kàu in tó tī góa ê kha-ē.
Lí sù góa khùi-la̍t hō͘ góa gâu kau-chiàn; lí hō͘ kong-kek góa ê lâng lóng hâng-ho̍k tī góa ē-bīn.
Lí hō͘ góa ê tùi-te̍k oa̍t-tńg-sin tô-cháu, koh hō͘ góa châu-bia̍t oàn-hūn góa ê lâng.
In kiû-kiò, bô lâng kiù in; kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, I mā bô ìn.
Góa kā in tûi kàu chhùi-chhùi, chhin-chhiūⁿ thô͘-hún hō͘ hong chhe-sòaⁿ, kā in piàⁿ-chhut, chhin-chhiūⁿ koe-lō͘ ê thô͘-bê.
Lí kiù góa thoat-lī hoán-poān góa ê jîn-bîn; lí siat-li̍p góa chòe lia̍t-pang ê thâu. Góa m̄-bat ê jîn-bîn ōe ho̍k-sāi góa;
gōa-pang ê lâng khut-sin tâu-hâng, in chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê miâ chiū sūn-ho̍k.
Gōa-pang ê lâng sit-táⁿ, kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah kiâⁿ-chhut in ê tīn-tōe.
Siōng Chú éng-oán oa̍h--teh! Goān góa óa-khò ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ siū chheng-chàn; goān kiù góa ê Siōng-tè siū ko-kú.
I chiū-sī ūi góa sin-oan hit-ūi Siōng-tè; I hō͘ chèng-lâng hâng-ho̍k tī góa kha-ē.
I kiù góa thoat-lī góa ê tùi-te̍k. Siōng Chú ah, lí thê-poa̍t góa koân-kè kong-kek góa ê lâng; lí kiù góa thoat-lī kiông-pō ê lâng.
Siōng Chú ah, in-ūi án-ni góa beh tī lia̍t-pang tiong kám-siā lí, chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí ê miâ.
Siōng Chú sù ke̍k-tōa ê kiù-un hō͘ I siat-li̍p ê ông, si-lo̍h chû-ài hō͘ I boah-iû soán-li̍p ê lâng, hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t kap i ê hō͘-tāi, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
Thiⁿ soan-pò͘ Siōng-tè ê êng-iāu; kiong-chhong thoân-iông I ê chok-ûi.
Chit-ji̍t tùi hit-ji̍t kóng-ōe; chit-mî tùi hit-mî thoân-pò͘ tì-sek;
bô-giân-bô-gú, bô-siaⁿ-bô-seh.
In ê siaⁿ-im thoân kàu choân sè-kài; in ê giân-sû thoân kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak. Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h ji̍t-thâu tī thiⁿ-téng tah pò͘-pîⁿ.
Ji̍t-thâu chhin-chhiūⁿ sin-lông tùi tōng-pông chhut--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ soán-chhiú ióng-io̍k cháu i ê lō͘-thêng,
tùi thiⁿ ê chit-pêng chhut--lâi, se̍h kàu hit-pêng, jia̍t-khì phó͘-ki̍p bān-mi̍h.
Siōng Chú ê Lu̍t-hoat oân-choân, hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h sin ê khùi-la̍t. Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng khó-khò, hō͘ bô tì-sek ê lâng tit-tio̍h tì-hūi.
Siōng Chú ê lu̍t-lē kong-chèng, hō͘ lâng ê sim hoaⁿ-hí. Siōng Chú ê kài-bēng sûn-kiat, hō͘ lâng ê ba̍k-chiu kng-bêng.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú sī sûn-chin, éng-oán bô kái-piàn; Siōng Chú ê phòaⁿ-toàn chin-si̍t, oân-choân kong-tō,
pí kim, pí chin chōe sûn-kim khah kùi-tiōng; pí bi̍t, pí sûn ê phang-bi̍t koh-khah tiⁿ.
Lu̍t-hoat hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn tit-tio̍h kéng-kài; siú kài-bēng chiū ū tōa pò-siúⁿ.
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe chai ka-kī ê chhò-gō͘? Kiû lí sià-bián góa bô-ì-tiong hoān ê kè-sit!
Kiû lí pó-siú lí ê po̍k-jîn, hō͘ i bōe kò͘-ì hoān-chōe; kiû lí m̄-thang iông-ún chōe-ok koán-hat góa, góa chiū chiâⁿ-chòe bô thang chí-chek ê lâng, bōe hoān tāng-chōe.
Siōng Chú — góa ê pī-lān-só͘, góa ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú ah, goān góa ê chhùi só͘ kóng--ê ha̍h lí ê chí-ì; goān góa ê sim só͘ siūⁿ--ê tit-tio̍h lí chiap-la̍p.
Goān Siōng Chú tī hoān-lān ê ji̍t ìn-tap lí; goān Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè kā lí khǹg tī koân ê só͘-chāi pó-hō͘ lí.
Goān I tùi sèng-só͘ pang-chān lí, tùi Sek-an hû-chhî lí.
Goān I ōe-kì-tit lí it-chhè ê sò͘-chè, chiap-la̍p lí ê sio-hòa-chè.
Goān I chiàu lí ê sim só͘ ài sù hō͘ lí, sêng-choân lí it-chhè ê kè-ōe.
Goán beh in-ūi lí ê tek-sèng chhiùⁿ-koa; goán beh hōng Siōng-tè ê miâ khèng-chiok lí ê sèng-lī. Goān Siōng Chú sêng-choân lí it-chhè ê kî-kiû.
Taⁿ góa chai Siōng Chú ōe kiù I soán-li̍p ê ông, ōe tùi I sèng ê thiⁿ ìn-tap ông; ēng I chiàⁿ-chhiú ê khùi-la̍t hō͘ i tōa sèng-lī.
Ū lâng óa-khò chhia, ū lâng óa-khò bé; m̄-kú goán chí-ū beh khoa-kháu Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ê miâ.
In ōe thâi-su tó--lo̍h-khì; goán ōe thâi-iâⁿ khiā-chāi-chāi.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí hō͘ goán ê ông sèng-lī; goán kiû-kiò ê sî, kiû lí ìn-tap.
Siōng Chú ah, ông ōe in-ūi lí hō͘ i ê khùi-la̍t hoaⁿ-hí, ōe in-ūi lí hō͘ i ê sèng-lī hui-siông khoài-lo̍k!
I ê sim ì-ài--ê, lí í-keng ū hō͘ i; i ê chhùi só͘ kiû--ê, lí lóng ū tah-èng.
In-ūi lí ēng tōa hok-khì teh gêng-chiap i, ēng sûn-kim ê ông-koan tì tī i ê thâu-khak.
I tùi lí kiû oa̍h-miā, lí ū hō͘ i, hō͘ i ê hè-siū kú-kú-tn̂g-tn̂g.
I in-ūi lí hō͘ i ê sèng-lī tit-tio̍h tōa êng-kng; lí chiong chun-kùi ui-giâm sù hō͘ i.
Lí hō͘ i ū tōa hok-khì kàu éng-oán, hō͘ i tī lí ê bīn-chêng hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
In-ūi ông óa-khò Siōng Chú, koh in-ūi Chì-koân Siōng-tè ê chû-ài, i ê ông-ūi éng-oán ún-kò͘.
Ông ê chhiú ōe lia̍h-tio̍h it-chhè ê tùi-te̍k; i ê chiàⁿ-chhiú ōe lia̍h-tio̍h só͘-ū oàn-hūn i ê lâng.

I chi̍t-ē chhut-hiān, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ iām-jia̍t ê hé-lô͘ kā in sio-bia̍t. Siōng Chú ah, lí chi̍t-ē chhut-hiān, beh tī tōa siū-khì tiong kā in thun--lo̍h-khì, beh ēng hé kā in sio-bia̍t.
In ê kiáⁿ-sun ōe tùi tōe-chiūⁿ siū châu-bia̍t; in ê hō͘-tāi ōe tùi lâng ê tiong-kan siau-sit.
In beh ēng im-bô͘ hām-hāi ông, m̄-kú in ê kè-bô͘ bōe sêng-kong.
Lí beh hō͘ in oa̍t-tńg-sin tô-cháu, beh khui keng siā in.
Siōng Chú ah, khí--lâi, hián-sī lí ê khùi-la̍t; goán beh gîm-si chheng-chàn lí ê tōa koân-lêng.
Góa ê Siōng-tè, góa ê Siōng-tè, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ pàng-sak góa? Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ lī góa hn̄g-hn̄g m̄ kiù góa, m̄ thiaⁿ góa ê âu-kiò?
Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, góa ji̍t--sî kiû-kiò, lí bô ìn góa; góa mî--sî kiû-kiò, bô tit-tio̍h an-lêng.
Lí sī sèng ê Siōng-tè, lí ēng Í-sek-lia̍t ê chheng-chàn chòe pó-chō.
Goán ê lia̍t-chó͘ óa-khò lí; in óa-khò lí, lí ū kái-kiù in.
In ai-kiû lí, ū tit-tio̍h chín-kiù; in óa-khò lí, lí bô hō͘ in sit-bāng.
M̄-kú góa m̄-sī lâng, sī thâng-thōa, hō͘ lâng ki-chhì, siū chèng-lâng khòaⁿ-khin.
Khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê lâng lóng kā góa thí-chhiò, ngiauh-chhùi hàiⁿ-thâu, kóng,
“Lí chiong pún-sin kau-tài Siōng Chú, I ná bô lâi kiù lí? Kì-jiân Siōng Chú kah-ì lí, I ná bô lâi kiù lí?”
Lí tùi bú-thai kā góa chiap--chhut-lâi; lí hō͘ góa tī lāu-bú ê heng-chêng tit-tio̍h an-ún.
