Góa tùi chhut bú-thai chiū kau-thok lí, tùi góa chhut-sì, lí chiū-sī góa ê Siōng-tè.
Kiû lí m̄-thang lī góa hn̄g-hn̄g, in-ūi hoān-lān pek-kūn, bô lâng pang-chān góa.
Ū chin chōe gû-káng pau-ûi góa; Pa-san ê iá-gû sì-bīn ûi-khùn góa.
In chhin-chhiūⁿ sai khui-chhùi tōa-siaⁿ háu, beh thiah-li̍h thun-chia̍h góa.
Góa ê khùi-la̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi piàⁿ-liáu-liáu; góa ê kut-thâu lóng thu̍t-lûn; góa ê sim chhin-chhiūⁿ la̍h tī pak-lāi siau-iûⁿ.
Góa ê cheng-le̍k ta--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ phòa--khì ê hiā-phìⁿ; góa ê chi̍h liâm tī téng-kiuⁿ bōe kóng-ōe; lí kā góa pàng tī thô͘-kha, chhut-chāi góa sí.
Pháiⁿ-lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-kûn káu pau-ûi góa, chhin-chhiūⁿ sai thiah-li̍h góa ê kha, góa ê chhiú.
Góa ê kut-thâu lóng ōe-sǹg--tit; in teh khòaⁿ góa, teh siòng góa.
In pun góa ê gōa-phàu, ūi-tio̍h góa ê saⁿ thiu-chhiam.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí m̄-thang lī góa hn̄g-hn̄g; Siōng-tè — góa ê khùi-la̍t ah, kiû lí kín lâi pang-chān góa.
Kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī to-kiàm, kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī káu ê sè-le̍k.
Kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī sai ê chhùi; lí í-keng ū thiaⁿ góa, hō͘ góa thoat-lī iá-gû ê kak.
Góa beh tùi góa ê hiaⁿ-tī pò-iông lí ê miâ; góa beh tī chū-hōe tiong o-ló lí.
Lín kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê, tio̍h chheng-chàn I. Í-sek-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi, tio̍h kui êng-kng hō͘ I; Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi, lóng tio̍h kèng-ùi I.
In-ūi I bōe khòaⁿ-khin sàn-chhiah-lâng, bōe bû-sī in ê khùn-khó͘, mā bōe bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ chhap in; in kiû-kiò ê sî, Siōng Chú ū kā in thiaⁿ.
Góa beh tī tōa chū-hōe tiong chheng-chàn lí ê só͘-chòe; góa beh tī kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê lâng bīn-chêng siā góa ê goān.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng ōe tit-tio̍h pá-chiok; chhē-kiû Siōng Chú ê lâng ōe chheng-chàn I. Goān lín ê sim éng-oán ū oa̍h-khì!
Tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ê lâng lóng ōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú ê só͘-chòe lâi kui-sūn I; sè-chiūⁿ bān-cho̍k lóng ōe tī I bīn-chêng kèng-pài.
In-ūi chú-koân sio̍k tī Siōng Chú, I sī bān-kok ê chú-cháiⁿ.
Tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū hù-kùi ê lâng ōe chū-chi̍p lim-chia̍h, kèng-pài; liân teh-beh sí, teh-beh kui-thó͘ ê lâng to ōe tī I bīn-chêng kūi-pài.
In ê kiáⁿ-sun ōe ho̍k-sāi I; Chú ê chok-ûi ōe thoân kàu in ê hō͘-tāi.
Lâng ōe tùi chiong-lâi beh chhut-sì ê chú-bîn kóng, “Chú í-keng oân-sêng I ê chín-kiù.”
Siōng Chú sī góa ê bo̍k-chiá, góa bô khiàm pòaⁿ-hāng.
I hō͘ góa tó tī chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chháu-po͘, chhōa góa kàu chheng-chēng ê chúi-piⁿ.
I hō͘ góa sin ê khùi-la̍t, ūi-tio̍h I ê miâ chhōa góa kiâⁿ chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘.
Góa sui-jiân keng-kè sí-ìm ê soaⁿ-kok, mā m̄ kiaⁿ chai-hāi, in-ūi lí kap góa tông-chāi; lí ê kùn, lí ê koáiⁿ hō͘ góa an-ún chū-chāi.
Tī góa tùi-te̍k ê bīn-chêng, lí ūi-tio̍h góa pâi-siat iàn-se̍k; lí ēng iû boah góa ê thâu-khak, khoán-thāi góa choh kùi-pin, thîn góa ê poe kàu móa--chhut-lâi.
Lí ê un-tián chû-ài it-tēng chi̍t-sì-lâng kap góa chòe phōaⁿ; góa beh éng-oán tòa tī Siōng Chú lí ê chhù.
Tōe kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê bān-mi̍h lóng sio̍k Siōng Chú; Sè-kài kap tiàm tī hia ê oa̍h-mi̍h mā lóng sio̍k I.
I kā tōe khǹg tī tōa-hái ê téng-bīn, chiong tōe-ki hē tī chhim-hái.
Sím-mi̍h khoán lâng ōe-tàng chiūⁿ Siōng Chú ê soaⁿ? Sím-mi̍h khoán lâng ōe-tàng ji̍p I ê sèng-tiān?
Chiū-sī chhiú chheng-khì, sim sûn-kiat, bô pài ngó͘-siōng, bô sûi-piān chiù-chōa ê lâng.
Chit-khoán lâng ōe siū Siōng Chú chiok-hok; Siōng-tè beh chín-kiù i, soan-phòaⁿ i bô chōe.
Chit-khoán lâng chhē-kiû Siōng Chú, kàu Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng lâi tiâu-kìⁿ I.
Siâⁿ-mn̂g ah, tio̍h phah-khui! Éng-oán ê mn̂g ah, tio̍h tōa khui! Êng-iāu ê Kun-ông beh ji̍p--lâi.
Chit-ūi Êng-iāu ê Kun-ông sī sím-mi̍h-lâng? Sī kiông koh ióng ê Siōng Chú! I sī pek-chiàn-pek-sèng ê Siōng Chú!
Siâⁿ-mn̂g ah, tio̍h phah-khui! Éng-oán ê mn̂g ah, tio̍h tōa khui! Êng-iāu ê Kun-ông beh ji̍p--lâi.
Chit-ūi Êng-iāu ê Kun-ông sī sím-mi̍h-lâng? Sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe! I sī Êng-iāu ê Kun-ông!
Siōng Chú ah, góa ê sim-sîn gióng-bōng lí!
Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, góa sìn-khò lí! M̄-thang hō͘ góa sit-pāi tì-kàu kiàn-siàu; m̄-thang hō͘ góa ê tùi-te̍k in-ūi iâⁿ góa lâi khoa-kháu.
Só͘-ū thèng-hāu lí pang-chān ê lâng it-tēng bōe tì-kàu kiàn-siàu; ōe tú-tio̍h kiàn-siàu--ê sī hiah-ê bô-iân-bô-kò͘ pōe-poān lí ê lâng.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí chiong lí ê lō͘ chí-sī góa, chiong lí ê tō kà-sī góa.
Kiû lí ēng lí ê chin-lí ín-chhōa góa, kà-sī góa, in-ūi lí sī chín-kiù góa ê Siōng-tè. Góa kui-ji̍t thèng-hāu lí.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí ōe-kì-tit lí ê lîn-bín kap chû-ài, in-ūi lí tùi kó͘-chá chiū án-ni tùi-thāi lâng.
Kiû lí m̄-thang kì-tiâu góa siàu-liân ê sî ê chōe-kò kap kè-sit; Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí chiàu lí ê chû-ài, in-ūi lí ê un-hūi ōe-kì-tit góa.
In-ūi Siōng Chú liông-siān koh chèng-ti̍t, I beh chí-sī chōe-jîn kiâⁿ chiàⁿ-lō͘.
I beh ēng kong-pêng ín-chhōa khiam-pi ê lâng, ēng I ê tō-lō͘ kà-sī khiam-sùn ê lâng.
Siú I ê iok kap I ê kài-bēng ê lâng, Siōng Chú lóng ēng chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t khoán-thāi in.
Siōng Chú ah, góa ê chōe chin tāng, kiû lí sià-bián góa.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê lâng, Siōng Chú beh chí-sī i só͘ tio̍h kéng ê lō͘.
I ê sim-sîn ōe tit-tio̍h an-hioh; i ê hō͘-tāi ōe sêng-chiap só͘ èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe.
Siōng Chú kap kèng-ùi I ê lâng chhin-bi̍t, beh chiong I ê iok chí-sī in.
Góa ê ba̍k-chiu put-sî gióng-bōng Siōng Chú, I beh hō͘ góa ê kha thoat-lī lô-bāng.
Kiû lí oa̍t kè-lâi khòaⁿ góa, lîn-bín góa, in-ūi góa ko͘-toaⁿ khùn-khó͘.
Góa sim-lāi ū chin chōe iu-khó͘, kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī lóng-chóng ê hoān-lān.
Kiû lí koan-sim góa ê kan-lân khùn-khó͘, tû-khì góa it-chhè ê chōe.
Lí khòaⁿ, góa ê tùi-te̍k hiah-ni̍h chōe; in chin ok-to̍k oàn-hūn góa.
Kiû lí pó-hō͘ góa ê sìⁿ-miā, chín-kiù góa, hō͘ góa bô sit-pāi tì-kàu kiàn-siàu, in-ūi góa óa-khò lí.
Goān sûn-choân chèng-ti̍t pó-hō͘ góa, in-ūi góa gióng-bōng lí.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kiù-sio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t thoat-lī it-chhè ê chai-lān.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí phòaⁿ góa bô chōe, in-ūi góa ū chiàu chèng-ti̍t teh kiâⁿ. Góa óa-khò Siōng Chú bô tōng-iâu.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí kàm-chhat góa, khó-giām góa; kiû lí chhat-giām góa ê sim-su ì-liām.
In-ūi lí ê chû-ài tī góa ê ba̍k-chiu chêng; góa ū chiàu lí ê chin-lí teh kiâⁿ.
Góa m̄-bat kap hu-ké ê lâng chòe-hé chē, mā m̄-bat kap ké-hó ê lâng tàu-tīn.
Góa iàm-ò͘ⁿ kap pháiⁿ-lâng kiat-tóng, bô ài kap ok-to̍k ê lâng chòe-hé chē.
Siōng Chú ah, góa sóe-chhiú piáu-sī bô chōe, se̍h lí ê chè-tôaⁿ chham-ka lé-pài;
góa ēng kám-siā ê si-koa siōng-chàn, kóng-khí lí it-chhè kî-biāu ê chok-ûi.
Siōng Chú ah, góa ì-ài lí tòa ê chhù, ì-ài lí ê êng-kng lîm-chāi ê só͘-chāi.
M̄-thang chiong góa ê sìⁿ-miā kap chōe-jîn chòe-hé siau-bia̍t; m̄-thang chiong góa ê oa̍h-miā kap thâi-lâng--ê chòe-chi̍t-ē siau-bia̍t.
In ê chhiú put-sî chòe pháiⁿ; in ê chiàⁿ-chhiú ta̍k só͘-chāi siu hóe-lō͘.
Nā-sī góa, góa beh chiàu chèng-ti̍t lâi kiâⁿ; kiû lí kiù-sio̍k góa, lîn-bín góa.
Góa ê kha khiā tī pîⁿ-tháⁿ ê só͘-chāi; góa beh tī tāi-hōe tiong chheng-chàn Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú sī góa ê kng, góa ê chín-kiù, góa iáu tio̍h kiaⁿ siáⁿ-lâng? Siōng Chú sī góa sìⁿ-miā ê pó-chiong, góa iáu tio̍h kiaⁿ siáⁿ-lâng?
Sui-jiân pháiⁿ-lâng kong-kek góa, tùi-te̍k thun-chia̍h góa, in lóng ōe poa̍h-tó sit-pāi.
Sui-jiân tāi-kun chat-iâⁿ pau-ûi, góa ê sim ia̍h bōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. Sui-jiân tùi-te̍k hoat-tōng chiàn-cheng, góa iû-goân an-ún chū-chāi.

Góa tùi Siōng Chú kiû chi̍t hāng tāi-chì, chí-ū tùi I kiû chit-hāng: Hō͘ góa chi̍t-sì-lâng tiàm tī Siōng Chú ê chhù, tī sèng-tiān gióng-bōng I ê êng-kng, chhē-kiû I ê chí-sī.
Góa tú-tio̍h hoān-lān ê sî, I ōe kā góa chhàng tī pò͘-pîⁿ lāi; I ōe pó-hō͘ góa, hō͘ góa bih tī I chhù-lāi. I ōe kā góa khǹg tī chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng,
hō͘ góa ê thâu gia̍h-koân, chhiau-kè pau-ûi góa ê tùi-te̍k. Góa beh tī I ê pò͘-pîⁿ hoan-ho͘ hiàn-chè; góa beh chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú ah, góa kiû-kiò ê siaⁿ kiû lí thiaⁿ, kiû lí lîn-bín góa, ìn-tap góa!
Góa ê sim tùi góa kóng, “Tio̍h lâi tiâu-kìⁿ I.” Siōng Chú ah, góa lâi tiâu-kìⁿ lí.

Kiû lí m̄-thang bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ chhap góa, m̄-thang siū-khì kóaⁿ lí ê po̍k-jîn. Lí it-ti̍t sī góa ê pang-chān. Chín-kiù góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí m̄-thang kū-choa̍t góa, pàng-sak góa.
Siat-sú góa ê pē-bú khì-sak góa, Siōng Chú mā it-tēng ōe siu-liû góa.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí chí-sī góa eng-kai kiâⁿ ê lō͘, in-ūi tùi-te̍k teh tng-tán, kiû lí chhōa góa kiâⁿ pîⁿ-tháⁿ ê lō͘.
M̄-thang chiàu tùi-te̍k ê sim-goān kā góa kau hō͘ in, in-ūi in ēng gūi-chèng khióng-hat góa.
Góa chhim-sìn chi̍t hāng sū: Góa iáu oa̍h--teh ê ji̍t ōe hióng-siū Siōng Chú ê un-hūi.
Tio̍h sìn-khò Siōng Chú! Tio̍h ióng-kám chòng-táⁿ! Tio̍h sìn-khò Siōng Chú!
Siōng Chú ah, góa kiû-kiò lí; góa ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ ah, m̄-thang m̄ chhap góa. Lí nā tùi góa chēng-chēng, góa chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍p bōng-khòng-khang ê lâng.
Góa kiû-kiò lí, ǹg lí ê Chì-sèng-só͘ gia̍h-chhiú kî-tó ê sî, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa khún-kiû ê siaⁿ.
M̄-thang chiong góa kap pháiⁿ-lâng, í-ki̍p choh-ok ê lâng chòe-chi̍t-ē siau-bia̍t; in kap chhù-piⁿ kóng hô-pêng ê ōe, m̄-kú sim im-hiám.
Goān lí chiàu in ê só͘-chòe, chiàu in só͘ kiâⁿ ê pháiⁿ-tāi pò-èng in. Goān lí chiàu in ê chhiú ê só͘-chòe pò-èng in, chiàu in eng-kai siū--ê kā in chhú-hoa̍t.
In-ūi in biáu-sī Siōng Chú ê chok-ûi, kap I ê chhiú só͘ chòe--ê; I ōe húi-hoāi in, bōe kā in tiông-kiàn.
Siōng Chú eng-kai siū chheng-chàn, in-ūi I ū thiaⁿ góa khún-kiû ê siaⁿ.
Siōng Chú sī góa ê khùi-la̍t, góa ê tún-pâi; góa óa-khò I. Siōng Chú pang-chān góa, góa ê sim tōa hoaⁿ-hí; góa beh ēng si-koa chheng-chàn I.
Siōng Chú sī I chú-bîn ê khùi-la̍t, sī I soán-li̍p ê ông tit-kiù ê pī-lān-só͘.
Kiû lí kái-kiù lí ê chú-bîn, sù-hok hō͘ chòe lí sán-gia̍p ê chú-bîn; kiû lí chòe in ê bo̍k-chiá éng-oán hû-chhî in.
Thian-kài tāi-lêng-chiá ê chèng kiáⁿ-jî ah, tio̍h chiong Siōng Chú èng-ū ê êng-kng koân-lêng kui hō͘ I. Tio̍h kui hō͘ I!
Tio̍h chiong Siōng Chú ê miâ èng-ū ê êng-kng kui hō͘ I, chûn sèng-kiat ê sim kèng-pài Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú ê siaⁿ tī chúi-bīn teh hiáng; êng-kng ê Siōng-tè khí-lûi tōa tân. Siōng Chú lîm-chāi tī hái-iûⁿ téng-bīn.
Siōng Chú ê siaⁿ ū tōa khùi-la̍t; Siōng Chú ê siaⁿ ui-giâm móa-móa.
Siōng Chú ê siaⁿ phah-chi̍h pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū; Siōng Chú phah-chhùi Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū.
I hō͘ Lê-pa-lūn tiô-thiàu chhin-chhiūⁿ gû-á-kiáⁿ, hō͘ Hek-bûn-soaⁿ tiô-thiàu chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-gû-á-kiáⁿ.
Siōng Chú ê siaⁿ hō͘ sih-nà siám-iāu.
Siōng Chú ê siaⁿ hō͘ khòng-iá iô-tāng; Siōng Chú hō͘ Ka-te-su ê khòng-iá tōa tín-tāng.
Siōng Chú ê siaⁿ hō͘ lo̍k-bú tio̍h-kiaⁿ seng-sán, hō͘ chhiū-nâ ê chhiū-hio̍h lak kah kng-kng-kng. Só͘-ū tī I tiān-lāi ê lâng lóng hoah kóng, “Êng-kng kui Siōng Chú!”
Siōng Chú siat pó-chō tī tōa-chúi téng-bīn; Siōng Chú choh-ông kàu éng-oán.
Siōng Chú sù khùi-la̍t hō͘ I ê chú-bîn; Siōng Chú sù pêng-an hō͘ I ê chú-bîn.
Siōng Chú ah, góa beh chun lí chòe chì-koân, in-ūi lí ū thê-poa̍t góa, bô hō͘ góa ê tùi-te̍k tùi góa khoa-kháu.
Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, góa kiû-kiò lí, lí ū i-hó góa.
Siōng Chú ah, lí tùi Im-hú kā góa khiú--chhut-lâi; lí hō͘ góa oa̍h--teh, bián ji̍p bōng-khòng-khang.
Siōng Chú sèng ê chú-bîn ah, lín tio̍h chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló I, chheng-chàn I ê sèng-miâ.
I ê siū-khì chí-ū chi̍t-sî-á-kú; I ê un-tián kàu chi̍t-sì-lâng. Sui-jiân kui-mî ū thî-khàu, thiⁿ chi̍t-ē kng chiū ū hoaⁿ-hí.
Tī góa sūn-lī ê sî, góa bat kóng, “Góa éng-oán bōe tōng-iâu.”
Siōng Chú ah, lí si-un, hō͘ góa chhin-chhiūⁿ soaⁿ khiā-chāi-chāi; lí bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ khòaⁿ góa, góa chiū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Siōng Chú ah, góa kiû-kiò lí; góa tùi Siōng Chú kiû lîn-bín, kóng,
“Góa sí, ji̍p bōng, ū siáⁿ lī-ek? Thô͘-hún kiám ōe chheng-chàn lí, kiám ōe pò-iông lí ê sìn-si̍t?”
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa, lîn-bín góa; Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí pang-chān góa.
Lí ū chiong góa ê thî-khàu pìⁿ-chòe thiàu-bú, chiong góa ê môa-saⁿ thǹg--khí-lâi, ēng hoaⁿ-hí chòe tòa kā góa hâ.
Án-ni góa ê sim-sîn chiū bōe tiām-tiām, ōe chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí; Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, góa beh éng-oán kám-siā lí.
Siōng Chú ah, góa khò lí chòe góa ê pó-hō͘. Kiû lí hō͘ góa éng-oán bōe sit-pāi kiàn-siàu; lí sī kong-gī ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí kái-kiù góa.
Kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa, kóaⁿ-kín lâi kiù góa, chòe góa kian-kò͘ ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ, chòe pó-lúi chín-kiù góa.
Lí sī góa ê soaⁿ-giâm, góa ê pó-lúi, kiû lí chiàu lí ê miâ léng-tō góa, ín-chhōa góa.
Lâng àm-tiong siat lô-bāng beh bāng góa, kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī, in-ūi lí sī góa ê pó-lúi.
Góa chiong góa ê lêng-hûn kau-tài lí; Siōng Chú — sìn-si̍t ê Siōng-tè ah, lí ōe kiù-sio̍k góa.
Góa iàm-ò͘ⁿ khîⁿ-tiâu bô lō͘-ēng ê ngó͘-siōng ê lâng; góa chí-ū sìn-khò Siōng Chú.
Góa beh in-ūi lí ê chû-ài hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k; in-ūi lí ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê kan-khó͘, chai góa lāi-sim ê khó͘-thàng.
Lí bô kā góa kau tī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú; lí hō͘ góa ê kha khiā tī khui-khoah an-ún ê só͘-chāi.
Siōng Chú ah, góa tī hoān-lān tiong, kiû lí lîn-bín góa. Góa ê ba̍k-chiu in-ūi iu-siong hoe--khì; góa ê sim-sîn, góa ê seng-khu soe-jio̍k.
Góa ê sìⁿ-miā in-ūi iu-khó͘ siau-chīn; góa ê nî-hè in-ūi ai-siong kiám-chió. Góa ê khùi-la̍t in-ūi góa ê chōe-kò soe-lám; góa ê kut-thâu ko͘-tâ.
Góa só͘-ū ê tùi-te̍k lóng lêng-jio̍k góa; góa ê chhù-piⁿ kā góa bú-jio̍k; liân bat góa ê lâng mā lóng kiaⁿ góa; tī lō͘--ni̍h khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê lâng lóng siám-khui.
Góa chhin-chhiūⁿ sí-lâng hō͘ lâng bōe-kì--tit, bô lâng siàu-liām; góa chhin-chhiūⁿ phòa--khì ê khì-khū hō͘ lâng hìⁿ-sak.
Góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chin chōe lâng sì-kòe teh chō-iâu; chiu-ûi chhiong-móa khióng-pò͘. In chham-siông beh kong-kek góa, kè-bô͘ beh hāi góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Siōng Chú ah, góa iáu-kú beh óa-khò lí; góa kóng, “Lí sī góa ê Siōng-tè.”
Góa ê it-seng tī lí ê chhiú-tiong; kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú kap khún-pek góa ê lâng.
Kiû lí ēng lí ê bīn ê kng chiò lí ê po̍k-jîn, chiàu lí ê chû-ài chín-kiù góa.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí hō͘ góa bô tì-kàu kiàn-siàu, in-ūi góa kiû-kiò lí. Kiû lí hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng sit-pāi kiàn-siàu, hō͘ in tī Im-hú tiām-tiām bô ōe thang kóng.
Goān lí hō͘ pe̍h-chha̍t ê chhùi pìⁿ é-káu, bōe koh kiau-ngō͘ kā lâng khòaⁿ-khin, lām-sám bú-jio̍k gī-lâng.
Tī sè-kan-lâng bīn-chêng, lí ūi-tio̍h kèng-ùi lí ê lâng chek-chū ê un-hūi jōa-á-ni̍h tōa! Lí ūi-tio̍h chhē lí chòe pī-lān-só͘ ê lâng só͘ sù ê un-hūi jōa-á-ni̍h hó!

Lí kā in chhàng tī lí ê bīn-chêng ún-ba̍t ê só͘-chāi, in chiah bián hām-lo̍h lâng ê im-bô͘. Lí àm-chīⁿ pó-siú in tī tiùⁿ-bō͘ lāi, in chiah bián siū chhùi-chi̍h ê tiòng-siong.
Siōng Chú eng-kai siū chheng-chàn, in-ūi siâⁿ siū ûi-khùn ê sî, I ū tùi góa hián-chhut kî-biāu ê thiàⁿ.
Góa bat tio̍h-kip kóng “Lí kā góa kóaⁿ-cháu m̄ chhap góa”, m̄-kú góa kiû-kiò ê sî, lí ū thiaⁿ góa khún-kiû ê siaⁿ.
Siōng Chú sèng ê chú-bîn ah, lín lóng tio̍h thiàⁿ I. Siōng Chú pó-siú tiong-sìn ê lâng, giâm-giâm pò-èng kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng.
Só͘-ū gióng-bōng Siōng Chú ê lâng ah, lín tio̍h chòng-táⁿ, sim kian-kò͘.
Kè-sit tit-tio̍h sià-bián, chōe-kò tit-tio̍h chhat-siau, chit-khoán lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Sim bô kan-chà, Siōng Chú bô sǹg i ū-chōe, chit-khoán lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Góa nā tiām-tiām m̄ jīn-chōe, chiū kui-ji̍t haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan, liân kut-thâu to ta--khì.
Lí ê chhiú mî-ji̍t tāng-tāng hêng-hoa̍t góa, góa ê cheng-le̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ joa̍h-thiⁿ ê ji̍t-thâu pha̍k kah ta-ta--khì.
Góa ū tùi lí pâi-lia̍t góa ê chōe, bô ún-môa góa ê chōe-ok. Góa beh tùi Siōng Chú sêng-jīn góa ê kè-sit; lí chiū sià-bián góa só͘ hoān ê chōe.
Án-ni, khiân-sêng ê lâng lóng tio̍h tī thang chhē-tio̍h lí ê sî tùi lí kî-tó; tōa-chúi hoàn-lām mā it-tēng bōe im-tio̍h i.
Lí sī góa siám-bih ê só͘-chāi, ōe pì-iū góa thoat-lī kan-khó͘; lí ōe ēng tit-kiù ê koa sì-bīn ûi góa.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh kà-sī lí, chí-sī lí eng-kai kiâⁿ ê lō͘; góa beh chù-ba̍k khòaⁿ lí, koàn-kò͘ lí.
M̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ bé, lô, bô tì-sek; in tio̍h ēng bé-kā-kiuⁿ, bé-le̍k-soh iok-sok chiah ōe sûn-ho̍k.”
Pháiⁿ-lâng ōe siū chin chōe thòng-khó͘; m̄-kú óa-khò Siōng Chú ê lâng ū chû-ài sì-bīn ûi i.
Gī-lâng ah, tio̍h in-ūi Siōng Chú lâi hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k! Sim chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ah, tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ hoan-ho͘!
Gī-lâng ah, tio̍h in-ūi Siōng Chú lâi hoaⁿ-hí; chèng-ti̍t ê lâng eng-kai tio̍h chheng-chàn I.
Lín tio̍h tôaⁿ-khîm kám-siā Siōng Chú, ēng cha̍p tiâu hiân ê khiā-khîm chheng-chàn I,
tôaⁿ hō͘ chin súi. Tio̍h tùi I chhiùⁿ sin ê koa, tōa-siaⁿ hoan-ho͘.
In-ūi Siōng Chú ê ōe chèng-khak; I ê chok-ûi lóng khó-khò.
Siōng Chú ì-ài kong-pêng chèng-ti̍t; I ê chû-ài phó͘-ki̍p choân-tōe.
Kiong-chhong tùi Siōng Chú ê ōe chhòng-chō; ji̍t, ge̍h, chhiⁿ-sîn tùi I ê chhùi pûn ê khùi chō-chiâⁿ.
I kā hái-chúi chi̍p chòe-tui, kā chhim-ian siu tī chhng-khò͘.
Choân-tōe tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng Chú; sè-kan-lâng lóng tio̍h kiaⁿ-ùi I.
I chi̍t-ē kóng, ú-tiū chiū chhut-hiān; I chi̍t-ē bēng-lēng, bān-iú chiū hêng-sêng.
Siōng Chú hō͘ lia̍t-pang ê kè-bô͘ lo̍k-khong, hō͘ bān-bîn ê kè-bô͘ sit-hāu.
Siōng Chú ê kè-ōe éng-oán bōe piàn; I ê sim-ì sòa kàu bān sè-tāi.
Jīn Siōng Chú chòe Siōng-tè hit-ê kok chin ū hok-khì! Siū kéng-soán chòe I sán-gia̍p hit-ê chú-bîn chin ū hok-khì!
Siōng Chú tùi thiⁿ-téng teh khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lóng-chóng ê sè-kan-lâng.
I tùi I ê pó-chō khòaⁿ--lo̍h-khì, khòaⁿ tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ê chū-bîn.
I chō chèng-lâng ê sim, liáu-kái in it-chhè ê chok-ûi.
Kun-ông bōe in-ūi peng chōe chiū sèng-lī; ióng-sū bōe in-ūi khùi-la̍t tōa chiū ōe iâⁿ.
Khò chiàn-bé bô it-tēng ōe thâi-iâⁿ; khò bé ê ui-le̍k bô it-tēng ōe kiù lâng.
Siōng Chú ê ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ-kò͘ kèng-ùi I ê lâng, koàn-kò͘ gióng-bōng I chû-ài ê lâng.
I ōe kiù in ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī sí-bông, pó-chûn in tō͘-kè ki-hng.
Goán ê sim-sîn thèng-hāu Siōng Chú; I sī goán ê pang-chān, goán ê tún-pâi.
Goán ê sim beh in-ūi I lâi hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi goán óa-khò I ê sèng-miâ.
Siōng Chú ah, goān lí ê chû-ài si-lo̍h hō͘ goán, in-ūi goán gióng-bōng lí.
Góa beh put-sî chheng-chàn Siōng Chú; góa ê chhùi beh siông-siông o-ló I.
Góa ê sim-sîn beh khoa-kháu Siōng Chú; khùn-khó͘ ê lâng thiaⁿ--kìⁿ mā ōe hoaⁿ-hí.
Tio̍h kap góa chheng-chàn Siōng Chú chòe tōa, chòe-hé chun-chông I ê miâ.
Góa kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, I ū ìn góa, kiù góa thoat-lī it-chhè ê kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Gióng-bōng I ê lâng bīn ū kong-chhái, sim khoài-lo̍k; in éng-oán bōe tì-kàu kiàn-siàu sit-bāng.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng kiû-kiò, Siōng Chú ū thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, kiù i thoat-lī it-chhè ê kan-lân.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tī kèng-ùi I ê lâng ê sì-ûi chat-iâⁿ, kiù in thoat-chhut khùn-kéng.
Chhin-sin thé-giām, chiū chai Siōng Chú chin hó; chhē I chòe pī-lān-só͘ ê lâng chin ū hok-khì.
Siōng Chú sèng ê chú-bîn ah, tio̍h kèng-ùi I, in-ūi kèng-ùi I ê lâng lóng bô khiàm-kheh.
Siàu-chòng ê sai mā ōe khiàm-kheh, ōe iau, m̄-kú chhē-kiû Siōng Chú ê lâng sím-mi̍h hó-mi̍h to bô khiàm.
Sòe-kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h lâi thiaⁿ, góa beh kà-sī lín kèng-ùi Siōng Chú.
Lín tiong-kan siáⁿ-lâng ì-ài sìⁿ-miā, ài tn̂g-hè-siū thang hióng-hok?
Tio̍h kìm ka-kī ê chi̍h bô kóng pháiⁿ-ōe, kìm-chí chhùi-tûn bô kóng khúi-chà.
Tio̍h kū-choa̍t pháiⁿ, chòe hó-sū, jia̍t-sim tui-kiû hô-pêng.
Siōng Chú ê ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ-kò͘ gī-lâng; I ê hī-khang thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó.
Siōng Chú tùi choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng pìⁿ-bīn, tùi sè-kan chhat-siau in ê miâ.
Siōng Chú thiaⁿ gī-lâng ê kiû-kiò, kiù in thoat-lī it-chhè ê kan-lân.
Siōng Chú chhin-kūn sim-lêng phò-chhùi ê lâng, chín-kiù sim thòng-hóe ê lâng.
Gī-lâng ū chin chōe khó͘-lān, m̄-kú Siōng Chú kiù in lóng thoat-lī.
Siōng Chú pó-choân in lóng-chóng ê kut-thâu, chi̍t ki to bô phah-chi̍h.
Chōe-ok ōe hāi-sí pháiⁿ-lâng; oàn-hūn gī-lâng--ê, ōe siū tēng-chōe.
Siōng Chú kiù-sio̍k I ê po̍k-jîn; óa-khò I ê lâng liân chi̍t ê to bōe siū tēng-chōe.
Siōng Chú ah, kap góa cheng-lūn ê lâng, kiû lí kap in cheng-lūn; kap góa kau-chiàn ê lâng, kiû lí kap in kau-chiàn.
Kiû lí the̍h tōa-sòe ê tún-pâi khí-lâi pang-chān góa,
ēng chhiuⁿ tùi-hù tui-kóaⁿ góa ê lâng. Kiû lí tùi góa kóng, “Góa sī lí ê Chín-kiù-chiá.”
Kiû lí hō͘ siàu-siūⁿ góa sìⁿ-miā ê lâng siū lêng-jio̍k kiàn-siàu; kiû lí hō͘ kè-bô͘ hām-hāi góa ê lâng thiat-thè làu-khùi.
Kiû lí hō͘ in chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ hong chhe ê chho͘-khng, ū Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kā in kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ.
Kiû lí hō͘ in ê lō͘ àm koh ku̍t, ū Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kā in tui-kóaⁿ.
In bô-iân-bô-kò͘ àm-siat lô-bāng beh tng góa, ku̍t hām-khiⁿ beh hāi góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Kiû lí hō͘ chai-hō tī bô phah-sǹg ê sî lîm-kàu in sin-chiūⁿ; lí hō͘ in àm-siat ê lô-bāng tîⁿ-tio̍h ka-kī, poa̍h-lo̍h hit lāi-bīn siū hāi.
Án-ni, góa ê sim ōe in-ūi Siōng Chú khoài-lo̍k, in-ūi I ê kiù-un hoaⁿ-hí.

Góa kui-ê lâng lóng beh kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, bô lâng ōe-tàng kap lí pí! Lí chín-kiù khùn-khó͘--ê thoat-lī pí i khah kiông ê lâng, chín-kiù khùn-khó͘ sàn-chhiah--ê thoat-lī chhiúⁿ-toa̍t i ê lâng.”
Hiong-ok ê kiàn-chèng-jîn khiā--chhut-lâi; in chhâ-mn̄g góa m̄-chai ê sū.
In tùi góa ēng pháiⁿ pò hó, hō͘ góa ko͘-khó͘-bû-chō͘.
M̄-kú, in phòa-pīⁿ ê sî, góa chhēng môa-saⁿ pi-siong, khek-khó͘ kìm-chia̍h, ūi-tio̍h in àⁿ-thâu kî-tó.
Góa khoán-thāi in chòe góa ê pêng-iú, chòe góa ê hiaⁿ-tī; góa khut-lo̍h ai-siong, ká-ná ūi-tio̍h lāu-bú sí--khì teh pi-siong.
M̄-kú góa poa̍h-tó sit-pāi ê sî, in tàu-tīn hoaⁿ-hí; liân siⁿ-hūn-lâng mā it-ti̍t kā góa lêng-jio̍k kong-kek.
In chòe-hé phì-siùⁿ góa, thí-chhiò góa, thòng-hūn góa, tùi góa kā-gê-chhiat-chhí.
Chú ah, lí ná tiām-tiām teh khòaⁿ, beh khòaⁿ jōa kú? Kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī in ê chân-hāi, kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī siàu-chòng ê sai.
Góa beh tī tōa chū-hōe tiong kám-siā lí, tī chèng-lâng ê tiong-kan chheng-chàn lí.
Kiû lí m̄-thang iông-ún bô-iân-bô-kò͘ te̍k-tùi góa ê lâng tùi góa khoa-kháu, m̄-thang hō͘ bô lí-iû oàn-hūn góa ê lâng kā góa gîn.
In-ūi in bô kóng hô-pêng ê ōe, tian-tò chō-iâu tiòng-siong ì-ài hô-pêng ê lâng.
In khui-chhùi tōa-siaⁿ kong-kek góa, kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ leh! Goán ū chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h.”
Siōng Chú ah, lí í-keng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, kiû lí m̄-thang tiām-tiām; Chú ah, m̄-thang khiā-hn̄g-hn̄g m̄ chhap góa.
Góa ê Siōng-tè, góa ê Chú ah, kiû lí cheng-sîn, kiû lí khí--lâi, ūi góa piān-hō͘, thòe góa sin-oan.
Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí chiàu lí ê kong-gī phòaⁿ-toàn, m̄-thang hō͘ in tī góa ê bīn-chêng iông-iông-tek-ì.
M̄-thang iông-ún in sim-lāi kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, tāi-chì tú chiàu goán ê sim-goān!” M̄-thang iông-ún in kóng, “Goán í-keng kā i thun--lo̍h-khì.”
Goān ài góa tú-tio̍h hoān-lān ê lâng kiàn-siàu làu-khùi; goān kiau-ngō͘ tùi-thāi góa ê lâng lóng sit-bāng kiàn-siàu.
Goān ài góa siū phòaⁿ bô chōe ê lâng khoài-lo̍k chhiùⁿ-koa; goān in put-sî kóng, “Tio̍h chun Siōng Chú chòe tōa, in-ūi I ì-ài I ê po̍k-jîn pêng-an hoân-êng.”
Góa ê chhùi-chi̍h beh soan-iông lí ê gī, kui-ji̍t lóng chheng-chàn lí.
Chōe tī pháiⁿ-lâng ê sim-tóe chhek-tōng; i gán-tiong m̄ kiaⁿ Siōng-tè.
Tùi i lâi khòaⁿ, chōe sī i ê khoa-kháu, ka-kī siūⁿ-kóng Siōng-tè bōe hoat-kiàn, bōe iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
I kóng ê ōe lóng sī chōe-ok kap kan-chà; i bô koh-chài ū tì-hūi, mā bô hó ê hêng-ûi.
I tī bîn-chhn̂g téng iáu-teh kè-bô͘ chōe-ok. I koat-tēng beh kiâⁿ pháiⁿ-lō͘, m̄ khì-sak pháiⁿ-tāi.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ê chû-ài koân kàu tú-thiⁿ; lí ê sìn-si̍t kàu kiong-chhong.
Lí ê kong-gī chhin-chhiūⁿ ke̍k-koân ê soaⁿ; lí ê phòaⁿ-toàn chhin-chhiūⁿ chhim-ian. Siōng Chú ah, lâng kap cheng-siⁿ lí lóng koàn-kò͘.
Siōng-tè ah, lí ê chû-ài ná hiah pó-pòe! Sè-kan-lâng lóng lâi bih tī lí si̍t-kó͘ ê pó-hō͘-ē.
In beh tī lí ê chhù hióng-siū hong-hù ê iàn-se̍k; lí beh hō͘ in lim lí khoài-lo̍k ê hô-chúi.
In-ūi oa̍h-miā ê goân-thâu chāi-tī lí; tùi lí ê kng, goán khòaⁿ-kìⁿ kng.
Goān lí kè-sio̍k si-lo̍h chû-ài hō͘ bat lí ê lâng, si-lo̍h kong-gī hō͘ sim-lāi chèng-ti̍t ê lâng.
M̄-thang iông-ún kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng ê kha thún-ta̍h góa; m̄-thang iông-ún hiong-ok ê lâng ê chhiú kóaⁿ-tio̍k góa.
Lí khòaⁿ, chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng í-keng tó--lo̍h-khì; in siū chhia-tó, bōe-tàng koh khí--lâi.
M̄-thang in-ūi chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng sim-lāi put-pêng; m̄-thang oàn-tò͘ hêng-ûi put-gī ê lâng;
in-ūi in chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu chin kín chiū ta--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiⁿ-chhùi ê hoe-chháu lian--khì.
Tio̍h óa-khò Siōng Chú lâi chòe hó, tiàm tī chit-ê thó͘-tōe an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p.
Tio̍h in-ūi Siōng Chú lâi hoaⁿ-hí; I ōe boán-chiok lí ê sim-goān.
Tio̍h chiong lí ê lō͘-tô͘ kau-thok Siōng Chú, óa-khò I, I ōe kā lí sêng-choân.
I ōe hō͘ lí ê gī chhin-chhiūⁿ kng hoat-chhut; lí ê chèng-ti̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ tiong-tàu ê ji̍t-thâu.
Tio̍h chēng-chēng tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng thun-lún thèng-hāu; m̄-thang in-ūi pháiⁿ-lâng ê kè-bô͘ sêng-kong lâi put-pêng.
M̄-thang siū-khì, tio̍h khì-sak tōa siū-khì; m̄-thang put-pêng, chiah bián tì-kàu chòe pháiⁿ.
In-ūi chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng ōe siū châu-bia̍t; thèng-hāu Siōng Chú ê lâng ōe sêng-siū só͘ èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe.
Pháiⁿ-lâng chin kín chiū ōe bô--khì; lí siông-sè chhâ i ê só͘-chāi, mā chhē bōe tio̍h.
M̄-kú khiam-pi ê lâng ōe sêng-siū só͘ èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe, hióng-siū hoân-êng hô-pêng.
Pháiⁿ-lâng siat-kè beh hāi gī-lâng, thòng-hūn i, tùi i kā-gê-chhiat-chhí.
Chú ōe kā i thí-chhiò, in-ūi chai i siū pò-èng ê ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu.
Pháiⁿ-lâng pu̍ih to khui keng, beh táⁿ-tó khùn-khó͘ sàn-chhiah ê lâng, thâi-sí hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t ê lâng.
In ê to ōe chha̍k ji̍p-khì ka-kī ê sim; in ê keng ōe siū at-tn̄g.
Gī-lâng só͘-ū--ê sui-jiân chin chió, mā pí pháiⁿ-lâng ū chin chōe châi-hù khah hó.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhiú-kut ōe siū at-tn̄g, m̄-kú Siōng Chú hû-chhî gī-lâng.
Siōng Chú koàn-kò͘ oân-choân ê lâng ê nî-ji̍t; in ê sán-gia̍p ōe-tàng éng-oán pó-chûn.
In tī hoān-lān ê sî bōe tì-kàu kiàn-siàu, tī ki-hng ê ji̍t ōe tit-tio̍h pá-chiok.
Chóng-sī pháiⁿ-lâng ōe bia̍t-bông. Siōng Chú ê tùi-te̍k ōe ká-ná iá-hoe siā--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-hun siau-sòaⁿ.
Pháiⁿ-lâng kā lâng chioh, m̄ hêng; gī-lâng khóng-khài si-sià.
Siōng Chú sù-hok ê lâng ōe sêng-siū só͘ èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe; siū I chiù-chó͘ ê lâng ōe bia̍t-bông.
Siōng Chú hō͘ gī-lâng ê kha-pō͘ ún-kò͘; I hoaⁿ-hí in ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe.
In tio̍h-tak mā bōe poa̍h-tó, in-ūi Siōng Chú ēng chhiú hû in.
Góa chêng siàu-liân taⁿ nî-lāu, m̄-bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h gī-lâng siū pàng-sak, i ê hō͘-tāi chòe khit-chia̍h.
I put-sî khóng-khài si-sià, hoaⁿ-hí chioh--lâng; i ê kiáⁿ-sun tit-tio̍h chiok-hok.
Tio̍h kū-choa̍t pháiⁿ, chòe hó-sū, chiū ōe éng-oán an-jiân khiā-khí.
Siōng Chú ì-ài kong-pêng, bōe pàng-sak I sèng ê chú-bîn. In éng-oán siū pó-hō͘; m̄-kú pháiⁿ-lâng ê kiáⁿ-sun ōe siū châu-bia̍t.
Gī-lâng ōe sêng-siū só͘ èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe, éng-oán tiàm tī hia.
Gī-lâng ê chhùi kóng tì-hūi; i ê chi̍h tâm-lūn kong-pêng.
Siōng-tè ê lu̍t-hoat tī i sim-lāi; i ê kha lóng bōe ta̍h-thu̍t.
Pháiⁿ-lâng kim-kim teh siòng gī-lâng, siàu-siūⁿ beh thâi i.
Siōng Chú bōe pàng i lo̍h tī pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhiú, sím-phòaⁿ ê sî i bōe siū tēng-chōe.
Tio̍h thèng-hāu Siōng Chú, chun-siú I ê tō-lō͘, I chiū ko-seng lí, hō͘ lí sêng-siū só͘ èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe; lí ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h pháiⁿ-lâng siau-bia̍t.
Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ kiông-pō ê pháiⁿ-lâng heng-ōng, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū tī ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe bō͘-sēng.
Ū lâng tùi hia keng-kè, khòaⁿ leh, i bô--khì lah; góa chhē mā chhē lóng bô.
Siông-sè khòaⁿ oân-choân chèng-ti̍t ê lâng, in-ūi ài hô-pêng ê lâng ū hó ê chiong-lâi.
M̄-kú hoān-hoat ê lâng ōe chòe-chi̍t-ē bia̍t-bông; pháiⁿ-lâng chòe-āu ōe siū châu-bia̍t.
Chóng-sī gī-lâng tùi Siōng Chú tit-tio̍h chín-kiù; hoān-lān ê sî, I chòe in ê pī-lān-só͘.
Siōng Chú pang-chān in, chín-kiù in; I kiù in, tháu-pàng in thoat-lī pháiⁿ-lâng, in-ūi in óa-khò I tit-tio̍h pó-hō͘.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí m̄-thang siū-khì chek-pī góa, m̄-thang hoat tōa siū-khì chek-hoa̍t góa.
Lí ê chìⁿ siā-ji̍p góa ê seng-khu; lí ê chhiú tāng-tāng chhi̍h góa.
Lí ê siū-khì hō͘ góa ê seng-khu bô chi̍t ūi kiān-choân; góa ê chōe-kò hō͘ góa ê kut-thâu bô chi̍t ki hó-hó.
Góa ê chōe-kò thia̍p--khí-lâi, chhiau-kè góa ê thâu-khak, chhin-chhiūⁿ tāng-tàⁿ hō͘ góa taⁿ bōe khí.
Góa in-ūi gû-gōng, tì-kàu khang-chhùi nōa koh chhàu.
Góa hō͘ chōe teh kah beh phih--lo̍h-khì, kui-ji̍t kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan.
Góa ê io chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh to̍h; góa ê seng-khu bô kah chi̍t ūi kiān-choân.
Góa siū teh-siong, kui seng-khu bâ-pì; góa ê sim khó͘-thàng, tōa-siaⁿ ai-chhan.
Chú ah, góa ê sim-goān lí lóng chai; góa ê thó͘-khùi mā bô tùi lí am-khàm.
Góa ê sim pho̍k-pho̍k-chhéng, khùi-la̍t soe-bî, liân góa ê ba̍k-chiu to lóng bô-sîn.
Góa ê pêng-iú tâng-phōaⁿ in-ūi góa ê pháiⁿ chèng-thâu lóng siám khui; góa ê chhin-lâng mā khiā-hn̄g-hn̄g.
Siàu-siūⁿ góa sìⁿ-miā ê lâng siat lô-bāng; beh hāi góa ê lâng kóng ok-to̍k ê ōe, kui-ji̍t teh siat-kè khúi-khiat ê im-bô͘.
Góa chhin-chhiūⁿ chhàu-hī-lâng bōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ é-káu bōe kóng-ōe.
Góa chhin-chhiūⁿ bô thiaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng, ū chhùi mā bōe-tàng tap-piān.
Siōng Chú ah, góa gióng-bōng lí; Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, lí beh ìn-tap góa.
Góa bat kóng, “Kiû lí m̄-thang hō͘ in tùi góa khoa-kháu; góa ê kha ta̍h-thu̍t ê sî, m̄-thang hō͘ in tùi góa khoa-iāu.”
In-ūi góa hiám-hiám-á poa̍h-tó; góa ê khó͘-thàng put-sî tîⁿ-tè góa.
Góa beh jīn góa ê chōe-ok, ūi-tio̍h góa ê chōe iu-būn.
Góa ê tùi-te̍k kiông koh ióng; bô-iân-bô-kò͘ oàn-hūn góa ê lâng ke-thiⁿ chin chōe.
Ēng pháiⁿ pò hó ê lâng kap góa chòe tùi-thâu; in-ūi góa tui-kiû liông-siān.
Siōng Chú ah, m̄-thang pàng-sak góa; góa ê Siōng-tè ah, m̄-thang lī-khui góa hn̄g-hn̄g.
Chú — góa ê Kiù-chú ah, kín lâi kiù góa!
Góa bat kóng, “Góa beh kín-sīn góa ê giân-hêng, chiah bián góa ê chi̍h hoān-chōe; pháiⁿ-lâng tī góa bīn-chêng ê sî, góa beh ēng chhùi-am iok-sok ka-kī ê chhùi-chi̍h.”
Góa tiām-tiām bô chhut-siaⁿ, liân hó-ōe to bô kóng chhut-chhùi; góa ê thòng-khó͘ chiū ná ke-thiⁿ.
Góa lāi-sim it-ti̍t sio--khí-lâi, góa jú siūⁿ hé jú to̍h, góa chiū khui-chhùi kóng,
“Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí hō͘ góa chai ka-kī ê kiat-kio̍k, ka-kī ê nî-hè ū jōa-chōe, hō͘ góa chai ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā chin kín chiū bô--khì.
“Lí hō͘ góa ê ji̍t-chí si̍t-chāi chin té; góa ê hè-siū tùi lí khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chha-put-to sī bô; lâng put-kò sī chi̍t ê khùi.
Lâng teh oa̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ iáⁿ; in bô-êng-chhih-chhih si̍t-chāi bô-chhái-kang; in só͘ chek-chū--ê m̄-chai siáⁿ-lâng ōe tit--khì.
“Chú ah, taⁿ góa tio̍h thèng-hāu sím-mi̍h? Góa ê ǹg-bāng chāi-tī lí.
Kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī góa it-chhè ê kè-sit, hō͘ góa bián siū gōng-lâng ê lêng-jio̍k.
In-ūi sī lí hō͘ góa siū-khó͘, góa chēng-chēng bô khui-chhùi.
Lí hō͘ góa ê chek-hoa̍t, kiû lí kā góa tû--khì; in-ūi lí ê chhiú ê tok-chek, góa teh-beh siau-bia̍t.
Lí chek-hoa̍t lâng, in-ūi in hoān-chōe; lí hō͘ in só͘ ì-ài--ê chhin-chhiūⁿ tio̍h chiù-thâng hu--khì. Lâng put-kò sī chi̍t ê khùi.

“Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó, àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa ê khún-kiû; góa lâu ba̍k-sái, kiû lí m̄-thang bô chhut-siaⁿ. Góa sī i-óa lí ê chhut-gōa-lâng, kap góa ê lia̍t-chó͘ siâng-khoán sī kià-ku--ê.
Kiû lí khoan-iông góa, hō͘ góa iáu-bē sí í-chêng tit-tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.”
Góa nāi-sim thèng-hāu Siōng Chú; I ū àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa ê ai-kiû.
I tùi sí-bông ê hām-khiⁿ, tùi thô͘-bê tiong kā góa khiú--khí-lâi; I hō͘ góa khiā tī chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng, hō͘ góa ê kha-pō͘ ún-kò͘.
I kà góa gîm sin ê si, chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló lán ê Siōng-tè; chin chōe lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiū kèng-ùi lâi sìn-khò Siōng Chú.
Choan-sim sìn-khò Siōng Chú ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! I bô pài ngó͘-siōng, bô kap pài ké-sîn ê lâng chòe-hé.

Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, lí ū ūi goán sêng-chiū chin chōe kî-sū; siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kap lí pí? Lí ūi goán an-pâi ê kè-ōe hiah-ni̍h chōe, beh kóng mā kóng bōe liáu.
Chè-sū kap lé-mi̍h, lí bô kah-ì; sio-hòa-chè kap sio̍k-chōe-chè, lí mā bô ài. Lí ū khui góa ê hī-khang thang thiaⁿ,
só͘-í góa ìn kóng, “Góa tī chia! Lí tùi góa ê chí-sī lóng kì tī Lu̍t-hoat.
Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, lí ê chí-ì góa hoaⁿ-hí thiaⁿ-thàn; lí ê Lu̍t-hoat tī góa sim-lāi.”
Góa tī tōa chū-hōe tiong soan-iông lí kong-gī ê hó siau-sit; Siōng chú ah, lí chai góa beh it-ti̍t soan-iông.
Góa m̄-bat chiong lí ê kong-gī khàm-ba̍t tī sim-lāi; góa í-keng ū kóng-khí lí ê sìn-si̍t kap kiù-un. Góa m̄-bat tī tōa chū-hōe tiong am-khàm lí ê chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí m̄-thang tùi góa siu-hôe lí ê chû-pi; goān lí ê chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t put-sî pó-siú góa.

In-ūi ū sǹg bōe liáu ê chai-hō ûi-khùn góa; góa ê chōe-ok jip-tio̍h góa, hō͘ góa ê ba̍k-chiu bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ; chiah-ê chōe-ok pí góa ê thâu-mn̂g khah chōe; góa oân-choân sit-khì ióng-khì.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí hoaⁿ-hí chín-kiù góa; Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí kín lâi pang-chān góa.
Goān siàu-siūⁿ beh hāi góa sìⁿ-miā ê lâng lóng làu-khùi kiàn-siàu; goān ài góa siū hām-hāi ê lâng pāi-thè siū lêng-jio̍k.
Goān tùi góa kóng “Hò͘, lí chhám ah” hiah-ê lâng, in-ūi kiàn-siàu bia̍t-bông.
Goān chhē-kiû lí ê lâng lóng in-ūi lí hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k; goān him-bō͘ lí chín-kiù ê lâng sî-siông kóng, “Tio̍h chun Siōng Chú chòe tōa!”
Chóng-sī góa khùn-khó͘ sàn-chhiah; Chú iáu-kú siàu-liām góa. Lí sī góa ê pang-chān, góa ê chín-kiù; góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí m̄-thang iân-chhiân.
Khòaⁿ-kò͘ sàn-chhiah-lâng ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! Tī hoān-lān ê ji̍t, Siōng Chú ōe kiù i.
Siōng Chú ōe pó-siú i ê sìⁿ-miā, hō͘ i tī tōe-chiūⁿ hióng-hok, bōe chiàu tùi-te̍k ê sim-goān chiong i kau hō͘ in.
I tó tī pīⁿ-chhn̂g, Siōng Chú ōe hû-chhî i; i phòa-pīⁿ ê sî, Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ i koh peh--khí-lâi.
Góa bat kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, góa ū tek-chōe lí, kiû lí lîn-bín góa, i-tī góa.”
Góa ê tùi-te̍k ēng pháiⁿ-ōe gī-lūn góa, kóng, “I tī-sî ōe sí, i ê miâ tī-sî ōe siau-sit?”
In lâi khòaⁿ góa lóng kóng pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe; in sim chûn kan-ok, chi̍t-ē chhut--khì chiū sì-kòe kā lâng kóng.
Só͘-ū oàn-hūn góa ê lâng chhi-bú-chhi-chhū gī-lūn góa; in siat kè-bô͘ beh hāi góa.
In kóng, “I ê seng-khu ū tì-tio̍h choa̍t-chèng, í-keng tó-chhn̂g bōe koh khí--lâi.”
Góa só͘ sìn-jīm, chia̍h góa ê pn̄g, ti-kí ê pêng-iú, kèng-jiân gia̍h kha that góa.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí lîn-bín góa, hō͘ góa koh peh khí-lâi pò-ho̍k in.
Góa ê tùi-te̍k bōe iâⁿ góa, góa chiū chai lí ì-ài góa.
In-ūi góa sûn-choân chèng-ti̍t, lí ōe hû-chhî góa, hō͘ góa éng-oán khiā tī lí ê bīn-chêng.
Goān chheng-chàn kui hō͘ Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, tùi éng-oán kàu éng-oán! Amen! Amen!
Siōng-tè ah, góa ê sim pek-chhiat him-bō͘ lí, chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k pek-chhiat him-bō͘ khoe-chúi.
Góa ê sim chhùi-ta him-bō͘ Siōng-tè, éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè; góa sím-mi̍h sî ōe-tàng kàu Siōng-tè bīn-chêng khì tiâu-kìⁿ?
Góa mî-ji̍t ēng ba̍k-sái chún pn̄g thun; góa ê tùi-te̍k it-ti̍t mn̄g góa, “Lí ê Siōng-tè tī tó-ūi?”
Góa chá-chêng chhōa chèng-lâng chòe-tīn khì Siōng-tè ê chhù, ēng hoaⁿ-hí chheng-chàn ê siaⁿ tāi-ke siú-choeh. Góa tui-liām chiah-ê tāi-chì, sim hui-siông pi-siong.

Góa ê sim ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ ut-chut, sī-án-chóaⁿ tī góa lāi-bīn haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan? Tio̍h gióng-bōng Siōng-tè; góa iáu-kú beh chheng-chàn I, in-ūi I sī góa ê Chín-kiù-chiá, góa ê Siōng-tè.
Góa ê sim tī góa lāi-bīn ut-chut, só͘-í góa beh tùi Iok-tàn ê tōe, Hek-bûn, Bí-sat ê soaⁿ siàu-liām lí.
Lí ê pho̍k-pò͘ chhut-siaⁿ, chhim-ian kap chhim-ian saⁿ ho͘-èng; lí ê pho-lōng, lí ê tōa-éng im-ba̍t góa.
Ji̍t--sî, Siōng Chú si-lo̍h I ê chû-ài; mî--sî, I hō͘ góa chhiùⁿ-koa, tùi sù góa oa̍h-miā ê Siōng-tè kî-kiû.
Góa beh tùi Siōng-tè — góa ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ bōe-kì-tit góa? Góa sī-án-chóaⁿ tio̍h in-ūi tùi-te̍k ê ap-pek pi-siong kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì?”
Góa ê tùi-te̍k khi-hū góa, phah-chhùi góa ê kut-thâu; in it-ti̍t mn̄g góa, “Lí ê Siōng-tè tī tó-ūi?”

Góa ê sim ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ ut-chut, sī-án-chóaⁿ tī góa lāi-bīn haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan? Tio̍h gióng-bōng Siōng-tè; góa iáu-kú beh chheng-chàn I, in-ūi I sī góa ê Chín-kiù-chiá, góa ê Siōng-tè.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí chú-chhî kong-tō, tùi bô kèng-ùi lí ê kok thòe góa sin-oan; kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī kan-chà put-gī ê lâng.
Lí sī góa ê Siōng-tè, góa ê pó-lúi; lí sī-án-chóaⁿ pàng-sak góa? Góa sī-án-chóaⁿ tio̍h in-ūi tùi-te̍k ê ap-pek pi-siong kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì?
Kiû lí hián-chhut lí ê kng kap chin-si̍t lâi ín-chhōa góa, chhōa góa khì lí ê sèng-soaⁿ, kàu lí ê hōe-bō͘.
Góa chiū lâi Siōng-tè ê chè-tôaⁿ, kàu góa ke̍k-tōa hoaⁿ-hí ê Siōng-tè hia. Siōng-tè, góa ê Siōng-tè ah, góa beh tôaⁿ-khîm chheng-chàn lí.

Góa ê sim ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ ut-chut, sī-án-chóaⁿ tī góa lāi-bīn haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan? Tio̍h gióng-bōng Siōng-tè; góa iáu-kú beh chheng-chàn I, in-ūi I sī góa ê Chín-kiù-chiá, góa ê Siōng-tè.
Siōng-tè ah, lí tī kó͘-chá, goán ê chó͘-sian ê sî só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì, goán ū chhin-hī thiaⁿ--kìⁿ; goán ê lia̍t-chó͘ ū tùi goán kóng-khí:
Lí ū ēng lí ê chhiú kóaⁿ-cháu lia̍t-pang lâi chai-pôe goán ê chó͘-sian, ū kàng chai-hō hō͘ hiah-ê bîn-cho̍k lâi hō͘ goán ê lia̍t-chó͘ hoat-tián.
In m̄-sī khò ka-kī ê to-kiàm tit-tio̍h thó͘-tōe, mā m̄-sī ēng chhiú-kut kiù ka-kī; sī lí ê chiàⁿ-chhiú, lí ê chhiú-kut, lí ê bīn ê kng kiù in; in-ūi lí ì-ài in.
Siōng-tè ah, lí sī góa ê Ông; kiû lí chhut bēng-lēng chín-kiù Ngá-kok.
Goán khò lí chhia-tó goán ê tùi-te̍k, khò lí ê miâ thún-ta̍h kong-kek goán ê lâng.
Góa bô óa-khò góa ê keng; góa ê to mā bōe kiù góa.
Lí ū kiù goán thoat-lī tùi-te̍k, hō͘ oàn-hūn goán ê lâng sit-pāi kiàn-siàu.
Goán beh kui-ji̍t khoa-kháu Siōng-tè, beh éng-oán chheng-chàn lí ê miâ.
M̄-kú hiān-chāi lí pàng-sak goán, hō͘ goán siū lêng-jio̍k; lí bô kap goán ê kun-peng tàu-tīn chhut-chiàn.
Lí hō͘ goán tī tùi-te̍k ê bīn-chêng oa̍t-thâu tô-cháu, chhut-chāi oàn-hūn goán ê lâng chhiúⁿ-toa̍t.
Lí hō͘ goán chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ hō͘ lâng thun-chia̍h; lí kā goán kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ khì lia̍t-pang.
Lí kā lí ê chú-bîn sio̍k-sio̍k-á bōe, lí kiám ū tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h lī-ek?
Lí hō͘ goán siū keh-piah kok lêng-jio̍k, hō͘ sì-ûi ê lâng thí-chhiò ki-chhì.
Lí hō͘ goán tī lia̍t-pang tiong chòe chhiò-khe, hō͘ in tùi goán hàiⁿ-thâu.
In-ūi lóe-mē, húi-pòng ê lâng ê siaⁿ, in-ūi tùi-te̍k kap pò-oan ê lâng ê iân-kò͘, goán kui-ji̍t siū lêng-jio̍k, móa-bīn kiàn-siàu.
Chiah-ê lóng lîm-kàu goán, goán iáu bô bōe-kì-tit lí, mā bô ûi-hoán lí ê iok.
Goán ê sim bô ûi-pōe lí; goán ê kha-pō͘ bô phian-lī lí ê lō͘.
Lí kèng-jiân kā goán phah-tó tī chhâi-lông chhut-ji̍p ê só͘-chāi, ēng sí ê ìm-ńg tà goán.
Goán nā bōe-kì-tit goán ê Siōng-tè ê miâ, chhun-chhiú hoan-gêng pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng,
Siōng-tè kiám khòaⁿ bōe chhut? I it-tēng chai lâng sim-lāi ê pì-bi̍t.
Goán in-ūi lí ê iân-kò͘ kui-ji̍t siū sat-hāi; lâng khòaⁿ goán chhin-chhiūⁿ beh hō͘ lâng thâi ê iûⁿ.
Chú ah, lí tio̍h cheng-sîn, ná iáu-teh khùn? Kiû lí khí--lâi, m̄-thang éng-oán pàng-sak goán.
Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ oa̍t-thâu m̄ chhap goán? Sī-án-chóaⁿ bōe-kì-tit goán só͘ siū ê ap-chè kap khó͘-lān?
Goán í-keng phak tī thô͘-hún, pak-tó͘ tah tī thô͘-kha.
Kiû lí khí-lâi pang-chān goán, in-ūi lí ê chû-ài, kiû lí kiù-sio̍k goán.
Góa ê sim chhèng-chhut bí-hó ê ōe; góa beh chhiùⁿ ūi-tio̍h ông chòe ê si, góa ê chi̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ chok-ka láu-liān ê pit.
Lí pí só͘-ū ê ta-po͘-lâng khah phiau-phiat, lí kóng ê ōe chin iu-ngá; só͘-í Siōng-tè sù-hok lí, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
Tōa koân-lêng ê ông, io tio̍h hâ kiàm, hián-sī lí ê êng-kng kap ui-giâm.
Ūi-tio̍h chin-lí, khiam-pi, kong-gī, lí ui-giâm khiâ-bé chìn-chêng, pek-chiàn-pek-sèng; lí ê chiàⁿ-chhiú chòe thang kiaⁿ-ùi ê sū.
Lí ê chìⁿ chin lāi, siā-thàng ông tùi-te̍k ê sim, hō͘ in lóng tó tī lí kha-ē.
Lí ê pó-chō sī Siōng-tè só͘ sù, sòa kàu éng-éng-oán-oán; lí ê kok ê koân-pèng sī chèng-ti̍t ê koân-pèng.
Lí ì-ài kong-gī, iàm-ò͘ⁿ put-hoat. Só͘-í Siōng-tè — lí ê Siōng-tè ēng hoaⁿ-hí ê iû boah lí, chhiau-kè boah lí ê tâng-phōaⁿ.
Lí ê i-ho̍k ū bu̍t-io̍h, tîm-hiuⁿ, jio̍k-kùi ê phang-bī; tùi chhiūⁿ-gê ê ông-kiong ū hiân-ga̍k hō͘ lí hoaⁿ-hí.
Lí ông-hui ê tiong-kan ū lia̍t-kok ê kong-chú; ông-hō͘ ēng siōng-sûn ê kim chng-thāⁿ, khiā tī lí chiàⁿ-pêng.
Cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, tio̍h chim-chiok thiaⁿ, siông-sè siūⁿ; tio̍h bōe-kì-tit lí ê peh-sìⁿ kap lí lāu-pē ê ke.
Ông ōe loân-bō͘ lí ê súi; i sī lí ê chú, lí tio̍h sūn-ho̍k.
Thài-ní ê jîn-bîn ōe lâi sàng lé-mi̍h; peh-sìⁿ tiong ê hó-gia̍h-lâng ōe lâi tùi lí kiû un-chêng.
Ông ê sin-niû tī kiong-lāi hui-siông êng-hôa; i chhēng kim-sòaⁿ siù ê lé-ho̍k.
I chhēng siù-hoe ê lé-ho̍k hō͘ lâng chhōa kàu ông bīn-chêng; phōaⁿ-kè ê chāi-sek-lú tè tī āu-bīn mā lâi kàu lí bīn-chêng.
In hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, hō͘ lâng chhōa-ji̍p ông-kiong.
Lí ê kiáⁿ-sun ōe sòa-chiap lí ê lia̍t-chó͘; lí beh siat-li̍p in tī choân-tōe chòe ông.
Góa beh hō͘ lí ê miâ tāi-tāi siū kì-liām; bān-bîn ōe éng-éng-oán-oán chheng-chàn lí.
Siōng-tè sī lán ê pī-lān-só͘, lán ê khùi-la̍t, sī hoān-lān tiong ki̍p-sî ê pang-chān.
Sui-jiân tōe tōa piàn-tōng, soaⁿ sóa kàu hái-tiong,
hái-chúi giâ-éng hōa-hōa-háu, soaⁿ in-ūi hái-tiòng iô-choah, lán lóng bián kiaⁿ.
Ū chi̍t tiâu hô, i ê chúi-liû hō͘ Siōng-tè ê siâⁿ hoaⁿ-hí; chiū-sī Chì-koân Siōng-tè khiā-khí sèng ê só͘-chāi.
Siōng-tè tiàm tī hia, siâⁿ it-tēng bōe iô-tāng; thiⁿ phú-kng, Siōng-tè chiū pang-chān i.
Lia̍t-pang hōa-hōa-háu, lia̍t-kok tōng-iâu; Siōng-tè chhut-siaⁿ, tōe chiū siau-iûⁿ.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kap lán tông-chāi; Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè chòe lán ê iàu-sài.
Lâi, lâi khòaⁿ Siōng Chú ê só͘-chòe, khòaⁿ I tī tōe-chiūⁿ kî-biāu ê chok-ûi.
I at-chi̍h keng, chām-tn̄g chhiuⁿ, pàng-hé sio chiàn-chhia; I hō͘ chiàn-cheng lóng soah, choân-tōe hô-pêng.
I kóng, “Lóng chēng-chēng! Tio̍h chai góa sī Siōng-tè! Góa tī lia̍t-pang siū chun-chông, tī choân-tōe siū chun chòe tōa.”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kap lán tông-chāi; Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè chòe lán ê iàu-sài.
Bān-bîn ah, lín lóng tio̍h phah-pho̍k-á; tio̍h ēng hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ tōa-siaⁿ tùi Siōng-tè hoan-ho͘.
Siōng Chú — Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè eng-kai siū kèng-ùi; I sī tōa Kun-ông, thóng-tī choân-tōe.
I hō͘ bān-bîn hâng-ho̍k goán, hō͘ lia̍t-pang khut-ho̍k tī goán kha-ē.
I ūi-tio̍h goán kéng èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe, chòe I só͘ thiàⁿ ê chú-bîn khoa-iāu ê sán-gia̍p.
Siōng-tè chiūⁿ-khì chē pó-chō, bān-bîn tōa-siaⁿ hoan-ho͘; Siōng Chú chiūⁿ-khì chē ông-ūi, sàu-kak lóng tōa tân.
Lín tio̍h chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn Siōng-tè, chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn; tio̍h chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló lán ê Ông, chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló.
Siōng-tè sī choân-tōe ê Ông, tio̍h ēng si-koa chheng-chàn I.
Siōng-tè chē tī sèng ê pó-chō; Siōng-tè choh-ông thóng-tī bān-kok.
Lia̍t-pang ê kùi-cho̍k chū-chi̍p, beh chòe A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn; in-ūi tōe-chiūⁿ ê kun-ông lóng kui-sio̍k I. Siōng-tè tōa-tōa siū chun-chông!
Siōng Chú chì-tōa, tī lán Siōng-tè ê siâⁿ, tī I sèng ê soaⁿ, eng-kai tōa-tōa siū chheng-chàn.
Sek-an-soaⁿ tī pak-bīn, koân koh hó-khòaⁿ, choân-tōe só͘ hoaⁿ-hí, tōa Kun-ông ê siâⁿ.
Siōng-tè tī siâⁿ ê iàu-sài teh kò͘-siú, hō͘ lâng chai I sī pī-lān-só͘.
Khòaⁿ ah, lia̍t-ông chū-chi̍p, tàu-tīn chìn-kun beh kong-siâⁿ.
In chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê siâⁿ chiū gông-ngia̍h, kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kóaⁿ-kín tô-cháu.
In tī hia ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhui-chūn ê hū-jîn-lâng thàng-thiàⁿ,
chhin-chhiūⁿ Tha-si ê chûn hō͘ tang-hong phah-phòa.

Tī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê siâⁿ-lāi, tī lán Siōng-tè ê siâⁿ-tiong, lán bat thiaⁿ--tio̍h, hiān-chāi chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h, Siōng-tè beh kò͘-siú chit-ê siâⁿ kàu éng-oán.
Siōng-tè ah, tī lí ê tiān-lāi, goán siàu-liām lí ê chû-ài.
Siōng-tè ah, lí ê miâ thoân kàu choân-tōe, o-ló ê siaⁿ thàu kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak. Lí ê thóng-tī chhiong-móa kong-gī,
lí ê phòaⁿ-toàn chèng-khak, Sek-an-soaⁿ tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí, Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-chhī tio̍h khoài-lo̍k.
Lín tio̍h se̍h Sek-an, chiu-ûi se̍h chi̍t lìn, tiám-sǹg siâⁿ-thah,
koan-chhat siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, him-sióng pó-lúi, thang hō͘ lín tùi hō͘-tāi soan-kò:
Chit-ūi Siōng-tè sī lán éng-éng-oán-oán ê Siōng-tè, I ōe éng-oán ín-chhōa lán.
Bān-bîn ah, lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ; sè-chiūⁿ lóng-chóng ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ.
Bô-lūn pi-chiān chun-kùi, hó-gia̍h sàn-chhiah, lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ.
Góa ê chhùi beh kóng tì-hūi ê ōe; góa ê sim beh siūⁿ bêng-lí ê sū.
Góa beh àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ phì-jū, tôaⁿ-khîm kóe-seh ò-pì.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ēng khúi-chà pau-ûi góa, tī hoān-lān ê ji̍t, góa mā m̄ kiaⁿ.
In óa-khò châi-hù, khoa-kháu hó-gia̍h;
in bô chi̍t ê ū hoat-tō͘ sio̍k-hôe ka-kī, mā bōe-tàng ēng chîⁿ tùi Siōng-tè sio̍k-hôe sìⁿ-miā.
In-ūi sio̍k-hôe sìⁿ-miā ê kè-chîⁿ siuⁿ kùi, éng-oán hù bōe khí;
lâng bōe-tàng kú-tn̂g oa̍h--teh, bián siū húi-bia̍t.
Ū lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h tì-hūi ê lâng sí, gû-gōng bû-ti ê lâng mā lóng bia̍t-bông, chîⁿ-châi lóng lâu hō͘ pa̍t-lâng.
In siūⁿ-kóng in ê chhù ōe éng-oán lâu--teh, in khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi ōe sòa kàu bān-tāi, só͘-í ēng ka-kī ê miâ hō ka-kī ê tōe.
M̄-kú lâng bōe-tàng kú-tn̂g hióng-siū hù-kùi, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ cheng-siⁿ sí--khì.
Che sī óa-khò ka-kī ê lâng só͘ kiâⁿ ê lō͘, sī chàn-tông in ê ōe ê lâng ê kiat-kio̍k.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ chù-tiāⁿ lo̍h Im-hú ê iûⁿ, Sí-bông chòe in ê bo̍k-chiá chhōa in chi̍t-lō͘ kàu hûn-bōng; in ê seng-khu tī Im-hú siau-bia̍t, bô koh ū khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.
M̄-kú Siōng-tè ōe sio̍k-hôe góa thoat-lī Im-hú ê koân-sè; in-ūi I ōe chiap-la̍p góa.
Lâng hoat-châi, ka-têng ke-thiⁿ kong-chhái; lí m̄-bián in-ūi án-ni tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
In-ūi i sí ê sî, bô chi̍t hāng tòa ōe khì; i ê êng-hôa bōe tè i khì.
Sui-jiân i chāi-siⁿ ka-kī khoa-iāu ū hok-khì, sêng-kong tit-tio̍h lâng ê o-ló,
i chòe-āu mā tio̍h khì kìⁿ in chó͘-kong, éng-oán bōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ kng.
Lâng bōe-tàng kú-tn̂g hióng-siū hù-kùi, i ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ cheng-siⁿ sí--khì.
Siōng Chú — Choân-lêng ê Siōng-tè tùi tang kàu sai chhut-siaⁿ, ho͘-tiàu choân-tōe.
Tùi súi bô-pí ê Sek-an, Siōng-tè hoat-chhut kng.
Lán ê Siōng-tè lâi-lîm, it-tēng bōe chēng-chēng; ū iām-hé tī I bīn-chêng teh to̍h, ū pō-hong tī I sì-ûi teh sàu.
Ūi-tio̍h beh sím-phòaⁿ I ê chú-bîn, I tiàu thiⁿ kap tōe lâi choh-chèng.
I kóng, “Tio̍h tiàu-chi̍p góa sèng ê chú-bîn lâi góa chia, chiū-sī ēng chè-sū kap góa li̍p-iok ê lâng.”
Thiⁿ beh hián-bêng I ê kong-gī; in-ūi Siōng-tè pún-sin sī Sím-phòaⁿ-chiá.
“Góa ê chú-bîn ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ, góa beh kóng; Í-sek-lia̍t ah, góa beh khòng-kò lí. Góa sī Siōng-tè, lí ê Siōng-tè.
Góa bô in-ūi lí ê chè-sū chek-pī lí; lí ê sio-hòa-chè sî-siông tī góa ê bīn-chêng.
Góa m̄-bián tùi lí ê gû-tiâu chiap-siū kang ê gû, mā m̄-bián tùi lí ê iûⁿ-tiâu chiap-siū kang ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ.
In-ūi chhiū-nâ lāi ê pah-siù, chèng-soaⁿ ê cheng-siⁿ lóng sio̍k góa.
Soaⁿ-lāi ê pe-chiáu, góa lóng bat; khòng-iá ê cháu-siù mā lóng sio̍k góa.
“Góa nā iau, mā bōe kā lí kóng; in-ūi sè-kài kap bān-mi̍h lóng sio̍k góa.
Góa kiám ōe chia̍h gû-káng ê bah, lim soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng ê huih?
Lí tio̍h ēng kám-siā chòe chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè; tio̍h tùi Chì-koân-chiá siā-goān.
Tī hoān-lān ê ji̍t, lí tio̍h kiû-kiò góa; góa beh kiù lí, lí mā tio̍h chun-chông góa.”
M̄-kú Siōng-tè tùi pháiⁿ-lâng kóng, “Lí ná ū koân liām góa ê kui-lē, chhùi kóng góa ê iok?
Kî-si̍t lí iàm-ò͘ⁿ kà-sī, chiong góa ê ōe tàn tī ka-chiah-āu.
Lí kìⁿ-tio̍h chha̍t chiū kap i tâng-sim, kap kiâⁿ kan-îm ê lâng tàu-tīn.
“Lí ê chhùi kóng pháiⁿ-ōe; lí ê chi̍h chè-chō kan-chà.
Lí sûi-piān kóng hiaⁿ-tī ê sī-hui, bû-lōa lí ê chhin-lâng.

Lí chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì, góa tiām-tiām bô chhut-siaⁿ, lí soah siūⁿ-kóng góa kap lí kâng-khoán. M̄-kú góa beh chek-pī lí, chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì pâi tī lí ê ba̍k-chiu chêng.
“Lín chiah-ê bōe-kì-tit Siōng-tè ê lâng ah, tio̍h siūⁿ chit-ê sū, chiah bián góa chiong lín thiah-chhùi, bô lâng thang kiù lín.
Só͘-ū ēng kám-siā hiàn-chè ê lâng sī teh chun-chông góa; kiâⁿ chiàⁿ-lō͘ ê lâng, góa beh hō͘ i tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê chín-kiù.”
Siōng-tè ah, lí ê thiàⁿ bōe kái-piàn, kiû lí lîn-bín góa! Lí ū hong-hù ê chû-ài, kiû lí chhat-siau góa ê chōe-kò!
Kiû lí sóe-tû góa it-chhè ê chōe, sóe-chheng góa ê chōe-ok.
Góa chai ka-kī ê kè-sit; góa ê chōe-ok put-sî tī góa ê ba̍k-chiu chêng.
Góa ū tek-chōe lí, góa tek-chōe--ê sī lí; góa ū chòe lí khòaⁿ-chòe siâ-ok ê tāi-chì. Só͘-í, góa siū lí sím-phòaⁿ sī tong-jiân, siū lí chek-hoa̍t sī eng-kai.
Góa tī bú-thai chiū ū chōe, chhut-sì hit-ji̍t chiū-sī chōe-jîn.
Lí ì-ài--ê sī lāi-sim sêng-si̍t; kiû lí kà-sī góa, hō͘ góa sim-lāi ū chin-chiàⁿ ê tì-hūi.
Kiû lí sóe-tû góa ê chōe, hō͘ góa chheng-khì; kiû lí kā góa sóe chheng-khì, hō͘ góa pí seh khah pe̍h.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k ê siaⁿ, hō͘ lí phah-chhùi ê kut-thâu koh-chài hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
Kiû lí bīn oa̍t-cháu bô khòaⁿ góa ê chōe; kiû lí chhat-siau góa it-chhè ê chōe-ok.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí ūi góa chhòng-chō sûn-kiat ê sim; kiû lí sù góa sin koh tiong-sêng ê sim-lêng.
M̄-thang kóaⁿ góa lī-khui lí ê bīn-chêng; m̄-thang tùi góa siu-hôe lí sèng ê sîn.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa têng-sin hióng-siū lí kiù-un ê hoaⁿ-hí, hō͘ góa ê sim-lêng goān-ì sūn-ho̍k lí.
Góa beh chiong lí ê tō-lō͘ chí-sī hoān kè-sit ê lâng, hō͘ chōe-jîn thang kui-ǹg lí.
Chín-kiù góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí bián-tû góa ê sí-chōe, hō͘ góa thang tōa-siaⁿ chheng-chàn lí ê chín-kiù.
Chú ah, kiû lí khui góa ê chhùi; góa beh chheng-chàn lí.
Lí bô ài seng-lé, nā ài, góa hoaⁿ-hí hiàn; góa nā hiàn sio-hòa-chè, lí mā bô hoaⁿ-hí.
Siōng-tè ah, lí só͘ ài ê chè sī thòng-hóe ê sim-lêng; iu-siong thòng-hóe ê sim, lí hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí ēng chû-ài hó khoán-thāi Sek-an, tiông-kiàn Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ.
Hit-sî, lí beh chiap-la̍p ha̍p-gî ê seng-lé, choân hù ê sio-hòa-chè; lâng beh chiong gû-káng hiàn tī lí ê chè-tôaⁿ.
Ū koân-le̍k ê lâng ah, sī-án-chóaⁿ lí kui-ji̍t ūi-tio̍h chòe pháiⁿ-tāi teh khoa-kháu? Siōng-tè ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
Lí chè-chō sī-hui tô͘-bô͘ húi-hoāi; lí ê chi̍h chin lāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ thì-thâu-to.
Lí ài pháiⁿ iâⁿ-kè hó, ài pe̍h-chha̍t iâⁿ-kè kóng gī-lí.
Khi-phiàn ê lâng ah, lí ài kóng it-chhè thun-chia̍h lâng ê ōe.
Siōng-tè ōe lia̍h lí, tùi pò͘-pîⁿ kā lí thoa--chhut-lâi, tùi oa̍h-lâng ê tōe kā lí pu̍ih--khí-lâi. I ōe éng-oán kā lí húi-bia̍t.
Gī ê lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h ōe kiaⁿ-ùi, thí-chhiò lí, kóng,
“Lí khòaⁿ leh, che chiū-sī bô óa-khò Siōng-tè, chí-ū óa-khò ka-kī châi-hù ê lâng; i óa-khò--ê hoán-tńg tì-kàu ka-kī húi-bia̍t.”
M̄-kú góa, chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè tiān-lāi chhiⁿ-chhùi ê kaⁿ-ná-chhiū, beh éng-éng-oán-oán óa-khò Siōng-tè ê chû-ài.
In-ūi lí án-ni tùi-thāi góa, góa beh éng-oán kám-siā lí. Góa beh tī lí sèng ê chú-bîn bīn-chêng gióng-bōng lí ê miâ; in-ūi lí ê miâ chin hó.
Gōng-lâng sim-lāi kóng, “Bô Siōng-tè.” In lóng hú-pāi, chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê tāi-chì, bô kah chi̍t ê chòe hó.
Siōng-tè tùi thiⁿ àⁿ lo̍h-lâi khòaⁿ sè-kan-lâng, beh khòaⁿ ū bêng-lí, ū chhē-kiû Siōng-tè ê lâng á bô.
In ta̍k-ê lâng lóng kiâⁿ bê-lō͘, pîⁿ-pîⁿ pìⁿ-chòe ù-òe; bô lâng chòe hó, liân chi̍t ê to bô.
Chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng kiám lóng m̄ chai? In thun-chia̍h góa ê chú-bîn chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chia̍h-pn̄g; in bô kiû-kiò Siōng-tè.
In tī m̄-bián kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ê sî tōa kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; in-ūi Siōng-tè ū chiong pau-ûi kong-kek lí ê lâng ê kut-thâu iā-sòaⁿ; in ōe kiàn-siàu sit-pāi, in-ūi Siōng-tè khì-sak in.
Goān Í-sek-lia̍t ê chín-kiù tùi Sek-an chhut! Goān Siōng-tè chhōa I siū-lia̍h ê chú-bîn tò-tńg--lâi! Hit-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t ōe hoaⁿ-hí, Ngá-kok ōe khoài-lo̍k!
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí in-ūi lí ê miâ chín-kiù góa, ēng lí ê koân-pèng thòe góa sin-oan.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó, àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa só͘ kóng ê ōe.
In-ūi siⁿ-hūn-lâng khí-lâi kong-kek góa, chân-jím ê lâng siàu-siūⁿ góa ê sìⁿ-miā; in gán-tiong bô Siōng-tè.
Siōng-tè khak-si̍t sī góa ê pang-chān; Chú sī góa ê pó-hō͘-chiá.
Kiû lí ēng góa ê tùi-te̍k tùi góa só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ kā in pò-èng, chiàu lí ê sìn-si̍t kā in húi-bia̍t.
Góa beh kam-sim lo̍k-ì hiàn chè-mi̍h hō͘ lí; Siōng Chú ah, góa beh kám-siā chheng-chàn lí ê miâ, in-ūi lí sī hó.
Lí ū kiù góa thoat-chhut it-chhè ê hoān-lān; góa ū chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê tùi-te̍k bia̍t-bông.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó, m̄-thang bih--khí-lâi, m̄ thiaⁿ góa ê khún-kiû.
Kiû lí thiaⁿ góa, ìn góa; góa chhau-hoân ut-chut, sim put-an,
lóng sī in-ūi tùi-te̍k háng-hoah, pháiⁿ-lâng ap-chè; in chiong chōe-kò thia̍p khí-lâi teh góa; in hoat siū-khì khún-pek góa.
Góa ê sim kiáu-ká thòng-khó͘; sí-bông ê kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ lîm-kàu góa.
Kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah pau-ûi góa; khióng-pò͘ khàm-ba̍t góa.
Góa kóng, “Góa chin ài chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu ū si̍t, thang pe-khì chhē-tio̍h an-hioh ê só͘-chāi.
Góa beh pe-khì hn̄g-hn̄g, hioh tī khòng-iá,
kín kàu pī-lān ê só͘-chāi, thang thoat-lī kông-hong-pō-ú.”
Chú ah, kiû lí phah-loān in ê gú-giân, hō͘ in ê ōe hūn-loān; in-ūi góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h siâⁿ-lāi ū kiông-pō hun-cheng,
pháiⁿ-lâng mî-ji̍t tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng kiâⁿ-se̍h, siâⁿ-lāi chhiong-móa chai-lān siâ-ok.
Siâⁿ-lāi tò-chhù ū phò-hoāi; koe-lō͘ ta̍k-ūi ū ap-chè kap kan-chà.
Bú-jio̍k góa--ê m̄-sī tùi-te̍k, nā sī, góa mā iáu ōe-tàng iông-jím. Chū-ko khòaⁿ-khin góa--ê m̄-sī oàn-hūn góa ê lâng, nā sī, góa mā iáu ōe-tàng siám-khui.
Bô phah-sǹg sī lí, kap góa kâng sin-hūn ê lâng, sī góa ê tâng-phōaⁿ, góa ti-kí ê pêng-iú.
Lán í-chêng siông-siông hō͘-siōng chhin-bi̍t tâm-lūn, kap chèng-lâng tī Siōng-tè ê tiān chòe-hé kèng-pài.
Goān sí-bông hut-jiân lîm-kàu in, hō͘ in oa̍h-oa̍h lo̍h Im-hú; in-ūi in khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi chhiong-móa siâ-ok.
Góa leh, góa beh kiû-kiò Siōng-tè; Siōng Chú ōe kiù góa.
Ē-hng, chá-khí, tiong-tàu, góa ai-siong thó͘-khùi; I lóng ōe thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ.
Sui-jiân hoán-tùi góa ê lâng chin chōe, I ōe kiù-sio̍k góa ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī kong-kek góa ê lâng, hō͘ góa pêng-an tò-tńg--lâi.
Tùi kó͘-chá éng-oán chûn-chāi ê Siōng-tè ōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, mā ōe kā in pò-èng; in-ūi in m̄ kái-piàn, bô beh kèng-ùi Siōng-tè.
In chhun-chhiú kong-kek ka-kī ê tâng-phōaⁿ, ûi-pōe kap in li̍p ê iok.
In ê chhùi chhin-chhiūⁿ iû ku̍t-liu-liu; in ê sim chhàng oàn-hūn; in ê ōe pí iû khah jiû-nńg, kî-si̍t sī pu̍ih--chhut-lâi ê to.
Tio̍h chiong lí ê tàⁿ sià hō͘ Siōng Chú; I ōe hû-chhî lí, choa̍t-tùi bōe hō͘ gī-lâng sit-pāi.
Thâi-sí lâng--ê kap kan-chà ê lâng bōe oa̍h kàu tiong-liân; Siōng-tè ah, lí ōe hō͘ in hām-lo̍h tī sí-bông ê Chhim-khiⁿ. Nā-sī góa, góa beh óa-khò lí.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí lîn-bín góa, in-ūi lâng thún-ta̍h góa, kui-ji̍t kong-kek ap-chè góa.
Góa ê tùi-te̍k kui-ji̍t thún-ta̍h góa; Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè ah, kong-kek góa ê lâng chin chōe.
Góa kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ê sî, góa beh óa-khò lí.
Góa óa-khò Siōng-tè, góa beh chheng-chàn I èng-ún ê ōe; óa-khò Siōng-tè, góa chiū bô kiaⁿ. Ōe-sí ê lâng ōe-tàng kā góa án-chóaⁿ?
In kui-ji̍t oai-khiok góa ê ōe, só͘ siūⁿ--ê lóng sī beh hāi góa.
In chū-chi̍p, bâi-ho̍k, teh siòng góa ê kha-pō͘, tng-tán beh hāi góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
In chòe pháiⁿ kiám ōe-tàng tô-thoat? Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí hoat siū-khì hō͘ chiah-ê tùi-te̍k khut-ho̍k.
Góa ê pi-siong, lí ū kì-lio̍k; kiû lí chiong góa ê ba̍k-sái siu tī lí ê phê-tē. Chiah-ê kiám bô lóng kì tī lí ê chheh?
Góa kiû-kiò ê sî, tùi-te̍k lóng ōe oa̍t-tńg-sin thè--khì; góa chai, Siōng-tè ūi góa.
Góa óa-khò Siōng-tè, góa beh chheng-chàn I èng-ún ê ōe; góa óa-khò Siōng Chú, góa beh o-ló I ê ōe.
Góa óa-khò Siōng-tè, góa chiū bōe kiaⁿ; lâng ōe-tàng kā góa án-chóaⁿ?
Siōng-tè ah, góa beh chiàu góa ǹg lí só͘ hē ê goān, tùi lí hiàn siā-un ê chè.
In-ūi lí ū kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī sí-bông, pó-hō͘ góa ê kha bô poa̍h-tó, hō͘ góa tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā ê kng ín-chhōa, kiâⁿ tī lí bīn-chêng.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí khó-lîn góa, khó-lîn góa; góa beh bih tī lí hia, bih tī lí si̍t-kó͘ ê pó-hō͘-ē, thèng-hāu chai-lān lóng kè--khì.
Góa beh kiû-kiò Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè, ta̍k-hāng sū lóng kā góa oân-sêng ê Siōng-tè.
Siōng-tè ōe tùi thiⁿ si-un kiù góa, hō͘ thún-ta̍h góa ê lâng sit-pāi kiàn-siàu. Siōng-tè ōe tùi góa si-lo̍h chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t.
Góa tó tī hiong-ok ê lâng tiong-kan, in chhin-chhiūⁿ sai tng-tán beh thun-chia̍h lâng; in ê chhùi-khí chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiuⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ chìⁿ, in ê chi̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ lāi ê to.
Siōng-tè ah, goān lí ê úi-tāi pôaⁿ-kè thiⁿ, lí ê êng-kng piàn-chiò choân-tōe.
In tī góa ê kha-chêng siat lô-bāng, beh hō͘ góa khut-ho̍k; tī góa ê bīn-chêng khui hām-khiⁿ, ka-kī tian-tò poa̍h-lo̍h hit lāi-bīn.
Siōng-tè ah, góa ê sim pêng-chēng, góa ê sim kian-tēng; góa beh gîm-si, góa beh chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn.
Góa ê sim-sîn ah, tio̍h chhíⁿ--khí-lâi! Khîm ah, sek ah, tio̍h chhíⁿ--khí-lâi! Góa beh kā ji̍t-thâu kiò-chhíⁿ.
Chú ah, góa beh tī bān-bîn tiong kám-siā lí, tī lia̍t-pang tiong chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí.
Lí ê chû-ài ná thiⁿ hiah-ni̍h koân; lí ê sìn-si̍t thàu kàu kiong-chhong.
Siōng-tè ah, goān lí ê úi-tāi pôaⁿ-kè thiⁿ; goān lí ê êng-kng piàn-chiò choân-tōe.
Chip-chèng-chiá, lín kiám ū chin-chiàⁿ teh kóng kong-gī? Kiám ū chiàu kong-pêng sím-phòaⁿ lâng?
Bô, lín sim-lāi kè-ōe chòe pháiⁿ tāi-chì, tī tōe-chiūⁿ, lín ēng chhiú tùi lâng si kiông-pō.
Pháiⁿ-lâng tùi chhut bú-thai chiū kiâⁿ bê-lō͘; chi̍t-ē lī-khui lāu-bú ê pak-tó͘ chiū kiâⁿ phian-lō͘, kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.
In ê to̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ chôa ê to̍k; in chhin-chhiūⁿ to̍k-chôa that-ba̍t ka-kī ê hī-khang,
m̄ thiaⁿ lāng-chôa ê lâng, á-sī gâu liām-chiù ê lâng ê siaⁿ.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí phah-chi̍h in ê chhùi-khí; Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí kòng-tn̄g béng-sai ê tōa-ki gê-khí.
Goān in siau-sit chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi lâu-liáu-liáu, chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu siū thún-ta̍h ta--khì.
Goān in chhin-chhiūⁿ lō͘-lê sô--kè ê jiah liâm-piⁿ bô--khì; chhin-chhiūⁿ hū-jîn-lâng liû-sán ê thai bô kìⁿ-tio̍h thiⁿ-ji̍t.
Lín ēng chhì-á hiâⁿ-hé, tiáⁿ iáu-bē jia̍t, I beh ēng kńg-lê-á-hong, chiong tâm--ê kap ta--ê chòe-chi̍t-ē sàu--khì.
Gī-lâng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ in siū pò-èng chiū hoaⁿ-hí; i ēng pháiⁿ-lâng lâu ê huih sóe-kha.
Lâng chiū kóng, gī-lâng chin-chiàⁿ ū hó-pò; tī tōe-bīn-chiūⁿ Siōng-tè kó-jiân ū teh sím-phòaⁿ.
Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī góa ê tùi-te̍k, kā góa an-tì tī koân ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ góa thoat-lī khí-lâi kong-kek góa ê lâng.
Kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng, kiù góa thoat-lī ài hāi lâng sìⁿ-miā ê lâng.
In bâi-ho̍k beh hāi góa ê sìⁿ-miā; hiong-ok ê lâng chū-chi̍p lâi kong-kek góa, m̄-kú Siōng Chú ah, che m̄-sī in-ūi góa ê kè-sit á-sī chōe-kò.
Góa sui-jiân bô kè-sit, in chhiong-lâi beh hāi góa. Kín khí--lâi, khòaⁿ góa ê khùn-kéng lâi pang-chān góa!
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè ah, kín khí-lâi chhú-hoa̍t te̍k-tùi lí ê lia̍t-pang! Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ah, m̄-thang khoan-sià só͘-ū kan-chà ê pháiⁿ-lâng.
In àm-sî tò--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ káu teh pūi, tī siâⁿ-lāi kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì.
In ê chhùi thò͘-chhut ê ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lāi ê to; in siūⁿ, “Kiám ū lâng teh thiaⁿ?”
M̄-kú Siōng Chú lí beh chhiò in; lí beh thí-chhiò lia̍t-pang.
Siōng-tè — góa ê khùi-la̍t ah, góa beh gióng-bōng lí, in-ūi lí sī góa ê pó-lúi.
Góa ê Siōng-tè ōe ēng chû-ài khoán-thāi góa; Siōng-tè ōe hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ tùi-te̍k siū pò-èng.
M̄-thang châu-bia̍t in, chiah bián góa ê chú-bîn bōe-kì--tit. Chú — goán ê tún-pâi ah, kiû lí ēng lí ê khùi-la̍t hō͘ in sì-kòe liû-lōng koh sit-sè.
In in-ūi chhùi hoān ê chōe kap chhùi-tûn kóng ê ōe, ōe poa̍h-lo̍h ka-kī ê kiau-ngō͘ só͘ siat ê hām-chíⁿ. In-ūi in só͘ kóng ê chiù-mē kap pe̍h-chha̍t,
kiû lí hoat siū-khì châu-bia̍t in, kā in thiat-tóe siau-bia̍t, hō͘ lâng lóng chai Siōng-tè teh chiáng-koán Í-sek-lia̍t, sīm-chì kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak.
In àm-sî tò--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ káu teh pūi, tī siâⁿ-lāi kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì.
In cháu-lâi-cháu-khì chhē-chia̍h, chia̍h bô pá chiū kui-mî pūi bô-thêng.

M̄-kú góa beh chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí ê khùi-la̍t, chá-khí-sî beh tōa-siaⁿ o-ló lí ê chû-ài; in-ūi lí sī góa ê pó-lúi, tī hoān-lān ê ji̍t chòe góa pī-lān ê só͘-chāi.
Siōng-tè — góa ê khùi-la̍t ah, góa beh chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí, in-ūi lí sī góa ê pó-lúi, sī éng-oán thiàⁿ góa ê Siōng-tè.
Siōng-tè ah, lí ū khì-sak goán, phah-chhùi goán; lí ū tùi goán siū-khì, taⁿ kiû lí koh tńg-lâi goán chia.
Lí kā tōe iô tín-tāng, hō͘ i li̍h--khui; kiû lí siu-pó͘ i ê li̍h-hûn, in-ūi tōe iáu-teh tín-tāng.
Lí ū hō͘ lí ê chú-bîn tú-tio̍h khó͘-lān, ū hō͘ goán lim hō͘ lâng tian-lâi-tian-khì ê chiú.
Lí ūi-tio̍h kèng-ùi lí ê lâng ia̍t tōa-kî, tiàu-chi̍p in, hō͘ in thoat-lī keng-chìⁿ ê kong-kek.
Kiû lí hôe-èng goán, ēng lí tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú chín-kiù goán, hō͘ lí só͘ thiàⁿ ê lâng tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.
Siōng-tè tī I ê sèng-só͘ kóng, “Góa tōa sèng-lī lah! Góa beh hun-koah Sī-kiàm, hun-phòe So͘-kat ê soaⁿ-kok.
Ki-lia̍t sī góa ê, Má-ná-se mā sio̍k góa; Í-hoat-liân sī góa ê thâu-khoe; Iû-tāi sī góa koân-pèng ê koáiⁿ.
Mô͘-ap chòe góa ê e̍k-phûn; góa hiat góa ê ôe tī Í-tong, ǹg Hui-lī-sū hoah sèng-lī ê siaⁿ.”
Siáⁿ-lâng beh chhōa góa ji̍p-khì kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ? Siáⁿ-lâng beh chhōa góa ji̍p-khì Í-tong ê tōe?
Siōng-tè ah, lí kiám ū khì-sak goán? Siōng-tè ah, lí kiám bōe koh kap goán ê kun-tūi tàu-tīn chhut-cheng?
Kiû lí oān-chō͘ goán kong-kek tùi-te̍k, in-ūi lâng ê pang-chān bōe-khò--tit.
Khò Siōng-tè goán chiah ōe tek-sèng; I ōe phah-pāi goán ê tùi-te̍k.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa ê kiû-kiò, àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó.
Góa sim sit-chì ê sî, beh tùi tōe ê chīn-thâu kiû-kiò lí. Kiû lí chhōa góa kàu pí góa khah koân ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ.
In-ūi lí sī góa ê pī-lān-só͘, chòe góa kian-kò͘ ê pó-lúi thang tí-khòng tùi-te̍k.
Góa beh éng-oán tòa tī lí ê pò͘-pîⁿ, bih tī lí ê si̍t-kó͘-ē.
Siōng-tè ah, góa só͘ hē ê goān lí ū thiaⁿ--kìⁿ; lí ū chiong sán-gia̍p sù hō͘ kèng-ùi lí ê lâng.
Lí beh ke-thiⁿ ông ê hè-siū, hō͘ i ê nî-hè kàu sè-sè-tāi-tāi.
Goān i tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng kú-tn̂g chiáng-koân; goān lí ēng chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t pó-hō͘ i.
Án-ni, góa beh put-sî chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí ê miâ, ji̍t-ji̍t siā góa ê goān.
Góa ê sim-sîn chēng-chēng, choan-sim thèng-hāu Siōng-tè; góa ê chín-kiù sī tùi I lâi.
Chí-ū I sī pó-hō͘ góa ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ, góa ê chín-kiù; I sī góa ê pó-lúi, góa lóng bōe tōng-iâu.
Lín kong-kek chi̍t ê lâng beh kàu sím-mi̍h sî? Lín chhin-chhiūⁿ teh sak khi-chhiâ ê chhiûⁿ, beh-tó ê piah án-ni kā hit-ê lâng húi-hoāi.
Lín tàu-tīn kè-bô͘, it-ti̍t beh kā i tùi chun-kùi ê ūi chhia--lo̍h-khì; lín ài kóng pe̍h-chha̍t. Lín chhùi chiok-hok, sim chiù-chó͘.
Góa ê sim-sîn ah, tio̍h chēng-chēng, choan-sim thèng-hāu Siōng-tè, in-ūi góa ê ǹg-bāng tùi I lâi.
Chí-ū I sī góa ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ, góa ê chín-kiù; I sī góa ê pó-lúi, góa lóng bōe tōng-iâu.
Góa ê chín-kiù, góa ê kong-êng chāi-tī Siōng-tè; I sī góa ê tōa chio̍h-pôaⁿ, góa ê pī-lān-só͘.
Bān-bîn ah, tio̍h put-sî óa-khò I, tùi I thò͘-lō͘ lín ê sim-chêng. Siōng-tè sī lán ê pī-lān-só͘.
Lâng chin-chiàⁿ sī khang-hu, ōe-sí ê lâng lóng sī hu-ké, hē tī thian-phêng it-tēng phû--khí-lâi; in ha̍p--khí-lâi iáu pí ho͘-khip ê khùi khah khin.
M̄-thang khò pō-le̍k, m̄-thang khò chhiúⁿ-toa̍t; châi-pó ke-thiⁿ mā m̄-thang siūⁿ-beh khò i.
Siōng-tè kóng chi̍t hāng, góa thiaⁿ-tio̍h nn̄g hāng: Koân-lêng sio̍k tī Siōng-tè,
chû-ài mā sio̍k tī I. Chú ah, lí beh chiàu ta̍k-lâng ê só͘-chòe kā i pò-èng.

Siōng-tè ah, lí sī góa ê Siōng-tè, góa pek-chhiat tui-chhē lí; chhin-chhiūⁿ tōe khòng-hān bô chúi, góa ê sim-sîn chhùi-ta khat-bō͘ lí; góa ê jio̍k-thé him-bō͘ lí kàu beh hūn--khì.
Só͘-í góa tī sèng-só͘ chhē lí, ài khòaⁿ lí ê koân-lêng kap êng-kng.
Góa ê chhùi-tûn beh siōng-chàn lí, in-ūi lí ê chû-ài pí sìⁿ-miā khah hó.
Góa beh chi̍t-sì-lâng chheng-chàn lí, beh gia̍h-chhiú kiû-kiò lí ê miâ.
Góa ê sim-sîn ōe boán-chiok, chhin-chhiūⁿ hióng-siū hong-sēng ê iàn-se̍k; góa mā beh ēng hoaⁿ-hí ê chhùi-tûn chhiùⁿ-koa siōng-chàn lí.
Góa tó tī bîn-chhn̂g kì-liām lí, mî--sî ta̍k-kiⁿ mā siàu-liām lí.
In-ūi lí ū pang-chān góa, góa beh tī lí ê si̍t-kó͘-ē hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa.
Góa tè lí tè-tiâu-tiâu; lí ê chiàⁿ-chhiú hû-chhî góa.
M̄-kú siàu-siūⁿ góa sìⁿ-miā ê lâng, in ōe hām-lo̍h tī tōe-ē siōng-chhim ê só͘-chāi.
In ōe hō͘ to-kiàm thâi, hō͘ chhâi-lông chia̍h.
Chóng-sī ông ōe in-ūi Siōng-tè lâi hoaⁿ-hí; só͘-ū kí I chiù-chōa ê lâng ōe in-ūi I lâi khoa-kháu; m̄-kú kóng pe̍h-chha̍t ê chhùi ōe siū that-ba̍t.
Siōng-tè ah, góa bâi-oàn ê sî, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ; kiû lí pó-hō͘ góa ê sìⁿ-miā bián kiaⁿ tùi-te̍k ê hām-hāi.
Kiû lí chiong góa khǹg-ba̍t, hō͘ góa thoat-lī siâ-ok ê lâng ê im-bô͘, thoat-lī chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng ê kè-bô͘.
In bôa in ê chi̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ bôa to; in ēng ok-to̍k ê ōe chòe chìⁿ teh biâu-chún,
bâi-ho̍k beh siā bû-ko͘ ê lâng; in hut-jiân siā i, chhiú mā bô chhoah.
In chham-siông pháiⁿ kè-bô͘; àm-tiong siat-kè, tiuⁿ lô-bāng, kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h lán?”
In tô͘-bô͘ pháiⁿ-tāi, kóng, “Goán í-keng ū siūⁿ-chhut siōng cheng-bi̍t ê kè-bô͘.” Lâng ê sim-su liām-thâu si̍t-chāi ū-kàu khúi-chà.
M̄-kú Siōng-tè beh ēng chìⁿ siā in; in ōe hut-jiân tio̍h-siong.
In ōe hō͘ ka-kī kóng ê ōe hāi-sí; khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng lóng ōe iô-thâu.
Chèng-lâng lóng ōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, beh pò-iông Siōng-tè ê só͘-chòe, siông-sè siūⁿ I ê chok-ûi.
Gī-lâng ōe in-ūi Siōng Chú lâi hoaⁿ-hí, mā ōe óa-khò I tit-tio̍h an-choân. Só͘-ū sim chèng-ti̍t ê lâng lóng ōe chheng-chàn I.
Siōng-tè ah, lâng eng-kai tī Sek-an chheng-chàn lí, tùi lí siā só͘ hē ê goān.
Thiaⁿ kî-tó ê Chú ah, choân jîn-lūi lóng beh chiū-kūn lí.
Chōe ap-tó góa; m̄-kú goán ê kè-sit lí lóng beh sià-bián.
Lí só͘ kéng-soán, hō͘ in chhin-kūn lí, tòa tī lí tiān ê tiâⁿ ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! Goán beh in-ūi lí ê chhù, lí ê sèng-tiān ê hok-khì sim-móa-ì-chiok!
Chín-kiù goán ê Siōng-tè ah, lí ēng thang kiaⁿ-ùi ê chok-ûi, si-hêng kong-gī lâi ìn-tap goán; tōe-ke̍k kap hái-bīn hn̄g-hn̄g ê lâng lóng beh óa-khò lí.
Lí chiong-hián lí ê koân-lêng, ēng khùi-la̍t hō͘ soaⁿ-niá an-ún khiā-chāi.
Hái iô-choah, hái-éng hōa-hōa-háu, bān-bîn háng-hoah, lí hō͘ in lóng pêng-chēng.
Khiā-khí tī tōe chīn-thâu ê lâng ōe in-ūi lí ê sîn-jiah kiaⁿ-ùi; ji̍t chhut ji̍t lo̍h ê só͘-chāi, lí hō͘ in hoan-ho͘.
Lí koàn-kò͘ thó͘-tōe, lo̍h-hō͘ koàn-ak, hō͘ thó͘-tōe chin pûi. Siōng-tè ê hô, chúi móa-móa; lí án-ni chún-pī thó͘-tōe, kiong-kip ngó͘-kok.
Lí koàn-ak chhân-hn̂g, hō͘ chúi móa kau móa lêng, hō͘ thô͘-bah nńg-nńg. Lí sù-hok hō͘ só͘ chai-chèng--ê lóng tōa-châng.
Lí ēng hong-siu chòe nî-tang ê ông-koan; lí keng-kè ê lō͘ ū iû teh tih,
liân khòng-iá ê chháu-po͘ to ū iû teh tih. Soaⁿ-thâu ēng hoaⁿ-hí chòe tòa hâ,
chháu-po͘ ū iûⁿ-kûn chòe saⁿ chhēng, soaⁿ-kok ū ngó͘-kok chòe gōa-thò moa; in lóng hoaⁿ-hí chhut-siaⁿ gîm-si.
Choân-tōe lóng tio̍h tùi Siōng-tè chhut hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ,
chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn I miâ ê êng-kng, ēng chàn-bí ê ōe hián-bêng I ê êng-kng.
Tio̍h tùi Siōng-tè kóng, “Lí ê chok-ûi jōa-ni̍h thang kiaⁿ-ùi! In-ūi lí ê tōa koân-lêng, lí ê tùi-te̍k ōe hâng-ho̍k lí.
Choân-tōe ōe kèng-pài lí, gîm-si chheng-chàn lí; ōe gîm-si o-ló lí ê miâ.”
Lâi, lâi khòaⁿ Siōng-tè ê chok-ûi; I tùi sè-kan-lâng ê só͘-chòe chin thang kiaⁿ-ùi.
I hō͘ hái pìⁿ-chòe ta-tōe, hō͘ I ê chú-bîn pō͘-kiâⁿ kè hô. Tī hia goán in-ūi I lâi hoaⁿ-hí.
I ēng I ê koân-lêng éng-oán thóng-tī; I ê ba̍k-chiu kàm-chhat lia̍t-pang; pōe-ge̍k ê lâng m̄-thang chū-ko.
Bān-bîn ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn goán ê Siōng-tè, hō͘ lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chheng-chàn I ê siaⁿ.
I pó-chûn goán ê sìⁿ-miā, hō͘ goán kian-kò͘ khiā-chāi.
Siōng-tè ah, lí ū chhì-giām goán, thoàn-liān goán chhin-chhiūⁿ thoàn-liān gûn.
Lí hō͘ goán ji̍p lô-bāng, ēng tāng-tàⁿ teh tī goán sin-chiūⁿ.
Lí iông-ún lâng sái-chhia kauh-kè goán ê thâu-khak; goán keng-kè chúi kap hé. Chóng-sī lí chhōa goán kàu khoan-khoah chū-iû ê só͘-chāi.
Góa beh tòa sio-hòa-chè chìn-ji̍p lí ê tiān; góa beh tùi lí siā góa ê goān.
Góa beh hêng tī hoān-lān ê sî chhùi-tûn só͘ kóng, chhùi só͘ hē ê goān.
Góa beh hiàn pûi ê cheng-siⁿ chòe sio-hòa-chè, hiàn mî-iûⁿ-káng, gû-káng, kap soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, chiong sio-hòa-chè ê phang-bī hiàn hō͘ lí.
Kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng lóng tio̍h lâi thiaⁿ; góa beh kóng-khí I ūi góa só͘ chòe ê sū.
Góa bat ēng góa ê chhùi kiû-kiò I, ēng góa ê chi̍h chheng-chàn I, chun-chông I.
Góa sim-lāi nā ū khǹg pháiⁿ ê liām-thâu, Chú it-tēng bōe thiaⁿ.
M̄-kú Siōng-tè si̍t-chāi ū thiaⁿ--kìⁿ; I í-keng àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ góa kî-tó ê siaⁿ.
Siōng-tè eng-kai siū chheng-chàn; I m̄-bat kū-choa̍t góa ê kî-tó, m̄-bat hō͘ I ê chû-ài lī-khui góa.
Goān Siōng-tè lîn-bín goán, sù-hok hō͘ goán; goān lí ēng jîn-chû khoán-thāi goán,
thang hō͘ choân sè-kài chai lí ê chí-ì, hō͘ bān-kok bat lí ê kiù-un.
Siōng-tè ah, goān sè-kan-lâng lóng chheng-chàn lí, bān-bîn lóng o-ló lí!
Goān bān-kok khoài-lo̍k, chhiùⁿ-koa hoaⁿ-hí! In-ūi lí chiàu kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ bān-bîn, ín-chhōa sè-chiūⁿ bān-kok.
Siōng-tè ah, goān sè-kan-lâng lóng chheng-chàn lí, bān-bîn lóng o-ló lí!
Thó͘-tōe ū seng-sán ngó͘-kok; Siōng-tè, goán ê Siōng-tè ū sù-hok hō͘ goán.
Goān Siōng-tè sù-hok hō͘ goán! Goān choân-tōe lóng kèng-ùi I!
Goān Siōng-tè khí--lâi, hō͘ I ê tùi-te̍k sì-sòaⁿ, hō͘ oàn-hūn I ê lâng tùi I ê bīn-chêng tô-cháu.
Lí kā in kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ kā ian chhe-sòaⁿ; in chhin-chhiūⁿ la̍h kìⁿ-tio̍h hé chiū iûⁿ--khì, pháiⁿ-lâng kìⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê bīn chiū siau-bia̍t.
Goān gī-lâng tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k; goān in hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí.
Tio̍h tùi Siōng-tè gîm-si, chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn I ê miâ, tōa-tōa chheng-chàn chē-hûn lâi--ê Hit-ūi; I ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú. Tio̍h tī I ê bīn-chêng khoài-lo̍k.
Siōng-tè tī I sèng ê só͘-chāi chòe ko͘-jî ê pē, kóaⁿ-hū ê pó-hō͘-chiá.
Siōng-tè hō͘ ko͘-toaⁿ ê lâng ū chhù thang tòa, chhōa koaiⁿ-kaⁿ ê lâng chhut-lâi tit-tio̍h chū-iû hióng-hok; m̄-kú I hō͘ pōe-ge̍k ê lâng tiàm tī khòng-hān ê tōe.
Siōng-tè ah, chá lí kiâⁿ tī lí ê chú-bîn thâu-chêng, keng-kè khòng-iá;
tōe kìⁿ-tio̍h Se-nāi ê Siōng-tè, tōa tín-tāng; thiⁿ tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng lo̍h tōa-hō͘.
Siōng-tè ah, lí lo̍h tōa-hō͘, hō͘ ta-sò ê thó͘-tōe tit-tio̍h lūn-te̍k,
hō͘ lí ê cho̍k-kûn tī hia khiā-khí. Siōng-tè ah, lí hō͘ sàn-chhiah-lâng tit-tio̍h un-hūi.
Chú chhut bēng-lēng; chi̍t tōa-tīn hū-lú thoân hó siau-sit,
“Kun-ông kap in ê kun-tūi lóng tô-cháu lah, tô-cháu lah!” Lâu tī chhù-lāi ê hū-lú mā pun-tio̍h chiàn-lī-phín.
Lín an-ún tó tī iûⁿ-tiâu lāi ê sî, chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu ê si̍t siuⁿ pe̍h-gûn, mn̂g siuⁿ n̂g-kim.
Choân-lêng-chiá tī kéng-lāi kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ lia̍t-ông ê sî, sè-bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ Sat-bûn-soaⁿ teh lo̍h-seh.
Pa-san-soaⁿ sī ke̍k-kî koân-tōa ê soaⁿ; Pa-san-soaⁿ sī ū chin chōe soaⁿ-niá ê soaⁿ.
Ū chin chōe soaⁿ-chiam ê soaⁿ ah, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ oàn-tò͘ teh khòaⁿ Siōng-tè só͘ ài khiā-khí ê soaⁿ? Siōng Chú ōe tiàm tī hia kàu éng-oán.
Siōng-tè ū chiàn-chhia chheng-chheng-bān-bān; Chú tùi Se-nāi chhut--lâi, lâi kàu I ê sèng-só͘.

Lí í-keng chiūⁿ kàu koân ê só͘-chāi, kā hu-ló͘ lia̍h--lâi; lí tùi lâng chiap-siū kòng-phín, sīm-chì chiap-siū pōe-poān ê lâng ê lé-mi̍h, hō͘ Chú Siōng-tè lí tī in tiong-kan khiā-khí.
Chú eng-kai siū chheng-chàn, I ji̍t-ji̍t pē lán ê tàⁿ; I chiū-sī kiù lán ê Siōng-tè.
Lán ê Siōng-tè sī chín-kiù ê Siōng-tè; chí-ū Chú Siōng-tè ōe kiù lán thoat-lī sí-bông.
Chóng-sī Siōng-tè beh phah-phòa tùi-te̍k ê thâu-khak, chiū-sī kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe ê lâng ê thâu-khak.
Chú kóng, “Góa beh kā in tùi Pa-san chhōa--lâi, tùi hái siōng-chhim ê só͘-chāi chhōa tò-tńg--lâi,
hō͘ lín tùi in ê huih tiong kiâⁿ--kè, hō͘ lín ê káu chī in ê huih.”
