Siōng-tè ah, lí sī góa ê Siōng-tè, góa ê Kun-ông. Lâng í-keng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí teh kiâⁿ, kiâⁿ-ji̍p sèng-só͘.
Chhiùⁿ-koa--ê kiâⁿ tī thâu-chêng, chàu-ga̍k--ê tè tī āu-bīn, iô lin-long-kó͘ ê cha-bó͘ gín-á kiâⁿ tī tiong-kan.
Tio̍h tī tāi-hōe tiong chheng-chàn Siōng-tè, chiū-sī Siōng Chú, Í-sek-lia̍t ê goân-thâu.
Siōng-sòe ê Piān-ngá-bín chòe thâu teh chhōa, Iû-tāi kui-kûn ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, Se-pò͘-lûn ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ, Ná-hut-tha-lī ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ tè tī āu-bīn.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí hián-chhut khùi-la̍t; kiû lí hián-sī lí kā goán chòe ê sū.
Ūi-tio̍h lí tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê tiān, lia̍t-ông beh tòa lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ lí.

Kiû lí chek-pī Ai-ki̍p, i chhin-chhiūⁿ tī lô͘-úi tiong ê iá-siù; kiû lí chek-pī lia̍t-pang, in chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-kûn ê gû-káng kap gû-á. Kiû lí hō͘ tham-ài kòng-phín ê lâng khut-ho̍k tī lí kha-ē; kiû lí kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ hò͘ⁿ-chiàn ê lia̍t-pang.
Te̍k-sài beh tòa kòng-phín tùi Ai-ki̍p lâi; Kó͘-si̍t beh kóaⁿ-kín tùi Siōng-tè hiàn lé-mi̍h.
Sè-chiūⁿ ê lia̍t-kok ah, tio̍h tùi Siōng-tè chhiùⁿ-koa, gîm-si chheng-chàn Chú,
chheng-chàn chē tī tùi kó͘-chá chiū ū, ke̍k-koân ê thiⁿ Hit-ūi. I hoat-chhut ke̍k-tōa ū-la̍t ê siaⁿ.
Lín tio̍h chiong koân-lêng kui hō͘ Siōng-tè. I ê ui-giâm tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê téng-bīn; I ê koân-lêng hián-sī tī kiong-chhong.
Siōng-tè ah, lí tī lí ê sèng-só͘ si̍t-chāi thang kèng-ùi; Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè sù khùi-la̍t koân-lêng hō͘ I ê chú-bîn. Siōng-tè eng-kai siū chheng-chàn!
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kiù góa, in-ūi chúi í-keng im kàu góa ê ām-kún.
Góa hām lo̍h-khì chhim ê thô͘-bê, kha ta̍h bōe tio̍h si̍t-tōe; góa lo̍h kàu chhim ê chúi-lāi, tōa-chúi im-ba̍t góa.
Góa in-ūi âu-kiò ià-siān, góa ê nâ-âu ta--khì; góa in-ūi thèng-hāu Siōng-tè, ba̍k-chiu hoe.

Bô lí-iû oàn-hūn góa ê lâng pí góa ê thâu-mn̂g khah chōe; bô-iân-bô-kò͘ tùi-te̍k góa beh húi-bia̍t góa ê lâng hui-siông kiông-béng. Góa bô thau-the̍h, kèng-jiân tio̍h hêng.
Siōng-tè ah, lí chai góa jōa-ni̍h gû-gōng; góa bô tùi lí ún-môa góa ê chōe-kò.

Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, kiû lí m̄-thang hō͘ gióng-bōng lí ê lâng in-ūi góa tì-kàu kiàn-siàu; Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí m̄-thang hō͘ chhē-kiû lí ê lâng in-ūi góa siū lêng-jio̍k.
Góa ūi-tio̍h lí ê iân-kò͘ siū lóe-mē, móa-bīn kiàn-siàu.
Góa ê hiaⁿ-tī khòaⁿ góa chòe siⁿ-hūn-lâng; góa ê tông-pau khòaⁿ góa chòe gōa-kok-lâng.
Góa ūi-tio̍h lí ê tiān sim hé-jia̍t, kui-ê lâng lóng hō͘ thun--lo̍h-khì; lóe-mē lí ê lâng ê lóe-mē lóng lo̍h tī góa sin-chiūⁿ.
Góa thòng-sim lâu ba̍k-sái, kìm-chia̍h, hoán-tńg siū chèng-lâng lêng-jio̍k.
Góa ēng môa-pò͘ chòe saⁿ chhēng; lâng hoán-tńg ēng góa chòe chhiàu-tâm.
Chē tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu ê lâng ēng góa chòe ōe-tôe; chùi-hàn ēng góa chòe koa-khek.
M̄-kú góa siū chiap-la̍p ê sî, Siōng Chú ah, góa tùi lí kî-tó; Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí chiàu lí hong-sēng ê chû-ài, chiàu lí chin-si̍t khó-khò ê chín-kiù lâi ìn góa.
Kiû lí kiù góa thoat-chhut thô͘-bê, hō͘ góa bô tîm--lo̍h-khì; kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī oàn-hūn góa ê lâng, hō͘ góa thoat-chhut chhim ê chúi.
Kiû lí m̄-thang iông-ún tōa-chúi im-ba̍t góa; m̄-thang iông-ún chhim-ian thun-chia̍h góa, m̄-thang iông-ún hām-khiⁿ khàm-ba̍t góa.
Siōng Chú ah, in-ūi lí ū chì-tōa ê chû-ài, kiû lí ìn góa; kiû lí chiàu lí hong-sēng ê chû-pi oa̍t kè-lâi khòaⁿ góa.
M̄-thang bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ khòaⁿ lí ê po̍k-jîn; góa tī hoān-lān ê tiong-kan, kiû lí kóaⁿ-kín lâi ìn góa.
Kiû lí óa-kūn góa lâi kiù-sio̍k góa; kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī góa ê tùi-te̍k.
Góa siū--tio̍h ê lóe-mē, kiàn-siàu, lêng-jio̍k, lí lóng chai; te̍k-tùi góa ê lâng lí lóng bat.
Lóe-mē hō͘ góa ê sim chhùi, hō͘ góa chhiong-móa iu-būn. Góa ǹg-bāng lâng tông-chêng, m̄-kú chi̍t ê to bô; ǹg-bāng lâng an-ùi, mā chhē bô.
In the̍h khó͘-táⁿ hō͘ góa chòe chia̍h-mi̍h; góa chhùi-ta, in ēng chhò͘ hō͘ góa lim.
Goān in ê iàn-se̍k pìⁿ-chòe in ka-kī ê lô-bāng; goān in ê hoân-êng an-tēng pìⁿ-chòe hām-chíⁿ.
Goān in ê ba̍k-chiu hoe, bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ; goān lí hō͘ in ê io chhoah bōe thêng.
Goān lí ê thòng-hūn piàⁿ tī in ê sin-chiūⁿ, hō͘ lí lia̍t-lia̍t ê siū-khì jip-tio̍h in.
Goān in khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi pha-hng; goān in ê pò͘-pîⁿ bô lâng tòa.
In-ūi in khún-pek hiah-ê hō͘ lí phah ê lâng; in ke-thiⁿ lí phah-siong ê lâng ê thòng-khó͘.
Goān lí kā in chōe-siōng-ka-chōe; m̄-thang hō͘ in bô siū tēng-chōe.
Goān lí kā in ê miâ tùi oa̍h-miā-chheh chhat-siau, m̄-thang lia̍t tī gī-lâng ê miâ-toaⁿ.
Chóng-sī góa khùn-khó͘ iu-siong; Siōng-tè ah, in-ūi lí ê kiù-un kiû lí kā góa an-tì tī koân ê só͘-chāi.
Góa beh ēng si-koa chheng-chàn Siōng-tè ê miâ, mā beh ēng kám-siā chun I chòe tōa.
Án-ni chòe ōe hō͘ Siōng Chú hoaⁿ-hí, pí hiàn gû, hiàn ū-kak ū-tôe ê gû-káng koh-khah hó.
Khùn-khó͘ ê lâng khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ōe hoaⁿ-hí; chhē-kiû Siōng-tè ê lâng ê sim ōe oa̍h--khí-lâi.
In-ūi Siōng Chú thiaⁿ sàn-chhiah-lâng ê kî-kiû, bô khòaⁿ-khin ūi-tio̍h I siū koaiⁿ-kaⁿ ê lâng.
Goān thiⁿ kap tōe chheng-chàn I, hái kap hit lāi-bīn it-chhè ê tōng-bu̍t lóng chheng-chàn I.
In-ūi Siōng-tè beh kiù Sek-an, tiông-kiàn Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ; in ōe tit-tio̍h èng-ún ê tōe chòe sán-gia̍p, tī hia khiā-khí.
I ê po̍k-jîn ê hō͘-tāi ōe sêng-siū hit-ê tōe; thiàⁿ I ê lâng ōe tī hia tòa--lo̍h-khì.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí chín-kiù góa; Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí kín lâi pang-chān góa.
Goān siàu-siūⁿ beh hāi góa sìⁿ-miā ê lâng làu-khùi kiàn-siàu; goān ài góa siū hām-hāi ê lâng pāi-thè siū lêng-jio̍k.
Goān tùi góa kóng “Hò͘, lí chhám ah” hiah-ê lâng, in-ūi kiàn-siàu thiat-thè.
Goān chhē-kiû lí ê lâng lóng in-ūi lí hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k; goān him-bō͘ lí chín-kiù ê lâng sî-siông kóng, “Tio̍h chun Siōng-tè chòe tōa!”
Chóng-sī góa khùn-khó͘ sàn-chhiah; Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kóaⁿ-kín lâi góa chia. Lí sī góa ê pang-chān, góa ê chín-kiù; Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí m̄-thang iân-chhiân.
Siōng Chú ah, góa óa-khò lí; kiû lí hō͘ góa éng-oán bōe tú-tio̍h kiàn-siàu.
Kiû lí chiàu lí ê kong-gī chín-kiù góa, tháu-pàng góa; kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa, kiù góa.
Kiû lí chòe góa khiā-khí ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ, hō͘ góa thang sî-siông tiàm hia. Lí í-keng koat-tēng beh kiù góa; lí sī góa ê pī-lān-só͘, góa ê pó-lúi.
Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhiú, thoat-lī put-gī kap chân-jím ê lâng ê chhiú-thâu.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, lí sī góa ê ǹg-bāng; tùi góa siàu-liân ê sî, lí it-ti̍t sī góa ê óa-khò.
Góa tùi thai--ni̍h chiū siū lí hû-chhî; hō͘ góa chhut lāu-bú ê pak-tó͘--ê, sī lí; góa beh put-sî chheng-chàn lí.
Chin chōe lâng khòaⁿ góa chòe kî-koài; m̄-kú lí sī góa kian-kò͘ ê pī-lān-só͘.
Góa ê chhùi chhiong-móa tùi lí ê chheng-chàn, kui-ji̍t kui êng-kng hō͘ lí.
Góa nî-lāu ê sî, kiû lí m̄-thang pàng-sak góa; góa khùi-la̍t soe-lám ê sî, kiû lí m̄-thang lī-khui góa.
Góa ê tùi-te̍k gī-lūn góa; tng-tán beh hāi góa sìⁿ-miā ê lâng teh chham-siông,
kóng, “Siōng-tè í-keng kā i pàng-sak; taⁿ lâi tui i, lâi lia̍h i; in-ūi bô lâng beh kiù i.”
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí m̄-thang pàng góa hn̄g-hn̄g m̄ chhap góa; góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kóaⁿ-kín lâi pang-chān góa.
Goān khòng-kò góa ê lâng tú-tio̍h kiàn-siàu bia̍t-bông; goān kè-bô͘ beh hāi góa ê lâng siū lêng-jio̍k làu-khùi.
M̄-kú góa beh sî-siông gióng-bōng lí, beh it-ti̍t chheng-chàn lí.
Sui-jiân lí kong-gī ê só͘-chòe kap chín-kiù ê chok-ûi sǹg bōe liáu, iáu-kú góa ê chhùi kui-ji̍t beh soan-iông.
Góa beh kóng-khí Chì-koân Siōng Chú tōa koân-lêng ê sū, kan-ta beh soan-iông lí ê kong-gī.
Siōng-tè ah, tùi góa siàu-liân ê sî lí chiū kà-sī góa, hiān-chāi góa iáu-teh pò-iông lí kî-biāu ê chok-ûi.

Siōng-tè ah, kàu góa nî-lāu, thâu-mn̂g pe̍h ê sî, kiû lí m̄-thang pàng-sak góa, hō͘ góa thang chiong lí ê khùi-la̍t thoân hō͘ ē chi̍t tāi, chiong lí ê tōa koân-lêng chí-sī chiong-lâi ê lâng.
Siōng-tè ah, lí ê kong-gī koân kàu tú-thiⁿ; Siōng-tè ah, lí ū kiâⁿ úi-tāi ê sū, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kap lí pí?
Lí hō͘ góa keng-le̍k chin chōe tōa chai-lān, iáu-kú beh hō͘ góa koh oa̍h--khí-lâi, tùi tōe-ē siōng-chhim ê só͘-chāi koh khí--lâi.
Lí ōe chiong chun-êng ke-thiⁿ hō͘ góa, koh-chài an-ùi góa.
Góa ê Siōng-tè, góa beh tôaⁿ-sek chheng-chàn lí, chheng-chàn lí ê sìn-si̍t. Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè, góa beh tôaⁿ-khîm chheng-chàn lí.
Góa sī lí só͘ kiù-sio̍k--ê, góa beh ēng choân sìⁿ-miā tōa-siaⁿ chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí.
Góa ê chi̍h beh kui-ji̍t kóng-khí lí ê kong-gī, in-ūi kè-bô͘ beh hāi góa ê lâng í-keng siū lêng-jio̍k kiàn-siàu.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí chiong lí kong-chèng ê phòaⁿ-toàn sù hō͘ ông; kiû lí chiong lí ê kong-gī sù hō͘ ông ê kiáⁿ,
hō͘ i ōe chiàu kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ lí ê chú-bîn, chiàu kong-chèng phòaⁿ-toàn sio̍k lí khùn-khó͘ siū ap-chè ê lâng.
Goān tōa-soaⁿ tòa hô-pêng hō͘ i ê peh-sìⁿ, goān sió-soaⁿ hō͘ in hióng-siū hoân-êng.
I ōe thòe peh-sìⁿ tiong khùn-khó͘ ê lâng sin-oan; I ōe kái-kiù sàn-chhiah-lâng, ōe phah-chhùi ap-pek-chiá.
Goān in kèng-ùi lí ji̍t kú ge̍h chhim, ti̍t-kàu bān sè-tāi.
Goān ông chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘-chúi lo̍h tī chháu koah-liáu ê hn̂g, chhin-chhiūⁿ ki̍p-sî ê hō͘-chúi lūn-te̍k thó͘-tōe.
Tī i chē-ūi ê ji̍t-chí gī-lâng ōe heng-ōng, kap ge̍h pîⁿ kú hióng-siū tōa hô-pêng.
I ōe chiáng-koân tùi chit-ê hái kàu hit-ê hái, tùi Tōa-hô ti̍t-kàu tōe-ke̍k.
Tòa tī khòng-iá ê lâng ōe kūi-lo̍h tī i bīn-chêng; i ê tùi-te̍k ōe oân-choân hâng-ho̍k.
Tha-si kap hái-tó ê lia̍t-ông lâi chìn-kòng; Sī-pa kap Se-pa ê ông lâi hiàn lé-mi̍h.
Goān lia̍t-ông lóng phak-lo̍h pài i, bān-kok lóng ho̍k-sāi i.
In-ūi sàn-chhiah-lâng kiû-kiò ê sî, i ōe kiù in; khùn-khó͘ bô i-óa ê lâng, i mā ōe kiù in.
I ōe lîn-bín khùn-khó͘ sàn-chhiah ê lâng; I ōe chín-kiù khùn-khó͘-lâng ê sìⁿ-miā.
I ōe kiù-sio̍k in thoat-lī ap-pek kap kiông-pō; I khòaⁿ in ê sìⁿ-miā chòe pó-pòe.
Goān ông bān-sòe! Goān i chiap-siū Sī-pa chìn-kòng ê kim. Goān peh-sìⁿ sî-siông ūi i kî-tó, kui-ji̍t chiok-hok i bô-thêng.

Goān chit-ê thó͘-tōe ngó͘-kok hong-siu, móa soaⁿ-phiâⁿ ū be̍h-sūi, chhin-chhiūⁿ Lê-pa-lūn ê chhiū-nâ hiah-ni̍h ōng. Goān siâⁿ-lāi, lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ tōe-chiūⁿ ê chháu bō͘-sēng heng-ōng.
Goān i ê miâ lâu kàu éng-oán, chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t-thâu kú-tn̂g liû-thoân. Lâng ōe in-ūi i tit-tio̍h hok-khì; bān-kok ōe chheng i ū hok-khì.
Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, chí-ū I kiâⁿ kî-īⁿ ê sū, eng-kai siū chheng-chàn.
Goān I êng-iāu ê miâ éng-oán siū chheng-chàn; goān I ê êng-iāu chhiong-móa choân-tōe. Amen! Amen!
Iâ-se ê kiáⁿ Tāi-pi̍t ê kî-tó kàu chia kiat-sok.
Siōng-tè si̍t-chāi hó khoán-thāi Í-sek-lia̍t, hó khoán-thāi hiah-ê sim chheng-khì ê lâng.
Sui-jiân án-ni, góa ê kha hiám-hiám ta̍h thu̍t--khì; góa ê kha-pō͘ hiám-hiám kiâⁿ phian--khì.
In-ūi góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h pháiⁿ-lâng kap kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng heng-ōng, góa chiū oàn-tò͘ put-pêng.
In it-seng lóng m̄-bat kan-khó͘, seng-khu ióng-chòng hó-khòaⁿ.
In bô chhin-chhiūⁿ pa̍t-lâng thoa-bôa lô-khó͘, mā bô chhin-chhiūⁿ pa̍t-lâng siū-tio̍h chai-hō.
Só͘-í in ēng kiau-ngō͘ chòe phoa̍h-liān kòa tī ām-kún, ēng pō-le̍k chòe saⁿ chhēng.
In seng-khu pûi, ba̍k-chiu ham, sim chhiong-móa siâ-liām.
In thí-chhiò, ok-ì tiòng-siong lâng; in kóng tōa-siaⁿ-ōe ap-chè lâng.
In ê chhùi siat-to̍k thiⁿ; in ê chi̍h chiù-mē tōe.
Liân Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn to kui-óa in, choân-pôaⁿ chiap-siū in só͘ kóng ê ōe.
In kóng, “Siōng-tè ná ōe chai? Chì-koân Siōng-tè kiám ōe bat?”
Khòaⁿ, chiah-ê sī pháiⁿ-lâng; in put-sî bô-hoân-bô-ló, châi-pó ná ke-thiⁿ.
Góa pó-siú góa ê sim chheng-khì si̍t-chāi bô-chhái-kang; góa sóe-chhiú bô bak-tio̍h chōe-ok mā-sī khang-khang.
In-ūi góa kui-ji̍t tú-tio̍h chai-lān, ta̍k chá-khí siū-tio̍h khiàn-chek.
Góa nā kóng góa beh chiàu in án-ni kóng, chiū tùi lí ê chú-bîn bô tiong-si̍t.
Góa siūⁿ-beh liáu-kái chit-ê tāi-chì, m̄-kú bô hoat-tō͘;
kàu ji̍p-khì Siōng-tè ê sèng-só͘, góa chiah bêng-pe̍k in ê kiat-kio̍k.
Lí it-tēng ōe kā in khǹg tī ku̍t-ku̍t ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ in siak-tó bia̍t-bông.
In hō͘ khióng-pò͘ thun-bia̍t, chi̍t-ba̍k-nih-kú chiū bia̍t-bông.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng khùn-chhíⁿ chiū chai in ê bîn-bāng sī hoàn-sióng, Chú ah, lí chi̍t-ē khí--lâi, pháiⁿ-lâng mā án-ni siau-sit.
Góa ê sim chin sng, góa ê sim-chêng khó͘-thàng.
Góa gû-gōng, bû-ti, tī lí ê bīn-chêng chhin-chhiūⁿ cheng-siⁿ.
Chóng-sī góa put-sî kap lí chòe-hé; lí khan góa ê chiàⁿ-chhiú,
ēng lí ê kà-sī ín-chhōa góa, chiap-la̍p góa, hō͘ góa tit-tio̍h chun-êng.
Tī thiⁿ-téng, lí í-gōa góa ū sím-mi̍h-lâng? Tī tōe-chiūⁿ, lí í-gōa góa bô só͘ ì-ài.
Góa ê jio̍k-thé, góa ê sim-sîn ōe soe-jio̍k, m̄-kú Siōng-tè éng-oán sī góa ê khùi-la̍t kap sán-gia̍p.
Lī-khui lí hn̄g-hn̄g ê lâng it-tēng bia̍t-bông; pàng-sak lí, pōe-poān lí ê lâng, lí lóng ōe kā in siau-bia̍t.
Tùi góa lâi kóng, chhin-kūn Siōng-tè siōng hó; góa chhē Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú chòe pī-lān-só͘, hō͘ góa thang soan-iông lí it-chhè ê chok-ûi.
Siōng-tè ah, sī-án-chóaⁿ lí éng-oán pàng-sak goán? Sī-án-chóaⁿ lí tùi lí chháu-po͘ ê iûⁿ hoat siū-khì, khì kah phīⁿ-khang chhèng-ian?
Kiû lí ōe-kì-tit lí chá-chêng kéng-soán ê chú-bîn, lí só͘ sio̍k-hôe chòe lí sán-gia̍p ê bîn-cho̍k, mā ōe-kì-tit lí só͘ khiā-khí ê Sek-an-soaⁿ.
Kiû lí kiâⁿ-lâi kú-kú pha-hng ê só͘-chāi, khòaⁿ tùi-te̍k thiat-tóe húi-hoāi ê sèng-só͘.
Lí ê tùi-te̍k tī lí tiān-lāi hoan-ho͘, chhāi in ê kî chòe kì-hō,
chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng gia̍h pó͘-thâu, chhò chhiū-nâ ê chhiū.
Sèng-só͘ lāi-bīn it-chhè ê tiau-khek, in ēng pó͘-thâu kap thûi lóng-chóng phò-hoāi.
In pàng-hé sio-húi lí ê sèng-só͘, phah lâ-sâm lí khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.
In chham-siông kóng, “Lán lâi kā in thiat-tóe húi-hoāi.” In chiong ta̍k-ūi kèng-pài Siōng-tè ê só͘-chāi lóng sio-liáu-liáu.
Goán bô koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ tiāu-thâu, mā bô koh ū sian-ti; chit-khoán chêng-hêng ōe kàu sím-mi̍h sî, goán tiong-kan bô lâng chai.
Siōng-tè ah, tùi-te̍k ki-chhì ōe kàu sím-mi̍h sî? Te̍k-jîn siat-to̍k lí ê miâ ōe kàu éng-oán mah?
Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ chhiú kiu--khí-lâi m̄ chhap goán? Kiû lí chhiú chhun-chhut-lâi kā in húi-bia̍t.
Chóng-sī Siōng-tè tùi kó͘-chá chiū-sī góa ê Ông, tī tōe-chiūⁿ si-hêng chín-kiù.
Lí bat ēng lí ê koân-lêng chiong hái pun-khui, kòng-phòa chúi-tiong hái-koài ê thâu-khak.
Lí bat kòng-chhùi hái-siù ê thâu-khak, hō͘ khòng-iá ê iá-siù chòe chia̍h-mi̍h.
Lí bat pun-khui chúi-goân kap hô-liû, bat hō͘ tn̂g-lâu ê kang-hô ta--khì.
Ji̍t--sî kap mî--sî, sī lí só͘ an-pâi; ji̍t-thâu kap kng-thé sī lí só͘ chhòng-chō.
Tōe-chiūⁿ it-chhè ê kài-hān sī lí só͘ tēng; hē-thiⁿ kap tang-thiⁿ sī lí só͘ siat.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí kì-tit tùi-te̍k án-chóaⁿ teh húi-pòng, gû-gōng ê lâng án-chóaⁿ teh siat-to̍k lí ê miâ.
Kiû lí m̄-thang chiong sûn-liông chú-bîn ê sìⁿ-miā kau hō͘ iá-siù, m̄-thang éng-oán bōe-kì-tit lí sàn-chhiah ê cho̍k-kûn.
Kiû lí ōe-kì-tit kap goán li̍p ê iok, in-ūi tōe-chiūⁿ o͘-àm ê só͘-chāi lóng sī kiông-pō ê lâng ê châu-hia̍t.
Kiû lí m̄-thang hō͘ siū ap-chè ê lâng kiàn-siàu tńg--khì; kiû lí hō͘ khùn-khó͘ sàn-chhiah ê lâng chheng-chàn lí ê miâ.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí khí-lâi ūi ka-kī piān-hō͘, ōe-kì-tit gōng-lâng kui-ji̍t án-chóaⁿ teh húi-pòng lí.
Kiû lí m̄-thang bōe-kì-tit lí tùi-te̍k ê hán-hoah, m̄-thang bōe-kì-tit khí-lâi kong-kek lí ê lâng bô-thêng ê chhiàng-siaⁿ.
Siōng-tè ah, goán kám-siā lí; goán kám-siā lí, in-ūi lí tī goán sin-piⁿ; goán beh pò-iông lí kî-biāu ê chok-ûi.
Siōng-tè kóng: Tī só͘ tēng ê ji̍t-chí, góa beh chiàu kong-pêng sím-phòaⁿ.
Tōe kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê chū-bîn lóng iô-choah ê sî, góa beh hō͘ tōe ê ki-chhó͘ kian-kò͘ khiā-chāi.
Góa tùi kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng kóng, “M̄-thang kiau-ngō͘”; tùi pháiⁿ-lâng kóng, “M̄-thang tián-ui,
m̄-thang chhàng-chhiu, m̄-thang ngī ām-kún kóng tōa-ōe.”
Lâng ko-seng m̄-sī tùi tang, m̄-sī tùi sai, mā m̄-sī tùi khòng-iá.
Chí-ū Siōng-tè si-hêng sím-phòaⁿ, I hō͘ chit-ê kàng-kē, hō͘ hit-ê ko-seng.
Siōng Chú chhiú--ni̍h the̍h poe, kui-poe lóng sī siū-khì ê kāu-chiú. I kā chiú tò--chhut-lâi; tōe-chiūⁿ ê pháiⁿ-lâng lóng lim, lim kàu ta.
M̄-kú góa beh chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè, beh éng-oán pò-iông I ê chok-ûi.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê koân-sè, I ōe chām-tn̄g; gī-lâng ê khùi-la̍t, I ōe ka-kiông.
Tī Iû-tāi, Siōng-tè lâng-lâng lóng bat; tī Í-sek-lia̍t, I ê miâ siū chun chòe tōa.
Tī Sat-léng, ū I ê hōe-bō͘; tī Sek-an, ū I khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.
Tī hia, I at-chi̍h hé ê chìⁿ, húi-hoāi tún-pâi, to-kiàm, í-ki̍p só͘-ū ê bú-khì.
Lí ê êng-kng kap ui-giâm iâⁿ-kè tún-móa chiàn-lī-phín ê soaⁿ-niá.
Siōng-ióng ê lâng lóng siū chhiúⁿ-kiap; in khùn--khì bô koh chhíⁿ, liân chiàn-sū mā bōe-tàng chhut-chhiú.
Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè ah, lí chi̍t-ē chek-pī, chiàn-chhia, chiàn-bé lóng tó--lo̍h-khì, bô koh khí--lâi.
Chí-ū lí thang kiaⁿ-ùi; lí ê siū-khì chi̍t-ē hoat-chhut, siáⁿ-lâng tī lí bīn-chêng khiā ōe tiâu?
Siōng-tè ah, lí khí-lâi sím-phòaⁿ, beh kiù tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū khùn-khó͘ ê lâng; lí chi̍t-ē tùi thiⁿ soan-phòaⁿ, tōe chiū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ m̄-káⁿ chhut-siaⁿ.
Lâng ê siū-khì chòe-āu ōe pìⁿ-chòe tùi lí ê chheng-chàn; keng-kè lí siū-khì lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng ōe ûi óa-lâi kèng-pài lí.
Tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè hē-goān, mā tio̍h siā-goān; sì-ûi ê lâng tio̍h tòa lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ thang kèng-ùi ê Chú.
I beh hō͘ kiau-ngō͘ ê kùi-cho̍k làu-khùi; I beh hō͘ sè-chiūⁿ ê lia̍t-ông kiaⁿ-ùi.
Góa beh tùi Siōng-tè tōa-siaⁿ kiû-kiò, tùi Siōng-tè chhut tōa-siaⁿ, I ōe àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ.
Tī hoān-lān ê ji̍t góa chhē Chú, tī mî--sî gia̍h-chhiú kî-tó bô-thêng; góa ê sim m̄-khéng siū an-ùi.
Góa siàu-liām Siōng-tè, chiū thó͘-khùi ai-oàn; góa chēng-chēng siūⁿ, chiū lóe-chì sit-bāng.
Lí hō͘ góa ba̍k-chiu kim-khok-khok khùn bōe khì; góa hoân-ló kah lóng bōe kóng-ōe.
Góa tui-liām kè-khì ê ji̍t-chí, hôe-sióng kó͘-chá ê nî.
Góa mî--sî chēng-chēng siūⁿ; góa bong sim-koaⁿ ka-kī mn̄g, sim-sîn siông-sè séng-chhat.
Chú kiám ōe éng-oán pàng-sak lán? I kiám bōe koh si-un hō͘ lán?
I ê chû-ài kiám ōe éng-kiú siau-sit? I ê èng-ún kiám ōe éng-oán lo̍k-khong?
Siōng-tè kiám bōe-kì-tit si-un, kiám í-keng ēng siū-khì tāi-thòe I ê chû-pi?
Góa kóng, “Góa siōng thòng-sim--ê, chiū-sī Chì-koân Siōng-tè bô koh ū khùi-la̍t.”
Góa beh kóng-khí Siōng Chú lí ê chok-ûi, siàu-liām lí chá-sî ê sîn-jiah.
Góa beh chhim-su lí ê chok-ûi, chēng-chēng siūⁿ lí ê só͘-chòe.
Siōng-tè ah, lí ê tō-lō͘ sîn-sèng; kiám ū sîn-bêng chhin-chhiūⁿ lí chiah-ni̍h úi-tāi?
Lí sī kiâⁿ kî-sū ê Siōng-tè; lí bat tī bān-bîn tiong hián-sī lí ê koân-lêng.
Lí bat ēng lí ê chhiú sio̍k-hôe lí ê chú-bîn, kái-kiù Ngá-kok kap Iok-sek ê kiáⁿ-sun.
Siōng-tè ah, tōa-chúi kìⁿ-tio̍h lí, tōa-chúi kìⁿ-tio̍h lí lóng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; chhim-ian mā ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah.
Ba̍t-hûn piàⁿ-lo̍h hō͘-chúi, kiong-chhong tân-lûi, lí ê sih-nà sì-kòe siā.
Kńg-lê-á-hong lāi-bīn ū lí tân-lûi ê siaⁿ; sih-nà ê kng sih kàu choân-tōe; tōe ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah tōa iô-tāng.
Hái-tiong ū lí ê tō-lō͘, tōa-chúi tiong ū lí ê lō͘-kèng; lí ê kha-jiah bô lâng chai.
Lí bat ēng Mô͘-se A-lûn ê chhiú, chhōa lí ê chú-bîn chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chhōa iûⁿ-kûn.
Góa ê chú-bîn ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa ê kà-sī, chù-ì thiaⁿ góa kóng ê ōe.
Góa beh khui-chhùi kóng phì-jū, beh kóng-chhut kó͘-chá ê ò-pì,
chiū-sī goán só͘ thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, só͘ chai, goán ê chó͘-sian só͘ thoân hō͘ goán ê sū.
Goán bô beh chiong chiah-ê sū tùi kiáⁿ-sun ún-môa, beh chiong Siōng Chú ê miâ-siaⁿ kap I ê koân-lêng, í-ki̍p I só͘ chòe kî-biāu ê sū, thoân hō͘ āu sè-tāi.
I tī Ngá-kok siat kài-bēng, tī Í-sek-lia̍t tēng Lu̍t-hoat, koh bēng-lēng lán ê chó͘-sian chiong chiah-ê thoân hō͘ in ê kiáⁿ-sun,
hō͘ hō͘-tāi, chiū-sī teh-beh chhut-sì ê kiáⁿ-sun chai; chiah-ê kiáⁿ-sun mā beh thoân hō͘ in ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun.
Án-ni, in thang chiong ǹg-bāng khǹg tī Siōng-tè, hō͘ in bô bōe-kì-tit Siōng-tè ê chok-ûi, chun-siú I ê kài-bēng;
chiah bián chhin-chhiūⁿ in chó͘-sian ê sè-tāi, ngī-sim pōe-ge̍k; in tùi Siōng-tè sim bô kian-tēng, sim-lêng bô chin-si̍t.
Í-hoat-liân ê kiáⁿ-sun gia̍h bú-khì kap keng-chìⁿ, cheng-chiàn ê ji̍t, khiok oa̍t-tńg-sin tô-cháu.
In bô chun-siú Siōng-tè ê iok, kū-choa̍t chiàu I ê Lu̍t-hoat seng-oa̍h.
In bōe-kì-tit I ê chok-ûi, bōe-kì-tit I hō͘ in khòaⁿ-kìⁿ kî-biāu ê sū.
I tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe, Só-an ê chhân-iá, tī in chó͘-sian ê ba̍k-chiu chêng chòe kî-īⁿ ê sū.
I kā hái hun-khui, hō͘ in kè--khì; I hō͘ chúi khiā--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ piah.
I ji̍t--sî ēng hûn chhōa in, kui-mî ēng hé ê kng ín-chhōa in.
I tī khòng-iá hō͘ chio̍h-pôaⁿ piak-li̍h, hō͘ in ū chin chōe chúi thang lim, chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi chhim-ian chhèng-chhut.
I hō͘ chúi tùi chio̍h-pôaⁿ chhèng-chhut, chhin-chhiūⁿ kang-hô lâu--lo̍h-lâi.
M̄-kú in iáu kè-sio̍k tek-chōe I, tī khòng-iá pōe-ge̍k Chì-koân Siōng-tè.
In sim-lāi chhì-thàm Siōng-tè, chiàu ka-kī ì-ài--ê kiû chia̍h-mi̍h.
In lām-sám gī-lūn Siōng-tè, kóng, “Siōng-tè kiám ōe tī khòng-iá pān-toh?
I bat kòng chio̍h-pôaⁿ, hō͘ chúi chhèng-chhut, khoe-chúi móa--chhut-lâi; I kiám ōe sù bí-niû? I kiám ōe kā I ê chú-bîn chún-pī bah?”
Só͘-í, Siōng Chú thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū siū-khì, ēng iām-hé sio Ngá-kok, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t hoat siū-khì.
In-ūi in m̄ sìn-ho̍k Siōng-tè, m̄ óa-khò I ê kiù-un.
M̄-kú I iáu bēng-lēng téng-bīn ê kiong-chhong, koh khui thiⁿ ê mn̂g;
I kàng-lo̍h má-ná hō͘ in chia̍h, chiong thiⁿ ê bí-niû sù hō͘ in.
In ta̍k-ê lâng chia̍h thiⁿ-sài ê chia̍h-mi̍h; Siōng-tè sù bí-niû hō͘ in chia̍h kàu pá.
I tùi thiⁿ khí tang-hong, ēng I ê koân-lêng chhe lâm-hong,
I kàng-lo̍h bah hō͘ in, ná thô͘-hún hiah chōe, kàng-lo̍h pe-chiáu ná hái-soa hiah chōe,
lo̍h tī in ê iâⁿ-tiong, tī in khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi ê sì-ûi.
In chiū chia̍h, chia̍h kàu pá-pá; I ū chiàu in só͘ ài--ê hō͘ in.
In só͘ ài--ê iáu-bē pá-chiok, chia̍h-mi̍h iáu tī chhùi-lāi ê sî,
Siōng-tè chiū tùi in hoat siū-khì, thâi-sí in tiong-kan ióng-chòng ê lâng, phah-tó Í-sek-lia̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng.
Sui-jiân án-ni, in kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe, bô in-ūi Siōng-tè kî-biāu ê chok-ûi lâi sìn I.
Só͘-í I hō͘ in khang-khang kè-ji̍t, hō͘ in nî-nî tī kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ tiong keng-kè.
Siōng-tè thâi in ê sî, in chiah lâi kiû I; oa̍t tò-tńg pek-chhiat chhē-kiû I.
In chiah ōe-kì-tit Siōng-tè sī in ê pó-hō͘-chiá, Chì-koân-chiá Siōng-tè sī in ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú.
M̄-kú in ēng chhùi kā I phô͘-tháⁿ, ēng chi̍h tùi I kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.
In tùi I bô tiong-sìn, bô chin-si̍t siú I ê iok.
M̄-kú I iáu chhiong-móa lîn-bín, sià-bián in ê chōe-kò, bô kā in húi-bia̍t, chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn jím--teh, siū-khì bô lóng hoat--chhut-lâi.
I tài-liām in put-kò sī ōe-sí ê lâng, sī chhe--kè-khì bōe koh tò-tńg--lâi ê hong.
In tī khòng-iá put-sî pōe-ge̍k I, tī hong-po͘ hō͘ I iu-būn.
In chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn chhì-thàm Siōng-tè, kek Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè siū-khì.
In bōe-kì-tit I ê koân-lêng, bōe-kì-tit I kái-kiù in thoat-lī tùi-te̍k ê ji̍t.
I tī Ai-ki̍p án-chóaⁿ kiâⁿ sîn-jiah, tī Só-an ê chhân-iá hián-chhut kî-sū:
I chiong in ê kang-hô pìⁿ-chòe huih, tì-kàu chúi lóng bōe-lim--tit.
I hō͘ kui-kûn hô͘-sîn lâi in hia thun-chia̍h, hō͘ chhân-kap-á lâi sún-hāi.
I chiong in ê thó͘-sán hō͘ chháu-meh-kong húi-hoāi, chiong in lô-khó͘ tit--tio̍h ê mi̍h hō͘ chháu-meh thun-chia̍h.
I lo̍h-pha̍uh húi-hoāi in ê phû-tô-chhiū, lo̍h-sng húi-hoāi in ê sng-châi-chhiū;
koh chiong in ê cheng-siⁿ kau hō͘ peng-pha̍uh, chiong in kui-kûn ê cheng-siⁿ kau hō͘ sih-nà.
I hoat tōa siū-khì, ēng siū-khì, thòng-hūn, khó͘-lān chòe kui-tīn ê sù-chiá lâi kā in húi-bia̍t.
I lún bōe tiâu siū-khì, bô kò͘-liām in ê sìⁿ-miā, ēng un-e̍k kā in húi-bia̍t.
I thâi-sí Ai-ki̍p só͘-ū ê tōa-kiáⁿ, tī Hâm ê pò͘-pîⁿ phah-sí in ê thâu-chiūⁿ-kiáⁿ.
I chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chhōa iûⁿ kā ka-kī ê chú-bîn chhōa--chhut-lâi, chhōa in keng-kè khòng-iá.
I chhōa in, hō͘ in an-ún bô kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, hō͘ hái im-sí in ê tùi-te̍k.
I koh chhōa in kàu sèng-tōe ê kéng-lāi, kàu I ēng khùi-la̍t tit--tio̍h ê soaⁿ-tōe.
I tī in ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-chhut lia̍t-pang; ēng soh-á niû thó͘-tōe hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê chi-cho̍k chòe sán-gia̍p, hō͘ in khiā-khí tī ka-kī ê pò͘-pîⁿ.
In iû-goân chhì-thàm Chì-koân-chiá Siōng-tè, pōe-ge̍k I, bô siú I ê kài-bēng.
In sit-sìn pōe-ge̍k, kap in ê chó͘-sian siâng-khoán, chhin-chhiūⁿ lēng--khì ê keng bōe-khò--tit.
In pài soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, jiá I siū-khì, pài tiau-khek ê ngó͘-siōng, hō͘ I thòng-hūn.
Siōng-tè thiaⁿ--tio̍h chin siū-khì, chiū oân-choân khì-sak Í-sek-lia̍t.
I khì-sak Sī-lô ê hōe-bō͘, khì-sak I tī lâng ê tiong-kan só͘ tah ê pò͘-pîⁿ.
I ún-chún lâng kā iok-kūi chhiúⁿ--khì, chiong I ê khùi-la̍t kap êng-kng kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k.
I tùi I ê ke-gia̍p Í-sek-lia̍t hoat siū-khì, chiong I ê chú-bîn kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k sat-hāi.
In ê siàu-liân-lâng siū chiàn-hé sio-bia̍t; in ê chāi-sek-lú bōe-tàng thiaⁿ-tio̍h kiat-hun ê chiok-koa.
In ê chè-si tó tī to-ē; in ê kóaⁿ-hū khàu bōe chhut--lâi.
Hit-sî Chú chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng khùn cheng-sîn, chhin-chhiūⁿ ióng-sū chiú-āu hán-hoah.
I chiū kā tùi-te̍k phah-thè, hō͘ in éng-oán siū lêng-jio̍k.
I khì-sak Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi, bô kéng-soán Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k.
I kéng-soán Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k, I só͘ ì-ài ê Sek-an-soaⁿ.
I khí-chō sèng-só͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ hiah koân, chhin-chhiūⁿ I kiàn-li̍p ê tāi-tōe éng-oán kian-kò͘.
I kéng-soán I ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t, tùi iûⁿ-tiâu chhōa i chhut--lâi,
hō͘ i bô koh iúⁿ-chhī iûⁿ-kûn, sī beh hō͘ i bo̍k-ióng Chú ê chú-bîn Ngá-kok, I ê ke-gia̍p Í-sek-lia̍t.
Tāi-pi̍t chiū ēng sûn-chèng ê sim bo̍k-ióng in, ēng láu-liān ê chhiú ín-chhōa in.
Siōng-tè ah, gōa-pang-lâng chhim-chiàm lí ê léng-thó͘, phah lâ-sâm lí ê sèng-tiān, hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng pìⁿ-chòe hong-hòe ê só͘-chāi.
In chiong lí po̍k-jîn ê sin-si kau hō͘ khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu chòe chia̍h-mi̍h, chiong lí sèng ê chú-bîn ê bah hō͘ tōe-chiūⁿ ê iá-siù thun-chia̍h.
In tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiu-ûi lâu lí chú-bîn ê huih chhin-chhiūⁿ teh piàⁿ-chúi, mā bô lâng kā in bâi-chòng.
Goán siū-tio̍h keh-piah-kok lêng-jio̍k, hō͘ sì-ûi ê lâng léng-chhiò ki-chhì.
Siōng Chú ah, lí beh siū-khì jōa kú, kiám beh kàu éng-oán? Lí ê tōa siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ hé beh to̍h jōa kú?
Kiû lí chiong lí ê siū-khì piàⁿ-lo̍h tī hiah-ê m̄ bat lí ê gōa-pang, í-ki̍p hiah-ê bô kiû-kiò lí ê miâ ê lia̍t-kok.
In-ūi in thun-chia̍h Ngá-kok, hō͘ i khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi pha-hng.
Kiû lí m̄-thang in-ūi goán chó͘-sian hoān ê chōe hêng-hoa̍t goán; kiû lí chiong lí ê chû-pi kín-kín si-lo̍h hō͘ goán, in-ūi goán hām-lo̍h choa̍t-bāng ê tōe-pō͘.
Kiù goán ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí in-ūi lí ê miâ ê êng-kng pang-chān goán; in-ūi lí ê miâ ê iân-kò͘ kiù goán, sià-bián goán ê chōe.
Ná beh hō͘ lia̍t-kok kóng, “In ê Siōng-tè tī tó-ūi?” Kiû lí ūi-tio̍h lí po̍k-jîn lâu ê huih sin-oan, hō͘ gōa-pang-lâng chai, koh hō͘ goán chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Kiû lí hō͘ siû-hoān ê thó͘-khùi thàu kàu lí ê bīn-chêng, chiàu lí ê tōa koân-lêng, pó-chûn siū phòaⁿ sí-hêng ê lâng ê sìⁿ-miā.
Chú ah, goán keh-piah-kok tùi lí ê lêng-jio̍k, kiû lí ke-thiⁿ chhit pē hêng hō͘ in.
Án-ni, goán chòe lí ê chú-bîn, lí chháu-po͘ ê iûⁿ ê lâng, ōe kám-siā lí kàu éng-oán, chheng-chàn lí ê miâ kàu bān sè-tāi.

Í-sek-lia̍t ê Bo̍k-chiá, chhōa Iok-sek chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chhōa iûⁿ-kûn ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ; chē tī thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek pó-chō téng ê Chú ah, kiû lí hoat-chhut kng.
Kiû lí tī Í-hoat-liân, Piān-ngá-bín, Má-ná-se ê bīn-chêng, hián-chhut lí ê koân-lêng lâi kiù goán.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí hō͘ goán ho̍k-heng, hō͘ lí ê bīn hoat-kng chiò goán, goán chiū tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè ah, lí tùi lí chú-bîn ê kî-tó hoat siū-khì beh kàu jōa kú?
Lí hō͘ goán ēng ba̍k-sái chòe pn̄g chia̍h, ēng kui-óaⁿ ba̍k-sái chòe chúi lim.
Lí hō͘ keh-piah-kok in-ūi goán saⁿ-chiⁿ, tùi-te̍k chòe-tīn kā goán thí-chhiò.
Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí hō͘ goán ho̍k-heng, hō͘ lí ê bīn hoat-kng chiò goán, goán chiū tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.
Lí tùi Ai-ki̍p sóa chi̍t châng phû-tô-chhiū, kóaⁿ-chhut lia̍t-pang, kā i chai-chèng tī chia.
Lí ūi-tio̍h i chéng-tōe; i ê kun tèng chhim, siⁿ-thòaⁿ móa-tōe.
I ê iáⁿ jia-ba̍t chèng-soaⁿ; i ê ki jia-khàm tōa-châng ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū.
I ê ki chhun kàu Tōe-tiong-hái; i ê tîn thòaⁿ kàu Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô.
Taⁿ lí sī-án-chóaⁿ thiah-húi i ê lî-pa, chhut-chāi só͘-ū kè-lō͘ ê lâng bán phû-tô,
chhut-chāi chhiū-nâ lāi ê soaⁿ-ti chau-that, chhut-chāi chhân-iá ê cháu-siù thun-chia̍h?
Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí oa̍t tò-tńg, tùi thiⁿ àⁿ-lo̍h khòaⁿ, chiàu-kò͘ chit-châng phû-tô-chhiū,
pó-hō͘ lí chiàⁿ-chhiú só͘ chai-chèng ê chhiū, kap lí ūi ka-kī só͘ chiàu-kò͘ ê iù-ki.
Hiah-ê ēng hé sio, ēng to chhò phû-tô-chhiū ê lâng, kiû lí hoat siū-khì kā in siau-bia̍t.
Goān lí ê chhiú pó-hō͘ lí chiàⁿ-pêng ê lâng, chiū-sī lí ūi ka-kī só͘ kéng-soán ê lâng.
Án-ni, goán chiū bōe pōe-poān lí; kiû lí kā goán kiù oa̍h, goán chiū beh kiû-kiò lí ê miâ.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí hō͘ goán ho̍k-heng; hō͘ lí ê bīn hoat-kng chiò goán, goán chiū tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.
Siōng-tè sī lán ê khùi-la̍t, tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ chheng-chàn I; tio̍h chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè.
Tio̍h chhiùⁿ si-koa, iô lin-long-kó͘, tôaⁿ hó-thiaⁿ ê khîm kap sek.
Tio̍h tī chhoe-it cha̍p-gō͘, lán choeh-kî ê ji̍t, pûn sàu-kak.
In-ūi che sī ūi Í-sek-lia̍t tēng ê kui-lē, sī Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè ūi in siat ê lé-gî.
I kong-kek Ai-ki̍p -tōe ê sî, ū kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê chú-bîn li̍p-iok. Tī hia góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ í-chêng m̄-bat thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê ōe.
Siōng-tè kóng, “Góa chiong in keng-thâu téng ê tāng-tàⁿ sóa-khui, hō͘ in pàng-lo̍h chhiú só͘ kōaⁿ tāng ê nâ-á.
Lín tī hoān-lān tiong kiû-kiò, góa ū kái-kiù lín; góa tùi lûi teh tân ê ba̍t-hûn tiong ìn-tap lín, tī Bí-lī-pa ê chúi-chôaⁿ piⁿ chhì-giām lín.
Góa ê chú-bîn ah, lín tio̍h thiaⁿ, góa beh kéng-kò lín; Í-sek-lia̍t ah, góa jōa-á-ni̍h ǹg-bāng lín thiaⁿ-thàn góa!
Lín tiong-kan m̄-thang ū pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng; gōa-pang ê sîn-bêng, lín m̄-thang kūi-pài.
Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè; góa bat chhōa lín tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chiūⁿ--lâi. Lín ê chhùi tio̍h tōa khui, góa chiū hō͘ lín pá-chiok.
“M̄-kú góa ê chú-bîn m̄ thiaⁿ góa ê ōe; Í-sek-lia̍t lóng m̄ chhap góa.
Góa chiū chhut-chāi in sim ngī, hō͘ in chiàu ka-kī só͘ ài khì chòe.
Góa jōa-á-ni̍h ǹg-bāng góa ê chú-bîn thiaⁿ-thàn góa, Í-sek-lia̍t khéng kiâⁿ góa ê lō͘!
Góa chin kín chiū ōe chè-ap in ê tùi-te̍k, ēng chhiú tò-koat kong-kek in ê te̍k-jîn.
Oàn-hūn Siōng Chú ê lâng ōe tī I bīn-chêng soe-thè; in ōe éng-oán siū hêng-hoa̍t.
Siōng Chú beh ēng hó ê be̍h hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t chia̍h, ēng tùi chio̍h-pôaⁿ chhut ê bi̍t hō͘ in boán-chiok.”
Siōng-tè tī thian-têng chú-chhî tāi-hōe, tī chiòng-sîn ê hōe-tiong teh sím-phòaⁿ.
“Lín bô chiàu kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ, phian-thán pháiⁿ-lâng beh kàu sím-mi̍h sî?
Lín tio̍h ūi sàn-chhiah-lâng kap ko͘-jî sin-oan, ūi khùn-khó͘ khiàm-kheh ê lâng chú-chhî kong-tō.
Tio̍h kái-kiù sàn-chhiah khiàm-kheh ê lâng, hō͘ in thoat-lī pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhiú.
“Lín m̄ chai, oân-choân bōe liáu-kái, tī o͘-àm tiong kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì; kong-gī ê kun-ki lóng iô-choah.
Góa bat kóng, ‘Lín sī sîn, lóng sī Chì-koân Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ;
m̄-kú lín kap sè-kan-lâng siâng-khoán lóng ōe sí, chhin-chhiūⁿ ta̍k-ê léng-siù ōe tó--lo̍h-khì.’”
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí khí-lâi sím-phòaⁿ sè-kài, in-ūi bān-kok lóng sī lí ê.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí m̄-thang tiām-tiām; Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí m̄-thang bô khui-chhùi, bô chhut-siaⁿ.
In-ūi lí ê tùi-te̍k teh jiáu-loān; oàn-hūn lí ê lâng teh hoán-poān.
In ēng kan-chà ê kè-bô͘ beh hāi lí ê chú-bîn; in chham-siông beh hāi lí pó-hō͘ ê lâng.
In kóng, “Lâi, lán lâi siau-bia̍t in, hō͘ in bông kok, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê miâ éng-oán siau-sit.”
In tâng-sim chham-siông, li̍p-iok liân-bêng beh tùi-khòng lí;
in chiū-sī tòa pò͘-pîⁿ ê Í-tong kap Í-si̍t-má-lī -lâng, Mô͘-ap kap Hā-kah -lâng,
Ka-pa-le̍k, A-bûn, kap A-má-le̍k, Hui-lī-sū, í-ki̍p Thài-ní ê chū-bîn;
A-su̍t mā kap in liân-ha̍p, chòe Lô-tek kiáⁿ-sun ê liân-bêng.
Kiû lí tùi-hù in chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-hù Bí-tiân -lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ lí tī Ki-sūn-hô tùi-hù Se-se-la kap Iâ-pin.
In tī Ún To-ní bia̍t-bông, pìⁿ-chòe tōe-chiūⁿ ê pùn-sò.
Kiû lí hō͘ in ê léng-siù chhin-chhiūⁿ Gô-li̍p kap Se-i-pek, hō͘ in ê kun-tiúⁿ lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ Se-pa kap Sat-bō͘-ná.
In kóng, “Lán tio̍h lâi-khì, kā Siōng-tè ê bo̍k-tiûⁿ chiàm-chòe lán ê.”
Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí hō͘ in chhin-chhiūⁿ kńg-lê-á-hong kńg--khí-lâi ê tîn-ai, chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ hong chhe-cháu ê chháu-á-iù.
Hé án-chóaⁿ sio chhiū-nâ, hé-iām án-chóaⁿ sio soaⁿ-niá,
kiû lí mā án-ni ēng lí ê kông-hong tui-kóaⁿ in, ēng lí ê pō-ú hō͘ in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí hō͘ in móa-bīn kiàn-siàu, thang lâi chhē-kiû lí.
Goān in éng-oán kiàn-siàu kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; goān in làu-khùi bia̍t-bông.
Goān in chai chí-ū lí sī Siōng Chú, sī chiáng-koán choân-tōe Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ah, lí khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi hō͘ lâng hiah-ni̍h ì-ài!
Góa loân-bō͘ Siōng Chú ê tiâⁿ kàu beh hūn--khì! Góa ê sim-sîn ǹg éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, góa ê Ông, góa ê Siōng-tè ah, chhek-chiáu-á tī lí ê chè-tôaⁿ piⁿ choh-siū; liân ìⁿ-á mā tī hia ūi-tio̍h ka-kī chhē-tio̍h áⁿ-kiáⁿ ê siū.
Khiā-khí tī lí tiān ê tiâⁿ ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! In chheng-chàn lí bô-soah!
Tùi lí tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! In pek-chhiat ài chiūⁿ Sek-an-soaⁿ tiâu-sèng.
In keng-kè ê ta-sò soaⁿ-kok lóng pìⁿ-chòe chôaⁿ-goân; chhiu-ú kàng-lo̍h, hok-khì móa-móa.
In ná kiâⁿ ná ū la̍t, lóng beh tī Sek-an tiâu-kìⁿ Siōng-tè.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó! Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang lâi thiaⁿ!
Pó-hō͘ goán ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí koàn-kò͘! Kiû lí sù-hok hō͘ lí só͘ siat-li̍p ê ông!
Tī lí ê tiâⁿ tiàm chi̍t ji̍t, khah iâⁿ tī pa̍t-ūi tiàm chi̍t-chheng ji̍t! Góa lêng-khó tī góa Siōng-tè ê chhù kò͘-mn̂g, mā m̄-goān tiàm tī siâ-ok ê lâng ê chhù-lāi.
In-ūi Chú Siōng-tè sī ji̍t-thâu, sī tún-pâi: I hō͘ lán un-hūi kap kong-êng; I m̄-bat lâu chi̍t hāng hó-mi̍h bô hō͘ chèng-ti̍t ê lâng.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ah, sìn-khò lí ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Siōng Chú ah, lí ū si-un hō͘ lí ê tōe; Í-sek-lia̍t siū-lia̍h ê lâng lí ū kái-kiù in tò--lâi.
Lí ū sià-bián lí chú-bîn ê chōe-ok, chhat-siau in it-chhè ê chōe-kò.
Lí ū siu-hôe lí lóng-chóng ê siū-khì, soah lí béng-lia̍t ê siū-khì.
Chín-kiù goán ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí hō͘ goán tò-tńg--lâi, soah lí tùi goán ê siū-khì.
Lí kiám beh éng-oán tùi goán siū-khì? Kiám beh kè-sio̍k siū-khì kàu bān-tāi?
Lí kiám m̄ koh kā goán kiù oa̍h, hō͘ lí ê chú-bîn in-ūi lí lâi hoaⁿ-hí?
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí hō͘ goán keng-giām lí put-piàn ê thiàⁿ, chiong lí ê kiù-un sù hō͘ goán.

Góa beh thiaⁿ Chú Siōng-tè só͘ beh kóng ê ōe; in-ūi I beh tùi I ê chú-bîn, chiū-sī sèng ê chú-bîn, èng-ún sù pêng-an hoân-êng; chóng-sī in m̄-thang tò-tńg-khì kiâⁿ gû-gōng ê lō͘.
I it-tēng ōe chín-kiù kèng-ùi I ê lâng, hō͘ I ê êng-kng lîm-chāi tī lán kéng-lāi.
Chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t saⁿ-tú; kong-gī kap hô-pêng sio-lám.
Sìn-si̍t tùi tōe hoat-chhut; kong-gī tùi thiⁿ kàng-lo̍h.
Siōng Chú sù hó-mi̍h; lán ê thó͘-tōe tōa hong-siu.
Kong-gī ōe kiâⁿ tī Siōng Chú thâu-chêng, ūi I chún-pī tō-lō͘.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa, ìn góa, in-ūi góa khùn-khó͘ sàn-chhiah.
Kiû lí pó-chûn góa ê sìⁿ-miā, in-ūi góa sìn-khò lí. Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, lí ê po̍k-jîn óa-khò lí; kiû lí chín-kiù góa.
Chú ah, kiû lí lîn-bín góa, in-ūi góa kui-ji̍t kiû-kiò lí.
Chú ah, kiû lí hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn sim-sîn hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi góa gióng-bōng lí, tùi lí kî-tó.
Chú ah, lí liông-siān, hoaⁿ-hí sià-bián; lí sù hong-sēng ê chû-ài hō͘ só͘-ū kiû-kiò lí ê lâng.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó, àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ góa khún-kiû ê siaⁿ.
Góa tī hoān-lān ê ji̍t kiû-kiò lí, in-ūi lí ōe ìn góa.
Chú ah, chiah-ê sîn-bêng bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kap lí saⁿ-pí; in ê só͘-chòe mā bōe-tàng kap lí pí.
Chú ah, lí só͘ chō ê bān-bîn lóng ōe lâi kàu lí ê bīn-chêng phak-pài; in ōe êng-iāu lí ê miâ.
In-ūi lí úi-tāi, chòe kî-biāu ê sū; chí-ū lí sī Siōng-tè.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí chiong lí ê tō-lō͘ chí-sī góa, góa beh chiàu lí ê chin-lí lâi kiâⁿ; kiû lí hō͘ góa ēng choan-it ê sim kèng-ùi lí ê miâ.
Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, góa beh choân-sim chheng-chàn lí; góa beh éng-oán êng-iāu lí ê miâ.
Lí si-lo̍h hō͘ góa ê chû-ài hiah-ni̍h tōa, ū kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā bián lo̍h Im-hú siōng-chhim ê só͘-chāi.
Siōng-tè ah, kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng khí-lâi kong-kek góa; kui-tīn kiông-pō ê lâng siàu-siūⁿ góa ê sìⁿ-miā; in bô chiong lí khǹg tī gán-tiong.
Chú ah, lí sī jîn-chû un-tián ê Siōng-tè, bô khoài siū-khì, koh ū hong-sēng ê chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t.
Kiû lí oa̍t kè-lâi khòaⁿ góa, khó-lîn góa, chiong lí ê khùi-la̍t sù hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn, kiù lí lú-pī ê kiáⁿ.
Kiû lí hián-sī un-thāi góa ê chèng-kù, hō͘ oàn-hūn góa ê lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h lâi kiàn-siàu, in-ūi Siōng Chú lí ū pang-chān góa, an-ùi góa.
Siōng Chú tī sèng-soaⁿ khí-chō ka-kī ê siâⁿ.
Siōng Chú ì-ài Sek-an ê siâⁿ-mn̂g, iâⁿ-kè Í-sek-lia̍t lóng-chóng khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.
Siōng-tè ê siâⁿ ah, hiah-ê thang khoa-iāu ê sū sī chí lí kóng--ê.
Góa beh chiong Ai-ki̍p kap Pa-pí-lûn lia̍t-ji̍p bat góa ê bîn-cho̍k lāi-bīn; khòaⁿ ah, Hui-lī-sū, Thài-ní, Kó͘-si̍t, in ta̍k-ê lóng tī chia chhut-sì.
Koan-hē Sek-an, lâng beh kóng, “Chit-ê, hit-ê, lóng tī chia chhut-sì; Chì-koân-chiá beh chhin-sin hō͘ Sek-an éng-oán kian-kò͘.”
Siōng Chú tiàu bān-cho̍k lâi teng-kì ê sî, I ōe kì-lio̍k kóng, “Chit-ê lâng chhut-sì tī hia.”
Chhiùⁿ-koa--ê, thiàu-bú--ê lóng kóng, “ Sek-an sī góa hok-khì ê goân-thâu.”
Siōng Chú, chín-kiù góa ê Siōng-tè ah, góa mî-ji̍t tī lí ê bīn-chêng kiû-kiò.
Goān góa ê kî-tó ta̍t-kàu lí bīn-chêng; kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa ê kî-kiû.
In-ūi góa keng-le̍k chin chōe hoān-lān; góa ê sìⁿ-miā biān-lîm sí-bông.
Góa kap beh lo̍h Im-hú ê lâng siâng-khoán, lóng bô khùi-la̍t, bô lâng pang-chān.
Góa hō͘ lâng tàn tī sí-lâng tiong-kan, chhin-chhiūⁿ siū thâi ê lâng tó tī bōng-lāi, bô koh hō͘ lí kì--teh, bô koh tit-tio̍h lí ê pang-chān.
Lí kā góa hiat tī Chhim-khiⁿ, tī o͘-àm ê Chhim-ian.
Lí ê siū-khì tāng-tāng teh góa; lí ēng hái-éng tùi sì-bīn im-ba̍t góa.
Lí hō͘ góa ê ti-kí lī-khui góa hn̄g-hn̄g, hō͘ in iàm-ò͘ⁿ góa. Góa siū koaiⁿ-kìm, bōe-tit chhut--khì.
Góa in-ūi iu-siong ba̍k-chiu hoe. Siōng Chú ah, góa ta̍k-ji̍t kiû-kiò lí; góa ǹg lí gia̍h-chhiú kî-tó.
Lí kiám beh kiâⁿ kî-sū hō͘ sí-lâng khòaⁿ? Im-hûn kiám ōe khí-lâi chheng-chàn lí?
Lâng kiám ōe tī bōng-lāi kóng-khí lí ê chû-ài? Lâng kiám ōe tī bia̍t-bông ê só͘-chāi kóng-khí lí ê sìn-si̍t?
Tī o͘-àm ê só͘-chāi, lí ê kî-sū kiám ū lâng khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h? Tī bô kì-e̍k ê só͘-chāi, lí ê kong-gī kiám ū lâng ōe chai?
Siōng Chú ah, góa ū tùi lí kî-kiû; chá-khí-sî góa ê kî-tó ōe thàu kàu lí ê bīn-chêng.
Siōng Chú ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ khì-sak góa? Sī-án-chóaⁿ bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ khòaⁿ góa?
Góa tùi siàu-liân siū-khó͘, hiám-hiám sí; góa siū-tio̍h lí ê chek-hoa̍t tì-kàu sim hun-loān.
Lí ê tōa siū-khì kā góa teh-chhùi; lí ēng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ kā góa húi-bia̍t.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi kui-ji̍t ûi góa, tùi sì-bīn ûi-khùn góa.
Lí chiong góa ê chhin-iú keh-khui hn̄g-hn̄g; o͘-àm soah pìⁿ-chòe góa î-it ê tâng-phōaⁿ.
Góa beh éng-oán chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn Siōng Chú ê chû-ài, beh sè-sè-tāi-tāi soan-iông lí ê sìn-si̍t.
Góa bat kóng, “Lí ê chû-ài éng-oán kian-li̍p; lí ê sìn-si̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ bōe tōng-iâu.”
Lí ū kóng, “Góa kap góa kéng-soán ê lâng li̍p-iok, tùi góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t soan-sè,
‘Góa beh kiàn-li̍p lí ê hō͘-tāi kàu éng-oán, kian-kò͘ lí ê pó-chō kàu bān-tāi.’”
Siōng Chú ah, goān thiⁿ chheng-chàn lí kî-biāu ê chok-ûi, thiⁿ-sài tī chū-hōe tiong siōng-chàn lí ê sìn-si̍t.
Tī khong-tiong tó chi̍t ê ōe-pí-tit Siōng Chú? Chèng sîn-bêng tiong tó chi̍t ê ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú?
I tī thiⁿ-sài ê gī-hōe tiong sī ū tōa ui-giâm ê Siōng-tè, pí it-chhè tī I sì-ûi ê sîn-bêng koh-khah thang kiaⁿ-ùi.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè ah, lí ê tōa koân-lêng tó chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kap lí pí? Lí tī ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì lóng hián-chhut sìn-si̍t.
Hái-chúi tiòng-koân, lí kā i koán-chè; hái-éng giâ--khí-lâi, lí hō͘ i pêng-chēng.
Lí chi̍t-ē-chhiú chiū phah-chhùi hái-koài La-hap-pek; lí ēng tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú phah-sòaⁿ tùi-te̍k.
Thiⁿ sio̍k lí, tōe mā lí ê; sè-kài kap bān-mi̍h lóng sī lí só͘ kiàn-li̍p.
Lâm kap pak sī lí só͘ chhòng-chō; Tha-po̍k-soaⁿ kap Hek-bûn-soaⁿ lóng hoaⁿ-hí chheng-chàn lí ê miâ.
Lí ê chhiú-kut ū koân-lêng; lí ê chhiú ū la̍t, lí ê chiàⁿ-chhiú gia̍h-koân-koân.
Kong-gī kap chèng-ti̍t sī lí pó-chō ê tōe-ki; chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t kiâⁿ tī lí bīn-chêng.
Ōe-hiáu tùi lí hoan-ho͘ ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! Siōng Chú ah, in beh tè lí ê bīn hoat-chhut ê kng lâi kiâⁿ.
In kui-ji̍t in-ūi lí ê miâ hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi lí ê kong-gī khoài-lo̍k.
Lí sī in kî-biāu ê khùi-la̍t; in-ūi lí ê un-tián, goán ōe tit-tio̍h sèng-lī.
Siōng Chú sī goán ê pó-hō͘-chiá; Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè sī goán ê Kun-ông.
Lí chá bat tī īⁿ-siōng tiong tùi lí tiong-si̍t ê chú-bîn kóng, “Góa ū ēng hoa-koan tì tī ióng-sū ê thâu-khak; góa tùi chú-bîn tiong kéng-soán i, ko-seng i.
Góa chhē-tio̍h góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t, ēng sèng-iû boah i.
Góa ê chhiú beh chi-chhî i; góa ê chhiú-kut beh sù i khùi-la̍t.
Tùi-te̍k bô hoat-tō͘ ēng kè-tì iâⁿ-kè i; hiong-ok ê lâng bô hoat-tō͘ khún-pek i.
Góa beh tī i ê bīn-chêng phah-chhùi i ê tùi-te̍k, phah-pāi hiah-ê oàn-hūn i ê lâng.
Góa ê sìn-si̍t kap góa ê chû-ài beh kap i tông-chāi, in-ūi góa ê miâ, i ōe tit-tio̍h sèng-lī.
Góa beh hō͘ i ê chhiú chhun kàu Tōe-tiong-hái, i ê chiàⁿ-chhiú chhun kàu Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô.
I beh tùi góa kóng, ‘Lí sī góa ê Pē, góa ê Siōng-tè, sī chín-kiù góa ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ.’
Góa beh siat-li̍p i chòe tōa-kiáⁿ, chòe sè-chiūⁿ siōng-tōa ê kun-ông.
Góa beh tùi i chhî-siú chû-ài kàu éng-oán; góa kap i só͘ li̍p ê iok it-tēng bōe kái-piàn.
Góa beh pó-siú i ê hō͘-tāi kàu éng-oán, hō͘ i ê pó-chō chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ hiah-ni̍h kú-tn̂g.
“I ê kiáⁿ-sun nā khì-sak góa ê Lu̍t-hoat, bô chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng,
ûi-pōe góa ê kui-lē, bô chun-hêng góa ê kài-bēng,
góa beh ēng koáiⁿ-á hêng-hoa̍t in ê kè-sit, ēng piⁿ chhú-hoa̍t in ê chōe-ok.
Chóng-sī góa it-tēng bōe tùi i siu-hôe góa lóng-chóng ê chû-ài, mā bōe ûi-pōe góa ê sìn-si̍t.
Góa it-tēng bōe ûi-hoán góa ê iok, mā bōe kái-piàn góa kóng ê ōe.
“Góa kí ka-kī ê sèng-kiat kian-koat li̍p-sè, choa̍t-tùi bōe tùi Tāi-pi̍t kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.
I ê hō͘-tāi ōe thoân kàu éng-oán, i ê pó-chō tī góa ê bīn-chêng chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t-thâu hiah-ni̍h kú-tn̂g;
chhin-chhiūⁿ ge̍h éng-oán ún-kò͘, tī thiⁿ-téng choh khak-si̍t ê kiàn-chèng.”
Chóng-sī lí ū tùi lí boah-iû soán-li̍p--ê hoat siū-khì, kā i kū-choa̍t khì-sak.
Lí hòe-tû kap lí ê po̍k-jîn só͘ li̍p ê iok, chiong i ê hoa-koan tàn tī thô͘-kha thún-ta̍h.
Lí thiah-húi i só͘-ū ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, hō͘ i ê pó-lúi pìⁿ-chòe pha-hng ê só͘-chāi.
Kè-lō͘-lâng lóng kā i chhiúⁿ-toa̍t; keh-piah-kok lóng kā i lêng-jio̍k.
Lí hō͘ i tùi-te̍k ê chiàⁿ-chhiú gia̍h-koân, hō͘ in lóng hoaⁿ-hí.
Lí hō͘ i ê to-kiàm tun--khì bōe-tàng ēng, hō͘ i tī kau-chiàn ê sî chiàn-pāi.
Lí chiong i koân-pèng ê koáiⁿ chhiúⁿ--khí-lâi, chiong i ê pó-chō chhia-tó tī tōe--ni̍h.
Lí kiám-chió i siàu-liân ê ji̍t-chí, hō͘ i tōa-tōa kiàn-siàu.
Siōng Chú ah, lí beh bih jōa kú, kàu éng-oán sī--bô? Lí chhin-chhiūⁿ hé to̍h teh siū-khì beh jōa kú?
Kiû lí tài-liām góa ê sìⁿ-miā hiah-ni̍h té, lí chhòng-chō ê sè-kan-lâng hiah-ni̍h khang-hu!
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kú-tn̂g oa̍h--teh, bô kìⁿ-tio̍h sí, ōe kiù ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī Im-hú ê koân-sè?
Chú ah, lí í-chêng ê chû-ài tī tó-ūi? Lí tùi Tāi-pi̍t li̍p-sè èng-ún ê sìn-si̍t tī tó-ūi?
Chú ah, kiû lí ōe-kì-tit lí ê po̍k-jîn só͘ siū ê lêng-jio̍k, ōe-kì-tit góa ê sim án-chóaⁿ sêng-siū lia̍t-kok ê bú-jio̍k.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ê tùi-te̍k án-ni teh bú-jio̍k lí ê po̍k-jîn; lí boah-iû kéng-soán--ê kiâⁿ kàu tó-ūi, in lóng tè teh kā i lêng-jio̍k.
Goān chheng-chàn kui hō͘ Siōng Chú kàu éng-oán! Amen! Amen!
Chú ah, lí sè-sè-tāi-tāi sī goán ê pī-lān-só͘.
Chèng-soaⁿ iáu-bē siū-chō, tāi-tōe kap sè-kài iáu-bē chō-chiâⁿ, lí éng-éng-oán-oán sī Siōng-tè!
Lí hō͘ thô͘ chō ê lâng kui-hôe thô͘-hún, kóng, “Lâng ah, tio̍h hôe-kui goân-pún.”
Tùi lí lâi khòaⁿ, chi̍t-chheng nî chhin-chhiūⁿ kè--khì ê chā-ji̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ àm-mî ê chi̍t kiⁿ.
Lí ēng tōa-chúi kā lâng chhiong-cháu; jîn-seng chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t tiûⁿ bîn-bāng, chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu chá-khí-sî puh-íⁿ;
chá-khí-sî hoat--khí-lâi, bō͘-sēng, àm-sî tiau-siā, ta--khì.
Goán in-ūi lí ê siū-khì siau-bia̍t, in-ūi lí ê tōa siū-khì kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Lí chiong goán ê chōe-kò pâi tī lí bīn-chêng; goán pì-bi̍t ê chōe tī lí bīn-chêng po̍k-lō͘--chhut-lâi.
Goán ê ji̍t-chí lóng tī lí ê siū-khì ē kè--khì; goán ê it-seng chhin-chhiūⁿ thó͘ chi̍t ê khùi.

Goán ê hè-siū put-kò sī chhit-cha̍p, nā ióng-kiāⁿ thang kàu poeh-cha̍p. Goán ōe-tàng khoa-kháu--ê put-kò sī lô-khó͘ iu-chhiû; jîn-seng chhin-chhiūⁿ teh pe, chi̍t-ba̍k-nih-kú chiū kè--khì.
Siáⁿ-lâng kám-siū ōe tio̍h lí siū-khì ê ui-le̍k? Siáⁿ-lâng liáu-kái lí siū-khì ê khó-phàⁿ?
Kiû lí kà goán ōe-hiáu sǹg ka-kī ê ji̍t-chí, hō͘ goán ê sim ū tì-hūi.
Siōng Chú ah, lí sím-mi̍h sî chiah beh kái-piàn sim-ì? Kiû lí lîn-bín lí ê po̍k-jîn.
Kiû lí thàu-chá chiū hō͘ goán hióng-siū lí ê chû-ài, hō͘ goán chi̍t-sì-lâng chhiong-móa hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
Lí hō͘ goán it-seng ū jōa-chōe kan-khó͘ chai-lān, kiû lí mā hō͘ goán it-seng hióng-siū hiah chōe hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
Kiû lí hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê chok-ûi, hō͘ goán ê kiáⁿ-sun khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê êng-iāu.
Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí sù-hok hō͘ goán! Kiû lí hō͘ goán it-chhè ê kang-chok sūn-lī; kiû lí hō͘ goán ê só͘-chòe lóng heng-thong.
Chhē Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè chòe pī-lān-só͘ ê lâng, ōe khiā-khí tī Choân-lêng-chiá ê ìm-ńg-ē.
I tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí sī góa ê pī-lān-só͘, góa ê pó-lúi, sī góa só͘ óa-khò ê Siōng-tè.”
Siōng Chú beh kiù lí thoat-lī tng chiáu-á ê lô-bāng, kap tì-miā ê un-e̍k.
I beh ēng si̍t kā lí áⁿ--teh, hō͘ lí bih tī I ê si̍t-kó͘-ē; I ê sìn-si̍t chòe tōa-sòe ê tún-pâi pó-hō͘ lí.
Lí bián kiaⁿ mî--sî ê khióng-pò͘, á-sī ji̍t--sî siā--lâi ê chìⁿ;
mā m̄-bián kiaⁿ o͘-àm tiong liû-hêng ê un-e̍k, á-sī ji̍t tiong-tàu húi-bia̍t lâng ê to̍k-chèng.
Ū kui-chheng lâng lek lo̍h-khì lí ê tò-pêng, ū kui-bān lâng tó lo̍h-khì lí ê chiàⁿ-pêng, chiah-ê chai-lān bōe lîm-kàu lí.
M̄-kú lí ōe chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h pháiⁿ-lâng siū pò-èng.
Lí chhē Siōng Chú chòe pī-lān-só͘, ēng Chì-koân Siōng-tè chòe khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi;
chai-hāi bōe lîm-kàu lí, un-e̍k mā bōe óa-kūn lí ê pò͘-pîⁿ.
In-ūi I beh ūi-tio̍h lí hoan-hù I ê sù-chiá, tī lí só͘ kiâⁿ it-chhè ê lō͘ pó-hō͘ lí.
In beh ēng chhiú hû lí, hō͘ lí ê kha bōe tak-tio̍h chio̍h.
Lí beh ēng kha chàm sai kap to̍k-chôa, ta̍h-chhùi béng-sai kap tōa-bé chôa.
Siōng-tè kóng, “In-ūi i chin thiàⁿ góa, góa beh kái-kiù i; in-ūi i bat góa ê miâ, góa beh kā i an-tì tī an-choân ê só͘-chāi.
I kiû-kiò góa, góa beh ìn i; i tī gûi-kip ê sî, góa beh kap i tông-chāi; góa beh kái-kiù i, hō͘ i ū chun-êng.
Góa beh sù i tn̂g-hè-siū hō͘ i boán-chiok, hō͘ i khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê kiù-un.”
Siōng Chú ah, goán kám-siā lí; Chì-koân-chiá ah, chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí ê miâ si̍t-chāi chin hó!
Goán chá-khí-sî pò-iông lí ê chû-ài, ē-hng-sî pò-iông lí ê sìn-si̍t,
tôaⁿ cha̍p tiâu hiân ê khiā-khîm, ēng ga̍k-khì bí-biāu ê siaⁿ-im phōaⁿ-chàu.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ēng lí ê chok-ûi hō͘ góa hoaⁿ-hí; góa beh in-ūi lí ê chhiú ê só͘-chòe chhiùⁿ-koa khoài-lo̍k.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ê chok-ûi hiah-ni̍h úi-tāi, lí ê ì-liām hiah-ni̍h chhim-ò;
bô tì-sek ê lâng bōe liáu-kái, gû-gōng ê lâng mā bōe bêng-pe̍k.
Pháiⁿ-lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu bō͘-sēng; chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng sui-jiân heng-ōng, it-tēng lóng ōe bia̍t-bông.
Chóng-sī Siōng Chú lí chì-chun, éng-oán chiáng-koân.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ê tùi-te̍k it-tēng bia̍t-bông; só͘-ū chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng lóng ōe siū phah-sòaⁿ.
Chóng-sī lí ū ke-thiⁿ góa ê khùi-la̍t, hō͘ góa chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-gû hiah-ni̍h ióng-chòng, in-ūi lí ū ēng sin ê iû tò tī góa sin-chiūⁿ.
Góa chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê tùi-te̍k siū pò-èng, chhin-hī thiaⁿ-tio̍h kong-kek góa ê pháiⁿ-lâng siū hêng-hoa̍t.
Gī-lâng ōe heng-ōng chhin-chhiūⁿ chang-chhiū, ōe seng-tióng chhin-chhiūⁿ Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū;
chiah-ê chhiū chai tī Siōng Chú ê tiān, tī lán Siōng-tè ê tiâⁿ bō͘-sēng.
Chhiū lāu ê sî iáu ōe kiat ké-chí, chiap chin chōe, sek chhiⁿ-chhùi,
teh hián-sī Siōng Chú kong-chèng, lóng bô put-gī; I sī pó-hō͘ góa ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ.

Siōng Chú choh-ông chiáng-koân! I ēng ui-giâm chòe saⁿ chhēng; Siōng Chú ēng ui-giâm chòe saⁿ chhēng, ēng khùi-la̍t chòe tòa hâ. I kiàn-li̍p sè-kài, sè-kài éng-oán bōe tōng-iâu.
Lí ê pó-chō kó͘-chá chiū kiàn-li̍p; lí tùi éng-oán chiū chûn-chāi.
Siōng Chú ah, tōa-chúi teh giâ-éng, tōa-chúi giâ-éng chhut tōa-siaⁿ; tōa-chúi giâ-éng hōa-hōa-háu.
Siōng Chú tī thiⁿ-téng hián-chhut ui-le̍k, iâⁿ-kè hái-iûⁿ ê tōa-éng, ah-kè tōa-chúi hōa-hōa-háu ê siaⁿ.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ê kài-bēng khak-li̍p bōe kái-piàn; lí ê tiān sîn-sèng, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
Siōng Chú, lí sī sin-oan ê Siōng-tè; sin-oan ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí hoat-chhut kng.
Sím-phòaⁿ sè-kài ê Chú ah, kiû lí khí--lâi, hō͘ kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng siū eng-kai siū ê pò-èng.
Siōng Chú ah, pháiⁿ-lâng beh koh jōa kú, pháiⁿ-lâng iông-iông-tek-ì beh koh jōa kú?
In ê chhùi thò͘-chhut kiau-ngō͘ ê ōe; chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng lóng teh tián ka-kī.
Siōng Chú ah, in khi-ap lí ê chú-bîn, khó͘-chhó͘ lí ê sán-gia̍p Í-sek-lia̍t.
In hāi-sí ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū, koh sat-hāi chhut-gōa-lâng.
In kóng, “Siōng Chú it-tēng bô teh chù-ì; Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè it-tēng bô teh khòaⁿ.”
Lín chiah-ê chhin-chhiūⁿ cheng-siⁿ ê lâng tio̍h siūⁿ; lín chiah-ê gû-gōng ê lâng tī-sî chiah ōe ū tì-hūi?
Chō hī-khang ê Siōng-tè ka-kī kiám bōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ? Chō ba̍k-chiu ê Siōng-tè ka-kī kiám bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ?
Koán-kàu lia̍t-pang ê Siōng-tè kiám bōe chhú-hoa̍t? Kàu-tō lâng ê Siōng-tè kiám ōe bô tì-sek?
Siōng Chú chai lâng ê sim-su, chai in só͘ siūⁿ--ê lóng bô lō͘-ēng.
Siōng Chú ah, siū lí koán-kàu ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! Lí ēng lu̍t-hoat kā i kàu-tō,
beh hō͘ i tī hoān-lān ê ji̍t an-ún chū-chāi, ti̍t-kàu beh tâi pháiⁿ-lâng ê bōng ku̍t hó-sè.
Siōng Chú it-tēng bōe pàng-sak I ê chú-bîn, mā bōe hòng-khì I ê sán-gia̍p Í-sek-lia̍t.
I ōe koh chiàu kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ, sim chèng-ti̍t ê lâng lóng ōe tè I.
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe ūi góa khí-lâi kong-kek pháiⁿ-lâng? Siáⁿ-lâng ōe ūi góa khiā khí-lâi kong-kek chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng?
Nā m̄-sī Siōng Chú pang-chān góa, góa chin kín chiū lo̍h-khì éng-oán chēng-be̍k ê só͘-chāi.
Góa kóng “Góa ê kha ta̍h chhū--khì”; hit-sî, Siōng Chú ah, lí ēng chû-ài hû-chhî góa.
Góa sim-lāi ū chin chōe iu-būn khòa-lū, lí ê an-ùi hō͘ góa sim-sîn khoài-lo̍k.
Hú-pāi ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ lī-iōng hoat-lu̍t chè-chō kan-ok, in kiám ōe kap lí khiā kâng-pêng?
In tàu-tīn kè-bô͘ beh hāi gī-lâng ê sìⁿ-miā, kā bô chōe ê lâng tēng sí-chōe.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú chòe góa ê pó-lúi; góa ê Siōng-tè chòe góa ê pī-lān-só͘.
I hō͘ in ê chōe-ok siū-tio̍h pò-èng; in chòe pháiⁿ ê sî, I beh châu-bia̍t in. Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè beh châu-bia̍t in.
Lâi ah, lán lâi chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló Siōng Chú! Lán lâi chheng-chàn chín-kiù lán ê pó-hō͘-chiá!
Lán tio̍h ēng kám-siā lâi kàu I ê bīn-chêng! Tio̍h tùi I chhiùⁿ hoaⁿ-hí ê koa!
In-ūi Siōng Chú sī úi-tāi ê Siōng-tè, sī iâⁿ-kè it-chhè sîn-bêng ê tōa Kun-ông.
I thóng-hat tōe ke̍k-chhim ê só͘-chāi; ke̍k-koân ê soaⁿ-hong mā tī I chhiú-lāi.
I chhòng-chō hái-iûⁿ, tōa-hái sio̍k I; I mā chhin-chhiú chhòng-chō lio̍k-tōe.
Lâi ah, lán lâi kiok-kiong kèng-pài I! Lán lâi kūi-pài chhòng-chō lán ê Siōng Chú!
In-ūi I sī lán ê Siōng-tè; lán sī I bo̍k-ióng ê iûⁿ-kûn, sī I chiàu-kò͘ ê chú-bîn. Kin-á-ji̍t, lín eng-kai tio̍h thiaⁿ I ê ōe.
Lín m̄-thang ngī-sim, chhin-chhiūⁿ tī Bí-lī-pa ê sî, chhin-chhiūⁿ tī khòng-iá ê Má-sat hit chi̍t ji̍t.
Hit-sî, lín ê chó͘-sian khó-giām góa; sui-jiân in ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê chok-ûi, iáu-kú chhì-thàm góa.
Sì-cha̍p nî kú, góa thó-ià hit sè-tāi ê lâng. Góa kóng, “In sī sim-sîn bô-tiāⁿ ê chú-bîn; in m̄ bat góa ê tō-lō͘.”
Só͘-í, góa tī siū-khì tiong li̍p-sè, kóng, “In choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng chìn-ji̍p góa ê thó͘-tōe an-hioh.”
Tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ sin ê koa! Choân-tōe lóng tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ-koa!
Tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ-koa, chheng-chàn I ê miâ! Tio̍h ji̍t-ji̍t soan-pò͘ I chín-kiù ê hó siau-sit!
Tio̍h tùi bān-kok soan-iông I ê êng-iāu! Tio̍h tùi bān-bîn kóng-khí I úi-tāi ê chok-ûi!
In-ūi Siōng Chú chì-tōa, eng-kai siū ke̍k-tōa ê chheng-chàn; I pí só͘-ū ê sîn-bêng eng-kai koh-khah siū kèng-ùi.
In-ūi gōa-pang ê sîn-bêng put-kò sī ngó͘-siōng; m̄-kú Siōng Chú chhòng-chō chiah-ê thiⁿ.
Chun-kùi kap ui-giâm pau-ûi I; koân-lêng kap êng-kng chhiong-móa I ê sèng-só͘.
Tōe-chiūⁿ bān-bîn lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Tio̍h chiong êng-iāu kap koân-lêng kui hō͘ I!
Tio̍h chiong Siōng Chú èng-tit ê êng-iāu kui hō͘ I! Tio̍h tòa chè-mi̍h chìn-ji̍p I ê tiâⁿ!
Tio̍h chhēng sèng-kiat chòe lé-ho̍k kèng-pài Siōng Chú! Choân-tōe tio̍h tī I bīn-chêng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah!
Tio̍h tùi bān-kok soan-pò͘, “Siōng Chú choh-ông! Sè-kài kian-kò͘ bōe tōng-iâu; I beh ēng kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ bān-bîn.”
Thiⁿ tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí, tōe tio̍h khoài-lo̍k! Hái kap hit lāi-bīn ê oa̍h-mi̍h lóng tio̍h chhut tōa-siaⁿ!
Chhân-hn̂g kap kî-tiong só͘-ū--ê lóng tio̍h khoài-lo̍k! Hit-sî, chhiū-nâ lāi ê chhiū-ba̍k lóng beh tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa.
Siōng Chú teh lâi lah; I beh lâi sím-phòaⁿ phó͘-thiⁿ-ē. I beh ēng kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ sè-kài; I beh ēng sìn-si̍t sím-phòaⁿ bān-bîn.
Siōng Chú choh-ông, tāi-tōe tio̍h khoài-lo̍k; chèng hái-tó tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí.
Ba̍t-hûn kap o͘-àm tī I ê sì-ûi; kong-gī kap chèng-ti̍t sī I pó-chō ê tōe-ki.
Hé kiâⁿ tī I ê bīn-chêng, sio I sì-ûi ê tùi-te̍k.
I ê sih-nà chiò-kng sè-kài; tāi-tōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ chiū iô-choah.
Tī Siōng Chú — choân-tōe ê Chú bīn-chêng, chèng-soaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ la̍h siau-iûⁿ.
Thiⁿ soan-pò͘ I ê kong-gī; lia̍t-pang khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I ê êng-kng.
Só͘-ū ho̍k-sāi tiau-khek ê ngó͘-siōng, ēng hu-ké ê sîn-bêng lâi khoa-kháu ê lâng lóng ōe kiàn-siàu sit-pāi. Chèng sîn-bêng ah, lín lóng tio̍h kèng-pài Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú ah, in-ūi lí ê sím-phòaⁿ, Sek-an thiaⁿ--kìⁿ chiū hoaⁿ-hí, Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ mā lóng khoài-lo̍k.
In-ūi Siōng Chú lí chì-koân, pôaⁿ-kè choân-tōe; lí chì-chun chhiau-oa̍t chèng sîn-bêng.
Siōng Chú só͘ thiàⁿ ê lâng oàn-hūn pháiⁿ. I pó-hō͘ I sèng ê chú-bîn ê sìⁿ-miā, kiù in thoat-lī pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhiú.
Kng ūi-tio̍h gī-lâng chhut-hiān; hí-lo̍k ūi-tio̍h sim chèng-ti̍t ê lâng chún-pī.
Gī-lâng ah, tio̍h in-ūi Siōng Chú hoaⁿ-hí, chheng-chàn I ê sèng-miâ.
Lín tio̍h ǹg Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ sin ê koa, in-ūi I ū chòe kî-biāu ê sū; I ê chiàⁿ-chhiú, sèng ê chhiú-kut si-hêng chín-kiù.
Siōng Chú í-keng soan-pò͘ I ê kiù-un, tùi lia̍t-pang hián-bêng I ê kong-gī.
I ōe-kì-tit I tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -ke èng-ún ê chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t; thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak lóng ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lán ê Siōng-tè ê chín-kiù.
Choân-tōe lóng tio̍h ǹg Siōng Chú chhut hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ; tio̍h chhut tōa-siaⁿ hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn I.
Tio̍h tôaⁿ-khîm chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, tôaⁿ-khîm chhiùⁿ hó-thiaⁿ ê si-koa o-ló I.
Tio̍h ēng lat-pah kap sàu-kak, tī Siōng Chú — lán ê Ông bīn-chêng chhut hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ.
Goān hái kap hái-tiong ê it-chhè lóng chhut-siaⁿ; sè-kài kap bān-mi̍h mā chhut tōa-siaⁿ.
Goān kang-hô phah-pho̍k-á hoaⁿ-hí, chèng soaⁿ-niá tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng chòe-hé khoài-lo̍k chhiùⁿ-koa;
in-ūi I lâi beh sím-phòaⁿ choân-tōe, I beh chiàu kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ sè-kài, ēng kong-pêng sím-phòaⁿ bān-bîn.
Siōng Chú choh-ông, bān-bîn ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah; I chē tī thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek pó-chō téng, tāi-tōe iô-tāng.
Siōng Chú tī Sek-an choh-tōa; I siū bān-bîn chun-chông.
Goān in chheng-chàn I úi-tāi thang kiaⁿ-ùi ê miâ. I sī chì-sèng!
Ū tōa koân-le̍k ê Ông ah, lí ì-ài chèng-ti̍t; lí kiàn-li̍p kong-pêng, tī Í-sek-lia̍t si-hêng chèng-ti̍t kong-gī.
Tio̍h chun-chông Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè, tī I kha-tiam ê thâu-chêng kūi-pài; I sī chì-sèng!
Tī I ê chè-si tiong ū Mô͘-se kap A-lûn; tī kiû-kiò I ê miâ ê lâng tiong-kan ū Sat-bó-ní; in kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, I ū ìn-tap.
I tī hûn-thiāu tiong tùi in kóng-ōe; in chun-siú I pan-pò͘ ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē.
Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ah, lí ū ìn-tap in; sui-jiân lí ū chiàu in ê só͘-chòe kā in pò-èng, iáu-kú lí sī sià-bián in ê Siōng-tè.
Tio̍h chun-chông Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè, tī I ê sèng-soaⁿ kūi-pài. Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè chì-sèng!
Choân-tōe ah, tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú hoan-ho͘!
Tio̍h hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí lâi kèng-pài Siōng Chú! Tio̍h chhiùⁿ chàn-bí ê si-koa lâi kàu I bīn-chêng!
Tio̍h chai Siōng Chú sī Siōng-tè! I chhòng-chō lán, lán sio̍k I; lán sī I ê chú-bîn, sī I bo̍k-ióng ê iûⁿ-kûn.
Tio̍h ēng kám-siā chìn-ji̍p I ê mn̂g! Tio̍h ēng siōng-chàn ji̍p-khì I ê tiâⁿ! Tio̍h kám-siā I, chheng-chàn I ê miâ!
Siōng Chú chì-siān: I ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán! I ê sìn-si̍t thàu kàu bān-tāi!
Góa beh chhiùⁿ chû-ài kap kong-gī ê koa; Siōng Chú ah, góa beh siōng-chàn lí.
Góa beh kín-sīn kiâⁿ chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘; lí sím-mi̍h sî chiah beh lâi góa chia? Góa beh ēng chèng-ti̍t ê sim tī kiong-lāi seng-oa̍h.
Hā-chiān ê sū, góa lóng m̄ khòaⁿ; pōe-ge̍k Siōng-tè ê lâng ê só͘-chòe, góa chin iàm-ò͘ⁿ; góa m̄ hō͘ i bak--tio̍h.
Oan-khiau ê sim-su, góa lóng bô ài; it-chhè ê pháiⁿ-tāi, góa lóng kū-choa̍t.
Àm-tiong húi-pòng chhù-piⁿ ê lâng, góa beh kā i húi-bia̍t; ba̍k-thâu-koân, sim kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng, góa bōe iông-ún.
Góa beh koàn-kò͘ kok-lāi tiong-si̍t ê lâng, hō͘ in kap góa chòe-hé tòa; góa beh hō͘ kiâⁿ chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘ ê lâng ho̍k-sāi góa.
Khúi-chà ê lâng bōe-ēng-tit tòa góa ê kiong-lāi; pe̍h-chha̍t ê lâng bōe-ēng-tit khiā tī góa ê ba̍k-chiu chêng.
Ta̍k chá-khí góa beh húi-bia̍t kok-lāi ê pháiⁿ-lâng, chiong só͘-ū chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng tùi Siōng Chú ê siâⁿ siau-tû.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó, hō͘ góa kiû-kiò ê siaⁿ thàu kàu lí ê bīn-chêng.
Góa tī gûi-kip ê ji̍t, m̄-thang bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ khòaⁿ góa; kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa. Góa kiû-kiò ê sî, kiû lí sûi-sî ìn góa.
In-ūi góa ê sìⁿ-miā chhin-chhiūⁿ ian siau-sòaⁿ; góa ê kut-thâu chhin-chhiūⁿ chhâ tī hé-lô͘ lāi teh sio.
Góa ê sim siū-siong, chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu ta--khì, liân pn̄g to bô ài chia̍h.
Góa thó͘-khùi haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan; góa siau-sán-lo̍h-bah.
Góa chhin-chhiūⁿ khòng-iá ê thê-ô͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ hong-po͘ ê àm-kong-chiáu.
Góa kui-mî bô khùn, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhù-téng ko͘-toaⁿ ê chiáu-á.
Góa ê tùi-te̍k kui-ji̍t bú-jio̍k góa; thí-chhiò góa ê lâng ēng góa kā lâng chiù-chó͘.
Góa ēng hé-hu chún pn̄g chia̍h, só͘ lim--ê lóng chham ba̍k-sái.
Che sī in-ūi lí khí sèng-tē hoat siū-khì, kā góa giâ--khí-lâi koh hiat--lo̍h-khì.
Góa ê sìⁿ-miā chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t chhiâ, chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu ta--khì.
Chí-ū Siōng Chú lí éng-oán chûn-chāi, hō͘ lâng kì-liām kàu bān-tāi.
Lí beh khí-lâi lîn-bín Sek-an; in-ūi hiān-chāi sī si-un ê sî, chí-tēng ê ji̍t í-keng kàu.
Lí ê po̍k-jîn ì-ài Sek-an ê chio̍h-thâu, liân i ê thô͘-hún to pó-sioh.
Lia̍t-kok ōe kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê miâ; sè-chiūⁿ ê kun-ông lóng ōe kèng-ùi lí ê êng-kng.
In-ūi Siōng Chú tiông-kiàn Sek-an ê sî, beh tī I ê êng-kng tiong hián-hiān.
I àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ sàn-chhiah-lâng ê kî-tó, bōe khòaⁿ-khin in ê khún-kiû.
Tio̍h ūi-tio̍h hō͘-tāi ê lâng kì-chài Siōng Chú ê chok-ûi, hō͘ chiong-lâi chhut-sì ê lâng thang chheng-chàn I.
Siōng Chú tùi chì-koân ê sèng-só͘ khòaⁿ--lo̍h-lâi, tùi thiⁿ-téng khòaⁿ lo̍h tōe.
I beh thiaⁿ siû-hoān ê thó͘-khùi, beh kái-kiù siū phòaⁿ sí-hêng ê lâng,
hō͘ lâng thang tī Sek-an thoân-iông Siōng Chú ê miâ, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng thoân-pò͘ chheng-chàn I ê ōe;
hit-sî lia̍t-kok ōe chū-chi̍p, bān-bîn ōe ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú.
I hō͘ góa ê khùi-la̍t bī-ló-sian-soe, hō͘ góa ê sìⁿ-miā sok-té.
Góa kóng, “Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, m̄-thang tī góa tiong-liân ê sî thó góa ê sìⁿ-miā.” Lí ê nî-ji̍t kàu bān sè-tāi bû-kiông-chīn!
Lí tī khí-thâu kā tōe hē tōe-ki; thiⁿ mā-sī lí chhin-chhiú chhòng-chō.
Thiⁿ-tōe lóng ōe siau-sit, m̄-kú lí éng-oán chûn-chāi. In ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ saⁿ chhēng phòa--khì; lí ōe kā in thòe-ōaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ ōaⁿ-saⁿ, in chiū bô--khì.
Chí-ū lí bōe kái-piàn; lí ê hè-siū bû-kiông-chīn.
Goān lí po̍k-jîn ê kiáⁿ-sun kú-tn̂g an-ún khiā-khí, in ê hō͘-tāi tī lí bīn-chêng kian-kò͘ khiā-chāi.
Góa ê sim-sîn ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Tio̍h ēng choân-pō͘ ê sim-sîn o-ló I ê sèng-miâ!
Góa ê sim-sîn ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! M̄-thang bōe-kì-tit I it-chhè ê un-hūi.
I sià-bián lí lóng-chóng ê chōe, i-hó lí it-chhè ê pīⁿ.
I kiù lí thoat-lī sí-bông ê hām-khiⁿ, ēng chû-pi kap jîn-ài chòe hoa-koan sù hō͘ lí.
I ēng ta̍k-khoán hó-mi̍h hō͘ lí chi̍t-sì-lâng boán-chiok, hō͘ lí hôe-ho̍k siàu-liân chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu hiah-ni̍h ióng-chòng.
Siōng Chú chip-hêng kong-gī; I ūi-tio̍h it-chhè siū ap-chè ê lâng sin-oan.
I ēng I ê tō-lō͘ chí-sī Mô͘-se, ēng I ê chok-ûi chí-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng.
Siōng Chú ū chû-pi, ū jîn-ài, bōe khoài siū-khì, ū hong-sēng ê chû-ài.
I bōe kú-tn̂g chek-pī, bōe éng-oán khǹg siū-khì.
I bōe chiàu lán ê chōe-kò chek-hoa̍t lán, mā bōe chiàu lán ê chōe-gia̍t pò-èng lán.
Thiⁿ lī-khui tōe ū jōa koân, I ê chû-ài tùi kèng-ùi I ê lâng mā hiah-ni̍h tōa.
Tang lī-khui sai ū jōa hn̄g, I hō͘ lán ê chōe-kò lī-khui lán mā hiah-ni̍h hn̄g.
Lāu-pē án-chóaⁿ thiàⁿ-sioh ka-kī ê kiáⁿ-jî, Siōng Chú mā ōe án-ni thiàⁿ-sioh kèng-ùi I ê lâng.
In-ūi I chai-iáⁿ lán siū-chō ê pún-chit; I ōe-kì-tit lán put-kò sī thô͘-hún.
Lâng leh, in ê sìⁿ-miā chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu; in chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-hoe seng-tióng bō͘-sēng,
hong chi̍t-ē chhe chiū siau-sit; bô lâng ōe koh khòaⁿ--tio̍h.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú éng-oán thiàⁿ-sioh kèng-ùi I ê lâng; I ēng kong-gī tùi-thāi in ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun,
chiū-sī hiah-ê chun-siú I ê iok, tiong-si̍t chun-hêng I lu̍t-lē ê lâng.
Siōng Chú tī thiⁿ-téng siat-li̍p pó-chō; I ê chú-koân phó͘-ki̍p bān-iú.
Ū tōa koân-lêng ê thiⁿ-sài, thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng-tè ê ōe, chip-hêng I bēng-lēng ê sù-chiá ah, lín lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Só͘-ū ê thian-kun, chip-hêng I chí-ì ê chhe-sài ah, lín lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Tī I chiáng-koân ta̍k só͘-chāi só͘-ū ê pī-chō-bu̍t ah, lín lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Góa ê sim-sîn ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Góa ê sim-sîn ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú. Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, lí chì-tōa! Lí ēng chun-êng ui-giâm chòe saⁿ chhēng;
lí ēng kng chòe gōa-phàu moa. Lí thí-khui thiⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ teh tah pò͘-pîⁿ;
lí tī chúi-téng an-tì kiong-tiān ê niû. Lí ēng hûn chòe chhia chē, ēng hong chòe si̍t pe.
Lí ēng hong chòe sù-chiá, ēng hé-iām chòe chhe-ēng.
Lí chiong tōe hē tī tōe-ki téng, hō͘ tōe éng-oán bōe iô-choah.
Lí hō͘ chhim-chúi ná gōa-saⁿ jia-khàm tōe-bīn, hō͘ chúi im-kè soaⁿ-niá.
Lí chi̍t-ē hoah, chúi chiū kóaⁿ-kín cháu; lí ê lûi chi̍t-ē tân, chúi chiū kín-kín lâu,
chhèng kàu soaⁿ-thâu, lo̍h kàu soaⁿ-kok, lâu kàu lí kā in tēng ê só͘-chāi.
Lí tēng kài-hān hō͘ chúi bōe pôaⁿ--kè, bōe koh tńg-lâi im tōe-bīn.
Lí hō͘ chúi-chôaⁿ tùi soaⁿ-lāi chhèng-chhut, lâu lo̍h soaⁿ-kok,
hō͘ soaⁿ-lāi ê cháu-siù ū chúi thang lim, hō͘ iá-lû chí chhùi-ta.
Lí hō͘ khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu hioh tī chúi-piⁿ, tī chhiū-ki téng chhiùⁿ-koa.
Lí tùi thiⁿ-téng ê kiong-tiān ēng chúi koàn-ak soaⁿ-niá, tùi lí só͘ chòe ê hāu-kó, tōe tit-tio̍h hù-chiok.
Lí hō͘ chháu seng-tióng, thang hō͘ cheng-siⁿ chia̍h, hō͘ chhài-soe tōa-châng, chòe lâng ê lō͘-ēng, thang hō͘ lâng tùi tōe tit-tio̍h chia̍h-mi̍h;
koh ū chiú hō͘ lâng ê sim hoaⁿ-hí; ū iû hō͘ lâng ê bīn kong-chhái; ū chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ lâng ióng-chòng ū-la̍t.
Siōng Chú só͘ chai-chèng Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū, lóng tit-tio̍h chhiong-chiok ê lūn-te̍k;
ū pe-chiáu choh-siū tī hia ê chhiū lāi-bīn; ū ho̍h tī siông-chhiū ê chhiū-ki choh-siū.
Ū koân-soaⁿ hō͘ iá-soaⁿ-iûⁿ tòa; ū chio̍h-phāng chòe chio̍h-hoan bih ê só͘-chāi.
I ēng ge̍h tēng kùi-choeh, hō͘ ji̍t-thâu chai thang lo̍h-soaⁿ.
Lí hō͘ ji̍t àm chòe mî--sî; hit-sî chhiū-nâ lāi ê pah-siù chiū lóng pê--chhut-lâi.
Sai-á-thûn háu beh chhē mi̍h chia̍h, tùi Siōng-tè thó chia̍h-mi̍h.
Ji̍t-thâu chi̍t-ē chhut, in chiū cháu-khì bih, tī in ê tōng-lāi hioh-khùn.
Lâng chhut-khì chòe kang, lô-tōng kàu ē-hng-sî.
Siōng Chú ah, lí só͘ chō--ê ná hiah-ni̍h chōe, lóng sī lí ēng tì-hūi só͘ chō; choân-tōe móa-móa lóng sī lí ê chhòng-chō.
Tī hia ū hái, tōa koh khoah, lāi-bīn ū sǹg bōe liáu ê tōng-bu̍t; tōa-sòe ê oa̍h-mi̍h lóng ū.
Tī hia ū chûn teh kiâⁿ, ū lí só͘ chhòng-chō ê hái-siù siû-lâi-siû-khì.
Chiah-ê lóng teh khò lí, lí chiàu-sî hō͘ in chia̍h-mi̍h.
Lí hiat hō͘ in, in chiū khioh--khí-lâi; lí thí-khui chhiú, in chiū ū hó-mi̍h chia̍h kàu pá.
Lí bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ khòaⁿ in, in chiū hoân-ló kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; lí chiong in ê khùi siu-hôe, in chiū sí--khì kui-hôe thô͘-hún.
Lí chi̍t-ē pûn-khùi, in chiū siū chhòng-chō; lí hō͘ tōe-bīn lóng ōaⁿ-sin.
Goān Siōng Chú ê êng-kng éng-oán chûn-sio̍k; goān Siōng Chú in-ūi ka-kī ê chhòng-chō hoaⁿ-hí.
I khòaⁿ tōe, tōe chiū tín-tāng; I bong soaⁿ, soaⁿ chiū chhèng-ian.
Góa beh chi̍t-sì-lâng tùi Siōng Chú gîm-si; góa iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî beh tùi góa ê Siōng-tè chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló.
Goān I hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p góa ê be̍k-sióng. Góa beh in-ūi Siōng Chú hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
Goān chōe-jîn tùi sè-chiūⁿ siau-bia̍t; goān pháiⁿ-lâng lóng bô--khì. Góa ê sim-sîn ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú. Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Lín tio̍h kám-siā Siōng Chú, kiû-kiò I ê miâ, tī bān-bîn tiong pò-iông I ê chok-ûi.
Tio̍h tùi I gîm-si, ǹg I chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló, tâm-lūn I it-chhè kî-biāu ê só͘-chòe.
Tio̍h khoa-iāu I ê sèng-miâ. Goān chhē-kiû Siōng Chú ê lâng sim-lāi hoaⁿ-hí.
Tio̍h óa-khò Siōng Chú kap I ê koân-lêng, put-sî chhē-kiû kìⁿ I ê bīn.
I ê po̍k-jîn A-pek-la-hán ê hō͘-tāi, I só͘ kéng Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ-sun ah, lín tio̍h siàu-liām I kî-biāu ê chok-ûi, siàu-liām I ê sîn-jiah kap I só͘ kóng phòaⁿ-toàn ê ōe.
I sī Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè; I ê sím-phòaⁿ phó͘-ki̍p choân-tōe.
I ōe-kì-tit I ê iok ti̍t-kàu éng-oán, I ê èng-ún ti̍t-kàu bān-tāi.
I ōe-kì-tit kap A-pek-la-hán li̍p ê iok, tùi Í-sat só͘ li̍p ê sè.
I chiong chit-ê iok hō͘ Ngá-kok chòe kui-lē, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t chòe éng-oán ê iok.
I kóng, “Góa beh chiong Ka-lâm -tōe sù hō͘ lí, chòe lí èng-tit ê sán-gia̍p.”
Tng-sî in ê jîn-kháu iú-hān, jîn-sò͘ chin chió; in tī hia chòe chhut-gōa-lâng.
In tùi chit-cho̍k kiâⁿ kàu hit-cho̍k, tùi chit-kok kàu hit-kok.
I bô iông-ún lâng ap-pek in; ūi-tio̍h in ê iân-kò͘, I khiàn-chek hiah-ê kun-ông.
I kóng, “M̄-thang kha̍p-tio̍h góa kéng-soán ê po̍k-jîn, mā m̄-thang khi-hū góa ê sian-ti.”
I hō͘ ki-hng kàng-lo̍h tī hit-ê thó͘-tōe, hō͘ só͘ óa-khò ê bí-niû lóng toān-choa̍t.
I chhe chi̍t ê lâng seng khì, chiū-sī siū bōe chòe lô͘-lē ê Iok-sek.
Lâng ēng kha-khàu khàu i ê kha, ēng thih-liān liān i ê ām-kún.
Siōng Chú ê ōe kā i khó-giām, ti̍t-kàu I ê ū-giân si̍t-hiān.
Ông chhe lâng kā i tháu-khui; thóng-tī bān-bîn ê Hoat-ló kā i tháu-pàng.
Ông siat-li̍p i chòe cháiⁿ-siòng, chiáng-koán Hoat-ló lóng-chóng ê châi-bu̍t,
thang sûi-ì pa̍k i ê jîn-sîn, ēng tì-hūi koán-kàu i ê tiúⁿ-ló.
Í-sek-lia̍t mā lâi kàu Ai-ki̍p; Ngá-kok chhut-gōa tī Hâm ê tōe.
Siōng Chú hō͘ I ê chú-bîn siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe, hō͘ in pí tùi-te̍k khah kiông.
I kái-piàn tùi-te̍k ê sim, hō͘ in oàn-hūn I ê chú-bîn, ēng khúi-khiat ê kè-bô͘ tùi-thāi I ê po̍k-jîn.
I chhe I ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se, kap I só͘ kéng ê A-lûn,
tī tùi-te̍k ê tiong-kan kiâⁿ I ê sîn-jiah, tī Hâm ê tōe kiâⁿ kî-sū.
I kàng-lo̍h o͘-àm, tōe chiū àm-bong-bong; Ai-ki̍p -lâng iáu-kú m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn I ê ōe.
I hō͘ in ê chúi pìⁿ-chòe huih, chúi-lāi ê hî lóng sí.
Tī in ê thó͘-tōe chhân-kap-á móa-móa-sī, liân ông ê pâng-keng to ū.
I chi̍t-ē chhut-siaⁿ, hô͘-sîn kui-tīn pe--lâi, koh tī in ê kéng-lāi ū sat-bú móa-sì-kòe.
I lo̍h-pha̍uh tāi-thòe hō͘, kàng-lo̍h sih-nà tī in choân-tōe.
I sàu-tó in ê phû-tô-chhiū kap bû-hoa-kó-chhiū, húi-hoāi in kéng-lāi ê chhiū-ba̍k.
I chi̍t-ē chhut-siaⁿ, kui-kûn ê chháu-meh kap chháu-meh-á-kiáⁿ chiū pe--lâi, chōe kah bōe-sǹg--tit,
kā in thó͘-tōe ê chhài-soe chia̍h-liáu-liáu, koh thun-chia̍h in ê chhân-hn̂g só͘ chhut ê ngó͘-kok.
I phah-sí in kok-lāi só͘-ū ê tōa-kiáⁿ, chiū-sī in ióng-chòng ê sî só͘ siⁿ--ê.
I chhōa in chhut--lâi, tòa gûn tòa kim; I ê chi-cho̍k tiong bô chi̍t ê loán-jio̍k.
In chhut--lâi ê sî, Ai-ki̍p -lâng tōa hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi Ai-ki̍p -lâng chin kiaⁿ in.
I ēng hûn kā in jia, mî--sî ēng hé kā in chiò.
In chi̍t-ē kiû, I chiū hō͘ ian-chhun pe--lâi, koh ēng thiⁿ ê chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ in pá-chiok.
I phah-khui chio̍h-pôaⁿ, chúi chiū chhèng--chhut-lâi, chiâⁿ-chòe hô-liû lâu-kè khòng-iá.
In-ūi I ōe-kì-tit I sèng ê èng-ún, ōe-kì-tit I ê po̍k-jîn A-pek-la-hán.
I chhōa I ê chú-bîn hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí chhut--lâi, chhōa I kéng-soán ê chú-bîn chhiùⁿ hoaⁿ-hí ê koa hiòng-chêng kiâⁿ.
I chiong lia̍t-kok ê thó͘-tōe sù hō͘ in, hō͘ in sêng-chiap pa̍t-ê bîn-cho̍k lô-khó͘ tit--tio̍h ê châi-hù,
thang hō͘ in chun-thàn I ê kui-lē, chun-siú I ê lu̍t-hoat. Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Tio̍h kám-siā Siōng Chú, in-ūi I chì-siān; I ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán!
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-hiáu kóng-khí Siōng Chú ê tōa koân-lêng? Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng oân-choân piáu-bêng tùi I ê chheng-chàn?
Só͘-ū ûi-hō͘ kong-pêng, put-sî si̍t-chián kong-gī ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Siōng Chú ah, lí un-thāi lí chú-bîn ê sî, kiû lí ōe-kì-tit góa; lí chín-kiù in ê sî, kiû lí koàn-kò͘ góa.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê soán-bîn heng-ōng, hō͘ góa kap lí ê kok-bîn hun-hióng khoài-lo̍k, kap lí ê chú-bîn chòe-hé khoa-iāu.
Goán kap goán ê chó͘-sian kâng-khoán ū hoān-chōe; goán phian-lī chiàⁿ-lō͘ chòe pháiⁿ.
Goán ê chó͘-sian tī Ai-ki̍p bô bêng-pe̍k lí só͘ chòe ê kî-sū, bōe-kì-tit lí hong-sēng ê chû-ài, hoán-tńg tī Âng-hái pōe-poān lí.
M̄-kú Chú, in-ūi I ê miâ ê iân-kò͘, kái-kiù in, beh hián-bêng I ê tōa koân-lêng.
I chi̍t-ē hoah Âng-hái, hái chiū ta--khì; I chhōa in keng-kè hái chhim ê só͘-chāi, ná teh keng-kè ta-tōe.
I kiù in thoat-lī oàn-hūn in ê lâng ê chhiú, tùi tùi-te̍k ê chhiú-tiong kái-kiù in.
In ê tùi-te̍k lóng hō͘ chúi im-ba̍t, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh.
Hit-chūn, in chiah sìn I ê ōe, chiah chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn I.
In chin kín chiū bōe-kì-tit I ê só͘-chòe, bô thèng-hāu I ê chí-sī.
In tī khòng-iá tōa-tōa khí tham-io̍k, tī hong-po͘ chhì-thàm Siōng-tè.
In só͘ kiû--ê, I ū hō͘ in, m̄-kú mā hō͘ in lóng soe-lám siau-sán.
In tī iâⁿ-tiong oàn-tò͘ Mô͘-se kap Siōng Chú sèng-pia̍t ê A-lûn.
Tōe chiū li̍h--khui, thun-bia̍t Tāi-tan, am-ba̍t A-pí-lân hit-kûn lâng.
Ū hé tī in tiong-kan to̍h--khí-lâi, hé-iām sio-bia̍t hiah-ê pháiⁿ-lâng.
In tī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ chō gû-á, phak-pài só͘ chù ê siōng.
Án-ni, in ēng chia̍h-chháu ê gû-á chòe siōng, thòe-ōaⁿ Siōng-tè ê êng-kng.
In bōe-kì-tit kā in chín-kiù ê Siōng-tè; I bat tī Ai-ki̍p chòe tōa tāi-chì,
tī Hâm ê tōe kiâⁿ kî-sū, tī Âng-hái chòe thang-kiaⁿ ê sū.
Só͘-í, I kóng beh kā in siau-bia̍t; nā m̄-sī I só͘ kéng-soán ê Mô͘-se khiā tī I bīn-chêng ke̍k-le̍k sin-sò͘, siau-tû I ê siū-khì, I í-keng kā in siau-bia̍t lah.
In khòaⁿ-khin hit-ê hó ê tōe, m̄ sìn I ê ōe;
in tī ka-kī ê pò͘-pîⁿ lāi bâi-oàn, m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú ê ōe.
Só͘-í I tùi in gia̍h-chhiú li̍p-sè, beh hō͘ in sí tī khòng-iá;
