hō͘ in ê kiáⁿ-sun sí tī gōa-kok, sì-sòaⁿ tī ta̍k só͘-chāi.
In tàu-tīn khì pài Pí-ní ê Pa-le̍k, chia̍h hiàn hō͘ bô sìⁿ-miā ê sîn-bêng ê chè-mi̍h.
In án-ni chòe, jiá-khí I ê siū-khì, chiū ū un-e̍k tī in tiong-kan thoân-jiám.
Hit-sî Hui-nî-hap khí-lâi thòe in pâi-kái, un-e̍k chiū soah.
Chit-ê tāi-chì Siōng-tè kā i sǹg-chòe gī, tùi hit-sî khí, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
In tī Bí-lī-pa ê chúi-chôaⁿ piⁿ koh jiá Siōng Chú siū-khì, ūi-tio̍h in ê iân-kò͘, Mô͘-se siū liân-lūi;
in-ūi in pōe-poān Siōng-tè, tì-kàu Mô͘-se kóng-chhut chhong-pōng ê ōe.
In bô thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú ê hoan-hù, bô châu-bia̍t gōa-cho̍k ê peh-sìⁿ;
hoán-tńg kap gōa-pang-lâng thong-hun, o̍h in ê só͘-chòe,
ho̍k-sāi in ê ngó͘-siōng; kiat-kó ka-kī poa̍h-lo̍h hām-chíⁿ.
In chiong kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ kúi-sîn;
in lâu bô chōe ê lâng ê huih, thâi ka-kī ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, chiong in chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Ka-lâm ê ngó͘-siōng, hit-ê tōe chiū siū-tio̍h huih ù-jiám.
Án-ni, in siū ka-kī ê hêng-ûi ù-jiám, in ê só͘-chòe hoān-tio̍h îm-hēng.
Só͘-í, Siōng Chú tùi I ê chú-bîn hoat siū-khì, iàm-ò͘ⁿ I ê sán-gia̍p Í-sek-lia̍t.
I chiong in kau tī gōa-pang-lâng ê chhiú, hō͘ oàn-hūn in ê lâng koán-hat in.
In ê tùi-te̍k ap-chè in, in chiū khut-ho̍k tī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú-ē.
Siōng Chú chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn kái-kiù in; m̄-kú in kò͘-ì pōe-ge̍k I, in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe-ok tì-kàu tūi-lo̍h.
I thiaⁿ-tio̍h in ê ai-kiò, thé-thiap in ê khùn-khó͘.
I ūi-tio̍h in siūⁿ-khí I ê iok, in-ūi hong-sēng ê chû-ài hôe-sim-tńg-ì,
hō͘ in tit-tio̍h só͘-ū lia̍h in ê lâng ê lîn-bín.

Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí chín-kiù goán, chū-chi̍p goán, chhōa goán tùi lia̍t-kok tńg--lâi, hō͘ goán thang kám-siā lí ê sèng-miâ, ēng chheng-chàn lí chòe goán siōng-tōa ê hoaⁿ-hí.
Goān chheng-chàn kui hō͘ Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, tùi éng-oán kàu éng-oán. Goān choân-thé jîn-bîn lóng kóng: Amen! Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Lín tio̍h kám-siā Siōng Chú, in-ūi I chì-siān! I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k!
Siōng Chú só͘ kiù-sio̍k ê lâng, I tùi tùi-te̍k chhiú-tiong só͘ kiù-sio̍k ê lâng,
tùi ta̍k-kok, tùi tang tùi sai, tùi lâm tùi pak, só͘ chū-chi̍p ê lâng lóng tio̍h án-ni kóng.
In tī khòng-iá pha-hng ê lō͘ liû-lōng, chhē bô siâⁿ thang khiā-khí.
In ia̍h iau ia̍h chhùi-ta; in ê sim-sîn hūn--khì.
In tī khó͘-lān tiong ai-kiû Siōng Chú, I chiū kái-kiù in thoat-lī hoān-lān.
I chhōa in kiâⁿ ti̍t ê lō͘, hō͘ in kàu thang khiā-khí ê siâⁿ.
In-ūi Siōng Chú ê chû-ài kap I tùi sè-kan-lâng só͘ chòe ê kî-sū, lâng lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn I.
I hō͘ chhùi-ta ê lâng ti-chiok, hō͘ iau-gō ê lâng ū hó-mi̍h chia̍h kàu pá.
Chē tī o͘-àm sí-ìm tiong ê lâng, siū khùn-khó͘ kap thih-liān khún-pa̍k ê lâng,
in-ūi in pōe-ge̍k Siōng-tè ê ōe, khòaⁿ-khin Chì-koân Siōng-tè ê chí-ì,
só͘-í I ēng lô-khó͘ kā in kà-koai; in poa̍h-tó, bô lâng hû-chō͘.
In tī khó͘-lān tiong ai-kiû Siōng Chú, I chiū kái-kiù in thoat-lī hoān-lān.
I tùi o͘-àm sí-ìm tiong chhōa in chhut--lâi, chhoah-tn̄g pa̍k in ê soh.
In-ūi Siōng Chú ê chû-ài kap I ūi-tio̍h sè-kan-lâng só͘ chòe ê kî-sū, lâng lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn I.
In-ūi I phah-phòa tâng ê mn̂g, chām-tn̄g thih ê mn̂g-chhòaⁿ.
Gōng-lâng in-ūi in ka-kī ê kè-sit, koh in-ūi in ê chōe-ok, siū khó͘-chhó͘.
In iàm-ò͘ⁿ ta̍k-khoán ê chia̍h-mi̍h, í-keng óa-kūn sí-bông ê mn̂g.
In tī khó͘-lān tiong ai-kiû Siōng Chú, I chiū kái-kiù in thoat-lī hoān-lān.
I chhut bēng-lēng i-hó in, kiù in thoat-lī sí-bông.
In-ūi Siōng Chú ê chû-ài kap I tùi sè-kan-lâng só͘ chòe ê kî-sū, lâng lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn I.
Goān in hiàn kám-siā ê chè, ēng hoaⁿ-hí ê si-koa kóng-khí I ê só͘-chòe.
Chē-chûn kè hái, tī tōa-hái chòe seng-lí ê lâng,
in ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê só͘-chòe, kap I tī chhim-ian só͘ chòe ê kî-sū.
Siōng Chú chi̍t-ē bēng-lēng, kông-hong chiū khí, hái-tiong ê éng giâ--khí-lâi.
In chiūⁿ kàu kiong-chhong, lo̍h kàu hái-tóe, in-ūi gûi-hiám, sîn-hûn siau-sòaⁿ.
In tian-tian-tó-tó, tang-tó-sai-oai, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiú-chùi ê lâng; in ê kang-hu lóng bô lō͘-ēng.
In tī khó͘-lān tiong ai-kiû Siōng Chú, I chiū tùi hoān-lān tiong kiù in chhut--lâi.
I hō͘ kông-hong thêng, hái-éng chiū pêng-chēng.
Hong thêng, éng chēng, in chiū hoaⁿ-hí, I chiū chhōa in kàu só͘ ài khì ê káng-kháu.
In-ūi Siōng Chú ê chû-ài kap I ūi-tio̍h sè-kan-lâng só͘ chòe ê kî-sū, lâng lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn I.
Goān in tī jîn-bîn ê chū-hōe tiong chun I chòe chì-koân, tī tiúⁿ-ló ê gī-hōe tiong chheng-chàn I.
I hō͘ kang-hô pìⁿ-chòe khòng-iá, hō͘ chúi-chôaⁿ pìⁿ-chòe ta-sò ê tōe.
I hō͘ pûi-tōe pìⁿ-chòe kiâm-tōe, che lóng sī in-ūi khiā-khí tī hia ê lâng ê chōe.
I hō͘ khòng-iá pìⁿ-chòe chúi-thâm, hō͘ ta-tōe pìⁿ-chòe chúi-chôaⁿ.
I hō͘ iau-gō ê lâng tiàm tī hia, hō͘ in khí-chō siâⁿ thang khiā-khí,
koh chèng-choh chhân-hn̂g, chai phû-tô, tit-tio̍h hong-hù ê thó͘-sán.
I sù hok-khì, hō͘ in siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe, hō͘ in ê cheng-siⁿ bô kiám-chió.
In koh in-ūi ap-pek, hoān-lān, iu-khó͘, jîn-kháu kiám-chió, hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-khin.
I hō͘ kùi-cho̍k siū bú-jio̍k, liû-lōng tī hong-hòe bô lō͘ ê só͘-chāi.
M̄-kú I thê-poa̍t sàn-chhiah-lâng, hō͘ in thoat-lī khó͘-lān, hō͘ in ka-cho̍k heng-ōng chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-kûn hiah chōe.
Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng khòaⁿ--kìⁿ chiū hoaⁿ-hí; pháiⁿ-lâng lóng tiām--khì bô ōe thang kóng.
Tì-hūi ê lâng tio̍h chù-ì chiah-ê tāi-chì, tio̍h siàu-liām Siōng Chú ê chû-ài.
Siōng-tè ah, góa ê sim kian-tēng; góa ê sim-sîn beh chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn.
Khîm ah, sek ah, tio̍h chhíⁿ--khí-lâi! Góa beh kā ji̍t-thâu kiò-chhíⁿ.
Siōng Chú ah, góa beh tī bān-bîn tiong kám-siā lí, tī lia̍t-pang tiong chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí.
Lí ê chû-ài pí thiⁿ khah koân; lí ê sìn-si̍t thàu kàu kiong-chhong.
Siōng-tè ah, goān lí ê úi-tāi pôaⁿ-kè thiⁿ; goān lí ê êng-kng piàn-chiò choân-tōe.
Kiû lí ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú khan-kiù goán lâi hôe-èng goán, hō͘ lí só͘ thiàⁿ ê lâng tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.
Siōng-tè tī I ê sèng-só͘ kóng, “Góa tōa sèng-lī lah! Góa beh hun-koah Sī-kiàm, hun-phòe So͘-kat ê soaⁿ-kok.
Ki-lia̍t sī góa ê, Má-ná-se mā sio̍k góa; Í-hoat-liân sī góa ê thâu-khoe; Iû-tāi sī góa koân-pèng ê koáiⁿ.
Mô͘-ap chòe góa ê e̍k-phûn; góa hiat góa ê ôe tī Í-tong; góa in-ūi khah iâⁿ Hui-lī-sū tōa-siaⁿ hoah.”
Siáⁿ-lâng beh chhōa góa ji̍p-khì kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ? Siáⁿ-lâng beh chhōa góa ji̍p-khì Í-tong ê tōe?
Siōng-tè ah, lí kiám ū khì-sak goán? Siōng-tè ah, lí kiám bōe koh kap goán ê kun-tūi tàu-tīn chhut-cheng?
Kiû lí oān-chō͘ goán kong-kek tùi-te̍k, in-ūi lâng ê pang-chān bōe-khò--tit.
Khò Siōng-tè goán chiah ōe tek-sèng; I ōe phah-pāi goán ê tùi-te̍k.
Góa só͘ chheng-chàn ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí m̄-thang chēng-chēng,
in-ūi siâ-ok kan-chà ê lâng khui-chhùi kong-kek góa; in ēng pe̍h-chha̍t ê chi̍h tùi góa kóng-ōe.
In ēng oàn-hūn ê ōe pau-ûi góa, bô-iân-bô-kò͘ kong-kek góa.
Góa thiàⁿ in, in hoán-tńg chòe góa ê tùi-te̍k; góa iáu-kú ūi in kî-tó.
In tùi góa ēng pháiⁿ pò hó, ēng oàn-hūn pò jîn-ài.
Kiû lí phài chi̍t ê pháiⁿ-lâng koán-hat i, phài chi̍t ê tùi-te̍k khiā tī i chiàⁿ-pêng khòng-kò i.
Kiû lí hō͘ i tī sím-phòaⁿ ê sî siū tēng-chōe, hō͘ i ê kî-tó mā sǹg-chòe chōe.
Kiû lí hō͘ i ê sìⁿ-miā kín kiat-sok, hō͘ pa̍t-lâng tāi-thòe i ê chit-ūi.
Kiû lí hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ-jî pìⁿ-chòe ko͘-jî, hō͘ i ê bó͘ pìⁿ-chòe kóaⁿ-hū.
Kiû lí hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ-jî sì-kòe kiû-khit, tùi in ê phòa-chhù hō͘ lâng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.
Kiû lí hō͘ chè-chú chhiúⁿ i it-chhè só͘-ū, hō͘ siⁿ-hūn-lâng chhiúⁿ-toa̍t i lô-khó͘ tit--tio̍h ê châi-bu̍t.
Kiû lí hō͘ i bô tit-tio̍h hó khoán-thāi, bô lâng khó-lîn i ê ko͘-jî.
Kiû lí hō͘ i ê hō͘-tāi toān-choa̍t, in ê miâ-jī siū chhat-siau, bô thoân kàu ē chi̍t tāi.
Kiû Siōng Chú ōe-kì-tit i chó͘-sian ê chōe-ok, hō͘ i lāu-bú ê chōe-kò bô tit-tio̍h chhat-siau.
Kiû Siōng Chú hō͘ in ê chōe-ok put-sî tī lí bīn-chêng, hō͘ in ê miâ tùi sè-kan siau-bia̍t.
In-ūi i bô siūⁿ-beh si lîn-bín, hoán-tńg ap-pek sàn-chhiah khùn-khó͘ ê lâng, hāi-sí siong-sim ê lâng.
I ài chiù-chó͘, goān chiù-chó͘ lîm-kàu i; I bô ài chiok-hok, goān chiok-hok lī-khui i hn̄g-hn̄g.
I ēng chiù-chó͘ chòe saⁿ chhēng, chiù-chó͘ chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi ji̍p i ê pak-lāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ iû ji̍p i ê kut.
Goān chit-ê chiù-chó͘ chòe i-ho̍k chhēng tī i seng-khu, chòe io-tòa put-sî kā i hâ-tiâu-tiâu.
Che chiū-sī i tùi Siōng Chú só͘ siū ê pò-èng; i sī góa ê tùi-te̍k, ēng pháiⁿ-ōe kong-kek góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí in-ūi lí ê miâ ê iân-kò͘ hó khoán-thāi góa, chiàu lí chì-siān ê chû-ài khan-kiù góa.
In-ūi góa sàn-chhiah khùn-khó͘, góa ê lāi-sim siū-siong.
Góa ê hè-siū chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t-iáⁿ chiām-chiām chhiâ; góa chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh hō͘ lâng pōaⁿ-tiāu.
Góa in-ūi kìm-chia̍h kha-thâu-u sng-nńg; góa siau-sán-lo̍h-bah.
Góa siū in húi-pòng; in khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa chiū hàiⁿ-thâu.
Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí pang-chān góa, chiàu lí ê chû-ài chín-kiù góa,
hō͘ in chai che sī lí chhin-chhiú só͘ chòe, sī Siōng Chú lí só͘ chòe--ê.
In sui-jiân chiù-chó͘ góa, lí ōe sù-hok hō͘ góa; in khí-lâi kong-kek góa ê sî ōe tú-tio̍h kiàn-siàu, m̄-kú lí ê po̍k-jîn ōe hoaⁿ-hí.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa ê tùi-te̍k ēng lêng-jio̍k chòe saⁿ chhēng, ēng kiàn-siàu chòe phàu moa.
Góa beh ēng góa ê chhùi tōa-tōa kám-siā Siōng Chú; góa beh tī chèng-lâng ê tiong-kan chheng-chàn I.
I beh khiā tī sàn-chhiah-lâng ê chiàⁿ-pêng, kiù i thoat-lī phòaⁿ i sí-chōe ê lâng.
Siōng Chú tùi góa ê chú kóng, “Lí chē góa ê chiàⁿ-pêng, thèng-hāu góa hō͘ lí ê tùi-te̍k chòe lí ê kha-tiam.”
Siōng Chú beh hō͘ lí tùi Sek-an chhun-chhut koân-lêng ê koáiⁿ; lí tio̍h tī tùi-te̍k ê tiong-kan chiáng-koân.
Lí chhut-cheng ê ji̍t, jîn-bîn ōe kam-sim choh-peng; lí ê chòng-teng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-khí-sî ê lō͘-chúi kiat-ha̍p, lâi sèng-soaⁿ kun-tè lí.
Siōng Chú ū li̍p-sè, it-tēng bōe hō͘-hóe, kóng, “Chiàu Be̍k-ki-sé-tek ê pan-chhù, lí éng-oán choh chè-si.”
Chú tī lí ê chiàⁿ-pêng, I siū-khì ê ji̍t ōe phah-pāi lia̍t-ông.
I beh sím-phòaⁿ bān-kok, phah-pāi in ê siú-léng, hō͘ sin-si piàn-móa choân-tōe.
Ông beh lim lō͘-piⁿ ê khoe-chúi, têng-sin tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t, pek-chiàn-pek-sèng.
Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Tī chèng-ti̍t ê lâng chū-chi̍p ê tāi-hōe tiong, góa beh choân-sim kám-siā Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú ê chok-ûi chin kî-biāu, ì-ài I chok-ûi ê lâng lóng hoaⁿ-hí chhâ-khó.
I ê chok-ûi chun-kùi ui-giâm; I ê kong-gī éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
Siōng Chú kiâⁿ kî-sū hō͘ lâng kì-liām; I ū un-hūi, ū lîn-bín.
I sù bí-niû hō͘ kèng-ùi I ê lâng; I ōe éng-oán kì-tiâu I ê iok.
I tùi I ê chú-bîn hián-bêng tōa koân-lêng ê chok-ûi, chiong lia̍t-pang ê thó͘-tōe sù hō͘ in.
I ê chhiú só͘ chòe--ê sìn-si̍t kong-pêng, I ê lu̍t-lē khak-si̍t ū-hāu,
éng-oán bōe kái-piàn, chiàu sìn-si̍t kong-chèng chè-tēng.
I kiù-sio̍k I ê chú-bîn, kap in li̍p éng-oán ê iok. I ê miâ sī sèng, thang kiaⁿ-ùi.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú sī tì-hūi ê kun-pún, chiàu án-ni chun-hêng chiah sī chhong-bêng. Siōng Chú eng-kai éng-oán siū chheng-chàn!
Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, chhim-chhim ì-ài I kài-bēng--ê, chit-khoán lâng chin ū hok-khì!
In ê kiáⁿ-sun tī Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe it-tēng kiông-sēng; chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ê hō͘-tāi it-tēng siū chiok-hok.
In ê ke-lāi chhiong-móa châi-hù; in ê hó hêng-ûi chûn kàu éng-oán.
Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng tī o͘-àm tiong ū kng teh chiò in; in ū un-hūi, ū lîn-bín, ū kong-gī.
Khóng-khài chioh--lâng koh kong-chèng chhú-lí ka-kī ê tāi-chì--ê, chit-khoán lâng sū-sū sūn-lī.
Gī-lâng choa̍t-tùi bōe sit-pāi; in éng-oán hō͘ lâng siàu-liām.
Pháiⁿ siau-sit, in lóng m̄ kiaⁿ, in-ūi sim kian-tēng, óa-khò Siōng Chú.
In ê sim chū-chāi, lóng bōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, chòe-āu ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h tùi-te̍k hō͘ Siōng Chú phah-pāi.
In khóng-khài chín-chè sàn-chhiah-lâng; in ê hó hêng-ûi chûn kàu éng-oán. In ê thâu ōe-tàng gia̍h-koân, siū lâng chun-kèng.
Pháiⁿ-lâng khòaⁿ-liáu tōa siū-khì, kā-gê-chhiat-chhí, ǹg-bāng lóng bô--khì. Pháiⁿ-lâng ê sim-goān lóng lo̍k-khong.
Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn ah, lín tio̍h chheng-chàn, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú ê miâ.
Goān Siōng Chú ê miâ siū chheng-chàn, tùi hiān-chāi kàu éng-oán.
Tùi ji̍t chhut kàu ji̍t lo̍h ê só͘-chāi, Siōng Chú ê miâ eng-kai siū chheng-chàn.
Siōng Chú thóng-hat bān-kok; I ê êng-kng pí thiⁿ khah koân.
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kap Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè pí? I chē tī chì-koân ê só͘-chāi,
àⁿ lo̍h-lâi khòaⁿ thiⁿ kap tōe.
I tùi tîn-ai ko-seng sàn-chhiah-lâng, tùi pùn-sò-tui thê-poa̍t khiàm-kheh ê lâng;
I hō͘ in pôe-phōaⁿ kùi-cho̍k, kap pún-kok ê kùi-cho̍k chòe-hé chē.
I hō͘ bōe seng-io̍k ê hū-jîn-lâng ū ka-têng, chòe chin chōe jî-lú ê lāu-bú lâi hoaⁿ-hí. Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p, Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi lī-khui ōe-gú bô-siâng ê jîn-bîn;
hit-sî Iû-tāi chiâⁿ-chòe I ê sèng-só͘, Í-sek-lia̍t chòe I ê kok-tō͘.
Tōa-hái khòaⁿ--kìⁿ chiū tô-cháu; Iok-tàn-hô tò-lâu.
Tōa-soaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-káng tiô-thiàu; sió-soaⁿ mā chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ thiàu-lâi-thiàu-khì.
Tōa-hái ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ tô-cháu? Iok-tàn-hô ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ tò-lâu?
Tōa-soaⁿ ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-káng tiô-thiàu? Sió-soaⁿ ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ thiàu-lâi-thiàu-khì?
Tāi-tōe ah, lí kìⁿ-tio̍h Chú ê bīn, kìⁿ-tio̍h Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè ê bīn, tio̍h phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.
I hō͘ chio̍h-pôaⁿ pìⁿ-chòe chúi-tî, hō͘ chio̍h-giâm pìⁿ-chòe chúi-chôaⁿ.
Siōng Chú ah, êng-kng chí-ū kui hō͘ lí, chí-ū kui hō͘ lí, in-ūi lí ê chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t, goān êng-kng kui hō͘ lí.
Lí ná beh hō͘ gōa-pang-lâng kóng, “In ê Siōng-tè tī tó-ūi?”
Goán ê Siōng-tè tī thiⁿ-téng, lóng chiàu I ê chí-ì chòe tāi-chì.
In ê ngó͘-siōng sī lâng ê chhiú ēng gûn, ēng kim chù-chō--ê;
in ū chhùi, bōe kóng-ōe; ū ba̍k-chiu, mā bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
In ū hī-khang, bōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ; ū phīⁿ-khang, mā bōe phīⁿ--tio̍h.
In ū chhiú, bōe the̍h; ū kha, bōe kiâⁿ. In mā bô ēng nâ-âu chhut-siaⁿ.
Chō in--ê, óa-khò in--ê, lóng kap in kâng-khoán.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, tio̍h óa-khò Siōng Chú; I sī lí ê pang-chān, lí ê tún-pâi.
A-lûn chè-si ê ke ah, tio̍h óa-khò Siōng Chú; I sī lín ê pang-chān, lín ê tún-pâi.
Lín kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê lâng ah, tio̍h óa-khò Siōng Chú; I sī lín ê pang-chān, lín ê tún-pâi.
Siōng Chú koan-sim lán, beh sù-hok hō͘ lán, beh sù hok-khì hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê ke, beh sù hok-khì hō͘ A-lûn chè-si ê ke.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê lâng, bô-lūn tōa-sòe, I beh sù-hok hō͘ in.
Goān Siōng Chú ke-thiⁿ lín ê jîn-sò͘, ke-thiⁿ lín kap lín ê kiáⁿ-sun.
Goān chhòng-chō thiⁿ tōe ê Siōng Chú sù hok-khì hō͘ lín.
Thiⁿ chí-ū sio̍k Siōng Chú; I chiong tōe sù hō͘ sè-kan-lâng.
Sí-lâng bōe chheng-chàn Siōng Chú; lo̍h-khì éng-oán chēng-be̍k ê só͘-chāi ê lâng mā lóng bōe.
Chóng-sī goán beh chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, tùi hiān-chāi ti̍t-kàu éng-oán. Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Góa thiàⁿ Siōng Chú, in-ūi I thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ, thiaⁿ góa ê khún-kiû.
I àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa, só͘-í góa chi̍t-sì-lâng beh kiû-kiò I.
Sí-bông ê soh khún-pa̍k góa; Im-hú ê thòng-khó͘ khîⁿ-tiâu góa. Góa ū tú-tio̍h hoān-lān iu-khó͘.
Góa kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê miâ, kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā.”
Siōng Chú ū un-hūi, ū kong-gī; goán ê Siōng-tè ū chû-pi.
Siōng Chú pó-hō͘ tan-sûn ê lâng; góa chhiⁿ-chhám-lo̍k-phek ê sî, I ū kiù góa.
Góa ê sim-sîn ah, tio̍h hôe-ho̍k an-lêng, in-ūi Siōng Chú it-ti̍t ū teh un-thāi lí.
Chú ah, lí kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī sí-bông, hō͘ góa ê ba̍k-chiu bô koh lâu ba̍k-sái, hō͘ góa ê kha bô koh poa̍h-tó.
Góa beh tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng, kè-sio̍k tī oa̍h-lâng ê tōe seng-oa̍h.
Góa sui-jiân kóng góa siū ke̍k-tōa ê khùn-khó͘, góa iû-goân sìn-khò Siōng Chú.
Góa bat tio̍h-kip kóng, “Lâng lóng hu-ké, bōe-khò--tit.”
Siōng Chú sù góa it-chhè ê un-hūi, góa tio̍h án-chóaⁿ pò-tap I?
Góa beh phâng kiù-un ê poe, kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê miâ.
Góa beh tī I só͘-ū chú-bîn ê bīn-chêng, tùi Siōng Chú siā góa ê goān.
Siōng Chú khòaⁿ I sèng ê chú-bîn ê sí ke̍k-kî m̄-kam.
Siōng Chú ah, góa si̍t-chāi sī lí ê po̍k-jîn; sī lí ê po̍k-jîn, lí lú-pī ê kiáⁿ; lí í-keng tháu-khui khún-pa̍k góa ê soh.
Góa beh tùi lí hiàn kám-siā ê chè, beh kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê miâ.
Tī I só͘-ū chú-bîn ê bīn-chêng, tī Siōng Chú tiān ê tiâⁿ lāi-bīn, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, góa beh tùi Siōng Chú siā góa ê goān. Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Bān-kok ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Bān-bîn ah, tio̍h o-ló I!
In-ūi I tùi lán si tōa chû-ài; Siōng Chú ê sìn-si̍t éng-oán chûn-sio̍k. Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Tio̍h kám-siā Siōng Chú, in-ūi I chì-siān; I ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán!
Goān Í-sek-lia̍t kóng, “I ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán!”
Goān A-lûn chè-si ê ke kóng, “I ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán!”
Goān só͘-ū kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê lâng kóng, “I ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán!”
Tī gûi-kip ê sî, góa kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, Siōng Chú chiū ìn-tap góa, kái-kiù góa.
Siōng Chú kap góa tông-chāi, góa bōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; lâng ōe-tàng kā góa án-chóaⁿ?
Siōng Chú ūi góa, chòe góa ê pang-chān; góa ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê tùi-te̍k siū pò-èng.
Chhē Siōng Chú chòe pī-lān-só͘ pí óa-khò lâng khah hó!
Chhē Siōng Chú chòe pī-lān-só͘ pí óa-khò thóng-tī-chiá khah hó!
Lia̍t-kok kā góa pau-ûi, góa hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ kā in châu-bia̍t!
In pau-ûi góa, tùi sì-bīn ûi-khùn góa; góa hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ kā in châu-bia̍t!
In chhin-chhiūⁿ phang kā góa pau-ûi, chhin-chhiūⁿ hé sio chhì-phè án-ni sio góa; góa hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ kā in châu-bia̍t!
In chhut-la̍t chhia góa, hō͘ góa hiám poa̍h-tó, m̄-kú Siōng Chú pang-chān góa.
Siōng Chú sī góa ê khùi-la̍t, góa beh chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn; I kā góa kái-kiù.
Tī Siōng Chú chú-bîn ê pò͘-pîⁿ lāi ū khái-soân ê hoan-ho͘, “Siōng Chú ê chiàⁿ-chhiú hián-chhut tōa koân-lêng!
Siōng Chú ê chiàⁿ-chhiú gia̍h-koân-koân; Siōng Chú ê chiàⁿ-chhiú hián-chhut tōa koân-lêng!”
Góa bōe tì-kàu sí, ōe oa̍h--lo̍h-khì, thang kóng-khí Siōng Chú ê chok-ûi.
Siōng Chú giâm-giâm koán-kàu góa, chóng-sī bô hō͘ góa tì-kàu sí.
Kā góa khui kong-gī ê mn̂g, hō͘ góa thang ji̍p-khì kám-siā Siōng Chú.
Chit-ê mn̂g sī Siōng Chú ê mn̂g, chí-ū chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ōe-tàng ji̍p--khì.
Siōng-tè ah, lí ū ìn-tap góa, góa beh kám-siā lí, in-ūi lí hō͘ góa tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.
Khí-chhù sai-hū khì-sak ê chio̍h, í-keng chiâⁿ-chòe siōng tiōng-iàu ê ki-chio̍h.
Che sī Siōng Chú ê chok-ûi; lán khòaⁿ--khí-lâi kám-kak chin kî-biāu.
Che sī Siōng Chú só͘ tēng ê ji̍t-chí; lán tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí, tio̍h khèng-chiok!
Siōng Chú ah, goán kiû lí, kiû lí kái-kiù goán! Siōng Chú ah, goán kiû lí, kiû lí hō͘ goán heng-ōng!
Hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ lâi Hit-ūi eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! Goán tùi Siōng Chú ê tiān chiok-hok lí.
Siōng Chú sī Siōng-tè, I hō͘ lán kng-bêng. Tio̍h gia̍h chhiū-ki chham-ka khèng-tián, iû-hêng lâi kàu chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-kak-thâu hia.
Lí sī góa ê Siōng-tè, góa beh kám-siā lí; lí sī góa ê Siōng-tè, góa beh soan-iông lí ê úi-tāi.
Tio̍h kám-siā Siōng Chú, in-ūi I chì-siān; I ê chû-ài sòa kàu éng-oán.
Hêng-ûi bô thang chí-chek, seng-oa̍h chun-hêng Siōng Chú lu̍t-hoat ê lâng, chit-khoán lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú ê kà-sī, choân-sim chhē-kiû I ê lâng, chit-khoán lâng chin ū hok-khì!
In bô chòe put-gī ê sū, ū chun-hêng I ê tō-lō͘.
Siōng Chú, lí chiong lí ê lu̍t-lē bēng-lēng goán, ài goán khak-si̍t chun-siú.
Goān góa ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe, khak-si̍t ū teh chun-siú lí ê kui-lē.
Góa tiōng-sī lí it-chhè ê kài-bēng, bōe tì-kàu sit-pāi kiàn-siàu.
Góa ha̍k-si̍p lí kong-chèng ê phòaⁿ-toàn; góa beh sêng-sim kám-siā lí.
Góa beh chun-siú lí ê kui-lē; kiû lí choa̍t-tùi m̄-thang pàng-sak góa.
Siàu-liân-lâng tio̍h án-chóaⁿ hō͘ seng-oa̍h sûn-kiat? Tio̍h chun-hêng lí ê ōe!
Siōng Chú ah, góa beh choân-sim chhē-kiû lí; kiû lí hō͘ góa bô phian-lī lí ê kài-bēng.
Góa chiong lí ê ōe khǹg tī sim-lāi, chiah bián hoān-chōe tek-chōe lí.
Siōng Chú ah, lí eng-kai siū chheng-chàn; kiû lí kà góa bat lí ê kui-lē.
Lí só͘ kóng it-chhè ê kui-lē, góa ēng chhùi chhut-siaⁿ liām.
Góa ì-ài lí ê kà-sī, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ì-ài tōa châi-hù.
Góa ná liām ná siūⁿ lí ê lu̍t-lē, tiōng-sī lí ê tō-lō͘.
Góa ì-ài lí ê bēng-lēng, bōe bōe-kì-tit lí ê ōe.
Kiû lí si tōa-un hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn, hō͘ góa oa̍h thang chun-thàn lí ê ōe.
Kiû lí khui góa ê ba̍k-chiu, hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-chhut lí lu̍t-hoat ê kî-biāu.
Góa tī tōe-chiūⁿ sī chhut-gōa-lâng; kiû lí m̄-thang tùi góa khàm-ba̍t lí ê kài-bēng.
Góa put-sî pek-chhiat him-bō͘ lí ê kui-lē, him-bō͘ kàu kiông-beh hūn--khì.
Lí chek-pī kiau-ngō͘ siū chiù-chó͘ ê lâng; in bê-lō͘ lī-khui lí ê kài-bēng.
Lâng tùi góa ê lêng-jio̍k kap khòaⁿ-khin, kiû lí tû--khì, in-ūi góa ū chun-siú lí ê kà-sī.
Thóng-tī-chiá chē-teh chham-siông beh hāi góa, m̄-kú lí ê po̍k-jîn teh be̍k-sióng lí ê bēng-lēng.
Lí ê kà-sī sī góa só͘ ì-ài, sī góa ê tō-su.
Góa siū phah-tó phak tī thô͘-kha; kiû lí chiàu lí ê èng-ún pó-siú góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Góa tùi lí kóng-khí só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì, lí ū ìn góa; kiû lí kà góa bat lí ê kui-lē.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa bêng-pe̍k lí ê lu̍t-lē, góa thang be̍k-sióng lí kî-biāu ê chok-ûi.
Góa ê sim pi-siong kàu beh chhùi--khì; kiû lí chiàu lí ê èng-ún hō͘ góa hôe-ho̍k goân-khì.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa bô kiâⁿ hu-ké ê tō-lō͘; kiû lí si-un kà-sī góa lí ê lu̍t-hoat.
Góa ū kéng chin-si̍t ê lō͘; góa khòaⁿ-tāng lí ê kui-lē.
Góa chhî-siú lí ê kà-sī; Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí m̄-thang hō͘ góa sit-pāi kiàn-siàu.
Góa beh jia̍t-chhiat tui-kiû lí ê kài-bēng, in-ūi lí ū khui góa ê sim-khiàu.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí chiong chun-siú lí bēng-lēng ê tō-lō͘ chí-sī góa, hō͘ góa chai án-chóaⁿ thiat-tóe chun-siú.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa ū tì-hūi chun-siú lí ê lu̍t-hoat, thang choân-sim chun-siú.
Kiû lí chhōa góa kiâⁿ lí kài-bēng ê lō͘; chit-ê lō͘ góa chin ì-ài.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa ê sim kui-ǹg lí ê kà-sī, bô ǹg put-gī ê chîⁿ-châi.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa bōe ì-ài hu-ké, chiàu lí ê ōe sù góa oa̍h-miā.
Kiû lí si̍t-hiān tùi lí po̍k-jîn ê èng-ún, hō͘ lâng thang kèng-ùi lí.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa só͘ kiaⁿ ê lêng-jio̍k lī-khui góa, in-ūi lí ê kui-lē sī hó.
Góa him-bō͘ lí ê lu̍t-lē; kiû lí chiàu lí ê kong-gī sù góa oa̍h-miā.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí hián-sī lí ê chû-ài, chiàu lí ê èng-ún chín-kiù góa,
góa chiū thang ìn-tap lêng-jio̍k góa ê lâng, in-ūi góa óa-khò lí ê ōe.
Kiû lí m̄-thang chiong chin-lí ê ōe tùi góa ê chhùi chhiúⁿ--khì, in-ūi góa gióng-bōng lí ê phòaⁿ-toàn.
Góa beh kè-sio̍k siú lí ê lu̍t-hoat, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
Góa beh chū-iû chū-chāi seng-oa̍h, in-ūi góa ū chhē-kiû lí ê lu̍t-lē.
Góa tī kun-ông ê bīn-chêng káng-lūn lí ê kà-sī, mā bōe tì-kàu kiàn-siàu.
Lí ê kài-bēng hō͘ góa hí-lo̍k, in-ūi chiah-ê kài-bēng sī góa só͘ ì-ài.
Góa chun-tiōng koh ì-ài lí ê kài-bēng; góa mā beh ná liām ná siūⁿ lí ê kui-lē.
Kiû lí ōe-kì-tit tùi lí po̍k-jîn ê èng-ún, in-ūi lí hō͘ góa ū ǹg-bāng.
Tī hoān-lān tiong, góa tit-tio̍h an-ùi; tùi lí ê èng-ún, góa tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā.
Kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng it-ti̍t bú-jio̍k thí-chhiò góa, iáu-kú góa m̄-bat phian-lī lí ê lu̍t-hoat.
Siōng Chú ah, góa ōe-kì-tit lí kó͘-chá í-lâi ê kui-lē, tùi chiah-ê tit-tio̍h an-ùi.
Góa in-ūi hiah-ê khì-sak lí lu̍t-hoat ê pháiⁿ-lâng, khí tōa siū-khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh to̍h.
Góa bô-lūn chhut-gōa khì tó-ūi, lóng ēng lí ê kui-lē chòe si-koa.
Siōng Chú ah, góa mî--sî ōe-kì-tit lí ê tông-chāi, chun-siú lí ê lu̍t-hoat.
Góa tit-tio̍h hok-hūn, in-ūi góa ū sūn-thàn lí ê lu̍t-lē.
Siōng Chú sī góa ê sán-gia̍p; góa bat kóng, “Góa beh chun-thàn lí ê ōe.”
Góa bat choân-sim kiû lí ê un; kiû lí chiàu lí ê èng-ún lîn-bín góa.
Góa chhim-chhim su-siúⁿ lí ê tō-lō͘, oa̍t-tńg-sin kui-ǹg lí ê kà-sī.
Góa kóaⁿ-kín bô iân-chhiân, beh siú lí ê kài-bēng.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê soh khún-pa̍k góa, m̄-kú góa bô bōe-kì-tit lí ê lu̍t-hoat.
Góa in-ūi lí kong-chèng ê phòaⁿ-toàn, pòaⁿ-mî khí-lâi kám-siā lí.
Só͘-ū kèng-ùi lí, chun-siú lí lu̍t-lē ê lâng, góa kap in chòe pêng-iú.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ê chû-ài piàn-móa choân-tōe; kiû lí kà góa bat lí ê kui-lē.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ū chiàu lí ê èng-ún, hó khoán-thāi lí ê po̍k-jîn.
Kiû lí kà-sī góa, hō͘ góa ū tì-sek kap chèng-khak ê phòaⁿ-toàn, in-ūi góa sìn-khò lí ê kài-bēng.
Góa chêng ū kiâⁿ bê-lō͘, siū lí kéng-kài, taⁿ góa chun-siú lí ê ōe.
Lí sī liông-siān, lí ê só͘-chòe lóng sī hó; kiû lí kà góa bat lí ê kui-lē.
Kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng ēng pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe kong-kek góa, m̄-kú góa beh choân-sim chun-siú lí ê lu̍t-lē.
In ê sim chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ iû pau-ba̍t bâ-pì, m̄-kú góa ì-ài lí ê lu̍t-hoat.
Góa siū koán-kàu tùi góa ū lī-ek, hō͘ góa thang ha̍k-si̍p lí ê kui-lē.
Lí só͘ kóng ê lu̍t-hoat tùi góa ū lī-ek, iâⁿ-kè chheng-bān ê kim-gûn.
Lí ê chhiú chhòng-chō góa, lia̍p-chō góa; kiû lí sù góa tì-hūi thang ha̍k-si̍p lí ê kài-bēng.
Kèng-ùi lí ê lâng ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa lâi hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi góa gióng-bōng lí ê ōe.
Siōng Chú ah, góa chai lí ê phòaⁿ-toàn kong-chèng, lí ū chiàu lí ê sìn-si̍t koán-kàu góa.
Kiû lí chiàu lí tùi po̍k-jîn ê èng-ún, ēng lí ê chû-ài an-ùi góa.
Goān lí ê chû-pi lîm-kàu góa, hō͘ góa thang oa̍h, in-ūi lí ê lu̍t-hoat sī góa só͘ ì-ài.
Goān kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng sit-pāi kiàn-siàu, in-ūi in bô lí-iû óng-khut góa, m̄-kú góa beh ná liām ná siūⁿ lí ê lu̍t-lē.
Goān kèng-ùi lí, jīn-bat lí kà-sī ê lâng, tò-tńg-lâi chiap-la̍p góa.
Goān góa choân-sim chun-siú lí ê kui-lē, hō͘ góa bōe tì-kàu sit-pāi kiàn-siàu.
Góa ê sim pek-chhiat him-bō͘ lí ê chín-kiù kàu beh hūn--khì; lí ê ōe hō͘ góa ū ǹg-bāng.
Góa in-ūi ǹg-bāng lí ê èng-ún kàu ba̍k-chiu beh hoe--khì; góa kóng, “Lí sím-mi̍h sî beh an-ùi góa?”
Sui-jiân góa chhin-chhiūⁿ phê-tē hō͘ hé hun kah beh ta--khì, iáu-kú góa bô bōe-kì-tit lí ê bēng-lēng.
Lí ê po̍k-jîn tio̍h koh jím-nāi jōa kú? Lí tī-sî chiah beh sím-phòaⁿ khún-pek góa ê lâng?
Kiau-ngō͘ bô thàn lí lu̍t-hoat ê lâng, ku̍t hām-khiⁿ beh hāi góa.
In bô lí-iû khún-pek góa, m̄-kú lí ê kài-bēng lóng khó-khò; kiû lí pang-chān góa.
Góa hiám-hiám-á hō͘ in tùi tōe-chiūⁿ siau-bia̍t, m̄-kú góa bô pàng-sak lí ê lu̍t-lē.
In-ūi lí ū hong-sēng ê chû-ài, kiû lí pó-siú góa ê sìⁿ-miā; góa beh chun-siú lí ê chhùi só͘ chhut ê kà-sī.
Siōng Chú ah, lí éng-oán chûn-chāi; lí ê ōe khak-li̍p tī thiⁿ-téng.
Lí ê sìn-si̍t sòa kàu bān-tāi; lí kiàn-li̍p tōe, hō͘ i khak-li̍p.
Thiⁿ tōe chiàu lí ê an-pâi, kàu taⁿ iáu chûn-chāi; in lóng sī lí ê chhe-ēng.
Góa nā m̄-sī ì-ài lí ê lu̍t-hoat, chá chiū tī góa ê khó͘-lān tiong bia̍t-bông.
Góa éng-oán bōe bōe-kì-tit lí ê lu̍t-lē, in-ūi lí ēng lí ê lu̍t-lē pó-siú góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Góa sī lí ê, kiû lí kiù góa, in-ūi góa chhē-kiû lí ê lu̍t-lē.
Pháiⁿ-lâng tng-tán beh húi-bia̍t góa, m̄-kú góa beh be̍k-sióng lí ê kà-sī.
Góa khòaⁿ-chhut só͘ ū oân-choân--ê lóng iú-hān, chí-ū lí ê kài-bēng oân-choân, bô kài-hān.
Góa si̍t-chāi chin ì-ài lí ê lu̍t-hoat, kui-ji̍t ná liām ná siūⁿ.
Lí ê kài-bēng put-sî tī góa sin-piⁿ, hō͘ góa pí góa ê tùi-te̍k khah ū tì-hūi.
Góa pí góa lóng-chóng ê sian-siⁿ khah thong-ta̍t, in-ūi góa ná liām ná siūⁿ lí ê kà-sī.
Góa pí lāu-lâng khah ū tì-hūi, in-ūi góa chun-siú lí ê lu̍t-lē.
Góa kìm-chí góa ê kha kiâⁿ it-chhè ê pháiⁿ-lō͘, hō͘ góa thang chun-hêng lí ê ōe.
Góa bô phian-lī lí ê kui-lē, in-ūi lí ū kà-sī góa.
Lí ê ōe tī góa chhùi-lāi, pí bi̍t koh-khah tiⁿ.
Góa tùi lí ê lu̍t-lē tit-tio̍h tì-hūi, só͘-í góa oàn-hūn it-chhè siâ-ok ê lō͘.
Lí ê ōe sī góa kha-chêng ê teng, sī góa lō͘-siōng ê kng.
Lí kong-chèng ê phòaⁿ-toàn, góa koat-ì beh chun-hêng; góa it-tēng beh án-ni chun-siú.
Góa siū-tio̍h ke̍k-tōa ê khó͘-lān; Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí chiàu lí ê èng-ún pó-siú góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí chiap-siū góa ê chhùi hoaⁿ-hí hiàn ê o-ló, koh chiong lí ê kui-lē kà-sī góa.
Góa ê sìⁿ-miā put-sî tú-tio̍h gûi-hiám, iáu-kú góa bô bōe-kì-tit lí ê lu̍t-hoat.
Pháiⁿ-lâng siat lô-bāng beh hāi góa, iáu-kú góa bô phian-lī lí ê lu̍t-lē.
Góa chiong lí ê kà-sī chòe éng-oán ê sán-gia̍p, in-ūi chiah-ê sī góa sim só͘ ì-ài.
Góa choân-sim kui-ǹg lí ê bēng-lēng, éng-oán chun-thàn, ti̍t-kàu sìⁿ-miā kiat-sok.
Tùi lí bô tiong-sim ê lâng, góa iàm-ò͘ⁿ; góa só͘ ì-ài--ê, sī lí ê lu̍t-hoat.
Lí sī góa siám-bih ê só͘-chāi, sī pó-hō͘ góa ê tún-pâi; góa gióng-bōng lí ê èng-ún.
Choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng ah, tio̍h lī-khui góa, hō͘ góa thang chun-siú góa ê Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng.
Kiû lí chiàu lí ê èng-ún hû-chhî góa, pó-siú góa ê sìⁿ-miā, hō͘ góa bô in-ūi gióng-bōng lí sit-pāi kiàn-siàu.
Kiû lí hû-chhî góa, góa chiū tit-kiù; góa beh put-sî choân-sim chun-hêng lí ê bēng-lēng.
Ûi-pōe lí bēng-lēng ê lâng, lí kū-choa̍t in; in ê khúi-chà ōe sit-pāi.
Sè-kan ê pháiⁿ-lâng, lí khòaⁿ-chòe pùn-sò kā in tû--khì, só͘-í góa ì-ài lí ê kà-sī.
Góa in-ūi kiaⁿ-ùi lí, kui seng-khu phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah; lí ê sím-phòaⁿ hō͘ góa kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Góa ū si̍t-hêng kong-gī chèng-ti̍t; kiû lí m̄-thang kā góa pàng hō͘ ap-chè góa ê lâng.
Kiû lí pó-chèng lí ê po̍k-jîn sū-sū heng-thong, bô siū-tio̍h kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng ap-chè.
Góa ǹg-bāng lí ê chín-kiù kap kong-gī ê èng-ún, tì-kàu ba̍k-chiu hoe.
Kiû lí chiàu lí ê chû-ài tùi-thāi lí ê po̍k-jîn, chiong lí ê kui-lē kà-sī góa.
Góa sī lí ê po̍k-jîn, kiû lí sù góa tì-hūi, hō͘ góa bat lí ê kà-sī.
Siōng Chú ah, hiān-chāi sī lí hêng-tōng ê sî, in-ūi lâng phò-hoāi lí ê lu̍t-hoat.
Só͘-í góa ì-ài lí ê kài-bēng, pí kim, pí sûn-kim koh-khah ài.
Lí ūi bān-sū tēng ê lu̍t-lē, góa lóng chun-hêng, só͘-í góa iàm-ò͘ⁿ it-chhè hu-ké ê lō͘.
Lí ê kà-sī kî-biāu, góa chīn-sim chun-siú.
Lí ê ōe chi̍t-ē kóe-seh chiū hoat-chhut kng, liân gōng-ti̍t ê lâng mā ōe liáu-kái.
Góa chhùi tōa khui ti̍t-ti̍t chhoán, khat-bō͘ lí ê kài-bēng.
Kiû lí oa̍t kè-lâi khòaⁿ góa, lîn-bín góa, chhin-chhiūⁿ lí teh tùi-thāi kèng-ài lí miâ ê lâng.
Kiû lí chiàu lí ê èng-ún ín-chhōa góa ê kha-pō͘, bô iông-ún chōe-ok koán-hat góa.
Kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī lâng ê ap-chè, hō͘ góa thang chun-siú lí ê lu̍t-lē.
Goān lí ēng lí ê bīn ê kng chiò lí ê po̍k-jîn, kà góa bat lí ê kui-lē.
Góa ê ba̍k-sái chhin-chhiūⁿ khoe-chúi ti̍t-ti̍t lâu, in-ūi lâng bô chun-siú lí ê lu̍t-hoat.
Siōng Chú, lí sī kong-gī; lí ê phòaⁿ-toàn kong-chèng.
Lí pan-pò͘ ê lu̍t-lē kong-chèng, oân-choân khó-khò.
Góa hui-siông siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ hé beh kā góa thun-bia̍t, in-ūi góa ê tùi-te̍k bōe-kì-tit lí ê ōe.
Lí ê èng-ún sûn-chin khó-khò; lí ê po̍k-jîn chin ì-ài.
Góa pi-bî, hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-khin, m̄-kú góa bô bōe-kì-tit lí ê lu̍t-lē.
Lí ê kong-gī sòa kàu éng-oán; lí ê lu̍t-hoat chin-si̍t.
Góa siū-tio̍h hoān-lān iu-khó͘, iáu-kú ì-ài lí ê kài-bēng.
Lí ê kà-sī éng-oán kong-chèng; kiû lí sù góa tì-hūi, hō͘ góa thang oa̍h.
Siōng Chú ah, góa choân-sim kiû-kiò lí, kiû lí ìn góa; góa beh chun-siú lí ê bēng-lēng.
Góa kiû-kiò lí, kiû lí kiù góa; góa beh chun-siú lí ê kà-sī.
Thiⁿ-bē-kng góa chiū khí-lâi kiû-kiò lí; góa gióng-bōng lí ê ōe.
Góa kui-mî ba̍k-chiu kim-kim, ná liām ná siūⁿ lí ê ōe.
Siōng Chú ah, in-ūi lí ū chû-ài, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ; chiàu lí kong-chèng ê phòaⁿ-toàn, kiû lí pó-siú góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Kè-bô͘ chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng pek-kūn góa; in lī lí ê lu̍t-hoat hn̄g-hn̄g.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú ah, lí óa-kūn góa; lí ê kài-bēng chin-si̍t khó-khò.
Góa chá chiū ha̍k-si̍p lí ê kà-sī; lí hō͘ in khak-li̍p kàu éng-oán.
Kiû lí koan-sim góa ê khó͘-lān lâi kái-kiù góa, in-ūi góa bô bōe-kì-tit lí ê lu̍t-hoat.
Kiû lí kā góa sin-oan, kiù-sio̍k góa, chiàu lí ê èng-ún pó-siú góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Kiù-un lī-khui pháiⁿ-lâng hn̄g-hn̄g, in-ūi in bô chhē-kiû lí ê bēng-lēng.
Siōng Chú, lí ū hong-sēng ê chû-ài; chiàu lí kong-chèng ê phòaⁿ-toàn, kiû lí pó-siú góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Khún-pek góa, tùi-te̍k góa ê lâng chin chōe, iáu-kú góa bô phian-lī lí ê kà-sī.
Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h kan-ok ê lâng chiū chin iàm-ò͘ⁿ, in-ūi in bô chun-siú lí ê ōe.
Lí khòaⁿ góa jōa-á-ni̍h ì-ài lí ê lu̍t-lē; Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí chiàu lí ê chû-ài pó-siú góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Lí ê ōe ê pún-chit sī chin-si̍t; lí it-chhè kong-chèng ê phòaⁿ-toàn éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
Thóng-tī-chiá bô-lí-bô-iû pek-hāi góa; m̄-kú góa ê sim kiaⁿ-ùi lí ê ōe.
Góa ì-ài lí ê ōe, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng tit-tio̍h chin chōe chiàn-lī-phín.
Góa thòng-hūn iàm-ò͘ⁿ pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe, m̄-kú góa ì-ài lí ê lu̍t-hoat.
In-ūi lí kong-chèng ê phòaⁿ-toàn, góa ta̍k-ji̍t chhit piàn chheng-chàn lí.
Ì-ài lí ê lu̍t-hoat ê lâng ū tōa pêng-an, bô chi̍t hāng ōe hō͘ in poa̍h-tó sit-pāi.
Siōng Chú ah, góa ǹg-bāng lí ê chín-kiù, chun-hêng lí ê kài-bēng.
Góa ê sim ū chun-siú lí ê kà-sī; chiah-ê ōe, góa hui-siông ì-ài.
Góa ū siú lí ê lu̍t-lē kap kà-sī; góa ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe, lí lóng khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h.
Siōng Chú ah, goān góa kiû-kiò ê siaⁿ thàu kàu lí ê bīn-chêng; kiû lí chiàu lí ê èng-ún sù góa tì-hūi.
Goān góa khún-kiû ê ōe ta̍t-kàu lí bīn-chêng; kiû lí chiàu lí ê èng-ún khan-kiù góa.
Goān góa ê chhùi-tûn hoat-chhut o-ló, in-ūi lí ū chiong lí ê lu̍t-lē kà-sī góa.
Goān góa ê chi̍h soan-pò͘ lí ê èng-ún, in-ūi lí ê kài-bēng lóng kong-chèng.
Kiû lí chhun-chhiú pang-chān góa, in-ūi góa ū soán-te̍k lí ê lu̍t-lē.
Siōng Chú ah, góa khat-bō͘ lí ê chín-kiù; lí ê lu̍t-hoat sī góa só͘ ì-ài.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa oa̍h--teh, thang chheng-chàn lí, hō͘ lí ê phòaⁿ-toàn pang-chān góa.
Góa bê-lō͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ sit-bê ê iûⁿ; kiû lí kā lí ê po̍k-jîn chhē tò-tńg, in-ūi góa bô bōe-kì-tit lí ê kài-bēng.
Góa tī gûi-kip ê sî kiû-kiò Siōng Chú; I ū ìn góa.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí kiù góa, thang thoat-lī kóng pe̍h-chha̍t kap khúi-chà ê lâng.
Khúi-chà ê lâng ah, Siōng-tè ōe án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lí? I ōe án-chóaⁿ kā lí hêng-hoa̍t?
I ōe ēng ióng-sū chiam ê chìⁿ, ēng iām-jia̍t ê thòaⁿ hêng-hoa̍t lí.
Góa kià-ku tī Bí-siat, tòa tī Ki-ta̍t -lâng ê pò͘-pîⁿ chin chhám!
Góa kap iàm-ò͘ⁿ hô-pêng ê lâng chòe-hé khiā-khí siuⁿ kú.
Góa ài hô-pêng; góa chi̍t-ē kóng chhut-chhùi, in chiū hoah beh chiàn-cheng.
Góa gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ soaⁿ; góa ê pang-chān tùi tó-ūi lâi?
Góa ê pang-chān tùi Siōng Chú lâi; I sī chhòng-chō thiⁿ-tōe ê Chú.
I bōe hō͘ lí poa̍h-tó; lí ê pó-hō͘-chiá bōe tuh-bîn.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê pó-hō͘-chiá bōe tuh-bîn, mā bōe khùn--khì.
Siōng Chú sī lí ê pó-hō͘-chiá; I tī lí sin-piⁿ chòe ìm-ńg teh pó-hō͘ lí.
Ji̍t--sî, ji̍t-thâu bōe siong lí; mî--sî, ge̍h mā bōe hāi lí.
Siōng Chú ōe pó-hō͘ lí thoat-lī ta̍k-khoán chai-lān; I ōe pó-hō͘ lí ê sìⁿ-miā.
Lí chhut lí ji̍p, Siōng Chú ōe pó-hō͘ lí, tùi chit-sî ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
Góa chin hoaⁿ-hí lâng chio góa kóng, “Lán lâi-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān.”
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, goán ê kha í-keng ta̍h-ji̍p lí ê mn̂g-lāi.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kiàn-chō chòe chi̍t ê siâⁿ, choân-siâⁿ chéng-chôe sù-phòe.
Chiah-ê chi-cho̍k, chiū-sī Siōng Chú ê chi-cho̍k, lóng chiàu ūi Í-sek-lia̍t chè-tēng ê kui-lē, chiūⁿ-khì hia chheng-chàn Siōng Chú ê miâ.
In-ūi tī hia ū siat-li̍p sím-phòaⁿ ê pó-chō, chiū-sī Tāi-pi̍t -ke ê pó-chō.
Tio̍h ūi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kiû hô-pêng; goān thiàⁿ lí ê lâng lóng hióng-siū an-lo̍k.
Goān lí ê siâⁿ-lāi ū hô-pêng; goān lí ê kiong-lāi ū an-lo̍k.
Ūi-tio̍h góa ê chhin-lâng pêng-iú, góa beh kóng, “Goān lín pêng-an!”
Ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè ê tiān, góa beh ūi lín kiû hok-khì.
Chē tī thiⁿ-téng pó-chō ê Siōng Chú ah, góa gia̍h-ba̍k ǹg lí.

Khòaⁿ ah, po̍k-jîn ê ba̍k-chiu án-chóaⁿ gióng-bōng chú-lâng ê chhiú, lú-pī ê ba̍k-chiu án-chóaⁿ gióng-bōng lú-chú-lâng ê chhiú, goán ê ba̍k-chiu mā án-ni gióng-bōng Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè, it-ti̍t kàu I lîn-bín goán.
Siōng Chú ah, lîn-bín goán, lîn-bín goán, in-ūi goán hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-khin kàu jím-siū bōe tiâu.
Goán í-keng bô hoat-tō͘ jím-siū chū-boán ê lâng ê léng-chhiò, bô hoat-tō͘ jím-siū chū-ko ê lâng ê biáu-sī.
Í-sek-lia̍t tio̍h kóng, “Nā m̄-sī Siōng Chú ūi lán,
nā m̄-sī Siōng Chú ūi lán, lâng khí-lâi kong-kek lán,
tùi lán hoat siū-khì ê sî, chá chiū kā lán oa̍h-oa̍h thun--lo̍h-khì.
Tōa-chúi chá chiū kā lán chhiong cháu, tōa-éng chá chiū im-ba̍t lán,
hiong-kông ê chúi chá chiū kā lán im-sí.”
Lán tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, in-ūi I bô chiong lán kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k thiah-chia̍h-lo̍h-pak.
Lán ê sìⁿ-miā chhin-chhiūⁿ chiáu-á thoat-lī lia̍h-chiáu ê lâng ê lô-bāng; lô-bāng phòa-li̍h, lán tit-tio̍h tô-thoat.
Lán tit-tio̍h pang-chān sī khò Siōng Chú ê miâ; I sī thiⁿ-tōe ê Chhòng-chō-chú!
Óa-khò Siōng Chú ê lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ Sek-an-soaⁿ éng-oán kian-kò͘ bōe iô-choah.
Chèng-soaⁿ pau-ûi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, Siōng chú mā án-ni pó-hō͘ I ê chú-bîn, tùi chit-sî kàu éng-oán.
Siâ-ok-chiá ê koân-pèng bōe kè-sio̍k koán-hat gī-lâng ê thó͘-tōe, chiah bián gī-lâng siū-pek chòe pháiⁿ.
Hiah-ê chòe hó, sim chèng-ti̍t ê lâng, Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí un-thāi in.
M̄-kú kiâⁿ ǹg oan-khiau ê lō͘ ê lâng, Siōng Chú ōe kā in kap chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng chòe-hé hêng-hoa̍t. Goān hô-pêng kui hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t!
Siōng Chú chhōa lán chiah-ê siū-lia̍h ê lâng tńg-lâi Sek-an ê sî, lán chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chòe bāng.
Hit-sî lán ê chhùi ha-ha-chhiò, tōa-siaⁿ hoan-ho͘. Lia̍t-kok ê lâng kóng, “Siōng Chú ūi-tio̍h in chòe tōa tāi-chì.”
Siōng Chú si̍t-chāi ū ūi lán chòe tōa tāi-chì; lán hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí hō͘ goán chiah-ê siū-lia̍h ê lâng tò-tńg--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâm-hng ta-sò ê tōe ū khoe-chúi koh teh lâu.
Lâu ba̍k-sái iā chéng-chí--ê, ōe chhut hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ siu-koah.
Lâu ba̍k-sái tòa chéng-chí chhut--khì-ê, ōe tòa i ê be̍h-khún hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí tò--lâi.
Chhù-the̍h nā m̄-sī Siōng Chú kiàn-chō, kiàn-chō ê lâng chiū khang-khang lô-khó͘. Siâⁿ nā m̄-sī Siōng Chú kò͘-siú, siú-bōng ê lâng chiū pe̍h-pe̍h kéng-séng.
Lín chá-chá khí--lâi, òaⁿ-òaⁿ chiah khùn, thoa-bôa thàn-chia̍h mā bô-chhái-kang. Siōng Chú só͘ thiàⁿ ê lâng, I hō͘ in hó khùn.
Kiáⁿ-jî sī Siōng Chú só͘ sù ê sán-gia̍p, eⁿ-á sī I ê pò-siúⁿ.
Siàu-liân ê sî siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-jî chhin-chhiūⁿ ióng-sū chhiú-tiong ê chìⁿ.
Chìⁿ-tē pá-pá ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! In tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu kap tùi-te̍k cheng-piān lóng bōe tì-kàu kiàn-siàu.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! Chun-hêng I tō-lō͘ ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Lí ōe-tàng chia̍h siang-chhiú phah-piàⁿ tit--tio̍h ê chia̍h-mi̍h, sū-sū sūn-lī, chin-chiàⁿ hēng-hok!
Lí ê bó͘ tī chhù-lāi chhin-chhiūⁿ gâu kiat ké-chí ê phû-tô-chhiū; lí ê kiáⁿ-jî ûi tī lí ê toh chhin-chhiūⁿ kaⁿ-ná-chai.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê lâng it-tēng chiah-ni̍h hēng-hok!
Goān Siōng Chú tùi Sek-an sù-hok hō͘ lí! Goān lí it-seng ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hoân-êng!
Goān lí ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun! Goān Í-sek-lia̍t kok-thài-bîn-an!
Í-sek-lia̍t tio̍h kóng, “Tùi góa sòe-hàn ê sî, tùi-te̍k siông-siông khó͘-chhó͘ góa.
Tùi góa sòe-hàn ê sî, tùi-te̍k siông-siông khó͘-chhó͘ góa, m̄-kú in m̄-bat iâⁿ góa.
Lôe-chhân ê lâng lôe góa ê ka-chiah-phiaⁿ, lôe--kè ê hûn-jiah chin tn̂g.”
Siōng Chú kong-gī; I ū chām-tn̄g pháiⁿ-lâng pa̍k lán ê soh.
Goān só͘-ū oàn-hūn Sek-an ê lâng lóng siū phah-pāi kiàn-siàu.
Goān in chhin-chhiūⁿ chhù-téng ê chháu, iáu-bē tōa-châng chiū ta--khì,
koah--ê koah bô kui-pé, hâ--ê hâ bô kui-lám.
Kè-lō͘ ê lâng bô lâng ōe kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú sù lín hok-khì! Goán hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ kā lín chiok-hok.”
Siōng Chú ah, góa tùi chhim-ian kiû-kiò lí.
Chú ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ! Kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa ê khún-kiû!
Siōng Chú ah, lí nā ōe-kì-tit lâng ê chōe-kò, Chú ah, sím-mi̍h-lâng khiā ōe tiâu?
Chóng-sī lí ōe sià-bián lâng, hō͘ lâng thang kèng-ùi lí.
Góa pek-chhiat thèng-hāu Siōng Chú; góa gióng-bōng lí ê ōe.
Góa ê sim-sîn thèng-hāu Chú, pí siú-bōng ê lâng thèng-hāu thiⁿ-kng koh-khah pek-chhiat, pí siú-bōng ê lâng thèng-hāu thiⁿ-kng koh-khah pek-chhiat.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, tio̍h gióng-bōng Siōng Chú! In-ūi Siōng Chú ū put-piàn ê chû-ài; I ū kiù-sio̍k ê tōa koân-lêng.
Chí-ū I ōe kiù-sio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t thoat-lī in it-chhè ê chōe-kò!
Siōng Chú ah, góa ê sim bô kiau-ngō͘, ba̍k-thâu bô koân; tāi-chì siuⁿ tōa, chhiau-kè góa ê lêng-le̍k, góa m̄-káⁿ chòe.
Góa ê sim an-ún pêng-chēng, chhin-chhiūⁿ tn̄g-lin ê eⁿ-á óa tī lāu-bú ê heng-chêng; góa ê sim chhin-chhiūⁿ tn̄g-lin ê eⁿ-á an-ún pêng-chēng.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, tio̍h gióng-bōng Siōng Chú, tùi chit-sî sòa kàu éng-oán.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí ōe-kì-tit Tāi-pi̍t só͘ siū it-chhè ê khó͘-lān,
ōe-kì-tit i án-chóaⁿ tùi Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, tùi Ngá-kok ê Tāi-lêng-chiá hē-goān,
“Góa it-tēng bōe ji̍p-khì góa ê chhù, mā bōe chiūⁿ góa ê bîn-chhn̂g;
góa bōe hō͘ góa ê ba̍k-chiu khùn--khì, mā bōe iông-ún góa ê ba̍k-chiu-phê ha̍p-óa;
thèng-hāu góa ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú chhē-tio̍h só͘-chāi, ūi Ngá-kok ê Tāi-lêng-chiá chhē-tio̍h khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.”
Goán thiaⁿ-kìⁿ iok-kūi tī Í-hoat-tha, tī Ngá-ní ê chhân chhē--tio̍h.
Goán beh ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi; goán beh tī I ê kha-tiam thâu-chêng kūi-pài.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí khí--lâi; lí kap lí ū khùi-la̍t ê iok-kūi chòe-hé ji̍p-khì lí hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi.
Goān lí ê chè-si ēng kong-gī chòe saⁿ chhēng; goān lí sèng ê chú-bîn chhut hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ.
Kiû lí in-ūi lí ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê iân-kò͘, m̄-thang khì-sak lí boah-iû kéng-soán ê kun-ông.
Siōng Chú ēng sìn-si̍t tùi Tāi-pi̍t li̍p-sè, it-tēng bōe kái-piàn, kóng, “Góa beh hō͘ lí chi̍t ê kiáⁿ chē lí ê pó-chō.
Lí ê kiáⁿ-sun nā chun-siú góa ê iok, kap góa beh hō͘ in ê kà-sī, in ê kiáⁿ-sun mā ōe éng-oán chē lí ê pó-chō.”
Siōng Chú ū kéng Sek-an, chòe I pún-sin khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, kóng,
“Che sī góa éng-oán hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi; góa beh tiàm chia, in-ūi sī góa só͘ ì-ài.
Góa beh hō͘ Sek-an bí-niû hong-sēng, ēng chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ i ê sàn-chhiah-lâng kàu-gia̍h thang chia̍h.
Góa beh hō͘ i ê chè-si ēng kiù-un chòe saⁿ chhēng; I sèng ê chú-bîn ōe chhut tōa hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ.
Góa beh hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-koân khok-tián chòng-tāi, ūi-tio̍h góa boah-iû kéng-soán ê kun-ông chún-pī kng-teng.
Góa beh hō͘ i ê tùi-te̍k ēng kiàn-siàu chòe saⁿ chhēng; chóng-sī ông tì ê ông-koan ōe hoat-chhut kong-chhái.”
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē chòe-hé khiā-khí, jōa-á-ni̍h hó, jōa-á-ni̍h hoaⁿ-hí!
Che thang pí-phēng kùi-khì ê iû thîn tī thâu-khak téng, lâu kàu chhùi-chhiu — A-lûn ê chhùi-chhiu; koh lâu kàu i ê ām-niá.
Che mā thang pí-phēng Hek-bûn-soaⁿ ê lō͘-chúi, lo̍h kàu Sek-an ê soaⁿ-niá; tī hia Siōng Chú ū èng-ún beh sù-hok, sù éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Lín chiah-ê mî--sî tī Siōng Chú ê tiān teh sū-hōng ê po̍k-jîn ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Lín tio̍h ǹg sèng-só͘ gia̍h-khí lín ê chhiú, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Goān chhòng-chō thiⁿ tōe ê Siōng Chú, tùi Sek-an sù hok-khì hō͘ lín.

Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú ê miâ! Lín chiah-ê tī Siōng Chú ê tiān teh sū-hōng, tī lán Siōng-tè sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ teh sū-hōng ê po̍k-jîn ah, lín lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn I.
Tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, in-ūi Siōng Chú chì-siān; tio̍h chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló I ê miâ, in-ūi I jîn-chû.
In-ūi Siōng Chú kéng-soán Ngá-kok kui-sio̍k I ka-kī, kéng Í-sek-lia̍t chòe I ê sán-gia̍p.
Góa chai Siōng Chú úi-tāi; lán ê Chú chhiau-oa̍t lóng-chóng ê sîn-bêng.
Siōng Chú tī thiⁿ-téng kap tōe-chiūⁿ, tī hái-tiong kap só͘-ū ê chhim-ian, lóng chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù chòe tāi-chì.
I hō͘ hûn-bū tùi thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak chhèng--chhut-lâi, hō͘ sih-nà tòa hō͘ chhut-hiān, hō͘ hong tùi I ê chhng-khò͘ chhe--chhut-lâi.
I chiong thâu-chiūⁿ-siⁿ ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng kap cheng-siⁿ lóng phah-sí.
Ai-ki̍p ah, I tī lín ê tiong-kan kiâⁿ sîn-jiah kî-sū, tùi-hù Hoat-ló kap i ê jîn-sîn.
I phah-pāi chin chōe pang-kok, phah-pāi kiông-béng ê kok-ông,
chiū-sī A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông kap Pa-san -ông Go̍k, koh cheng-ho̍k Ka-lâm só͘-ū ê ông-kok.
I chiong in ê thó͘-tōe hō͘ I ka-kī ê chú-bîn, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t chòe sán-gia̍p.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ê miâ lâu kàu éng-oán; Siōng Chú ah, bān sè-tāi ê lâng lóng ōe kì-liām lí,
in-ūi Siōng Chú beh ūi-tio̍h I ê chú-bîn sin-oan, beh lîn-bín I ê po̍k-jîn.
Gōa-pang ê ngó͘-siōng sī lâng ê chhiú ēng gûn, ēng kim só͘ chù-chō;
in ū chhùi, bōe kóng-ōe; ū ba̍k-chiu, mā bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ;
ū hī-khang, bōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ; ū chhùi, mā bô khùi.
Chō in--ê, óa-khò in--ê, lóng kap in kâng-khoán.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ke ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú. A-lûn chè-si ê ke ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú.
Lī-bī ê ke ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú; kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê lâng ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú khiā-khí tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; goān I tùi Sek-an siū chheng-chàn. Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Tio̍h kám-siā Siōng Chú, in-ūi I chì-siān; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
Tio̍h kám-siā bān-sîn ê Sîn; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
Tio̍h kám-siā bān-chú ê Chú; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
Chí-ū I chòe kî-biāu tōa-sū; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I ēng tì-hūi chhòng-chō thiⁿ; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I kā tōe pho͘ tī chúi ê téng-bīn; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I chhòng-chō tōa ê kng-thé; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I ēng ji̍t-thâu koán-lí ji̍t--sî; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I ēng ge̍h kap chhiⁿ koán-lí mî--sî; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I phah-sí Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê tōa-kiáⁿ; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi in tiong-kan chhut--lâi; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I chhun-chhut tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I kā Âng-hái pun-khui; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t tùi hit tiong-kan kè--khì; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I chiong Hoat-ló kap i ê kun-peng hiat-lo̍h Âng-hái; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I chhōa I ê chú-bîn keng-kè khòng-iá; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I phah-sí hiah-ê tōa kun-ông; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I thâi-sí kiông koh ióng ê ông; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I thâi-sí A-mô͘-lī -ông Se-hông; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I thâi-sí Pa-san -ông Go̍k; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I chiong in ê thó͘-tōe sù hō͘ I ê chú-bîn chòe sán-gia̍p; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I sù sán-gia̍p hō͘ I ê po̍k-jîn Í-sek-lia̍t; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I tī lán siū khut-jio̍k ê sî bô bōe-kì-tit lán; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I kái-kiù lán thoat-lī tùi-te̍k; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
I sù chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ só͘-ū ê oa̍h-mi̍h; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
Tio̍h kám-siā thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè; I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
Goán chē tī Pa-pí-lûn ê hô-piⁿ, chi̍t-ē siūⁿ-tio̍h Sek-an, ba̍k-sái chiū lâu.
Goán chiong khîm tiàu tī hia ê liú-chhiū.
Tī hia, lia̍h goán ê lâng kiò goán chhiùⁿ-koa; khó͘-chhó͘ goán ê lâng ài goán hō͘ in khoài-lo̍k, kóng, “Kā goán chhiùⁿ chi̍t tiâu Sek-an ê koa.”
Goán tī īⁿ-pang ná chhiùⁿ ōe chhut kèng-pài Siōng Chú ê si-koa?
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, góa nā bōe-kì-tit lí, tio̍h hō͘ góa ê chiàⁿ-chhiú khê--khì, bōe tôaⁿ-khîm.
Góa nā bōe-kì-tit lí, nā bô khòaⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe góa ê tē-it hoaⁿ-hí, tio̍h hō͘ góa ê chi̍h liâm tī téng-kiuⁿ bōe chhiùⁿ-koa.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lûn-hām ê ji̍t, Í-tong -lâng kóng, “Kā i thiah-húi! Kā i thiah-húi! Kā i thiah kàu tōe-ki!” Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí ōe-kì-tit hit-ji̍t.
Pa-pí-lûn -siâⁿ ah, lí eng-kai siū húi-bia̍t! Lí án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi goán, hiah-ê chiàu án-ni tùi-thāi lí ê lâng ū hok-khì.
Lia̍h lí ê eⁿ-á siak tī chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng hit-khoán lâng ū hok-khì.
Góa beh choân-sim kám-siā lí, tī chèng sîn-bêng bīn-chêng chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí.
Góa beh ǹg lí ê sèng-tiān kūi-pài, beh in-ūi lí ê chû-ài kap sìn-si̍t chheng-chàn lí ê miâ; in-ūi lí hō͘ lí ê miâ kap lí ê ōe chhiau-oa̍t it-chhè.
Góa kiû-kiò ê sî lí ū ìn góa; lí ū kó͘-lē góa, hō͘ góa tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t.
Siōng Chú ah, sè-chiūⁿ ê kun-ông lóng ōe kám-siā lí, in-ūi in ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ lí só͘ kóng ê ōe.
In ōe chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn Siōng Chú ê chok-ûi, in-ūi Siōng Chú ū tōa êng-kng.
Siōng Chú sui-jiân chun-kùi, iáu-kú khòaⁿ-kò͘ pi-chiān ê lâng; I tùi hn̄g-hn̄g chiū jīn-chhut kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng.
Góa sui-jiân hō͘ hoān-lān ûi-khùn, lí ōe pó-siú góa ê sìⁿ-miā; góa ê tùi-te̍k siū-khì, lí ōe chhun-chhiú tùi-hù, ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú kái-kiù góa.
Siōng Chú ōe si̍t-hiān tùi góa ê èng-ún. Siōng Chú ah, lí ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k. Lí chhin-chhiú só͘ chòe--ê, kiû lí m̄-thang hòng-khì.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ū kàm-chhat góa, bat góa.
Góa ê it-kú-it-tōng lí lóng chai; tùi chin hn̄g lí mā khòaⁿ ōe chhut góa ê sim-su.
Góa kiâⁿ-lō͘, góa hioh-khùn, lí lóng teh khòaⁿ; góa ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe, lí mā lóng chai.
Siōng Chú ah, góa iáu-bē khui-chhùi, lí í-keng chai góa beh kóng sím-mi̍h.
Lí tī góa ê chêng-āu chiàu-kò͘ góa; lí chhin-chhiú pó-hō͘ góa.
Lí ê chai-bat hiah-ni̍h kî-biāu, hiah-ni̍h ko-chhim, chhiau-kè góa ê liáu-kái.
Khì tó-ūi, góa chiah ōe-tàng tô-pī lí? Cháu kàu tó-ūi, góa chiah ōe-tàng tô-siám lí?
Góa nā peh-chiūⁿ thiⁿ, lí tī hia; Góa nā lo̍h Im-hú, lí mā tī hia.
Góa nā thí-si̍t pe-khì ji̍t chhut hit-pêng, á-sī hioh tī ji̍t lo̍h chit-pêng,
chiū nā tī hia, lí ê chhiú mā ōe ín-chhōa góa, lí ê chiàⁿ-chhiú mā ōe hû-chhî góa.
Góa nā kiû o͘-àm kā góa khàm--khí-lâi, kiò àm-mî kā góa jia-cha̍h,
tùi lí lâi kóng, o͘-àm bô sǹg sī àm, àm-sî chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t--sî hiah-ni̍h kng; tùi lí lâi kóng, o͘-àm kap kng-bêng lóng kâng-khoán.
Lí chō góa ê chōng-hú; góa tī lāu-bú ê pak-tó͘ lāi, lí kā góa sok-chō.
Góa kám-siā lí, in-ūi góa ê siū-chō kî-biāu thang kiaⁿ-ùi. Lí ê chok-ûi kî-biāu; góa ê it-chhè lí oân-choân chai.
Góa tī lâng khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h ê só͘-chāi siū-chō, tī lāu-bú ê pak-tó͘ lāi, lí kā góa sok-chō; góa hêng-sêng ê kè-thêng lí lóng chheng-chhó.
Góa bē chiâⁿ-hêng ê seng-khu, lí í-keng khòaⁿ--tio̍h. Lí ūi-tio̍h góa an-pâi ê ji̍t-chí, lóng í-keng kì tī lí ê chheh.
Siōng-tè ah, lí ê ì-liām si̍t-chāi chin oh liáu-kái! Lí ê sim-su si̍t-chāi bōe-sǹg--tit!
Góa nā beh sǹg, pí hái-soa khah chōe; nā sǹg ōe liáu, mā bōe-tàng thàu-thiat lí ê ò-biāu.
Siōng-tè ah, góa jōa-á-ni̍h ài lí siau-bia̍t pháiⁿ-lâng; góa jōa-á-ni̍h ǹg-bāng kiông-pō ê lâng lī-khui góa.
In kóng pháiⁿ-ōe siat-to̍k lí; lí ê tùi-te̍k ēng siâ-ok ê ōe bú-jio̍k lí.
Siōng Chú ah, oàn-hūn lí ê lâng góa kiám bô oàn-hūn in? Khí-lâi hoán-poān lí ê lâng góa kiám bô iàm-ò͘ⁿ in?
Góa chhim-chhim oàn-hūn in, khòaⁿ in chòe góa ê tùi-te̍k.
Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kàm-chhat góa, chai góa ê sim-su, khó-giām góa, chai góa ê ì-liām.
Kiû lí chí-tiám góa, hō͘ góa bô pháiⁿ hêng-ûi, chhōa góa kiâⁿ éng-oán ê tō-lō͘.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī pháiⁿ-lâng, pó-hō͘ góa thoat-lī hiong-ok ê lâng.
In sim-lāi tô͘-bô͘ siâ-ok, put-sî chè-chō hun-cheng.
In ê chi̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ to̍k-chôa ê chi̍h hiah-ni̍h lāi; in ê chhùi-tûn ū to̍k-chôa ê to̍k.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí pó-siú góa thoat-lī pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhiú, pó-hō͘ góa thoat-lī kiông-pō ê lâng; in tô͘-bô͘ beh kā góa chhia-tó.
Kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng àm-tiong ku̍t hām-chíⁿ, tiuⁿ lô-bāng, tī lō͘-piⁿ siat khoân-thò beh hāi góa.
Góa tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí sī góa ê Siōng-tè.” Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa khún-kiû ê siaⁿ.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú — góa tōa khùi-la̍t ê Chín-kiù-chiá ah, tī kau-chiàn ê sî, lí ū pó-hō͘ góa.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí m̄-thang hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng ê sim-goān si̍t-hiān, m̄-thang hō͘ in ê kè-bô͘ sêng-kong, tì-kàu chū-ko.
M̄-thang hō͘ ûi-khùn góa ê lâng sèng-lī; tio̍h hō͘ in chhùi-tûn ê to̍k-hāi hāi-tio̍h in ka-kī.
Kiû lí ēng teh to̍h ê hé-thòaⁿ kàng-lo̍h tī in sin-chiūⁿ; kā in hiat-lo̍h hé, tàn tī Chhim-khiⁿ, bōe koh khí--lâi.
Kiû lí hō͘ chè-chō sī-hui ê lâng tī tōe-chiūⁿ khiā bōe tiâu, tio̍h hō͘ chai-hō kā kiông-pō ê lâng tè-tiâu-tiâu, lóng kā in phah-tó.
Góa chai Siōng Chú ōe ūi-tio̍h khùn-khó͘ ê lâng sin-oan, ūi-tio̍h sàn-chhiah-lâng chú-chhî kong-tō.
Gī-lâng it-tēng ōe kám-siā lí; chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ōe-tàng tī lí bīn-chêng khiā-khí.
Siōng Chú ah, góa kiû-kiò lí; kiû lí kín lâi pang-chān góa! Góa kiû-kiò lí ê sî, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ.
Goān góa ê kî-tó chhin-chhiūⁿ hiuⁿ chhèng kàu lí bīn-chêng; goān góa gia̍h-khí ê siang-chhiú, chhin-chhiūⁿ ē-hng-sî ê chè-sū siū lí chiap-la̍p.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí iok-sok góa ê chhùi, khàn-siú góa chhùi ê mn̂g.
Kiû lí m̄-thang hō͘ góa ê sim phian-ǹg siâ-ok, kap chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng tàu-tīn chòe pháiⁿ; m̄-thang hō͘ góa kap in kâng-toh lim-chia̍h.

Lêng-khó hō͘ gī-lâng ēng jîn-chû phah góa, chí-chèng góa, mā m̄ hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng tī góa thâu-khak boah-iû hoan-gêng góa. Sui-jiân pháiⁿ-lâng chòe pháiⁿ, iáu-kú góa beh kè-sio̍k kî-tó.
In ê chip-chèng-chiá siū hiat-lo̍h soaⁿ-khàm, in chiū ōe chai góa ê ōe sī chin-si̍t.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ thô͘ hō͘ lôe lôe-sòaⁿ, in ê kut-thâu ōe sòaⁿ kah kui bōng-kháu.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, góa chù-ba̍k khòaⁿ lí; kiû lí pó-hō͘ góa bián tì-kàu sí-bông.
Kiû lí pó-hō͘ góa bián hām-lo̍h in kā góa siat ê lô-bāng, í-ki̍p chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng ê khoân-thò.
Kiû lí hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng hām-lo̍h ka-kī ê lô-bāng, hō͘ góa an-choân thoat-lī.
Góa tōa-siaⁿ kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, chhut tōa-siaⁿ khún-kiû Siōng Chú.
Góa tī I bīn-chêng thò͘-lō͘ góa ê khó͘-chêng, tī I bīn-chêng kóng-chhut góa ê hoān-lān.
Góa ê sim-sîn sit-chì, kiông-beh hūn--khì, lí chai góa ê lō͘; tī góa kiâⁿ ê lō͘, in àm-tiong kā góa siat lô-bāng.
Kiû lí khòaⁿ góa ê chiàⁿ-pêng, tī hia bô lâng ūi góa; góa bô só͘-chāi thang bih, mā bô lâng koan-sim góa.
Siōng Chú ah, góa tùi lí ai-kiû, kóng, “Lí sī góa ê pī-lān-só͘; góa iáu oa̍h--teh ê ji̍t, lí sī góa ê it-chhè.”
Kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa ê kiû-kiò, in-ūi góa hām-lo̍h kàu siōng pi-chhám ê tōe-pō͘; kiû lí kiù góa thoat-lī khún-pek góa ê lâng, in-ūi in pí góa khah kiông.
Kiû lí kiù góa thoat-chhut kaⁿ-lô, hō͘ góa thang chheng-chàn lí ê miâ. Gī-lâng ōe ûi-lûi tī góa sin-piⁿ, in-ūi lí ēng un-tián tùi-thāi góa.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó, àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa ê khún-kiû, chiàu lí ê sìn-si̍t, chiàu lí ê kong-gī ìn-tap góa.
Kiû lí m̄-thang sím-mn̄g lí ê po̍k-jîn, in-ūi tī lí bīn-chêng, oa̍h--teh ê lâng bô chi̍t ê sī gī-lâng.
Tùi-te̍k khún-pek góa, chiong góa thiat-tóe phah-tó tī thô͘-kha, hō͘ góa tiàm tī o͘-àm ê só͘-chāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ sí chin kú ê lâng,
tì-kàu góa ê sim-sîn sit-chì, kiông-beh hūn--khì; góa ê sim kiaⁿ kah gāng--khì.
Góa ōe-kì-tit kó͘-chá ê ji̍t, siàu-liām lí it-chhè ê chok-ûi, chēng-chēng siūⁿ lí chhiú ê só͘-chòe.
Góa ǹg lí gia̍h-chhiú; góa ê sim khat-bō͘ lí chhin-chhiūⁿ khòng-hān ê tōe thèng-hāu hō͘-chúi.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí kóaⁿ-kín ìn-tap góa; góa ê sim-sîn thèng-hāu lí kàu beh hūn--khì. M̄-thang bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ chhap góa, chiah bián góa chhin-chhiūⁿ sí--khì ê lâng.
Kiû lí hō͘ góa chá-khí-sî thiaⁿ-kìⁿ lí chû-ài ê siaⁿ, in-ūi góa óa-khò lí. Kiû lí hō͘ góa chai eng-kai kiâⁿ ê lō͘, in-ūi góa ê sim gióng-bōng lí.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí kái-kiù góa thoat-lī góa ê tùi-te̍k, hō͘ góa thang cháu-khì bih tī lí hia.
Lí sī góa ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí kà-sī góa chun-hêng lí ê chí-ì. Goān lí liông-siān ê sîn ín-chhōa góa kiâⁿ pîⁿ-tháⁿ ê lō͘.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí in-ūi lí ê miâ hō͘ góa koh oa̍h--khí-lâi, chiàu lí ê kong-gī ín-chhōa góa thoat-chhut hoān-lān.
Kiû lí chiàu lí ê chû-ài siau-bia̍t góa ê tùi-te̍k, châu-bia̍t só͘-ū khó͘-chhó͘ góa ê lâng, in-ūi góa sī lí ê po̍k-jîn.
Siōng Chú góa só͘ óa-khò ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ, eng-kai tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn; I hùn-liān góa ê chhiú gâu cheng-chiàn, kà góa ê chńg-thâu-á ū ki-khiáu gâu sio-thâi.
I sī éng-oán thiàⁿ góa ê Siōng-tè, góa ê iàu-sài, sī góa ê pó-lúi, góa ê Chín-kiù-chiá, sī góa óa-khò ê tún-pâi. I hō͘ lia̍t-pang hâng-ho̍k tī góa ē-bīn.
Siōng Chú ah, lâng sǹg sím-mi̍h, lí iáu hiah-ni̍h koan-sim! Thô͘ chòe ê lâng sǹg sím-mi̍h, lí iáu hiah-ni̍h chiàu-kò͘!
Lâng ê sìⁿ-miā chhin-chhiūⁿ chhoán chi̍t ê khùi; i ê ji̍t-chí chhin-chhiūⁿ iáⁿ chin kín chiū siau-sit.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí thí-khui thiⁿ, chhin-sin kàng-lîm, bong soaⁿ, hō͘ soaⁿ chhèng-ian.
Kiû lí hoat-chhut sih-nà kā tùi-te̍k kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ; kiû lí siā-chìⁿ, hō͘ in sì-sòaⁿ.
Kiû lí tùi téng-bīn chhun-chhiú kiù góa, kiù góa thoat-lī tōa-chúi, kái-kiù góa thoat-lī gōa-pang-lâng ê chhiú.
In ê chhùi kóng pe̍h-chha̍t; in gia̍h chiàⁿ-chhiú choh gūi-chèng.
Siōng-tè ah, góa beh tùi lí chhiùⁿ sin ê koa, ēng cha̍p tiâu hiân ê sek chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn lí.
Lí hō͘ kun-ông tek-sèng, kiù lí ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t thoat-lī thâi-lâng ê to.
Kiû lí kái-kiù góa thoat-lī gōa-pang-lâng ê chhiú. In ê chhùi kóng pe̍h-chha̍t; in gia̍h chiàⁿ-chhiú choh gūi-chèng.
Goān goán ê ta-po͘-kiáⁿ siàu-liân ióng-chòng, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū-á bō͘-sēng; goán ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chin súi, chhin-chhiūⁿ ông-kiong tiau-khek ê chio̍h-thiāu.
Goān goán ê chhek-chhng móa-móa, ū tún ta̍k-chióng ê bí-niû, goán ê iûⁿ tī soaⁿ-iá siⁿ-thòaⁿ, chiâⁿ-chheng chiâⁿ-bān.
Goān goán ê gû pûi koh gâu siⁿ. Siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ bô siū lòng-phòa, bô lâng siū-lia̍h khì īⁿ-pang, koe-chhī bô ai-khàu ê siaⁿ.
Hióng-siū chit-khoán kéng-hóng ê chú-bîn chin ū hok-khì! Jīn Siōng Chú chòe in ê Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn chin ū hok-khì!
Góa ê Siōng-tè góa ê Ông ah, góa beh chun lí chòe chì-koân; góa beh éng-éng-oán-oán chheng-chàn lí ê miâ.
Góa beh ji̍t-ji̍t chheng-chàn lí, beh éng-oán o-ló lí ê miâ.
Siōng Chú chì-tōa, eng-kai siū tōa chheng-chàn; I ê úi-tāi bô hoat-tō͘ chhek-to̍k.
Chit-tāi beh tùi hit-tāi chheng-chàn lí ê chok-ûi, beh pò-iông lí tōa koân-lêng ê só͘-chòe.
Lâng beh kóng-khí lí chun-kùi êng-kng ê ui-giâm; góa beh siàu-liām lí kî-biāu ê chok-ûi.
Lâng beh kóng-khí lí thang kiaⁿ-ùi ê tōa koân-lêng; góa beh pò-iông lí úi-tāi ê chok-ûi.
In beh pò-iông lí ke̍k-tōa ê un-hūi, beh chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló lí ê kong-gī.
Siōng Chú ū un-hūi, ū lîn-bín, bô khoài siū-khì, ū tōa chû-ài.
Siōng Chú thiàⁿ-sioh bān-iú; I ê lîn-bín phó͘-ki̍p I só͘ chō ê it-chhè.
Siōng Chú ah, lí só͘ chō ê it-chhè beh kám-siā lí; lí sèng ê chú-bîn mā beh chheng-chàn lí.
In beh kóng-khí lí kok-tō͘ ê êng-kng, tâm-lūn lí ê tōa koân-lêng,
thang hō͘ sè-kan-lâng chai lí tōa koân-lêng ê chok-ûi, chai lí kok-tō͘ ê ui-giâm kap êng-kng.
Lí ê kok-tō͘ éng-oán chûn-chāi; lí chip-chiáng ê koân-pèng sòa kàu bān-tāi. Siōng Chú it-chhè ê èng-ún sìn-si̍t khó-khò; I thiàⁿ-sioh I só͘ chō ê it-chhè.
Poa̍h-tó sit-pāi ê lâng, Siōng Chú hû-chhî in; siū ap-chè ê lâng, I hû in khí--lâi.
Só͘-ū ê oa̍h-mi̍h lóng gióng-bōng lí; lí chiàu-sî hō͘ in chia̍h-mi̍h.
Lí thí-khui chhiú, hō͘ só͘-ū ê oa̍h-mi̍h lóng chiàu só͘ ài tit-tio̍h pá-chiok.
Siōng Chú it-chhè ê só͘-chòe lóng kong-chèng; I ê chok-ûi chhiong-móa jîn-chû.
Só͘-ū kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê lâng, I kap in chhin-kūn; I chhin-kūn sêng-si̍t kiû-kiò I ê lâng.
Kèng-ùi I ê lâng, I ōe hō͘ in ê sim-goān si̍t-hiān, koh ōe thiaⁿ in ê kiû-kiò, lâi chín-kiù in.
Siōng Chú pó-hō͘ só͘-ū thiàⁿ I ê lâng; m̄-kú chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng, I ōe kā in siau-bia̍t.
Góa ê chhùi beh kóng-chhut chheng-chàn Siōng Chú ê ōe; goān it-chhè ū sìⁿ-miā--ê, lóng éng-éng-oán-oán chheng-chàn I ê sèng-miâ.
Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Góa ê sim-sîn ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Góa it-seng beh chheng-chàn Siōng Chú; góa oa̍h ê ji̍t lóng beh chhiùⁿ-koa chheng-chàn góa ê Siōng-tè.
M̄-thang óa-khò kun-ông; m̄-thang óa-khò ōe-sí ê lâng, in bōe-tàng pang-chān.
In chi̍t-ē tn̄g-khùi chiū kui-thó͘; in ê kè-ōe tī hit-ji̍t chiū lo̍k-khong.
Khò Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè pang-chān ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè sī in ê ǹg-bāng.
I chhòng-chō thiⁿ, tōe, hái, mā chhòng-chō kî-tiong bān-mi̍h. I éng-oán sìn-si̍t.
I ūi-tio̍h siū óng-khut ê lâng sin-oan; I sù chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ iau-gō ê lâng. Siōng Chú tháu-pàng siū koaiⁿ-kaⁿ ê lâng;
Siōng Chú hō͘ bông-jîn ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. Siōng Chú hû-khí siū ap-chè ê lâng; Siōng Chú thiàⁿ-sioh gī-lâng.
Siōng Chú pó-hō͘ chhut-gōa-lâng, hû-chhî ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū. I hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng ê lō͘ kiâⁿ bōe thong.
Siōng Chú ōe éng-oán choh-ông; Sek-an ah, lí ê Siōng-tè beh choh-ông, ti̍t-kàu bān-tāi! Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló lán ê Siōng-tè, chin hó; chheng-chàn I sī ha̍p-gî, chin thang hoaⁿ-hí.
Siōng Chú tiông-kiàn Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chū-chi̍p Í-sek-lia̍t tiong siū-lia̍h khì īⁿ-pang ê lâng.
I i-hó siong-sim ê lâng, pau-chat in ê siong.
I sǹg chhiⁿ-sîn ê sò͘-bo̍k, chi̍t-lia̍p chi̍t-lia̍p kā in hō-miâ.
Lán ê Chú chì-tōa, ū tōa khùi-la̍t; I ê tì-hūi bû-kiông-chīn.
Siōng Chú hû-chhî pi-bî ê lâng, kā pháiⁿ-lâng phah-tó tī thô͘-kha.
Lín tio̍h ēng kám-siā ǹg Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ-koa, tôaⁿ-khîm chhiùⁿ-koa, o-ló lán ê Siōng-tè.
I khí-hûn jia-thiⁿ, ūi-tio̍h tōe chún-pī hō͘-chúi, hō͘ soaⁿ hoat-chháu.
I sù chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ cháu-siù, hō͘ teh thó-chia̍h ê sòe-chiah o͘-a.
I ì-ài--ê m̄-sī bé ê la̍t tōa; I hoaⁿ-hí--ê m̄-sī lâng ê kha gâu-cháu.
Siōng Chú ì-ài--ê sī kèng-ùi I, gióng-bōng I chû-ài ê lâng.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú; Sek-an ah, tio̍h siōng-chàn lí ê Siōng-tè.
In-ūi I kian-kò͘ lí siâⁿ-mn̂g ê mn̂g-chhòaⁿ, sù-hok hō͘ siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng.
I hō͘ lí kéng-lāi pêng-an, ēng siōng-hó ê be̍h hō͘ lí chia̍h pá.
I ǹg tōe hoat-chhut bēng-lēng; I ê ōe thoân-pò͘ chin kín.
I lo̍h-seh chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-mn̂g, lo̍h-sng chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-hu.
I lo̍h-pha̍uh chhin-chhiūⁿ iù-chio̍h; I thàu léng-hong, siáⁿ-lâng tòng ōe tiâu?
I chi̍t-ē bēng-lēng, chiah-ê chiū lóng iûⁿ--khì; I khí hong, chúi chiū lâu.
I ēng I ê ōe chí-sī Ngá-kok, chiong I ê bēng-lēng kap kui-lē chí-sī Í-sek-lia̍t.
I m̄-bat án-ni khoán-thāi pa̍t-kok; I ê kui-lē, in m̄ bat. Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Lín tio̍h tùi thiⁿ-téng chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, tī koân ê só͘-chāi o-ló I.
I ê chèng sù-chiá ah, lín tio̍h chheng-chàn I. I ê chèng thian-kun ah, lín tio̍h o-ló I.
Ji̍t kap ge̍h ah, lín tio̍h chheng-chàn I; hoat-kng ê chhiⁿ-sîn ah, lín lóng tio̍h o-ló I.
Thiⁿ-téng ê thiⁿ, kap thiⁿ téng-bīn ê chúi ah, lín tio̍h o-ló I.
Chiah-ê lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú ê miâ, in-ūi I chi̍t-ē bēng-lēng, it-chhè chiū chō-sêng.
I chiong chiah-ê an-tì hó-sè, éng-oán bōe piàn-chhian; I tēng kui-lē, éng-oán bōe hòe-bô.
Lín tio̍h tùi tōe-chiūⁿ chheng-chàn Siōng Chú; tōa-hî kap só͘-ū ê chhim-hái,
sih-nà kap peng-pha̍uh, seh kap hûn-bū, thiaⁿ I ê ōe ê kông-hong, lín lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Só͘-ū ê tōa-soaⁿ kap sió-soaⁿ, ké-chí-chhiū kap pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū,
só͘-ū ê iá-siù kap cheng-siⁿ, thâng-thōa kap pe-chiáu, lín lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ê kun-ông kap jîn-bîn, kùi-cho̍k kap thóng-tī-chiá,
siàu-liân-lâng kap chāi-sek-lú, lāu-lâng kap gín-á, lín lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Lín chiah-ê lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú ê miâ, in-ūi chí-ū I ê miâ siū chun-chông, I ê êng-kng pôaⁿ-kè thiⁿ kap tōe.
I hō͘ I ê chú-bîn kiông-sēng, hō͘ I sèng ê chú-bîn lóng chheng-chàn I, chiū-sī hiah-ê chhin-kūn Chú ê Í-sek-lia̍t chú-bîn. Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ sin ê koa, tī sèng ê chú-bîn ê chū-hōe tiong chheng-chàn I.
Goān Í-sek-lia̍t in-ūi in ê Chhòng-chō-chú lâi hoaⁿ-hí; goān Sek-an ê chú-bîn in-ūi in ê Ông lâi khoài-lo̍k.
Goān in thiàu-bú chheng-chàn I ê miâ, phah-kó͘ tôaⁿ-khîm, chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló I.
Siōng Chú ì-ài I ê chú-bîn; I ōe ēng kiù-un chòe khiam-pi ê lâng ê chng-thāⁿ.
Goān sèng ê chú-bîn in-ūi só͘ tit--tio̍h ê êng-kng lâi hoaⁿ-hí; goān in kui-mî chhut hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ.
Goān in ê chhùi chheng-chàn Siōng-tè chòe chì-koân, in ê chhiú gia̍h siang-bīn-lāi ê kiàm,
pò-èng gōa-pang, hêng-hoa̍t lia̍t-kok,
ēng thih-liān pa̍k in ê kun-ông, ēng thih-khàu só in ê jîn-sîn,
tī in ê sin-chiūⁿ chip-hêng só͘ tēng ê phòaⁿ-koat; che sī I sèng ê chú-bîn ê êng-kng. Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! Tio̍h tī Siōng-tè ê sèng-só͘ chheng-chàn I; tio̍h tī hián-chhut I koân-lêng ê kiong-chhong o-ló I.
Tio̍h in-ūi I tōa koân-lêng ê chok-ûi chheng-chàn I, in-ūi I ê chì-chun chì-tōa o-ló I.
Tio̍h pûn sàu-kak chheng-chàn I, tôaⁿ-sek tôaⁿ-khîm o-ló I,
phah-kó͘ thiàu-bú chheng-chàn I, ēng si-hiân ê ga̍k-khì kap siau o-ló I,
ēng siaⁿ tōa ê poa̍h chheng-chàn I, ēng im koân ê poa̍h o-ló I.
Só͘-ū ōe chhoán-khùi--ê lóng tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú. Ha-lé-lú-iah, chheng-chàn Siōng Chú!
Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Só͘-lô-bûn ê chim-giân.
Chiah-ê chim-giân ōe hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h tì-hūi kap kà-sī, lí-kái chhim-ò ê tō-lí;
ōe hō͘ lâng siū kà-sī, ēng tì-hūi pān tāi-chì, si̍t-chián kong-gī, kong-chèng, kap kong-pêng.
Chiah-ê ōe ōe hō͘ gōng-ti̍t ê lâng ū lêng-khiáu, hō͘ siàu-liân-lâng ū tì-sek, gâu kè-ōe;
ōe hō͘ ū tì-hūi ê lâng thiaⁿ-liáu ke-thiⁿ ha̍k-sek, hō͘ chhong-bêng ê lâng tit-tio̍h chin ê kiàn-sek;
ōe hō͘ lâng bêng-pe̍k chim-giân kap phì-jū, liáu-kái tì-hūi ê lâng ê ōe kap gū-giân.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú sī tì-sek ê kun-pún; gû-gōng ê lâng biáu-sī tì-hūi kap kà-sī.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ lāu-pē ê kàu-tok; m̄-thang khì-sak lāu-bú ê kà-sī.
In-ūi chiah-ê ōe ōe chòe lí thâu-khak téng ê hoa-koan, chòe lí ām-kún ê kim-liān.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, pháiⁿ-lâng nā ín-iú lí, m̄-thang tè i khì.
In nā kóng, “Kap goán tàu-tīn lâi-khì, lâi-khì bâi-ho̍k thâi-lâng, tng-tán bû-ko͘ ê lâng, lâi kā thâi.
Lán chhin-chhiūⁿ Im-hú lâi kā in oa̍h-oa̍h thun--lo̍h-khì; in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hām-lo̍h Chhim-khiⁿ ê lâng hō͘ lán kui-ê thun--lo̍h-khì.
Lán ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h ta̍k-khoán ê châi-bu̍t, só͘ chhiúⁿ--ê tún-móa lán ê chhù.
Lí lâi ka-ji̍p goán ê tóng, chhiúⁿ--lâi ê châi-bu̍t tāi-ke lóng ū hūn.”
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, m̄-thang tè in khì, tio̍h iok-sok lí ê kha bô ta̍h-ji̍p in ê lō͘.
In-ūi in kóaⁿ beh chòe pháiⁿ, kip beh thâi-lâng.
Tī chiáu-á ê ba̍k-chiu chêng siat lô-bāng, só͘ chòe bô-chhái-kang.
In bâi-ho̍k beh hāi lâng, hoán-tńg hāi-tio̍h ka-kī, tng-tán beh siong lâng, tian-tò siong-tio̍h ka-kī.
Lâng nā put-te̍k-chhiú-tōaⁿ chhú-tit châi-lī, kiat-kio̍k it-tēng sit-khì ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.
Tì-hūi tī koe-lō͘ tōa-siaⁿ teh kiò, tī chhī-tiûⁿ-kháu tōa-siaⁿ teh hoah;
tī lāu-jia̍t ê koe-lō͘-thâu tōa-siaⁿ teh kiò, tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu tōa-siaⁿ kóng,
“Gōng-ti̍t ê lâng ài gōng-ti̍t beh jōa kú? Biáu-sī tì-sek ê lâng ài biáu-sī tì-sek beh jōa kú? Gû-gōng ê lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ tì-sek beh jōa kú?
Góa chek-pī lín, lín nā thiaⁿ-thàn, góa beh tùi lín thò͘-lō͘ góa ê sim-ì, hō͘ lín bêng-pe̍k góa ê ōe.
Góa kiò, lín m̄ thiaⁿ; góa iau-chhiáⁿ, bô lâng hoán-èng;
lín bû-sī góa it-chhè ê khoàn-kài, m̄-khéng chiap-siū góa ê chek-pī.
Só͘-í, lín tú-tio̍h hoān-lān, góa beh léng-chhiò; lín tú-tio̍h kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, góa beh thí-chhiò.
Tng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ kông-hong chhe--lâi, chai-hō chhin-chhiūⁿ kńg-lê-á-hong sàu--lâi, hoān-lān thòng-khó͘ lîm-kàu lín,
hit-sî lín beh kiû-kiò góa, góa m̄ thiaⁿ, pek-chhiat chhē góa, chhē bōe tio̍h.
In-ūi lín iàm-ò͘ⁿ tì-sek, bô ài kèng-ùi Siōng Chú,
m̄ thiaⁿ góa ê khoàn-kài, biáu-sī góa ê chek-pī,
só͘-í lín ōe chia̍h ka-kī só͘ chèng ê pháiⁿ ké-chí, ka-kī kè-bô͘ ê ok-kó chia̍h kah pá koh ià.
Gōng-ti̍t ê lâng ōe hō͘ ka-kī ê kò͘-chip hāi-sí; gû-gōng ê lâng ōe in-ūi chū-boán tì-kàu bia̍t-bông.
M̄-kú thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe ê lâng ōe an-ún khiā-khí, bián kiaⁿ chai-hō, hióng-siū pêng-an.”
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, lí nā chiap-siū góa ê ōe, chiong góa ê bēng-lēng khǹg tī sim-lāi,
chù-ì thiaⁿ tì-hūi, choan-sim kiû chhong-bêng;
lí nā kiû bêng-lí, tōa-siaⁿ kiû chhong-bêng;
nā chhē i chhin-chhiūⁿ chhē gûn, chhiau-chhē i chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiau-chhē chhàng--teh ê pó-pòe;
lí chiū bêng-pe̍k beh án-chóaⁿ kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, chai beh án-chóaⁿ jīn-bat Siōng-tè.
In-ūi Siōng Chú sù tì-hūi; chai-bat kap chhong-bêng lóng tùi I ê chhùi chhut.
I ūi-tio̍h chèng-ti̍t ê lâng chek-chū chin ê tì-hūi, pó-hō͘ hêng-ûi toan-chèng ê lâng.
I pó-siú chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ê lō͘, pó-hō͘ tùi I tiong-sìn ê lâng ê tō-lō͘.
Án-ni, lí chiū bêng-pe̍k kong-gī, kong-chèng, kong-pêng, chiū-sī chhōa lâng kàu it-chhè liông-siān ê lō͘.
Tì-hūi ōe ji̍p lí ê sim; tì-sek ōe hō͘ lí ê sim-sîn hoaⁿ-hí.
Chhek-lio̍k ōe pó-hō͘ lí; chhong-bêng ōe pó-siú lí,
kiù lí lī-khui pháiⁿ-lō͘, thoat-lī oai-khiok sī-hui ê lâng.
Hit-khoán lâng khì-sak chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘, kiâⁿ o͘-àm ê tō-lō͘.
In ài chòe pháiⁿ, ì-ài pháiⁿ-lâng ê oai-khiok.
In ê lō͘ oan-khiau, in ê só͘-kiâⁿ phian-lī chiàⁿ-lō͘.
Tì-hūi ōe hō͘ lí siám-pī îm-hū, siám-pī kóng sai-nai-ōe ê ki-lú.
I khì-sak siàu-liân ê sî ê phit-phòe, bōe-kì-tit i ê Siōng-tè ê iok.
Lí ji̍p i ê chhù chiū kiâⁿ-ji̍p sí-lō͘, kiâⁿ i ê lō͘ chiū thàng kàu Im-hú.
Kàu i hia--ê, bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng oa̍t tò-tńg, bô chi̍t ê ōe koh kiâⁿ tńg-lâi oa̍h-miā ê lō͘.
Án-ni, tì-hūi ōe hō͘ lí kiâⁿ hó-lâng ê lō͘, chhî-siú gī-lâng ê tō-lō͘.
Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ōe khiā-khí tī èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe; bô thang chí-chek ê lâng ōe lâu tī hia.
M̄-kú pháiⁿ-lâng ōe tùi tōe-bīn siau-bia̍t, kan-chà ê lâng ōe tùi tōe-chiūⁿ liân kun khau hiat-ka̍k.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, m̄-thang bōe-kì-tit góa ê kà-sī; lí ê sim tio̍h chhî-siú góa ê bēng-lēng;
án-ni, lí ōe tn̂g-hè-siū hó kè-ji̍t, hióng-siū pêng-an hoân-êng.
M̄-thang hō͘ chû-ài kap chin-si̍t lī-khui lí; tio̍h pa̍k tī lí ê ām-kún, khek-tiâu tī lí ê sim-lāi.
Án-ni tī Siōng-tè kap lâng ê bīn-chêng, lí ōe tit-tio̍h un-tián kap hó miâ-siaⁿ.
Tio̍h choan-sim óa-khò Siōng Chú; m̄-thang óa-khò ka-kī ê chhong-bêng.
Tī lí it-chhè ê só͘-chòe lóng tio̍h chun-tiōng I, I ōe chí-tiám lí ê lō͘.
M̄-thang khòaⁿ ka-kī chòe ū tì-hūi; tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, lī-khui pháiⁿ-sū.
Án-ni, lí ê sin-thé ōe ióng-kiāⁿ, lí ê kun-kut ōe ióng-chòng.
Tio̍h ēng lí ê châi-bu̍t kap it-chhè thâu-chúi ê thó͘-sán hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Lí ê chhek-chhng chiū ōe móa-móa, chiú-khut ū sin-chiú móa--chhut-lâi.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, m̄-thang khòaⁿ-khin Siōng Chú ê koán-kàu, mā m̄-thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ I ê chek-pī.
In-ūi Siōng Chú chek-pī I só͘ thiàⁿ ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ lāu-pē chek-pī i só͘ ì-ài ê kiáⁿ.
Tit-tio̍h tì-hūi ê lâng chin ū hok-khì, i ū tit-tio̍h chhong-bêng.
Tit-tio̍h tì-hūi pí tit-tio̍h gûn khah ū lī-ek, pí tùi kim tit--tio̍h ê lī-sûn khah koân.
Tì-hūi pí âng-pó-chio̍h khah kùi-khì; lâng só͘ ì-ài--ê bô chi̍t hāng ōe-tàng kap i pí.
I ê chiàⁿ-chhiú ū tn̂g-hè-siū; i ê tò-chhiú ū hó-gia̍h kap chun-kùi.
I ê lō͘ ū hí-lo̍k; i ê tō-lō͘ hō͘ lâng pêng-an hoân-êng.
Chhî-siú tì-hūi ê lâng tùi i tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā; kian-siú ê lâng lóng chin ū hok-khì.
Siōng Chú ēng tì-hūi kiàn-li̍p tōe, ēng chhong-bêng an-tì thiⁿ.
I ēng tì-sek hō͘ chhim-ian li̍h--khui, hō͘ kiong-chhong tih lō͘-chúi.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h chhî-siú chin ê tì-hūi, sīn-tiōng kè-ōe; tio̍h put-sî chù-ì, m̄-thang hut-lio̍k;
án-ni chiah ōe hō͘ lí tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā, chiâⁿ-chòe lí ām-kún súi ê chng-thāⁿ.
Lí chiū ōe an-ún kiâⁿ lí ê lō͘; lí ê kha bōe tak--tio̍h poa̍h-tó.
Lí tó--teh, it-tēng bōe kiaⁿ, tó--lo̍h-khì, ōe chin hó-khùn.
Hut-jiân hoat-seng thang-kiaⁿ ê tāi-chì, lí m̄-bián kiaⁿ; pháiⁿ-lâng beh kā lí húi-bia̍t, lí mā m̄-bián kiaⁿ.
In-ūi Siōng Chú ōe chòe lí ê óa-khò; I ōe pó-siú lí ê kha bô hām-lo̍h lô-bāng.
Lí nā ū khùi-la̍t chòe hó, m̄-thang kū-choa̍t; tio̍h pang-chān su-iàu pang-chān ê lâng.
Lí nā chòe ōe kàu, m̄-thang tùi lí ê chhù-piⁿ kóng, “Lí tńg--khì, bîn-á-chài koh lâi, góa chiah hō͘ lí.”
Chhù-piⁿ kap lí hô-bo̍k khiā-khí, lí m̄-thang siat-kè hāi i.
Lâng m̄-bat hām-hāi lí, lí m̄-thang bô-iân-bô-kò͘ kap i oan-ke.
M̄-thang him-siān kiông-pō ê lâng, mā m̄-thang kéng i só͘ kiâⁿ ê lō͘.
Oai-khiok sī-hui ê lâng Siōng Chú iàm-ò͘ⁿ; chèng-ti̍t ê lâng Siōng Chú kap i chhin-bi̍t.
Siōng Chú chiù-chó͘ pháiⁿ-lâng ê ke; gī-lâng ê chhù siū I chiok-hok.
Biáu-sī lâng--ê, Siōng Chú biáu-sī i; khiam-pi ê lâng, Siōng Chú si-un hō͘ i.
