Tì-hūi ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h chun-êng; gû-gōng ê lâng só͘ tit--tio̍h-ê sī kiàn-siàu.
Góa ê kiáⁿ-jî ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ lāu-pē ê kà-sī; tio̍h choan-sim ha̍k-si̍p chiah ōe bêng-pe̍k.
In-ūi góa ēng hó ê tō-lí hō͘ lín; m̄-thang pàng-sak góa ê kàu-tō.
Góa mā bat chòe goán lāu-pē ê sòe-kiáⁿ, sī goán lāu-bú siōng-thiàⁿ ê ko͘-kiáⁿ.
Lāu-pē ū kà-sī góa, kóng, “Lí tio̍h kì-tiâu góa ê ōe, chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng chiū ōe tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā.
Tio̍h chhē-kiû tì-hūi, chhē-kiû chhong-bêng; m̄-thang bōe-kì--tit, m̄-thang pàng-sak góa só͘ kóng ê ōe.
M̄-thang khì-sak tì-hūi, i ōe pó-hō͘ lí; tio̍h ì-ài tì-hūi, i ōe chiàu-kò͘ lí.
Tì-hūi siōng tiōng-iàu, tio̍h phah-piàⁿ chhē; tio̍h hù-chhut lí it-chhè só͘ ū--ê lâi tùi-ōaⁿ chhong-bêng.
Lí chun-tiōng tì-hūi, i ōe ko-kú lí; lí thiàⁿ-sioh i, i ōe hō͘ lí chun-êng.
Tì-hūi ōe ēng hoa-koan tì tī lí ê thâu-khak, chiong êng-kng ê ông-koan sù hō͘ lí.”
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ, tio̍h niá-siū góa ê ōe, lí chiū ōe tn̂g-hè-siū.
Góa ū chí-sī lí tì-hūi ê lō͘, ín-chhōa lí kiâⁿ chèng-ti̍t ê tō-lō͘.
Lí kiâⁿ ê sî, bōe tú-tio̍h chó͘-gāi; lí cháu, mā bōe tak--tio̍h poa̍h-tó.
Tio̍h chhî-siú kà-sī, m̄-thang pàng-sang; tio̍h kín-sīn kò͘-siú, in-ūi tì-hūi sī lí ê sìⁿ-miā.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê lō͘ m̄-thang kiâⁿ; siâ-ok ê lâng ê lō͘ m̄-thang ji̍p.
Tio̍h siám-pī, m̄-thang tùi hia kè; tio̍h oa̍t-cháu, hiòng-chêng kiâⁿ.
Pháiⁿ-lâng nā bô hāi lâng bōe-khùn--tit, nā bô hō͘ lâng poa̍h-tó khùn bōe lo̍h-bîn.
In-ūi in ēng siâ-ok chòe pn̄g chia̍h, ēng kiông-pō chòe chiú lim.
Gī-lâng ê lō͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ thàu-chá ê kng, jú chiò jú kng, chiò kàu tiong-tàu.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê lō͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ mî--sî o͘-o͘-àm-àm, lâng tak--tio̍h poa̍h-tó mā m̄ chai sī-án-chóaⁿ.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ góa ê kà-sī, àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa kóng ê ōe.
Tio̍h put-sî chù-ì, m̄-thang hut-lio̍k; tio̍h kì-tiâu tī sim-lāi.
Chhē--tio̍h ê lâng tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā, kui seng-khu lóng ióng-kiāⁿ.
Tio̍h chīn-la̍t pó-siú lí ê sim, in-ūi sim sī sìⁿ-miā ê kun-goân.
Lí ê chhùi m̄-thang khi-phiàn; lí ê chhùi-tûn m̄-thang oai-khiok sī-hui.
Lí ê ba̍k-chiu tio̍h khòaⁿ-ti̍t-ti̍t; tio̍h chù-ba̍k khòaⁿ thâu-chêng.
Lí kiâⁿ ê lō͘ tio̍h siu hō͘ pîⁿ; lí ê tō-lō͘ chiū lóng pîⁿ-tháⁿ hó-kiâⁿ.
M̄-thang phian-chó-phian-iū; tio̍h hō͘ lí ê kha lī-khui siâ-ok.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h liû-sim góa ê tì-hūi, àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa bêng-lí ê ōe,
hō͘ lí thang sīn-tiōng kè-ōe, hō͘ lí ê giân-gú hián-chhut tì-sek.
In-ūi îm-hū ê chhùi-tûn tiⁿ-but-but, i ê chhùi ku̍t-liu-liu;
m̄-kú āu-lâi pìⁿ-chòe khó͘-te̍h-te̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ siang-bīn-lāi ê kiàm ōe siong-hāi lâng.
I ê kha kiâⁿ ǹg sí-tōe; i ê kha-pō͘ kiâⁿ-lo̍h Im-hú.
Oa̍h-miā pîⁿ-tháⁿ ê lō͘, i bô siūⁿ-beh kiâⁿ; kiâⁿ-ji̍p oan-khiau gûi-hiám ê lō͘, i mā m̄ chai.
Góa ê kiáⁿ-jî ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn góa; m̄-thang khì-sak góa só͘ kóng ê ōe.
Tio̍h lī-khui îm-hū ê lō͘ hn̄g-hn̄g, m̄-thang kūn-óa i ê mn̂g-kháu,
chiah bián lí chiong ka-kī ê cheng-le̍k hō͘ pa̍t-lâng, chiong lí ê hè-siū kau hō͘ chân-jím bô-chêng ê lâng;
chiah bián siⁿ-hūn-lâng the̍h lí ê chîⁿ-châi khì hióng-lo̍k; lí phah-piàⁿ tit--tio̍h ê châi-hù lóng pìⁿ-chòe pa̍t-lâng ê.
Kàu-bé lí ê seng-khu soe-pāi, lí chiū pi-ai thó͘-khùi, kóng,
“Hāi ah, góa ná ōe iàm-ò͘ⁿ koán-kàu, biáu-sī chek-pī;
koh bô thiaⁿ tō-su ê ōe, bô thiaⁿ-thàn kà-sī góa ê lâng.
Góa tī hōe-chiòng ê tāi-hōe tiong, siū-tio̍h chek-hoa̍t, kiàn-siàu kah beh sí.”
Tio̍h lim ka-kī chúi-tî ê chúi, lim ka-kī chíⁿ-lāi chhut ê chúi.
Lí ê chôaⁿ-chúi kiám thang móa kàu gōa-bīn? Lí ê khoe-chúi kiám thang lâu khì chhī-tiûⁿ-kháu?
I chí-ū sio̍k lí chi̍t lâng; m̄-thang kap pa̍t-lâng kong-ke.
Tio̍h hō͘ lí ê chúi-chôaⁿ siū chiok-hok; tio̍h tùi lí siàu-liân ê sî só͘ chhōa ê bó͘ tit-tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
I chhin-chhiūⁿ khó-ài ê lo̍k-bú, súi ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú; lí tī i ê heng-chêng put-sî tit-tio̍h boán-chiok; i ê ài-chêng hō͘ lí sî-siông loân-bō͘.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ loân-bō͘ îm-hū? Sī-án-chóaⁿ lám pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘?
In-ūi lâng só͘ kiâⁿ ê lō͘ Siōng Chú lóng khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h; lâng it-chhè ê kiâⁿ-chòe I lóng teh kàm-chhat.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ōe hō͘ ka-kī ê chōe-kò khîⁿ-tiâu-tiâu, ōe hō͘ ka-kī chōe-ok ê soh pa̍k-sí-sí.
I ōe in-ūi bô siū koán-kàu tì-kàu sí-bông, ōe in-ūi kè-thâu gû-gōng kiâⁿ bê-lō͘.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, lí nā ūi-tio̍h chhù-piⁿ chòe tam-pó, thòe gōa-lâng pó-chèng,
lí chiū hō͘ ka-kī kóng ê ōe tauh--tio̍h, hō͘ ka-kī tah-èng ê ōe tîⁿ--tio̍h.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, kì-jiân lí lo̍h tī chhù-piⁿ ê chhiú-thâu, tio̍h án-ni chòe lâi kiù ka-kī: Tio̍h kín khì, khiam-pi khún-kiû lí ê chhù-piⁿ.
Ba̍k-chiu m̄-thang khùn--khì, ba̍k-chiu-phê m̄-thang khoeh--khì.
Tio̍h kiù ka-kī, chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k thoat-lī phah-la̍h ê lâng ê chhiú; chhin-chhiūⁿ chiáu thoat-lī lia̍h chiáu ê lâng ê chhiú.
Pîn-tōaⁿ-lâng ah, khì khòaⁿ káu-hiā, khòaⁿ i ê só͘-chòe thang tit-tio̍h tì-hūi.
I bô léng-siù, bô thâu-ba̍k, bô koaⁿ-tiúⁿ,
m̄-kú ōe-hiáu tī joa̍h-thiⁿ chún-pī chia̍h-mi̍h, tī siu-sêng ê sî chek-chū bí-niû.
Pîn-tōaⁿ-lâng ah, lí beh khùn jōa kú, sím-mi̍h sî chiah khùn ōe chhíⁿ?
Koh khùn chi̍t-kú-á, koh bîn chi̍t-sî-á, koh the chi̍t-ē-á;
sàn-chhiah chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ chha̍t lâi; khiàm-kheh chhin-chhiūⁿ kiông-tō kàu.
Lô͘-môa húi-lūi ta̍k só͘-chāi chè-chō sī-hui, sì-kòe kóng-ōe khi-phiàn lâng;
in sái-ba̍k-bé sī-ì, ēng kha àm-sī, ēng chńg-thâu-á chí-tiám;
in sim-su oai-chhoa̍h, kè-bô͘ pháiⁿ-tāi; sì-kòe sái-lōng, jiá-khí hun-cheng.
Só͘-í chai-hō hut-jiân lîm-kàu; i ōe sûi-sî sit-pāi bia̍t-bông, bōe hù kā kiù.
Ū la̍k hāng sī Siōng Chú só͘ oàn-hūn, liân I ê sim só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê ū chhit hāng:
Chiū-sī kiau-ngō͘ ê ba̍k-chiu, kóng pe̍h-chha̍t ê chi̍h, thâi bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê chhiú,
kè-bô͘ pháiⁿ-tāi ê sim, phun-cháu pháiⁿ-lō͘ ê kha,
kóng pe̍h-chha̍t choh gūi-chèng, tī hiaⁿ-tī tiong sái-lōng lâng oan-ke.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h chun-siú lāu-pē ê bēng-lēng, m̄-thang khì-sak lāu-bú ê kà-sī;
tio̍h put-sî kì tī lí ê sim, kòa tī lí ê ām-kún.
Lí kiâⁿ-lō͘ ê sî, i ōe ín-chhōa lí; lí khùn ê sî, i ōe khòaⁿ-kò͘ lí; lí khùn-chhíⁿ, i ōe kap lí tâm-lūn.
In-ūi bēng-lēng sī teng, kà-sī sī kng; koán-kàu ê chek-pī ōe chhōa lí kiâⁿ oa̍h-miā ê lō͘,
ōe pó-hō͘ lí bô chhin-kūn pháiⁿ-cha-bó͘, bô thiaⁿ ki-lú sai-nai ê ōe.
Lí ê sim m̄-thang hō͘ i ê súi bê--khì, m̄-thang in-ūi i sái-ba̍k-bé siū ín-iú.
Chhē ki-lú ōe hō͘ lâng sàn kah chhun chi̍t tè piáⁿ; kap pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘ kan-îm ōe sòng-sit pó-kùi ê sìⁿ-miā.
Lâng phō hé tī heng-chêng, saⁿ kiám bōe to̍h--khí-lâi?
Lâng ta̍h teh to̍h ê hé-thòaⁿ, kha kiám bōe sio--tio̍h?
Kap chhù-piⁿ ê bó͘ chòe-hé khùn mā ōe án-ni; kap i hoat-seng koan-hē it-tēng ōe siū hêng-hoa̍t.
Chha̍t in-ūi iau thau-the̍h mi̍h chí-ki, lâng bōe kā i khòaⁿ-khin;
m̄-kú hō͘ lâng lia̍h--tio̍h, tio̍h pê chhit pē, ke-lāi só͘ ū--ê lóng tio̍h the̍h chhut-lâi pê.
Kap pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘ thong-kan ê lâng chin bô tì-sek; chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì ōe hāi-tio̍h ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.
I ōe siū-tio̍h siong-hāi kap lêng-jio̍k; i ê kiàn-siàu sóe bōe chheng.
Tiōng-hu in-ūi oàn-tò͘ khí tōa siū-khì; pò-siû ê sî it-tēng bōe liû-chêng.
Ēng chîⁿ sio̍k-chōe, i m̄ ti̍h; lé-mi̍h sàng khah chōe, i mā m̄ pàng lí soah.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h chun-siú góa ê ōe, sim-lāi khǹg góa ê bēng-lēng.
Chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng chiū ōe tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā; chun-siú góa ê kà-sī, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh pó-hō͘ ba̍k-chiu-jîn.
Tio̍h pa̍k tī lí ê chńg-thâu-á, khek tī lí ê sim-lāi.
Tio̍h tùi tì-hūi kóng “Lí sī góa ê chí-bē”; tio̍h kiò chhong-bêng chòe lí ê chhin-lâng.
I ōe pó-hō͘ lí siám-pī îm-hū, siám-pī kóng sai-nai-ōe ê ki-lú.
Góa khiā tī goán tau ê thang-á-piⁿ, tùi thang-á khòaⁿ--chhut-khì;
góa tī gōng-ti̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng tiong-kan, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê bōe-hiáu siūⁿ ê siàu-liân-ke.
I keng-kè koe-lō͘, lâi kàu îm-hū in chhù ê hāng-á-kháu, siám ji̍p-khì îm-hū in tau ê lō͘.
Hông-hun, ji̍t lo̍h, o͘-àm tà-óa;
hit-sî ū chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-lâng, chhēng-chhah chhin-chhiūⁿ ki-lú, sim hoâi khì-tô͘ chhut-lâi chiap i.
Chit-ê cha-bó͘-lâng kóng-ōe tōa-sòe-siaⁿ, bô kàu-ióng, chhù tòa bōe tiâu.
Ū-sî tī koe-lō͘, ū-sî tī chhī-tiûⁿ-kháu; ū-sî tī chia thèng-hāu, ū-sî tī hia tng-tán.
I kā hit-ê siàu-liân-ke khîⁿ-tiâu-tiâu, kā i chim, m̄ kiaⁿ kiàn-siàu tùi i kóng,
“Góa kin-á-ji̍t ū hiàn pêng-an-chè, chhù-lāi ū siā-goān ê bah,
só͘-í góa chhut-lâi chhē lí, chhē chin kú chiah chhē--tio̍h.
Góa í-keng ēng Ai-ki̍p chhái-sek ê chhn̂g-kun, chhu tī góa ê bîn-chhn̂g;
koh ēng bu̍t-io̍h, tîm-hiuⁿ, jio̍k-kùi, hiù tī góa ê bîn-chhn̂g.
Lâi, lán lâi thong-siau hióng-siū chêng-ài kàu boán-chiok, lâi hióng-siū chêng-ài ê khoài-lo̍k.
In-ūi góa ê tiōng-hu bô tī chhù--ni̍h, chhut-gōa khì chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi.
I tòa kui-tē ê chîⁿ, kàu ge̍h îⁿ chiah ōe tò--lâi.”
Îm-hū ēng chin chōe hoa-giân-kháu-gú kā i ín-iú, ēng sai-nai ê chhùi chhui-pek i chòe-hé ji̍p--khì.
I sûi-sî tè i ji̍p--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ gû hō͘ lâng khan-khì thâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k-á poa̍h-lo̍h hām-chíⁿ,
kàu chìⁿ siā-ji̍p i ê koaⁿ; i chhin-chhiūⁿ chiáu-á chông-ji̍p lô-bāng iáu m̄-chai sí-oa̍h.
Góa ê kiáⁿ-jî ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn góa, liû-sim thiaⁿ góa só͘ kóng ê ōe.
Lí ê sim m̄-thang hō͘ i bê--khì, m̄-thang gōng-gōng-á tè i khì.
In-ūi i hō͘ chin chōe lâng siū-siong tó--lo̍h-khì; chin chōe lâng hō͘ i hāi-sí.
I ê chhù sī Im-hú ê ji̍p-kháu, ti̍t-chiap thàng kàu Sí-bông.
Tio̍h thiaⁿ, Tì-hūi teh kiò, chhong-bêng teh chhut-siaⁿ.
Tì-hūi tī lō͘-piⁿ koân ê só͘-chāi, khiā tī si̍p-jī-lō͘-kháu.
Tì-hūi tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu, tī lâng teh chhut-ji̍p ê só͘-chāi tōa-siaⁿ hoah,
“Chèng-lâng ah, góa kiò lín; sè-kan-lâng ah, góa tùi lín kóng.
Gōng-ti̍t ê lâng ah, tio̍h ha̍k-si̍p cheng-bêng; gû-gōng ê lâng ah, tio̍h tui-kiû chhong-bêng.
Tio̍h thiaⁿ, góa beh kóng ke̍k-hó ê sū, beh lūn chèng-ti̍t ê tāi-chì.
Góa ê chhùi kóng chin-si̍t; góa ê chhùi-tûn iàm-ò͘ⁿ siâ-ok.
Góa só͘ kóng ê ōe lóng kong-chèng, bô oan-khiau, bô oai-khiok.
Bêng-lí ê lâng lóng ōe liáu-kái; ū tì-sek ê lâng lóng khòaⁿ-chòe chèng-khak.
Chiap-siū góa ê koán-kàu pí tit-tio̍h gûn khah hó; tit-tio̍h tì-sek pí tit-tio̍h sûn-kim khah hó.
In-ūi tì-hūi pí âng-pó-chio̍h khah hó; lâng só͘ ì-ài--ê lóng bōe-tàng kap i pí.
“Góa sī Tì-hūi, hō͘ lâng cheng-bêng, hō͘ lâng ū tì-sek gâu kè-ōe.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú chiū tio̍h iàm-ò͘ⁿ siâ-ok; kiau-ngō͘, chū-tāi, siâ-ok ê hêng-ûi, í-ki̍p oai-khiok sī-hui lóng sī góa só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
Góa ū chhek-lio̍k kap chin ê tì-sek; góa chhong-bêng, ū lêng-le̍k.
Kun-ông khò góa lâi thóng-tī; thóng-tī-chiá thong-kè góa tēng kong-pêng ê hoat-lu̍t.
Ông-chhin kùi-cho̍k, sè-chiūⁿ ê sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, lóng khò góa lâi chiáng-koân.
Thiàⁿ góa--ê, góa mā thiàⁿ i; khún-chhiat chhē góa--ê, ōe chhē--tio̍h.
Hó-gia̍h kap chun-kùi sī góa só͘ sù; kú-tn̂g ê hù-jū kap hoân-êng mā-sī góa só͘ sù.
Góa hō͘ lâng ê ké-chí pí kim, pí sûn-kim khah hó; góa hō͘ lâng ê siu-sêng pí sûn ê gûn khah hó.
Góa kiâⁿ kong-gī ê lō͘, kiâⁿ kong-pêng ê tō-lō͘,
hō͘ thiàⁿ góa ê lâng tit-tio̍h châi-hù, hō͘ in ê châi-pó móa-móa.
“Tī chhòng-chō ê khí-thâu, Siōng Chú seng chō góa; chū-kó͘ í-lâi, góa sī I thâu chi̍t ê chhòng-chō--ê.
Tī siōng khí-thâu, tī chhòng-chō sè-kài í-chêng, tùi ke̍k kó͘-chá, I chō góa.
Góa chhut-sì ê sî iáu-bē ū chhim-ian, mā iáu-bē ū hái-iûⁿ.
Góa chhut bú-thai ê sî, tōa-soaⁿ iáu-bē siū-chō, sió-soaⁿ mā iáu-bē hêng-sêng.
Hit-sî tāi-tōe kap chhân-iá iáu-bē chhòng-chō, liân tōe-chiūⁿ thâu chi̍t pé thô͘-hún mā iáu-bē ū.
I an-tì kiong-chhong, tī hái-bīn ōe tōe-pêng-sòaⁿ, hit-sî góa í-keng tī hia.
I tī khong-tiong pò͘-tì hûn-chhái, hō͘ chhim-ian ê chúi-chôaⁿ chhèng--chhut-lâi,
kā hái tēng kài-hān, hō͘ hái-chúi bōe pôaⁿ kè-kài, kā tāi-tōe hē tōe-ki, hit-sî góa í-keng tī hia.
Hit-sî, góa tī I sin-piⁿ chòe sai-hū-thâu, ta̍k-ji̍t hō͘ I hoaⁿ-hí. Góa put-sî tī I bīn-chêng hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k,
ì-ài I hō͘ lâng khiā-khí ê sè-kài, hoaⁿ-hí I chhòng-chō ê sè-kan-lâng.
“Taⁿ, góa ê kiáⁿ-jî, tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn góa; chun-hêng góa tō-lō͘ ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Tio̍h thiaⁿ kà-sī lâi tit-tio̍h tì-hūi, m̄-thang kū-choa̍t.
Thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! In ta̍k-ji̍t tī góa ê mn̂g-kháu teh tán, tī góa ê mn̂g-piⁿ teh thèng-hāu.
Chhē-tio̍h góa ê lâng chiū-sī chhē-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā; i ōe tùi Siōng Chú tit-tio̍h un-hūi.
Chhē bô tio̍h góa ê lâng ōe bia̍t-bông; oàn-hūn góa ê lâng ka-kī chhē sí.”
Tì-hūi ū khí-chhù, chhāi chhit ki chio̍h-thiāu;
ū thâi cheng-siⁿ, tiâu-hô chiú, koh pān-toh.
I chhe lú-pī chhut--khì, tī siâⁿ-lāi siōng-koân ê só͘-chāi soan-pò͘,
“Gōng-ti̍t ê lâng lóng oat-lâi chia.” Tì-hūi kā bû-ti ê lâng kóng,
“Lín lâi, lâi chia̍h góa ê piáⁿ, lim góa tiâu-hô ê chiú.
Lín pàng-sak bû-ti chiū tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā, mā tio̍h kiâⁿ kng-bêng ê lō͘.”
Kiù-chèng ài biáu-sī lâng--ê, pún-sin ōe siū lêng-jio̍k; khiàn-chek pháiⁿ-lâng, ka-kī chhú kiàn-siàu.
M̄-thang khiàn-chek ài biáu-sī lâng--ê, in-ūi i ōe oàn-hūn lí; khiàn-chek ū tì-hūi ê lâng, i ōe thiàⁿ lí.
Kàu-tō ū tì-hūi ê lâng, i ōe jú ū tì-hūi; kà-sī gī-lâng, i ōe ke-thiⁿ ha̍k-būn.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú sī tì-hūi ê kun-pún; bat hit-ūi Chì-sèng ê Siōng-tè chiū-sī chhong-bêng.
In-ūi khò góa, lí ê ji̍t-chí ōe cheng-ka, lí ê nî-hè mā ōe ke-thiⁿ.
Lí nā ū tì-hūi, tì-hūi ōe hō͘ lí ū lī-ek; lí nā ài kā lâng biáu-sī, siū-sún--ê sī lí ka-kī.
Gōng ê cha-bó͘-lâng kóng-ōe tōa-sòe-siaⁿ; i gōng-ti̍t, m̄ bat pòaⁿ-hāng.
I chē tī ka-kī ê mn̂g-kháu, chē tī siâⁿ-lāi siōng-koân ê só͘-chāi,
kiò kè-lō͘ ê lâng, kiò kóaⁿ-kín teh keng-kè ê lâng, kóng,
“Gōng-ti̍t ê lâng lóng oat-lâi chia.” I kā bû-ti ê lâng kóng,
“Thau iúⁿ ê chúi khah tiⁿ; thau chia̍h ê piáⁿ khah ū chu-bī.”
M̄-kú gû-gōng ê lâng m̄ chai tī i hia ū im-hûn; i ê lâng-kheh tī Im-hú siōng-chhim ê só͘-chāi.
Só͘-lô-bûn ê chim-giân: Tì-hūi ê kiáⁿ hō͘ lāu-pē hoaⁿ-hí; gû-gōng ê kiáⁿ hō͘ lāu-bú iu-būn.
Put-gī ê chîⁿ-châi lóng bô lī-ek; chí-ū kong-gī ōe kiù lâng thoat-lī sí-bông.
Siōng Chú bōe hō͘ gī-lâng iau-gō; I ōe phò-hoāi pháiⁿ-lâng ê khì-tô͘.
Pîn-tōaⁿ hō͘ lâng sàn-chhiah; kut-la̍t hō͘ lâng hù-chiok.
Chiàu-sî siu-sêng--ê sī chhong-bêng-lâng; siu-koah ê sî ài-khùn--ê sī pāi-ka-chú.
Gī-lâng ê thâu-khak téng ū chiok-hok; pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhùi chhàng kiông-pō.
Gī-lâng ê miâ-siaⁿ siū chheng-chàn; pháiⁿ-lâng it-tēng lâu chhàu-miâ.
Sim-lāi chhong-bêng, ōe thiaⁿ-siū bēng-lēng; chhùi kóng gōng-ōe, it-tēng sit-pāi.
Kiâⁿ-lō͘ chèng-ti̍t, kha-pō͘ chiū an-ún; hêng-ûi put-chèng, kàu-bé ōe lō͘-hiān.
Ok-ì sái-ba̍k-bé, chè-chō kiù-hun; thán-pe̍k khó͘-khǹg lâng, chhiok-chìn hô-pêng.
Gī-lâng ê chhùi sī oa̍h-miā ê chúi-chôaⁿ; pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhùi chhàng kiông-pō.
Oàn-hūn jiá-khí hun-cheng; jîn-ài jia-khàm lóng-chóng ê kè-sit.
Bêng-lí ê lâng chhùi-lāi ū tì-hūi; bû-ti ê lâng ê ka-chiah ū chhê-á piān-piān teh tán.
Tì-hūi ê lâng chek-chū tì-sek; gōng-lâng ê chhùi chin khoài tì-kàu sit-pāi.
Châi-hù sī hó-gia̍h-lâng ê pó-chiong; pîn-khùn sī sàn-chhiah-lâng ê chai-lān.
Gī-lâng ê pò-siúⁿ sī sìⁿ-miā; pháiⁿ-lâng ê kang-chîⁿ sī hêng-hoa̍t.
Thiaⁿ-siū khoàn-kài, kiâⁿ oa̍h-lō͘; khì-sak chek-pī, kiâⁿ bê-lō͘.
Am-khàm oàn-hūn ê lâng, chhùi kóng pe̍h-chha̍t; sì-kòe chō-iâu--ê sī gōng-lâng.
Kāu-ōe lân-bián ū kè-sit; iok-sok chhùi-chi̍h chiah sī chhong-bêng.
Gī-lâng ê chi̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ sûn ê gûn; pháiⁿ-lâng ê sim bô kè-ta̍t.
Gī-lâng ê chhùi pôe-iúⁿ chin chōe lâng; gōng-lâng in-ūi bû-ti sí-bông.
Siōng Chú sù ê hok-khì hō͘ lâng hù-chiok, lāi-bīn bô chham iu-khó͘.
Gû-gōng ê lâng khòaⁿ choh-ok chòe khoài-lo̍k; bêng-lí ê lâng khòaⁿ tì-hūi chòe hoaⁿ-hí.
Pháiⁿ-lâng só͘ kiaⁿ--ê, ōe lîm-kàu i; gī-lâng só͘ ì-ài--ê, ōe tit--tio̍h.
Kông-hong chhe--kè, pháiⁿ-lâng chiū siau-sit; gī-lâng ōe éng-oán an-ún khiā-chāi.
Chhe pîn-tōaⁿ-lâng chòe tāi-chì, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhùi-khí hō͘ chhò͘ sng--tio̍h, ba̍k-chiu hō͘ ian hun--tio̍h.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ōe ke-thiⁿ ji̍t-chí; pháiⁿ-lâng ê nî-hè ōe kiám-chió.
Gī-lâng ê ǹg-bāng tòa-lâi hoaⁿ-hí; pháiⁿ-lâng ê kî-thāi kàu-bé lo̍k-khong.
Siōng Chú ê tō-lō͘ tùi chèng-ti̍t ê lâng sī pó-chiong, tùi chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng sī húi-bia̍t.
Gī-lâng éng-oán bōe tōng-iâu; pháiⁿ-lâng bōe-tàng khiā-khí tī èng-ún ê tōe.
Gī-lâng ê chhùi hoat-chhut tì-hūi; oai-khiok sī-hui ê chi̍h ōe siū koah-tn̄g.
Gī-lâng kóng-ōe ha̍p-gî; pháiⁿ-lâng chhut-chhùi oai-khiok sī-hui.
Khi-phiàn ê thian-phêng, Siōng Chú iàm-ò͘ⁿ; kong-pêng ê chhìn-thûi, I só͘ ì-ài.
Ū kiau-ngō͘ chiū ū kiàn-siàu; ū khiam-pi chiū ū tì-hūi.
Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ū sêng-si̍t teh ín-chhōa; khúi-khiat ê lâng in-ūi kan-chà tì-kàu húi-bia̍t.
Siōng Chú tōa siū-khì ê ji̍t, chîⁿ-châi bô lō͘-ēng, chí-ū kong-gī ōe kiù lâng thoat-lī sí-bông.
Bô thang chí-chek ê gī-lâng, i ê lō͘ ti̍t, hó kiâⁿ; pháiⁿ-lâng ōe in-ūi ka-kī ê siâ-ok poa̍h-tó sit-pāi.
Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ōe hō͘ ka-kī ê gī kiù--tio̍h; kan-chà ê lâng ōe hām-lo̍h ka-kī ê pháiⁿ só͘ siat ê lô-bāng.
Pháiⁿ-lâng chi̍t-ē sí, i ê ǹg-bāng chiū bô--khì, i só͘ kî-thāi--ê mā ōe siau-sit.
Gī-lâng ōe-tàng thoat-lī hoān-lān; pháiⁿ-lâng hoán-tńg hām-lo̍h hit lāi-bīn.
Gán-tiong bô Siōng-tè ê lâng kóng-ōe hāi chhù-piⁿ; gī-lâng in-ūi tì-sek tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.
Gī-lâng sūn-lī heng-thong, thong-siâⁿ hoaⁿ-hí; pháiⁿ-lâng bia̍t-bông, lâng lóng tōa-siaⁿ khèng-chiok.
Siâⁿ in-ūi chèng-ti̍t-lâng ê chiok-hok heng-khí, in-ūi pháiⁿ-lâng ê ōe tó-hoāi.
Biáu-sī chhù-piⁿ ê lâng bô siông-sek; bêng-lí ê lâng chēng-chēng bô chhut-siaⁿ.
Sì-kòe kóng lâng sī-hui--ê, ōe lāu-sia̍p lâng ê pì-bi̍t; sêng-si̍t khó-khò ê lâng khǹg-ba̍t tāi-chì.
Bô hó ê léng-tō, kok-ka chiū soe-pāi; kò͘-būn chōe, jîn-bîn chiū an-ún.
Kā siⁿ-hūn-lâng pó-chèng ōe siū tōa khek-khui; kū-choa̍t kā lâng tam-pó chiū an-choân.
Hiân-hūi ê hū-jîn-lâng siū lâng kèng-tiōng; pāi-tek ê hū-jîn-lâng chū-chhú-thí-jio̍k. Pîn-tōaⁿ ê ta-po͘-lâng ōe sàn-chhiah; kian-kiông ê ta-po͘-lâng ōe hó-gia̍h.
Jîn-chû ê lâng ka-kī tit-tio̍h lī-ek; chân-jím ê lâng ka-kī siū siong-hāi.
Pháiⁿ-lâng tit--tio̍h ê kang-chîⁿ sī khang-khang; iā gī ê chéng-chí tit--tio̍h ê pò-siúⁿ chiah sī si̍t-chāi.
Kian-chhî kong-gī, tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā; kè-sio̍k chòe pháiⁿ, tì-kàu sí-bông.
Oai-khiok sī-hui ê sim, Siōng Chú iàm-ò͘ⁿ; hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t, I só͘ ì-ài.
Pháiⁿ-lâng it-tēng siū hêng-hoa̍t; gī-lâng ê hō͘-tāi ōe tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.
Hū-jîn-lâng súi nā bô bêng-lí, chhin-chhiūⁿ kim-khoân kòa tī ti ê phīⁿ.
Gī-lâng só͘ ì-ài--ê, chòe-āu lóng sī hó; pháiⁿ-lâng tui-kiû--ê, jiá Siōng-tè siū-khì.
Lâng ná si-sià chiū ná hó-gia̍h; lâng ná tàng-sng chiū ná sàn-chhiah.
Ài si-sià--ê, jú hong-sēng; pang-chān lâng--ê, tit-tio̍h pang-chān.
Tún-chek ngó͘-kok m̄ bōe, ōe siū chiù-chó͘; hoaⁿ-hí bōe-chhut, ōe siū chiok-hok.
Chhut-la̍t chòe hó, ōe tit-tio̍h un-hūi; tui-kiû siâ-ok, ōe tú-tio̍h chai-hō.
Óa-khò ka-kī ê chîⁿ-châi, ōe poa̍h-tó sit-pāi; gī-lâng ōe heng-ōng chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū-hio̍h.
Jiá-khí ka-têng hun-cheng ê lâng, sím-mi̍h lóng tit bōe tio̍h; gōng-lâng ōe chòe chhong-bêng-lâng ê lô͘-po̍k.
Gī-lâng kiat ê ké-chí sī sìⁿ-miā; kiông-pō ê lâng chân-hāi sìⁿ-miā.
Gī-lâng tī sè-kan tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ; ū-chōe ê pháiⁿ-lâng it-tēng siū pò-èng.
Ì-ài tì-sek ê lâng hoaⁿ-hí chiap-siū koán-kàu; gōng-lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ chek-pī.
Hó-lâng ōe tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú si-un; khúi-kè-to-toan ê lâng ōe siū Siōng Chú tēng-chōe.
Lâng bōe-tàng tùi chòe pháiⁿ tit-tio̍h an-choân; gī-lâng ê kun-ki éng-oán bōe tōng-iâu.
Châi-tek ê hū-jîn-lâng sī tiōng-hu ê hoa-koan; m̄-chai kiàn-siàu ê hū-jîn-lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ tiōng-hu kut-lāi ê to̍k-liû.
Gī-lâng ê ì-liām sì-chiàⁿ; pháiⁿ-lâng ê kè-bô͘ khúi-chà.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê giân-lūn tng-tán beh thâi-lâng; chèng-ti̍t-lâng ê chhùi ōe kiù lâng.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ōe siū chhia-tó siau-sit; gī-lâng ê ke ōe kian-kò͘.
Lâng in-ūi tì-hūi siū o-ló; sim oai-khiok sī-hui ōe siū biáu-sī.
Pi-chiān ê lâng thàn ū chia̍h, khah iâⁿ phòng-hong chū-tāi ê lâng bô mi̍h thang chia̍h.
Gī-lâng koan-sim i ê cheng-siⁿ ê sìⁿ-miā; pháiⁿ-lâng liân tùi lâng tông-chêng to chân-jím.
Chèng-choh ê lâng ū kàu-gia̍h ê bí-niû; tui-kiû khang-khang bô kè-ta̍t ê sū sī bô tì-sek.
Pháiⁿ-lâng tham-ài siâ-ok ê lâng chhiúⁿ--lâi ê châi-bu̍t; gī-lâng ê kun ōe kiat ké-chí.
Siâ-ok ê lâng in-ūi chhùi-tûn ê kè-sit poa̍h-lo̍h ka-kī ê lô-bāng; gī-lâng ōe thoat-lī hoān-lān.
Lâng tùi chhùi só͘ kiat ê ké-chí tit-tio̍h móa-móa ê hok-khì; ta̍k-ê lâng chiàu i ê só͘-chòe siū pò-èng.
Gōng-lâng khòaⁿ ka-kī ê lō͘ chòe tio̍h; chhong-bêng ê lâng thiaⁿ lâng khó͘-khǹg.
Gōng-lâng chin khoài hián-chhut siū-khì; bêng-lí ê lâng jím-siū bú-jio̍k.
Kóng si̍t-ōe choh-chèng chiong-hián kong-gī; lām-sám choh-chèng hián-chhut khúi-khiat.
Kóng-ōe bô kín-sīn chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng to chha̍k--lâng; tì-hūi ê lâng ê chi̍h i-tī lâng.
Sêng-si̍t ê chhùi éng-oán khó-khò; pe̍h-chha̍t ê chi̍h chí-ū tòng chi̍t-sî-á-kú.
Tô͘-bô͘ pháiⁿ-tāi ê lâng sim chûn khúi-chà; khǹg lâng hô-hó ê lâng ōe khoài-lo̍k.
Gī-lâng bōe tú-tio̍h chai-hāi; pháiⁿ-lâng ōe tú-tio̍h chin chōe chai-hō.
Pe̍h-chha̍t ê chhùi-tûn, Siōng Chú iàm-ò͘ⁿ; chòe tāi-chì sêng-si̍t, I só͘ hoaⁿ-hí.
Bêng-lí ê lâng khǹg-ba̍t tì-sek; gōng-lâng ê sim hián-lō͘ gû-gōng.
Un-khûn ê chhiú ū-la̍t chiáng-koân; pîn-tōaⁿ ê lâng kā lâng chòe khó͘-kang.
Sim ū khòa-lū, hō͘ lâng lóe-chì; chi̍t kù hó-ōe, hō͘ lâng hoaⁿ-hí.
Gī-lâng chhōa chhù-piⁿ kiâⁿ chiàⁿ-lō͘; pháiⁿ-lâng chhōa lâng kiâⁿ bê-lō͘.
Pîn-tōaⁿ ê lâng ū bah mā bô beh hang; phah-piàⁿ ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h pó-kùi ê châi-bu̍t.
Chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘ hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā; siâ-ok ê lō͘ thàng kàu sí-bông.
Tì-hūi ê kiáⁿ thiaⁿ-thàn lāu-pē ê kàu-tō; chū-ko chū-tāi ê lâng m̄ thiaⁿ chek-pī.
Lâng kóng hó-ōe ū hó ê sêng-kó; kan-chà ê lâng tô͘-bô͘ kiông-pō.
Iok-sok chhùi-chi̍h, pó-choân sìⁿ-miā; sûi-piān khui-chhùi, tì-kàu húi-bia̍t.
Pîn-tōaⁿ ê lâng sim him-bō͘, mā tit bōe tio̍h; phah-piàⁿ ê lâng ōe sim-móa-ì-chiok.
Gī-lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe; pháiⁿ-lâng sit thé-biān, lâu chhàu-miâ.
Kong-gī pó-hō͘ chèng-ti̍t ê lâng; siâ-ok pāi-hoāi ū-chōe ê lâng.
Ū lâng chng-chòe hó-gia̍h, kî-si̍t bô-pòaⁿ-hāng; ū lâng chng-chòe sàn-chhiah, kî-si̍t ū chin chōe châi-bu̍t.
Hó-gia̍h-lâng ēng chîⁿ sio̍k-miā; sàn-chhiah-lâng m̄ kiaⁿ lâng ui-hia̍p.
Gī-lâng ê kng ōe bêng-liāng; pháiⁿ-lâng ê teng ōe sit--khì.
Kiau-ngō͘ it-tēng khí saⁿ-chiⁿ; thiaⁿ lâng khó͘-khǹg ū tì-hūi.
M̄-sī phah-piàⁿ tit--tio̍h ê chîⁿ ōe ná kiám-chió; lâu-kōaⁿ chek-chū ê chîⁿ ōe ná ke-thiⁿ.
Só͘ ǹg-bāng--ê kú bô si̍t-hiān, sim chiū thòng-khó͘ sit-chì; só͘ ì-ài--ê chi̍t-ē si̍t-hiān, sìⁿ-miā chiū chhiong-móa oa̍h-le̍k.
Biáu-sī kà-sī, chū-chhú-bia̍t-bông; chun-tiōng kài-bēng, tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ.
Chhong-bêng-lâng ê kà-sī sī oa̍h-miā ê chúi-chôaⁿ, hō͘ lâng bián hām-lo̍h sí-bông ê lô-bāng.
Bêng-lí ê lâng ōe siū chun-tiōng, siū chiap-la̍p; kan-chà ê lâng ê lō͘ khâm-khia̍t pháiⁿ-kiâⁿ.
Thong-ta̍t ê lâng ēng tì-hūi chòe tāi-chì; gōng-lâng hián-lō͘ ka-kī ê gû-gōng.
Pháiⁿ ê sù-chiá hō͘ lâng hām-lo̍h chai-hō; tiong-sìn ê chhe-sài hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h i-tī kiù-chō͘.
Kū-choa̍t kàu-tok, ōe tì-kàu sàn-chhiah kiàn-siàu; goān-ì siū chek-pī, ōe siū kèng-tiōng.
Só͘ ì-ài--ê si̍t-hiān, sim chiū hoaⁿ-hí; lī-khui pháiⁿ-tāi, gōng-lâng m̄-goān.
Kap tì-hūi ê lâng tâng-kiâⁿ chiū ū tì-hūi; kap gōng-lâng choh-phōaⁿ ōe siū siong-hāi.
Chai-hō ōe tui-jip chōe-jîn; hoân-êng sī gī-lâng ê pò-siúⁿ.
Hó-lâng lâu sán-gia̍p hō͘ kiáⁿ-sun; chōe-jîn chek-chū ê châi-hù chòe-āu kui gī-lâng.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng ê chhân-hn̂g seng-sán chin chōe bí-niû, m̄-kú in-ūi bô kong-gī soah lóng siū chhiúⁿ-toa̍t.
M̄-kam chek-hoa̍t kiáⁿ-jî sī bô thiàⁿ in; nā thiàⁿ in, chiū tio̍h chiàu-sî chek-tok.
Gī-lâng ōe-tàng chia̍h kah sim-móa-ì-chiok; pháiⁿ-lâng ê pak-tó͘ put-sî iau-iau.
Tì-hūi ê hū-jîn-lâng kiàn-li̍p ka-kī ê ka-têng; gû-gōng ê hū-jîn-lâng chhin-chhiú thiah-húi.
Chòe sū chèng-ti̍t ê lâng kèng-ùi Siōng Chú; chòe tāi-chì oai-chhoa̍h ê lâng biáu-sī I.
Gōng-lâng kóng-ōe ka-kī siū chek-hoa̍t; tì-hūi ê lâng ê ōe pó-hō͘ ka-kī.
Bô gû keng-choh chiū bô ngó͘-kok; gû ū-la̍t thó͘-sán chiū jú chōe.
Sêng-si̍t ê chèng-jîn bōe kóng pe̍h-chha̍t; hu-ké ê chèng-jîn móa-chhùi hô͘-soat.
Chū-ko chū-tāi ê lâng chhē tì-hūi, chhē bōe tio̍h; chhong-bêng ê lâng chin kín tit-tio̍h tì-sek.
Tio̍h lī-khui gōng-lâng, in-ūi tùi i kóng ê ōe chhē bōe tio̍h tì-sek.
Thong-ta̍t ê lâng ê tì-hūi hō͘ i liáu-kái tio̍h kiâⁿ ê lō͘; gōng-lâng ê gōng tì-kàu kiâⁿ bê-lō͘.
Gōng-lâng khòaⁿ hoān-chōe chòe kún-chhiò; chèng-ti̍t ê lâng hun-hióng Siōng-tè ê un-hūi.
Lâng ê kan-khó͘, chí-ū ka-kī ê sim chai; i ê hoaⁿ-hí, gōa-lâng bōe-tàng hun-hióng.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhù ōe tó-hoāi; chèng-ti̍t-lâng ê pò͘-pîⁿ ōe heng-ōng.
Ū chi̍t tiâu lō͘ khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chiàⁿ koh ti̍t, kàu-bé thàng kàu sí-bông.
Lâng teh chhiò ê sî sim iáu ū iu-būn; khoài-lo̍k ê kiat-kio̍k ōe pìⁿ-chòe pi-siong.
Pháiⁿ-lâng it-tēng siū pò-èng; hó-lâng it-tēng tit pò-siúⁿ.
Gōng-ti̍t ê lâng ta̍k-hāng lóng sìn; thong-ta̍t ê lâng pō͘-pō͘ kín-sīn.
Tì-hūi ê lâng sū-sū kín-sīn, oán-lī pháiⁿ-tāi; gōng-lâng kiau-ngō͘ hòng-sù.
Khoài siū-khì ê lâng chòe tāi-chì gû-gōng; khúi-chà ê lâng hō͘ lâng oàn-hūn.
Gōng-ti̍t ê lâng sêng-chiap gû-gōng chòe sán-gia̍p; thong-ta̍t ê lâng tit-tio̍h tì-sek chòe hoa-koan.
Pháiⁿ-lâng phak-lo̍h tī hó-lâng ê bīn-chêng; chōe-jîn phak-lo̍h tī gī-lâng ê mn̂g-kháu.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng liân chhù-piⁿ to iàm-chiān; hó-gia̍h-lâng pêng-iú chin chōe.
Khòaⁿ-khin chhù-piⁿ ê lâng ū chōe; lîn-bín sàn-chhiah ê lâng ū hok-khì.
Kè-bô͘ pháiⁿ-tāi ōe kiâⁿ-ji̍p bê-lō͘; kè-bô͘ hó-sū ōe tit-tio̍h lâng ê chin-sêng lîn-bín.
Ta̍k-khoán ê phah-piàⁿ lóng ū lī-ek; khong-tâm ōe tì-kàu sàn-chhiah.
Tì-hūi ê lâng ê châi-hù sī in ê hoa-koan; gōng-lâng ê gōng kàu-bé mā-sī gōng.
Kóng si̍t-ōe choh-chèng kiù lâng ê sìⁿ-miā; choh gūi-chèng sī ēng khúi-chà hāi lâng.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ū kian-kò͘ ê óa-khò; i ê kiáⁿ-jî ū tô-siám ê só͘-chāi.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú sī oa̍h-miā ê chúi-chôaⁿ, hō͘ lâng bián hām-lo̍h sí-bông ê lô-bāng.
Peh-sìⁿ chōe, kok-ông ū êng-kng; jîn-bîn chió, jîn-kun chiū soe-pāi.
Bōe khoài siū-khì sī tōa chhong-bêng; bô nāi-sim--ê hián-chhut gû-gōng.
Sim pêng-chēng hō͘ sin-thé kiān-khong; oàn-tò͘ hō͘ kut-thâu hiú-nōa.
Ap-pek sàn-chhiah-lâng sī siat-to̍k chhòng-chō in ê Chú; hó khoán-thāi bô-chîⁿ-lâng sī chun-kèng Chú.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ōe in-ūi só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ bia̍t-bông; gī-lâng kàu sí iáu ū óa-khò.
Tì-hūi ài tiàm tī chhong-bêng-lâng ê sim-lāi; gōng-lâng ê sim-lāi chhē bô tì-hūi.
Kong-gī hō͘ kok-ka kiông-sēng; chōe-ok hō͘ jîn-bîn siū lêng-jio̍k.
Ông ì-ài ēng tì-hūi pān tāi-chì ê koaⁿ-oân, chek-hoa̍t sit-chit ê jîn-sîn.
Un-hô ê ìn-tap hō͘ siū-khì soah; chhì-chha̍k ê ōe kek-khí siū-khì.
Tì-hūi-lâng ê chi̍h gâu kóng tì-sek; gōng-lâng ê chhùi thò͘-chhut gû-gōng.
Siōng Chú ê ba̍k-chiu ta̍k só͘-chāi teh khòaⁿ, hó-pháiⁿ lóng teh kàm-chhat.
Un-hô ê chi̍h sī oa̍h-miā ê chhiū; kóng-ōe oai-khiok sún-siong sim-sîn.
Gōng-lâng khòaⁿ-khin lāu-pē ê koán-kàu; goān-ì siū chek-pī sī bêng-lí.
Gī-lâng ê chhù-lāi ū chin chōe châi-pó; pháiⁿ-lâng só͘ thàn--ê chiâⁿ-chòe ka-kī ê hām-hāi.
Tì-hūi-lâng ê chhùi pò-iông tì-sek; gōng-lâng ê sim m̄-sī án-ni.
Pháiⁿ-lâng hiàn ê chè, Siōng Chú iàm-ò͘ⁿ; chèng-ti̍t-lâng ê kî-tó, Siōng Chú hoaⁿ-hí.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê lō͘ sī Siōng Chú só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ; tui-kiû kong-gī sī I só͘ ì-ài.
Pàng-sak chiàⁿ-lō͘ ê lâng ōe siū giâm-keh koán-kàu; iàm-ò͘ⁿ chek-pī ê lâng ōe tì-kàu sí-bông.
Im-hú kap Bia̍t-bông Siōng Chú to teh kàm-chhat, sè-kan-lâng ê sim koh-khah bōe-tàng tùi I khàm-ba̍t.
Chū-ko chū-tāi ê lâng bô ài siū chek-pī, mā bô ài kap tì-hūi ê lâng chham-siông.
Sim hoaⁿ-hí, bīn chiū ū chhiò-iông; sim iu-būn, sim-lêng chiū lóe-chì.
Chhong-bêng-lâng ê sim chhē-kiû tì-sek; gōng-lâng ê chhùi ēng gû-gōng chòe chia̍h-mi̍h.
Khùn-khó͘ ê lâng, ji̍t-chí pháiⁿ kè; sim khoài-lo̍k ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ iàn-se̍k bô tn̄g.
Sàn-chhiah ū teh kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, khah iâⁿ hó-gia̍h ū chin chōe hoân-ló.
Chia̍h chhiⁿ-chhài, tāi-ke saⁿ-thiàⁿ, khah iâⁿ chia̍h pûi gû-á, hō͘-siōng oàn-hūn.
Pháiⁿ sèng-tē jiá-khí oan-ke; bô khoài siū-khì ōe hō͘ saⁿ-chiⁿ soah.
Pîn-tōaⁿ-lâng ê lō͘ hō͘ chhì-phè ûi--teh; chèng-ti̍t-lâng ê lō͘ tōa-tiâu pîⁿ-tháⁿ.
Tì-hūi ê kiáⁿ hō͘ lāu-pē hoaⁿ-hí; gōng-lâng khòaⁿ-khin ka-kī ê lāu-bú.
Bû-ti ê lâng khòaⁿ gû-gōng chòe hoaⁿ-hí; bêng-lí ê lâng chiàu chèng-ti̍t kiâⁿ.
Bô chham-siông, kè-ōe ōe sit-pāi; kò͘-būn chōe, chiū ōe sêng-kong.
Ìn-tap ha̍p-gî hō͘ lâng hoaⁿ-hí; ha̍p-sî ê ōe si̍t-chāi chin hó!
Tì-hūi ê lâng kiâⁿ-chiūⁿ oa̍h-miā ê lō͘, chiah bián lo̍h-khì ē-bīn ê Im-hú.
Siōng Chú thiah-húi kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng ê chhù, pó-hō͘ kóaⁿ-hū ê tōe-kài.
Pháiⁿ ê sim-su, Siōng Chú iàm-ò͘ⁿ; sûn-kiat ê ōe, Siōng Chú ì-ài.
Tham put-gī-chi-châi, hām-hāi ka-kī ê ke; kū-choa̍t hóe-lō͘, ōe tn̂g-hè-siū.
Gī-lâng ê sim siūⁿ-liáu chiah ìn; pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhùi thò͘-chhut siâ-ok.
Siōng Chú lī-khui pháiⁿ-lâng chin hn̄g, m̄-kú ū teh thiaⁿ gī-lâng ê kî-tó.
Un-jiû ê gán-sîn hō͘ lâng sim hoaⁿ-hí; hó siau-sit hō͘ kun-kut ióng-kiāⁿ.
Thiaⁿ-thàn koán-kàu ê lâng ōe tn̂g-hè-siū, ōe-tàng kap tì-hūi ê lâng chòe-hé khiā-khí.
M̄ thiaⁿ kéng-kài sī khòaⁿ-khin ka-kī; thiaⁿ-thàn koán-kàu ōe tit-tio̍h tì-hūi.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú sī kà lâng ū tì-hūi; seng ū khiam-pi chiah ū chun-êng.
Lâng teh kè-ōe, Siōng Chú teh koat-tēng.
Lâng khòaⁿ ka-kī ê só͘-chòe chòe tio̍h, m̄-kú Siōng Chú sím-cha lâng ê tōng-ki.
Chiong lí ê só͘-chòe kau-thok Siōng Chú, lí ê kè-ōe chiū ōe sêng-kong.
Siōng Chú só͘ chō--ê lóng ū bo̍k-te̍k, liân pháiⁿ-lâng bia̍t-bông ê ji̍t mā-sī I ê kè-ōe.
Siōng Chú iàm-ò͘ⁿ sim kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng; pháiⁿ-lâng it-tēng siū hêng-hoa̍t.
In-ūi chû-ài sìn-si̍t, chōe-kò tit-tio̍h jia-khàm; kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, lâng thang lī-khui siâ-ok.
Lâng ê só͘-chòe nā hō͘ Siōng Chú hoaⁿ-hí, Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ tùi-te̍k kap i hô-hó.
Thàn-chîⁿ chió, ū kong-tō, khah iâⁿ thàn-chîⁿ chōe bô kong-tō.
Lâng kè-ōe ka-kī ê tō-lō͘; Siōng Chú ín-chhōa i ê kha-pō͘.
Ông ê chhùi kóng Siōng-tè chí-sī ê ōe, i ê sím-phòaⁿ chiū bōe chha-chhò.
Kong-tō ê thian-phêng kap chhìn lóng sio̍k Siōng Chú; tē-á lāi ê chhìn-thûi lóng sī I só͘ chè-tēng.
Chòe pháiⁿ sī ông só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ; ông-ūi khò kong-gī kiàn-li̍p.
Kong-chèng ê chhùi-tûn sī ông só͘ hoaⁿ-hí; kóng-ōe chèng-ti̍t sī ông só͘ ì-ài.
Ông ê tōa siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ sí-bông ê sù-chiá; tì-hūi ê lâng ōe hō͘ i ê siū-khì soah.
Ông kong-chhái ê bīn hō͘ lâng ū sìⁿ-miā; ông ê un-hūi chhin-chhiūⁿ chhun-ú ê hûn.
Tit-tio̍h tì-hūi pí tit-tio̍h kim khah hó; kéng-tio̍h chhong-bêng pí tit-tio̍h gûn koh-khah hó.
Chèng-ti̍t-lâng ê tōa-lō͘ lī-khui pháiⁿ; kín-sīn ka-kī ê kha-pō͘ ōe pó-choân sìⁿ-miā.
Ū kiau-ngō͘ chiū ū sit-pāi; ū chū-ko chiū ū poa̍h-tó.
Sim khiam-pi kap sàn-chhiah-lâng chòe-hé tòa, khah iâⁿ kap kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng pun só͘ chhiúⁿ ê mi̍h.
Thiaⁿ-thàn tō-lí, ōe tit-tio̍h lī-ek; óa-khò Siōng Chú, chin ū hok-khì.
Sim ū tì-hūi chheng-chòe thong-ta̍t; kóng-ōe bûn-ngá ōe hō͘ lâng sim ho̍k.
Chhong-bêng-lâng ê tì-hūi sī i oa̍h-miā ê chúi-chôaⁿ; gōng-lâng ê gōng sī i ê chek-hoa̍t.
Tì-hūi ê lâng ê sim iok-sok i ê chhùi, hō͘ i ê ōe ke-thiⁿ sòe-ho̍k-le̍k.
Chhin-chhiat ê ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ bi̍t, hō͘ sim hoaⁿ-hí, hō͘ kut ióng-kiāⁿ.
Ū chi̍t tiâu lō͘ khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chiàⁿ koh ti̍t, kàu-bé thàng kàu sí-bông.
Chòe-kang-lâng ūi-tio̍h kò͘ pak-tó͘ chòe kang; pak-tó͘ iau pek in phah-piàⁿ.
Lô͘-môa kè-bô͘ beh hāi lâng; i ê chhùi-tûn chhin-chhiūⁿ teh to̍h ê hé.
Oai-khiok sī-hui ê lâng sì-kòe chè-chō hun-cheng; gâu o̍h-ōe ê lâng hō͘ chhin-bi̍t ê pêng-iú pìⁿ-bīn.
Kiông-pō ê lâng ín-iú chhù-piⁿ, chhōa in kiâⁿ pháiⁿ-lō͘.
Nih-ba̍k sī-ì sī teh tô͘-bô͘ siâ-ok; chhùi-tûn kā-ân piáu-sī kian-koat chòe pháiⁿ.
Pe̍h thâu-mn̂g sī êng-iāu ê hoa-koan, si̍t-hêng kong-gī chiah ōe tit--tio̍h.
Jím-nāi iâⁿ-kè ui-le̍k; gâu khòng-chè ka-kī khah iâⁿ cheng-ho̍k kui-chō siâⁿ.
Lâng thiu-chhiam koat-tēng tāi-chì; chòe-āu ê koat-tēng chāi-tī Siōng Chú.
Ū chi̍t-tè-á piáⁿ thang chia̍h, tāi-ke hô-bo̍k, khah iâⁿ chhe-chhau móa toh ū saⁿ-chiⁿ.
Gâu pān tāi-chì ê po̍k-jîn ōe koán-hat sià-thé-biān ê kiáⁿ, koh ōe-tàng kap chú-lâng ê kiáⁿ pîⁿ-pîⁿ pun-tio̍h ke-hé.
Liān gûn ēng tiáⁿ, liān kim ēng lô͘, m̄-kú Siōng Chú thoàn-liān lâng ê sim.
Chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng chù-ì thiaⁿ kan-chà ê ōe; kóng pe̍h-chha̍t ê lâng ài thiaⁿ siâ-ok ê giân-gú.
Thí-chhiò sàn-chhiah-lâng sī bú-jio̍k chhòng-chō in ê Chú; ài lâng tú-tio̍h chai-hō--ê it-tēng ōe siū hêng-hoa̍t.
Kiáⁿ-sun sī lāu-lâng ê hoa-koan; lāu-pē sī kiáⁿ-jî ê êng-iāu.
Gōng-lâng kóng tōa-ōe bô ha̍h; ū tōe-ūi ê lâng kóng pe̍h-chha̍t koh-khah bô ha̍h.
Hóe-lō͘, sàng ê lâng khòaⁿ-chòe pó-chio̍h, ta̍k-tiâu lō͘ lóng kiâⁿ ōe thong.
Bōe-kì-tit lâng ê kè-sit ōe tit-tio̍h iú-hó ê hôe-èng; tāi-chì ta̍uh-ta̍uh-liām ōe hō͘ chhin-bi̍t ê pêng-iú so͘-oán.
Kā bêng-lí ê lâng kóng chi̍t kù chek-pī ê ōe, khah iâⁿ kā gōng-lâng phah chi̍t-pah ē.
Pháiⁿ-lâng chûn-sim pōe-ge̍k; húi-bia̍t ê sù-chiá ōe lâi kā i tùi-hù.
Lêng-khó tú-tio̍h sit-lo̍h kiáⁿ ê hîm-bú, m̄-thang tú-tio̍h kò͘-chip ê gōng-lâng.
Ēng pháiⁿ pò hó--ê, chai-hō bōe lī-khui i ê ke.
Saⁿ-chiⁿ chi̍t-ē khai-sí chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi pang-khiah, tio̍h seng chè-chí chiah bōe tì-kàu hoàn-lām.
Phòaⁿ pháiⁿ-lâng chòe bô-chōe, tēng gī-lâng chòe ū-chōe, nn̄g hāng lóng sī Siōng Chú só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
Gōng-lâng bô siūⁿ-beh bóe tì-hūi, chhiú--ni̍h the̍h chîⁿ ū siáⁿ lō͘-ēng?
Pêng-iú put-sî saⁿ chiàu-kò͘; hiaⁿ-tī chhut-sì sī beh hun-tam khó͘-lān.
Kā chhù-piⁿ tah-èng chòe tam-pó, hit-khoán lâng sī gōng-lâng.
Ài hoān-chōe ê lâng ài saⁿ-chiⁿ; chū-ko kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng chū-chhú-bia̍t-bông.
Sim-su siâ-ok ê lâng chhē bōe tio̍h hok-khì; gâu péng-ōe ê lâng ōe hām-lo̍h hoān-lān.
Siⁿ-tio̍h gōng-kiáⁿ sī pē-bú ê iu-būn; gōng-lâng ê lāu-pē bô sím-mi̍h thang hoaⁿ-hí.
Hoaⁿ-hí ê sim sī hó-io̍h; iu-siong ê sîn hō͘ kut ko͘-tâ.
Pháiⁿ-lâng àm-tiong siu hóe-lō͘, ōe hō͘ phòaⁿ-koat sit-khì kong-chèng.
Tì-hūi tī bêng-lí ê lâng ê ba̍k-chiu chêng, m̄-kú gōng-lâng ê ba̍k-chiu chhē kàu tōe ê ke̍k-thâu.
Gû-gōng ê kiáⁿ hō͘ lāu-pē hoân-ló, hō͘ lāu-bú iu-khó͘.
Hêng-hoa̍t bû-ko͘ ê lâng m̄ hó; táⁿ-kek chèng-ti̍t ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ mā m̄ hó.
Iok-sok giân-gú--ê ū tì-sek; sèng-chêng léng-chēng--ê sī chhong-bêng.
Gōng-lâng nā tiām-tiām mā khòaⁿ-chòe khiáu; i bô khui-chhùi mā sǹg-chòe chhong-bêng.
Ko͘-ta̍k ê lâng tui-kiû ka-kī ê io̍k-bōng, pâi-thek it-chhè chin-sêng ê khoàn-kò.
Gōng-lâng bô ài tì-sek, chí-ū ài tián ka-kī ê ì-kiàn.
Ū siâ-ok chiū ū biáu-sī; ū kiàn-siàu chiū ū lêng-jio̍k.
Lâng chhùi-lāi ê ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhim ê chúi; tì-hūi ê chúi-chôaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ teh lâu ê khoe-chúi.
Phòaⁿ-toàn ê sî phian-thán pháiⁿ-lâng, á-sī oan-óng bû-ko͘ ê lâng, lóng m̄ hó.
Gōng-lâng khui-chhùi ín-khí oan-ke, i chi̍t-ē kóng-ōe chiū jiá-khí sio-phah.
Gōng-lâng ê chhùi hō͘ i bia̍t-bông; i ê chhùi-tûn sī i sìⁿ-miā ê lô-bāng.
Hī-khang piⁿ ê êng-á-ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hó-chia̍h-mi̍h, chi̍t-ē ji̍p-chhùi chiū thun lo̍h-pak.
Bô chiàu-khí-kang kang-chok ê lâng, sī kap phò-hoāi-chiá chòe hiaⁿ-tī.
Siōng Chú sī kian-kò͘ ê pó-lúi; gī-lâng cháu--ji̍p-khì chiū an-ún.
Hó-gia̍h-lâng siūⁿ-kóng châi-hù sī in ê pó-chiong, sī an-choân khó-khò ê koân-chhiûⁿ.
Ū kiau-ngō͘ chiū ū sit-pāi; ū khiam-pi chiū ū chun-êng.
Iáu-bē thiaⁿ-liáu chiū ìn-tap, chiū-sī gû-gōng kap kiàn-siàu.
Lâng ê sim ōe-tàng jím-siū pīⁿ-thiàⁿ; sim-lêng phò-chhùi, bô lâng jím-siū ōe tiâu.
Chhong-bêng-lâng ê sim tit-tio̍h tì-sek; tì-hūi-lâng ê hī-khang chhē-kiû tì-sek.
Lé-mi̍h kā lâng khui-lō͘, ōe chhōa i kàu tōa-jîn-bu̍t ê bīn-chêng.
Seng sin-sò͘--ê ká-ná ū-lí, m̄-kú tùi-hong lâi chiū cha-chhut si̍t-chêng.
Thiu-chhiam ōe hō͘ oan-ke soah, ōe-tàng kái-koat kiông-chiá chi kan ê kiù-hun.
Hō͘ kiat-oan ê hiaⁿ-tī koh hô, pí kong-chhú kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ khah khùn-lân; chit-khoán hun-cheng chhin-chhiūⁿ siâⁿ-mn̂g ê mn̂g-chhòaⁿ chhòaⁿ-tiâu-tiâu.
Lâng tùi kóng-ōe só͘ kiat ê ké-chí, pak-tó͘ tit-tio̍h pá-chiok; lâng tùi chhùi-tûn só͘ siu-sêng--ê tit-tio̍h boán-chiok.
Chhùi-chi̍h ōe-tàng chi-phòe lâng ê siⁿ-sí; ài lī-iōng chit-ê koân ê lâng tio̍h sêng-tam hō͘-kó.
Chhōa-tio̍h hó bó͘ sī hok-khì, sī Siōng Chú ê un-sù.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng khún-chhiat kiû-chêng; hó-gia̍h-lâng pháiⁿ-siaⁿ-sàu ìn-tap.
Ū chin chōe pêng-iú put-kò sī choh-phōaⁿ; ū chi̍t ê ti-kí pí hiaⁿ-tī khah chhin.
Hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t ê sàn-chhiah-lâng khah iâⁿ kóng-ōe khúi-chà ê gōng-lâng.
Jia̍t-sim bô tì-sek m̄ hó; kho̍k-kho̍k-chông tian-tò ōe cháu m̄-tio̍h lō͘.
Lâng in-ūi gû-gōng phò-hoāi ka-kī ê chiân-tô͘; i ê sim tian-tò oàn-thàn Siōng Chú.
Hó-gia̍h, pêng-iú chiū ke chin chōe; sàn-chhiah, pêng-iú chiū lóng lī-khui.
Choh gūi-chèng it-tēng siū hêng-hoa̍t; kóng pe̍h-chha̍t bōe-tàng tô-thoat chek-hoa̍t.
Ū-koân--ê, lâng-lâng kā i phô͘-tháⁿ; khóng-khài--ê, lâng-lâng chòe i ê pêng-iú.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng liân hiaⁿ-tī to iàm-ò͘ⁿ, pêng-iú koh-khah ōe lī-khui i; i jip beh kap lâng kóng-ōe, lâng m̄ chhap i.
Ū tì-hūi chiah ōe-hiáu thiàⁿ-sioh ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā; tin-sioh tì-sek ōe tit-tio̍h hok-khì.
Choh gūi-chèng it-tēng siū hêng-hoa̍t; kóng pe̍h-chha̍t ōe bia̍t-bông.
Gōng-lâng seng-oa̍h chhia-hoa bô ha̍h; po̍k-jîn koán-hat chú-lâng koh-khah bô eng-kai.
Lâng ū kiàn-sek chiū bōe khoài siū-khì; bô tui-kiù lâng ê kè-sit sī ka-kī ê kong-êng.
Ông ê siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ sai tōa-siaⁿ háu; i ê un-hūi chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-téng ê lō͘-chúi.
Kiáⁿ gōng sī lāu-pē ê chai-hō; bó͘ chháu-nāu chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘-chúi chha̍p-chha̍p-tih.
Chhù-the̍h châi-sán sī chó͘-kong só͘ lâu; hiân-hūi ê bó͘ sī Siōng Chú só͘ sù.
Pîn-tōaⁿ hō͘ lâng khùn tāng-bîn; lán-si ê lâng ōe iau-gō.
Chun-siú kài-bēng ōe pó-choân ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā; bô tì-ì Siōng Chú ê lō͘ ōe tì-kàu sí-bông.
Chín-chè sàn-chhiah-lâng sī chioh hō͘ Siōng Chú, Siōng Chú ōe chiàu i ê só͘-chòe hêng i.
Thàn iáu ū ǹg-bāng, tio̍h koán-kàu ka-kī ê kiáⁿ, m̄-kú m̄-thang kè-thâu soah kā i hāi-sí.
Gâu hoat tōa siū-khì ê lâng it-tēng siū chhú-hoa̍t; nā beh kiù i, it-tēng ke liáu-kang.
Tio̍h thiaⁿ khó͘-khǹg siū kà-sī, hō͘ lí kàu-bé ū tì-hūi.
Lâng sim-lāi ū chin chōe kè-ōe, chí-ū Siōng Chú ê chí-ì ōe si̍t-hiān.
Tham-sim hō͘ lâng tì-kàu kiàn-siàu; lêng-khó sàn-chhiah mā bô ài pe̍h-chha̍t.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ōe tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā; i ōe an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p, bōe tú-tio̍h chai-hō.
Pîn-tōaⁿ ê lâng chhiú chhun kàu pôaⁿ--ni̍h, mā m̄-khéng the̍h kàu chhùi.
Phah chū-ko chū-tāi ê lâng, ōe hō͘ gōng-ti̍t ê lâng tit-tio̍h kà-sī; chek-pī bêng-lí ê lâng, ōe hō͘ i tit-tio̍h tì-sek.
Pháiⁿ khoán-thāi lāu-pē, kóaⁿ lāu-bú chhut--khì-ê, chit-khoán kiáⁿ tòa-lâi kiàn-siàu, lâu chhàu-miâ.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, lí nā bô kè-sio̍k thiaⁿ kà-sī, ōe phian-lī tì-sek ê ōe.
Choh gūi-chèng sī teh hì-lāng kong-pêng; pháiⁿ-lâng ēng chōe-ok chòe pn̄g chia̍h.
Hêng-hoa̍t sī ūi-tio̍h chū-ko chū-tāi ê lâng chún-pī; piⁿ-phah sī ūi-tio̍h gōng-lâng ê ka-chiah-phiaⁿ an-pâi.
Po̍h-chiú hō͘ lâng hòng-chhiòng, kāu-chiú hō͘ lâng hoat-kông; in-ūi chiú lâi bê-sit sī bô tì-hūi.
Ông tōa siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ sai tōa-siaⁿ háu; jiá i siū-khì ōe hāi-tio̍h ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.
Pī-bián hun-cheng ê lâng thang chheng-chàn, m̄-kú gōng-lâng ài oan-ke.
Pîn-tōaⁿ ê lâng bô beh chiàu-sî chèng-choh, siu-koah ê sî chhē bô pòaⁿ-hāng.
Lâng sim-lāi ê kè-bô͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ chhim ê chúi, chí-ū bêng-lí ê lâng chiah ōe kā i chhiūⁿ--khí-lâi.
Kóng ka-kī tiong-sêng ê lâng chin chōe, m̄-kú tiong-si̍t ê lâng beh khì tó-ūi chhē?
Chiàu chèng-ti̍t kiâⁿ ê gī-lâng, i ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun chin ū hok-khì!
Ông chē tī sím-phòaⁿ ê ūi, i ê ba̍k-chiu kàm-chhat lóng-chóng ê pháiⁿ.
Siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ kóng “Góa í-keng kiat-chēng góa ê sim, góa ê chōe í-keng chheng-khì”?
Ēng phiⁿ--lâng ê chhìn-thûi, pián--lâng ê táu, lóng sī Siōng Chú só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
Gín-á sī sûn-kiat á-sī chèng-ti̍t, tùi i ê hêng-ûi khòaⁿ ōe chhut.
Ōe thiaⁿ ê hī-khang, ōe khòaⁿ ê ba̍k-chiu, nn̄g hāng lóng sī Siōng Chú só͘ chō.
M̄-thang tham-bîn chiah bián tì-kàu sàn-chhiah; ba̍k-chiu peh hō͘ kim chiah ū kàu-gia̍h ê bí-niû.
Lâng bóe-mi̍h ê sî hiâm kóng “M̄ hó, m̄ hó”, bóe liáu, ka-kī khoa-kháu chin hó.
Sui-jiân ū kim, koh ū chin chōe pó-chio̍h, m̄-kú ū tì-sek ê chhùi-tûn chiah sī tin-pó.
Kā siⁿ-hūn-lâng tam-pó, tio̍h the̍h ka-kī ê saⁿ khì chòe tí-ah; thòe gōa-lâng pó-chèng, tio̍h ka-kī sêng-tam hō͘-kó.
Pián--lâi ê chia̍h-mi̍h chu-bī chin hó, āu-lâi chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ chhùi teh pō͘ soa.
Chham-siông ōe hō͘ kè-ōe sêng-kong; hó ê chhek-lio̍k ōe hō͘ kau-chiàn sèng-lī.
Sì-kòe kóng lâng sī-hui--ê, ōe lāu-sia̍p lâng ê pì-bi̍t; kāu-ōe--ê, m̄-thang kap i kiat-kau.
Chiù-chó͘ pē-bú--ê, i ê sìⁿ-miā ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ teng tī ke̍k o͘-àm ê tiong-kan sit--khì.
Chin kín tit--tio̍h ê châi-hù, kàu-bé bô it-tēng sī chiok-hok.
M̄-thang kóng “Góa beh pò-oan”; tio̍h thèng-hāu Siōng Chú, I ōe kiù lí.
Phiⁿ--lâng ê chhìn-thûi sī Siōng Chú só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ; pián--lâng ê thian-phêng mā m̄ hó.
Lâng kiám ōe chai i ka-kī ê lō͘? Lâng ê kha-pō͘ sī Siōng Chú teh koat-tēng.
M̄-thang sûi-piān kóng “Che sī beh hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè ê mi̍h”, chiah bián hē-goān liáu soah hō͘-hóe.
Tì-hūi ê ông chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng pòa-ki kā pháiⁿ-lâng pòa--chhut-lâi, ēng chhia-lián kā in géng--kè.
Lâng ê sim-lêng sī Siōng Chú ê teng, chhâ-bêng ka-kī ê sim-su ì-liām.
Chû-ài sìn-si̍t pó-hō͘ kok-ông; i ê chō-ūi in-ūi jîn-chû tit-tio̍h pó-choân.
Ióng-kiāⁿ sī siàu-liân-lâng ê êng-kng; pe̍h thâu-mn̂g sī lāu-lâng ê kong-chhái.
Piⁿ-phah ōe tû-khì lâng ê chōe-ok; phah-siong ōe kiat-chēng lâng ê sim-su ì-liām.
Ông ê sim tī Siōng Chú ê chhiú-tiong, chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi-liû chiàu Siōng-tè só͘ tēng ê hong-hiòng teh lâu.
Lâng khòaⁿ ka-kī ê só͘-chòe chòe tio̍h, m̄-kú Siōng Chú sím-cha lâng ê tōng-ki.
Péng-kong-hêng-gī pí hiàn-chè koh-khah ōe tit-tio̍h Siōng Chú chiap-la̍p.
Ba̍k-thâu-koân, sim kiau-ngō͘, sī pháiⁿ-lâng teh hián-iāu ka-kī, lóng sī chōe.
Lâng chim-chiok kè-ōe ōe hù-chiok; chhong-pōng chòe tāi-chì it-tēng tì-kàu khiàm-kheh.
Lâng ēng khúi-chà tit--tio̍h ê châi-lī, chhin-chhiūⁿ phû-hûn chin kín chiū siau-sit.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê kiông-pō ōe hāi-sí ka-kī, in-ūi in m̄-khéng si̍t-hêng kong-gī.
Chōe-jîn ê lō͘ oan-khiau; sûn-kiat ê lâng hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t.
Lêng-khó tiàm chhù-téng ê kak-thâu, mā m̄ kap chháu-nāu ê hū-jîn-lâng chòe-hé tòa tōa keng chhù.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ê sim ì-ài siâ-ok, chhù-piⁿ tit bōe tio̍h i ê koan-ài.
Chū-ko chū-tāi ê lâng siū hêng-hoa̍t, gōng-ti̍t ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h tì-hūi; tì-hūi ê lâng siū kà-sī, in ōe tit-tio̍h tì-sek.
Kong-gī ê Siōng-tè kàm-chhat pháiⁿ-lâng ê ke, kā pháiⁿ-lâng chhia-tó kàu bia̍t-bông.
That-ba̍t hī-khang m̄ thiaⁿ sàn-chhiah-lâng ai-kiû--ê, i chiong-lâi kiû-kiò mā bô lâng beh chhap i.
Àm-tiong sàng-lé ōe soah siū-khì; pì-bi̍t hóe-lō͘ ōe soah tōa siū-khì.
Péng-kong-hêng-gī hō͘ hó-lâng hoaⁿ-hí, khiok hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Phian-lī bêng-lí ê lō͘ ê lâng, ōe kap im-hûn chòe-hé tòa.
Ài chhia-chhí--ê ōe sàn-chhiah; ài iàn-lo̍k--ê bōe hó-gia̍h.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ōe chòe gī-lâng sio̍k-hôe ê kè-chîⁿ; kan-chà ê lâng ōe chòe chèng-ti̍t-lâng ê thòe-sin.
Lêng-khó tiàm khòng-iá, mā m̄ kap chháu-nāu pháiⁿ sèng-tē ê hū-jîn-lâng chòe-hé tòa.
Tì-hūi ê lâng chhù-lāi chek-chū kùi-khì ê mi̍h; gōng-lâng chin kín chiū sńg-liáu-liáu.
Tui-chhē kong-gī kap jîn-chû, ōe chhē-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā, hoân-êng, kap chun-êng.
Tì-hūi ê lâng peh-chiūⁿ ióng-sū ê siâⁿ, thiah-húi in só͘ óa-khò ê pó-lúi.
Iok-sok chhùi kap chi̍h--ê, ōe pó-siú ka-kī bián siū chai-hāi.
Kiau-ngō͘ chū-ko ê lâng, miâ kiò-chòe bú-bān; i chòe tāi-chì chhiong-kông.
Pîn-tōaⁿ ê lâng ōe hō͘ ka-kī ê io̍k-bōng hāi-sí, in-ūi i ê chhiú m̄-khéng chòe kang.
Ū lâng kui-ji̍t tham-sim put-ti-chiok; gī-lâng khóng-khài si-sià.
Pháiⁿ-lâng hiàn ê chè thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ, hô-hòng i chûn pháiⁿ ì-sù lâi hiàn.
Choh gūi-chèng ê lâng ōe bia̍t-bông; chiàu-si̍t choh-chèng--ê, bô lâng ōe-tàng kā i piān-tó.
Pháiⁿ-lâng bīn-phê kāu; chèng-ti̍t ê lâng kiâⁿ-ta̍h kín-sīn.
Lâng ê tì-hūi, chhong-bêng, kap só͘-ū ê chhek-lio̍k lóng bōe-tàng tùi-khòng Siōng Chú.
Bé sī ūi-tio̍h kau-chiàn ê ji̍t chún-pī; m̄-kú sèng-lī sī Siōng Chú teh koat-tēng.
Miâ-siaⁿ pí tōa châi-hù khah thang ì-ài; un-hūi pí kim-gûn khah thang him-siān.
Hó-gia̍h-lâng kap sàn-chhiah-lâng ū kiōng-tông ê só͘-chāi, in lóng sī Siōng Chú só͘ chhòng-chō.
Ōe piàn-khiàu ê lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h gûi-hiám chiū siám-pī; gōng-ti̍t ê lâng ti̍t-ti̍t chìn-chêng khì, siū chai-hāi.
Khiam-pi kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, chiū ū châi-hù, chun-êng, sìⁿ-miā.
Gâu oai-khiok sī-hui ê lâng kiâⁿ ê lō͘ ū chhì-phè kap lô-bāng; pó-sioh ka-kī sìⁿ-miā ê lâng lī-khui hit-tiâu lō͘ chin hn̄g.
Kàu-tō gín-á kiâⁿ ha̍p-gî ê lō͘, i kàu lāu lóng bōe oai-chhoa̍h.
Hó-gia̍h-lâng koán-hat sàn-chhiah-lâng; khiàm-chè--ê chòe chè-chú ê lô͘-châi.
Iā put-gī chéng-chí ê lâng ōe siu chai-hō; i khi-ap lâng ê sè-le̍k ōe siū húi-bia̍t.
Hó-sim ê lâng ū hok-khì, in-ūi i chiong bí-niû pun hō͘ sàn-chhiah-lâng.
Kóaⁿ-chhut chū-ko chū-tāi ê lâng, saⁿ-chiⁿ chiū bô--khì, oan-ke kap bú-jio̍k mā ōe soah.
Sim chheng-khì, kóng-ōe un-hô ê lâng, ông ōe chòe in ê pêng-iú.
Siōng Chú ê ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ-kò͘ chhong-bêng ê lâng, m̄-kú I phò-hoāi kan-chà ê lâng ê giân-lūn.
Pîn-tōaⁿ-lâng kóng, “Gōa-kháu ū sai, góa nā chhut--khì ōe hō͘ i kā-sí.”
Îm-hū ê chhùi sī Chhim-khiⁿ; Siōng Chú só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê lâng ōe poa̍h-lo̍h hit lāi-bīn.
Gín-á ê sim hō͘ gû-gōng tîⁿ--teh, koán-kàu ê chhê-á ōe kā gû-gōng kóaⁿ-cháu.
Khò pak-siah sàn-chhiah-lâng lâi hó-gia̍h, á-sī sàng lé-mi̍h hō͘ hó-gia̍h-lâng, lóng ōe tì-kàu khiàm-kheh.
Tio̍h àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ tì-hūi ê lâng ê ōe, choan-sim niá-siū góa ê kà-sī;
siōng-hó sī khǹg tī lí ê sim-tóe, put-sî thang èng-iōng.
Góa kin-á-ji̍t án-ni chí-sī lí, sī beh hō͘ lí óa-khò Siōng Chú.
Chit saⁿ-cha̍p kù kàu-tō kap tì-sek ê ōe, góa í-keng ū siá hō͘ lí,
hō͘ lí chai chiah-ê chin-lí ê ōe khak-si̍t ōe-khò--tit, thang chèng-khak hôe-tap chhe-phài lí ê lâng.
M̄-thang in-ūi lâng sàn-chhiah kā in pak-siah; mā m̄-thang tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu khi-ap khùn-khó͘-lâng,
in-ūi Siōng Chú ōe thòe in sin-oan; chhiúⁿ-toa̍t in--ê, Siōng Chú ōe chhiúⁿ-toa̍t hiah-ê lâng ê sìⁿ-miā.
Khoài siū-khì ê lâng, m̄-thang kap in kau-pôe; pháiⁿ sèng-tē ê lâng, m̄-thang kap in óng-lâi;
kiaⁿ-liáu lí o̍h in ê hêng-ûi, ka-kī soah hām-lo̍h lô-bāng.
M̄-thang kā lâng chòe tam-pó, m̄-thang kā khiàm-chîⁿ ê lâng pó-chèng.
Lí nā bōe-tàng hêng, lâng ōe kā lí teh khùn ê bîn-chhn̂g giâ--khì.
Chá-chêng lí ê chó͘-kong só͘ li̍p ê tōe-kài, m̄-thang î-sóa.
Lí bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h gâu pān tāi-chì ê lâng--bô? I bōe ho̍k-sāi phó͘-thong-lâng, ōe ho̍k-sāi kun-ông.
Lí nā kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ chē-toh, tio̍h chù-ì tī lí bīn-chêng--ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng.
Lí ūi-kháu nā hó, tio̍h ōe-hiáu ka-kī iok-sok.
M̄-thang tham mi̍h-kiāⁿ hó-chia̍h, in-ūi he sī teh pián--lâng ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
M̄-thang thoa-bôa kiû hó-gia̍h, tio̍h ū tì-hūi ka-kī iok-sok.
Lí ba̍k-chi̍t-ē-nih, chîⁿ-châi chiū bô--khì, in-ūi i ōe hoat-si̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu pe-chiūⁿ thiⁿ.
M̄-thang chia̍h tàng-sng ê lâng ê pn̄g, mā m̄-thang tham i ê hó chia̍h-mi̍h.
I chin gâu sǹg, bōe hō͘ lí pe̍h-pe̍h-chia̍h. I sui-jiân tùi lí kóng “Chhiáⁿ chia̍h, chhiáⁿ lim”, kî-si̍t i sim-lāi bô teh án-ni siūⁿ.
Lí só͘ chia̍h hit-tiám-á mā tio̍h thò͘--chhut-lâi; lí só͘ kóng ê hó-ōe lóng bô lō͘-ēng.
M̄-thang kóng-ōe hō͘ gōng-lâng thiaⁿ, i ōe khòaⁿ-khin lí tì-hūi ê ōe.
M̄-thang î-sóa chá-chêng só͘ li̍p ê tōe-kài, mā m̄-thang chhim-chiàm ko͘-jî ê chhân-hn̂g.
In-ūi in ê Sio̍k-hôe-chiá Siōng Chú tōa ū lêng-le̍k, I ōe thòe in sin-oan.
Tio̍h choan-sim niá-siū kà-sī, àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ tì-sek ê ōe.
Gín-á m̄-thang bô koán-kàu; ēng chhê-á phah, bōe tì-kàu sí.
Lí ēng chhê-á phah, ōe kiù i bián lo̍h Im-hú.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, lí ê sim nā ū tì-hūi, góa ê sim ōe chin hoaⁿ-hí.
Lí ê chhùi nā kóng chèng-ti̍t, góa ê sim ōe chin khoài-lo̍k.
M̄-thang him-siān pháiⁿ-lâng, tio̍h put-sî kèng-ùi Siōng Chú,
chiong-lâi it-tēng ū ǹg-bāng, lí ê ǹg-bāng bōe bô--khì.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ, tio̍h ū tì-hūi, hō͘ lí ê sim ǹg chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘.
Hò͘ⁿ-chiú--ê, tham-chia̍h--ê, m̄-thang kap in óng-lâi chòe-tīn,
in-ūi hò͘ⁿ-chiú tham-chia̍h, ōe tì-kàu sàn-chhiah; kui-ji̍t teh khùn, ōe tì-kàu chhēng phòa-saⁿ.
Tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn siⁿ lí ê lāu-pē; lí ê lāu-bú lāu ê sî mā m̄-thang kā i khòaⁿ-khin.
Tio̍h bóe chin-lí, m̄-thang bōe; mā tio̍h bóe tì-hūi, kà-sī, kap bêng-lí.
Chèng-ti̍t-lâng ê lāu-pē ōe tōa khoài-lo̍k; lâng siⁿ-tio̍h tì-hūi ê kiáⁿ ōe in-ūi i tōa hoaⁿ-hí.
Tio̍h hō͘ lí ê pē-bú hoaⁿ-hí, hō͘ siⁿ lí ê lāu-bú khoài-lo̍k.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h chiong lí ê sim kau-thok góa, ba̍k-chiu tio̍h chù-ì khòaⁿ góa ê tō-lō͘.
In-ūi chhiong-ki sī Chhim-khiⁿ, îm-hū sī hām-chíⁿ.
I chhin-chhiūⁿ chha̍t teh tng-tán, beh hō͘ bô tiong-si̍t ê lâng cheng-ka.
Siáⁿ-lâng teh hoah “chhám ah”? Siáⁿ-lâng teh hoah “hāi ah”? Siáⁿ-lâng teh oan-ke? Siáⁿ-lâng teh oàn-thàn? Siáⁿ-lâng bô iân-kò͘ siū siong? Siáⁿ-lâng ba̍k-chiu teh khí ian-n̄g?
Chiū-sī lim-chiú m̄-chai soah, sì-kòe chhē tiâu-hô ê chiú lim hit-khoán lâng.
Chiú tī poe-lāi pìⁿ âng siám-sih, lí m̄-thang khòaⁿ; lim ê sî ku̍t-âu, kàu-bé chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ chôa kā--tio̍h, hō͘ to̍k-chôa tok--tio̍h.
Lí ê ba̍k-chiu ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h kî-koài ê kéng-siōng; lí ê sim ōe chhò-loān, chhùi kóng chiú-ōe.
Lí ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ tó tī hái-tiong, khùn tī chûn-thiāu-téng.
Lí ōe kóng, “Lâng phah góa, góa bōe thiàⁿ; lâng kòng góa, góa m̄-chai thiàⁿ; góa chhíⁿ--khí-lâi chiū koh khì chhē chiú lim.”
M̄-thang him-siān pháiⁿ-lâng, mā m̄-thang ài kap in chòe-tui,
in-ūi in ê sim kè-ōe kiông-pō ê tāi-chì, in ê chhùi tâm-lūn hāi-lâng ê sū.
Chhù khò tì-hūi khí-chō, ēng chhong-bêng kiàn-li̍p;
ū tì-sek ê lâng ê pâng-keng chhiong-móa ta̍k-hāng pó-pòe kap kùi-tiōng ê châi-bu̍t.
Ū tì-hūi ê lâng ū tōa lêng-le̍k; ū tì-sek ê lâng ke-thiⁿ khùi-la̍t.
Beh kau-chiàn tio̍h ū hó ê chhek-lio̍k; chham-bô͘ chōe chiū ōe tek-sèng.
Tì-hūi ko-chhim, gōng-lâng bōe liáu-kái; tī kong-kiōng chi̍p-hōe tiong i bô ōe thang kóng.
Kè-bô͘ chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng ōe hō͘ lâng kiò-chòe im-bô͘-ka.
Gōng-lâng ê kè-bô͘ lóng sī chōe-ok; biáu-sī lâng--ê, lâng-lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
Tī hoān-lān ê ji̍t sit-táⁿ, khùi-la̍t chiū kiám-chió.
Lâng siū thoa kàu sí-tōe, tio̍h kā i kái-kiù; lâng teh-beh siū thâi, m̄-thang bô kiù i.

Lí nā kóng “Chit-ê tāi-chì góa m̄ chai”, kàm-chhat lâng ê sim ê Siōng-tè kiám bōe sím-phòaⁿ? Pó-choân lí sìⁿ-miā--ê kiám ōe m̄ chai? I kiám bōe chiàu ta̍k-lâng ê só͘-chòe pò-èng?
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h chia̍h bi̍t, in-ūi bi̍t sī hó; chia̍h bi̍t-pô͘ tih--lo̍h-lâi ê bi̍t chiū chai tiⁿ.
Tio̍h chai, tì-hūi tī lí ê sim mā-sī án-ni; lí nā chhē--tio̍h, chiân-tô͘ chiū kng-bêng, ǹg-bāng bōe bô--khì.
M̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ pháiⁿ-lâng bâi-ho̍k beh kong-kek gī-lâng ê ke; m̄-thang phò-hoāi i tòa ê chhù.
Gī-lâng poa̍h-tó chhit piàn mā ōe koh khí--lâi; pháiⁿ-lâng chi̍t-ē tú-tio̍h chai-lān chiū tó--lo̍h-khì.
Lí ê tùi-te̍k poa̍h-tó, m̄-thang hoaⁿ-hí; i tó--lo̍h-khì, lí ê sim mā m̄-thang khoài-lo̍k,
chiah bián Siōng Chú khòaⁿ--kìⁿ bô hoaⁿ-hí, soah hō͘ I ê siū-khì bô lîm-kàu lí ê tùi-te̍k.
M̄-thang in-ūi chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng sim-lāi put-pêng, mā m̄-thang him-siān pháiⁿ-lâng,
in-ūi pháiⁿ-lâng bô hó kiat-kio̍k, in ê teng ōe sit--khì.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng Chú kap kun-ông, m̄-thang kap hoán-poān ê lâng kau-kiat,
in-ūi húi-bia̍t ōe tùi Siōng Chú kap kun-ông hut-jiân lîm-kàu lín, in beh kàng-lo̍h ê chai-lān siáⁿ-lâng ōe chai?
Ē-bīn só͘ kì mā-sī tì-hūi ê lâng ê ōe: Sím-phòaⁿ ê sî m̄-thang ū phian-sim.
Kā ū-chōe ê lâng phòaⁿ bô-chōe, ōe siū chèng-lâng chiù-chó͘, lâng-lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
Kā pháiⁿ-lâng phòaⁿ ū-chōe, ōe tit-tio̍h chèng-lâng hoaⁿ-hí; i ōe tōa-tōa siū chiok-hok.
Ēng kong-chèng ê ōe ìn-tap, piáu-sī chin-sêng ê iú-gî.
Gōa-bīn ê tāi-chì chún-pī hó-sè, chhân-hn̂g hó-hó chèng-choh, chiah lâi khí-chhù, sêng-ka-li̍p-gia̍p.
M̄-thang ēng bô kun-kù ê kiàn-chèng hām-hāi chhù-piⁿ; m̄-thang choh gūi-chèng khi-phiàn lâng.
M̄-thang kóng, “I án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi góa, góa mā beh án-ni tùi-thāi i; góa beh chiàu hit-ê lâng ê só͘-chòe kā i pò-ho̍k.”
Góa keng-kè pîn-tōaⁿ-lâng ê chhân-hn̂g, bô tì-sek ê lâng ê phû-tô-hn̂g,
khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chhì-phè hoat kah móa-móa-sī, chháu-chhì jia-khàm tōe-bīn, chio̍h-chhiûⁿ mā tó--lo̍h-khì.
Góa khòaⁿ--kìⁿ chiū chhim-chhim siūⁿ, khòaⁿ-liáu tit-tio̍h kà-sī.
Koh khùn chi̍t-kú-á, koh bîn chi̍t-sî-á, koh the chi̍t-ē-á,
sàn-chhiah chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ chha̍t lâi, khiàm-kheh chhin-chhiūⁿ kiông-tō kàu.
Ē-bīn mā-sī Só͘-lô-bûn ê chim-giân, sī Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka kiong-têng ê lâng chhau-siá--ê.
Lâng chun-chông Siōng-tè, in-ūi I chiong tāi-chì khàm-ba̍t; lâng chun-kèng kun-ông, in-ūi i chiong tāi-chì chhâ-bêng.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ hiah-ni̍h koân, tōe hiah-ni̍h chhim, ông ê sim, lâng oh-tit liáu-kái.
Gûn ê che-tái seng tû--khì, gûn-chhiūⁿ chiah ōe-tàng chòe-chhut súi ê khì-khū;
ông sin-piⁿ ê pháiⁿ-lâng seng tû--khì, ông-ūi chiah ōe-tàng ēng kong-gī chòe ki-chhó͘ kiàn-li̍p.
M̄-thang tī ông ê bīn-chêng chū-ko chū-tāi, mā m̄-thang chiàm tōa-ūi.
Lêng-khó tán lâng chhiáⁿ lí chē tōa-ūi, m̄-thang tī ū tōe-ūi ê lâng bīn-chêng hō͘ lâng kiò lí lo̍h--khì.
M̄-thang chhong-pōng beh kap lâng sio-kò, chiah bián kàu-bé siū chhù-piⁿ lêng-jio̍k ê sî m̄ chai beh án-chóaⁿ chòe.
Lí kap chhù-piⁿ ū kiù-hun, m̄-thang lāu-sia̍p pa̍t-lâng ê pì-bi̍t,
chiah bián thiaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng chek-pī lí, lí ê chhàu-miâ oh-tit sóe-chheng.
Kóng-ōe ha̍p-gî, chhin-chhiūⁿ kim phōng-kó siuⁿ tī gûn-pôaⁿ.
Tì-hūi ê lâng ê chek-pī, tùi hoaⁿ-hí thiaⁿ-siū ê lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ kim ê hī-kau kap sûn-kim ê phoa̍h-liān.
Khó-khò ê sù-chiá hō͘ chhe i ê chú-lâng cheng-sîn khin-sang, chhin-chhiūⁿ joa̍h-thiⁿ siu-koah ê sî ū sng-seh ê liâng-léng.
Bô sàng lé-mi̍h, kan-ta khoa-kháu lé-mi̍h jōa hó, chhin-chhiūⁿ ū hong ū hûn, bô lo̍h-hō͘.
Kú-tn̂g jím-nāi, koân-le̍k-chiá mā ōe siū kám-tōng; un-jiû ê chhùi-chi̍h ōe kòng-tn̄g kut-thâu.
Lí nā chhē-tio̍h bi̍t, chia̍h kàu-gia̍h chiū hó, chiah bián chia̍h kè-thâu soah thò͘--chhut-lâi.
M̄-thang chia̍p-chia̍p khì chhē chhù-piⁿ, chiah bián i khí-hoân soah iàm-ò͘ⁿ lí.
Choh gūi-chèng hām-hāi chhù-piⁿ ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ thûi, to, kap lāi-chìⁿ ōe siong-hāi lâng.
Hoān-lān ê sî sìn-nāi khò-put-chū ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhùi-khí tn̄g--khì, kha thu̍t-lûn.
Tùi siong-sim ê lâng chhiùⁿ-koa, chhin-chhiūⁿ tang-thiⁿ kā i thǹg gōa-saⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ iâm iā tī khang-chhùi.
Lí ê tùi-te̍k nā iau, tio̍h hō͘ i chia̍h, chhùi-ta, tio̍h hō͘ i lim;
in-ūi lí án-ni chòe, ná-chún chiong teh to̍h ê hé-thòaⁿ thia̍p tī i ê thâu-khak téng, hō͘ i bīn âng chai thang kiàn-siàu; Siōng Chú mā ōe pò-siúⁿ lí.
Pak-hong thàu chiū lo̍h-hō͘; húi-pòng ê chi̍h ōe jiá lâng pìⁿ-bīn.
Lêng-khó tiàm chhù-téng ê kak-thâu, mā m̄ kap chháu-nāu ê hū-jîn-lâng chòe-hé tòa tōa keng chhù.
Thiaⁿ-tio̍h hó siau-sit tùi hn̄g-hn̄g lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ ià-siān chhùi-ta ê lâng lim-tio̍h liâng-chúi.
Gī-lâng tī pháiⁿ-lâng ê bīn-chêng khut-ho̍k, chhin-chhiūⁿ phah lâ-sâm ê chíⁿ, thún lô--khì ê chúi-chôaⁿ.
Bi̍t chia̍h siuⁿ chōe m̄ hó; lâng kè-thâu kiû ka-kī ê êng-kng mā m̄ hó.
Bōe-hiáu khòng-chè ka-kī ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ bô chhiûⁿ ê siâⁿ chin kín siū kong-phòa.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ joa̍h-thiⁿ lo̍h-seh, siu-koah ê sî lo̍h-hō͘, gōng-lâng tit-tio̍h chun-êng, bô ha̍p-gî.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ chhek-chiáu-á pe-khí-pe-lo̍h, ìⁿ-á pe-lâi-pe-khì, bô-lí-bô-iû ê chiù-chó͘ bōe hoat-seng chok-iōng.
Tùi bé tio̍h ēng piⁿ, tùi lû tio̍h ēng kā-kiuⁿ; gōng-lâng ê ka-chiah tio̍h ēng tîn-tiâu.
M̄-thang chiàu gōng-lâng ê gōng-ōe ìn i, chiah bián lí kap i kâng-khoán.
Tio̍h chiàu gōng-lâng ê gōng-ōe ìn i, chiah bián i khòaⁿ ka-kī chòe ū tì-sek.
Thok gōng-lâng thoân-ta̍t siau-sit, chhin-chhiūⁿ chām-tn̄g ka-kī ê kha, siong-hāi ka-kī.
Chim-giân tī gōng-lâng ê chhùi, chhin-chhiūⁿ khê--khì ê kha bô chok-iōng.
Chiong chun-êng hō͘ gōng-lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng pó-chio̍h chòe chio̍h-thâu khǹg tī hìⁿ-soh hìⁿ.
Gōng-lâng ê chhùi kóng chim-giân, chhin-chhiūⁿ chùi-hàn gia̍h ū chhì ê chhiū-ki loān sut.
Chhiàⁿ gōng-lâng á-sī chùi-hàn chòe tāi-chì, chhin-chhiūⁿ chìⁿ loān siā siong-tio̍h lâng.
Gōng-lâng it-chài chòe gû-gōng ê sū, chhin-chhiūⁿ káu oa̍t tńg-lâi chia̍h ka-kī thò͘--chhut-lâi ê mi̍h.
Lí bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī sī chhong-bêng ê lâng bô? Liân gōng-lâng to pí i khah ū ǹg-bāng.
Pîn-tōaⁿ ê lâng kóng, “Lō͘--ni̍h ū sai, koe-lō͘--ni̍h ū béng-sai.”
Pîn-tōaⁿ-lâng tī bîn-chhn̂g kō-lâi-kō-khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ mn̂g khui-lâi-khui-khì.
Pîn-tōaⁿ ê lâng chhiú chhun kàu pôaⁿ--ni̍h, the̍h kàu chhùi mā hiâm hùi-khì.
Pîn-tōaⁿ-lâng khòaⁿ ka-kī chin khiáu, iâⁿ-kè chhit ê gâu ìn-tap ê lâng.
Kè-lō͘-lâng khì chhap kap i bô koan-hē ê kiù-hun, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng khì khiú káu-á ê hī-á.
Lâng khi-phiàn chhù-piⁿ, kóng, “Góa sī teh kún-chhiò”, sī chhin-chhiūⁿ siáu-lâng hiat hé-pé, lāi-chìⁿ, kap bú-khì hō͘ lâng sí.
Hé bô chhâ chiū hoa--khì; bô lâng o̍h-ōe, saⁿ-chiⁿ chiū soah--khì.
Ài saⁿ-chiⁿ ê lâng siàn-tōng hun-cheng, chhin-chhiūⁿ thòaⁿ-siōng-ka-thòaⁿ, hé-siōng-thiam-chhâ.
Hī-khang piⁿ ê êng-á-ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hó-chia̍h-mi̍h, chi̍t-ē ji̍p-chhùi chiū thun-lo̍h pak.
Chhùi tiⁿ, sim kan-ok, chhin-chhiūⁿ hûi-khì chhat chho͘-gûn.
Ké-hó ê lâng kóng hó-thiaⁿ-ōe, sim-lāi khiok chûn khúi-chà.
I kóng hó-thiaⁿ-ōe, lí m̄-thang sìn, in-ūi i sim-lāi ū chhit hāng thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
I sui-jiân ēng khúi-chà am-khàm ka-kī ê oàn-hūn, i ê siâ-ok ōe lō͘-hiān tī kong-chiòng bīn-chêng.
Ku̍t hām-chíⁿ ê lâng, ka-kī ōe poa̍h-lo̍h hit lāi-bīn; kō chio̍h-thâu ê lâng, chio̍h-thâu ōe kō tò-tńg-lâi teh-tio̍h ka-kī.
Pe̍h-chha̍t ê chi̍h ōe siong-hāi lâng; phô͘-tháⁿ ê chhùi ōe húi-bia̍t lâng.
M̄-thang ūi-tio̍h bîn-á-chài beh chòe ê sū khoa-kháu, in-ūi bîn-á-chài ōe hoat-seng sím-mi̍h tāi-chì lí m̄ chai.
Tio̍h hō͘ pa̍t-lâng o-ló, m̄-thang ka-kī po; tio̍h hō͘ gōa-lâng chheng-chàn lí, m̄-thang ka-kī khoa-kháu.
Chio̍h-thâu tāng, soa mā tāng; gōng-lâng jiá-khí ê hō-toan pí chit nn̄g hāng koh-khah giâm-tiōng.
Siū-khì iáu ōe-tàng tng, tōa siū-khì oh tam-tng, oàn-tò͘, siáⁿ-lâng tòng ōe tiâu?
Tng-bīn ê chek-pī, iâⁿ-kè bô piáu-bêng ê thiàⁿ.
Pêng-iú chō-sêng ê siong sī chhut tī hó-ì; tùi-te̍k ê chim-chhùi sī hu-ké.
Lâng chia̍h pá, liân bi̍t to thó-ià; pak-tó͘ iau, liân khó͘ ê mi̍h to hó-chia̍h.
Lâng lī-khui pún só͘-chāi khì liû-lōng, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiáu-á lī-khui siū sì-kòe pe.
Phang-iû kap hiuⁿ-liāu hō͘ lâng ê sim hoaⁿ-hí; pêng-iú chin-sêng ê khoàn-bián hō͘ sim tit-tio̍h kó͘-lē.
Lí ê pêng-iú kap lāu-pē ê pêng-iú lóng m̄-thang pàng-sak; tú-tio̍h hoān-lān ê ji̍t m̄-thang khì hiaⁿ-tī ê ke; kūn ê chhù-piⁿ iâⁿ-kè hn̄g ê hiaⁿ-tī.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h ū tì-hūi, hō͘ góa ê sim hoaⁿ-hí, hō͘ góa thang hoán-pok thí-chhiò góa ê lâng.
Ōe piàn-khiàu ê lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h gûi-hiám chiū siám-pī; gōng-ti̍t ê lâng chìn-chêng khì, siū chai-hāi.
Kā siⁿ-hūn-lâng tam-pó, tio̍h the̍h ka-kī ê saⁿ khì chòe tí-ah; thòe gōa-lâng pó-chèng tio̍h ka-kī sêng-tam hō͘-kó.
Thàu-chá kā pêng-iú chhá-chhíⁿ, chiok-hok mā pìⁿ-chòe chiù-chó͘.
Chháu-nāu ê bó͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍h-hō͘-thiⁿ chha̍p-chha̍p-tih;
beh kā i tòng, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh tòng hong tòng bōe tiâu, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiú la̍k iû la̍k bōe tiâu.
Pêng-iú hō͘-siōng kek-lē, chhin-chhiūⁿ thih bôa thih, jú bôa jú lāi.
Koán-lí bû-hoa-kó-chhiū--ê, thang chia̍h i ê ké-chí; chiàu-kò͘ chú-lâng--ê, ōe tit-tio̍h chun-êng.
Lâng tùi chúi chiò-chhut ka-kī ê bīn; lâng tùi sim khòaⁿ-chhut ka-kī ê chin-siōng.
Im-hú kap Bia̍t-bông lóng thūn bōe móa; lâng ê io̍k-bōng mā éng-oán bōe boán-chiok.
Liān gûn ēng tiáⁿ, liān kim ēng lô͘; lâng tùi chheng-chàn siū khó-giām.
Gōng-lâng án-chóaⁿ kà to kà bōe khiáu.
Tio̍h siông-sè chai lí iûⁿ-kûn ê chōng-hóng, liû-sim chiàu-kò͘ lí ê gû-kûn;
in-ūi chîⁿ-châi bōe éng-oán lâu--teh, ông-ūi mā bōe sòa kàu bān-tāi.
Chháu koah--khí-lâi, sin-íⁿ puh--chhut-lâi, soaⁿ-téng ê bo̍k-chháu mā siu--khí-lâi,
mî-iûⁿ ê mn̂g chiū thang chián khí-lâi chòe saⁿ, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng thang bōe lâi bóe chhân-hn̂g,
soaⁿ-iûⁿ-bú ê lin hō͘ lí kap ke-lāi ê lâng kàu-gia̍h thang chia̍h, koh thang iúⁿ-chhī lú-pī.
Pháiⁿ-lâng bô lâng tui-jip mā teh tô-cháu; hó-lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ sai lóng bōe kiaⁿ.
Kok-ka tōng-loān, thóng-tī-chiá chiū chia̍p-chia̍p ōaⁿ; ū bêng-lí kap tì-sek ê léng-siù, kok-ka chiū kú-tn̂g an-tēng.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng khi-ap khùn-khó͘-lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍h tōa-hō͘ kā ngó͘-kok chhiong-tiāu.
Khì-sak lu̍t-hoat--ê o-ló pháiⁿ-lâng, m̄-kú chun-siú lu̍t-hoat--ê hoán-tùi pháiⁿ-lâng.
Siâ-ok ê lâng bô bêng-pe̍k kong-gī; chhē-kiû Siōng Chú ê lâng oân-choân bêng-pe̍k.
Hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t ê sàn-chhiah-lâng khah iâⁿ chòe tāi-chì oan-khiau ê hó-gia̍h-lâng.
Kín-sīn siú lu̍t-hoat--ê, sī tì-hūi ê kiáⁿ; kap tham-chia̍h--ê choh-phōaⁿ, hō͘ pē-bú kiàn-siàu.
Lâng khò pàng tāng-lī hoat-châi, sī teh kā lîn-bín sàn-chhiah-lâng--ê chek-chū châi-hù.
Hī-khang oa̍t-cháu m̄ thiaⁿ lu̍t-hoat ê lâng, i ê kî-tó Siōng-tè iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
Bê-he̍k chèng-ti̍t-lâng kiâⁿ pháiⁿ-lō͘, ōe poa̍h lo̍h-khì ka-kī ó͘ ê hām-khiⁿ, m̄-kú sûn-choân ê lâng ōe sêng-chiap hó ê sán-gia̍p.
Hó-gia̍h-lâng khòaⁿ ka-kī chòe ū tì-hūi, m̄-kú i ū kúi niú tāng, chhong-bêng ê sàn-chhiah-lâng khòaⁿ kah chin chheng-chhó.
Gī-lâng sèng-lī, lâng-lâng khèng-chiok; pháiⁿ-lâng tek-chì, lâng-lâng siám-bih.
Jia-khàm ka-kī ê chōe-kò, it-tēng bōe heng-thong; jīn-chōe hóe-kái, it-tēng tit-tio̍h lîn-bín.
Put-sî kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng chin ū hok-khì! Ngī-sim ê lâng ōe tú-tio̍h chai-hō.
Tú chhin-chhiūⁿ hm̄-hm̄-háu ê sai kap chhē-chia̍h ê hîm, siâ-ok ê thóng-tī-chiá mā án-ni teh koán-hat sàn-chhiah ê jîn-bîn.
Bû-ti ê thóng-tī-chiá si-hêng pō-chèng; iàm-ò͘ⁿ put-gī-chi-châi ê lâng ōe tn̂g-hè-siū.
Thâi-sí-lâng--ê tio̍h hō͘ i it-seng chòe tô-hoān, m̄-thang kiù i.
Chòe tāi-chì chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ōe an-choân; chòe tāi-chì oan-khiau ê lâng ōe hut-jiân poa̍h-tó sit-pāi.
Chèng-choh ê lâng ū kàu-gia̍h ê bí-niû; tui-kiû khang-khang bô kè-ta̍t ê sū ōe tì-kàu sàn-chhiah.
Ū sìn-iōng ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h chin chōe hok-khì; beh hoat hoâiⁿ-châi ê lâng it-tēng siū hêng-hoa̍t.
Khòaⁿ lâng tōa-sòe-ba̍k, m̄-tio̍h, m̄-kú lâng ōe ūi-tio̍h chi̍t-tè-á piáⁿ hoān-hoat.
Tàng-sng ê lâng siūⁿ-beh kín hoat-châi, bô siūⁿ-kóng sàn-chhiah teh thèng-hāu i.
Kā lâng chek-pī, kàu-bé pí kā lâng phô͘-tháⁿ khah ōe tit-tio̍h lâng hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p.
Thau-the̍h pē-bú ê mi̍h, koh kóng “Che bô sǹg ū-chōe”, chit-khoán lâng kap kiông-tō siâng-lūi.
Tham-sim ōe ín-khí saⁿ-chiⁿ; óa-khò Siōng Chú ōe tit-tio̍h hong-sēng.
Siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī sī chhong-bêng--ê sī gōng-lâng; chiàu tì-hūi chòe tāi-chì ê lâng ōe an-choân.
Chín-chè sàn-chhiah-lâng bōe tì-kàu khiàm-kheh; ké bô khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ōe siū chin chōe chiù-chó͘.
Pháiⁿ-lâng tek-chì, lâng-lâng cháu-khì bih; in nā bia̍t-bông, gī-lâng chiū ke-thiⁿ chin chōe.
Lâng siū chek-hoa̍t iáu m̄-khéng hóe-kái, ōe hut-jiân sit-pāi bia̍t-bông, bōe hù kā kiù.
Gī-lâng chip-chèng, jîn-bîn hoaⁿ-hí; pháiⁿ-lâng chiáng-koân, jîn-bîn thó͘-khùi.
Ì-ài tì-hūi, pē-bú hoaⁿ-hí; kiat-kau ki-lú, kheng-ka-tōng-sán.
Ông si-hêng kong-gī, kok chiū ún-kò͘; kiông siu hóe-lō͘, kok chiū bia̍t-bông.
Phô͘-tháⁿ chhù-piⁿ, sī teh siat lô-bāng tîⁿ ka-kī ê kha.
Pháiⁿ-lâng ōe hō͘ ka-kī ê chōe tîⁿ--tio̍h; m̄-kú gī-lâng ū hoan-ho͘ ū khoài-lo̍k.
Gī-lâng koan-sim sàn-chhiah-lâng ê àn-chêng; pháiⁿ-lâng lóng bô koan-sim.
Chū-ko chū-tāi ê lâng kā siâⁿ chè-chō hūn-loān, m̄-kú ū tì-hūi ê lâng ōe hō͘ siū-khì soah.
Tì-hūi ê lâng kap gōng-lâng sio-kò, gōng-lâng chí-ū siū-khì á-sī thí-chhiò, lóng bōe kái-koat.
Ài thâi-lâng--ê oàn-hūn sûn-choân ê lâng, m̄-kú chèng-ti̍t ê lâng pó-hō͘ i ê sìⁿ-miā.
Gōng-lâng ū siū-khì chiū lóng piàⁿ-chhut, m̄-kú ū tì-hūi ê lâng ōe-hiáu khòng-chè siū-khì.
Thóng-tī-chiá nā beh thiaⁿ pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe, koaⁿ-oân lóng ōe pìⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ.
Sàn-chhiah-lâng kap ap-pek-chiá ū kiōng-tông ê só͘-chāi: Siōng Chú lóng hō͘ in ê ba̍k-chiu kim, ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Ông nā chiàu kong-chèng phòaⁿ-toàn khùn-khó͘-lâng, i ê ông-ūi ōe éng-oán kian-kò͘.
Koán-kàu kap chek-tok ōe ke-thiⁿ tì-hūi; bô koán-kàu ê gín-á ōe hō͘ lāu-bú kiàn-siàu.
Pháiⁿ-lâng chiáng-koân, chōe-kò chiū ke-thiⁿ; gī-lâng ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h in sit-pāi.
Koán-kàu lí ê kiáⁿ, i ōe hō͘ lí an-sim, koh ōe hō͘ lí ê sim hoaⁿ-hí.
Bô Siōng-tè ê chí-sī, jîn-bîn chiū hòng-chhiòng, m̄-kú chun-siú lu̍t-hoat ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Kan-ta ēng ōe, lô͘-po̍k bōe siū koán-kàu; i bêng-pe̍k mā bōe thiaⁿ-thàn.
Lí bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h sûi-piān kóng-ōe ê lâng--bô? Liân gōng-lâng to pí i khah ū ǹg-bāng.
Lô͘-po̍k nā tùi sòe-hàn chiū kā i sēng, chit-ê lô͘-po̍k kàu-bé ōe chhiúⁿ-toa̍t chú-lâng ê châi-sán.
Pháiⁿ sèng-tē ê lâng ōe jiá-khí oan-ke; gâu hoat siū-khì ê lâng ōe hoān chin chōe chōe-kò.
Lâng kiau-ngō͘ ōe hō͘ ka-kī kiàn-siàu; sim khiam-pi ōe hō͘ ka-kī tit-tio̍h chun-êng.
Kap chha̍t pun thau--lâi ê mi̍h sī bô ài ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā; i sui-jiân chiù-chōa choh-chèng mā bōe kóng si̍t-ōe.
Kiaⁿ lâng bô kiaⁿ Siōng-tè sī kā ka-kī siat lô-bāng, m̄-kú sìn-khò Siōng Chú chiū ū an-ún.
Chin chōe lâng ài tùi thóng-tī-chiá kiû-chêng, m̄-kú chí-ū tùi Siōng Chú chiah ōe tit-tio̍h kong-chèng ê phòaⁿ-koat.
Bô kong-tō ê lâng, gī-lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ; hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t ê lâng, pháiⁿ-lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
Ē-bīn sī Ngá-ki ê kiáⁿ A-kó͘-ní kà-sī ê ōe, i tùi Í-thiat kap O͘-kah án-ni kóng,
“Góa sī chèng-lâng tiong siōng gû-gōng--ê, liân it-poaⁿ-lâng ê tì-sek to bô.
Góa bô o̍h-tio̍h tì-hūi, mā bô Chì-sèng ê Siōng-tè ê tì-sek.

Siáⁿ-lâng bat chiūⁿ-thiⁿ koh lo̍h--lâi? Siáⁿ-lâng bat ēng chhiú la̍k-tio̍h hong? Siáⁿ-lâng bat ēng saⁿ pau chúi? Siáⁿ-lâng bat kài-tēng tōe ê ke̍k-thâu? I ê miâ kiò sím-mi̍h, I kiáⁿ ê miâ kiò sím-mi̍h, lí chai--bô?
Siōng-tè ê ōe ta̍k-kù lóng keng-kè thoàn-liān; só͘-ū óa-khò I ê lâng, I chòe in ê tún-pâi.
I ê ōe, lí m̄-thang ke-thiⁿ, chiah bián siū chek-pī, phòaⁿ-chòe kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.
“Góa tùi lí kiû nn̄g hāng tāi-chì; tī góa sí í-chêng m̄-thang bô hō͘ góa.
Kiû lí hō͘ hu-ké kap pe̍h-chha̍t lī-khui góa hn̄g-hn̄g; kiû lí hō͘ góa bô sàn-chhiah mā bô hó-gia̍h, sù góa su-iàu ê bí-niû,
chiah bián góa pá-chiok m̄ jīn lí, kóng Siōng Chú sī siáⁿ-lâng; chiah bián góa sàn-chhiah soah thau-the̍h, tì-kàu siat-to̍k góa ê Siōng-tè ê miâ.
“M̄-thang tùi chú-lâng kóng i lô͘-po̍k ê pháiⁿ-ōe, chiah bián i kā lí chiù-chó͘, lí soah siū chek-hoa̍t.
“Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng chiù-chó͘ in ê lāu-pē, mā bô kā lāu-bú chiok-hok.
Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng khòaⁿ ka-kī chòe chheng-khì, m̄-kú bô sóe-tû ka-kī ê ù-òe.
Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng ba̍k-thâu-koân, ba̍k-sîn kiau-ngō͘.
Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng ê gê chhin-chhiūⁿ kiàm, khí chhin-chhiūⁿ to, beh thun-chia̍h tōe-chiūⁿ ê khùn-khó͘-lâng kap sè-kan ê sàn-chhiah-lâng.
“Gô͘-khî ū nn̄g ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ put-sî hoah kóng, ‘Hō͘ góa, hō͘ góa.’ Bōe ti-chiok--ê ū saⁿ hāng, liân bōe kóng ‘Kàu-gia̍h lah’ ū sì hāng:
Im-hú, bōe hoâi-īn ê thai, khah chōe chúi mā bô-kàu ê tōe, kap bōe kóng ‘Kàu-gia̍h’ ê hé.
Thí-chhiò lāu-pē, biáu-sī, m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn lāu-bú, chit-khoán lâng ê ba̍k-chiu ōe hō͘ soaⁿ-kok tiong ê o͘-a tok--khì, ōe hō͘ eng-chiáu ê kiáⁿ chia̍h--khì.
“Góa siūⁿ bōe chhut ê kî-biāu ū saⁿ hāng, liân góa m̄ bat--ê ū sì hāng:
Eng-chiáu tī khong-tiong ê lō͘, chôa tī chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng ê lō͘, chûn tī hái-tiong ê lō͘, lâm lú kau-ha̍p ê lō͘.
Îm-hū ê lō͘ mā oh liáu-kái: I chia̍h-liáu chiū chhit-chhùi, kóng ‘Góa bô chòe pháiⁿ’.
“Hō͘ tāi-tōe iô-tāng--ê ū saⁿ hāng, liân tam-tng bōe khí--ê ū sì hāng:
Lô͘-po̍k chòe ông, gōng-lâng tiùⁿ kàu pá,
bô lâng-iân ê lú-chú chhut-kè, lú-pī chhú-tāi lú-chú-lâng.
“Tōe-chiūⁿ ū sì hāng bî-sòe ê tōng-bu̍t, m̄-kú ke̍k ū tì-sek:
Káu-hiā sui-jiân jio̍k-siáu, m̄-kú ōe-hiáu tī joa̍h-thiⁿ chún-pī chia̍h-mi̍h;
chio̍h-hoan sui-jiân bô ióng-chòng, m̄-kú ōe-hiáu tī chio̍h-phāng choh-siū;
chháu-meh sui-jiân bô ông, m̄-kú ōe-hiáu cho͘-tūi chhut--khì;
siān-lâng-á sui-jiân lâng ēng chhiú lia̍h ōe tio̍h, m̄-kú tiàm tī ông-kiong.
“Kiâⁿ-lō͘ ui-hong--ê ū saⁿ hāng, liân kha-pō͘ ui-hong--ê ū sì hāng:
Sai, iá-siù tiong tē-it béng--ê, tú-tio̍h sím-mi̍h to bōe siám-pī;
la̍h-káu, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, í-ki̍p ū kun-peng pó-hō͘ ê kun-ông.
“Lí nā chū-ko chū-tāi khám-khám-á chòe, á-sī kè-bô͘ pháiⁿ-tāi, tio̍h ēng chhiú ng chhùi.
Ká gû-lin ōe chhut lin-iû, phah-tio̍h phīⁿ ōe lâu-huih; chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, tōa siū-khì ōe khí saⁿ-chiⁿ.”
Lī-bō͘-i-le̍k -ông ê lāu-bú kà-sī i ê ōe,
“Góa ê kiáⁿ, góa chhin-siⁿ ê kiáⁿ, góa hē-goān tit--tio̍h ê kiáⁿ ah, góa tio̍h kā lí kóng sím-mi̍h?
M̄-thang tī hū-jîn-lâng sin-chiūⁿ ēng-chīn lí ê cheng-le̍k; húi-hoāi kun-ông ê lō͘ m̄-thang kiâⁿ.
Lī-bō͘-i-le̍k ah, choh-ông--ê m̄-thang lim-chiú, chhian-bān m̄-thang; ông-chhin hò͘ⁿ kāu-chiú mā m̄ eng-kai,
chiah bián lim--lo̍h-khì soah bōe-kì-tit hoat-lēng, hut-lio̍k khùn-khó͘-lâng ê koân-ek.
Kāu-chiú tio̍h hō͘ teh-beh sí ê lâng, po̍h-chiú hō͘ sim kan-khó͘ ê lâng;
hō͘ i lim-liáu bōe-kì-tit ka-kī ê sàn-chhiah, bōe-kì-tit i ê kan-khó͘.
Tio̍h ūi-tio̍h bōe kóng-ōe ê lâng hoat-giân, ūi-tio̍h só͘-ū bô i-óa ê lâng sin-oan.
Tio̍h khui-chhùi chiàu kong-gī phòaⁿ-toàn, ūi-tio̍h khùn-khó͘ sàn-chhiah ê lâng sin-oan.”
Ū châi-tek ê hū-jîn-lâng siáⁿ-lâng chhē ōe tio̍h? I ê kè-ta̍t tōa-tōa chhiau-kè chu-pó.
I ê tiōng-hu sìn-nāi i, sím-mi̍h lóng bô khiàm-kheh.
I chi̍t-sì-lâng hō͘ tiōng-hu ū lī-ek bô sún-hāi.
I chhē iûⁿ-mn̂g kap iù-môa, kam-sim chhin-chhiú chòe kang.
I chhin-chhiūⁿ siong-chûn, tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi ūn bí-niû lâi.
Thiⁿ bē kng, i chiū khí--lâi, chún-pī chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ ke-lāi ê lâng, chiong eng-kai chòe ê khang-khè hun-phài hō͘ lú-pī.
I chhē-tio̍h kah-ì ê thó͘-tōe chiū bóe--khí-lâi, ēng i ê chhiú só͘ thàn--ê chai-chèng phû-tô-hn̂g.
I chhēng-saⁿ pih-chah, chún-pī hó-sè, chhiú-kut giám-ngī thang chhut-la̍t kang-chok.
I chai só͘ keng-êng--ê sūn-lī ū lī-ek; i ê teng kui-mî tiám-kng-kng.
I ê chhiú the̍h a̍k-á; i ê chhiú-sim hōaⁿ pháng-chhia.
I khóng-khài chín-chè khùn-khó͘-lâng, chhun-chhiú pang-chān sàn-chhiah-lâng.
I bián ūi-tio̍h lo̍h-seh ūi ke-lāi ê lâng hoân-ló, in-ūi choân-ke lóng ū kāu-saⁿ thang chhēng.
I ūi ka-kī chòe súi ê thán-á; i só͘ chhēng--ê chiū-sī iù-môa-pò͘ kap chí-sek-pò͘ chòe ê saⁿ.
I ê tiōng-hu tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu lâng-lâng lóng bat, in-ūi i kap pún-tōe ê tiúⁿ-ló chòe-hé chē.
I chòe iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ khì bōe, koh bōe io-tòa hō͘ seng-lí-lâng.
I ēng khùi-la̍t kap ui-gî chòe saⁿ chhēng; i siūⁿ-tio̍h chiong-lâi ê kéng-hóng chiū chhiò-bî-bî.
I khui-chhùi kóng tì-hūi ê ōe; i ê chi̍h ū jîn-chû ê kà-sī.
I gâu liāu-lí ke-lāi ê sū, bô chia̍h êng-pn̄g.
I ê kiáⁿ-jî khùn-chhíⁿ khí--lâi chiū kā i chiok-hok; i ê tiōng-hu mā chheng-chàn i, kóng,
“Hū-jîn-lâng hó tek-hēng--ê chin chōe, m̄-kú lí siōng hó.”
Gōa-piáu hó-khòaⁿ sī hu-ké, súi mā-sī khang-khang, m̄-kú kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê hū-jîn-lâng ōe tit-tio̍h o-ló.
I ê chhiú só͘ chòe ê sêng-kó tio̍h kā i khéng-tēng; i só͘ chòe--ê eng-kai tī kong-chiòng bīn-chêng tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn.
Tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông, Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ, Thoân-tō-chiá ê ōe.
Góa — Thoân-tō-chiá kóng: Khang-hu ê khang-hu; khang-hu ê khang-hu; it-chhè lóng sī khang-hu.
Lâng it-chhè ê lô-khó͘ phah-piàⁿ, chiū-sī tī ji̍t-kng ē-bīn ê lô-lo̍k ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek?
Chi̍t-tāi kè-liáu koh chi̍t-tāi, m̄-kú tōe chiàu-siông chûn-chāi.
Ji̍t chhut, ji̍t lo̍h, kín-kín tò-tńg-khì chhut--lâi ê só͘-chāi.
Hong ǹg lâm chhe, koh tò-tńg ǹg pak, bô-thêng tńg-se̍h, koh se̍h tńg-khì goân-lâi ê só͘-chāi.
Kang-hô lóng lâu-ji̍p hái, m̄-kú hái mā bōe móa; kang-hô lâu kàu tó-ūi, koh lâu tńg-khì goân-lâi ê só͘-chāi.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì hō͘ lâng siān koh ùi; kóng mā kóng bōe liáu, khòaⁿ mā khòaⁿ bōe pá, thiaⁿ mā thiaⁿ bōe oân.
