Í-chêng í-keng ū--ê, chiong-lâi ōe koh ū; í-chêng í-keng chòe--ê, chiong-lâi ōe koh chòe; ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn bô sin ê tāi-chì.
Kiám ū sím-mi̍h sū, lâng ōe-tàng kóng “Lí khòaⁿ, che sī sin--ê”? Tī lán í-chêng ê sè-tāi, chá chiū ū lah.
Í-keng kè--khì ê sè-tāi, bô lâng ōe-kì--tit; chiong-lâi ê sè-tāi, āu-lâi ê lâng mā bōe-kì--tit.
Góa — Thoân-tō-chiá bat tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông.
Góa choan-sim ēng tì-hūi gián-kiù chhâ-khó thiⁿ-ē só͘ hoat-seng it-chhè ê tāi-chì, chiū chai che sī Siōng-tè só͘ hō͘ lâng bô ì-gī ê lô-khó͘.
Góa koan-chhat ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn só͘ hoat-seng it-chhè ê tāi-chì, khòaⁿ-chhut it-chhè lóng sī khang-hu, lóng sī lia̍h-hong.
Oan-khiau--ê bōe-tàng hō͘ i ti̍t; khiàm-kheh--ê pó͘ bōe móa.
Góa siūⁿ-kóng, góa ū tōa tì-hūi, pí chêng-kàu-taⁿ só͘-ū tī-lí Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng khah ū tì-hūi; góa mā ū khip-siu chin chōe tì-hūi kap kiàn-sek.
Góa choan-sim tì-ì bêng-pe̍k tì-hūi, ài bêng-pe̍k tian-kông kap gû-gōng, chiū chai che mā-sī lia̍h-hong.
In-ūi lâng jú ū tì-hūi jú ū hoân-ló, jú ū tì-sek jú ū iu-siong.
Góa tùi ka-kī kóng: Lâi, lâi tui-kiû hióng-lo̍k, khòaⁿ ū sím-mi̍h hó-chhù. Kiat-kó, che mā-sī khang-hu.
Góa kóng: Sńg-chhiò sī tian-kông; hióng-lo̍k mā-sī khang-khang.

Góa siūⁿ-beh ēng chiú hō͘ seng-khu sóng-khoài, kè gû-gōng ê seng-oa̍h. M̄-kú, góa ê sim iáu-kú ài hō͘ tì-hūi ín-chhōa, thang chai lâng té-té ê it-seng sím-mi̍h sī siōng-hó ê seng-oa̍h.
Góa ūi-tio̍h ka-kī heng-khí tōa kang-thêng: Khí chin chōe chhù, chai-chèng phû-tô,
siu-chō hoe-hn̂g kap ké-chí-hn̂g, tī hit lāi-bīn chai-chèng ta̍k-chióng ké-chí-chhiū;
koh khui chúi-tî koàn-ak chhiū-nâ lāi ê chhiū-á-chai.
Góa ū bóe lâm-lú lô͘-lē, mā ū chhut-sì tī góa ke-lāi--ê; koh ū chin chōe gû-kûn, iûⁿ-kûn, pí góa í-chêng tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hiah-ê lâng só͘-ū--ê khah chōe.

Góa mā ūi ka-kī chek-chū kim gûn, siu-chi̍p lia̍t-ông kap ta̍k-séng ê châi-pó; koh tit-tio̍h chhiùⁿ-koa ê lâm-lú, chin chōe kiong-hui, í-ki̍p sè-kan-lâng só͘ ì-ài ê hióng-siū.
Án-ni góa chiū pí í-chêng só͘-ū tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng koh-khah heng-ōng; koh tì-hūi mā bô lī-khui góa.

Góa ê ba̍k-chiu só͘ ài--ê, góa bô kā i chó͘-tòng; góa ê sim só͘ hoaⁿ-hí--ê, góa bô kā i kìm-chí; in-ūi góa ê sim tùi góa só͘ phah-piàⁿ--ê kám-kak boán-chiok; che sī góa phah-piàⁿ tit--tio̍h ê pò-siúⁿ.
M̄-kú góa khòaⁿ góa ê chhiú só͘ chòe ê it-chhè, í-ki̍p góa lô-lo̍k só͘ ta̍t-sêng--ê, lóng sī khang-hu, lóng sī lia̍h-hong; ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn lóng bô lī-ek.
Góa oa̍t-tńg lâi koan-chhat tì-hūi, tian-kông, kap gû-gōng. Ông ê kè-sêng-jîn kiám ōe-tàng koh chòe sím-mi̍h? Put-kò chòe í-chêng ê ông só͘ chòe--ê nā-tiāⁿ.
Góa khòaⁿ-chhut tì-hūi pí gû-gōng khah hó, chhin-chhiūⁿ kng-bêng pí o͘-àm khah hó.
Tì-hūi ê lâng khòaⁿ chheng-chhó thâu-chêng ê lō͘, gû-gōng ê lâng tī o͘-àm tiong bong bô lō͘. M̄-kú góa mā chai in ê kiat-kio̍k lóng siâng-khoán.
Góa sim-lāi siūⁿ, gōng-lâng tú--tio̍h-ê, góa mā ōe tú--tio̍h; án-ni góa ū tì-hūi ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek? Góa sim-lāi kóng: Che mā-sī khang-hu.

Tì-hūi ê lâng kap gû-gōng ê lâng pîⁿ-pîⁿ lóng bōe éng-oán hō͘ lâng kì-liām, in-ūi kàu-bé lóng ōe hō͘ lâng bōe-kì--tit. Hài! Gû-gōng ê lâng sí, tì-hūi ê lâng mā tio̍h sí.
Só͘-í góa oàn-chhoeh sìⁿ-miā, in-ūi ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì lóng hō͘ góa iu-khó͘. Che lóng sī khang-hu, lóng sī lia̍h-hong.
Góa iàm-ò͘ⁿ it-chhè ê lô-lo̍k, in-ūi góa tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn lô-lo̍k só͘ ta̍t-sêng--ê, lóng tio̍h lâu hō͘ góa ê kè-sêng-jîn.
Hit-ê lâng sī tì-hūi á-sī gû-gōng siáⁿ-lâng chai; góa tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn, ēng tì-hūi phah-piàⁿ só͘ chòe--ê, lóng ōe hō͘ i chiáng-koán. Che mā-sī khang-hu.
Án-ni, tùi chêng-kàu-taⁿ tī ji̍t-kng ē-bīn ê lô-khó͘ phah-piàⁿ, góa kám-kak chin sit-bāng.

Ū lâng ēng tì-hūi, ēng tì-sek, ēng pún-sū phah-piàⁿ tit--tio̍h-ê, soah tio̍h lâu hō͘ m̄-bat ūi-tio̍h hiah-ê châi-sán phah-piàⁿ ê lâng chòe sán-gia̍p. Che mā-sī khang-hu, sī tōa put-hēng.
Lâng tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn phah-piàⁿ chhau-hoân, ū tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h?
I it-seng ê nî-ji̍t chhau-hoân, lô-lo̍k kang-chok, liân mî--sî sim to bô an-lêng. Che mā-sī khang-hu.
Lâng siōng-hó sī lâi chia̍h lâi lim, hióng-siū in phah-piàⁿ tit--tio̍h ê sêng-kó. Góa khòaⁿ che mā-sī Siōng-tè ê an-pâi.
Nā m̄-sī tùi Siōng-tè, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng lim-chia̍h, hióng-lo̍k?

Siōng-tè chiong tì-hūi, tì-sek, khoài-lo̍k sù hō͘ I só͘ hoaⁿ-hí ê lâng; m̄-kú ū-chōe ê lâng Siōng-tè hō͘ in lô-khó͘, chiong in siu-khioh chek-chū--ê, kui hō͘ I só͘ hoaⁿ-hí ê lâng. Che mā-sī khang-hu, mā-sī lia̍h-hong.
Thiⁿ-ē bān-hāng-sū lóng ū i ê kî; sū-sū lóng ū i ê sî:
Siⁿ ū sî, sí ū sî; chai-chèng ū sî, khau só͘ chai-chèng--ê ū sî;
thâi ū sî, i-hó ū sî; thiah-húi ū sî, khí-chō ū sî;
khàu ū sî, chhiò ū sî; ai-siong ū sî, thiàu-bú ū sî;
tâng-pâng ū sî, hun-pâng ū sî; chhin-jia̍t ū sî, léng-tām ū sî;
chhiau-chhē ū sî, sit-lo̍h ū sî; pó-chûn ū sî, pàng-sak ū sî;
thiah ū sî, pó͘ ū sî; chēng-chēng ū sî, kóng-ōe ū sî;
thiàⁿ ū sî, oàn ū sî; chiàn-cheng ū sî, hô-pêng ū sî.
Choh-kang ê lâng tùi i só͘ lô-lo̍k phah-piàⁿ--ê ū tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h?
Góa ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè hō͘ sè-kan-lâng pē tāng-tàⁿ, hō͘ in bōe-tàng chheng-êng.

Siōng-tè hō͘ I só͘ chō ê it-chhè ha̍h in ê sî, lóng chin hó; koh chiong éng-oán chit-ê koan-liām hē tī lâng ê sim; m̄-kú Siōng-tè tùi thâu kàu bé só͘ chòe--ê, lâng bōe-tàng liáu-kái.
Góa chai lâng oa̍h--teh siōng-hó sī khoài-lo̍k koh chòe hó-sū.
Lâng mā chia̍h mā lim, hióng-siū i phah-piàⁿ tit--tio̍h-ê, tī i it-chhè só͘ lô-lo̍k--ê lâi hióng-hok, che mā-sī Siōng-tè só͘ sù.
Góa chai Siōng-tè só͘ chòe ê it-chhè lóng ōe lâu kàu éng-oán, bōe ke-thiⁿ, bōe kiám-chió. Siōng-tè án-ni chòe, sī beh hō͘ lâng tī I ê bīn-chêng sim chûn kèng-ùi.
Hiān-chāi ū--ê í-chêng í-keng ū; chiong-lâi beh ū--ê chá í-keng ū; kè--khì ê tāi-chì Siōng-tè ōe koh hō͘ i hoat-seng.
Góa koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn, tī sím-phòaⁿ ê só͘-chāi ū siâ-ok, tī kong-gī ê só͘-chāi mā ū siâ-ok.
Góa sim-lāi kóng: Siōng-tè beh pîⁿ-pîⁿ sím-phòaⁿ gī-lâng kap pháiⁿ-lâng, in-ūi ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì, ta̍k-hāng hêng-ûi lóng ū i it-tēng ê sî.
Góa sim-lāi kóng: Koan-hē sè-kan-lâng, Siōng-tè beh chhì-giām in, hō͘ in chai in put-kò kap cheng-siⁿ kâng-khoán.

In-ūi sè-kan-lâng ê miā-ūn kap cheng-siⁿ ê miā-ūn lóng siâng-khoán; chit-ê sí, hit-ê mā sí, lóng siâng-khoán chí-ū chi̍t-kháu-khùi; lâng bô pí cheng-siⁿ khah hó, che lóng sī khang-hu.
In lóng khì kàu kâng chi̍t ê só͘-chāi; lóng tùi thô͘-hún chhut, mā lóng kui thô͘-hún.
Siáⁿ-lâng chai lâng ê sìⁿ-miā chiūⁿ téng-bīn, siù ê sìⁿ-miā lo̍h tōe-ē?
Só͘-í, lâng siōng-hó sī ōe-tàng hióng-siū ka-kī só͘ phah-piàⁿ ê sêng-kó, in-ūi che sī i ê pò-siúⁿ. Sí-āu ê tāi-chì, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng hō͘ i khòaⁿ--tio̍h?

Góa koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn só͘ hoat-seng it-chhè ap-pek ê tāi-chì: Siū ap-pek ê lâng lâu ba̍k-sái, bô lâng kā in an-ùi; in-ūi ap-pek in--ê ū sè-le̍k, siū ap-pek--ê bô lâng kā in an-ùi.
In-ūi án-ni, góa kā hiah-ê í-keng sí--khì ê lâng kiong-hí, in pí iáu oa̍h--teh ê lâng khah hēng-hok.
Koh hiah-ê iáu-bē chhut-sì, bē khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ji̍t-kng ē-bīn só͘ hoat-seng pháiⁿ ê tāi-chì--ê, góa khòaⁿ in pí chit nn̄g khoán lâng iáu khah hó.

Góa koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h lâng it-chhè ê lô-khó͘ kap ta̍k-khoán kang-chok ê sêng-chiū, sī in-ūi lâng kap lâng tiong-kan ê oàn-tò͘ kèng-cheng chō-sêng--ê. Che mā-sī khang-hu, mā-sī lia̍h-hong.
Gû-gōng ê lâng chhiú lám-heng m̄ chòe tāi-chì, iau kah gō-sí.
Chi̍t chhiú móa-móa m̄-kú an-jiân chū-chāi, pí siang-chhiú móa-móa tio̍h lô-lo̍k koh lia̍h-hong khah hó.
Góa koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn ū khang-hu ê sū:

Ū lâng ko͘-toaⁿ bô-phōaⁿ, bô kiáⁿ mā bô hiaⁿ-tī, iáu-kú lô-lo̍k bô-soah, bô khòaⁿ só͘-ū ê châi-hù chòe kàu-gia̍h. I kóng: Góa lô-lo̍k khek-khó͘, bô hióng-hok, tàu-tóe sī ūi siáⁿ-lâng? Che mā-sī khang-hu, sī bô ì-gī ê kang-chok.
Nn̄g ê lâng pí chi̍t ê khah hó, in-ūi nn̄g ê ha̍p-chok ōe tit-tio̍h khah-hó ê hāu-kó;
nā chi̍t ê poa̍h-tó, iáu ū chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kā i hû--khí-lâi; nā ka-kī chi̍t ê, poa̍h-tó ê sî bô lâng thang kā i hû--khí-lâi, chit-ê lâng chiū chin put-hēng.
Nn̄g ê lâng chòe-hé khùn khah sio-lō, ka-kī chi̍t ê ná ōe sio?
Siū kong-kek ê sî, kan-ta chi̍t ê lâng phah bōe iâⁿ, nā ū nn̄g ê chiū ōe-tàng tí-khòng. Saⁿ kó͘ ê soh bô hiah hó chhoah-tn̄g.
Sàn-chhiah ū tì-hūi ê siàu-liân-lâng pí nî-lāu m̄-khéng siū tiong-kò gû-gōng ê ông khah hó.
Ū lâng tùi kaⁿ-ga̍k chhut--lâi, āu-lâi choh-ông; ū lâng chhut-sì tī ông-kiong, āu-lâi pìⁿ-chòe sàn-chhiah.
Góa khòaⁿ tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn teh seng-oa̍h ê jîn-bîn lóng kun-tè sòa-chiap choh-ông ê siàu-liân-lâng.
I ū léng-tō chin chōe jîn-bîn, m̄-kú āu-lâi ê lâng tùi i bô kah-ì. Che mā-sī khang-hu, mā-sī lia̍h-hong.
Lí nā khì Siōng-tè ê tiān, kha-pō͘ tio̍h kín-sīn; chìn-chêng lâi thiaⁿ pí gōng-lâng hiàn-chè khah hó, in-ūi in kan-ta ōe-hiáu chòe pháiⁿ.
Tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng lí m̄-thang sûi-piān kóng-ōe, mā m̄-thang kip beh kóng; in-ūi Siōng-tè tī thiⁿ lí tī tōe, só͘-í lí ê ōe tio̍h chió.
Tāi-chì chōe, kāu bîn-bāng; kāu-ōe ōe hián-chhut gû-gōng.
Lí tùi Siōng-tè hē-goān, tio̍h kín siā-goān; in-ūi I bô ài gû-gōng ê lâng; lí hē ê goān tio̍h siā.
Hē-goān bô siā, lêng-khó bô hē.

M̄-thang in-ūi lí ê ōe tì-kàu ka-kī hoān-chōe, mā m̄-thang tī Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá bīn-chêng kóng só͘ hē ê goān m̄-tio̍h. Sī-án-chóaⁿ beh hō͘ Siōng-tè in-ūi lí ê ōe siū-khì, phò-hoāi lí ê só͘-chòe?
Bîn-bāng chōe, ōe chiū chōe, bô ì-gī ê sū mā chōe; chí-ū tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng-tè.

Lí nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h sàn-chhiah-lâng siū koaⁿ-oân ap-pek, á-sī chèng-ti̍t kong-gī siū pak-toa̍t, m̄-bián in-ūi án-ni kám-kak kî-koài; in-ūi koaⁿ-oân lóng ū khah koân ê koaⁿ teh kā in pó-hō͘.
Thó͘-tōe ū hó ê siu-sêng, peh-sìⁿ chiah hó kè-ji̍t, chóng-sī tit-tio̍h siōng-tōa lī-ek--ê sī kun-ông.
Ài chîⁿ--ê bōe in-ūi chîⁿ ti-chiok; ài hó-gia̍h--ê bōe in-ūi só͘ thàn--ê ti-chiok. Che mā-sī khang-hu.
Châi-hù ke-thiⁿ, khò i chia̍h ê lâng mā ke-thiⁿ; án-ni i ū tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h lī-ek? Put-kò sī khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h nā-tiāⁿ.
Lô-kang bô-lūn chia̍h-chōe chia̍h-chió lóng hó-khùn; hó-gia̍h-lâng chia̍h kah pá-pá mā khùn bōe khì.
Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn ū chi̍t hāng tōa put-hēng, chiū-sī châi-chú chîⁿ siú-tiâu-tiâu soah hāi-tio̍h ka-kī.
I in-ūi sū-gia̍p bô sūn, chîⁿ-châi bô--khì; ū kiáⁿ mā bô sím-mi̍h thang lâu hō͘ i.
I thǹg-theh chhut bú-thai, mā ōe thǹg-theh tò--khì; i lô-lo̍k tit--tio̍h-ê, chi̍t hāng mā bōe-tàng tòa--khì.
I lâi ê sî án-chóaⁿ, khì ê sî mā-sī án-ni; che mā-sī chi̍t hāng tōa put-hēng; i lô-lo̍k lia̍h-hong ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek?
M̄-nā án-ni, i chi̍t-sì-lâng tī o͘-àm tiong teh seng-oa̍h, ū chin chōe hoân-ló, mā ū pīⁿ-thiàⁿ kap siū-khì.

Chiàu góa khòaⁿ, siōng-hó ê jîn-seng chiū-sī lâng tī Siōng-tè só͘ sù iú-hān ê nî-ji̍t lim-chia̍h, hióng-siū ji̍t-kng ē-bīn lô-lo̍k só͘ tit--tio̍h ê sêng-kó, in-ūi che sī i èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h.
Siōng-tè nā hō͘ lâng ū châi-hù, sán-gia̍p, thang khoài-lo̍k hióng-siū i lô-lo̍k tit--tio̍h ê hūn-gia̍h, che sī Siōng-tè ê un-sù.
I m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h it-seng ê nî-ji̍t chhau-hoân, in-ūi Siōng-tè hō͘ i ê sim chhiong-móa hoaⁿ-hí.
Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn ū chi̍t hāng put-hēng tāng-tāng teh tī lâng ê sin-chiūⁿ.

Ū lâng tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè sù i chîⁿ-châi, hó-gia̍h, chun-kùi, i ê sim só͘ ài--ê bô khiàm pòaⁿ-hāng; m̄-kú Siōng-tè hō͘ i bōe-tàng hióng-siū, hoán-tńg hō͘ gōa-lâng hióng-siū; che mā-sī khang-hu, sī tōa pi-ai.

Lâng nā ū chi̍t-pah ê kiáⁿ, koh chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū, sui-jiân oa̍h chin chōe hè, m̄-kú bô hióng-hok bô boán-chiok, koh bô tit-tio̍h an-chòng; góa kóng, liû-sán ê thai mā pí i khah hó.
Chit-ê thai lâi sī khang-hu, sûi-sî chìn-ji̍p o͘-àm; i ê miâ siū o͘-àm khàm-ba̍t siau-sit.
I m̄-bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h ji̍t-kng, mā bô ti-kak, iáu-kú pí hit-ê lāu-lâng tit-tio̍h khah hó ê an-hioh.
Hit-ê lâng sui-jiân oa̍h kàu chi̍t-chheng nî koh chi̍t-chheng nî, m̄-kú bô hióng-hok; in nn̄g khoán lâng kiám m̄-sī lóng tio̍h khì kâng chi̍t ê só͘-chāi?
Lâng ê lô-lo̍k lóng sī ūi-tio̍h pak-tó͘, m̄-kú si̍t-io̍k éng bōe boán-chiok.
Tì-hūi ê lâng pí gû-gōng ê lâng kiám ū khah gâu? Sàn-chhiah-lâng chai án-chóaⁿ choh-lâng, kiám ū lō͘-ēng?
Ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê pí sim siūⁿ--ê khah hó. Che mā-sī khang-hu, mā-sī lia̍h-hong.
Í-keng ū--ê, chá chiū hō-miâ; lâng sī sím-mi̍h, mā chá chiū chai; bô lâng ōe-tàng kap pí i khah kiông--ê tùi-khòng.
Ōe chōe, khang-hu chiū ná chōe, tùi lâng ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek?

Lâng it-seng hu-tō͘-kong-im chhin-chhiūⁿ iáⁿ kè--khì, siáⁿ-lâng ōe chai lâng oa̍h--teh ê sî sím-mi̍h siōng hó? Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kā i kóng, i sí-āu, tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn ōe hoat-seng sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?
Hó miâ-siaⁿ iâⁿ-kè hó ê phang-iû; lâng sí ê ji̍t pí chhut-sì ê ji̍t khah hó.
Khì song-sū ê ke pí khì iàn-lo̍k ê ke khah hó, in-ūi sí sī chèng-lâng ê kiat-kio̍k; oa̍h-lâng mā tio̍h chiong chit-ê tāi-chì khǹg tī sim-lāi.
Iu-būn pí chhiò khah hó; in-ūi bīn-tài-iu-iông tùi sim ū hó-chhù.
Tì-hūi ê lâng ê sim tī song-sū ê ke; gû-gōng ê lâng ê sim tī khoài-lo̍k ê ke.
Thiaⁿ tì-hūi-lâng ê chek-pī, pí thiaⁿ gû-gōng ê lâng ê chheng-chàn khah hó.
Gōng-lâng ê chhiò chhin-chhiūⁿ tiáⁿ-ē sio chhì-á teh to̍h ê siaⁿ; che mā-sī khang-hu.
Khióng-hat chhú-châi ōe hō͘ tì-hūi ê lâng pìⁿ-chòe gōng; hóe-lō͘ ōe hō͘ lâng ê sim hú-pāi.
Tāi-chì ê kiat-kio̍k pí tāi-chì ê khai-sí khah hó; thun-lún pí kiau-ngō͘ khah hó.
M̄-thang sûi-piān siū-khì, in-ūi siū-khì sī gû-gōng.
M̄-thang kóng: Sī-án-chóaⁿ í-chêng pí hiān-chāi khah hó? Án-ni mn̄g sī bô tì-hūi.
Tì-hūi kap ke-gia̍p lóng sī hó; tùi oa̍h tī ji̍t-kng ē-bīn ê lâng lóng ū lī-ek.
In-ūi tì-hūi ōe tì-ìm lâng, chîⁿ-gûn mā ōe tì-ìm lâng; m̄-kú chí-ū tì-hūi ōe pó-choân ū tì-hūi ê lâng ê sìⁿ-miā. Che chiū-sī ū tì-sek ê hó-chhù.
Lí tio̍h siūⁿ Siōng-tè ê chok-ûi; Siōng-tè hō͘ i oan--ê, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng hō͘ i ti̍t?
Sūn-kéng ê sî tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí, hoān-lān ê sî tio̍h siūⁿ: Chit nn̄g hāng lóng sī Siōng-tè ê chok-ûi, sī beh hō͘ lâng chhâ bōe chhut chiong-lâi ōe hoat-seng sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.
Tī khang-hu ê jîn-seng góa ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h: Ū gī-lâng chòe hó tian-tò bia̍t-bông, ū pháiⁿ-lâng chòe pháiⁿ tian-tò chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū.
M̄-thang kè-thâu chòe hó, m̄-thang kè-thâu chhong-bêng; ná tio̍h húi-bia̍t ka-kī?
M̄-thang kè-thâu chòe pháiⁿ, mā m̄-thang chòe gōng-lâng; ná tio̍h sî bē kàu chiū sí?
Lí lia̍h-tiâu chit-thâu, hit-thâu mā m̄-thang pàng--khì; kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng ōe-hiáu siang-thâu kiam-kò͘.
Tì-hūi ōe hō͘ tì-hūi ê lâng ū lêng-le̍k iâⁿ-kè siâⁿ-lāi cha̍p ê chiáng-koân-chiá.
Sè-kan bô chi̍t ê chí-ū hêng-siān bô hoān-chōe ê gī-lâng.
Pa̍t-lâng kóng ê ōe m̄-thang lóng khǹg tī sim-lāi; lí khó-lêng ōe thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê po̍k-jîn kā lí chiù-mē,
in-ūi lí ka-kī chai, lí mā bat chin chōe piàn chiù-mē pa̍t-lâng.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì, góa bat ēng tì-hūi chhì-giām; góa kóng: Góa beh chòe ū tì-hūi ê lâng; m̄-kú tì-hūi lī-khui góa chin hn̄g.
Tì-hūi hn̄g koh chhim, kiám ū lâng chhē ōe tio̍h?
Góa it-sim-it-ì ài chai, ài chhâ-khó, ài chhē-kiû tì-hūi kap bān-iú chûn-chāi ê lí-iû, thang chai siâ-ok sī gû-gōng, gû-chhún sī tian-kông.

Góa koh hoat-kiàn, pháiⁿ ê cha-bó͘-lâng pí sí khah khióng-pò͘; i sī oa̍h-tauh, i ê sim sī lô-bāng, chhiú sī só-liān. Siōng-tè ì-ài ê lâng lóng ōe-tàng siám-pī, m̄-kú siâ-ok ê lâng ōe hō͘ i lia̍h--tio̍h.
Thoân-tō-chiá kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, góa ài chai bān-iú chûn-chāi ê lí-iû, chi̍t-hāng chi̍t-hāng kā i pí-kàu, chiū chhē-tio̍h chit-ê —

góa it-ti̍t teh chhē, iáu chhē bōe tio̍h — tī chi̍t-chheng lâng ê tiong-kan góa chhē ōe tio̍h chi̍t ê ta-po͘-lâng sī chèng-ti̍t, m̄-kú liân chi̍t ê chèng-ti̍t ê cha-bó͘-lâng to chhē bōe tio̍h.
Khòaⁿ leh, góa chí-ū chhē tio̍h chit-ê, chiū-sī Siōng-tè chhòng-chō ê lâng pún-lâi sī chèng-ti̍t, chóng-sī in siūⁿ-chhut chin chōe khúi-kè.
Siáⁿ-lâng chin-chiàⁿ ū tì-hūi? Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-hiáu kái-sek tāi-chì? Lâng ê tì-hūi hō͘ i ê bīn ū kong-chhái, mā hō͘ i hiong-ok ê bīn kái-piàn.
Tio̍h siú ông ê bēng-lēng, in-ūi lí ū kí Siōng-tè soan-sè.
Tī ông ê bīn-chêng m̄-bián kiaⁿ, m̄-kú sè-bīn nā bái, tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín lī-khui; in-ūi i ài chòe sím-mi̍h chiū chòe sím-mi̍h.
Ông ê ōe ū koân; siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ tùi i kóng: Lí teh chhòng sím-mi̍h?
Siú bēng-lēng ê lâng bōe tú-tio̍h chai-hō; tì-hūi ê lâng khòaⁿ chheng-chhó sî-sè, ōe-hiáu phòaⁿ-toàn.
Sui-jiân khó͘-lān tāng-tāng teh tī lâng ê sin-chiūⁿ, m̄-kú ta̍k-hāng sū lóng ū i sek-tòng ê sî kap kiat-kio̍k.
I m̄ chai chiong-lâi ōe hoat-seng sím-mi̍h tāi-chì; mā bô lâng ōe-tàng kā i kóng chiong-lâi ōe án-chóaⁿ.

Bô lâng ōe-tàng chi-phòe ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā, mā bô lâng ū koân koat-tēng i sí ê ji̍t; chit-khoán siⁿ-sí ê cheng-chat lâng bōe-tàng pī-bián, chōe-ok mā bōe-tàng kiù chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng.
Chiah-ê góa lóng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, mā choan-sim chhâ-khó ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn só͘ hoat-seng it-chhè ê tāi-chì; ū-sî chit-ê lâng koán-hat pa̍t-lâng, kiat-kó hāi-tio̍h ka-kī.

Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h pháiⁿ-lâng siū-tio̍h liông-tiōng ê bâi-chòng, sàng-chòng ê lâng tùi bōng-tōe tńg--lâi, í-keng bōe-kì--tit hit-ê lâng tī siâⁿ-lāi só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ-tāi; che mā-sī khang-hu.
Chōe tēng-liáu bô sûi-sî chip-hêng, sè-kan-lâng chiah ōe tōa-táⁿ chòe pháiⁿ.
Chōe-jîn chòe pháiⁿ chi̍t-pah piàn, iáu-kú chia̍h tn̂g-hè-siū, m̄-kú góa khak-si̍t chai, kiaⁿ-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng, in-ūi sim chûn kèng-ùi, chòe-āu ōe tit-tio̍h hok-khì.
Chóng-sī pháiⁿ-lâng bōe tit-tio̍h hok-khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ iáⁿ chin kín chiū bô--khì, in-ūi i bô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè.

Tī sè-kan koh ū chi̍t hāng khang-hu ê tāi-chì, chiū-sī gī-lâng tú-tio̍h pháiⁿ-lâng kai siū ê pò-èng, pháiⁿ-lâng tit-tio̍h gī-lâng èng-tit ê pò-siúⁿ; góa kóng: Che mā-sī khang-hu.

Só͘-í góa kó͘-lē lâng hióng-siū khoài-lo̍k. In-ūi lâng tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn ia̍h-chia̍h-ia̍h-lim sī siōng-tōa ê hióng-lo̍k. Che sī Siōng-tè hō͘ lâng tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn phah-piàⁿ eng-kai tit--tio̍h ê hióng-siū.
Góa choan-sim tui-kiû tì-hūi koh koan-chhat sè-kan só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, sīm-chì mî-ji̍t lóng bô khùn.

Góa ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè it-chhè ê chok-ûi, tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, lâng lóng chhē bōe tio̍h hoat-seng ê lí-iû; lâng bô-lūn án-chóaⁿ chhiau-chhē to chhē bōe tio̍h; liân ū tì-hūi ê lâng, sui-jiân siūⁿ-kóng i chai, mā chhē bōe tio̍h.

Góa chiong che it-chhè ê tāi-chì khǹg tī sim-lāi siông-sè siūⁿ, chiū chai gī ê lâng kap tì-hūi ê lâng, í-ki̍p in ê it-kú-it-tōng, liân thiàⁿ kap hūn, lóng tī Siōng-tè ê chhiú-lāi, lâng bōe-tàng tāi-seng chai.

Chèng-lâng ê miā-ūn lóng kâng-khoán: gī-lâng kap siâ-ok ê lâng, hó-lâng kap pháiⁿ-lâng, chheng-khì ê lâng kap bô chheng-khì ê lâng, hiàn-chè ê lâng kap bô hiàn-chè ê lâng, lóng siâng-khoán; hó-lâng án-chóaⁿ, chōe-jîn mā án-ni; chiù-chōa ê lâng án-chóaⁿ, m̄-káⁿ chiù-chōa ê lâng mā án-ni.

Tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn só͘ hoat-seng it-chhè ê tāi-chì, ū chi̍t hāng put-hēng, chiū-sī chèng-lâng ê cho-gū lóng kâng-khoán; sè-kan-lâng ê sim chhiong-móa siâ-ok, oa̍h ê sî sim-lāi tian-kông, chòe-āu lóng tio̍h sí.
Lâng iáu-teh oa̍h chiū ū ǹg-bāng, in-ūi oa̍h ê káu pí sí ê sai khah hó.
Oa̍h--teh ê lâng chai in ōe sí; sí ê lâng sím-mi̍h to m̄ chai, mā bōe koh tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ; in ê miâ bô lâng ōe-kì--tit.
In ê thiàⁿ, in ê hūn, in ê oàn-tò͘, lóng í-keng siau-sit. Tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn só͘ hoat-seng it-chhè ê tāi-chì, éng-oán bô in ê hūn.
Chòe lí khì, hoaⁿ-hí chia̍h lí ê pn̄g, khoài-lo̍k lim lí ê chiú, in-ūi Siōng-tè í-keng chiap-la̍p lí ê só͘-chòe.
Lí tio̍h put-sî chhēng súi ê saⁿ; thâu-khak tio̍h siông-siông boah-iû.

Tī lí it-seng khang-hu ê ji̍t-chí, chiū-sī Siōng-tè sù lí tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn khang-hu ê ji̍t-chí, tio̍h kap lí só͘ thiàⁿ ê bó͘ khoài-lo̍k kè-ji̍t; in-ūi he sī lí chāi-siⁿ, tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn phah-piàⁿ só͘ tit--tio̍h ê hok-hūn.
Lí ê chhiú eng-kai chòe ê tāi-chì tio̍h chīn-la̍t khì chòe, in-ūi tī lí beh khì ê Im-kan bô kang-chok, bô kè-ōe, bô ha̍k-sek, mā bô tì-hūi.

Góa koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h tī ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn, gâu-cháu--ê bô it-tēng ōe seng kàu, ū-la̍t--ê bô it-tēng ōe khah iâⁿ, chhong-bêng--ê bô it-tēng ōe tit-tio̍h bí-niû, bêng-lí--ê bô it-tēng ōe hó-gia̍h, ū ha̍k-sek--ê bô it-tēng siū khòaⁿ-tāng; in só͘ tú--tio̍h-ê lóng chāi-tī sî kap ki-hōe.

Lâng ê sî ka-kī m̄ chai, chhin-chhiūⁿ hî put-hēng hō͘ bāng bāng--tio̍h, chiáu hō͘ lô-bāng tng--tio̍h, chai-hō hut-jiân kàu ê sî, sè-kan-lâng hām-lo̍h hit lāi-bīn mā-sī án-ni.
Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn ū chi̍t hāng tì-hūi, chiàu góa koan-chhat chin te̍k-pia̍t.
Ū chi̍t ê chin sòe ê siâⁿ, hit lāi-bīn lâng chin chió; ū chi̍t ê kiông ê ông lâi kong-kek, ûi-khùn, koh khí koân ê thô͘-tui kā i kong-kek.
Siâⁿ-lāi ū chi̍t ê sàn-chhiah khiok ū tì-hūi ê lâng, ū ēng i ê tì-hūi kiù hit-ê siâⁿ; āu-lâi bô lâng kì-tit i.
Góa kóng, “Tì-hūi iâⁿ-kè khùi-la̍t.” Chóng-sī sàn-chhiah-lâng ê tì-hūi soah hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-khin, i ê ōe bô siū tiōng-sī.
Tì-hūi ê lâng khin-khin-á kóng ê ōe, pí gōng-lâng ê thâu-ba̍k tōa-siaⁿ jióng khah ū lâng thiaⁿ.
Tì-hūi iâⁿ-kè kau-chiàn ê bú-khì; chóng-sī chi̍t piàn sit-chhò ōe phò-hoāi chin chōe hó-sū.
Sí--khì ê hô͘-sîn hō͘ kui-koàn phang-iû hoat-chhut chhàu-bī; sió-khóa ê gû-gōng pí tì-hūi kap chun-kùi khah ū-la̍t.
Tì-hūi ê lâng ê sim ǹg chiàⁿ-lō͘; gû-gōng ê lâng ê sim ǹg phian-lō͘.
Gû-gōng ê lâng khiàm-kheh tì-hūi, liân chhut-mn̂g mā iân-lō͘ hián-chhut ka-kī sī gōng-lâng.
Chiáng-koân-chiá nā tùi lí hoat siū-khì, m̄-thang lī-khui lí ê chit-ūi, in-ūi léng-chēng ōe-tàng hō͘ lí pī-bián tōa kè-sit.
Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h ji̍t-kng ê ē-bīn ū chi̍t hāng put-hēng, sī chiáng-koân-chiá chō-sêng ê chhò-gō͘,
chiū-sī an-pâi gōng-lâng chē koân-ūi, hó-gia̍h-lâng chē kē-ūi.
Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lô͘-po̍k khiâ-bé, kùi-cho̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ lô͘-po̍k kiâⁿ-lō͘.
Ku̍t hām-khiⁿ ê lâng ōe ka-kī poa̍h-lo̍h hit lāi-bīn; thiah-chhiûⁿ ê lâng ōe hō͘ chôa kā--tio̍h.
Phah-chio̍h ê lâng ōe hō͘ chio̍h siong--tio̍h; phòa-chhâ ê lâng ōe hō͘ chhâ kòng--tio̍h.
Pó͘-thâu tun, nā bô bôa hō͘ lāi, chiū tio̍h ke chhut chin chōe la̍t; oa̍h-iōng tì-hūi, ōe chān lâng sêng-kong.
Lāng-chôa--ê iáu-bē lāng, chiū hō͘ chôa kā--tio̍h, i chiū bián koh lāng.
Tì-hūi ê lâng kóng-ōe lâng-lâng kah-ì; gû-gōng ê lâng khui-chhùi ka-kī jiá chai-hō.
Gōng-lâng khui-chhùi kóng gōng-ōe, kàu-bé pìⁿ siáu-ōe.
Gōng-lâng kāu-ōe, ōe kóng bōe soah. Lâng m̄ chai chiong-lâi ōe án-chóaⁿ; i sí-āu hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kā i kóng?
Gōng-lâng chhut gōng-la̍t piàⁿ kah siān-tauh-tauh, liân ji̍p-siâⁿ ê lō͘ to chhē bô.
Nā gín-á choh-ông, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ thàu-chá chiū teh iàn-lo̍k, hit-ê kok-ka ū chai-hō ah.
Nā chun-kùi ê lâng choh-ông, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ chiàu-sî lim-chia̍h, m̄-sī in-ūi hò͘ⁿ-chiú, sī ūi-tio̍h beh tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t, hit-ê kok-ka chin ū hok-khì.
Pîn-tōaⁿ, chhù-kòa ōe lap--lo̍h-khì; chhiú bô ài tín-tāng, chhù ōe lāu.
Iàn-se̍k hō͘ lâng hoaⁿ-hí, chiú hō͘ lâng khoài-lo̍k, chîⁿ-gûn kái-koat bān-sū.

M̄-thang chiù-chó͘ kun-ông, liân siūⁿ mā m̄-thang; tī pâng-keng lāi m̄-thang chiù-chó͘ hó-gia̍h-lâng, in-ūi khong-tiong ê chiáu-á ōe thoân-pò͘ chit-ê siau-sit, ū-si̍t--ê ōe thoân-ōe.
Chiong lí ê bí-niû khǹg tī chúi-bīn hō͘ i lâu--khì, kè chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan ōe koh tit--tio̍h.
Chiong sán-gia̍p pun-chòe chhit hūn á-sī poeh hūn, in-ūi m̄ chai chiong-lâi ū sím-mi̍h chai-lān.
Hûn nā ū chúi-khì móa-móa, hō͘ chiū piàⁿ-lo̍h tōe; chhiū nā tó ǹg lâm á-sī ǹg pak, tó tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, chiū tiāⁿ-tiāⁿ tī hia.
Khòaⁿ hong-sè ê lâng bōe khì iā-chéng; koan-chhat thiⁿ-sek ê lâng bōe khì siu-koah.
Sìⁿ-miā ê oa̍h-khì án-chóaⁿ tī lāu-bú ê chú-kiong chiâⁿ-chòe hêng-thé, lí m̄ chai; chhòng-chō bān-mi̍h ê Siōng-tè ê chok-ûi, lí mā m̄ chai.
Chá-khí-sî tio̍h iā-chéng, kàu ē-hng-sî chhiú mā m̄-thang thêng; in-ūi lí m̄ chai ōe kiat-si̍t--ê sī chit-ê á-sī hit-ê; á-sī nn̄g ê lóng ōe kiat-si̍t.
Kng si̍t-chāi chin hó; ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ-tio̍h ji̍t-thâu chin hoaⁿ-hí.
Lâng oa̍h jōa kú, tio̍h khoài-lo̍k hiah kú; m̄-kú mā tio̍h kì-tit o͘-àm ê ji̍t-chí, in-ūi o͘-àm ê ji̍t-chí ōe chin kú. Beh hoat-seng ê sū lóng sī khang-hu.

Siàu-liân-lâng ah, tio̍h tī nî-khin ê sî hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k; tī siàu-liân ê ji̍t, chiàu sim só͘ ì-ài, ba̍k-chiu só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê khì chòe; chóng-sī tio̍h chai, ūi-tio̍h che it-chhè, lí tio̍h tùi Siōng-tè hū-chek.
Tio̍h chiong chhau-hoân tùi lí ê sim sàu-tû, thòng-khó͘ tùi seng-khu tû--khì; in-ūi chheng-chhun bô kú-tn̂g, lóng sī khang-hu.
Tio̍h tī siàu-liân ê sî kì-liām chhòng-chō lí ê Chú. Tī nî-lāu thòng-khó͘ ê ji̍t iáu-bē kàu, chiū-sī lí só͘ kóng “Góa bô khoài-lo̍k” ê nî iáu-bē lâi í-chêng;
tī ji̍t kap kng, ge̍h kap chhiⁿ iáu-bē piàn àm, hō͘ lo̍h-liáu o͘-hûn iáu-bē koh lâi í-chêng;
hit-sî, kò͘-chhù ê lâng phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, ū-la̍t ê ta-po͘-lâng khiau-ku, oe-bō ê cha-bó͘-lâng kiám-chió soah thêng-kang, tùi thang-á teh khòaⁿ ê hū-jîn-lâng ba̍k-chiu ian-n̄g,
thàng koe-lō͘ ê tōa-mn̂g koaiⁿ--teh, oe-bō ê siaⁿ jú sòe-siaⁿ, chiáu-á teh háu ê siaⁿ kiông-beh thiaⁿ bô, cha-bó͘ gín-á chhiùⁿ-koa ê siaⁿ teh-beh tiām--khì;

lâng kiaⁿ peh-koân, kiaⁿ lō͘--ni̍h gûi-hiám m̄-káⁿ chhut-mn̂g; hēng-chhiū khui-hoe, chháu-meh pûi kah bōe thiàu, io̍k-chêng soe-thè; lâng tńg-khì éng-oán ê chhù, kui-tīn sàng-chòng ê lâng tī koe-lō͘ ná kiâⁿ ná háu;
tī gûn-liān-á iáu-bē tn̄g, kim-óaⁿ iáu-bē phòa, chúi-chôaⁿ piⁿ ê chúi-pân iáu-bē sún-hoāi, chhiūⁿ kó͘-chíⁿ-chúi ê chhia-lûn iáu-bē pháiⁿ--khì,
thô͘-hún kui-hôe tāi-tōe, lêng-hûn tò-tńg-khì sù oa̍h-miā ê Siōng-tè hia í-chêng, tio̍h kì-liām chhòng-chō lí ê Chú.
Thoân-tō-chiá kóng, “Khang-hu ê khang-hu, it-chhè lóng sī khang-hu.”
Thoân-tō-chiá m̄-nā ū tì-hūi, koh kè-sio̍k tùi bîn-chiòng thoân-siū tì-sek; i koh chēng-chēng thiaⁿ, chhâ-khó, chiàu chhù-sū phian-pâi chin chōe chim-giân.
Thoân-tō-chiá choan-sim chhē kek-lē lâng ê ōe, chèng-khak kì-lio̍k chin-lí ê ōe.
Tì-hūi ê lâng ê ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhì-kùn; phian-chi̍p-chiá ê ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ tèng-tiâu-tiâu ê teng-á, lóng sī tùi kâng chi̍t ê bo̍k-chiá lâi--ê.
Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, iáu ū chi̍t hāng, lí tio̍h siū khoàn-kài; tù-chheh chōe, bû-kiông-chīn; chheh tha̍k chōe, seng-khu ōe ià-siān.
Chiah-ê sū lí lóng í-keng thiaⁿ-liáu, kiat-bé lâi kóng, tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, kín-sīn siú I ê kài-bēng; che sī choh-lâng èng chīn ê pún-hūn.
Lâng só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì kap it-chhè pì-bi̍t ê sū, bô-lūn hó á-sī pháiⁿ, Siōng-tè lóng beh sím-phòaⁿ.
Só͘-lô-bûn si-koa tiong ê si-koa.
Lâi, ēng lí ê chhùi kā góa chim; lí ê ài-chêng pí chiú khah hó.
Lí ê phang-iû si̍t-chāi chin phang; lí ê miâ chhin-chhiūⁿ tò--chhut-lâi ê phang-iû; só͘-í, bô chi̍t ê cha-bó͘ gín-á bô ài lí.

Chhiáⁿ khan góa, lán kín lâi cháu! Ông ah, chhōa góa ji̍p-khì lí ê pâng-keng, lán lâi hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k; lí ê ài-chêng pí chiú khah hó, bo̍k-koài só͘-ū ê cha-bó͘ gín-á lóng ài lí.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, góa o͘, m̄-kú siⁿ-chòe súi, chhin-chhiūⁿ Ki-ta̍t ê pò͘-pîⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn ê tiùⁿ-lî.

M̄-thang in-ūi góa phê-hu o͘-o͘ ti̍t-ti̍t kā góa khòaⁿ, he sī ji̍t-thâu pha̍k--ê. Góa ê hiaⁿ-tī tùi góa siū-khì, kiò góa khì kò͘ phû-tô-hn̂g; góa soah bōe-tàng chiàu-kò͘ ka-kī ê hn̂g.

Góa sim-ài--ê ah, kā góa kóng, lí tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi teh chhī iûⁿ, tiong-tàu tī tó-ūi hō͘ iûⁿ hioh-khùn, góa chiah bián tī lí tâng-phōaⁿ ê iûⁿ-kûn tiong sì-kòe chhē lí.
Cha-bó͘ gín-á tiong siōng-súi--ê ah, lí nā m̄ chai góa tī tó-ūi, tè iûⁿ-kûn ê kha-jiah khì, tī bo̍k-chiá ê pò͘-pîⁿ piⁿ chhī lí ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á.
Góa ê ài-jîn, góa khòaⁿ lí chhin-chhiūⁿ Hoat-ló chiàn-chhia ê bé.
Lí pìn-piⁿ ê chng-thāⁿ hō͘ lí ê bīn chin súi; lí ê ām-kún kòa chin-chu-liān chin hó-khòaⁿ.
Goán beh kā lí chòe kim ê liān-á, siuⁿ gûn ê liú-á.
Ông chē-toh ê sî, góa ê ná-ta̍t phang-iû chhèng-chhut phang-bī.
Góa chhin-ài--ê, lí sī chi̍t pau bu̍t-io̍h, kòa tī góa ê heng-chêng.
Góa chhin-ài--ê, lí sī chi̍t pha chńg-kah-hoe, tī Ún Ki-tí ê phû-tô-hn̂g lāi teh khui.
Góa ê ài-jîn, lí chin súi, si̍t-chāi chin súi! Lí ê ba̍k-chiu chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu.
Góa chhin-ài--ê, lí chin eng-chùn, góa chin kah-ì! Lán ēng chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chháu-po͘ chòe chhn̂g-pho͘,
ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ chòe chhù ê niû, chhêng-pek-chhâ chòe kak-á.
Góa sī Sa-lûn ê mûi-kùi-hoe, sī soaⁿ-kok ê pek-ha̍p-hoe.
Góa ê ài-jîn tī cha-bó͘ gín-á tiong, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhì-phè lāi ê pek-ha̍p-hoe.
Góa chhin-ài--ê tī ta-po͘ gín-á tiong, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū-nâ lāi ê phōng-kó-chhiū; góa chin ài chē tī i ê ìm-ńg-ē, i ê ké-chí góa chia̍h--khí-lâi chin tiⁿ.
I chhōa góa ji̍p iàn-se̍k-thiaⁿ, ēng ài-chêng ê kî khàm tī góa ê téng-bīn,
ēng phû-tô-koaⁿ-oân pó͘ góa ê la̍t, ēng phōng-kó chān góa ê goân-khì; góa ài i ài kah phòa-pīⁿ.
I ēng tò-chhiú hû góa ê thâu-khak, ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú lám góa.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, góa kí lêng-iûⁿ kap chhân-iá ê lo̍k-bú, khún-chhiat kā lín hoan-hù, m̄-thang phah-chhíⁿ, m̄-thang kiáu-jiáu goán ê ài-chêng, kàu goán hoaⁿ-hí boán-chiok.
Khòaⁿ leh, góa chhin-ài--ê lâi lah; i pôaⁿ-soaⁿ-kè-niá tiô-tiô-thiàu-thiàu teh lâi.
Góa chhin-ài--ê chhin-chhiūⁿ lêng-iûⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k-á; lí khòaⁿ, i khiā tī chhiûⁿ-á gōa, tùi thang-á teh khòaⁿ, tùi thang-á-chí teh thàm.
Góa chhin-ài--ê chhut-siaⁿ tùi góa kóng: Góa ê ài-jîn, góa ê bí-jîn, khí--lâi, lán lâi-khì.
Tang-thiⁿ í-keng kè, hō͘ í-keng soah.
Hoe khui móa piàn-tōe, chiáu-á chhiùⁿ-koa ê sî kàu lah, tī chhân-iá ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ pan-kah ê siaⁿ.
Bû-hoa-kó chiām-chiām sêng-se̍k, phû-tô-chhiū khui-hoe hoat-chhut phang-bī; góa ê ài-jîn, góa ê bí-jîn, khí--lâi, lán lâi-khì.

Góa ê hún-chiáu ah, lí bih tī chio̍h-phāng lāi, tī soaⁿ-giâm ún-ba̍t ê só͘-chāi; kiû lí hō͘ góa khòaⁿ lí ê bīn, thiaⁿ lí ê siaⁿ; in-ūi lí ê siaⁿ un-hô, lí ê bīn chin súi.
Kā goán lia̍h hô͘-lî, hiah-ê sún-hoāi phû-tô-hn̂g ê sòe-chiah hô͘-lî; in-ūi goán ê phû-tô tú-á teh khui-hoe.
Góa chhin-ài--ê sī góa ê, góa mā-sī i ê; i tī pek-ha̍p-hoe tiong teh chhī iûⁿ.
Góa chhin-ài--ê ah, lí tio̍h tī ji̍t liâng-léng, iáⁿ chhun-tn̂g ê sî tńg--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ lêng-iûⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k-á, tùi khâm-khia̍t ê soaⁿ-niá tò-tńg--lâi.
Góa mî--sî tó tī bîn-chhn̂g, góa beh chhē góa sim-ài--ê; góa chhē i, chhē bô.
Góa khí--lâi, tī siâⁿ-lāi sì-kòe kiâⁿ, tī koe-thâu-hāng-bé chhē góa sim-ài--ê; góa chhē i, m̄-kú chhē bô.
Siâⁿ-lāi sûn-lô ê lâng tú-tio̍h góa, góa mn̄g in: Lín ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa sim só͘ ài--ê-bô?

Góa lī-khui in bô jōa hn̄g, chiū chhē-tio̍h góa sim-ài--ê. Góa kā i khîⁿ--teh, m̄ hō͘ i lī-khui; kàu góa chhōa i ji̍p-khì goán lāu-bú ê chhù, chiū-sī hoâi-īn góa hit-keng pâng-keng.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, góa kí lêng-iûⁿ kap chhân-iá ê lo̍k-bú, khún-chhiat kā lín hoan-hù, m̄-thang phah-chhíⁿ, m̄-thang kiáu-jiáu goán ê ài-chêng, kàu goán hoaⁿ-hí boán-chiok.
Hit-ê tùi khòng-iá lâi, hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-hun ê thiāu, ēng bu̍t-io̍h, jú-hiuⁿ, kap seng-lí-lâng teh bōe ê phang-hún hō͘ i hoat-chhut phang-bī--ê sī siáⁿ-lâng?
Lí khòaⁿ, sī Só͘-lô-bûn ê kiō, sì-ûi ū la̍k-cha̍p ê ióng-sū, lóng sī tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ióng-sū tiong kéng--ê.
In lóng gâu ēng kiàm, gâu sio-chiàn; ta̍k-ê io hâ to, hông-pī mî--sî ê gûi-hiám.
Só͘-lô-bûn -ông ēng Lê-pa-lūn ê chhâ, ūi ka-kī chòe chi̍t téng kiō.
Thiāu ēng gûn chòe, kòa ēng kim chòe, chē-ūi ēng chí-sek ê châi-liāu, lāi-bīn sī ēng Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ê ài-chêng pho͘--ê.
Sek-an ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, tio̍h chhut--khì, khì khòaⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn -ông; i tì ông-koan, i ê lāu-bú tī i kiat-hun khoài-lo̍k ê ji̍t kā i tì--ê.

Góa ê ài-jîn, lí chin súi, lí si̍t-chāi chin súi! Lí ê ba̍k-chiu chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu bih tī phè ê lāi-bīn; lí ê thâu-mn̂g chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-tīn soaⁿ-iûⁿ tó tī Ki-lia̍t ê soaⁿ-phiâⁿ.
Lí ê chhùi-khí chhin-chhiūⁿ tú chián-mn̂g kui-kûn ê iûⁿ-bú, sóe chheng-khì tùi chúi--ni̍h peh--khí-lâi; ta̍k-chiah lóng siⁿ siang-siⁿ, bô chi̍t chiah phah-sńg.
Lí ê chhùi-tûn chhin-chhiūⁿ chu-âng ê sòaⁿ; lí ê chhùi siⁿ-chòe chin hó-khòaⁿ; lí ê pìn-piⁿ tī phè ê lāi-bīn, chhin-chhiūⁿ peh-khui ê sia̍h-liû.
Lí ê ām-kún chhin-chhiūⁿ Tāi-pi̍t ê thah kian-kò͘ hó khòaⁿ, tiàu móa ióng-sū ê tún-pâi.
Lí nn̄g lia̍p lin chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t tùi lo̍k-á, chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k-bú ê siang-siⁿ-kiáⁿ, tī pek-ha̍p-hoe tiong teh chia̍h-chháu.
Ji̍t liâng-léng, iáⁿ chhun-tn̂g ê sî, góa beh khì bu̍t-io̍h ê soaⁿ, kap jú-hiuⁿ ê soaⁿ-thâu.
Góa ê ài-jîn, lí si̍t-chāi chin súi, bô chi̍t-tiám-á thang hiâm.

Góa ê sin-niû ah, lī-khui Lê-pa-lūn, kap góa chòe-hé lâi-khì; tùi A-má-ná ê soaⁿ-téng, tùi Sī-nî-ní, chiū-sī Hek-bûn ê soaⁿ-téng, tùi sai ê hia̍t, tùi pà tòa ê soaⁿ kóaⁿ-kín lo̍h--lâi.
Góa ê sió-bē, góa ê sin-niû ah, lí ū toa̍t góa ê sim; lí ba̍k-chiu chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, ēng lí ām-kún ê chi̍t tiâu kim-liān-á chiū kā góa ê sim toa̍t--khì.
Góa ê sió-bē, góa ê sin-niû, lí ê ài-chêng ná hiah bí-biāu. Lí ê ài-chêng si̍t-chāi pí chiú khah hó; lí ko-iû ê phang-bī pí só͘-ū ê hiuⁿ-liāu khah phang.
Góa ê sin-niû ah, lí ê chhùi-tûn tiⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi phang-pâng tih--lo̍h-lâi ê bi̍t; lí ê chi̍h ū bi̍t ū lin; lí ê i-ho̍k ū Lê-pa-lūn ê phang-bī.
Góa ê sió-bē, góa ê sin-niû, sī só--teh ê hn̂g, khàm-ba̍t ê chíⁿ, hong-ba̍t ê chúi-chôaⁿ.
Lí chai-chèng sia̍h-liû ê hn̂g, chhut chin chōe chióng siōng-hó ê ké-chí, koh ū chńg-kah-hoe kap ná-ta̍t-chhiū.
Ū ná-ta̍t kap hoan-âng-hoe, chhiong-pô͘, jio̍k-kùi, kap jú-hiuⁿ, bu̍t-io̍h, tîm-hiuⁿ, kap it-chhè siōng-téng ê phang-liāu.
Lí sī hn̂g-tiong ê chúi-chôaⁿ, oa̍h-chúi ê chíⁿ, tùi Lê-pa-lūn lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê khoe-chúi.

Pak-hong ah, khí--lâi; lâm-hong ah, chhe--lâi; chhe-lâi góa ê hn̂g, hō͘ i ê phang-bī piàn-móa ta̍k só͘-chāi; hō͘ góa chhin-ài--ê ji̍p i ê hn̂g-lāi, hióng-siū siōng-hó ê ké-chí.

Góa ê sió-bē, góa ê sin-niû ah, góa ū ji̍p-khì góa ê hn̂g-lāi, bán góa ê bu̍t-io̍h kap phang-liāu, chia̍h bi̍t-pô͘ kap bi̍t, lim góa ê chiú kap lin. Góa ê pêng-iú, lâi chia̍h, lâi lim; chīn-chêng lâi hióng-siū ài-chêng.

Góa teh khùn, m̄-kú sim iáu cheng-sîn. Thiaⁿ leh, góa chhin-ài--ê teh phah-mn̂g, kóng: Góa ê sió-bē, góa ê ài-jîn, góa sûn-choân ê hún-chiáu, kā góa khui-mn̂g; góa ê thâu-khak hō͘ lō͘-chúi tih-tâm, góa ê thâu-mn̂g tâm-lok-lok.
Góa í-keng thǹg-saⁿ, tio̍h koh chhēng o͘h? Góa í-keng sóe-kha, tio̍h koh phah lâ-sâm o͘h?
Góa chhin-ài--ê tùi mn̂g-phāng chhun-chhiú ji̍p--lâi; góa ê sim ūi-tio̍h i kek-tōng.
Góa khí--lâi, beh kā góa chhin-ài--ê khui-mn̂g; bu̍t-io̍h tùi góa ê siang-chhiú tih--lo̍h-khì, tùi chńg-thâu-á tih lo̍h-khì mn̂g-chhòaⁿ.
Góa kā góa chhin-ài--ê khui-mn̂g; m̄-kú góa só͘ ài--ê í-keng oa̍t-tńg-sin khì ah. I tú-chiah kóng ê ōe, hō͘ góa sîn-put-hū-thé. Góa chhē i, chhē bô; góa kiò i, i bô ìn.
Siâⁿ-lāi sûn-lô ê lâng tú-tio̍h góa, phah góa, siong góa; kò͘ siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê lâng chiong góa moa seng-khu ê kun chhiúⁿ--khì.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, góa pài-thok lín, lín nā tú-tio̍h góa chhin-ài--ê, tio̍h kā i kóng: Góa in-ūi ài-chêng tì-pīⁿ.

Lí chit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á tiong siōng-súi--ê ah, lí chhin-ài--ê, pí pa̍t-lâng chhin-ài--ê ū sím-mi̍h khah hó? Lí chhin-ài--ê, pí pa̍t-lâng chhin-ài--ê ū sím-mi̍h khah hó, ta̍t-tit goán tah-èng lí ê iau-kiû?
Góa chhin-ài--ê eng-chùn koh ióng-chòng, sī bān-lâng tiong ê tē-it.
I ê thâu-khak ná sûn-kim; i ê thâu-mn̂g ām koh khiû, o͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ o͘-a.
I ê ba̍k-chiu chhin-chhiūⁿ hioh tī khoe-piⁿ ê hún-chiáu, ēng lin sóe--kè, chhin-chhiūⁿ pó-chio̍h an-tì hó-sè.
I ê chhùi-phóe chhin-chhiūⁿ hoe-hn̂g chhèng-chhut phang-bī; i ê chhùi-tûn chhin-chhiūⁿ pek-ha̍p-hoe, tih-lo̍h chin phang ê bu̍t-io̍h.
I ê siang-chhiú chhin-chhiūⁿ kim ê koáiⁿ siuⁿ chhiⁿ-ge̍k; i ê seng-khu chhin-chhiūⁿ kng-ku̍t ê chhiūⁿ-gê siuⁿ nâ-pó-chio̍h.
I ê siang-kha chhin-chhiūⁿ tāi-lí-chio̍h ê thiāu, an-tì tī sûn-kim ê chō; i ê thé-keh hiông-úi chhin-chhiūⁿ Lê-pa-lūn, súi chhin-chhiūⁿ pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū.
I ê chhùi chin tiⁿ, lâng-lâng ì-ài. Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, i chiū-sī góa chhin-ài--ê, sī góa ê ài-jîn.
Lí chit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á tiong siōng-súi--ê ah, lí chhin-ài--ê khì tó-ūi? Lí chhin-ài--ê oa̍t-tńg khì tó-ūi? Goán thang kap lí chòe-hé khì chhē.
Góa chhin-ài--ê lo̍h-khì i ê hn̂g, khì chhèng-chhut phang-bī ê hoe-hn̂g; i tī hn̂g-lāi chhī iûⁿ, koh bán pek-ha̍p-hoe.
Góa sio̍k góa chhin-ài--ê, góa chhin-ài--ê mā sio̍k góa; i tī pek-ha̍p-hoe tiong teh chhī iûⁿ.
Góa ê ài-jîn ah, lí súi chhin-chhiūⁿ Tek-sat, khó-ài chhin-chhiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, ui-gî chhin-chhiūⁿ gia̍h tōa-kî ê kun-tūi.
Lí ê ba̍k-chiu m̄-thang khòaⁿ góa, in-ūi ōe toa̍t góa ê sim. Lí ê thâu-mn̂g chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-kûn ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ, tùi Ki-lia̍t ê soaⁿ-phiâⁿ tiô--lo̍h-lâi.
Lí ê chhùi-khí chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-kûn ê iûⁿ-bú, sóe chheng-khì tùi chúi--ni̍h peh--khí-lâi; ta̍k-chiah lóng siⁿ siang-siⁿ, bô chi̍t chiah phah-sńg.
Lí ê pìn-piⁿ tī phè ê lāi-bīn, chhin-chhiūⁿ peh-khui ê sia̍h-liû.
Chiū-sī-kóng ū la̍k-cha̍p ê ông-hō͘, poeh-cha̍p ê pîn-hui, koh ū sǹg bōe liáu ê kiong-lú,

lí sī góa î-it sûn-choân ê hún-chiáu, sī lāu-bú to̍k-siⁿ, te̍k-pia̍t thiàⁿ-sioh ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ. Cha-bó͘ gín-á khòaⁿ--tio̍h, lóng kóng i ū hok-khì; ông-hō͘ pîn-hui mā chheng-chàn i.
Kong-chhái chhin-chhiūⁿ chheng-chá ê kng, súi chhin-chhiūⁿ ge̍h, chhàn-lān chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t, ui-gî chhin-chhiūⁿ gia̍h tōa-kî ê kun-tūi, hit-ê sī siáⁿ-lâng?
Góa lo̍h-khì hu̍t-thô-hn̂g, beh khòaⁿ soaⁿ-kok tiong ê ké-chí, khòaⁿ phû-tô hoat-íⁿ á bē, sia̍h-liû khui-hoe á bē.
Put-ti-put-kak, góa ná chhin-chhiūⁿ chē tī chun-kùi ê lâng ê bé-chhia téng.
Thiàu ah, Su-la-bi̍t, thiàu! Se̍h--kè-lâi, se̍h--kè-khì, hō͘ goán khòaⁿ lí teh thiàu-bú. Lín ná teh khòaⁿ Su-la-bi̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh khòaⁿ nn̄g tūi ê peng thiàu-bú?
Chun-kùi ê cha-bó͘ gín-á, lí chhēng-ôe ê kha ná hiah súi! Lí tōa-thúi ê khiok-sòaⁿ, súi chhin-chhiūⁿ chu-pó, sī gē-su̍t-ka ê kia̍t-chok.
Lí ê tō͘-châi chhin-chhiūⁿ poe îⁿ-îⁿ, ū tiâu-hô ê chiú put-sî móa-kîⁿ. Lí ê pak-tó͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-tui ê be̍h, ū pek-ha̍p-hoe ûi--teh.
Lí nn̄g lia̍p lin chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t tùi lo̍k-á, chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k-bú ê siang-siⁿ-kiáⁿ.

Lí ê ām-kún chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiūⁿ-gê ê thah, ba̍k-chiu chhin-chhiūⁿ Hi-si̍t-pún ê chúi-tî, tī Pa-te̍k La-pèng ê siâⁿ-mn̂g piⁿ. Lí ê phīⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ Lê-pa-lūn ê thah, bīn ǹg Tāi-má-sū-kek.
Lí ê thâu gia̍h-koân-koân chhin-chhiūⁿ Ka-bi̍t-soaⁿ, sûi--lo̍h-lâi ê thâu-mn̂g sī chí-sek, ông ê sim hō͘ i tîⁿ--teh.
Góa sim-ài--ê, lí ná hiah súi, hiah khó-ài, ná hiah-ni̍h hō͘ lâng ì-ài!
Lí ê sin-châi chhin-chhiūⁿ iâ-chó-chhiū; lí ê lin chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-pha ê ké-chí.
Góa kóng: Góa beh peh-khí-khì chit-châng iâ-chó-chhiū bán ké-chí. Goān lí ê lin chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-pha ê phû-tô, lí ê khùi chhin-chhiūⁿ phōng-kó hiah-ni̍h phang,
lí ê chhùi chhin-chhiūⁿ siōng-hó ê chiú. Goān hit-ê chiú lâu-ji̍p góa chhin-ài--ê ê chhùi, lim-liáu ku̍t-âu.
Góa sio̍k góa chhin-ài--ê, i só͘ loân-bō͘--ê sī góa.
Góa chhin-ài--ê ah, lâi, lán lâi-khì iá-gōa, lâi-khì chng-kha hioh-mî.
Lán thàu-chá khí--lâi, lâi-khì phû-tô-hn̂g, khòaⁿ phû-tô puh-íⁿ khui-hoe á bē, sia̍h-liû khui-hoe á bē; tī hia góa beh chiong ài-chêng hiàn hō͘ lí.
Chhui-chêng-kó chhut phang-bī; tī lán ê mn̂g-piⁿ ū ta̍k-khoán chin hó ê ké-chí, sin--ê kū--ê lóng ū; Góa chhin-ài--ê, che lóng sī góa kā lí pó-chûn--ê.
Lí nā-sī góa ê hiaⁿ-tī, suh-kè goán lāu-bú ê lin, m̄-chai jōa hó! Án-ni, góa tī gōa-bīn tú-tio̍h lí, kap lí chim-chhùi, chiū bô lâng ōe khòaⁿ-khin góa.
Góa ōe chhōa lí ji̍p-khì goán lāu-bú ê chhù, i ōe kà-sī góa; góa ōe hō͘ lí lim tiâu-hô ê chiú kap sia̍h-liû ê chiap.
Lí ēng tò-chhiú hû góa ê thâu-khak, ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú lám góa.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, góa khún-chhiat kā lín hoan-hù, m̄-thang phah-chhíⁿ, m̄-thang kiáu-jiáu goán ê ài-chêng, kàu goán hoaⁿ-hí boán-chiok.

Tùi khòng-iá chiūⁿ--lâi, the tī i chhin-ài--ê ê seng-khu hit-ê sī siáⁿ-lâng? Góa tī phōng-kó-chhiū kha kā lí kiò-chhíⁿ; lí ê lāu-bú tī hia hoâi-īn, tī hia keng-kè chhui-chūn ê thòng-khó͘ siⁿ lí.

Hō͘ góa chhin-chhiūⁿ ìn, khàm tī lí ê sim-lāi; chhin-chhiūⁿ ìn, tǹg tī lí ê chhiú-kut. In-ūi ài-chêng chhin-chhiūⁿ sí hiah-ni̍h ū-la̍t, chêng-jia̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ Im-hú hiah-ni̍h kiông-lia̍t, só͘ hoat-chhut ê iām-jia̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-iām, chhin-chhiūⁿ ke̍k béng-lia̍t ê hé-iām.
Tōa-chúi bōe-tàng phah-hoa ài-chêng; khoe-chúi bōe-tàng kā i siau-bia̍t. Lâng nā ēng i só͘-ū ê châi-sán lâi bóe ài-chêng, it-tēng hō͘ lâng biáu-sī.
Goán ū chi̍t ê sòe-hàn sió-bē, i ê lin iáu-bē hoat-io̍k sêng-se̍k; lâng lâi thê-chhin, goán tio̍h án-chóaⁿ kā i siat-hoat?
I nā-sī chhiûⁿ, goán beh tī i ê téng-bīn khí gûn-thah; i nā-sī mn̂g, goán beh ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ-pán kā i ûi--khí-lâi.
Góa sī chhiûⁿ, góa ê lin chhin-chhiūⁿ nn̄g ê thah; góa chhin-ài--ê chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa, chiū sim-móa-ì-chiok.
Só͘-lô-bûn tī Pa-le̍k Hap-bûn ū chi̍t khu phû-tô-hn̂g; I chiong chit-khu phû-tô-hn̂g cho͘ hō͘ kò͘-siú ê lâng; in ta̍k-ê lâng ūi-tio̍h in ê ké-chí tio̍h la̍p chi̍t-chheng ê gûn.
Góa ū phû-tô-hn̂g, sī góa ka-kī ê; Só͘-lô-bûn ah, hit chi̍t-chheng lí the̍h--khì, nn̄g-pah hō͘ kò͘-siú ké-chí ê lâng.
Tiàm tī hn̂g-lāi ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, tâng-phōaⁿ lóng teh thiaⁿ lí ê siaⁿ, lí mā hō͘ góa thiaⁿ--chi̍t-ē.
Góa chhin-ài--ê ah, kóaⁿ-kín lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ lêng-iûⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k-á, lâi kàu chhèng-chhut phang-bī ê soaⁿ!

Ē-bīn sī A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ Í-sài-a só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê īⁿ-siōng; che sī O͘-se-a, Iok-thán, A-hap-su, Hi-se-ka chòe Iû-tāi -ông ê sî, i só͘ tit--tio̍h iú-koan Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sìn-sit.
Thiⁿ ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ! Tōe ah, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! In-ūi Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa ióng-io̍k kiáⁿ-jî, kā in chhī tōa-hàn, in kèng-jiân pōe-poān góa.
Gû bat ka-kī ê chú-lâng, lû ōe-jīn-tit chú-lâng ê chô; m̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t m̄ bat góa, góa ê chú-bîn lóng bōe-hiáu siūⁿ.”

Ài, hoān-chōe ê bîn-cho̍k! Chōe-ok ke̍k-tāng ê chú-bîn! Chok-ok-to-toan ê cho̍k-lūi! Hêng-ûi pāi-hoāi ê kiáⁿ-sun! In khì-sak Siōng Chú, biáu-sī Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè. In lóng oa̍t-tńg-sin lī-khui I.
Sī-án-chóaⁿ lín ài koh siū piⁿ-phah? Sī-án-chóaⁿ lín beh kè-sio̍k pōe-poān? Lín kui-lia̍p thâu-khak lóng ū pīⁿ, kui-ê sim lóng siū-siong;
tùi thâu kàu kha, bô chi̍t ūi kiān-choân, lóng sī siong-hûn, o͘-chhiⁿ, teh lâu huih ê khang-chhùi; khang-chhùi iáu-bē sóe chheng-khì, iáu-bē pau-chat, mā iáu-bē ēng iû boah.
Lín ê kok-thó͘ pha-hng; lín ê siâⁿ-chhī hō͘ hé sio-húi. Lín chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h chhân-hn̂g hō͘ gōa-kok-lâng thun-chia̍h, hō͘ siⁿ-hūn-lâng thún-ta̍h, pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘.
Chí-ū chhun Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lâu--teh, chhin-chhiūⁿ phû-tô-hn̂g lāi ê chháu-liâu-á, chhì-koe-á-hn̂g lāi ê chháu-pîⁿ-á, chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t ê siū ûi-khùn ê siâⁿ.
Nā m̄-sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kā lán lâu kúi-ê-á chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê chú-bîn, lán chá chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ Só͘-to-má hiah hāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ Gô-mô͘-la hiah chhám!
Lín chiah-ê Só͘-to-má ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe! Lín chiah-ê Gô-mô͘-la ê jîn-bîn ah, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ lán ê Siōng-tè ê kà-sī!

Siōng Chú kóng, “Lín hiàn hiah chōe chè-mi̍h hō͘ góa, ū sím-mi̍h lō͘-ēng? Góa bô hi-hán mî-iûⁿ-káng ê sio-hòa-chè; pûi-chut-chut ê cheng-siⁿ ê iû, góa chin ià. Góa mā bô kah-ì gû-káng, iûⁿ-ko, kap soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng ê huih.
“Lín lâi tiâu-kìⁿ góa, sī siáⁿ-lâng kiò lín tòa chiah-ê cheng-siⁿ lâi thún-ta̍h góa sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ?

M̄-thang koh the̍h bô lō͘-ēng ê chè-mi̍h lâi; hiuⁿ ê bī góa chin iàm-ò͘ⁿ. Chhoe-it, An-hioh-ji̍t, tiàu-chi̍p ê chū-hōe, góa lún bōe tiâu. Góa bōe-tàng iông-jím lín hoān-chōe koh siú giâm-siok-hōe.
Lín chhoe-it kap tēng-kî ê choeh-khèng, góa hui-siông thó-ià; chiah-ê lóng pìⁿ-chòe góa ê tāng-tàⁿ, góa chin hoân, bô ài koh taⁿ.
Lín chhiú gia̍h-koân-koân kî-tó ê sî, góa ōe ng ba̍k-chiu m̄ khòaⁿ lín; lín kî-tó jōa-chōe piàn, góa mā m̄ thiaⁿ; in-ūi lín siang-chhiú lóng bak-tio̍h thâi-lâng ê huih.
Lín tio̍h sóe, sóe hō͘ chheng-khì; tio̍h tû-khì it-chhè siâ-ok ê hêng-ûi, hō͘ góa bô koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín teh chòe pháiⁿ.
Tio̍h ha̍k-si̍p kiâⁿ-hó. Tio̍h tui-kiû chèng-gī, kái-kiù siū khi-ap--ê; tio̍h ūi ko͘-jî sin-oan, ūi kóaⁿ-hū piān-hō͘.”

Siōng Chú kóng, “Lâi, lán lâi piān-lūn! Sui-jiân lín ê chōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chu-âng, iáu ōe pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ seh hiah pe̍h; sui-jiân chhin-chhiūⁿ o͘-tò͘-âng, iáu ōe pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-mn̂g hiah pe̍h.
Lín nā goān-ì thiaⁿ-thàn, lín ōe-tàng chia̍h thó͘-tōe chhut-sán siōng-hó ê mi̍h.
M̄-kú lín nā m̄ sūn-thàn, hoán-poān, lín ōe siū to-kiàm thun-bia̍t.” Siōng Chú chhin-chhùi án-ni soan-pò͘.

Pún-lâi tiong-sêng ê siâⁿ kèng-jiân pìⁿ-chòe chhiong-ki! Í-chêng siâⁿ-lāi chhiong-móa chèng-ti̍t, kong-gī tī lāi-bīn khiā-khí; kin-á-ji̍t tòa tī hia--ê sī thâi-lâng ê hiong-siú!
Lí ê gûn í-keng pìⁿ-chòe che-tái; lí ê chiú lóng thàu chúi.

Lí ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ pōe-poān, pìⁿ-chòe chha̍t ê tâng-phōaⁿ; in lóng ài siu hóe-lō͘, sì-kòe iau-kiû lâng sàng-lé. In bô ūi ko͘-jî chú-chhî kong-tō; kóaⁿ-hū ê khòng-sò͘, in m̄ chhap.

Só͘-í, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Tāi-lêng-chiá án-ni kóng, “Ah, lí chiâⁿ-chòe góa ê tùi-te̍k! Góa beh chiong tōa siū-khì piàⁿ tī lí téng-bīn; góa beh pò-ho̍k te̍k-tùi góa ê lâng!
Góa beh hē-chhiú chhú-hoa̍t lí; góa beh chiong lí ê che-tái liān chheng-khì, chiong cha̍p-chit lóng tû-chīn.

Góa beh têng-sin siat-li̍p lí ê sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-chêng chi̍t-iūⁿ; koh siat-li̍p lí ê chham-bô͘, kap khí-chho͘ siâng-khoán. Jiân-āu, lí ōe koh kiò-chòe Kong-gī ê Siâⁿ, Tiong-sêng chi To͘.”
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe in-ūi kong-pêng tit-tio̍h kiù-sio̍k; siâⁿ-lāi hoán-hóe ê lâng ōe in-ūi kong-gī tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.
M̄-kú pōe-ge̍k--ê kap chōe-jîn ōe chòe-chi̍t-ē siū phah-chhùi; khì-choa̍t Siōng Chú ê lâng ōe bia̍t-bông.
Lín í-chêng só͘ ì-ài sèng ê siōng-chhiū, lín ōe in-ūi i kám-kak kiàn-siàu. Lín chá-chêng soán-te̍k ê hn̂g-á, taⁿ ōe in-ūi i kám-kak pháiⁿ-sè.
In-ūi lín ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hio̍h teh-beh ta--khì ê siōng-chhiū, chhin-chhiūⁿ bô chúi ê hn̂g-á.
Ū koân-sè--ê ōe pìⁿ-chòe hé-chéng, i ê só͘-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-chhiⁿ, nn̄g hāng chòe-chi̍t-ē to̍h--khí-lâi, bô lâng ōe-tàng kā i phah-hoa.
A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ Í-sài-a só͘ tit--tio̍h iú-koan Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sìn-sit.
Tī chiong-lâi ê ji̍t-chí, Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê soaⁿ ōe kian-li̍p tī chèng-soaⁿ ê téng-bīn, pí lóng-chóng ê soaⁿ-niá khah koân; bān-kok lóng ōe ek óa-lâi kui I.

Bān-bîn ōe lâi, kóng, “Lán lâi chiūⁿ Siōng Chú ê soaⁿ, lâi-khì Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè ê tiān. I ōe ēng I ê tō-lō͘ kà-sī lán, hō͘ lán thang kiâⁿ I ê lō͘.” Lu̍t-hoat ōe tùi Sek-an hoat-chhut; Siōng Chú ê ōe ōe tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng thoân-khui.

Siōng Chú ōe tī lia̍t-kok tiong si-hêng sím-phòaⁿ, tī bān-bîn tiong pâi-kái hun-cheng. In ōe chiong to phah-chòe lôe-thâu, chiong chhiuⁿ phah-chòe liâm-to. Chit-kok bōe koh gia̍h to kong-kek hit-kok, in mā bián koh o̍h chiàn-cheng.
Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi ah, lâi! Lán tio̍h khò Siōng Chú ê kng lâi kiâⁿ.

Siōng-tè ah, lí ū khì-sak lí ê chú-bîn Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi, in-ūi kok-lāi ta̍k só͘-chāi lóng ū tang-hng lâi ê hong-sio̍k, jîn-bîn chhin-chhiūⁿ Hui-lī-sū -lâng teh pok-kòa, koh thàn gōa-kok-lâng ê si̍p-koàn.
Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kok kim gûn móa-móa sī; in ê châi-pó sǹg bōe liáu. In ê tōe chiàn-bé chin chōe; in ê chiàn-chhia bōe-tàng kè-sǹg.
Choân-kok ta̍k só͘-chāi to ū ngó͘-siōng; in kūi-pài ka-kī ê chhiú só͘ chō--ê, pài ka-kī ê chńg-thâu-á lia̍p-chō ê sîn-bêng.
Só͘-í, lâng siū khut-jio̍k, ta̍k-ê lâng pìⁿ-chòe pi-chiān. Siōng Chú ah, m̄-thang sià-bián in.
Tio̍h bih ji̍p-khì chio̍h-tōng! Tio̍h chhàng ji̍p-khì thô͘-tóe! Siám-pī tùi Siōng Chú lâi ê khióng-pò͘, cháu-siám I ui-giâm ê kong-hui.
Hit-ji̍t, ba̍k-thâu-koân ê lâng ōe siū kàng-kē, kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng ōe siū khut-jio̍k. Chí-ū Siōng Chú siū ko-kú tit-tio̍h chun-chông!
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê ji̍t teh-beh lîm-kàu; I beh hō͘ só͘-ū kiau-ngō͘ chū-ko ê lâng pìⁿ pi-chiān, hō͘ ko-kú ka-kī ê lâng lóng siū bú-jio̍k.
I beh hō͘ Lê-pa-lūn koân koh tōa ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū, Pa-san ê siōng-chhiū,
só͘-ū ê koân-soaⁿ, it-chhè ê sió-soaⁿ,
só͘-ū ê pó-lúi, it-chhè kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ,
só͘-ū Tha-si ê chûn-chiah, it-chhè súi ê phâng-chûn, lóng siū kong-kek.
Āu-lâi, chū-ko ê lâng ōe siū khut-jio̍k; kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng ōe siū kàng-kē. Tī hit-ji̍t, chí-ū Siōng Chú siū ko-kú tit-tio̍h chun-chông.
Ngó͘-siōng ōe oân-choân siau-sit.

Tī Siōng Chú khí-lâi hō͘ tōe tōa iô-tāng ê sî, lâng ōe bih ji̍p-khì chio̍h-tōng, chhàng ji̍p-khì thô͘-khang, beh siám-pī tùi Siōng Chú lâi ê khióng-pò͘, cháu-siám I ui-giâm ê kong-hui.
Tī hit-ji̍t, lâng ōe chiong ēng kim gûn chō lâi pài ê ngó͘-siōng hiat-ka̍k hō͘ chhân-chhú kap bi̍t-pô.

Tī Siōng Chú khí-lâi hō͘ tōe tōa iô-tāng ê sî, lâng ōe cháu ji̍p-khì chio̍h-tōng lāi, á-sī bih tī soaⁿ-piah phāng, beh siám-pī tùi Siōng Chú lâi ê khióng-pò͘, cháu-siám I ui-giâm ê kong-hui.
M̄-thang óa-khò ōe-sí ê lâng; in put-kò khò phīⁿ-khang teh chhoán-khùi. In lóng bô sǹg sím-mi̍h.
Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe beh tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi tû-khì in só͘ óa-khò, só͘ i-óa--ê, chiū-sī só͘ óa-khò ê bí-niû, só͘ i-óa ê chúi;
tû-khì ióng-sū kap chiàn-sū, sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ kap sian-ti, pok-kòa--ê kap tiúⁿ-ló,
tû-khì koán gō͘-cha̍p ê peng ê kun-koaⁿ kap ū tōe-ūi ê jîn-sū, chham-bô͘, gâu ê sai-hū, kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t--ê.
Góa beh hō͘ gín-á chòe in ê léng-siù, hō͘ eⁿ-á chòe in ê thóng-tī-chiá;
jîn-bîn ōe hō͘-siōng ap-pek: Lâng kong-kek lâng, chhù-piⁿ kong-kek chhù-piⁿ, siàu-liân-lâng tùi lāu-lâng bô-lé, pi-chiān--ê bú-jio̍k chun-kùi--ê.
Lâng ōe tī chhin-cho̍k ê tiong-kan khiú i ê hiaⁿ-tī, kóng, “Lí ū gōa-phàu, lí tio̍h chòe goán ê léng-tō-chiá, lâi chhú-lí chit-ê hūn-loān ê kéng-hóng.”
Hit-sî, i ōe tōa-siaⁿ ìn kóng, “Góa bōe-tàng kā lín i-tī; góa chhù--ni̍h bô chia̍h-mi̍h, mā bô gōa-phàu. Lín m̄-thang kiò góa khì chòe jîn-bîn ê léng-siù!”
Ah, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng í-keng soe-pāi, Iû-tāi í-keng tó-hoāi; in-ūi in ê giân-hêng-kú-chí lóng te̍k-tùi Siōng Chú, hoán-khòng I ui-giâm ê lîm-chāi.
In ê bīn-chhiuⁿ hián-lō͘ in bô chèng-ti̍t; in chhin-chhiūⁿ Só͘-to-má tián ka-kī ê chōe, lóng bô am-khàm. In siū chai-hō, chōe-kai-èng-tit!
Tio̍h kā chèng-ti̍t ê lâng kóng, in ōe bān-sū heng-thong, in-ūi in ōe hióng-siū ka-kī hêng-ûi ê ké-chí.
Siâ-ok ê lâng chhám ah! In ōe tú-tio̍h chai-lān. In ê chhiú án-chóaⁿ tùi-hù lâng, mā ōe án-ni siū pò-èng.
Góa ê chú-bîn ōe siū gín-á khi-ap, ōe hō͘ hū-jîn-lâng koán-hat. Góa ê chú-bîn ah, lín ê chí-tō-chiá chhōa lín kiâⁿ bê-lō͘, hō͘ lín kiâⁿ ê hong-hiòng chhò-loān.
Siōng Chú chiūⁿ-têng khòng-kò; I khiā khí-lâi beh sím-phòaⁿ I ê chú-bîn.
Siōng Chú tùi I ê chú-bîn ê tiúⁿ-ló kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ thê-chhut kò-sò͘, “Lín thun-chia̍h phû-tô-hn̂g; lín ê chhù-lāi ū tùi sàn-chhiah-lâng chhiúⁿ--lâi ê châi-bu̍t.
Lín ná hiah hó-táⁿ ap-chè góa ê chú-bîn, géng-chhùi sàn-chhiah-lâng ê bīn?” Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng.
Siōng Chú kóng, “In-ūi Sek-an ê lú-chú hiah-ni̍h kiau-ngō͘, kiâⁿ-lō͘ ām-kún chhun-tn̂g-tn̂g, khòaⁿ lâng sái-ba̍k-bé, kek chu-sè liam-kha kiâⁿ, kha-khoân khin-khiang-kiò,
só͘-í, Siōng Chú beh hō͘ Sek-an ê lú-chú chhàu-thâu siⁿ-chhng, beh hō͘ in hā-thé lō͘-hiān.”
Tī hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú beh tû-khì in it-chhè súi ê chong-sek-phín: Kha-khoân, thâu-mn̂g-bāng, ge̍h-bâi-chiam,
hī-kau, chhiú-khoân, bīn-phè,
thâu-kun, kha-liān-á, hoe-tòa, hiuⁿ-a̍h, pêng-an-hû,
chhiú-chí, phīⁿ-khoân,
lé-ho̍k, gōa-thò, phoa̍h-kun, phê-pau-á,
chhiú-kiàⁿ, iù-môa-pò͘ ê lāi-saⁿ, lé-bō, í-ki̍p moa seng-khu ê kun.
Phang-bī ōe pìⁿ-chòe chhàu-bī, chho͘ ê soh tāi-thòe io-tòa, súi thâu-mn̂g ōe pìⁿ-chòe kng-thâu, hâ môa-pò͘ tāi-thòe chhēng ko-kip saⁿ, bí-māu ōe ū sio--tio̍h ê siong-jiah.
Sek-an ê ta-po͘-lâng ōe sí tī to-ē, i ê chiàn-sū ōe tī chiàn-cheng tiong sí-bông;
i ê siâⁿ-mn̂g ōe pi-siong ai-khàu; Sek-an ōe hō͘ lâng pak-kng-kng chē tī thô͘-kha.

Tī hit-ji̍t, chhit ê cha-bó͘-lâng ōe khîⁿ-tiâu chi̍t ê ta-po͘-lâng, kóng, “Goán beh chia̍h ka-kī, beh chhēng goán ka-kī ê saⁿ; m̄-kú, chhiáⁿ hō͘ goán kui-sio̍k lí ê miâ, hō͘ goán bián siū kè bōe chhut--khì ê kiàn-siàu.”
Tī hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú ê sin-íⁿ ōe súi koh bō͘-sēng; thó͘-tōe chhut-sán ê ké-chí, ōe chiâⁿ-chòe Í-sek-lia̍t sí-bô-khì ê lâng ê khoa-iāu kap êng-kng.
Hiah-ê lâu tī Sek-an, chiū-sī só͘-ū khiā-khí tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, siū kéng-soán iáu oa̍h--teh ê lâng, in lóng ōe siū hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng.
Siōng Chú it-tēng ōe ēng sím-phòaⁿ ê sîn kap sio-húi ê sîn, sóe-tû Sek-an chū-bîn ê lâ-sâm, tùi in tiong-kan sóe-chheng Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng thâi-lâng ê huih-jiah.

Āu-lâi, Siōng Chú ōe tī kui-chō Sek-an-soaⁿ kap só͘-ū ê hōe-chiòng téng-bīn, tī ji̍t--sî chō hûn, tī mî--sî chō ū ian kap hé-iām ê kng; Siōng-tè ê êng-kng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa pò͘-phâng tah tī choân-siâⁿ téng-bīn.
Án-ni, ji̍t--sî thang jia thài-iông ê iām-jia̍t; kông-hong-pō-ú ê sî thang chòe pī-lān-só͘.
Góa ūi-tio̍h góa só͘ chhin-ài--ê chhiùⁿ-koa, chhiùⁿ chi̍t siú iú-koan i ê phû-tô-hn̂g ê koa: Góa só͘ chhin-ài--ê ū chi̍t khu phû-tô-hn̂g tī chi̍t ê pûi-súi ê soaⁿ-thâu.

I ku̍t thô͘, chiong chio̍h-thâu lóng khioh hiat-ka̍k, jiân-āu chèng chin chōe siōng-hó ê phû-tô-chhiū. I tī hn̂g-lāi chō chi̍t ê siú-bōng-tâi, koh ó͘ chi̍t ê ta̍h phû-tô ê khut-á. I kî-thāi ōe chhut-sán chin chōe hó ê phû-tô, m̄-kú só͘ kiat--ê lóng sī bái--ê.
Taⁿ, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kap Iû-tāi -lâng ah, chhiáⁿ lín tī góa kap góa ê phû-tô-hn̂g tiong-kan chú-chhî kong-tō.
Góa tio̍h koh ūi-tio̍h góa ê phû-tô-hn̂g chòe sím-mi̍h? Kiám ū sím-mi̍h góa iáu chòe bô-kàu? Góa kî-thāi chhut-sán hó phû-tô, sī-án-chóaⁿ só͘ kiat--ê lóng sī bái--ê?

Taⁿ, góa kā lín kóng, góa beh án-chóaⁿ chhú-lí góa ê phû-tô-hn̂g. Góa beh chiong hn̂g ê lî-pa thiah--khí-lâi, hō͘ i siū phò-hoāi. Góa beh thiah-húi hn̂g ê ûi-chhiûⁿ, hō͘ i siū thún-ta̍h.
Góa bô beh koh siu-chián, bô beh koh thóaⁿ-chháu, beh hō͘ hn̂g hong-hòe, hō͘ chhì-á cha̍p-chháu hoat kah móa-sì-kòe; góa mā beh bēng-lēng hûn bô lo̍h-hō͘ tī hia.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê phû-tô-hn̂g chiū-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -ke; I sòe-jī chai-chèng ê phû-tô-chhiū sī Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn. I só͘ kî-thāi--ê sī kong-pêng, m̄-kú só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê sī thâi-lâng lâu-huih; I só͘ ǹg-bāng ê sī kong-gī, m̄-kú chí-ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lâng hoah oan-óng.
Chhám ah, lín chiah-ê lâng, lín ê chhù chi̍t-keng koh chi̍t-keng, thó͘-tōe chi̍t-tè koh chi̍t-tè; lín chiàm kah pa̍t-lâng soah bô ūi thang khiā, kéng-lāi chhun lín teh tòa.
Góa ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng: It-tēng ū chin chōe tōa keng chhù ōe hong-hòe, chin chōe khoah koh súi ê chhù-the̍h bô lâng khiā-khí.
Nn̄g kah ê phû-tô-hn̂g chiah seng-sán jī-cha̍p kong-seng ê chiú; iā cha̍p láng ê chéng-chí siu bô kah chi̍t láng be̍h-á.
Chhám ah, hiah-ê tùi thàu-chá chiū teh jip kāu-chiú lim ê lâng! In lim-chiú lim kàu pòaⁿ-mî, lim kah chùi-bâng-bâng hoat-kông.
In tī iàn-se̍k tôaⁿ-khîm, tôaⁿ-sek, phah-kó͘, pûn phín-á, lim-chiú, m̄-kú bô teh siūⁿ Siōng Chú ê kè-ōe, m̄-bat chù-ì Siōng Chú ê chok-ûi.
In-ūi góa ê chú-bîn bōe-hiáu siūⁿ, in ōe siū hòng-tio̍k chòe hu-ló͘; in tiong-kan ū tōe-ūi ê lâng ōe iau kah teh-beh sí, in ê kûn-chiòng mā ōe chhùi-ta kah beh sí.

Só͘-í, Im-hú ūi-kháu tōa khui, bû-hān-liōng khui tōa-chhùi beh thun-chia̍h; tī in tiong-kan teh iàn-lo̍k ê kùi-cho̍k, chháu-nāu ê pêng-bîn, lóng chòe-chi̍t-ē hō͘ i thun--lo̍h-khì.
Lâng siū khut-jio̍k, sè-kan-lâng siū kàng-kē, ba̍k-thâu-koân ê lâng kàng-chòe pi-bî.
M̄-kú, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe in-ūi kong-pêng siū ko-kú; Chì-sèng ê Siōng-tè in-ūi kong-gī hián-bêng ka-kī sī sèng.
Iûⁿ-á ōe ná-chún tī ka-kī ê bo̍k-tiûⁿ teh chia̍h-chháu; sòe-chiah iûⁿ-á ōe tī hó-gia̍h-lâng pha-hng--khì ê thó͘-tōe chhē-chia̍h.
Chhám ah, hiah-ê ēng khi-chà chòe soh khiú chōe-kò, ēng thoa-chhia ê soh thoa chōe-ok ê lâng!

In kóng, “Siōng Chú tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín, khah kín oân-sêng I ê kang-chok, hō͘ goán ōe-tàng khòaⁿ--tio̍h. Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín si̍t-hêng I ê kè-ōe, hō͘ goán ōe-tàng chai-iáⁿ.”
Chhám ah, hiah-ê kā siān kóng-chòe ok, kā ok kóng-chòe siān ê lâng! In ēng àm chòe kng, ēng kng chòe àm; in ēng khó͘ chòe tiⁿ, ēng tiⁿ chòe khó͘.
Chhám ah, hiah-ê siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī ū tì-hūi, ka-kī chin khiáu ê lâng!
Chhám ah, hiah-ê lim-chiú tián eng-hiông, tiâu-chiú piàⁿ thâu-miâ ê lâng!
In siu hóe-lō͘ phòaⁿ ū-chōe--ê chòe bô-chōe, pak-siah bû-ko͘ ê lâng eng-kai ū ê koân-ek.

Só͘-í, in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ be̍h-kó hō͘ hé-chi̍h thun-chia̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ ta-chháu hō͘ hé sio-liáu-liáu; in ê kun ōe nōa--khì, in ê hoe ná tîn-ai hō͘ hong chhe-sòaⁿ; in-ūi in kū-choa̍t Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê lu̍t-hoat, bû-sī Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè ê ōe.

Só͘-í, Siōng Chú tùi I ê chú-bîn hoat siū-khì; I chhun-chhut I ê chhiú tùi-hù in, phah in; in-ūi án-ni, chèng-soaⁿ iô-choah, koe-thâu-hāng-bé sin-si ná pùn-sò tàn kah móa-sì-kòe. Sui-jiân sī án-ni, I ê siū-khì iáu-bē soah; I ê chhiú iáu chhun-tn̂g-tn̂g beh chhú-hoa̍t in.
Siōng Chú chhāi tōa-kî chòe sìn-hō, tiàu chin hn̄g ê kok-ka lâi; I chhut hō-lēng kiò lâng tùi thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak lâi. Khòaⁿ leh, in chin kín chiū lâi!
Lâi ê lâng bô ià-siān--ê, bô poa̍h-tó--ê, bô tuh-ku--ê, bô ài-khùn--ê; ta̍k-ê io-tòa lóng hâ hó-sè, bô chi̍t ê ôe-tòa tn̄g--khì.
In ê chìⁿ bôa-lāi-lāi, keng lóng tiuⁿ-ân-ân; in ê chiàn-bé ê tôe chhin-chhiūⁿ tēng ê chio̍h, chiàn-chhia ê lián chhin-chhiūⁿ kńg-lê-á-hong.

In âu-kiò chhin-chhiūⁿ sai teh háu, âu-kiò chhin-chhiūⁿ siàu-chòng ê sai teh háu. In kā-tio̍h la̍h-bu̍t hm̄-hm̄-háu, chiong la̍h-bu̍t thoa lī-khui, bô lâng ōe-tàng kā i kiù--chhut-lâi.

Tī hit-ji̍t, in ōe tùi Í-sek-lia̍t hm̄-hm̄-háu, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-hái hōa-hōa-háu. Lâng nā khòaⁿ chit-ê kok-ka, chí-ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h o͘-àm kap chai-lān; ba̍t-hûn jia-khàm, kng-bêng lóng pìⁿ o͘-àm.
O͘-se-a -ông kè-sin hit-nî, góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Chú chē tī chin koân ê pó-chō téng; I ê tn̂g-phàu sûi--lo̍h-lâi, khàm-móa sèng-tiān.
I ê chiu-ûi ū sat-la-hut thiⁿ-sài khiā-teh sū-hāu; múi chi̍t ê ū la̍k ki si̍t, nn̄g ki jia bīn, nn̄g ki jia kha, nn̄g ki chòe si̍t pe.
In pí-chhú ho͘-èng: Sèng--chài, sèng--chài, sèng--chài! Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe! I ê êng-kng chhiong-móa choân-tōe!
Mn̂g-kheng ê kun-ki in-ūi ho͘-èng ê siaⁿ iô-choah, sèng-tiān ū ian móa-móa.

Hit-sî góa kóng: Góa ū chai-hō, góa bia̍t-bông lah! In-ūi góa sī chhùi-tûn bô chheng-khì ê lâng, koh tòa tī chhùi-tûn bô chheng-khì ê lâng tiong-kan. Góa ê ba̍k-chiu ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Ông, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe.
Jiân-āu, ū chi̍t ê sat-la-hut pe óa-lâi góa chia, i ê chhiú ēng hé-ngoeh tùi chè-tôaⁿ téng ngoeh chi̍t tè jia̍t-jia̍t ê thòaⁿ,
chiong thòaⁿ ù góa ê chhùi-tûn, kóng: Taⁿ, chit-ê ù-tio̍h lí ê chhùi-tûn, lí ê chōe-kò í-keng tû--khì, lí ê chōe-ok ū tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Liáu-āu, góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Chú ê siaⁿ, kóng, “Góa thang chhe siáⁿ-lâng? Siáⁿ-lâng beh ūi-tio̍h goán khì?” Góa chiū kóng, “Góa tī chia, chhiáⁿ chhe góa!”
I koh kóng, “Lí khì kā chit-ê chú-bîn kóng: Lín thiaⁿ koh thiaⁿ, m̄-kú bōe bêng-pe̍k; lín khòaⁿ koh khòaⁿ, m̄-kú bōe liáu-kái.
Lí tio̍h hō͘ chit-ê chú-bîn ê sim tūn, hī-khang tāng, ba̍k-chiu hoe; chiah bián in ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, hī-á thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, sim bêng-pe̍k, oa̍t tò-tńg lâi tit-tio̍h i-tī.”
Góa chiū kóng, “Chú ah, tio̍h jōa kú?” I ìn, “Tio̍h kàu siâⁿ-chhī hong-hòe, bô lâng tòa, chhù bô lâng khiā, thó͘-tōe thiat-tóe pha-hng.
It-ti̍t kàu Siōng Chú chiong chèng-lâng sóa-khì kàu iâu-oán ê só͘-chāi, kéng-lāi chin chōe thó͘-tōe siū khì-sak;

liân hit só͘-chāi só͘ chhun ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê lâng, mā ōe koh siū húi-bia̍t. Tān-sī, chhin-chhiūⁿ le̍k-chhiū, siōng-chhiū, sui-jiân hō͘ lâng chhò--khí-lâi, m̄-kú chhiū-thâu iáu lâu--teh; hit-ê chhiū-thâu sī sèng ê cho̍k-lūi.”

O͘-se-a ê sun, Iok-thán ê kiáⁿ, A-hap-su chòe Iû-tāi -ông ê sî, Sū-lī-a -ông Lī-sìn kap Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pí-ka chìn-kun kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, m̄-kú kong bōe phòa.

Ū lâng kā Tāi-pi̍t -ke kóng, Sū-lī-a kap Í-hoat-liân liân-bêng; A-hap-su ê sim kap jîn-bîn ê sim lóng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū-nâ lāi ê chhiū hō͘ tōa-hong chhe tín-tāng.
Siōng Chú tùi Í-sài-a kóng, “Lí kap lí ê kiáⁿ Si-a-ngá-su̍t chhut-khì gêng-chiap A-hap-su, tī Siōng-tî ê chúi-kau-kháu, thàng kàu Phiò-pò͘-tiûⁿ ê tōa-lō͘ kìⁿ i,

kā i kóng, ‘Tio̍h kín-sīn, tio̍h tìn-chēng, m̄-bián kiaⁿ. M̄-thang ūi-tio̍h chit nn̄g ki teh chhèng-ian ê hé-pé, chiū-sī teh tōa hoat siū-khì ê Lī-sìn kap in Sū-lī-a -lâng, í-ki̍p Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ, lâi kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ sit-táⁿ.
In-ūi Sū-lī-a kap Í-hoat-liân, í-ki̍p Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ kè-bô͘ kong-kek lí, kóng:
Goán beh chiūⁿ-khì kong-kek Iû-tāi, chhim-chiàm, cheng-ho̍k i; goán beh siat-li̍p Tha-pí-le̍k ê kiáⁿ choh-ông.
Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Chit-ê tāi-chì bōe sêng-kong, it-tēng bōe si̍t-hiān,

in-ūi Sū-lī-a ê siú-to͘ sī Tāi-má-sū-kek, Tāi-má-sū-kek ê siú-léng sī Lī-sìn; Í-hoat-liân ê siú-to͘ sī Sat-má-lī-a, Sat-má-lī-a ê siú-léng sī Lī-má-lī ê kiáⁿ. (La̍k-cha̍p-gō͘ nî lāi Í-hoat-liân it-tēng bia̍t-bông.) Lín ê sìn-sim nā bô chāi, lín choa̍t-tùi khiā bōe ún.’”
Siōng Chú koh tùi A-hap-su kóng,
“Tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè kiû chi̍t ê kì-hō, bô-lūn tùi siōng-kē ê Chhim-ian á-sī siōng-koân ê thiⁿ-téng lâi”.
M̄-kú A-hap-su hôe-tap, “M̄, góa m̄ kiû, góa bô beh chhì-thàm Siōng Chú.”
Sian-ti chiū kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t -ke ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ! Lín hō͘ lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ, kiám sǹg sió-khóa sū? Lín kiám mā beh hō͘ góa ê Siōng-tè iàm-ò͘ⁿ?
In-ūi án-ni, Chú beh chhin-chū hō͘ lín chi̍t ê kì-hō: Khòaⁿ leh, ū chi̍t ê siàu-liân lú-chú ōe hoâi-īn siⁿ-kiáⁿ; i beh kiò-chòe ‘Í-má-lōe-lī’.
Kàu i o̍h ōe-hiáu kū-choa̍t ok, soán-te̍k siān ê sî, i beh ū chhì-jù kap phang-bi̍t thang chia̍h.
In-ūi chit-ê gín-á ōe-hiáu kū-choa̍t ok, soán-te̍k siān í-chêng, lín só͘ teh kiaⁿ hit nn̄g ê ông ê kok-thó͘ lóng ōe thiat-tóe hong-hòe.
Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ A-su̍t -ông tòa--lâi ê hoān-lān lîm-kàu lí, lí ê jîn-bîn, kap lín lāu-pē ê ke; che sī Í-hoat-liân tùi Iû-tāi hun-lia̍t í-lâi m̄-bat ū ê hoān-lān!
“Tī hit-ji̍t Siōng Chú ōe hoat-lēng, tùi Nî-lô-hô ê goân-thâu tiàu-chi̍p hô͘-sîn, koh tùi A-su̍t -tōe tiàu-chi̍p bi̍t-phang lâi.
In lóng ōe pe-lâi hioh tī kiā ê soaⁿ-kok, chio̍h-piah phāng, í-ki̍p it-chhè ê chhì-phè kap chháu-po͘.

“Hit-sî, A-su̍t -ông chhin-chhiūⁿ Chú tùi Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô tùi-hōaⁿ cho͘--lâi ê thì-thâu-to, Chú beh ēng i kā lín ê thâu-mn̂g kap kha-mn̂g, sīm-chì lín ê chhùi-chhiu lóng thì-tiāu.
“Hit-sî, chi̍t ê lâng ōe chhī chi̍t chiah bú ê gû-á, nn̄g chiah bú ê mî-iûⁿ;
in-ūi ū chhiong-chiok ê lin, kok-lāi só͘-ū chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng lóng ōe-tàng chia̍h chhì-jù kap phang-bi̍t.
“Hit-sî, chèng chi̍t-chheng châng phû-tô, ta̍t gûn chi̍t-chheng ê só͘-chāi, lóng ōe hoat chhì-phè cha̍p-chháu.
Lâng tio̍h tòa chìⁿ kap keng chiah káⁿ khì hia; in-ūi só͘-ū ê thó͘-tōe lóng hō͘ chhì-phè cha̍p-chháu khàm-móa.
Só͘-ū ēng tî-thâu chèng-choh--kè ê soaⁿ-tōe, in-ūi ū cha̍p-chháu chhì-phè, lâng m̄-káⁿ koh khì, pìⁿ-chòe pàng gû khì chia̍h-chháu, chhut-chāi iûⁿ thún-ta̍h ê só͘-chāi.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Lí the̍h chi̍t tè tōa tè pang, ēng thong-iōng ê jī siá: Má-he̍k-ní Sa-la-le̍k Hap-si Pā-su.
Góa beh ēng khó-khò ê kiàn-chèng-jîn, chiū-sī chè-si O͘-lī-a kap Iâ-pí-lī-ka ê kiáⁿ Sat-ka-lī-a, ūi góa choh-chèng.”
Góa kap góa ê hū-jîn-lâng lú-sian-ti tâng-pâng, i chiū hoâi-īn siⁿ chi̍t ê ta-po͘-kiáⁿ. Siōng Chú kā góa kóng, “Kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe ‘ Má-he̍k-ní Sa-la-le̍k Hap-si Pā-su.’
In-ūi gín-á ōe-hiáu kiò ‘A-pa’, ‘A-bú’ í-chêng, Tāi-má-sū-kek ê châi-hù kap Sat-má-lī-a tit--tio̍h ê chiàn-lī-phín lóng ōe hō͘ A-su̍t -ông chhiúⁿ--khì.”
Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng,
“Kì-jiân chit-ê chú-bîn kū-choa̍t Se-lô-a bān-bān-á lâu ê chúi, tian-tò khì pa-kiat Lī-sìn -ông kap Pí-ka -ông.
Só͘-í, lí ê Chú beh chhōa A-su̍t -ông kap i hiong-béng ê tāi-kun, chhin-chhiūⁿ Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô kiông-béng ê chúi chhiong-kè hô-kau, móa-kè hô-hōaⁿ,
lâu-ji̍p Iû-tāi, im kàu ām-kún, chō-sêng hoàn-lām.” Í-má-lōe-lī, Siōng-tè kap lán tông-chāi! I ê si̍t thí-khui, khàm-móa kui-phiàn thó͘-tōe.

Lia̍t-kok ê jîn-bîn ah, chòe lín liân-ha̍p kiat chòe-tui; lín ōe thiat-tóe siū húi-bia̍t! Tùi iâu-oán ê só͘-chāi lâi--ê, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Chòe lín pī-chiàn! Lín ōe thiat-tóe siū húi-bia̍t! Chòe lín pī-chiàn! Lín ōe thiat-tóe siū húi-bia̍t!
Chòe lín khì kè-ōe, it-tēng lóng bô-chhái-kang! Chòe lín khì siūⁿ kè-chhek, it-tēng bōe sêng-kong! In-ūi Siōng-tè kap goán tông-chāi.
Siōng Chú ēng tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú khan góa, kéng-kò góa m̄-thang tè chit-ê jîn-bîn ê kha-pō͘ kiâⁿ. I kóng,
“Chit-ê jîn-bîn teh kóng ê im-bô͘, lín m̄-thang tè teh kóng. In teh kiaⁿ--ê, lín m̄-bián kiaⁿ, mā m̄-bián lún.
Lín tio̍h chun-chông góa Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chòe sèng, góa chiah sī lín só͘ tio̍h kiaⁿ-ùi, tio̍h chhoah--ê.
Góa ōe chiâⁿ-chòe sèng-só͘, mā ōe chòe hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t nn̄g kok poa̍h-tó ê chio̍h, that-gāi ê tōa tè chio̍h, chòe Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chū-bîn ê oa̍h-tauh kap lô-bāng.
Chin chōe lâng ōe tī hit téng-bīn tak--tio̍h, poa̍h-tó, siū-siong; in ōe hō͘ lâng bāng--tio̍h, lia̍h--tio̍h.”
Lín tio̍h kā lu̍t-hoat ê chheh kńg--khí-lâi, tī góa ha̍k-seng ê tiong-kan kā kà-sī hong--khí-lâi.
Góa beh thèng-hāu Siōng Chú; I oa̍t-thâu bô khòaⁿ-kò͘ Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi, m̄-kú góa beh gióng-bōng I.

Khòaⁿ leh, góa kap Siōng Chú siúⁿ-sù hō͘ góa ê kiáⁿ-jî, lóng sī I hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiāu-thâu kap kì-hō; Siōng Chú sī tiàm tī Sek-an-soaⁿ ê Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe.

Nā ū lâng kā lín kóng, “Lín tio̍h khì mn̄g khan-bông--ê kap tâng-ki toh-thâu; in ki-ki-kiu̍h-kiu̍h, ēng lâng thiaⁿ-bô ê ōe liām-tang-liām-sai. Jîn-bîn kiám bōe-ēng-tit kiû-mn̄g in ê sîn-bêng, á-sī thòe oa̍h-lâng khì mn̄g sí--khì ê lâng?”
Bōe-ēng--tit! Tio̍h chhéng-sī lu̍t-hoat kap kà-sī! Hiah-ê kóng-ōe bô chiàu lu̍t-hoat kap kà-sī ê lâng, in bōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h thiⁿ-kng.
Lâng ōe tī ta̍k só͘-chāi liû-lōng, kan-khó͘, iau-gō; in bô thang chia̍h ê sî ōe khí siū-khì, chiù-chó͘ in ê ông kap in ê Siōng-tè. In gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ thiⁿ,
àⁿ-lo̍h khòaⁿ tōe, chí-ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h kan-khó͘, o͘-àm, khó͘-būn, koh siū kóaⁿ ji̍p-khì o͘-o͘-àm-àm lāi-bīn.

Chóng-sī hit-ê bat siū-kè thòng-khó͘ ê tōe bōe koh-chài ū o͘-àm. Í-chêng, Se-pò͘-lûn ê tōe kap Ná-hut-tha-lī ê tōe siū khòaⁿ-khin, m̄-kú chiong-lâi chit-ê tōe-khu, iân Tōe-tiong-hái ê lō͘, kàu Iok-tàn-hô gōa, sīm-chì kàu gōa-cho̍k ê Ka-lī-lī, lóng ōe tit-tio̍h êng-kng.
Kiâⁿ tī o͘-àm tiong ê lâng í-keng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ tōa-kng; seng-oa̍h tī sí-ìm ê tōe ê lâng ū kng teh chiò in.

Lí hō͘ in ê kok-ka kiông-sēng, hō͘ in tōa hoaⁿ-hí. In tī lí ê bīn-chêng hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh siu-koah ê hoaⁿ-hí, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh pun chiàn-lī-phín ê khoài-lo̍k.
In-ūi lí ū phah-chhùi in teh pē ê taⁿ, kòng-tn̄g in keng-thâu téng ê kùn, at-chi̍h ap-pek-chiá ê piⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ lí húi-bia̍t Bí-tiân ê kun-tūi hit-ji̍t.
Chiàn-sū tī kau-chiàn tiong chhēng ê kun-ôe, kō-tio̍h huih ê kun-ho̍k, lóng ōe chòe chhâ sio.

In-ūi ū chi̍t ê eⁿ-á í-keng ūi-tio̍h lán chhut-sì, ū chi̍t ê kiáⁿ sù hō͘ lán. I beh hū-tam kok-chèng; I ê miâ beh chheng-chòe: Hiân-bêng ê Tō-su, Choân-lêng ê Siōng-tè, Éng-chāi ê Thiⁿ-pē, Hô-pêng ê Kun-ông.

I ê chú-koân bû-kiông; I ê hô-pêng bû-chīn. I beh chē Tāi-pi̍t ê pó-chō, kè-sêng i ê ông-kok. I beh ēng kong-pêng chèng-gī hō͘ kok ún-kò͘ kian-li̍p, tùi chit-sî ti̍t-kàu éng-oán. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê jia̍t-sêng it-tēng ōe sêng-choân chit-ê sū.
Chú ū soan-kò beh kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t ông-kok; chit-ê sím-phòaⁿ beh kàng-lo̍h tī Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi.
Só͘-ū Í-hoat-liân ê jîn-bîn kap Sat-má-lī-a ê chū-bîn lóng chai, m̄-kú in iáu chū-ko kiau-ngō͘, kóng,
“Chng-á-chhù í-keng tó--lo̍h-khì, goán beh ēng phah-hó ê chio̍h têng-khí. Sng-châi-chhiū í-keng hō͘ lâng chhò-liáu, goán ōe ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū tāi-thòe.”
Só͘-í Siōng Chú kek in ê te̍k-jîn Lī-sìn -ông khí-lâi kong-kek Í-sek-lia̍t.

Tang ū Sū-lī-a -lâng, sai ū Hui-lī-sū -lâng, in lóng khui tōa-chhùi beh thun-chia̍h Í-sek-lia̍t. Sui-jiân sī án-ni, Siōng Chú ê siū-khì iáu-bē soah; I ê chhiú iáu chhun-tn̂g-tn̂g beh chhú-hoa̍t in.
M̄-kú, jîn-bîn bô hóe-kái kui-ǹg phah in ê Siōng Chú, mā bô chhē-kiû Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe.
Só͘-í, Siōng Chú beh chiong Í-sek-lia̍t ê thâu kap bé-liu — chang-chhiū-ki kap lô͘-úi — tī chi̍t ji̍t lāi lóng chām-tn̄g.
Tiúⁿ-ló kap ū tōe-ūi ê lâng chiū-sī thâu; ēng pe̍h-chha̍t kà lâng ê sian-ti sī bé-liu.
Chiah-ê léng-siù chhōa chit-ê chú-bîn kiâⁿ m̄-tio̍h ê lō͘; hō͘ in chhōa ê lâng lóng siū thun-bia̍t.

Só͘-í, Chú bô beh lîn-bín in ê siàu-liân-lâng, mā bô beh thiàⁿ-sioh in ê ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū; in-ūi só͘-ū ê lâng lóng bû-hoat-bû-thian, ta̍k-ê chhùi kóng ê ōe lóng sī siâ-ok. Sui-jiân sī án-ni, Siōng Chú ê siū-khì iáu-bē soah; I ê chhiú iáu chhun-tn̂g-tn̂g beh chhú-hoa̍t in.
Siâ-ok chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh sio, thun-bia̍t chhì-phè iá-chháu; hé tī ām-ām ê chhiū-nâ teh to̍h, hé-hun ná hûn-thiāu ti̍t-ti̍t chhèng-koân.
In-ūi Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê tōa siū-khì, thó͘-tōe sio kah ta-ta-ta; jîn-bîn lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ thun-bia̍t lâng ê hé, kā ka-kī ê hiaⁿ-tī sio kah chhun bô pòaⁿ-ê.
Jîn-bîn chiàⁿ-pêng chhiúⁿ, iáu-teh iau, tò-pêng thun-chia̍h, iáu chia̍h bōe pá; ta̍k-ê lâng lóng chia̍h ka-kī kiáⁿ-jî ê bah.

Má-ná-se thun Í-hoat-liân, Í-hoat-liân chia̍h Má-ná-se; in liân-ha̍p kong-kek Iû-tāi. Sui-jiân sī án-ni, Siōng Chú ê siū-khì iáu-bē soah; I ê chhiú iáu chhun-tn̂g-tn̂g beh chhú-hoa̍t in.
Chhám ah, hiah-ê chè-tēng put-gī ê hoat-lu̍t, siá phòaⁿ-koat-su khi-ap góa ê chú-bîn ê lâng!
Lín pak-siah sàn-chhiah-lâng ê koân-ek, pak-toa̍t khùn-khó͘-lâng èng-iú ê kong-chèng, chiong kóaⁿ-hū chòe lín ê la̍h-bu̍t, ko͘-jî chòe lín ê chiàn-lī-phín.
Tī sím-phòaⁿ ê ji̍t, chai-lān tùi iâu-oán ê só͘-chāi lâi ê sî, lín beh án-chóaⁿ? Lín beh tùi siáⁿ-lâng kiû pang-chān? Lín ê châi-hù beh lâu hō͘ siáⁿ-lâng?

Lín chí-ū khut tī hu-ló͘ tiong-kan, á-sī siū sat-hāi tó tī si-thé tiong. Sui-jiân sī án-ni, Siōng Chú ê siū-khì iáu-bē soah; I ê chhiú iáu chhun-tn̂g-tn̂g beh chhú-hoa̍t lín.
Chhám ah, A-su̍t! Góa siū-khì ê kùn, góa chhiú-tiong só͘ gia̍h siū-khì ê koáiⁿ.

Góa bēng-lēng i khì tùi-hù bû-hoat-bû-thian ê kok-bîn, phài i khì kong-kek góa só͘ thòng-hūn ê jîn-bîn; chhiúⁿ in ê chiàn-lī-phín, toa̍t in chhiúⁿ-toa̍t ê mi̍h, koh thún-ta̍h in, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh lap koe-lō͘ ê lō͘-kô͘-bê.
M̄-kú che m̄-sī A-su̍t ê kè-ōe, i ê bo̍k-te̍k m̄-sī kan-ta án-ni. I chûn-sim beh húi-bia̍t koh-khah chōe ê kok-ka.
I khoa-kháu kóng, “Góa ê chí-hui-koaⁿ ta̍k-ê lóng sī chiàng-châi.
Góa ū cheng-ho̍k Ka-le̍k-lô, mā ū cheng-ho̍k Ka-ki-bí-si. Góa ū cheng-ho̍k Hap-má, mā ū cheng-ho̍k A-ní-poa̍t. Góa ū cheng-ho̍k Sat-má-lī-a, mā ū cheng-ho̍k Tāi-má-sū-kek.
Góa ê chhiú í-keng chhun kàu pài ngó͘-siōng ê kok-ka; in ê ngó͘-siōng pí Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Sat-má-lī-a ê ngó͘-siōng khah chōe.
Góa kiám m̄-bián tùi-hù Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap i ê ngó͘-siōng, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ū tùi-hù Sat-má-lī-a kap i ê ngó͘-siōng?”
Chú tī Sek-an-soaⁿ kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng oân-sêng I beh chòe it-chhè ê kang-chok liáu-āu, beh chhú-hoa̍t chū-ko chū-tāi ê A-su̍t -ông kap i ê kiau-ngō͘.

In-ūi i kóng, “Góa khò ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t kap tì-hūi oân-sêng chit-ê sū, in-ūi góa chin ū pún-sū. Góa ū hòe-tû kok kap kok chi kan ê kéng-kài, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t in ê châi-pó. Góa chhin-chhiūⁿ ióng-sū chè-ho̍k kun-ông.
