Góa ê chhiú ū la̍k-tio̍h lâng ê châi-hù, ná teh the̍h chiáu-á-siū. Góa tit-tio̍h choân-tōe, chhin-chhiūⁿ khioh-tio̍h lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê chiáu-á-nn̄g; bōe ū chiáu-á phia̍t si̍t kā góa heh-kiaⁿ, mā bô chiáu-á khui chhùi chiu̍h-chiu̍h-kiò hoán-khòng.”
Pó͘-thâu kiám thang tùi ēng i chhò-chhâ ê lâng khoa-kháu? Kù-á kiám thang tián i pí thoa kù-á--ê khah gâu? Sī lâng teh ēng kùn-á, m̄-sī kùn-á teh ēng lâng!
Só͘-í, Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe beh hō͘ ióng-chòng ê lâng pīⁿ kah siau-sán-lo̍h-bah, beh tiám hé kā in ê êng-hôa sio-tiāu.
Hit-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Kng ōe pìⁿ-chòe hé, i sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè pìⁿ-chòe hé-iām, tī chi̍t ji̍t lāi kā chhin-chhiūⁿ chhì-phè kap iá-chháu ê A-su̍t -ông sio-bia̍t.
I bō͘-sēng ê chhiū-nâ kap chin pûi ê chhân-hn̂g ōe thiat-tóe siū húi-hoāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ pīⁿ-lâng soe-jio̍k, sí--khì, siau-sit.
Chhiū-nâ lāi chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê chhiū chin chió, liân gín-á to ōe-hiáu sǹg.

Tī hit-ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn, Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi sí-bô-liáu ê lâng bōe koh khì óa-khò kong-kek in ê lâng; in beh kian-tēng óa-khò Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè.
Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi só͘ chhun ê lâng ōe tò-tńg-khì tōa koân-lêng ê Siōng-tè hia.

Sui-jiân lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-piⁿ ê soa hiah chōe, in tiong-kan chí-ū chhun kúi-ê-á ōe tńg--lâi. Húi-bia̍t ê sū í-keng koat-tēng, in-ūi Siōng Chú tōa-tōa si-hêng kong-gī.
Án-ni, Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chiàu I só͘ koat-tēng, beh thiat-tóe húi-hoāi choân-tōe.

Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe khak-si̍t ū án-ni kóng, “Tòa tī Sek-an góa ê chú-bîn ah, sui-jiân A-su̍t ēng koáiⁿ kā lín phah, chhin-chhiūⁿ Ai-ki̍p ēng kùn kā lín kòng, lín m̄-bián kiaⁿ;
in-ūi góa tùi lín ê siū-khì liâm-piⁿ ōe soah, góa ê siū-khì sī beh hō͘ A-su̍t bia̍t-bông.”

Āu-lâi Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ōe gia̍h I ê piⁿ sut in, chhin-chhiūⁿ I tī Gô-li̍p ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ piⁿ-phah Bí-tiân. I beh chhun I ê koáiⁿ-á tī hái ê téng-bīn, chhin-chhiūⁿ I tī Ai-ki̍p ū án-ni chòe.
Tī hit-ji̍t, A-su̍t hē ê tāng-tàⁿ beh tùi lín ê keng-thâu sóa-cháu, hē tī lín ām-kún ê taⁿ beh kòng-tn̄g.
A-su̍t kong-chiàm Ai -siâⁿ, keng-kè Bí-ki-lûn, hē pó͘-kip-phín tī Bi̍t-boat.
In keng-kè ài-kháu, tī Ka-pa kè-mî. La-má -lâng phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, Sò-lô kò͘-hiong ê Ki-pí-a -lâng tô-cháu.
Ka-lîm ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ hoah; Lâi-soah -lâng ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ; A-ná-tu̍t -lâng ah, tio̍h ìn-tap.
Má-tek-bí-ná -lâng tô-cháu; Ki-pèng ê chū-bîn tô-miā.
Hit-ji̍t, A-su̍t -ông ōe tī Ná-pek thêng-teh pâi-tīn; i beh tāng-chhiú kong-kek Sek-an-soaⁿ, chiū-sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê soaⁿ.

Khòaⁿ leh, Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe beh ēng thang-kiaⁿ ê le̍k-liōng chhò-tn̄g chhiū-ki; tōa-châng chhiū ōe siū chām-tn̄g, chho͘ koh ióng ê chhiū lóng ōe tó kah pîⁿ-pîⁿ-pîⁿ.
I beh ēng pó͘-thâu chhò-pîⁿ chhiū-nâ, liân Lê-pa-lūn siōng-hó ê chhiū to tó-liáu-liáu.
Tùi Iâ-se ê lāu chhiū-thâu ōe puh-íⁿ, tùi i ê kun ōe hoat iù-ki.
Siōng Chú ê sîn beh kap i tông-chāi, chiū-sī hō͘ i ū tì-hūi kap chhong-bêng ê sîn, ū kè-ōe kap lêng-le̍k ê sîn, ū tì-sek kap kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê sîn.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú sī i só͘ ì-ài. I bōe chiàu ba̍k-chiu só͘ khòaⁿ lâi sím-phòaⁿ, mā bōe khò hī-khang só͘ thiaⁿ lâi phòaⁿ-toàn.

I beh ēng kong-gī ûi-hō͘ sàn-chhiah-lâng, ēng kong-pêng pó-chiong hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-bô-khí ê lâng. I beh ēng kong-chèng ê chhâi-koat chòe kùn kòng pek-hāi-chiá, hoat bēng-lēng chhú-sí siâ-ok ê lâng.
I beh ēng kong-gī tī-lí, ēng sìn-si̍t thóng-tī.
Chhâi-lông kap mî-iûⁿ ōe chòe-hé tòa; pà kap soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ chòe-hé khùn. Gû-á-kiáⁿ kap sai-á-kiáⁿ tàu-tīn chia̍h; sòe-hàn gín-á ōe chòe bo̍k-chiá khòaⁿ-kò͘ in.
Gû-bú kap hîm-bú ōe chòe-hé chia̍h; in ê kiáⁿ ōe chòe-tīn hioh-khùn. Sai ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ gû chia̍h-chháu.
Chia̍h-lin ê eⁿ-á ōe tī to̍k-chôa ê khang-kháu thit-thô; tn̄g-lin ê gín-á ōe chhun-chhiú ji̍p-khì to̍k-chôa ê hia̍t.
Tī góa sèng-soaⁿ ê ta̍k só͘-chāi, it-tēng bô siong-hāi, mā bô phò-hoāi; in-ūi tùi Siōng Chú ê jīm-sek phó͘-ki̍p choân-tōe, chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi chhiong-móa tōa-hái.
Tī hit-ji̍t, Iâ-se ê kun ōe chiâⁿ-chòe bān-bîn ê tōa-kî khiā-chāi-chāi. Bān-kok lóng ōe ióng-hō͘ i. I khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi ōe chhiong-móa êng-kng chhàn-lān.

Hit-sî, Chú ōe tē-jī piàn chhun-chhiú tùi A-su̍t, Ai-ki̍p, Pa-te̍k-lô, I-soh-phit-a, Í-lân, Pa-pí-lûn, Hap-má, í-ki̍p iân-hái tōe-khu sio̍k-hôe só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn tò-tńg--lâi.
Chú ōe ǹg bān-kok chhāi tōa-kî, tùi tōe ê sì-hng chū-chi̍p sì-sòaⁿ ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng óa--lâi, chiong siū kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ ê Iû-tāi jîn-bîn chū-chi̍p tò-tńg--lâi.
Hit-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t ê oàn-tò͘ ōe siau-sit, Iû-tāi ê te̍k-sī mā ōe soah; Í-sek-lia̍t bōe koh oàn-tò͘ Iû-tāi, Iû-tāi mā bōe koh te̍k-sī Í-sek-lia̍t.

In ōe tàu-tīn chhiong lo̍h-lâi kong-kek sai-pêng ê Hui-lī-sū, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t tang-pêng ê jîn-bîn. In ōe cheng-ho̍k Í-tong kap Mô͘-ap ê jîn-bîn; A-bûn -lâng ōe khut-ho̍k tī in kha-ē.

Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ Ai-ki̍p ê hái-oan ta-khok-khok; I ōe gia̍h-koân I ê chhiú tōa la̍t ia̍t sio-hong, hō͘ Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô pìⁿ-chòe chhit tiâu ta-khoe, lâng chhēng chháu-ôe mā ōe-tàng kiâⁿ--kè.

Beh ū chi̍t tiâu tōa-lō͘ ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn pī-pān, thang hō͘ in tùi A-su̍t tô-thoat--chhut-lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ kó͘-chá Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhut--lâi siâng-khoán.
Tī hit-ji̍t, lí ōe kóng: Siōng Chú, góa kám-siā lí; sui-jiân lí ū tùi góa hoat siū-khì, m̄-kú lí ê siū-khì í-keng soah, lí ū kā góa an-ùi.
Khòaⁿ ah, Siōng-tè sī góa ê chín-kiù; góa óa-khò I, lóng bōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. Siōng Chú sī góa ê khùi-la̍t, góa ê si-koa; I it-ti̍t sī góa ê chín-kiù.
Lín ōe tùi chín-kiù ê chíⁿ hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k chhiūⁿ-chúi.
Tī hit-ji̍t lín ōe kóng: Tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, kiû-kiò I ê miâ; tio̍h tùi bān-bîn soan-iông I ê chok-ûi. Tio̍h soan-pò͘: I ê miâ eng-kai siū chun-chông.
Tio̍h gîm-si chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, in-ūi I ū kî-biāu ê chok-ûi; tio̍h tùi choân sè-kài soan-iông chit-ê tāi-chì.
Lín Sek-an ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h hoan-ho͘, tōa-siaⁿ chhiùⁿ-koa, in-ūi tī lín tiong-kan ê Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè siōng úi-tāi.
Che sī A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ Í-sài-a tùi Siōng-tè só͘ niá-siū iú-koan Pa-pí-lûn ê sìn-sit.
Tio̍h tī kng-thut-thut ê soaⁿ-téng chhāi chi̍t ki tōa-kî, tùi chiàn-sū hoat hō-lēng; tio̍h kā in ia̍t-chhiú, hō͘ in chìn-ji̍p kùi-cho̍k ê mn̂g.
Góa ū bēng-lēng te̍k-pia̍t kéng--chhut-lâi ê lâng, ū soán-tiàu iāu-bú-iông-ui ê ióng-sū, lâi chip-hêng góa ê siū-khì.

Thiaⁿ leh, soaⁿ-téng ū soan-hoa ê siaⁿ, ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t tōa-tūi kun-peng teh chū-chi̍p! Thiaⁿ leh, ū bān-kok chi̍p-ha̍p chháu-nāu ê siaⁿ! Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe teh tiàu-chi̍p kun-tūi pī-chiàn.
In tùi iâu-oán ê só͘-chāi, tùi tōe ê hit-pêng lâi; in sī Siōng Chú siū-khì ēng ê bú-khì, beh húi-hoāi choân-tōe.
Lín tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ ai-khàu, in-ūi Siōng Chú ê ji̍t kūn lah; Choân-lêng-chiá si-hêng húi-bia̍t ê sî kàu lah!
Só͘-ū ê chhiú-kut lóng ōe sng-nńg bô-la̍t, lâng ê sim ōe siau-iûⁿ sit-táⁿ.

In lóng ōe hō͘ khióng-hông chhiong-móa, hō͘ thàng-thiàⁿ kan-khó͘ khîⁿ--teh. In ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ sán-hū chhui-chūn, kiáu-ká thàng-thiàⁿ, in-ūi khióng-pò͘ gông-ngia̍h, hō͘-siōng siòng-lâi-siòng-khì; in lóng kiaⁿ kah bīn chhiⁿ-sún-sún.
Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú ê ji̍t teh-beh kàu ah! Ū chân-khok, hùn-lō͘, kap tōa siū-khì, beh hō͘ tāi-tōe hong-hòe, hō͘ tōe-chiūⁿ ê chōe-jîn siū húi-bia̍t.
Thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ-sîn thian-thé lóng bōe hoat-kng. Ji̍t-thâu chi̍t-ē chhut--lâi sûi-sî pìⁿ o͘-àm, ge̍h-niû mā àm-tām bô kng.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh in-ūi lâng ê siâ-ok hêng-hoa̍t sè-kài, in-ūi in ê chōe-ok kā in chhú-hoa̍t. Góa beh chiong-chí kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng ê chū-ko, beh chè-ho̍k pō-kun ê chhiong-kông.
Góa ōe hō͘ lâng pí siōng-téng ê kim khah chió, pí Gô-hui ê sûn-kim koh-khah hi-hán.
Góa Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe hùn-lō͘ ê sî, hoat tōa siū-khì hit-ji̍t, beh hō͘ thiⁿ iô-choah, hō͘ tāi-tōe tín-tāng, lī-khui goân-ūi.

“Hit-sî, in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ siū tui-kóaⁿ ê lo̍k-á, chhin-chhiūⁿ bô bo̍k-chiá khòaⁿ-kò͘ ê iûⁿ, múi chi̍t ê lâng lóng ōe tńg-khì ka-kī ê tông-pau hia, ta̍k-ê lâng tô-cháu tńg-khì ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong.
Hō͘ lâng jip--tio̍h-ê, ōe hō͘ chhiuⁿ chha̍k--sí; hō͘ lâng lia̍h--tio̍h-ê, ōe hō͘ to thâi--sí.
In ê eⁿ-á ōe tī in bīn-chêng hō͘ lâng siak kah chhùi-kô͘-kô͘. In ê chhù ōe hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ-kiap; in ê bó͘ siū bú-jio̍k.
“Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh siàn-tōng Bí-tí-a -lâng khí-lâi kong-kek in; Bí-tí-a -lâng bô khòaⁿ-tāng gûn, mā bô ài kim.
In ê keng-chìⁿ ōe siā-tó siàu-liân-lâng; in bōe lîn-bín pak-tó͘ lāi ê eⁿ-á, mā bōe pó-sioh gín-á ê sìⁿ-miā.
Pa-pí-lûn goân-pún sī lia̍t-kok ê êng-kng, Ka-le̍k-tí -lâng khoa-kháu ê êng-iāu, m̄-kú in ōe hō͘ Siōng-tè chhia-tó, tú chhin-chhiūⁿ Só͘-to-má kap Gô-mô͘-la siū húi-bia̍t.
Pa-pí-lûn bōe koh ū lâng tòa, tāi-tāi bōe koh ū lâng khiā-khí. Bô-pòaⁿ-ê A-la-pek -lâng ōe tī hia tah pò͘-pîⁿ, kò͘-iûⁿ--ê mā bōe chhōa iûⁿ-kûn khì hia hioh-khùn.
M̄-kú, khòng-iá ê cháu-siù ōe lâi tó tī hia, tī hia ê chhù ū chin chōe àm-kong-chiáu. Tô-chiáu ōe tī hia choh-siū, iá-soaⁿ-iûⁿ tī hia thiàu-bú.

Chhâi-lông ōe tī in ê pó-lúi kho͘-káu-lê, in chhia-hoa ê kiong-tiān ū chhâi-lông teh háu. Pa-pí-lûn ê kiat-kio̍k í-keng pek-kūn; i bia̍t-bông ê ji̍t bōe koh iân-tî! I ê ji̍t bô kú lah!”

Siōng Chú beh lîn-bín I ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t, koh chi̍t piàn kéng-soán Ngá-kok, kā in an-tì tī in ka-kī ê hiong-thó͘. Chin chōe tòa tī in tiong-kan gōa-cho̍k ê lâng ōe kap in liân-ha̍p, kui-sio̍k Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi.

Chin chōe kok-ka ōe hia̍p-chō͘ in tńg-khì in ê chó͘-kok; Í-sek-lia̍t -ke ōe tī Siōng Chú ê tōe tit-tio̍h gōa-cho̍k-lâng chòe lâm-po̍k lú-pī. Í-chêng lia̍h in--ê taⁿ pìⁿ-chòe in ê hu-ló͘, kè-khì koán-hat in--ê taⁿ beh siū in koán-hat.
Siōng Chú hō͘ lín tùi pi-siong, khó͘-thàng, tùi siū kiông-pek chòe khó͘-kang tit-tio̍h tháu-pàng hit-sî,
lí ōe tùi Pa-pí-lûn -ông chhiùⁿ chit-siú hong-chhì ê si, kóng: Ap-pek-chiá kèng-jiân bia̍t-bông, i ê kiông-pō siau-sit lah!
Siōng Chú í-keng kòng-tn̄g siâ-ok-chiá ê kùn, phah-tn̄g thóng-tī-chiá ê koáiⁿ!
In tī tōa siū-khì ê sî put-toān khi-ap lia̍t-kok, tī hùn-lō͘ tiong chân-khok koán-hat lia̍t-pang.
Choân-tōe tit-tio̍h an-hioh pêng-chēng, só͘-ū ê lâng lóng hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa.
Liân siông-chhiū kap Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū to in-ūi lí ê kiat-kio̍k hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ, kóng: Taⁿ lí í-keng tó--lo̍h-khì, bōe koh ū chhò-chhâ ê lâng lâi kā goán chhò.

Tāi-tōe ē-bīn ê Im-hú hong-tōng, beh gêng-chiap lí ê lâi-lîm. Tōe-chiūⁿ thóng-tī-chiá ê im-hûn lóng siū hoàn-khí, lia̍t-kok kun-ông ê im-hûn tùi in ê pó-chō khí--lâi, hoan-gêng lí kàu-ūi.
In ōe khui-chhùi tùi lí kóng: Lí kap goán siâng-khoán lóng pìⁿ nńg-chiáⁿ! Lí kap goán lóng sio-siâng lah!
Lí ê ui-hong kap lí khîm-sek ê siaⁿ lóng lo̍h kàu Im-hú. Lí khùn ê bîn-chhn̂g pho͘--ê sī thâng; lí kah ê phē sī chhu.
Thiⁿ-kng-chá ê khé-bêng-chhiⁿ ah, lí kèng-jiân tùi thiⁿ lak--lo̍h-lâi! Lí chit-ê lia̍t-kok ê cheng-ho̍k-chiá ah, lí kèng-jiân poa̍h-lo̍h tōe-bīn!

Lí sim-lāi án-ni kóng: Góa beh peh-chiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng, chiong góa ê pó-chō siat tī Siōng-tè chèng chhiⁿ-sîn ê téng-bīn. Góa beh chē tī chū-hōe ê soaⁿ-téng, tī ke̍k pak-pêng ê só͘-chāi.
Góa beh peh-chiūⁿ hûn-téng; góa beh kap Chì-koân-chiá pîⁿ koân.
M̄-kú, lí ōe siū tàn-lo̍h Im-hú, kàu Chhim-khiⁿ siōng-chhim ê só͘-chāi.
Khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng lóng ti̍t-ti̍t kā lí siòng, sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng: Chit-ê kiám m̄-sī hō͘ tāi-tōe iô-choah, hō͘ lia̍t-kok hong-tōng hit-ê lâng?
Chit-ê kiám m̄-sī hō͘ sè-kài pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘, húi-hoāi siâⁿ-chhī, m̄ pàng hu-ló͘ tńg-khì in tau hit-ê lâng?
Lia̍t-kok ê kok-ông ta̍k-ê lóng chin ū chun-êng, an-chòng tī ka-kī ê hûn-bōng.

M̄-kú lí sí bô chòng-sin-chi-tōe; lí ê sin-si hō͘ lâng thó-ià, siū lâng thún-ta̍h, hō͘ chin chōe siū sat-hāi ê lâng ê si-thé khàm--teh, chòe-hé lak lo̍h-khì Chhim-khiⁿ ê chio̍h-thâu hia.
Lí bōe-tàng kap hiah-ê kun-ông tâng bâi-chòng, in-ūi lí húi-hoāi lí ê kok, sat-hāi lí ê jîn-bîn. Goān pháiⁿ-lâng ê hō͘-tāi éng-oán hō͘ lâng bōe-kì--tit.
In-ūi in chó͘-sian ê chōe, lín tio̍h kā in ê kiáⁿ-sun choân-pō͘ tô͘-sat, chiah bián in koh heng-khí, chiàm-iú tāi-tōe, tī sè-kài ta̍k só͘-chāi khí-chō siâⁿ-chhī.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng: Góa beh khí-lâi kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn, beh chhat-siau in ê miâ, châu-bia̍t sí-bô-khì ê lâng, í-ki̍p in ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Góa beh hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn pìⁿ-chòe hô-ti tòa ê só͘-chāi, pìⁿ-chòe lóng sī lō͘-kô͘-bê-khut ê só͘-chāi. Góa beh ēng húi-bia̍t ê sàu-chhiú kā i sàu. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni li̍p-sè kóng: Góa só͘ kè-ōe--ê, lóng ōe hoat-seng; góa só͘ koat-tēng--ê, lóng ōe si̍t-hiān.

Góa beh tī góa ê tōe phah-chhùi A-su̍t, beh tī góa ê chèng-soaⁿ thún-ta̍h i. I khǹg tī góa chú-bîn ê taⁿ, góa ōe kā in sóa-khui; i hē tī in keng-thâu ê tāng-tàⁿ, góa ōe kā in poaⁿ--lo̍h-lâi.
Che sī ūi-tio̍h choân-tōe só͘ tēng ê kè-ōe; che sī chhun chhut-khì beh kong-kek lia̍t-kok ê chhiú-kut.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe í-keng chòe chit-ê koat-tēng, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kā I chó͘-tòng? I chhun--chhut-khì ê chhiú-kut, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng hō͘ i koh kiu tò-tńg?
A-hap-su -ông sí hit-nî, Siōng-tè soan-pò͘ ē-bīn ê sìn-sit:
Lín só͘-ū ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng ah, m̄-thang in-ūi phah lín ê kùn í-keng tn̄g lâi hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi chôa it-tēng ōe siⁿ to̍k-chôa, só͘ siⁿ--ê sī ōe pe ê hé-chôa.

Siōng Chú ōe bo̍k-ióng I ê chú-bîn tiong siōng sàn-chhiah--ê; khiàm-kheh--ê ōe-tàng an-jiân hioh-khùn. M̄-kú, góa beh ēng ki-hng sat-hāi lín Hui-lī-sū ê hō͘-tāi, beh thâi-sí lín só͘ chhun sí-bô-khì ê lâng.

Siâⁿ-mn̂g ah, tio̍h thî-khàu! Siâⁿ-chhī ah, tio̍h âu-kiò! Hui-lī-sū ah, tio̍h kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah! Ū o͘-ian tùi pak-hng teh lo̍h--lâi; kun-peng hiòng-chêng chìn-kun, tūi-ngó͘ tiong bô chi̍t ê tè bōe tio̍h tīn.
Lán beh án-chóaⁿ hôe-tap Hui-lī-sū ê sù-chiá? Lán tio̍h kā in kóng: Siōng Chú siat-li̍p Sek-an, tī hia, I ê chú-bîn tiong khùn-khó͘--ê ōe tit-tio̍h pó-hō͘.
Che sī iú-koan Mô͘-ap ê sìn-sit: Mô͘-ap ê A-ní hong-hòe, tī chi̍t mî ê tiong-kan lóng bô--khì lah! Mô͘-ap ê Ki-ní hong-hòe, tī chi̍t mî ê tiong-kan lóng bô--khì lah!

Tí-pún ê jîn-bîn chiūⁿ-khì in ê sī-biō, tī hia thî-khàu. Mô͘-ap -lâng ūi-tio̍h Nî-pho kap Bí-tí-pa ai-khàu. Só͘-ū ê lâng thâu-khak thì-kng-kng; ta̍k-ê lâng ê chhùi-chhiu thì-liáu-liáu.
In tī koe-lō͘ lóng hâ môa-pò͘, tī kóng-tiûⁿ kap ka-kī ê chhù-bé-téng thî-khàu, ba̍k-sái chha̍p-chha̍p-tih.
Hi-si̍t-pún kap Í-lī-a-lī chhut-siaⁿ khàu; in pi-ai ê siaⁿ tī Ngá-cha̍p to thiaⁿ ōe tio̍h. Só͘-í, Mô͘-ap bú-chong ê kun-jîn tōa-siaⁿ hoah; in ê sim sit-táⁿ, ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah.

Góa ê sim ūi-tio̍h Mô͘-ap thî-khàu; in ê lān-bîn tô-cháu khì Só-ní, kàu I-ki-la Si-lī-si-a. In peh-chiūⁿ Ló͘-hi ê soaⁿ-phiâⁿ, ná peh ná khàu; in tô-cháu khì Hô-lô-liām, in-ūi siū húi-bia̍t tōa-siaⁿ ai-khàu.
Lêng-lîm-khoe ê chúi ta--khì; khoe-piⁿ ê chháu lian--khì, chhài-soe sí--khì, chhiⁿ-chhùi ê mi̍h lóng bô--khì.
Só͘-í, in tit--tio̍h ê châi-bu̍t, só͘-ū tún-chek ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, lóng ōe poaⁿ-khì Liú-chhiū-khoe hit-pêng.
In-ūi ai-chhám ê siaⁿ í-keng thoân-piàn Mô͘-ap sù-kéng; thî-khàu ê siaⁿ thàng kàu Í-ki-liân, thoân kàu Pí-ní Í-lîm.
Tí-bûn hô-liû ê chúi lóng sī huih; m̄-kú, góa Siōng-tè beh ke-thiⁿ Tí-bûn ê chai-lān, ū sai lâi tui-jip Mô͘-ap ê lān-bîn kap hit só͘-chāi liû-bông sí-bô-khì ê lâng.
Lín Mô͘-ap ê lān-bîn tio̍h tùi khòng-iá ê Se-la, sàng iûⁿ-á chòe lé-mi̍h hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê léng-siù.
Mô͘-ap ê jîn-bîn ōe tī A-lūn-hô bô bo̍k-te̍k lōa-lōa-sô, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiáu-á hō͘ lâng tùi chiáu-á-siū kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, ta̍k só͘-chāi liû-lōng, pe-lâi-pe-khì.

In ōe tùi Iû-tāi -lâng kóng: Lín tio̍h kā goán chí-kàu, kà goán tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe. Kiû lín hō͘ lín ê ìm-ńg tī ji̍t--sî chhin-chhiūⁿ àm-mî, kā goán chiah-ê tô-miā--ê khàm--khí-lâi, hō͘ lān-bîn ê hêng-chong bô lâng chai.

Kiû lín iông-ún siū kóaⁿ-tio̍k ê Mô͘-ap -lâng kap lín tòa, thang chòe in ê pī-lān-só͘, hō͘ in bián siū húi-bia̍t. Tng ap-pek thêng-chí, phò-hoāi soah, kiông-pō tùi kok-lāi siau-sit ê sî,
Tāi-pi̍t -ke ū chi̍t ūi ông ōe ēng sìn-si̍t thóng-tī, i ê ông-ūi ōe ēng jîn-ài kian-li̍p; i sī chhē-kiû kong-pêng, si̍t-chián kong-gī ê sím-phòaⁿ-chiá.
Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn kóng: Thiaⁿ-kóng Mô͘-ap -lâng hui-siông kiau-ngō͘, chū-ko chū-tāi, kiau-ngō͘ kàu-ke̍k; in ê khoa-kháu lóng sī khang-khang.
Só͘-í, Mô͘-ap tio̍h thî-khàu, múi chi̍t ê Mô͘-ap -lâng tio̍h ūi Mô͘-ap thî-khàu. Lín ōe in-ūi chia̍h bōe tio̍h Kiat-ní Hap-lia̍t-siat ê phû-tô-koaⁿ-oân ai-siong.

Hi-si̍t-pún ê chhân-hn̂g hong-hòe, Se-pí-má ê phû-tô-chhiū ta--khì. Lia̍t-kok ê kun-ông at-chi̍h phû-tô-chhiū siōng-hó ê ki; hiah-ê ki bat chhun kàu Ngá-siā, soan-khì khòng-iá, sīm-chì pôaⁿ-kè hái, khì kàu gōa-kok.

Só͘-í, góa beh kap Ngá-siā chòe-hé ūi-tio̍h Se-pí-má ê phû-tô-chhiū thî-khàu. Hi-si̍t-pún kap Í-lī-a-lī ah, góa beh ēng ba̍k-sái kā lín koàn-ak, in-ūi lín siu-sêng sêng-se̍k ê ké-chí kap ngó͘-kok hoan-ho͘ ê siaⁿ í-keng soah.

Hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k í-keng tùi ké-chí-hn̂g siau-sit lah. Tī phû-tô-hn̂g bô koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h koa-siaⁿ, mā bô koh ū hoan-ho͘. Bô koh ū lâng tī chiú-khut ta̍h chiú; góa hō͘ hoan-ho͘ ê siaⁿ thêng-chí.
Só͘-í, góa ê sim ūi-tio̍h Mô͘-ap pi-siong, góa ê sim-tn̂g ūi-tio̍h Kiat-ní Hap-lia̍t-siat ai-siong, chhin-chhiūⁿ khîm hoat-chhut ai-oàn ê siaⁿ.
Mô͘-ap -lâng sui-jiân piàⁿ-miā khì soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, koh khì in ê sèng-só͘ kî-tó, chóng-sī lóng bô-chhái-kang.
Í-siōng sī í-chêng Siōng Chú só͘ kóng iú-koan Mô͘-ap ê ōe.

Hiān-chāi Siōng Chú kóng, “Tī saⁿ nî lāi, chiàu chhiàⁿ-kang ê nî-hān, Mô͘-ap ê êng-hôa it-tēng ōe siau-sit, sui-jiân jîn-kháu hiah-ni̍h chōe, m̄-kú chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng ōe chin chió, koh soe-jio̍k.”
Che sī iú-koan Tāi-má-sū-kek ê sìn-sit: Khòaⁿ leh, Tāi-má-sū-kek bô koh sī siâⁿ-chhī, it-tēng ōe pìⁿ-chòe pùn-sò-tui.
A-lô-ní ê siâⁿ-chhī ōe éng-oán hong-hòe, pìⁿ-chòe chhī iûⁿ ê só͘-chāi; iûⁿ tó-teh hioh-khùn mā bōe siū heh-kiaⁿ.

Í-sek-lia̍t bōe koh ū iàu-sài, Tāi-má-sū-kek mā bōe koh ū chú-koân; só͘ chhun ê Sū-lī-a -lâng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sit-khì kong-chhái. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-kò.
Tī hit-ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t ê kong-chhái ōe siau-sit, i pûi-nńg ê seng-khu ōe siau-sán-lo̍h-bah;

chhin-chhiūⁿ siu-koah liáu ê be̍h-hn̂g, chhun ê be̍h-á hō͘ lâng khioh--khì; chhin-chhiūⁿ Lī-hoa̍t-im Soaⁿ-kok siu-koah--kè ê be̍h-hn̂g, chhun ê be̍h-sūi mā hō͘ lâng khioh-liáu-liáu.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan chí-ū chió-sò͘ ōe lâu--teh; in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ tú-á siu-sêng liáu ê kaⁿ-ná-chhiū, chhiū-téng chí-ū chhun nn̄g saⁿ lia̍p kaⁿ-ná, ē-bīn ê ki siōng chōe mā chiah chhun sì gō͘ lia̍p. Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni soan-kò.
Tī hit-ji̍t, lâng ōe choán-ǹg in ê Chhòng-chō-chú; in ê ba̍k-chiu ōe gióng-bōng Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè.
In bōe koh kui-ǹg in chhin-chhiú khí ê chè-tôaⁿ, mā bōe koh óa-khò in chńg-thâu-á chō ê A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng kap hiuⁿ-tâi.

Tī hit-ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t hông-pī kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ-chhī ōe pha-hng hong-hòe, chhin-chhiūⁿ A-mô͘-lī -lâng kap Hi-bī -lâng tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bīn-chêng tô-cháu khì-sak ê siâⁿ-chhī.

Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí í-keng bōe-kì-tit chín-kiù lí ê Siōng-tè, bōe-kì-tit hō͘ lí pī-lān ê Tōa-chio̍h-pôaⁿ, khì pài gōa-kok ê sîn-bêng. Lí chhin-chhiūⁿ ū chai siōng-hó ê chhiū-châng, m̄-kú chiap gōa-lâi ê chhiū-ki.
Sui-jiân tī chai-chèng hit-ji̍t chiū puh-íⁿ, tī chai-chèng hit chá-khí chiū khui-hoe, chóng-sī siu-sêng ōe lo̍k-khong; hit-ji̍t, chí-ū pīⁿ-thiàⁿ kap tōa thòng-khó͘.
Thiaⁿ leh, ū chin chōe jîn-bîn teh soan-hoa; in soan-hoa ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-hái hōa-hōa-háu! Lia̍t-kok ná tōa-éng teh chhiong-kek, chhin-chhiūⁿ pho-lōng ti̍t-ti̍t chhiong.

Lia̍t-kok sui-jiân ná tōa-chúi ti̍t-ti̍t phoah, Siōng-tè chi̍t-ē chek-pī, in sûi-sî cháu-lī-lī, chhin-chhiūⁿ chho͘-khng hō͘ soaⁿ-téng chhe--lo̍h-lâi ê kńg-lê-á-hong sàu-cháu, chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-iù-á hō͘ tōa-hong chhe-sòaⁿ.
Khòaⁿ leh! Mî--sî, ū khióng-pò͘, ji̍t bē chhut, in chiū lóng siau-sit. Che chiū-sī chhiúⁿ goán ê lâng èng-siū ê pò-èng, sī kiap goán ê lâng èng-iú ê miā-ūn.
Tī Kó͘-si̍t ê hô hit-pêng ū chi̍t tè tōe, tī hia ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h chin chōe si̍t teh phia̍t ê siaⁿ;

hia ū chin chōe sù-chiá chē lô͘-úi chō ê chûn tùi Nî-lô-hô lo̍h--lâi. Lín chiah-ê hêng-tōng bín-chia̍t ê sù-chiá, tio̍h khì, khì chi̍t ê sin-châi koân-tōa, phê-hu kng-ku̍t ê bîn-cho̍k hia, chi̍t ê hn̄g kap kūn ê lâng lóng kiaⁿ-ùi ê kok-ka, chi̍t ê kiông-tāi, ài thún-ta̍h lâng ê kok-ka; in ê thó͘-tōe hō͘ hô-liû hun-khui.
Lín chiah-ê tòa tī sè-kan, tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ê chū-bîn ah! Tōa-kî tī soaⁿ-téng chhāi--khí-lâi ê sî, tio̍h khòaⁿ, sàu-kak pûn ê sî, tio̍h thiaⁿ!

Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Góa beh tùi góa khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi tiām-tiām koan-khòaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t-kng ê iām-jia̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ siu-koah ê sî lō͘-chúi cheng-hoat ê hûn-bū.”
Phû-tô iáu-bē siu-sêng í-chêng, hoe siā, beh kiat-chòe phû-tô ê sî, Siōng Chú ōe ēng liâm-to chiong iù-ki koah-tn̄g, chiong ām-ām ê phû-tô-tîn chián hiat-ka̍k.
In ōe siū khì-sak, hiat hō͘ soaⁿ-téng ê eng-chiáu, tàn hō͘ tōe-chiūⁿ ê iá-siù; tī hē-thiⁿ, hō͘ eng-chiáu choh-siū, tī tang-thiⁿ, hō͘ iá-siù hioh-khùn.

Hit-sî, ū chi̍t ê kok-ka, thó͘-tōe hō͘ hô-liû hun-khui; i ê jîn-bîn sin-châi koân-tōa, phê-hu kng-ku̍t, thún-ta̍h lâng, hō͘ hn̄g kap kūn ê lâng lóng kiaⁿ-ùi. In ōe lâi kàu Sek-an-soaⁿ kèng-pài Siōng Chú, hiàn lé-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe.

Che sī iú-koan Ai-ki̍p ê sìn-sit. Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú chē khoài-sok ê hûn, pe-lâi Ai-ki̍p. Ai-ki̍p ê ngó͘-siōng ōe tī I bīn-chêng phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah; Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê sim ōe siau-iûⁿ sit-táⁿ.
Siōng Chú kóng: Góa beh kek-khí Ai-ki̍p -lâng kong-kek Ai-ki̍p -lâng: Hiaⁿ-tī kong-kek hiaⁿ-tī, chhù-piⁿ kong-kek chhù-piⁿ, siâⁿ kong-kek siâⁿ, kok kong-kek kok.
Ai-ki̍p -lâng ōe sit-táⁿ bô-la̍t; góa beh phah-loān in ê kè-ōe. In ōe khì chhē in ê ngó͘-siōng kap liām-chiù--ê, khì kiû in ê khan-bông--ê kap tâng-ki toh-thâu.
Góa beh kā Ai-ki̍p -lâng kau hō͘ chi̍t ê hiong-ok ê kok-ông thóng-tī. Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-kò.
Hái-chúi ōe ta--khì, kang-hô ōe ta-khok-khok.
Ūn-hô ê chúi ōe chhàu, Nî-lô-hô ê chúi ōe kiám-chió soah ta--khì; lô͘-úi kap lô͘-tek lóng ōe lian--khì.
Nî-lô-hô hô-kháu kap iân-hōaⁿ chai-chèng--ê, ōe ko͘-tâ, hō͘ hong chhe-sòaⁿ soah bô--khì.
Lia̍h-hî ê lâng ōe ai-khàu; tī Nî-lô-hô tiò-hî--ê ōe pi-siong; tī hô--ni̍h pha-bāng--ê lóng bōe-tàng seng-oa̍h.
So môa chòe se kap chit môa-se ê lâng lóng ōe sit-bāng kiàn-siàu.
Chit-pò͘ sai-hū ōe lóe-chì; chhiàⁿ--lâi ê kang-lâng ōe hoân-ló iu-chhiû.

Só-an ê léng-siù ū-kàu gû-gōng; Hoat-ló siōng ū-tì-hūi ê kò͘-būn bô hó ê kè-chhek. Lín ná ōe-tàng kā Hoat-ló kóng “Góa sī ū-tì-hūi ê lâng ê hō͘-tāi, sī kó͘-chá kun-ông ê kiáⁿ-sun”?
Ai-ki̍p -ông, lí ū-tì-hūi ê kò͘-būn tī tó-ūi? In hiān-chāi tio̍h kóng hō͘ lí chai Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe beh tùi-hù Ai-ki̍p ê kè-ōe.
Só-an ê léng-siù ū-kàu gōng, Bēng-húi-su ê léng-siù hō͘ lâng phiàn--khì lah; chiah-ê chi-cho̍k ê tòng-liông kā Ai-ki̍p chhōa bê-lō͘.
Siōng Chú kā chhò-loān ê sîn koàn-ji̍p in lāi-bīn, hō͘ Ai-ki̍p só͘ chòe it-chhè ê tāi-chì lóng chha-chhò, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiú-chùi ê lâng ná tian ná thò͘.
Tī Ai-ki̍p, bô chi̍t ê ū lō͘-ēng, bô-lūn sī thâu á-sī bé-liu, chang-chhiū-ki á-sī lô͘-úi, lóng siâng-khoán!
Tī hit-ji̍t, Ai-ki̍p -lâng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hū-jîn-lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah, in-ūi Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe gia̍h-chhiú beh chhú-hoa̍t in.
Iû-tāi -tōe mā ōe hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; nā ū lâng thê-khí Iû-tāi ê miâ, in chiū phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, in-ūi Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ū kè-ōe beh tùi-hù in.

Tī hit-ji̍t, Ai-ki̍p ū gō͘ ê siâⁿ-chhī, lâng ōe kóng Hi-pek-lâi-ōe, tùi Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe soan-sè chīn-tiong; kî-tiong ū chi̍t ê siâⁿ kiò-chòe “Thài-iông-siâⁿ”.
Tī hit-ji̍t, Ai-ki̍p -tōe ê tiong-sim ōe khí-chō chi̍t chō chè-tôaⁿ hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, mā ōe tī pian-kài chhāi chi̍t ki hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê thiāu.

Chiah-ê beh chòe Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe lîm-chāi tī Ai-ki̍p ê kì-hō kap kiàn-chèng. Ai-ki̍p -lâng siū ap-pek kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê sî, I ōe thòe in chhe chi̍t ê chín-kiù-chiá lâi pó-hō͘ in, tháu-pàng in.
Siōng Chú ōe tùi Ai-ki̍p -lâng hián-sī I pún-sin. Tī hit-ji̍t, Ai-ki̍p -lâng ōe sêng-jīn Siōng Chú, tùi I hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap sò͘-chè, mā ōe tùi I hē-goān koh siā-goān.
Siōng Chú it-tēng ōe chek-hoa̍t Ai-ki̍p -lâng, jiân-āu kā in i-tī. In oa̍t-tńg-sin kui-ǹg Siōng Chú ê sî, I ōe thiaⁿ in ê kî-kiû, kā in i-hó.

Tī hit-ji̍t, tùi Ai-ki̍p kàu A-su̍t ōe khui chi̍t tiâu tōa-lō͘. A-su̍t -lâng ōe khì Ai-ki̍p, Ai-ki̍p -lâng ōe khì A-su̍t; Ai-ki̍p -lâng kap A-su̍t -lâng ōe chòe-hé kèng-pài Siōng Chú.
Tī hit-ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t ōe kap Ai-ki̍p í-ki̍p A-su̍t, saⁿ kok chòe-hé chiâⁿ-chòe choân sè-kài ê chiok-hok.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe beh sù-hok hō͘ in, kóng, “Goān góa ê chú-bîn Ai-ki̍p, góa ê chhiú só͘ chō ê A-su̍t, góa ê soán-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t, lóng siū chiok-hok!”
A-su̍t -ông Sat-ní-kun bēng-lēng i ê goân-sòe khì kong-chhú Hui-lī-sū ê A-si̍t-tu̍t -siâⁿ.

Chit-ê tāi-chì í-chêng, Siōng Chú tùi A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ Í-sài-a kóng, “Lí khì, chiong lí seng-khu téng ê môa-pò͘-saⁿ thǹg--khí-lâi, kha chhēng ê liâng-ôe thǹg--khí-lâi!” Í-sài-a chiū chiàu án-ni chòe, chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé thǹg-chhiah-kha kiâⁿ-lō͘.
Jiân-āu Siōng Chú kóng, “Che sī Ai-ki̍p kap Kó͘-si̍t teh-beh tú--tio̍h ê tāi-chì ê kì-hō kap tiāu-thâu. Góa ê po̍k-jîn ū saⁿ nî kú chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé thǹg-chhiah-kha,

A-su̍t -ông ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni lia̍h Ai-ki̍p ê hu-ló͘ kap Kó͘-si̍t ê chiàn-hoān, bô-lūn sī siàu-liân--ê á-sī lāu--ê, hō͘ in lóng chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé thǹg-chhiah-kha iû-hêng, hō͘ Ai-ki̍p kiàn-siàu.
Só͘-ū óa-khò Kó͘-si̍t í-ki̍p ēng Ai-ki̍p chòe khoa-kháu ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ kiàn-siàu.
Tī hit-ji̍t, tòa tī iân-hái ê lâng ōe kóng, ‘Khòaⁿ leh, lán só͘ óa-khò beh pó-hō͘ lán tô-thoat A-su̍t -ông--ê to lóng án-ni, lán ná ū hoat-tō͘ cháu-siám?’”
Che sī iú-koan iân-hái khòng-iá ê sìn-sit. Kńg-lê-á-hong tùi lâm-pō͘ ê soa-bô͘ sàu--kè-lâi, tùi khòng-iá, tùi khióng-pò͘ ê tōe lâi.

Góa ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chhiⁿ-chhám ê īⁿ-siōng: Pōe-poān ê lâng kè-sio̍k pōe-poān; phò-hoāi ê lâng it-ti̍t phò-hoāi. Í-lân, chiūⁿ-khì kong-kek! Bí-tí-a, kā i pau-ûi! Siōng Chú beh kiat-sok Pa-pí-lûn só͘ chō-sêng ê thòng-khó͘.
Só͘-í, góa ê io ke̍k-lia̍t thàng-thiàⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ sán-hū teh chhui-chūn. Góa kiaⁿ kah sím-mi̍h to thiaⁿ bōe tio̍h; góa chhoah kah sím-mi̍h to khòaⁿ bô.
Góa ê sim hūn-loān, khióng-pò͘ hō͘ góa phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah; góa só͘ ì-ài ê hông-hun hō͘ góa gi̍h-gi̍h-chùn.
In pâi-siat iàn-se̍k, tōe-thán pho͘ hó-sè, ia̍h-chia̍h-ia̍h-lim. “Léng-siù, khí--lâi! Ēng iû chhat tún-pâi!”
Chú kā góa kóng, “Lí khì, khì an-pâi chi̍t ê siú-bōng--ê, kiò i kā lí pò-kò i khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê sū.
I ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h kun-tūi, bé-peng chi̍t-tùi chi̍t-tùi, koh ū khiâ lû-á--ê, khiâ lo̍k-tô--ê. I tio̍h thiaⁿ, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ!”
Jiân-āu siú-bōng--ê hoah kóng, “Chú ah, góa ta̍k-ji̍t khiā-teh siú-bōng, ta̍k-mî tī siú-bōng-tâi khàn-siú.

Khòaⁿ leh, bé-peng lâi lah! Chi̍t-tùi chi̍t-tùi teh lâi!” Āu-lâi i koh hoah kóng, “ Pa-pí-lûn tó--lo̍h-khì lah, tó--lo̍h-khì lah! It-chhè ê sîn-bêng ngó͘-siōng lóng kòng-chhùi lak kah kui thô͘-kha.”

O͘h, lín siū phah-chhùi, tó kah kui phah-be̍h-tiûⁿ, góa ê tông-pau ah, góa tùi Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, góa lóng kā lín kóng lah!
Che sī iú-koan Í-tong ê sìn-sit. Ū lâng tùi Í-tong teh hoah, kóng, “Siú-bōng--ê, hiān-chāi kúi kiⁿ? Siú-bōng--ê, mî--sî koh jōa kú chiah ōe kè--khì?”
Siú-bōng--ê ìn kóng, “Chá-khí-sî teh-beh lâi ah, m̄-kú iáu-sī mî--sî. Lí nā ài mn̄g, chòe lí mn̄g, mā thang koh tńg-lâi mn̄g.”
Che sī iú-koan A-la-pek ê sìn-sit. Tī A-la-pek ê chhiū-nâ hioh-mî ê Tí-tān siong-tūi ah,
tio̍h the̍h chúi lâi hō͘ chhùi-ta ê lâng lim. Thê-má ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h tòa chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ tô-lān ê lâng chia̍h.
In-ūi in tô-pī to-kiàm, teh tô-siám í-keng pu̍ih-chhut ê to-kiàm; in siám-pī í-keng giú--khui ê keng, teh tô-siám béng-lia̍t ê chiàn-cheng.
Chú tùi góa kóng, “Tī chi̍t nî lāi, chiàu chhiàⁿ-kang chhiam-iok ê nî-hān, Ki-ta̍t só͘-ū ê êng-hôa lóng ōe bô--khì;
gia̍h keng-chìⁿ ê Ki-ta̍t ióng-sū ōe chhun chin chió.” Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni soan-kò.
Che sī iú-koan Īⁿ-siōng Soaⁿ-kok ê sìn-sit. Sī-án-chóaⁿ lín lóng peh-chiūⁿ chhù-bé-téng?
Lín chit-ê chhiong-móa lāu-jia̍t soan-hoa ê siâⁿ-chhī, lín tiong-kan sí--khì ê lâng m̄-sī hō͘ to-kiàm thâi--sí, mā m̄-sī tī chiàn-cheng tiong sí-bông.
Lín só͘-ū ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kui-tīn tô-cháu, bô chi̍t ê khui keng siā-chìⁿ. Chiàn-sū sui-jiân cháu chin hn̄g, mā hō͘ lâng chhē--tio̍h, chòe-chi̍t-ē lia̍h--khì.
Só͘-í, góa kóng, “Mài chhap--góa, hō͘ góa thòng-sim thî-khàu. M̄-thang siūⁿ-beh kā góa an-ùi, góa ê tông-pau lóng bia̍t-bông lah!”

Che sī Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe hō͘ Īⁿ-siōng Soaⁿ-kok kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, hūn-loān, siū thún-ta̍h ê ji̍t; tī hit-ji̍t siâⁿ siū kong-phòa, ai-kiò ê siaⁿ hiáng-piàn soaⁿ-kan.
Í-lân ê peng khiâ-bé, chē chiàn-chhia, tòa chìⁿ-tē lâi chìn-kong, Kiat-ní ê peng chiong tún-pâi tu--chhut-lâi.
Lí siōng-súi ê soaⁿ-kok chiàn-chhia móa-móa-sī, bé-peng tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu pâi-tīn.
Iû-tāi só͘-ū ê hông-ōe lóng sit-hāu. Tī hit-ji̍t, lín kî-thāi Lê-pa-lūn Lîm-kiong thê-kiong bú-khì.
Lín hoat-kak Tāi-pi̍t -siâⁿ ū chin chōe phòa-khiah, chiū tī Hā-tî chek-chū chúi.
Lín tiám-sǹg Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chhù, thiah chhù lâi siu-pó͘ siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, hō͘ chhiûⁿ khah hó hông-pī.

Lín tī nn̄g ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ tiong-kan chō chúi-khut, thang chek-chū kū chúi-tî ê chúi. M̄-kú, lín lóng bô óa-khò chō chit-ê siâⁿ ê Siōng-tè, mā bô kā tùi kó͘-chá chiū kè-ōe chit-hāng tāi-chì Hit-ūi khàn-chāi-gán-lāi.
Tī hit-ji̍t, Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kiò lín tio̍h thî-khàu pi-siong, tio̍h thì kng-thâu chhēng môa-saⁿ.
M̄-kú lín kông-hoan-iàn-lo̍k, thâi gû thâi iûⁿ, tōa-chia̍h tōa-lim. Lín kóng, “Lán lâi chia̍h lâi lim, in-ūi bîn-á-chài lán to beh sí ah!”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chhin-sin kā góa khé-sī kóng, “Chit-ê chōe, kàu lín sí, góa it-tēng bōe sià-bián!” Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.
Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Lí khì kìⁿ kiong-têng châi-bū chóng-koán Sià-pek-ná, kā i kóng,
‘Lí tī chia teh chhòng siáⁿ? Siáⁿ-lâng hō͘ lí koân-pèng tī chia ūi lí ka-kī phah hûn-bōng, tī koân ê giâm-chio̍h tiong chō chi̍t ê an-hioh ê só͘-chāi?

Lí khòaⁿ--khí-lâi ká-ná chin liáu-put-khí, m̄-kú Siōng Chú beh kā lí lia̍h--khí-lâi, kā lí chhio̍k kui-oân chhin-chhiūⁿ kiû, hiat-khì chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi. Lí ōe sí tī hia, lí lia̍h-chòe khoa-iāu ê chiàn-chhia mā ōe pàng tī hia. Lí ōe chiâⁿ-chòe lí chú-lâng ê ke ê kiàn-siàu.
Góa beh thiat lí ê chit, pak lí ê ūi.
“‘Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh kā góa ê po̍k-jîn Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-kèng tiàu--lâi.

Góa beh chiong lí ê gōa-phàu hō͘ i chhēng, chiong lí ê io-tòa hō͘ i hâ, chiong lí ê koân-pèng kau hō͘ i. I beh chhin-chhiūⁿ lāu-pē khòaⁿ-kò͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kap Iû-tāi jîn-bîn.
Góa beh chiong Tāi-pi̍t ông-tiâu ê só-sî khǹg tī i ê keng-thâu téng; i khui, chiū bô lâng ōe-tàng koaiⁿ; i koaiⁿ, chiū bô lâng ōe-tàng khui.
Góa beh kā i an-tì tī ún-kò͘ ê tōe-ūi, chhin-chhiūⁿ khi̍t-á tèng chin tiâu. I beh chiâⁿ-chòe in lāu-pē ê ke ê êng-iāu.
I ê ka-cho̍k, tùi kiáⁿ kàu sun ê tàⁿ-thâu, chhin-chhiūⁿ khaⁿ-á e-á, lóng kòa tī i sin-chiūⁿ.’”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Tī hit-ji̍t, tèng tī kian-kò͘ só͘-chāi ê khi̍t-á ōe lēng--khì, lak--khì. I phāiⁿ ê tāng-tàⁿ ōe bô--khì!”

Che sī iú-koan Thài-ní ê sìn-sit. Tha-si ê chûn-chiah ah, tio̍h pi-siong thî-khàu, in-ūi Thài-ní siū húi-hoāi, bô chhù mā bô káng-kháu lah! Tùi Ki-thê ê tōe ū ōe thoân kàu in hia.
Iân-hái ê chū-bîn, Se-tùn ê seng-lí-lâng ah, tio̍h ai-khàu! Lín kè-hái thàn chin chōe chîⁿ;
keng-kè tōa-hái, chài Se-hat ê ngó͘-kok, Nî-lô-hô nn̄g hōaⁿ ê siu-sêng; Thài-ní chiâⁿ-chòe bān-kok ê chhī-tiûⁿ.
Se-tùn, hái-iûⁿ ê iàu-sài ah, tio̍h kiàn-siàu, in-ūi tōa-hái ū kóng, “Góa m̄-bat hoâi-īn, mā m̄-bat siⁿ lí. Góa m̄-bat iúⁿ-chhī hāu-siⁿ, mā m̄-bat ióng-io̍k cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.”
Siau-sit thoân kàu Ai-ki̍p ê sî, in ōe ūi-tio̍h iú-koan Thài-ní ê hong-siaⁿ hui-siông thòng-sim.
Iân-hái ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h kè-khì Tha-si! Tio̍h ai-khàu!
Che kiám sī kó͘-chá chiū kiàn-li̍p, hoân-êng ê siâⁿ-chhī? Ū chin chōe lâng tùi chia khì kàu chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi chòe seng-lí.
Thài-ní bat chí-phài lâng chòe pa̍t-kok ê ông, i ê seng-lí-lâng chin chōe sī ông-chhin, i ê siong-jîn sī kok-chhek. Siáⁿ-lâng koat-tēng beh kong-kek Thài-ní?
Che sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê koat-tēng, beh lêng-jio̍k Thài-ní só͘ khoa-kháu ê êng-kng, hō͘ sè-chiūⁿ it-chhè ê kùi-cho̍k kiàn-siàu.
Tha-si ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h tòa-móa lín ê thó͘-tōe, chhin-chhiūⁿ Nî-lô-hô ê chúi hoàn-lām, bô siū hān-chè.
Siōng Chú í-keng chhun-chhiú tī tōa-hái ê téng-bīn, beh hō͘ lia̍t-kok phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah. I hā-lēng beh húi-hoāi Hui-nî-ki ê iàu-sài.
I kóng, “Siū lêng-jio̍k ê chāi-sek-lú Se-tùn ah, lí bōe koh ū khoài-lo̍k! Khí--lâi! Kè-khì Ki-thê, tī hia lí mā bōe-tàng tit-tio̍h an-hioh.”

Lín khòaⁿ Ka-le̍k-tí -lâng ê tōe, i ê jîn-bîn bô koh chûn-chāi. A-su̍t -lâng hō͘ i chiâⁿ-chòe iá-siù tòa ê só͘-chāi; in khí-chō kong-siâⁿ ê thah, thiah-húi i ê kiong-tiān, hō͘ chit-tè tōe pha-hng.
Tha-si ê chûn-chiah ah, lín tio̍h pi-siong thî-khàu! Lín ê pó-lúi í-keng siū phò-hoāi lah.

Tī hit-ji̍t, Thài-ní ōe hō͘ lâng bōe-kì-tit chhit-cha̍p nî kú, kap chi̍t ê ông ê nî-hè pîⁿ tn̂g. Chhit-cha̍p nî liáu-āu, Thài-ní ê kéng-hóng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ koa só͘ teh biô-siá ê ki-lú:
Lí chit-ê hō͘ lâng bōe-kì--tit ê ki-lú ah, the̍h khiā-khîm tī siâⁿ-lāi sì-kòe kiâⁿ, tôaⁿ hó-thiaⁿ ê koa, gîm chin chōe si, hō͘ lâng koh ōe-kì-tit lí.
Chhit-cha̍p nî kè-liáu, Siōng Chú ōe koh koàn-kò͘ Thài-ní, Thài-ní ōe hôe-ho̍k i ê pún-gia̍p, kap sè-kài ta̍k-kok bō͘-e̍k.

M̄-kú i ê êng-lī kap só͘ thàn ê chîⁿ lóng beh hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; bô beh khǹg--teh, mā bô beh tún--khí-lâi. I ê êng-lī beh kui hō͘ kèng-pài Siōng Chú ê lâng, hō͘ in chia̍h chhēng lóng hù-chiok.
Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú hō͘ tāi-tōe pha-hng, oân-choân hong-hòe; I kā tōe-bīn péng-lìn-tńg, hō͘ chū-bîn lóng sì-sòaⁿ.

Jîn-bîn án-chóaⁿ, chè-si mā án-ni; po̍k-jîn án-chóaⁿ, chú-lâng mā án-ni; lú-pī án-chóaⁿ, lú-chú-lâng mā án-ni; bóe-mi̍h--ê án-chóaⁿ, bōe-mi̍h--ê mā án-ni; kā-lâng-chioh--ê án-chóaⁿ, chioh--lâng-ê mā án-ni; sàn-chhiah--ê án-chóaⁿ, hó-gia̍h--ê mā án-ni. In lóng ōe sì-sòaⁿ.
Tāi-tōe ōe oân-choân pha-hng, hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ kah khang-khang. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Tāi-tōe soe-pāi, ta--khì; sè-kài soe-pāi, tó-hoāi; tōe-chiūⁿ ko-kùi ê lâng mā soe-bî.
Tāi-tōe hō͘ khiā-khí ê chū-bîn ù-jiám; in phò-hoāi lu̍t-hoat, ûi-hoán lu̍t-lē, ûi-pōe éng-oán ê iok.
Só͘-í, tāi-tōe siū chiù-chó͘ tì-kàu pāi-hoāi, tōe-chiūⁿ ê chū-bîn lóng in-ūi in ê chōe siū hêng-hoa̍t; só͘ chhun ê lâng kiám-chió, chhun bô kúi ê.
Sin-chiú ta--khì, phû-tô-chhiū ko͘-tâ; khoài-lo̍k ê lâng mā lóng thó͘-khùi.
Lin-long-kó͘ khoài-lo̍k ê siaⁿ tiām--khì, iàn-lo̍k chháu-nāu ê siaⁿ chēng--khì, tôaⁿ-khîm ê siaⁿ-im mā lóng bô--khì.
Bô koh ū lâng lim-chiú chhiùⁿ-koa; kāu-chiú lim--khí-lâi khó͘-te̍h-te̍h.
Siâⁿ pha-hng, siū thiah-húi; chhù lóng koaiⁿ--teh, bô lâng chhut-ji̍p.
Lâng tī koe-lō͘ hoah beh chhē chiú lim; it-chhè ê khoài-lo̍k pìⁿ-chòe àm-tām, tōe-chiūⁿ ê hoaⁿ-hí lóng siau-sit.
Siâⁿ-chhī hong-hòe, siâⁿ-mn̂g kòng kah chhùi-kô͘-kô͘.
Tōe-chiūⁿ bān-bîn mā ōe án-ni, chhin-chhiūⁿ kaⁿ-ná-chhiū phû-tô-chhiū siu-sêng liáu, koh chhē mā chhē bô jōa-chōe.
In tōa-siaⁿ hoan-ho͘, tùi sai-pêng soan-pò͘ Siōng Chú ê ui-giâm.
In-ūi án-ni, lín tio̍h tùi tang-pêng kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng Chú, tī chèng hái-sū chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ê miâ.

Tùi thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak, goán thiaⁿ-tio̍h koa-siaⁿ, “Êng-kng kui hō͘ Kong-gī ê Siōng-tè!” M̄-kú góa kóng, “Góa ōe sí! Góa ōe sí! Góa chhám ah! Pōe-poān ê lâng kè-sio̍k pōe-poān; khi-phiàn ê lâng iáu-teh khi-phiàn.”
Tōe-chiūⁿ ê chū-bîn ah, khióng-pò͘, hām-khiⁿ, oa̍h-tauh teh tng-tán lín.

Siám-pī khióng-pò͘ siaⁿ-im ê lâng ōe poa̍h-lo̍h hām-khiⁿ; tùi hām-khiⁿ tô-thoat ê lâng ōe hō͘ oa̍h-tauh tauh--tio̍h. Thiⁿ-téng ê thang-á lóng phah-khui; tōe-chiūⁿ ê kun-ki iô-tāng.
Tāi-tōe chòe-chi̍t-ē phò-hoāi, li̍h kah chhùi-chhùi; tōe tōa iô-tāng,
chhin-chhiūⁿ chiú-chùi ê lâng tian-lâi-tian-khì, ná-chún chháu-chhù-á iô-lâi-iô-khì. Tōe hō͘ chōe tāng-tāng teh--leh, pang--lo̍h-khì, bōe koh-chài khí--lâi.
Hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú beh hêng-hoa̍t thiⁿ-téng ê thian-kun, mā beh chhú-hoa̍t tōe-chiūⁿ ê kun-ông.
In ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hoān-lâng hō͘ lâng chi̍p-tiong tī tōe-lô, koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ-ga̍k; kè chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan chiū siū hêng-hoa̍t.

Hit-sî, ge̍h-niû ōe kiàn-siàu, ji̍t-thâu ōe làu-khùi, in-ūi Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe beh tī Sek-an-soaⁿ, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông, tùi I ê tiúⁿ-ló hián-chhut êng-kng.
Siōng Chú ah, lí sī góa ê Siōng-tè; góa beh chun lí chòe tōa, chheng-chàn lí ê miâ; in-ūi lí ū ēng chin-sêng sìn-si̍t si̍t-hiān tùi kó͘-chá chiū kè-ōe kî-biāu ê sū.
Lí ū hō͘ siâⁿ pìⁿ-chòe pùn-sò-tui, hō͘ siat-hông ê siâⁿ hong-hòe, hō͘ gōa-kok-lâng ê iàu-sài thiat-tóe húi-hoāi, éng-oán bōe-tàng tiông-kiàn.
Só͘-í ióng-béng ê jîn-bîn beh êng-iāu lí; kiông-pō siâⁿ-chhī ê kok-bîn beh kiaⁿ-ùi lí.

Lí it-ti̍t sī sàn-chhiah-lâng ê óa-khò, sī khiàm-kheh ê lâng kan-lân tiong ê pó-lúi, sī kông-hong-pō-ú tiong ê pī-lān-só͘, sī iām-jia̍t ê sî ê ìm-ńg; in-ūi kiông-pō ê lâng kong-kek ê sî, ná kông-hong teh phah siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ.
Gōa-kok-lâng ê soan-hoa chhin-chhiūⁿ khòng-iá ê iām-jia̍t, lí ēng hûn jia-khàm, hō͘ jia̍t-khì siau-sòaⁿ; lí hō͘ kiông-pō ê lâng bô koh chhiùⁿ khái-soân ê koa.
Tī chit-ê soaⁿ-téng, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe beh ūi-tio̍h bān-bîn chún-pī hong-sēng ê iàn-se̍k, siōng-hó ê chiú-iàn; ū pûi-bah, ū kut-chhé, ū tîn-nî ê hó-chiú.
Tī chit-ê soaⁿ-téng, I beh chiong só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn am bīn ê phè, kap lia̍t-kok khàm seng-khu ê pò͘ the̍h-tiāu.

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú beh éng-oán thun-bia̍t sí-bông, tùi ta̍k-ê lâng ê bīn chhit-khì in ê ba̍k-sái; I beh tī choân-tōe tû-khì I chú-bîn ê thí-jio̍k. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Tī hit-ji̍t ū lâng ōe kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, chit-ūi sī goán ê Siōng-tè, goán it-ti̍t teh gióng-bōng I, I it-tēng ōe lâi kái-kiù goán. Chit-ūi sī goán it-ti̍t teh thèng-hāu ê Siōng Chú. Lán tio̍h lâi hoaⁿ-hí khèng-chiok I ê chín-kiù.”
Siōng Chú ê chhiú beh khòa tī Sek-an-soaⁿ téng, m̄-kú Mô͘-ap ōe siū thún-ta̍h, ná be̍h-kó tī pùn-sò-tui hō͘ lâng thún-lâi-thún-khì.

Tī hia Mô͘-ap ōe thí-khui i ê siang-chhiú, chhin-chhiūⁿ siû-chúi ê lâng chhun-chhiú beh siû. Sui-jiân i ê siang-chhiú khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chin liú-lia̍h, m̄-kú bô-chhái-kang; Siōng-tè beh hō͘ i ê kiau-ngō͘ pìⁿ kiàn-siàu.
Koân-chhiûⁿ téng ê pó-lúi, I beh kā in chhia-tó húi-hoāi; I beh kā in thiah kah pìⁿ pîⁿ-tōe, pìⁿ thô͘-hún.
Hit-ji̍t, tī Iû-tāi -tōe lâng ōe chhiùⁿ chit-siú koa: Goán ū chi̍t ê kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ; Siōng Chú ēng sèng-lī chòe siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ kap pó-lúi.
Tio̍h phah-khui siâⁿ-mn̂g, hō͘ tiong-sìn chèng-gī ê jîn-bîn ji̍p--lâi!
Sim kian-tēng--ê, lí sù in pêng-an hoân-êng, in-ūi in sìn-khò lí.
Tio̍h éng-oán sìn-khò Siōng Chú, in-ūi Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè sī éng-oán ê Chio̍h-pôaⁿ.
I kā chē koân-ūi ê lâng thoa--lo̍h-lâi, thiah-húi khí tī koân ê só͘-chāi ê siâⁿ, kā i tàn tī thô͘-kha, hō͘ i pìⁿ-chòe thô͘-hún,
hō͘ lâng thún-ta̍h; sàn-chhiah-lâng kā i thún, khùn-khó͘-lâng kā i ta̍h.
Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng lō͘ pîⁿ-tháⁿ; kong-gī ê Chú, lí kā chèng-ti̍t-lâng ê lō͘ pho͘-pîⁿ siu-ti̍t.
Siōng Chú ah, tī lí sím-phòaⁿ ê lō͘, goán teh thèng-hāu lí; goán ê sim khat-bō͘ lí siū chun-chông ê miâ.
Tī mî--sî, góa ê sim-sîn him-bō͘ lí; góa ê sîn-hûn pek-chhiat chhē-kiû lí. In-ūi lí tī tōe-chiūⁿ si-hêng sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, sè-kan ê chū-bîn ha̍k-si̍p chèng-gī.
Siâ-ok ê lâng chiū-sī tit-tio̍h jîn-chû, mā o̍h bōe tio̍h kong-gī. Tī chèng-ti̍t-lâng ê tōe, in iû-goân chòe pháiⁿ, in khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h Siōng Chú ê ui-giâm.

Siōng Chú ah, lí chhiú gia̍h-koân beh hêng-hoa̍t in, m̄-kú in bô khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. Kiû lí hō͘ in khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí tùi lí chú-bîn ê jia̍t-ài, ka-kī kám-kak kiàn-siàu. Goān lí ēng hé thun-bia̍t lí ê tùi-te̍k.
Siōng Chú ah, goān lí sù goán pêng-an hoân-êng, in-ūi goán ê só͘-chòe lí lóng ū kā goán sêng-chiū.
Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ah, bat ū pa̍t-ê chú koán-hat goán, m̄-kú goán chí-ū chun-chông lí ê miâ.
Sí--khì ê lâng bōe-tàng koh oa̍h--khí-lâi; in ê im-hûn mā bōe-tàng koh khí--lâi. Só͘-í, lí chhú-hoa̍t in, húi-bia̍t in, hō͘ in tùi lâng ê kì-e̍k tiong siau-sit.
Siōng Chú ah, lí hō͘ goán ê kok-bîn cheng-ka, hō͘ kok-bîn ke-thiⁿ lâi hián-sī lí ê êng-iāu. Lí hō͘ goán ê kok-thó͘ khok-tián kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak.
Siōng Chú ah, in tī kan-lân tiong chhē-kiû lí; lí koán-kàu in ê sî, in thó͘-khùi tùi lí kî-kiû.
Sán-hū teh-beh siⁿ, chhui-chūn, thàng-thiàⁿ, âu-kiò; Siōng Chú ah, goán tī lí bīn-chêng mā chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni.
Goán hoâi-īn, thàng-thiàⁿ kiáu-ká, put-kò siⁿ lóng bô; goán bô ūi kok-ka tòa-lâi kái-kiù, bô ūi jîn-bîn kòng-hiàn sím-mi̍h.

M̄-kú goán sí--khì ê tông-pau ōe koh-oa̍h, in ê si-thé ōe koh khí--lâi. Tòa tī tîn-ai ê lâng ah, chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa! Lí ê lō͘-chúi sī siám-sih ê kam-lō͘, lo̍h tī tōe, hō͘ sí--khì ê lâng oa̍h--khí-lâi.
Taⁿ, góa ê chú-bîn ah, ji̍p-khì lín ê pâng-keng; mn̂g tio̍h chhòaⁿ hō͘ tiâu. Lín tio̍h chiām-sî bih--khí-lâi, it-ti̍t kàu Siōng-tè ê tōa siū-khì soah.

Lín khòaⁿ, Siōng Chú teh-beh tùi I tòa ê só͘-chāi chhut--lâi, beh hêng-hoa̍t tōe-bīn-chiūⁿ hoān-chōe ê lâng. Tōe ōe po̍k-lō͘ in thâi-lâng só͘ lâu ê huih, bōe koh am-khàm in sat-hāi ê lâng ê si-thé.
Tī hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú beh ēng I tēng koh lāi ê tōa-ki kiàm hêng-hoa̍t hit-chiah hái-siù, chiū-sī soan-lâi-soan-khì sô chin kín ê chôa, koh beh thâi-sí hit-chiah hái-koài.
Tī hit-ji̍t, tio̍h ūi-tio̍h chhut hó-chiú ê phû-tô-hn̂g lâi hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa:
Góa Siōng Chú sī kò͘-siú phû-tô-hn̂g--ê; góa put-sî kā i ak-chúi. Góa mî-ji̍t lóng teh kò͘-siú, chiah bián ū lâng kā i sún-hoāi.
Góa bô koh tùi phû-tô-hn̂g siū-khì; hn̂g-lāi nā ū chhì-phè iá-chháu, góa ōe chìn-chêng kā in phut, kā in sio-liáu-liáu.
Hiah-ê tùi-te̍k nā bô ài án-ni, tio̍h kui-ǹg góa, siū góa pó-hō͘, kap góa hô-hó; in tio̍h kap góa hô-hó.
Chiong-lâi, Í-sek-lia̍t ōe tèng-kun, Ngá-kok ōe puh-gê khui-hoe, in ê ké-chí ōe piàn-móa choân sè-kài.
Siōng Chú phah Í-sek-lia̍t, bô chhin-chhiūⁿ I phah hiah-ê kong-kek in--ê hiah-ni̍h giâm-tiōng; I sat-hāi in, bô chhin-chhiūⁿ I sat-hāi hiah-ê tô͘-sat in--ê hiah-ni̍h lī-hāi.
Siōng Chú hòng-tio̍k in, kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ in, ēng án-ni hêng-hoa̍t in; I tī thàu tang-hong ê ji̍t, ēng kiông-lia̍t ê hong chhe-sòaⁿ in.

Í-sek-lia̍t nā phah-chhùi gōa-pang sîn-bêng chè-tôaⁿ ê chio̍h, bô koh ū A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng kap hiuⁿ-tâi, in ê chōe-kò chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián, in ê chōe tit-tio̍h kái-tû.

Nā bô, kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ-chhī ōe pìⁿ hong-po͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ khòng-iá bô lâng khiā-khí; tī hia chhun gû teh hioh-khùn, teh chia̍h-chháu, ōe kā só͘-ū chhiū-ki ê hio̍h chia̍h-liáu-liáu.

Chhiū-ki chi̍t-ē ko͘-tâ tn̄g--khì, cha-bó͘-lâng chiū khioh-khì hiâⁿ-hé. In-ūi in sī oân-choân bû-ti ê chú-bîn, só͘-í chō in--ê bô beh lîn-bín in, in ê Chhòng-chō-chú bô beh si-un hō͘ in.
Tī hit-ji̍t, tùi Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô kàu Ai-ki̍p ê khoe-kok, Siōng Chú ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ siu-sêng ké-chí án-ni, kā lín — Í-sek-lia̍t ê jîn-bîn chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê chū-chi̍p--khí-lâi.

Tī hit-ji̍t, tōa-ki sàu-kak ōe tân, hiah-ê liû-bông tī A-su̍t -tōe kap Ai-ki̍p -tōe ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ōe tò-tńg--lâi. In lóng beh tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sèng-soaⁿ kèng-pài Siōng Chú.

Í-hoat-liân chiú-chùi ê lâng só͘ teh khoa-iāu ê hoa-koan, taⁿ chhám ah! Hit-lúi chhia-iāⁿ ê súi-hoe chiām-chiām siā--khì. In tī pûi-súi ê soaⁿ-kok téng-bīn, lim kah chùi-bâng-bâng.

Khòaⁿ leh, Chú phài chi̍t ê ū tōa koân-lêng ū tōa khùi-la̍t ê lâng lâi kong-kek in, chhin-chhiūⁿ kiông-lia̍t ê pha̍uh, húi-bia̍t ê kông-hong, chhin-chhiūⁿ pō-ú, béng-lia̍t ê tōa-chúi chhiâng-lo̍h tāi-tōe.
Hit-ê chiú-chùi ê lâng só͘ khoa-iāu ê hoa-koan ōe siū thún-ta̍h tī kha-ē.

Hit-lúi tī pûi-súi ê soaⁿ-kok téng-bīn, khui kah chin chhia-iāⁿ, chiām-chiām siā--khì ê súi-hoe, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hē-thiⁿ chêng thâu-chúi ê bû-hoa-kó, lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h sûi-sî bán khì chia̍h.
Tī hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe beh chhin-chhiūⁿ êng-iāu ê hoa-koan, chòe I só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn êng-kng ê ông-koan,
hō͘ chē-teh sím-phòaⁿ hit-ūi ū kong-chèng ê sîn, chiâⁿ-chòe in tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu phah-thè tùi-te̍k ê khùi-la̍t.

Chè-si kap sian-ti in-ūi lim-chiú tian-tian-tó-tó, in-ūi kāu-chiú tian-lâi-tian-khì. Chiah-ê lâng in-ūi lim kāu-chiú kho̍k-kho̍k-tian, lim po̍h-chiú chùi-bâng-bâng. In in-ūi kāu-chiú tang-tó-sai-oai, chhò-kái īⁿ-siōng, phòaⁿ-koat hoán-khí-hoán-tó.
In ê toh-téng thò͘ kah móa-sì-kòe, bô chi̍t ê só͘-chāi bô lâ-sâm.
In kóng, “Chit-ê sian-ti sī beh kā tì-sek kà siáⁿ-lâng? I sī teh kā siáⁿ-lâng kóe-seh sìn-sit? Sī beh kà tú-á tn̄g-lin, tú-á lī-khui lāu-bú heng-chêng ê gín-á sī--bô?
I ki-ki-kū-kū, li-li-lū-lū, chia kóng chi̍t-kóa, hia kóng chi̍t-kóa, m̄-chai teh kóng sím-mi̍h.”
Án-ni hó, Chú beh ēng I ê chú-bîn thiaⁿ bô ê gōa-kok-ōe, ēng pa̍t-khoán khiuⁿ-kháu tùi in kóng-ōe.
I bat tùi in kóng, “Che sī an-hioh ê só͘-chāi, ià-siān ê lâng thang lâi an-hioh; che sī hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi.” Iáu-kú in m̄ thiaⁿ.

Só͘-í, Siōng Chú ê ōe in thiaⁿ--khí-lâi sī: Ki-ki-kū-kū, li-li-lū-lū, chia kóng chi̍t-kóa, hia kóng chi̍t-kóa. Só͘-í, in kiâⁿ chìn-chêng, soah tò-siàng-hiàⁿ, siū-siong, poa̍h-lo̍h oa̍h-tauh, hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì.
Lín chiah-ê chū-ko chū-tāi, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chū-bîn ê thóng-tī-chiá, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe.

In-ūi lín khoa-kháu kóng, “Goán í-keng kap Sí-bông chhiam-iok, mā ū kap Im-hú kiat-bêng. Tōa-chúi chhiong--kè-lâi, bōe im-tio̍h goán; in-ūi goán ū ēng pe̍h-chha̍t chòe pī-lān-só͘, ēng hu-ké chòe siám-bih ê só͘-chāi.”

Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, góa beh tī Sek-an hē chi̍t tè chio̍h, sī chhì-giām--kè ê chio̍h, pó-kùi ê ki-chio̍h, thang chòe kian-kò͘ ê kun-ki; óa-khò I ê lâng choa̍t-tùi bōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ tio̍h-kip.
Góa beh ēng chèng-ti̍t chòe chîn-sòaⁿ, ēng kong-gī chòe tūi-chîn. Peng-pha̍uh beh húi-hoāi pe̍h-chha̍t ê lâng ê pī-lān-só͘; tōa-chúi ōe im-móa lín siám-bih ê só͘-chāi.
Lín kap Sí-bông li̍p ê iok it-tēng ōe hòe-tû, kap Im-hú chhiam ê iok mā ōe chhú-siau. Tōa-chúi im--kè-lâi ê sî, ōe kā lín im--sí.

Múi chi̍t piàn tōa-chúi lâi ê sî, ōe kā lín chhiong cháu; tōa-chúi ōe ta̍k chá-khí im--kè-lâi, kui-mî kui-ji̍t im bōe soah, chai-iáⁿ che siau-sit ê lâng lóng ōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ khióng-hông.”
Bîn-chhn̂g siuⁿ té, seng-khu chhun bōe ti̍t; mî-phē siuⁿ oe̍h, khàm bōe ba̍t.

Siōng Chú beh khí--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ tī Pí-la-sim-soaⁿ; I siū-khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ tī Ki-piàn-kok. I beh chòe kang, sī te̍k-pia̍t ê kang; I beh oân-sêng I ê kè-ōe, sī kî-īⁿ ê kè-ōe.

Só͘-í, m̄-thang chū-ko chū-tāi, chiah bián pa̍k lín ê soh khún jú ân; in-ūi góa tùi Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h húi-bia̍t choân-tōe ê bēng-lēng.
Tio̍h àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ; tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ góa kóng ê ōe.
Lông-hu lôe-chhân beh chèng-choh, kiám ōe kui-ji̍t lóng teh lôe? I kiám ōe kè-sio̍k ku̍t-thô͘, kiám ōe it-ti̍t ó͘-kau?

I thô͘-bīn nā pê pîⁿ, kiám bōe sûi-sî iā tōa-hôe-hiong, sió-hôe-hiong? I kiám bōe chi̍t-chōa chi̍t-chōa chèng tōa-be̍h, chi̍t-lia̍t chi̍t-lia̍t chèng sió-be̍h, koh tī hn̂g-piⁿ chèng chho͘-be̍h?
In-ūi Siōng-tè ēng sek-tòng ê hong-hoat kā i chí-sī, kā i kà.
Siâng-khoán, tōa-hôe-hiong bōe ēng táⁿ-kok-ki phah, sió-hôe-hiong bōe ēng chhia-lián lún; tōa-hôe-hiong sī ēng thûi-á kòng, sió-hôe-hiong ēng koáiⁿ-á phah.
Ngó͘-kok tio̍h seng géng chiah ōe-tàng chòe mī-pau, m̄-kú bô su-iàu it-ti̍t géng. Lông-hu ēng bé-chhia lún ngó͘-kok, mā bōe kā ngó͘-kok lún kàu chhùi-chhùi.
Che lóng sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê chok-ûi; I ê kè-chhek kî-biāu; I ê tì-hūi chhim-tîm.
A-lī-i-le̍k, A-lī-i-le̍k, lí chhám ah! Tāi-pi̍t an-iâⁿ khiā-khí ê siâⁿ, lí chhám ah! Lín chi̍t-nî koh chi̍t-nî, choeh-kî chiàu-sî khèng-chiok.
M̄-kú, góa beh hō͘ A-lī-i-le̍k tú-tio̍h chai-lān; i ōe pi-siong, thó͘-khùi, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ teh sio ê chè-tôaⁿ ê lô͘.
Góa beh sì-ûi chat-iâⁿ ûi-khùn lí, beh khí thô͘-tui kong-kek lí, khí koân-tâi kong-táⁿ lí.

Lí ōe tó-hoāi, tùi thô͘-tóe kóng-ōe, tùi tîn-ai chhut sòe-sòe ê siaⁿ; lí ê siaⁿ ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ khan-bông--ê ê siaⁿ tùi thô͘-kha-tóe chhut--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiáu-á chiu̍h-chiu̍h-kiò ê siaⁿ tùi tîn-ai chhut--lâi.
Lí ê te̍k-jîn ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ iù ê thô͘-hún, kiông-pō ê peng-sū ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ hong chhe ê chho͘-khng hiah chōe. Chi̍t-sî-á-kú, hut-jiân-kan,
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ōe ēng lûi-kong-sih-nà, tōe-tāng, kông-hong-pō-ú, kap thun-bia̍t ê hé hêng-hoa̍t te̍k-jîn.
Hit-sî, kong-kek A-lī-i-le̍k lia̍t-kok ê peng-sū, só͘-ū teh kong-kek i ê siâⁿ-pó, ûi-khùn i--ê, ōe pìⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê bāng, chhin-chhiūⁿ iā-kan ê īⁿ-siōng siau-sit.

In chhin-chhiūⁿ iau-gō ê lâng bāng-kìⁿ teh chia̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ, khùn-chhíⁿ iáu-teh iau; chhin-chhiūⁿ chhùi-ta ê lâng bāng-kìⁿ teh lim-chúi, khùn-chhíⁿ iáu ià-siān, chhùi-ta. Só͘-ū kong-kek Sek-an-soaⁿ lia̍t-kok ê peng-sū lóng ōe án-ni.

Lín ài chòe gōng-lâng, chhut-chāi lín tòng-gōng! Lín ài chhiⁿ-mî, chhut-chāi lín chhiⁿ-mî! Lín chùi-bâng-bâng, m̄-sī in-ūi lim-chiú; lín tian-lâi-tian-khì, m̄-sī in-ūi kāu-chiú.
Siōng Chú ū kā lín koàn-ji̍p tāng-bîn ê sîn, kā lín ê ba̍k-chiu, chiū-sī sian-ti, am--khí-lâi, kā lín ê thâu-khak, chiū-sī sian-kiàn, khàm--khí-lâi.

In-ūi án-ni, só͘-ū ê be̍k-sī tùi lín khòaⁿ--khí-lâi sī hong-ba̍t ê chheh. Chit-pún chheh the̍h hō͘ bat-jī ê lâng chhiáⁿ i tha̍k, i ōe kóng, “Góa bōe-tàng tha̍k, in-ūi chheh hong--teh.”
The̍h hō͘ m̄-bat-jī ê lâng chhiáⁿ i tha̍k, i ōe kóng, “Góa m̄ bat jī.”

Chú kóng, “Chit-ê chú-bîn ēng chhùi chhin-kūn góa, ēng chhùi-tûn chun-kèng góa; m̄-kú in ê sim lī-khui góa hn̄g-hn̄g, in kèng-ùi góa put-kò sī chiàu lâng lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê kà-sī.
Só͘-í, góa beh tī jîn-bîn tiong-kan chòe chi̍t hāng kî-īⁿ koh kî-biāu ê sū: In tì-hūi ê lâng ê tì-hūi ōe siau-bô, chhong-bêng ê lâng ê chhong-bêng ōe siau-sit.”
Chhám ah, hiah-ê siūⁿ-beh tùi Siōng Chú am-khàm in ê im-bô͘ ê lâng! In tī àm-tiong chòe tāi-chì, kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h lán, siáⁿ-lâng ōe chai?”

Lín tian-tò sī-hui! Lín beh kā sio-hûi sai-hū khòaⁿ-chòe liâm-thô͘ sī--bô? Siū-chō--ê kiám ōe-tàng tùi chō i--ê kóng “Lí bô chō góa”? Hûi kiám ōe-tàng tùi sio-hûi sai-hū kóng “Lí lóng m̄ bat”?
Koh bô-jōa-kú, Lê-pa-lūn ōe pìⁿ-chòe pûi ê chhân-hn̂g, pûi ê chhân-hn̂g ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū-nâ.
Tī hit-ji̍t, sit-chhong ê lâng ōe thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chheh lāi-bīn ê ōe; sit-bêng ê lâng tī bông-bū o͘-àm tiong ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Pi-bî ê lâng ōe in-ūi Siōng Chú ke-thiⁿ hí-lo̍k; sàn-chhiah ê lâng ōe ko-kú Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè.
In-ūi kiông-pō ê lâng ōe siau-sit, biáu-sī Siōng-tè ê lâng ōe bô--khì, tng-tán beh chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng ōe bia̍t-bông.
In ēng bô sū-si̍t ê ōe hāi lâng siū tēng-chōe, kā tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu phòaⁿ-àn ê lâng siat lô-bāng, koh ēng ké kiàn-chèng hām-hāi chèng-ti̍t ê lâng.
Só͘-í, hit-ūi bat kiù-sio̍k A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn án-ni kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t bōe koh siū thí-jio̍k; in ê bīn-iông bōe koh-chài chhiⁿ-sún-sún.

Tng in ê kiáⁿ-sun khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa tī in tiong-kan ê só͘-chòe, in ōe chun góa ê miâ chòe sèng, ōe chun Ngá-kok sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè chòe sèng, ōe kèng-ùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.
Gû-gōng ê lâng ōe hiáu-ngō͘; nga̍uh-nga̍uh-liām ê lâng ōe chiap-siū kà-sī.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Chiah-ê pōe-poān ê chú-bîn, chhám ah! In bô chiàu góa ê sim-ì, ka-kī tēng kè-ōe, bô chiàu góa ê chí-ì loān kiat bêng-iok, tì-kàu chōe-siōng-ka-chōe.
In bô mn̄g góa chiū lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p, chhē-kiû Hoat-ló ê pó-hō͘, thang bih tī Ai-ki̍p ê si̍t-kó͘-ē.
M̄-kú ǹg-bāng Hoat-ló pó-hō͘, pìⁿ-chòe lín ê kiàn-siàu; kî-thāi Ai-ki̍p tì-ìm, tian-tò hō͘ lín làu-khùi.
Sui-jiân in ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ khì kàu Só-an, in ê sù-chiá phài-kàu Hap-lōe-su,
m̄-kú in ta̍k-ê lâng lóng ōe siū-tio̍h bú-jio̍k kiàn-siàu, in-ūi Ai-ki̍p bōe-tàng pang-chān in, bōe-tàng hō͘ in sím-mi̍h lī-ek, chí-ū hō͘ in kiàn-siàu làu-khùi.”

Iú-koan Nî-kek-hu Iá-siù ê sìn-sit: Iû-tāi ê sù-chiá chiong châi-bu̍t chài tī lû-á ê ka-chiah, chiong châi-pó khòa tī lo̍k-tô ê ka-chiah-phiaⁿ. In keng-kè kan-lân khùn-khó͘ ê tōe, tī hia ū sai teh háu, ū to̍k-chôa kap pe-chôa, khì kàu bōe-tàng kiù in ê kok-ka hia.
Ai-ki̍p ê pang-chān oân-choân bô lō͘-ēng, só͘-í, góa kiò i chòe “Chē-tiāⁿ-tiāⁿ bô lō͘-ēng ê La-hap-pek ”.
Taⁿ lí khì, tī in bīn-chêng chiong chiah-ê khek tī chio̍h-pán, siá tī chheh--ni̍h; tī beh lâi ê ji̍t-chí, thang éng-oán chòe kiàn-chèng.
In-ūi in sī pōe-poān ê chú-bîn, khi-phiàn ê kiáⁿ-jî; Siōng Chú ê kà-sī, in lóng m̄ thiaⁿ.

In kā sian-kiàn kóng, “M̄-thang khòaⁿ īⁿ-siōng.” In kā sian-ti kóng, “M̄-thang kā goán kóng chèng-khak ê ū-giân; tio̍h kā goán kóng goán kah-ì thiaⁿ ê ōe, kā goán ū-giân bô-iáⁿ-chiah ê tāi-chì.
Goán beh lī-khui chiàⁿ-lō͘, tùi ti̍t-lō͘ oa̍t-cháu, bô ài koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè ê miâ.”
Só͘-í, Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “In-ūi lín kū-choa̍t chit-ê sìn-sit, tian-tò sìn-nāi ap-pek, óa-khò khi-phiàn,
só͘-í, chit-ê chōe tī lín sin-chiūⁿ ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ koân-chhiûⁿ ê pit-hûn piak-li̍h, hut-jiân tó-hoāi.
I ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hûi-khì hō͘ sio-hûi sai-hū tōa-la̍t siak, phòa kah chhùi-kô͘-kô͘, bô kah chi̍t tè ōe-tàng the̍h-lâi chhú hé-lô͘ ê hé-chéng, iúⁿ chúi-tî ê chúi.”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “Tio̍h hoán-hóe an-hioh, lín chiū tit-tio̍h kái-kiù; tio̍h tìn-chēng sìn-khò, lín chiū tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t, m̄-kú lín kū-choa̍t.
Lín kóng ‘Bô ài! Goán beh khiâ-bé tô-cháu’, só͘-í, lín ōe chin kín tô-cháu; lín kóng ‘Goán beh khiâ khoài-má tô-cháu’, só͘-í, jip lín ê lâng ōe tui chin kín.

Tùi-te̍k chi̍t ê lâng hoah, lín chi̍t-chheng lâng tô-cháu, gō͘ ê hoah-hiàm, lín choân-pō͘ cháu-sòaⁿ; chhun--ê, chhin-chhiūⁿ soaⁿ-téng ê chi̍t ki kî-koaⁿ, soaⁿ-thâu ê chi̍t ki tōa-kî.”
Siōng Chú iáu-teh thèng-hāu beh si-un hō͘ Sek-an; I it-tēng beh khí-lâi lîn-bín lín. Siōng Chú sī kong-gī ê Siōng-tè; só͘-ū thèng-hāu I ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Khiā-khí tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, Sek-an ê jîn-bîn ah, lín bōe koh-chài thî-khàu. I thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín thî-khàu ê siaⁿ, ōe si-un hō͘ lín; I chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū ōe ìn lín.
Sui-jiân Chú ēng kan-lân chòe pn̄g, ēng khùn-khó͘ chòe chúi hō͘ lín, m̄-kú lín ê Lāu-su bōe koh bih--khí-lâi, lín ōe chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê Lāu-su.
Bô-lūn lín phian chiàⁿ-pêng á-sī phian tò-pêng, lín ōe thiaⁿ-tio̍h āu-bīn ū siaⁿ tùi lín kóng, “Che sī chiàⁿ-lō͘; lín tio̍h kiâⁿ chit-tiâu lō͘.”

Jiân-āu lín beh chiong lín só͘ tiau-khek siuⁿ gûn ê ngó͘-siōng, kap só͘ chù-chō pau kim ê sîn-siōng kā in phah lâ-sâm, chhin-chhiūⁿ kā bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h hìⁿ-sak, kóng, “Mài koh hō͘ goán khòaⁿ--tio̍h!”

Chú ōe lo̍h-hō͘, hō͘ lín iā tī thô͘--ni̍h ê chéng-chí seng-tióng, hō͘ thó͘-tōe só͘ chhut ê ngó͘-kok hó koh hong-hù. Tī hit-ji̍t, lín ê cheng-siⁿ ōe tī khoan-khoah ê chháu-po͘ chia̍h-chháu.
Lôe-hn̂g ê gû kap lû ōe chia̍h ēng chhiám-á kap pê-á iāⁿ chheng-khì, koh chham iâm ê chhī-liāu.
Tī lín ê tùi-te̍k siū tōa tô͘-sat ê ji̍t, in ê siú-bōng-tâi tó-hoāi ê sî, lín múi chi̍t ê tōa-soaⁿ koân-niá lóng ōe ū khoe-chúi ti̍t-ti̍t lâu.

Tī Siōng Chú pau-chat I hō͘ I chú-bîn siū ê siong, i-tī I kā in chek-hoa̍t ê tāng-siong hit-sî, ge̍h-niû ê kng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t-thâu ê kng, ji̍t-thâu ōe hoat-chhut chhit pē ê kng, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhit ji̍t kú lóng-chóng ê kng.

Lí khòaⁿ, Siōng Chú pún-sin tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi; I ê siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ béng-lia̍t ê hé teh to̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ ba̍t-ba̍t ê ian chhèng koân. I ê chhùi-tûn chhiong-móa hùn-lō͘; I ê chi̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ teh thun-bia̍t ê hé.
I ê khùi chhin-chhiūⁿ tiòng kàu ām-kún ê khoe-chúi; I beh ēng húi-bia̍t ê thai-á thai lia̍t-kok, ēng bé-kā-kiuⁿ tàu tī in ê chhùi, kā in thoa-khì sí-bông-chi-tōe.

M̄-kú lín, Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn, beh chhiùⁿ-koa, chhin-chhiūⁿ choeh-kî ê àm-mî teh khèng-chiok; sim-lāi hoaⁿ-hí, pûn phín-á chiūⁿ Siōng Chú ê soaⁿ, chiūⁿ kàu Í-sek-lia̍t ê Chio̍h-pôaⁿ hia.

Siōng Chú beh hō͘ lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h I ui-giâm ê siaⁿ, hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h I hêng-hoa̍t ê chhiú-kut, ū ke̍k-tōa ê siū-khì, thun-bia̍t ê hé-iām, ū chhè-lûi, pō-hong, kap chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-thâu ê peng-pha̍uh.
A-su̍t -lâng ōe in-ūi Siōng Chú ê siaⁿ kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, in-ūi I ōe ēng koáiⁿ-á phah in.
Siōng Chú múi chi̍t piàn ēng hêng-hoa̍t ê koáiⁿ kā in kòng, I ê chú-bîn lóng ōe tôaⁿ-khîm phah-kó͘ phòe-ha̍p; tī cheng-chiàn ê sî, I ōe chhut-chhiú kap in kau-chiàn.

Tô-hui-te̍k í-keng ūi-tio̍h A-su̍t -ông chún-pī hó-sè, hit só͘-chāi ê hé-khut chhim koh khoah, lāi-bīn ū hé kap chin chōe bo̍k-châi; Siōng Chú ê khùi, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh sio ê liû-hông, beh kā bo̍k-châi tiám-to̍h.

Chhám ah, hiah-ê lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p kiû pang-chān ê lâng! In óa-khò bé, óa-khò chin chōe chiàn-chhia, óa-khò chin kiông ê bé-peng. In bô ài gióng-bōng Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè, mā bô beh chhē-kiû Siōng Chú ê pang-chān.
M̄-kú, Siōng Chú ū tì-hūi, I ōe kàng chai-lān, bōe siu-hôe I ê ōe, ōe khí-lâi kong-kek pháiⁿ-lâng ê ke, tùi-khòng hiah-ê pang-chān choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng.

Ai-ki̍p -lâng put-kò sī lâng, m̄-sī Siōng-tè; in ê bé sī hiat-jio̍k, m̄-sī sîn-lêng. Siōng Chú chi̍t-ē chhut-chhiú, pang-chān--ê ōe poa̍h-tó, siū pang-chān--ê ōe tó--lo̍h-khì; nn̄g pêng ê lâng lóng ōe chòe-hé bia̍t-bông.

Siōng Chú ū tùi góa án-ni kóng: Sai á-sī sai-á-thûn ūi-tio̍h i ê la̍h-bu̍t hm̄-hm̄-háu, kui-tīn bo̍k-chiá chi̍p óa-lâi kong-kek i ê sî, i bōe in-ūi in ê háng-hoah tio̍h-kiaⁿ, bōe in-ūi in ê soan-hoa cháu-siám. Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ōe lo̍h-lâi Sek-an-soaⁿ ê soaⁿ-niá chok-chiàn.

Chhin-chhiūⁿ thí-si̍t teh pe ê chiáu án-chóaⁿ pó-hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe mā beh án-ni pó-hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; I beh siú-hō͘, beh tháu-pàng, beh kái-kiù, beh pó-siú.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, tio̍h hóe-kái, kui-ǹg lín só͘ pōe-ge̍k ê Siōng Chú.
Tī hit-ji̍t, ta̍k-ê lâng beh sàu-tû kim ê ngó͘-siōng kap gûn ê ngó͘-siōng, chiū-sī lín siang-chhiú só͘ chō tì-kàu lín ka-kī hoān-chōe ê ngó͘-siōng.

A-su̍t ōe sí tī to-ē, m̄-sī in-ūi lâng ê to chō-sêng--ê; A-su̍t ōe hō͘ to thun-bia̍t, m̄-sī in-ūi lâng ê to. In hō͘ to-kiàm tui-jip tô-cháu; in ê siàu-liân-lâng it-tēng ōe chòe khó͘-kang.

A-su̍t -ông ōe khióng-hông siau-iûⁿ; in ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ in-ūi kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ pàng-sak kun-kî tô-cháu. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘. Siōng Chú tī Sek-an-soaⁿ ū hé, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ū hé-lô͘.
Lín khòaⁿ, ū chi̍t ê ông ēng kong-chèng tī-kok, ū koaⁿ-tiúⁿ chiàu chèng-ti̍t tī-lí;
in múi chi̍t ê lóng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ pī-hong-káng, pō-hong-ú tiong ê pī-lān-só͘; chhin-chhiūⁿ soa-bô͘ tiong ê khoe-chúi, hong-po͘ tiong tōa chio̍h-pôaⁿ ê ìm-ńg.
Hit-sî, ba̍k-kng ê lâng ōe kim-kim-khòaⁿ; hī-khang ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng ōe chù-ì thiaⁿ.
Chhong-pōng ê lâng ū hó phòaⁿ-toàn; chhùi-chi̍h tūn ê lâng kóng-ōe sūn koh chheng-chhó.
Bô lâng ōe koh kóng gōng-lâng sī ko-sióng; bô lâng ōe chheng siáu-jîn chòe kun-chú.

Gōng-lâng kóng gōng-ōe, sim chí-ū siūⁿ-beh chòe pháiⁿ. I chòe siat-to̍k ê sū, kóng pháiⁿ-ōe kong-kek Siōng Chú; i hō͘ iau-gō ê lâng bô mi̍h thang chia̍h, pàng chhùi-ta ê lâng bô chúi thang lim.
Kan-kúi ê lâng ēng ê hong-hoat khúi-chà; in kè-bô͘ siâ-ok, sui-jiân khùn-khó͘-lâng iau-kiû kong-chèng, in iáu ēng gūi-chèng húi-bia̍t sàn-chhiah-lâng.
M̄-kú kun-chú kè-ōe ko-sióng ê sū, kian-chhî chòe ko-sióng ê tāi-chì.
Chheng-êng ê hū-jîn-lâng ah, khí--lâi, lâi thiaⁿ góa ê ōe; bô-khòa-bô-lū ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ góa kóng ê ōe.
Lín chiah-ê bô-khòa-bô-lū ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, koh kè chi̍t nî gōa, lín ōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, in-ūi bô phû-tô thang bán, bô ké-chí thang siu-sêng.
Chheng-êng ê hū-jîn-lâng ah, tio̍h phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah; bô-khòa-bô-lū ê cha-bó͘ gín-á ah, tio̍h kiaⁿ-kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ-hiâⁿ! Tio̍h chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, io hâ môa-pò͘.
Tio̍h ūi-tio̍h hó ê chhân-tōe, ūi-tio̍h kiat chi̍t-pha chi̍t-pha ê phû-tô-chhiū tûi-heng ai-khàu.
Góa chú-bîn ê thó͘-tōe ōe hoat chhì-phè kap cha̍p-chháu, khoài-lo̍k ê siâⁿ-chhī, hoaⁿ-hí ê ka-hn̂g mā ōe án-ni.

Ông-kiong ōe hō͘ lâng pàng-sak, lāu-jia̍t ê siâⁿ-chhī bô lâng tòa, siâⁿ-pó kap siú-bōng-thah lóng ōe éng-oán pìⁿ-chòe tōng-hia̍t, chiâⁿ-chòe iá-lû kap gû iûⁿ hoaⁿ-hí ê chháu-po͘.
Kàu Siōng-tè chhe I ê sîn tùi téng-bīn piàⁿ lo̍h-lâi hō͘ lán, hit-sî, khòng-iá ōe pìⁿ-chòe pûi ê hn̂g, pûi ê hn̂g ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū-nâ.
Hit-sî, kong-pêng beh tòa tī khòng-iá, kong-gī beh hioh tī pûi-nńg ê thó͘-tōe.
Kong-gī ê kong-hāu sī hô-pêng, kong-gī ê hāu-kó sī pêng-chēng an-ún, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
Góa ê chú-bîn ōe tòa tī hô-bo̍k ê ke, an-ún ê chhù-the̍h, thang hioh-khùn bô siū kiáu-jiáu ê só͘-chāi.
Sui-jiân chhiū-nâ siū peng-pha̍uh húi-hoāi, siâⁿ-chhī siū thiah-húi pìⁿ-chòe pîⁿ-tōe,
m̄-kú lín chiah-ê tī khoe-piⁿ iā-chéng, hō͘ gû lû ōe-tàng chū-chāi chia̍h-chháu ê lâng, si̍t-chāi ū hok-khì!

Chhám ah, lí chit-ê iáu-bē siū húi-bia̍t ê húi-bia̍t-chiá, lí chit-ê m̄-bat siū pōe-poān ê pōe-poān-chiá! Lí húi-bia̍t lâng liáu-āu, lí mā ōe siū húi-bia̍t; lí pōe-poān lâng liáu-āu, lí mā ōe siū pōe-poān.
Siōng Chú ah, lîn-bín goán; goán teh thèng-hāu lí. Kiû lí ta̍k chá-khí chòe goán ê khùi-la̍t, tī goán tú-tio̍h hoān-lān ê sî chòe goán ê chín-kiù.
Lí chi̍t-ē hoah-siaⁿ, bān-bîn lóng tô-cháu; lí chi̍t-ē tián-ui, bān-kok lóng sì-sòaⁿ.
Lâng ōe lâi siu-si̍p chiàn-lī-phín, ná-chún chháu-meh-kong chi̍p óa--lâi; chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh chiⁿ óa--khì, lâng ōe án-ni saⁿ-chiⁿ chhiúⁿ.
Siōng Chú siū chun chòe tōa, I tòa tī ke̍k-koân ê só͘-chāi; I beh chiong kong-pêng chèng-gī chhiong-móa Sek-an.
I beh hō͘ lí it-seng it-sè an-ún, ū hong-sēng ê kiù-un, tì-hūi, kap tì-sek; kèng-ùi Siōng Chú sī lí ê chì-pó.
Lín khòaⁿ, ióng-sū tī koe-lō͘ teh ai-kiò; kiû-hô ê chhe-sài ai-chhám thî-khàu.
Tōa-lō͘ chhiⁿ-chhìn, bô lâng teh kiâⁿ. Khè-iok phò-lia̍t, chèng-jîn siū khòaⁿ-khin; lâng bô siū chun-tiōng.
Tāi-tōe ai-siong soe-pāi; Lê-pa-lūn kiàn-siàu ko͘-tâ; Sa-lûn pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ khòng-iá; Pa-san kap Ka-bi̍t ê chhiū-hio̍h lak-liáu-liáu.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Chit-chūn góa beh khiā--khí-lâi, beh ko-kú ka-kī, hián-bêng góa ê tōa khùi-la̍t.
Lín hoâi-īn--ê sī chho͘-khng, seng-sán--ê sī be̍h-kó; góa ê khùi beh ná hé thun-bia̍t lín.
Bān-bîn ōe hō͘ hé sio kah pìⁿ-chòe chio̍h-he, chhin-chhiūⁿ chām--khí-lâi ê chhì-phè hō͘ hé sio-bia̍t.
Lín tī hn̄g-hn̄g ê lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa só͘ chòe ê sū; lín tī kūn-kūn ê lâng, tio̍h sêng-jīn góa ê tāi-lêng.”

Sek-an ê chōe-jîn lóng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; bô kèng-khiân ê lâng phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah; in kóng, “Lán kiám ū lâng ōe-tàng kap thun-bia̍t ê hé khiā-khí? Kiám ū lâng ōe-tàng kap éng-oán bōe hoa ê hé chòe-hé tòa?”

Hiah-ê hêng-ûi kong-gī, kóng-ōe chèng-ti̍t, iàm-ò͘ⁿ khi-ap tit--lâi ê châi-lī, iô-chhiú kū-choa̍t hóe-lō͘, that hī-khang m̄ thiaⁿ hāi-lâng ê kè-bô͘, ng ba̍k-chiu bô khòaⁿ siâ-ok,
chit-khoán lâng ōe tòa tī koân ê só͘-chāi, ēng soaⁿ-giâm ê pó-lúi chòe i ê pī-lān-só͘, bí-niû kiong-kip chhiong-chiok, chúi-goân put-toān.
Lín ōe chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h ông ê kong-chhái, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ khui-khoah ê thó͘-tōe.

Lín ōe hôe-sióng chá-chêng khióng-pò͘ ê sū, sim-lāi kóng, “Taⁿ, hiah-ê khioh-sè--ê tī tó-ūi? Teh chhìn chìn-kòng ê kim-gûn--ê tī tó-ūi? Tī siú-bōng-tâi teh kàm-sī lán--ê tī tó-ūi?”
Lín bōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ áu-bân ê jîn-bîn; in kóng lâng thiaⁿ-bô ê ōe, kóng-ōe thi̍h-thi̍h-thu̍h-thu̍h, lâng bōe liáu-kái.

Tio̍h chù-ba̍k khòaⁿ Sek-an, lín siú-choeh ê siâⁿ. Lín ê ba̍k-chiu ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chi̍t ê chheng-chēng an-ún ê chū-the̍h, bōe hō͘ lâng î-sóa ê pò͘-pîⁿ; i ê khi̍t-á bōe koh pu̍ih--khí-lâi, i ê soh bōe tn̄g--khì.
Tī hia Siōng Chú beh tùi lán hián-chhut ui-giâm. Hia ū khui-khoah ê kang-hô kap khoe, bô chiàn-chûn keng-kè, bô tōa chiah chûn óng-lâi.
In-ūi Siōng Chú sī lán ê sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, sī lán ê chí-hui-koaⁿ, sī lán ê kun-ông, I ōe kái-kiù lán.
Chûn ê soh lóng lēng--khì, phâng-thiāu khiā bōe chāi, chûn-phâng thí bōe khui; hit-sî, ū chin chōe chiàn-lī-phín thang pun, liân kha-pái ê lâng to ū hūn.
Tī hia khiā-khí ê lâng bô lâng ōe kóng “Góa phòa-pīⁿ”; chū-bîn ê chōe lóng ōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Lia̍t-kok ah, óa-lâi thiaⁿ! Bān-bîn ah, chù-ì thiaⁿ! Choân-tōe kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê bān-mi̍h, sè-kài kap tòa tī hit lāi-bīn--ê, lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ!
In-ūi Siōng Chú tùi bān-kok hoat siū-khì, tùi bān-kun hoat tōa siū-khì. I beh kā in siau-bia̍t, hō͘ in chhut-chāi lâng thâi.
Siū thâi-sí--ê ōe hō͘ lâng hìⁿ-sak; sin-si ê chhàu-bī chhèng-koân. Chèng-soaⁿ ōe in-ūi in ê huih hoán âng.

Thiⁿ-téng ê bān-siōng ōe siau-sit; thiⁿ ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chheh kńg--khí-lâi. Thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ-sîn ōe lak--lo̍h-lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ phû-tô-chhiū-hio̍h lian--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ bû-hoa-kó-chhiū ta--khì.
Góa ê kiàm í-keng tī thiⁿ-téng chhut-hiān. Khòaⁿ leh, chit-ki kiàm beh kàng-lo̍h tī Í-tong, lîm-kàu hiah-ê góa phòaⁿ-chòe eng-kai bia̍t-bông ê jîn-bîn.

Siōng Chú ê kiàm kui-ki lóng huih kap iû, chiū-sī iûⁿ-ko kap soaⁿ-iûⁿ ê huih, í-ki̍p iûⁿ-káng io-chí ê iû. In-ūi tī Pho-su-la ū chè-mi̍h beh hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú, tī Í-tong ū tōa tô͘-sat.
Iá-gû ōe kap in chòe-hé siū thâi, gû-á-kiáⁿ kap gû-káng mā ōe án-ni. In ê thó͘-tōe ōe hō͘ huih bak âng; in ê thô͘ kui-ê lóng iû.
In-ūi Siōng Chú ū pò-siû ê ji̍t, ūi-tio̍h Sek-an ê àn-kiāⁿ ū sin-oan ê nî.
Í-tong ê khoe-chúi lóng pìⁿ táⁿ-má-ka, thô͘ pìⁿ-chòe liû-hông, thó͘-tōe pìⁿ-chòe teh sio ê táⁿ-má-ka.
Mî-ji̍t hé lóng bōe sit, hé-ian éng-oán teh chhèng. Thó͘-tōe ōe tāi-tāi pha-hng, éng-oán bô lâng tùi hia keng-kè.
M̄-kú thê-ô͘ kap hô-ti ōe chiàm hia, niau-thâu-chiáu kap o͘-a ōe tī hia choh-siū. Siōng Chú beh ēng hūn-tūn chòe chîn-sòaⁿ kā i niû, ēng khang-hu chòe tūi-chîn kā i chhek.
In ê ông-kok ōe bia̍t-bông; in ê kùi-cho̍k kap koaⁿ-tiúⁿ ōe lóng siau-sit.
Kiong-tiān ōe hoat chhì-phè, chi̍t-lê kap cha̍p-chháu ōe khàm-móa iàu-sài; hia ōe chiâⁿ-chòe chhâi-lông tòa ê só͘-chāi, tô-chiáu tī hia choh-siū.

Khòng-iá ê cháu-siù kap chhâi-lông ōe tòa tī hia, iá-soaⁿ-iûⁿ ōe kap i ê tâng-phōaⁿ saⁿ tùi-kiò; iā-kan ê kúi-koài ōe tī hia hioh-khùn, tī hia chhē-tio̍h an-hioh ê só͘-chāi.
Tī hia ū chìⁿ-thâu-chôa choh-siū, siⁿ-nn̄g, pū chôa-kiáⁿ, chiàu-kò͘ chôa-kiáⁿ; bā-hio̍h tī hia chū-chi̍p, kang--ê bú--ê lóng chi̍p chòe-hé.

Lín tio̍h chhâ-khó, tio̍h tha̍k Siōng Chú ê chheh; bô chi̍t hāng tōng-bu̍t bô tī hit lāi-bīn, kang--ê bú--ê tùi-tùi lóng ū. In-ūi Siōng Chú ê chhùi ū bēng-lēng, I ê khùi kā in chū-chi̍p.
I ūi-tio̍h in thiu-chhiam, chhin-chhiú ēng soh kā in pun tōe-kài; in ōe éng-oán tit-tio̍h só͘ pun ê tōe-khu, sè-sè-tāi-tāi tòa tī hia.
Khòng-iá kap ta-sò ê tōe beh hoaⁿ-hí, soa-bô͘ beh khoài-lo̍k, chhin-chhiūⁿ mûi-kùi khui-hoe.

Mûi-kùi beh khui-hoe bō͘-sēng, beh hoaⁿ-hí hoan-ho͘. I beh ū Lê-pa-lūn ê êng-kng, beh tit-tio̍h Ka-bi̍t kap Sa-lûn ê kong-chhái. In ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê êng-iāu, kìⁿ-tio̍h lán Siōng-tè ê kong-chhái.
Tio̍h hō͘ loán-jio̍k ê chhiú kian-kiông, hō͘ bô-la̍t ê kha-thâu-u khiā-chāi.

Sim-koaⁿ kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ê lâng, lín tio̍h tùi in kóng, “Tio̍h kian-kiông, m̄-bián kiaⁿ! Lín khòaⁿ, lín ê Siōng-tè beh lâi sin-oan; Siōng-tè it-tēng ōe si-hêng pò-èng lâi chín-kiù lín.”
Hit-sî, sit-bêng ê lâng ba̍k-chiu ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ; sit-chhong ê lâng hī-khang ōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Kha-pái ê lâng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k tiô-thiàu; bōe kóng-ōe ê lâng ōe hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa. Hong-po͘ beh ū chúi chhèng-chhut; soa-bô͘ beh ū kang-hô teh lâu.
Iām-jia̍t ê soa-tōe ōe pìⁿ-chòe chúi-tî; ta-sò ê thó͘-tōe ōe pìⁿ-chòe chôaⁿ-goân. Chhâi-lông tòa ê só͘-chāi ōe hoat chhiⁿ-chháu, lô͘-úi, kap pô͘-chháu.

Tī hia beh ū chi̍t tiâu tōa-lō͘, lâng kā i kiò-chòe “Sèng-lō͘”. Bô chheng-khì ê lâng lóng bōe-tàng tùi hia keng-kè; hit-tiâu lō͘ sī ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn chō--ê; kiâⁿ hit-tiâu lō͘--ê, liân gōng-lâng to bōe bê-lō͘.
Tī hia bô sai, hiong-béng ê iá-siù mā bōe chhut-hiān. Tī hia lâng bōe tú-tio̍h iá-siù; chí-ū siū kiù-sio̍k ê lâng ōe kiâⁿ hit-tiâu lō͘.
Siōng Chú sio̍k-hôe ê lâng ōe tò-tńg--lâi, chhiùⁿ-koa lâi kàu Sek-an; éng-oán ê hí-lo̍k ōe chòe in ê hoa-koan. In ōe hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, bô koh ū pi-siong thó͘-khùi.
Hi-se-ka -ông tē-cha̍p-sì nî, A-su̍t -ông Se-ná-ki-li̍p chiūⁿ-lâi kong-kek Iû-tāi só͘-ū kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, koh kā in chiàm-léng.
A-su̍t -ông tùi La-kiat phài chóng-su-lēng tòa tāi-kun khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Hi-se-ka -ông hia. Chóng-su-lēng khiā tī Siōng-tî ê chúi-kau piⁿ, tī Phiò-pò͘-tiûⁿ ê tōa-lō͘ hia.
Hit-sî, Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ kiong-têng chóng-koán Í-lī-a-kèng, su-kì Sià-pek-ná, í-ki̍p A-sat ê kiáⁿ sú-koaⁿ Iok-a, chhut-lâi kìⁿ i.
Chóng-su-lēng tùi in kóng, “Khì kā Hi-se-ka kóng, A-su̍t tāi-ông án-ni kóng, ‘Lí teh khò-sè sím-mi̍h?
Lí siūⁿ-kóng ū chhek-lio̍k kap kun-le̍k, kî-si̍t sī phòng-hong ê ōe. Tàu-tóe lí sī khò siáⁿ-lâng, kèng-jiân káⁿ hoán-poān góa?
Lí só͘ óa-khò ê Ai-ki̍p sī chi̍t ki tn̄g--khì ê lô͘-tek-á-koáiⁿ; lâng nā khò i, chhiú ōe hō͘ i chha̍k--ji̍p-khì. Só͘-ū óa-khò Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló ê lâng lóng ōe án-ni.

Lín nā tùi góa kóng: Goán óa-khò Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè; Hi-se-ka kiám m̄-sī ū hòe-tû Siōng-tè ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ kap chè-tôaⁿ, koh kā Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng kóng: Lín it-tēng tio̍h tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chit-ê chè-tôaⁿ kèng-pài?’
Taⁿ lâi, lâi kap góa ê chú-lâng A-su̍t -ông sio-su. Góa hō͘ lín nn̄g-chheng chiah bé, lín kiám ū hoat-tō͘ chhē kàu-gia̍h ê lâng thang khiâ?
Nā bô hoat-tō͘, lín ná ōe-tàng phah-pāi góa ê chú siōng-sòe ê chi̍t ê pō͘-hā? Lín kiám beh koh óa-khò Ai-ki̍p ê chiàn-chhia kap bé-peng?

Hiān-chāi, góa lâi kong-kek húi-bia̍t chit-ê thó͘-tōe, kiám m̄-sī Siōng Chú ê chí-ì? Siōng Chú chhin-sin kā góa kóng, ‘Chiūⁿ-khì kong-chhú chit-tè thó͘-tōe, kā i húi-bia̍t.’”

Í-lī-a-kèng, Sià-pek-ná, kap Iok-a tùi chóng-su-lēng kóng, “Chhiáⁿ ēng A-lân-ōe tùi lí ê po̍k-jîn kóng, goán thiaⁿ ū. Chhiáⁿ m̄-thang ēng Hi-pek-lâi-ōe kóng, kiaⁿ-liáu hō͘ siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng ê jîn-bîn thiaⁿ--tio̍h.”

M̄-kú chóng-su-lēng kóng, “Lín siūⁿ-kóng goán chú-lâng chhe góa kóng chiah-ê ōe, chí-ū beh hō͘ lín kap lín ê kok-ông thiaⁿ sī--bô? M̄-sī, góa mā beh kóng hō͘ siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng ê lâng thiaⁿ. In kap lín kâng-khoán tio̍h chia̍h ka-kī ê pùn, lim ka-kī ê jiō.”
Chóng-su-lēng koh khiā khí-lâi tōa-siaⁿ ēng Hi-pek-lâi-ōe hoah kóng, “Tio̍h thiaⁿ A-su̍t tāi-ông ê ōe.
Ông án-ni kóng, ‘M̄-thang hō͘ Hi-se-ka phiàn--khì, in-ūi i bōe-tàng kiù lín.
I kiò lín sìn-khò Siōng Chú, kóng: Siōng Chú it-tēng ōe kiù lán; chit-ê siâⁿ bōe hām-lo̍h tī A-su̍t -ông ê chhiú.’

M̄-thang thiaⁿ Hi-se-ka ê ōe. A-su̍t -ông án-ni kóng, ‘Kap góa kóng-hô, chhut-lâi tâu-hâng. Án-ni, lín ta̍k-ê lâng chiū ōe-tàng chia̍h ka-kī chèng ê phû-tô kap bû-hoa-kó, lim lín ka-kī ê chíⁿ-chúi,
thèng-hāu góa chhōa lín kàu chi̍t ê só͘-chāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ê thó͘-tōe, ū ngó͘-kok kap sin-chiú, ū bí-niû kap phû-tô-hn̂g.
