M̄-thang hō͘ Hi-se-ka khi-phiàn kóng: Siōng Chú it-tēng ōe kiù lán. Bān-kok ê chèng sîn-bêng tó chi̍t ê bat kiù i ka-kī ê kok thoat-lī A-su̍t -ông ê chhiú?
Hap-má kap A-ní-poa̍t ê sîn-bêng tī tó-ūi? Se-hoat-óa-im ê sîn-bêng tī tó-ūi? In kiám ū kái-kiù Sat-má-lī-a thoat-lī góa ê chhiú?
Chiah-ê kok-ka ê sîn-bêng ū tó chi̍t ê bat tùi góa ê chhiú kiù-chhut i ka-kī ê kok-ka? Án-ni, Siōng Chú ná ōe-tàng kiù Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng thoat-lī góa ê chhiú-thâu?’”
M̄-kú jîn-bîn lóng chēng-chēng, bô ìn pòaⁿ-kù ōe, in-ūi Hi-se-ka -ông ū kā in hoan-hù, “M̄-thang ìn i!”

Hit-sî, Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ kiong-têng chóng-koán Í-lī-a-kèng, su-kì Sià-pek-ná, kap A-sat ê kiáⁿ sú-koaⁿ Iok-a, lóng thiah-li̍h in ê saⁿ, tùi Hi-se-ka pò-kò A-su̍t ê chóng-su-lēng kā in kóng ê ōe.
Hi-se-ka -ông chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h in ê pò-kò, chiū thiah-li̍h i ê saⁿ, chhēng môa-saⁿ, ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān.
I phài kiong-têng chóng-koán Í-lī-a-kèng, su-kì Sià-pek-ná, kap chu-chhim ê chè-si, lóng chhēng môa-saⁿ khì kìⁿ A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Í-sài-a.

In kā Í-sài-a kóng, “ Hi-se-ka án-ni kóng, ‘Kin-á-ji̍t sī hoān-lān ê ji̍t, sī siū chek-hoa̍t lêng-jio̍k ê ji̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ ū gín-á beh chhut-sì, m̄-kú bô-la̍t kā siⁿ--chhut-lâi.

A-su̍t -ông ū phài i ê pō͘-hā chóng-su-lēng lâi siat-to̍k éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè, kiám-chhái Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h, ōe chhú-hoa̍t kóng chiah-ê ōe ê lâng. Só͘-í, tio̍h thòe lâu tī chia ê lâng kî-tó.’”
Hi-se-ka -ông ê tāi-sîn lâi kìⁿ Í-sài-a ê sî,

Í-sài-a tùi in kóng, “Lín tio̍h án-ni kā lín ê chú-lâng kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: M̄-thang in-ūi lín só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h A-su̍t -ông ê pō͘-hā tùi góa ê húi-pòng lâi kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh jiáu-loān i ê sim, hō͘ i thiaⁿ-tio̍h hong-siaⁿ, tò-tńg-khì ka-kī ê kok-ka; góa beh hō͘ i tī hia hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.’”
Chóng-su-lēng thiaⁿ-tio̍h A-su̍t -ông í-keng lī-khui La-kiat khì kong-kek Li̍p-ná, chiū chhut-hoat khì Li̍p-ná kap ông hōe-ha̍p.
A-su̍t -ông thiaⁿ-kìⁿ I-soh-phit-a -ông Te̍k-hap-ka beh lâi kong-kek in, chiū phài sù-chiá khì kìⁿ Hi-se-ka, hoan-hù in
tùi Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka kóng, “M̄-thang hō͘ lín só͘ óa-khò ê Siōng-tè phiàn--khì, kóng: Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng bōe hām-lo̍h tī A-su̍t -ông ê chhiú-thâu.
Lín it-tēng ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h A-su̍t chu-ông tùi lia̍t-kok só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì; in kā lia̍t-kok lóng châu-bia̍t. Lín kiám ū hoat-tō͘ pī-bián?
Góa ê chó͘-sian húi-bia̍t ê kok-ka, Ko-sàn, Hap-lân, Lī-sek, í-ki̍p tòa tī Thê-la-sat ê Pek I-tiân -lâng, in ê sîn-bêng kiám ū kái-kiù in?
Hap-má ê ông, A-ní-poa̍t ê ông, Se-hoat-óa-im -siâⁿ ê ông, Hi-ná kap Í-óa ê ông tī tó-ūi?”
Hi-se-ka tùi sù-chiá ê chhiú chiap-tio̍h phoe, tha̍k liáu-āu, chiū chiūⁿ-khì Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng chiong phoe thí-khui.
Hi-se-ka ǹg Siōng Chú kî-tó kóng,
“Chē tī thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek téng-bīn ê Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè ah, chí-ū lí sī tōe-chiūⁿ bān-kok ê Siōng-tè. Lí chhòng-chō thiⁿ kap tōe.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ, khui lí ê ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ. Kiû lí thiaⁿ Se-ná-ki-li̍p chhe sù-chiá lâi kóng it-chhè siat-to̍k lí oa̍h-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê ōe.
Siōng Chú ah, A-su̍t chu-ông khak-si̍t ū hō͘ lia̍t-kok kap in ê thó͘-tōe lóng hong-hòe,
kā in ê sîn-bêng lóng hiat hō͘ hé sio-bia̍t, kî-si̍t hiah-ê m̄-sī sîn, put-kò sī lâng ê chhiú ēng chhâ ēng chio̍h chō--ê.
Taⁿ, Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí kiù goán thoat-lī i ê chhiú, hō͘ tōe-chiūⁿ bān-kok lóng ōe chai chí-ū lí sī Siōng Chú.”
A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ Í-sài-a chhe lâng khì kìⁿ Hi-se-ka, kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lí in-ūi A-su̍t -ông Se-ná-ki-li̍p ê sū tùi góa kî-tó.
Koan-hē Se-ná-ki-li̍p, góa Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Chāi-sek-lú Sek-an khòaⁿ-khin lí, thí-chhiò lí; siàu-lú Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tùi lí iô-thâu.

Lí teh bú-jio̍k siáⁿ-lâng, siat-to̍k siáⁿ-lâng? Lí teh tùi siáⁿ-lâng tōa-siaⁿ? Lí teh tùi siáⁿ-lâng kiau-ngō͘, kā i khòaⁿ m̄ chiūⁿ-ba̍k? Kî-si̍t lí sī teh bû-sī góa Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè!

Lí ū thong-kè lí ê po̍k-jîn bú-bān Chú. Lí kóng: Góa sái chin chōe chiàn-chhia peh-chiūⁿ koân-soaⁿ, khì kàu Lê-pa-lūn siōng-koân ê soaⁿ-chiam. Góa tī hia chhò siōng-koân ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū, chhò siōng-hó ê siông-chhiū. Góa peh kàu siōng-koân ê soaⁿ-chiam, chìn-ji̍p siōng bō͘-sēng ê chhiū-nâ.
Góa ó͘ chíⁿ, lim in ê chúi. Góa mā ēng kha lap Ai-ki̍p só͘-ū ê hô-liû, lap kah hô-liû lóng ta--khì.

“‘Lín kiám m̄-bat thiaⁿ--kìⁿ? Chin chá góa chòe chit-ê kè-ōe, kó͘-chá chiū koat-tēng, taⁿ í-keng si̍t-hiān, chiū-sī lí hō͘ kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ-pó lóng tó-hoāi, pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘ chio̍h-tui.
Hia ê chū-bîn lóng bô-la̍t; in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kiàn-siàu. In chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-tōe ê chháu, iù-nńg ê íⁿ, chhù-bé-téng ê chháu, tang-hong chhe--lâi chiū ta--khì.
“‘Lí tòa tó-ūi, lí chhut, lí ji̍p, lí tùi góa ê siū-khì, góa lóng chai.

In-ūi lí ū tùi góa hoat siū-khì, góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí chū-ko ê ōe; góa beh ēng kau-á kau lí ê phīⁿ, ēng bé-kā-kiuⁿ kòa tī lí ê chhùi, hō͘ lí tùi lâi hit-tiâu lō͘ tò-tńg--khì.’
“ Hi-se-ka, che beh hō͘ lí chòe kì-hō: Kin-nî, mê-nî, lín lóng ōe chia̍h iá-seng ê mi̍h; tē-saⁿ nî, lín ōe iā-chéng, siu-sêng, chai-chèng phû-tô, chia̍h só͘ kiat ê ké-chí.
Iû-tāi -ke tô-thoat só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ si̍t-bu̍t, ē-bīn tèng-kun, téng-bīn kiat ké-chí.

Tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng beh ū chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê chú-bîn chhut--lâi, tùi Sek-an-soaⁿ beh ū lâng tô-thoat--chhut-lâi. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê jia̍t-sêng it-tēng ōe sêng-choân chit-ê sū.

“Só͘-í, koan-hē A-su̍t -ông, Siōng Chú ū án-ni kóng, ‘I bōe chìn-ji̍p chit-ê siâⁿ, liân chi̍t ki chìⁿ mā bōe siā--ji̍p-lâi. I bōe giâ tún-pâi óa-kūn siâⁿ, mā bōe khí thô͘-tui kong siâⁿ.
I tùi tó chi̍t tiâu lō͘ lâi, mā ōe tùi hit-tiâu lō͘ tńg--khì; i bōe chìn-ji̍p chit-ê siâⁿ. Siōng Chú án-ni kóng.
Góa ūi-tio̍h góa ê iân-kò͘, mā ūi-tio̍h góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê iân-kò͘, beh pó-hō͘ kái-kiù chit-ê siâⁿ.’”
Siōng Chú ê thiⁿ-sài khì A-su̍t kun-iâⁿ, thâi-sí cha̍p-poeh-bān gō͘-chheng ê lâng. Keh-chá-khí, lâng khí--lâi, hoat-kiàn ta̍k só͘-chāi lóng sī sin-si.
A-su̍t -ông Se-ná-ki-li̍p chiū thiat-iâⁿ, tò-tńg-khì Nî-nî-bî, tòa tī hia.

Ū chi̍t ji̍t, i tī Nî-su-lo̍k ê biō teh pài i ê sîn-bêng ê sî, i ê kiáⁿ A-tek-bí-le̍k kap Sa-lī-sek ēng to kā i thâi-sí, jiân-āu tô-cháu khì A-la-la̍h ê tōe; i lēng-gōa chi̍t ê kiáⁿ Í-sat Hap-tùn kè-sêng i choh-ông.

Hit-ê sî-chūn, Hi-se-ka phòa-pīⁿ, pīⁿ kah teh-beh sí. A-mô͘-su ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Í-sài-a lâi kìⁿ i, kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lí ê hō͘-sū tio̍h kau-tài hó-sè, in-ūi lí ōe sí, pīⁿ bōe hó.’”
Hi-se-ka chiū oa̍t-tńg-sin ǹg piah, tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó kóng,
“Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí tài-liām góa án-chóaⁿ tiong-sêng chīn-sim ho̍k-sāi lí, chòe lí khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū.” Hi-se-ka chiū tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu.
Jiân-āu Siōng Chú tùi Í-sài-a kóng,

“Lí khì kā Hi-se-ka kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — lí ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê kî-tó, ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê ba̍k-sái. Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh hō͘ lí ê hè-siū ke-thiⁿ cha̍p-gō͘ nî.
Góa beh kái-kiù lí kap chit-ê siâⁿ thoat-lī A-su̍t -ông ê chhiú; góa ōe pó-hō͘ chit-ê siâⁿ.’”
Í-sài-a kóng, “Siōng Chú beh si̍t-hiān I só͘ kóng ê tāi-chì; che chiū-sī Siōng Chú hō͘ lí ê tiāu-thâu.
Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú beh hō͘ chiò tī A-hap-su só͘ chō ji̍t-kui ê ji̍t-iáⁿ tò-thè cha̍p tō͘.” Kó-jiân, ji̍t-iáⁿ tò-thè cha̍p tō͘.
Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka pīⁿ hó liáu-āu siá chit-siú si:
Góa siūⁿ-kóng: Góa tī chòng-liân ê sî tio̍h lī-khui sè-kan, kiâⁿ-ji̍p Im-kan ê mn̂g, bōe-tàng hióng-siū góa só͘ chhun ê ji̍t-chí.
Góa siūⁿ-kóng: Tī oa̍h-lâng ê tōe, góa bōe-tàng koh kìⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú; tī sè-kan ê chū-bîn tiong, góa bōe-tàng koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h lâng.

Góa tòa ê só͘-chāi siū thiah, chhin-chhiūⁿ bo̍k-chiá ê pò͘-pîⁿ siū sóa-cháu. Siōng Chú chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-pò͘ ê lâng, chiong góa ê sìⁿ-miā kńg--khí-lâi, koh tùi chit-pò͘-ki kā pò͘ chián-tn̄g; I tī chi̍t ji̍t ê tiong-kan chiū beh kiat-sok góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Góa kui-mî ai-khàu ti̍t-kàu chheng-chá; I chhin-chhiūⁿ sai thiah-chhùi góa só͘-ū ê kut-thâu; tī chi̍t ji̍t ê tiong-kan chiū beh kiat-sok góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Góa chhin-chhiūⁿ ìⁿ-á chiu̍h-chiu̍h-kiò, chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu kū-kū-háu. Góa gia̍h-thâu ǹg thiⁿ, ba̍k-chiu ian-n̄g ià-siān. Góa siū khi-ap, Chú ah, kiû lí kái-kiù góa.
Góa ōe-tàng kóng sím-mi̍h? I kā góa èng-ún, mā ū chiàu án-ni chòe. Góa sim-sîn khó͘-thàng, sit-bîn, ut-chut kè-ji̍t.
Chú ah, lâng khò lí lâi oa̍h; góa ê sim-sîn tùi lí ê èng-ún tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t. Lí ū hôe-ho̍k góa ê kiān-khong, hō͘ góa kè-sio̍k oa̍h--lo̍h-khì.

Góa siū hiah-ni̍h tōa ê khó͘-thàng, khak-si̍t ū hō͘ góa tit-tio̍h lī-ek. Lí chín-kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī bia̍t-bông ê Chhim-khiⁿ, chiong góa ê chōe hiat tī lí ê ka-chiah-āu.
In-ūi Im-hú bōe-tàng kám-siā lí, Sí-bông mā bōe chheng-chàn lí. Hiah-ê lo̍h Im-hú ê lâng bōe-tàng kî-thāi lí ê sìn-si̍t.
Oa̍h ê lâng, chí-ū oa̍h--teh ê lâng ōe-tàng chheng-chàn lí, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa kin-á-ji̍t án-ni. Choh lāu-pē--ê beh hō͘ in só͘-ū ê kiáⁿ-jî chai lí ê sìn-si̍t.
Siōng Chú beh chín-kiù góa; goán beh chi̍t-sì-lâng tī Siōng Chú ê chhù, ēng hiân-ga̍k phōaⁿ-chàu chhiùⁿ-koa.
Í-sài-a kóng, “Tio̍h the̍h chi̍t tè bû-hoa-kó io̍h-ko tah tī lia̍p-á, ông chiū ōe hó.”
Hi-se-ka mn̄g kóng, “Ū sím-mi̍h tiāu-thâu hō͘ góa chai, góa ōe chiūⁿ-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān?”

Hit-sî, Pa-la-tān ê kiáⁿ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Bí-lô-ta̍t Pa-la-tān thiaⁿ-tio̍h Hi-se-ka phòa-pīⁿ, mā í-keng hó--khí-lâi, chiū chhe sù-chiá the̍h phoe kap lé-mi̍h khì thàm-hóng Hi-se-ka.

Hi-se-ka chin hoaⁿ-hí chiap-thāi in, chiong i ê châi-pó-khò͘ lāi-bīn ê kim, gûn, hiuⁿ-liāu, kùi-khì ê iû, kap i só͘-ū ê kun-khì, í-ki̍p hú-khò͘ lāi ê it-chhè lóng hō͘ in khòaⁿ. I ê ông-kiong kap choân-kok só͘-ū ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ bô chi̍t hāng bô hō͘ in khòaⁿ.

Āu-lâi sian-ti Í-sài-a lâi kìⁿ Hi-se-ka -ông, mn̄g i kóng, “Chiah-ê lâng tùi lí kóng sím-mi̍h? In tùi tó-ūi lâi kìⁿ lí?” Hi-se-ka kóng, “In tùi chi̍t ê chin hn̄g ê kok-ka Pa-pí-lûn lâi thàm góa.”

Í-sài-a kóng, “In tī lí ê ông-kiong ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h sím-mi̍h?” Hi-se-ka hôe-tap, “In ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ông-kiong lāi ta̍k-hāng mi̍h. Góa só͘-ū ê châi-pó bô chi̍t hāng bô hō͘ in khòaⁿ.”
Í-sài-a kā Hi-se-ka kóng, “Tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê ōe:

Ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, ông-kiong lāi it-chhè lí ê chó͘-sian chek-chū kàu kin-á-ji̍t ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, lóng ōe hō͘ lâng poaⁿ-khì Pa-pí-lûn, bô lâu kah pòaⁿ-hāng. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Koh lí chhin-siⁿ--ê, lí ê kiáⁿ-sun, ū-ê ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê ông-kiong chòe thài-kàm.”
Hi-se-ka sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng “Góa chāi-siⁿ ê sî ū thài-pêng an-choân chiū hó”, chiū tùi Í-sài-a kóng, “Lí só͘ thoân-ta̍t Siōng Chú ê ōe chin hó.”
Lín ê Siōng-tè kóng, “Tio̍h an-ùi, an-ùi góa ê chú-bîn!

Tio̍h kó͘-lē Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn, tùi in tōa-siaⁿ soan-pò͘: In chòe hu-ló͘ siū ê khó͘ í-keng kàu-gia̍h; in hoān ê chōe í-keng tit-tio̍h sià-bián. In ūi-tio̍h só͘ hoān ê chōe í-keng tùi Siōng Chú siū siang-pē ê hêng-hoa̍t!”
Ū siaⁿ teh hoah kóng, “Tio̍h tī khòng-iá ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú chún-pī tō-lō͘, tī hong-po͘ ūi-tio̍h lán ê Siōng-tè khui tōa-lō͘.
Ta̍k-ê soaⁿ-kok tio̍h thūn hō͘ móa, tōa soaⁿ sió soaⁿ lóng siah hō͘ pîⁿ; koân-kē bô pîⁿ ê tōe tio̍h pho͘ hō͘ pîⁿ-tháⁿ; khâm-khia̍t ê só͘-chāi hō͘ i pìⁿ-chòe pîⁿ-tōe.
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú ê êng-iāu ōe chhut-hiān; choân jîn-lūi lóng ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. Siōng Chú chhin-chhùi án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Ū siaⁿ teh hoah kóng: Tio̍h soan-pò͘! Góa mn̄g: Beh soan-pò͘ sím-mi̍h? Tio̍h soan-pò͘: Só͘-ū ê lâng lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu, in ê súi chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-tōe ê hoe.
Siōng Chú chhe--lâi ê hong chi̍t-ē sàu--kè, chháu chiū ta, hoe chiū siā. Khak-si̍t, lâng put-kò chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu!
Chháu ōe ta, hoe ōe siā, m̄-kú lán ê Siōng-tè ê ōe éng-oán chûn-chāi!

Pò hó siau-sit ê Sek-an ah, tio̍h peh-chiūⁿ koân-soaⁿ chhut-la̍t tōa-siaⁿ hoah; pò hó siau-sit ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, tio̍h hó-táⁿ, tōa-siaⁿ tùi Iû-tāi ê chèng siâⁿ kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, lín ê Siōng-tè!”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú tòa koân-lêng teh lâi lah, I beh ēng koân-pèng chiáng-koân; kap I chòe-hé--ê, ū I só͘ tháu-pàng ê lâng, kiâⁿ tī I thâu-chêng--ê, ū I kái-kiù ê chú-bîn.
I beh chhin-chhiūⁿ bo̍k-chiá kò͘ I ê iûⁿ-kûn, beh ēng chhiú âⁿ-óa iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ, kā in phō tī heng-chêng; I beh chhōa hiah-ê hō͘ iûⁿ-á suh-lin ê iûⁿ-bú ûn-ûn-á kiâⁿ.
Siáⁿ-lâng bat ēng chhiú-sim niû hái-chúi, ēng chhiú-chiúⁿ chhek-liōng thiⁿ? Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng ēng poe tóe tāi-tōe ê thô͘-hún, ēng chhìn-á chhìn tōa-soaⁿ sió-soaⁿ?
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng liáu-kái Siōng Chú ê sim, chòe I ê tō-su kā I chí-tō?
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng chòe I ê chham-bô͘, kà I chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘? Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kà I tì-sek, chí-sī I bêng-tì ê tō-lō͘?
Tī Siōng Chú gán-tiong, lia̍t-kok put-kò sī tháng-á lāi ê chi̍t tih chúi, sī thian-phêng téng ê thô͘-hún; hái-tó put-kò sī ke̍k khin ê tîn-ai!
Lê-pa-lūn ê chhiū-nâ bô-kàu chòe chhâ-liāu sio, chhiū-nâ lāi ê cháu-siù mā bô-kàu chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn.
Tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng, lia̍t-kok bô sǹg sím-mi̍h; tùi I lâi khòaⁿ, ta̍k-hāng lóng khang-khang bô chûn-chāi!
Án-ni, lín beh ēng siáⁿ-lâng lâi pí-phēng Siōng-tè? Lín beh ēng sím-mi̍h hêng-siōng lâi tāi-piáu I?
Kiám beh ēng ngó͘-siōng? Ngó͘-siōng put-kò sī sai-hū chù-chō, kim-chhiūⁿ ēng kim kā i pau, ēng gûn-liān-á kā i chng-thāⁿ.
Bô-chîⁿ thang bóe kim gûn ê lâng, in chiū kéng bōe nōa ê hó-chhâ, chhē gâu ê sai-hū kā in chhāi bōe tín-tāng ê ngó͘-siōng.
Lín kiám m̄ chai, kiám m̄-bat thiaⁿ--kìⁿ? Tùi kó͘-chá kàu taⁿ kiám m̄-bat ū lâng kā lín kóng? Lín kiám iáu-bē bêng-pe̍k tāi-tōe án-chóaⁿ siū chhòng-chō?

Siōng-tè choh-ông chē tī tāi-tōe ê kiong-chhong téng-bīn; tōe-chiūⁿ ê chū-bîn chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh hiah-ni̍h sòe. I thí-khui thiⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh thoa mn̂g-lî, tián-khui thiⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh tah pò͘-pîⁿ.
I kā thóng-tī-chiá lóng thoa--lo̍h-lâi, hō͘ sè-kan ê léng-siù siau-sit--khì.

In tú-tú chiah iā-chéng, tú-tú chiah chai-chèng, tú-tú chiah tèng-kun lo̍h thô͘, Siōng Chú ēng hong kā in chhe, in chiū ta--khì, in chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-iù-á hō͘ kńg-lê-á-hong chhe-sòaⁿ!
Sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè mn̄g: Lín beh ēng sím-mi̍h-lâng kap góa pí? Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng chhin-chhiūⁿ góa?

Lín gia̍h-thâu ǹg thiⁿ khòaⁿ-bāi leh, sī siáⁿ-lâng chhòng-chō thiⁿ-téng bān-siōng? Chiū-sī ōe-hiáu sǹg chhiⁿ-sîn ê sò͘-bo̍k koh chhōa in chhut--lâi, ōe-hiáu chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê kiò in ê miâ Hit-ūi. I ê koân-lêng khùi-la̍t tōa, liân chi̍t ê to bōe làu-kau.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ bâi-oàn, Ngá-kok ah, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ kóng “Siōng Chú m̄ chai góa siū--tio̍h ê thòng-khó͘; Siōng-tè bô koan-sim góa ê koân-ek”?
Lí kiám m̄ chai, kiám m̄-bat thiaⁿ--tio̍h? Siōng Chú sī éng-oán ê Siōng-tè, sī choân-tōe ê Chhòng-chō-chú; I bōe ià mā bōe siān, I ê tì-hūi bōe-tàng chhek-liōng.
Ià-siān ê lâng, I sù in khùi-la̍t; loán-jio̍k ê lâng, I hō͘ in lêng-le̍k.
Liân siàu-liân-lâng to ōe ià ōe siān, ióng-chòng ê lâng mā ōe thiám kah tó--lo̍h-khì.
M̄-kú óa-khò Siōng Chú ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h sin ê khùi-la̍t, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu thí-si̍t pe-koân; in phun-pháu bōe ià-siān, kiâⁿ hn̄g-lō͘ mā bōe hūn-tó.

Siōng-tè kóng: Chèng hái-sū ah, tio̍h tī góa ê bīn-chêng chēng-chēng; chèng jîn-bîn ah, tio̍h têng-sin tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t. Tio̍h hō͘ in chìn-chêng lâi sin-sò͘; lán chòe-hé khiā chìn-chêng lâi piān-lūn.

Siáⁿ-lâng tùi tang-hng heng-khí chi̍t ê sèng-lī-chiá, hō͘ i pek-chiàn-pek-sèng? Siáⁿ-lâng chiong bān-kok kau hō͘ i, hō͘ i thún-ta̍h chu-ông, hō͘ i ēng to kā in kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh sàu thô͘-hún, ēng chìⁿ kā in siau-bia̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-hong chhe-cháu be̍h-kó?
I tui-kóaⁿ in hui-siông sūn-lī, chi̍t-kú-á chiū jip-tio̍h in, kín kah ná-chún kha bô ta̍h-tio̍h tōe.

Sī siáⁿ-lâng hō͘ chit-hāng tāi-chì hoat-seng? Siáⁿ-lâng tùi khí-chho͘ chiū koat-tēng le̍k-sú ê tōng-hiòng? Chiū sī góa Siōng Chú, siōng khí-thâu góa chiū tī hia, it-ti̍t kàu siōng lō͘-bé góa mā ōe tī hia.
Chèng hái-sū ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chin kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; tōe ê ke̍k-thâu mā lóng kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah. In lóng chòe-chi̍t-ē chū-chi̍p óa--lâi.
Ta̍k-ê lâng lóng hō͘-siōng pang-chān, pí-chhú kó͘-lē kóng, “Tio̍h ióng-kám!”

Ba̍k-chhiūⁿ bián-lē gûn-chhiūⁿ; chù-chō ngó͘-siōng ê sai-hū kó͘-lē tèng teng-á ê ba̍k-chhiūⁿ. In tùi phah thih--ê kóng, “Phah-liáu chin hó!” Tèng teng-á--ê chiong ngó͘-siōng chhāi hō͘ ún-kò͘.
M̄-kú, lí Í-sek-lia̍t — góa ê po̍k-jîn, góa só͘ soán-li̍p ê Ngá-kok ah, lí sī góa ê pêng-iú A-pek-la-hán ê hō͘-tāi;
lí sī góa tùi tōe ê ke̍k-thâu chhōa--lâi-ê, tùi siōng hn̄g ê kak-lo̍h tiàu--lâi-ê. Góa ū tùi lí kóng “Lí sī góa ê po̍k-jîn”; góa ū kéng-soán lí, bōe khì-sak lí.
M̄-bián kiaⁿ, góa put-sî kap lí tông-chāi; m̄-bián kiaⁿ, góa sī lí ê Siōng-tè. Góa beh hō͘ lí kian-kiông, beh pang-chān lí; góa beh ēng sèng-lī ê chiàⁿ-chhiú pó-hō͘ lí.
Khòaⁿ leh, só͘-ū tùi lí hoat tōa siū-khì ê lâng ōe làu-khùi, kiàn-siàu; kap lí saⁿ-chiⁿ ê lâng lóng ōe bô--khì, bia̍t-bông.
Tùi-khòng lí--ê, lí beh chhē in mā chhē bô; thiau-chiàn lí--ê, in lóng ōe siau-bia̍t.
In-ūi góa Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè hû-chhî lí ê chiàⁿ-chhiú; “M̄-bián kiaⁿ, góa beh pang-chān lí.” Kóng chit-kù ōe--ê sī góa!
Lí chit-ê ná thâng ê Í-sek-lia̍t ah, m̄-bián kiaⁿ! Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh pang-chān lí. Lí ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú sī Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè.”
Lí khòaⁿ, góa beh hō͘ lí chòe siak ngó͘-kok ê khì-khū, sī sin koh lāi, ū khí ê khì-khū. Lí beh kā tōa-soaⁿ thún kah chhùi-chhùi, hō͘ sió-soaⁿ pìⁿ-chòe ná chho͘-khng.
Lí beh kā in pòa, hō͘ hong chhe-sòaⁿ, kông-hong kā in sàu-cháu. Chóng-sī lín ōe in-ūi Siōng Chú lâi hoaⁿ-hí, ōe ēng Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè chòe khoa-iāu.

Sàn-chhiah khùn-khó͘ ê lâng chhē chúi, chhē lóng bô; in ê nâ-âu ta, chhùi-chi̍h khoah; hit-sî góa Siōng Chú ōe thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó, góa Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè choa̍t-tùi bōe pàng-sak in.
Góa beh tī chhàu-ta ê soaⁿ-téng khui kang-hô, hō͘ soaⁿ-kok chhèng-chhut chúi-chôaⁿ; góa beh hō͘ soa-bô͘ pìⁿ-chòe chúi-tî, hō͘ ta-sò ê tōe pìⁿ-chòe chôaⁿ-goân.

Góa beh tī khòng-iá chèng pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū, kim-ha̍p-hoan-chhiū, tiông-chheng-chhiū, kaⁿ-ná-chhiū; góa mā beh tī hong-po͘ chai-chèng siông-chhiū, sam-chhiū, n̂g-iông-chhiū, hō͘ i pìⁿ-chòe chhiū-nâ.
Án-ni, jîn-bîn khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiū ōe bêng-pe̍k, che sī góa Siōng Chú ê chok-ûi; in ōe thé-hōe, ōe liáu-kái, che sī góa Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè chhòng-chō--ê.
Siōng Chú tùi ngó͘-siōng kóng, “Thê-chhut lín ê sin-sò͘!” Í-sek-lia̍t ê Kun-ông kóng, “Pâi-lia̍t lín iú-le̍k ê chèng-kù!”
Tio̍h tùi goán kóng teh-beh hoat-seng ê sū, kā goán soat-bêng í-chêng hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, hō͘ goán thang chim-chiok siūⁿ, ū-chhek teh-beh lâi ê sū, chai tāi-chì ê kiat-kio̍k.
Tio̍h hō͘ goán chai chiong-lâi beh hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, goán chiah thang chai lín sī sîn-bêng. Tio̍h sù hok-khì á-sī kàng chai-hō, thang hō͘ goán kiaⁿ-ùi, khióng-hông.
Lín kap lín chòe ê it-chhè lóng bô sǹg sím-mi̍h; soán-te̍k lín--ê si̍t-chāi thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ!

Góa í-keng tùi pak-hng heng-khí chi̍t ê lâng; i tùi tang-pêng lâi, beh kiû-kiò góa ê miâ. I thún-ta̍h chiáng-koân-chiá chhin-chhiūⁿ teh ta̍h thô͘-bê, chhin-chhiūⁿ sio-hûi sai-hū teh ta̍h liâm-thô͘.

Siáⁿ-lâng tī khí-thâu chiū soan-pò͘ chit-ê tāi-chì hō͘ goán chai, tī khí-thâu chiū kóng-bêng, hō͘ goán thang kóng “I bô m̄-tio̍h”? Kî-si̍t, bô lâng soan-pò͘, bô lâng soat-bêng, mā bô lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê ōe.
Góa tāi-seng tùi Sek-an soan-pò͘; góa phài chi̍t ê pò hó siau-sit ê sù-chiá khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Góa tī chèng sîn-bêng tiong-kan chhē, chhē bô chi̍t ê tō-su ōe-tàng ìn-tap góa ê būn-tôe.
Só͘-ū ê sîn-bêng lóng bô lō͘-ēng; in ê só͘-chòe sī khang-khang; in ê siōng put-kò sī hong.
Siōng Chú kóng: “Khòaⁿ leh, góa só͘ hû-chhî ê po̍k-jîn, i sī góa só͘ kéng-soán, sim só͘ ì-ài--ê! Góa ū chiong góa ê sîn sù hō͘ i; i ōe tī bān-pang si-hêng kong-gī.
I bōe chhut-siaⁿ hoah, bōe tōa-siaⁿ jióng; i bōe tī koe-thâu-hāng-bé hoah hō͘ lâng thiaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Siū-siong ê lô͘-úi, i bōe at-tn̄g; beh hoa ê teng-hé, i bōe pûn-sit. I ōe khak-si̍t si-hêng kong-gī.
I bōe hoe-sim, mā bōe sit-chì, it-ti̍t kàu kong-gī tī tōe-chiūⁿ khak-li̍p. Chèng hái-tó lóng gióng-bōng i ê kàu-tō.”

Siōng-tè chhòng-chō thiⁿ, kā thiⁿ thí-khui; I chō tōe kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê bān-mi̍h, chiong khùi sù hō͘ sè-kan-lâng, sù sìⁿ-miā hō͘ tī tōe-chiūⁿ teh seng-oa̍h ê lâng. Chit-ūi Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng,
“Góa Siōng Chú tiàu lí lâi si̍t-chián kong-gī; góa ū khan lí ê chhiú pó-siú lí. Thong-kè lí, góa kap bān-bîn tēng khè-iok, beh hō͘ lí chòe bān-kok ê kng.
Lí beh khui sit-bêng ê lâng ê ba̍k-chiu, hō͘ siū-koaiⁿ--ê chhut kaⁿ-ga̍k, hō͘ chē tī o͘-àm tōe-lô tiong--ê tit chū-iû.
Góa sī Siōng Chú, che sī góa ê chheng-ho͘. Góa bōe chiong góa ê êng-iāu niū hō͘ pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, bōe chiong góa ê chheng-chàn kui hō͘ ngó͘-siōng.
Khòaⁿ leh, chá-chêng ê sū í-keng si̍t-hiān; hiān-chāi góa tùi lín soan-pò͘ sin ê sū, tī iáu-bē hoat-seng í-chêng seng kóng hō͘ lín thiaⁿ.”
Hái kap hái-tiong it-chhè ê seng-bu̍t, hái-tó kap tó-lāi ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h tùi Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ sin ê koa, tùi thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak chheng-chàn I.
Hong-iá kap lāi-bīn ê siâⁿ-tìn, tio̍h chhut tōa-siaⁿ; Ki-ta̍t -lâng ê chng-siā, tio̍h hoan-ho͘. Se-la ê chū-bîn, tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa, tùi soaⁿ-téng tōa-siaⁿ hoah.
In tio̍h chiong êng-kng kui hō͘ Siōng Chú, tī chèng hái-tó soan-iông chheng-chàn I.
Siōng Chú ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chiàn-sū chhut-cheng, chhin-chhiūⁿ ióng-sū kek-hoat tò͘-chì. I ōe chhut-siaⁿ hoah, tōa-siaⁿ kiò, ióng-béng kong-kek I ê tùi-te̍k.
Siōng-tè kóng, “Góa í-keng lún chin kú, it-ti̍t tiām-tiām bô chhut-siaⁿ. Taⁿ góa beh chhái-chhú hêng-tōng, chhin-chhiūⁿ sán-hū ai-ai-kiò, ti̍t-ti̍t chhoán, chhoán bōe lī.
Góa beh hō͘ tōa-soaⁿ sió-soaⁿ lóng hong-hòe, hō͘ só͘-ū ê hoe-chháu ta-liáu-liáu. Góa beh hō͘ kang-hô pìⁿ-chòe ta-tōe, hō͘ ô͘-chúi lóng ta--khì.

Góa beh chhōa sit-bêng ê lâng kiâⁿ-lō͘, kiâⁿ in m̄-bat kiâⁿ--kè ê lō͘. Góa beh hō͘ o͘-àm tī in bīn-chêng pìⁿ-chòe kng-bêng, hō͘ oan-khiau ê lō͘ pìⁿ-chòe ti̍t-ti̍t. Chiah-ê sū góa lóng beh chòe, choa̍t-tùi bōe hòng-khì.
Óa-khò tiau-khek ê ngó͘-siōng--ê, tùi chù-chō ê siōng kóng ‘Lín sī goán ê sîn’ ê lâng, chit-khoán lâng it-tēng sit-pāi siū tōa thí-jio̍k.”
Lín chiah-ê chhàu-hī--ê, tio̍h thiaⁿ! Lín chiah-ê chhiⁿ-mî--ê, tio̍h khòaⁿ!
Siáⁿ-lâng pí góa ê po̍k-jîn koh-khah chhiⁿ-mî? Siáⁿ-lâng pí góa chhe ê sù-chiá koh-khah chhàu-hī?
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí khòaⁿ chin chōe, m̄-kú bōe bêng-pe̍k; lí hī-á phah chin khui, m̄-kú bōe léng-ngō͘.
Siōng Chú ì-ài péng-kong-hêng-gī, chiong ka-kī ê kàu-tō hoat-iông-kong-tāi.

M̄-kú chiah-ê siū chhiúⁿ-kiap pak-toa̍t ê chú-bîn, lóng koaiⁿ tī tōe-hia̍t, kìm tī kaⁿ-ga̍k. In hō͘ lâng chòe la̍h-bu̍t kng-cháu, bô lâng kái-kiù; in hō͘ lâng kiap--khì, bô lâng iau-kiû pàng in.
Lín tiong-kan ū siáⁿ-lâng ōe koan-sim chit-ê tāi-chì? Tùi hiān-chāi khí ū siáⁿ-lâng ōe chù-ì chit-hāng sū?

Siáⁿ-lâng chiong Ngá-kok kau hō͘ lâng chòe la̍h-bu̍t, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t chhut-chāi lâng chhiúⁿ-kiap? Sī in só͘ tek-chōe hit-ūi Siōng Chú pún-sin! In m̄-khéng kiâⁿ I ê tō-lō͘, m̄-khéng chun-siú I ê lu̍t-hoat.

Só͘-í, I chiong béng-lia̍t ê siū-khì, chiàn-cheng ê pō-le̍k lóng piàⁿ tī Í-sek-lia̍t sin-chiūⁿ. In hō͘ lia̍t-hé pau-ûi, m̄-kú lóng bô-iàu-bô-kín, hō͘ hé sio--tio̍h, mā iáu phî-phî.

Ngá-kok ah, chhòng-chō lí ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng; Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lia̍p-chō lí--ê Hit-ūi án-ni soan-pò͘: M̄-bián kiaⁿ, in-ūi góa í-keng ū kiù-sio̍k lí; góa ū kiò lí ê miâ ho͘-tiàu lí, lí sio̍k góa.

Lí keng-kè tōa-chúi ê sî, góa beh kap lí tông-chāi; lí kè tōa-hô ê sî, chúi bōe kā lí im-bia̍t. Lí tùi hé tiong keng-kè, it-tēng bōe siong--tio̍h; hé-iām mā bōe kā lí thun-bia̍t.

In-ūi góa sī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè; góa sī Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè — lí ê Kiù-chú. Góa ēng Ai-ki̍p chòe tāi-kè kā lí sio̍k-hôe, ēng I-soh-phit-a kap Se-pa chòe lí ê thòe-sin.
In-ūi lí tī góa gán-tiong chin pó-kùi, góa khòaⁿ-tāng lí, chin thiàⁿ lí; só͘-í góa ēng pa̍t-lâng lâi tāi-thòe lí, ēng bān-kok lâi kau-ōaⁿ lí ê sìⁿ-miā.
M̄-bián kiaⁿ, góa kap lí tông-chāi; góa beh tùi tang-hng chhōa lí ê hō͘-tāi, tùi se-hng chū-chi̍p lí ê kiáⁿ-sun tò-tńg--lâi.
Góa beh tùi pak-hng kóng: Pàng in khì! Kā lâm-hng kóng: M̄-thang khàu-liû in! Hō͘ góa ê kiáⁿ-jî tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi, góa ê jî-lú tùi thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak tò-tńg--lâi.
Só͘-ū kui góa ê miâ, sio̍k góa ê lâng, chiū-sī góa só͘ chhòng-chō sok-chō, ūi-tio̍h góa ê êng-kng chō ê lâng, lóng ōe tò-tńg--lâi.
Siōng-tè kóng: Ū ba̍k-chiu m̄-kú bōe-tàng khòaⁿ--ê, ū hī-khang bōe-tàng thiaⁿ--ê, lóng kā in chhōa--chhut-lâi.

Tio̍h tiàu-chi̍p bān-kok chū-chi̍p chòe-hé, só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn lóng chū-chi̍p chòe-tui. Só͘ hoat-seng ê sū, tó chi̍t ê sîn-bêng bat seng soan-kò? Kè-khì ê tāi-chì, tó chi̍t ê bat ūi lán ū-chhek? Tio̍h hō͘ in thê-chhut chèng-jîn chèng-si̍t in kóng--ê sī tio̍h, hō͘ jîn-bîn thiaⁿ--tio̍h ōe kóng: Che sī sū-si̍t.

Siōng Chú kóng: Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lín sī góa ê kiàn-chèng-jîn; góa ū kéng-soán lín chòe góa ê po̍k-jîn. Góa beh hō͘ lín bat góa, hō͘ lín sìn góa, thang liáu-kái góa sī Siōng-tè. Tī góa í-chêng m̄-bat ū Siōng-tè, tī góa í-āu mā bōe ū.
Chí-ū góa sī Siōng Chú; góa í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê Chín-kiù-chiá.
Góa bat soan-kò, bat chín-kiù, bat kóng-bêng; sī góa, m̄-sī lín tiong-kan ê pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng. Lín sī góa ê kiàn-chèng-jîn. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Góa sī Siōng-tè, tùi khí-thâu góa chiū-sī Siōng-tè; bô lâng ōe-tàng thoat-lī góa chiáng-ak ê koân. Góa ê chok-ûi, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kái-piàn?

Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè, Siōng Chú — lín ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú án-ni kóng: In-ūi lín ê iân-kò͘, góa í-keng chhe lâng khì Pa-pí-lûn; góa beh kòng-chhùi in só͘-ū siâⁿ-mn̂g ê mn̂g-chhòaⁿ, beh hō͘ Ka-le̍k-tí -lâng ê hoan-ho͘ pìⁿ-chòe ai-ko.
Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè; góa sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê Chhòng-chō-chú — lín ê Kun-ông.
Kó͘-chá, Siōng Chú tī hái-tiong chō chi̍t tiâu lō͘, tī tōa-chúi tiong khui chi̍t tiâu tōa-lō͘.
I châu-bia̍t chiàn-chhia, bé, kun-tūi, ióng-sū, hō͘ in lóng phak--lo̍h-khì, bōe-tàng koh khí--lâi. In siū siau-bia̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ teng-hé choân-pō͘ hoa--khì.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: M̄-thang chí-ū ōe-kì-tit kè-khì ê sū-kiāⁿ; m̄-thang it-ti̍t siàu-liām kó͘-chá ê tāi-chì.
Góa teh-beh chòe chi̍t hāng sin ê sū, chit-chūn í-keng teh hoat-seng, lín kiám m̄ chai? Góa beh tī khòng-iá khui tō-lō͘, tī soa-bô͘ khui kang-hô.
Iá-siù lóng ōe chun-tiōng góa; liân chhâi-lông kap tô-chiáu to chun-kèng góa. In-ūi góa hō͘ khòng-iá ū chúi, tī ta-sò ê soa-bô͘ ū hô, hō͘ góa ê soán-bîn thang lim.
Chit-ê chú-bîn sī góa chhin-chhiú chō--ê; in ōe chheng-chàn soan-iông góa!
Siōng Chú kóng: Ngá-kok ah, lí bô kiû-kiò góa; Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí tian-tò it-ti̍t thó-ià góa.

Lí pèng bô chiong lí ê iûⁿ chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ góa, mā bô hiàn chè-mi̍h tùi góa piáu kèng-ì. Góa m̄-bat iau-kiû lí hiàn sò͘-chè hō͘ lí chhau-lô, mā m̄-bat iau-kiû lí hiàn jú-hiuⁿ hō͘ lí chhau-hoân.

Lí m̄-bat ēng chîⁿ bóe phang-liāu hō͘ góa, mā m̄-bat ēng chi̍t chiah pûi-nńg ê cheng-siⁿ hō͘ góa pá-chiok. Lí tian-tò in-ūi lí ê chōe-ok hō͘ góa chhau-hoân, in-ūi lí hoān ê chōe-kò hō͘ góa thó-ià.
Chí-ū góa sī Siōng-tè, góa chiong lí ê chōe-kò chhat-siau; góa bōe éng-kiú kì-tiâu lí ê chōe.
Lâi! Lán lâi-khì chiūⁿ hoat-têng, lí thang khòng-kò; lí thê-chhut sin-sò͘, chèng-si̍t lí kong-chèng.
Lí tē-it ê chó͘-sian hoān-chōe, lí ê tāi-giân-jîn pōe-poān góa,
lí ê siú-léng phah lâ-sâm góa ê sèng-só͘. Só͘-í, góa hō͘ Ngá-kok húi-bia̍t, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t siū lêng-jio̍k.
Siōng Chú kóng: Ngá-kok — góa ê po̍k-jîn, taⁿ tio̍h thiaⁿ; góa só͘ kéng-soán ê Í-sek-lia̍t, thiaⁿ leh!
Lia̍p-chō lí, tùi bú-thai chiū sok-chō lí, beh pang-chān lí hit-ūi Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa ê po̍k-jîn Í-sek-lia̍t, m̄-bián kiaⁿ! Lí sī góa só͘ thiàⁿ, só͘ kéng-soán--ê.

Góa beh piàⁿ-lo̍h chúi hō͘ chhùi-ta ê tōe; góa beh hō͘ ta-sò ê tōe ū khoe-chúi teh lâu. Góa beh chiong góa ê sîn piàⁿ hō͘ lí ê hō͘-tāi, beh sù hok-khì hō͘ lí ê kiáⁿ-sun.
In ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu tī chúi chhiong-chiok ê só͘-chāi tōa-châng, chhin-chhiūⁿ liú-chhiū tī chúi ti̍t-ti̍t-lâu ê khoe-piⁿ seng-tióng.
Ū lâng ōe kóng “Góa sio̍k Siōng Chú”; lēng-gōa chi̍t ê kā ka-kī hō-miâ kiò Ngá-kok; koh chi̍t ê tī chhiú ê téng-bīn siá “Siōng Chú ê”, chū-chheng chòe Í-sek-lia̍t.
Siōng Chú — thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng: Góa sī khai-sí, góa sī kiat-sok; góa í-gōa bô Siōng-tè.
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kap góa pí? Tio̍h chhut-lâi kóng! Góa bat tùi kó͘-chá ê chú-bîn ū-kò beh hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, i mā thang án-ni soan-kò chiong-lâi ê sū.

Lín m̄-bián kiaⁿ, mā m̄-bián chhoah! Góa kiám bô chá chiū tùi lín soan-kò? Lín sī góa ê kiàn-chèng-jîn. Góa í-gōa kiám ū Siōng-tè, kiám ū hō͘ lín thang siám-bih ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ? Góa chai, liân chi̍t ê to bô.
Só͘-ū chè-chō ngó͘-siōng ê lâng lóng bô lō͘-ēng; in só͘ kah-ì--ê lóng bô lī-ek. Pài ngó͘-siōng ê lâng lóng chhiⁿ-mî, bû-ti; in lóng ōe sit-pāi kiàn-siàu.
Siáⁿ-lâng chè-chō sîn-bêng, chù-chō bô lō͘-ēng ê ngó͘-siōng?
Lí khòaⁿ, i ê tâng-phōaⁿ lóng ōe kiàn-siàu; sai-hū put-kò sī lâng. Hō͘ in lóng chū-chi̍p óa--lâi, chún-pī chiūⁿ hoat-têng; in ōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, lóng ōe kiàn-siàu.

Phah-thih sai-hū kā thih khǹg tī hé-thòaⁿ lāi pû hō͘ âng, ēng ióng ê chhiú-kut giâ kòng-thûi phah-chhut hêng-thé. I nā iau, chiū bô la̍t; chhùi-ta bô lim-chúi, chiū ià-siān.

Ba̍k-chhiūⁿ ēng chîn-sòaⁿ niû, ēng hún-pit ōe sòaⁿ, ēng kok-chióng khì-khū tiau-khek, ēng îⁿ-chhioh ōe bô͘, chiàu lâng ê khoán-sit chòe súi ê lâng-hêng chō ngó͘-siōng, kā i chhāi tī biō-lāi.
I chhò pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū; koh kéng chheng-tông-chhiū kap siōng-chhiū hō͘ in tī chhiū-nâ lāi sêng-tióng; i chai-chèng siông-chhiū, thèng-hāu hō͘-chúi lūn-te̍k hō͘ i tōa-châng.
Jiân-āu, chhiū chhò--khí-lâi chòe hé-chhâ; ū-ê the̍h-lâi hō͘ chhù-lāi khah sio-lō, ū-ê tiám-to̍h thang hang-piáⁿ chí-ki. Koh chi̍t-kóa chòe sîn-siōng kā kūi kā pài.
Chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê chhâ, i khí-hé hang-bah lâi chia̍h, chia̍h kah boán-chiok. I mā ka-kī ná hang ná kóng, “Chán! Góa khòaⁿ hé teh to̍h, kám-kak chin sio-lō.”
I ēng só͘ chhun ê chhâ chòe chi̍t ê sîn-bêng, chòe ngó͘-siōng, kūi lo̍h-khì kā pài, tùi i kî-tó kóng, “Lí sī góa ê sîn-bêng, kiù góa!”
Chit-khoán lâng m̄ bat koh bōe lí-kái, in-ūi Siōng Chú kā in ê ba̍k-chiu kô͘--teh, hō͘ in khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h, sim-tì that--teh, bōe-hiáu siūⁿ.

In lóng bô teh siūⁿ, bô tì-sek bô chhong-bêng thang kóng, “Chi̍t-pòaⁿ ê chhâ, góa ēng chòe hé-thòaⁿ hang-piáⁿ, mā hang-bah lâi chia̍h. Só͘ chhun ê chhâ góa kiám thang ēng lâi chō chi̍t ê ngó͘-siōng? Góa kiám thang kūi lo̍h-khì pài chi̍t tè chhâ-thâu?”
In ēng hé-hu chún pn̄g chia̍h, gōng kah hō͘ lâng koái--khì, bô hoat-tō͘ kiù ka-kī. In m̄ sêng-jīn chhiú--ni̍h phóng ê ngó͘-siōng kun-pún m̄-sī sîn-bêng.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Ngá-kok ah, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit chiah-ê tāi-chì; Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí sī góa ê po̍k-jîn. Góa sok-chō lí, lí sī góa ê po̍k-jîn; Í-sek-lia̍t ah, góa it-tēng bōe kā lí bōe-kì--tit.

Góa í-keng kā lí ê chōe-kò sàu-tû, chhin-chhiūⁿ kā ba̍t-hûn chhe-sòaⁿ; chhat-siau lí ê chōe-ok, chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ po̍h-bū siau-sòaⁿ. Tio̍h kui-ǹg góa, in-ūi góa ū kiù-sio̍k lí.

Chiah-ê thiⁿ ah, tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa, in-ūi Siōng Chú ū chòe chit-hāng tāi-chì! Tōe ê chhim-khiⁿ ah, tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ hoah! Tōa-soaⁿ sió-soaⁿ ah, tio̍h chhut-siaⁿ chhiùⁿ-koa! Chhiū-nâ kap lāi-bīn só͘-ū ê chhiū ah, tio̍h chhiùⁿ! In-ūi Siōng Chú ū kiù-sio̍k Ngá-kok, I beh thong-kè Í-sek-lia̍t hián-sī I ê êng-iāu!

Hō͘ lí tī bú-thai chiâⁿ-hêng, kiù-sio̍k lí ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘: Góa sī Siōng Chú, sī bān-mi̍h ê Chhòng-chō-chú. Góa thí-khui thiⁿ ê sî, tan-to̍k chi̍t ê; góa pho͘ tōe ê sî, chí-ū góa ka-kī chi̍t ê.
Góa hō͘ ké sian-ti ê tiāu-thâu hūn-loān, hō͘ pok-kòa ê lâng ū-chhek sit-hāu. Góa hō͘ ū tì-hūi ê lâng kiàn-siàu thè-āu, ū tì-sek ê lâng pìⁿ gû-gōng.

Góa hō͘ góa po̍k-jîn ê ōe tit-tio̍h chèng-si̍t, hō͘ góa sù-chiá ê kè-ōe si̍t-hiān. Koan-hē Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, góa kóng: Beh ū lâng tī hia khiā-khí; koan-hē Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-chhī, góa kóng: Góa beh kā in khí-chō; í-keng pìⁿ hong-po͘ ê só͘-chāi, góa kā in tiông-kiàn.
Góa tùi chhim-ian kóng: Tio̍h ta--khì! Góa beh hō͘ lí ê hô-liû lóng ta-ta--khì.
Góa tùi Sài-ló͘-sū kóng: Lí tio̍h thòe góa bo̍k-ióng; lí tio̍h oân-sêng góa ê chí-ì. I ōe hā-lēng tiông-kiàn Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, têng-sin hē sèng-tiān ê tōe-ki.

Siōng Chú soán-li̍p Sài-ló͘-sū choh-ông. Siōng Chú hû-chhî i, hō͘ i ū khùi-la̍t cheng-ho̍k lia̍t-pang, pak-toa̍t lia̍t-ông ê koân-sè; siâⁿ-mn̂g lóng ōe tī i ê bīn-chêng phah-khui, bōe koh koaiⁿ--khí-lâi. Siōng Chú tùi Sài-ló͘-sū án-ni kóng:
Góa Siōng Chú beh chhin-sin thòe lí khui-lō͘, beh siah-pîⁿ tōa-soaⁿ sió-soaⁿ. Góa beh kòng-phòa tâng ê siâⁿ-mn̂g, beh kù-tn̄g thih ê mn̂g-chhòaⁿ.

Góa beh chiong àm-tiong ê pó-pòe, ún-chông ê châi-hù lóng hō͘ lí; án-ni, lí chiū ōe chai góa sī Siōng Chú, góa kiò lí ê miâ ho͘-tiàu lí. Góa sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.
Sui-jiân lí m̄ bat góa, ūi-tio̍h góa ê po̍k-jîn Ngá-kok, ūi-tio̍h góa kéng-soán ê Í-sek-lia̍t, góa iáu kiò lí ê miâ ho͘-tiàu lí, sù lí miâ-hō.
Góa sī Siōng Chú, kî-tha bô pa̍t-ê; góa í-gōa, bô pa̍t-ê Siōng-tè. Sui-jiân lí iáu m̄ bat góa, góa beh hō͘ lí khùi-la̍t,
án-ni, tùi ji̍t chhut kàu ji̍t lo̍h ê só͘-chāi, lâng-lâng lóng ōe chai, góa í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê; góa sī Siōng Chú, í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê.
Góa chhòng-chō kng, koh chō àm; góa sù pêng-an hoân-êng, mā kàng chai-lān. Góa Siōng Chú beh si̍t-hiān che it-chhè ê tāi-chì.

Thiⁿ ah, tio̍h kàng-lo̍h sèng-lī, chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘-chúi tùi téng-bīn piàⁿ-lo̍h. Tōe ah, tio̍h phah-khui, hō͘ chín-kiù khui-hoe, hō͘ sèng-lī kiat-chí. Góa Siōng Chú beh sêng-chiū chit-ê sū!

Kap Chō-bu̍t-chú cheng-lūn ê lâng chhám ah! I put-kò sī tōe-chiūⁿ hiā-phìⁿ tiong ê chi̍t phìⁿ. Liâm-thô͘ kiám káⁿ tùi sio-hûi sai-hū kóng, “Lí teh chhòng siáⁿ? Lí ê kang-hu bô hó!”
Káⁿ kā lāu-pē kóng “Lí ná kā góa siⁿ-chòe án-ni”, káⁿ kā lāu-bú kóng “Hô-mi̍h-khó͘ siⁿ góa”, chit-khoán lâng chhám ah!

Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè — chhòng-chō Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lín bô koân thang chit-būn góa ê kiáⁿ-jî ê chiong-lâi, bô koân chí-sī góa eng-kai tio̍h chòe sím-mi̍h!
Góa sī tāi-tōe ê Chhòng-chō-chú, koh chhòng-chō tòa tī hit téng-bīn ê jîn-lūi. Góa chhin-chhiú thí-khui kiong-chhong, chí-hui thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ-sîn.

Góa heng-khí Sài-ló͘-sū hō͘ i tit-tio̍h sèng-lī, siu-ti̍t i só͘ beh kiâⁿ ê tō-lō͘. I beh tiông-kiàn góa ê siâⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, beh tháu-pàng góa siū-lia̍h ê chú-bîn; i án-ni chòe m̄-sī beh thàn kang-chîⁿ, mā m̄-sī in-ūi hō͘ lâng bóe-siu. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t án-ni kóng: Ai-ki̍p kap I-soh-phit-a ê châi-hù lóng ōe pìⁿ-chòe lí ê; tōa koh lò ê Se-pa -lâng lóng pìⁿ-chòe lí ê lô͘-lē, in ōe hō͘ só-liān liān--teh, tè lí ê ka-chiah-āu kiâⁿ. In ōe kūi lo̍h-khì pài lí, kiong-kèng tùi lí kóng: Siōng-tè khak-si̍t kap lín tông-chāi, chí-ū I sī Siōng-tè, í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê.
Kiù-sio̍k-chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, lí chin-chiàⁿ sī ún-ba̍t ka-kī ê Siōng-tè.
Chè-chō ngó͘-siōng--ê lóng ōe kiàn-siàu làu-khùi; in lóng ōe chòe-hé siū thí-jio̍k.
M̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t siū Siōng Chú chín-kiù. Lín tit--tio̍h ê kiù-un ōe sòa kàu éng-oán; lín éng-oán bōe koh siū bú-jio̍k.

Siōng Chú chhòng-chō thiⁿ; I chiū-sī hit-ūi î-it ê Siōng-tè. I chhòng-chō, hêng-sêng, kiàn-li̍p tāi-tōe. I bô hō͘ tāi-tōe pìⁿ-chòe hūn-tūn hong-hòe, hoán-tńg hō͘ i chiâⁿ-chòe lâng khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi. I kóng: Góa sī Siōng Chú, í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê.

Góa m̄-bat tī ún-ba̍t ê só͘-chāi kóng-ōe, mā m̄-bat tī o͘-àm ê tōe tâm-lūn. Góa m̄-bat kā Í-sek-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi kóng: Lín tio̍h tī hūn-tūn tiong chhē-kiû góa. Góa Siōng Chú chí-ū kóng kong-gī, chí-ū soan-kò chèng-ti̍t.

Siōng Chú kóng: Lâi, lín chiah-ê tùi lia̍t-pang tô-thoat ê lâng, lóng chū-chi̍p óa--lâi, chiap-siū sím-phòaⁿ! Hiah-ê kng chhâ khek ê ngó͘-siōng iû-koe, koh tùi bô-la̍t thang kiù in ê sîn-bêng kî-tó ê lâng sī bû-ti.

Lâi, lín khì pí-chhú chham-siông, thê-chhut lín ê sò͘-chn̄g. Siáⁿ-lâng tùi kó͘-chá chiū chai chit-ê tāi-chì? Siáⁿ-lâng chin chá í-chêng chiū soan-kò chit-ê sū? Kiám m̄-sī góa Siōng Chú? Góa í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê Siōng-tè. Góa chiah sī kong-gī ê Siōng-tè, góa í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê ōe chín-kiù lâng!
Thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak ê lâng ah, tio̍h kui-ǹg góa thang tit-tio̍h kiù! Góa chiū-sī Siōng-tè, kî-tha bô pa̍t-ê.
Góa kí ka-kī li̍p-sè; góa pîn kong-gī kóng-chhut ê ōe choa̍t-tùi bōe siu-hôe: Múi chi̍t ê kha-thâu-u lóng ōe tùi góa kūi-pài; múi chi̍t ê chhùi lóng ōe tùi góa soan-sè.
Lâng ōe kóng: Chí-ū thong-kè Siōng Chú chiah ōe tit-tio̍h sèng-lī kap khùi-la̍t; só͘-ū tùi I hoat siū-khì ê lâng lóng ōe siū thí-jio̍k.
Só͘ ū Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ-sun lóng ōe tùi Siōng Chú tit-tio̍h sèng-lī kap êng-iāu.

Pí-le̍k kūi--lo̍h-khì lah, Nî-pho phak--lo̍h-khì lah! Chiah-ê Pa-pí-lûn ê sîn-bêng hē tī cháu-siù kap cheng-siⁿ ê ka-chiah-phiaⁿ. Lín teh kng ê ngó͘-siōng chiâⁿ-chòe ià-siān ê cheng-siⁿ ê tāng-tàⁿ.
In í-keng lóng kūi--lo̍h-khì, phak--lo̍h-khì, bô hoat-tō͘ kiù ka-kī, tian-tò hō͘ te̍k-jîn chhiúⁿ-khì chòe chiàn-lī-phín.
Ngá-kok lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê kiáⁿ-sun, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, lín lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ! Lín chi̍t-ē chhut-sì góa chiū it-ti̍t kā lín phō, tùi chhut bú-thai chiū kā lín āiⁿ.

Kàu lín nî-lāu, góa lóng siâng-khoán; kàu lín thâu-mn̂g pe̍h, góa iáu ōe kā lín hû-chhî. Góa chhòng-chō lín, ōe kā lín phō; góa ōe kè-sio̍k kā lín āiⁿ, kā lín kái-kiù.
Siōng Chú kóng: Lín beh ēng siáⁿ-lâng kap góa pí, kap góa phēng? Siáⁿ-lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ góa, ōe-tàng kap góa siâng-khoán?
Lâng tùi tē-á piàⁿ kui-tui kim-á chhut--lâi, ēng chhìn-á chhìn gûn. In chhiàⁿ sai-hū ēng chiah-ê kim-gûn chù-chō sîn-siōng, jiân-āu phak lo̍h-khì kūi-pài.

In chiong ngó͘-siōng giâ--khí-lâi, khǹg tī keng-thâu-téng kng, kā i chhāi tī chi̍t ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ i bōe-tàng lī-khui pún-ūi. Lâng kā i kiû-kiò, i lóng bōe ìn-tap; i mā bô hoat-tō͘ kiù lâng thoat-lī chai-lān.
Ū-chōe ê lâng ah, tio̍h kì hō͘ tiâu; pōe-poān ê lâng ah, tio̍h hó-hó siūⁿ.
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit kó͘-chá hoat-seng ê tāi-chì. Góa sī Siōng-tè, kî-tha bô pa̍t-ê; góa sī Siōng-tè, bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kap góa pí.

Tùi khí-chho͘ góa chiū ū-chhek chiong-kio̍k ê sū; tùi kó͘-chá góa chiū soan-kò iáu-bē hoat-seng ê tāi-chì. Góa kóng: Góa ê kè-ōe bōe kái-piàn; góa ài chòe ê sū, it-tēng ōe hō͘ i si̍t-hiān.

Góa beh chhe chi̍t ê sù-chiá tùi tang-hng chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi; i beh chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu chhiong--lo̍h-lâi. Góa í-keng kóng chhut-chhùi, it-tēng beh si̍t-hiān; góa í-keng kè-ōe, it-tēng beh oân-sêng.
Lín chiah-ê sim ngī, siūⁿ-kóng sèng-lī bô-bāng ê lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa kóng.
Góa beh hō͘ sèng-lī pek-kūn, liâm-piⁿ kàu; góa ê chín-kiù bōe iân-tî. Góa beh kái-kiù Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t tit-tio̍h êng-kng.
Chāi-sek-lú Pa-pí-lûn ah, lo̍h-lâi chē tiàm thô͘-hún! Siàu-lú Ka-le̍k-tí ah, tùi pó-chō lo̍h--lâi, chē tiàm thô͘-kha! Bô lâng ōe koh kóng lí un-jiû á-sī iù-siù.
Khì oe chio̍h-bō, bôa mī-hún! Bīn-phè the̍h-tiāu! Kûn cháng--khí-lâi, lō͘-chhut tōa-thúi liâu-kè khoe!
Lâng ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé; lí ê kiàn-siàu ōe lō͘-hiān. Góa beh pò-ho̍k, chi̍t ê to bōe pàng i soah.
Goán ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú sī Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè; I ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe.
Siàu-lú Ka-le̍k-tí ah, ji̍p-khì o͘-àm ê só͘-chāi tiām-tiām-á chē; lí bōe koh-chài hō͘ lâng chheng-chòe “Lia̍t-kok ê lú-ông”.

Góa ū tùi góa ê chú-bîn hoat siū-khì, hō͘ ka-kī ê sán-gia̍p siū lêng-jio̍k, kā in kau tī lí ê chhiú-tiong. Lí bô tùi in si lîn-bín, sīm-chì ēng chin tāng ê taⁿ hō͘ lāu-lâng phāiⁿ.
Lí bat kóng “Góa beh éng-oán chòe lú-ông”, só͘-í bô kā chiah-ê tāi-chì khǹg tī sim-lāi, mā bô khó-lū tāi-chì ê kiat-kio̍k.

Taⁿ, lí chit-ê ài iàn-lo̍k, an-ún chē tī pó-chō téng ê lâng, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Lí ka-kī sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng: Chí-ū góa, góa í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê; góa choa̍t-tùi bōe pìⁿ-chòe kóaⁿ-hū, bōe keng-giām sòng-sit kiáⁿ-jî ê khó͘-thàng.

M̄-kú, tī chi̍t ji̍t lāi, chi̍t-ba̍k-nih-kú, chit nn̄g hāng tāi-chì lóng ōe hoat-seng tī lí sin-chiūⁿ, sí-kiáⁿ kap chiú-kóaⁿ chòe-chi̍t-ē kàu! Bô-lūn lí kiâⁿ jōa-chōe siâ-su̍t, liām jōa-chōe hû-chiù to bô-chhái-kang.

Lí chū-sìn chòe pháiⁿ bô tāi-chì, kóng: Bô lâng ōe khòaⁿ--tio̍h. Lí hō͘ ka-kī ê tì-hūi chhong-bêng chhōa-ji̍p phian-lō͘, ka-kī sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng: Góa kap Siōng-tè pîⁿ tōa, bô lâng ōe-tàng kap góa pí.

M̄-kú chai-hō ōe jip-tio̍h lí, lí m̄ chai tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chiah ōe-tàng kā i kóaⁿ-cháu. Chai-hāi ōe kàng-lo̍h tī lí sin-chiūⁿ, lí bô hoat-tō͘ kā i tû-tiāu. Tī lí m̄-chai ê sî, húi-bia̍t ōe hut-jiân lîm-kàu lí!

Khí--lâi, chòe lí khì liām lí ê hû-chiù, kiâⁿ khah chōe siâ-su̍t; lí tùi siàu-liân ê sî chiū phah-piàⁿ chòe chiah-ê sū. Án-ni, lí khó-lêng ōe sêng-kong, ōe hō͘ te̍k-jîn kiaⁿ kah beh sí.

Lí in-ūi lâng hō͘ lí ê kè-chhek siuⁿ chōe soah ià-siān; khì kiò hiah-ê koan thian-siōng--ê, khòaⁿ chhiⁿ-sîn--ê chhut-lâi kiù lí; in ōe tī chhoe-it-cha̍p-gō͘ ū-giân chiong-lâi ê sū.
Khòaⁿ leh, in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ be̍h-kó hō͘ hé sio-húi; in bōe-tàng kiù ka-kī thoat-lī hé-iām ê ui-le̍k, hit-khoán hé m̄-sī ōe-tàng chē tī piⁿ--á hang-sio ê ûn-ûn-á hé.

Tùi siàu-liân chiū kap lí kau-kiat, tàu-tīn phah-piàⁿ ê lâng, tòa-lâi hō͘ lí--ê, chòe-āu lóng sī án-ni. In lóng ōe tī ka-kī kéng ê lō͘ sit-bê, bô lâng ōe-tàng kiù lí.

Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Lín siū chheng chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, sī Iû-tāi ê kiáⁿ-sun. Lín kí Siōng Chú ê miâ chiù-chōa, kiû-kiò Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè, m̄-kú m̄-sī chhut tī sêng-sim-si̍t-ì.
Lín chū-khoa sī Sèng-siâⁿ ê jîn-bîn, só͘ óa-khò--ê sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè; I ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe.

Siōng Chú kóng: Góa chin kú í-chêng chiū soan-kò, chhin-chhùi kóng hō͘ lín chai chiong-lâi ōe hoat-seng ê sū. Tī lín bô phah-sǹg ê sî, góa hêng-tōng, tāi-chì chiū sêng-chiū.
In-ūi góa chai, lín ê sim ngī, ām-kún ná thih, thâu-hia̍h ná tâng,

só͘-í, góa tùi kó͘-chá chiū ū kā lín kóng, tī tāi-chì hoat-seng í-chêng chiū ū kā lín soan-kò, hō͘ lín bōe-tàng kóng: Chiah-ê sī goán ê ngó͘-siōng só͘ chòe, sī goán khek ê ngó͘-siōng, chō ê sîn-bêng chù-tiāⁿ--ê.

Góa só͘ ū-giân ê sū taⁿ í-keng lóng hoat-seng; chit-ê sū-si̍t lín kiám bô beh sêng-jīn? Tùi chit-chūn khí, góa beh hō͘ lín chai chiong-lâi sin ê sū, sī lín í-chêng m̄ chai, tùi lín ún-chông ê tāi-chì.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì hiān-chāi chiah hoat-seng, kè-khì lín lóng m̄-bat thiaⁿ--tio̍h, hō͘ lín bōe-tàng kóng: Goán láu-chá chiū chai.
Lín m̄-bat thiaⁿ--tio̍h, mā m̄ chai; lín ê hī-á lóng m̄-bat thiaⁿ--kè. Góa chai lín hui-siông khúi-chà, tùi chhut-sì, lâng chiū kiò lín chòe pōe-poān-chiá.
Góa ūi-tio̍h pó-chhî góa ê miâ ê êng-ū, jím-nāi, bô hoat siū-khì; góa it-ti̍t jím--teh, bô kā lín húi-bia̍t.
Góa ū kā lín thê-liān, put-kò bô chhin-chhiūⁿ teh thê-liān gûn, sī ēng thòng-khó͘ ê hé kā lín thoàn-liān.
Góa khak-si̍t sī ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê iân-kò͘; góa bô ài hō͘ góa ê êng-ū siū-jio̍k. Góa ê miâ ná thang siū siat-to̍k? Góa bô ài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng hun-hióng góa ê êng-iāu!
Ngá-kok ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ! Góa só͘ ho͘-tiàu ê Í-sek-lia̍t ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa kóng! Góa sī Siōng-tè, sī siōng tāi-seng--ê, mā-sī siōng lō͘-bé--ê.
Góa chhin-chhiú hē tāi-tōe ê tōe-ki; góa ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú thí-khui thiⁿ. Góa chi̍t-ē bēng-lēng, thiⁿ kap tōe chiū chòe-hé khiā--chhut-lâi.

Lín tāi-ke lóng tio̍h chū-chi̍p, chū-chi̍p óa-lâi thiaⁿ! Kiám ū sîn-bêng bat ū-chhek góa Siōng Chú só͘ soán-li̍p ê lâng ōe kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn, ōe chiàu góa ê chí-ì tùi-hù Ka-le̍k-tí -lâng?
Tùi i kóng-ōe, ho͘-tiàu i--ê sī góa; góa kā i chhōa--chhut-lâi, hō͘ i heng-ōng.

Taⁿ, kiâⁿ óa--lâi, thiaⁿ góa kóng: Tùi khí-thâu, góa it-ti̍t ū kong-khai kā lín kóng, tāi-chì hoat-seng hit-sî, góa chiū tī hia. Taⁿ, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú í-keng chhe-khián góa, sù góa I ê khùi-la̍t.

Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè — lín ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú án-ni kóng: Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè. Góa kà-sī lín sī ūi-tio̍h lín hó; góa chhōa lín kiâⁿ eng-kai kiâⁿ ê lō͘.
Góa jōa-á-ni̍h kî-thāi lín thiaⁿ góa ê bēng-lēng! Nā ū thiaⁿ, lín ê pêng-an chiū ná hô-liû, lín ê kong-gī ōe ná hái-éng;
lín ê hō͘-tāi ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-soa, lín ê kiáⁿ-sun chhin-chhiūⁿ soa hiah chōe. Góa bōe hō͘ in ê miâ siū chián-tn̄g bia̍t-choa̍t!

Tio̍h tùi Pa-pí-lûn chhut--lâi, thoat-lī Ka-le̍k-tí -lâng! Tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí chhut-siaⁿ, tōa-siaⁿ soan-pò͘! Chiong siau-sit thoân kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak, kóng: Siōng Chú í-keng kiù-sio̍k I ê po̍k-jîn Í-sek-lia̍t!
Siōng Chú chhōa in keng-kè khòng-iá, in lóng bô chhùi-ta. I hō͘ chúi tùi chio̍h-pôaⁿ chhèng--chhut-lâi; I hō͘ chio̍h-pôaⁿ piak-li̍h, hō͘ chúi ek--chhut-lâi.
Siōng Chú kóng: Siâ-ok ê lâng bô pêng-an!

Chèng hái-tó ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa kóng! Tòa tī chin hn̄g lia̍t-kok ê jîn-bîn ah, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Siōng Chú tī góa chhut-sì í-chêng chiū kéng-tiàu góa, góa iáu tī bú-thai chiū kā góa hō-miâ.
I hō͘ góa ê chhùi chhin-chhiūⁿ lāi-kiàm, ēng I ê chhiú pì-iū góa, pó-hō͘ góa. I hō͘ góa chhin-chhiūⁿ bôa kah kim-sih-sih ê chìⁿ, kā góa chhàng tī I ê chìⁿ-tē lāi-bīn.
I tùi góa kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí sī góa ê po̍k-jîn; góa beh thong-kè lí hián-sī góa ê êng-iāu.”

M̄-kú góa kóng, “Góa ê lô-khó͘ lóng sī khang-khang; góa ēng-chīn khùi-la̍t, lóng bô-chhái-kang.” Iáu-kú, Siōng Chú sī góa ê chhâi-koat-chiá; góa it-tēng ōe tùi Siōng-tè tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ.

Góa tī bú-thai Siōng Chú chiū chō góa, hō͘ góa chòe I ê po̍k-jîn, thang hō͘ Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi tò-tńg-lâi I hia, chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t liû-bông ê chú-bîn chū-chi̍p óa--lâi. Án-ni, góa tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ōe tit-tio̍h kong-êng; góa ê Siōng-tè mā chiâⁿ-chòe góa ê khùi-la̍t.

Hiān-chāi Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Góa beh hō͘ lí chòe góa ê po̍k-jîn, hō͘ Ngá-kok ta̍k chi-cho̍k koh ho̍k-heng, kā liû-bông ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhōa--tńg-lâi. Góa beh koh hō͘ lí chi̍t hāng tiōng-iàu ê jīm-bū, hō͘ lí chòe bān-kok ê kng, hō͘ góa ê chín-kiù phó͘-ki̍p thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak.”

Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú, Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “Lí chit-ê siū lâng biáu-sī, hō͘ bān-kok thòng-hūn, chòe thóng-tī-chiá ê lô͘-lē ê lâng, kun-ông khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ōe khiā--khí-lâi; léng-siù khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí mā ōe phak lo̍h-khì piáu kèng-ì. Chit-ê sū ōe si̍t-hiān, in-ūi Siōng Chú sìn-si̍t, in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè ū kéng-soán lí.”

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Tī góa hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p ê sî, góa ū èng-ún lí; tī chín-kiù ê ji̍t, góa ū pang-chān lí. Góa beh pó-hō͘ lí, koh thong-kè lí kap góa ê chú-bîn li̍p-iok. Góa beh hō͘ lí tī í-keng hong-hòe ê thó͘-tōe tiông-kiàn, koh tēng-ku.

Góa beh kā siū-lia̍h ê lâng kóng, ‘Lín chū-iû lah!’ Góa beh kā tī o͘-àm tiong ê lâng kóng, ‘Chhut-lâi kìⁿ kng!’ In ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ iân-lō͘ ū chháu thang chia̍h; hong-hòe ê só͘-chāi lóng pìⁿ-chòe bo̍k-tiûⁿ.
In bōe iau, mā bōe chhùi-ta; ji̍t-thâu kap sio-hong bōe siong-hāi in. Thiàⁿ-sioh in--ê ōe ín-chhōa in, chhōa in kàu chúi-chôaⁿ piⁿ.
“Góa beh tī só͘-ū ê soaⁿ-niá khui tōa-lō͘, kā tōa-lō͘ lóng thūn koân.
Khòaⁿ leh, góa ê chú-bîn tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi; ū-ê tùi pak-pêng, ū-ê tùi sai-pêng, mā ū chi̍t-kóa tùi Hi-nî tōe-hng lâi.”
Thiⁿ ah, tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa! Tōe ah, tio̍h hoan-ho͘! Tōa-soaⁿ sió-soaⁿ ah, tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ chhiùⁿ-koa! Siōng Chú beh an-ùi I ê chú-bîn; I beh lîn-bín I siū-khó͘ ê chú-bîn.
M̄-kú Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kóng, “Siōng Chú í-keng pàng-sak lán! Chú í-keng bōe-kì-tit lán lah!”
In-ūi án-ni, Siōng Chú hôe-tap, “Lāu-bú kiám ōe bōe-kì-tit chia̍h-lin ê eⁿ-á, á-sī bōe thiàⁿ-sioh i ê chhin-siⁿ-kiáⁿ? Lāu-bú nā ōe bōe-kì--tit, góa choa̍t-tùi bōe!
Lí khòaⁿ leh, góa ū chiong lí ê miâ khek tī chhiú-sim! Lí ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ put-sî tī góa ba̍k-chiu chêng, góa bô khó-lêng bōe-kì--tit!
“Kā lí tiông-kiàn ê lâng chin kín chiū lâi; kā lí thiah-húi--ê teh lī-khui lah.

Lí gia̍h-thâu sì-chiu-ûi khòaⁿ-bāi--leh, lí ê tông-pau lóng chū-chi̍p óa--lâi, teh-beh kàu-ūi lah. Góa kí góa ê sìⁿ-miā li̍p-sè: In ōe chiâⁿ-chòe lí pó-kùi ê chng-thāⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ sin-niû seng-khu kòa ê chu-pó. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Hit-ê húi-hoāi, pha-hng, hong-hòe ê kok-thó͘ taⁿ khak-si̍t siuⁿ sòe, bô-kàu hō͘ liû-bông hôe-kok ê tông-pau tòa; kā lí húi-bia̍t--ê ōe lī-khui lí chin hn̄g.
Lí ōe chhin-hī thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí liû-bông í-āu siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-jî kóng, ‘Chit-ê só͘-chāi siuⁿ oe̍h; tio̍h hō͘ goán khah khoah ê só͘-chāi thang tòa.’

Hit-sî, lí tī sim-lāi ōe kóng, ‘Siáⁿ-lâng kā góa siⁿ chiah-ê gín-á? Góa í-keng sòng-sit kiáⁿ mā bōe koh siⁿ lah. Góa liû-bông koh tò-chhù liû-lōng, sī siáⁿ-lâng kā góa ióng-io̍k chiah-ê gín-á? Góa ko͘-toaⁿ, ka-kī chi̍t ê; chiah-ê gín-á tùi tó-ūi lâi?’”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh tùi lia̍t-kok gia̍h-chhiú sī-ì, tùi bān-bîn hoat-chhut sìn-hō. In ōe phō lí ê ta-po͘-kiáⁿ tī heng-chêng, āiⁿ lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tī ka-chiah-āu tò-tńg--lâi.

Lia̍t-ông ōe chòe lí ê kiáⁿ-jî ê iúⁿ-pē, in ê ông-hō͘ ōe chòe lí ê jî-lú ê lin-bú. In ōe phak-lo̍h tōe kā lí kūi-pài, ōe chī lí kha--ni̍h ê thô͘-hún. Án-ni, lí chiū ōe chai góa sī Siōng Chú; thèng-hāu góa ê lâng it-tēng bōe sit-bāng kiàn-siàu.”
Lí kiám ōe-tàng tùi ióng-sū ê chhiú chhiúⁿ-toa̍t chiàn-lī-phín? Kiám ōe-tàng tùi pō-kun ê chhiú kái-kiù hu-ló͘?

Siōng Chú án-ni hôe-tap: Ōe-tàng! Ióng-sū ê hu-ló͘ ōe siū chhiúⁿ-toa̍t; pō-kun ê chiàn-lī-phín ōe siū kái-kiù. Góa beh kap te̍k-tùi lí ê lâng te̍k-tùi; góa beh chín-kiù lí ê kiáⁿ-jî.

Góa beh hō͘ ap-pek lí ê lâng chia̍h in ka-kī ê bah, lim ka-kī ê huih, chhin-chhiūⁿ lim sin-chiú lim kah chùi. Án-ni, choân jîn-lūi chiū ōe chai: Góa Siōng Chú sī lí ê Kiù-chú, lí ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú, sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê Tāi-lêng-chiá.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa hō͘ lín lāu-bú ê lî-hun-su tī tó-ūi? Góa kā lín bōe hō͘ tó chi̍t ê chè-chú? Góa sī in-ūi lín ê chōe chiah kā lín bōe--chhut-khì, in-ūi lín ê chōe-kò chiah kā lín lāu-bú kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.

Sī-án-chóaⁿ góa lâi ê sî, lín bô-pòaⁿ-lâng tī--teh? Sī-án-chóaⁿ góa kiò ê sî, lín lóng bô lâng ìn? Sī in-ūi góa ê chhiú-kut siuⁿ té bô hoat-tō͘ sio̍k-hôe lín, á-sī góa bô khùi-la̍t thang kái-kiù lín? Lín khòaⁿ leh, góa chi̍t-ē hoah, hái chiū ta--khì; góa hō͘ kang-hô pìⁿ-chòe khòng-iá. Hî lóng in-ūi chhùi-ta sí--khì, in-ūi bô chúi chhàu--khì.
Góa kā thiⁿ chhēng o͘-saⁿ, kā kiong-chhong khàm môa-pò͘.

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kà góa kóng eng-kai kóng ê ōe, hō͘ góa ōe-hiáu ēng ōe hû-chō͘ ià-siān ê lâng. I ta̍k chá-khí kā góa kiò-chhíⁿ, khui góa ê hī-khang hō͘ góa chhin-chhiūⁿ ha̍k-seng ōe-hiáu thiaⁿ-siū.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ū khui góa ê hī-khang, góa bô ûi-pōe, mā bô kū-choa̍t.

Lâng beh phah góa, góa oa̍t ka-chiah-phiaⁿ hō͘ in phah; lâng beh chhoah góa ê chhùi-chhiu, góa tu chhùi-phóe chhut-chāi in chhoah. Lâng bú-jio̍k góa, kā góa phùi chhùi-nōa, góa mā bô ng góa ê bīn.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ū pang-chān góa, góa bōe siū lêng-jio̍k; só͘-í, góa chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-thâu kian-tēng biān-tùi it-chhè, góa chai, góa it-tēng bōe tú-tio̍h kiàn-siàu.
Phòaⁿ góa bô-chōe Hit-ūi teh-beh lâi lah! Siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ khòng-kò góa? Lán chòe-tīn lâi-khì chiūⁿ hoat-têng! Siáⁿ-lâng kap góa choh-tùi? Chòe lí lâi khòng-kò!

Khòaⁿ! Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ū teh pang-chān góa, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng soan-kò góa ū-chōe? Khòaⁿ! Khòng-kò góa ê lâng lóng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ saⁿ kū--khì, hō͘ chiù-thâng chia̍h-liáu-liáu.

Lín tiong-kan sím-mi̍h-lâng kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, chun-siú I ê po̍k-jîn ê ōe? I sui-jiân tī o͘-àm bô kng ê lō͘ teh kiâⁿ, mā ōe óa-khò Siōng Chú ê miâ, sìn-nāi i ê Siōng-tè.

Khòaⁿ! Lín só͘-ū tiám-hé, ēng hé-pé bú-chong ka-kī ê lâng, ōe hō͘ lín só͘ khí ê hé, só͘ tiám ê hé-iām siong-hāi. Lín it-tēng ōe tī thòng-khó͘ chiat-bôa tiong tó--lo̍h-khì. Che sī góa chhin-chū kā lín chù-tiāⁿ--ê.

Lín chiah-ê tui-kiû chèng-gī, chhē-kiû góa Siōng Chú ê lâng ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ! Tio̍h khòaⁿ hit-tè chio̍h-pôaⁿ, lín chiū-sī tùi hia phah--chhut-lâi--ê; chù-ì khòaⁿ hit-ê chio̍h-hia̍t, lín chiū-sī tùi hia ó͘--chhut-lâi--ê.
Tio̍h chù-ì khòaⁿ lín ê chó͘-sian A-pek-la-hán, khòaⁿ lín ê lāu-bú Sa-la. Góa soán-tiàu i ê sî, i kan-ta ka-kī chi̍t ê, m̄-kú góa sù-hok i, hō͘ i kiáⁿ-sun chin chōe.

Siōng Chú beh an-ùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, an-ùi i só͘-ū ê hong-po͘. Góa beh hō͘ soa-bô͘ pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ I-tiân-hn̂g, hō͘ hong-po͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú ê hn̂g; tī hn̂g-lāi ū hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, ū kám-siā o-ló ê koa-siaⁿ.
Góa ê chú-bîn ah, chù-ì thiaⁿ góa kóng; góa ê kok-bîn ah, tio̍h àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ góa. Góa beh chiong lu̍t-hoat sù hō͘ bān-kok; góa ê kong-gī beh chòe bān-bîn ê kng.

Góa ê sèng-lī í-keng pek-kūn; góa ê chín-kiù í-keng hoat-chhut. Góa ê chhiú-kut beh thóng-tī bān-bîn. Hái-tó lóng teh thèng-hāu góa lâi, it-ti̍t kî-thāi góa lâi kái-kiù.

Tio̍h gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ thiⁿ, àⁿ-lo̍h khòaⁿ tōe; in-ūi thiⁿ teh-beh chhin-chhiūⁿ ian-bū siau-sòaⁿ, tōe chhin-chhiūⁿ saⁿ chhēng kū--khì, lāi-bīn ê chū-bîn chhin-chhiūⁿ báng-thâng sí--khì. M̄-kú góa ê chín-kiù ōe éng-oán chûn-sio̍k, góa ê kong-gī tāi-tāi bû-kiông.
Tio̍h thiaⁿ! Lín chiah-ê jīn-bat kong-gī, ū kā góa ê kà-sī khǹg tī sim-lāi ê lâng. M̄-bián kiaⁿ lâng kā lín thí-chhiò! M̄-bián lún pa̍t-lâng kā lín bú-jio̍k!

In-ūi chiù-thâng ōe kā in thun-bia̍t, ná-chún teh chia̍h saⁿ; thâng ōe kā in chia̍h-liáu, ná-chún teh chia̍h iûⁿ-mn̂g. M̄-kú, góa ê kong-gī ōe éng-oán chûn-sio̍k, góa ê chín-kiù sòa kàu bān-tāi.

Siōng Chú ah, tio̍h chhíⁿ--khí-lâi! Chhíⁿ--khí-lâi! Lí ê chhiú-kut tio̍h kian-kiông--khí-lâi! Chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-sî ê nî-ji̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ kó͘-chá ê sî-tāi án-ni, tio̍h khí--lâi! Kā La-hap-pek tok-chòe chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè, koh chha̍k-thàu hit-bé tōa hái-koài--ê kiám m̄-sī lí?
Hō͘ hái kap tōa chhim-ian ê chúi ta--khì, tī chhim-ian khui chi̍t tiâu lō͘, hō͘ tit-tio̍h sio̍k-hôe ê lâng kè--khì-ê kiám m̄-sī lí?
Án-ni, Siōng Chú sio̍k-hôe ê lâng lóng ōe tò-tńg--lâi. In ōe hoaⁿ-thâu-hí-bīn, iân-lō͘ chhiùⁿ-koa tńg-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; ai-thàn pi-siong lóng siau-sit.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Sī góa, góa chiah sī an-ùi lín ê Siōng-tè. Sī-án-chóaⁿ lí teh kiaⁿ it-tēng ōe sí ê lâng? In ê sìⁿ-miā put-kò chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu.

Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ bōe-kì-tit lí ê Siōng Chú, bōe-kì-tit hit-ūi thí-khui kiong-chhong, li̍p tāi-tōe kun-ki ê Chō-bu̍t-chú? Lí kui-ji̍t kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ bô-thêng, kiaⁿ hit-ê siūⁿ-beh húi-hoāi lí ê khi-ap-chiá siū-khì. Kî-si̍t, i ê siū-khì bōe-tàng siong-hāi lí.
Siū lia̍h--khì ê lâng chin kín chiū ōe tit-tio̍h tháu-pàng; in bōe sí tī kaⁿ-lô, mā bōe khiàm-kheh chia̍h-mi̍h.
“Góa sī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè; góa iô-tāng hái-iûⁿ, hō͘ éng hōa-hōa-háu. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe sī góa ê chheng-ho͘.

Góa chiong góa ê ōe khǹg tī lí ê chhùi, ēng góa ê chhiú ê iáⁿ jia-khàm lí. Góa thí-khui kiong-chhong, kā tāi-tōe hē kun-ki, kā Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kóng ‘Lí sī góa ê chú-bîn’.”

Tio̍h chhíⁿ--khí-lâi! Chhíⁿ--khí-lâi! Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tio̍h peh--khí-lâi! Lí ū lim Siōng Chú the̍h hō͘ lí tōa siū-khì ê poe, lim hō͘ lâng tian-lâi-tian-khì ê chiú, kui óaⁿ-kong lim kah ta-ta.
I siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-jî bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kā i chhah--teh; i chhī tōa-hàn ê jî-lú bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kā i hû--teh.
Chit nn̄g têng ê chai-hō, lí lóng bat tú--tio̍h, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kap lí chòe-hé pi-siong? Húi-hoāi kap hong-hòe, ki-hng kap to-kiàm lîm-kàu, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kā lí an-ùi?
Lí ê kiáⁿ-jî hūn-tó tī koe-lō͘-kháu, chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ lâng bāng--tio̍h ê lêng-iûⁿ. In chhiong-hun kám-siū Siōng Chú ê tōa siū-khì, siū-chīn lí ê Siōng-tè ê chek-pī.
Só͘-í, lín siū-khó͘ ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chū-bîn, bô lim-chiú mā tian-lâi-tian-khì ê lâng ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ!

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, ūi-tio̍h I chú-bîn sin-oan ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, góa í-keng tùi lín ê chhiú chiong hō͘ lín tian-lâi-tian-khì ê poe the̍h-cháu; lín m̄-bián koh lim góa tōa siū-khì ê óaⁿ.

Góa beh chiong chit-óaⁿ chiú the̍h hō͘ khó͘-chhó͘ lín ê lâng lim; in bat kā lín kóng, ‘Phak--lo̍h-khì, hō͘ goán ta̍h--kè-khì.’ Hit-sî, lín ê ka-chiah-phiaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ thô͘-kha, chhin-chhiūⁿ koe-lō͘ kù-chāi in ta̍h--kè-khì.”

Chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, tio̍h chhíⁿ--khí-lâi! Sek-an ah, tio̍h kian-kiông! Tio̍h chhēng súi ê i-ho̍k! Sèng-siâⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, tùi taⁿ í-āu, bô siū kat-lé, bô chheng-khì--ê bōe koh ji̍p-khì lí lāi-bīn.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, chiong thô͘-hún pōaⁿ hiat-ka̍k! Khí--lâi, chē tī ông-ūi! Lín chiah-ê siū-lia̍h ê Sek-an ê chū-bîn ah, tháu-khui ām-kún ê só-liān!
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lín hō͘ lâng bōe--khì ê sî, bô siu-tio̍h kè-chîⁿ; siâng-khoán, lín tit-tio̍h chū-iû, mā m̄-bián hù sio̍k-kim.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh kóng: Tāi-khí-seng, góa ê chú-bîn lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p kià-ku; āu-lâi, A-su̍t -lâng kā in khi-ap.

Góa ê chú-bîn hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì chòe hu-ló͘, bô siu-tio̍h kè-chîⁿ; koán-hat in ê lâng kā in hoah-lâi-hoah-khì, kui-ji̍t teh bú-jio̍k góa ê miâ. Taⁿ, góa beh chhái-chhú hêng-tōng.
In-ūi án-ni, tī hit-ji̍t, góa ê chú-bîn it-tēng ōe bat góa ê miâ, koh chai teh kóng-ōe--ê sī góa Siōng Chú. Lín khòaⁿ, góa tī chia!
Pôaⁿ-soaⁿ-kè-niá teh soan-kò hô-pêng, thoân hó siau-sit ê sù-chiá, in ê kha-jiah jōa-á-ni̍h súi! In soan-kò chín-kiù, tùi Sek-an kóng: Lí ê Siōng-tè choh-ông thóng-tī lah!
Thiaⁿ! Lín ê siú-bōng-chiá teh chhut tōa-siaⁿ, chôe-siaⁿ hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa. In-ūi in beh chhin-ba̍k kiàn-chèng: Siōng Chú tò-tńg-lâi Sek-an lah!
Hong-hòe ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa; in-ūi Siōng Chú ū an-ùi I ê chú-bîn, I í-keng kiù-sio̍k Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Siōng Chú í-keng tī bān-kok ê gán-chêng hián-chhut I sîn-sèng ê khùi-la̍t; phó͘-thiⁿ-ē ê lâng lóng ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lán ê Siōng-tè ê chín-kiù.

Tio̍h lī-khui, tio̍h lī-khui! Tùi Pa-pí-lûn chhut--lâi! M̄-thang bak-tio̍h bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h. Lín chiah-ê kng Siōng Chú khì-khū ê lâng, tio̍h tùi Pa-pí-lûn chhut--lâi, tio̍h kiat-chēng ka-kī.

M̄-kú lín m̄-bián kóaⁿ-kín, m̄-bián tio̍h-kip; lín m̄-sī teh tô-miā. Siōng Chú it-tēng ōe tī lín thâu-chêng chhōa-lō͘; Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè it-tēng tī lín āu-bīn pó-hō͘.
Siōng Chú kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, góa ê po̍k-jîn beh chòe--ê it-tēng ōe oân-sêng; i it-tēng ōe siū ko-kú tit-tio̍h êng-iāu, siū ko-seng kàu chì-koân.
Chin chōe lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h i, ōe kî-koài gông-ngia̍h; in-ūi i ê bīn-māu siū sún-siong, i ê gōa-piáu bô chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ê khoán-sit.
Án-ni, i ōe hō͘ bān-kok tio̍h-kiaⁿ, hō͘ lia̍t-ông ng-chhùi m̄-káⁿ kóng-ōe; kè-khì m̄-bat niá-siū ê lâng, ōe liáu-kái, m̄-bat thiaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng, ōe léng-ngō͘.
Lán só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, siáⁿ-lâng ōe siong-sìn? Siōng Chú ê khùi-la̍t bat tùi siáⁿ-lâng hián-sī?

Siōng Chú hō͘ I ê po̍k-jîn chhin-chhiūⁿ sin ê íⁿ puh--chhut-lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ kun tùi ta-tōe hoat--chhut-lâi. I bô hó hêng-chōng, bô ui-gî thang khip-ín lán, mā bô hó khòaⁿ ê gōa-māu hō͘ lán thang him-bō͘.
I hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-khin, siū lâng khì-sak, koh siū chin chōe khó͘-lān, keng-le̍k ta̍k-khoán pīⁿ-thiàⁿ. Lâng oa̍t-thâu m̄ khòaⁿ i; lán biáu-sī i, bô kā chun-tiōng.
I khak-si̍t sêng-tam lán ê pīⁿ-thiàⁿ, tam-tng lán ê khó͘-lān. Lán siūⁿ-kóng i siū chek-hoa̍t, hō͘ Siōng-tè phah, siū khó͘-chhó͘.
M̄-kú i sī ūi-tio̍h lán ê kè-sit siū siong-hāi, ūi-tio̍h lán ê chōe-kò siū teh-chhùi. I tam-tng hêng-hoa̍t, lán tit-tio̍h pêng-an; I siū piⁿ-phah, lán tit-tio̍h i-hó.
Lán lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ bê-lō͘; ta̍k-ê lâng kiâⁿ ka-kī ê lō͘. Siōng Chú chiong lán chèng-lâng ê chōe lóng kui tī i sin-chiūⁿ.
I siū ap-pek, siū khó͘-chhó͘, m̄-kú i tiām-tiām bô chhut-siaⁿ; i chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-ko hō͘ lâng khan-khì thâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-bú hō͘ lâng chián-mn̂g, i lóng bô chhut-siaⁿ.
I siū bô kong-tō ê sím-phòaⁿ, hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì; kiám ū lâng koan-sim i ê cho-gū? I ūi-tio̍h góa chú-bîn ê chōe-kò siū piⁿ-phah; i siū chhú-sí, tùi jîn-kan siau-sit.
Sui-jiân i bô ēng pō-le̍k, bô kóng khúi-chà ê ōe, lâng chiong i kap pháiⁿ-lâng tâi chòe-tui, kap hó-gia̍h-lâng tâi chòe-hé.

Chóng-sī Siōng Chú koat-ì hō͘ i siū teh-chhùi, siū khó͘-chhó͘, hō͘ i thang hiàn sìⁿ-miā sio̍k lâng ê chōe. I ōe tn̂g-hè-siū, khòaⁿ-tio̍h kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun, hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chí-ì thong-kè i lâi si̍t-hiān.
Keng-le̍k siū-khó͘, i ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ kng. Tùi i ê thé-giām, i ōe sim-móa-ì-chiok. Góa gī ê po̍k-jîn ōe hō͘ chin chōe lâng chiâⁿ-chòe gī-lâng; i beh tam-tng in ê chōe-kò.

Só͘-í, góa beh hō͘ i kap ū tōe-ūi ê lâng pun só͘ tit--tio̍h ê hūn-gia̍h, kap kiông-béng ê lâng pun chiàn-lī-phín. In-ūi i kam-goān pàng-sak sìⁿ-miā kàu sí, hō͘ lâng lia̍t-ji̍p chōe-hoān ê miâ-toaⁿ. Chóng-sī i tam-tng chin chōe lâng ê chōe, koh thòe chōe-hoān kî-tó.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, lí chit-ê bōe hoâi-īn, bô siⁿ-kiáⁿ ê hū-jîn-lâng ah, tio̍h chhiùⁿ-koa! Lí chit-ê m̄-bat keng-giām chhui-chūn kan-khó͘ ê hū-jîn-lâng ah, tio̍h chhut tōa-siaⁿ hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa! In-ūi siū khì-sak ê hū-jîn-lâng ōe ū chin chōe kiáⁿ-jî, pí ū tiōng-hu--ê khah chōe. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Tio̍h khok-tián lí tòa ê pò͘-pîⁿ ê tōe. Tio̍h kā lí pò͘-pîⁿ ê pò͘ khiú hō͘ khui, m̄-thang hān-chè; soh tio̍h khan kah chīn-pōng; khi̍t-á lóng tèng hō͘ tiâu.
In-ūi lí ōe sì-bīn khok-tián léng-thó͘, lí ê hō͘-tāi ōe tit-tio̍h lia̍t-kok ê thó͘-tōe; hong-hòe ê siâⁿ-tìn ōe ū chin chōe lâng tòa.
M̄-bián kiaⁿ! Lí bōe koh-chài kiàn-siàu; lí bián koh jím-siū bú-jio̍k. Tio̍h bōe-kì-tit lí siàu-liân ê sî ê kiàn-siàu; m̄-thang koh kì-tiâu lí chòe kóaⁿ-hū ê thí-jio̍k.

In-ūi chhòng-chō lí--ê sī lí ê tiōng-hu; I ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe. Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè sī lí ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú; I siū chheng-ho͘ chòe choân-tōe ê Siōng-tè.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí í-chêng sī siàu-liân ê hū-jîn-lâng, hō͘ Siōng Chú — lí ê tiōng-hu khì-sak, sim iu-siong. M̄-kú I kiò lí tò-tńg-khì I hia, kóng:
Sui-jiân góa ū chiām-sî khì-sak lí, góa beh ēng chhim-chhim ê thiàⁿ chiap lí tńg--lâi.
Góa bat tùi lí hoat ke̍k-tōa ê siū-khì, lī-khui lí chi̍t-sî-á kú, taⁿ, góa beh ēng put-piàn ê thiàⁿ lîn-bín lí. Siōng Chú — lí ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Che, tùi góa lâi kóng, ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ Ná-a ê ji̍t: Góa li̍p-sè bōe koh hō͘ tōa-chúi im-ba̍t tāi-tōe. Taⁿ, góa mā li̍p-sè bōe koh tùi lí siū-khì, bōe koh chek-pī lí.

Tōa-soaⁿ ōe-tàng sóa-khui, sió-soaⁿ ōe-tàng chhian-î; m̄-kú góa put-piàn ê thiàⁿ éng-oán bōe lī-khui lí; góa ōe éng-oán chun-siú hô-pêng ê iok. Lîn-bín lí ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú kóng: Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, lí chit-ê siū-khó͘ ê siâⁿ ah, lí hō͘ pō-hong sàu-cháu, bô lâng kā lí an-ùi. Góa beh ēng chhái-sek ê chio̍h kā lí tiông-kiàn, ēng nâ-pó-chio̍h chòe lí ê tōe-ki.
Góa beh ēng âng-pó-chio̍h kā lí khí siâⁿ-thah, ēng ōe hoat-kng ê pó-chio̍h chō lí ê siâⁿ-mn̂g, ēng chu-pó chō lí sì-ûi ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ.
Lí ê kiáⁿ-jî lóng ōe siū Siōng Chú kàu-tō; lí ê kiáⁿ-sun lóng ōe pêng-an hoân-êng.
Lí ōe in-ūi péng-kong-hêng-gī tit-tio̍h kian-li̍p. Lí bô sím-mi̍h thang kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, in-ūi bōe koh siū ap-pek; hiong-pō ōe lī-khui lí hn̄g-hn̄g, khióng-pò͘ bōe pek-kūn lí.
Nā ū lâng kong-kek lí, m̄-sī góa ín-khí--ê. Só͘-ū kong-kek lí--ê, ōe hō͘ lí phah-pāi.
Lí khòaⁿ, góa chō phah-thih sai-hū, in pûn hé-thòaⁿ hō͘ hé iām, chè-chō bú-khì. Góa mā chō húi-bia̍t-chiá, in khí-lâi si-hêng châu-bia̍t.

Só͘-ū ūi-tio̍h beh kong-kek lí chè-chō ê bú-khì, bô chi̍t hāng ū lō͘-ēng. Múi chi̍t ê tī hoat-têng khòng-kò lí ê lâng, it-tēng bōe sèng-sò͘. Che sī Siōng Chú ê po̍k-jîn èng-tit ê sán-gia̍p; góa beh ûi-hō͘ i, hō͘ i sèng-lī. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Chhùi-ta ê lâng, lâi, chia ū chúi! Bô-chîⁿ ê lâng mā lâi, lâi bóe, lâi chia̍h! Lâi bóe chiú, bóe lin! M̄-bián chîⁿ, m̄-bián tāi-kè.

Ná tio̍h khai-chîⁿ bóe bōe-chia̍h--tit ê mi̍h? Ná tio̍h ēng lô-khó͘ thàn ê chîⁿ bóe chia̍h bōe pá ê mi̍h? Lín chù-ì thiaⁿ góa kóng, chiū ū hó-mi̍h thang chia̍h, thang hióng-siū siōng-hó ê chia̍h-mi̍h, hō͘ lín boán-chiok.

“Lín tio̍h àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ, lâi chiū-kūn góa; tio̍h thiaⁿ, lín chiah ōe oa̍h. Góa beh kap lín li̍p éng-oán ê iok, hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h góa èng-ún Tāi-pi̍t hit-ê khak-si̍t put-piàn ê thiàⁿ.
Góa ū chí-phài i chòe bān-kok ê kiàn-chèng-jîn, chòe bān-bîn ê léng-siù thóng-tī in.

Lí khòaⁿ, lí ōe tiàu-chi̍p lí í-chêng m̄-bat ê kok-bîn; m̄ bat lí ê kok-bîn lóng ōe chông-lâi tâu-khò lí. Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè beh chhiok-sêng chit-ê sū; Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè beh hō͘ lí siū chun-tiōng, tit-tio̍h êng-iāu.”
Tio̍h thàn Siōng Chú chhē ōe tio̍h ê sî, chhē-kiû I; thàn I tī sin-piⁿ ê sî, kiû-kiò I.

Siâ-ok ê lâng tio̍h khì-sak in ê tō-lō͘; put-gī ê lâng tio̍h kái-piàn in ê siūⁿ-hoat. In tio̍h kui-ǹg Siōng Chú, I ōe lîn-bín in; tio̍h kui-ǹg lán ê Siōng-tè, I ōe khoan-hông sià-bián in.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa ê ì-liām m̄-sī lín ê ì-liām; góa ê tō-lō͘ m̄-sī lín ê tō-lō͘.
Thiⁿ pí tōe khah koân, siâng-khoán, góa ê tō-lō͘ pí lín ê tō-lō͘ khah koân, góa ê ì-liām mā pí lín ê ì-liām khah koân.
“Chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ kap seh tùi thiⁿ kàng-lo̍h, bô koh tò-tńg, beh lūn-te̍k tāi-tōe, hō͘ ngó͘-kok puh-íⁿ tōa-châng, hō͘ iā-chéng--ê ū chéng-chí, hō͘ lâng ū bí-niû;

tùi góa ê chhùi kóng-chhut ê ōe mā ōe án-ni; góa ê ōe choa̍t-tùi ōe si̍t-hiān, bōe lo̍k-khong. Góa ê ōe beh oân-sêng góa ê kè-ōe; góa ê ōe beh sêng-chiū góa ài chòe ê tāi-chì.

“Lín ōe hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí lī-khui, siū ín-chhōa pêng-pêng-an-an tńg--khì. Tōa-soaⁿ sió-soaⁿ ōe tī lín bīn-chêng chhut-siaⁿ chhiùⁿ-koa; chhân-iá ê chhiū-ba̍k ōe phah-pho̍k-á hoaⁿ-hí.

Í-chêng ū chhì-phè ê só͘-chāi ōe hoat chhêng-peh; ū chháu-chhì ê só͘-chāi ōe hoat tiông-chheng-chhiū. Che beh chòe éng-kiú put-bia̍t ê kì-hō, hō͘ lín ōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú ê chok-ûi.”
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Lín tio̍h ûi-hō͘ kong-pêng, si̍t-chián kong-gī; in-ūi góa ê chín-kiù kūn lah, góa ê kong-gī liâm-piⁿ si̍t-hiān.
Kian-siú An-hioh-ji̍t, lóng bô ûi-pōe, chhiú bô choh-pháiⁿ, chit-khoán lâng chin ū hok-khì!”

Í-keng kui-sìn Siōng Chú ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng m̄-thang kóng, “Siōng Chú it-tēng ōe kā góa kap I ê chú-bîn keh-lī.” Thài-kàm mā m̄-thang kóng, “Góa put-kò sī chi̍t châng ta--khì ê chhiū.”
In-ūi Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Hiah-ê chun-siú góa ê An-hioh-ji̍t, chòe góa só͘ hoaⁿ-hí ê sū, chhî-siú góa ê iok ê thài-kàm,

góa beh hō͘ in tī góa ê sèng-tiān, góa ê chhiûⁿ-ûi lāi ū kì-liām-pi, ū miâ-hō, pí ū chin chōe kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ khah hó; góa beh sù in éng-oán bōe hō͘ lâng chhat-siau ê miâ.

“Hiah-ê kui-sìn Siōng Chú ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng beh sū-hōng góa, kèng-ài góa Siōng Chú ê miâ, koh chòe góa ê po̍k-jîn; in lóng chun-siú An-hioh-ji̍t, bô kan-hoān lām-iōng, khak-si̍t chhî-siú góa ê iok,

góa beh chhōa in kàu Sek-an — góa ê sèng-soaⁿ, hō͘ in tī góa kî-tó ê tiān lāi-bīn ū hoaⁿ-hí; góa mā beh chiap-la̍p in hiàn tī góa chè-tôaⁿ téng ê sio-hòa-chè kap chè-mi̍h. In-ūi góa ê tiān beh kiò-chòe bān-bîn kî-tó ê tiān.”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ū chio-chi̍p liû-bông ê Í-sek-lia̍t chú-bîn tò-tńg--lâi, I án-ni kóng, “Í-keng tò-tńg--lâi ê chú-bîn í-gōa, góa mā beh chio-chi̍p koh-khah chōe lâng lâi kui-óa in.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Chhân-iá ê cháu-siù ah, lóng lâi! Chhiū-nâ lāi ê iá-siù ah, lóng lâi thun-chia̍h!
Í-sek-lia̍t ê siú-bōng-chiá lóng chhiⁿ-mî, lóng bô tì-sek; in sī bōe pūi ê káu, kui-ji̍t tó-teh khùn, teh choh-bāng.
In lóng sī tham-chia̍h ê káu, kui-ji̍t chia̍h bōe pá. Chiah-ê bo̍k-chiá bô tì-sek; ta̍k-ê lâng kiâⁿ ka-kī ê lō͘, tui-kiû ka-kī ê lī-ek.
In kóng, ‘Lâi! Lán lâi-khì bóe chiú, lim kāu-chiú, lim hō͘ kàu-khùi. Bîn-á-chài ōe kap kin-á-ji̍t siâng-khoán, sīm-chì koh-khah chán!’”
Gī-lâng siū húi-bia̍t, bô lâng koan-sim; kèng-khiân ê lâng sìⁿ-miā siū chhú-toa̍t, bô lâng chù-ì. Gī-lâng siū chhú-toa̍t, thang thoat-lī chai-lān.
Hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t ê lâng ōe chìn-ji̍p an-lêng, tī bîn-chhn̂g an-jiân kè-óng.
Lín chiah-ê kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t ê cha-bó͘-lâng ê kiáⁿ-jî, kan-hu kap ki-lú ê hō͘-tāi, lóng chìn-chêng lâi!
Lín teh hì-lāng siáⁿ-lâng? Teh tùi siáⁿ-lâng khui-chhùi thó͘-chi̍h? Lín kiám m̄-sī pōe-ge̍k ê kiáⁿ-jî? Kiám m̄-sī pe̍h-chha̍t ê hō͘-tāi?
Lín tī siōng-chhiū tiong-kan, tī chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū ē-bīn, io̍k-hé-kong-sim; lín tī soaⁿ-kok, tī chio̍h-hia̍t, thâi lín ê gín-á chòe seng-lé hiàn hō͘ ngó͘-siōng.
Lín tī soaⁿ-kok tiong the̍h kng-ku̍t ê chio̍h-thâu chòe sîn-bêng pài, tùi in tò chiú hiàn-chè, lín siūⁿ chiah-ê tāi-chì góa kiám ōe iông-ún?
Lín tī koân koh kiā ê soaⁿ-téng khǹg bîn-chhn̂g kiâⁿ-îm; lín chiūⁿ-khì hia hiàn-chè.

Lín tī mn̂g-āu, tī mn̂g-thiāu piⁿ, chhāi îm-hēng ê siōng; lín pàng-sak góa, seng-khu thǹg-kng-kng, kap ài-jîn peh-khí-khì tōa téng bîn-chhn̂g, ēng iok-tēng ê kè-chîⁿ tàu-tīn khùn, boán-chiok lín ê jio̍k-io̍k.
Lín tòa iû kap chin chōe phang-chúi khì pài Mô͘-lo̍k. Ūi-tio̍h beh chhē sîn-bêng lâi pài, lín chhe sù-chiá khì thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak, sīm-chì lo̍h kàu Im-hú.
Lín kiâⁿ chin hn̄g ê lō͘, chin ià-siān, m̄-kú iáu bô sí-sim. Lín siūⁿ-kóng ōe-tàng tùi lín ê sîn-bêng têng-sin tit-tio̍h goân-khì, só͘-í bô kám-kak ià-siān.

Lín teh kiaⁿ siáⁿ-lâng soah tio̍h kóng pe̍h-chha̍t? Lín kèng-jiân bōe-kì-tit góa, bô kā góa khǹg tī sim-lāi! Góa it-ti̍t bô kóng-ōe, ba̍k-chiu pàng-khoeh-khoeh, lín chiū m̄ kiaⁿ góa sī--bô?
Góa beh kong-khai lín chū-chheng sī chèng-gī hêng-ûi ê chin-siòng; chiah-ê tùi lín lóng bô lī-ek.

Lín ai-kiû ê sî, tio̍h kiò hiah-ê ngó͘-siōng lâi kiù lín. Hong ōe kā in chhe-liáu-liáu; khùi ōe kā in pûn sòaⁿ--khì. M̄-kú tâu-khò góa ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe, ōe-tàng sêng-chiap góa ê sèng-soaⁿ.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Tio̍h kiàn-chō, tio̍h kiàn-chō, ūi-tio̍h beh tńg--lâi ê chú-bîn khui chi̍t tiâu tōa-lō͘, sóa-khui lō͘--ni̍h só͘-ū ê chó͘-gāi.”

Chì-ko-bû-siōng, éng-oán chûn-chāi, chheng-chòe “Sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè” Hit-ūi án-ni kóng, “Góa tòa tī chì-koân chì-sèng ê só͘-chāi, mā kap sim thòng-hóe khiam-pi ê lâng chòe-hé tòa; góa beh hō͘ khiam-pi ê lâng sim-lêng chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, hō͘ sim thòng-hóe ê lâng sim-sîn oa̍h--khí-lâi.
Góa bōe kè-sio̍k khòng-kò in, mā bōe éng-oán tùi in siū-khì; góa hō͘ lâng ê sim-lêng soe-lám, mā ōe-tàng hō͘ lâng ū oa̍h-miā.
In-ūi in tham-loân ê chōe, góa ū tùi in siū-khì, só͘-í góa chhú-hoa̍t in, khì-sak in. M̄-kú in kè-sio̍k pōe-ge̍k, kiâⁿ ka-kī ê lō͘.
“Góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h in ê só͘-kiâⁿ, iáu-kú ōe kā in i-tī. Góa ōe ín-chhōa in, pang-chān in, hō͘ siong-sim ê lâng tit-tio̍h an-ùi,
hō͘ iu-siong ê lâng hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa lâi o-ló. Góa beh sù pêng-an hoân-êng hō͘ hn̄g kap kūn ê lâng. Góa koh beh i-tī góa ê chú-bîn.” Siōng Chú koh kóng,
“M̄-kú siâ-ok ê lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-éng péng-lâi-péng-khì, lóng bōe pêng-chēng; hái-chúi it-ti̍t chhèng-chhut lâ-sâm ê thô͘-bê.
Siâ-ok ê lâng bô pêng-an!” Góa ê Siōng-tè án-ni soan-kò.

Tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ hoah! M̄-thang thêng-chí. Tio̍h chhut-la̍t hoah! Chhin-chhiūⁿ teh pûn sàu-kak. Tio̍h tùi góa ê chú-bîn soan-pò͘ in ê pōe-ge̍k! Tùi Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi soan-kò in ê chōe!

In ta̍k-ji̍t teh chhē-kiû góa, ì-ài beh chai góa ê tō-lō͘, ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ sī péng-kong-hêng-gī ê kok-bîn, bô khì-sak in ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng. In ū tùi góa kiû-mn̄g kong-gī ê sím-phòaⁿ, ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ hoaⁿ-hí chhin-kūn Siōng-tè.
