M̄-kú in mn̄g, “Goán kìm-chia̍h, lí ná bô koan-sim? Goán khek-khó͘, lí ná bô chù-ì?” Kî-si̍t, lín tī kìm-chia̍h ê ji̍t, iáu ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê lī-ek, kiông-pek lín ê kang-lâng chòe khó͘-kang.
Lín kìm-chia̍h, mā teh oan-ke cheng-tò͘, ēng hiong-béng ê kûn-thâu-bú cheng pa̍t-lâng. Lín kin-á-ji̍t án-ni teh kìm-chia̍h, kiám ōe hō͘ lín kî-tó ê siaⁿ thàu kàu thiⁿ-téng?

Che kiám sī góa só͘ ài ê kìm-chia̍h? Lâng khek-khó͘ ka-kī ê ji̍t-chí kiám sī án-ni? Lín chhin-chhiūⁿ lô͘-úi thâu àⁿ-àⁿ, chhēng môa-saⁿ tó tī hé-hu, kiám kóng che chiū-sī kìm-chia̍h, sī Siōng Chú hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p ê ji̍t?
Kî-si̍t, góa só͘ ài ê kìm-chia̍h sī án-ni: Tháu-khui bô kong-chèng ê só-liān; chián-tn̄g pa̍k tāng-tàⁿ ê soh; tháu-pàng siū ap-pek--ê tit chū-iû; kòng-tn̄g it-chhè ê taⁿ.

Góa só͘ ài--ê kiám m̄-sī lín kap iau-gō--ê hun-hióng chia̍h-mi̍h, chiap-thāi bû-ka-khó-kui ê sàn-chhiah-lâng khì lín tau, hō͘ chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé--ê ū saⁿ thang moa, bô siám-pī tùi chhin-lâng ê chek-jīm?

Án-ni, lín ê kng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lê-bêng hoat-chhut ê kng, lín ōe chin kín tit-tio̍h i-tī, lín ê kong-gī ōe chòe sian-hong chhōa lín, Siōng Chú ê êng-kng ōe tī āu-bīn pó-hō͘ lín.

Hit-sî, lín kiû-kiò, Siōng Chú it-tēng ìn-tap; lín tùi I kiû pang-chān, I ōe kóng: Góa tī chia. Lín nā chiong khi-ap lâng ê taⁿ sóa-khui, chiong chí-chek lâng ê chńg-thâu-á sóa-cháu, bô koh kóng lâng ê pháiⁿ-ōe;
lín nā chiong chia̍h-mi̍h pun hō͘ iau-gō ê lâng, boán-chiok khùn-khó͘ ê lâng ê su-iàu; án-ni, lín ê kng ōe tī o͘-àm tiong hoat-chhut, àm-mî ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t tiong-tàu.

Siōng Chú ōe kè-sio̍k ín-chhōa lín, hō͘ lín tī khòng-hān ê só͘-chāi ta̍k-hāng lóng boán-chiok, hō͘ lín ê kut-thâu ióng-chòng. Lín ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ ū chúi koàn-ak ê hn̂g, chhin-chhiūⁿ ū chúi ti̍t-ti̍t-lâu ê chúi-chôaⁿ.

Lín ōe tiông-kiàn chá chiū hong-hòe ê só͘-chāi, siu-kiàn kó͘-chá chiū ū ê tōe-ki. Lín ōe hō͘ lâng chheng-chòe “pó͘ phòa-khiah--ê”, hō͘ lâng kiò-chòe “siu-lí chhù hō͘ lâng khiā-khí--ê”.

Lín nā bô phò-hoāi An-hioh-ji̍t, bô tī sèng ê ji̍t-chí tui-kiû lī-ek ka-kī ê sū; lín nā khòaⁿ An-hioh-ji̍t chòe thang hoaⁿ-hí ê ji̍t, chun-tiōng i chòe Siōng Chú ê sèng-ji̍t; lín nā chun-tiōng sèng-ji̍t, bô chòe ji̍t-siông ê kang-chok, bô chòe ka-kī hoaⁿ-hí ê sū, bô lām-sám kóng-ōe;

án-ni, lín chiū ōe tùi Siōng Chú tit-tio̍h hí-lo̍k. Góa beh hō͘ lín tī tōe-chiūⁿ ta̍k só͘-chāi siū chun-tiōng, ēng lín chó͘-sian Ngá-kok lâu hō͘ lín ê sán-gia̍p iúⁿ-chhī lín. Siōng Chú chhin-chhùi án-ni soan-pò͘.
Tio̍h chai, Siōng Chú ê chhiú-kut m̄-sī siuⁿ té kiù bōe tio̍h lâng; I ê hī-khang mā m̄-sī siuⁿ tāng bōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Sī lín ê chōe-ok chiong lín kap lín ê Siōng-tè keh-choa̍t; lín ê chōe-kò hō͘ I ê bīn oa̍t-cháu, m̄ thiaⁿ lín ê kî-tó.
In-ūi lín ê chhiú móa-móa sī huih, chńg-thâu-á hō͘ chōe-ok bak--tio̍h; Lín ê chhùi-tûn kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, lín ê chhùi-chi̍h kóng siâ-ok.
Bô lâng chiàu kong-gī kò-sò͘, mā bô lâng chiàu sêng-si̍t piān-hō͘; in lóng sìn-nāi hu-ké, kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, pū to̍k-hāi, siⁿ chōe-gia̍t.
In pū to̍k-chôa-nn̄g, khan ti-tu-bāng, chia̍h-tio̍h nn̄g ê lâng it-tēng sí; chôa-nn̄g phòa, it-tēng chhut to̍k-chôa.
In kiⁿ ê bāng bōe-tàng chòe saⁿ chhēng, bōe-tàng jia-khàm ka-kī; in ê hêng-ûi lóng sī chōe-ok, in só͘ chòe--ê lóng sī kiông-pō.
In ê kha chông-khì chòe pháiⁿ, kip beh lâu bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih; in ê sim-su ì-liām lóng sī chōe-ok, kiâⁿ--kè ê lō͘ lóng sī thún-ta̍h húi-bia̍t.
Hô-pêng ê lō͘, in m̄ bat; in kiâⁿ ê lō͘ bô chèng-ti̍t. In ūi ka-kī chō oan-khiau ê lō͘; kiâⁿ chit-khoán lō͘ ê lâng lóng bô pêng-an hô-pêng.

In-ūi án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn kóng, “Chèng-ti̍t lī-khui goán chin hn̄g, kong-gī mā jip goán bōe tio̍h. Goán kî-thāi kng-bêng, m̄-kú iáu-sī o͘-àm; goán thèng-hāu kng-liāng, m̄-kú iáu kiâⁿ tī o͘-àm.

Goán ná sit-bêng ê lâng bong chhiûⁿ-piah teh kiâⁿ; tī tiong-tàu poa̍h-tó, ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ tī hông-hun; goán chiu-ûi ê lâng lóng ióng-chòng, m̄-kú goán ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ sí-lâng.
Goán chhin-chhiūⁿ hîm teh háu, chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu teh ai-bêng. Goán ǹg-bāng chèng-ti̍t, m̄-kú tán lóng bô; goán kî-thāi chín-kiù, m̄-kú chín-kiù lī goán chin hn̄g.
Goán tī lí bīn-chêng só͘ hoān ê chōe-kò chin chōe; goán ê chōe choh-chèng khòng-kò goán. Goán ê chōe-kò tè goán tè-tiâu-tiâu; goán lóng chai goán ê chōe chin tāng.
Goán pōe-ge̍k, khì-choa̍t Siōng Chú, oa̍t-tńg-sin m̄ kun-tè goán ê Siōng-tè; goán kè-bô͘ ap-pek kap hoán-poān, sim chûn hu-ké, chhùi kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.
Chèng-ti̍t chhò-pāi, kong-gī tiām-tiām khiā-hn̄g-hn̄g; chin-lí tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu siak-tó, sêng-si̍t bōe-tàng ji̍p--lâi.
Chin-lí chhē bōe tio̍h; lī-khui siâ-ok ê lâng hoán-tńg siū-hāi.” Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-kìⁿ bô chèng-ti̍t, chin bô hoaⁿ-hí.
I khòaⁿ bô lâng pang-chān siū khi-ap ê lâng, chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, chiū ēng ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t chín-kiù in, ēng ka-kī ê kong-gī hû-chhî in.
I ēng kong-gī chòe chiàn-kah chhēng, ēng chín-kiù chòe thâu-khoe tì, ēng pò-ho̍k chòe saⁿ chhēng, ēng béng-lia̍t ê siū-khì chòe gōa-phàu moa.
I beh chiàu lâng ê hêng-ûi kā in pò-èng, beh tùi te̍k-jîn hoat tōa siū-khì, kā tùi-te̍k pò-ho̍k, tùi chèng hái-tó ê lâng pò-èng.

Án-ni, sai-pêng ê lâng ōe kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê miâ; tang-pêng ê lâng ōe chun-chông I ê êng-kng. In-ūi Siōng Chú ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ kip-liû ê hô-chúi chhiong--lâi, I ê hong teh chhe, teh sàu.
Ū chi̍t ūi Kiù-sio̍k-chú ōe lâi Sek-an, lâi kàu hiah-ê ūi ka-kī ê pōe-poān hóe-kái ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú kā I ê chú-bîn kóng, “Góa kap lín li̍p ê iok sī án-ni: Góa ê sîn kap góa ê ōe lóng ōe tī lín tiong-kan; góa hē tī lín chhùi-lāi ê ōe it-tēng bōe lī-khui lín ê chhùi, mā bōe lī-khui lín ê kiáⁿ-sun kap lín kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun ê chhùi, tùi chit-sî ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Khí--lâi! Hoat-kng! Lí ê kng í-keng lâi kàu! Siōng Chú ê êng-kng í-keng teh chiò lí!
Khòaⁿ leh, sui-jiân o͘-àm tà-móa tāi-tōe, tōa o͘-àm jia-khàm bān-bîn, m̄-kú Siōng Chú ōe kā lí chiò-kng, I ê êng-kng ōe tī lí sin-chiūⁿ hián-bêng.
Bān-kok ōe lâi chiū-kūn lí ê kng, lia̍t-ông lâi chhin-kūn lí hoat-chhut ê kong-hui.
Tio̍h gia̍h-thâu sì-hng koan-khòaⁿ: Lí ê chú-bîn chū-chi̍p lâi kàu lí chia; lí ê kiáⁿ tùi hn̄g-hn̄g tńg--lâi, lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ná gín-á hō͘ lâng phō--lâi.
Hit-sî lí khòaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê, chiū chin kong-chhái; sim kek-tōng chin hoaⁿ-hí. Tùi hái ūn--lâi ê châi-hù ōe piàⁿ hō͘ lí; bān-kok ê châi-pó lóng pìⁿ lí ê.
Kui tōa-tīn ê lo̍k-tô, Bí-tiân kap Í-hoat ê tan-hong lo̍k-tô lóng ōe lâi, tùi Sī-pa lâi--ê mā ōe tòa n̂g-kim kap jú-hiuⁿ; in lóng ōe siōng-chàn soan-iông Siōng Chú.

Só͘-ū Ki-ta̍t ê iûⁿ-kûn lóng ōe chū-chi̍p khì lí hia, só͘-ū Nî-pài-iok ê mî-iûⁿ-káng ōe chòe lí ê lō͘-ēng; chiah-ê lóng ōe hiàn tī chè-tôaⁿ, chiâⁿ-chòe góa hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p ê chè-mi̍h. Góa Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ góa ê tiān ê êng-iāu koh-khah hui-hông.
Hiah-ê chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-phìⁿ hûn pe--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu pe tńg-lâi siū--ni̍h-ê sī siáⁿ-lâng?

In sī tùi hn̄g-hn̄g ê hái-tó chū-chi̍p ê chûn-tūi; Tha-si ê chûn chòe thâu, chhōa lí ê kiáⁿ-jî tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi tòa kim tòa gûn lâi, lóng sī ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè, Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè ê miâ. In-ūi I í-keng ū hō͘ lí tit-tio̍h êng-iāu.

Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kóng, “Gōa-kok-lâng ōe tiông-kiàn lí ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, in ê kun-ông ōe ho̍k-sāi lí. Góa bat tī siū-khì tiong hêng-hoa̍t lí, m̄-kú taⁿ beh si-un lîn-bín lí.
Lí ê siâⁿ-mn̂g lóng ōe put-sî khui-khui, ji̍t--sî mî--sî mn̂g lóng bōe koaiⁿ; án-ni, lia̍t-pang ōe tòa in ê châi-bu̍t lâi, in ê kun-ông chhōa-tūi, pâi-lia̍t chìn-kòng.
M̄-khéng ho̍k-sāi lí ê lia̍t-pang kap ông-kok lóng ōe bia̍t-bông; hiah-ê pang-kok lóng ōe thiat-tóe hong-hòe.

“ Lê-pa-lūn ê êng-kng, chiū-sī siông-chhiū, sam-chhiū, n̂g-iông-chhiū, lóng ōe ūn-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chong-sek bí-hòa góa ê sèng-só͘; góa mā beh hō͘ góa kha ta̍h ê só͘-chāi tit-tio̍h êng-kng.

Ap-pek lí hiah-ê lâng ê hō͘-tāi lóng ōe lâi kiâⁿ-lé piáu kèng-ì; só͘-ū biáu-sī lí ê lâng ōe lâi tī lí ê kha-ē kūi-pài. In beh chheng lí chòe ‘Siōng Chú ê Siâⁿ’, ‘ Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè ê Sek-an ’.
“Sui-jiân lí bat siū khì-sak, siū iàm-ò͘ⁿ, bô lâng tùi lí hia keng-kè, góa beh hō͘ lí ū éng-oán ê êng-hôa, ū sè-sè-tāi-tāi ê hoaⁿ-hí!
Lí beh suh lia̍t-kok ê lin, beh lim kun-ông ê lin; lí chiū chai góa Siōng Chú sī lí ê Kiù-chú, lí ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Tāi-lêng-chiá.

“Góa beh the̍h kim tāi-thòe tâng, the̍h gûn tāi-thòe thih; beh ēng tâng tāi-thòe chhâ, ēng thih tāi-thòe chio̍h-thâu. Góa beh siat-li̍p Hô-pêng chòe lí ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, chí-phài Kong-gī chòe lí ê kam-tok.
Tī lí ê thó͘-tōe bōe koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ kiông-pō, lí ê kéng-lāi bōe koh ū húi-bia̍t hong-hòe. Lí beh chheng lí ê chhiûⁿ chòe ‘Chín-kiù’, kiò lí ê mn̂g chòe ‘Chàn-bí’.
“Ji̍t--sî lí bô koh su-iàu ji̍t-thâu ê kng, àm-sî mā bô su-iàu ge̍h-niû ê kng chiò; in-ūi góa Siōng Chú beh chòe lí éng-oán ê kng; lí ê Siōng-tè sī lí ê êng-kng.
Lí ê ji̍t-thâu bōe koh lo̍h-soaⁿ, lí ê ge̍h-niû bōe bih--khí-lâi. Siōng Chú beh chòe lí éng-oán ê kng; lí pi-siong ê ji̍t-chí ōe soah.
Lí ê jîn-bîn lóng ōe péng-kong-hêng-gī; in ōe éng-oán kè-sêng èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe. In sī góa chhin-chhiú só͘ chèng só͘ chō, hō͘ góa thang tit-tio̍h êng-kng.
Siōng-sòe--ê ōe pìⁿ-chòe tōa chong-cho̍k; siōng-jio̍k--ê ōe pìⁿ-chòe kiông-kok. Góa sī Siōng Chú, tī sî-ki sêng-se̍k ê sî góa ōe chin kín chhiok-sêng chit-ê sū.”

Chì-koân Siōng Chú ê sîn lîm-kàu góa, in-ūi Siōng Chú ēng iû boah góa; I chhe góa khì thoân hó siau-sit hō͘ sàn-chhiah-lâng, i-tī sim-lêng phò-chhùi ê lâng, soan-pò͘ siū-lia̍h--ê tit-tio̍h tháu-pàng, siū-koaiⁿ--ê chhut kaⁿ-lô,
soan-pò͘ Siōng Chú un-thāi lâng ê nî kap lán ê Siōng-tè thòe I ê chú-bîn sin-oan ê ji̍t, an-ùi só͘-ū pi-ai ê lâng;

tī Sek-an pi-ai ê lâng, I sù in hoa-koan tāi-thòe hé-hu, hoaⁿ-hí ê iû tāi-thòe pi-ai, chheng-chàn ê saⁿ tāi-thòe iu-siong ê sim. In siū chheng-chòe “Kong-gī ê siōng-chhiū”, sī Siōng Chú chai-chèng--ê, beh hián-bêng I ka-kī ê êng-kng.
In ōe tiông-kiàn kú-kú pha-hng ê tōe, siu-kiàn chá-chêng húi-hoāi ê só͘-chāi, têng-chài khí-chō sè-sè-tāi-tāi hong-hòe ê siâⁿ-chhī.
Gōa-cho̍k-lâng ōe lâi chhī lín ê iûⁿ-kûn, gōa-kok-lâng ōe thòe lín keng-choh chhân-hn̂g, chiàu-kò͘ lín ê phû-tô-hn̂g.
Lín beh kiò-chòe “Siōng Chú ê chè-si”, sū-hōng lán ê Siōng-tè. Lín ōe tit-tio̍h lia̍t-kok ê châi-bu̍t, hióng-siū in ê châi-hù lâi khoa-kháu.

Lín ū siū-tio̍h siang-pē ê lêng-jio̍k; lâng siūⁿ-kóng lêng-jio̍k sī lín èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h. Chóng-sī, lín ōe tī ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe tit-tio̍h siang-pē ê sán-gia̍p; lín ê hoaⁿ-hí ōe éng-oán chûn-sio̍k.
Góa Siōng Chú ì-ài kong-pêng, iàm-ò͘ⁿ chhiúⁿ-toa̍t kap hoān-chōe. Góa beh ēng sìn-si̍t kā in pò-siúⁿ, beh kap in li̍p éng-oán ê iok.
In ê hō͘-tāi tī lia̍t-kok tiong ōe chin chhut-miâ; in ê kiáⁿ-sun tī bān-bîn tiong ū hó miâ-siaⁿ. Só͘-ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ in ê lâng ōe sêng-jīn in sī Siōng Chú sù-hok ê chú-bîn.

Góa ōe in-ūi Siōng Chú tōa-tōa hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi góa ê Siōng-tè khoài-lo̍k. Siōng-tè ēng chín-kiù chòe saⁿ kā góa chhēng, ēng sèng-lī chòe gōa-phàu kā góa moa; chhin-chhiūⁿ sin-lông tì hoa-koan, sin-niû kòa chu-pó.

Tú chhin-chhiūⁿ thó͘-tōe hō͘ chéng-chí puh-gê, chhân-hn̂g hō͘ só͘ iā--ê seng-tióng, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ sèng-lī kap chàn-bí tī bān-kok ê bīn-chêng khui-hoe kiat-chí.

Ūi-tio̍h Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê iân-kò͘, góa bōe tiām-tiām, ūi-tio̍h Sek-an ê iân-kò͘, góa bōe chēng-chēng; ti̍t-kàu i ê kong-gī chhin-chhiūⁿ kng hoat-chhut, i ê chín-kiù chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-pé teh to̍h.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, bān-kok lóng beh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí tek-sèng; bān-ông beh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê êng-iāu. Lâng beh ēng sin ê miâ chheng-ho͘ lí, sī Siōng Chú pún-sin kā lí hō--ê.
Lí sī Siōng Chú chhiú-tiong siōng súi ê hoa-koan, sī lí ê Siōng-tè chhiú--ni̍h ê ông-koan.

Lí bōe koh hō͘ lâng kiò-chòe “Siū khì-sak--ê”, lí ê thó͘-tōe bōe koh kiò-chòe “Hong-hòe--ê”. Lâng beh chheng-ho͘ lí chòe “Lí sī góa siōng ì-ài--ê”, kā lí ê thó͘-tōe kiò-chòe “Ū kui-sio̍k--ê”. In-ūi Siōng Chú ì-ài lí; lí ê thó͘-tōe ōe ū kui-sio̍k.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ siàu-liân-lâng chhōa siàu-lú, lí ê chū-bîn mā ōe án-ni thiàⁿ-sioh lí; chhin-chhiūⁿ sin-lông ì-ài sin-niû, lí ê Siōng-tè mā ōe án-ni ì-ài lí.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, góa ū phài siú-bōng ê lâng tī lí ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng teh kò͘; in mî-ji̍t lóng bōe chēng-chēng. Kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê lâng, lín lóng m̄-thang hioh-khùn,
hō͘ Siōng Chú bô thang hioh-khùn, ti̍t-kàu I tiông-kiàn Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, hō͘ chit-ê siâⁿ tī choân-tōe siū chheng-chàn.

Siōng Chú í-keng gia̍h I ê chiàⁿ-chhiú, ēng I ū khùi-la̍t ê chhiú-kut li̍p-sè: Góa choa̍t-tùi bōe koh chiong lí ê ngó͘-kok hō͘ tùi-te̍k chòe chia̍h-mi̍h, gōa-kok-lâng mā bōe koh lim lí lô-khó͘ tit--lâi ê chiú.
Chèng-choh ê lâng ōe-tàng chia̍h i só͘ chèng--ê, koh chheng-chàn Siōng Chú; siu-sêng phû-tô ê lâng ōe-tàng tī góa sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ lim-chiú.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h chhut--khì, chhut-khì siâⁿ-mn̂g gōa, ūi-tio̍h tńg--lâi ê tông-pau khui-lō͘. Tio̍h siu-chō chi̍t tiâu tōa-lō͘; chiong chio̍h-thâu poaⁿ-khui, ūi bān-bîn chhāi tōa-kî chòe kì-hō.

Siōng Chú soan-pò͘ ê ōe í-keng thoân kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak; tio̍h tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, lí ê Chín-kiù-chiá teh lâi lah; kap I chòe-hé--ê, ū I só͘ tháu-pàng ê lâng, kiâⁿ tī I thâu-chêng--ê, ū I kái-kiù ê chú-bîn.”
Lâng beh kiò in chòe “Siōng Chú só͘ kiù-sio̍k sèng ê chú-bîn”; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng beh kiò-chòe “Siū khòaⁿ-kò͘, bô siū khì-sak ê Siâⁿ”.

Tùi Í-tong ê Pho-su-la -siâⁿ teh lâi, chhēng âng-sek gōa-phàu Hit-ūi sī siáⁿ-lâng? Chhēng-chhah hôa-bí, chhiong-móa ui-le̍k, tōa-pō͘ hiòng-chêng māi-chìn Hit-ūi sī siáⁿ-lâng? “Sī góa — ū tōa khùi-la̍t chín-kiù ê Siōng Chú; góa lâi soan-kò sèng-lī.”
Sī-án-chóaⁿ lí ê gōa-phàu sī âng-sek, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh ta̍h chiú-khut ê lâng ê saⁿ?

Siōng Chú kóng: Góa ka-kī chi̍t ê tī chiú-khut ta̍h phû-tô, góa ê chú-bîn bô lâng kap góa chòe-hé. Góa tī siū-khì tiong ta̍h lia̍t-kok, tī tōa siū-khì tiong thún-ta̍h in; in ê huih phùn-tio̍h góa ê gōa-phàu, phah lâ-sâm góa só͘-ū ê saⁿ.
Sin-oan ê ji̍t, góa í-keng tiāⁿ-tio̍h, góa kiù-sio̍k ê nî mā í-keng kàu.

Góa sì-kòe khòaⁿ, m̄-kú bô chi̍t ê lâi pang-chān; góa chù-ì khòaⁿ, kèng-jiân bô lâng lâi hia̍p-chō͘. Só͘-í, góa khò ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t si-hêng chín-kiù; góa ê tōa siū-khì ka-kiông góa ê koat-sim.
Góa tī siū-khì tiong thún-ta̍h lia̍t-kok ê jîn-bîn, tī tōa siū-khì tiong phah-chhùi in; góa kā in ê huih piàⁿ tī tōe--ni̍h.

Góa beh kóng-khí Siōng Chú put-piàn ê thiàⁿ, beh chheng-chàn I ūi-tio̍h lán só͘ chòe it-chhè ê chok-ûi. Siōng Chú ū chiàu I ê un-hūi kap hong-sēng ê chû-ài tōa-tōa sù-hok hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -ke.
Siōng Chú kóng, “In khak-si̍t sī góa ê chú-bîn, sī bōe kiâⁿ khúi-chà ê kiáⁿ-jî.” Án-ni, I chiū chòe in ê Kiù-chú.

Tī in it-chhè ê khó͘-lān tiong, I mā tâng siū khó͘; I chhe I bīn-chêng ê sù-chiá kái-kiù in. I ēng I ê thiàⁿ, I ê lîn-bín kiù-sio̍k in; tī kó͘-chá ê sî-ji̍t, I lóng kā in phō, kā in āiⁿ.
In kèng-jiân pōe-poān, hō͘ I sèng ê sîn iu-siong; só͘-í Siōng Chú pìⁿ-chòe in ê te̍k-jîn, kap in choh-tùi.

Hit-sî, in chiah siūⁿ-khí kó͘-chá I ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se ê ji̍t-chí. In mn̄g, “Taⁿ, hit-ūi chiong I ê chú-bîn kap in ê léng-siù tùi hái-tiong kiù--chhut-lâi ê Siōng Chú tī tó-ūi? Hit-ūi chiong sèng ê sîn sù hō͘ in ê Siōng Chú tī tó-ūi?
Hit-ūi kiâⁿ tī Mô͘-se ê chiàⁿ-pêng, ēng tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú-kut kā hái-chúi pun-chòe nn̄g pêng, ūi ka-kī kiàn-li̍p éng-oán ê miâ ê Siōng Chú tī tó-ūi?
Hit-ūi chhōa I ê chú-bîn kè chhim-hái, hō͘ in chhin-chhiūⁿ bé tī khòng-iá teh cháu bōe poa̍h-tó ê Siōng Chú tī tó-ūi?”
Siōng Chú ê sîn hō͘ I ê chú-bîn tit-tio̍h an-hioh, chhin-chhiūⁿ gû-kûn lo̍h-khì soaⁿ-kok; lí chiū-sī án-ni ín-chhōa lí ê chú-bîn, ūi ka-kī kiàn-li̍p êng-iāu ê miâ.

Kiû lí tùi thiⁿ-téng àⁿ lo̍h-lâi khòaⁿ, tùi lí sèng koh êng-iāu ê só͘-chāi khòaⁿ. Lí ê jia̍t-sêng kap lí ê khùi-la̍t tī tó-ūi? Lí jia̍t-chêng ê thiàⁿ kap lîn-bín tī tó-ūi? M̄-thang m̄ chhap goán!

Sui-jiân A-pek-la-hán m̄ bat goán, Ngá-kok m̄ sêng-jīn goán, m̄-kú lí sī goán ê lāu-pē. Siōng Chú ah, lí sī goán ê lāu-pē; tùi kó͘-chá lí ê chheng-ho͘ sī “goán ê Kiù-sio̍k-chú”.

Siōng Chú ah, sī-án-chóaⁿ lí hō͘ goán phian-lī lí ê tō-lō͘? Sī-án-chóaⁿ hō͘ goán ngī-sim m̄ kèng-ùi lí? In-ūi lí po̍k-jîn ê iân-kò͘, kiû lí hôe-sim-tńg-ì; ūi-tio̍h lí ê chú-bîn, lí ê sán-gia̍p, kiû lí tńg--lâi!
Lí sèng ê chú-bîn put-kò chiām-sî tit-tio̍h lí èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe, m̄-kú goán ê tùi-te̍k í-keng thún-ta̍h lí ê sèng-só͘.
Goán ká-ná m̄-bat siū lí thóng-tī, ká-ná m̄-bat chòe lí ê chú-bîn.
Lí ná m̄ thiah-li̍h thiⁿ kàng--lo̍h-lâi? Lí chi̍t-ē chhut-hiān chèng-soaⁿ chiū iô-tāng,
chhin-chhiūⁿ hé tiám-to̍h ta-chhâ, chhin-chhiūⁿ hé kā chúi hiâⁿ-kún. Goān te̍k-jîn bat lí ê miâ, bān-kok tī lí ê bīn-chêng phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.
Lí bat chòe goán liāu-sióng bōe kàu, thang kiaⁿ-ùi ê tāi-chì, hit-sî lí kàng-lîm, chèng-soaⁿ lóng iô-choah.
Tùi kó͘-chá í-lâi, lâng m̄-bat thiaⁿ--kè, hī-khang m̄-bat thiaⁿ--tio̍h, ba̍k-chiu mā m̄-bat khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí í-gōa ū Siōng-tè ōe-tàng ūi-tio̍h thèng-hāu I ê lâng chòe tāi-chì.

Lí hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t ê lâng, chiū-sī hiah-ê ōe-kì-tit lí, chun-thàn lí tō-lō͘ ê lâng. M̄-kú lí siū-khì, in-ūi goán hoān-chōe; chit-khoán chêng-hêng í-keng chin kú, goán ná ōe tit-kiù?

Goán chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t ê bô chheng-khì ê lâng; goán it-chhè gī ê hêng-ûi chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t niá lah-sap saⁿ. Goán lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū-hio̍h lian--khì, goán ê chōe-kò chhin-chhiūⁿ hong kā goán chhe cháu.
Bô lâng kiû-kiò lí ê miâ, bô lâng kā lí khiú-tiâu-tiâu; in-ūi lí bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ khòaⁿ goán, chiong goán pàng hō͘ goán ê chōe koán-hat.
M̄-kú, Siōng Chú ah, lí iû-goân sī goán ê Lāu-pē. Goán sī liâm-thô͘, lí sī sio-hûi sai-hū; goán lóng sī lí chhin-chhiú chō--ê.
Siōng Chú ah, m̄-thang tùi goán hoat tōa siū-khì; m̄-thang éng-oán kì-tiâu goán ê chōe-kò. Khòaⁿ leh, goán lóng sī lí ê chú-bîn, kiû lí khòaⁿ-kò͘.
Lí sèng ê siâⁿ-chhī í-keng pìⁿ-chòe khòng-iá; Sek-an í-keng pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng í-keng hong-hòe.
Goán sîn-sèng koh súi ê tiān, goán ê chó͘-sian chheng-chàn lí ê só͘-chāi, lóng hō͘ hé sio-liáu-liáu; goán him-bō͘ ê hó só͘-chāi lóng húi-hoāi lah.
Siōng Chú ah, keng-kè chiah-ê tāi-chì, lí kiám iáu jím ōe tiâu? Lí kiám ōe tìⁿ-tiām-tiām, hō͘ goán siū tōa khó͘-lān?

Siōng Chú kóng: Bô tui-kiû góa--ê, góa beh hō͘ in chhē--tio̍h. Bô chhē góa--ê, góa beh hō͘ in tú--tio̍h. Góa tùi bô kiû-kiò góa ê miâ ê kok-ka kóng, “Góa tī chia, góa tī chia!”
Góa kui-ji̍t chhun-chhiú thèng-hāu pōe-ge̍k ê chú-bîn; in chiàu ka-kī ê siâ-liām kiâⁿ pháiⁿ-lō͘.
Chiah-ê jîn-bîn tng góa ê bīn it-ti̍t jiá góa siū-khì, tī hn̂g-lāi tùi ngó͘-siōng hiàn-chè, tī tôaⁿ-téng kā sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ.
In ēng bōng-khòng-khang chòe bîn-chhn̂g, tī chio̍h-tōng lāi kè-mî. In chia̍h ti-bah, kui-tiáⁿ lóng sī bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h chú ê thng.
In kóng, “Siám-khui, m̄-thang óa--lâi! Góa sîn-sèng, bōe-kha̍p--tit.” Chiah-ê lâng hō͘ góa phīⁿ-khang chhèng-ian, kui-ji̍t kui pak-tó͘ hé.
Khòaⁿ leh, chiah-ê góa lóng í-keng siá--khí-lâi; góa it-tēng bōe tiām-tiām, góa beh pò-èng, thiat-tóe kā in pò-èng;

in-ūi in kap in ê lia̍t-chó͘ hoān kâng-khoán ê chōe, tī soaⁿ-téng sio-hiuⁿ, tī soaⁿ-lûn-á siat-to̍k góa. Góa beh chiàu in èng-tit--ê kā in pò-èng, chiàu in ê hêng-ûi hêng-hoa̍t in. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lâng chhē-tio̍h kui-pha phû-tô ōe-tàng chòe sin-chiú, i ōe kóng, “M̄-thang kā i húi-hoāi, in-ūi lāi-bīn ū chiok-hok.” Só͘-í, ūi-tio̍h góa ê po̍k-jîn ê iân-kò͘, góa bōe kā in choân-pō͘ siau-bia̍t.

Góa beh hō͘ Ngá-kok ū hō͘-tāi, tùi Iû-tāi chhut kiáⁿ-sun kè-sêng góa ê chèng-soaⁿ; góa kéng-soán ê chú-bîn ōe sêng-chiap chit-tè thó͘-tōe, góa ê po̍k-jîn ōe tī hia khiā-khí.
Sa-lûn pêng-goân ōe pìⁿ-chòe iûⁿ-kûn ê bo̍k-tiûⁿ, A-kat Soaⁿ-kok pìⁿ-chòe gû-kûn hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi. Chiah-ê lóng beh sù hō͘ chhē-kiû góa ê chú-bîn.
M̄-kú, lín chiah-ê pàng-sak Siōng Chú ê lâng, lín bōe-kì-tit góa ê sèng-soaⁿ Sek-an, ūi-tio̍h “Hó-ūn ê sîn” pān-toh, koh ūi-tio̍h “Miā-ūn ê sîn” tò-móa tiâu-hô ê chiú.

Góa it-tēng beh hō͘ lín sí tī to-ē, hō͘ lín kūi-teh siū thâi-sí; in-ūi góa kiò, lín m̄ ìn, góa kóng, lín m̄ thiaⁿ. Lín tian-tò chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê tāi-chì, ì-ài góa bô ài ê sū.

Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa ê po̍k-jîn it-tēng ū thang chia̍h, m̄-kú lín ōe iau-gō; góa ê po̍k-jîn ū thang lim, m̄-kú lín ōe chhùi-ta; góa ê po̍k-jîn ōe hoaⁿ-hí, m̄-kú lín ōe kiàn-siàu;
góa ê po̍k-jîn ōe hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa, m̄-kú lín ōe iu-siong ai-khàu, in-ūi sim-sîn iu-khó͘ tōa-siaⁿ háu.
Lín ê miâ ōe lâu--teh, hō͘ góa ê soán-bîn ēng lâi chiù-chó͘. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ōe kā lín siau-bia̍t, m̄-kú ōe hō͘ I ê po̍k-jîn lēng-gōa chi̍t ê miâ.

Án-ni, só͘-ū tī chit-ê tōe ūi ka-kī kiû hok-khì ê lâng, ōe tùi sìn-si̍t ê Siōng-tè tit-tio̍h hok-khì; só͘-ū tī chit-ê tōe chiù-chōa ê lâng, ōe kí sìn-si̍t ê Siōng-tè chiù-chōa; in-ūi chá-chêng ê hoān-lān ōe hō͘ lâng bōe-kì--tit, ōe tùi góa ê ba̍k-chiu chêng siau-sit.
Siōng Chú kóng: Lín khòaⁿ, góa beh chhòng-chō sin ê thiⁿ, sin ê tōe; kè-khì ê tāi-chì lâng bōe koh kì--tit, bōe koh hoâi-liām.

Lín tio̍h in-ūi góa teh chhòng-chō ê it-chhè éng-oán hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, ūi-tio̍h góa beh chhòng-chō ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chhiong-móa hoaⁿ-hí, ūi-tio̍h siâⁿ-lāi ê chū-bîn chhiong-móa khoài-lo̍k.
Góa in-ūi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lâi hoaⁿ-hí, beh in-ūi góa ê chú-bîn lâi khoài-lo̍k. Siâⁿ-lāi bōe koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h thî-khàu ê siaⁿ, mā bōe koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ ai-khàu ê siaⁿ.

Tī hia bōe koh ū kan-ta oa̍h kúi-ji̍t-á ê eⁿ-á, mā bōe ū hè-siū bē móa chiū sí ê lāu-lâng. Chia̍h chi̍t-pah-hè sí--khì-ê, lâng mā siūⁿ-kóng i iáu siàu-liân; chia̍h bô-kàu chi̍t-pah-hè--ê, lâng ōe siūⁿ-kóng i sī siū chiù-chó͘.
In ōe khí-chhù, ka-kī tòa tī lāi-bīn; in ōe chai-chèng phû-tô-hn̂g, chia̍h hn̂g--ni̍h ê ké-chí.

In khí-chhù, bōe hō͘ pa̍t-lâng chiàm-khì tòa; in chai-chèng, bōe hō͘ pa̍t-lâng chhiúⁿ-khì chia̍h. Chhiū oa̍h jōa kú, góa ê chú-bîn mā ōe oa̍h hiah kú; góa ê soán-bîn ōe kú-tn̂g hióng-siū lô-khó͘ tit--lâi ê sêng-kó.
In ê lô-lo̍k bōe lo̍k-khong, in siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-jî bōe tú-tio̍h chai-lān; in-ūi in sī Siōng Chú sù-hok ê lâng ê kiáⁿ-sun, in ê hō͘-tāi mā-sī án-ni.
In iáu-bē kiû-kiò, góa chiū èng-ún; in iáu-teh kóng, góa chiū ìn-tap.

Chhâi-lông kap iûⁿ-ko ōe chòe-hé chia̍h, sai ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ gû chia̍h-chháu; chôa ê chia̍h-mi̍h iáu-kú sī thô͘-hún! Tī góa sèng-soaⁿ ê ta̍k só͘-chāi, it-tēng bô ū siong-hāi, mā bô phò-hoāi. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Thiⁿ sī góa ê chō-ūi; tōe sī góa ê kha-tiam. Lín beh tī tó-ūi ūi-tio̍h góa khí kiong-tiān? Tó-ūi ōe-tàng chòe góa an-hioh ê só͘-chāi?

Chiah-ê it-chhè sī góa ê chhiú só͘ chō, só͘-í, chiah-ê lóng sī góa--ê. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘. Góa beh khòaⁿ-kò͘--ê sī khùn-khó͘, sim-lêng thòng-hóe, thiaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê ōe chiū kiaⁿ-ùi ê lâng.

Thâi gû hiàn chòe chè, mā thâi lâng; hiàn iûⁿ-ko, mā kòng-tn̄g káu ê ām-kún; hiàn sò͘-chè, mā hiàn ti ê huih; sio jú-hiuⁿ, mā chàn-bí ngó͘-siōng; chit-khoán lâng í-keng soán-tēng ka-kī ê lō͘, in ê sim ì-ài thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.

Só͘-í, góa soán-tēng beh ge̍k-thāi in, hō͘ kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ê tāi-chì lîm-kàu in. In-ūi góa kiò, bô lâng ìn; góa kóng, in m̄ thiaⁿ. In tian-tò chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe siâ-ok ê sū, soán-te̍k góa bô hoaⁿ-hí ê tāi-chì.

Thiaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú ê ōe chiū kiaⁿ-ùi ê lâng, lín tio̍h thiaⁿ I ê ōe. I kóng: Lín ka-kī ê hiaⁿ-tī oàn-hūn lín, in-ūi góa ê miâ ê iân-kò͘ khì-sak lín. In kóng, “Goān Siōng Chú tit-tio̍h êng-iāu, hō͘ goán thang khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lín ê hoaⁿ-hí.” Kî-si̍t, in chiah sī eng-kai siū lêng-jio̍k--ê.
Thiaⁿ leh, siâⁿ-lāi ū soan-hoa ê siaⁿ! Tùi sèng-tiān ū siaⁿ hoat-chhut! Che sī Siōng Chú teh pò-èng I te̍k-jîn ê siaⁿ!
Sèng-siâⁿ iáu-bē thàng-thiàⁿ chiū seng-sán; Sek-an iáu-bē chhui-chūn chiū siⁿ-kiáⁿ.

Siáⁿ-lâng bat thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-khoán sū? Siáⁿ-lâng bat khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chiah-ê tāi-chì? Kiám ū kok-ka tī chi̍t ji̍t lāi chiū sán-seng? Kiám ū bîn-cho̍k tī chi̍t-ba̍k-nih-kú chiū siⁿ--chhut-lâi? M̄-kú Sek-an chi̍t-ē khai-sí chhui-chūn, kiáⁿ-jî chiū chhut-sì.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa kì-jiân hō͘ lâng lîm-phûn, kiám ōe bô hō͘ eⁿ-á siⁿ--chhut-lâi? Lí ê Siōng-tè án-ni mn̄g: Góa sī hō͘ eⁿ-á chhut-sì--ê, kiám ōe kā bú-thai koaiⁿ--khí-lâi?

Lín chiah-ê thiàⁿ-sioh Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng, tio̍h kap i chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí, ūi-tio̍h i khoài-lo̍k. Lín chiah-ê ūi-tio̍h i pi-siong ê lâng, tio̍h kap i chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí khèng-chiok.
Lín thang tī i ê heng-chêng suh-lin tit-tio̍h boán-chiok, tit-tio̍h an-ùi; tùi i chhiong-chiok ê lin tit-tio̍h iúⁿ-chhī lâi hoaⁿ-hí.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hoân-êng, chhin-chhiūⁿ hô-liû ti̍t-ti̍t lâu; góa beh hō͘ bān-kok ê châi-hù chhin-chhiūⁿ khoe-chúi kā lí im-móa. Góa ōe kā lí phō tī heng-chêng hō͘ lí suh-lin, tī kha-thâu-u téng kap lí sńg, kā lí lāng.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ lāu-bú an-ùi i ê kiáⁿ, góa mā beh an-ùi lín; lín ōe tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tit-tio̍h an-ùi.

Lín ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, sim chiū hoaⁿ-hí; chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu tit-tio̍h lūn-te̍k bō͘-sēng, lín ōe ná ióng-chòng. Lâng lóng ōe chai, góa Siōng Chú ê khùi-la̍t kap ho̍k-sāi góa ê lâng tông-chāi; góa ê siū-khì ōe tùi góa ê te̍k-jîn hoat-chhut.”

Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú tī hé-tiong lâi-lîm, I ê chiàn-chhia chhin-chhiūⁿ kńg-lê-á-hong sàu--lâi; I tī tōa siū-khì tiong si-hêng I ê pò-èng, tī hé-tiong chip-hêng I ê hêng-hoa̍t.
Siōng Chú beh ēng hé kap to sím-phòaⁿ choân jîn-lūi; chin chōe lâng ōe hō͘ Siōng Chú chhú-sí.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Hiah-ê chiàu īⁿ-kàu ê gî-sek sèng-pia̍t ka-kī, kiat-chēng ka-kī, tè lâng ji̍p-khì hn̂g-lāi pài ngó͘-siōng, chia̍h ti-bah, niáu-chhú, thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê mi̍h ê lâng, lóng ōe chòe-chi̍t-ē bia̍t-bông.
“Góa chai in ê chok-ûi kap ì-liām. Góa beh lâi lah, beh chiong bān-kok í-ki̍p kóng ta̍k-chióng gú-giân ê lâng lóng chi̍p óa--lâi; in ōe lâi, ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê êng-kng.

Góa beh tī in tiong-kan chhāi chi̍t ê kì-hō, koh tùi in tiong-kan chhe tô-thoat ê lâng khì lia̍t-kok, chiū-sī Tha-si, Lī-pí-a, gâu siā-chìⁿ ê Lū-tí-a, Thó͘-pa, Hi-la̍h, koh kàu iáu m̄-bat thiaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê miâ, m̄-bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê êng-kng hiah-ê hn̄g-hn̄g ê hái-tó. In beh tī lia̍t-kok thoân-pò góa ê êng-kng.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: In beh tùi lia̍t-kok chiong lín ê tông-pau chhōa--tò-lâi; ū-ê khiâ-bé, ū-ê chē chiàn-chhia, bé-chhia, ū-ê khiâ lô, lo̍k-tô, lâi góa ê sèng-soaⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chòe lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú; tú chhin-chhiūⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ēng chheng-khì ê khì-khū tóe chè-mi̍h hiàn tī Siōng Chú ê tiān.
Góa mā beh chí-tēng in tiong-kan chi̍t-kóa lâng chòe chè-si, chòe Lī-bī -lâng.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú kóng: Góa beh chō ê sin-thiⁿ-sin-tōe ōe chiàu góa ê chí-ì kú-tn̂g chûn-chāi; lín ê hō͘-tāi kap lín ê miâ mā ōe án-ni kú-tn̂g chûn-chāi.
Múi ge̍h ê chhoe-it kap ta̍k-ê An-hioh-ji̍t, só͘-ū ê lâng lóng ōe lâi góa bīn-chêng kèng-pài góa. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Kèng-pài góa ê lâng chhut--khì, ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ pōe-poān góa ê lâng ê si-thé; chia̍h hiah-ê si-thé ê chiù-thâng bōe sí, sio in ê hé bōe hoa; só͘-ū ê lâng lóng ōe iàm-ò͘ⁿ in.
Chit-pún chheh sī Iâ-lī-bí ê giân-hêng-lio̍k. Iâ-lī-bí sī Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu, A-ná-tu̍t -siâⁿ chi̍t ê chè-si Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ.
A-bûn ê kiáⁿ Iok-se-a chòe Iû-tāi -ông tē-cha̍p-saⁿ nî, Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Iâ-lī-bí.

Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kèng chòe Iû-tāi -ông kî-kan, kàu Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Se-tí-ka chòe Iû-tāi -ông chòe-āu chi̍t nî, tē-cha̍p-it nî gō͘--ge̍h, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn siū-lia̍h khì Pa-pí-lûn ê sî, Siōng Chú siông-siông tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng-ōe.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Góa iáu-bē hō͘ lí tī bú-thai chiâⁿ-hêng í-chêng, í-keng kéng lí; lí iáu-bē siⁿ--chhut-lâi í-chêng, chiū kā lí hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, soán-li̍p lí chòe lia̍t-kok ê sian-ti.”
Góa ìn kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, lí chai, góa iáu siàu-liân, koh han-bān kóng-ōe.”
M̄-kú Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Lí m̄-thang kóng lí siàu-liân. Góa kā lí phài-khì tó-ūi, lí tio̍h khì; kiò lí kóng sím-mi̍h, lí tio̍h kóng.
Lí m̄-bián kiaⁿ in, in-ūi góa kap lí tông-chāi, beh pó-hō͘ lí. Góa Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘!”
Siōng Chú chiū chhun-chhiú bong góa ê chhùi, tùi góa kóng, “Hiān-chāi, góa chiong góa ê ōe hē tī lí ê chhùi--ni̍h.
Góa kin-á-ji̍t siū-koân hō͘ lí, hō͘ lí tī lia̍t-kok bān-bîn chòe pu̍ih-chhut kap thiah-húi, phò-hoāi kap thui-hoan, tiông-kiàn kap chai-chèng ê kang-chok.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “ Iâ-lī-bí, lí ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sím-mi̍h?” Góa ìn kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ki hēng-chhiū ê chhiū-ki.”
Siōng Chú chiū kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ-liáu tio̍h, góa put-sî kéng-kak, beh hō͘ góa ê ōe si̍t-hiān.”
Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng, “Lí ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sím-mi̍h?” Góa kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê teh kún ê e-á, tùi pak-pêng piàⁿ--lo̍h-lâi.”
I tùi góa kóng, “Beh ū chai-lān tùi pak-pêng hoat-chhut, lîm-kàu chit-ê tōe só͘-ū ê chū-bîn.

Góa beh kā pak-hng lia̍t-kok só͘-ū ê lâng tiàu-chi̍p--lâi, hō͘ in tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu siat pó-chō, ûi-kong siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ; koh beh kong-kek Iû-tāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-tìn.
Chiah-ê jîn-bîn khì-sak góa, khì kā pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ, kūi-pài ka-kī ê chhiú chō ê ngó͘-siōng; góa beh in-ūi in ê chōe kā in sím-phòaⁿ, kā in hêng-hoa̍t.

Só͘-í, Iâ-lī-bí, lí tio̍h chún-pī hó-sè, chiong góa bēng-lēng lí kóng ê ōe lóng kā in kóng; m̄-thang in-ūi in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, chiah bián góa hō͘ lí tī in ê bīn-chêng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.

Lí tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, góa kin-á-ji̍t beh hō͘ lí chiâⁿ-chòe kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, chiâⁿ-chòe tâng-chhiûⁿ thih-piah, ōe-tàng tùi-khòng choân-kok, tùi-khòng Iû-tāi ê ông, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, chè-si, kap jîn-bîn.
In ōe kong-kek lí, m̄-kú bōe iâⁿ lí; in-ūi góa kap lí tông-chāi, beh pó-hō͘ lí. Góa Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘!”
Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu góa, kóng,

“Tio̍h tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng tōa-siaⁿ hoah kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa ōe-kì-tit lí siàu-liân ê sî ê ài-chêng, sin-hun ê sî ê un-ài; tī khòng-iá, tī m̄-bat chèng-choh ê tōe, lí kā góa tè-tiâu-tiâu.
Í-sek-lia̍t sī Siōng Chú sèng ê chú-bîn, sī Siōng Chú chho͘-se̍k ê ké-chí; só͘-ū thun-chia̍h i--ê lóng ū chōe, chai-hō ōe lîm-kàu in. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘!’”
Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi, Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lín ê chó͘-sian kiám bat hoat-kiàn góa ū sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h, kèng-jiân lī-khui góa hn̄g-hn̄g, khì kun-tè hu-bû ê sîn-bêng, ka-kī soah chiâⁿ-chòe hu-bû.

In bô mn̄g: Hit-ê chhōa goán chhut Ai-ki̍p, chhōa goán keng-kè khòng-iá kap khi-khu ê soa-bô͘, keng-kè ta-sò kap o͘-àm ê só͘-chāi, bô lâng kiâⁿ--kè, bô lâng tòa ê tōe, hit-ūi Siōng Chú tī tó-ūi?

Góa chhōa lín chìn-ji̍p pûi koh súi ê tōe, hō͘ lín chia̍h lāi-bīn ê ké-chí kap hó ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ; lín chi̍t-ē ji̍p--lâi, chiū sńg-tn̄g góa ê thó͘-tōe, ù-jiám góa sù hō͘ lín ê sán-gia̍p.
Chè-si m̄-bat mn̄g “Siōng Chú tī tó-ūi”, kà lu̍t-hoat--ê tìⁿ m̄ bat góa, koaⁿ-oân ngó͘-ge̍k góa; sian-ti hōng Pa-le̍k ê miâ thoân sìn-sit, tè bô lō͘-ēng ê sîn-bêng.
Só͘-í, góa Siōng Chú kóng: Góa beh khòng-kò lín, beh kap lín ê hō͘-tāi cheng-piān.
Lín tio̍h khì sai-pêng ê Ki-thê chiah-ê tó khòaⁿ, khì tang-pêng ê Ki-ta̍t tiâu-cha, khòaⁿ in kiám bat chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì.
Ū tó chi̍t kok bat ōaⁿ-kè in ê sîn-bêng? Kî-si̍t hiah-ê lóng m̄-sī sîn. M̄-kú góa ê chú-bîn chiong in êng-kng ê Siōng-tè ōaⁿ chòe bô lō͘-ēng ê sîn-bêng.
Thiⁿ ah, lín kiám bōe in-ūi án-ni tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kiám bōe in-ūi án-ni kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah? Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Góa ê chú-bîn chòe siang-têng ê pháiⁿ tāi-chì: In pàng-sak góa chit-ê oa̍h-chúi ê goân-thâu, khì ó͘ chi̍t ê bōe chek-chúi ê chúi-tî.
Í-sek-lia̍t kiám sī lô͘-lē? Kiám chhut-sì chiū chòe lâng ê lô͘-châi? Ná ōe chiâⁿ-chòe la̍h-bu̍t?
Tùi-te̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ siàu-chòng ê sai ǹg i hm̄-hm̄-háu, tùi i tōa-siaⁿ hoah. In hō͘ i ê tōe hong-hòe, hō͘ i ê siâⁿ húi-hoāi, bô lâng tòa.
Ai-ki̍p ê Bēng-húi-su -lâng kap Tap-pí-le̍k -lâng thì-kng lí ê thâu-khak.
Che kiám m̄-sī lí ka-kī jiá--lâi-ê? Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè chhōa lí kiâⁿ-lō͘ ê sî, lí pàng-sak I.
Taⁿ, lí khì Ai-ki̍p lim Nî-lô-hô ê chúi kiám ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h lī-ek? Lí khì A-su̍t lim Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô ê chúi kiám ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h hó-chhù?

Lí ka-kī ê chōe-ok beh hêng-hoa̍t lí; lí ka-kī ê put-tiong beh khòng-kò lí. Án-ni, lí chiū ōe chheng-chhó bêng-pe̍k: Pàng-sak Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè, bô kiaⁿ-ùi góa, sī jōa-á-ni̍h siâ-ok, jōa-á-ni̍h put-hēng. Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.

Lí tùi kó͘-chá chiū kòng-tn̄g lí ê taⁿ, tháu-khui lí ê soh, kóng “Góa m̄ ho̍k-sāi lí”. Lí tī ta̍k-ê soaⁿ-lûn-á, tī ta̍k-châng chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū ē-bīn, chhin-chhiūⁿ ki-lú tó--teh.
Lí goân-lâi sī góa chai-chèng te̍k-soán ê phû-tô-chhiū, sī sûn-chéng ê phû-tô-chhiū, kèng-jiân kā góa pìⁿ-chòe iá-chéng ê bái chhiū-ki.
Lí ēng kiⁿ, ēng chin chōe sat-bûn sóe, m̄-kú góa iáu khòaⁿ ōe chhut lí chōe-ok ê hûn-jiah. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Lí ná ōe kóng “Góa bô phah lâ-sâm ka-kī, bô khì tè Pa-le̍k”? Lí khòaⁿ lí tī soaⁿ-kok tiong ê hêng-ûi, chiū chai ka-kī ê só͘-chòe, ká-ná gâu cháu ê tan-hong lo̍k-tô-bú, sì-kòe loān-chông.

Lí koh chhin-chhiūⁿ koàn-sì tòa tī khòng-iá ê iá-lû-bú, io̍k-hé-kong-sim ê sî chiū phi̍hⁿ-phe̍hⁿ-chhoán, siáu ê sî, siáⁿ-lâng kā i khòng-chè ōe tiâu? Kang ê lû-á chin kín chiū ōe-tàng chhē-tio̍h i; kau-phòe ê kùi-choeh, it-tēng chhē i ōe tio̍h.

Lí m̄-thang tè lâng cháu kah ôe phòa--khì, m̄-thang hèng kah nâ-âu ta; lí kèng-jiân kóng, “Bô-chhái-kang lah, bô hoat-tō͘ lah! Góa to ài-tio̍h siⁿ-hūn-lâng, góa beh tè in cháu.”
Chha̍t-á hō͘ lâng lia̍h--tio̍h, ōe án-chóaⁿ kiàn-siàu, Í-sek-lia̍t -ke, pau-koat in ê ông, in ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, chè-si, kap sian-ti, mā ōe án-ni kiàn-siàu.

In tùi chhâ-thâu kóng “Lí sī góa ê lāu-pē”, tùi chio̍h-thâu kóng “Lí sī góa ê lāu-bú”. In ka-chiah-phiaⁿ ǹg góa, m̄-khéng bīn khòaⁿ góa; kàu tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê sî, chiah kā góa kóng, “Kiû lí lâi kái-kiù goán!”
Lín ūi ka-kī chō ê sîn-bêng tī tó-ūi? Lín tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê sî, kiò in khí-lâi kiù lín! Iû-tāi ah, lín ê sîn-bêng chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ê siâⁿ-tìn hiah chōe!
Lín ná beh kap góa cheng-piān? Lín lóng pōe-poān góa. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Bô-chhái góa teh tok-chek lín ê kiáⁿ-jî, in lóng m̄-khéng siū koán-kàu. Lín ēng to thâi-sí sian-ti, chhin-chhiūⁿ hiong-béng ê sai teh thun-chia̍h.

Lín chit sè-tāi ê lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe! Tùi lín Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lâi kóng, góa kiám chhin-chhiūⁿ khòng-iá, á-sī o͘-àm gûi-hiám ê tōe? Góa ê Chú-bîn ná ōe kóng “Goán chū-iû lah, bô beh koh tńg-lâi lí chia”?
Siàu-liân ê lú-chú kiám ōe bōe-kì-tit i ê chu-pó? Sin-niû kiám ōe bōe-kì-tit ka-kī ê sin-niû-saⁿ? M̄-kú góa ê chú-bîn m̄-chai jōa kú í-chêng chiū bōe-kì-tit góa.
Lín chiah gâu chhē ài-jîn, liân siōng-pháiⁿ ê cha-bó͘ mā tio̍h kā lí chhéng-kàu.
Lín ê saⁿ-á-ku ū bû-ko͘, sàn-chhiah-lâng ê huih, kî-si̍t in pèng bô thau-the̍h lín chhù-lāi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ. Sui-jiân lín chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì,
lín iáu kóng, “Góa bô chōe! Siōng Chú í-keng kā góa sià-bián lah.” Tio̍h chai, góa it-tēng ōe sím-mn̄g lín, in-ūi lín bô beh sêng-jīn ka-kī ê chōe.
Lín ná chông-lâi-chông-khì, put-sî teh kái-piàn lō͘-hiòng? Lín tâu-khò Ai-ki̍p, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng óa-khò A-su̍t án-ni chū-chhú-kiàn-siàu.

Lín it-tēng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hu-ló͘, siang-chhiú mo͘h thâu-khak lī-khui Ai-ki̍p, in-ūi Siōng Chú í-keng khì-sak lín só͘ óa-khò--ê; lín bōe-tàng in-ūi tâu-khò in tit-tio̍h lī-ek.

“Nā ū lâng kā i ê bó͘ lî-hun, i ê bó͘ lī-khui i khì kè pa̍t-lâng, i kiám thang koh tò-khì chhē chit-ê chêng-bó͘? I nā án-ni chòe, chiū-sī phah lâ-sâm chit-tè thó͘-tōe.” Siōng Chú kóng: Lí í-keng kap chin chōe ài-jîn kiâⁿ-îm, iáu siūⁿ-beh tò-lâi góa chia sī--bô?

Lí tio̍h gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ chhiū-á í-keng chhò-liáu-liáu ê soaⁿ-lûn-á, iáu ū tó-ūi m̄-sī lí kiâⁿ-îm--kè ê só͘-chāi? Lí tī lō͘-piⁿ teh thèng-hāu ài-jîn, chhin-chhiūⁿ kiông-tō tī khòng-iá bâi-ho̍k tng-tán; lí ê îm-loān kap siâ-ok ù-jiám choân-tōe.
In-ūi án-ni, hō͘-chúi thêng-chí, chhun-ú bô lo̍h. Lí iáu bīn-tài-thô-hoe, m̄-chai kiàn-siàu.
Lí tú-chiah chiah tùi góa kiò kóng, “A-pa, tùi góa sòe-hàn lí chiū thiàⁿ góa.
Lâng kiám ōe it-ti̍t siū-khì, éng-oán khioh-hūn?” Lí sui-jiân án-ni kóng, m̄-kú iáu piàⁿ-sì teh chòe pháiⁿ.

Iok-se-a thóng-tī Iû-tāi ê sî, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Lí ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ pōe-poān ê Í-sek-lia̍t ê só͘-chòe--bô? I chiūⁿ koân-soaⁿ, tī ta̍k-châng chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū ē-bīn kiâⁿ-îm.
Góa siūⁿ-kóng i chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, ōe tò-tńg-lâi góa chia, m̄-kú i bô tńg--lâi; i put-cheng ê sió-bē Iû-tāi mā ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h i án-ni chòe.
Pōe-poān ê Í-sek-lia̍t îm-loān, só͘-í góa hō͘ i lî-hun-su; i put-cheng ê sió-bē Iû-tāi lóng m̄ kiaⁿ, mā khì kiâⁿ-îm.
Í-sek-lia̍t kā kiâⁿ-îm khòaⁿ-chòe bô iàu-kín, khì pài chhâ-thâu kap chio̍h-thâu, chiū kā chit-ê thó͘-tōe phah lâ-sâm.
Sui-jiân hoat-seng chiah-ê tāi-chì, i put-cheng ê sió-bē Iû-tāi iáu ké-ì kui-ǹg góa, bô beh chin-sim tńg-lâi góa chia. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng, “Pōe-poān ê Í-sek-lia̍t pí put-cheng ê Iû-tāi iáu khah hó.

Lí tio̍h khì kā tī pak-hng ê lâng kóng: Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò, ‘Pōe-poān ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tio̍h tńg--lâi! Góa bōe tùi lín pìⁿ-bīn, bōe éng-oán tùi lín siū-khì, in-ūi góa tùi lín ê thiàⁿ éng-oán bōe kái-piàn.

Lín tio̍h jīn-chōe, in-ūi lín ū ûi-pōe Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, tī chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū ē-bīn tui-jip gōa-cho̍k ê sîn-bêng, bô beh thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe! Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

“‘Pōe-ge̍k ê kiáⁿ-jî, tio̍h tńg--lâi! Siōng Chú án-ni kóng. Góa chiah sī lín ê chú-lâng; góa beh tùi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ soán chi̍t ê lâng, ta̍k-cho̍k soán nn̄g ê lâng, kā lín chhōa tò-lâi Sek-an.
Góa beh chiong ha̍h góa sim-ì ê thóng-tī-chiá sù hō͘ lín; in ōe ēng tì-sek kap chhek-lio̍k tī-lí lín.

Lín tī chit-tè thó͘-tōe jîn-kháu tōa-tōa ke-thiⁿ ê sî, lâng bōe koh kóng-khí Siōng Chú ê iok-kūi, bōe koh siàu-liām, bōe koh kì--tit; in bô su-iàu iok-kūi, bōe koh chè-chō. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Hit-sî, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe hō͘ lâng chheng-chòe Siōng Chú ê pó-chō; bān-kok bān-bîn ūi-tio̍h beh ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú, lóng beh chū-chi̍p lâi hia; in bōe koh chiàu ka-kī siâ-ok kò͘-chip ê sim chòe tāi-chì.
Hit-sî, Iû-tāi -ke beh kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ke liân-ha̍p, tùi pak-hng chòe-hé tò-lâi góa sù hō͘ lín chó͘-sian chòe sán-gia̍p ê thó͘-tōe.’”

Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa jōa-á-ni̍h ài kā lí tòng-chòe ka-kī ê kiáⁿ tùi-thāi, chiong sè-kài siōng-hó ê thó͘-tōe sù lí chòe sán-gia̍p. Góa siūⁿ-kóng lí ōe kiò góa ‘A-pa’, bōe koh oa̍t-cháu m̄ tè góa.
M̄-kú, Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lín kèng-jiân pōe-poān góa, chhin-chhiūⁿ hū-jîn-lâng pōe-poān tiōng-hu lī-khui i. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Tī chhiū-á chhò-liáu-liáu ê soaⁿ-lûn-á ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ siaⁿ, sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng teh háu, teh kî-kiû ê siaⁿ, in-ūi in kiâⁿ oan-khiau ê lō͘, kā Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè pàng bōe-kì--tit.

Lín chiah-ê pōe-ge̍k ê kiáⁿ-jî, tò--lâi ah! Góa beh i-hó lín pōe-ge̍k ê pīⁿ. “Lín kóng, ‘Goán tī chia, goán tńg-lâi lí chia lah, in-ūi lí sī Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè.
Tī sió-soaⁿ lāu-jia̍t kap tōa-soaⁿ chháu-nāu ê pài-pài, lóng bô lō͘-ēng, chí-ū Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè chiah ōe-tàng kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t.
Goán tùi siàu-liân chiū teh pài ê sîn-bêng, hāi goán sit-khì chó͘-sian lô-khó͘ tit--tio̍h ê gû-kûn, iûⁿ-kûn, hāu-siⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.

Goán sêng-jīn ka-kī ê kiàn-siàu, sêng-tam eng-kai siū ê lêng-jio̍k, in-ūi goán tùi siàu-liân kàu taⁿ tek-chōe Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè. Goán kap goán ê chó͘-sian lóng bô thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ê ōe.’”
Siōng Chú kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí nā oa̍t tò-tńg, tò-tńg-lâi góa chia, chiong chiah-ê thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng tû-tiāu, bô koh sam-sim-lióng-ì,
lí nā chiàu chin-sêng, kong-pêng, chèng-ti̍t kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, lia̍t-kok chiū beh tit-tio̍h góa ê chiok-hok, koh khoa-iāu góa.”
Siōng Chú kā Iû-tāi -lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kóng, “Lín tio̍h khai-khún iáu-bē lôe--kè ê hn̂g, m̄-thang iā-chéng tī chhì-phè lāi-bīn.

Iû-tāi -lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h kā lín ê sim kiâⁿ kat-lé kui-sio̍k Siōng Chú, tû-khì lín lāi-sim ê lâ-sâm, chiah bián góa in-ūi lín ê pháiⁿ hêng-ûi hoat siū-khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ hé to̍h--khí-lâi, bô lâng ōe-tàng phah-hoa.”
Lín tio̍h tī Iû-tāi soan-kò, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng soan-thoân: Tio̍h tī choân-kok pûn sàu-kak, tōa-siaⁿ hoah kóng, “Lán tio̍h chi̍p-ha̍p, cháu ji̍p-khì siat-hông ê siâⁿ!”
Tio̍h gia̍h tōa-kî kí ǹg Sek-an! Tio̍h tô-miā, m̄-thang thêng-kha! Siōng Chú beh hō͘ chai-hō kap khó-phàⁿ ê húi-bia̍t tùi pak-pêng lâi.
Húi-bia̍t lia̍t-kok--ê í-keng chhut-hoat, chhin-chhiūⁿ sai tùi ām-ām ê chhiū-nâ chhut--lâi. I beh hō͘ lí ê thó͘-tōe pha-hng, hō͘ lí ê siâⁿ-tìn hong-hòe, bô lâng tòa.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h chhēng môa-saⁿ, lâu ba̍k-sái thî-khàu, in-ūi Siōng Chú iáu-teh tùi lán siū-khì.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Kàu hit-ji̍t, ông kap koaⁿ-oân beh sit-khì ióng-khì; chè-si lóng ōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, sian-ti mā ōe chhiⁿ-kông.”

Góa chiū kóng, “Ài ah! Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, lí si̍t-chāi khi-phiàn chiah-ê jîn-bîn kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng. Lí kóng ‘Pêng-an bô-sū’, kî-si̍t to-kiàm í-keng tú tī goán ê nâ-âu.”

Hit-sî chiah-ê jîn-bîn kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng ōe thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe: Tùi bô chhiū bô chháu ê khòng-iá koân ê só͘-chāi, ōe ū sio-hong chhe-lâi góa ê chú-bîn hia; m̄-sī beh chhe be̍h-hiūⁿ, á-sī kā ngó͘-kok ê cha̍p-chit chhe-cháu,
sī siū góa bēng-lēng chhe--lâi ê kiông-hong. Hiān-chāi góa beh soan-pò͘ góa ê sím-phòaⁿ.
Lí khòaⁿ, tùi-te̍k teh lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ o͘-hûn teh ká; in ê chiàn-chhia chhin-chhiūⁿ kńg-lê-á-hong, in ê chiàn-bé pí eng-chiáu khah kín. Goán ū chai-hō lah! Goán bô-miā lah!
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, tio̍h chiong lí sim-lāi ê siâ-ok sóe chheng-khì, hō͘ lí thang tit-tio̍h kái-kiù. Lí sim-lāi ê pháiⁿ liām-thâu beh khǹg kàu tī-sî?
Ū siau-sit tùi Tān tōe-khu thoân--chhut-lâi; ū pháiⁿ siau-sit tùi Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu thoân--lâi.
Lín tio̍h kā lia̍t-kok thoân-pò͘, kā Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng soan-kò: Ū ûi-kong ê lâng tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi, tōa-siaⁿ hoah, beh kong-táⁿ Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn.
In chhin-chhiūⁿ kò͘-siú hn̂g-tōe ê lâng pau-ûi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, in-ūi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng pōe-poān góa. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Lí ê só͘-chòe, lí ê hêng-ûi jiá-khí chiah-ê sū; che sī lí chō-sêng ê ok-kó. Chit-ê ok-kó chin khó͘, khó͘ kàu lí ê sim-tn̂g.

Góa ê pak-lāi, góa ê chōng-hú, góa ê sim ká-thiàⁿ! Góa ê sim pho̍k-pho̍k-chhéng. Góa bô kóng-ōe tòng bōe tiâu, góa í-keng thiaⁿ-tio̍h sàu-kak kap kau-chiàn hoah-hiàm ê siaⁿ.
Húi-bia̍t ê siau-sit kè-sio̍k thoân--lâi; choân-tōe lóng siū phò-hoāi. Góa ê pò͘-pîⁿ hut-jiân tó--khì; góa ê tiùⁿ-ûi liâm-piⁿ li̍h--khì.
Góa khòaⁿ tùi-te̍k ê tōa-kî, tio̍h koh khòaⁿ jōa kú? Góa thiaⁿ sàu-kak ê siaⁿ, tio̍h koh thiaⁿ jōa kú?
“Góa ê chú-bîn gû-gōng, m̄ bat góa; góa ê kiáⁿ-jî bû-ti, bô tì-hūi; in choh-pháiⁿ chin gâu, choh-hó han-bān.”
Góa khòaⁿ tāi-tōe, tāi-tōe hūn-tūn bô chiâⁿ-hêng; góa khòaⁿ thiⁿ, thiⁿ àm-tām bô kng.
Góa khòaⁿ tōa-soaⁿ, tōa-soaⁿ tín-tāng, sió-soaⁿ mā iô-lâi-iô-khì.
Góa sì-kòe khòaⁿ, ta̍k-ūi lóng bô lâng, pe-chiáu mā lóng cháu-khì bih.
Góa koh khòaⁿ, pûi-súi ê hn̂g pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘, só͘-ū ê siâⁿ-tìn lóng siū thiah-húi, in-ūi Siōng Chú hoat tōa siū-khì.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Choân-tōe lóng ōe hong-hòe, m̄-kú góa bōe thiat-tóe kā i húi-bia̍t.
Tāi-tōe ōe khòng-hān, thiⁿ ōe o͘-àm. Góa chi̍t-ē kóng-chhut, it-tēng bōe hō͘-hóe; góa kì-jiân koat-tēng, it-tēng bōe kái-piàn.

Siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h bé-peng kap siā-chìⁿ ê lâng hoah-hiàm ê siaⁿ chiū lóng tô-cháu, cháu-ji̍p chhiū-nâ, peh-chiūⁿ soaⁿ-giâm; choân-siâⁿ lóng siū pàng-sak, bô lâng tòa tī hit lāi-bīn.

Lí chit-ê beh siū húi-hoāi ê siâⁿ, ná tio̍h chhēng âng-sek ê súi-saⁿ, kòa n̂g-kim ê chng-thāⁿ, soe-chng-táⁿ-pān, tián lí ê iau-kiau bí-lē? Lí án-ni táⁿ-pān kiám ū-chhái-kang? Lí ê ài-jîn kā lí pàng-sak, beh siu-si̍p lí ê sìⁿ-miā.

Góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ sán-hū chhui-chūn beh siⁿ thâu-chiūⁿ-kiáⁿ thàng-thiàⁿ ê siaⁿ, sī Sek-an ê chū-bîn teh phi̍hⁿ-phe̍hⁿ-chhoán, in chhun siang-chhiú, kóng, “Góa chhám ah! Ū lâng beh lâi thâi góa, góa beh hūn--khì lah.”

Tio̍h kiâⁿ-thàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koe-lō͘, sì-kòe thàm-thiaⁿ, tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu chhē, khòaⁿ ōe-tàng chhē-tio̍h chi̍t ê kiâⁿ kong-gī, tui-kiû chin-sêng ê lâng á bô; nā ū, góa chiū beh sià-bián chit-ê siâⁿ.
In sui-jiân kí oa̍h-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, m̄-kú in chiù ê chōa sī ké--ê.

Siōng Chú, lí kiám m̄-sī teh chhē chin-sêng ê lâng? Chit-ê siâⁿ ê lâng lí phah in, in m̄-chai thiàⁿ; lí húi-bia̍t in, in m̄-khéng siū-kà; in kò͘-chip ngī-sim, m̄-khéng hôe-thâu.
Góa siūⁿ: In sī sàn-chhiah, bû-ti ê jîn-bîn; in m̄ bat Siōng Chú ê tō-lō͘, m̄ chai Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng.

Góa chiū khì chhē ū koân-sè ê lâng, kap in tâm-lūn. In eng-kai bat Siōng Chú ê tō-lō͘, chai in ê Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng. Ná ōe chai, in kèng-jiân kòng-tn̄g taⁿ, tháu-khui soh, bô beh sūn-ho̍k Siōng Chú.

Só͘-í, chhiū-nâ ê sai ōe lâi kā in thun-chia̍h, iá-gōa ê chhâi-lông ōe lâi kā-sí in, siâⁿ-gōa ê pà teh tng-tán in. Nā ū lâng chhut-siâⁿ, it-tēng siū thiah-chhùi, in-ūi in put-sî ûi-pōe Siōng Chú, tùi Siōng Chú put-tiong ê sū sǹg bōe liáu.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa ná tio̍h sià-bián lín? Lín ê kiáⁿ-jî pàng-sak góa, koh kí ké-sîn chiù-chōa. Góa hō͘ in pá-chiok, in soah khì kiâⁿ-îm, kui-tīn khì khoeh tī ki-lú ê chhù.
In chhin-chhiūⁿ chhī-pá khí-chhio ê bé, ǹg chhù-piⁿ ê bó͘ kho͘ si-á.
In chòe chiah-ê sū, góa kiám m̄-bián pān? Chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-khoán kok-ka, góa kiám m̄-bián pò-ho̍k? Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Lín tio̍h khì húi-hoāi i ê phû-tô-hn̂g, m̄-kú m̄-thang kā in húi-liáu-liáu, kan-ta chhò i ê ki, in-ūi in bô sio̍k tī Siōng Chú.
Í-sek-lia̍t -ke kap Iû-tāi -ke oân-choân pōe-poān góa.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Í-sek-lia̍t m̄ sêng-jīn Siōng Chú só͘ kóng ê ōe, kóng, “Siōng Chú bōe chòe sím-mi̍h, bōe kàng chai-hō, bōe hō͘ lán tú-tio̍h chiàn-loān á-sī ki-hng.

Sian-ti ê kà-sī put-kò chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t chūn hong, Siōng Chú ê ōe bô tī in lāi-bīn.” Só͘-í Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè tùi góa kóng, “In kì-jiân án-ni kóng, góa beh hō͘ góa khǹg tī lí chhùi-lāi ê ōe chiâⁿ-chòe hé, hō͘ chiah-ê jîn-bîn chiâⁿ-chòe chhâ, hé beh kā in sio-tiāu.”

Siōng Chú kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, góa beh hō͘ chi̍t ê kok-ka tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi kong-kek lí. Chit-ê kok-ka chin kiông, le̍k-sú iu-kiú; in ê gú-giân lín m̄ bat, in kóng sím-mi̍h lín thiaⁿ bô.
In lóng sī ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū; in ê chìⁿ-tē chhin-chhiūⁿ phah-khui ê bōng, ōe-tàng siā-sí chin chōe lâng.

In beh kā lín ê ngó͘-kok kap bí-niû chia̍h-liáu-liáu, thun-bia̍t lín ê hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, koh thun-chia̍h lín ê gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn, chiong lín ê phû-tô kap bû-hoa-kó chia̍h kah lóng bô chhun, koh ēng to-kiàm húi-hoāi lín só͘ óa-khò kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Chiū-sī kàu hit-sî, góa mā bōe kā góa ê chú-bîn thiat-tóe húi-bia̍t.

In nā mn̄g, ‘Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè sī-án-chóaⁿ kā goán chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì?’ Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Kì-jiân lín pàng-sak góa, tī lín ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, lín mā beh chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, tī m̄-sī sio̍k lín ê tōe ho̍k-sāi gōa-cho̍k-lâng.’”
Tio̍h kā Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi thoân-pò, kā Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn soan-pò͘:
Lín chit-ê gōng koh bû-ti ê jîn-bîn, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Lín ū ba̍k-chiu m̄-kú khòaⁿ bô, ū hī-khang m̄-kú thiaⁿ bô.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Lín m̄ kiaⁿ góa sī--bô? Tī góa ê bīn-chêng bōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah sī--bô? Góa ēng soa kā hái siat éng-oán ê kài-hān, hō͘ hái bōe-tàng chhiau-kè; hái-éng poah-lâi-poah-khì chhèng-koân, mā bōe-tàng pôaⁿ--kè.
M̄-kú chit-ê jîn-bîn kò͘-chip, ngó͘-ge̍k, pōe-poān góa, lī-khui góa.
In sim-lāi lóng bô siūⁿ, ‘Lán tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè, I chiàu-sî sù chhun-lîm chhiu-ú hō͘ lán, koh kā lán tēng siu-sêng ê kùi-choeh.’
Lín ê chōe-kò soah hō͘ hong-ú sit-tiau; lín ê chōe-gia̍t hō͘ lín bōe-tàng tit-tio̍h hok-khì.
“Góa ê chú-bîn tiong-kan ū pháiⁿ-lâng; in chhin-chhiūⁿ lia̍h-chiáu ê lâng bâi-ho̍k tng-tán, siat oa̍h-tauh beh lia̍h lâng.
In kui chhù-keng lóng sī khúi-chà, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiáu-láng-á lāi lóng sī chiáu, só͘-í in hó-gia̍h koh ū-sè.
In âng-ko-chhiah-chhi̍h, chòe chīn pháiⁿ-tāi. In bô thòe ko͘-jî sin-oan, mā bô thòe sàn-chhiah-lâng chú-chhî kong-tō.”
Siōng Chú koh kóng, “In chòe chiah-ê sū, góa kiám m̄-bián kā in pān? Chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-khoán kok-ka, góa kiám m̄-bián kā in pò-ho̍k?
Khióng-pò͘ kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ê sū kèng-jiân tī chit-ê kok-ka hoat-seng:
Sian-ti kóng ké sìn-sit, chè-si la̍k-koân, góa ê chú-bîn mā ì-ài án-ni. Sím-phòaⁿ kàu ê sî, khòaⁿ lín beh án-chóaⁿ?”

Piān-ngá-bín -lâng, tio̍h tô-miā! Kóaⁿ-kín cháu lī-khui Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng! Tio̍h tī Thê-ko-a pûn sàu-kak; tī Pek Hap-ki-lîm khí hé-hun chòe sìn-hō! Chai-lān kap giâm-tiōng ê húi-hoāi tùi pak-hng pek óa--lâi lah!
Sek-an sui-jiân chhin-chhiūⁿ súi koh iù-siù ê lú-chú, m̄-kú góa beh kā lí húi-bia̍t.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ bo̍k-chiá chhōa iûⁿ-kûn, lia̍t-kok ê kun-ông beh chhōa kun-tūi lâi, tī chit-ê siâⁿ ê chiu-ûi chat-iâⁿ kong-kek i.
In beh hā-lēng, “Chún-pī chhut-chiàn! Lâi, thàn tiong-tàu lán lâi-khì kā in kong-kek!” Ū lâng ōe kóng, “Chin bái! Ji̍t-thâu teh-beh lo̍h-soaⁿ, teh-beh àm lah.”
“Khí--lâi! Lán tio̍h thàu-mî kā kong-kek, húi-hoāi in ê pó-lúi!”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Lín tio̍h chhò chhiū-á, chō thô͘-tui, kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. Chit-ê siâⁿ chhiong-móa khi-ap pak-siah, eng-kai siū hêng-hoa̍t.

Chíⁿ án-chóaⁿ chhèng chúi chhut--lâi, chit-ê siâⁿ mā kâng-khoán chōe-ok koàn-boán, kui-ê siâⁿ lóng ōe-tàng thiaⁿ-tio̍h pō-le̍k kap húi-hoāi ê siaⁿ; góa mā put-sî khòaⁿ-tio̍h siâⁿ-lāi ū pīⁿ-thiàⁿ kap siong-hûn.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, lí tio̍h siū koán-kàu, chiah bián góa kap lí so͘-oán, hō͘ lí pìⁿ-chòe hong-hòe bô lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi.”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ chhun ê lâng lóng ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ phû-tô hō͘ lâng bán-liáu-liáu; lí tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ bán phû-tô ê lâng, chhiú koh chhun ji̍p-khì phû-tô-tîn kā bán hō͘ chheng-khì.”

Góa ìn kóng, “Góa nā kā lâng thoân-ta̍t lí ê ōe, kā lâng kéng-kò, kiám ū lâng beh thiaⁿ? In kā hī-á that--khí-lâi, bô beh thiaⁿ. In chiong Siōng Chú ê ōe tòng-chòe sńg-chhiò, chi̍t-sut-á to bô ài thiaⁿ.

M̄-kú góa móa-pak lóng sī Siōng Chú ê siū-khì, tòng bōe tiâu.” Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h chiong góa ê siū-khì piàⁿ tī koe-lō͘ ê gín-á kap kiat kui-kûn ê siàu-liân-lâng sin-chiūⁿ; hiah-ê ang-bó͘, lāu-lâng, tn̂g-hè-siū--ê, lóng ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì.
Góa beh hō͘ in ê chhù, chhân-hn̂g, kap in ê bó͘, lóng pìⁿ-chòe pa̍t-lâng ê; góa beh chhun-chhiú kong-kek chit-tè thó͘-tōe ê chū-bîn. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
In tùi siōng pi-bî--ê kàu siōng ū koân-sè--ê lóng siàu-siūⁿ put-gī-chi-châi; liân sian-ti kap chè-si to lóng hêng-ûi khúi-chà.
Góa ê chú-bîn siū-tio̍h siong-hāi, in lóng bô-iàu-bô-kín. In kóng, ‘Pêng-an bô-sū! Pêng-an bô-sū!’ Kî-si̍t lóng bô pêng-an.

In chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, kiám chai kiàn-siàu? In si̍t-chāi ū-kàu bōe-kiàn-siàu! In ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ pa̍t-kok ê lâng hō͘ tùi-te̍k thâi--sí; góa kā in hêng-hoa̍t, in ōe oân-choân húi-bia̍t.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Siōng Chú tùi I ê chú-bîn kóng, “Lín tio̍h tī lō͘--ni̍h chù-ì koan-chhat, kā lâng mn̄g kó͘-chá ê lō͘, khòaⁿ hit-tiâu siōng-hó ê lō͘ tī tó-ūi, chiū khì kiâⁿ; án-ni, lín ê sim-sîn chiū ōe tit-tio̍h an-hioh.” M̄-kú in kóng, “M̄! Goán bô beh kiâⁿ hit-tiâu lō͘.”
Siōng Chú koh kā in chí-phài siú-bōng ê ōe-peng, kiò in tio̍h thiaⁿ sàu-kak ê siaⁿ. M̄-kú in kóng, “M̄! Goán bô beh thiaⁿ.”
Só͘-í, Siōng Chú kóng, “Lia̍t-kok ah, thiaⁿ leh! Kiàn-chèng-jîn ah, tio̍h koan-chhat, khòaⁿ in ōe tú-tio̍h sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.
Tāi-tōe ah, thiaⁿ leh! Góa beh hō͘ chiah-ê jîn-bîn siū chai-lān, che sī in kan-kan-kúi-kúi ê hō͘-kó; in m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe, kū-choa̍t góa ê lu̍t-hoat.

In hiàn Sī-pa ê jú-hiuⁿ hō͘ góa, tòa chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi chhut-sán ê chhiong-pô͘ lâi hō͘ góa, góa chiah bô teh hi-hán. Lín ê sio-hòa-chè, góa bô beh chiap-la̍p; lín ê seng-lé, góa bô hoaⁿ-hí.
Só͘-í, góa beh kā poàn-kha-chio̍h hē tī chiah-ê jîn-bîn ê thâu-chêng, hō͘ pē kap kiáⁿ chòe-hé poa̍h-tó, hō͘ chhù-piⁿ kap pêng-iú lóng bia̍t-bông.”
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê bîn-cho̍k beh tùi pak-hng lâi; ū chi̍t ê kiông ê kok-ka tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi chún-pī beh chhut-cheng.
In gia̍h keng gia̍h chhiuⁿ, chân-jím bô-chêng; in ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-éng hōa-hōa-háu. Sek-an ê chū-bîn ah, in khiâ chiàn-bé, thoân-kiat tâng-sim, pâi-tīn beh kong-kek lí.”
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kóng, “Goán thiaⁿ-tio̍h in ê siau-sit, chhiú lóng nńg--lo̍h-khì; goán hui-siông thòng-khó͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ sán-hū teh chhui-chūn.
M̄-thang chhut-khì iá-gōa, mā m̄-thang cháu-khì koe-lō͘, in-ūi chi̍t-sì-kòe ū bú-chong ê tùi-te̍k, lóng chin khióng-pò͘.”
Siōng Chú tùi I ê chú-bîn kóng, “Tio̍h chhēng môa-saⁿ sám hé-hu, tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ sí ko͘-kiáⁿ tōa-siaⁿ ai-khàu, in-ūi chân-hāi sìⁿ-miā--ê ōe hut-jiân lâi kong-kek lín.”
Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng, “Góa beh hō͘ lí tī góa ê chú-bîn tiong-kan, chhin-chhiūⁿ kàm-tēng-su, chhin-chhiūⁿ khó-chhat-koaⁿ, phêng-phòaⁿ khó-giām in ê só͘-chòe.
In chhin-chhiūⁿ tâng kap thih hiah-ni̍h kò͘-chip pōe-poān góa; chō-iâu jiá tāi-chì, kui-ê hú-pāi-liáu-liáu.

Lâng tōa-la̍t iô hong-kūi, lô͘ ê hé hiâⁿ koh-khah iām, kā iân sio-iûⁿ; liān liáu koh liān, m̄-kú lóng bô-chhái-kang, in-ūi in ê siâ-ok tû bōe chīn, chhin-chhiūⁿ iân ê cha̍p-chit iûⁿ bōe tiāu.
In ōe hō͘ lâng kiò-chòe ‘bô kè-ta̍t ê gûn’, in-ūi Siōng Chú í-keng kā in tàn hiat-ka̍k.”
Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Iâ-lī-bí, kóng,
“Lí tio̍h khì khiā tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê mn̂g-kháu, soan-káng chiah-ê ōe: “Só͘-ū ji̍p-lâi kèng-pài Siōng Chú ê Iû-tāi -lâng, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe.
“Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: “Tio̍h kái-chèng lín ê giân-hêng-kú-chí, án-ni góa chiū hō͘ lín tòa tī chit-tè thó͘-tōe.
M̄-thang siong-sìn hiah-ê pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe, kóng, ‘Che sī Siōng Chú ê tiān! Che sī Siōng Chú ê tiān! Siōng Chú ê tiān tī chia! An-choân lah!’
“Lín nā si̍t-chāi kái-chèng giân-hêng-kú-chí, tī lâng kap lâng ê tiong-kan si̍t-hêng kong-pêng chèng-ti̍t,
bô khi-ap kià-ku ê chhut-gōa-lâng, ko͘-jî, kóaⁿ-hū, bô tī chit-ê só͘-chāi bô͘-hāi bû-ko͘ ê lâng, bô pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, kā ka-kī jiá hō-toan,
góa chiū beh hō͘ lín éng-oán tòa tī góa sù hō͘ lín ê chó͘-sian khiā-khí ê chit-ê só͘-chāi.
“Lín khòaⁿ, lín kèng-jiân siong-sìn hiah-ê bô lō͘-ēng ê pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe.
Lín ná ōe-ēng-tit thau-the̍h, bô͘-hāi, kan-îm, chiù ké-chōa, kā Pa-le̍k sio-hiuⁿ, khì tè lín m̄-bat ê sîn-bêng,
koh lâi chit-keng hōng góa ê miâ khí ê sèng-tiān kèng-pài góa, kóng ‘Goán ū kiù lah’, thang kè-sio̍k khì chòe hiah-ê khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū?
Chit-keng hōng góa ê miâ khí ê sèng-tiān, lín kā i khòaⁿ-chòe thó͘-húi-á khut sī--bô? Lín tio̍h chai, lín teh chòe siáⁿ, góa lóng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h! Siōng Chú án-ni kóng.

“Lín khì Sī-lô khòaⁿ-bāi--leh. Kó͘-chá, góa tī hia siat-li̍p kèng-pài góa ê só͘-chāi, m̄-kú lín tio̍h khì khòaⁿ, góa in-ūi góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê chōe-ok, án-chóaⁿ tùi-hù hit-ê só͘-chāi.
Hiān-chāi lín chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì, góa it-chài kā lín khoàn-kài, m̄-kú lín lóng m̄ thiaⁿ; kā lín kiò, lín mā m̄ ìn;

só͘-í, góa beh chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-hù Sī-lô án-ni húi-hoāi chit-keng lín só͘ óa-khò, hōng góa ê miâ khí ê sèng-tiān, í-ki̍p chit-tè góa sù hō͘ lín kap lín chó͘-sian ê thó͘-tōe.
Góa mā beh kā lín tùi góa ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-cháu, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng góa chiong lín ê chhin-cho̍k Í-hoat-liân ê hō͘-tāi kóaⁿ-cháu siâng-khoán.”
Lí m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h chit-ê jîn-bîn kî-tó, m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h in tōa-siaⁿ ai-kiû, mā m̄-bián thòe in tùi góa khún-kiû, in-ūi góa lóng bô beh thiaⁿ.
Lí kiám bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h in tī Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koe-lō͘ teh chhòng sím-mi̍h?
Gín-á khioh-chhâ, lāu-pē hiâⁿ-hé, lāu-bú chhiau mī-hún chòe piáⁿ, hiàn hō͘ Thian-hō͘, koh kā pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng hiàn tiān-chiú-chè, thiau-kang jiá góa siū-khì.
Siōng Chú kóng: Kî-si̍t in m̄-sī siong-hāi tio̍h góa, sī siong-tio̍h ka-kī, hāi ka-kī kiàn-siàu.

Só͘-í Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh chiong góa béng-lia̍t ê siū-khì piàⁿ tī chit-ê só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn kap tōng-bu̍t sin-chiūⁿ, í-ki̍p chhân-iá ê chhiū-ba̍k kap thó͘-tōe ê chhut-sán. Góa ê siū-khì ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-hé teh to̍h bô lâng phah ōe hoa.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “Lín hiàn-chè ê sî, chòe lín chiong sio-hòa-chè ê bah chham chòe-hé chia̍h-chia̍h--khì.
Góa chhōa lín ê chó͘-sian chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî, góa m̄-bat tùi in thê-khí sio-hòa-chè kap kî-tha ê chè-sū, mā m̄-bat bēng-lēng in tio̍h án-ni chòe.

Góa kan-ta kā in bēng-lēng chit-hāng sū, ‘Lín tio̍h thiaⁿ góa ê ōe, kiâⁿ góa só͘ bēng-lēng lín ê lō͘, góa chiū beh chòe lín ê Siōng-tè, lín chòe góa ê chú-bîn, thang hō͘ lín sū-sū sūn-lī.’
M̄-kú in m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn, m̄ chù-ì thiaⁿ góa ê ōe, hoán-tńg chiàu in siâ-ok ê sim kò͘-chip pōe-poān góa; m̄-nā bô kái-siān, tian-tò koh-khah pháiⁿ.
Tùi lín ê chó͘-sian chhut Ai-ki̍p kàu kin-á-ji̍t, góa it-chài phài góa ê po̍k-jîn sian-ti khì in hia.
M̄-kú in iû-goân m̄ thiaⁿ, m̄ chù-ì thiaⁿ góa ê ōe; tian-tò ngī-sim kò͘-chip, pí in ê lia̍t-chó͘ chòe koh-khah pháiⁿ ê sū.
“ Iâ-lī-bí, lí tio̍h chiong chiah-ê ōe lóng kā in kóng, m̄-kú in bōe thiaⁿ; lí án-chóaⁿ kā in kiò, in mā bōe kā lí ìn.

Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Lín chit-ê bîn-cho̍k m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, m̄-khéng siū kà-sī. Lín tiong-kan bô koh ū chin-si̍t; lín ê chhùi liân chi̍t kù sêng-si̍t khó-khò ê ōe to bô.’”

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, tio̍h thì kng-thâu, kā thâu-mn̂g hiat-ka̍k! Tio̍h tī chhiū-á chhò-liáu-liáu ê soaⁿ-téng chhiùⁿ ai-ko! Siōng Chú í-keng chiong jiá I siū-khì ê sè-tāi pàng-sak lah!
Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe siâ-ok ê sū, tī kèng-pài góa ê sèng-tiān chhāi khó-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng, kā chit-ê tiān phah lâ-sâm. Siōng Chú án-ni kóng.
In tī Him-lūn-chú Soaⁿ-kok khí Tô-hui-te̍k ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, sio in ê kiáⁿ-jî hiàn chòe chè. Góa m̄-bat bēng-lēng in chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì, liân siūⁿ to m̄-bat siūⁿ--kè.

Lín tio̍h chai, sî-ji̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, hit-ê só͘-chāi bōe koh kiò-chòe Him-lūn-chú Soaⁿ-kok á-sī Tô-hui-te̍k, beh kiò-chòe “Tô͘-sat ê soaⁿ-kok”. In-ūi pa̍t-ūi bô-kàu só͘-chāi bâi-chòng sí-lâng, in ōe tī Tô-hui-te̍k tâi sin-si. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Chit-ê jîn-bîn ê si-thé, ōe chiâⁿ-chòe khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê iá-siù ê chia̍h-mi̍h; bô lâng lâi kā in kóaⁿ-cháu.

Hit-sî, góa beh hō͘ Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koe-lō͘ oân-choân bô hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k ê siaⁿ, bô koh ū hun-iàn hí-khèng ê siaⁿ, in-ūi chit-ê tōe beh pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘.
Siōng Chú kóng: Kàu hit-sî, lâng beh chiong Iû-tāi ê chu-ông, koaⁿ-oân, chè-si, sian-ti, í-ki̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chū-bîn ê kut-thâu, tùi bōng--ni̍h the̍h--chhut-lâi,

hiat tī ji̍t-thâu, ge̍h-niû, chhiⁿ-sîn ê ē-bīn; chiah-ê thian-thé sī hiah-ê lâng siⁿ-chêng kah-ì, ho̍k-sāi, kun-tè, pok-kòa, pài-pài--ê. Hiah-ê kut-thâu bô lâng ōe koh kā in khioh-khì tâi, ōe tī thô͘-kha chiâⁿ-chòe pûi-liāu.

Chit-ê siâ-ok ê bîn-cho̍k chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng, tī góa kā in liû-hòng--khì ê kok-ka bô siūⁿ-beh koh oa̍h--lo̍h-khì, lêng-khó sí. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù góa tùi I ê chú-bîn kóng: Lâng poa̍h-tó, kiám bô beh peh--khí-lâi; kiâⁿ m̄-tio̍h lō͘, kiám bô beh oa̍t tò-tńg?
Lín chiah-ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng, sī-án-chóaⁿ lín chi̍t-ē tùi góa put-tiong chiū it-ti̍t pōe-poān góa? Lín ná kò͘-chip ài khi-phiàn, m̄-khéng hoán-hóe?

Góa chù-ì kā in thiaⁿ, in lóng bô kóng si̍t-ōe, bô lâng ūi-tio̍h ka-kī só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ-sū hoán-séng kóng, “Góa ná ōe chòe chit-khoán pháiⁿ tāi-chì?” In ta̍k-ê lâng lóng oat-khì kiâⁿ ka-kī ê lō͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiàn-bé chhiong ji̍p-khì chiàn-tiûⁿ.
Khong-tiong ê ho̍h chai-iáⁿ chiàu kùi-choeh chhian-sóa, pan-kah, ìⁿ-á, kap gān mā chai thang chiàu sî-kan sóa-ūi, góa ê chú-bîn kèng-jiân m̄ bat Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng!
Lín ná ōe kóng “Goán sī ū tì-hūi ê lâng; goán ū Siōng Chú ê lu̍t-hoat”? Kî-si̍t lu̍t-hoat-kàu-su í-keng ēng in pe̍h-chha̍t ê bûn-pit oai-khiok lu̍t-hoat ê ì-sù.
Hiah-ê ū tì-hūi ê lâng ōe tú-tio̍h kiàn-siàu, ōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, ōe siū sím-phòaⁿ. In khì-sak Siōng Chú ê ōe, ná ū sím-mi̍h tì-hūi?

Só͘-í, góa beh chiong in ê bó͘ hō͘ pa̍t-lâng, in ê chhân-hn̂g hō͘ lâng chiàm--khì. In tùi siōng pi-bî--ê kàu siōng ū koân-sè--ê lóng siàu-siūⁿ put-gī-chi-châi, liân sian-ti kap chè-si to lóng hêng-ûi khúi-chà.
Góa ê chú-bîn siū-tio̍h siong-hāi, in lóng bô-iàu-bô-kín. In kóng, “Pêng-an bô-sū! Pêng-an bô-sū!” Kî-si̍t lóng bô pêng-an.

In chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, kiám chai kiàn-siàu? In si̍t-chāi ū-kàu bōe-kiàn-siàu! In ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ pa̍t-kok ê lâng hō͘ tùi-te̍k thâi-sí, góa kā in hêng-hoa̍t, in ōe oân-choân húi-bia̍t. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Góa beh hō͘ in lóng bô siu-sêng; phû-tô-chhiū bô siⁿ phû-tô, bû-hoa-kó-chhiū bô kiat bû-hoa-kó, chhiū-hio̍h lóng ta-ta--khì. Góa hō͘ in--ê, lóng bô--khì lah. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Jîn-bîn kóng, “Lán ná iáu chē tī chia? Lán tio̍h sio-chio lâi-khì kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, sí tiàm hia! Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè chù-tiāⁿ beh kā lán siau-bia̍t lah, I beh hō͘ lán lim khó͘-chúi, in-ūi lán ū tek-chōe Siōng Chú.
Lán kî-thāi hô-pêng hoân-êng, m̄-kú ta̍k-hāng lóng bô sūn-lī; kî-thāi i-tī ê ki-hōe, m̄-kú kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ hut-jiân lâi kàu.

Chiàn-bé phn̍gh-phn̍gh-háu ê siaⁿ tùi Tān thoân--chhut-lâi; ióng-chòng ê bé hiu-hiu-kiò, tāi-tōe in-ūi in ê siaⁿ tín-tāng. Tùi-te̍k lâi beh húi-bia̍t chit-tè thó͘-tōe kap tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ê it-chhè, thun-bia̍t chiah-ê siâⁿ-tìn kap lāi-bīn ê chū-bîn.”
Siōng Chú kéng-kò I ê chú-bîn, kóng, “Góa beh phài bōe-tàng ēng hoat-su̍t khòng-chè ê to̍k-chôa khì lín hia kā lín.”
Góa siong-sim kah bô io̍h thang i; góa ê sim-sîn soe-lám kiông-beh hūn--khì.

Thiaⁿ! Góa ê tông-pau ai-kiò ê siaⁿ, tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi thoân--lâi: Siōng Chú kiám bô tī Sek-an? Sek-an ê ông kiám bô tī siâⁿ-lāi? Siōng Chú kóng, “In sī-án-chóaⁿ pài tiau-khek ê ngó͘-siōng, pài gōa-pang hu-bû ê sîn-bêng jiá góa siū-khì?”
Góa ê tông-pau kóng, “Siu-sêng í-keng kè, joa̍h-thiⁿ í-keng kiat-sok, m̄-kú goán iáu-bē tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.”
Góa in-ūi tông-pau siū húi-bia̍t sim chhùi--khì; góa hui-siông pi-siong, kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ sit-sîn.
Ki-lia̍t kiám bô jú-hiuⁿ? Hia kiám bô i-seng? Góa ê tông-pau ná iáu-bē tit-tio̍h i-tī?
Khó͘-bōe-tit góa ê thâu pìⁿ-chòe chúi-goân, góa ê ba̍k-chiu pìⁿ-chòe ba̍k-sái ê chôaⁿ-goân, mî-ji̍t ūi-tio̍h hō͘ lâng thâi-sí ê tông-pau ai-khàu.
Chiok hi-bāng tī khòng-iá ū kheh-chàn thang tòa, hō͘ góa thang pàng-sak góa ê tông-pau, lī-khui in hn̄g-hn̄g; in-ūi in sī chi̍t kûn kiâⁿ-îm pōe-poān ê pháiⁿ-lâng.

In ê chi̍h kńg--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ keng, ūi-tio̍h beh kóng pe̍h-chha̍t; in tī kok-lāi ū koân-sè, m̄-sī khò chin-si̍t, sī khò khúi-chà. Siōng Chú kóng: Góa ê chú-bîn ok-siōng-ka-ok, in m̄ bat góa.
Lín ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h tî-hông lín ê chhù-piⁿ, liân chhin hiaⁿ-tī to m̄-thang sìn-jīm; hiaⁿ-tī-á lóng teh kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, chhù-piⁿ mā teh chō-iâu húi-pòng.
In hō͘-siōng khi-phiàn, bô beh kóng chin-si̍t; in hùn-liān chhùi-chi̍h kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, phah-piàⁿ chòe pháiⁿ.
In koàn-sì kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, m̄ sêng-jīn góa sī in ê Siōng-tè. Siōng Chú án-ni kóng.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng: Góa beh thoàn-liān góa ê chú-bîn, kā in bôa-liān; nā bô án-ni, góa beh án-chóaⁿ chhú-lí in?
In ê chi̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ to̍k-chìⁿ, kóng-ōe khúi-chà; ta̍k-ê lâng tùi chhù-piⁿ kóng hó-thiaⁿ-ōe, m̄-kú sim-lāi beh bô͘-hāi in.
In chòe chiah-ê sū, góa kiám m̄-bián pān in? Chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-khoán bîn-cho̍k, góa kiám m̄-bián kā in pò-ho̍k? Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Góa beh ūi-tio̍h soaⁿ-niá thî-khàu pi-siong, ūi-tio̍h khòng-iá ê chháu-po͘ chhiùⁿ ai-ko; in lóng hō͘ hé sio-liáu-liáu, bô lâng kiâⁿ tùi hia khì. Gû iûⁿ ê siaⁿ bô koh thiaⁿ--tio̍h; pe-chiáu kap iá-siù ê iáⁿ bô koh khòaⁿ--tio̍h.
Góa beh hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng pha-hng, chiâⁿ-chòe chhâi-lông ê siū; beh hō͘ Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘, bô koh ū lâng tòa.

Siáⁿ-lâng ū-kàu chhong-bêng, thang liáu-kái chit-ê sū? Siōng Chú thang chí-sī siáⁿ-lâng, hō͘ i kóe-seh: Chit-ê tōe sī-án-chóaⁿ húi-hoāi, pha-hng chhin-chhiūⁿ khòng-iá, bô lâng tùi hia keng-kè?
Siōng Chú kóng: Che sī in-ūi in pàng-sak góa sù hō͘ in ê lu̍t-hoat, bô thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe, m̄ si̍t-hêng góa ê lu̍t-hoat;
in kò͘-chip chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù choh-sū, chiàu in ê chó͘-sian kà--in-ê khì pài Pa-le̍k.
Só͘-í, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè soan-pò͘: Góa beh hō͘ in chia̍h khó͘-kó, lim to̍k-chúi.
Góa beh kā in liû-hòng khì in kap in ê chó͘-sian m̄-bat ê lia̍t-kok, hō͘ in siū tui-sat kàu oân-choân siau-bia̍t.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng: Lín tio̍h chai-sí! Khì chhiàⁿ hiah-ê chhiùⁿ ai-ko ê hū-jîn-lâng lâi, khì chio hiah-ê gâu khàu ê cha-bó͘-lâng lâi.
Jîn-bîn kóng: In tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín lâi, kā lán chhiùⁿ ai-ko, hō͘ lán ba̍k-sái ti̍t-ti̍t lâu, hō͘ lán ê ba̍k-sái pé bōe lī.

Thiaⁿ leh, Sek-an thoân-chhut khàu-siaⁿ: Goán kèng-jiân chiah-ni̍h lo̍k-phek! Goán ū-kàu kiàn-siàu! Goán soah tio̍h pàng-lo̍h chit-tè thó͘-tōe! Goán ê chhù soah hō͘ lâng thiah-húi!
Hū-jîn-lâng ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê siaⁿ, thiaⁿ-thàn I ê ōe; tio̍h kà lín ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ai-khàu, kà lín ê cha-bó͘-phōaⁿ chhiùⁿ ai-ko.
Sí-bông ōe tùi thang-á ji̍p--lâi, ji̍p-lâi lán ê pó-lúi, tī koe-lō͘ sat-hāi lán ê gín-á, tī kóng-tiûⁿ thâi-sí lán ê siàu-liân-lâng.
Siōng Chú bēng-lēng góa kā lín kóng: Lâng ê sin-si ōe tó tī iá-gōa chhin-chhiūⁿ pùn-sò, chhin-chhiūⁿ siu-koah ê lâng lak--lo̍h-lâi ê be̍h-sūi, bô lâng khioh.
Siōng Chú kóng: Tì-hūi ê lâng m̄-thang khoa-kháu ka-kī ê tì-hūi; ióng-béng ê lâng m̄-thang khoa-kháu i ê khùi-la̍t; hó-gia̍h-lâng m̄-thang khoa-kháu i ê châi-hù.
Lâng nā beh khoa-kháu, tio̍h khoa-kháu i bat góa, sêng-jīn góa sī Siōng Chú; góa ài tī sè-kan si chû-ài, kong-gī, kap kong-pêng. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Lín tio̍h chù-ì, sî-ji̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, góa beh hêng-hoa̍t kan-ta jio̍k-thé chiap-siū kat-lé ê lâng,

chiū-sī Ai-ki̍p -lâng, Iû-tāi -lâng, Í-tong -lâng, A-bûn -lâng, Mô͘-ap -lâng, í-ki̍p só͘-ū tòa tī khòng-iá, thì pìn-piⁿ ê lâng; chiah-ê bîn-cho̍k lóng bô siū kat-lé, Í-sek-lia̍t choân-thé jîn-bîn ê sim mā bô siū kat-lé.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú tùi lín kóng ê ōe.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lín m̄-thang o̍h gōa-cho̍k-lâng ê chong-kàu hêng-ûi; sui-jiân lia̍t-kok ōe in-ūi kî-koài ê thian-siōng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, m̄-kú lín lóng m̄-bián kiaⁿ.
Bān-bîn só͘ pài--ê lóng sī hu-bû, put-kò sī tùi chhiū-nâ ēng pó͘-thâu chhò--lo̍h-lâi ê chhâ-kho͘; sai-hū tiau-khek,
ēng kim gûn chng-thāⁿ, ēng kòng-thûi tèng teng-á, kā i chhāi tiâu--teh, hō͘ i bōe tín-tāng.
In ê sîn-siōng chhin-chhiūⁿ chhì-koe-á-hn̂g ê tiū-chháu-lâng, bōe kóng-ōe, bōe kiâⁿ-lō͘, tio̍h hō͘ lâng kng. M̄-bián kiaⁿ in! In bōe kàng chai-hō, mā bōe sù hok-khì.
Siōng Chú ah, bô lâng ōe-tàng kap lí pí; chí-ū lí sī úi-tāi, lí ū tōa koân-lêng.
Bān-kok ê Ông, siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ m̄ kèng-ùi lí? Chí-ū lí eng-kai siū kèng-ùi. Lia̍t-kok só͘-ū tì-hūi ê lâng kap it-chhè ū koân-le̍k ê lâng, bô lâng ōe-tàng kap lí pí.
In lóng gû-gōng bû-ti; hiah-ê ngó͘-siōng bōe-tàng hō͘ in sím-mi̍h kà-sī; in put-kò sī chhâ-thâu nā-tiāⁿ.

Phah-chòe kui-phìⁿ ê gûn tùi Tha-si ūn--lâi, kim tùi O͘-hoat chìn-kháu, lóng sī sai-hū kap gûn-chhiūⁿ ê chok-phín; in só͘ chhēng nâ-sek, chí-sek ê saⁿ, mā-sī ki-su̍t kháu-biāu ê sai-hū chòe--ê.
Chí-ū Siōng Chú sī chin Sîn, sī oa̍h ê Siōng-tè, sī éng-oán chûn-chāi ê Kun-ông. I chi̍t-ē siū-khì, tāi-tōe iô-tāng; I hoat tōa siū-khì, lia̍t-kok lóng tòng bōe tiâu.
Lín tio̍h kā in kóng, “Hiah-ê m̄-sī chhòng-chō thiⁿ-tōe ê sîn-bêng, lóng beh tùi thiⁿ-ē tōe-chiūⁿ siau-sit.”
Siōng Chú ēng ka-kī ê tāi-lêng chhòng-chō tāi-tōe, ēng I ê tì-hūi kian-li̍p sè-kài, ēng chhong-bêng thí-khui kiong-chhong.

Siōng Chú chi̍t-ē chhut-siaⁿ, thiⁿ-téng ê chúi chiū ká-kún, hûn-bū chiū tùi thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak chhèng--chhut-lâi; I tùi hō͘ ê tiong-kan siā-chhut sih-nà, tùi I ê chhng-khò͘ sàng hong chhut--lâi.
Sè-kan-lâng lóng gû-gōng bû-ti; ta̍k-ê phah-kim sai-hū lóng ūi-tio̍h ka-kī chō ê sîn-siōng kiàn-siàu, in-ūi in chù ê sîn-siōng lóng sī hu-ké, lāi-bīn bô sìⁿ-miā.
Ngó͘-siōng lóng sī hu-ké, sī lâng thí-chhiò ê tùi-siōng; hêng-hoa̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, in lóng ōe siau-sit.

Choh Ngá-kok sán-gia̍p ê Siōng-tè kap in bô kâng-khoán; I sī chhòng-chō bān-iú ê Chú; Í-sek-lia̍t sī I ê chú-bîn, sī I ê sán-gia̍p. I ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe.
Lín tòa tī siū ûi-khùn ê siâⁿ ê lâng, tio̍h siu-si̍p lín ê hêng-lí lī-khui.
In-ūi Siōng Chú kóng, “Chit-piàn góa beh chiong chit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn tàn hiat-ka̍k; kā in chiat-bôa, hō͘ in kak-chhíⁿ.”
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng tōa-siaⁿ hoah, kóng: Goán chhám ah, goán tio̍h-siong lah! Goán siū ê siong chin tāng. M̄-kú goán siūⁿ, che sī goán tio̍h jím-siū ê thòng-khó͘.

Goán ê pò͘-pîⁿ húi-hoāi lah, pò͘-pîⁿ ê soh-á tn̄g--khì lah, goán ê gín-á lóng lī-khui goán, bōe koh tò--lâi; bōe koh ū lâng lâi kā goán tah pò͘-pîⁿ, kā goán kòa pò͘-lî.
Góa ìn kóng: Léng-tō-chiá lóng gû-gōng bû-ti, bô beh chhē-kiû Siōng Chú, só͘-í lóng bōe sūn-lī; in ê iûⁿ-kûn mā lóng siū kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ.
Thiaⁿ leh, ū siau-sit thoân--lâi! Ū tōa jiáu-tōng tùi pak-hng lâi, beh hō͘ Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘, pìⁿ-chòe chhâi-lông ê siū.
Siōng Chú, góa chai, lâng bōe-tàng koat-tēng ka-kī ê lō͘, bōe-tàng khòng-chè ka-kī ê kha-pō͘.
Siōng Chú ah, lí koán-kàu góa ê sî, kiû lí kong-tō tùi-thāi góa, m̄-thang tī lí tōa siū-khì tiong hō͘ góa it-bû-só͘-iú.

Kiû lí chiong tōa siū-khì piàⁿ tī bô kèng-ùi lí ê kok-ka, í-ki̍p bô beh kiû-kiò lí ê miâ ê bîn-cho̍k; in thun-chia̍h Ngá-kok, kā i oân-choân siau-bia̍t, hō͘ i khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi pha-hng.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Lí tio̍h thiaⁿ chheng-chhó chit-ê iok ê lōe-iông, jiân-āu kā Iû-tāi -lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn soan-pò͘.
Lí tio̍h tùi in kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: M̄ thiaⁿ-thàn chit-ê iok ê ōe ê lâng, it-tēng ōe siū chiù-chó͘.

Chit-ê iok sī góa chhōa lín ê chó͘-sian chhut Ai-ki̍p, thoat-lī chù-thih ê hé-lô͘ ê sî bēng-lēng in--ê, kóng: Lín tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe, si̍t-hêng góa só͘ bēng-lēng lín--ê, án-ni lín chiū thang chiâⁿ-chòe góa ê chú-bîn, góa chòe lín ê Siōng-tè,
thang si̍t-hiān góa tùi lín ê chó͘-sian só͘ li̍p-sè--ê, chiong lín kin-á-ji̍t khiā-khí chit-tè lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe sù hō͘ in.’” Góa ìn kóng, “Siōng Chú, Amen!”
Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h khì Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koe-lō͘ soan-pò͘, ‘Lín tio̍h chhiat-si̍t chun-hêng chit-ê iok ê ōe.
