Góa tùi chhōa lín ê chó͘-sian lī-khui Ai-ki̍p hit-ji̍t kàu kin-á-ji̍t, it-chài giâm-giâm kā in kéng-kài, kiò in tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe.

M̄-kú in m̄-nā bô beh chù-ì thiaⁿ, koh chiàu in kò͘-chip siâ-ok ê sim chòe tāi-chì. In-ūi in m̄ chiàu góa ê bēng-lēng chun-siú chit-ê iok, só͘-í góa chiàu chit-ê iok kā in hêng-hoa̍t.’”
Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng, “Tī Iû-tāi -lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn tiong-kan, ū lâng kè-bô͘ beh pōe-poān góa.

In koh tńg-khì hoān in ê chó͘-sian m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe ê chōe, khì ho̍k-sāi pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng. Í-sek-lia̍t -ke kap Iû-tāi -ke lóng phò-hoāi góa kap in chó͘-sian só͘ li̍p ê iok.
Só͘-í, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ in, in bô hoat-tō͘ cháu-siám. In kā góa ai-kiû, góa mā m̄ thiaⁿ.

Hit-sî, Iû-tāi ta̍k siâⁿ-tìn ê lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn, ōe khì ai-kiû in sio-hiuⁿ ho̍k-sāi ê sîn-bêng. M̄-kú tī in tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê sî, chiah-ê sîn-bêng lóng bōe-tàng kā in kái-kiù.

Iû-tāi ah, lín ê sîn-bêng chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ê siâⁿ-tìn hiah chōe; lín ūi-tio̍h thang kiàn-siàu ê Pa-le̍k só͘ khí sio-hiuⁿ ê tôaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koe-lō͘ hiah chōe.’
Iâ-lī-bí ah, lí m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h chiah-ê jîn-bîn kî-tó, m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h in tōa-siaⁿ khún-kiû, in-ūi in tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê sî tùi góa ai-kiû, góa bô beh kā thiaⁿ.”

Siōng Chú tùi Iû-tāi -lâng kóng, “Góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê chú-bîn, lín chòe hiah chōe pháiⁿ, iáu ōe-tàng tī góa ê sèng-tiān chhòng sím-mi̍h? Lín hē-goān, hiàn bah, kiám chiū ōe kā lín siau-tû chai-hō, hō͘ lín sim-an hoaⁿ-hí?

Góa Siōng Chú bat kā lín hō-miâ chòe chhiⁿ-chhùi, bō͘-sēng, kiat kah kui-châng ké-chí ê kaⁿ-ná-chhiū, m̄-kú taⁿ góa beh ēng lûi-kong sih-nà sio i ê chhiū-hio̍h, kòng-tn̄g i ê chhiū-oe.

“Góa Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kā lín chai-chèng, m̄-kú taⁿ í-keng soan-pò͘ beh kàng chai-hō kong-kek lín; in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng lóng chòe pháiⁿ, ǹg Pa-le̍k sio-hiuⁿ, jiá góa siū-khì.”
Siōng Chú chí-sī góa, góa chiah chai ū lâng beh tùi-hù góa.

Góa chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t chiah beh hō͘ lâng khan-khì thâi sûn-liông ê iûⁿ-á, m̄ chai in siat-kè beh bô͘-hāi góa. In kóng, “Lán kā chit-châng chhiū kap i ê ké-chí lóng húi-tiāu! Lán lâi kā chit-ê lâng thâi--sí, hō͘ lâng bōe-kì-tit i ê miâ.”

Góa chiū kî-tó kóng, “Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe! Lí kàm-chhat lâng ê sim-su liām-thâu, chiàu kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ. Góa chiong góa ê àn-kiāⁿ kau hō͘ lí, kiû lí hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí thòe góa chú-chhî kong-tō.”

A-ná-tu̍t -lâng tùi góa kóng, “Lí bōe-ēng-tit hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ thoân-ta̍t I ê ōe, chiah bián sí tī goán ê chhiú-thâu.” Chiam-tùi hiah-ê beh bô͘-hāi góa ê A-ná-tu̍t -lâng,
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Góa beh hêng-hoa̍t A-ná-tu̍t -lâng, in ê siàu-liân-lâng beh sí tī to-ē, in ê hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ beh in-ūi ki-hng sí.
In liân chi̍t ê to bōe-tàng lâu--teh, in-ūi góa hêng-hoa̍t in ê sî, góa beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ in.”

Siōng Chú, góa kap lí cheng-piān ê sî, ta̍k-piàn lóng lí iâⁿ, m̄-kú góa iáu-sī beh kap lí lí-lūn koan-hē kong-gī ê tāi-chì; sī-án-chóaⁿ pháiⁿ-lâng lóng sū-sū sūn-lī? Choh-lâng kan-kúi--ê ná ōe hióng-siū êng-hôa?
Lí kā in chai-chèng, in chiū tèng-kun, tōa-châng, kiat-si̍t. In siông-siông kóng-khí lí, m̄-kú sim-lāi bô lí.

Siōng Chú ah, lí bat góa, liáu-kái góa, chhì-giām góa tùi lí ê tiong-sêng. Kiû lí kā hiah-ê pháiⁿ-lâng thoa--chhut-lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh giú beh thâi ê iûⁿ; kā in koaiⁿ--khí-lâi, koaiⁿ kàu beh thâi hit-ji̍t.

Chit-ê tōe khòng-hān, chhân-iá ê chhiⁿ-chháu choân-pō͘ ta--khì beh kàu tī-sî? In-ūi chit-ê tōe ê chū-bîn chòe pháiⁿ, chiáu-á kap cheng-siⁿ sí-liáu-liáu; m̄-kú in kóng, “Siōng Chú bô teh koán lán ê kiat-kio̍k!”

Siōng Chú kóng: Lí kap lâng kiâⁿ-lō͘ pí-sài to ōe thiám, ná cháu ōe iâⁿ chiàn-bé? Lí tī an-choân khòng-khoah ê só͘-chāi chiah ōe kám-kak an-ún, nā tī Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ ê chhiū-nâ, lí beh án-chóaⁿ?
Liân lí ê hiaⁿ-tī, lí ê chhin-chiâⁿ to ōe chhut-bōe lí, tī lí ê āu-bīn tōa-siaⁿ kong-kek lí; in chiū-sī tùi lí kóng hó-thiaⁿ-ōe, lí mā m̄-thang sìn-jīm in.
Góa pàng-sak Í-sek-lia̍t -ke, hòng-khì góa ê sán-gia̍p; chiong góa sim-ài ê chú-bîn kau tī i ê tùi-te̍k ê chhiú-thâu.
Góa ê chú-bîn tùi góa lâi kóng, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū-nâ lāi ê sai, tōa-siaⁿ kong-kek góa, só͘-í góa oàn-hūn in.
Góa ê chú-bîn tùi góa lâi kóng, chhin-chhiūⁿ ū pan-tiám ê eng, chin chōe chiah eng tī chiu-ûi kong-kek i. Tio̍h chio-chi̍p chhân-iá ê iá-siù chòe-hé lâi thun-chia̍h i.
Lia̍t-kok ê thóng-tī-chiá húi-bia̍t góa chai-pôe ê chú-bîn, thún-ta̍h góa ê chhân-hn̂g, hō͘ góa pûi-súi ê chhân-hn̂g pìⁿ-chòe pha-hng ê hong-po͘.
In phò-hoāi thó͘-tōe, hō͘ thó͘-tōe pha-hng kah tùi góa ai-khàu; choân-tōe pha-hng, m̄-kú bô lâng koan-sim.
Húi-bia̍t-chiá lâi kàu khòng-iá kng-ku̍t ê soaⁿ-lûn-á; Siōng Chú ê to beh húi-bia̍t tāi-tōe, tùi chit-pêng kàu hit-pêng; bô chi̍t ê lâng an-choân.
In chèng be̍h-á, siu-sêng chhì-phè; in lô-khó͘ chèng-choh, m̄-kú bô siu-sêng; in ê siu-sêng hō͘ in tōa-tōa sit-bāng, in-ūi góa Siōng Chú tùi in hoat tōa siū-khì.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Góa beh chiong só͘-ū ê pháiⁿ chhù-piⁿ, tùi in ê thó͘-tōe pu̍ih--chhut-lâi; in chhim-hoān góa sù hō͘ góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê thó͘-tōe; góa mā beh chiong Iû-tāi jîn-bîn tùi in tiong-kan pu̍ih--chhut-lâi.

Góa kā Iû-tāi jîn-bîn pu̍ih--chhut-lâi liáu-āu, beh oat tńg-lâi lîn-bín in, kā in chhōa--tò-lâi, hō͘ in ta̍k-ê lâng tńg-khì ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong, hôe-ho̍k in ta̍k-ê lâng ê sán-gia̍p.

Āu-lâi, chiu-ûi ê kok-ka nā khéng sêng-sim ha̍k-si̍p góa chú-bîn ê sìn-gióng, kí góa — éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú ê miâ chiù-chōa, chhin-chhiūⁿ in í-chêng kà góa ê chú-bîn kí Pa-le̍k chiù-chōa kâng-khoán, in chiū ōe tī góa chú-bîn ê tiong-kan tit-tio̍h ho̍k-heng.
“M̄-kú nā ū kok-ka m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn, góa chiū beh kā i pu̍ih--khí-lâi, chiong i siau-bia̍t.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Lí khì bóe chi̍t tiâu môa-pò͘ chòe ê io-tòa lâi hâ-io, m̄-thang kā i chìm tī chúi--ni̍h.”
Góa chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê ōe, bóe chi̍t tiâu io-tòa hâ-io.
Siōng Chú ê ōe tē-jī piàn kā góa kóng, “Chiong lí bóe ê io-tòa hâ--teh. Khí--lâi, khì Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô, chiong hit-tiâu io-tòa chhàng tī chio̍h-thâu-phāng.”
Góa chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng, chiong hit-tiâu io-tòa chhàng tī Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hia.
Kè chin chōe ji̍t, Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng, “Lí kóaⁿ-kín khì Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô, chiong góa kiò lí chhàng tī hia ê io-tòa the̍h--lâi.”
Góa chiū khì Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hia, chiong góa chhàng ê io-tòa ó͘--chhut-lâi. Góa chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, io-tòa í-keng nōa--khì, bô lō͘-ēng lah.
Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng, “Góa beh chiàu án-ni phò-hoāi Iû-tāi ê kiau-ngō͘, í-ki̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng koh-khah tōa ê kiau-ngō͘.
Chiah-ê siâ-ok ê jîn-bîn m̄-khéng thiaⁿ góa ê ōe, tè in kò͘-chip ê sim khì pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng; in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-tiâu bô lō͘-ēng ê io-tòa.

Góa ài Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi choân-ke kap góa kiat-liân, chhin-chhiūⁿ io-tòa kap lâng ê seng-khu kiat-liân, chiâⁿ-chòe góa ê chú-bîn, hō͘ góa tit-tio̍h miâ-siaⁿ, chheng-chàn, kap êng-kng; m̄-kú in m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”

Lí khì tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè kā góa kóng: Tio̍h kiò Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiong chiú kā chiú-àng lóng tóe hō͘ tīⁿ. In ōe kóng, ‘Goán soah m̄-chai ta̍k-ê chiú-àng lóng tio̍h tóe hō͘ móa.’
Lí tio̍h tùi in kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh ēng chiú hō͘ chē tī Tāi-pi̍t ông-ūi--ê, chè-si, sian-ti, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘-ū ê lâng lóng lim kah chùi.
Góa beh hō͘ in chùi kah khí chhiong-tu̍t, liân pē-kiáⁿ mā án-ni. Góa bô beh tông-chêng, bô beh thiàⁿ-sioh, bô beh lîn-bín, it-tēng beh kā in thiat-tóe siau-bia̍t.’”
Lín Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ, m̄-thang kiau-ngō͘. Siōng Chú í-keng án-ni soan-pò͘.

Tī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè iáu-bē hō͘ o͘-àm lâi kàu, tī o͘-àm ê soaⁿ--ni̍h lín ê kha iáu-bē poa̍h-tó í-chêng, lín tio̍h chiong êng-kng kui hō͘ I. Nā bô, I ōe hō͘ sí-ìm ê o͘-àm tāi-thòe lín kî-thāi ê kng-bêng.
Lín nā m̄ thiaⁿ, góa ōe in-ūi lín ê kiau-ngō͘ àm-tiong thî-khàu; góa ōe ūi-tio̍h lín thòng-khó͘ lâu ba̍k-sái, in-ūi Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì lah.
Siōng Chú kiò góa tùi ông kap thài-hō͘ kóng, “Lín tio̍h khiam-pi chē tī ē-bīn, in-ūi lín thâu-khak téng súi ê ông-koan í-keng lak--lo̍h-khì.”
Nî-kek-hu hiah-ê siâⁿ ê mn̂g koaiⁿ-tiâu-tiâu, bô lâng chhut-ji̍p; Iû-tāi jîn-bîn lóng siū-lia̍h lah.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tio̍h chù-ì khòaⁿ tùi pak-pêng lâi ê tùi-te̍k. Chá-chêng kau-tài lí chiàu-kò͘, lí só͘ khoa-kháu ê jîn-bîn, taⁿ tī tó-ūi?
Lí í-chêng chai-pôe ê bêng-iú lâi thóng-tī lí, lí iáu ū sím-mi̍h ōe thang kóng? Lí ōe thòng-khó͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ sán-hū chhui-chūn.
Lí siūⁿ-beh chai, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ góa ū chiah-ê chai-lān? Sī-án-chóaⁿ góa ê saⁿ hō͘ lâng thiah-phòa, góa hō͘ lâng kiông-pō?” Sī in-ūi lí hoān ê chōe chin tāng.
Kó͘-si̍t -lâng nā ōe-tàng kái-piàn in ê phê-hu-sek, pà kái-piàn in ê hoe-tiám, lín chiah-ê koàn-sì chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng, mā ōe-tàng chòe hó.

Siōng Chú kóng: Góa beh kā lín kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ khòng-iá ê hong chhe-sòaⁿ chháu-iù. Che sī lín eng-kai tit--tio̍h ê pò-èng; in-ūi lín í-keng bōe-kì-tit góa, khì pài hu-ké ê sîn-bêng.
Góa beh hian lí ê kûn khàm lí ê bīn, hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê kiàn-siàu.

Lí tī soaⁿ-lûn-á, tī iá-gōa ho̍k-sāi hiah-ê sîn-bêng, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhut-siaⁿ kiâⁿ îm-loān khó-ò͘ⁿ ê kéng-siōng, góa lóng ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, lí beh kàu tī-sî chiah ōe chheng-khì? Lí ū chai-hō lah!
Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng-khí iú-koan khòng-hān ê sū.
Iû-tāi ai-siong, i ê siâⁿ-tìn soe-bî, jîn-bîn chē tī thô͘-kha thî-khàu; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng thî-khàu ê siaⁿ thàu kàu thiⁿ-téng.
Hó-gia̍h-lâng chhe lô͘-po̍k khì chhiūⁿ-chúi; in khì kàu chúi-tî chhē bô chúi, tòa khang-khang ê khì-khū, kiàn-siàu, sit-bāng, tà thâu-khak tò--lâi.
Thiⁿ bô lo̍h-hō͘, thó͘-tōe pit-li̍h; choh-sit-lâng mā sit-bāng tà thâu-khak.
In-ūi bô chháu-liāu, iá lo̍k-bú pàng-sak i siⁿ ê lo̍k-á-kiáⁿ.
Iá-lû khiā tī bô chháu koân ê só͘-chāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhâi-lông chhoán tōa-khùi, in-ūi bô chháu thang chia̍h, ba̍k-chiu sit-sîn.
Siōng Chú ah, goán ê chōe nā khòng-kò goán, sui-jiân goán chōe-chōe piàn pōe-poān lí, put-sî tek-chōe lí, kiû lí in-ūi lí ê miâ ê iân-kò͘ chín-kiù goán.
Lí sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê ǹg-bāng, sī goán kan-lân ê sî ê kiù-chú. Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chhut-gōa-lâng, kè chi̍t mî chiū lī-khui?
Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ tio̍h-chhiⁿ-kiaⁿ, bô khùi-la̍t kiù-lâng ê ióng-sū? Siōng Chú, lí khak-si̍t tī goán tiong-kan, goán sī lí ê, kiû lí m̄-thang lī-khui goán.

Koan-hē chiah-ê lâng, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “In chin ài chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù sì-kòe cháu, bô beh iok-sok ka-kī ê kha-pō͘, só͘-í góa bōe chiap-la̍p in. Taⁿ, góa beh kā in ê chōe kì--teh, kā in hêng-hoa̍t.”
Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng, “Lí m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h chiah-ê jîn-bîn tùi góa kiû-chêng.
In chiū-sī kìm-chia̍h kî-tó, góa mā bô beh thiaⁿ; chiū-sī hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap sò͘-chè, góa mā m̄ chiap-la̍p. Góa tian-tò beh ēng to-kiàm, ki-hng, un-e̍k kā in châu-bia̍t.”

Góa chiū kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, hiah-ê sian-ti bat tùi in kóng, ‘Lín bōe ū chiàn-loān, bōe ū ki-hng, in-ūi Siōng Chú ū èng-ún beh tī chit-ê só͘-chāi siúⁿ-sù lín éng-oán ê pêng-an.’”

M̄-kú Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Hiah-ê sian-ti ēng góa ê miâ kóng pe̍h-chha̍t. Góa bô chhe-phài in, mā bô bēng-lēng in, kun-pún to bô tùi in kóng-ōe. In tùi lín kóng ê ū-giân sī hu-ké ê īⁿ-siōng, sī bô lō͘-ēng ê pok-kòa, sī tùi in sim-lāi chhut--lâi khúi-chà ê ōe.

Só͘-í, kóng-tio̍h hiah-ê ēng góa ê miâ kóng pe̍h-chha̍t ê sian-ti, góa bô chhe-phài in; in kóng chit-ê só͘-chāi bōe ū chiàn-cheng kap ki-hng, góa tian-tò beh ēng án-ni kā in siau-bia̍t.

Hiah-ê thiaⁿ in kóng pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe ê jîn-bîn mā ōe ū siâng-khoán ê kiat-kio̍k; in kap in bó͘-kiáⁿ ê sin-si bô lâng tâi, ōe hō͘ lâng hiat tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koe-lō͘. Góa beh in-ūi in ê siâ-ok kā in pò-èng.”
Siōng Chú hoan-hù góa tio̍h tùi chiah-ê jîn-bîn kóng: Goān góa ê ba̍k-sái mî-ji̍t lâu bô-soah, in-ūi góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê jîn-bîn siū-siong chin giâm-tiōng.

Góa chhut-khì chhân-iá, khòaⁿ-tio̍h hō͘ to thâi-sí ê lâng; kiâⁿ-ji̍p siâⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in-ūi ki-hng soah phòa-pīⁿ ê lâng. Chè-si kap sian-ti liû-bông, khì kàu in m̄-chai ê só͘-chāi.

Lí kiám oân-choân khì-sak Iû-tāi? Lí kiám chin-chiàⁿ iàm-ò͘ⁿ Sek-an? Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ kā goán phah kah hō͘ goán bōe-i--tit? Goán kî-thāi hēng-hok hoân-êng, m̄-kú bô chi̍t hāng hó; goán kî-thāi i-tī ê ki-hōe, m̄-kú kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ hut-jiân lâi kàu.
Siōng Chú ah, goán sêng-jīn ka-kī ê chōe, sêng-jīn goán chó͘-sian ê chōe-kò; goán ū tek-chōe lí.
Kiû lí in-ūi lí ê miâ ê iân-kò͘, bô khì-sak goán, bô hō͘ lí êng-kng ê pó-chō siū bú-jio̍k; kiû lí ōe-kì-tit lí kap goán só͘ li̍p ê iok.

Gōa-cho̍k hu-ké ê sîn-bêng, tó chi̍t ê ōe hō͘ thiⁿ lo̍h-hō͘? Thiⁿ kiám ōe ka-kī lo̍h-hō͘? Kiám m̄-sī chí-ū lí Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè chiah ōe! Goán ê ǹg-bāng chāi-tī lí, in-ūi chiah-ê it-chhè lóng sī lí chō--ê.

Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Chiū-sī Mô͘-se kap Sat-bó-ní khiā tī góa ê bīn-chêng thòe Iû-tāi jîn-bîn kî-kiû, góa mā bô beh lîn-bín in. Lí tio̍h chiong in tùi góa ê bīn-chêng kóaⁿ-cháu, kiò in lī-khui!

In nā mn̄g, ‘Goán beh cháu-khì tó-ūi?’ Lí chiū kā in kóng, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Chù-tiāⁿ pīⁿ--sí-ê, ōe pīⁿ-sí; chù-tiāⁿ chiàn--sí-ê, ōe chiàn-sí; chù-tiāⁿ gō--sí-ê, ōe gō-sí; chù-tiāⁿ siū-lia̍h--ê, ōe siū-lia̍h!
Góa Siōng Chú í-keng koat-tēng, in ōe tú-tio̍h sì hāng chai-hāi: Sí tī to-ē, iá-káu thoa--khì, khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu tok--khì, kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê cháu-siù chia̍h--khì.
Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka ê kiáⁿ Má-ná-se tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hoān ê chōe, góa beh hō͘ só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiū iàm-ò͘ⁿ.”
Siōng Chú kóng: Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe khó-lîn lín? Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe ūi lín pi-siong? Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe oa̍t-thâu kā lín chhéng-an?
Lín í-keng lī-khui góa, oa̍t-tńg-sin m̄ chhap góa; góa beh chhun-chhiú kong-kek lín, húi-hoāi lín, bô beh koh lîn-bín lín.
Góa beh tī chit só͘-chāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-tìn, chiong lín kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ iāⁿ be̍h-hiūⁿ. Góa beh siau-bia̍t lín, thâi-sí lín ê jî-lú, in-ūi lín lóng bô hóe-kái.

Góa beh hō͘ lín ê kóaⁿ-hū pí hái-soa khah chōe; góa beh hō͘ húi-bia̍t-chiá thàu-tiong-tàu lâi, kong-kek siàu-liân-lâng ê lāu-bú, hō͘ thòng-khó͘ kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ hut-jiân lîm-kàu in.

Siⁿ chhit ê jî-lú ê lāu-bú soe-jio̍k bô-la̍t; i ê hi-bāng hut-jiân siau-sit, i chiū choa̍t-bāng kiàn-siàu. Góa beh hō͘ in ê tùi-te̍k thâi-sí in chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng, Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

A-bú, góa chin chhiⁿ-chhám! Lí siⁿ góa, góa chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê kap choân-kok jîn-bîn chhiong-tu̍t, hō͘ lâng chí-chek ê lâng. Góa m̄-bat chioh-chîⁿ hō͘ lâng, mā m̄-bat kā pa̍t-lâng chioh-chîⁿ, m̄-kú só͘-ū ê lâng lóng kā góa chiù-chó͘.
Siōng Chú, góa nā bô chīn-sim ho̍k-sāi lí, nā bô ūi-tio̍h tùi-te̍k ê chai-hō tùi lí khún-kiû, goān in tùi góa ê chiù-chó͘ si̍t-hiān.
Kiám ū lâng ōe-tàng kòng-tn̄g thih, te̍k-pia̍t sī tùi pak-hng lâi ê tâng kap thih?
Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa ê chú-bîn tī choân-kok ta̍k só͘-chāi hoān-chōe, só͘-í góa beh chiong in ê châi-hù kap pó-pòe hō͘ tùi-te̍k chhiúⁿ--khì.
Góa beh hō͘ in tī in m̄-bat ê kok-ka chòe tùi-te̍k ê lô͘-lē; góa ê siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ iām-hé kā in sio-bia̍t.”

Góa chiū tùi Siōng Chú kóng, “Siōng Chú, lí ta̍k-hāng lóng chai; kiû lí ōe-kì-tit góa, koàn-kò͘ góa; kiû lí m̄-thang khoan-iông hiah-ê tùi-te̍k, hō͘ in lâi hāi góa; lí tio̍h ōe-kì-tit góa sī in-ūi lí ê iân-kò͘ siū lêng-jio̍k.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè, lí tùi góa kóng ê ōe, góa ta̍k-kù lóng ū thiaⁿ, lí ê ōe hō͘ góa ê sim hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, in-ūi góa sio̍k tī lí.
Góa bô kap chhia-hoa-iàn-lo̍k ê lâng chòe-hé iàn-lo̍k. Góa in-ūi lí ê bēng-lēng, ka-kī chi̍t ê chēng-chēng chē--teh, móa-pak hùn-khài.
Sī-án-chóaⁿ góa ê khó͘-thàng hiah kú bōe soah? Sī-án-chóaⁿ góa siū ê siong bōe-i--tit? Lí kiám chhin-chhiūⁿ ta--khì ê khoe, chhin-chhiūⁿ bōe-khò--tit ê chúi?”

Siōng Chú chiū ìn góa kóng, “Lí nā oa̍t tò-tńg, góa chiū koh chiap-la̍p lí chòe góa ê po̍k-jîn ho̍k-sāi góa; lí nā kóng pó-kùi ê sìn-sit, bô kóng bô lō͘-ēng ê ōe, chiū ōe-tàng chòe góa ê tāi-giân-jîn. Án-ni, jîn-bîn ōe kui-ǹg lí, m̄-kú lí m̄-thang sūn in.

Biān-tùi chiah-ê jîn-bîn, góa beh hō͘ lí chiâⁿ-chòe kian-kò͘ ê tâng-chhiûⁿ. In sui-jiân kong-kek lí, m̄-kú bōe iâⁿ lí, in-ūi góa kap lí tông-chāi, beh kái-kiù lí, pó-hō͘ lí.
Góa beh kiù lí thoat-lī pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhiú, kiông-pō ê lâng ê sè-le̍k. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Lí m̄-thang tī chit-ê só͘-chāi chhōa-bó͘ siⁿ hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Góa kā lí kóng, tī chit-ê só͘-chāi chhut-sì ê gín-á kap in ê pē-bú

ōe sí tī tì-miā ê pīⁿ; bô lâng ūi in ai-khàu, mā bô lâng kā in bâi-chòng. In ê sin-si ōe pàng tī thô͘-kha chiâⁿ-chòe pûi-liāu. In nā m̄-sī hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, chiū-sī gō-sí; in ê si-thé chiâⁿ-chòe pe-chiáu kap cháu-siù ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
“Lí m̄-thang ji̍p song-ka ê chhù, mā m̄-thang ūi in ai-khàu, kā in an-ùi; góa bōe koh sù pêng-an hō͘ góa ê chú-bîn, mā bōe koh lîn-bín in, tùi in si chû-ài.
Bô-lūn hó-gia̍h á-sī sàn-chhiah lóng siâng-khoán ōe sí tī chia, bô lâng kā in bâi-chòng, ūi in ai-khàu; bô lâng ōe koah-siong ka-kī, thì kng-thâu ūi in ai-siong.
Bô lâng ōe the̍h chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ song-ka, ūi-tio̍h in ê ke tú--tio̍h ê sū kā in an-ùi; bô lâng ōe ūi-tio̍h in sit-khì pē-bú hō͘ in lim an-ùi ê chiú.
“Lí m̄-thang ji̍p-khì iàn-lo̍k ê ke kap in chòe-hé lim-chia̍h.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh tī lín ê ba̍k-chiu chêng, tī lín iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî, hō͘ hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k ê siaⁿ, hun-iàn hí-khèng ê siaⁿ lóng tùi chit-ê só͘-chāi siau-sit.

“Lí kā chiah-ê jîn-bîn kóng chiah-ê it-chhè ê ōe ê sî, in ōe mn̄g lí, ‘Sī-án-chóaⁿ Siōng Chú beh kàng chiah tōa ê chai-hō kong-kek goán? Goán sī hoān-tio̍h sím-mi̍h chōe? Tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi tek-chōe Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè?’
Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Lín ê chó͘-sian pōe-poān góa khì tè pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, kā in ho̍k-sāi kèng-pài. In khì-sak góa, bô chun-siú góa ê lu̍t-hoat.
Lín pí lín ê chó͘-sian só͘ chòe--ê koh-khah khó-ò͘ⁿ, lín ta̍k-ê lâng chiàu kò͘-chip siâ-ok ê sim chòe tāi-chì, bô beh sūn-thàn góa.
Só͘-í, góa beh kā lín tùi chit-ê tōe kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, khì kàu lín kap lín ê chó͘-sian lóng m̄-bat ê tōe, mî-ji̍t pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng; góa bô beh koh lîn-bín lín.’”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Sî-ji̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, lâng chiù-chōa ê sî bōe kóng, ‘Góa kí hit-ūi chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p ê éng-oa̍h Siōng Chú chiù-chōa.’

In beh kóng, ‘Góa kí hit-ūi chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui pak-hng ê tōe, lī-khui I kā in liû-hòng--khì ê ta̍k-kok hit-ūi éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa.’ In-ūi góa beh kā in chhōa tńg-khì góa sù hō͘ in chó͘-sian ê thó͘-tōe.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh phài chin chōe lia̍h-hî ê lâng khì lia̍h chiah-ê lâng, āu-lâi koh phài chin chōe phah-la̍h ê lâng khì tōa-soaⁿ, sió-soaⁿ, kap chio̍h-phāng lia̍h in.
In it-chhè ê só͘-chòe góa lóng ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, in ê chōe-ok tī góa ê bīn-chêng lóng bōe-tàng ún-môa am-khàm.

Góa beh ka-pē pò-èng in só͘ hoān it-chhè ê chōe, in-ūi in khì pài hiah-ê khó-ò͘ⁿ, bô sìⁿ-miā ê ngó͘-siōng, phah lâ-sâm góa ê thó͘-tōe, ēng thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê ké-sîn that-móa góa ê sán-gia̍p.”

Siōng Chú ah, lí sī góa ê khùi-la̍t, góa ê pó-lúi, sī góa tú-tio̍h gûi-hiám ê sî ê pī-lān-só͘. Bān-kok ōe tùi thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak lâi kàu lí ê bīn-chêng, kóng, “Goán ê chó͘-sian lâu--lo̍h-lâi--ê sī hu-ké, khang-hu, bô lī-ek ê ngó͘-siōng.
Lâng kiám ōe-tàng ūi ka-kī chō sîn? Chiah-ê ngó͘-siōng lóng m̄-sī chin Sîn.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Chit-piàn góa beh hō͘ in chheng-chhó bat góa ê khùi-la̍t kap koân-lêng, in chiū chai góa ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “ Iû-tāi jîn-bîn ah, lín ê chōe sī ēng thih-pit siá--ê, ēng soān-chio̍h-to khek--ê; siá tī lín ê sim-pán, khek tī lín chè-tôaⁿ ê kak.

Lín lóng teh siàu-liām tī ta̍k-ê soaⁿ-lûn-á, iá-tōe koân ê só͘-chāi, kap ta̍k-châng chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū ē-bīn ê chè-tôaⁿ kap A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng. In-ūi lín tī kéng-lāi ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ só͘ hoān ê chōe, góa beh hō͘ lín ê châi-pó hō͘ tùi-te̍k chhiúⁿ--khì.

Lín ōe sit-khì góa sù hō͘ lín ê sán-gia̍p; góa beh hō͘ lín ê tùi-te̍k kā lín lia̍h-khì lín m̄-bat ê kok-ka ho̍k-sāi in, in-ūi lín jiá góa siū-khì; góa siū-khì ê hé éng-oán bōe hoa.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Óa-khò sè-kan-lâng, siong-sìn jio̍k-thé ê khùi-la̍t, sim lī-khui Siōng Chú ê lâng, chit-khoán lâng ōe siū chiù-chó͘.
In ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ soa-bô͘ tiong ê sòe-châng chhiū-á, hēng-hok lâi ê sî khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h; in ōe tòa tī ta-sò ê khòng-iá, bô lâng khiā-khí ê kiâm-tōe.
“Óa-khò Siōng Chú, choan-sim sìn-khò góa ê lâng, chit-khoán lâng chin ū hok-khì!
In chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū chai tī chúi-piⁿ, tèng-kun tī khoe-chúi piⁿ, m̄ kiaⁿ iām-jia̍t, hio̍h chhiⁿ-chhùi bō͘-sēng; khòng-hān ê sî lóng m̄-bián khòa-lū, ōe put-toān kiat ké-chí.
“Lâng ê sim pí sím-mi̍h lóng khah khúi-chà, bô io̍h thang i, sím-mi̍h-lâng bat ōe thàu?
Góa Siōng Chú bat lâng ê sim, chhâ-giām lâng ê sim-su, beh chiàu ta̍k-ê lâng ê só͘-chòe pò-èng in.”

Ēng bô chèng-tong ê chhiú-tōaⁿ hoat-châi--ê, chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-chiáu teh pū m̄-sī ka-kī siⁿ ê nn̄g, tiong-liân ê sî ōe sit-khì châi-hù, kàu lō͘-bé ōe pìⁿ-chòe gû-gōng ê lâng.
Goán ê sèng-só͘ sī êng-kng ê pó-chō, tùi kó͘-chá chiū khiā tī koân-koân ê só͘-chāi.

Siōng Chú ah, lí sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê ǹg-bāng! Khì-sak lí--ê lóng ōe kiàn-siàu; in ōe siau-sit, chhin-chhiūⁿ miâ siá tī thô͘-kha, in-ūi in khì-sak Siōng Chú — oa̍h-chúi ê goân-thâu.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí i-tī góa, góa chiū ōe tit-tio̍h i-hó; kiû lí chín-kiù góa, góa chiū ōe tit-tio̍h kái-kiù. Lí sī góa só͘ chheng-chàn--ê.
Lâng tùi góa kóng, “Siōng Chú kéng-kò ê ōe tī tó-ūi? Nā ū, tio̍h hō͘ i si̍t-hiān.”
Siōng Chú ah! Góa m̄-bat tô-pī chòe bo̍k-chiá ê chit-hūn bô kun-tè lí, mā m̄-bat ǹg-bāng in ū chi̍t ji̍t ōe tú-tio̍h chai-lān. Góa ê chhùi só͘ kóng--ê lí lóng chai.
Kiû lí m̄-thang kā góa heh-kiaⁿ, in-ūi lí sī góa hoān-lān ê sî ê pī-lān-só͘.
Kiû lí hō͘ pek-hāi góa ê lâng kiàn-siàu kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, m̄-thang hō͘ góa kiàn-siàu kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; kiû lí kàng chai-hō hō͘ in, kā in thiat-tóe siau-bia̍t.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Lí khì khiā tī Iû-tāi kun-ông chhut-ji̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe keng-kè ê Piān-ngá-bín-mn̂g, kap ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu,
tùi in kóng, ‘ Iû-tāi kun-ông kap jîn-bîn, í-ki̍p só͘-ū tùi chiah-ê siâⁿ-mn̂g chhut-ji̍p ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chū-bîn, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe.
Siōng Chú kóng: Lín tio̍h sòe-jī, m̄-thang tī An-hioh-ji̍t poaⁿ mi̍h-kiāⁿ, tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiah-ê siâⁿ-mn̂g chhut-ji̍p,
mā m̄-thang poaⁿ jīm-hô mi̍h-kiāⁿ chhut-mn̂g, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h kang-chok lóng m̄-thang chòe. Tio̍h chiàu góa tùi lín chó͘-sian ê bēng-lēng, siú An-hioh-ji̍t chòe sèng-ji̍t.’
M̄-kú in m̄ thiaⁿ; in ngī-sim, m̄ siū-kà.
“Siōng Chú koh kóng: Lín nā chù-ì thiaⁿ góa ê ōe, bô tī An-hioh-ji̍t poaⁿ mi̍h-kiāⁿ tùi chiah-ê siâⁿ-mn̂g chhut-ji̍p, siú chit-ji̍t chòe sèng-ji̍t, bô chòe jīm-hô kang-chok,

án-ni, lín chiū ōe ū sòa-chiap Tāi-pi̍t chē ông-ūi ê kun-ông kap in ê koaⁿ-oân khiâ-bé chē bé-chhia, kap Iû-tāi -lâng, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chū-bîn, chòe-hé tùi chiah-ê siâⁿ-mn̂g chhut-ji̍p; chit-ê siâⁿ mā ōe éng-oán ū lâng khiā-khí.

Lín mā ōe ū jîn-bîn tùi Iû-tāi ta̍k siâⁿ-tìn, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiu-ûi ta̍k chng-siā, Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu, soaⁿ-po͘, soaⁿ-tōe, kap Nî-kek-hu tòa sio-hòa-chè, pêng-an-chè, sò͘-chè, jú-hiuⁿ, í-ki̍p siā-un-chè lâi góa ê sèng-tiān.

M̄-kú, in nā bô beh thiaⁿ-thàn góa, bô siú An-hioh-ji̍t chòe sèng-ji̍t, tī An-hioh-ji̍t poaⁿ mi̍h-kiāⁿ tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-mn̂g chhut-ji̍p, góa chiū beh pàng-hé sio siâⁿ-mn̂g; tōa-hé ōe thun-chia̍h Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê kiong-tiān, bô lâng phah ōe hoa.”
Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng,
“Lí khì sio-hûi-lâng ê chhù, góa beh tī hia tùi lí kóng-ōe.”
Góa chiū khì sio-hûi-lâng ê chhù, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i teh se̍h tńg-pôaⁿ chòe hûi-khì.
I chhiú-tiong só͘ chòe ê hûi, chòe bô hó-sè, chiū ēng hit-tè hûi-thô͘ lēng-gōa chòe i kah-ì ê hûi-khì.
Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng,

“ Í-sek-lia̍t -ke ah, góa kiám bōe-tàng chhin-chhiūⁿ sio-hûi-lâng án-ni tùi-thāi lín? Hûi-thô͘ tī sio-hûi-lâng ê chhiú--ni̍h án-chóaⁿ, lín tī góa ê chhiú--ni̍h mā siâng-khoán.
Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h sî, góa soan-pò͘ beh pu̍ih-chhut, thiah-húi, á-sī phò-hoāi chi̍t ê kok-ka,
hit-ê kok-ka nā lī-khui siâ-ok, góa chiū ōe hôe-sim-tńg-ì, bô kàng chai-hō hō͘ in.
Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h sî, góa soan-pò͘ beh chai-chèng, tiông-kiàn chi̍t ê kok-ka,
hit-ê kok-ka nā m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe, chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, góa chiū ōe kái-piàn sim-ì, bô beh chiong góa só͘ èng-ún ê hok-khì sù hō͘ in.

Taⁿ, lí tio̍h tùi Iû-tāi -lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa koat-tēng beh chhú-hoa̍t lín, kàng chai-hō hō͘ lín; lín tio̍h hôe-thâu lī-khui lín siâ-ok ê hêng-ûi, kái-chèng lín ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe.
In ōe ìn kóng: Lí kóng che bô lō͘-ēng lah! Goán beh chiàu ka-kī ê kè-ōe kiâⁿ, ta̍k-ê lâng chiàu siâ-ok ê pún-sèng chòe.’”
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Lín mn̄g chiah-ê kok-ka, ū sím-mi̍h-lâng thiaⁿ-kè chit-khoán tāi-chì? Í-sek-lia̍t kèng-jiân chòe chiah-ni̍h khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū!
Lê-pa-lūn soaⁿ-téng ê seh kiám bat iûⁿ--kè? Soaⁿ-téng lâu--lo̍h-lâi chheng-liâng ê khoe-chúi kiám ōe ta--khì?

M̄-kú, góa ê jîn-bîn bōe-kì-tit góa, kā hu-ké ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ, tì-kàu in tī eng-kai kiâⁿ ê lō͘ poa̍h-tó; in bô kiâⁿ kó͘-chá ê chiàⁿ-lō͘, tian-tò khì kiâⁿ khâm-khia̍t oai-chhoa̍h ê lō͘.
In ê thó͘-tōe pìⁿ-chòe pha-hng ê só͘-chāi, éng-oán hō͘ lâng thí-chhiò; kè-lō͘ ê lâng lóng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ hàiⁿ-thâu.
Góa beh tī tùi-te̍k ê bīn-chêng chhin-chhiūⁿ tang-hong kā góa ê chú-bîn chhe-sòaⁿ; góa beh tī in tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê sî, oa̍t-tńg-sin m̄ chhap in.”

In kóng, “Lâi, lán lâi siat-kè tùi-hù Iâ-lī-bí! Lán put-sî ū chè-si kà lu̍t-hoat, ū tì-hūi ê lâng chhut kè-tì, mā ū sian-ti thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè ê ōe. Lán lâi khòng-kò Iâ-lī-bí, mài koh thiaⁿ i ê ōe.”
In-ūi án-ni, góa kî-tó kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ góa ê khún-kiû, mā thiaⁿ góa ê tùi-te̍k khòng-kò góa ê ōe.
Lâng kiám ōe-ēng-tit ēng pháiⁿ pò hó? In ó͘ hām-chíⁿ beh hāi góa. Kiû lí ōe-kì-tit góa án-chóaⁿ tī lí ê bīn-chêng thòe in kóng hó-ōe, hō͘ lí bô tùi in hoat siū-khì.

M̄-kú, chit-sî góa kiû lí hō͘ in ê jî-lú tú-tio̍h ki-hng, sí tī to-kiàm; hō͘ in ê bó͘ sit-khì tiōng-hu kap kiáⁿ-jî, ta-po͘-lâng hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, siàu-liân-lâng sí tī chiàn-tiûⁿ.

Kiû lí phài chi̍t tōa-tīn kiông-tō hut-jiân lâi kàu, hō͘ kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ thî-khàu ê siaⁿ tùi chhù-lāi thoân--chhut-lâi; in-ūi in ó͘ hām-chíⁿ beh lia̍h góa, ēng lô-bāng beh hō͘ góa poa̍h-tó.

Siōng Chú ah, lí chai in siat-kè beh thâi góa, kiû lí m̄-thang sià-bián in ê chōe, m̄-thang chhat-siau in ê chōe-kò; kiû lí hō͘ in tī lí ê bīn-chêng sit-pāi kiàn-siàu; kiû lí hoat tōa siū-khì kā in hêng-hoa̍t.”
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Lí tio̍h khì kā sio-hûi-lâng bóe hûi-pân, koh chhōa jîn-bîn tiong-kan ê tiúⁿ-ló kap chè-si tiong-kan siū chun-tiōng--ê,
kè Hap-ní-se-mn̂g, khì Him-lūn-chú Soaⁿ-kok, tī hia soan-pò͘ góa hoan-hù lí ê ōe,

kóng, ‘ Iû-tāi kun-ông kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe! Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh kàng chai-hō tī chit-ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng lóng kiaⁿ-chi̍t-tiô.

In-ūi in kap in ê lia̍t-chó͘, í-ki̍p Iû-tāi kun-ông lóng khì-sak góa, kā in m̄-bat ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ, hō͘ chit-ê só͘-chāi pìⁿ-chòe gōa-pang-lâng ê tōe, chi̍t-sì-kòe lóng sī bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih.

In koh ūi-tio̍h Pa-le̍k khí soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, chiong in ê kiáⁿ-jî chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Pa-le̍k. Góa m̄-bat bēng-lēng in chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì, m̄-bat thê-khí, liân siūⁿ to m̄-bat siūⁿ--kè.
Lín tio̍h chai, sî-ji̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, chit-ê só͘-chāi bōe koh kiò-chòe Tô-hui-te̍k á-sī Him-lūn-chú Soaⁿ-kok, beh kiò-chòe Tô͘-sat ê soaⁿ-kok. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Góa beh tī chia hō͘ Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng jîn-bîn ê kè-bô͘ lo̍k-khong, mā beh hō͘ in ê tùi-te̍k thâi-iâⁿ, hō͘ in sí tī siàu-siūⁿ in sìⁿ-miā ê lâng ê chhiú; in ê si-thé ōe chiâⁿ-chòe khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê iá-siù ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Góa beh hō͘ chit-ê siâⁿ chiâⁿ-chòe thang kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, hō͘ lâng thí-chhiò ê tùi-siōng; tùi chia keng-kè ê lâng ōe in-ūi in só͘ tú--tio̍h ê chai-hō tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kā in thí-chhiò.
Tùi-te̍k, chiū-sī siàu-siūⁿ in sìⁿ-miā ê lâng, ōe lâi pau-ûi chit-ê siâⁿ, kā in pek kah in tio̍h chia̍h ka-kī ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p in ê pêng-iú ê bah.’
“Lí kóng soah, tio̍h kā hit-ê hûi-pân siak-phòa, hō͘ kap lí chòe-hé khì ê lâng chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h,

koh kā in kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng: Góa beh phah chit-ê siâⁿ kap chiah-ê jîn-bîn, chhin-chhiūⁿ kā sio-hûi-lâng ê hûi-khì siak-phòa, phòa kah bōe-pó͘--tit. Lâng beh tī Tô-hui-te̍k bâi-chòng sí-lâng, tâi kah bô só͘-chāi thang tâi.
Siōng Chú kóng: Góa beh án-ni tùi-thāi chit-ê só͘-chāi kap chia ê chū-bîn, hō͘ chit-ê siâⁿ kap Tô-hui-te̍k kâng-khoán.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chhù í-ki̍p Iû-tāi kun-ông ê kiong-tiān mā ōe kap Tô-hui-te̍k kâng-khoán siū phah lâ-sâm, in-ūi in tī chhù-téng kā thiⁿ-téng ê bān-siōng sio-hiuⁿ, ǹg pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng hiàn tiān-chiú-chè.’”
Iâ-lī-bí tùi Siōng Chú chhe i khì thoân-ta̍t bēng-lēng ê Tô-hui-te̍k tò--lâi, khiā tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ, tùi jîn-bîn kóng,

“Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ chit-ê siâⁿ kap i chiu-ûi ê siâⁿ-tìn, in-ūi hiah-ê chū-bîn ngī-sim kò͘-chip, m̄-khéng thiaⁿ góa ê ōe.”
Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê chóng-koán, Im-be̍k ê kiáⁿ chè-si Pa-si-hō͘-ní thiaⁿ-tio̍h sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí kóng ê ōe,
chiū phah i, koh ēng chhâ-kông kā i khàu tī sèng-tiān pak-pêng ê Piān-ngá-bín-mn̂g.

Tē-jī ji̍t, Pa-si-hō͘-ní chiah chiong sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí pàng-khui. Iâ-lī-bí tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú bô beh koh kiò lí chòe Pa-si-hō͘-ní, beh kā lí kiò-chòe Má-ko-ní Bí-sat-pit.

Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Góa beh hō͘ lí kap lí ê pêng-iú lóng tio̍h-kiaⁿ; lí beh chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h in hō͘ tùi-te̍k thâi-sí. Góa beh chiong Iû-tāi -lâng kau tī Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê chhiú; i beh kā in lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn, á-sī ēng to kā in thâi-sí.

Góa mā beh chiong chit-ê siâⁿ só͘-ū ê châi-bu̍t, chiū-sī lín lô-khó͘ tit--tio̍h-ê kap pó-kùi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, í-ki̍p Iû-tāi lia̍t-ông ê pó-pòe, lóng kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k; in beh chiong só͘-ū ê it-chhè lóng chhiúⁿ--khì, tòa-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
Pa-si-hō͘-ní, lí kap lí ke-lāi só͘-ū ê lâng lóng ōe siū-lia̍h khì Pa-pí-lûn; lí kap só͘-ū thiaⁿ lí kóng ké ū-giân ê pêng-iú, lóng ōe sí tī hia, tâi tī hia.’”
Siōng Chú ah, lí phiàn góa, góa hō͘ lí pián--khì. Lí pí góa khah kiông, iâⁿ-kè góa. Góa ta̍k-ji̍t chiâⁿ-chòe lâng thí-chhiò ê tùi-siōng; in lóng hì-lāng góa.
Góa ta̍k-piàn kóng-ōe lóng chin tōa-siaⁿ; góa hoah kóng, “Ū kiông-pō kap húi-bia̍t!” Siōng Chú ê ōe hāi góa ta̍k-ji̍t hō͘ lâng lóe-mē, thí-chhiò.

Góa nā kóng “Góa bô beh koh thê-khí Siōng Chú, bô beh koh hōng I ê miâ kóng-ōe”, góa ê lāi-bīn chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ ū hé teh to̍h, chǹg-ji̍p góa ê kut-thâu; góa tòng bōe tiâu, bô hoat-tō͘ bô kóng.

Góa koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chin chōe lâng sòe-siaⁿ kóng, “Hit-ê kóng ‘Ta̍k só͘-chāi ōe ū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ’ ê lâng lâi lah, lán lâi kò i, lâi kā i khòng-kò.” Góa ê pêng-iú tán beh khòaⁿ góa hoān-chhò, in kóng: Tán i hō͘ lâng pián--khì, lán chiū ōe-tàng lia̍h-tio̍h ki-hōe kā i pò-ho̍k.

Chóng-sī, Siōng Chú kap góa tông-chāi; I chhin-chhiūⁿ kiông-béng khó-phàⁿ ê ióng-sū. Hiah-ê ap-pek góa ê lâng lóng ōe poa̍h-tó sit-pāi, ōe kiàn-siàu làu-khùi; lâng éng-oán bōe bōe-kì-tit in ê kiàn-siàu.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ah, lí kàm-chhat lâng ê sim-su liām-thâu, chiàu kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ. Góa chiong góa ê àn-kiāⁿ kau hō͘ lí, kiû lí hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí chú-chhî kong-tō.
Tio̍h ǹg Siōng Chú chhiùⁿ-koa! Tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú! In-ūi I kái-kiù siū ap-pek ê lâng thoat-lī siâ-ok ê lâng ê chhiú.
Goān góa chhut-sì hit-ji̍t siū chiù-chó͘; goān góa ê lāu-bú siⁿ góa hit-ji̍t bô siū chiok-hok.
Goān hit-ê kā góa ê lāu-pē pò siau-sit ê lâng siū chiù-chó͘! I kóng “Lí tit-tio̍h chi̍t ê ta-po͘-eⁿ”, hō͘ góa ê lāu-pē thiaⁿ-liáu chin hoaⁿ-hí.

Goān hit-ê lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ Siōng Chú húi-bia̍t, bô tit-tio̍h lîn-bín ê siâⁿ. Goān i chá-khí-sî thiaⁿ-tio̍h ai-khàu ê siaⁿ, tiong-tàu-sî thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiàn-cheng kéng-pò ê siaⁿ.
In-ūi i bô tī góa chhut-sì í-chêng kā góa thâi-sí, bô hō͘ góa ê lāu-bú ê pak-tó͘ chiâⁿ-chòe góa ê hûn-bōng.
Góa sī-án-chóaⁿ tio̍h chhut-sì? Góa ê keng-le̍k lóng sī lô-khó͘ kap iu-siong. Góa tio̍h tī siū bú-jio̍k ê tiong-kan kiat-sok góa ê jîn-seng sī--bô?

Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Iâ-lī-bí. Hit-sî, Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka chhe-phài Má-ki-ngá ê kiáⁿ Pa-si-hō͘-ní, kap Má-se-ngá ê kiáⁿ chè-si Se-hoan-ngá khì Iâ-lī-bí hia. In iau-kiû, kóng,

“ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat phài kun-tūi lâi kong-táⁿ chit-ê siâⁿ, chhiáⁿ thòe goán khún-kiû Siōng Chú, bô-tiāⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú ōe ēng kî-biāu ê hong-hoat hō͘ Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat thiat-thè.”
Iâ-lī-bí chiū tùi in kóng, “Lín khì kā Se-tí-ka kóng,

‘Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Se-tí-ka, lí hiah-ê chhut-khì siâⁿ-gōa tí-khòng Pa-pí-lûn -ông kap i ê kun-tūi--ê, góa beh chiong in chhiú--ni̍h gia̍h ê bú-khì lóng siu tò-lâi khǹg tī siâⁿ-lāi.
Góa beh tī tōa siū-khì tiong ēng só͘-ū ê khùi-la̍t kong-kek lín.
Góa beh kong-kek siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn kap tōng-bu̍t, in ōe in-ūi un-e̍k sí.

Lí kap lí ê koaⁿ-oân, í-ki̍p keng-kè chiàn-loān, un-e̍k, ki-hng chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng, góa beh chiong in kau hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat, chiū-sī beh hāi lín sìⁿ-miā ê tùi-te̍k. Pa-pí-lûn -ông bōe lîn-bín lín, bōe tông-chêng lín, ōe ēng to-kiàm thâi-sí lín, bōe chhiú-hā-liû-chêng. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.’”
Siōng Chú koh hoan-hù Iâ-lī-bí tùi jîn-bîn kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa kā oa̍h-lō͘ kap sí-lō͘ pâi tī lín ê bīn-chêng, lín ka-kī soán-te̍k.
Lâu tī siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng, nā m̄-sī hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, chiū-sī gō-sí á-sī pīⁿ-sí; m̄-kú lín nā chhut-siâⁿ khì kā Pa-pí-lûn -lâng tâu-hâng, chiū ōe oa̍h.

Góa í-keng koat-tēng bô beh sù hok-khì, beh kàng chai-hō tī chit-ê siâⁿ. Chit-ê siâⁿ beh kau tī Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê chhiú; i ōe pàng-hé sio chit-ê siâⁿ.’ Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”

Siōng Chú hoan-hù Iâ-lī-bí kā Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi — Iû-tāi ông-sek kóng, “Lín tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ góa Siōng Chú kóng ê ōe. Lín ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h péng-kong-hêng-gī, tùi khi-ap ê lâng ê chhiú kái-kiù siū ap-chè ê lâng, chiah bián lín siâ-ok ê hêng-ûi jiá góa siū-khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh to̍h bô lâng phah ōe hoa.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, góa beh kong-kek lí; lí chē tī koân-koân ê soaⁿ-téng, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa chio̍h chhāi tī pêng-goân. Lí khoa-kháu bô lâng ōe-tàng kong-kek lí, ōe-tàng kong-ji̍p lí tô-siám ê só͘-chāi.

M̄-kú, góa beh in-ūi lí ê hêng-ûi kā lí chhú-hoa̍t. Góa beh pàng-hé sio Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê kiong-tiān; tōa-hé ōe thun-bia̍t siâⁿ sì-chiu-ûi só͘-ū ê it-chhè. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Siōng Chú kiò góa ji̍p-khì Iû-tāi ông-kiong, kā chē Tāi-pi̍t ông-ūi ê Iû-tāi -ông, koaⁿ-oân, í-ki̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê jîn-bîn kóng, “Tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lín tio̍h péng-kong-hêng-gī, tùi khi-ap ê lâng ê chhiú kái-kiù siū ap-chè ê lâng; m̄-thang ge̍k-thāi á-sī ēng kiông-pō ê chhiú-tōaⁿ tùi-thāi gōa-cho̍k-lâng, ko͘-jî, kóaⁿ-hū, mā m̄-thang tī chit-tè thó͘-tōe lâu bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih.

Lín nā chhiat-si̍t chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng, chē Tāi-pi̍t pó-chō ê kun-ông, kap hiah-ê koaⁿ-oân, jîn-bîn chiū thang chē bé-chhia á-sī khiâ-bé, keng-kè siâⁿ-mn̂g chìn-ji̍p ông-kiong.
M̄-kú lín nā bô beh ho̍k-chiông góa ê bēng-lēng, góa kí ka-kī li̍p-sè, chit-ê kiong-tiān ōe chiâⁿ-chòe hong-po͘. Góa Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

“‘Tùi góa Siōng Chú lâi khòaⁿ, Iû-tāi ê ông-kiong chhin-chhiūⁿ Ki-lia̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ Lê-pa-lūn ê soaⁿ-téng hiah-ni̍h súi; m̄-kú góa beh hō͘ i pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘, bô lâng khiā-khí.
Góa ōe phài lâng kā i húi-bia̍t; in ōe tòa pó͘-thâu lâi chhò-tn̄g hiah-ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū chòe ê thiāu, kā hiat-lo̍h hé.
“‘Ōe ū chin chōe gōa-cho̍k-lâng keng-kè chit-ê siâⁿ, hō͘-siōng kóng-lâi-kóng-khì: Siōng Chú sī-án-chóaⁿ án-ni tùi-thāi chit-ê tōa ê siâⁿ?
Ū lâng ōe kóng: Sī in-ūi chit-ê siâⁿ ê lâng ûi-pōe Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè kap in li̍p ê iok, khì ho̍k-sāi kèng-pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng.’”

Iû-tāi -lâng, m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h í-keng sí--khì ê ông ai-khàu, m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h i pi-siong; tio̍h ūi i ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-su ai-khàu, in-ūi Iok-hap-su siū-lia̍h bōe koh tńg--lâi, bōe-tàng koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h ka-kī ê hiong-thó͘.
Iú-koan kè-sêng i ê lāu-pē Iok-se-a chòe Iû-tāi -ông ê Iok-hap-su, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “I siū-lia̍h lī-khui chit-ê só͘-chāi, éng-oán bōe koh tńg--lâi.
I ōe sí tī siū lia̍h--khì ê só͘-chāi, bōe-tàng koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-tè thó͘-tōe.”

Chit-ê lâng ū chai-hō lah! I ēng bô kong-gī ê chhiú-tōaⁿ khí ka-kī ê kiong-tiān, ēng bô kong-tō ê hong-hoat khí lâu-á-chhù; i hō͘ ka-kī ê tông-pau chòe pe̍h-kang, lóng bô hō͘ in kang-chîⁿ.
I kóng, “Góa beh ūi ka-kī khí koân-lâu-tōa-chhù, kā chhù khui thang-á, ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ chong-hông, piah-pang chhat âng-sek.”

Lí ēng pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ chō ko-kùi ê kiong-tiān, beh piáu-sī lí pí pa̍t-lâng khah gâu choh-ông sī--bô? Lí ê lāu-pē kiám m̄-sī péng-kong-hêng-gī, chi̍t-sì-lâng hióng-siū hok-khì, sū-sū heng-thong?
I ūi khùn-khó͘ kap sàn-chhiah ê lâng sin-oan, hit-sî i sū-sū heng-thong; che kiám m̄-sī in-ūi i chin-chiàⁿ bat góa? Siōng Chú án-ni kóng.
M̄-kú lí ê sim-ba̍k kan-ta khòaⁿ ka-kī ê lī-ek, lâu bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih, khi-hū ap-chè jîn-bîn.

Só͘-í, chiam-tùi Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kèng, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Bô lâng ōe ūi-tio̍h i ai-siong, kóng, “Ài ah, góa ê hiaⁿ-tī, góa ê chí-bē!” Bô lâng ōe ūi-tio̍h i ai-khàu, kóng, “Ài ah, góa ê chú, góa ê ông!”
I siū bâi-chòng chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng teh tâi lû-á, hō͘ lâng thoa-cháu, hiat chhut-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siâⁿ-gōa.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h peh-chiūⁿ Lê-pa-lūn-soaⁿ tōa-siaⁿ hoah! Khì Pa-san tōa-siaⁿ khàu! Khì Mô͘-ap ê soaⁿ-téng tōa-siaⁿ hoah! Kap lí kiat-bêng ê pêng-iú lóng siū phah-pāi lah.
Lín chá-chêng an-tēng ê sî, góa kéng-kò lín, lín lóng m̄ thiaⁿ! Lín tùi siàu-liân chiū án-ni, m̄ thiaⁿ góa ê ōe.
Lín ê siú-léng ōe hō͘ hong chhe-cháu; kap lín kiat-bêng ê pêng-iú ōe siū-lia̍h. Lín lóng ōe siū bú-jio̍k, in-ūi lín ê só͘-chòe lóng sī pháiⁿ.
Lín tòa tī Lê-pa-lūn, tī pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ khí ê kiong-tiān, lín lia̍h chòe an-choân; chai-lān chi̍t-ē kàu, lín ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hū-jîn-lâng chhui-chūn, thòng-khó͘ ai-kiò.

Siōng Chú tùi Iok-ngá-kèng ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kun kóng, “Góa beh kí góa éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè, sui-jiân lí sī góa chiàⁿ-chhiú ê chhiú-chí-ìn, góa mā beh kā lí pak--lo̍h-lâi,
kau hō͘ hiah-ê lí só͘ kiaⁿ, beh thâi lí ê lâng, chiū-sī Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat kap i ê kun-tūi.
Góa beh chiong lí kap lí ê lāu-bú kóaⁿ-khì gōa-kok, khì m̄-sī lín chhut-sì ê só͘-chāi; lín ōe sí tī hia.
Lín chin ài tò--lâi, m̄-kú éng-oán bōe-tàng tò--lâi.”

Siōng Chú koh kóng, “ Iok-ngá-kun kiám m̄-sī chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t tè phò-chhùi, bô lâng beh ti̍h ê pôaⁿ-á? Sī-án-chóaⁿ i kap i ê kiáⁿ-jî, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ lóng siū hiat-ka̍k, liû-bông tī gōa-tōe?
Tāi-tōe ah, tāi-tōe! Tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe.

Tio̍h kì chi̍t pit: Chit-ê lâng bô hō͘-sû, sī it-seng lóng bô sêng-chiū ê lâng; i bô hō͘-tāi kè-sêng Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-ūi, thang kè-sio̍k thóng-tī Iû-tāi.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Hiah-ê sat-hāi koh kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ góa chháu-tiûⁿ ê iûⁿ ê bo̍k-chiá ū chai-hō lah!

Koan-hē chiah-ê tio̍h bo̍k-ióng Siōng Chú chú-bîn ê bo̍k-chiá, Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lín bô chiàu-kò͘ góa ê iûⁿ, koh kā in kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ, lín tio̍h chai, góa beh in-ūi lín ê pháiⁿ hêng-ûi kā lín chhú-hoa̍t.
Góa beh chū-chi̍p hiah-ê chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê iûⁿ, tùi góa kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ in khì ê só͘-chāi kā in chhōa--tò-lâi, hō͘ in siⁿ-thòaⁿ koh ke-thiⁿ chin chōe.
Góa beh phài sin ê bo̍k-chiá bo̍k-ióng in. Góa ê iûⁿ-kûn bōe koh sit-táⁿ kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, liân chi̍t chiah to bōe sit-lo̍h.’ Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Sî-ji̍t teh-beh kàu, góa beh hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t ê sè-hē hoat chi̍t ki kong-gī ê Ki. I tī-kok hiân-bêng, tī chit-ê thó͘-tōe si-hêng kong-pêng kap chèng-gī.
In-ūi i ê chip-chèng, Iû-tāi beh tit-tio̍h kái-kiù, Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ōe-tàng an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p. Lâng ōe kā i kiò-chòe ‘Siōng Chú sī goán ê kong-gī’.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Sî-ji̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, lâng chiù-chōa ê sî bōe koh kóng, ‘Góa kí hit-ūi chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa.’

In beh kóng, ‘Góa kí hit-ūi chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui pak-hng ê tōe, lī-khui I kā in liû-hòng--khì ê ta̍k-kok hit-ūi éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa.’ In ōe khiā-khí tī ka-kī ê hiong-thó͘.”

Kóng-tio̍h hiah-ê sian-ti, góa ê sim chhì-chha̍k, góa kui seng-khu ê kut-thâu kho̍k-kho̍k-tiô; ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú kap I sîn-sèng ê ōe, góa chhin-chhiūⁿ chiú-chùi ê lâng, bōe-tàng khòng-chè ka-kī.
Chit-ê tōe sì-kòe lóng sī tùi Siōng Chú put-tiong ê lâng; in ê só͘-chòe siâ-ok, lām-iōng koân-le̍k. In siū chiù-chó͘, tōe chiū khòng-hān, chháu-tiûⁿ ko͘-tâ.
Siōng Chú kóng: Sian-ti kap chè-si lóng siat-to̍k góa, tī góa ê sèng-tiān chòe siâ-ok ê sū.
In kiâⁿ ê lō͘ àm koh ku̍t, hō͘ lâng tui-jip, tī hia poa̍h-tó. Góa hêng-hoa̍t in ê ji̍t kàu lah; góa beh hō͘ chai-hō lîm-kàu in.
Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Sat-má-lī-a ê sian-ti chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū: In hōng Pa-le̍k sîn-bêng ê miâ kóng ū-giân, chhōa góa ê jîn-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t kiâⁿ chhò-gō͘ ê lō͘.

Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sian-ti chòe khó-phàⁿ ê sū: In hoān kan-îm, kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, ka-kiông pháiⁿ-lâng ê sè-le̍k, só͘-í bô lâng lī-khui siâ-ok. Tùi góa lâi khòaⁿ, in lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ Só͘-to-má, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn chhin-chhiūⁿ Gô-mô͘-la.

Só͘-í, góa Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chiam-tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sian-ti kóng: Góa beh hō͘ in chia̍h khó͘-kó, lim to̍k-chúi, in-ūi ta̍k só͘-chāi bô kèng-khiân ê hong-khì sī in chō-sêng--ê.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng jîn-bîn kóng, “M̄-thang thiaⁿ chiah-ê sian-ti ê ōe; in thoân hō͘ lín--ê sī hu-ké ê ǹg-bāng. In kóng ê ū-giân sī ka-kī siūⁿ--ê, m̄-sī góa thoân hō͘ in--ê.
In it-ti̍t tùi hiah-ê m̄-khéng thiaⁿ góa ê ōe ê lâng kóng, ‘Siōng Chú kóng: Pêng-an bô-sū!’ Koh tùi hiah-ê sim-ngī ê lâng kóng, ‘Chai-hō bōe lîm-kàu lín.’
“Kiám ū lâng chham-ka Siōng Chú thian-têng ê gī-hōe, bat khòaⁿ--tio̍h á-sī thiaⁿ-tio̍h I kóng-ōe? In kiám ū jīn-chin thiaⁿ I kóng ê ōe?
Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú ê tōa siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ kńg-lê-á-hong, tī pháiⁿ-lâng ê thâu-khak téng tńg-se̍h.
Kàu Siōng Chú ê kè-ōe oân-choân si̍t-hiān, I ê siū-khì chiah ōe soah; sî-ji̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, lín chiah ōe chheng-chhó bêng-pe̍k chiah-ê sū.
“Góa bô chhe-phài chiah-ê sian-ti, m̄-kú in ka-kī sì-kòe cháu; góa bô tùi in kóng-ōe, m̄-kú in ka-kī kóng ū-giân.
In nā bat chham-ka góa tiàu-chi̍p ê gī-hōe, chiū ōe tùi góa ê jîn-bîn thoân-ta̍t góa ê sìn-sit, hō͘ jîn-bîn lī-khui chōe-ok ê lō͘, bô chòe siâ-ok ê sū.
“Góa Siōng Chú mn̄g lín, ‘Góa kiám kan-ta tī kūn ê só͘-chāi chiah sī Siōng-tè, tī hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi chiū m̄-sī Siōng-tè?’
Góa koh mn̄g lín, ‘Kiám ū lâng ōe-tàng bih tī ún-ba̍t ê só͘-chāi hō͘ góa khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h? Góa kiám m̄-sī chhiong-móa tī thiⁿ-tōe ta̍k kak-lo̍h?’
Hiah-ê sian-ti ēng góa ê miâ kóng ké ê ū-giân, kóng, ‘Góa ū bāng-kìⁿ! Góa ū bāng-kìⁿ!’
In sim chûn khúi-chà, kóng pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe beh kàu sím-mi̍h sî?
In hō͘-siōng kóng ka-kī ê bāng, beh hō͘ góa ê jîn-bîn bōe-kì-tit góa ê miâ, chhin-chhiūⁿ in ê chó͘-sian ūi-tio̍h Pa-le̍k bōe-kì-tit góa ê miâ.
Kù-chāi hiah-ê chòe bāng ê sian-ti khì kóng in chòe ê bāng; hō͘ hiah-ê thiaⁿ góa sìn-sit ê sian-ti tiong-si̍t thoân-ta̍t góa ê ōe. Be̍h-kó kap be̍h-sūi beh án-chóaⁿ pí?
Góa ê sìn-sit kiám m̄-sī chhin-chhiūⁿ hé, kiám m̄-sī chhin-chhiūⁿ ōe kòng-chhùi chio̍h-pôaⁿ ê thih-thûi?
“Góa Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Chù-ì! Góa beh tùi-hù hiah-ê sian-ti. In hō͘-siōng thau ēng pa̍t-lâng ê ōe tòng-chòe góa ê ōe.’
Siōng Chú koh kóng, ‘Chù-ì! Góa beh tùi-hù hiah-ê sian-ti. In chiong ka-kī ê ōe tòng-chòe góa ê ōe.’

Góa beh tùi-hù hiah-ê sian-ti, in-ūi in ê bāng lóng sī phiàn--lâng-ê; in ēng chiah-ê bāng, í-ki̍p pe̍h-chha̍t kap khoa-kháu ê ōe chhōa góa ê jîn-bîn kiâⁿ-ji̍p oai-lō͘. Góa bô chhe-phài in, mā bô bēng-lēng in; in tùi chiah-ê jîn-bîn lóng bô lī-ek. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”

Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Góa ê chú-bîn, sian-ti, á-sī chè-si nā mn̄g lí, ‘Siōng Chú ū sím-mi̍h sìn-sit?’ Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Lín sī Siōng Chú ê tāng-tàⁿ; I beh khì-sak lín.’
Nā ū sian-ti, chè-si, á-sī góa ê chú-bîn kóng ‘Che chiū-sī Siōng Chú ê sìn-sit’, góa beh hêng-hoa̍t i kap i ê choân-ke.
Ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h mn̄g ka-kī ê chhù-piⁿ, pêng-iú, ‘Siōng Chú ū kóng sím-mi̍h? Siōng Chú ū ìn-tap sím-mi̍h?’

In bōe-tàng koh kóng ‘Che sī Siōng Chú ê sìn-sit’. Nā ū lâng koh kóng chit-kù ōe, góa chiū beh chiong góa ê sìn-sit pìⁿ-chòe i ê tāng-tàⁿ. In lām-sám sú-iōng éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê ōe, chiū-sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe lán ê Siōng-tè ê ōe.
Lí tio̍h mn̄g hiah-ê sian-ti, ‘Siōng Chú ū kóng sím-mi̍h? Siōng Chú ū ìn-tap sím-mi̍h?’
In nā koh kóng ‘Che sī Siōng Chú ê sìn-sit’, chit-kù ōe góa í-keng hoan-hù lín m̄-thang koh kóng; lí tio̍h kā in kóng,
‘Góa it-tēng beh chiong lín pàng bōe-kì--tit, kā lín í-ki̍p góa sù hō͘ lín kap lín chó͘-sian ê siâⁿ tùi góa bīn-chêng hiat--chhut-khì.
Góa beh hō͘ lín kú-tn̂g kiàn-siàu, éng-oán bōe bōe-kì-tit chit-ê bú-jio̍k.’”

Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiong Iok-ngá-kèng ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kun, í-ki̍p Iû-tāi -kok ê koaⁿ-oân, choh-kang sai-hū kap phah-thih sai-hū lóng lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn. Chit-ê tāi-chì í-āu, Siōng Chú hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān thâu-chêng ū nn̄g láng bû-hoa-kó:
Chi̍t láng chin súi chhin-chhiūⁿ chho͘-se̍k ê bû-hoa-kó, chi̍t láng chin bái, bái kah bōe-chia̍h--tit ê bû-hoa-kó.
Siōng Chú mn̄g góa, “ Iâ-lī-bí, lí ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sím-mi̍h?” Góa ìn kóng, “Góa ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ bû-hoa-kó; hó--ê chin hó, bái--ê chin bái, bái kah bōe-chia̍h--tit”.
Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng,
“Góa Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè beh chiong hiah-ê tùi chit-tè thó͘-tōe liû-hòng khì Pa-pí-lûn ê Iû-tāi -lâng, tòng-chòe hó ê bû-hoa-kó hó khoán-thāi in.
Góa beh khòaⁿ-kò͘ in, sù-hok in, chhōa in tńg-lâi chit-tè thó͘-tōe. Góa beh kā in tiông-kiàn, bōe kā in thiah-húi; góa beh kā in chai-chèng, bōe kā in pu̍ih-chhut.
Góa beh sù in chi̍t lia̍p jīn-bat góa ê sim, sêng-jīn góa sī Siōng Chú. In beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn, góa beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè, in-ūi in beh it-sim-it-ì kui-ǹg góa.”

Siōng Chú koh kóng, “ Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka kap i ê koaⁿ-oân, chhun--lo̍h-lâi lâu tī chit-tè thó͘-tōe ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng jîn-bîn, í-ki̍p tòa tī Ai-ki̍p ê Iû-tāi -lâng, góa beh kā in tòng-chòe bái kah bōe-chia̍h--tit ê bû-hoa-kó.

Góa beh hō͘ in tú-tio̍h tōa chai-lān, hō͘ thiⁿ-ē bān-kok ê lâng khòaⁿ-liáu lóng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ thó-ià in; góa beh hō͘ in tī liû-hòng--khì ê ta̍k só͘-chāi, hō͘ lâng bú-jio̍k, thí-chhiò, hì-lāng, koh siū chiù-chó͘.
Góa beh ēng chiàn-loān, ki-hng, kap un-e̍k tû-bia̍t in, hō͘ in tùi góa siúⁿ-sù in kap in lia̍t-chó͘ ê chit-tè thó͘-tōe siau-sit.”

Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kèng choh Iû-tāi -ông tē-sì nî, chiū-sī Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat choh Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê tē-it nî, Siōng Chú chiong iú-koan Iû-tāi jîn-bîn ê ōe thoân hō͘ Iâ-lī-bí.
Sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí chiū chiong chiah-ê ōe kā só͘-ū ê Iû-tāi jîn-bîn kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kóng,

“Tùi A-bûn -ông ê kiáⁿ Iok-se-a choh-ông tē-cha̍p-saⁿ nî kàu kin-á-ji̍t, chit jī-cha̍p-saⁿ nî lâi, Siōng Chú put-sî tùi góa kóng-ōe, góa mā kè-sio̍k chiong I ê ōe thoân hō͘ lín, m̄-kú lín lóng bô beh thiaⁿ-thàn.
Siōng Chú sui-jiân chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn phài I ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti lâi lín chia, m̄-kú lín oân-choân m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn.

In kā lín kóng, ‘Lín ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h hóe-kái, lī-khui siâ-ok ê tō-lō͘, pàng-sak chōe-ok ê hêng-ûi; án-ni, lín chiah ōe-tàng éng-éng-oán-oán tòa tī Siōng Chú sù hō͘ lín kap lín ê chó͘-sian ê thó͘-tōe.

Só͘-í Siōng Chú kóng: Lín m̄-thang khì tè pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, ho̍k-sāi kèng-pài in; m̄-thang pài lín ê chhiú chō ê mi̍h, jiá góa siū-khì; án-ni góa chiū bōe kàng chai-hō hō͘ lín. M̄-kú, lín lóng m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn, tian-tò khì pài ka-kī ê chhiú chō ê ngó͘-siōng, jiá góa siū-khì, ka-kī jiá hō-toan.’”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “In-ūi lín m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe,

góa beh tiàu pak-hng ê bîn-cho̍k kap góa ê po̍k-jîn Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat, lâi kong-kek chit-ê thó͘-tōe kap hiah-ê chū-bîn, í-ki̍p chiu-ûi ê bîn-cho̍k. Góa beh kā in thiat-tóe siau-bia̍t, hō͘ chit-ê tōe éng-oán pha-hng, hō͘ lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ thí-chhiò. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Góa mā beh hō͘ in bô koh ū hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k ê siaⁿ, bô koh ū hun-iàn hí-khèng ê siaⁿ, bô lâng oe-bō, bô lâng tiám-teng.
Choân-kok lóng ōe pha-hng, hō͘ lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ. Chiah-ê kok-ka ōe ho̍k-sāi Pa-pí-lûn -ông chhit-cha̍p nî.

Chhit-cha̍p nî móa liáu-āu, góa beh in-ūi Pa-pí-lûn -ông kap chit-ê bîn-cho̍k só͘ hoān ê chōe kā in hêng-hoa̍t, siau-bia̍t chit-ê kok-ka, hō͘ hit-ê tōe éng-oán hong-hòe. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Góa beh hō͘ góa chiam-tùi chit-ê kok-ka só͘ kóng ê ōe si̍t-hiān, mā beh hō͘ kì-chài tī chit-pún chheh koan-hē Iâ-lī-bí tùi lia̍t-kok ê ū-giân lóng si̍t-hiān.
Góa beh chiàu Pa-pí-lûn -lâng ê hêng-ûi kap in ê chhiú só͘ chòe--ê pò-èng in; ōe ū chin chōe kok kap tōa kun-ông lia̍h in khì chòe lô͘-lē.”
Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kā góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h tùi góa ê chhiú kā chit-poe siū-khì ê chiú chiap--khì, the̍h-khì hō͘ góa phài lí khì ê ta̍k-kok lim.
In lim-liáu ōe tang-tó-sai-oai, khí-siáu, in-ūi góa beh hō͘ in tú-tio̍h chiàn-loān.”
Góa chiū tùi Siōng Chú ê chhiú kā chit-poe chiú chiap--kè-lâi, the̍h-khì hō͘ Siōng Chú phài góa khì ê ta̍k-kok lim;

pau-koat Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn, Iû-tāi ê kun-ông kap léng-siù, hō͘ chiah-ê siâⁿ-tìn pha-hng siū khì-sak; hō͘ lâng thí-chhiò, chiù-chó͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ kin-á-ji̍t án-ni;
mā pau-koat Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló, i ê jîn-sîn, léng-siù kap só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn,
í-ki̍p gōa-cho̍k-lâng, O͘-su tōe-khu ê kun-ông, Hui-lī-sū ê chu-ông: A-si̍t-ki-lûn, Ka-sat, Í-kek-lûn, í-ki̍p A-si̍t-tu̍t chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng;
Í-tong -lâng, Mô͘-ap -lâng, A-bûn -lâng;
Thài-ní kap Se-tùn ê kun-ông, Tōe-tiong-hái iân-hái tōe-khu ê kun-ông;
Tí-tān, Thê-má, Pò͘-su, kap thì pìn-piⁿ ê bîn-cho̍k,
A-la-pek ê kun-ông, soa-bô͘ tōe-khu ta̍k-cho̍k ê ông;
Sim-lī, Í-lân, Bí-tí-a só͘-ū ê kun-ông;
pak-hng bô-lūn hn̄g á-sī kūn ê kun-ông. Choân sè-kài ê ta̍k-kok lóng beh lim chit-poe chiú; chòe-āu Pa-pí-lûn -ông mā tio̍h lim.

Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Lín tio̍h lim chit-poe chiú lim kah chùi, lim kah thò͘, lim kah poa̍h-tó, lim kah peh bōe khí--lâi, in-ūi góa beh hō͘ lín tú-tio̍h chiàn-loān.
In nā m̄-khéng chiap lí chit-poe chiú khì lim, lí tio̍h kā in kóng: Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng: Lín it-tēng tio̍h lim!

Góa kì-jiân tùi chit-chō hōng góa ê miâ khí ê siâⁿ khai-sí kàng chai-hō, lín kiám ōe-tàng bián siū hêng-hoa̍t? Lín it-tēng bōe! In-ūi góa í-keng bēng-lēng to-kiàm lâi kong-kek choân-tōe ê chū-bîn. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-kò.’

“Só͘-í lí tio̍h chiong góa kau-tài ê ōe tùi in soan-káng, chek-pī in: Siōng Chú tùi thiⁿ-téng tōa-siaⁿ hoah, tùi I tòa sèng ê só͘-chāi hoah-siaⁿ, I tùi bo̍k-tiûⁿ ê iûⁿ-kûn tōa-siaⁿ hoah; tùi tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ê chū-bîn hoah-siaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ ta̍h phû-tô ê lâng teh hoah.

Siōng Chú hoah ê siaⁿ ōe thoân kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak, in-ūi I beh khòng-kò bān-cho̍k, beh sím-phòaⁿ só͘-ū ê lâng. Siâ-ok ê lâng, I beh hō͘ in sí tī to-ē. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe koh kóng, “Tio̍h chù-ì, ōe ū chai-lān tùi chit-kok thòaⁿ kàu hit-kok, ōe ū tōa pō-hong tùi sè-kài ê chīn-thâu ká--khí-lâi.

Kàu hit-ji̍t, tùi tōe ê chit-pêng-thâu kàu hit-pêng-thâu, chi̍t-sì-kòe lóng sī Siōng Chú thâi-sí ê lâng. Bô lâng ūi-tio̍h in thî-khàu, bô lâng kā in siu sin-si, bô lâng kā in tâi; hiah-ê si-thé lóng beh pìⁿ-chòe tōe-bīn ê pùn.

“Jîn-bîn ê bo̍k-chiá ah, lín tio̍h ai-khàu âu-kiò! Iûⁿ-kûn ê léng-siù ah, lín tio̍h ai-siong, tī thô͘-soa-hún kō-lâi-kō-khì! Lín beh hō͘ lâng châu-bia̍t ê ji̍t-chí kàu lah. Lín ōe siak-tó, chhin-chhiūⁿ kùi-tiōng ê hûi-khì siak kah chhùi-chhùi.
Bo̍k-chiá bô lō͘ thang tô-cháu; iûⁿ-kûn ê léng-siù mā bô hoat-tō͘ tô-thoat.
Tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ, bo̍k-chiá teh âu-kiò, iûⁿ-kûn ê léng-siù teh ai-khàu, in-ūi Siōng Chú teh húi-hoāi in ê bo̍k-tiûⁿ.
Siōng Chú hoat-chhut béng-lia̍t ê siū-khì; pêng-an chhiⁿ-chhùi ê bo̍k-tiûⁿ pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘.
Siōng Chú chhin-chhiūⁿ siàu-chòng ê sai lī-khui hia̍t; in ê thó͘-tōe, in-ūi khi-ap-chiá ê siū-khì, koh in-ūi Siōng Chú béng-lia̍t ê siū-khì, pìⁿ-chòe pha-hng ê só͘-chāi.”
Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kèng khai-sí choh Iû-tāi -ông ê sî, Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng,

“Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lí tio̍h khì khiā tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ, chiong góa bēng-lēng lí tio̍h kóng ê ōe kā hiah-ê tùi Iû-tāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-tìn lâi kèng-pài Siōng Chú ê lâng kóng; liân chi̍t kù to m̄-thang bô kóng.
Khó-lêng in ōe thiaⁿ, ta̍k-ê lâng ōe lī-khui in siâ-ok ê tō-lō͘, án-ni góa chiū beh kái-piàn sim-ì, bô beh in-ūi in siâ-ok ê hêng-ûi kàng chai-hō hō͘ in.
“Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lín nā bô beh thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe, bô beh chun-hêng góa pan-pò͘ hō͘ lín ê lu̍t-hoat,
bô beh thiaⁿ-thàn góa phài góa ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti lâi lín chia só͘ kóng ê ōe, góa chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn phài in lâi, lín iû-goân m̄ thiaⁿ,
só͘-í góa beh hō͘ chit-keng sèng-tiān kap Sī-lô kâng-khoán, hō͘ chit-ê siâⁿ chiâⁿ-chòe tōe-chiūⁿ bān-cho̍k chiù-chó͘ ê tùi-siōng.’”
Iâ-lī-bí tī Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān kóng chiah-ê ōe, chè-si, sian-ti, kap só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn lóng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h.
Iâ-lī-bí chiong Siōng Chú bēng-lēng i tio̍h tùi só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn kóng ê ōe kóng soah, chè-si, sian-ti, kap jîn-bîn kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, kóng, “Lí kai sí!

Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ lī-iōng Siōng Chú ê miâ kóng ū-giân, kóng chit-keng sèng-tiān ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Sī-lô, chit-ê siâⁿ it-tēng ōe pha-hng, bô lâng tòa?” Só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn chiū lóng chi̍p óa-lâi Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, kā Iâ-lī-bí ûi--teh.
Iû-tāi ê koaⁿ-oân thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì, chiū tùi ông-kiong chiūⁿ-lâi Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, chē tiàm Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê Sin-mn̂g mn̂g-kháu.
Chè-si, sian-ti tùi koaⁿ-oân kap jîn-bîn kóng, “Chit-ê lâng tio̍h kā chhú sí-hêng. I kóng ū-giân kong-kek chit-ê siâⁿ; lín mā ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h i án-ni kóng.”

Iâ-lī-bí chiū tùi hiah-ê koaⁿ-oân kap jîn-bîn kóng, “Siōng Chú phài góa thoân-ta̍t I ê ōe, kong-kek chit-keng sèng-tiān kap chit-chō siâⁿ; chiū-sī thoân-káng lín tú-chiah thiaⁿ--tio̍h hiah-ê ōe.

Taⁿ lín tio̍h kái-piàn lín ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe, thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, I chiū ōe kái-piàn sim-ì, chiong I só͘ soan-pò͘ beh kàng hō͘ lín ê chai-hō chhú-siau.
Góa leh, góa í-keng tī lín ê chhiú-thâu, lín khòaⁿ beh án-chóaⁿ kā góa chhú-lí, chiū chiàu lín khòaⁿ-chòe tio̍h--ê, hó--ê kā góa chhú-lí.

M̄-kú lín tio̍h khak-si̍t chai, lín nā kā góa chhú-sí, lín chit-ê siâⁿ í-ki̍p chiah-ê chū-bîn tio̍h taⁿ hāi-sí bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê sìⁿ-miā ê chek-jīm, in-ūi Siōng Chú chin-chiàⁿ ū phài góa lâi lín chia, chiong chiah-ê ōe lóng kóng hō͘ lín chai.”
Koaⁿ-oân kap choân-thé bîn-chiòng chiū tùi chè-si kap sian-ti kóng, “Chit-ê lâng bô eng-kai kā i chhú-sí, in-ūi i hōng Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè ê miâ tùi lán kóng-ōe.”
Ū chi̍t-kóa kok-lāi ê tiúⁿ-ló khiā--khí-lâi, tùi chū-chi̍p ê bîn-chiòng kóng,

“ Hi-se-ka -ông thóng-tī Iû-tāi ê sî, Mô͘-lī-siat -lâng Bí-ka tùi Iû-tāi jîn-bîn kóng ū-giân, kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng: Sek-an ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhân-hn̂g hō͘ lâng lôe, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe pìⁿ-chòe thô͘-tui, chit-ê tiān ê soaⁿ ōe pìⁿ-chòe chhiū-nâ ê soaⁿ-lûn-á.’

Iû-tāi -ông Hi-se-ka kap Iû-tāi jîn-bîn kiám ū kā Bí-ka chhú-sí? Hi-se-ka kiám m̄-sī kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, ū kiû Siōng Chú lîn-bín, Siōng Chú chiū kái-piàn sim-ì, bô chiong I goân-lâi só͘ kóng ê chai-hō kàng-lo̍h? Lán hiān-chāi soah beh ka-kī jiá chai-hō.”

Lēng-gōa ū chi̍t ê Ki-lia̍t Iâ-lîm -lâng, kiò-chòe O͘-lī-a, sī Sī-má-ngá ê kiáⁿ; i hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ kóng ū-giân, kap Iâ-lī-bí kâng-khoán kóng ū-giân kong-kek chit-chō siâⁿ kap chit-ê kok-ka.

Iok-ngá-kèng -ông kap i ê kun-koaⁿ, koaⁿ-oân thiaⁿ-tio̍h O͘-lī-a ê ōe liáu-āu, ông siūⁿ-beh kā i chhú-sí. O͘-lī-a chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chit-ê siau-sit chiū kiaⁿ, tô-cháu khì Ai-ki̍p.
Iok-ngá-kèng -ông phài A-kek-pho ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-ná-tan chhōa kúi-nā ê lâng khì Ai-ki̍p,
kā O͘-lī-a tùi Ai-ki̍p lia̍h tńg-lâi kau hō͘ Iok-ngá-kèng -ông; ông chiū kā i chhú-sí, chiong i ê sin-si hiat tī pêng-bîn ê bōng-tōe.
M̄-kú, Sa-hoan ê kiáⁿ A-hi-kam pó-hō͘ Iâ-lī-bí, bô chiong Iâ-lī-bí kau hō͘ jîn-bîn chhú-sí.
Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Se-tí-ka khai-sí choh-ông thóng-tī Iû-tāi -kok ê sî, Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Iâ-lī-bí.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h ēng soh kap chhâ-kông chòe taⁿ, hē tī lí ê ām-kún,

jiân-āu chiong ē-bīn ê sìn-sit úi-thok lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kìⁿ Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka hiah-ê gōa-kok sù-chiá, thoân-ta̍t hō͘ Í-tong -ông, Mô͘-ap -ông, A-bûn -ông, Thài-ní -ông, Se-tùn -ông;
chhiáⁿ in kā in ê ông kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Lín tio̍h tùi lín ê chú-lâng kóng:
Góa ēng tōa koân-lêng, ēng tōa khùi-la̍t chhòng-chō tāi-tōe í-ki̍p tōe-chiūⁿ ê lâng kap tōng-bu̍t; góa khòaⁿ sím-mi̍h-lâng khah sek-ha̍p chiū chiong tāi-tōe kau hō͘ i.
Hiān-chāi góa chiong chiah-ê kok kau hō͘ góa ê po̍k-jîn Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat, mā chiong iá-gōa ê tōng-bu̍t kau hō͘ i koán-lí.
Lia̍t-kok lóng beh ho̍k-sāi i, i ê kiáⁿ, kap i ê sun, ti̍t-kàu i ê kok-ka soe-pāi; hit-sî, ōaⁿ i tio̍h ho̍k-sāi chiah-ê kok kap kun-ông.

“‘Nā ū tó chi̍t cho̍k, tó chi̍t kok m̄-khéng ho̍k-sāi Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat, ām-kún m̄-khéng taⁿ i ê taⁿ, góa it-tēng beh ēng chiàn-loān, ki-hng, un-e̍k hêng-hoa̍t hiah-ê kok-ka, ti̍t-kàu góa thong-kè Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê chhiú kā in siau-bia̍t. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.’

M̄-kú lín Iû-tāi jîn-bîn m̄-thang thiaⁿ lín ê sian-ti, pok-kòa--ê, kái-bāng--ê, khòaⁿ thian-siōng--ê, kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t--ê ê ōe; in kā lín kóng, ‘Lín it-tēng bōe ho̍k-sāi Pa-pí-lûn -ông.’
Kî-si̍t in kóng ê ū-giân sī ké--ê, tian-tò ōe hō͘ lín liû-bông khì chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi; góa beh kā lín kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, hō͘ lín bia̍t-bông.
Nā ū tó chi̍t kok khéng taⁿ Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê taⁿ, ho̍k-sāi i, góa it-tēng beh hō͘ hit-ê cho̍k lâu tī i pún-kok chèng-choh, khiā-khí. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Góa mā chiong chiah-ê ōe lóng tùi Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka kóng, “Lín ê ām-kún tio̍h taⁿ Pa-pí-lûn -ông hō͘ lín ê taⁿ, ho̍k-sāi i kap i ê jîn-bîn, chiah ōe-tàng seng-chûn.
Lí kap lí ê jîn-bîn ná tio̍h in-ūi chiàn-loān, ki-hng, un-e̍k bia̍t-bông, chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú tùi hiah-ê m̄-khéng ho̍k-sāi Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê kok-ka só͘ kóng--ê án-ni.
M̄-thang thiaⁿ hiah-ê sian-ti tùi lín kóng ê ōe, in kóng ‘Lín bōe ho̍k-sāi Pa-pí-lûn -ông’, kî-si̍t in ê ū-giân lóng sī pe̍h-chha̍t.

Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Góa bô chhe-phài in, in kèng-jiân lī-iōng góa ê miâ kóng ké ū-giân. Lín nā thiaⁿ in ê ōe, góa chiū beh chiong lín kap hiah-ê kā lín kóng ké ū-giân ê sian-ti kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, hō͘ lín chòe-hé bia̍t-bông.’”

Góa koh tùi chè-si kap chiah-ê jîn-bîn kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lín m̄-thang thiaⁿ hiah-ê sian-ti kā lín kóng ê ōe, in kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê khì-khū bô-jōa-kú lóng ōe tùi Pa-pí-lûn poaⁿ--tò-lâi. Kî-si̍t in kóng--ê sī pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe.
M̄-thang sìn in ê ōe. Tio̍h ho̍k-sāi Pa-pí-lûn -ông, án-ni chiah ōe-tàng seng-chûn. Ná tio̍h hō͘ chit-ê siâⁿ pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘?

In nā sī chin ê sian-ti, chin-chiàⁿ ū Siōng Chú ê ōe thoân hō͘ in, in eng-kai tio̍h kî-kiû Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, hō͘ sèng-tiān, Iû-tāi ông-kiong, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lāi-bīn chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê khì-khū, bōe hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ-khì Pa-pí-lûn.’”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng-tio̍h koan-hē tâng-thiāu, tâng-hái, phûn-chō, í-ki̍p iáu lâu tī chit-ê siâⁿ ê khì-khū;

chiū-sī Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat lia̍h Iok-ngá-kèng ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kun, í-ki̍p Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koaⁿ-oân ê sî, bô poaⁿ-khì Pa-pí-lûn ê khì-khū;
koan-hē sèng-tiān kap Iû-tāi ông-kiong lāi-bīn, í-ki̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê khì-khū, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng,

“Chiah-ê khì-khū it-tēng ōe hō͘ lâng poaⁿ-khì Pa-pí-lûn, khǹg tī hia, ti̍t-kàu góa koh-chài koàn-kò͘ in hit-ji̍t. Góa Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘. Kàu hit-sî, góa it-tēng ōe chiong chiah-ê khì-khū tòa tńg-lâi chit-tè thó͘-tōe.”

Se-tí-ka -ông thóng-tī Iû-tāi tē-sì nî gō͘--ge̍h, Ki-piàn -lâng Ap-sok ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Hap-ná-nî-ngá tī Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, tī chè-si kap bîn-chiòng ê bīn-chêng kā góa kóng,
“Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Góa í-keng kòng-tn̄g Pa-pí-lûn -ông hō͘ lín ê taⁿ.

Nn̄g nî lāi, góa beh chiong Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat tùi chit-tè thó͘-tōe chhiúⁿ-khì Pa-pí-lûn ê Siōng Chú sèng-tiān só͘-ū ê khì-khū, lóng poaⁿ tńg-lâi chit-ê só͘-chāi;

koh beh kā Iok-ngá-kèng ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kun kap siū-lia̍h khì Pa-pí-lûn só͘-ū ê Iû-tāi -lâng lóng chhōa--tò-lâi, in-ūi góa beh kòng-tn̄g Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê taⁿ.’ Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí chiū tī hiah-ê khiā tī Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ê chè-si kap bîn-chiòng ê bīn-chêng, kā sian-ti Hap-ná-nî-ngá kóng,

“Amen! Goān Siōng Chú ōe án-ni chòe. Goān Siōng Chú si̍t-hiān lí kóng ê ū-giân, chiong Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê khì-khū kap só͘-ū siū lia̍h--khì ê lâng, lóng tùi Pa-pí-lûn tòa tò-lâi chit-ê só͘-chāi.
Taⁿ, lí tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ góa beh tùi lí kap bîn-chiòng kóng ê ōe.
Tùi kó͘-chá í-lâi, lí góa í-chêng ê sian-ti lóng bat tùi chin chōe tōe-khu kap kiông-tāi ê kok-ka ū-giân ōe hoat-seng chiàn-cheng, chai-hō, un-e̍k.
Hiah-ê ū-giân pêng-an ê sian-ti tio̍h ài kàu in ê ōe si̍t-hiān ê sî, lâng chiah ōe sêng-jīn in chin-chiàⁿ sī Siōng Chú chhe-phài--lâi ê sian-ti.”
Hap-ná-nî-ngá chiū chiong Iâ-lī-bí ām-kún ê taⁿ the̍h--khí-lâi, kā i kòng-tn̄g.

I koh tùi só͘-ū ê bîn-chiòng kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Nn̄g nî lāi, Siōng Chú beh chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, kā Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat hē tī lia̍t-kok ām-kún ê taⁿ kòng-tn̄g.’” Iâ-lī-bí chiū lī-khui hia.
Sian-ti Hap-ná-nî-ngá kā sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí ām-kún téng-bīn ê taⁿ kòng-tn̄g liáu-āu, Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu Iâ-lī-bí, kóng,
“Lí tio̍h khì kā Hap-ná-nî-ngá kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lí kòng-tn̄g chhâ chòe ê taⁿ, m̄-kú Siōng Chú ōe chòe thih ê taⁿ lâi tāi-thòe.

In-ūi Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Góa beh chiong thih ê taⁿ hē tī lia̍t-kok ê ām-kún, hō͘ in ho̍k-sāi Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat; in it-tēng tio̍h ho̍k-sāi i, in-ūi liân iá-gōa ê tōng-bu̍t góa to kau hō͘ i koán-lí.’”

Sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí koh kā sian-ti Hap-ná-nî-ngá kóng, “ Hap-ná-nî-ngá, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Siōng Chú bô chhe-phài lí, lí kèng-jiân hō͘ chiah-ê jîn-bîn siong-sìn lí ê pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe.
Só͘-í, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh hō͘ lí lī-khui sè-kan; kin-nî lí it-tēng ōe sí, in-ūi lí siàn-tōng lâng pōe-poān Siōng Chú.’”
Hit-nî chhit--ge̍h, Hap-ná-nî-ngá chiū sí.

Sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siá-phoe hō͘ Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn iáu oa̍h--teh ê tiúⁿ-ló, chè-si, sian-ti, í-ki̍p só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn.

Chit-tiuⁿ phoe sī tī Iok-ngá-kun -ông, thài-hō͘ kap tiâu-têng ê jîn-sîn, Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê léng-siù, choh-kang sai-hū kap phah-thih sai-hū, hō͘ lâng tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lia̍h--khì í-āu siá--ê.

Chit-tiuⁿ phoe sī thok Sa-hoan ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-a-sat, kap Hi-le̍k-ka ê kiáⁿ Ki-má-lī-ngá tòa-khì Pa-pí-lûn; in nn̄g ê lâng ū siū Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka phài-khì kìⁿ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat. Phoe án-ni siá:
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè kā só͘-ū tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siū-lia̍h khì Pa-pí-lûn ê lâng án-ni kóng,
“Lín tio̍h tī Pa-pí-lûn khí-chhù tòa, chèng-choh, chia̍h chhut-sán ê mi̍h,
chhōa-bó͘ siⁿ-kiáⁿ, hō͘ lín ê hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kiat-hun, ióng-io̍k chú-lú. Lín tio̍h tī hia siⁿ-thòaⁿ, m̄-thang hō͘ lín ê jîn-kháu kiám-chió.
Lín tio̍h ūi kā lín liû-hòng--khì ê siâⁿ-tìn kiû pêng-an, ǹg Siōng Chú kî-tó, in-ūi hiah-ê siâⁿ-tìn pêng-an hoân-êng, lín chiah ōe pêng-an hoân-êng.”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè koh kā lín kóng, “M̄-thang hō͘ lín tiong-kan ê sian-ti kap pok-kòa--ê phiàn--khì, mā m̄-thang sìn in chòe ê bāng.
In-ūi góa bô chhe-phài chiah-ê lâng, m̄-kú in lī-iōng góa ê miâ kóng ké ê ū-giân.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Góa ūi Pa-pí-lûn só͘ tēng chhit-cha̍p nî ê kî-hān chi̍t-ē móa, góa ōe koàn-kò͘ lín, si̍t-hiān góa tùi lín kóng--kè beh sù-hok ê èng-ún, chhōa lín tńg-lâi chit-tè thó͘-tōe.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa khak-si̍t chai, góa ūi-tio̍h lín tēng ê kè-ōe sī beh hō͘ lín pêng-an hoân-êng, m̄-sī beh hō͘ lín siū chai-hō, thang hō͘ lín ū kng-bêng ê chiong-lâi.
Lín kiû-kiò góa, ǹg góa kî-tó, góa ōe chù-ì thiaⁿ.
Lín nā chhē-kiû góa, lín ōe chhē--tio̍h; lín nā choân-sim chhē-kiû góa,

góa it-tēng ōe hō͘ lín chhē--tio̍h. Siōng Chú án-ni kóng. Góa mā beh kā lín chiah-ê siū-lia̍h ê lâng chhōa--tò-lâi; chiong lín tùi góa kā lín liû-hòng--khì ê ta̍k-kok ta̍k só͘-chāi tiàu-chi̍p, chhōa tńg-lâi lín siū-lia̍h lī-khui ê hiong-thó͘.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Lín kóng, “Siōng Chú ū tī Pa-pí-lûn kā goán heng-khí sian-ti.”
Taⁿ, chiam-tùi chē Tāi-pi̍t pó-chō ê ông, kap tòa tī chit-ê siâⁿ bô kap lín chòe-hé siū liû-hòng ê tông-pau,
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Góa beh hō͘ in siū chiàn-loān, ki-hng, un-e̍k ê chai-lān, hō͘ in pìⁿ-chòe nōa kah bōe-chia̍h--tit ê bû-hoa-kó.

Góa beh ēng chiàn-loān, ki-hng, un-e̍k tui-jip in, hō͘ in liû-hòng khì tī thiⁿ-ē bān-cho̍k; in bô-lūn hō͘ góa kóaⁿ-khì tó-ūi, hia ê lâng lóng ōe kā in chiù-chó͘, thí-chhiò, bú-jio̍k, koh tùi in ê cho-gū kám-kak tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Siōng Chú kóng, che sī in-ūi in bô thiaⁿ-thàn góa ê ōe. Góa chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn chhe-phài góa ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti khì kā in kóng-ōe, in lóng m̄ thiaⁿ.
Só͘-í, lín chiah-ê hō͘ góa tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng liû-hòng khì Pa-pí-lûn ê lâng, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ góa Siōng Chú ê ōe.”

Koan-hē Ko-nāi-ngá ê kiáⁿ A-hap, kap Má-se-ngá ê kiáⁿ Se-tí-ka, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “In lī-iōng góa ê miâ tùi lín kóng ké ê ū-giân, góa beh chiong in kau hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat; i ōe tī lín ê bīn-chêng kā in chhú-sí.

Lín só͘-ū hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn ê Iû-tāi -lâng beh kā lâng chiù-chó͘ ê sî, ōe ēng chit nn̄g ê lâng ê miâ kā lâng kóng, ‘Goān Siōng Chú hō͘ lí chhin-chhiūⁿ Pa-pí-lûn -ông ēng hé sio-sí ê Se-tí-ka kap A-hap.’

In-ūi in tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan chòe kiàn-siàu-sū, kap chhù-piⁿ ê bó͘ kiâⁿ kan-îm, koh lī-iōng góa ê miâ kóng góa bô bēng-lēng in kóng ê pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe. Góa chai-iáⁿ chiah-ê tāi-chì, mā chhin-sin choh-chèng.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Koan-hē Nî-hi-lân -lâng Sī-má-ngá,

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “Lí ū ēng lí ka-kī ê miâ siá-phoe hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn, Má-se-ngá ê kiáⁿ chè-si Se-hoan-ngá, kap só͘-ū ê chè-si, kóng,

‘Siōng Chú í-keng siat-li̍p lí Se-hoan-ngá chòe chè-si, chhú-tāi Iâ-hô-iâ-tāi chòe Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê kam-tok, ōe-tàng kā só͘-ū ka-kī hong chòe sian-ti ê siáu-lâng khàu chhâ-kê thih-kho͘.
Hiān-chāi, A-ná-tu̍t -lâng Iâ-lī-bí chū-chheng sī sian-ti, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ bô kā i chí-chek?
I ū siá-phoe lâi Pa-pí-lûn, kā goán kóng, goán liû-hòng ê sî-kan ōe thoa chin kú, só͘-í tio̍h tī chia khí-chhù tòa, chèng-choh, chia̍h chhut-sán ê mi̍h.’”
Chè-si Se-hoan-ngá chiong chit-tiuⁿ phoe tha̍k hō͘ sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí thiaⁿ.
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng,

“Lí tio̍h siá-phoe hō͘ só͘-ū liû-hòng tī Pa-pí-lûn ê tông-pau: “Koan-hē Nî-hi-lân -lâng Sī-má-ngá, Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Góa bô chhe-phài Sī-má-ngá, m̄-kú i kèng-jiân tùi lín kóng ū-giân, hō͘ lín siong-sìn i ê pe̍h-chha̍t-ōe,

só͘-í góa Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh hêng-hoa̍t Nî-hi-lân -lâng Sī-má-ngá kap i ê hō͘-tāi. I ê hō͘-tāi it-tēng bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng tòa tī chiah-ê jîn-bîn tiong-kan, mā bōe-tàng oa̍h-teh hióng-siū góa beh sù hō͘ góa ê chú-bîn ê hok-khì, in-ūi i siàn-tōng lâng pōe-poān Siōng Chú.’ Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè tùi Iâ-lī-bí án-ni kóng, “Só͘-ū góa tùi lí kóng ê ōe, lí lóng tio̍h siá tī chheh-kǹg.

Siōng Chú kóng: Sî-ji̍t teh-beh kàu, góa beh hō͘ góa siū-lia̍h ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi tò-tńg--lâi. Góa beh hō͘ in tò-lâi góa siúⁿ-sù in chó͘-sian ê thó͘-tōe, in chiū tit-tio̍h chit-tè thó͘-tōe chòe sán-gia̍p. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Í-hā sī Siōng Chú chiam-tùi Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi kóng ê ōe.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lín ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h khióng-pò͘ ê hoah-siaⁿ; chí-ū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, bô pêng-an.

Lín ka-kī khì mn̄g khòaⁿ-bāi, tiâu-cha khòaⁿ-bāi, ta-po͘-lâng kiám ōe siⁿ-kiáⁿ? Sī-án-chóaⁿ góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h ta̍k-ê ta-po͘-lâng siang-chhiú thìⁿ-io, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh-beh seng-sán ê cha-bó͘-lâng, bīn lóng chhiⁿ-sún-sún?

Chhám ah! Hit-ji̍t sī khióng-pò͘ ê ji̍t-chí, chêng-kàu-taⁿ m̄-bat ū ê ji̍t-chí, sī góa ê chú-bîn tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê ji̍t-chí, m̄-kú in ōe tit-tio̍h kái-kiù, thoat-lī chai-lān.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘, “Kàu hit-ji̍t, góa beh kòng-tn̄g góa chú-bîn ām-kún ê taⁿ, chhoah-tn̄g pa̍k in ê soh; in bōe koh chòe gōa-cho̍k-lâng ê lô͘-lē.
In beh sū-hōng Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè, mā beh ho̍k-sāi góa ūi-tio̍h in heng-khí choh-ông ê Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ-sun.

Góa ê po̍k-jîn Ngá-kok, m̄-bián kiaⁿ! Í-sek-lia̍t, m̄-bián sit-chì! Góa beh tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi kái-kiù lí, tùi lí siū-lia̍h ê tōe kái-kiù lí ê hō͘-tāi; Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi ōe tò-lâi ka-kī ê hiong-thó͘ an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p, bô lâng ōe koh hō͘ in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Góa kap lí tông-chāi, beh kái-kiù lí, mā beh oân-choân húi-bia̍t góa kóaⁿ lí khì hiah-ê kok-ka. Góa bōe kā lí oân-choân siau-bia̍t, m̄-kú bōe-tàng bô hêng-hoa̍t lí; góa beh chiàu kong-gī koán-kàu lí.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú tùi Sek-an ê jîn-bîn kóng: Lí siū ê siong bōe-i--tit, lí ê khang-chhùi chin siong-tiōng.
Lí siū siong-hāi, bô lâng thòe lí piān-hō͘; mā bô io̍h thang kā lí i-tī.

Lí ê ài-jîn lóng bōe-kì-tit lí, bōe koh lâi tui-kiû lí. In-ūi lí ê chōe chin tāng, chōe-ok chin chōe, góa táⁿ-kek lí chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-te̍k teh phah lí, chân-jím hêng-hoa̍t lí.
