Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ in-ūi lí siū ê siong-hāi hoah-hiu, kóng, lí ê thòng-khó͘ bōe-i--tit? In-ūi lí ê chōe chin tāng, chōe-ok chin chōe, góa chiah án-ni tùi-thāi lí.
Taⁿ, só͘-ū thun-bia̍t lí--ê, beh siū thun-bia̍t, lí ê tùi-te̍k chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê lóng beh siū-lia̍h; lia̍h lí--ê, beh hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì, chhiúⁿ lí--ê, beh chiâⁿ-chòe la̍h-bu̍t.
Sui-jiân lâng lóng kóng, Sek-an sī siū pàng-sak--ê, bô lâng beh chhap i; m̄-kú, góa beh i-tī lí ê siong, hō͘ lí ê khang-chhùi siⁿ-bah kè-phê. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh hō͘ Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ-sun tò-tńg--lâi, beh lîn-bín in siū húi-hoāi ê ka-hn̂g; siâⁿ ōe tī goân-lâi ê thô͘-tui téng-bīn tiông-kiàn, kiong-tiān koh khí tī goân-lâi ê só͘-chāi.
Hiah-ê chū-bîn beh hoat-chhut kám-siā hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ; góa beh hō͘ in ê jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ, bōe kiám-chió, hō͘ in ū chun-êng, bōe koh siū khòaⁿ-khin.
In ê kiáⁿ-sun beh chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-chêng hiah-ni̍h kiông-sēng; in ê kok-ka ōe siū góa khòaⁿ-kò͘ tit-tio̍h kian-li̍p; só͘-ū ap-pek in--ê, góa beh kā in hêng-hoa̍t.

Tī-lí in--ê sī in ka-kī ê lâng, in ê thóng-tī-chiá sī in ê tông-pau. Góa beh hō͘ i chhin-kūn góa, i mā ōe lâi chhin-kūn góa; nā m̄-sī án-ni, siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ lâi kàu góa bīn-chêng? Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Lín beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn, góa beh chòe lín ê Siōng-tè.
Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú ê siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ pō-hong hoat-chhut, sī húi-bia̍t ê kńg-lê-á-hong, beh siàn pháiⁿ-lâng ê thâu-khak.
Siōng Chú ê siū-khì bōe siau, ti̍t-kàu I ê kè-ōe oân-sêng; tī chiong-lâi ê ji̍t-chí, lín chiū ōe bêng-pe̍k.
“Kàu hit-sî, góa beh chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chong-cho̍k ê Siōng-tè, in beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Thoat-lī to-kiàm chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê chú-bîn, tī khòng-iá tit-tio̍h un-hūi; Í-sek-lia̍t chhē-tio̍h an-hioh ê só͘-chāi.
Siōng Chú tùi kó͘-chá chiū tùi in piáu-bêng, ‘Góa ēng put-piàn ê thiàⁿ thiàⁿ lí, góa beh éng-oán ēng chû-ài tùi-thāi lí.’
Só͘ thiàⁿ ê Í-sek-lia̍t ah, góa beh kā lí tiông-kiàn, lí chiū thang koh the̍h lin-long-kó͘ chhut-khì kap hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k ê lâng chòe-hé thiàu-bú.
Lí ōe koh tī Sat-má-lī-a ê soaⁿ-téng chai-chèng phû-tô; chai-chèng ê lâng ōe-tàng hióng-siū ké-chí.
Kàu ū chi̍t ji̍t, siú-bōng ê lâng it-tēng ōe tī Í-hoat-liân ê soaⁿ-téng hoah kóng, ‘Khí--lâi, lán lâi-khì Sek-an tiâu-kìⁿ Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè!’”

Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Tio̍h ūi Ngá-kok hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa, ūi siōng úi-tāi ê kok-ka hoan-ho͘. Tio̍h thoân-pò, tio̍h chheng-chàn, kóng, ‘Siōng Chú í-keng kái-kiù I ê chú-bîn, kái-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng.’

Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh tùi pak-hng chhōa in tò--lâi, tùi thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak chiong in tiàu-chi̍p óa--lâi; sit-bêng--ê, kha-pái--ê, hoâi-īn--ê, teh-beh seng-sán--ê lóng kui tōa-tīn tâng-chôe tò--lâi.

In iân-lō͘ khàu--tò-lâi; góa beh an-ùi in ín-chhōa in, chhōa in sūn khoe-chúi piⁿ kiâⁿ, kiâⁿ pîⁿ-tháⁿ ê lō͘ bōe poa̍h-tó; góa sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê Pē, Í-hoat-liân sī góa ê tōa-kiáⁿ.

“Lia̍t-kok ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe, tio̍h tī chin hn̄g ê hái-tó soan-iông, kóng, ‘Kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t Hit-ūi beh tiàu-chi̍p i, beh khòaⁿ-kò͘ i chhin-chhiūⁿ bo̍k-chiá kò͘-siú iûⁿ-kûn.’
Góa Siōng Chú í-keng kiù-sio̍k Ngá-kok, kái-kiù i thoat-lī pí i khah kiông ê lâng ê chhiú-thâu.

In beh lâi Sek-an koân ê só͘-chāi hoan-ho͘, ūi-tio̍h Siōng Chú só͘ sù ê hó-mi̍h hoaⁿ-thâu-hí-bīn, in-ūi Siōng Chú sù in ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, kap sin-iû, koh ū iûⁿ-ko kap sòe-chiah gû-á; in beh chhin-chhiūⁿ ū chúi koàn-ak ê hn̂g, bōe koh iu-khó͘.

Hit-sî, cha-bó͘ gín-á beh hoaⁿ-hí thiàu-bú, siàu-liân-lâng kap lāu-lâng chòe-hé khoài-lo̍k; góa beh hō͘ in ê pi-siong pìⁿ-chòe hoaⁿ-hí, beh an-ùi in, hō͘ in ū hí-lo̍k tāi-thòe pi-ai.
Góa beh ēng iû-jī hō͘ chè-si pá-chiok, góa ê chú-bîn beh in-ūi góa ê un-hūi sim-móa-ì-chiok.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Tī La-má ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h pi-siong ai-khàu ê siaⁿ; Lúi-kiat ūi-tio̍h i ê kiáⁿ-jî ai-khàu, m̄-goān siū an-ùi, in-ūi in lóng bô--khì lah.”

Siōng Chú koh kóng, “M̄-thang koh chhut-siaⁿ ai-khàu, m̄-bián koh lâu ba̍k-sái; lí ê lô-khó͘ it-tēng ōe tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ. In it-tēng ōe tùi tùi-te̍k ê thó͘-tōe tò--lâi. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Lí ê chiong-lâi chhiong-móa hi-bāng; lí ê kiáⁿ-jî it-tēng ōe tò-lâi in ka-kī ê hiong-thó͘.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

“Góa chheng-chhó thiaⁿ-tio̍h Í-hoat-liân -lâng ūi-tio̍h ka-kī teh oàn-thàn: Goán chhin-chhiūⁿ iáu-bē siū hùn-liān ê chhiⁿ-gû-á, lí kā goán koán-kàu, goán chiū chiap-siū. Kiû lí chhōa goán tò-tńg--lâi, goán chiū hóe-kái kui-ǹg lí, in-ūi lí sī Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè.
Goán chi̍t-ē pōe-poān lí, chiū hō͘-hóe; siū lí koán-kàu, goán chiū tûi sim-koaⁿ. Goán in-ūi siàu-liân ê sî siū ê bú-jio̍k, bô bīn thang kìⁿ lâng.”

“ Í-hoat-liân -lâng kiám m̄-sī góa thiàⁿ ê kiáⁿ? Kiám m̄-sī góa ì-ài ê gín-á? Góa ta̍k-piàn chek-pī i, iû-goân chhim-chhim su-liām i. Góa ūi-tio̍h i khan-tn̂g-khòa-tō͘, góa it-tēng lîn-bín i. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Lí tio̍h ūi ka-kī siat chí-lō͘-pâi, ūi ka-kī chhāi ín-lō͘-thiāu; tio̍h liû-sim tì-ì lí kiâⁿ--kè ê tōa-lō͘, sūn hit-tiâu lō͘ tò-tńg--lâi. Chāi-sek-lú Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí tio̍h tò--lâi, tò-lâi lí ka-kī ê siâⁿ-tìn.

Ngó͘-ge̍k ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lí sì-kòe liû-lōng beh kàu tī-sî? Siōng Chú í-keng tī chit-ê tōe-chiūⁿ chhòng-chō chi̍t kiāⁿ sin ê sū, chiū-sī cha-bó͘-lâng beh pó-hō͘ ta-po͘-lâng.”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “Góa hō͘ siū-lia̍h ê chú-bîn tò--lâi ê sî, in tī Iû-tāi ê thó͘-tōe kap siâⁿ-tìn ōe koh án-ni kóng, ‘Kong-gī ê chhù, sèng ê soaⁿ ah, goān Siōng Chú sù-hok lí!’
Choh-sit-lâng kap kò͘-iûⁿ ê lâng lóng ōe chòe-hé tòa tī Iû-tāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-tìn.
Ià-siān ê lâng, góa hō͘ in goân-khì; iu-khó͘ ê lâng, góa hō͘ in boán-chiok.”
Án-ni, góa khùn-chhíⁿ, hoat-kiàn góa chin hó-khùn.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, góa beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -ke kap Iû-tāi -ke jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ, cheng-siⁿ heng-ōng.

Góa í-chêng liû-sim khòaⁿ in, kā in pu̍ih-chhut, thiah-húi, phò-hoāi, thui-hoan, kap siong-hāi; í-āu góa beh koh liû-sim khòaⁿ in, kā in tiông-kiàn, chai-chèng. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Hit-sî lâng bōe koh kóng: Lāu-pē chia̍h sng phû-tô, kiáⁿ ê chhùi-khí sng-nńg.
Taⁿ, chia̍h sng phû-tô--ê, ka-kī ê chhùi-khí beh sng-nńg; ta̍k-ê lâng ōe in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe sí.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, góa beh kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ke kap Iû-tāi -ke li̍p sin ê iok.

Chit-ê iok kap góa í-chêng kap in ê chó͘-sian só͘ li̍p ê iok bô kâng-khoán; hit-ê iok sī góa khan in ê chó͘-sian ê chhiú, tùi Ai-ki̍p kā in chhōa--chhut-lâi ê sî kap in li̍p ê iok. Góa sui-jiân choh in ê tiōng-hu, m̄-kú in phò-hoāi hit-ê iok. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Hiah-ê ji̍t-chí í-āu, góa kap choân-thé Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ beh li̍p ê iok sī án-ni: Góa beh chiong góa ê lu̍t-hoat hē tī in ê sim-lāi, khek tī in ê sim-pán. Góa beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè, in beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

In m̄-bián koh kàu-tō ka-kī ê chhù-piⁿ kap tông-pau, kóng, ‘Lín tio̍h jīn-bat Siōng Chú.’ In-ūi in tùi tōa kàu sòe lóng ōe jīn-bat góa. Góa beh sià-bián in ê chōe-kò, kā in ê chōe pàng bōe-kì--tit.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú hō͘ ji̍t-thâu tī ji̍t--sî hoat-kng, hō͘ ge̍h-niû kap chhiⁿ-sîn chiàu tēng-lu̍t chiò-kng àm-mî; I kiáu-lā tōa-hái, hō͘ hái-chúi giâ tōa-éng. I ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe. I án-ni kóng:

Chū-jiân-kài ê tēng-lu̍t nā ōe tùi góa ê bīn-chêng hòe-chí, góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t chiah ōe tī góa ê bīn-chêng toān-choa̍t, éng-oán bōe koh chiâⁿ-chòe kok-ka. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Thiⁿ nā ōe chhek-liōng--tit, tōe ê kun-ki nā ōe thàm-cha--tit, góa chiah ōe in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t ê hō͘-tāi ê só͘-chòe kā in khì-sak. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Hiah-ê ji̍t-chí chin-chiàⁿ ōe lâi, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chit-chō siâⁿ ōe koh siu-kiàn kui hō͘ Siōng Chú, tùi Hap-lâm-gia̍p-lâu kàu Kak-mn̂g.
Chhek-liōng ê soh beh chhun chhut-khì kàu Ka-li̍p-soaⁿ, oat-khì Ko-a,

keng-kè tâi sí-lâng piàⁿ pùn-sò ê soaⁿ-kok, kàu Khip-lûn Khoe-kok, ti̍t-kàu tang-pêng Bé-mn̂g ê oat-kak hit-phiàn ê thó͘-tōe, lóng beh sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú, éng-oán bōe koh siū pu̍ih-chhut, siū phò-hoāi.”
Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka tē-cha̍p nî, chiū-sī Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat thóng-tī Pa-pí-lûn tē-cha̍p-poeh nî, Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng-ōe.
Hit-sî, Pa-pí-lûn ê kun-tūi pau-ûi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí hō͘ lâng koaiⁿ tī Iû-tāi ông-kiong ê kaⁿ-ga̍k.

Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka kā sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí koaiⁿ--teh, mn̄g i kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ ū-giân Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh chiong chit-ê siâⁿ kau hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông; i ōe kong-chiàm chit-ê siâⁿ.
Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka it-tēng thoat bōe khui Pa-pí-lûn -lâng ê chhiú, ōe hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông tng-bīn sím-mn̄g.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông ōe kā Se-tí-ka lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn, kā i lâu tī hia, kàu góa kā i koàn-kò͘ ê sî. Siōng Chú koh kóng: Lín kap Pa-pí-lûn -lâng kau-chiàn, it-tēng bōe iâⁿ.’”
Iâ-lī-bí kóng, “Siōng Chú kā góa kóng,

‘Lí ê a-chek Sa-liông ê kiáⁿ Hap-ná-be̍k ōe lâi lí chia, kā lí kóng: Chhiáⁿ lí kā góa tī A-ná-tu̍t hit-khu hn̂g bóe--tńg-khì, in-ūi lí sī góa ê chì-chhin, ū koân-lī sio̍k-hôe.’”

Goán a-chek ê kiáⁿ Hap-ná-be̍k kó-jiân lâi chhē góa, kā góa kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kā góa bóe góa tī Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu A-ná-tu̍t hit-khu hn̂g, in-ūi lí ū kè-sêng ê iu-sian-koân. Chhiáⁿ lí bóe.” Góa chiū chai, Siōng Chú khak-si̍t ū kā góa kóng-ōe.
Góa chiū ēng chi̍t-pah káu-cha̍p-saⁿ kong-khek ê gûn kā góa ê chek-peh hiaⁿ-tī Hap-ná-be̍k bóe hit-khu hn̂g.
Góa tī khè-iok-su chhiam-miâ, hong--khí-lâi, chhiáⁿ lâng lâi chòe chèng-jîn, phêng gûn hō͘ Hap-ná-be̍k.
Góa chiàu hoat-lu̍t ê kui-tēng, chiong hong-ba̍t kap bô hong-ba̍t ê bóe-bōe khè-iok-su,
tng góa ê chek-peh hiaⁿ-tī Hap-ná-be̍k, chhiam-miâ ê chèng-jîn, kap tī kaⁿ-ga̍k lāi ê Iû-tāi -lâng bīn-chêng kau hō͘ Má-se-ngá ê sun, Nî-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Pa-lio̍k.
Góa tī in ê bīn-chêng kau-tài Pa-lio̍k, kóng,
“Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Chiong hong-ba̍t kap bô hong-ba̍t ê khè-iok-su lóng siu tiàm hûi-khì lāi-bīn, tn̂g-kî pó-chûn.
In-ūi Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè kóng: Chiong-lâi, lâng ōe koh tī chit-ê tōe bóe-bōe chhù-the̍h, chhân-hn̂g, kap phû-tô-hn̂g.”
Góa chiong bóe-bōe ê khè-iok-su kau hō͘ Nî-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Pa-lio̍k liáu-āu, chiū tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó, kóng,
“Ah! Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, lí ū ēng koân-lêng kap tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú chhòng-chō thiⁿ-tōe; bô chi̍t hāng sū lí chòe bōe kàu.

Lí ēng chû-ài tùi-thāi chheng-bān lâng, m̄-kú chiàu sī-tōa-lâng ê chōe kā in ê hō͘-tāi pò-èng. Lí sī Chì-tōa Choân-lêng ê Siōng-tè, lí ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe.
Lí ê kè-ōe úi-tāi, chòe tāi-chì ū khùi-la̍t; lí chù-ì teh khòaⁿ sè-kan-lâng ê hêng-ûi, chiàu ta̍k-ê lâng ê só͘-chòe kā in pò-èng.
Lí tī Ai-ki̍p kiâⁿ sîn-jiah kî-sū, kàu kin-á-ji̍t, koh tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap sè-kan-lâng ê tiong-kan án-ni teh chòe, hō͘ lí ka-kī tī kin-á-ji̍t ū miâ-siaⁿ.
Lí kiâⁿ sîn-jiah kî-sū, ēng koân-lêng ê chhiú, ū khùi-la̍t ê chhiú-kut, kap tōa koh thang-kiaⁿ ê sū, chhōa lí ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t chhut Ai-ki̍p,
chiong lí tùi in lia̍t-chó͘ soan-sè èng-ún beh hō͘ in lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe sù hō͘ in.

In chi̍t-ē ji̍p-lâi chiàm-léng chit-tè thó͘-tōe, soah bô thiaⁿ-thàn lí ê ōe, bô chun-hêng lí ê lu̍t-hoat; lí bēng-lēng in tio̍h si̍t-hêng--ê, in lóng bô chòe, só͘-í lí hō͘ in tú-tio̍h chiah-ê chai-lān.

Taⁿ, tùi-te̍k í-keng pek-óa--lâi, khí thô͘-tui beh kong-chhú chit-ê siâⁿ. Chit-ê siâⁿ mā in-ūi chiàn-loān, ki-hng, un-e̍k, hām-lo̍h tī lâi kong-kek i ê Pa-pí-lûn -lâng ê chhiú. Siōng Chú lí kóng--ê í-keng si̍t-hiān, lí mā í-keng khòaⁿ--tio̍h.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, chit-ê siâⁿ í-keng kau hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -lâng, m̄-kú lí kèng-jiân kiò góa tio̍h ēng gûn bóe chhân-hn̂g, koh chhiáⁿ lâng choh-chèng.”
Siōng Chú chiū tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng,
“Góa sī Siōng Chú, sī choân jîn-lūi ê Siōng-tè; kiám ū sím-mi̍h sū góa chòe bōe kàu?
Góa beh chiong chit-ê siâⁿ kau hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat kap i ê kun-tūi, i beh kong-chiàm chit-ê siâⁿ.

Kong-chhú chit-ê siâⁿ ê Pa-pí-lûn kun-tūi ōe ji̍p-lâi pàng-hé sio siâⁿ, mā chiong tī chhù-téng kā Pa-le̍k sio-hiuⁿ, kā gōa-pang ê sîn-bêng hiàn tiān-chiú-chè, jiá góa siū-khì hiah-ê lâng ê chhù choân-pō͘ sio-liáu-liáu.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng tùi siàu-liân ê sî, chiū it-ti̍t chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ, kek góa siū-khì ê sū. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Chit-chō siâⁿ tùi khí-chō ê sî kàu kin-á-ji̍t, put-sî kek góa hoat tōa siū-khì, só͘-í góa beh tùi góa ê bīn-chêng kā i siau-bia̍t.

In-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng, pau-koat in ê kun-ông, koaⁿ-oân, chè-si, sian-ti, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn, í-ki̍p Iû-tāi jîn-bîn lóng chòe siâ-ok ê sū, jiá góa siū-khì.
In ka-chiah-phiaⁿ ǹg góa, bô beh chiàⁿ-bīn khòaⁿ góa. Góa sui-jiân chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn kà-sī in, m̄-kú in lóng bô beh thiaⁿ-thàn, m̄ siū koán-kàu,
tian-tò chiong khó-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng chhāi tī ūi-tio̍h kèng-pài góa lâi khí ê sèng-tiān lāi-bīn, kā chit-keng sèng-tiān phah lâ-sâm.

In tī Him-lūn-chú Soaⁿ-kok khí pài Pa-le̍k ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, tī hia hiàn hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō͘ Mô͘-lo̍k. Chiah-ê tāi-chì góa lóng m̄-bat kiò in chòe, góa liân siūⁿ mā m̄-bat siūⁿ--kè. In kèng-jiân chòe chiah-ê khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, hō͘ Iû-tāi hām-lo̍h chōe.”
Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “Taⁿ, koan-hē lín teh kóng in-ūi chiàn-loān, ki-hng, un-e̍k hām-lo̍h tī Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê chhiú ê chit-ê siâⁿ,

góa beh chiong i ê chū-bîn tùi góa tī hùn-lō͘ tōa siū-khì tiong kā in liû-hòng--khì ê lia̍t-kok chū-chi̍p--khí-lâi, chhōa tò-lâi chit-tè thó͘-tōe, hō͘ in tī chia an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p.
In beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn, góa beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè.
Góa beh hō͘ in ū kâng chi̍t ê sim-chì, kiâⁿ kâng tiâu tō-lō͘, éng-oán kèng-ùi góa, hō͘ in kap in ê kiáⁿ-sun hióng-siū hok-khì.
Góa beh kap in li̍p éng-oán ê iok, bô beh koh pàng-sak in; góa beh sù in hok-khì, hō͘ in choân-sim kèng-ùi góa, bōe koh oa̍t-cháu lī-khui góa.
Góa beh hoaⁿ-hí si-un hō͘ in, chin-sêng chīn-sim chīn-ì kā in chai-chèng tī chit-tè thó͘-tōe.”

Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Góa án-chóaⁿ kā chiah-ê it-chhè ê tōa chai-hō kàng-lo̍h hō͘ chiah-ê jîn-bîn, mā beh chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni chiong góa èng-ún beh hō͘ in ê tōa hok-khì lóng sù hō͘ in.
Lín só͘ kóng chit-ê í-keng kau hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -lâng, pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘, bô lâng mā bô cheng-siⁿ ê só͘-chāi, ōe koh ū lâng lâi bóe-bōe chhân-hn̂g.

Tī Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiu-ûi, í-ki̍p tī Iû-tāi, soaⁿ-tōe, soaⁿ-po͘, Nî-kek-hu ê siâⁿ-tìn, lâng beh ēng gûn bóe-bōe thó͘-tōe, tī khè-iok-su chhiam-miâ, kā khè-iok-su hong-ba̍t, chhiáⁿ lâng choh-chèng. Góa beh kā siū-lia̍h ê lâng chhōa--tò-lâi.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Iâ-lī-bí iáu hō͘ lâng koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ-ga̍k ê sî, Siōng Chú tē-jī piàn tùi i kóng-ōe,
“Hit-ūi chhòng-chō tāi-tōe, hō͘ i chiâⁿ-hêng, hō͘ i kian-kò͘ ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng,
‘Lí kiû góa, góa chiū ìn lí, beh chiong lí m̄-chai, úi-tāi ò-pì ê sū chí-sī lí.

Chiam-tùi siâⁿ-lāi hiah-ê ūi-tio̍h beh chó͘-tòng tùi-te̍k chō thô͘-tui, ēng to-kiàm kong-siâⁿ só͘ thiah-húi ê chhù kap Iû-tāi kun-ông ê kiong-tiān, góa Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng:

Lín kap Pa-pí-lûn -lâng kau-chiàn ê sî, in beh chiong góa tī hùn-lō͘ kap tōa siū-khì tiong thâi-sí ê lâng ê sin-si, tóe-móa chiah-ê chhù; in-ūi lín chōe-ok koàn-boán, góa í-keng pàng-sak chit-ê siâⁿ.
M̄-kú, góa beh hō͘ chit-ê siâⁿ ho̍k-goân, beh i-tī siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng, hō͘ in ê khang-chhùi siⁿ-bah kè-phê, hō͘ in chhiong-hun hióng-siū hô-pêng an-choân.
Góa beh kā siū-lia̍h ê Iû-tāi -lâng kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhōa--tò-lâi, tiông-kiàn in ê ka-hn̂g.
Góa beh kā in tek-chōe góa ê chōe sóe chheng-khì, koh sià-bián in só͘-ū pōe-poān góa ê chōe.

In-ūi góa ê iân-kò͘, chit-ê siâⁿ tī tōe-chiūⁿ bān-kok tiong ōe tit-tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí, siōng-chàn, kap chun-êng, ūi-tio̍h án-ni lâi chhut-miâ. Lia̍t-kok beh in-ūi thiaⁿ-tio̍h góa sù hō͘ chit-ê siâⁿ ê lâng hoân-êng kap hok-khì lóng kiaⁿ-ùi góa.’”

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Lín lóng kóng ‘Chit-tè thó͘-tōe sī hong-po͘, bô lâng tòa, bô cheng-siⁿ ê tōe’; m̄-kú, pha-hng, bô lâng tòa, bô lâng-iáⁿ, bô cheng-siⁿ ê Iû-tāi siâⁿ-tìn kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koe-lō͘, ōe koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h

hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k ê siaⁿ, hun-iàn hí-khèng ê siaⁿ, koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h lâng tòa chè-mi̍h lâi kàu Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān kám-siā ê siaⁿ, kóng: Tio̍h kám-siā Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, in-ūi Siōng Chú chì-siān, I ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-sio̍k! Góa beh chhōa in tùi siū-lia̍h ê tōe tò--lâi, hō͘ in hôe-ho̍k chá-chêng ê sēng-hóng.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Chit-ê pha-hng, bô lâng-iáⁿ, bô cheng-siⁿ ê só͘-chāi, hia só͘-ū ê siâⁿ-tìn ōe koh ū bo̍k-chiá ê chháu-tiûⁿ, hō͘ iûⁿ tó tī hia hioh-khùn.

Soaⁿ-tōe, soaⁿ-po͘, Nî-kek-hu, Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiu-ûi, í-ki̍p Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn, ōe koh ū lâng tiám-sǹg tùi in chhiú-ē keng-kè ê iûⁿ-kûn.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Sî-ji̍t teh-beh kàu, góa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng èng-ún ê chiok-hok lóng beh si̍t-hiān.
Tī hiah-ê sî-ji̍t, góa beh hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t ê sè-hē hoat chi̍t ki kong-gī ê Ki; i beh tī chit-ê thó͘-tōe si-hêng kong-pêng kap chèng-gī.
In-ūi i ê chip-chèng, Iû-tāi beh tit-tio̍h kái-kiù, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe-tàng an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p. Lâng ōe kā i kiò-chòe ‘Siōng Chú sī goán ê kong-gī’.
In-ūi Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi kè-sio̍k ōe ū lâng thóng-tī Í-sek-lia̍t;
Lī-bī chi-cho̍k it-tēng ōe ū chè-si kè-sio̍k hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap sò͘-chè, sio chè-mi̍h ho̍k-sāi góa, pān-lí hiàn-chè ê sū.”
Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng,
“Góa Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lín nā ōe-tàng hòe-tû góa kap ji̍t--sî, mî--sî tēng ê iok, hō͘ in bô chiàu só͘ tēng ê sî-kan ūn-choán,

chiah ōe-tàng kā góa kap góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t li̍p ê iok soan-kò bô-hāu, hō͘ i bô hō͘-tāi chē ông-ūi, mā chiah ōe-tàng kā góa kap ho̍k-sāi góa ê Lī-bī -lâng chè-si só͘ li̍p ê iok soan-kò bô-hāu.
Góa beh hō͘ góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi kap ho̍k-sāi góa ê Lī-bī -lâng ke-thiⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ bōe-sǹg--tit, chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-piⁿ ê soa bōe-niû--tit.”
Siōng Chú koh kā Iâ-lī-bí kóng,

“Chiah-ê jîn-bîn kóng ‘Siōng Chú só͘ kéng-soán nn̄g ê cho̍k, I lóng kā in pàng-sak lah’, lí ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h bô? In án-ni kóng sī khòaⁿ-khin góa ê chú-bîn, bô koh kā in khòaⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê kok-ka.
Góa Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘: Góa nā bô kap ji̍t--sî, mî--sî tēng-iok, bô kā thiⁿ-tōe tēng tēng-lu̍t,

góa chiah ōe kā Ngá-kok kap góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ-sun khì-sak, bô beh tùi Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ-sun soán-li̍p lâng thóng-tī A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi. Góa beh lîn-bín in, hō͘ hiah-ê liû-hòng ê lâng tò-tńg--lâi.”

Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chhōa i choân-pō͘ ê kun-tūi, kap i só͘ thóng-tī sè-kài ê ta̍k-kok ta̍k-cho̍k, lâi kong-táⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap hù-kūn ê siâⁿ-tìn. Hit-sî, Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng,

“Góa Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè hoan-hù lí tio̍h khì kā Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka án-ni kóng: Siōng Chú beh kā chit-ê siâⁿ kau hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông, i ōe kā i pàng-hé sio.
Lí bô hoat-tō͘ thoat-lī i ê chhiú-thâu, it-tēng ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì kau hō͘ i. Lí ōe hō͘ i tng-bīn sím-mn̄g, hō͘ i lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka, lí tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ góa ê ōe. Siōng Chú án-ni kā lí kóng: Lí bōe hō͘ lâng thâi-sí,

ōe pêng-an sí. Lí sí-liáu, lâng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ teh kā lí ê chó͘-sian í-chêng ê ông sio-hiuⁿ án-ni, kā lí sio-hiuⁿ. In ōe kā lí chhiùⁿ ai-ko, kóng, ‘Ài ah, goán ê ông!’ Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí chiū chiong chiah-ê ōe kā tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka kóng.
Hit-sî, Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê kun-tūi í-keng teh kong-táⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ La-kiat kap A-se-ka; Iû-tāi kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ chí-ū chhun chit nn̄g ê.
Se-tí-ka -ông ū kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê jîn-bîn li̍p-iok, beh kā lô͘-lē soan-pò͘ chū-iû,
ta̍k-ê lâng tháu-pàng Hi-pek-lâi lâm-lú lô͘-lē, bô koh ū lâng ēng tông-pau Iû-tāi -lâng chòe lô͘-lē.

Hiah-ê ū chham-ú chit-ê iok ê léng-siù kap jîn-bîn chiū tháu-pàng in ê lâm-lú lô͘-lē, hō͘ in tit-tio̍h chū-iû, bô koh ēng in chòe lô͘-lē; hiah-ê léng-siù kap jîn-bîn lóng tông-ì, tháu-pàng lâm-lú lô͘-lē.
M̄-kú, āu-lâi in hō͘-hóe, kiò in só͘ tháu-pàng ê lâm-lú lô͘-lē lóng tò--lâi, kiông-pek in koh chòe lô͘-lē.
Siōng Chú chiū hoan-hù Iâ-lī-bí tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng,
“Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Góa kā lín ê chó͘-sian tùi Ai-ki̍p chòe lô͘-lē ê tōe chhōa--chhut-lâi ê sî, ū kap in li̍p-iok, hoan-hù in,

‘Lín bóe--lâi ê Hi-pek-lâi tông-pau ho̍k-sāi lín la̍k nî liáu-āu, kàu tē-chhit nî, lín ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h kā in tháu-pàng, hō͘ in chū-iû lī-khui.’ M̄-kú lín ê chó͘-sian lóng bô thiaⁿ, bô sūn-thàn góa.

Chòe-kūn, lín ū kái-piàn sim-ì, chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe chèng-ti̍t ê sū, ta̍k-ê lâng tī kèng-pài góa ê sèng-tiān, tī góa ê bīn-chêng li̍p-iok, kā lín ê tông-pau soan-pò͘ chū-iû.
M̄-kú lín soah hō͘-hóe, kèng-jiân kā lín tháu-pàng ê lâm-lú lô͘-lē kiò--tò-lâi, kiông-pek in koh chòe lô͘-lē, siat-to̍k góa ê miâ.

Só͘-í, góa Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lín kì-jiân bô beh sūn-thàn góa, bô kā lín chòe lô͘-lē ê tông-pau, chhù-piⁿ soan-pò͘ chū-iû, án-ni, góa beh pàng lín hō͘ chiàn-loān, un-e̍k, ki-hng thún-ta̍h, hō͘ lia̍t-kok ê lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê cho-gū kám-kak tio̍h-kiaⁿ. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê léng-siù, koaⁿ-oân, chè-si, í-ki̍p só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn kap góa li̍p-iok; in chiong sòe-chiah gû phòa-chòe nn̄g pêng, tùi nn̄g pêng ê tiong-ng kiâⁿ--kè, m̄-kú in ûi-pōe chit-ê iok, bô chun-siú iok ê kui-tēng. Só͘-í, góa beh hō͘ in chhin-chhiūⁿ sòe-chiah gû siū phòa-khui.
Góa beh kā in kau hō͘ in ê tùi-te̍k kap siàu-siūⁿ in sìⁿ-miā ê lâng. In ê sin-si ōe chiâⁿ-chòe khong-tiong pe-chiáu kap tōe-chiūⁿ iá-siù ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Góa mā beh chiong Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka kap i ê jîn-sîn kau hō͘ in ê tùi-te̍k kap siàu-siūⁿ in sìⁿ-miā ê lâng, í-ki̍p chiām-sî thiat-thè ê Pa-pí-lûn kun-tūi.

Góa beh bēng-lēng Pa-pí-lûn ê kun-tūi koh tò-lâi kong-táⁿ chit-ê siâⁿ, kā i kong-chiàm, pàng-hé sio; góa beh hō͘ Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn pha-hng, bô lâng tòa. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kèng chòe Iû-tāi -ông ê sî, Siōng Chú kā Iâ-lī-bí kóng,
“Lí khì Lī-kah -cho̍k hia, kā in chhōa-lâi Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê chi̍t ê pâng-keng, the̍h chiú hō͘ in lim.”
Góa chiū khì kā Hap-pa-sé-nî-ngá ê sun, Iâ-lī-bí ê kiáⁿ Ngá-sat-nî-a, i ê hiaⁿ-tī, i ê hāu-siⁿ, í-ki̍p Lī-kah choân-cho̍k ê lâng,

lóng chhōa-lâi Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, ji̍p-khì I-ki-tāi-lī ê kiáⁿ Siōng-tè tiōng-iōng ê lâng Hap-lân hiah-ê kiáⁿ ê pâng-keng; hit-ê pâng-keng óa-kūn koaⁿ-oân ê pâng-keng, tī Sa-liông ê kiáⁿ sèng-tiān mn̂g-kháu ê siú-ōe Má-se-ngá pâng-keng ê lâu-téng.
Góa ēng chiú kā chiú-ô͘, chiú-poe tò-tīⁿ, hē tī Lī-kah -cho̍k ê lâng thâu-chêng, tùi in kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lim.”
In kóng, “Goán bô lim-chiú. Goán ê chó͘-sian Lī-kah ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-ta̍t ū kā goán kau-tài, ‘Lín kap lín ê hō͘-tāi éng-oán to m̄-thang lim-chiú.

M̄-thang khí-chhù, m̄-thang iā-chéng, m̄-thang chai-chèng phû-tô, mā m̄-thang ū phû-tô-hn̂g; tio̍h chi̍t-sì-lâng tòa tī pò͘-pîⁿ, lín chiah ōe-tàng tī kià-ku ê tōe tn̂g-hè-siū.’
Goán chó͘-sian Lī-kah ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-ta̍t kau-tài goán ê ōe, goán lóng ū chun-siú. Goán kap goán ê bó͘-kiáⁿ, chi̍t-sì-lâng lóng bô lim-chiú,
bô khí-chhù tòa, bô phû-tô-hn̂g, bô thó͘-tōe, bô chèng-choh,
kan-ta tòa tī pò͘-pîⁿ, lóng chiàu goán ê chó͘-sian Iok-ná-ta̍t ê bēng-lēng.

Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat lâi kong-táⁿ chit-tè thó͘-tōe ê sî, goán kóng, ‘Kiâⁿ, lán lâi-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, siám-bih Pa-pí-lûn kap Sū-lī-a ê kun-tūi.’ Án-ni, goán chiah lâi tòa tiàm Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.”

Siōng Chú hoan-hù Iâ-lī-bí khì kā Iû-tāi -lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn kóng, “Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lín bô beh thiaⁿ góa ê kà-sī, m̄ sūn-thàn góa ê ōe sī--bô?
Lī-kah ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-ta̍t kau-tài i ê hō͘-tāi m̄-thang lim-chiú, in chiū lóng chun-siú it-ti̍t kàu kin-á-ji̍t. M̄-kú, góa put-toān kā lín kéng-kài, lín lóng m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn.

Góa chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn chhe-phài góa ê po̍k-jîn sian-ti khì lín hia, kā lín kóng: Lín ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h hôe-thâu, lī-khui siâ-ok ê tō-lō͘, kái-chèng lín ê hêng-ûi, bô koh khì tè pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, ho̍k-sāi in, án-ni lín chiū ōe-tàng tòa tī góa sù hō͘ lín kap lín ê chó͘-sian ê thó͘-tōe. M̄-kú lín lóng bô beh thiaⁿ, bô beh chun-siú.
Lī-kah ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-ta̍t ê hō͘-tāi ōe-tàng chun-siú in ê chó͘-sian hō͘ in ê bēng-lēng, m̄-kú lín chiah-ê jîn-bîn lóng bô beh thiaⁿ-thàn góa.

Só͘-í, góa Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Góa beh chiong góa só͘ kóng it-chhè ê chai-hō kàng hō͘ Iû-tāi -lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘-ū ê chū-bîn; in-ūi góa kā lín kà-sī, lín bô beh thiaⁿ, kā lín kiò, lín bô beh ìn.’”

Āu-lâi, Iâ-lī-bí tùi Lī-kah -cho̍k kóng, “Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Lín ū thiaⁿ-thàn lín ê chó͘-sian Iok-ná-ta̍t kau-tài lín ê ōe, chun-siú i só͘-ū ê bēng-lēng, chiàu i kā lín hoan-hù--ê khì chòe,
só͘-í, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni soan-pò͘: Lī-kah ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná-ta̍t éng-oán ū lâng tī góa ê bīn-chêng sū-hōng góa.”
Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kèng thóng-tī Iû-tāi tē-sì nî, Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng,

“Lí the̍h chi̍t kńg chheh lâi, chiong Iok-se-a choh-ông ê sî kàu kin-á-ji̍t, góa tùi lí kóng só͘-ū iú-koan Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi, í-ki̍p lia̍t-kok ê ōe, lóng kì-lio̍k--khí-lâi.

Iû-tāi -ke thiaⁿ-tio̍h góa beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ in, in ta̍k-ê lâng ū khó-lêng ōe hóe-kái, bô koh kiâⁿ siâ-ok ê lō͘, án-ni góa chiū ōe sià-bián in ê chōe-gia̍t kap chōe-ok.”
Iâ-lī-bí kiò Nî-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Pa-lio̍k lâi, chiong Siōng Chú tùi i só͘ kóng it-chhè ê ōe kā Pa-lio̍k kóng, Pa-lio̍k chiū chiong chiah-ê ōe lóng kì-lio̍k tī chheh-kǹg.
Iâ-lī-bí hoan-hù Pa-lio̍k, kóng, “Góa hō͘ lâng kìm-chí, bōe-ēng-tit ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān,

só͘-í lí tio̍h tī kìm-chia̍h ê ji̍t ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān, chiong góa kā lí kóng, lí siá tī chheh-kǹg Siōng Chú ê ōe, tha̍k hō͘ jîn-bîn kap tùi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-tìn lâi ê Iû-tāi -lâng thiaⁿ.

In ū khó-lêng ōe tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng kî-tó hóe-kái, ta̍k-ê lâng bô koh kiâⁿ siâ-ok ê lō͘, in-ūi Siōng Chú ū kóng, I tùi chit-ê bîn-cho̍k hoat ê siū-khì hui-siông béng-lia̍t.”
Nî-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Pa-lio̍k chiū chiàu sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí só͘ hoan-hù it-chhè ê ōe, tī Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān soan-tho̍k chheh-kǹg só͘ kì-chài Siōng Chú ê ōe.

Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kèng choh Iû-tāi -ông tē-gō͘ nî káu--ge̍h, tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng kap só͘-ū tùi Iû-tāi ta̍k siâⁿ-tìn lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê jîn-bîn, tī Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng chun-siú kìm-chia̍h.

Hit-sî, Pa-lio̍k tī Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê téng-bīn-tiâⁿ, óa-kūn sèng-tiān Sin-mn̂g mn̂g-kháu, Sa-hoan ê kiáⁿ su-kì Ki-má-lī-ngá ê pâng-keng, soan-tho̍k chheh-kǹg lāi-bīn Iâ-lī-bí ê ōe hō͘ só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn thiaⁿ.
Sa-hoan ê sun, Ki-má-lī-ngá ê kiáⁿ Bí-kai-ngá thiaⁿ-tio̍h chheh-kǹg só͘ kì-chài Siōng Chú ê ōe,

chiū khì ông-kiong, ji̍p-khì kiong-tiān su-kì ê pâng-keng. Hit-sî, chin chōe koaⁿ-oân í-keng chē tī hia, pau-koat su-kì-koaⁿ Í-lī-sa-má, Sī-má-ngá ê kiáⁿ Tē-lâi-ngá, A-kek-pho ê kiáⁿ Í-lī-ná-tan, Sa-hoan ê kiáⁿ Ki-má-lī-ngá, Hap-ná-nî-ngá ê kiáⁿ Se-tí-ka, í-ki̍p kî-tha ê koaⁿ-oân.
Bí-kai-ngá chiong i só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h, Pa-lio̍k tùi só͘-ū jîn-bîn soan-tho̍k hit-ê chheh-kǹg ê ōe, lóng kā in kóng.

In chiū phài Kó͘-sī ê kan-á-sun, Sī-lī-bí-ngá ê sun, Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iû-tí khì Pa-lio̍k hia, kiò i chhin-sin kā hit-kńg chheh tòa--lâi. Nî-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Pa-lio̍k chiū the̍h chheh-kǹg khì in hia.
In kā i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ-chē. Chhiáⁿ tha̍k hō͘ goán thiaⁿ.” Pa-lio̍k chiū tha̍k hō͘ in thiaⁿ.
In thiaⁿ-liáu, chin kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, hō͘-siōng khòaⁿ-lâi-khòaⁿ-khì. In kā Pa-lio̍k kóng, “Goán it-tēng tio̍h chiong chiah-ê ōe lóng tùi ông pò-kò.”
In koh mn̄g Pa-lio̍k, “Chhiáⁿ kā goán kóng, lí án-chóaⁿ kā chiah-ê siá--khí-lâi? Sī Iâ-lī-bí chhin-chhùi kóng--ê sī--bô?”
Pa-lio̍k ìn kóng, “Só͘-ū chiah-ê ōe lóng sī i chhin-chhùi kā góa kóng--ê, góa chiū ēng pit-ba̍k siá tī chheh-kǹg.”
Hiah-ê koaⁿ-oân kā Pa-lio̍k kóng, “Lí kap Iâ-lī-bí tio̍h khì bih--khí-lâi, m̄-thang hō͘ lâng chai lín tī tó-ūi.”
Hiah-ê koaⁿ-oân chiong hit-kńg chheh hē tī su-kì-koaⁿ Í-lī-sa-má ê pâng-keng, jiân-āu ji̍p-khì ông-kiong ê tiâⁿ khì kìⁿ ông, chiong chiah-ê ōe tùi ông pò-kò.
Ông chiū phài Iû-tí khì su-kì-koaⁿ Í-lī-sa-má ê pâng-keng, the̍h hit-kńg chheh lâi, tha̍k hō͘ ông kap khiā tī ông chó-iū ê jîn-sîn thiaⁿ.
Hit-chūn sī káu--ge̍h, ông chē tī tang-kiong; i thâu-chêng hé-lô͘ ê hé teh to̍h.
Iû-tí ta̍k-piàn tha̍k saⁿ sì lân, ông chiū ēng su-kì ê to-á kā chheh-kǹg koah-phòa, hiat-lo̍h hé-lô͘, kàu kui-kńg chheh lóng sio-liáu-liáu.
Ông kap hiah-ê jîn-sîn thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe lóng bô teh kiaⁿ, mā bô thiah-li̍h in ê saⁿ.
Í-lī-ná-tan, Tē-lâi-ngá, Ki-má-lī-ngá chhéng-kiû ông m̄-thang sio hit-kńg chheh, m̄-kú ông lóng m̄ thiaⁿ.

Ông tian-tò bēng-lēng ông-chú Iâ-la-bia̍t, A-su-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ Se-lâi-ngá, kap A-pek-tia̍p ê kiáⁿ Sī-lī-bí-ngá khì lia̍h su-kì Pa-lio̍k kap sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí; m̄-kú Siōng Chú kā in nn̄g ê chhàng--khí-lâi.
Iok-ngá-kèng -ông chiong Iâ-lī-bí kóng hō͘ Pa-lio̍k siá--lo̍h-lâi hit-kńg chheh sio--khì liáu-āu, Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng-ōe, kóng,
“Lí koh the̍h chi̍t kńg chheh-kǹg, chiong Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kèng sio--khì hit-kńg chheh lāi-bīn ê ōe koh siá chi̍t piàn.

Koan-hē Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kèng, lí tio̍h kóng, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lí sio hit-kńg chheh, koh kóng, ‘ Iâ-lī-bí sī-án-chóaⁿ tī hit lāi-bīn siá, Pa-pí-lûn -ông ōe lâi húi-bia̍t chit-tè thó͘-tōe, siau-bia̍t chiah-ê jîn-bîn kap cheng-siⁿ?’

Só͘-í, Siōng Chú chiam-tùi Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kèng án-ni kóng: I ê kiáⁿ-sun it-tēng bô lâng ōe-tàng chē Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-ūi; i ê si-thé ōe hō͘ lâng hiat tī gōa-bīn, ji̍t--sî hō͘ ji̍t pha̍k, mî--sî hō͘ sng tàng.

Góa beh in-ūi i, i ê kiáⁿ-jî, kap i ê jîn-sîn ê chōe-gia̍t kā in hêng-hoa̍t, mā beh chiong góa tùi in kóng--kè ê chai-hō kàng hō͘ in kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn, í-ki̍p Iû-tāi jîn-bîn. M̄-kú in iáu-sī m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn.”

Iâ-lī-bí chiū koh the̍h chi̍t kńg chheh-kǹg, kau hō͘ Nî-lī-a ê kiáⁿ su-kì Pa-lio̍k, kiò i chiong hō͘ Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kèng sio--khì hit-kńg chheh-kǹg ê lōe-iông koh siá chi̍t piàn, lēng-gōa koh pó͘-chhiong chin chōe lūi-sū ê ōe.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat siat-li̍p Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Se-tí-ka tāi-thòe Iok-ngá-kèng ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kun choh Iû-tāi -ông.
M̄-kú Se-tí-ka, i ê jîn-sîn, kap choân-kok jîn-bîn m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú thong-kè sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí kóng ê ōe.

Se-tí-ka -ông phài Sī-lī-bí-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iû-kah, Má-se-ngá ê kiáⁿ chè-si Se-hoan-ngá khì kā sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí thòe goán kî-kiû Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè.”
Hit-sî, Iâ-lī-bí iáu-bē hō͘ lâng koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ, iáu ōe-tàng tī jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan chhut-chhut-ji̍p-ji̍p;
koh ûi-kong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Pa-pí-lûn kun-tūi hut-jiân thiat-thè, in-ūi in thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Hoat-ló í-keng phài kun-tūi tùi Ai-ki̍p chhut-hoat.
Siōng Chú tùi sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí kóng,

“Lí kā in kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Lín tio̍h kā phài lín lâi kiû-mn̄g góa ê Iû-tāi -ông án-ni kóng: Lí khòaⁿ-bāi--leh, hiah-ê chhut-lâi beh oān-chō͘ lí ê Hoat-ló kun-tūi ōe thiat-thè tò-khì Ai-ki̍p.
Pa-pí-lûn ê kun-tūi it-tēng ōe koh lâi kong-táⁿ chit-ê siâⁿ, kā i chiàm-léng, pàng-hé sio.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, lín m̄-thang chū-ngó͘ khi-phiàn, siūⁿ-kóng Pa-pí-lûn -lâng it-tēng ōe lī-khui lín. Kî-si̍t, in bōe lī-khui.
Chiū-sī-kóng lín kā lâi kong-táⁿ ê Pa-pí-lûn choân-kun phah-pāi, chhun chi̍t-kóa siū-siong ê peng-á, in mā ōe tùi iâⁿ-pâng khí--lâi, pàng-hé sio chit-ê siâⁿ.’”
Pa-pí-lûn kun-tūi ūi-tio̍h beh siám-pī Hoat-ló ê kun-tūi, thiat-thè lī-khui Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Iâ-lī-bí chiū tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chhut-hoat khì Piān-ngá-bín tōe-khu, beh tī chhin-cho̍k ê tiong-kan kè-sêng i ê sán-gia̍p.

I khì kàu Piān-ngá-bín-mn̂g ê sî, Hap-ná-nî-ngá ê sun, Sī-lī-bí-ngá ê kiáⁿ siú-ōe-tūi ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ I-lī-ngá kā Iâ-lī-bí lia̍h--khí-lâi, kóng, “Lí beh tùi Pa-pí-lûn -lâng tâu-hâng ho͘hⁿ.”
Iâ-lī-bí kóng, “Lí o͘-pe̍h kóng! Góa bô beh khì tâu-hâng Pa-pí-lûn -lâng!” M̄-kú I-lī-ngá m̄ thiaⁿ, kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, kau hō͘ koaⁿ-oân.
Hiah-ê koaⁿ-oân lóng chin khì Iâ-lī-bí, chiū kā i phah, kā i koaiⁿ tī kiong-têng su-kì-koaⁿ Iok-ná-tan ê chhù, hit-keng chhù í-keng kái chòe kaⁿ-lô.
In chiong Iâ-lī-bí koaiⁿ tī tōe-lô kúi-nā ji̍t.

Se-tí-ka -ông phài lâng khì kā Iâ-lī-bí chhōa--lâi, tī ông-kiong su-hā mn̄g i, “Siōng Chú kiám ū kā lí kóng sím-mi̍h?” Iâ-lī-bí ìn kóng, “Ū! Lí ōe hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông lia̍h--khì.”
Koh kā Se-tí-ka -ông kóng, “Góa ū tek-chōe lí sím-mi̍h, á-sī tek-chōe lí ê jîn-sîn kap chiah-ê jîn-bîn, lí kèng-jiân kā góa koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ?
Hiah-ê tùi lí ū-giân, kóng Pa-pí-lûn -ông it-tēng bōe lâi kong-táⁿ lín kap chit-tè thó͘-tōe ê sian-ti, taⁿ tī tó-ūi?
Góa ê chú, góa ê ông, chhiáⁿ lí thiaⁿ, ún-chún góa ê khún-kiû, m̄-thang sàng góa koh tò-khì su-kì-koaⁿ Iok-ná-tan ê chhù; nā bô, góa ōe sí tī hia.”

Se-tí-ka -ông chiū hā-lēng, kā Iâ-lī-bí khu-liû tī hō͘-ōe-tūi ê tiâⁿ, ta̍k-ji̍t tùi piáⁿ-tiàm-koe the̍h chi̍t hūn mī-pau hō͘ i, ti̍t-kàu siâⁿ-lāi ê mī-pau lóng chia̍h-liáu-liáu; Iâ-lī-bí chiū án-ni it-ti̍t hō͘ lâng khu-liû tī hō͘-ōe-tūi ê tiâⁿ--ni̍h.
Má-thán ê kiáⁿ Sī-hoat-thê-ngá, Pa-si-hō͘-ní ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī, Sī-lī-bí-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iû-kah, Má-ki-ngá ê kiáⁿ Pa-si-hō͘-ní, thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-lī-bí tùi bîn-chiòng kóng,

“Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Só͘-ū lâu tī chit-ê siâⁿ lāi-bīn ê lâng, lóng ōe in-ūi chiàn-loān, ki-hng, un-e̍k sí, m̄-kú chhut-khì tâu-hâng Pa-pí-lûn -lâng--ê chiū ōe oa̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ sìⁿ-miā koh khioh--tio̍h.
Siōng Chú koh kóng: Góa beh chiong chit-ê siâⁿ kau hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê kun-tūi, i it-tēng ōe kong-chiàm chit-ê siâⁿ.”

Hit kúi ê koaⁿ-oân chiū khì kā Se-tí-ka -ông pò-kò, kóng, “Chhiáⁿ ông kā chit-ê lâng chhú-sí, in-ūi i kā siâⁿ-lāi chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê kun-peng kap jîn-bîn kóng chit-khoán ōe, hō͘ in ê sū-khì siau-tîm sit-chì. Chit-ê lâng m̄-sī beh hō͘ jîn-bîn an-choân, sī beh hō͘ jîn-bîn siū chai-hāi.”
Ông kā in kóng, “Góa kā lín kóng, góa kā i kau hō͘ lín; lín án-chóaⁿ kā i chhú-lí, góa bōe kā lín hoán-tùi.”

In chiū kā Iâ-lī-bí lia̍h--khí-lâi, ēng soh-á kā i lūi lo̍h-khì ông-chú Má-ki-ngá tī hō͘-ōe-tūi ê tiâⁿ ê thiok-chúi-tî. Chit-ê thiok-chúi-tî bô chúi, chí-ū thô͘-bê. Iâ-lī-bí chiū hām tī thô͘-bê lāi-bīn.

Se-tí-ka -ông tī Piān-ngá-bín-mn̂g teh chhú-lí àn-kiāⁿ ê sî, ông-kiong lāi-bīn ê thài-kàm Kó͘-si̍t -lâng Í-pek Bí-le̍k thiaⁿ-tio̍h lâng kā Iâ-lī-bí lūi lo̍h-khì thiok-chúi-tî,
chiū chhut ông-kiong khì tùi ông pò-kò,

“Góa ê chú, góa ê ông, hiah-ê lâng án-ni chhú-lí sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí ū khah kè-hūn. In kā i pàng lo̍h-khì thiok-chúi-tî; i ōe gō--sí, in-ūi siâⁿ-lāi í-keng bô niû-si̍t lah.”
Ông chiū bēng-lēng Kó͘-si̍t -lâng Í-pek Bí-le̍k, kóng, “Lí tùi chia chhōa saⁿ-cha̍p ê lâng, thàn sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí iáu-bē sí, kā i tùi thiok-chúi-tî kiù--chhut-lâi.”
Í-pek Bí-le̍k chiū chhōa hiah-ê lâng ji̍p-khì ông-kiong ê chhng-khò͘, the̍h chi̍t-kóa kū-saⁿ phòa-pò͘, ēng soh-á lūi lo̍h-khì thiok-chúi-tî lāi-bīn hō͘ Iâ-lī-bí.
I kā Iâ-lī-bí kóng, “Lí ēng hiah-ê kū-saⁿ phòa-pò͘ hē tī soh-á téng-bīn, gia̍p tī lí ê koh-ē-khang.” Iâ-lī-bí chiū chiàu án-ni chòe.
Án-ni, in chiū kā Iâ-lī-bí tùi thiok-chúi-tî khiú--khí-lâi. Iâ-lī-bí kè-sio̍k hō͘ lâng khu-liû tī hō͘-ōe-tūi ê tiâⁿ--ni̍h.

Se-tí-ka -ông phài lâng khì kā sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí chhōa-lâi Siōng Chú sèng-tiān tē-saⁿ ê mn̂g ê ji̍p-kháu, ông tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê būn-tôe góa beh chhiáⁿ-mn̄g lí, lí tio̍h chiàu-si̍t kóng.”
Iâ-lī-bí tùi Se-tí-ka kóng, “Góa nā chiàu-si̍t kā lí kóng, lí it-tēng ōe kā góa thâi-sí. Góa kā lí khó͘-khǹg, lí mā bōe thiaⁿ.”

Se-tí-ka -ông chiū su-hā chiù-chōa kóng, “Góa kí chhòng-chō lán sìⁿ-miā éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa, góa it-tēng bōe thâi lí, mā bōe kā lí kau hō͘ hiah-ê siàu-siūⁿ lí sìⁿ-miā ê lâng.”

Iâ-lī-bí chiū tùi Se-tí-ka -ông kóng, “Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Lí nā chhut-khì tâu-hâng Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê chiong-kun, lí chiū ōe oa̍h, chit-ê siâⁿ mā bōe hō͘ in pàng-hé sio; lí kap lín choân-ke lóng ōe-tàng oa̍h--lo̍h-lâi.
Lí nā m̄ tâu-hâng Pa-pí-lûn ê chiong-kun, chit-ê siâⁿ chiū ōe kau tī Pa-pí-lûn -lâng ê chhiú; in ōe kā siâⁿ pàng-hé sio; lí mā bōe-tàng thoat-lī in ê chhiú-thâu.”

Se-tí-ka -ông tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng, “Góa chin kiaⁿ hiah-ê í-keng tâu-hâng Pa-pí-lûn ê Iû-tāi -lâng; kiaⁿ Pa-pí-lûn -lâng kā góa kau hō͘ in, in ōe kā góa hì-lāng lêng-jio̍k.”

Iâ-lī-bí kóng, “ Pa-pí-lûn -lâng bōe kā lí kau hō͘ in lah! Chhiáⁿ lí tio̍h chiàu góa tùi lí kóng Siōng Chú ê ōe khì chòe, án-ni, lí chiū ōe pêng-an bô-sū, lí mā ōe oa̍h.
Lí nā m̄ chhut-khì tâu-hâng, Siōng Chú í-keng án-ni chí-sī góa:

Só͘-ū lâu tī ông-kiong ê kiong-lú ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê chiong-kun hia. Hiah-ê kiong-lú ōe chí-chek lí, kóng: Lí sìn-nāi ê pêng-iú siàn-tōng lí, lí hō͘ in phiàn--khì; in hō͘ lí ê kha hām-lo̍h lō͘-kô͘-bê, chiū oa̍t-tńg-sin chòe in cháu.

Lí ê pîn-hui kap hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ lóng ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn, lí mā bōe-tàng tô-thoat. Lí beh hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông lia̍h--khì, chit-ê siâⁿ mā ōe hō͘ lâng pàng-hé sio.”
Se-tí-ka -ông kā Iâ-lī-bí kóng, “Lí bōe-ēng-tit hō͘ lâng chai-iáⁿ lán kóng-ōe ê lōe-iông, án-ni lí chiū bōe sí.

Nā ū koaⁿ-oân chai-iáⁿ góa ū kap lí kóng-ōe, in lâi mn̄g lí, kóng, ‘Lí kā ông kóng sím-mi̍h? Ông kā lí kóng sím-mi̍h? Lí tio̍h chiàu-si̍t kā goán kóng, nā bô, goán beh kā lí thâi--sí.’
Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Góa kan-ta chhéng-kiû ông m̄-thang kā góa sàng tò-khì Iok-ná-tan ê chhù, chiah bián góa sí tī hia.’”
Āu-lâi, só͘-ū ê koaⁿ-oân kó-jiân lâi mn̄g Iâ-lī-bí; i chiū chiàu ông ê hoan-hù kā in tap-ho̍k. Hiah-ê koaⁿ-oân bô koh tui-mn̄g, in-ūi tāi-chì lóng bô lāu-sia̍p--chhut-khì.
Án-ni, Iâ-lī-bí kè-sio̍k koaiⁿ tī hō͘-ōe-tūi ê tiâⁿ--ni̍h, koaiⁿ kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siū kong-chiàm hit-ji̍t.
Se-tí-ka thóng-tī Iû-tāi tē-káu nî cha̍p--ge̍h, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chhōa i ê tāi-kun lâi ûi-kong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Se-tí-ka tē-cha̍p-it nî sì-ge̍h chhoe-káu, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -siâⁿ siū kong-phòa.

Siâⁿ siū kong-phòa ê sî, Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê chiòng-léng, pau-koat Nî-kah Sa-lī-sih, Sam-kah Nî-pho, Sat-se-kim, lēng-gōa koh chi̍t ê Nî-kah Sa-lī-sih, í-ki̍p Pa-pí-lûn -ông kî-tha ê kun-koaⁿ lóng lâi chē tī siâⁿ ê Tiong-iong-mn̂g.

Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka kap só͘-ū ê kun-peng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pa-pí-lûn tāi-kun, chiū thàu-mî tô-cháu; tùi ông-kiong hoe-hn̂g ê lō͘, keng-kè nn̄g ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ tiong-kan ê mn̂g chhut-siâⁿ; ông ǹg A-la-pa ê hong-hiòng tô-cháu.

Pa-pí-lûn ê kun-peng tui-jip in, tī Iâ-lī-ko ê pêng-goân jip-tio̍h Se-tí-ka, kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat hia. Hit-sî, Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat lâi tī Hap-má tōe-khu ê Lī-pí-la; i chiū tī hia sím-phòaⁿ Se-tí-ka.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông tī Lī-pí-la thâi-sí Se-tí-ka ê kiáⁿ, hō͘ i chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h, mā thâi-sí Iû-tāi só͘-ū ê kùi-cho̍k.
Āu-lâi Pa-pí-lûn -ông ó͘ Se-tí-ka ê nn̄g lúi ba̍k-chiu, ēng tâng-liān kā i liān--teh, beh kā i lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
Pa-pí-lûn -lâng pàng-hé sio ông-kiong kap jîn-bîn ê chhù, thiah-húi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ.
Hit-sî, sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn chiong siâⁿ-lāi chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê jîn-bîn, tâu-hâng kui-sūn ê lâng, kap kî-tha ê jîn-bîn lóng lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
I kā jîn-bîn tiong-kan sím-mi̍h lóng bô ê sàn-chhiah-lâng lâu tī Iû-tāi -tōe, kā phû-tô-hn̂g kap chhân-hn̂g pun hō͘ in.
Koan-hē Iâ-lī-bí, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat bēng-lēng sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn, kóng,
“Góa chiong Iâ-lī-bí kau-tài lí, lí tio̍h hó-hó kā i chiàu-kò͘, m̄-thang kā i siong-hāi; i ū sím-mi̍h iau-kiû, lí tio̍h chiàu án-ni pān-lí.”
Sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn, chiong-kun Nî-pò͘-sa-su-pan, chiong-kun Nî-kah Sa-lī-sih, kap Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ chiū phài lâng

chiong Iâ-lī-bí tùi hō͘-ōe-tūi ê tiâⁿ chhōa--chhut-lâi, kau hō͘ Sa-hoan ê sun, A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī, hō͘ i kā Iâ-lī-bí chhōa tò-khì in tau. Tùi án-ni, Iâ-lī-bí ōe-tàng tī jîn-bîn ê tiong-kan khiā-khí.
Iâ-lī-bí iáu koaiⁿ tī hō͘-ōe-tūi ê tiâⁿ ê sî, Siōng Chú tùi i kóng,

“Lí khì kā Kó͘-si̍t -lâng Í-pek Bí-le̍k kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Góa beh hō͘ góa ê ōe si̍t-hiān tī chit-ê siâⁿ; bô beh sù hok-khì, sī beh kàng chai-hō. Kàu-sî, lí ōe chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h.
M̄-kú kàu hit-ji̍t, góa ōe kiù lí; lí bōe hō͘ lâng kau tī lí teh kiaⁿ ê lâng ê chhiú. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Góa it-tēng beh kiù lí; lí bōe hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, sìⁿ-miā ōe tit-tio̍h pó-choân, in-ūi lí sìn-khò góa. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.’”

Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn tī La-má kā Iâ-lī-bí pàng--chhut-khì í-āu, Siōng Chú ū tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng-ōe. Iâ-lī-bí hō͘ lâng ēng liān-á liān--teh, kap hiah-ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng, í-ki̍p Iû-tāi -lâng chòe-hé beh hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn kiò Iâ-lī-bí lâi, tùi i kóng, “Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè bat kéng-kò beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ chit-ê só͘-chāi.
Taⁿ, Siōng Chú kó-jiân chiàu I só͘ kóng--ê chòe. Che sī in-ūi lín tek-chōe Siōng Chú, bô thiaⁿ-thàn I ê ōe, chiah-ê tāi-chì chiah ōe lîm-kàu lín.

Taⁿ góa chiong liān tī lí ê chhiú ê liān-á pak--khí-lâi. Lí nā khòaⁿ kap góa chòe-hé khì Pa-pí-lûn hó, chiū lâi-khì, góa ōe hó-hó-á kā lí chiàu-kò͘; nā bô ài khì, chiū m̄-bián khì. Lí khòaⁿ, thó͘-tōe chiah khoah, lí ài khì tó-ūi, chiū thang khì.”

Iâ-lī-bí iáu-bē lī-khui í-chêng, Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn koh kā i kóng, “Lí mā ōe-ēng-tit tò-khì Sa-hoan ê sun, A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī hia; Pa-pí-lûn -ông í-keng chí-phài i tī-lí Iû-tāi ta̍k siâⁿ-tìn. Lí thang tòa tī lín ê tông-pau tiong-kan. Á-sī, lí khòaⁿ tó-ūi khah tú-hó, chiū thang khì hia.” Sī-ōe-tiúⁿ chiū sàng lé-mi̍h kap niû-si̍t hō͘ Iâ-lī-bí, hō͘ i chū-iû lī-khui.
Iâ-lī-bí chiū khì Bí-su-pa, khì A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī hia, kap i chòe-hé tòa tī chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê tông-pau tiong-kan.

Tī iá-gōa, hiah-ê bô tâu-hâng Pa-pí-lûn ê kun-koaⁿ kap in ê pō͘-hā, thiaⁿ-tio̍h Pa-pí-lûn -ông chí-phài A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī chòe hit tōe-khu ê séng-tiúⁿ, tī-lí bô lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn ê ta-po͘-lâng, cha-bó͘-lâng, gín-á, kap hit só͘-chāi hui-siông sàn-chhiah ê lâng,

chiū lâi Bí-su-pa kìⁿ Ki-tāi-lī. Chiah-ê kun-koaⁿ pau-koat Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī, Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân kap Iok-ná-tan, Tan-hō͘-be̍k ê kiáⁿ Se-lâi-ngá, Nî-tô-hoat -lâng Í-húi ê kiáⁿ-jî, Má-ka -lâng Iâ-sat-nî-a, í-ki̍p in ê pō͘-hā.

Sa-hoan ê sun, A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī tùi hiah-ê kun-koaⁿ kap in ê pō͘-hā chiù-chōa, kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ ho̍k-sāi Pa-pí-lûn -lâng. Chòe lín tòa tiàm chit-ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông koán, lín chiū ōe pêng-an bô-sū.

Góa leh, góa ōe tòa tī Bí-su-pa, sū-hāu hiah-ê lâi lán chia ê Pa-pí-lûn -lâng. M̄-kú lín, lín tio̍h chek-chū chi̍t-kóa chiú, iû, kap joa̍h-thiⁿ ê ké-chí, siu tiàm khì-khū lāi-bīn, koh tòa tī lín chiàm ê siâⁿ-tìn.”

Hiah-ê tī Mô͘-ap, A-bûn, Í-tong tōe-khu, kap ta̍k-kok ê Iû-tāi -lâng, thiaⁿ-tio̍h Pa-pí-lûn -ông bô châu-bia̍t só͘-ū ê Iû-tāi -lâng, koh phài Sa-hoan ê sun, A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī chòe séng-tiúⁿ,
in chiū tùi hō͘ lâng kóaⁿ--khì ê ta̍k só͘-chāi tńg--lâi, lâi Iû-tāi -tōe ê Bí-su-pa, khì Ki-tāi-lī hia. In lóng ū siu-khǹg chin chōe chiú kap joa̍h-thiⁿ ê ké-chí.
Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân kap hiah-ê tī iá-gōa ê kun-koaⁿ lâi Bí-su-pa kìⁿ Ki-tāi-lī,
tùi i kóng, “ A-bûn -ông Pa-lī-su ū phài Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī lâi beh thâi lí, lí kiám chai?” A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī m̄ sìn in ê ōe.

Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân tī Bí-su-pa su-hā tùi Ki-tāi-lī kóng, “Chhiáⁿ ún-chún góa khì thâi Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī, it-tēng bô lâng ōe chai-iáⁿ chit-ê tāi-chì. Ná thang hō͘ i kā lí thâi-sí. Lí nā sí, só͘-ū kui-óa lâi lí chia ê Iû-tāi -lâng chiū ōe sì-sòaⁿ, chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê Iû-tāi -lâng kiám m̄-sī lóng ōe bia̍t-bông?”
A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī kā Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân kóng, “Lí m̄-thang chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì. Lí só͘ kóng koan-hē Í-si̍t-má-lī ê ōe bô-iáⁿ.”

Chhit--ge̍h, Iû-tāi -ông ông-ka ê hō͘-tāi, mā-sī koaⁿ-oân, Í-lī-sa-má ê sun, Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī chhōa cha̍p ê lâng lâi Bí-su-pa kìⁿ A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī. In tī Bí-su-pa chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g ê sî,

Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī kap hit cha̍p ê kap i chòe-hé lâi ê lâng, ēng to thâi-sí Pa-pí-lûn -ông chí-phài chòe séng-tiúⁿ, Sa-hoan ê sun, A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī.
Í-si̍t-má-lī mā thâi-sí tī Bí-su-pa só͘-ū kap Ki-tāi-lī chòe-hé ê Iû-tāi -lâng, í-ki̍p chū-chāi tī hia ê Pa-pí-lûn kun-peng.
Keh-ji̍t, lâng iáu m̄ chai Ki-tāi-lī siū àm-sat ê sū,

ū poeh-cha̍p ê lâng tùi Sī-kiàm, Sī-lô, Sat-má-lī-a lâi kàu Bí-su-pa. In thì chhùi-chhiu, thiah-phòa saⁿ, koah-siong ka-kī ê seng-khu, tòa sò͘-chè kap jú-hiuⁿ beh khì Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān hiàn-chè.

Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī tùi Bí-su-pa chhut--lâi, ná kiâⁿ ná háu khì gêng-chiap in. Í-si̍t-má-lī tú-tio̍h in, chiū tùi in kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lâi kìⁿ A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī.”
In chi̍t-ē ji̍p-siâⁿ, Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī kap i ê pō͘-hā chiū thâi-sí hiah-ê lâng, kā in ê si-thé hiat tī ta--khì ê thiok-chúi-tî.

Hit poeh-cha̍p ê lâng tiong-kan ū cha̍p ê tùi Í-si̍t-má-lī kóng, “M̄-thang kā goán thâi-sí. Goán ū chhàng tōa-be̍h, sió-be̍h, iû, kap bi̍t tī hn̂g--ni̍h.” I chiū thêng-chhiú, bô chiong chit cha̍p ê lâng kap kî-tha ê tâng-phōaⁿ chòe-hé thâi-sí.

Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī chiong hiah-ê in-ūi Ki-tāi-lī ê iân-kò͘ hō͘ i thâi-sí ê lâng ê sin-si, lóng hiat lo̍h-khì thiok-chúi-tî hiat kah tīⁿ-tīⁿ-tīⁿ; chit-ê thiok-chúi-tî sī í-chêng Iû-tāi -ông A-sat ūi-tio̍h hông-ōe pak-kok Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Pa-sa ó͘--ê.

Í-si̍t-má-lī chiong Bí-su-pa chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê jîn-bîn, pau-koat Se-tí-ka -ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kap iáu tòa tī Bí-su-pa ê lâng lóng lia̍h--khí-lâi. Chiah-ê chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng sī sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn kau-tài A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī koán-lí--ê. Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī beh chiong chiah-ê lâng lóng lia̍h-khì A-bûn -lâng hia.
Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân kap kun-tè i ê kun-koaⁿ thiaⁿ-tio̍h Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ tāi-chì,
chiū chhōa só͘-ū ê pō͘-hā beh khì kap Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī kau-chiàn, tī Ki-piàn ê tōa chúi-tî piⁿ jip-tio̍h i.
Hō͘ Í-si̍t-má-lī lia̍h--khì hiah-ê jîn-bîn khòaⁿ-tio̍h Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân í-ki̍p kap i chòe-hé lâi ê kun-koaⁿ, lóng chin hoaⁿ-hí.
Án-ni, hiah-ê hō͘ Í-si̍t-má-lī tùi Bí-su-pa lia̍h--khì ê lâng chiū oa̍t-tńg-sin cháu kè-lâi Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân hia.
Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī kap lēng-gōa poeh ê lâng thoat-lī Iok-hap-lân ê chhiú, cháu-khì A-bûn -lâng hia.

Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī thâi-sí A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī liáu-āu, chiong chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê jîn-bîn, pau-koat ta-po͘-lâng, peng-á, hū-lú, gín-á, koaⁿ-oân, tùi Bí-su-pa lia̍h-khì Ki-piàn; āu-lâi, Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân kap kun-tè i ê kun-koaⁿ chiong hiah-ê lâng lóng kiù--chhut-lâi.
In khì kàu Pek-lī-hêng hù-kūn ê Ki-lô-tek Kim-hán, tī hia hioh-khùn, chún-pī beh lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p,

thang tô-pī Pa-pí-lûn -lâng. Nî-thàm-ngá ê kiáⁿ Í-si̍t-má-lī àm-sat Pa-pí-lûn -ông só͘ chí-phài chòe séng-tiúⁿ, A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī liáu-āu, in chin kiaⁿ Pa-pí-lûn -lâng.
Só͘-ū ê kun-koaⁿ, pau-koat Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân, Hô-sa-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iâ-sat-nî-a, í-ki̍p só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn, bô-lūn chun-kùi á-sī pi-bî, lóng khì kìⁿ sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí,

tùi i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chiap-siū goán ê chhéng-kiû, thòe goán chiah-ê chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng ǹg Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè kî-tó. Lí ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, goán pún-lâi lâng chin chōe, m̄-kú hiān-chāi chhun chiah chió.
Chhiáⁿ thòe goán kî-kiû Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè, chí-sī goán eng-kai kiâⁿ ê lō͘, tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe.”

Sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí kā in kóng, “Án-ni góa chai. Hó! Góa ōe chiàu lín ê chhéng-kiû, ǹg Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè kî-tó. Siōng Chú kā góa kóng sím-mi̍h, góa it-tēng ōe kā lín kóng, bōe kā lín ún-môa.”

In chiū tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng, “Goán nā bô chiàu Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè phài lí lâi thoân-ta̍t hō͘ goán ê ta̍k-kù ōe khì chòe, goān I tī lán tiong-kan chòe kong-chèng khó-khò ê kiàn-chèng-jîn.

Sī goán chhiáⁿ lí thòe goán ǹg Siōng Chú khún-kiû, só͘-í, I tùi goán kóng ê ōe bô-lūn sī hó á-sī bái, goán lóng beh thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè, án-ni goán chiah ōe sū-sū sūn-lī.”
Cha̍p ji̍t āu, Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng-ōe.
Iâ-lī-bí chiū kiò Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân, í-ki̍p kap i chòe-hé ê kun-koaⁿ, jîn-bîn, bô-lūn chun-kùi á-sī pi-bî, lóng khì i hia.
I kā in kóng, “Lín ū chhiáⁿ góa ūi-tio̍h lín ǹg Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè kî-tó, I án-ni kóng,

‘Lín nā iû-goân tòa tī chit-tè thó͘-tōe, góa chiū beh kā lín tiông-kiàn, bōe kā lín thiah-húi; beh kā lín chai-chèng, bōe kā lín pu̍ih-chhut; in-ūi góa ūi-tio̍h góa kàng hō͘ lín ê chai-hō kám-kak chin siong-sim.
Lín teh kiaⁿ ê Pa-pí-lûn -ông, m̄-bián kiaⁿ i! In-ūi góa kap lín tông-chāi, beh kái-kiù lín, hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h chū-iû. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Góa beh tùi lín si lîn-bín, mā beh hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông lîn-bín lín, hō͘ lín tò-tńg-lâi lín ê thó͘-tōe.’
“M̄-kú lín nā bô beh lâu tiàm chia, bô beh sūn-chiông Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, tian-tò kóng,
‘M̄, goán beh khì Ai-ki̍p; hia bô chiàn-cheng, bōe thiaⁿ-tio̍h sàu-kak ê siaⁿ, koh ū mi̍h-kiāⁿ thang chia̍h bōe iau-sí. Goán beh khì tòa hia.’

Taⁿ, Iû-tāi chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe! Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lín nā kian-chhî beh khì Ai-ki̍p, beh kià-ku tī hia,
lín teh kiaⁿ ê to-kiàm ōe jip kàu hia; lín teh kiaⁿ ê ki-hng mā ōe tè lín kàu Ai-ki̍p, hō͘ lín sí tī hia.
Só͘-ū kian-koat beh kià-ku tī Ai-ki̍p ê lâng it-tēng ōe in-ūi chiàn-loān, ki-hng, un-e̍k sí tī hia, bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng oa̍h--lo̍h-lâi, thoat-lī góa beh kàng hō͘ in ê chai-hō.’

“Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lín nā khì Ai-ki̍p, góa chiū beh tùi lín hoat tōa siū-khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn hoat tōa siū-khì kâng-khoán. Lín ōe chiâⁿ-chòe lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ, chiù-chó͘, bú-jio̍k ê tùi-siōng, hō͘ lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ; lín mā bōe-tàng koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê kò͘-hiong.’
“Tùi lín chiah-ê Iû-tāi chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng, Siōng Chú kóng, ‘M̄-thang khì Ai-ki̍p!’ Lín tio̍h chheng-chhó chai-iáⁿ, góa kin-á-ji̍t í-keng kā lín kéng-kò.

Lín í-keng hoān tì-miā ê chhò-gō͘; lín chhiáⁿ góa khì kiû-mn̄g Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, lín kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ thòe goán ǹg Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè kî-tó, chiong Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè tùi lí kóng ê ōe lóng kā goán kóng, goán it-tēng beh thiaⁿ-thàn.’
Taⁿ góa chiong Siōng Chú ê ōe kā lín kóng lah, lín soah m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè phài góa lâi kā lín kóng ê ta̍k-kù ōe.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h khak-si̍t chai, lín ōe tī beh khì kià-ku ê tōe in-ūi tú-tio̍h chiàn-loān, ki-hng, un-e̍k bia̍t-bông.”
Iâ-lī-bí tùi jîn-bîn thoân-ta̍t Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè chhe-phài i kóng it-chhè ê ōe, kóng soah,

Hô-sa-ngá ê kiáⁿ A-sat-lī-ngá, Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân, kap só͘-ū kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng chiū tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng, “Lí kóng pe̍h-chha̍t! Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè bô chhe-phài lí kóng ‘Lín bōe-ēng-tit khì Ai-ki̍p, kià-ku tī hia’,
sī Nî-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Pa-lio̍k sái-lōng lí hoán-tùi goán, beh chiong goán kau hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn ê kun-tūi, hō͘ in kā goán thâi-sí, á-sī kā goán lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn.”
Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân, só͘-ū ê kun-koaⁿ, í-ki̍p choân-thé bîn-chiòng, m̄ thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe, bô beh tòa tī Iû-tāi -tōe.
Ka-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-hap-lân kap só͘-ū ê kun-koaⁿ tian-tò chiong Iû-tāi só͘-ū chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng, chiū-sī tùi ta̍k-kok tò-tńg-lâi tòa tī Iû-tāi -tōe hiah-ê lâng,

pau-koat ta-po͘-lâng, cha-bó͘-lâng, gín-á, ông ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kap sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn kau-tài hō͘ Sa-hoan ê sun, A-hi-kam ê kiáⁿ Ki-tāi-lī koán-lí ê lâng, í-ki̍p sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí kap Nî-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Pa-lio̍k,
lóng chòe-hé chhōa-khì Ai-ki̍p kàu Tap-pí-le̍k. Iok-hap-lân kap i ê pō͘-hā bô thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú ê ōe.
Tī Tap-pí-le̍k, Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lī-bí kóng,
“Lí tio̍h tī Iû-tāi -lâng ê bīn-chêng the̍h kúi lia̍p tōa lia̍p chio̍h-thâu, tī Tap-pí-le̍k ê Hoat-ló ông-kiong mn̂g-kháu ê pho͘-chio̍h-lō͘, ēng he-thô͘ kā in tâi--khí-lâi;

jiân-āu kā in kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Góa beh phài lâng khì kā góa ê po̍k-jîn Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chhōa--lâi, chiong i ê ông-ūi an tī hiah-ê chio̍h-thâu téng-bīn; i beh tī hit téng-bīn tah i chhia-iāⁿ ê pò͘-pîⁿ.
I beh lâi kong-táⁿ Ai-ki̍p -tōe: Chù-tiāⁿ sí--ê, ōe sí; chù-tiāⁿ siū-lia̍h--ê, ōe siū-lia̍h; chù-tiāⁿ sí tī to-ē--ê, ōe hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.

Góa beh sio Ai-ki̍p ê sîn-biō. Pa-pí-lûn -ông beh kā Ai-ki̍p ta̍k-hāng chhiúⁿ-liáu-liáu, chhin-chhiūⁿ bo̍k-chiá teh kā gōa-phàu ê sat-bú pōaⁿ chheng-khì, koh kā hiah-ê sîn-siōng lóng the̍h-the̍h--khì, jiân-āu bô siū chó͘-tòng lī-khui Ai-ki̍p.
I it-tēng ōe kòng-chhùi Ai-ki̍p thài-iông sîn-biō ê thiāu-siōng, pàng-hé sio Ai-ki̍p ê sîn-biō.’”
Ē-bīn sī koan-hē tòa tī Ai-ki̍p ê Bi̍t-toa̍t, Tap-pí-le̍k, Bēng-húi-su, Pa-te̍k-lô tōe-khu só͘-ū ê Iû-tāi -lâng, Siōng Chú tùi sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí kóng ê ōe,

“Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Lín ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa kàng hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi ta̍k siâⁿ-tìn it-chhè ê chai-hō. Taⁿ chiah-ê siâⁿ-tìn í-keng lóng pha-hng, bô lâng tòa.
Che sī in-ūi in ū chòe siâ-ok ê sū, jiá góa siū-khì. In khì kā in kap lín, í-ki̍p lín ê chó͘-sian m̄-bat ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ, ho̍k-sāi in.
Góa chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn chhe-phài góa ê po̍k-jîn chin chōe sian-ti khì kā in kóng: Lín chhian-bān m̄-thang chòe góa iàm-ò͘ⁿ oàn-hūn ê sū.
M̄-kú in m̄ thiaⁿ, bô beh thiaⁿ-thàn, bô beh pàng-sak in siâ-ok ê hêng-ûi, iû-goân kā pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ.
Só͘-í, góa chiong chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh to̍h ê tōa siū-khì piàⁿ-lo̍h tī Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koe-lō͘; kin-á-ji̍t in chiah ōe hiah-ni̍h hong-hòe chhiⁿ-chhìn.’

“Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè koh kóng, ‘Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ beh chòe chiah-ni̍h siâ-ok ê sū, hāi lín ka-kī, hō͘ lín ê ta-po͘-lâng, cha-bó͘-lâng, gín-á, chia̍h-lin ê eⁿ-á lóng tùi Iû-tāi siū châu-bia̍t, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh?

Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ tô-lān lâi Ai-ki̍p, koh chō ngó͘-siōng, kā pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ, kek góa siū-khì, tì-kàu lín siū siau-bia̍t, tī sè-kài ta̍k-kok chiâⁿ-chòe lâng chiù-chó͘, bú-jio̍k ê tùi-siōng?

Lín kiám í-keng bōe-kì-tit lín ê chó͘-sian, Iû-tāi lia̍t-ông kap in ê hō͘-hui, í-ki̍p lín ka-kī kap lín ê bó͘, tī Iû-tāi -tōe, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koe-lō͘ só͘ chòe siâ-ok ê sū?
Kàu kin-á-ji̍t, lín iáu bô chhàm-hóe, iáu m̄ kiaⁿ, bô beh chun-hêng góa kā lín í-ki̍p lín ê chó͘-sian tēng ê lu̍t-hoat kap kui-lē.’
“Só͘-í, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, ‘Góa koat-tēng beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ lín, kā choân-pō͘ Iû-tāi -lâng lóng siau-bia̍t.

Chiah-ê koat-sim lâi Ai-ki̍p kià-ku chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê Iû-tāi -lâng, góa beh kā in siau-bia̍t, hō͘ in lóng sí tī Ai-ki̍p, m̄-sī hō͘ lâng thâi-sí chiū-sī iau-sí; bô-lūn chun-kùi á-sī pi-bî, lóng beh in-ūi chiàn-loān, ki-hng sí--khì, chiâⁿ-chòe lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, chiù-chó͘, thí-chhiò ê tùi-siōng.
Góa án-chóaⁿ ēng chiàn-loān, ki-hng, un-e̍k hêng-hoa̍t Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, mā beh án-ni hêng-hoa̍t tòa tī Ai-ki̍p ê Iû-tāi -lâng,

hō͘ chiah-ê lâi Ai-ki̍p kià-ku iáu oa̍h--teh ê Iû-tāi -lâng, bōe-tàng tô-thoat tò-khì Iû-tāi -tōe; sui-jiân in chin ài-beh tńg--khì, m̄-kú tû-khì chió-sò͘ ê lâng í-gōa, bô lâng ōe-tàng tô-thoat tńg--khì.’”

Kui tōa-tīn tòa tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe Pa-te̍k-lô ê Iû-tāi -lâng, chiū-sī hiah-ê chai-iáⁿ ka-kī ê bó͘ ū kā pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ ê ta-po͘-lâng, kap chāi-tiûⁿ ê hū-jîn-lâng, kā Iâ-lī-bí kóng,
“Goán bô beh thiaⁿ lí hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ tùi goán kóng ê ōe.

Goán it-tēng beh chiàu goán hē ê goān khì chòe, kā Thian-hō͘ sio-hiuⁿ, hiàn tiān-chiú-chè, kap goán, í-ki̍p goán ê chó͘-sian, kun-ông, koaⁿ-oân tī Iû-tāi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-tìn kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koe-lō͘ só͘ chòe--ê kâng-khoán, in-ūi hit-chūn goán ê niû-si̍t chhiong-chiok, pêng-an bô-sū.
M̄-kú goán chi̍t-ē bô kā Thian-hō͘ sio-hiuⁿ, hiàn tiān-chiú-chè, chiū ta̍k-hāng lóng bô, sīm-chì sí tī chiàn-loān kap ki-hng.”

Hiah-ê hū-jîn-lâng mā kóng, “Goán khak-si̍t ū kā Thian-hō͘ sio-hiuⁿ, hiàn tiān-chiú-chè. Goán chiàu Thian-hō͘ ê hêng-siōng chòe piáⁿ hiàn hō͘ i, kā i hiàn tiān-chiú-chè, goán ê tiōng-hu mā lóng chai.”
Iâ-lī-bí kā hiah-ê hôe-tap i ê ta-po͘-lâng kap cha-bó͘-lâng kóng,

“Lín kap lín ê chó͘-sian, lín ê kun-ông kap koaⁿ-oân, í-ki̍p kok-lāi ê jîn-bîn tī Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê koe-lō͘ sio-hiuⁿ, Siōng Chú kiám ōe bōe-kì--tit, lóng bô kì tī sim-lāi?

Lín siâ-ok ê hêng-ûi kap só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, Siōng Chú í-keng bô beh koh thun-lún, só͘-í I hō͘ lín ê thó͘-tōe hong-hòe, bô lâng tòa, chiâⁿ-chòe lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, chiù-chó͘ ê tùi-siōng, kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu-sī án-ni.

Lín kā pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ, tek-chōe Siōng Chú, bô beh thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe, bô chun-hêng I ê lu̍t-hoat, kui-lē, kap kà-sī, só͘-í kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu tú-tio̍h chiah-ê chai-hō.”
Iâ-lī-bí koh kā choân-pō͘ ê lâng, te̍k-pia̍t sī cha-bó͘-lâng kóng, “Só͘-ū lâi tī Ai-ki̍p ê Iû-tāi -lâng, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Lín kap lín ê bó͘ kóng ‘Goán it-tēng beh kā Thian-hō͘ siā-goān, kā i sio-hiuⁿ, hiàn tiān-chiú-chè’, chiū án-ni khì chòe. Taⁿ, chòe lín chiàu lín hē ê goān khì siā-goān.

Lín só͘-ū tòa tī Ai-ki̍p ê Iû-tāi -lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe. Góa Siōng Chú kí góa úi-tāi ê miâ li̍p-sè: Tī Ai-ki̍p choân-tōe, bōe koh ū jīm-hô chi̍t ê Iû-tāi -lâng chheng-ho͘ góa ê miâ-hō kóng ‘Góa kí éng-oa̍h Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa’.

Lín tio̍h chai, góa ōe liû-sim khòaⁿ in, m̄-sī beh sù hok-khì, sī beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ in, tī Ai-ki̍p ê Iû-tāi -lâng it-tēng ōe sí tī chiàn-loān kap ki-hng, kàu choân-pō͘ siau-bia̍t.

Sui-jiân ū lâng ōe-tàng thoat-lī chiàn-loān, tùi Ai-ki̍p tò-khì Iû-tāi, m̄-kú sī ke̍k chió-sò͘. Hiah-ê lâi Ai-ki̍p kià-ku chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê Iû-tāi -lâng, āu-lâi ōe chai sī siáⁿ-lâng ê ōe ōe si̍t-hiān, sī góa ê, á-sī in ê.
Góa beh tī chia kā lín hêng-hoa̍t. Che sī góa hō͘ lín ê tiāu-thâu, hō͘ lín chai góa só͘ kóng beh kā lín kàng chai-hō ê ōe it-tēng ōe si̍t-hiān. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Siōng Chú koh án-ni kóng: Góa beh chiong Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló Ha̍p-hut-la kau hō͘ siūⁿ-beh thâi i ê tùi-te̍k, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ū chiong Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka kau hō͘ beh thâi i ê tùi-te̍k, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat ê chhiú kâng-khoán.”

Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kèng choh Iû-tāi -ông tē-sì nî, Nî-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Pa-lio̍k chiong sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí só͘ thoân ê sìn-sit kì tī chheh--ni̍h. Hit-sî Iâ-lī-bí kā Pa-lio̍k kóng,
“ Pa-lio̍k ah, Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng,
‘Lí ū teh kóng: Góa ū-kàu chhám; Siōng Chú tī góa thòng-khó͘ ê sî koh ke-thiⁿ góa ê iu-chhiû. Góa thó͘-khùi thó͘ kah chin siān, mā bô thang ū chi̍t-si-á an-hioh.’”

Siōng-tè hoan-hù Iâ-lī-bí tio̍h kā Pa-lio̍k kóng, “Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh thiah-húi góa só͘ tiông-kiàn--ê, kā góa só͘ chai-chèng--ê pu̍ih--khí-lâi; tī choân-tōe góa lóng beh án-ni chòe.

Lí teh ūi ka-kī tô͘-bô͘ tōa-sū sī--bô? M̄-thang tô͘-bô͘. Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ só͘-ū ê jîn-lūi. M̄-kú lí bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, góa lóng ōe pó-choân lí ê sìⁿ-miā.’ Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Koan-hē lia̍t-kok, Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí.

Chiam-tùi Ai-ki̍p: Koan-hē Ai-ki̍p -ông Nî-ko ê kun-tūi, in tī Iok-se-a ê kiáⁿ Iok-ngá-kèng choh Iû-tāi -ông tē-sì nî, tī Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hô-piⁿ ê Ka-ki-bí-si hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat phah-pāi.
“Tio̍h chún-pī tōa-sòe tún-pâi, chhut-tīn kau-chiàn!
Tio̍h thò bé-oaⁿ, khiâ-bé, pâi-tūi, tì thâu-khoe, bôa chhiuⁿ, chhēng chiàn-kah!”
M̄-kú, Siōng Chú kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ thiat-thè? In ê ióng-sū thâi-su, piàⁿ sìⁿ-miā tô-cháu, m̄-káⁿ oa̍t-thâu; sì-chiu-ûi chhiong-móa khióng-pò͘!
Siōng gâu-cháu--ê mā cháu bōe lī, liân ióng-sū to bōe-tàng tô-thoat; tī pak-hng, Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hô-piⁿ, in lóng poa̍h-tó peh bōe khí--lâi.
Chit-ê chhin-chhiūⁿ Nî-lô-hô tiòng-móa, chhin-chhiūⁿ kang-hô giâ-éng chhèng-koân--ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?

Sī Ai-ki̍p! I chhin-chhiūⁿ Nî-lô-hô tiòng-móa, chhin-chhiūⁿ kang-hô giâ-éng chhèng-koân; i kóng, ‘Góa beh tiòng-móa, beh im-móa choân-tōe; góa beh húi-hoāi siâⁿ-tìn, siau-bia̍t hia ê chū-bîn.’
Chiàn-bé, chhiong ah! Chiàn-chhia, tu̍t-kek! Giâ tún-pâi ê Kó͘-si̍t kap Hut ê ióng-sū, khui-keng ê Lū-tí-a kun-peng, chhiong--chhut-khì!”

Chit-ji̍t sī Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe pò-siû ê ji̍t, I beh hêng-hoa̍t te̍k-jîn. To-kiàm ōe thun-chia̍h, chia̍h kah pá, ōe lim huih, lim kah boán-chiok; tī pak-hng Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hô-piⁿ, ū chè-mi̍h beh hiàn hō͘ Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe.
Ai-ki̍p -lâng ah, tio̍h khì Ki-lia̍t chhē jú-hiuⁿ! Lín chia̍h chiah chōe io̍h-á lóng bô-hāu, bōe-tàng kā lín i-hó.
Lia̍t-kok ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí siū ê lêng-jio̍k; choân-tōe chhiong-móa lí ai-khàu ê siaⁿ; ióng-sū kap ióng-sū sio-lòng, nn̄g ê chòe-chi̍t-ē poa̍h-tó.
Ē-bīn sī koan-hē Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat kong-táⁿ Ai-ki̍p, Siōng Chú tùi sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí só͘ kóng ê ōe.

Tio̍h tī Ai-ki̍p pò-iông, tī Bi̍t-toa̍t soan-pò͘, tī Bēng-húi-su kap Tap-pí-le̍k soan-pò͘, kóng, “Tio̍h pâi-tīn, chún-pī chok-chiàn! Chiàn-cheng ōe thun-bia̍t lín it-chhè só͘ ū--ê.”
Lín ê ióng-sū sī-án-chóaⁿ poa̍h-tó? In-ūi Siōng Chú kā in chhia-tó, hō͘ in khiā bōe tiâu.
In chiàn-pāi sì-sòaⁿ, tāi-ke saⁿ thún-ta̍h, hō͘-siōng kóng, “Khí--lâi! Lán tò-lâi-khì lán ê pún-cho̍k, tńg-lâi-khì lán ê kò͘-hiong, siám-pī khi-ap-chiá ê to-kiàm.”
In tī hia hoah kóng, “ Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló kan-ta ōe-hiáu kóng tōa-siaⁿ-ōe; i í-keng sit-khì i ê ki-hōe.”

Tōa-kun-ông, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Góa kí góa ê sìⁿ-miā li̍p-sè, Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat lâi ê sî, i ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiau-oa̍t chèng-soaⁿ ê Tha-po̍k-soaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ tī hái-piⁿ ê Ka-bi̍t-soaⁿ.
Ai-ki̍p -lâng ah, tio̍h kā siū-lia̍h beh ēng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ khoán hó-sè, in-ūi Bēng-húi-su ōe siū sio-húi, pha-hng, bô lâng khiā-khí.
“ Ai-ki̍p sī pûi koh súi ê gû-bú, m̄-kú tùi pak-hng lâi ê gû-bông í-keng kàu lah! In í-keng lâi lah!

Ai-ki̍p chhiàⁿ--lâi ê peng, chhin-chhiūⁿ tiâu-lāi pûi ê gû-á, in lóng thiat-thè tô-cháu, m̄-káⁿ kè-sio̍k kau-chiàn; in-ūi in hoān-lān ê ji̍t lâi lah, siū hêng-hoa̍t ê sî í-keng kàu lah.
“ Ai-ki̍p tô-cháu, chhin-chhiūⁿ chôa teh sô hoat-chhut siaⁿ; te̍k-jîn beh kui-tīn chòe-hé lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhò-chhiū-á ê lâng gia̍h pó͘-thâu kā i chhò-tiāu.
Siōng Chú kóng: I ê chhiū-nâ sui-jiân chin ām, te̍k-jîn mā ōe kā chhò-liáu-liáu; in-ūi te̍k-jîn pí chháu-meh khah chōe, bōe-sǹg--tit.
Ai-ki̍p ê jîn-bîn beh siū bú-jio̍k kiàn-siàu, in ōe hō͘ pak-hng ê lâng cheng-ho̍k.”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, góa beh hêng-hoa̍t Tí-pí-su ê sîn-bêng A-bûn, hêng-hoa̍t Ai-ki̍p, í-ki̍p i ê sîn-bêng kap kun-ông; góa mā beh hêng-hoa̍t Hoat-ló kap só͘-ū óa-khò i ê lâng.

Góa beh chiong in kau tī ài-beh thâi in ê lâng ê chhiú, chiū-sī Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat kap i ê jîn-sîn ê chhiú. M̄-kú, Ai-ki̍p chiong-lâi ōe koh ū lâng khiā-khí, kap chá-chêng kâng-khoán.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

“Góa ê po̍k-jîn Ngá-kok, m̄-bián kiaⁿ! Í-sek-lia̍t, m̄-bián sit-chì! Góa beh tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi kái-kiù lí, tùi lí siū-lia̍h ê tōe kái-kiù lí ê hō͘-tāi; Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi ōe tò-lâi ka-kī ê hiong-thó͘ an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p, bô lâng ōe koh hō͘ in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.

Góa ê po̍k-jîn Ngá-kok m̄-bián kiaⁿ, in-ūi góa kap lí tông-chāi. Góa kóaⁿ lí khì hiah-ê kok-ka, góa beh kā in oân-choân húi-bia̍t. Lí leh, góa bōe kā lí oân-choân siau-bia̍t, m̄-kú bōe-tàng bô hêng-hoa̍t lí; góa beh chiàu kong-gī koán-kàu lí.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Ai-ki̍p -ông kong-kek Ka-sat í-chêng, Siōng Chú chiam-tùi Hui-lī-sū -lâng, tùi sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí kóng-ōe.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, pak-hng ê hô-chúi tiòng-koân, chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t tiâu hoàn-lām ê tōa-hô, im-kè choân-tōe kap kî-tiong só͘-ū--ê, khàm-kè siâⁿ kap siâⁿ-lāi ê chū-bîn; lâng beh hoah-hiu, kéng-lāi ê chū-bîn lóng tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu.

Chòe lāu-pē--ê chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiàn-bé bé-tôe ê siaⁿ, chiàn-chhia hō͘ tōe tín-tāng ê siaⁿ, chhia-lián kō--kè ê siaⁿ, siang-chhiú chiū sng-nńg, bô hoat-tō͘ oa̍t-tńg-sin kiù ka-kī ê gín-á.

Sî-ji̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, Siōng Chú ōe húi-bia̍t só͘-ū ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng, siau-bia̍t chhun--lo̍h-lâi beh pang-chān Thài-ní kap Se-tùn ê lâng; Siōng Chú beh húi-bia̍t Hui-lī-sū -lâng, siau-bia̍t Ka-hui-thok hái-tó só͘ chhun ê chū-bîn.
Ka-sat thì kng-thâu pi-siong, A-si̍t-ki-lûn mā o͘-iú--khì ah. Tī pêng-goân só͘ chhun ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng ah, lín koah ka-kī ê seng-khu ai-siong, beh kàu tī-sî?
Lín kiò kóng, ‘Siōng Chú ê to-kiàm ah, lí kàu tī-sî chiah ōe an-chēng? Tio̍h kiu ji̍p-khì to-siù, m̄-thang koh tín-tāng.’
I ná ū khó-lêng an-chēng leh? Siōng Chú bēng-lēng i khì kong-kek A-si̍t-ki-lûn, kong-kek tòa tī hái-piⁿ ê chū-bîn; góa Siōng Chú phài i khì, chit-kiāⁿ sū í-keng tiāⁿ-tio̍h.”

Koan-hē Mô͘-ap, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “ Nî-pho chhám ah, i ōe hong-hòe; Ki-lia̍t-têng siū bú-jio̍k, hō͘ lâng chiàm-léng, i ê pó-lúi siū húi-hoāi, chū-bîn siū lêng-jio̍k.

Mô͘-ap bōe koh ū chhàn-lān ê êng-kng; ū lâng tī Hi-si̍t-pún siat-kè beh hāi Mô͘-ap, kóng, ‘Lâi, lán lâi kā siau-bia̍t, hō͘ i bōe-tàng chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t kok.’ Má-tek-bián -siâⁿ ah, tio̍h tiām-tiām, m̄-thang chhut-siaⁿ; ū kun-tūi beh lâi kong-kek lí.
Tùi Hô-lô-liām thoân-chhut ai-khàu ê siaⁿ, ‘Hong-hòe lah, lóng-chóng húi-bia̍t lah!’
“ Mô͘-ap siū húi-bia̍t, tī hia thoân-chhut gín-á teh háu ê siaⁿ.
Lâng peh Ló͘-hi ê soaⁿ-phiâⁿ, ná peh ná khàu; in lo̍h Hô-lô-liām ê soaⁿ-phiâⁿ, thiaⁿ-tio̍h húi-bia̍t ai-khàu ê siaⁿ,
‘Tio̍h tô-cháu, sûi-lâng kò͘ sìⁿ-miā, chhin-chhiūⁿ khòng-iá ê iá-lû.’

“ Mô͘-ap ah, lí khò ka-kī ê kun-le̍k kap châi-hù, m̄-kú kâng-khoán ōe siū cheng-ho̍k. Lí ê sîn-bêng Ki-boat kap i ê chè-si, í-ki̍p koaⁿ-oân, lóng ōe siū liû-hòng, chòe-chi̍t-ē siū chhian-sóa.
Lín ta̍k-ê siâⁿ lóng ōe siū húi-bia̍t, bô chi̍t ê siâⁿ ōe-tàng pī-bián; soaⁿ-kok siū húi-hoāi, pêng-goân siū thún-ta̍h. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Tio̍h kā Mô͘-ap tàu nn̄g ki si̍t, hō͘ i thang pe-cháu; i ê siâⁿ-tìn ōe pha-hng, bô lâng khiā-khí.”
Pîn-tōaⁿ m̄ chòe Siōng Chú ê kang--ê, ōe siū chiù-chó͘; m̄ gia̍h ka-kī ê to khì thâi te̍k-jîn--ê, ōe siū chiù-chó͘.

Mô͘-ap tùi khai-kok í-lâi chiū chin thài-pêng, m̄-bat siū hòng-tio̍k; i chhin-chhiūⁿ hong-ba̍t tī chiú-àng lāi ê chiú, m̄-bat hō͘ lâng tò-lâi tò-khì, só͘-í chu-bī goân-chāi, khì-bī bô piàn.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, sî-ji̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, góa beh phài lâng kā Mô͘-ap tò hìⁿ-sak, chhin-chhiūⁿ kā chiú tò-tiāu kâng-khoán. In ōe kā chiú tò kah khang-khang-khang, koh kā chiú-àng siak-phòa.
Mô͘-ap ōe in-ūi i ê sîn-bêng Ki-boat kiàn-siàu, chhin-chhiūⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ūi-tio̍h in só͘ óa-khò Pek-te̍k-lī ê sîn-bêng kiàn-siàu kâng-khoán.
Mô͘-ap ah, lí ná ōe-tàng chū-chheng sī eng-hiông, sī gâu sio-chiàn ê ióng-sū?

Mô͘-ap ōe siū húi-hoāi, tùi-te̍k chiàm-léng i ê siâⁿ-tìn; te̍k-soán ê chòng-teng lóng siū thâi-sí. Mô͘-ap ê chiong-kio̍k pek-kūn lah, i ê chai-lān ōe kín-kín kàu.” Tōa-kun-ông, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.
“ Mô͘-ap chiu-ûi ê kok-ka, jīn-bat i ê bîn-cho̍k ah, lín lóng tio̍h ūi Mô͘-ap pi-siong, kóng, ‘I ê tōa koân-sè pang--khì, i ê êng-kng bô--khì lah!’
Tí-pún ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h tùi lí êng-kng ê chō-ūi lo̍h--lâi, chē tī ta-sò ê thô͘-kha; in-ūi húi-bia̍t Mô͘-ap --ê í-keng kàu, i beh thiah-húi lí ê pó-lúi.
A-lô-ní ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h khiā tī lō͘-piⁿ khòaⁿ, mn̄g hiah-ê tô-lān ê lâm-lú, kóng, ‘Tàu-tóe hoat-seng sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?’
In ōe ìn kóng, ‘ Mô͘-ap lûn-hām lah!’ Lín tio̍h ūi i ai-siong thî-khàu; tio̍h tī A-lūn-hô soan-pò͘, kóng, ‘ Mô͘-ap bia̍t-bông lah!’

“Sím-phòaⁿ í-keng lîm-kàu pêng-goân ta̍k só͘-chāi, chiū-sī Mô͘-ap bô-lūn hn̄g á-sī kūn só͘-ū ê siâⁿ-tìn, kàu tī Hô-lûn, Ngá-cha̍p, Bí-hoat-ap, Tí-pún, Nî-pho, Pek Te-pí-la-thài-im, Ki-lia̍t-têng, Pek Ka-boa̍t, Pek Bí-un, Ka-lio̍k, Pho-su-la.
Mô͘-ap ê koân-sè bô--khì, kun-le̍k choân-sit lah!” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Lín tio̍h kā Mô͘-ap koàn hō͘ chùi; in-ūi i chū-ko, pōe-ge̍k góa; i ōe tī ka-kī thò͘--chhut-lâi ê lah-sap-mi̍h tiong-kan kō-lâi-kō-khì, hō͘ lâng thí-chhiò.
Mô͘-ap ah, lí kiám m̄-sī bat thí-chhiò Í-sek-lia̍t? Lí ta̍k-piàn kóng-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t, kiám m̄-sī iô-thâu, kā i tòng-chòe hō͘ lâng lia̍h--tio̍h ê chha̍t-á?
Mô͘-ap -lâng ah, tio̍h tô-cháu lī-khui siâⁿ-tìn, khì tòa tī soaⁿ-giâm, chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu tī ài-kháu choh-siū.
Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn kóng, ‘Thiaⁿ-kóng Mô͘-ap -lâng hui-siông kiau-ngō͘, chū-ko chū-tāi, kiau-ngō͘ kàu-ke̍k; ka-kī lia̍h-chòe liáu-put-khí.’
Góa chai in ê chū-tāi sī khang-hu, só͘ khoa-kháu--ê lóng sī phòng-hong.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Só͘-í, góa ūi-tio̍h Mô͘-ap thî-khàu, ūi-tio̍h Mô͘-ap choân-kok thî-khàu; lâng mā beh ūi-tio̍h Kiat-ní Hap-lia̍t-siat ê lâng ai-siong.

Se-pí-má, góa ūi-tio̍h lí ai-khàu, pí ūi Ngá-siā khàu koh-khah tōa-siaⁿ. Lí chhin-chhiūⁿ phû-tô-chhiū, ki chhun-kè tōa-hái, soan kàu Ngá-siā ê hái. M̄-kú húi-bia̍t-chiá lâi lah, beh chiong lí teh-beh siu-sêng ê ké-chí kap phû-tô lóng húi-tiāu.

Siōng Chú kóng, “ Mô͘-ap pûi ê chhân-hn̂g siau-sit, bô koh ū hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k ê siaⁿ! Góa hō͘ chiú-khut bô koh chhut chiú, bô lâng tī hia ta̍h chiú chhut hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ; sui-jiân ū hoah ê siaⁿ, m̄-kú m̄-sī hoaⁿ-hí ê siaⁿ.”

Hi-si̍t-pún -lâng ai-khàu ê siaⁿ thoân kàu Í-lī-a-lī, thàng kàu Ngá-cha̍p; koh tùi Só-ní it-ti̍t thoân kàu Hô-lô-liām, ti̍t-kàu I-ki-la Si-lī-si-a, in-ūi liân Lêng-lîm ê khoe-chúi to ta-ta--khì.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Hiah-ê tī Mô͘-ap ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ hiàn-chè, ǹg in ê sîn-bêng sio-hiuⁿ ê lâng, góa lóng beh kā in siau-bia̍t.”

Só͘-í, góa ê sim ūi-tio̍h Mô͘-ap pi-siong, góa ê sim-tn̂g ūi-tio̍h Kiat-ní Hap-lia̍t-siat ai-siong, chhin-chhiūⁿ phín-á ai-oàn ê siaⁿ. In só͘ chek-chū ê châi-bu̍t lóng sit--khì lah.
In ta̍k-ê lâng thì kng-thâu, chián chhùi-chhiu, koah-siong chhiú-kut, io hâ môa-pò͘.
Siōng Chú kóng, “ Mô͘-ap ta̍k-keng chhù ê chhù-téng kap kóng-tiûⁿ lóng ū thî-khàu ê siaⁿ; in-ūi góa húi-hoāi Mô͘-ap, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng kòng-chhùi bô kah-ì ê khì-khū.
