Lín tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu! Mô͘-ap oân-choân húi-bia̍t lah! In kiàn-siàu bô bīn thang kìⁿ-lâng, chiâⁿ-chòe sì-chiu-ûi ê kok-ka thí-chhiò hō͘ lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ ê tùi-siōng.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, ū chi̍t ê kok-ka chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu thí-khui i ê si̍t, chhiong lo̍h-lâi kong-kek Mô͘-ap.
Mô͘-ap ê siâⁿ-tìn kap pó-lúi lóng hō͘ i chiàm--khì. Hit-sî, Mô͘-ap chiàn-sū ê sim ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhui-chūn ê hū-jîn-lâng hiah-ni̍h thàng-thiàⁿ.
Mô͘-ap siū húi-bia̍t, bô koh chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê kok-ka; in-ūi in chū-ko chū-tāi, pōe-poān góa Siōng Chú.
Mô͘-ap ê chū-bîn ah, khióng-pò͘, hām-khiⁿ, oa̍h-tauh teh tng-tán lín.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

“Siám-pī khióng-pò͘ ê lâng ōe poa̍h-lo̍h hām-khiⁿ; tùi hām-khiⁿ tô-thoat ê lâng ōe hō͘ oa̍h-tauh tauh--tio̍h, in-ūi hêng-hoa̍t Mô͘-ap ê nî í-keng tiāⁿ-tio̍h.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

“Hiah-ê tô-lān khì Hi-si̍t-pún chhē-kiû pó-hō͘--ê, in ê khùi-la̍t í-keng ēng-chīn; m̄-kú, ū hé tùi Hi-si̍t-pún hoat, ū hé-iām tùi Se-hông ê siâⁿ chhut, sio-chīn Mô͘-ap -lâng ê thâu-hia̍h, kap ài sio-thâi ê lâng ê thâu-khak.
Mô͘-ap ah, lí ū chai-hō lah! Pài Ki-boat sîn-bêng ê lâng ah, lín bia̍t-bông lah! Lín ê hāu-siⁿ hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì, lín ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ mā chòe-hé siū-lia̍h.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú mā ū kóng: Chiong-lâi góa ōe hō͘ Mô͘-ap siū-lia̍h ê lâng tò-tńg--lâi.” Iú-koan Mô͘-ap siū sím-phòaⁿ ê ōe, kàu chia ûi-chí.

Koan-hē A-bûn -lâng, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t lóng bô lâng sī--bô? Lín lóng bô lâng thang kè-sêng sán-gia̍p sī--bô? Sī-án-chóaⁿ hō͘ pài Bí-le̍k-kong ê lâng chhim-chiàm Ka-tek chi-cho̍k ê thó͘-tōe, tòa tī hiah-ê siâⁿ?

“Siōng Chú kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, sî-ji̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, A-bûn -lâng ê siú-to͘ La-pa ōe thoân-chhut kau-chiàn ê siaⁿ, La-pa ōe pìⁿ-chòe hong-hòe ê thô͘-tui; in ê siâⁿ-tìn ōe hō͘ hé sio. Í-chêng in chhim-chiàm Í-sek-lia̍t, hiān-chāi Í-sek-lia̍t ōe tùi in siu-hôe kok-thó͘.

Hi-si̍t-pún -lâng, tio̍h ai-khàu, in-ūi Ai -siâⁿ pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘. La-pa ê chū-bîn, tio̍h âu-kiò, the̍h môa-pò͘ hâ-io; tio̍h thî-khàu, tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ lāi sì-kòe chông; in-ūi Bí-le̍k-kong kap i ê chè-si, í-ki̍p koaⁿ-oân ōe chòe-chi̍t-ē hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì.

Pōe-poān ê chú-bîn ah, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ teh khoa-kháu ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t? Lín ê khùi-la̍t í-keng chiām-chiām soe-thè, ná iáu-teh óa-khò ka-kī ê châi-pó, siūⁿ-kóng bô lâng ōe lâi chhim-hoān?

Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, lín ōe hō͘ tùi chiu-ûi kok-ka lâi ê khióng-pò͘ pau-ûi; lín beh tô-cháu, sûi-lâng kò͘ sìⁿ-miā, bô lâng ōe-tàng kā chiah-ê sì-sòaⁿ ê lān-bîn chū-chi̍p--khí-lâi.
“M̄-kú, āu-lâi góa ōe hō͘ siū-lia̍h ê A-bûn -lâng tò-tńg--lâi.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Koan-hē Í-tong, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Tī Thê-bān bōe-tàng koh chhē-tio̍h tì-hūi sī--bô? Bêng-lí ê lâng bô hoat-tō͘ thang thê-kiong hó ê kiàn-gī sī--bô? In ê tì-hūi lóng bô--khì sī--bô?
Tí-tān ê chū-bîn ah, kóaⁿ-kín thiat-thè tô-cháu, khì bih--khí-lâi; góa hêng-hoa̍t Í-sò ê sî kàu lah, góa beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ i.
Bán-phû-tô--ê nā khì lí hia, kiám bōe lâu tām-po̍h? Chha̍t nā mî--sî lâi thau, kiám m̄-sī the̍h in só͘ ài ê mi̍h nā-tiāⁿ?

M̄-kú góa beh kā Í-sò pak kah kng-liu-liu; i ún-ba̍t ê só͘-chāi ōe lō͘-hiān, bô só͘-chāi thang bih; i ê hō͘-tāi, chhin-cho̍k, chhù-piⁿ lóng ōe siū siau-bia̍t, bô chhun pòaⁿ-ê.
Tio̍h chiong lín ê ko͘-jî pàng hō͘ góa, góa ōe pó-choân in ê sìⁿ-miā; lín ê kóaⁿ-hū mā tio̍h óa-khò góa.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, liân hiah-ê bô eng-kai siū hêng-hoa̍t--ê mā tio̍h lim hêng-hoa̍t ê poe, lí kiám ōe-tàng bián siū hêng-hoa̍t? Bô khó-lêng! Lí it-tēng tio̍h lim.

Góa kí ka-kī li̍p-sè, Pho-su-la ōe pìⁿ-chòe hong-hòe ê só͘-chāi, siū lêng-jio̍k, siū chiù-chó͘, hō͘ lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ; hù-kūn ê siâⁿ-tìn mā ōe éng-oán pha-hng.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Góa tùi Siōng Chú hia thiaⁿ-tio̍h siau-sit, I chhe sù-chiá khì lia̍t-kok, kóng, “Lín tio̍h chū-chi̍p lâi kong-kek Í-tong, kap i kau-chiàn.”
Siōng Chú tùi Í-tong kóng, “Góa beh hō͘ lí tī lia̍t-kok tiong pìⁿ-chòe jio̍k-siáu, hō͘ sè-kan-lâng khòaⁿ-khin.

Lín tòa tī chio̍h-tōng lāi, tī soaⁿ-téng teh kò͘-siú, sui-jiân chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu choh-siū tī koân ê só͘-chāi, góa mā beh tùi hia kā lí thoa--lo̍h-lâi; lí m̄-thang hō͘ ka-kī ê siaⁿ-sè, sim-lāi ê kiau-ngō͘ phiàn--khì.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú kóng, “ Í-tong ōe hō͘ lâng gông-ngia̍h, tùi hia keng-kè ê lâng lóng ōe tio̍h-kiaⁿ, koh in-ūi i tú--tio̍h ê chai-hō kā i thí-chhiò. Chhin-chhiūⁿ Só͘-to-má, Gô-mô͘-la kap hù-kūn ê siâⁿ-tìn tó-hoāi, Í-tong mā ōe án-ni siū húi-bia̍t, bōe koh ū lâng tòa, mā bōe koh ū lâng tī hia kià-ku.

Góa beh chhin-chhiūⁿ sai tùi Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ ê chhiū-nâ chhut--lâi, khì kong-kek chhiⁿ-chhùi chháu-po͘ ê iûⁿ-kûn, chin kín kā in kóaⁿ-cháu, lī-khui in ê kok-thó͘. Góa kéng-soán sím-mi̍h-lâng, chiū phài i thóng-tī chit-ê kok-ka. Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kap góa pí? Siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ thoân góa chhut-têng? Tó chit-ê thóng-tī-chiá káⁿ tùi-khòng góa?

Lín tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú kong-kek Í-tong kap Thê-bān chū-bîn ê kè-ōe; in liân siōng jio̍k-siáu--ê to ōe hō͘ lâng thoa--khì. Góa it-tēng ōe hō͘ in khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi hong-hòe.
Í-tong tó-hoāi ê siaⁿ ōe hō͘ tōe tōa tín-tāng; lâng hoah-hiu ê siaⁿ ōe thàng kàu Âng-hái.

I ê tùi-te̍k ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu thí-si̍t chhiong lo̍h-lâi kong-kek Pho-su-la; hit-sî, Í-tong chiàn-sū ê sim ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhui-chūn ê hū-jîn-lâng hiah-ni̍h thàng-thiàⁿ.”

Koan-hē Tāi-má-sū-kek, Siōng Chú kóng, “ Hap-má kap A-ní-poa̍t ê lâng hui-siông put-an; in thiaⁿ-tio̍h pháiⁿ siau-sit chiū sit-táⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-éng lōng-lōng-kún, bōe pêng-chēng.
Tāi-má-sū-kek ê lâng sit-khì ióng-khì, in oa̍t-tńg-sin beh tô-cháu, soah hō͘ thòng-khó͘ iu-chhiû khîⁿ-tiâu-tiâu, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhui-chūn ê hū-jîn-lâng kâng-khoán.
Chit-ê hō͘ lâng o-ló ê siâⁿ, góa só͘ hoaⁿ-hí ê siâⁿ, sī-án-chóaⁿ ōe siū pàng-sak, oân-choân pha-hng?

In ê siàu-liân-lâng ōe tī kóng-tiûⁿ hō͘ lâng thâi-sí; kâng hit-ji̍t, in ê chiàn-sū ōe hō͘ lâng châu-bia̍t. Góa beh pàng-hé sio Tāi-má-sū-kek ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, sio-húi Piān Hap-ta̍t ê kiong-tiān.” Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.

Koan-hē hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat phah-pāi ê Ki-ta̍t kap Hā-só hiah-ê kok-ka, Siōng Chú án-ni kā Pa-pí-lûn -lâng kóng, “Khí--lâi, chiūⁿ-khì kong-kek Ki-ta̍t, châu-bia̍t hiah-ê tang-hng ê lâng.
Khì chhiúⁿ in ê pò͘-pîⁿ kap iûⁿ-kûn, í-ki̍p in ê tiùⁿ-bō͘ kap só͘-ū ê kang-khū; lo̍k-tô mā lóng kā chhiúⁿ--khì; tio̍h kā in hoah kóng, ‘Lín hō͘ khióng-pò͘ pau-ûi lah!’

“Siōng Chú kóng: Hā-só ê chū-bîn, tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín tô-cháu, cháu-khì hn̄g koh chhim ê só͘-chāi bih--khí-lâi; in-ūi Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat siat-kè beh hāi lín, koat-tēng beh kong-kek lín.
“Siōng Chú koh kóng: Khí--lâi! Khì kong-kek hiah-ê bô-khòa-bô-lū an-jiân khiā-khí ê lâng, in bô siâⁿ-mn̂g, bô mn̂g-chhòaⁿ, sī ka-kī tan-to̍k khiā-khí ê chū-bîn.

In ê lo̍k-tô ōe hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì; in chōe-chōe cheng-siⁿ ōe hō͘ lâng kiap--khì; góa beh kā só͘-ū thì pìn-piⁿ ê lâng kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ khì ta̍k só͘-chāi; góa beh tùi sì-chiu-ûi kàng chai-hō hō͘ in. Hā-só ōe chiâⁿ-chòe chhâi-lông tòa ê só͘-chāi, éng-oán hong-hòe, bô lâng khiā-khí, mā bô lâng tī hia kià-ku.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka tú chē-ūi ê sî, koan-hē Í-lân, Siōng Chú ê ōe lîm-kàu sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh at-chi̍h Í-lân -lâng ê keng, che sī in sio-chiàn ê sî siōng chú-iàu ê bú-le̍k.
Góa beh hō͘ hong tùi thiⁿ ê sì-bīn chhe--lâi, kā Í-lân -lâng kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ khì ta̍k só͘-chāi; choân-tōe ta̍k-kok lóng ū Í-lân ê lān-bîn.

Siōng Chú koh kóng: Góa beh hō͘ Í-lân -lâng tī siàu-siūⁿ in ê sìⁿ-miā ê tùi-te̍k bīn-chêng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; góa beh tùi in hoat siū-khì, kàng chai-hō hō͘ in, koh beh ēng chiàn-cheng kā in thiat-tóe siau-bia̍t.
Siōng Chú kóng: Góa beh siau-bia̍t Í-lân ê kun-ông kap koaⁿ-oân, tī hia siat-li̍p góa ê pó-chō.
M̄-kú chiong-lâi ū chi̍t ji̍t, góa beh hō͘ Í-lân siū-lia̍h ê lâng tò-tńg--lâi.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Ē-bīn sī koan-hē Pa-pí-lûn kap Pa-pí-lûn -lâng ê tōe, Siōng Chú thong-kè sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí só͘ kóng ê ōe.

“Tio̍h tī lia̍t-pang thoân-pò, ǹg in soan-kò; tio̍h chhāi tōa-kî, ǹg lia̍t-pang soan-kò. M̄-thang ún-môa, tio̍h kóng, Pa-pí-lûn teh-beh lûn-hām lah! I ê sîn-bêng Pí-le̍k ōe chin kiàn-siàu, Má-tō͘-khek tio̍h-chhiⁿ-kiaⁿ; i ê sîn-siōng lóng chin kiàn-siàu, i ê ngó͘-siōng lóng tio̍h-chhiⁿ-kiaⁿ.”
In-ūi tùi pak-hng ū chi̍t kok beh lâi kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn, beh hō͘ i ê tōe pha-hng, bô lâng koh tī hia khiā-khí; liân cheng-siⁿ mā cháu-liáu-liáu.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Sî nā kàu, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng beh chòe-hé, ná kiâⁿ ná háu, lâi chhē Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè.
In lóng bīn ǹg Sek-an, teh mn̄g beh khì hia ê lō͘. In beh lâi kap Siōng Chú li̍p éng-oán ê iok, kap I kiat-liân.
“Góa ê chú-bîn pìⁿ-chòe sit-bê ê iûⁿ; in ê bo̍k-chiá chhōa in kiâⁿ bê-lō͘, hō͘ in oat ji̍p-khì soaⁿ-lāi. In tùi tōa-soaⁿ kiâⁿ kàu sió-soaⁿ, chhē bô ka-kī ê iûⁿ-tiâu.

Tú-tio̍h in--ê beh kā in thun-chia̍h; in ê tùi-te̍k kóng, ‘Goán án-ni chòe bô chōe. Che sī in-ūi in tek-chōe Siōng Chú, chiū-sī in chin-chiàⁿ thang an-hioh ê só͘-chāi, mā-sī in lia̍t-chó͘ só͘ ǹg-bāng ê Siōng Chú.’
“Tio̍h lī-khui Pa-pí-lûn, tô-cháu thoat-chhut Pa-pí-lûn -lâng ê tōe, chhin-chhiūⁿ soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng cháu tī iûⁿ-kûn ê thâu-chêng lī-khui.

Góa beh hoat-tōng pak-hng tōa-kok ê liân-bêng chòe-hé lâi kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn. In beh pâi-tīn chìn-kong, kā Pa-pí-lûn -siâⁿ kong-phòa. In ê chìⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ gâu siā-chìⁿ ê lâng só͘ siā ê chìⁿ, ta̍k-ki to siā-tio̍h bo̍k-phiau.
Pa-pí-lûn ōe hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ, chhiúⁿ-lia̍h i--ê lóng chhiúⁿ kah sim-móa-ì-chiok.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú kóng, “ Pa-pí-lûn -lâng ah, lín chhiúⁿ góa ê sán-gia̍p, hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, koh thiàu-lâi-thiàu-khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh lún ngó͘-kok ê gû-bú, chhin-chhiūⁿ ióng-béng ê bé tōa-siaⁿ háu;
lín ê lāu-bú ōe hui-siông kiàn-siàu, siⁿ lín--ê ōe kám-kak làu-khùi; khòaⁿ leh, Pa-pí-lûn ōe pìⁿ-chòe siōng jio̍k-siáu ê kok-ka, pìⁿ-chòe ta-sò bô-chúi ê khòng-iá.

In-ūi Siōng Chú hoat tōa siū-khì, Pa-pí-lûn it-tēng bô lâng khiā-khí, beh oân-choân pha-hng; tùi hia keng-kè--ê lóng ōe tio̍h-kiaⁿ, koh in-ūi in só͘ tú--tio̍h ê chai-hō kā in thí-chhiò.
“Siā-chìⁿ ê peng ah, tio̍h pâi-tīn pau-ûi Pa-pí-lûn -siâⁿ; tio̍h ǹg i siā-chìⁿ, m̄-bián pó-sioh lín ê chìⁿ, in-ūi Pa-pí-lûn tek-chōe Siōng Chú.

Lín tio̍h tī Pa-pí-lûn sì-ûi hoah-hiàm, ‘ Pa-pí-lûn í-keng tâu-hâng lah! I ê pó-lúi tó-hoāi, i ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ siū thiah-húi lah!’ Che sī Siōng Chú teh pò-siû, lín mā tio̍h tùi i pò-siû; i án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lâng, lín mā tio̍h án-ni tùi-thāi i.

Iā-chéng--ê kap gia̍h liâm-le̍k-á siu-koah--ê, tio̍h lóng kā in tùi Pa-pí-lûn siau-bia̍t. Ūi-tio̍h beh siám-pī lâi chhim-hoān ê kun-tūi, siâⁿ-lāi só͘-ū kià-ku--ê lóng tò-khì pún-cho̍k, cháu tńg-khì ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong.”
Í-sek-lia̍t sī hō͘ sai kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ ê iûⁿ; tāi-seng hō͘ A-su̍t -ông thun-chia̍h, āu-lâi hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat at-tn̄g kut-thâu.

Só͘-í Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh hêng-hoa̍t Pa-pí-lûn -ông kap i ê kok, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa hêng-hoa̍t A-su̍t -ông kâng-khoán.

Góa beh chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t tò-tńg-lâi in ka-kī ê chháu-po͘; in beh tī Ka-bi̍t kap Pa-san chia̍h-chháu, koh tī Í-hoat-liân soaⁿ-khu kap Ki-lia̍t tōe-khu hióng-siū hia só͘ chhut-sán ê ngó͘-kok.
Tī hit-ji̍t, tī hit-sî, Í-sek-lia̍t ê chōe-kò chhâ lóng bô, Iû-tāi ê chōe-ok mā chhē bô; in-ūi góa beh sià-bián góa lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê chú-bîn.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Tio̍h chiūⁿ-khì kong-kek Bí-la-tāi-ong ê tōe kap Pí-kat ê chū-bîn; tio̍h kā in choân-pō͘ siau-bia̍t, chiàu góa só͘ hoan-hù ê it-chhè khì chòe.
Pa-pí-lûn kéng-lāi ū kau-chiàn ê siaⁿ, koh ū tōa húi-bia̍t.
Phah choân-tōe ê tōa-ki thûi Pa-pí-lûn, í-keng húi-hoāi tn̄g--khì lah! Lia̍t-kok khòaⁿ--tio̍h lóng tio̍h-kiaⁿ!
Pa-pí-lûn ah, lí tùi-khòng góa Siōng Chú, só͘-í góa kā lí siat oa̍h-tauh, lí hō͘ i tauh--tio̍h kèng-jiân m̄ chai; lí hō͘ lâng chhē--tio̍h, lia̍h--tio̍h.”
Siōng Chú í-keng khui bú-khì-khò͘, tī siū-khì tiong gia̍h-chhut I ê bú-khì; Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe beh tùi-hù Pa-pí-lûn.
Lín tio̍h tùi ta̍k-ê hong-hiòng chìn-kong; khui i ê chhek-chhng, kā chiàn-lī-phín thia̍p chòe-tui, chhin-chhiūⁿ thia̍p ngó͘-kok; choân-pō͘ húi-bia̍t, bô lâu pòaⁿ-hāng.
Tio̍h thâi in só͘-ū ê chiàn-sū, kā in lóng-chóng siau-bia̍t. Pa-pí-lûn chhám ah! In siū hêng-hoa̍t ê ji̍t kàu lah!
Tùi Pa-pí-lûn tô-cháu--chhut-lâi ê lān-bîn kóng, “Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè tī Sek-an teh pò-siû, in-ūi Pa-pí-lûn -lâng húi-hoāi I ê sèng-tiān.”

“Tio̍h chio-chi̍p siā-chìⁿ ê peng kong-táⁿ Pa-pí-lûn, tī i ê sì-chiu-ûi chat-iâⁿ, liân chi̍t ê to m̄-thang hō͘ i cháu--khì. Tio̍h chiàu i ê só͘-chòe kā i pò-ho̍k; i án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lâng, lín mā tio̍h án-ni tùi-thāi i, in-ūi i kiau-ngō͘ pōe-ge̍k Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè.
In ê siàu-liân-lâng ōe tī kóng-tiûⁿ hō͘ lâng thâi-sí; kâng hit-ji̍t, in ê chiàn-sū ōe hō͘ lâng châu-bia̍t.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng, lí khòaⁿ, góa beh kong-kek lí, góa tùi-hù lí ê sî-ji̍t í-keng kàu.
Kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng ōe poa̍h-tó, bô lâng kā i hû--khí-lâi; góa beh tiám-hé sio i hiah-ê siâⁿ-tìn, chiong i sì-ûi só͘-ū--ê choân-pō͘ sio-húi.”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng lóng siū khi-ap; hiah-ê lia̍h in khì--ê kā in lia̍h-tiâu-tiâu, m̄-khéng pàng in cháu.

Kiù-sio̍k in--ê sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, góa ū tōa khùi-la̍t, beh thòe in sin-oan, hō͘ choân-tōe tit-tio̍h an-hioh, m̄-kú góa ōe hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn ê chū-bîn tōa kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
To-kiàm ōe lâi kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn -lâng, kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn ê chū-bîn, kap in ê koaⁿ-oân, í-ki̍p ū tì-hūi ê lâng. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
To-kiàm ōe lâi kong-kek su̍t-sū, in ōe pìⁿ-chòe gû-gōng; to-kiàm kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn ê ióng-sū, in chiū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.

To-kiàm ōe lâi kong-kek i ê chiàn-bé chiàn-chhia, í-ki̍p só͘-ū tòa tī in tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng; in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hū-jîn-lâng hiah-ni̍h nńg-chiáⁿ; to-kiàm ōe lâi kong-kek i ê châi-bu̍t, in chiū siū chhiúⁿ-toa̍t.
I ê hô-liû in-ūi khòng-hān ta-khok-khok; i sī pài ngó͘-siōng ê kok-ka, khióng-pò͘ ê sîn-bêng hō͘ lâng tian-kông.
“Só͘-í, khòng-iá ê cháu-siù kap chhâi-lông beh tòa tī hia; tô-chiáu mā beh tī hia chhut-ji̍p; m̄-kú hia bô lâng tòa, éng-oán bô lâng tī hia khiā-khí.

Tú chhin-chhiūⁿ Só͘-to-má, Gô-mô͘-la, í-ki̍p in hù-kūn ê siâⁿ-tìn siū Siōng-tè húi-bia̍t, Pa-pí-lûn bōe koh ū lâng tòa, mā bōe koh ū lâng tī hia kià-ku. Góa Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Khòaⁿ leh, ū chi̍t ê bîn-cho̍k beh tùi pak-hng lâi; ū chi̍t ê kiông ê kok-ka kap chin chōe kun-ông tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi chún-pī beh chhut-cheng.
In gia̍h keng gia̍h chhiuⁿ, chân-jím bô-chêng; in ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-éng hōa-hōa-háu. Pa-pí-lûn -lâng ah, in khiâ chiàn-bé, thoân-kiat tâng-sim, pâi-tīn beh kong-kek lí.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê siau-sit, chhiú lóng nńg--lo̍h-khì; i hui-siông thòng-khó͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ sán-hū teh chhui-chūn.

“Góa beh chhin-chhiūⁿ sai tùi Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ ê chhiū-nâ chhut--lâi, khì kong-kek chhiⁿ-chhùi chháu-po͘ ê iûⁿ-kûn, chin kín kā in kóaⁿ-cháu, lī-khui in ê kok-thó͘. Góa kéng-soán sím-mi̍h-lâng, chiū phài i thóng-tī chit-ê kok-ka. Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kap góa pí? Siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ thoân góa chhut-têng? Tó chit-ê thóng-tī-chiá káⁿ tùi-khòng góa?

Lín tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn kap i ê chū-bîn ê kè-ōe; in liân siōng jio̍k-siáu--ê to ōe hō͘ lâng thoa--khì. Góa it-tēng ōe hō͘ in khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi hong-hòe.
Pa-pí-lûn tó-hoāi ê siaⁿ hō͘ tōe tōa tín-tāng; lâng ai-khàu ê siaⁿ thàng kàu lia̍t-pang.”
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh ēng húi-bia̍t ê tōa-hong kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn kap i ê jîn-bîn.

Góa beh phài gōa-kok-lâng lâi chhim-hoān Pa-pí-lûn, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-hong teh pòa be̍h-sūi; in beh kā i ê kok-thó͘ pòa kah khang-khang-khang. Húi-bia̍t ê ji̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, in beh tùi sì-chiu-ûi lâi kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn.

M̄-thang hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn siā-chìⁿ ê peng siā-chìⁿ, m̄-thang hō͘ in ū ki-hōe bú-chong--khí-lâi; in ê siàu-liân-lâng lín m̄-bián kā in tin-sioh, tio̍h kā in choân-pō͘ ê kun-tūi siau-bia̍t.
Pa-pí-lûn -lâng ōe tī ka-kī ê siâⁿ-chhī siū-thâi, tī ta̍k-tiâu koe-lō͘ hō͘ lâng tô͘-sat.
Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iû-tāi sui-jiân tī ta̍k só͘-chāi tek-chōe góa Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè, m̄-kú in iáu bô hō͘ Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, in ê Siōng-tè khì-sak.

Tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín tô-cháu, lī-khui Pa-pí-lûn, sûi-lâng kò͘ sìⁿ-miā. M̄-thang in-ūi in ê chōe, kap in chòe-hé bia̍t-bông; in-ūi Siōng Chú pò-siû ê sî í-keng kàu, góa beh hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn siū pò-èng.
Pa-pí-lûn í-chêng sī Siōng Chú chhiú-tiong ê kim-poe, hō͘ choân-tōe ê lâng lóng lim kah chùi-bâng-bâng; lia̍t-kok bat lim i ê chiú, lim kah hoat-kông.
Pa-pí-lûn ōe hut-jiân tó-hoāi, húi-bia̍t. Lín tio̍h ūi i ai-khàu! Tio̍h kā i boah jú-hiuⁿ, kiám-khin i ê thàng-thiàⁿ, i khó-lêng iáu i ōe hó.”

Tòa tī Pa-pí-lûn ê gōa-kok-lâng kóng, “Goán bat siūⁿ beh i Pa-pí-lûn, m̄-kú bô-hāu. Hiān-chāi lán tio̍h lī-khui, ta̍k-ê lâng tò-khì ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong; in-ūi Pa-pí-lûn só͘ beh siū ê hêng-hoa̍t chin tōa, tōa kah tú-thiⁿ, thàng kàu kiong-chhong.”
Siōng Chú ê chú-bîn teh hoan-ho͘, “Siōng Chú í-keng soan-pò͘ lán kong-gī bô-chōe. Lâi! Lán tio̍h tī Sek-an soan-iông Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè ê chok-ûi.”

Siōng Chú koat-tēng beh húi-bia̍t Pa-pí-lûn, chiū kek-tōng Bí-tí-a ê kun-ông lâi kong-kek i; che sī Siōng Chú beh pò-siû, beh ūi-tio̍h I siū húi-hoāi ê sèng-tiān pò-ho̍k. Chí-hui-koaⁿ hā-lēng, “Chìⁿ bôa hō͘ chiam, tún-pâi gia̍h hō͘ tiâu.

Chhāi tōa-kî chòe sìn-hō, kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ; ka-kiông kò͘-siú siú-bōng-tâi, phài ōe-peng lûn-pan, koh phài lâng bâi-ho̍k.” Koan-hē Pa-pí-lûn chū-bîn ê miā-ūn, Siōng Chú án-ni koat-tēng, mā án-ni si̍t-hiān.
Pa-pí-lûn ah, lí ê kéng-lāi ū chin chōe hô-liû, koh chek-chū chin chōe châi-pó, m̄-kú lí ê chiong-kio̍k kàu lah! Lí ê sìⁿ-miā kàu chia ûi-chí!

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kí ka-kī li̍p-sè kóng, “Góa beh tiàu-chi̍p chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh hiah-ni̍h chōe ê tāi-kun, chhim-chiàm lín ê thó͘-tōe; in ōe tùi lín hoat-chhut sèng-lī ê hoan-ho͘.”
Siōng Chú ēng ka-kī ê tāi-lêng chhòng-chō tāi-tōe, ēng I ê tì-hūi kian-li̍p sè-kài, ēng chhong-bêng thí-khui kiong-chhong.

Siōng Chú chi̍t-ē chhut-siaⁿ, thiⁿ-téng ê chúi chiū ká-kún, hûn-bū chiū tùi thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak chhèng--chhut-lâi; I tùi hō͘ ê tiong-kan siā-chhut sih-nà, tùi I ê chhng-khò͘ sàng hong chhut--lâi.
Sè-kan-lâng lóng gû-gōng bû-ti; ta̍k-ê phah-kim sai-hū lóng ūi-tio̍h ka-kī chō ê sîn-siōng kiàn-siàu; in-ūi in chù ê sîn-siōng lóng sī hu-ké, lāi-bīn bô sìⁿ-miā.
Ngó͘-siōng lóng sī hu-ké, sī lâng thí-chhiò ê tùi-siōng; hêng-hoa̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, in lóng ōe siau-sit.

Choh Ngá-kok sán-gia̍p ê Siōng-tè kap in bô kâng-khoán; I sī chhòng-chō bān-iú ê Chú; Í-sek-lia̍t sī I ê chú-bîn, sī I ê sán-gia̍p. I ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe.
Siōng Chú kóng, “ Pa-pí-lûn ah, lí sī góa ê thih-thûi kap bú-khì; góa bat ēng lí kòng-chhùi lia̍t-pang, húi-bia̍t lia̍t-kok;
bat ēng lí phah-pāi chiàn-bé kap khiâ-bé--ê; phah-chhùi chiàn-chhia kap sái-chhia--ê;
bat ēng lí thâi-sí ta-po͘-lâng kap hū-jîn-lâng; thâi-sí lāu-lâng kap gín-á; thâi-sí siàu-liân-lâng kap siàu-lú;
bat ēng lí thâi-sí bo̍k-chiá kap i ê iûⁿ-kûn; thâi-sí choh-sit-lâng kap i ê gû; thâi-sí chóng-tok kap koaⁿ-oân.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Lín beh chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa pò-èng Pa-pí-lûn kap i ê chū-bîn, in-ūi in choh-pháiⁿ siong-hāi Sek-an.
Pa-pí-lûn ah, lí sī húi-bia̍t choân-tōe ê tōa-soaⁿ; lí khòaⁿ, góa beh kong-kek lí, beh chhun-chhiú tùi soaⁿ-giâm kā lí chhia--lo̍h-khì, hō͘ lí pìⁿ-chòe sio-húi ê soaⁿ.
Lâng bōe koh tùi lí hia the̍h chio̍h-thâu chòe chhù-kak-chio̍h, á-sī chòe tōe-ki; in-ūi lí ōe éng-oán hong-hòe.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

“Tio̍h tī kéng-lāi chhāi tōa-kî chòe sìn-hō, tī lia̍t-kok tiong pûn sàu-kak, tiàu-chi̍p lia̍t-kok lâi kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn. Tio̍h chio-chi̍p A-la-la̍h, Bí-nî, A-si̍t-ki-ná lâi kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn; koh phài chiong-kun chí-hui chok-chiàn, tiàu-chi̍p chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh hiah-ni̍h chōe ê bé-peng chiūⁿ--lâi.
Tio̍h chio-chi̍p lia̍t-kok, Bí-tí-a ê kun-ông, chóng-tok, koaⁿ-oân, kap in só͘ koán ta̍k-kok ê kun-tūi, lâi kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn.
Tōe tōa tín-tāng koh tńg-se̍h; in-ūi Siōng Chú kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn ê chí-ì í-keng khak-tēng, beh hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn ê thó͘-tōe hong-hòe, bô lâng khiā-khí.

Pa-pí-lûn ê ióng-sū bô beh koh kau-chiàn, lóng bih tī pó-lúi lāi-bīn; in khùi-la̍t ēng-chīn, chhin-chhiūⁿ hū-jîn-lâng bô-la̍t kâng-khoán. Pa-pí-lûn ê chhù-the̍h hō͘ hé sio-liáu-liáu, in ê siâⁿ-mn̂g hō͘ lâng lòng-phòa.
Sàng-phoe--ê liân-sòa cháu--lâi, pò siau-sit--ê chi̍t-ê koh chi̍t-ê, lóng cháu-lâi beh pò hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông chai, siâⁿ ta̍k-pêng lóng hō͘ lâng kong-phòa,
hô ê tō͘-kháu hō͘ te̍k-jîn chiàm--khì, chúi-tî ê lô͘-úi hō͘ hé sio--khì, chiàn-sū lóng kiaⁿ kah phòa-táⁿ.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè soan-pò͘: Pa-pí-lûn ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ, hō͘ lâng ta̍h kah pîⁿ-pîⁿ-pîⁿ; koh bô-jōa-kú, siu-sêng ê sî chiū kàu lah!”

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng kóng: “ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat kā goán thun-bia̍t, kā goán teh-chhùi, koh hō͘ goán chhin-chhiūⁿ piàⁿ-khang ê khì-khū; i chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-koài kā goán thun--lo̍h-khì, chiong goán ê pó-pòe chia̍h-liáu-liáu, chiū kā goán phùi--chhut-lâi.”

Sek-an ê chū-bîn kóng: “ Pa-pí-lûn -lâng ge̍k-thāi goán kap goán ê chhin-cho̍k, goān in siū pò-ho̍k!” Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -lâng kóng: “In lâu goán ê huih, goān in chiah-ê chōe siū pò-èng!”
Só͘-í Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh thòe lín sin-oan, beh ūi lín pò-siû; góa beh hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn ê hô bô chúi, hō͘ i ê chúi-goân lóng ta--khì.
Pa-pí-lûn beh pìⁿ-chòe thô͘-tui, chiâⁿ-chòe chhâi-lông tòa ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ thí-chhiò, bô lâng khiā-khí.
Pa-pí-lûn chhin-chhiūⁿ ióng-béng ê sai hm̄-hm̄-háu, koh chhin-chhiūⁿ sòe-chiah sai teh kiò.

In ê si̍t-io̍k chi̍t-ē khí, góa chiū thòe in pān-toh, hō͘ in khoài-lo̍k, hō͘ in lim kah chiú-chùi, éng-oán khùn bōe chhíⁿ. Góa beh chhin-chhiūⁿ teh kóaⁿ iûⁿ-á, kóaⁿ mî-iûⁿ-káng, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, kóaⁿ in lo̍h-khì tô͘-sat-tiûⁿ.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú kóng, “ Pa-pí-lûn kèng-jiân siū kong-phòa! Choân sè-kài lóng teh chheng-chàn ê tōa-siâⁿ kèng-jiân siū chiàm-léng! Lia̍t-kok khòaⁿ-tio̍h i lóng tio̍h-kiaⁿ!
Hái-chúi tiòng-koân, im-kè Pa-pí-lûn; hōa-hōa-háu ê hái-éng kā i khàm--khí-lâi.
Pa-pí-lûn ê siâⁿ-tìn pha-hng, thó͘-tōe ta-khok-khok, pìⁿ-chòe soa-bô͘, bô lâng khiā-khí, mā bô lâng keng-kè.
Góa beh hêng-hoa̍t Pa-pí-lûn ê sîn-bêng Pí-le̍k, kiò i thò͘-chhut thun--lo̍h-khì ê châi-bu̍t; lia̍t-kok bōe koh khì kèng-pài i. “ Pa-pí-lûn ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ tó-hoāi lah!
Góa ê chú-bîn ah, tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín tô-cháu, lī-khui Pa-pí-lûn! Ta̍k-ê lâng kiù ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā, siám-pī Siōng Chú ê tōa siū-khì.
Lín m̄-thang sit-táⁿ, m̄-bián in-ūi kéng-lāi ê hong-siaⁿ kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; in-ūi múi-nî lóng ū hong-siaⁿ thoân--lâi, kéng-lāi ū kiông-pō ê sū, léng-siù hō͘-siōng tò͘-cheng.
Khòaⁿ leh, sî-ji̍t it-tēng ōe kàu, góa beh hêng-hoa̍t Pa-pí-lûn ê ngó͘-siōng. Pa-pí-lûn choân-kok lóng ōe tú-tio̍h kiàn-siàu; siū thâi ê lâng ōe tó kah móa-sì-kòe.

Hit-sî, húi-bia̍t-chiá tùi pak-hng lâi kàu Pa-pí-lûn, thiⁿ-tōe kap kî-tiong só͘-ū--ê beh in-ūi Pa-pí-lûn tó-hoāi hoan-ho͘. Pa-pí-lûn tī sè-kài ta̍k só͘-chāi thâi-sí chin chōe lâng, mā thâi-sí chin chōe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, ūi-tio̍h án-ni, i ōe siū húi-bia̍t.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Lín í-keng siám-pī to-kiàm, tio̍h kín cháu, m̄-thang khiā tiàm hia. Lín sui-jiân lī-khui kò͘-hiong chin hn̄g, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Siōng Chú, tio̍h siàu-liām Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Lín kóng, ‘Goán thiaⁿ-tio̍h lâng teh lóe-mē chiū kám-kak làu-khùi, móa-bīn kiàn-siàu, in-ūi gōa-pang-lâng ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê sèng-só͘.’
Só͘-í, sî-ji̍t it-tēng ōe kàu, góa beh hêng-hoa̍t Pa-pí-lûn ê ngó͘-siōng; Pa-pí-lûn kok-lāi ū chōe-chōe lâng siū-siong teh haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan.
Pa-pí-lûn sui-jiân peh-chiūⁿ thiⁿ, koh kiông-hòa pó-lúi, góa iû-goân beh chhe húi-bia̍t-chiá tùi-hù i.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Tùi Pa-pí-lûn thoân-chhut ai-khàu ê siaⁿ, tī Pa-pí-lûn hoat-seng tōa húi-bia̍t.
In-ūi Siōng Chú beh húi-bia̍t Pa-pí-lûn, siâⁿ-lāi bô koh ū soan-hoa ê siaⁿ. Tùi-te̍k ê kun-tūi chhin-chhiūⁿ éng lōng-lōng-háu, hoat-chhut hiáng-liāng ê siaⁿ.
Ū húi-bia̍t-chiá lâi kong-kek Pa-pí-lûn; Pa-pí-lûn ê ióng-sū hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì, in ê keng siū at-chi̍h; Siōng Chú sī hêng-hoa̍t ê Siōng-tè, it-tēng ōe pò-èng Pa-pí-lûn.

Góa beh hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn ê kùi-cho̍k, tì-hūi ê lâng, chóng-tok, koaⁿ-oân, í-ki̍p ióng-sū lóng lim kah chiú-chùi, éng-oán khùn bōe chhíⁿ.” Tōa kun-ông, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “ Pa-pí-lûn khoan-khoah ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ōe choân-pō͘ tó-hoāi, koân-tōa ê siâⁿ-mn̂g ōe hō͘ hé sio-sio--khì. Bān-bîn só͘ lô-lo̍k--ê lóng bô-chhái-kang, bān-kok só͘ lô-le̍k--ê lóng sio-liáu-liáu; in chiū lóng ià-siān.”

Iû-tāi -ông Se-tí-ka chē-ūi tē-sì nî, Má-se-ngá ê sun, Nî-lī-a ê kiáⁿ Se-lâi-ngá chòe ông-kiong chóng-koán; i kap ông chòe-hé khì Pa-pí-lûn ê sî, sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí ū ōe hoan-hù i.
Iâ-lī-bí chiong teh-beh lîm-kàu Pa-pí-lûn ê chai-hō, chiū-sī iú-koan Pa-pí-lûn it-chhè ê ōe, lóng siá tī chi̍t kńg chheh.
Iâ-lī-bí tùi Se-lâi-ngá kóng, “Lí khì kàu Pa-pí-lûn ê sî, tio̍h soan-tho̍k siá tī chit-ê chheh-kǹg ê ōe.
Koh tio̍h kî-tó kóng, ‘Siōng Chú ah, koan-hē chit-ê só͘-chāi, lí bat kóng lí beh húi-bia̍t, hō͘ i éng-oán pha-hng, bô lâng khiā-khí, liân cheng-siⁿ mā cháu-liáu-liáu.’
Se-lâi-ngá, lí kā chit-kńg chheh soan-tho̍k liáu-āu, tio̍h kā i pa̍k tī chi̍t tè chio̍h-thâu, hiat lo̍h-khì Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô,

jiân-āu kóng, ‘ Pa-pí-lûn ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni tîm--lo̍h-khì, bōe koh heng-khí; jîn-bîn mā lóng ià-siān, in-ūi Siōng Chú beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ in.’” Iâ-lī-bí ê ōe kàu chia kiat-sok.
Se-tí-ka chē-ūi ê sî jī-cha̍p-it hè, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choh-ông cha̍p-it nî. I ê lāu-bú kiò-chòe Hap-bō͘-tha, sī Li̍p-ná -lâng Iâ-lī-bí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
I chòe Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-chòe pháiⁿ ê sū, chiàu Iok-ngá-kèng ê só͘-chòe khì chòe.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi hoat-seng chiah-ê sū, sī in-ūi Siōng Chú hoat siū-khì, tùi I ê bīn-chêng kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì. Se-tí-ka pōe-poān Pa-pí-lûn -ông.

Se-tí-ka thóng-tī tē-káu nî, cha̍p-ge̍h chhoe-cha̍p, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chhōa i ê tāi-kun lâi kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tī siâⁿ ê tùi-bīn chat-iâⁿ, koh tī sì-ûi choh thô͘-tui kong-siâⁿ.
Siâⁿ siū ûi-khùn, it-ti̍t kàu Se-tí-ka -ông tē-cha̍p-it nî.
Sì-ge̍h chhoe-káu, siâⁿ-lāi ki-hng chin giâm-tiōng, chū-bîn lóng bô mi̍h thang chia̍h,

siâⁿ siū kong-phòa; só͘-ū ê peng-sū thàu-mî tùi ông-kiong hoe-hn̂g hù-kūn, nn̄g ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ tiong-kan ê mn̂g hit-tiâu lō͘ tô-cháu. Pa-pí-lûn kun-tūi iáu tī sì-ûi kong-siâⁿ ê sî, in ǹg A-la-pa ê hong-hiòng tô-cháu.
Pa-pí-lûn ê kun-peng tui-jip Se-tí-ka -ông, tī Iâ-lī-ko ê pêng-goân jip-tio̍h i; i ê choân-kun lóng khì-sak i sì-sòaⁿ.
Pa-pí-lûn ê kun-peng lia̍h-tio̍h Se-tí-ka, kā i lia̍h-khì Hap-má tōe-khu ê Lī-pí-la ê Pa-pí-lûn -ông hia, tī hia siū sím-phòaⁿ.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông thâi-sí Se-tí-ka ê kiáⁿ, hō͘ i chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h, koh tī Lī-pí-la thâi Iû-tāi só͘-ū ê kùi-cho̍k.
Koh ó͘ i nn̄g lúi ba̍k-chiu, ēng tâng-liān kā i liān--teh, tòa i khì Pa-pí-lûn, kā i koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ--ni̍h, ti̍t-kàu i sí hit-ji̍t.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat tē-cha̍p-káu nî, gō͘-ge̍h chhoe-chhit, Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê jîn-sîn sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn chìn-ji̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng,
ēng hé sio Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān, ông-kiong, kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘-ū ê chhù, í-ki̍p só͘-ū kùi-cho̍k ê chhù.
Tè sī-ōe-tiúⁿ ê Pa-pí-lûn kun-peng chiong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sì-ûi ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ lóng thiah-húi.

Hit-sî, sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn chiong bîn-kan sòng-hiong-lâng, lâu tī siâⁿ-lāi só͘ chhun ê jîn-bîn, kap tâu-hâng Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê lâng, í-ki̍p só͘ chhun ê sai-hū lóng lia̍h--khì.
M̄-kú sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn ū lâu chi̍t-kóa siōng sòng-hiong--ê, hō͘ in tī phû-tô-hn̂g kap chhân-hn̂g chèng-choh.
Pa-pí-lûn -lâng chiong Siōng Chú tiān-lāi ê tâng-thiāu, phûn-chō, kap tâng-hái lóng phah-phòa, chiong hiah-ê tâng ūn-khì Pa-pí-lûn.
In mā chiong tiáⁿ, thuh-á, teng-sim ê chián-to, óaⁿ-pôaⁿ-á, khǹg hiuⁿ ê phiat-á, kap sèng-tiān só͘-ū tâng ê khì-khū lóng poaⁿ--khì;
poe, khǹg hé-thòaⁿ ê phûn, pôaⁿ, tiáⁿ, teng-tâi, khǹg hiuⁿ ê phiat-á, au-á, só͘-ū kim-khì ê kim, gûn-khì ê gûn, sī-ōe-tiúⁿ lóng the̍h--khì.

Koh chiong Só͘-lô-bûn -ông ūi Siōng Chú ê tiān só͘ chō nn̄g ki thiāu, chi̍t ê tâng-hái, kap chō-ē cha̍p-jī chiah tâng-gû tòa--khì; chiah-ê khì-khū ê tâng chōe kah bōe-chhìn--tit.

Chit nn̄g ki thiāu siâng-khoán, múi chi̍t ki koân poeh kong-chhioh, chiu-ûi gō͘ kong-chhioh saⁿ-cha̍p kong-hun, kāu chhit-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-lî, tiong-ng khang-khak; thiāu ê téng-bīn ū tâng ê thiāu-táu; thiāu-táu koân chi̍t kong-chhioh saⁿ-cha̍p kong-hun; thiāu-táu ê chiu-ûi ū tâng chòe ê bāng-á kap sia̍h-liû.
Sì-bīn ū sia̍h-liû káu-cha̍p-la̍k lia̍p; bāng-á ê chiu-ûi sia̍h-liû chóng-kiōng chi̍t-pah lia̍p.
Sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn lia̍h tōa-chè-si Se-lâi-ngá, hù-chè-si Se-hoan-ngá, kap saⁿ ê sèng-tiān mn̂g-kháu ê siú-ōe;
koh tùi siâⁿ-lāi lia̍h chi̍t ê koán-peng ê koaⁿ-oân, ông ê chhit ê chhin-sìn, kap teng-bō͘ peng-sū ê hù-chí-hui-koaⁿ, í-ki̍p tī siâⁿ-lāi tú--tio̍h ê la̍k-cha̍p ê kok-bîn.
Sī-ōe-tiúⁿ chiong chiah-ê lâng tòa-khì tī Lī-pí-la ê Pa-pí-lûn -ông hia.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông tī Hap-má tōe-khu ê Lī-pí-la lóng kā in thâi-sí. Án-ni, Iû-tāi ê jîn-bîn siū-lia̍h lī-khui in pún-tōe.
Ē-bīn sī Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat só͘ lia̍h ê jîn-sò͘: Tī i thóng-tī tē-chhit nî, lia̍h Iû-tāi -lâng saⁿ-chheng khòng jī-cha̍p-saⁿ lâng;
Tē-cha̍p-poeh nî, tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lia̍h poeh-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-jī lâng;
Tē-jī-cha̍p-saⁿ nî, sī-ōe-tiúⁿ Nî-pò͘-sat-la-tàn lia̍h Iû-tāi -lâng chhit-pah sì-cha̍p-gō͘ lâng; chóng-kiōng ū sì-chheng la̍k-pah lâng.

Pa-pí-lûn -ông Í-bī Bí-lô-ta̍t tī i chē-ūi hit-nî, chiū-sī Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kun siū-lia̍h liáu-āu tē-saⁿ-cha̍p-chhit nî, cha̍p-jī-ge̍h jī-cha̍p-gō͘ ji̍t, te̍k-sià Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kun, pàng i chhut-kaⁿ,
koh ēng hó-ōe an-ùi i, hō͘ i pí siū-lia̍h tī Pa-pí-lûn kî-tha kok-ka ê ông ū khah-koân ê tōe-ūi.
Iok-ngá-kun thǹg-khì kaⁿ-lāi só͘ chhēng ê saⁿ, chi̍t-sì-lâng kap Pa-pí-lûn -ông chòe-hé chia̍h.
Iok-ngá-kun oa̍h--teh ê sî, Pa-pí-lûn -ông siúⁿ-sù i só͘ su-iàu ê seng-oa̍h hùi-iōng, ti̍t-kàu i sí hit-ji̍t.

Ài ah! Chit-ê chá-chêng lâng-khoeh-lâng ê siâⁿ-chhī, hiān-chāi kèng-jiân pha-hng. Chá-chêng tī lia̍t-kok siū kèng-tiōng--ê, hiān-chāi kèng-jiân chhin-chhiūⁿ kóaⁿ-hū. Chá-chêng tī ta̍k siâⁿ-chhī chòe ông-hō͘--ê, hiān-chāi kèng-jiân lo̍k-phek kah chòe lô͘-lē.
I kui-mî ai-khàu, móa-bīn ba̍k-sái. Chá-chêng ê ài-jîn, hiān-chāi bô chi̍t ê lâi an-ùi. I ê pêng-iú chhut-bōe i, pìⁿ-chòe i ê tùi-te̍k.
Iû-tāi liû-bông tī gōa-pang, siū khó͘, chòe khó͘-kang. In tòa tī lia̍t-kok, bōe-tàng an-jiân khiā-khí; in siū ûi-khùn, bô lō͘ tô-thoat.
Thàng kàu Sek-an ê tōa-lō͘ ai-siong, in-ūi bô lâng lâi kè-choeh; só͘-ū ê siâⁿ-mn̂g hong-hòe, chè-si ai-thàn, siàu-lú pi-siong; Sek-an ut-chut thòng-khó͘.
I ê tùi-te̍k pìⁿ-chòe chú-lâng; i ê siû-jîn hoân-êng sáng-sè. In-ūi i chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn pōe-poān, Siōng Chú hō͘ i siū-khó͘; i ê gín-á hō͘ tùi-te̍k lia̍h--khì.
Sek-an ê êng-hôa í-keng siau-sit. I ê léng-siù chhin-chhiūⁿ chhē bô chháu-tiûⁿ ê lo̍k; in siám-pī tui-jip in ê lâng, m̄-kú bô-la̍t thang cháu.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khùn-khó͘ liû-lōng ê sî, hôe-sióng i chá-chêng ê êng-hôa. I ê chū-bîn lo̍h tī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú-thâu, bô lâng kiù-chō͘ i. Tùi-te̍k khòaⁿ-kìⁿ i lûn-hām, hong-chhì thí-chhiò i.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hoān tōa-chōe, chiâⁿ-chòe lâng ê chhiò-pìⁿ. Chá-chêng chun-tiōng i ê lâng, khòaⁿ i hiān-chāi chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, chiū biáu-sī i. I ka-kī ai-thàn, kiàn-siàu cháu-khì bih.

I ê ù-òe kō-tio̍h i ê kûn; i m̄-bat siūⁿ-tio̍h ka-kī ê kiat-kio̍k. I ê tūi-lo̍h hō͘ lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ; bô lâng an-ùi i. Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí khòaⁿ góa ê khó͘-lān, in-ūi góa ê tùi-te̍k teh tùi góa chhàng-chhiu.
Tùi-te̍k chhun-chhiú chhiúⁿ-toa̍t i choân-pō͘ ê châi-pó; i khòaⁿ-tio̍h gōa-cho̍k-lâng chhim-ji̍p sèng-tiān, chiū-sī Siōng Chú kìm-chí in ji̍p--khì ê só͘-chāi.

Jîn-bîn ai-thàn thó͘-khùi, sì-kòe chhē-chia̍h, ūi-tio̍h kiù sìⁿ-miā, the̍h châi-pó ōaⁿ chia̍h-mi̍h. Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí àⁿ-lo̍h khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ góa pìⁿ-chòe chiah-ni̍h pi-chhám!

Lín chiah-ê kè-lō͘-lâng, lín kiám lóng bô iàu-kín? Lín sì-bīn koan-chhat, kiám ū lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ góa án-ni siū khó͘-chhó͘? Che sī Siōng Chú tōa siū-khì ê sî hō͘ góa sêng-siū ê thòng-khó͘.
I tùi téng-bīn kàng-hé tī góa ê kut-thâu lāi-bīn teh sio. I siat lô-bāng tîⁿ góa ê kha, hō͘ góa poa̍h-tó thè-āu. I pàng góa ko͘-toaⁿ, hō͘ góa kui-ji̍t pi-chhám.
I chiong góa chōe-kò ê taⁿ pa̍k tī góa ê ām-kún, hō͘ góa cheng-le̍k ta--khì. Chú chiong góa kau tī góa bô-la̍t tùi-khòng ê tùi-te̍k chhiú-tiong.

Chú khì-sak góa só͘-ū ê ióng-sū; I tiàu-chi̍p tāi-kun kong-kek góa, teh-chhùi góa ê siàu-liân-lâng. Chú thún-ta̍h góa ê jîn-bîn, chhin-chhiūⁿ tī chiú-khut ta̍h phû-tô kâng-khoán.

Góa ūi-tio̍h chiah-ê sū thî-khàu, góa ê ba̍k-sái ti̍t-ti̍t lâu. Bô lâng tī sin-piⁿ an-ùi góa; bô lâng hō͘ góa koh-chài tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t. Góa ê jîn-bîn ko͘-khó͘-bû-chō͘, in-ūi góa ê tùi-te̍k thâi-iâⁿ góa.

Sek-an chhun siang-chhiú kî-kiû, m̄-kú bô lâng an-ùi i. Kóng-tio̍h Ngá-kok, Siōng Chú í-keng hā-lēng, hō͘ sì-chiu-ûi ê lâng chiâⁿ-chòe i ê tùi-te̍k; in chiong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khòaⁿ-chòe ù-òe ê mi̍h.

Siōng Chú kong-gī, m̄-kú góa ûi-pōe I ê bēng-lēng. Bān-kok ê jîn-bîn, chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ, chhiáⁿ khòaⁿ góa só͘ siū ê thòng-khó͘: Góa ê siàu-lú, góa ê chheng-liân lóng siū lia̍h--khì!
Góa kā pêng-iú kiû oān-chō͘, m̄-kú in khi-phiàn góa. Góa ê chè-si kap tiúⁿ-ló chhē-chia̍h beh kiù sìⁿ-miā, soah tn̄g-khùi sí tī siâⁿ-lāi.

Siōng Chú, lí khòaⁿ leh, góa chiah-ni̍h put-hēng thòng-khó͘! Góa ê tn̂g-á ká-kún, góa ê sim-koaⁿ kiat kui-kiû, in-ūi góa tōa-tōa pōe-ge̍k. Tī koe-lō͘ ū hiong-sat, tī chhù-lāi ū sí-bông.

Lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h góa haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan, m̄-kú bô lâng an-ùi góa. Tùi-te̍k thiaⁿ-kìⁿ góa tú--tio̍h ê chai-hō, lóng in-ūi lí hêng-hoa̍t góa lâi hoaⁿ-hí. Goān lí soan-kò ê ji̍t-chí lâi kàu, hō͘ tùi-te̍k kap góa siâng-khoán siū khó͘-lān.

Goān lí khòaⁿ-kìⁿ in só͘-chòe ê siâ-ok, kā in hêng-hoa̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ lí in-ūi góa ê chōe-kò hêng-hoa̍t góa siâng-khoán. Góa in-ūi ai-thàn bô-soah, góa ê sim-sîn soe-lám.

Ài ah! Siōng Chú kèng-jiân hoat tōa siū-khì, hō͘ Sek-an kiàn-siàu! I chiong Í-sek-lia̍t ê êng-hôa tùi thiⁿ hiat-lo̍h tōe; tī I siū-khì ê ji̍t, liân ka-kī ê kha-tiam, sèng-tiān, I mā bô kò͘-liām.

Siōng Chú húi-bia̍t Ngá-kok lóng-chóng ê chháu-po͘, chi̍t-sut-á to bô lîn-bín. I hoat tōa siū-khì, thiah-húi Iû-tāi ê pó-lúi, hō͘ Iû-tāi kap i ê léng-siù thiat-tóe siū lêng-jio̍k.

I hoat tōa siū-khì, siau-bia̍t Í-sek-lia̍t só͘-ū ê khùi-la̍t; tùi-te̍k lâi ê sî, I m̄ chhun-chhiú pó-hō͘. I chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-iām thun-bia̍t Ngá-kok, chiong i só͘-ū--ê lóng sio-húi.

I chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-te̍k ǹg góa khui keng, chhin-chhiūⁿ te̍k-jîn ēng chìⁿ siā góa. I chiong goán ióng-chòng ê siàu-liân-lâng lóng thâi-sí; I ê tōa siū-khì hoat-chhut, chhin-chhiūⁿ hé sio-húi Sek-an ê pò͘-pîⁿ.
Siōng Chú chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-te̍k, húi-bia̍t Í-sek-lia̍t; I thiah-húi Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiong-tiān, hō͘ pó-lúi hong-hòe; I ke-thiⁿ Iû-tāi jîn-bîn ê pi-siong kap ai-khàu.

I húi-hoāi I ka-kī khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ húi-hoāi hn̂g-á; I thiah-húi sèng-tiān. Siōng Chú hō͘ Sek-an ê lâng bōe-kì-tit choeh-kî kap An-hioh-ji̍t; I tī tōa siū-khì tiong khì-sak kun-ông kap chè-si.

Siōng Chú hòng-khì ka-kī ê chè-tôaⁿ, pàng-sak I ê sèng-só͘; I chiong kiong-tiān ê ûi-chhiûⁿ kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k, chhut-chāi in thiah-húi. In tī Siōng Chú ê tiān-lāi, tōa-siaⁿ soan-hoa, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh kè-choeh.
Siōng Chú koat-tēng beh thiah-húi Sek-an ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ; I giú chún-chîn, beh phò-hoāi; I ê chhiú bô koh siu-hôe. I hō͘ siâⁿ-lâu kap siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ai-khàu, chòe-hé tó-hoāi.

Sek-an ê siâⁿ-mn̂g í-keng tâi tī thô͘--ni̍h; Siōng Chú kòng-tn̄g siâⁿ-mn̂g ê mn̂g-chhòaⁿ. Kun-ông kap léng-siù lóng siū hòng-tio̍k khì lia̍t-kok. Sek-an bô lâng káng-kái lu̍t-hoat; sian-ti bô koh tùi Siōng Chú tit-tio̍h īⁿ-siōng.

Sek-an ê tiúⁿ-ló chē tī thô͘-kha, tiām-tiām bô chhut-siaⁿ. In iā thô͘-soa-hún sám thâu-khak, seng-khu chhēng môa-saⁿ; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siàu-lú thâu-lôe-lôe tàm kàu thô͘-kha.

Góa ê ba̍k-chiu in-ūi lâu ba̍k-sái sit-bêng, góa ê tn̂g-á kiáu-ká, góa ê ngó͘-chōng siau-iûⁿ; góa ê tông-pau siū châu-bia̍t, gín-á kap eⁿ-á hūn-tó tī siâⁿ-lāi ê kóng-tiûⁿ.

In chhin-chhiūⁿ siū-siong ê chiàn-sū hūn-tó tī kóng-tiûⁿ, tī lāu-bú ê heng-chêng bān-bān tn̄g-khùi; in mn̄g lāu-bú, kóng: Ū sím-mi̍h thang chia̍h--bô? Ū sím-mi̍h thang lim--bô?

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, góa ōe-tàng thòe lí kóng sím-mi̍h? Góa ōe-tàng ēng sím-mi̍h pí-phēng lí? Sek-an, góa thang ēng sím-mi̍h kap lí pí-kàu lâi an-ùi lí? Lí ê khang-chhùi chhin-chhiūⁿ hái hiah-ni̍h tōa, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kā lí i-tī?

Lí ê sian-ti khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê sī bô-iáⁿ-chiah, phiàn--lâng ê īⁿ-siōng; in m̄-bat chí-chhut lí ê chōe, hō͘ lí hóe-kái, m̄-bián siū lia̍h; in thoân hō͘ lí--ê sī hu-ké, kiâⁿ bê-lō͘ ê be̍k-sī.

Só͘-ū ê kè-lō͘-lâng lóng phah-pho̍k-á, hàiⁿ-thâu thí-chhiò Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, kóng: Che kiám sī lâng teh kóng hit-ê si̍p-choân-si̍p-bí ê siâⁿ? Che kiám sī choân sè-kài ê lâng lóng teh o-ló ê siâⁿ?

Só͘-ū ê tùi-te̍k lóng kā lí phì-siùⁿ; in thí-chhiò lí, kā-gê-chhiat-chhí kóng: Goán í-keng chiong i thun-bia̍t lah! Goán chiū-sī teh thèng-hāu chit-ji̍t! Taⁿ goán chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h lah!

Siōng Chú í-keng oân-sêng I ê kè-ōe, si̍t-hiān I chá-chêng tiāⁿ-tio̍h ê kéng-kò; I thiah-húi, chi̍t-sut-á to bô liû-chêng. I hō͘ tùi-te̍k tùi lí khoa-kháu, hō͘ in iāu-bú-iông-ui.

Tio̍h tùi sim-tóe kiû-kiò Chú! Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ah, goān lí ê ba̍k-sái chhin-chhiūⁿ kang-hô ti̍t-ti̍t lâu, mî-ji̍t bô-thêng! Goān lí ê ba̍k-chiu lâu ba̍k-sái bô hioh-khùn!

Tio̍h tī ta̍k-àm ōaⁿ-kiⁿ ê sî khí-lâi kiû-kiò; ǹg Siōng Chú thò͘-lō͘ lí ê sim-siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ piàⁿ-chúi; tio̍h gia̍h siang-chhiú ūi-tio̍h lín ê gín-á ê sìⁿ-miā kî-tó, in tī koe-lō͘ iau kah teh-beh sí--khì.

Siōng Chú, kiû lí khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ lí kiám bat án-ni kā lâng chek-hoa̍t--kè? Hū-jîn-lâng kiám thang chia̍h ka-kī só͘ siⁿ só͘ iúⁿ-chhī ê eⁿ-á? Chè-si kap sian-ti ná thang tī Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān siū sat-hāi?
Siàu-liân-lâng kap lāu-lâng lóng tó tī koe-lō͘; siàu-lú kap chheng-liân-lâng lóng sí tī to-ē. Lí tī siū-khì ê ji̍t kā in thâi-sí, chi̍t-sut-á to bô liû-chêng.

Lí tùi sì-bīn tiàu-chi̍p góa ê tùi-te̍k, chhin-chhiūⁿ kiò lâng lâi kè-choeh. Tī Siōng Chú siū-khì ê ji̍t, bô lâng ōe-tàng tô-thoat, ōe-tàng pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā; tùi-te̍k thâi-sí góa só͘-ū ióng-io̍k ê jî-lú.
Góa hō͘ Siōng Chú siū-khì ê koáiⁿ hêng-hoa̍t, siū-chīn khó͘-thàng.
I kóaⁿ góa ji̍p-khì o͘-àm, sì-bīn bô kng.
I it-chài hē-chhiú phah góa, kui-ji̍t bô-thêng.
I hō͘ góa siau-sán-lo̍h-bah; I at-chi̍h góa ê kut-thâu.
I ēng pi-chhám pau-ûi góa, ēng khó͘-chhó͘ kong-kek góa.
I hō͘ góa tòa tī o͘-àm tiong, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-keng sí chin kú ê lâng.
I ēng chhiûⁿ ûi-khùn góa, hō͘ góa bōe-tàng tô-thoat; I ēng chin tāng ê tâng-liān kā góa pa̍k--teh.
Góa ai-kiû ho͘-kiò, I m̄ thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó.
I ēng phah--kè ê tōa chio̍h tòng góa ê lō͘, hō͘ góa ê lō͘ khâm-khia̍t oan-khiau.
I chhin-chhiūⁿ bâi-ho̍k ê hîm, mā chhin-chhiūⁿ bih--teh ê sai, thèng-hāu beh kong-kek góa.
I pek góa lī-khui tōa-lō͘, kā góa thiah-chhùi, pàng tī piⁿ--á.
I khui keng, kā góa tòng-chòe âng-sim siā.
I ēng chìⁿ-tē lāi ê chìⁿ, siā-ji̍p góa ê sim.
Góa chiâⁿ-chòe bān-bîn ê chhiò-pìⁿ; in kui-mî kui-ji̍t choh-koa thí-chhiò góa.
I ēng khó͘-chhài kiông-pek góa chia̍h, ēng khó͘-chiú kiông-pek góa lim.
I ēng chhùi-chio̍h-á bôa-tn̄g góa ê chhùi-khí, ēng thô͘-soa-hún khàm góa.
Góa ê seng-oa̍h sit-khì pêng-an; góa í-keng bōe-kì-tit hēng-hok sī sím-mi̍h.
Só͘-í góa kóng: Góa ê goân-khì siau-sit, m̄-káⁿ koh kî-thāi Siōng Chú kái-kiù góa.
Hôe-sióng góa ê thòng-khó͘ kap liû-lōng, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chia̍h khó͘-chhài, lim khó͘-chiú.
Siūⁿ-khí chiah-ê sū, góa ê sim tîm-tāng ut-chut.
M̄-kú tng góa siūⁿ-khí chit-kiāⁿ sū, góa chiū koh ū ǹg-bāng:
Siōng Chú ê chû-ài éng-oán chûn-chāi, I ê lîn-bín éng bōe toān-choa̍t,
ta̍k chá-khí ōaⁿ-sin; lí ê sìn-si̍t kóng-tāi.
Góa ê sim kóng: Siōng Chú sī góa it-chhè hok-khì ê goân-thâu, só͘-í góa beh ǹg-bāng thèng-hāu I.
Sìn-khò I, chhē-kiû I ê lâng, Siōng Chú si-un hō͘ in.
Lâng tio̍h thun-lún thèng-hāu Siōng Chú ê kiù-un, in-ūi che sī hó.
Lâng eng-kai tī siàu-liân ê sî pē i ê taⁿ, in-ūi che sī hó.
Lâng tio̍h ka-kī chi̍t ê tiām-tiām chē--teh, che sī Siōng Chú hō͘ i ê taⁿ.
Lâng eng-kai bīn phak tī thô͘-kha, án-ni khó-lêng iáu ū ǹg-bāng.
Tio̍h kù-chāi lâng pa chhùi-phóe, jím-siū it-chhè ê lêng-jio̍k.
Chú bōe éng-oán khì-sak lâng.
I sui-jiân hō͘ lâng iu-chhiû, iû-goân ōe chiàu I hong-sēng ê chû-ài lîn-bín lâng.
I m̄-kam hō͘ lâng siū-khó͘, hō͘ lâng iu-siong.
Só͘-ū siū-lia̍h--ê hō͘ lâng thún-ta̍h ap-chè, Chú it-tēng koan-hoâi!
Chì-koân-chiá só͘ sù ê jîn-koân siū pak-siah, Chú it-tēng koan-hoâi!
Lâng tī hoat-têng siū oan-óng, Chú it-tēng koan-hoâi!
Nā m̄-sī Chú ê chí-ì, lâng kiám ōe-tàng ū sím-mi̍h sêng-chiū?
Chai-hō á-sī chiok-hok, kiám m̄-sī lóng chhut tī Chì-koân-chiá ê bēng-lēng?
Lâng in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe siū hêng-hoa̍t, ū sím-mi̍h thang bâi-oàn?
Lán tio̍h hoán-séng kiám-thó ka-kī ê hêng-ûi, oa̍t-tńg kui-ǹg Siōng Chú.
Lán tio̍h ǹg thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè, sêng-sim gia̍h-chhiú kî-tó.
Goán hoān-chōe pōe-ge̍k, lí bô sià-bián goán.
Lí hoat tōa siū-khì, tui-jip goán; lí hē-chhiú châu-bia̍t goán, lóng bô liû-chêng.
Lí bih tī ba̍t-hûn lāi-tóe, goán ê kî-tó bōe-tàng thàu kàu lí hia.
Lí hō͘ goán chiâⁿ-chòe che-tái pùn-sò, tī bān-bîn tiong siū khì-sak.
Goán só͘-ū ê tùi-te̍k lóng tōa-siaⁿ kong-kek goán.
Goán tú-tio̍h kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ kap hām-chíⁿ, keng-le̍k sí-bông kap húi-bia̍t.
Ūi-tio̍h tông-pau siū húi-bia̍t, góa ê ba̍k-sái chhin-chhiūⁿ kang-hô ti̍t-ti̍t lâu.
Góa ê ba̍k-sái ti̍t-ti̍t lâu, lâu bōe thêng,
ti̍t-kàu Siōng Chú khòaⁿ-kò͘, tùi thiⁿ lîn-bín.
Khòaⁿ-kìⁿ siâⁿ-lāi hū-lú ê cho-gū, góa ê sim hui-siông thòng-khó͘.
Te̍k-jîn bô-iân-bô-kò͘ tui-jip góa, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh lia̍h chhek-chiáu-á.
In beh hō͘ góa sí, oa̍h-oa̍h hiat-lo̍h Chhim-khiⁿ, koh ēng chio̍h-thâu that-tiâu khiⁿ-kháu.
Chúi im-kè góa ê thâu-khak; góa siūⁿ: Góa bô-miā lah!
Siōng Chú ah, góa tùi chhim-khiⁿ-tóe kiû-kiò lí ê miâ.
Lí bat thiaⁿ góa ê kî-kiû; kiû lí m̄-thang that-ba̍t hī-khang, m̄ thiaⁿ góa hoah-kiù ê siaⁿ.
Góa ho͘-kiû ê sî, lí ū óa-kūn góa, kā góa kóng: M̄-bián kiaⁿ!
Chú ah, lí bat thòe góa sin-oan, sio̍k-hôe góa ê sìⁿ-miā.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa siū úi-khut; kiû lí soan-phòaⁿ góa chèng-ti̍t bô-chōe.
Lí chai tùi-te̍k án-chóaⁿ oàn-hūn góa, tô͘-bô͘ beh hāi góa.
Siōng Chú ah, lí ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ in lóe-mē góa; chai-iáⁿ in hāi góa ê kè-bô͘.
Lí thiaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê tùi-te̍k kui-ji̍t kong-kek góa ê ōe, kap in beh hām-hāi góa ê im-bô͘.
Lí khòaⁿ, tùi chá-khí kàu àm-mî, in put-sî chhiùⁿ-koa phì-siùⁿ góa.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí chiàu in ê hêng-ûi pò-èng in.
Kiû lí hō͘ in sim ngī, kā in chiù-chó͘.
Kiû lí hoat tōa siū-khì tui-jip in, kā in tùi Siōng Chú lí ê tōe siau-bia̍t.
Ah, n̂g-kim kèng-jiân àm-tām bô kng, sûn-kim kèng-jiân sit-khì kong-chhái! Sèng-tiān ê chio̍h-thâu kèng-jiân sòaⁿ kah kui koe-lō͘.
Sek-an chun-kùi ê chú-bîn kè-ta̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ sûn-kim, hiān-chāi soah hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe sio-hûi sai-hū chòe ê chho͘-hûi.
Chhâi-lông iáu-kú hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ suh-lin, góa ê chú-bîn kèng-jiân chân-jím chhin-chhiūⁿ khòng-iá ê tô-chiáu.
Chia̍h-lin ê eⁿ-á bô lin thang suh, chhùi-ta kah chhùi-chi̍h liâm tī téng-kiuⁿ; gín-á thó chia̍h-mi̍h, liân chi̍t-sut-á to bô lâng pun hō͘ in.
Pêng-sî chia̍h san-tin-hái-bī ê lâng, hiān-chāi gō-sí tī koe-lō͘; kè-khì seng-oa̍h chhia-chhí ê lâng, hiān-chāi tī pùn-sò-tui chhē mi̍h chia̍h.
Siōng-tè chi̍t-ba̍k-nih-kú húi-bia̍t Só͘-to-má, bô ēng lâng ê chhiú; góa ê chú-bîn ê chōe, pí Só͘-to-má chū-bîn ê chōe koh-khah tāng.
Kè-khì, Sek-an ê Ná-sè-ní-lâng pí seh khah pe̍h, pí lin khah sûn; in ê seng-khu pí âng-pó-chio̍h khah âng, siⁿ-chòe súi chhin-chhiūⁿ nâ-pó-chio̍h.
Hiān-chāi, in ê bīn pí hé-thòaⁿ khah o͘, siau-sán-lo̍h-bah, sán kah chhin-chhiūⁿ chhâ; in tī lō͘--ni̍h bô lâng ōe-jīn--tit.
Hō͘ lâng thâi--sí-ê pí gō--sí-ê khah hó; gō-sí sī bô chia̍h-mi̍h, bān-bān siau-sán lâi sí.
Góa ê chú-bîn siū húi-bia̍t ê sî, liân jîn-chû ê lāu-bú to chú ka-kī ê kiáⁿ chia̍h!
Siōng Chú hoat tōa siū-khì, piàⁿ-chhut pak-lāi ê lia̍t-hé, ēng hé sio Sek-an, liân tōe-ki mā kā i sio-húi.
Sè-kan ê kun-ông kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê chū-bîn, lóng bōe-tàng siong-sìn ū tùi-te̍k ōe-tàng kong-ji̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-mn̂g.
Che lóng sī in-ūi in sian-ti ê chōe-ok kap chè-si ê chōe-gia̍t; in thâi-sí siâⁿ-lāi kong-gī chèng-ti̍t ê lâng.
In chhin-chhiūⁿ bông-jîn tī koe-lō͘ sì-kòe se̍h, kui seng-khu bak kah choân-choân huih, bô lâng káⁿ bong-tio̍h in ê saⁿ, khióng-kiaⁿ bô chheng-khì.
Lâng hoah in: Cháu! Siám-khui! Lín chiah-ê bô chheng-khì ê lâng, mài óa--lâi! In pìⁿ-chòe lān-bîn sì-kòe liû-lōng, bô chi̍t ê kok-ka khéng siu-liû in.
Siōng Chú chhin-sin kā in kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ, bô koh khòaⁿ-kò͘ in; chè-si bô siū khòaⁿ-tāng, tiúⁿ-ló bô siū chun-tiōng.
Goán khòaⁿ kah ba̍k-chiu hoe, iáu khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h kiù-chō͘ ê ǹg-bāng; goán thèng-hāu koh-chài thèng-hāu--ê, kèng-jiân sī chi̍t ê bô-la̍t kái-kiù goán ê kok-ka.
Tùi-te̍k tui-chong goán ê kha-pō͘, hāi goán m̄-káⁿ tī koe-lō͘ kiâⁿ. Goán ê ji̍t-chí móa lah! Goán ê kiat-kio̍k kàu lah!
Tui-jip goán ê lâng pí khong-tiong teh pe ê eng-chiáu khah kín; in tī soaⁿ--ni̍h tui-jip goán, tī khòng-iá bâi-ho̍k thèng-hāu goán.

Siōng Chú boah-iû soán-li̍p ê kun-ông sī goán ê sìⁿ-miā; goán bat án-ni siūⁿ: Tī i ê pó-hō͘-ē, goán ōe-tàng tī lia̍t-kok tiong seng-chûn. M̄-kú i lo̍h tī hām-khiⁿ hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì.
Í-tong -lâng, O͘-su ê chū-bîn ah, chhut-chāi lín hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k! Khó͘-poe mā ōe lûn kàu lín lim; lín beh lim kah chiú-chùi, chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé.
Sek-an ah, lí chōe-kò ê hêng-hoa̍t í-keng móa, Siōng Chú bōe koh hō͘ lí siū hòng-tio̍k. Í-tong ah, Siōng Chú beh hêng-hoa̍t lí, beh po̍k-lō͘ lí ê chōe-ok.
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí ōe-kì-tit goán ê cho-gū, àⁿ-lo̍h khòaⁿ goán só͘ siū ê lêng-jio̍k.
Goán ê sán-gia̍p lo̍h tī siⁿ-hūn-lâng ê chhiú-tiong; goán ê chhù-the̍h hō͘ gōa-cho̍k-lâng the̍h--khì.
Goán chiâⁿ-chòe bô pē ê ko͘-jî; goán ê lāu-bú chhin-chhiūⁿ kóaⁿ-hū.
Goán liân lim ka-kī ê chúi mā tio̍h hù-chîⁿ, liân ka-kī beh hiâⁿ ê chhâ mā tio̍h bóe.
Goán chhin-chhiūⁿ ām-kún kòa taⁿ ê gû hō͘ lâng kóaⁿ, lô-lo̍k ià-siān, bô thang hioh-khùn.
Goán tio̍h ǹg Ai-ki̍p kap A-su̍t tâu-hâng, chiah chia̍h ōe pá.
Goán ê chó͘-sian hoān-chōe; taⁿ in mā í-keng bô tī--teh lah, m̄-kú goán soah in-ūi in ê chōe siū-khó͘.
Chòe lô͘-châi ê lâng koán-hat goán, mā bô lâng kiù goán thoat-lī in ê chhiú.
Khòng-iá ū kiông-tō, goán tio̍h mō͘ sìⁿ-miā ê gûi-hiám chhē-chia̍h.
Goán in-ūi iau-gō hoat-jia̍t, phê-hu o͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-lô͘.
Hū-jîn-lâng tī Sek-an siū kiông-pō, siàu-lú tī Iû-tāi ê siâⁿ-tìn siū lêng-jio̍k.
Goán ê léng-siù hō͘ lâng tiàu--khí-lâi; lāu-lâng bô siū chun-tiōng.
Siàu-liân-lâng siū-pek oe chio̍h-bō; gín-á in-ūi phāiⁿ chhâ poa̍h-tó.
Lāu-lâng bô koh tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu chū-chi̍p; siàu-liân-lâng bô koh tôaⁿ-khîm chok-ga̍k.
Goán ê sim bô koh ū hí-lo̍k; thiàu-bú pìⁿ-chòe ai-khàu.
Goán ê ông-koan tùi thâu-khak lak--lo̍h-lâi; goán hoān-chōe, goán ū chai-hō lah.
Goán in-ūi chiah-ê sū sim-hoân-ì-loān; ba̍k-sái hō͘ goán ê ba̍k-chiu bông-bū.
Sek-an-soaⁿ í-keng pha-hng, chhâi-lông tī hia lōa-lōa-sô.
Siōng Chú, lí éng-oán chûn-chāi; lí ê thóng-tī ti̍t-kàu bān sè-tāi.
Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ it-ti̍t bōe-kì-tit goán? Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ tn̂g-kî khì-sak goán?
Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí hō͘ goán hôe-sim-tńg-ì, hō͘ goán oa̍t-thâu kui-ǹg lí. Kiû lí ōaⁿ-sin goán ê sìⁿ-miā, chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-sî ê ji̍t-chí!
Lí ná thang éng-oán siū-khì goán? Lí ná thang éng-oán khì-sak goán?

Tē-saⁿ-cha̍p nî sì-ge̍h chhoe-gō͘, góa kap siū hòng-tio̍k kàu Pa-pí-lûn ê Iû-thài -lâng chòe-hé tòa tī Ka-pa-ló͘ hô-piⁿ. Hit-sî thiⁿ phah-khui, góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè ê īⁿ-siōng.
Chit-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng tī Iok-ngá-kun -ông siū-lia̍h khì Pa-pí-lûn í-āu tē-gō͘ nî.
Tī Pa-pí-lûn ê Ka-pa-ló͘ hô-piⁿ, Siōng Chú tùi Pò͘-se ê kiáⁿ chè-si Í-se-kiat kóng-ōe; Siōng Chú siúⁿ-sù i khùi-la̍t.

Góa teh koan-khòaⁿ ê sî, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ tōa-hong tùi pak-pêng sàu--kè-lâi; ū chi̍t tōa-phìⁿ hûn koh ū siám-sih ê hé, hûn ê sì-chiu-ûi kng-iàⁿ-iàⁿ, tùi hit tiong-kan hoat-chhut ê hé chhin-chhiūⁿ ōe sih ê kim-sio̍k hiah-ni̍h kng.
Tī tiong-ng ū chhut-hiān sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h: In ê hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng,
ta̍k-ê lóng ū sì ê bīn, sì ki si̍t;
in ê kha ti̍t-ti̍t, kha-tôe chhin-chhiūⁿ gû ê tôe, kng-iàⁿ-iàⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ bôa-kng ê tâng,
tī ta̍k-ki si̍t-kó͘ ē-bīn ū lâng ê chhiú. Sì ê bīn, sì ki si̍t sī án-ni:
In ê si̍t lóng saⁿ liân-chiap; hêng-tōng ê sî m̄-bián tńg-sin, lóng ōe-tàng tùi ta̍k-pêng ti̍t-kiâⁿ.
Sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h kok ū sì khoán bīn: Thâu-chêng ê bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng, chiàⁿ-pêng ê bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ sai, tò-pêng ê bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ gû, āu-bīn ê bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ eng.
In ê si̍t ǹg téng-bīn thí-khui, ta̍k-ê oa̍h-mi̍h ê nn̄g ki si̍t kap nn̄g pêng ê oa̍h-mi̍h ê si̍t sio-chiap, lēng-gōa nn̄g ki si̍t jia-khàm ka-kī ê seng-khu.
Ta̍k-ê oa̍h-mi̍h ê bīn hiòng-chêng, chiàu sim-ì chòe-hé hêng-tōng, ti̍t-kiâⁿ m̄-bián tńg-oat.

Chiah-ê oa̍h-mi̍h ê hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ teh to̍h ê hé-thòaⁿ, mā chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-pé, hé-iām put-toān tī oa̍h-mi̍h tiong-ng lâi-hôe sóa-ūi tín-tāng; hé chin kng, tùi hé ê tiong-kan hoat-chhut sih-nà.
Chiah-ê oa̍h-mi̍h chêng-āu chông-lâi-chông-khì, sok-tō͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ sih-nà hiah-ni̍h kín.
Góa teh koan-khòaⁿ chiah-ê oa̍h-mi̍h ê sî, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ múi chi̍t ê ū sì ê bīn ê oa̍h-mi̍h piⁿ--á lóng ū chi̍t ê lián-á tī thô͘-kha.
Sì ê lián-á lāi-gōa ê hêng-chōng lóng kâng-khoán, ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ múi chi̍t ê lián-á lāi-bīn koh ū chi̍t ê lián-á; lián-á lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ pó-chio̍h hoat-kng.
Chit sì ê lián-á tín-tāng ê sî, lóng ōe-tàng ǹg ta̍k-pêng ti̍t-kiâⁿ, m̄-bián tńg-oat.
Sì ê lián-á ê lián-kheng, koân koh hō͘ lâng kiaⁿ-ùi; kheng ê gōa-piáu lóng sī ba̍k-chiu.
Chiah-ê oa̍h-mi̍h hêng-tōng ê sî, sì ê lián-á tè tī piⁿ--á tńg-se̍h; oa̍h-mi̍h lī-khui tōe-bīn, lián-á mā lī-khui tōe-bīn.
Oa̍h-mi̍h ê sim-ì beh khì tó-ūi, lián-á chiū khì tó-ūi, in-ūi oa̍h-mi̍h ê sim-ì khòng-chè lián-á.

Tng oa̍h-mi̍h hêng-tōng, lián-á mā hêng-tōng; oa̍h-mi̍h thêng--teh, lián-á mā thêng--teh; oa̍h-mi̍h tùi tōe-bīn seng-koân, lián-á mā tùi tōe-bīn seng-koân, in-ūi oa̍h-mi̍h ê sim-ì khòng-chè lián-á.
Chiah-ê oa̍h-mi̍h ê thâu-khak téng ū kiong-chhong ê hêng-chōng, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh hoat-kng, hiáⁿ-ba̍k ê chúi-chiⁿ tī in ê thâu-khak téng tián-khui.
Tī kiong-chhong ē-bīn, in ê si̍t ti̍t-ti̍t thí-khui, kap piⁿ--á ê oa̍h-mi̍h ê si̍t saⁿ liân-chiap, múi chi̍t ê oa̍h-mi̍h ēng nn̄g ki si̍t jia-khàm ka-kī ê seng-khu.

Oa̍h-mi̍h hêng-tōng ê sî, góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ in ê si̍t hoat-chhut siaⁿ, siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi hōa-hōa-háu, mā chhin-chhiūⁿ kun-tūi teh chō siaⁿ-sè, koh chhin-chhiūⁿ Choân-lêng Siōng-tè ê siaⁿ. In thêng-chí, khiā--teh ê sî, si̍t chiū sûi--lo̍h-lâi.
M̄-kú oa̍h-mi̍h thêng--teh, si̍t sûi--lo̍h-khì ê sî, iû-goân ū siaⁿ-im tùi in thâu-khak téng ê kiong-chhong thoân--chhut-lâi.
Tī oa̍h-mi̍h thâu-khak téng ê kiong-chhong téng-bīn, ū chi̍t ê hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng nâ-pó-chio̍h chō ê pó-chō; chē tī pó-chō téng--ê, hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng.
Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ i ê io téng-koân chhin-chhiūⁿ ōe sih ê kim-sio̍k hiah-ni̍h kng, sì-chiu-ûi chhin-chhiūⁿ teh to̍h ê hé; i ê io í-hā chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh to̍h, sì-bīn hoat-chhut kng.

Chiu-ûi ê kong-hui chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍h-hō͘ ê sî hûn-tiong ê khēng kâng-khoán. Che chiū-sī Siōng Chú hián-hiān ê sî êng-kng ê hêng-chōng. Góa chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chit-ê kéng-siōng, chiū phak tī thô͘-kha. Góa koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ ū lâng teh kóng-ōe ê siaⁿ.
Siōng-tè tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, khiā--khí-lâi! Góa ū ōe beh kā lí kóng.”
I kóng-ōe ê sî, Siōng-tè ê sîn chìn-ji̍p góa ê lāi-bīn, hō͘ góa khiā--khí-lâi. Góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ I kā góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, góa beh phài lí khì Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chiū-sī pōe-ge̍k góa ê kok-bîn hia. In kap in ê chó͘-sian pōe-ge̍k góa, hiān-chāi iáu-teh pōe-poān góa.
Chiah-ê chú-bîn bīn-phê kāu, sim ngī, góa phài lí khì in hia, thoân-ta̍t góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú beh kā in kóng ê ōe.
Put-koán chiah-ê pōe-ge̍k ê lâng beh thiaⁿ á-sī m̄ thiaⁿ, in eng-kai chai ū chi̍t ê sian-ti tī in tiong-kan.

“Jîn-chú, m̄-bián kiaⁿ in, mā m̄-bián in-ūi in kóng ê ōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. Sui-jiân in ōe hoán-khòng, khòaⁿ bōe khí lí, hō͘ lí chhin-chhiūⁿ siū chháu-chhì kap chi̍t-lê pau-ûi, koh chhin-chhiūⁿ tiàm tī giat-á-thâng tiong-kan, lí m̄-bián kiaⁿ in kóng ê ōe, mā m̄-bián in-ūi in ê bīn-sek tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Put-koán in beh thiaⁿ á-sī m̄ thiaⁿ, lí tio̍h chiong góa ê ōe kā in kóng, in-ūi in sī pōe-ge̍k ê lâng.
“Jîn-chú, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa kā lí kóng ê ōe; m̄-thang kap hiah-ê pōe-ge̍k ê lâng siâng-khoán pōe-poān góa. Khui lí ê chhùi, chiong góa beh hō͘ lí ê mi̍h chia̍h--lo̍h-khì.”
Khòaⁿ leh, góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ki chhiú chhun kè-lâi góa chia, chhiú-lāi ū chi̍t kńg chheh-kǹg.
I tī góa ê bīn-chêng thí-khui hit-kńg chheh-kǹg; góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chheh ê siang-bīn lóng ū siá-jī, lāi-bīn siá--ê sī ai-ko, thó͘-khùi, kap chai-hō ê ōe.
Siōng-tè tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú, chiong góa hō͘ lí chit-kńg chheh-kǹg chia̍h--lo̍h-khì, jiân-āu khì tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-káng.”
Só͘-í góa chhùi peh-khui, I chiū chiong hit-kńg chheh hō͘ góa chia̍h.
I koh kóng, “Jîn-chú, tio̍h chia̍h góa hō͘ lí ê chheh-kǹg, hō͘ lí ê pak-tó͘ pá-tīⁿ.” Góa chiū chia̍h; chheh tī góa ê chhùi-lāi kam-tiⁿ ná bi̍t.
Siōng-tè kā góa kóng, “Jîn-chú, khì Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hia, chiong góa ê ōe kā in kóng.
Góa m̄-sī phài lí khì gú-giân oh-tit lí-kái ê bîn-cho̍k hia, sī phài lí khì Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan.
Góa m̄-sī phài lí khì gú-giân bōe thong, kóng sím-mi̍h lí lóng thiaⁿ bô ê bîn-cho̍k hia; góa nā phài lí khì in tiong-kan, in ōe thiaⁿ lí ê ōe.
M̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn m̄-khéng thiaⁿ lí ê ōe, in-ūi in liân góa ê ōe to m̄ thiaⁿ. Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn kò͘-chip, sim-koaⁿ ngī.
Góa beh hō͘ lí ì-chì kian-tēng ōe-tàng kap in tùi-khòng.

Góa beh hō͘ lí ê ì-chì chhin-chhiūⁿ soān-chio̍h, pí hé-chio̍h koh-khah kian-tēng. Sui-jiân in sī pōe-ge̍k ê chú-bîn, lí m̄-bián kiaⁿ in, mā m̄-bián in-ūi in ê bīn-sek tio̍h-kiaⁿ.”
Siōng-tè koh tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú, góa kóng ê ōe, lí tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ, mā tio̍h khǹg tī sim-lāi.
Lí tio̍h khì liû-bông ê tông-pau hia, put-koán in beh thiaⁿ á-sī m̄ thiaⁿ, tio̍h thoân-ta̍t góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú beh kā in kóng ê ōe.”

Hit-sî, Siōng-tè ê sîn kā góa giâ--khí-lâi, góa chiū thiaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê āu-bīn ū hōng-hōng-kiò ê siaⁿ, kóng, “Tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú tùi I hia só͘ hián-chhut ê êng-iāu!”
Góa koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chiah-ê oa̍h-mi̍h tī khong-tiong teh pe, si̍t-á sio-kha̍p ê siaⁿ, mā thiaⁿ-kìⁿ in ê lián-á tńg-se̍h só͘ hoat-chhut chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa tōe-tāng ê siaⁿ.
Siōng-tè ê sîn kā góa giâ--khí-lâi, chhōa góa kiâⁿ, góa ê sim kan-khó͘ koh siū-khì, Siōng Chú ê tōa khùi-la̍t kā góa chhi̍h--teh.
Án-ni, góa lâi kàu Ka-pa-ló͘ hô-piⁿ ê Thê-le̍k A-pit, chiū-sī liû-bông ê tông-pau tòa ê só͘-chāi. Góa ut-chut gāng-gāng tī in tiong-kan tòa chhit ji̍t.
Chhit ji̍t āu, Siōng Chú kā góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, taⁿ góa chí-phài lí chòe Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ê siú-bōng-chiá. Lí tio̍h chiong góa kā lí kóng kéng-kò ê ōe kā in kóng.

Nā-sī góa soan-pò͘ bó͘ chi̍t ê siâ-ok ê lâng it-tēng tio̍h sí, lí bô khì kā kéng-kò, khǹg i kái-siâ-kui-chèng, hō͘ i thang kiù ka-kī, chit-ê lâng sui-jiân ōe in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe sí, m̄-kú góa beh tùi lí tui-kiù i sí ê chek-jīm.
Lí nā ū kéng-kò hit-ê lâng m̄-thang kè-sio̍k choh-pháiⁿ, m̄-kú i bô beh kái-siâ-kui-chèng, i ōe in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe sí; i ê sí, lí m̄-bián hū chek-jīm.

“Nā-sī gī-lâng lī-khui chiàⁿ-lō͘ khì choh-pháiⁿ, góa beh hō͘ i poa̍h-tó, hō͘ i sí. Lí nā bô kéng-kò i, i it-tēng ōe sí. I beh in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe sí, góa bô beh kì-liām i só͘ chòe ê hó-sū, mā beh tùi lí tui-kiù chek-jīm.
M̄-kú lí nā ū kéng-kò i m̄-thang hoān-chōe, i mā bô koh hoān-chōe, i beh in-ūi chiap-siū kéng-kò lâi oa̍h, lí mā beh kiù ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.”
Siōng Chú ê khùi-la̍t chhiong-móa góa; I kā góa kóng, “Khí--lâi, khì soaⁿ-kok hia, góa beh tī hia tùi lí kóng-ōe.”
Góa chiū khí--lâi, khì soaⁿ-kok, tī hia khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê êng-kng, kap góa tī Ka-pa-ló͘ hô-piⁿ só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê siâng-khoán. Góa chiū phak lo̍h-khì thô͘-kha;
Siōng-tè ê sîn chìn-ji̍p góa lāi-bīn, hō͘ góa khiā--khí-lâi. Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Tńg--khì, kā ka-kī koaiⁿ tī chhù-lāi.
Jîn-chú ah, lâng beh ēng soh-á kā lí pa̍k--khí-lâi, hō͘ lí bōe-tàng chhut-khì gōa-bīn kìⁿ lâng.
Góa beh hō͘ lí é-káu bōe kóng-ōe, hō͘ lí bô hoat-tō͘ kéng-kò hiah-ê pōe-ge̍k ê jîn-bîn.

M̄-kú, góa ōe koh tùi lí kóng-ōe, hit-sî, góa ōe khui lí ê chhùi, lí tio̍h thoân-ta̍t góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú beh kā in kóng ê ōe. Lâng nā beh thiaⁿ, hō͘ in thiaⁿ; lâng nā m̄ thiaⁿ, kù-chāi in, in-ūi in sī pōe-ge̍k ê jîn-bîn.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h the̍h chi̍t tè chng-á khǹg tī lí ê bīn-chêng, téng-bīn ōe chi̍t chō siâⁿ tāi-piáu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng,
koh tī siâⁿ sì-chiu-ûi khí koân-thah, chō thô͘-tui, chat-iâⁿ, an lòng-siâⁿ ê thûi.

Jiân-āu, the̍h chi̍t tè thih-pang chhāi tī lí kap siâⁿ ê tiong-kan chòe siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ. Lí tio̍h biān-tùi chit-chō siâⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ lí teh ûi-kong siâⁿ. Che sī góa hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiāu-thâu.
“Lí tio̍h tó tò-pêng lâi taⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chōe-kò ê hêng-hoa̍t. Lí tó kúi ji̍t, tāi-piáu in sêng-siū hêng-hoa̍t jōa kú.
Góa í-keng koat-tēng lí tó ê ji̍t-sò͘, tāi-piáu in pōe-ge̍k ê nî ê sò͘-bo̍k, lí tio̍h tó saⁿ-pah káu-cha̍p ji̍t, taⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -kok chōe-kò ê hêng-hoa̍t.
Chit-ê sū liáu-āu, lí tio̍h koh tó chiàⁿ-pêng sì-cha̍p ji̍t, taⁿ Iû-tāi -kok chōe-kò ê hêng-hoa̍t. Chi̍t ji̍t tú chi̍t nî.
“Lí tio̍h bīn ǹg siū ûi-khùn ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -siâⁿ, lō͘-chhut chhiú-kut, kóng ū-giân kong-kek i.
Góa beh kā lí pa̍k--khí-lâi, hō͘ lí bōe-tàng hoan-sin péng-pêng, ti̍t-kàu ûi siâⁿ ê ji̍t-chí móa.

“Liáu-āu, lí tio̍h the̍h chi̍t-kóa sió-be̍h, tōa-be̍h, tāu-á, píⁿ-tāu, sóe-á, chho͘-be̍h, khǹg tī óaⁿ--ni̍h choh-piáⁿ, che chiū-sī lí ǹg tò-pêng tó--ê hit saⁿ-pah káu-cha̍p ji̍t ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Lí múi-ji̍t chia̍h ê liōng sī nn̄g-pah saⁿ-cha̍p kong-khek, ta̍k-ji̍t chiàu-sî chia̍h.
Lí múi-ji̍t lim ê chúi sī pòaⁿ kong-seng, ta̍k-ji̍t chiàu-sî lim.
Lí tio̍h tī bîn-chiòng bīn-chêng, ēng lâng ê pùn chòe hé-chhâ hang-piáⁿ lâi chia̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chia̍h tōa-be̍h-piáⁿ.”
Siōng Chú koh kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hō͘ góa kóaⁿ-tio̍k liû-bông tī gōa-kok ê sî, in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni chia̍h lu̍t-hoat só͘ kìm-chí bô chheng-khì ê chia̍h-mi̍h.”

M̄-kú góa ìn kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, góa chêng-kàu-taⁿ m̄-bat ûi-pōe chheng-khì ê tiâu-lē, tùi sòe-hàn chiū bô chia̍h chū-jiân sí--ê, á-sī hō͘ iá-siù thiah-li̍h ê tōng-bu̍t. Góa m̄-bat chia̍h lé-gî-siōng bô chheng-khì ê chia̍h-mi̍h.”
Siōng-tè kā góa kóng, “Án-ni hó, lí thang ēng gû-pùn tāi-thòe lâng ê pùn chòe hé-chhâ hang lí ê piáⁿ.”
I koh kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, góa beh toān-choa̍t Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê niû-si̍t. In beh sim chûn khòa-lū chia̍h phòe-kip ê piáⁿ, tòa kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ lim siū hān-liōng ê chúi.
In ê niû-si̍t bô-kàu thang chia̍h, chúi bô-kàu thang lim; in beh choa̍t-bāng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe-ok soe-lám lâi sí.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h the̍h chi̍t ki lāi-kiàm chòe thì-thâu-to, thì lí ê thâu-mn̂g, khau lí ê chhùi-chhiu, ēng thian-phêng kā in chhìn, pîⁿ-pun chòe saⁿ hūn.

Siâⁿ siū ûi-khùn ê ji̍t-chí móa liáu-āu, lí tio̍h the̍h saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t ê chhùi-chhiu kap thâu-mn̂g tī siâⁿ-lāi sio; the̍h lēng-gōa saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t khì siâⁿ-gōa, kā in tok hō͘ iù-iù; koh the̍h chhun ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t iā tī khong-tiong, hō͘ hong chhe-sòaⁿ, góa mā beh pu̍ih kiàm tui-kóaⁿ in.
Lí tio̍h lâu kúi ki mn̂g, ēng lí ê saⁿ-á-ku pau--teh,
jiân-āu koh the̍h kúi ki mn̂g chhut--lâi, hiat tī hé--ni̍h sio. Hé beh tùi hia sio, thòaⁿ kàu Í-sek-lia̍t choân-kok.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng, “Che chiū-sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng! Góa kā i hē tī bān-kok ê tiong-sim, hō͘ lia̍t-kok tī i ê sì-chiu-ûi.
M̄-kú i ûi-pōe góa ê bēng-lēng kap kui-lē, pí lia̍t-kok koh-khah siâ-ok, pí i chiu-ûi ê kok-ka koh-khah pōe-ge̍k. I bô siú góa ê bēng-lēng, khì-sak góa ê kui-lē.

Só͘-í, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng! Tio̍h thiaⁿ góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú só͘ kóng ê ōe. Lí bô siú góa ê kui-lē, khì-sak góa ê bēng-lēng, liân sì-chiu-ûi lia̍t-kok ê kui-kú mā bô chun-siú.
In-ūi án-ni, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú soan-pò͘, góa beh kap lí choh tùi-te̍k; góa beh tī lia̍t-kok ê bīn-chêng sím-phòaⁿ lí.
In-ūi lí chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, góa beh hêng-hoa̍t lí. Góa chêng-kàu-taⁿ m̄-bat án-ni kā lí hêng-hoa̍t, í-āu mā bōe koh án-ni hêng-hoa̍t lí.

Tī lí kéng-lāi, pē-bú beh chia̍h in ê kiáⁿ-jî, kiáⁿ-jî mā beh chia̍h in ê pē-bú. Góa beh kā lí hêng-hoa̍t, beh kā Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ chhun ê jîn-bîn lóng liû-hòng khì ta̍k só͘-chāi.

“Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ēng ka-kī ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè: Lí kì-jiân chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ, thang thòng-hūn ê sū lâi phah lâ-sâm góa ê sèng-tiān, góa beh kā lí siau-bia̍t, bô beh tông-chêng, bô beh thiàⁿ-sioh.

Í-sek-lia̍t ê jîn-bîn saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t beh in-ūi un-e̍k, á-sī ki-hng sí; lēng-gōa saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t beh tī siâⁿ-gōa sì-ûi hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí; chhun ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t góa beh hō͘ in lóng sì-sòaⁿ khì ta̍k só͘-chāi, mā beh pu̍ih kiàm tui-kóaⁿ in.
“Án-ni, góa ê siū-khì chiah ōe siau, góa tùi in ê tōa siū-khì chiah ōe soah. In chiū chai góa Siōng Chú chhut tī kek-tōng jia̍t-chhiat kóng chiah-ê ōe.
Góa beh hō͘ lí tú-tio̍h kiàn-siàu, hō͘ lí pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘, sì-chiu-ûi lia̍t-kok tùi chia keng-kè ê lâng lóng beh thí-chhiò lí.

“Góa hoat tōa siū-khì, tāng-tāng hêng-hoa̍t lí ê sî, lí beh tī sì-chiu-ûi ê lia̍t-kok tiong siū lêng-jio̍k, thí-chhiò; in mā beh in-ūi lí só͘ siū ê hêng-hoa̍t tio̍h-kiaⁿ, siū kéng-kài. Góa Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Góa ǹg chù-tiāⁿ bia̍t-bông ê lâng siā-chhut ki-hng húi-bia̍t ê chìⁿ ê sî, góa beh hō͘ ki-hng koh-khah giâm-tiōng, beh toān-choa̍t lín ê niû-si̍t.
Góa beh hō͘ lín tú-tio̍h ki-hng, siū iá-siù chhim-hoān, lín ōe sit-khì kiáⁿ-jî, mā ōe tú-tio̍h un-e̍k, pō-le̍k, kap chiàn-cheng.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú kā góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, tio̍h bīn ǹg Í-sek-lia̍t ê chèng-soaⁿ, thoân-ta̍t góa ê sìn-sit, kóng,

‘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê chèng-soaⁿ ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ Chì-koân Siōng Chú ê ōe. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú tùi tōa-soaⁿ, sió-soaⁿ, soaⁿ-kau, soaⁿ-kok án-ni kóng: Góa beh ēng to-kiàm húi-bia̍t lín ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ.
Chè-tôaⁿ beh siū thiah-húi, hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ siū phah-chhùi, siū thâi-sí ê lâng beh tó tī lín ê ngó͘-siōng ê thâu-chêng.
Góa beh kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê sin-si hiat tī in ê ngó͘-siōng ê thâu-chêng, chiong lín ê kut-hâi iā-sòaⁿ tī lín ê chè-tôaⁿ sì-chiu-ûi.

Bô-lūn lín tòa tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, lín ê siâⁿ-tìn lóng beh pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘, soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ pha-hng tì-kàu chè-tôaⁿ hong-hòe, ngó͘-siōng siū phah-chhùi húi-bia̍t, hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ siū chám-tn̄g. Lín só͘ chō ê it-chhè lóng beh siū tû-bia̍t.
Siū thâi ê lâng tó tī lín tiong-kan, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
“‘Góa beh kā lín lâu chi̍t-kóa lâng, hō͘ in tô-thoat lia̍t-kok ê to-kiàm, hun-sòaⁿ khì ta̍k só͘-chāi.

Hit-sî, hiah-ê thoat-lī to-kiàm ê lâng, tī siū hòng-tio̍k ê só͘-chāi beh siūⁿ-khí góa, liáu-kái góa in-ūi in ê put-tiong, pōe-ge̍k, í-ki̍p sim-ba̍k loân-bō͘ ngó͘-siōng lâi sim kan-khó͘. In ōe in-ūi ka-kī só͘ chòe siâ-ok ê pháiⁿ-sū iàm-ò͘ⁿ ka-kī.
In beh bêng-pe̍k góa sī Siōng Chú, góa kóng beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ in, m̄-sī kóng ké--ê.’”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Lí tio̍h chàm-kha tǹg-chhiú, kóng, ‘Chhám lah, Í-sek-lia̍t in-ūi chòe siâ-ok kap chòe hō͘ lâng iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, beh sí tī chiàn-cheng, iau-gō, kap un-e̍k.’

Tī hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi ê lâng beh in-ūi un-e̍k lâi sí; tī hù-kūn ê lâng beh in-ūi chiàn-loān lâi sí; lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng beh in-ūi ki-hng lâi sí. Góa beh tī in sin-chiūⁿ piàⁿ-chīn góa ê tōa siū-khì.

“In siū thâi ê lâng ê sin-si beh sì-sòaⁿ tī in ê ngó͘-siōng tiong-kan, tī in ê chè-tôaⁿ sì-chiu-ûi, tī múi chi̍t chō tōa-soaⁿ, sió-soaⁿ ê téng-bīn, tī múi chi̍t châng chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū kap bō͘-sēng ê siōng-chhiū kha, chiū-sī in bat ǹg ngó͘-siōng hiàn phang-phang ê chè ê só͘-chāi. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.

Góa it-tēng beh chhut-chhiú kong-kek in. Góa beh hō͘ in ê tōe hong-hòe, tùi lâm-hng ê khòng-iá it-ti̍t kàu pak-hng ê Tē-pek-la -siâⁿ; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi lóng beh pha-hng. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, che chiū-sī góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú beh tùi Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn soan-pò͘ ê ōe: Chiong-kio̍k kàu lah, Í-sek-lia̍t -kok sù-kéng ê chiong-kio̍k kūn lah!

“ Í-sek-lia̍t ah! Lí ê chiong-kio̍k kàu lah. Góa beh tùi lí hoat tōa siū-khì. Góa beh chiàu lí ê hêng-ûi sím-phòaⁿ lí, beh in-ūi lí só͘ chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū hêng-hoa̍t lí.

Góa bô beh lîn-bín lí, bô beh tông-chêng lí. Góa beh chiàu lí ê hêng-ûi pò-èng lí, chiàu lí só͘ chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū hêng-hoa̍t lí. Án-ni, lí chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, chai-lān ōe chi̍t-ê chiap chi̍t-ê lîm-kàu.
Lí ê chiong-kio̍k kūn lah! Lí ê chiong-kio̍k kàu lah! Khòaⁿ leh, lí bōe cháu-siám--tit lah!
Kok-lāi ê chū-bîn, chai-lān lîm-kàu lah. Sî kàu lah, ji̍t-chí pek-kūn lah! Soaⁿ-téng ê chè-tôaⁿ beh ū hūn-loān, bô koh ū hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k ê siaⁿ.

“Góa chin kín chiū beh chiong góa ê tōa siū-khì piàⁿ tī lí sin-chiūⁿ, chiong góa ê siū-khì lóng piàⁿ hō͘ lí. Góa beh chiàu lí ê hêng-ûi sím-phòaⁿ lí, beh in-ūi lí só͘ chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū hêng-hoa̍t lí.

Góa bô beh lîn-bín lí, bô beh tông-chêng lí. Góa beh chiàu lí ê hêng-ûi pò-èng lí, chiàu lí só͘ chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū hêng-hoa̍t lí. Án-ni, lí chiū chai kā lí hêng-hoa̍t--ê sī góa Siōng Chú.
“Khòaⁿ leh, hit-ji̍t lâi lah, chai-lān í-keng kàu lah; kiau-ngō͘ í-keng puh-gê, koáiⁿ-á í-keng khui-hoe.
Kiông-pō heng-khí, pìⁿ-chòe hêng-hoa̍t pháiⁿ-lâng ê koáiⁿ-á. In só͘-ū--ê lóng beh bô--khì, châi-hù, chun-kùi lóng beh sit--khì.
“Sî kàu lah, hit-ji̍t kūn lah, bóe ê lâng m̄-bián hoaⁿ-hí, bōe ê lâng m̄-bián siong-sim, in-ūi Siōng Chú ê tōa siū-khì beh kàng-lo̍h tī in chèng-lâng sin-chiūⁿ.

Bô chi̍t ê bōe-chú ōe-tàng oa̍h kàu kā i bōe--chhut-khì--ê bóe--tńg-lâi, in-ūi Siōng Chú koan-hē chit-ê jîn-bîn ê īⁿ-siōng it-tēng bōe hòe-chí. Bô lâng ōe-tàng tī ka-kī ê chōe-ok tiong pó-choân sìⁿ-miā.
In pûn sàu-kak, kun-khì chún-pī hó-sè, m̄-kú bô lâng chiūⁿ chiàn-tiûⁿ kau-chiàn, in-ūi góa ê tōa siū-khì beh kàng-lo̍h tī chèng-lâng ê sin-chiūⁿ.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Siâⁿ-gōa ū chiàn-cheng, siâⁿ-lāi ū un-e̍k, ki-hng. Tī chhân-iá ê lâng lóng beh sí tī to-ē; siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng lóng beh pīⁿ-sí, gō-sí.
In tiong-kan nā ū lâng tô-thoat, ōe tī soaⁿ-téng ūi ka-kī ê chōe, chhin-chhiūⁿ soaⁿ-kok tiong ê hún-chiáu ai-oàn thó͘-khùi.
In ta̍k-ê lâng ê chhiú lóng bô-la̍t, kiaⁿ kah kha-sng-chhiú-nńg.
In beh chhēng môa-saⁿ, kui-ê lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah; ta̍k-ê lâng lóng thì kng-thâu, kiàn-siàu bô bīn-chú.

In beh chiong kim gûn hiat tī koe-lō͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ tàn pùn-sò kâng-khoán. Tī Siōng Chú hoat tōa siū-khì ê ji̍t, kim-gûn bô hoat-tō͘ kái-kiù in, in-ūi kim-gûn bōe-tàng boán-chiok in ê io̍k-bōng, bōe-tàng hō͘ pak-tó͘ chia̍h-pá, tian-tò hō͘ in poa̍h-tó hoān-chōe.
In bat khoa-kháu in súi ê chu-pó, koh ēng hiah-ê chu-pó chù-chō thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng. Só͘-í, Siōng Chú beh hō͘ in khòaⁿ ka-kī ê chu-pó chòe ù-òe ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ.
“Góa beh hō͘ gōa-cho̍k-lâng kā i chhiúⁿ-toa̍t, kiò húi-tô͘ kā i chhiúⁿ-kiap; in beh kā i phah lâ-sâm.
Góa beh bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ chhap Í-sek-lia̍t, chhut-chāi góa sèng ê só͘-chāi siū siat-to̍k, hō͘ kiông-tō ji̍p-khì siat-to̍k.
“Liān-á tio̍h chún-pī hó-sè! In-ūi ta̍k só͘-chāi lóng ū thâi-lâng lâu-huih ê sū, ta̍k hiong-tìn chhiong-móa kiông-pō.
Góa beh hō͘ siōng hiong-ok ê bîn-cho̍k lâi chiàm in ê chhù, hō͘ lia̍t-kok siat-to̍k in kèng-pài ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ kiông-pō ê lâng bōe koh chhàng-chhiu.
Chai-hō kàu lah! In teh kiû pêng-an, m̄-kú bô pêng-an.

Chai-lān liáu-āu koh ū chai-lān, pháiⁿ siau-sit sòa-chiap pháiⁿ siau-sit. In chhē sian-ti kiû īⁿ-siōng, m̄-kú bô lō͘-ēng; chè-si bô koh ū kàu-tō, tiúⁿ-ló mā bōe-tàng kā jîn-bîn chí-tō.

Kok-ông pi-siong, léng-siù sit-bāng, jîn-bîn kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah. Góa beh chiàu in ê hêng-ûi pān in, chiàu in phòaⁿ-toàn lâng ê hong-hoat kā in sím-phòaⁿ. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Tē-la̍k nî la̍k-ge̍h chhoe-gō͘, góa chē tī chhù-lāi, Iû-tāi ê chèng tiúⁿ-ló chē tī góa ê bīn-chêng. Chì-koân Siōng Chú ê khùi-la̍t chhiong-móa góa.
Góa koan-khòaⁿ ê sî, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ê hêng-siōng; i ê io í-hā chhin-chhiūⁿ hé, io téng-koân chhin-chhiūⁿ ōe sih ê kim-sio̍k hiah-ni̍h kng.

I chhun-chhut chi̍t ki chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ê chhiú khiú góa ê thâu-mn̂g. I ê sîn kā góa giâ-koân kàu khong-tiong; tī īⁿ-siōng tiong, I ê sîn tòa góa khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sèng-tiān lāi-tiâⁿ ê pak-mn̂g mn̂g-kháu. Tī hia ū chi̍t ê chō-ūi, téng-bīn chē jiá Siōng-tè siū-khì ê ngó͘-siōng.
Tī hia, góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê êng-kng, kap góa tī Ka-pa-ló͘ hô-piⁿ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê siâng-khoán.

Siōng-tè tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí khòaⁿ pak-pêng!” Góa chiū gia̍h-thâu ǹg pak khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chè-tôaⁿ-mn̂g ê pak-pêng, tī ji̍p-kháu ū chi̍t sian jiá Siōng-tè siū-khì ê ngó͘-siōng.

Siōng-tè koh tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī chia teh chòe sím-mi̍h? In tī chia chòe ke̍k thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê tāi-chì, pek góa lī-khui góa ê sèng-só͘ hn̄g-hn̄g. M̄-kú, lí ōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ pí che koh-khah thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.”
I chhōa góa khì gōa-tiâⁿ ê ji̍p-kháu; góa chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, chhiûⁿ-piah ū chi̍t khang.
I tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, kā chhiûⁿ-piah ó͘ thàng--kè.” Góa chi̍t-ē ó͘ thàng--kè, chiū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ū chi̍t ê mn̂g.
I kā góa kóng, “Ji̍p--khì, khòaⁿ in tī lāi-bīn só͘ chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê pháiⁿ-sū.”

Góa chiū ji̍p-khì khòaⁿ. Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sì-bīn ê chhiûⁿ-piah khek ta̍k-khoán tī thô͘-kha teh sô ê oa̍h-mi̍h kap thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê cháu-siù, mā ū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng pài ê ngó͘-siōng.
Ū chhit-cha̍p ê Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló khiā tī hiah-ê siōng ê thâu-chêng, Sa-hoan ê kiáⁿ Ngá-sat-nî-a mā tī hia. In ta̍k-ê lâng chhiú phâng hiuⁿ-lô͘, hiuⁿ ê ian chhèng-koân.

Siōng-tè tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló, in ta̍k-ê lâng àm-tiong tī chhiong-móa ngó͘-siōng ê pâng-keng teh chòe sím-mi̍h? In kóng, ‘Siōng Chú khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h goán; I í-keng khì-sak chit-tè thó͘-tōe.’”
Siōng Chú koh kā góa kóng, “Lí ōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ in chòe chin khó-ò͘ⁿ ê pháiⁿ-sū.”
