Jiân-āu, I chhōa góa khì Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê pak-mn̂g, tī hia ū chi̍t kûn hū-lú chē--teh, ūi Tah-bô͘-su sîn-bêng thî-khàu.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-bô? Lí beh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ pí che koh-khah thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê pháiⁿ-sū.”

I koh chhōa góa khì Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê lāi-tiâⁿ. Tī sèng-tiān ê mn̂g-kháu, tī chè-tôaⁿ kap cháu-lông ê tiong-kan, tāi-iok ū jī-cha̍p-gō͘ ê lâng, ka-chiah ǹg sèng-tiān, bīn ǹg tang-pêng pài ji̍t-thâu.

Siōng Chú kā góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-bô? Lí khòaⁿ, Iû-tāi -lâng tī chia só͘ chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê pháiⁿ-sū kiám sī sió-khóa? In tī choân-kok ta̍k só͘-chāi chòe kiông-pō ê sū, it-chài kek góa siū-khì. In koh gia̍h chhiū-ki tú ǹg phīⁿ-á, ēng án-ni bú-jio̍k góa.
Só͘-í, góa beh tùi in hoat tōa siū-khì; bô beh khó-lîn in, mā bô beh thiàⁿ-sioh in. Chiū-sī-kóng in tī góa ê hī-khang piⁿ tōa-siaⁿ ho͘-kiû, góa mā m̄ thiaⁿ.”
Liáu-āu, góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Lín chiah-ê hū-chek hêng-hoa̍t chit-ê siâⁿ ê lâng, lâi! Ta̍k-ê lâng tòa thâi-lâng ê bú-khì lâi!”

Sûi-sî ū la̍k ê lâng, ta̍k-ê tòa thâi-lâng ê bú-khì, tùi sèng-tiān gōa-tiâⁿ ê pak-mn̂g kè--lâi, kî-tiong ū chi̍t ê chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ chòe ê saⁿ, io ū siá-jī ê pit kap ba̍k. In chìn-chêng lâi, khiā tī tâng ê chè-tôaⁿ piⁿ.

Pún-lâi thêng tī thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek téng-bīn ê Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê êng-kng, seng-koân kàu sèng-tiān ê ji̍p-kháu. Siōng-tè kiò hit-ê chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ, io tòa pit-ba̍k ê lâng lâi.

Siōng Chú tùi i kóng, “Lí khì, kiâⁿ-thàu choân Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -siâⁿ, kā hiah-ê ūi-tio̍h siâⁿ-lāi só͘ hoat-seng thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê pháiⁿ-sū teh thó͘-khùi thî-khàu ê lâng ê thâu-hia̍h chòe kì-hō.”
Góa koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú tùi kî-tha ê lâng kóng, “Lín tio̍h tè i ê āu-bīn, kiâⁿ-thàu choân-siâⁿ, hē-chhiú thâi-lâng; m̄-bián khó-lîn, m̄-bián thiàⁿ-sioh in.

Bô-lūn sī lāu-lâng, siàu-liân-lâng, siàu-lú, hū-lú kap gín-á, lóng tio̍h thâi-sí; m̄-kú m̄-thang thâi hiah-ê thâu-hia̍h ū kì-hō ê lâng. Tùi góa ê sèng-só͘ khai-sí hē-chhiú!” Án-ni, in hē-chhiú thâi tī sèng-tiān thâu-chêng ê tiúⁿ-ló.
I tùi in kóng, “Tio̍h kā sèng-tiān ê tiâⁿ tui-móa si-thé, phah lâ-sâm sèng-tiān. Hiān-chāi chiū khai-sí!” In chiū chhut--khì, khai-sí tī siâⁿ--ni̍h thâi-lâng.

In tī siâⁿ--ni̍h teh thâi-lâng ê sî, góa chi̍t ê lâng lâu tī sèng-tiān. Góa bīn phak tī thô͘-kha ai-kiû, kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, lí chin-chiàⁿ beh chiong lí ê siū-khì piàⁿ-lo̍h tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, kā Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ chhun ê lâng lóng siau-bia̍t sī--bô?”

I ìn kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Iû-tāi -lâng chōe-tāi-ok-ke̍k. Choân-kok ta̍k só͘-chāi lóng ū thâi-lâng lâu-huih ê sū-kiāⁿ; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chhiong-móa put-gī. In kóng, ‘Siōng Chú í-keng khì-sak chit-tè thó͘-tōe, I lóng bô teh chhap goán.’
Só͘-í, góa bô beh khó-lîn, bô beh thiàⁿ-sioh in. In án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi pa̍t-lâng, góa mā beh án-ni tùi-thāi in.”
Āu-lâi, hit-ê chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ, io tòa pit-ba̍k ê lâng tńg--lâi, chiong chiah-ê sū ǹg Siōng Chú pò-kò, kóng, “Góa í-keng chiàu lí ê bēng-lēng khì chòe lah.”
Góa koan-khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ tī thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek thâu-khak téng ê kiong-chhong téng-bīn, ū chi̍t ê hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng nâ-pó-chio̍h chō ê pó-chō.

Siōng-tè tùi chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ hit-ê lâng kóng, “Lí ji̍p--khì, tùi ki-lō͘-pek ē-bīn ê lián-á ê tiong-ng, the̍h teh to̍h ê hé-thòaⁿ chhut--lâi, phóng tī siang-chhiú, iā tī choân Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -siâⁿ.” Góa khòaⁿ i ji̍p--khì.
I ji̍p--khì ê sî, ki-lō͘-pek khiā tī sèng-tiān ê lâm-pêng, ū hûn-chhái chhiong-móa lāi-tiâⁿ.

Siōng Chú ê êng-kng seng-koân lī-khui ki-lō͘-pek, thêng tī sèng-tiān ê ji̍p-kháu; ū hûn-chhái chhiong-móa sèng-tiān, Siōng Chú ê êng-kng hoat-chhut ê kong-hui chhiong-móa kui-ê tiâⁿ.
Ki-lō͘-pek ê si̍t hoat-chhut ê siaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ Choân-lêng Siōng-tè teh kóng-ōe ê siaⁿ, tī gōa-tiâⁿ mā thiaⁿ ōe tio̍h.
Siōng Chú hoan-hù chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ hit-ê lâng tùi ki-lō͘-pek ē-bīn lián-á ê tiong-ng the̍h hé; i chiū ji̍p--khì, khiā tī chi̍t ê lián-á ê piⁿ--á.

Kî-tiong chi̍t ê ki-lō͘-pek chhun-chhiú tùi ki-lō͘-pek tiong-ng the̍h chi̍t-kóa hé, hē tī chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ hit-ê lâng ê chhiú-tiong. Hit-ê lâng the̍h--tio̍h chiū chhut--khì.
Hiah-ê ki-lō͘-pek ê si̍t-kó͘ ē-bīn ū chhiú, khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ê chhiú.
Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chiah-ê ki-lō͘-pek ê piⁿ--á ū sì ê lián-á, múi chi̍t ê ki-lō͘-pek piⁿ--á lóng ū chi̍t ê lián-á; lián-á chhin-chhiūⁿ pó-chio̍h hoat-kng.
Sì ê lián-á ê gōa-hêng lóng kâng-khoán; múi chi̍t ê lián-á chhin-chhiūⁿ lāi-bīn koh ū chi̍t ê lián-á.
Chit sì ê lián-á tín-tāng ê sî, lóng ōe-tàng tùi ta̍k-pêng ti̍t-kiâⁿ, m̄-bián tńg-oat. In ǹg tó chi̍t ê hong-hiòng kiâⁿ, lóng m̄-bián tńg-oat.
Ki-lō͘-pek kui seng-khu, liân ka-chiah, chhiú, si̍t, sīm-chì múi chi̍t ê lián-á, sì-chiu-ûi lóng sī ba̍k-chiu.
Chiah-ê lián-á, chiàu góa thiaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê kiò-chòe “teh tńg ê lián-á”.
Múi chi̍t ê ki-lō͘-pek lóng ū sì khoán bīn: Tē-it ê sī gû ê bīn, tē-jī ê sī lâng ê bīn, tē-saⁿ ê sī sai ê bīn, tē-sì ê sī eng ê bīn.
Ki-lō͘-pek pe-chiūⁿ koân; chiah-ê sī góa tī Ka-pa-ló͘ hô-piⁿ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê oa̍h-mi̍h.
Ki-lō͘-pek kiâⁿ ê sî, lián-á mā tī piⁿ--á kiâⁿ. In thí-khui si̍t pe koân lī-khui tōe-bīn, lián-á mā bô tńg-se̍h lī-khui in sin-piⁿ.
Ki-lō͘-pek thêng--teh, lián-á mā thêng--teh; ki-lō͘-pek tùi tōe-bīn seng-koân, lián-á mā chòe-hé seng-koân, in-ūi oa̍h-mi̍h ê sim-ì khòng-chè lián-á.
Siōng Chú ê êng-kng lī-khui sèng-tiān ê ji̍p-kháu, thêng tī ki-lō͘-pek ê téng-bīn.

Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ki-lō͘-pek thí-si̍t pe-koân lī-khui tōe-bīn, lián-á mā tī in sin-piⁿ. In thêng tī sèng-tiān tang-mn̂g ê ji̍p-kháu, Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê êng-kng tī in téng-bīn.
Chiah-ê sī góa tī Ka-pa-ló͘ hô-piⁿ só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, tī Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ē-bīn ê oa̍h-mi̍h; góa chai in sī ki-lō͘-pek.
Múi chi̍t ê ki-lō͘-pek ū sì khoán bīn, sì ki si̍t; si̍t ē-bīn ū chhiú, khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ê chhiú.

In ê bīn ê bô͘-iūⁿ, chiū-sī in ê hêng-chōng kap khoán-sit, kap góa tī Ka-pa-ló͘ hô-piⁿ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê bīn kâng-khoán. Múi chi̍t ê ki-lō͘-pek, lóng ōe-tàng tùi ta̍k-pêng ti̍t-kiâⁿ.

Siōng-tè ê sîn kā góa giâ--khí-lâi, tòa góa kàu Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ǹg tang-pêng ê chiàⁿ-mn̂g. Góa tī mn̂g ê ji̍p-kháu khòaⁿ-kìⁿ jī-cha̍p-gō͘ ê lâng, kî-tiong ū Ap-sok ê kiáⁿ Ngá-sat-nî-a kap Pí-ná-ngá ê kiáⁿ Pí-la-thê chit nn̄g ê bîn-kan ê léng-siù.
Siōng-tè kā góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, in chiū-sī tī siâⁿ-lāi tô͘-bô͘ siâ-ok, chhut pháiⁿ chú-ì ê lâng.
In kóng, ‘Hiān-chāi iáu m̄-sī khí-chhù ê sî. Chit-chō siâⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ e-á, lán chhin-chhiūⁿ lāi-bīn ê bah.’
Só͘-í, jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h kóng, tio̍h soan-káng chí-chek in ê ōe.”
Siōng Chú ê sîn lîm-kàu góa. I tùi góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h kā jîn-bîn kóng, ‘Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, lín teh kóng sím-mi̍h, teh siūⁿ sím-mi̍h, góa lóng chai.
Lín tī chit-ê siâⁿ thâi-sí chiah chōe lâng, si-thé móa koe-lō͘.’

“Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Chit-chō siâⁿ chiū-sī e-á, e-á lāi ê bah chiū-sī lín tī siâⁿ-lāi thâi-sí ê lâng ê sin-si. Góa beh kā lín kóaⁿ-chhut chit-ê siâⁿ.
Lín kiaⁿ to-kiàm, góa beh ēng to-kiàm kong-kek lín. Che sī Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng--ê.
Góa beh kā lín kóaⁿ-chhut chit-ê siâⁿ, chiong lín kau hō͘ gōa-kok-lâng, koh kā lín sím-phòaⁿ.
Lín beh sí tī to-ē; góa beh tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê pian-kài sím-phòaⁿ lín, án-ni lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
Chit-chō siâⁿ bô beh koh pó-hō͘ lín, chhin-chhiūⁿ e-á pó-hō͘ lāi-bīn ê bah. Góa beh tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê pian-kài sím-phòaⁿ lín.
Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú. Lín bô chun-siú góa ê kui-lē, bô sūn-thàn góa ê bēng-lēng, tian-tò chiàu lín chiu-ûi lia̍t-kok ê kui-kú khì chòe.”

Góa tú-teh soan-káng ê sî, Pí-ná-ngá ê kiáⁿ Pí-la-thê hut-jiân sí--khì. Góa bīn phak tī thô͘-kha tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Ài, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, lí beh chiong Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ chhun ê lâng lóng siau-bia̍t sī--bô?”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn teh tâm-lūn lí ê hiaⁿ-tī, lí ê chhin-cho̍k, lí ê tông-pau, chiū-sī só͘-ū siū hòng-tio̍k ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng. In kóng, ‘Hiah-ê siū hòng-tio̍k ê lâng lī-khui Siōng Chú chin hn̄g lah. Siōng Chú í-keng chiong chit-tè thó͘-tōe sù hō͘ goán chòe sán-gia̍p.’

“Só͘-í, lí tio̍h kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa sui-jiân chiong Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hòng-tio̍k khì iâu-oán ê lia̍t-kok, kā in hun-sòaⁿ tī ta̍k só͘-chāi, góa iû-goân beh tī in tòa ê só͘-chāi chòe in chiām-sî ê sèng-só͘.’

“Lí tio̍h koh kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh tùi bān-bîn ê tiong-kan tiàu-chi̍p lín, tùi lín sì-sòaⁿ--khì ê ta̍k só͘-chāi chū-chi̍p lín, chiong Í-sek-lia̍t ê thó͘-tōe koh sù hō͘ lín.’
Siū hòng-tio̍k ê lâng tńg--lâi ê sî, in it-tēng ōe tû-khì só͘-ū thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng kap thang thòng-hūn pài ngó͘-siōng ê sū.

Góa beh hō͘ in ha̍p-it ê sim, chiong sin ê sîn khǹg tī in lāi-bīn. Góa beh tùi in ê seng-khu tû-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-thâu hiah-ni̍h tēng ê sim, koh siúⁿ-sù in chhin-chhiūⁿ bah hiah-ni̍h nńg ê sim.
Án-ni, in chiū ōe chun-siú góa ê kui-lē, sūn-thàn góa ê bēng-lēng. In beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn, góa beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè.
M̄-kú sim ì-ài thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng kap ì-ài pài ngó͘-siōng ê sū hiah-ê lâng, góa beh chiàu in ê hêng-ûi kā in hêng-hoa̍t. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Ki-lō͘-pek thí-khui si̍t, lián-á tè tī in sin-piⁿ; tī in ê téng-bīn ū Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê êng-kng.
Siōng Chú ê êng-kng tùi siâⁿ-lāi seng-koân, thêng tī siâⁿ tang-pêng ê hit-chō soaⁿ-téng.
Tī īⁿ-siōng tiong, Siōng-tè ê sîn kā góa giâ--khí-lâi, tòa góa khì siū hòng-tio̍k tī Pa-pí-lûn ê tông-pau hia. Liáu-āu, góa khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê īⁿ-siōng lī-khui góa.
Góa chiū chiong Siōng Chú chí-sī góa ê ta̍k-hāng sū lóng kóng hō͘ siū hòng-tio̍k ê tông-pau thiaⁿ.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, lí tòa tī pōe-ge̍k ê lâng tiong-kan. In ū ba̍k-chiu, m̄-kú bô beh khòaⁿ; ū hī-khang, m̄-kú bô beh thiaⁿ, in-ūi in lóng sī pōe-ge̍k ê lâng.

“Só͘-í, jîn-chú, lí tio̍h chún-pī siū hòng-tio̍k ê sî só͘ su-iàu ê pau-ho̍k-á, tng-thâu-pe̍h-ji̍t, tī in ê ba̍k-chiu chêng lī-khui lí tòa ê só͘-chāi khì pa̍t-ūi; in sui-jiân pōe-ge̍k, khó-lêng ōe in-ūi lí ê hêng-tōng kak-chhíⁿ.

Lí tio̍h tī ji̍t--sî, tī in ê ba̍k-chiu chêng, the̍h lí khoán-hó tī siū hòng-tio̍k ê sî beh ēng ê pau-ho̍k-á chhut--khì. Kàu hông-hun, lí tio̍h tī in ê bīn-chêng chhin-chhiūⁿ siū hòng-tio̍k ê lâng lī-khui.
Lí koh tio̍h tī in iáu-teh khòaⁿ ê sî, kā lí chhù ê piah ó͘-khang, tùi hit-khang kōaⁿ pau-ho̍k-á chhut--khì.

Kàu thiⁿ àm ê sî, lí tio̍h tī in bīn-chêng kā pau-ho̍k-á phāiⁿ tī keng-thâu kiâⁿ--chhut-khì. Lí koh tio̍h kā lí ê bīn khàm--khí-lâi, khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h chit-tè tōe; góa beh hō͘ lí chiâⁿ-chòe góa hêng-hoa̍t Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiāu-thâu.”

Góa chiū chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng chòe. Hit-ji̍t, góa tī ji̍t--sî chiong khoán-hó tī siū hòng-tio̍k ê sî beh ēng ê pau-ho̍k-á the̍h--chhut-lâi. Kàu hông-hun, góa ēng chhiú kā piah ó͘-khang; thiⁿ àm ê sî, tī chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng phāiⁿ pau-ho̍k-á lī-khui.
Keh-chá-khí, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, hiah-ê pōe-ge̍k ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng nā mn̄g lí, ‘Lí teh chhòng siáⁿ?’
Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Che sī iú-koan tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê ông kap só͘-ū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê sìn-sit.’
Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Góa chiū-sī lín ê tiāu-thâu. Góa só͘ chòe--ê beh hoat-seng tī lín sin-chiūⁿ. Lín beh siū-lia̍h, siū hòng-tio̍k.
Lín ê ông beh tī thiⁿ àm ê sî, phāiⁿ pau-ho̍k-á tùi ūi-tio̍h i ó͘ ê piah-khang chhut--khì. I ê bīn beh khàm--teh, khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h chit-tè tōe.’
Góa beh pha-bāng kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn. I khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h hit-ê só͘-chāi, lō͘-bé ōe sí tī hia.
Góa beh kā i ê kun-tūi kap sì-chiu-ûi só͘-ū pang-chān i ê lâng, kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ khì tang sai lâm pak ta̍k só͘-chāi, mā beh pu̍ih to tui-sat in.
“Góa kā in kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ khì lia̍t-kok, kā in hòng-tio̍k khì ta̍k só͘-chāi ê sî, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.

M̄-kú góa beh kā in lâu chi̍t-kóa lâng, bô sí tī to-kiàm, ki-hng, un-e̍k. Án-ni, hiah-ê lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng beh tī siū hòng-tio̍k ê ta̍k-kok, kóng-khí ka-kī chá-chêng só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ-tāi. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, lí chia̍h-pn̄g ê sî tio̍h phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, lim-chúi ê sî tio̍h kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ put-an.

Lí tio̍h tùi chit só͘-chāi ê jîn-bîn kóng, ‘Che sī Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú iú-koan lâu tī Í-sek-lia̍t pún-kok ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng jîn-bîn kóng ê ōe: In chia̍h-pn̄g ê sî ōe phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, lim-chúi ê sî ōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ put-an; in-ūi hia ê chū-bîn bû-hoat-bû-thian, in ê thó͘-tōe ōe pha-hng, bô chhun pòaⁿ-hāng.
Ū lâng tòa ê siâⁿ-tìn ōe hong-hòe, thó͘-tōe ōe pha-hng. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sī-án-chóaⁿ ū sio̍k-gú kóng ‘Ji̍t-chí chi̍t-ji̍t chi̍t-ji̍t teh kè, bô chi̍t ê īⁿ-siōng si̍t-hiān’?

Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh hō͘ chit-kù sio̍k-gú bô koh liû-hêng; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bōe koh kóng chit-kù sio̍k-gú.’ Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Sî-ji̍t pek-kūn lah, só͘-ū ê īⁿ-siōng lóng beh si̍t-hiān lah.’
“ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan bô beh koh ū ké ê īⁿ-siōng á-sī lâng kah-ì thiaⁿ ê ū-giân.

Góa Siōng Chú chhin-chhùi tùi in kóng ê ōe, it-tēng ōe si̍t-hiān, bōe iân-tî. Pōe-ge̍k ê lâng ah, góa kā lín kóng ê ōe beh tī lín oa̍h--teh ê sî si̍t-hiān. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng beh kóng, ‘I khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê īⁿ-siōng sī teh kóng chin kú í-āu ê tāi-chì, só͘ kóng ê ū-giân lóng sī chí iâu-oán ê chiong-lâi.’

Só͘-í, lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa ê ōe bô chi̍t kù ōe iân-tî; góa kóng ê ōe it-tēng si̍t-hiān.’ Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, lí tio̍h chek-pī Í-sek-lia̍t hiah-ê chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù kóng ū-giân ê sian-ti, kā in kóng, ‘Tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe.’”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Gû-gōng ê sian-ti chhám ah! In bô khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sím-mi̍h īⁿ-siōng, kan-ta chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù phian-chō ū-giân.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, lín ê sian-ti kap tòa tī hong-hòe ê só͘-chāi ê hô͘-lî siâng-khoán.
Siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê phòa-khiah, in bô khì pó͘, bô siu-kiàn, tì-kàu tī Siōng Chú ê ji̍t, tú-tio̍h chiàn-cheng ê sî, Í-sek-lia̍t bô hoat-tō͘ khiā-chāi.

In ê īⁿ-siōng sī ké--ê; in ê ū-giân sī pe̍h-chha̍t. In kóng ‘Che sī Siōng Chú kóng--ê’, kî-si̍t, góa Siōng Chú bô chhe-phài in; in kèng-jiân teh kî-thāi hiah-ê ōe si̍t-hiān.

Góa kā in kóng, ‘Lín khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê īⁿ-siōng kiám m̄-sī ké--ê? Lín kóng ê ū-giân kiám m̄-sī pe̍h-chha̍t? Lín kèng-jiân kóng che sī Siōng Chú kóng--ê, kî-si̍t, góa bô kā lín kóng sím-mi̍h!’”
Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “In-ūi lín ê ū-giân sī hu-ké, lín ê īⁿ-siōng sī hoàn-sióng, góa beh kap lín choh-tùi.

Góa beh chhun-chhiú kong-kek hiah-ê phian-chō hu-ké ê īⁿ-siōng, kap kóng pe̍h-chha̍t ê ū-giân ê sian-ti. In bōe-ēng-tit chham-ka góa chú-bîn ê chū-hōe, bōe-ēng-tit teng-kì tī Í-sek-lia̍t -ke ê miâ-chheh, mā bōe-ēng-tit tńg-khì Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú.
“In kā góa ê chú-bîn chhōa bê-lō͘, tī bô pêng-an ê sî kóng ‘Pêng-an’, chhin-chhiūⁿ khí chhiûⁿ-piah ê sî, in kā piah boah pe̍h-he.
Lí tio̍h kā hiah-ê boah pe̍h-he ê lâng kóng, ‘Ōe ū kông-hong-pō-ú kap tōa peng-pha̍uh kā chhiûⁿ phah-tó.’
Chhiûⁿ tó-hoāi liáu-āu, lâng beh mn̄g, ‘Lín án-ni boah ū siáⁿ lō͘-ēng?’”
Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Góa beh hoat tōa siū-khì, ēng kông-hong-pō-ú kap tōa peng-pha̍uh phah-tó chit-ê chhiûⁿ.
Góa beh thiah-húi lín boah pe̍h-he ê chhiûⁿ, thiah kah pîⁿ-pîⁿ-pîⁿ, lō͘-chhut tōe-ki; chhiûⁿ beh tó-hoāi, lín beh sí tī siâⁿ-lāi. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
“Góa beh tùi chhiûⁿ kap kā chhiûⁿ boah pe̍h-he ê lâng hoat tōa siū-khì. Góa beh kā in kóng, ‘Chhiûⁿ kap boah pe̍h-he ê lâng lóng o͘-iú--khì ah.
Hiah-ê tī bô pêng-an ê sî, kā Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng pó-chèng pêng-an ê sian-ti lóng bô--khì lah.’” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Jîn-chú, lí tio̍h tng-bīn chek-pī hiah-ê chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù kóng ū-giân ê cha-bó͘-lâng,

kā in kóng, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lín chiah-ê cha-bó͘-lâng chhám ah! Lín kā lâng ê chhiú-kut pa̍k hû-á-tòa, hō͘ in tì phek-siâ ê thâu-kun, siūⁿ-beh khòng-chè lâng ê sìⁿ-miā. Kiám kóng lín siūⁿ-beh khòng-chè góa chú-bîn ê siⁿ-sí lâi kiû ka-kī ê lī-ek?

Lín ūi-tio̍h kúi pé tōa-be̍h, kúi tè piáⁿ, tī góa chú-bîn ê bīn-chêng siat-to̍k góa. Bô eng-kai sí--ê, lín kā in thâi-sí; kai-sí--ê, lín lâu in ê sìⁿ-miā. Lín ǹg hiah-ê bô ài thiaⁿ chin-si̍t-ōe ê chú-bîn kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.

“‘Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, lín tio̍h chai, góa thòng-hūn lín ēng lâi chho-chhiòng lâng sìⁿ-miā ê hû-á-tòa. Góa beh pak lín chhiú-kut téng-bīn ê hû-á-tòa, kái-kiù hō͘ lín khòng-chè ê lâng, tháu-pàng hiah-ê chhin-chhiūⁿ chiáu-á hō͘ lín lia̍h--khì ê lâng.
Góa beh thiah-li̍h lín phek-siâ ê thâu-kun, kái-kiù góa ê chú-bîn, hō͘ in bô koh siū lín khòng-chè. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.

“‘Góa m̄-bat hō͘ gī-lâng siong-sim, m̄-kú lín kóng pe̍h-chha̍t hō͘ in ê sim kan-khó͘. Lín kó͘-lē siâ-ok ê lâng, bô hō͘ in hóe-kái lī-khui pháiⁿ-lō͘ lâi pó-choân in ê sìⁿ-miā.

Só͘-í, lín bōe koh khòaⁿ hu-ké ê īⁿ-siōng, bōe koh kóng pe̍h-chha̍t ê ū-giân. Góa beh kái-kiù góa ê chú-bîn thoat-lī lín ê chhiú. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”
Ū kúi ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiúⁿ-ló lâi chhē góa, chē tī góa ê bīn-chêng.
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, chiah-ê lâng ê sim choán-ǹg ngó͘-siōng, poa̍h-tó hoān-chōe. Góa kiám thang hôe-èng in ê kî-kiû?

“Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng nā sim choán-ǹg ngó͘-siōng, poa̍h-tó hoān-chōe, koh lâi chhē-kiû sian-ti, góa Siōng Chú beh chiàu in pài ngó͘-siōng ê chōe kā in pò-èng.
Góa án-ni chòe sī beh hō͘ in ê sim choán-ǹg góa, in-ūi ngó͘-siōng hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lī-khui góa, kap góa so͘-oán.’
“Só͘-í, lí tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Tio̍h hôe-thâu, khì-sak lín ê ngó͘-siōng, sim lī-khui só͘-ū thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.’

“Bô-lūn sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, á-sī tòa tī in tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, nā lī-khui góa, sim choán-ǹg ngó͘-siōng, bīn ǹg ōe hō͘ in poa̍h-tó ê chōe, chiah lâi sian-ti chia kiû-mn̄g góa, góa Siōng Chú beh chhin-sin pò-èng i.
Góa beh pìⁿ-bīn kap i choh-tùi, hō͘ i chiâⁿ-chòe lâng ê kàm-kài kap chhiàu-tâm. Góa beh tùi góa ê chú-bîn tiong kā i kek-chhut. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.

“Nā ū sian-ti siū bê-he̍k kóng ū-giân, chún-kóng sī góa Siōng Chú hō͘ i siū bê-he̍k, góa mā beh chhun-chhiú hêng-hoa̍t i, kā i tùi góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan siau-bia̍t.
In tio̍h tùi ka-kī ê chōe hū chek-jīm; kiû-mn̄g ê lâng ê hêng-hoa̍t kap sian-ti ê hêng-hoa̍t siâng-khoán.

Án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiah bōe koh bê-sit lī-khui góa, bōe koh hoān-chōe hō͘ ka-kī siū ù-jiám. In beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn; góa beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, nā ū chi̍t ê kok-ka hoān-chōe pōe-ge̍k góa, góa beh chhun-chhiú chhiat-tn̄g in niû-si̍t ê lâi-goân, hō͘ ki-hng lîm-kàu, lâng kap cheng-siⁿ lóng gō-sí;
chún-kóng Ná-a, Tān-í-lí, Iok-pek saⁿ ê lâng lóng tòa tī hia, in ê chèng-ti̍t kan-ta ōe-tàng kiù in ka-kī. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Góa nā hō͘ iá-siù kiâⁿ-thàu chit-ê só͘-chāi, sì-kòe thún-ta̍h, kā-sí chū-bîn, hō͘ tōe pha-hng, hō͘ lâng m̄-káⁿ tùi hia keng-kè.

Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kí góa éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè, chún-kóng hit saⁿ ê lâng tòa tī hia, in mā bōe-tàng kiù in ê kiáⁿ-jî; in kan-ta ōe-tàng kiù ka-kī, thó͘-tōe iû-goân pha-hng.
“Á-sī, góa nā hō͘ hit só͘-chāi tú-tio̍h chiàn-loān, lâng kap cheng-siⁿ lóng hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí,
góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kí góa éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè, chiū-sī hit saⁿ ê lâng tòa tī hia, in mā bōe-tàng kiù in ê kiáⁿ-jî; in kan-ta ōe-tàng kiù ka-kī.
“Á-sī, góa hoat ke̍k-tōa ê siū-khì, hō͘ un-e̍k tī hit só͘-chāi liû-hêng, chiong lâng kap cheng-siⁿ lóng bia̍t-choa̍t,

sui-jiân ū Ná-a, Tān-í-lí, Iok-pek tòa tī hia, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kí góa éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè, in mā bōe-tàng kiù in ê kiáⁿ-jî; in ê chèng-ti̍t kan-ta ōe-tàng kiù in ka-kī.

“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa nā ēng chiàn-loān, ki-hng, iá-siù, kap un-e̍k chit sì chióng khó-phàⁿ ê chai-lān hêng-hoa̍t Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chiong lâng kap cheng-siⁿ lóng tû-bia̍t, án-ni kiám m̄-sī koh-khah giâm-tiōng?

Nā ū lâng oa̍h--lo̍h-lâi, chiong in ê hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ chhōa-lâi lín chia, lín khòaⁿ-kìⁿ in ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe, chiū ōe bêng-pe̍k góa án-ni hêng-hoa̍t Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sī eng-kai--ê,
mā ōe liáu-kái góa só͘ chòe--ê m̄-sī bô lí-iû. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, phû-tô-chhiū kiám ū pí kî-tha ê chhiū khah hó? Phû-tô chhiū-ki kiám ōe pí chhiū-nâ lāi kî-tha ê chhiū-ki khah ū lō͘-ēng?
Phû-tô chhiū-ki kiám ōe-tàng the̍h-lâi chòe sím-mi̍h? I kiám ōe-tàng chòe kòa mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê chhâ-teng-á?
I kan-ta ōe-tàng hiâⁿ-hé. I nn̄g thâu lóng to̍h-hé, tiong-kho͘ mā sio--khí-lâi, kiám iáu ū sím-mi̍h lō͘-ēng?
I hó-hó ê sî to bô sím-mi̍h lō͘-ēng, taⁿ hō͘ hé sio, sio kah chhàu-ta, kiám iáu ōe-tàng the̍h-lâi chòe sím-mi̍h?”
Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Góa án-chóaⁿ hō͘ chhiū-nâ lāi ê phû-tô-chhiū chòe hé-chhâ sio, mā beh án-ni tùi-thāi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn.
Góa beh pìⁿ-bīn kap in choh-tùi; in sui-jiân tùi hé-tiong cháu--chhut-lâi, hé iû-goân beh kā in sio-bia̍t. Góa tùi in pìⁿ-bīn ê sî, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
In-ūi in tùi góa put-tiong, só͘-í góa beh hō͘ in ê thó͘-tōe pha-hng.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú koh tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, lí tio̍h hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chai i só͘ chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.

Tio̍h kā Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kóng, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lí ê pún-ku-tōe, lí chhut-sì ê só͘-chāi, sī Ka-lâm -lâng ê tōe. Lí ê lāu-pē sī A-mô͘-lī -lâng, lāu-bú sī Hek -lâng.
Lí chhut-sì ê sî, bô lâng kā lí tńg-châi, ēng chúi kā lí sóe chheng-khì, mā bô lâng ēng iâm kā lí chhit seng-khu, ēng pò͘ kā lí pau--teh.
Bô lâng khó-lîn lí, lâi kā lí chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì. Lí chhut-sì ê sî, hō͘ lâng hiat tī chhân-iá, in-ūi lí hō͘ lâng thó-ià.

“‘Góa kiâⁿ-lō͘ tùi lí hia keng-kè, khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí tī huih-tiong ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-tāng; góa tùi lí kóng: Sui-jiân lí kui seng-khu lóng sī huih, m̄-kú lí tio̍h oa̍h--lo̍h-khì, tio̍h oa̍h--lo̍h-khì!

Góa chai-pôe lí, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chiàu-kò͘ hn̂g--ni̍h ê lông-chok-bu̍t. Lí chiām-chiām tōa-hàn, hoat-io̍k chiâⁿ-chòe siàu-lú, nn̄g lia̍p lin kiat-si̍t, thâu-mn̂g tn̂g, m̄-kú iû-goân chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé.

“‘Góa tùi lí hia keng-kè, khòaⁿ lí í-keng sêng-se̍k, ōe tâm-chêng-soat-ài. Góa ēng gōa-saⁿ jia-khàm lí bô chhēng-saⁿ ê seng-khu, kap lí li̍p-sè kiat bêng-iok; góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kap lí kiat-iok, lí chiū kui-sio̍k góa.
“‘Góa ēng chúi kā lí seng-khu ê huih sóe chheng-khì, koh ēng iû kā lí boah.
Góa hō͘ lí chhēng siù-hoe ê súi-saⁿ, ko-kip ê phê-ôe, iù-môa-pò͘ ê thâu-kun, koh kā lí chhēng si-tiû ê gōa-thò.
Góa kā lí soe-chng-táⁿ-pān, kā lí kòa chhiú-khoân, phoa̍h-liān,
phīⁿ-khoân, hī-kau, ēng hoa-koan kā lí tì.

Án-ni, lí ū kim-gûn ê chng-thāⁿ, chhēng iù-môa, si-tiû, kap siù-hoe ê súi-saⁿ. Lí ēng siōng-hó ê mī-hún, phang-bi̍t, kap kaⁿ-ná-iû chòe chia̍h-mi̍h. Lí siⁿ-chòe chin súi, súi kah ōe-tàng chòe lú-ông.
In-ūi góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kā lí chng-thāⁿ, hō͘ lí ke̍k súi. Lí ê bí-māu chiū thoân-piàn lia̍t-kok.
“‘M̄-kú lí khò-sè ka-kī ê bí-māu kap miâ-siaⁿ khì chòe chhiong-ki, hòng-chhiòng chêng-io̍k, kap ta̍k-ê kè-lō͘ ê lâng kiâⁿ-îm.
Lí ēng lí ê saⁿ chng-thāⁿ soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, tī hia kiâⁿ-îm. Ài, chit-khoán tāi-chì bô eng-kai ū, chiong-lâi mā bô eng-kai hoat-seng.
Lí the̍h góa hō͘ lí kùi-tiōng ê kim-gûn chu-pó, chù-chō ta-po͘-lâng ê siōng, chhin-chhiūⁿ ki-lú kap in kiâⁿ-îm.
Lí ēng góa hō͘ lí siù-hoe ê súi-saⁿ kā in moa--teh, koh kā góa hō͘ lí ê iû kap phang-liāu hiàn hō͘ in.

Lí koh chiong góa hō͘ lí ê niû-si̍t, chiū-sī siōng-hó ê mī-hún, kaⁿ-ná-iû, phang-bi̍t, the̍h-khì chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ in. Tāi-chì chiū-sī án-ni. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng.
“‘Lí sīm-chì chiong lí kap góa siⁿ ê hāu-siⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tòng-chòe chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ ngó͘-siōng. Lí ka-kī ê îm-loān iáu bô-kàu sī--bô?
Lí koh thâi góa ê jî-lú tòng-chòe chè-mi̍h ēng hé sio, hiàn hō͘ in.
Lí chòe ki-lú kap chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, kā lí sòe-hàn ê sî chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, tī huih-tiong ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-tāng ê chêng-hóng lóng pàng bōe-kì--tit.’”
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kè-sio̍k kóng, ‘Lí chhám ah! Lí ū chai-hō lah! Lí chòe chiah-ê pháiⁿ-tāi í-gōa,
koh tī siâⁿ-lāi khí-chō hoe-lâu, tī khoan-khoah ê só͘-chāi khí pài ngó͘-siōng ê koân-tâi.
Lí tī koe-thâu-hāng-bé khí-chō koân-tâi, hō͘ lí ê bí-māu pìⁿ-chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê; lí koh hòng-chhiòng chêng-io̍k, kap só͘-ū kè-lō͘ ê lâng kiâⁿ-îm.
Lí kap hò͘ⁿ-sek ê chhù-piⁿ Ai-ki̍p kiâⁿ-îm; lí hòng-chhiòng chêng-io̍k lâi jiá góa siū-khì.

“‘Só͘-í, góa beh chhun-chhiú hêng-hoa̍t lí, siu-hôe góa hō͘ lí ê hok-hūn. Góa beh chiong lí kau hō͘ oàn-hūn lí ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng, sûi-chāi in tùi-thāi lí; liân in mā in-ūi lí ê îm-loān kám-kak kiàn-siàu.
“‘M̄-kú, lí iáu bô boán-chiok, koh kap A-su̍t kiâⁿ-îm; án-ni mā iáu bô boán-chiok lí îm-loān ê io̍k-bōng.
Lí koh kap gâu chòe seng-lí ê Pa-pí-lûn kiâⁿ-îm; chiū-sī án-ni, lí iû-goân bô boán-chiok.’
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh kóng, ‘Lí si̍t-chāi hō͘ góa hui-siông siū-khì! Lí chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì chhin-chhiūⁿ m̄-chai kiàn-siàu ê ki-lú chòe--ê.
Lí tī lō͘-thâu chō hoe-lâu, tī kóng-tiûⁿ khí koân-tâi, tī hia kiâⁿ-îm. Lí pí ki-lú khah m̄-ta̍t, in-ūi lí bô beh the̍h lâng ê chîⁿ;
lí sī îm-hū, lêng-khó kap gōa-lâng su-thong, bô ài ka-kī ê tiōng-hu.
Ki-lú sī kā lâng the̍h lé-mi̍h, lí tian-tò sàng lé-mi̍h hō͘ ài-jîn; lí ín-iú in tùi ta̍k só͘-chāi lâi boán-chiok lí ê chêng-io̍k.

Lí kap it-poaⁿ ê ki-lú bô siâng-khoán, m̄-sī lâng lâi chhē lí kiâⁿ-îm, sī lí khì chhē lâng; lí bô siu lâng ê chîⁿ, tian-tò tò-thiap. Lí kap kî-tha ê ki-lú tian-tò-péng.’”
Taⁿ, lí chit-ê îm-hū Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe.

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng, “Lí hòng-chhiòng chêng-io̍k, ūi ài-jîn lō͘-hiān lí ê hā-thé kap in kiâⁿ-îm, koh thâi ka-kī ê jî-lú chòe chè-mi̍h, hiàn hō͘ thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng.

Só͘-í, góa beh kā lí só͘-ū ê ài-jîn, bô-lūn sī lí kah-ì--ê á-sī thó-ià--ê, tùi ta̍k só͘-chāi tiàu-chi̍p lâi kong-kek lí; góa beh tī in ê bīn-chêng kā lí thǹg-kng-kng, hō͘ in kā lí kui seng-khu khòaⁿ-liáu-liáu.
Góa beh sím-phòaⁿ lí, chhin-chhiūⁿ sím-phòaⁿ kiâⁿ-îm kap thâi-lâng ê cha-bó͘-lâng. Góa beh tī tōa siū-khì kap oàn-tò͘ tiong kā lí hêng-hoa̍t, kā lí chhú-sí.
Góa beh chiong lí kau tī in ê chhiú; in beh thiah-húi lí ê hoe-lâu, húi-hoāi lí ê koân-tâi, pak lí ê saⁿ, chhiúⁿ lí ê chu-pó, hō͘ lí chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé.
“In beh chhōa kûn-chiòng lâi kong-kek lí, ēng chio̍h-thâu kā lí tìm-sí, ēng to-kiàm kā lí tok-chhùi.
In beh pàng-hé sio lí ê chhù, tī chin chōe hū-lú ê bīn-chêng kā lí hêng-hoa̍t. Góa bô beh hō͘ lí koh chòe ki-lú, liáu-chîⁿ tò-thiap ài-jîn.
Án-ni, góa ê tōa siū-khì chiah ōe siau, góa ê oàn-tò͘ chiah ōe soah; góa chiah ōe pêng-chēng, bô koh siū-khì.

Lí bōe-kì-tit sòe-hàn ê sî góa án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lí, tian-tò chòe chiah-ê sū jiá góa siū-khì, só͘-í góa beh chiàu lí ê só͘-chòe pò-èng lí. Lí í-keng chòe hiah chōe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, sī-án-chóaⁿ beh koh kiâⁿ-îm?” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Nā ū lâng beh ēng sio̍k-gú kā lí phì-siùⁿ, it-tēng ōe kóng, ‘Iú kî bú pit iú kî lú.’

Lí chin-chiàⁿ kap lí ê lāu-bú siâng-khoán, khì-sak ka-kī ê tiōng-hu kap kiáⁿ-jî. Lí mā kap lí ê chí-bē siâng-khoán, khì-sak ka-kī ê tiōng-hu kap kiáⁿ-jî. Lí ê lāu-bú sī Hek -lâng, lāu-pē sī A-mô͘-lī -lâng.
“Lí ê tōa-chí sī Sat-má-lī-a; i kap i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tòa tī lí ê pak-pêng. Lí ê sió-bē sī Só͘-to-má; i kap i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tòa tī lí ê lâm-pêng.
Lí o̍h in ê só͘-chòe, chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, m̄-nā án-ni, bô-jōa-kú, lí tī ta̍k hong-bīn lóng pí in koh-khah pháiⁿ.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Góa kí góa ê sìⁿ-miā li̍p-sè: Lí ê sió-bē Só͘-to-má kap i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ bô chòe lí kap lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ-sū.

Khòaⁿ leh, lí ê sió-bē Só͘-to-má ê chōe sī án-ni: I kap i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ê chōe sī kiau-ngō͘, chiū-sī in chia̍h-mi̍h chhiong-chiok, an-ún kè hó ji̍t-chí, m̄-kú bô chiàu-kò͘ khùn-khó͘ kap sàn-chhiah ê lâng.
In kiau-ngō͘, chòe góa khòaⁿ-chòe iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, só͘-í góa kā in siau-bia̍t. Chit-hāng sū lí í-keng chai.
“ Sat-má-lī-a hoān ê chōe khah bô lí ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ. Lí só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū pí in koh-khah chōe. Lí só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū soah hō͘ lí ê chí-bē pí lí khah chèng-ti̍t.

Lí kì-jiân ūi-tio̍h lí ê chí-bē piān-hō͘, taⁿ lí tio̍h sêng-tam ka-kī ê kiàn-siàu, in-ūi lí hoān ê chōe pí in koh-khah khó-ò͘ⁿ, soah hō͘ in pí lí khah chèng-ti̍t. Taⁿ lí tio̍h chai thang kiàn-siàu, in-ūi lí hō͘ lí ê chí-bē khòaⁿ--khí-lâi pí lí hó chin chōe.”

Siōng Chú tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kóng, “Góa beh hō͘ Só͘-to-má kap Sat-má-lī-a í-ki̍p in ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, tùi siū-lia̍h ê tōe tò-tńg--lâi, mā beh hō͘ lí kap in chòe-hé tò-tńg--lâi;
án-ni, lí chiah ōe-hiáu in-ūi só͘ siū ê bú-jio̍k lâi kám-kak kiàn-siàu, hō͘ lí ê chí-bē tit-tio̍h an-ùi.
Só͘-to-má kap Sat-má-lī-a í-ki̍p in ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ beh hôe-ho̍k chá-chêng ê sēng-hóng. Lí kap lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ mā it-tēng ōe án-ni.

Tī lí chhia-iāⁿ, chōe-ok iáu-bē hián-lō͘ ê sî, lí kiám m̄-sī bat thí-chhiò Só͘-to-má? Taⁿ, lí beh hō͘ Í-tong -lâng, Hui-lī-sū -lâng, kap chiu-ûi oàn-hūn lí ê lâng kā lí thí-chhiò.
Lí beh ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê îm-loān kap só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū siū pò-èng.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh chiàu lí ê hêng-ûi pò-èng lí, in-ūi lí ûi-pōe tùi góa chiù-chōa ê ōe, hòe-tû kap góa li̍p ê iok.
Sui-jiân sī án-ni, góa beh kì-tiâu góa tī lí siàu-liân ê sî kap lí li̍p ê iok, koh kian-li̍p i chiâⁿ-chòe éng-oán ê iok.

Lí chiap-la̍p lí ê tōa-chí sió-bē ê sî, beh siūⁿ-khí lí í-chêng só͘ chòe ê it-chhè lâi kám-kak kiàn-siàu. Sui-jiân góa bô án-ni kap lín iok-tēng, góa beh kā in kau hō͘ lí, chòe lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.
Góa beh kian-li̍p góa kap lí li̍p ê iok, lí chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
Góa beh sià-bián lí só͘ hoān it-chhè ê chōe-kò, hō͘ lí ōe-kì-tit chiah-ê sū lâi kám-kak kiàn-siàu, m̄-káⁿ koh khui-chhùi.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú, lí tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng chi̍t ê phì-jū, hō͘ in siūⁿ lāi-bīn ê ì-sù.

Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Ū chi̍t chiah tōa eng-chiáu, si̍t-kó͘ tōa, mn̂g tn̂g koh cha̍t, sek-chhái chōe koh súi. I pe-khì Lê-pa-lūn soaⁿ-téng, khì kàu pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū ê bé-liu,
tok-tn̄g pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū chhiū-bé iù-nńg ê ki, kā-khì chòe seng-lí ê tōe-khu, pàng tī chòe bō͘-e̍k ê siâⁿ-chhī.
I koh tùi Í-sek-lia̍t the̍h chéng-chí chai tī pûi ê tōe, chhin-chhiūⁿ liú-chhiū chèng tī chúi-goân chhiong-chiok ê khoe-piⁿ.

Chéng-chí puh-gê seng-tióng, chiâⁿ-chòe sòe-châng sì-kòe soan-tîn ê phû-tô-chhiū. I ê ki chhun ǹg eng-chiáu, tèng-kun tī eng-chiáu ê ē-bīn, chiâⁿ-chòe hoat-ki soan-tîn ê phû-tô-chhiū.

“‘Lēng-gōa ū chi̍t chiah tōa eng-chiáu, si̍t-kó͘ tōa, mn̂g chin cha̍t. Chit-châng phû-tô-chhiū chiong kun kap ki oan ǹg chit-chiah tōa eng-chiáu, siūⁿ-beh tit-tio̍h pí i goân-lâi siū chai-chèng ê thó͘-tōe koh-khah chōe koàn-ak ê chúi.
Kî-si̍t, chit-châng phû-tô-chhiū chá chiū chai tī thô͘ pûi chúi chōe ê hn̂g--ni̍h, ōe-tàng hoat-ki, kiat ké-chí, chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t châng gâu kiat ké-chí ê phû-tô-chhiū.’

“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh kóng, ‘Chit-châng phû-tô-chhiū kiám ōe-tàng koh tióng-tōa bō͘-sēng? Kiám kóng tē-it chiah tōa eng-chiáu bōe kā i liân kun pu̍ih--khí-lâi, kā i ê ké-chí bán-liáu-liáu, hō͘ kui-châng chhiū, liân sin hoat ê ki-hio̍h mā ko͘-tâ? Án-ni, m̄-bián chhut tōa-la̍t á-sī chōe lâng, chiū ōe-tàng kā i liân kun pu̍ih--khí-lâi.

Lí khòaⁿ, phû-tô-chhiū sui-jiân siū chai-chèng, m̄-kú kiám ōe-tàng tióng-tōa bō͘-sēng? I kiám ōe-kham-tit hō͘ tang-hong siàn? I it-tēng ōe tī i seng-tióng ê hn̂g--ni̍h ko͘-tâ.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Lí kā hiah-ê pōe-ge̍k ê lâng mn̄g, khòaⁿ in chai chiah-ê phì-jū ê ì-sù bô? Lí kā in kóng, Pa-pí-lûn -ông bat lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chiong Iû-tāi -ông kap i ê jîn-sîn lia̍h-khì Pa-pí-lûn,
koh tùi Iû-tāi ông-cho̍k tiong soán chi̍t ê lâng, kap i li̍p-iok, kiò i chiù-chōa. Pa-pí-lûn -ông mā chiong Iû-tāi kok-tiong chi̍t-kóa léng-tō-chiá lia̍h--khì,
hō͘ Iû-tāi -kok soe-bî bô hoat-tō͘ hoán-khòng, kan-ta ōe-tàng khò siú-iok lâi seng-chûn.

M̄-kú Iû-tāi -ông hoán-poān. I phài sù-chiá khì Ai-ki̍p iau-kiû chiàn-bé kap tāi-kun lâi chi-oān. I kiám ōe sêng-kong? Chòe chit-chióng tāi-chì ê lâng, kiám ōe-tàng tô-thoat? I ûi-pōe iok-tēng, kiám ū hoat-tō͘ siám-khui hêng-hoa̍t?

“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Góa kí góa ê sìⁿ-miā li̍p-sè: Chit-ê ông it-tēng ōe sí tī i siū siat-li̍p choh-ông ê só͘-chāi, in-ūi Pa-pí-lûn -ông siat-li̍p i choh-ông, m̄-kú i ûi-pōe ka-kī chiù-chōa ê ōe, hòe-tû i kap Pa-pí-lûn -ông li̍p ê iok.

Tng tùi-te̍k Pa-pí-lûn -ông lâi kong-siâⁿ, thūn thô͘-tui, khí-chō kong-táⁿ siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê koân-tâi, chìn-hêng tōa tô͘-sat ê sî, Ai-ki̍p -ông kiông koh chōe ê kun-tūi mā bōe-tàng pang-chān i.
I ûi-pōe ka-kī chiù-chōa ê ōe, hòe-tû i kap Pa-pí-lûn -ông só͘ li̍p ê iok. I í-keng tâu-hâng, kèng-jiân chòe chiah-ê sū, taⁿ, i bô lō͘ thang tô-cháu lah.’
“Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa kí góa ê sìⁿ-miā li̍p-sè: Góa beh hêng-hoa̍t i, in-ūi i ûi-pōe ka-kī chiù-chōa ê ōe, hòe-tû i kap góa li̍p ê iok.
Góa beh siat lô-bāng, kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, tòa-khì Pa-pí-lûn, kā i sím-phòaⁿ, in-ūi i tùi góa put-tiong.
Só͘-ū tô-cháu ê chiàn-sū ōe chiàn-sí, chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê kun-peng ōe tô-cháu sì-sòaⁿ. Án-ni lín chiū chai, kóng chiah-ê ōe--ê sī góa Siōng Chú.’”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Góa beh at-tn̄g pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū ê chhiū-bé, chiong i iù-nńg ê ki at--lo̍h-lâi, kā i chèng tī koân-soaⁿ téng.

Góa beh kā i chai tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê koân-soaⁿ téng; i beh hoat-ki, kiat ké-chí, chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t châng koân koh súi ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū. Ta̍k-chióng chiáu-á pe-lâi chia choh-siū, hioh tī i chhiū-ki ê ìm-ńg-ē.

Chhân-iá só͘-ū ê chhiū-ba̍k lóng beh chai: Góa Siōng Chú hō͘ tōa-châng chhiū pìⁿ sòe-châng, hō͘ sòe-châng chhiū tōa-châng; góa hō͘ chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chhiū ko͘-tâ, hō͘ ko͘-tâ ê chhiū bō͘-sēng. Góa Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, it-tēng án-ni chòe.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Lín Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ná ū chit-kù sio̍k-gú, kóng ‘Lāu-pē chia̍h sng phû-tô, kiáⁿ-jî ê chhùi-khí sng-nńg’?”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Góa kí góa éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè: Lín Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bōe koh liû-thoân chit-kù sio̍k-gú.
Múi chi̍t ê lâng ê sìⁿ-miā lóng sī góa ê; pē-bú ê sìⁿ-miā sio̍k tī góa, kiáⁿ-jî ê sìⁿ-miā mā sio̍k tī góa. Sím-mi̍h-lâng hoān-chōe, chiū hit-ê lâng sí.
“Nā ū lâng chèng-ti̍t, hêng-ûi kong-pêng chèng-gī:

I bô chia̍h soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ sîn-biō ê chè-mi̍h, bô ǹg Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê ka-cho̍k sîn-bêng kiû pó-pì, bô chhim-hoān pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘, bô kap keng-kî tiong ê hū-jîn-lâng tâng-pâng,

bô khi-ap lâng, chiong khiàm-chè ê lâng tí-ah ê mi̍h hêng i, bô chhiúⁿ-toa̍t pa̍t-lâng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, the̍h chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ iau-gō ê lâng chia̍h, the̍h saⁿ hō͘ chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé ê lâng chhēng,
chioh-chîⁿ hō͘ lâng bô the̍h lī-sek, bô pàng tāng-lī, bô chòe siâ-ok ê sū, chiàu kong-tō chhú-lí kiù-hun.

Chit-chióng lâng ho̍k-chiông góa ê kui-lē, kín-sīn chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng, chiàu-khí-kang chòe tāi-chì; i sī chèng-ti̍t ê lâng, it-tēng ōe-tàng pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Chit-ê lâng nā ū kiáⁿ chòe kiông-tō, thâi-lâng, chòe in lāu-pē m̄-bat chòe--kè ê pháiⁿ tāi-chì, chia̍h soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ sîn-biō ê chè-mi̍h, chhim-hoān pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘,
khi-ap khùn-khó͘ kap sàn-chhiah ê lâng, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t pa̍t-lâng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, khàu-liû khiàm-chè ê lâng tí-ah ê mi̍h, ǹg ngó͘-siōng kiû pó-pì, chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū,

chioh-chîⁿ hō͘ lâng the̍h lī-sek koh the̍h tāng-lī. Chit-chióng lâng kiám ōe-tàng pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā? Bōe! I chòe chiah-ê khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, it-tēng tio̍h sí; i sī chū-chhú-bia̍t-bông.
“Chit-ê pháiⁿ-lâng nā ū chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, chit-ê kiáⁿ khòaⁿ-kìⁿ i ê lāu-pē só͘ chòe it-chhè ê pháiⁿ tāi-chì, m̄-kú i ka-kī séng-chhat, lóng bô án-ni khì chòe.
I bô chia̍h soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ sîn-biō ê chè-mi̍h, bô ǹg Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê ka-cho̍k sîn-bêng kiû pó-pì, bô chhim-hoān pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘,

bô khi-ap lâng, chiong khiàm-chè ê lâng tí-ah ê mi̍h hêng i, bô chhiúⁿ-toa̍t pa̍t-lâng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, hoán-tńg the̍h chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ iau-gō ê lâng chia̍h, the̍h saⁿ hō͘ chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé ê lâng chhēng,

bô siong-hāi sàn-chhiah-lâng, chioh-chîⁿ hō͘ lâng bô the̍h lī-sek, bô pàng tāng-lī; m̄-kú ū chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng, ho̍k-chiông góa ê kui-lē. I bōe in-ūi i ê lāu-pē só͘ hoān ê chōe sí. I it-tēng ōe-tàng pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā.
I ê lāu-pē in-ūi khi-ap lâng, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t pa̍t-lâng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, tī jîn-bîn tiong-kan chòe pháiⁿ tāi-chì; i ōe in-ūi ka-kī hoān ê chōe sí.

“Lín teh mn̄g, ‘Sī-án-chóaⁿ hāu-siⁿ bô in-ūi lāu-pē só͘ hoān ê chōe siū hêng-hoa̍t?’ Góa ê hôe-tap sī, ‘Hāu-siⁿ chòe kong-pêng chèng-gī ê sū, kín-sīn chun-siú góa ê kui-lē, i it-tēng ōe-tàng pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā.’

Chí-ū hoān-chōe ê lâng tio̍h sí. Hāu-siⁿ m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h lāu-pē ê chōe siū hêng-hoa̍t; lāu-pē mā m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h hāu-siⁿ ê chōe siū hêng-hoa̍t. Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng beh in-ūi choh-hó tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ; pháiⁿ-lâng beh in-ūi choh-pháiⁿ siū hêng-hoa̍t.
“Pháiⁿ-lâng nā hóe-kái, lī-khui i só͘ hoān it-chhè ê chōe, kín-sīn chun-siú góa ê kui-lē, chòe kong-pêng chèng-gī ê sū, i chiū thang pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā, m̄-bián sí.
I só͘ hoān it-chhè ê chōe lóng ōe siū sià-bián; i beh in-ūi i chòe ê hó-sū pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā.
Pháiⁿ-lâng sí-bông, kiám sī góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú só͘ ài? M̄-sī! Góa kiám m̄-sī ài in lī-khui pháiⁿ-lō͘ lâi pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā?

“Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng nā lī-khui chiàⁿ-lō͘ khì choh-pháiⁿ, kap pháiⁿ-lâng kâng-khoán chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, i kiám ōe-tàng pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā? Bōe-tàng! I chá-chêng só͘ chòe ê hó-sū bô chún-sǹg. I ōe in-ūi pōe-ge̍k, hoān-chōe lâi sí.
“M̄-kú lín kóng, ‘Chú án-ni chhú-lí bô kong-tō!’ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, chù-ì thiaⁿ, góa án-ni chhú-lí bô kong-tō o͘h? Lín chiah sī bô kong-tō!
Chèng-ti̍t ê lâng nā lī-khui chiàⁿ-lō͘ khì choh-pháiⁿ, i sí, sī in-ūi i choh-pháiⁿ.
Pháiⁿ-lâng hóe-kái, lī-khui i só͘ hoān it-chhè ê chōe, chòe kong-pêng chèng-gī ê sū, i beh kiù ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.
I séng-chhat ka-kī, hóe-kái, lī-khui i só͘ hoān it-chhè ê chōe, chiū ōe-tàng pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā, m̄-bián sí.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, lín kóng, ‘Chú ê choh-hoat bô kong-tō!’ Lín siūⁿ-kóng góa ê choh-hoat bô kong-tō o͘h? Lín ê choh-hoat chiah sī bô kong-tō!

“Só͘-í, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh chiàu lín ta̍k-ê lâng ê hêng-ûi sím-phòaⁿ lín. Lín tio̍h hóe-kái, lī-khui lín só͘ hoān it-chhè ê chōe, chiah bián lín in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe siū húi-bia̍t.
Tio̍h pàng-sak lín só͘ chòe it-chhè ê pháiⁿ-sū, ōaⁿ chi̍t lia̍p sin ê sim, sin ê sîn! Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ ài-beh sí?
Góa bô ài ū lâng sí. Lín hóe-kái chiū ōe-tàng pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Lí tio̍h ūi Í-sek-lia̍t ê léng-siù chhiùⁿ ai-ko:
Lí ê lāu-bú sī sai-bú, phak tī sai-kûn ê tiong-kan; i tī ióng-béng ê sai tiong-kan ióng-io̍k sòe-chiah sai.
I kā chi̍t chiah sòe-chiah sai-á chhī tōa-chiah, hō͘ i chiâⁿ-chòe siàu-chòng ê sai, o̍h ōe-hiáu lia̍h la̍h-bu̍t, thun-chia̍h lâng.
Lia̍t-kok thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū ēng hām-khiⁿ kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, ēng kau-á kā i thoa-khì Ai-ki̍p.
Sai-bú khòaⁿ-kìⁿ i ê kî-thāi lo̍k-khong, sim choa̍t-bāng; chiū koh chhī chi̍t chiah sòe-chiah sai-á, hō͘ i chiâⁿ-chòe siàu-chòng ê sai.
Siàu-chòng ê sai tī sai-kûn tiong kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì; i o̍h ōe-hiáu lia̍h la̍h-bu̍t, thun-chia̍h lâng.
I phò-hoāi siâⁿ-pó, húi-hoāi siâⁿ-tìn; i hm̄-hm̄-háu, chèng-lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, choân-tōe pha-hng.
Chiu-ûi ê lia̍t-kok tùi sì-bīn ûi-kong i; in siat lô-bāng, ó͘ hām-khiⁿ, kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi.

In ēng kau-á kā i kau--teh, koaiⁿ-ji̍p lông-á lāi, tòa-khì Pa-pí-lûn -ông hia; in kā i koaiⁿ tī kian-kò͘ ê kaⁿ-lô, Í-sek-lia̍t ê chèng-soaⁿ bô koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ i hm̄-hm̄-háu ê siaⁿ.
Lí ê lāu-bú chhin-chhiūⁿ phû-tô-chhiū, chai tī khoe-chúi piⁿ, in-ūi chúi-goân chhiong-chiok, ki-hio̍h bō͘-sēng, gâu kiat ké-chí.

I ê chhiū-ki ióng koh tēng, thang chòe thóng-tī-chiá ê koáiⁿ. Chit-châng chhiū tōa-châng, pí bō͘-sēng ê chhiū-oe khah koân; i ê chhiū-ki thiu-koân, hn̄g-hn̄g chiū khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h.

M̄-kú, chit-châng phû-tô-chhiū, in-ūi Siōng-tè ê siū-khì, liân kun pu̍ih--khí-lâi, hiat tī thô͘-kha, ké-chí hō͘ tang-hong chhe ta, tēng ê chhiū-ki siū at-tn̄g ko͘-tâ, hō͘ hé sio-sio--khì.
Taⁿ i siū sóa-chai tī khòng-iá, chèng tī ta-sò bô-chúi ê só͘-chāi.
Chhiū-châng to̍h-hé, sio-húi chhiū-oe kap ké-chí; i bô koh ū tēng ê chhiū-ki thang chòe thóng-tī-chiá ê koáiⁿ. Che sī chi̍t siú ai-ko; chit-siú ai-ko it-ti̍t liû-thoân.
Tē-chhit nî gō͘-ge̍h chhoe-cha̍p, ū kúi ê Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló lâi chē tī góa ê bīn-chêng, beh chai Siōng Chú ê chí-ì.
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t ê tiúⁿ-ló kóng, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lín lâi beh kiû-mn̄g góa ê chí-ì sī--bô? Góa kí góa éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè: Góa bô beh hō͘ lín mn̄g.’ Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Jîn-chú ah, lí beh sím-mn̄g in sī--bô? Nā sī, tio̍h hō͘ in chai in ê chó͘-sian só͘ chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.

Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa kéng-soán Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe góa chú-bîn ê sî, tī Ai-ki̍p -tōe hō͘ in bat góa; góa tùi Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi li̍p-sè kóng: Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.
Hit-sî, góa èng-ún beh chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p, kàu góa ūi-tio̍h in soán-tēng hit-tè lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe, sī bān-kok tiong siōng pûi koh súi ê tōe.

Góa kā in kóng: Lín ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h pàng-sak lín ê ba̍k-chiu só͘ kah-ì hiah-ê thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng; m̄-thang pài Ai-ki̍p ê ké-sîn lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī, in-ūi góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.

M̄-kú in pōe-ge̍k góa, m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn góa. In bô pàng-sak só͘ kah-ì hiah-ê thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng, mā bô khì-sak Ai-ki̍p ê ké-sîn. Hit-sî, góa siūⁿ-beh tī Ai-ki̍p chiong góa choân-pō͘ ê siū-khì lóng piàⁿ tī in sin-chiūⁿ.

Chóng-sī góa bô án-ni chòe. Góa bô beh hō͘ góa ê miâ tī in khiā-khí ê lia̍t-kok tiong siū siat-to̍k; in-ūi góa bat tī in khiā-khí ê lia̍t-kok jîn-bîn ê bīn-chêng tùi in kóng, góa beh chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p.’
“Só͘-í, góa chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p, kā in chhōa kàu khòng-iá.
Góa chiong góa ê kui-lē sù hō͘ in, chiong góa ê bēng-lēng kà-sī in, hō͘ chun-hêng ê lâng lóng thang pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā.
Góa koh chiong góa ê An-hioh-ji̍t sù hō͘ in, chòe góa kap in li̍p-iok ê kì-hō, hō͘ in chai, góa sī kā in hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê Siōng Chú.

M̄-kú, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soah tī khòng-iá pōe-ge̍k góa, bô chun-siú góa ê kui-lē, kū-choa̍t góa ê bēng-lēng; chun-hêng ê lâng chiah ōe-tàng pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā. In thiat-tóe ûi-hoān An-hioh-ji̍t. In-ūi án-ni, góa siūⁿ-beh tī khòng-iá chiong góa choân-pō͘ ê siū-khì lóng piàⁿ tī in sin-chiūⁿ, kā in siau-bia̍t.

Chóng-sī góa bô án-ni chòe. Góa bô beh hō͘ góa ê miâ tī in khiā-khí ê lia̍t-kok tiong siū siat-to̍k; in-ūi góa bat tī in khiā-khí ê lia̍t-kok jîn-bîn ê bīn-chêng tùi in kóng, góa beh chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p.
Só͘-í, góa tī khòng-iá ǹg in li̍p-sè, bô beh chhōa in ji̍p-khì góa beh sù hō͘ in hit-tè lâu lin kap bi̍t ê tōe, chiū-sī bān-kok tiong siōng pûi koh súi ê tōe.
In-ūi in khì-sak góa ê bēng-lēng, bô chun-siú góa ê kui-lē, ûi-hoān góa ê An-hioh-ji̍t, khì pài in ka-kī ê ngó͘-siōng.
“Sui-jiân án-ni, góa iû-goân khó-lîn in, bô tī khòng-iá kā in lóng-chóng siau-bia̍t.

Góa tī khòng-iá kā in ê jî-lú kéng-kò, m̄-thang chun-thàn in ê chó͘-sian só͘ tēng ê kui-lē, m̄-thang siú in ê bēng-lēng, m̄-thang pài in ê ngó͘-siōng lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī.
Góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè. Lín tio̍h sūn-thàn góa ê kui-lē, chun-hêng góa ê bēng-lēng;
tio̍h siú An-hioh-ji̍t chòe sèng-ji̍t, chòe góa kap lín li̍p-iok ê kì-hō, hō͘ lín chai góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè.

“M̄-kú, in ê jî-lú mā pōe-ge̍k góa. In bô sūn-thàn góa ê kui-lē, bô chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng, ûi-hoān An-hioh-ji̍t; chun-hêng ê lâng chiah ōe-tàng pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā. Góa siūⁿ-beh tī khòng-iá chiong góa choân-pō͘ ê siū-khì lóng piàⁿ tī in sin-chiūⁿ.

M̄-kú, góa kā góa ê chhiú kiu--tò-lâi. Góa án-ni chòe, sī bô beh hō͘ góa ê miâ siū bú-jio̍k, in-ūi lia̍t-kok ê jîn-bîn lóng ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi Ai-ki̍p chhōa--chhut-lâi.
Góa koh tī khòng-iá ǹg in li̍p-sè: Góa beh kā in hòng-tio̍k khì gōa-pang, sì-sòaⁿ tī lia̍t-kok,
in-ūi in bô chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng, khì-sak góa ê kui-lē, ûi-hoān An-hioh-ji̍t, kèng-pài in chó͘-sian ê ngó͘-siōng.
“Āu-lâi, góa kui-khì chiong bô hó ê kui-lē, bōe-tàng hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā ê bēng-lēng hō͘ in;
hō͘ in sio ka-kī ê tōa-kiáⁿ hiàn-chòe chè lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī. Góa beh hō͘ in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
“Só͘-í, jîn-chú ah, tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lín ê chó͘-sian tùi góa put-tiong, siat-to̍k góa.

Góa chhōa in kàu góa èng-ún beh hō͘ in ê thó͘-tōe. In chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h koân ê soaⁿ kap hoat kah chin ām ê chhiū, chiū tī hia hiàn-chè; in tī hia hiàn phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h kap tiān-chiú-chè, jiá góa siū-khì.
Góa mn̄g in: Lín khì hit-ê koân ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe sím-mi̍h? Chit-ê só͘-chāi kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu kiò-chòe Pa-bâ.’

Só͘-í, lí tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lín beh kè-sio̍k hoān lín chó͘-sian só͘ hoān ê chōe lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī sī--bô? Beh kè-sio̍k pài in só͘ pài khó-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng lâi hoān kan-îm sī--bô?

Lín kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu-teh sio ka-kī ê jî-lú hiàn chòe chè, pài ngó͘-siōng lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, góa kiám ōe-tàng hō͘ lín kiû-mn̄g? Góa Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kí góa éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè: Góa bô beh hō͘ lín mn̄g.
Lín sim-lāi siūⁿ: Goán beh chhin-chhiūⁿ lia̍t-kok, chhin-chhiūⁿ gōa-cho̍k-lâng, khì pài chhâ-thâu kap chio̍h-thâu. Lín ê sim-ì choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng si̍t-hiān.’”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa kí góa éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè, góa beh choh-ông, chhun-chhut tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú tī-lí lín, beh chiong góa ê tōa siū-khì piàⁿ tī lín sin-chiūⁿ.
Góa beh chhun-chhut tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú, ēng piàⁿ--chhut-lâi ê tōa siū-khì, chiong lín tùi bān-bîn tiong chhōa--chhut-lâi, tùi hun-sòaⁿ--khì ê lia̍t-kok chū-chi̍p lín.
Góa beh kā lín chhōa-khì gōa-cho̍k-lâng ê khòng-iá, tng-bīn kā lín sím-mn̄g.
Góa chá-chêng án-chóaⁿ tī Ai-ki̍p ê khòng-iá hêng-hoa̍t lín ê chó͘-sian, hiān-chāi beh chiàu án-ni kā lín hêng-hoa̍t. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
“Góa beh giâm-giâm koán-kàu lín, chhin-chhiūⁿ kò͘-iûⁿ ê bo̍k-chiá koán-lí iûⁿ-kûn, hō͘ lín chun-siú góa ê iok.

Góa beh tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì pōe-ge̍k kap tek-chōe góa ê lâng; góa beh kā in tùi kià-ku ê só͘-chāi chhōa--chhut-lâi, m̄-kú in bōe-tàng tńg-khì kò͘-hiong Í-sek-lia̍t. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.

“Koan-hē lín, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Sûi-chāi lín, lín nā bô beh ho̍k-chiông góa, chòe lín khì pài lín ê ngó͘-siōng! M̄-kú lín bōe-ēng-tit koh hiàn-chè hō͘ ngó͘-siōng lâi siat-to̍k góa ê sèng-miâ.’

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Lín só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng beh tī góa ê sèng-soaⁿ, chiū-sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê koân-soaⁿ kèng-pài góa. Góa beh chiap-la̍p lín, koh ài lín tòa chè-mi̍h, chho͘-se̍k ê lông-sán-bu̍t, kap it-chhè sîn-sèng ê lé-mi̍h lâi hiàn hō͘ góa.

Góa beh tùi bān-cho̍k ê tiong-kan kā lín chhōa--chhut-lâi, kā lín tùi sì-sòaⁿ--khì ê lia̍t-kok chū-chi̍p óa--lâi; hit-sî, góa beh chiap-la̍p lín chhin-chhiūⁿ chiap-siū phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h; lia̍t-kok beh in-ūi lín chai, góa sī sîn-sèng--ê.
Góa beh kā lín chhōa tńg-khì lín ê kò͘-hiong Í-sek-lia̍t, chiū-sī góa èng-ún beh hō͘ lín chó͘-sian ê thó͘-tōe, hit-sî, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
Lín beh tī hia siūⁿ-khí í-chêng só͘ chòe it-chhè phah lâ-sâm ka-kī ê sū, in-ūi ka-kī só͘ chòe siâ-ok ê sū iàm-ò͘ⁿ ka-kī.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, góa ūi-tio̍h góa ê miâ bô chiàu lín ê siâ-ok kap lín só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ-sū kā lín hêng-hoa̍t ê sî, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’ Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Siōng Chú kā góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí khòaⁿ lâm-pêng, kā lâm-hng kéng-kò, tùi Nî-kek-hu ê chhiū-nâ kóng ū-giân.

Tio̍h kā Nî-kek-hu ê chhiū-nâ kóng, ‘Tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú só͘ kóng ê ōe. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh tī lín hia pàng-hé, kā chhiū-nâ lāi só͘-ū ê chhiū-ba̍k, bô-lūn sī chhiⁿ-chhùi--ê á-sī ko͘-tâ--ê, lóng sio-liáu-liáu. Béng-lia̍t ê hé-iām phah bōe hoa, tùi lâm kàu pak, kā tōe-bīn ê it-chhè sio kah chhùn-chháu-put-liû.
Ta̍k-ê lâng lóng ōe chai, che sī góa Siōng Chú pàng ê hé, it-tēng phah bōe hoa.’”
M̄-kú góa kóng, “Ài, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, mài kiò góa chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì. Lâng lóng án-ni kóng góa, chit-ê lâng put-sî teh kóng hàm-kó͘.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h bīn ǹg Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, thoân-káng kong-kek sèng-tiān ê ōe, kóng kéng-kò Í-sek-lia̍t ê ū-giân.
Tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, góa Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh kap lí choh-tùi, beh pu̍ih to thâi lín, hó-lâng pháiⁿ-lâng lóng châu-bia̍t.
Góa beh châu-bia̍t lín tiong-kan hó-lâng kap pháiⁿ-lâng, só͘-í góa beh pu̍ih to, tùi lâm thâi kàu pak, thâi-sí só͘-ū ê lâng.
Ta̍k-ê lâng chiū ōe chai, góa Siōng Chú to chi̍t-ē pu̍ih-chhut, chiū bô koh siu-hôe.’
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h tī in ê bīn-chêng thó͘-khùi, chhin-chhiūⁿ khó͘-thàng chhoeh-sim ê lâng.

Nā ū lâng mn̄g lí, ‘Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ thó͘-khùi?’ Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘In-ūi ū hong-siaⁿ thoân--lâi, jîn-sim-hông-hông, lâng-lâng kha-nńg chhiú-nńg, sit-chì phòa-táⁿ. Chai-hō kàu lah, it-tēng ōe hoat-seng.’” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h kóng ū-giân, tio̍h kóng Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Ū chi̍t ki to, bôa-lāi-lāi koh chhit kah kim-sih-sih.

Bôa-lāi-lāi sī beh thâi-lâng, chhit kah kim-sih-sih sī beh hō͘ i chhin-chhiūⁿ sih-nà. Góa ê chú-bîn m̄ thiaⁿ koáiⁿ-á ê kéng-kò, m̄ kiaⁿ chhê-á ê hêng-hoa̍t. Án-ni, lán ū sím-mi̍h thang khoài-lo̍k?
To í-keng chhit kah kim-sih-sih thang ēng lah; to í-keng bôa-lāi, beh kau hō͘ sat-chhiú lah.

“Jîn-chú ah, tio̍h pi-siong thî-khàu! To-kiàm beh lîm-kàu góa ê chú-bîn, beh lîm-kàu Í-sek-lia̍t ê léng-siù; in beh kap góa ê chú-bîn chòe-hé siū thâi. Lí tio̍h tûi-heng thó͘-khùi.
Lín siūⁿ khòaⁿ-bāi, to-kiàm liân ū koân-pèng ê koáiⁿ-á to m̄ kiaⁿ, iáu ū sím-mi̍h bōe hoat-seng? Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
“Só͘-í, jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h siū-khì tǹg toh-á kóng ū-giân: Ū chi̍t ki to chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn put-toān teh phut, thâi-sí lâng, kā lâng ûi-khùn tô͘-sat.
Góa beh tī in só͘-ū ê siâⁿ-mn̂g piⁿ chí-phài chit-ki to khì tô͘-sat, hō͘ góa ê chú-bîn phòa-táⁿ, poa̍h-tó. Ài ah, chit-ki bôa-lāi-lāi chhit kah kim-sih-sih ê to teh tô͘-sat!
To ah, lí tio̍h phut chiàⁿ-pêng, phut tò-pêng; to-mî ǹg tó chi̍t pêng chiū phut hit-pêng.
Góa mā beh tǹg toh-á, góa ê siū-khì chiah ōe siau. Góa Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h chiong Pa-pí-lûn -ông tòa to-kiàm lâi chìn-kong ê nn̄g tiâu lō͘-sòaⁿ ōe--chhut-lâi; chit nn̄g tiâu lō͘-sòaⁿ lóng tio̍h tùi kâng chi̍t ê kok-ka choh khí-tiám, koh tī chit-tiâu lō͘ hun-chhe beh khì bô kâng-khoán siâⁿ-chhī ê só͘-chāi chhāi lō͘-phiau.
To-kiàm beh keng-kè ê lō͘, chi̍t tiâu ǹg A-bûn ê La-pa -siâⁿ, chi̍t tiâu ǹg Iû-tāi kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Pa-pí-lûn -ông kàu hun-chhe-lō͘, tī lō͘-kháu iô-chìⁿ pok-kòa, chhâ-khòaⁿ hiàn-chòe seng-lé ê koaⁿ, kiû-mn̄g i ê ngó͘-siōng.

I ê chiàⁿ-chhiú the̍h--tio̍h ê chìⁿ sī kí kong-táⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chìⁿ, kà in chún-pī lòng-siâⁿ ê thûi, hā-lēng tô͘-sat, tōa-siaⁿ háng-hoah, chō thô͘-tui, khí koân-tâi, ēng lòng-siâⁿ ê thûi kong-táⁿ siâⁿ-mn̂g.

Tùi hiah-ê chiù-chōa kap Pa-pí-lûn kiat-bêng ê Iû-tāi -lâng khòaⁿ--khí-lâi, pok-kòa ê chí-sī m̄-tio̍h; m̄-kú Pa-pí-lûn -ông beh hō͘ in ōe-kì-tit ka-kī só͘ hoān ê chōe, mā beh kā in lia̍h--khì.”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Lín ê chōe-kò í-keng lō͘-hiān, chèng-lâng lóng chai lín ê kè-hoān; lín ê hêng-ûi hián-chhut lín ê chōe-ok. Lín it-tēng ōe siū hêng-hoa̍t, hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì.
“Lí chit-ê siâ-ok kai-sí ê Í-sek-lia̍t -ông, lí chōe-ok koàn-boán, siū hêng-hoa̍t ê sî-kan kàu lah.

Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Kā ông-koan chhái--khí-lâi! Kā lé-bō the̍h--lo̍h-lâi! Chêng-hêng bô koh chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-chêng, tāi-chì beh kái-piàn, bô koân-le̍k ê lâng siū ko-seng, thóng-tī-chiá beh lo̍h-tâi.

Góa beh kā chit-ê siâⁿ húi-hoāi, húi-hoāi, koh-chài húi-hoāi. Tán góa chí-phài lâi hêng-hoa̍t ê lâng kàu, chit-ê kok chiū bô koh chûn-chāi. Hit-sî góa beh chiong kok kau hō͘ i.’”

“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h kóng ū-giân, kóng, ‘Koan-hē A-bûn -lâng kap in tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê lêng-jio̍k, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Ū chi̍t ki bôa-lāi-lāi, chhit kah kim-sih-sih ê to, í-keng pu̍ih-chhut beh thâi-lâng.

Lín khòaⁿ ê īⁿ-siōng sī hoàn-sióng, pok-kòa tit--tio̍h ê ū-giân sī pe̍h-chha̍t. To beh chām-tn̄g lín ê ām-kún. Lín ê chōe-ok koàn-boán, lín siū hêng-hoa̍t ê sî-kan kàu lah.
“‘Siu to ji̍p siù! Góa beh tī lí ê kò͘-hiong, lí chhut-sì tōa-hàn ê só͘-chāi sím-phòaⁿ lí.
Góa beh ǹg lí piàⁿ-lo̍h góa ê thòng-hūn, ēng góa tōa siū-khì ê hé kā lí sio. Góa beh kā lí kau hō͘ iá-bân chân-jím ê sat-chhiú.
Lí beh chhin-chhiūⁿ chhâ hō͘ hé sio; lí ê huih beh lâu tī chit-tè thó͘-tōe, bô lâng koh ōe-kì-tit lí. Góa Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h giâm-giâm sím-phòaⁿ chit-ê lâu lâng ê huih ê siâⁿ! Tio̍h hō͘ i chheng-chhó chai ka-kī só͘ chòe it-chhè khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.
Lí tio̍h kóng, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lí ū sat-hāi chin chōe lâng ê sìⁿ-miā, koh pài ngó͘-siōng phah lâ-sâm ka-kī; lí siū hêng-hoa̍t ê sî kàu lah.

Lí hoān thâi-lâng ê chōe, koh hō͘ ka-kī chō ê ngó͘-siōng phah lâ-sâm; lí ê sî-ji̍t kàu lah, lí ê hè-sò͘ móa lah. Só͘-í, góa beh hō͘ lí siū lia̍t-kok lêng-jio̍k, siū bān-cho̍k thí-chhiò.
Lí chit-ê hūn-loān koh chhàu-miâ móa thiⁿ-ē ê siâⁿ, bô-lūn sī hn̄g á-sī kūn ê kok-ka lóng beh thí-chhiò lí.
“‘Lí khòaⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t ê siú-léng lām-iōng koân-le̍k, sat-hāi jîn-bîn.
Lín ū lâng ngó͘-ge̍k pē-bú, khi-ap kià-ku--ê, pháiⁿ khoán-thāi ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū.
Lín biáu-sī góa ê sèng-só͘, bô siú An-hioh-ji̍t.
Lín ū lâng chō-iâu hāi-sí lâng; ū lâng chia̍h soaⁿ-téng sîn-biō ê chè-mi̍h, kiâⁿ îm-loān.
Lín ū lâng kap lāu-pē ê bó͘ ū sèng-koan-hē, kap keng-kî tiong ê hū-jîn-lâng chòe-hé khùn;
ū lâng kap pa̍t-lâng ê bó͘ su-thong; ū lâng kiâⁿ îm-loān bú-jio̍k sin-pū; ū lâng kā kâng-pē ê chí-bē phah lâ-sâm.

Lín ū lâng the̍h chîⁿ thâi-lâng; ū lâng m̄-nā chioh lâng chîⁿ the̍h lī-sek, koh pàng tāng-lī; ū lâng pak-siah chhù-piⁿ thàn put-gī-chi-châi. Lín í-keng kā góa bōe-kì--tit lah. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
“‘In-ūi lín the̍h put-gī-chi-châi kap hoān thâi-lâng ê chōe, góa siū-khì tǹg toh-á.
Tng góa hêng-hoa̍t lín ê sî, lín kiám chih-chài ōe tiâu? Lín ê chhiú kiám iáu ū khùi-la̍t? Góa Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, it-tēng án-ni chòe.
Góa beh kā lí ê chū-bîn kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ khì lia̍t-kok, sì-sòaⁿ tī lia̍t-pang. Góa beh siau-tû lí ê ù-òe.
Lín beh siū lia̍t-kok bú-jio̍k, án-ni lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, góa khòaⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sī chi̍t tui che-tái. In chhin-chhiūⁿ thê-liān gûn chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê tâng, thih, siah, iân ê che-tái.
Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘In-ūi lín chiâⁿ-chòe bô lō͘-ēng ê che-tái, góa beh kā lín chū-chi̍p tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng siu-chi̍p gûn, tâng, thih, siah, iân tī tōa hé-lô͘ thê-liān, góa beh tī góa ê tōa siū-khì tiong kā lín chū-chi̍p tī chit-ê siâⁿ-lāi sio-iûⁿ.
Góa it-tēng beh chū-chi̍p lín, ēng góa tōa siū-khì ê iām-hé kā lín sio, lín beh tī hé-tiong siau-iûⁿ.

Gûn án-chóaⁿ tī thê-liān ê hé-lô͘ lāi-bīn iûⁿ--khì, lín mā beh án-ni tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siâⁿ-lāi siau-iûⁿ. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa Siōng Chú ǹg lín piàⁿ tōa siū-khì lah.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, ‘Lín ê thó͘-tōe sī bô chheng-khì ê tōe. Só͘-í, tī góa tōa siū-khì hêng-hoa̍t lín ê sî, bô beh lo̍h-hō͘ hō͘ lín.’
In ê sian-ti kè-bô͘ pháiⁿ-sū, chhin-chhiūⁿ hm̄-hm̄-háu ê sai thiah-li̍h la̍h-bu̍t. In sat-hāi jîn-bîn, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t châi-pó, hō͘ chin chōe hū-lú chiâⁿ-chòe kóaⁿ-hū.

Chè-si khiok-kái góa ê lu̍t-hoat, siat-to̍k góa ê sèng-mi̍h. In bô hun-pia̍t sím-mi̍h sī sîn-sèng kap bô sîn-sèng ê mi̍h, mā bô kà lâng hun-piān sím-mi̍h sī chheng-khì á-sī bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h, koh khin-sī góa ê An-hioh-ji̍t. Kiat-kó, góa tī in tiong-kan siū siat-to̍k.
In ê léng-siù chhin-chhiūⁿ chhâi-lông lia̍h la̍h-bu̍t thiah-li̍h in; in ūi-tio̍h beh tit-tio̍h put-gī-chi-châi thâi-lâng chhú lâng ê sìⁿ-miā.

Sian-ti kā hiah-ê léng-siù am-khàm chōe-ok, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ēng pe̍h-he boah piah. In khòaⁿ ê īⁿ-siōng sī ké--ê, kóng ê ū-giân sī pe̍h-chha̍t. In kóng ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng’, kî-si̍t, góa Siōng Chú pèng bô kā in kóng sím-mi̍h.
Tòa tī chia ê jîn-bîn koàn-sì ap-chè lâng, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t lâng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, khi-hū sàn-chhiah khùn-khó͘ ê lâng, pak-siah kià-ku ê lâng, lóng bô chiàu kong-tō.

Góa tī in tiong-kan teh chhē, khòaⁿ sī m̄-sī ū lâng tī góa ê bīn-chêng ūi-tio̍h chit-ê kok-ka siu-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, khiā tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ phòa-khiah ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ góa bōe kā chit-ê kok-ka húi-bia̍t, m̄-kú chhē lóng bô.

Só͘-í, góa tùi in piàⁿ-lo̍h góa ê hùn-lō͘; góa ê tōa siū-khì beh chhin-chhiūⁿ hé kā in sio. Góa beh chiàu in ê só͘-chòe kā in pò-èng.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, í-chêng ū chi̍t tùi chí-bē, sī kâng lāu-bú siⁿ--ê.
In tòa tī Ai-ki̍p, siàu-liân ê sî chiū chòe ki-lú; chāi-sek-lú ê sî chiū hō͘ lâng bong in ê lin, sńg in ê seng-khu.
Tōa-chí kiò-chòe A-hô-la, chiū-sī Sat-má-lī-a; sió-bē kiò-chòe A-hô-lī-pa, chiū-sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. Góa chhōa in nn̄g chí-bē; in lóng thòe góa siⁿ gín-á.
“ A-hô-la kè góa liáu-āu kè-sio̍k chòe ki-lú. I bê-loân i ê ài-jîn A-su̍t.
In sī chhēng nâ-sek ê saⁿ ê léng-siù kap kun-koaⁿ, lóng sī khiâ-bé ê chiàn-sū, eng-chùn ê siàu-liân-lâng.
I kap chiah-ê A-su̍t -lâng tiong-kan phiau-phiat ê siàu-liân-lâng kiâⁿ-îm, pài in ê ngó͘-siōng lâi phah lâ-sâm ka-kī.

I bô lī-khui tùi Ai-ki̍p ê sî chiū ū ê îm-loān. I tī siàu-liân ê sî, chiū hō͘ lâng kap i khùn; tī chāi-sek-lú ê sî, chiū hō͘ lâng bong i ê lin. Lâng kā i tòng-chòe hòng-chhiòng chêng-io̍k ê tùi-siōng.
Só͘-í, góa chiong i kau tī i loân-bō͘ ê ài-jîn A-su̍t ê chhiú-tiong.
In kā i thǹg-kng-kng, lia̍h i ê kiáⁿ-jî, koh ēng to kā i thâi-sí. I siū ê hêng-hoa̍t, hō͘ i tī hū-jîn-lâng ê tiong-kan lâu chhàu-miâ.”
“I ê sió-bē A-hô-lī-pa sui-jiân ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì, khiok pí i ê tōa-chí A-hô-la koh-khah tūi-lo̍h, koh-khah îm-loān.
I mā bê-loân A-su̍t -lâng; in sī chhēng choân-hù-kun-chong ê léng-siù kap kun-koaⁿ, lóng sī khiâ-bé ê chiàn-sū, eng-chùn ê siàu-liân-lâng.
Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ i tūi-lo̍h phah lâ-sâm ka-kī; in chí-bē-á kiâⁿ kâng tiâu lō͘.
“ A-hô-lī-pa pí i ê tōa-chí koh-khah îm-loān. I khòaⁿ-kìⁿ khek tī piah--ni̍h hiah-ê chhat chu-âng-sek ê Pa-pí-lûn -lâng ê siōng;
in hâ io-tòa, thâu-khak pau ê thâu-kun sûi hong phiau-iông, khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ tī Ka-le̍k-tí chhut-sì ê Pa-pí-lûn chí-hui-koaⁿ.
A-hô-lī-pa chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ--kìⁿ chiū loân-bō͘ in, phài sù-chiá khì Pa-pí-lûn kìⁿ in.
Pa-pí-lûn -lâng chiū lâi kap i khùn, kā i bú-jio̍k phah lâ-sâm. I siū phah lâ-sâm liáu-āu, chiū kap in so͘-oán.
I kong-jiân chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, hián-lō͘ i ê îm-hēng. Só͘-í, góa kap i so͘-oán, chhin-chhiūⁿ khah-chá kap i ê tōa-chí so͘-oán siâng-khoán.
I su-liām siàu-liân ê sî tī Ai-ki̍p chòe ki-lú ê ji̍t-chí, ke-thiⁿ ka-kī ê îm-hēng.
I bê-loân thé-keh chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-lû hiah-ni̍h chòng, cheng-le̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-bé hiah-ni̍h chiok ê ài-jîn.
A-hô-lī-pa ah, lí khat-bō͘ lí siàu-liân ê sî ê îm-hēng. Lí siàu-liân ê sî tī Ai-ki̍p chiū chòe ki-lú, hō͘ lâng bong lí ê lin, sńg lí ê seng-khu.”
“Só͘-í, A-hô-lī-pa ah, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni tùi lí kóng, ‘Góa beh kek-tōng lí so͘-oán ê ài-jîn lâi kong-kek lí. Góa beh chhōa in lâi, tùi sì-bīn kong-kek lí.

In ū Pa-pí-lûn -lâng, Ka-le̍k-tí -lâng, Pí-kat -lâng, Su-a -lâng, Ko-a -lâng, koh ū A-su̍t -lâng kap in chòe-hé lâi; in lóng sī phiau-phiat ê siàu-liân-lâng, sī khiâ-bé ê léng-siù, kun-koaⁿ, kap chiàn-sū.

In beh chhōa tāi-kun, ēng kun-khì, chiàn-chhia, kap pó͘-kip-chhia lâi kong-kek lí. In giâ tōa sió tún-pâi, chhēng chiàn-kah, tì thâu-khoe, tùi sì-bīn ûi-kong lí. In beh thòe góa kā lí hêng-hoa̍t, chiàu in ê hoat-lu̍t sím-phòaⁿ lí.

Góa in-ūi oàn-tò͘ kong-kek lí, hō͘ in hoat tōa siū-khì tùi-hù lí. In beh koah lí ê phīⁿ-á kap hī-á, thâi-sí lí chhun ê jîn-bîn. In beh lia̍h lí ê hāu-siⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, kā chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng sio-sí.
In beh pak lí ê saⁿ, chhiúⁿ lí kùi-tiōng ê chu-pó.
Góa beh hō͘ lí bô koh hoān tùi Ai-ki̍p chiū ū ê îm-hēng, hō͘ lí bô koh su-liām Ai-ki̍p, bô koh kî-thāi in ê pang-chān.’
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh kóng, ‘Góa beh kā lí kau hō͘ lí oàn-hūn so͘-oán ê lâng.

In beh ēng oàn-hūn tùi-thāi lí, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t lí lô-lo̍k tit--lâi ê châi-bu̍t, kā lí thǹg-kng-kng. Lí îm-loān ê seng-khu kap hêng-ûi lóng beh lō͘-hiān hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. Che sī lí ê io̍k-bōng kap îm-hēng jiá--lâi-ê.
Lí choh lia̍t-kok ê chhiong-ki, pài in ê ngó͘-siōng phah lâ-sâm ka-kī.
Lí kiâⁿ lín tōa-chí kiâⁿ--kè ê lō͘, só͘-í góa beh the̍h i lim--kè hêng-hoa̍t ê poe hō͘ lí lim.’
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lí beh lim lí ê tōa-chí ê poe; chit-ê poe chhim koh tōa, tóe-móa hêng-hoa̍t. Lí beh hō͘ lâng thí-chhiò ki-chhì.
Lí ê tōa-chí Sat-má-lī-a lim ê poe, sī hō͘ lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, chhiⁿ-chhám ê chiú-poe; lí beh chùi-bâng-bâng, tōa iu-khó͘.
Lí beh lim chit-ê poe, lim kàu ta-ta; lí beh siak-phòa chit-ê poe, koh koah-siong lí ê lin. Chiah-ê sū góa í-keng kóng--kè, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
“Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘In-ūi lí bōe-kì-tit góa, chiong góa hiat tī ka-chiah-āu, lí beh sêng-siū lí ê io̍k-bōng kap îm-hēng chō-sêng ê hō͘-kó.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h sím-phòaⁿ A-hô-la kap A-hô-lī-pa! Lí tio̍h chí-chhut in só͘ chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.
In hoān kan-îm kap thâi-lâng ê chōe. In pài ngó͘-siōng kiâⁿ kan-îm, chiong in kap góa siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-jî sio hō͘ ngó͘-siōng chòe chia̍h-mi̍h.
M̄-nā án-ni, in kâng hit-ji̍t phah lâ-sâm góa ê sèng-tiān, kan-hoān góa ê An-hioh-ji̍t.
In thâi in ê kiáⁿ-jî hiàn hō͘ ngó͘-siōng, kâng hit-ji̍t koh chìn-ji̍p góa ê sèng-tiān kā i siat-to̍k. Che chiū-sī in tī góa ê sèng-tiān só͘-chòe ê tāi-chì!
“In koh phài sù-chiá khì chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi chhiáⁿ ta-po͘-lâng lâi. Ta-po͘-lâng lâi, in nn̄g ê chí-bē chiū sóe seng-khu, boah hún, ōe ba̍k-chiu ba̍k-bâi, kòa chu-pó.
In chē tī súi ê bîn-chhn̂g, chiong kèng-pài góa ê phang-iû hē tī bîn-chhn̂g thâu piⁿ--á ê toh-á téng.
Ū kui-tīn tùi khòng-iá lâi ê lâng tī hia lim-chiú hi-hi-hōa-hōa; in chiong chhiú-khoân kòa tī nn̄g ê chí-bē ê chhiú--ni̍h, chiong hoa-koan tì tī in ê thâu-khak téng.
Kóng-tio̍h chit-tùi chí-bē-á, in hòng-chhiòng îm-loān tì-kàu soe-ló, hiān-chāi lâng iáu lâi kap in kiâⁿ-îm, in mā kap lâng kiâⁿ-îm.
Lâng it-chài lâi kap A-hô-la, A-hô-lī-pa nn̄g ê chí-bē-á kiâⁿ-îm, kā in tòng-chòe ki-lú; in chòe ki-lú kap ta̍k-ê lâng khùn.
Kong-chèng ê lâng tio̍h phòaⁿ in hoān îm-loān kap thâi-lâng ê chōe; in-ūi in kiâⁿ-îm, chhiú bak thâi-lâng ê huih.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Góa beh tiàu-chi̍p chi̍t tōa-tīn kûn-chiòng lâi kong-kek in, hō͘ in kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kā in lia̍h--khì.
Kûn-chiòng beh ēng chio̍h-thâu kā in tìm-sí, ēng to-kiàm thâi-sí in kap in ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, pàng-hé sio in ê chhù.
Góa beh hō͘ chit-ê kok-ka bô koh kiâⁿ-îm, thang kéng-kài só͘-ū ê hū-jîn-lâng, m̄-thang o̍h in ê îm-hēng.
Lâng beh chiàu lín ê îm-hēng hêng-hoa̍t lín; lín beh sêng-tam pài ngó͘-siōng ê chōe. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú.”
Tē-káu nî cha̍p-ge̍h chhoe-cha̍p, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h ūi kin-á-ji̍t chit-ê te̍k-pia̍t ê ji̍t-chí chòe kì-lio̍k, in-ūi kin-á-ji̍t Pa-pí-lûn -ông khai-sí ûi-kong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Lí tio̍h ǹg chit-ê pōe-ge̍k ê chú-bîn kóng phì-jū, kā in kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Kā e-á hē tī hé téng-bīn, hē hó-sè, tò-chúi tī e-á lāi-bīn.
Chiong chhiat-chòe chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè siōng-hó ê bah, chiū-sī keng-thâu-bah kap thúi-bah, kap siōng-hó ê kut-thâu, kā e-á tóe-móa-móa;
chhú iûⁿ-kûn tiong siōng-hó ê iûⁿ-á. Chiong chhâ khǹg tī e-á ē-bīn, kā hiah-ê kut-thâu kap bah chú hō͘ kún.

“‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Chhám ah, chit-ê lâu lâng ê huih ê siâⁿ, siⁿ-sian m̄-bat lù--kè ê e-á! Lāi-bīn ê bah m̄-bián thiu-chhiam kéng, tio̍h chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè lóng kā ngoeh--chhut-lâi.
Chit-ê siâⁿ iáu ū thâi-lâng lâu-chhut ê huih; huih piàⁿ tī kng-ku̍t ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng-bīn, m̄-sī tò tī thô͘-kha, ōe-tàng ēng thô͘ khàm.
Sī góa hō͘ chit-ê siâⁿ chiong thâi-lâng lâu-chhut ê huih piàⁿ tī kng-ku̍t ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng-bīn; bōe-tàng ēng thô͘ khàm, sī beh kek-tōng góa ê siū-khì, kā in pò-èng.
“‘Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Chhám ah, chit-ê lâu lâng ê huih ê siâⁿ! Góa beh chhin-sin thia̍p chi̍t-tōa-tui chhâ.
Thiⁿ khah chōe chhiū-oe, hō͘ hé khah iām, kā bah chú hō͘ nōa, thng khòng kah ta--khì, liân kut to chhàu-hé-ta!
Liáu-āu, chiong khang ê e-á hē tī hé téng-bīn, hō͘ e-á jia̍t, kā tâng sio âng, hō͘ lāi-bīn ê lah-sap iûⁿ--khì, e-á chiū bô koh ū sian.
M̄-kú só͘-ū ê lô-lo̍k lóng bô-chhái-kang, e-á kāu-kāu ê sian ēng hé mā tû bōe khì.

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, e-á ê sian chiū-sī lí ê îm-hēng. Góa siūⁿ-beh kā lí sóe chheng-khì, m̄-kú lí m̄-khéng. Só͘-í, tī góa tùi lí hoat tōa siū-khì í-chêng, lí ê lah-sap bōe-tàng tû--khì.

Góa Siōng Chú bat kóng: Góa chhái-chhú hêng-tōng ê sî-ki kàu lah. Góa bōe kái-piàn sim-ì, bô beh lîn-bín, mā bô beh khoan-iông. Góa beh chiàu lí ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe kā lí sím-phòaⁿ. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, góa beh hō͘ lí sim-ài ê lâng hut-jiân sí--khì, m̄-kú lí bōe-ēng-tit ai-siong, thî-khàu, mā bōe-ēng-tit lâu ba̍k-sái.

Lí thang tiām-tiām-á thó͘-khùi, m̄-kú bōe-ēng-tit kā i pān song-sū. Lí tio̍h pa̍k thâu-kun, kha chhēng-ôe; m̄-thang ng chhùi-chhiu piáu-sī ai-siong, m̄-thang chia̍h ūi-tio̍h song-ka chún-pī ê chia̍h-mi̍h.”
Hit chá-khí góa kā lâng kóng chit-ê sū, hit-mî góa ê bó͘ chiū sí--khì. Keh-chá-khí, góa chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng khì chòe.
Lâng mn̄g góa, “Lí ná bô beh kā goán kóng, lí chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì tùi goán ū sím-mi̍h ì-sù?”
Góa kā in kóng, “Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng-ōe,

kiò góa kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lín chiong sèng-tiān tòng-chòe siōng khoa-iāu ê óa-khò, ba̍k-chiu só͘ ì-ài, sim-lêng ê kià-thok, m̄-kú góa beh hō͘ góa ê sèng-tiān siū siat-to̍k. Lín lâu tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ lóng beh hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.
Hit-sî, lín beh chiàu góa só͘ chòe--ê khì chòe. Lín m̄-thang ng chhùi-chhiu piáu-sī ai-siong, m̄-thang chia̍h ūi-tio̍h song-ka chún-pī ê chia̍h-mi̍h;
lín mā tio̍h pa̍k thâu-kun, kha chhēng-ôe, m̄-thang ai-siong thî-khàu. Lín beh in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe-ok soe-lám, bīn-tùi-bīn haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan.
Siōng Chú kóng: Í-se-kiat chiū-sī lín ê tiāu-thâu; i chòe--ê, lín mā lóng beh chòe. Kàu hit-sî, lín chiū chai góa sī Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú.’”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, hit-ji̍t góa beh thiah-húi lín óa-khò ê pó-lúi, khoa-iāu ê êng-kng, ba̍k-chiu ì-ài ê sèng-tiān, mā beh thâi-sí lín ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ;
kâng hit-ji̍t, tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tô-cháu--chhut-lâi ê lâng beh lâi lí chia, kā lí kóng chiah-ê tāi-chì.
Hit-ji̍t, lí bô koh tiām-tiām bōe kóng-ōe; lí beh khui-chhùi tùi chiah-ê tô-thoat ê lâng kóng-ōe. Án-ni, lí beh chiâⁿ-chòe in ê tiāu-thâu, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h tùi A-bûn -lâng kóng ū-giân kong-kek in,

kā in kóng, ‘Tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe! Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa ê sèng-tiān siū siat-to̍k, Í-sek-lia̍t ê thó͘-tōe pha-hng, Iû-tāi -lâng siū hòng-tio̍k ê sî, lín kèng-jiân kóng: Ha ha, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng mā ū chit chi̍t ji̍t o͘h!

Só͘-í, góa beh hō͘ tang-hng lâi ê bîn-cho̍k cheng-ho̍k lín, chiàm lín ê thó͘-tōe chòe in ê sán-gia̍p. In beh tī lín ê thó͘-tōe chat-iâⁿ, tēng-ku, chia̍h lín chhân-hn̂g ê chhut-sán, lim lín iûⁿ-kûn ê lin.
Góa beh hō͘ La-pa -siâⁿ pìⁿ-chòe lo̍k-tô ê bo̍k-tiûⁿ, hō͘ A-bûn -lâng ê tōe chiâⁿ-chòe iûⁿ-kûn tó-teh hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
“‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh kóng: In-ūi lín chhiong-móa oàn-hūn, khòaⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe siū chai-lān chòe hoaⁿ-hí, chhiú phah-pho̍k-á, kha tiô-thiàu.

Só͘-í góa beh chhun-chhiú kong-kek lín, kā lín kau hō͘ lia̍t-kok chòe hu-ló͘; góa beh tùi bān-bîn tiong kā lín châu-bia̍t, hō͘ lín tùi bān-kok tiong siau-sit. Góa beh tû-bia̍t lín, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng, “In-ūi Mô͘-ap -lâng kap Í-tong -lâng kóng, Iû-tāi -kok kap pa̍t-ê kok-ka bô sím-mi̍h bô kâng,
só͘-í góa beh hō͘ Mô͘-ap pian-kài ê siâⁿ-tìn siū kong-kek, liân in siōng khoa-kháu ê siâⁿ-pó, Pek Iâ-se-boa̍t, Pa-le̍k Bián, kap Ki-lia̍t-têng, lóng siū kong-phòa.
Góa mā beh chiong A-bûn -lâng kap Mô͘-ap chòe-hé kau hō͘ tang-hng lâi ê bîn-cho̍k chòe sán-gia̍p, koh hō͘ lia̍t-kok bōe-kì-tit Mô͘-ap.
Góa it-tēng beh hêng-hoa̍t Mô͘-ap. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ Í-tong -lâng in-ūi tùi Iû-tāi -lâng pò-siû, in ê pò-siû hián-lō͘ in ke̍k-tōa ê chōe,

só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh hêng-hoa̍t Í-tong, kā in kap in ê cheng-siⁿ siau-bia̍t, hō͘ Í-tong tùi Thê-bān kàu Tí-tān ê thó͘-tōe lóng pha-hng, lâng siū thâi-sí.

Góa beh ēng góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê chhiú tùi Í-tong pò-ho̍k; in beh chiàu góa ke̍k-tōa ê siū-khì pò-ho̍k Í-tong. Hit-sî, Í-tong -lâng chiū chai che sī góa teh ǹg in pò-ho̍k.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ Hui-lī-sū -lâng ǹg Iû-tāi -lâng pò in kó͘-chá chiū kiat ê oan-siû, sim chûn ok-ì beh siau-bia̍t Iû-tāi -lâng.

Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò: Góa beh chhun-chhiú kong-kek Hui-lī-sū -lâng, châu-bia̍t Ki-lī-thê -lâng, liân tòa tī iân-hái pêng-goân chhun ê lâng mā beh siau-bia̍t.
