Góa beh giâm-giâm kā in pò-ho̍k, hoat tōa siū-khì hêng-hoa̍t in. Góa kā in pò-ho̍k ê sî, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Tē-cha̍p-it nî bó͘ chi̍t kò-ge̍h ê chhoe-it, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, in-ūi Thài-ní -lâng ǹg Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kóng, ‘Ha ha, hit-ê kap bān-kok chòe bō͘-e̍k ê siâⁿ í-keng húi-hoāi lah! Seng-lí lóng pìⁿ-chòe goán ê lah! I beh soe-bî, goán beh hoân-êng!’
“Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Thài-ní, góa beh kap lí choh-tùi! Góa beh tiàu-chi̍p lia̍t-kok, hō͘ in chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-éng giâ khí-lâi kong-táⁿ lí.
In beh húi-hoāi lí ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, thiah-húi lí ê siâⁿ-lâu. Góa mā beh kā só͘-ū ê thô͘ lóng pê chheng-khì, chhun kng-ku̍t ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ.
Hái-tiong ê Thài-ní beh pìⁿ-chòe pha̍k hî-bāng ê só͘-chāi. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò. I beh chiâⁿ-chòe lia̍t-kok ê la̍h-bu̍t,
i chiu-ûi siâⁿ-tìn ê chū-bîn beh hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.

“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh tiàu lia̍t-kok chi ông, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat, tòa-niá chiàn-bé, chiàn-chhia, bé-peng, tùi pak-hng lâi kong-táⁿ Thài-ní.
Lí chiu-ûi siâⁿ-tìn ê chū-bîn mā lóng beh siū châu-bia̍t; tùi-te̍k beh chō thô͘-tui, khí koân-tâi, gia̍h tún-pâi kong-táⁿ lí.
I beh ēng lòng-siâⁿ ê thûi kong-phòa lí ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, ēng thih-khì thiah-húi lí ê siâⁿ-lâu.

I tōa-kûn chiàn-bé ká--khí-lâi ê thô͘-hún beh kā lí jia-khàm. I ê bé-peng kap chiàn-chhia hoat-chhut ê siaⁿ hō͘ lí ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ tín-tāng. I beh ji̍p lí ê siâⁿ-mn̂g, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng tùi phòa-khiah ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ji̍p--khì.
I ê bé-peng beh thún-ta̍h lí ê tōa-koe-sió-hāng, ēng to-kiàm thâi-sí lí ê jîn-bîn. Lí ê sîn-biō kian-kò͘ ê tōa-thiāu beh tó tī thô͘-kha.
Tùi-te̍k beh chhiúⁿ lí ê châi-pó, toa̍t lí ê hè-mi̍h, chhia-tó lí ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, thiah-húi lí súi ê chhù-the̍h, kā chio̍h-thâu, chhâ, thô͘ lóng hiat-lo̍h hái.
Góa beh hō͘ lí bōe-tàng koh chhiùⁿ-koa, lâng bōe-tàng koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ lí tôaⁿ-khîm ê siaⁿ.
Góa beh hō͘ lí pìⁿ-chòe kng-ku̍t ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ, chòe pha̍k hî-bāng ê só͘-chāi; lí bô khó-lêng koh tiông-kiàn. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh tùi Thài-ní kóng, “Lí ê jîn-bîn siū tô͘-sat, siū-siong haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan ê sî, iân-hái ê chū-bîn kiám bōe in-ūi thiaⁿ-kìⁿ lí tó-hoāi ê siau-sit kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah?

Iân-hái kok-ka ê kun-ông lóng beh lī-khui in ê chō-ūi, kā ông-phàu kap siù-hoe ê saⁿ thǹg--khí-lâi, chē tī thô͘-kha, it-ti̍t kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah; lí ê kiat-kio̍k hō͘ in lóng gāng--khì.

In beh ūi lí chhiùⁿ ai-ko: Ah, lí chit-ê chhut-miâ ê siâⁿ, hiān-chāi kèng-jiân bia̍t-bông lah! Lí bat chheng-pà hái-siōng; lí kap lí ê jîn-bîn bat hō͘ só͘-ū tòa tī iân-hái ê lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Lí siū húi-bia̍t hit-ji̍t, hái-tó beh ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah; tòa tī hia ê lâng lóng beh in-ūi lí ê siau-bia̍t kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Góa beh hō͘ lí hong-hòe chhin-chhiūⁿ bô lâng khiā-khí ê siâⁿ. Góa beh ēng chhim-ian ê chúi khàm-kè lí, ēng tōa-chúi im-ba̍t lí.

Góa beh hō͘ lí kap lo̍h Chhim-khiⁿ ê lâng, chòe-hé lo̍h-khì kó͘-chá sí--khì ê lâng hia. Góa beh hō͘ lí kap lo̍h Chhim-khiⁿ ê lâng tòa tī tōe chhim, kó͘-chá chiū hong-hòe ê só͘-chāi. Lí bōe-tàng koh tī jîn-kan tián-ui.
Góa beh hō͘ lí tú-tio̍h khióng-pò͘ ê kiat-kio̍k, lí bô koh chûn-chāi; lâng beh chhē lí, éng-oán chhē bōe tio̍h.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h ūi Thài-ní chhiùⁿ ai-ko.

Lí tio̍h tùi tī hái-kháu, kap tī chin chōe iân-hái ê tó-sū chòe bō͘-e̍k ê Thài-ní kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Thài-ní ah, lí bat khoa-kháu ka-kī sī si̍p-choân-si̍p-bí ê siâⁿ-chhī.
Lí khok-tián lí ê pian-kài kàu hái ê tiong-sim; lí siū khí-chō chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t chiah oân-bí ê tōa-chûn.
In ēng Hek-bûn-soaⁿ ê siông-chhiū chòe chûn-pang, ēng Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū chòe chûn-ûi,
ēng Pa-san ê siōng-chhiū chòe chiúⁿ, ēng Sài-phó͘-lō͘-su ê n̂g-iông-bo̍k, siuⁿ chhiūⁿ-gê chòe chhn̂g-pang.
In ēng Ai-ki̍p siù-hoe ê iù-môa-pò͘ chòe phâng, lâng tùi hn̄g-hn̄g chiū khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h. In ēng Í-lī-sa iân-hōaⁿ ūn--lâi ê nâ-sek, chí-sek ê pò͘-liāu chòe pò͘-pîⁿ.
Ūi lí kò-chûn--ê sī Se-tùn -lâng kap A-hoat -lâng; ūi lí hōaⁿ-tōa--ê sī Thài-ní pún-tōe ê ko-chhiú.
Siu-lí chûn--ê sī Ka-pa-le̍k láu-liān ê sai-hū; tōa-hái lâi-óng ê chûn-chiah kap chûn-oân lóng lâi lí chia chòe seng-lí.
“‘Lí chhiàⁿ Pho-su -lâng, Lū-tí-a -lâng, kap Hut -lâng lâi lí ê kun-tūi chòe chiàn-sū. In kā tún-pâi kap thâu-khoe kòa tī lí ê iâⁿ-pâng, ke-thiⁿ lí ê ui-hong.

Tùi A-hoat chhiàⁿ--lâi ê chiàn-sū ūi lí siú-ōe siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ; lí ê siâⁿ-lâu mā ū Ka-má-tí -lâng teh kò͘-siú. In kā tún-pâi kòa tī lí ê piah-téng, hō͘ lí koh-khah chòng-koan.
“‘ Tha-si -lâng in-ūi lí ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chin chōe chiū lâi kau-koan, ēng gûn, thih, siah, kap iân, kau-ōaⁿ lí ê siong-phín.
Hi-la̍h -lâng, Thó͘-pa -lâng, Bí-siat -lâng kap lí chòe seng-lí, ēng lô͘-lē kap tâng-khì kau-ōaⁿ lí ê hè-mi̍h.
Tô-ka-má -lâng ēng bé, chiàn-bé, kap lô, kau-ōaⁿ lí ê hè-mi̍h.
Tí-tān -lâng kap lí chòe seng-lí, chin chōe hái-tó ê chū-bîn mā-sī lí ê kò͘-kheh; in ēng chhiūⁿ-gê, o͘-tôaⁿ-bo̍k kap lí kau-ōaⁿ hè-mi̍h.
A-lân -lâng in-ūi lí ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chin chōe chiū lâi kau-koan, ēng le̍k-pó-chio̍h, chí-sek-pò͘, siù-hoe-pò͘, iù-môa-pò͘, san-ô͘, kap âng-pó-chio̍h, kau-ōaⁿ lí ê siong-phín.
Iû-tāi -lâng, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng kap lí chòe seng-lí, ēng Bí-le̍k ê be̍h, piáⁿ, bi̍t, kaⁿ-ná-iû, jú-hiuⁿ kau-ōaⁿ lí ê hè-mi̍h.
In-ūi lí ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chin chōe, Tāi-má-sū-kek -lâng ēng Hek-pún ê chiú kap pe̍h iûⁿ-mn̂g kap lí kau-e̍k,
ēng O͘-sat ê chiú, cheng-liān ê thih, kùi-phê, phang ê chhiong-pô͘, kap lí kau-ōaⁿ hè-mi̍h.
Tí-tān -lâng ēng chū bé-oaⁿ ê thán-á kau-ōaⁿ lí ê hè-mi̍h.
A-la-pek kap Ki-ta̍t só͘-ū ê léng-siù ēng iûⁿ-ko, mî-iûⁿ-káng, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng kau-ōaⁿ lí ê hè-mi̍h.
Sī-pa kap La-má ê seng-lí-lâng ēng ko-kip hiuⁿ-liāu, chu-pó, n̂g-kim kau-ōaⁿ lí ê siong-phín.
Hap-lân, Kan-nî, I-tiân, Sī-pa ê seng-lí-lâng, A-su̍t, Ki-boat lóng lâi kap lí chòe seng-lí.
In chiong siōng-téng ê i-ho̍k, siù-hoe ê chí-sek-pò͘, chhái-sek ê tōe-thán, ēng soh-á pa̍k kah chin hó-sè, tòa-lâi chhī-tiûⁿ kap lí bóe-bōe.
Tha-si ê chûn-tūi kā lí ūn-sàng hè-mi̍h. Lí chhin-chhiūⁿ hái--ni̍h ê tōa-chûn, tóe-móa hè-mi̍h, chia̍h-chúi chin chhim.
Kò-chûn--ê kā lí kò kàu gōa-hái; tang-hong tī hái-tiong kā lí siàn-phòa.

Chûn phòa tîm--lo̍h-khì ê sî, lí ê châi-pó, siong-phín, hè-mi̍h, chûn-oân kap hōaⁿ-tōa--ê, siu-lí chûn--ê, hū-chek bóe-bōe--ê, chûn-téng ê kun-jîn kap só͘-ū ê lâng, lóng tîm-lo̍h hái-tóe.
Chûn tîm-lo̍h hái ê sî, chûn-oân hoah kiù-miā ê siaⁿ, hù-kūn iân-hái ê lâng lóng tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
“‘Kò-chûn--ê, chûn-oân, kap hōaⁿ-tōa--ê, lóng beh lo̍h-chûn chiūⁿ-hōaⁿ.
In beh ūi-tio̍h lí chhut-siaⁿ tōa khàu, thâu-khak sám thô͘-hún, tī hé-hu tiong kō-lâi-kō-khì.
In ūi-tio̍h lí thì kng-thâu, chhēng môa-saⁿ, siong-sim ai-khàu, thòng-khó͘ kàu-ke̍k.
In ūi-tio̍h lí thî-khàu ai-siong ê sî, ūi lí chhiùⁿ ai-ko: Ū tó chi̍t chō siâⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ Thài-ní, tîm-lo̍h hái-tóe bô-siaⁿ-bô-seh?
Lí tī hái--ni̍h sàng-hè, hō͘ lia̍t-kok chhiong-chiok. Lí ê châi-hù kap siong-phín chin chōe, hō͘ sè-kan ê kun-ông hó-gia̍h.
Lí tī tōa-hái hō͘ éng lòng-phòa, só͘-ū ê hè-mi̍h kap chûn-oân lóng tîm lo̍h-khì hái chhim ê só͘-chāi.
“‘Hái-tó ê chū-bîn lóng in-ūi lí ê kiat-kio̍k tio̍h-kiaⁿ; in ê kun-ông mā lóng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ khióng-hông, bīn-tài-iu-iông.
Lia̍t-kok ê seng-lí-lâng kā lí hàiⁿ-thâu thí-chhiò; lí éng-oán siau-sit, chit-khoán ê kiat-kio̍k hō͘ lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, tio̍h kā Thài-ní -ông kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lí sim-lāi kiau-ngō͘, siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī sī sîn-bêng, chē tī hái-tiong chiòng-sîn ê chō-ūi. Sui-jiân lí sim-lāi án-ni siūⁿ, kî-si̍t lí sī lâng, m̄-sī sîn-bêng.
Lí siūⁿ lí ka-kī pí Tān-í-lí khah chhong-bêng, bêng-pe̍k só͘-ū ê ò-pì.
Lí khò ka-kī ê chhong-bêng kap ki-khiáu tit-tio̍h châi-hù, lúi-chek chin chōe kim-gûn tī khò͘-pâng.
Lí ūn-iōng chòe seng-lí ê chhong-bêng, cheng-ka lí ê châi-hù. Lí in-ūi ka-kī ê châi-hù jú lâi jú kiau-ngō͘!
“‘Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: In-ūi lí siūⁿ ka-kī kap sîn-bêng kâng-khoán,

só͘-í góa beh chhōa lia̍t-kok tiong siōng hiong-ok ê gōa-kok-lâng lâi kong-táⁿ lí. In beh pu̍ih to húi-hoāi lí ēng chhong-bêng kiàn-li̍p ê sêng-chiū, hō͘ lí sit-khì kong-chhái.
In beh kā lí hiat-lo̍h Chhim-khiⁿ, hō͘ lí chhám-sí tī hái--ni̍h.
Lí kiám ōe-tàng tùi kā lí thâi ê lâng kóng lí sī sîn-bêng? Tī thâi lí ê lâng chhiú-tiong, lí put-kò sī lâng, m̄-sī sîn-bêng.
Lí beh sí tī gōa-kok-lâng ê chhiú-tiong, chhin-chhiūⁿ bô siū kat-lé ê lâng sí, sí kah chin kiàn-siàu. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h ūi Thài-ní -ông chhiùⁿ ai-ko, kā i kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Lí kè-khì sī oân-bí ê tián-hoān, chhiong-móa tì-hūi, si̍p-choân-si̍p-bí.

Lí bat tòa tī I-tiân, chiū-sī Siōng-tè ê hn̂g lāi-bīn, ēng âng-pó-chio̍h, n̂g-ge̍k, kim-kong-chio̍h, chhiⁿ-ge̍k, âng-bé-ló, phek-ge̍k, nâ-pó-chio̍h, le̍k-pó-chio̍h, chhiah-ge̍k chng-thāⁿ ka-kī; só͘-ū ê pó-chio̍h lóng siuⁿ kim-kheng. Tī lí siū-chō hit-ji̍t, góa chiū lóng ūi lí chún-pī hó-sè.
Góa siat-li̍p lí chòe ki-lō͘-pek, pó-hō͘ Siōng-tè ê sèng-soaⁿ, tī chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh to̍h kng-liāng ê pó-chio̍h tiong-kan sûn-sī.
Tùi siū-chō ê ji̍t, lí ê hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t, āu-lâi soah khai-sí chòe pháiⁿ.

Lí seng-lí hó koh chòe chin tōa, soah hoān-chōe, chòe chin chōe kiông-pō ê sū. Só͘-í, góa kā lí kóaⁿ lī-khui góa ê sèng-soaⁿ, hō͘ lí tú-tio̍h kiàn-siàu. Ah, siú-hō͘-chiá ki-lō͘-pek, góa tùi chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh to̍h kng-liāng ê pó-chio̍h tiong-kan kā lí kóaⁿ-cháu.
Lí in-ūi eng-chùn, lāi-sim kiau-ngō͘; lí chhut-miâ, soah khòaⁿ-khin tì-hūi. Só͘-í góa kā lí siak tī thô͘-kha, hō͘ chu-ông chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h.
Lí in-ūi chōe-kò chin chōe, chòe seng-lí bô kong-tō, soah siat-to̍k lí ê sèng-só͘, só͘-í góa pàng-hé kā lí sio, hō͘ lí tī lâng ê ba̍k-chiu chêng pìⁿ-chòe hé-hu.
Só͘-ū jīn-bat lí ê kok-ka lóng beh kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; lí éng-oán siau-sit, chit-khoán ê kiat-kio̍k hō͘ lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h ǹg Se-tùn -lâng kóng ū-giân, chí-chek in.

Tio̍h kā in kóng Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘ Se-tùn, góa beh kap lí choh-tùi! Góa beh tī lín tiong-kan hián-chhut góa ê êng-kng. Góa hián-bêng góa ê sîn-sèng, si-hêng sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, lâng chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.

Góa beh hō͘ un-e̍k tī Se-tùn liû-hêng, hō͘ Se-tùn ê koe-lō͘ lóng sī huih; tùi-te̍k gia̍h to tùi sì-bīn kong-kek i, siū thâi ê lâng tó tī koe-lō͘. Án-ni, lâng chiū chai Góa sī Siōng Chú.’”

Siōng Chú kóng, “Kè-khì khòaⁿ-khin Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiu-ûi ê kok-ka, bōe koh chhin-chhiūⁿ chha̍k--lâng ê chhì-phè, siong-lâng ê chi̍t-lê chhì-siong Í-sek-lia̍t, án-ni lâng chiū chai góa sī Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú.”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Góa beh chū-chi̍p siū hòng-tio̍k khì bān-cho̍k ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, bān-cho̍k beh in-ūi án-ni chai góa sī sîn-sèng; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng beh tòa tī in ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe, chiū-sī góa siúⁿ-sù hō͘ góa ê po̍k-jîn Ngá-kok ê thó͘-tōe.

In beh tī hia an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p; góa hêng-hoa̍t chiu-ûi hiah-ê khòaⁿ-khin Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê bîn-cho̍k liáu-āu, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng beh khí-chhù, khai-khún phû-tô-hn̂g, an-jiân khiā-khí. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè.”
Tē-cha̍p nî cha̍p-ge̍h cha̍p-jī, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h tùi Ai-ki̍p -ông kap Ai-ki̍p choân-kok kóng ū-giân, chí-chek in,

kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Ai-ki̍p -ông, lí chhin-chhiūⁿ bih tī hô--ni̍h ê tōa hái-koài, góa beh kap lí choh-tùi! Lí bat kóng Nî-lô-hô sī lí ê, sī lí chō--ê.
Góa beh ēng kau-á kau lí ê gê-chô, hō͘ hô--ni̍h ê hî kha̍h tī lí ê lân; góa beh kā lí kap kha̍h tī lí ê lân ê hî lóng tùi hô--ni̍h giú--khí-lâi.

Góa mā beh kā lí kap hô--ni̍h ê hî hiat tī khòng-iá. Lí ōe sí tī iá-tōe, bô lâng kā lí siu sin-si, bô lâng kā lí bâi-chòng. Góa beh hō͘ lí chòe tōe-chiūⁿ ê iá-siù kap khong-tiong pe-chiáu ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Án-ni, só͘-ū Ai-ki̍p ê chū-bîn chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú. “‘Siōng Chú koh kóng: Ai-ki̍p -lâng, lí tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng--khí-lâi, put-kò sī chi̍t ki lô͘-tek-á-koáiⁿ.
In ēng chhiú gia̍h lí tú thô͘-kha, lí chiū pit--khui, siong-tio̍h in ê keng-thâu; in ê seng-khu khò lí, lí chiū tn̄g--khì, hō͘ in ê io siám--tio̍h.
Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh hō͘ lín tú-tio̍h chiàn-loān; lâng kap cheng-siⁿ lóng beh hō͘ to thâi-sí.
Ai-ki̍p ê tōe beh pha-hng hong-hòe, án-ni, lâng chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú. “‘In-ūi Ai-ki̍p -ông khoa-kháu kóng: Nî-lô-hô sī góa ê, sī góa chō--ê.

Góa beh kap lí í-ki̍p lí ê hô-liû choh-tùi. Góa beh hō͘ Ai-ki̍p ê thó͘-tōe, tùi pak-pō͘ ê Bi̍t-toa̍t, kàu lâm-pō͘ ê Sek-hut-nî, it-ti̍t kàu Kó͘-si̍t pian-kài, choân-pō͘ pha-hng hong-hòe,
bô koh ū lâng á-sī iá-siù keng-kè; sì-cha̍p nî kú, Ai-ki̍p bô lâng khiā-khí.

Góa beh hō͘ Ai-ki̍p pìⁿ-chòe sè-kan siōng pha-hng ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ Ai-ki̍p ê siâⁿ-tìn pìⁿ-chòe siōng hong-hòe ê siâⁿ-tìn. Góa beh kā Ai-ki̍p -lâng kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ khì lia̍t-kok, sì-sòaⁿ tī lia̍t-pang sì-cha̍p nî kú.
“‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Sì-cha̍p nî liáu-āu, góa beh chū-chi̍p siū hòng-tio̍k ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng,
chhōa in tùi siū-lia̍h ê só͘-chāi tńg-lâi in ê pún-ku-tōe Pa-te̍k-lô. Tī hia, in beh chiâⁿ-chòe jio̍k-siáu ê kok-ka,
sī lia̍t-kok tiong siōng bî-sòe--ê, bōe-tàng koh thóng-tī pa̍t-ê kok-ka. Góa beh hō͘ in soe-lám, bōe-tàng koh koán-hat pa̍t-ê kok-ka.
Ai-ki̍p bōe-tàng koh chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê khò-soaⁿ, chí-ū hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siūⁿ-khí in óa-khò Ai-ki̍p ê chōe-kò. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú.’”
Tē-jī-cha̍p-chhit nî chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-it, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chhōa i ê tāi-kun kong-táⁿ Thài-ní. Pa-pí-lûn -ông kap i ê kun-tūi chhut-la̍t khó͘-chiàn, ta̍k-ê lâng lóng lak thâu-mn̂g, keng-thâu liù-phê, m̄-kú in lóng bô tùi Thài-ní tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h.

Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh chiong Ai-ki̍p ê thó͘-tōe kau hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat. I beh chhiúⁿ Ai-ki̍p ê châi-bu̍t, chiong in ê chu-goân chhiúⁿ-liáu-liáu; chiah-ê chiàn-lī-phín beh chòe i ê kun-tūi ê pò-siúⁿ.
Góa beh kā Ai-ki̍p kau hō͘ i, tòng-chòe i ê kang-chîⁿ, in-ūi i ê kun-tūi sī ūi góa chòe kang. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.’
“Hit-sî, góa beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t kiông-sēng, mā beh hō͘ lí Í-se-kiat koh-chài khui-chhùi tī in tiong-kan kóng-ōe. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h kóng ū-giân; lí tio̍h kóng Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Chhám ah, hit-ji̍t! Lín tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ ai-khàu.
Hit-ji̍t kàu lah! Siōng Chú ê ji̍t pek-kūn lah! Hit-ji̍t sī o͘-hûn-bi̍t-pò͘, lia̍t-kok siū hêng-hoa̍t ê ji̍t-chí.

Ai-ki̍p beh tú-tio̍h chiàn-loān, Kó͘-si̍t ōe kám-siū thòng-khó͘. Ai-ki̍p -lâng siū tô͘-sat ê sî, jîn-bîn ê châi-hù beh hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì; i ê kun-ki oân-choân siū thiah-húi.
Kó͘-si̍t -lâng, Hut -lâng, Lū-tí-a -lâng, A-la-pek -lâng, Kò͘-phó͘ -lâng, í-ki̍p kap Ai-ki̍p kiat-bêng--ê lóng beh kap Ai-ki̍p -lâng chòe-hé sí tī to-ē.

“Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Tùi pak-pō͘ ê Bi̍t-toa̍t kàu lâm-pō͘ ê Sek-hut-nî, só͘-ū chi-chhî Ai-ki̍p ê lâng lóng beh sí tī to-ē; Ai-ki̍p khoa-iāu ê koân-sè beh kàng-kē pìⁿ-chòe pi-bî. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Ai-ki̍p beh pìⁿ-chòe sè-kan siōng pha-hng ê só͘-chāi, bô chi̍t ê siâⁿ-tìn ōe pí Ai-ki̍p ê siâⁿ-tìn koh-khah hong-hòe.
Góa pàng-hé sio Ai-ki̍p ê sî, só͘-ū pang-chān Ai-ki̍p --ê mā beh siū châu-bia̍t. Hit-sî, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.

“‘Hit-ji̍t, góa beh phài sù-chiá chē-chûn khì Kó͘-si̍t -lâng hia; an-ún chū-chāi ê Kó͘-si̍t -lâng beh kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, beh ū chhin-chhiūⁿ Ai-ki̍p só͘ siū ê thòng-khó͘ lîm-kàu in. Khòaⁿ leh, chiah-ê sū liâm-piⁿ beh hoat-seng!’
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh thong-kè Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat, châu-bia̍t Ai-ki̍p ê jîn-bîn.
I beh tòa-niá lia̍t-kok tiong hiong-ok ê kun-tūi lâi húi-bia̍t Ai-ki̍p. In beh ēng to kong-kek Ai-ki̍p -lâng, hō͘ si-thé móa-sì-kòe.
Góa beh hō͘ Nî-lô-hô ta-khok-khok, kā Ai-ki̍p kau tī siâ-ok ê lâng chhiú-tiong. Góa beh thong-kè gōa-kok-lâng húi-hoāi Ai-ki̍p ê it-chhè. Góa Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.’

“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh húi-bia̍t ngó͘-siōng, tùi Bēng-húi-su tû-khì sîn-siōng; Ai-ki̍p bô koh ū kun-ông; góa beh hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -lâng oa̍h tī kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ê tiong-kan.
Góa beh hō͘ Ai-ki̍p ê Pa-te̍k-lô pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘, ēng hé sio Só-an, hêng-hoa̍t tōa-siâⁿ Tí-pí-su.
Góa beh chiong góa ê tōa siū-khì piàⁿ tī Ai-ki̍p siōng kian-kò͘ ê iàu-sài Sìn, mā beh siau-bia̍t Tí-pí-su ê jîn-bîn.
Góa beh pàng-hé sio Ai-ki̍p; Sìn beh thòng-khó͘ ká-kún. Tí-pí-su ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ beh siū kong-phòa, Bēng-húi-su beh kui-ji̍t siū tùi-te̍k kong-kek.
Hi-lī-pho-lí kap Pí Pek-si̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng lóng beh sí tī to-ē, hiah-ê siâⁿ ê chū-bîn hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì.

Góa húi-hoāi Ai-ki̍p ê koân-sè, hō͘ i khoa-iāu ê khùi-la̍t chiong-chí ê sî, Tap-pí-le̍k ji̍t--sî beh pìⁿ-chòe o͘-àm, o͘-hûn kā i jia-khàm, só͘-ū ê chū-bîn lóng beh siū-lia̍h chòe hu-ló͘.
Góa beh án-ni hêng-hoa̍t Ai-ki̍p, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”
Tē-cha̍p-it nî chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-chhit, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, góa í-keng phah-tn̄g Ai-ki̍p -ông ê chi̍t ki chhiú-kut, bô lâng kā i i-tī, pau-chat, hō͘ i ū-la̍t thang gia̍h to.

Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh kap Ai-ki̍p -ông choh-tùi, phah-tn̄g i nn̄g ki chhiú-kut, kā ióng--ê kap tio̍h-siong--ê lóng phah-tn̄g, hō͘ i chhiú-lāi ê to lak-lo̍h thô͘-kha.
Góa beh kā Ai-ki̍p -lâng hòng-tio̍k khì lia̍t-kok, sì-sòaⁿ tī choân sè-kài ta̍k só͘-chāi.

Jiân-āu, góa beh hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê chhiú ióng-chòng ū-la̍t, kā góa ê to kau hō͘ i. M̄-kú góa beh phah-tn̄g Ai-ki̍p -ông ê chhiú-kut, hō͘ i tī Pa-pí-lûn -ông bīn-chêng chhin-chhiūⁿ siū-siong beh sí ê lâng haiⁿ-haiⁿ-chhan.

Góa beh hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông ê chhiú ióng-chòng, hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -ông ê chhiú soe-lám sûi--lo̍h-khì. Góa kā góa ê to kau hō͘ Pa-pí-lûn -ông, i gia̍h to kong-kek Ai-ki̍p ê sî, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
Góa beh kā Ai-ki̍p -lâng hòng-tio̍k khì lia̍t-kok, sì-sòaⁿ tī choân sè-kài ta̍k só͘-chāi; hit-sî, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”
Tē-cha̍p-it nî, saⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-it, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h kā Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i ê jîn-bîn kóng: Lí ê kiông-sēng, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kap lí pí?
Lí khòaⁿ, A-su̍t bat chhin-chhiūⁿ Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū, ki-hio̍h chhiⁿ-chhùi, chhiū-nâ bō͘-sēng, chhiū-châng koân-tōa, chhiū-bé tú-thiⁿ.
Pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū ū chúi lūn-te̍k; tōe-hā chúi-goân hō͘ i koân-tōa. I chai-chèng ê só͘-chāi sì-chiu-ûi ū kang-hô; chi-liû koàn-ak chhân-iá só͘-ū ê chhiū-ba̍k.
Só͘-í, i pí kî-tha ê chhiū-ba̍k khah tōa-châng; in-ūi chúi-goân chhiong-chiok, i ê chhiū-oe tn̂g koh chōe, hio̍h bō͘-sēng.
Khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu tī chhiū-oe choh-siū; tōe-chiūⁿ ê cháu-siù tī chhiū-ńg ē seng-sán; lia̍t-kok ê jîn-bîn lóng tī i ê ìm-ńg-ē khiā-khí.
Chiah-ni̍h tōa-châng koh súi ê chhiū! Chhiū koân, chhiū-oe tn̂g, hio̍h bō͘-sēng; chhiū-kun tèng chhim, chhim-ji̍p tōe-hā ê chúi-goân.

Siōng-tè hn̂g-tiong ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū bōe pí i khah koân; siông-chhiū ê chhiū-ki bōe pí i khah tn̂g; png-chhiū ê chhiū-oe bōe-tàng kap i pí. Siōng-tè hn̂g-tiong ê chhiū bô chi̍t châng chhin-chhiūⁿ i hiah súi.
Góa hō͘ i ê ki-hio̍h bō͘-sēng, siⁿ-chòe chin súi; Siōng-tè ê hn̂g I-tiân só͘-ū ê chhiū lóng him-siān i.
“Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Chit-châng chhiū in-ūi koân-tōa, chhiū-bé koân kah tú-thiⁿ, soah chū-ko kiau-ngō͘,
góa chiū kā i kau hō͘ lia̍t-kok tiong siōng kiông-tāi ê thóng-tī-chiá; chit-ê thóng-tī-chiá beh chiàu i ê siâ-ok kā i pò-èng. Góa í-keng kā i khì-sak.

Hiong-ok ê gōa-kok-lâng kā i chám-tn̄g, hiat-ka̍k. I ê ki-hio̍h lak tī soaⁿ-téng kap soaⁿ-kok tiong, chhiū-ki chi̍h--khì lak tī hô-piⁿ; chhiū-ńg ē lia̍t-kok ê jîn-bîn lóng lī-khui.
Khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu beh hioh tī tó--lo̍h-khì ê chhiū-kho͘; chhân-iá ê cháu-siù beh tó tī lak--lo̍h-khì ê chhiū-ki.

Í-āu, chai-chèng tī chúi-piⁿ ê chhiū bô thang koh in-ūi tōa-châng, koân kah tú-thiⁿ chū-ko kiau-ngō͘. Hiah-ê chhiū lóng beh ko͘-tâ, chhin-chhiūⁿ kiau-ngō͘ ê sè-kan-lâng sí--khì, kap sí-lâng chòe-hé lo̍h-khì Im-kan.

“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh kóng: Hit-châng tōa-châng chhiū lo̍h-khì Im-kan ê sî, góa beh khàm chhim-ian, chia̍t-tn̄g kang-hô, hō͘ chúi-lâu thêng-chí lâi piáu-sī ai-siong. Góa beh hō͘ o͘-àm jia-khàm Lê-pa-lūn-soaⁿ, hō͘ chhiū-nâ lāi ê chhiū-ba̍k lóng ko͘-tâ.

Góa kā i hiat-lo̍h Im-kan, hō͘ i kap lo̍h chhim-ian ê sí-lâng chòe-hé ê sî, i siak--lo̍h-khì ê siaⁿ iô-tāng lia̍t-kok. I-tiân-hn̂g ê chhiū, í-ki̍p Lê-pa-lūn chúi-goân chhiong-chiok, siōng-hó siōng-súi ê chhiū-ba̍k, lóng beh tī Im-kan tit-tio̍h an-ùi.

Chiah-ê chhiū lóng beh kap hit-châng tōa-châng chhiū lo̍h-khì Im-kan, kap hō͘ to thâi-sí ê lâng chòe-hé. Só͘-ū tòa tī hit-châng chhiū ìm-ńg-ē ê lâng lóng beh siū hòng-tio̍k khì lia̍t-kok.

“Lí ê êng-kng kap koân-tōa, I-tiân-hn̂g lāi-bīn ê chhiū-ba̍k ū tó chi̍t châng ōe-tàng kap lí pí? M̄-kú, lí beh kap I-tiân-hn̂g lāi-bīn ê chhiū-ba̍k siâng-khoán hō͘ lâng hiat-lo̍h Im-kan, kap hiah-ê bô siū kat-lé í-ki̍p hō͘ to thâi-sí ê lâng chòe-hé. Che sī chí Ai-ki̍p -ông kap i ê jîn-bîn kóng--ê. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Tē-cha̍p-jī nî cha̍p-jī-ge̍h chhoe-it, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h ūi Ai-ki̍p -ông chòe ai-ko, kā i kóng: Lí siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī tī lia̍t-kok tiong sī siàu-chòng ê sai, kî-si̍t, lí sī hái--ni̍h ê hái-koài. Lí tī kang-hô phah-phún, ēng kha lā chúi, hō͘ hô-chúi pìⁿ lô.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Tī chin chōe kok-ka ê jîn-bîn chū-chi̍p ê sî, góa beh pha góa ê bāng kā lí lia̍h--khí-lâi, kiò in kā lí thoa-chiūⁿ hōaⁿ.
Góa beh kā lí hiat tī thô͘-kha, tàn tī iá-tōe, hō͘ lí chòe khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu kap tōe-chiūⁿ cháu-siù ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Góa beh kā lí ê sin-si tàn tī soaⁿ--ni̍h, ēng lí nōa--khì ê si-thé kā soaⁿ-kok thūn-tīⁿ.
Góa beh hō͘ thó͘-tōe lim lí ê huih; hō͘ lí ê huih im kàu soaⁿ-niá, tiòng-móa kang-hô.
Góa siau-bia̍t lí ê sî, beh jia-khàm thiⁿ, hō͘ chhiⁿ-sîn o͘-àm; góa beh ēng ba̍t-hûn jia ji̍t-thâu, hō͘ ge̍h-niû mā bōe hoat-kng.
Góa beh hō͘ thiⁿ-téng ê kng-thé bōe koh hoat-kng, hō͘ lí ê thó͘-tōe hām-ji̍p o͘-àm. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
“Góa hō͘ lí tī lia̍t-kok tiong bia̍t-bông ê siau-sit, thoân kàu lí m̄-bat ê kok-ka ê sî, góa beh hō͘ hiah-ê jîn-bîn ê sim kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.

Góa tī lia̍t-kok bīn-chêng lāng to-kiàm ê sî, in ê jîn-bîn beh in-ūi lí kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kun-ông mā beh in-ūi lí ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah. Lí tó-hoāi hit-ji̍t, in lóng beh ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā put-sî phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Pa-pí-lûn -ông beh gia̍h to kong-kek lí.
Góa beh ēng in ê chiàn-sū siau-bia̍t lí ê kun-tūi; in sī lia̍t-kok tiong siōng hiong-ok--ê. Ai-ki̍p ê khoa-iāu beh thiat-tóe siau-sit, i ê kun-tūi beh bia̍t-bông.
Góa beh thâi-sí hô-piⁿ ê cheng-siⁿ; bô koh ū lâng kap cheng-siⁿ ēng kha lā hô-chúi, hō͘ chúi lô--khì.
Hit-sî, góa beh hō͘ in ê hô-chúi chheng-chheng, hō͘ hô-chúi chhin-chhiūⁿ iû khoaⁿ-khoaⁿ-á lâu. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Góa hō͘ Ai-ki̍p pha-hng, thó͘-tōe bô chhun pòaⁿ-hāng, kā i ê chū-bîn lóng thâi-sí ê sî, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
Che sī chi̍t siú lâng ai-siong ê sî chhiùⁿ ê ai-ko. Lia̍t-kok ê lú-chú beh ūi-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p kap i ê jîn-bîn chhiùⁿ chit-siú ai-ko. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Tē-cha̍p-jī nî bó͘-ge̍h ê cha̍p-gō͘, Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h ūi Ai-ki̍p ê kûn-chiòng thî-khàu, in kap kî-tha kiông-kok ê jîn-bîn beh siū hiat-lo̍h tōe chhim ê só͘-chāi, kap hiah-ê í-keng tī Im-kan ê lâng chòe-hé.
Lí tio̍h tùi in kóng: Lí siūⁿ-kóng lí siōng súi o͘h? Lí lo̍h-khì Chhim-khiⁿ, khì kap bô siū kat-lé ê lâng chòe-hé!
“In beh kap hiah-ê hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí ê lâng tó chòe-hé. To í-keng chhut-siù, Ai-ki̍p kap i ê jîn-bîn lóng ōe hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.
Tī Im-hú siōng kiông-béng ê chiàn-sū beh kā Ai-ki̍p í-ki̍p kap i kiat-bêng ê kok-ka kóng, ‘Hiah-ê bô siū kat-lé, hō͘ to thâi-sí ê lâng lóng lo̍h-lâi tó tī chia!’
“ A-su̍t kap i ê chiàn-sū lóng tī hia, i ê chiàn-sū tâi tī sì-chiu-ûi; in lóng hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí.
In ê hûn-bōng tī Im-kan ke̍k-chhim ê só͘-chāi, i ê chiàn-sū tâi tī sì-chiu-ûi; in lóng sī hō͘ to-kiàm thâi--sí-ê. In chāi-siⁿ ê sî, lâng hui-siông kiaⁿ in.

“ Í-lân kap i ê chiàn-sū lóng tī hia, i ê chiàn-sū tâi tī sì-chiu-ûi. Hiah-ê bô siū kat-lé, hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí ê lâng lóng lo̍h tī Im-kan. In chāi-siⁿ ê sî, lâng hui-siông kiaⁿ in; taⁿ sí-liáu, in kap só͘-ū sí ê lâng siâng-khoán siū bú-jio̍k.

Tī hō͘ lâng thâi-sí ê lâng tiong-kan, in ūi-tio̍h Í-lân chòe chi̍t téng bîn-chhn̂g, in ê chiàn-sū lóng tâi tī sì-chiu-ûi. In sī bô siū kat-lé, hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí ê lâng. In chāi-siⁿ ê sî, lâng hui-siông kiaⁿ in; taⁿ sí-liáu, in kap só͘-ū sí ê lâng siâng-khoán siū bú-jio̍k.

“ Bí-siat, Thó͘-pa kap in ê chiàn-sū mā tī hia, in ê chiàn-sū lóng tâi tī sì-chiu-ûi. In lóng sī bô siū kat-lé, hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí ê lâng. In chāi-siⁿ ê sî, lâng hui-siông kiaⁿ in.

In bô kap hiah-ê kó͘-chá ê ióng-sū chòe-hé bâi-chòng; chiah-ê ióng-sū tòa kun-khì lo̍h-khì Im-hú, to-kiàm chòe chím-thâu, chōe ê hêng-hoa̍t khàm tī in ê kut-thâu téng. In chāi-siⁿ ê sî, lâng hui-siông kiaⁿ in.
“Hoat-ló, lí beh hō͘ lâng chhùi-kut-hun-si, tó tī bô siū kat-lé, hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí ê lâng tiong-kan.
“ Í-tong mā tī hia, i ê ông kap só͘-ū ê léng-siù sui-jiân sī ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū, m̄-kú mā beh kap bô siū kat-lé, hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, kap lo̍h Im-kan ê lâng tó chòe-hé.

“Só͘-ū pak-hng ê léng-siù kap Se-tùn -lâng mā tī hia; in ê koân-sè bat hō͘ lâng khióng-hông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. Taⁿ in mā kap bô siū kat-lé, hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí ê lâng chòe-hé tó tī Im-kan, siū bú-jio̍k.”
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng: Ai-ki̍p -ông khòaⁿ-kìⁿ hiah-ê kok-ka ê bia̍t-bông, ōe ūi-tio̍h hō͘ to thâi-sí ê kun-peng kám-kak an-ùi.

“Sui-jiân góa bat ēng Ai-ki̍p -ông hō͘ sè-kan-lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, m̄-kú i kap i ê kun-tūi mā lóng beh kap hiah-ê bô siū kat-lé, hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí ê lâng tó chòe-hé. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, tio̍h kā lí ê tông-pau kóng, góa hō͘ chi̍t ê kok-ka tú-tio̍h chiàn-loān, hit-ê kok-ka ê jîn-bîn tio̍h tùi in tiong-kan soán chi̍t ê lâng chòe siú-bōng-chiá.
Siú-bōng-chiá khòaⁿ-tio̍h tùi-te̍k pek-kūn, chiū pûn sàu-kak kéng-kò jîn-bîn.
Nā ū lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h sàu-kak ê siaⁿ m̄-kú bô kéng-kak, soah hō͘ tùi-te̍k thâi-sí, i tio̍h ūi ka-kī ê sí hū chek-jīm.
I thiaⁿ-tio̍h sàu-kak ê siaⁿ m̄-kú bô kéng-kak, i tio̍h ūi ka-kī ê sí hū chek-jīm. I nā chiap-siū kéng-kài, chiū ōe-tàng kiù ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.

Siú-bōng-chiá khòaⁿ-tio̍h tùi-te̍k pek-kūn, nā bô pûn sàu-kak, tì-kàu jîn-bîn m̄-chai thang kéng-kài, soah ū lâng hō͘ tùi-te̍k thâi-sí, chiū-sī-kóng hit-ê lâng ū chōe kai-sí, góa mā ài siú-bōng-chiá ūi-tio̍h hit-ê lâng ê sí hū chek-jīm.
“Jîn-chú ah, taⁿ góa chí-phài lí chòe Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn ê siú-bōng-chiá. Lí tio̍h chiong góa kā lí kóng kéng-kò ê ōe kā in kóng.

Nā-sī góa soan-pò͘ bó͘ chi̍t ê siâ-ok ê lâng it-tēng tio̍h sí, lí khiok bô khì kā i kéng-kò, khǹg i kái-siâ-kui-chèng, chit-ê lâng sui-jiân mā ōe in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe lâi sí, m̄-kú góa beh tùi lí tui-kiù i sí ê chek-jīm.
Lí nā ū kéng-kò hit-ê lâng m̄-thang kè-sio̍k choh-pháiⁿ, m̄-kú i bô beh kái-siâ-kui-chèng, i ōe in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe sí; i ê sí, lí m̄-bián hū chek-jīm.”

Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bat kóng: Goán ê chōe kap kè-sit chhin-chhiūⁿ tāng-tàⁿ kā goán teh--leh, goán in-ūi án-ni sit-chì soe-lám, m̄-chai beh án-chóaⁿ oa̍h--lo̍h-khì.

Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kí ka-kī ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè, góa m̄-ài pháiⁿ-lâng sí-bông, ài in lī-khui pháiⁿ-lō͘ lâi tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, lín tio̍h hóe-kái, oa̍t tò-tńg, lī-khui siâ-ok ê hêng-ûi! Lín ná beh chhē sí leh?

“Só͘-í, jîn-chú ah, tio̍h kā lí ê tông-pau kóng, ‘Gī-lâng hoān-chōe, i chá-chêng chòe ê hó-sū bōe kiù i. Pháiⁿ-lâng hóe-kái, i chá-chêng chòe ê pháiⁿ bōe hō͘ i bia̍t-bông; gī-lâng hoān-chōe, i chá-chêng ê hó hêng-ûi bōe hō͘ i tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā.’

Góa tùi gī-lâng kóng ‘Lí it-tēng ōe oa̍h’, m̄-kú i nā khò ka-kī ê hó hêng-ûi soah khai-sí hoān-chōe, i só͘-ū ê hó hêng-ûi góa bōe kā i kì--teh. I ōe in-ūi só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ lâi sí.
Góa bat tùi pháiⁿ-lâng kóng ‘Lí it-tēng ōe sí’, m̄-kú i nā hóe-kái lī-khui pháiⁿ, chòe kong-pêng chèng-gī ê sū;

phì-jū kóng, chiong i thau--lâi á-sī pa̍t-lâng tí-ah ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ hêng hō͘ goân-chú, chun-siú sù sìⁿ-miā ê lu̍t-hoat, bô koh chòe pháiⁿ, i it-tēng ōe tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā, bōe sí.
Góa bōe kā i jīm-hô ê chōe kì--teh; i beh in-ūi só͘ chòe kong-pêng chèng-gī ê sū, sìⁿ-miā tit-tio̍h pó-chûn.
“Lí ê tông-pau kóng ‘Chú án-ni chhú-lí bô kong-tō’. Kî-si̍t, in chiah sī bô kong-tō.
Gī-lâng bô koh chòe hó-sū, tian-tò khì chòe pháiⁿ, in it-tēng ōe in-ūi án-ni lâi sí.
Pháiⁿ-lâng nā hóe-kái bô koh choh-pháiⁿ, chòe kong-pêng chèng-gī ê sū, i beh in-ūi án-ni pó-chûn sìⁿ-miā.
Lín iáu-teh kóng ‘Chú án-ni chhú-lí bô kong-tō’. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, góa beh chiàu lín ta̍k-ê lâng ê hêng-ûi kā lín sím-phòaⁿ.”
Tē-cha̍p-jī nî cha̍p-ge̍h chhoe-gō͘, ū chi̍t ê tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tô-cháu--chhut-lâi ê lâng lâi góa chia. I kā góa kóng, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -siâⁿ í-keng lûn-hām.

Chit-ê lâng lâi ê chêng chi̍t àm, Siōng Chú ê khùi-la̍t chhiong-móa góa, hō͘ góa ōe koh kóng-ōe. Tē-jī ji̍t chá-khí, chit-ê lâng lâi góa chia í-chêng, góa ê chhùi í-keng khui, khai-sí ōe kóng-ōe.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t hong-hòe ê siâⁿ ê jîn-bîn kóng, ‘ A-pek-la-hán chi̍t ê lâng chiū tit-tio̍h chit-tè thó͘-tōe, lán jîn-sò͘ chiah chōe, chit-tè thó͘-tōe koh-khah ōe-ēng-tit hō͘ lán chòe sán-gia̍p.’

“Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lín chia̍h kâⁿ-huih ê bah, pài ngó͘-siōng, koh thâi-sí lâng, iáu siūⁿ-beh tit-tio̍h chit-tè thó͘-tōe chòe sán-gia̍p o͘h?
Lín khò to-kiàm kè ji̍t-chí, chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, lâng-lâng hoān kan-îm, iáu káⁿ siūⁿ-beh tit-tio̍h chit-tè thó͘-tōe chòe sán-gia̍p?’

“Lí tio̍h koh kā in kóng, ‘Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kí ka-kī ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè: Lín tòa tī hong-hòe ê siâⁿ ê jîn-bîn beh hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, tòa tī iá-gōa ê lâng beh hō͘ iá-siù thun-chia̍h, bih tī pó-lúi á-sī tōng-lāi ê lâng beh tì-tio̍h un-e̍k sí--khì.
Góa beh hō͘ chit-tè tōe thiat-tóe pha-hng; in só͘ khoa-iāu--ê lóng beh siau-sit. Í-sek-lia̍t ê soaⁿ beh hong-hòe, bô lâng keng-kè.’
Góa in-ūi in só͘ chòe it-chhè thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū kā in hêng-hoa̍t, hō͘ thó͘-tōe pha-hng ê sî, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.”

Siōng Chú kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí ê tông-pau tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ piⁿ, tī chhù mn̂g-kháu tâm-lūn lí. In hō͘-siōng kóng-lâi-kóng-khì, ‘Lâi, lán lâi thiaⁿ-khòaⁿ Siōng Chú ōe kóng sím-mi̍h!’

In kui-tīn chòe-hé lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ beh lâi chū-hōe, chē tī lí ê bīn-chêng, ká-ná sī góa ê chú-bîn. In thiaⁿ sī thiaⁿ, m̄-kú bô khì kiâⁿ. In ê chhùi lóng teh kiông-tiau thiàⁿ, m̄-kú in ê sim teh siūⁿ put-gī-chi-châi.
Tī in ê sim-ba̍k tiong, lí put-kò sī siaⁿ-im súi, gâu chhiùⁿ chêng-koa, koh ōe-hiáu tôaⁿ-khîm ê koa-chhiú. Lí ê ōe, in chit-hī thiaⁿ, hit-hī chhut, lóng bô khì chòe.
M̄-kú lí kóng ê ōe chin kín chiū ōe si̍t-hiān; lí ê ōe si̍t-hiān ê sî, in chiū chai, bat ū sian-ti tī in tiong-kan.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h khiàn-chek Í-sek-lia̍t ê léng-tō-chiá, tùi in thoân-ta̍t góa ê sìn-sit. Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê bo̍k-chiá, lín chhám ah! Lín kan-ta kò͘ ka-kī. Bo̍k-chiá kiám m̄-sī tio̍h chiàu-kò͘ iûⁿ-kûn?
Lín chia̍h iûⁿ-lin, chhēng iûⁿ-mn̂g ê saⁿ, thâi siōng-pûi ê iûⁿ lâi chia̍h, m̄-kú bô beh chiàu-kò͘ iûⁿ-kûn.

Soe-lám--ê, lín bô kā in kò͘ hō͘ ióng; phòa-pīⁿ--ê, lín bô kā in i-tī; siū-siong--ê, lín bô kā in pau-chat; sit-bê--ê, lín bô kā in chhōa--tò-lâi; sit-lo̍h--ê, lín bô khì chhē. Lín tian-tò ēng kiông-pō chân-khok koán-hat in.
In-ūi bô bo̍k-chiá, iûⁿ-kûn chiū sì-sòaⁿ; iûⁿ sì-sòaⁿ, chiū hō͘ iá-siù thun-chia̍h.
Góa ê iûⁿ-kûn tī tōa-soaⁿ sió-soaⁿ bê-lō͘ liû-lōng, sì-sòaⁿ tī choân-tōe, bô lâng chiàu-kò͘, bô lâng khì chhē.
“‘Só͘-í, bo̍k-chiá ah, lín tio̍h thiaⁿ góa Siōng Chú tùi lín kóng ê ōe:

Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kí ka-kī ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè, góa ê iûⁿ-kûn in-ūi bô bo̍k-chiá, soah chiâⁿ-chòe la̍h-bu̍t, hō͘ iá-siù thun-chia̍h. Góa ê bo̍k-chiá bô khì chhē góa ê iûⁿ; in kan-ta kò͘ ka-kī, bô chiàu-kò͘ góa ê iûⁿ-kûn.
Só͘-í, lín chiah-ê bo̍k-chiá tio̍h thiaⁿ góa Siōng Chú ê ōe.

Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú beh kap lín chiah-ê bo̍k-chiá choh-tùi. Góa beh tùi lín siu-hôe góa ê iûⁿ-kûn, put-chún lín koh chòe in ê bo̍k-chiá, mā bô beh hō͘ lín kā ka-kī chhī kah pûi-pûi-pûi. Góa beh kiù góa ê iûⁿ thoat-lī lín ê chhùi, put-chún lín chia̍h in ê bah.’”
“Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh chhin-sin khì chhē góa ê iûⁿ, kā in chhē--tò-lâi.

Bo̍k-chiá tī iûⁿ-kûn sì-sòaⁿ ê sî, án-chóaⁿ khì chhē i ê iûⁿ, góa mā beh án-ni chhē góa ê iûⁿ. In tī o͘-thiⁿ-àm-tōe ê ji̍t-chí sì-sòaⁿ khì ta̍k só͘-chāi, góa beh tùi hia kā in kiù--tò-lâi.

Góa beh tùi bān-cho̍k tiong kā in chhōa--chhut-lâi, tùi lia̍t-kok tiàu-chi̍p in, chhōa in tńg-lâi hiong-thó͘. Góa beh tī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-soaⁿ ê khoe-chúi piⁿ, hó khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi bo̍k-ióng in.

Góa beh tī hó ê chháu-po͘ bo̍k-ióng in; Í-sek-lia̍t ê koân-soaⁿ beh chòe in ê bo̍k-tiûⁿ. In beh tó tī chhiⁿ-chhùi ê bo̍k-tiûⁿ, tī Í-sek-lia̍t soaⁿ--ni̍h pûi-súi ê chháu-po͘ chia̍h-chháu.
Góa beh chhin-sin chòe góa iûⁿ-kûn ê bo̍k-chiá, hō͘ in ū an-hioh ê só͘-chāi. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

“‘Sit-lo̍h--ê, góa beh khì chhē; sit-bê--ê, góa beh kā in chhōa--tò-lâi; siū-siong--ê, góa beh kā in pau-chat; phòa-pīⁿ--ê, góa beh kā in i-tī. M̄-kú hiah-ê pûi koh ióng--ê, góa beh kā in tû-bia̍t; góa beh chiàu kong-tō bo̍k-ióng in.’
“Kóng-tio̍h góa ê iûⁿ-kûn, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh sím-phòaⁿ ta̍k-chiah iûⁿ, tī mî-iûⁿ-káng kap soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng ê tiong-kan chú-chhî kong-tō.

Lín chiah-ê tī chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chháu-po͘ chia̍h kah pûi-pûi--ê, siūⁿ-kóng che sī lí-só͘-tong-jiân sī--bô? Lín kèng-jiân ēng kha thún-ta̍h chia̍h chhun ê chháu! Lín lim chheng ê chúi, kèng-jiân ēng kha kā lim chhun ê chúi lā hō͘ lô.
Kiám kóng góa kî-tha ê iûⁿ kan-ta ōe-tàng chia̍h lín thún-ta̍h--kè ê chháu, lim lín lā-lô ê chúi?
“‘Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh chhin-sin tī lín chiah-ê pûi kap sán ê iûⁿ tiong-kan chú-chhî kong-tō.
In-ūi lín ēng pak-tó͘-piⁿ kap keng-kah-thâu khoeh soe-lám--ê, ēng kak kā in tak, kā in kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ khì pa̍t-ūi.
Só͘-í, góa beh kái-kiù góa ê iûⁿ-kûn, hō͘ in bô koh chiâⁿ-chòe la̍h-bu̍t; góa beh tī iûⁿ kap iûⁿ ê tiong-kan chú-chhî kong-tō.
Góa beh siat-li̍p chi̍t ê bo̍k-chiá, chiū-sī góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t, lâi kā in tī-lí, kā in bo̍k-ióng.
Góa Siōng Chú beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè, góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t beh chòe in ê kun-ông. Góa Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Góa beh kap in li̍p pêng-an ê iok, siau-bia̍t in kok-lāi hiong-ok ê iá-siù, in chiū thang tī khòng-iá an-jiân khiā-khí, tī chhiū-nâ lāi hioh-khùn.
“‘Góa beh sù-hok hō͘ in, mā sù-hok hō͘ góa ê soaⁿ sì-chiu-ûi ê tōe-khu. Góa beh chiàu-sî lo̍h-hō͘; hok-khì beh chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘-chúi kàng-lîm.

Chhân-iá ê chhiū-ba̍k beh kiat ké-chí, thó͘-tōe beh chhut thó͘-sán; góa ê chú-bîn beh tī ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p. Góa kòng-tn̄g in pē ê taⁿ, tùi ap-pek in ê chhiú kā in tháu-pàng ê sî, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
In bô koh chòe lia̍t-kok ê la̍h-bu̍t, hō͘ iá-siù thun-chia̍h. In beh an-jiân khiā-khí, bô koh ū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Góa beh kā in kiàn-li̍p chi̍t ê lông-tiûⁿ, hō͘ in bu̍t-sán hong-hù; in bōe koh in-ūi ki-hng siū-hāi, lia̍t-kok bōe koh kā in thí-chhiò.
In lóng beh chai góa Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè kap in tông-chāi; in sī góa ê chú-bîn.’ Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Lín sī góa ê iûⁿ, góa chháu-tiûⁿ ê iûⁿ; lín sī góa ê chú-bîn, góa sī lín ê Siōng-tè.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h tùi Í-tong -lâng thoân-ta̍t góa ê sìn-sit, chí-chek in.
Tio̍h kā in kóng, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Í-tong -lâng, góa beh kap lí choh-tùi! Góa beh chhun-chhiú kong-kek lí, hō͘ lí pha-hng hong-hòe.
Góa beh hō͘ lí ê siâⁿ-tìn pha-hng; hō͘ lí ê thó͘-tōe pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘; án-ni, lí chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
“Lí tùi kó͘-chá chiū oàn-hūn Í-sek-lia̍t. Í-sek-lia̍t in-ūi chōe-ok koàn-boán siū hêng-hoa̍t ê sî, lí kā in pàng hō͘ lâng tô͘-sat.

Só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kí ka-kī ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè: Góa beh hō͘ lí tú-tio̍h lâu-huih ê pò-èng, huih it-tēng ōe tui-jip lí; lí kì-jiân bô oàn-hūn thâi-lâng lâu-huih, lâu lâng huih ê chōe it-tēng kā lí tîⁿ chi̍t-sì-lâng.
Góa beh hō͘ Se-ní-soaⁿ pha-hng hong-hòe, bô beh hō͘ lâng koh tùi hia keng-kè.
Góa beh hō͘ Í-tong só͘-ū ê soaⁿ piàn-móa sin-si; hō͘ to thâi-sí ê lâng tó tī lí ê soaⁿ-lûn-á, soaⁿ-kok, kap khoe-kau.
Góa beh hō͘ lí éng-oán hong-hòe, bô koh ū lâng tòa tī lí ê siâⁿ-tìn. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
“Lí bat kóng, ‘ Iû-tāi kap Í-sek-lia̍t chit nn̄g kok kap in ê thó͘-tōe lóng sī góa ê, beh chòe góa ê sán-gia̍p.’ Kî-si̍t, Siōng Chú iáu tī hia.

Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kí ka-kī ê oa̍h-miā li̍p-sè: Lí án-chóaⁿ siū-khì, oàn-tò͘ góa ê chú-bîn, góa mā beh chiàu án-ni tùi-thāi lí. Góa sím-phòaⁿ lí ê sî, beh hō͘ in bat góa.
Hit-sî lí chiū chai, góa Siōng Chú ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ lí bú-jio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-soaⁿ ê ōe, kóng, ‘Chiah-ê soaⁿ í-keng hong-hòe, beh hō͘ goán thun-bia̍t.’
Lí chū-ko khoa-kháu, bô chām-chat kong-kek góa ê ōe, góa lóng ū thiaⁿ--kìⁿ.
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa it-tēng beh hō͘ lí hong-hòe, hit-sî choân-tōe beh hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.

Lí tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tōe pha-hng ê sî hoaⁿ-hí, góa mā beh chiàu lí ê só͘-chòe tùi-thāi lí. Se-ní-soaⁿ kap Í-tong choân-kok lóng beh pha-hng hong-hòe, lâng chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”

Siōng Chú bēng-lēng góa tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê chèng-soaⁿ thoân-ta̍t I ê sìn-sit, chiong Chì-koân Siōng Chú ê ōe kā in kóng. Siōng Chú kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t ê tùi-te̍k bat kóng, ‘Ha ha! Í-sek-lia̍t kó͘-chá chiū ū ê soaⁿ-lûn-á beh pìⁿ-chòe goán ê sán-gia̍p lah!’

Só͘-í lí tio̍h thoân-ta̍t góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ê sìn-sit, kóng, ‘In-ūi tùi-te̍k hō͘ lí hong-hòe, tùi sì-bīn thún-ta̍h lí, hō͘ lí chiâⁿ-chòe kî-tha kok-ka ê sán-gia̍p, hō͘ in ê jîn-bîn kā lí thí-chhiò, tòng-chòe chhiàu-tâm;
só͘-í, lín chiah-ê tōa-soaⁿ sió-soaⁿ, khoe-kau soaⁿ-kok, pha-hng ê tōe, hong-hòe ê siâⁿ, hō͘ chiu-ûi lia̍t-kok chiàm-léng siū ki-chhì--ê, tio̍h thiaⁿ Chì-koân Siōng Chú ê ōe.

Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa ê siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh to̍h, beh khiàn-chek lia̍t-kok kap Í-tong -lâng, in-ūi in sim chûn ok-to̍k, chiàm-léng góa ê thó͘-tōe, hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k chiong i tòng-chòe chiàn-lī-phín.’

“Só͘-í, lí tio̍h tùi tōa-soaⁿ sió-soaⁿ, khoe-kau soaⁿ-kok thoân-ta̍t góa iú-koan Í-sek-lia̍t thó͘-tōe ê sìn-sit, kóng, ‘In-ūi lín ū siū lia̍t-kok lêng-jio̍k, só͘-í, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú tōa siū-khì li̍p-sè kóng: Lín sì-chiu-ûi ê lia̍t-kok it-tēng mā ōe siū lêng-jio̍k. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
M̄-kú, Í-sek-lia̍t ê chèng-soaⁿ, chhiū-ba̍k ōe koh bō͘-sēng, ūi-tio̍h góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t lín chiah-ê lâng kiat ké-chí. Lín chin-kín chiū ōe tńg--lâi.
Góa koan-sim lín, thiàⁿ-sioh lín, beh hō͘ lín ê thó͘-tōe ōe-tàng koh khai-khún chèng-choh.
Góa beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ, siâⁿ-tìn ū lâng khiā-khí, hong-po͘ koh-chài tiông-kiàn.

Góa beh hō͘ lín kap lín ê cheng-siⁿ lóng heng-ōng, siⁿ-thòaⁿ chin chōe. Góa beh hō͘ lín tòa tī chá-chêng tòa--kè ê só͘-chāi, siúⁿ-sù lín pí í-chêng koh-khah chōe ê hok-khì. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.
Góa beh hō͘ góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t lín chiah-ê lâng tī chèng-soaⁿ ê téng-bīn kiâⁿ-ta̍h; in beh chiâⁿ-chòe lín ê sán-gia̍p, bōe koh hō͘ lín tī hia sòng-sit jî-lú.
“‘Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, lâng bat kóng: Chit-tè tōe ōe thun-chia̍h lâng, koh hō͘ kok-ka sòng-sit jîn-bîn.
Taⁿ, chit-tè thó͘-tōe bōe koh thun-chia̍h lâng, bōe koh hō͘ jîn-bîn sòng-sit chú-lú. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Lí chit-tè thó͘-tōe bōe koh siū lia̍t-kok lêng-jio̍k, bōe koh siū bān-cho̍k ki-chhì, mā bōe koh hō͘ jîn-bîn sòng-sit chú-lú. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tòa tī in pún-tōe ê sî, in ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe chiong hit-tè thó͘-tōe phah lâ-sâm. Tùi góa khòaⁿ, in ê hêng-ûi chhin-chhiūⁿ keng-kî tiong ê hū-lú bô chheng-khì.
In-ūi in tī hia thâi-lâng, pài ngó͘-siōng, phah lâ-sâm hit-tè thó͘-tōe, só͘-í, góa beh chiong góa ê tōa siū-khì piàⁿ-lo̍h tī in sin-chiūⁿ.
Góa beh chiàu in ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe hêng-hoa̍t in, kā in hòng-tio̍k khì gōa-pang, sì-sòaⁿ tī lia̍t-kok.
Lâng lóng teh kóng, ‘Chiah-ê lâng sī Siōng Chú ê jîn-bîn, soah tio̍h lī-khui Siōng Chú ê tōe.’ In hō͘ góa sîn-sèng ê miâ tī in khì ê lia̍t-kok siū siat-to̍k.
Góa tin-sioh góa ê sèng-miâ, m̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bô-lūn hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì tó-ūi, lóng hō͘ góa sîn-sèng ê miâ siū siat-to̍k.

“Só͘-í, tio̍h kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, góa beh chòe ê sū, m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h lín, sī ūi-tio̍h góa sîn-sèng ê miâ, in-ūi chit-ê miâ tī lín khì ê lia̍t-kok tiong siū siat-to̍k.

Lín bat hō͘ góa ê miâ tī lia̍t-kok tiong siū siat-to̍k, m̄-kú góa beh tī in tiong-kan hián-bêng góa ê miâ sī chì-tōa sîn-sèng. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Góa beh tùi lia̍t-kok tiong chhōa lín chhut--lâi, tùi bān-pang chū-chi̍p lín, chhōa lín tńg-khì ka-kī ê hiong-thó͘.
Góa beh ēng chheng-chúi kā lín hiù, lín chiū chheng-khì. Góa beh kā lín sóe chheng-khì, tû-khì lín it-chhè ê ù-òe kap só͘-ū ê ngó͘-siōng.

“‘Góa beh sù lín sin ê sim, chiong sin ê sîn khǹg tī lín lāi-bīn. Góa beh tùi lín ê seng-khu tû-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ chio̍h-thâu hiah-ni̍h tēng ê sim, koh siúⁿ-sù lín chhin-chhiūⁿ bah hiah-ni̍h nńg ê sim.
Góa beh chiong góa ê sîn khǹg tī lín lāi-bīn, hō͘ lín ōe chun-siú góa ê kui-lē, sūn-thàn góa ê bēng-lēng.
Lín beh tòa tī góa sù hō͘ lín chó͘-sian ê hit-tè thó͘-tōe. Lín beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn, góa chòe lín ê Siōng-tè.
Góa beh kiù lín thoat-lī it-chhè ê ù-òe, mā beh hō͘ lín ngó͘-kok hong-siu, bōe koh ū ki-hng.
Góa beh hō͘ lín ê chhiū-ba̍k gâu kiat ké-chí, chhân-hn̂g chhut-sán chin chōe, hō͘ lín bōe koh in-ūi ki-hng siū lia̍t-kok bú-jio̍k.
Hit-sî, lín ōe siūⁿ-khí ka-kī siâ-ok ê hêng-ûi kap só͘ hoān ê chōe-kò, mā beh in-ūi lín ê chōe-ok kap thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū iàm-chiān ka-kī.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, lín tio̍h chai, góa án-ni chòe m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h lín. Lín tio̍h ūi ka-kī ê hêng-ûi kiàn-siàu pháiⁿ-sè. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.’
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa chiong lín só͘-ū ê chōe kiat-chēng liáu-āu, beh hō͘ lín ê siâⁿ-tìn ū lâng khiā-khí, hong-po͘ koh-chài tiông-kiàn.
Chit-tè pha-hng ê tōe, chiū-sī kè-lō͘ ê lâng chá-chêng khòaⁿ-chòe hong-po͘ ê só͘-chāi, taⁿ ōe-tàng khai-khún chèng-choh.

In beh kóng: Chit-tè í-chêng pha-hng ê tōe, hiān-chāi kèng-jiân chhin-chhiūⁿ I-tiân-hn̂g; chiah-ê pha-hng, hong-hòe, hō͘ lâng húi-hoāi ê só͘-chāi, hiān-chāi pìⁿ-chòe kian-kò͘, ū lâng khiā-khí ê siâⁿ-tìn.

Hit-sî, lí sì-chiu-ûi iáu-bē bia̍t-bông ê kok-ka beh chai, sī góa Siōng Chú tiông-kiàn hong-hòe ê siâⁿ-tìn, koh-chài chiong hong-po͘ khai-khún chèng-choh. Góa Siōng Chú kóng chhut-chhùi, it-tēng si̍t-hêng.’
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Góa beh koh hôe-èng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tùi góa ê khún-kiû, hō͘ in ê jîn-kháu chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-kûn hiah-ni̍h chōe.
Hong-hòe ê siâⁿ-tìn beh koh ū lâng oe-oe-khoeh-khoeh, chhin-chhiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tī choeh-kî hiàn-chè ê iûⁿ-kûn hiah-ni̍h chōe. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”
Siōng Chú ê khùi-la̍t chhiong-móa góa; I ê sîn chhōa góa khì chi̍t ê soaⁿ-kok; hit-ê soaⁿ-kok sì-kòe lóng sī kut-thâu.
I chhōa góa kiâⁿ-thàu kui-ê soaⁿ-kok. Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ kut-thâu piàn-móa soaⁿ-kok; hiah-ê kut-thâu lóng ta-khok-khok.
I tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, chiah-ê kut-thâu kiám ōe koh oa̍h--khí-lâi?” Góa ìn kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú, che chí-ū lí chai!”
I koh tùi góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h tùi chiah-ê kut-thâu thoân-ta̍t góa ê sìn-sit, kóng, ‘Ko͘-tâ ê kut-thâu, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú tùi lín kóng: Góa beh pûn-khùi ji̍p-khì lín lāi-bīn, hō͘ lín oa̍h--khí-lâi.
Góa beh hō͘ lín siⁿ kun siⁿ bah, koh ēng phê kā lín pau--khí-lâi. Góa beh pûn-khùi ji̍p lín lāi-bīn, hō͘ lín oa̍h--khí-lâi. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”
Góa chiū chun-chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng thoân-ta̍t I ê sìn-sit. Teh kóng ê sî, hut-jiân góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ khi-khi-kho̍k-kho̍k ê siaⁿ, kut-thâu kap kut-thâu liân-chiap--khí-lâi.
Góa chù-ì khòaⁿ, kut-thâu khai-sí siⁿ kun siⁿ bah, koh ū phê kā in pau--khí-lâi, m̄-kú bô oa̍h-khì.

Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h tùi hong thoân-ta̍t góa ê sìn-sit, kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Hong ah, tio̍h tùi sì-bīn chhe--lâi, chhe ji̍p-khì chiah-ê hō͘ lâng thâi-sí ê lâng lāi-bīn, hō͘ in oa̍h--khí-lâi.’”

Góa chiū chun-chiàu Siōng Chú ê bēng-lēng thoân-ta̍t I ê sìn-sit; khùi chiū chìn-ji̍p kut-thâu lāi-bīn, in chiū oa̍h--khí-lâi, khiā--teh. In ê sò͘-bo̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ kun-tūi hiah-ni̍h chōe.
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, chiah-ê kut-thâu chiū-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng. In kóng, ‘Goán ê kut-thâu ta-khok-khok, bô ǹg-bāng bô chiân-tô͘.’

Só͘-í, lí tio̍h tùi góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t thoân-ta̍t góa ê sìn-sit, kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa ê chú-bîn ah, góa beh phah-khui lín ê hûn-bōng, hō͘ lín tùi bōng chhut--lâi, chhōa lín tńg-khì Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe.
Góa phah-khui lín ê hûn-bōng, chhōa lín chhut--lâi liáu-āu, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.

Góa beh chiong góa ê khùi pûn-ji̍p lín lāi-bīn, hō͘ lín oa̍h--khí-lâi. Góa beh kā lín an-tì tī lín ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe. Án-ni, lín chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú. Góa kóng chhut-chhùi, it-tēng si̍t-hêng.’ Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, lí khì the̍h chi̍t tè chhâ-pang lâi, tī téng-bīn siá ‘ Iû-tāi ông-kok kap i ê jîn-bîn’; koh khì the̍h lēng-gōa chi̍t tè chhâ-pang, tī téng-bīn siá ‘ Í-sek-lia̍t ông-kok kap i ê jîn-bîn’.
Jiân-āu, chiong chit nn̄g tè chhâ-pang liân chòe-hé, hō͘ in tī lí ê chhiú-tiong chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t tè.
Lí ê tông-pau nā mn̄g lí, ‘Lí kiám bô beh kā goán kóng che sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù?’

Lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh kā tāi-piáu Í-sek-lia̍t hit-tè chhâ-pang liân tī tāi-piáu Iû-tāi hit-tè, hō͘ nn̄g tè tī góa ê chhiú-tiong chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t tè.’
“Lí tio̍h chiong lí ū siá-jī hit nn̄g tè chhâ-pang the̍h tī chhiú--ni̍h hō͘ in khòaⁿ.

Jiân-āu, lí tio̍h kā in kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh chiong góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t tùi in siū hòng-tio̍k ê lia̍t-kok tiong tòa--chhut-lâi; góa beh tùi sè-kài ta̍k kak-lo̍h kā in chū-chi̍p--khí-lâi, chhōa in tò-lâi ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe.
Góa beh hō͘ in tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê chèng-soaⁿ, chit-tè thó͘-tōe, chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê kok-ka, chí-ū chi̍t ê ông thóng-tī; in bô koh sī nn̄g kok, bōe koh hun-lia̍t chòe nn̄g kok.

In bōe koh in-ūi pài ngó͘-siōng kap thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê mi̍h, í-ki̍p kî-tha ê chōe-kò phah lâ-sâm ka-kī. Góa beh kiù in thoat-lī pōe-ge̍k ê seng-oa̍h, kā in sóe chheng-khì. Án-ni, in beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn, góa beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè.
“‘Góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t beh choh-ông thóng-tī in; in beh kui-sio̍k chi̍t ê bo̍k-chiá. In beh ho̍k-chiông góa ê bēng-lēng, chun-siú góa ê kui-lē.

In beh tòa tī góa sù hō͘ góa ê po̍k-jîn Ngá-kok hit-tè thó͘-tōe, chiū-sī in ê chó͘-sian tòa--kè ê hit-tè tōe. In kap in ê kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun beh éng-oán tòa tī hia. Góa ê po̍k-jîn Tāi-pi̍t beh choh-ông thóng-tī in, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.

Góa beh kap in li̍p pêng-an ê iok; chit-ê iok beh chiâⁿ-chòe éng-oán ê iok. Góa beh hō͘ in an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p, jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ, koh siat-li̍p góa ê sèng-tiān tī in tiong-kan, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
Góa beh khiā-khí tī in tiong-kan. Góa beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè, in beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn.
Góa beh hō͘ góa ê sèng-tiān éng-oán tiàm tī in tiong-kan, lia̍t-kok chiū chai, sī góa Siōng Chú kā Í-sek-lia̍t hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng.’”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h tùi Má-kok tōe-khu ê Ko-kek thoân-ta̍t góa ê sìn-sit; i sī Bí-siat kap Thó͘-pa chit nn̄g ê kok-ka ê thóng-tī-chiá.
Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘ Bí-siat kap Thó͘-pa ê thóng-tī-chiá Ko-kek, góa beh kap lí choh-tùi.

Góa beh ēng kau-á kau lí ê gê-chô, kā lí thoa hoan-thâu, hō͘ lí kap lí tòa-niá ê kun-tūi, chiàn-bé, bé-peng thâi-su thiat-thè. Lí ê kun-tūi lâng chōe, ū choân-thò ê bú-chong; in chhiú gia̍h tōa-sòe tún-pâi kap to-kiàm.
Lí ê kun-tūi ū tùi Pho-su, Kó͘-si̍t, kap Hut chhiàⁿ--lâi ê chiàn-sū; in mā lóng the̍h tún-pâi, tì thâu-khoe.
Lēng-gōa, Ko-bia̍t -lâng kap ke̍k pak-pêng Tô-ka-má -cho̍k ê kun-tūi, í-ki̍p chōe-chōe lâng mā tè lí lâi.
Lí kap chū-chi̍p tī lí hia ê tāi-kun tio̍h chún-pī hó-sè; lí tio̍h chòe in ê chí-hui-koaⁿ.

Kè chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan, góa beh chhe-phài lí tī chiong-lâi chhut-peng cheng-ho̍k Í-sek-lia̍t; i ê jîn-bîn bat thoat-lī to-kiàm ê chai-lān, tùi lia̍t-kok tńg--lâi, chū-chi̍p tī Í-sek-lia̍t pha-hng ê chèng-soaⁿ an-jiân khiā-khí.
Lí kap lí ê tāi-kun, í-ki̍p chin chōe tè lí ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, beh chhin-chhiūⁿ pō-hong sàu--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ o͘-hûn khàm-ba̍t chit-tè thó͘-tōe.’
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú tùi Ko-kek án-ni kóng, ‘Hit-sî, lí ê sim beh tô͘-bô͘ pháiⁿ-sū.
Lí siūⁿ-kóng: Góa beh chhim-ji̍p hit-tè bô siat-hông ê tōe, khì pêng-an seng-oa̍h ê jîn-bîn hia; in khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi bô chhiûⁿ, bô mn̂g, bô chhòaⁿ.

Góa beh khì hia kong-kek í-chêng pha-hng, hiān-chāi ū lâng tòa ê tōe, kong-kek hiah-ê tùi lia̍t-kok tńg--lâi, chek-chū chin chōe cheng-siⁿ kap châi-pó, tòa tī choân-tōe tiong-sim ê jîn-bîn; tī hia chhiúⁿ-toa̍t in ê châi-bu̍t.’

Sī-pa -lâng, Tí-tān -lâng, kap tùi Tha-si hù-kūn ta̍k siâⁿ-tìn lâi ê seng-lí-lâng beh mn̄g lí, ‘Lí siūⁿ-beh chhiúⁿ cheng-siⁿ, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t kim-gûn châi-pó sī--bô? Lí siūⁿ-beh chiong só͘-ū ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ lóng chhiúⁿ-chhiúⁿ--khì sī--bô?’
“Só͘-í, jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h tùi Ko-kek thoân-ta̍t góa ê sìn-sit, kóng: Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lí bêng-bêng chai góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t pêng-an kè-ji̍t,
kèng-jiân tùi ke̍k pak-pêng lí tòa ê só͘-chāi, chhōa kiông-béng ê tāi-kun khiâ chiàn-bé lâi.

Ko-kek ah, lí lâi kong-táⁿ góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t; lí ê kun-tūi chhin-chhiūⁿ o͘-hûn khàm-ba̍t tōe-bīn. Kè chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan, góa beh chhōa lí khì chhim-lio̍k góa ê thó͘-tōe, thang hō͘ lia̍t-kok jīn-bat góa; góa mā beh thong-kè lí, tùi in chèng-si̍t góa sī sîn-sèng.

Lí chiū-sī góa chá-chêng thong-kè góa ê po̍k-jîn, Í-sek-lia̍t ê chèng sian-ti só͘ ū-giân hit-ê lâng. Hit-sî, góa bat thong-kè góa ê po̍k-jîn — Í-sek-lia̍t ê chèng sian-ti thoân-ta̍t góa ê sìn-sit, góa beh chhōa lí lâi kong-táⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t.’ Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.”
“Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng, ‘ Ko-kek chhim-lio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t hit-ji̍t, góa beh hoat tōa siū-khì.
Góa kui pak-tó͘ hé tōa siū-khì soan-kò: Tī hit-ji̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t beh ū tōa tōe-tāng.

Hái--ni̍h ê hî, khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu, chhân-iá ê cháu-siù, tōe-chiūⁿ ê tōng-bu̍t, í-ki̍p só͘-ū ê lâng, lóng beh tī góa ê bīn-chêng phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah. Koân-soaⁿ beh piak-li̍h, soaⁿ-khàm beh pang--khì, siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ beh tó-hoāi.
Góa beh tī Í-sek-lia̍t chèng-soaⁿ ēng to-kiàm kong-kek Ko-kek; i ê kun-tūi beh hō͘-siōng chân-sat. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Góa beh ēng un-e̍k kap to-kiàm hêng-hoa̍t i. Góa koh beh lo̍h tōa-hō͘, piàⁿ peng-pha̍uh, kàng tōa-hé, liû-hông tī i só͘ tòa-niá ê kun-tūi kap tè i ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng sin-chiūⁿ,
thong-kè chiah-ê, tùi lia̍t-kok hián-bêng góa ka-kī, í-ki̍p góa ê úi-tāi kap sîn-sèng. Hit-sî, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.’”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h tùi Bí-siat kap Thó͘-pa chit nn̄g ê kok-ka ê thóng-tī-chiá Ko-kek thoân-ta̍t góa ê sìn-sit, kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Góa beh kap lí choh-tùi.
Góa beh kā lí tiàu hoan-thâu, hō͘ lí lī-khui ke̍k pak-pêng ê só͘-chāi, chhōa lí khì kong-táⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t ê soaⁿ.
Jiân-āu, góa beh kā lí tò-chhiú ê keng kap chiàⁿ-chhiú ê chìⁿ phah lak--khì.
Lí kap lí ê kun-tūi, í-ki̍p tè lí lâi ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, lóng beh sí tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê soaⁿ. Góa beh hō͘ lí chòe eng-chiáu kap iá-siù ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Góa bat kóng, lí beh sí tī iá-tōe. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Góa beh pàng-hé sio Má-kok kap pêng-an khiā-khí tī iân-hái it-tài ê jîn-bîn. Án-ni, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú.

Góa beh tī góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t tiong-kan hián-sī góa ê sèng-miâ, choa̍t-tùi bô iông-ún góa ê sèng-miâ koh siū siat-to̍k. Án-ni, lia̍t-kok chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè.
“‘Lín tio̍h chai! Ji̍t-kî kàu lah, góa kóng ê hit-ji̍t lâi lah! Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k siâⁿ-tìn ê chū-bîn beh chhut-khì khioh lâng hiat-ka̍k ê kun-khì chòe hiâⁿ-hé ê chhâ, chiū-sī tún-pâi, keng, chìⁿ, chhiuⁿ, kùn-á; chiah-ê ū-kàu hō͘ in hiâⁿ chhit nî kú.

In m̄-bián koh khì iá-gōa khioh-chhâ, m̄-bián koh khì chhiū-nâ chhò-chhâ, in-ūi lâng hiat-ka̍k ê kun-khì ōe-tàng hō͘ in hiâⁿ-hé. In beh chhiúⁿ hiah-ê bat chhiúⁿ in ê lâng, beh kiap hiah-ê bat kiap in ê lâng. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.’”

Siōng Chú kóng, “Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh tī Sí-hái ê tang-pêng Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe ê ‘Chhut-gōa-lâng Soaⁿ-kok’, chhē chi̍t tè tōe hō͘ Ko-kek chòe bōng-tōe. Chit-tè bōng-tōe ōe tòng-tio̍h beh tùi hia keng-kè ê lâng, in-ūi Ko-kek kap kun-tè i ê kun-peng bâi-chòng tī hia. Chit-ê soaⁿ-kok beh kiò-chòe ‘ Ko-kek Kun-peng-kok’.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ūi-tio̍h beh kiat-chēng hit-tè tōe, ēng chhit kò-ge̍h ê sî-kan kā in bâi-chòng.
Hit só͘-chāi ê lâng lóng chhut-lâi chham-ú, tùi án-ni, in tit-tio̍h o-ló. Che sī góa hián-sī êng-kng ê ji̍t. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
In chhit kò-ge̍h kú phài choan-lâng khì ta̍k só͘-chāi sûn-cha, chiong hiah-ê lâi chhim-hoān Í-sek-lia̍t ê lâng ê si-thé bâi-chòng hó-sè, hō͘ thó͘-tōe kiat-chēng.
Sûn-cha ê lâng kiâⁿ-thàu ta̍k só͘-chāi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h sí-lâng ê kut-thâu, chiū tī piⁿ--á chòe kì-hō, thèng-hāu lâng chiong hiah-ê kut-thâu bâi-chòng tī ‘ Ko-kek Kun-peng-kok’.
Tī hia mā ū chi̍t chō siâⁿ kiò-chòe Hap-mô͘-ná, ì-sù sī ‘Kun-peng ê siâⁿ’. Án-ni, thó͘-tōe chiū tit-tio̍h kiat-chēng.”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, tio̍h tùi ta̍k-chióng ê pe-chiáu kap iá-siù kóng, ‘Lâi, tùi ta̍k só͘-chāi chū-chi̍p óa--lâi, lâi chia̍h góa tī Í-sek-lia̍t ê soaⁿ ūi lín chún-pī ê chè-bah. Lín thang tī hia chia̍h-bah lim-huih.
Lín beh chia̍h chiàn-sū ê bah, lim sè-kan siú-léng ê huih, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chia̍h Pa-san pûi ê mî-iûⁿ-káng, iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, gû-káng siâng-khoán.
Lín beh chia̍h góa ūi-tio̍h lín chún-pī ê chè-bah; chia̍h-bah chia̍h kah pá, lim-huih lim kah chùi.
Lín beh tī góa ê iàn-se̍k chia̍h chiàn-bé, bé-peng, chiàn-sū, chiū-sī só͘-ū tāi-kun ê bah, chia̍h kàu pá-pá-pá. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.’”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh tùi lia̍t-kok hián-sī góa ê êng-kng, bān-bîn chiū beh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa án-chóaⁿ hē-chhiú tī in sin-chiūⁿ, si-hêng sím-phòaⁿ.
Tùi hit-ji̍t khí, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng beh chai góa sī Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè.

Lia̍t-kok beh bêng-pe̍k, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siū hòng-tio̍k sī in-ūi in ê chōe-kò. In pōe-poān góa, góa chiū bīn oa̍t-cháu bô khòaⁿ-kò͘ in, koh chiong in kau hō͘ in ê tùi-te̍k, hō͘ tùi-te̍k kā in thâi-sí.
Góa chiàu in ê ù-òe kap chōe-kò tùi-thāi in. Góa bīn oa̍t-cháu bô beh khòaⁿ-kò͘ in.”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Taⁿ, góa beh lîn-bín Í-sek-lia̍t só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn, hō͘ siū hòng-tio̍k ê Ngá-kok hō͘-tāi tńg--lâi, koh beh chīn-la̍t ûi-hō͘ góa ê sèng-miâ.
In tī ka-kī ê hiong-thó͘ an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p, bô siū ui-hia̍p ê sî, in beh bōe-kì-tit kè-khì só͘ siū ê kiàn-siàu kap pōe-ge̍k góa ê chōe.
Góa kā in tùi tùi-te̍k ê tōe chū-chi̍p--khí-lâi, tùi lia̍t-kok chhōa tńg--lâi ê sî, lia̍t-kok chiū chai góa sī sîn-sèng.
Góa kā in hòng-tio̍k khì gōa-pang, āu-lâi koh kā in chū-chi̍p tńg-lâi pún-tōe, bô lâu chi̍t ê tī gōa-pang, in chiū chai góa sī Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè.
Góa beh chiong góa ê sîn piàⁿ-lo̍h hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, bōe koh oa̍t-tńg-sin bô khòaⁿ-kò͘ in.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Goán siū hòng-tio̍k ê tē-jī-cha̍p-gō͘ nî, chiū-sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lûn-hām ê tē-cha̍p-sì nî, chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-cha̍p, Siōng Chú ê khùi-la̍t chhiong-móa góa, kā góa chhōa-khì Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe.
Tī īⁿ-siōng tiong, Siōng Chú kā góa hē tī Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe chi̍t chō ke̍k-koân ê soaⁿ. Soaⁿ ê lâm-pêng ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ ū chi̍t chō siâⁿ.
I chhōa góa khì hia; góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê lâng, i ê hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ tâng hoat kng, chhiú the̍h môa-soh kap lô͘-tek ê niû-chhioh, khiā tī mn̂g-kháu.

I tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, góa kā lí hoan-hù--ê, lí tio̍h siông-sè khòaⁿ, chù-ì thiaⁿ, koh kì tī sim-lāi, in-ūi che sī góa chhōa lí lâi chia ê bo̍k-te̍k. Lí tio̍h chiong só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê it-chhè, lóng kā Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng.”

Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sèng-tiān, sì-chiu-ûi ū ûi-chhiûⁿ. Hit-ê lâng chhiú the̍h chi̍t ki saⁿ kong-chhioh tn̂g ê lô͘-tek-chhioh. I niû chhiûⁿ; chhiûⁿ koân saⁿ kong-chhioh, kāu saⁿ kong-chhioh.
I kàu tang-mn̂g, peh-chiūⁿ kiā-á, niû mn̂g ê hō͘-tēng, khoah saⁿ kong-chhioh.

Hia mā ū siú-ōe-sek; ta̍k-keng tn̂g saⁿ kong-chhioh, khoah saⁿ kong-chhioh. Pâng-keng kap pâng-keng tiong-kan làng nn̄g kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ. Cháu-lông ū chi̍t ê mn̂g ǹg sèng-tiān; hit-ê mn̂g ê hō͘-tēng, khoah saⁿ kong-chhioh.
I niû beh khì sèng-tiān ê mn̂g ê cháu-lông, khoah saⁿ kong-chhioh.
I koh niû thàng khì sèng-tiān hit-ê cháu-lông, khoah sì kong-chhioh; piah-thiāu kāu chi̍t kong-chhioh.
Tang-mn̂g ê siú-ōe-sek chit-pêng saⁿ keng, hit-pêng saⁿ keng, ta̍k-keng tōa-sòe lóng siâng-khoán; nn̄g pêng ê piah-thiāu kāu-tō͘ mā siâng-khoán.
I niû tang-mn̂g ê ji̍p-kháu khoah gō͘ kong-chhioh, mn̂g pún-sin la̍k kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.
Ta̍k-keng siú-ōe-sek ê thâu-chêng lóng ū chhiûⁿ-á, koân gō͘-cha̍p kong-hun, kāu gō͘-cha̍p kong-hun; pâng-keng ê tn̂g kap khoah lóng saⁿ kong-chhioh.
Nn̄g pêng siú-ōe-sek ê mn̂g sio-tùi, chit-pêng siú-ōe-sek ê gōa-piah niû kàu hit-pêng siú-ōe-sek ê gōa-piah, ū cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.
I sūn chhiûⁿ niû, kàu thàng khì gōa-tiâⁿ ê chhiûⁿ, tn̂g saⁿ-cha̍p kong-chhioh.
I koh tùi tōa-mn̂g-kháu chit-pêng niû kàu cháu-lông āu-bīn ê chhiûⁿ, tn̂g jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh.
Ta̍k-keng siú-ōe-sek, piah-thiāu kap piah-thiāu ê tiong-kan, í-ki̍p cháu-lông nn̄g pêng lóng ū thang-á. Piah-thiāu téng-bīn ū khek chang-chhiū.
Hit-ê lâng chhōa góa khì gōa-tiâⁿ. Gōa-tiâⁿ chiu-ûi ū saⁿ-cha̍p keng pâng-keng, thô͘-kha pho͘ chio̍h.
Pho͘ chio̍h ê lō͘ tùi lāi-tiâⁿ se̍h kàu gōa-tiâⁿ, khoah-tō͘ kap mn̂g kâng-khoán; gōa-tiâⁿ pho͘ ê lō͘ pí lāi-tiâⁿ khah kē.
I koh niû tùi lāi-tiâⁿ ê mn̂g kàu gōa-tiâⁿ gōa-piah ê mn̂g, tn̂g gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh. Pak-pêng kap tang-pêng siâng-khoán.
Hit-ê lâng koh niû gōa-tiâⁿ pak-mn̂g ê tn̂g kap khoah.

Cháu-lông nn̄g pêng kok ū saⁿ keng siú-ōe-sek. Nn̄g pêng ê piah-thiāu í-ki̍p cháu-lông ê chhùn-chhioh kap tang-mn̂g siâng-khoán, tn̂g jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh, khoah cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.

Cháu-lông, thang-á, kap tiau-khek ê chang-chhiū, lóng kap tang-mn̂g ê chhùn-chhioh kâng-khoán. Cháu-lông ê ji̍p-kháu peh chhit chàn kiā-á chiūⁿ kàu pak-mn̂g; cháu-lông lēng-gōa chi̍t pêng thàng gōa-tiâⁿ.
Lāi-tiâⁿ ū chi̍t ê mn̂g kap pak-mn̂g sio-tùi; pak-pêng kap tang-pêng lóng siâng-khoán. I niû chit nn̄g ê mn̂g ê kū-lī, tn̂g gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh.

Hit-ê lâng chhōa góa kiâⁿ tùi lâm-pêng, khì kàu lâm-mn̂g. I niû chit-ê mn̂g; nn̄g pêng ê piah-thiāu í-ki̍p cháu-lông ê chhùn-chhioh lóng kap thâu-chêng nn̄g ê mn̂g kâng-khoán.

Chit-ê mn̂g nn̄g pêng kap cháu-lông sì-chiu-ûi lóng ū thang-á, kap thâu-chêng niû ê thang-á kâng-khoán. Mn̂g ê cháu-lông tn̂g jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh, khoah cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.

Cháu-lông ê ji̍p-kháu peh chhit chàn kiā-á chiūⁿ kàu lâm-mn̂g, cháu-lông lēng-gōa chi̍t pêng thàng gōa-tiâⁿ. Cháu-lông ê piah-thiāu ū khek chang-chhiū, chit-pêng chi̍t châng, hit-pêng chi̍t châng.
Lāi-tiâⁿ lâm-pêng mā ū mn̂g. Hit-ê lâng niû chit nn̄g ê mn̂g tiong-kan ê kū-lī, tn̂g gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh.
Hit-ê lâng chhōa góa tùi lâm-mn̂g ji̍p-khì lāi-tiâⁿ. I niû lāi-tiâⁿ ê lâm-mn̂g, chhùn-chhioh kap gōa-tiâⁿ ê mn̂g siâng-khoán.

Chiah-ê siú-ōe-sek, cháu-lông, kap piah-thiāu, tōa-sòe lóng kap kî-tha ê mn̂g kâng-khoán. Chit-ê mn̂g kap cháu-lông sì-chiu-ûi lóng ū thang-á. Mn̂g ê cháu-lông tn̂g jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh, khoah cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.
Sì-bīn ū cháu-lông, tn̂g jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh, khoah cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.
Cháu-lông bīn ǹg gōa-tiâⁿ, piah-thiāu ū khek chang-chhiū; peh poeh chàn kiā-á chiū thàng kàu chit-ê mn̂g.
Hit-ê lâng chhōa góa tùi tang-mn̂g ji̍p-khì lāi-tiâⁿ. I niû lāi-tiâⁿ ê tang-mn̂g, chhùn-chhioh kap gōa-tiâⁿ ê mn̂g siâng-khoán.

Chiah-ê siú-ōe-sek, cháu-lông, kap piah-thiāu, tōa-sòe lóng kap kî-tha ê mn̂g kâng-khoán. Chit-ê mn̂g kap cháu-lông sì-chiu-ûi lóng ū thang-á. Mn̂g ê cháu-lông tn̂g jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh, khoah cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.
Cháu-lông bīn ǹg gōa-tiâⁿ, mn̂g nn̄g pêng ê piah-thiāu lóng ū khek chang-chhiū; peh poeh chàn kiā-á chiū thàng kàu chit-ê mn̂g.
Hit-ê lâng chhōa góa tùi pak-mn̂g ji̍p-khì lāi-tiâⁿ. I niû lāi-tiâⁿ ê pak-mn̂g, chhùn-chhioh kap gōa-tiâⁿ ê mn̂g siâng-khoán.
I mā niû chiah-ê siú-ōe-sek, cháu-lông, kap piah-thiāu. Mn̂g ê sì-chiu-ûi lóng ū thang-á. Mn̂g ê cháu-lông tn̂g jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh, khoah cha̍p-jī kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.
Cháu-lông bīn ǹg gōa-tiâⁿ, cháu-lông nn̄g pêng ê piah-thiāu lóng ū khek chang-chhiū; peh poeh chàn kiā-á chiū thàng kàu chit-ê mn̂g.
Tī ta̍k-ê mn̂g ê cháu-lông piⁿ--á lóng ū chi̍t keng ū mn̂g ê pâng-keng; chè-si tī hia sóe sio-hòa-chè ê cheng-siⁿ.
Cháu-lông ū hē toh-á, chit-pêng nn̄g tè, hit-pêng nn̄g tè; in tī chiah-ê toh-á téng thâi sio-hòa-chè, sio̍k-chōe-chè, kap pê-chōe-chè ê cheng-siⁿ.
Cháu-lông beh khì pak-mn̂g ê mn̂g-kháu, ǹg gōa-bīn hit-pêng ū nn̄g tè toh-á, ǹg lāi-bīn chit-pêng mā ū nn̄g tè.
Só͘-í, tōa-mn̂g nn̄g pêng kok ū sì tè toh-á, chóng-kiōng ū poeh tè, thang tī hit téng-bīn thâi hiàn-chè ê cheng-siⁿ.

Sio-hòa-chè beh ēng ê toh-á ū sì tè; chiah-ê toh-á sī ēng chio̍h-thâu phah--ê, koân gō͘-cha̍p kong-hun, toh-bīn tn̂g khoah lóng sī chhit-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-hun; thâi sio-hòa-chè kap kî-tha chè-sū ê cheng-siⁿ beh ēng ê khì-khū hē tī toh-téng.
Cháu-lông sì-chiu-ûi ê piah ū kau-á, tn̂g chhit kong-hun-pòaⁿ. Hiàn-chè ê bah lóng hē tī toh-téng.

Hit-ê lâng chhōa góa ji̍p-khì lāi-tiâⁿ. Lāi-tiâⁿ ū nn̄g keng ūi-tio̍h chhiùⁿ-koa ê lâng siat ê pâng-keng, chi̍t keng tī pak-mn̂g ê piⁿ--á, ǹg lâm; chi̍t keng tī lâm-mn̂g ê piⁿ--á, ǹg pak.
I kā góa kóng, “Ǹg lâm ê pâng-keng sī beh hō͘ tī sèng-tiān sū-hōng ê chè-si ēng--ê.

Ǹg pak ê pâng-keng sī beh hō͘ tī chè-tôaⁿ sū-hōng ê chè-si ēng--ê. Chiah-ê chè-si lóng sī Lī-bī chi-cho̍k tiong Sat-tok ê hō͘-tāi; chí-ū in thang lâi Siōng Chú bīn-chêng sū-hōng.”
Hit-ê lâng koh niû lāi-tiâⁿ, tn̂g, khoah lóng sī gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh. Chè-tôaⁿ tī sèng-tiān thâu-chêng.

I koh chhōa góa khì kàu sèng-tiān thâu-chêng ê cháu-lông. I niû cháu-lông ê piah-thiāu, kāu nn̄g kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ; mn̂g ê khoah chhit kong-chhioh, nn̄g pêng ê piah kāu lóng sī chi̍t kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.

Cháu-lông ê tn̂g cha̍p kong-chhioh, khoah gō͘ kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ; lâng tio̍h peh kiā-á chiah ōe-tàng khì kàu cháu-lông. Óa-kūn piah-thiāu ū thiāu-á, chit-pêng chi̍t ki, hit-pêng chi̍t ki.
Hit-ê lâng chhōa góa khì kàu sèng-tiān; i niû piah-thiāu, nn̄g pêng ê khoah lóng sī saⁿ kong-chhioh.

Ji̍p-kháu ê mn̂g khoah gō͘ kong-chhioh, mn̂g nn̄g pêng ê piah, chit-pêng nn̄g kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ, hit-pêng nn̄g kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ. I koh niû sèng-tiān, tn̂g jī-cha̍p kong-chhioh, khoah cha̍p kong-chhioh.
Jiân-āu, i ji̍p-khì lōe-tiān. I niû hiah-ê piah-thiāu, kāu chi̍t kong-chhioh; ji̍p-kháu pún-sin khoah saⁿ kong-chhioh, nn̄g pêng ê piah khoah lóng sī saⁿ kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.
I koh niû lōe-tiān, tn̂g kap khoah lóng sī cha̍p kong-chhioh. I kā góa kóng, “Che sī Chì-sèng-só͘.”
Hit-ê lâng niû sèng-tiān ê piah, kāu saⁿ kong-chhioh. Sèng-tiān chiu-ûi ū siuⁿ-pâng, ta̍k-keng khoah nn̄g kong-chhioh.

Siuⁿ-pâng ū saⁿ chàn, chi̍t chàn tha̍h chi̍t chàn, ta̍k-chàn ū saⁿ-cha̍p keng siuⁿ-pâng. Sèng-tiān gōa-piah sì-ûi ū png-chhiûⁿ, kā siuⁿ-pâng thuh--teh, chiah bián siuⁿ-pâng kan-ta khò sèng-tiān ê piah.
Sèng-tiān chiu-ûi ê siuⁿ-pâng, ná koân ná khoah. Ū lâu-thui thang tùi it-lâu chiūⁿ kàu jī-lâu, koh kàu saⁿ-lâu. Sèng-tiān ê kiat-kò͘ jú koân jú khoah.
Góa koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sèng-tiān chiu-ûi ū koân ê pîⁿ-tâi, chòe siuⁿ-pâng ê tōe-ki; pîⁿ-tâi saⁿ kong-chhioh koân.
Chiah-ê siuⁿ-pâng ê gōa-piah kāu nn̄g kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ. Sèng-tiān ê siuⁿ-pâng kap chè-si ēng ê pâng-keng tiong-kan ê sì-chiu-ûi ū khàng-tōe, khoah cha̍p kong-chhioh.
Siuⁿ-pâng ê mn̂g lóng ǹg khàng-tōe; chi̍t ê mn̂g ǹg pak, chi̍t ê mn̂g ǹg lâm. Sì-chiu-ûi ê khàng-tōe khoah nn̄g kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.
Sèng-tiān sai-pêng hit-phiàn khàng-tōe ê āu-bīn ū chi̍t keng chhù, tn̂g sì-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh, khoah saⁿ-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh, sì-ûi ê piah kāu nn̄g kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.
Hit-ê lâng niû sèng-tiān, tn̂g gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh; tùi sèng-tiān āu-piah kàu khàng-tōe sai-pêng hit-keng chhù, kū-lī tn̂g gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh.
Sèng-tiān ê thâu-chêng, chiū-sī tang-pêng ê khàng-tōe, khoah gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh.
I koh niû sai-pêng hit-keng chhù, pau-koat nn̄g pêng ê cháu-lông, tn̂g gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh. Sèng-tiān ê lōe-tiān, gōa-bīn ê cháu-lông,
hō͘-tēng, thang-á, í-ki̍p hō͘-tēng tùi-bīn saⁿ chàn ê cháu-lông, tùi thô͘-kha kàu thang-á lóng ēng chhâ-pang pau--teh. Chiah-ê thang-á lóng koaiⁿ--teh.
Lōe-tiān kap gōa-tiâⁿ chiu-ûi ê piah, tùi thô͘-kha kàu mn̂g ê téng-bīn, lóng chiàu chhùn-chhioh ēng chhâ-pang pau--teh.
Ta̍k-bīn piah ū khek ki-lō͘-pek kap chang-chhiū; ki-lō͘-pek kap ki-lō͘-pek tiong-kan ū chi̍t châng chang-chhiū; ta̍k-ê ki-lō͘-pek ū nn̄g khoán bīn:
Chi̍t ê bīn sī lâng ê bīn, ǹg chit-pêng ê chang-chhiū; chi̍t ê bīn sī sai ê bīn, ǹg hit-pêng ê chang-chhiū. Sèng-tiān chiu-ûi ê piah lóng kâng-khoán.
Án-ni, sèng-tiān ê piah, tùi thô͘-kha kàu mn̂g ê téng-bīn, lóng ū ki-lō͘-pek kap chang-chhiū.
Sèng-só͘ ê mn̂g-thiāu sī sì-kak--ê. Tī Chì-sèng-só͘ ê thâu-chêng ū chi̍t ê

khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ bo̍k-chō ê chè-tôaⁿ, koân chi̍t kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ, khoah chi̍t kong-chhioh. Chè-tôaⁿ ê sì ki kak, tôaⁿ ê chō, sì ê bīn lóng sī ēng chhâ chòe--ê. Hit-ê lâng kā góa kóng, “Che sī hē tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ê toh-á.”
Sèng-tiān kap Chì-sèng-só͘ ê mn̂g lóng sī nn̄g sìⁿ--ê.
Ta̍k-sìⁿ mn̂g kok ū nn̄g phìⁿ, sī ōe-áu--tit-ê.
Sèng-tiān ê mn̂g-sìⁿ ū khek ki-lō͘-pek kap chang-chhiū, kap piah-thiāu ê tiau-khek kâng-khoán. Cháu-lông ǹg gōa hit-bīn ū chhâ chòe ê pîⁿ-á.
Mn̂g ê cháu-lông nn̄g pêng lóng ū thang-á kap chang-chhiū ê tiau-khek. Sèng-tiān ê siuⁿ-pâng kap pîⁿ-á mā-sī án-ni.

Hit-ê lâng chhōa góa ǹg pak kiâⁿ, lâi kàu gōa-tiâⁿ. I koh chhōa góa ji̍p-khì chi̍t pâi chhù; chiah-ê chhù chi̍t bīn ǹg sèng-tiān ê khàng-tōe, chi̍t bīn ǹg pak-pêng ê pâng-keng.
Chit-pâi chhù tn̂g gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh, khoah jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh, ǹg pak chit-pêng ū mn̂g.
Chit-pâi chhù chi̍t bīn ǹg cha̍p kong-chhioh khoah ê lāi-tiâⁿ, chi̍t bīn ǹg ū pho͘ chio̍h-pán ê gōa-tiâⁿ. Chit-pâi chhù ū saⁿ chàn, ta̍k-chàn ê cháu-lông saⁿ-liân.
Chit-pâi chhù ê mn̂g lóng ǹg pak, thâu-chêng ū thong-lō͘, khoah gō͘ kong-chhioh, tn̂g gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh.
In-ūi cháu-lông chiàm chi̍t-kóa khong-kan, só͘-í saⁿ-lâu ê pâng-keng pí jī-lâu kap it-lâu ê pâng-keng khah oe̍h.
Chit-pâi chhù ū saⁿ chàn, in-ūi bô chhin-chhiūⁿ gōa-tiâⁿ ê chhù ēng thiāu-á thuh--teh, só͘-í, saⁿ-lâu ê pâng-keng pí jī-lâu kap it-lâu ê pâng-keng khah oe̍h.
Tī gōa-tiâⁿ, chit-pâi chhù ê thâu-chêng, ū chi̍t tó͘ chhiûⁿ kap chhù pêng-hêng, tn̂g jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh.
Ǹg gōa-tiâⁿ ê pâng-keng, tn̂g jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh, ǹg sèng-tiān ê pâng-keng tn̂g gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh.
Chit-pâi chhù ē-bīn ê tang-pêng, ū chi̍t ê mn̂g thong kàu gōa-tiâⁿ;

hit-ê thong-lō͘ ê khoah-tō͘ kap gōa-tiâⁿ ê chhiûⁿ siâng-khoán. Sèng-tiān ê lâm-pêng mā ū chi̍t pâi chhù; chiah-ê chhù chi̍t bīn ǹg sèng-tiān ê khàng-tōe, chi̍t bīn ǹg lâm-pêng ê chhù.

Chit-pâi chhù ê thâu-chêng ū chi̍t tiâu thong-lō͘, kap pak-pêng hit-pâi chhù kâng-khoán; pâng-keng ê tn̂g, khoah, khoán-sit, kap chhut-ji̍p-kháu lóng kap pak-pêng ê chhù siâng-khoán.
Lâm-pêng hiah-ê pâng-keng ê ē-bīn, kap pak-pêng ê chhù kâng-khoán, tī thong-lō͘ ê khai-sí ū mn̂g thang chhut-ji̍p.

Hit-ê lâng kā góa kóng, “Lâm-pêng kap pak-pêng biān-tùi khàng-tōe ê pâng-keng, lóng hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng; tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng ho̍k-sāi ê chè-si tī hia chia̍h chì-sèng ê mi̍h; chè-si tī chia khǹg chì-sèng ê chè-mi̍h, chiū-sī sò͘-chè, sio̍k-chōe-chè, kap pê-chōe-chè ê chè-mi̍h.

Chè-si ji̍p-khì sèng-só͘ liáu-āu, bōe-ēng-tit ti̍t-chiap chhut-lâi gōa-tiâⁿ, tio̍h chiong sū-hōng Siōng Chú ê sî chhēng ê lé-ho̍k lâu tī hia ê pâng-keng, in-ūi chiah-ê lé-ho̍k sī sèng--ê; in tio̍h chhēng pa̍t-chióng saⁿ, chiah thang chhin-kūn hōe-chiòng.”
Hit-ê lâng niû sèng-tiān lāi-pō͘ ê chhùn-chhioh liáu-āu, chiū chhōa góa tùi tang-mn̂g chhut--khì, khì niû sèng-tiān ê sì-chiu-ûi.
I ēng lô͘-tek ê niû-chhioh niû, tang-pêng tn̂g nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh.
I koh se̍h-khì pak-pêng, lâm-pêng, sai-pêng, ēng lô͘-tek ê niû-chhioh niû, múi chi̍t pêng tn̂g lóng sī nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh.
Án-ni, i niû sèng-tiān ê sì-chiu-ûi, tn̂g, khoah kok nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh; sì-chiu-ûi lóng ū ûi-chhiûⁿ, keh-khui sèng kap sio̍k ê só͘-chāi.
Liáu-āu, hit-ê lâng chhōa góa khì ǹg tang ê mn̂g.
Khòaⁿ leh! Í-sek-lia̍t Siōng-tè ê êng-kng tùi tang-pêng lâi. I ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi giâ-éng hōa-hōa-háu; tōe in-ūi I ê êng-kng hoat-chhut kong-chhái.

Chit-ê īⁿ-siōng kap í-chêng góa só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ Siōng-tè húi-bia̍t Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê īⁿ-siōng, í-ki̍p góa tī Ka-pa-ló͘ hô-piⁿ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê īⁿ-siōng siâng-khoán, góa chiū phak-lo̍h thô͘-kha.
Siōng Chú ê êng-kng tùi tang-mn̂g chìn-ji̍p sèng-tiān.
Siōng-tè ê sîn kā góa giâ--khí-lâi, tòa góa ji̍p-khì lāi-tiâⁿ. Tī hia, góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê êng-kng chhiong-móa sèng-tiān.
Hit-ê lâng khiā tī góa sin-piⁿ; góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ ū chi̍t ê siaⁿ tùi sèng-tiān kā góa kóng,

“Jîn-chú ah, chia sī góa ê pó-chō, sī góa ê kha-tiam; góa beh éng-oán tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap in ê kun-ông bōe-ēng-tit koh in-ūi pài ngó͘-siōng kiâⁿ îm-loān, á-sī in-ūi kun-ông ê si-thé siat-to̍k góa ê sèng-miâ.

In chiong ông-kiong ê hō͘-tēng khí óa góa sèng-tiān ê hō͘-tēng, koh chiong ông-kiong ê mn̂g-thiāu khí óa góa sèng-tiān ê mn̂g-thiāu; in kap góa ê tiong-kan kan-ta keh chi̍t tó͘ chhiûⁿ. In ēng chiah-ê thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū siat-to̍k góa ê sèng-miâ, só͘-í góa hoat tōa siū-khì kā in siau-bia̍t.
