Taⁿ, in bōe-ēng-tit koh pài ngó͘-siōng, koh tio̍h chiong kun-ông ê si-thé sóa lī-khui góa sèng ê só͘-chāi, góa chiū beh éng-oán tòa tī in tiong-kan.

“Jîn-chú ah, lí tio̍h chiong chit-ê sèng-tiān ê siat-kè chí-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, hō͘ in niû sèng-tiān ê tōa-sòe, tùi án-ni ōe-hiáu ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê chōe-ok kám-kak kiàn-siàu.

In nā ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê hêng-ûi kám-kak kiàn-siàu, lí tio̍h chiong chit-ê sèng-tiān ê siat-kè, khoán-sit, chhut-ji̍p-kháu, só͘-ū ê siat-kè kap kui-lē, só͘-ū ê khoán-sit kap tiâu-lē lóng kā in kóng. Lí tio̍h tī in ê bīn-chêng chiong chiah-ê siá chheng-chhó, hō͘ in thang chiàu chit-ê sèng-tiān ê siat-kè kap kui-lē khì chòe.
Sèng-tiān ê tiâu-lē sī án-ni: Sèng-tiān tio̍h khí tī soaⁿ-téng, sèng-tiān ê sì-chiu-ûi sī chì-sèng. Tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, che chiū-sī sèng-tiān ê tiâu-lē.”
Chè-tôaⁿ ê chhùn-chhioh sī: Chè-tôaⁿ ê ki-chō koân gō͘-cha̍p kong-hun, khoah gō͘-cha̍p kong-hun; sì-chiu-ûi ū tûn, khoah jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-hun.
Tē-jī chàn ki-chō koân chi̍t kong-chhioh, khoah gō͘-cha̍p kong-hun. Tē-saⁿ chàn ki-chō koân nn̄g kong-chhioh, khoah gō͘-cha̍p kong-hun.
Lô͘-tâi, chiū-sī siōng téng-bīn chàn, koân nn̄g kong-chhioh, téng-bīn ū khiàu--khí-lâi ê sì ki kak, koân gō͘-cha̍p kong-hun.
Lô͘-tâi tn̂g kap khoah lóng sī la̍k kong-chhioh, sī sù-hong--ê.

Ki-chō ê tn̂g kap khoah lóng sī chhit kong-chhioh, sī sù-hong--ê. Sì-chiu-ûi ū tûn, khoah jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-hun. Ki-chō sì-chiu-ûi khoah gō͘-cha̍p kong-hun. Chiūⁿ chè-tôaⁿ ê kiā-á ǹg tang-pêng.

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, ē-bīn sī iú-koan chè-tôaⁿ ê tiâu-lē: Chè-tôaⁿ chō hó í-āu, tio̍h tī chè-tôaⁿ téng-bīn hiàn sio-hòa-chè, hiù hiàn-chè ê huih.

Lí tio̍h khan chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á, kau hō͘ sū-hōng góa ê chè-si, chiū-sī Lī-bī chi-cho̍k, Sat-tok ê hō͘-tāi, hiàn chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Lí tio̍h the̍h gû-káng ê huih boah chè-tôaⁿ khiàu--khí-lâi ê sì ki kak, kap lô͘-tâi ê sì-kak-thâu, í-ki̍p sì-chiu-ûi thóng--chhut-lâi ê tûn. Lí tio̍h án-ni chòe lâi kiat-chēng chè-tôaⁿ hō͘ i chheng-khì.
Lí tio̍h chiong sio̍k-chōe-chè ê gû-káng-á tòa-khì sèng-tiān gōa-bīn, tī chí-tēng ê só͘-chāi sio-tiāu.
Tē-jī ji̍t, lí tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè kiat-chēng chè-tôaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng gû-káng-á kiat-chēng chè-tôaⁿ kâng-khoán.
Chè-tôaⁿ kiat-chēng liáu-āu, lí tio̍h khan chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê gû-káng-á kap chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê mî-iûⁿ-káng,
lâi kàu Siōng Chú bīn-chêng. Chè-si tio̍h iā iâm tī in ê seng-khu téng, chiong in chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Liân-sòa chhit ji̍t, lí tio̍h ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn chi̍t chiah gû-káng-á, soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng, kap mî-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè. Chiah-ê cheng-siⁿ lóng tio̍h bô hâ-chhû--ê.
Chit chhit ji̍t lāi, chè-si tio̍h ta̍k-ji̍t ūi chè-tôaⁿ kiâⁿ kiat-chēng-lé, hō͘ i chheng-khì; kā i hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng.
Tē-poeh ji̍t, chè-si tio̍h tī chè-tôaⁿ téng ūi jîn-bîn hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè. Án-ni, góa chiū beh chiap-la̍p lín.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Hit-ê lâng chhōa góa tńg-lâi sèng-tiān gōa-tiâⁿ ê tang-mn̂g. Hit-ê mn̂g koaiⁿ--teh.

Siōng Chú kā góa kóng, “Chit-ê mn̂g it-tēng tio̍h koaiⁿ--teh, bōe-ēng-tit phah-khui, put-chún jīm-hô-lâng tùi chia chhut-ji̍p, in-ūi góa Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè í-keng tùi chit-ê mn̂g ji̍p--lâi. Chit-ê mn̂g tio̍h koaiⁿ--teh.
Nā-sī ông, i thang lâi chē tī lāi-bīn, tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng chia̍h hiàn--kè ê piáⁿ. M̄-kú, i tio̍h tùi gōa-tiâⁿ ê cháu-lông chhut-ji̍p.”

Jiân-āu, hit-ê lâng chhōa góa tùi pak-mn̂g lâi kàu sèng-tiān thâu-chêng. Tī hia, góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng Chú ê êng-kng chhiong-móa I ê sèng-tiān; góa chiū phak lo̍h-khì thô͘-kha.

Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, góa só͘ beh hoan-hù lí iú-koan Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê kui-chek kap tiâu-lē, lí tio̍h siông-sè khòaⁿ, chù-ì thiaⁿ, koh kì tī sim-lāi; lí tio̍h chù-ì sím-mi̍h khoán lâng chiah ōe-ēng-tit tī sèng-tiān kap sèng-só͘ chhut-ji̍p.

“Lí tio̍h kā hiah-ê pōe-ge̍k ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng, ‘Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, góa bô beh koh jím-siū lín só͘ chòe it-chhè thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū.

Lín teh hiàn cheng-siⁿ ê huih kap iû chòe góa chia̍h-mi̍h ê sî, kèng-jiân hō͘ hiah-ê seng-khu kap sim-lêng bô siū kat-lé ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng ji̍p-khì sèng-só͘, phah lâ-sâm góa ê sèng-tiān. Lín chòe chiah-ê thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū, ûi-pōe góa ê iok.
Lín ka-kī bô tī góa ê sèng-só͘ chīn lín ê chit-chek, tian-tò kiò gōa-cho̍k-lâng tī sèng-só͘ thòe lín chip-hêng.

“‘Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘: Tòa tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan só͘-ū seng-khu kap sim-lêng bô siū kat-lé ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, lóng put-chún chìn-ji̍p góa ê sèng-só͘.’”
Siōng Chú kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiâⁿ bê-lō͘, khì pài in ê ngó͘-siōng ê sî, Lī-bī -lâng mā khì-sak góa; góa beh chiàu in ê chōe hêng-hoa̍t in.

M̄-kú, góa beh hō͘ in tī góa ê sèng-só͘ sū-hōng, kò͘-siú sèng-tiān ê mn̂g, tī sèng-tiān chip-hêng chit-bū. In thang thòe jîn-bîn thâi sio-hòa-chè kap kî-tha chè-sū ê cheng-siⁿ, lûn-pan ūi jîn-bîn ho̍k-bū.

M̄-kú, in-ūi chiah-ê Lī-bī -lâng bat ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chú-chhî pài ngó͘-siōng ê sū, hō͘ jîn-bîn poa̍h-tó hoān-chōe, só͘-í, góa tùi in li̍p-sè, in it-tēng tio̍h siū hêng-hoa̍t. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

In bōe-tàng chhin-kūn góa, bōe-tàng chòe chè-si sū-hōng góa, bōe-tàng óa-kūn góa it-chhè ê sèng-mi̍h, á-sī chì-sèng ê mi̍h. Che chiū-sī in chòe thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū eng-kai sêng-siū ê kiàn-siàu.
Góa beh chí-phài in kò͘-siú sèng-tiān, chòe sèng-tiān lāi-bīn eng-kai chòe ê sū-bū.”

“ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiâⁿ bê-lō͘ lī-khui góa hn̄g-hn̄g ê sî, Lī-bī chi-cho̍k Sat-tok hō͘-tāi ê chè-si iû-goân chīn in tī góa sèng-só͘ ê chit-chek. Só͘-í, chí-ū in thang chhin-kūn góa, sū-hōng góa; in beh tī góa ê bīn-chêng, hiàn cheng-siⁿ ê iû kap huih hō͘ góa. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Chí-ū in thang chìn-ji̍p góa ê sèng-só͘, tī góa ê chè-tôaⁿ sū-hōng, chòe góa kau-tài ê chit-bū.
In tùi mn̂g ji̍p-khì lāi-tiâⁿ ê sî, tio̍h chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ; in tī lāi-tiâⁿ kap sèng-tiān sū-hōng ê sî, m̄-thang chhēng iûⁿ-mn̂g chòe ê i-ho̍k.
In tio̍h tì iù-môa-pò͘ ê thâu-kun, chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ chòe ê lé-khò͘; io m̄-thang hâ tòa, chiah bián lâu-kōaⁿ.

In chhut-lâi gōa-tiâⁿ hōe-chiòng hia í-chêng, tio̍h seng chiong tī sèng-tiān sū-hōng chhēng ê lé-ho̍k thǹg--khí-lâi, khǹg tī sèng ê pâng-keng, jiân-āu chhēng pa̍t-chióng saⁿ, chiah bián in ê saⁿ hō͘ hōe-chiòng chiâⁿ-chòe sèng.
“Chè-si m̄-thang thì kng-thâu, mā m̄-thang lâu tn̂g thâu-mn̂g; thâu-mn̂g tio̍h siu-chián.
Chè-si beh ji̍p-khì lāi-tiâⁿ ê sî, bōe-ēng-tit lim-chiú.
Chè-si bōe-ēng-tit kap it-poaⁿ ê kóaⁿ-hū á-sī lî-hun ê hū-jîn-lâng kiat-hun, kan-ta thang kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê chāi-sek-lú á-sī chè-si ê kóaⁿ-hū kiat-hun.
“Chè-si tio̍h kàu-tō góa ê chú-bîn sím-mi̍h sī sèng, sím-mi̍h sī sio̍k; hō͘ in chai sím-mi̍h sī chheng-khì--ê á-sī bô chheng-khì--ê.

Nā ū sò͘-siōng su-iàu chè-si chhâi-koat, chè-si tio̍h chun-chiàu góa ê bēng-lēng sím-phòaⁿ. Chè-si tio̍h tī góa só͘-ū ê choeh-kî chun-siú góa ê tiâu-lē kap kui-chek, koh siú góa ê An-hioh-ji̍t chòe sèng-ji̍t.
“Tû-liáu kè-sin ê lâng sī ka-kī ê pē-bú, kiáⁿ-jî, hiaⁿ-tī, á-sī bē chhut-kè ê chí-bē, chè-si m̄-thang óa-kūn si-thé, hō͘ ka-kī bô chheng-khì.
I kiat-chēng liáu-āu, tio̍h koh tán chhit ji̍t,
chiah thang chìn-ji̍p sèng-só͘ ê lāi-tiâⁿ; i tī sèng-só͘ sū-hōng góa í-chêng, tio̍h ūi ka-kī hiàn sio̍k-chōe-chè. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Chè-si ū sán-gia̍p; góa chiū-sī in ê sán-gia̍p. Tī Í-sek-lia̍t, m̄-bián hō͘ in sím-mi̍h sán-gia̍p; góa chiū-sī in ê sán-gia̍p.
Sò͘-chè, sio̍k-chōe-chè, pê-chōe-chè ê chè-mi̍h beh chòe chè-si ê chia̍h-mi̍h; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hiàn hō͘ góa--ê, lóng beh kui-sio̍k in.

Thâu-chúi ê lông-chok-bu̍t kap hiàn hō͘ góa ê chè-mi̍h, lóng kui hō͘ chè-si. Lín tio̍h ēng thâu-chúi ê be̍h-á chòe ê thâu chi̍t tè bô chham kàⁿ ê mī-oân hō͘ chè-si; án-ni góa chiū beh sù hok-khì hō͘ lín.
Pe-chiáu á-sī cháu-siù, bô-lūn sī chū-jiân sí--ê, á-sī hō͘ iá-siù thiah-li̍h--ê, chè-si lóng m̄-thang chia̍h.”

“Lín thiu-chhiam pun thó͘-tōe hō͘ ta̍k chi-cho̍k chòe sán-gia̍p ê sî, tio̍h lâu chi̍t hūn hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. Chit-tè thó͘-tōe tio̍h tn̂g cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ, khoah cha̍p kong-lí; chit-ê tōe-khu lóng sī sèng--ê.

Tio̍h tùi hit tiong-kan ōe chi̍t tè tōe, tn̂g, khoah lóng sī nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh, chòe sèng-só͘ ê iōng-tōe; sì-chiu-ûi tio̍h koh ōe khoah jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh ê khàng-tōe.
Niû chit-tè tōe ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ, tn̂g cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ, khoah gō͘ kong-lí, tio̍h ōe i chòe sèng-só͘ ê iōng-tōe, sī chì-sèng--ê.

Che sī choân-kok tiong-kan sèng ê só͘-chāi, beh kui hō͘ koán-lí sèng-tiān, chhin-kūn koh sū-hōng Siōng Chú ê chè-si; in ê chhù kap sèng-tiān lóng tī chit-ê sèng ê tōe-khu lāi-bīn.
Lēng-gōa chi̍t-pòaⁿ tn̂g cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ, khoah gō͘ kong-lí ê thó͘-tōe, beh kui hō͘ tī sèng-tiān sū-hōng ê Lī-bī -lâng, chòe in tòa ê só͘-chāi.
“Koh tio̍h tī sèng ê thó͘-tōe piⁿ--á ōe chi̍t tè tōe, tn̂g cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ, khoah nn̄g kong-lí-pòaⁿ, chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khiā-khí ê siâⁿ-tìn.”

“Beh ōe hō͘ kun-ông ê thó͘-tōe sī tī sèng ê thó͘-tōe kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siâⁿ-tìn ê iōng-tōe ê siang-pêng, chi̍t pêng tī sèng ê thó͘-tōe keh-piah, chi̍t pêng tī siâⁿ-tìn iōng-tōe ê keh-piah. Sai-pêng ê tōe thàng kàu Tōe-tiong-hái, tang-pêng ê tōe thàng kàu tang-pêng ê pian-kài; thó͘-tōe ê tn̂g-tō͘ kap Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k pun--tio̍h ê thó͘-tōe kâng-khoán.

Chit-tè tōe sī kun-ông tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong-kan pun--tio̍h ê sán-gia̍p. Án-ni, ông bōe koh khi-ap góa ê chú-bîn; i beh chiàu ta̍k chi-cho̍k eng-kai tit--tio̍h ê thó͘-tōe pun hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn.”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-ông ah, góa bô beh koh jím-siū lín lah! Tio̍h thêng-chí kiông-pō kap khi-ap ê sū; tio̍h péng-kong-hêng-gī. Lín m̄-thang koh chhiúⁿ-toa̍t góa chú-bîn ê thó͘-tōe. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Lín tio̍h ēng kong-tō ê thian-phêng, i-hoat, pā-te̍k.
Niû kò͘-thé ê i-hoat kap niû e̍k-thé ê pā-te̍k hūn-liōng tio̍h kâng-khoán, ēng ‘hō-mûi-ní’ chòe tan-ūi, chi̍t ‘hō-mûi-ní’ chiū-sī cha̍p i-hoat, mā-sī cha̍p pā-te̍k.
“Kè-sǹg tāng-liōng ê tan-ūi sī ‘sià-khek-le̍k’; chi̍t ‘sià-khek-le̍k’ chiū-sī jī-cha̍p ‘kùi-la’; chi̍t ‘bí-ná’ chiū-sī la̍k-cha̍p ‘sià-khek-le̍k’.
“Lín tio̍h chiàu án-ni hōng-hiàn lín ê chè-mi̍h: Sió-be̍h: Tio̍h hōng-hiàn siu-sêng ê la̍k-cha̍p-hūn-chi-it Tōa-be̍h: Tio̍h hōng-hiàn siu-sêng ê la̍k-cha̍p-hūn-chi-it
Kaⁿ-ná-iû: Tio̍h hōng-hiàn siu-sêng ê pah-hūn-chi̍t

Iûⁿ: Tio̍h tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chúi-goân chhiong-chiok ê chháu-tiûⁿ chhú iûⁿ, múi nn̄g-pah chiah hōng-hiàn chi̍t chiah “Chiah-ê thang chòe sò͘-chè, sio-hòa-chè, pêng-an-chè ê chè-mi̍h, ūi jîn-bîn sio̍k-chōe. Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Choân-kok ê jîn-bîn lóng tio̍h tòa chit-ê chè-mi̍h khì kàu Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-ông hia.

Tī chhoe-it, An-hioh-ji̍t, kap kî-tha Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê choeh-ji̍t, ông tio̍h hū-chek thê-kiong sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, tiān-chiú-chè ê chè-mi̍h. I tio̍h chún-pī sio̍k-chōe-chè, sò͘-chè, sio-hòa-chè, kap pêng-an-chè ê chè-mi̍h, hō͘ chè-si ūi Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn sio̍k-chōe.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-it, lí tio̍h hiàn chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê sòe-chiah gû-káng chòe chè-mi̍h, kiat-chēng sèng-tiān.
Chè-si tio̍h the̍h sio̍k-chōe-chè cheng-siⁿ ê huih boah tī sèng-tiān ê mn̂g-khiā, chè-tôaⁿ ê sì ki kak, í-ki̍p lāi-tiâⁿ tōa-mn̂g ê mn̂g-kheng.
Chiaⁿ-ge̍h chhoe-chhit, lí mā tio̍h ūi hiah-ê bô-ì-tiong, á-sī in-ūi bû-ti hoān-chōe ê lâng hiàn-chè; án-ni, sèng-tiān chiū tit-tio̍h kiat-chēng.
“Tùi chiaⁿ-ge̍h cha̍p-sì khai-sí, lín tio̍h siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh. Tī chit chhit ji̍t ê choeh-kî tiong, lín lóng tio̍h chia̍h bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ.
Choeh-kî ê tē-it ji̍t, ông tio̍h ūi ka-kī kap choân-kok jîn-bîn chún-pī chi̍t chiah gû-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè.

Tī chit chhit ji̍t ê choeh-kî tiong, i tio̍h ta̍k-ji̍t pī-pān chhit chiah bô hâ-chhû ê gû-káng kap chhit chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio-hòa-chè, hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. I mā tio̍h ta̍k-ji̍t chún-pī chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè.
I koh tio̍h pī-pān sò͘-chè; múi chi̍t chiah gû-káng á-sī mî-iûⁿ-káng phòe cha̍p-chhit kong-seng-pòaⁿ ê iù mī-hún, koh kah saⁿ kong-seng ê iû.

Chhit-ge̍h cha̍p-gō͘ siú Tah-liâu-choeh ê sî, ông tio̍h chiàu Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê tiâu-lē, tī chhit ji̍t ê choeh-kî tiong, ta̍k-ji̍t chún-pī sio̍k-chōe-chè, sio-hòa-chè, sò͘-chè, kap iû chiah-ê chè-mi̍h.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Lāi-tiâⁿ ê tang-mn̂g, An-hioh-ji̍t kap chhoe-it tio̍h phah-khui, ōe-tàng chòe kang hit la̍k ji̍t tio̍h koaiⁿ--teh.

Chè-si beh ūi ông hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè ê sî, ông tio̍h tùi gōa-tiâⁿ keng-kè chit-ê mn̂g ê cháu-lông ji̍p--lâi, khiā tī mn̂g-thiāu piⁿ, tī hō͘-tēng hia kèng-pài; kèng-pài liáu-āu chiū thè--chhut-khì. Chit-ê mn̂g tio̍h it-ti̍t khui--teh, ē-hng í-chêng m̄-thang koaiⁿ.
Múi chi̍t ê An-hioh-ji̍t kap chhoe-it, choân-kok ê jîn-bîn tio̍h tī chit-ê mn̂g ê thâu-chêng kèng-pài Siōng Chú.
An-hioh-ji̍t, ông tio̍h ēng la̍k chiah bô hâ-chhû ê iûⁿ-ko, kap chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû ê mî-iûⁿ-káng, chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.

Siâng-sî tio̍h hiàn ê sò͘-chè, múi chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng phòe cha̍p-chhit kong-seng-pòaⁿ ê iù mī-hún, múi chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-ko phòe jōa-chōe iù mī-hún, ông thang chiàu ka-kī ê lêng-le̍k koat-tēng. Múi cha̍p-chhit kong-seng-pòaⁿ ê iù mī-hún tio̍h kah saⁿ kong-seng ê iû.
Múi ge̍h chhoe-it, i tio̍h hiàn bô hâ-chhû ê sòe-chiah gû-káng chi̍t chiah, iûⁿ-ko la̍k chiah, mî-iûⁿ-káng chi̍t chiah.

Ông mā tio̍h chún-pī sò͘-chè, múi chi̍t chiah gû-káng kap múi chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, lóng tio̍h phòe cha̍p-chhit kong-seng-pòaⁿ ê iù mī-hún chòe-hé hiàn; múi chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-ko phòe jōa-chōe iù mī-hún, ông thang chiàu ka-kī ê lêng-le̍k koat-tēng. Múi cha̍p-chhit kong-seng-pòaⁿ ê iù mī-hún tio̍h kap saⁿ kong-seng ê iû chòe-hé hiàn.
Ông tùi gōa-tiâⁿ chit-ê mn̂g ê cháu-lông ji̍p--lâi, mā tio̍h tùi goân-lō͘ chhut--khì.

“Tī choeh-kî, jîn-bîn beh lâi kèng-pài Siōng Chú ê sî, tùi pak-mn̂g ji̍p--lâi-ê, tio̍h tùi lâm-mn̂g chhut--khì; tùi lâm-mn̂g ji̍p--lâi-ê, tio̍h tùi pak-mn̂g chhut--khì. Put-chún in tùi kâng chi̍t ê mn̂g chhut-ji̍p; in tio̍h tùi ji̍p--lâi ê mn̂g tùi-bīn hit-ê mn̂g chhut--khì.
Ông tio̍h tī jîn-bîn ji̍p--lâi ê sî ji̍p--lâi, tī jîn-bîn chhut--khì ê sî chhut--khì.

Tī choeh-kî kap chí-tēng ê ji̍t-chí, beh hiàn ê sò͘-chè, múi chi̍t chiah gû-káng, á-sī mî-iûⁿ-káng, tio̍h phòe cha̍p-chhit kong-seng-pòaⁿ ê iù mī-hún. Múi chi̍t chiah iûⁿ-ko tio̍h phòe jōa-chōe iù mī-hún, ông thang chiàu ka-kī ê lêng-le̍k koat-tēng. Múi cha̍p-chhit kong-seng-pòaⁿ ê iù mī-hún tio̍h kap saⁿ kong-seng ê iû chòe-hé hiàn.

“Ông chiàu i ê sim-ì hōng-hiàn sio-hòa-chè á-sī pêng-an-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú ê sî, tio̍h ūi i khui tang-mn̂g. I tio̍h chiàu An-hioh-ji̍t ê tiâu-lē hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap pêng-an-chè. I lī-khui liáu-āu, mn̂g tio̍h koaiⁿ--khí-lâi.”
“Ông ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h chún-pī chi̍t chiah bô hâ-chhû chi̍t-hè ê iûⁿ-ko, chòe sio-hòa-chè ta̍k chá-khí hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Ta̍k chá-khí ông mā tio̍h hiàn sò͘-chè, ēng chi̍t kong-seng iû chhiau nn̄g kong-seng iù mī-hún hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú. Chit-ê sò͘-chè ê kui-lē tio̍h éng-oán chun-siú.
Ta̍k chá-khí tio̍h án-ni, ēng iûⁿ-ko, sò͘-chè, kap iû chòe sio-hòa-chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú.”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Ông nā chiong ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe sù hō͘ i jīm-hô chi̍t ê kiáⁿ, hit-tè tōe chiū kui-sio̍k hit-ê kiáⁿ; hit-ê kiáⁿ thang kā thó͘-tōe lâu hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ-sun chòe sán-gia̍p.

Ông nā chiong i ê thó͘-tōe sù hō͘ i ê jîn-sîn, hit-tè tōe chiū kui-sio̍k hit-ê jîn-sîn; m̄-kú kàu ‘Un-hūi ê Nî’, jîn-sîn tio̍h chiong hit-tè tōe hêng hō͘ ông, in-ūi chí-ū ông ê kiáⁿ-sun chiah ōe-tàng sêng-chiap hit-tè tōe.

Ông bōe-ēng-tit chhim-chiàm jîn-bîn ê thó͘-tōe, kā in kóaⁿ lī-khui in ê thó͘-tōe. I tio̍h chiong ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe pun hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ-jî, chiah bián góa ê chú-bîn lī-khui in ê thó͘-tōe, sì-sòaⁿ khì ta̍k só͘-chāi.”

Āu-lâi, hit-ê lâng chhōa góa tùi tōa-mn̂g piⁿ--á ê ji̍p-kháu, ji̍p-khì hiah-ê ǹg pak, ūi-tio̍h chè-si chún-pī ê sèng ê pâng-keng. Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ siōng sai-pêng ê só͘-chāi ū chi̍t tè khàng-tōe.

I kā góa kóng, “Che sī hō͘ chè-si chú pê-chōe-chè kap sio̍k-chōe-chè ê bah, í-ki̍p hang sò͘-chè ê chè-mi̍h ê só͘-chāi, chiah bián chè-si kā sèng ê chè-mi̍h tòa-khì gōa-tiâⁿ, hō͘ jîn-bîn in-ūi chiap-chhiok-tio̍h sèng ê mi̍h tì-kàu siū chek-hoa̍t.”
I koh chhōa góa khì gōa-tiâⁿ, keng-kè gōa-tiâⁿ sì ê kak-thâu; múi chi̍t ê kak-thâu lóng ū chi̍t ê sòe-sòe ê tiâⁿ.
Chiah-ê sòe-sòe ê tiâⁿ lóng ū chhiûⁿ-á ûi--teh, tn̂g jī-cha̍p kong-chhioh, khoah cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh; sì ê kak-thâu sòe-sòe ê tiâⁿ tōa-sòe lóng kâng-khoán.
Múi chi̍t ê sòe ê tiâⁿ sì-piⁿ lóng ū chio̍h-chhiûⁿ, chio̍h-chhiûⁿ ē-bīn ū chàu.
Hit-ê lâng kā góa kóng, “Chia sī chàu-kha, sèng-tiān ê kang-chok jîn-oân tī chia chú jîn-bîn hiàn ê chè-mi̍h.”

Hit-ê lâng chhōa góa tńg-lâi sèng-tiān mn̂g-kháu. Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ū chúi tùi sèng-tiān ê hō͘-tēng ē-bīn chhèng--chhut-lâi, lâu ǹg tang-pêng, chiū-sī sèng-tiān tōa-mn̂g ê hong-hiòng. Chúi tùi sèng-tiān ê chiàⁿ-pêng, keng-kè chè-tôaⁿ ê lâm-pêng lâu--lo̍h-lâi.
Jiân-āu, i koh chhōa góa tùi pak-mn̂g chhut--lâi, chhōa góa tùi gōa-bīn se̍h kàu tang-pêng ê gōa-mn̂g. Ū chúi tùi mn̂g ê lâm-pêng lâu--chhut-lâi.
Hit-ê lâng the̍h niû-chhioh, tùi mn̂g-kháu ǹg tang kiâⁿ, niû gō͘-pah kong-chhioh, kiò góa liâu-chúi kè--khì; chúi im kàu kha-ba̍k.

I koh tùi hia chìn-chêng niû gō͘-pah kong-chhioh, kiò góa liâu-chúi kè--khì; chúi im kàu kha-thâu-u. Koh tùi hia chìn-chêng niû gō͘-pah kong-chhioh, kiò góa liâu-chúi kè--khì; chúi im kàu io.
I koh tùi hia chìn-chêng niû gō͘-pah kong-chhioh; chúi tiòng--khí-lâi chiâⁿ-chòe hô, bô lâng ōe-tàng liâu--kè-khì, chí-ū ōe-tàng ēng siû--ê.
I kā góa kóng, “Jîn-chú ah, lí ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-bô?” Liáu-āu, hit-ê lâng chhōa góa tńg-lâi hô-piⁿ.
Góa tńg--lâi ê sî, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ hô ê nn̄g pêng hōaⁿ ū chin chōe chhiū.
I kā góa kóng, “Chit-tiâu hô lâu ǹg tang, keng-kè Iok-tàn-hô hô-kok, chìn-ji̍p Sí-hái. Hô-chúi lâu-ji̍p Sí-hái, ōe hō͘ kiâm-chúi pìⁿ-chòe chiáⁿ-chúi.

Chit-tiâu hô keng-kè ê só͘-chāi, lóng ōe chhiong-móa ta̍k-chióng seng-bu̍t, hô--ni̍h ōe ū chin chōe hî. Chit-tiâu hô hō͘ Sí-hái ê chúi pìⁿ chiáⁿ-chúi; lâu--kè ê só͘-chāi, ta̍k-hāng mi̍h lóng ōe oa̍h.

Tī hia ōe ū chin chōe lia̍h-hî--ê; tùi Ún Ki-tí kàu Ún Í-kek-liân ê hōaⁿ-piⁿ ōe pìⁿ-chòe pha̍k-bāng ê só͘-chāi. Sí-hái ê hî-lūi ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Tōe-tiong-hái hiah-ni̍h chōe.
M̄-kú Sí-hái hù-kūn ê sip-tōe kap chúi-khut ê chúi bô pìⁿ chiáⁿ, lâu-teh chòe iâm.

Chit-tiâu hô ê siang-pêng hōaⁿ beh ū ta̍k-chióng chhiū-ba̍k seng-tióng, só͘ kiat ê ké-chí thang chòe chia̍h-mi̍h; hio̍h bōe ta, ké-chí chhut-sán bōe tn̄g, ta̍k kò-ge̍h lóng ū sin ê ké-chí, in-ūi tùi sèng-tiān lâu--chhut-lâi ê chúi lūn-te̍k chiah-ê chhiū; ké-chí thang chòe chia̍h-mi̍h, hio̍h-á thang chòe io̍h-châi.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Lín tio̍h chiong thó͘-tōe pun hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t cha̍p-jī chi-cho̍k; Iok-sek chi-cho̍k tio̍h pun nn̄g hūn.
Góa bat tùi lín ê chó͘-sian li̍p-sè, beh chiong chit-tè tōe sù hō͘ in chòe sán-gia̍p. Taⁿ, lín sêng-siū chit-tè tōe, tio̍h kong-pîⁿ hun-phòe thó͘-tōe.
“Pak-pêng ê tōe-kài sī: Tùi Tōe-tiong-hái ǹg tang iân beh khì Hi-te̍k-lûn ê lō͘, keng-kè Hap-má ài-kháu, Se-ta̍t-ta̍t,
Pí-lô-tha, Se-pek-liân (chiah-ê siâⁿ-chhī tī Tāi-má-sū-kek ông-kok kap Hap-má ông-kok ê tiong-kan), kàu Hō-lân ông-kok ê Hap-sat Hap-thê-kan.
Só͘-í, pak-pêng ê tōe-kài sī tùi Tōe-tiong-hái kàu Hap-sat Í-lân -siâⁿ; chit-ê siâⁿ tī Tāi-má-sū-kek ê pak-pêng, Hap-má ê lâm-pêng. Í-siōng sī pak-pêng ê tōe-kài.
“Tang-pêng ê tōe-kài sī: Tùi Tāi-má-sū-kek kap Hō-lân ê kau-kài, iân Í-sek-lia̍t kap Ki-lia̍t tiong-kan ê Iok-tàn-hô sòa kàu Sí-hái ê Tha-má.
“Lâm-pêng ê tōe-kài sī: Tùi Tha-má ǹg sai-lâm kàu Bí-lī-pa Ka-te-su le̍k-chiu, koh oat ǹg sai-pak, iân Ai-ki̍p pian-kài ê khoe-kok kàu Tōe-tiong-hái.
“Sai-pêng ê tōe-kài sī Tōe-tiong-hái, ǹg pak kàu Hap-má ài-kháu ê tùi-bīn.
“Lín tio̍h chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k pun chit-tè tōe.

Tio̍h thiu-chhiam pun chit-tè tōe, hō͘ lín ka-kī kap tī lín tiong-kan kià-ku siⁿ-kiáⁿ ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng chòe sán-gia̍p. Lín tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-thāi chāi-tōe siⁿ ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng án-ni tùi-thāi in, hō͘ in tī lín tiong-kan kap Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k kâng-khoán tit-tio̍h thó͘-tōe.
Gōa-cho̍k-lâng kià-ku tī tó chi̍t chi-cho̍k, chiū tī hit-ê chi-cho̍k pun-tio̍h thó͘-tōe.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Ē-bīn sī ta̍k chi-cho̍k chiàu miâ-toaⁿ pun--tio̍h ê thó͘-tōe: Tùi siōng pak-pêng, iân Hi-te̍k-lûn beh khì Hap-má ài-kháu ê lō͘, kàu Tāi-má-sū-kek ông-kok pian-kài ê Hap-sat Í-lân -siâⁿ. Pak-pêng kàu Hap-má ông-kok, tùi tang-pêng ê pian-kài kàu sai-pêng ê Tōe-tiong-hái sī Tān ê hūn-gia̍h.

Kî-tha chi-cho̍k ê thó͘-tōe, tùi pak kàu lâm chiàu sūn-sū sī Tān, A-siat, Ná-hut-tha-lī, Má-ná-se, Í-hoat-liân, Lū-piān, kap Iû-tāi, ta̍k chi-cho̍k lóng tit-tio̍h in èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h.

Pak-pêng kap Iû-tāi ê tōe-kài sio-chiap, tùi tang-pêng ê pian-kài kàu sai-pêng ê Tōe-tiong-hái, khoah cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ, tōa-sòe kap ta̍k chi-cho̍k kâng-khoán; tio̍h hōng-hiàn chit-tè tōe chòe sèng-tōe, tī hit tiong-kan khí sèng-tiān.
Lín tio̍h hōng-hiàn tn̂g cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ, khoah cha̍p kong-lí ê tōe hō͘ Siōng Chú.

Chè-si beh tit-tio̍h chit-tè sèng-tōe ê chi̍t pō͘-hūn. In pun--tio̍h ê tōe, tùi tang kàu sai cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ, tùi pak kàu lâm gō͘ kong-lí. Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān beh khí tī chit-tè sèng-tōe ê tiong-kan.

Chit-tè sèng-tōe beh hō͘ Sat-tok hō͘-tāi hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng ê chè-si. In tiong-si̍t chun-siú góa só͘ hoan-hù ê chit-hūn; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiâⁿ bê-lō͘ lī-khui góa ê sî, in bô chhin-chhiūⁿ Lī-bī -lâng mā kiâⁿ bê-lō͘.
Só͘-í, chit-tè tōe beh pó-liû chi̍t pō͘-hūn hō͘ in, chòe chì-sèng ê thó͘-tōe, kap Lī-bī chi-cho̍k ê tōe-kài sio-chiap.
Lī-bī chi-cho̍k beh tī chè-si ê thó͘-tōe lâm-pêng pun-tio̍h chi̍t tè tōe, kap chè-si ê tōe pîⁿ tōa; tùi tang kàu sai cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ, tùi pak kàu lâm gō͘ kong-lí.

Hiàn hō͘ Siōng Chú ê chit-tè tōe sī siōng-hó ê thó͘-tōe, bōe-ēng-tit bōe á-sī kau-ōaⁿ, mā bōe-ēng-tit jiōng-tō͘ hō͘ pa̍t-lâng. Chit-tè thó͘-tōe sī sèng--ê, kui-sio̍k Siōng Chú.

Sèng-tōe iáu ū chhun chi̍t tè tn̂g cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ, khoah nn̄g kong-lí-pòaⁿ ê thó͘-tōe; chit-tè tōe beh chòe it-poaⁿ ê kong-iōng-tōe, thang khí siâⁿ, khí chhù, chòe chháu-tiûⁿ. Siâⁿ tio̍h khí tī chit-tè tōe ê tiong-ng.
Siâⁿ ê tōa-sòe, tang, sai, lâm, pak sì pêng lóng sī nn̄g-chheng nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh.
Siâⁿ ê sì-chiu-ûi tio̍h ū chháu-tiûⁿ, tang, sai, lâm, pak sì-bīn, khoah lóng sī chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p-gō͘ kong-chhioh.

Kong-iōng-tōe nn̄g pêng iáu ū chhun thó͘-tōe, kap sèng-tōe saⁿ-liân, tang-pêng kap sai-pêng kok tn̂g gō͘ kong-lí; chiah-ê tōe thang chèng-choh, chhut-sán--ê tio̍h chòe tī siâⁿ-lāi kang-chok ê lâng ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Só͘-ū tī siâⁿ-lāi kang-chok ê lâng, bô-lūn sio̍k Í-sek-lia̍t tó chi̍t chi-cho̍k, lóng thang tī chit-tè tōe chèng-choh.
Lín tio̍h chiong chit-tè cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ sù-hong ê sèng-tōe, kap siâⁿ ê iōng-tōe, lóng hōng-hiàn chòe sèng-tōe.

Sèng-tōe kap siâⁿ ê iōng-tōe nn̄g pêng chhun ê thó͘-tōe, tio̍h kui-sio̍k ông. Sèng-tōe ê tang-pêng kàu tang-pêng pian-kài ê tōe, lâm pak khoah cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ; sai-pêng kàu sai-pêng ê Tōe-tiong-hái, khoah mā-sī cha̍p-jī kong-lí-pòaⁿ. Chit nn̄g pêng kap kî-tha chi-cho̍k tit--tio̍h ê hūn-gia̍h pêng-hêng ê thó͘-tōe, lóng kui-sio̍k ông. Án-ni, só͘ hiàn ê sèng-tōe kap beh khí sèng-tiān ê tōe, sī tī ông nn̄g tè tōe ê tiong-kan.
Lī-bī -lâng ê tōe kap khí-siâⁿ ê iōng-tōe, mā tī ông nn̄g tè tōe ê tiong-kan; kui-sio̍k ông ê tōe sī tī Iû-tāi ê tōe-kài kap Piān-ngá-bín ê tōe-kài tiong-kan.

Kî-tha chi-cho̍k ê thó͘-tōe, tùi tang-pêng ê pian-kài kàu sai-pêng ê Tōe-tiong-hái, tùi pak kàu lâm chiàu sūn-sū sī Piān-ngá-bín, Se-biān, Í-sat-ka, Se-pò͘-lûn, kap Ka-tek, ta̍k chi-cho̍k lóng tit-tio̍h in èng-tit ê hūn-gia̍h.
Ka-tek chi-cho̍k lâm-pêng ê pian-kài, sī tùi Tha-má ǹg sai-lâm kàu Bí-lī-pa Ka-te-su le̍k-chiu, koh oat tùi sai-pak, iân Ai-ki̍p pian-kài ê khoe-kok kàu Tōe-tiong-hái.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “Chiah-ê sī lín beh thiu-chhiam pun hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k, chòe in sán-gia̍p ê thó͘-tōe.”

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng -siâⁿ lóng-chóng ū cha̍p-jī ê siâⁿ-mn̂g. Sì pêng ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ tn̂g lóng sī nn̄g-chheng nn̄g-pah gō͘-cha̍p kong-chhioh, kok ū saⁿ ê siâⁿ-mn̂g; ta̍k-ê mn̂g chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t chi-cho̍k ê miâ hō-miâ. Pak-pêng saⁿ ê sī Lū-piān-mn̂g, Iû-tāi-mn̂g, Lī-bī-mn̂g; tang-pêng saⁿ ê sī Iok-sek-mn̂g, Piān-ngá-bín-mn̂g, Tān-mn̂g; lâm-pêng saⁿ ê sī Se-biān-mn̂g, Í-sat-ka-mn̂g, Se-pò͘-lûn-mn̂g; sai-pêng saⁿ ê sī Ka-tek-mn̂g, A-siat-mn̂g, Ná-hut-tha-lī-mn̂g.
Siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ sì-chiu-ûi kiōng káu chheng kong-chhioh. Tùi taⁿ í-āu, chit-ê siâⁿ beh kiò-chòe “Siōng Chú tī chia”.
Iû-tāi -ông Iok-ngá-kèng chē-ūi tē-saⁿ nî, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat lâi ûi-kong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Chú chiong Iok-ngá-kèng kap Siōng-tè sèng-tiān lāi-bīn chi̍t-pō͘-hūn ê khì-khū kau tī i ê chhiú. Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chiong hu-ló͘ tòa-khì Pa-pí-lûn ê sîn-biō, kā hiah-ê khì-khū siu ji̍p-khì sîn-biō ê khò͘-pâng.
Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông bēng-lēng thài-kàm chóng-koán A-si-pí-ná, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông-sek kap kùi-cho̍k ê kiáⁿ-sun soán chi̍t-kóa siàu-liân-lâng;
in tio̍h seng-khu kiān-choân, eng-chùn, phok-ha̍k, ū tì-hūi, thong-ta̍t-sū-lí, thang lâi ông-kiong sū-hāu. A-si-pí-ná kā in kà Pa-pí-lûn ê gú-giân kap bûn-ha̍k.
Ông koh hoan-hù, chiong kiong-lāi ê chia̍h-mi̍h kap chiú ta̍k-ji̍t chiàu hūn-liōng hō͘ in chia̍h; án-ni kā in chai-pôe saⁿ nî kú, hō͘ in kî-móa liáu-āu, ōe-tàng sū-hāu ông.
Chiah-ê chheng-liân tiong-kan ū Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k ê Tān-í-lí, Hap-ná-nî-ngá, Bí-sa-lī, kap A-sat-lī-ngá.
Thài-kàm chóng-koán kā in hō sin ê miâ: Kā Tān-í-lí hō-chòe Pek-thê-sa-sat, Hap-ná-nî-ngá hō-chòe Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa-lī hō-chòe Bí-sa, A-sat-lī-ngá hō-chòe A-pek-nî-ko.

Tān-í-lí koat-sim m̄ chia̍h ông-kiong ê chia̍h-mi̍h kap chiú, chiah bián chia̍h chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ kā ka-kī phah lâ-sâm. I chiū chhéng-kiû thài-kàm chóng-koán ún-chún, bô hō͘ i phah lâ-sâm ka-kī.
Siōng-tè hō͘ Tān-í-lí tit-tio̍h thài-kàm chóng-koán ê lîn-bín kap hó khoán-thāi.

Thài-kàm chóng-koán tùi Tān-í-lí kóng, “Góa kiaⁿ góa ê chú góa ê ông. I í-keng chí-tēng lín tio̍h chia̍h chiah-ê chia̍h-mi̍h; bān-it i khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí pí kî-tha ê siàu-liân-lâng khah siau-sán pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ, lí ōe hāi góa hō͘ ông chām-thâu.”
Tān-í-lí tùi thài-kàm chóng-koán phài-lâi kàm-hō͘ i, Hap-ná-nî-ngá, Bí-sa-lī, A-sat-lī-ngá ê lâng kóng,
“Chhiáⁿ hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn cha̍p ji̍t ê sî-kan, goán chit kúi ê kan-ta chia̍h-chhài lim-chúi.

Cha̍p ji̍t āu, chhiáⁿ lí chiong goán ê bīn-iông kap hiah-ê chia̍h ông-kiong chia̍h-mi̍h ê siàu-liân-lâng ê bīn-iông pí-kàu. Jiân-āu, chiàu lí ê koan-chhat koat-tēng beh án-chóaⁿ kā goán chhú-lí.”
Kàm-hō͘ ê lâng chiū ún-chún hō͘ in chhì cha̍p ji̍t.
Cha̍p ji̍t āu, in sì ê lâng pí kî-tha chia̍h ông-kiong chia̍h-mi̍h ê siàu-liân-lâng koh-khah kiān-khong hó-khòaⁿ.
Kàm-hō͘ ê lâng chiū bô koh hō͘ in chia̍h ông-kiong ê chia̍h-mi̍h kap chiú, chí-ū hō͘ in chia̍h chhiⁿ-chhài.
Siōng-tè hō͘ chit sì ê siàu-liân-lâng tī bûn-ha̍k kap ha̍k-būn hong-bīn chin ū châi-lêng kap ha̍k-sek, koh hō͘ Tān-í-lí ōe-hiáu bêng-pe̍k ta̍k-chióng īⁿ-siōng kap bîn-bāng.
Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông kui-tēng só͘-ū ê siàu-liân-lâng tio̍h chìn-kiong ê ji̍t-kî kàu, thài-kàm chóng-koán chiū chhōa in khì kìⁿ ông.
Ông kap in biān-tâm, hoat-kiàn kî-tha ê lâng bô chi̍t ê kap Tān-í-lí, Hap-ná-nî-ngá, Bí-sa-lī, kap A-sat-lī-ngá ōe-pí--tit, chiū hō͘ in sì ê lâng sū-hāu i.
Ông kā in mn̄g iú-koan tì-hūi kap kiàn-sek ê sū, chiū chai in pí choân-kok ê su̍t-sū kap kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t--ê khah gâu cha̍p pē.
Tān-í-lí kàu Sài-ló͘-sū chē-ūi goân-nî iáu oa̍h--teh.
Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chē-ūi tē-jī nî, i bāng-tio̍h chi̍t ê bāng. Chit-ê bāng hō͘ i sim chin hoân, khùn bōe khì.
Ông chiū hā-lēng tiàu-chi̍p su̍t-sū, kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t--ê, kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t--ê, kap seng-siōng-ka lâi, ài in chiong ông ê bāng kā i kóng. In lóng lâi khiā tī ông ê bīn-chêng.
Ông kā in kóng, “Góa bāng-tio̍h chi̍t ê bāng, sim chin hoân, ài-beh chai chit-ê bāng sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù.”
Hiah-ê seng-siōng-ka ēng A-lân-gú tùi ông kóng, “Hông-siōng bān-sòe! Chhiáⁿ chiong hit-ê bāng kā lí chiah-ê po̍k-jîn kóng, hō͘ goán thang kóe-seh hit-ê bāng ê ì-sù.”

Ông kā in kóng, “Góa í-keng koat-tēng, ài lín chiong góa ê bāng kā góa kóng. Lín nā bô chiong góa ê bāng kā góa kóng, koh kóe-seh hō͘ góa thiaⁿ, góa chiū beh chām-tn̄g lín ê kha-chhiú, lín ê chhù mā ōe pìⁿ-chòe pùn-sò-tui.

M̄-kú lín nā kā góa kóng hit-ê bāng kap bāng ê ì-sù, lín chiū ū siúⁿ, ōe tit-tio̍h lé-mi̍h, koh tit-tio̍h ke̍k-tōa ê êng-ū. Hiān-chāi, tio̍h chiong hit-ê bāng kā góa kóng, koh kā góa kóe-seh.”
In koh chi̍t piàn kā ông kóng, “Chhiáⁿ hông-siōng chiong lí ê bāng kā lí ê po̍k-jîn kóng, goán chiū ōe kā ông kóe-seh.”
Ông chiū kóng, “Góa chá chiū chai, lín teh thoa sî-kan, in-ūi lín chai, góa kóng ōe kàu chòe ōe kàu.

Lín nā bô beh kā góa kóng chit-ê bāng, góa ōe kā lín phòaⁿ-hêng, in-ūi lín kiōng-bô͘ beh phiàn góa, thèng-hāu sî-sè kái-piàn. Taⁿ lín tio̍h chiong chit-ê bāng kā góa kóng, góa chiū chai lín chin-chiàⁿ ōe-hiáu kóe-seh chit-ê bāng.”

Hiah-ê seng-siōng-ka koh tùi ông kóng, “Sè-kan bô lâng ōe-tàng chiong ông ài chai ê sū kóng--chhut-lâi. Iáu m̄-bat ū kun-ông, tāi-sîn, thóng-tī-chiá iau-kiû su̍t-sū, kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t--ê, seng-siōng-ka chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì.
Hông-siōng mn̄g ê būn-tôe si̍t-chāi chin khùn-lân; tû-liáu sîn-bêng í-gōa, bô lâng ōe-tàng hôe-tap hông-siōng ê būn-tôe.”
In-ūi án-ni, ông hui-siông siū-khì, hā-lēng beh thâi-sí Pa-pí-lûn só͘-ū ū tì-hūi ê lâng.
Chit-ê bēng-lēng chi̍t-ē hoat-chhut, lâng chiū khì chhē Tān-í-lí kap i ê tâng-phōaⁿ, mā beh kā in thâi-sí.
Ông ê sī-ōe-tiúⁿ A-lio̍k chhut-khì beh thâi Pa-pí-lûn ū tì-hūi ê lâng ê sî, Tān-í-lí ēng oán-choán, tì-hūi ê ōe
tùi ông ê sī-ōe-tiúⁿ A-lio̍k kóng, “Ông sī-án-chóaⁿ hoat-chhut hiah-ni̍h kín-kip ê bēng-lēng?” A-lio̍k chiū chiong tāi-chì ê keng-kè kā Tān-í-lí kóng.
Tān-í-lí chiū ji̍p-khì kìⁿ ông, chhéng-kiû ông iân-tn̂g kî-hān, thang hō͘ i kā ông kóe-seh bāng ê ì-sù.
Tān-í-lí tò-khì i ê chhù, chiong chit-ê tāi-chì kā i ê tâng-phōaⁿ Hap-ná-nî-ngá, Bí-sa-lī, kap A-sat-lī-ngá kóng,
ài in kî-tó, kiû thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè lîn-bín, chiong chit-ê bāng ê ò-pì chí-bêng, hō͘ in m̄-bián kap Pa-pí-lûn ū tì-hūi ê lâng chòe-hé siū thâi.
Hit-àm, Siōng-tè chiū tī īⁿ-siōng tiong chiong hit-ê bāng ê ì-sù kā Tān-í-lí khé-sī. Tān-í-lí chiū siōng-chàn thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè,
kóng: Goān Siōng-tè ê miâ tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn, sè-sè-tāi-tāi bû-kiông-chīn! I choân-tì, choân-lêng.
I kái-piàn sî-kan, piàn-ōaⁿ kùi-choeh; I hòe-tû ông, soán-li̍p ông; I hō͘ tì-hūi ê lâng ū tì-hūi, hō͘ chhong-bêng ê lâng ū tì-sek.
I khé-sī ò-pì ún-ba̍t ê sū, I chai àm-tiong ê it-chhè; kng kap I tông-chāi.

Góa ê lia̍t-chó͘ ê Siōng-tè ah, góa kám-siā lí, chheng-chàn lí! In-ūi lí sù góa tì-hūi kap châi-lêng, goán kiû-mn̄g lí--ê, lí í-keng khé-sī góa, chiong ông ài-beh chai--ê chí-sī goán.

Tān-í-lí chiū khì kìⁿ ông phài-khì beh thâi choân-kok ū tì-hūi ê lâng ê A-lio̍k, tùi i kóng, “Kiû lí m̄-thang thâi-sí choân-kok só͘-ū ū tì-hūi ê lâng! Chhiáⁿ lí kā góa ín-chìn khì kìⁿ ông, góa ōe-tàng kā i kái-bāng.”
A-lio̍k sûi-sî chhōa Tān-í-lí khì kìⁿ ông. A-lio̍k tùi ông kóng, “Góa tī siū-lia̍h ê Iû-thài -lâng tiong-kan chhē-tio̍h chi̍t ê lâng; i ōe-tàng kā ông kái-bāng.”
Ông tùi kiò-chòe Pek-thê-sa-sat ê Tān-í-lí kóng, “Lí chin-chiàⁿ ōe-tàng chiong góa ê bāng kā góa kóng, koh kóe-seh hō͘ góa chai o͘h?”
Tān-í-lí ìn ông kóng, “Ông só͘ ài chai hit-ê ò-pì ê sū, ū tì-hūi--ê, kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t--ê, su̍t-sū, chiam-pok--ê bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng kā ông kóe-seh,

chí-ū thiⁿ-téng hit-ūi Siōng-tè chiah ōe-tàng chiong hit-ê pì-bi̍t khé-sī--chhut-lâi. I í-keng chiong bī-lâi teh-beh hoat-seng ê sū kā hông-siōng chí-sī lah. Lí bāng--tio̍h-ê kap teh su-khó ê īⁿ-siōng sī án-ni:
“Hông-siōng, lí tī bîn-chhn̂g teh siūⁿ iú-koan chiong-lâi ê sū, hit-ūi khé-sī ò-pì ê Chú í-keng chiong bī-lâi beh hoat-seng ê sū thong-kè chit-ê bāng kā lí chí-sī lah.

Put-kò, góa ōe-tàng bêng-pe̍k chit-ê ò-pì ê khé-sī, m̄-sī in-ūi góa pí só͘-ū ê lâng khah ū tì-hūi, sī Siōng-tè beh hō͘ ông chai-iáⁿ chit-ê bāng ê ì-sù, hō͘ lí chai lí sim-lāi teh siūⁿ sím-mi̍h.

“Hông-siōng, lí tī bāng-tiong ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chō hui-siông tōa-sian ê siōng. Chit-chō siōng chin koân, koh hui-siông chhàn-lān hiáⁿ-ba̍k; khiā tī lí ê bīn-chêng, hêng-chōng hui-siông khó-phàⁿ.
I ê thâu-khak sī sûn-kim--ê, heng-khám kap chhiú sī gûn--ê, pak-tó͘ kap io sī tâng--ê,
tōa-thúi sī thih--ê, ē-bīn ê kha sī thih kap thô͘ lām--ê.
Lí teh khòaⁿ ê sî, hut-jiân ū chi̍t tè m̄-sī lâng ê chhiú phah ê chio̍h-thâu, phah-tio̍h hit-chō tōa-siōng thih kap thô͘ lām-teh chō ê kha, kā kha phah-chhùi.

Chit-ê tōa-siōng, thih kap thô͘, tâng, gûn, kim ta̍k pō͘-hūn soah lóng chòe-chi̍t-ē chhùi-kô͘-kô͘, chhùi kah chhin-chhiūⁿ joa̍h-thiⁿ ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ ê chho͘-khng hō͘ hong chhe-sòaⁿ, liân chi̍t-sut-á to chhē bô. Hit-tè phah-tio̍h tōa-siōng ê chio̍h-thâu pìⁿ-chòe chi̍t chō soaⁿ, tōa kah kā choân-tōe khàm--khí-lâi.
“Í-siōng sī ông chòe ê bāng. Taⁿ, góa beh chiong chit-ê bāng ê ì-sù kā ông soat-bêng.
Hông-siōng, lí sī lia̍t-ông tiong siōng úi-tāi ê ông, thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè í-keng chiong kok-ka, koân-pèng, ui-le̍k, chun-êng lóng sù hō͘ lí,
mā chiong tòa tī ta̍k só͘-chāi ê lâng, iá-tōe ê cháu-siù, khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu lóng kau hō͘ lí koán-lí. Lí chiū-sī hit-ê kim ê thâu-khak.
Lí í-āu, ōe ū chi̍t ê pí lí khah jio̍k ê kok-ka heng-khí, jiân-āu ū tē-saⁿ ê chhin-chhiūⁿ tâng ê kok-ka, beh chiáng-koán thian-hā.

Āu-lâi ōe ū tē-sì ê kok-ka, i ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ thih hiah-ni̍h tēng, hiah-ni̍h kiông. Thih ōe chiong ta̍k-hāng mi̍h-kiāⁿ phah-chhùi; hit-ê kok mā ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni kā só͘-ū ê kok-ka phah-tó.

Tú-tú chiàu lí khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, ēng thih kap sio-hûi sai-hū ê thô͘ lām chòe-hé chō ê kha kap kha-chńg-thâu-á, sī chí chi̍t ê ōe hun-lia̍t ê kok-ka, m̄-kú i iáu-sī ū chhin-chhiūⁿ thih ê khùi-la̍t.
Hiah-ê ēng thih kap thô͘ lām chòe-hé chō ê kha-chńg-thâu-á, piáu-sī chit-ê kok-ka chi̍t-pō͘-hūn kiông chi̍t-pō͘-hūn jio̍k.

Tú-tú chiàu lí khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, i sī thih kap thô͘ lām chòe-hé--ê, sī chí chit-ê kok-ka ê lâng ōe kap pa̍t-ê chióng-cho̍k thong-hun siⁿ-kiáⁿ, m̄-kú in bōe thoân-kiat, chhin-chhiūⁿ thih kap thô͘ bōe-tàng kiat-ha̍p chòe chi̍t-ê.

Hiah-ê ông chāi-ūi ê sî, thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè ōe kiàn-li̍p chi̍t ê éng-oán bōe bia̍t-bông ê kok. Chit-ê kok ê chú-koân bōe hō͘ lia̍t-kok chhiúⁿ--khì, tian-tò ōe phah-tó húi-bia̍t só͘-ū ê kok-ka; i beh éng-oán khiā-chāi.

Chiàu lí khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, hit-lia̍p tùi soaⁿ-téng kō--lo̍h-lâi, m̄-sī lâng ê chhiú phah ê chio̍h-thâu, chiong thih, tâng, thô͘, gûn, kim lóng phah-chhùi. Chì-tōa ê Siōng-tè hō͘ hông-siōng chòe chit-ê bāng, chiū-sī beh hō͘ lí chai chiong-lâi beh hoat-seng ê tāi-chì. Lí ê bāng sī chin--ê, bāng ê kóe-seh sī khak-si̍t--ê.”
Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông chiū phak tī thô͘-kha pài Tān-í-lí, koh bēng-lēng lâng sàng lé-mi̍h kap phang-liāu hō͘ i.

Ông tùi Tān-í-lí kóng, “Lín ê Siōng-tè chin-chiàⁿ sī bān-sîn ê Sîn, bān-chú ê Chú, sī ò-pì ê khé-sī-chiá! I hō͘ lí ōe-hiáu chiong chit-ê ò-pì kóe-seh hō͘ góa chai.”
Ông chiū ko-seng Tān-í-lí, sù i chin chōe siōng-téng ê lé-mi̍h, phài i koán-lí Pa-pí-lûn choân-séng, koh siat-li̍p i koán-lí choân-kok ū tì-hūi ê lâng.
Ông koh chiap-siū Tān-í-lí ê chhéng-kiû, phài Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko koán-lí Pa-pí-lûn -séng ê sū-bū; m̄-kú Tān-í-lí lâu tī ông-kiong sū-hōng ông.
Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông chō chi̍t chō kim-siōng, koân jī-cha̍p-chhit kong-chhioh, khoah saⁿ kong-chhioh, chhāi tī Pa-pí-lûn -séng ê Tō͘-la Pêng-goân.
I tiàu-chi̍p choân-thé chóng-tok, séng-tiúⁿ, koān-tiúⁿ, chham-bô͘, châi-bū-koaⁿ, hoat-koaⁿ, kap tōe-hng koaⁿ-oân, lâi chham-ka i só͘ chō kim-siōng ê khai-kong tián-lé.
Chiah-ê koaⁿ-oân lóng lâi chham-ka, khiā tī Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông só͘ chō kim-siōng ê thâu-chêng.
Thoân-lēng-koaⁿ tōa-siaⁿ soan-pò͘, “Ta̍k-cho̍k, ta̍k-kok, kóng ta̍k-chióng gú-giân ê jîn-bîn! Tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ chit-ê bēng-lēng:
Lín nā thiaⁿ-tio̍h hō-kak, phín-á, khîm, sek, khiā-khîm, kó͘, kap ta̍k-chióng ga̍k-khì ê siaⁿ, chiū tio̍h sûi-sî phak-pài Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông só͘ chō ê kim-siōng.
Nā ū lâng bô beh phak-pài, chiū beh chek-sî kā i lia̍h-khì hiat-lo̍h iām-hé teh sio ê iô.”
Só͘-ū ê jîn-bîn, bô-lūn sio̍k tó chi̍t cho̍k, tó chi̍t kok, kóng tó chi̍t khoán gú-giân, chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ga̍k-khì ê siaⁿ, chiū lóng phak-pài ông chō ê kim-siōng.
Hit-sî, ū kúi ê Pa-pí-lûn -lâng lī-iōng ki-hōe ok-ì khòng-kò Iû-thài -lâng,
tùi Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông kóng, “Goān ông bān-sòe!
Hông-siōng, lí ū hā-lēng, só͘-ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h hō-kak, phín-á, khîm, sek, khiā-khîm, kó͘, kap ta̍k-chióng ga̍k-khì ê siaⁿ ê lâng, lóng tio̍h phak-pài kim-siōng;
nā ū lâng bô beh phak-pài, chiū kā i hiat-lo̍h iām-hé teh sio ê iô.

Hiān-chāi, hông-siōng, lí phài-lâi koán-lí Pa-pí-lûn -séng sū-bū chit saⁿ ê Iû-thài -lâng Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko, in bô ho̍k-chiông lí ê bēng-lēng, bô beh ho̍k-sāi lí ê sîn-bêng, bô phak-pài lí chō ê kim-siōng.”
Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông thiaⁿ-liáu hui-siông siū-khì, chiū hā-lēng, chiong Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko tòa-lâi kàu i ê bīn-chêng.
Ông mn̄g in, “ Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko, lín kiám chin-chiàⁿ bô ho̍k-sāi góa ê sîn-bêng, bô phak-pài góa chhāi ê kim-siōng?

Taⁿ, lín tio̍h siūⁿ hō͘ hó-sè, lín chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h hō-kak, phín-á, khîm, sek, khiā-khîm, kó͘, kap ta̍k-chióng ga̍k-khì ê siaⁿ, nā phak-pài góa chō ê siōng, chiū bô tāi-chì; nā bô, chiū beh chek-sî kā lín hiat-lo̍h teh sio ê hé-iô. Kàu-sî, ū siáⁿ sîn-bêng ōe-tàng tùi góa ê chhiú-thâu kā lín kái-kiù chhut--khì?”
Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko ìn ông kóng, “ Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat, chit-ê tāi-chì goán m̄-bián kā lí hôe-tap.

Goán nā hō͘ lí hiat-lo̍h hé-iô, goán ho̍k-sāi kèng-pài ê Siōng-tè ōe kā goán tùi iām-hé teh to̍h ê hé-iô kiù--chhut-lâi; hông-siōng, I mā ōe kiù goán thoat-lī lí ê chhiú.
Chiū-sǹg-kóng m̄-sī án-ni, hông-siōng, lí tio̍h chai, goán mā it-tēng bô beh ho̍k-sāi lí ê sîn-bêng, bô beh phak-pài lí chhāi ê kim-siōng.”

Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ--tio̍h, tùi Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko hui-siông siū-khì, tùi in pìⁿ-bīn, chiū bēng-lēng lâng kā hé-iô hiâⁿ khah jia̍t, pí pêng-siông ke chhit pē sio;
koh bēng-lēng kúi-nā ê ióng-béng ê chiàn-sū kā Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko pa̍k--khí-lâi, hiat lo̍h-khì iām-jia̍t ê hé-iô.
Chit saⁿ ê lâng hō͘ lâng pa̍k khí-lâi hiat-lo̍h hé-iô ê sî, iáu chhēng gōa-phàu, tn̂g-khò͘, thâu-kun, kap kî-tha ê saⁿ.
In-ūi ông ê bēng-lēng chin kín-kip, hé-iô koh chin iām-jia̍t, hiah-ê chiong in hiat-lo̍h hé-iô ê lâng soah hō͘ hé sio--sí.
Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko lóng hō͘ lâng pa̍k--teh, hiat lo̍h-khì hé-iô lāi-bīn.

Hit-sî, Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat kiaⁿ-chi̍t-tiô, kóaⁿ-kín khiā--khí-lâi, tùi i ê chham-bô͘ kóng, “Hō͘ lán pa̍k--khí-lâi, hiat lo̍h-khì hé-iô--ê, kiám m̄-sī saⁿ ê lâng?” In kóng, “Hông-siōng, sī.”

Ông kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ! Góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h sì ê lâng, bô pa̍k--teh, tī hé-iô lāi-bīn kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì, koh lóng bô tio̍h-siong. Hit-ê tē-sì ê khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ sîn-bêng ê kiáⁿ.”

Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat kiâⁿ-kūn iām-jia̍t ê hé-iô kháu, kóng, “Chì-koân Siōng-tè ê po̍k-jîn Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko, chhiáⁿ chhut--lâi! Lâi góa chia.” Hit saⁿ ê lâng chiū tùi hé-iô chhut--lâi.

Hiah-ê chóng-tok, séng-tiúⁿ, koān-tiúⁿ, kap ông ê chham-bô͘ lóng chū-chi̍p óa-lâi khòaⁿ chit saⁿ ê lâng, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in seng-khu bô hō͘ hé sio--tio̍h, liân thâu-mn̂g mā bô sio--tio̍h, saⁿ kap khò͘ bô piàn-sek, koh bô tio̍h-hé-sio ê bī.

Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chiū kóng, “Tio̍h chheng-chàn Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko ê Siōng-tè! I phài I ê sù-chiá chín-kiù pó-hō͘ só͘-ū óa-khò I ê po̍k-jîn. In káⁿ bô ho̍k-chiông góa ê bēng-lēng, kam-goān hi-seng sìⁿ-miā, ka-kī ê Siōng-tè í-gōa, bô beh sū-hōng kèng-pài kî-tha jīm-hô sîn-bêng.

“Só͘-í góa hā-lēng, bô-lūn tó chi̍t ê bîn-cho̍k, tó chi̍t ê pang-kok, kóng tó chi̍t khoán gú-giân ê jîn-bîn, nā ū lâng siat-to̍k Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko ê Siōng-tè, it-tēng tio̍h kā in chām-tn̄g kha-chhiú; in ê chhù beh pìⁿ-chòe pùn-sò-tui, in-ūi bô pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng ōe-tàng chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè án-ni kái-kiù lâng.”
Āu-lâi, ông chiū ko-seng Sa-tek-la, Bí-sa, A-pek-nî-ko tī Pa-pí-lûn -séng ê tōe-ūi.

Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông tùi choân-kok jîn-bîn, bô-lūn in sio̍k tó chi̍t ê bîn-cho̍k, tó chi̍t ê pang-kok, kóng tó chi̍t khoán gú-giân, kā in chiok-hok: Goān lín pêng-an hù-chiok!
Góa lo̍k-ì chiong Chì-koân Siōng-tè tùi góa só͘ chòe ê sîn-jiah kî-sū kā lín kóng.
I ê sîn-jiah hui-siông úi-tāi! I ê kî-sū chin ū khùi-la̍t! I ê kok-tō͘ éng-oán chûn-chāi! I ê thóng-tī sòa kàu bān-tāi!
Góa Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat pêng-an tòa tī góa ê chhù, tī ông-kiong hióng-siū êng-hôa-hù-kùi.
Góa chòe chi̍t ê bāng hō͘ góa chin kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. Góa tī bîn-chhn̂g téng ê hoàn-sióng kap thâu-khak lāi ê īⁿ-siōng hō͘ góa kám-kak chin khióng-pò͘.
Góa ū tiàu-chi̍p Pa-pí-lûn só͘-ū ū tì-hūi ê lâng lóng lâi góa chia, ài in kā góa kái-bāng.
Chiah-ê su̍t-sū, kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t--ê, seng-siōng-ka, chiam-pok--ê chìn-kiong, góa tng-bīn chiong hit-ê bāng kā in kóng, m̄-kú in lóng bōe-hiáu kā góa kóe-seh hit-ê bāng ê ì-sù.
Chòe-āu, góa chiàu góa ê sîn-bêng ê miâ kā i hō-chòe Pek-thê-sa-sat ê Tān-í-lí lâi góa chia; i ū chì-sèng sîn-bêng ê sîn tī i ê lāi-bīn. Góa chiong bāng kā i kóng,

“Koán-lí ū tì-hūi ê lâng ê Pek-thê-sa-sat, góa chai lí lāi-bīn ū chì-sèng sîn-bêng ê sîn, bô chi̍t hāng ò-pì ōe-tàng kā lí ûi-lân. Taⁿ chhiáⁿ lí chiong góa tī bîn-bāng tiong khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê īⁿ-siōng kā góa kóe-seh.
“Góa teh khùn ê sî khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê īⁿ-siōng sī án-ni: Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h tāi-tōe ê tiong-ng chhut-hiān chi̍t châng hui-siông tōa-châng ê chhiū.
Hit-châng chhiū ná tōa-châng ná chho͘-ióng, koân kah tú-thiⁿ, thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak lóng khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h.

I ki-hio̍h bō͘-sēng, ké-chí chin chōe, chōe kah ū-kàu thang chòe só͘-ū tōng-bu̍t ê chia̍h-mi̍h; chhân-iá ê cháu-siù lâi i ê chhiū-ńg hioh-khùn, pe-chiáu lâi hioh tī i ê chhiū-oe, só͘-ū ê seng-bu̍t lóng tùi chit-châng chhiū tit-tio̍h chia̍h-mi̍h.
“Góa tó tī bîn-chhn̂g iáu-teh khòaⁿ chit-ê īⁿ-siōng ê sî, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ūi sèng ê siú-bōng-chiá tùi thiⁿ lo̍h--lâi.

I tōa-siaⁿ hoah kóng, ‘Chiong hit-châng chhiū chhò--khí-lâi, kā chhiū-oe chām-tn̄g, kā chhiū-hio̍h iô hō͘ lak-liáu-liáu, kā ké-chí iā hìⁿ-sak, kā cháu-siù kóaⁿ lī-khui chhiū-kha, hō͘ pe-chiáu bōe-tàng koh lâi hioh tī chhiū-ki.

M̄-kú, tio̍h kā chhiū-thâu lâu tī tōe--ni̍h, ēng thih kap tâng ê liān-á kā i khún tiàm iá-gōa chhiⁿ-chháu ê tiong-kan. “‘Tio̍h kā chit-ê lâng pàng tī iá-gōa, hō͘ lō͘-chúi tàng, hō͘ i kap iá-gōa ê cháu-siù kâng-khoán chia̍h chhiⁿ-chháu;
hō͘ i ê sim kái-piàn chòe iá-siù ê sim, án-ni keng-kè chhit nî kú.

Che sī hit kúi ê siú-bōng-chiá soan-pò͘ ê chhâi-koat, sī chiah-ê sèng-chiá soan-pò͘ ê koat-tēng, beh hō͘ sè-kan-lâng lóng chai, Chì-koân-chiá teh chiáng-koán chit sè-kan ê kok-ka; I beh chiong kok sù hō͘ sím-mi̍h-lâng, chiū hō͘ hit-ê lâng; I ōe-tàng soán-li̍p sè-kan siōng pi-bî ê lâng tī-lí kok-ka.’”

Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông koh kóng, “Che sī góa chòe ê bāng. Pek-thê-sa-sat, chhiáⁿ kā góa kóe-seh chit-ê bāng ê ì-sù. Góa ê kok-ka só͘-ū ū tì-hūi ê lâng chí-ū lí ōe-tàng kā góa kái-bāng, in-ūi lí lāi-bīn ū chì-sèng sîn-bêng ê sîn.”

Hit-chūn, kiò-chòe Pek-thê-sa-sat ê Tān-í-lí gāng chi̍t-sî-á kú; i siūⁿ--tio̍h ê tāi-chì hō͘ i chin khióng-hông. Ông kā i kóng, “ Pek-thê-sa-sat, lí m̄-bián in-ūi hit-ê bāng kap i ê ì-sù sim kan-khó͘.” Pek-thê-sa-sat ìn ông kóng, “Hông-siōng, goān chit-ê bāng si̍t-hiān tī oàn-hūn lí ê lâng, èng-giām tī lí ê tùi-te̍k.
Lí khòaⁿ--tio̍h hit-châng tōa-châng chhiū, i jú lâi jú tōa-châng, jú ióng, koân kah tú-thiⁿ, tùi thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak lóng ōe-tàng khòaⁿ--tio̍h,

ki-hio̍h bō͘-sēng, ké-chí chin chōe, chōe kah ū-kàu thang hō͘ só͘-ū ê tōng-bu̍t chòe chia̍h-mi̍h; chhân-iá ê cháu-siù lóng lâi hioh tī i ê ńg, pe-chiáu lóng lâi hioh tī i ê ki.

“Hông-siōng, hit-châng jú lâi jú tōa-châng, jú ióng ê tōa-châng chhiū chiū-sī lí. Lí í-keng tōa koh kiông; lí ê koân-le̍k í-keng chhèng kàu thiⁿ, lí thóng-tī ê hoān-ûi í-keng ta̍t-kàu tōe ê chīn-thâu.

Hông-siōng, lí só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h tùi thiⁿ lo̍h--lâi hit-ê sîn-sèng ê siú-bōng-chiá, i ū kóng, ‘Kā hit-châng chhiū chhò--khí-lâi, kā i húi-húi--tiāu, kan-ta tio̍h kā chhiū-thâu lâu tī tōe--ni̍h, ēng thih kap tâng ê liān-á kā i khún tiàm iá-gōa chhiⁿ-chháu ê tiong-kan; tio̍h kā chit-ê lâng pàng tī iá-gōa, hō͘ lō͘-chúi tàng, hō͘ i kap iá-gōa ê cháu-siù kâng-khoán chia̍h chhiⁿ-chháu; án-ni keng-kè chhit nî kú.’
“Hông-siōng, chit-ê bāng ōe hoat-seng tī góa ê chú góa ê ông sin-chiūⁿ, sī chhut-tī Chì-koân-chiá ê koat-tēng.

Lí ōe siū kóaⁿ lī-khui jîn-kûn, khì kap iá-gōa ê cháu-siù chòe-hé tòa, chhin-chhiūⁿ gû chia̍h-chháu, hō͘ lō͘-chúi tàng, án-ni keng-kè chhit nî kú; ti̍t-kàu lí sêng-jīn Chì-koân-chiá teh chiáng-koán sè-kan ê kok-ka, I beh chiong kok sù hō͘ sím-mi̍h-lâng, chiū hō͘ hit-ê lâng.
Koan-hē chhiū-thâu tio̍h lâu--teh ê bēng-lēng, sī beh tán lí sêng-jīn, Thiⁿ teh chiáng-koán choân sè-kài; kàu hit-sî, lí ê kok chiū ōe koh kau hō͘ lí.

Hông-siōng, kiû lí chiap-siū góa ê khó͘-khǹg: Tio̍h péng-kong-hêng-gī, lī-khui lí ê chōe; chû-pi tùi-thāi sàn-chhiah-lâng, thoat-lī lí ê pháiⁿ só͘-kiâⁿ, án-ni, lí chiū ōe kú-tn̂g hoân-êng.”
Chiah-ê sū lóng tī Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông sin-chiūⁿ si̍t-hiān.
Chi̍t nî āu, ū chi̍t ji̍t, i tī Pa-pí-lûn ông-kiong ê chhù-téng teh sàn-pō͘,
i kóng, “Chit-ê tōa Pa-pí-lûn ê kiaⁿ-siâⁿ kiám m̄-sī góa ēng góa úi-tāi ê châi-lêng kiàn-chō--ê, ōe-tàng chiong-hián góa ê êng-kng?”
Ōe kóng iáu-bē liáu, chiū ū chi̍t ê siaⁿ tùi thiⁿ thoân--chhut-lâi, kóng, “ Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông, góa kā lí kóng, ‘Lí bōe-tàng koh choh-ông lah.

Lí beh hō͘ lâng kóaⁿ lī-khui jîn-kûn, khì kap iá-gōa ê cháu-siù chòe-hé tòa, chhin-chhiūⁿ gû chia̍h-chháu, án-ni keng-kè chhit nî kú; ti̍t-kàu lí sêng-jīn Chì-koân-chiá teh chiáng-koán sè-kan ê kok, I beh chiong kok sù hō͘ sím-mi̍h-lâng, chiū hō͘ hit-ê lâng.’”

Chit-ê sū sûi-sî tī Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat sin-chiūⁿ si̍t-hiān. I siū kóaⁿ lī-khui jîn-kûn, chhin-chhiūⁿ gû chia̍h-chháu, hō͘ lō͘-chúi tàng; i ê thâu-mn̂g tn̂g kah chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu ê mn̂g, chńg-kah hoat kah chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu ê jiáu.

“Chhit nî kàu lah, góa Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat gia̍h-thâu ǹg thiⁿ, góa ê cheng-sîn hôe-ho̍k chèng-siông, chiū chheng-chàn Chì-koân-chiá, o-ló chit-ūi chun-êng, éng-oán chûn-chāi ê Siōng-tè: I ê thóng-tī éng-oán chûn-chāi! I ê kok sòa kàu bān-tāi!

Tùi I lâi khòaⁿ, sè-kan-lâng lóng sī khang-hu; tī thiⁿ-téng bān-kun kap tōe-chiūⁿ chū-bîn tiong-kan, I chiàu I ê chí-ì chòe tāi-chì, bô lâng ōe-tàng chó͘-tòng I, á-sī chit-būn I: Lí teh chhòng siáⁿ?

“Hit-sî, góa ê cheng-sîn hôe-ho̍k, góa ê chun-giâm kap êng-kng mā hôe-ho̍k, góa ê kok koh-chài chhiong-sēng. Chham-bô͘ kap jîn-sîn koh lâi ióng-hō͘ góa. Góa tiông-kiàn góa ê kok, tit-tio̍h pí í-chêng koh-khah tōa ê koân-pèng.

“Taⁿ, góa Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat beh chheng-chàn, chun-chông, chiong êng-kng kui hō͘ thiⁿ-téng ê Ông, in-ūi I ê só͘-chòe lóng sī sìn-si̍t, I ê tō-lō͘ chèng-ti̍t; hêng-ûi kiau-ngō͘--ê, I kā in kàng-chòe pi-bî.”
Pek-sa-sat -ông kú-hêng tōa iàn-hōe, iau-chhiáⁿ chi̍t-chheng ê tāi-sîn lâi kap i chòe-hé lim-chiú.

Pek-sa-sat lim-chiú lim kàu sóng-khoài ê sî, i bēng-lēng lâng chiong i ê chó͘-sian Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sèng-tiān chhiúⁿ--lâi ê kim-khì gûn-khì poaⁿ--chhut-lâi, hō͘ ông kap hiah-ê tāi-sîn, í-ki̍p ông ê hō͘-hui tóe chiú lim.
Lâng chiū chiong tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān chhiúⁿ--lâi ê khì-khū, the̍h-lâi hō͘ ông, tāi-sîn, kap hō͘-hui lim-chiú.
In ná lim-chiú, ná o-ló in ēng kim, gûn, tâng, thih, chhâ, chio̍h-thâu chō ê sîn-bêng.
Hit-sî, hut-jiân chhut-hiān chi̍t ki lâng ê chńg-thâu-á, tī ông-kiong teng-tâi tùi-bīn ê chio̍h-he-piah siá-jī. Ông khòaⁿ-tio̍h siá-jī ê chhiú,
bīn chiū sit-sek, hui-siông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, io-kut bô-la̍t, kha-thâu-u kho̍k-kho̍k-tiô.

Ông tōa-siaⁿ hoah, bēng-lēng hiah-ê kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t--ê, seng-siōng-ka, chiam-pok--ê lóng lâi kàu i hia. Ông kā chiah-ê Pa-pí-lûn ū tì-hūi ê lâng kóng, “Nā ū lâng bat chiah-ê jī, koh ōe-hiáu kā góa kóe-seh, góa chiū beh sù i chi̍t niá chí-sek ê gōa-phàu, kā i kòa kim phoa̍h-liān, hō͘ i chòe choân-kok tē-saⁿ tōa--ê.”
Ông só͘-ū ê kò͘-būn lóng chìn-chêng, m̄-kú in bōe-hiáu tha̍k hiah-ê jī, mā bōe-hiáu kā ông kóe-seh hiah-ê jī ê ì-sù.
Pek-sa-sat -ông chiū chin kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, bīn sit-sek; i ê tāi-sîn mā m̄-chai beh án-chóaⁿ.
Thài-hō͘ thiaⁿ-kìⁿ ông kap i ê tāi-sîn ê ōe, chiū ji̍p-khì iàn-hōe-thiaⁿ, tùi ông kóng, “Tāi-ông bān-sòe! Lí m̄-bián kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ sit-sek.

Lí kok-lāi ū chi̍t ê lâng, i ū chì-sèng sîn-bêng ê sîn, lí ê chó͘-sian Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat chāi-siⁿ ê sî, chiū hoat-kiàn chit-ê lâng ū tōng-chhat-le̍k, chin chhong-bêng, chhin-chhiūⁿ sîn-bêng hiah-ni̍h ū tì-hūi. Lí ê chó͘-sian Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông ū siat-li̍p i koán-lí su̍t-sū, kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t--ê, seng-siōng-ka, kap chiam-pok--ê,

sī in-ūi i ū hui-siông hó ê lêng-sèng, ū tì-hūi kap tōng-chhat-le̍k, ōe kái-bāng, ōe kái-tap būn-tôe, kóe-seh ò-pì ê sū. Chit-ê lâng kiò-chòe Tān-í-lí, Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông koh kā i hō-miâ chòe Pek-thê-sa-sat. Lí hiān-chāi chiū thang tiàu Tān-í-lí lâi, i ōe kā lí kóe-seh chiah-ê jī ê ì-sù.”
Tān-í-lí sûi-sî hō͘ lâng chhōa-khì kìⁿ ông. Ông mn̄g i, “Lí sī góa ê sian-ông tùi Iû-tāi -tōe lia̍h--lâi ê Iû-thài -lâng Tān-í-lí sī--bô?
Thiaⁿ-kóng lí ū chì-sèng sîn-bêng ê sîn, ū tōng-chhat-le̍k kap chhong-bêng, koh ū tì-hūi.
Hiān-chāi góa ū tiàu chiah-ê kò͘-būn kap su̍t-sū lâi góa chia, ài in tha̍k chiah-ê jī, koh chiong lāi-bīn ê ì-sù kā góa kóe-seh, m̄-kú in lóng bōe-hiáu.

Góa ū thiaⁿ-kóng lí chin gâu kóe-seh, ōe kái-tap būn-tôe. Taⁿ, lí nā ōe-hiáu tha̍k chiah-ê jī, koh kóe-seh hō͘ góa thiaⁿ, góa chiū beh sù lí chí-sek ê gōa-phàu, kā lí kòa kim phoa̍h-liān, koh hō͘ lí chòe choân-kok tē-saⁿ tōa--ê.”

Tān-í-lí ìn ông kóng, “Chhiáⁿ hông-siōng pó-liû lí ê lé-mi̍h kap siúⁿ-phín, á-sī sàng hō͘ pa̍t-lâng. Taⁿ, góa beh tha̍k chit-ê bûn-jī, koh chiong lāi-bīn ê ì-sù kā ông kóe-seh.
“Hông-siōng, chì-koân ê Siōng-tè ū chiong kok-ka, koân-pèng, kong-êng, chun-giâm sù hō͘ lí ê sian-ông Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat -ông.

In-ūi Siōng-tè ū chiong tōa ê koân-le̍k sù hō͘ i, hō͘ chiah-ê bîn-cho̍k, pang-kok, kap kóng ta̍k-chióng gú-giân ê jîn-bîn lóng tī i ê bīn-chêng kiaⁿ-kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ-hiâⁿ; mā hō͘ i ōe-tàng chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù hō͘ lâng sí hō͘ lâng oa̍h, kā lâng ko-seng, kā lâng kàng-kē.
M̄-kú i lāi-sim chū-ko chū-tāi, sèng-chêng kò͘-chip, gán-tiong-bû-jîn, só͘-í Siōng-tè chiong i tùi ông-ūi kóaⁿ--lo̍h-khì, chiong i ê chun-êng chhiúⁿ-cháu.

I chiū hō͘ lâng kóaⁿ lī-khui jîn-kûn, i ê sim pìⁿ-chòe iá-siù ê sim, kap iá-lû chòe-hé tòa, chhin-chhiūⁿ gû chia̍h-chháu, hō͘ lō͘-chúi tàng, ti̍t-kàu i sêng-jīn Chì-koân Siōng-tè teh chiáng-koán sè-kan ê kok-ka, chiàu I ê chí-ì soán-li̍p lâng tī-lí.
“ Pek-sa-sat, lí sī Nî-pò͘-kah-nî-sat ê hō͘-tāi; sui-jiân chai-iáⁿ só͘-ū chiah-ê tāi-chì, m̄-kú lí iû-goân bô beh khiam-pi,

kèng-jiân chū-ko chū-tāi, kong-kek thiⁿ-téng ê Chú, phài lâng chiong thiⁿ-téng ê Chú sèng-tiān lāi-bīn ê khì-khū tòa-lâi lí chia, hō͘ lí, lí ê tāi-sîn, kap hō͘-hui ēng lâi lim-chiú. Lí koh o-ló hiah-ê ēng kim, gûn, tâng, thih, chhâ, chio̍h-thâu chō, bōe khòaⁿ, bōe thiaⁿ, sím-mi̍h lóng m̄ bat ê sîn-bêng; tian-tò bô chun-chông hit-ūi koat-tēng lí siⁿ-sí, chiáng-ak lí ê miā-ūn ê Siōng-tè.
Só͘-í Siōng-tè hō͘ chi̍t ki chhiú chhut-hiān siá hiah-ê jī.
“Hiah-ê jī sī ‘Bí-nî, Bí-nî, Thê-khek-le̍k, kap Pí-le̍k-su’,
ì-sù sī án-ni: ‘Bí-nî’ chiū-sī Siōng-tè í-keng kè-sǹg lí ê kok-ka ê nî-sò͘, beh hō͘ i kiat-sok.
‘Thê-khek-le̍k’ chiū-sī Siōng-tè ēng thian-phêng kā lí chhìn, lí bô kúi niú tāng.
‘Pí-le̍k-su’ chiū-sī lí ê kok-ka ōe hun-lia̍t, ōe kau hō͘ Bí-tí-a kap Pho-su.”
Pek-sa-sat chiū hā-lēng, kā Tān-í-lí chhēng chí-sek ê gōa-phàu, kòa kim phoa̍h-liān, koh soan-pò͘ i chòe choân-kok tē-saⁿ tōa--ê.
Hit-àm, Pa-pí-lûn -ông Pek-sa-sat hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.
Bí-tí-a -lâng Tāi-liû-sū la̍k-cha̍p-jī hè ê sî, siau-bia̍t Pa-pí-lûn -kok.
Tāi-liû-sū chiàu i ê siūⁿ-hoat, siat-li̍p chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p ê chóng-tok tī-lí choân-kok;
tī in ê téng-bīn koh siat-li̍p saⁿ ê chóng-tiúⁿ, kî-tiong chi̍t ê sī Tān-í-lí, kàm-tok hiah-ê chóng-tok, chiah bián ông kè-thâu chhau-lô.
Tān-í-lí in-ūi ū hui-siông hó ê lêng-sèng, pí kî-tha ê chóng-tiúⁿ kap chóng-tok khah kia̍t-chhut, só͘-í ông beh chí-phài i tī-lí choân-kok.

In-ūi án-ni, kî-tha ê chóng-tiúⁿ kap chóng-tok tī kok-chióng ê sū-bū beh chhē Tān-í-lí ê khang-phāng, thang kā i khòng-kò. M̄-kú in chhē bô i ū sím-mi̍h khang-phāng á-sī kè-sit, in-ūi i tiong-si̍t khó-khò.
Hiah-ê lâng chiū chham-siông, kóng, “Tû-liáu tùi Tān-í-lí chun-hêng i ê Siōng-tè ê lu̍t-hoat í-gōa, lán bōe-tàng chhē-tio̍h kā i khòng-kò ê lí-iû.”
Chiah-ê chóng-tiúⁿ kap chóng-tok sio-iok lâi kìⁿ ông, tùi ông kóng, “Hông-siōng bān-sòe!

Choân-kok ê chóng-tiúⁿ, chóng-tok, séng-tiúⁿ, koān-tiúⁿ, kap kò͘-būn chòe-hé chham-siông, beh chhiáⁿ hông-siōng kàng-chí, soan-pò͘ chi̍t ê kìm-lēng, ‘Saⁿ-cha̍p ji̍t lāi, tû-liáu ǹg ông í-gōa, nā ū lâng ǹg jīm-hô sîn-bêng á-sī tùi lâng kî-tó, tio̍h kā i hiat-lo̍h sai-hia̍t.’

Hông-siōng, chhiáⁿ lí chè-tēng chhiam-sú chit-tiâu kìm-lēng, lâng chiū bōe-tàng kái-piàn chit-ê bēng-lēng, in-ūi chiàu Bí-tí-a kap Pho-su ê hoat-lu̍t, chhiam-sú--kè ê hoat-lēng bōe-ēng-tit kái-piàn.”
Tāi-liû-sū chiū tī chit-ê kìm-lēng chhiam-sú.

Tān-í-lí thiaⁿ-tio̍h ông í-keng tī chit-ê bûn-kiāⁿ chhiam-miâ, chiū tò-khì chhù--ni̍h; i lâu-téng ê pâng-keng ū thang-á khui ǹg Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. I chiàu-siông chi̍t ji̍t saⁿ piàn kūi-teh ǹg Siōng-tè khún-kiû kám-siā.
Hiah-ê lâng tàu-tīn khì Tān-í-lí hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i kūi-teh ǹg Siōng-tè kî-kiû pang-chān,

chiū koh lâi kìⁿ ông, tùi ông thê-khí kìm-lēng ê tāi-chì, kóng, “Hông-siōng, lí kiám m̄-sī ū chhiam-sú chi̍t ê bûn-kiāⁿ, kui-tēng saⁿ-cha̍p ji̍t lāi, tû-khì ǹg hông-siōng í-gōa, nā ū lâng ǹg jīm-hô sîn-bêng kî-tó á-sī tùi lâng khún-kiû, tio̍h kā i hiat-lo̍h sai-hia̍t?” Ông ìn kóng, “Khak-si̍t ū. Chiàu Bí-tí-a kap Pho-su ê hoat-lu̍t, chit-ê hoat-lu̍t bōe-ēng-tit piàn-keng.”

In chiū tùi ông kóng, “Hông-siōng, hit-ê siū-lia̍h ê Iû-thài -lâng Tān-í-lí bô chun-tiōng ông, bô chun-siú lí chhiam-sú ê kìm-lēng. I kèng-jiân chi̍t ji̍t saⁿ piàn kî-tó.”
Ông thiaⁿ-liáu hui-siông hoân-ló, siūⁿ-beh kiù Tān-í-lí, kui-ji̍t teh siūⁿ pān-hoat.

Āu-lâi, hiah-ê lâng koh sio-iok lâi kìⁿ ông, tùi ông kóng, “Hông-siōng, tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, chiàu Bí-tí-a -lâng kap Pho-su -lâng ê hoat-lu̍t, ông pan-pò͘ ê kìm-lēng kap hoat-lu̍t bōe-ēng-tit kái-piàn.”
Ông chiū hā-lēng lia̍h Tān-í-lí, kā i hiat-lo̍h sai-hia̍t. Ông kā Tān-í-lí kóng, “Lí it-ti̍t teh ho̍k-sāi ê Siōng-tè it-tēng ōe kiù lí.”

Ū lâng poaⁿ chi̍t lia̍p tōa-lia̍p chio̍h-thâu kā sai-hia̍t ê kháu that--teh; khàm ông-ìn kap tāi-sîn ê koaⁿ-ìn, kā sai-hia̍t hong--khí-lâi, hō͘ Tān-í-lí ê àn-kiāⁿ bōe-tàng ū sím-mi̍h kái-piàn.
Ông tò-khì ông-kiong, kui-mî kìm-chia̍h, bô beh hō͘ lâng ián-chàu ga̍k-khì; hit-mî, ông khùn bōe khì.
Keh-ji̍t, ông thàu-chá khí--lâi, kóaⁿ-kín khì sai-hia̍t hia.
I óa-kūn sai-hia̍t ê piⁿ--á, siong-sim kiò Tān-í-lí, kóng, “Éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê po̍k-jîn Tān-í-lí, lí chīn-tiong ho̍k-sāi ê Siōng-tè ū kiù lí bô hō͘ sai kā bô?”
Tān-í-lí kóng, “Hông-siōng bān-sòe!

Góa ê Siōng-tè ū phài sù-chiá kā hiah-ê sai ê chhùi hong--khí-lâi, bô kā góa siong-hāi, in-ūi góa tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng sī bû-ko͘--ê. Hông-siōng, góa mā bô chòe sím-mi̍h siong-hāi ông ê tāi-chì.”

Ông hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí, chiū hoan-hù lâng chiong Tān-í-lí tùi sai-hia̍t giú--chhut-lâi. Tān-í-lí tùi sai-hia̍t chhut--lâi, kui seng-khu lóng bô siū-siong, in-ūi i óa-khò i ê Siōng-tè.

Ông bēng-lēng, chiong hiah-ê khòng-kò Tān-í-lí ê lâng kap in ê bó͘-kiáⁿ lóng lia̍h--khí-lâi, kā in hiat-lo̍h sai-hia̍t. In iáu-bē kàu sai-hia̍t ê tóe, sai chiū ǹg in tà--khì, kā-chhùi in ê kut-thâu.
Āu-lâi, Tāi-liû-sū thong-kò choân-kok bô-lūn tó chi̍t ê bîn-cho̍k, tó chi̍t ê pang-kok, kóng tó chi̍t khoán gú-giân ê jîn-bîn, kóng, “Goān lín pêng-an hù-chiok!

Hiān-chāi góa kàng-chí, góa thóng-tī ê choân-kok jîn-bîn, lín lóng tio̍h kèng-ùi Tān-í-lí ê Siōng-tè, I sī éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè, éng-oán chûn-chāi; I ê kok éng-oán bōe siau-bia̍t, I ê ông-koân éng-oán chûn-sio̍k!
I tháu-pàng, I chín-kiù, tī thiⁿ-téng tōe-chiūⁿ kiâⁿ sîn-jiah kî-sū; I kái-kiù Tān-í-lí, chiong i tùi sai ê chhùi kiù--chhut-lâi.”
Tān-í-lí tī Tāi-liû-sū kap Pho-su -lâng Sài-ló͘-sū chāi-ūi ê sî, sū-sū heng-thong.

Pa-pí-lûn -ông Pek-sa-sat tē-it nî, Tān-í-lí teh khùn ê sî bāng-tio̍h chi̍t ê bāng, thâu-khak lāi-bīn chhut-hiān chi̍t ê īⁿ-siōng. I chiū kā bāng ê lōe-iông siá--khí-lâi.
Tān-í-lí siá kóng: Góa tī mî--sî khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê īⁿ-siōng: Thiⁿ ê sì-bīn hut-jiân khí tōa-hong, jiáu-tōng tōa-hái.
Ū sì chiah hêng-chōng lóng bô kâng-khoán ê tōa-chiah iá-siù tùi hái--ni̍h khí--lâi.

Thâu chi̍t chiah chhin-chhiūⁿ sai, ū eng-chiáu ê si̍t. Góa tú-teh khòaⁿ ê sî, i ê si̍t hō͘ lâng pu̍ih--khí-lâi, m̄-kú ū lâng kā i tùi thô͘-kha hû--khí-lâi, hō͘ i chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng nn̄g ki kha khiā--teh, koh hō͘ i ū lâng ê thâu-náu.
Góa koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h tē-jī chiah siù, chhin-chhiūⁿ hîm, pòaⁿ-khû pòaⁿ-khiā, chhùi-khí kā saⁿ ki pín-á-kut, ū lâng tōa-siaⁿ kā i kóng, “Khí--lâi, bah chhut-chāi lí chia̍h.”
Góa koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chiah siù, chhin-chhiūⁿ pà, ka-chiah-phiaⁿ ū sì ki chiáu-á ê si̍t. I ū sì ê thâu, koh ū koân-pèng.

Góa tī mî--sî ê īⁿ-siōng tiong iáu-teh khòaⁿ ê sî, tē-sì chiah siù chhut-hiān; i khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chin khó-phàⁿ, chin khióng-pò͘, koh chin hiong-béng. I ū tōa-ki thih ê chhùi-khí, ōe thun-chia̍h thiah-chhùi; chia̍h bô liáu--ê, chiū ēng kha thún-ta̍h. I kap thâu-chêng hit kúi chiah iá-siù bô kâng-khoán, ū cha̍p ki kak.

Góa teh koan-chhat hiah-ê kak ê sî, hut-jiân tùi hit tiong-kan hoat chi̍t ki sòe-ki kak; chit-ki sòe-ki kak kā hit cha̍p ki tiong-kan ê saⁿ ki, liân kun to pu̍ih--khí-lâi. Chit-ki sòe-ki kak ū chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ê ba̍k-chiu, ū kóng tōa-siaⁿ-ōe ê chhùi.

Góa tú-teh chù-ì khòaⁿ hit-ê īⁿ-siōng ê sî, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ū pâi hó-sè ê pó-chō, tùi bān-kó͘ í-chêng chiū chûn-chāi Hit-ūi chē tī hia; I ê saⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ seh hiah pe̍h, thâu-mn̂g chheng-pe̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-mn̂g. I ê pó-chō sī hé-iām, pó-chō ê lián-á sī iām-jia̍t ê hé.
Ū hé chhin-chhiūⁿ hô-liû tùi pó-chō lâu--chhut-lâi; ho̍k-sāi i--ê ū chheng-chheng, sū-hāu i--ê ū bān-bān. I beh khui-têng sím-phòaⁿ, àn-kiāⁿ ê chheh-kǹg í-keng phah-khui.
In-ūi hit-ki kak teh kóng tōa-siaⁿ-ōe, góa chiū chù-ì koan-chhat, khòaⁿ-tio̍h tē-sì chiah siù hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, seng-khu húi-hoāi, hō͘ lâng hiat-lo̍h hé sio.
Kî-tha hiah-ê siù, in ê koân-sè lóng siau-sit, m̄-kú in iáu siū ún-chún ōe-tàng oa̍h kàu só͘ tēng ê kî-hān.

Góa koh tī àm-sî ê īⁿ-siōng tiong chù-ì khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê chhin-chhiūⁿ jîn-chú--ê tùi thiⁿ-téng chē-hûn lo̍h--lâi, hō͘ lâng chhōa kàu tùi bān-kó͘ í-chêng chiū chûn-chāi Hit-ūi ê bīn-chêng,

niá-siū koân-pèng, êng-iāu, kap ông-koân; ta̍k-cho̍k, ta̍k pang-kok, kap kóng ta̍k-chióng gú-giân ê jîn-bîn lóng ho̍k-sāi i. I ê koân-pèng éng-chûn, bōe siau-sit; i ê ông-koân it-tēng bōe siū húi-hoāi.
Góa Tān-í-lí in-ūi khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê īⁿ-siōng sim chin iu-siong, put-an,
chiū kiâⁿ óa-khì chi̍t ê teh sū-hāu ê lâng, mn̄g i koan-hē chiah-ê īⁿ-siōng ê ì-sù. I chiū kóe-seh hō͘ góa chai.
I kóng, “Hit sì chiah tōa-chiah iá-siù sī teh-beh tùi sè-kài heng-khí ê sì ê ông.
M̄-kú Chì-koân-chiá sèng ê chú-bîn beh tit-tio̍h chit-ê kok, sè-sè-tāi-tāi chiáng-lí ông-koân.”

Góa ài-beh koh khak-si̍t chai tē-sì chiah siù ê ì-sù. I kap hit saⁿ chiah siù bô kâng-khoán; i hui-siông khó-phàⁿ, ēng thih ê chhùi-khí thun-chia̍h, ēng tâng ê jiáu thiah-chhùi, koh ēng kha thún-ta̍h chia̍h chhun--ê.

I ê thâu ū cha̍p ki kak, āu-lâi koh hoat chi̍t ki kak; kî-tiong ê saⁿ ki kak tī chit-ki kak ê bīn-chêng lak--lo̍h-lâi; chit-ki kak ū ba̍k-chiu, chhùi kóng tōa-siaⁿ-ōe; i ê hêng-chōng pí kî-tha ê kak koh-khah khó-phàⁿ.
Góa koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ hit-ki kak kap sèng ê chú-bîn kau-chiàn, kā in phah-pāi.
M̄-kú tùi bān-kó͘ í-chêng chiū chûn-chāi Hit-ūi ōe lâi kàu, thòe Chì-koân-chiá sèng ê chú-bîn sin-oan. Sèng ê chú-bîn tit-tio̍h kok-tō͘ ê sî-kan chiū kàu.

Hit-ê teh sū-hāu ê lâng kā góa kóng, “Tē-sì chiah siù sī chí teh-beh tùi sè-kan heng-khí ê tē-sì ê kok-ka. I kap kî-tha ê kok-ka bô kâng-khoán, beh thun-chia̍h, thiah-chhùi, pèng-thun choân sè-kài.
Hit cha̍p ki kak chiū-sī tùi i ê kok ōe ū cha̍p ê ông; āu-lâi koh heng-khí chi̍t ê kap í-chêng ê ông bô kâng-khoán ê ông, beh thui-hoan kî-tiong saⁿ ê ông.

I kóng-ōe te̍k-tùi Chì-koân-chiá, ap-chè Chì-koân-chiá sèng ê chú-bîn; koh siūⁿ-beh kái-piàn choeh-kî kap lu̍t-hoat; sèng ê chú-bîn ōe kau tī i ê chhiú-thâu, keng-kè chi̍t ê sî-kî, koh nn̄g ê sî-kî, koh pòaⁿ-ê sî-kî.
M̄-kú Chì-koân-chiá chi̍t-ē khai-sí sím-phòaⁿ, chit-ê ông ê chú-koân beh siū pak-toa̍t, ōe éng-oán siū húi-hoāi siau-bia̍t.

Chì-koân-chiá ōe chiong koân-pèng, ông-koân, kap thian-hā lia̍t-kok ê thóng-tī-koân sù hō͘ I sèng ê chú-bîn. In ê kok sī éng-oán ê kok; sè-kài só͘-ū kok-ka ê thóng-tī-chiá lóng ōe ho̍k-sāi sūn-ho̍k in.”
Chit-ê sū kàu chia ûi-chí. Góa Tān-í-lí siūⁿ-liáu chin kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, bīn piàn-sek. Góa chiong chit-ê sū khǹg tī góa ê sim-lāi.
Pek-sa-sat choh-ông tē-saⁿ nî, góa Tān-í-lí khòaⁿ-kìⁿ tē-it ê īⁿ-siōng liáu-āu, koh ū chi̍t ê īⁿ-siōng tùi góa chhut-hiān.
Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ka-kī tī Í-lân -séng ê Su-san siâⁿ-pó, khiā tī O͘-lâi hô-piⁿ.

Góa gia̍h-thâu chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng khiā tī hô-piⁿ. I ū nn̄g ki tn̂g ê kak, kî-tiong chi̍t ki pí lēng-gōa chi̍t ki khah tn̂g; khah tn̂g hit-ki lō͘-bé chiah hoat--chhut-lâi.

Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ hit-chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng ǹg sai, ǹg pak, ǹg lâm teh tak; bô chi̍t chiah tōng-bu̍t tòng i ōe tiâu, bô chi̍t chiah ōe-tàng cháu-siám i ê ui-le̍k. I chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì, iāu-bú-iông-ui.

Góa iáu-teh siūⁿ ê sî, koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng tùi sai-pêng lâi, kiâⁿ-thàu choân-tōe, kha bô ta̍h-tio̍h thô͘. Chit-chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng tī i nn̄g lúi ba̍k-chiu ê tiong-kan ū chi̍t ki chin hiáⁿ-ba̍k ê kak.
I khì góa tú-chiah khòaⁿ--tio̍h, khiā tī hô-piⁿ, ū nn̄g ki kak ê mî-iûⁿ-káng hia, tùi i hoat siū-khì, tōa-la̍t chông--khì.

Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ i óa-kūn hit-chiah mî-iûⁿ-káng, khì-phut-phut kā tak, tak kah mî-iûⁿ-káng nn̄g ki kak lóng tn̄g--khì, bô-la̍t thang hoán-khòng. Soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng kā mî-iûⁿ-káng lòng-tó tī thô͘-kha, koh ti̍t-ti̍t kā i thún-ta̍h, bô lâng ōe-tàng kā i kái-kiù.

Chit-chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng jú lâi jú chhàng-chhiu. Kàu i siōng ióng-chòng ê sî, i hit-ki tōa-ki kak tn̄g--khì. Tùi hit-ki kak goân-lâi ê só͘-chāi, ǹg thian-hā sì ê hong-hiòng hoat sì ki chin hiáⁿ-ba̍k ê kak.
Tùi hit tiong-kan ê chi̍t ki kak koh siⁿ chi̍t ki sòe-ki kak, ǹg lâm, ǹg tang, ǹg pûi koh súi ê tōe jú hoat jú tōa-ki,
tōa kah tú-tio̍h thiⁿ-téng bān-siōng, ōe-tàng chiong thiⁿ-téng bān-siōng kap chhiⁿ-sîn siak-lo̍h tōe-bīn, kā in thún-ta̍h.

I chū-ko chū-tāi, siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī ōe-tàng kap Thian-siōng ê Goân-sòe pí-phēng. I kìm-chí lâng ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn-chè hō͘ Thian-siōng ê Goân-sòe, koh húi-hoāi Goân-sòe ê sèng-só͘.
I kiông-pek sèng ê chú-bîn tī ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn-chè ê sū hoān-chōe; i koh chiong chin-lí hiat tī thô͘-kha. Chiah-ê sū, i lóng chòe-liáu chin sūn-lī.

Āu-lâi, góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê sèng-chiá teh kóng-ōe, koh ū lēng-gōa chi̍t ê sèng-chiá tùi thâu chi̍t ê sèng-chiá kóng, “Ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h hiàn ê chè siū kìm-chí, hō͘ tōe hong-hòe ê chōe, sèng-só͘ kap chú-bîn siū thún-ta̍h, chiah-ê īⁿ-siōng tī-sî ōe si̍t-hiān?”
I kā góa kóng, “Koh nn̄g-chheng saⁿ-pah mî-ji̍t, sèng-só͘ chiū it-tēng ōe tit-tio̍h kiat-chēng.”
Góa Tān-í-lí khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chit-ê īⁿ-siōng, tú siūⁿ-beh chai hit-ê ì-sù ê sî, hut-jiân ū chi̍t ūi chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ê khoán-sit--ê khiā tī góa ê bīn-chêng.
Góa koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ O͘-lâi-hô hia ū lâng ê siaⁿ hoah kóng, “ Ka-pek-lia̍t, tio̍h hō͘ chit-ê lâng bêng-pe̍k chit-ê īⁿ-siōng.”

I chiū lâi góa khiā ê só͘-chāi. I chi̍t-ē kàu, góa chin khióng-hông, bīn phak tī thô͘-kha. I kā góa kóng, “Lâng ah, lí tio̍h liáu-kái, chit-ê īⁿ-siōng ū koan-hē le̍k-sú ê chiong-kio̍k.”
I tùi góa kóng-ōe ê sî, góa hūn--tó, bīn ǹg thô͘-kha. I kā góa bong, kā góa hû--khí-lâi.
I kóng, “Góa kā lí chí-sī Siōng-tè thêng-chí hoat tōa siū-khì ê sî ōe hoat-seng ê tāi-chì; che kap Siōng-tè só͘ chí-tēng le̍k-sú ê chiong-kio̍k ê sî-kan iú-koan.
“Lí khòaⁿ--tio̍h hit-chiah ū nn̄g ki kak ê mî-iûⁿ-káng sī chí Bí-tí-a -ông kap Pho-su hông-tè.
Hit-chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-káng chiū-sī Hi-la̍h -ông; nn̄g lúi ba̍k-chiu tiong-kan ê tōa-ki kak chiū-sī Hi-la̍h tē-it ê ông.
Koan-hē tōa-ki kak tn̄g--khì, koh tùi kak ê ē-bīn hoat sì ki kak chhut--lâi, chiū-sī ū sì ê kok beh tùi hit-ê kok siⁿ--chhut-lâi, m̄-kú sè-le̍k lóng put-pí hit-ê kok.
“Chit sì ê kok kàu boa̍t-kî chōe-ok koàn-boán ê sî, it-tēng ōe ū chi̍t ê ông heng-khí; i bīn-māu hiong-ok, khúi-kè-to-toan.

I ê koân-pèng hui-siông tōa, m̄-kú m̄-sī in-ūi i ka-kī ê châi-tiāu. I ōe chō-sêng hui-siông tōa ê húi-bia̍t, ōe-tàng chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù sūn-lī chìn-hêng; koh ōe húi-bia̍t ū koân-le̍k ê lâng kap sèng ê chú-bîn.

I chin kan-chà, gâu ēng khúi-kè hō͘ i beh chòe ê sū sūn-lī chìn-hêng. I chū-ko chū-tāi, ōe thàn lâng bô hông-pī ê sî hāi-sí chin chōe lâng, koh beh khí-lâi te̍k-tùi bān-ông ê Ông, m̄-kú i ōe hō͘ chhiau-kè lâng lêng-le̍k ê khùi-la̍t kā i siau-bia̍t.
Í-siōng só͘ kóng nn̄g-chheng saⁿ-pah mî-ji̍t ê īⁿ-siōng lóng ōe hoat-seng, m̄-kú lí tio̍h pó-siú chit-ê pì-bi̍t, in-ūi che koan-hē chiong-lâi chin kú ê sū.”

In-ūi án-ni góa Tān-í-lí hui-siông ià-siān, phòa-pīⁿ kúi-nā ji̍t, āu-lâi chiah khí-lâi pān-lí ông kau-tài ê chèng-sū. Góa in-ūi chit-ê īⁿ-siōng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ khùn-jiáu, in-ūi bōe liáu-kái īⁿ-siōng ê ì-sù.
Bí-tí-a -lâng A-hap-sûi-ló͘ ê kiáⁿ Tāi-liû-sū thóng-tī Pa-pí-lûn -kok tē-it nî,
chiū-sī i choh-ông ê goân-nî, góa Tān-í-lí tī keng-tián tha̍k-tio̍h Siōng Chú khé-sī sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí koan-hē Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe hong-hòe chhit-cha̍p nî ê kì-chài.
Góa chiū ǹg Chú Siōng-tè kî-tó, khún-kiû, kìm-chia̍h, chhēng môa-saⁿ, sám hé-hu, tùi I kiû-mn̄g chit-ê sū.

Góa ǹg Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè kî-tó, jīn-chōe kóng, “Chú ah, lí sī chì-tōa thang kiaⁿ-ùi ê Siōng-tè, siú-iok si chû-ài hō͘ só͘-ū thiàⁿ lí, chun-hêng lí kài-bēng ê lâng.
“Goán ū hoān-chōe, kiâⁿ put-gī ê sū, chòe pháiⁿ, pōe-poān lí ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē;
lí ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti bat hōng lí ê miâ tùi goán ê kun-ông, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, chó͘-sian, kap choân-kok jîn-bîn kóng-ōe, m̄-kú goán lóng bô thiaⁿ-thàn.

Chú ah, lí sī kong-gī--ê; goán chiah-ê Iû-tāi -lâng, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chū-bîn, í-ki̍p hō͘ lí kóaⁿ-khì hn̄g-kūn ta̍k-kok ê Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn, tùi kó͘-chá kàu hiān-chāi lóng kâng-khoán chū-chhú-kiàn-siàu, in-ūi goán pōe-ge̍k lí.
Siōng Chú ah, goán kap goán ê kun-ông, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, chó͘-sian ū tek-chōe lí, tì-kàu móa-bīn kiàn-siàu.

M̄-kú sui-jiân goán pōe-poān lí, m̄ thiaⁿ lí ê ōe, bô sūn-thàn lí thong-kè lí ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti tùi goán soan-pò͘ ê lu̍t-hoat, Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè, lí iáu-kú chhiong-móa chû-ài, koh it-ti̍t sià-bián goán.

Goán só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ū ûi-hoán lí ê lu̍t-hoat, phian-lī, m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn lí ê ōe, só͘-í lí ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se ê lu̍t-hoat só͘ kì-chài ê chiù-chó͘, kap Siōng-tè li̍p-sè beh kàng ê chai-hō, chiū piàⁿ tī goán sin-chiūⁿ. Goán si̍t-chāi ū tek-chōe lí!

Lí ū si̍t-hiān lí tùi goán kap thóng-tī goán ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ só͘ kóng kéng-kài ê ōe, hō͘ tōa chai-hō lîm-kàu goán; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siū--tio̍h-ê, sī thiⁿ-ē bô chi̍t ê siâⁿ-chhī bat tú--tio̍h ê chai-lān.

Lí hō͘ Mô͘-se lu̍t-hoat só͘ kì-chài ê chai-hō, lóng lîm-kàu goán sin-chiūⁿ, m̄-kú goán kèng-jiân bô khún-kiû Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè si-un, hō͘ goán oa̍t-tńg-sin lī-khui chōe-ok, bêng-pe̍k lí sìn-si̍t ê ōe.
Tùi án-ni, Siōng Chú koat-ì hō͘ chai-hō lîm-kàu goán, in-ūi Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ê só͘-chòe lóng sī kong-gī; m̄-kú goán bô thiaⁿ-thàn lí ê ōe.

“Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè, lí bat ēng tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú chhōa lí ê chú-bîn thoat-lī Ai-ki̍p; tī hit-sî, lí chiū hián-chhut kap kin-á-ji̍t kâng-khoán ê miâ-siaⁿ. M̄-kú, kàu taⁿ goán iáu-teh hoān-chōe chòe pháiⁿ.

Chú ah, kiû lí chiàu lí ê kong-gī, bô hō͘ lí ke̍k-tōa ê siū-khì koh lîm-kàu chit-ê siâⁿ, chiū-sī lí ê sèng-soaⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, in-ūi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap lí ê chú-bîn ūi-tio̍h goán kap goán ê chó͘-sian ê chōe-kò siū chiu-ûi ê lâng lêng-jio̍k.
Goán ê Siōng-tè, taⁿ kiû lí àⁿ-lo̍h thiaⁿ lí ê po̍k-jîn ê kî-tó khún-kiû. Chú ah, kiû lí in-ūi lí ka-kī ê iân-kò͘, khòaⁿ-kò͘ lí hong-hòe ê sèng-só͘.

Góa ê Siōng-tè ah, kiû lí àⁿ hī-khang thiaⁿ lí po̍k-jîn ê kî-tó, khui lí ê ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ goán hiah-ê pha-hng ê thó͘-tōe í-ki̍p ēng lí ê miâ kiàn-li̍p ê siâⁿ; goán ǹg lí kî-tó, m̄-sī khò ka-kī ê hó hêng-ûi, sī in-ūi lí hong-hù ê chû-pi lîn-bín.

Chú ah, kiû lí thiaⁿ! Chú ah, kiû lí sià-bián! Chú ah, kiû lí chhái-chhú hêng-tōng! Góa ê Siōng-tè, kiû lí ūi-tio̍h lí ka-kī ê iân-kò͘ m̄-thang iân-tî, in-ūi chit-ê siâⁿ, chiah-ê chú-bîn lóng sī lí ê.”
Góa kè-sio̍k kóng-ōe kî-tó, sêng-jīn góa kap góa ê tông-pau Í-sek-lia̍t ê chōe, ūi-tio̍h góa ê Siōng-tè ê sèng-soaⁿ ǹg Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè khún-kiû.
Góa tú-teh kî-tó ê sî, tú-chiah tī īⁿ-siōng tiong khòaⁿ--kìⁿ hit-ūi Ka-pek-lia̍t, tāi-iok tī hiàn ē-hng-chè ê sî chin-kín pe-lâi góa chia.
I kā góa kóe-seh, kóng, “ Tān-í-lí, góa hiān-chāi lâi sī beh hō͘ lí oân-choân bêng-pe̍k.
Lí khai-sí kî-tó ê sî, Siōng-tè chiū bēng-lēng góa lâi kā lí kóng: Lí sī Siōng-tè só͘ thiàⁿ ê lâng, só͘-í tio̍h chù-ì chit-ê sìn-sit, liáu-kái chit-ê īⁿ-siōng.

“Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h lí ê tông-pau kap Sèng-siâⁿ chí-tēng chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan, chiū-sī chhit-cha̍p lé-pài. Hit-sî, lín bô koh pōe-poān, chōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián, chōe-kò tit-tio̍h chhat-siau, éng-oán ê kong-gī khai-sí si̍t-chián, īⁿ-siōng kap ū-giân tit-tio̍h èng-giām, koh-chài kā Chì-sèng-só͘ boah-iû.

Só͘-í lí tio̍h chheng-chhó liáu-kái, tùi hā-lēng tiông-kiàn Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kàu siū boah-iû soán-li̍p ê léng-siù chhut-hiān, chit tiong-kan tio̍h ū chhit lé-pài, koh keng-kè la̍k-cha̍p-jī lé-pài, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng í-ki̍p i ê koe-lō͘ kap hô-kau ōe tī kan-lân ê tiong-kan tiông-kiàn oân-sêng.

La̍k-cha̍p-jī lé-pài kè-liáu, siū boah-iû soán-li̍p ê léng-siù ōe siū chián-tû, bô lâng sòa-chiap i.
