Āu-lâi ū chi̍t ê ông ōe chhōa kun-tūi lâi húi-bia̍t chit-ê siâⁿ kap sèng-só͘, i ê kiat-kio̍k ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi chhiong--lâi, koh ōe ū chiàn-cheng, chòe-āu ta̍k sì-kòe lóng pìⁿ-chòe pha-hng.

I ōe tī chi̍t lé-pài lāi kap chin chōe lâng kiat-bêng; tī chi̍t lé-pài ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ kìm-chí lâng ǹg Siōng-tè hiàn-chè kap hōng-hiàn lé-mi̍h, koh chiong khó-ò͘ⁿ, ōe chō-sêng húi-bia̍t ê mi̍h chhāi tī sèng-tiān, ti̍t-kàu chí-tēng ê kiat-kio̍k si̍t-hiān tī hit-ê húi-bia̍t-chiá sin-chiūⁿ.”

Sài-ló͘-sū chòe Pho-su hông-tè tē-saⁿ nî, hō͘ lâng kiò-chòe Pek-thê-sa-sat ê Tān-í-lí tit-tio̍h khé-sī; hit-ê khé-sī sī chin-si̍t--ê, sī iú-koan chi̍t ê tōa chiàn-cheng. Tān-í-lí chai-iáⁿ chit-ê khé-sī ê ì-sù, mā liáu-kái chit-ê īⁿ-siōng.
Hit-sî góa Tān-í-lí iu-siong saⁿ lé-pài.
Tī chit tiong-kan, góa bô chia̍h hó-chia̍h ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, bô chia̍h-bah, bô lim-chiú, mā bô ēng iû boah seng-khu.
Chiaⁿ-ge̍h jī-sì, góa tī Tí-kek-lí-su tōa-hô hô-piⁿ,
gia̍h-thâu chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê lâng chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ chit ê saⁿ, hâ O͘-hoat sûn-kim chòe ê io-tòa;

i ê seng-khu chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiⁿ-ge̍k, bīn-māu chhin-chhiūⁿ sih-nà, ba̍k-chiu chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-iām, chhiú kap kha kng kah chhin-chhiūⁿ bôa kng ê tâng, kóng-ōe ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-kûn lâng teh hoah ê siaⁿ.
Chit-ê īⁿ-siōng chí-ū góa Tān-í-lí khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, kap góa chòe-hé ê lâng bô chi̍t ê ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, m̄-kú in lóng hui-siông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, cháu-khì bih,
chhun góa chi̍t ê tī hia. Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chit-ê tōa ê īⁿ-siōng, chiū kui seng-khu bô la̍t, bīn sit-sek, liân chi̍t-sut-á khùi-la̍t to bô.
Góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ i kóng-ōe ê siaⁿ; góa chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū phak--lo̍h-khì, bīn ǹg thô͘-kha, sit-khì ì-sek.
Hut-jiân ū chi̍t ki chhiú kā góa bong, hō͘ góa ēng kha-thâu-u kap chhiú-tôe-á thuh tī thô͘-kha, seng-khu iáu-teh chhoah.

I tùi góa kóng, “Tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè thiàⁿ-thàng ê Tān-í-lí, lí tio̍h bêng-pe̍k góa tùi lí kóng ê ōe. Lí khiā--khí-lâi. Góa hiān-chāi hō͘ Siōng-tè chhe-khián lâi lí chia.” I teh kóng ê sî, góa khiā--khí-lâi, seng-khu phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.

I koh kā góa kóng, “ Tān-í-lí, m̄-bián kiaⁿ! Lí tùi thâu chi̍t ji̍t khí chiū koat-sim beh liáu-kái chit-ê īⁿ-siōng, tī lí ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng khiam-pi. I ū thiaⁿ lí ê kî-tó; góa chiū-sī ūi-tio̍h lí ê kî-tó lâi--ê.
M̄-kú Pho-su -kok ê siú-hō͘ thiⁿ-sài kā góa tòng tī Pho-su ê léng-siù hia jī-cha̍p-it ji̍t. Āu-lâi, thiⁿ-sài-tiúⁿ tiong-kan ê chi̍t ūi Bí-ka-le̍k lâi pang-chān góa.
Hiān-chāi góa lâi sī beh hō͘ lí bêng-pe̍k lí ê tông-pau í-āu ōe tú--tio̍h ê sū; che sī koan-hē beh lâi ê sî-kî ê īⁿ-siōng.”
I tùi góa kóng chiah-ê ōe ê sî, góa bīn ǹg thô͘-kha, bô hoat-tō͘ kóng-ōe.

Hut-jiân ū chi̍t ê khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng--ê lâi bong góa ê chhùi-tûn; góa chiū khui-chhùi tùi hit-ê khiā tī góa bīn-chêng--ê kóng, “Góa ê chú ah, góa in-ūi chit-ê īⁿ-siōng sim-lāi iu-siong thòng-khó͘, kui seng-khu bô la̍t.
Góa sī chú ê po̍k-jîn, góa ná ōe-kham-tit kap góa ê chú kóng-ōe? Hiān-chāi góa kui seng-khu bô la̍t, khiā bōe tiâu, kiông-beh bōe chhoán-khùi.”
Hit-ê khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng--ê koh kā góa bong, hō͘ góa ū khùi-la̍t.

I kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ! Lí sī Siōng-tè só͘ thiàⁿ--ê, goān lí pêng-an! Lí tio̍h kian-kiông, koh-chài kian-kiông!” I chi̍t-ē tùi góa kóng-ōe, góa chiū hôe-ho̍k khùi-la̍t. Góa kóng, “Góa ê chú, chhiáⁿ lí kè-sio̍k tùi góa kóng-ōe, lí í-keng hō͘ góa kian-kiông--khí-lâi lah.”

I chiū kóng, “Lí í-keng chai góa sī-án-chóaⁿ lâi lí chia. Hiān-chāi góa beh tò-khì kap Pho-su ê siú-hō͘ thiⁿ-sài kau-chiàn. Lí tio̍h chai, góa khì liáu-āu, Hi-la̍h ê siú-hō͘ thiⁿ-sài chiū ōe lâi.
M̄-kú góa beh chiong chin-lí ê chheh kì-lio̍k ê sū kā lí kóng. Í-sek-lia̍t ê siú-hō͘ thiⁿ-sài Bí-ka-le̍k í-gōa, bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng pang-chān góa tí-khòng in.”
Hit-ê khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng--ê koh kóng, “ Bí-tí-a ê Tāi-liû-sū choh-ông goân-nî, góa ū khí-lâi hia̍p-chō͘ Bí-ka-le̍k, hō͘ i kian-kiông.

Hiān-chāi góa beh chiong khak-si̍t ê sū kā i kóng.” “ Pho-su ōe ū sì ê ông. Tē-sì ê ông pí í-chêng ê ông khah hù-chiok, koh in-ūi i ê hù-chiok pìⁿ-chòe kiông-sēng, chiū siàn-tōng ta̍k-kok kong-kek Hi-la̍h.
“ Hi-la̍h ōe ū chi̍t ê ióng-béng ê ông chiáng-ak tāi-koân, chiàu i ê ì-sù thóng-tī kok-ka.

I ê koân-sè chin kiông-sēng ê sî, i ê thian-hā chiū hun-lia̍t, m̄-kú i ê hō͘-tāi lóng bô lâng kè-sêng; hun-lia̍t--chhut-lâi ê kok-ka bô chhin-chhiūⁿ i ū hiah tōa ê koân-le̍k. I ê tè-kok ōe siau-bia̍t, thóng-tī-koân hō͘ gōa-lâng tit--khì.
“Lâm-hng ê ông ōe kiông--khí-lâi, m̄-kú i ê chiong-kun tiong-kan ōe ū chi̍t ê pí i khah kiông-sēng, chiáng-ak chin tōa ê koân-le̍k.

Kúi-nā nî āu, lâm-hng kap pak-hng nn̄g kok beh kiat-bêng, lâm-hng ê ông ōe chiong cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ pak-hng ê ông, m̄-kú lâm-hng ê kong-chú ê éng-hióng-le̍k î-chhî bô-jōa-kú, ông ê sè-le̍k mā tòng bô-jōa-kú. Lâm-hng ê kong-chú kap sū-hāu i ê lâng, i ê kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p hû-chō͘ i ê lâng, lóng ōe siū sat-hāi.
M̄-kú kong-chú ê āu-thâu ū chi̍t ê khí-lâi choh-ông. I ōe chhōa kun-tūi kong-táⁿ pak-hng ê pó-lúi, tit-tio̍h sèng-lī;
koh chiong pak-hng ê sîn-bêng, chù ê sîn-siōng, í-ki̍p kim-khì, gûn-khì lóng tòa tńg-khì Ai-ki̍p; kúi-nā nî bô koh kong-kek pak-hng ê ông.
Āu-lâi pak-hng ê ông ōe chhim-ji̍p lâm-hng ê léng-thó͘, jiân-āu chiah thiat-thè tò-khì pak-hng i ê pún-kok.

“Pak-hng ê ông ê kiáⁿ ōe tiàu-chi̍p tōa-tūi kun-peng, chún-pī chiàn-cheng; kî-tiong chi̍t ê kiáⁿ ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi hoàn-lām, chhiong-kek lâm-hng. Āu-lâi, i ōe koh khì chìn-kong, kong-phòa lâm-hng ê pó-lúi.
Lâm-hng ê ông hui-siông siū-khì, chhut-lâi pâi-tīn kau-chiàn, chiong pak-hng ê tāi-kun phah-pāi.
Lâm-hng ê ông phah-pāi tùi-te̍k, lia̍h chin chōe lâng, chiū kiau-ngō͘ chū-ko. I sui-jiân thâi-sí kui-bān lâng, m̄-kú i ê sèng-lī î-chhî bô-jōa-kú.
“Pak-hng ê ông ōe chhōa pí í-chêng koh-khah chōe ê kun-peng chhut-khì kau-chiàn; kúi nî āu, i ōe chhōa kiông-tāi, chong-pī iu-liông ê kun-tūi lâi.

Hit-sî, ōe ū chin chōe lâng khí-lâi kong-kek lâm-hng ê kok. Lí tông-pau tiong-kan ê pō-le̍k hūn-chú mā ōe pōe-poān lâm-hng ê ông, hō͘ īⁿ-siōng si̍t-hiān, m̄-kú in ōe sit-pāi.
Pak-hng ê ông ōe koh lâi chō thô͘-tui, kong-táⁿ hông-pī chin kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, lâm-hng ê kun-tūi tí-tng bōe tiâu, liân te̍k-soán ê kun-tūi mā bô hoat-tō͘ hông-siú.
Lâi kong-kek lâm-hng--ê, ōe chhut-chāi i ka-kī ê ì-sù chòe sū, bô lâng ōe-tàng hoán-khòng. I ōe chiàm-léng hit-ê pûi-súi ê tōe, oân-choân khòng-chè hit-ê tōe.

“Ūi-tio̍h beh thui-hoan lâm-hng ê kok, i koat-tēng ēng choân-kok ê le̍k-liōng cheng-ho̍k lâm-hng, chiū seng kap lâm-hng tēng hô-pêng tiâu-iok, chiong ka-kī ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kè hō͘ lâm-hng ê ông, beh ēng án-ni thui-hoan lâm-hng. M̄-kú i ê kè-chhek bōe sêng-kong, ka-kī mā bōe tit-tio̍h lī-ek.

Āu-lâi i chiū kái-piàn chú-ì, kong-chhú chin chōe iân-hái tó-sū. M̄-kú ū chi̍t ê gōa-kok ê chiong-kun beh chó͘-chí pak-hng ê ông ê ah-pà, kā i phah-pāi, hō͘ i siū bú-jio̍k.
Liáu-āu, i ōe thiat-thè tò-khì pún-kok kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, m̄-kú ōe hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, chiū éng-oán siau-sit.

“Í-āu ōe ū chi̍t ê lâng sòa-chiap pak-hng ê ông-ūi. Ūi-tio̍h beh cheng-ka ông-kok ê châi-hù, hit-ê lâng ōe phài koaⁿ-oân tī choân-kok pak-siah. Kè bô-jōa-kú, chit-ê ông sí--khì; m̄-sī in-ūi koat-tàu sí--khì, mā m̄-sī in-ūi chiàn-cheng.”
“Āu-lâi ōe ū chi̍t ê pi-phí ê lâng khí--lâi. I m̄-sī ha̍p-hoat ê kè-sêng-jîn, m̄-kú thàn lâng bô hông-pī ê sî, ēng khúi-khiat ê chhiú-tōaⁿ toa̍t-chhú ông-ūi.
I ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi chiong só͘-ū hoán-tùi i ê sè-le̍k choân-pō͘ chhiong-sòaⁿ, hiah-ê chiàu khè-iok siat-li̍p ê léng-siù mā hō͘ i thâi-sí.
I kap pa̍t-ê kok-ka kiat-bêng, chiū ēng khúi-chà ê chhiú-tōaⁿ, hō͘ i sió-sió ê kok-ka chiām-chiām kiông-sēng.

I thàn lâng bô hông-pī ê sî, chhim-ji̍p tùi-hong séng-lāi siōng pûi-súi ê tōe, chòe i ê chó͘-sian m̄-bat chòe--kè ê sū, chiong chhiúⁿ--lâi ê chiàn-lī-phín kap châi-pó pun hō͘ i ê pō͘-hā, koh ēng kè-bô͘ kong-chhú pó-lúi; put-kò chiah-ê lóng sī chiām-sî--ê.

“Pak-hng ê ông ōe chhōa tāi-kun choân-le̍k kong-kek lâm-hng ê ông, lâm-hng ê ông mā ōe chhōa kiông-tāi ê kun-tūi kap i kau-chiàn. In-ūi ū lâng siat-kè bô͘-hāi lâm-hng ê ông, só͘-í lâm-hng bô hoat-tō͘ tí-khòng.
Bô͘-hāi lâm-hng ê ông ê lâng sī i ê chhin-sìn, só͘-í i ê kun-tūi chiàn-pāi sì-sòaⁿ, hō͘ lâng thâi-sí--ê chin chōe.

Chit nn̄g ê ông lóng lāi-sim khúi-khiat; sui-jiân chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g, m̄-kú hō͘-siōng kóng pe̍h-chha̍t. In nn̄g pêng ê kè-bô͘ bōe sêng-kong, in-ūi só͘ chí-tēng chiong-kio̍k ê sî-kan iáu-bē kàu.

Pak-hng ê ông ōe tòa chin chōe châi-pó tńg-khì pún-kok. I sim-lāi hoán-tùi Siōng-tè chú-bîn ê sìn-gióng. I chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù chòe tāi-chì, liáu-āu chiah tò-khì i ê pún-kok.
“Kàu chí-tēng ê sî-kan, i ōe koh lâi kong-táⁿ lâm-hng. M̄-kú chit-piàn kap téng-piàn bô siâng-khoán.

In-ūi Ki-thê ê chiàn-chûn lâi kong-kek pak-hng ê ông, i tio̍h-kiaⁿ thiat-thè. “I chin m̄ kam-goān, chiū chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù phò-hoāi i só͘ oàn-hūn ê Siōng-tè chú-bîn ê sìn-gióng, ēng án-ni chhut-khùi. I ōe koh tò-lâi thiaⁿ hiah-ê pōe-poān sìn-gióng ê lâng ê ì-kiàn,

phài peng lâi chiàm-léng pó-lúi, siat-to̍k sèng-só͘, kìm-chí hiàn ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h hiàn ê chè hō͘ Siōng-tè, koh chiong khó-ò͘ⁿ ōe tì-kàu húi-bia̍t ê mi̍h chhāi tī sèng-tiān.
I ōe ēng khúi-kè tit-tio̍h ûi-pōe sìn-gióng ê lâng ê chi-chhî, m̄-kú hiah-ê tùi Siōng-tè tiong-sêng ê lâng ōe ióng-kám chhái-chhú hêng-tōng.
Ū tì-hūi ê léng-siù ōe kàu-tō chèng-lâng, m̄-kú ū chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan in ōe siū sat-hāi, hō͘ lâng sio, hō͘ lâng lia̍h, hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ-kiap.
In tī siū pek-hāi ê tiong-kan, kan-ta ōe tit-tio̍h sió-khóa ê oān-chō͘, koh ōe ū chin chōe lâng ké-ì ka-ji̍p in.

Ū tì-hūi ê lâng ū-ê ōe siū pek-hāi, án-ni sī beh kā kî-tha ê lâng bôa-liān, tī sî-kî kiat-sok í-chêng, kā in kiat-chēng hō͘ in chheng-pe̍k, in-ūi lī Siōng-tè chí-tēng ê sî iáu ū chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan.

“Pak-hng ê ông ōe kè-sio̍k chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù chòe tāi-chì, chū-ko chū-tāi, khòaⁿ ka-kī pí só͘-ū ê sîn-bêng khah tōa, koh ēng tōa-siaⁿ-ōe siat-to̍k bān-sîn ê Sîn. I chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì, tī Siōng-tè tōa siū-khì kiat-sok í-chêng, lóng chin sūn-lī; m̄-kú Siōng-tè koat-tēng beh chòe ê sū it-tēng ōe si̍t-hiān.

Pak-hng ê ông bô chun-tiōng i chó͘-sian ê sîn-bêng kap hū-lú kah-ì ê sîn-bêng, bô kā jīm-hô sîn-bêng khàn-chāi-gán-lāi, in-ūi i chū-ko chū-tāi, khòaⁿ ka-kī chhiau-kè it-chhè.
I kan-ta chông-pài pó-lúi ê sîn-bêng, ēng kim, gûn, pó-chio̍h, kap chun-kùi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ hiàn hō͘ i chó͘-sian m̄-bat ê sîn-bêng.

I khò gōa-kok sîn-bêng ê pang-chān, kong-phòa siōng kian-kò͘ ê pó-lúi. Nā ū lâng jīm-tông chàn-sêng i, i chiū kā in chióng-lē, hō͘ in koán chin chōe lâng, koh sù thó͘-tōe hō͘ in.

“Boa̍t-kî kàu ê sî, lâm-hng ê ông ōe kap pak-hng ê ông kau-chiàn. Pak-hng ê ông ōe phài chiàn-chhia, bé-peng, chin chōe chiàn-chûn, chhin-chhiūⁿ kńg-lê-á-hong kā i hoán-kek, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi chhiong-ji̍p hiah-ê kok ê léng-thó͘.
Pak-hng ê ông koh ōe chhim-ji̍p pûi koh súi ê tōe, thâi-sí kui-chheng kui-bān lâng, m̄-kú Í-tong, Mô͘-ap, kap A-bûn tāi-pō͘-hūn ê lâng ōe tô-thoat bián-sí.
I beh koh chhun-chhiú kong-kek ta̍k-kok, liân Ai-ki̍p to bōe-tàng tô-thoat.
I ōe chiáng-ak Ai-ki̍p ê kim-gûn châi-pó kap kùi-tiōng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, koh cheng-ho̍k Lī-pí-a kap Kó͘-si̍t.
M̄-kú tùi tang-pêng kap pak-pêng thoân--lâi ê siau-sit hō͘ i chin hoân-ló, i chiū siū-khì chhut-peng, beh khì siau-bia̍t chin chōe lâng.
I beh tī hái kap súi ê sèng-soaⁿ tiong-kan tah tông-hông ê pò͘-pîⁿ. M̄-kú i ê kiat-kio̍k í-keng kàu lah, bô lâng ōe-tàng pang-chān i.”

Siōng-tè ê sù-chiá kè-sio̍k tùi góa kóng, “Hit-sî, hit-ê pó-hō͘ lí ê tông-pau ê thiⁿ-sài-tiúⁿ Bí-ka-le̍k beh chhut-hiān, jiân-āu it-tēng ōe ū chi̍t tōaⁿ chai-lān ê sî-kî; hit-ê chai-lān sī tùi khai-kok í-lâi m̄-bat ū--ê. Hit-sî, lí hiah-ê miâ ū kì tī oa̍h-miā-chheh ê tông-pau ōe tit-tio̍h kái-kiù.
Chin chōe í-keng sí--khì ê lâng ōe koh-oa̍h; ū-ê tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê sìⁿ-miā, ū-ê éng-oán siū thí-chhiò iàm-chiān.
Ū tì-hūi ê lâng ōe hoat-kng, chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê kng; hiah-ê chhōa chin chōe lâng kui-ǹg chèng-ti̍t ê lâng, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiⁿ-sîn éng-oán hoat-kng.

“ Tān-í-lí, boa̍t-ji̍t kàu í-chêng, lí tio̍h chiong chiah-ê ōe pó-bi̍t, kā chit-pún chheh hong-ba̍t. Tī chit-tōaⁿ sî-kan, it-tēng ū chin chōe lâng choan-sim thàm-thó ò-pì ê sū, tì-sek chiū ná ke-thiⁿ.”
Āu-lâi, góa Tān-í-lí khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū nn̄g ê lâng khiā--teh: chi̍t ê tī hô ê chit-pêng, chi̍t ê tī hô ê hit-pêng.
Kî-tiong chi̍t ê tùi lēng-gōa khiā tī hô-chúi téng-bīn, chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ hit-ê lâng kóng, “Chiah-ê kî-īⁿ ê sū sím-mi̍h sî ōe si̍t-hiān?”

Hit-ê khiā tī hô-chúi téng-bīn, chhēng iù-môa-pò͘ ê saⁿ ê lâng ǹg thiⁿ gia̍h siang-chhiú; góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ i kí éng-oa̍h ê Chú soan-sè kóng, “Koh saⁿ nî pòaⁿ, chiū-sī chân-hāi hiah-ê sèng ê chú-bîn ê sè-le̍k kiat-sok ê sî, chiah-ê it-chhè ê sū lóng ōe si̍t-hiān.”
Góa thiaⁿ-liáu, bōe bêng-pe̍k, chiū mn̄g kóng, “Góa ê chú, chiah-ê sū ê kiat-kio̍k ōe án-chóaⁿ?”
I kóng, “ Tān-í-lí, lí m̄-bián chhau-hoân, in-ūi tī boa̍t-ji̍t í-chêng, chiah-ê ōe lóng ōe hong-ba̍t pó-bi̍t.

It-tēng ōe ū chin chōe lâng tit-tio̍h sóe-chheng, kiat-chēng, chiap-siū thoàn-liān. M̄-kú, pháiⁿ-lâng ōe kè-sio̍k chòe pháiⁿ. Chiah-ê sū pháiⁿ-lâng bōe bêng-pe̍k, chí-ū ū tì-hūi ê lâng chiah ōe.
“Tùi kìm-chí ta̍k-ji̍t hiàn-chè hō͘ Siōng-tè, koh chhāi hit-ê tì-kàu bia̍t-bông khó-ò͘ⁿ ê siōng hit-ji̍t khai-sí, tio̍h koh thèng-hāu chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah káu-cha̍p ji̍t.
Só͘-ū kian-chhî kàu chi̍t-chheng saⁿ-pah saⁿ-cha̍p-gō͘ ji̍t ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!
“Lí leh, lí tio̍h kian-chhî kàu kiat-kio̍k ê sî. Lí ōe tit-tio̍h an-hioh, kàu boa̍t-ji̍t, lí ōe koh khí--lâi, hióng-siū lí ê hok-hūn!”

Ē-bīn sī O͘-se-a, Iok-thán, A-hap-su, Hi-se-ka sòa-chiap chòe Iû-tāi -ông, Iok-hôa-si ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an Jī-sè chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông ê sî, Siōng Chú tùi Pī-lī ê kiáⁿ Hô-se-a kóng ê ōe.

Siōng Chú thâu chi̍t piàn tùi Hô-se-a kóng-ōe, kóng, “Lí khì chhōa chi̍t ê îm-hū chòe bó͘, siu i tùi îm-loān siⁿ ê gín-á; in-ūi chit-ê tōe-hng chhiong-móa îm-loān, lī-khui Siōng Chú.”
Hô-se-a chiū khì chhōa Tih-la-im ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ Ko-bi̍t, i hoâi-īn, siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ.

Siōng Chú tùi Hô-se-a kóng, “Kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Iâ-su-lia̍t, in-ūi koh bô-jōa-kú, góa beh in-ūi Iâ-hō͘ -ke tī Iâ-su-lia̍t thâi-lâng lâu-huih ê chōe kā in hêng-hoa̍t, beh toān-choa̍t Í-sek-lia̍t ê ông-tiâu.
Kàu hit-ji̍t, góa beh tī Iâ-su-lia̍t Soaⁿ-kok at-chi̍h Í-sek-lia̍t ê keng.”

Ko-bi̍t koh hoâi-īn siⁿ chi̍t ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ; Siōng Chú tùi Hô-se-a kóng, “Kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Lô Lō͘-hap-má, in-ūi góa bô beh thiàⁿ-sioh Í-sek-lia̍t -ke, it-tēng m̄ kā in sià-bián.
Chóng-sī góa beh thiàⁿ-sioh Iû-tāi -ke, góa Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè ōe kiù in, m̄-sī ēng keng, ēng to, ēng kau-chiàn, ēng chiàn-bé, á-sī ēng bé-peng kiù in.”
Lô Lō͘-hap-má tn̄g-lin liáu-āu, hū-jîn-lâng koh hoâi-īn siⁿ chi̍t ê kiáⁿ.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Tio̍h kā i hō-miâ kiò-chòe Lô A-bí; in-ūi lín m̄-sī góa ê chú-bîn, góa mā m̄-sī lín ê Siōng-tè.”

Chóng-sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê lâng-gia̍h ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-soa bōe-niû--tit, bōe-sǹg--tit. Í-chêng Siōng-tè tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi ū tùi in kóng “Lín m̄-sī góa ê chú-bîn”, chiong-lâi tī hia beh tùi in kóng “Lín sī éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ”.
Iû-tāi -lâng kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ōe liân-ha̍p, soán chi̍t ê léng-siù, tùi chit-ê tōe heng-khí; in-ūi Iâ-su-lia̍t ê ji̍t ōe chiâⁿ-chòe êng-kng ê ji̍t.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, tio̍h kā lín ê hiaⁿ-tī kiò-chòe “góa ê chú-bîn”, kā lín ê chí-bē kiò-chòe “só͘ thiàⁿ-sioh--ê”.
Khì kò lín lāu-bú, kap i lí-lūn. I kiám m̄-sī góa ê bó͘, góa kiám m̄-sī i ê ang? Kiò i tû-khì îm-loān ê bīn-iông, ín-iú-lâng ê heng-khám,
chiah bián góa kā i thǹg-kng-kng, chhin-chhiūⁿ tú-á chhut-sì hit-ji̍t ê khoán-sit, chiah bián góa hō͘ i chhin-chhiūⁿ khòng-iá ta-sò ê tōe, chhùi-ta kàu sí.
Góa bô beh thiàⁿ i ê kiáⁿ-jî, in-ūi in sī tùi îm-loān siⁿ--ê.

In ê lāu-bú kiâⁿ îm-loān, chòe kiàn-siàu-sū siⁿ in; i kóng: Góa beh khì tè góa ê ài-jîn; góa ê iûⁿ-mn̂g, môa-pò͘, piáⁿ, chúi, iû kap só͘ lim--ê, lóng sī in hō͘ góa--ê.
In-ūi án-ni, góa beh ēng chhì-á that i ê lō͘, chō chhiûⁿ hō͘ i chhē bô lō͘.

I beh khì jip hiah-ê chêng-jîn, m̄-kú jip bōe tio̍h, beh chhē mā chhē bōe tio̍h. I chiū kóng, “Góa beh tò-khì chhē goân-lâi ê tiōng-hu, in-ūi góa chêng ê kéng-hóng pí hiān-chāi khah hó.”
I m̄ chai i ê ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, sin-iû, lóng sī góa hō͘ i--ê; i ho̍k-sāi Pa-le̍k ê kim kap gûn, mā-sī góa hō͘ i--ê.

Só͘-í, siu-koah ê sî á-sī chhut sin-chiú ê sî, góa beh chiong góa ê ngó͘-kok kap sin-chiú kā the̍h tò-tńg, mā beh chiong góa hō͘ i jia-khàm seng-khu ê iûⁿ-mn̂g kap môa-pò͘ kā chhiúⁿ tò-tńg.
Góa beh hō͘ i tī i ê chêng-jîn ê ba̍k-chiu chêng chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé tì-kàu kiàn-siàu; bô lâng ōe-tàng kiù i thoat-lī góa ê chhiú.
Góa beh hō͘ i bōe-tàng koh ū iàn-lo̍k, bô koh ū chhoe-it, An-hioh-ji̍t, kap kî-tha ê choeh-ji̍t.

Góa mā beh húi-hoāi i ê phû-tô-chhiū, bû-hoa-kó-chhiū, in-ūi i kóng chiah-ê sī i ê chêng-jîn hō͘ i ê pò-siúⁿ; góa beh hō͘ i ê ké-chí-hn̂g pha-hng, chhut-chāi iá-siù thún-ta̍h thun-chia̍h.

I í-chêng sio-hiuⁿ ho̍k-sāi Pa-le̍k, ēng hī-kau kap ta̍k-chióng chong-sek-phín, chng-súi-súi khì tè i hiah-ê chêng-jîn, soah bōe-kì-tit góa, só͘-í góa beh kā i chhú-hoa̍t. Che sī Siōng Chú kóng--ê.
Án-ni, góa beh chio i lâi-khì khòng-iá, khin-siaⁿ-sòe-seh kap i kóng-ōe.

Tī hia góa beh chiong i ê phû-tô-hn̂g hêng i, koh kā “Chai-lān ” ê soaⁿ-kok pìⁿ-chòe “Ǹg-bāng” ê mn̂g; tī hia i ōe ìn-tap góa, chhin-chhiūⁿ i siàu-liân ê sî, chhin-chhiūⁿ i chhut Ai-ki̍p ê ji̍t.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Tī hit-ji̍t lí beh chheng-ho͘ góa ‘goán ang’, bô koh chheng-ho͘ góa ‘goán thâu-ke ’.
Góa bô beh hō͘ i koh kiû-kiò Pa-le̍k, beh hō͘ i bōe-kì-tit chit-ê miâ.

“Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh ūi-tio̍h góa ê chú-bîn kap chhân-iá ê tōng-bu̍t, khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu, í-ki̍p tōe-chiūⁿ ê thâng-thōa li̍p-iok; góa mā beh kòng-tn̄g tōe-bīn-chiūⁿ ê keng, to, kap só͘-ū ê bú-khì, hō͘ in thang an-jiân tó lo̍h-khì hioh-khùn.
“Góa beh chhōa lí éng-oán chòe góa ê bó͘, ēng kong-gī, kong-pêng, chû-ài, lîn-bín chòe phèng-kim kā lí chhōa.
Góa mā beh ēng tiong-si̍t chòe phèng-kim chhōa lí, lí chiū ōe chin-chiàⁿ bat Siōng Chú.”
Siōng Chú kóng: Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh ìn-tap góa chú-bîn ê kî-kiû, beh hō͘ thiⁿ lo̍h-hō͘, koàn-ak thó͘-tōe,
hō͘ tōe chhut-sán ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú kap iû, ēng chiah-ê ìn-tap Iâ-su-lia̍t.

Góa beh ūi-tio̍h góa ka-kī kā i chai-chèng tī chit-tè thó͘-tōe; góa beh thiàⁿ-sioh Lô Lō͘-hap-má, beh tùi Lô A-bí kóng “Lí sī góa ê chú-bîn”; in ōe ìn kóng “Lí sī goán ê Siōng-tè”.

Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h koh khì ài hit-ê tùi lí bô tiong-si̍t ê cha-bó͘-lâng; i hiān-chāi ū chi̍t ê chêng-jîn. Sui-jiân Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng khì pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, ài chia̍h chè ngó͘-siōng ê phû-tô-koaⁿ-oân, m̄-kú góa iáu thiàⁿ in; lí mā tio̍h án-ni thiàⁿ chit-ê cha-bó͘-lâng.”
Góa chiū ēng cha̍p-gō͘ tè gûn-á kap chi̍t-pah gō͘-cha̍p kong-kun tōa-be̍h kā i bóe--tńg-lâi.
Góa tùi i kóng, “Lí tio̍h kap góa tòa, m̄-thang koh kiâⁿ-îm, mā m̄-thang khì tè pa̍t-ê ta-po͘-lâng; m̄-kú chit-tōaⁿ sî-kan góa mā bô beh kap lí tâng-pâng.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ōe chi̍t tōaⁿ tn̂g ê sî-kan bô kun-ông, bô siú-léng, bô chè-sū, bô tiau-khek ê thiāu, bô í-hut-tek, bô chhāi ka-cho̍k-sîn-siōng.

Āu-lâi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ōe koh tńg-lâi kui-sio̍k Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè, hôe-ho̍k Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-tiâu; tī chiong-lâi ê ji̍t-chí, in ōe kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, niá-siū I hong-sēng ê un-hūi.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe; Siōng Chú beh khòng-kò chit-tè tōe ê chū-bîn, in-ūi in bô sêng-si̍t, bô jîn-chû, bô lâng chin-chiàⁿ bat Siōng-tè,
kan-ta teh lām-sám chiù-chōa, pōe-iok, hiong-sat, thau-the̍h, kan-îm, kiông-pō, kè-sio̍k thâi-lâng lâu-huih.
In-ūi án-ni, chit-ê tōe ōe ta--khì; só͘-ū tòa tī chia--ê, liân chhân-iá ê siù, khong-tiong ê chiáu lóng ōe siau-bia̍t, hái--ni̍h ê hî mā ōe bô--khì.
M̄-thang hō͘-siōng khòng-kò, m̄-thang pí-chhú chí-chek; góa chek-pī--ê sī lín chiah-ê chòe chè-si--ê.
Ji̍t--sî, lín ōe poa̍h-tó, mî--sî, sian-ti mā ōe kap lín siâng-khoán poa̍h-tó; góa beh siau-bia̍t lín ê jîn-bîn.

Góa ê chú-bîn in-ūi bû-ti bia̍t-bông; lín m̄ sêng-jīn góa, góa mā m̄ sêng-jīn lín chòe chè-si. Kì-jiân lín khì-sak lín ê Siōng-tè ê lu̍t-hoat, góa mā it-tēng beh khì-sak lín ê kiáⁿ-sun.
Lín chè-si ê jîn-sò͘ jú chōe jú tek-chōe góa; só͘-í góa beh hō͘ lín ê chun-êng pìⁿ-chòe kiàn-siàu.
Lín ài góa ê chú-bîn hoān khah-chōe ê chōe, thang tit-tio̍h khah chōe sio̍k-chōe ê chè-mi̍h.
Án-ni, lín chè-si ōe kap jîn-bîn siâng-khoán siū hêng-hoa̍t; góa beh chiàu lín ê só͘-chòe pān lín, chiàu lín ê hêng-ûi pò-èng lín.
Lín chia̍h, chia̍h bōe pá; kiâⁿ-îm, seng-sán mā bōe cheng-ka; in-ūi lín khì-sak Siōng Chú, khì tè pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng.
Chiú kap sin-chiú ōe hō͘ lâng sit-khì liông-ti.
Góa ê chú-bîn khì mn̄g chhâ-thâu, thiu-chhiam pok-kòa kiû chí-sī; îm-loān ê sîn chhōa in lī-khui chiàⁿ-lō͘, in kiâⁿ-îm pōe-poān in ê Siōng-tè.

In tī soaⁿ-téng hiàn-chè, tī soaⁿ-lûn-á sio-hiuⁿ, tī hia ū siōng-chhiū, iông-chhiū, siông-chiat-chhiū liâng-sóng ê ìm-ńg. In-ūi án-ni, lín ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ îm-loān, lín ê sin-pū hoān kan-îm.

Sui-jiân lín ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ îm-loān, lín ê sin-pū hoān kan-îm, góa bōe kā in hêng-hoa̍t, in-ūi lín chiah-ê ta-po͘-lâng khì kap chhiong-ki lēng-gōa tòa, kap sī-biō ê ki-lú tàu-tīn hiàn-chè; chit-khoán bû-ti ê jîn-bîn it-tēng bia̍t-bông.
Sui-jiân Í-sek-lia̍t îm-loān, m̄-kú Iû-tāi m̄-thang hoān-chōe. M̄-thang khì Kiat-kah, m̄-thang chiūⁿ-khì Pek A-bûn, m̄-thang kí éng-oa̍h ê Siōng Chú chiù-chōa.
Í-sek-lia̍t kò͘-chip chhin-chhiūⁿ ngī-phīⁿ ê gû-bú; Siōng Chú kiám ōe iúⁿ-chhī in, chhin-chhiūⁿ tī khui-khoah ê só͘-chāi iúⁿ-chhī iûⁿ?
Kì-jiân Í-hoat-liân kap ngó͘-siōng kiat-liân, chhut-chāi in khì!
In lim kah chùi-bâng-bâng koh kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ-îm; in ài kiàn-siàu, bô ài êng-ū.
Hong ōe ēng si̍t kā in kńg--khì; in hiàn hō͘ ngó͘-siōng ê chè-sū ōe hō͘ in tì-kàu kiàn-siàu.

Chè-si ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ! Í-sek-lia̍t chú-bîn, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Ông-chhin ah, tio̍h chim-chiok thiaⁿ! Lín teh-beh siū sím-phòaⁿ, in-ūi lín tī Bí-su-pa chiâⁿ-chòe hāi-lâng ê oa̍h-tauh, tī Tha-po̍k-soaⁿ chiâⁿ-chòe tng lâng ê lô-bāng.
Chiah-ê pōe-poān ê lâng tāi-khai-sat-kài, góa beh koán-kàu in lóng-chóng ê lâng.
Í-hoat-liân ah, góa chin liáu-kái lí; Í-sek-lia̍t bōe-tàng tùi góa am-khàm. Taⁿ, Í-hoat-liân, lí kiâⁿ îm-loān, Í-sek-lia̍t kā ka-kī phah lâ-sâm.
In ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe hō͘ in bōe-tàng kui-ǹg Siōng-tè; in-ūi in ê sim chhiong-móa îm-loān, oân-choân m̄ bat Siōng Chú.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiau-ngō͘ chèng-bêng in ka-kī ū-chōe; Í-hoat-liân ōe in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe poa̍h-tó sit-pāi; Iû-tāi ōe kap in siâng-khoán sit-pāi.
In beh chhōa gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn khì chhē Siōng Chú, m̄-kú chhē bōe tio̍h, in-ūi Siōng Chú í-keng lī-khui in.
In tùi Siōng Chú bô tiong-si̍t, kap pa̍t-lâng thau siⁿ-kiáⁿ; chhoe-it ê khèng-tián í-chêng, in kap in ê sán-gia̍p lóng ōe siū húi-hoāi.
Tio̍h tī Ki-pí-a pûn sàu-kak, tī La-má pûn lat-pah, tī Pek A-bûn hoat-chhut kéng-pò. Piān-ngá-bín ah, tio̍h chù-ì lí ê āu-bīn!
Hêng-hoa̍t ê ji̍t nā kàu, Í-hoat-liân ōe hong-hòe; góa beh tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k chi-cho̍k soan-kò, soan-kò chiong-lâi it-tēng ōe hoat-seng ê sū.
Iû-tāi ê siú-léng kèng-jiân pà-chiàm jîn-bîn ê thó͘-tōe; góa beh chiong góa ê siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi piàⁿ-lo̍h tī Iû-tāi.
Í-hoat-liân kam-goān khì tè bô lō͘-ēng ê ngó͘-siōng; in it-tēng ōe siū sím-phòaⁿ, siū ap-pek thún-ta̍h.
Góa beh chhin-chhiūⁿ chiù-thâng tùi-thāi Í-hoat-liân, mā beh hō͘ Iû-tāi nōa--khì.
Í-hoat-liân khòaⁿ-tio̍h ka-kī ū pīⁿ, Iû-tāi khòaⁿ-tio̍h pún-sin ū siong; Í-hoat-liân chiū phài lâng khì kiû A-su̍t tāi-ông; m̄-kú i bōe-tàng i in ê pīⁿ, tī in ê siong.
Góa beh chhin-chhiūⁿ sai tùi-thāi Í-hoat-liân, chhin-chhiūⁿ béng-sai tùi-thāi Iû-tāi; góa beh kā in thiah-chhùi, thoa-cháu; bô lâng ōe-tàng kiù in.
Taⁿ góa beh tò-khì góa ê só͘-chāi, thèng-hāu in sêng-jīn ka-kī ê chōe, kî-kiû kìⁿ góa ê bīn; in tī kip-lān ê sî, ōe pek-chhiat chhē-kiû góa.
In kóng: Lâi ah, lán tio̍h hôe-thâu kui-ǹg Siōng Chú; I thiah-li̍h lán, mā beh i-hó lán; I phah lán, mā beh pau lán ê siong.
Kè nn̄g ji̍t, I ōe hō͘ lán ho̍k-goân; tē-saⁿ ji̍t, I ōe hō͘ lán peh--khí-lâi, lán chiū ōe-tàng tī I ê koàn-kò͘-ē seng-oa̍h.

Lán tio̍h jīn-bat Siōng Chú, chīn-la̍t tui-kiû lâi bat I; I ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chheng-chá ê kng chhut-hiān, chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘-chúi lîm-kàu lán, chhin-chhiūⁿ chhun-ú lūn-te̍k thó͘-tōe.

Í-hoat-liân ah, góa tio̍h án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lí? Iû-tāi ah, góa tio̍h án-chóaⁿ tùi-hù lí? Lín tùi góa ê thiàⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-khí-sî ê hûn-bū, chhin-chhiūⁿ lō͘-chúi chin kín ta--khì.
In-ūi án-ni, góa phài sian-ti kā lín phut--sí, ēng góa ê ōe kā lín thâi--sí; góa ê sím-phòaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chheng-chá ê kng hoat-chhut.
Góa khah ài chû-ài, bô ài chè-sū; ài lâng chin-chiàⁿ bat Siōng-tè, iâⁿ-kè hiàn sio-hòa-chè.
M̄-kú in chhin-chhiūⁿ A-tong pōe-iok, tùi góa bô tiong-si̍t.
Ki-lia̍t sī pháiⁿ-lâng ê siâⁿ; in ê kha-jiah lóng sī thâi-lâng ê huih.
Chè-si kiat-tóng, chhin-chhiūⁿ kiông-tō, tī Sī-kiàm ê lō͘-tiong bâi-ho̍k, thâi-lâng, chòe siâ-ok ê sū.
Tī Í-sek-lia̍t -ke góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ ê sū; Í-hoat-liân hoān îm-hēng, Í-sek-lia̍t bak lâ-sâm.
Lí leh, Iû-tāi, kā lí siu-koah ê sî í-keng koat-tēng! Góa beh hō͘ góa ê chú-bîn hôe-ho̍k hoân-êng.

Góa siūⁿ-beh i-hó Í-sek-lia̍t ê sî, Í-hoat-liân ê chōe-kò lō͘-hiān, Sat-má-lī-a ê chōe-ok po̍k-lō͘, in-ūi in chòe tāi-chì hu-ké, chhim-ji̍p chhù-lāi thau-the̍h, tī gōa-bīn kong-jiân chhiúⁿ-kiap.
In bô siūⁿ-kóng góa ōe-kì-tit in it-chhè ê chōe-ok; in só͘ hoān ê chōe-ok kā in tîⁿ-tiâu-tiâu, góa lóng khòaⁿ-hiān-hiān.
Siōng Chú kóng: In chòe pháiⁿ, hō͘ kun-ông hoaⁿ-hí; in khi-phiàn, hō͘ koaⁿ-oân khoài-lo̍k.
In lóng kiâⁿ îm-loān, chhin-chhiūⁿ iām-jia̍t ê hé-lô͘, teh thèng-hāu mī-oân hoat--khí-lâi, hang-piáⁿ ê lâng m̄-bián koh lā hé hō͘ iām.
Tī lán ê ông hí-khèng ê ji̍t, koaⁿ-oân lim lia̍t-chiú, chùi kah m̄-chai-lâng, ông kap pōe-poān-chiá ak-chhiú.
In chō-hoán ê sim chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-lô͘, kui-mî ûn-ûn-á to̍h, thiⁿ chi̍t-ē kng chiū po̍k-hoat.
In sim-kông-hé-jia̍t, kā thóng-tī-chiá chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê siau-bia̍t; kun-ông lóng tó--lo̍h-khì, m̄-kú bô lâng kiû-kiò góa.
Í-hoat-liân kap gōa-cho̍k chham-chhap; in sī bô péng-pêng ê piáⁿ.
Gōa-cho̍k-lâng kā in ê khùi-la̍t suh ta--khì, in lóng m̄ chai; in í-keng hoat pe̍h thâu-mn̂g, ka-kī mā m̄ chai.
Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiau-ngō͘ chèng-bêng in ka-kī ū-chōe; sui-jiân tú-tio̍h chiah-ê sū, in iáu-kú m̄ kui-ǹg Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè, mā bô chhē-kiû I.
Í-hoat-liân chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu gōng-gōng m̄ bat pòaⁿ-hāng; in liâm-piⁿ kiû-kiò Ai-ki̍p, liâm-piⁿ khì óa A-su̍t.
In khì tâu-khò ê sî, góa beh ēng bāng pha tī in téng-bīn, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh lia̍h khong-tiong ê chiáu, kā in bāng--lo̍h-lâi; góa beh chiàu in ê pháiⁿ hêng-ûi kā in hêng-hoa̍t.
In chhám ah, in-ūi in lī-khui góa. In ōe siū húi-bia̍t, in-ūi in pōe-poān góa. Góa beh kái-kiù in, m̄-kú in môa-phiàn góa, kū-choa̍t góa.
In bô sêng-sim tùi góa kî-kiû, kan-ta tī bîn-chhn̂g téng ai-ai-kiò; in chū-chi̍p kèng-pài, kî-kiû ngó͘-kok kap sin-chiú, kî-si̍t sī teh pōe-poān góa.
Góa thoàn-liān in, hō͘ in chhiú-kut ū-la̍t; in kèng-jiân tô͘-bô͘ pháiⁿ-tāi hoán-khòng góa.

In it-ti̍t khì pài pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng, m̄ kui-ǹg Chì-koân-chiá; in chhin-chhiūⁿ lēng--khì ê keng bô lō͘-ēng; in ê siú-léng kóng-ōe kiau-ngō͘ bú-bān, ōe sí tī to-ē; chit-ê sū ōe chiâⁿ-chòe Ai-ki̍p -lâng ê chhiò-pìⁿ.

Siōng Chú kóng: Tio̍h pûn sàu-kak hoat kéng-pò! Tùi-te̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu chhiong--lo̍h-lâi, beh kong-kek Siōng Chú ê chhù, in-ūi góa ê chú-bîn phò-hoāi góa ê iok, ûi-pōe góa ê lu̍t-hoat.
In tùi góa ai-kiò kóng, “Siōng-tè ah, goán Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sêng-jīn lí sī goán ê Siōng-tè!”
M̄-kú Í-sek-lia̍t kū-choa̍t liông-siān, só͘-í tùi-te̍k ōe tui-jip in.
In siat-li̍p kun-ông, m̄-sī chiàu góa ê ì-sù; in siat-li̍p siú-léng, góa bô sêng-jīn. In ēng kim, ēng gûn chō ngó͘-siōng, kiat-kó ka-kī siū húi-bia̍t.
Sat-má-lī-a -lâng, tio̍h khì-sak lín ê gû-á-siōng! Góa tùi lín hoat tōa siū-khì; lín tio̍h koh jōa kú chiah ōe hòng-khì ngó͘-siōng chông-pài?
Ngó͘-siōng sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê sai-hū chù-chō--ê; in m̄-sī Siōng-tè. Sat-má-lī-a ê gû-á-siōng it-tēng ōe siū kòng-chhùi.
In iā--ê sī hong, siu--ê sī kńg-lê-á-hong, bōe tōa-châng, bōe kiat-si̍t; nā ōe kiat-si̍t, mā ōe hō͘ gōa-cho̍k-lâng chia̍h-chia̍h--khì.
Í-sek-lia̍t í-keng siū thun-bia̍t; hiān-chāi tī lia̍t-kok tiong chhin-chhiūⁿ bô lō͘-ēng ê khì-khū.
Í-sek-lia̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-lû sì-kòe cháu, cháu-khì A-su̍t; Í-hoat-liân chhut-bōe ka-kī hō͘ ài-jîn.
In mā tī lia̍t-kok tiong chhut-bōe ài-chêng, góa beh kā in chi̍p óa--lâi, kā in hêng-hoa̍t; in liâm-piⁿ ōe tī A-su̍t tāi-ông ê ap-pek ē siū-khó͘.
Í-hoat-liân ūi-tio̍h beh sio̍k-chōe, ta̍k só͘-chāi khí chè-tôaⁿ; chè-tôaⁿ jú chōe, hoān-chōe jú ke-thiⁿ.
Góa ūi-tio̍h in siá chin chōe lu̍t-hoat, m̄-kú in khòaⁿ-chòe kap in lóng bô koan-hē.

In hiàn-chè hō͘ góa, m̄-kú hiàn ê bah ka-kī chia̍h-liáu-liáu; góa Siōng Chú bô beh chiap-la̍p. Taⁿ, góa beh kā in ê chōe kì--teh, kā in hêng-hoa̍t; góa beh hō͘ in tò-tńg-khì Ai-ki̍p.
Í-sek-lia̍t khí kiong-tiān, bōe-kì-tit in ê Chhòng-chō-chú; Iû-tāi mā khí chin chōe kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, góa beh kàng-hé sio in ê siâⁿ, sio-húi in ê pó-lúi.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ gōa-cho̍k-lâng hoaⁿ-hí khèng-chiok, in-ūi lín kiâⁿ îm-loān lī-khui Siōng-tè, tī ta̍k-ê ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ siu kiâⁿ-îm thàn ê chîⁿ.
Ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ kap chiú-khut bōe-tàng iúⁿ-chhī lín; só͘ kî-thāi ê sin-chiú mā ōe lo̍k-khong.
Í-hoat-liân bōe-tàng koh tòa tī Siōng Chú ê tōe; in ōe tò-tńg-khì Ai-ki̍p, tī A-su̍t chia̍h bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h.

In bōe-tàng koh ǹg Siōng Chú hiàn tiān-chiú-chè; in hiàn ê chè bōe hō͘ I hoaⁿ-hí. In ê chè-mi̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ song-ka chia̍h ê mi̍h, chia̍h ê lâng pìⁿ-chòe bô chheng-khì. In ê chia̍h-mi̍h chí-ū ōe-tàng hō͘ in chí-ki, bōe-ēng-tit the̍h ji̍p-khì Siōng Chú ê tiān.
Tī só͘ tēng ê choeh-kî, kèng-pài Siōng Chú ê ji̍t, lín beh chòe sím-mi̍h?

In sui-jiân siám-kè chai-lān, mā ōe hō͘ Ai-ki̍p ûi-khùn sat-hāi, tī Bēng-húi-su hō͘ lâng siu-si bâi-chòng. In ê kim-gûn châi-pó ōe hō͘ cha̍p-chháu khàm-ba̍t; in tòa ê só͘-chāi chhì-phè móa-sì-kòe.

Tio̍h hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t chai, hêng-hoa̍t ê ji̍t lâi lah, pò-èng ê sî kàu lah. Lín ê chōe tāng, chhiong-móa oàn-hūn, só͘-í lín kóng, “Sian-ti sī gōng-lâng, siū sîn kám-tōng--ê sī siáu-lâng.”
Sian-ti siū Siōng-tè chí-phài chòe Í-sek-lia̍t ê siú-bōng-chiá; i bô-lūn khì tó-ūi lóng ū lô-bāng teh tng-tán, liân tī Siōng-tè ê ke to siū te̍k-sī.
Í-sek-lia̍t thiat-tóe hú-pāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ in chá-chêng tī Ki-pí-a ê só͘-chòe. Siōng-tè ōe-kì-tit in ê chōe, beh hêng-hoa̍t in ê chōe-kò.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Thâu chi̍t piàn, góa tú-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ tī khòng-iá khòaⁿ-tio̍h phû-tô; góa tú-tio̍h lín ê lia̍t-chó͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ khòaⁿ-tio̍h thâu chi̍t kùi chho͘-se̍k ê bû-hoa-kó. M̄-kú in chi̍t-ē kàu Pa-le̍k Pí-ní, chiū khai-sí khì pài hit só͘-chāi khó-ò͘ⁿ ê sîn-bêng, in chiū pìⁿ-chòe kap in só͘ ài ê sîn-bêng siâng-khoán hiah-ni̍h thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
Í-hoat-liân ê êng-kng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chiáu pe--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ hū-jîn-lâng bōe siū-thai, bōe hoâi-īn, bōe siⁿ-kiáⁿ.
In nā ōe siⁿ, góa mā beh hō͘ hiah-ê gín-á chhī bōe tōa, bô lâu pòaⁿ-ê. Góa nā pàng-sak in, in chiū chhiⁿ-chhám.
Góa khòaⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ-jî chù-tiāⁿ tio̍h hō͘ lâng tui-jip chân-sat; Í-hoat-liân ōe chhōa in ê kiáⁿ-jî chhut-lâi kau hō͘ tô͘-sat-chiá.”
Siōng Chú ah, lí beh hō͘ in sím-mi̍h? Tio̍h hō͘ in liû-sán, lin ta--khì.

Í-sek-lia̍t tī Kiat-kah chòe chīn pháiⁿ-tāi, góa tī hia khai-sí oàn-hūn in. In-ūi in só͘ chòe ê pháiⁿ, góa beh tùi góa ê ke kā in kóaⁿ--chhut-khì; góa bōe koh thiàⁿ-sioh in; in ê siú-léng mā lóng pōe-poān góa.
Í-hoat-liân siū phah-tó; in ê kun ta--khì, bōe kiat ké-chí. In nā siⁿ-kiáⁿ, só͘ siⁿ ê pó-pòe-á-kiáⁿ, góa mā beh kā thâi-sí.
Góa ê Siōng-tè it-tēng beh kā in khì-sak, in-ūi in m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn I. In ōe tī lia̍t-kok tiong liû-lōng.

Í-sek-lia̍t sī gâu siⁿ-thòaⁿ, gâu kiat ké-chí ê phû-tô-chhiū. Ké-chí kiat ná chōe, chè-tôaⁿ chiū khí ná chōe; thó͘-tōe chhut-sán ná hong-hù, chio̍h-thiāu-siōng chiū chō ná súi.
In ê sim khúi-chà, it-tēng tio̍h siū tēng-chōe; Siōng Chú beh thiah in ê chè-tôaⁿ, húi in ê chio̍h-thiāu-siōng.
Hit-sî in ōe kóng: Goán bô ông, goán bô teh kiaⁿ Siōng Chú. Ū ông, i ōe-tàng thòe goán chòe sím-mi̍h?
In khang-chhùi-pō͘-chi̍h, lām-sám chiù-chōa li̍p-iok; in hō͘ kong-gī pìⁿ-chòe put-gī, chhin-chhiūⁿ hn̂g-kau ê to̍k-chháu sì-kòe siⁿ-thòaⁿ.
Pek A-bûn ê gû-á-siōng siū húi-hoāi; Sat-má-lī-a ê chū-bîn kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, ūi-tio̍h gû-á-siōng ai-siong, in ê chè-si pi-ai, in-ūi kim-gû í-keng sit-khì êng-kng.
In ê gû-á-siōng ōe hō͘ lâng kng-khì A-su̍t, chòe lé-mi̍h sàng hō͘ A-su̍t tāi-ông; Í-hoat-liân ōe siū lêng-jio̍k, Í-sek-lia̍t in-ūi pài ngó͘-siōng kiàn-siàu.
Sat-má-lī-a ê ông ōe siau-sit, chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi-bīn ê chhâ-iù-á.

A-bûn ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ, Í-sek-lia̍t hoān-chōe ê só͘-chāi, ōe siū húi-bia̍t; hiah-ê chè-tôaⁿ ōe hō͘ chhì-phè kap chi̍t-lê khàm-móa; jîn-bîn ōe tùi tōa-soaⁿ kóng “Kā goán khàm--khí-lâi”, tùi sió-soaⁿ kóng “Kā goán teh--lo̍h-lâi”.

Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lín tùi Ki-pí-a sū-kiāⁿ í-lâi kè-sio̍k teh hoān-chōe. Lín kè-sio̍k tek-chōe góa, siūⁿ-kóng tī Ki-pí-a kong-kek hoān-chōe ê lâng ê chiàn-cheng bōe lîm-kàu lín.
Góa it-tēng ōe lâi hêng-hoa̍t chiah-ê hoān-chōe ê lâng; in hoān siang-têng ê chōe, lia̍t-kok ōe chū-chi̍p lâi kong-kek in.

Í-hoat-liân sī hó-kà ê gû-bú, ài lún ngó͘-kok; góa chiong taⁿ kòa tī i súi koh ióng ê ām-kún. Góa beh hō͘ Í-hoat-liân thoa-chhia, hō͘ Iû-tāi lôe-chhân, hō͘ Ngá-kok pê-sang chhân-thô͘.

Tio̍h ūi ka-kī khai-khún pha-hng ê tōe, chèng kong-gī, siu chû-ài. Hiān-chāi sī chhē-kiû Siōng Chú ê sî; I lâi ê sî, beh hō͘ kong-gī chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘-chúi kàng-lo̍h hō͘ lín.
Lín chèng siâ-ok, siu chōe-kò, chia̍h pe̍h-chha̍t kiat ê ké-chí. Lín óa-khò ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t, khò-sè lín ū chin chōe ióng-sū.

Só͘-í, chiàn-loān ê hán-hoah ōe lîm-kàu lí ê jîn-bîn, lí só͘-ū ê pó-lúi ōe hō͘ lâng thiah-húi, chhin-chhiūⁿ A-su̍t -ông Sa-le̍k-bān tī chiàn-cheng ê sî thiah-húi Pek A-pí-le̍k; hit-sî lāu-bú kap in ê kiáⁿ-jî lóng ōe hō͘ lâng siak-sí.
Pek-te̍k-lī -lâng ah, lín chōe-tāi-ok-ke̍k, ōe tú-tio̍h siâng-khoán ê chai-hō; thiⁿ chi̍t-ē kng, Í-sek-lia̍t -ông chiū ōe siū siau-bia̍t.
Siōng Chú kóng: Í-sek-lia̍t sòe-hàn ê sî góa chiū thiàⁿ i; góa ū tiàu góa ê kiáⁿ chhut Ai-ki̍p.
Góa ná kiò in, in ná cháu-khui; in kā Pa-le̍k hiàn-chè, tùi ngó͘-siōng sio-hiuⁿ.
Góa khan Í-hoat-liân ê chhiú kà in kiâⁿ; m̄-kú in m̄ chai góa ū i-hó in, chiàu-kò͘ in.
Góa ēng chû-pi ê soh, jîn-ài ê tòa khan in; góa tùi in ê ām-kún giâ-khui in ê taⁿ, àⁿ lo̍h-khì iúⁿ-chhī in.
In m̄-khéng tńg-lâi góa chia; án-ni, in it-tēng ōe koh tò-tńg-khì Ai-ki̍p, hō͘ A-su̍t -ông thóng-tī.
Chiàn-loān ōe lîm-kàu in ê siâⁿ, húi-hoāi in ê siâⁿ-mn̂g, phò-hoāi in ê kè-bô͘.
Góa ê chú-bîn kian-koat pōe-poān góa; án-ni, in kiò thiⁿ, thiⁿ bōe ìn.

Í-hoat-liân ah, góa ná kam khì-sak lí? Í-sek-lia̍t ah, góa ná kam chiong lí kau hō͘ pa̍t-lâng? Góa ná ōe hō͘ lí chhin-chhiūⁿ Ap-má, tùi-thāi lí chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-thāi Sé-pián? Góa ê sim í-keng kái-piàn; góa ê chêng chhiong-móa lîn-bín.

Góa bōe hoat-chhut béng-lia̍t ê siū-khì, bōe koh húi-bia̍t Í-hoat-liân. In-ūi góa sī Siōng-tè, m̄-sī sè-kan-lâng, sī tī lín tiong-kan Chì-sèng ê Siōng-tè; góa bōe koh tùi lín hoat siū-khì.
Siōng Chú ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ sai teh háu, I ê chú-bîn ōe kun-tè I. I chi̍t-ē háu, in chiū ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah tùi sai-pêng kóaⁿ--lâi;

in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhek-chiáu ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah tùi Ai-ki̍p pe--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu tùi A-su̍t kóaⁿ--lâi. Góa beh hō͘ in tòa tī ka-kī ê chhù. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Í-hoat-liân ēng pe̍h-chha̍t, Í-sek-lia̍t -ke ēng khúi-chà pau-ûi góa; Iû-tāi mā pōe-poān Siōng-tè, tùi sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè bô tiong-si̍t.
Í-hoat-liân kui-ji̍t teh jip tang-hong, só͘ chòe bô-chhái-kang; sì-kòe lóng sī pe̍h-chha̍t kap kiông-pō. In kap A-su̍t li̍p-iok, sàng kaⁿ-ná-iû hō͘ Ai-ki̍p.
Siōng Chú khòng-kò Iû-tāi, mā beh chiàu Í-sek-lia̍t ê hêng-ûi chek-hoa̍t i, chiàu in ê só͘-chòe kā in pò-èng.
In ê chó͘-sian Ngá-kok tī thai--ni̍h khiú-tiâu hiaⁿ-ko ê kha-āu-tiⁿ; chòng-liân ê sî kap Siōng-tè sio-ián.
I ián-iâⁿ thiⁿ-sài, lâu ba̍k-sái kiû chiok-hok. I tī Pek-te̍k-lī tú-tio̍h Siōng-tè, tī hia kap I kóng-ōe.
Siōng Chú sī Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè; I ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú.
Só͘-í lí tio̍h kui-ǹg lí ê Siōng-tè, chhî-siú chû-ài kong-chèng, put-sî nāi-sim thèng-hāu lí ê Siōng-tè.
Í-sek-lia̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ seng-lí-lâng, ài ēng bô kong-tō ê chhìn khi-phiàn lâng.
I kóng, “Góa chin-chiàⁿ hó-gia̍h, ū chin chōe châi-pó; bô lâng ōe-tàng chí-chek góa thàn--ê sī hoâiⁿ-châi.”
Tùi lí chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî, góa chiū-sī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè; góa beh hō͘ lí koh tòa tī pò͘-pîⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh siú choeh-kî.
Góa bat tùi sian-ti kóng-ōe, hō͘ in khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chin chōe īⁿ-siōng, thong-kè in kóng phì-jū.

Ki-lia̍t ū hoān-chōe, tī hia ê chū-bîn lóng bô lō͘-ēng, in-ūi in tī Kiat-kah hiàn gû-á chòe chè; in ê chè-tôaⁿ ōe pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ hn̂g--ni̍h lôe-kau téng-bīn ê chio̍h-tui.
Chá-chêng Ngá-kok cháu-khì A-lân -tōe, Í-sek-lia̍t ūi-tio̍h beh chhōa-bó͘ kā lâng chòe kang, ūi-tio̍h beh tit-tio̍h bó͘ thòe lâng chhī iûⁿ.
Siōng Chú ēng sian-ti chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p, mā thong-kè sian-ti chiàu-kò͘ in.
M̄-kú in jiá Siōng-tè siū-khì. Chú ōe chiong in lâu lâng ê huih ê chōe kui tī in; in lêng-jio̍k Chú, Chú it-tēng ōe kā in hêng-hoa̍t.
Chá-chêng Í-hoat-liân chi-cho̍k chi̍t-ē kóng-ōe, lâng lóng phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah; i tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong siū chun-tiōng. M̄-kú i pài Pa-le̍k, hoān-chōe tì-kàu sí.

In hoān-chōe, ná hoān ná chōe; in ēng gûn ūi-tio̍h ka-kī chō ngó͘-siōng; sai-hū chiàu in ê siūⁿ-hoat chù-chō. Ngó͘-siōng lóng sī lâng chō--ê. In kóng, “Lán lâi tùi gû-á-siōng hiàn-chè, koh kā in chim.”

Án-ni, in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-khí-sî ê bū, chhin-chhiūⁿ chheng-chá ê lō͘-chúi, chin kín chiū ta--khì; chhin-chhiūⁿ ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ ê chho͘-khng, chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi thang-á chhèng--chhut-lâi ê ian, hong chi̍t-ē chhe chiū siau-sit.
Tùi lí chhut Ai-ki̍p -tōe ê sî, góa chiū-sī Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè; góa í-gōa lí m̄-thang jīn pa̍t-ê chòe Siōng-tè; góa í-gōa bô Kiù-chú.
Tī khòng-iá ta-sò ê tōe, góa chiū bat lí, chiàu-kò͘ lí.
Góa iúⁿ-chhī chiah-ê jîn-bîn, hō͘ in chia̍h-pá; in chi̍t-ē chia̍h-pá chiū chū-ko, soah bōe-kì-tit góa.
Só͘-í, góa beh chhin-chhiūⁿ sai kong-kek in, chhin-chhiūⁿ pà bih tī lō͘-piⁿ tng-tán in.
Góa beh kā in kong-kek: chhin-chhiūⁿ sit-lo̍h kiáⁿ ê hîm-bú thiah-li̍h in ê heng-khám; chhin-chhiūⁿ sai-bú kā in thun-chia̍h; chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-siù kā in thiah-chhùi.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, góa beh kā lí húi-bia̍t; siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng pang-chān lí?
Lí thó beh ài ū ông kap léng-siù lâi kiù lí. Taⁿ ông tī tó-ūi? Hiah-ê siâⁿ ê léng-siù tī tó-ūi?
Góa tī siū-khì tiong thòe lín siat-li̍p ông, mā tī tōa siū-khì tiong kā i hòe-tû.
Í-hoat-liân ê chōe-kò lóng ū kì-lio̍k, i ê chōe-ok lóng ū pó-chûn.
I ōe siū chhui-chūn ê thàng-thiàⁿ; i chhin-chhiūⁿ gōng-kiáⁿ, chhut-sì ê sî í-keng kàu, iáu bih tī chú-kiong kháu m̄ chhut--lâi.

Góa kiám tio̍h kiù in thoat-lī Im-hú ê koân-sè? Góa kiám tio̍h sio̍k-hôe in thoat-lī Sí-bông? Sí-bông ah, lí ê chai-hāi tī tó-ūi? Im-hú ah, lí ê húi-bia̍t tī tó-ūi? Góa it-tēng bô beh lîn-bín in.

Sui-jiân Í-hoat-liân pí pa̍t-ê chi-cho̍k khah hoân-êng, m̄-kú Siōng Chú ōe hō͘ kiông-lia̍t ê tang-hong tùi khòng-iá chhe--lâi. I ê chúi-chôaⁿ ōe ta--khì, chúi-goân ōe tn̄g--khì. I só͘ chek-chū it-chhè ê châi-pó lóng ōe siū chhiúⁿ-toa̍t.
Sat-má-lī-a -lâng tio̍h tam-tng pōe-ge̍k Siōng-tè ê chōe; in ōe tó tī to-ē; in ê eⁿ-á ōe hō͘ lâng siak-sí; ū-sin ê hū-jîn-lâng ê pak-tó͘ mā ōe hō͘ lâng phòa-khui.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lí ê chōe ū hō͘ lí poa̍h-tó, tio̍h oa̍t-thâu kui-ǹg Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè;

Tio̍h tò-tńg-lâi kui Siōng Chú, kā beh kóng ê ōe chún-pī hó-sè; tio̍h tùi I kóng, “Kiû lí sià-bián goán lóng-chóng ê chōe, ēng un-tián chiap-la̍p goán, goán chiū ēng chheng-chàn tāi-thòe seng-lé.

A-su̍t bōe-tàng kiù goán; goán bô beh koh khiâ-bé chhut-chiàn, bô beh koh tùi goán chō ê ngó͘-siōng kóng, ‘Lí sī goán ê Siōng-tè.’ In-ūi goán chiah-ê chòe ko͘-jî--ê chí-ū ōe-tàng tùi lí tit-tio̍h lîn-bín.”
Siōng Chú kóng: Góa beh i-hó Í-sek-lia̍t ê pōe-poān, chīn-chêng thiàⁿ in, in-ūi góa í-keng tùi in soah góa ê siū-khì.
Góa beh chhin-chhiūⁿ kam-lō͘ kàng-lo̍h hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t, in chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ pek-ha̍p-hoe khui-hoe, chhin-chhiūⁿ Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū tèng-kun.
In ê ki chhun-tn̂g, ōe bō͘-sēng chhin-chhiūⁿ kaⁿ-ná-chhiū; in ê phang-bī chhin-chhiūⁿ Lê-pa-lūn ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū.
In ōe tò-tńg-lâi tiàm tī góa ê ìm-ńg-ē, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ ngó͘-kok seng-tióng, phû-tô-chhiū khui-hoe; in ê hó miâ-siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ Lê-pa-lūn ê chiú.

Í-sek-lia̍t ah, góa kap ngó͘-siōng ū sím-mi̍h koan-hē? Góa beh ìn-tap lín, khòaⁿ-kò͘ lín, beh chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiⁿ-chhùi ê siông-chhiū tì-ìm lín. Góa sī it-chhè hok-khì ê goân-thâu.

Ū tì-hūi ê lâng ōe bêng-pe̍k chiah-ê sū. Bêng-lí ê lâng ōe liáu-kái chiah-ê it-chhè. Siōng Chú ê tō-lō͘ chèng-ti̍t; gī-lâng it-tēng ōe kiâⁿ chiah-ê lō͘, m̄-kú pōe-ge̍k ê lâng ōe tī chiah-ê lō͘ poa̍h-tó.
Ē-bīn sī Siōng Chú tùi Pí-thó͘-ní ê kiáⁿ Iok-ní kóng ê ōe:
Lāu-lâng ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ! Chit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn ah, lóng tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Tī lín ê ji̍t, á-sī lín lia̍t-chó͘ ê ji̍t, kiám bat hoat-seng chit-khoán tāi-chì?
Tio̍h chiong chit-ê tāi-chì thoân hō͘ lín ê kiáⁿ-jî, kiáⁿ-jî thoân hō͘ sun, sun thoân hō͘ hō͘-tāi.
Tōa-chiah chháu-meh chia̍h chhun--ê, chháu-meh lâi chia̍h; chháu-meh chia̍h chhun--ê, chháu-meh-á-kiáⁿ lâi chia̍h; chháu-meh-á-kiáⁿ chia̍h chhun--ê, chháu-meh-kong lâi chia̍h.
Chiú-chùi ê lâng ah, tio̍h chhíⁿ, tio̍h khàu; hò͘ⁿ-chiú ê lâng ah, tio̍h ūi-tio̍h sin-chiú ai-khàu; in-ūi lín bô koh ū chiú thang lim lah.
Ū chi̍t kûn chháu-meh lâi chhim-hoān góa ê tōe, kiông-béng, sò͘-bo̍k sǹg bōe liáu; in ê khí chhin-chhiūⁿ sai-kang ê khí, in ê gê chhin-chhiūⁿ sai-bú ê gê;
in húi-hoāi góa ê phû-tô-chhiū, kā góa ê bû-hoa-kó-chhiū ê chhiū-phê pak kah kng-liu-liu, pàng-teh hō͘ sí.
Lí tio̍h ai-khàu, chhin-chhiūⁿ siàu-lú io hâ môa-pò͘, ūi-tio̍h i tī siàu-liân ê sî sit-khì bī-hun-hu ai-khàu.
Siōng Chú ê tiān bô sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè thang hiàn; ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú ê chè-si mā ai-khàu.
Chhân-hn̂g hong-hòe, tōe pi-ai; in-ūi ngó͘-kok húi-hoāi, sin-chiú ta--khì, iû khiàm-kheh.
Choh-sit-lâng ah, tio̍h kiàn-siàu; chai-chèng phû-tô ê lâng ah, tio̍h ai-khàu, in-ūi tōa-be̍h sió-be̍h kap chhân-hn̂g ê siu-sêng lóng bô--khì.

Phû-tô-chhiū ta--khì, bû-hoa-kó-chhiū ko͘-tâ, sia̍h-liû-chhiū, iâ-chó-chhiū, phōng-kó-chhiū, liân chhân-iá it-chhè ê chhiū-ba̍k lóng ko͘-tâ; jîn-kan ê khoài-lo̍k mā lóng siau-sit.

Chè-si ah, tio̍h hâ môa-pò͘ thî-khàu; tī chè-tôaⁿ ho̍k-sāi ê lâng ah, tio̍h ai-khàu; chòe góa ê Siōng-tè chhe-ēng ê lâng ah, tio̍h lâi, chhēng môa-saⁿ kè-mî; in-ūi bô lâng the̍h sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè lâi lín ê Siōng-tè ê tiān hōng-hiàn.

Lín tio̍h siat chi̍t ê sèng-ji̍t lâi kìm-chia̍h, tiàu-chi̍p giâm-siok-hōe, chio-chi̍p sī-tōa, kap kok-lāi só͘-ū ê chū-bîn lâi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê tiān, tùi Siōng Chú ai-kiû.
Hit-ji̍t lín chhám ah! In-ūi Siōng Chú ê ji̍t kūn lah, Choân-lêng-chiá beh lâi húi-bia̍t lah.
Niû-si̍t tī lán ê ba̍k-chiu chêng toān-choa̍t lah! Hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k tī lán Siōng-tè ê tiān siau-sit lah!
Chéng-chí tī thô͘--ni̍h nōa--khì; chhng-khò͘ hong-hòe, chhek-chhng tó-hoāi, in-ūi bô ngó͘-kok thang siu-sêng.
Cheng-siⁿ háu kah chin chhiⁿ-chhám, gû-kûn loān-loān-chông, in-ūi bô chháu; iûⁿ-kûn mā siū-khó͘.
Siōng Chú ah, góa kiû-kiò lí, in-ūi hé sio-bia̍t khòng-iá ê chháu-po͘, hé-iām sio-chīn chhân-iá ê chhiū-ba̍k.
Chhân-iá ê cháu-siù mā tùi lí ai-kiò, in-ūi khoe-chúi ta--khì, hé sio-bia̍t khòng-iá ê chháu-po͘.
Lín tio̍h tī Sek-an pûn sàu-kak, tī góa ê sèng-soaⁿ hoat kéng-pò; kok-lāi ê chū-bîn lóng ōe ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah, in-ūi Siōng Chú ê ji̍t teh-beh kàu, í-keng kūn lah.

Hit-ji̍t o͘-thiⁿ-àm-tōe; hit-ji̍t o͘-hûn-bi̍t-pò͘; ū chi̍t tūi tōa koh kiông ê chháu-meh pek-óa, chhin-chhiūⁿ o͘-àm tà-móa soaⁿ-niá. Chit-khoán chêng-kéng kàu taⁿ m̄-bat ū, í-āu tāi-tāi mā bōe koh ū.

In thâu-chêng ū lia̍t-hé teh thun-bia̍t, āu-bīn ū hé-iām teh to̍h. In iáu-bē kàu, tōe chhin-chhiūⁿ I-tiân-hn̂g; in kè-liáu, tōe chiâⁿ-chòe pha-hng ê khòng-iá, bô-pòaⁿ-hāng ōe-tàng tô-siám.
In ê hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ bé, phun-cháu chhin-chhiūⁿ chiàn-bé.

In tī chèng-soaⁿ téng-bīn teh thiàu, siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chiàn-chhia lōng-lōng-hiáng, chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-iām sio ta-chháu pi̍t-pia̍k-kiò; in chhin-chhiūⁿ kiông-béng ê kun-tūi pâi-tīn beh chhut-chiàn.
Só͘-ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h in ê lâng lóng phòa-táⁿ, bīn chhiⁿ-sún-sún.
In chhin-chhiūⁿ ióng-sū phun-cháu, chhin-chhiūⁿ chiàn-sū peh-chiūⁿ siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ; in ōe-hiáu chiàu ka-kī ê lō͘-sòaⁿ chìn-kong, bōe phah-loān tūi-ngó͘.
In bōe khoeh-lâi-khoeh-khì, ta̍k-ê chiàu lō͘-sòaⁿ chìn-kong; in chhiong-kè hông-ōe-sòaⁿ, iáu pó-chhî tūi-hêng.
In chhiong-ji̍p siâⁿ, tī siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng chông-lâi-chông-khì, peh-chiūⁿ chhù-téng; chhin-chhiūⁿ chha̍t tùi thang-á ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi.
In chi̍t-ē chhut-hiān, tōe tín-tāng, thiⁿ iô-choah, ji̍t-goa̍t-bû-kong, chhiⁿ-sîn àm-tām.

Siōng Chú tī I ê kun-tūi thâu-chêng hoat hō-lēng, I ê kun-peng sǹg bōe liáu; chip-hêng I bēng-lēng--ê chin kiông-béng. Siōng Chú ê ji̍t tōa koh thang kiaⁿ, siáⁿ-lâng jím-siū ōe tiâu?
Siōng Chú kóng: Hiān-chāi iáu-bē bān, lín tio̍h ēng kìm-chia̍h, thî-khàu, ai-siong, oa̍t tò-tńg choân-sim kui-ǹg góa.

Tio̍h thiah-li̍h lín ê sim, m̄-sī thiah-li̍h lín ê saⁿ; tio̍h kui-ǹg Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, in-ūi I ū un-hūi lîn-bín, bōe khoài siū-khì, ū hong-sēng ê chû-ài, ōe kái-piàn sim-ì, bōe kàng chai-hō.
Bô-tiāⁿ-tio̍h Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ōe kái-piàn sim-ì, lâu hok-khì hō͘ lín, án-ni lín chiū thang hiàn sò͘-chè kap tiān-chiú-chè hō͘ I.
Lín tio̍h tī Sek-an pûn sàu-kak, siat chi̍t ê sèng-ji̍t lâi kìm-chia̍h, tiàu-chi̍p giâm-siok-hōe,
chū-chi̍p bîn-chiòng, sèng-hòa hōe-chiòng; chio-chi̍p sī-tōa, chū-chi̍p gín-á kap chia̍h-lin ê eⁿ-á; sin-lông tio̍h lī-khui i ê chhù, sin-niû lī-khui i ê pâng.

Ho̍k-sāi Siōng Chú ê chè-si tio̍h tī cháu-lông kap chè-tôaⁿ ê tiong-kan thî-khàu. In tio̍h kóng, “Siōng Chú, kiû lí khoan-sià lí ê chú-bîn; m̄-thang hō͘ lí ê chú-bîn siū lêng-jio̍k, siū lia̍t-kok thí-chhiò. Ná tio̍h hō͘ bān-bîn kóng ‘In ê Siōng-tè tī tó-ūi’?”
Hit-sî Siōng Chú ōe chhim-chhim thiàⁿ-sioh I ê thó͘-tōe, koh lîn-bín I ê chú-bîn.
Siōng Chú ìn I ê chú-bîn, kóng, “Góa beh sù lín ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, kap sin-iû, hō͘ lín sim-móa-ì-chiok; góa bōe koh hō͘ lín siū lia̍t-kok lêng-jio̍k.

Góa beh hō͘ pak-hng lâi ê kun-tūi lī-khui lín hn̄g-hn̄g, kā in kóaⁿ-khì khòng-hān pha-hng ê tōe: Chêng-tūi kóaⁿ-ji̍p tang-pêng ê Sí-hái, āu-tūi kóaⁿ-ji̍p sai-pêng ê Tōe-tiong-hái; in si-thé ê pháiⁿ-bī chhèng-koân, chhàu-bī chhiong-thian. Khak-si̍t, Siōng Chú ū oân-sêng chiah-ê tōa tāi-chì!”
Thó͘-tōe ah, m̄-bián kiaⁿ, tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k. Siōng Chú khak-si̍t ū chòe tōa tāi-chì!
Chhân-iá ê cháu-siù ah, m̄-bián kiaⁿ, in-ūi khòng-iá ê chháu-po͘ pìⁿ chhiⁿ-chhùi, chhiū-ba̍k kiat ké-chí; bû-hoa-kó-chhiū, phû-tô-chhiū lóng kiat chin chōe ké-chí.

Sek-an ê chú-bîn ah, lín tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí, tio̍h in-ūi Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè khoài-lo̍k. I chiàu-sî lo̍h chhiu-thiⁿ ê hō͘ hō͘ lín; kap í-chêng kâng-khoán, koh kā lín lo̍h chhun-lîm chhiu-ú.
Ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ ū móa-móa ê ngó͘-kok, chiú-khut ū sin-chiú, iû-khut ū sin-iû móa--chhut-lâi.

Góa phài-lâi lín chia chi̍t-kûn koh chi̍t-kûn ê chháu-meh tāi-kun, chháu-meh, chháu-meh-á-kiáⁿ, chháu-meh-kong, kap tōa-chiah chháu-meh, kúi-nā nî kā lín chia̍h--khì ê lông-chok-bu̍t, góa lóng beh pó͘-sióng lín.

Lín ū chin chōe thang chia̍h, chia̍h kàu pá, koh ōe chheng-chàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê miâ; in-ūi I ūi-tio̍h lín chòe kî-biāu ê sū. Góa ê chú-bîn éng-oán bōe koh sit-pāi kiàn-siàu.
Lín chiū ōe chai góa tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tiong-kan, koh chai chí-ū góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê; góa ê chú-bîn éng-oán bōe koh sit-pāi kiàn-siàu.

Í-āu, góa beh chiong góa ê sîn piàⁿ lo̍h-khì hō͘ só͘-ū ê lâng; lín ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ōe kóng ū-giân, lín ê lāu-lâng ōe choh-bāng, siàu-liân-lâng ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ īⁿ-siōng.
Tī hiah-ê ji̍t, góa sīm-chì beh chiong góa ê sîn piàⁿ lo̍h-khì hō͘ po̍k-jîn kap lú-pī.
Góa beh tī thiⁿ-téng hián-chhut kî-sū, tī tōe-chiūⁿ ū huih, ū hé, kap hé-hun ê thiāu.
Tī Siōng Chú tōa koh thang-kiaⁿ ê ji̍t lâi-lîm í-chêng, ji̍t-thâu ōe pìⁿ-chòe o͘-àm, ge̍h pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ huih hiah-ni̍h âng.

Hit-sî, kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê miâ ê lâng lóng ōe tit-tio̍h kiù. Chiàu Siōng Chú ê èng-ún, tī Sek-an-soaⁿ kap tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ū tô-thoat ê lâng; tī chiah-ê chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê chú-bîn tiong-kan ū Siōng Chú soán-tiàu ê lâng.
Lín khòaⁿ, tī hiah-ê ji̍t, sî chi̍t-ē kàu, góa beh hôe-ho̍k Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê hoân-êng,

góa beh chū-chi̍p bān-kok, chhōa in lo̍h-khì Iok-sa-hoat Soaⁿ-kok, tī hia kā in sím-phòaⁿ, in-ūi in chiong góa ê chú-bîn, chiū-sī góa ê sán-gia̍p Í-sek-lia̍t, hun-sòaⁿ khì lia̍t-kok, koh pun góa ê thó͘-tōe.
In thiu-chhiam pun góa ê chú-bîn, ēng ta-po͘ gín-á ōaⁿ ki-lú, bōe cha-bó͘ gín-á bóe chiú lim.
Thài-ní, Se-tùn, Hui-lī-sū só͘-ū tōe-khu ê lâng ah, lín beh kā góa án-chóaⁿ? Beh kā góa pò-ho̍k sī--bô? Lín nā kā góa pò-ho̍k, góa chiū beh sûi-sî kā lín pò-èng.
Lín chhiúⁿ góa ê kim-gûn, toa̍t góa kùi-tiōng ê châi-pó, kng ji̍p-khì lín ê sîn-biō,
koh kā Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng bōe hō͘ Hi-la̍h -lâng, hō͘ in oán-lī hiong-thó͘.
Góa beh chhui-pek in tùi lín kā in bōe--khì ê só͘-chāi tò-tńg--lâi. Góa beh chiàu lín ê só͘-chòe kā lín pò-èng.
Góa beh chiong lín ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ bōe hō͘ Iû-tāi -lâng; Iû-tāi -lâng ōe kā in choán-bōe hō͘ hn̄g-hn̄g ê Sī-pa -lâng. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Tio̍h tùi bān-kok soan-pò͘: Chún-pī khai-chiàn! Hoàn-khí ióng-sū ê tò͘-chì, tiàu-chi̍p choân-thé chiàn-sū chham-chiàn.
Tio̍h chiong lín ê lôe-thâu phah-chòe to-kiàm, chiong lín ê liâm-to phah-chòe chhiuⁿ. Loán-jio̍k--ê tio̍h kóng, “Góa chin ióng!”
Sì-ûi ê lia̍t-kok ah, kóaⁿ-kín chi̍p-ha̍p. Siōng Chú ah, phài lí ê ióng-sū lo̍h--lâi.
Tio̍h hoàn-khí bān-kok ê lâng lóng chiūⁿ-lâi Iok-sa-hoat Soaⁿ-kok; tī hia góa beh chē-teh sím-phòaⁿ sì-ûi ê lia̍t-kok.
Tio̍h gia̍h liâm-le̍k-á koah, siu-koah ê sî kàu lah. Lâi, ta̍h--lo̍h-khì, in-ūi chiú-khut móa lah, chiú-tî ek--chhut-lâi lah, in ê chōe-ok koàn-boán.
Ū chheng-chheng-bān-bān ê lâng tī soan-phòaⁿ ê soaⁿ-kok, in-ūi Siōng Chú ê ji̍t beh lîm-kàu sím-phòaⁿ-kok.
Ji̍t-goa̍t-bû-kong, chhiⁿ-sîn àm-tām.

Siōng Chú tī Sek-an hoat-chhut chhin-chhiūⁿ sai teh háu ê siaⁿ, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hoat-chhut chhin-chhiūⁿ lûi teh tân ê siaⁿ, thiⁿ tōe chiū tōa tín-tāng; m̄-kú Siōng Chú beh chòe I chú-bîn ê pī-lān-só͘, chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê pó-lúi.

Hit-sî, lín chiū ōe chai góa sī Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè, khiā-khí tī Sek-an góa ê sèng-soaⁿ. Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe chiâⁿ-chòe Sèng-siâⁿ, bōe koh hō͘ gōa-cho̍k-lâng chhim-hoān.
Tī hit-ji̍t, tōa-soaⁿ ōe tih sin-chiú, sió-soaⁿ ōe lâu lin, Iû-tāi ê khoe lóng ū chúi teh lâu; ū chúi-chôaⁿ ōe tùi Siōng Chú ê tiān lâu--chhut-lâi, lūn-te̍k Si̍p-têng -kok.
Ai-ki̍p ōe pha-hng, Í-tong ōe pìⁿ-chòe hong-hòe ê khòng-iá, in-ūi in ge̍k-thāi Iû-tāi -lâng, tī in ê tōe lâu bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih.
Chóng-sī Iû-tāi ōe éng-oán ū lâng khiā-khí, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe chûn-sio̍k kàu bān-tāi.
Chá-chêng góa m̄-bat sóe-chheng in thâi-lâng lâu-huih ê chōe, hiān-chāi beh kā in sóe-chheng. Siōng Chú éng-oán tī Sek-an khiā-khí!

Ē-bīn sī Thê-ko-a chi̍t ê kò͘-iûⁿ-lâng A-mô͘-sū ê ōe. O͘-se-a chòe Iû-tāi -ông, Iok-hôa-si ê kiáⁿ Iâ-lô-pho-an Jī-sè chòe Í-sek-lia̍t -ông ê nî-kan, chiū-sī tōa tōe-tāng chêng nn̄g nî, Siōng-tè kā A-mô͘-sū khé-sī iú-koan Í-sek-lia̍t ê sū.

A-mô͘-sū kóng: “Siōng Chú tùi Sek-an chhin-chhiūⁿ sai teh háu, tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chhin-chhiūⁿ lûi teh tân; kò͘-iûⁿ-lâng ê chháu-po͘ ta--khì, Ka-bi̍t ê soaⁿ-téng lóng ko͘-tâ.”

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ Tāi-má-sū-kek -lâng chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn hoān-chōe, góa it-tēng beh hêng-hoa̍t in; in-ūi in ge̍k-thāi Ki-lia̍t -lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng thih-khí-pang géng ngó͘-kok.
Só͘-í, góa beh pàng-hé sio Hap-sih ê ông-kiong, sio-húi Piān Hap-ta̍t ê kiong-tiān.

Góa beh lòng-tn̄g Tāi-má-sū-kek -siâⁿ ê mn̂g-chhòaⁿ, beh siau-bia̍t A-bûn pêng-goân ê chū-bîn, í-ki̍p Pek I-tiân ê thóng-tī-chiá, chiong Sū-lī-a -lâng lia̍h-khì Kiat-ní.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ Ka-sat -lâng chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn hoān-chōe, góa it-tēng beh hêng-hoa̍t in; in-ūi in lia̍h só͘-ū ê chū-bîn, bōe hō͘ Í-tong -lâng chòe lô͘-châi.
Só͘-í, góa beh pàng-hé sio Ka-sat ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, sio-húi i ê kiong-tiān.

Góa beh siau-bia̍t A-si̍t-tu̍t ê chū-bîn, í-ki̍p A-si̍t-ki-lûn ê thóng-tī-chiá; góa beh chhun-chhiú kong-kek Í-kek-lûn, ti̍t-kàu só͘ chhun ê Hui-lī-sū -lâng lóng bia̍t-bông.” Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ Thài-ní -lâng chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn hoān-chōe, góa it-tēng beh hêng-hoa̍t in; in-ūi in lia̍h kui-cho̍k ê chū-bîn, bōe hō͘ Í-tong -lâng chòe lô͘-châi, bô chun-siú kap iú-pang só͘ tēng ê bêng-iok.
Só͘-í, góa beh pàng-hé sio Thài-ní ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, sio-húi i ê kiong-tiān.”

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ Í-tong -lâng chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn hoān-chōe, góa it-tēng beh hêng-hoa̍t in; in-ūi in ēng to-kiàm tui-sat ka-kī ê hiaⁿ-tī, chi̍t-tiám-á to bô lîn-bín ê sim, in hoat sèng-tē bô-thêng, khí siū-khì bô-soah.
Só͘-í, góa beh pàng-hé sio Thê-bān, sio-húi Pho-su-la ê kiong-tiān.”

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ A-bûn -lâng chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn hoān-chōe, góa it-tēng beh hêng-hoa̍t in; ūi-tio̍h beh khok-tián in ê léng-thó͘, in phòa-khui Ki-lia̍t ū-sin ê hū-jîn-lâng.
Só͘-í, tī chiàn-cheng háng-hoah ê ji̍t, tī kông-hong-tāi-chok ê sî, góa beh pàng-hé sio La-pa ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ, sio-húi i ê kiong-tiān;
In ê ông ōe siū hòng-tio̍k, ông kap i ê koaⁿ-oân chòe-hé siū-lia̍h.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ Mô͘-ap -lâng chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn hoān-chōe, góa it-tēng beh hêng-hoa̍t in; in-ūi in chiong Í-tong -ông ê kut-thâu sio kah pìⁿ hé-hu.
Góa beh pàng-hé sio Mô͘-ap, sio-húi Ka-lio̍k ê kiong-tiān; Mô͘-ap ōe tī hōa-hōa-háu hoah-hiàm pûn sàu-kak ê tiong-kan sí-bông.
Góa ōe chiong Mô͘-ap ê thóng-tī-chiá chhú-sí, thâi-sí ông kap i só͘-ū ê koaⁿ-oân.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ Iû-tāi -lâng chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn hoān-chōe, góa it-tēng beh hêng-hoa̍t in; in-ūi in kū-choa̍t Siōng Chú ê lu̍t-hoat, bô siú I ê kui-lē; in tè in ê chó͘-sian pài ké-sîn, siū ín-iú kiâⁿ bê-lō͘.
Só͘-í góa beh pàng-hé sio Iû-tāi, sio-húi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê kiong-tiān.”

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn hoān-chōe, góa it-tēng beh hêng-hoa̍t in; in-ūi in ūi-tio̍h gûn chhut-bōe gī-lâng, ūi-tio̍h chi̍t siang ôe bōe sàn-chhiah-lâng.

In thún-ta̍h sàn-chhiah-lâng ê thâu-khak, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh ta̍h thô͘-hún; in pak-toa̍t khùn-khó͘-lâng ê koân-lī; lāu-pē kap kiáⁿ kong-ke chi̍t ê siàu-lú, tì-kàu siat-to̍k góa ê sèng-miâ.
In tī ta̍k-ê chè-tôaⁿ piⁿ, ēng sàn-chhiah-lâng the̍h-lâi tí-ah ê gōa-saⁿ chòe chhn̂g-kun; tī in ê Siōng-tè ê tiān, lim pak-siah tit--tio̍h ê chîⁿ bóe ê chiú.

Góa bat tī in bīn-chêng tû-bia̍t A-mô͘-lī -lâng; hiah-ê lâng koân-tōa chhin-chhiūⁿ pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū, ióng-chòng chhin-chhiūⁿ siōng-chhiū; chóng-sī góa húi-tiāu in téng-bīn ê ké-chí, chām-tn̄g in ē-bīn ê kun.
Góa mā ū tòa lín tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhut--lâi, sì-cha̍p nî kú chhōa lín keng-kè khòng-iá, hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h A-mô͘-lī -lâng ê tōe chòe sán-gia̍p.

Góa tùi lín ê kiáⁿ-sun tiong-kan kéng-soán sian-ti, koh tùi lín ê siàu-liân-lâng tiong-kan soán-li̍p Ná-sè-ní-lâng. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, kiám m̄-sī án-ni?” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
“M̄-kú lín hō͘ Ná-sè-ní-lâng lim-chiú, kìm-chí sian-ti thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè ê ōe.
Só͘-í, góa beh kā lín chhi̍h tī thô͘-kha, chhin-chhiūⁿ chài-móa be̍h-khún ê chhia kā lín teh kah bōe tín-tāng.
Tô-miā--ê cháu bōe lī, ióng-chòng--ê sit-khì khùi-la̍t, ióng-sū mā bōe-tàng kiù ka-kī;
siā-chìⁿ--ê khiā bōe chāi, kha kín--ê cháu bōe hù, khiâ-bé--ê mā bōe-tàng kiù ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.
Tī hit-ji̍t, liân siōng ióng-kám ê chiàn-sū mā ōe pàng-sak bú-khì tô-cháu.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ góa Siōng Chú chek-pī lín ê ōe: Lín choân-ke sī góa tùi Ai-ki̍p -tōe chhōa--chhut-lâi--ê;
tī tōe-chiūⁿ bān-cho̍k tiong góa chí-ū kéng lín, só͘-í góa beh in-ūi lín só͘ hoān it-chhè ê chōe hêng-hoa̍t lín.
Nn̄g ê lâng nā bô sio-iok, ná ōe tàu-tīn kiâⁿ?
Sai nā bô la̍h-bu̍t, kiám ōe tī chhiū-nâ lāi háu? Sai-á-thûn nā bô tit-tio̍h chia̍h-mi̍h, kiám ōe tī tōng-lāi chhut-siaⁿ?
Oa̍h-tauh nā bô khǹg jī, ná ōe tng-tio̍h chiáu-á? Nā bô ta̍h-tio̍h ki-koan, oa̍h-tauh ná ōe ha̍p--khí-lâi?
Siâⁿ-lāi nā ū sàu-kak ê siaⁿ, chū-bîn kiám bōe kiaⁿ? Siâⁿ-lāi nā ū chai-hō, kiám m̄-sī Siōng Chú só͘ kàng?
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kè-ōe beh chòe tāi-chì, it-tēng ōe tāi-seng chí-sī I ê po̍k-jîn sian-ti.
Sai teh háu, siáⁿ-lâng bōe kiaⁿ? Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng-ōe, siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ bô thoân-ta̍t?
Tio̍h tī A-si̍t-tu̍t ê kiong-tiān kap Ai-ki̍p ê kiong-tiān soan-pò͘: Tio̍h tī Sat-má-lī-a ê soaⁿ chū-chi̍p, khòaⁿ siâⁿ-lāi ê tōa jiáu-loān kap lāi-bīn khi-ap jîn-bîn ê sū.
In-ūi in bōe-hiáu chòe chèng-ti̍t ê tāi-chì; in ê kiong-tiān tún-móa ēng kiông-pō chhiúⁿ--lâi ê mi̍h. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Só͘-í Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Ū tùi-te̍k beh lâi ûi-khùn chit-ê tōe, kong-phòa lí ê hông-ōe-sòaⁿ, chhiúⁿ lí ê kiong-tiān.

Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Chhin-chhiūⁿ bo̍k-chiá tùi sai ê chhùi chhiúⁿ--chhut-lâi--ê, kan-ta nn̄g ki iûⁿ-kha, á-sī chi̍t-tè-á hī-á, tī Sat-má-lī-a kè chhia-chhí seng-oa̍h ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, ōe-tàng tô-thoat--ê mā-sī hiah-ni̍h chió.
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè kóng: Tio̍h thiaⁿ, tio̍h kéng-kò Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi.
Góa in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hoān-chōe kā in hêng-hoa̍t hit-ji̍t, góa beh húi-hoāi Pek-te̍k-lī ê chè-tôaⁿ; tôaⁿ ê kak ōe siū chám-tn̄g, lak-lo̍h tōe.
Góa beh thiah-húi in tang-thiⁿ joa̍h-thiⁿ ê pia̍t-chong; chhiūⁿ-gê chng-thāⁿ ê chhù ōe siū húi-bia̍t, liân tōa keng chhù to ōe bô--khì. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Tòa tī Sat-má-lī-a-soaⁿ Pa-san ê gû-bú, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ. Lín khi-hū sàn-chhiah-lâng, ap-chè kan-khó͘-lâng, tùi lín tiōng-hu kóng, “Chiú phâng--lâi, lán lâi lim.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kí ka-kī ê sèng-miâ li̍p-sè, kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, lâng beh ēng kau-á kā lín kau--khì, ēng tiò-hî-kau kā só͘ chhun--ê thoa--khì.
Lín ta̍k-ê lâng ōe hō͘ lâng thoa-khì siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê phòa-khiah, tùi hia tàn--chhut-khì.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Chòe lín khì Pek-te̍k-lī hoān-chōe, chhut-chāi lín khì Kiat-kah ke-thiⁿ lín ê chōe; ta̍k chá-khí hiàn lín ê chè-mi̍h, múi saⁿ ji̍t hiàn lín só͘ tit--tio̍h ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t;
koh hiàn ū-kàⁿ ê piáⁿ chòe siā-un-chè, tōa-siaⁿ tián lín kam-sim hiàn ê chè. Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, che kiám m̄-sī lín kah-ì chòe--ê? Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Góa hō͘ lín tī ta̍k-ê siâⁿ chhùi-khí bô mi̍h thang pō͘, tī lín khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi lóng bô mi̍h thang chia̍h; lín iáu-kú m̄ kui-ǹg góa. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Siu-koah chêng saⁿ ge̍h-ji̍t kú, góa bô lo̍h-hō͘ hō͘ lín; góa hō͘ chit-chng ū hō͘, hit-chng bô hō͘; góa hō͘ chit-khu hn̂g ū hō͘, hit-khu hn̂g bô hō͘ soah ta--khì.

Án-ni, nn̄g saⁿ ê chng-siā ê lâng phiân-lâi-phiân-khì, phiân kàu lēng-gōa chi̍t ê chng-siā chhē chúi lim, mā bōe chí chhùi-ta; lín iáu-kú m̄ kui-ǹg góa. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Góa ēng hé-sio-hong, ēng pīⁿ-hāi kong-kek lín, phò-hoāi lín ê chhân-hn̂g kap phû-tô-hn̂g; bû-hoa-kó-chhiū kap kaⁿ-ná-chhiū mā hō͘ tōa-chiah chháu-meh chia̍h-liáu-liáu; lín iáu-kú m̄ kui-ǹg góa. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Góa kàng un-e̍k tī lín tiong-kan, chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-chêng kàng tī Ai-ki̍p; góa tī chiàn-tiûⁿ thâi-sí lín ê siàu-liân-lâng, koh lín ê chiàn-bé mā hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì; iâⁿ-lāi si-thé ê chhàu-bī chhèng kàu lín ê phīⁿ-khang; lín iáu-kú m̄ kui-ǹg góa. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Góa húi-bia̍t lín, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng húi-bia̍t Só͘-to-má Gô-mô͘-la; lín chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi hé-tiong khiú--chhut-lâi ê chi̍t tè chhâ; lín iáu-kú m̄ kui-ǹg góa. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Í-sek-lia̍t ah, góa beh án-ni tùi-thāi lín. Í-sek-lia̍t ah, kì-jiân góa beh án-ni chòe, lín tio̍h chún-pī hó-sè lâi kìⁿ lín ê Siōng-tè.

Khòaⁿ leh, chō-soaⁿ chō-hong, chiong I ê sim-ì chí-sī lâng, hō͘ o͘-àm pìⁿ-chòe kng-bêng, kha ta̍h tī tōe koân ê só͘-chāi Hit-ūi, I ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ, góa beh tùi lín chhiùⁿ chi̍t siú ai-ko:
Siàu-lú Í-sek-lia̍t poa̍h-tó, bōe koh khí--lâi; i tī ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe hō͘ lâng pàng-sak, bô lâng kā i hû--khí-lâi.
In-ūi Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: Í-sek-lia̍t ê siâⁿ, chi̍t-chheng ê chhut-cheng, chhun chi̍t-pah ê tńg--lâi, chi̍t-pah ê chhut-cheng, chhun cha̍p ê tńg--lâi.
Siōng Chú tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kóng: Tio̍h chhē-kiû góa, lín chiū ōe oa̍h.
M̄-thang khì Pek-te̍k-lī chhē, m̄-thang ji̍p-khì Kiat-kah, mā m̄-thang kè-khì Pia̍t-sī-pa; in-ūi Kiat-kah ê lâng it-tēng ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì, Pek-te̍k-lī ōe bia̍t-bông.
Tio̍h chhē-kiû Siōng Chú, lín chiū ōe oa̍h; nā bô, I ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ iām-hé thun-bia̍t Iok-sek ê ke, sio-chīn Pek-te̍k-lī, bô lâng ōe-tàng kā i phah-hoa.
Lín chhám ah, lín oai-khiok chèng-ti̍t, thún-ta̍h kong-gī.

Lín tio̍h chhē hit-ūi Chhòng-chō-chú; I chhòng-chō Báu-chhiⁿ kap Chham-chhiⁿ, hō͘ o͘-àm pìⁿ-chòe lê-bêng, hō͘ ji̍t--sî pìⁿ-chòe àm-mî, bēng-lēng hái-chúi piàⁿ tī tōe-bīn. I ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú.
I hō͘ pó-lúi hut-jiân húi-hoāi, hō͘ iàu-sài pìⁿ-chòe thô͘-tui.
Lín oàn-hūn tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu chú-chhî kong-tō ê lâng, iàm-ò͘ⁿ kóng chin-si̍t-ōe ê lâng;

lín thún-ta̍h sàn-chhiah-lâng, pak-siah in só͘ siu-sêng--ê, só͘-í lín ēng phah--kè ê chio̍h-thâu khí ê súi-chhù tòa bōe tio̍h, hó ê phû-tô-hn̂g chhut-sán ê chiú mā lim bōe tio̍h.
Góa chai lín ê chōe-kò jōa-á-ni̍h tōa, lín ê chōe sǹg bōe liáu; lín ap-chè gī-lâng, siu hóe-lō͘, tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu oan-óng sàn-chhiah-lâng.
Tī chit-khoán siâ-ok ê sî-sè, khiáu-lâng lóng tiām-tiām m̄ kóng-ōe.
Tio̍h tui-kiû hó, m̄-thang tui-kiû pháiⁿ, lín chiah ōe oa̍h; án-ni, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè ōe chiàu lín só͘ kóng--ê kap lín tông-chāi.
Tio̍h oàn-hūn pháiⁿ, ì-ài hó; tī siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu chú-chhî kong-tō; án-ni, kiám-chhái Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè ōe si-un hō͘ Iok-sek -ke chhun ê kiáⁿ-sun.

Só͘-í, Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Tī só͘-ū ê kóng-tiûⁿ ū ai-khàu, tī ta̍k-tiâu koe-lō͘ ū lâng kóng, “Chhám ah, chhám ah!” In ōe kiò choh-sit-lâng lâi thî-khàu, chhiàⁿ gâu chhiùⁿ ai-ko--ê lâi ai-khàu.
Tī só͘-ū ê phû-tô-hn̂g ōe ū ai-khàu, in-ūi góa beh lâi kā lín hêng-hoa̍t. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.
Lín ǹg-bāng Siōng Chú ê ji̍t ê lâng, chhám ah! Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ teh ǹg-bāng Siōng Chú ê ji̍t? Hit-ji̍t sī àm, m̄-sī kng.
Hit-ji̍t lâi-lîm ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng siám-pī sai soah tú-tio̍h hîm; ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi, chhiú hōaⁿ piah soah hō͘ chôa kā--tio̍h.
Siōng Chú ê ji̍t sī àm, m̄-sī kng; àm-àm-àm, chi̍t-si-á kng to bô.
Góa iàm-ò͘ⁿ, kū-choa̍t lín ê choeh-kî, mā bô ài lín ê giâm-siok-hōe.
Lín hiàn sio-hòa-chè kap sò͘-chè hō͘ góa, góa m̄ chiap-siū; lín hiàn pûi ê cheng-siⁿ chòe pêng-an-chè, góa mā bô beh chiap-la̍p.
Tio̍h hō͘ lín chhiùⁿ-koa ê siaⁿ lī-khui góa; lín tôaⁿ-khîm ê tiāu, góa bô ài thiaⁿ.
Tio̍h hō͘ kong-pêng chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi tn̂g-lâu, hō͘ kong-gī chhin-chhiūⁿ kang-hô ti̍t-ti̍t lâu.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, lín tī khòng-iá sì-cha̍p nî, kiám ū hiàn seng-lé kap lé-mi̍h hō͘ góa?
Lín kng lín ūi ka-kī chō ê sîn-bêng Sat-kò͘ -ông kap Ka-un chhiⁿ-sîn ê siōng.
Só͘-í góa beh hō͘ lín siū-lia̍h khì pí Tāi-má-sū-kek koh-khah hn̄g ê só͘-chāi. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè án-ni soan-kò.

Lín tòa tī Sek-an bô-khòa-bô-lū, tòa tī Sat-má-lī-a-soaⁿ bô-hoân-bô-ló ê lâng, lín chhám ah! Lín siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī sī Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn só͘ óa-khò, sī bān-kok ū bêng-bōng ê léng-tō-chiá.

Lín tio̍h kè-khì Kah-nî khòaⁿ, koh khì tōa-siâⁿ Hap-má, jiân-āu lo̍h-khì Hui-lī-sū ê Ka-te̍k, khòaⁿ lín nn̄g kok kiám ū pí in khah kiông? Lín ê léng-thó͘ kiám ū pí in ê khah khoah?
Lín siūⁿ-kóng ū kā chai-hō ê ji̍t sak-hn̄g-hn̄g, tian-tò hō͘ kiông-pō ê thóng-tī óa--lâi.
Lín tó tī chhiūⁿ-gê ê bîn-chhn̂g, phēng tī the-í, chia̍h iûⁿ-kûn tiong siōng-hó ê iûⁿ-á, gû-tiâu lāi pûi koh nńg ê gû-á,
siau-iâu chhiùⁿ-koa, chhin-chhiūⁿ Tāi-pi̍t tôaⁿ-khîm choh-si.
Lín lim-chiú chi̍t-óaⁿ sòa chi̍t-óaⁿ, boah siōng-hó ê phang-iû; m̄-kú bô ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t teh-beh húi-bia̍t pi-siong.
Só͘-í lín ōe tāi-seng siū-lia̍h, siau-iâu iàn-lo̍k ōe kiat-sok.

Chì-koân Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè kí ka-kī li̍p-sè kóng: Góa iàm-ò͘ⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiau-ngō͘, thó-ià in ê kiong-tiān; góa beh chiong in ê siâⁿ kap siâⁿ-lāi ê it-chhè kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k.
Chi̍t keng chhù nā iáu chhun cha̍p ê ta-po͘-lâng, in mā lóng ōe sí.

Sí-lâng ê chhin-chiâⁿ lâi thoa sin-si khì sio ê sî, ōe tùi chhù-lāi ê lâng kóng, “Iáu ū lâng kap lí chòe-hé--bô?” I ōe ìn kóng, “Bô!” Koh kóng, “M̄-thang chhut-siaⁿ! M̄-thang thê-khí Siōng Chú ê miâ.”
In-ūi Siōng Chú hoat-chhut bēng-lēng, I ōe kā tōa keng chhù kòng-chhùi, kā sòe keng chhù kòng kah chhùi-kô͘-kô͘.

Bé kiám ōe-tàng tī giâm-chio̍h téng phun-pháu? Lâng kiám ōe hō͘ gû tī hái--ni̍h keng-choh? Lín kèng-jiân hō͘ kong-pêng chiâⁿ-chòe to̍k-chhài, hō͘ kong-gī ê ké-chí chiâⁿ-chòe khó͘-chháu.
Lín chiah-ê cheng-ho̍k Lô Tí-pa ê lâng khoa-iāu kóng, “Goán kiám m̄-sī khò ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t kong-chiàm Ka-lêng?”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t ah, góa beh heng-khí chi̍t kok kong-kek lín; in ōe ap-chè lín, tùi Hap-má ài-kháu kàu A-la-pa ê soaⁿ-kok.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê kéng-siōng: Ông-ka ê lông-chok-bu̍t siu-koah liáu, koh hoat sin-íⁿ ê sî, Siōng-tè chō chi̍t kûn chháu-meh.

Chháu-meh kā kéng-lāi ê lông-chok-bu̍t lóng chia̍h-liáu, góa chiū kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí sià-bián; Í-sek-lia̍t bōe-tàng koh oa̍h--lo̍h-khì lah, in-ūi in bî-sòe loán-jio̍k.”
Siōng Chú in-ūi án-ni kái-piàn sim-ì, chiū kóng, “Chit-ê sū bōe hoat-seng.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê kéng-siōng: Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú bēng-lēng hé lâi chhú-hoa̍t; hé kā chhim-ian sio-ta, koh sio-húi choân-tōe.
Góa chiū kóng, “Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú ah, góa kiû lí, chhiáⁿ thêng-chí! Í-sek-lia̍t bōe-tàng koh oa̍h--lo̍h-khì lah, in-ūi in sī bî-sòe loán-jio̍k.”
Siōng Chú in-ūi án-ni kái-piàn sim-ì. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú chiū kóng, “Chit-ê sū mā bōe hoat-seng.”
I koh hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê kéng-siōng: Chú chhiú the̍h tūi-chîn, khiā tī chiàu tūi-chîn khí ê chhiûⁿ téng-bīn.

Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng, “ A-mô͘-sū, lí khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sím-mi̍h?” Góa ìn kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ tūi-chîn.” Chú kóng, “Góa beh ēng tūi-chîn niû góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t; góa bōe koh pàng in soah.
Í-sat ê soaⁿ-thâu-tôaⁿ ōe hong-hòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê sèng-só͘ ōe pha-hng; góa beh khí--lâi, ēng to kong-kek Iâ-lô-pho-an ông-tiâu.”

Pek-te̍k-lī ê chè-si A-má-siā phài sù-chiá khì kā Í-sek-lia̍t -ông Iâ-lô-pho-an kóng, “ A-mô͘-sū tī Í-sek-lia̍t tiong-kan siàn-tōng lâng hoán-tùi lí; i ê giân-lūn tùi kok-ka put-lī.
In-ūi i kóng, ‘ Iâ-lô-pho-an ōe hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng it-tēng ōe liû-bông lī-khui pún-kok.’”
A-má-siā koh tùi A-mô͘-sū kóng, “Lí chit-ê sian-kiàn, kā góa chhut--khì, tò-tńg-khì lín pún-kok Iû-tāi, tī hia thàn-chia̍h, tī hia kóng ū-giân.
M̄-thang koh tī Pek-te̍k-lī kóng ū-giân; in-ūi chia ū ông ê sèng-só͘, ū ông-ka ê kiong-tiān.”
A-mô͘-sū ìn A-má-siā kóng, “Góa m̄-sī sian-ti, mā m̄-sī sian-ti ê tô͘-tē; góa sī chhī iûⁿ--ê, mā teh chiàu-kò͘ sng-châi-chhiū.
Góa teh kò͘ iûⁿ-kûn ê sî, Siōng Chú ho͘-tiàu góa, kā góa kóng, ‘Lí khì, tùi góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t thoân-ta̍t góa ê ōe.’
Án-ni, A-má-siā, lí tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê ōe. Lí kóng ‘M̄-thang thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè ê ōe hoán-tùi Í-sek-lia̍t, m̄-thang kóng-ōe kong-kek Í-sat ê ke’,

só͘-í, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng, ‘Lí ê bó͘ ōe tī siâⁿ-lāi chòe chhiong-ki; lí ê kiáⁿ cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ōe sí tī to-ē; lí ê thó͘-tōe ōe hō͘ lâng hun-koah chiàm--khì; lí ka-kī ōe sí tī gōa-kok; Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng it-tēng ōe liû-bông lī-khui pún-kok.’”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê kéng-siōng: Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t nâ joa̍h-thiⁿ ê ké-chí.

Siōng-tè kóng, “ A-mô͘-sū, lí khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sím-mi̍h?” Góa ìn kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t nâ joa̍h-thiⁿ ê ké-chí.” Siōng Chú chiū tùi góa kóng, “Góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiat-kio̍k í-keng kàu, góa bōe koh pàng in soah.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Tī hit-ji̍t, kiong-tiān ê koa-siaⁿ ōe pìⁿ-chòe ai-khàu; ta̍k só͘-chāi lóng sī hiat-ka̍k ê sin-si, sì-kòe tiām-chih-chih.”
Lín chiah-ê thún-ta̍h sàn-chhiah-lâng, châu-bia̍t khùn-khó͘-lâng ê lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ!

Lín kóng, “Chhoe-it khah kín kè, goán thang bōe ngó͘-kok; An-hioh-ji̍t kín kiat-sok, goán thang khui-chhī bóe-bōe, thang ēng sòe ê táu, ēng bô sêng-si̍t ê chhìn-thûi, ēng khúi-chà ê thian-phêng pián lâng,
thang ēng gûn bóe sàn-chhiah-lâng, ēng chi̍t siang ôe ōaⁿ khùn-khó͘-lâng, chiong bái ê be̍h-á bōe hō͘ lâng.”
Siōng Chú chiam-tùi Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiau-ngō͘ li̍p-sè kóng, “In só͘ chòe ê it-chhè, góa éng-oán kì-tiâu-tiâu.

Chit-ê tōe kiám bōe in-ūi án-ni iô-choah, tòa tī hia ê lâng kiám bōe pi-ai? Chit-ê tōe ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Nî-lô-hô tiòng--khí-lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ Ai-ki̍p ê tōa-hô tiòng-koân kàng-kē.”
Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kóng, “Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh hō͘ ji̍t-thâu tī tiong-tàu lo̍h-soaⁿ, hō͘ tōe tī ji̍t--sî pìⁿ o͘-àm.

Góa beh hō͘ lín ê choeh-khèng pìⁿ-chòe pi-ai, koa-khek pìⁿ-chòe ai-ko. Góa beh hō͘ lín chhēng môa-saⁿ, thâu thì-kng-kng; hō͘ lín pi-siong chhin-chhiūⁿ sí ko͘-kiáⁿ, chòe-āu kui-mî kui-ji̍t lóng thòng-khó͘.”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Khòaⁿ leh, ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, góa beh hō͘ ki-hng lîm-kàu chit só͘-chāi; ki-hng m̄-sī in-ūi bô mi̍h thang chia̍h, chhùi-ta m̄-sī bô chúi thang lim, sī in-ūi bô Siōng Chú ê ōe thang thiaⁿ.
In chông-lâi-chông-khì, tùi lâm kàu pak, tùi tang kàu sai, sì-kòe chhē Siōng Chú ê ōe, m̄-kú chhē lóng bô.
Tī hit-ji̍t, liân súi ê siàu-lú kap ióng-chòng ê siàu-liân-lâng to ōe in-ūi chhùi-ta hūn--khì.

Hiah-ê kí Sat-má-lī-a ê ngó͘-siōng chiù-chōa ê lâng, kóng ‘ Tān, lí ê sîn-bêng sī oa̍h--ê’, á-sī kóng ‘ Pia̍t-sī-pa ê sîn-bêng ū lêng-siàⁿ’ ê lâng, in lóng ōe tó--lo̍h-khì, éng-oán bōe koh khí--lâi.”

Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Chú khiā tī chè-tôaⁿ piⁿ; I kóng, “Tio̍h kòng thiāu ê téng-chō, kòng kah ki-chō iô-tāng, hō͘ chhù-téng hām--lo̍h-lâi, teh-tio̍h chèng-lâng ê thâu-khak; teh bô sí--ê, góa beh ēng to thâi-sí, bô chi̍t ê cháu ōe lī, liân chi̍t ê to bô lâu--teh.
In nā ó͘-khang, chǹg ji̍p-khì Im-kan, góa mā beh tùi hia kā in lia̍h--chhut-lâi; nā peh-chiūⁿ thiⁿ, góa mā beh tùi hia kā thoa--lo̍h-lâi.
