In nā bih tī Ka-bi̍t soaⁿ-téng, góa mā beh kā in chhē kàu tio̍h, lia̍h--chhut-lâi; nā môa-kè góa ê ba̍k-chiu khì bih tī hái-tóe, góa mā beh bēng-lēng chôa khì kā in.
In nā hō͘ tùi-te̍k lia̍h--khì, góa beh tùi hia bēng-lēng to-kiàm kā in thâi-sí. Góa beh kā in kò͘-tiâu-tiâu, m̄-sī beh pó-hō͘ in, sī beh kā in hêng-hoa̍t.”

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chi̍t-ē bong-tio̍h tōe, tōe chiū siau-iûⁿ; só͘-ū tòa tī tōe-chiūⁿ--ê lóng ōe ai-siong; choân-tōe ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Nî-lô-hô tiòng--khí-lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ Ai-ki̍p tōa-hô ê chúi kàng-kē.
I tī thiⁿ-téng khí I tòa ê só͘-chāi, tī tōe-chiūⁿ hē kiong-chhong ê tōe-ki, kiò hái-chúi lâi piàⁿ tī tōe-chiūⁿ. I ê chheng-ho͘ sī Siōng Chú.

Siōng Chú kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, Góa tùi-thāi lín kiám m̄-sī kap tùi-thāi Kó͘-si̍t -lâng siâng-khoán? Góa kiám m̄-sī ū chhōa Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p, ū chhōa Hui-lī-sū -lâng chhut Ka-hui-thok, chhōa Sū-lī-a -lâng chhut Kiat-ní?

Góa — Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú kim-kim teh khòaⁿ chit-ê ū-chōe ê Í-sek-lia̍t -kok, beh tùi tōe-chiūⁿ kā i siau-bia̍t, m̄-kú bōe kā Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi lóng-chóng châu-bia̍t. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Góa beh chhut bēng-lēng, kā Í-sek-lia̍t -ke khǹg tī thai-á, kap bān-kok chòe-hé thai, liân chi̍t lia̍p sòe-lia̍p chio̍h-thâu to bô beh hō͘ i lak--khì.
Góa ê chú-bîn tiong-kan só͘-ū ū-chōe ê lâng kóng, ‘Chai-hō bōe jip-tio̍h goán, bōe lîm-kàu goán.’ Chiah-ê lâng lóng ōe sí tī to-ē.”

Siōng Chú kóng, “Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh tiông-kiàn Tāi-pi̍t tó-hoāi ê pò͘-pîⁿ; góa beh siu-pó͘ i ê phòa-khiah, beh tùi hong-hòe tiong têng-sin khí-chō, hō͘ i hôe-ho̍k chá-chêng ê chêng-kéng;
hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê Í-tong -lâng, í-ki̍p só͘-ū sio̍k góa ê kok-ka.” Beh sêng-chiū chit-ê sū ê Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú kóng: Ji̍t-chí beh kàu, siu-koah--ê ōe hō͘ lôe-chhân--ê jip--tio̍h; ta̍h phû-tô--ê ōe hō͘ chèng phû-tô--ê jip--tio̍h; tōa-soaⁿ ōe tih tiⁿ-chiú, sió-soaⁿ ōe lâu sin-chiú.

Góa beh chhōa góa siū-lia̍h ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t tò-tńg--lâi. In ōe tiông-kiàn hong-hòe ê siâⁿ-chhī, koh tòa tī hia; in ōe chai-chèng phû-tô, lim chhut-sán ê chiú; in ōe keng-choh ké-chí-hn̂g, chia̍h chhut-sán ê ké-chí.
Góa beh hō͘ in khiā-khí tèng-kun tī ka-kī ê thó͘-tōe; in bōe koh hō͘ lâng tùi góa siúⁿ-sù hō͘ in ê thó͘-tōe pu̍ih--khí-lâi. Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè án-ni soan-pò͘.

Ē-bīn sī Gô-pa-tí-a tit--tio̍h ê khé-sī, sī Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú só͘ kóng koan-hē Í-tong ê sìn-sit. Siōng Chú chhe-khián sù-chiá khì lia̍t-kok, thoân-ta̍t Siōng Chú ê sìn-sit; i kóng: Khí--lâi, lán lâi-khì kap Í-tong kau-chiàn.
Siōng Chú tùi Í-tong kóng, “Góa beh hō͘ lí tī lia̍t-kok tiong pìⁿ-chòe jio̍k-siáu; lí ōe tōa-tōa siū biáu-sī.
Lí sim-lāi ê kiau-ngō͘ khi-phiàn lí; lí tòa tī chio̍h-tōng lāi, khiā-khí tī koân-soaⁿ téng, só͘-í, sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng, ‘Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng kā góa thoa-lo̍h tōe?’
Sui-jiân lí chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu pe kah hiah-ni̍h koân, choh-siū tī chèng chhiⁿ-sîn ê tiong-kan, góa mā beh tùi hia kā lí thoa--lo̍h-lâi.” Siōng Chú án-ni kóng.

Mî--sî chha̍t nā lâi thau, kiông-tō nā lâi chhiúⁿ, in kiám m̄-sī the̍h só͘ ài ê mi̍h nā-tiāⁿ? Bán phû-tô ê lâng nā khì lí hia, kiám bōe lâu tām-po̍h? M̄-kú, lí ōe thiat-tóe siū siau-bia̍t.
Í-sò ê kiáⁿ-sun ah, lín chhàng ê châi-pó kèng-jiân siū chhiúⁿ-toa̍t!

Só͘-ū kap lí kiat-bêng ê kok-ka kóaⁿ lí chhut lí ka-kī ê kok-kéng; lí ê bêng-iú ēng phiàn-su̍t cheng-ho̍k lí. Chia̍h lí ê pn̄g ê lâng siat lô-bāng hām-hāi lí, án-ni lí iáu bô hoat-kak?
Siōng Chú kóng: Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh húi-bia̍t Í-tong ê khiáu-lâng, beh sàu-tû in hiah-ê ū tì-hūi ê lâng;
Thê-bān ê chiàn-sū ōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, Í-tong só͘-ū ê lâng ōe siū châu-bia̍t.
In-ūi lí chân-hāi ka-kī ê hiaⁿ-tī Ngá-kok, lí ōe kiàn-siàu kah beh sí, éng-oán siū húi-bia̍t.
Tùi-te̍k kong-phòa i ê siâⁿ-mn̂g ê sî, lí tiām-tiām khiā-teh khòaⁿ; gōa-cho̍k chhiúⁿ-toa̍t châi-bu̍t, thiu-chhiam pun Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hit-ji̍t, lí kèng-jiân chhap-chi̍t-kha.

Lí ê hiaⁿ-tī tú-tio̍h chai-lān hit-ji̍t, lí m̄ eng-kai khiā-teh khòaⁿ; Iû-tāi -lâng siū húi-bia̍t hit-ji̍t, lí m̄ eng-kai hoaⁿ-hí; in tú-tio̍h chai-lān hit-ji̍t, lí m̄ eng-kai kā in thí-chhiò.

Góa ê chú-bîn tú-tio̍h chai-hō hit-ji̍t, lí m̄ eng-kai ji̍p-khì in ê siâⁿ-lāi; in tú-tio̍h chai-lān hit-ji̍t, lí m̄ eng-kai khiā-teh khòaⁿ in siū-khó͘; in tú-tio̍h chai-hō hit-ji̍t, lí m̄ eng-kai chhiúⁿ-toa̍t in ê châi-bu̍t.
Lí m̄ eng-kai khiā tī si̍p-jī-lō͘-thâu cha̍h tô-lān ê lâng, mā bô eng-kai tī chai-lān ê ji̍t chiong lān-bîn kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k.
Siōng Chú sím-phòaⁿ bān-kok ê ji̍t kàu lah! Í-tong ah, lí án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lâng, lâng mā beh án-ni tùi-thāi lí; lí án-chóaⁿ chòe, mā beh án-ni siū pò-èng.
Lín tī sèng-soaⁿ só͘ lim hêng-hoa̍t ê poe, chiu-ûi lia̍t-kok mā ōe sòa lo̍h-khì lim; in ōe kè-sio̍k lim, koàn kah chùi, kàu tùi tōe-bīn siau-bia̍t.
Sek-an-soaⁿ teh-beh ū chhun--lo̍h-lâi tit-kiù ê lâng; chit-ê soaⁿ beh chiâⁿ-chòe sèng-soaⁿ. Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi ōe siu-hôe in ê sán-gia̍p.

Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi chhin-chhiūⁿ jia̍t-hé, Iok-sek ê hō͘-tāi chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-iām, in beh sio Í-sò ê hō͘-tāi chhin-chhiūⁿ sio be̍h-kó. Í-sò ê hō͘-tāi lóng chhun bô pòaⁿ-ê! Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Iû-tāi lâm-pêng ê Nî-kek-hu chū-bîn ōe chiàm-léng Í-tong-soaⁿ; tòa tī sai-pêng soaⁿ-po͘ ê lâng beh chiàm-léng Hui-lī-sū pêng-goân, koh siu-hôe Í-hoat-liân kap Sat-má-lī-a ê thó͘-tōe. Piān-ngá-bín -lâng ōe chiàm-léng Ki-lia̍t.
Í-sek-lia̍t liû-bông ê tāi-kun ōe tńg-lâi cheng-ho̍k Hui-nî-ki, ti̍t-kàu Sat-le̍k-hoat; tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng liû-bông khì Sat-te̍k ê lâng ōe chiàm-léng Nî-kek-hu ê siâⁿ-tìn.
Hiah-ê tek-sèng-chiá beh chiūⁿ Sek-an-soaⁿ, tùi hia thóng-tī Í-tong; kok-koân chiū kui tī Siōng Chú.
Siōng Chú tùi A-bí-thài ê kiáⁿ Iok-ná kóng,
“Lí khì, khì Nî-nî-bî hit-ê tōa-siâⁿ, chhut-siaⁿ kéng-kài in; in-ūi in ê siâ-ok góa ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h.”

M̄-kú Iok-ná siūⁿ-beh cháu-khì Tha-si siám-pī Siōng Chú. I lo̍h-khì Iok-phà, tú-tio̍h chi̍t chiah chûn beh khì Tha-si, chiū la̍p chûn-hùi, chē hit-chiah chûn kap lâng khì Tha-si, siám-pī Siōng Chú.
M̄-kú Siōng Chú hō͘ hái khí tōa-hong, hong-éng chin tōa, chûn kiông-beh phòa--khì.

Chûn-oân chin kiaⁿ, ta̍k-ê lâng ai-kiû ka-kī ê sîn-bêng, koh chiong chûn-lāi ê hè-mi̍h hiat-lo̍h hái, hō͘ chûn khah khin. M̄-kú Iok-ná í-keng lo̍h-khì chûn-tó͘ tóe, tó--teh, khùn kah chin lo̍h-bîn.
Chûn-tiúⁿ kiâⁿ óa--khì, kā Iok-ná kóng, “Lí ná hiah hó-khùn? Khí-lâi kiû-kiò lí ê sîn-bêng; i kiám-chhái ōe kā lán pó-pì, hō͘ lán bián sí.”
Chèng-lâng kóng-lâi-kóng-khì, “Lâi, lâi thiu-chhiam, khòaⁿ sī siáⁿ-lâng jiá-khí chit-ê chai-hō.” In chiū thiu-chhiam, thiu-tio̍h Iok-ná.
In mn̄g i kóng, “Lí kā goán kóng, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ ín-khí chit-ê chai-hō? Lí sī chia̍h sím-mi̍h thâu-lō͘? Lí tó-ūi lâi? Sī tó chi̍t kok, tó chi̍t cho̍k--ê?”
I ìn kóng, “Góa sī Hi-pek-lâi lâng; góa kèng-ùi Siōng Chú — Thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè, I sī chhòng-chō tōa-hái kap lio̍k-tōe--ê.”
Hiah-ê lâng hui-siông tio̍h-kiaⁿ, tùi i kóng, “Lí tàu-tóe ū chòe sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?” Hiah-ê lâng chai Iok-ná teh siám-pī Siōng Chú, in-ūi i ū kā in kóng.
In chiū mn̄g i, “Goán tio̍h án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lí, chiah ōe hō͘ hái pêng-chēng?” In-ūi hái-éng ná lâi ná tōa.
I kā in kóng, “Lín kā góa lia̍h khí-lâi hiat-lo̍h hái, hái chiū ōe pêng-chēng; góa chai lín tú-tio̍h chit-ê tōa-hong sī in-ūi góa ê iân-kò͘.”
Sui-jiân Iok-ná án-ni kóng, chûn-oân iáu-kú chīn-la̍t beh kā chûn kò óa-hōaⁿ, m̄-kú bô hoat-tō͘, in-ūi hái-éng ná khí ná tōa.

In chiū kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, goán pek-chhiat kiû lí, m̄-thang in-ūi goán hō͘ chit-ê lâng sí, soah hāi goán bô-miā; m̄-thang kā goán chek-hoa̍t, kóng goán lâu bû-ko͘ ê lâng ê huih. Siōng Chú ah, che it-chhè lóng sī chiàu lí ê ì-sù chòe.”
In chiū kā Iok-ná lia̍h khí-lâi hiat-lo̍h hái; hái ê hong-éng chiū pêng-chēng.
Hiah-ê lâng chiū tōa-tōa kèng-ùi Siōng Chú, hiàn-chè hō͘ Siōng Chú, koh hē-goān.
Siōng Chú an-pâi chi̍t bé tōa-hî kā Iok-ná thun--lo̍h-khì; Iok-ná tī hî ê pak-tó͘ lāi saⁿ mî saⁿ ji̍t.
Iok-ná tī hî ê pak-tó͘ lāi tùi Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè kî-tó, kóng:
Góa tī gûi-kip ê sî kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, I ū ìn góa; góa tùi Im-kan siōng-chhim ê só͘-chāi ai-kiò, lí ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h.
Lí kā góa hiat-lo̍h chhim-hái, kàu hái-tóe; tōa-chúi ûi góa, lí ê pho-lōng, lí ê tōa-éng khàm góa.
Góa siūⁿ, “Lí tùi lí ê bīn-chêng kā góa kóaⁿ-cháu, góa beh án-chóaⁿ chiah ōe-tàng koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê sèng-tiān?”
Góa hō͘ chúi kek kah beh bô-miā; Chhim-ian ûi-khùn góa; hái-chháu tîⁿ-tiâu góa ê thâu-khak.
Góa tîm lo̍h-khì kàu soaⁿ ê kun-ki; tōe ê mn̂g-chhòaⁿ éng-oán kā góa chhòaⁿ--teh; m̄-kú, Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè, lí ū kiù góa ê sìⁿ-miā thoat-lī sí-bông.
Góa ê sìⁿ-miā kiông-beh bô--khì ê sî, góa siūⁿ-khí Siōng Chú; góa ê kî-tó chìn-ji̍p lí ê sèng-tiān, kàu tī lí ê bīn-chêng.
Só͘-ū khîⁿ-tiâu bô lō͘-ēng ê ngó͘-siōng ê lâng, khì-sak in tùi lí ê tiong-sêng.
Chóng-sī góa beh ēng kám-un ê siaⁿ chòe chè hiàn hō͘ lí, siā góa hē ê goān. Chín-kiù sī tùi Siōng Chú lâi!
Siōng Chú chiū bēng-lēng hit-bé hî, kā Iok-ná thò͘ tī lio̍k-tōe.
Siōng Chú ê ōe tē-jī piàn thoân hō͘ Iok-ná, kóng,
“Khí--lâi, lí khì Nî-nî-bî hit-ê tōa-siâⁿ, chiong góa kau-tài lí ê sìn-sit tùi in soan-pò͘.”
Iok-ná sûi-sî khí--lâi, chiàu Siōng Chú ê ōe khì Nî-nî-bî. Nî-nî-bî sī hui-siông tōa ê siâⁿ, tio̍h saⁿ ji̍t chiah kiâⁿ ōe thàu.
Thâu chi̍t ji̍t, Iok-ná ji̍p-siâⁿ, soan-pò͘ kóng, “Koh sì-cha̍p ji̍t, Nî-nî-bî ōe húi-bia̍t.”
Nî-nî-bî -lâng sìn Siōng-tè, chiū soan-pò͘ kìm-chia̍h, tùi tōa kàu sòe lóng chhēng môa-saⁿ chhàm-hóe.
Chit-ê siau-sit thoân kàu Nî-nî-bî -ông hia; i chiū tùi ông-ūi khí--lâi, thǹg lé-ho̍k, chhēng môa-saⁿ, chē tī hé-hu.

I koh tùi Nî-nî-bî -lâng soan-pò͘ kóng, “Ông kap tāi-sîn hā-lēng: Lâng kap cheng-siⁿ, gû-kûn iûⁿ-kûn, lóng put-chún chia̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ — m̄-thang hō͘ in chia̍h, m̄-thang hō͘ in lim.
Lâng kap cheng-siⁿ lóng tio̍h chhēng môa-saⁿ. Ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h pek-chhiat kiû-kiò Siōng-tè, tio̍h hóe-kái khì-sak pháiⁿ hêng-ûi kap pō-le̍k.
Bô-tiāⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè ōe hôe-sim-tńg-ì, bô hoat tōa siū-khì hō͘ lán bia̍t-bông.”
Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-tio̍h in ê só͘-chòe, ū hóe-kái hòng-khì in ê pháiⁿ hêng-ûi, chiū kái-piàn sim-ì, bô chiong só͘ kóng ê chai-hō kàng-lo̍h tī in sin-chiūⁿ.
Iok-ná tùi chit-ê tāi-chì chin bô hoaⁿ-hí, hui-siông siū-khì,

chiū tùi Siōng Chú kî-tó kóng, “Siōng Chú ah, góa iáu-bē cháu-lī pún-kok ê sî, kiám m̄-sī ū án-ni kóng? Góa kóaⁿ-kín beh cháu-khì Tha-si, sī in-ūi góa chai lí sī ū un-tián ê Siōng-tè, chhiong-móa lîn-bín, bōe khoài siū-khì, ū hong-sēng ê chû-ài, ōe kái-piàn sim-ì bô beh kàng chai-hō.
Siōng Chú, kui-khì hō͘ góa sí-sí--leh, góa sí pí oa̍h--teh khah hó.”
Siōng Chú ìn kóng, “Lí án-ni siū-khì kiám tio̍h?”
Iok-ná chiū chhut-khì siâⁿ-gōa, kàu siâⁿ ê tang-pêng, ūi ka-kī tah chi̍t ê liâu-á, chē tī ìm-ńg-ē, beh khòaⁿ hit-ê siâⁿ tàu-tóe ōe hoat-seng sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.

Chú Siōng-tè an-pâi chi̍t châng pi-môa, hō͘ i hoat kah pí Iok-ná khah koân, chòe ìm-ńg jia i ê thâu-khak, hō͘ i bián kan-khó͘; Iok-ná in-ūi chit-châng pi-môa hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí.
Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, Siōng-tè an-pâi chi̍t bé thâng chia̍h chit-châng pi-môa, pi-môa soah sí--khì.

Ji̍t chhut ê sî, Siōng-tè an-pâi iām-jia̍t ê tang-hong; ji̍t-thâu pha̍k Iok-ná ê thâu-khak, hō͘ i kiông-beh hūn--khì; i chiū ūi ka-kī kiû sí, kóng, “Góa sí pí oa̍h--teh khah hó.”
Siōng-tè tùi Iok-ná kóng, “Lí ūi-tio̍h chit-châng pi-môa siū-khì kiám tio̍h?” Iok-ná ìn kóng, “Tong-jiân! Góa khì kah beh sí.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Chit-châng pi-môa m̄-sī lí chèng--ê, m̄-sī lí hō͘ i tōa-châng--ê, chi̍t mî tōa-châng, keh-mî sí--khì, lí to ōe m̄-kam;
Nî-nî-bî chit-ê tōa-siâⁿ, lāi-bīn ū cha̍p-jī-bān bōe-hiáu hun-pia̍t hó-pháiⁿ ê lâng, koh ū chin chōe cheng-siⁿ, góa kiám m̄-bián kā i thiàⁿ-sioh?”

Ē-bīn sī Siōng Chú tùi Mô͘-lī-siat -lâng Bí-ka khé-sī ê ōe; che sī Iû-tāi -ông Iok-thán, A-hap-su, Hi-se-ka sòa-chiap chip-chèng ê sî, Bí-ka só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ iú-koan Sat-má-lī-a kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê īⁿ-siōng.
Bān-bîn ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ! Choân-tōe kap só͘-ū tiàm tī hit lāi-bīn--ê, lóng tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ. Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú beh tùi I ê Sèng-tiān chí-chèng lín ê m̄-tio̍h.
Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú beh tùi I tòa ê só͘-chāi chhut--lâi, kàng-lîm, kha ta̍h tī tōe koân ê só͘-chāi.
Chèng-soaⁿ ōe tī I ê kha-ē iûⁿ--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ la̍h tú-tio̍h hé; soaⁿ-kok ōe li̍h--khui, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi chhiong-lo̍h soaⁿ-phiâⁿ.

Che lóng sī in-ūi Ngá-kok ê chōe-kò, in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -ke ê chōe-ok; Ngá-kok ê chōe-kò sī sím-mi̍h? Kiám m̄-sī Sat-má-lī-a? Iû-tāi ê chōe-ok sī sím-mi̍h? Kiám m̄-sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng?

Só͘-í, góa beh hō͘ Sat-má-lī-a pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘, chiâⁿ-chòe thô͘-tui, chòe chèng phû-tô ê só͘-chāi; góa beh chiong i ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ chhia lo̍h-khì soaⁿ-kok, hō͘ i lō͘-chhut tōe-ki.

Sat-má-lī-a tiau-khek ê ngó͘-siōng lóng ōe siū phah-chhùi, i chòe chhiong-ki tit--tio̍h ê châi-bu̍t ōe hō͘ hé sio--khì; góa beh hō͘ só͘-ū ê ngó͘-siōng pìⁿ-chòe hòe-bu̍t. Sat-má-lī-a chòe chhiong-ki thàn ê chîⁿ, ōe koh hō͘ lâng the̍h-khì khai tī chhiong-ki ê sin-chiūⁿ.
Bí-ka kóng: In-ūi án-ni, góa tōa-siaⁿ ai-khàu, chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì; góa beh âu-kiò chhin-chhiūⁿ chhâi-lông, ai-khàu chhin-chhiūⁿ tô-chiáu.
In-ūi Sat-má-lī-a ê siong bōe-i--tit, í-keng thòaⁿ kàu Iû-tāi, kàu góa chú-bîn ê siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu, sīm-chì thòaⁿ kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
M̄-thang tī Ka-te̍k soan-thoân chit-ê tāi-chì, mā m̄-thang thî-khàu; tio̍h tī Pek A-hut-la ê tîn-ai téng kō-lâi-kō-khì.
Sa-húi ê chū-bîn ah, lín ōe chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé kiàn-siàu, Sat-lâm ê chū-bîn cháu bōe chhut--lâi; Pek Í-siat -lâng ai-khàu, in-ūi in sit-khì in só͘ óa-khò--ê.
Má-lu̍t ê chū-bîn pek-chhiat kî-thāi kái-kiù, in-ūi chai-hō í-keng tùi Siōng Chú hia lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu.
La-kiat ê chū-bîn ah, tio̍h chiong chiàn-chhia thò tī khoài-má chún-pī tô-lān; in-ūi lí o̍h Í-sek-lia̍t pōe-poān Siōng-tè, chhōa Sek-an ê chú-bîn hoān-chōe.
Lí tio̍h ēng lé-mi̍h kā Mô͘-lī-siat Ka-te̍k sàng-pia̍t; Í-sek-lia̍t ê kun-ông ōe hō͘ A-kek-sek -ke phiàn--khì.
Má-lī-sa ê chū-bîn ah, góa beh chhōa cheng-ho̍k-chiá kàu lí hia; Í-sek-lia̍t ê kùi-cho̍k ōe tô-cháu khì A-tō͘-lân.
Iû-tāi -ke ah, tio̍h ūi só͘ thiàⁿ ê jî-lú thì ka-kī ê thâu, thì kah chhin-chhiūⁿ thuh-thâu-eng kng-kng-kng; in-ūi in lóng siū hòng-tio̍k lī-khui lín.
Tī bîn-chhn̂g tô͘-bô͘ put-gī, kè-ōe pháiⁿ-tāi ê lâng, chhám ah! In thiⁿ chi̍t-ē kng chiū khì chòe pháiⁿ, in-ūi in chiáng-ak koân-le̍k.
In tham lâng ê hn̂g, chiū kā chhiúⁿ; ài lâng ê chhù, chiū kā chiàm; in khi-ap lâng kap in ê ka-têng, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t lâng kap in ê sán-gia̍p.

Só͘-í Siōng Chú kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, góa kè-ōe beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ lín chiah-ê lâng; lín bōe-tàng thoat-lī chit-ê chai-hō, kiâⁿ-lō͘ thâu-khak gia̍h bōe koân, in-ūi che sī chai-lān ê sî.

Tī hit-ji̍t, lâng ōe tùi lín kóng hong-chhì ê ōe, chhiùⁿ pi-chhám ê ai-ko, kóng: Goán hāi-liáu-liáu lah! Goán tông-pau ê sán-gia̍p pìⁿ-chòe pa̍t-lâng ê; goán ê chhân-tōe hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì, kau hō͘ goán ê tùi-te̍k!
Só͘-í, tī Siōng Chú ê tāi-hōe tiong, lín choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng koh thiu-chhiam pun thó͘-tōe.
In kóng, “Lín m̄-thang soat-kàu, m̄-thang tùi goán soan-káng chiah-ê tāi-chì; Siōng-tè bōe hō͘ goán kiàn-siàu.”
Ngá-kok ê hō͘-tāi kiám thang kóng, “Siōng Chú ê sim-heng ná hiah oe̍h? I kiám ōe chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì?” Góa ê ōe tùi hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t ê lâng it-tēng ū lī-ek.

Siōng-tè kóng: Lín chiah-ê kè-ōe pháiⁿ-tāi ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi-te̍k khí-lâi kong-kek góa ê chú-bîn, chhiúⁿ-toa̍t tùi chiàn-tiûⁿ tńg--lâi, kî-thāi pêng-an kè-ji̍t ê lâng ê gōa-saⁿ.
Lín chiong góa chú-bîn ê hū-jîn-lâng tùi un-loán ê ka-têng kóaⁿ-chhut, chiong góa tùi in sòe-kiáⁿ ê chiok-hok éng-oán chhiúⁿ--khì.
Khí--lâi, tô-cháu! Chia m̄-sī lín an-choân khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi; in-ūi lín put-gī ê hêng-ûi, chit-ê tōe it-tēng siū húi-hoāi, thiat-tóe húi-hoāi.
Nā ū lâng sì-kòe kiâⁿ, thoân bô-iáⁿ-chiah phiàn lâng ê ōe, kóng, “Góa ū-giân, chiong-lâi lín po̍h-chiú kāu-chiú lim bōe liáu.” Chit-khoán sī lín kah-ì ê sian-ti.

Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn ah, góa it-tēng beh kā lín lóng chū-chi̍p--khí-lâi. Góa beh kā lín an-tì tī chi̍t ê só͘-chāi, chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ tī iûⁿ-tiâu, chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-kûn tī chháu-tiûⁿ, lâng chin chōe, siaⁿ chin ōng.
Ū chi̍t ūi chhōa-thâu chhiong--chhut-khì, chhōa in tùi siâⁿ-mn̂g chhiong--chhut-khì; in ê ông choh-chêng kiâⁿ, Siōng Chú tī thâu-chêng ín-chhōa in.
Góa kóng: Ngá-kok ê siú-léng, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, tio̍h thiaⁿ! Lín kiám m̄ chai sím-mi̍h sī kong-pêng?
Lín iàm-ò͘ⁿ liông-siān, ì-ài siâ-ok; lín pak lâng ê phê, thek lâng ê kut.
Lín chia̍h góa chú-bîn ê bah, pak in ê phê, kòng-tn̄g in ê kut-thâu, tok chi̍t-tè chi̍t-tè, chhin-chhiūⁿ beh lo̍h tiáⁿ chú ê bah.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, lín beh kiû-kiò Siōng Chú, m̄-kú I bōe ìn-tap lín; hit-sî I ōe bīn oa̍t-cháu m̄ chhap lín, in-ūi lín ū chòe siâ-ok ê sū.

Iú-koan chhōa góa ê chú-bîn kiâⁿ bê-lō͘ ê sian-ti, Siōng Chú án-ni kóng: In ê chhùi nā ū mi̍h thang pō͘, chiū kóng “Pêng-an hô-pêng”; lâng nā bô ēng mi̍h that in ê chhùi, in chiū tùi hiah-ê lâng soan-chiàn.
Só͘-í, mî--sî beh kàu, lín khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h īⁿ-siōng; o͘-àm beh lâi, lín bōe-tàng pok-kòa. Tùi lín chiah-ê sian-ti, ji̍t-thâu ōe lo̍h--khì, ji̍t--sî ōe pìⁿ àm-mî.
Hit-sî, sian-kiàn ōe kiàn-siàu, pok-kòa--ê ōe làu-khùi; in lóng ng-chhùi tiām--khì, in-ūi Siōng-tè bô hôe-èng.
Góa leh, Siōng Chú ê sîn hō͘ góa chhiong-móa khùi-la̍t, chèng-gī-kám, kap ióng-khì, thang tùi Ngá-kok soan-kò i ê kè-sit, tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chí-chhut i ê chōe.
Ngá-kok ê siú-léng, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Lín iàm-ò͘ⁿ chèng-gī, tian-tò sī-hui.
Lín ēng huih kiàn-li̍p Sek-an, ēng chōe-ok khí-chō Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Lín ê siú-léng sím-phòaⁿ ê sî siu hóe-lō͘, chè-si ūi-tio̍h kang-chîⁿ kà-sī, sian-ti ūi-tio̍h chîⁿ kóe-seh Siōng-tè ê chí-sī; in kèng-jiân káⁿ hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ kóng, “Siōng Chú tī lán tiong-kan, chai-hō bōe lîm-kàu lán.”
Só͘-í, in-ūi lín ê iân-kò͘, Sek-an ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhân-hn̂g hō͘ lâng lôe, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe pìⁿ-chòe thô͘-tui, chit-ê tiān ê soaⁿ ōe pìⁿ-chòe chhiū-nâ ê soaⁿ-lûn-á.
Tī chiong-lâi ê ji̍t-chí, Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê soaⁿ ōe kian-li̍p tī chèng-soaⁿ ê téng-bīn, pí lóng-chóng ê soaⁿ-niá khah koân; bān-bîn lóng ōe ek óa-lâi kui I.

Bān-kok ōe lâi, kóng, “Lán lâi chiūⁿ Siōng Chú ê soaⁿ, lâi-khì Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè ê tiān. I ōe ēng I ê tō-lō͘ kà-sī lán, hō͘ lán thang kiâⁿ I ê lō͘.” Lu̍t-hoat ōe tùi Sek-an hoat-chhut; Siōng Chú ê ōe ōe tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng thoân-khui.

I ōe tī bān-bîn tiong si-hêng sím-phòaⁿ, ūi hn̄g-hn̄g ê kiông-kok pâi-kái hun-cheng; in ōe chiong to phah-chòe lôe-thâu, chiong chhiuⁿ phah-chòe liâm-to; chit-kok bōe koh gia̍h to kong-kek hit-kok, mā bián koh o̍h chiàn-cheng.
Ta̍k-ê lâng lóng chē tī ka-kī ê phû-tô-chhiū kha kap bû-hoa-kó-chhiū kha, bô lâng ōe kā in phah-chhiⁿ-kiaⁿ; che sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chhin-chhùi kóng--ê.
Sui-jiân bān-bîn lóng khò ka-kī sîn-bêng ê miâ seng-oa̍h, m̄-kú goán beh hōng Siōng Chú — goán ê Siōng-tè ê miâ kiâⁿ-ta̍h, ti̍t-kàu éng-éng-oán-oán.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh chū-chi̍p kha-pái--ê, chio-chi̍p siū hòng-tio̍k--ê, kap góa bat hō͘ in siū-khó͘--ê.

Góa beh hō͘ kha-pái--ê chiâⁿ-chòe só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn, hō͘ siū hòng-tio̍k--ê chiâⁿ-chòe kiông-kok. Siōng Chú beh tī Sek-an-soaⁿ choh-ông tī-lí in, tùi chit-sî kàu éng-oán.”
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, Sek-an -siâⁿ ê pó-lúi ah, lí chòe iûⁿ-kûn ê siú-bōng-tâi, chá-chêng ê chú-koân beh koh kui hō͘ lí, ông-koân beh hôe-ho̍k hō͘ lí.
Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ teh tōa-siaⁿ ai-khàu? Sī in-ūi lí bô ông, tāi-sîn sí-liáu-liáu, lí chiah chhin-chhiūⁿ sán-hū chhui-chūn thòng-khó͘ sī--bô?

Sek-an ê chú-bîn ah, lí ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ sán-hū chhui-chūn thòng-khó͘, in-ūi lí ōe lī-khui chit-ê siâⁿ khì tòa tī iá-gōa, khì kàu Pa-pí-lûn, m̄-kú lí ōe tī hia tit-tio̍h kái-kiù. Siōng Chú beh tùi tùi-te̍k ê chhiú-tiong kā lí sio̍k-hôe.
Hiān-chāi chin chōe kok-ka í-keng liân-ha̍p khí-lâi beh kong-kek lí. In kóng: Tio̍h hō͘ Sek-an siū lêng-jio̍k, lán thang chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h.
M̄-kú in m̄ chai Siōng Chú ê sim-ì, bô bêng-pe̍k I ê kè-ōe; I í-keng kā in chū-chi̍p--khí-lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ siu-chi̍p be̍h-khún tī ngó͘-kok-tiûⁿ.

Siōng Chú kóng: Sek-an ê chú-bîn ah, khí-lâi lún ngó͘-kok. Góa beh hō͘ lí thih ê kak, tâng ê kha-tôe, thang phah-chhùi lia̍t-kok, chiong in só͘ chhiúⁿ ê mi̍h the̍h-lâi hiàn hō͘ góa, chiong in ê châi-bu̍t hiàn hō͘ phó͘-thiⁿ-ē ê Chú.
Sek-an ê chú-bîn, tio̍h chū-chi̍p chiâⁿ-chòe kun-tūi. Lán siū ûi-khùn kong-kek lah; in ēng kùn teh kòng Í-sek-lia̍t léng-siù ê chhùi-phóe.

Í-hoat-tha tōe-khu ê Pek-lī-hêng ah, lí tī Iû-tāi chong-cho̍k tiong sui-jiân bî-sòe, m̄-kú ū chi̍t ūi ōe tùi lí hia chhut--lâi, ūi góa tī-lí Í-sek-lia̍t; i ê kun-goân tùi kó͘-chá, tùi siōng khí-thâu chiū ū.

Só͘-í, Siōng Chú beh chiong I ê chú-bîn kau hō͘ tùi-te̍k, ti̍t-kàu hit-ê teh chhui-chūn ê hū-jîn-lâng kā kiáⁿ siⁿ--chhut-lâi. Hit-sî, hiah-ê siū-lia̍h iáu oa̍h--teh ê tông-pau ōe tò-lâi Í-sek-lia̍t hia.

I beh khò Siōng Chú ê khùi-la̍t khiā--chhut-lâi, hōng Siōng Chú — i ê Siōng-tè ê miâ ê ui-giâm, bo̍k-ióng i ê iûⁿ-kûn, hō͘ in an-jiân khiā-khí; i ōe tī choân-tōe siū chun chòe tōa.
Chit-ūi ōe hō͘ lán sù-kéng-pêng-an. A-su̍t chhim-hoān lán ê kok-thó͘, kong-kek lán ê pó-lúi ê sî, lán beh chí-phài chhit ê bo̍k-chiá, poeh ê siú-léng hoán-kek.
In ōe ēng kiàm tī-lí A-su̍t -tōe, ēng pu̍ih--chhut-lâi ê to thóng-tī Lêng-lio̍k -tōe. A-su̍t chhim-hoān lán ê tōe, thún-ta̍h lán ê kok-thó͘ ê sî, chit-ūi ōe kái-kiù lán.

Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn tī bān-bîn tiong, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú kàng-lo̍h ê lō͘-chúi, chhin-chhiūⁿ lūn-te̍k chháu ê kam-lîm; in m̄-bián óa-khò lâng, m̄-bián kî-thāi sè-kan-lâng.

Í-sek-lia̍t chhun--lo̍h-lâi ê chú-bîn tī bān-kok bān-bîn tiong, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū-nâ lāi pah-siù tiong ê sai, chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-kûn tiong-kan siàu-chòng ê sai, in keng-kè ê sî, ōe thún-ta̍h, thiah-li̍h, bô lâng ōe-tàng kái-kiù.
Lín ōe iâⁿ-kè tùi-te̍k, siau-bia̍t lín só͘-ū ê te̍k-jîn.
Siōng Chú kóng: Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì lín ê chiàn-bé, húi-hoāi lín ê chiàn-chhia.
Góa beh húi-hoāi lín kok-lāi ê siâⁿ-chhī, thiah-húi lín só͘-ū ê pó-lúi.
Góa beh tû-khì lín chhiú teh lāng ê siâ-su̍t, tī lín hia bô koh ū pok-kòa--ê.
Góa beh tùi lín tiong-kan tû-bia̍t tiau-khek ê ngó͘-siōng kap chio̍h-thiāu-siōng; lín chiū bô koh kūi-pài ka-kī ê chhiú chō ê ngó͘-siōng.
Góa beh tùi lín tiong-kan pu̍ih-chhut A-sià-la lú-sîn ê thiāu-siōng, koh húi-bia̍t lín ê siâⁿ-chhī.
Góa mā beh hoat tōa siū-khì, pò-èng bô sūn-thàn ê lia̍t-kok.
Tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú teh kóng ê ōe: Khí--lâi, tī tōa-soaⁿ bīn-chêng thê-chhut tap-piān, hō͘ sió-soaⁿ thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê siaⁿ.
Tōa-soaⁿ kap tōe kian-kò͘ ê kun-ki ah, tio̍h thiaⁿ Siōng Chú ê khòng-sò͘; Siōng Chú beh kap I ê chú-bîn cheng-piān, beh khòng-kò Í-sek-lia̍t.
Góa ê chú-bîn ah, góa ū tùi lín chòe sím-mi̍h? Góa ū sím-mi̍h hō͘ lín ûi-lân? Lín lâi tap-piān.
Góa ū chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p, kiù-sio̍k lín thoat-lī chòe lô͘-châi ê tōe; góa chhe Mô͘-se, A-lûn, Bí-lī-an chòe thâu chhōa lín.

Góa ê chú-bîn ah, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Mô͘-ap -ông Pa-le̍k ê kè-bô͘, kap Pí-ní ê kiáⁿ Pa-lân ìn i ê ōe, ōe-kì-tit tùi Si̍p-têng kàu Kiat-kah hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, thang hō͘ lín chai Siōng Chú kong-chèng ê chok-ûi.
Góa tio̍h tòa sím-mi̍h chiū-kūn Siōng Chú, tòa sím-mi̍h lâi kèng-pài Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè? Kiám tio̍h ēng sio-hòa-chè, á-sī chi̍t-hè ê gû-á lâi chiū-kūn I?

Siōng Chú kiám ōe hoaⁿ-hí chheng-chheng chiah ê iûⁿ-káng, á-sī bān-bān tiâu khoe ê iû? Góa kiám tio̍h ūi ka-kī ê chōe-kò hiàn tōa-kiáⁿ, ūi góa ê chōe-ok hiàn góa ê chhin-siⁿ-kiáⁿ?
Lâng ah, Siōng Chú í-keng ū chí-sī lí sím-mi̍h sī hó. I iau-kiû lí--ê sī sím-mi̍h? Chiū-sī si̍t-hêng kong-gī, sim chûn chû-pi, khiam-pi kap lí ê Siōng-tè chòe-hé kiâⁿ.
Kèng-ùi Siōng Chú chiah sī tì-hūi. Siōng Chú tùi siâⁿ chhut-siaⁿ ho͘-kiò, “Ta̍k-ê chi-cho̍k kap siâⁿ-lāi ê hōe-chiòng, lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ.
Góa kiám ōe bōe-kì-tit pháiⁿ-lâng chhù-lāi put-gī ê chîⁿ-châi, bōe-kì-tit bô ha̍h kui-keh ê chin kap táu?
Góa kiám ōe iông-ún bô kong-tō ê thian-phêng, kap pián--lâng ê chhìn-thûi?
Siâⁿ-lāi ê hó-gia̍h-lâng chhiong-móa kiông-pō, chū-bîn lóng kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, in ê chhùi-chi̍h khúi-chà.
Só͘-í góa tāng-tāng kā lí phah, ūi-tio̍h lí ê chōe kā lí húi-bia̍t.
Lí chia̍h, m̄-kú chia̍h bōe pá; pak-tó͘ put-sî khang-khang. Lí chek-chū, m̄-kú lâu bōe tiâu; lí só͘ chhun--ê, mā ōe tī chiàn-loān tiong siū húi-hoāi.
Lí iā-chéng, bô thang siu-sêng; chiⁿ kaⁿ-ná, mā bô iû thang boah seng-khu; ta̍h phû-tô, mā bô chiú thang lim.

In-ūi lín chun-siú Àm-lī ê kui-lē, o̍h A-hap -ke ê pháiⁿ hêng-ûi, sūn-thàn in ê kè-bô͘, só͘-í góa beh kā lín húi-bia̍t, hō͘ lín tòa tī chia ê lâng siū thí-chhiò, lín mā ōe tam-tng góa chú-bîn ê kiàn-siàu.”

Góa chhám ah! Góa chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t ê lâng, joa̍h-thiⁿ ê ké-chí siu-sêng liáu, phû-tô lóng bán-liáu, chhē bô kui-pha ê phû-tô thang chia̍h, liân só͘ ài thâu-chúi ê bû-hoa-kó mā chhē bô.
Tōe-chiūⁿ tiong-si̍t ê lâng lóng siau-sit, sè-kan bô chèng-ti̍t ê lâng; só͘-ū ê lâng bâi-ho̍k beh thâi-lâng, ta̍k-ê ēng lô-bāng tng i ê tông-pau.
In ê chhiú choan chòe pháiⁿ-tāi, tāi-sîn kap sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ thó hóe-lō͘, koaⁿ-oân kong-jiân iau-kiû in só͘ ài--ê; in hō͘-siōng kau-kiat, kè-bô͘ chòe pháiⁿ.

In tiong-kan siōng-hó--ê, put-kò chhin-chhiūⁿ chhì-phè; siōng chèng-ti̍t--ê chhin-chhiūⁿ chhì-á lî-pa. Lí ê siú-bōng-chiá só͘ kéng-kò sím-phòaⁿ ê ji̍t kàu lah, hūn-loān ê ji̍t kūn lah.
M̄-thang sìn-jīm chhù-piⁿ, mā m̄-thang óa-khò pêng-iú; sīm-chì tùi chhin-bi̍t ê bó͘ kóng-ōe mā tio̍h sió-sim.
Kiáⁿ biáu-sī lāu-pē, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kap lāu-bú choh-tùi, sin-pū ngó͘-ge̍k ta-ke; lâng ê tùi-te̍k sī ka-kī ke-lāi ê lâng.
M̄-kú góa, góa beh gióng-bōng Siōng Chú, beh thèng-hāu Siōng-tè — góa ê Kiù-chú; góa ê Siōng-tè ōe thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó.
Góa ê tùi-te̍k ah, bián ūi-tio̍h góa ê cho-gū hoaⁿ-hí; góa sui-jiân poa̍h-tó, mā ōe koh khí--lâi; góa chē tī o͘-àm tiong, Siōng Chú chòe góa ê kng.

Góa tio̍h jím-siū Siōng Chú ê siū-khì, in-ūi góa ū tek-chōe I. Góa beh thèng-hāu I ūi-tio̍h góa ê àn-kiāⁿ piān-hō͘, ūi góa chú-chhî kong-tō. I ōe chhōa góa chìn-ji̍p kng-bêng, hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h I ê kong-gī.

Hit-sî góa ê tùi-te̍k khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, it-tēng chin kiàn-siàu; in bat thí-chhiò góa kóng, “Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè tī tó-ūi?” Góa ōe chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-kìⁿ tùi-te̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ koe-lō͘ ê thô͘-bê siū thún-ta̍h.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn ah, tiông-kiàn siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê ji̍t kàu lah; hit-ji̍t, lín ōe khok-tián lín ê léng-thó͘.

Hit-ji̍t, lín ê tông-pau beh tò-tńg--lâi, tùi A-su̍t kàu Ai-ki̍p, tùi Ai-ki̍p kàu Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô, tùi chit-ê hái kàu hit-ê hái, tùi chit-ê soaⁿ kàu hit-ê soaⁿ, in lóng beh tò-tńg--lâi.
M̄-kú chit-ê tōe, ōe in-ūi chū-bîn ê pháiⁿ hêng-ûi pìⁿ-chòe hong-hòe.

Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí ēng lí ê koáiⁿ bo̍k-ióng lí ka-kī ê chú-bîn, chiū-sī lí ê iûⁿ-kûn, lí ê sán-gia̍p, hō͘ in tiàm tī ū chhiⁿ-chhùi chháu-tiûⁿ pau-ûi ê chhiū-nâ lāi, bô siū kiáu-chhá, chhin-chhiūⁿ kó͘-chá tī Pa-san kap Ki-lia̍t án-ni kā in bo̍k-ióng.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh chhin-chhiūⁿ chhōa lín chhut Ai-ki̍p ê ji̍t án-ni, hián-chhut kî-biāu ê sîn-jiah hō͘ lín khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.”
Lia̍t-pang khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, ōe in-ūi ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t kiàn-siàu, ēng chhiú ng-chhùi, hī-khang that--teh.

In ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chôa chī thô͘-hún, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh sô ê tōng-bu̍t ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah tùi bih ê khang chhut--lâi. In ōe kiaⁿ-kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ-hiâⁿ kui-ǹg Siōng Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè.

Siōng-tè ah, kiám ū pa̍t-ê sîn-bêng ōe-tàng kap lí pí? Lí sià-bián chōe-kò, khoan-sià só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn hoān ê kè-sit. Lí bô éng-oán khǹg siū-khì, hoán-tńg ì-ài lîn-bín.
Lí ōe koh chi̍t piàn lîn-bín goán, chiong goán ê chōe ta̍h tī kha-tóe, chiong it-chhè ê chōe-kò hiat-lo̍h chhim-hái.
Lí it-tēng chiàu lí kó͘-chá tùi goán lia̍t-chó͘ li̍p-sè ê èng-ún, ēng sìn-si̍t tùi-thāi Ngá-kok, si-lo̍h chû-ài hō͘ A-pek-la-hán.
Ē-bīn sī iú-koan Nî-nî-bî ê soan-kò, chiū-sī I-le̍k-ko-su -lâng Ná-hông só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê īⁿ-siōng ê kì-lio̍k.

Siōng Chú sī iau-kiû choan-chêng, koh sī ōe pò-ho̍k ê Siōng-tè; Siōng Chú ōe pò-ho̍k, ōe hoat tōa siū-khì. Siōng Chú ōe pò-ho̍k I ê tùi-te̍k, tùi I ê te̍k-jîn hoat tōa siū-khì.

Siōng Chú bōe khoài siū-khì, m̄-kú ū tōa khùi-la̍t; I it-tēng bōe kā ū-chōe--ê phòaⁿ-chòe bô-chōe. Siōng Chú keng-kè ê lō͘ ōe ká kńg-lê-á-hong, ōe khí kông-hong; hûn sī I ê kha ká--khí-lâi ê thô͘-hún.
I chek-pī hái, hái chiū ta--khì, só͘-ū ê hô lóng bô chúi. Pa-san kap Ka-bi̍t ê chháu lóng ta--khì, Lê-pa-lūn ê hoe mā siā--khì.
Tōa-soaⁿ in-ūi Siōng Chú tín-tāng, sió-soaⁿ siau-iûⁿ; tāi-tōe tī I bīn-chêng iô-choah, sè-kài kap tiàm tī hit tiong-kan--ê phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.

I khí siū-khì, siáⁿ-lâng khiā ōe tiâu? I hoat sèng-tē, siáⁿ-lâng tng ōe khí? I ê tōa siū-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ hé phùn-chhut; chio̍h-pôaⁿ tī I bīn-chêng piak kah chhùi-chhùi-chhùi.
Siōng Chú chì-siān. Tī hoān-lān ê ji̍t, I sī pī-lān-só͘; I chiàu-kò͘ só͘-ū óa-khò I ê lâng.
M̄-kú I ōe ēng hoàn-lām ê tōa-chúi húi-bia̍t Nî-nî-bî, kā tùi-te̍k kóaⁿ-ji̍p o͘-àm.
Lín bô-lūn siat sím-mi̍h kè-bô͘ tí-te̍k Siōng Chú, I ōe thiat-tóe kā lín châu-bia̍t; lín bōe-tàng koh-chài pōe-poān.
Lín chhin-chhiūⁿ lim chiú-chùi ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ kiat kui-kiû ê chhì-phè, koh chhin-chhiūⁿ ta--khì ê be̍h-kó ōe hō͘ hé sio-bia̍t.
Nî-nî-bî ah, ū chi̍t ê lâng ōe tùi lí hia chhut--lâi, tô͘-bô͘ siâ-ok, siat-kè kong-kek Siōng Chú.

Siōng Chú tùi Iû-tāi ê chú-bîn kóng, “ A-su̍t -lâng sui-jiân kiông koh chōe, mā ōe siū húi-bia̍t siau-sit. Góa ê chú-bîn ah, góa bat hō͘ lín siū-khó͘, m̄-kú í-āu bōe koh hō͘ lín siū-khó͘.
Hiān-chāi góa beh kòng-tn̄g in hō͘ lín ê taⁿ, chhoah-tn̄g in khún-pa̍k lín ê soh.”

Siōng Chú tùi Nî-nî-bî soan-kò, “Lí bô koh ū hō͘-tāi thang iân-sio̍k lí ê miâ. Góa beh tùi lí ê sîn-biō tû-bia̍t tiau-khek ê ngó͘-siōng, kap chù-chō ê sîn-siōng; góa beh kā lí chún-pī hûn-bōng, in-ūi lí bô koh ū oa̍h--teh ê kè-ta̍t.”

Khòaⁿ leh, thoân-pò hó siau-sit, soan-pò͘ hô-pêng ê lâng peh-chiūⁿ soaⁿ-téng, kóng, “ Iû-tāi ah, tio̍h siú choeh-kî, siā lín ê goān; pháiⁿ-lâng bōe koh chhim-hoān lín, in ōe thiat-tóe siū húi-bia̍t.”
Nî-nî-bî, hit-ê beh phah-chhùi lia̍t-kok--ê í-keng chhut-peng kong-kek lín; tio̍h kò͘-siú pó-lúi, hông-pī iàu-tō, chi̍p-tiong le̍k-liōng, chún-pī èng-chiàn.
Sui-jiân te̍k-jîn ū kā Ngá-kok chhiúⁿ-kiap, húi-hoāi Í-sek-lia̍t ê phû-tô-hn̂g, Siōng Chú beh hôe-ho̍k in ê êng-kng, hôe-ho̍k in ê hoân-êng.

I ê ióng-sū gia̍h âng ê tún-pâi, chiàn-sū lóng chhēng chu-âng-sek ê chè-ho̍k; tī kau-chiàn ê ji̍t, chiàn-chhia ê kǹg-thih chhin-chhiūⁿ hé iām-iām-sih, in gia̍h chhiuⁿ bú-lâi-bú-khì.
Chiàn-chhia tī koe-lō͘ khoài-sok ti̍t-chhiong, tī khui-khoah ê só͘-chāi chông-chêng-chông-āu; in khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-pé, chhiong-lâi-chhiong-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ sih-nà.
Kun-koaⁿ siū tiàu-chi̍p, chhiⁿ-chhiⁿ-pōng-pōng kóaⁿ óa--lâi, piàⁿ kàu siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng, chiong hông-ōe ê tòng-pâi chhāi--khí-lâi.
Chúi-mn̂g lóng phah-khui, kiong-tiān chhiong bô--khì.
Ông-hō͘ siū lêng-jio̍k hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì; kiong-lú tûi-heng, ai-khàu chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu ê siaⁿ.
Nî-nî-bî chá-chêng chhin-chhiūⁿ tóe-chúi ê chúi-tî, taⁿ lâng it-ti̍t tô-cháu--chhut-khì; ū lâng hoah “Thêng leh, thêng leh”, m̄-kú bô lâng oa̍t tò-tńg--lâi.
Chhiúⁿ o͘h, chhiúⁿ i ê gûn! Kiap i ê kim! Siâⁿ-lāi ū sǹg bōe liáu ê châi-pó, ū ta̍k-khoán ê pó-pòe.
Nî-nî-bî lóng khang-khang lah, bia̍t-bông lah, hong-hòe lah! Lâng ê sim sit-táⁿ, kha-thâu-u phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, io bô-la̍t, bīn chhiⁿ-sún-sún.
Sai ê tōng-hia̍t, sai-á-kiáⁿ chia̍h-mi̍h ê só͘-chāi tī tó-ūi? Liân sai-kang, sai-bú, sai-á-kiáⁿ sì-kòe kiâⁿ, bô siū heh-kiaⁿ ê só͘-chāi mā lóng bô--khì lah.
Sai-kang ūi-tio̍h sai-á-kiáⁿ thiah-li̍h kàu-gia̍h ê chia̍h-mi̍h, ūi-tio̍h sai-bú kā-sí la̍h-bu̍t; i chiong thiah-li̍h--ê tún-móa i ê tōng, chiong kā--tio̍h-ê, chek-móa i ê hia̍t.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, góa beh kong-kek lí, pàng-hé sio-húi lí ê chiàn-chhia, ēng to-kiàm thâi-sí lí ê chiàn-sū. Góa beh tùi tōe-chiūⁿ húi-tiāu lí ê chiàn-lī-phín; lâng bōe koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê sù-chiá ê siaⁿ.”
Chhám ah, thâi-lâng lâu-huih ê siâⁿ, khúi-chà kiông-pō móa-móa, put-sî ū chhiúⁿ-kiap.
Bé-piⁿ phi̍t-phia̍k-kiò, chhia-lián lōng-lōng-háu, chiàn-bé phun-pháu, chiàn-chhia khōng-khōng-kiò;
bé-peng chhiong chìn-chêng, to-kiàm kng-nà-nà, chhiuⁿ iām-iām-sih; siū-thâi--ê chin chōe, sin-si thia̍p kui-tui, si-thé sǹg bōe liáu, lâng hō͘ si-thé khê-tó,
in-ūi chit-ê siâⁿ sī iau-kiau ê chhiong-ki, bê-he̍k lâng ê ang-î; i ēng îm-hēng ín-iú lia̍t-kok, ēng siâ-su̍t bê-he̍k bān-cho̍k.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, góa beh kong-kek lí; góa beh hian lí ê kûn, hian kàu khàm-tio̍h lí ê bīn, hō͘ lia̍t-kok khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê hā-thé, hō͘ lia̍t-pang khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê kiàn-siàu.
Góa beh chiong khó-ò͘ⁿ ù-òe ê mi̍h hiat tī lí ê sin-chiūⁿ, kā lí bú-jio̍k, kong-khai sī-chiòng.
Khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí--ê, lóng ōe cháu-siám, kóng, ‘ Nî-nî-bî hong-hòe lah! Siáⁿ-lâng ōe ūi i ai-siong?’ Góa beh khì tó-ūi chhē-tio̍h an-ùi lí ê lâng?”
Lí kiám ū pí Tí-pí-su khah kian-kò͘? I tī Nî-lô-hô ê hô-piⁿ, ū hô chòe i ê pó-lúi, chúi chòe i ê siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ.
Kó͘-si̍t kap Ai-ki̍p chòe i bô hān-liōng ê khùi-la̍t; Hut kap Lī-pí-a kap i liân-bêng.

Iáu-kú i hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì, liû-hòng khì gōa-kok; i ê eⁿ-á hō͘ lâng siak-sí tī ta̍k-ê koe-lō͘-thâu. I ê kùi-cho̍k hō͘ lâng thiu-chhiam, pun--khì; koaⁿ-oân hō͘ lâng ēng thih-liān pa̍k--teh, lia̍h--khì.
Nî-nî-bî ah, lí mā ōe chiú-chùi, tian-lâi-tian-khì, beh chhē só͘-chāi pī-lān, siám-pī tùi-te̍k.
Lí ê iàu-sài lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ bû-hoa-kó-chhiū, chhiū-téng kiat-móa chho͘-se̍k ê ké-chí; chi̍t-ē iô, ké-chí chiū lak lo̍h-khì beh chia̍h ê lâng ê chhùi-lāi.
Lí khòaⁿ, lín ê chiàn-sū lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ nńg-chiáⁿ ê cha-bó͘-lâng; mn̂g-chhòaⁿ hō͘ hé sio--khì; siâⁿ-mn̂g khui-khui, chhut-chāi tùi-te̍k kong-kek.
Lí tio̍h chhiūⁿ-chúi, chún-pī siū ûi-khùn; tio̍h ka-kiông hông-ōe; tio̍h khì thô͘-khut ta̍h liâm-thô͘, siu-lí chng-á-iô.

M̄-kú, tī hia lí ōe hō͘ hé sio-bia̍t, hō͘ to thâi-sí; lí ōe siū húi-bia̍t, chhin-chhiūⁿ lông-chok-bu̍t hō͘ chháu-meh-á-kiáⁿ chia̍h-liáu-liáu. Chhut-chāi lí ke-thiⁿ jîn-sò͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh-á-kiáⁿ, chhut-chāi lí ke-thiⁿ jîn-sò͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh hiah chōe.
Lí ke-thiⁿ lí ê seng-lí-lâng, chōe kah chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ; m̄-kú in chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh-á-kiáⁿ thí-si̍t pe-cháu.
Lí ê kùi-cho̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu-meh, lí ê koaⁿ-oân chhin-chhiūⁿ kui-tīn ê chháu-meh-kong, thiⁿ-khì léng, hioh tī lî-pa, ji̍t chhut chiū pe--khì, lâng m̄ chai in khì tó-ūi.
A-su̍t -ông ah, lí ê koaⁿ-oân teh tuh-ku, lí ê kùi-cho̍k teh khùn; lí ê jîn-bîn sì-sòaⁿ tī soaⁿ-téng, bô lâng kā in chio-chi̍p.
Lí ê siong bōe-i--tit; lí siū phah chin siong-tiōng; thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê siau-sit--ê, lóng ōe phah-pho̍k-á. Siáⁿ-lâng m̄-bat in-ūi lí ê chân-jím siū-hāi?
Ē-bīn sī sian-ti Hap-pa-kok só͘ soan-kò tùi Siōng Chú lâi ê sìn-sit.
Siōng Chú ah, góa tùi lí âu-kiò, lí bô thiaⁿ, beh jōa kú ah? Góa hoah “Ū kiông-pō”, lí ná bô lâi kái-kiù?

Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ beh hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ siâ-ok? Chai-lān chiah chōe, lí ná bô beh chhap? Tī góa bīn-chêng ū húi-bia̍t kap kiông-pō; chhiong-tu̍t kap tò͘-cheng put-sî teh hoat-seng.
In-ūi án-ni, lu̍t-hoat sit-khì hāu-le̍k, chèng-gī bōe-tàng si-hêng; pháiⁿ-lâng khi-ap gī-lâng, tì-kàu chèng-gī siū oai-khiok.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Chù-ì koan-chhat lín chiu-ûi ê kok-ka, lín ōe chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ. Tī lín oa̍h--teh ê ji̍t, góa beh chòe chi̍t hāng tāi-chì, kā lín kóng, lín mā bōe siong-sìn.
Lín khòaⁿ, góa beh hō͘ chân-jím hiong-pō ê Pa-pí-lûn kiông-sēng khí--lâi; in beh chìn-kun choân sè-kài, pà-chiàm pa̍t-lâng ê thó͘-tōe;
in khó-phàⁿ khióng-pò͘, gán-tiong-bû-jîn, ēng ka-kī ê ì-chì tēng hoat-lu̍t.

“In ê chiàn-bé pí pà cháu khah kín, pí hông-hun ê chhâi-lông khah béng. Bé-peng tùi hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi, phun-pháu ti̍t-chông, chhin-chhiūⁿ eng-chiáu chhiong lo̍h-lâi beh thun-chia̍h.
In lâi beh kiâⁿ kiông-pō; in kian-koat hiòng-chêng chìn-kong, lia̍h--tio̍h ê hu-ló͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ soa hiah chōe.
In biáu-sī kun-ông, ki-chhì chip-chèng-chiá; in thí-chhiò só͘-ū ê pó-lúi, chō thô͘-tui kā in kong-chhú.
In chhin-chhiūⁿ hong sàu--kè liáu-āu, koh kè-sio̍k hiòng-chêng; in sī ū-chōe ê lâng, pài ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t chòe sîn-bêng.”

Siōng Chú ah, lí kiám m̄-sī tùi kó͘-chá chiū chûn-chāi? Lí sī Chì-sèng, sī goán ê Siōng-tè, lí éng-oán bōe sí. Siōng Chú ah, lí kèng-jiân kéng-soán Pa-pí-lûn lâi sím-phòaⁿ goán. Goán ê Chio̍h-pôaⁿ ah, lí kèng-jiân chí-phài i lâi hêng-hoa̍t goán.

Lí ê ba̍k-chiu chheng-khì kah bōe khòaⁿ siâ-ok, bōe khòaⁿ pháiⁿ-tāi. Sī-án-chóaⁿ lí iông-jím khúi-chà ê lâng? Siâ-ok ê lâng thun-bia̍t pí in khah chèng-ti̍t ê lâng, sī-án-chóaⁿ lí tìⁿ-tiām-tiām?
Lí hō͘ lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ hái--ni̍h ê hî, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh sô ê thâng, bô léng-siù kā in koán-lí.
Pa-pí-lûn ēng hî-kau kā in kau, ēng bāng kā in pha, ēng hî-bāng kā in bāng, kā in lia̍h-liáu-liáu. Pa-pí-lûn chiū hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k,
tùi bāng hiàn-chè, tùi hî-bāng sio-hiuⁿ, in-ūi in khò bāng tit-tio̍h hong-hù ê chia̍h-mi̍h, seng-oa̍h chhia-chhí.
In kiám thang án-ni kè-sio̍k pha-bāng lia̍h-hî, bô-chêng chân-sat lia̍t-kok ê jîn-bîn?
Góa beh peh-chiūⁿ siú-bōng-tâi, khiā tī pó-lúi téng koan-khòaⁿ, thèng-hāu Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng sím-mi̍h, khòaⁿ I beh án-chóaⁿ ìn-tap góa ê bâi-oàn.
Siōng Chú ìn góa kóng, “Chiong chit-ê khé-sī siá--lo̍h-lâi, chheng-chhó khek tī pán--ni̍h, hō͘ lâng chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ chiū bêng-pe̍k.

Chit-ê khé-sī teh thèng-hāu chí-tēng ê sî-kan; sî-kan chi̍t-ē kàu, só͘ kóng ê kiat-kio̍k chiū ōe si̍t-hiān. Chí-tēng ê sî-kan sui-jiân kám-kak khah bān, iáu-kú tio̍h tán, in-ūi it-tēng ōe lâi, bōe iân-tî.
Lí khòaⁿ, sim bô chèng-ti̍t ê lâng chū-ko chū-tāi, m̄-kú gī ê lâng ōe tùi sìn lâi oa̍h.”

Châi-hù ōe bê-he̍k lâng, hō͘ lâng kiau-ngō͘, tham-io̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ Im-hú thūn bōe tīⁿ; i ê sim chhin-chhiūⁿ sí-bông bōe boán-chiok, siūⁿ-beh cheng-ho̍k bān-kok, hō͘ bān-bîn lóng kui-sūn i.

Siū cheng-ho̍k ê lâng ōe ēng sio̍k-gú phì-jū kā i ki-chhì phì-siùⁿ kóng, “Lí chhám ah! Lí tún-chek thau-the̍h--lâi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, ēng pa̍t-lâng ê tí-ah thàn tōa chîⁿ, lí chòe chit-khoán pháiⁿ-tāi beh kàu tī-sî?”
Hō͘ lí pak-siah ê lâng kiám bōe hut-jiân heng-khí? In kiám bōe heng-ōng hō͘ lí phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah? Hit-sî lí ōe pìⁿ-chòe in ê la̍h-bu̍t.
Lí ū chhiúⁿ-kiap chin chōe kok-ka, lia̍t-kok tiong só͘ chhun ê lâng mā ōe kā lí chhiúⁿ; in-ūi lí ū lâu lâng ê huih, húi-bia̍t kéng-lāi ê siâⁿ-chhī kap lāi-bīn ê chū-bîn.
Ūi ka-kī ê ke chek-chū put-gī ê chîⁿ-châi, tī koân ê só͘-chāi choh-siū ǹg-bāng thoat-lī chai-lān, chit-khoán lâng chhám ah!
Lí kè-bô͘ beh húi-bia̍t chin chōe kok ê jîn-bîn, soah hō͘ lí ê ke siū thí-jio̍k, hāi-tio̍h ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā,
liân piah ê chio̍h to ōe âu-kiò, chhù ê niû mā ōe ìn-siaⁿ.
Ēng thâi-lâng lâu-huih kiàn-chō siâⁿ, ēng chōe-kò kiàn-li̍p siâⁿ-chhī, chit-khoán lâng chhám ah!
Lí khòaⁿ, jîn-bîn lô-lo̍k tit--tio̍h-ê hō͘ hé sio--khì, lia̍t-kok thoa-bôa tit--tio̍h-ê lóng lo̍k-khong, che kiám m̄-sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê chok-ûi?
Choân-tōe beh chhiong-móa tùi Siōng Chú êng-kng ê jīm-sek, chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi chhiong-móa hái-iûⁿ.
Hō͘ chhù-piⁿ lim-chiú, lim kah chùi-bâng-bâng, thang khòaⁿ in chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, chit-khoán lâng chhám ah!

Lí tit--tio̍h-ê m̄-sī chun-êng, sī ke̍k-tōa ê lêng-jio̍k. Taⁿ ōaⁿ lí lim, lim kah tang-tó-sai-oai. Siōng Chú tōa siū-khì ê poe ōe lûn kàu lí hia, lí ê êng-kng ōe pìⁿ-chòe kiàn-siàu.

Lí ū tùi Lê-pa-lūn chòe hiong-pō ê sū, lí ōe siū khah-tōa ê hiong-pō; iá-siù tú--tio̍h ê húi-bia̍t, ōe hō͘ lí kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. Lí it-tēng ōe siū pò-èng, in-ūi lí ū lâu lâng ê huih, húi-bia̍t kéng-lāi ê siâⁿ-chhī kap lāi-bīn ê chū-bîn.

Tiau-khek ê siōng sī lâng chō--ê, ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek? Chù-chō ê ngó͘-siōng kà lâng hu-ké, ū sím-mi̍h lō͘-ēng? Sai-hū óa-khò ka-kī só͘ chō--ê, i chō--ê put-kò sī bōe kóng-ōe ê ngó͘-siōng.

Tùi chhâ-thâu kóng “Chhíⁿ--khí-lâi”, tùi bōe kóng-ōe ê chio̍h-thâu kóng “Peh--khí-lâi”, chit-khoán lâng chhám ah! Ngó͘-siōng kiám ōe kà-sī lâng? Lí khòaⁿ, ngó͘-siōng put-kò sī ēng kim ēng gûn pau--ê, lāi-bīn lóng bô sìⁿ-miā.
Siōng Chú tī I ê sèng-tiān, choân-tōe tī I ê bīn-chêng lóng tio̍h siok-chēng.
Sian-ti Hap-pa-kok ê kî-tó; tiāu, ēng “Lī-pia̍t”.

Siōng Chú ah, góa thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê miâ-siaⁿ kap lí ê só͘-chòe chiū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. Siōng Chú ah, kiû lí tī goán ê sè-tāi hō͘ goán koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí úi-tāi ê chok-ûi, tī lí tōa siū-khì ê sî, kiû lí ōe-kì-tit lîn-bín goán!
Siōng-tè tùi Thê-bān lâi, sîn-sèng ê Siōng-tè tùi Pa-lân-soaⁿ lo̍h--lâi. I ê êng-kng khàm-móa thiⁿ; chheng-chàn I ê siaⁿ chhiong-móa choân-tōe.
I ê chhàn-lān chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t-kng; I ê chhiú chiáng-ak khùi-la̍t, tùi hia siā-chhut sih-nà.
Un-e̍k kiâⁿ tī I ê thâu-chêng, jia̍t-pīⁿ tè tī I ê āu-bīn.

I khiā--teh, tāi-tōe chiū tín-tāng; I chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ, lia̍t-pang chiū phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah. Bān-nî ê tōa-soaⁿ pang--lo̍h-lâi; chhian-kó͘ ê sió-soaⁿ tîm--lo̍h-khì. Siōng-tè ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe, éng-oán bô kái-piàn.
Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h Kó͘-san ê pò͘-pîⁿ siū thiah-húi, Bí-tiân -lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi siū húi-hoāi.
Siōng Chú ah, lí khiâ-bé, chē tek-sèng ê chiàn-chhia lâi, kiám sī teh tùi khoe hoat siū-khì, tùi kang-hô khí sèng-tē, tùi hái-iûⁿ hoat tōa siū-khì?
Lí ê keng lóng gia̍h--chhut-lâi, chìⁿ mā í-keng an hó-sè. Lí ēng kang-hô pun-khui tāi-tōe.
Soaⁿ-niá khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí lóng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; tōa-chúi chhiong--kè, chhim-ian chhut tōa-siaⁿ, tōa-éng chhèng-koân.
Lí ê chìⁿ siā-chhut kng, lí ê chhiuⁿ iām-iām-sih, ji̍t kap ge̍h soah thêng tī goân-ūi.
Lí hoat siū-khì piàn-kiâⁿ choân-tōe; lí tōa siū-khì thún-ta̍h lia̍t-kok.
Lí chhut-lâi beh kái-kiù lí ê chú-bîn, chín-kiù lí soán-li̍p ê ông. Lí thiah-húi pháiⁿ-lâng ê chhù-téng, thiah kah liân tōe-ki to lō͘-hiān.
Lí ēng chhiuⁿ chha̍k-thàng in ê chiàn-sū ê thâu; in lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ pō-hong kā góa chhe-cháu; in ài tī àm-tiong thun-chia̍h khùn-khó͘-lâng.
Lí khiâ-bé chhiong-kè tōa-hái, hō͘ hái-chúi ká-kún giâ-éng.

Góa chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ--tio̍h, kui seng-khu phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah; hit-ê siaⁿ hō͘ góa ê chhùi-tûn gi̍h-gi̍h-chùn, kut-thâu so͘--khì, kha khiā bōe tiâu. Góa kan-ta ōe-tàng tiām-tiām-á thèng-hāu kong-kek goán ê lâng tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê ji̍t lâi-lîm.
Sui-jiân bû-hoa-kó-chhiū bô puh-íⁿ, phû-tô-chhiū bô kiat ké-chí, kaⁿ-ná-chhiū bô siu-sêng, chhân-hn̂g bô chhut ngó͘-kok, tiâu-lāi bô pòaⁿ-chiah iûⁿ, gû-tiâu mā bô gû,
góa iáu-kú beh in-ūi Siōng Chú lâi hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi kiù góa ê Siōng-tè lâi khoài-lo̍k.

Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú sī góa ê khùi-la̍t; I hō͘ góa ê kha chhin-chhiūⁿ lo̍k-bú gâu cháu, hō͘ góa tī koân ê só͘-chāi kha-pō͘ an-ún. Kau hō͘ sèng-ga̍k-tiúⁿ, ēng hiân-ga̍k phōaⁿ-chàu.
A-bûn ê kiáⁿ Iok-se-a choh Iû-tāi -ông ê sî, Siōng Chú tùi Hi-se-ka ê goân-sun, A-má-lī-ngá ê cheng-sun, Ki-tāi-lī ê sun, Kó͘-sī ê kiáⁿ Se-hoan-ngá kóng chiah-ê ōe.
Siōng Chú kóng: Góa beh tùi tōe-chiūⁿ thiat-tóe tû-bia̍t bān-mi̍h.

Góa beh tû-bia̍t lâng kap cheng-siⁿ, tû-bia̍t khong-tiong ê chiáu kap hái--ni̍h ê hî. Góa beh hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng poa̍h-tó bōe koh khí--lâi, beh tùi tōe-chiūⁿ húi-bia̍t choân jîn-lūi. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-kò.

Góa beh chhun-chhiú kong-kek Iû-tāi, kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘-ū ê chū-bîn. Góa mā beh tùi chit-ê só͘-chāi húi-bia̍t iáu-teh pài Pa-le̍k ê lâng, í-ki̍p ho̍k-sāi ngó͘-siōng ê chè-si.
Só͘-ū tī chhù-téng pài thiⁿ-téng bān-siōng--ê, kap hiah-ê kèng-pài Siōng Chú kí góa chiù-chōa, siâng-sî koh kí sîn-bêng Bí-le̍k-kong chiù-chōa--ê,
í-ki̍p pōe-poān Siōng Chú, bô chhē-kiû góa, bô kiû góa pang-chān ê lâng, góa lóng beh kā in húi-bia̍t.

Lí tio̍h tī Chì-koân Siōng Chú ê bīn-chêng siok-chēng, in-ūi Siōng Chú ê ji̍t teh-beh kàu lah. Siōng Chú í-keng chún-pī beh hi-seng I ê chú-bîn, beh kiò tùi-te̍k lâi thun-chia̍h Iû-tāi.
Siōng Chú kóng, “Tī hiàn-chè ê ji̍t, góa beh hêng-hoa̍t kùi-cho̍k kap ông ê chèng-kiáⁿ, í-ki̍p lóng-chóng chhēng gōa-pang-lâng ê saⁿ--ê.
Hit-ji̍t, góa beh hêng-hoa̍t it-chhè hāⁿ-kè hō͘-tēng, hō͘ chú-lâng ê chhù chhiong-móa kiông-pō kap khúi-chà ê lâng.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Hit-ji̍t, tī Hî-mn̂g ū hoah-hiu, tī sin ê siâⁿ-khu ū ai-khàu, tùi soaⁿ-téng ū soaⁿ-pang ê siaⁿ hoat-chhut.
Tòa tī kē ê siâⁿ-khu ê lâng ah, tio̍h ai-kiò, in-ūi seng-lí-lâng lóng ōe siau-bia̍t, ēng gûn bóe-bōe ê ū-chîⁿ-lâng lóng ōe siū châu-bia̍t.
Hit-sî góa beh tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng gia̍h teng chhiau-chhē; góa beh hêng-hoa̍t hiah-ê chū-boán chū-tāi ê lâng, in siūⁿ-kóng ‘Siōng Chú bōe sù-hok, mā bōe kàng-chai’.
In ê châi-bu̍t ōe hō͘ lâng chhiúⁿ--khì, in ê chhù-the̍h ōe hong-hòe; in khí-chhù, bōe-tàng tòa; chai-chèng phû-tô, mā bô chiú thang lim.”
Siōng Chú ê tōa Ji̍t-chí kūn lah, chin kūn, liâm-piⁿ chiū kàu. Thiaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú ê ji̍t sī thòng-khó͘ ê ji̍t, ióng-sū to ōe kan-khó͘ ai-kiò.
Hit-ji̍t sī Siōng Chú tōa siū-khì ê ji̍t, hoān-lān khùn-khó͘ ê ji̍t, tōa chai-lān chhiⁿ-chhìn ê ji̍t, o͘-o͘-àm-àm ê ji̍t, o͘-hûn khàm-ba̍t ê ji̍t,
pûn sàu-kak háng-hoah ê ji̍t; tùi-te̍k beh kong-kek kian-kò͘ ê siâⁿ, kong-kek siâⁿ-kak ê koân-thah.

Góa beh hō͘ lâng tú-tio̍h khùn-khó͘, hō͘ in chhin-chhiūⁿ sit-bêng ê lâng kiâⁿ-lō͘, in-ūi in tek-chōe Siōng Chú; in ê huih ōe siū piàⁿ-chhut chhin-chhiūⁿ teh piàⁿ thô͘-hún, tn̂g-á-tn̂g-tō͘ hō͘ lâng hiat-ka̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ teh hiat pùn-sò.

Siōng Chú tōa siū-khì ê ji̍t, lâng ê kim gûn bōe-tàng kiù in. Choân-tōe ōe hō͘ Siōng Chú béng-lia̍t siū-khì ê hé thun-bia̍t, in-ūi I ōe chin kín châu-bia̍t tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū ê chū-bîn.

M̄-chai kiàn-siàu ê kok-ka, tio̍h chū-chi̍p! Tī bēng-lēng iáu-bē hoat-chhut, ji̍t-chí iáu-bē chhin-chhiūⁿ chho͘-khng pe--khì, Siōng Chú tōa siū-khì iáu-bē kàu, I siū-khì ê ji̍t iáu-bē lîm-kàu lín í-chêng, tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín chū-chi̍p!

Tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū pi-bî, chun-thàn Siōng Chú bēng-lēng ê lâng, tio̍h chhē-kiû Siōng Chú, chhē kong-gī, kiû khiam-pi; án-ni tī Siōng Chú siū-khì ê ji̍t, lín chiah thang tô-pī chai-lān.
Ka-sat ōe siū khì-sak, A-si̍t-ki-lûn ōe hong-hòe, A-si̍t-tu̍t ōe tī thàu-tiong-tàu siū kóaⁿ-chhut, Í-kek-lûn ōe hō͘ lâng liân kun khau--khí-lâi.

Tòa tī iân-hái ê Ki-lī-thê -lâng chhám ah! Hui-lī-sū -lâng teh tòa ê Ka-lâm -tōe ah, Siōng Chú tùi lín soan-phòaⁿ kóng, “Góa beh thiat-tóe kā lí châu-bia̍t, bô lâng lâu tī chia.”
Iân-hái ê tōe ōe pìⁿ-chòe chháu-tiûⁿ, pìⁿ-chòe ū bo̍k-chiá ê chháu-liâu-á, ū iûⁿ-tiâu.

Chit-ê tōe ōe kui hō͘ Iû-tāi só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn, in ōe tī hia chhī iûⁿ; ē-hng-sî in ōe tī A-si̍t-ki-lûn ê chhù hioh-khùn; in-ūi Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè ōe chiàu-kò͘ in, hō͘ siū-lia̍h ê lâng tò-tńg--lâi.
Góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Mô͘-ap ê bú-jio̍k, A-bûn -lâng ê thí-chhiò; in bú-jio̍k góa ê chú-bîn, khióng-hat beh chhim-chiàm in ê kok-thó͘.

In-ūi án-ni, Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni soan-kò, “Góa kí góa ê sìⁿ-miā li̍p-sè, Mô͘-ap ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Só͘-to-má, A-bûn -lâng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Gô-mô͘-la, chhì-phè móa-sì-kòe, piàn-tōe ū iâm-khiⁿ, éng-oán hong-hòe. Góa só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn ōe kā in chhiúⁿ-toa̍t; góa kok-lāi lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê jîn-bîn ōe chhim-chiàm in ê thó͘-tōe.”
In siū-tio̍h chit-ê pò-èng, sī in-ūi in kiau-ngō͘; in bú-jio̍k, khióng-hat Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê chú-bîn.
Siōng Chú beh tùi in hián-chhut ui-giâm, hō͘ sè-chiūⁿ ê sîn-bêng soe-bî; lia̍t-kok kap chèng hái-tó ê chū-bîn lóng ōe tī ka-kī tòa ê só͘-chāi kèng-pài Siōng Chú.
Kó͘-si̍t -lâng ah, lín mā ōe hō͘ góa ê to thâi--sí.
Siōng Chú beh chhun-chhiú kong-kek pak-hng, châu-bia̍t A-su̍t; hō͘ Nî-nî-bî hong-hòe, chhin-chhiūⁿ ta-sò ê khòng-iá.
Ta̍k-chióng ê iá-siù ōe kui-kûn hioh tī hia; thê-ô͘ kap hô-ti hioh tī thiāu-chō téng-bīn; thang-á lāi ū háu ê siaⁿ, hō͘-tēng húi-hoāi, pek-hiuⁿ-chhâ-pán lō͘-chhut.

Chit-ê iàn-lo̍k an-jiân khiā-khí ê siâⁿ, bat sim-lāi kóng, “Góa sī choân sè-kài siōng úi-tāi ê siâⁿ!” Taⁿ kèng-jiân chiah-ni̍h hong-hòe, chiâⁿ-chòe iá-siù hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi! Tùi hia keng-kè ê lâng, lóng ōe hàiⁿ-thâu thí-chhiò.
Chit-ê pōe-ge̍k, ù-òe, khi-ap ê siâⁿ, chhám ah!
I bô thiaⁿ ōe, bô siū kà-sī, bô óa-khò Siōng Chú, bô chhin-kūn i ka-kī ê Siōng-tè.
I ê kùi-cho̍k tī siâⁿ-lāi sī hm̄-hm̄-háu ê sai; i ê sím-phòaⁿ-koaⁿ sī mî--sî ê chhâi-lông, liân chi̍t-tè-á kut-thâu to bô lâu kàu thiⁿ-kng.
I ê sian-ti kóng-ōe bô hū-chek, choh-lâng khúi-chà; i ê chè-si phah lâ-sâm sèng-só͘, lām-iōng lu̍t-hoat.
Tī in tiong-kan ê Siōng Chú sī kong-gī--ê, bô chòe put-gī ê sū. I ta̍k chá-khí si-hêng sím-phòaⁿ, mî-ji̍t bô-thêng; m̄-kú put-gī ê lâng m̄-chai kiàn-siàu.

Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa í-keng siau-bia̍t lia̍t-kok, húi-hoāi in siâⁿ-kak ê thah; góa hō͘ in ê koe-lō͘ léng-léng-chheng-chheng, bô lâng keng-kè; in ê siâⁿ hong-hòe, bô lâng lâu tī hia, lóng bô lâng khiā-khí.

Góa kóng, ‘Lí eng-kai tio̍h kèng-ùi góa, tio̍h siū kà-sī, chiah bián siâⁿ-lāi ê chhù chiàu góa ê phòaⁿ-tēng siū châu-bia̍t.’ M̄-kú in tian-tò put-toān chòe pāi-hoāi ê tāi-chì.”

Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Só͘-í, lín tio̍h thèng-hāu góa, kàu góa khí-lâi khòng-kò lia̍t-kok hit-ji̍t; in-ūi góa í-keng koat-tēng beh tiàu-chi̍p lia̍t-kok, chū-chi̍p lia̍t-pang, chiong góa ê tōa siū-khì tùi in piàⁿ-lo̍h; choân-tōe it-tēng ōe hō͘ góa béng-lia̍t siū-khì ê hé thun-bia̍t.
“Hit-sî góa beh kiat-chēng bān-bîn ê chhùi-tûn, hō͘ in thang kiû-kiò Siōng Chú ê miâ, tâng-sim chi̍t-ì ho̍k-sāi góa.
Góa phah-sòaⁿ ê chú-bîn ōe tùi Kó͘-si̍t ê hô hit-pêng tńg--lâi, tùi góa kî-tó hiàn lé-mi̍h.

“Tī hit-ji̍t, lín bōe koh in-ūi it-chhè tek-chōe góa ê sū kiàn-siàu; hit-sî góa beh tùi lín tiong-kan tû-khì khoa-kháu kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng, lín chiū bōe koh tī góa ê sèng-soaⁿ chū-ko.
Góa ōe lâu sàn-chhiah pi-bî ê lâng tī lín tiong-kan, in ōe óa-khò góa Siōng Chú tit-tio̍h pó-hō͘.
Í-sek-lia̍t só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn bōe koh chòe pháiⁿ, bōe koh kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, chhùi-lāi bô khúi-chà ê chi̍h; in ōe hó-chia̍h hó-khùn, bōe koh hō͘ lâng heh-kiaⁿ.”
Sek-an ah, tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa! Í-sek-lia̍t ah, tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ hoan-ho͘! Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, tio̍h móa-sim hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k!
Siōng Chú í-keng thiat-siau tùi lí ê sím-phòaⁿ, chiong lí ê tùi-te̍k kóaⁿ-cháu. Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Ông kap lí tông-chāi; lí bián koh kiaⁿ chai-hāi.
Tī hit-ji̍t, lâng ōe tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kóng, “ Sek-an ah, m̄-thang kiaⁿ! M̄-bián kha-sng-chhiú-nńg.

Siōng Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè kap lí tông-chāi; I ū tōa khùi-la̍t si-hêng chín-kiù, I ōe in-ūi lí hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, I ōe in-ūi thiàⁿ lí, hō͘ lí ê sìⁿ-miā ōaⁿ-sin, koh in-ūi lí, hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Góa beh chū-chi̍p hiah-ê in-ūi bōe-tàng siú-choeh sim kan-khó͘ ê lâng, hō͘ in bián koh taⁿ siū lêng-jio̍k ê tāng-tàⁿ.

Hit-sî, góa beh hêng-hoa̍t khi-ap lín--ê, kái-kiù kha-pái--ê, chū-chi̍p siū hòng-tio̍k--ê. Góa beh hō͘ hiah-ê tī ta̍k só͘-chāi siū lêng-jio̍k--ê, tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn kap chun-êng.

Hit-sî, góa beh kā lín chū-chi̍p, chhōa lín tńg--lâi. Góa hō͘ lín chiah-ê siū-lia̍h ê lâng hôe-ho̍k hoân-êng ê sî, lín ōe chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín tī tōe-chiūⁿ bān-bîn ê tiong-kan tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn kap chun-êng.” Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

Tāi-liû-sū chòe Pho-su Hông-tè tē-jī nî la̍k-ge̍h chhoe-it, Siōng Chú kau-tài sian-ti Hap-kai thoân-ōe hō͘ Sat-la-thiat ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi séng-tiúⁿ Só͘-lô-pa-pek kap Iok-sat-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ tōa-chè-si Iâ-su-a.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Chiah-ê jîn-bîn kóng Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān tiông-kiàn ê sî iáu-bē kàu.”
Hit-sî, Siōng Chú kau-tài sian-ti Hap-kai thoân-ōe kóng,
“Chit-ê sèng-tiān iáu hong-hòe, lín ka-kī kiám thang tòa tī chong-hông sù-sī ê chhù?”
Só͘-í Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Lín tio̍h iōng-sim kiám-thó lín ê hêng-ûi.

Lín iā-chéng chōe, siu-sêng chió; lín chia̍h, m̄-bat chia̍h kàu pá; lín lim, m̄-bat lim kàu chí-khoah; lín chhēng, m̄-bat chhēng kàu sio; lín thàn-chîⁿ, lóng khǹg lo̍h-khì phòa-khang ê chîⁿ-tē.”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Tio̍h iōng-sim kiám-thó lín ê hêng-ûi.
Tio̍h peh-khì soaⁿ-téng, chhú chi̍t-kóa bo̍k-châi, khí chi̍t keng góa ì-ài ê tiān, hō͘ góa thang hián-sī góa ê êng-kng. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.

“Lín kî-thāi hong-siu, tian-tò siu khah chió; the̍h--tńg-lâi--ê, góa ēng hong kā in chhe-cháu. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng: Sī-án-chóaⁿ góa beh án-ni chòe? In-ūi góa ê tiān iáu hong-hòe, lín ta̍k-ê lâng kèng-jiân ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê chhù teh bô-êng.
Só͘-í, thiⁿ bô lo̍h-hō͘, tōe bô chhut thó͘-sán.

Góa beh ēng khòng-hān hō͘ thó͘-tōe, soaⁿ-niá, ngó͘-kok, sin-chiú, kaⁿ-ná-iû, tōe ê chhut-sán-bu̍t, jîn-lūi, cheng-siⁿ, í-ki̍p lâng lô-khó͘ tit--tio̍h ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, lóng siū-tio̍h chai-hāi.”

Hit-sî, Sat-la-thiat ê kiáⁿ Só͘-lô-pa-pek kap Iok-sat-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ tōa-chè-si Iâ-su-a, í-ki̍p só͘ chhun ê chú-bîn, lóng ho̍k-chiông Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, chiū-sī Siōng Chú chhe-phài--lâi ê sian-ti Hap-kai ê sìn-sit. Chèng-lâng mā lóng kèng-ùi Siōng Chú.
Jiân-āu, Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá Hap-kai hōng Siōng Chú chhe-phài, tùi jîn-bîn thoân-ōe kóng, “Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Góa kap lín tông-chāi.’”

Siōng Chú ū kám-tōng Sat-la-thiat ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi séng-tiúⁿ Só͘-lô-pa-pek, kap Iok-sat-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ tōa-chè-si Iâ-su-a ê sim, koh kám-tōng lóng-chóng só͘ chhun ê lâng ê sim; in lóng lâi tiông-kiàn Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, in ê Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān.
In tī Tāi-liû-sū -ông tē-jī nî la̍k-ge̍h jī-cha̍p-sì ji̍t khai-kang.
Chhit-ge̍h jī-it, Siōng Chú thong-kè sian-ti Hap-kai thoân-ōe, kóng,
“Taⁿ, lí tio̍h kā Sat-la-thiat ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi séng-tiúⁿ Só͘-lô-pa-pek kap Iok-sat-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ tōa-chè-si Iâ-su-a, í-ki̍p só͘ chhun ê jîn-bîn kóng,

‘Lín chiah-ê iáu oa̍h--teh ê lâng, sím-mi̍h-lâng bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tiān kó͘-chá ê êng-kng? Hiān-chāi lín khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê sī sím-mi̍h khoán? Tī lín ê ba̍k-chiu chêng kiám m̄-sī sím-mi̍h lóng bô?’

Siōng Chú kóng, ‘ Só͘-lô-pa-pek, tio̍h kian-kiông! Iok-sat-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ tōa-chè-si Iâ-su-a, tio̍h kian-kiông!’ Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Só͘-ū tòa tī chit-tè tōe ê jîn-bîn, tio̍h kian-kiông!’ Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe koh kóng, ‘Tio̍h chòe kang! Góa kap lín tông-chāi!
Che sī kun-kù lín chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî góa hō͘ lín ê èng-ún. Góa kè-sio̍k kap lín tông-chāi. M̄-bián kiaⁿ!’
“Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, ‘Koh bô-jōa-kú, góa beh koh chi̍t piàn hō͘ thiⁿ, tōe, hái, kap ta-tōe lóng iô-choah.’
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, ‘Góa beh hō͘ bān-kok iô-choah, hō͘ bān-kok ê châi-pó ūn-lâi chia, hō͘ chit-ê tiān chhiong-móa êng-kng.’
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, ‘Gûn sī góa ê, kim mā-sī góa ê.’

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe koh kóng, ‘Sin-khí ê tiān ê êng-kng ōe chhiau-kè chá-chêng ê tiān ê êng-kng. Tī chit-ê só͘-chāi, góa beh siúⁿ-sù hô-pêng hoân-êng.’ Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Tāi-liû-sū chē-ūi tē-jī nî káu-ge̍h jī-cha̍p-sì, Siōng Chú tùi sian-ti Hap-kai kóng,
“Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, ‘Lí khì kìⁿ chè-si, kā in mn̄g iú-koan lu̍t-hoat ê būn-tôe.

Nā ū lâng ēng saⁿ-á-ku pau hōng-hiàn-kui-sèng ê bah, jiân-āu saⁿ-á-ku khì kha̍p-tio̍h piáⁿ, thng, chiú, iû, á-sī kî-tha chia̍h-mi̍h, hit-ê chia̍h-mi̍h kiám ōe-tàng sǹg-chòe sèng?’” Chè-si ìn kóng, “Bōe.”

Hap-kai koh kóng, “Nā ū lâng bong-tio̍h si-thé soah bô chheng-khì, i bong--tio̍h ê chia̍h-mi̍h kiám ōe sǹg-chòe bô chheng-khì?” Chè-si ìn kóng, “Ōe, hit-ê chia̍h-mi̍h sǹg-chòe bô chheng-khì.”

Jiân-āu Hap-kai kóng, “Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Chit-ê chú-bîn, chit-ê kok tī góa ba̍k-chiu chêng chiū-sī án-ni; in ê chhiú só͘ chòe ta̍k-hāng kang-chok, só͘ hiàn ta̍k-hāng chè-mi̍h mā lóng bô chheng-khì.’”
“Taⁿ lín tio̍h iōng-sim kiám-thó, tī Siōng Chú ê tiān tiông-kiàn í-chêng,

lín án-chóaⁿ teh kè-ji̍t? Ū lâng khì ngó͘-kok-tui, siūⁿ-kóng ōe tit-tio̍h jī-cha̍p táu sió-be̍h, chí-ū tit-tio̍h cha̍p táu; khì chiú-tî, siūⁿ-kóng ōe tit-tio̍h gō͘-cha̍p tháng chiú, chí-ū tit-tio̍h jī-cha̍p tháng.
Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Góa ēng hé-sio-hong, pīⁿ-hāi, peng-pha̍uh kā lín chhú-hoa̍t, lín iáu bô hóe-kái.
Tùi kin-á-ji̍t, káu-ge̍h jī-sì, chiū-sī hē Siōng Chú sèng-tiān ê tōe-ki ê ji̍t khí, lín tio̍h iōng-sim kiám-thó, tio̍h séng-chhat.

Chhng-khò͘--ni̍h iáu ū chéng-chí bô? Sui-jiân phû-tô-chhiū, bû-hoa-kó-chhiū, sia̍h-liû-chhiū, kaⁿ-ná-chhiū lóng iáu-bē kiat ké-chí, m̄-kú tùi kin-á-ji̍t khí góa beh sù-hok hō͘ lín.’”
Siâng hit-ji̍t, chiū-sī káu-ge̍h jī-sì, Siōng Chú tē-jī piàn tùi Hap-kai kóng,
“Lí khì kā Iû-tāi séng-tiúⁿ Só͘-lô-pa-pek kóng, ‘Góa teh-beh hō͘ thiⁿ kap tōe iô-choah,
thui-hoan lia̍t-kok ê sè-le̍k, koh chiong-chí in ê koân-le̍k, chhia-tó chiàn-chhia kap sái-chhia--ê, hō͘ bé sí peng bông, kun-tiong hiaⁿ-tī hō͘-siōng chân-sat.’

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, ‘ Sat-la-thiat ê kiáⁿ, góa ê po̍k-jîn Só͘-lô-pa-pek, góa Siōng Chú kóng: Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh ēng lí chòe góa ê chhiú-chí-ìn, in-ūi góa ū kéng-soán lí!’ Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Tāi-liû-sū chē-ūi tē-jī nî poeh--ge̍h, Siōng Chú tùi E̍k-to ê sun, Pí-lī-ka ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Sat-ka-lī-a kóng,
“Siōng Chú tùi lín ê chó͘-sian hoat tōa siū-khì.

Só͘-í lí tio̍h kā jîn-bîn kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni hoan-hù: Lín tio̍h kui-ǹg góa, góa chiū choán-ǹg lín.’ Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.

M̄-thang o̍h lín ê chó͘-sian. Í-chêng ê sian-ti bat tùi in soan-pò͘: Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, ‘Tio̍h hôe-thâu lī-khui lín ê pháiⁿ-lō͘ kap pháiⁿ hêng-ûi.’ M̄-kú in m̄ thiaⁿ, m̄ sūn-chiông góa. Che sī Siōng Chú kóng--ê.
Taⁿ lín ê chó͘-sian tī tó-ūi? Hiah-ê sian-ti kiám ōe éng-oán oa̍h--teh?

M̄-kú góa hoan-hù góa ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti só͘ kóng ê ōe kap kui-lē, í-keng tī lín chó͘-sian ê sin-chiūⁿ si̍t-hiān. Āu-lâi in hôe-thâu, kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe koat-tēng beh chiàu lán ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe tùi-thāi lán. I í-keng chiàu án-ni chòe lah.’”
Tāi-liû-sū chē-ūi tē-jī nî cha̍p-it--ge̍h, chiū-sī Sè-pā-te̍k-ge̍h jī-cha̍p-sì ji̍t, Siōng Chú tùi E̍k-to ê sun, Pí-lī-ka ê kiáⁿ sian-ti Sat-ka-lī-a kóng-ōe.
Góa tī mî--sî khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê lâng khiâ chi̍t chiah âng-bé, khiā tī soaⁿ-kok tiông-chheng-chhiū ê tiong-kan; tī i ê āu-bīn ū âng-sek, chang-sek, pe̍h-sek ê bé.
Góa mn̄g i, “Sian-siⁿ, chiah-ê bé teh piáu-sī sím-mi̍h?” Lēng-gōa chi̍t ê kap góa kóng-ōe ê sù-chiá kā góa kóng, “Góa beh chí-sī lí chiah-ê sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù.”
Hit-ê khiā tī tiông-chheng-chhiū tiong-kan ê lâng ìn kóng, “Chiah-ê sī Siōng Chú chhe-phài lâi tī tōe-chiūⁿ sûn-lô--ê.”
In chiū kā hit-ê khiā tī tiông-chheng-chhiū tiong-kan Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá pò-kò kóng, “Goán ū tī tōe-chiūⁿ sûn-lô, khòaⁿ-tio̍h choân-tōe lóng pêng-chēng bô-sū.”

Jiân-āu Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kóng, “Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, lí tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi chiah-ê siâⁿ siū-khì í-keng chhit-cha̍p nî; lí bô thiàⁿ-sioh in beh koh jōa kú?”
Siōng Chú chiū ēng jîn-chû an-ùi ê ōe, ìn kap góa kóng-ōe hit-ê sù-chiá.
Kap góa kóng-ōe ê sù-chiá kiò góa soan-kò Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe só͘ kóng ê ōe, “Góa chhim-chhim thiàⁿ-sioh Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, jia̍t-ài Sek-an.
M̄-kú góa tùi an-ún chū-boán ê lia̍t-kok hui-siông siū-khì; in-ūi góa bat tùi góa ê chú-bîn sió-khóa siū-khì, lia̍t-kok soah thàn ki-hōe ke-thiⁿ in ê khó͘-lān.
Taⁿ, góa beh tò-tńg-lâi thiàⁿ-sioh Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; tī chia góa ê tiān beh tiông-kiàn, siâⁿ beh têng-khí.” Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.

Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá koh kiò góa soan-pò͘, “Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, ‘Góa chiah-ê siâⁿ beh koh hoân-êng hoat-ta̍t; Siōng Chú beh koh an-ùi Sek-an, beh koh kéng Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe góa ka-kī ê siâⁿ.’”
Góa gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sì ki kak.
Góa mn̄g kap góa kóng-ōe ê sù-chiá, “Chiah-ê kak teh piáu-sī sím-mi̍h?” I ìn góa kóng, “Chiah-ê sī kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ Iû-tāi, Í-sek-lia̍t, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê kak.”
Siōng Chú koh hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sì ê sai-hū.

Góa mn̄g, “Chiah-ê sai-hū lâi beh chòe sím-mi̍h?” Sù-chiá ìn kóng, “Chiah-ê sai-hū lâi, sī beh heh-kiaⁿ lia̍t-kok, phah-tn̄g in ê kak, in-ūi in bat ēng in ê kak kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ Iû-tāi, hō͘ lâng m̄-káⁿ gia̍h-thâu.”
Góa koh gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê lâng chhiú the̍h niû-soh.
Góa mn̄g i, “Lí beh khì tó-ūi?” I kā góa kóng, “Beh khì niû Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, khòaⁿ i jōa khoah, jōa tn̂g.”
Āu-lâi, kap góa kóng-ōe ê sù-chiá chhut--khì, koh ū chi̍t ê sù-chiá lâi chiap i,
tùi i kóng, “Lí kóaⁿ-kín khì kā hit-ê siàu-liân-lâng kóng, ‘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng beh chiâⁿ-chòe bô chhiûⁿ ê siâⁿ, lâng kap cheng-siⁿ khoeh kah móa-móa.’
Siōng Chú kóng, ‘Góa beh ēng hé chòe chhiûⁿ sì-bīn pau-ûi pó-hō͘ i, koh góa ê êng-kng beh lîm-chāi tī hit lāi-bīn.’”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Cháu, kín cháu, tùi pak-hng ê tōe tô-cháu--tńg-lâi! In-ūi góa í-chêng ū kā lín kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ khì choân-tōe ta̍k só͘-chāi.
Cháu, tòa tī Pa-pí-lûn ê Sek-an chú-bîn, kín cháu o͘h!”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe hián-chhut êng-kng liáu-āu, chhe góa khì chhiúⁿ-lia̍h I ê chú-bîn ê lia̍t-kok hia, kóng, “Kha̍p-tio̍h góa ê chú-bîn, chiū-sī kha̍p-tio̍h góa ê ba̍k-chiu-jîn.
Góa beh hē-chhiú kong-kek in, in ōe hō͘ in ê lô͘-lē chhiúⁿ.” Hit-sî lín chiū ōe chai, sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chhe góa lâi.
Siōng Chú koh kóng, “ Sek-an ê chú-bîn, tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa! Lín khòaⁿ, góa beh lâi, beh tiàm tī lín tiong-kan.

Hit-ji̍t, ū chin chōe kok ōe lâi kui-óa Siōng Chú, chòe góa ê chú-bîn. Góa beh tiàm tī lín tiong-kan.” Án-ni, lín chiū ōe chai, sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chhe góa lâi lín chia.
Siōng Chú beh tit-tio̍h Iû-tāi chòe I tī sèng-tōe ê sán-gia̍p; I beh koh kéng Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe I ê siâⁿ.
Só͘-ū ê lâng tī Siōng Chú bīn-chêng lóng tio̍h siok-chēng, in-ūi Siōng Chú tùi I ê sèng-só͘ khiā--chhut-lâi.
Siōng Chú koh hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h tōa-chè-si Iâ-su-a khiā tī Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá bīn-chêng, Sat-tàn khiā tī Iâ-su-a ê chiàⁿ-pêng beh kā i khòng-kò.

Siōng Chú tùi Sat-tàn kóng, “Sat-tàn, Siōng Chú kā lí chek-pī! Kéng-soán Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Siōng Chú chek-pī lí! Chit-ê lâng kiám m̄-sī tùi hé-tiong thiu--chhut-lâi ê chi̍t tè chhâ?”
Iâ-su-a chhēng lah-sap ê saⁿ, khiā tī sù-chiá ê bīn-chêng.
Sù-chiá kā hiah-ê teh sū-hāu--ê kóng, “Kā i ê lah-sap-saⁿ thǹg--khí-lâi.” Siōng Chú kā Iâ-su-a kóng, “Góa í-keng tû-khì lí ê chōe-ok, góa beh kā lí chhēng lé-ho̍k.”

Siōng Chú hoan-hù tio̍h ēng chheng-khì ê lé-bō kā i tì tī thâu-khak. In chiū kā i chhēng lé-ho̍k, tì chheng-khì ê lé-bō; hit-sî Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá khiā tī piⁿ--á teh khòaⁿ.
Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá kéng-kài Iâ-su-a kóng,

“Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, ‘Lí nā chun-hêng góa ê tō-lō͘, chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng, chiū ōe-tàng koán-lí góa ê tiān, kò͘-siú góa ê tiâⁿ; góa mā beh hō͘ lí tī hiah-ê sū-hāu-chiá tiong-kan chū-iû chhut-ji̍p.

Tōa-chè-si Iâ-su-a, lí kap chē tī lí bīn-chêng ê chè-si-phōaⁿ lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ; chiah-ê lâng sī chiong-lâi beh hoat-seng ê tāi-chì ê tiāu-thâu, góa beh hō͘ Sin-íⁿ, chiū-sī góa só͘ kéng-soán ê ông lâi-lîm.

Lí khòaⁿ, góa tī Iâ-su-a bīn-chêng hē chi̍t tè ū chhit lúi ba̍k-chiu ê chio̍h.’ Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, ‘Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh tī hit-tè chio̍h téng-bīn khek-jī choh-chèng, beh tī chi̍t ji̍t lāi chhat-siau chit-ê tōe ê chōe.
Tī hit-ji̍t, lín ta̍k-ê lâng ōe chhiáⁿ chhù-piⁿ lâi phû-tô-chhiū kha kap bû-hoa-kó-chhiū kha chē.’ Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.”
Hit-ê kap góa kóng-ōe ê sù-chiá koh óa--lâi, kā góa kiò-chhíⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ kā teh khùn ê lâng kiò cheng-sîn.

I mn̄g góa, “Lí khòaⁿ-tio̍h sím-mi̍h?” Góa kóng, “Góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chō kim teng-tâi, tâi-téng ū chi̍t ê tóe iû ê phûn, phûn-téng ū chhit ki teng, ta̍k-ki teng ū chhit ê teng-sim.
Teng-tâi piⁿ ū nn̄g châng kaⁿ-ná-chhiū, chi̍t châng tī iû-phûn ê chiàⁿ-pêng, chi̍t châng tī tò-pêng.”
Góa mn̄g kap góa kóng-ōe ê thiⁿ-sài, “Sian-siⁿ, chiah-ê teh piáu-sī sím-mi̍h?”
I ìn góa kóng, “Lí m̄ chai chiah-ê sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù o͘h?” Góa kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, góa m̄ chai.”

I kā góa kóe-seh, “Siōng Chú hoan-hù Só͘-lô-pa-pek ê ōe sī án-ni, ‘M̄-sī khò koân-le̍k, m̄-sī khò châi-lêng, tio̍h khò góa ê sîn.’ Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.

Tōa-soaⁿ ah, lí sǹg sím-mi̍h? Lí ōe tī Só͘-lô-pa-pek bīn-chêng pìⁿ-chòe pîⁿ-tōe. I kā siōng tiōng-iàu ê chio̍h poaⁿ--chhut-lâi ê sî, chèng-lâng ōe hoah kóng, ‘Siōng-tè sù-hok! Siōng-tè sù-hok!’”
Siōng Chú ū koh tùi góa kóng,

Só͘-lô-pa-pek ū kā chit-keng sèng-tiān hē tōe-ki, mā beh chhin-chhiú oân-sêng tiông-kiàn ê kang-chok. Hit-sî lín chiū chai Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ū chhe góa lâi lín chia.

Siáⁿ-lâng káⁿ biáu-sī chit-ji̍t, khòaⁿ beh hoat-seng ê tāi-chì chòe sió-sū? In chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h Só͘-lô-pa-pek chhiú koh the̍h tūi-chîn ōe chin hoaⁿ-hí. Chit chhit ki teng sī Siōng Chú teh sûn-sī choân-tōe ê ba̍k-chiu.
Góa koh mn̄g hit-ê sù-chiá, “Chit-ê teng-tâi siang-pêng ê nn̄g châng kaⁿ-ná-chhiū teh piáu-sī sím-mi̍h?
Kaⁿ-ná-chhiū ê nn̄g ki chhiū-oe ê piⁿ--á, ū nn̄g tiâu kim ê kńg lâu-chhut kim-sek ê iû, teh piáu-sī sím-mi̍h?”
I ìn kóng, “Lí m̄ chai chiah-ê sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù o͘h?” Góa kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, góa m̄ chai.”
I kóng, “Che sī nn̄g ê siū boah-iû kéng-soán ê po̍k-jîn, teh sū-hāu choân-tōe ê Chú.”
Góa koh gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ū chi̍t kńg teh pe ê chheh.
Sù-chiá mn̄g góa, “Lí khòaⁿ-tio̍h sím-mi̍h?” Góa ìn kóng, “Góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t kńg teh pe ê chheh, tn̂g káu kong-chhioh, khoah sì kong-chhioh-pòaⁿ.”

I chiū tùi góa kóng, “Chit-ê sī tùi choân-tōe hoat-chhut ê chiù-chó͘; só͘-ū thau-the̍h--ê ōe chiàu chit-kńg chheh ê chit-bīn só͘ siá--ê kā in tû-bia̍t; só͘-ū choh gūi-chèng--ê ōe chiàu lēng-gōa hit-bīn só͘ siá--ê kā in tû-bia̍t.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ū kóng: Góa beh sàng hit-kńg chheh chhut--khì, hit-kńg chheh ōe ji̍p-khì hiah-ê thau-the̍h ê lâng kap kí góa ê miâ lām-sám chiù-chōa ê lâng ê chhù, ōe lâu tī in hia, ti̍t-kàu kui-keng chhù liân chhâ kap chio̍h lóng húi-hoāi.”
Kap góa kóng-ōe ê sù-chiá chhut-lâi kā góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ ū chhut-hiān sím-mi̍h?”
Góa mn̄g, “Che sī sím-mi̍h?” I kóng, “Sī niû ngó͘-kok ê tháng-á.” I koh kóng, “Chit-ê tháng-á piáu-sī chit-ê tōe lóng-chóng ê lâng ê chōe.”
Khòaⁿ leh, îⁿ ê iân-kòa chi̍t-ē hian-khui, ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng chē tī lāi-bīn.
Sù-chiá kóng, “Chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng piáu-sī siâ-ok.” I chiū chiong hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng chhi̍h lo̍h-khì tháng-á lāi, koh ēng hit-ê iân-kòa khàm--teh.
Góa koh gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h nn̄g ê hū-jîn-lâng chhut-hiān; in ū chhin-chhiūⁿ ho̍h ê si̍t. In thí-si̍t sūn-hong pe--lâi, chiong tháng-á giâ kàu pòaⁿ khong-tiong.
Góa mn̄g kap góa kóng-ōe ê sù-chiá, “In beh kā tháng-á giâ-khì tó-ūi?”
I kā góa kóng, “Beh giâ-khì Pa-pí-lûn, tī hia kā i khí chi̍t keng biō; tán biō khí hó, chiū kā chit-ê tháng-á hē tī hia.”
Góa koh gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ū sì tâi chiàn-chhia tùi nn̄g chō tâng-soaⁿ ê tiong-kan chhut--lâi.
Thâu chi̍t tâi sī âng-bé teh thoa, tē-jī tâi o͘-bé,
tē-saⁿ tâi pe̍h-bé, tē-sì tâi hoe-pan ê bé teh thoa.
Góa chiū mn̄g kap góa kóng-ōe ê sù-chiá, “Sian-siⁿ, chiah-ê teh piáu-sī sím-mi̍h?”
Sù-chiá ìn góa kóng, “Chiah-ê teh piáu-sī thiⁿ sì-bīn ê hong; in teh sū-hāu choân-tōe ê Chú, taⁿ tùi hia chhut--lâi.”
O͘-bé thoa ê chhia ǹg pak-pêng khì; pe̍h-bé ê chhia tè tī āu-bīn; hoe-pan-bé ǹg lâm-pêng khì.
Chiah-ê ióng ê bé chhut--khì, kip beh kiâⁿ-thàu choân-tōe. Sù-chiá kóng, “Lín khì choân-tōe sûn-lô.” In chiū khì.
I kiò góa, kā góa kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, ǹg pak-pêng khì--ê í-keng tī pak-pêng, hō͘ góa ê sim pêng-chēng.”
Siōng Chú tùi góa kóng,
“Lí tio̍h chiong hiah-ê liû-hòng khì Pa-pí-lûn tò-tńg--lâi ê Hek-tāi, To-pí-ngá, kap Iâ-tāi-ngá só͘ hiàn ê kim-gûn, sûi-sî the̍h-khì Se-hoan-ngá ê kiáⁿ Iok-se-a ê chhù,
ēng hiah-ê kim-gûn chòe lé-koan, tì tī Iok-sat-ta̍t ê kiáⁿ tōa-chè-si Iâ-su-a ê thâu-khak téng;

tùi i kóng, ‘Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, ū chi̍t ê chheng-chòe Sin-íⁿ--ê beh tùi i ê pún só͘-chāi puh--chhut-lâi; i beh khí-chō Siōng Chú ê tiān.

Chiū-sī i, beh khí-chō Siōng Chú ê tiān. I beh ū ông ê chun-êng, chē ông-ūi thóng-tī; koh ōe ū chi̍t ê chè-si tī i ê pó-chō piⁿ. In nn̄g ê lâng tiong-kan ū hô-hâi kiōng-sek.
Chit-téng lé-koan beh hē tī Siōng Chú ê tiān lâi kì-liām Hek-tāi, To-pí-ngá, Iâ-tāi-ngá, kap Se-hoan-ngá ê kiáⁿ — Iok-se-a.’”

Tòa tī chin hn̄g ê lâng mā ōe lâi chòe-hé tiông-kiàn Siōng Chú ê tiān. Hit-sî lín chiū ōe chai, sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chhe góa lâi lín chia. Lín nā sêng-sim thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè ê ōe, chit-ê tāi-chì it-tēng si̍t-hiān.
Tāi-liû-sū chòe Pho-su Hông-tè tē-sì nî káu--ge̍h, chiū-sī Ki-su-liû-ge̍h chhoe-sì, Siōng Chú tùi Sat-ka-lī-a kóng-ōe.
Hit-sî, Pek-te̍k-lī -lâng í-keng chhe Sa-lī-sek kap Lī-kian Bí-le̍k, í-ki̍p tè in ê lâng khì khún-kiû Siōng Chú si-un.

In mn̄g Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe sèng-tiān ê chè-si í-ki̍p sian-ti kóng, “Chin chōe nî lâi, goán tī gō͘--ge̍h lóng ū teh ai-siong kìm-chia̍h, hiān-chāi kiám tio̍h koh án-ni chòe?”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe tùi góa kóng,
“Lí tio̍h kā chit só͘-chāi ê jîn-bîn kap chè-si kóng, ‘Lín chhit-cha̍p nî kú, tī gō͘--ge̍h, chhit--ge̍h ai-siong kìm-chia̍h, kiám chin-chiàⁿ sī ūi-tio̍h góa?
Lín chia̍h lín lim, kiám m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h lín ka-kī?

Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap chiu-ûi ê siâⁿ jîn-kháu chōe koh hoân-êng, lâm-pêng ê khòng-iá kap sai-pêng ê soaⁿ-po͘ ū lâng khiā-khí ê sî, Siōng Chú kau-tài í-chêng ê sian-ti soan-iông--ê, kiám m̄-sī siâng-khoán chiah-ê ōe?’”
Siōng Chú koh tùi Sat-ka-lī-a kóng,
“Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ū án-ni kóng, ‘Lín sím-phòaⁿ tio̍h chiàu chin-si̍t kong-chèng; tio̍h ēng chû-ài lîn-bín saⁿ tùi-thāi.
M̄-thang khi-hū ko͘-jî, kóaⁿ-hū, tòa tī lín tiong-kan ê gōa-cho̍k-lâng, kap sàn-chhiah-lâng; m̄-thang kè-bô͘ pháiⁿ-tāi, hō͘-siōng hām-hāi.’
“M̄-kú in oa̍t-tńg-sin, m̄-khéng thiaⁿ-thàn,

koh hō͘ ka-kī ê sim ngī kah chhin-chhiūⁿ soān-chio̍h hiah-ni̍h tēng, m̄-khéng thiaⁿ-thàn lu̍t-hoat, m̄ thiaⁿ góa Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe thong-kè I ê sîn chhe-khián í-chêng ê sian-ti thoân-ta̍t ê ōe; só͘-í, góa Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe hoat tōa siū-khì,
in-ūi góa ū kiò, in m̄ thiaⁿ. Góa Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, ‘Án-ni, in kiû-kiò, góa mā m̄ thiaⁿ.

Góa beh ēng kńg-lê-á-hong kā in chhe-sòaⁿ, chhe khì in m̄-bat ê lia̍t-kok hia. In lī-khui liáu-āu, chit-ê tōe chiū hong-hòe, bô lâng chhut-ji̍p; in hō͘ pûi-súi ê tōe pìⁿ-chòe hong-po͘.’”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe tùi góa kóng-ōe.
I kóng, “Góa chhim-chhim thiàⁿ-sioh Sek-an, jia̍t-ài i, ài kah sim-kông-hé-jia̍t.”

Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Góa beh tò-lâi Sek-an, beh tiàm tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng beh chheng-chòe Tiong-si̍t ê Siâⁿ; Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê soaⁿ beh chheng-chòe Sèng-soaⁿ.”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Chiong-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê kóng-tiûⁿ ōe koh ū tn̂g-hè-siū, gia̍h koáiⁿ-á ê lāu-a-peh, lāu-a-ḿ tī hia teh chē.
Siâⁿ-lāi ê kóng-tiûⁿ ōe koh ū chin chōe ta-po͘ gín-á kap cha-bó͘ gín-á tī hia teh thit-thô.”
