Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Kàu hiah-ê ji̍t, liû-bông tò-tńg--lâi ê chú-bîn ōe khòaⁿ che chòe bô khó-lêng; góa kiám mā ōe khòaⁿ che chòe bô khó-lêng?”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe koh kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, góa beh tùi ji̍t chhut ê só͘-chāi kap ji̍t lo̍h ê só͘-chāi kái-kiù góa ê chú-bîn.
Góa beh chhōa in tò-tńg-lâi tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; in beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn, góa beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè, ēng sìn-si̍t kap kong-gī tùi-thāi in.”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Tio̍h kian-kiông! Che sī lín tī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê sèng-tiān hē tōe-ki beh tiông-kiàn ê sî, só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h sian-ti kóng ê ōe.
Tī hiah-ê ji̍t í-chêng, lâng kap cheng-siⁿ lóng bô lâng chhiàⁿ, koh in-ūi ū tùi-te̍k, lâng chhut-ji̍p bô pêng-an; in-ūi góa hō͘ lâng hō͘-siōng te̍k-tùi.
M̄-kú, hiān-chāi góa bōe koh chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng án-ni tùi-thāi liû-bông tò-tńg--lâi ê chú-bîn. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.
In thang pêng-an iā-chéng; phû-tô-chhiū ōe kiat ké-chí, tōe chhut thó͘-sán, thiⁿ kàng lō͘-chúi. Góa beh hō͘ liû-bông tò-tńg--lâi ê jîn-bîn hióng-siū chiah-ê it-chhè.

Iû-tāi -ke kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ke ah, í-chêng lín tī lia̍t-kok tiong hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe sī siū chiù-chó͘--ê, hiān-chāi góa beh kái-kiù lín, hō͘ lín chiâⁿ-chòe siū chiok-hok--ê. M̄-bián kiaⁿ, tio̍h kian-kiông!”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Lín ê lia̍t-chó͘ jiá góa siū-khì ê sî, góa ū koat-ì kàng chai-hō hō͘ in, bô kái-piàn sim-ì. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng,
‘Hiān-chāi góa koat-ì beh si-un hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi -ke, bōe kái-piàn sim-ì. Lín m̄-bián kiaⁿ.
Lín eng-kai chòe--ê sī án-ni: Tio̍h hō͘-siōng kóng chin-si̍t-ōe; tī hoat-têng sím-phòaⁿ tio̍h chiàu chin-si̍t kong-chèng, chhiok-chìn hô-bo̍k.
M̄-thang kè-bô͘ pháiⁿ-tāi, hō͘-siōng hām-hāi; m̄-thang chiù ké-chōa; in-ūi chiah-ê tāi-chì lóng sī góa só͘ iàm-ò͘ⁿ.’ Che sī Siōng Chú kóng--ê.”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe tùi góa kóng-ōe.

I kóng, “Sì--ge̍h, gō͘--ge̍h, chhit--ge̍h, cha̍p--ge̍h kìm-chia̍h ê ji̍t beh chiâⁿ-chòe Iû-tāi -ke hoaⁿ-hí ê ji̍t-chí, khoài-lo̍k ê choeh-kî; só͘-í lín tio̍h ì-ài chin-si̍t kap hô-pêng.”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Chiong-lâi ū lia̍t-kok ê lâng kap chin chōe siâⁿ ê chū-bîn ōe lâi;
chit-ê siâⁿ ê chū-bîn ōe khì kā hit-ê siâⁿ ê lâng kóng, ‘Lán kín lâi-khì chhē Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, kî-kiû I si-un; góa mā beh chòe-hé khì.’
Koh ōe ū chin chōe bîn-cho̍k kap kiông-kok lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chhē Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, kiû Siōng Chú si-un.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe koh kóng, ‘Tī hiah-ê ji̍t beh ū cha̍p ê gōa-kok-lâng lâi khiú chi̍t ê Iû-tāi -lâng ê saⁿ-á-ku, kóng: Goán beh kap lín chòe-hé khì, in-ūi goán ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè kap lín tông-chāi.’”

Ē-bīn sī Siōng Chú iú-koan Hap-tek-la tōe-khu kap Tāi-má-sū-kek ê sìn-sit: Sè-kan-lâng, te̍k-pia̍t sī Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k-ê chi-cho̍k, in ê ba̍k-chiu lóng chù-ba̍k teh khòaⁿ Siōng Chú;
hù-kūn ê Hap-má, sīm-chì chin khiáu ê Thài-ní kap Se-tùn mā án-ni.
Thài-ní ūi-tio̍h ka-kī khí-chō pó-lúi, tún-chek gûn chhin-chhiūⁿ tún-chek thô͘-soa, chek-chū kim chōe kah chhin-chhiūⁿ koe-lō͘ ê thô͘-bê.
M̄-kú, Chú it-tēng ōe chiong i só͘-ū--ê pak-liáu-liáu, mā ōe phah-pāi i hái-siōng ê sè-le̍k, sio-húi i ê siâⁿ.

A-si̍t-ki-lûn khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; Ka-sat kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah; Í-kek-lûn ê ǹg-bāng ōe lo̍k-khong. Ka-sat bōe koh-chài ū kun-ông; A-si̍t-ki-lûn bōe koh-chài ū lâng khiā-khí.
Hūn-cha̍p ê chióng-cho̍k ōe lâi A-si̍t-tu̍t tēng-ku. Góa beh tû-bia̍t Hui-lī-sū -lâng ê kiau-ngō͘.

Góa beh hō͘ in bô koh chia̍h kâⁿ-huih ê bah, chhùi-lāi bô koh ū bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h ê chia̍h-mi̍h. Hui-lī-sū só͘ chhun ê lâng ōe kui-sūn lán ê Siōng-tè, chhin-chhiūⁿ Iû-tāi ê chi̍t ê chong-cho̍k; Í-kek-lûn -lâng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Iâ-pò͘-su -lâng.
Góa beh chat-iâⁿ pó-hō͘ góa ê ka-hn̂g, bô hō͘ tùi-te̍k chhim-hoān; chhim-lio̍k-chiá bōe koh lâi kong-kek, in-ūi góa hiān-chāi chhin-sin teh kò͘-siú.

Sek-an ê chú-bîn ah, tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k! Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chú-bîn ah, tio̍h hoan-ho͘! Lí khòaⁿ, lí ê kun-ông lâi lah! I sèng-lī khái-soân; i khiam-sùn khiâ-lû, chiū-sī khiâ lû-á-kiáⁿ.

Góa beh tû-khì Í-sek-lia̍t ê chiàn-chhia, tû-bia̍t Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chiàn-bé, at-chi̍h kau-chiàn ê keng. I beh tùi lia̍t-kok soan-pò͘ hô-pêng. I ê thóng-tī ōe tùi chit-ê hái kàu hit-ê hái, tùi Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô ti̍t-kàu tōe-ke̍k.
Sek-an ah, in-ūi góa ū ēng huih kap lí li̍p-iok, góa beh kā lín chiah-ê siū-lia̍h ê lâng tùi bô-chúi ê chhim-khiⁿ kái-kiù--chhut-lâi.
Lín chiah-ê siū-lia̍h iáu ū ǹg-bāng ê lâng ah, tio̍h tò-tńg--lâi, tńg-lâi lín ê pó-lúi. Góa kin-á-ji̍t soan-pò͘: Góa beh ka-pē pó͘-sióng lín.
Góa beh ēng Iû-tāi chòe góa ê keng, ēng Í-sek-lia̍t chòe an tī keng ê chìⁿ. Sek-an ah, góa beh kek-tōng lí ê chú-bîn, hō͘ in chòe góa ê to-kiàm kong-kek Hi-la̍h -lâng.

Siōng Chú beh chhut-hiān tī I chú-bîn ê téng-bīn; I ê chìⁿ beh chhin-chhiūⁿ sih-nà siā-chhut; Chì-koân ê Siōng Chú beh pûn sàu-kak, chē kńg-lê-á-hong tùi lâm-pêng lâi chìn-kong.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe beh pó-hō͘ I ê chú-bîn; in ōe thun-bia̍t hìⁿ chio̍h-thâu ê tùi-te̍k, ōe hoan-ho͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ chiú-chùi ê lâng tōa-siaⁿ hoah; in ōe hō͘ tùi-te̍k ê huih lâu kah chhin-chhiūⁿ hiàn-chè ê huih, tùi chè-tôaⁿ ê sì-kak-thâu ek--chhut-lâi.
Hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè beh kiù in, chhin-chhiūⁿ bo̍k-chiá kái-kiù iûⁿ-kûn; in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ ông-koan ê pó-chio̍h tī I ê tōe hoat-kng.
Hiah-ni̍h hó! Hiah-ni̍h súi! Siōng Chú sù ngó͘-kok hō͘ siàu-lâm ióng-chòng, sù sin-chiú hō͘ siàu-lú bí-lē.
Tio̍h tī chhun-thiⁿ ú-kî ê sî tùi Siōng Chú kiû hō͘; chō o͘-hûn kap lûi-tiān ê Siōng Chú ōe lo̍h kam-lîm hō͘ só͘-ū ê lâng, hō͘ ta̍k-ê lâng ê chhân-hn̂g seng-sán.

Lín tī ke-lāi ho̍k-sāi ê sîn-bêng o͘-pe̍h chí-sī, pok-kòa--ê lām-sám pò; in o͘-pe̍h kái-bāng, bōe-tàng an-ùi lâng. Góa ê chú-bîn lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ bê-lō͘, in in-ūi bô bo̍k-chiá siū khi-ap.

Góa Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe tùi hiah-ê bo̍k-chiá hoat tōa siū-khì, beh hêng-hoa̍t chhōa-thâu--ê. Góa beh khòaⁿ-kò͘ góa ê iûⁿ-kûn Iû-tāi -ke, hō͘ in pìⁿ-chòe kiông-béng ê chiàn-bé.
Só͘-ū ê léng-siù lóng ōe tùi Iû-tāi -ke chhut; in ióng-chòng khó-khò chhin-chhiūⁿ chhù-kak-chio̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ pò͘-phâng ê khi̍t-á, chhin-chhiūⁿ kau-chiàn ê keng.

In chhin-chhiūⁿ teh kau-chiàn ê ióng-sū, thún-ta̍h tùi-te̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ teh ta̍h koe-lō͘ ê thô͘-bê, in-ūi góa Siōng Chú kap in tông-chāi, in ōe ióng-kám kau-chiàn, phah-pāi bé-peng, hō͘ tùi-te̍k kiàn-siàu.

Góa beh hō͘ Iû-tāi kiông-sēng, hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t sèng-lī. Góa beh lîn-bín in, chhōa in tńg--lâi, hō͘ in kám-kak ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ góa m̄-bat kā in khì-sak. Góa sī Siōng Chú — in ê Siōng-tè, góa beh thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó.
Í-sek-lia̍t ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ ióng-sū; in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lim-chiú sim khoài-lo̍k. In ê kiáⁿ-sun ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ lâi khoài-lo̍k; in ê sim ōe in-ūi Siōng Chú hoaⁿ-hí.
Góa beh kā in kho͘ óa--lâi, in-ūi góa ū koat-tēng beh kiù-sio̍k in. In ê jîn-kháu ōe ke-thiⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ í-chêng hiah-ni̍h chōe.
Góa sui-jiân ū kā in hun-sòaⁿ khì lia̍t-kok, in ōe tī hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi siàu-liām góa; in kap in ê kiáⁿ-sun lóng ōe oa̍h--teh koh tò-tńg--lâi.
Góa beh chhōa in tùi Ai-ki̍p tò-tńg--lâi, mā beh tùi A-su̍t chhōa in chhut--lâi, chhōa in lâi Ki-lia̍t kap Lê-pa-lūn, kàu hiah-ê tōe-khu bô-kàu só͘-chāi thang tòa.
Siōng Chú keng-kè hiong-ok ê hái, chè-ho̍k hái-tiong ê pho-lōng, hō͘ Nî-lô-hô chhim ê só͘-chāi ta--khì, A-su̍t ê kiau-ngō͘ kàng-chòe pi-bî, Ai-ki̍p ê koân-le̍k siau-sit.
Góa Siōng Chú beh hō͘ in khò góa kian-kiông, chiàu góa ê ì-sù seng-oa̍h hêng-tōng. Siōng Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
Lê-pa-lūn, phah-khui lí ê mn̂g, hō͘ hé sio lí ê pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū.

Siông-chhiū ah, tōa-siaⁿ háu, in-ūi pek-hiuⁿ-chhiū í-keng tó--lo̍h-khì, súi ê chhiū í-keng tó-hoāi. Pa-san ê siōng-chhiū, tōa-siaⁿ háu, in-ūi bō͘-sēng ê chhiū-nâ í-keng chhò-liáu-liáu.
Thiaⁿ leh, ū bo̍k-chiá teh ai-chhan, in-ūi chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chháu-po͘ siū húi-hoāi. Thiaⁿ leh, ū béng-sai hm̄-hm̄-háu, in-ūi Iok-tàn hô-piⁿ ê chhiū-nâ í-keng hong-hòe.
Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “Tio̍h bo̍k-ióng beh hō͘ lâng thâi ê iûⁿ-kûn,
in-ūi kā in bóe khì thâi ê lâng bô siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī ū-chōe; bōe-in--ê kóng ‘Tio̍h chheng-chàn Siōng Chú, in-ūi góa hó-gia̍h lah’; liân in ê bo̍k-chiá mā bô khó-lîn in.”

Siōng Chú koh kóng, “Góa bōe koh lîn-bín chit só͘-chāi ê chū-bîn. Góa beh kā in lóng kau hō͘ keh-piah-kok kap in ê thóng-tī-chiá, hō͘ in lâi húi-bia̍t chit-ê tōe; góa mā bô beh kiù in thoat-lī tùi-te̍k ê chhiú.”

Tùi án-ni, góa bo̍k-ióng beh hō͘ lâng thâi ê iûⁿ-kûn, te̍k-pia̍t sī iûⁿ-kûn tiong siōng khùn-khó͘--ê. Góa the̍h nn̄g ki koáiⁿ-á bo̍k-ióng chiah-ê iûⁿ-kûn, chi̍t ki kiò-chòe “Un-hūi”, chi̍t ki kiò-chòe “liân-ha̍p”.
Chi̍t ge̍h-ji̍t lāi, góa khai-tû saⁿ ê bo̍k-chiá, in-ūi góa bōe-tàng koh iông-jím in, in mā thó-ià góa.
Góa kóng, “Góa bô beh bo̍k-ióng lín. Teh-beh sí--ê chhut-chāi i sí; beh bia̍t-bông--ê, chhut-chāi i bia̍t-bông; chhun--ê, hō͘ in hō͘-siōng thun-chia̍h.”
Góa chiū at-chi̍h hit-ki kiò-chòe “Un-hūi” ê koáiⁿ-á, piáu-sī Siōng Chú hòe-tû kap bān-bîn só͘ li̍p ê iok.
Hit-ji̍t, chit-ê iok chiū hòe-tû. Hiah-ê teh gióng-bōng góa ê siōng khùn-khó͘ ê iûⁿ-kûn, chiū chai che sī Siōng Chú ê sìn-sit.
Góa tùi in kóng, “Lín nā tông-ì, chiū hō͘ góa kang-chîⁿ; nā bô, chiū soah.” In chiū sǹg hō͘ góa saⁿ-cha̍p ê gûn-á chòe góa ê kang-chîⁿ.

Che sī in só͘ kó͘-kè ê hó kè-siàu. Siōng Chú kā góa kóng, “Chiong gûn-á hiat hō͘ sio-hûi-lâng.” Góa chiū the̍h hit saⁿ-cha̍p ê gûn-á tī Siōng Chú ê sèng-tiān hiat hō͘ sio-hûi-lâng.
Góa koh at-chi̍h kiò-chòe “Liân-ha̍p” ê tē-jī ki koáiⁿ-á, piáu-sī Iû-tāi kap Í-sek-lia̍t ê hiaⁿ-tī-koan-hē í-keng chhiat-tn̄g.
Siōng Chú koh kā góa kóng, “Tio̍h kā hit-ê bô lō͘-ēng ê bo̍k-chiá só͘ ēng ê khì-khū the̍h--khí-lâi.

Góa beh tī chit-ê kok-ka heng-khí chi̍t ê bo̍k-chiá. Teh-beh sí--ê, i bô khòaⁿ-kò͘; sit-bê--ê, i bô chhiau-chhē; siū-siong--ê, i bô i-tī; ióng-chòng--ê, i bô iúⁿ-chhī; kan-ta beh chia̍h pûi-iûⁿ ê bah, thiah-li̍h in ê tôe.
Pàng-sak iûⁿ-kûn, bô lō͘-ēng ê bo̍k-chiá, chhám ah! I ê chhiú-kut ōe hō͘ to thâi, khê--khì; chiàⁿ-ba̍k hō͘ to siong, sit-bêng.”
Che sī Siōng Chú iú-koan Í-sek-lia̍t ê khé-sī. Kā thiⁿ thí-khui, kiàn-li̍p tāi-tōe ê kun-ki, chhòng-chō lâng sìⁿ-miā ê Siōng Chú án-ni kóng,

“Góa beh hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t poe chiú, hō͘ sì-ûi chiah-ê kok-ka lim kah chùi-chùi-chùi; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siū ûi-khùn ê sî, Iû-tāi choân-tōe mā ōe siū kong-kek.
Chiah-ê kok-ka chū-chi̍p lâi kong-kek ê sî, góa beh hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiâⁿ-chòe tāng ê chio̍h-thâu, hō͘ beh giâ i ê lâng lóng siū tāng-siong.”

Siōng Chú kóng, “Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh phah só͘-ū ê bé, hō͘ in tio̍h-kiaⁿ, hō͘ khiâ-bé--ê lia̍h-kông; góa beh thí-khui ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ-kò͘ Iû-tāi -ke, phah lia̍t-kok ê bé, hō͘ in bô khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Iû-tāi ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ sim-lāi án-ni kóng, ‘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn sī goán ê khùi-la̍t, in-ūi in óa-khò Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe, in ê Siōng-tè.’

“Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh hō͘ Iû-tāi ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chhâ-tui tiong ê hé-chéng, chhin-chhiūⁿ be̍h-kó téng ê hé-pé; in ōe sio tùi tò-pêng chiàⁿ-pêng, chiong sì-ûi ê lia̍t-kok sio-bia̍t. Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe tī goân-lâi ê só͘-chāi kian-kò͘ khiā-chāi.
“Siōng Chú beh tāi-seng chín-kiù Iû-tāi ê pò͘-pîⁿ, chiah bián Tāi-pi̍t ông-tiâu ê êng-kng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chū-bîn ê êng-kng iâⁿ-kè Iû-tāi.

Tī hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú beh pó-hō͘ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn. Án-ni, in tiong-kan siōng nńg-chiáⁿ--ê ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Tāi-pi̍t hiah-ni̍h ióng-béng; Tāi-pi̍t ông-tiâu ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè, chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng Chú ê sù-chiá tī thâu-chêng ín-chhōa in.
Hit-ji̍t, lâi kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lia̍t-kok, góa it-tēng beh kā in châu-bia̍t.”

“Góa beh chiong lîn-bín kap kî-kiû ê sîn piàⁿ-lo̍h hō͘ Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn; in beh gióng-bōng góa, chiū-sī in chha̍k--sí hit-ūi; koh beh ūi-tio̍h i ai-khàu, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ūi-tio̍h ko͘-kiáⁿ ai-khàu; koh ūi-tio̍h i iu-khó͘, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ūi-tio̍h sit-lo̍h tōa-kiáⁿ iu-khó͘.
Tī hit-ji̍t, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ū tōa ai-khàu, chhin-chhiūⁿ tī Bí-kiat-to pêng-goân ê Hap-ta̍t Lîm-bûn ê ai-khàu.
Choân-kok múi chi̍t ke lóng ōe ai-khàu: Tāi-pi̍t -ke, Ná-tan -ke, Lī-bī -ke, Sī-múi -ke, kap kî-tha só͘-ū ê ka-cho̍k, lóng kok chòe chi̍t tui, lâm lú hun-khui ai-khàu.”
Tī hit-ji̍t, beh ūi-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê chū-bîn khui chi̍t ê chúi-chôaⁿ, thang sóe-tû in ê chōe-ok kap lâ-sâm.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Tī hit-ji̍t, góa beh tùi chit-ê tōe tû-khì ngó͘-siōng ê miâ, hō͘ lâng bōe koh kì-tit in; góa mā beh tùi chit-ê tōe tû-khì sian-ti kap ù-òe ê sîn.

Nā ū lâng iáu beh kóng ū-giân, i ê pē-bú ōe kā i kóng, ‘Lí kai-sí, in-ūi lí hōng Siōng Chú ê miâ kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.’ I nā kè-sio̍k kóng, i ê chhin-siⁿ pē-bú ōe kā i chha̍k--sí.
Tī hit-ji̍t, ta̍k-ê ké sian-ti ōe in-ūi só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê īⁿ-siōng kám-kak kiàn-siàu, bōe koh chhēng sian-ti-saⁿ phiàn lâng;
i ōe kóng, ‘Góa m̄-sī sian-ti, sī lông-hu, chi̍t-sì-lâng choh-sit.’
Lâng nā mn̄g i, ‘Lí seng-khu ná ū siong?’ I ōe ìn kóng, ‘Sī tī goán pêng-iú in tau siū ê siong.’”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “To-kiàm ah, chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, kong-kek góa ê bo̍k-chiá, kong-kek góa ê tâng-phōaⁿ. Phah bo̍k-chiá, iûⁿ-kûn chiū sì-sòaⁿ. Góa beh oa̍t-tńg-sin kong-kek sòe-chiah iûⁿ-á.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Chit-ê tōe saⁿ-hūn-jī ê lâng ōe siū siau-bia̍t, saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t ōe lâu--teh.

Góa beh hō͘ chit saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t ê lâng siū hé thoàn-liān, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh liān kim, liān gûn. In ōe kiû-kiò góa ê miâ, góa beh ìn in. Góa beh kóng ‘Lín sī góa ê chú-bîn’; in ōe ìn, ‘Siōng Chú, lí sī goán ê Siōng-tè!’”
Khòaⁿ leh, Siōng Chú ê ji̍t beh kàu lah, lâng beh tī lí ê ba̍k-chiu chêng pun lí chhiúⁿ--lâi ê mi̍h.

Góa beh tiàu-chi̍p bān-kok lâi kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; siâⁿ ōe siū kong-phòa, chhù siū chhiúⁿ-kiap, hū-jîn-lâng siū lêng-jio̍k; siâⁿ-lāi ê chū-bîn chi̍t-pòaⁿ hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì, chhun--ê lâu--teh.
Āu-lâi, Siōng Chú ōe chhut-khì kap hiah-ê kok kau-chiàn, kap í-chêng siâng-khoán.

Tī hit-ji̍t, I ōe khiā tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tang-pêng ê Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ. Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ ōe tùi tiong-ng li̍h--khui, chi̍t-pòaⁿ ǹg lâm î-sóa, chi̍t-pòaⁿ ǹg pak, tùi tang kàu sai hêng-sêng hui-siông tōa ê soaⁿ-kok.

Lín ōe sūn chit-tiâu góa só͘ pun-khui thàng kàu A-sek ê soaⁿ-kok tô-cháu, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ê chó͘-sian tī Iû-tāi -ông O͘-se-a ê sî in-ūi tōe-tāng teh tô-cháu siâng-khoán. Siōng Chú — góa ê Siōng-tè ōe chhōa só͘-ū ê sèng-chiá chòe-hé lâi.
Hit-ji̍t, bô ji̍t-kng, bōe kôaⁿ, bōe lo̍h-sng.
Koh ū chi̍t ê te̍k-pia̍t ê ji̍t, chí-ū Siōng Chú chai; bô hun ji̍t--sî á-sī mî--sî, in-ūi mî--sî mā ū kng.

Hit-ji̍t ōe ū oa̍h-chúi tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lâu--chhut-lâi; chi̍t-pòaⁿ lâu-khì tang-pêng ê Sí-hái, chi̍t-pòaⁿ lâu-khì sai-pêng ê Tōe-tiong-hái; tang-thiⁿ hē-thiⁿ lóng sī án-ni.
Siōng Chú beh chòe choân-tōe ê Ông. Hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú chì-chun-bû-tùi, I ê miâ to̍k-it-bû-jī.

Tùi pak-pêng ê Ka-pa kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lâm-pêng ê Lîm-bûn, choân-pō͘ ê tōe-khu lóng ōe pìⁿ-chòe pêng-goân. Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tī goân-ūi koân-koân khiā--teh, siâⁿ ê hoān-ûi tùi Piān-ngá-bín-mn̂g keng-kè Kū-mn̂g kàu Kak-mn̂g; tùi Hap-lâm-gia̍p-lâu kàu ông ê chiú-khut.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe ū chin chōe lâng tī hia an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p, bōe koh ū siū húi-bia̍t ê chiù-chó͘.
Hiah-ê kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lia̍t-kok, Siōng Chú beh kàng chai-hō hō͘ in; in iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî, bah ōe nōa--khì, ba̍k-chiu kap chi̍h mā lóng ōe nōa--khì.
Tī hit-ji̍t, Siōng Chú beh hō͘ in khí hūn-loān; in khiú-lâi-khiú-khì, hō͘-siōng kong-kek.
Iû-tāi mā beh tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chham-chiàn; hit-sî, chiu-ûi lia̍t-kok chin chōe châi-bu̍t, chiū-sī kim, gûn, i-ho̍k, lóng ōe siu-chi̍p óa--lâi.
Siâng-khoán ê chai-hō mā ōe lîm-kàu te̍k-jîn ê bé, lô, lo̍k-tô, lû, í-ki̍p iâⁿ-tiong só͘-ū ê cheng-siⁿ.

Só͘-ū lâi kong-kek Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lia̍t-kok iáu oa̍h--lo̍h-lâi ê lâng, ta̍k-nî ōe chiūⁿ-lâi kèng-pài Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chit-ūi Kun-ông, koh siú Tah-liâu-choeh.
Tōe-chiūⁿ bān-cho̍k tiong, bô chiūⁿ-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kèng-pài Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe chit-ūi Kun-ông ê lâng, hō͘-chúi bōe lo̍h tī in ê thó͘-tōe.
Ai-ki̍p -lâng nā bô chiūⁿ-lâi siú-choeh, Siōng Chú bōe lo̍h hō͘-chúi tī in ê thó͘-tōe, Siōng Chú mā ōe ēng un-e̍k hêng-hoa̍t hiah-ê bô lâi siú Tah-liâu-choeh ê lia̍t-kok.
Che chiū-sī Ai-ki̍p kap hiah-ê bô chiūⁿ-lâi siú Tah-liâu-choeh ê lia̍t-kok só͘ siū ê hêng-hoa̍t.
Tī hit-ji̍t, bé ê hâm-lêng ōe khek-jī, “Sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú”; Siōng Chú sèng-tiān lāi ê tiáⁿ ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chè-tôaⁿ chêng ê óaⁿ siâng-khoán sîn-sèng.

Só͘-ū Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap Iû-tāi ê tiáⁿ, lóng ōe sèng-hòa kui Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe; só͘-ū hiàn-chè ê lâng lóng ōe ēng chiah-ê tiáⁿ chú bah. Tī hit-ji̍t, bōe koh ū lâng tī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê sèng-tiān lāi bóe-bōe.
Ē-bīn sī Siōng Chú kau-tài Má-la-ki tùi Í-sek-lia̍t chú-bîn soan-kò ê sìn-sit.

Siōng Chú kā I ê chú-bîn kóng, “Góa it-ti̍t lóng ū teh thiàⁿ lín.” M̄-kú lín kóng, “Lí án-chóaⁿ piáu-hiān lí ū teh thiàⁿ goán?” Siōng Chú ìn kóng, “ Í-sò kiám m̄-sī Ngá-kok ê hiaⁿ-ko? M̄-kú góa khah thiàⁿ Ngá-kok,
khah bô thiàⁿ Í-sò. Góa hō͘ Í-sò ê soaⁿ-niá hong-hòe, chiong i ê thó͘-tōe kau hō͘ khòng-iá ê chhâi-lông.”

Í-sò ê hō͘-tāi Í-tong -lâng nā kóng, “Sui-jiân goán siū húi-hoāi, m̄-kú beh koh tiông-kiàn--khí-lâi.” Hit-sî Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ōe hôe-tap, “Chhut-chāi in khì khí-chō, góa ōe kā in thiah-húi, ti̍t-kàu lâng kiò in chòe ‘siâ-ok ê kok-ka’ á-sī ‘hō͘ Siōng Chú éng-oán siū-khì ê jîn-bîn’.”
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng it-tēng ōe chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--kìⁿ; in ōe kóng, “Siōng Chú tī Í-sek-lia̍t kéng-gōa mā siū chun-chông!”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kā lín chiah-ê chè-si kóng, “Kiáⁿ-jî chun-tiōng lāu-pē; po̍k-jîn kèng-ùi chú-lâng. Kì-jiân góa sī lāu-pē, góa eng-kai ū ê chun-tiōng tī tó-ūi? Kì-jiân góa sī chú-lâng, góa eng-kai ū ê kèng-ùi tī tó-ūi? Lín biáu-sī góa ê miâ, kèng-jiân káⁿ mn̄g, ‘Goán bat án-chóaⁿ kā lí biáu-sī?’

Lín chiong bô chheng-khì ê chia̍h-mi̍h hiàn tī góa ê chè-tôaⁿ téng, kèng-jiân koh káⁿ mn̄g, ‘Goán bat án-chóaⁿ phah lâ-sâm chè-tôaⁿ?’ Lín sīm-chì siūⁿ-kóng Siōng Chú ê chè-tôaⁿ thang biáu-sī.

Lín hiàn sit-bêng ê cheng-siⁿ chòe chè-mi̍h, án-ni kiám tio̍h? Chiong kha-pái--ê á-sī ū-pīⁿ--ê hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè, án-ni kiám tio̍h? Lín the̍h chit-khoán lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ lín ê séng-tiúⁿ, i kiám ōe kah-ì á-sī hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p? Che sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng--ê.”

Taⁿ, lín chiah-ê chè-si, khì tùi Siōng-tè kiû-chêng, kiû I khoan-iông lán. Lín the̍h hit-khoán chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ I, I kiám ōe hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p? Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Góa jōa-ni̍h ài lín tiong-kan ū lâng ōe kā sèng-tiān ê mn̂g koaiⁿ--khí-lâi, chiah bián lín tī góa ê chè-tôaⁿ pe̍h-pe̍h khí-hé. Góa bô kah-ì lín, mā bô ài chiap-la̍p lín hiàn ê chè-mi̍h.”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe koh kóng, “Choân sè-kài, tùi ji̍t chhut ê só͘-chāi kàu ji̍t lo̍h ê só͘-chāi, góa ê miâ tī bān-kok tiong siū kèng-tiōng, tī ta̍k só͘-chāi ū lâng tùi góa sio-hiuⁿ, hiàn kiat-chēng ê chè-mi̍h, in-ūi góa ê miâ tī bān-kok tiong siū kèng-tiōng.
M̄-kú lín siat-to̍k góa ê miâ; lín siūⁿ-kóng Chú ê toh siū ù-jiám, toh-téng ê chia̍h-mi̍h bô chheng-khì.

Lín kóng ‘Chiah-ê ū-kàu lô-so hùi-khì’. Lín kèng-jiân kā góa khòaⁿ-khin bú-jio̍k! Che sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng--ê. Lín the̍h chhiúⁿ--lâi-ê, kha-pái--ê, á-sī ū-pīⁿ ê cheng-siⁿ chòe lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ góa; góa kiám ōe chiap-la̍p lín chit-khoán chè-mi̍h? Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni mn̄g.

Nā ū lâng hē-goān beh chiong iûⁿ-kûn tiong ê iûⁿ-káng hiàn hō͘ góa, tian-tò ēng ū khoat-hām--ê lâi hiàn, khi-phiàn góa, i eng-kai siū chiù-chó͘! In-ūi góa sī tōa Kun-ông; góa ê miâ tī bān-kok tiong siū kèng-ùi.” Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe tùi lín chiah-ê chè-si kóng, “Chit-ê bēng-lēng sī hō͘ lín--ê:

Lín nā m̄ thiaⁿ-thàn, m̄ khǹg tī sim-lāi, bô chiong êng-kng kui hō͘ góa, góa chiū beh hō͘ chiù-chó͘ lîm-kàu lín, hō͘ lín ê hok-khì pìⁿ-chòe chiù-chó͘. Bô m̄-tio̍h, góa í-keng kā lín chiù-chó͘ lah, in-ūi lín bô chiong góa ê bēng-lēng khǹg tī sim-lāi.
Góa beh chek-hoa̍t lín ê hō͘-tāi, ēng lín tī choeh-kî hiàn ê cheng-siⁿ ê pùn boah lín ê bīn, kā lín the̍h chhut-khì pùn-tui hiat-ka̍k.
Hit-sî lín chiū chai góa ū hō͘ lín chit-ê bēng-lēng, sī beh hō͘ góa kap Lī-bī ê hō͘-tāi só͘ li̍p ê iok ōe-tàng khak-li̍p. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-kò.
“Góa kap Lī-bī ê hō͘-tāi li̍p ê iok sī èng-ún sù oa̍h-miā kap hô-pêng ê iok, bo̍k-te̍k sī ài in kèng-ùi góa. In khak-si̍t ū kèng-ùi góa, chun-tiōng góa.
In ū thoân-siū chin-lí ê kà-sī, bô kóng put-gī ê ōe. In kap góa kâng pō͘-tiau kiâⁿ hô-pêng chèng-ti̍t ê lō͘, hō͘ chin chōe lâng oa̍t tò-tńg lī-khui chōe-ok.
Chè-si ê chek-jīm sī ûi-hō͘ tì-sek, lâng-lâng tio̍h tùi in chhē-kiû kà-sī, in-ūi in sī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe ê sù-chiá.

“M̄-kú lín chiah-ê chè-si lī-khui chiàⁿ-lō͘, hō͘ chin chōe lâng in-ūi lín ê kà-sī poa̍h-tó hoān-chōe. Lín í-keng phò-hoāi góa kap Lī-bī -lâng li̍p ê iok. Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng.

Só͘-í, góa tian-tò beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t chú-bîn kā lín khòaⁿ-khin, hō͘ lín tī tāi-chiòng bīn-chêng siū lêng-jio̍k; in-ūi lín bô chun-siú góa ê chí-ì, khòaⁿ lâng ê bīn-sek kóe-seh lu̍t-hoat.”

Lán tāi-ke kiám m̄-sī ū siâng chi̍t ê lāu-pē? Kiám m̄-sī siâng chi̍t ūi Siōng-tè chhòng-chō lán? Án-ni, sī-án-chóaⁿ lán hō͘-siōng pōe-sìn, ûi-pōe Siōng-tè kap lán lia̍t-chó͘ só͘ li̍p ê iok?

Iû-tāi jîn-bîn ê hêng-ûi khúi-chà, tī Í-sek-lia̍t kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chòe khó-ò͘ⁿ ê tāi-chì, in-ūi in ū phah lâ-sâm Siōng Chú só͘ ì-ài ê sèng-tiān, chhōa ho̍k-sāi gōa-pang sîn-bêng ê lú-chú chòe bó͘.

Chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì--ê, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h khoán lâng, sui-jiân in hiàn chè-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú, goān Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe tùi Í-sek-lia̍t cho̍k-kûn tiong kā in kóaⁿ-chhut.
Lín lēng-gōa ū koh chòe chi̍t hāng tāi-chì. Lín pi-chhám ai-khàu, ba̍k-sái im-móa Siōng Chú ê chè-tôaⁿ, in-ūi I bô koh-chài hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p lín hiàn hō͘ I ê chè-mi̍h.

Lín mn̄g, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ Siōng Chú bô ài chiap-la̍p?” Sī in-ūi lí ū pōe-poān lí siàu-liân ê sî chhōa ê bó͘, i sī lí ê phit-phòe, lí ū kap i li̍p-iok. Siōng Chú sī lí kap i tiong-kan ê chèng-jîn.

Lâng nā-sī iáu ū chi̍t-sut-á lêng-sèng, i bōe án-ni chòe. Siōng-tè só͘ ì-ài--ê kiám m̄-sī tùi I tiong-sêng ê hō͘-tāi? Só͘-í, tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang pōe-poān lín siàu-liân ê sî chhōa ê bó͘.

Siōng Chú — Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè án-ni kóng, “Góa thó-ià lî-hun. Góa thó-ià lín tiong-kan ū lâng tùi ka-kī ê bó͘ chòe chit-khoán chân-jím ê tāi-chì. Só͘-í, tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang tùi ka-kī ê bó͘ put-tiong pōe-sìn.” Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni soan-pò͘.

Lín ê tâm-lūn hō͘ Siōng Chú ià-siān chhau-hoân. Lín iáu-teh mn̄g, “Goán án-chóaⁿ teh hō͘ I ià-siān chhau-hoân?” Sī in-ūi lín kóng, “Siōng Chú khòaⁿ só͘-ū choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng chòe hó-lâng, koh kah-ì chit-khoán lâng.” Koh kóng, “Kong-gī ê Siōng-tè tī tó-ūi?”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Góa beh chhe-khián góa ê sù-chiá chún-pī góa thâu-chêng ê lō͘; lín teh chhē-kiû ê Chú ōe hut-jiân-kan lâi kàu I ê sèng-tiān. Lín só͘ gióng-bōng hit-ūi li̍p-iok ê sù-chiá teh-beh lâi lah.

“M̄-kú I lâi ê ji̍t siáⁿ-lâng chih-chài ōe tiâu? I chhut-hiān ê sî siáⁿ-lâng khiā ōe chāi? I chhin-chhiūⁿ liān-kim ê lâng ēng ê hé, chhin-chhiūⁿ phiò-pò͘ ê lâng ēng ê kiⁿ.

I beh lâi sím-phòaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng teh thê-liān sûn-kim; i beh chēng-hòa Lī-bī ê hō͘-tāi, thoàn-liān in chhin-chhiūⁿ teh thoàn-liān kim-gûn, it-ti̍t kàu in ōe-tàng hiàn ha̍p-gî ê chè-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng Chú.
Hit-sî, Iû-tāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê jîn-bîn, beh hiàn Siōng Chú só͘ hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p ê chè-mi̍h, kap kó͘-chá ê nî-ji̍t siâng-khoán.”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Góa beh khiā chhut-lâi tī lín bīn-chêng si-hêng sím-phòaⁿ; góa beh kóaⁿ-kín choh-chèng khòng-kò hiah-ê kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t--ê, hoān kan-îm--ê, lām-sám chiù-chōa--ê, pak-siah kang-lâng ê kang-chîⁿ--ê, khi-ap ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū--ê, óng-khut chhut-gōa-lâng--ê — chiū-sī só͘-ū bô kèng-ùi góa ê lâng.”
“In-ūi góa sī Siōng Chú, góa bōe kái-piàn, só͘-í lín chiah-ê Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ-sun bōe bia̍t-bông.”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Tùi lín chó͘-sian ê sî-tāi khai-sí, lín put-sî ûi-pōe góa ê kui-lē, bô teh chun-siú. Taⁿ lín tio̍h kui-ǹg góa, góa chiū choán-ǹg lín. M̄-kú lín mn̄g, ‘Goán beh án-chóaⁿ kui-ǹg lí?’

Góa mn̄g lín, ‘Lâng thau-the̍h Siōng-tè ê mi̍h kiám tio̍h? Lín kèng-jiân ū lâng teh thau-the̍h góa ê mi̍h!’ Lín mn̄g, ‘Goán án-chóaⁿ kā lí thau?’ Lín chiū-sī bô chiàu kui-tēng hōng-hiàn cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t kap kî-tha ê koan-hiàn.
Lín lóng ōe siū tāng ê chiù-chó͘, in-ūi lín choân-kok lóng teh kā góa thau.”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Lín tio̍h chiong cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê hōng-hiàn choân-sò͘ the̍h-lâi khǹg tī khò͘-pâng, án-ni góa ê sèng-tiān chiū ū kàu-gia̍h ê chia̍h-mi̍h. Lâi, lâi chhì-khòaⁿ góa ōe ūi-tio̍h lín khui thiⁿ-thang, chiong hok-khì piàⁿ lo̍h-lâi hō͘ lín á bōe?”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe koh kóng, “Góa beh chó͘-chí chháu-meh húi-hoāi lín thó͘-tōe ê chhut-sán, beh hō͘ hn̂g--ni̍h ê phû-tô-chhiū kiat chin chōe phû-tô.”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Án-ni, bān-kok lóng ōe kóng lín siōng ū hok-khì, in-ūi lín ê tōe ōe hō͘ lâng tī hia an-ku-lo̍k-gia̍p.”
Siōng Chú kóng, “Lín ū ēng ngó͘-ge̍k ê ōe kek góa. Lín kóng, ‘Goán bat ēng sím-mi̍h ōe kek lí?’

Lín bat kóng, ‘Sū-hōng Siōng-tè bô-chhái-kang. Goán chun-siú I ê bēng-lēng, á-sī tī Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe bīn-chêng ai-siong thî-khàu kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì, ū sím-mi̍h lō͘-ēng?
Goán khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê sī chū-ko ê lâng khoài-lo̍k, chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng heng-ōng; in chhì-thàm Siōng-tè mā bián siū hêng-hoa̍t.’”

Jiân-āu, hiah-ê kèng-ùi Siōng Chú ê lâng hō͘-siōng tâm-lūn, Siōng Chú ū chù-ì thiaⁿ. Tī I bīn-chêng ū chi̍t pún kì-lio̍k ê chheh, lāi-bīn kì-chài hiah-ê kèng-ùi Siōng-tè chun-chông I miâ ê lâng.

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Tī góa chhái-chhú hêng-tōng hit-ji̍t, in ōe chiâⁿ-chòe góa te̍k-pia̍t ê chú-bîn; góa ōe thiàⁿ-sioh in, chhin-chhiūⁿ pē-bú thiàⁿ-sioh hiah-ê ho̍k-sāi in ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Hit-sî, lín ōe koh chi̍t piàn khòaⁿ-chhut chèng-ti̍t ê lâng kap siâ-ok ê lâng, ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè kap bô ho̍k-sāi I ê lâng ê chha-pia̍t.”

Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe án-ni kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, hit-ji̍t ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ teh to̍h ê hé-lô͘; sî kàu, só͘-ū chū-ko kap choh-ok ê lâng lóng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ be̍h-kó, hō͘ hé sio kah liân kun kap ki to lóng bô--khì.

M̄-kú, lín chiah-ê kèng-ùi góa ê lâng, kong-gī ê ji̍t-thâu ōe chhut-hiān kā lín chiò; i ê kng ū i-tī ê kong-lêng. Lín ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ gû-káng-á chhut gû-tiâu phut-phut-thiàu.”
Siōng Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kóng, “Tī góa chhái-chhú hêng-tōng hit-ji̍t, lín ōe thún-ta̍h siâ-ok ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh ta̍h kha-ē ê thô͘-hún.
“Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit góa ê po̍k-jîn Mô͘-se ê lu̍t-hoat, chiū-sī góa tī Hô-lia̍t-soaⁿ hoan-hù Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tio̍h chun-siú ê kui-lē kap bēng-lēng.
“Lí khòaⁿ, tī Siōng Chú hit-ê tōa koh thang-kiaⁿ ê ji̍t-chí lâi-lîm í-chêng, góa beh chhe-khián sian-ti Í-lī-a khì lín hia.
I ōe hō͘ lāu-pē ê sim choán-ǹg kiáⁿ-jî, kiáⁿ-jî ê sim choán-ǹg lāu-pē, chiah bián góa lâi ê sî thiat-tóe húi-bia̍t chit-ê tōe.”
Che sī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê ka-phó͘: Iâ-so͘ sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi, Tāi-pi̍t sī A-pek-la-hán ê hō͘-tāi.
A-pek-la-hán siⁿ Í-sat, Í-sat siⁿ Ngá-kok, Ngá-kok siⁿ Iû-tāi kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī.
Iû-tāi tùi Tha-má siⁿ Hoat-le̍k-su kap Siā-la, Hoat-le̍k-su siⁿ Hi-su-lûn, Hi-su-lûn siⁿ A-lân,
A-lân siⁿ A-bí-ná-ta̍t, A-bí-ná-ta̍t siⁿ Ná-sūn, Ná-sūn siⁿ Sat-bûn,
Sat-bûn tùi Lat-ha̍p siⁿ Pho-a-su, Pho-a-su tùi Lō͘-tek siⁿ Gô-pī-tek, Gô-pī-tek siⁿ Iâ-se,
Iâ-se siⁿ Tāi-pi̍t -ông. Tāi-pi̍t tùi O͘-lī-a ê bó͘ siⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn,
Só͘-lô-bûn siⁿ Lô-pho-an, Lô-pho-an siⁿ A-pí-ngá, A-pí-ngá siⁿ A-sat,
A-sat siⁿ Iok-sa-hoat, Iok-sa-hoat siⁿ Iok-lân, Iok-lân siⁿ O͘-se-a,
O͘-se-a siⁿ Iok-thán, Iok-thán siⁿ A-hap-su, A-hap-su siⁿ Hi-se-ka,
Hi-se-ka siⁿ Má-ná-se, Má-ná-se siⁿ A-mô͘-sū, A-mô͘-sū siⁿ Iok-se-a.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng siū chhian-sóa khì Pa-pí-lûn ê sî, Iok-se-a siⁿ Iok-ngá-kun kap i ê hiaⁿ-tī.
Siū chhian-sóa khì Pa-pí-lûn í-āu, Iok-ngá-kun siⁿ Sat-lia̍p-thiat, Sat-lia̍p-thiat siⁿ Só͘-lô-pa-pek,
Só͘-lô-pa-pek siⁿ A-pí-gio̍k, A-pí-gio̍k siⁿ Í-lī-a-kèng, Í-lī-a-kèng siⁿ A-só͘,
A-só͘ siⁿ Sat-tok, Sat-tok siⁿ A-kim, A-kim siⁿ Í-lu̍t,
Í-lu̍t siⁿ Í-lī-a-sat, Í-lī-a-sat siⁿ Má-tān, Má-tān siⁿ Ngá-kok,
Ngá-kok siⁿ Iok-sek, Iok-sek sī Má-lī-a ê tiōng-hu; hit-ê chheng-chòe Ki-tok ê Iâ-so͘ sī tùi chit-ê Má-lī-a siⁿ--ê.

Án-ni, tùi A-pek-la-hán kàu Tāi-pi̍t lóng-chóng ū cha̍p-sì tāi, tùi Tāi-pi̍t kàu siū chhian-sóa khì Pa-pí-lûn ū cha̍p-sì tāi, tùi siū chhian-sóa khì Pa-pí-lûn kàu Ki-tok mā ū cha̍p-sì tāi.
Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok chhut-sì ê keng-kè sī án-ni: I ê lāu-bú Má-lī-a í-keng kap Iok-sek tēng-hun, iáu-bē kiat-hun chiū tùi Sèng Sîn hoâi-īn.
I ê bī-hun-hu Iok-sek sī chèng-ti̍t ê lâng, bô ài hō͘ i tī lâng ê bīn-chêng kiàn-siàu, siūⁿ-beh àm-tiong kái-tû hun-iok.

I teh siūⁿ chit-ê tāi-chì ê sî, tī bîn-bāng tiong, Chú ê thiⁿ-sài tùi i chhut-hiān, kóng, “ Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi Iok-sek, m̄-bián kiaⁿ, tio̍h chhōa Má-lī-a ji̍p-mn̂g chòe bó͘, in-ūi i só͘ hoâi-īn ê thai sī tùi Sèng Sîn lâi--ê.
I ōe siⁿ chi̍t ê ta-po͘-kiáⁿ, lí tio̍h kā I hō-miâ kiò-chòe Iâ-so͘, in-ūi I beh kiù I ê chú-bîn thoat-lī in ê chōe.”
Che it-chhè ê sū hoat-seng sī beh èng-giām Chú thok sian-ti só͘ kóng ê ōe:
Lí khòaⁿ, chāi-sek-lú ōe hoâi-īn siⁿ-kiáⁿ, I ê miâ beh kiò-chòe Í-má-lōe-lī. “Í-má-lōe-lī” ê ì-sù sī “Siōng-tè kap lán tông-chāi”.
Iok-sek chi̍t-ē khùn-chhíⁿ, chiū chiàu Chú ê thiⁿ-sài só͘ hoan-hù chhōa Má-lī-a ji̍p-mn̂g chòe bó͘,
put-kò chit-ê ta-po͘-kiáⁿ iáu-bē chhut-sì í-chêng bô kap Má-lī-a tâng-pâng. Eⁿ-á chhut-sì, Iok-sek chiū kā I hō-miâ kiò-chòe Iâ-so͘.
Hi-lu̍t choh-ông ê sî, Iâ-so͘ tī Iû-thài ê Pek-lī-hêng chhut-sì. Ū kúi-nā ê seng-siōng-ka tùi tang-hng lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
In mn̄g kóng, “Hit-ê chhut-sì chòe Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông--ê tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi? Goán ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h I ê chhiⁿ chhut-hiān, choan-kang lâi beh pài I.”
Hi-lu̍t -ông thiaⁿ--tio̍h, sim-lāi tio̍h-kip put-an; Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng choân-siâⁿ ê lâng mā-sī án-ni.
I chiū tiàu-chi̍p só͘-ū ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap bîn-kan ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su, mn̄g in kóng, “Ki-tok eng-kai tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi chhut-sì?”
In ìn kóng, “ Iû-thài ê Pek-lī-hêng. In-ūi sian-ti ū án-ni kì-chài:

Iû-tāi tōe-khu ê Pek-lī-hêng ah, lí tī Iû-tāi siâⁿ-chhī tiong m̄-sī siōng bî-sòe--ê; in-ūi ū chi̍t ê léng-siù ōe tùi lí hia chhut--lâi, I beh bo̍k-ióng góa ê chú-bîn Í-sek-lia̍t.”
Hi-lu̍t chiū àm-tiong tiàu hit kúi ê seng-siōng-ka, siông-sè kā in mn̄g hit-lia̍p chhiⁿ sím-mi̍h sî chhut-hiān.
Āu-lâi, i chhe in khì Pek-lī-hêng, kóng, “Lín khì siông-sè chhâ-mn̄g koan-hē chit-ê sòe-hàn gín-á ê sū; chhē--tio̍h, tio̍h lâi pò góa chai, góa mā thang khì pài I.”
In thiaⁿ ông ê ōe chiū khì. In tī tang-hng khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê hit-lia̍p chhiⁿ chòe thâu chhōa in, lâi kàu hit-ê sòe-hàn gín-á ê só͘-chāi chiū thêng tī téng-bīn.
In khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-lia̍p chhiⁿ, hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí.

In ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h sòe-hàn gín-á kap I ê lāu-bú Má-lī-a, chiū phak lo̍h-khì pài I, jiân-āu khui in ê pó-a̍h, chiong n̂g-kim, jú-hiuⁿ, kap bu̍t-io̍h chòe lé-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ I.
Āu-lâi, tī bîn-bāng tiong Siōng-tè chí-sī in m̄-thang tò-khì Hi-lu̍t hia, in chiū tùi pa̍t-tiâu lō͘ tò-khì pún-kok.

Seng-siōng-ka lī-khui liáu-āu, Chú ê thiⁿ-sài tī Iok-sek ê bîn-bāng tiong tùi i chhut-hiān, kóng, “Khí--lâi, chhōa sòe-hàn gín-á kap I ê lāu-bú tô-cháu khì Ai-ki̍p, tòa hia kàu góa kóng thang lī-khui ê sî, in-ūi Hi-lu̍t teh chhē chit-ê sòe-hàn gín-á, beh kā I thâi-sí.”
Iok-sek chiū khí--lâi, chhōa sòe-hàn gín-á kap I ê lāu-bú thàu-mî lī-khui khì Ai-ki̍p,
tòa tī hia kàu Hi-lu̍t sí. Che sī beh èng-giām Chú thong-kè sian-ti só͘ kóng ê ōe: Góa ū tiàu góa ê kiáⁿ chhut Ai-ki̍p.

Hi-lu̍t chi̍t-ē chai ka-kī hō͘ seng-siōng-ka phiàn--khì, hui-siông siū-khì, chiū chhe lâng chiong Pek-lī-hêng í-ki̍p chiu-ûi só͘-ū ê ta-po͘ gín-á, chiàu i tùi seng-siōng-ka siông-sè chhâ-mn̄g ê sî sǹg-khí, nn̄g hè í-hā--ê lóng thâi-sí.
Chit-ê tāi-chì ū èng-giām Chú thong-kè sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí só͘ kóng ê ōe:
Tī La-má ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h siaⁿ, thî-khàu chin pi-siong; Lúi-kiat ūi-tio̍h i ê kiáⁿ-jî teh khàu, m̄-khéng siū an-ùi, in-ūi in lóng bô--khì lah.
Hi-lu̍t sí í-āu, Chú ê thiⁿ-sài tī Ai-ki̍p, tī Iok-sek ê bîn-bāng tiong tùi i chhut-hiān,
kóng, “Khí--lâi, chhōa sòe-hàn gín-á kap I ê lāu-bú tò-khì Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe; in-ūi beh hāi sòe-hàn gín-á ê sìⁿ-miā hiah-ê lâng í-keng sí.”
Iok-sek chiū khí--lâi, chhōa sòe-hàn gín-á kap I ê lāu-bú tò-khì Í-sek-lia̍t -tōe.
Iok-sek thiaⁿ-kìⁿ A-ki-ló sòa-chiap i ê lāu-pē Hi-lu̍t chòe Iû-thài ê ông, m̄-káⁿ tò-khì hia; āu-lâi tī bîn-bāng tiong tit-tio̍h chí-sī, chiū thè-khì Ka-lī-lī kéng-lāi,
kàu chi̍t ê siâⁿ kiò-chòe Ná-sat-le̍k, tòa tī hia. Che sī beh èng-giām Chú thong-kè sian-ti só͘ kóng ê ōe: I beh kiò-chòe Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng.
Tng-sî, Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān lâi Iû-thài ê khòng-iá teh thoân-tō.
I soan-iông kóng, “Lín tio̍h hóe-kái, in-ūi Thian-kok teh-beh si̍t-hiān lah!”
Chit-ê lâng chiū-sī sian-ti Í-sài-a só͘ teh kóng--ê: Ū siaⁿ tī khòng-iá teh hoah: Tio̍h ūi Chú chún-pī tō-lō͘, ūi I siu-ti̍t sió-lō͘.
Iok-hān chhēng lo̍k-tô-mn̂g ê saⁿ, io hâ phê-tòa, só͘ chia̍h--ê sī chháu-meh kap iá-bi̍t.
Ū chin chōe lâng tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, Iû-thài ta̍k só͘-chāi, kap Iok-tàn-hô it-tài lâi i hia,
jīn-chōe, tī Iok-tàn-hô tùi i niá-siū sóe-lé.

Iok-hān khòaⁿ-tio̍h chin chōe Hoat-lī-sài-phài kap Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng mā lâi niá-siū sóe-lé, chiū tùi in kóng, “Lín chiah-ê to̍k-chôa, sím-mi̍h-lâng kéng-kò lín siám-pī Siōng-tè teh-beh hoat ê siū-khì?
Tio̍h ēng hêng-ûi chèng-bêng lín ū hóe-kái.
Lín m̄-thang ka-kī siūⁿ-kóng ‘ A-pek-la-hán sī goán ê chó͘-sian’, góa kā lín kóng, Siōng-tè ōe-tàng ēng chiah-ê chio̍h-thâu chō kiáⁿ-sun hō͘ A-pek-la-hán.
Pó͘-thâu í-keng khòa tī chhiū-thâu; só͘-ū bô kiat hó ké-chí ê chhiū lóng beh kā chhò--khí-lâi, hiat-lo̍h hé.

Góa ēng chúi kā lín sóe-lé, piáu-sī lín í-keng ū hóe-kái; m̄-kú tī góa āu-bīn teh lâi Hit-ūi pí góa khah ū koân-lêng, góa liân kā I kōaⁿ ôe to bōe-kham--tit; I beh ēng Sèng Sîn kap hé kā lín sóe-lé.
I ê chhiú the̍h pòa-ki, beh chiong be̍h-tiâⁿ ê be̍h pòa chheng-khì, be̍h-á siu-ji̍p chhng-khò͘, be̍h-hiūⁿ chiū ēng bōe hoa ê hé kā i sio-tiāu.”
Hit-sî, Iâ-so͘ tùi Ka-lī-lī lâi Iok-tàn-hô Iok-hān hia, beh tùi i niá-siū sóe-lé.
Iok-hān beh kā I chó͘-chí, kóng, “Góa eng-kai tùi lí niá-siū sóe-lé, lí hoán-tńg lâi chhē góa?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lán hiān-chāi án-ni chòe chiah ha̍h Siōng-tè it-chhè ê iau-kiû.” Iok-hān chiū tông-ì.

Iâ-so͘ niá-siū sóe-lé í-āu sûi-sî tùi chúi--ni̍h khí--lâi; hut-jiân thiⁿ ūi-tio̍h I khui, I khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè ê Sîn chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu kàng--lo̍h-lâi, hioh tī I sin-chiūⁿ.
Koh tùi thiⁿ ū siaⁿ kóng: Chit-ê sī góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê Kiáⁿ, I, góa chin ì-ài.
Āu-lâi, Iâ-so͘ hō͘ Sèng Sîn chhōa-khì khòng-iá, tī hia siū Mô͘-kúi chhì-thàm.
Iâ-so͘ kìm-chia̍h sì-cha̍p mî-ji̍t, āu-lâi chiū iau.
Chhì-thàm-chiá óa-lâi tùi I kóng, “Kì-jiân lí sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ, bēng-lēng chiah-ê chio̍h-thâu pìⁿ-chòe piáⁿ!”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Lâng teh oa̍h m̄-nā óa-khò piáⁿ, sī óa-khò tùi Siōng-tè ê chhùi só͘ chhut ê ta̍k-kù ōe.”
Jiân-āu, Mô͘-kúi chhōa Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì Sèng-tiān, hō͘ I khiā tī Sèng-tiān chhù-téng siōng-koân ê só͘-chāi,

tùi I kóng, “Kì-jiân lí sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ, thiàu--lo̍h-khì! In-ūi Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Siōng-tè ōe ūi-tio̍h lí bēng-lēng I ê thiⁿ-sài, in ōe ēng chhiú hû lí, hō͘ lí ê kha bōe kha̍p-tio̍h chio̍h-thâu.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Sèng-keng koh ū kì-chài: M̄-thang chhì-thàm Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè.”
Mô͘-kúi koh chhōa Iâ-so͘ chiūⁿ chi̍t ê chin-koân ê soaⁿ, chiong sè-chiūⁿ bān-kok kap in ê êng-hôa hō͘ I khòaⁿ,
tùi I kóng, “Lí nā phak lo̍h-lâi pài góa, chiah-ê it-chhè góa lóng hō͘ lí.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Sat-tàn, cháu! Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Tio̍h pài Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè, chí-ū ho̍k-sāi I.”
Jiân-āu Mô͘-kúi lī-khui Iâ-so͘; ū thiⁿ-sài lâi kā I sū-hāu.
Iâ-so͘ thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-hān hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì chiū thè-khì Ka-lī-lī.
I lī-khui Ná-sat-le̍k khì tòa tī Se-pò͘-lûn kap Ná-hut-tha-lī tōe-khu, Ka-lī-lī ô͘-piⁿ ê Ka-pek-lông.
Che sī beh èng-giām thong-kè sian-ti Í-sài-a só͘ kóng ê ōe:
Se-pò͘-lûn ê tōe, Ná-hut-tha-lī ê tōe, iân-hái ê lō͘, Iok-tàn-hô tang-hōaⁿ, Gōa-pang-lâng ê Ka-lī-lī,
tiàm tī o͘-àm tiong ê lâng ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ tōa-kng; tiàm tī sí-ìm ê tōe--ê ū kng chiò in.
Tùi hit-sî, Iâ-so͘ khai-sí soan-iông kóng, “Tio̍h hóe-kái, in-ūi Thian-kok teh-beh si̍t-hiān lah!”
Iâ-so͘ tī Ka-lī-lī ô͘-piⁿ teh kiâⁿ ê sî, khòaⁿ-tio̍h nn̄g ê hiaⁿ-tī, kiò-chòe Pí-tek ê Se-bûn kap i ê sió-tī An-tek-lia̍t, tī ô͘--ni̍h teh pha-bāng, in-ūi in sī lia̍h-hî--ê.
I tùi in kóng, “Lâi tè góa, góa beh hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ lia̍h-hî--ê tit-tio̍h hî.”
In sûi-sî kā bāng pàng--leh, khì tè Iâ-so͘.

Iâ-so͘ kiâⁿ chìn-chêng, khòaⁿ-tio̍h lēng-gōa nn̄g ê hiaⁿ-tī, Se-pì-thài ê kiáⁿ Ngá-kok kap i ê sió-tī Iok-hān. In kap lāu-pē Se-pì-thài tī chûn-téng teh chéng-lí bāng, I chiū ho͘-tiàu in.
In sûi-sî chiong chûn kap lāu-pē pàng--leh, khì tè Iâ-so͘.
Iâ-so͘ kàu Ka-lī-lī ta̍k só͘-chāi, tī in ê hōe-tn̂g kà-sī lâng, thoân Thian-kok ê hok-im, i-hó bîn-kan ta̍k-khoán ê pīⁿ-chèng.

I ê miâ-siaⁿ thoân kàu Sū-lī-a ê ta̍k só͘-chāi. Lâng chiong só͘-ū ê pīⁿ-lâng, chiū-sī siâ-sîn hū-sin, iûⁿ-hîn, kap poàn-sin-put-sūi, téng, hoān-tio̍h ta̍k-khoán chèng-thâu kap pīⁿ-thiàⁿ ê lâng lóng chhōa-lâi I hia, I chiū kā in i-hó.
Ū chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng tùi Ka-lī-lī, Te-ka-pho-lí, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, Iû-thài, kap Iok-tàn-hô tang-hōaⁿ lâi tè I.
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng, chiū peh-chiūⁿ soaⁿ. I chē--lo̍h-khì, bûn-tô͘ óa--lâi,
chiū khai-sí kà-sī in, kóng,
“Sim-lêng sàn-chhiah ê lâng chin ū hok-khì, in-ūi Thian-kok sī chit-khoán lâng ê.
Iu-siong ê lâng chin ū hok-khì, in-ūi Siōng-tè ōe kā in an-ùi.
Un-jiû ê lâng chin ū hok-khì, in-ūi Siōng-tè ōe hō͘ in sêng-siū èng-ún ê thó͘-tōe.
Iau chhùi-ta him-bō͘ Siōng-tè chí-ì si̍t-hiān ê lâng chin ū hok-khì, in-ūi Siōng-tè ōe hō͘ in pá-chiok.
Gâu lîn-bín ê lâng chin ū hok-khì, in-ūi Siōng-tè ōe kā in lîn-bín.
Sim chheng-khì ê lâng chin ū hok-khì, in-ūi in ōe kìⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè.
Chhiok-chìn hô-pêng ê lâng chin ū hok-khì, in-ūi in ōe chiâⁿ-chòe Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Ūi-tio̍h si̍t-chián Siōng-tè ê chí-ì siū pek-hāi ê lâng chin ū hok-khì, in-ūi Thian-kok sī chit-khoán lâng ê.
“Ūi-tio̍h góa ê iân-kò͘, lâng kā lín bú-jio̍k, pek-hāi, kóng ta̍k-khoán pháiⁿ-ōe húi-pòng, lín chin ū hok-khì.
Tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, in-ūi lín tī thiⁿ-téng ê pò-siúⁿ chin tōa; lín í-chêng ê sian-ti mā bat án-ni siū pek-hāi.”
“Lín sī tōe-chiūⁿ ê iâm; iâm nā sit-bī, beh án-chóaⁿ hō͘ i koh kiâm? Iâm sit-bī chiū bô lō͘-ēng, chí-ū hìⁿ-sak, hō͘ lâng thún-ta̍h.
“Lín sī sè-kan ê kng. Khí tī soaⁿ-téng ê siâⁿ khàm bōe tiâu.
Lâng tiám-teng liáu-āu bōe ēng táu kā i khàm--khí-lâi, it-tēng ōe kā i chhāi tī teng-tâi téng, thang kā chhù-lāi só͘-ū ê lâng chiò-kng.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, lín ê kng tio̍h chiò tī lâng ê bīn-chêng, thang hō͘ in khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lín ê hó hêng-ûi lâi êng-kng lín ê Thiⁿ-pē.”
“M̄-thang siūⁿ-kóng góa lâi sī beh hòe-tû Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat á-sī sian-ti ê kà-sī. Góa lâi m̄-sī beh hòe-tû, sī beh si̍t-hiān.
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, thiⁿ kap tōe ōe siau-sit, Lu̍t-hoat ê chi̍t-tiám chi̍t-u̍ih choa̍t-tùi bōe siau-sit, lóng ōe si̍t-hiān.

Só͘-í, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng hoān-tio̍h chiah-ê kài-bēng siōng-sòe ê chi̍t tiâu, koh kà lâng án-ni khì hoān, tī Thian-kok i sǹg-chòe sī siōng-sòe--ê. Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng ka-kī chun-siú, mā kà lâng chun-siú, tī Thian-kok chit-ê lâng sǹg-chòe sī siōng-tōa--ê.
Góa kā lín kóng, lín nā bô pí keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng koh-khah tiong-si̍t chun-siú Siōng-tè ê chí-ì, choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng ji̍p Thian-kok.”
“Lín ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Lu̍t-hoat án-ni kà-sī kó͘-chá-lâng, kóng, ‘M̄-thang hāi-sí lâng; hāi-sí lâng--ê tio̍h siū sím-phòaⁿ.’

M̄-kú góa kā lín kóng, tùi hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē hoat siū-khì, lóng tio̍h siū sím-phòaⁿ. Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng mē hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē ‘hòe-jîn’, tio̍h chiūⁿ hoat-têng; mē hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē ‘tòng-gōng’, tio̍h siū tōe-ge̍k ê hé sio.
Só͘-í, lí tī chè-tôaⁿ beh hiàn lé-mi̍h ê sî, nā siūⁿ-tio̍h lí ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē tùi lí ū put-móa,
tio̍h chiong lé-mi̍h pàng-hē tī chè-tôaⁿ chêng, seng khì kap i hô-hó, jiân-āu chiah lâi hiàn lé-mi̍h.

“Lâng kā lí khòng-kò, beh thoa lí khì hoat-têng, iáu tī lō͘-tiong ê sî tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín kap i hô-kái, chiah bián hō͘ khòng-kò lí ê lâng kā lí kau hō͘ phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, phòaⁿ-koaⁿ kā lí kau hō͘ hoat-kéng khì koaiⁿ-kaⁿ. Góa si̍t-chāi kā lí kóng, chòe-āu ê chi̍t-sián-gō͘-lî bô hêng chheng-chhó, lí choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng chhut-kaⁿ.”
“Lín ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Lu̍t-hoat án-ni kà-sī kóng, ‘M̄-thang kan-îm.’
M̄-kú góa kā lín kóng, lâng nā ēng siâ-liām khòaⁿ hū-lú, í-keng tī sim-lāi hoān kan-îm.
Lí ê chiàⁿ-ba̍k nā ín-khí lí hoān-chōe, tio̍h kā i ó͘ hiat-ka̍k, lêng-khó sit-khì seng-khu ê chi̍t-pō͘-hūn, pí kui seng-khu hó-hó hiat-lo̍h tōe-ge̍k khah hó.
Lí ê chiàⁿ-chhiú nā ín-khí lí hoān-chōe, tio̍h kā i chām hiat-ka̍k, lêng-khó sit-khì seng-khu ê chi̍t-pō͘-hūn, pí kui seng-khu hó-hó hiat-lo̍h tōe-ge̍k khah hó.”
“Koh ū Lu̍t-hoat án-ni kóng, ‘Lâng nā beh lî i ê bó͘, tio̍h hō͘ i lî-hun-su.’

M̄-kú góa kā lín kóng, nā m̄-sī in-ūi bó͘ put-cheng, m̄-thang kā i lî, in-ūi i nā koh khì kè chiū-sī hāi i hoān kan-îm; chhōa chit-ê lî-hun ê hū-lú ê lâng mā-sī hoān kan-îm.”
“Lín koh ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Lu̍t-hoat án-ni kà-sī kó͘-chá-lâng, kóng, ‘M̄-thang ûi-pōe só͘ hē ê goān, tī Chú bīn-chêng hē-goān tio̍h si̍t-hêng.’
M̄-kú góa kā lín kóng, lóng m̄-thang chiù-chōa. M̄-thang kí thiⁿ chiù-chōa, in-ūi thiⁿ sī Siōng-tè ê pó-chō;
mā m̄-thang kí tōe chiù-chōa, in-ūi tōe sī Siōng-tè ê kha-tiam; mā m̄-thang kí Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiù-chōa, in-ūi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sī tōa Kun-ông ê siâⁿ.
Mā m̄-thang kí lí ê thâu-khak chiù-chōa, in-ūi lí bōe-tàng hō͘ chi̍t ki thâu-mn̂g pìⁿ-o͘ á-sī pìⁿ-pe̍h.
Lín kóng-ōe, sī, chiū kóng sī, m̄-sī, chiū kóng m̄-sī; kî-tha ke kóng--ê sī tùi Siâ-ok-chiá chhut--lâi-ê.”
“Lín ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Lu̍t-hoat án-ni kà-sī kóng, ‘Ba̍k-chiu pê ba̍k-chiu; chhùi-khí pê chhùi-khí.’
M̄-kú góa kā lín kóng, m̄-thang tí-khòng choh-ok ê lâng. Lâng nā siàn lí chiàⁿ-pêng ê chhùi-phóe, liân tò-pêng mā oa̍t hō͘ i siàn.
Lâng nā kò lí, beh the̍h lí ê lāi-saⁿ, liân gōa-saⁿ mā hō͘ i.
Chiàm-léng-kun ê kun-jîn nā kiông-pek lí kiâⁿ chi̍t lí lō͘, tio̍h kap i kiâⁿ nn̄g lí.
Lâng nā tùi lí kiû, tio̍h hō͘ i; kā lí chioh, m̄-thang kū-choa̍t.”
“Lín ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-khoán kà-sī, ‘Tio̍h thiàⁿ lí ê chhù-piⁿ, oàn-hūn lí ê tùi-te̍k.’
M̄-kú góa kā lín kóng, tio̍h thiàⁿ lín ê tùi-te̍k, thòe pek-hāi lín ê lâng kî-tó.
Án-ni, lín chiah ōe-tàng chiâⁿ-chòe lín Thiⁿ-pē ê kiáⁿ-jî, in-ūi I hō͘ ji̍t-thâu chhut-lâi chiò pháiⁿ-lâng kap hó-lâng, mā lo̍h-hō͘ hō͘ gī-lâng kap put-gī ê lâng.
In-ūi lín nā kan-ta thiàⁿ hiah-ê thiàⁿ lín ê lâng, ū sím-mi̍h pò-siúⁿ? Kiám m̄-sī liân hiah-ê ba̍uh-sè--ê mā án-ni chòe?
Lín nā chí-ū tùi ka-kī ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē chhéng-an, ū sím-mi̍h pí pa̍t-lâng khah te̍k-pia̍t? Kiám m̄-sī liân Gōa-pang-lâng mā án-ni chòe?
Kì-jiân lín ê Thiⁿ-pē sī oân-choân, lín mā tio̍h oân-choân.”
“Tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ chiah kò͘-ì tī lâng ê bīn-chêng tián lín ê kèng-khiân; án-ni chòe bōe-tàng tùi lín ê Thiⁿ-pē tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ.

“Só͘-í, lí chín-chè ê sî, m̄-thang seng pûn lat-pah pò lâng chai, chhin-chhiūⁿ ké-hó ê lâng tī hōe-tn̂g kap koe-lō͘ án-ni chòe, ài hō͘ lâng o-ló. Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, in í-keng tit-tio̍h in ê pò-siúⁿ lah.
Lí chín-chè ê sî, m̄-thang hō͘ lí ê tò-chhiú chai chiàⁿ-chhiú ê só͘-chòe,
hō͘ lí thang tiām-tiām-á chín-chè, tiām-tiām-á teh khòaⁿ ê lí ê Pē ōe kā lí pò-siúⁿ.”

“Lín kî-tó ê sî, m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ ké-hó ê lâng, in-ūi in ài hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ, kò͘-ì khiā tī hōe-tn̂g á-sī lō͘-kháu kî-tó. Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, in í-keng tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ lah.
Lí kî-tó ê sî, tio̍h ji̍p-khì pâng-keng lāi, koaiⁿ-mn̂g, tùi lí tiām-tiām-á teh khòaⁿ ê Pē kiû, án-ni tiām-tiām-á teh khòaⁿ ê lí ê Pē ōe kā lí pò-siúⁿ.
“Lín kî-tó ê sî, m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ Gōa-pang-lâng kóng-liáu koh kóng, in-ūi in siūⁿ, kóng khah chōe ōe Siōng-tè chiah ōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Lín m̄-thang kap in siâng-khoán; in-ūi iáu-bē kiû í-chêng, lín ê Pē í-keng chai lín ê su-iàu.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h án-ni kî-tó: Goán ê Thiⁿ-pē: Goān lí ê sèng-miâ siū chun-chông.
Goān lí si-hêng chú-koân; goān lí ê chí-ì si̍t-hiān, tī tōe-chiūⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ tī thiⁿ-téng.
Kiû lí kin-á-ji̍t sù goán su-iàu ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Kiû lí sià-bián goán ê ko͘-hū, chhin-chhiūⁿ goán mā ū sià-bián ko͘-hū goán ê lâng.
Kiû lí m̄-thang hō͘ goán hām-lo̍h tam-tng bōe khí ê chhì-thàm, kiù goán thoat-lī hit-ê Siâ-ok-chiá.
“Lín nā sià-bián lâng ê kè-sit, lín ê Thiⁿ-pē mā ōe sià-bián lín;
lín nā bô sià-bián lâng, lín ê Thiⁿ-pē mā bōe sià-bián lín ê kè-sit.”

“Lín kìm-chia̍h ê sî, m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ ké-hó ê lâng iu-thâu-kat-bīn; in-ūi in kò͘-ì hō͘ bīn pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ, ài hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chhut in teh kìm-chia̍h. Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, in í-keng tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ lah.
Lí kìm-chia̍h ê sî, thâu-mn̂g tio̍h boah-iû, bīn tio̍h sóe,
hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ bōe chhut lí teh kìm-chia̍h, chí-ū hō͘ tiām-tiām-á teh khòaⁿ ê Pē khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, án-ni tiām-tiām-á teh khòaⁿ ê lí ê Pē ōe kā lí pò-siúⁿ.”
“M̄-thang ūi-tio̍h ka-kī chek-chū châi-pó tī tōe-chiūⁿ, tī chia ū thâng kā, ōe siⁿ-sian, chha̍t ōe ó͘-khang thau-the̍h.
Tio̍h ūi-tio̍h ka-kī chek-chū châi-pó tī thiⁿ-téng, tī hia bô thâng kā, bōe siⁿ-sian, bô chha̍t ó͘-khang thau-the̍h.
In-ūi lí ê châi-pó tī tó-ūi, lí ê sim mā ōe tī hia.”
“Ba̍k-chiu sī seng-khu ê teng. Lí ê ba̍k-chiu nā kim, kui seng-khu chiū kng-bêng;
lí ê ba̍k-chiu nā hoe, kui seng-khu chiū o͘-àm. Án-ni, lí lāi-bīn ê kng nā pìⁿ-chòe àm, chit-ê o͘-àm sī jōa-á-ni̍h giâm-tiōng!”

“Bô lâng ōe-tàng ho̍k-sāi nn̄g ê chú-lâng; i nā m̄-sī oàn-hūn chit-ê, thiàⁿ hit-ê, chiū-sī khòaⁿ-tāng chit-ê, khòaⁿ-khin hit-ê. Lín bōe-tàng siâng-sî ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè koh ho̍k-sāi chîⁿ-châi.

“Só͘-í, góa kā lín kóng, m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h lín ê sìⁿ-miā beh chia̍h sím-mi̍h, beh lim sím-mi̍h teh chhau-hoân; mā m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h lín ê seng-khu beh chhēng sím-mi̍h teh chhau-hoân. Sìⁿ-miā kiám m̄-sī pí chia̍h-mi̍h khah tiōng-iàu? Seng-khu kiám m̄-sī pí i-ho̍k khah tiōng-iàu?

Lín khòaⁿ khong-tiong ê pe-chiáu, in bô chèng-choh, bô siu-sêng, mā bô tún-chek niû-si̍t tī chhng-khò͘, lín ê Thiⁿ-pē mā teh kā in iúⁿ-chhī. Lín kiám bô pí in khah kùi-tiōng?
Lín kiám ū lâng siūⁿ-kóng chhau-hoân ōe-tàng hō͘ ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā ke oa̍h chi̍t-sî-á kú?
“Lín ná tio̍h in-ūi beh chhēng sím-mi̍h chhau-hoân? Lín siūⁿ-khòaⁿ soaⁿ-iá ê hoe án-chóaⁿ teh tōa-châng; in bô lô-khó͘, mā bô pháng-chit.
Put-kò góa kā lín kóng, liân Só͘-lô-bûn siōng êng-hôa ê sî, i chhēng ê saⁿ to bô pí chiah-ê hoe ê chi̍t lúi koh-khah súi.

Soaⁿ-iá ê hoe-chháu kin-á-ji̍t teh oa̍h, bîn-á-chài hō͘ lâng hiat-lo̍h hé-lô͘, Siōng-tè to án-ni kā in chng-thāⁿ, I kiám bōe koh-khah kā lín chng-thāⁿ? Lín ná chiah-ni̍h bô sìn-sim!
“Só͘-í, lín m̄-bián chhau-hoân kóng ‘Goán beh chia̍h sím-mi̍h’ á-sī ‘Goán beh lim sím-mi̍h, beh chhēng sím-mi̍h’.
Chiah-ê lóng sī Gōa-pang-lâng teh tui-kiû--ê. Lín ê Thiⁿ-pē chai chiah-ê lóng sī lín só͘ su-iàu--ê.
Tio̍h seng tui-kiû I ê chú-koân kap I ê chí-ì si̍t-hiān, chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chiū ōe lóng sòa hō͘ lín.
Só͘-í, m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h bîn-á-chài chhau-hoân; bîn-á-chài ê tāi-chì bîn-á-chài chiah chhau-hoân. Chi̍t ji̍t ê kan-khó͘ chi̍t ji̍t tng.”
“M̄-thang phoe-phòaⁿ lâng, chiah bián siū Siōng-tè sím-phòaⁿ.

In-ūi lín ēng sím-mi̍h phiau-chún phoe-phòaⁿ lâng, Siōng-tè mā ōe chiàu án-ni kā lín sím-phòaⁿ; lín ēng sím-mi̍h niû niû hō͘ lâng, Siōng-tè mā ōe chiàu án-ni niû hō͘ lín.
Lí ná kan-ta teh khòaⁿ hiaⁿ-tī ba̍k-chiu lāi ê chhâ-iù-á, ia̍h bô chù-ì tio̍h ka-kī ba̍k-chiu lāi ū chhâ-kho͘?
Lí ka-kī ba̍k-chiu lāi ū chhâ-kho͘, ná ōe-tàng kā lí ê hiaⁿ-tī kóng ‘Lí ba̍k-chiu lāi ū chhâ-iù-á, góa kā lí the̍h--chhut-lâi’?
Ké-hó ê lâng, ka-kī ba̍k-chiu lāi ê chhâ-kho͘ tio̍h seng the̍h--chhut-lâi, chiah ōe-tàng khòaⁿ chheng-chhó thang kā hiaⁿ-tī ba̍k-chiu lāi ê chhâ-iù-á the̍h--chhut-lâi.
“M̄-thang the̍h sîn-sèng ê mi̍h hō͘ káu, in ōe oa̍t kè-lâi kā lín; mā m̄-thang chiong lín ê chin-chu hiat tī ti ê bīn-chêng, in ōe ēng kha thún-ta̍h.”
“Kiû, ōe tit--tio̍h; chhē, ōe chhē--tio̍h; phah-mn̂g, ōe kā lín khui.
In-ūi kiû--ê, chiū tit--tio̍h; chhē--ê, chiū chhē--tio̍h; phah-mn̂g--ê, chiū kā i khui.
Lín tiong-kan kiám ū lâng, in kiáⁿ kā i thó mī-pau, ōe the̍h chio̍h-thâu hō͘ i?
Kā i thó hî, ōe lia̍h chôa hō͘ i?
Lín sui-jiân pháiⁿ, iáu ōe-hiáu the̍h hó-mi̍h hō͘ lín ê kiáⁿ-jî, hô-hòng lín ê Thiⁿ-pē, I it-tēng ōe the̍h hó-mi̍h hō͘ tùi I kî-kiû ê lâng!
“Só͘-í, lín ài lâng án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lín, mā tio̍h án-ni tùi-thāi in. Che chiū-sī Lu̍t-hoat kap sian-ti ê kà-sī.”
“Lín tio̍h tùi hit-ê oe̍h ê mn̂g ji̍p--khì; in-ūi thàng kàu bia̍t-bông hit-ê mn̂g khoah, hit-tiâu lō͘ hó kiâⁿ, ji̍p--khì ê lâng chin chōe.
Thàng kàu oa̍h-miā hit-ê mn̂g oe̍h, hit-tiâu lō͘ sòe, chhē--tio̍h ê lâng chin chió.”
“Tio̍h hông-pī ké sian-ti. In lâi lín chia, gōa-piáu chhin-chhiūⁿ mî-iûⁿ, lāi-bīn khiok sī hiong-ok ê chhâi-lông.
Lín ōe-tàng tùi in ê ké-chí lâi bat in. Kiám ōe-tàng tùi chhì-phè bán phû-tô? Á-sī tùi chi̍t-lê bán bû-hoa-kó?
Án-ni, hó-chhiū kiat hó ké-chí; pháiⁿ-chhiū kiat pháiⁿ ké-chí.
Hó-chhiū bōe kiat pháiⁿ ké-chí; pháiⁿ-chhiū mā bōe kiat hó ké-chí.
Bōe kiat hó ké-chí ê chhiū lóng tio̍h chhò--khí-lâi, hiat-lo̍h hé.
Án-ni, lín ōe-tàng tùi in ê ké-chí lâi bat in.”
“Chheng-ho͘ góa ‘Chú ah, Chú ah’ ê lâng, bōe lóng ji̍p Thian-kok; chí-ū si̍t-hêng góa ê Thiⁿ-pē ê chí-ì ê lâng chiah ōe.

Tī Hit-ji̍t, ū chin chōe lâng ōe tùi góa kóng, ‘Chú ah, Chú ah, goán kiám m̄-sī bat hōng lí ê miâ thoân sìn-sit, bat hōng lí ê miâ kóaⁿ-kúi, bat hōng lí ê miâ kiâⁿ chin chōe sîn-jiah?’
Hit-sî góa ōe bêng-bêng tùi in kóng, ‘Góa lóng m̄ bat lín. Lín chiah-ê chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng, lóng lī-khui góa!’”
“Só͘-í, thiaⁿ góa chiah-ê ōe koh si̍t-hêng ê lâng lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ chhong-bêng ê lâng kā chhù khí tī chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng,
hō͘ phoah, tōa-chúi lâi, hong sàu, chhiong-tio̍h chhù, chhù mā bōe tó, in-ūi khí tī chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng.
“Thiaⁿ góa chiah-ê ōe bô si̍t-hêng ê lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ gōng-lâng kā chhù khí tī soa-téng,
hō͘ phoah, tōa-chúi lâi, hong sàu, chhiong-tio̍h chhù, chhù chiū tó, koh tó kah chin lī-hāi.”
Iâ-so͘ chiah-ê ōe kóng soah, kûn-chiòng tùi I ê kà-sī kám-kak hui-siông hi-kî,
in-ūi I ê kà-sī chin ū koân-ui, kap in ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su bô kâng-khoán.
Iâ-so͘ tùi soaⁿ-téng lo̍h--lâi ê sî, ū kui tōa-tīn ê lâng tè I.
Tú hit-sî, ū chi̍t ê bâ-hong pīⁿ-lâng kiâⁿ óa--lâi, kūi lo̍h-khì I ê bīn-chêng, kóng, “Chú ah, lí nā khéng, ōe-tàng hō͘ góa chheng-khì.”
Iâ-so͘ chhun-chhiú kā i bong, kóng, “Góa khéng, hō͘ lí chheng-khì!” I ê bâ-hong-pīⁿ sûi-sî chheng-khì.
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Tio̍h chù-ì, lóng m̄-thang kā lâng kóng. Put-kò tio̍h khì hō͘ chè-si giām, koh chiàu Mô͘-se ê kui-tēng hiàn lé-mi̍h, thang tùi chèng-lâng chèng-bêng.”
Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì Ka-pek-lông ê sî, ū chi̍t ê Lô-má kun-koaⁿ kiâⁿ óa-lâi kā I khún-kiû,
kóng, “Chú ah, góa ê po̍k-jîn poàn-sin-put-sūi tó tī chhù-lāi, hui-siông kan-khó͘.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Góa lâi-khì kā i i-tī.”
Kun-koaⁿ ìn kóng, “Chú ah, lí lâi goán tau, góa bōe-kham--tit. Lí kan-ta kóng chi̍t kù ōe, góa ê po̍k-jîn chiū ōe hó.

In-ūi góa sī hō͘ lâng koán ê lâng, mā ū peng hō͘ góa koán. Góa kā chit-ê kóng ‘Khì’, i chiū khì; kā pa̍t-ê kóng ‘Lâi’, i chiū lâi; kā góa ê po̍k-jîn kóng ‘Lí chòe chit-ê’, i chiū khì chòe.”

Iâ-so͘ thiaⁿ-liáu kám-kak chin ì-gōa, chiū tùi hiah-ê tè I ê lâng kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, liân tī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiong-kan, góa to iáu m̄-bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-khoán ê sìn-sim.
Góa kā lín kóng, ū chin chōe lâng ōe tùi tang tùi sai lâi kap A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok tī Thian-kok chē-toh.
Put-kò hiah-ê pún-lâi sī Thian-kok ê kiáⁿ-jî--ê, hoán-tńg ōe siū kóaⁿ chhut-khì gōa-bīn o͘-àm ê só͘-chāi, tī hia thî-khàu, kā-gê-chhiat-chhí.”
Jiân-āu Iâ-so͘ tùi hit-ê kun-koaⁿ kóng, “Lí khì, hō͘ lí só͘ sìn--ê si̍t-hiān!” Tú-tú hit-sî, po̍k-jîn ê pīⁿ chiū hó--khì.
Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì Pí-tek in tau, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ê tiūⁿ-ḿ hoat-jia̍t, tó tī bîn-chhn̂g.
Iâ-so͘ bong i ê chhiú, jia̍t thè--khì, i chiū khí-lâi sū-hāu I.

Hông-hun ê sî, ū chi̍t-kóa lâng chhōa chin chōe hō͘ siâ-sîn hū-sin ê lâng lâi Iâ-so͘ hia. I ēng chi̍t kù ōe chiū kā siâ-sîn lóng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, koh i-hó só͘-ū ê pīⁿ-lâng.
Che sī beh èng-giām thong-kè sian-ti Í-sài-a só͘ kóng ê ōe: I sêng-siū lán ê loán-jio̍k, tam-tng lán ê pīⁿ-thiàⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng ûi tī I chiu-ûi, chiū hoan-hù bûn-tô͘ kè-khì ô͘ ê hit-pêng hōaⁿ.
Ū chi̍t ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kiâⁿ óa-lâi kā I kóng, “Lāu-su, lí bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, góa lóng beh tè lí.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Hô͘-lî ū khang, khong-tiong ê chiáu ū siū, put-kò Jîn-chú liân khòa thâu-khak ê só͘-chāi to bô.”
Lēng-gōa chi̍t ê bûn-tô͘ kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Chú ah, thèng-hāu goán sī-tōa-lâng pah-hè-nî-lāu, góa chiū lâi tè lí. ”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lâi tè góa, hō͘ sí-lâng khì bâi-chòng in ka-kī ê sí-lâng!”
Iâ-so͘ chiūⁿ-chûn, I ê bûn-tô͘ tè I khì.
Hut-jiân, ô͘ khí tōa hong-éng, chûn soah hō͘ éng khàm kah beh tîm--lo̍h-khì, m̄-kú Iâ-so͘ teh khùn.
Bûn-tô͘ khì kā I kiò-chhíⁿ, kóng, “Chú ah, kiù--leh-o͘h, lán teh-beh bô-miā lo͘h!”
Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Sió-sìn ê lâng, lín ná chiah bô-táⁿ?” I chiū khí--lâi, chek-pī hong kap éng, ô͘ chiū chēng-chēng-chēng.
Hiah-ê lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ kóng, “Chit-ê sī sím-mi̍h khoán lâng, liân hong kap éng to sūn-ho̍k!”

Iâ-so͘ kè-khì ô͘ ê hit-pêng hōaⁿ, kàu Ka-tāi-lia̍p -lâng ê tōe-khu, ū nn̄g ê hō͘ kúi hū-sin ê lâng tùi bōng-á-po͘ chhut--lâi, tú-tio̍h I. In hiông-kài-kài, só͘-í bô lâng káⁿ tùi hit-tiâu lō͘ keng-kè.
In hut-jiân tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ, lí mài chhap--goán! Sî iáu-bē kàu, lí chiū lâi beh kā goán khó͘-chhó͘ sī--bô?”
Hit-sî, lī in ū hiah--hn̄g-ah ê só͘-chāi, ū chi̍t tōa-kûn ti teh thó-chia̍h.
Kúi kiû Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lí nā beh kā goán kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, tio̍h chhe goán chìn-ji̍p hit-kûn ti.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín khì!” Kúi chiū chhut--khì, chìn-ji̍p ti-kûn; hut-jiân kui-kûn ti lóng tùi soaⁿ-phiâⁿ chông lo̍h-khì ô͘--ni̍h, tū-sí tī chúi-lāi.
Chhī ti ê lâng chiū tô-cháu, cháu ji̍p-khì siâⁿ-lāi, chiong it-chhè só͘ hoat-seng í-ki̍p hō͘ kúi hū-sin ê lâng só͘ tú--tio̍h ê tāi-chì lóng pò lâng chai.
Choân-siâⁿ ê lâng lóng chhut-lâi beh khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘; in chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h I, chiū khún-kiû I lī-khui in ê tōe-khu.
Iâ-so͘ chē-chûn kè ô͘, tńg-khì ka-kī ê siâⁿ.

Ū lâng ēng chhn̂g kng chi̍t ê poàn-sin-put-sūi ê lâng lâi Iâ-so͘ hia. I khòaⁿ-kìⁿ in ê sìn-sim, chiū tùi hit-ê poàn-sin-put-sūi ê lâng kóng, “Siàu-liân-lâng, an-sim, lí ê chōe sià-bián lah!”
Ū kúi-nā ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su sim-lāi siūⁿ, “Chit-ê lâng teh siat-to̍k Siōng-tè!”
Iâ-so͘ chai in ê sim-su chiū mn̄g in, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ lín sim-lāi ū chit-khoán pháiⁿ liām-thâu?
Tùi chit-ê lâng kóng ‘Lí ê chōe sià-bián lah’, á-sī kóng ‘Lí khí-lâi kiâⁿ’, tó chi̍t hāng khah kán-tan?

Put-kò góa beh hō͘ lín chai, Jîn-chú tī tōe-chiūⁿ ū sià-chōe ê koân-pèng.” Jiân-āu I tùi hit-ê poàn-sin-put-sūi ê lâng kóng, “Khí--lâi, giâ lí ê chhn̂g, tńg-khì lín tau!”
Hit-ê lâng chiū khí--lâi, tńg-khì in tau.
Chèng-lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè, in-ūi I ū chiong chit-khoán koân-pèng sù hō͘ lâng.
Iâ-so͘ lī-khui hia ǹg thâu-chêng kiâⁿ ê sî khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê lâng, miâ kiò-chòe Má-thài, chē tī sè-koan. Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lâi tè góa!” I chiū khí-lâi tè I.
Iâ-so͘ tī Má-thài ê chhù chia̍h-pn̄g ê sî, ū chin chōe ba̍uh-sè--ê kap chōe-jîn mā lâi kap Iâ-so͘ í-ki̍p I ê bûn-tô͘ chòe-hé chia̍h.
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiū tùi I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ lín lāu-su kap ba̍uh-sè--ê í-ki̍p chōe-jîn chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g?”
Iâ-so͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū kóng, “Kiān-khong--ê bô su-iàu i-seng, phòa-pīⁿ--ê chiah ū su-iàu.
Lín khì ha̍k-si̍p chit-kù Sèng-keng ê ōe, ‘Góa ài lîn-bín, bô ài chè-mi̍h.’ In-ūi góa lâi, m̄-sī beh chio gī-lâng, sī beh chio chōe-jîn.”
Ū chi̍t piàn, Iok-hān ê bûn-tô͘ lâi kìⁿ Iâ-so͘, tùi I kóng, “Goán kap Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng siông-siông kìm-chia̍h, sī-án-chóaⁿ lí ê bûn-tô͘ bô kìm-chia̍h?”

Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Sin-lông iáu kap hun-iàn ê lâng-kheh chòe-hé ê sî, lâng-kheh kiám ōe ai-siong? Ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, sin-lông ōe hō͘ lâng tùi in tiong-kan lia̍h--khì, hit-sî in chiū ōe kìm-chia̍h.
“Bô lâng ēng bô kiu-chúi ê pò͘ khì pó͘ kū-saⁿ, in-ūi pó͘--ê hit-tè ōe kā saⁿ kiù-li̍h, tian-tò phòa koh-khah tōa-khang.

Mā bô lâng chiong sin-chiú ji̍p tī kū phê-tē. Nā án-ni chòe, phê-tē ōe piak-phòa, chiú lâu--chhut-lâi, phê-tē mā pháiⁿ--khì. Sin-chiú eng-kai ji̍p tī sin phê-tē, án-ni nn̄g hāng chiū lóng pó-choân.”

Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng chiah-ê ōe ê sî, ū chi̍t ê hōe-tn̂g ê chú-koán lâi kūi tī I ê bīn-chêng, kóng, “Góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tú-á sí--khì, chhiáⁿ lí lâi kā i hōaⁿ-chhiú, i chiū ōe oa̍h--khí-lâi.”
Iâ-so͘ chiū khí--lâi, tè i khì; I ê bûn-tô͘ mā khì.
Tú hit-sî, ū chi̍t ê tì-tio̍h hiat-lāu-pīⁿ cha̍p-jī nî kú ê hū-jîn-lâng kiâⁿ óa-khì Iâ-so͘ ê āu-bīn, bong I saⁿ-á-ku ê chhiu.
In-ūi i sim-lāi siūⁿ, “Góa kan-ta bong-tio̍h I ê saⁿ, pīⁿ chiū ōe hó.”
Iâ-so͘ oa̍t kè-lâi khòaⁿ i, kā i kóng, “Cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, an-sim; lí ê sìn-sim hō͘ lí hó--khì lah!” Hū-jîn-lâng sûi-sî tit-tio̍h i-hó.
Iâ-so͘ lâi kàu hōe-tn̂g chú-koán ê chhù, khòaⁿ-tio̍h pûn phín-á--ê kap kui tōa-tīn lâng lōng-lōng-kún,
chiū kā in kóng, “Lín lóng chhut--khì, chit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á m̄-sī sí--khì, sī teh khùn.” In chiū kā I thí-chhiò.
Kóaⁿ kûn-chiòng chhut--khì liáu-āu, Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì cha-bó͘ gín-á ê pâng-keng, khan i ê chhiú, cha-bó͘ gín-á chiū khí--lâi.
Tùi án-ni, chit-ê siau-sit thoân kàu hit tōe-khu ê ta̍k só͘-chāi.
Iâ-so͘ lī-khui hia ê sî, ū nn̄g ê bông-jîn tè I khì; in tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “ Tāi-pi̍t ê Kiáⁿ, lîn-bín goán!”
Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi, bông-jîn chiū kiâⁿ óa--khì. Iâ-so͘ mn̄g in, “Lín sìn góa ōe-tàng kā lín chòe chit-ê tāi-chì sī--bô?” In ìn kóng, “Chú ah, lí ōe.”
Jiân-āu, Iâ-so͘ bong in ê ba̍k-chiu, kóng, “Chiàu lín ê sìn-sim hō͘ lín si̍t-hiān.”
In ê ba̍k-chiu chiū khui, ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. Iâ-so͘ giâm-giâm hoan-hù in kóng, “Chhian-bān m̄-thang hō͘ lâng chai chit-ê tāi-chì.”
M̄-kú in chi̍t-ē chhut--khì, soah chiong Iâ-so͘ ê tāi-chì thoân-piàn hit tōe-khu ê ta̍k só͘-chāi.
In chhut--khì ê sî, ū lâng chhōa chi̍t ê hō͘ kúi hū-sin bōe kóng-ōe ê lâng lâi Iâ-so͘ hia.
Kúi chi̍t-ē hō͘ Iâ-so͘ kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, hit-ê bōe kóng-ōe ê lâng chiū kóng-ōe. Kûn-chiòng lóng tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kóng, “Tī Í-sek-lia̍t goán m̄-bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-khoán tāi-chì.”
Put-kò Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng kóng, “I sī khò kúi-ông teh kóaⁿ-kúi.”
Iâ-so͘ kiâⁿ-thàu chiu-ûi só͘-ū ê siâⁿ-chhī kap chng-siā, tī in ê hōe-tn̂g kà-sī lâng, thoân Thian-kok ê hok-im, i-hó ta̍k-khoán ê chèng-thâu kap pīⁿ-thiàⁿ.
I khòaⁿ-tio̍h hiah tōa-tīn ê lâng, chiū khó-lîn in, in-ūi in chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ bô bo̍k-chiá, khùn-khó͘, bô lâng chiàu-kò͘.
Iâ-so͘ chiū tùi I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Thang siu-sêng--ê chin chōe, choh-kang ê lâng chin chió.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h kî-kiû koán siu-sêng ê Chú phài kang-lâng khì siu-sêng.”
Iâ-so͘ tiàu-chi̍p I cha̍p-jī ê bûn-tô͘ lâi, hō͘ in ū koân-pèng thang kóaⁿ siâ-sîn, i-tī ta̍k-khoán ê chèng-thâu kap pīⁿ-thiàⁿ.
Chit cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ ê miâ chiū-sī chiah-ê: Tē-it sī Se-bûn, mā kiò-chòe Pí-tek, kap i ê sió-tī An-tek-lia̍t; Se-pì-thài ê kiáⁿ Ngá-kok kap i ê sió-tī Iok-hān;
Hui-le̍k kap Pa-to-lô-mái; To-má kap ba̍uh-sè ê Má-thài; Ta̍t-thài kap A-le̍k-hui ê kiáⁿ Ngá-kok;
Kek-chìn-tóng ê Se-bûn kap chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘ hit-ê Í-su-ka-lio̍k ê Iû-tāi.
Iâ-so͘ chhe chit cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ chhut--khì, hoan-hù in kóng, “Lín m̄-thang khì Gōa-pang-lâng ê tōe-khu; m̄-thang chìn-ji̍p Sat-má-lī-a -lâng ê siâⁿ,
chí-ū tio̍h khì chhē Í-sek-lia̍t -ke sit-bê ê iûⁿ.
Lín khì ê sî tio̍h soan-iông kóng, ‘Thian-kok teh-beh si̍t-hiān lah!’
Lín tio̍h i-hó phòa-pīⁿ ê lâng, hō͘ sí-lâng koh-oa̍h, hō͘ bâ-hong pīⁿ-lâng chheng-khì, koh kóaⁿ-chhut siâ-sîn. Lín pe̍h-pe̍h tit--tio̍h, mā tio̍h pe̍h-pe̍h hō͘ lâng.
Io-tòa lāi-bīn m̄-bián tòa kim-pè, gûn-pè, á-sī tâng-pè;
chhut-mn̂g m̄-bián tòa lú-hêng-tē á-sī nn̄g niá lāi-saⁿ, mā m̄-bián tòa liâng-ôe á-sī gia̍h koáiⁿ-á; in-ūi kang-lâng tit-tio̍h chia̍h-mi̍h sī eng-kai.
“Lín bô-lūn ji̍p-khì tó chi̍t ê siâⁿ tó chi̍t ê chng-siā, tio̍h thàm-thiaⁿ khòaⁿ sím-mi̍h-lâng goān-ì chiap-thāi lín, chiah khì tòa hia, tòa kàu lī-khui.
Lín ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi ê sî, tio̍h kā in chhéng-an.
Chit-ke ê lâng nā goān-ì chiap-thāi lín, tio̍h chiong lín ê pêng-an hō͘ in; nā bô goān-ì chiap-thāi lín, tio̍h chiong pêng-an siu-hôe.
M̄ chiap-thāi lín, m̄ thiaⁿ lín ê ōe ê lâng, lín lī-khui hit-keng chhù á-sī hit-ê siâⁿ ê sî, tio̍h chiong lín kha--ni̍h ê thô͘-hún pōaⁿ hō͘ i chheng-khì.
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê Ji̍t, Só͘-to-má kap Gô-mô͘-la tōe-khu só͘ siū ê hêng-hoa̍t ōe pí hit-ê siâⁿ só͘ siū--ê koh-khah hó jím-siū.”

“Tio̍h chai, góa chhe lín chhut--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ sàng iûⁿ ji̍p-khì chhâi-lông ê tiong-kan. Só͘-í, tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ chôa hiah-ni̍h lêng-khiáu, chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu hiah-ni̍h sûn-liông.
Lín tio̍h tî-hông, in-ūi ū lâng ōe kā lín lia̍h-khì kau hō͘ gī-hōe, tī in ê hōe-tn̂g ēng piⁿ kā lín phah.
Koh ūi-tio̍h góa ê iân-kò͘, lín ōe hō͘ lâng thoa kàu chóng-tok kap kun-ông ê bīn-chêng, lâi tùi in kap Gōa-pang-lâng chòe kiàn-chèng.
M̄-kú, lín hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì sím-mn̄g ê sî, m̄-bián hoân-ló beh án-chóaⁿ kóng, á-sī beh kóng sím-mi̍h; hit-sî lín só͘ tio̍h kóng--ê, ōe kā lín chí-sī,
in-ūi teh kóng--ê m̄-sī lín ka-kī, sī lín Thiⁿ-pē ê Sîn thong-kè lín teh kóng.
“Hiaⁿ-tī ōe chhut-bōe hiaⁿ-tī, hō͘ i sí; lāu-pē mā ōe án-ni tùi-thāi kiáⁿ-jî. Kiáⁿ-jî ōe khí-lâi kong-kek pē-bú, kā in hāi-sí.
Lín ōe in-ūi góa ê miâ hō͘ chèng-lâng oàn-hūn, m̄-kú jím-nāi kàu chòe-āu--ê ōe tit-tio̍h kiù.
In tī chit-ê siâⁿ pek-hāi lín, tio̍h tô-cháu khì pa̍t-ê siâⁿ. Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, Í-sek-lia̍t ê siâⁿ-chhī lín kiâⁿ iáu-bē thàu, Jîn-chú chiū lâi!
“Ha̍k-seng bōe chhiau-kè lāu-su; po̍k-jîn mā bōe chhiau-kè chú-lâng.

Ha̍k-seng tú--tio̍h ê pek-hāi kap lāu-su kâng-khoán, po̍k-jîn tú--tio̍h-ê kap chú-lâng kâng-khoán, án-ni chiū ū-kàu. Lâng to kā chit-ke ê chú-lâng kiò-chòe Pia̍t-se-pok, hô-hòng i ke-lāi ê lâng.”
“Só͘-í, m̄-bián kiaⁿ in; in-ūi bô chi̍t hāng am-khàm--ê bōe lō͘-hiān; mā bô chi̍t hāng pì-bi̍t--ê bōe hō͘ lâng chai.
Góa tī àm-tiong kā lín kóng--ê, lín tio̍h tī kng-bêng tiong kóng--chhut-lâi; lín tī hī-khang piⁿ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, tio̍h tī chhù-bé-téng soan-pò͘.
Ōe hāi-sí seng-khu khiok bōe hāi-sí lêng-hûn--ê, lín m̄-bián kiaⁿ; tian-tò tio̍h kiaⁿ ōe chiong lêng-hûn kap seng-khu hiat-lo̍h tōe-ge̍k húi-bia̍t ê Siōng-tè.
Nn̄g chiah chhek-chiáu-á kiám m̄-sī bōe chi̍t kak gûn nā-tiāⁿ? Lín ê Thiⁿ-pē nā bô ún-chún, liân chi̍t chiah to bōe poa̍h-lo̍h tōe.
Lín leh, liân lín ê thâu-mn̂g to lóng ū sǹg--kè.
Só͘-í, m̄-bián kiaⁿ, lín pí kui-kûn chhek-chiáu-á koh-khah kùi-tiōng!”
“Só͘-í, tī lâng ê bīn-chêng soan-jīn góa--ê, góa tī góa Thiⁿ-pē ê bīn-chêng mā ōe jīn i.
Tī lâng ê bīn-chêng m̄ jīn góa--ê, góa tī góa Thiⁿ-pē ê bīn-chêng mā m̄ jīn i.”
“M̄-thang siūⁿ-kóng góa lâi sī beh tòa hô-pêng hō͘ tōe-chiūⁿ; góa tòa--lâi-ê m̄-sī hô-pêng, sī to-kiàm.
In-ūi góa lâi sī beh hō͘ lâng hun-lia̍t: Lâng tùi-khòng lāu-pē, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tùi-khòng lāu-bú, sin-pū tùi-khòng ta-ke.
Lâng ê tùi-te̍k sī ka-kī ke-lāi ê lâng.
“Thiàⁿ pē-bú iâⁿ-kè thiàⁿ góa--ê, bô chu-keh tè góa; thiàⁿ kiáⁿ á-sī cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ iâⁿ-kè thiàⁿ góa--ê, bô chu-keh tè góa.
M̄ giâ ka-kī ê si̍p-jī-kè lâi tè góa--ê, mā bô chu-keh tè góa.
Beh tit-tio̍h ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā--ê, ōe sòng-sit sìⁿ-miā; ūi-tio̍h góa sòng-sit ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā--ê, ōe tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā.”
“Chiap-la̍p lín--ê chiū-sī chiap-la̍p góa; chiap-la̍p góa--ê chiū-sī chiap-la̍p chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi.
Chiap-la̍p sian-ti chòe sian-ti--ê, ōe tit-tio̍h sian-ti èng-tit ê pò-siúⁿ; chiap-la̍p gī-lâng chòe gī-lâng--ê, ōe tit-tio̍h gī-lâng èng-tit ê pò-siúⁿ.

Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng, kan-ta the̍h chi̍t poe léng-chúi hō͘ chiah-ê siōng bî-sòe ê chi̍t ê lim, in-ūi siōng bî-sòe--ê sī góa ê bûn-tô͘, chit-ê lâng it-tēng ōe tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ.”
Iâ-so͘ kà-sī cha̍p-jī ê bûn-tô͘ í-āu lī-khui hit só͘-chāi, khì hù-kūn ê siâⁿ-chhī kà-sī lâng kap thoân hok-im.
Iok-hān tī kaⁿ--ni̍h thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ki-tok só͘ chòe ê sū, chiū chhe i ê bûn-tô͘ khì
mn̄g I, “Lí chiū-sī teh-beh lâi Hit-ūi, á-sī goán tio̍h thèng-hāu pa̍t-lâng?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lín chiong só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h, só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê khì kā Iok-hān kóng,

chiū-sī sit-bêng ê lâng koh khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, kha-pái ê lâng kiâⁿ-lō͘, bâ-hong pīⁿ-lâng chheng-khì, hī-khang bōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, sí-lâng koh-oa̍h, sàn-chhiah-lâng ū hó-siau-sit thoân hō͘ in.
Tùi góa bô sit-khì sìn-sim ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!”

Iok-hān ê bûn-tô͘ lī-khui liáu-āu, Iâ-so͘ chiah tùi kûn-chiòng kóng-khí Iok-hān ê sū. I kóng, “Lín chhut-khì khòng-iá sī beh khòaⁿ sím-mi̍h? Beh khòaⁿ hō͘ hong chhe iô-lâi-iô-khì ê lô͘-úi sī--bô?
Nā m̄-sī, lín chhut--khì beh khòaⁿ sím-mi̍h? Beh khòaⁿ chhēng ko-kùi i-ho̍k ê lâng sī--bô? Lín khòaⁿ, chhēng ko-kùi i-ho̍k ê lâng sī tī ông-kiong.
Án-ni, lín chhut--khì beh khòaⁿ sím-mi̍h? Beh khòaⁿ sian-ti sī--bô? Sī, m̄-kú góa kā lín kóng, i pí sian-ti koh-khah úi-tāi.
Koan-hē Iok-hān, Sèng-keng ū án-ni kì-chài: Khòaⁿ ah, góa chhe góa ê sù-chiá chòe lí ê sian-hong; i beh tī lí ê thâu-chêng kā lí khui-lō͘.
“Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, hū-jîn-lâng só͘ siⁿ--ê bô chi̍t ê pí Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān khah úi-tāi; m̄-kú, tī Thian-kok siōng bî-sòe--ê iáu pí i koh-khah úi-tāi.
Tùi Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān ê ji̍t kàu hiān-chāi, Thian-kok it-ti̍t siū kiông-lia̍t ê kong-kek, hiong-béng ê lâng ēng pō-le̍k kā i chhiúⁿ--khì.
Sian-ti kap Lu̍t-hoat só͘-ū ê ū-giân kàu Iok-hān ûi-chí.
Lín nā goān-ì chiap-siū chiah-ê ū-giân, chiū ōe bêng-pe̍k Iok-hān chiū-sī hit-ê teh-beh lâi ê Í-lī-a.
Ū hī-khang--ê, tio̍h thiaⁿ!
“Góa beh ēng sím-mi̍h pí-phēng chit sè-tāi? In chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t tīn gín-á chē tī chhī-tiûⁿ-kháu tùi lēng-gōa chi̍t tīn hoah:
Goán tùi lín pûn phín-á, lín bô thiàu-bú! Goán chhiùⁿ ai-ko, lín mā bô pi-siong!
Iok-hān lâi, bô chia̍h bô lim, lâng chiū kóng, ‘I hō͘ kúi hū-sin!’

Jîn-chú lâi, mā chia̍h mā lim, lâng chiū kóng, ‘I sī tham-chia̍h hò͘ⁿ-chiú ê lâng, sī ba̍uh-sè--ê kap chōe-jîn ê pêng-iú!’ Put-kò, si̍t-chāi ê tì-hūi tùi hêng-ûi tit-tio̍h chèng-si̍t.”
Iâ-so͘ ū tī chi̍t-kóa siâⁿ-chhī kiâⁿ chin chōe sîn-jiah, m̄-kú hiah-ê siâⁿ-chhī ê lâng lóng bô hóe-kái, I chiū kā in chek-pī.

I kóng, “ Ko-lia̍p-sìn, lí chhám ah! Pek-sài-tāi, lí chhám ah! Góa tī lín tiong-kan kiâⁿ ê sîn-jiah nā tī Thài-ní kap Se-tùn kiâⁿ, in chá chiū chhēng môa-saⁿ sám hé-hu hóe-kái lah.
Góa kā lín kóng, tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê Ji̍t, Thài-ní kap Se-tùn siū ê hêng-hoa̍t ōe pí lín tio̍h siū--ê khah hó jím-siū.

Lí leh, Ka-pek-lông, Lí ài lâng kā lí hû-chiūⁿ thiⁿ sī--bô? Bōe, Siōng-tè ōe kā lí hiat-lo̍h Im-hú. Tī lí hia kiâⁿ ê sîn-jiah nā tī Só͘-to-má kiâⁿ, Só͘-to-má it-tēng iáu lâu kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Chóng-sī góa kā lín kóng, tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê Ji̍t, Só͘-to-má tōe-khu siū ê hêng-hoa̍t pí lí tio̍h siū--ê khah hó jím-siū.”

Hit-sî, Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Pē ah, thiⁿ-tōe ê Chú, góa kám-siā lí, in-ūi lí ū chiong chiah-ê sū tùi ū tì-hūi ū ha̍k-būn ê lâng khàm--khí-lâi, m̄-kú tùi sòe-hàn gín-á khé-sī.
Pē ah, sī lah, in-ūi che sī lí ê hó chí-ì.
“Góa ê Pē í-keng ū chiong it-chhè lóng kau-thok góa. Pē í-gōa bô lâng bat Kiáⁿ; Kiáⁿ kap Kiáⁿ ài-beh khé-sī ê lâng í-gōa mā bô lâng bat Pē.
“Lô-khó͘ pē tāng-tàⁿ ê lâng lóng tio̍h lâi góa chia, góa beh hō͘ lín an-hioh.
Tio̍h pē góa ê taⁿ, lâi tùi góa o̍h, in-ūi góa ê sim un-jiû khiam-sùn. Án-ni, lín ê sim-sîn chiū ōe tit-tio̍h an-hioh.
Góa ê taⁿ ha̍h-ēng, góa ê tàⁿ chin khin.”
Kè bô jōa kú, tī An-hioh-ji̍t Iâ-so͘ tùi be̍h-hn̂g keng-kè. I ê bûn-tô͘ pak-tó͘ iau, chiū tiah be̍h-sūi lâi chia̍h.
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng khòaⁿ--tio̍h, tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, lí ê bûn-tô͘ tī An-hioh-ji̍t chòe bōe-ēng-tit chòe ê tāi-chì.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín kiám m̄-bat tha̍k-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t kap tè i ê lâng pak-tó͘ iau ê sî só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì?
I ji̍p-khì Siōng-tè ê tiān chia̍h hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ, chit-khoán piáⁿ chí-ū chè-si chiah thang chia̍h, i kap tè i ê lâng lóng bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h.
Lēng-gōa, lín kiám bô tha̍k-tio̍h Lu̍t-hoat ê kì-chài, chiū-sī An-hioh-ji̍t chè-si tī Sèng-tiān hoān-tio̍h An-hioh-ji̍t ê kui-kú mā sǹg bô chōe.
Góa kā lín kóng, tī chia ū chi̍t ê pí Sèng-tiān khah tiōng-iàu--ê.
Sèng-keng ū kóng, ‘Góa ài lîn-bín, bô ài chè-mi̍h.’ Lín nā liáu-kái chit-kù ōe ê ì-sù, chiū bōe kā bô chōe ê lâng tēng-chōe.
In-ūi Jîn-chú sī An-hioh-ji̍t ê Chú.”
Iâ-so͘ lī-khui hit só͘-chāi, ji̍p-khì in ê hōe-tn̂g.
Tú-hó ū chi̍t ê chi̍t ki chhiú khê--khì ê lâng tī hia. Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng siūⁿ-beh khòng-kò Iâ-so͘, chiū mn̄g I kóng, “Tī An-hioh-ji̍t i-pīⁿ ū ha̍h Lu̍t-hoat bô?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lín tiong-kan ū lâng ū chi̍t chiah iûⁿ, tú-hó tī An-hioh-ji̍t poa̍h-lo̍h khut-á, i kiám bōe kā i khiú--khí-lâi?
Lâng pí iûⁿ ke jōa-á-ni̍h kùi-tiōng! Só͘-í, tī An-hioh-ji̍t chòe hó-sū ū ha̍h Lu̍t-hoat.”
Iâ-so͘ chiū kā hit-ê lâng kóng, “Chhiú chhun--chhut-lâi!” Chit-ê lâng chhiú chhun--chhut-lâi, chiū ho̍k-goân, oân-choân hó--khì, kap lēng-gōa hit-ki chhiú kâng-khoán.
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chhut--khì, chiū kè-bô͘ beh tùi-hù Iâ-so͘, khòaⁿ beh án-chóaⁿ kā I hāi-sí.
Iâ-so͘ chai-iáⁿ in ê kè-bô͘ chiū lī-khui hia; ū chin chōe lâng tè I khì, I chiū i-hó in tiong-kan só͘-ū ê pīⁿ-lâng.
I bēng-lēng in m̄-thang tùi lâng thoân-iông I ê tāi-chì.
Che sī beh èng-giām thong-kè sian-ti Í-sài-a só͘ kóng ê ōe:
Lín khòaⁿ, góa só͘ kéng-soán ê po̍k-jîn, góa só͘ thiàⁿ, só͘ ì-ài--ê. Góa beh sù góa ê Sîn hō͘ I; I beh tùi bān-bîn soan-kò góa ê kong-gī.
I bōe cheng-piān, bōe soan-jióng; tī koe-lō͘ bô lâng ōe thiaⁿ-tio̍h I ê siaⁿ.
Siū-siong ê lô͘-úi, I bōe at-tn̄g; beh hoa ê teng-hé, I bōe pûn-sit, ti̍t-kàu I hō͘ kong-gī tek-sèng.
Bān-bîn lóng ōe chiong ǹg-bāng kau-thok I.

Hit-sî, ū lâng chhōa chi̍t ê hō͘ kúi hū-sin, sit-bêng koh bōe kóng-ōe ê lâng lâi Iâ-so͘ hia; Iâ-so͘ kā i i-hó, hit-ê bōe kóng-ōe ê lâng chiū ōe kóng-ōe, koh ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Kûn-chiòng lóng chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kóng, “Chit-ê lâng káⁿ sī Tāi-pi̍t ê Kiáⁿ ho͘hⁿ?”
