Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū kóng, “Chit-ê lâng sī khò kúi-ông Pia̍t-se-pok teh kóaⁿ-kúi.”
Iâ-so͘ chai-iáⁿ in ê sim-su chiū kā in kóng, “Kok-ka ka-kī hun-cheng, ōe hong-hòe; siâⁿ-chhī á-sī ka-têng ka-kī hun-cheng, khiā bōe tiâu.
Sat-tàn nā kóaⁿ Sat-tàn, sī ka-kī hun-cheng, i ê kok beh ná khiā ōe tiâu?
Góa nā khò Pia̍t-se-pok kóaⁿ-kúi, lín ê chú-tē sī khò sím-mi̍h-lâng kóaⁿ-kúi? Án-ni, lín ka-kī ê chú-tē ōe kā lín phòaⁿ-chōe.
Put-kò góa nā-sī khò Siōng-tè ê Sîn kóaⁿ-kúi, Siōng-tè ê chú-koân chiū í-keng tī lín tiong-kan si̍t-hiān lah.
“Lâng án-chóaⁿ chiah ōe-tàng ji̍p-khì ióng-sū ê chhù chhiúⁿ i ê châi-bu̍t, kiám m̄-sī tio̍h seng kā i pa̍k--khí-lâi?
“Bô ūi góa--ê chiū-sī hoán-tùi góa; bô kap góa chòe-hé siu-chi̍p--ê chiū-sī teh phah-sòaⁿ.
Só͘-í, góa kā lín kóng, lâng it-chhè ê chōe kap húi-pòng lóng ōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián, m̄-kú siat-to̍k Sèng Sîn bōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián.

Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng kóng-ōe kong-kek Jîn-chú, ōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián, m̄-kú bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng kóng-ōe kong-kek Sèng Sîn, tī hiān-chāi kap chiong-lâi lóng bōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián.”
“Hó-chhiū kiat hó ké-chí; pháiⁿ-chhiū kiat pháiⁿ ké-chí; tùi só͘ kiat ê ké-chí thang chai chhiū ê hó-pháiⁿ.
Lín chiah-ê to̍k-chôa, lín pún-lâi sī pháiⁿ--ê, beh ná ōe kóng hó-ōe? In-ūi lâng sim-lāi chhiong-móa sím-mi̍h, chhùi chiū kóng sím-mi̍h.
Hó-lâng tùi só͘ chek-chū ê hó hoat-chhut hó; pháiⁿ-lâng tùi só͘ chek-chū ê pháiⁿ hoat-chhut pháiⁿ.
“Góa kā lín kóng, lâng só͘ kóng it-chhè ê êng-á-ōe, tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê Ji̍t ta̍k-kù lóng tio̍h hū-chek.
In-ūi Siōng-tè beh ēng lí ê ōe lâi phòaⁿ lí bô-chōe, mā beh ēng lí ê ōe lâi tēng lí ū-chōe.”
Hit-sî, ū kúi-nā ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, goán ài lí kiâⁿ chi̍t ê sîn-jiah hō͘ goán khòaⁿ.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Siâ-ok kan-îm ê sè-tāi iau-kiû sîn-jiah, m̄-kú sian-ti Iok-ná ê sîn-jiah í-gōa, bōe koh ū sîn-jiah hō͘ in.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ Iok-ná saⁿ mî saⁿ ji̍t tī tōa-hî ê pak-tó͘ lāi, Jîn-chú mā ōe saⁿ mî saⁿ ji̍t tī tōe chhim ê só͘-chāi.

Tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, Nî-nî-bî -lâng ōe kap chit sè-tāi ê lâng chòe-hé khí--lâi, kā chit sè-tāi ê lâng tēng-chōe, in-ūi Nî-nî-bî -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-ná ê thoân-tō liáu-āu lóng ū hóe-kái. Lín khòaⁿ, ū pí Iok-ná koh-khah úi-tāi--ê tī chia!

Tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, Lâm-hng ê lú-ông ōe kap chit sè-tāi ê lâng chòe-hé khí--lâi, kā chit sè-tāi ê lâng tēng-chōe, in-ūi i ū tùi tōe ê ke̍k-thâu lâi thiaⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn tì-hūi ê ōe. Lín khòaⁿ, ū pí Só͘-lô-bûn koh-khah úi-tāi--ê tī chia!”
“Siâ-sîn lī-khui só͘ hū-sin ê lâng liáu-āu, tī bô-chúi ê tōe-khu kiâⁿ-thàu-thàu, beh chhē chi̍t ê hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi, chhē lóng bô,
chiū kóng, ‘Góa beh tńg-lâi-khì góa chhut--lâi hit-keng chhù.’ I tńg--khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chhù khang-khang, sàu kah chin chheng-khì, koh chéng-lí hó-sè.

Āu-lâi, i khì chhōa chhit ê pí i khah pháiⁿ ê siâ-sîn kap i chòe-hé lâi, ji̍p-khì hia tòa. Án-ni, hit-ê lâng ê kiat-kio̍k pí khí-thâu koh-khah chhám. Chit-ê siâ-ok ê sè-tāi mā ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni.”
Iâ-so͘ iáu-teh tùi chèng-lâng kóng-ōe ê sî, I ê lāu-bú kap hiaⁿ-tī lâi khiā tī gōa-bīn, ài-beh kap I kóng-ōe.
Ū lâng kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, lí ê lāu-bú kap hiaⁿ-tī khiā tī gōa-bīn, ài-beh kap lí kóng-ōe.”
Iâ-so͘ kā hit-ê lâng kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng sī góa ê lāu-bú? Sím-mi̍h-lâng sī góa ê hiaⁿ-tī?”
Jiân-āu I chhun-chhiú kí I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, góa ê lāu-bú, góa ê hiaⁿ-tī!
Si̍t-hêng góa Thiⁿ-pē chí-ì ê lâng chiū-sī góa ê hiaⁿ-tī, chí-bē, kap lāu-bú.”
Siâng hit-ji̍t, Iâ-so͘ tùi chhù--ni̍h chhut--khì, tī ô͘-piⁿ chē.
Ū chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng chū-chi̍p óa-lâi I hia, I soah tio̍h khì chē tī chûn-téng, kui tōa-tīn lâng lóng khiā tī hōaⁿ-téng.
I chiū ēng phì-jū tùi in kóng chin chōe hāng sū. I kóng: “Ū chi̍t ê iā chéng-chí ê lâng chhut-khì iā chéng-chí.
I iā ê sî, ū-ê chéng-chí lak tī lō͘-piⁿ, chiáu-á pe--lâi, kā in chia̍h-liáu-liáu.
Ū-ê lak tī chio̍h-thâu tōe, thô͘ chió ê só͘-chāi, in-ūi thô͘ bô chhim, chin kín chiū puh-gê;
put-kò ji̍t-thâu chi̍t-ē chhut, kā in pha̍k--tio̍h, in-ūi bô kun chiū ta--khì.
Ū-ê lak tī chhì-phè lāi, chhì-á tōa-châng--khí-lâi chiū kā in hip--sí.
Put-kò ū-ê lak tī hó thó͘-tōe, chiū kiat-si̍t; ū-ê chi̍t-pah pē, ū-ê la̍k-cha̍p pē, ū-ê saⁿ-cha̍p pē.
Ū hī-khang--ê, tio̍h thiaⁿ!”
Bûn-tô͘ lâi mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ lí tùi kûn-chiòng lóng ēng phì-jū kā in kóng?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Thian-kok ê ò-pì í-keng ū hō͘ lín chai, m̄-kú bô hō͘ in chai.
In-ūi ū--ê, beh hō͘ i koh-khah chōe, chōe kàu ū-chhun; bô--ê, liân i só͘-ū--ê mā beh kā i chhiúⁿ--khí-lâi.
Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê iân-kò͘, góa ēng phì-jū tùi in kóng, in-ūi: In khòaⁿ mā khòaⁿ bô, thiaⁿ mā thiaⁿ bô, koh bōe liáu-kái.
Í-sài-a ê ū-giân tú tī in sin-chiūⁿ èng-giām: Lín thiaⁿ koh thiaⁿ mā bōe liáu-kái; lín khòaⁿ koh khòaⁿ mā bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.

In-ūi chit-ê chú-bîn ê sim í-keng tūn, hī-khang tāng, ba̍k-chiu khoeh. Nā m̄-sī án-ni, in ê ba̍k-chiu ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, hī-khang ōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, sim ōe bêng-pe̍k, ōe hôe-sim-tńg-ì, góa chiū kā in i-hó.
“M̄-kú lín chin ū hok-khì, in-ūi lín ba̍k-chiu ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, hī-khang ū thiaⁿ--kìⁿ.

Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, í-chêng ū chin chōe sian-ti kap gī-lâng ài-beh khòaⁿ lín só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê ia̍h bô khòaⁿ--tio̍h, beh thiaⁿ lín só͘ thiaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê ia̍h bô thiaⁿ--tio̍h.”
“Só͘-í, lín tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ chit-ê iā chéng-chí ê phì-jū.
Só͘-ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Thian-kok ê sìn-sit bô bêng-pe̍k--ê, sī chhin-chhiūⁿ iā tī lō͘-piⁿ ê chéng-chí, hit-ê Siâ-ok-chiá lâi, kā iā tī i sim-lāi ê chéng-chí chhiúⁿ--khì.
Iā tī chio̍h-thâu tōe--ê, sī chí lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h sìn-sit, sûi-sî hoaⁿ-hí chiap-siū,
m̄-kú tī i ê sim-lāi tèng-kun bô chhim, tòng bōe kú, chi̍t-ē ūi-tio̍h sìn-sit tú-tio̍h hoān-lān á-sī pek-hāi, sûi-sî chiū pàng-sak.
Iā tī chhì-phè lāi--ê, sī chí lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h sìn-sit liáu-āu, seng-oa̍h ê khòa-lū kap chîⁿ-châi ê bê-he̍k kā só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê sìn-sit hip--sí, soah bōe kiat-si̍t.
Iā tī hó thó͘-tōe--ê, sī chí lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h sìn-sit, ū liáu-kái, chin-chiàⁿ ū kiat-si̍t; ū-ê chi̍t-pah pē, ū-ê la̍k-cha̍p pē, ū-ê saⁿ-cha̍p pē.”
Iâ-so͘ koh tùi in kóng chi̍t ê phì-jū: “Thian-kok thang phì-jū chòe ū chi̍t ê lâng iā hó chéng-chí tī ka-kī ê hn̂g--ni̍h.
Lâng teh khùn ê sî, tùi-te̍k lâi, chiong phōe-á iā tī be̍h-á ê tiong-kan, chiū lī-khui.
Be̍h-á hoat--khí-lâi, chhut-sūi ê sî, phōe-á mā hoat--chhut-lâi.
Po̍k-jîn lâi kìⁿ chú-lâng kóng, ‘Thâu-ke, lí kiám m̄-sī iā hó ê chéng-chí tī hn̂g--ni̍h? Ná ōe ū chiah-ê phōe-á?’
Chú-lâng ìn kóng, ‘Che sī tùi-te̍k chòe--ê.’ Po̍k-jîn kóng, ‘Án-ni, goán lâi-khì kā hiah-ê phōe-á khau--khí-lâi hó--bô?’
Chú-lâng ìn kóng, ‘M̄ thang, lín khau phōe-á ê sî, m̄-tú-hó liân be̍h-á soah khau-khau--khí-lâi.

Hō͘ phōe-á kap be̍h-á tâng-chôe tōa-châng, siu-sêng ê sî góa chiah hoan-hù siu-koah ê lâng seng kā phōe-á khau--khí-lâi, khún kui-pé khì sio, jiân-āu kā be̍h-á siu ji̍p-khì góa ê chhng-khò͘.’”
Iâ-so͘ koh kā in kóng chi̍t ê phì-jū: “Thian-kok chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t lia̍p kòa-chhài-chí, lâng kā i the̍h-khì iā tī ka-kī ê hn̂g--ni̍h.

Kòa-chhài-chí sī só͘-ū chéng-chí tiong siōng sòe-lia̍p--ê, tōa-châng--khí-lâi, pí só͘-ū ê chhài-soe koh-khah tōa-châng, chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t châng chhiū, liân khong-tiong ê chiáu-á to lâi tī chhiū-ki chòe siū.”

Iâ-so͘ koh kā in kóng chi̍t ê phì-jū: “Thian-kok chhin-chhiūⁿ kàⁿ-bú, ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng the̍h-khì lām tī saⁿ táu mī-hún chòe-hé chhiau, chòe-āu kui-ê lóng hoat--khí-lâi.”
Chiah-ê it-chhè ê kà-sī Iâ-so͘ lóng ēng phì-jū tùi chèng-lâng kóng; I bô ēng pa̍t-khoán ê hong-sek, chí-ū ēng phì-jū tùi in kóng.
I án-ni chòe sī beh èng-giām Chú thong-kè sian-ti só͘ kóng ê ōe: Góa beh khui-chhùi kóng phì-jū, kóng chhòng-sè í-lâi ún-ba̍t ê sū.
Iâ-so͘ lī-khui chèng-lâng, ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi. I ê bûn-tô͘ lâi kā I kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kā goán kóe-seh hn̂g--ni̍h ê phōe-á ê phì-jū.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Hit-ê iā hó chéng-chí--ê sī Jîn-chú;
hn̂g sī sè-kài; hó chéng-chí sī Thian-kok ê kiáⁿ-jî; phōe-á sī hit-ê Siâ-ok-chiá ê kiáⁿ-jî;
iā phōe-á hit-ê te̍k-jîn sī Mô͘-kúi; siu-koah sī chí kim-sè ê chiong-kio̍k; siu-koah--ê sī thiⁿ-sài.
Tī kim-sè ê chiong-kio̍k, pháiⁿ-lâng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ phōe-á hō͘ lâng khioh kui-pé ēng hé kā in sio.
Jîn-chú ōe chhe I ê thiⁿ-sài lâi, tùi I ê kok-lāi chiong it-chhè hō͘ lâng poa̍h-tó hoān-chōe kap put-hoat ê lâng lóng lia̍h--lâi,
kā in hiat-lo̍h hé-lô͘, tī hia in ōe thî-khàu, kā-gê-chhiat-chhí.
Hit-sî, gī-lâng tī in ê Pē ê Kok-tō͘ ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t-thâu hoat-kng. Ū hī-khang--ê, tio̍h thiaⁿ!”
“Thian-kok chhin-chhiūⁿ pó-pòe chhàng tī hn̂g--ni̍h, ū lâng chhē--tio̍h, kā i khàm--khí-lâi, chin hoaⁿ-hí khì bōe it-chhè só͘ ū--ê lâi bóe hit-khu hn̂g.
“Thian-kok mā chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t ê seng-lí-lâng teh chhē súi ê chin-chu.
I chi̍t-ē chhē-tio̍h chi̍t lia̍p chin ta̍t-chîⁿ ê chin-chu, chiū khì bōe it-chhè só͘ ū--ê lâi bóe hit-lia̍p chin-chu.”
“Thian-kok mā chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng tī ô͘--ni̍h pha-bāng, lia̍h ta̍k-khoán hî;
bāng móa chiū thoa-chiūⁿ hōaⁿ, chē--lo̍h-lâi, kéng hó--ê khǹg lo̍h-khì tháng-á lāi, bái--ê hiat-ka̍k.
Kim-sè ê chiong-kio̍k mā chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni; thiⁿ-sài beh chhut--khì, tùi gī-lâng ê tiong-kan kā pháiⁿ-lâng hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi,
hiat-lo̍h hé-lô͘; tī hia in ōe thî-khàu, kā-gê-chhiat-chhí.”
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Chiah-ê lín lóng ū bêng-pe̍k bô?” In ìn kóng, “Ū.”
I chiū kā in kóng, “Só͘-í, ta̍k-ê ha̍k-si̍p Thian-kok tō-lí ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su, chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t ke ê chú-lâng tùi chhng-khò͘ kā sin kap kū ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ lóng poaⁿ--chhut-lâi.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê phì-jū liáu-āu lī-khui hia,
tò-khì ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong. I tī in ê hōe-tn̂g kà-sī lâng, in lóng chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kóng, “Chit-ê lâng tùi tó-ūi tit-tio̍h chit-khoán ê tì-hūi kap kiâⁿ sîn-jiah ê khùi-la̍t?
I kiám m̄-sī hit-ê ba̍k-chhiūⁿ ê kiáⁿ? I ê lāu-bú kiám m̄-sī kiò-chòe Má-lī-a? I ê hiaⁿ-tī kiám m̄-sī Ngá-kok, Iok-sek, Se-bûn, kap Iû-tāi?
I ê sió-bē kiám m̄-sī lóng kap lán tī chia? Án-ni, chit-ê lâng tùi tó-ūi tit-tio̍h chit-khoán ê tì-hūi kap khùi-la̍t?”
In soah tùi Iâ-so͘ khí hoán-kám. Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Sian-ti tī ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong ka-kī ê ka-cho̍k í-gōa, it-tēng ōe siū chun-tiōng.”
In-ūi in m̄ sìn, Iâ-so͘ tī hia bô kiâⁿ chin chōe sîn-jiah.
Hit-sî, Ka-lī-lī hun-hong ê ông Hi-lu̍t thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê miâ-siaⁿ,
chiū tùi i ê pō͘-hā kóng, “Chit-ê lâng sī Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān, i í-keng tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, só͘-í chiah ū koân-lêng kiâⁿ chiah-ê sîn-jiah.”
Goân-lâi, Hi-lu̍t ūi-tio̍h i ê sió-tī Hui-le̍k ê bó͘ Hi-lô-tí ê iân-kò͘ ū lia̍h Iok-hān, kā i liān--khí-lâi, koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ.
In-ūi Iok-hān tiāⁿ-tiāⁿ tùi i kóng, “Lí chhōa chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng chòe bó͘ bô ha̍p-hoat.”
Hi-lu̍t siūⁿ-beh kā i thâi, put-kò kiaⁿ kûn-chiòng, in-ūi in lóng siūⁿ-kóng i sī sian-ti.
Hi-lu̍t choh-siⁿ-ji̍t ê sî, Hi-lô-tí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tī lâi-pin bīn-chêng thiàu-bú; Hi-lu̍t chin hoaⁿ-hí,
chiū chiù-chōa tah-èng hit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á bô-lūn kiû sím-mi̍h lóng beh hō͘ i.
Cha-bó͘ gín-á hō͘ lāu-bú sái-lōng, chiū kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chiong Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān ê thâu-khak khǹg tī pôaⁿ--ni̍h hō͘ góa.”
Ông ê sim chin kan-khó͘, put-kò in-ūi í-keng tī kùi-pin ê bīn-chêng chiù-chōa, chiū bēng-lēng chiàu só͘ kiû--ê hō͘ i.
Ông chhe lâng khì kaⁿ--ni̍h chām Iok-hān ê thâu,
chiong thâu-khak hē tī pôaⁿ--ni̍h, kau hō͘ cha-bó͘ gín-á, cha-bó͘ gín-á chiū phâng-khì hō͘ i ê lāu-bú.
Iok-hān ê bûn-tô͘ lâi siu i ê sin-si khì bâi-chòng, jiân-āu khì kā Iâ-so͘ pò-kò.

Iâ-so͘ thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê siau-sit chiū lī-khui hia, kan-ta ka-kī chē-chûn thè-khì phian-phiah bô lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi. Chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū tùi ta̍k siâⁿ-chhī kiâⁿ-lō͘ tè I.
Iâ-so͘ chiūⁿ-hōaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng chiū khó-lîn in, i-hó in ê pīⁿ.

Hông-hun-àm, bûn-tô͘ óa-lâi kā I kóng, “Chia sī phian-phiah ê só͘-chāi, thiⁿ mā teh àm ah; chhiáⁿ kā kûn-chiòng kái-sàn, hō͘ in thang ka-kī khì hù-kūn ê chng-siā bóe chia̍h-mi̍h.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “In m̄-bián khì, lín hō͘ in chia̍h.”
Bûn-tô͘ tùi I kóng, “Lán chia chí-ū gō͘ ê piáⁿ, nn̄g bé hî.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “The̍h-lâi chia hō͘ góa.”
I chiū kiò chèng-lâng chē tī chháu-po͘, jiân-āu the̍h hit gō͘ ê piáⁿ kap nn̄g bé hî, ǹg thiⁿ kám-siā; piáⁿ peh-khui, the̍h hō͘ bûn-tô͘, bûn-tô͘ chiū pun hō͘ chèng-lâng.
Tāi-ke lóng chia̍h, chia̍h kàu pá. Bûn-tô͘ khioh chia̍h chhun ê chhùi-sut-á, móa cha̍p-jī nâ.
Chia̍h ê lâng, hū-jîn-lâng kap gín-á bô sǹg, iok ū gō͘-chheng ê ta-po͘-lâng.
Iâ-so͘ sûi-sî pek bûn-tô͘ chiūⁿ-chûn seng kè-khì tùi-bīn hōaⁿ, I ka-kī lâu teh kái-sàn kûn-chiòng.
Kûn-chiòng sì-sòaⁿ liáu-āu, I ka-kī chiūⁿ-soaⁿ kî-tó. Thiⁿ àm ê sî, I iáu ka-kī chi̍t ê tī hia.
Hit-sî, chûn í-keng lī hōaⁿ chin hn̄g, in-ūi chìⁿ-hong hō͘ éng poah-lâi-poah-khì.
Thiⁿ beh kng ê sî, Iâ-so͘ tī ô͘ ê téng-bīn ǹg bûn-tô͘ hia kiâⁿ--khì.
Bûn-tô͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h I tī ô͘ ê téng-bīn teh kiâⁿ, chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kóng, “Sī kúi!” In kiaⁿ kah tōa-siaⁿ hoah--chhut-lâi.
Iâ-so͘ sûi-sî kā in kóng, “An-sim, sī góa, m̄-bián kiaⁿ!”
Pí-tek ìn kóng, “Chú ah, nā chin-chiàⁿ sī lí, bēng-lēng góa kiâⁿ chúi-bīn khì lí hia.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lâi!” Pí-tek chiū tùi chûn-téng lo̍h--lâi, kiâⁿ chúi-bīn khì Iâ-so͘ hia.
Pí-tek chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h hong hiah-ni̍h tōa chiū kiaⁿ, soah beh tîm--lo̍h-khì, tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Chú ah, kiù--leh-o͘h!”
Iâ-so͘ sûi-sî chhun-chhiú kā i khiú--teh, kóng, “Sió-sìn ê lâng, sī-án-chóaⁿ teh giâu-gî?”
In chiūⁿ-chûn, hong chiū tiām--khì.
Chûn-téng ê lâng kūi lo̍h-khì pài I, kóng, “Lí chin-chiàⁿ sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ!”
Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ kè ô͘ liáu-āu, tī Kek-nî-sat-le̍k chiūⁿ-hōaⁿ.
Hit só͘-chāi ê lâng chi̍t-ē jīn-chhut Iâ-so͘, chiū phài lâng khì sì-chiu-ûi kā só͘-ū ê pīⁿ-lâng lóng chhōa-lâi I hia.
In khún-kiû Iâ-so͘ hō͘ pīⁿ-lâng kan-ta bong I saⁿ-á-ku ê chhiu chiū hó; só͘-ū bong--tio̍h ê lâng lóng tit-tio̍h i-hó.
Ū Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lâi kìⁿ Iâ-so͘, mn̄g I kóng,
“Sī-án-chóaⁿ lí ê bûn-tô͘ bô seng sóe-chhiú chiū chia̍h-pn̄g, ûi-hoān kó͘-chá-lâng ê thoân-thóng?”
I ìn kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ in-ūi lín ê thoân-thóng lâi ûi-hoān Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng?
Siōng-tè kóng ‘Tio̍h hàu-kèng pē-bú’; koh kóng ‘Mē lāu-pē á-sī mē lāu-bú ê lâng eng-kai chhú-sí’.
M̄-kú lín kóng, ‘Lâng nā tùi ka-kī ê lāu-pē á-sī lāu-bú kóng: Góa eng-kai hō͘ lí--ê í-keng hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè,
i chiū bô su-iàu hàu-kèng lāu-pē.’ Án-ni, lín in-ūi ka-kī ê thoân-thóng hòe-tû Siōng-tè ê ōe.
Lín ké-hó ê lâng, Í-sài-a só͘ kóng koan-hē lín ê ū-giân chin tio̍h; i kóng:
Chit-ê chú-bîn ēng chhùi-tûn chun-kèng góa, in ê sim khiok lī-khui góa hn̄g-hn̄g.
In ēng lâng ê kui-lē chòe góa ê kà-sī kà-sī lâng; in kèng-pài góa lóng bô-chhái-kang.”
Iâ-so͘ kiò chèng-lâng lâi, kā in kóng, “Tio̍h thiaⁿ, tio̍h liáu-kái:
M̄-sī tùi chhùi ji̍p--khì-ê hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì, sī tùi chhùi chhut--lâi-ê chiah hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì.”
Bûn-tô͘ lâi tùi I kóng, “Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí chit-ê ōe chin hoán-kám, lí chai--bô?”
I ìn kóng, “M̄-sī góa ê Thiⁿ-pē chai-chèng--ê, lóng beh kā i khau--khí-lâi.
Chhut-chāi in kóng. In sī chhiⁿ-mî teh khan chhiⁿ-mî; nā chhiⁿ-mî khan chhiⁿ-mî, nn̄g ê lóng ōe poa̍h-lo̍h khut-á.”
Pí-tek ìn I kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kā goán kóe-seh chit-ê phì-jū.”
I chiū kóng, “Liân lín to iáu bô bêng-pe̍k o͘h?
Lín kiám bô liáu-kái, só͘-ū tùi chhùi ji̍p--ê lóng ji̍p-khì pak-tó͘ lāi, āu-lâi pàng lo̍h-khì piān-só͘?
Tùi chhùi chhut--lâi-ê sī tùi sim chhut, che chiah ōe hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì.
In-ūi tùi sim chhut--lâi-ê ū pháiⁿ liām-thâu, hiong-sat, su-thong, kan-îm, thau-the̍h, gūi-chèng, kap húi-pòng.
Chiah-ê chiah ōe hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì; bô sóe-chhiú chiū chia̍h-pn̄g, bōe hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì.”
Iâ-so͘ lī-khui hit só͘-chāi, thè-khì Thài-ní kap Se-tùn ê kéng-lāi.
Tú-hó ū chi̍t ê Ka-lâm ê hū-jîn-lâng tùi hit tōe-khu lâi, tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Chú ah, Tāi-pi̍t ê Kiáⁿ, lîn-bín góa! Góa ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō͘ kúi hū-sin, chin kan-khó͘.”
Iâ-so͘ bô kā i ìn pòaⁿ-kù. I ê bûn-tô͘ lâi kiû I kóng, “Kā i kóaⁿ-cháu, i tè tī lán āu-bīn ti̍t-ti̍t teh hoah.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa siū chhe-phài chí-ū sī beh chhē Í-sek-lia̍t -ke sit-lo̍h ê iûⁿ.”
M̄-kú hū-jîn-lâng lâi kūi tī I ê bīn-chêng, kóng, “Chú ah, chhiáⁿ pang-chān góa!”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “The̍h gín-á ê chia̍h-mi̍h hiat hō͘ káu-á chia̍h, m̄ hó.”
Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Chú, sī lah, káu-á mā ū chia̍h chú-lâng toh-téng lak--lo̍h-lâi ê piáⁿ-iù-á.”
Āu-lâi, Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Hū-jîn-lâng, lí ê sìn-sim chin tōa. Hō͘ lí ê sim-goān si̍t-hiān!” I ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tī hit-chūn chiū tit-tio̍h i-hó.
Iâ-so͘ lī-khui hit só͘-chāi, iân Ka-lī-lī ô͘-piⁿ kiâⁿ, āu-lâi chiūⁿ-soaⁿ, tī hia chē.

Ū chin tōa-tīn ê lâng chhōa kha-chhiú khê--khì, kha-pái, ba̍k-chiu bô khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, chhùi bōe kóng-ōe, kap chin chōe ū pa̍t-khoán pīⁿ ê lâng lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, hē tī I ê kha-chêng, I chiū kā in i-hó.

Chèng-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h bōe kóng-ōe ê lâng ōe kóng-ōe, chhiú khê--khì ê lâng ho̍k-goân, kha-pái ê lâng ōe kiâⁿ, bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, chiū kui êng-kng hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t ê Siōng-tè.

Iâ-so͘ kiò I ê bûn-tô͘ lâi, kā in kóng, “Góa chin khó-lîn chit-tīn lâng, in-ūi in í-keng kap góa chòe-hé saⁿ ji̍t kú, hiān-chāi bô mi̍h thang chia̍h lah. Góa m̄-kam hō͘ in sì-sòaⁿ iau-iau tńg--khì, kiaⁿ-liáu in tī lō͘-tiong hūn-tó.”
Bûn-tô͘ kā I kóng, “Tī chit-ê phian-phiah bô lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi, goán beh khì tó-ūi the̍h hiah chōe piáⁿ lâi hō͘ chiah chōe lâng chia̍h?”
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g in kóng, “Lín ū jōa-chōe piáⁿ?” In kóng, “Chhit ê; mā ū kúi-bé-á sòe bé hî.”
I bēng-lēng kûn-chiòng chē lo̍h-khì thô͘-kha,
jiân-āu the̍h hit chhit ê piáⁿ kap hiah-ê hî, kám-siā, peh-khui, the̍h hō͘ bûn-tô͘, bûn-tô͘ chiū the̍h hō͘ kûn-chiòng.
Chèng-lâng lóng chia̍h, chia̍h kàu pá; in khioh chia̍h chhun ê chhùi-sut-á, tóe-móa chhit láng.
Chia̍h ê lâng, hū-jîn-lâng kap gín-á bô sǹg, kan-ta ta-po͘-lâng chiū ū sì-chheng.
Iâ-so͘ kái-sàn kûn-chiòng liáu-āu, chiūⁿ-chûn khì Má-ka-tan tōe-khu.
Ū Hoat-lī-sài-phài kap Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng lâi chhì-thàm Iâ-so͘, iau-kiû I hō͘ in khòaⁿ tùi thiⁿ lâi ê sîn-jiah.
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Hông-hun ê sî, lín kóng ‘Bîn-á-chài ōe hó-thiⁿ, in-ūi thiⁿ-sek âng’.
Chá-khí-sî lín kóng ‘Kin-á-ji̍t ū hong-hō͘, in-ūi thiⁿ-sek àm koh âng’. Lín to khòaⁿ ōe chhut thiⁿ ê kéng-siōng, ná khòaⁿ bōe chhut chit-ê sî-tāi ê tiāu-thâu.
Siâ-ok kan-îm ê sè-tāi iau-kiû sîn-jiah; Iok-ná ê sîn-jiah í-gōa, bōe koh ū sîn-jiah hō͘ chit sè-tāi ê lâng.” Kóng-liáu, Iâ-so͘ chiū lī-khui in khì pa̍t-ūi.
Bûn-tô͘ kàu ô͘ ê hit-pêng hōaⁿ chiah chai in bōe-kì-tit tòa piáⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Tio̍h chù-ì, tio̍h tî-hông Hoat-lī-sài-phài kap Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê kàⁿ.”
In hō͘-siōng gī-lūn kóng, “Sī in-ūi lán bô tòa piáⁿ sī--bô?”
Iâ-so͘ chai-iáⁿ chiū kóng, “Sió-sìn ê lâng, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ teh gī-lūn bô tòa piáⁿ ê tāi-chì?
Lín kiám iáu-bē bêng-pe̍k, kiám bōe-kì-tit góa ēng gō͘ ê piáⁿ hō͘ gō͘-chheng lâng chia̍h, chia̍h chhun--ê lín ū khioh kúi nâ?
Lín kiám bōe-kì-tit góa ēng chhit ê piáⁿ hō͘ sì-chheng lâng chia̍h, chia̍h chhun--ê lín ū khioh kúi láng?
Sī-án-chóaⁿ lín bô bêng-pe̍k góa kā lín kóng--ê m̄-sī koan-hē piáⁿ ê tāi-chì? Tio̍h tî-hông Hoat-lī-sài-phài kap Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê kàⁿ!”
Chit-sî bûn-tô͘ chiah bêng-pe̍k Iâ-so͘ m̄-sī kóng tio̍h tî-hông piáⁿ ê kàⁿ, sī tio̍h tî-hông Hoat-lī-sài-phài kap Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê kà-sī.
Iâ-so͘ lâi kàu Khái-sat-lī-a Hui-li̍p-pí kéng-lāi ê sî, mn̄g I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Lâng kóng Jîn-chú sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?”
In ìn kóng, “Ū lâng kóng sī Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān; ū lâng kóng sī Í-lī-a; mā ū lâng kóng sī Iâ-lī-bí á-sī sian-ti tiong ê chi̍t ūi.”
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g in kóng, “Lín leh, lín kóng góa sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?”
Se-bûn Pí-tek ìn kóng, “Lí sī Ki-tok, éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn i kóng, “ Se-bûn Pa-iok-ná, lí chin ū hok-khì, in-ūi kā lí khé-sī--ê m̄-sī lâng, sī góa ê Thiⁿ-pē.
Góa koh kā lí kóng, lí sī Pí-tek, sī chio̍h-pôaⁿ, góa beh tī chit-ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ téng khí-chō góa ê kàu-hōe, Im-hú sí-bông ê koân-sè to bōe iâⁿ-kè i.
Góa beh chiong Thian-kok ê só-sî hō͘ lí; lí tī tōe-chiūⁿ kìm-chí--ê, tī thiⁿ-téng mā ōe kìm-chí; lí tī tōe-chiūⁿ ún-chún--ê, tī thiⁿ-téng mā ōe ún-chún.”
Āu-lâi, I bēng-lēng bûn-tô͘ m̄-thang kā lâng kóng I chiū-sī Ki-tok.

Hit-sî, Iâ-so͘ khai-sí tùi I ê bûn-tô͘ piáu-sī I it-tēng tio̍h khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tùi tiúⁿ-ló, chè-si-tiúⁿ, kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su siū chin chōe khó͘-lān, koh hō͘ lâng hāi-sí, tē-saⁿ ji̍t Siōng-tè ōe hō͘ I koh-oa̍h.
Pí-tek chiū khiú Iâ-so͘ khì piⁿ--á, kā I chek-pī kóng, “Chú ah, choa̍t-tùi m̄-thang! Lí bōe-ēng-tit ū chit-khoán tāi-chì!”
Iâ-so͘ oa̍t-tńg-sin tùi Pí-tek kóng, “Sat-tàn, siám-khui! Lí teh kā góa tîⁿ-kha-pòaⁿ-chhiú; lí siūⁿ--ê m̄-sī Siōng-tè ê sū, sī lâng ê sū.”
Āu-lâi, Iâ-so͘ tùi I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Beh tè góa ê lâng, tio̍h oân-choân hó͘-tēng ka-kī, giâ ka-kī ê si̍p-jī-kè lâi tè góa.
In-ūi beh kiù ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā--ê, ōe sòng-sit sìⁿ-miā; ūi-tio̍h góa ê iân-kò͘ sòng-sit ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā--ê, ōe tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā.
Lâng nā tit-tio̍h choân sè-kài soah sòng-sit ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek? Lâng ōe-tàng ēng sím-mi̍h tāi-kè lâi kau-ōaⁿ ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā?
Jîn-chú teh-beh tī I ê Pē ê êng-iāu tiong kap I ê thiⁿ-sài lâi-lîm, hit-sî I ōe chiàu ta̍k-ê lâng ê hêng-ûi kā in pò-siúⁿ á-sī hêng-hoa̍t.
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, khiā tī chia ê lâng, ū-ê iáu-bē sí í-chêng ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Jîn-chú choh-ông lâi-lîm.”
La̍k ji̍t āu, Iâ-so͘ chhōa Pí-tek, Ngá-kok, kap Ngá-kok ê sió-tī Iok-hān, kan-ta in ka-kī peh-chiūⁿ chi̍t chō koân soaⁿ.
Tī in bīn-chêng, Iâ-so͘ ê hêng-siōng kái-piàn: I ê bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t-thâu hoat-kng; I ê saⁿ piàn kah chhin-chhiūⁿ kng hiah-ni̍h pe̍h.
Hut-jiân-kan, Mô͘-se kap Í-lī-a tùi in hián-hiān, kap Iâ-so͘ kóng-ōe.
Pí-tek tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Chú ah, lán tī chia chin hó! Lí nā beh, góa tī chia tah saⁿ keng liâu-á, chi̍t keng hō͘ lí, chi̍t keng hō͘ Mô͘-se, chi̍t keng hō͘ Í-lī-a.”

I iáu-teh kóng ê sî, hut-jiân ū chi̍t phìⁿ chhàn-lān ê hûn kā in tà--leh, ū siaⁿ tùi hûn chhut--lâi, kóng, “Chit-ê sī góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê Kiáⁿ, I, góa chin ì-ài, lín tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn I.”
Bûn-tô͘ chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū phak--lo̍h-khì, hui-siông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ kiâⁿ óa--khì, kā in bong, kóng, “Khí--lâi, m̄-bián kiaⁿ!”
In chi̍t-ē gia̍h-ba̍k khòaⁿ, chí-ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘, í-gōa bô pa̍t-lâng.
In lo̍h-soaⁿ ê sî, Iâ-so͘ bēng-lēng in, kóng, “Jîn-chú tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h í-chêng, lín m̄-thang kā lâng kóng-khí só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê īⁿ-siōng.”
Bûn-tô͘ mn̄g I, kóng, “Nā án-ni, sī-án-chóaⁿ keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kóng Í-lī-a it-tēng tio̍h seng lâi?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “ Í-lī-a it-tēng tio̍h lâi têng-sin chéng-lí it-chhè.
Góa kā lín kóng, Í-lī-a í-keng lâi lah, m̄-kú lâng m̄ bat i, hoán-tńg chiàu in ê ì-sù tùi-thāi i. Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, Jîn-chú mā teh-beh tī in ê chhiú-ē siū-khó͘.”
Hit-sî bûn-tô͘ chiah bêng-pe̍k I tùi in kóng--ê sī chí Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān.
In lâi kàu kûn-chiòng hia, ū chi̍t ê lâng lâi, kūi tī Iâ-so͘ ê kha-chêng,
tùi I kóng, “Chú ah, lîn-bín góa ê kiáⁿ! In-ūi i tì-tio̍h iûⁿ-hîn, hui-siông kan-khó͘, put-sî poa̍h-lo̍h hé, mā put-sî poa̍h-lo̍h chúi.
Góa chhōa i khì lí ê bûn-tô͘ hia, in bô hoat-tō͘ kā i i-hó.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Ài ah, m̄-sìn koh hú-pāi ê sè-tāi, góa tio̍h kap lín tòa jōa kú? Góa tio̍h koh jím-nāi lín jōa kú? Kā i chhōa-lâi góa chia.”
Iâ-so͘ chek-pī kúi, kúi chiū tùi gín-á chhut--khì; i ê pīⁿ sûi-sî hó--khì.
Āu-lâi, bûn-tô͘ su-hā lâi mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ goán bô hoat-tō͘ kā kúi kóaⁿ--chhut-khì?”

Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Sī in-ūi lín sió-sìn. Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, lín ê sìn-sim nā ū kòa-chhài-chí hiah tōa, lín tùi chit-chō soaⁿ kóng ‘Tùi chia sóa-khì hia’, soaⁿ mā ōe sóa--khì; bô chi̍t hāng sū lín chòe bōe kàu.”
Bûn-tô͘ chū-chi̍p tī Ka-lī-lī ê sî, Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Jîn-chú teh-beh hō͘ lâng chhut-bōe.
In ōe kā I hāi-sí, tē-saⁿ ji̍t Siōng-tè ōe hō͘ I koh-oa̍h.” Bûn-tô͘ chiū hui-siông siong-sim.
Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ lâi kàu Ka-pek-lông ê sî, ū chi̍t-kóa siu sèng-tiān-sè ê lâng khì mn̄g Pí-tek, “Lín lāu-su ū la̍p sèng-tiān-sè bô?”

I kóng, “Ū.” Pí-tek ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi ê sî, Iâ-so͘ seng mn̄g i kóng, “Tōe-chiūⁿ ê kun-ông sī tùi sím-mi̍h-lâng siu koan-sè á-sī lâng-thâu-sè? Sī tùi pún-kok-lâng á-sī gōa-kok-lâng? Se-bûn, lí siūⁿ án-chóaⁿ?”
Pí-tek ìn kóng, “Tùi gōa-kok-lâng.” Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Án-ni, pún-kok-lâng chiū m̄-bián la̍p-sè lo͘h.

Put-kò, lán ūi-tio̍h bô ài tek-chōe chiah-ê lâng, lí khì ô͘--ni̍h tiò hî, tiò--khí-lâi ê thâu chi̍t bé, kā hî ê chhùi peh-khui chiū ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê gûn-á, the̍h-khì hō͘ in, thòe góa kap lí la̍p sèng-tiān-sè.”
Hit-sî, bûn-tô͘ lâi mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Tī Thian-kok sím-mi̍h-lâng siōng tōa?”
Iâ-so͘ kiò chi̍t ê gín-á lâi, hō͘ i khiā tī in tiong-kan,
kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, lín nā bô kái-piàn pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ gín-á, choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng ji̍p Thian-kok.
Só͘-í, lâng ka-kī khiam-pi chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-ê gín-á, chit-ê lâng tī Thian-kok chiū-sī siōng tōa.
Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng, ūi-tio̍h góa ê miâ chiap-la̍p chit-khoán gín-á chiū-sī chiap-la̍p góa.”
“Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng hō͘ sìn góa ê lâng tiong-kan bî-sòe ê chi̍t ê hoān-chōe, lêng-khó hō͘ lâng ēng tōa chio̍h-bō pa̍k tī ām-kún thiām-lo̍h chhim-hái.
Chit-ê sè-kan chhám ah, in-ūi ū hō͘ lâng poa̍h-tó hoān-chōe. Hō͘ lâng hoān-chōe ê sū it-tēng ū, m̄-kú ín-khí lâng hoān-chōe ê lâng chhám ah.

“Lí ê chi̍t ki chhiú á-sī chi̍t ki kha nā hō͘ lí hoān-chōe, tio̍h kā i chām khí-lâi tàn hiat-ka̍k. Lêng-khó chi̍t-kha chi̍t-chhiú ji̍p éng-oán-oa̍h, pí siang-kha siang-chhiú hó-hó hō͘ lâng hiat-lo̍h éng-oán ê hé khah hó.

Lí ê ba̍k-chiu nā hō͘ lí hoān-chōe, tio̍h kā i ó͘ chhut-lâi tàn hiat-ka̍k. Lêng-khó kiám chi̍t lúi ba̍k-chiu ji̍p éng-oán-oa̍h, pí nn̄g lúi ba̍k-chiu hó-hó, hō͘ lâng hiat-lo̍h hé teh to̍h ê tōe-ge̍k khah hó.”
“Lín tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang khòaⁿ-khin chiah-ê bî-sòe ê lâng ê chi̍t ê. Góa kā lín kóng, in ê thiⁿ-sài tī thiⁿ-téng sî-siông teh kìⁿ góa Thiⁿ-pē ê bīn.
“Lín siūⁿ siáⁿ-khoán? Ū chi̍t ê lâng ū chi̍t-pah chiah iûⁿ, kî-tiong chi̍t chiah sit-bê, i kiám bōe chiong káu-cha̍p-káu chiah pàng tī soaⁿ-téng, khì chhē hit-chiah sit-bê--ê?
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, i nā chhē-tio̍h hit-chiah sit-bê ê iûⁿ, it-tēng chin hoaⁿ-hí, pí ū káu-cha̍p-káu chiah bô sit-bê--ê koh-khah hoaⁿ-hí.
Siâng-khoán, lín ê Thiⁿ-pē m̄-kam chiah-ê bî-sòe ê lâng ê chi̍t ê bia̍t-bông.”

“Lí ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē nā tek-chōe lí, tio̍h khì chhē i, kan-ta lín nn̄g lâng chòe-hé ê sî su-hā kā i chí-chhut chhò-gō͘. I nā beh thiaⁿ, chiū hôe-ho̍k lí kap i chòe hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē ê koan-hē.
I nā m̄ thiaⁿ, tio̍h chhōa chi̍t nn̄g ê lâng kap lí khì, án-ni ta̍k-kù ōe ū nn̄g ê á-sī saⁿ ê lâng thang choh-chèng.
I nā iáu m̄ thiaⁿ, tio̍h kā kàu-hōe kóng; i nā liân kàu-hōe to m̄ thiaⁿ, chiū kā i khòaⁿ-chòe Gōa-pang-lâng á-sī ba̍uh-sè--ê.”
“Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, lín tī tōe-chiūⁿ kìm-chí--ê, tī thiⁿ-téng mā ōe kìm-chí; lín tī tōe-chiūⁿ ún-chún--ê, tī thiⁿ-téng mā ōe ún-chún.
“Góa koh kā lín kóng, lín tiong-kan nā ū nn̄g ê lâng tī tōe-chiūⁿ tâng-sim-ha̍p-ì kî-kiû, góa ê Thiⁿ-pē lóng ōe kā in sêng-choân.
In-ūi, ū nn̄g ê á-sī saⁿ ê lâng hōng góa ê miâ chū-hōe, góa chiū tī in tiong-kan.”
Pí-tek lâi mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Chú ah, góa ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē tek-chōe góa, góa tio̍h sià-bián i kúi piàn? Kàu chhit piàn sī--bô?”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “M̄-sī. Góa m̄-sī kā lí kóng tio̍h kàu chhit piàn, sī tio̍h kàu chhit-cha̍p ê chhit piàn.
“Án-ni, Thian-kok thang ēng chit-ê phì-jū lâi soat-bêng: Ū chi̍t ê kok-ông beh kap i ê po̍k-jîn kiat-siàu,
i khai-sí sǹg-siàu ê sî, ū lâng chiong khiàm kúi-nā pah-bān gûn-á ê lâng chhōa-lâi i ê bīn-chêng.
Hit-ê lâng bōe-tàng hêng, chú-lâng chiū bēng-lēng lâng chiong hit-ê lâng kap i ê bó͘-kiáⁿ í-ki̍p it-chhè só͘ ū--ê lóng khì bōe lâi hêng-chè.
Hit-ê po̍k-jîn chiū kūi lo̍h-khì kiû kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa ān chi̍t-ē, góa ōe lóng hêng.’
Po̍k-jîn ê chú-lâng chiū khó-lîn i, chhat-siau i ê chè, pàng i khì.

“Hit-ê po̍k-jîn chhut--khì, tú-tio̍h chi̍t ê pîⁿ-pîⁿ chòe po̍k-jîn--ê, hit-ê lâng chí-ū khiàm i kúi ê gûn-á, chiū kā i lia̍h--teh, tīⁿ i ê ām-kún, kóng, ‘Lí só͘ khiàm--ê, lóng tio̍h hêng!’
Pîⁿ-pîⁿ chòe po̍k-jîn--ê kūi lo̍h-khì kiû i kóng, ‘Pài-thok hō͘ góa ān chi̍t-ē, góa ōe lóng hêng.’
I m̄-khéng, tian-tò chiong chit-ê lâng koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ, koaiⁿ kàu só͘ khiàm--ê lóng hêng chheng-chhó.
Lēng-gōa pîⁿ-pîⁿ chòe po̍k-jîn--ê khòaⁿ--tio̍h, hui-siông thòng-sim, chiū chiong só͘ hoat-seng it-chhè ê tāi-chì khì kā chú-lâng pò-kò.
Chú-lâng chiū kiò hit-ê po̍k-jîn lâi, tùi i kóng, ‘Lí chit-ê pháiⁿ po̍k-jîn, in-ūi lí tùi góa kiû, góa chiū chiong lí só͘ khiàm ê chè lóng chhat-siau.
Góa ū lîn-bín lí, lí kiám m̄ eng-kai chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni lîn-bín hit-ê pîⁿ-pîⁿ chòe po̍k-jîn--ê?’
I ê chú-lâng chin siū-khì, chiū kā i koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ siū-hêng, koaiⁿ kàu i chiong it-chhè ê chè-bū lóng hêng chheng-chhó.
“Lín ta̍k-ê lâng nā bô tùi sim-tóe sià-bián ka-kī ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē, góa ê Thiⁿ-pē mā ōe án-ni tùi-thāi lín, bōe kā lín sià-bián.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu, lī-khui Ka-lī-lī khì Iok-tàn-hô tùi-hōaⁿ ê Iû-thài tōe-khu.
Ū kui tōa-tīn ê lâng tè I, I chiū tī hia i-hó in ê pīⁿ.
Ū chi̍t-kóa Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng lâi chhì-thàm I, kóng, “Lâng bô-lūn sím-mi̍h lí-iû to thang lî i ê bó͘, ū ha̍h Lu̍t-hoat bô?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lín kiám bô tha̍k-tio̍h Chhòng-chō-chú tī khí-thâu chhòng-chō lâng ū lâm ū lú?
Siōng-tè kóng, ‘In-ūi chit-ê lí-iû, lâng ōe lī-khui pē-bú, kap i ê bó͘ kiat-ha̍p, nn̄g lâng chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé.’
Án-ni, in í-keng m̄-sī nn̄g ê, sī chi̍t-thé. Só͘-í, Siōng-tè só͘ phòe-ha̍p--ê, lâng m̄-thang thiah-khui.”
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng mn̄g I kóng, “Nā án-ni, Mô͘-se sī-án-chóaⁿ bēng-lēng lâng hō͘ i ê bó͘ chi̍t tiuⁿ lî-hun-su chiū thang kā i lî?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “In-ūi lín ê sim ngī, Mô͘-se chiah iông-ún lín lî lín ê bó͘. Khí-thâu chhòng-chō ê sî Siōng-tè ê ì-sù pèng m̄-sī án-ni.
Góa kā lín kóng, nā m̄-sī in-ūi bó͘ put-cheng, bōe-ēng-tit kā i lî, nā kā i lî koh chhōa pa̍t-ê hū-jîn-lâng chiū-sī hoān kan-îm.”
Bûn-tô͘ kā I kóng, “Kì-jiân hu-hū ê koan-hē sī án-ni, lêng-khó mài kiat-hun khah hó.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Chit-ê ōe m̄-sī ta̍k-ê lâng lóng ōe-tàng chiap-siū, chí-ū ū chit-khoán un-sù ê lâng chiah ōe.

Ū lâng tùi chhut-sì chiū bô sek-ha̍p kiat-hun; ū lâng sī jîn-ûi ê goân-in bōe-tàng kiat-hun; mā ū lâng sī ūi-tio̍h Thian-kok ê iân-kò͘ bô ài kiat-hun. Ōe-tàng chiap-siū ê lâng tio̍h chiap-siū.”
Ū lâng chhōa gín-á lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, ài I kā in hōaⁿ-chhiú kî-tó. Bûn-tô͘ chek-pī hiah-ê lâng.
M̄-kú Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Hō͘ gín-á lâi góa chia, m̄-thang kā in chó͘-tòng, in-ūi Thian-kok sī chit-khoán lâng ê.”
I chiū kā in hōaⁿ-chhiú chiok-hok, jiân-āu lī-khui hia.
Ū chi̍t piàn, ū chi̍t ê lâng lâi chhē Iâ-so͘, tùi I kóng, “Lāu-su, góa tio̍h chòe sím-mi̍h hó-sū chiah ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lí ná ōe mn̄g góa koan-hē hó ê sū? Chí-ū Chi̍t-ūi sī hó. Lí nā ài chìn-ji̍p éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā, tio̍h chun-siú kài-bēng.”
I mn̄g Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Sī tó chi̍t tiâu kài-bēng?” Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “M̄-thang hāi-sí lâng; m̄-thang kan-îm; m̄-thang thau-the̍h; m̄-thang choh gūi-chèng;
tio̍h hàu-kèng pē-bú; tio̍h thiàⁿ chhù-piⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī.”
Chit-ê siàu-liân-lâng kā I kóng, “Chiah-ê góa it-ti̍t ū teh chun-siú, iáu khiàm sím-mi̍h?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lí nā ài chòe oân-choân ê lâng, lí khì, khì bōe lí ê châi-sán, pun hō͘ sàn-chhiah-lâng, lí tī thiⁿ-téng chiū ū châi-pó, jiân-āu lâi tè góa.”
Siàu-liân-lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê ōe, chiū iu-iu-chhiû-chhiû lī-khui; in-ūi i châi-sán chin chōe.
Iâ-so͘ chiū kā I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, hó-gia̍h-lâng ji̍p Thian-kok si̍t-chāi chin khùn-lân!
Góa koh kā lín kóng, lo̍k-tô chhng-kè chiam-phīⁿ mā pí hó-gia̍h-lâng ji̍p Siōng-tè-kok koh-khah kán-tan.”
Bûn-tô͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kóng, “Nā án-ni, sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h kiù?”
Iâ-so͘ chù-ba̍k kā in khòaⁿ, kóng, “Chit-ê sū, lâng chòe bōe kàu, m̄-kú Siōng-tè ta̍k-hāng lóng ōe.”
Pí-tek ìn kóng, “Goán í-keng pàng-sak it-chhè lâi tè lí lah, goán ōe tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h?”

Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, chiong-lâi ê sin sè-kài, Jîn-chú chē tī I êng-kng ê pó-chō ê sî, lín tè góa ê lâng ōe chē tī cha̍p-jī ê pó-chō lâi sím-phòaⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t ê cha̍p-jī chi-cho̍k.
Ūi-tio̍h góa ê miâ pàng-sak ka-kī ê chhù, hiaⁿ-tī, chí-bē, pē-bú, kiáⁿ-jî, á-sī chhân-hn̂g ê lâng, lóng ōe tit-tio̍h pah-pē ê pò-siúⁿ, koh sêng-siū éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Chóng-sī chin chōe chòe thâu-chêng--ê ōe chòe siōng lō͘-bé; siōng lō͘-bé--ê ōe chòe siōng thâu-chêng.”
“Thian-kok chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t ê hn̂g-chú thàu-chá chhut-khì chhiàⁿ kang-lâng lâi i ê phû-tô-hn̂g chòe kang.
I kap kang-lâng iok-tēng chi̍t ji̍t chi̍t ê gûn, chiū chhe in khì phû-tô-hn̂g chòe kang.
Chá-khí-sî káu tiám chó-iū i koh chhut--khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū chi̍t-kóa lâng tī chhī-tiûⁿ-kháu teh khiā, bô tāi-chì chòe,
chiū tùi in kóng, ‘Lín mā khì phû-tô-hn̂g chòe kang, góa ōe hō͘ lín kong-tō ê kang-chîⁿ.’
In chiū khì. Tiong-tàu cha̍p-jī tiám kap ē-po͘ saⁿ tiám chó-iū i koh chhut--khì, mā án-ni chòe.
Ē-po͘ gō͘ tiám, i koh chhut--khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū chi̍t-kóa lâng khiā tī hia, chiū tùi in kóng, ‘Lín ná kui-ji̍t khiā tī chia, bô tāi-chì chòe?’
In kā i kóng, ‘In-ūi bô lâng chhiàⁿ goán.’ Chú-lâng kā in kóng, ‘Lín mā khì phû-tô-hn̂g chòe kang.’
“Hông-hun ê sî, hn̂g-chú kā i ê koán-ke kóng, ‘Lí khì kiò kang-lâng lâi, hoat kang-chîⁿ hō͘ in, tùi lō͘-bé lâi--ê seng hoat, jiân-āu chiah hoat hō͘ tāi-seng lâi--ê.’
Hiah-ê ē-po͘ gō͘ tiám chiah lâi--ê, ta̍k-ê lâng niá-tio̍h chi̍t ê gûn.
Tāi-seng lâi choh-kang ê lâng siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī ōe niá khah chōe, m̄-kú ta̍k-ê lâng mā chí-ū niá chi̍t ê gûn.
In niá liáu, tùi chú-lâng bâi-oàn,
kóng, ‘Chiah-ê chòe-āu lâi ê lâng chí-ū chòe chi̍t tiám-cheng nā-tiāⁿ, goán hō͘ ji̍t-thâu pha̍k kui-ji̍t, lô-khó͘ kang-chok, lí kèng-jiân hō͘ in kap goán niá pîⁿ chōe!’
Chú-lâng ìn kî-tiong chi̍t ê lâng kóng, ‘Pêng-iú, góa tùi lí m̄-sī bô kong-tō. Lí kiám m̄-sī kap góa iok-tēng chi̍t ji̍t chi̍t ê gûn?
The̍h lí ê kang-chîⁿ, tńg--khì! Góa beh hō͘ siōng-bé lâi--ê kap lí niá pîⁿ chōe.
Góa ēng ka-kī ê mi̍h chòe góa ài chòe--ê kiám bōe-ēng--tit? Góa khóng-khài, lí teh ba̍k-kháng-chhiah sī--bô?’
“Án-ni, siōng lō͘-bé--ê ōe chòe tē-it; tē-it--ê ōe chòe siōng lō͘-bé.”
Iâ-so͘ tī chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lō͘-tiong kiò cha̍p-jī ê bûn-tô͘ lâi, su-hā tùi in kóng,
“Taⁿ lán beh chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, Jîn-chú ōe siū chhut-bōe hō͘ chè-si-tiúⁿ kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su. In ōe kā I tēng sí-chōe,
āu-lâi chiong I kau hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng, kā I hì-lāng, piⁿ-phah, tèng si̍p-jī-kè; tē-saⁿ ji̍t Siōng-tè ōe hō͘ I koh-oa̍h.”
Hit-sî, Se-pì-thài ê bó͘ chhōa i nn̄g ê kiáⁿ lâi kìⁿ Iâ-so͘, kūi lo̍h-khì I bīn-chêng, kiû chi̍t hāng tāi-chì.
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g i kóng, “Lí ài sím-mi̍h?” I ìn kóng, “Lí choh-ông ê sî, chhiáⁿ lí hō͘ góa chit nn̄g ê kiáⁿ chi̍t ê chē lí ê chiàⁿ-pêng, chi̍t ê chē lí ê tò-pêng.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lín m̄ chai ka-kī teh kiû sím-mi̍h. Góa teh-beh lim ê poe, lín ōe-tàng lim bōe?” In kóng, “Goán ōe.”

Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa ê poe lín beh lim, put-kò chē góa ê chiàⁿ-pêng tò-pêng m̄-sī góa ōe-tàng hō͘ lâng--ê. Góa ê Pē ūi-tio̍h sím-mi̍h-lâng chún-pī chiū hō͘ hit-ê lâng.”
Kî-tha hit cha̍p ê bûn-tô͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū tùi hit nn̄g ê hiaⁿ-tī siū-khì.
Iâ-so͘ kiò in lâi, kā in kóng, “Lín chai Gōa-pang-lâng ū thóng-tī-chiá teh kā in koán-hat, ū léng-siù teh kā in chi-phòe.
Lín tiong-kan chiū m̄ eng-kai án-ni. Lín tiong-kan ài chòe tōa--ê tio̍h chòe lín ê chhe-ēng;
ài chòe tē-it--ê, tio̍h chòe lín ê po̍k-jîn;
tú chhin-chhiūⁿ Jîn-chú lâi, m̄-sī beh hō͘ lâng ho̍k-sāi, hoán-tńg sī beh kā lâng ho̍k-sāi, sīm-chì hi-seng ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā lâi sio̍k-hôe chin chōe lâng.”
In lī-khui Iâ-lī-ko ê sî, ū chi̍t tōa-kûn lâng tè Iâ-so͘ khì.
Tú ū nn̄g ê bông-jîn chē tī lō͘-piⁿ, thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ tùi hia keng-kè, chiū tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “ Tāi-pi̍t ê Kiáⁿ, lîn-bín goán!”
Kûn-chiòng kā in chek-pī, kiò in tiām-tiām, m̄-kú in koh-khah tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Chú — Tāi-pi̍t ê Kiáⁿ, lîn-bín goán!”
Iâ-so͘ thêng-kha, kiò in, kóng, “Lín ài góa kā lín chòe sím-mi̍h?”
In kóng, “Chú ah, goán ài ba̍k-chiu ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.”
Iâ-so͘ khó-lîn in, bong in ê ba̍k-chiu, in sûi-sî koh ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū tè I khì.
Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ teh-beh kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, lâi kàu Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ hù-kūn ê Pek-hoat-kî. Hit-sî I chhe nn̄g ê bûn-tô͘,

kā in kóng, “Lín khì tùi-bīn ê chng-siā, kàu hia sûi-sî ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chiah lû pa̍k--teh, koh ū chi̍t chiah lû-á-kiáⁿ kap i tī hia; lín kā in tháu-khui, khan-lâi góa chia.
Nā ū lâng tùi lín kóng sím-mi̍h, lín chiū kóng, ‘Chú beh ēng in.’ Hit-ê lâng ōe sûi-sî chún lín khan--lâi.”
Chit-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng sī beh èng-giām Siōng-tè thong-kè sian-ti só͘ kóng ê ōe:
Tio̍h kā Sek-an ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, lín ê Ông beh lâi lín chia; I khiam-sùn khiâ lû-á, khiâ lû-á-kiáⁿ.
Bûn-tô͘ chiū khì, chiàu Iâ-so͘ ê chí-sī khì chòe.
In khan lû-á kap lû-á-kiáⁿ lâi, chiong gōa-saⁿ phoa̍h tī in téng-bīn, Iâ-so͘ chiū peh-khí-khì khiâ.
Tōa-pō͘-hūn ê kûn-chiòng chiong in ka-kī ê gōa-saⁿ pho͘ tī lō͘--ni̍h, mā ū lâng chhò chhiū-oe pho͘ tī lō͘--ni̍h kā I hoan-gêng.
Chêng-kiâⁿ-āu-tè ê kûn-chiòng hoah kóng: Tāi-pi̍t ê Kiáⁿ, hô-sàn-ná! Hōng Chú ê miâ lâi Hit-ūi eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè, hô-sàn-ná!
Iâ-so͘ chi̍t-ē chìn-ji̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, choân-siâⁿ lóng hán--khí-lâi, kóng, “Chit-ê sī siáⁿ-lâng?”
Chèng-lâng kóng, “Chit-ê sī tùi Ka-lī-lī ê Ná-sat-le̍k lâi ê sian-ti Iâ-so͘.”
Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì Sèng-tiān, chiong tiān-lāi só͘-ū teh bóe-bōe ê lâng lóng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, koh chhia-tó ōaⁿ-chîⁿ ê lâng ê toh kap bōe hún-chiáu ê lâng ê í.
I tùi in kóng, “Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Góa ê chhù beh kiò-chòe kî-tó ê tiān, lín soah kā i pìⁿ-chòe thó͘-húi-á khut.”
Ū bông-jîn kap kha-pái ê lâng lâi Sèng-tiān chhē Iâ-so͘, I chiū kā in i-hó.

Chè-si-tiúⁿ kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ só͘ kiâⁿ ê kî-sū, koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ sòe-hàn gín-á tī Sèng-tiān tōa-siaⁿ hoah “ Tāi-pi̍t ê Kiáⁿ, hô-sàn-ná”, chiū chin siū-khì,

kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lí ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h in teh hoah sím-mi̍h bô?” Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Ū. Lín kiám bô tha̍k-tio̍h Sèng-keng ê ōe: Lí hō͘ gín-á kap eⁿ-á ê chhùi tōa-siaⁿ chhiùⁿ-chhut o-ló.”
Āu-lâi Iâ-so͘ lī-khui in, chhut-siâⁿ khì Pek-tāi-nî, tī hia kè-mî.
Keh-chá-khí, beh tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sî, Iâ-so͘ pak-tó͘ iau.

I khòaⁿ-tio̍h lō͘-piⁿ ū chi̍t châng bû-hoa-kó-chhiū, chiū kiâⁿ óa--khì, m̄-kú chhiū-téng lóng bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h pòaⁿ-hāng, chí-ū hio̍h nā-tiāⁿ. I tùi hit-châng chhiū kóng, “Lí éng-oán bōe koh kiat ké-chí.” Hit-châng bû-hoa-kó-chhiū sûi-sî ta--khì.
Bûn-tô͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kóng, “Chit-châng bû-hoa-kó-chhiū ná ōe hut-jiân-kan ta--khì?”

Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, lín nā ū sìn-sim, bô giâu-gî, m̄-nā ōe-tàng chòe góa tùi chit-châng bû-hoa-kó-chhiū só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì, sīm-chì bēng-lēng chit-chō soaⁿ kóng ‘Khí--lâi, khì thiām-hái’ mā it-tēng ōe si̍t-hiān.
Kî-tó ê sî, lín só͘ kiû ê it-chhè, ū sìn chiū ōe tit--tio̍h.”

Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì Sèng-tiān teh kà-sī lâng ê sî, chè-si-tiúⁿ kap bîn-kan ê tiúⁿ-ló lâi I hia, tùi I kóng, “Lí khò sím-mi̍h koân-pèng chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì? Sím-mi̍h-lâng hō͘ lí chit-ê koân-pèng?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa mā beh mn̄g lín chi̍t kù ōe, lín nā kā góa ìn, góa chiah kā lín kóng góa khò sím-mi̍h koân-pèng chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì.

Iok-hān kā lâng sóe-lé ê koân-pèng tùi tó-ūi lâi, sī tùi Thiⁿ á-sī tùi lâng?” In hō͘-siōng gī-lūn kóng, “Lán nā kóng ‘Tùi Thiⁿ’, I ōe kā lán kóng ‘Án-ni, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ bô sìn Iok-hān?’
Lán nā kóng ‘Tùi lâng’, khióng-kiaⁿ kûn-chiòng hoán-kám, in-ūi in lóng siūⁿ-kóng Iok-hān sī sian-ti.”
In chiū ìn Iâ-so͘, “Goán m̄ chai.” Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Án-ni, góa mā m̄ kā lín kóng góa khò sím-mi̍h koân-pèng chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lín siūⁿ án-chóaⁿ? Ū chi̍t ê lâng ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ; i khì kā tōa-kiáⁿ kóng, ‘Kiáⁿ ah, lí kin-á-ji̍t khì phû-tô-hn̂g chòe kang.’
Tōa-kiáⁿ ìn kóng ‘Góa m̄ khì’, āu-lâi kái-piàn sim-ì ū khì.
Lāu-pē mā khì kā tē-jī kiáⁿ kóng siâng-khoán ê ōe. Tē-jī kiáⁿ ìn kóng ‘A-pa, góa lâi-khì’, āu-lâi bô khì.

Chit nn̄g ê kiáⁿ tó chi̍t ê ū chiàu lāu-pē ê ì-sù khì chòe?” In kóng, “Tōa-kiáⁿ.” Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, ba̍uh-sè--ê kap chhiong-ki ōe pí lín seng chìn-ji̍p Siōng-tè-kok.

In-ūi Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān lâi lín chia, chí-sī lín kiâⁿ chiàⁿ-lō͘, lín bô sìn i, m̄-kú ba̍uh-sè--ê kap chhiong-ki ū sìn. Sīm-chì lín khòaⁿ--tio̍h liáu-āu mā bô hóe-kái lâi sìn i.”

Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín koh thiaⁿ chi̍t ê phì-jū. Ū chi̍t ê hn̂g-chú khai-khún chi̍t khu phû-tô-hn̂g, sì-bīn ûi lî-pa, lāi-bīn ó͘ chi̍t ê chiú-khut, khí chi̍t ê siú-bōng-tâi, chiong chit-khu hn̂g cho͘ hō͘ tiān-lông, āu-lâi chhut-gōa khì chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi.
Siu-sêng ké-chí ê sî kàu, hn̂g-chú chhe po̍k-jîn khì tiān-lông hia, beh tùi in siu ké-chí.
Tiān-lông kā chiah-ê po̍k-jîn lia̍h--khí-lâi, chi̍t ê kā i phah, chi̍t ê kā i thâi--sí, chi̍t ê ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm--sí.
Hn̂g-chú koh chhe lēng-gōa chi̍t-kóa po̍k-jîn khì, pí thâu chi̍t piàn khah chōe lâng. Tiān-lông mā chiàu án-ni tùi-thāi in.
Chòe-āu, hn̂g-chú chhe ka-kī ê kiáⁿ khì in hia, siūⁿ-kóng ‘In ōe chun-tiōng góa ê kiáⁿ’.
M̄-kú tiān-lông chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ê kiáⁿ chiū chham-siông kóng, ‘Chit-ê sī i ê kè-sêng-jîn. Lâi, lán lâi kā thâi--sí, thang tit i ê châi-sán!’
In chiū kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, hiat chhut-khì phû-tô-hn̂g ê gōa-bīn, kā i thâi--sí.
“Án-ni, phû-tô-hn̂g ê chú-lâng tò--lâi ê sî ōe án-chóaⁿ chhú-lí hiah-ê tiān-lông?”
In kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “I it-tēng ōe chiong hiah-ê pháiⁿ-lâng thiat-tóe siau-bia̍t, chiong phû-tô-hn̂g cho͘ hō͘ pa̍t-ê ōe chiàu kùi-chiat la̍p ké-chí-cho͘ ê tiān-lông.”

Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín kiám m̄-bat tha̍k-tio̍h Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Khí-chhù sai-hū só͘ khì-sak ê chio̍h, í-keng chiâⁿ-chòe siōng tiōng-iàu ê ki-chio̍h. Che sī Chú ê chok-ûi, tùi lán lâi khòaⁿ si̍t-chāi chin kî-biāu!
“Só͘-í, góa kā lín kóng, Siōng-tè ōe chiong Siōng-tè-kok tùi lín chhiúⁿ--khí-lâi, kau hō͘ ōe kiat ké-chí ê lâng.
Hit-ê siak lo̍h-khì chit-tè chio̍h-thâu téng ê lâng, ōe siak kah chhùi-kut-hun-si; hō͘ hit-tè chio̍h-thâu teh--tio̍h ê lâng, ōe teh kah chhùi-kô͘-kô͘. ”
Chiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê phì-jū, chai-iáⁿ I sī teh kóng in.
In chiū chhē khang-phāng beh kā I lia̍h, m̄-kú kiaⁿ kûn-chiòng, in-ūi in khòaⁿ I sī sian-ti.
Iâ-so͘ koh ēng phì-jū kā in kóng:
“Thian-kok thang phì-jū chòe chi̍t ê kok-ông kā i ê kiáⁿ pān hun-iàn.
I chhe po̍k-jîn khì kiò só͘ chhiáⁿ ê lâng-kheh lâi hù hun-iàn, put-kò in m̄ lâi.

Kok-ông koh chhe kî-tha ê po̍k-jîn, kā in kóng, ‘Lín khì kā hiah-ê siū iau-chhiáⁿ ê lâng kóng, góa ê iàn-se̍k í-keng chún-pī hó-sè; góa ê gû kap pûi ê gû-á-kiáⁿ mā í-keng thâi, it-chhè lóng chún-pī hó-sè lah, chhiáⁿ lín lâi hù hun-iàn.’
M̄-kú hiah-ê siū iau-chhiáⁿ ê lâng bô khòaⁿ-chòe iàu-kín, chòe in khì; chi̍t ê khì hn̂g--ni̍h chòe kang; chi̍t ê khì chòe seng-lí;
kî-tha--ê lia̍h i ê po̍k-jîn, kā in lêng-jio̍k, sòa kā in thâi-sí.
Kok-ông hui-siông siū-khì, chiū phài peng khì châu-bia̍t hiah-ê hiong-siú, pàng-hé sio in ê siâⁿ.
Jiân-āu i kā po̍k-jîn kóng, ‘Hun-iàn chún-pī hó lah, m̄-kú só͘ iau-chhiáⁿ--ê lóng put-phòe hō͘ lán chhiáⁿ.
Só͘-í, lín khì koe-lō͘-kháu, tú--tio̍h ê lâng lóng kā in chhiáⁿ-lâi hù hun-iàn.’
Hiah-ê po̍k-jîn chiū chhut-khì koe--ni̍h, tú--tio̍h-ê bô-lūn hó-lâng pháiⁿ-lâng lóng kā in chhiáⁿ--lâi; hun-iàn ê só͘-chāi lâng-kheh chiū chē kàu móa-móa.
“Kok-ông ji̍p--lâi khòaⁿ hiah-ê lâng-kheh, khòaⁿ-tio̍h tī hia ū chi̍t ê lâng bô chhēng hun-iàn ê lé-ho̍k,
chiū kā i mn̄g, ‘Pêng-iú ah, lí ji̍p-lâi chia ná bô chhēng hun-iàn ê lé-ho̍k?’ Hit-ê lâng lóng bô ìn.
Kok-ông chiū tùi chhe-ēng--ê kóng, ‘Kha-chhiú kā pa̍k--khí-lâi, kā i hiat chhut-khì gōa-bīn o͘-àm ê só͘-chāi. Tī hia, i ōe thî-khàu, kā-gê-chhiat-chhí.’
“Siū ho͘-tiàu--ê chin chōe, m̄-kú siū kéng-soán--ê chin chió.”
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chhut--khì, chòe-hé chham-siông beh án-chóaⁿ lia̍h Iâ-so͘ ê ōe-phāng thang kā I hām-hāi.

In chhe ka-kī ê bûn-tô͘ kap Hi-lu̍t-tóng ê lâng khì Iâ-so͘ hia, tùi I kóng, “Lāu-su, goán chai lí chin sêng-si̍t, chiàu-si̍t chiong Siōng-tè ê tō-lí kà-sī lâng, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h khoán lâng, lí tùi-thāi in lóng bô chha-pia̍t.
La̍p-sè hō͘ Lô-má hông-tè Khái-sat ū ha̍h Lu̍t-hoat bô? Chhiáⁿ kā goán kóng lí ê siūⁿ-hoat siáⁿ-khoán.”
Iâ-so͘ chai-iáⁿ in ê ok-ì, chiū tùi in kóng, “Ké-hó ê lâng, sī-án-chóaⁿ beh kā góa chhì-thàm?
The̍h chi̍t ê la̍p-sè ê gûn-pè hō͘ góa khòaⁿ.” In chiū the̍h chi̍t ê gûn-pè hō͘ I.
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g in, “Che sī sím-mi̍h-lâng ê siōng, sím-mi̍h-lâng ê jī-hō?”
In kóng, “Khái-sat ê.” Iâ-so͘ chiū kā in kóng, “Án-ni, Khái-sat ê mi̍h hō͘ Khái-sat; Siōng-tè ê mi̍h hō͘ Siōng-tè.”
In thiaⁿ-liáu chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, chiū lī-khui.
Siâng hit-ji̍t, chi̍t-kóa chú-tiuⁿ bô koh-oa̍h ê Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, mn̄g I kóng,
“Lāu-su, Mô͘-se kóng, ‘Ū lâng bô siⁿ-kiáⁿ chiū sí--khì, sió-tī tio̍h chhōa hiaⁿ-só thòe hiaⁿ-ko thoân-chong-chiap-tāi.’
Í-chêng goán chia bat ū chhit ê hiaⁿ-tī; siōng-tōa--ê kiat-hun, bô lâu hō͘-tāi chiū sí--khì, pàng bó͘ hō͘ sió-tī.
Tē-jī--ê, tē-saⁿ--ê, kàu tē-chhit--ê lóng siâng-khoán.
In lóng sí liáu-āu, hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng mā sí--khì.
Án-ni, koh-oa̍h ê sî, chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng sī chit chhit ê lâng tiong-kan tó chi̍t ê ê bó͘? In-ūi in lóng bat chhōa i.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lín m̄-tio̍h. Lín m̄ bat Sèng-keng, mā m̄ bat Siōng-tè ê koân-lêng.
In-ūi koh-oa̍h ê sî, in kap thiⁿ-téng ê thiⁿ-sài siâng-khoán, bô kè bô chhōa.
Koan-hē sí-lâng koh-oa̍h ê sū, lín kiám bô tha̍k-tio̍h Siōng-tè tùi lín kóng ê ōe:
‘Góa chiū-sī A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, Í-sat ê Siōng-tè, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè’? I m̄-sī sí-lâng ê Siōng-tè, sī oa̍h-lâng ê Siōng-tè.”
Kûn-chiòng chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ--tio̍h, tùi I ê kà-sī kám-kak chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ hō͘ Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng bô ōe thang ìn, chiū chū-chi̍p chòe-hé.
Kî-tiong ū chi̍t ê lu̍t-hoat-kàu-su lâi mn̄g chi̍t ê būn-tôe, beh kā I chhì-thàm, kóng,
“Lāu-su, Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat tó chi̍t tiâu sī siōng-tōa ê kài-bēng?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lí tio̍h choân-sim, choân-chêng, choân-ì thiàⁿ Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè.
Che sī siōng-tōa koh tē-it ê kài-bēng.
Tē-jī ê mā siâng-khoán: Tio̍h thiàⁿ chhù-piⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī.
Choân-pō͘ Lu̍t-hoat kap sian-ti ê kà-sī lóng ēng chit nn̄g tiâu chòe kun-kù.”
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chū-chi̍p ê sî, Iâ-so͘ mn̄g in,
“Koan-hē Ki-tok, I sī sím-mi̍h-lâng ê hō͘-tāi, lín siūⁿ án-chóaⁿ?” In kóng, “I sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi.”
Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Nā-sī án-ni, sī-án-chóaⁿ Tāi-pi̍t siū Sèng Sîn kám-tōng ê sî chheng Ki-tok chòe Chú, kóng:
Chú kā góa ê Chú kóng: Lí chē góa ê chiàⁿ-pêng, kàu góa hō͘ lí ê tùi-te̍k khut-ho̍k tī lí kha-ē.
Kì-jiân Tāi-pi̍t chheng-ho͘ Ki-tok chòe ‘Chú’, Ki-tok ná ōe sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi?”
Bô lâng ōe-tàng hôe-tap pòaⁿ-kù. Tùi hit-ji̍t khí, bô lâng káⁿ koh kā I mn̄g sím-mi̍h būn-tôe.
Āu-lâi, Iâ-so͘ tùi kûn-chiòng kap I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng,
“Keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chē Mô͘-se ê ūi kóe-seh Lu̍t-hoat.
Só͘-í, in só͘ kā lín kóng--ê, lín lóng tio̍h chòe, tio̍h chun-siú; put-kò m̄-thang o̍h in ê hêng-ûi, in-ūi in ōe-kóng bōe-chòe.
In chiong lâng taⁿ bô hoat ê tāng-tàⁿ khún hō͘ lâng taⁿ, ka-kī liân chi̍t ki chńg-thâu-á to m̄-khéng tín-tāng.
In só͘-ū ê hêng-ûi lóng sī beh chòe hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ, in-ūi in chiong ka-kī ê keng-bûn-tē chòe khah khoah, saⁿ-á-ku ê chhiu chòe khah tn̂g.
In ài tī iàn-hōe chē tōa-ūi, tī hōe-tn̂g chē koân-ūi,
tī chhī-tiûⁿ-kháu hō͘ lâng chhéng-an, hō͘ lâng chheng-ho͘ ‘lia̍p-pí’.
M̄-kú lín m̄-thang hō͘ lâng chheng-chòe ‘lia̍p-pí’, in-ūi lín chí-ū chi̍t ūi ‘Lāu-su’, lín lóng sī hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē.
Tī tōe-chiūⁿ, lín m̄-thang chheng-ho͘ lâng chòe ‘lāu-pē’, in-ūi lín chí-ū chi̍t ūi ‘Lāu-pē’, chiū-sī tī thiⁿ-téng Hit-ūi.
Lín mā m̄-thang hō͘ lâng chheng-chòe ‘kàu-su’, in-ūi lín chí-ū chi̍t ūi ‘Kàu-su’, chiū-sī Ki-tok.
Lín tiong-kan siōng-tōa--ê tio̍h chòe lín ê chhe-ēng.
Thê-ko ka-kī--ê, ōe siū kàng-kē; khut-kē ka-kī--ê, ōe siū ko-seng.”

“Ké-hó ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-lâng, lín chhám ah! Lín chiong Thian-kok ê mn̂g koaiⁿ--khí-lâi, m̄ hō͘ lâng ji̍p--khì; lín ka-kī m̄ ji̍p--khì, liân beh ji̍p--khì ê lâng mā m̄ hō͘ in ji̍p--khì.

“Ké-hó ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-lâng, lín chhám ah! Lín ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ chi̍t ê lâng kái-chong ji̍p-kàu, thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak kiâⁿ-thàu-thàu. Hit-ê lâng ji̍p-kàu liáu-āu, lín soah hō͘ i pìⁿ-chòe tōe-ge̍k ê kiáⁿ, pí lín têng-pē pháiⁿ.
“Chhiⁿ-mî chòe chhōa-lō͘--ê, lín chhám ah! Lín kóng, ‘Lâng kí Sèng-tiān chiù-chōa bô chún-sǹg, m̄-kú nā kí tiān-lāi ê kim-khì chiù-chōa chiū tio̍h siú.’
Lín chiah-ê tòng-gōng koh chhiⁿ-mî ê lâng ah, tó chi̍t hāng khah tiōng-iàu? Sī kim-khì á-sī hō͘ kim-khì chiâⁿ-chòe sîn-sèng ê Sèng-tiān?
Lín koh kóng, ‘Lâng kí chè-tôaⁿ chiù-chōa bô chún-sǹg, nā kí chè-tôaⁿ téng ê chè-mi̍h chiù-chōa chiū tio̍h siú.’
Lín chiah-ê chhiⁿ-mî ê lâng ah, sī chè-mi̍h á-sī hō͘ chè-mi̍h chiâⁿ-chòe sîn-sèng ê chè-tôaⁿ, tó chi̍t hāng khah tiōng-iàu?
Só͘-í, lâng kí chè-tôaⁿ chiù-chōa, chiū-sī kí chè-tôaⁿ kap hit téng-bīn só͘-ū ê chè-mi̍h chiù-chōa.
Lâng kí Sèng-tiān chiù-chōa, chiū-sī kí Sèng-tiān kap tiàm tī hit lāi-bīn ê Siōng-tè chiù-chōa.
Lâng kí thiⁿ chiù-chōa, chiū-sī kí Siōng-tè ê pó-chō kap chē tī hit téng-bīn ê Siōng-tè chiù-chōa.

“Ké-hó ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-lâng, lín chhám ah! In-ūi lín liân phang-liāu, po̍k-hô, poeh-kak, sió-hôe-hiong to hiàn cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t hō͘ Siōng-tè, Lu̍t-hoat só͘ tiōng-sī ê chèng-gī, jîn-chû, kap sìn-si̍t, lín tian-tò hut-lio̍k. Chiah-ê chiah sī lín eng-kai si̍t-hêng--ê; téng-bīn hiah-ê mā m̄-thang hut-lio̍k.
Lín chiah-ê chhiⁿ-mî chòe chhōa-lō͘--ê, chi̍t chiah sòe chiah báng-thâng lín to kā lū--chhut-lâi, lo̍k-tô tian-tò kui-chiah kā thun--lo̍h-khì.
“Ké-hó ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-lâng, lín chhám ah! In-ūi lín chiong poe kap pôaⁿ ê gōa-bīn sóe chheng-khì, lāi-bīn khiok tóe-móa tham-io̍k kap hòng-chhiòng.
Lín chiah-ê chhiⁿ-mî ê Hoat-lī-sài-lâng ah, tio̍h seng kā poe ê lāi-bīn sóe chheng-khì, gōa-bīn chū-jiân chiū chheng-khì.

“Ké-hó ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-lâng, lín chhám ah! In-ūi lín chhin-chhiūⁿ chhat pe̍h-pe̍h ê bōng, gōa-bīn hó-khòaⁿ, lāi-bīn khiok tóe-móa sí-lâng ê kut-thâu kap ta̍k-hāng ê ù-òe.
Lín mā chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, gōa-bīn hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe gī-lâng, lāi-bīn khiok chhiong-móa ké-hó kap put-hoat.
“Ké-hó ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-lâng, lín chhám ah! In-ūi lín chō sian-ti ê bōng, chéng-siu gī-lâng ê kì-liām-pi,
koh kóng ‘Goán nā oa̍h tī goán chó͘-sian ê sî-tāi, it-tēng bōe kap in chòe-hé sat-hāi sian-ti’.
Án-ni, lín sī teh chèng-si̍t lín ka-kī sī sat-hāi sian-ti ê lâng ê kiáⁿ-sun.
Lín chó͘-sian chòe ê pháiⁿ-tāi, chòe lín khì oân-sêng hó lah!
Lín chiah-ê to̍k-chôa ê kiáⁿ-sun, kan-kúi ê lâng ah, lín kiám ōe-tàng tô-siám tōe-ge̍k ê hêng-hoa̍t?

Só͘-í, góa beh chhe sian-ti, tì-hūi ê lâng, kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su khì lín hia; in ū-ê ōe hō͘ lín sat-hāi á-sī tèng si̍p-jī-kè, ū-ê ōe hō͘ lín tī lín ê hōe-tn̂g piⁿ-phah, hō͘ lín tùi chit-ê siâⁿ kóaⁿ kàu hit-ê siâⁿ.

Án-ni, lín tī tōe-chiūⁿ thâi-sí gī-lâng ê huih-chè lóng kui tī lín sin-chiūⁿ; chiū-sī tùi gī-lâng A-pek lâu ê huih kàu Pí-lī-ka ê kiáⁿ Sat-ka-lī-a tī sèng-só͘ kap chè-tôaⁿ ê tiong-kan lâu ê huih, lóng kui tī lín sin-chiūⁿ.
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, chiah-ê chè lóng ōe kui tī chit sè-tāi ê lâng.”

“ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, lí thâi-sí sian-ti, koh ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm-sí Siōng-tè chhe-lâi lí chia ê sù-chiá. Góa jōa-chōe piàn ài-beh chū-chi̍p lí ê kiáⁿ-jî, chhin-chhiūⁿ koe-bú chū-chi̍p koe-á-kiáⁿ kā in áⁿ tī si̍t-kó͘-ē, lín lóng bô ài!
Lín khòaⁿ, lín ê chhù ōe hong-hòe, bô lâng tòa.
Góa kā lín kóng, tùi taⁿ í-āu lín choa̍t-tùi khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h góa, ti̍t-kàu lín kóng, ‘Hōng Chú ê miâ lâi Hit-ūi eng-kai siū chheng-chàn!’”
Iâ-so͘ tùi Sèng-tiān chhut--lâi, tú-beh lī-khui ê sî, bûn-tô͘ óa--lâi, pò I khòaⁿ Sèng-tiān ê kiàn-tio̍k-bu̍t.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Chiah-ê lín kiám m̄-sī lóng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h? Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, tī chia it-chhè lóng ōe siū thiah-húi, thiah kah bô nn̄g tè chio̍h sio-tha̍h.”

Iâ-so͘ tī Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ téng teh chē ê sî, bûn-tô͘ su-hā lâi mn̄g I, “Chhiáⁿ kā goán kóng, chit-ê tāi-chì sím-mi̍h sî ōe hoat-seng? Lí ê lâi-lîm kap kim-sè ê kiat-kio̍k ū sím-mi̍h tiāu-thâu?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bián siū bê-he̍k.
In-ūi ū chin chōe lâng ōe lī-iōng góa ê miâ lâi, kóng ‘Góa chiū-sī Ki-tok’ lâi bê-he̍k chin chōe lâng.
Lín ōe thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiàn-cheng í-ki̍p chiàn-cheng ê hong-siaⁿ. Tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-bián kiaⁿ. Chiah-ê tāi-chì it-tēng ōe hoat-seng, m̄-kú chiong-kio̍k iáu-bē kàu.
In-ūi bîn-cho̍k ōe khí-lâi kong-kek bîn-cho̍k, kok-ka kong-kek kok-ka; chin chōe só͘-chāi ū ki-hng kap tōe-tāng.
Che it-chhè ê tāi-chì put-kò sī chhui-chūn thàng-thiàⁿ ê khai-sí.
“Hit-sî, lín ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h--khì, siū khó͘-chhó͘, sat-hāi; lín ōe in-ūi góa ê miâ hō͘ bān-bîn oàn-hūn.
Hit-sî, chin chōe lâng ōe sit-khì sìn-sim, hō͘-siōng chhut-bōe, pí-chhú oàn-hūn.
Ū chin chōe ké sian-ti ōe chhut-hiān lâi bê-he̍k chin chōe lâng.
Put-hoat ê tāi-chì ná ke-thiⁿ, chin chōe lâng ê thiàⁿ-sim ōe chiām-chiām léng-tām.
M̄-kú jím-nāi kàu chòe-āu ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h kiù.
Chit-ê Thian-kok ê hok-im ōe thoân kàu phó͘-thiⁿ-ē, tùi bān-bîn chòe kiàn-chèng, chòe-āu chiong-kio̍k chiah ōe kàu.”

“Só͘-í, tng lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè thong-kè sian-ti Tān-í-lí só͘ kóng hit-ê ‘Khó-ò͘ⁿ ê Húi-bia̍t-chiá’ khiā tī sîn-sèng ê só͘-chāi — tha̍k ê lâng tio̍h bêng-pe̍k chit-kù ōe ê ì-sù —
hit-sî tī Iû-thài ê lâng tio̍h tô-cháu khì soaⁿ-lāi;
tī chhù-téng--ê, m̄-thang lo̍h-lâi the̍h chhù-lāi ê mi̍h;
tī hn̂g--ni̍h-ê, m̄-thang tńg-khì hiahⁿ gōa-saⁿ.
Tī hiah-ê ji̍t-chí, ū sin-īn--ê kap hō͘ eⁿ-á chia̍h-lin ê hū-jîn-lâng hui-siông put-hēng!
Tio̍h kî-tó, lín chiah bián tī tang-thiⁿ á-sī An-hioh-ji̍t tô-lān.
In-ūi tī hiah-ê ji̍t-chí teh-beh ū tōa chai-lān, sī chhòng-chō ú-tiū í-lâi m̄-bat ū--ê, chiong-lâi mā bōe koh ū.
Siōng-tè nā bô kiám-chió hiah-ê ji̍t-chí, bô lâng ōe tit-tio̍h kiù; m̄-kú ūi-tio̍h I ê soán-bîn, Siōng-tè ōe kiám-chió hiah-ê ji̍t-chí.
“Hit-sî, nā ū lâng kā lín kóng ‘Lín khòaⁿ, Ki-tok tī chia’, á-sī kóng ‘I tī hia’, m̄-thang siong-sìn.
In-ūi ū chi̍t-kóa ké Ki-tok kap ké sian-ti ōe chhut-hiān, kiâⁿ tōa sîn-jiah kap kî-sū lâi bê-he̍k lâng, nā ōe-tàng, liân soán-bîn to beh kā in bê-he̍k.
Góa í-keng seng kā lín kóng lah.
“Só͘-í, nā ū lâng kā lín kóng ‘Lín khòaⁿ, Ki-tok tī khòng-iá’, m̄-thang chhut--khì; á-sī kóng ‘Lín khòaⁿ, I tī pâng-keng lāi’, mā m̄-thang siong-sìn.
Sih-nà tùi tang-pêng sih kàu sai-pêng, Jîn-chú ê lâi-lîm mā ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni.
“Si-thé tī tó-ūi, thuh-thâu-eng lóng ōe khîⁿ óa-khì hia.”
“Chit-ê chai-lān ê ji̍t-chí chi̍t-ē kè--khì, ji̍t ōe pìⁿ o͘-àm, ge̍h bōe hoat-kng, chhiⁿ ōe tùi thiⁿ-téng lak--lo̍h-lâi, thiⁿ-téng ê kng-thé lóng ōe iô-choah.

Hit-sî, Jîn-chú ê tiāu-thâu ōe tī thiⁿ-téng chhut-hiān. Tōe-chiūⁿ bān-cho̍k bān-bîn lóng ōe thî-khàu; in ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Jîn-chú chhiong-móa koân-lêng kap tōa êng-kng chē thiⁿ-téng ê hûn lâi-lîm.
I ōe chhe I ê thiⁿ-sài pûn hiáng-liāng ê lat-pah, tùi thiⁿ ê chit-pêng kàu thiⁿ ê hit-pêng, tùi sì-hng chū-chi̍p I ê soán-bîn.”
“Tio̍h tùi bû-hoa-kó-chhiū ha̍k-si̍p: Ki puh-íⁿ hoat-hio̍h ê sî, lín chiū chai joa̍h-thiⁿ teh-beh kàu ah.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h che it-chhè ê tāi-chì ê sî chiū chai Jîn-chú í-keng chiap-kūn, kàu mn̂g-kháu lah.
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, chit sè-tāi iáu-bē kè--khì, che it-chhè lóng ōe hoat-seng.
Thiⁿ kap tōe ōe siau-sit, m̄-kú góa ê ōe choa̍t-tùi bōe siau-sit.”
“Koan-hē hit-ê ji̍t, hit-ê sî, bô lâng chai; thiⁿ-téng ê thiⁿ-sài m̄ chai, Kiáⁿ mā m̄ chai, chí-ū Pē chai nā-tiāⁿ.
In-ūi Jîn-chú ê lâi-lîm mā ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ Ná-a ê sî ê chêng-kéng.
Tōa-chúi lâi í-chêng kàu Ná-a chìn-ji̍p tōa-chûn hit-ji̍t, lâng chiàu-siông lim-chia̍h kè-chhōa.
In hô͘-lí-hô͘-tô͘ lóng m̄ chai, tōa-chúi hut-jiân lâi, kā in lóng chhiong-cháu. Jîn-chú ê lâi-lîm mā ōe án-ni.
Hit-sî, ū nn̄g ê lâng tī hn̂g--ni̍h, chi̍t ê siū chiap--khì; chi̍t ê pàng--teh.
Nn̄g ê hū-jîn-lâng tī oe-bō-keng teh oe chio̍h-bō, chi̍t ê siū chiap--khì; chi̍t ê pàng--teh.
“Tio̍h kéng-séng, in-ūi lín m̄ chai lín ê Chú sím-mi̍h ji̍t ōe lâi-lîm.
Lín tio̍h chai, chit-ke ê chú-lâng nā chai àm-sî kúi tiám chha̍t-á ōe lâi, it-tēng ōe kéng-séng, bōe hō͘ chha̍t-á ó͘ piah-khang ji̍p-lâi chhù-lāi.
Só͘-í, lín mā tio̍h chún-pī piān-piān, in-ūi Jîn-chú ōe tī lín siūⁿ bōe kàu ê sî-chūn lâi-lîm.”
“Nā-sī án-ni, sím-mi̍h-lâng sī tiong-si̍t koh chhong-bêng ê po̍k-jîn? Chiū-sī chú-lâng kau-tài i koán ke-lāi kî-tha ê po̍k-jîn, chiàu-sî pun chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ in hit-ê lâng.
Chú-lâng tńg--lâi ê sî khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū chiàu án-ni teh chòe hit-ê po̍k-jîn si̍t-chāi ū hok-khì!
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, chú-lâng ōe phài chit-ê po̍k-jîn koán-lí i lóng-chóng ê châi-sán.
Hit-ê pháiⁿ ê po̍k-jîn nā sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng ‘Góa ê chú-lâng bōe hiah kín tńg--lâi’,
chiū phah pîⁿ-pîⁿ chòe po̍k-jîn--ê, koh kap chiú-chùi--ê chòe-hé ia̍h-lim-ia̍h-chia̍h.
Chú-lâng ōe tī i bô àn-sǹg ê ji̍t, m̄-chai ê sî tńg--lâi.
Chú-lâng ōe giâm-giâm kā i chhú-hoa̍t, kā i kap ké-hó ê lâng hē chòe-tui; tī hia in ōe thî-khàu, kā-gê-chhiat-chhí.”
“Thian-kok thang phì-jū chòe cha̍p ê chāi-sek-lú gia̍h teng chhut-khì gêng-chiap sin-lông.
Kî-tiong ū gō͘ ê gōng--ê, gō͘ ê khiáu--ê.
Hiah-ê gōng--ê gia̍h teng, bô lēng-gōa tòa iû,
m̄-kú khiáu--ê gia̍h teng, ū lēng-gōa tòa kúi-nā koàn iû.
Sin-lông khah òaⁿ kàu, in soah lóng tuh-ku khùn--khì.
“Pòaⁿ-mî, ū lâng tōa-siaⁿ hoah, ‘Sin-lông lâi lah, chhut-lâi gêng-chiap!’
Hit-sî, hiah-ê chāi-sek-lú lóng chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, siu-chéng in ê teng.
Gōng--ê kā khiáu--ê kóng, ‘Goán ê teng teh-beh hoa--khì lah, lín ê iû pun chi̍t-kóa hō͘ goán.’
Khiáu--ê ìn kóng, ‘Kiaⁿ-liáu iû bô-kàu pun lín ēng, siōng-hó lín ka-kī khì kā bōe-iû--ê bóe.’
In khì bóe ê sî sin-lông kàu-ūi, hiah-ê chún-pī hó-sè--ê kap i ji̍p-khì hù hun-iàn, mn̂g chiū koaiⁿ--khí-lâi.
“Āu-lâi hiah-ê gōng ê chāi-sek-lú mā lâi, kóng, ‘Sian-siⁿ, sian-siⁿ, chhiáⁿ kā goán khui-mn̂g!’
Sin-lông ìn kóng, ‘Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, góa m̄ bat lín!’
“Só͘-í, tio̍h kéng-séng, in-ūi hit-ê ji̍t hit-ê sî lín m̄ chai.”
“Thian-kok chhin-chhiūⁿ ū chi̍t ê lâng beh chhut-gōa lú-hêng, kiò ka-kī ê po̍k-jîn lâi, chiong châi-sán kau-tài in.
I chiàu ta̍k-lâng ê châi-tiāu kau kim-pè hō͘ in, chi̍t ê gō͘-chheng, chi̍t ê nn̄g-chheng, chi̍t ê chi̍t-chheng, chiū chhut-gōa--khì.
Hit-ê niá gō͘-chheng--ê sûi-sî the̍h-khì chòe seng-lí, koh thàn gō͘-chheng.
Siâng-khoán, hit-ê niá nn̄g-chheng--ê mā koh thàn nn̄g-chheng.
M̄-kú hit-ê niá chi̍t-chheng--ê chhut--khì, tī thô͘-kha ó͘ chi̍t khang, kā chú-lâng ê kim-pè chhàng--khí-lâi.
“Kè chin kú, hiah-ê po̍k-jîn ê chú-lâng tńg--lâi, kap in sǹg-siàu.
Hit-ê niá gō͘-chheng--ê kiâⁿ chìn-chêng, lēng-gōa the̍h gō͘-chheng lâi, kóng, ‘Thâu-ke, lí kau-tài góa gō͘-chheng ê kim-pè, chhiáⁿ khòaⁿ, góa ū koh thàn gō͘-chheng.’
Chú-lâng kā i kóng, ‘Chin hó, hó koh tiong-si̍t ê po̍k-jîn, lí kì-jiân tī chió--ê ū tiong-si̍t, góa beh phài lí koán khah chōe--ê; ji̍p-lâi kap chú-lâng chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí.’
“Niá nn̄g-chheng--ê mā lâi, kóng, ‘Thâu-ke, lí kau-tài góa nn̄g-chheng ê kim-pè, chhiáⁿ lí khòaⁿ, góa ū koh thàn nn̄g-chheng.’
Chú-lâng kā i kóng, ‘Chin hó, hó koh tiong-si̍t ê po̍k-jîn, lí kì-jiân tī chió--ê ū tiong-si̍t, góa beh phài lí koán khah chōe--ê; ji̍p-lâi kap chú-lâng chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí.’
“Chit-sî, hit-ê niá chi̍t-chheng--ê mā kiâⁿ chìn-chêng, kóng, ‘Thâu-ke, góa chai lí sī giâm-hat ê lâng, bô iā-chéng mā beh siu-koah, bô chèng-choh mā beh siu-sêng.
Góa chin kiaⁿ, chiah chiong lí ê kim-pè the̍h-khì chhàng tī thô͘-kha-tóe. Taⁿ lí ê kim-pè hêng lí.’
“Chú-lâng ìn kóng, ‘Pháiⁿ koh pîn-tōaⁿ ê po̍k-jîn, lí kì-jiân chai góa bô iā-chéng mā beh siu-koah, bô chèng-choh mā beh siu-sêng,
lí eng-kai chiong góa ê kim-pè kià gûn-hâng, góa tńg--lâi ê sî thang liân-pún-tài-lī siu-hôe.’
Kā i ê kim-pè the̍h--lâi, kau hō͘ ū chi̍t-bān kim-pè hit-ê lâng.
In-ūi ū--ê, beh hō͘ i koh-khah chōe, sīm-chì ū chhun; bô--ê, liân i só͘-ū--ê mā beh kā i chhiúⁿ--khí-lâi.
Chit-ê bô lō͘-ēng ê po̍k-jîn, kā i kóaⁿ chhut-khì gōa-bīn o͘-àm ê só͘-chāi; tī hia i ōe thî-khàu, kā-gê-chhiat-chhí.”
“Jîn-chú choh-ông chhōa chèng thiⁿ-sài lâi-lîm ê sî, I ōe chē tī êng-iāu ê pó-chō.
Tōe-chiūⁿ bān-bîn lóng ōe chū-chi̍p tī I ê bīn-chêng. I ōe chiong in hun-chòe nn̄g pêng, chhin-chhiūⁿ bo̍k-chiá chiong mî-iûⁿ kap soaⁿ-iûⁿ hun-khui;
kā mî-iûⁿ an-pâi tī chiàⁿ-pêng, soaⁿ-iûⁿ tī tò-pêng.
Āu-lâi, Ông ōe kā chiàⁿ-pêng ê lâng kóng, ‘Lâi, lín chiah-ê siū góa ê Pē chiok-hok--ê, lâi sêng-siū tùi chhòng-chō ú-tiū í-lâi chiū ūi-tio̍h lín chún-pī ê kok-tō͘.
In-ūi góa iau, lín ū hō͘ góa chia̍h; góa chhùi-ta, lín ū hō͘ góa lim; góa choh chhut-gōa-lâng, lín ū kā góa siu-liû;
góa chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, lín ū hō͘ góa chhēng; góa phòa-pīⁿ, lín ū kā góa chiàu-kò͘; góa tī kaⁿ--ni̍h, lín ū lâi thàm góa.’
“Hit-sî, gī-lâng ōe ìn I kóng, ‘Chú ah, sím-mi̍h sî goán khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí iau ū hō͘ lí chia̍h, chhùi-ta ū hō͘ lí lim?
Sím-mi̍h sî goán khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí choh chhut-gōa-lâng ū kā lí siu-liû, chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé ū hō͘ lí chhēng?
Sím-mi̍h sî goán khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí phòa-pīⁿ á-sī tī kaⁿ--ni̍h, goán ū khì thàm lí?’
Ông ōe ìn kóng, ‘Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, lín ū án-ni tùi-thāi góa hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē siōng bî-sòe ê chi̍t ê, chiū-sī hó khoán-thāi góa.’
“Āu-lâi, Ông ōe kā tò-pêng ê lâng kóng, ‘Lín chiah-ê siū chiù-chó͘ ê lâng, lī-khui góa, ji̍p-khì ūi-tio̍h Mô͘-kúi kap i ê sù-chiá só͘ chún-pī éng-oán ê hé--ni̍h.
In-ūi góa iau, lín bô hō͘ góa chia̍h; góa chhùi-ta, lín bô hō͘ góa lim;
góa choh chhut-gōa-lâng, lín bô kā góa siu-liû; góa chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, lín bô hō͘ góa chhēng; góa phòa-pīⁿ á-sī tī kaⁿ--ni̍h, lín bô lâi thàm góa.’
“Hit-sî, in mā ōe ìn kóng, ‘Chú ah, sím-mi̍h sî goán khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí iau, chhùi-ta, choh chhut-gōa-lâng, chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé, phòa-pīⁿ, á-sī tī kaⁿ--ni̍h, bô kā lí chiàu-kò͘?’
Ông ōe kā in kóng, ‘Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, lín bô án-ni tùi-thāi siōng bî-sòe ê chi̍t ê, chiū-sī bô hó khoán-thāi góa.’
Chiah-ê lâng ōe siū éng-oán ê hêng-hoa̍t, chóng-sī gī-lâng ōe tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu kā I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng,
“Lín chai koh nn̄g ji̍t chiū-sī Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, Jîn-chú ōe siū chhut-bōe hō͘ lâng tèng si̍p-jī-kè.”
Hit-sî, chè-si-tiúⁿ kap bîn-kan ê tiúⁿ-ló chū-chi̍p tī tōa-chè-si Kai-a-hoat ê kong-koán.
In chham-siông beh ēng kè-bô͘ lia̍h Iâ-so͘, kā I hāi-sí.
M̄-kú in kóng, “M̄-thang tī choeh-kî tiong, kiaⁿ-liáu bîn-chiòng khí pō-tōng.”

Iâ-so͘ tī Pek-tāi-nî bâ-hong pīⁿ-lâng Se-bûn ê chhù teh chē-toh chia̍h-pn̄g ê sî, ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng the̍h chi̍t koàn ge̍k-pân, lāi-bīn tóe hui-siông ko-kùi ê phang-iû, kiâⁿ óa--lâi, chiong phang-iû tò tī Iâ-so͘ ê thâu-khak téng.
Bûn-tô͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h chin siū-khì, kóng, “Ná tio̍h chiah lōng-hùi?
Chit-koàn phang-iû ōe-tàng bōe chin chōe chîⁿ lâi kiù-chè sàn-chhiah-lâng.”
Iâ-so͘ chai-iáⁿ, chiū tùi in kóng, “Lín ná beh tiau-lân chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng? I ū ūi-tio̍h góa chòe chi̍t hāng hó-sū.
Put-sî ū sàn-chhiah-lâng kap lín chòe-hé, put-kò góa bōe put-sî kap lín chòe-hé.
I tò phang-iû tī góa ê seng-khu sī kā góa chún-pī bâi-chòng.
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, chit-ê hok-im bô-lūn thoân kàu choân sè-kài sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, lâng lóng ōe kóng-khí chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì lâi kì-liām i.”
Cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ ê chi̍t ê, kiò-chòe Í-su-ka-lio̍k ê Iû-tāi, khì kìⁿ hiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ,
kóng, “Góa nā chiong Iâ-so͘ kau hō͘ lín, lín beh hō͘ góa sím-mi̍h?” In chiū the̍h saⁿ-cha̍p ê gûn-á hō͘ i.
Tùi hit-sî khí, Iû-tāi it-ti̍t teh chhē ki-hōe beh chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘.
Tû-kàⁿ-choeh ê thâu chi̍t ji̍t, bûn-tô͘ lâi mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Lí ài goán tī tó-ūi kā lí chún-pī chia̍h Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê boán-chhan?”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lín ji̍p-siâⁿ khì chhē hit-ê bó͘-lâng, kā i kóng, ‘Lāu-su kóng: Góa ê sî í-keng kàu, góa beh kap góa ê bûn-tô͘ tī lí ê chhù siú Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh.’”
Bûn-tô͘ chiū chiàu Iâ-so͘ ê hoan-hù khì chún-pī Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê boán-chhan.
Hông-hun ê sî, Iâ-so͘ kap cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ chē-toh.
In teh chia̍h-pn̄g ê sî, Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, lín tiong-kan ū chi̍t ê lâng beh kā góa chhut-bōe.”
In chin siong-sim, chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê kā I mn̄g, “Chú ah, m̄-sī góa ho͘hⁿ?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Chhun-chhiú kap góa siâng-sî the̍h chia̍h-mi̍h tī pôaⁿ--ni̍h teh ùn hit-ê lâng beh kā góa chhut-bōe.
Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài, Jîn-chú ōe siū hāi, put-kò chhut-bōe Jîn-chú hit-ê lâng chhám ah! Hit-ê lâng lêng-khó bô chhut-sì khah hó.”
Chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘ ê Iû-tāi mā kā I mn̄g, “Lia̍p-pí, m̄-sī góa ho͘hⁿ?” Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Che sī lí kóng--ê.”
In teh chia̍h ê sî, Iâ-so͘ the̍h piáⁿ, kám-siā liáu-āu peh-khui, pun hō͘ bûn-tô͘, kóng, “The̍h-khì chia̍h; che sī góa ê seng-khu.”
Jiân-āu I phâng-poe, kám-siā liáu-āu the̍h hō͘ bûn-tô͘, kóng, “Lín lóng tio̍h lim chit-poe,
in-ūi che sī góa ê huih, sī li̍p-iok ê huih, ūi-tio̍h chin chōe lâng lâu-chhut--ê, beh hō͘ in ê chōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Góa kā lín kóng, tī góa ê Pē ê Kok kap lín lim sin ê phû-tô-chiú hit-ji̍t í-chêng, góa choa̍t-tùi bōe koh lim chit-ê chiú.”
In gîm-si liáu-āu chiū chhut--khì, khì Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Kim-mî lín lóng ōe pàng-sak góa, in-ūi Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Góa beh phah bo̍k-chiá, kui-kûn iûⁿ chiū sì-sòaⁿ.
M̄-kú góa koh-oa̍h í-āu ōe pí lín seng khì Ka-lī-lī.”
Pí-tek tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Sui-jiân in tāi-ke lóng pàng-sak lí, góa choa̍t-tùi bōe pàng-sak lí!”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lí kóng, kim-mî koe thî í-chêng, lí ōe saⁿ piàn m̄ jīn góa.”
Pí-tek ìn kóng, “Nā it-tēng tio̍h kap lí chòe-hé sí, góa mā choa̍t-tùi bōe m̄ jīn lí!” Kî-tha ê bûn-tô͘ mā lóng án-ni kóng.
Āu-lâi, Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ lâi kàu chi̍t ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Khek-se-má-nî. I kā bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Góa khì hia kî-tó, lín tiàm chia chē.”
I chiū chhōa Pí-tek kap Se-pì-thài ê nn̄g ê kiáⁿ chòe-hé khì. I pi-siong, hui-siông thòng-khó͘,
tùi in kóng, “Góa sim iu-siong kàu beh sí. Lín tiàm chia, kap góa chòe-hé kéng-séng.”

I kiâⁿ khah chìn-chêng, bīn phak--lo̍h-khì, kî-tó kóng, “Góa ê Pē ah, nā ōe-tàng, kiû lí hō͘ góa bián lim chit-ê poe, m̄-kú m̄-sī chiàu góa ê ì-sù, tio̍h chiàu lí ê chí-ì si̍t-hiān.”
I tńg-lâi bûn-tô͘ hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in teh khùn, chiū tùi Pí-tek kóng, “Lín chin-chiàⁿ bōe-tàng kap góa kéng-séng chi̍t tiám-cheng kú sī--bô?
Tio̍h kéng-séng, tio̍h kî-tó, chiah bōe hām-lo̍h iú-he̍k. Lín sui-jiân sim chin ì-ài, m̄-kú jio̍k-thé loán-jio̍k.”
Iâ-so͘ tē-jī piàn koh khì kî-tó, kóng, “Góa ê Pē ah, chit-ê poe nā bōe-tàng bián, góa it-tēng tio̍h lim, goān lí ê chí-ì si̍t-hiān.”
I koh tńg--lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in in-ūi ba̍k-chiu siap iáu-teh khùn.
Iâ-so͘ koh lī-khui in, tē-saⁿ piàn khì kî-tó, mā-sī kóng siâng-khoán ê ōe.

Jiân-āu I koh tńg-lâi bûn-tô͘ hia, tùi in kóng, “Lín iáu-teh khùn, iáu-teh hioh-khùn o͘h? Lín khòaⁿ, sî-kan chiap-kūn lah; Jîn-chú siū chhut-bōe kau tī chōe-jîn ê chhiú-thâu lah.
Khí--lâi, lán lâi-khì. Lín khòaⁿ, chhut-bōe góa ê lâng lâi lah.”
Iâ-so͘ iáu-teh kóng ê sî, cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ ê chi̍t ê — Iû-tāi lâi, chè-si-tiúⁿ kap bîn-kan ê tiúⁿ-ló phài--lâi ê chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng gia̍h to gia̍h kùn kap i tàu-tīn lâi.
Chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘ hit-ê lâng ū hō͘ in chi̍t ê àm-hō, kóng, “Góa kā I chim hit-ê chiū-sī; lín kā lia̍h.”
Iû-tāi sûi-sî kiâⁿ-óa Iâ-so͘, tùi I kóng, “Lia̍p-pí, pêng-an!” chiū kā I chim.
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Pêng-iú, lí ná tī chia?” Hiah-ê lâng chiū óa--khì, hē-chhiú lia̍h Iâ-so͘.
Hut-jiân, ū chi̍t ê kap Iâ-so͘ tàu-tīn ê lâng chhun-chhiú pu̍ih to tùi tōa-chè-si ê po̍k-jîn phut--lo̍h-khì, kā i chi̍t pêng ê hī-á siah--khí-lâi.
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “To siu--khí-lâi, in-ūi gia̍h-to--ê lóng ōe sí tī to-ē.
Lí siūⁿ-kóng góa bōe-tàng khún-kiû góa ê Pē sûi-sî chhe cha̍p-jī iâⁿ khah ke ê thiⁿ-sài lâi sī--bô?
Góa nā án-ni chòe, Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài it-tēng tio̍h hoat-seng ê tāi-chì ná ōe èng-giām?”

Hit-sî Iâ-so͘ tùi kûn-chiòng kóng, “Lín gia̍h to gia̍h kùn chhut-lâi lia̍h góa, sī beh lia̍h kiông-tō sī--bô? Góa ta̍k-ji̍t tī Sèng-tiān chē-teh kà-sī lâng, lín bô kā góa lia̍h.
Put-kò che it-chhè ê tāi-chì lóng í-keng si̍t-hiān, sī beh èng-giām sian-ti tī Sèng-keng só͘ kóng ê ōe.” Jiân-āu, só͘-ū ê bûn-tô͘ lóng pàng-sak Iâ-so͘ tô-cháu.
Hiah-ê lia̍h Iâ-so͘ ê lâng kā I chhōa-khì tōa-chè-si Kai-a-hoat hia; keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap tiúⁿ-ló lóng í-keng chū-chi̍p tī hia.
Pí-tek lī hn̄g-hn̄g teh tè Iâ-so͘, tè kàu tōa-chè-si kong-koán ê tiâⁿ. I ji̍p-khì lāi-bīn kap kéng-ōe chòe-hé chē, beh khòaⁿ tāi-chì ê kiat-kio̍k.
Chè-si-tiúⁿ kap choân gī-hōe it-ti̍t teh chhē ké chèng-kù beh kò Iâ-so͘, thang kā I chhú-sí.
Sui-jiân ū chin chōe lâng chhut-lâi kā I bû-kò, m̄-kú in lóng chhē bô chèng-kù. Āu-lâi ū nn̄g ê lâng chhut--lâi,
kóng, “Chit-ê lâng bat kóng ‘Góa ū hoat-tō͘ húi-hoāi Siōng-tè ê Sèng-tiān, saⁿ ji̍t lāi koh kā i khí--khí-lâi’.”
Tōa-chè-si khiā khí-lâi tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Chiah-ê lâng teh kā lí kò sím-mi̍h, lí ná lóng bô tap-piān?”
M̄-kú Iâ-so͘ lóng tiām-tiām. Tōa-chè-si koh chi̍t piàn tùi I kóng, “Góa kí éng-oán-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè bēng-lēng lí kā goán kóng, lí sī Ki-tok, Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ á m̄-sī.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lí í-keng kóng lah. M̄-kú góa kā lín kóng, tùi taⁿ í-āu lín ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Jîn-chú chē tī Choân-lêng-chiá ê chiàⁿ-pêng, chē thiⁿ-téng ê hûn lâi-lîm.”
Tōa-chè-si chiū thiah-li̍h ka-kī ê gōa-saⁿ, kóng, “I í-keng siat-to̍k Siōng-tè. Lán iáu su-iàu sím-mi̍h chèng-jîn? Taⁿ lín í-keng ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h I siat-to̍k Siōng-tè.
Lín siūⁿ án-chóaⁿ?” In ìn kóng, “I kai sí!”
Āu-lâi in phùi-nōa tī Iâ-so͘ ê bīn, kā I cheng, koh ū lâng kā I siàn,
kóng, “Ki-tok ah, lí sī sian-ti, kā goán kóng khòaⁿ-bāi, siáⁿ-lâng kā lí phah?”
Pí-tek tī kong-koán gōa-bīn ê tiâⁿ teh chē, ū chi̍t ê lú-pī kiâⁿ óa--khì, kóng, “Lí mā lóng ū teh kap hit-ê Ka-lī-lī -lâng Iâ-so͘ chòe-hé.”
Pí-tek tī chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng m̄ jīn, kóng, “Góa m̄ chai lí teh kóng sím-mi̍h.”

Pí-tek kiâⁿ chhut-khì kàu tōa mn̂g-kháu ê sî, ū lēng-gōa chi̍t ê lú-pī khòaⁿ-tio̍h i, chiū kā tī hia ê lâng kóng, “Chit-ê lâng ū teh kap Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘ chòe-hé.”
Pí-tek koh chi̍t piàn chiù-chōa m̄ jīn, kóng, “Góa m̄ bat hit-ê lâng.”
Kè bô jōa kú, khiā tī piⁿ--á ê lâng óa--lâi, tùi Pí-tek kóng, “Lí khak-si̍t mā-sī in hit-tīn ê lâng, thiaⁿ lí ê khiuⁿ chiū chai.”
I chiū chiù-chōa kóng, “Góa m̄ bat hit-ê lâng. Góa nā kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, goān Thiⁿ chek-hoa̍t góa!” Koe sûi-sî thî.
Pí-tek siūⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ só͘ kóng ê ōe “Koe thî í-chêng, lí ōe saⁿ piàn m̄ jīn góa”, chiū chhut-khì gōa-bīn tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu.
Thàu-chá, só͘-ū ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap bîn-kan ê tiúⁿ-ló tàu-tīn chham-siông beh hām-hāi Iâ-so͘, kā I chhú sí-hêng.
In kā Iâ-so͘ pa̍k--khí-lâi, ah-khì kau hō͘ Lô-má chóng-tok Pí-lia̍p-to.
