Chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘ ê Iû-tāi khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ í-keng siū tēng-chōe, chiū hō͘-hóe, the̍h hit saⁿ-cha̍p ê gûn-á khì hêng hō͘ hiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap tiúⁿ-ló,
kóng, “Chhut-bōe bû-ko͘ ê lâng, góa ū chōe lah!” In ìn kóng, “Bô goán ê tāi-chì, lí ka-kī hū-chek!”
Iû-tāi chiong hiah-ê gûn-á hiat tī Sèng-tiān ê lāi-bīn chiū lī-khui, khì tiàu--sí.
Hiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ chiong gûn-á khioh--khí-lâi, kóng, “Che sī huih-chîⁿ, bô eng-kai khǹg-ji̍p Sèng-tiān ê kim-khò͘.”
In chham-siông liáu, koat-tēng ēng chiah-ê chîⁿ khì bóe sio-hûi-lâng ê hn̂g, thang bâi-chòng chhut-gōa-lâng.
Só͘-í hit-ê hn̂g kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu kiò-chòe Huih-hn̂g.
Chit-ê tāi-chì èng-giām Siōng-tè thong-kè sian-ti Iâ-lī-bí só͘ kóng ê ōe: “In the̍h hit saⁿ-cha̍p ê gûn-á, chiū-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ūi-tio̍h i kó͘-kè ê kè-chîⁿ,
chiàu Chú só͘ bēng-lēng góa--ê, khì bóe hit-khu sio-hûi-lâng ê hn̂g.”
Iâ-so͘ khiā tī chóng-tok ê bīn-chêng, chóng-tok mn̄g I kóng, “Lí sī Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông sī--bô?” Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Che sī lí kóng--ê.”
Hiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap tiúⁿ-ló khòng-kò Iâ-so͘ ê sî, I lóng bô ìn.
Āu-lâi Pí-lia̍p-to tùi I kóng, “In kā lí khòng-kò chiah chōe hāng tāi-chì, lí kiám bô thiaⁿ--kìⁿ?”
Iâ-so͘ iû-goân bô kā i ìn, liân chi̍t kù mā bô, chóng-tok soah kám-kak hui-siông kî-koài.
Ta̍k-nî ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, chiàu koàn-lē chóng-tok lóng ū pàng chi̍t ê kûn-chiòng ài pàng ê hoān-lâng.
Hit-sî tú-hó ū chi̍t ê tāi-ke lóng bat ê hoān-lâng, miâ kiò-chòe Iâ-so͘ Pa-lia̍p-pa.
Só͘-í, kûn-chiòng chū-chi̍p ê sî, Pí-lia̍p-to mn̄g in kóng, “Lín ài góa pàng tó chi̍t ê hō͘ lín? Iâ-so͘ Pa-lia̍p-pa, á-sī chheng-chòe Ki-tok ê Iâ-so͘?”
Pí-lia̍p-to chai in sī in-ūi oàn-tò͘ chiah chiong Iâ-so͘ kau hō͘ i.

Pí-lia̍p-to khui-têng sím-mn̄g ê sî, i ê hu-jîn chhe lâng lâi kā i kóng, “Hit-ê gī-lâng ê tāi-chì, lí chhian-bān m̄-thang chhap; chā-àm góa tī bîn-bāng tiong in-ūi I siū chin chōe khó͘.”
Hiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap tiúⁿ-ló siàn-tōng bîn-chiòng, kah in tio̍h iau-kiû pàng Pa-lia̍p-pa, kā Iâ-so͘ chhú sí-hêng.
Chóng-tok koh mn̄g in, “Chit nn̄g ê lâng lín ài góa pàng tó chi̍t ê hō͘ lín?” In ìn, “ Pa-lia̍p-pa!”
Pí-lia̍p-to mn̄g in, “Án-ni, hit-ê chheng-chòe Ki-tok ê Iâ-so͘, lín ài góa án-chóaⁿ chhú-lí?” Kûn-chiòng lóng ìn, “Kā tèng si̍p-jī-kè!”
Pí-lia̍p-to kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ? I ū chòe sím-mi̍h pháiⁿ tāi-chì?” In koh-khah tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Kā tèng si̍p-jī-kè!”
Pí-lia̍p-to khòaⁿ í-keng bô-chhái-kang, kiông-beh ín-khí pō-tōng, chiū the̍h chúi tī kûn-chiòng bīn-chêng sóe-chhiú, kóng, “Lín ka-kī hū-chek. ”
Bîn-chiòng lóng ìn kóng, “Chit-ê lâng ê huih-chè, goán kap goán ê kiáⁿ-sun lâi sêng-tam.”
Pí-lia̍p-to chiū pàng Pa-lia̍p-pa hō͘ in, koh bēng-lēng lâng ēng piⁿ phah Iâ-so͘, jiân-āu kau I khì tèng si̍p-jī-kè.
Chóng-tok ê peng-sū ah Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì chóng-tok-hú, tiàu-chi̍p choân-tūi ê peng kā I ûi--khí-lâi.
In chiong Iâ-so͘ ê saⁿ thǹg--khí-lâi, kā I chhēng chu-âng-sek ê tn̂g-phàu,

koh ēng chhì-á pīⁿ chi̍t téng ông-koan kā tì tī thâu-khak téng, chiong chi̍t ki lô͘-tek-á hō͘ I gia̍h tī chiàⁿ-chhiú. In koh kūi tī I ê bīn-chêng hì-lāng, kóng, “ Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông bān-sòe!”
In koh kā I phùi chhùi-nōa, gia̍h hit-ki lô͘-tek-á sut I ê thâu-khak.
In kā I hì-lāng liáu-āu, chiong hit-niá tn̂g-phàu kā thǹg--khí-lâi, koh chiong I ka-kī ê saⁿ kā chhēng tò-tńg--khì, jiân-āu kau I khì tèng si̍p-jī-kè.
In chhut--khì ê sî tú-tio̍h chi̍t ê Kó͘-lī-nāi -lâng, miâ kiò-chòe Se-bûn. In kiông-pek i giâ Iâ-so͘ ê si̍p-jī-kè.
In kàu chi̍t ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe Kok-kok-tha, chiū-sī “ Thâu-khak-óaⁿ-niá ”,
chiū ēng chham khó͘-táⁿ ê chiú hō͘ Iâ-so͘ lim; I tam chi̍t-ē, m̄ lim.
Peng-sū tèng Iâ-so͘ tī si̍p-jī-kè liáu-āu thiu-chhiam pun I ê saⁿ,
jiân-āu chē tī hia kò͘-siú.
In tī I ê thâu-khak téng tèng chi̍t ê chōe-chn̄g, siá kóng, “Chit-ê sī Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông Iâ-so͘.”
Ū nn̄g ê kiông-tō kap Iâ-so͘ chòe-hé tèng si̍p-jī-kè, chi̍t ê tī chiàⁿ-pêng, chi̍t ê tī tò-pêng.
Tùi hia keng-kè ê lâng kā I bú-jio̍k, iô-thâu,
kóng, “Lí chit-ê lâng, kóng beh thiah-húi Sèng-tiān saⁿ ji̍t lāi koh khí--khí-lâi, tio̍h kiù lí ka-kī. Lí nā-sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ, tio̍h tùi si̍p-jī-kè lo̍h--lâi!”
Chè-si-tiúⁿ, keng-ha̍k-kàu-su, kap tiúⁿ-ló mā lóng án-ni kā I thí-chhiò, kóng,
“I kiù pa̍t-lâng, bô hoat-tō͘ kiù ka-kī. I sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê Ông, hiān-chāi tio̍h tùi si̍p-jī-kè lo̍h--lâi, lán chiū sìn I.
I sìn-khò Siōng-tè; Siōng-tè nā beh kiù I, hiān-chāi tio̍h kiù I, in-ūi I kóng, ‘Góa sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ.’”
Kap Iâ-so͘ chòe-hé tèng si̍p-jī-kè hit nn̄g ê kiông-tō mā kâng-khoán kā I bú-jio̍k.
Tùi tiong-tàu khí sòa kàu ē-po͘ saⁿ tiám, choân-tōe lóng o͘-àm.
Ē-po͘ saⁿ tiám chó-iū, Iâ-so͘ tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Í-lī, Í-lī, la-má sat-pak-tāi-nî?” Ì-sù sī “Góa ê Siōng-tè, góa ê Siōng-tè, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ pàng-sak góa?”
Ū chi̍t-kóa khiā tī hia ê lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h, kóng, “Chit-ê lâng teh kiò Í-lī-a.”
Kî-tiong ū chi̍t ê lâng sûi-sî cháu-khì the̍h hái-mî, chìm sng-chiú, pa̍k tī lô͘-tek-á bé, tu-khì hō͘ Iâ-so͘ suh.
Kî-tha ê lâng kóng, “Tán--chi̍t-ē! Khòaⁿ Í-lī-a ōe lâi kā I kiù bōe.”
Iâ-so͘ koh tōa-siaⁿ hoah chi̍t siaⁿ, khùi chiū tn̄g.
Hut-jiân, Sèng-tiān lāi ê tiùⁿ-lî tùi téng kàu ē li̍h-chòe nn̄g pêng; tōe tōa tín-tāng, chio̍h-pôaⁿ piak-li̍h;
bōng mā khui; ū chin chōe í-keng sí--khì ê Siōng-tè chú-bîn ê si-thé lóng koh-oa̍h--khí-lâi.
Iâ-so͘ koh-oa̍h í-āu hiah-ê lâng tùi bōng chhut--lâi, ji̍p-khì Sèng-siâⁿ, chhut-hiān hō͘ chin chōe lâng khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Hit-ê kun-koaⁿ kap chòe-hé kò͘-siú Iâ-so͘ ê peng-sū khòaⁿ-tio̍h tōe-tāng kap só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, hui-siông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kóng, “Chit-ê khak-si̍t sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ!”
Tī hia ū chin chōe hū-jîn-lâng tùi hn̄g-hn̄g teh khòaⁿ; in sī tùi Ka-lī-lī tè Iâ-so͘ lâi sū-hāu I--ê,
kî-tiong ū Boa̍t-tāi-lia̍p ê Má-lī-a, Ngá-kok kap Iok-sek ê lāu-bú Má-lī-a, koh ū Se-pì-thài nn̄g ê kiáⁿ ê lāu-bú.
Hông-hun ê sî, ū chi̍t ê A-lī-má-thài ê hó-gia̍h-lâng lâi, i miâ kiò-chòe Iok-sek, mā-sī Iâ-so͘ ê bûn-tô͘.
Chit-ê lâng khì kìⁿ Pí-lia̍p-to, chhéng-kiû chiong Iâ-so͘ ê ûi-thé hō͘ i. Pí-lia̍p-to chiū hoan-hù lâng chiong ûi-thé hō͘ i.
Iok-sek kā Iâ-so͘ ê ûi-thé siu--lo̍h-lâi í-āu, ēng chheng-khì ê iù-môa-pò͘ pau--khí-lâi,
jiân-āu kā I an-chòng tī ka-kī ê sin bōng, chiū-sī Iok-sek phah tī chio̍h-piah--ni̍h ê bōng. I koh kō chi̍t tè tōa tè chio̍h lâi that tī bōng-kháu chiah lī-khui.
Hit-sî, ū Boa̍t-tāi-lia̍p ê Má-lī-a kap pa̍t-ê Má-lī-a tī hia, chē tī bōng ê tùi-bīn.
Keh-ji̍t, chiū-sī Pī-pān-ji̍t āu hit-ji̍t, hiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chòe-hé khì kìⁿ Pí-lia̍p-to,
kóng, “Tāi-jîn, goán ōe-kì-tit hit-ê pián-sian-á iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî bat kóng, ‘Saⁿ ji̍t āu, góa ōe koh-oa̍h.’

Só͘-í, chhiáⁿ lí hā-lēng giâm-siú hûn-bōng kàu tē-saⁿ ji̍t, chiah bōe hō͘ I ê bûn-tô͘ lâi thau-the̍h I ê sin-si, soah kā bîn-chiòng kóng ‘I í-keng tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h’. Nā án-ni, chit-ê chòe-āu ê khi-phiàn ōe pí thâu chi̍t piàn ê koh-khah giâm-tiōng.”
Pí-lia̍p-to kā in kóng, “Lín chhōa ōe-peng khì, chīn só͘-ōe giâm-bi̍t kò͘-siú hit-ê bōng.”
In chiū khì, ēng hong-tiâu hong hit-tè chio̍h-thâu, lâu ōe-peng tī hia kò͘-siú.
An-hioh-ji̍t kè-liáu, Lé-pài-ji̍t thiⁿ beh kng ê sî, Boa̍t-tāi-lia̍p ê Má-lī-a kap pa̍t-ê Má-lī-a khì thàm-bōng.
Hut-jiân, ū tōa tōe-tāng, in-ūi Chú ê chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài tùi thiⁿ kàng-lîm, chiong hit-tè chio̍h-thâu kō-khui, chē tī hit téng-bīn.
I ê bīn-māu chhin-chhiūⁿ sih-nà, i ê saⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ seh hiah-ni̍h pe̍h.
Hiah-ê kò͘-siú ê ōe-peng kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, soah pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ sí-lâng.
Hit-ê thiⁿ-sài kā hiah-ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ; góa chai lín teh chhē hō͘ lâng tèng si̍p-jī-kè ê Iâ-so͘.
I bô tī chia, chiàu I só͘ kóng, I í-keng koh-oa̍h. Lâi, lâi khòaⁿ I tó ê só͘-chāi.

Lín kóaⁿ-kín khì kā I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, ‘I í-keng tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h lah. I pí lín seng khì Ka-lī-lī, tī hia lín ōe kìⁿ-tio̍h I.’ Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit góa í-keng ū kā lín kóng lah.”
In chiū kóaⁿ-kín lī-khui bōng, iā kiaⁿ iā tōa hoaⁿ-hí, cháu-khì kā Iâ-so͘ ê bûn-tô͘ kóng.
Hut-jiân, Iâ-so͘ chhut-hiān, tùi in kóng, “Tāi-ke pêng-an!” In kiâⁿ chìn-chêng lám I ê kha, kā I pài.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ! Khì kā góa ê hiaⁿ-tī kóng, kiò in khì Ka-lī-lī, tī hia in ōe kìⁿ-tio̍h góa.”
Hiah-ê hū-jîn-lâng lī-khui ê sî, ū chi̍t-kóa kò͘-siú bōng ê ōe-peng ji̍p-khì siâⁿ-lāi, chiong só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì lóng kā chè-si-tiúⁿ pò-kò.
Chè-si-tiúⁿ kap tiúⁿ-ló chū-chi̍p chham-siông liáu-āu, the̍h chin chōe gûn-á hō͘ hiah-ê peng,
kóng, “Lín tio̍h án-ni kóng, ‘I ê bûn-tô͘ àm-sî lâi, tī goán teh khùn ê sî chiong I ê sin-si thau-the̍h--khì.’
Bān-it chóng-tok thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì, goán ōe khì kā i an-tah, pau lín bô tāi-chì.”
Ōe-peng chiū the̍h hiah-ê gûn-á chiàu in só͘ hoan-hù--ê khì chòe. Chit-ê tāi-chì kàu kin-á-ji̍t iáu tī Iû-thài -lâng ê tiong-kan teh liû-thoân.
Cha̍p-it ê bûn-tô͘ khì Ka-lī-lī, kàu Iâ-so͘ chí-tēng in khì hit-chō soaⁿ-téng.
In kìⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ chiū kā I pài, put-kò ū lâng iáu-teh giâu-gî.
Iâ-so͘ kiâⁿ óa-khì kā in kóng, “Siōng-tè í-keng chiong thiⁿ-téng tōe-ē it-chhè ê koân-pèng lóng hō͘ góa.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h khì chio bān-bîn lâi chòe bûn-tô͘, kā in sóe-lé, hō͘ in kui tī Pē, Kiáⁿ, Sèng Sîn ê miâ,
kà-sī in chun-siú góa só͘ hō͘ lín it-chhè ê bēng-lēng. Tio̍h ōe-kì--tit, góa ta̍k-ji̍t kap lín tông-chāi, ti̍t-kàu kim-sè ê kiat-sok.”
Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê hok-im án-ni khai-sí.
Sian-ti Í-sài-a ê chheh ū kì-chài: Siōng-tè kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, góa chhe góa ê sù-chiá chòe lí ê sian-hong, i beh kā lí khui-lō͘.
Ū siaⁿ tī khòng-iá teh hoah: Tio̍h ūi Chú chún-pī tō-lō͘, ūi-tio̍h I siu-ti̍t sió-lō͘.
Kó-jiân, Iok-hān tī khòng-iá chhut-hiān, kā lâng sóe-lé, soan-iông kóng, “Tio̍h hóe-kái, niá-siū sóe-lé, Siōng-tè chiū sià-bián lín ê chōe.”
Iû-thài ta̍k só͘-chāi ū chin chōe lâng kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘-ū ê lâng lóng chhut--lâi, khì Iok-hān hia, kò-pe̍k ka-kī ê chōe, tī Iok-tàn-hô tùi i niá-siū sóe-lé.
Iok-hān chhēng lo̍k-tô-mn̂g ê saⁿ, io hâ phê-tòa, chia̍h chháu-meh kap iá-bi̍t.
I soan-iông kóng, “Ū chi̍t ūi pí góa khah ū koân-lêng--ê tī góa āu-bīn teh lâi, góa liân khû lo̍h-khì kā I tháu ôe-tòa to bōe-kham--tit.
Góa ēng chúi kā lín sóe-lé, m̄-kú I beh ēng Sèng Sîn kā lín sóe-lé.”
Kè bô kúi ji̍t, Iâ-so͘ tùi Ka-lī-lī ê Ná-sat-le̍k lâi, tī Iok-tàn-hô tùi Iok-hān niá-siū sóe-lé.
Iâ-so͘ chi̍t-ē tùi chúi--ni̍h khí--lâi, chiū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ thiⁿ li̍h--khui, Sèng Sîn chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu kàng-lo̍h tī I sin-chiūⁿ.
Koh tùi thiⁿ ū siaⁿ kóng: Lí sī góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê Kiáⁿ, lí, góa chin ì-ài.
Sèng Sîn sûi-sî chhui-pek Iâ-so͘ khì khòng-iá.
I tī khòng-iá sì-cha̍p ji̍t kú siū Sat-tàn chhì-thàm; I it-ti̍t lóng kap iá-siù chòe-hé, m̄-kú ū thiⁿ-sài teh kā I sū-hāu.
Iok-hān siū lia̍h liáu-āu, Iâ-so͘ khì Ka-lī-lī soan-iông Siōng-tè ê hok-im,
kóng, “Sî-ki kàu ah, Siōng-tè-kok teh-beh si̍t-hiān lah, tio̍h hóe-kái, sìn hok-im.”
Iâ-so͘ tùi Ka-lī-lī ô͘-piⁿ keng-kè ê sî, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Se-bûn kap i ê sió-tī An-tek-lia̍t tī ô͘--ni̍h teh pha-bāng, in-ūi in sī lia̍h-hî--ê.
Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Lâi tè góa, góa beh hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ lia̍h-hî--ê tit-tio̍h hî.”
In sûi-sî kā bāng pàng--leh, khì tè Iâ-so͘.
Kiâⁿ bô jōa hn̄g, Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h Se-pì-thài ê kiáⁿ Ngá-kok kap i ê sió-tī Iok-hān tī chûn-téng teh chéng-lí bāng.
I sûi-sî ho͘-tiàu in, in chiū chiong lāu-pē Se-pì-thài kap chhiàⁿ ê kang-lâng pàng tī chûn-téng, tè Iâ-so͘ khì.
Iâ-so͘ kap I ê bûn-tô͘ khì Ka-pek-lông; An-hioh-ji̍t chi̍t-ē kàu, I sûi-sî ji̍p-khì hōe-tn̂g kà-sī.
Chèng-lâng tùi I ê kà-sī kám-kak hui-siông hi-kî, in-ūi I ê kà-sī chin ū koân-ui, kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su bô sio-siâng.
Hit-sî, hōe-tn̂g lāi ū chi̍t ê siâ-sîn hū-sin ê lâng hiông-hiông hoah--chhut-lâi,
“ Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘, lí mài chhap--goán! Lí lâi beh húi-bia̍t goán sī--bô? Góa chai lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng; lí sī Siōng-tè ê Sèng-chiá.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i chek-pī kóng, “Tiām-tiām! Tùi chit-ê lâng chhut--khì!”
Siâ-sîn hō͘ hit-ê lâng thiu-chhoah, tōa-siaⁿ hoah chi̍t siaⁿ, chiū tùi i chhut--khì.
Chèng-lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ, gī-lūn-hun-hun kóng, “Che sī sím-mi̍h tāi-chì? Sī ū koân-pèng ê sin kà-sī! I bēng-lēng siâ-sîn, in lóng hâng-ho̍k.”
Iâ-so͘ ê miâ-siaⁿ sûi-sî thoân kàu Ka-lī-lī kap chiu-ûi ta̍k só͘-chāi.
Iâ-so͘ chi̍t-ē lī-khui hōe-tn̂g, sûi-sî chhōa Ngá-kok kap Iok-hān khì Se-bûn kap An-tek-lia̍t in tau.
Se-bûn ê tiūⁿ-ḿ tú-teh hoat-jia̍t, tó tī bîn-chhn̂g, in sûi-sî chiong i ê chêng-hêng kā Iâ-so͘ kóng.
Iâ-so͘ kiâⁿ óa-khì khan i ê chhiú, kā i hû--khí-lâi; i ê jia̍t thè--khì, chiū kā in sū-hāu.
Hông-hun, ji̍t lo̍h ê sî, chèng-lâng chiong ta̍k-chióng pīⁿ-lâng kap kúi hū-sin ê lâng lóng chhōa-lâi Iâ-so͘ hia.
Thong-siâⁿ ê lâng lóng chū-chi̍p tī mn̂g-kháu.
Iâ-so͘ i-hó chin chōe hoān-tio̍h ta̍k-khoán pīⁿ ê lâng, koh kóaⁿ-chhut chin chōe kúi. I m̄-chún kúi kóng-ōe, in-ūi in chai I sī sím-mi̍h-lâng.
Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, thiⁿ iáu-bē kng, Iâ-so͘ chiū khí--lâi, chhut-khì phian-phiah bô lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi, tī hia kî-tó.
Se-bûn kap tâng-phōaⁿ khì chhē I.
In chhē--tio̍h chiū kā I kóng, “Ta̍k-ê lóng teh chhē lí.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lán lâi-khì hù-kūn ê chng-siā, góa mā thang tī hia thoân-tō, in-ūi che sī góa chhut--lâi ê bo̍k-te̍k.”
Iâ-so͘ khì Ka-lī-lī ta̍k só͘-chāi, tī in ê hōe-tn̂g thoân-tō koh kóaⁿ-kúi.
Ū chi̍t ê bâ-hong pīⁿ-lâng lâi khún-kiû Iâ-so͘, kūi lo̍h-khì tùi I kóng, “Lí nā khéng, ōe-tàng hō͘ góa chheng-khì.”
Iâ-so͘ móa-sim lîn-bín, chhun-chhiú kā i bong, kóng, “Góa khéng, hō͘ lí chheng-khì!”
I ê bâ-hong sûi-sî bô--khì, i chiū chheng-khì.
Iâ-so͘ sûi-sî kiò i lī-khui, giâm-giâm kā i hoan-hù,

kóng, “Chhian-bān m̄-thang kā lâng kóng. Put-kò lí tio̍h khì hō͘ chè-si giām, koh chiàu Mô͘-se ê kui-tēng ūi-tio̍h lí ū tit-tio̍h chheng-khì hiàn chè-mi̍h, thang tùi chèng-lâng chèng-bêng.”

M̄-kú i chi̍t-ē chhut--khì, chiū sì-kòe soan-thoân pò-iông chit-ê siau-sit, tì-kàu Iâ-so͘ bōe-tàng kong-khai ji̍p-siâⁿ, soah tio̍h tòa tī siâⁿ-gōa phian-phiah ê só͘-chāi. Chèng-lâng iû-goân tùi ta̍k só͘-chāi khì chhē I.
Kúi ji̍t āu, Iâ-so͘ koh khì Ka-pek-lông, ū siau-sit thoân kóng I tī chhù-lāi,
chiū ū chin chōe lâng chū-chi̍p óa--lâi, soah lóng bô khang-ūi, liân mn̂g-kháu to bô. Iâ-so͘ tùi in teh káng-tō ê sî,
ū sì ê lâng kng chi̍t ê poàn-sin-put-sūi ê lâng lâi I hia.

In-ūi lâng chin chōe, bōe-tàng kng-khì kàu Iâ-so͘ ê bīn-chêng, in chiū tī I téng-bīn ê chhù-téng thiah chi̍t khang, hō͘ hit-ê poàn-sin-put-sūi ê lâng tó tī chhn̂g-pho͘ lūi--lo̍h-khì.
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-kìⁿ in ê sìn-sim, chiū tùi hit-ê poàn-sin-put-sūi ê lâng kóng, “Siàu-liân-lâng, lí ê chōe sià-bián lah!”
Ū kúi-nā ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su chē tī hia, sim-lāi teh gī-lūn,
“Chit-ê lâng ná ōe án-ni kóng? I teh siat-to̍k Siōng-tè! To̍k-it ê Siōng-tè í-gōa, sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng sià-chōe?”
Iâ-so͘ lāi-sim sûi-sî chai-iáⁿ in án-ni teh gī-lūn, chiū tùi in kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ lín sim-lāi teh chit-būn chit-ê tāi-chì?
Tùi poàn-sin-put-sūi ê lâng kóng ‘Lí ê chōe sià-bián lah’, á-sī kóng ‘Khí--lâi, giâ lí ê chhn̂g-pho͘ khí-lâi kiâⁿ’, tó chi̍t hāng khah kán-tan?
Put-kò góa beh hō͘ lín chai Jîn-chú tī tōe-chiūⁿ ū sià-chōe ê koân-pèng.” Iâ-so͘ chiū tùi hit-ê poàn-sin-put-sūi ê lâng kóng,
“Góa kā lí kóng, khí--lâi, giâ lí ê chhn̂g-pho͘, tńg-khì lín tau!”

I chiū khí--lâi, sûi-sî giâ i ê chhn̂g-pho͘, tī chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng kiâⁿ--chhut-khì. Chèng-lâng lóng tōa tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè kóng, “Goán chêng-kàu-taⁿ m̄-bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-khoán tāi-chì!”
Iâ-so͘ koh khì Ka-lī-lī ô͘-piⁿ, ū chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng lâi I hia, I chiū kā in kà-sī.
Iâ-so͘ keng-kè ê sî khòaⁿ-tio̍h A-le̍k-hui ê kiáⁿ Lī-bī chē tī sè-koan, chiū tùi i kóng, “Lâi tè góa!” Lī-bī chiū khí-lâi tè Iâ-so͘.
Āu-lâi, Iâ-so͘ tī Lī-bī in tau chia̍h-pn̄g. Ū chin chōe ba̍uh-sè--ê kap chōe-jîn mā kap Iâ-so͘ í-ki̍p I ê bûn-tô͘ chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g, in-ūi ū chin chōe lâng teh tè Iâ-so͘.

Chi̍t-kóa Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ kap chōe-jîn í-ki̍p ba̍uh-sè--ê chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g, chiū tùi I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ I kap ba̍uh-sè--ê í-ki̍p chōe-jîn chòe-hé chia̍h?”
Iâ-so͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū kā in kóng, “Kiān-khong--ê bô su-iàu i-seng, phòa-pīⁿ--ê chiah ū su-iàu. Góa lâi, m̄-sī beh chio gī-lâng, sī beh chio chōe-jîn.”

Iok-hān ê bûn-tô͘ kap Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng teh kìm-chia̍h. Ū lâng lâi mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “ Iok-hān ê bûn-tô͘ kap Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê bûn-tô͘ kìm-chia̍h, sī-án-chóaⁿ lí ê bûn-tô͘ bô kìm-chia̍h?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Sin-lông iáu kap hun-iàn ê lâng-kheh chòe-hé ê sî, lâng-kheh kiám ōe kìm-chia̍h? In iáu kap sin-lông chòe-hé ê sî bōe kìm-chia̍h.
Ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, sin-lông ōe hō͘ lâng tùi in tiong-kan lia̍h--khì, hit-sî in chiū ōe kìm-chia̍h.
“Bô lâng ēng bô kiu-chúi ê pò͘ khì pó͘ kū-saⁿ. Nā án-ni chòe, hit-tè sin-pò͘ ōe kiù-li̍h kū-saⁿ, tian-tò phòa koh-khah tōa-khang.

Mā bô lâng chiong sin-chiú ji̍p tī kū phê-tē. Nā án-ni chòe, sin-chiú ōe kā phê-tē piak-phòa, chiú lâu--chhut-lâi, phê-tē mā pháiⁿ--khì. Sin-chiú eng-kai ji̍p tī sin phê-tē!”
Ū chi̍t ê An-hioh-ji̍t, Iâ-so͘ tùi be̍h-hn̂g keng-kè. I ê bûn-tô͘ ná kiâⁿ ná tiah be̍h-sūi.
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ! In sī-án-chóaⁿ tī An-hioh-ji̍t chòe bōe-ēng-tit chòe ê tāi-chì?”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín kiám m̄-bat tha̍k-tio̍h Tāi-pi̍t kap tè i ê lâng pak-tó͘ iau su-iàu chia̍h-mi̍h ê sî só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì?

A-pí-a-tha chòe tōa-chè-si ê sî, Tāi-pi̍t ji̍p-khì Siōng-tè ê tiān chia̍h hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ, mā hō͘ tè i ê lâng chia̍h; chit-khoán piáⁿ chè-si í-gōa ê lâng bōe-ēng-tit chia̍h.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “An-hioh-ji̍t sī ūi-tio̍h lâng lâi siat-li̍p; lâng m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h An-hioh-ji̍t lâi chhòng-chō.
Só͘-í, Jîn-chú mā-sī An-hioh-ji̍t ê Chú.”
Iâ-so͘ koh ji̍p-khì hōe-tn̂g, tī hia ū chi̍t ê chi̍t ki chhiú khê--khì ê lâng.
Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng teh tng-tán khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘ tī An-hioh-ji̍t ōe kā chit-ê lâng i-tī á bōe, thang kā I kò.
Iâ-so͘ tùi hit-ê chhiú khê--khì ê lâng kóng, “Khí--lâi, lâi tiong-ng chia.”
Jiân-āu I mn̄g chèng-lâng, “Tī An-hioh-ji̍t, chòe hó-sū á-sī chòe pháiⁿ-sū, kiù sìⁿ-miā á-sī hāi sìⁿ-miā, tó chi̍t hāng ha̍h Lu̍t-hoat?” In lóng tiām-tiām.
Iâ-so͘ siū-khì, chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê kā in khòaⁿ, ūi-tio̍h in ê ngī-sim iu-siong, chiū tùi hit-ê lâng kóng, “Chhiú chhun--chhut-lâi!” I chhiú chhun--chhut-lâi, chiū ho̍k-goân.
Hiah-ê Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chiū lī-khui hōe-tn̂g, sûi-sî kap Hi-lu̍t-tóng ê lâng tàu-tīn kè-bô͘ tùi-hù Iâ-so͘, khòaⁿ beh án-chóaⁿ kā I hāi-sí.

Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ thè-khì Ka-lī-lī ô͘-piⁿ, ū chi̍t tōa-tīn Ka-lī-lī -lâng tè I khì; koh ū chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì, tùi Iû-thài, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, Í-thó͘-mái, Iok-tàn-hô tang-hōaⁿ, í-ki̍p Thài-ní kap Se-tùn chiu-ûi lâi chhē I.
In-ūi lâng chin chōe, Iâ-so͘ hoan-hù bûn-tô͘ kā I chún-pī chi̍t chiah chûn, chiah bián hō͘ lâng kā I khoeh píⁿ--khì.
In-ūi Iâ-so͘ bat i-hó chin chōe pīⁿ-lâng, só͘-í só͘-ū ê pīⁿ-lâng lóng khoeh óa-lâi beh kā I bong.
Hiah-ê siâ-sîn chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘, chiū phak tī I ê bīn-chêng, tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Lí sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ!”
Iâ-so͘ giâm-giâm bēng-lēng in m̄-thang tùi lâng thoân-iông I ê tāi-chì.
Iâ-so͘ chiūⁿ-soaⁿ, tiàu-chi̍p I só͘ ì-ài ê lâng, in chiū lâi.
I siat-li̍p cha̍p-jī lâng, chheng in chòe sù-tô͘, sī beh hō͘ in kap I chòe-hé, koh chhe in khì thoân-tō,
mā hō͘ in ū koân-pèng kóaⁿ-kúi.
I só͘ jīm-bēng ê cha̍p-jī lâng chiū-sī: Se-bûn — Iâ-so͘ kā i kiò-chòe Pí-tek,
Se-pì-thài ê kiáⁿ Ngá-kok kap i ê sió-tī Iok-hān — Iâ-so͘ kā in kiò-chòe Poàn-nî-kî, ì-sù sī “Lûi-kong-á-kiáⁿ”,
koh ū An-tek-lia̍t, Hui-le̍k, Pa-to-lô-mái, Má-thài, To-má, A-le̍k-hui ê kiáⁿ Ngá-kok, Ta̍t-thài, Kek-chìn-tóng ê Se-bûn,
kap chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘ hit-ê Í-su-ka-lio̍k ê Iû-tāi.
Iâ-so͘ tńg-khì chhù--ni̍h. Ū chi̍t tīn lâng koh chū-chi̍p óa--lâi, Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ soah liân pn̄g to bōe-kò͘-tit chia̍h.
I ê chhin-lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì chiū chhut-lâi beh kā I chó͘-chí, in-ūi in kóng “I cheng-sîn sit-siông!”
Tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lo̍h--lâi ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kóng, “I sī hō͘ Pia̍t-se-pok hū-sin, khò kúi-ông teh kóaⁿ-kúi.”
Iâ-so͘ kiò in lâi, ēng phì-jū tùi in kóng, “Sat-tàn ná ōe kóaⁿ Sat-tàn?
Kok-ka nā ka-kī hun-cheng, hit-ê kok-ka chiū khiā bōe tiâu.
Ka-têng nā ka-kī hun-cheng, hit-ê ka-têng mā khiā bōe tiâu.
Sat-tàn nā ka-kī kong-kek, hun-cheng, i khiā bōe tiâu, it-tēng ōe bia̍t-bông.
“Bô lâng ōe-tàng ji̍p-khì ióng-sū ê chhù chhiúⁿ i ê châi-bu̍t; tio̍h seng kā i pa̍k--khí-lâi, chiah ōe-tàng kiap i ê chhù.
“Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, lâng bô-lūn hoān sím-mi̍h chōe, kóng sím-mi̍h pòng-to̍k ê ōe, lóng ōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
M̄-kú bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng siat-to̍k Sèng Sîn, éng-oán bōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián, i sī hoān-tio̍h éng-oán ê chōe.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe sī in-ūi in kóng “I hō͘ siâ-sîn hū-sin”.
Iâ-so͘ ê lāu-bú kap I ê hiaⁿ-tī lâi, khiā tī gōa-bīn, chhe lâng khì kiò I.
Ū chi̍t tīn lâng chē tī Iâ-so͘ chiu-ûi; ū lâng kā I kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, lí ê lāu-bú kap lí ê sió-tī sió-bē tī gōa-bīn beh chhē lí!”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng sī góa ê lāu-bú, góa ê hiaⁿ-tī?”
Jiân-āu I tùi chē tī chiu-ûi ê lâng chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê kā in khòaⁿ, kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, góa ê lāu-bú, góa ê hiaⁿ-tī!
Si̍t-hêng Siōng-tè chí-ì ê lâng chiū-sī góa ê hiaⁿ-tī, chí-bē, kap lāu-bú.”

Iâ-so͘ koh chi̍t piàn tī Ka-lī-lī ô͘-piⁿ teh kà-sī lâng. Ū chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng chū-chi̍p óa-lâi I hia, I soah tio̍h khì chē tī chûn-téng; chûn tī ô͘--ni̍h, kui tōa-tīn lâng tī hōaⁿ-téng.
Iâ-so͘ ēng phì-jū kà-sī in chin chōe hāng sū. I kà-sī ê sî kā in kóng:
“Tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ! Ū chi̍t ê iā chéng-chí ê lâng chhut-khì iā chéng-chí.
I iā ê sî, ū-ê chéng-chí lak tī lō͘-piⁿ, chiáu-á pe--lâi, kā i chia̍h-liáu-liáu.
Ū-ê lak tī chio̍h-thâu tōe, thô͘ chió ê só͘-chāi, in-ūi thô͘ bô chhim, chin kín chiū puh-gê,
ji̍t-thâu chi̍t-ē chhut, kā in pha̍k--tio̍h, in-ūi bô kun chiū ta--khì.
Ū-ê lak tī chhì-phè lāi, chhì-á tōa-châng--khí-lâi, kā i hip--sí, chiū bô kiat-si̍t.
Ū-ê lak tī hó thó͘-tōe, chiū hoat-íⁿ, sêng-tióng, kiat-si̍t; ū-ê kiat saⁿ-cha̍p pē, ū-ê la̍k-cha̍p pē, ū-ê chi̍t-pah pē.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Ū hī-khang thang thiaⁿ ê lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ!”
Iâ-so͘ ka-kī chi̍t ê ê sî, tī I chiu-ûi ê lâng kap cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ lâi mn̄g I chiah-ê phì-jū ê ì-sù.
Iâ-so͘ chiū kā in kóng, “Siōng-tè-kok ê ò-pì í-keng ū hō͘ lín, m̄-kú tùi gōa-lâng ta̍k-hāng lóng sī ēng phì-jū,
beh hō͘ In khòaⁿ koh khòaⁿ, mā khòaⁿ bô, thiaⁿ koh thiaⁿ, mā bô liáu-kái; nā m̄-sī án-ni, in ōe hôe-sim-tńg-ì, Siōng-tè chiū kā in sià-bián.”
Iâ-so͘ koh mn̄g in kóng, “Chit-ê phì-jū lín bōe liáu-kái sī--bô? Án-ni lín ná ōe bêng-pe̍k kî-tha só͘-ū ê phì-jū?
Iā chéng-chí--ê sī iā Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit.
Iā tī lō͘-piⁿ--ê, sī chí lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h sìn-sit, Sat-tàn sûi-sî lâi, kā iā tī in sim-lāi ê sìn-sit chhiúⁿ--khì.
Siâng-khoán, iā tī chio̍h-thâu tōe--ê, sī chí lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h sìn-sit, sûi-sî hoaⁿ-hí chiap-siū,
put-kò tī in ê sim-lāi tèng-kun bô chhim, tòng bōe kú, chi̍t-ē ūi-tio̍h sìn-sit tú-tio̍h hoān-lān á-sī pek-hāi, sûi-sî pàng-sak.
Iā tī chhì-phè lāi--ê, sī chí lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h sìn-sit liáu-āu,
in-ūi seng-oa̍h ê khòa-lū, chîⁿ-châi ê bê-he̍k, kap kî-tha ta̍k-khoán ê su-io̍k ji̍p-khì sim-lāi, kā só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê sìn-sit hip--sí, soah bōe kiat-si̍t.
Hiah-ê iā tī hó thó͘-tōe--ê, sī chí lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h sìn-sit, hoaⁿ-hí chiap-siū chiū kiat-si̍t; ū-ê saⁿ-cha̍p pē, ū-ê la̍k-cha̍p pē, ū-ê chi̍t-pah pē.”
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g in kóng, “Kiám ū lâng tiám-teng ēng táu khàm--khí-lâi á-sī khǹg tī bîn-chhn̂g kha, bô kā i chhāi tī teng-tâi téng?
In-ūi it-chhè ún-ba̍t--ê bô chi̍t hāng bōe hián-lō͘; it-chhè am-khàm--ê bô chi̍t hāng bōe lō͘-hiān.
Ū hī-khang thang thiaⁿ ê lâng, tio̍h thiaⁿ!”
Iâ-so͘ koh kā in kóng, “Tio̍h chù-ì lín thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê. Lín ēng sím-mi̍h niû niû hō͘ lâng, Siōng-tè ōe ēng siâng-khoán ê niû niû hō͘ lín, sīm-chì hō͘ lín koh-khah chōe.
In-ūi ū--ê, beh hō͘ i koh-khah chōe; bô--ê, liân i só͘-ū--ê mā beh kā i chhiúⁿ--khí-lâi.”
Iâ-so͘ koh kóng, “Siōng-tè-kok chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng chiong chéng-chí iā tī tōe--ni̍h.
I àm-sî khì khùn, ji̍t--sî khí--lâi, chéng-chí teh puh-gê tōa-châng, i m̄ chai sī-án-chóaⁿ ōe án-ni.
Thó͘-tōe chū-jiân seng-sán ngó͘-kok, tāi-seng puh-gê, āu-lâi thò͘-sūi, chòe-āu pá-sūi.
Ngó͘-kok sek ê sî, sûi-sî ēng liâm-le̍k-á siu-koah, in-ūi siu-sêng ê sî kàu lah.”
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g kóng, “Lán beh ēng sím-mi̍h lâi pí-phēng Siōng-tè-kok, beh ēng sím-mi̍h phì-jū lâi soat-bêng?
Siōng-tè-kok chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t lia̍p kòa-chhài-chí, iā-lo̍h tōe ê sî sī tōe-chiūⁿ chéng-chí tiong siōng sòe-lia̍p--ê;
iā--lo̍h-khì, tōa-châng--khí-lâi, pí só͘-ū ê chhài-soe koh-khah tōa-châng, hoat-chhut tōa-ki oe, sīm-chì khong-tiong ê chiáu-á to ōe-tàng tī chhiū-ńg ē chòe siū.”
Iâ-so͘ ēng chin chōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-khoán ê phì-jū tùi chèng-lâng soan-káng sìn-sit, lóng chiàu in ōe bêng-pe̍k--ê kā in kóng.
I bô ēng pa̍t-khoán ê hong-sek, chí-ū ēng phì-jū tùi in kóng, put-kò kan-ta kap ka-kī ê bûn-tô͘ chòe-hé ê sî chiah ta̍k-hāng kā in soat-bêng.
Hit-ji̍t thiⁿ àm ê sî, Iâ-so͘ tùi bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Lán kè lâi-khì hit-pêng hōaⁿ.”
Bûn-tô͘ chiū lī-khui kûn-chiòng chiūⁿ-chûn, kap í-keng tī chûn-téng ê Iâ-so͘ chòe-hé khì. Ū kúi-nā chiah chûn mā chòe-hé khì.
Hut-jiân khí tōa-hong, éng phoah-ji̍p chûn-lāi, chûn soah hō͘ chúi im kàu beh móa.
Iâ-so͘ tī chûn-bé khòa chím-thâu teh khùn; bûn-tô͘ kā I kiò-chhíⁿ, kóng, “Lāu-su, lán teh-beh bô-miā lo͘h, lí bô iàu-kín o͘h?”
Iâ-so͘ khí--lâi, chek-pī hong, koh bēng-lēng éng, kóng, “Chēng--lo̍h-khì! Tiāⁿ--lo̍h-lâi!” Hong tiām--khì, ô͘ chiū chēng-chēng-chēng.
Iâ-so͘ tùi bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Lín ná hiah-ni̍h kiaⁿ? Lín iáu bô sìn-sim sī--bô?”
In hui-siông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kóng-lâi-kóng-khì, “Chit-ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng, liân hong kap éng to sūn-ho̍k!”
Iâ-so͘ kè-khì Ka-lī-lī-ô͘ ê hit-pêng hōaⁿ, Kek-la-sim -lâng ê tōe-khu.
I chi̍t-ē lo̍h-chûn, ū chi̍t ê hō͘ siâ-sîn hū-sin ê lâng tú tùi bōng-á-po͘ chhut--lâi, tú-tio̍h I.
Chit-ê lâng lóng tòa tī bōng-á-po͘, lâng ēng thih-liān to kā i liān bōe tiâu.
Chin chōe piàn lâng ēng thih-liān kap kha-khàu kā i khún-pa̍k, thih-liān hō͘ i chhoah-tn̄g, kha-khàu hō͘ i kòng-chhùi, bô lâng ū khùi-la̍t kā i chè-ho̍k.
I mî-ji̍t tī bōng-á-po͘ á-sī soaⁿ-phiâⁿ loān jióng, koh ēng chio̍h-thâu siong-hāi ka-kī.
I tī hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘, chiū cháu-lâi kūi tī I ê bīn-chêng,
tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Chì-koân Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘, lí mài chhap--góa! Góa kí Siōng-tè ê miâ khún-kiû lí m̄-thang khó͘-chhó͘ góa.”
In-ūi Iâ-so͘ ū tùi i kóng, “Siâ-sîn, tùi chit-ê lâng chhut--khì!”
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g i, “Lí sím-mi̍h miâ?” I ìn kóng, “Góa ê miâ sī ‘Kun-thoân’, in-ūi goán chin tōa-tīn.”
I pek-chhiat ai-kiû Iâ-so͘ m̄-thang kóaⁿ in lī-khui hit-ê tōe-khu.
Hit-sî, hù-kūn ê soaⁿ-phiâⁿ ū chi̍t tōa-kûn ti teh thó-chia̍h.
Siâ-sîn kiû Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Hō͘ goán khì ti-kûn hia, thang ji̍p-khì in lāi-bīn.”
Iâ-so͘ chún in. Siâ-sîn chiū chhut--khì, chìn-ji̍p hit-kûn ti; kui-kûn ti, iok ū nn̄g-chheng chiah, tùi soaⁿ-phiâⁿ chông lo̍h-khì ô͘--ni̍h, hō͘ chúi tū-sí.
Chhī ti ê lâng chiū kiaⁿ kah cháu-khì siâⁿ-lāi kap hiong-chhoan pò chit-ê siau-sit. Chèng-lâng chiū chhut-lâi beh khòaⁿ ū hoat-seng sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.
In lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê hō͘ kúi hū-sin, chiū-sī bat hō͘ “Kun-thoân” tîⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng chē tī hia, ū chhēng-saⁿ, cheng-sîn chèng-siông, chiū chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng chiū chiong hō͘ kúi hū-sin ê lâng kap ti-kûn só͘ tú--tio̍h ê tāi-chì kā lâng kóng.
In chiū iau-kiû Iâ-so͘ lī-khui in ê tōe-khu.
Iâ-so͘ beh chiūⁿ-chûn ê sî, bat hō͘ kúi hū-sin hit-ê lâng kiû Iâ-so͘ chún i chòe-hé khì.
Iâ-so͘ m̄-chún, kā i kóng, “Tńg-khì lín tau, lín chhin-lâng hia, chiong Chú lîn-bín lí, tùi lí só͘ chòe hiah-ni̍h tōa ê tāi-chì lóng pò in chai.”
Hit-ê lâng chiū lī-khui, tī Te-ka-pho-lí thoân-iông Iâ-so͘ tùi i só͘ chòe hiah-ni̍h tōa ê tāi-chì; só͘-ū ê lâng lóng tio̍h-kiaⁿ kî-koài.
Iâ-so͘ koh chē-chûn kè-khì ô͘ ê hit-pêng hōaⁿ; I tī ô͘-piⁿ, ū chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng chū-chi̍p óa--lâi.
Ū chi̍t ê hōe-tn̂g ê chú-koán kiò-chòe Ia̍p-ló͘ lâi, chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ chiū phak tī I ê kha-chêng,
khún-kiû I, kóng, “Góa ê sòe-hàn cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ teh-beh sí ah, chhiáⁿ lí lâi kā i hōaⁿ-chhiú, i-hó, hō͘ i ōe oa̍h.”
Iâ-so͘ chiū kap i khì; ū chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng mā oe-oe-khoeh-khoeh tè I khì.
Ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng tì-tio̍h hiat-lāu-pīⁿ cha̍p-jī nî kú;
i ū hō͘ chin chōe i-seng khòaⁿ--kè, siū-tio̍h chin chōe thòng-khó͘, koh chîⁿ lóng khai-liáu-liáu, i ê pīⁿ m̄-nā bô khah hó, tian-tò ná siong-tiōng.
I ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê tāi-chì, chiū khoeh ji̍p-khì kûn-chiòng lāi-bīn, kiâⁿ óa-khì Iâ-so͘ ê āu-bīn, bong I ê saⁿ.
I siūⁿ-kóng, “Góa kan-ta bong-tio̍h I ê saⁿ, pīⁿ chiū ōe hó.”
I ê hiat-lāu sûi-sî chí, kám-kak seng-khu ê pīⁿ í-keng hó.
Iâ-so͘ sûi-sî chai ū khùi-la̍t tùi I chhut--khì, chiū oa̍t--kè-lâi, mn̄g kûn-chiòng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng bong góa ê saⁿ?”
Bûn-tô͘ ìn kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ kui-tīn lâng teh kā lí khoeh, lí ná ōe kóng ‘Sím-mi̍h-lâng kā góa bong’?”
Iâ-so͘ sì-kho͘-lìn-tńg khòaⁿ chi̍t-ē, ài chai sím-mi̍h-lâng kā I bong.
Hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng chai tī i sin-chiūⁿ só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, chiū phak tī Iâ-so͘ kha-chêng, chiong lóng-chóng ê si̍t-chêng kóng--chhut-lâi.
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lí ê sìn-sim hō͘ lí hó--khì lah, pêng-an tò--khì, lí ê pīⁿ í-keng hó ah.”
Iâ-so͘ iáu-teh kóng ê sî, ū lâng tùi hōe-tn̂g chú-koán ê chhù lâi, kā Ia̍p-ló͘ kóng, “Lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ í-keng sí--khì, ná tio̍h koh lô-hoân lāu-su.”
Iâ-so͘ ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h in kóng ê ōe, chiū tùi hōe-tn̂g chú-koán kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ, chí-ū tio̍h sìn!”
I chiū chhōa Pí-tek, Ngá-kok, kap Ngá-kok ê sió-tī Iok-hān chòe-hé khì, í-gōa m̄-chún pa̍t-lâng tè--khì.
In lâi kàu hōe-tn̂g chú-koán ê chhù, Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h tiûⁿ-bīn chin loān, ū lâng teh háu, ū lâng tōa-siaⁿ teh khàu.
I chi̍t-ē ji̍p--khì chiū kā in kóng, “Lín ná khàu kah loān-chhau-chhau? Chit-ê gín-á m̄-sī sí--khì, sī teh khùn.”
In chiū kā I thí-chhiò, m̄-kú I kā in lóng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, jiân-āu chhōa gín-á ê pē-bú kap hit saⁿ ê bûn-tô͘ ji̍p-khì gín-á ê pâng-keng.
I khan gín-á ê chhiú, tùi i kóng, “Tāi-lī-tāi kó͘-bí!” ì-sù chiū-sī “Cha-bó͘ gín-á, góa kā lí kóng, khí--lâi!”
Cha-bó͘ gín-á sûi-sî peh khí-lâi kiâⁿ, in-ūi i í-keng cha̍p-jī hè. In hui-siông tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ giâm-giâm kéng-kài in m̄-thang chiong chit-ê tāi-chì hō͘ lâng chai, koh kiò in the̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ cha-bó͘ gín-á chia̍h.
Iâ-so͘ lī-khui hia, tò-khì ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong, bûn-tô͘ tè I khì.

An-hioh-ji̍t, I tī hōe-tn̂g kà-sī lâng. Chin chōe lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h I ê kà-sī, lóng chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kóng, “Chit-ê lâng ê pún-sū tùi tó-ūi lâi? I tit--tio̍h-ê tàu-tóe sī sím-mi̍h khoán ê tì-hūi? I ê chhiú ná ōe-tàng kiâⁿ chit-khoán sîn-jiah?

I kiám m̄-sī ba̍k-chhiūⁿ? Kiám m̄-sī Má-lī-a ê kiáⁿ, Ngá-kok, Iok-se, Iû-tāi, kap Se-bûn ê hiaⁿ-tī? I ê sió-bē kiám m̄-sī kap lán tòa tī chia?” In soah tùi Iâ-so͘ khí hoán-kám.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Sian-ti tī ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong, ka-kī ê chhin-lâng, ka-kī ê ka-cho̍k í-gōa, it-tēng ōe siū chun-tiōng.”
I tī hia bōe-tàng kiâⁿ sím-mi̍h sîn-jiah, chí-ū kā kúi-ê-á pīⁿ-lâng hōaⁿ-chhiú, kā in i-hó.
Iâ-so͘ tùi in ê m̄ sìn kám-kak chin kî-koài. Iâ-so͘ kiâⁿ-thàu chiu-ûi ê chng-siā kà-sī lâng.
I tiàu-chi̍p cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ lâi, chhe in nn̄g-ê nn̄g-ê chhut--khì, hō͘ in ū koân-pèng thang chè-ap siâ-sîn.
I hoan-hù in, chhut-mn̂g ê sî koáiⁿ-á í-gōa sím-mi̍h lóng m̄-thang tòa; m̄-thang tòa chia̍h-mi̍h; m̄-thang tòa lú-hêng-tē; io-tòa lāi-bīn m̄-thang tòa chîⁿ;
chí-ū chhēng liâng-ôe; m̄-thang chhēng nn̄g niá lāi-saⁿ.
I koh kā in kóng, “Lín bô-lūn ji̍p-khì sím-mi̍h-lâng ê chhù, tio̍h tòa hia kàu lī-khui hit só͘-chāi.
Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, lâng nā m̄ chiap-la̍p lín, m̄ thiaⁿ lín ê kà-sī, lín lī-khui ê sî tio̍h chiong kha--ni̍h ê thô͘-hún pōaⁿ-tiāu, piáu-sī tùi in kéng-kò.”
Sù-tô͘ chiū chhut-khì thoân-tō, khǹg lâng hóe-kái.
In koh kóaⁿ-chhut chin chōe kúi, mā ēng iû boah chin chōe pīⁿ-lâng, kā in i-hó.

Hi-lu̍t -ông ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê sū, in-ūi I ê miâ thoân-piàn ta̍k só͘-chāi. Ū lâng kóng, “I sī Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, só͘-í ū koân-lêng kiâⁿ chiah-ê sîn-jiah.”
M̄-kú mā ū lâng kóng, “I sī Í-lī-a ”; koh ū lâng kóng, “I sī sian-ti, chhin-chhiūⁿ kó͘-chá ê chi̍t ê sian-ti.”
Hi-lu̍t thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū kóng, “Sī góa kā i chām-thâu hit-ê Iok-hān, i ū koh-oa̍h.”
Hi-lu̍t ū phài lâng khì lia̍h Iok-hān, kā i liān tī kaⁿ--ni̍h, goân-in sī Hi-lu̍t ū chhōa sió-tī Hui-le̍k ê bó͘ Hi-lô-tí chòe bó͘;
in-ūi Iok-hān tiāⁿ-tiāⁿ tùi Hi-lu̍t kóng, “Lí chhōa sió-tī ê bó͘ bô ha̍p-hoat!”
Hi-lô-tí sim-lāi tùi Iok-hān khioh-hūn, siūⁿ-beh kā i thâi, m̄-kú bōe-tàng chiàu sim-goān,
in-ūi Hi-lu̍t kiaⁿ Iok-hān, chai-iáⁿ i sī chèng-gī koh sèng-kiat ê lâng, ū kā i pó-hō͘. Hi-lu̍t ta̍k-piàn thiaⁿ Iok-hān ê ōe, hui-siông put-an, iáu-kú chin ài thiaⁿ.
Hi-lô-tí ê ki-hōe lâi lah. Hi-lu̍t choh-siⁿ-ji̍t ê sî, pān iàn-se̍k chhiáⁿ bûn-bú-pah-koaⁿ kap Ka-lī-lī bîn-kan ê léng-siù.

Hi-lô-tí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ji̍p-lâi thiàu-bú, hō͘ Hi-lu̍t kap chāi-chō ê kùi-pin hoaⁿ-hí. Ông kā hit-ê cha-bó͘ gín-á kóng, “Khòaⁿ lí ài sím-mi̍h, chòe lí kiû, góa lóng beh hō͘ lí.”
Hi-lu̍t koh tùi i soan-sè kóng, “Lí bô-lūn kiû sím-mi̍h, liân góa ông-kok ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ mā ōe hō͘ lí.”
Cha-bó͘ gín-á chhut-khì mn̄g i ê lāu-bú, “Góa tio̍h kiû sím-mi̍h?” I ê lāu-bú kā i kóng, “Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān ê thâu.”
I sûi-sî kóaⁿ tò-tńg--lâi, tùi ông iau-kiû kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí sûi-sî chiong Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān ê thâu-khak khǹg tī pôaⁿ--ni̍h hō͘ góa.”
Ông ê sim hui-siông kan-khó͘, put-kò in-ūi í-keng tī kùi-pin ê bīn-chêng chiù-chōa, chiū bô kā i kū-choa̍t.
Ông sûi-sî chhe chi̍t ê kéng-ōe khì the̍h Iok-hān ê thâu. Kéng-ōe chiū khì kaⁿ--ni̍h chām Iok-hān ê thâu,
chiong thâu-khak hē tī pôaⁿ--ni̍h phâng-lâi hō͘ cha-bó͘ gín-á, cha-bó͘ gín-á chiū hō͘ i ê lāu-bú.
Iok-hān ê bûn-tô͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū lâi siu i ê sin-si, kā i bâi-chòng tī bōng--ni̍h.
Sù-tô͘ tńg-lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, chiong in só͘ chòe só͘ kà-sī--ê lóng kā I pò-kò.

Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Án-ni, lín mā tio̍h ka-kī khì phian-phiah bô lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi sió-khóa hioh-khùn chi̍t-ē.” In-ūi chhut-chhut-ji̍p-ji̍p ê lâng chin chōe, in liân chia̍h-pn̄g ê sî-kan to bô.
In chiū chē-chûn kan-ta in ka-kī khì phian-phiah bô lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi.
Chin chōe lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h in lī-khui, jīn-chhut sī in, chiū tùi ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-chhī sūn lio̍k-lō͘ cháu chìn-chêng, pí in tāi-seng kàu hit só͘-chāi.
Iâ-so͘ chiūⁿ-hōaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng chiū khó-lîn in, in-ūi in chhin-chhiūⁿ bô bo̍k-chiá ê iûⁿ. I chiū kà-sī in chin chōe hāng sū.
Sî-kan í-keng chin òaⁿ, bûn-tô͘ óa-lâi kā I kóng, “Chit-ê só͘-chāi chin phian-phiah, sî-kan mā chin òaⁿ lah.
Chhiáⁿ kā in kái-sàn, hō͘ in khì hù-kūn ê hiong-chhoan chng-siā ka-kī bóe mi̍h-kiāⁿ chia̍h.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lín hō͘ in chia̍h.” Bûn-tô͘ mn̄g kóng, “Goán tio̍h khì bóe nn̄g-pah ê gûn-á ê piáⁿ hō͘ in chia̍h o͘h?”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lín ū jōa-chōe piáⁿ, khì khòaⁿ-bāi leh!” In khòaⁿ-liáu chiū kóng, “Ū gō͘ ê; mā ū nn̄g bé hî.”
Iâ-so͘ hoan-hù bûn-tô͘ kā chèng-lâng hun-cho͘, hō͘ in chē tī chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chháu-po͘.
Chèng-lâng chiū chi̍t-cho͘ chi̍t-cho͘ chē--lo̍h-khì, ū ê chi̍t-pah ê, ū ê gō͘-cha̍p ê.
Āu-lâi Iâ-so͘ the̍h hit gō͘ ê piáⁿ kap nn̄g bé hî, ǹg thiⁿ kám-siā, peh-khui, the̍h hō͘ bûn-tô͘ khì pun hō͘ chèng-lâng. I koh chiong hit nn̄g bé hî pun hō͘ chèng-lâng.
Tāi-ke lóng chia̍h, chia̍h kàu pá.
Bûn-tô͘ khioh chia̍h chhun ê piáⁿ-iù-á kap hî-sut-á, móa cha̍p-jī nâ.
Chia̍h-piáⁿ--ê, kan-ta ta-po͘-lâng chiū ū gō͘-chheng.
Iâ-so͘ sûi-sî pek I ê bûn-tô͘ chiūⁿ-chûn seng kè-khì tùi-bīn hōaⁿ, khì Pek-sài-tāi, ka-kī lâu teh kái-sàn kûn-chiòng.
Iâ-so͘ lī-khui kûn-chiòng liáu-āu chiū chiūⁿ-soaⁿ kî-tó.
Thiⁿ àm ê sî, chûn kiâⁿ kàu ô͘ ê tiong-ng; Iâ-so͘ ka-kī chi̍t ê tī hōaⁿ-téng.
I khòaⁿ-tio̍h bûn-tô͘ chìⁿ-hong teh kò-chiúⁿ, kò kah chin kan-khó͘. Thiⁿ beh kng ê sî, Iâ-so͘ tī ô͘ ê téng-bīn ǹg in hia kiâⁿ--khì, siūⁿ-beh tùi piⁿ--á kè--khì.
Bûn-tô͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h I tī ô͘ ê téng-bīn teh kiâⁿ, siūⁿ-kóng sī kúi, chiū tōa-siaⁿ hoah,
in-ūi tāi-ke lóng ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h I, chin kiaⁿ. Iâ-so͘ sûi-sî kā in kóng, “An-sim, sī góa, bián kiaⁿ!”
Iâ-so͘ chiūⁿ-chûn khì kap in chòe-hé, hong chiū tiām--khì. Bûn-tô͘ hui-siông tio̍h-kiaⁿ,
in-ūi in bô bêng-pe̍k hit-ê piáⁿ ê ì-gī, sim iáu chin tūn.
Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ kè ô͘ liáu-āu tī Kek-nî-sat-le̍k chiūⁿ-hōaⁿ, kā chûn pha tī hōaⁿ-piⁿ.
In chi̍t-ē lo̍h-chûn, chèng-lâng sûi-sî jīn-chhut Iâ-so͘,
chiū sì-kòe kiâⁿ-thàu-thàu, thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ tī tó-ūi chiū ēng chhn̂g-pho͘ kng pīⁿ-lâng khì hia.

Iâ-so͘ bô-lūn kiâⁿ kàu sím-mi̍h chng-siā, siâⁿ-chhī, hiong-chhoan, lâng chiū kā pīⁿ-lâng kng-lâi khǹg tī chhī-tiûⁿ-kháu, khún-kiû Iâ-so͘ siōng-bô mā hō͘ pīⁿ-lâng bong-tio̍h I saⁿ-á-ku ê chhiu; só͘-ū bong--tio̍h ê lâng lóng tit-tio̍h i-hó.
Ū hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng kap chi̍t-kóa tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lâi ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su tàu-tīn lâi chhē Iâ-so͘.
In khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê bûn-tô͘ ū lâng ēng bô chheng-khì ê chhiú, chiū-sī bô sóe-chhiú chiū chia̍h-pn̄g.
Goân-lâi Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng kap só͘-ū ê Iû-thài -lâng lóng chip-siú chó͘-sian ê thoân-thóng, nā bô chiàu hoat-tō͘ sóe-chhiú chiū bô chia̍h-pn̄g;
tùi chhī-tiûⁿ tò--lâi, nā bô sóe mā bô chia̍h. In koh chun-siú kî-tha chin chōe thoân-thóng ê kui-lē, chhin-chhiūⁿ sóe poe-á, koàn-á, tâng-khì, kap chhn̂g-pho͘, téng.
Só͘-í, Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ lí ê bûn-tô͘ ēng bô chheng-khì ê chhiú chia̍h-pn̄g, ûi-hoān chó͘-sian ê thoân-thóng?”

Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “ Í-sài-a só͘ kóng koan-hē lín chiah-ê ké-hó ê lâng ê ū-giân chin tio̍h; i án-ni siá: Chit-ê chú-bîn ēng chhùi-tûn chun-kèng góa, in ê sim khiok lī-khui góa hn̄g-hn̄g.
In ēng lâng ê kui-lē chòe góa ê kà-sī kà-sī lâng; in kèng-pài góa lóng bô-chhái-kang.
Lín kèng-jiân pàng-sak Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng, khì chip-siú lâng ê thoân-thóng.”
Iâ-so͘ koh kóng, “Lín ūi-tio̍h beh chip-siú thoân-thóng, ēng kháu-biāu ê hong-hoat lâi kū-choa̍t Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng.
Mô͘-se bēng-lēng lín ‘Tio̍h hàu-kèng pē-bú’, koh kóng ‘Mē lāu-pē á-sī mē lāu-bú ê lâng eng-kai chhú-sí’.
M̄-kú lín kóng, lâng nā tùi ka-kī ê lāu-pē á-sī lāu-bú kóng ‘Góa eng-kai hō͘ lí--ê í-keng chòe Kok-ní-pán’ — Kok-ní-pán ê ì-sù chiū-sī hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè ê lé-mi̍h,
lín chiū chún i bián hōng-ióng ka-kī ê pē-bú.
Lín ēng lín só͘ thoân-siū ê thoân-thóng lâi hòe-tû Siōng-tè ê ōe. Lín koh chòe chin chōe chit-khoán ê tāi-chì.”
Iâ-so͘ koh kiò chèng-lâng lâi, kā in kóng, “Lín tāi-ke lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ góa ê ōe, tio̍h liáu-kái:
Tùi gōa-bīn ji̍p-khì lâng lāi-bīn ê mi̍h, bô chi̍t hāng ōe hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì; tùi lāi-bīn chhut--lâi-ê, chiah ōe hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì.”
Iâ-so͘ lī-khui chèng-lâng, ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi, I ê bûn-tô͘ chiū mn̄g I chit-ê phì-jū ê ì-sù.
I kā in kóng, “Án-ni liân lín to bô bêng-pe̍k o͘h? Lín kiám bô liáu-kái, tùi gōa-bīn ji̍p-khì lâng lāi-bīn--ê lóng bōe hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì?

In-ūi tùi gōa-bīn ji̍p--khì-ê m̄-sī ji̍p-khì sim-lāi, sī ji̍p-khì pak-tó͘ lāi, āu-lâi pàng lo̍h-khì piān-só͘.” Iâ-so͘ án-ni kóng sī chí só͘-ū ê chia̍h-mi̍h lóng chheng-khì.
I koh kóng, “Tùi lâng lāi-bīn chhut--lâi-ê chiah ōe hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì.
In-ūi tùi lāi-bīn chhut--lâi-ê, chiū-sī tùi lâng ê sim chhut--ê, ū pháiⁿ liām-thâu, su-thong, thau-the̍h, hiong-sat,
kan-îm, tham-sim, siâ-ok, kan-chà, hòng-chhiòng, oàn-tò͘, húi-pòng, kiau-ngō͘, bōe-hiáu hun-pia̍t sī-hui.
Chiah-ê it-chhè siâ-ok ê sū lóng sī tùi lāi-bīn chhut--lâi-ê, che chiah ōe hō͘ lâng bô chheng-khì.”
Iâ-so͘ tùi hia chhut-hoat khì Thài-ní tōe-khu. I ji̍p-khì chi̍t keng chhù, bô ài lâng chai, put-kò bô hoat-tō͘ pó-bi̍t.
Sûi-sî ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê tāi-chì, chiū lâi kūi tī I ê kha-chêng; i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ hō͘ siâ-sîn hū-sin.
Chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng sī chhut-sì tī Sū-lī-a Hui-nî-ki ê Hi-la̍h -lâng. I kiû Iâ-so͘ kā i ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kóaⁿ-kúi.
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Tio̍h seng hō͘ gín-á chia̍h; the̍h gín-á ê chia̍h-mi̍h hiat hō͘ káu-á chia̍h, m̄ hó.”
Hū-jîn-lâng ìn kóng, “Chú ah, toh-á kha ê káu-á to chia̍h gín-á ê piáⁿ-iù-á.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “In-ūi lí chit-kù ōe, lí thang tńg--khì; kúi í-keng lī-khui lí ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ lah!”
Hū-jîn-lâng tńg-khì in tau, khòaⁿ-tio̍h cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tó tī chhn̂g--ni̍h, kúi í-keng lī-khui.
Iâ-so͘ koh lī-khui Thài-ní tōe-khu, keng-kè Se-tùn í-ki̍p Te-ka-pho-lí tōe-khu, lâi kàu Ka-lī-lī-ô͘.
Ū lâng chhōa chi̍t ê bōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ koh bōe kóng-ōe ê lâng lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, khún-kiû Iâ-so͘ kā i hōaⁿ-chhiú.
Iâ-so͘ chhōa hit-ê lâng lī-khui chèng-lâng khì piⁿ--á, chhng chńg-thâu-á ji̍p-khì i siang-pêng ê hī-khang, koh phùi-nōa boah i ê chi̍h,
jiân-āu ǹg thiⁿ, thó͘-khùi, kā i kóng, “Í-hoat-tāi”, ì-sù chiū-sī “Khui!”
Hit-lâng ê hī-khang sûi-sî khui, chi̍h-kun lēng, kóng-ōe kóng kah chin chheng-chhó.
Iâ-so͘ giâm-giâm bēng-lēng in m̄-thang kā lâng kóng, m̄-kú I jú kìm-chí, in jú chhut-la̍t pò-iông.
Tāi-ke lóng hui-siông tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kóng, “I ta̍k-hāng lóng chòe kah chin hó, liân bōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng to ōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, bōe kóng-ōe ê lâng to ōe kóng-ōe!”
Kè bô kúi ji̍t, koh ū chi̍t tōa-tīn kûn-chiòng chū-chi̍p. In bô mi̍h thang chia̍h, Iâ-so͘ chiū kiò I ê bûn-tô͘ lâi, kā in kóng,
“Góa chin khó-lîn chit-tīn lâng, in-ūi in í-keng kap góa chòe-hé saⁿ ji̍t kú, hiān-chāi bô mi̍h thang chia̍h lah.
Góa nā hō͘ in sì-sòaⁿ iau-iau tńg-khì in tau, in ōe tī lō͘-tiong hūn-tó, in-ūi ū lâng tùi chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi lâi.”
Bûn-tô͘ kā I kóng, “Tī chit-ê phian-phiah bô lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi, beh khì tó-ūi chhē chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ chiah-ê lâng chia̍h pá?”
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g in, “Lín ū jōa-chōe piáⁿ?” In kóng, “Chhit ê.”
Iâ-so͘ bēng-lēng kûn-chiòng chē lo̍h-khì thô͘-kha, jiân-āu the̍h hit chhit ê piáⁿ, kám-siā, peh-khui, the̍h hō͘ bûn-tô͘ khì pun, in chiū pun hō͘ kûn-chiòng.
In mā ū kúi-nā bé sòe bé hî, Iâ-so͘ kám-siā liáu, kiò bûn-tô͘ the̍h-khì pun.
In lóng chia̍h, chia̍h kàu pá, koh khioh chia̍h chhun ê chhùi-sut-á, lóng-chóng khioh chhit láng.
Jîn-sò͘ iok ū sì-chheng. Iâ-so͘ kā in kái-sàn,
jiân-āu sûi-sî kap bûn-tô͘ chiūⁿ-chûn, khì Tāi-má-ló͘-tha ê kéng-lāi.
Chi̍t-kóa Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng lâi chhē Iâ-so͘, kap I piān-lūn. In siūⁿ-beh kā I chhì-thàm, iau-kiû I kiâⁿ tùi thiⁿ lâi ê sîn-jiah.
Iâ-so͘ tùi sim-tóe thó͘ chi̍t ê tōa-khùi, kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ chit sè-tāi ê lâng kiû sîn-jiah? Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, bōe koh ū sîn-jiah hō͘ chit sè-tāi ê lâng.”
I chiū lī-khui in, koh chiūⁿ-chûn kè-khì ô͘ ê hit-pêng hōaⁿ.
Bûn-tô͘ bōe-kì-tit tòa piáⁿ, put-kò in tī chûn-lāi ū chi̍t ê piáⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kéng-kò, “Tio̍h chù-ì, tio̍h tî-hông Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê kàⁿ kap Hi-lu̍t ê kàⁿ!”
Bûn-tô͘ hō͘-siōng gī-lūn, “Sī in-ūi lán bô piáⁿ sī--bô?”
Iâ-so͘ chai-iáⁿ chiū kā in kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ teh gī-lūn bô tòa piáⁿ ê tāi-chì? Lín kiám iáu bô liáu-kái, iáu bô bêng-pe̍k? Lín ê sim kiám hiah-ni̍h tūn?
Lín ū ba̍k-chiu, kiám bô khòaⁿ--kìⁿ? Lín ū hī-khang, kiám bô thiaⁿ--kìⁿ? Lín kiám bōe-kì--tit,
góa peh gō͘ ê piáⁿ hō͘ gō͘-chheng lâng chia̍h ê sî, chia̍h chhun ê chhùi-sut-á, lín ū khioh móa kúi nâ?” In kóng, “Cha̍p-jī nâ.”
Iâ-so͘ koh mn̄g, “Góa peh chhit ê piáⁿ hō͘ sì-chheng lâng chia̍h ê sî, chia̍h chhun ê chhùi-sut-á, lín ū khioh kúi láng?” In kóng, “Chhit láng.”
Iâ-so͘ chiū kā in kóng, “Án-ni, lín kiám iáu bô bêng-pe̍k?”
Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ lâi kàu Pek-sài-tāi. Ū lâng chhōa chi̍t ê bông-jîn lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, khún-kiû Iâ-so͘ kā i bong.

Iâ-so͘ khan hit-ê bông-jîn ê chhiú, chhōa i chhut-khì chng-gōa, jiân-āu chiong chhùi-nōa phùi tī i ê ba̍k-chiu, koh ēng siang-chhiú kā i bong, mn̄g kóng, “Lí ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h sím-mi̍h?”
I gia̍h-thâu khí-lâi khòaⁿ, kóng, “Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h lâng, khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū-á teh kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì.”
Iâ-so͘ koh chi̍t piàn ēng siang-chhiú bong i ê ba̍k-chiu, i chù-sîn khòaⁿ, sī-le̍k chiū ho̍k-goân, ta̍k-hāng lóng khòaⁿ kah chin chheng-chhó.
Iâ-so͘ kiò i tńg-khì in tau, kā i kóng, “Lí liân chng-lāi to m̄-thang ji̍p--khì.”
Iâ-so͘ kap I ê bûn-tô͘ khì Khái-sat-lī-a Hui-li̍p-pí hù-kūn ê hiong-chhoan. Tī lō͘-tiong, I mn̄g in kóng, “Lâng kóng góa sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?”
In ìn kóng, “Ū lâng kóng lí sī Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān; ū lâng kóng sī Í-lī-a; mā ū lâng kóng sī sian-ti tiong ê chi̍t ê.”
Iâ-so͘ koh mn̄g in kóng, “Lín leh, lín kóng góa sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?” Pí-tek ìn kóng, “Lí sī Ki-tok.”
Iâ-so͘ bēng-lēng in chhian-bān m̄-thang tùi lâng kóng-khí I ê tāi-chì.

Iâ-so͘ khai-sí kà-sī bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Jîn-chú it-tēng tio̍h siū chin chōe khó͘-lān, hō͘ tiúⁿ-ló, chè-si-tiúⁿ, kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kū-choa̍t, koh hō͘ lâng hāi-sí, saⁿ ji̍t āu koh-oa̍h.”
I chiong chit-ê tāi-chì chheng-chheng-chhó-chhó kā in kóng. Pí-tek chiū khiú Iâ-so͘ khì piⁿ--á, kā I chek-pī.
Iâ-so͘ oa̍t kè-lâi khòaⁿ bûn-tô͘, chek-pī Pí-tek, kóng, “Sat-tàn, siám-khui! Lí siūⁿ--ê m̄-sī Siōng-tè ê sū, sī lâng ê sū.”
Jiân-āu, Iâ-so͘ kā kûn-chiòng kap bûn-tô͘ kiò óa--lâi, tùi in kóng, “Beh tè góa ê lâng, tio̍h oân-choân hó͘-tēng ka-kī, giâ ka-kī ê si̍p-jī-kè lâi tè góa.
In-ūi beh kiù ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā--ê, ōe sòng-sit sìⁿ-miā; ūi-tio̍h góa kap hok-im ê iân-kò͘ sòng-sit ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā--ê, ōe kiù-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā.
Lâng tit-tio̍h choân sè-kài soah sòng-sit ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek?
Lâng ōe-tàng ēng sím-mi̍h tāi-kè lâi kau-ōaⁿ ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā?

Tī chit-ê îm-loān siâ-ok ê sè-tāi, lâng nā in-ūi góa kap góa ê ōe kám-kak kiàn-siàu, Jîn-chú tī I ê Pē ê êng-kng tiong kap sèng thiⁿ-sài lâi-lîm ê sî mā ōe in-ūi i kám-kak kiàn-siàu.”
Iâ-so͘ koh kā in kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, khiā tī chia ê lâng, ū-ê iáu-bē sí í-chêng ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè-kok í-keng chhiong-móa tōa lêng-le̍k lâi-lîm.”
La̍k ji̍t āu, Iâ-so͘ chhōa Pí-tek, Ngá-kok, kap Iok-hān, kan-ta in ka-kī peh-chiūⁿ chi̍t chō koân soaⁿ. Tī in ê bīn-chêng, Iâ-so͘ ê hêng-siōng hut-jiân kái-piàn.
I ê saⁿ piàn-kàu kng-iàⁿ-iàⁿ, hui-siông pe̍h, tōe-chiūⁿ ê phiò-pò͘ sai-hū mā bōe-tàng phiò kàu hiah-ni̍h pe̍h.
Hit-sî Í-lī-a kap Mô͘-se chòe-hé chhut-hiān, kap Iâ-so͘ kóng-ōe.
Pí-tek tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lia̍p-pí, lán tī chia chin hó, goán lâi tah saⁿ keng liâu-á, chi̍t keng hō͘ lí, chi̍t keng hō͘ Mô͘-se, chi̍t keng hō͘ Í-lī-a.”
Pí-tek m̄-chai tio̍h kóng sím-mi̍h, in-ūi in hui-siông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Hit-sî, ū chi̍t phìⁿ hûn kā in tà--teh, koh ū siaⁿ tùi hûn chhut--lâi, kóng, “Chit-ê sī góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê Kiáⁿ, lín tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn I.”
In kóaⁿ-kín sì-chiu-ûi khòaⁿ chi̍t lìn, chí-ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘, bô pa̍t-lâng tī hia.
In lo̍h-soaⁿ ê sî, Iâ-so͘ bēng-lēng in, kóng, “Jîn-chú tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h í-chêng, m̄-thang chiong só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê sū kā lâng kóng.”
In chiong Iâ-so͘ ê ōe khǹg tī sim-lāi, su-hā teh gī-lūn tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h chit-kù ōe sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù.
In mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kóng Í-lī-a it-tēng tio̍h seng lâi?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “ Í-lī-a it-tēng tio̍h seng lâi hôe-ho̍k it-chhè. Án-ni, Sèng-keng ná ōe kì-chài kóng Jîn-chú it-tēng tio̍h siū chin chōe khó͘-lān koh hō͘ lâng biáu-sī?
Góa kā lín kóng, tú-tú chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài, Í-lī-a í-keng lâi lah, lâng chiàu in ê ì-sù tùi-thāi i.”
In lâi kàu kî-tha ê bûn-tô͘ hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t tōa-kûn lâng kā in ûi--teh, ū kúi-nā ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap in teh piān-lūn.
Kûn-chiòng chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘, chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, sûi-sî cháu óa-khì kā I chhéng-an.
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Lín kap in teh piān-lūn sím-mi̍h?”
Kûn-chiòng ê tiong-kan ū chi̍t ê ìn I kóng, “Lāu-su, góa chhōa góa ê kiáⁿ lâi chhē lí, i hō͘ kúi hū-sin bōe kóng-ōe.

Bô-lūn tī tó-ūi, kúi chi̍t-ē hū-sin, kā i siak-tó, i chiū phū pe̍h-pho-nōa, kā chhùi-khí-kun, kui seng-khu ngī-khok-khok. Góa chhiáⁿ lí ê bûn-tô͘ kā kúi kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, in lóng bô hoat-tō͘.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Ài ah, m̄-sìn ê sè-tāi! Góa tio̍h kap lín tòa jōa kú? Góa tio̍h koh jím-nāi lín jōa kú? Kā i chhōa-lâi góa chia.”
In chiū kā i chhōa--lâi. Hit-ê kúi chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘, sûi-sî hō͘ hit-ê gín-á thiu-chhoah, tó tī thô͘-kha kō-lâi-kō-khì, phū pe̍h-pho-nōa.
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g i ê lāu-pē, “I án-ni jōa kú ah?” I ìn kóng, “Tùi sòe-hàn chiū án-ni.
Kúi tiāⁿ-tiāⁿ kā i hiat-lo̍h hé, chhia-lo̍h chúi, beh kā i hāi-sí. Lí nā ōe, kiû lí khó-lîn goán, pang-chān goán!”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí ná kóng ‘Lí nā ōe’? Ū sìn ê lâng ta̍k-hāng lóng ōe.”
Gín-á ê lāu-pē sûi-sî hoah kóng, “Góa sìn! Góa ê sìn bô-kàu, kiû lí pang-chān!”

Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h kûn-chiòng cháu óa--lâi, giâm-giâm chek-pī hit-ê siâ-sîn, kóng, “Lí chit-ê é-káu koh chhàu-hī ê kúi, góa bēng-lēng lí tùi chit-ê gín-á chhut--lâi, m̄-chún lí koh ji̍p--khì!”
Kúi tōa-siaⁿ hoah, hō͘ hit-ê gín-á tōa thiu-chhoah chiah chhut--khì. Hit-ê gín-á pìⁿ-chòe kap sí-lâng siâng-khoán, só͘-í tōa-pō͘-hūn ê lâng kóng, “I sí--khì lah.”
Chóng-sī Iâ-so͘ khan gín-á ê chhiú, kā i hû--khí-lâi, i chiū khí--lâi.
Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi, i ê bûn-tô͘ su-hā kā I mn̄g, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ goán bô hoat-tō͘ kā kúi kóaⁿ--chhut-khì?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Chit-chióng kúi chí-ū khò kî-tó chiah kóaⁿ ōe chhut--khì.”
Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ lī-khui hia, keng-kè Ka-lī-lī. Iâ-so͘ bô ài lâng chai I tī tó-ūi,
in-ūi I tú-teh kà-sī bûn-tô͘, tùi in kóng, “Jîn-chú ōe hō͘ lâng chhut-bōe, in ōe kā I hāi-sí, sí-liáu saⁿ ji̍t āu ōe koh-oa̍h.”
In bōe bêng-pe̍k chit-kù ōe, koh m̄-káⁿ kā I mn̄g.
In lâi kàu Ka-pek-lông. Iâ-so͘ tī chhù--ni̍h ê sî mn̄g bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Lín tī lō͘-tiong teh gī-lūn sím-mi̍h?”
In lóng tiām-tiām, in-ūi tī lō͘-tiong in hō͘-siōng teh cheng-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng siōng tōa.
Iâ-so͘ chē--lo̍h-khì, kiò cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ lâi, tùi in kóng, “Nā ū lâng beh chòe tē-it, tio̍h chòe chèng-lâng ê siōng lō͘-bé, chòe chèng-lâng ê chhe-ēng.”
I chiū khan chi̍t ê gín-á lâi, hō͘ i khiā tī in tiong-kan, kā i phō--khí-lâi, tùi in kóng,

“Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng nā ūi-tio̍h góa ê miâ chiap-la̍p chi̍t ê chit-khoán gín-á, chiū-sī chiap-la̍p góa. Chiap-la̍p góa--ê, m̄-sī chiap-la̍p góa, sī chiap-la̍p chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi.”
Iok-hān tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, goán ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê lâng hōng lí ê miâ kóaⁿ-kúi, goán kā i chó͘-tòng, in-ūi i bô teh tè lán.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “M̄-thang kā i chó͘-tòng, in-ūi bô lâng ōe hōng góa ê miâ kiâⁿ sîn-jiah, sûi-sî koh kóng góa ê pháiⁿ-ōe.
Bô hoán-tùi lán--ê chiū-sī ūi lán.
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng, in-ūi lín sio̍k Ki-tok, ēng chi̍t poe chúi hō͘ lín lim, i it-tēng ōe tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng hō͘ sìn góa ê lâng tiong-kan bî-sòe ê chi̍t ê hoān-chōe, i khah hó hō͘ lâng ēng tōa chio̍h-bō kā i tiàu tī ām-kún, hiat-lo̍h hái.
“Lí ê chhiú nā hō͘ lí hoān-chōe, tio̍h chām hiat-ka̍k, lêng-khó kiám chi̍t ki chhiú ji̍p éng-oán-oa̍h, pí siang-chhiú hó-hó lo̍h tōe-ge̍k hō͘ bōe hoa ê hé sio khah hó.
Lí ê kha nā hō͘ lí hoān-chōe, tio̍h chām hiat-ka̍k, lêng-khó kiám chi̍t ki kha ji̍p éng-oán-oa̍h, pí siang-kha hó-hó hō͘ lâng hiat-lo̍h tōe-ge̍k khah hó.
Lí ê ba̍k-chiu nā hō͘ lí hoān-chōe, tio̍h ó͘ hiat-ka̍k, lêng-khó kiám chi̍t lúi ba̍k-chiu ji̍p Siōng-tè-kok, pí nn̄g lúi ba̍k-chiu hó-hó hō͘ lâng hiat-lo̍h tōe-ge̍k khah hó.
Tī tōe-ge̍k, thâng bōe sí, hé bōe hoa.
“Ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tio̍h ēng hé liān, chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng iâm sīⁿ.
Iâm chin ū lō͘-ēng; m̄-kú iâm nā sit-khì kiâm-bī, beh án-chóaⁿ koh hō͘ i kiâm? Lín ka-kī tio̍h ū iâm ê chok-iōng, hō͘-siōng hô-hó.”
Iâ-so͘ lī-khui hit só͘-chāi ji̍p-khì Iû-thài tōe-khu, kè-khì Iok-tàn-hô ê hit-pêng hōaⁿ. Kûn-chiòng koh chū-chi̍p khì I hia, I koh chiàu-siông kà-sī in.
Ū chi̍t-kóa Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng beh chhì-thàm Iâ-so͘, óa-lâi mn̄g I kóng, “Tiōng-hu lî i ê bó͘ ū ha̍h Lu̍t-hoat bô?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “ Mô͘-se ū hō͘ lín sím-mi̍h bēng-lēng?”
In kóng, “ Mô͘-se ún-chún lâng siá lî-hun-su chiū thang lî i ê bó͘.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “ Mô͘-se sī in-ūi lín ê sim ngī chiah siá chit-tiâu kài-bēng hō͘ lín.
M̄-kú khí-thâu chhòng-chō ê sî, Siōng-tè chō lâng, ū lâm ū lú.
In-ūi chit-ê lí-iû, lâng ōe lī-khui i ê pē-bú, kap i ê bó͘ kiat-ha̍p,
nn̄g lâng chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé. Án-ni, in í-keng m̄-sī nn̄g ê, sī chi̍t-thé.
Só͘-í, Siōng-tè só͘ phòe-ha̍p--ê, lâng m̄-thang thiah-khui.”
In ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi ê sî, bûn-tô͘ koh mn̄g Iâ-so͘ chit-ê tāi-chì.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng, lî i ê bó͘ khì chhōa pa̍t-ê hū-jîn-lâng chiū-sī hoān kan-îm, ko͘-hū i ê bó͘;
bó͘ nā lî i ê tiōng-hu khì kè pa̍t-lâng mā-sī hoān kan-îm.”
Ū lâng chhōa gín-á lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, ài I kā in hōaⁿ-chhiú chiok-hok; bûn-tô͘ kā in chek-pī.
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chin siū-khì, tùi bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Hō͘ gín-á lâi góa chia, m̄-thang kā in chó͘-tòng, in-ūi Siōng-tè-kok sī chit-khoán lâng ê.
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, lâng nā bô chhin-chhiūⁿ gín-á án-ni chiap-siū Siōng-tè-kok, choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng ji̍p--khì.”
Iâ-so͘ chiū kā in phō, hōaⁿ-chhiú chiok-hok.

Iâ-so͘ tú-beh chhut-gōa ê sî, ū chi̍t ê lâng cháu--lâi, kūi tī I ê bīn-chêng, mn̄g I kóng, “Hó ê Lāu-su, góa tio̍h chòe sím-mi̍h chiah ōe-tàng sêng-siū éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā?”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí ná ōe kóng góa sī hó? Siōng-tè í-gōa, bô chi̍t ê sī hó.
Chiah-ê kài-bēng lí lóng bat: M̄-thang hāi-sí lâng; m̄-thang kan-îm; m̄-thang thau-the̍h; m̄-thang choh gūi-chèng; m̄-thang chà-khi; tio̍h hàu-kèng pē-bú.”
Hit-ê lâng ìn Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, chiah-ê kài-bēng góa tùi sòe-hàn chiū it-ti̍t ū teh chun-siú.”

Iâ-so͘ chù-ba̍k khòaⁿ i, thiàⁿ i, kā i kóng, “Lí iáu khiàm chi̍t hāng; lí khì, khì bōe só͘-ū--ê lâi pun hō͘ sàn-chhiah-lâng, lí tī thiⁿ-téng chiū ū châi-pó, jiân-āu lâi tè góa.”
Hit-ê lâng chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-kù ōe, bīn sit-sek, iu-iu-chhiû-chhiû lī-khui; in-ūi i châi-sán chin chōe.
Iâ-so͘ sì-chiu-ûi khòaⁿ chi̍t lìn, kā bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Ū-chîⁿ-lâng ji̍p Siōng-tè-kok jōa-á-ni̍h khùn-lân!”
Bûn-tô͘ thiaⁿ-tio̍h I só͘ kóng ê ōe, hui-siông tio̍h-kiaⁿ. Iâ-so͘ koh kā in kóng, “Sòe-kiáⁿ ah, ji̍p Siōng-tè-kok chin-chiàⁿ khùn-lân!
Lo̍k-tô chhng-kè chiam-phīⁿ mā pí hó-gia̍h-lâng ji̍p Siōng-tè-kok koh-khah kán-tan.”
Bûn-tô͘ koh-khah tio̍h-kiaⁿ, tāi-ke kóng-lâi-kóng-khì, “Nā án-ni, sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h kiù?”
Iâ-so͘ chù-ba̍k kā in khòaⁿ, kóng, “Chit-ê sū, lâng chòe bōe kàu, Siōng-tè chiū m̄-sī án-ni, in-ūi Siōng-tè ta̍k-hāng lóng ōe.”
Pí-tek chiū kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Goán í-keng pàng-sak it-chhè lâi tè lí.”

Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng, nā ūi-tio̍h góa kap hok-im ê iân-kò͘ pàng-sak chhù-the̍h, hiaⁿ-tī, chí-bē, lāu-bú, lāu-pē, kiáⁿ-jî, á-sī chhân-hn̂g,
tī kim-sè ōe tit-tio̍h pah-pē ê chhù-the̍h, hiaⁿ-tī, chí-bē, lāu-bú, kiáⁿ-jî, kap chhân-hn̂g, koh ū pek-hāi; tī lâi-sè ōe tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Chóng-sī chin chōe chòe thâu-chêng--ê ōe chòe siōng lō͘-bé; siōng lō͘-bé--ê ōe chòe siōng thâu-chêng.”

Iâ-so͘ kap I ê bûn-tô͘ chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lō͘-tiong, I kiâⁿ tī thâu-chêng; bûn-tô͘ kám-kak chin kî-koài, tè ê lâng chin kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. Iâ-so͘ koh chi̍t piàn chhōa cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ khì piⁿ--á, chiong I teh-beh tú--tio̍h ê sū kā in kóng,
“Taⁿ lán beh chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; Jîn-chú ōe siū chhut-bōe hō͘ chè-si-tiúⁿ kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su. In ōe kā I tēng sí-chōe, āu-lâi chiong I kau hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng.
In ōe kā I hì-lāng, phùi-nōa, piⁿ-phah, hāi--sí; saⁿ ji̍t āu, I ōe koh-oa̍h.”
Se-pì-thài ê kiáⁿ Ngá-kok kap Iok-hān kiâⁿ chìn-chêng, kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, goán só͘ kiû--ê, chhiáⁿ lí kā goán sêng-choân.”
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g kóng, “Lín ài góa kā lín chòe sím-mi̍h?”
In kóng, “Lí tit-tio̍h êng-kng ê sî, chhiáⁿ hō͘ goán chi̍t ê chē lí ê chiàⁿ-pêng, chi̍t ê chē lí ê tò-pêng.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín m̄ chai ka-kī teh kiû sím-mi̍h. Góa lim ê poe, lín ōe-tàng lim bōe? Góa siū ê sóe, lín ōe-tàng siū bōe?”
In kóng, “Goán ōe!” Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa só͘ lim ê poe, lín beh lim; góa só͘ siū ê sóe, lín beh siū,
put-kò chē góa ê chiàⁿ-pêng tò-pêng m̄-sī góa ōe-tàng hō͘ lâng--ê. Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h sím-mi̍h-lâng chún-pī chiū hō͘ hit-ê lâng.”
Kî-tha hit cha̍p ê bûn-tô͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū tùi Ngá-kok kap Iok-hān siū-khì.
Iâ-so͘ kiò in lâi, kā in kóng, “Lín chai, tī Gōa-pang-lâng ê tiong-kan, hiah-ê hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe thóng-tī-chiá--ê chòe chú kā in koán-hat, in ê léng-siù kā in chi-phòe.
Put-kò lín tiong-kan chiū m̄ eng-kai án-ni. Lín tiong-kan ài chòe tōa--ê tio̍h chòe lín ê chhe-ēng;
ài chòe tē-it--ê tio̍h chòe chèng-lâng ê po̍k-jîn.
In-ūi Jîn-chú lâi, m̄-sī beh hō͘ lâng ho̍k-sāi, hoán-tńg sī beh kā lâng ho̍k-sāi, sīm-chì hi-seng ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā lâi sio̍k-hôe chin chōe lâng.”

Iâ-so͘ kap I ê bûn-tô͘ lâi kàu Iâ-lī-ko. In kap chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng beh tùi Iâ-lī-ko chhut--khì ê sî, ū chi̍t ê sit-bêng ê khit-chia̍h, Tí-mái ê kiáⁿ Pa-tí-mái, chē tī lō͘-piⁿ.
I thiaⁿ-kóng Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘ tùi hia kè, chiū hoah, “ Tāi-pi̍t ê Kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘, lîn-bín góa!”
Chin chōe lâng kā i chek-pī, kiò i tiām-tiām, m̄-kú i jú tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “ Tāi-pi̍t ê Kiáⁿ, lîn-bín góa!”
Iâ-so͘ thêng-kha, kóng, “Kiò i lâi!” In chiū khì kiò hit-ê bông-jîn, kā i kóng, “An-sim, khí--lâi! I teh kiò lí.”
Bông-jîn chiū chiong gōa-saⁿ hiat-tiāu, thiàu--khí-lâi, lâi kàu Iâ-so͘ hia.
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí ài góa kā lí chòe sím-mi̍h?” Bông-jîn ìn kóng, “Lia̍p-pho-nî, góa ài koh khòaⁿ--kìⁿ!”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí tńg--khì. Lí ê sìn-sim hō͘ lí tit-tio̍h i-hó!” Bông-jîn sûi-sî koh ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū kui-lō͘ tè Iâ-so͘.
Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ teh-beh kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, lâi kàu Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ soaⁿ-kha ê Pek-hoat-kî kap Pek-tāi-nî ê sî, I chhe nn̄g ê bûn-tô͘,
kā in kóng, “Lín khì tùi-bīn ê chng-siā, ji̍p--khì, sûi-sî ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chiah m̄-bat hō͘ lâng khiâ--kè ê lû-á-kiáⁿ pa̍k tī hia; lín kā i tháu-khui, khan-lâi chia.
Nā ū lâng mn̄g lín sī-án-chóaⁿ án-ni chòe, tio̍h kā i kóng, ‘Chú beh ēng i, liâm-piⁿ ōe koh khan tńg-lâi hêng.’”
In khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h lō͘-piⁿ ū chi̍t chiah lû-á-kiáⁿ pa̍k tī mn̂g-kháu, chiū kā i tháu-khui.
Ū chi̍t-kóa khiā tī hia ê lâng mn̄g in kóng, “Lín tháu lû-á-kiáⁿ beh chhòng sím-mi̍h?”
In chiàu Iâ-so͘ só͘ hoan-hù--ê kā in hôe-tap; hiah-ê lâng chiū chún in khan--khì.
In khan hit-chiah lû-á-kiáⁿ lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, chiong ka-kī ê gōa-saⁿ phoa̍h tī lû-á téng, Iâ-so͘ chiū peh-khí-khì khiâ.
Ū chin chōe lâng ēng in ê gōa-saⁿ pho͘ tī lō͘--ni̍h, mā ū lâng tùi iá-gōa chhò chhiū-oe pho͘ tī lō͘--ni̍h kā I hoan-gêng.
Chêng-kiâⁿ-āu-tè ê lâng tōa-siaⁿ hoah: Hô-sàn-ná! Hōng Chú ê miâ lâi Hit-ūi eng-kai siū chheng-chàn!
Teh-beh lâi lán chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t ê ông-kok eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè, hô-sàn-ná!
Iâ-so͘ chìn-ji̍p Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, ji̍p-khì Sèng-tiān, ta̍k-hāng khòaⁿ chi̍t lìn. In-ūi thiⁿ í-keng àm, I chiū kap cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ chhut siâⁿ khì Pek-tāi-nî.
Keh-ji̍t, Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ tùi Pek-tāi-nî chhut--lâi ê sî, Iâ-so͘ pak-tó͘ iau.

I tī hn̄g-hn̄g khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t châng ū chin chōe hio̍h ê bû-hoa-kó-chhiū, chiū kiâⁿ óa-khì beh khòaⁿ ū ké-chí á bô. I kiâⁿ kàu hia, chhiū-téng hio̍h-á í-gōa, lóng bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h pòaⁿ-hāng, in-ūi m̄-sī bû-hoa-kó ê kùi-chiat.
I chiū tùi hit-châng bû-hoa-kó-chhiū kóng, “Éng-oán bô lâng ōe koh chia̍h lí ê ké-chí!” I ê bûn-tô͘ lóng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h.

Āu-lâi in lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì Sèng-tiān, khí-chhiú chiong tī tiān-lāi teh bóe-bōe ê lâng kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, koh chhia-tó ōaⁿ-chîⁿ ê lâng ê toh kap bōe hún-chiáu ê lâng ê í.
I mā m̄-chún lâng the̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ ēng Sèng-tiān chòe thong-lō͘ kè-lâi-kè-khì.
I kà-sī in kóng, “Sèng-keng kiám bô kì-chài: Góa ê chhù beh kiò-chòe bān-bîn kî-tó ê tiān, lín soah kā i pìⁿ-chòe thó͘-húi-á khut.”
Chè-si-tiúⁿ kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū it-ti̍t siūⁿ pān-hoat beh hāi-sí Iâ-so͘, m̄-kú in kiaⁿ I, in-ūi kûn-chiòng tùi I ê kà-sī lóng chin kám-ho̍k.
Hông-hun ê sî, Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ chhut-khì siâⁿ-gōa.
Keh-chá-khí, Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ tùi hia keng-kè ê sî, khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-châng bû-hoa-kó-chhiū kui-châng lóng ta--khì.
Pí-tek ōe-kì--tit, chiū kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lia̍p-pí, lí khòaⁿ, lí chiù-chó͘ hit-châng bû-hoa-kó-chhiū í-keng ta--khì.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lín tio̍h sìn Siōng-tè.

Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng tùi chit-chō soaⁿ kóng ‘Khí--lâi, khì thiām-hái’, i sim nā bô giâu-gî, sìn só͘ kóng--ê it-tēng ōe si̍t-hiān, mā ōe án-ni hō͘ i si̍t-hiān.
Só͘-í, góa kā lín kóng, lín kî-tó ê sî bô-lūn kiû sím-mi̍h, sìn í-keng tit--tio̍h chiū ōe tit--tio̍h.
Lín khiā-teh kî-tó ê sî, nā tùi bó͘-lâng sim ū put-pêng, tio̍h kā i sià-bián; án-ni, lín ê Thiⁿ-pē mā ōe sià-bián lín ê kè-sit.”
In koh lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. Iâ-so͘ tī Sèng-tiān teh kiâⁿ ê sî, chè-si-tiúⁿ, keng-ha̍k-kàu-su, kap tiúⁿ-ló lâi I hia,
mn̄g I kóng, “Lí khò sím-mi̍h koân-pèng chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì? Sím-mi̍h-lâng hō͘ lí chit-ê koân-pèng lâi chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì?”
Iâ-so͘ kā in ìn kóng, “Góa beh mn̄g lín chi̍t kù ōe. Lín kā góa ìn-tap, góa chiah kā lín kóng góa khò sím-mi̍h koân-pèng chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì.
Iok-hān sóe-lé ê koân-pèng sī tùi Thiⁿ á-sī tùi lâng lâi--ê? Lín kā góa kóng.”
In hō͘-siōng gī-lūn kóng, “Lán nā kóng ‘Tùi Thiⁿ’, I ōe kóng ‘Án-ni lín sī-án-chóaⁿ bô sìn Iok-hān?’
M̄-kú lán nā kóng ‘Tùi lâng’, khióng-kiaⁿ kûn-chiòng hoán-kám, in-ūi in lóng siūⁿ-kóng Iok-hān chin-chiàⁿ sī sian-ti.”
In chiū ìn Iâ-so͘, “Goán m̄ chai.” Iâ-so͘ chiū tùi in kóng, “Án-ni, góa mā m̄ kā lín kóng góa khò sím-mi̍h koân-pèng chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì.”

Iâ-so͘ koh ēng phì-jū tùi in kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê lâng khai-khún chi̍t khu phû-tô-hn̂g, sì-bīn ûi lî-pa, ó͘ chi̍t ê chiú-khut, khí chi̍t ê siú-bōng-tâi, chiong chit-khu hn̂g cho͘ hō͘ tiān-lông, āu-lâi chhut-gōa khì chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi.
Siu-sêng ê sî kàu, i chhe chi̍t ê po̍k-jîn khì tiān-lông hia, beh kā in siu hn̂g--ni̍h ê ké-chí.
In lia̍h hit-ê po̍k-jîn, kā i phah, kóaⁿ i khang-chhiú tò--khì.
I koh chhe lēng-gōa chi̍t ê po̍k-jîn khì, in siong-hāi i ê thâu-khak, kā i bú-jio̍k.
Āu-lâi, hn̂g-chú koh chhe pa̍t-ê po̍k-jîn khì, in kā i thâi-sí. I koh chhe chin chōe po̍k-jîn khì, ū-ê hō͘ in phah, ū-ê hō͘ in thâi-sí.
I iáu ū chi̍t ê, chiū-sī só͘ thiàⁿ ê kiáⁿ, chòe-āu mā chhe i khì tiān-lông hia, siūⁿ-kóng ‘In ōe chun-tiōng góa ê kiáⁿ’.
M̄-kú hiah-ê tiān-lông chham-siông kóng, ‘Chit-ê sī i ê kè-sêng-jîn. Lâi, lán lâi kā thâi-sí, i ê châi-sán chiū pìⁿ-chòe lán ê.’
In chiū kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi, kā i thâi-sí, kā hiat chhut-khì phû-tô-hn̂g ê gōa-bīn.
“Án-ni, phû-tô-hn̂g ê chú-lâng ōe án-chóaⁿ chhú-lí? I ōe lâi châu-bia̍t chiah-ê tiān-lông, chiong phû-tô-hn̂g cho͘ hō͘ pa̍t-lâng.
Lín kiám m̄-bat tha̍k-tio̍h chit-tōaⁿ Sèng-keng ê kì-chài: Khí-chhù sai-hū só͘ khì-sak ê chio̍h í-keng chiâⁿ-chòe siōng tiōng-iàu ê ki-chio̍h.
Che sī Chú ê chok-ûi, tùi lán lâi khòaⁿ si̍t-chāi chin kî-biāu.”
Hiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-tō-chiá chai-iáⁿ Iâ-so͘ kóng chit-ê phì-jū sī teh chí in, chiū siūⁿ-beh kā I lia̍h, m̄-kú kiaⁿ kûn-chiòng, chiū lī-khui.
In chhe kúi-nā ê Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng kap Hi-lu̍t-tóng ê lâng khì Iâ-so͘ hia, beh chhē I ê ōe-pìⁿ thang kā I hām-hāi.

In chiū khì, tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, goán chai lí chin sêng-si̍t, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h khoán lâng, lí tùi-thāi in lóng bô chha-pia̍t, lí chí-ū tiong-si̍t kà-sī Siōng-tè ê tō-lí. Án-ni, la̍p-sè hō͘ Lô-má hông-tè Khái-sat ū ha̍h Lu̍t-hoat bô? Goán tio̍h la̍p-sè á m̄-bián?”
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-chhut in ê khúi-kè, chiū tùi in kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ beh kā góa chhì-thàm? The̍h chi̍t ê gûn-pè hō͘ góa khòaⁿ-bāi leh.”
In chiū the̍h chi̍t ê gûn-pè lâi. Iâ-so͘ mn̄g in, “Che sī sím-mi̍h-lâng ê siōng, sím-mi̍h-lâng ê jī-hō?” In ìn kóng, “Khái-sat ê.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Khái-sat ê mi̍h hō͘ Khái-sat; Siōng-tè ê mi̍h hō͘ Siōng-tè.” In tùi Iâ-so͘ kám-kak chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Ū chi̍t-kóa chú-tiuⁿ bô koh-oa̍h ê Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, mn̄g I kóng,

“Lāu-su, Mô͘-se só͘ siá ê Lu̍t-hoat kā goán kóng, ‘Nā ū lâng i ê hiaⁿ-ko sí--khì, pàng bó͘ bô pàng kiáⁿ, i choh sió-tī--ê tio̍h chhōa hiaⁿ-só thòe hiaⁿ-ko thoân-chong-chiap-tāi.’
Í-chêng bat ū chhit ê hiaⁿ-tī, siōng-tōa--ê chhōa-bó͘, bô lâu hō͘-tāi chiū sí--khì.
Tē-jī--ê chhōa i ê hiaⁿ-só, mā bô lâu hō͘-tāi chiū sí--khì. Tē-saⁿ--ê mā siâng-khoán.
Chit chhit ê hiaⁿ-tī lóng bô lâu hō͘-tāi, chòe-āu chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng mā sí--khì.
Koh-oa̍h ê sî, in lóng koh-oa̍h, án-ni chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng sī tó chi̍t ê lâng ê bó͘? In-ūi chit chhit ê lóng bat chhōa i chòe bó͘.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín m̄-tio̍h, in-ūi lín m̄ bat Sèng-keng, mā m̄ bat Siōng-tè ê koân-lêng.
In tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h ê sî, kap thiⁿ-téng ê thiⁿ-sài siâng-khoán, bô kè bô chhōa.

Koan-hē sí-lâng koh-oa̍h, lín kiám m̄-bat tha̍k-tio̍h Mô͘-se ê chheh ‘Teh to̍h ê chhì-phè’ hit-tōaⁿ? Siōng-tè tùi Mô͘-se kóng, ‘Góa sī A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, Í-sat ê Siōng-tè, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè.’
I m̄-sī sí-lâng ê Siōng-tè, sī oa̍h-lâng ê Siōng-tè. Lín oân-choân m̄-tio̍h!”

Ū chi̍t ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su lâi, thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ kap Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng teh piān-lūn, khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘ ìn liáu chin tio̍h, chiū mn̄g I, “Só͘-ū ê kài-bēng tiong, tó chi̍t tiâu tē-it tiōng-iàu?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Tē-it sī: Í-sek-lia̍t ah, lín tio̍h thiaⁿ! Chú — lán ê Siōng-tè sī to̍k-it ê Chú.
Lí tio̍h choân-sim, choân-chêng, choân-ì, choân-le̍k thiàⁿ Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè.
Tē-jī sī: Tio̍h thiàⁿ chhù-piⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī. Bô pa̍t-ê kài-bēng pí chiah-ê koh-khah tiōng-iàu.”
Hit-ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, lí só͘ kóng--ê chin tio̍h. Lí kóng Siōng-tè chí-ū chi̍t ūi, I í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê;

koh kóng tio̍h ēng choân-sim, choân-tì, choân-le̍k thiàⁿ Siōng-tè, koh thiàⁿ chhù-piⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī sī pí hiàn lóng-chóng ê sio-hòa-chè kap chè-mi̍h koh-khah iàu-kín.”
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ìn liáu chin ū tì-hūi, chiū kā i kóng, “Lí lī Siōng-tè-kok bô hn̄g.” Hit-sî í-āu, bô lâng káⁿ koh mn̄g Iâ-so͘ sím-mi̍h būn-tôe.
Iâ-so͘ tī Sèng-tiān teh kà-sī ê sî, mn̄g kóng, “Keng-ha̍k-kàu-su ná ōe kóng Ki-tok sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi?
Tāi-pi̍t pún-sin siū Sèng Sîn kám-tōng kóng: Chú kā góa ê Chú kóng: Lí chē góa ê chiàⁿ-pêng, kàu góa hō͘ lí ê tùi-te̍k khut-ho̍k tī lí kha-ē.
Tāi-pi̍t pún-sin chheng-ho͘ Ki-tok chòe ‘Chú’, Ki-tok ná ōe sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi?” Ū chi̍t tōa-kûn lâng ài thiaⁿ Iâ-so͘ ê kà-sī.
Iâ-so͘ kà-sī kóng, “Tio̍h tî-hông keng-ha̍k-kàu-su. In ài chhēng tn̂g-saⁿ kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì, tī chhī-tiûⁿ-kháu hō͘ lâng chhéng-an,
tī hōe-tn̂g chē koân-ūi, tī iàn-hōe chē tōa-ūi.
In chhim-chiàm kóaⁿ-hū ê ke-hé, thiau-kò͘-ì kî-tó chin tn̂g. In ōe siū koh-khah tāng ê hêng-hoa̍t.”
Iâ-so͘ chē tī Sèng-tiān hōng-hiàn-kūi ê tùi-bīn teh khòaⁿ lâng hiàn chîⁿ lo̍h--khì. Chin chōe hó-gia̍h-lâng hiàn chin chōe chîⁿ.
Ū chi̍t ê sàn-chhiah ê kóaⁿ-hū lâi, hiàn nn̄g ê tâng-chîⁿ-á, chiū-sī chi̍t kak gûn.
Iâ-so͘ kiò bûn-tô͘ lâi, kā in kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, chit-ê sàn-chhiah ê kóaⁿ-hū hiàn ji̍p-khì hōng-hiàn-kūi--ê, pí chèng-lâng hiàn--ê koh-khah chōe.
In-ūi in lóng sī hiàn ēng chhun--ê, m̄-kú chit-ê kóaⁿ-hū sui-jiân chin sàn-chhiah, iáu-kú the̍h só͘-ū--ê, chiū-sī choân-pō͘ ê seng-oa̍h-hùi lóng hiàn--lo̍h-khì.”
Iâ-so͘ tùi Sèng-tiān chhut--lâi ê sî, ū chi̍t ê bûn-tô͘ tùi I kóng, “Lāu-su, lí khòaⁿ, chio̍h chiah-ni̍h tōa tè! Kiàn-tio̍k-bu̍t chiah-ni̍h tông-hông!”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín teh khòaⁿ chiah-ê tōa ê kiàn-tio̍k-bu̍t o͘h. Tī chia, chiah-ê lóng ōe siū thiah-húi, thiah kah bô chi̍t tè chio̍h ōe tha̍h tī pa̍t-tè téng-bīn.”
Iâ-so͘ tī Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ -téng, bīn ǹg Sèng-tiān teh chē ê sî, Pí-tek, Ngá-kok, Iok-hān, kap An-tek-lia̍t su-hā kā I mn̄g,
“Chhiáⁿ kā goán kóng, chit-ê tāi-chì sím-mi̍h sî ōe hoat-seng? Chiah-ê it-chhè ê tāi-chì teh-beh oân-sêng ê sî ū sím-mi̍h tiāu-thâu?”
Iâ-so͘ chiū kā in kóng, “Tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bián siū bê-he̍k.
Ū chin chōe lâng ōe lī-iōng góa ê miâ lâi, kóng ‘Góa chiū-sī Ki-tok’ lâi bê-he̍k chin chōe lâng.
Lín thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiàn-cheng í-ki̍p chiàn-cheng ê hong-siaⁿ ê sî, m̄-bián kiaⁿ. Chiah-ê tāi-chì it-tēng ōe hoat-seng, m̄-kú chiong-kio̍k iáu-bē kàu.
In-ūi bîn-cho̍k ōe khí-lâi kong-kek bîn-cho̍k, kok-ka kong-kek kok-ka. Chin chōe só͘-chāi ū tōe-tāng, ū ki-hng. Chiah-ê tāi-chì put-kò sī chhui-chūn thàng-thiàⁿ ê khai-sí.

“Lín ka-kī tio̍h kín-sīn, lín ōe hō͘ lâng kau hō͘ gī-hōe, tī hōe-tn̂g siū piⁿ-phah. Lín ōe ūi-tio̍h góa ê iân-kò͘ khiā tī chóng-tok kap kun-ông ê bīn-chêng, tùi in chòe kiàn-chèng.
M̄-kú hok-im it-tēng tio̍h tāi-seng thoân hō͘ bān-bîn.

In kā lín lia̍h-khì kau hō͘ hoat-têng ê sî, m̄-bián seng hoân-ló beh kóng sím-mi̍h, hit-sî lín tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h chí-sī chiū chiàu án-ni kóng, in-ūi teh kóng--ê m̄-sī lín ka-kī, sī Sèng Sîn.
Hiaⁿ-tī ōe chhut-bōe hiaⁿ-tī, hō͘ i sí; lāu-pē mā ōe án-ni tùi-thāi kiáⁿ-jî. Kiáⁿ-jî ōe khí-lâi kong-kek pē-bú, kā in hāi-sí.
Lín ōe in-ūi góa ê miâ hō͘ chèng-lâng oàn-hūn, m̄-kú jím-nāi kàu chòe-āu ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h kiù.”

“Tng lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê ‘Khó-ò͘ⁿ ê Húi-bia̍t-chiá’ khiā tī m̄ eng-kai khiā ê só͘-chāi — tha̍k ê lâng tio̍h bêng-pe̍k chit-kù ōe ê ì-sù — hit-sî tī Iû-thài ê lâng tio̍h tô-cháu khì soaⁿ-lāi;
tī chhù-téng--ê, m̄-thang lo̍h--lâi, mā m̄-thang ji̍p-khì chhù-lāi the̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ;
tī hn̂g--ni̍h-ê, m̄-thang tńg-khì hiahⁿ gōa-saⁿ.
Tī hiah-ê ji̍t-chí, ū sin-īn--ê kap hō͘ eⁿ-á chia̍h-lin ê hū-jîn-lâng hui-siông put-hēng!
Tio̍h kî-tó, chiah-ê tāi-chì chiah bián tī tang-thiⁿ hoat-seng.
In-ūi tī hiah-ê ji̍t-chí teh-beh ū chai-lān, sī tùi Siōng-tè chhòng-chō bān-mi̍h í-lâi m̄-bat ū--ê, chiong-lâi mā bōe koh ū.
Chú nā bô kiám-chió hiah-ê ji̍t-chí, bô lâng ōe tit-tio̍h kiù; m̄-kú ūi-tio̍h I só͘ kéng ê soán-bîn, I í-keng ū kiám-chió hiah-ê ji̍t-chí.
“Hit-sî, nā ū lâng kā lín kóng ‘Lín khòaⁿ, Ki-tok tī chia’, á-sī kóng ‘Lín khòaⁿ, I tī hia’, m̄-thang siong-sìn.
In-ūi ū chi̍t-kóa ké Ki-tok kap ké sian-ti ōe chhut-hiān, kiâⁿ sîn-jiah kî-sū, nā ōe-tàng, liân soán-bîn to beh kā in bê-he̍k.
Tio̍h kín-sīn; góa í-keng chiong it-chhè lóng seng kā lín kóng lah.”
“Tī hit-ê chai-lān kè-liáu hiah-ê ji̍t-chí, ji̍t ōe pìⁿ o͘-àm, ge̍h bōe hoat-kng,
chhiⁿ ōe tùi thiⁿ-téng lak--lo̍h-lâi, thiⁿ-téng ê kng-thé lóng ōe iô-choah.
Hit-sî, lâng ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Jîn-chú chhiong-móa tōa koân-lêng kap êng-kng chē-hûn lâi-lîm.
I ōe chhe-khián thiⁿ-sài tùi sì-hng, tùi tōe ê chit-pêng kàu thiⁿ ê hit-pêng chū-chi̍p I ê soán-bîn.”
“Tio̍h tùi bû-hoa-kó-chhiū ha̍k-si̍p: Ki puh-íⁿ hoat-hio̍h ê sî, lín chiū chai joa̍h-thiⁿ teh-beh kàu.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng ê sî chiū chai Jîn-chú í-keng chiap-kūn, kàu mn̂g-kháu lah.
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, chit sè-tāi iáu-bē kè--khì, che it-chhè lóng ōe hoat-seng.
Thiⁿ kap tōe ōe siau-sit, m̄-kú góa ê ōe choa̍t-tùi bōe siau-sit.”
“Koan-hē hit-ê ji̍t, hit-ê sî, bô lâng chai; thiⁿ-téng ê thiⁿ-sài m̄ chai, Kiáⁿ mā m̄ chai, chí-ū Pē chai.
Tio̍h kín-sīn, tio̍h kéng-séng, in-ūi lín m̄ chai hit-ê sî-khek sím-mi̍h sî ōe kàu.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ ū chi̍t ê lâng beh chhut-gōa, chiong koân kau hō͘ po̍k-jîn, hun-phòe kang-chok hō͘ ta̍k-ê lâng, koh hoan-hù siú-ōe sió-sim kò͘-siú.

Só͘-í, tio̍h kéng-séng, chiah bián chit-ke ê chú-lâng hut-jiân tńg--lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín teh khùn, in-ūi lín m̄ chai i sím-mi̍h sî ōe tńg--lâi, sī hông-hun á-sī pòaⁿ-mî, sī thiⁿ beh kng á-sī ji̍t chhut ê sî.
Góa kā lín kóng ê ōe mā beh tùi chèng-lâng kóng: Tio̍h kéng-séng!”
Koh nn̄g ji̍t chiū-sī Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh kap Tû-kàⁿ-choeh. Chè-si-tiúⁿ kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su teh chhē-khòaⁿ beh ēng sím-mi̍h kè-bô͘ thang lia̍h Iâ-so͘, kā I hāi-sí;
