Iâ-so͘ siū chiap chiūⁿ-thiⁿ ê ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, chiū koat-ì beh khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
I chhe-phài sù-chiá tāi-seng khì. In ji̍p-khì Sat-má-lī-a -lâng ê chng-thâu, ūi-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ chún-pī.
Hit só͘-chāi ê lâng bô hoan-gêng Iâ-so͘, in-ūi I beh khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
I ê bûn-tô͘ Ngá-kok kap Iok-hān khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū kóng, “Chú ah, goán tùi thiⁿ-téng kiò hé lo̍h-lâi kā in húi-bia̍t hó--bô?”
Iâ-so͘ oa̍t--kè-lâi, kā in chek-pī.
In chiū khì pa̍t-ê chng-thâu.
In tī lō͘-tiong ê sî, ū chi̍t ê lâng tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lí bô-lūn khì tó-ūi, góa lóng beh tè lí.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Hô͘-lî ū khang, khong-tiong ê chiáu ū siū, put-kò Jîn-chú liân khòa thâu-khak ê só͘-chāi to bô.”
Iâ-so͘ koh tùi lēng-gōa chi̍t ê lâng kóng, “Lâi tè góa!” Hit-ê lâng ìn kóng, “Chú ah, thèng-hāu goán sī-tōa-lâng pah-hè-nî-lāu, góa chiū lâi tè lí. ”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Hō͘ sí-lâng khì bâi-chòng in ka-kī ê sí-lâng. Put-kò, lí tio̍h khì soan-káng Siōng-tè-kok ê hok-im.”
Koh ū chi̍t ê lâng kóng, “Chú ah, góa beh tè lí; put-kò hō͘ góa tāi-seng tńg-khì chhù--ni̍h kap ke-lāi ê lâng saⁿ-sî.”
Iâ-so͘ tùi i kóng, “Chhiú hōaⁿ tī lôe-bé iáu ti̍t-ti̍t oa̍t-thâu khòaⁿ āu-bīn ê lâng bô sek-ha̍p Siōng-tè-kok.”
Chiah-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, Chú lēng-gōa kéng chhit-cha̍p-jī lâng, chhe in nn̄g-ê nn̄g-ê seng khì I pún-sin siūⁿ-beh khì ê ta̍k-ê siâⁿ ta̍k-ê só͘-chāi.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Thang siu-sêng--ê chin chōe, choh-kang ê lâng chin chió. Só͘-í, lín tio̍h kî-kiû koán siu-sêng ê Chú phài kang-lâng khì siu-sêng.
Khì! Góa chhe lín chhut--khì, chhin-chhiūⁿ sàng iûⁿ-á ji̍p-khì chhâi-lông ê lāi-bīn.
M̄-thang tòa chîⁿ-tē, m̄-thang tòa lú-hêng-tē, mā m̄-thang tòa ôe, tī lō͘--ni̍h m̄-thang kā lâng chhéng-an.
Lín bô-lūn ji̍p-khì tó chi̍t keng chhù, tio̍h tāi-seng kóng ‘Goān lín chit-ke pêng-an!’
Tī hia nā ū ài pêng-an ê lâng, lín ê pêng-an ōe lâu tī in hia; nā bô, hit-ê pêng-an ōe tò-tńg-lâi kui lín.
Lín tio̍h tiàm hit-ê ke. In chún-pī sím-mi̍h, lín chiū chia̍h sím-mi̍h, lim sím-mi̍h, in-ūi choh-kang ê lâng eng-kai tit-tio̍h kang-chîⁿ. Lín m̄-thang tùi chit-ke sóa-kè hit-ke.
Lín bô-lūn ji̍p-khì tó chi̍t ê siâⁿ, lâng nā chiap-thāi lín, phâng sím-mi̍h chhut--lâi, lín chiū chia̍h sím-mi̍h.
Siâⁿ-lāi ū pīⁿ ê lâng tio̍h kā in i, sòa kā in kóng, ‘Siōng-tè ê chú-koân teh-beh si̍t-hiān lah.’
“Bô-lūn ji̍p-khì tó chi̍t ê siâⁿ, lâng nā bô hoan-gêng lín, lín tio̍h chhut-khì tōa koe-lō͘ kóng,
‘Liân lín chit-ê siâⁿ tiâu tī goán kha ê thô͘-hún, goán to beh pōaⁿ-tiāu kā lín kéng-kò; put-kò lín tio̍h chai Siōng-tè ê chú-koân teh-beh si̍t-hiān lah.’
Góa kā lín kóng, tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê Ji̍t, Só͘-to-má só͘ siū ê hêng-hoa̍t ōe pí hit-ê siâⁿ só͘ siū--ê koh-khah hó jím-siū.”

“ Ko-lia̍p-sìn, lí chhám ah! Pek-sài-tāi, lí chhám ah! Góa tī lín tiong-kan kiâⁿ ê sîn-jiah nā tī Thài-ní kap Se-tùn kiâⁿ, in chá chiū chhēng môa-saⁿ, chē tī hé-hu téng hóe-kái lah.
Tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, Thài-ní kap Se-tùn siū ê hêng-hoa̍t ōe pí lín tio̍h siū--ê khah hó jím-siū.
Lí leh, Ka-pek-lông, Lí ài lâng kā lí hû-chiūⁿ thiⁿ sī--bô? Bōe, Siōng-tè ōe kā lí hiat-lo̍h Im-hú!
“Thiaⁿ-thàn lín--ê chiū-sī thiaⁿ-thàn góa, kū-choa̍t lín--ê chiū-sī kū-choa̍t góa; kū-choa̍t góa--ê chiū-sī kū-choa̍t chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi.”
Hit chhit-cha̍p-jī lâng hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí tò--lâi, pò-kò kóng, “Chú ah, goán hōng lí ê miâ bēng-lēng, liân kúi to ho̍k-chiông goán!”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Sat-tàn chhin-chhiūⁿ sih-nà tùi thiⁿ-téng siak--lo̍h-lâi.
Tio̍h chai, góa ū sù lín koân-pèng thang ta̍h chôa kap giat-á-thâng, koh thang chè-ho̍k tùi-te̍k it-chhè ê lêng-le̍k; bô chi̍t hāng ōe kā lín siong-hāi.
Put-kò, m̄-thang in-ūi chiah-ê siâ-sîn hâng-ho̍k lín, lín chiū hoaⁿ-hí; tio̍h in-ūi lín ê miâ kì-chài tī thiⁿ-téng lâi hoaⁿ-hí.”

Hit-sî, Iâ-so͘ hō͘ Sèng Sîn kám-tōng móa-sim hoaⁿ-hí, kóng, “Pē ah, thiⁿ-tōe ê Chú, góa kám-siā lí, in-ūi lí ū chiong chiah-ê sū tùi ū tì-hūi ū ha̍k-būn ê lâng khàm--khí-lâi, m̄-kú tùi sòe-hàn gín-á khé-sī. Pē ah, sī lah, in-ūi che sī lí ê hó chí-ì.

“Góa ê Pē í-keng ū chiong it-chhè lóng kau-thok góa. Pē í-gōa bô lâng bat Kiáⁿ sī sím-mi̍h-lâng; Kiáⁿ kap Kiáⁿ ài-beh khé-sī ê lâng í-gōa mā bô lâng bat Pē sī sím-mi̍h-lâng.”
Iâ-so͘ oa̍t-tńg-sin su-hā tùi bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Ū ba̍k-chiu thang khòaⁿ lín só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê, hit-ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Góa kā lín kóng, í-chêng ū chin chōe sian-ti kap kun-ông ài-beh khòaⁿ lín só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê ia̍h bô khòaⁿ--tio̍h, beh thiaⁿ lín só͘ thiaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê ia̍h bô thiaⁿ--tio̍h.”
Ū chi̍t ê lu̍t-hoat-kàu-su khiā khí-lâi chhì-thàm Iâ-so͘, kóng, “Lāu-su, góa tio̍h chòe sím-mi̍h chiah ōe tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn i kóng, “Lu̍t-hoat ū siá sím-mi̍h? Lí án-chóaⁿ liáu-kái?”
Hit-ê lâng ìn kóng, “Lí tio̍h choân-sim, choân-chêng, choân-le̍k, choân-ì thiàⁿ Chú — lí ê Siōng-tè; koh tio̍h thiàⁿ chhù-piⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí ìn liáu chin tio̍h. Chiàu án-ni khì chòe chiū ōe tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā.”
Hit-ê lu̍t-hoat-kàu-su ūi-tio̍h beh piáu-bêng ka-kī sī tio̍h, chiū koh mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng sī góa ê chhù-piⁿ?”

Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê lâng tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lo̍h-khì Iâ-lī-ko, tú-tio̍h kiông-tō; in pak i ê saⁿ, koh kā i phah kàu pòaⁿ-sí, jiân-āu kā i pàng hē--teh, chòe in khì.
Tú-hó ū chi̍t ê chè-si tùi hit-tiâu lō͘ lo̍h--lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê lâng chiū siám tùi lō͘ ê hit-pêng kè--khì.
Siâng-khoán, ū chi̍t ê Lī-bī -lâng lâi kàu hit-ê só͘-chāi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê lâng mā siám tùi lō͘ ê hit-pêng kè--khì.
Chóng-sī, ū chi̍t ê Sat-má-lī-a -lâng tùi hia keng-kè, chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê lâng chiū sim chin m̄-kam,
kiâⁿ óa--khì, ēng iû kap chiú boah i ê khang-chhùi, koh ēng pò͘ kā i pau-chat, jiân-āu kā i hû-khì khiâ ka-kī ê lû-á, chhōa i khì lú-koán, kā i chiàu-kò͘.
Keh-ji̍t, i the̍h nn̄g ê gûn-á kau hō͘ lú-koán ê thâu-ke, kau-tài kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ lí chiàu-kò͘ chit-ê lâng, só͘-hùi nā tio̍h khah chōe, góa tò--lâi ê sî ōe pó͘--lí.’”
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g hit-ê lu̍t-hoat-kàu-su, “Lí siūⁿ, chit saⁿ ê lâng tó chi̍t ê sī hō͘ kiông-tō chhiúⁿ hit-ê lâng ê chhù-piⁿ?”
I ìn kóng, “Kā i lîn-bín hit-ê.” Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí khì, chiàu án-ni khì chòe.”
Iâ-so͘ kap bûn-tô͘ kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ. Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì chi̍t ê chng-thâu, ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng, kiò-chòe Má-tāi, kā I chiap-thāi.
Má-tāi ū chi̍t ê sió-bē, kiò-chòe Má-lī-a, chē tī Chú ê kha-chêng thiaⁿ I ê kà-sī.

Má-tāi ūi-tio̍h chiap-thāi, tāi-chì chōe sim ak-chak, chiū lâi kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Chú ah, góa ê sió-bē pàng góa ka-kī chi̍t ê teh bong, lí ná bô-iàu-bô-kín? Kiò i lâi kā góa tàu-kha-chhiú.”
Chú ìn i kóng, “ Má-tāi, Má-tāi, lí ūi-tio̍h tāi-chì chōe teh khòa-lū chhau-hoân;
só͘ su-iàu--ê chí-ū chi̍t hāng. Má-lī-a í-keng kéng-tio̍h siōng-hó hit-hūn, bô lâng ōe-tàng kā i chhiúⁿ--khì.”

Ū chi̍t piàn, Iâ-so͘ tī chi̍t ê só͘-chāi teh kî-tó. I kî-tó soah ê sî, ū chi̍t ê bûn-tô͘ kā I kóng, “Chú ah, Iok-hān ū kà i ê bûn-tô͘ kî-tó, chhiáⁿ lí mā kà goán kî-tó.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín kî-tó ê sî, tio̍h án-ni kóng: Pē ah, goān lí ê sèng-miâ siū chun-chông. Goān lí si-hêng chú-koân.
Kiû lí ta̍k-ji̍t sù goán só͘ su-iàu ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Kiû lí sià-bián goán ê chōe, in-ūi goán ka-kī mā ū sià-bián só͘-ū ko͘-hū goán ê lâng. Kiû lí m̄-thang hō͘ goán hām-lo̍h tam-tng bōe khí ê chhì-thàm.”
Iâ-so͘ koh tùi I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Lín tiong-kan ū sím-mi̍h-lâng pòaⁿ-mî khì pêng-iú hia, kā i kóng, ‘Pêng-iú, chhiáⁿ lí chioh góa saⁿ tè piáⁿ,
in-ūi góa ū chi̍t ê pêng-iú lú-hêng lâi kàu goán chia, góa bô mi̍h-kiāⁿ thang chhiáⁿ i.’
Lí ê pêng-iú ōe tùi chhù-lāi ìn kóng, ‘Mài kā góa chhá, mn̂g í-keng koaiⁿ, góa kap gín-á tī bîn-chhn̂g teh khùn lah, bōe-tàng khí-lâi the̍h hō͘ lí.’
Góa kā lí kóng, sui-jiân hit-ê lâng bōe in-ūi i sī pêng-iú khí-lâi the̍h piáⁿ hō͘ i, mā ōe in-ūi i pek-chhiat khún-kiû, khí-lâi the̍h só͘ su-iàu ê mi̍h hō͘ i.
“Só͘-í, góa kā lín kóng: Kiû, ōe tit--tio̍h; chhē, ōe chhē--tio̍h; phah-mn̂g, ōe kā lín khui.
In-ūi kiû--ê, chiū tit--tio̍h; chhē--ê, chiū chhē--tio̍h; phah-mn̂g--ê, chiū kā i khui.
Lín tiong-kan choh lāu-pē--ê, ka-kī ê kiáⁿ kā lín thó hî, kiám ōe lia̍h chôa hō͘ i?
Á-sī kā lín thó nn̄g, kiám ōe lia̍h giat-á-thâng hō͘ i?
Lín sui-jiân pháiⁿ, iáu ōe-hiáu the̍h hó-mi̍h hō͘ lín ê kiáⁿ-jî, hô-hòng lín ê Thiⁿ-pē, I it-tēng ōe chiong Sèng Sîn sù hō͘ tùi I kî-kiû ê lâng!”
Iâ-so͘ kóaⁿ chi̍t ê é-káu-kúi; kúi chi̍t-ē chhut--khì, hit-ê bōe kóng-ōe ê lâng chiū kóng-ōe, kûn-chiòng lóng tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
M̄-kú, kî-tiong ū lâng kóng, “I khò kúi-ông Pia̍t-se-pok kóaⁿ-kúi.”
Koh ū chi̍t-kóa lâng beh chhì-thàm Iâ-so͘, it-ti̍t iau-kiû I kiâⁿ tùi thiⁿ lâi ê sîn-jiah.
Iâ-so͘ chai-iáⁿ in teh siūⁿ sím-mi̍h, chiū kā in kóng, “Kok-ka ka-kī hun-cheng, ōe hong-hòe; ka-têng ka-kī hun-cheng, ōe tó-hoāi.
Sat-tàn nā ka-kī hun-cheng, Sat-tàn ê kok ná khiā ōe tiâu? Lín kóng góa sī óa-khò Pia̍t-se-pok kóaⁿ-kúi.
Góa nā khò Pia̍t-se-pok kóaⁿ-kúi, lín ê chú-tē sī khò sím-mi̍h-lâng kóaⁿ-kúi? Án-ni, lín ka-kī ê chú-tē ōe kā lín phòaⁿ-chōe.
Put-kò góa nā-sī khò Siōng-tè ê khùi-la̍t teh kóaⁿ-kúi, Siōng-tè ê chú-koân chiū í-keng tī lín tiong-kan si̍t-hiān lah.
“Ióng-sū bú-chong choân-pī kò͘-siú ka-kī ê chhù, i ê châi-bu̍t chiū an-choân.
M̄-kú ū chi̍t ê pí i khah ióng ê lâng lâi kong-kek, phah-iâⁿ, chiū chiong i só͘ óa-khò ê bú-khì chhiúⁿ--khì, koh chiong só͘ chhiúⁿ ê châi-bu̍t pun-liáu-liáu.
“Bô ūi góa--ê chiū-sī hoán-tùi góa; bô kap góa chòe-hé siu-chi̍p--ê chiū-sī teh phah-sòaⁿ.”

“Siâ-sîn lī-khui só͘ hū-sin ê lâng liáu-āu, tī bô-chúi ê tōe-khu kiâⁿ-thàu-thàu, beh chhē chi̍t ê hioh-khùn ê só͘-chāi, chhē lóng bô, chiū kóng, ‘Góa beh tńg-lâi-khì góa chhut--lâi hit-keng chhù.’
I tńg--khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chhù-lāi sàu kah chin chheng-khì, koh chéng-lí hó-sè.
Āu-lâi, i khì chhōa chhit ê pí i khah pháiⁿ ê siâ-sîn lâi, ji̍p-khì hia tòa. Án-ni, hit-ê lâng ê kiat-kio̍k pí khí-thâu koh-khah chhám.”
Iâ-so͘ teh kóng chiah-ê ōe ê sî, kûn-chiòng lāi-bīn ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng tōa-siaⁿ tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Siⁿ lí, hō͘ lí suh-lin ê hū-jîn-lâng chin ū hok-khì!”
Put-kò Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Thiaⁿ Siōng-tè ê ōe koh chun-siú ê lâng koh-khah ū hok-khì!”
Kûn-chiòng jú lâi jú chōe, Iâ-so͘ chiū kóng, “Chit sè-tāi chin-chiàⁿ sī siâ-ok ê sè-tāi! In iau-kiû sîn-jiah, m̄-kú Iok-ná ê sîn-jiah í-gōa, bōe koh ū sîn-jiah hō͘ in.
Tú chhin-chhiūⁿ Iok-ná chiâⁿ-chòe Nî-nî-bî -lâng ê sîn-jiah, Jîn-chú mā beh chiâⁿ-chòe chit sè-tāi ê lâng ê sîn-jiah.

Tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, Lâm-hng ê lú-ông ōe kap chit sè-tāi ê lâng chòe-hé khí-lâi kā in tēng-chōe, in-ūi i ū tùi tōe ê ke̍k-thâu lâi thiaⁿ Só͘-lô-bûn tì-hūi ê ōe. Lín khòaⁿ, ū pí Só͘-lô-bûn koh-khah úi-tāi--ê tī chia!

Tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, Nî-nî-bî -lâng ōe kap chit sè-tāi ê lâng chòe-hé khí-lâi kā in tēng-chōe, in-ūi Nî-nî-bî -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iok-ná ê thoân-tō liáu-āu lóng ū hóe-kái. Lín khòaⁿ, ū pí Iok-ná koh-khah úi-tāi--ê tī chia!”
“Bô lâng tiám-teng hē tī lâng khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h ê só͘-chāi, á-sī khàm tī táu-ē; it-tēng sī hē tī teng-tâi téng, thang hō͘ ji̍p--lâi ê lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h kng.
Lí ê ba̍k-chiu sī seng-khu ê teng. Lí ê ba̍k-chiu nā kim, kui seng-khu chiū kng-bêng; lí ê ba̍k-chiu nā hoe, kui seng-khu chiū o͘-àm.
Só͘-í, tio̍h sió-sim, m̄-thang hō͘ lí lāi-bīn ê kng pìⁿ-chòe àm.
Lí kui seng-khu nā lóng kng-bêng, liân chi̍t-tiám-á o͘-àm to bô, chiū ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ teng kng-iàⁿ-iàⁿ teh kā lí chiò, oân-choân kng-bêng.”
Iâ-so͘ teh kóng chiah-ê ōe ê sî, ū chi̍t ê Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chhiáⁿ I chia̍h-pn̄g, I chiū ji̍p-khì chē-toh.
Hit-ê Hoat-lī-sài-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h I chia̍h-pn̄g bô seng sóe-chhiú, kám-kak chin kî-koài.
Chú chiū kā i kóng, “Lín Hoat-lī-sài-lâng chí-ū chiong poe kap pôaⁿ ê gōa-bīn sóe chheng-khì, m̄-kú lín ê lāi-bīn chhiong-móa tham-io̍k kap siâ-ok!
Lín chiah-ê gōng-lâng! Hit-ūi chhòng-chō gōa-bīn ê Siōng-tè kiám m̄-sī mā ū chhòng-chō lāi-bīn?
Tio̍h the̍h poe kap pôaⁿ lāi-bīn ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ khì chín-chè, án-ni lín ê it-chhè chiū lóng chheng-khì.

“Lín chiah-ê Hoat-lī-sài-lâng chhám ah! In-ūi lín chiong po̍k-hô, ûn-hiong, kap ta̍k-khoán chhài-soe hōng-hiàn cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t hō͘ Siōng-tè, m̄-kú bô tiōng-sī kong-gī kap thiàⁿ Siōng-tè. Kî-si̍t chiah-ê chiah sī lín eng-kai si̍t-hêng--ê, kî-tha--ê mā m̄-thang hut-lio̍k.
“Lín chiah-ê Hoat-lī-sài-lâng chhám ah! In-ūi lín ài tī hōe-tn̂g chē koân-ūi, tī chhī-tiûⁿ-kháu hō͘ lâng kā lín chhéng-an.
Lín chhám ah! In-ūi lín chhin-chhiūⁿ khòaⁿ bōe chhut ê bōng, lâng tùi téng-bīn kiâⁿ--kè mā m̄ chai.”
Ū chi̍t ê lu̍t-hoat-kàu-su kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, lí kóng chiah-ê ōe mā-sī teh bú-jio̍k goán!”

Iâ-so͘ ìn i kóng, “Liân lín chiah-ê lu̍t-hoat-kàu-su mā chhám ah! In-ūi lín chiong taⁿ bô hoat ê tāng-tàⁿ hō͘ lâng taⁿ, ka-kī liân chi̍t ki chńg-thâu-á to m̄-khéng tín-tāng lâi kiám-khin in ê tāng-tàⁿ.
Lín chhám ah! Lín ê chó͘-sian thâi-sí hiah-ê sian-ti, lín kā in chō bōng.
Án-ni, lín ka-kī chèng-si̍t, mā chàn-sêng chó͘-sian só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì, in-ūi in thâi-sí sian-ti, lín kā in chō bōng.
Só͘-í, Siōng-tè ê Tì-hūi mā ū kóng, ‘Góa beh chhe sian-ti kap sù-tô͘ khì in hia, kî-tiong ū-ê ōe hō͘ in thâi-sí, ū-ê ōe hō͘ in pek-hāi.’

Án-ni, tùi chhòng-chō thiⁿ-tōe í-lâi, chiū-sī tùi A-pek khí ti̍t-kàu tī chè-tôaⁿ kap sèng-só͘ ê tiong-kan hō͘ lâng sat-hāi ê Sat-ka-lī-a ûi-chí, in só͘ lâu ê huih, chit sè-tāi ê lâng lóng tio̍h hêng. Tio̍h, góa kā lín kóng, hiah-ê chè lóng ōe kā lín chit sè-tāi ê lâng thó.
“Lín chiah-ê lu̍t-hoat-kàu-su chhám ah! In-ūi lín chiong khui tì-sek ê mn̂g ê só-sî kā lâng the̍h-cháu, ka-kī m̄ ji̍p--khì, beh ji̍p--khì ê lâng, lín soah kā in chó͘-tòng!”
Iâ-so͘ tùi hia chhut--lâi ê sî, keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-lâng chiū ke̍k-le̍k kā I kong-kek, pek I kóng khah chōe ōe,
tng-tán I kóng m̄-tio̍h, thang lia̍h I ê ōe-phāng.
Hit-sî, ū kúi-nā chheng lâng khoeh chòe-hé, tì-kàu hō͘-siōng thún-ta̍h. Iâ-so͘ chiū seng tùi I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Tio̍h tî-hông Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê kàⁿ, chiū-sī ké-hó.
Bô chi̍t hāng am-khàm--ê bōe lō͘-hiān; mā bô chi̍t hāng pì-bi̍t--ê bōe hō͘ lâng chai.
Só͘-í, lín tī àm-tiong kóng--ê, ōe tī kng-bêng tiong hō͘ lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h; lín tī pâng-keng lāi hī-khang piⁿ kóng--ê, ōe hō͘ lâng tī chhù-bé-téng soan-pò͘.”
“Pêng-iú, góa kā lín kóng, hāi-sí lín ê seng-khu liáu-āu, bōe-tàng koh tùi lín chòe sím-mi̍h--ê, m̄-bián kiaⁿ.

Góa beh chí-sī lín eng-kai kiaⁿ--ê sī tó chi̍t ūi. Lín eng-kai kiaⁿ Siōng-tè; I hō͘ lâng sí liáu-āu, iáu ū koân thang kā lâng hiat-lo̍h tōe-ge̍k. Sī! Góa kā lín kóng, tio̍h kiaⁿ Chit-ūi!
“Gō͘ chiah chhek-chiáu-á kiám m̄-sī bōe nn̄g kak gûn nā-tiāⁿ? Siōng-tè liân chi̍t chiah to bô bōe-kì--tit.
Liân lín ê thâu-mn̂g to lóng ū sǹg--kè. M̄-bián kiaⁿ! Lín pí kui-kûn chhek-chiáu-á koh-khah kùi-tiōng!”
“Góa kā lín kóng, tī lâng ê bīn-chêng soan-jīn góa--ê, Jîn-chú tī Siōng-tè ê thiⁿ-sài bīn-chêng mā ōe jīn i.
M̄-kú tī lâng ê bīn-chêng m̄ jīn góa--ê, Jîn-chú tī Siōng-tè ê thiⁿ-sài bīn-chêng mā m̄ jīn i.
“Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng kóng-ōe te̍k-tùi Jîn-chú, ōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián. M̄-kú siat-to̍k Sèng Sîn ê, bōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
“Lín hō͘ lâng lia̍h kàu hōe-tn̂g, tī thóng-tī-chiá á-sī koaⁿ-oân bīn-chêng ê sî, m̄-bián hoân-ló tio̍h án-chóaⁿ tap-piān, á-sī tio̍h kóng sím-mi̍h.
In-ūi hit-ê sî Sèng Sîn ōe kà lín tio̍h kóng sím-mi̍h.”
Chèng-lâng ê tiong-kan ū chi̍t ê lâng kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, chhiáⁿ lí kah góa ê hiaⁿ-tī kap góa pun ke-hé.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí chit-ê lâng, siáⁿ-lâng jīm-bēng góa chòe lín ê phòaⁿ-koaⁿ á-sī kong-chhin?”
I chiū tùi chèng-lâng kóng, “Tio̍h kín-sīn, tio̍h tî-hông ta̍k-khoán ê tham-sim, in-ūi lâng ê sìⁿ-miā m̄-sī chāi-tī châi-sán ê chōe-chió.”
Āu-lâi Iâ-so͘ ēng chi̍t ê phì-jū kā in kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê hó-gia̍h-lâng, i ê chhân-hn̂g tōa hong-siu.
I sim-lāi siūⁿ-lâi-siūⁿ-khì, kóng, ‘Góa bô-kàu só͘-chāi thang tún ngó͘-kok, taⁿ beh án-chóaⁿ?’
I chiū kóng, ‘Góa tio̍h án-ni chòe. Góa beh kā chhng-khò͘ thiah--khí-lâi koh khí khah tōa keng, thang lâi tún ngó͘-kok kap it-chhè ê châi-bu̍t,
jiân-āu tùi góa ka-kī kóng: Eh, lí í-keng chek-chū chin chōe châi-bu̍t, ū-kàu thang ēng chin chōe nî. Taⁿ chheng-êng lah, lâi lim, lâi chia̍h, lâi hióng-siū!’
M̄-kú Siōng-tè kā i kóng, ‘Gōng-lâng! Kim-mî chiū beh siu-hôe lí ê sìⁿ-miā; lí só͘ chek-chū ê it-chhè beh lâu hō͘ siáⁿ-lâng?’
Kâng-khoán, ūi-tio̍h ka-kī chek-chū châi-hù, bô hō͘ Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe hó-gia̍h--ê mā ōe án-ni.”

Iâ-so͘ koh tùi I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Só͘-í góa kā lín kóng, m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h lín ê sìⁿ-miā beh chia̍h sím-mi̍h teh chhau-hoân; mā m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h lín ê seng-khu beh chhēng sím-mi̍h teh chhau-hoân.
In-ūi sìⁿ-miā pí chia̍h-mi̍h khah tiōng-iàu; seng-khu pí i-ho̍k khah tiōng-iàu.
Lín khòaⁿ o͘-a, in sui-jiân bô chèng-choh, bô siu-sêng, bô chhek-chhng mā bô chhng-khò͘, Siōng-tè mā teh kā in iúⁿ-chhī, lín kiám bô pí hiah-ê chiáu-á koh-khah kùi-tiōng!
Lín kiám ū lâng siūⁿ-kóng chhau-hoân ōe-tàng hō͘ ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā ke oa̍h chi̍t-sî-á kú?
Kì-jiân liân chiah-ni̍h sòe-hāng tāi-chì lín to bô châi-tiāu chòe, ná tio̍h ūi kî-tha ê sū chhau-hoân?

Lín khòaⁿ soaⁿ-iá ê hoe, in án-chóaⁿ teh tōa-châng? In bô lô-khó͘, mā bô pháng-chit. Put-kò góa kā lín kóng, liân Só͘-lô-bûn siōng êng-hôa ê sî, i chhēng ê saⁿ to bô pí chiah-ê hoe ê chi̍t lúi koh-khah súi.
Soaⁿ-iá ê hoe-chháu kin-á-ji̍t teh oa̍h, bîn-á-chài hō͘ lâng hiat-lo̍h hé-lô͘, Siōng-tè to án-ni kā in chng-thāⁿ, I koh-khah ōe kā lín chng-thāⁿ! Lín ná chiah-ni̍h bô sìn-sim!
“Só͘-í, lín m̄-thang kan-ta teh siūⁿ-beh chia̍h sím-mi̍h, lim sím-mi̍h; mā m̄-thang chhau-hoân.
Chiah-ê lóng sī chit sè-kan bô sìn ê lâng só͘ teh tui-kiû--ê. Lín ê Pē chai lín ū su-iàu chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ.
Tian-tò tio̍h tāi-seng tui-kiû I chú-koân ê si̍t-hiān, chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chiū ōe lóng sòa hō͘ lín.”
“Lín sòe-sòe ê iûⁿ-kûn ah, m̄-bián kiaⁿ, in-ūi lín ê Pē hoaⁿ-hí chiong I ê kok hō͘ lín.

Tio̍h bōe lín ê châi-sán lâi chín-chè sàn-chhiah-lâng. Tio̍h ūi-tio̍h lín ka-kī chún-pī ēng bōe phòa ê chîⁿ-tē lâi chek-chū ēng bōe liáu ê châi-pó tī thiⁿ-téng; tī hia chha̍t-á the̍h bōe tio̍h, chiù-thâng mā kā bōe tio̍h.
In-ūi lín ê châi-pó tī tó-ūi, lín ê sim mā ōe tī hia.”
“Saⁿ tio̍h chhēng hó-sè; teng tio̍h tiám hō͘ to̍h.
Tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ po̍k-jîn teh thèng-hāu chú-lâng tùi hun-iàn tńg--lâi; chú-lâng tńg--lâi, chi̍t-ē phah-mn̂g thang sûi-sî kā i khui.

Chú-lâng tńg--lâi ê sî khòaⁿ-tio̍h po̍k-jîn chhíⁿ-chhíⁿ, hiah-ê po̍k-jîn chin ū hok-khì! Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, chú-lâng ōe ka-kī saⁿ chhēng hó-sè, chhiáⁿ in chē-toh, lâi kā in sū-hāu.
Chú-lâng nā tī pòaⁿ-mî á-sī thiⁿ beh kng ê sî tńg--lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h po̍k-jîn chhíⁿ-chhíⁿ, hiah-ê po̍k-jîn chin ū hok-khì!
Chit-ke ê chú-lâng nā chai chha̍t-á sím-mi̍h sî-chūn ōe lâi, it-tēng bōe hō͘ chha̍t-á chhim-ji̍p i ê chhù.
Só͘-í, lín mā tio̍h chún-pī piān-piān, in-ūi Jîn-chú ōe tī lín siūⁿ bōe kàu ê sî-chūn lâi-lîm.”
Pí-tek kóng, “Chú ah, lí chit-ê phì-jū sī tùi goán kóng, á-sī tùi chèng-lâng kóng?”
Chú kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng sī tiong-si̍t koh chhong-bêng ê koán-ke? Chiū-sī chú-lâng kau-tài i koán-lí kî-tha ê po̍k-jîn, chiàu-sî pun chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ in hit-ê lâng.
Chú-lâng tńg--lâi ê sî, khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū chiàu án-ni teh chòe hit-ê po̍k-jîn si̍t-chāi ū hok-khì!
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, chú-lâng ōe phài chit-ê po̍k-jîn koán-lí i lóng-chóng ê châi-sán.
Hit-ê po̍k-jîn nā sim-lāi siūⁿ-kóng ‘Góa ê chú-lâng bōe hiah kín tńg--lâi’, chiū khí-chhiú phah kî-tha ê po̍k-jîn lú-pī, ia̍h-chia̍h-ia̍h-lim, koh lim kàu chiú-chùi.
Hit-ê po̍k-jîn ê chú-lâng ōe tī i bô àn-sǹg ê ji̍t, m̄-chai ê sî tńg--lâi. Chú-lâng ōe giâm-giâm kā i chhú-hoa̍t, kā i kap bô tiong-si̍t ê lâng khǹg chòe-tui.
“Po̍k-jîn chai chú-lâng ê ì-sù khiok bô khì chún-pī, á-sī bô chiàu chú-lâng ê ì-sù khì chòe, i ōe hō͘ chú-lâng phah chin thiám.

Put-kò m̄ chai chú-lâng ê ì-sù khì chòe eng-kai siū chhú-hoa̍t ê tāi-chì, hit-ê po̍k-jîn ōe hō͘ chú-lâng phah khah khin. Hō͘ i khah chōe, chiū tùi i the̍h khah chōe; kau-tài i khah chōe, chiū tùi i iau-kiû khah chōe.”
“Góa lâi sī beh chiong hé hiat-lo̍h tōe-chiūⁿ, góa jōa-á-ni̍h ài hé í-keng to̍h--khí-lâi!
Góa ū eng-kai siū ê sóe-lé; chit-ê sóe-lé iáu-bē siū í-chêng, góa si̍t-chāi chin kan-khó͘!
Lín siūⁿ-kóng góa lâi sī beh hō͘ tōe-chiūⁿ hô-pêng sī--bô? Góa kā lín kóng, m̄-sī, tian-tò sī hun-lia̍t.
Tùi taⁿ í-āu, chi̍t ke ū gō͘ ê lâng, in ōe hun-lia̍t, saⁿ ê tùi nn̄g ê, nn̄g ê tùi saⁿ ê.
In ōe hun-lia̍t, lāu-pē tùi hāu-siⁿ, hāu-siⁿ tùi lāu-pē; lāu-bú tùi cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ tùi lāu-bú; ta-ke tùi sin-pū, sin-pū tùi ta-ke.”
Iâ-so͘ koh kā chèng-lâng kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h hûn tùi sai-pêng khí--lâi ê sî, sûi-sî kóng ‘Teh-beh lo̍h-hō͘ lah’, kó-jiân chiū lo̍h-hō͘.
Thàu lâm-hong ê sî, lín kóng ‘Teh-beh sio-joa̍h lah’, chiū chin-chiàⁿ sio-joa̍h.
Ké-hó ê lâng, lín to ōe-hiáu phòaⁿ-toàn thiⁿ kap tōe ê kéng-siōng, ná bōe-hiáu phòaⁿ-toàn chit-ê sî-tāi?”
“Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ m̄ ka-kī phòaⁿ-toàn sím-mi̍h sī ha̍p-lí?

Lí kap khòng-kò lí ê lâng khì kìⁿ koaⁿ-tiúⁿ ê sî, tio̍h tī lō͘-tiong siat-hoat kap i hô-kái; nā bô, i ōe thoa lí khì kìⁿ phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, phòaⁿ-koaⁿ chiong lí kau hō͘ hoat-kéng, hoat-kéng chiū kā lí koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ.
Góa kā lí kóng, chòe-āu ê chi̍t-sián-gō͘-lî bô hêng chheng-chhó, lí choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng chhut-kaⁿ.”
Tú hit-ê sî, ū kúi-nā ê lâng lâi, tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng-khí Pí-lia̍p-to thâi-sí tī chè-tôaⁿ hiàn-chè ê Ka-lī-lī -lâng ê tāi-chì.
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “In-ūi chiah-ê Ka-lī-lī -lâng siū chit-khoán ê chai-lān, lín chiū siūⁿ-kóng in pí kî-tha ê Ka-lī-lī -lâng ū hoān khah-tāng ê chōe sī--bô?
Góa kā lín kóng, m̄-sī, lín nā bô hóe-kái, lóng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ in án-ni bia̍t-bông.
Kiám-chhái lín mā siūⁿ-kóng, Se-lô-a ê thah tó--lo̍h-khì ê sî, hō͘ i teh-sí hit cha̍p-poeh ê lâng pí tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lóng-chóng ê lâng ū hoān khah-tāng ê chōe.
Góa kā lín kóng, m̄-sī, lín nā bô hóe-kái, lóng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ in án-ni bia̍t-bông.”

Āu-lâi, Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng chit-ê phì-jū. I kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê lâng tī i ê phû-tô-hn̂g chèng chi̍t châng bû-hoa-kó-chhiū. I lâi hit-châng chhiū chhē ké-chí, m̄-kú chhē lóng bô.

I chiū tùi kò͘-hn̂g ê lâng kóng, ‘Lí khòaⁿ, góa liân-sòa saⁿ nî lâi chit-châng bû-hoa-kó-chhiū chia chhē ké-chí, chhē lóng bô. Kā i chhò--khí-lâi! Ná tio̍h lâu-teh tìn só͘-chāi?’
Hit-ê kò͘-hn̂g--ê ìn kóng, ‘Chú-lâng ah, koh kā i lâu chi̍t nî, góa lâi ku̍t sì-piⁿ ê thô͘, koh lo̍h-pûi;
mê-nî nā ū kiat ké-chí chiū hó, nā bô, chiah kā i chhò--khí-lâi.’”
Ū chi̍t ê An-hioh-ji̍t, Iâ-so͘ tī chi̍t ê hōe-tn̂g lāi teh kà-sī lâng.
Ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng hō͘ siâ-sîn hū-sin, phòa-pīⁿ cha̍p-poeh nî, seng-khu oan-khiau chhun bōe ti̍t.
Iâ-so͘ chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū kiò i lâi, kā i kóng, “Hū-jîn-lâng, lí ê pīⁿ í-keng hó lah!”
Iâ-so͘ ēng siang-chhiú kā i hōaⁿ; i ê seng-khu sûi-sî chhun-ti̍t, chiū kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè.

Put-kò hōe-tn̂g ê chú-koán, in-ūi Iâ-so͘ tī An-hioh-ji̍t kā lâng i-pīⁿ, chiū chin siū-khì, tùi chèng-lâng kóng, “Lán ū la̍k ji̍t thang chòe kang, beh i-pīⁿ tio̍h tī chit tiong-kan lâi i, m̄ eng-kai tī An-hioh-ji̍t.”
Chú ìn kóng, “Ké-hó ê lâng, lín ta̍k-ê lâng kiám bô tī An-hioh-ji̍t tùi tiâu--ni̍h tháu gû á-sī lû, khan-khì lim-chúi?
Chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ-sun, í-keng siū Sat-tàn sok-pa̍k cha̍p-poeh nî kú, tī An-hioh-ji̍t kā i tháu-pàng kiám m̄ eng-kai?”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe ê sî, I ê tùi-te̍k lóng kám-kak kiàn-siàu; só͘-ū ê kûn-chiòng in-ūi I só͘ chòe it-chhè kî-biāu ê tāi-chì lóng chin hoaⁿ-hí.
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Siōng-tè-kok chhin-chhiūⁿ sím-mi̍h? Góa tio̍h ēng sím-mi̍h lâi pí-phēng?

Siōng-tè-kok chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t lia̍p kòa-chhài-chí, ū lâng the̍h-khì iā tī ka-kī ê hn̂g--ni̍h. Kòa-chhài chiām-chiām tōa-châng, chiâⁿ-chòe chhiū, khong-tiong ê chiáu-á mā tī chhiū-ki chòe siū.”
Iâ-so͘ koh kóng, “Góa beh ēng sím-mi̍h lâi pí-phēng Siōng-tè-kok?
Siōng-tè-kok chhin-chhiūⁿ kàⁿ-bú, ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng the̍h-khì lām tī saⁿ táu mī-hún chòe-hé chhiau, chòe-āu kui-ê lóng hoat--khí-lâi.”
Iâ-so͘ keng-kè siâⁿ-chhī kap chng-kha khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, iân-lō͘ kà-sī lâng.
Ū lâng mn̄g I kóng, “Chú ah, ōe tit-tio̍h kiù ê lâng chin chió sī--bô?” Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng,
“Tio̍h chīn-la̍t tùi oe̍h ê mn̂g ji̍p--khì. Góa kā lín kóng, ū chin chōe lâng siūⁿ-beh ji̍p--khì ia̍h bōe-tàng ji̍p.
Chú-lâng khí-lâi koaiⁿ-mn̂g liáu-āu, lín chiah khiā tī mn̂g gōa phah-mn̂g, kóng, ‘Sian-siⁿ, chhiáⁿ kā goán khui-mn̂g!’ I ōe ìn kóng, ‘Góa m̄ chai lín sī tó-ūi lâi ê lâng.’
Hit-sî, lín ōe kóng, ‘Goán bat kap lí chòe-hé lim-chia̍h; lí mā bat tī goán ê koe-lō͘ kà-sī.’
M̄-kú I ōe kóng, ‘Góa kā lín kóng, góa m̄ chai lín sī tó-ūi lâi ê lâng. Lín chiah-ê choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng lóng lī-khui góa!’

Lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok, kap só͘-ū ê sian-ti tī Siōng-tè-kok ê lāi-bīn, ka-kī khiok siū kóaⁿ chhut-khì gōa-bīn, hit-sî lín ōe tī hia thî-khàu, kā-gê-chhiat-chhí.
Lâng ōe tùi tang sai lâm pak lâi, tī Siōng-tè-kok chē-toh chham-ka iàn-hōe.
Án-ni, siōng lō͘-bé--ê ōe chòe tē-it; tē-it--ê ōe chòe siōng lō͘-bé.”
Tú hit-ê sî, ū chi̍t-kóa Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng óa-lâi kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lí tio̍h lī-khui chia khì pa̍t-ê só͘-chāi, in-ūi Hi-lu̍t siūⁿ-beh thâi lí.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín khì kā hit-chiah hô͘-lî kóng, ‘Lí khòaⁿ, kin-á-ji̍t, bîn-á-chài góa kóaⁿ-kúi, i-pīⁿ, tē-saⁿ ji̍t oân-sêng góa ê kang-chok.

Sui-jiân sī án-ni, kin-á-ji̍t, bîn-á-chài, kap āu--ji̍t, góa it-tēng tio̍h kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ góa ê lō͘, in-ūi sian-ti bô eng-kai tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng í-gōa ê só͘-chāi hō͘ lâng thâi-sí.’

“ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ah, lí thâi-sí sian-ti, koh ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm-sí Siōng-tè chhe-lâi lí chia ê sù-chiá. Góa jōa-chōe piàn ài-beh chū-chi̍p lí ê kiáⁿ-jî, chhin-chhiūⁿ koe-bú chū-chi̍p koe-á-kiáⁿ kā in áⁿ tī si̍t-kó͘-ē, lín lóng bô ài.

Lín khòaⁿ, lín ê chhù ōe hong-hòe! Góa kā lín kóng, tùi taⁿ í-āu lín choa̍t-tùi khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h góa, ti̍t-kàu lín kóng ‘Hōng Chú ê miâ lâi Hit-ūi eng-kai siū chheng-chàn!’”
Ū chi̍t ê An-hioh-ji̍t, Iâ-so͘ khì chi̍t ê Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê léng-siù in tau chia̍h-pn̄g. Tāi-ke chù-ì teh kā I khòaⁿ.
Hit-sî, tī I ê bīn-chêng ū chi̍t ê kó͘-tiòng-pīⁿ ê lâng.
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g lu̍t-hoat-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-lâng kóng, “Tī An-hioh-ji̍t i-pīⁿ ū ha̍p-hoat bô?”
In lóng bô ìn. Iâ-so͘ chiū khan hit-ê lâng lâi, kā i i-hó, hō͘ i tńg--khì.
Jiân-āu Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín tiong-kan kiám ū lâng ka-kī ê kiáⁿ á-sī gû tī An-hioh-ji̍t poa̍h-lo̍h kó͘-chíⁿ, bōe sûi-sî kā i khiú--khí-lâi?”
In tùi Iâ-so͘ só͘ mn̄g ê ōe lóng bōe-hiáu ìn.
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h lâng-kheh teh kéng tōa-ūi, chiū ēng chi̍t ê phì-jū kā in kóng:
“Lín hō͘ lâng chhiáⁿ-khì hù hun-iàn ê sî, m̄-thang chē tōa-ūi, kiaⁿ-liáu ū pí lí khah chun-kùi ê lâng-kheh mā lâi hō͘ i chhiáⁿ.
Hit-sî, chhiáⁿ i kap lí hit-ê chú-lâng ōe lâi kā lí kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ niū-ūi hō͘ chit-ê lâng-kheh.’ Hit-chūn, lí ōe kám-kak chin pháiⁿ-sè, soah tio̍h khì chē siōng-sòe ê ūi.

Lí hō͘ lâng chhiáⁿ ê sî, lêng-khó khì chē siōng-sòe ê ūi. Án-ni, chhiáⁿ lí ê chú-lâng ōe lâi kā lí kóng, ‘Pêng-iú, chhiáⁿ lâi chē tōa-ūi.’ Hit-chūn, lí tī kâng-toh ê lâng-kheh bīn-chêng chiū ū thé-biān.
In-ūi thê-ko ka-kī--ê, ōe siū kàng-kē; m̄-kú khut-kē ka-kī--ê, ōe siū thê-ko.”

Jiân-āu, Iâ-so͘ mā kā chhiáⁿ I ê chú-lâng kóng, “Lí chhiáⁿ lâng chia̍h tiong-tàu-tǹg á-sī àm-tǹg ê sî, m̄-thang chhiáⁿ lí ê pêng-iú, hiaⁿ-tī, chhin-cho̍k, hó-gia̍h ê chhù-piⁿ, chiah bián in kā lí chhiáⁿ tò-tńg, lí soah siū pò-tap.
Lí chhiáⁿ lâng-kheh ê sî, lêng-khó chhiáⁿ sàn-chhiah-lâng, hêng-tōng bô hong-piān ê lâng, kha-pái ê lâng, sit-bêng ê lâng.
Án-ni, lí it-tēng ōe siū chiok-hok, in-ūi in bōe-tàng kā lí pò-tap. Tī gī-lâng koh-oa̍h ê sî, Siōng-tè ōe kā lí pò-tap.”
Kâng-toh ū chi̍t ê lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe chiū kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Ōe-tàng tī Siōng-tè-kok lim-chia̍h ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê lâng pān tōa iàn-se̍k, chhiáⁿ chin chōe lâng-kheh.
Beh khui-toh ê sî, i chhe po̍k-jîn khì kā siū chhiáⁿ ê lâng-kheh kóng, ‘Chhiáⁿ lín lâi; ta̍k-hāng lóng chún-pī hó-sè lah.’
M̄-kú in chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê the-sî. Thâu chi̍t ê kā i kóng, ‘Góa ū bóe chi̍t tè tōe, tio̍h khì khòaⁿ-bāi leh. Chhiáⁿ lí liōng-kái.’
Lēng-gōa chi̍t ê kóng, ‘Góa ū bóe gō͘ tùi gû, tio̍h khì chhì-ēng khòaⁿ-bāi leh. Chhiáⁿ lí liōng-kái.’
Koh chi̍t ê kóng, ‘Góa tú chhōa-bó͘, só͘-í bōe-tàng khì.’

Hit-ê po̍k-jîn tńg-lâi kā chú-lâng pò-kò chiah-ê tāi-chì. Hit-ke ê chú-lâng chiū siū-khì, kā po̍k-jîn kóng, ‘Kóaⁿ-kín chhut-khì siâⁿ-lāi koe-thâu-hāng-bé, chhōa hiah-ê sàn-chhiah-lâng, hêng-tōng put-piān ê lâng, sit-bêng ê lâng, kha-pái ê lâng lâi.’
Hit-ê po̍k-jîn kóng, ‘Chú-lâng, lí só͘ hoan-hù--ê góa í-keng lóng ū chòe, m̄-kú iáu ū khang-ūi.’
Chú-lâng chiū kā po̍k-jîn kóng, ‘Chhut-khì tōa-lō͘ kap lî-pa piⁿ kiông-pek lâng ji̍p--lâi, thang hō͘ góa ê chhù chē móa.
Góa kā lín kóng, tāi-seng chhiáⁿ hiah-ê lâng, bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng chia̍h góa ê iàn-se̍k.’”
Chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng kap Iâ-so͘ chòe-tīn kiâⁿ-lō͘, Iâ-so͘ oa̍t kè-lâi kā in kóng,
“Tè góa ê lâng nā thiàⁿ ka-kī ê pē-bú, bó͘-kiáⁿ, hiaⁿ-tī, chí-bē, sīm-chì ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā iâⁿ-kè thiàⁿ góa, bōe-tàng chòe góa ê bûn-tô͘.
Bô giâ ka-kī ê si̍p-jī-kè lâi tè góa--ê bōe-tàng chòe góa ê bûn-tô͘.
Lín tiong-kan ū lâng siūⁿ-beh khí chi̍t ê thah, kiám bô tāi-seng chē lo̍h-lâi kó͘-kè khòaⁿ ū-kàu chîⁿ thang oân-sêng kang-thêng á bô?
Nā bô án-ni chòe, i phah tōe-ki liáu-āu soah bōe-tàng oân-sêng kang-thêng, só͘-ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng ōe kā i thí-chhiò,
kóng, ‘Chit-ê lâng ū khai-sí khí, soah bōe-tàng oân-sêng!’

Á-sī, ū chi̍t ê kok-ông beh khì kap pa̍t-ê kok-ông kau-chiàn, i kiám bōe seng chē--lo̍h-lâi, siūⁿ-khòaⁿ i ōe-tàng ēng chi̍t-bān ê peng tí-khòng ū nn̄g-bān ê peng ê kok-ông á bōe?
Nā chai-iáⁿ bōe, i ōe thàn hit-ê kok-ông iáu tī hn̄g-hn̄g ê sî, chhe sù-chiá khì kap i kóng-hô.
Kâng-khoán, lín tiong-kan bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng, nā bô pàng-sak ka-kī só͘ ū ê it-chhè, bōe-tàng chòe góa ê bûn-tô͘.”
“Iâm chin ū lō͘-ēng, m̄-kú nā sit-bī, beh án-chóaⁿ hō͘ i koh kiâm?
Sit-bī ê iâm bōe-tàng lo̍h-chhân, mā bōe-tàng kauh-pûi, chí-ū hìⁿ-sak. Ū hī-khang thang thiaⁿ--ê, tio̍h thiaⁿ!”
Ū chi̍t piàn, chin chōe ba̍uh-sè--ê kap chōe-jîn óa-lâi Iâ-so͘ hia beh thiaⁿ I káng-tō.
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su nga̍uh-nga̍uh-liām, kóng, “Chit-ê lâng chiap-la̍p chōe-jîn, kap in chia̍h-pn̄g!”
Iâ-so͘ chiū kā in kóng chit-ê phì-jū:
“Lín tiong-kan sím-mi̍h-lâng ū chi̍t-pah chiah iûⁿ phah-m̄-kìⁿ chi̍t chiah, i kiám bōe pàng hit káu-cha̍p-káu chiah tī khòng-iá, khì chhē phah-m̄-kìⁿ hit-chiah, chhē kàu tio̍h?
Chi̍t-ē chhē--tio̍h, i chiū chin hoaⁿ-hí, chiong hit-chiah iûⁿ phāiⁿ tī keng-thâu.
I tńg-lâi kàu chhù, kiò pêng-iú kap chhù-piⁿ lâi, kā in kóng, ‘Lâi tàu hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi phah-m̄-kìⁿ hit-chiah iûⁿ í-keng chhē--tio̍h.’
Góa kā lín kóng, chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, ūi-tio̍h ū chi̍t ê hóe-kái ê chōe-jîn, pí ū káu-cha̍p-káu ê m̄-bián hóe-kái ê gī-lâng, tī thiⁿ-téng ê hoaⁿ-hí ōe koh-khah tōa.”
“Á-sī, ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng ū cha̍p ê gûn-oân, phah-m̄-kìⁿ chi̍t ê, kiám bōe tiám-teng, sàu chhù-lāi, phah-piàⁿ chhē, chhē kàu tio̍h?
I chi̍t-ē chhē--tio̍h, chiū kiò pêng-iú kap chhù-piⁿ lâi, kā in kóng, ‘Lâi tàu hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi phah-m̄-kìⁿ hit-ê gûn-oân í-keng chhē--tio̍h.’
Góa kā lín kóng, chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, Siōng-tè ê thiⁿ-sài ōe ūi-tio̍h chi̍t ê chōe-jîn hóe-kái lâi hoaⁿ-hí.”
Iâ-so͘ koh kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê lâng ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ;
sòe-hàn--ê kā lāu-pē kóng, ‘A-pa, góa eng-kai tit ê châi-sán, chhiáⁿ lí pun hō͘ góa.’ Lāu-pē chiū chiong châi-sán pun hō͘ in nn̄g ê.

Kè bô kúi ji̍t, sòe-hàn kiáⁿ chiong só͘ tit--tio̍h choân-pō͘ ê châi-sán lóng ōaⁿ chòe hiān-kim, jiân-āu chhut-gōa khì chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi, tī hia hòng-tōng, chîⁿ o͘-pe̍h khai.
I só͘ ū--ê lóng khai-liáu-liáu ê sî, tú-hó hit só͘-chāi hoat-seng tōa ki-hng, i chiah chai khiàm-kheh ê kan-khó͘.
I chiū khì hō͘ hit só͘-chāi ê chi̍t ê lâng chhiàⁿ. Hit-ê lâng kiò i khì hn̂g--ni̍h chhī ti.
I iau kah siūⁿ-beh the̍h ti teh chia̍h ê tāu-ngoeh chí-ki, m̄-kú liân che lâng mā bô hō͘ i.
“Āu-lâi, i kak-chhíⁿ, kóng, ‘Goán lāu-pē ū hiah-ni̍h chōe chhiàⁿ-kang, in lóng ū mi̍h thang chia̍h, koh chia̍h kàu ū-chhun, m̄-kú góa tī chia teh-beh gō-sí.
Góa beh khí--lâi, tńg-khì góa ê lāu-pē hia, kā i kóng: A-pa, góa ū tek-chōe Thiⁿ, mā ū tek-chōe lí,
í-keng bô chu-keh chòe lí ê kiáⁿ. Chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa chòe lí ê chhiàⁿ-kang chiū hó.’
I chiū chhut-hoat tńg-khì lāu-pē hia. “I lī in tau iáu chin hn̄g, lāu-pē chiū khòaⁿ-tio̍h i, sim chin m̄-kam, kóaⁿ-kín cháu óa-khì kā i lám--teh, ti̍t-ti̍t kā i chim.
Kiáⁿ chiū tùi lāu-pē kóng, ‘A-pa, góa ū tek-chōe Thiⁿ, mā ū tek-chōe lí. Góa í-keng bô chu-keh chòe lí ê kiáⁿ.’
M̄-kú, lāu-pē kā po̍k-jîn kóng, ‘Kóaⁿ-kín hiahⁿ siōng-hó ê gōa-phàu lâi kā i chhēng, kā i kòa chhiú-chí, koh kā i chhēng-ôe,
sòa khan hit-chiah pûi ê gû-á-kiáⁿ lâi thâi, lâi khèng-chiok.
In-ūi góa chit-ê kiáⁿ sī sí--khì ū koh-oa̍h, sit-lo̍h ū koh tit--tio̍h.’ In chiū khai-sí khèng-chiok.
“Hit-sî, tōa-kiáⁿ tī hn̂g--ni̍h. I tńg--lâi, teh-beh kàu chhù ê sî thiaⁿ-tio̍h chàu-ga̍k kap thiàu-bú ê siaⁿ.
I kiò chi̍t ê po̍k-jîn lâi, mn̄g-khòaⁿ tàu-tóe sī sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.
Hit-ê po̍k-jîn kā i kóng, ‘Lín sió-tī tńg--lâi; lín lāu-pē in-ūi i pêng-an bô-sū tò--lâi, chiū thâi hit-chiah pûi ê gû-á-kiáⁿ.’
Tōa-kiáⁿ hui-siông siū-khì, m̄ ji̍p--khì. I ê lāu-pē chhut-lâi kā i khó͘-khǹg.

M̄-kú i ìn lāu-pē kóng, ‘Lí siūⁿ-khòaⁿ leh, góa choh lô͘-châi ho̍k-sāi lí chiah chōe nî, m̄-bat ûi-pōe lí ê bēng-lēng, lí liân chi̍t chiah soaⁿ-iûⁿ-á to m̄-bat hō͘ góa kap pêng-iú chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí!
M̄-kú, lí chit-ê kiáⁿ ūi-tio̍h chhiong-ki kā lí ê châi-sán khai-liáu-liáu, i chi̍t-ē tńg--lâi, lí chiū ūi-tio̍h i thâi hit-chiah pûi ê gû-á-kiáⁿ.’
I ê lāu-pē ìn kóng, ‘Kiáⁿ ah, lí put-sî to kap góa chòe-hé, góa só͘-ū--ê lóng sī lí ê.
Chóng-sī lí chit-ê sió-tī, i sī sí--khì ū koh-oa̍h, sit-lo̍h ū koh tit--tio̍h, lán eng-kai hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí lâi khèng-chiok.’”
Iâ-so͘ koh tùi bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê lâng chin hó-gia̍h, i ū chi̍t ê koán-ke; ū lâng tùi chú-lâng kiám-kú chit-ê koán-ke lōng-hùi i ê châi-sán.
Chú-lâng kiò i lâi, kā i mn̄g, ‘Góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí chit-ê tāi-chì, tàu-tóe sī án-chóaⁿ? Lí só͘ koán-lí ê siàu-phō͘ kau--chhut-lâi, m̄ hō͘ lí koh choh koán-ke.’

Hit-ê koán-ke ka-kī siūⁿ-kóng, ‘Chú-lâng beh kā góa sî thâu-lō͘, m̄ hō͘ góa koh choh koán-ke, taⁿ góa beh án-chóaⁿ? Gia̍h tî-thâu bô khùi-la̍t, choh khit-chia̍h koh kiaⁿ kiàn-siàu.
Taⁿ, góa chai tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe, bô choh koán-ke í-āu chiah ū pêng-iú thang kā góa siu-liû.’
“Koán-ke chiū chiong chú-lâng ê chè-bū-jîn chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê kiò--lâi, kā thâu chi̍t ê kóng, ‘Lí khiàm goán chú-lâng jōa-chōe?’
I ìn kóng, ‘Chi̍t-pah tháng kaⁿ-ná-iû.’ Koán-ke kā i kóng, ‘Lí ê chioh-tiâu tī chia, kóaⁿ-kín chē--lo̍h-lâi, kā kái-chòe gō͘-cha̍p.’
Koán-ke koh kā lēng-gōa chi̍t ê kóng, ‘Lí khiàm jōa-chōe?’ I ìn kóng, ‘Chi̍t-pah chio̍h be̍h-á.’ Koán-ke kā i kóng, ‘Lí ê chioh-tiâu tī chia, kā kái-chòe poeh-cha̍p.’
“Chú-lâng po-chióng chit-ê bô láu-si̍t ê koán-ke chòe-liáu chin khiáu, in-ūi sio̍k sè-kan ê lâng chhú-lí sè-sū pí sio̍k kng-bêng ê lâng khah ū piàn-khiàu.”

Iâ-so͘ kè-sio̍k kóng, “Góa kā lín kóng: Tio̍h ēng put-gī ê chîⁿ-châi ūi-tio̍h ka-kī kiat-kau pêng-iú, án-ni chîⁿ-châi bô--khì ê sî, in ōe chiap-la̍p lín ji̍p-khì éng-oán khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.
Tùi chin sòe-hāng tāi-chì tiong-si̍t ê lâng, tùi tōa-hāng tāi-chì mā ōe tiong-si̍t; tùi chin sòe-hāng tāi-chì bô láu-si̍t ê lâng, tùi tōa-hāng tāi-chì mā bōe láu-si̍t.
Só͘-í, lín tùi put-gī ê chîⁿ-châi nā bô láu-si̍t, siáⁿ-lâng beh chiong chin-chiàⁿ ê châi-pó kau-tài lín?
Lín tùi pa̍t-lâng ê mi̍h nā bô láu-si̍t, siáⁿ-lâng beh chiong lín ê mi̍h hō͘ lín?

“Bô chi̍t ê po̍k-jîn ōe-tàng ho̍k-sāi nn̄g ê chú-lâng; i nā m̄-sī oàn-hūn chit-ê, thiàⁿ hit-ê, chiū-sī khòaⁿ-tāng chit-ê, khòaⁿ-khin hit-ê. Lín bōe-tàng siâng-sî ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè koh ho̍k-sāi chîⁿ-châi.”
Hiah-ê tham-châi ê Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe chiū kā I thí-chhiò.

Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín chiah-ê lâng tī lâng ê bīn-chêng chū-chheng chòe gī, m̄-kú Siōng-tè chai lín ê lāi-sim, in-ūi lâng khòaⁿ-chòe chun-kùi--ê, tùi Siōng-tè lâi khòaⁿ sī thang iàm-ò͘ⁿ--ê.
“ Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat kap sian-ti ê kà-sī kàu Si-sóe-chiá Iok-hān kiat-sok. Tùi hit-sî khí, Siōng-tè-kok ê hok-im chiū thoân--chhut-khì, lâng-lâng lóng ngī-beh chiⁿ--ji̍p-khì.
M̄-kú thiⁿ-tōe siau-sit pí hòe-tû Lu̍t-hoat ê chi̍t-u̍ih koh-khah kán-tan.
“Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng, lî i ê bó͘ khì chhōa pa̍t-ê hū-jîn-lâng chiū-sī hoān kan-îm; chhōa hō͘ lâng lî-hun ê hū-jîn-lâng mā-sī hoān kan-îm.”
“Ū chi̍t ê lâng chin hó-gia̍h, i chhēng chí-sek chin ko-kùi ê i-ho̍k, ta̍k-ji̍t chhia-hoa iàn-lo̍k.
Koh ū chi̍t ê khit-chia̍h, miâ kiò-chòe Lia̍p-sat-lō͘, kui seng-khu siⁿ-chhng, tó tī hit-ê hó-gia̍h-lâng ê mn̂g-kháu,
beh khioh hó-gia̍h-lâng toh-téng lak--lo̍h-lâi ê sap-á chí-ki; káu mā lâi chī i ê chhng.
“Āu-lâi, chit-ê khit-chia̍h sí--khì, thiⁿ-sài kā i chhōa-khì A-pek-la-hán ê seng-khu piⁿ. Hit-ê hó-gia̍h-lâng mā sí--khì, koh bâi-chòng.
I tī Im-hú siū chin tōa ê thòng-khó͘, gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h A-pek-la-hán tī hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi, Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ tī i ê seng-khu piⁿ.

I chiū chhut-siaⁿ kiò, ‘Góa ê chó͘ A-pek-la-hán, lîn-bín góa! Chhiáⁿ lí chhe Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ ēng chńg-thâu-á-bé ùn chúi lâi hō͘ góa ê chhùi-chi̍h liâng--chi̍t-ē, in-ūi góa tī chit-ê hé-iām tiong teh siū khó͘-chhó͘.’

“M̄-kú A-pek-la-hán kóng, ‘Kiáⁿ ah, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit lí chāi-siⁿ hióng-siū it-chhè ê khoài-lo̍k, m̄-kú Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ chāi-siⁿ siū-chīn thòng-khó͘, I hiān-chāi tī chia tit-tio̍h an-ùi, lí tī hia teh siū khó͘-chhó͘.
M̄-nā án-ni, goán kap lín ê tiong-kan ū tōa chhim-ian keh-khui, án-ni tùi chia bô lâng ōe-tàng kè-khì lín hia, mā bô lâng ōe-tàng tùi lín hia kè-lâi goán chia.’
Hit-ê hó-gia̍h-lâng chiū kóng, ‘Góa ê chó͘ ah, kì-jiân sī án-ni, góa khún-kiû lí chhe Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ khì goán lāu-pē ê chhù;
góa ū gō͘ ê hiaⁿ-tī tī hia, i thang khì kā in kéng-kò, chiah bián in mā lâi kàu chit-ê hui-siông thòng-khó͘ ê só͘-chāi.’
“M̄-kú A-pek-la-hán ìn kóng, ‘Lí ê hiaⁿ-tī ū Mô͘-se kap sian-ti, in eng-kai khì thiaⁿ in ê ōe.’
Hit-ê hó-gia̍h-lâng ìn kóng, ‘Góa ê chó͘ A-pek-la-hán, in bōe lah. Nā ū lâng tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h khì chhē in, in chiū ōe hóe-kái.’
A-pek-la-hán kā i kóng, ‘In nā m̄ thiaⁿ Mô͘-se kap sian-ti ê ōe, ū lâng tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, in mā bōe siong-sìn.’”
Iâ-so͘ koh tùi I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Ín-khí lâng hoān-chōe ê sū it-tēng ū, put-kò chō-sêng chit-ê sū ê lâng chhám ah!
Lêng-khó ēng tōa chio̍h-bō kā i tiàu tī ām-kún hiat-lo̍h hái, mā m̄-thang hō͘ bî-sòe ê chi̍t ê poa̍h-tó hoān-chōe.
Lín ka-kī mā tio̍h kín-sīn! “Lí ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē nā hoān-chōe, tio̍h kā i chek-pī, i nā hóe-kái, tio̍h kā i sià-bián.
Nā ū lâng chi̍t ji̍t tek-chōe lí chhit piàn, chhit piàn lóng oa̍t tò-tńg lâi kā lí kóng ‘Góa hóe-kái lah’, lí mā lóng tio̍h kā i sià-bián.”
Sù-tô͘ tùi Chú kóng, “Kiû lí ke-thiⁿ goán ê sìn-sim!”

Chú kóng, “Lín nā ū chhin-chhiūⁿ kòa-chhài-chí hiah tōa ê sìn-sim, kā chit-châng sng-châi-chhiū kóng ‘Liân kun pu̍ih--khí-lâi, khì chai tī hái--ni̍h’, hit-châng chhiū mā ōe ho̍k-chiông lín.
“Lín tiong-kan kiám ū sím-mi̍h-lâng, i ê po̍k-jîn khì choh-hn̂g á-sī chhī iûⁿ, tùi hn̂g--ni̍h tńg--lâi ê sî, ōe kā po̍k-jîn kóng ‘Kóaⁿ-kín chē lo̍h-lâi chia̍h-pn̄g’?
I kiám bōe kā i kóng ‘Kā góa chún-pī àm-tǹg; hâ ûi-kûn lâi sū-hāu góa chia̍h-pn̄g, āu-lâi lí chiah chia̍h chiah lim’?
Po̍k-jîn chòe chú-lâng só͘ hoan-hù ê tāi-chì, chú-lâng kiám tio̍h kā i soeh-siā?
Lín mā-sī án-ni, lín chòe siū kau-tài ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, tio̍h kóng ‘Goán sī bô lō͘-ēng ê po̍k-jîn, goán put-kò chīn pún-hūn chòe nā-tiāⁿ’.”
Iâ-so͘ khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lō͘-tiong, keng-kè Sat-má-lī-a kap Ka-lī-lī ê kau-kài.
I ji̍p-khì chi̍t ê chng-siā ê sî tú-tio̍h cha̍p ê bâ-hong pīⁿ-lâng. In khiā tī hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi,
tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Iâ-so͘ lāu-su ah, lîn-bín goán!”
Iâ-so͘ chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū kā in kóng, “Lín khì hō͘ chè-si kiám-cha!” In tī lō͘-tiong, chiū tit-tio̍h chheng-khì.
Kî-tiong ū chi̍t ê khòaⁿ-tio̍h ka-kī ê pīⁿ í-keng hó, chiū tò-tńg-lâi tōa-siaⁿ o-ló Siōng-tè,
phak tī Iâ-so͘ ê kha-chêng, kā I kám-siā. Chit-ê sī Sat-má-lī-a -lâng.
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g kóng, “Kiám m̄-sī ū cha̍p ê lâng tit-tio̍h i-hó? Iáu hit káu ê tī tó-ūi?
Chit-ê gōa-cho̍k ê lâng í-gōa kiám bô lâng tńg-lâi kám-siā Siōng-tè?”
Iâ-so͘ chiū kā hit-ê lâng kóng, “Khí--lâi, tńg--khì. Lí ê sìn-sim ū kiù lí.”
Ū chi̍t piàn, chi̍t-kóa Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng mn̄g Iâ-so͘, Siōng-tè-kok sím-mi̍h sî ōe lâi-lîm. Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Siōng-tè-kok ê lâi-lîm m̄-sī lâng khòaⁿ ōe chhut--lâi,
mā bô lâng ōe-tàng kóng ‘Lí khòaⁿ, tī hia’, á-sī kóng ‘Lí khòaⁿ, tī chia’, in-ūi Siōng-tè-kok sī tī lín tiong-kan.”
Iâ-so͘ chiū tùi I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, lín siūⁿ-beh khòaⁿ Jîn-chú lâi-lîm ê ji̍t-chí, liân chi̍t ji̍t mā khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h.
Ū lâng ōe kā lín kóng ‘Lí khòaⁿ, tī hia’, á-sī kóng ‘Lí khòaⁿ, tī chia’. M̄-thang chhut--khì, mā m̄-thang tè in khì.
Sih-nà tùi thiⁿ chit-pêng sih, chiò kàu thiⁿ hit-pêng, Jîn-chú tī hit-ji̍t mā ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni lâi-lîm.
Put-kò, I it-tēng tio̍h seng siū chin chōe khó͘-lān, koh hō͘ chit sè-tāi ê lâng kū-choa̍t.
Jîn-chú lâi-lîm ê ji̍t-chí ōe kap Ná-a ê sî kâng-khoán;
hit-sî lâng chiàu-siông lim-chia̍h kè-chhōa, it-ti̍t kàu Ná-a ji̍p-khì tōa-chûn hit-ji̍t. Tōa-chúi kàu, kā in lóng siau-bia̍t.
Hit-ji̍t mā kap Lô-tek ê ji̍t-chí kâng-khoán, lâng chiàu-siông lim-chia̍h, bóe-bōe, chèng-choh, khí-chhù,
m̄-kú Lô-tek tùi Só͘-to-má chhut--khì hit-ji̍t, tùi thiⁿ ū lo̍h hé kap liû-hông, kā in lóng siau-bia̍t.
Jîn-chú hián-hiān ê ji̍t mā ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni.
“Hit-ji̍t, tī chhù-téng--ê, m̄-thang lo̍h-lâi the̍h chhù-lāi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ; tī hn̂g--ni̍h-ê, mā m̄-thang tò-tńg--khì.
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Lô-tek ê bó͘ só͘ tú--tio̍h ê tāi-chì!
Só͘-ū siūⁿ-beh pó-chûn ka-kī sìⁿ-miā--ê, ōe sòng-sit sìⁿ-miā; só͘-ū sòng-sit ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā--ê, ōe tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā.
Góa kā lín kóng, tī hit-àm, ū nn̄g ê lâng khùn kâng chi̍t téng bîn-chhn̂g, chi̍t ê ōe siū chhōa--khì, lēng-gōa chi̍t ê ōe lâu--teh.
Ū nn̄g ê hū-jîn-lâng chòe-hé teh oe chio̍h-bō, chi̍t ê siū chhōa--khì, chi̍t ê lâu--teh.
Ū nn̄g ê lâng tī hn̂g--ni̍h, chi̍t ê siū chiap--khì, chi̍t ê lâu--teh.”
Bûn-tô͘ mn̄g Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Chú ah, ōe tī tó-ūi hoat-seng?” Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Si-thé tī tó-ūi, thuh-thâu-eng lóng ōe khîⁿ óa-khì hia.”
Iâ-so͘ koh tùi bûn-tô͘ kóng chi̍t ê phì-jū, kà-sī in tio̍h siông-siông kî-tó, m̄-thang hoe-sim.
I kóng, “Bó͘ chi̍t ê siâⁿ ū chi̍t ê phòaⁿ-koaⁿ, i bô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, mā bô chun-tiōng lâng.
Tī hit-ê siâⁿ ū chi̍t ê kóaⁿ-hū it-ti̍t lâi chhē i, kóng, ‘Góa ū chi̍t ê sò͘-siōng ê tùi-thâu, chhiáⁿ lí thòe góa chú-chhî kong-tō.’
Chit-ê phòaⁿ-koaⁿ chin kú lóng m̄ tah-èng, āu-lâi i ka-kī siūⁿ-kóng, ‘Góa sui-jiân m̄ kiaⁿ Siōng-tè, mā bô chun-tiōng lâng,
m̄-kú in-ūi chit-ê kóaⁿ-hū it-ti̍t lâi kā góa chhá, góa beh thòe i chú-chhî kong-tō, chiah bián i it-ti̍t lâi kô-kô-tîⁿ.’”
Chú koh kóng, “Lín tio̍h thiaⁿ chit-ê put-gī ê phòaⁿ-koaⁿ só͘ kóng ê ōe!
Siōng-tè só͘ kéng-soán ê lâng mî-ji̍t tùi I ai-kiû, I kiám bōe thòe in chú-chhî kong-tō? I kiám ōe thoa-iân chin kú?
Góa kā lín kóng, I chin kín chiū ōe thòe in chú-chhî kong-tō. Chóng-sī, Jîn-chú lâi-lîm ê sî, I tī tōe-chiūⁿ kiám ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-khoán ê sìn-sim?”
Iâ-so͘ tùi hiah-ê khòaⁿ ka-kī chòe gī-lâng koh khòaⁿ-khin pa̍t-lâng ê lâng ū kóng chit-ê phì-jū:
“Ū nn̄g ê lâng chiūⁿ Sèng-tiān kî-tó; chi̍t ê sī Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng, lēng-gōa chi̍t ê sī ba̍uh-sè--ê.

Hoat-lī-sài-lâng khiā-thêng-thêng ka-kī kî-tó kóng, ‘Siōng-tè ah, góa kám-siā lí, in-ūi góa bô chhin-chhiūⁿ kî-tha ê lâng khióng-hat chhú-châi, put-gī, îm-loān, mā bô chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-ê ba̍uh-sè--ê.
Góa chi̍t lé-pài kìm-chia̍h nn̄g piàn, koh hōng-hiàn choân-pō͘ siu-ji̍p ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t.’
M̄-kú hit-ê ba̍uh-sè--ê khiā tī hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi, liân gia̍h-thâu khí-lâi khòaⁿ thiⁿ to m̄-káⁿ, chí-ū tûi-heng kóng, ‘Siōng-tè ah, lîn-bín góa chit-ê ū-chōe ê lâng!’

Góa kā lín kóng, chōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián tńg-khì in tau--ê sī chit-ê lâng, m̄-sī hit-ê Hoat-lī-sài-lâng; in-ūi thê-ko ka-kī--ê, ōe siū kàng-kē; khut-kē ka-kī--ê, ōe siū thê-ko.”
Ū lâng liân eⁿ-á mā phō-lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, beh hō͘ I hōaⁿ-chhiú chiok-hok; bûn-tô͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h chiū kā in chek-pī.
M̄-kú Iâ-so͘ kiò in lâi, kóng, “Hō͘ gín-á lâi góa chia, m̄-thang kā in chó͘-tòng, in-ūi Siōng-tè-kok sī chit-khoán lâng ê.
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, lâng nā bô chhin-chhiūⁿ gín-á án-ni chiap-siū Siōng-tè-kok, choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng ji̍p--khì.”
Ū chi̍t ê Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-tō-chiá lâi mn̄g Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Hó ê lāu-su, góa tio̍h chòe sím-mi̍h chiah ōe-tàng sêng-siū éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā?”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí ná ōe kóng góa sī hó? Siōng-tè í-gōa, bô chi̍t ê sī hó.
Chiah-ê kài-bēng lí lóng bat: ‘M̄-thang kan-îm; m̄-thang hāi-sí lâng; m̄-thang thau-the̍h; m̄-thang choh gūi-chèng; tio̍h hàu-kèng pē-bú.’”
Hit-ê lâng kóng, “Chiah-ê kài-bēng góa tùi sòe-hàn chiū it-ti̍t ū teh chun-siú.”

Iâ-so͘ thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe, chiū kā i kóng, “Lí iáu khiàm chi̍t hāng. Khì bōe só͘-ū--ê, tit--tio̍h ê chîⁿ lóng pun hō͘ sàn-chhiah-lâng, lí tī thiⁿ-téng chiū ū châi-pó, jiân-āu lâi tè góa.”
Hit-ê lâng chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe, chin siong-sim, in-ūi i hui-siông hó-gia̍h.
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ hit-ê lâng chiū kóng, “Ū-chîⁿ-lâng ji̍p Siōng-tè-kok jōa-á-ni̍h khùn-lân!
Lo̍k-tô chhng-kè chiam-phīⁿ mā pí hó-gia̍h-lâng ji̍p Siōng-tè-kok koh-khah kán-tan!”
Thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe ê lâng mn̄g I kóng, “Nā án-ni, sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h kiù?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lâng chòe bōe kàu--ê, Siōng-tè lóng ōe.”
Pí-tek kóng, “Goán í-keng pàng-sak goán só͘-ū--ê lâi tè lí lah.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, lâng nā ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè-kok pàng-sak chhù-the̍h, bó͘, hiaⁿ-tī, pē-bú á-sī kiáⁿ-jî,
tī kim-sè it-tēng ōe tit-tio̍h koh-khah chōe, tī lâi-sè tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.”
Iâ-so͘ chhōa cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ khì piⁿ--á, kā in kóng, “Taⁿ lán beh chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, sian-ti só͘ kì-chài koan-hē Jîn-chú ê it-chhè lóng ōe èng-giām.
I ōe siū chhut-bōe hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng; in ōe kā I hì-lāng, bú-jio̍k, phùi-nōa.
In ōe ēng piⁿ kā I phah, kā I hāi--sí, tē-saⁿ ji̍t I ōe koh-oa̍h.”
M̄-kú sù-tô͘ tùi chiah-ê tāi-chì lóng bô liáu-kái; chiah-ê ōe ê ì-sù ū tùi in khàm--teh, in m̄ chai Iâ-so͘ teh kóng sím-mi̍h.
Iâ-so͘ teh-beh kàu Iâ-lī-ko ê sî, ū chi̍t ê bông-jîn chē tī lō͘-piⁿ teh kiû-khit.
I thiaⁿ-tio̍h kûn-chiòng tùi hia keng-kè, chiū mn̄g lâng khòaⁿ sī sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.
In kā i kóng, “ Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘ teh-beh tùi chia keng-kè.”
I chiū tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “ Tāi-pi̍t ê Kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘, lîn-bín góa!”
Tī thâu-chêng teh kiâⁿ ê lâng kā i chek-pī, kiò i tiām-tiām, m̄-kú i jú tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “ Tāi-pi̍t ê Kiáⁿ, lîn-bín góa!”
Iâ-so͘ chiū thêng-kha, kiò lâng chhōa i lâi. I óa--lâi ê sî, Iâ-so͘ mn̄g i kóng:
“Lí ài góa kā lí chòe sím-mi̍h?” I kóng, “Chú ah, góa ài koh khòaⁿ--kìⁿ!”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Hó, hō͘ lí koh khòaⁿ--kìⁿ! Lí ê sìn-sim hō͘ lí tit-tio̍h i-hó!”
I sûi-sî koh ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū tè Iâ-so͘, kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè. Chèng-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì, lóng chheng-chàn Siōng-tè.
Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì Iâ-lī-ko, tùi hia teh keng-kè.
Tī hia ū chi̍t ê lâng miâ kiò-chòe Sat-kai; i sī ba̍uh-sè ê thâu-lâng, chin hó-gia̍h.
I ài-beh khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘ sī sím-mi̍h khoán lâng, put-kò in-ūi lâng chin chōe, i ê sin-châi koh óe, khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h.
I chiū cháu chìn-chêng, peh-chiūⁿ chi̍t châng sng-châi-chhiū beh khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘, in-ūi Iâ-so͘ teh-beh tùi hia keng-kè.
Iâ-so͘ kiâⁿ kàu hit-ê só͘-chāi, gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ, tùi i kóng, “ Sat-kai, kóaⁿ-kín lo̍h--lâi; kin-á-ji̍t góa it-tēng beh tòa lín tau.”
Sat-kai chiū kóaⁿ-kín lo̍h--lâi, hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí chiap-thāi Iâ-so͘.
Chèng-lâng chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ--tio̍h, nga̍uh-nga̍uh-liām kóng, “Chit-ê lâng soah ji̍p-khì chōe-jîn ê chhù tòa!”
Sat-kai khiā--teh, tùi Chú kóng, “Chú ah, góa beh the̍h châi-sán ê chi̍t-pòaⁿ chín-chè sàn-chhiah-lâng. Góa nā ū kā lâng pián-chîⁿ, beh sì pē hêng i.”
Iâ-so͘ tùi i kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t chín-kiù í-keng lîm-kàu chit-ê ke, in-ūi i mā-sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ-sun.
Jîn-chú lâi sī beh tui-chhē koh chín-kiù sit-lo̍h ê lâng.”

Chèng-lâng teh thiaⁿ chiah-ê ōe ê sî, Iâ-so͘ koh kā in kóng chi̍t ê phì-jū, in-ūi I teh-beh kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, koh hiah-ê lâng siūⁿ-kóng Siōng-tè-kok liâm-piⁿ ōe si̍t-hiān.
Só͘-í Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê kùi-cho̍k khì chin hn̄g ê só͘-chāi beh siū hong choh-ông chiah tńg--lâi.
I tiàu-chi̍p cha̍p ê po̍k-jîn lâi, hō͘ in cha̍p ê kim-pè, chi̍t lâng chi̍t ê, kā in kóng, ‘Góa tńg--lâi í-chêng, lín ēng chiah-ê kim-pè khì chòe seng-lí.’
Pún-kok ê jîn-bîn oàn-hūn i, chhe chi̍t ê sù-chiá tè i ê āu-bīn khì, tùi hông-tè chàu kóng, ‘Goán bô ài chit-ê lâng chòe goán ê ông.’
“Chit-ê kùi-cho̍k siū hong choh-ông tńg--lâi ê sî, kiò hiah-ê niá-tio̍h chîⁿ ê po̍k-jîn lâi, ài chai in ta̍k-ê lâng thàn jōa-chōe.
Thâu chi̍t ê lâi i ê bīn-chêng, kóng, ‘Chú ah, góa ū ēng lí hit-ê kim-pè thàn cha̍p ê.’
Chú-lâng kā i kóng, ‘Chin hó, hó ê po̍k-jîn! Lí kì-jiân tī sió-sū tiong-si̍t, góa beh hō͘ lí ū koân koán-lí cha̍p ê siâⁿ.’
Tē-jī ê lâi, kóng, ‘Chú ah, góa ū ēng lí hit-ê kim-pè thàn gō͘ ê.’
Chú-lâng mā án-ni kā chit-ê lâng kóng, ‘Góa beh hō͘ lí koán-lí gō͘ ê siâⁿ.’
“Koh lēng-gōa chi̍t ê lâi, kóng, ‘Chú ah, lí khòaⁿ, lí ê kim-pè tī chia. Góa ēng chhiú-kun kā i pau khí-lâi khǹg.
Góa chin kiaⁿ lí, in-ūi lí sī chi̍t ūi giâm-hat ê lâng, bô kià, lí mā beh niá; bô chèng, lí mā beh siu.’

Chú-lâng kā i kóng, ‘Lí chit-ê khó-ò͘ⁿ ê po̍k-jîn, góa beh chiàu lí ka-kī só͘ kóng--ê kā lí tēng-chōe. Lí kì-jiân chai góa sī giâm-hat ê lâng, bô kià mā beh niá, bô chèng mā beh siu,
lí ná bô chiong góa ê chîⁿ kià tī gûn-hâng, tán góa tńg--lâi ê sî thang niá bú-chîⁿ kap lī-sek?’
“Chú-lâng chiū kā khiā tī piⁿ--á ê lâng kóng, ‘Kā i ê kim-pè the̍h--lâi, kau hō͘ hit-ê ū cha̍p ê kim-pè--ê!’
In chiū tùi i kóng, ‘Chú ah, i í-keng ū cha̍p ê kim-pè lah.’
Chú-lâng kóng, ‘Góa kā lín kóng, í-keng ū--ê, beh koh-khah chōe hō͘ i; bô--ê, liân i só͘-ū--ê mā beh kā i chhiúⁿ--khí-lâi.
M̄-kú hiah-ê tùi-te̍k góa, bô ài góa chòe in ê ông--ê, kā in thoa-lâi chia, tī góa ê bīn-chêng kā in thâi-sí!’”
Kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu, Iâ-so͘ kiâⁿ chòe-chêng chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
I teh-beh kàu Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ soaⁿ-kha ê Pek-hoat-kî kap Pek-tāi-nî ê sî, chhe nn̄g ê bûn-tô͘,
hoan-hù in, kóng, “Lín khì tùi-bīn ê chng-siā, ji̍p--khì ê sî ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chiah m̄-bat hō͘ lâng khiâ--kè ê lû-á-kiáⁿ pa̍k tī hia. Lín kā i tháu-khui, khan-lâi chia.
Nā ū lâng mn̄g, ‘Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ teh tháu lû-á-kiáⁿ?’ Lín tio̍h kóng, ‘Chú beh ēng i.’”
In chiū khì, só͘ tú--tio̍h ê tāi-chì ta̍k-hāng kap Iâ-so͘ só͘ kóng--ê siâng-khoán.
In teh tháu hit-chiah lû-á-kiáⁿ ê sî, chú-lâng mn̄g in kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ teh tháu chit-chiah lû-á-kiáⁿ?”
In ìn kóng, “Chú beh ēng i.”
In chiū khan hit-chiah lû-á-kiáⁿ lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, chiong ka-kī ê gōa-saⁿ phoa̍h tī lû-á téng, kā Iâ-so͘ hû-khí-khì khiâ.
Iâ-so͘ khiâ lû-á-kiáⁿ chìn-chêng kiâⁿ ê sî, chèng-lâng chiong ka-kī ê gōa-saⁿ pho͘ tī lō͘--ni̍h kā I hoan-gêng.

Iâ-so͘ teh-beh kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng beh lo̍h Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ ê só͘-chāi, kui tōa-tīn ê bûn-tô͘ in-ūi khòaⁿ-tio̍h it-chhè kî-biāu ê sū chiū lóng hoaⁿ-hí, tōa-siaⁿ o-ló Siōng-tè kóng:
Hōng Chú ê miâ lâi ê Ông eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! Goān thiⁿ-téng ū hô-pêng, êng-kng kui hō͘ chì-koân ê Siōng-tè!
Chèng-lâng tiong-kan, ū kúi-nā ê Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, tio̍h chek-pī lí ê bûn-tô͘!”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa kā lín kóng, in nā tiām-tiām, chiah-ê chio̍h-thâu mā ōe tōa-siaⁿ hoah--chhut-lâi.”
Iâ-so͘ teh-beh kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, khòaⁿ-tio̍h siâⁿ, chiū ūi-tio̍h siâⁿ ai-khàu,
kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi chin ài lí kin-á-ji̍t chai án-chóaⁿ chiah ōe kiâⁿ ǹg hô-pêng! M̄-kú chit-ê sū hiān-chāi tùi lí khàm--teh, hō͘ lí khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h.
In-ūi ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, hit-sî lí ê tùi-te̍k ōe tī lí ê chiu-ûi chō thô͘-tui pau-ûi, tùi sì-bīn kā lí kong-kek.
In ōe chiong lí kap lí siâⁿ-lāi ê jîn-bîn choân-pō͘ húi-bia̍t, bô lâu nn̄g tè chio̍h sio-tha̍h, in-ūi lí khòaⁿ bōe chhut Siōng-tè chín-kiù lí ê sî-ki.”
Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì Sèng-tiān, chiū khí-chhiú kóaⁿ hiah-ê bōe mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê lâng chhut--khì.
I kā in kóng, “Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Góa ê chhù eng-kai sī kî-tó ê tiān, lín soah kā i pìⁿ-chòe thó͘-húi-á khut.”
Iâ-so͘ ta̍k-ji̍t tī Sèng-tiān kà-sī lâng. Chè-si-tiúⁿ, keng-ha̍k-kàu-su, kap jîn-bîn ê thâu-lâng it-ti̍t siūⁿ pān-hoat beh hāi-sí Iâ-so͘,
m̄-kú chhē bô hoat-tō͘, in-ūi chèng-lâng lóng chin chù-ì teh thiaⁿ I ê ōe.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, Iâ-so͘ tī Sèng-tiān teh kà-sī lâng koh thoân hok-im. Ū chè-si-tiúⁿ, keng-ha̍k-kàu-su, kap tiúⁿ-ló chòe-hé lâi,
mn̄g I, “Kā goán kóng, lí khò sím-mi̍h koân-pèng chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì? Sím-mi̍h-lâng hō͘ lí chit-ê koân-pèng?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa mā beh mn̄g lín chi̍t kù ōe. Lín kā góa ìn.
Iok-hān kā lâng sóe-lé ê koân-pèng sī tùi Thiⁿ á-sī tùi lâng lâi--ê?”
In hō͘-siōng gī-lūn, “Lán nā kóng ‘Tùi Thiⁿ’, I ōe kóng ‘Án-ni, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ bô sìn Iok-hān?’
Lán nā kóng ‘Tùi lâng’, chèng-lâng ōe ēng chio̍h-thâu kā lán tìm, in-ūi in lóng sìn Iok-hān sī sian-ti.”
Só͘-í in ìn kóng m̄ chai tùi tó-ūi lâi.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Án-ni, góa mā m̄ kā lín kóng góa khò sím-mi̍h koân-pèng chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì.”
Iâ-so͘ koh ēng chi̍t ê phì-jū kā chèng-lâng kóng, “Ū chi̍t ê lâng khai-khún chi̍t khu phû-tô-hn̂g. I chiong chit-khu hn̂g cho͘ hō͘ tiān-lông, āu-lâi chhut-gōa chin kú.
Siu-sêng ê sî kàu, i chhe chi̍t ê po̍k-jîn khì tiān-lông hia, beh kā in siu hn̂g--ni̍h ê ké-chí. Tiān-lông kā i phah, hō͘ i khang-chhiú tò--khì.
Chú-lâng koh chhe pa̍t-ê po̍k-jîn khì. In mā kā i phah, kā i bú-jio̍k, kóaⁿ i khang-chhiú tò--khì.
Chú-lâng chiū chhe tē-saⁿ ê po̍k-jîn khì. In mā kā i siong-hāi, kā i kóaⁿ--chhut-khì.
Āu-lâi phû-tô-hn̂g ê chú-lâng kóng, ‘Taⁿ góa tio̍h án-chóaⁿ chòe? Góa beh chhe góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê kiáⁿ khì. In tāi-khài ōe kā i chun-tiōng.’
M̄-kú tiān-lông khòaⁿ-tio̍h i, chiū chham-siông kóng, ‘Chit-ê sī i ê kè-sêng-jîn. Lán lâi kā i thâi-sí, án-ni i ê châi-sán chiū pìⁿ-chòe lán ê.’
In chiū kā i hiat chhut-khì phû-tô-hn̂g ê gōa-bīn, kā i thâi-sí. “Án-ni, phû-tô-hn̂g ê chú-lâng ōe án-chóaⁿ kā in chhú-lí?
I ōe lâi châu-bia̍t chiah-ê tiān-lông, chiong phû-tô-hn̂g cho͘ hō͘ pa̍t-lâng.” Chèng-lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe, chiū kóng, “Chhian-bān m̄-thang ū chit-khoán tāi-chì!”
Iâ-so͘ chù-ì kā in khòaⁿ, kóng, “Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài--ê sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù: Khí-chhù sai-hū só͘ khì-sak ê chio̍h í-keng chiâⁿ-chòe siōng tiōng-iàu ê ki-chio̍h.
Só͘-ū siak lo̍h-khì hit-tè chio̍h-thâu téng ê lâng, ōe siak kah chhùi-kut-hun-si; hō͘ hit-tè chio̍h-thâu teh--tio̍h ê lâng, ōe teh kah chhùi-kô͘-kô͘.”
Hit-sî, keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap chè-si-tiúⁿ chai-iáⁿ Iâ-so͘ kóng chit-ê phì-jū sī teh chí in, chiū siūⁿ-beh tong-tiûⁿ hē-chhiú lia̍h Iâ-so͘, put-kò kiaⁿ chèng-lâng.
Só͘-í, in chiū chhē ki-hōe, phài bi̍t-thàm ké-chòe láu-si̍t-lâng, beh lia̍h Iâ-so͘ ê ōe-phāng, chiong I kau hō͘ chóng-tok thang ēng i ê koân-pèng i-hoat pān-lí.
Chiah-ê bi̍t-thàm lâi mn̄g Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, goán chai lí só͘ kóng só͘ kà-sī--ê lóng chin tio̍h, bô phian-sim, chí-ū tiong-si̍t kà-sī Siōng-tè ê tō-lí.
Goán la̍p-sè hō͘ Lô-má hông-tè Khái-sat ū ha̍h Lu̍t-hoat bô?”
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-chhut in ê khúi-kè, chiū tùi in kóng,
“The̍h chi̍t ê gûn-pè hō͘ góa khòaⁿ. Che ū sím-mi̍h-lâng ê siōng kap jī-hō?” In ìn kóng, “Khái-sat ê.”
Iâ-so͘ chiū tùi in kóng, “Án-ni, Khái-sat ê mi̍h hō͘ Khái-sat; Siōng-tè ê mi̍h hō͘ Siōng-tè.”
In tī kong-chiòng bīn-chêng lia̍h bōe tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê ōe-phāng, koh I ê ìn-tap hō͘ in chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, chiū tiām--khì.
Ū chi̍t-kóa chú-tiuⁿ bô koh-oa̍h ê Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng lâi Iâ-so͘ hia, mn̄g I kóng,

“Lāu-su, Mô͘-se só͘ siá ê Lu̍t-hoat kā goán kóng, ‘Nā ū lâng i ê hiaⁿ sí--khì, bó͘ iáu oa̍h--teh m̄-kú bô kiáⁿ, i choh sió-tī--ê tio̍h chhōa hiaⁿ-só thòe hiaⁿ thoân-chong-chiap-tāi.’
Í-chêng bat ū chhit ê hiaⁿ-tī, siōng-tōa--ê chhōa-bó͘, bô kiáⁿ chiū sí--khì.
Tē-jī--ê,
tē-saⁿ--ê mā chhōa in hiaⁿ-só. Chhit ê lóng án-ni, bô kiáⁿ chiū sí--khì.
Āu-lâi, hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng mā sí--khì.
Án-ni, koh-oa̍h ê sî, chit-ê hū-jîn-lâng sī tó chi̍t ê lâng ê bó͘? In-ūi chit chhit ê lóng bat chhōa i chòe bó͘.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Kim-sè ê lâng ū kè ū chhōa;
put-kò ōe-kham-tit tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h koh chìn-ji̍p lâi-sè ê lâng chiū bô kè bô chhōa.
In-ūi in sī koh-oa̍h ê lâng, bōe koh sí, kap thiⁿ-sài siâng-khoán sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî.

Koan-hē sí-lâng koh-oa̍h ê sū, Mô͘-se í-keng tī ‘Teh to̍h ê chhì-phè’ hit-tōaⁿ keng-chat ū chí-bêng, mā chheng-ho͘ Chú sī A-pek-la-hán ê Siōng-tè, Í-sat ê Siōng-tè, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè.
I m̄-sī sí-lâng ê Siōng-tè, sī oa̍h-lâng ê Siōng-tè. In-ūi tùi Siōng-tè lâi khòaⁿ, in lóng teh oa̍h.”
Ū kúi-nā ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, lí kóng-liáu chin hó.”
In chiū m̄-káⁿ koh kā I mn̄g sím-mi̍h.
Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Lâng ná ōe kóng Ki-tok sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi?
Tāi-pi̍t pún-sin tī Si-phian kóng: Chú kā góa ê Chú kóng: Lí chē góa ê chiàⁿ-pêng,
thèng-hāu góa hō͘ lí ê tùi-te̍k khut-ho̍k tī lí kha-ē.
Tāi-pi̍t to chheng-ho͘ Ki-tok chòe ‘Chú’, Ki-tok ná ōe sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi?”
Chèng-lâng teh thiaⁿ ê sî, Iâ-so͘ tùi I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng,
“Tio̍h tî-hông keng-ha̍k-kàu-su. In ài chhēng tn̂g-saⁿ kiâⁿ-lâi-kiâⁿ-khì, tī chhī-tiûⁿ-kháu hō͘ lâng chhéng-an, tī hōe-tn̂g chē koân-ūi, tī iàn-hōe chē tōa-ūi.
In chhim-chiàm kóaⁿ-hū ê ke-hé, thiau-kò͘-ì kî-tó chin tn̂g. In ōe siū koh-khah tāng ê hêng-hoa̍t.”
Iâ-so͘ gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ-tio̍h hó-gia̍h-lâng chiong in ê hiàn-kim hiàn lo̍h-khì hōng-hiàn-kūi.
I koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê sàn-chhiah ê kóaⁿ-hū hiàn nn̄g ê tâng-chîⁿ-á lo̍h--khì.
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, chit-ê sàn-chhiah ê kóaⁿ-hū hiàn--ji̍p-khì--ê pí chèng-lâng hiàn--ê koh-khah chōe.
In-ūi in lóng sī hiàn in ēng chhun--ê, m̄-kú chit-ê kóaⁿ-hū sui-jiân chin sàn-chhiah, iáu-kú the̍h só͘-ū ê seng-oa̍h-hùi lóng hiàn--lo̍h-khì.”
Ū lâng teh tâm-lūn Sèng-tiān sī ēng hó chio̍h kap hōng-hiàn ê mi̍h lâi chong-sek--ê. Iâ-so͘ kóng,
“Ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, lín teh khòaⁿ ê chiah-ê it-chhè lóng ōe siū thiah-húi, thiah kah bô nn̄g tè chio̍h sio-tha̍h.”
Bûn-tô͘ mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Lāu-su, chit-ê tāi-chì sím-mi̍h sî ōe hoat-seng? Chit-ê tāi-chì beh hoat-seng ê sî ū sím-mi̍h tiāu-thâu?”

Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang siū bê-he̍k. In-ūi ū chin chōe lâng ōe lī-iōng góa ê miâ lâi, kóng ‘Góa chiū-sī Ki-tok’, koh kóng ‘Sî-ki teh-beh kàu lah’. Lín m̄-thang tè in khì.
Lín thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiàn-cheng kap pō-loān ê siau-sit, m̄-bián kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. Chiah-ê tāi-chì it-tēng ōe tāi-seng hoat-seng, m̄-kú chiong-kio̍k bōe sûi-sî kàu.”
Iâ-so͘ kè-sio̍k kā in kóng, “Bîn-cho̍k ōe khí-lâi kong-kek bîn-cho̍k, kok-ka kong-kek kok-ka.
Ū tōa tōe-tāng, chin chōe só͘-chāi ū ki-hng kap un-e̍k, koh ū thang-kiaⁿ ê kéng-siōng kap tōa kî-chek tùi thiⁿ-téng chhut-hiān.

Chiah-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng í-chêng, lâng ōe lia̍h lín, pek-hāi lín, kā lín kau hō͘ hōe-tn̂g kap kaⁿ-ga̍k. Lín ōe ūi-tio̍h góa ê iân-kò͘ hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì kun-ông kap chóng-tok ê bīn-chêng.
Chit-ê sī lín chòe kiàn-chèng ê ki-hōe.
Só͘-í, lín ê sim tio̍h lia̍h hō͘ tiāⁿ, m̄-bián seng siūⁿ-beh án-chóaⁿ piān-bêng.
In-ūi góa beh sù lín kháu-châi kap tì-hūi, hō͘ lín ê tùi-te̍k bô chi̍t ê ōe-tàng tùi-khòng á-sī hoán-pok.
Liân lín ê pē-bú, hiaⁿ-tī, chhin-cho̍k, kap pêng-iú mā ōe kā lín chhut-bōe; lín tiong-kan ū lâng ōe hō͘ in hāi-sí.
Lín ōe in-ūi góa ê miâ hō͘ chèng-lâng oàn-hūn.
Put-kò lín liân chi̍t ki thâu-mn̂g to bōe sit-lo̍h.
Tio̍h jím-nāi chiah ōe tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā.”
“Lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hō͘ kun-tūi pau-ûi ê sî, chiū chai chit-ê siâⁿ teh-beh húi-bia̍t lah.
Hit-sî, tī Iû-thài ê lâng tio̍h tô-cháu khì soaⁿ-lāi; tī siâⁿ-lāi--ê tio̍h lī-khui; tī chng-kha--ê m̄-thang ji̍p-siâⁿ.
In-ūi che sī Pò-èng ê Ji̍t-chí, sī beh èng-giām Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài ê it-chhè.

Tī hiah-ê ji̍t-chí, ū sin-īn--ê kap hō͘ eⁿ-á chia̍h-lin ê hū-jîn-lâng hui-siông put-hēng! In-ūi tōa chai-hō teh-beh lîm-kàu chit-ê tōe; Siōng-tè ê tōa siū-khì teh-beh lîm-kàu chit-ê jîn-bîn.
In ōe hō͘ to-kiàm thâi-sí, mā ōe hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì ta̍k-kok. Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ōe hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng thún-ta̍h, ti̍t-kàu Gōa-pang-lâng ê kî-hān móa.”
“Hit-sî, ji̍t, ge̍h, chhiⁿ lóng ōe hián-chhut tiāu-thâu. Tōe-chiūⁿ bān-bîn ōe in-ūi hái-éng hōa-hōa-háu kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ put-an.
Lâng ōe in-ūi chit sè-kài teh-beh hoat-seng ê tāi-chì kiaⁿ kah hūn--khì, in-ūi thiⁿ-téng ê kng-thé lóng ōe iô-choah.
Hit-sî, lâng ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Jîn-chú chhiong-móa koân-lêng kap tōa êng-kng chē-hûn lâi-lîm.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì teh-beh hoat-seng ê sî, lín tio̍h gia̍h-thâu théng-sin, in-ūi lín ê chín-kiù teh-beh kàu lah.”
Iâ-so͘ koh ēng phì-jū kā in kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ bû-hoa-kó-chhiū kap it-chhè ê chhiū.
Lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê chhiū puh-íⁿ ê sî chiū chai joa̍h-thiⁿ teh-beh kàu.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng ê sî chiū chai Siōng-tè ê chú-koân teh-beh si̍t-hiān.
Góa si̍t-chāi kā lín kóng, chit sè-tāi iáu-bē kè--khì, chiah-ê tāi-chì lóng ōe hoat-seng.
Thiⁿ kap tōe ōe siau-sit, m̄-kú góa ê ōe choa̍t-tùi bōe siau-sit.”

“Lín ka-kī tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bián in-ūi tham-chia̍h, chiú-chùi, kap seng-oa̍h ê khòa-lū hō͘ lín ê sim bâ-pì, tì-kàu hit-ji̍t chhin-chhiūⁿ lô-bāng hut-jiân lîm-kàu lín, in-ūi hit-ji̍t ōe lîm-kàu tòa tī choân sè-kài ta̍k só͘-chāi ê lâng.
Tio̍h put-sî kéng-séng, kî-tó, hō͘ lín ū khùi-la̍t thang tô-pī it-chhè teh-beh hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, thang khiā tī Jîn-chú ê bīn-chêng.”
Chit kúi ji̍t, Iâ-so͘ ji̍t--sî lóng tī Sèng-tiān kà-sī lâng, mî--sî chhut-siâⁿ khì Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ kè-mî.
Chèng-lâng lóng thàu-chá chiū khì Sèng-tiān thiaⁿ Iâ-so͘ kóng tō-lí.
Tû-kàⁿ-choeh, iā kiò-chòe Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, teh-beh kàu.
Chè-si-tiúⁿ kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su in-ūi kiaⁿ bîn-chiòng, só͘-í teh chhē-khòaⁿ ū sím-mi̍h hoat-tō͘ thang hāi-sí Iâ-so͘.
Sat-tàn ji̍p-khì hit-ê kiò-chòe Í-su-ka-lio̍k ê Iû-tāi ê sim-lāi; i sī cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ ê chi̍t ê.
I khì kap chè-si-tiúⁿ í-ki̍p Sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe-koaⁿ chham-siông, khòaⁿ beh ēng sím-mi̍h hoat-tō͘ chiong Iâ-so͘ chhut-bōe hō͘ in.
In chin hoaⁿ-hí, iok beh hō͘ i chîⁿ.
Iû-tāi tông-ì, chiū it-ti̍t teh chhē ki-hōe, thang tī kûn-chiòng bô tī in tiong-kan ê sî chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘.
Tû-kàⁿ-choeh, chiū-sī tio̍h thâi Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê iûⁿ-ko hit-ji̍t, kàu lah.
Iâ-so͘ chhe Pí-tek kap Iok-hān, kā in kóng, “Lín khì chún-pī Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê boán-chhan, lán thang chia̍h.”
In kā I mn̄g, “Lí ài goán tī tó-ūi chún-pī?”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín ji̍p-khì siâⁿ-lāi, ōe tú-tio̍h chi̍t ê the̍h chúi-pân ê ta-po͘-lâng, lín tè i khì i beh ji̍p--khì hit-keng chhù,
kā hit-ke ê chú-lâng kóng, ‘Lāu-su teh mn̄g, I kap I ê bûn-tô͘ beh chia̍h Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh boán-chhan ê kheh-thiaⁿ tī tó-ūi?’
Hit-ê lâng ōe pò lín khòaⁿ lâu-téng chi̍t keng khoán hó-sè ê tōa-thiaⁿ. Lín chiū tī hia chún-pī.”
In khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h ta̍k-hāng kap Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng--ê lóng siâng-khoán; in chiū tī hia chún-pī Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê boán-chhan.
Boán-chhan ê sî-kan kàu, Iâ-so͘ chiū chē-toh; sù-tô͘ kap I chòe-hé chē.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa siū-lān í-chêng chin ài kap lín chia̍h chit-ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê boán-chhan.
Góa kā lín kóng, chit-ê Boán-chhan tī Siōng-tè-kok oân-choân si̍t-hiān í-chêng, góa choa̍t-tùi bōe koh chia̍h.”
Iâ-so͘ chiong poe chiap--kè-lâi, kám-siā liáu-āu, kóng, “Lín phâng chit-ê poe, pun hō͘ tāi-ke lim.
Góa kā lín kóng, tùi hiān-chāi khí ti̍t-kàu Siōng-tè-kok lâi-lîm, góa choa̍t-tùi bōe koh lim chit-ê phû-tô-chiú.”
Jiân-āu Iâ-so͘ the̍h piáⁿ, kám-siā liáu-āu peh-khui, the̍h hō͘ in, kóng, “Chit-ê sī góa ê seng-khu, sī ūi-tio̍h lín hiàn--ê. Lín tio̍h chòe chit-ê lâi kì-liām góa.”
Chia̍h liáu-āu I koh chiàu án-ni phâng poe, kóng, “Chit-ê poe sī sin ê iok, ēng góa ūi-tio̍h lín lâu-chhut ê huih siat-li̍p--ê.
“Lín khòaⁿ! Chhut-bōe góa hit-ê lâng chit-chūn kap góa chòe-hé chhun-chhiú tī toh-téng.
In-ūi Jîn-chú ōe chiàu Siōng-tè ê koat-tēng lī-khui sè-kan; m̄-kú chhut-bōe Jîn-chú hit-ê lâng chhám ah!”
In chiū mn̄g-lâi-mn̄g-khì, ài chai in tiong-kan sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe chòe chit-ê tāi-chì.
Bûn-tô͘ tiong-kan ū khí cheng-lūn, khòaⁿ sím-mi̍h-lâng sǹg siōng tōa.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Gōa-pang-lâng ê kun-ông choh-chú koán-hat jîn-bîn; thóng-tī-chiá hō͘ lâng chheng-chòe un-chú.
Chóng-sī lín m̄-sī án-ni. Lín tiong-kan siōng-tōa--ê tian-tò tio̍h chiâⁿ-chòe siōng-sòe--ê; choh léng-siù--ê tio̍h chiâⁿ-chòe ho̍k-sāi--ê.
Án-ni, sím-mi̍h-lâng khah tōa? Sī chē-toh chia̍h-pn̄g--ê á-sī ho̍k-sāi--ê? Kiám m̄-sī chē-toh--ê? M̄-kú góa tī lín tiong-kan sī hit-ê ho̍k-sāi--ê.
“Lín chiah-ê lâng tī góa ê chhì-liān tiong it-ti̍t kap góa chòe-hé.
Góa ê Pē chiong ông ê koân-pèng sù hō͘ góa, góa mā án-ni chiong ông ê koân-pèng sù hō͘ lín,
hō͘ lín thang tī góa ê Kok-tō͘ kap góa chē-toh, lim-chia̍h, koh chē tī pó-chō sím-phòaⁿ Í-sek-lia̍t ê cha̍p-jī chi-cho̍k.”
Iâ-so͘ koh kóng, “ Se-bûn, Se-bûn, Sat-tàn í-keng tùi Siōng-tè iau-kiû beh chhin-chhiūⁿ pòa be̍h-á án-ni kā lín pòa.
Put-kò góa ū ūi-tio̍h lí kî-tó, hō͘ lí bōe sit-khì sìn-sim. Lí hôe-thâu tńg--lâi liáu-āu, tio̍h kian-kò͘ lí ê hiaⁿ-tī ê sìn-sim.”
Pí-tek ìn I kóng, “Chú ah, góa í-keng chún-pī piān-piān beh kap lí chē-kaⁿ, kap lí chòe-hé sí!”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “ Pí-tek, góa kā lí kóng, kin-á-ji̍t koe thî í-chêng, lí ōe saⁿ piàn m̄ jīn góa.”
Iâ-so͘ koh kā bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Í-chêng góa chhe lín chhut--khì, kiò lín chîⁿ-tē, lú-hêng-tē, kap ôe lóng bián tòa, lín kiám ū khiàm sím-mi̍h?” In ìn kóng, “Lóng bô.”
I chiū kā in kóng, “M̄-kú hiān-chāi, ū chîⁿ-tē--ê tio̍h tòa leh; ū lú-hêng-tē--ê mā tio̍h tòa leh; bô to--ê tio̍h bōe ka-kī ê gōa-phàu khì bóe.

Góa kā lín kóng, Sèng-keng kì-chài ‘I hō͘ lâng sǹg-chòe put-hoat ê lâng’ chit-kù ōe it-tēng tio̍h tī góa ê sin-chiūⁿ èng-giām. Sèng-keng kì-chài koan-hē góa ê tāi-chì í-keng teh èng-giām lah.”
Bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Chú ah, lí khòaⁿ, chia ū nn̄g ki to.” Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Kàu-gia̍h lah!”
Iâ-so͘ chhut--khì, chiàu-siông khì Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ; bûn-tô͘ tè I khì.
Kàu hit-ê só͘-chāi, I kā in kóng, “Tio̍h kî-tó chiah bōe hām-lo̍h chhì-thàm.”
Jiân-āu I lī-khui in kàu hiat chio̍h-thâu ōe kàu hiah-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi, kūi lo̍h-khì kî-tó,
kóng, “Pē ah, lí nā khéng, kiû lí chiong chit-ê poe kā góa the̍h-khui! Chóng-sī m̄-thang chiàu góa ê ì-sù, tio̍h chiàu lí ê chí-ì si̍t-hiān.”
Ū chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài tùi thiⁿ chhut-hiān, lâi chān I ê la̍t.
Iâ-so͘ hui-siông thòng-khó͘, jú jia̍t-chhiat kî-tó; I ê kōaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa tiám huih tih-lo̍h tōe.
Kî-tó soah, Iâ-so͘ khiā--khí-lâi, tò-khì bûn-tô͘ hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in in-ūi iu-siong soah khùn--khì.
I chiū kā in kóng, “Lín ná teh khùn? Khí-lâi kî-tó chiah bōe hām-lo̍h chhì-thàm.”
Iâ-so͘ iáu-teh kóng ê sî, hut-jiân ū chi̍t tīn lâng lâi; cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ ê chi̍t ê, kiò-chòe Iû-tāi --ê, chòe-chêng chhōa-lō͘. I kiâⁿ-óa Iâ-so͘, beh kā i chim.
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “ Iû-tāi, lí ēng chhùi chim lâi chhut-bōe Jîn-chú o͘h?”
Iâ-so͘ sin-piⁿ ê bûn-tô͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h teh hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, chiū kóng, “Chú ah, goán ēng to kā in thâi hó--bô?”
Kî-tiong ū chi̍t ê kā tōa-chè-si ê po̍k-jîn phut--lo̍h-khì, kā i chiàⁿ-pêng ê hī-á siah--khí-lâi.
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “M̄-thang koh tāng-chhiú!” Iâ-so͘ bong hit-ê po̍k-jîn ê hī-á, kā i i-hó.
Iâ-so͘ kā hiah-ê lâi beh lia̍h I ê chè-si-tiúⁿ, Sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe-koaⁿ, kap tiúⁿ-ló kóng, “Lín gia̍h to gia̍h kùn chhut--lâi, sī teh lia̍h kiông-tō sī--bô?
Góa ta̍k-ji̍t kap lín tī Sèng-tiān, lín bô hē-chhiú kā góa lia̍h. M̄-kú, che sī lín ê sî, o͘-àm teh chiáng-koân lah.”
In lia̍h Iâ-so͘, ah I ji̍p-khì tōa-chè-si ê kong-koán. Pí-tek lī hn̄g-hn̄g teh tè Iâ-so͘.
In tī tiâⁿ ê tiong-ng khí hé, ûi tī hé piⁿ chòe-hé teh chē; Pí-tek mā chē tī in tiong-kan.
Ū chi̍t ê lú-pī khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pí-tek ǹg hé teh chē, kim-kim kā i siòng, kóng, “Chit-ê mā-sī Iâ-so͘ in hit-tīn ê lâng.”
Pí-tek m̄ jīn, kóng, “Lí chit-ê cha-bó͘-lâng, góa m̄ bat I.”
Kè bô jōa kú, lēng-gōa chi̍t ê lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h i, kóng, “Lí mā-sī in hit-tīn ê lâng.” Pí-tek kóng, “Lí chit-ê lâng, góa m̄-sī!”
Chha-put-to kè chi̍t tiám-cheng, koh ū chi̍t ê lâng kian-chhî kóng, “Chit-ê lâng khak-si̍t ū teh kap Iâ-so͘ chòe-hé, in-ūi i mā-sī Ka-lī-lī -lâng.”
M̄-kú Pí-tek kóng, “Lí chit-ê lâng, góa m̄ chai lí teh kóng sím-mi̍h!” I iáu-teh kóng ê sî, koe sûi-sî thî.
Hit-sî Chú oa̍t-thâu khòaⁿ Pí-tek, Pí-tek chiū siūⁿ-khí Chú tùi i kóng ê ōe, “Kin-á-ji̍t koe thî í-chêng, lí ōe saⁿ piàn m̄ jīn góa.”
I chiū chhut-khì gōa-bīn tōa-siaⁿ thî-khàu.
Hiah-ê khàn-siú Iâ-so͘ ê lâng kā I hì-lāng, koh kā I phah.
In ng I ê ba̍k-chiu, mn̄g I kóng, “Sian-ti, lí kā goán kóng, siáⁿ-lâng kā lí phah?”
In koh kóng chin chōe ōe kā I bú-jio̍k.
Thiⁿ-kng, Iû-thài -lâng ê tiúⁿ-ló, chè-si-tiúⁿ, kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su chū-chi̍p. In kā Iâ-so͘ ah-khì in ê gī-hōe,
kā I kóng, “Lí nā-sī Ki-tok, tio̍h kā goán kóng.” Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa nā kā lín kóng, lín mā m̄ sìn.
Góa mn̄g lín, lín mā m̄ ìn.
Tùi hiān-chāi khí, Jîn-chú ōe chē tī Choân-lêng Siōng-tè ê chiàⁿ-pêng.”
Chèng-lâng kóng, “Án-ni lí chiū-sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ lo͘h?” Iâ-so͘ ìn in kóng, “Góa sī, sī lín kóng--ê.”
In chiū kóng, “Lán iáu su-iàu sím-mi̍h chèng-kù? Lán í-keng ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h I chhin-chhùi kóng lah!”
Choân-thé gī-oân lóng khiā--khí-lâi, kā Iâ-so͘ ah-khì Pí-lia̍p-to bīn-chêng.
In chiū khòng-kò kóng, “Goán ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê lâng teh bê-he̍k goán ê bîn-cho̍k, kìm-chí lâng la̍p-sè hō͘ Khái-sat, koh chū-chheng sī Ki-tok, sī Ông.”
Pí-lia̍p-to mn̄g Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lí sī ‘ Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông’ sī--bô?” Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Che sī lí kóng--ê.”
Pí-lia̍p-to chiū tùi hiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap kûn-chiòng kóng, “Góa chhâ bōe chhut chit-ê lâng ū sím-mi̍h chōe.”
M̄-kú in kian-chhî kóng, “I tùi Ka-lī-lī kàu chia, tī Iû-thài choân-tōe kà-sī lâng, siàn-tōng bîn-chiòng.”
Pí-lia̍p-to chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū mn̄g-khòaⁿ chit-ê lâng sī Ka-lī-lī -lâng á m̄-sī.
I chi̍t-ē chai Iâ-so͘ sio̍k Hi-lu̍t -ông ê koán-hat, chiū kā I sàng-khì Hi-lu̍t hia; hit-sî Hi-lu̍t pún-lâng mā tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Hi-lu̍t khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘, hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi i bat thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê tāi-chì, it-ti̍t ài-beh kìⁿ I, koh ǹg-bāng ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h I kiâⁿ sîn-jiah.
I mn̄g Iâ-so͘ chin chōe tāi-chì, Iâ-so͘ lóng bô ìn i.
Chè-si-tiúⁿ kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su khiā--khí-lâi, ke̍k-le̍k kā I khòng-kò.
Hi-lu̍t kap i ê peng mā kā I bú-jio̍k, hì-lāng, jiân-āu koh kā I chhēng chi̍t niá chin súi ê tn̂g-phàu, chiah kā I sàng tńg-khì hō͘ Pí-lia̍p-to.
Hi-lu̍t kap Pí-lia̍p-to pún-lâi ū oan-siû, tī hit chi̍t ji̍t soah pìⁿ-chòe pêng-iú.
Pí-lia̍p-to tiàu-chi̍p chè-si-tiúⁿ, koaⁿ-oân, kap bîn-chiòng lâi,
kā in kóng, “Lín ah chit-ê lâng lâi góa chia, khòng-kò I siàn-tōng bîn-chiòng. Taⁿ góa tī lín ê bīn-chêng ū kā I sím-mn̄g, chhâ lóng bô lín só͘ khòng-kò ê chōe.
Hi-lu̍t mā jīn-tēng I bô chōe, chiah chiong I sàng tò-lâi lán chia. Khó-kiàn I bô chòe sím-mi̍h kai-sí ê tāi-chì.
Só͘-í, góa beh ēng piⁿ kā I kà-sī chi̍t-ē, chiah pàng I khì.”
