Ta̍k-nî ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, chóng-tok tio̍h chiàu kûn-chiòng ê iau-kiû pàng chi̍t ê hoān-lâng hō͘ in.
Kûn-chiòng lóng hoah, “Chit-ê lâng tio̍h hō͘ I sí! Pàng Pa-lia̍p-pa hō͘ goán.”
Chit-ê Pa-lia̍p-pa in-ūi tī siâⁿ-lāi chok-loān koh thâi-lâng chiah siū koaiⁿ-kaⁿ.
Pí-lia̍p-to siūⁿ-beh pàng Iâ-so͘, chiū koh sòe-ho̍k chèng-lâng.
M̄-kú in tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Kā tèng si̍p-jī-kè! Kā tèng si̍p-jī-kè!”

Pí-lia̍p-to tē-saⁿ piàn tùi in kóng, “Sī-án-chóaⁿ? I ū chòe sím-mi̍h pháiⁿ tāi-chì? Góa chhâ bōe chhut I ū kai-sí ê chōe. Só͘-í, góa beh ēng piⁿ kā I kà-sī chi̍t-ē, chiah pàng I khì.”
Put-kò kûn-chiòng kian-chhî, tōa-siaⁿ iau-kiû kā Iâ-so͘ tèng si̍p-jī-kè, chòe-āu in ê siaⁿ soah khah iâⁿ.
Pí-lia̍p-to chiū soan-phòaⁿ, chiàu in ê iau-kiû khì chip-hêng,
pàng in só͘ iau-kiû hit-ê in-ūi chok-loān, thâi-lâng, hō͘ lâng koaiⁿ-kaⁿ ê Pa-lia̍p-pa, kā Iâ-so͘ kau hō͘ in, chiàu in ê ì-sù khì chhú-lí.

Hiah-ê peng-sū ah Iâ-so͘ chhut--khì ê sî, tú-hó ū chi̍t ê Kó͘-lī-nāi -lâng miâ kiò-chòe Se-bûn tùi chng-kha lâi. In kā i lia̍h--lâi, chiong si̍p-jī-kè khǹg tī i ê keng-thâu hō͘ i giâ, tè Iâ-so͘ ê āu-bīn kiâⁿ.
Ū chi̍t tōa-tīn bîn-chiòng tè Iâ-so͘, kî-tiong ū chi̍t-kóa hū-jîn-lâng ūi-tio̍h I tûi-heng pi-siong thî-khàu.
Iâ-so͘ oa̍t-thâu tùi in kóng, “ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê hū-jîn-lâng ah, m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h góa thî-khàu; tio̍h ūi lín ka-kī kap lín ê kiáⁿ-jî thî-khàu!
In-ūi ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, lâng ōe kóng, ‘Bōe hoâi-īn, m̄-bat siⁿ-kiáⁿ, m̄-bat hō͘ gín-á chia̍h-lin ê hū-jîn-lâng chin ū hok-khì!’
Hit-sî, lâng ōe tùi tōa-soaⁿ kóng: Kā goán teh--lo̍h-lâi! Tùi sió-soaⁿ kóng: Kā goán khàm--lo̍h-lâi!
In-ūi in tùi oa̍h--teh ê chhiū-ba̍k to ōe án-ni chòe, tùi ta--khì ê chhiū-ba̍k kiám bōe koh-khah lī-hāi?”
Lēng-gōa nn̄g ê hoān-lâng mā hō͘ lâng ah-khì kap Iâ-so͘ chòe-hé chhú sí-hêng.
In kàu chi̍t ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe “ Thâu-khak-óaⁿ ”, chiū tī hia kā Iâ-so͘ tèng si̍p-jī-kè, mā tèng hit nn̄g ê hoān-lâng, chi̍t ê tī chiàⁿ-pêng, chi̍t ê tī tò-pêng.
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Pē ah, sià-bián in, in-ūi in m̄ chai in teh chòe sím-mi̍h.” Āu-lâi in thiu-chhiam pun Iâ-so͘ ê saⁿ.
Bîn-chiòng khiā tī hia teh khòaⁿ. Hiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-siù kā I thí-chhiò, kóng, “I kiù pa̍t-lâng; I nā-sī Siōng-tè só͘ kéng-soán ê Ki-tok, tio̍h kiù ka-kī!”
Hiah-ê peng-sū mā kā I hì-lāng, kiâⁿ óa--khì, the̍h chhò͘ hō͘ I,
kóng, “Lí nā-sī ‘ Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông’, tio̍h kiù lí ka-kī!”
Tī I ê thâu-khak téng ū chōe-chn̄g ê pâi-á siá “Chit-ê sī Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông”.
Chòe-hé tèng ê hoān-lâng, ū chi̍t ê it-ti̍t kā Iâ-so͘ bú-jio̍k kóng, “Lí kiám m̄-sī Ki-tok? Kiù lí ka-kī mā kiù goán.”
Lēng-gōa chi̍t ê kā i chek-pī kóng, “Lí kap I siâng-khoán siū-hêng, lí kiám m̄ kiaⁿ Siōng-tè?
Lán siū-hêng sī kong-tō, in-ūi lán só͘ siū--ê sī chōe-kai-èng-tit, m̄-kú chit-ê lâng lóng m̄-bat chòe sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h.”
I chiū tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Iâ-so͘ ah, lí choh-ông lâi-lîm ê sî, chhiáⁿ ōe-kì-tit góa!”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Góa si̍t-chāi kā lí kóng, kin-á-ji̍t lí ōe kap góa chòe-hé tī Lo̍k-hn̂g.”
Chha-put-to tiong-tàu ê sî, o͘-àm jia-khàm choân-tōe kàu ē-po͘ saⁿ tiám, ji̍t-thâu sit kng,
Sèng-tiān lāi ê tiùⁿ-lî li̍h-chòe nn̄g pêng.
Iâ-so͘ tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Pē ah, góa chiong góa ê lêng-hûn kau-tài lí.” Kóng soah, chiū tn̄g-khùi.
Chi̍t ê kun-koaⁿ khòaⁿ-tio̍h só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè kóng, “Chit-ê lâng chin-chiàⁿ sī gī-lâng!”
Chū-chi̍p tī hia teh khòaⁿ chit-ê tāi-chì ê chèng-lâng, khòaⁿ-tio̍h só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, lóng ná kiâⁿ ná tûi-heng pi-siong tńg--khì.
Hiah-ê bat Iâ-so͘ ê lâng, í-ki̍p tùi Ka-lī-lī tè--lâi ê hū-jîn-lâng, lóng khiā tī hn̄g-hn̄g ê só͘-chāi khòaⁿ chiah-ê tāi-chì.
Ū chi̍t ê lâng kiò-chòe Iok-sek; i sī gī-oân, sī chi̍t ê siān-liông chèng-gī ê lâng.
I bô chàn-sêng kî-tha gī-oân ê kè-bô͘ kap hêng-tōng. I sī Iû-thài -lâng ê siâⁿ A-lī-má-thài ê lâng, it-ti̍t teh kî-thāi Siōng-tè-kok ê lâi-lîm.
Chit-ê lâng khì kìⁿ Pí-lia̍p-to, chhéng-kiû chiong Iâ-so͘ ê ûi-thé hō͘ i.
I chiong ûi-thé siu--lo̍h-lâi, ēng iù-môa-pò͘ pau, jiân-āu kā I an-chòng tī phah hó tī chio̍h-piah ê bōng lāi-bīn; chit-ê bōng lóng iáu m̄-bat ū lâng ēng.
Hit-ji̍t sī Pī-pān-ji̍t, An-hioh-ji̍t tú-beh khai-sí.
Tùi Ka-lī-lī kap Iâ-so͘ chòe-hé lâi hiah-ê hū-jîn-lâng tè Iok-sek khì. In chim-chiok khòaⁿ hit-ê bōng, khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘ ê ûi-thé án-chóaⁿ hē,
chiū tńg-khì chún-pī phang-liāu kap phang-iû. An-hioh-ji̍t, hiah-ê hū-jîn-lâng chiàu Lu̍t-hoat ê kui-tēng hioh-khùn.
Lé-pài-ji̍t thàu-chá, thiⁿ beh kng ê sî, hiah-ê hū-jîn-lâng tòa in só͘ chún-pī ê phang-liāu khì bōng-tōe.
In khòaⁿ-tio̍h chio̍h-thâu í-keng tùi bōng kō-khui,
chiū ji̍p--khì, m̄-kú chhē bô Chú Iâ-so͘ ê ûi-thé.
In ūi-tio̍h chit-hāng tāi-chì gāng--khì m̄ chai beh án-chóaⁿ ê sî, hut-jiân ū nn̄g ê lâng chhēng kng-iàⁿ-iàⁿ ê saⁿ khiā tī in sin-piⁿ.

Chiah-ê hū-jîn-lâng hui-siông tio̍h-kiaⁿ, bīn phak-lo̍h thô͘-kha. Hit nn̄g ê lâng kā in kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ tī sí-lâng ê tiong-kan teh chhē oa̍h-lâng? I bô tī chia, i í-keng koh-oa̍h.
Lín tio̍h ōe-kì-tit I iáu tī Ka-lī-lī ê sî kā lín kóng ê ōe,
‘Jîn-chú it-tēng ōe siū chhut-bōe tī chōe-jîn ê chhiú, hō͘ in tèng si̍p-jī-kè, tē-saⁿ ji̍t koh-oa̍h.’”
Hiah-ê hū-jîn-lâng chiū siūⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê ōe.
In lī-khui bōng tńg--khì, chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì lóng tùi cha̍p-it ê sù-tô͘ kap kî-tha lóng-chóng ê lâng pò-kò.
Tùi sù-tô͘ pò-kò chiah-ê tāi-chì--ê, chiū-sī Boa̍t-tāi-lia̍p ê Má-lī-a, Iok-a-ná, Ngá-kok ê lāu-bú Má-lī-a, í-ki̍p kî-tha kap in chòe-tīn ê hū-jîn-lâng.
Sù-tô͘ siūⁿ-kóng chiah-ê hū-jîn-lâng só͘ kóng ê ōe bô-iáⁿ-bô-chiah, só͘-í bô siong-sìn.
M̄-kú Pí-tek khí--lâi, cháu-khì bōng--ni̍h, àⁿ lo̍h-khì khòaⁿ, chí-ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h iù-môa-pò͘ nā-tiāⁿ. I chiū tńg--khì, tùi só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì kám-kak chin kî-koài.
Siâng hit-ji̍t, bûn-tô͘ tiong ū nn̄g ê lâng beh khì chi̍t ê chng-thâu, kiò-chòe Í-má-ngó͘-su, chit-ê só͘-chāi lī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng iok cha̍p-it kong-lí.
In tī lō͘-tiong hō͘-siōng teh tâm-lūn só͘ hoat-seng lóng-chóng ê tāi-chì.
In tâm-lūn lâi tâm-lūn khì ê sî, Iâ-so͘ chhin-sin kiâⁿ óa-lâi kap in chòe-tīn kiâⁿ.
In khòaⁿ--tio̍h, m̄-kú bōe jīn--tit.
Iâ-so͘ mn̄g in, “Lín ná kiâⁿ ná teh gī-lūn--ê sī sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?” In chiū thêng--lo̍h-lâi, móa-bīn iu-chhiû.

Kî-tiong ū chi̍t ê lâng kiò-chòe Kek-liû-pa ìn I kóng, “Chit kúi ji̍t tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, tùi gōa-tōe lâi tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng, sī-án-chóaⁿ kan-ta lí chi̍t ê m̄ chai?”

Iâ-so͘ mn̄g in, “Sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?” In kā I kóng, “ Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘ ê tāi-chì. I sī sian-ti, tī Siōng-tè kap chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng, bô-lūn kóng-ōe á-sī chòe tāi-chì lóng chin ū koân-lêng.
Goán ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap léng-siù kā I sàng-khì hō͘ lâng phòaⁿ sí-hêng, tèng si̍p-jī-kè.
I chiū-sī goán só͘ teh kî-thāi beh lâi chín-kiù Í-sek-lia̍t Hit-ūi. M̄-nā án-ni, chit-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng kàu kin-á-ji̍t í-keng tē-saⁿ ji̍t lah.
Koh goán tiong-kan ū kúi-nā ê hū-jîn-lâng hō͘ goán chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ. In thiⁿ phú-kng chiū kàu bōng--ni̍h,
m̄-kú chhē bô Iâ-so͘ ê ûi-thé. In tńg-lâi pò-kò kóng ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h thiⁿ-sài chhut-hiān, kā in kóng I koh-oa̍h lah.
Goán tiong-kan mā ū kúi-nā ê lâng khì bōng--ni̍h, khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê tāi-chì ta̍k-hāng kap hū-jîn-lâng só͘ kóng--ê lóng siâng-khoán, in mā bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘.”
Iâ-so͘ chiū tùi in kóng, “Ài ah, lín ná chiah-ni̍h gōng, sim ná chiah-ni̍h tūn, bōe siong-sìn sian-ti só͘ kóng it-chhè ê ōe!
Ki-tok kiám m̄-sī eng-kai tio̍h siū chiah-ê khó͘-lān chiah lâi ji̍p I ê êng-kng?”
Iâ-so͘ chiū tùi Mô͘-se kap chèng sian-ti khí, kā in kóe-seh Sèng-keng tiong só͘-ū koan-hē I pún-sin ê kì-chài.
In teh-beh kàu só͘ beh khì hit-ê chng-thâu, Iâ-so͘ ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ beh kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ,
put-kò in nn̄g ê kiông-kiông kā I lâu, kóng, “Ji̍t-thâu í-keng lo̍h-soaⁿ, thiⁿ àm lah, chhiáⁿ kap goán tòa.” Iâ-so͘ chiū ji̍p-khì kap in tòa.
Iâ-so͘ kap in chē-toh ê sî, the̍h piáⁿ kám-siā, jiân-āu peh-khui, pun hō͘ in.
In ê ba̍k-chiu khui, jīn-tio̍h I; I hut-jiân tùi in bīn-chêng siau-sit.
In chiū hō͘-siōng kóng, “I tī lō͘-tiong kap lán kóng-ōe, kā lán soat-bêng Sèng-keng ê sî, lán ê sim kiám bô chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh to̍h?”
In sûi-sî chhut-hoat, tò-tńg-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit cha̍p-it ê sù-tô͘ kap kî-tha ê lâng chū-chi̍p tī hia,
teh kóng, “Chú chin-chiàⁿ koh-oa̍h lah! I í-keng ū chhut-hiān hō͘ Se-bûn khòaⁿ.”
Hit nn̄g ê lâng chiū chiong tī lō͘-tiong só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, kap Iâ-so͘ teh peh-piáⁿ ê sî in chiah jīn-tio̍h I ê keng-kè, lóng kā in kóng.
Hit nn̄g ê bûn-tô͘ teh kóng chiah-ê tāi-chì ê sî, Iâ-so͘ chhin-sin khiā tī in tiong-kan, tùi in kóng, “Goān lín pêng-an!”
In ia̍h-kiaⁿ-ia̍h-chhoah, siūⁿ-kóng sī khòaⁿ-tio̍h kúi.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín sī-án-chóaⁿ put-an, sim-lāi ná ōe teh giâu-gî?
Khòaⁿ góa ê chhiú, góa ê kha; khak-si̍t sī góa. Lín bong chiū chai, in-ūi kúi bô-kut bô-bah; bong khòaⁿ-bāi leh, góa lóng ū!”
I kóng-liáu chiū chiong I ê kha kap chhiú chhun hō͘ in khòaⁿ.
In hoaⁿ-hí kah m̄-káⁿ siong-sìn, iáu kám-kak kî-koài ê sî, Iâ-so͘ mn̄g in, “Lín chia ū sím-mi̍h thang chia̍h--bô?”
In the̍h chi̍t bé hang hó ê hî hō͘ I,
I chiū tī in ê bīn-chêng chiap-khì chia̍h.

Āu-lâi Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “ Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat kap sian-ti ê chheh, í-ki̍p Si-phian kì-chài koan-hē góa ê tāi-chì, it-tēng tio̍h èng-giām. Chiah-ê ōe góa iáu kap lín chòe-hé ê sî í-keng ū kā lín kóng lah.”
Iâ-so͘ chiū khui in ê sim-khiàu, hō͘ in bêng-pe̍k Sèng-keng,
tùi in kóng, “Sèng-keng ū án-ni kì-chài: Ki-tok tio̍h siū khó͘-lān, tē-saⁿ ji̍t tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h,
koh lín tio̍h hōng I ê miâ thoân hóe-kái lâi tit-tio̍h sià-chōe ê tō-lí, tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khí, thoân kàu bān-kok.
Lín chiū-sī chiah-ê tāi-chì ê kiàn-chèng-jîn.
Góa chiong góa ê Pē só͘ èng-ún--ê kau hō͘ lín; tio̍h tī chit-ê siâⁿ thèng-hāu, kàu lín tit-tio̍h tùi téng-bīn lâi ê lêng-le̍k.”
Iâ-so͘ chhōa in chhut--khì, it-ti̍t kàu Pek-tāi-nî, jiân-āu gia̍h siang-chhiú kā in chiok-hok.
I teh kā in chiok-hok ê sî lī-khui in, siū chiap chiūⁿ-thiⁿ.
In chiū kā I pài, jiân-āu hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí tńg-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng,
kè-sio̍k tī Sèng-tiān chheng-chàn Siōng-tè.
Chhòng-sè í-chêng chiū ū Tō, Tō kap Siōng-tè tông-chāi, Tō sī Siōng-tè.
I tī chhòng-sè í-chêng chiū kap Siōng-tè tông-chāi.
Siōng-tè thong-kè I chhòng-chō bān-iú; it-chhè pī-chō ê ta̍k-hāng lóng sī thong-kè Tō lâi chhòng-chō.
Tī I lāi-bīn ū oa̍h-miā; chit-ê oa̍h-miā sī jîn-lūi ê kng.
Chit-ê kng tī o͘-àm tiong teh chiò, o͘-àm m̄-bat iâⁿ-kè kng.
Ū Siōng-tè chhe--lâi ê chi̍t ê lâng, miâ kiò-chòe Iok-hān.
Chit-ê lâng lâi sī beh choh-chèng, ūi-tio̍h kng choh-chèng, beh hō͘ só͘-ū ê lâng thong-kè i lâi sìn.
I pún-sin m̄-sī hit-ê kng, sī beh ūi-tio̍h hit-ê kng choh-chèng.
Ū chin ê kng chìn-ji̍p sè-kan lâi chiò choân jîn-lūi.
I tī sè-kan; sè-kan thong-kè I lâi chhòng-chō, m̄-kú sè-kan m̄ bat I.
I lâi kàu ka-kī ê só͘-chāi, ka-kī ê lâng bô chiap-la̍p I.
Hiah-ê chiap-la̍p I--ê, chiū-sī sìn I ê lâng, I sù in ū koân chiâⁿ-chòe Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî.
In m̄-sī tùi hiat-thóng, m̄-sī tùi jio̍k-io̍k, mā m̄-sī tùi ta-po͘-lâng ê ì-liām, sī tùi Siōng-tè siⁿ--ê.
Tō chiâⁿ-chòe lâng, tiàm tī lán tiong-kan, chhiong-móa un-tián kap chin-lí; goán ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I ê êng-iāu, sī Thiⁿ-pē to̍k-it ê Kiáⁿ chiah ū ê êng-iāu.

Iok-hān ūi-tio̍h I choh-chèng, hoah kóng, “Chit-ūi chiū-sī góa bat kā lín kóng--ê, I tī góa āu-bīn teh lâi, khiok pí góa khah tōa; in-ūi góa iáu-bē chhut-sì, I chiū chûn-chāi.”
Tùi I ê hong-hù lán lóng niá-siū un-tián, un-siōng-ka-un.
Lu̍t-hoat thong-kè Mô͘-se pan-pò͘; un-tián kap chin-lí sī thong-kè Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok lâi--ê.
Bô lâng bat khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè, chí-ū Pē sim-hoâi tiong to̍k-it ê Kiáⁿ ū kā I hián-sī--chhut-lâi.
Í-hā sī Iok-hān ê kiàn-chèng: Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê Iû-thài -kàu tong-kio̍k phài chè-si kap Lī-bī -lâng khì mn̄g Iok-hān ê sî, kóng, “Lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?”
I bô kū-choa̍t hôe-tap, kong-khai seng-bêng “Góa m̄-sī Ki-tok”.
In koh mn̄g i, “Nā án-ni, lí sī Í-lī-a sī--bô?” Iok-hān ìn kóng, “Góa m̄-sī.” In koh mn̄g, “Lí sī hit-ūi Sian-ti sī--bô?” Iok-hān ìn kóng, “M̄-sī.”
In chiū kā i kóng, “Án-ni lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng? Chhiáⁿ kā goán kóng, hō͘ goán thang hôe-tap phài goán lâi ê lâng. Lí kóng, tàu-tóe lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?”
Iok-hān ín-iōng sian-ti Í-sài-a ê ōe, kóng: Góa chiū-sī tī khòng-iá teh hoah ê siaⁿ, kóng: Tio̍h ūi Chú siu-ti̍t tō-lō͘.
Hiah-ê lâng sī Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chhe--lâi-ê.
In koh mn̄g Iok-hān, kóng, “Lí nā m̄-sī Ki-tok, m̄-sī Í-lī-a, mā m̄-sī hit-ūi Sian-ti, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ kā lâng sóe-lé?”
Iok-hān ìn kóng, “Góa ēng chúi kā lâng sóe-lé; m̄-kú ū chi̍t ūi lín m̄ bat--ê khiā tī lín tiong-kan.
I tī góa āu-bīn teh lâi, góa liân kā I tháu ôe-tòa to bōe-kham--tit.”
Chiah-ê sū tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-hōaⁿ ê Pek-tāi-nî hoat-seng, Iok-tàn-hô chiū-sī Iok-hān teh kā lâng sóe-lé ê só͘-chāi.
Keh-ji̍t, Iok-hān khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ kiâⁿ óa--lâi, chiū kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, Siōng-tè ê Iûⁿ-ko, I beh tû-khì sè-kan-lâng ê chōe.
Koan-hē I ê tāi-chì, góa bat kā lín kóng, I pí góa khah bān lâi, chóng-sī pí góa khah tōa, in-ūi góa iáu-bē chhut-sì, I chiū chûn-chāi.
Góa ka-kī mā m̄ bat I, m̄-kú góa lâi ēng chúi kā lâng sóe-lé, sī beh hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng jīn-bat I.”
Iok-hān koh choh-chèng, kóng, “Góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sèng Sîn chhin-chhiūⁿ hún-chiáu tùi thiⁿ kàng--lo̍h-lâi, hioh tī I téng-bīn.

Góa ka-kī mā m̄ bat I, m̄-kú chhe góa ēng chúi kā lâng sóe-lé hit-ūi Siōng-tè ū tùi góa kóng, ‘Lí khòaⁿ-tio̍h Sèng Sîn kàng lo̍h-lâi hioh tī I téng-bīn hit-ê, I chiū-sī beh ēng Sèng Sîn kā lâng sóe-lé Hit-ūi.’
Góa ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, koh choh-chèng, chit-ūi chiū-sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ.”
Keh-ji̍t, Iok-hān koh kap i nn̄g ê bûn-tô͘ khiā tī hia;
i khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ keng-kè, chiū kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, Siōng-tè ê Iûⁿ-ko!”
Chit nn̄g ê bûn-tô͘ thiaⁿ-tio̍h i án-ni kóng, chiū khì tè Iâ-so͘.
Iâ-so͘ oa̍t--kè-lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h in teh tè I, chiū mn̄g in, “Lín teh chhē sím-mi̍h?” In kā I kóng, “Lia̍p-pí, lí tòa tó-ūi?” Lia̍p-pí ê ì-sù sī lāu-su.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín lâi khòaⁿ!” In chiū khì khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘ tòa ê só͘-chāi, hit-ji̍t kap I chòe-hé tòa. Hit-sî tāi-iok ē-po͘ sì tiám.
Thiaⁿ Iok-hān ê ōe lâi tè Iâ-so͘ hit nn̄g lâng, chi̍t ê sī Se-bûn Pí-tek ê sió-tī An-tek-lia̍t.
I seng khì chhē i ê hiaⁿ-ko Se-bûn, tùi i kóng, “Goán í-keng ū tú-tio̍h Bí-sài-a.” Bí-sài-a ê ì-sù sī Ki-tok.

I chiū chhōa Se-bûn khì kìⁿ Iâ-so͘. Iâ-so͘ chù-ba̍k kā i khòaⁿ, kóng, “Lí sī Iok-hān ê kiáⁿ Se-bûn, góa beh kā lí kiò-chòe Ki-hoat.” Ki-hoat kap Pí-tek siâng ì-sù, chiū-sī chio̍h-pôaⁿ.
Keh-ji̍t, Iâ-so͘ koat-tēng beh khì Ka-lī-lī. I tú-tio̍h Hui-le̍k, tùi i kóng, “Lâi tè góa!”
Hui-le̍k sī Pek-sài-tāi -lâng, An-tek-lia̍t kap Pí-tek ê tông-hiong.

Hui-le̍k tú-tio̍h Ná-tàn-gia̍p, tùi i kóng, “ Mô͘-se tī Lu̍t-hoat-su só͘ siá, í-ki̍p sian-ti só͘ kì-chài Hit-ūi, goán í-keng ū tú--tio̍h, chiū-sī Iok-sek ê kiáⁿ Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘.”
Ná-tàn-gia̍p ìn kóng, “ Ná-sat-le̍k hit-khoán só͘-chāi kiám ōe chhut sím-mi̍h hó-mi̍h?” Hui-le̍k kā i kóng, “Lí lâi khòaⁿ!”
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h Ná-tàn-gia̍p kiâⁿ óa--lâi, chiū kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, i sī chin-chiàⁿ ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, lóng bô hu-ké!”
Ná-tàn-gia̍p mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Lí ná ōe bat góa?” Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “ Hui-le̍k iáu-bē kiò lí, góa chiū khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí tī hit-châng bû-hoa-kó-chhiū kha.”
Ná-tàn-gia̍p ìn kóng, “Lia̍p-pí, lí sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ! Lí sī Í-sek-lia̍t ê Ông!”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “In-ūi góa kā lí kóng góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí tī hit-châng bû-hoa-kó-chhiū kha, lí chiū sìn o͘h? Lí ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h pí che koh-khah tōa ê sū.”
Iâ-so͘ koh kā i kóng, “Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, lín ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ thiⁿ khui, Siōng-tè ê thiⁿ-sài tī Jîn-chú ê sin-chiūⁿ chiūⁿ-lo̍h óng-lâi.”
Nn̄g ji̍t āu, tī Ka-lī-lī ê Ka-ná ū hun-lé; Iâ-so͘ ê lāu-bú ū tī hia.
Iâ-so͘ kap I ê bûn-tô͘ mā siū iau-chhiáⁿ khì chham-ka.
Chiú ēng-liáu ê sî, Iâ-so͘ ê lāu-bú tùi I kóng, “In í-keng bô chiú lah.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “A-bú, che kap lí góa ū sím-mi̍h koan-hē; góa ê sî iáu-bē kàu.”
I ê lāu-bú hoan-hù chhe-ēng ê lâng kóng, “I kā lín kóng sím-mi̍h, chiàu án-ni khì chòe.”
Chiàu Iû-thài -lâng kiat-chēng ê kui-lē, tī hia ū la̍k ê chio̍h-àng, ta̍k-ê ōe-tàng tóe chha-put-to chi̍t-pah kong-seng.
Iâ-so͘ kā hiah-ê chhe-ēng kóng, “Chiah-ê chúi-àng, chúi lóng tò hō͘ i tīⁿ.” In chiū chiong chúi tò ji̍p-khì chúi-àng, tò kàu móa.
Jiân-āu Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Taⁿ lín kā chúi iúⁿ--chhut-lâi, the̍h hō͘ pān-toh ê chóng-koán.” In chiū phâng-khì hō͘ i.
Pān-toh ê chóng-koán chi̍t-ē tam-tio̍h í-keng pìⁿ-chòe chiú ê chúi, m̄ chai chit-ê chiú tùi tó-ūi lâi, put-kò iúⁿ-chúi ê chhe-ēng chai; chóng-koán chiū kiò sin-lông lâi,
tùi i kóng, “Lâng lóng seng chhut hó chiú, tán lâng-kheh lim kàu chùi chiah chhut khah bái ê chiú, lí tian-tò chiong hó chiú lâu kàu chit-chūn.”
Iâ-so͘ tī Ka-lī-lī ê Ka-ná kiâⁿ chit-ê tē-it ê sîn-jiah, tī hia hián-sī I ê êng-kng; I ê bûn-tô͘ lóng sìn I.
Chit-ê tāi-chì í-āu, Iâ-so͘ kap I ê lāu-bú, hiaⁿ-tī, í-ki̍p bûn-tô͘ lo̍h-khì Ka-pek-lông, tī hia tòa kúi-nā ji̍t.
Iû-thài -lâng ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh teh-beh kàu, Iâ-so͘ chiūⁿ-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
I khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū lâng tī Sèng-tiān ê gōa-tiâⁿ teh bōe gû, iûⁿ, hún-chiáu; mā ū ōaⁿ-chîⁿ ê lâng teh hō͘ lâng ōaⁿ-chîⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ chiū ēng soh-á chòe piⁿ, chiong gû, iûⁿ lóng tùi Sèng-tiān kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, chhia-tó chîⁿ-toh-á, kā in ê chîⁿ iā-sòaⁿ.
I koh tùi bōe hún-chiáu ê lâng kóng, “Chiah-ê lóng poaⁿ-poaⁿ--chhut-khì; m̄-thang kā góa ê Pē ê chhù pìⁿ-chòe bóe-bōe ê chhù!”
I ê bûn-tô͘ ōe-kì-tit Sèng-keng ū kì-chài, “Siōng-tè ah, góa ūi-tio̍h lí ê tiān sim hé-jia̍t, kui-ê lâng lóng hō͘ thun--lo̍h-khì.”
Iû-thài -kàu tong-kio̍k ê lâng hoán-mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Lí beh ēng sím-mi̍h sîn-jiah kā goán chèng-bêng lí ū koân-pèng chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lín thiah-húi chit-keng Sèng-tiān, saⁿ ji̍t lāi góa beh koh kā i khí--khí-lâi.”
In kóng, “Chit-keng Sèng-tiān sì-cha̍p-la̍k nî kú chiah khí hó, lí saⁿ ji̍t lāi chiū beh khí--khí-lâi o͘h?”
Kî-si̍t, Iâ-so͘ só͘ kóng ê Sèng-tiān sī chí I ê seng-khu.
I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h í-āu, I ê bûn-tô͘ chiah ōe-kì-tit I bat án-ni kóng, in chiū sìn Sèng-keng kap Iâ-so͘ kóng ê ōe.
Iâ-so͘ tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kè Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê sî, chin chōe lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h I kiâⁿ ê sîn-jiah chiū sìn I.
Put-kò Iâ-so͘ bô sìn-jīm in, in-ūi I liáu-kái só͘-ū ê lâng.
Koan-hē lâng ê tāi-chì, I bô su-iàu lâng kā I soat-bêng, in-ūi I chin-chiàⁿ liáu-kái lâng ê lāi-sim.
Ū chi̍t ê Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng miâ kiò-chòe Nî-ko-tek-bō͘, sī Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-tō-chiá.

Ū chi̍t àm, chit-ê lâng lâi kìⁿ Iâ-so͘, kóng, “Lia̍p-pí, goán chai lí sī Siōng-tè chhe--lâi ê kàu-su. Nā m̄-sī Siōng-tè tông-chāi, bô lâng ōe-tàng kiâⁿ lí só͘ kiâⁿ chiah-ê sîn-jiah.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lí kóng, lâng nā bô têng chhut-sì, chiū bōe-tàng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè-kok.”
Nî-ko-tek-bō͘ mn̄g kóng, “Lâng í-keng lāu, ná ōe-tàng têng chhut-sì? Kiám kóng i ōe-tàng koh chi̍t piàn ji̍p-khì bú-thai lâi chhut-sì?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lí kóng, lâng nā bô tùi chúi kap Sèng Sîn lâi chhut-sì, chiū bōe-tàng chiâⁿ-chòe Siōng-tè-kok ê chú-bîn.
Tùi jio̍k-thé siⁿ--ê, sī jio̍k-thé; tùi Sèng Sîn siⁿ--ê, sī sîn-lêng.
M̄-thang in-ūi góa kóng ‘lín tio̍h têng chhut-sì’ lâi kî-koài.
Hong beh chhe-khì tó-ūi chiū chhe-khì tó-ūi, lí ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h siaⁿ, m̄-kú m̄ chai i tùi tó-ūi lâi, tùi tó-ūi khì. Ta̍k-ê tùi Sèng Sîn siⁿ--ê mā-sī án-ni.”
Nî-ko-tek-bō͘ mn̄g Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Chit-khoán tāi-chì ná ū khó-lêng?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lí sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê kàu-su, liân che to m̄ chai o͘h?
“Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lí kóng, goán kóng goán só͘ chai--ê, mā ūi-tio̍h goán só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê choh-chèng, m̄-kú lín m̄ chiap-siū goán ê kiàn-chèng.
Góa kā lín kóng chit sè-kan ê tāi-chì, lín to m̄ sìn, góa nā kā lín kóng thiⁿ-téng ê tāi-chì, lín ná beh sìn?
Tùi thiⁿ-téng kàng-lîm ê Jîn-chú í-gōa, bô lâng bat chiūⁿ-thiⁿ.
“Chhin-chhiūⁿ Mô͘-se tī khòng-iá kú-khí tâng-chôa, Jîn-chú mā it-tēng tio̍h án-ni siū kú-khí,
hō͘ ta̍k-ê sìn I ê lâng tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Siōng-tè liân I to̍k-it ê Kiáⁿ to sù hō͘ sè-kan, beh hō͘ ta̍k-ê sìn I ê lâng bián bia̍t-bông, hoán-tńg tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā, I chiah-ni̍h thiàⁿ sè-kan!
In-ūi Siōng-tè chhe I ê Kiáⁿ lâi sè-kan, m̄-sī beh sím-phòaⁿ sè-kan, sī beh thong-kè I lâi chín-kiù sè-kan.
“Sìn Kiáⁿ ê lâng bōe siū tēng-chōe; m̄-sìn ê lâng í-keng siū tēng-chōe, in-ūi i m̄ sìn Siōng-tè to̍k-it ê Kiáⁿ.
Siōng-tè ê sím-phòaⁿ sī án-ni: Kng chìn-ji̍p sè-kan, sè-kan-lâng khah ài o͘-àm, khah bô ài kng-bêng, in-ūi in ê hêng-ûi siâ-ok.
Chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng lóng oàn-hūn kng, m̄ chiap-kūn kng, án-ni i ê hêng-ûi chiah bōe lō͘-hiān.
M̄-kú si̍t-hêng chin-lí ê lâng chiap-kūn kng, sī beh hián-bêng i ê hêng-ûi sī sūn-thàn Siōng-tè lâi chòe--ê.”
Chiah-ê tāi-chì í-āu, Iâ-so͘ kap I ê bûn-tô͘ khì Iû-thài tōe-khu, I kap in chiām-sî tòa hia, koh kā lâng sóe-lé.
Iok-hān mā tī Sat-léng hù-kūn ê Ai-loán teh kā lâng sóe-lé, in-ūi hia ū chin chōe chúi, chèng-lâng sòa-chiap lâi chiap-siū Iok-hān ê sóe-lé.
Hit-sî Iok-hān iáu-bē hō͘ lâng koaiⁿ-kaⁿ.
Kúi-nā ê Iok-hān ê bûn-tô͘ kap chi̍t ê Iû-thài -lâng ūi-tio̍h kiat-chēng ê lé-gî piān-lūn.

In lâi kìⁿ Iok-hān, tùi i kóng, “Lia̍p-pí, í-chêng tī Iok-tàn-hô tang-hōaⁿ kap lí chòe-hé, lí bat ūi-tio̍h I choh-chèng Hit-ūi, lí khòaⁿ, I hiān-chāi teh kā lâng sóe-lé, chèng-lâng lóng khì I hia.”
Iok-hān ìn kóng, “Nā m̄-sī thiⁿ siúⁿ-sù, lâng bōe-tàng tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h.
Góa bat kóng ‘Góa m̄-sī Ki-tok, put-kò sī siū phài chòe I ê sian-hong’. Chit-ê tāi-chì, lín pún-sin sī góa ê kiàn-chèng-jîn.
Chhōa sin-niû--ê sī sin-lông; sin-lông ê pêng-iú khiā tī piⁿ--á, chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h sin-lông ê siaⁿ chiū hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí. Só͘-í, góa ê hoaⁿ-hí móa-móa.
I it-tēng ná heng-ōng, góa it-tēng ná soe-bî.”
Tùi téng-bīn lâi--ê, tī bān-iú ê téng-bīn; tùi tōe-chiūⁿ lâi--ê, sio̍k tōe-chiūⁿ, só͘ kóng--ê sī tōe-chiūⁿ ê sū. Tùi thiⁿ-téng lâi--ê, tī bān-iú ê téng-bīn.
I ūi-tio̍h só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê kap só͘ thiaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê choh-chèng, put-kò bô lâng chiap-siū I ê kiàn-chèng.
Chiap-siū I kiàn-chèng ê lâng chèng-bêng Siōng-tè sī sìn-si̍t.
Siōng-tè só͘ chhe-khián Hit-ūi kóng Siōng-tè só͘ kóng ê ōe, in-ūi Siōng-tè bû-hān-liōng sù Sèng Sîn hō͘ I.
Pē thiàⁿ Kiáⁿ, í-keng chiong it-chhè lóng kau tī I ê chhiú-tiong.
Sìn Kiáⁿ ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā; m̄ sūn-ho̍k Kiáⁿ ê lâng m̄-nā bōe tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā, hoán-tńg kè-sio̍k hō͘ Siōng-tè siū-khì.
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ pí Iok-hān chio khah chōe bûn-tô͘, koh kā khah chōe lâng sóe-lé.
Kî-si̍t Iâ-so͘ m̄-bat kā lâng sóe-lé, sī I ê bûn-tô͘ kā lâng sóe-lé.
Iâ-so͘ thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì chiū lī-khui Iû-thài, tńg-khì Ka-lī-lī;
I tio̍h keng-kè Sat-má-lī-a.
Iâ-so͘ lâi kàu Sat-má-lī-a ê chi̍t ê siâⁿ, kiò-chòe Sū-ka, chit-ê siâⁿ óa-kūn Ngá-kok hō͘ i ê kiáⁿ Iok-sek hit-tè tōe.
Ngá-kok -chíⁿ tī hia. Iâ-so͘ in-ūi kiâⁿ-lō͘ chin siān chiū chē tī chíⁿ-piⁿ. Hit-sî chha-put-to sī tiong-tàu.
Ū chi̍t ê Sat-má-lī-a ê hū-jîn-lâng lâi chhiūⁿ-chúi. Iâ-so͘ tùi i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chi̍t-sut-á chúi hō͘ góa lim.”
Hit-sî I ê bûn-tô͘ í-keng ji̍p-khì siâⁿ-lāi bóe chia̍h-mi̍h.

Sat-má-lī-a ê hū-jîn-lâng ìn Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lí sī Iû-thài -lâng, ná ōe tùi góa chit-ê Sat-má-lī-a ê cha-bó͘-lâng thó chúi lim?” Goân-lâi Iû-thài -lâng kap Sat-má-lī-a -lâng bô lâi-óng.

Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lí nā liáu-kái Siōng-tè hō͘ lâng ê un-sù, koh ū tùi lí kóng ‘Chhiáⁿ chi̍t-sut-á chúi hō͘ góa lim’ hit-ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng, lí chá chiū ōe kā I kiû, I chá chiū ōe chiong oa̍h-chúi hō͘ lí.”
Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, lí bô chhiūⁿ-chúi ê khì-khū, chíⁿ koh chhim, lí beh án-chóaⁿ tit-tio̍h oa̍h-chúi?
Goán ê chó͘-sian Ngá-kok lâu chit-ê chíⁿ hō͘ goán, i ka-kī, i ê kiáⁿ-sun, kap i ê cheng-siⁿ, lóng lim chit-ê chíⁿ-chúi, lí kiám ōe pí i khah gâu?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lim chit-ê chíⁿ-chúi ê lâng lóng ōe koh chhùi-ta;

put-kò lim góa só͘ beh hō͘ i ê chúi--ê bōe koh chhùi-ta. In-ūi góa beh hō͘ i ê chúi tī i ê lāi-bīn ōe chiâⁿ-chòe chúi-chôaⁿ, it-ti̍t chhèng-chhut oa̍h-chúi, hō͘ i tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.”
Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, chhiáⁿ hō͘ góa chit-ê chúi, góa chiah bōe koh chhùi-ta, mā bián koh lâi chia chhiūⁿ-chúi.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí khì kiò lí ê tiōng-hu, chhōa i lâi chia.”
Hū-jîn-lâng ìn kóng, “Góa bô tiōng-hu.” Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí kóng ‘Góa bô tiōng-hu’ ū-iáⁿ.
Lí bat ū gō͘ ê tiōng-hu, hiān-chāi chit-ê m̄-sī lí ê tiōng-hu, lí kóng--ê sī sū-si̍t.”
Hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, góa khòaⁿ lí sī sian-ti.
Goán Sat-má-lī-a -lâng ê chó͘-sian tī chit-ê soaⁿ-téng kèng-pài Siōng-tè; lín Iû-thài -lâng kóng Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiah sī kèng-pài Siōng-tè ê só͘-chāi.”
Iâ-so͘ tùi i kóng, “Hū-jîn-lâng, tio̍h sìn góa. Sî teh-beh kàu, hit-sî lín bōe tī chit-ê soaⁿ-téng, mā bōe tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kèng-pài Pē.
Lín Sat-má-lī-a -lâng kèng-pài lín só͘ m̄ bat--ê; goán Iû-thài -lâng kèng-pài goán só͘ bat--ê; in-ūi chín-kiù tùi Iû-thài -lâng chhut--lâi.
Put-kò, sî teh-beh kàu, hiān-chāi chiū-sī, chin-chiàⁿ kèng-pài Pē ê lâng ōe ēng sim-lêng kap chin-sêng kèng-pài. In-ūi Pē ài chit-khoán ê lâng kèng-pài I.
Siōng-tè sī Sîn, kèng-pài I ê lâng tio̍h ēng sim-lêng kap chin-sêng kèng-pài.”
Hū-jîn-lâng tùi I kóng, “Góa chai hit-ūi chheng-chòe Ki-tok ê Bí-sài-a teh-beh lâi, I lâi ê sî ōe chiong it-chhè ê tāi-chì kā goán kóng.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Góa, chit-ê teh kap lí kóng-ōe--ê chiū-sī.”

Tú chit-ê sî, Iâ-so͘ ê bûn-tô͘ tńg--lâi. In khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ kap hū-jîn-lâng teh kóng-ōe, kám-kak chin kî-koài, put-kò bô lâng mn̄g hū-jîn-lâng “Lí beh chhòng sím-mi̍h”, á-sī mn̄g Iâ-so͘ “Lí ná teh kap hū-jîn-lâng kóng-ōe”.
Hū-jîn-lâng chiū chiong chúi-pân pàng-hē--teh, tńg-khì siâⁿ-lāi, tùi lâng kóng,
“Lâi-khì khòaⁿ, chit-ê lâng chiong góa kè-khì só͘ chòe ê it-chhè lóng kā góa kóng--chhut-lâi. I káⁿ sī Ki-tok ho͘hⁿ?”
Tāi-ke chiū chhut-siâⁿ khì khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘.
Hit-sî bûn-tô͘ kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lia̍p-pí, chhiáⁿ lâi chia̍h.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa ū lín m̄-chai ê chia̍h-mi̍h.”
Bûn-tô͘ chiū mn̄g-lâi-mn̄g-khì kóng, “Kiám ū lâng the̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ I chia̍h?”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa ê chia̍h-mi̍h chiū-sī si̍t-hêng chhe góa Hit-ūi ê chí-ì, koh oân-sêng I ê kang-chok.
Lín kiám bô án-ni kóng ‘Koh sì kò-ge̍h chiū ū thang siu-sêng’? Góa kā lín kóng, ba̍k-chiu peh hō͘ kim, khòaⁿ sì-bīn ê chhân-hn̂g; ngó͘-kok í-keng sek, thang siu-sêng lah.
Hiān-chāi siu-koah ê lâng í-keng teh niá kang-chîⁿ, koh teh siu-sêng hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h éng-oán oa̍h-miā ê ngó͘-kok, hō͘ iā-chéng--ê kap siu-koah--ê chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí.
In-ūi sio̍k-gú kóng ‘Chi̍t ê iā-chéng, chi̍t ê siu-koah’, kóng-liáu chin tio̍h.
Lín bô sin-khó͘ keng-choh--ê, góa chhe lín khì siu-sêng; pa̍t-lâng sin-khó͘, lín hióng-siū in sin-khó͘ ê sêng-kó.”
Hit-ê siâⁿ ū chin chōe Sat-má-lī-a -lâng sìn Iâ-so͘, in-ūi hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng choh-chèng kóng, “I chiong góa kè-khì só͘ chòe ê it-chhè lóng kā góa kóng--chhut-lâi.”
Só͘-í hiah-ê Sat-má-lī-a -lâng lâi kìⁿ Iâ-so͘, kiû I tòa in hia, I chiū tī hia tòa nn̄g ji̍t.
In-ūi Iâ-so͘ só͘ kóng ê ōe, ū koh-khah chōe lâng lâi sìn.

Hiah-ê lâng kā hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng kóng, “Hiān-chāi goán sìn, m̄-sī in-ūi lí só͘ kóng ê ōe, sī in-ūi goán ū chhin-hī thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê ōe, chai-iáⁿ I chin-chiàⁿ sī sè-kan ê Kiù-chú.”
Nn̄g ji̍t āu, Iâ-so͘ lī-khui hia khì Ka-lī-lī.
In-ūi Iâ-so͘ ka-kī bat kóng, “Sian-ti tī ka-kī ê kò͘-hiong bōe siū chun-tiōng.”

Iâ-so͘ kàu Ka-lī-lī ê sî, Ka-lī-lī -lâng ū kā I hoan-gêng, in-ūi in khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kè Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê sî, ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h I tī choeh-kî tiong só͘ chòe it-chhè ê tāi-chì.
Iâ-so͘ koh tńg-khì Ka-lī-lī ê Ka-ná, chiū-sī I bat ēng chúi pìⁿ-chòe chiú ê só͘-chāi. Tī hia ū chi̍t ê Ka-pek-lông ê koaⁿ-oân, i ê kiáⁿ phòa-pīⁿ.
I thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ tùi Iû-thài lâi kàu Ka-lī-lī, chiū khì kiû Iâ-so͘ lo̍h-khì Ka-pek-lông i-tī i ê kiáⁿ, in-ūi i ê kiáⁿ teh-beh sí lah.
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lín nā bô khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sîn-jiah kî-sū, it-tēng bōe sìn.”
Hit-ê koaⁿ-oân ìn kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, chhiáⁿ lí tī góa ê sòe-kiáⁿ iáu-bē sí í-chêng lo̍h--lâi-khì.”
Iâ-so͘ tùi i kóng, “Tńg--khì, lí ê kiáⁿ bōe sí.” Hit-ê lâng sìn Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng ê ōe, chiū tńg--khì.
Tī lō͘-tiong, i ê po̍k-jîn tú--tio̍h, kā i kóng i ê sòe-kiáⁿ oa̍h--khí-lâi lah.
I chiū mn̄g in i ê kiáⁿ sím-mi̍h sî hó--khí-lâi. In ìn kóng, “Chā-hng ē-po͘ chi̍t tiám jia̍t chiū thè--khì.”
Lāu-pē chai-iáⁿ, tú-tú hit-ê sî Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng “Lí ê kiáⁿ bōe sí”. I ka-kī sìn, choân-ke ê lâng mā lóng sìn.
Che sī Iâ-so͘ tùi Iû-thài lâi Ka-lī-lī í-āu só͘ kiâⁿ ê tē-jī ê sîn-jiah.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì í-āu, ū chi̍t ê Iû-thài -lâng ê choeh-kî, Iâ-so͘ chiūⁿ-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, kūn Iûⁿ-mn̂g ê só͘-chāi ū chi̍t ê chúi-tî, Hi-pek-lâi-ōe kiò-chòe Pit-sū-tāi, chúi-tî piⁿ ū gō͘ ê cháu-lông.
Tī cháu-lông ū chin chōe pīⁿ-lâng tó tī hia; ū sit-bêng--ê, kha-pái--ê, kap poàn-sin-put-sūi--ê.
Tī hia ū chi̍t ê phòa-pīⁿ saⁿ-cha̍p-poeh nî kú ê lâng.
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h i tī hia, chai-iáⁿ i í-keng tī hia tó chin kú, chiū kā i kóng, “Lí ài hó--khí-lâi--bô?”
Hit-ê pīⁿ-lâng ìn kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, chúi tín-tāng ê sî bô lâng kā góa phō lo̍h-khì chúi-tî, góa siūⁿ-beh lo̍h--khì ê sî, pa̍t-lâng pí góa seng lo̍h--khì lah.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Khí--lâi, giâ lí ê chhn̂g-pho͘ khí-lâi kiâⁿ.”
Hit-ê lâng sûi-sî hó--khí-lâi, chiū giâ i ê chhn̂g-pho͘ khí-lâi kiâⁿ. Hit-ji̍t sī An-hioh-ji̍t,
só͘-í Iû-thài -lâng tùi hit-ê hō͘ Iâ-so͘ i-hó ê lâng kóng, “Kin-á-ji̍t sī An-hioh-ji̍t, lí giâ chhn̂g-pho͘ bô ha̍p-hoat.”
I ìn kóng, “I-hó góa hit-ê lâng kā góa kóng, ‘Giâ lí ê chhn̂g-pho͘ khí-lâi kiâⁿ.’”
In chiū mn̄g i, “Kiò lí giâ chhn̂g-pho͘ khí-lâi kiâⁿ hit-ê sī siáⁿ-lâng?”
I m̄ chai hit-ê kā i i-hó--ê sī siáⁿ-lâng, in-ūi ū chin chōe lâng tī hia, koh Iâ-so͘ ia̍h í-keng tiām-tiām-á lī-khui.
Āu-lâi, Iâ-so͘ tī Sèng-tiān tú-tio̍h i, kā i kóng, “Lí í-keng hó lah, m̄-thang koh hoān-chōe, chiah bōe tú-tio̍h koh-khah chhám ê tāi-chì.”
Hit-ê lâng lī-khui liáu-āu tùi Iû-thài -lâng kóng, kā i i-hó--ê sī Iâ-so͘.
In-ūi án-ni, in khai-sí pek-hāi Iâ-so͘, in-ūi I tī An-hioh-ji̍t kā lâng i-pīⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Góa ê Pē kàu hiān-chāi it-ti̍t teh kang-chok, góa mā teh kang-chok.”

Ūi-tio̍h án-ni, Iû-thài -kàu tong-kio̍k koh-khah siūⁿ-beh hāi-sí Iâ-so͘; in-ūi Iâ-so͘ m̄-nā ûi-hoān An-hioh-ji̍t ê kui-tēng, koh chheng Siōng-tè chòe I ka-kī ê Pē, khòaⁿ ka-kī kap Siōng-tè pêng-téng.

Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, Kiáⁿ bōe-tàng chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù chòe tāi-chì, chí-ū khòaⁿ Pē chòe sím-mi̍h, I chiah chiàu án-ni chòe. Pē só͘ chòe--ê, Kiáⁿ mā chiàu án-ni chòe.
In-ūi Pē thiàⁿ Kiáⁿ, chiong ka-kī só͘ teh chòe ê it-chhè lóng chí-sī Kiáⁿ, mā ōe chiong pí chiah-ê khah-tōa ê sū chí-sī I, beh hō͘ lín kám-kak kî-koài.
Pē án-chóaⁿ hō͘ sí-lâng koh-oa̍h, sù in oa̍h-miā, chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, Kiáⁿ mā beh chiong oa̍h-miā sù hō͘ ka-kī só͘ ài ê lâng.
Pē lóng bô kā lâng sím-phòaⁿ. I í-keng chiong sím-phòaⁿ ê koân-pèng lóng kau hō͘ Kiáⁿ,
sī beh hō͘ chèng-lâng chun-kèng Kiáⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ chun-kèng Pē. Bô chun-kèng Kiáⁿ chiū-sī bô chun-kèng chhe I lâi ê Pē.
“Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, thiaⁿ góa ê ōe koh sìn chhe góa Hit-ūi ê lâng ū éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā; i í-keng chhut-sí-ji̍p-oa̍h, m̄-bián siū sím-phòaⁿ.
Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, sî teh-beh kàu, hiān-chāi chiū-sī, sí-lâng ōe thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ ê siaⁿ, thiaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng ōe oa̍h--khí-lâi.
In-ūi Pē pún-sin sī oa̍h-miā ê kun-goân, I mā án-ni hō͘ Kiáⁿ chiâⁿ-chòe oa̍h-miā ê kun-goân.
I í-keng chiong sím-phòaⁿ ê koân-pèng sù hō͘ Kiáⁿ, in-ūi Kiáⁿ sī Jîn-chú.
Chit-ê sū lín m̄-thang kám-kak kî-koài, in-ūi sî teh-beh kàu, só͘-ū sí--khì ê lâng lóng ōe thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Kiáⁿ ê siaⁿ,
in ōe tùi bōng--ni̍h chhut--lâi: Choh-hó--ê koh-oa̍h, tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā; choh-pháiⁿ--ê koh-oa̍h, siū tēng-chōe.”

“Góa bōe-tàng chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù chòe sím-mi̍h; góa chí-ū chiàu só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê lâi sím-phòaⁿ. Góa ê sím-phòaⁿ kong-chèng, in-ūi góa m̄-sī thàn ka-kī ê ì-sù, sī chiàu chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi ê chí-ì.
“Góa nā ūi-tio̍h ka-kī choh-chèng, góa ê kiàn-chèng chiū bô chin-si̍t.
Ū lēng-gōa chi̍t ê lâng teh ūi-tio̍h góa choh-chèng, góa chai i ūi-tio̍h góa só͘ chòe ê kiàn-chèng sī chin-si̍t.
Lín bat phài lâng khì kìⁿ Iok-hān, i ū ūi-tio̍h chin-lí choh-chèng.
M̄-sī kóng góa su-iàu lâng ūi-tio̍h góa choh-chèng; kî-si̍t góa kóng chiah-ê sū sī beh hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h kiù.
Iok-hān sī teh to̍h teh chiò-kng ê teng, lín hoaⁿ-hí chiām-sî hióng-siū i ê kng.

Put-kò góa ū pí Iok-hān khah ū-la̍t ê kiàn-chèng. Pē kau-tài góa oân-sêng ê kang-chok, chiū-sī góa hiān-chāi teh chòe ê kang-chok, ōe-tàng ūi-tio̍h góa choh-chèng, piáu-sī Pē ū chhe góa.
Koh chhe góa ê Pē í-keng chhin-sin ūi-tio̍h góa choh-chèng. Lín iáu m̄-bat thiaⁿ-tio̍h I ê siaⁿ, mā m̄-bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h I ê hêng-chōng.
Lín bô chiong I ê ōe khǹg tī sim-lāi, in-ūi lín m̄ sìn I só͘ chhe Hit-ūi.
Lín gián-kiù Sèng-keng, in-ūi lín siūⁿ, tī hit lāi-bīn ōe chhē-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā. Kî-si̍t, chiū-sī Sèng-keng teh ūi-tio̍h góa choh-chèng.
Án-ni, lín iáu-kú m̄-khéng lâi góa chia tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā.
“Góa bô chiap-siū lâng ê chheng-chàn.
M̄-kú góa chin-chiàⁿ liáu-kái lín, tī lín lāi-bīn bô thiàⁿ Siōng-tè ê sim.
Góa hōng góa ê Pē ê miâ lâi, lín bô chiap-la̍p góa; nā ū pa̍t-lâng hōng ka-kī ê miâ lâi, lín tian-tò kā i chiap-la̍p.
Lín hō͘-siōng chheng-chàn, chóng-sī bô tui-kiû tùi î-it ê Siōng-tè lâi ê chheng-chàn, án-ni lín ná ōe-tàng sìn góa?
M̄-thang siūⁿ-kóng góa ōe tī Pē ê bīn-chêng khòng-kò lín. Teh khòng-kò lín--ê sī lín it-ti̍t teh gióng-bōng ê Mô͘-se.
Lín nā chin-chiàⁿ ū sìn Mô͘-se, mā ōe sìn góa; in-ūi i ū siá góa ê tāi-chì.
I siá ê chheh lín to m̄ sìn, ná ōe sìn góa kóng ê ōe?”
Chit-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, Iâ-so͘ kè-khì Ka-lī-lī-ô͘, chiū-sī Thê-pí-lí-a-ô͘ ê hit-pêng hōaⁿ.
Ū chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng tè I khì, in-ūi in ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ i-hó pīⁿ-lâng ê sîn-jiah.
Iâ-so͘ peh-chiūⁿ soaⁿ, kap I ê bûn-tô͘ tī hia chē.
Hit-sî Iû-thài -lâng ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh teh-beh kàu.
Iâ-so͘ gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t tōa-tīn lâng it-ti̍t ǹg I hia teh lâi, chiū kā Hui-le̍k kóng, “Lán beh khì tó-ūi bóe chia̍h-mi̍h thang hō͘ chiah-ê lâng chia̍h?”
I kóng án-ni sī teh chhì-giām Hui-le̍k; kî-si̍t, I ka-kī í-keng chai teh-beh chòe ê tāi-chì.
Hui-le̍k ìn kóng, “Ēng nn̄g pah ê gûn-á khì bóe piáⁿ mā bô-kàu hō͘ ta̍k-ê lâng chia̍h chi̍t-sut-á.”
Lēng-gōa chi̍t ê bûn-tô͘, chiū-sī Se-bûn Pí-tek ê sió-tī An-tek-lia̍t, kā Iâ-so͘ kóng,
“Chia ū chi̍t ê gín-á, i ū gō͘ ê tōa-be̍h-piáⁿ kap nn̄g bé hî; m̄-kú lâng chiah-ni̍h chōe, kan-ta chiah-ê ná ū-kàu?”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lín kiò chèng-lâng chē--lo̍h-khì.” Hit-ê só͘-chāi chháu chin chōe. Chèng-lâng chiū chē--lo̍h-khì; kan-ta ta-po͘-lâng chiū ū gō͘-chheng.
Jiân-āu Iâ-so͘ the̍h hiah-ê piáⁿ, kám-siā liáu-āu pun hō͘ chē tī hia ê lâng; hî mā án-ni pun, chhut-chāi in chia̍h.
In chia̍h pá liáu-āu, Iâ-so͘ kā I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Chiong chia̍h chhun ê chhùi-sut-á khioh--khí-lâi, m̄-thang phah-sńg.”
In chiū chiong hit gō͘ ê piáⁿ ê sut-á, chiū-sī tāi-ke chia̍h chhun--ê, khioh--khí-lâi, lóng-chóng móa cha̍p-jī nâ.
Chèng-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ só͘ kiâⁿ ê sîn-jiah, chiū kóng, “Chit-ê chin-chiàⁿ sī beh lâi chit sè-kan hit-ūi Sian-ti!”
Iâ-so͘ chai-iáⁿ chèng-lâng teh-beh kiông-pek I choh-ông, chiū ka-kī chi̍t ê koh thè-khì soaⁿ--ni̍h.
Hông-hun ê sî, I ê bûn-tô͘ lo̍h-khì ô͘-piⁿ,
chiūⁿ-chûn beh kè ô͘ khì Ka-pek-lông. Hit-sî thiⁿ í-keng àm, Iâ-so͘ iáu-bē kàu in hia.
Hut-jiân, in-ūi thàu tōa-hong, ô͘ khí tōa-éng.
Bûn-tô͘ kò-chûn, tāi-iok kò gō͘ la̍k kong-lí ê sî, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ tī ô͘ ê téng-bīn teh kiâⁿ, kiâⁿ óa-kūn chûn, in chiū khí kiaⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Sī góa, bián kiaⁿ!”
Bûn-tô͘ chiū hoaⁿ-hí chiap I chiūⁿ-chûn; chûn liâm-piⁿ kàu in beh khì ê só͘-chāi.
Keh-ji̍t, iáu tī ô͘ tùi-bīn hōaⁿ hit-tīn lâng hoat-kak tī hia chí-ū chi̍t chiah chûn nā-tiāⁿ; Iâ-so͘ mā bô kap bûn-tô͘ chòe-hé chē-chûn, kan-ta bûn-tô͘ ka-kī kè--khì.
M̄-kú ū kúi-nā chiah chûn tùi Thê-pí-lí-a lâi kàu óa-kūn Chú kám-siā liáu-āu hō͘ chèng-lâng chia̍h-piáⁿ hit-ê só͘-chāi.
Chèng-lâng chi̍t-ē hoat-kak Iâ-so͘ kap I ê bûn-tô͘ lóng bô tī hia, chiū chē hiah-ê chûn kè-khì Ka-pek-lông chhē Iâ-so͘.
Chèng-lâng tī ô͘ ê tùi-bīn hōaⁿ chhē-tio̍h Iâ-so͘, chiū kā I mn̄g, “Lia̍p-pí, lí sím-mi̍h sî lâi chia?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, lín chhē góa, sī in-ūi ū piáⁿ chia̍h kàu pá, m̄-sī in-ūi khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sîn-jiah.

M̄-thang ūi-tio̍h ōe pāi-hoāi ê chia̍h-mi̍h phah-piàⁿ, tio̍h ūi-tio̍h kú-tn̂g chûn-chāi, ōe-tàng hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā hit-ê chia̍h-mi̍h lâi phah-piàⁿ, chiū-sī Jîn-chú beh hō͘ lín--ê; in-ūi Pē Siōng-tè í-keng kā I khàm-ìn jīn-tēng.”
In chiū mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Beh oân-sêng Siōng-tè ê kang-chok, goán tio̍h chòe sím-mi̍h?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Sìn Siōng-tè só͘ chhe Hit-ūi chiū-sī chòe Siōng-tè ê kang.”
In chiū kóng, “Lí beh kiâⁿ sím-mi̍h sîn-jiah hō͘ goán khòaⁿ lâi sìn lí? Lí beh chòe sím-mi̍h?
Goán ê chó͘-sian tī khòng-iá chia̍h má-ná, tú-tú chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài: ‘I ū chiong tùi thiⁿ lâi ê piáⁿ hō͘ in chia̍h.’”
Iâ-so͘ chiū kā in kóng, “Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, m̄-sī Mô͘-se chiong tùi thiⁿ lâi ê piáⁿ hō͘ lín, sī góa ê Pē chiong tùi thiⁿ lâi chin ê piáⁿ hō͘ lín.
In-ūi Siōng-tè só͘ sù ê piáⁿ chiū-sī tùi thiⁿ kàng--lo̍h-lâi, sù oa̍h-miā hō͘ sè-kan--ê.”
In chiū kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, chhiáⁿ lí put-sî chiong chit-ê piáⁿ hō͘ goán.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa chiū-sī hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā ê piáⁿ; lâi góa chia ê lâng it-tēng bōe iau, sìn góa ê lâng it-tēng bōe chhùi-ta.
M̄-kú góa bat kā lín kóng, lín í-keng ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa, iáu-kú m̄ sìn.
Pē só͘ hō͘ góa ê lâng lóng ōe lâi góa chia; lâi góa chia ê lâng, góa choa̍t-tùi bōe kā i khì-sak;
in-ūi góa tùi thiⁿ kàng--lo̍h-lâi, m̄-sī beh chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù chòe tāi-chì, sī beh si̍t-hêng chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi ê chí-ì.
Chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi ê chí-ì sī án-ni: I só͘ hō͘ góa ê lâng, góa liân chi̍t ê to bōe sòng-sit, tī Boa̍t-ji̍t góa ōe hō͘ in koh-oa̍h.
In-ūi góa ê Pē ê chí-ì sī beh hō͘ só͘-ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Kiáⁿ lâi sìn Kiáⁿ ê lâng lóng ōe tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā; tī Boa̍t-ji̍t góa ōe hō͘ in koh-oa̍h.”
In-ūi Iâ-so͘ kóng “Góa sī tùi thiⁿ kàng--lo̍h-lâi ê piáⁿ”, Iû-thài -lâng chiū su-hā gī-lūn,
kóng, “Chit-ê lâng kiám m̄-sī Iok-sek ê kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘? Lán bat I ê pē-bú, hiān-chāi I ná ōe kóng ‘góa sī tùi thiⁿ kàng--lo̍h-lâi--ê’?”
Iâ-so͘ chiū tùi in kóng, “Lín mài teh su-hā gī-lūn.
Nā m̄-sī chhe góa ê Pē ín-chhōa, bô lâng ōe lâi góa chia. Lâi góa chia--ê, tī Boa̍t-ji̍t góa ōe hō͘ i koh-oa̍h.
Sian-ti ê chheh ū kì-chài, ‘Chèng-lâng lóng ōe chiap-siū Siōng-tè ê kàu-tō.’ Só͘-ū thiaⁿ-thàn Pē, tùi I ha̍k-si̍p ê lâng, ōe lâi góa chia.
Che m̄-sī kóng ū lâng bat khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Pē; chí-ū tùi Siōng-tè hia lâi Hit-ūi bat khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng: Sìn ê lâng ū éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Góa chiū-sī hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā ê piáⁿ.
Lín ê chó͘-sian tī khòng-iá chia̍h má-ná mā sí--khì.
Che chiū-sī tùi thiⁿ kàng--lo̍h-lâi ê piáⁿ, hō͘ lâng chia̍h-liáu bōe sí.

Góa chiū-sī tùi thiⁿ kàng--lo̍h-lâi hit-ê oa̍h-miā ê piáⁿ. Lâng nā chia̍h chit-ê piáⁿ ōe éng-oán oa̍h--teh. Góa beh hō͘ lâng ê piáⁿ chiū-sī góa ê bah, sī ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ sè-kan-lâng ū oa̍h-miā hiàn--ê.”
Tùi án-ni, Iû-thài -lâng hō͘-siōng cheng-lūn kóng, “Chit-ê lâng ná ōe-tàng ēng I ê bah hō͘ lán chia̍h?”
Iâ-so͘ chiū tùi in kóng, “Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, lín nā bô chia̍h Jîn-chú ê bah, bô lim I ê huih, lín lāi-bīn chiū bô oa̍h-miā.
Chia̍h góa ê bah, lim góa ê huih ê lâng, chiū ū éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā; tī Boa̍t-ji̍t góa ōe hō͘ i koh-oa̍h.
Góa ê bah chin-chiàⁿ ōe-chia̍h--tit, góa ê huih chin-chiàⁿ ōe-lim--tit.
Chia̍h góa ê bah, lim góa ê huih ê lâng, tiàm tī góa lāi-bīn, góa mā tiàm tī i lāi-bīn.
Éng-oa̍h ê Pē chhe góa, góa mā in-ūi Pē lâi oa̍h; chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, chia̍h góa ê lâng mā ōe in-ūi góa lâi oa̍h.
Che chiū-sī tùi thiⁿ kàng--lo̍h-lâi ê piáⁿ; m̄-sī chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ê chó͘-sian só͘ chia̍h ê piáⁿ, in chia̍h-liáu mā sí--khì; chia̍h chit-ê piáⁿ ê lâng ōe éng-oán oa̍h--teh.”
Chiah-ê sī Iâ-so͘ tī Ka-pek-lông ê hōe-tn̂g kà-sī lâng ê sî kóng ê ōe.
Iâ-so͘ ê bûn-tô͘ tiong ū chin chōe lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū kóng, “Chit-ê ōe chin khùn-lân liáu-kái, siáⁿ-lâng thiaⁿ ōe lo̍h--khì?”
Iâ-so͘ sim-lāi chai-iáⁿ I ê bûn-tô͘ su-hā teh gī-lūn chit-ê sū, chiū tùi in kóng, “Chit-ê ōe kā lín jiá--tio̍h sī--bô?
Án-ni, lín nā khòaⁿ-tio̍h Jîn-chú seng-koân khì kàu I goân-lâi ê só͘-chāi, lín beh án-chóaⁿ?
Sù oa̍h-miā--ê sī Siōng-tè ê Sîn; jio̍k-thé lóng bô kong-hāu. Góa kā lín kóng chiah-ê ōe sī Sîn, sī oa̍h-miā.
M̄-kú lín tiong-kan ū lâng m̄ sìn.” In-ūi Iâ-so͘ tùi khí-thâu chiū chai sím-mi̍h-lâng m̄ sìn, sím-mi̍h-lâng beh kā I chhut-bōe.
I koh kóng, “In-ūi án-ni, góa bat kā lín kóng, nā m̄-sī Pē ún-chún, bô lâng ōe-tàng lâi góa chia.”
In-ūi án-ni, I ê bûn-tô͘ tiong ū chin chōe lâng lī-khui, bô koh tè I.
Iâ-so͘ chiū tùi cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ kóng, “Lín mā beh lī-khui o͘h?”
Se-bûn Pí-tek ìn kóng, “Chú ah, lí ū éng-oán-oa̍h ê ōe, goán beh khì tè siáⁿ-lâng?
Goán í-keng sìn, koh khak-si̍t chai lí sī Siōng-tè ê Sèng-chiá.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa kiám m̄-sī kéng-soán lín cha̍p-jī lâng? Lín tiong-kan ū chi̍t ê sī mô͘-kúi.”
I án-ni kóng sī teh chí Í-su-ka-lio̍k Se-bûn ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi, i sī cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ ê chi̍t ê, teh-beh chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘.
Chit-ê tāi-chì í-āu, Iâ-so͘ khì Ka-lī-lī kéng-lāi ta̍k só͘-chāi; I bô ài khì Iû-thài, in-ūi Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù chhē ki-hōe beh kā I thâi.
Iû-thài -lâng ê Tah-liâu-choeh teh-beh kàu.
Só͘-í Iâ-so͘ ê hiaⁿ-tī kā I kóng, “Lí tio̍h lī-khui chia khì Iû-thài, hō͘ lí ê bûn-tô͘ mā thang khòaⁿ lí teh chòe ê tāi-chì.
Lâng beh chhut-miâ bōe tiām-tiām-á chòe. Kì-jiân lí teh chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì, tio̍h khì chòe hō͘ sè-kan-lâng khòaⁿ.”
In-ūi liân I ê hiaⁿ-tī to bô sìn I.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa ê sî iáu-bē kàu; put-kò lín ta̍k-sî lóng piān-piān.
Sè-kan-lâng bô lí-iû oàn-hūn lín; in oàn-hūn góa, in-ūi góa put-sî teh chí-chhut in ê hêng-ûi siâ-ok.
Lín chòe lín chiūⁿ-khì siú-choeh; góa bô ài chiūⁿ-khì siú chit-ê choeh, in-ūi góa ê sî-ki iáu-bē sêng-se̍k.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu kè-sio̍k lâu tī Ka-lī-lī.
Iâ-so͘ ê hiaⁿ-tī chiūⁿ-khì siú-choeh, I mā khì, m̄-sī kong-khai, sī tiām-tiām-á khì.
Choeh-kî ê tiong-kan, Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù teh chhē Iâ-so͘, mn̄g kóng, “I tī sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi?”
Kûn-chiòng ê tiong-kan ū chin chōe lâng su-hā teh gī-lūn Iâ-so͘ ê tāi-chì. Ū lâng kóng, “I sī hó-lâng.” Mā ū lâng kóng, “M̄-sī, I sī teh siàn-tōng kûn-chiòng.”
M̄-kú in kiaⁿ Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù, bô lâng káⁿ kong-jiân kóng-khí I ê tāi-chì.
Choeh-kî kè chi̍t-pòaⁿ, Iâ-so͘ chiah chiūⁿ-khì Sèng-tiān kà-sī lâng.
Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù kám-kak kî-koài, kóng, “Chit-ê lâng bô siū-kè kàu-io̍k, ná hiah-ni̍h ū ha̍k-būn?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa ê kà-sī m̄-sī góa ka-kī ê, sī chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi ê kà-sī.
Lâng nā goān-ì si̍t-hêng Siōng-tè ê chí-ì, chiū ōe chai góa ê kà-sī sī tùi Siōng-tè lâi á-sī chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù teh kóng.
Óa-khò ka-kī kóng--ê sī teh kiû ka-kī ê êng-kng; kiû chhe i Hit-ūi ê êng-kng ê lâng sī chin-si̍t, i ê lāi-bīn lóng bô put-gī.
Mô͘-se kiám bô hō͘ lín Lu̍t-hoat? Put-kò lín tiong-kan bô kah chi̍t ê chun-siú Lu̍t-hoat. Sī-án-chóaⁿ lín siūⁿ-beh thâi góa?”
Kûn-chiòng ìn kóng, “Lí m̄-teh khòaⁿ-tio̍h kúi. Siáⁿ-lâng siūⁿ-beh thâi lí?”
Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Góa kan-ta chòe chi̍t hāng tāi-chì, lín chiū lóng kám-kak kî-koài.
Mô͘-se bēng-lēng lín kiâⁿ kat-lé, lín mā tī An-hioh-ji̍t kā lâng kiâⁿ kat-lé. Sū-si̍t, chit-ê lé-gî m̄-sī tùi Mô͘-se, sī tùi lín chó͘-sian khai-sí.

Kì-jiân lín ūi-tio̍h beh chun-siú Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat, tī An-hioh-ji̍t kā chi̍t ê ta-po͘ gín-á kiâⁿ kat-lé, án-ni góa tī An-hioh-ji̍t hō͘ chi̍t ê pīⁿ-lâng oân-choân hó--khí-lâi, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ tùi góa siū-khì?
M̄-thang khòaⁿ gōa-piáu lâi phòaⁿ-toàn sī-hui, tio̍h chiàu kong-chèng phòaⁿ-toàn.”
Ū chi̍t-kóa Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng teh kóng, “Chit-ê kiám m̄-sī in siūⁿ-beh sat-hāi hit-ê lâng?
Lí khòaⁿ, I kong-khai teh kóng-ōe, in mā bô kóng sím-mi̍h kā I hoán-tùi. Kiám kóng chiah-ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ chin-chiàⁿ chai chit-ê lâng sī Ki-tok?
M̄-kú chit-ê lâng ê lâi-le̍k lán lóng chai; Ki-tok lâi ê sî, bô lâng ōe chai I tùi tó-ūi lâi.”

Iâ-so͘ tī Sèng-tiān teh kà-sī ê sî, tōa-siaⁿ kóng, “Lín bat góa, mā chai góa ê lâi-le̍k; put-kò góa m̄-sī chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù lâi. Chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi sī chin-si̍t, lín khiok m̄ bat I.
Góa bat I, in-ūi góa tùi I hia lâi, I chhe-khián góa lâi.”
In chiū siūⁿ-beh kā I lia̍h, put-kò bô lâng hē-chhiú, in-ūi I ê sî iáu-bē kàu.
Kûn-chiòng ê tiong-kan ū chin chōe lâng sìn I, kóng, “Ki-tok lâi ê sî, kiám ōe pí chit-ê lâng kiâⁿ khah chōe sîn-jiah?”
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h kûn-chiòng su-hā teh gī-lūn Iâ-so͘ ê tāi-chì, chè-si-tiúⁿ kap Hoat-lī-sài-lâng chiū phài Sèng-tiān ê kéng-ōe khì lia̍h Iâ-so͘.
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Góa koh kap lín chòe-hé bô jōa kú chiū beh tńg-khì chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi hia.
Lín ōe chhē góa, m̄-kú chhē bōe tio̍h, in-ūi góa khì ê só͘-chāi, lín bōe-tàng khì.”

Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù hō͘-siōng kóng, “Chit-ê lâng beh khì tó-ūi hō͘ lán chhē bōe tio̍h? I siūⁿ-beh khì sì-sòaⁿ tī Hi-la̍h siâⁿ-chhī ê Iû-thài kiâu-bîn hia, khì kà-sī Hi-la̍h -lâng sī--bô?
I kóng ‘Lín ōe chhē góa, m̄-kú chhē bōe tio̍h’, koh kóng ‘Góa khì ê só͘-chāi, lín bōe-tàng khì’, che sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù?”
Choeh-kî ê chòe-āu hit-ji̍t, mā-sī siōng tiōng-iàu ê ji̍t, Iâ-so͘ khiā--khí-lâi, tōa-siaⁿ kóng, “Chhùi-ta ê lâng tio̍h lâi góa chia lim.
Sìn góa ê lâng, chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kóng, ‘Ū oa̍h-chúi ê khoe ōe tùi i ê pak-lāi chhèng--chhut-lâi.’”
Iâ-so͘ án-ni kóng sī chí sìn I ê lâng teh-beh niá-siū ê Sèng Sîn. Hit-sî, Siōng-tè iáu-bē sù Sèng Sîn, in-ūi Iâ-so͘ iáu-bē tit-tio̍h êng-kng.
Kûn-chiòng ê tiong-kan ū lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe chiū kóng, “Chit-ê lâng chin-chiàⁿ sī hit-ūi Sian-ti.”
Koh ū lâng kóng, “Chit-ê lâng sī Ki-tok.” Put-kò mā ū lâng kóng, “Ki-tok ná ōe tùi Ka-lī-lī chhut?
Sèng-keng kiám m̄-sī kóng Ki-tok sī Tāi-pi̍t ê kiáⁿ-sun, sī tùi Tāi-pi̍t ê kò͘-hiong Pek-lī-hêng chhut?”
Án-ni, kûn-chiòng in-ūi Iâ-so͘ ê iân-kò͘ khí hun-cheng.
Kî-tiong ū chi̍t-kóa lâng siūⁿ-beh lia̍h Iâ-so͘, m̄-kú bô lâng hē-chhiú.
Sèng-tiān ê kéng-ōe tńg-khì kìⁿ chè-si-tiúⁿ kap Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng. In chiū mn̄g kéng-ōe kóng, “Lín ná bô kā I ah--lâi?”
Kéng-ōe ìn kóng, “M̄-bat ū lâng kóng-ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chit-ê lâng.”
Hoat-lī-sài-lâng chiū tùi in kóng, “Lín mā hō͘ I bê--khì o͘h?
Lán ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ á-sī Hoat-lī-sài-lâng kiám ū lâng sìn I?
Chit-tīn m̄ bat Lu̍t-hoat ê kûn-chiòng sī siū chiù-chó͘--ê.”
Hoat-lī-sài-lâng ê tiong-kan bat khì kìⁿ Iâ-so͘ ê Nî-ko-tek-bō͘ kā in kóng,
“Chiàu lán ê Lu̍t-hoat, bô seng sím-mn̄g koh chhâ-bêng lâng ū chòe sím-mi̍h, kiám ōe-tàng kā i tēng-chōe?”
In ìn kóng, “Lí mā-sī Ka-lī-lī lâi--ê sī--bô? Lí chhâ-khó Sèng-keng chiū chai Ka-lī-lī m̄-bat chhut sian-ti.” {
Chèng-lâng lóng tńg-khì ka-kī ê chhù,
m̄-kú Iâ-so͘ khì Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ.
Keh-ji̍t thàu-chá, Iâ-so͘ koh khì Sèng-tiān. Bîn-chiòng lóng óa-lâi I hia, I chiū chē lo̍h-khì kā in kà-sī.
Hit-sî keng-ha̍k-kàu-su kap Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chhōa chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng lâi, i teh hoān kan-îm ê sî hō͘ lâng lia̍h--tio̍h. In hō͘ i khiā tī tiong-ng,
mn̄g Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lāu-su, chit-ê cha-bó͘-lâng hoān kan-îm ê sî hō͘ lâng lia̍h--tio̍h.
Kun-kù Lu̍t-hoat, Mô͘-se bēng-lēng lán tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm-sí chit-khoán cha-bó͘-lâng. Lí ū sím-mi̍h ì-kiàn?”
In án-ni kóng sī beh chhì-thàm Iâ-so͘, thang chhē khang-phāng kā I kò. Iâ-so͘ khû--lo̍h-khì, ēng chńg-thâu-á tī thô͘-kha siá-jī.
In ti̍t-ti̍t kā I mn̄g, Iâ-so͘ chiū khiā--khí-lâi, tùi in kóng, “Lín tiong-kan bô chōe ê lâng seng the̍h chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm.”
Jiân-āu I koh khû lo̍h-khì tī thô͘-kha siá-jī.
In chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe, tùi lāu--ê khai-sí chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê liu--chhut-khì, chhun Iâ-so͘ chi̍t ê, hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng iáu khiā tī hia.
Iâ-so͘ khiā--khí-lâi, kā i kóng, “Hū-jîn-lâng, in tī tó-ūi? Bô lâng kā lí tēng-chōe sī--bô?”
I ìn kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, bô.” Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Góa mā bô kā lí tēng-chōe. Lí tńg--khì, í-āu m̄-thang koh hoān-chōe.”}
Iâ-so͘ koh kā chèng-lâng kóng, “Góa sī sè-kan ê kng; tè góa ê lâng bōe tī o͘-àm tiong seng-oa̍h, hoán-tńg ū oa̍h-miā ê kng.”
Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chiū tùi I kóng, “Lí teh ūi ka-kī choh-chèng, lí ê kiàn-chèng bô-hāu.”

Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Sui-jiân góa ūi ka-kī choh-chèng, góa ê kiàn-chèng ū-hāu, in-ūi góa chai góa tùi tó-ūi lâi, beh khì tó-ūi; m̄-kú lín m̄ chai góa tùi tó-ūi lâi, beh khì tó-ūi.
Lín ēng lâng ê phiau-chún phoe-phòaⁿ lâng, góa bô kā lâng phoe-phòaⁿ.
Góa nā phoe-phòaⁿ, góa ê phòaⁿ-toàn chèng-khak, in-ūi góa m̄-sī ka-kī chi̍t ê teh phòaⁿ-toàn, sī chhe góa ê Pē kap góa chòe-hé phòaⁿ-toàn.
Koh lín ê Lu̍t-hoat ū kì-chài, ū nn̄g ê lâng choh-chèng, in ê kiàn-chèng chiah ū-hāu.
Góa ūi ka-kī choh-chèng, chhe góa ê Pē mā ūi góa choh-chèng.”
In chiū mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Lí ê Pē tī tó-ūi?” Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lín m̄ bat góa, mā m̄ bat góa ê Pē. Lín nā bat góa, mā ōe bat góa ê Pē.”
Chiah-ê ōe sī Iâ-so͘ tī Sèng-tiān kà-sī lâng ê sî, tī khǹg hōng-hiàn-kūi hia kóng--ê. Put-kò bô lâng kā I lia̍h, in-ūi I ê sî iáu-bē kàu.
Iâ-so͘ koh kā in kóng, “Góa beh lī-khui lah. Lín ōe chhē góa, m̄-kú lín ōe in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe lâi sí; góa khì ê só͘-chāi, lín bōe-tàng khì.”
Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù kóng, “I kóng ‘Góa khì ê só͘-chāi, lín bōe-tàng khì’, kiám kóng I beh khì chū-sat?”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín tùi ē-bīn lâi, góa tùi téng-bīn lâi. Lín sio̍k chit sè-kan, góa bô sio̍k chit sè-kan.
Só͘-í góa chiah kā lín kóng lín ōe in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe lâi sí; in-ūi lín nā m̄ sìn góa chiū-sī ‘Chū-iú-éng-iú’ Hit-ūi, lín ōe in-ūi ka-kī ê chōe lâi sí.”
In chiū mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?” Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa tùi khí-thâu chiū kā lín kóng lah.
Koan-hē lín, góa ū chin chōe thang kóng, thang tēng-chōe. M̄-kú chhe góa Hit-ūi sī chin-si̍t, góa chiong tùi I thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê thoân hō͘ sè-kan-lâng.”
In bô liáu-kái Iâ-so͘ sī teh tùi in kóng Pē ê tāi-chì.

Só͘-í Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lín kú-khí Jîn-chú liáu-āu chiū ōe chai, góa chiū-sī ‘Chū-iú-éng-iú’ Hit-ūi, koh góa chòe tāi-chì bô chi̍t hāng sī chiàu góa ka-kī ê ì-sù, chí-ū chiàu Pē kà-sī góa--ê lâi kóng.
Chhe góa Hit-ūi kap góa tông-chāi; I m̄-bat pàng góa ka-kī chi̍t ê, in-ūi góa put-sî teh chòe I só͘ hoaⁿ-hí ê tāi-chì.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe ê sî, ū chin chōe lâng sìn I.
Iâ-so͘ tùi sìn I hiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng kóng, “Lín nā kè-sio̍k chun-siú góa ê ōe, chiū si̍t-chāi sī góa ê bûn-tô͘;
lín ōe bat chin-lí, chin-lí ōe hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h chū-iû.”
In ìn kóng, “Goán sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ-sun, m̄-bat chòe lâng ê lô͘-lē. Lí ná ōe kóng ‘Lín ōe tit-tio̍h chū-iû’?”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, ta̍k-ê hoān-chōe ê lâng chiū-sī chōe ê lô͘-lē.
Lô͘-lē bô éng-oán sio̍k tī chú-lâng ê ka-têng, kiáⁿ chiū éng-oán ū.
Só͘-í, Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ nā hō͘ lín chū-iû, lín chiū si̍t-chāi ū chū-iû.
Góa chai lín sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ-sun; m̄-kú lín siūⁿ-beh thâi góa, in-ūi lín m̄ chiap-siū góa ê ōe.
Góa sī teh kóng tùi góa ê Pē hia khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê; lín sī teh chòe tùi lín ê pē hia thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê.”
In ìn Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Goán ê pē sī A-pek-la-hán.” Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Lín nā-sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ-sun, lín ōe chòe A-pek-la-hán só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì.
Hiān-chāi góa chiong tùi Siōng-tè thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê chin-lí kā lín kóng, lín soah siūⁿ-beh thâi góa. A-pek-la-hán pèng bô chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì.
Lín sī teh chòe lín ê pē só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì.” In ìn kóng, “Goán m̄-sī su-seng-chú; Siōng-tè sī goán î-it ê Pē.”

Iâ-so͘ chiū tùi in kóng, “Siōng-tè nā chin-chiàⁿ sī lín ê Pē, lín ōe thiàⁿ góa, in-ūi góa tùi Siōng-tè hia lâi, hiān-chāi tī chia. Góa m̄-sī chiàu góa ka-kī ê ì-sù lâi, sī Siōng-tè chhe-khián góa lâi.
Sī-án-chóaⁿ lín bô bêng-pe̍k góa ê ōe? Sī in-ūi góa ê ōe lín thiaⁿ bōe ji̍p--khì.

Lín ê pē sī Mô͘-kúi; lín kan-ta siūⁿ-beh si̍t-hêng lín ê pē ê io̍k-bōng. I tùi khí-thâu chiū-sī sat-jîn-hoān, bô chun-siú chin-lí, in-ūi i ê lāi-bīn bô chin-lí. Kóng pe̍h-chha̍t sī i ê pún-sèng, in-ūi i sī kóng pe̍h-chha̍t--ê, mā-sī kóng pe̍h-chha̍t ê lâng ê pē.
In-ūi góa kóng chin-lí, lín m̄ sìn góa.
Lín tiong-kan sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng chí-chèng góa ū-chōe? Kì-jiân góa kóng chin-lí, sī-án-chóaⁿ lín m̄ sìn góa?
Sio̍k Siōng-tè ê lâng thiaⁿ Siōng-tè ê ōe; lín m̄ thiaⁿ, in-ūi lín m̄-sī sio̍k Siōng-tè.”
Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Goán kóng lí sī Sat-má-lī-a -lâng, koh hoān-tio̍h kúi, kiám m̄-tio̍h?”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Góa bô hoān-tio̍h kúi; góa chun-kèng góa ê Pē, lín khiok bô chun-kèng góa.
Góa bô tui-kiû ka-kī ê êng-kng, put-kò ū Chi̍t-ūi ūi-tio̍h góa tui-kiû, ūi-tio̍h góa chhâi-koat.
Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, chun-siú góa ê ōe ê lâng it-tēng éng-oán bōe sí.”

Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù ìn kóng, “Taⁿ goán khak-si̍t chai lí hoān-tio̍h kúi. A-pek-la-hán í-keng sí, chèng sian-ti mā sí--khì, lí ná kóng ‘chun-siú góa ê ōe ê lâng éng-oán bōe sí’?
Lí kiám pí goán ê pē A-pek-la-hán khah úi-tāi? I í-keng sí, chèng sian-ti mā sí--khì. Lí siūⁿ lí sī siáⁿ-lâng?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa nā êng-iāu góa ka-kī, góa ê êng-kng chiū bô kè-ta̍t. Êng-iāu góa--ê sī góa ê Pē, chiū-sī lín kóng ‘I sī goán ê Siōng-tè’ Hit-ūi.
Lín m̄ bat I, m̄-kú góa bat I. Góa nā kóng góa m̄ bat I, góa chiū kap lín kâng-khoán sī pe̍h-chha̍t. M̄-kú góa bat I, koh chun-siú I ê ōe.
Lín ê pē A-pek-la-hán hoaⁿ-hí teh thèng-hāu góa lâi-lîm ê ji̍t-chí; i ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, khòaⁿ-liáu chin hoaⁿ-hí.”
Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù tùi Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lí iáu-bē gō͘-cha̍p hè, kiám bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h A-pek-la-hán?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, A-pek-la-hán iáu-bē chhut-sì, góa í-keng chûn-chāi.”
In chiū the̍h chio̍h-thâu beh kā I tìm; m̄-kú Iâ-so͘ siám-khui, lī-khui Sèng-tiān.
Iâ-so͘ teh kiâⁿ-lō͘ ê sî, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê chhut-sì chiū sit-bêng ê lâng.
I ê bûn-tô͘ kā I mn̄g, “Lia̍p-pí, chit-ê lâng chhut-sì chiū sit-bêng, sī siáⁿ-lâng hoān-chōe, sī i pún-sin á-sī i ê pē-bú?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “M̄-sī in-ūi chit-ê lâng hoān-chōe, mā m̄-sī i ê pē-bú hoān-chōe, sī beh thong-kè i lâi hián-bêng Siōng-tè ê chok-ûi.
Thàn iáu-sī ji̍t--sî, lán tio̍h chòe chhe góa Hit-ūi ê kang; àm-sî chi̍t-ē kàu, bô lâng ōe-tàng chòe kang.
Góa tī sè-kan ê sî, sī sè-kan ê kng.”
Chiah-ê ōe kóng-liáu, I phùi chhùi-nōa tī thô͘-kha, ēng chhùi-nōa chhiau thô͘, jiân-āu ēng thô͘ kô͘ hit-ê lâng ê ba̍k-chiu,
kā i kóng, “Lí khì Se-lô-a-tî sóe.” — Se-lô-a ê ì-sù sī “Hōng chhe-khián” — I chiū khì sóe, tńg--lâi ê sî í-keng ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
I ê chhù-piⁿ kap bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h i í-chêng teh chòe khit-chia̍h ê lâng, kóng, “Chit-ê kiám m̄-sī put-sî chē-teh kā lâng pun hit-ê lâng?”
Ū lâng kóng, “I chiū-sī.” Koh ū lâng kóng, “M̄-sī; sī chhin-chhiūⁿ i.” M̄-kú hit-ê lâng ka-kī kóng, “Góa chiū-sī.”
In koh mn̄g i, “Lí ê ba̍k-chiu án-chóaⁿ ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ?”
I ìn kóng, “Kiò-chòe Iâ-so͘ hit-ê lâng chhiau thô͘ kô͘ góa ê ba̍k-chiu, kā góa kóng, ‘Lí khì Se-lô-a-tî sóe’; góa khì, chi̍t-ē sóe, chiū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.”
In mn̄g i, “Hit-ê lâng tī tó-ūi?” I kóng, “Góa m̄ chai.”
In chiū chhōa í-chêng sit-bêng hit-ê lâng khì Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng hia.
Iâ-so͘ chhiau thô͘ lâi khui i ê ba̍k-chiu hit-ji̍t sī An-hioh-ji̍t.
Só͘-í, Hoat-lī-sài-lâng koh chi̍t piàn mn̄g i sī-án-chóaⁿ ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. I kā in kóng, “I ēng thô͘ kô͘ góa ê ba̍k-chiu, góa khì sóe, chiū ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.”

Ū chi̍t-kóa Hoat-lī-sài-lâng kóng, “Chit-ê lâng m̄-sī tùi Siōng-tè hia lâi--ê, in-ūi I bô siú An-hioh-ji̍t.” Koh ū pa̍t-ê lâng kóng, “Chi̍t ê ū-chōe ê lâng ná ōe-tàng kiâⁿ chit-khoán sîn-jiah?” In tiong-kan soah khí hun-lia̍t.
Hoat-lī-sài-lâng chiū mn̄g hit-ê sit-bêng ê lâng, “Kì-jiân I hō͘ lí ê ba̍k-chiu ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, lí kóng I sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?” I ìn kóng, “I sī sian-ti.”
Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù it-ti̍t bô siong-sìn i í-chêng sit-bêng, hiān-chāi ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, chiū tiàu i ê pē-bú lâi,
mn̄g in kóng, “Chit-ê sī lín kóng chhut-sì chiū sit-bêng hit-ê kiáⁿ sī--bô? I hiān-chāi ná ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ?”
I ê pē-bú ìn kóng, “Goán chai i sī goán kiáⁿ, mā chai i chhut-sì chiū sit-bêng.
M̄-kú i hiān-chāi án-chóaⁿ ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, goán m̄ chai; mā m̄ chai sím-mi̍h-lâng hō͘ i ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. Lín kā mn̄g, i í-keng tōa-hàn, ka-kī ōe-hiáu ìn.”
I ê pē-bú án-ni kóng, sī in-ūi kiaⁿ Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù; in-ūi in í-keng chham-siông hó-sè, nā ū lâng sêng-jīn Iâ-so͘ sī Ki-tok, tio̍h kā i tùi hōe-tn̂g kek-chhut.
In-ūi án-ni, i ê pē-bú chiah kóng, “I í-keng tōa-hàn, lín kā mn̄g.”
Hoat-lī-sài-lâng tē-jī piàn kiò hit-ê chhut-sì chiū sit-bêng--ê lâi, kā i kóng, “Tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng tio̍h chiàu-si̍t kóng. Goán chai chit-ê lâng sī ū-chōe ê lâng.”
I ìn kóng, “I sī ū-chōe ê lâng á m̄-sī, góa m̄ chai. Góa chí-ū chai chi̍t hāng tāi-chì, góa chêng sit-bêng, taⁿ ū khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.”
In chiū mn̄g i, “I kā lí chòe sím-mi̍h? I án-chóaⁿ hō͘ lí ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ?”
I ìn kóng, “Góa í-keng kā lín kóng lah, lín m̄ thiaⁿ, ná beh koh thiaⁿ? Lín mā siūⁿ-beh chòe I ê bûn-tô͘ sī--bô?”
In chiū kā i mē, “Lí chiah sī hit-ê lâng ê bûn-tô͘; goán sī Mô͘-se ê bûn-tô͘.
Goán chai Siōng-tè bat tùi Mô͘-se kóng-ōe, m̄-kú chit-ê lâng, i tùi tó-ūi lâi, goán m̄ chai.”
Hit-ê lâng ìn kóng, “Án-ni ū-kàu kî-koài! I i-hó góa ê ba̍k-chiu, lín iáu-kú m̄ chai I tùi tó-ūi lâi?
Lán chai Siōng-tè bô thiaⁿ chōe-jîn ê kî-kiû; m̄-kú lâng nā kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, si̍t-hêng I ê chí-ì, Siōng-tè chiū kā i thiaⁿ.
Tùi chhòng-sè í-lâi, iáu m̄-bat thiaⁿ-kìⁿ kóng ū lâng hō͘ chhut-sì chiū sit-bêng ê lâng ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Chit-ê lâng nā m̄-sī tùi Siōng-tè hia lâi, bōe-tàng chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì.”
In chiū tùi i kóng, “Lí chhut-sì chiū ū chōe, tī chōe tiong tōa-hàn, koh káⁿ beh kà-sī goán!” In chiū kā i kek-chhut hōe-tn̂g.
Iâ-so͘ thiaⁿ-tio̍h in kā i kek-chhut hōe-tn̂g, āu-lâi chhē-tio̍h i, chiū kā i mn̄g, “Lí ū sìn Jîn-chú bô?”
I ìn kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, sím-mi̍h-lâng sī Jîn-chú, góa thang sìn I?”
Iâ-so͘ tùi i kóng, “Lí í-keng ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h I; chit-chūn teh kap lí kóng-ōe--ê chiū-sī I.”
I kóng, “Chú ah, góa sìn!” Chiū kūi lo̍h-khì kā I pài.
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Góa ūi-tio̍h sím-phòaⁿ lâi kàu chit sè-kan, thang hō͘ sit-bêng--ê khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, hō͘ ba̍k-kng--ê pìⁿ-chòe sit-bêng.”
Chi̍t-kóa Hoat-lī-sài-lâng thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Lí sī kóng goán mā sit-bêng o͘h?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lín nā sit-bêng chiū bô chōe; m̄-kú lín kóng ‘Goán sī ba̍k-kng--ê’, án-ni lín iáu ū chōe.”
“Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, beh ji̍p-khì iûⁿ-tiâu, bô tùi mn̂g ji̍p, tùi pa̍t só͘-chāi pôaⁿ--kè-khì--ê, sī chha̍t, sī kiông-tō.
Tùi mn̂g ji̍p--khì-ê chiah sī iûⁿ ê bo̍k-chiá.
Kò͘-mn̂g--ê kā bo̍k-chiá khui-mn̂g; iûⁿ ōe-jīn-tit bo̍k-chiá ê siaⁿ. I kā ka-kī ê iûⁿ chi̍t-chiah chi̍t-chiah kiò-miâ, chhōa in chhut--lâi.
I chhōa ka-kī ê iûⁿ chhut--lâi liáu-āu, kiâⁿ tī iûⁿ ê thâu-chêng, iûⁿ chiū tè i kiâⁿ, in-ūi ōe-jīn-tit i ê siaⁿ.
In it-tēng bōe tè siⁿ-hūn-lâng, tian-tò ōe cháu-siám, in-ūi in m̄ bat siⁿ-hūn-lâng ê siaⁿ.”
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng chit-ê phì-jū, m̄-kú in m̄ chai I teh kā in kóng sím-mi̍h.
Só͘-í, Iâ-so͘ koh kā in kóng, “Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, góa sī iûⁿ ê mn̂g.
Só͘-ū pí góa khah tāi-seng lâi--ê lóng sī chha̍t, sī kiông-tō, iûⁿ bōe thiaⁿ in.
Góa sī mn̂g; thong-kè góa chit-ê mn̂g ji̍p--lâi-ê, ōe an-choân, thang chhut-chhut-ji̍p-ji̍p, koh ōe chhē-tio̍h chháu-po͘.
Chha̍t lâi, it-tēng sī beh thau-lia̍h, beh thâi, beh húi-bia̍t. Góa lâi sī beh hō͘ in tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā, tit kah chin hong-sēng.
“Góa sī hó ê bo̍k-chiá. Hó ê bo̍k-chiá ūi-tio̍h iûⁿ pàng-sak sìⁿ-miā.

Hō͘ lâng chhiàⁿ--ê m̄-sī bo̍k-chiá, iûⁿ m̄-sī ka-kī ê, i chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h chhâi-lông lâi chiū kā iûⁿ pàng--teh, tô-cháu; chhâi-lông chiong iûⁿ kā--khì, kā in kóaⁿ-sòaⁿ.
I tô-cháu, in-ūi i sī hō͘ lâng chhiàⁿ--ê, bô chin-chiàⁿ koan-sim iûⁿ-kûn.
Góa sī hó ê bo̍k-chiá; góa bat góa ka-kī ê iûⁿ, góa ê iûⁿ mā bat góa.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ Pē bat góa, góa mā bat Pē. Góa ūi-tio̍h iûⁿ pàng-sak sìⁿ-miā.
Góa iáu ū kî-tha ê iûⁿ bô sio̍k chit-ê iûⁿ-tiâu; góa mā it-tēng tio̍h chhōa in lâi. In ōe thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ, mā ōe chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t kûn, kui-sio̍k chi̍t ê bo̍k-chiá.
“Pē thiàⁿ góa, in-ūi góa pàng-sak ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā, thang koh tit-tio̍h sìⁿ-miā.
Bô lâng chhiúⁿ góa ê sìⁿ-miā, sī góa chū-goān pàng-sak. Góa ū koân pàng-sak, mā ū koân the̍h--tńg-lâi. Che sī góa tùi Pē chiap-siū ê bēng-lēng.”
In-ūi Iâ-so͘ só͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe, Iû-thài -lâng koh khí hun-lia̍t.
In tiong-kan ū chin chōe lâng kóng, “I hoān-tio̍h kúi, cheng-sîn sit-siông, ná tio̍h thiaⁿ I ê ōe?”
Lēng-gōa ū lâng kóng, “Hoān-tio̍h kúi ê lâng bōe kóng chiah-ê ōe. Kúi kiám ōe khui sit-bêng ê lâng ê ba̍k-chiu?”
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tú-teh khèng-chiok Hiàn-tiān-choeh, hit-sî sī tang-thiⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ tī Sèng-tiān ê Só͘-lô-bûn Cháu-lông teh kiâⁿ.
Iû-thài -lâng kā Iâ-so͘ ûi--teh, tùi I kóng, “Lí beh hō͘ goán chhai-gî jōa kú? Lí nā-sī Ki-tok, tio̍h chiàu-si̍t kā goán kóng.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa í-keng ū kā lín kóng, lín m̄ sìn. Góa hōng góa ê Pē ê miâ só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì teh ūi góa choh-chèng.
M̄-kú lín m̄ sìn, in-ūi lín m̄-sī góa ê iûⁿ.
Góa ê iûⁿ thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ, góa bat in, in tè góa.
Góa sù in éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā; in éng-oán bōe bia̍t-bông; bô lâng ōe tùi góa ê chhiú kā in chhiúⁿ--khì.
Chiong iûⁿ sù hō͘ góa ê Pē pí it-chhè khah úi-tāi; bô lâng ōe-tàng kā iûⁿ tùi Pē ê chhiú chhiúⁿ--khì.
Góa kap Pē sī chi̍t-ê.”
Iû-thài -lâng koh the̍h chio̍h-thâu beh kā I tìm.
Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Pē ū kiò góa chòe chin chōe hó tāi-chì, góa lóng ū chòe hō͘ lín khòaⁿ, lín sī ūi-tio̍h tó chi̍t hāng beh ēng chio̍h-thâu kā góa tìm?”

Iû-thài -lâng ìn kóng, “Goán beh ēng chio̍h-thâu kā lí tìm, m̄-sī in-ūi lí chòe ê hó tāi-chì, sī in-ūi lí siat-to̍k Siōng-tè. Lí put-kò sī lâng, iáu-kú chū-chheng chòe Siōng-tè.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lín ê Lu̍t-hoat kiám m̄-sī ū kì-chài ‘Góa kóng: Lín sī sîn’?
Sèng-keng ê ōe éng-oán bōe kái-piàn. Kì-jiân Siōng-tè chheng-ho͘ hiah-ê chiap-siū Siōng-tè ê ōe ê lâng chòe sîn,
án-ni, góa sī Pē hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng, koh chhe-khián ji̍p sè-kan--ê, sī-án-chóaⁿ góa kóng ‘Góa sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ’, lín chiū kóng góa siat-to̍k Siōng-tè?
Góa nā m̄-sī teh chòe góa ê Pē ê tāi-chì, lín m̄-bián sìn góa;
góa nā teh chòe Pē ê tāi-chì, sui-jiân lín m̄ sìn góa, mā tio̍h sìn góa só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì, thang hō͘ lín khak-si̍t chai Pē tī góa lāi-bīn, góa tī Pē lāi-bīn.”
In koh siūⁿ-beh kā I lia̍h, I chiū thoat-chhut in ê chhiú lī-khui.
Iâ-so͘ koh kè-khì Iok-tàn-hô tùi-hōaⁿ, kàu khah-chá Iok-hān kā lâng sóe-lé ê só͘-chāi, tī hia tòa.
Ū chin chōe lâng lâi kìⁿ Iâ-so͘, kóng, “Sui-jiân Iok-hān bô kiâⁿ sîn-jiah, i só͘ kóng it-chhè koan-hē chit-ê lâng ê tāi-chì lóng khak-si̍t.”
Tī hia ū chin chōe lâng sìn Iâ-so͘.
Ū chi̍t ê lâng kiò-chòe Lia̍p-sat-lō͘, phòa-pīⁿ, tòa tī Pek-tāi-nî, chiū-sī Má-lī-a kap i ê a-chí Má-tāi tòa ê chng-siā.
Chit-ê Má-lī-a bat ēng phang-iû boah Chú, koh ēng thâu-mn̂g chhit I ê kha; i ê sió-tī Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ phòa-pīⁿ.
Chit nn̄g ê chí-bē chhe lâng khì kìⁿ Iâ-so͘, kóng, “Chú ah, lí só͘ thiàⁿ ê lâng teh phòa-pīⁿ.”
Iâ-so͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū kóng, “Chit-ê pīⁿ bōe tì-kàu sí; sī beh hián-bêng Siōng-tè ê êng-kng, thang hō͘ Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ tùi chit-hāng tāi-chì tit-tio̍h êng-kng.”
Iâ-so͘ chin thiàⁿ Má-tāi kap i ê sió-bē, í-ki̍p Lia̍p-sat-lō͘.
I thiaⁿ-tio̍h Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ phòa-pīⁿ, kè-sio̍k tī hit só͘-chāi tòa nn̄g ji̍t.
Āu-lâi, I kā bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Lán koh lâi-khì Iû-thài.”
Bûn-tô͘ ìn kóng, “Lia̍p-pí, Iû-thài -lâng tú-á chiah teh chhē ki-hōe beh ēng chio̍h-thâu kā lí tìm, lí kiám beh koh khì hia?”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Ji̍t--sî kiám m̄-sī ū cha̍p-jī tiám-cheng? Lâng nā tī ji̍t--sî kiâⁿ chiū bōe poa̍h-tó, in-ūi ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chit sè-kài ê kng.
Lâng nā tī àm-sî kiâⁿ ōe poa̍h-tó, in-ūi i bô kng.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu, koh kā in kóng, “Lán ê pêng-iú Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ khùn--khì lah, góa beh lâi-khì kā i kiò-chhíⁿ.”
Bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Chú ah, i nā-sī khùn--khì chiū ōe hó--khí-lâi.”
Iâ-so͘ sī kóng Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ í-keng sí--khì, m̄-kú in siūⁿ-chòe i chin-chiàⁿ teh khùn.
Só͘-í Iâ-so͘ bêng-bêng kā in kóng, “ Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ sí--khì lah.
Ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lín sìn góa, góa bô tī hia tian-tò hó. Taⁿ, lán lâi-khì i hia.”
Hit-ê kiò-chòe Siang-siⁿ-á ê To-má kā bûn-tô͘-phōaⁿ kóng, “Lán mā lâi-khì kap I chòe-hé sí!”
Iâ-so͘ kàu Pek-tāi-nî ê sî chiah chai Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ í-keng chòng tī bōng-lāi sì ji̍t.
Pek-tāi-nî lī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chha-put-to saⁿ kong-lí;
ū chin chōe Iû-thài -lâng in-ūi Má-tāi kap Má-lī-a sió-tī ê tāi-chì lâi an-ùi in.
Má-tāi thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ kàu-ūi chiū chhut-khì kā I gêng-chiap; Má-lī-a iû-goân chē tī chhù-lāi.
Má-tāi kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Chú ah, lí nā ū tī chia, góa ê sió-tī chiū bōe sí.
Sīm-chì hiān-chāi, góa chai lí bô-lūn tùi Siōng-tè kiû sím-mi̍h, I lóng ōe hō͘ lí!”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí ê sió-tī ōe koh-oa̍h--khí-lâi.”
Má-tāi ìn kóng, “Góa chai tī Boa̍t-ji̍t koh-oa̍h ê sî, i ōe koh-oa̍h.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Góa sī koh-oa̍h, sī oa̍h-miā; sìn góa ê lâng sui-jiân sí, iáu-kú ōe oa̍h.
Só͘-ū hiān-chāi teh oa̍h lâi sìn góa ê lâng éng-oán bōe sí. Lí ū sìn bô?”
Má-tāi ìn kóng, “Chú ah, góa sìn lí sī Ki-tok, sī hit-ūi teh-beh lâi sè-kan ê Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ.”
Má-tāi kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu chiū tńg--khì, kiò i ê sió-bē Má-lī-a lâi, su-hā kā i kóng, “Lāu-su lâi lah, I teh kiò lí.”
Má-lī-a chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ--tio̍h, kóaⁿ-kín khí--lâi, khì Iâ-so͘ hia.
Hit-sî Iâ-so͘ iáu-bē kàu chng-lāi, iáu tī Má-tāi khì gêng-chiap I ê só͘-chāi.
Tī chhù-lāi teh an-ùi Má-lī-a ê Iû-thài -lâng, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Má-lī-a kóaⁿ-kín peh--khí-lâi koh cháu--chhut-khì, chiū tè i khì, siūⁿ-kóng i beh khì bōng hia khàu.
Má-lī-a kàu Iâ-so͘ hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h I, chiū phak lo̍h-khì I ê kha-chêng, tùi I kóng, “Chú ah, lí nā ū tī chia, góa ê sió-tī chiū bōe sí.”
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h i teh khàu, koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h kap i chòe-hé lâi hiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng mā teh khàu, sim chin pi-siong kek-tōng,
mn̄g in kóng, “Lín kā i chòng tī tó-ūi?” In ìn kóng, “Chú ah, lâi-khì khòaⁿ.”
Iâ-so͘ lâu ba̍k-sái.
Iû-thài -lâng kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, I hiah-ni̍h thiàⁿ i!”
In tiong-kan ū chi̍t-kóa lâng kóng, “I bat hō͘ sit-bêng ê lâng ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, kiám bōe-tàng hō͘ chit-ê lâng bô sí?”
Iâ-so͘ iū koh chin pi-siong, lâi kàu bōng hia; hit-ê bōng sī chi̍t ê tōng-hia̍t, ū chi̍t tè chio̍h that--teh.
Iâ-so͘ bēng-lēng, kóng, “Kā hit-tè chio̍h sóa-khui!” Sí--khì hit-ê lâng ê a-chí Má-tāi kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Chú ah, i sí sì ji̍t lah, í-keng chhàu ah.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Góa kiám bô kā lí kóng, lí nā sìn, ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè ê êng-kng?”
In chiū chiong hit-tè chio̍h sóa-khui. Iâ-so͘ gia̍h-ba̍k ǹg thiⁿ kóng, “Pē ah, góa kám-siā lí, in-ūi lí í-keng ū thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó.
Góa chai lí put-sî lóng ū teh thiaⁿ góa ê kî-tó, m̄-kú góa án-ni kóng sī ūi-tio̍h khiā tī chiu-ûi ê kûn-chiòng, thang hō͘ in sìn lí ū chhe góa.”
Kóng soah, Iâ-so͘ tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “ Lia̍p-sat-lō͘, chhut--lâi!”
Hit-ê sí--khì ê lâng chiū chhut--lâi; i ê kha-chhiú chat pò͘, bīn ēng kun-á pau--teh. Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Kā i tháu--khui, hō͘ i kiâⁿ!”
Lâi thàm Má-lī-a ê Iû-thài -lâng, ū chin chōe lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê só͘-chòe chiū sìn I.
Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng khì chhē Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng, kā in pò-kò Iâ-so͘ só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì.
In-ūi án-ni, hiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap Hoat-lī-sài-lâng tiàu-khui gī-hōe, kóng, “Chit-ê lâng kiâⁿ chiah-ni̍h chōe sîn-jiah, lán beh án-chóaⁿ tùi-hù?
Lán nā pàng I kè-sio̍k án-ni chòe, tāi-ke lóng ōe khì sìn I, Lô-má -lâng ōe lâi húi-hoāi lán ê Sèng-tiān, koh húi-bia̍t lán ê bîn-cho̍k.”
Kî-tiong ū chi̍t ê lâng kiò-chòe Kai-a-hoat, sī hit-nî ê tōa-chè-si, i kā in kóng, “Lín m̄ bat pòaⁿ-hāng.
Lín bōe-hiáu siūⁿ, lêng-khó hō͘ chi̍t ê lâng thòe chèng-lâng sí, chiah bián hō͘ choân bîn-cho̍k bia̍t-bông, án-ni tùi lín sī khah hó.”
I án-ni kóng m̄-sī ka-kī ê ì-sù, sī i chòe hit-nî ê tōa-chè-si teh ū-giân Iâ-so͘ teh-beh ūi-tio̍h chit-ê bîn-cho̍k lâi sí;
m̄-nā ūi-tio̍h chit-ê bîn-cho̍k, mā beh chiong Siōng-tè sì-sòaⁿ ê kiáⁿ-jî chū-chi̍p chòe chi̍t ê.
Tùi hit-ji̍t khí, Iû-thài -kàu ê léng-siù kè-bô͘ beh thâi Iâ-so͘.

In-ūi án-ni, Iâ-so͘ bô koh kong-jiân tī Iû-thài -lâng ê tiong-kan chhut-ji̍p; I lī-khui hia, khì óa-kūn khòng-iá ê só͘-chāi, kàu chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Í-hoat-liân ê siâⁿ, kap I ê bûn-tô͘ tī hia tòa.
Iû-thài -lâng ê Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh teh-beh kàu. Choeh-kî chêng, ū chin chōe lâng tùi hiong-chhoan lâi kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng beh siú kiat-chēng-lé.
In teh chhē Iâ-so͘, khiā tī Sèng-tiān lāi hō͘-siōng mn̄g kóng, “Lín siūⁿ án-chóaⁿ? I it-tēng bōe lâi kè-choeh ho͘hⁿ?”
In-ūi hiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap Hoat-lī-sài-lâng ū hoat bēng-lēng, nā ū lâng chai Iâ-so͘ tī tó-ūi, tio̍h lâi pò-kò, hō͘ in thang khì kā I lia̍h.
Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê la̍k ji̍t chêng, Iâ-so͘ khì Pek-tāi-nî, chiū-sī Iâ-so͘ hō͘ hit-ê tùi sí koh-oa̍h ê Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ tòa ê só͘-chāi.
Ū lâng tī hia ūi-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ chún-pī àm-tǹg. Má-tāi teh chiau-thāi; Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ sī kap Iâ-so͘ kâng-toh ê chi̍t ê.
Má-lī-a the̍h chi̍t koàn sûn ê ko-kùi ná-ta̍t phang-iû lâi boah Iâ-so͘ ê kha, koh ēng ka-kī ê thâu-mn̂g kā I chhit; iû ê phang-bī hō͘ kui chhù-lāi phang-kòng-kòng.
Iâ-so͘ ê chi̍t ê bûn-tô͘, chiū-sī āu-lâi chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘ hit-ê Í-su-ka-lio̍k ê Iû-tāi, kóng,
“Ná m̄ the̍h chit-ê phang-iû khì bōe saⁿ-pah ê gûn-á lâi chín-chè sàn-chhiah-lâng?”
I án-ni kóng m̄-sī i koan-sim sàn-chhiah-lâng, sī in-ūi i sī chha̍t, koh siông-siông thau-the̍h i teh koán-lí ê kong-khóaⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “M̄-thang kā i tòng! Chit-ê phang-iû sī i ūi-tio̍h góa bâi-chòng ê ji̍t chún-pī--ê.
Put-sî ū sàn-chhiah-lâng kap lín chòe-hé, put-kò góa bōe put-sî kap lín chòe-hé.”

Ū chi̍t tōa-kûn Iû-thài -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ tī Pek-tāi-nî chiū khì hia; in m̄-nā ūi-tio̍h beh khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘, mā siūⁿ-beh khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘ hō͘ i tùi sí koh-oa̍h hit-ê Lia̍p-sat-lō͘.
Só͘-í, chiah-ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kè-bô͘ liân Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ ia̍h beh kā i thâi,
in-ūi ū chin chōe Iû-thài -lâng ūi-tio̍h Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ ê iân-kò͘ lī-khui in khì sìn Iâ-so͘.
Keh-ji̍t, lâi kè-choeh ê chi̍t tōa-kûn lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ beh lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng,
chiū gia̍h chang-chhiū-ki chhut-khì gêng-chiap, hoah kóng: Hô-sàn-ná! Hōng Chú ê miâ lâi Hit-ūi eng-kai siū chheng-chàn! Í-sek-lia̍t ê Ông eng-kai siū chheng-chàn!
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chiah lû-á-kiáⁿ, chiū khan-lâi khiâ. Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài:
Sek-an ê hū-jîn-lâng ah, m̄-bián kiaⁿ! Khòaⁿ, lín ê Ông khiâ lû-á-kiáⁿ teh lâi lah!

I ê bûn-tô͘ goân-lâi bōe liáu-kái chit-hāng tāi-chì, m̄-kú Iâ-so͘ tit-tio̍h êng-kng ê sî, in chiah siūⁿ-tio̍h Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài chit-hāng tāi-chì sī teh chí Iâ-so͘; tāi-chì mā chiàu án-ni hoat-seng tī I sin-chiūⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ kiò Lia̍p-sat-lō͘ chhut bōng hō͘ i tùi sí koh-oa̍h hit-sî, kap Iâ-so͘ chòe-hé tī hia hit-kûn lâng ū kè-sio̍k teh chòe kiàn-chèng.
Chèng-lâng mā chhut-khì gêng-chiap Iâ-so͘, in-ūi in ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h I kiâⁿ chit-ê sîn-jiah.
