Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chiū hō͘-siōng kóng, “Lán khah chòe mā bô-chhái-kang. Lín khòaⁿ, choân sè-kài lóng tè I khì lah!”
Choeh-kî tiong khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tiâu-pài--ê ū kúi-nā ê Hi-la̍h -lâng.
Chiah-ê lâng lâi kìⁿ Ka-lī-lī ê Pek-sài-tāi -lâng Hui-le̍k, kā i kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, goán ài kìⁿ Iâ-so͘.”
Hui-le̍k khì kā An-tek-lia̍t kóng, An-tek-lia̍t kap Hui-le̍k chiū chòe-hé khì kā Iâ-so͘ kóng.
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Jîn-chú tit-tio̍h êng-kng ê sî kàu lah.
Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, chi̍t lia̍p be̍h-á nā bô lo̍h tōe sí, iû-goân sī chi̍t lia̍p nā-tiāⁿ; nā sí, chiū kiat chin chōe be̍h-á.
Thiàⁿ-sioh ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā--ê, ōe sòng-sit sìⁿ-miā; tī chit sè-kan kam-goān hi-seng ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā--ê, ōe pó-siú sìⁿ-miā ti̍t-kàu éng-oán-oa̍h.
Lâng nā beh ho̍k-sāi góa, tio̍h tè góa; góa tī tó-ūi, ho̍k-sāi góa ê lâng mā ōe tī hia. Lâng nā ho̍k-sāi góa, góa ê Pē ōe kā i chun-tiōng.”
“Chit-chūn, góa ê sim loān-chhau-chhau, góa beh kóng sím-mi̍h? Kiám beh kóng ‘Pē ah, kiù góa thoat-chhut chit-ê sî-khek’? M̄-sī. Góa sī ūi-tio̍h chit-ê sî-khek chiah lâi.
Pē ah, goān lí êng-iāu lí ê miâ.” Jiân-āu ū siaⁿ tùi thiⁿ-téng lâi, kóng, “Góa í-keng ū êng-iāu góa ê miâ, beh koh-chài êng-iāu.”
Khiā tī hia ê kûn-chiòng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê siaⁿ, siūⁿ-kóng “Lûi teh tân”; mā ū lâng kóng “Thiⁿ-sài ū tùi I kóng-ōe”.
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Chit-ê siaⁿ m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h góa, sī beh hō͘ lín thiaⁿ--ê.
Hiān-chāi sī chit-ê sè-kan siū sím-phòaⁿ ê sî; hiān-chāi chit sè-kan ê thóng-tī-chiá teh-beh siū thui-hoan.
Góa tùi tōe-chiūⁿ siū kú-khí ê sî, ōe khip-ín bān-bîn kui-óa góa.”
Iâ-so͘ án-ni kóng sī piáu-bêng I teh-beh án-chóaⁿ sí.
Kûn-chiòng ìn I kóng, “Goán thiaⁿ-tio̍h Lu̍t-hoat ū kì-chài, Ki-tok éng-oán chûn-chāi. Lí ná ōe kóng Jîn-chú tio̍h siū kú-khí? Chit-ê Jîn-chú sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?”

Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Kng iáu ōe tī lín tiong-kan chi̍t-sî-á kú. Lín tio̍h thàn ū kng ê sî kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ, chiah bōe hō͘ o͘-àm jia-khàm. Tī o͘-àm tiong teh kiâⁿ ê lâng m̄ chai ōe kiâⁿ-khì tó-ūi.
Thàn ū kng ê sî, lín tio̍h sìn kng, hō͘ lín thang chiâⁿ-chòe kng-bêng ê lâng.” Chiah-ê ōe kóng soah, Iâ-so͘ lī-khui in, bih--khí-lâi.
Sui-jiân Iâ-so͘ tī in bīn-chêng ū kiâⁿ hiah chōe sîn-jiah, in iáu m̄ sìn I.
Che sī beh èng-giām sian-ti Í-sài-a ê ōe, kóng: Chú ah, sím-mi̍h-lâng sìn goán só͘ thoân ê sìn-sit? Chú ê koân-lêng ū tùi sím-mi̍h-lâng hián-sī?
In bōe-tàng siong-sìn ê goân-in, Í-sài-a ū koh án-ni kóng:
Siōng-tè hō͘ in ê ba̍k-chiu bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, hō͘ in ê sim ngī, chiah bián in ê ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, in ê sim bêng-pe̍k, lâi kui-ǹg góa, góa chiū kā in i-hó.
Í-sài-a án-ni kóng, sī in-ūi i ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Iâ-so͘ ê êng-iāu, chiah kóng koan-hē I ê tāi-chì.

Sui-jiân sī án-ni, iáu-kú ū chin chōe Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-siù sìn Iâ-so͘; put-kò in-ūi in kiaⁿ Hoat-lī-sài-lâng, m̄-káⁿ kong-khai sêng-jīn, chiah bián siū kek-chhut hōe-tn̂g.
In ài lâng ê chheng-chàn iâⁿ-kè Siōng-tè ê chheng-chàn.
Iâ-so͘ tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Sìn góa ê lâng m̄-sī sìn góa, sī sìn chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi.
Khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa chiū-sī khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi.
Góa choh-kng lâi kàu chit sè-kan, sī beh hō͘ sìn góa ê lâng lóng bōe tiàm tī o͘-àm.
Thiaⁿ góa ê ōe bô chun-siú ê lâng, góa bōe kā i sím-phòaⁿ. In-ūi góa m̄-sī lâi beh sím-phòaⁿ sè-kan-lâng, sī beh chín-kiù sè-kan-lâng.
Kū-choa̍t góa, m̄ chiap-siū góa ê ōe ê lâng, ū chi̍t ê sím-phòaⁿ-chiá ōe kā i sím-phòaⁿ. Tī Boa̍t-ji̍t, góa só͘ kóng ê ōe ōe kā i sím-phòaⁿ.
In-ūi góa m̄-sī chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù kóng, sī chiàu chhe góa lâi ê Pē hō͘ góa ê bēng-lēng chiah kóng sím-mi̍h, thoân sím-mi̍h.
Góa chai I ê bēng-lēng ōe hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā. Só͘-í, góa kóng--ê lóng sī chiàu Pē kā góa kóng--ê.”
Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh chêng, Iâ-so͘ chai I lī-khui chit sè-kan tńg-khì Pē hia ê sî-kan í-keng kàu. I it-ti̍t ū thiàⁿ chit sè-kan sio̍k I ka-kī ê lâng, chiū thiàⁿ in kàu-tóe.
Iâ-so͘ kap I ê bûn-tô͘ teh chia̍h àm-tǹg ê sî, Mô͘-kúi í-keng chiong chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘ ê ì-sù hē tī Í-su-ka-lio̍k Se-bûn ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi ê sim.
Iâ-so͘ chai Pē í-keng chiong it-chhè kau tī I ê chhiú, mā chai ka-kī tùi Siōng-tè hia lâi, beh koh tńg-khì Siōng-tè hia,
chiū lī-khui toh, thǹg gōa-saⁿ, the̍h chi̍t tiâu kun-á hâ tī io--ni̍h,
jiân-āu chiong chúi tò tī chúi-phûn, kā bûn-tô͘ sóe-kha, koh ēng hâ tī io--ni̍h ê kun-á kā in chhit.
I sóe kàu Se-bûn Pí-tek hia, Pí-tek kā I kóng, “Chú ah, lí beh kā góa sóe-kha o͘h?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa teh chòe--ê, lí hiān-chāi m̄ chai, āu-lâi chiū ōe bêng-pe̍k.”
Pí-tek kā I kóng, “Lí choa̍t-tùi bōe-ēng-tit kā góa sóe-kha.” Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa nā bô kā lí sóe-kha, lí chiū kap góa bô koan-hē.”
Se-bûn Pí-tek kā I kóng, “Chú ah, m̄-nā kha, liân chhiú kap thâu-khak mā kā góa sóe.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lâng seng-khu sóe liáu, kui seng-khu lóng chheng-khì; kan-ta sóe-kha chiū hó. Lín í-keng chheng-khì, m̄-kú m̄-sī ta̍k-ê lóng án-ni.”
In-ūi Iâ-so͘ chai sím-mi̍h-lâng teh-beh kā I chhut-bōe, só͘-í chiah kóng “Lín m̄-sī ta̍k-ê lóng chheng-khì”.
Iâ-so͘ kā in sóe-kha liáu-āu, chhēng gōa-saⁿ, tò-tńg-khì I ê chē-ūi. I mn̄g in kóng, “Lín kiám ū bêng-pe̍k góa tùi lín só͘ chòe--ê?
Lín chheng-ho͘ góa ‘Lāu-su’, mā chheng-ho͘ góa ‘Chú’; lín án-ni chheng-ho͘ chin tio̍h, in-ūi góa chiū-sī.
Góa choh Chú, choh Lāu-su, to kā lín sóe-kha, lín mā tio̍h hō͘-siōng sóe-kha.
Góa ū lâu bô͘-iūⁿ hō͘ lín, sī beh hō͘ lín thang chiàu góa tùi lín só͘ chòe--ê khì chòe.
Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, po̍k-jîn bōe pí chú-lâng khah tōa; hōng chhe-phài--ê mā bōe pí chhe-phài i--ê khah tōa.
Kì-jiân lín bêng-pe̍k chit-ê sū, nā khì si̍t-hêng chiū chin ū hok-khì.

“Góa m̄-sī chí lín choân-thé teh kóng; góa jīn-bat góa só͘ kéng-soán--ê. Put-kò che sī beh hō͘ Sèng-keng só͘ kóng ‘Kap góa chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g ê lâng kèng-jiân pōe-ge̍k góa’ chit-kù ōe ōe èng-giām.
Taⁿ tāi-chì iáu-bē hoat-seng, góa seng kā lín kóng, hō͘ lín tī tāi-chì hoat-seng ê sî thang sìn góa chiū-sī hit-ūi ‘Chū-iú-éng-iú’ ê.
Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, chiap-la̍p góa só͘ chhe--ê chiū-sī chiap-la̍p góa; chiap-la̍p góa--ê chiū-sī chiap-la̍p chhe góa Hit-ūi.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu, sim-lāi hui-siông kek-tōng, chiū bêng-bêng kóng, “Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, lín tiong-kan ū chi̍t ê lâng beh kā góa chhut-bōe.”
Bûn-tô͘ lí-khòaⁿ-góa góa-khòaⁿ-lí, m̄ chai I sī teh kóng sím-mi̍h-lâng.
Bûn-tô͘ tiong-kan ū chi̍t ê sī Iâ-so͘ só͘ thiàⁿ--ê, i chē tī Iâ-so͘ ê sin-piⁿ.
Se-bûn Pí-tek chiū ǹg hit-ê bûn-tô͘ tìm-thâu piáu-sī, kiò i mn̄g-khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘ sī teh kóng sím-mi̍h-lâng.
Hit-ê bûn-tô͘ chiū the-óa Iâ-so͘, kā I mn̄g, “Chú ah, sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?”

Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa beh ùn chit-tè piáⁿ the̍h hō͘ chi̍t ê lâng, hit-ê lâng chiū-sī.” I chiū the̍h hit-tè piáⁿ ùn chiùⁿ, jiân-āu the̍h hō͘ Í-su-ka-lio̍k Se-bûn ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi.
I chi̍t-ē chiap-tio̍h hit-tè piáⁿ, Sat-tàn chiū ji̍p i ê sim. Iâ-so͘ kā Iû-tāi kóng, “Lí siūⁿ-beh chòe--ê, kóaⁿ-kín khì chòe!”
Tâng chē-toh ê lâng bô chi̍t ê chai sī-án-chóaⁿ Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng chit-kù ōe.
In-ūi Iû-tāi sī koán-chîⁿ--ê, ū lâng siūⁿ-chòe Iâ-so͘ sī teh kiò i khì bóe siú-choeh beh ēng ê mi̍h, á-sī kiò i khì chín-chè sàn-chhiah-lâng.
Iû-tāi chiap hit-tè piáⁿ liáu-āu sûi-sî chhut--khì. Hit-sî sī àm-sî.
Iû-tāi chhut--khì liáu-āu, Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Taⁿ Jîn-chú í-keng tit-tio̍h êng-kng; Siōng-tè mā thong-kè Jîn-chú tit-tio̍h êng-kng.
Kì-jiân Siōng-tè thong-kè Jîn-chú tit-tio̍h êng-kng, Siōng-tè ka-kī mā beh êng-iāu Jîn-chú, koh beh sûi-sî hō͘ I tit-tio̍h êng-kng.

Sòe-kiáⁿ, góa kap lín chòe-hé chhun bô jōa kú lah. Lín ōe chhē góa, chiàu góa bat kā Iû-thài -lâng kóng, taⁿ góa kā lín kóng, ‘Góa beh khì ê só͘-chāi, lín bōe-tàng khì.’
Góa hō͘ lín chi̍t tiâu sin ê kài-bēng: Lín tio̍h saⁿ-thiàⁿ; chiàu góa thiàⁿ lín án-ni, lín mā tio̍h saⁿ-thiàⁿ.
Lín nā saⁿ-thiàⁿ, chèng-lâng ōe tùi che lâi chai lín sī góa ê bûn-tô͘.”
Se-bûn Pí-tek mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Chú ah, lí beh khì tó-ūi?” Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa beh khì ê só͘-chāi, lí hiān-chāi bōe-tàng tè góa khì, put-kò āu-lâi ōe tè góa khì.”
Pí-tek kóng, “Chú ah, sī-án-chóaⁿ góa hiān-chāi bōe-tàng tè lí khì? Góa kam-goān ūi-tio̍h lí pàng-sak sìⁿ-miā!”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lí beh ūi-tio̍h góa pàng-sak sìⁿ-miā o͘h? Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lí kóng, koe thî í-chêng, lí ōe saⁿ piàn m̄ jīn góa.”
Iâ-so͘ koh kóng, “Lín ê sim m̄-thang tio̍h-kip put-an. Tio̍h sìn Siōng-tè, mā tio̍h sìn góa.
Tī góa ê Pē ê chhù ū chin chōe pâng-keng, góa khì sī beh kā lín chún-pī só͘-chāi. Nā m̄-sī án-ni, góa bōe kā lín kóng chit-ê tāi-chì.
Góa khì kā lín pī-pān só͘-chāi liáu-āu, ōe koh lâi chhōa lín khì góa hia; góa tī hia, lín mā ōe tī hia.
Góa beh khì ê hit-tiâu lō͘, lín chai.”
To-má kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Chú ah, goán to m̄ chai lí beh khì tó-ūi, beh ná ōe chai hit-tiâu lō͘?”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Góa chiū-sī tō-lō͘, chin-lí, oa̍h-miā. Nā m̄-sī thong-kè góa, bô lâng ōe-tàng khì Pē hia.
Lín nā bat góa, mā ōe bat góa ê Pē. Tùi taⁿ í-āu, lín bat I, in-ūi lín í-keng ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I.”
Hui-le̍k kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Chú ah, chiong Pē hián-sī hō͘ goán khòaⁿ, goán chiū boán-chiok.”

Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “ Hui-le̍k, góa kap lín chòe-hé chiah-ni̍h kú, lí iáu m̄ bat góa o͘h? Khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa, chiū-sī khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Pē. Lí ná ōe kóng ‘Chiong Pē hián-sī hō͘ goán khòaⁿ’?

Góa tī Pē lāi-bīn, Pē mā tī góa lāi-bīn, lí bô sìn sī--bô? Góa kā lín kóng ê ōe m̄-sī chhut tī góa ka-kī, sī tiàm tī góa lāi-bīn ê Pē teh chòe I ka-kī ê tāi-chì.
Tio̍h sìn góa tī Pē lāi-bīn, Pē tī góa lāi-bīn; nā bô, mā tio̍h in-ūi góa só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì lâi sìn.
Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng: Sìn góa ê lâng ōe chòe góa só͘ chòe ê sū, sīm-chì ōe chòe koh-khah tōa--ê, in-ūi góa beh khì Pē hia.
Lín hōng góa ê miâ bô-lūn kiû sím-mi̍h, góa it-tēng ōe kā lín chòe, thang hō͘ Pē tùi Kiáⁿ tit-tio̍h êng-kng.
Lín nā hōng góa ê miâ bô-lūn kiû sím-mi̍h, góa it-tēng ōe kā lín chòe.”
“Lín nā thiàⁿ góa, chiū ōe chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng.
Góa beh tùi Pē kiû, I ōe sù lín lēng-gōa chi̍t ūi Ùi-chō͘-chiá, thang kap lín éng-oán tông-chāi.
I sī chin-lí ê Sîn, sè-kan-lâng bōe-tàng chiap-siū--ê, in-ūi in bô khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I, mā m̄ bat I. M̄-kú lín bat I, in-ūi I kap lín tông-chāi, ōe kè-sio̍k tī lín lāi-bīn.
“Góa bōe pàng lín chòe ko͘-jî; góa ōe koh tò-tńg-lâi lín chia.
Koh bô jōa kú, sè-kan-lâng bōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa, put-kò lín ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa, in-ūi góa oa̍h, lín mā ōe oa̍h.
Kàu hit-ji̍t, lín ōe chai góa tī góa ê Pē lāi-bīn, lín tī góa lāi-bīn, góa mā tī lín lāi-bīn.
“Chiap-siū góa ê bēng-lēng koh chun-siú--ê chiū-sī thiàⁿ góa ê lâng. Thiàⁿ góa--ê, góa ê Pē ōe thiàⁿ i; góa mā ōe thiàⁿ i, koh chiong pún-sin hián-hiān hō͘ i khòaⁿ.”
Iû-tāi — m̄-sī hit-ê Í-su-ka-lio̍k — mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Chú ah, sī-án-chóaⁿ lí beh chiong pún-sin tùi goán hián-hiān, m̄ tùi sè-kan-lâng hián-hiān?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Thiàⁿ góa ê lâng ōe chun-siú góa ê ōe. Góa ê Pē ōe thiàⁿ i; góa ê Pē kap góa ōe lâi i hia, kap i chòe-hé tòa.
Bô thiàⁿ góa ê lâng bōe chun-siú góa ê ōe. Lín só͘ thiaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê m̄-sī góa ka-kī ê ōe, sī chhe góa lâi ê Pē ê ōe.
“Góa iáu kap lín chòe-hé ê sî, í-keng ū chiong chiah-ê ōe kā lín kóng.
M̄-kú Ùi-chō͘-chiá, chiū-sī Pē ēng góa ê miâ beh chhe--lâi ê Sèng Sîn, ōe chiong it-chhè ê tāi-chì kà-sī lín, mā ōe hō͘ lín ōe-kì-tit góa kā lín kóng it-chhè ê ōe.

“Góa chiong pêng-an lâu hō͘ lín; góa chiong góa ê pêng-an sù hō͘ lín. Góa sù hō͘ lín--ê kap chit sè-kan teh hō͘ lâng--ê bô kâng-khoán. Lín ê sim m̄-thang tio̍h-kip put-an, mā m̄-thang kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Lín í-keng ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ góa kā lín kóng, ‘Góa khì, beh koh tńg-lâi lín chia.’ Lín nā ū thiàⁿ góa, ōe in-ūi góa beh khì Pē hia lâi hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi Pē pí góa khah tōa.
Taⁿ tāi-chì iáu-bē hoat-seng, góa seng kā lín kóng, hō͘ lín tī tāi-chì hoat-seng ê sî thang sìn.
Góa bōe koh kap lín kóng chin chōe ōe, in-ūi chit sè-kài ê thóng-tī-chiá teh lâi lah. I choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng tùi góa chòe sím-mi̍h,
m̄-kú beh hō͘ sè-kan-lâng chai góa thiàⁿ Pē, ū chiàu Pē ê bēng-lēng khì chòe. “Khí--lâi, lán lâi-khì.”
“Góa sī chin ê phû-tô-chhiū, góa ê Pē sī chèng phû-tô--ê.
Liân tī góa koh bô kiat ké-chí ê ki, I chiū kā i chián--khí-lâi; ū kiat ké-chí ê ki, I chiū kā i siu-chián, hō͘ i kiat khah chōe ké-chí.
Góa tùi lín kóng ê ōe í-keng hō͘ lín chheng-khì lah.
Lín tio̍h put-sî kap góa kiat-liân, góa chiū put-sî kap lín kiat-liân. Ki bô liân tī phû-tô-chhiū, ka-kī bōe kiat ké-chí; lín nā bô kap góa kiat-liân mā-sī án-ni.
“Góa sī phû-tô-chhiū, lín sī ki. Kap góa kiat-liân, góa mā kap i kiat-liân--ê, ōe kiat chin chōe ké-chí, in-ūi bô góa, lín bōe-tàng chòe sím-mi̍h.
Lâng nā bô kap góa kiat-liân, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ ta--khì ê ki hō͘ lâng hiat chhut-khì gōa-bīn, khioh kui-tui, hiat-lo̍h hé sio.
Lín nā kap góa kiat-liân, góa ê ōe tī lín lāi-bīn, lín bô-lūn ài sím-mi̍h, kiû chiū kā lín si̍t-hiān.
Lín nā kiat chin chōe ké-chí, piáu-sī lín sī góa ê bûn-tô͘, góa ê Pē ōe in-ūi án-ni tit-tio̍h êng-kng.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ Pē ū thiàⁿ góa, góa mā ū thiàⁿ lín, lín tio̍h put-sî tiàm tī góa ê thiàⁿ lāi-bīn.
Lín nā chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng, lín ōe put-sî tiàm tī góa ê thiàⁿ lāi-bīn, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ū chun-siú góa ê Pē ê bēng-lēng, put-sî tiàm tī I ê thiàⁿ lāi-bīn.
“Góa kā lín kóng chiah-ê tāi-chì, sī beh hō͘ góa ê hoaⁿ-hí tī lín lāi-bīn, koh hō͘ lín ê hoaⁿ-hí móa-móa.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ góa ū thiàⁿ lín, lín tio̍h saⁿ-thiàⁿ; che sī góa ê bēng-lēng.
Lâng ūi-tio̍h pêng-iú hi-seng sìⁿ-miā, bô pí che khah-tōa ê thiàⁿ.
Lín nā chun-siú góa ê bēng-lēng chiū-sī góa ê pêng-iú.

Góa bô koh kiò lín chòe po̍k-jîn, in-ūi po̍k-jîn m̄ chai chú-lâng teh chòe sím-mi̍h; taⁿ góa í-keng kiò lín chòe pêng-iú, in-ūi góa tùi góa ê Pē só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê lóng ū kā lín kóng lah.

M̄-sī lín kéng-soán góa, sī góa kéng-soán lín, koh jīm-bēng lín, hō͘ lín khì kiat ké-chí, hō͘ lín ê ké-chí ōe-tàng éng-oán pó-chûn. Án-ni, lín hōng góa ê miâ bô-lūn tùi Pē kiû sím-mi̍h, I ōe hō͘ lín.
Che sī góa hō͘ lín ê bēng-lēng: Lín tio̍h pí-chhú saⁿ-thiàⁿ.”
“Sè-kan-lâng nā oàn-hūn lín, tio̍h chai in oàn-hūn lín í-chêng seng oàn-hūn góa lah.

Lín nā sio̍k chit sè-kan, sè-kan-lâng ōe khòaⁿ lín chòe ka-kī ê lâng kā lín thiàⁿ. Put-kò góa í-keng tùi sè-kan kā lín kéng-soán--chhut-lâi, lín m̄-sī sio̍k chit sè-kan, in-ūi án-ni sè-kan-lâng oàn-hūn lín.

Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit góa kā lín kóng ê ōe, ‘Po̍k-jîn bōe pí chú-lâng khah tōa.’ Sè-kan-lâng nā pek-hāi góa, mā ōe pek-hāi lín; in nā chun-siú góa ê ōe, mā ōe chun-siú lín ê ōe.
Put-kò ūi-tio̍h góa ê iân-kò͘, in ōe tùi lín chòe chiah-ê lóng-chóng ê tāi-chì, in-ūi in m̄ bat chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi.
Góa nā bô lâi, bô kā in kóng, in chiū bô chōe; put-kò in hiān-chāi bô hoat-tō͘ ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê chōe piān-kái.
Oàn-hūn góa ê lâng mā oàn-hūn góa ê Pē.
Góa tī in tiong-kan nā bô chòe pa̍t-lâng m̄-bat chòe ê tāi-chì, in chiū bô chōe; hiān-chāi in ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê só͘-chòe, iáu-kú oàn-hūn góa kap góa ê Pē.
Che sī beh si̍t-hiān in ê Lu̍t-hoat só͘ kì-chài ê ōe, ‘In bô-iân-bô-kò͘ oàn-hūn góa.’
“Góa beh tùi Pē hia chhe chi̍t ūi Ùi-chō͘-chiá lâi lín chia, I chiū-sī tùi Pē hia lâi hit-ūi khé-sī chin-lí ê Sîn, I lâi ê sî ōe ūi-tio̍h góa choh-chèng.
Lín mā tio̍h ūi-tio̍h góa choh-chèng, in-ūi lín tùi khai-sí chiū kap góa chòe-hé.”
“Góa í-keng ū chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì kā lín kóng, sī beh hō͘ lín ê sìn-sim bōe iô-tāng.
Lâng ōe kā lín kóaⁿ-chhut hōe-tn̂g; sî teh-beh kàu, beh thâi lín ê lâng lóng ōe siūⁿ-kóng in sī teh ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè.
In ōe chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì, sī in-ūi in m̄ bat Pē, mā m̄ bat góa.

M̄-kú góa í-keng ū chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì kā lín kóng, sī beh hō͘ lín sî kàu ōe-kì-tit góa ū kā lín kóng.” “Góa bô tùi khí-thâu chiū chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì kā lín kóng, sī in-ūi góa it-ti̍t lóng ū kap lín chòe-hé.
Hiān-chāi góa teh-beh tńg-khì chhe góa lâi Hit-ūi hia, lín tiong-kan bô lâng mn̄g góa ‘Lí beh khì tó-ūi?’
Góa chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì kā lín kóng, lín soah móa-sim iu-būn.

Put-kò, góa tio̍h chiong si̍t-chêng kā lín kóng: Góa khì, sī tùi lín ū lī-ek, in-ūi góa nā bô khì, Ùi-chō͘-chiá chiū bōe lâi lín chia; góa nā khì, góa ōe chhe I lâi lín chia.
I lâi ê sî, ōe kā sè-kan-lâng chí-chèng in tùi chōe, tùi gī, tùi sím-phòaⁿ ê koan-liām ū chhò-gō͘.
Tùi chōe, in-ūi in m̄ sìn góa;
tùi gī, in-ūi góa teh-beh khì Pē hia, lín bōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa;
tùi sím-phòaⁿ, in-ūi chit sè-kan ê thóng-tī-chiá í-keng siū sím-phòaⁿ.
“Góa iáu ū chin chōe tāi-chì beh kā lín kóng, m̄-kú lín hiān-chāi iáu bōe-tàng liáu-kái.

Chin-lí ê Sîn lâi ê sî, I ōe chhōa lín liáu-kái it-chhè ê chin-lí. I bōe chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù kóng, ōe chiàu só͘ thiaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê lâi kóng, mā ōe kā lín thoân-ta̍t teh-beh lâi ê sū.
I ōe chiong êng-iāu kui hō͘ góa, in-ūi I ōe chiong góa kau-tài I--ê kā lín thoân-ta̍t.
Góa ê Pē só͘-ū ê lóng sī góa ê; in-ūi án-ni, góa chiah kóng Sèng Sîn ōe chiong góa kau-tài I--ê kā lín thoân-ta̍t.”
“Koh bô jōa kú, lín bōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa; iū koh bô jōa kú, lín ōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa.”

Ū kúi-nā ê bûn-tô͘ kóng-lâi-kóng-khì, “I kā lán kóng ‘Koh bô jōa kú, lín bōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa; iū koh bô jōa kú, lín ōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa’, koh kóng ‘In-ūi góa teh-beh khì Pē hia’, chiah-ê ōe sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù?”
Só͘-í in it-ti̍t mn̄g, “I só͘ kóng ‘Koh bô jōa kú’ sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù? Lán m̄ chai I teh kóng sím-mi̍h.”

Iâ-so͘ chai in ài-beh mn̄g I, chiū kā in kóng, “Lín in-ūi góa kóng ‘Koh bô jōa kú, lín bōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa; iū koh bô jōa kú, lín ōe koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ góa’ teh mn̄g-lâi-mn̄g-khì sī--bô?
Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng, lín ōe thî-khàu ai-siong, m̄-kú sè-kan-lâng ōe hoaⁿ-hí; lín ōe iu-chhiû, m̄-kú lín ê iu-chhiû ōe pìⁿ-chòe hoaⁿ-hí.

Sán-hū siⁿ-kiáⁿ ê sî ū iu-chhiû, in-ūi sán-kî í-keng kàu; eⁿ-á chi̍t-ē chhut-sì chiū bô koh kì-tit seng-sán ê thòng-khó͘, i ōe in-ūi eⁿ-á í-keng chhut-sì tī sè-kan lâi hoaⁿ-hí.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, hiān-chāi lín ū iu-chhiû, put-kò góa ōe koh kìⁿ-tio̍h lín, lín ê sim chiū ōe hoaⁿ-hí; lín ê hoaⁿ-hí bô lâng ōe kā lín chhiúⁿ--khì.
“Tī hit-ji̍t, lín bōe koh kā góa mn̄g sím-mi̍h. Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lín kóng: Lín hōng góa ê miâ bô-lūn tùi Pē kiû sím-mi̍h, I ōe sù hō͘ lín.
Kàu hiān-chāi, lín iáu m̄-bat hōng góa ê miâ kiû sím-mi̍h. Lín tio̍h kiû, chiū ōe tit--tio̍h, thang hō͘ lín ê hoaⁿ-hí móa-móa.”
“Chiah-ê tāi-chì góa í-keng ēng phì-jū kā lín kóng lah. Sî teh-beh kàu, góa bōe koh-chài ēng phì-jū, ōe bêng-bêng tùi lín kóng-khí Pē ê sū.
Tī hit-ji̍t, lín ōe hōng góa ê miâ kî-kiû; góa pèng bô kā lín kóng góa ōe thòe lín tùi Pē khún-kiû.
Pē pún-sin thiàⁿ lín, in-ūi lín ū thiàⁿ góa, koh ū sìn góa sī tùi Siōng-tè hia lâi--ê.
Góa tùi Pē hia chhut--lâi, lâi kàu sè-kan; hiān-chāi góa beh lī-khui sè-kan, tńg-khì Pē hia.”
I ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Hiān-chāi lí bêng-bêng kóng, bô koh ēng phì-jū lâi kóng.
Taⁿ goán chai lí bû-só͘-put-ti, bô su-iàu lâng kā lí mn̄g; in-ūi án-ni goán sìn lí sī tùi Siōng-tè hia lâi--ê.”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Chit-chūn lín ū sìn--bô?

Lín khòaⁿ, sî teh-beh kàu, taⁿ í-keng kàu, lín ōe hun-sòaⁿ, ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tńg-khì ka-kī ê só͘-chāi, pàng góa ka-kī chi̍t ê. Kî-si̍t góa m̄-sī ka-kī chi̍t ê, in-ūi ū Pē kap góa tông-chāi.
Góa ū chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì kā lín kóng, sī beh hō͘ lín tī góa lāi-bīn ū pêng-an. Tī sè-kan lín ū khó͘-lān, m̄-kú tio̍h ióng-kám, góa í-keng khah iâⁿ sè-kan.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu, gia̍h-ba̍k ǹg thiⁿ kóng, “Pē ah, sî í-keng kàu, goān lí êng-iāu lí ê Kiáⁿ, hō͘ Kiáⁿ thang êng-iāu lí.
Lí ū chiong thóng-tī bān-bîn ê koân-pèng sù hō͘ Kiáⁿ, hō͘ I thang chiong éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā sù hō͘ it-chhè lí kau-tài I ê lâng.
Éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā chiū-sī: Jīn-bat lí sī to̍k-it chin Sîn, koh jīn-bat lí chhe--lâi ê Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok.
Góa í-keng tī tōe-chiūⁿ ū oân-sêng lí kau-tài góa ê kang-chok lâi êng-iāu lí.
Pē ah, hiān-chāi kiû lí hō͘ góa tī lí bīn-chêng tit-tio̍h êng-kng, chiū-sī chhòng-sè í-chêng góa kap lí í-keng ū ê êng-kng.
“Lí tùi chit sè-kan kéng chhut-lâi hō͘ góa ê lâng, góa í-keng ū chiong lí tùi in hián-bêng. In sī lí ê, lí ū chiong in hō͘ góa; in í-keng ū chun-siú lí ê ōe.
Hiān-chāi in chai, lí hō͘ góa ê ta̍k-hāng lóng sī tùi lí lâi--ê.
In-ūi góa ū chiong lí hō͘ góa ê sìn-sit hō͘ in; in í-keng chiap-siū koh chin-chiàⁿ chai góa tùi lí hia lâi, koh ū sìn lí chhe góa.
“Góa ūi-tio̍h in kî-kiû, m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h sè-kan-lâng, sī ūi-tio̍h lí hō͘ góa ê lâng kî-kiû, in-ūi in sī lí ê.
Góa só͘ ū ê it-chhè lóng sī lí ê, lí só͘ ū--ê mā-sī góa ê; góa ū thong-kè in tit-tio̍h êng-kng.

Góa bô koh tiàm chit sè-kan; put-kò in iáu tiàm tī chit sè-kan. Sèng ê Pē ah, kiû lí ēng lí hō͘ góa ê miâ pó-siú in, thang hō͘ in chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê, chhin-chhiūⁿ lán sī chi̍t-ê.

Góa kap in chòe-hé ê sî, góa ū ēng lí hō͘ góa ê miâ pó-siú in. Góa ū pó-hō͘ in, tû-khì chù-tiāⁿ bia̍t-bông hit-ê lâng í-gōa, chi̍t ê mā bōe bia̍t-bông, thang hō͘ Sèng-keng ê ōe èng-giām.
Hiān-chāi góa teh-beh khì lí hia; góa iáu tī chit sè-kan kóng chiah-ê ōe, sī beh hō͘ in sim-lāi chhiong-móa góa ê hoaⁿ-hí.
Góa ū chiong lí ê ōe hō͘ in; sè-kan-lâng oàn-hūn in, in-ūi in m̄-sī sio̍k chit sè-kan, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa m̄-sī sio̍k chit sè-kan.
Góa m̄-sī kiû lí chhōa in lī-khui chit sè-kan, sī kiû lí pó-siú in thoat-lī hit-ê Siâ-ok-chiá.
In m̄-sī sio̍k chit sè-kan, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa m̄-sī sio̍k chit sè-kan.
Kiû lí ēng chin-lí kā in sèng-hòa. Lí ê ōe chiū-sī chin-lí.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ū chhe góa ji̍p sè-kan, góa mā chhe in ji̍p sè-kan.
Ūi-tio̍h in ê iân-kò͘, góa ka-kī hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng hō͘ lí ēng, hō͘ in mā thang thong-kè chin-lí hun-pia̍t-choh-sèng hō͘ lí ēng.
“Góa m̄-nā ūi-tio̍h lí tùi sè-kan kéng chhut-lâi hō͘ góa hiah-ê lâng kî-kiû, mā ūi-tio̍h tùi in só͘ kóng ê ōe lâi sìn góa hiah-ê lâng kî-kiû,

thang hō͘ in lóng-chóng chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê. Pē ah, chhin-chhiūⁿ lí tī góa lāi-bīn, góa mā tī lí lāi-bīn, kiû lí hō͘ in tī lán lāi-bīn, thang hō͘ sè-kan-lâng sìn sī lí chhe góa lâi.
Lí hō͘ góa ê êng-kng, góa mā ū hō͘ in, thang hō͘ in chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê, chhin-chhiūⁿ lán sī chi̍t-ê.

Góa tī in lāi-bīn, lí tī góa lāi-bīn, sī beh hō͘ in oân-choân chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê, thang hō͘ sè-kan-lâng chai sī lí chhe góa lâi, mā chai lí thiàⁿ in, chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ū thiàⁿ góa.

“Pē ah, lí só͘ hō͘--góa hiah-ê lâng, góa tī tó-ūi, góa mā ài in kap góa chòe-hé tī hia, thang hō͘ in khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lí sù hō͘ góa ê êng-kng, in-ūi lí tī chhòng-sè í-chêng í-keng thiàⁿ góa.
Kong-gī ê Pē ah, sè-kan-lâng m̄ bat lí, m̄-kú góa bat lí; chiah-ê lâng chai lí í-keng ū chhe-khián góa.
Góa í-keng ū hō͘ in bat lí ê miâ, mā beh kè-sio̍k hō͘ in bat, thang hō͘ lí tùi góa ê thiàⁿ tī in lāi-bīn, góa mā tī in lāi-bīn.”
Iâ-so͘ kî-tó soah, chiū kap I ê bûn-tô͘ chhut--khì, kè-khì Khip-lûn-khoe ê hit-pêng. Tī hia ū chi̍t khu hn̂g, Iâ-so͘ kap I ê bûn-tô͘ ji̍p--khì.
Chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘ ê Iû-tāi mā chai hit só͘-chāi, in-ūi Iâ-so͘ kap I ê bûn-tô͘ siông-siông tī hia chū-chi̍p.

Só͘-í Iû-tāi chiū chhōa chi̍t tūi Lô-má peng, í-ki̍p chè-si-tiúⁿ kap Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng só͘ phài Sèng-tiān ê kéng-ōe khì kàu hia, chhiú gia̍h teng, hé-pé, kap bú-khì.
Iâ-so͘ chai I só͘ beh tú-tio̍h it-chhè ê tāi-chì, chiū kiâⁿ chìn-chêng, tùi in kóng, “Lín teh chhē sím-mi̍h-lâng?”
In ìn kóng, “ Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘.” Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Góa chiū-sī.” Chhut-bōe Iâ-so͘ ê Iû-tāi mā kap in khiā chòe-hé.
Iâ-so͘ chi̍t-ē kā in kóng “Góa chiū-sī”, in chiū tò-thè, tó lo̍h-khì thô͘-kha.
Iâ-so͘ koh chi̍t piàn mn̄g in, “Lín teh chhē sím-mi̍h-lâng?” In ìn kóng, “ Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Góa í-keng kā lín kóng góa chiū-sī. Lín nā-sī teh chhē góa, chiah-ê lâng tio̍h pàng in khì.”
Chit-ê ōe sī beh èng-giām I í-chêng só͘ kóng--ê, “Lí só͘ hō͘ góa ê lâng, chi̍t ê to bōe bia̍t-bông.”

Se-bûn Pí-tek ū tòa chi̍t ki to, chiū pu̍ih--chhut-lâi, tùi tōa-chè-si ê po̍k-jîn phut--lo̍h-khì, kā i chiàⁿ-pêng ê hī-á siah--khí-lâi; hit-ê po̍k-jîn ê miâ kiò-chòe Má-le̍k-kó͘.
Iâ-so͘ kā Pí-tek kóng, “To siu-ji̍p siù! Pē só͘ hō͘ góa ê khó͘-poe, góa kiám ōe-tàng bô lim?”
Āu-lâi, hit-tūi Lô-má peng kap tūi-tiúⁿ, í-ki̍p Iû-thài -lâng ê kéng-ōe lia̍h Iâ-so͘, kā I pa̍k--khí-lâi.
In seng kā I ah-khì hō͘ A-ná, in-ūi A-ná sī hit-nî ê tōa-chè-si Kai-a-hoat ê tiūⁿ-lâng.
Chit-ê Kai-a-hoat í-chêng bat tùi Iû-thài -kàu tong-kio̍k kiàn-gī, kóng “Lêng-khó hō͘ chi̍t ê lâng thòe chèng-lâng sí sī khah hó”.
Se-bûn Pí-tek kap lēng-gōa chi̍t ê bûn-tô͘ tè Iâ-so͘ khì; hit-ê bûn-tô͘ kap tōa-chè-si ū se̍k-sāi, só͘-í tè Iâ-so͘ ji̍p-khì tōa-chè-si kong-koán ê lāi-bīn-tiâⁿ,
m̄-kú Pí-tek khiā tī mn̂g-kháu. Kap tōa-chè-si se̍k-sāi hit-ê bûn-tô͘ chhut--lâi, kā kò͘-mn̂g ê lú-pī kóng--chi̍t-ē, chiū chhōa Pí-tek ji̍p--khì.
Kò͘-mn̂g ê lú-pī tùi Pí-tek kóng, “Lí mā-sī hit-ê lâng ê bûn-tô͘ ho͘hⁿ?” I kóng, “Góa m̄-sī!”
In-ūi thiⁿ-khì léng, hiah-ê po̍k-jîn kap kéng-ōe sio hé-thòaⁿ, khiā-teh hang-sio; Pí-tek mā kap in chòe-hé khiā-teh hang.
Tōa-chè-si sím-mn̄g Iâ-so͘ koan-hē I ê bûn-tô͘ kap I ê kàu-hùn ê tāi-chì.
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa lóng kong-khai tùi sè-kan-lâng kóng-ōe. Góa siông-siông tī Iû-thài -lâng chū-chi̍p ê hōe-tn̂g kap Sèng-tiān lāi kà-sī lâng; góa m̄-bat pì-bi̍t kóng.
Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ sím-mn̄g góa? Lí khì mn̄g bat thiaⁿ góa kóng-ōe ê lâng, khòaⁿ góa tùi in kóng sím-mi̍h, in chai góa só͘ kóng--ê.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng-liáu, khiā tī piⁿ--á ê chi̍t ê kéng-ōe kā I siàn chhùi-phóe, kóng, “Lí káⁿ án-ni ìn tōa-chè-si?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn i kóng, “Góa nā kóng m̄-tio̍h, lí tio̍h chí-chhut chhò-gō͘; nā kóng tio̍h, sī-án-chóaⁿ kā góa phah?”
Jiân-āu A-ná chiong hō͘ lâng pa̍k--teh ê Iâ-so͘ ah-khì hō͘ tōa-chè-si Kai-a-hoat.
Se-bûn Pí-tek iáu khiā-teh hang-hé. Ū lâng mn̄g i, “Lí mā-sī hit-ê lâng ê bûn-tô͘ ho͘hⁿ?” Pí-tek m̄ jīn, kóng, “Góa m̄-sī!”
Tōa-chè-si ê chi̍t ê po̍k-jîn, sī hī-á hō͘ Pí-tek siah--khí-lâi hit-ê lâng ê chhin-chiâⁿ, tùi i kóng, “Góa kiám m̄-sī ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí kap I tī hn̂g-lāi?”
Pí-tek koh-chài m̄ jīn; hit-sî, koe sûi-sî thî.

Thàu-chá, Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-siù chiong Iâ-so͘ tùi Kai-a-hoat hia ah-khì chóng-tok-hú; in ka-kī bô ji̍p--khì, in-ūi kiaⁿ bak-tio̍h lâ-sâm soah bōe-tàng chia̍h Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê boán-chhan.
Só͘-í, Pí-lia̍p-to chhut-lâi kìⁿ in, mn̄g in kóng, “Lín kò chit-ê lâng sím-mi̍h chōe?”
In ìn kóng, “Chit-ê lâng nā bô chòe pháiⁿ tāi-chì, goán bōe kā I kau hō͘ lí.”
Pí-lia̍p-to kā in kóng, “Lín ka-kī khì pān, chiàu lín ê Lu̍t-hoat kā I sím-phòaⁿ.” In tùi i kóng, “Goán bô koân kā lâng phòaⁿ sí-hêng.”
Che sī beh èng-giām Iâ-so͘ í-chêng só͘ kóng ê ōe, piáu-sī I teh-beh án-chóaⁿ sí.
Pí-lia̍p-to koh ji̍p-khì chóng-tok-hú, tiàu Iâ-so͘ lâi, mn̄g I kóng, “Lí sī Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông sī--bô?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lí án-ni mn̄g góa sī lí ka-kī ê ì-sù, á-sī thiaⁿ-tio̍h pa̍t-lâng kā lí kóng góa ê tāi-chì?”
Pí-lia̍p-to kóng, “Góa kiám sī Iû-thài -lâng? Lí pún-cho̍k ê lâng kap chè-si-tiúⁿ chiong lí kau hō͘ góa. Lí ū chòe sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?”

Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Góa ê Kok-tō͘ m̄-sī sio̍k chit sè-kan. Góa ê Kok-tō͘ nā sio̍k chit sè-kan, góa ê pō͘-hā ōe ūi góa cheng-chiàn, bián tì-kàu góa siū chhut-bōe hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-siù. Kî-si̍t, góa ê Kok-tō͘ m̄-sī sio̍k chit sè-kan.”

Pí-lia̍p-to chiū mn̄g I kóng, “Án-ni lí sī ông lo͘h?” Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Lí kóng góa sī ông. Góa ūi-tio̍h chit-ê chhut-sì, ūi-tio̍h chit-ê lâi sè-kan, sī beh ūi chin-lí choh-chèng. Sio̍k chin-lí ê lâng lóng ōe thiaⁿ góa ê siaⁿ.”
Pí-lia̍p-to mn̄g I kóng, “Sím-mi̍h sī chin-lí?” Kóng soah, Pí-lia̍p-to chiū koh chhut-khì gōa-bīn tùi in kóng, “Góa chhâ bōe chhut I ū sím-mi̍h chōe.
Lín ū chi̍t ê koàn-lē, tī Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh góa tio̍h pàng chi̍t ê hoān-lâng hō͘ lín. Án-ni, lín ài góa pàng Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông hō͘ lín--bô?”
In koh tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “M̄-sī chit-ê lâng, goán ài Pa-lia̍p-pa!” Pa-lia̍p-pa sī chi̍t ê pō-tô͘.
Āu-lâi, Pí-lia̍p-to kiò lâng chhōa Iâ-so͘ chhut-khì ēng piⁿ kā I phah.
Hiah-ê peng ēng chhì-á pīⁿ chi̍t téng ông-koan kā I tì tī thâu-khak téng, koh kā I moa chi̍t niá chí-sek ê tn̂g-phàu.
In óa--khì, tùi I kóng, “ Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông bān-sòe!” jiân-āu kā I siàn chhùi-phóe.
Pí-lia̍p-to koh chhut-lâi gōa-bīn, tùi hiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ, góa chhōa I chhut-lâi hō͘ lín, hō͘ lín chai góa chhâ bōe chhut I ū-chōe.”
Iâ-so͘ chiū chhut--lâi, tì chhì-á ê ông-koan, moa chí-sek ê tn̂g-phàu. Pí-lia̍p-to kā in kóng, “Khòaⁿ, chit-ê lâng!”

Chè-si-tiúⁿ kap Sèng-tiān ê kéng-ōe khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ chiū tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Kā tèng si̍p-jī-kè! Kā tèng si̍p-jī-kè!” Pí-lia̍p-to tùi in kóng, “Lín ka-kī kā I chhōa-khì tèng si̍p-jī-kè, in-ūi góa chhâ bōe chhut I ū-chōe.”
Hiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng ìn kóng, “Goán ū Lu̍t-hoat, chiàu Lu̍t-hoat I eng-kai sí, in-ūi I hong ka-kī chòe Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ.”
Pí-lia̍p-to thiaⁿ-tio̍h in án-ni kóng chiū jú kiaⁿ.
I koh ji̍p-khì chóng-tok-hú, mn̄g Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Lí tùi tó-ūi lâi?” M̄-kú Iâ-so͘ bô kā i ìn.
Pí-lia̍p-to tùi I kóng, “Lí m̄ kā góa kóng o͘h? Kiám m̄ chai góa ū koân thang pàng lí, mā ū koân kā lí tèng si̍p-jī-kè?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn kóng, “Nā m̄-sī Siōng-tè sù lí koân-pèng, lí bô koân thang pān góa. In-ūi án-ni, kā góa kau hō͘ lí hit-ê lâng, i ê chōe koh-khah tāng.”

Pí-lia̍p-to thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê ōe jú siūⁿ-beh pàng Iâ-so͘, m̄-kú hiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng it-ti̍t hoah kóng, “Lí nā pàng chit-ê lâng, lí chiū m̄-sī Lô-má -hông-tè Khái-sat ê pêng-iú. Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng hong ka-kī choh-ông chiū-sī pōe-poān Khái-sat.”
Pí-lia̍p-to thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe chiū chhōa Iâ-so͘ chhut--lâi, ka-kī chē tī sím-phòaⁿ-se̍k. Hit-ê só͘-chāi kiò-chòe “Pho͘-chio̍h-tōe”, Hi-pek-lâi-ōe kiò-chòe Ka-pa-tāi.
Hit-ji̍t sī Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê chêng-ji̍t, sî-kan chha-put-to tiong-tàu. Pí-lia̍p-to tùi hiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng kóng, “Khòaⁿ, lín ê ông!”

In chiū hoah kóng, “Hō͘ sí, hō͘ sí! Kā tèng si̍p-jī-kè!” Pí-lia̍p-to tùi in kóng, “Lín ài góa chiong lín ê ông tèng si̍p-jī-kè o͘h?” Chè-si-tiúⁿ kóng, “Khái-sat í-gōa, goán bô ông!”
Āu-lâi Pí-lia̍p-to chiong Iâ-so͘ kau hō͘ in khì tèng si̍p-jī-kè. In chiū kā Iâ-so͘ ah--khì.
Iâ-so͘ chhut--lâi, pē ka-kī ê si̍p-jī-kè, lâi kàu hit-ê kiò-chòe “Thâu-khak-óaⁿ-niá” ê só͘-chāi, Hi-pek-lâi-ōe kiò-chòe Kok-kok-tha.
In tī hia kā Iâ-so͘ tèng tī si̍p-jī-kè; í-gōa ū nn̄g ê lâng kap I chòe-hé tèng, chi̍t pêng chi̍t ê, Iâ-so͘ tī tiong-ng.
Pí-lia̍p-to siá chi̍t tè chōe-chn̄g, tèng tī si̍p-jī-kè téng, téng-bīn siá, “ Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘, Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông.”

Ū chin chōe Iû-thài -lâng tha̍k-tio̍h chōe-chn̄g, in-ūi Iâ-so͘ hō͘ lâng tèng si̍p-jī-kè ê só͘-chāi óa-kūn Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, koh chōe-chn̄g sī ēng Hi-pek-lâi-bûn, La-teng-bûn, Hi-la̍h-bûn siá--ê.
Iû-thài -kàu ê chè-si-tiúⁿ tùi Pí-lia̍p-to kóng, “M̄-thang siá ‘ Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông’, tio̍h siá ‘Chit-ê lâng chū-chheng: Góa sī Iû-thài -lâng ê Ông’.”
Pí-lia̍p-to ìn kóng, “Góa só͘ siá--ê í-keng siá lah, bô beh kái!”

Hiah-ê peng chiong Iâ-so͘ tèng si̍p-jī-kè liáu-āu, the̍h I ê gōa-phàu pun-chòe sì hūn, chi̍t lâng chi̍t hūn. In koh the̍h I ê lāi-saⁿ; chit-niá lāi-saⁿ bô kap-chōa, téng-ē chit-chòe chi̍t tè.

Só͘-í, in chham-siông kóng, “Chit-niá mài thiah-khui, lán lâi thiu-chhiam khòaⁿ sī siáⁿ-lâng ê.” Che sī beh èng-giām Sèng-keng ê ōe: In pun góa ê gōa-phàu, ūi-tio̍h góa ê saⁿ thiu-chhiam. Chiah-ê peng tú chiàu án-ni chòe.
Iâ-so͘ ê lāu-bú, I ê a-î, Kek-lô-pa ê bó͘ Má-lī-a, kap Boa̍t-tāi-lia̍p ê Má-lī-a lóng khiā tī Iâ-so͘ ê si̍p-jī-kè piⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h I ê lāu-bú, koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h I só͘ thiàⁿ hit-ê bûn-tô͘ khiā tī piⁿ--á, chiū tùi I ê lāu-bú kóng, “A-bú, khòaⁿ, lí ê kiáⁿ!”
Āu-lâi I tùi hit-ê bûn-tô͘ kóng, “Khòaⁿ, lí ê lāu-bú!” Tùi hit-sî khí, hit-ê bûn-tô͘ kā Iâ-so͘ ê lāu-bú chiap tńg-khì in tau.
Chit-ê sū í-āu, Iâ-so͘ chai it-chhè ê tāi-chì í-keng oân-sêng, ūi-tio̍h beh èng-giām Sèng-keng ê ōe chiū kóng, “Góa chhùi-ta.”
Tī hia ū chi̍t ê tóe-móa sng-chiú ê pân, in chiū ēng hái-mî chìm chiú, pa̍k tī gû-chhek-chháu bé, tu kàu I ê chhùi.
Tam liáu-āu, Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Oân-sêng lah!” Kóng-liáu, thâu kau--lo̍h-khì, khùi chiū tn̄g.

Hit-ji̍t sī pài-gō͘, sī Pī-pān-ji̍t. In-ūi keh-ji̍t sī te̍k-pia̍t ê An-hioh-ji̍t, Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-siù ūi-tio̍h bô ài tī An-hioh-ji̍t lâu sin-si tī si̍p-jī-kè téng, chiū kiû Pí-lia̍p-to kah lâng kòng-tn̄g siū-hêng-chiá ê kha-kut, thang chiong sin-si siu--lo̍h-lâi.
Hiah-ê peng chiū khì, chiong kap Iâ-so͘ chòe-hé tèng si̍p-jī-kè thâu chi̍t ê kap lēng-gōa chi̍t ê ê kha-kut kòng-tn̄g.
In lâi kàu Iâ-so͘ hia, khòaⁿ-tio̍h I í-keng sí, chiū bô kā I ê kha-kut kòng-tn̄g.
M̄-kú ū chi̍t ê peng ēng chhiuⁿ chha̍k Iâ-so͘ ê hia̍p-ē, sûi-sî ū huih kap chúi lâu--chhut-lâi.
Khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng í-keng ū choh-chèng, sī beh hō͘ lín mā sìn; i ê kiàn-chèng sī chin-si̍t, i chai i só͘ kóng--ê sī sū-si̍t.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng sī beh èng-giām Sèng-keng ê ōe, “I ê kut liân chi̍t ki to bōe kòng-tn̄g.”
Koh lēng-gōa ū chi̍t kù keng-bûn kóng, “In ōe gióng-bōng in ēng chhiuⁿ kā i chha̍k ê lâng.”

Chiah-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, ū chi̍t ê A-lī-má-thài -lâng Iok-sek lâi kiû Pí-lia̍p-to chún i khì siu Iâ-so͘ ê ûi-thé. I in-ūi kiaⁿ Iû-thài -kàu tong-kio̍k, só͘-í pì-bi̍t choh Iâ-so͘ ê bûn-tô͘. Pí-lia̍p-to ún-chún, Iok-sek chiū khì siu Iâ-so͘ ê ûi-thé.
Koh í-chêng bat tī àm-sî khì kìⁿ Iâ-so͘ hit-ê Nî-ko-tek-bō͘ mā tòa iok saⁿ-cha̍p kong-kun ê bu̍t-io̍h chhiau tîm-hiuⁿ ê phang-liāu lâi.
In nn̄g lâng chiong Iâ-so͘ ê ûi-thé siu--lo̍h-lâi, chiàu Iû-thài -lâng an-chòng ê koàn-lē kā I boah phang-liāu, koh ēng iù-môa-pò͘ kā I pau-chat.
Iâ-so͘ tèng si̍p-jī-kè ê só͘-chāi ū chi̍t khu hn̂g, hn̂g-lāi ū chi̍t ê iáu m̄-bat chòng-kè lâng ê sin bōng.
In-ūi hit-ji̍t sī pài-gō͘, sī Iû-thài -lâng ê Pī-pān-ji̍t, bōng koh bô hn̄g, in chiū kā Iâ-so͘ an-chòng tī hia.
Lé-pài-ji̍t thàu-chá, thiⁿ iáu-bē kng, Boa̍t-tāi-lia̍p ê Má-lī-a khì bōng-tōe, khòaⁿ-tio̍h bōng-kháu ê chio̍h í-keng sóa-khui.

I chiū cháu-khì chhē Se-bûn Pí-tek, koh khì chhē Iâ-so͘ só͘ thiàⁿ hit-ê bûn-tô͘, kā in kóng, “Ū lâng chiong Chú tùi bōng--ni̍h sóa-cháu; goán m̄ chai in kā I khǹg tī tó-ūi.”
Pí-tek kap hit-ê bûn-tô͘ chiū khì bōng-tōe.
Nn̄g ê lâng chòe-hé cháu, hit-ê bûn-tô͘ pí Pí-tek cháu khah kín, seng kàu bōng--ni̍h.
I àⁿ lo̍h-khì khòaⁿ bōng-lāi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h iù-môa-pò͘ khǹg tī hia, put-kò bô ji̍p--khì.
Se-bûn Pí-tek tè-āu mā kàu, ji̍p-khì bōng-lāi. I khòaⁿ-tio̍h iù-môa-pò͘ khǹg tī hia,
mā khòaⁿ-tio̍h pau-chat Iâ-so͘ thâu-khak ê kun bô kap iù-môa-pò͘ khǹg chòe-hé, kńg--teh, lēng-gōa khǹg.
Seng kàu bōng hit-ê bûn-tô͘ mā ji̍p--khì, khòaⁿ-liáu chiū sìn.
In iáu-bē liáu-kái Sèng-keng ê ōe, kóng I it-tēng tio̍h tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h.
Jiân-āu, hit nn̄g ê bûn-tô͘ tńg-khì in tau.
Má-lī-a khiā tī bōng-gōa teh khàu. I ná khàu ná àⁿ lo̍h-khì khòaⁿ bōng-lāi,
khòaⁿ-tio̍h nn̄g ê chhēng pe̍h-saⁿ ê thiⁿ-sài chē tī goân-lâi hē Iâ-so͘ ê ûi-thé ê só͘-chāi, chi̍t ê tī thâu chit-pêng, chi̍t ê tī kha hit-pêng.
In mn̄g i kóng, “Hū-jîn-lâng, lí ná teh khàu?” I ìn kóng, “Ū lâng kā góa ê Chú sóa-cháu, góa m̄ chai in kā I khǹg tī tó-ūi.”
Kóng soah, Má-lī-a oa̍t-tńg-sin, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ khiā tī hia, m̄-kú m̄ chai I sī Iâ-so͘.

Iâ-so͘ mn̄g i, “Hū-jîn-lâng, lí ná teh khàu? Lí teh chhē sím-mi̍h-lâng?” Má-lī-a siūⁿ-chòe I sī kò͘-hn̂g--ê, chiū ìn kóng, “Thâu-ke, lí nā ū kā I sóa-cháu, chhiáⁿ kā góa kóng lí kā I khǹg tī tó-ūi, góa thang khì kā I siu--tńg-lâi.”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kiò, “ Má-lī-a!” Má-lī-a oa̍t-tńg-sin, ēng Hi-pek-lâi-ōe kiò Iâ-so͘, “Lia̍p-pho-nî!” ì-sù chiū-sī “Lāu-su”.

Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “M̄-thang kā góa khîⁿ--teh, in-ūi góa iáu-bē chiūⁿ-khì Pē hia. Lí tio̍h khì kā góa ê hiaⁿ-tī kóng, ‘Góa beh chiūⁿ-khì góa ê Pē, mā-sī lín ê Pē, góa ê Siōng-tè, mā-sī lín ê Siōng-tè hia.’”
Boa̍t-tāi-lia̍p ê Má-lī-a chiū khì kā bûn-tô͘ pò-kò kóng “Góa í-keng kìⁿ-tio̍h Chú”; koh kóng Chú ū kā i kóng chiah-ê ōe.

Kâng hit-ê lé-pài-ji̍t àm-sî, bûn-tô͘ chū-chi̍p ê só͘-chāi mn̂g lóng koaiⁿ--teh, in-ūi in kiaⁿ Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-siù. Iâ-so͘ lâi, khiā tī in tiong-ng, tùi in kóng, “Goān lín pêng-an!”
I kóng-liáu, chiong siang-chhiú kap hia̍p-ē hō͘ in khòaⁿ. Bûn-tô͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h Chú, chin hoaⁿ-hí.
Iâ-so͘ koh kā in kóng, “Goān lín pêng-an! Chhin-chhiūⁿ Pē ū chhe góa, góa mā chhe lín.”
Kóng soah, I tùi in pûn-khùi, kóng, “Niá-siū Sèng Sîn!
Lín sià-bián sím-mi̍h-lâng ê chōe, in chiū tit-tio̍h sià-bián; lín bô sià-bián sím-mi̍h-lâng ê chōe, in chiū bô tit-tio̍h sià-bián.”
To-má, mā kiò-chòe Siang-siⁿ-á, i sī cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ ê chi̍t ê, Iâ-so͘ lâi hit-sî bô kap in chòe-hé tī hia.

Só͘-í kî-tha ê bûn-tô͘ kā i kóng, “Goán í-keng kìⁿ-tio̍h Chú lah.” To-má kā in kóng, “Góa nā bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h I chhiú-tiong ê teng-jiah, ēng chńg-thâu-á bong teng-jiah, koh ēng chhiú bong I ê hia̍p-ē, góa choa̍t-tùi m̄ sìn.”
Chi̍t lé-pài āu, bûn-tô͘ koh chū-chi̍p tī chhù-lāi, To-má mā kap in chòe-hé. Mn̂g koaiⁿ--teh, Iâ-so͘ lâi, khiā tī in tiong-ng, kóng, “Goān lín pêng-an!”
Jiân-āu, I kā To-má kóng, “Chhun chńg-thâu-á lâi chia, thàm góa ê chhiú; chhun-chhiú lâi bong góa ê hia̍p-ē. M̄-thang bô-sìn, tio̍h sìn!”
To-má kóng, “Góa ê Chú, góa ê Siōng-tè!”
Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa chiah sìn o͘h? Bô khòaⁿ--tio̍h lâi sìn ê lâng chin ū hok-khì!”
Iâ-so͘ tī bûn-tô͘ ê bīn-chêng iáu kiâⁿ chin chōe sîn-jiah, bô kì-chài tī chit-pún chheh.
Kì-chài chiah-ê sī beh hō͘ lín sìn Iâ-so͘ sī Ki-tok, sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ, koh hō͘ lín thong-kè sìn, khò I ê miâ tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā.
Āu-lâi, Iâ-so͘ koh tī Thê-pí-lí-a ô͘-piⁿ tùi bûn-tô͘ hián-hiān. Hián-hiān ê keng-kè sī án-ni:
Se-bûn Pí-tek, kiò-chòe Siang-siⁿ-á ê To-má, Ka-lī-lī ê Ka-ná -lâng Ná-tàn-gia̍p, Se-pì-thài ê nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, kap lēng-gōa nn̄g ê bûn-tô͘ lóng chòe-hé.
Se-bûn Pí-tek kā in kóng, “Góa beh lâi-khì lia̍h-hî.” In kā i kóng, “Goán mā beh kap lí khì.” In chhut--khì, chiūⁿ-chûn; hit-àm, in lia̍h lóng bô.
Thiⁿ phú-kng, Iâ-so͘ khiā tī hōaⁿ-téng; put-kò bûn-tô͘ jīn bōe chhut I sī Iâ-so͘.
Iâ-so͘ tùi in kóng, “Siàu-liân-lâng, lín lia̍h ū hî bô?” In ìn kóng, “Bô.”
I kā in kóng, “Kā bāng pha lo̍h-khì chûn ê chiàⁿ-pêng chiū ōe lia̍h--tio̍h.” In chiū pha--lo̍h-khì; in-ūi pha-tio̍h chin chōe hî, soah thoa bōe khí--lâi.
Iâ-so͘ só͘ thiàⁿ hit-ê bûn-tô͘ kā Pí-tek kóng, “Sī Chú!” Se-bûn Pí-tek chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h sī Chú, in-ūi thǹg-pak-theh, kín chiong gōa-saⁿ moa--teh, thiàu-lo̍h chúi.
Kî-tha ê bûn-tô͘, in-ūi in lī lio̍k-tōe bô hn̄g, iok chi̍t-pah kong-chhioh, chiū kò hit-chiah sòe-chiah chûn kā kui-bāng ê hî thoa óa-hōaⁿ.
In chi̍t-ē chiūⁿ-hōaⁿ, khòaⁿ-tio̍h hia ū hé-thòaⁿ hé, téng-bīn ū hî, koh ū piáⁿ.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Tú-chiah lia̍h--tio̍h ê hî, lia̍h kúi-bé-á lâi.”

Se-bûn Pí-tek peh-khì chûn-téng, thoa bāng khí-lâi hōaⁿ-téng, kui-bāng lóng sī tōa bé hî, lóng-chóng chi̍t-pah gō͘-cha̍p-saⁿ bé, sui-jiân hiah-ni̍h chōe, bāng mā bô phòa--khì.
Iâ-so͘ kā in kóng, “Lâi chia̍h chá-tǹg!” Bûn-tô͘ bô lâng káⁿ kā I mn̄g, “Lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?” In-ūi in chai I sī Chú.
Iâ-so͘ kiâⁿ óa--lâi, the̍h piáⁿ, pun hō͘ in, hî mā chiàu án-ni pun hō͘ in.
Iâ-so͘ tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h í-āu tùi bûn-tô͘ hián-hiān, che sī tē-saⁿ piàn.

In chia̍h chá-tǹg liáu-āu, Iâ-so͘ mn̄g Se-bûn Pí-tek, “ Iok-hān ê kiáⁿ Se-bûn, lí ū thiàⁿ góa iâⁿ-kè chiah-ê--bô?” I ìn kóng, “Chú ah, ū, lí chai góa ū thiàⁿ lí.” Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Iúⁿ-chhī góa ê iûⁿ-á-kiáⁿ!”
Iâ-so͘ tē-jī piàn mn̄g i kóng, “ Iok-hān ê kiáⁿ Se-bûn, lí ū thiàⁿ góa--bô?” I ìn kóng, “Chú ah, ū, lí chai góa ū thiàⁿ lí.” Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Bo̍k-ióng góa ê iûⁿ!”

Iâ-so͘ tē-saⁿ piàn kā i mn̄g, “ Iok-hān ê kiáⁿ Se-bûn, lí ū thiàⁿ góa--bô?” Pí-tek in-ūi Iâ-so͘ tē-saⁿ piàn mn̄g kóng “Lí ū thiàⁿ góa--bô”, chiū chin siong-sim, kā Iâ-so͘ kóng, “Chú ah, lí ta̍k-hāng lóng chai, lí chai góa ū thiàⁿ lí.” Iâ-so͘ chiū kā i kóng, “Iúⁿ-chhī góa ê iûⁿ!

Góa si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi kā lí kóng, lí siàu-liân ê sî ka-kī hâ io-tòa khì ài khì ê só͘-chāi; m̄-kú nî-lāu ê sî, lí ōe chhun siang-chhiú hō͘ lâng pa̍k, kā lí thoa kàu lí bô ài khì ê só͘-chāi.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe sī chí Pí-tek ōe án-chóaⁿ sí lâi êng-iāu Siōng-tè. Kóng soah, Iâ-so͘ kā i kóng, “Lâi tè góa!”

Pí-tek oa̍t-tńg-sin, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ só͘ thiàⁿ hit-ê bûn-tô͘ tè tī āu-bīn. I bat tī boán-chhan ê sî the-óa Iâ-so͘ ê heng-chêng, mn̄g kóng, “Chú ah, sī sím-mi̍h-lâng beh chhut-bōe lí?”
Pí-tek chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h i chiū mn̄g Iâ-so͘, “Chú ah, chit-ê lâng ōe án-chóaⁿ?”
Iâ-so͘ ìn i kóng, “Góa nā ài i oa̍h kàu góa lâi, kap lí ū sím-mi̍h koan-hē. Lí lâi tè góa!”

Tùi án-ni, chit-ê ōe tī bûn-tô͘ ê tiong-kan liû-thoân kóng chit-ê bûn-tô͘ bōe sí. Kî-si̍t, Iâ-so͘ m̄-sī kóng i bōe sí, sī kóng “Góa nā ài i oa̍h kàu góa lâi, kap lí ū sím-mi̍h koan-hē”.
Chit-ê bûn-tô͘ chiū-sī ūi-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì choh-chèng, koh chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì siá--khí-lâi ê lâng. Lán chai i ê kiàn-chèng sī chin-si̍t.
Iâ-so͘ koh ū chòe kî-tha chin chōe tāi-chì, nā beh chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì chi̍t-hāng chi̍t-hāng siá--khí-lâi, só͘ siá ê chheh, góa siūⁿ choân sè-kài mā tóe bōe liáu.

Thê-o-hui-lô sian-siⁿ: Tī góa só͘ siá ê thâu chi̍t pún chheh, góa í-keng ū chiong Iâ-so͘ só͘ chòe só͘ kà-sī it-chhè ê tāi-chì, tùi I khai-sí kang-chok ti̍t-kàu chiūⁿ-thiⁿ hit-ji̍t, lóng ū kóng-khí. I chiūⁿ-thiⁿ í-chêng, ū thong-kè Sèng Sîn chiong chin chōe tāi-chì chí-sī só͘ kéng-soán ê sù-tô͘.

I siū-hāi í-āu, ū ēng chin chōe chèng-kù hián-bêng I pún-sin oa̍h--teh, tī sì-cha̍p ji̍t ê tiong-kan ū hián-hiān hō͘ sù-tô͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, tùi in káng-lūn Siōng-tè-kok ê sū.
Iâ-so͘ kap in chòe-hé ê sî ū hoan-hù in, “M̄-thang lī-khui Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, chiàu góa bat kā lín kóng, tio̍h thèng-hāu Pē ê èng-ún.
Iok-hān ēng chúi kā lín sóe-lé, m̄-kú koh bô kúi ji̍t, lín ōe niá-siū Sèng Sîn ê sóe-lé.”
Sù-tô͘ kap Iâ-so͘ chū-chi̍p ê sî, mn̄g I kóng, “Chú ah, lí beh tī chit-ê sî chiong chú-koân hôe-ho̍k hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t sī--bô?”
I kā in kóng, “Pē ēng ka-kī ê koân-pèng koat-tēng ê sî-kan kap ki-hōe, m̄-sī lín thang chai--ê.
M̄-kú Sèng Sîn lîm-kàu lín ê sî, lín ōe tit-tio̍h lêng-le̍k, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, choân Iû-thài kap Sat-má-lī-a, ti̍t-kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak ūi-tio̍h góa chòe kiàn-chèng.”
Iâ-so͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu, tī in teh khòaⁿ ê sî siū chiap chiūⁿ-thiⁿ; ū chi̍t phìⁿ hûn kā I chiap--khì, in chiū khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h.
In iáu-teh chù-ba̍k khòaⁿ thiⁿ ê sî, hut-jiân ū nn̄g ê chhēng pe̍h-saⁿ ê lâng khiā tī in sin-piⁿ,

kóng, “ Ka-lī-lī -lâng ah, lín ná khiā tī chia teh khòaⁿ thiⁿ? Chit-ūi lī-khui lín siū chiap chiūⁿ-thiⁿ ê Iâ-so͘, lín khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I án-ni chiūⁿ-thiⁿ, I mā ōe chiàu án-ni koh-lâi.”

Āu-lâi, sù-tô͘ tùi hit-ê kiò-chòe Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ ê só͘-chāi tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; Kaⁿ-ná-soaⁿ lī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng bô jōa hn̄g, chha-put-to chi̍t kong-lí, chiū-sī An-hioh-ji̍t ōe-ēng-tit kiâⁿ ê lō͘-thêng.

In ji̍p-siâⁿ liáu-āu, peh-khí-khì in só͘ tòa hit-keng chhù lâu-téng ê thiaⁿ; Pí-tek, Iok-hān, Ngá-kok, An-tek-lia̍t, Hui-le̍k kap To-má, Pa-to-lô-mái kap Má-thài, A-le̍k-hui ê kiáⁿ Ngá-kok, Kek-chìn-tóng ê Se-bûn, kap Ngá-kok ê kiáⁿ Iû-tāi tī hia.
In kap kúi-nā ê hū-jîn-lâng, mā ū Iâ-so͘ ê lāu-bú Má-lī-a í-ki̍p I ê hiaⁿ-tī, lóng kè-sio̍k tâng-sim-ha̍p-ì pek-chhiat kî-tó.
Kúi-nā ji̍t āu, chha-put-to ū chi̍t-pah jī-cha̍p ê sìn-tô͘ chū-chi̍p. Pí-tek khiā--khí-lâi, kóng,
“Kok-ūi hiaⁿ-tī, Sèng Sîn thong-kè Tāi-pi̍t ê chhùi tī Sèng-keng só͘ ū-giân, koan-hē Iû-tāi chhōa lâng lia̍h Iâ-so͘ ê tāi-chì it-tēng tio̍h èng-giām.
I pún-lâi sī lán tiong-kan ê chi̍t ê, siū soán lâi hun-tam chit-ê chit-hūn.
“ Iû-tāi ēng i chòe put-gī ê tāi-chì só͘ tit--tio̍h ê chîⁿ bóe chi̍t tè tōe; I tī hia tò-thâu-chai siak-sí, pak-tó͘ piak-li̍h, tn̂g-á lóng lâu--chhut-lâi.
Tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng lóng chai chit-hāng tāi-chì, só͘-í chiàu in pún-tōe ê ōe kā hit-tè tōe kiò-chòe A-kek-tāi-má, ì-sù sī ‘Huih-hn̂g’.
“In-ūi Si-phian ū kì-chài: Tio̍h hō͘ i ê chhù hong-hòe, bô lâng tī hia khiā-khí. Koh ū kì-chài: Tio̍h hō͘ pa̍t-lâng tāi-thòe i léng-tō ê chit-ūi.

“Só͘-í, tio̍h ū chi̍t ê lâng lâi ka-ji̍p, kap goán chòe-hé choh Chú Iâ-so͘ koh-oa̍h ê kiàn-chèng-jîn. Chit-ê lâng tio̍h tī Chú Iâ-so͘ kap lán chòe-hé chhut-ji̍p ê sî, chiū-sī tùi Iok-hān si-sóe khí, kàu Iâ-so͘ lī-pia̍t lán siū chiap chiūⁿ-thiⁿ hit-ji̍t, put-sî kap lán chòe-tīn.”
In chiū thê-miâ nn̄g ê lâng, chiū-sī kiò-chòe Pa-sat-pa, mā chheng-chòe Iû-sū-to͘ ê Iok-sek, kap Má-thê-a.
In kî-tó kóng, “Chú ah, lí chai ta̍k-ê lâng ê sim. Kiû lí chí-sī goán, chit nn̄g lâng tiong-kan tó chi̍t ê sī lí só͘ kéng-soán,
beh lâi tam-tng sù-tô͘ ê chit-hūn--ê, in-ūi Iû-tāi í-keng pàng-sak chit-ê chit-hūn, khì i eng-kai khì ê só͘-chāi.”
Jiân-āu, in thiu-chhiam, thiu-tio̍h Má-thê-a, i chiū ka-ji̍p cha̍p-it ê sù-tô͘ ê thoân-thé.
Gō͘-sûn-choeh ê ji̍t kàu, bûn-tô͘ lóng chū-chi̍p tī chi̍t só͘-chāi.
Hut-jiân ū siaⁿ tùi thiⁿ-téng lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ thàu tōa-hong, chhiong-móa in teh chē ê kui-keng chhù.
Koh ū chhin-chhiūⁿ hun-khui ê hé-chi̍h tùi in chhut-hiān, hioh tī ta̍k-ê lâng ê téng-bīn.
In lóng siū Sèng Sîn chhiong-móa, chiàu Sèng Sîn hō͘ in ê châi-lêng khai-sí kóng pa̍t-chióng gú-giân.
Hit-sî, ū chi̍t-kóa khiân-sêng ê Iû-thài -lâng tùi sè-kài ta̍k-kok lâi, tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê siaⁿ hiáng, chèng-lâng chiū lóng chū-chi̍p óa--lâi. In-ūi ta̍k-ê lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h bûn-tô͘ ēng in ê pún-tōe-ōe tùi in kóng-ōe, soah gāng--khì.
In tio̍h-kiaⁿ koh kî-koài, kóng, “Lí khòaⁿ, chiah-ê teh kóng-ōe--ê kiám m̄-sī lóng Ka-lī-lī -lâng?
Lán ná ōe thiaⁿ-tio̍h in lóng ēng lán ta̍k-ê lâng tòa ê só͘-chāi ê gú-giân teh kóng-ōe?
Lán chiah-ê Phà-thê-a -lâng, Bí-tí-a -lâng, Í-lân -lâng, í-ki̍p tùi Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a, Iû-thài kap Ka-phà-to-ka, Pún-to͘ kap A-sè-a,
Hut-lū-ka kap Pông-hui-lī-a, Ai-ki̍p kap óa-kūn Kó͘-lī-nāi ê Lī-pí-a tōe-khu lâi ê lâng, mā ū tùi Lô-má lâi ê chhut-gōa-lâng, lāi-bīn ū

Iû-thài -lâng kap kái-chong ji̍p Iû-thài -kàu ê lâng, koh ū Khek-lí-te̍k -lâng kap A-la-pek -lâng, lán kèng-jiân thiaⁿ-tio̍h in lóng ēng lán chāi-tōe ê ōe kóng-khí Siōng-tè só͘ chòe úi-tāi ê tāi-chì.”
Tāi-ke tio̍h-kiaⁿ koh gông-ngia̍h, mn̄g-lâi-mn̄g-khì, “Che sī sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?”
Ū lâng thí-chhiò kóng, “Chiah-ê lâng sī lim sin-chiú teh chùi.”

Chit-ê sî, Pí-tek kap cha̍p-it ê sù-tô͘ khiā--khí-lâi, tōa-siaⁿ tùi chèng-lâng kóng, “ Iû-thài -lâng kap só͘-ū tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng, lín tio̍h chai, chù-ì thiaⁿ góa ê ōe.
Chiah-ê lâng m̄-sī chiàu lín só͘ siūⁿ teh chiú-chùi, chit-chūn chiah chá-khí-sî káu tiám.
Kî-si̍t che chiū-sī sian-ti Iok-ní só͘ kóng--ê.

Siōng-tè kóng: Tī chiong-boa̍t ê ji̍t-chí, Góa beh chiong góa ê Sîn piàⁿ lo̍h-khì hō͘ só͘-ū ê lâng. Lín ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ ōe kóng ū-giân; lín ê siàu-liân-lâng ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ īⁿ-siōng; lín ê lāu-lâng ōe choh-bāng.
Koh tī hiah-ê ji̍t, góa mā beh chiong góa ê Sîn piàⁿ lo̍h-khì hō͘ góa ê po̍k-jîn kap lú-pī; in ōe kóng ū-giân.
Góa beh tī thiⁿ-téng hián-chhut kî-sū, tī tōe-chiūⁿ kiâⁿ sîn-jiah, ū huih, hé, kap ian-bū.
Tī Chú tōa koh êng-iāu ê Ji̍t lâi-lîm í-chêng, ji̍t-thâu ōe pìⁿ-chòe o͘-àm, ge̍h pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ huih hiah-ni̍h âng.
Hit-sî, só͘-ū kiû-kiò Chú ê miâ ê lâng lóng ōe tit-tio̍h kiù.

“ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, lín tio̍h thiaⁿ chiah-ê ōe. Chiàu lín só͘ chai, Siōng-tè thong-kè Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘ tī lín tiong-kan kiâⁿ koân-lêng, kî-sū, kap sîn-jiah, lâi tùi lín chèng-bêng I sī Siōng-tè só͘ chí-phài--ê.
Siōng-tè chiàu I ū-tēng ê chí-ì kap kè-ōe, chiong Iâ-so͘ kau hō͘ lín; lín ēng bô Lu̍t-hoat ê lâng ê chhiú chiong I tèng tī si̍p-jī-kè téng, kā I sat-hāi.
Siōng-tè kā I kái-tû sí ê thòng-khó͘, hō͘ I koh-oa̍h, in-ūi sí bô hoat-tō͘ kā I khòng-chè.
Tāi-pi̍t bat chí I kóng: Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Chú put-sî tī góa ê bīn-chêng, I tī góa ê chiàⁿ-pêng, hō͘ góa bōe tōng-iâu;
in-ūi án-ni, góa ê sim hoaⁿ-hí, góa ê chi̍h khoài-lo̍k; góa chit-ê ōe hiú-nōa ê jio̍k-thé ōe khò ǹg-bāng lâi oa̍h.
In-ūi lí bōe kā góa pàng-sak tī Im-hú, mā bōe hō͘ lí ê Sèng-chiá hiú-nōa.
Lí í-keng chí-sī góa oa̍h-miā ê tō-lō͘, hō͘ góa tī lí ê bīn-chêng chhiong-móa hoaⁿ-hí.
“Kok-ūi hiaⁿ-tī, koan-hē sian-chó͘ Tāi-pi̍t ê sū, góa hó-táⁿ kā lín kóng. I í-keng sí, koh bâi-chòng lah, i ê bōng kin-á-ji̍t iáu tī lán chia.
I sī sian-ti, chai Siōng-tè ū tùi i giâm-siok èng-ún, beh tùi i ê kiáⁿ-sun jīm-bēng chi̍t ê choh-ông lâi chē i ê pó-chō.
Tāi-pi̍t seng khòaⁿ-chhut chit-ê tāi-chì, koan-hē Ki-tok ê koh-oa̍h ū kóng: I bô siū pàng-sak tī Im-hú; I ê jio̍k-thé mā bô hiú-nōa.
Chit-ūi Iâ-so͘, Siōng-tè í-keng ū hō͘ I koh-oa̍h. Goán lóng sī chit-hāng sū ê kiàn-chèng-jîn.

I í-keng siū ko-seng kàu Siōng-tè ê chiàⁿ-pêng, koh tùi Pē niá-siū só͘ èng-ún ê Sèng Sîn, I hiān-chāi chiong chit-ūi Sèng Sîn piàⁿ lo̍h-lâi hō͘ goán, chiū-sī lín hiān-chāi só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ koh thiaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê.
Tāi-pi̍t m̄-bat chiūⁿ-thiⁿ, m̄-kú i kóng: Chú tùi góa ê Chú kóng: Lí chē góa ê chiàⁿ-pêng,
thèng-hāu góa hō͘ lí ê tùi-te̍k khut-ho̍k tī lí kha-ē.
“Só͘-í, Í-sek-lia̍t choân-ke tio̍h khak-si̍t chai, lín kā I tèng si̍p-jī-kè chit-ūi Iâ-so͘, Siōng-tè í-keng jīm-bēng I chòe Chú, chòe Ki-tok lah!”
Chèng-lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe, sim chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ chhì chha̍k--tio̍h, tùi Pí-tek kap kî-tha ê sù-tô͘ kóng, “Kok-ūi hiaⁿ-tī, goán eng-kai chòe sím-mi̍h?”

Pí-tek tùi in kóng, “Tio̍h hóe-kái, ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tio̍h hōng Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ siū sóe-lé, hō͘ lín ê chōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián, chiū ōe niá-siū Siōng-tè só͘ sù ê Sèng Sîn.
In-ūi chit-ê èng-ún sī beh hō͘ lín kap lín ê kiáⁿ-sun, í-ki̍p it-chhè tī hn̄g ê só͘-chāi ê lâng, chiū-sī lán ê Chú Siōng-tè só͘ ho͘-tiàu lâi kui I ê lâng.”
Pí-tek koh ēng chin chōe ōe chhut-la̍t chòe kiàn-chèng, khoàn-bián in, kóng, “Tio̍h kiù ka-kī thoat-lī chit-ê siâ-ok ê sè-tāi.”
Tùi án-ni, niá-siū i ê sìn-sit ê lâng lóng siū sóe-lé; hit-ji̍t sìn-tô͘ tāi-iok ke-thiⁿ saⁿ-chheng lâng.
In choân-sim niá-siū sù-tô͘ ê kà-sī, chham-ú thoân-khè seng-oa̍h, peh-piáⁿ, kî-tó.
Sù-tô͘ kiâⁿ chin chōe kî-sū sîn-jiah, ín-khí chèng-lâng kèng-ùi ê sim.
Só͘-ū ê sìn-tô͘ lóng chòe-hé seng-oa̍h, só͘-ū ê mi̍h kong-ke ēng,
koh bōe ka-sán châi-bu̍t, chiàu ta̍k-ê lâng ê su-iàu pun hō͘ tāi-ke.
In ta̍k-ji̍t tâng-sim-ha̍p-ì tī Sèng-tiān chū-hōe, koh tī chi̍t-ke chi̍t-ke peh-piáⁿ, ēng hoaⁿ-hí sêng-sim chòe-hé lim-chia̍h,
siōng-chàn Siōng-tè, koh tit-tio̍h chèng-lâng hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p. Chú chiong tit-kiù ê lâng ji̍t-ji̍t ke-thiⁿ hō͘ in.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, ē-po͘-sî saⁿ tiám kî-tó ê sî-kan, Pí-tek kap Iok-hān chiūⁿ Sèng-tiān.
Ū chi̍t ê chhut-sì kha chiū pái ê lâng, ta̍k-ji̍t hō͘ lâng kng-lâi hē tī Sèng-tiān hit-ê kiò-chòe “ Súi-mn̂g ” ê mn̂g-kháu, thang tùi ji̍p Sèng-tiān ê lâng kiû-khit.
I chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pí-tek kap Iok-hān teh-beh ji̍p-khì Sèng-tiān, chiū kiû in siá-sì.
Pí-tek kap Iok-hān chù-ba̍k kā i khòaⁿ, Pí-tek tùi i kóng, “Khòaⁿ goán!”
I chiū chù-sîn khòaⁿ in, khòaⁿ ōe-tàng tùi in tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h.
Pí-tek tùi i kóng, “Kim gûn góa lóng bô, góa chiong góa só͘ ū--ê hō͘ lí. Góa hōng Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ bēng-lēng lí, khí-lâi kiâⁿ!”
Jiân-āu Pí-tek khan i ê chiàⁿ-chhiú, kā i hû--khí-lâi. I ê kha kap kha-ba̍k sûi-sî ū la̍t,
chiū thiàu khí-lâi khiā--teh, koh kiâⁿ, kap in chòe-hé chìn-ji̍p Sèng-tiān, ná kiâⁿ ná thiàu, ná o-ló Siōng-tè.
Chèng-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ná kiâⁿ ná siōng-chàn Siōng-tè,
koh jīn-tit i sī pêng-siông chē tī “ Súi-mn̂g ” ê mn̂g-kháu teh kiû-khit hit-ê lâng, chiū tùi tī i sin-chiūⁿ só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì kám-kak chin kî-koài tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Tī Só͘-lô-bûn Cháu-lông, hit-ê tit-tio̍h i-hó ê lâng kā Pí-tek kap Iok-hān khiú-tiâu-tiâu, chèng-lâng tōa kî-koài, lóng cháu óa--lâi.

Pí-tek khòaⁿ-tio̍h hiah-ê lâng, chiū kā in kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ tùi chit-hāng tāi-chì kám-kak kî-koài? Sī-án-chóaⁿ chù-ba̍k khòaⁿ goán, siūⁿ-kóng goán sī khò ka-kī ê lêng-le̍k á-sī khiân-sêng hō͘ chit-ê lâng khí-lâi kiâⁿ?

A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè, chiū-sī lán chó͘-sian ê Siōng-tè, í-keng hō͘ I ê po̍k-jîn Iâ-so͘ tit-tio̍h êng-kng. Chit-ūi Iâ-so͘ lín kā I kau hō͘ koaⁿ-hú; Pí-lia̍p-to koat-tēng beh pàng I ê sî, lín tong-tiûⁿ kū-choa̍t.
Lín kū-choa̍t hit-ūi Sèng koh Kong-gī--ê, iau-kiû Pí-lia̍p-to pàng chi̍t ê sat-jîn-hoān hō͘ lín.
Lín thâi-sí oa̍h-miā ê Goân-thâu, chiū-sī Siōng-tè hō͘ I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h Hit-ūi. Goán sī chit-ê tāi-chì ê kiàn-chèng-jîn.

Tùi sìn-khò chit-ê miâ, chiū-sī Iâ-so͘ ê miâ, lín só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ só͘ bat chit-ê kha-pái ê lâng, ū tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t. Tùi Iâ-so͘ só͘ sù ê sìn-sim, chit-ê lâng oân-choân hó--khí-lâi. Chit-hāng tāi-chì lín tāi-ke lóng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h.
“Hiaⁿ-tī, taⁿ góa chai, lín kap lín ê léng-tō-chiá án-ni chòe sī in-ūi m̄ chai.
Siōng-tè ū thong-kè chèng sian-ti ê chhùi ū-giân I ê Ki-tok tio̍h siū-khó͘, chit-ê tāi-chì kó-jiân èng-giām lah.
Só͘-í, tio̍h hóe-kái kui-ǹg Siōng-tè, thang hō͘ lín ê chōe tit-tio̍h chhat-siau.
Án-ni, Chú chiū ōe sù lín keng-sin ê ji̍t-chí, koh chhe-khián chá chiū kéng hó-sè ê Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ lâi.
Chiàu Siōng-tè thong-kè kó͘-chá sèng sian-ti ê chhùi só͘ soan-pò͘--ê, I it-tēng tio̍h tiàm tī thiⁿ-téng ti̍t-kàu bān-mi̍h ho̍k-heng ê sî.

Mô͘-se bat kóng, ‘Chú — lín ê Siōng-tè beh tùi lín tông-pau ê tiong-kan kā lín jīm-bēng chi̍t ūi chhin-chhiūⁿ góa chit-khoán ê sian-ti. I kā lín kóng ê ōe, lín lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ-thàn.
M̄ thiaⁿ chit-ūi sian-ti ê ōe ê lâng, ōe tùi chú-bîn tiong lóng kā in tû-bia̍t.’
Tùi Sat-bó-ní kàu í-āu só͘-ū thoân sìn-sit ê sian-ti lóng ū kóng-khí chiah-ê ji̍t-chí.

Lín sī sian-ti ê kiáⁿ-sun, mā-sī Siōng-tè kap lín ê chó͘-sian só͘ li̍p ê iok ê kè-sêng-jîn. I bat tùi A-pek-la-hán kóng, ‘Tōe-chiūⁿ bān-cho̍k lóng ōe in-ūi lí ê hō͘-tāi tit-tio̍h hok-khì.’
Siōng-tè jīm-bēng I ê Po̍k-jîn, seng chhe I lâi lín chia, kā lín sù-hok, hō͘ lín ta̍k-ê lâng oa̍t tò-tńg lī-khui siâ-ok.”
Pí-tek kap Iok-hān tùi kûn-chiòng teh kóng-ōe ê sî, ū chè-si, Sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe-koaⁿ, kap Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng lâi.
In hui-siông siū-khì, in-ūi chit nn̄g ê sù-tô͘ teh kà-sī chèng-lâng, kun-kù Iâ-so͘ ê koh-oa̍h soan-káng sí-lâng koh-oa̍h ê sū.
In chiū lia̍h chit nn̄g ê sù-tô͘, kā in khu-liû kàu keh-ji̍t, in-ūi thiⁿ í-keng àm.
Thiaⁿ-tio̍h sìn-sit--ê ū chin chōe lâng sìn, ta-po͘-lâng ê jîn-sò͘ chha-put-to ū gō͘-chheng.
Keh-ji̍t, Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-siù, tiúⁿ-ló, kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su chū-chi̍p tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Tōa-chè-si A-ná kap Kai-a-hoat, Iok-hān, A-le̍k-san-tāi, kap tōa-chè-si ê ka-cho̍k mā lóng tī hia.
In kiò sù-tô͘ lâi khiā tī in tiong-kan, mn̄g kóng, “Lín khò sím-mi̍h koân-lêng, hōng sím-mi̍h miâ, chòe chit-hāng tāi-chì?”
Hit-sî Pí-tek siū Sèng Sîn chhiong-móa, ìn kóng, “Kok-ūi bîn-kan ê léng-siù kap tiúⁿ-ló,
goán kin-á-ji̍t nā-sī ūi-tio̍h hō͘ chit-ê kha-pái ê lâng tit-tio̍h i-hó chit-hāng hó-sū siū chhâ-mn̄g,

lín tāi-ke kap só͘-ū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng tio̍h chai, chit-ê lâng oân-choân ióng-kiāⁿ khiā tī lín bīn-chêng, sī khò Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ. Chit-ūi Iâ-so͘, lín kā I tèng si̍p-jī-kè, m̄-kú Siōng-tè hō͘ I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h.
I chiū-sī Sèng-keng só͘ kóng: Lín chiah-ê khí-chhù sai-hū só͘ khì-sak ê chio̍h, í-keng chiâⁿ-chòe siōng tiōng-iàu ê ki-chio̍h.
Iâ-so͘ í-gōa lóng bô chín-kiù, in-ūi tī thiⁿ-ē jîn-kan, Siōng-tè bô sù pa̍t-ê miâ hō͘ lán thang óa-khò lâi tit-kiù.”
Gī-hōe ê gī-oân khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pí-tek kap Iok-hān hiah-ni̍h ióng-kám, chai in sī bô tha̍k-chheh ê phó͘-thong-lâng, chiū chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ, koh jīn-tit in bat kap Iâ-so͘ chòe-hé,
mā khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê tit-tio̍h i-hó ê lâng khiā tī in sin-piⁿ, chiū bô ōe thang hoán-pok.
Gī-oân chiū kiò in lī-khui gī-hōe, jiân-āu chham-siông
kóng, “Lán tio̍h án-chóaⁿ lâi tùi-hù chiah-ê lâng? In só͘ kiâⁿ chit-ê kî-īⁿ ê sîn-jiah, tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng lóng chai, lán bô hoat-tō͘ hó͘-jīn.
M̄-kú ūi-tio̍h beh pī-bián chit-ê tāi-chì tī bîn-kan ná thoân ná khoah, lán tio̍h kéng-kò in tùi sím-mi̍h-lâng to m̄-thang koh hōng Iâ-so͘ ê miâ káng-lūn.”
Āu-lâi, in kiò hit nn̄g ê sù-tô͘ lâi, bēng-lēng in bōe-ēng-tit koh hōng Iâ-so͘ ê miâ káng-lūn á-sī kà-sī.
M̄-kú Pí-tek kap Iok-hān ìn kóng, “Thiaⁿ-thàn lín chiah tio̍h á-sī thiaⁿ-thàn Siōng-tè chiah tio̍h, tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng lín ka-kī phòaⁿ-toàn.
Goán só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, bōe-tàng bô kóng.”

Hiah-ê gī-oân m̄ chai tio̍h án-chóaⁿ kā in chhú-hoa̍t, chiū giâm-giâm kā in kéng-kò, liáu-āu pàng in khì, in-ūi bîn-chiòng lóng teh ūi-tio̍h só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè.
Tùi chit-ê sîn-jiah tit-tio̍h i-hó hit-ê lâng í-keng sì-cha̍p gōa hè.
Pí-tek kap Iok-hān siū tháu-pàng, chiū tò-khì tâng-phōaⁿ hia, chiong chè-si-tiúⁿ kap tiúⁿ-ló kā in kóng ê ōe lóng tùi in pò-kò.
In thiaⁿ-liáu chiū tâng-sim tōa-siaⁿ tùi Siōng-tè kî-tó kóng, “Chhòng-chō thiⁿ, tōe, hái, kap kî-tiong bān-mi̍h ê Chú-cháiⁿ,
lí bat thong-kè Sèng Sîn ēng lí ê po̍k-jîn goán ê chó͘-sian Tāi-pi̍t ê chhùi kóng: Gōa-pang sī-án-chóaⁿ háng-hoah? Bān-bîn sī-án-chóaⁿ kè-bô͘ bô hāu-kó ê sū?
Tōe-chiūⁿ ê kun-ông lóng pâi-tīn beh kau-chiàn; thóng-tī-chiá liân-ha̍p--khí-lâi, beh kong-kek Chú kap I soán-li̍p ê Ki-tok.
Hi-lu̍t kap Pâng-siu Pí-lia̍p-to kó-jiân tī chit-ê siâⁿ-lāi kap Gōa-pang-lâng í-ki̍p Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng liân-ha̍p lâi kong-kek lí só͘ soán-li̍p sèng ê po̍k-jîn Iâ-so͘.
In chū-chi̍p beh chòe lí ê koân-lêng kap lí ê chí-ì ū-tēng ōe hoat-seng it-chhè ê sū.
Taⁿ Chú ah, in teh kā goán khióng-hat, kiû lí kàm-chhat, hō͘ lí ê po̍k-jîn koh-khah ū ióng-khì thang soan-káng lí ê sìn-sit.
Kiû lí chhun-chhiú i-tī, koh thong-kè lí sèng ê po̍k-jîn Iâ-so͘ ê miâ hō͘ goán kiâⁿ sîn-jiah kî-sū.”
Kî-tó soah, chū-hōe ê só͘-chāi iô-tāng; in lóng siū Sèng Sîn chhiong-móa, ióng-kám soan-káng Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit.
Choân-thé sìn-tô͘ lóng tâng-sim-ha̍p-ì, bô chi̍t ê lâng kóng i ê châi-bu̍t sī ka-kī ê; só͘-ū ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ kong-ke ēng.
Sù-tô͘ ēng tōa lêng-le̍k kiàn-chèng Chú Iâ-so͘ ê koh-oa̍h, chèng-lâng lóng tit-tio̍h tōa un-tián.
In tiong-kan bô lâng ū khiàm-kheh, in-ūi ū chhân-hn̂g chhù-the̍h ê lâng lóng bōe--chhut-khì,
só͘ tit--tio̍h ê chîⁿ the̍h-lâi kau hō͘ sù-tô͘, chiàu ta̍k-ê lâng ê su-iàu hun-phòe.
Ū chi̍t ê chhut-sì tī Sài-phó͘-lō͘-su ê Lī-bī -lâng Iok-sek, sù-tô͘ kā i kiò-chòe Pa-ná-pa, ì-sù chiū-sī An-ùi-chiá.
I bōe ka-kī ê chhân-hn̂g, chîⁿ the̍h-lâi kau hō͘ sù-tô͘.
Ū chi̍t ê lâng miâ kiò-chòe A-ná-nî-a, i kap i ê bó͘ Sat-hui-lat bōe chi̍t-kóa chhân-hn̂g;
i tit-tio̍h bó͘ ê tông-ì, chiong só͘ tit--tio̍h ê chîⁿ lâu chi̍t-kóa khí--lâi, chhun--ê the̍h-lâi kau hō͘ sù-tô͘.
Pí-tek tùi i kóng, “ A-ná-nî-a, lí ná hō͘ Sat-tàn khòng-chè lí ê sim lâi khi-phiàn Sèng Sîn, kā bōe chhân-hn̂g ê chîⁿ lâu chi̍t-pō͘-hūn khí--lâi?
Chhân-hn̂g iáu-bē bōe sī lí ê, bōe liáu só͘ tit--tio̍h ê chîⁿ lí ū koân thang chhú-lí, lí ná chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì? Lí m̄-sī khi-phiàn lâng, sī khi-phiàn Siōng-tè!”
A-ná-nî-a chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê ōe, lek--lo̍h-khì chiū sí. Thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê tāi-chì ê lâng lóng chin kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Ū kúi-nā ê siàu-liân-lâng lâi, kā i ê si-thé pau--khí-lâi, kng chhut-khì bâi-chòng.
Chha-put-to saⁿ tiám-cheng āu, i ê bó͘ ji̍p--lâi, m̄ chai só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì.
Pí-tek mn̄g i, “Lí kā góa kóng, lín bōe chhân-hn̂g só͘ tit--tio̍h ê chîⁿ kan-ta chiah-ê sī--bô?” I ìn kóng, “Sī, chiah-ê nā-tiāⁿ.”
Pí-tek tùi i kóng, “Lín ná tâng-sim chhì-thàm Chú ê Sîn? Lí khòaⁿ, bâi-chòng lí ê tiōng-hu ê lâng tú tńg-lâi kàu mn̂g-kháu, in mā beh kā lí kng--chhut-khì!”

Sat-hui-lat sûi-sî lek--lo̍h-khì, tī Pí-tek ê kha-chêng sí--khì. Hiah-ê siàu-liân-lâng ji̍p--lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i í-keng sí, chiū kā i kng--chhut-khì, bâi-chòng tī i tiōng-hu ê sin-piⁿ.
Choân kàu-hōe kap thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì ê lâng lóng chin kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
Sù-tô͘ tī bîn-kan kiâⁿ chin chōe sîn-jiah kî-sū. Sìn-tô͘ lóng tâng-sim-ha̍p-ì tī Só͘-lô-bûn Cháu-lông chū-hōe.
Bîn-chiòng lóng chin chun-tiōng in, m̄-kú m̄-káⁿ kap in chiap-kūn.
Sìn Chú ê lâng it-ti̍t ke-thiⁿ, lâm--ê lú--ê lóng chin chōe.
Ū lâng chiong pīⁿ-lâng khǹg tī bîn-chhn̂g á-sī chhn̂g-pho͘, kng chhut-lâi hē tī lō͘-piⁿ, tī Pí-tek keng-kè ê sî thang hō͘ i ê iáⁿ ìm--tio̍h.
Koh ū kui-kûn lâng chhōa phòa-pīⁿ--ê í-ki̍p hō͘ siâ-sîn khó͘-chhó͘ ê lâng tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiu-ûi ê hiong-tìn chū-chi̍p óa--lâi, in lóng ū tit-tio̍h i-hó.
Tōa-chè-si í-ki̍p kap i kâng-tóng, chiū-sī Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng, tùi sù-tô͘ móa-sim oàn-tò͘.
In hē-chhiú lia̍h sù-tô͘, kā in koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ.
Hit-mî, Chú ê thiⁿ-sài phah-khui kaⁿ-mn̂g, kā in chhōa--chhut-lâi, tùi in kóng,
“Lín khì, khiā tī Sèng-tiān chiong chit-ê sù oa̍h-miā ê sìn-sit choân-pō͘ tùi bîn-chiòng soan-káng.”

Sù-tô͘ thiaⁿ i ê ōe, thiⁿ beh kng ê sî ji̍p-khì Sèng-tiān kà-sī lâng. Tōa-chè-si kap i kâng-tóng ê lâng kàu-ūi, chiū tiàu-chi̍p só͘-ū Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tiúⁿ-ló khui-hōe, jiân-āu chhe lâng khì kaⁿ-ga̍k chhōa sù-tô͘ lâi.
Siú-ōe kàu ê sî, hoat-kiàn sù-tô͘ bô tī kaⁿ--ni̍h, chiū tò-lâi pò-kò kóng,
“Goán hoat-kiàn kaⁿ-pâng só-tiâu-tiâu, khàn-siú khiā tī mn̂g-kháu, goán chi̍t-ē khui kaⁿ-mn̂g, lāi-bīn lóng bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h pòaⁿ-lâng.”
Sèng-tiān ê siú-ōe-koaⁿ kap chè-si-tiúⁿ thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê pò-kò, m̄ chai tāi-chì ōe án-chóaⁿ ián-piàn chiū chin tio̍h-kip.
Hit-sî, ū chi̍t ê lâng ji̍p-lâi kā in kóng, “Lín kā in lia̍h-khì koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ--ni̍h hiah-ê lâng, hiān-chāi khiā tī Sèng-tiān teh kà-sī bîn-chiòng!”
Hit-ê siú-ōe-koaⁿ kap i ê pō͘-hā chiū khì kā sù-tô͘ chhōa--lâi; in bô ēng pō-le̍k, in-ūi kiaⁿ bîn-chiòng ēng chio̍h-thâu kā in tìm.
In chhōa sù-tô͘ ji̍p--lâi, hō͘ in khiā tī gī-hōe bīn-chêng. Tōa-chè-si chiū kā in sím-mn̄g,

kóng, “Goán ū giâm-giâm kìm-chí lín m̄-thang hōng chit-ê miâ kà-sī lâng, lín tian-tò chiong chit-ê tō-lí thoân-piàn Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, siūⁿ-beh chiong lâu chit-ê lâng ê huih ê chek-jīm kui hō͘ goán.”
Pí-tek kap kî-tha ê sù-tô͘ ìn kóng, “Goán tio̍h sūn-ho̍k Siōng-tè, m̄-sī sūn-ho̍k lâng.
Lín kā I tèng-sí tī si̍p-jī-kè téng ê Iâ-so͘, lán chó͘-sian ê Siōng-tè ū hō͘ I koh-oa̍h.
Chit-ūi Iâ-so͘, Siōng-tè ko-kú I chē tī ka-kī ê chiàⁿ-pêng, choh Siú-léng, choh Kiù-chú, thang hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng hóe-kái, chōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Goán sī chiah-ê tāi-chì ê kiàn-chèng-jîn. Siōng-tè sù hō͘ sūn-ho̍k I ê lâng ê Sèng Sîn mā ūi-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì choh chèng-jîn.”
Gī-hōe ê gī-oân thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe hui-siông siū-khì, ài-beh thâi in.
M̄-kú in tiong-kan ū chi̍t ê Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng, kiò-chòe Ka-má-lia̍t, sī chèng-lâng chun-kèng ê lu̍t-hoat-kàu-su. I khiā--khí-lâi, hoan-hù sù-tô͘ chiām-sî chhut--khì,
jiân-āu tùi gī-hōe kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, lín beh pān chiah-ê lâng tio̍h chin kín-sīn!
Í-chêng Tō͘-ta̍t khí--lâi, chū-chheng tōa-jîn-bu̍t, iok ū sì-pah lâng tè i, āu-lâi i hō͘ lâng thâi-sí, só͘-ū tè i ê lâng lóng sì-sòaⁿ, siau-sit--khì.
Āu-lâi ū chi̍t ê Ka-lī-lī -lâng Iû-tāi tī hō͘-kháu-phó͘-cha ê sî chhut-hiān, chhōa chi̍t-kóa lâng tè i, i mā hō͘ lâng thâi-sí; tè i ê lâng lóng sì-sòaⁿ.
Taⁿ koan-hē chit-hāng tāi-chì, góa kā lín kóng, chiah-ê lâng lín m̄-thang chhap, chhut-chāi in khì. In só͘ kè-ōe só͘ chòe--ê nā chhut tī lâng, it-tēng ōe sit-pāi;
nā chhut tī Siōng-tè, lín chiū bōe-tàng kā in siau-bia̍t, kiaⁿ-liáu lín soah kap Siōng-tè choh tùi-thâu!” Gī-hōe chiap-la̍p i ê ì-kiàn.
In kiò sù-tô͘ ji̍p--lâi, ēng piⁿ kā in phah, bēng-lēng in bōe-ēng-tit koh hōng Iâ-so͘ ê miâ káng-tō, jiân-āu pàng in chhut--khì.
Sù-tô͘ lī-khui gī-hōe, móa-sim hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi in hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe ōe-kham-tit ūi-tio̍h Chú ê miâ siū lêng-jio̍k.
In ta̍k-ji̍t tī Sèng-tiān kap jîn-ke-chhù kè-sio̍k kà-sī lâng, thoân Ki-tok Iâ-so͘.

Kè bô-jōa-kú, bûn-tô͘ ê jîn-sò͘ it-ti̍t ke-thiⁿ, kóng Hi-la̍h-gú ê Iû-thài -lâng bâi-oàn hiah-ê kóng Hi-pek-lâi-gú ê Iû-thài -lâng, in-ūi tī hun-phòe ji̍t-siông seng-oa̍h ê su-iàu ū hut-lio̍k in ê kóaⁿ-hū.

Cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ chiū tiàu-chi̍p choân-thé bûn-tô͘, tùi in kóng, “Goán chiong soan-káng Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê kang-chok pàng-hē--teh, khì koán hun-phòe ji̍t-siông seng-oa̍h ê su-iàu bô ha̍h.
Só͘-í, hiaⁿ-tī ah, tio̍h tùi lín tiong-kan soán chhit ê ū hó miâ-siaⁿ, siū Sèng Sîn chhiong-móa, koh ū tì-hūi ê lâng, goán thang jīm-bēng in pān-lí chit-ê tāi-chì.
Goán beh choan-sim tī kî-tó kap thoân-tō ê kang-chok.”

Sù-tô͘ ê ì-kiàn tit-tio̍h choân hōe-chiòng chàn-sêng, in chiū soán Sū-thê-hoán, i sī chhiong-móa sìn-sim kap Sèng Sîn ê lâng; koh soán Hui-le̍k, Pek-lô-ko-lô, Nî-ka-ná, Thê-bûn, Pa-bí-ná, kap kái-chong ji̍p Iû-thài -kàu ê An-thê-o -lâng Nî-ko-la.
In hō͘ chiah-ê lâng khiā tī sù-tô͘ bīn-chêng, sù-tô͘ chiū ūi-tio̍h in kî-tó, kā in àn-chhiú.
Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit kè-sio̍k thoân-khui; tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng bûn-tô͘ ê jîn-sò͘ ke-thiⁿ chin chōe, koh ū chin chōe chè-si mā thiaⁿ-thàn chit-ê sìn-gióng.
Sū-thê-hoán chhiong-móa un-sù kap lêng-le̍k, tī bîn-chiòng ê tiong-kan kiâⁿ tōa kî-sū kap sîn-jiah.

Put-kò ū chi̍t-kóa lâng khí-lâi kap Sū-thê-hoán piān-lūn, in sī tùi Kó͘-lī-nāi kap A-le̍k-san-tāi lâi, sio̍k “Chū-iû-jîn” hōe-tn̂g ê hōe-oân, í-ki̍p tùi Ki-lī-ka kap A-sè-a lâi ê lâng.
Sèng Sîn sù tì-hūi hō͘ Sū-thê-hoán, hō͘ in bô hoat-tō͘ thang piān-pok.
Āu-lâi, in bóe-siu chi̍t-kóa lâng chhut-lâi kóng, “Goán bat thiaⁿ-tio̍h i kóng húi-pòng Mô͘-se kap siat-to̍k Siōng-tè ê ōe.”
In siàn-tōng bîn-chiòng, tiúⁿ-ló, kap keng-ha̍k-kàu-su, chhiong-khì lia̍h Sū-thê-hoán, kā i kau hō͘ gī-hōe.
In kiò chi̍t-kóa ké chèng-jîn chhut--lâi, kóng, “Chit-ê lâng put-sî kóng-ōe kong-kek chit-ê Sèng-tiān kap Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat.
Goán bat thiaⁿ-tio̍h i kóng, chit-ê Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘ beh húi-hoāi chit-ê Sèng-tiān, koh kái-piàn Mô͘-se thoân hō͘ lán ê kui-lē.”
Hit-sî chē tī gī-hōe ê lâng lóng chù-ba̍k khòaⁿ Sū-thê-hoán, khòaⁿ-tio̍h i ê bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-sài ê bīn-māu.
Tōa-chè-si mn̄g Sū-thê-hoán, “Sū-si̍t sī án-ni sī--bô?”

Sū-thê-hoán ìn kóng, “Kok-ūi hū-ló hiaⁿ-tī, chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ! Lán ê chó͘-sian A-pek-la-hán sóa-khì Hap-lân í-chêng, iáu tòa tī Bí-soh-put-ta̍t-bí-a ê sî, êng-kng ê Siōng-tè tùi i hián-hiān,
kā i kóng, ‘Tio̍h lī-khui lí ê kò͘-hiong kap chhin-cho̍k, khì góa beh chí-sī lí ê só͘-chāi.’
A-pek-la-hán chiū lī-khui Ka-le̍k-tí -lâng ê tōe-hng, khì tòa tī Hap-lân. I ê lāu-pē sí liáu-āu, Siōng-tè tùi hia kā i chhian-sóa lâi hiān-chāi lín teh tòa chit-ê tōe.

M̄-kú Siōng-tè lóng bô sán-gia̍p hō͘ i, liân li̍p-chiok-chi-tōe to bô. Sui-jiân hit-sî i iáu bô kiáⁿ, m̄-kú Siōng-tè èng-ún beh sù i chit-ê thó͘-tōe, hō͘ i kap i ê hō͘-tāi chòe sán-gia̍p.
Siōng-tè ū án-ni kóng, ‘Lí ê hō͘-tāi ōe khì kià-ku tī gōa-kok, chòe lô͘-châi siū ge̍k-thāi sì-pah nî kú.’
I koh kóng, ‘M̄-kú góa beh sím-phòaⁿ hit-ê hō͘ in chòe lô͘-châi ê kok-ka, āu-lâi góa ōe hō͘ in chhut--lâi, tī chit-ê só͘-chāi kèng-pài góa.’

Jiân-āu Siōng-tè ū kap i li̍p-iok, ēng kat-lé chòe kì-hō. In-ūi án-ni, A-pek-la-hán siⁿ Í-sat liáu-āu tē-poeh ji̍t kā i kat-lé. Āu-lâi Í-sat siⁿ Ngá-kok, Ngá-kok siⁿ cha̍p-jī ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ.
“Chiah-ê cho̍k-tiúⁿ oàn-tò͘ Iok-sek, kā i bōe-khì Ai-ki̍p, m̄-kú Siōng-tè kap i tông-chāi,
kiù i thoat-lī it-chhè ê chai-lān, koh sù i tì-hūi, hō͘ i tit-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p -ông Hoat-ló ê koan-ài, chí-phài i chòe Ai-ki̍p ê siú-siòng kap ông-kiong ê chóng-koán.
Āu-lâi Ai-ki̍p kap Ka-lâm choân-tōe hoat-seng ki-hng, ín-khí tōa chai-lān, lán ê chó͘-sian bô niû-si̍t thang chia̍h.
Ngá-kok thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ai-ki̍p ū niû-si̍t, chiū chhe lán ê chó͘-sian khì hia; che sī thâu chi̍t piàn.
Tē-jī piàn in khì ê sî, Iok-sek tùi i ê hiaⁿ-tī piáu-pe̍k i ê sin-hūn; tùi án-ni Hoat-ló chiah bat Iok-sek ê ka-cho̍k.
Iok-sek chhe lâng khì chhiáⁿ i ê lāu-pē Ngá-kok kap choân ka-cho̍k chhit-cha̍p-gō͘ ê lâng lóng khì Ai-ki̍p.
Ngá-kok chiū lo̍h-khì Ai-ki̍p, āu-lâi i kap lán ê chó͘-sian lóng sí tī hia;
in ê ûi-thé hō͘ lâng ūn kàu Sī-kiàm, bâi-chòng tī A-pek-la-hán ēng chîⁿ tùi Hap-boat ê kiáⁿ-sun bóe hit-ê bōng-tōe.
“Siōng-tè tùi A-pek-la-hán ê èng-ún teh-beh si̍t-hiān ê sî, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tī Ai-ki̍p ê jîn-kháu ke-thiⁿ chin chōe.
Āu-lâi ū lēng-gōa chi̍t ê m̄ bat Iok-sek ê ông khí-lâi thóng-tī Ai-ki̍p.
I ēng khúi-kè tùi-hù lán ê bîn-cho̍k, ge̍k-thāi lán ê chó͘-sian, kiông-pek in kā eⁿ-á tàn tī gōa-bīn, hō͘ in sí.
Tú chit-ê sî Mô͘-se chhut-sì, siⁿ-chòe hui-siông chheng-siù tit-lâng-thiàⁿ. I tī lāu-pē ê chhù siū iúⁿ-chhī saⁿ ge̍h-ji̍t kú.
I siū pàng-sak ê sî, Hoat-ló ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ kā i khioh-khì chòe ka-kī ê kiáⁿ iúⁿ-chhī.
I siū chai-pôe ha̍k-si̍p Ai-ki̍p it-chhè ê tì-hūi, kóng-ōe chòe tāi-chì lóng ū châi-lêng.
“ Mô͘-se móa sì-cha̍p hè ê sî, siūⁿ-beh khì thàm ka-kī ê hiaⁿ-tī Í-sek-lia̍t tông-pau.
I khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê hiaⁿ-tī hō͘ Ai-ki̍p -lâng khi-hū, chiū khì kā i pó-hō͘, phah-sí hit-ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng, thòe i pò-ho̍k.
I siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī ê hiaⁿ-tī ōe liáu-kái Siōng-tè beh ēng i ê chhiú lâi kái-kiù in, m̄-kú in bô liáu-kái.
Keh-ji̍t, i khòaⁿ-tio̍h nn̄g ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng teh oan-ke, siūⁿ-beh kā in tiâu-kái, kóng, ‘Pêng-iú, lín sī hiaⁿ-tī, ná teh hō͘-siōng siong-hāi?’
M̄-kú hit-ê teh khi-hū lâng--ê kā Mô͘-se sak--khui, kóng, ‘Siáⁿ-lâng jīm-bēng lí choh goán ê thâu-lâng, choh goán ê phòaⁿ-koaⁿ?
Lí mā beh thâi góa chhin-chhiūⁿ chā-hng thâi hit-ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng o͘h?’
Mô͘-se chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê ōe chiū tô-cháu, khì Bí-tiân -lâng ê tōe kià-ku; i tī hia siⁿ nn̄g ê kiáⁿ.
“Sì-cha̍p nî āu, tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ ê khòng-iá ū chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài tī chhì-phè ê hé-iām tiong tùi Mô͘-se hián-hiān.
Mô͘-se khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chit-ê kéng-siōng kám-kak chin hi-kî, beh kiâⁿ óa-khì khòaⁿ khah siông-sè ê sî, thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Chú ê siaⁿ kóng,
‘Góa sī lín chó͘-sian ê Siōng-tè, sī A-pek-la-hán, Í-sat, Ngá-kok ê Siōng-tè.’ Mô͘-se kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah, m̄-káⁿ khòaⁿ.
Chú tùi i kóng, ‘Ôe thǹg--khí-lâi, in-ūi lí só͘ khiā ê só͘-chāi sī sîn-sèng ê tōe.

Góa ê chú-bîn tī Ai-ki̍p só͘ siū ê thòng-khó͘, góa khak-si̍t ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, mā ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h in ê ai-kiò, góa lo̍h-lâi beh chín-kiù in. Taⁿ lí lâi, góa beh chhe lí khì Ai-ki̍p.’

“Chit-ê Mô͘-se, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bat kā i kū-choa̍t, mn̄g i kóng ‘Siáⁿ-lâng jīm-bēng lí choh thâu-lâng, choh phòaⁿ-koaⁿ’; chit-ê lâng Siōng-tè khiok thong-kè tī hé-iām tiong hián-hiān ê thiⁿ-sài chhe-phài i choh léng-siù, choh chín-kiù-chiá.
I chhōa in chhut--lâi, tī Ai-ki̍p, tī Âng-hái, tī khòng-iá sì-cha̍p nî kú, kiâⁿ chin chōe kî-sū sîn-jiah.
Chit-ê Mô͘-se bat tùi Í-sek-lia̍t kiáⁿ-sun kóng, ‘Siōng-tè beh tùi lín tông-pau ê tiong-kan kā lín heng-khí chi̍t ê chhin-chhiūⁿ góa chit-khoán ê sian-ti.’
Mô͘-se mā bat kap tī Se-nāi-soaⁿ tùi i kóng-ōe hit-ê thiⁿ-sài í-ki̍p lán ê chó͘-sian tī khòng-iá chū-hōe; i ū chiong só͘ niá-siū oa̍h ê sìn-sit thoân hō͘ lán.
Lán ê chó͘-sian m̄-khéng thiaⁿ-thàn, tian-tò kā i kū-choa̍t, siūⁿ-beh tò-tńg-khì Ai-ki̍p.
In tùi A-lûn kóng, ‘Lí tio̍h chō chi̍t-kóa sîn-bêng lâi kā goán chhōa-lō͘, in-ūi chhōa goán chhut Ai-ki̍p hit-ê Mô͘-se m̄-chai tú-tio̍h sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.’
Hit-sî in chō chi̍t ê gû-á-kiáⁿ ê siōng, tùi hit-ê ngó͘-siōng hiàn-chè, ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê chhiú só͘ chō ê ngó͘-siōng khèng-chiok.

M̄-kú Siōng-tè oa̍t-thâu m̄ khòaⁿ in, chhut-chāi in khì pài thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ-sîn, chiàu sian-ti-su só͘ kóng: Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ah, lín tī khòng-iá sì-cha̍p nî kú, kiám bat hiàn seng-lé á-sī chè-mi̍h hō͘ góa?
Lín kng Mô͘-lo̍k ê pò͘-pîⁿ, í-ki̍p Lí-hoan -sîn ê chhiⁿ, chiū-sī lín chō lâi pài ê siōng; só͘-í góa beh kā lín hòng-tio̍k khì Pa-pí-lûn hit-pêng!
