“Lán ê chó͘-sian tī khòng-iá ū kiàn-chèng Siōng-tè tông-chāi ê hōe-bō͘, chiū-sī Siōng-tè tùi Mô͘-se kóng-ōe ê sî chí-sī i, chiàu i só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê bô͘-hêng kiàn-chō--ê.

Āu-lâi lán ê chó͘-sian sêng-chiap chit-ê hōe-bō͘. Siōng-tè tùi in bīn-chêng kā gōa-cho̍k kóaⁿ-cháu; in chiàm-léng hit-ê thó͘-tōe í-āu chiah kap Iok-su-a chiong hōe-bō͘ sóa-khì hia, it-ti̍t kàu Tāi-pi̍t ê sî-tāi.
Tāi-pi̍t ū tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí, thang kiû Siōng-tè chún i ūi-tio̍h Ngá-kok ê ke chhē chi̍t ê khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.
M̄-kú āu-lâi ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè khí Sèng-tiān--ê sī Só͘-lô-bûn.
“Kî-si̍t Chì-koân ê Siōng-tè pèng bô tòa tī lâng ê chhiú só͘ khí ê chhù, chhin-chhiūⁿ sian-ti só͘ kóng:
Chú kóng: Thiⁿ sī góa ê pó-chō, tōe sī góa ê kha-tiam. Lín beh kā góa khí sím-mi̍h khoán chhù? Tó-ūi sī góa an-hioh ê só͘-chāi?
Che it-chhè kiám m̄-sī góa chhin-chhiú chhòng-chō--ê?
“Lín chiah-ni̍h kò͘-chip! Lín ê sim ngī, hī-khang m̄ thiaⁿ! Lín kap lín ê chó͘-sian sio-siâng, put-sî hoán-khòng Sèng Sîn!

Tó chi̍t ê sian-ti bô siū-tio̍h lín ê chó͘-sian pek-hāi? Ū-giân hit-ê Kong-gī ê Po̍k-jîn lâi-lîm hiah-ê lâng lóng hō͘ lín thâi-sí. Taⁿ lín chiâⁿ-chòe chhut-bōe koh thâi-sí hit-ūi Po̍k-jîn ê lâng.
Lín sī tùi thiⁿ-sài niá-siū Siōng-tè Lu̍t-hoat ê lâng, kèng-jiân bô chun-siú!”
In thiaⁿ-tio̍h Sū-thê-hoán chiah-ê ōe hui-siông siū-khì, tùi i kā-gê-chhiat-chhí.
M̄-kú Sū-thê-hoán hō͘ Sèng Sîn chhiong-móa, gia̍h-thâu khòaⁿ thiⁿ, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè ê êng-kng, mā khòaⁿ-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ khiā tī Siōng-tè ê chiàⁿ-pêng.
I kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ! Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ thiⁿ khui, Jîn-chú khiā tī Siōng-tè ê chiàⁿ-pêng!”
Chèng-lâng ng hī-khang, tōa-siaⁿ hoah, chòe-hé chhi̍h óa--khì,
kā i thoa chhut-khì siâⁿ-gōa, ēng chio̍h-thâu kā i tìm. Hiah-ê chèng-jîn chiong ka-kī ê gōa-saⁿ kau hō͘ chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Sò-lô ê siàu-liân-lâng kò͘.
In ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm Sū-thê-hoán ê sî, Sū-thê-hoán kiû-kiò kóng, “Chú Iâ-so͘, kiû lí chiap-la̍p góa ê lêng-hûn!”
I koh kūi--lo̍h-khì, tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Chú ah, m̄-thang chiong chit-ê chōe kui hō͘ in!” I kóng-liáu chiū sí.

Thâi-sí Sū-thê-hoán ê tāi-chì Sò-lô mā chàn-sêng. Kâng hit-ji̍t, Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê kàu-hōe siū-tio̍h chin tōa ê pek-hāi. Sù-tô͘ í-gōa só͘-ū ê sìn-tô͘ lóng hun-sòaⁿ khì Iû-thài kap Sat-má-lī-a ê ta̍k só͘-chāi.
M̄-kú ū chi̍t-kóa khiân-sêng ê lâng kā Sū-thê-hoán bâi-chòng, ūi-tio̍h i tōa pi-siong.
Hit-sî Sò-lô hē-chhiú chân-hāi kàu-hōe, chi̍t-hō͘ chi̍t-hō͘ ji̍p--khì, bô-lūn lâm lú lóng thoa--chhut-lâi, kā in sàng-khì koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ.
Hiah-ê hun-sòaⁿ ê sìn-tô͘ khì ta̍k só͘-chāi thoân-tō.
Hui-le̍k khì Sat-má-lī-a ê chi̍t ê siâⁿ, tùi hia ê lâng soan-iông Ki-tok.
Kûn-chiòng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Hui-le̍k só͘ kóng ê ōe, koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h i só͘ kiâⁿ ê sîn-jiah, chiū choan-sim thiaⁿ i só͘ kóng ê ōe.
Ū chin chōe lâng hō͘ siâ-sîn hū-sin, hiah-ê siâ-sîn tōa-siaⁿ hoah, tùi in só͘ hū-sin ê lâng chhut--khì. Ū chin chōe poàn-sin-put-sūi--ê kap kha-pái--ê mā tit-tio̍h i-hó.
Hit-ê siâⁿ ê lâng lóng tōa hoaⁿ-hí.
Ū chi̍t ê lâng miâ kiò-chòe Se-bûn, í-chêng bat tī hit-ê siâⁿ kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t, ka-kī chū-khoa choh-tōa, hō͘ Sat-má-lī-a ê lâng tio̍h-kiaⁿ kî-koài.
Siâⁿ-lāi ê lâng tōa-tōa-sòe-sòe lóng choan-sim thiaⁿ-thàn i, kóng, “Chit-ê lâng ū Siōng-tè ê koân-lêng, sī lâng teh kóng ê ‘Tāi-lêng-chiá’.”
In lóng choan-sim thiaⁿ-thàn i, in-ūi i chin kú ū ēng siâ-su̍t hō͘ in tio̍h-kiaⁿ kî-koài.
Put-kò in sìn Hui-le̍k só͘ thoân Siōng-tè-kok ê hok-im kap Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ liáu-āu, lâm--ê lú--ê lóng chiap-siū sóe-lé.

Liân Se-bûn pún-sin mā sìn; i siū sóe-lé í-āu chiū kā Hui-le̍k tè-tiâu-tiâu. I khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Hui-le̍k só͘ kiâⁿ ê sîn-jiah kap só͘ chòe tōa koân-lêng ê kî-sū, kám-kak chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ.
Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sù-tô͘ thiaⁿ-tio̍h Sat-má-lī-a -lâng í-keng chiap-siū Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit, chiū phài Pí-tek kap Iok-hān khì in hia.
In lo̍h--khì, chiū ūi-tio̍h hiah-ê sìn-tô͘ kî-tó, hō͘ in thang tit-tio̍h Sèng Sîn,
in-ūi hiah-ê sìn-tô͘ tú siū sóe-lé, kui tī Chú Iâ-so͘ ê miâ; Sèng Sîn iáu-bē kàng-lo̍h tī in tiong-kan jīm-hô-lâng.
Pí-tek kap Iok-hān kā in hōaⁿ-chhiú, in chiū tit-tio̍h Sèng Sîn.
Se-bûn khòaⁿ-tio̍h sù-tô͘ hōaⁿ-chhiú ê lâng lóng tit-tio̍h Sèng Sîn, chiū the̍h chîⁿ hō͘ in,
kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lín mā chiong chit-ê koân-lêng hō͘ góa, hō͘ góa só͘ hōaⁿ-chhiú ê lâng lóng ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h Sèng Sîn.”
Pí-tek tùi i kóng, “Lí ê chîⁿ kap lí chòe-hé khì sí! Lí káⁿ siūⁿ-beh ēng chîⁿ bóe Siōng-tè ê un-sù!
Che bô lí ê hūn, kap lí bô koan-hē; in-ūi tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng lí chûn-sim put-liông.
Só͘-í, tio̍h hóe-kái tû-khì chit-ê siâ-liām, kî-kiû Chú hō͘ lí sim-lāi ê ì-liām ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí sim-lāi chhiong-móa tham-sim oàn-tò͘, siū-tio̍h chōe-ok khu-sok.”
Se-bûn ìn kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí ūi-tio̍h góa tùi Chú kî-kiû, hō͘ lí só͘ kóng ê tāi-chì bōe lîm-kàu góa.”
Pí-tek kap Iok-hān chòe kiàn-chèng, soan-káng Chú ê sìn-sit, jiân-āu tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, iân-lō͘ tī Sat-má-lī-a ê chin chōe chng-siā thoân hok-im.
Chú ê thiⁿ-sài kā Hui-le̍k kóng, “Khí--lâi, ǹg lâm-pêng khì, kiâⁿ tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lo̍h-khì Ka-sat hit-tiâu lō͘.” Hit-tiâu lō͘ í-keng hong-hòe.

Hui-le̍k khí--lâi, chiū khì. I tī lō͘-tiong tú-tio̍h chi̍t ê I-soh-phit-a ê thài-kàm; chit-ê lâng sī I-soh-phit-a lú-ông Kam-tāi-ki ê châi-bū tāi-sîn. I chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khì kèng-pài Siōng-tè, tú-beh tò--khì, chē tī chhia-téng teh tha̍k sian-ti Í-sài-a ê chheh.
Sèng Sîn kā Hui-le̍k kóng, “Lí chìn-chêng óa-khì tè hit-tâi chhia.”
Hui-le̍k cháu óa--khì, thiaⁿ-tio̍h i teh tha̍k sian-ti Í-sài-a ê chheh, chiū mn̄g, “Lí teh tha̍k--ê, ū liáu-kái--bô?”
I ìn kóng, “Bô lâng kā góa kóe-seh, góa ná ōe liáu-kái?” Thài-kàm chiū chhiáⁿ Hui-le̍k chiūⁿ-chhia, kap i chòe-hé chē.
I teh tha̍k ê hit-tōaⁿ keng-bûn sī án-ni: I chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ hō͘ lâng khan-khì thâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-á tī chián-mn̂g ê lâng bīn-chêng bô chhut-siaⁿ, lóng bô khui-chhùi.
I jím-siū lêng-jio̍k ê sî bô lâng thòe I chú-chhî kong-tō. Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng soat-bêng I ê sè-hē? In-ūi I ê sìⁿ-miā tùi tōe-chiūⁿ siau-bia̍t.
Thài-kàm mn̄g Hui-le̍k, “Chhiáⁿ mn̄g, sian-ti chit-ê ōe sī chí sím-mi̍h-lâng kóng--ê? Sī chí i ka-kī á-sī chí pa̍t-lâng?”
Hui-le̍k chiū tùi hit-tōaⁿ keng-bûn khai-sí tùi i thoân Iâ-so͘ ê hok-im.
In tùi hit-tiâu lō͘ lo̍h--khì, kàu ū chúi ê só͘-chāi, thài-kàm kóng, “Chia ū chúi, góa kiám bōe-ēng-tit tī chia niá-siū sóe-lé?”
Thài-kàm kiò chhia thêng--teh, Hui-le̍k kap thài-kàm nn̄g ê chòe-hé lo̍h-khì chúi--ni̍h, Hui-le̍k chiū kā i sóe-lé.
In tùi chúi--ni̍h khí--lâi ê sî, Chú ê Sîn kā Hui-le̍k chiap--khì; thài-kàm bô koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h i, m̄-kú iáu hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí kè-sio̍k i ê lú-thêng.
Āu-lâi ū lâng tī A-só-to͘ khòaⁿ-tio̍h Hui-le̍k; i iân-lō͘ tī ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-chhī thoân hok-im it-ti̍t kàu Khái-sat-lī-a.
Sò-lô kè-sio̍k khióng-hat beh sat-hāi Chú ê bûn-tô͘. I khì kìⁿ tōa-chè-si,

iau-kiû tōa-chè-si siá kong-hâm hō͘ Tāi-má-sū-kek ta̍k-ê hōe-tn̂g, chún i so͘-cha, nā ū chhē-tio̍h sìn-hōng chit-ê Tō-lō͘ ê lâng, bô-lūn lâm lú, thang kā in pa̍k--khí-lâi, ah-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
I chiū khì, teh-beh kàu Tāi-má-sū-kek ê sî, hut-jiân ū kng tùi thiⁿ lâi, sì-bīn kā i chiò.
I chiū poa̍h-lo̍h thô͘-kha, thiaⁿ-kìⁿ ū siaⁿ tùi i kóng, “ Sò-lô, Sò-lô, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ teh pek-hāi góa?”
I mn̄g kóng, “Chú ah, lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?” Hit-ê siaⁿ ìn kóng, “Góa chiū-sī lí teh pek-hāi ê Iâ-so͘.
Khí--lâi, ji̍p-khì siâⁿ-lāi, lí tio̍h chòe ê sū, ū lâng ōe kā lí kóng.”
Tâng-kiâⁿ ê lâng chiū khiā--teh, gāng-gāng bōe kóng-ōe; in ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h siaⁿ, m̄-kú bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h lâng.
Sò-lô tùi thô͘-kha peh--khí-lâi, ba̍k-chiu thí-khui, soah sím-mi̍h lóng khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h. In chiū khan i ê chhiú, chhōa i ji̍p-khì Tāi-má-sū-kek.
I saⁿ ji̍t kú bô khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, mā bô chia̍h, bô lim.
Tī Tāi-má-sū-kek ū chi̍t ê bûn-tô͘ miâ kiò-chòe A-ná-nî-a. Tī īⁿ-siōng tiong Chú kā i kiò, “ A-ná-nî-a!” I ìn kóng, “Chú ah, góa tī chia.”
Chú kóng, “Khí--lâi, khì hit-tiâu Ti̍t-koe, tī Iû-tāi ê chhù chhē chi̍t ê Tāi-sò͘ -lâng kiò-chòe Sò-lô; i tú-teh kî-tó.
I tī īⁿ-siōng tiong ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê lâng kiò-chòe A-ná-nî-a ji̍p-lâi kā i hōaⁿ-chhiú, hō͘ i ōe-tàng koh khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.”
A-ná-nî-a ìn kóng, “Chú ah, góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h chin chōe lâng kóng-khí chit-ê lâng tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tùi lí ê sìn-tô͘ chòe chin chōe ok-to̍k ê tāi-chì.
I ū chè-si-tiúⁿ ê siū-koân thang lia̍h só͘-ū kiû-kiò lí ê miâ ê lâng, hiān-chāi lâi tī chia.”
Chú tùi i kóng, “Lí khì, i sī góa kéng-soán ê khì-khū, beh tùi Gōa-pang-lâng, kun-ông, kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng soan-iông góa ê miâ.
Góa mā beh hō͘ i chai, ūi-tio̍h góa ê miâ i it-tēng tio̍h siū chin chōe khó͘-lān.”

A-ná-nî-a chiū khì, ji̍p-khì hit-keng chhù, kā Sò-lô hōaⁿ-chhiú, kóng, “ Sò-lô hiaⁿ-tī, lí lâi ê lō͘-tiong tùi lí hián-hiān ê Chú Iâ-so͘, chhe góa lâi beh hō͘ lí ōe-tàng koh khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, koh siū Sèng Sîn chhiong-móa.”
Sûi-sî ū chhin-chhiūⁿ hî-lân ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ tùi Sò-lô ê ba̍k-chiu lak--lo̍h-lâi, i chiū koh ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. I khí--lâi, niá-siū sóe-lé;
chia̍h pá liáu-āu, thé-le̍k chiū ho̍k-goân. Sò-lô kap tī Tāi-má-sū-kek ê bûn-tô͘ chòe-hé tòa kúi-nā ji̍t.
I sûi-sî tī ta̍k-ê hōe-tn̂g soan-káng Iâ-so͘, kóng, “I sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ.”

Thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng lóng tio̍h-kiaⁿ, kóng, “Tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siau-bia̍t kiû-kiò chit-ê miâ--ê, kiám m̄-sī chit-ê lâng? I lâi chia kiám m̄-sī beh lia̍h sìn-tô͘, kā in ah-khì kau hō͘ chè-si-tiúⁿ?”
Sò-lô ná kóng ná ū la̍t, chèng-bêng Iâ-so͘ sī Ki-tok, hō͘ tòa tī Tāi-má-sū-kek ê Iû-thài -lâng bô thang piān-pok.
Chin chōe ji̍t āu, Iû-thài -lâng tàu-tīn kè-bô͘ beh thâi Sò-lô,
in ê kè-bô͘ ū hō͘ Sò-lô thiaⁿ--tio̍h. In mî-ji̍t tī siâⁿ-mn̂g tng-tán beh kā i thâi.
M̄-kú i ê bûn-tô͘ tī àm-sî kā i chhōa--chhut-lâi, ēng chi̍t ê nâ-á tùi siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ téng kā i lūi--lo̍h-khì.
Sò-lô kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, siūⁿ-beh kap bûn-tô͘ kau-pôe, in lóng kiaⁿ i, in-ūi bô siong-sìn i sī bûn-tô͘.

Put-kò Pa-ná-pa chiap-la̍p i, chhōa i khì kìⁿ sù-tô͘, kā in soat-bêng Sò-lô tī lō͘-tiong khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Chú ê keng-kè, kap Chú tùi i kóng-ōe, í-ki̍p i tī Tāi-má-sū-kek jōa-á-ni̍h ióng-kám hōng Iâ-so͘ ê miâ thoân-tō ê tāi-chì.
Sò-lô tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kap sù-tô͘ ū chhut-ji̍p lâi-óng, hōng Chú ê miâ hó-táⁿ thoân-tō.
I mā ū kap kóng Hi-la̍h-gú ê Iû-thài -lâng kóng-ōe piān-lūn, in iáu-kú put-sî kè-bô͘ beh kā i thâi.
Sìn-tô͘ chai-iáⁿ chit-ê tāi-chì, chiū chhōa i lo̍h-khì Khái-sat-lī-a, tùi hia sàng i khì Tāi-sò͘.

Hit-sî, Iû-thài, Ka-lī-lī, kap Sat-má-lī-a ta̍k só͘-chāi ê kàu-hōe lóng ū pêng-an, ná kian-kò͘ hoat-tián, só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe kèng-ùi Chú, tit-tio̍h Sèng Sîn ê kó͘-lē, jîn-sò͘ it-ti̍t ke-thiⁿ.
Pí-tek khì ta̍k só͘-chāi hóng-būn, mā ū hóng-būn tiàm tī Lū-tāi ê sìn-tô͘.
I tī hia tú-tio̍h chi̍t ê lâng miâ kiò-chòe Í-nî-ngá; chit-ê lâng poàn-sin-put-sūi, í-keng tó-chhn̂g poeh nî kú.
Pí-tek tùi i kóng, “ Í-nî-ngá, Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok kā lí i-hó lah. Khí--lâi, chéng-lí ka-kī ê bîn-chhn̂g.” Í-nî-ngá sûi-sî khí--lâi.
Só͘-ū tòa tī Lū-tāi kap Sa-lûn ê lâng lóng ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū sìn lâi kui Chú.
Tī Iok-phà ū chi̍t ê lú sìn-tô͘, miâ kiò-chòe Tāi-pí-tāi, Hi-la̍h-gú sī To-ka, i ū chòe chin chōe hó-sū, chín-chè sàn-chhiah-lâng.
I phòa-pīⁿ sí--khì, lâng sóe i ê si-thé liáu-āu, kā i hē tī lâu-téng ê pâng-keng.
In-ūi Lū-tāi lī Iok-phà bô hn̄g, bûn-tô͘ thiaⁿ-tio̍h Pí-tek tī hia, chiū chhe nn̄g ê lâng khì hia, kiû i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ lí kóaⁿ-kín lâi goán hia.”

Pí-tek chiū khí--lâi, kap in chòe-hé khì. I chi̍t-ē kàu-ūi, ū lâng chhōa i khì lâu-téng ê pâng-keng. Só͘-ū ê kóaⁿ-hū lóng ûi tī Pí-tek ê sin-piⁿ thî-khàu, the̍h To-ka siⁿ-chêng chòe ê lāi-saⁿ gōa-saⁿ hō͘ i khòaⁿ.

Pí-tek kiò tāi-ke lóng chhut--khì, chiū kūi lo̍h-khì kî-tó, jiân-āu oa̍t kè-khì tùi si-thé kóng, “ Tāi-pí-tāi, khí--lâi!” To-ka ba̍k-chiu thí-khui, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pí-tek chiū khí-lâi chē.
Pí-tek chhun-chhiú kā i hû--khí-lâi, āu-lâi kiò hiah-ê sìn-tô͘ kap kóaⁿ-hū lóng ji̍p--lâi, hō͘ koh oa̍h--khí-lâi ê To-ka kap in kìⁿ-bīn.
Chit-ê siau-sit thoân-piàn Iok-phà, chiū ū chin chōe lâng lâi sìn Chú.
Pí-tek tī Iok-phà chi̍t ê hoan-phê sai-hū Se-bûn ê chhù tòa chin chōe ji̍t.
Tī Khái-sat-lī-a ū chi̍t ê lâng, miâ kiò-chòe Ko-nî-liû, sī Lô-má kun-tūi kiò-chòe “ Ì-tāi-lī -iâⁿ” ê kun-koaⁿ.
I sī khiân-sêng ê lâng, kap choân-ke lóng kèng-ùi Siōng-tè; i khóng-khài chín-chè sàn-chhiah ê Iû-thài -lâng, koh put-sî tùi Siōng-tè kî-tó.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, chha-put-to ē-po͘ saⁿ tiám, i tī īⁿ-siōng tiong bêng-bêng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè ê thiⁿ-sài ji̍p--lâi, kā i kiò, “ Ko-nî-liû!”
I kā thiⁿ-sài ti̍t-ti̍t siòng, hui-siông kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kóng, “Chú ah, sím-mi̍h tāi-chì?” Thiⁿ-sài kóng, “Lí ê kî-tó kap chín-chè í-keng lóng tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p.
Taⁿ tio̍h chhe lâng khì Iok-phà, chhiáⁿ hit-ê chheng-chòe Pí-tek ê Se-bûn lâi.
I choh lâng-kheh tòa tī hoan-phê sai-hū Se-bûn ê chhù; i ê chhù tī hái-piⁿ.”
Tùi i kóng-ōe ê thiⁿ-sài lī-khui liáu-āu, Ko-nî-liû kiò nn̄g ê po̍k-jîn kap chi̍t ê pêng-siông teh sū-hāu i kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê peng lâi,
chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì lóng kā in kóng, chiū chhe in khì Iok-phà.
Keh-ji̍t, chha-put-to tiong-tàu, chit saⁿ ê lâng kiâⁿ beh kàu Iok-phà ê sî, Pí-tek peh-khì chhù-téng kî-tó.
I pak-tó͘ iau, siūⁿ-beh chia̍h. Lâng teh ūi i chún-pī chia̍h-mi̍h ê sî, i ji̍p-sîn,
khòaⁿ-kìⁿ thiⁿ khui, ū chi̍t ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t tè tōa tè pò͘, sì-kak-thâu tiàu--teh, lūi lo̍h-lâi thô͘-kha,
lāi-bīn ū tōe-chiūⁿ ta̍k-chióng ê cháu-siù, thâng-thōa, kap khong-tiong ê chiáu-lūi.
Ū siaⁿ tùi i kóng, “ Pí-tek, khí--lâi, thâi lâi chia̍h.”
M̄-kú Pí-tek kóng, “Chú ah, choa̍t-tùi bōe-ēng--tit! Góa m̄-bat chia̍h ù-òe bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h.”
Hit-ê siaⁿ tē-jī piàn tùi i kóng, “Siōng-tè hō͘ i chheng-khì--ê, lí m̄-thang khòaⁿ-chòe ù-òe.”
Chit-ê tāi-chì kè-sio̍k ū saⁿ piàn, hit-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ sûi-sî koh siu tò-khì thiⁿ-téng.
Pí-tek kám-kak kî-koài, tú-teh siūⁿ chit-ê īⁿ-siōng sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù ê sî, Ko-nî-liû chhe--lâi ê lâng í-keng chhē-tio̍h Se-bûn ê chhù, lâi khiā tī mn̂g-kháu,
tōa-siaⁿ mn̄g, “Ū chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Pí-tek ê Se-bûn tòa tī chia--bô?”
Pí-tek iáu-teh siūⁿ chit-ê īⁿ-siōng sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù ê sî, Sèng Sîn kā i kóng, “Ū saⁿ ê lâng lâi beh chhē lí!
Lí khí--lâi, lo̍h--khì, kap in chòe-hé khì; m̄-thang tiû-tû, in-ūi in sī góa chhe--lâi-ê.”
Pí-tek chiū lo̍h-khì kìⁿ hiah-ê lâng, kā in kóng, “Góa chiū-sī lín teh chhē ê lâng. Lín lâi ū sím-mi̍h kùi-sū?”

In ìn kóng, “Goán ê tiúⁿ-koaⁿ Ko-nî-liû chhe goán lâi, i sī chèng-ti̍t koh kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng, siū choân-thé Iû-thài -lâng ê chun-kèng. I tit-tio̍h sèng thiⁿ-sài ê chí-sī, lâi chhiáⁿ lí khì in tau beh niá-siū lí ê kà-sī.”
Pí-tek chiū chhiáⁿ in ji̍p--khì, lâu in tòa hia kè-mî. Keh-ji̍t, Pí-tek khí-lâi kap in chòe-hé khì; mā ū kúi-nā ê Iok-phà ê sìn-tô͘ chòe-hé khì.
Koh keh-ji̍t, in kàu Khái-sat-lī-a, Ko-nî-liû í-keng iau-chhiáⁿ i ê chhin-lâng kap pêng-iú teh thèng-hāu.
Pí-tek ji̍p--khì, Ko-nî-liû chiū chìn-chêng gêng-chiap, phak tī i ê kha-chêng kā i pài.
Pí-tek kā i khan--khí-lâi, kóng, “Khí--lâi, góa ka-kī mā-sī lâng.”
Pí-tek kap i ná kiâⁿ ná kóng-ōe ji̍p-khì lāi-bīn, khòaⁿ-tio̍h chin chōe lâng í-keng chū-chi̍p tī hia,

chiū tùi in kóng, “Lín chai-iáⁿ, chiàu goán ê kui-tēng, Iû-thài -lâng bōe-ēng-tit kap Gōa-pang-lâng kau-pôe lâi-óng, m̄-kú Siōng-tè í-keng chí-sī góa, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h cho̍k-kûn ê lâng to m̄-thang khòaⁿ i chòe bô chheng-khì á-sī ù-òe.
Só͘-í lín chhiáⁿ góa lâi, góa bô the-sî chiū lâi. Taⁿ chhiáⁿ mn̄g, lín ūi-tio̍h sím-mi̍h tāi-chì chhiáⁿ góa lâi?”

Ko-nî-liû kóng, “Sì ji̍t chêng, tú chit-ê sî-chūn, chha-put-to ē-po͘ saⁿ tiám, góa tī chhù-lāi teh kî-tó ê sî, hut-jiân ū chi̍t ê lâng chhēng kng-iàⁿ-iàⁿ ê saⁿ khiā tī góa ê bīn-chêng,
kóng, ‘ Ko-nî-liû! Siōng-tè í-keng ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ lí ê kî-tó, mā ōe-kì-tit lí só͘ chòe chín-chè lâng ê sū.
Lí tio̍h chhe lâng khì Iok-phà, chhiáⁿ kiò-chòe Pí-tek ê Se-bûn lâi; i choh lâng-kheh tòa tī hái-piⁿ hoan-phê sai-hū Se-bûn in tau.’

Góa chiū sûi-sî chhe lâng khì chhiáⁿ lí lâi; taⁿ lí lâi lah, si̍t-chāi chin hó. Hiān-chāi goán lóng chū-chi̍p tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng, beh thiaⁿ Chú bēng-lēng lí só͘ beh kóng lóng-chóng ê ōe.”
Pí-tek khui-chhùi kóng, “Taⁿ góa khak-si̍t chai, Siōng-tè bô phian-thāi lâng.
Bô-lūn tó chi̍t ê bîn-cho̍k, kèng-ùi I, hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t ê lâng, I lóng hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p.

Lín chai: Í-chêng Siōng-tè ū thong-kè bān-bîn ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thoân hô-pêng ê hok-im; Iok-hān thoân sóe-lé ê tō-lí í-āu, chit-ê hok-im ū tùi Ka-lī-lī khai-sí thoân-piàn Iû-thài choân-tōe;

chiū-sī, Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘, Siōng-tè ū án-chóaⁿ ēng Sèng Sîn kap tōa lêng-le̍k kā I boah-iû jīm-bēng, ū án-chóaⁿ hō͘ I khì ta̍k só͘-chāi chòe hó-sū, i-hó só͘-ū siū Mô͘-kúi ap-chè ê lâng, in-ūi Siōng-tè kap I tông-chāi.
Goán chiū-sī I tī Iû-thài ta̍k só͘-chāi kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘ chòe ê sū ê kiàn-chèng-jîn. In kā I tèng-sí tī si̍p-jī-kè téng,
tē-saⁿ ji̍t Siōng-tè hō͘ I koh-oa̍h, koh hō͘ I hián-hiān,

m̄-sī tùi só͘-ū ê lâng, chí-ū tùi goán chiah-ê siū Siōng-tè kéng-soán lâi chòe kiàn-chèng ê lâng hián-hiān; goán bat tī I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h liáu-āu kap I chòe-hé lim-chia̍h.
I bēng-lēng goán thoân hok-im hō͘ só͘-ū ê lâng, chèng-si̍t I sī Siōng-tè só͘ jīm-bēng choh oa̍h-lâng kap sí-lâng ê sím-phòaⁿ-chiá.
Só͘-ū ê sian-ti lóng ūi-tio̍h I chòe kiàn-chèng kóng, sìn I ê lâng lóng ōe in-ūi I ê miâ tit-tio̍h sià-chōe.”
Pí-tek iáu-teh kóng-ōe ê sî, Sèng Sîn kàng-lîm tī só͘-ū thiaⁿ tō-lí ê lâng.
Kap Pí-tek tùi Iok-phà chòe-hé lâi hiah-ê siū kat-lé ê sìn-tô͘ lóng tōa tio̍h-kiaⁿ, in-ūi Sèng Sîn ê un-sù mā ū piàⁿ-lo̍h tī Gōa-pang-lâng ê sin-chiūⁿ;
in-ūi in ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h hiah-ê lâng kóng lêng-gú koh chheng-chàn Siōng-tè ê úi-tāi. Jiân-āu Pí-tek kóng,
“Chiah-ê lâng kap lán kâng-khoán í-keng ū niá-siū Sèng Sîn, kiám ū lâng ōe-tàng kìm-chí in niá-siū chúi ê sóe-lé?”
I chiū bēng-lēng in hōng Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ niá-siū sóe-lé. Āu-lâi, in chhiáⁿ Pí-tek kap in koh tòa kúi-nā ji̍t.
Sù-tô͘ kap tòa tī Iû-thài ê sìn-tô͘ lóng ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Gōa-pang-lâng mā chiap-siū Siōng-tè ê tō.
Pí-tek chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sî, hiah-ê siū kat-lé ê Iû-thài -lâng sìn-tô͘ kā i phoe-phêng, kóng,
“Lí kèng-jiân ji̍p-khì bô siū kat-lé ê lâng ê chhù kap in chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g!”
Pí-tek chiū chiong só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì tùi thâu chi̍t-hāng chi̍t-hāng kā in soat-bêng:

“Góa tī Iok-phà -siâⁿ teh kî-tó ê sî ū ji̍p-sîn khòaⁿ-kìⁿ īⁿ-siōng, ū chi̍t ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t tè tōa tè pò͘, sì-kak-thâu tiàu--teh, tùi thiⁿ-téng lūi lo̍h-lâi kàu góa bīn-chêng.
Góa siông-sè khòaⁿ, lāi-bīn ū tōe-chiūⁿ ê cheng-siⁿ, iá-siù, thâng-thōa, kap khong-tiong ê chiáu-lūi.
Góa koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h ū siaⁿ kā góa kóng, ‘ Pí-tek, khí--lâi, thâi lâi chia̍h!’
Góa kóng, ‘Chú ah, choa̍t-tùi bōe-ēng--tit! Góa m̄-bat chia̍h ù-òe bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h.’
Hit-ê siaⁿ tē-jī piàn tùi thiⁿ-téng ìn góa kóng, ‘Siōng-tè hō͘ i chheng-khì--ê, lí m̄-thang khòaⁿ-chòe ù-òe.’
Chit-ê tāi-chì kè-sio̍k ū saⁿ piàn, hiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chiū lóng koh siu tò-tńg-khì thiⁿ-téng.
Tú hit-sî, tùi Khái-sat-lī-a phài-lâi chhē góa hit saⁿ ê lâng lâi kàu goán teh tòa hit-keng chhù.
Sèng Sîn kiò góa tio̍h kap in khì, m̄-thang tiû-tû. Hit la̍k ê sìn-tô͘ mā kap góa chòe-hé khì Khái-sat-lī-a. Goán chiū lóng ji̍p-khì Ko-nî-liû ê chhù.
Ko-nî-liû kā goán kóng i ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài khiā tī i ê chhù-lāi, tùi i kóng, ‘Tio̍h chhe lâng khì Iok-phà chhiáⁿ hit-ê kiò-chòe Pí-tek ê Se-bûn lâi.
I ū ōe beh kā lí kóng, thang hō͘ lí kap lí ê choân-ke lóng tit-tio̍h kiù.’
Góa khai-sí kóng-ōe ê sî, Sèng Sîn kàng-lîm tī in sin-chiūⁿ, kap tong-chho͘ kàng-lîm tī lán sin-chiūⁿ kâng-khoán.
Góa chiū siūⁿ-khí Chú só͘ kóng ê ōe: Iok-hān ēng chúi kā lín sóe-lé, m̄-kú lín ōe niá-siū Sèng Sîn ê sóe-lé.

Kì-jiân Siōng-tè ū chiong lán sìn Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê sî só͘ niá-siū siâng-khoán ê un-sù sù hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng, góa sǹg siáⁿ-lâng, ná ōe-tàng chó͘-tòng Siōng-tè ê só͘-chòe?”
In thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe chiū tiām--khì, kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè, kóng, “Siōng-tè mā ū hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng hóe-kái lâi tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā.”
In-ūi Sū-thê-hoán ê tāi-chì siū pek-hāi sì-sòaⁿ ê sìn-tô͘, ū-ê kàu Hui-nî-ki, Sài-phó͘-lō͘-su, kap An-thê-o, in bô tùi pa̍t-lâng, chí-ū tùi Iû-thài -lâng thoân-tō.
M̄-kú kî-tiong ū chi̍t-kóa Sài-phó͘-lō͘-su kap Kó͘-lī-nāi ê sìn-tô͘ kàu An-thê-o, mā ǹg Hi-la̍h -lâng thoân, tùi in kóng-khí Chú Iâ-so͘ ê hok-im.
Chú ê khùi-la̍t kap in tông-chāi, sìn lâi kui Chú ê lâng-gia̍h chin chōe.
Chit-ê siau-sit thoân kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê kàu-hōe, in chiū phài Pa-ná-pa khì An-thê-o.
I chi̍t-ē kàu-ūi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè ū sù in un-hūi, chiū hoaⁿ-hí, khoàn-bián in tāi-ke tio̍h choân-sim chi̍t-ì sìn-khò Chú.
Pa-ná-pa sī hó-lâng, hō͘ Sèng Sîn chhiong-móa, koh ū sìn-sim. Hit-sî ū chin chōe lâng sìn Chú.
Āu-lâi, Pa-ná-pa khì Tāi-sò͘ chhē Sò-lô,

chhē--tio̍h chiū chhōa i khì An-thê-o. Chiok-chiok chi̍t nî kú, in nn̄g ê kap kàu-hōe ê lâng chū-hōe, kà-sī chin chōe lâng. Bûn-tô͘ kiò-chòe “Ki-tok-tô͘” sī tùi An-thê-o khai-sí.
Hit-sî, ū kúi-nā ê sian-ti tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lo̍h-khì An-thê-o.

Kî-tiong chi̍t ê miâ kiò-chòe A-ka-pò͘; i tit-tio̍h Sèng Sîn ê chí-sī, khiā khí-lâi ū-giân kóng choân sè-kài teh-beh ū tōa ki-hng. Chit-ê tāi-chì tī Khek-lô-tē thóng-tī ê nî-kan kó-jiân hoat-seng.
Bûn-tô͘ chiū koat-tēng ta̍k-ê lâng chiàu ka-kī ê lêng-le̍k koan-hiàn, thang sàng-khì chín-chè tòa tī Iû-thài ê sìn-tô͘.
In chiū chiàu án-ni chòe, chiong koan-hiàn thok Pa-ná-pa kap Sò-lô kau hō͘ hia ê tiúⁿ-ló.
Chha-put-to hit-ê sî, Hi-lu̍t -ông hē-chhiú pek-hāi kàu-hōe ê chi̍t-kóa lâng,
ēng to thâi-sí Iok-hān ê hiaⁿ-ko Ngá-kok.
I khòaⁿ-chhut chit-ê tāi-chì ū hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng hoaⁿ-hí, chiū sòa lo̍h-khì lia̍h Pí-tek. Chit-ê tāi-chì tī Tû-kàⁿ-choeh ê kî-kan hoat-seng.

I lia̍h Pí-tek, kā i koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ, kau hō͘ sì pan ê kéng-ōe kò͘-siú, ta̍k-pan ū sì ê peng. Hi-lu̍t àn-sǹg beh tī Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh āu kā i ah chhut-lâi tī chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng sím-phòaⁿ.
Pí-tek chiū án-ni hō͘ lâng koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ--ni̍h; kàu-hōe ūi-tio̍h i tùi Siōng-tè pek-chhiat kî-tó.

Hi-lu̍t beh ah Pí-tek chhut-lâi sím-phòaⁿ ê chêng chi̍t àm, Pí-tek khùn tī nn̄g ê kéng-ōe ê tiong-kan, hō͘ lâng ēng nn̄g tiâu thih-liān liān--teh, koh ū kéng-ōe tī mn̂g-gōa kò͘-siú.

Hut-jiân Chú ê thiⁿ-sài khiā tī hia, ū kng teh chiò kaⁿ-pâng. Thiⁿ-sài tah Pí-tek ê keng-thâu, kā i kiò-chhíⁿ, kóng, “Kín khí--lâi!” Thih-liān chiū tùi i ê chhiú lak--lo̍h-khì.
Thiⁿ-sài tùi i kóng, “Io-tòa hâ--leh, ôe chhēng--leh.” Pí-tek chiū chiàu án-ni chòe. Thiⁿ-sài koh kóng, “Gōa-saⁿ moa--leh, tè góa lâi!”
Pí-tek chiū tè i chhut--khì, m̄ chai-iáⁿ thiⁿ-sài teh chòe ê sī chin--ê, siūⁿ-chòe sī teh khòaⁿ īⁿ-siōng.

In keng-kè kéng-ōe-só͘ tē-it koan kap tē-jī koan, lâi kàu thàng ji̍p-siâⁿ hit-ê thih-mn̂g, mn̂g chū-tōng khui, in chiū chhut--khì, kiâⁿ-kè chi̍t tiâu koe; thiⁿ-sài sûi-sî lī-khui Pí-tek.
Pí-tek chi̍t-ē chhíⁿ, kóng, “Taⁿ góa chin-chiàⁿ chai, Chú chhe I ê thiⁿ-sài lâi kiù góa thoat-lī Hi-lu̍t ê chhiú kap Iû-thài -lâng it-chhè ê kè-bô͘.”
I bêng-pe̍k chit-ê chêng-hêng, chiū khì Iok-hān, mā kiò-chòe Má-khó ê lāu-bú Má-lī-a ê chhù; tī hia ū chin chōe lâng chū-chi̍p teh kî-tó.
Pí-tek phah gōa-mn̂g, ū chi̍t ê lú-pī kiò-chòe Lô-tāi chhut-lâi beh khui-mn̂g.
I jīn-tit Pí-tek ê siaⁿ, hoaⁿ-hí kah bōe-kò͘-tit khui-mn̂g, chiū cháu ji̍p-khì pò-kò kóng Pí-tek khiā tī mn̂g-kháu.
In kóng, “Lí teh khí-kông!” I kian-chhî kóng ū-iáⁿ. In chiū kóng, “Án-ni it-tēng sī i ê thiⁿ-sài.”
Pí-tek it-ti̍t phah-mn̂g. In khui-mn̂g, khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pí-tek, hui-siông tio̍h-kiaⁿ.

Pí-tek pí-chhiú kiò in an-chēng, kā in soat-bêng Chú chhōa i tùi kaⁿ-ga̍k chhut--lâi ê keng-kè. Pí-tek koh hoan-hù in chiong chit-ê siau-sit pò-kò Ngá-kok kap chèng sìn-tô͘, chiū lī-khui khì pa̍t-ê só͘-chāi.
Thiⁿ-kng ê sî, peng-sū m̄ chai Pí-tek khì tó-ūi, chiū loān-chhau-chhau.
Hi-lu̍t kiò lâng khì chhē, m̄-kú chhē bô, chiū sím-mn̄g khàn-siú, hā-lēng kā in chhú-sí. Chit-ê tāi-chì í-āu, Hi-lu̍t lī-khui Iû-thài khì Khái-sat-lī-a, tòa tī hia.

Tng-sî, Hi-lu̍t tùi Thài-ní kap Se-tùn ê jîn-bîn hui-siông siū-khì, in chiū phài tāi-piáu cho͘-thoân khì kìⁿ i. In tāi-seng sòe-ho̍k kiong-têng ê chóng-koán Pek-la-su-to͘, siat-hoat hō͘ in thang khì kìⁿ Hi-lu̍t, tùi i kiû-hô, in-ūi in ê niû-si̍t khò ông koán-hat ê tōe-khu teh kiong-èng.
Tī iok-tēng ê ji̍t-chí, Hi-lu̍t chhēng ông-ho̍k, chē tī chō-ūi, tùi jîn-bîn ián-káng.
Chèng-lâng it-ti̍t hoah kóng, “Che sī sîn-bêng ê siaⁿ, m̄-sī lâng ê siaⁿ!”
Chú ê thiⁿ-sài sûi-sî kā Hi-lu̍t phah-tó, in-ūi i bô kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè; āu-lâi i hō͘ thâng kā, chiū sí--khì.
Siōng-tè ê tō jú thoân-khui jú heng-ōng.
Pa-ná-pa kap Sò-lô oân-sêng in ê jīm-bū, chiū chhōa kiò-chòe Má-khó ê Iok-hān chòe-hé lī-khui Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

An-thê-o ê kàu-hōe ū kúi-nā ê sian-ti kap kàu-su, chiū-sī Pa-ná-pa, hō͘ lâng kiò-chòe “O͘-lâng” ê Se-biān, Kó͘-lī-nāi -lâng Lō͘-kiû, kap hun-hong ê ông Hi-lu̍t chòe-hé tōa-hàn ê Má-liām, í-ki̍p Sò-lô.
In teh kèng-pài Chú, kìm-chia̍h ê sî, Sèng Sîn kā in kóng, “Tio̍h ūi-tio̍h góa chí-phài Pa-ná-pa kap Sò-lô khì chòe góa ho͘-tiàu in chòe ê kang-chok.”
In kìm-chia̍h kî-tó liáu-āu, kā in àn-chhiú, chhe-phài in chhut--khì.
Pa-ná-pa kap Sò-lô í-keng siū Sèng Sîn chhe-phài, chiū lo̍h-khì Se-liû-ki, tùi hia chē-chûn khì Sài-phó͘-lō͘-su.
In kàu Sat-lia̍p-bí, chiū tī Iû-thài -lâng ê hōe-tn̂g soan-káng Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit. Iok-hān Má-khó mā khì hia kā in hia̍p-chō͘.
In kiâⁿ-thàu choân-tó, lâi kàu Phà-hut, tī hia tú-tio̍h chi̍t ê kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t ê lâng, sī Iû-thài -lâng ê ké sian-ti, kiò-chòe Pa-iâ-so͘.
I kap chóng-tok Sū-kiû Pó-lô ū kau-pôe; chit-ê chóng-tok sī hiân-bêng ê lâng, i chhiáⁿ Pa-ná-pa kap Sò-lô lâi, beh tùi in thiaⁿ Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit.
Put-kò hit-ê kiâⁿ hoat-su̍t ê Í-lū-má — Í-lū-má sī i ê Hi-la̍h-miâ — hoán-tùi in nn̄g lâng, siūⁿ-beh chó͘-tòng chóng-tok chiap-siū chit-ê sìn-gióng.
M̄-kú Sò-lô, mā kiò-chòe Pó-lô, hō͘ Sèng Sîn chhiong-móa, ti̍t-ti̍t kā i siòng,
kóng, “Lí chit-ê mô͘-kúi-á-kiáⁿ, lí sī it-chhè kong-gī ê tùi-te̍k, chhiong-móa ta̍k-khoán siâ-ok kap khúi-chà, kò͘-ì oai-khiok Chú ê chèng-ti̍t ê tō-lō͘!

Taⁿ, lí khòaⁿ, Chú beh kā lí hêng-hoa̍t, lí ōe chhiⁿ-mî, chiām-sî bōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ji̍t-kng.” Í-lū-má ê ba̍k-chiu sûi-sî hō͘ o͘-àm tà--teh, khí ian-n̄g; i sì-kòe bong, chhē lâng kā i khan.
Chóng-tok khòaⁿ-tio̍h só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì chiū sìn, tùi Chú ê kà-sī kám-kak chin hi-kî.
Pó-lô kap i ê tâng-phōaⁿ tùi Phà-hut khui-chûn, kàu Pông-hui-lī-a ê Pia̍t-ka; Iok-hān Má-khó tī hia lī-khui in, tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
In tùi Pia̍t-ka kè-sio̍k hêng-thêng lâi kàu Pí-se-tí ê An-thê-o. Tī An-hioh-ji̍t in ji̍p-khì hōe-tn̂g, chē--lo̍h-khì.
Tha̍k Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat kap sian-ti-su liáu-āu, hōe-tn̂g ê chú-koán chhe lâng lâi kā in kóng, “Hiaⁿ-tī, lín nā ū ōe beh khoàn-bián tāi-ke, chhiáⁿ lín kóng.”
Pó-lô chiū khiā--khí-lâi, pí chhiú-sè, kóng: “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê chèng-lâng, chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ!
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê Siōng-tè ū kéng-soán lán ê chó͘-sian, tī in kià-ku Ai-ki̍p ê sî hō͘ in chiâⁿ-chòe tōa ê bîn-cho̍k, ēng I tōa koân-lêng ê chhiú chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p,
koh tī khòng-iá khoan-iông in sì-cha̍p nî kú.
I húi-bia̍t Ka-lâm tōe-khu chhit ê bîn-cho̍k liáu-āu, chiong hit-ê thó͘-tōe hō͘ in chòe sán-gia̍p,
iok sì-pah gō͘-cha̍p nî kú. “Í-āu Siōng-tè ū ūi-tio̍h in siat-li̍p sū-su, it-ti̍t kàu sian-ti Sat-bó-ní ê sî.
Āu-lâi in iau-kiû ài ū chi̍t ê ông, Siōng-tè chiū tùi Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k soán-chhut Ki-sū ê kiáⁿ Sò-lô, hō͘ i choh-ông sì-cha̍p nî kú.

Siōng-tè hòe Sò-lô liáu-āu, jīm-bēng Tāi-pi̍t chòe in ê ông. Koan-hē Tāi-pi̍t, I ū án-ni kóng, ‘Góa chhē-tio̍h Iâ-se ê hō͘-tāi Tāi-pi̍t, i sī ha̍h góa sim-ì ê lâng, ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì chun-thàn góa ê chí-ì.’
Siōng-tè chiàu I ê èng-ún, tùi Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chi̍t ūi Kiù-chú, chiū-sī Iâ-so͘.
Iâ-so͘ chhut--lâi í-chêng, Iok-hān tùi chèng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng thoân-tō, kiò in tio̍h hóe-kái lâi niá-siū sóe-lé.

Iok-hān teh-beh kiat-sok i ê kang-chok ê sî, tùi chèng-lâng kóng, ‘Lín siūⁿ góa sī sím-mi̍h-lâng? Góa m̄-sī lín teh thèng-hāu Hit-ūi, m̄-kú ū chi̍t ūi tè tī góa āu-bīn teh lâi, góa liân kā I tháu ôe-tòa to bōe-kham--tit.’
“Kok-ūi hiaⁿ-tī, A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ-sun kap lín tiong-kan kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê chèng-lâng, chit-ê chín-kiù ê sìn-sit í-keng ū thoân hō͘ lán.

In-ūi tòa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng kap in ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ m̄ bat Iâ-so͘, mā bô bêng-pe̍k ta̍k-ê An-hioh-ji̍t só͘ tha̍k sian-ti ê ōe, chiū kā I tēng-chōe, che tú èng-giām sian-ti ê ū-giân.
Sui-jiân in chhē bōe chhut kā I tēng sí-chōe ê lí-iû, iáu-kú iau-kiû Pí-lia̍p-to kā I chhú sí-hêng.
Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài koan-hē Iâ-so͘ it-chhè ê sū lóng oân-sêng, in chiū chiong I tùi si̍p-jī-kè téng hû--lo̍h-lâi, hē tī bōng--ni̍h.
Chóng-sī Siōng-tè ū hō͘ I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h,

ū chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan, I hián-hiān hō͘ hiah-ê tùi Ka-lī-lī tè I lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. Chiah-ê lâng hiān-chāi tī chèng-lâng tiong teh choh Iâ-so͘ ê kiàn-chèng-jîn.
Goán chiong Siōng-tè èng-ún hō͘ chó͘-sian ê hok-im thoân hō͘ lín,

in-ūi I hō͘ Iâ-so͘ koh-oa̍h, chit-ê èng-ún í-keng ū tùi lán chiah-ê choh kiáⁿ-sun--ê èng-giām, chhin-chhiūⁿ Si-phian tē-jī phiⁿ só͘ kì-chài: Lí sī góa ê Kiáⁿ, góa kin-á-ji̍t siⁿ lí.
Koan-hē hō͘ I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h bô koh hiú-nōa ê sū, Siōng-tè kóng: Góa beh chiong tùi Tāi-pi̍t só͘ èng-ún hit-ê sîn-sèng khó-khò ê un-tián sù hō͘ lín.
Só͘-í, tī Si-phian pa̍t-ê só͘-chāi mā án-ni kóng: Lí bōe hō͘ lí ê Sèng-chiá hiú-nōa.
Tāi-pi̍t chāi-siⁿ ê sî ū chun-thàn Siōng-tè ê kè-ōe. I sí liáu-āu bâi-chòng tī chó͘-sian ê piⁿ--á, hiú-nōa lah.
M̄-kú Siōng-tè hō͘ I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h Hit-ūi bô hiú-nōa.

Só͘-í, kok-ūi hiaⁿ-tī, lín eng-kai chai, sià-chōe ê sìn-sit sī tùi chit-ūi Iâ-so͘ thoân hō͘ lín; lín khò Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat bōe-tàng hō͘ lín thoat-lī chōe, m̄-kú só͘-ū sìn Iâ-so͘ ê lâng lóng ōe-tàng tùi chōe tit-tio̍h tháu-pàng.
Só͘-í lín tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bián hō͘ sian-ti só͘ kóng--ê lîm-kàu lín:
Biáu-sī Siōng-tè ê lâng ah, tio̍h khòaⁿ, tio̍h kiaⁿ, tio̍h bia̍t-bông! In-ūi tī lín ê sî-tāi góa só͘ chòe ê sū, ū lâng kā lín soat-bêng, lín mā m̄ sìn.”
Pó-lô kap Pa-ná-pa tùi hōe-tn̂g chhut--khì ê sî, chèng-lâng iau-chhiáⁿ in tī ē chi̍t ê An-hioh-ji̍t koh lâi kóng chiah-ê tāi-chì hō͘ in thiaⁿ.

Sòaⁿ-hōe āu, chin chōe Iû-thài -lâng kap kái-chong ji̍p Iû-thài -kàu hiah-ê khiân-sêng ê Gōa-pang-lâng chiū tè Pó-lô kap Pa-ná-pa chhut--khì. Nn̄g ê sù-tô͘ kap in tâm-ōe, khoàn-bián in tio̍h khîⁿ-tiâu Siōng-tè ê un-tián.
Koh lo̍h-khì ê An-hioh-ji̍t, choân-siâⁿ ê lâng lóng chū-chi̍p, beh thiaⁿ Chú ê tō.
Iû-thài -lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h lâng hiah chōe, sim-lāi chhiong-móa oàn-tò͘, hoán-pok Pó-lô só͘ kóng ê ōe, koh kā i bú-jio̍k.

M̄-kú Pó-lô kap Pa-ná-pa ióng-kám soan-káng kóng, “Siōng-tè ê tō tio̍h seng thoân hō͘ lín, lín kèng-jiân kū-choa̍t, ka-kī toàn-tēng bô chu-keh tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā, só͘-í goán chiah choán-ǹg Gōa-pang-lâng.
In-ūi Chú bat án-ni bēng-lēng goán kóng: Góa í-keng chí-tēng lí chòe Gōa-pang-lâng ê kng, thang hō͘ lí chiong góa ê chín-kiù tòa kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak.”

Gōa-pang-lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe lóng chin hoaⁿ-hí, kui êng-kng hō͘ Chú ê sìn-sit. Hiah-ê í-keng siū Siōng-tè kéng-soán thang tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā ê lâng lóng chiâⁿ-chòe sìn-tô͘.
Tùi án-ni Chú ê sìn-sit thoân-piàn hit tōe-hng.
M̄-kú Iû-thài -lâng siàn-tōng khiân-sêng chun-kùi ê hū-lú kap siâⁿ-lāi ū tōe-ūi ê jîn-sū lâi pek-hāi Pó-lô kap Pa-ná-pa, chiong in kóaⁿ chhut-kéng.
In nn̄g lâng chiū tī chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng kā kha--ni̍h ê thô͘-hún pōaⁿ hiat-ka̍k piáu-sī khòng-gī, jiân-āu khì Í-ko-liām.
Bûn-tô͘ móa-sim hoaⁿ-hí, koh siū Sèng Sîn chhiong-móa.

Siâng-khoán ê tāi-chì mā hoat-seng tī Í-ko-liām. Pó-lô kap Pa-ná-pa ji̍p-khì Iû-thài -lâng ê hōe-tn̂g káng-tō, kiat-kó ū chin chōe Iû-thài -lâng kap Hi-la̍h -lâng lâi sìn.
M̄-kú hiah-ê m̄-sìn ê Iû-thài -lâng siàn-tōng Gōa-pang-lâng, hō͘ in iàm-ò͘ⁿ sìn-tô͘, tùi in khí hoán-kám.
Put-kò in nn̄g lâng tī hia tòa chin kú, khò Chú ióng-kám soan-káng; Chú sù in lêng-le̍k kiâⁿ sîn-jiah kî-sū, chèng-bêng in só͘ thoân un-tián ê sìn-sit sī chin-si̍t.
Siâⁿ-lāi ê kûn-chiòng soah hun-lia̍t, ū-ê óa Iû-thài -lâng, ū-ê óa sù-tô͘.
Hit-sî, Gōa-pang-lâng kap Iû-thài -lâng í-ki̍p in ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ kè-bô͘ siong-hāi sù-tô͘, beh ēng chio̍h-thâu kā in tìm.
Sù-tô͘ chai chit-ê tāi-chì, chiū tô-pī khì Lū-ko-nî ê Lō͘-su-tek kap Te̍k-pì nn̄g ê siâⁿ í-ki̍p chiu-ûi ê tōe-hng,
tī hia kè-sio̍k thoân hok-im.
Tī Lō͘-su-tek, ū chi̍t ê lâng nńg-kha, put-sî chē--teh, tùi chhut-sì chiū bōe kiâⁿ.
I thiaⁿ Pó-lô káng-tō; Pó-lô chù-ba̍k kā i khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ i ū sìn-sim thang tit-tio̍h i-tī,
chiū tōa-siaⁿ kóng, “Khiā--khí-lâi, khiā ti̍t-ti̍t!” Hit-ê lâng chiū thiàu khí-lâi kiâⁿ.
Kûn-chiòng khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pó-lô ê só͘-chòe, chiū ēng Lū-ko-nî ê ōe tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Ū sîn-bêng hòa-sin chòe lâng kàng-lîm tī lán tiong-kan lah!”
In chheng-ho͘ Pa-ná-pa chòe Tiū-su, chheng Pó-lô chòe Hi-ní-bí, in-ūi i sī chú-káng-chiá.
Siâⁿ-gōa ū chi̍t ê Tiū-su -biō ê chè-si, i khan gû koh the̍h hoe-khoân lâi kàu siâⁿ-mn̂g-kháu, beh kap chèng-lâng chòe-hé hiàn-chè.
Pa-ná-pa kap Pó-lô nn̄g ê sù-tô͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū thiah-phòa saⁿ, chông ji̍p-khì kûn-chiòng lāi-bīn, hoah kóng,

“Lín ná teh chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì? Goán mā-sī lâng, kap lín lóng kâng-khoán. Goán lâi chia thoân hok-im sī beh hō͘ lín lī-khui hu-ké ê ngó͘-siōng, lâi kui-ǹg hit-ūi oa̍h-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè; I sī thiⁿ, tōe, hái, kap kî-tiong bān-mi̍h ê Chhòng-chō-chú.
Chá-chêng ê sè-tāi, I iông-ún bān-bîn kiâⁿ ka-kī ê lō͘.

Put-kò I it-ti̍t ū thong-kè só͘ chòe ê hó-sū lâi hián-bêng I ka-kī, chiū-sī tùi thiⁿ lo̍h-hō͘, hō͘ lín chiàu-sî siu-sêng, chia̍h-mi̍h chhiong-chiok, sim-lāi hoaⁿ-hí boán-chiok.”
Sù-tô͘ kóng chiah-ê ōe chiah lím-lím-á chó͘-chí kûn-chiòng tùi in hiàn-chè.

Ū chi̍t-kóa tùi Pí-se-tí ê An-thê-o kap Í-ko-liām lâi ê Iû-thài -lâng siàn-tōng kûn-chiòng ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm Pó-lô, siūⁿ-kóng i í-keng sí, chiū kā i thoa chhut-khì siâⁿ-gōa.
Bûn-tô͘ ûi óa-lâi ê sî, i khiā--khí-lâi, kiâⁿ ji̍p-khì siâⁿ-lāi. Keh-ji̍t, i kap Pa-ná-pa chòe-hé khì Te̍k-pì.
Pó-lô kap Pa-ná-pa tī Te̍k-pì thoân hok-im, hō͘ chin chōe lâng chiâⁿ-chòe bûn-tô͘. Āu-lâi in tò-khì Lō͘-su-tek, Í-ko-liām, kap An-thê-o,
iân-lō͘ kian-kò͘ bûn-tô͘ ê sìn-sim, kó͘-lē in chhî-siú sìn-gióng, koh tùi in kóng, “Lán tio̍h keng-kè chin chōe khó͘-lān chiah ōe-tàng chìn-ji̍p Siōng-tè-kok.”
In nn̄g lâng tī ta̍k-ê kàu-hōe soán-phài tiúⁿ-ló, ēng kìm-chia̍h kî-tó chiong in kau-thok hō͘ só͘ sìn ê Chú.
In nn̄g lâng keng-kè Pí-se-tí lâi kàu Pông-hui-lī-a,
tī Pia̍t-ka káng-tō liáu-āu lo̍h-khì A-tāi-lī,
tùi hia chē-chûn tò-khì An-thê-o; chiū-sī tī chia kàu-hōe ū chiong in kau-thok tī Siōng-tè ê un-tián, chhe in chhut-khì chòe hiān-chāi í-keng oân-sêng ê kang-chok.

In kàu An-thê-o chiū tiàu-chi̍p kàu-hōe ê chèng sìn-tô͘, chiong Siōng-tè kap in chòe-hé chòe ê it-chhè, í-ki̍p I kā Gōa-pang-lâng khui sìn-gióng ê mn̂g ê keng-kè, lóng tùi in pò-kò.
Āu-lâi in kap chèng bûn-tô͘ tòa chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan.
Ū kúi-nā ê lâng tùi Iû-thài lo̍h-lâi An-thê-o teh kà-sī sìn-tô͘ kóng, “Lín nā bô chiàu Mô͘-se ê kui-kú siū kat-lé chiū bōe tit-tio̍h kiù.”

Pó-lô í-ki̍p Pa-ná-pa kap in ū ke̍k-lia̍t ê cheng-piān. Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê būn-tôe, tāi-ke koat-tēng phài Pó-lô, Pa-ná-pa, kap in tiong-kan kúi-nā ê lâng chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khì kìⁿ sù-tô͘ í-ki̍p tiúⁿ-ló, kap in chham-siông.
Kàu-hōe ê lâng sàng in chhut-hoat. In keng-kè Hui-nî-ki kap Sat-má-lī-a, tùi chèng sìn-tô͘ pò-kò Gōa-pang-lâng kui Chú ê sū. Tāi-ke thiaⁿ-liáu lóng chin hoaⁿ-hí.
In kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sî, siū-tio̍h kàu-hōe, sù-tô͘, kap tiúⁿ-ló hoan-gêng. In chiong Siōng-tè kap in tông-chāi só͘ chòe it-chhè ê sū kā tāi-ke pò-kò.
Put-kò ū kúi-nā ê sio̍k Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê sìn-tô͘ khiā khí-lâi kóng, “Gōa-pang-lâng it-tēng tio̍h siū kat-lé, koh tio̍h bēng-lēng in chun-siú Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat.”
Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê būn-tôe, sù-tô͘ kap tiúⁿ-ló khui-hōe thó-lūn.

Piān-lūn chin kú liáu-āu, Pí-tek khiā--khí-lâi, kóng, “Kok-ūi hiaⁿ-tī, lín chai Siōng-tè chá chiū tùi lín tiong-kan kéng-soán góa, thang hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng thiaⁿ góa só͘ thoân hok-im ê sìn-sit lâi sìn.
Hit-ūi chai lâng lāi-sim ê Siōng-tè sù Sèng Sîn hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng, kap ū sù hō͘ lán kâng-khoán, chèng-bêng I ū chiap-la̍p in.
Tùi sìn, I ū kā in ê sim sóe chheng-khì; I tùi-thāi lán kap in lóng bô chha-pia̍t.
Kì-jiân sī án-ni, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ iáu-teh chhì-thàm Siōng-tè, chiong lán ê chó͘-sian kap lán taⁿ bōe khí ê tàⁿ khòa tī hiah-ê bûn-tô͘ ê keng-thâu téng?
M̄ eng-kai án-ni, lán siong-sìn tio̍h thong-kè Chú Iâ-so͘ ê un-tián chiah ōe tit-tio̍h kiù; in mā-sī án-ni.”
Tāi-ke lóng chēng-chēng thiaⁿ Pa-ná-pa kap Pó-lô kóng-khí Siōng-tè thong-kè in tī Gōa-pang-lâng ê tiong-kan só͘ kiâⁿ it-chhè ê sîn-jiah kî-sū.
In kóng soah, Ngá-kok kóng, “Kok-ūi hiaⁿ-tī, chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ góa kóng.
Tú-chiah Se-bûn ū kóng-tio̍h Siōng-tè tong-chho͘ án-chóaⁿ khòaⁿ-kò͘ Gōa-pang-lâng, tùi in tiong-kan kéng lâng lâi kui-sio̍k I ka-kī.
Sian-ti ū kóng-khí kap chit-ê siâng-khoán ì-sù ê ōe. Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài:

Chú kóng: Chiah-ê sū í-āu góa beh tò-tńg--lâi, beh tiông-kiàn í-keng tó-hoāi ê Tāi-pi̍t ê ke. Góa beh tùi hong-hòe tiong koh kā i khí-chō, beh têng-sin kā i kiàn-li̍p--khí-lâi,

thang hō͘ só͘ chhun ê lâng, chiū-sī só͘-ū siū ho͘-tiàu kui góa ê Gōa-pang-lâng, lóng ōe chhē-kiû Chú. Hit-ūi chiong chiah-ê sū tùi kó͘-chá chiū hō͘ lâng chai ê Chú án-ni soan-pò͘.
“Só͘-í, chiàu góa ê phòaⁿ-toàn, lán m̄-thang kā hiah-ê kui-ǹg Siōng-tè ê Gōa-pang-lâng tiau-lân,
put-kò tio̍h siá-phoe hoan-hù in m̄-thang chia̍h pài ngó͘-siōng bô chheng-khì ê mi̍h; m̄-thang îm-loān; m̄-thang chia̍h ni̍h-sí ê cheng-siⁿ kap huih.
In-ūi tùi kó͘-chá í-lâi, Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat tī ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-chhī lóng ū lâng soan-káng, ta̍k-ê An-hioh-ji̍t, tī ta̍k-ê hōe-tn̂g lóng ū lâng soan-tho̍k.”

Hit-sî, sù-tô͘ kap tiúⁿ-ló, í-ki̍p choân kàu-hōe koat-tēng beh tùi in tiong-kan kéng lâng, chhe in kap Pó-lô, Pa-ná-pa chòe-hé khì An-thê-o. In só͘ soán-phài--ê sī kiò-chòe Pa-sat-pa ê Iû-tāi kap Se-la. Chit nn̄g ê lâng tī hiaⁿ-tī ê tiong-kan sī léng-tō jîn-bu̍t.
Sù-tô͘ kau-tài in tòa--khì ê phoe án-ni siá: “Goán chiah-ê choh sù-tô͘ kap tiúⁿ-ló ê hiaⁿ-tī, kā tòa tī An-thê-o, Sū-lī-a, kap Ki-lī-ka ê Gōa-pang-lâng sìn-tô͘ chhéng-an!
Thiaⁿ-kóng ū tùi goán chia chhut--khì ê lâng khì lín hia, in ēng goán bô chí-sī in kóng ê ōe kā lín kiáu-jiáu, hō͘ lín ê sim siū-tio̍h jiáu-loān.
Ūi-tio̍h án-ni, goán tâng-sim-ha̍p-ì koat-tēng kéng lâng, chhe in kap goán só͘ kèng-ài ê Pó-lô í-ki̍p Pa-ná-pa khì lín hia;
chit nn̄g ê lâng ūi-tio̍h lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok kam-goān hiàn sìⁿ-miā.
Só͘-í, goán chhe-phài Iû-tāi kap Se-la khì, in ōe chhin-chhùi kā lín kóng kap phoe-lāi só͘ siá kâng-khoán ê tāi-chì.
In-ūi Sèng Sîn kap goán koat-tēng, ē-bīn chiah-ê tiōng-iàu sū-hāng í-gōa, bô koh ke-thiⁿ lín ê hū-tam:

Chiū-sī m̄-thang chia̍h pài ngó͘-siōng ê mi̍h; m̄-thang chia̍h huih kap ni̍h-sí ê cheng-siⁿ; mā m̄-thang îm-loān. Chiah-ê tāi-chì lín nā bô hoān--tio̍h chiū hó. Goān lín pêng-an!”
In siū-phài lo̍h-khì An-thê-o, tī hia tiàu-chi̍p choân-thé sìn-tô͘, chiong phoe kau hō͘ in.
Chèng-lâng tha̍k-tio̍h hit-tiuⁿ phoe, in-ūi kó͘-lē ê ōe móa-sim hoaⁿ-hí.
Iû-tāi kap Se-la, in pún-sin mā-sī sian-ti, ū tùi sìn-tô͘ kóng chin chōe kó͘-lē ê ōe, kian-kò͘ in ê sìn-sim.
In tī hia tòa chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan liáu-āu, siū sìn-tô͘ hoan-sàng, pêng-an tò-khì chhe in lâi ê lâng ê só͘-chāi.
Pó-lô kap Pa-ná-pa kè-sio̍k tòa tī An-thê-o; in kap kî-tha chin chōe lâng chòe-hé kà-sī koh soan-káng Chú ê sìn-sit.
Kúi-nā ji̍t āu, Pó-lô tùi Pa-ná-pa kóng, “Lán koh lâi-khì chêng thoân Chú ê sìn-sit hiah-ê siâⁿ-chhī thàm sìn-tô͘, khòaⁿ in ê chêng-hêng.”
Pa-ná-pa ài-beh chhōa kiò-chòe Má-khó ê Iok-hān chòe-hé khì,
m̄-kú Pó-lô siūⁿ-kóng bô sek-ha̍p, in-ūi Má-khó bat tī Pông-hui-lī-a lī-khui in, bô kè-sio̍k kap in chòe kang.
In nn̄g ê lâng ì-kiàn ke̍k-lia̍t chhiong-tu̍t, tì-kàu tio̍h hun-khui. Pa-ná-pa chhōa Má-khó chē-chûn khì Sài-phó͘-lō͘-su;
Pó-lô kéng Se-la, sìn-tô͘ chiong i kau-thok tī Chú ê un-tián, i chiū chhut-hoat.
I kiâⁿ-thàu Sū-lī-a kap Ki-lī-ka, kian-kò͘ ta̍k kàu-hōe ê sìn-sim.
Pó-lô koh khì Te̍k-pì kap Lō͘-su-tek, tī hia ū chi̍t ê bûn-tô͘ kiò-chòe Thê-mô͘-thài, lāu-bú sī Iû-thài -lâng, sī sìn-tô͘, lāu-pē sī Hi-la̍h -lâng.
Lō͘-su-tek kap Í-ko-liām ê sìn-tô͘ lóng chheng-chàn i.
Pó-lô siūⁿ-beh chhōa i chòe-hé khì, chiū kā i kiâⁿ kat-lé, in-ūi hit só͘-chāi ê Iû-thài -lâng lóng chai i ê lāu-pē sī Hi-la̍h -lâng.
In chi̍t ê siâⁿ kè chi̍t ê siâⁿ chiong Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sù-tô͘ kap tiúⁿ-ló só͘ gī-koat ê kui-lē kau hō͘ in khì chun-siú.
Tùi án-ni, ta̍k kàu-hōe ê sìn-sim ná kian-kò͘, jîn-sò͘ ji̍t-ji̍t ke-thiⁿ.
In-ūi Sèng Sîn chó͘-chí Pó-lô kap Se-la tī A-sè-a -séng thoân-tō, in chiū tùi Hut-lū-ka kap Ka-lia̍p-thài ê tōe-hng keng-kè.
In lâi kàu Múi-se-a pian-kài ê sî, siūⁿ-beh ji̍p-khì Pì-chhui-nî -séng, put-kò Iâ-so͘ ê Sîn m̄-chún,
in chiū se̍h-kè Múi-se-a, lo̍h-khì Te̍k-lô-a.
Hit-àm, Pó-lô khòaⁿ-kìⁿ īⁿ-siōng, ū chi̍t ê Má-kî-tùn -lâng khiā--teh, kā i khún-kiû kóng, “Chhiáⁿ kè-lâi Má-kî-tùn pang-chān goán!”
Pó-lô khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chit-ê īⁿ-siōng liáu-āu, goán sûi-sî chún-pī beh khì hia, in-ūi khak-sìn Siōng-tè ū ho͘-tiàu goán khì thoân hok-im hō͘ Má-kî-tùn -lâng.
Goán tùi Te̍k-lô-a khui-chûn, ti̍t-ti̍t khui-khì Sat-mô͘-te̍k-lat, keh-ji̍t kàu Nî-a-pho-lí.
Goán tùi hia lâi kàu Má-kî-tùn tē-it khu ê siâⁿ Hui-li̍p-pí; chit-ê siâⁿ sī Lô-má ê si̍t-bîn-khu. Goán tī hia tòa kúi-nā ji̍t.
Tī An-hioh-ji̍t, goán chhut-siâⁿ khì hô-piⁿ, siūⁿ-kóng tī hia ū kî-tó ê só͘-chāi. Goán chē--lo̍h-khì, chiū tùi chū-chi̍p tī hia ê hū-lú kóng tō-lí.

Ū chi̍t ê bōe chí-sek-pò͘ ê Chhui-ngá-chhui-lat ê hū-lú, miâ kiò-chòe Lū-tí-a, sī kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng, i mā lâi thiaⁿ. Chú khui i ê sim, hō͘ i choan-sim thiaⁿ Pó-lô só͘ kóng ê ōe.

I kap choân-ke lóng siū sóe-lé, āu-lâi i khún-kiû goán kóng, “Lín nā khòaⁿ góa ū chin-si̍t sìn Chú, chhiáⁿ lâi tòa goán tau.” I án-ni kā goán kiông lâu--teh, goán chiū lâu--lo̍h-lâi.
Ū chi̍t ji̍t, goán beh khì kî-tó ê só͘-chāi, ū tú-tio̍h chi̍t ê hō͘ pok-kòa ê sîn hū-sin ê cha-bó͘ lô͘-lē, i khò pok-kòa hō͘ chú-lâng thàn chin chōe chîⁿ.
I tè tī Pó-lô kap goán āu-bīn, tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Chiah-ê lâng sī Chì-koân Siōng-tè ê po̍k-jîn, beh tùi lín soan-pò͘ tit-kiù ê tō-lō͘.”

I chin chōe ji̍t lóng án-ni hoah; Pó-lô kám-kak chin thó-ià, chiū oa̍t kè-khì kā hit-ê siâ-sîn kóng, “Góa hōng Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ bēng-lēng lí tùi i chhut--khì!” Siâ-sîn sûi-sî tùi i chhut--khì.
Cha-bó͘ lô͘-lē ê chú-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h in thàn-chîⁿ ê ǹg-bāng lóng bô--khì, chiū kā Pó-lô kap Se-la khiú--teh, thoa in khì chhī-tiong-sim kìⁿ koaⁿ-oân,
kau hō͘ Lô-má koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, khòng-kò in, kóng, “Chiah-ê lâng lâi teh jiáu-loān lán ê siâⁿ; in sī Iû-thài -lâng,
teh thoân lán Lô-má -lâng m̄ eng-kai chiap-siū á-sī chun-siú ê hong-sio̍k si̍p-koàn.”
Kûn-chiòng chham-teh kong-kek, koaⁿ-tiúⁿ chiū pak Pó-lô kap Se-la ê saⁿ, bēng-lēng lâng ēng kùn-á kā in kòng.
Peng-teng kā in kòng chin chōe ē liáu-āu, kā in koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ, koh bēng-lēng kò͘-kaⁿ ê lâng giâm-bi̍t khàn-siú.
Kò͘-kaⁿ ê lâng chiap-tio̍h bēng-lēng, chiū kā in koaiⁿ-lo̍h lāi-kaⁿ, siang-kha khàu tī chhâ-kông.
Chha-put-to pòaⁿ-mî, Pó-lô kap Se-la teh kî-tó, gîm-si o-ló Siōng-tè, kî-tha ê hoān-lâng lóng chù-ì teh thiaⁿ.
Hut-jiân ū tōa tōe-tāng, tì-kàu kaⁿ-ga̍k ê tōe-ki iô-choah; só͘-ū ê kaⁿ-mn̂g sûi-sî khui, hoān-lâng ê só-liān lóng lak--khì.
Kò͘-kaⁿ ê lâng chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, khòaⁿ-tio̍h kaⁿ-mn̂g khui-khui, siūⁿ-kóng hoān-lâng lóng tô-cháu, chiū pu̍ih to beh chū-sat.
Pó-lô tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “M̄-thang siong-hāi ka-kī, goán lóng tī chia.”
Kò͘-kaⁿ ê lâng kiò lâng gia̍h-teng lâi, chông--ji̍p-khì, phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah phak tī Pó-lô kap Se-la ê kha-chêng,
jiân-āu chhōa in chhut--khì, mn̄g kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, góa tio̍h chòe sím-mi̍h chiah ōe tit-tio̍h kiù?”
In kóng, “Tio̍h sìn Chú Iâ-so͘, lí kap lí ê ke chiū ōe tit-tio̍h kiù.”
In chiū chiong Chú ê tō-lí kóng hō͘ i kap in choân-ke ê lâng thiaⁿ.
Hit-mî, kò͘-kaⁿ ê lâng chhōa Pó-lô kap Se-la khì sóe khang-chhùi, jiân-āu i kap choân-ke ê lâng lóng sûi-sî siū sóe-lé.
I chhōa in ji̍p-khì i ê chhù, chún-pī mi̍h-kiāⁿ hō͘ in chia̍h. I kap choân-ke lóng tōa hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi in í-keng sìn Siōng-tè.
Keh-chá-khí, Lô-má ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ phài kéng-koaⁿ lâi, kóng, “Kā hit nn̄g ê lâng pàng--chhut-khì.”
Kò͘-kaⁿ ê lâng chiong chiah-ê ōe kā Pó-lô kóng, “Koaⁿ-tiúⁿ ū kau-tài beh pàng lín chhut--khì; taⁿ lín chhut--lâi, pêng-an lī-khui.”

M̄-kú Pó-lô tùi kéng-koaⁿ kóng, “Goán sī Lô-má kong-bîn, bô siū sím-mn̄g chiū tī chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng ēng kùn-á kā goán kòng, koh kā goán koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ, chit-chūn in beh tiām-tiām-á kā goán kóaⁿ--chhut-khì sī--bô? Bōe-ēng--tit! Kiò Lô-má koaⁿ-tiúⁿ chhin-sin lâi chhōa goán chhut--khì!”
Kéng-koaⁿ chiong chiah-ê ōe tùi Lô-má ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ pò-kò. In chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h Pó-lô kap Se-la sī Lô-má kong-bîn chiū chin kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ,
lâi kaⁿ--ni̍h khǹg in, chhōa in chhut--lâi, chhiáⁿ in lī-khui hit-ê siâⁿ.
Pó-lô kap Se-la lī-khui kaⁿ-ga̍k, chiū khì Lū-tí-a in tau, kap sìn-tô͘ kìⁿ-bīn, kā in kó͘-lē liáu-āu chiah lī-khui.
Pó-lô kap Se-la keng-kè Àm-hui-pho-lí kap A-pho-lô-nî-a, lâi kàu Thiap-sat-lô-nî-ka, tī hia ū Iû-thài -lâng ê hōe-tn̂g.
Pó-lô chiàu si̍p-koàn ji̍p-khì hōe-tn̂g, liân-sòa saⁿ ê An-hioh-ji̍t, ín-iōng Sèng-keng kap lâng piān-lūn.
I káng-kái koh chèng-bêng Ki-tok it-tēng tio̍h siū-hāi, jiân-āu tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h. I kóng, “Góa tùi lín soan-iông ê chit-ūi Iâ-so͘ chiū-sī Ki-tok.”
In tiong-kan ū lâng siū sòe-ho̍k lâi sìn, chiū khì tè Pó-lô kap Se-la; kî-tiong ū chi̍t tōa-tīn kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê Hi-la̍h -lâng, koh ū bōe chió kùi-hu-jîn.

M̄-kú Iû-thài -lâng khí oàn-tò͘, chiū chio chi̍t-kóa koe-thâu ê húi-lūi, ká-kûn kiat-tóng, jiáu-loān choân-chhī, kong-kek Iâ-sun ê chhù, chhē Pó-lô kap Se-la, beh kā in lia̍h-khì kau hō͘ bîn-chiòng.
In chhē bô, chiū chiong Iâ-sun kap chi̍t-kóa sìn-tô͘ thoa-khì kìⁿ tōe-hng-koaⁿ, hoah kóng, “Chiah-ê kā thian-hā péng-lìn-tńg ê lâng mā lâi kàu lán chia lo͘h!
Iâ-sun kèng-jiân kā in siu-liû. In ûi-pōe Lô-má hông-tè Khái-sat ê hoat-lēng, kóng lēng-gōa ū chi̍t ê ông kiò-chòe Iâ-so͘.”
Kûn-chiòng kap tōe-hng-koaⁿ thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe tio̍h-kip put-an.
Koaⁿ-oân tùi Iâ-sun kap kî-tha ê lâng siu chîⁿ kau-pó liáu-āu pàng in chhut--khì.
Hit-àm, sìn-tô͘ thàu-mî sàng Pó-lô kap Se-la khì Pì-lí-a. In chi̍t-ē kàu-ūi chiū ji̍p-khì Iû-thài -lâng ê hōe-tn̂g.

Chiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng pí Thiap-sat-lô-nî-ka ê Iû-thài -lâng khah khai-bêng, hui-siông jia̍t-sim niá-siū tō-lí, ta̍k-ji̍t chhâ-khó Sèng-keng, khòaⁿ Pó-lô só͘ kóng--ê ū khak-si̍t--bô.
In tiong-kan ū chin chōe chun-kùi ê Hi-la̍h hū-jîn-lâng kap ta-po͘-lâng sìn.
M̄-kú Thiap-sat-lô-nî-ka ê Iû-thài -lâng chi̍t-ē chai-iáⁿ Pó-lô mā tī Pì-lí-a teh thoân Siōng-tè ê tō, chiū khì hia siàn-tōng kûn-chiòng, ín-khí jiáu-loān.
Sìn-tô͘ sûi-sî sàng Pó-lô khì hái-piⁿ; Se-la kap Thê-mô͘-thài lâu tī hia.
In chi̍t-lō͘ hō͘-sàng Pó-lô kàu Ngá-tián. Pó-lô hoan-hù in kiò Se-la kap Thê-mô͘-thài chīn-liōng kóaⁿ-kín khì kap i hōe-ha̍p, jiân-āu in chiū lī-khui.
Pó-lô tī Ngá-tián teh thèng-hāu Se-la kap Thê-mô͘-thài ê tiong-kan, khòaⁿ-tio̍h móa-siâⁿ lóng sī ngó͘-siōng, sim chin kan-khó͘.
I tī hōe-tn̂g kap Iû-thài -lâng í-ki̍p kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê Gōa-pang-lâng tâm-lūn, mā ta̍k-ji̍t tī chhī-tiong-sim kap só͘ tú--tio̍h ê lâng tâm-lūn.

Ū chi̍t-kóa I-phek-khiu-ló͘ kap Su-to-a ha̍k-phài ê tiat-ha̍k-ka lâi kap i piān-lūn. Ū lâng kóng, “Chit-ê ài kóng-ōe--ê teh o͘-pe̍h kóng sím-mi̍h?” Ū lâng kóng, “I chhin-chhiūⁿ teh thoân gōa-kok ê kúi-sîn.” In án-ni kóng sī in-ūi Pó-lô thoân Iâ-so͘ kap I koh-oa̍h ê hok-im.
In chiū kā Pó-lô thoa kàu A-lio̍k Pa-kó͘ gī-tiûⁿ, tùi i kóng, “Lí teh káng-lūn ê sin ha̍k-soat ōe-tàng hō͘ goán chai bōe?
Ū chi̍t-kóa tāi-chì goán thiaⁿ-liáu koài-koài, goán ài chai sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù.”
Goân-lâi só͘-ū Ngá-tián -lâng kap tòa tī hia ê gōa-kok-lâng ēng chin chōe sî-kan tâm-lūn kap thiaⁿ sin-kî ê sū.
Pó-lô khiā tī A-lio̍k Pa-kó͘ gī-tiûⁿ ê tiong-ng, kóng, “Kok-ūi Ngá-tián -lâng, góa khòaⁿ-chhut lín tī ta̍k hong-bīn ū kiông-lia̍t ê chong-kàu jia̍t-sêng.

Góa tī siâⁿ-lāi teh kiâⁿ, koan-chhat lín kèng-pài ê só͘-chāi, mā ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chō tôaⁿ, téng-bīn siá: ‘Hiàn hō͘ m̄-bat ê sîn’. Lín só͘ teh kèng-pài m̄-bat ê sîn, hiān-chāi góa pò lín chai.
Chit-ūi chhòng-chō ú-tiū kap kî-tiong bān-mi̍h ê Siōng-tè sī thiⁿ-tōe ê Chú, bô tòa tī lâng ê chhiú khí ê biō-sī,
mā bô khiàm-ēng lâng ê chhiú só͘ hiàn ê mi̍h, kî-si̍t I lóng bô su-iàu, I ka-kī tian-tò chiong sìⁿ-miā, kap khùi, í-ki̍p bān-mi̍h sù hō͘ jîn-lūi.
I tùi chi̍t ê lâng chō-chhut ta̍k chióng-cho̍k ê lâng, hō͘ in khiā-khí tī tōe-bīn-chiūⁿ ta̍k só͘-chāi, koh tāi-seng kā in tēng nî-hān kap khiā-khí ê tōe-kài.
Siōng-tè án-ni chòe sī beh hō͘ in chhē I, in nā chhiau-chhē chiū ōe chhē--tio̍h, kî-si̍t I kap lán ta̍k-ê lâng saⁿ-lī bô hn̄g.
In-ūi ‘lán khò I seng-oa̍h, hêng-tōng, chûn-chāi’; chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ê si-jîn ū-ê án-ni kóng, ‘In-ūi lán mā-sī I ê kiáⁿ-sun.’

Kì-jiân lán sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-sun, bô eng-kai chiong I ê sîn-sèng khòaⁿ-chòe kap ngó͘-siōng kâng-khoán, sī khò lâng ê chhiú-gē, ēng kim, gûn, á-sī chio̍h-thâu tiau-khek--chhut-lâi--ê.
Jîn-lūi iáu oa̍h tī bû-ti ê sî-tāi, Siōng-tè bô tui-kiù, m̄-kú hiān-chāi I bēng-lēng choân jîn-lūi tio̍h hóe-kái.

In-ūi I í-keng koat-tēng ji̍t-chí, beh ēng I só͘ chí-tēng ê lâng chiàu kong-gī lâi sím-phòaⁿ choân sè-kài; I hō͘ chi̍t ê lâng tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, ēng chit-ê chòe pîn-kù, hō͘ choân jîn-lūi thang sìn.”
In chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h sí-lâng koh-oa̍h ê sū, ū lâng kā i thí-chhiò, mā ū lâng kóng, “Koan-hē chit-ê sū goán ài koh thiaⁿ lí kóng.”
Jiân-āu Pó-lô tùi in tiong-kan chhut--khì.

Put-kò ū chi̍t-kóa lâng tè i khì, chiâⁿ-chòe sìn-tô͘, kî-tiong ū A-lio̍k Pa-kó͘ ê gī-oân Tō͘-nî-siu, koh ū chi̍t ê lú-sū kiò-chòe Tāi-má-lí, í-ki̍p chi̍t-kóa kap in chòe-hé ê lâng.
Chit-ê sū í-āu, Pó-lô lī-khui Ngá-tián khì Ko-lîm-to.

I tī hia tú-tio̍h chi̍t ê tī Pún-to͘ chhut-sì ê Iû-thài -lâng, miâ kiò A-ku-la, chòe-kūn chiah kap i ê bó͘ Pek-ki-la tùi Ì-tāi-lī lâi, in-ūi hông-tè Khek-lô-tē ū bēng-lēng só͘-ū ê Iû-thài -lâng lóng lī-khui Lô-má. Pó-lô khì chhē in,
in-ūi kâng hâng-gia̍p, lóng sī teh chòe pò͘-pîⁿ, chiū kap in tòa, chòe-hé chòe kang.
Ta̍k-ê An-hioh-ji̍t, Pó-lô lóng tī hōe-tn̂g kap lâng piān-lūn, khó͘-khǹg Iû-thài -lâng kap Hi-la̍h -lâng sìn Chú.
Se-la kap Thê-mô͘-thài tùi Má-kî-tùn lâi liáu-āu, Pó-lô chiū choân-sim thoân-tō, tùi Iû-thài -lâng kiàn-chèng Iâ-so͘ sī Ki-tok.

In kā i hoán-tùi koh húi-pòng ê sî, Pó-lô kā saⁿ--ni̍h ê thô͘-hún pōaⁿ hiat-ka̍k, tùi in kóng, “Lín ka-kī beh thó-sí, bô góa ê tāi-chì! Tùi taⁿ í-āu góa beh khì Gōa-pang-lâng hia.”
Jiân-āu Pó-lô lī-khui in, khì tòa tī chi̍t ê kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê Gōa-pang-lâng kiò-chòe Thê-to Iû-sū-to͘ ê chhù; i ê chhù tī hōe-tn̂g ê keh-piah.
Hōe-tn̂g ê chú-koán Ki-lī-sū-pò͘ kap i ê choân-ke lóng sìn Chú; koh ū chin chōe Ko-lîm-to -lâng thiaⁿ-liáu lâi sìn, mā siū sóe-lé.
Ū chi̍t àm, tī īⁿ-siōng tiong Chú tùi Pó-lô kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ, tio̍h kè-sio̍k kóng, m̄-thang tiām--khì,
in-ūi góa kap lí tông-chāi, bô lâng ōe hē-chhiú kā lí siong-hāi; góa ū chin chōe chú-bîn tī chit-ê siâⁿ-lāi.”
Pó-lô tī hia tòa chi̍t nî pòaⁿ kú, chiong Siōng-tè ê tō kà-sī in.
Ka-liû choh A-kai-a chóng-tok ê sî, Iû-thài -lâng liân-ha̍p kong-kek Pó-lô, kā i lia̍h-khì hoat-têng,
kò i kóng, “Chit-ê lâng siàn-tōng lâng ēng ûi-pōe Lu̍t-hoat ê hong-sek kèng-pài Siōng-tè!”

Pó-lô tú-beh khui-chhùi, Ka-liû tùi Iû-thài -lâng kóng, “ Iû-thài -lâng, che nā-sī hoān-hoat ê hêng-ûi á-sī ok-chit ê hoān-chōe, góa tong-jiân tio̍h nāi-sim thiaⁿ lín ê khòng-sò͘.
Só͘ cheng-lūn--ê kì-jiân sī koan-hē lín Lu̍t-hoat ê jī-gán kap bêng-chheng, lín ka-kī khì kái-koat; góa m̄ pān chit-khoán tāi-chì!”
I kā in kóaⁿ-chhut hoat-têng.
Chèng-lâng chiū lia̍h hōe-tn̂g ê chú-koán Só͘-thê-nî, tī hoat-têng chêng kā i phah. Chit-hāng tāi-chì Ka-liû lóng bô chhap.

Pó-lô tī Ko-lîm-to kap sìn-tô͘ koh tòa chin chōe ji̍t liáu-āu lī-khui in, kap Pek-ki-la í-ki̍p A-ku-la chòe-hé chē-chûn khì Sū-lī-a. Chhut-hoat chêng, Pó-lô in-ūi ū hē-goān, tī Kian-kek-lí chián thâu-mn̂g.
In kàu Í-hut-só͘, Pó-lô kap in hun-khui, ka-kī ji̍p-khì hōe-tn̂g kap Iû-thài -lâng piān-lūn.
Tāi-ke chhiáⁿ i lâu lo̍h-lâi ke tòa kúi-ji̍t-á, i bô tah-èng.
Beh lī-khui ê sî, i kā in kóng “Nā-sī Siōng-tè ê chí-ì, góa ōe koh tńg-lâi lín chia”, jiân-āu chē-chûn lī-khui Í-hut-só͘.
I tī Khái-sat-lī-a lo̍h-chûn, tùi hia chiūⁿ-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, kā kàu-hōe chhéng-an, jiân-āu lo̍h-khì An-thê-o.
Pó-lô tī hia tòa chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan liáu-āu koh chhut-hoat, keng-kè Ka-lia̍p-thài kap Hut-lū-ka tōe-khu, kian-kò͘ chèng bûn-tô͘ ê sìn-sim.
Ū chi̍t ê tī A-le̍k-san-tāi chhut-sì ê Iû-thài -lâng, kiò-chòe A-pho-lô, lâi kàu Í-hut-só͘; i ū chin hó ê kháu-châi, tùi Sèng-keng mā cheng-thong.
I tùi Chú ê Tō-lō͘ ū siū-kè hùn-liān, jia̍t-sim soan-káng, chèng-khak kà-sī Iâ-so͘ ê sū, put-kò chí-ū chai Iok-hān ê sóe-lé nā-tiāⁿ.
I tī hōe-tn̂g hó-táⁿ khai-sí káng-tō. Pek-ki-la kap A-ku-la thiaⁿ-tio̍h i ê káng-tō chiū chhōa i khì in tau, koh-khah chèng-khak kā i kóe-seh Siōng-tè ê Tō-lō͘.

Āu-lâi A-pho-lô koat-tēng beh khì A-kai-a, Í-hut-só͘ ê sìn-tô͘ chiū kā i kó͘-lē, siá-phoe hō͘ A-kai-a ê bûn-tô͘, chhiáⁿ in kā i chiap-thāi. I kàu hia í-āu, hiah-ê tùi Siōng-tè ê un-hūi lâi sìn Chú ê lâng siū-tio̍h chin tōa ê pang-chān,
in-ūi tī kong-khai ê piān-lūn, i ēng ū-la̍t ê ōe piān-tó Iû-thài -lâng, kun-kù Sèng-keng chèng-bêng Iâ-so͘ sī Ki-tok.
A-pho-lô tī Ko-lîm-to ê sî, Pó-lô keng-kè lōe-lio̍k ê tōe-khu, lâi kàu Í-hut-só͘, tī hia ū tú-tio̍h kúi-nā ê bûn-tô͘.
I mn̄g in, “Lín sìn Chú ê sî ū niá-siū Sèng Sîn bô?” In ìn kóng, “Bô, goán kàu taⁿ m̄-bat thiaⁿ-tio̍h kóng ū Sèng Sîn.”
Pó-lô koh mn̄g kóng, “Án-ni, lín niá-siū--ê sī sím-mi̍h sóe-lé?” In ìn kóng, “Sī Iok-hān ê sóe-lé.”
Pó-lô kóng, “ Iok-hān ê sóe-lé sī hóe-kái ê sóe-lé; i kiò Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tio̍h sìn tè tī i āu-bīn lâi Hit-ūi, chiū-sī tio̍h sìn Iâ-so͘.”
In thiaⁿ-liáu chiū hōng Chú Iâ-so͘ ê miâ niá-siū sóe-lé.
Pó-lô chi̍t-ē kā in hōaⁿ-chhiú, Sèng Sîn chiū kàng-lîm tī in sin-chiūⁿ, in chiū ēng lêng-gú kóng-ōe, koh soan-káng Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit.
In lóng-chóng ū cha̍p-jī ê lâng.
Pó-lô liân-sòa saⁿ ge̍h-ji̍t kú ji̍p-khì hōe-tn̂g hó-táⁿ thoân-tō, kap lâng piān-lūn Siōng-tè-kok ê sū, khó͘-khǹg in sìn Chú.

Put-kò ū chi̍t-kóa lâng kò͘-chip m̄ sìn, tī hōe-chiòng bīn-chêng húi-pòng Chú ê Tō-lō͘. Pó-lô chiū chhōa bûn-tô͘ lī-khui in, ta̍k-ji̍t tī Chhui-lat-lô͘ ê káng-tn̂g kap lâng tâm-lūn.
Án-ni kè-sio̍k nn̄g nî kú, só͘-ū tòa tī A-sè-a -séng ê lâng, bô-lūn Iû-thài -lâng á-sī Hi-la̍h -lâng, lóng ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Chú ê sìn-sit.
Siōng-tè ēng Pó-lô ê chhiú kiâⁿ kî-īⁿ ê sîn-jiah;
sīm-chì ū lâng the̍h Pó-lô ēng--kè ê chhiú-kun á-sī ûi-kûn khǹg tī pīⁿ-lâng sin-chiūⁿ, in ê pīⁿ chiū hó--khì, siâ-sîn chiū tùi in chhut--khì.

Hit-sî ū kúi-nā ê kiâⁿ-kang-ô͘ teh kóaⁿ-kúi ê Iû-thài -lâng, mā siūⁿ-beh chioh Chú Iâ-so͘ ê miâ chè-ap siâ-sîn hū-sin ê lâng, kóng, “Góa hōng Pó-lô só͘ thoân Iâ-so͘ ê miâ bēng-lēng lín chhut--khì!”
Iû-thài ê chè-si-tiúⁿ Sū-ki-óa ê chhit ê kiáⁿ mā teh chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì.
M̄-kú siâ-sîn ìn kóng, “Iâ-so͘ góa bat, Pó-lô góa mā bat, lín leh, lín sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?”
Hit-ê hō͘ siâ-sîn hū-sin ê lâng chhi̍h óa-khì kong-kek hiah-ê kiâⁿ-kang-ô͘--ê, kā in chè-ho̍k, hō͘ in siū-siong, chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé tùi hit-keng chhù tô-cháu.
Tòa tī Í-hut-só͘ só͘-ū ê Iû-thài -lâng kap Hi-la̍h -lâng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-hāng tāi-chì lóng chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ; Chú Iâ-so͘ ê miâ tōa siū chun-chông.
Ū chin chōe í-keng sìn ê lâng chhut--lâi, kong-khai sêng-jīn koh pò lâng chai in kè-khì só͘ chòe ê tāi-chì.
Ū chin chōe kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t ê lâng the̍h in ê chheh lâi, khǹg kui-tui, tī chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng pàng-hé sio. In kè-sǹg chheh ê kè-ta̍t, tāi-iok ū gō͘-bān ê gûn-goân.
Tùi án-ni, Chú ê sìn-sit it-ti̍t thoân-khui, tōa-tōa heng-ōng.

Chiah-ê tāi-chì liáu-āu, Pó-lô siū Sèng Sîn kám-tōng, koat-tēng beh keng-kè Má-kî-tùn kap A-kai-a khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. I kóng, “Góa kàu hia í-āu mā it-tēng tio̍h khì hóng-būn Lô-má.”
I chiū chhe nn̄g ê chō͘-chhiú Thê-mô͘-thài kap Í-la-to͘ khì Má-kî-tùn, ka-kī chiām-sî lâu tī A-sè-a.
Tú hit-sî, koan-hē Chú ê Tō-lō͘ tī Í-hut-só͘ ín-khí giâm-tiōng ê jiáu-loān.
Ū chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Tí-bí-te̍k ê phah-kim sai-hū, i ēng gûn chō lú-sîn A-tí-bí ê biō ê bô͘-hêng, hō͘ chi̍t-kóa sai-hū thàn bōe chió chîⁿ.
Tí-bí-te̍k kā hiah-ê sai-hū kap só͘-ū ê tông-gia̍p chi̍p óa--lâi, tùi in kóng, “Kok-ūi, lín chai lán sī khò chit-ê kang-gē teh thàn-chîⁿ.

Hiān-chāi lín ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h koh ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê Pó-lô teh chòe ê tāi-chì. I kóng, ‘Lâng ê chhiú só͘ chō--ê lóng m̄-sī sîn.’ Chiah-ê ōe m̄-nā tī Í-hut-só͘, mā chha-put-to tī choân A-sè-a -séng, ū hō͘ chin chōe lâng siū kiau-so khì tè in.

Án-ni, m̄-nā lán chit-ê sū-gia̍p ōe phah-pháiⁿ miâ-siaⁿ, liân úi-tāi ê lú-sîn A-tí-bí ê biō to ōe hō͘ lâng khin-sī, choân A-sè-a -séng kap choân sè-kài só͘ teh pài chit-ê lú-sîn ê chun-giâm mā ōe siū phò-hoāi!”
Kûn-chiòng chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê ōe hui-siông siū-khì, tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “ Í-hut-só͘ -lâng ê A-tí-bí chin úi-tāi!”
Choân-siâⁿ lóng loān--khí-lâi; chèng-lâng thoa Pó-lô ê tâng-phōaⁿ Má-kî-tùn -lâng Kai-iû kap A-lí-ta̍t-kó͘, kui-tīn chòe-chi̍t-ē chhiong ji̍p-khì kio̍k-tiûⁿ.
Pó-lô siūⁿ-beh ji̍p-khì kûn-chiòng lāi-bīn, m̄-kú bûn-tô͘ kā i chó͘-chí.
Ū kúi-nā ê A-sè-a -séng ê koaⁿ-oân, sī Pó-lô ê pêng-iú, mā chhe lâng khì khǹg Pó-lô m̄-thang ji̍p-khì kio̍k-tiûⁿ.
Hit-sî kui-ê hōe-tiûⁿ loān-chhau-chhau, chi̍t lâng hoah chi̍t hāng; tōa-pō͘-hūn ê lâng m̄ chai in sī-án-chóaⁿ teh chū-chi̍p.

Kûn-chiòng tiong-kan ū lâng chiong jiáu-loān ê chek-jīm kui hō͘ A-le̍k-san-tāi, in-ūi Iû-thài -lâng kā i sak chhut-khì thâu-chêng. A-le̍k-san-tāi chiū pí chhiú-sè kiò in an-chēng, siūⁿ-beh kā in piān-bêng.
In chi̍t-ē jīn-chhut i sī Iû-thài -lâng, chiū lóng chôe-siaⁿ hoah, “ Í-hut-só͘ -lâng ê A-tí-bí chin úi-tāi!” Án-ni ti̍t-ti̍t hoah, hoah nn̄g tiám-cheng kú.

Hit-ê siâⁿ ê su-kì-koaⁿ hō͘ kûn-chiòng lóng an-chēng liáu-āu, kóng, “ Í-hut-só͘ -lâng, siáⁿ-lâng m̄ chai Í-hut-só͘ -siâⁿ sī úi-tāi ê A-tí-bí -biō kap tùi thiⁿ lak--lo̍h-lâi hit-tè sèng-chio̍h ê siú-hō͘-chiá?
Kì-jiân bô lâng ōe-tàng hó͘-jīn chit-ê tāi-chì, lín eng-kai an-chēng, m̄-thang chhiong-tōng.
Lín thoa chiah-ê lâng lâi chia, m̄-kú in pèng bô chhiúⁿ sī-biō, mā bô siat-to̍k lán ê lú-sîn.
Tí-bí-te̍k kap i ê sai-hū nā beh khòng-kò, ū khui-têng ê ji̍t-chí kap chú-chhî sò͘-siōng ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ, in thang thê-chhut kò-sò͘.
Lín nā ū kî-tha ê iau-kiû, thang tī tēng-kî ê hōe-gī kái-koat.
Kin-á-ji̍t só͘ hoat-seng ê tāi-chì, lán kiaⁿ-liáu ōe hō͘ lâng tui-kiù chek-jīm, koh tùi chit-khoán ê hūn-loān, lán mā the̍h bōe chhut lí-iû thang piān-kái.”
Kóng chiah-ê ōe liáu-āu, I chiū soan-pò͘ sòaⁿ-hōe.
Jiáu-loān pêng-chēng liáu-āu, Pó-lô tiàu-chi̍p bûn-tô͘, kā in bián-lē, kap in saⁿ-sî, chiū lī-khui hia khì Má-kî-tùn.
I keng-kè hiah-ê tōe-khu, kóng chin chōe ōe bián-lē sìn-tô͘, jiân-āu khì Hi-la̍h,
tī hia tòa saⁿ kò-ge̍h. I chún-pī beh chē-chûn khì Sū-lī-a ê sî, Iû-thài -lâng kè-bô͘ beh hāi i, chiū koat-tēng keng-kè Má-kî-tùn tńg--khì.

Kap i chòe-hé khì--ê, ū Pì-lí-a -lâng Pit-lô-su ê kiáⁿ Só͘-pa-te̍k, koh ū Thiap-sat-lô-nî-ka -lâng A-lí-ta̍t-kó͘ kap Se-kong-to͘, Te̍k-pì -lâng Kai-iû, koh ū Thê-mô͘-thài kap A-sè-a -lâng Chhui-ki-kó͘ kap Te̍k-lô-hui-mô͘.
Chiah-ê lâng seng chhut-hoat, tī Te̍k-lô-a teh thèng-hāu goán.
Tû-kàⁿ-choeh kè-liáu, goán tùi Hui-li̍p-pí khui-chûn, gō͘ ji̍t āu kàu Te̍k-lô-a kap in hōe-ha̍p, tī hia tòa chhit ji̍t.
Pài-la̍k àm, goán tāi-ke chū-hōe peh-piáⁿ ê sî, Pó-lô kap tāi-ke tâm-lūn, in-ūi keh-ji̍t chiū beh lī-khui, só͘-í kóng kàu pòaⁿ-mî.
Goán teh chū-hōe hit-keng lâu-téng ê pâng-keng ū tiám chin chōe teng-hé.

Ū chi̍t ê siàu-liân-lâng, kiò-chòe Iû-chhui-kó͘, chē tī thang-á-mn̂g, Pó-lô kè-sio̍k kóng chin kú, i soah khùn tāng-bîn, tùi saⁿ-lâu poa̍h--lo̍h-khì, tāi-ke kā i hû--khí-lâi ê sî í-keng sí.
Pó-lô lo̍h-khì, phak tī i ê seng-khu, kā i lám--teh, kóng, “M̄-bián tio̍h-kip, i iáu ū khùi.”
Jiân-āu i koh peh-khì lâu-téng, peh-piáⁿ, chia̍h, kè-sio̍k kap in tâm-lūn chin kú, kàu thiⁿ-kng chiah lī-khui.
In kā hit-ê oa̍h--khí-lâi ê siàu-liân-lâng chhōa--tńg-khì, tāi-ke siū chin tōa ê an-ùi.
Goán seng chiūⁿ-chûn, khui-khì A-sok, thang tī hia chiap Pó-lô chiūⁿ-chûn; in-ūi i beh kiâⁿ lio̍k-lō͘ khì hia, só͘-í ū án-ni an-pâi.
I tī A-sok kap goán hōe-ha̍p, goán chiū chiap i chiūⁿ-chûn khì Bí-chhui-lī-nî.
Goán tùi hia khui-chûn, keh-ji̍t kàu Ki-o ê tùi-bīn-hōaⁿ, chi̍t ji̍t āu tī Sat-mô͘ khò-hōaⁿ, koh keh-ji̍t kàu Bí-lī-to͘.

Pó-lô í-keng koat-tēng bô ài tī Í-hut-só͘ thêng-liû, chiah bián tī A-sè-a chhiân sî-kan. I beh kóaⁿ-kín khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, khòaⁿ ōe-tàng tī Gō͘-sûn-choeh í-chêng kàu-ūi bōe.
Pó-lô tùi Bí-lī-to͘ chhe lâng khì Í-hut-só͘, tiàu-chi̍p kàu-hōe ê tiúⁿ-ló lâi.
In kàu-ūi ê sî, Pó-lô tùi in kóng, “Tùi góa lâi kàu A-sè-a hit-ji̍t khí it-ti̍t kàu hiān-chāi, góa kap lín án-chóaⁿ chòe-hé seng-oa̍h, lín lóng chai.
Sui-jiân góa ū tùi Iû-thài -lâng ê kè-bô͘ siū-tio̍h chhì-liān, iáu-kú hui-siông khiam-pi koh lâu ba̍k-sái teh ho̍k-sāi Chú.
Bô-lūn tī kong-kiōng ê tiûⁿ-ha̍p á-sī kò-pia̍t ê ka-têng, nā tùi lín ū lī-ek--ê, góa m̄-bat bô tùi lín thoân, bô kā lín kà;
tùi Iû-thài -lâng kap Hi-la̍h -lâng, góa lóng giâm-giâm khoàn-kò in tio̍h hóe-kái kui-ǹg Siōng-tè, koh sìn lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘.
Hiān-chāi, góa sūn-ho̍k Sèng Sîn beh khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tī hia ōe tú-tio̍h sím-mi̍h tāi-chì, góa m̄ chai,
put-kò góa chai, Sèng Sîn kā góa kéng-kò, kóng tī ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-chhī ū kaⁿ-ga̍k kap hoān-lān teh thèng-hāu góa.

M̄-kú ūi-tio̍h beh kiâⁿ-oân góa ê lō͘-thêng, oân-sêng Chú Iâ-so͘ kau-tài góa ê jīm-bū, thang kiàn-chèng Siōng-tè un-tián ê hok-im, góa oân-choân bô sioh ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.
“Góa it-ti̍t tī lín tiong-kan chhut-ji̍p teh soan-iông Siōng-tè-kok, hiān-chāi góa chai, í-āu lín bōe-tàng koh kìⁿ-tio̍h góa.
Só͘-í, kin-á-ji̍t góa kā lín kóng chheng-chhó, lín tiong-kan nā ū lâng tîm-lûn, m̄-sī góa ê chek-jīm,
in-ūi góa í-keng chiong Siōng-tè ê chí-ì lóng-chóng thoân hō͘ lín lah.

Lín ka-kī tio̍h kín-sīn, mā tio̍h chiàu-kò͘ Sèng Sîn kau-thok hō͘ lín lóng-chóng ê iûⁿ-kûn, choh kam-tok lâi bo̍k-ióng Siōng-tè ê kàu-hōe, chiū-sī I ēng ka-kī ê Kiáⁿ ê sí lâi sio̍k-hôe--ê.
Góa chai góa lī-khui liáu-āu ū hiong-ok ê chhâi-lông ōe ji̍p-lâi lín tiong-kan siong-hāi iûⁿ-kûn.
Sīm-chì tī lín tiong-kan ū lâng ōe chhut-lâi khiok-kái chin-lí, ín-iú bûn-tô͘ khì tè in.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h kéng-séng, ōe-kì-tit góa saⁿ nî kú mî-ji̍t lâu ba̍k-sái khoàn-kài lín ta̍k-ê lâng.

“Hiān-chāi góa chiong lín kau-thok hō͘ Siōng-tè, thang tùi I un-tián ê sìn-sit tit-tio̍h chō-chiū, hō͘ lín kap sèng-hòa kui Chú ê lâng lóng thang kè-sêng I só͘ sù ê hok-hūn.
Góa m̄-bat tham lâng ê kim, gûn, á-sī i-ho̍k.
Lín ka-kī chai, góa ēng chit nn̄g ki chhiú chòe kang lâi kiong-kip ka-kī kap tâng-phōaⁿ ê su-iàu.

Ta̍k-hāng sū góa lóng ū chòe hō͘ lín khòaⁿ, ài lín it-tēng tio̍h phah-piàⁿ chòe kang lâi pang-chān loán-jio̍k ê lâng. Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Chú Iâ-so͘ ka-kī só͘ kóng ê ōe: ‘Hō͘-lâng--ê pí niá-siū--ê khah ū hok-khì.’”
Chiah-ê ōe kóng soah, Pó-lô kap in tāi-ke lóng kūi lo̍h-khì kî-tó.
Tāi-ke tōa-siaⁿ háu, kā i lám, kā i chim;
in-ūi Pó-lô kóng “Í-āu bōe-tàng koh saⁿ-kìⁿ” chit-kù ōe hō͘ in hui-siông siong-sim. Jiân-āu in sàng i chiūⁿ-chûn.
Lī-pia̍t chèng-lâng liáu-āu, goán khui-chûn it-ti̍t kàu Ko-sū, keh-ji̍t kàu Lô-tí, tùi hia khì Phà-tāi-lat,
tī hia tú-tio̍h chi̍t chiah beh kè-khì Hui-nî-ki ê chûn, goán chiū chiūⁿ-chûn chhut-hoat.
Goán lâi kàu khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h Sài-phó͘-lō͘-su ê sî, tùi lâm-pêng se̍h--kè, khì Sū-lī-a, tī Thài-ní lo̍h-chûn, in-ūi chûn beh tī hia lo̍h-hè.
Goán chhē-tio̍h chi̍t-kóa bûn-tô͘, tī hia kap in tòa chhit ji̍t. In tit-tio̍h Sèng Sîn ê chí-sī, khǹg Pó-lô m̄-thang chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Goán kap in lī-pia̍t ê sî-kan kàu chiū lī-khui, kè-sio̍k goán ê lō͘-thêng. In lóng chhōa in ê bó͘-kiáⁿ sàng goán kàu siâⁿ-gōa, tī hái-piⁿ kūi lo̍h-khì kî-tó,
hō͘-siōng saⁿ-sî liáu-āu goán chiūⁿ-chûn, in tò-khì in tau.
Goán kè-sio̍k hâng-thêng tùi Thài-ní khì kàu To-lī-mái, tī hia kā sìn-tô͘ chhéng-an, kap in tòa chi̍t ji̍t.
Keh-ji̍t, goán chhut-hoat khì Khái-sat-lī-a, tī hia tòa tī thoân hok-im ê Hui-le̍k ê chhù, i sī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hit chhit ê chip-sū ê chi̍t ê.
I ū sì ê iáu-bē kiat-hun ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ, lóng chòe sian-ti ōe kóng ū-giân.
Goán tòa tī hia kúi-nā ji̍t ê tiong-kan, ū chi̍t ê sian-ti kiò-chòe A-ka-pò͘ tùi Iû-thài lo̍h--lâi.

I lâi chhē goán, the̍h Pó-lô ê io-tòa pa̍k ka-kī ê kha kap chhiú, kóng, “Sèng Sîn án-ni kóng, ‘Chit-tiâu io-tòa ê chú-lâng ōe tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng pa̍k--khí-lâi, jiân-āu kau hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng.’”
Goán chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ--tio̍h, chiū kap hit só͘-chāi ê lâng khó͘-khǹg Pó-lô m̄-thang chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.

Pó-lô ìn kóng, “Lín ná khàu kah án-ni, hō͘ góa ê sim kiông-beh chhùi--khì? Góa ūi-tio̍h Chú Iâ-so͘ ê miâ, m̄-nā tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng hō͘ lâng pa̍k, sīm-chì tī hia sí mā kam-goān.”
I m̄ siū khó͘-khǹg, goán chiū tiām-tiām, chí-ū kóng, “Goān Chú ê chí-ì si̍t-hiān!”
Kúi-nā ji̍t āu, goán chún-pī hó-sè, chiū chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Ū chi̍t-kóa tùi Khái-sat-lī-a lâi ê bûn-tô͘ mā kap goán khì, chhōa goán khì Sài-phó͘-lō͘-su -lâng Ná-sun ê chhù tòa; i sī chá-kî ê bûn-tô͘.
Goán kàu Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sî, sìn-tô͘ jia̍t-sêng chiap-thāi goán.
Keh-ji̍t, Pó-lô kap goán khì hóng-būn Ngá-kok; kàu-hōe ê chèng tiúⁿ-ló lóng tī hia.
Pó-lô kā in chhéng-an, jiân-āu chiong Siōng-tè thong-kè i tī Gōa-pang-lâng ê tiong-kan só͘ chòe ê kang-chok chi̍t-hāng chi̍t-hāng tùi in pò-kò.
In thiaⁿ-liáu lóng kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè, tùi Pó-lô kóng, “Hiaⁿ-tī, lí chai, tī chia ū kúi-nā bān Iû-thài -lâng chiâⁿ-chòe sìn-tô͘, in lóng jia̍t-sim chun-siú Lu̍t-hoat.

In ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí kà-sī tòa tī Gōa-pang ê Iû-thài -lâng, kiò in hòng-khì Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat, m̄-bián kā in ê gín-á kiâⁿ kat-lé, mā m̄-bián siú Iû-thài -lâng ê hong-sio̍k si̍p-koàn.
In it-tēng ōe thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí lâi chia ê siau-sit, án-ni beh án-chóaⁿ?
Taⁿ tio̍h chiàu goán kā lí kóng--ê khì chòe. Chia ū sì ê hē-goān ê ta-po͘-lâng;

lí chhōa in chòe-hé khì chham-ka kiat-chēng-lé, thòe in la̍p só͘-hùi, hō͘ in thang thì-thâu. Lí án-ni chòe, chèng-lâng chiū chai, in só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h koan-hē lí ê sū m̄-sī sū-si̍t, koh chai lí ka-kī mā ū teh chun-siú Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat.

Put-kò tùi í-keng chòe sìn-tô͘ ê Gōa-pang-lâng, goán í-keng ū siá-phoe kā in kóng, goán ū chhâi-koat kiò in m̄-thang chia̍h chè ngó͘-siōng ê mi̍h, huih, kap ni̍h-sí ê cheng-siⁿ, mā m̄-thang ū îm-loān.”

Keh-ji̍t, Pó-lô chhōa hit sì ê ta-po͘-lâng kap in chòe-hé khì chham-ka kiat-chēng-lé, jiân-āu ji̍p-khì Sèng-tiān pò-kò kiat-chēng-lé sím-mi̍h sî móa, thang ūi-tio̍h in ta̍k-ê lâng hiàn chè-mi̍h.
Chhit ji̍t ê kî teh-beh móa ê sî, chi̍t-kóa tùi A-sè-a lâi ê Iû-thài -lâng ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Pó-lô tī Sèng-tiān lāi, chiū siàn-tōng kûn-chiòng lia̍h Pó-lô,

hoah kóng, “ Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, lâi tàu-saⁿ-kāng chi̍t-ē! Chit-ê lâng ta̍k só͘-chāi kà lâng hoán-tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat, mā hoán-tùi chit-ê Sèng-tiān. Hiān-chāi i koh káⁿ chhōa Hi-la̍h -lâng chìn-ji̍p Sèng-tiān, ù-jiám chit-ê sîn-sèng ê só͘-chāi.”
In-ūi in ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h Í-hut-só͘ -lâng Te̍k-lô-hui-mô͘ kap Pó-lô chòe-hé tī siâⁿ-lāi, siūⁿ-kóng Pó-lô ū chhōa i ji̍p-khì Sèng-tiān.
Choân-siâⁿ jiáu-loān--khí-lâi, bîn-chiòng lóng cháu óa--lâi; in lia̍h Pó-lô, kā i thoa chhut-khì Sèng-tiān ê gōa-bīn, tiān ê mn̂g sûi-sî koaiⁿ--khí-lâi.
In tú siūⁿ-beh thâi Pó-lô ê sî, ū siau-sit thoân kàu Lô-má kun-iâⁿ ê chí-hui-koaⁿ hia, kóng choân Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng teh khí jiáu-loān.
Chí-hui-koaⁿ sûi-sî tòa peng kap kun-koaⁿ cháu kàu bîn-chiòng hia. Bîn-chiòng chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h chí-hui-koaⁿ kap peng chiū thêng-chhiú, bô koh phah Pó-lô.
Chí-hui-koaⁿ óa-khì lia̍h Pó-lô, kiò lâng ēng nn̄g tiâu thih-liān kā i liān--teh, koh mn̄g i sī siáⁿ-lâng, ū chòe sím-mi̍h tāi-chì.
Kûn-chiòng chi̍t ê hoah chi̍t khoán, in-ūi loān-chhau-chhau, chí-hui-koaⁿ bô hoat-tō͘ thang chai si̍t-chêng, chiū bēng-lēng peng ah Pó-lô ji̍p-khì iâⁿ-pâng.
Pó-lô teh-beh peh gîm-á ê sî, in-ūi kûn-chiòng hiông-kài-kài, peng soah tio̍h kā Pó-lô kng--ji̍p-khì.
Kûn-chiòng tè tī āu-bīn hoah kóng, “Hō͘ i sí!”
Pó-lô tú-beh hō͘ lâng ah ji̍p-khì iâⁿ-pâng ê sî tùi chí-hui-koaⁿ kóng, “Góa ōe-tàng kā lí kóng chi̍t kù ōe bōe?” Chí-hui-koaⁿ mn̄g kóng, “Lí bat Hi-la̍h-gú o͘h!
Án-ni lí chiū m̄-sī hit-ê bô kú í-chêng chō-hoán, chhōa sì chheng ê sat-chhiú cháu-khì khòng-iá ê Ai-ki̍p -lâng lo͘h.”
Pó-lô ìn kóng, “Góa sī Iû-thài -lâng, chhut-sì tī Ki-lī-ka ê Tāi-sò͘, sī chi̍t ê put-chí ū-miâ ê siâⁿ-chhī ê chhī-bîn. Chhiáⁿ lí chún góa tùi bîn-chiòng kóng-ōe.”
Chí-hui-koaⁿ ún-chún, Pó-lô chiū khiā tī gîm-á téng tùi bîn-chiòng pí chhiú-sè. Chèng-lâng lóng tiām--lo̍h-khì, Pó-lô chiū ēng Hi-pek-lâi-ōe tùi in kóng-ōe.
Pó-lô kóng, “Kok-ūi hū-ló hiaⁿ-tī, chhiáⁿ thiaⁿ góa chit-chūn beh ūi-tio̍h ka-kī piān-hō͘ ê ōe.”
In chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h Pó-lô ēng Hi-pek-lâi-ōe tùi in kóng-ōe, chiū koh-khah an-chēng. Pó-lô kóng:

“Góa sī Iû-thài -lâng, tī Ki-lī-ka ê Tāi-sò͘ chhut-sì, tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tōa-hàn, chòe Ka-má-lia̍t ê ha̍k-seng, kap kin-á-ji̍t tī chia ê chu-ūi kâng-khoán ū siū lán chó͘-sian Lu̍t-hoat giâm-keh ê kàu-io̍k, jia̍t-sim ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè.
Góa bat pek-hāi sìn-hōng chit-ê Tō-lō͘ ê lâng, hō͘ in tì-kàu sí, bô-lūn lâm, lú, lóng kā in lia̍h-khì koaiⁿ-kaⁿ.

Tōa-chè-si kap gī-hōe lóng-chóng ê tiúⁿ-ló ōe-tàng ūi góa choh-chèng. Góa mā ū tùi in tit-tio̍h hō͘ Tāi-má-sū-kek Iû-thài tông-pau ê phoe. Āu-lâi góa ū khì hia beh pa̍k tòa tī hia ê sìn-tô͘, kā in lia̍h-lâi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siū hêng-hoa̍t.
“Góa kiâⁿ beh kàu Tāi-má-sū-kek ê sî, chha-put-to sī tiong-tàu, hut-jiân ū chin kiông ê kng tùi thiⁿ-téng chiò tī góa ê chiu-ûi.
Góa poa̍h lo̍h-khì thô͘-kha, thiaⁿ-tio̍h ū siaⁿ tùi góa kóng, ‘ Sò-lô, Sò-lô! Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ teh pek-hāi góa?’
Góa mn̄g kóng, ‘Chú ah, lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?’ I ìn góa kóng, ‘Góa chiū-sī lí teh pek-hāi ê Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘.’
Hiah-ê kap góa chòe-tīn kiâⁿ ê lâng ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-ê kng, bô thiaⁿ-tio̍h tùi góa kóng-ōe Hit-ūi ê siaⁿ.

Góa koh mn̄g kóng, ‘Chú ah, góa tio̍h chòe sím-mi̍h?’ Chú tùi góa kóng, ‘Khí--lâi, ji̍p-khì Tāi-má-sū-kek, tī hia ū lâng ōe chiong góa beh chí-phài lí khì chòe lóng-chóng ê tāi-chì kā lí kóng.’
In-ūi hit-ê kng chin chha̍k-ba̍k, góa soah bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, góa ê tâng-phōaⁿ chiū khan góa ji̍p-khì Tāi-má-sū-kek.
