“Tī hia ū chi̍t ê lâng kiò-chòe A-ná-nî-a, sī chi̍t ê chun-siú Mô͘-se Lu̍t-hoat khiân-sêng ê lâng, put-chí siū Tāi-má-sū-kek ê Iû-thài -lâng chun-kèng.
I lâi chhē góa, khiā tī góa ê sin-piⁿ, kóng, ‘ Sò-lô hiaⁿ-tī, hō͘ lí ōe koh khòaⁿ--kìⁿ!’ Hit-chūn góa sûi-sî ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h i.
I kóng, ‘Lán chó͘-sian ê Siōng-tè í-keng kéng-soán lí, hō͘ lí chai I ê chí-ì, thang khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I hit-ūi Kong-gī ê Po̍k-jîn, koh thiaⁿ-tio̍h I ê chhùi só͘ chhut ê siaⁿ,
in-ūi lí ōe chiong lí só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê tùi bān-bîn chòe kiàn-chèng.
Ná iáu-teh iân-chhiân, khí-lâi niá-siū sóe-lé, kiû-kiò I ê miâ thang hō͘ lí ê chōe tit-tio̍h chheng-khì!’”
“Āu-lâi, góa tò-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; tī Sèng-tiān teh kî-tó ê sî ji̍p-sîn,
khòaⁿ-tio̍h Chú kā góa kóng, ‘Kóaⁿ-kín, sûi-sî lī-khui Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, in-ūi chit só͘-chāi ê lâng bōe chiap-siū lí ūi-tio̍h góa só͘ chòe ê kiàn-chèng.’
Góa ìn kóng, ‘Chú ah, in ka-kī chai góa í-chêng khì ta̍k-ê hōe-tn̂g lia̍h sìn lí ê lâng koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ, koh kā in phah.
Lí ê kiàn-chèng-jîn Sū-thê-hoán hō͘ lâng sat-hāi ê sî, góa mā khiā tī piⁿ--á, chàn-tông in, koh kā hāi-sí i ê lâng kò͘ gōa-saⁿ.’
Chú tùi góa kóng, ‘Lí khì, in-ūi góa beh chhe lí khì hn̄g-hn̄g ê Gōa-pang-lâng hia.’”
Chèng-lâng it-ti̍t chù-ì thiaⁿ, kàu Pó-lô kóng chit-kù ōe ê sî, in tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “Chit-khoán lâng tio̍h tùi tōe-chiūⁿ siau-bia̍t! M̄-thang hō͘ i oa̍h!”
In tōa-siaⁿ jióng, thiah-phòa gōa-saⁿ, ǹg khong-tiong iā thô͘-hún ê sî,
Lô-má ê chí-hui-koaⁿ bēng-lēng lâng chiong Pó-lô ah ji̍p-khì iâⁿ-pâng, ēng piⁿ kā i phah, ūi-tio̍h beh khak-si̍t chai Iû-thài -lâng sī-án-chóaⁿ teh kā i jióng.
In kā i pa̍k khí-lâi beh piⁿ-phah ê sî, Pó-lô tùi khiā tī piⁿ--á ê kun-koaⁿ kóng, “Tùi chi̍t ê bô siū phòaⁿ-chōe ê Lô-má kong-bîn, lín ēng piⁿ kā i phah kiám ū ha̍p-hoat?”
Hit-ê kun-koaⁿ chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ--tio̍h chiū khì kìⁿ chí-hui-koaⁿ, tùi i kóng, “Taⁿ beh án-chóaⁿ? Chit-ê lâng sī Lô-má kong-bîn!”
Chí-hui-koaⁿ khì kìⁿ Pó-lô, mn̄g i kóng, “Kā góa kóng, lí sī Lô-má ê kong-bîn sī--bô?” Pó-lô ìn kóng, “Sī.”
Chí-hui-koaⁿ kóng, “Góa ēng chin chōe chîⁿ chiah tit-tio̍h chit-ê kong-bîn-koân.” Pó-lô kóng, “Góa chhut-sì chiū-sī Lô-má kong-bîn.”
Hiah-ê beh sím-mn̄g Pó-lô ê lâng sûi-sî lī-khui. Chí-hui-koaⁿ chi̍t-ē chai Pó-lô sī Lô-má kong-bîn, koh in-ūi kā i pa̍k--teh, chiū chin kiaⁿ.

Keh-ji̍t, Chí-hui-koaⁿ ài chai Iû-thài -lâng khòng-kò Pó-lô khak-si̍t ê lí-iû, chiū kā i tháu-khui, koh bēng-lēng chè-si-tiúⁿ kap choân gī-hōe chū-chi̍p, chhōa Pó-lô chhut--lâi, hō͘ i khiā tī in bīn-chêng.
Pó-lô chù-ba̍k khòaⁿ gī-oân, kóng, “Kok-ūi hiaⁿ-tī, góa tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng chiàu oân-choân chheng-pe̍k ê liông-sim seng-oa̍h, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.”
Tōa-chè-si A-ná-nî-a bēng-lēng khiā tī Pó-lô sin-piⁿ ê lâng kā i siàn chhùi-phóe.

Pó-lô tùi i kóng, “Lí chit-ê chhat kah pe̍h-pe̍h ê chhiûⁿ, Siōng-tè beh phah lí! Lí khui-têng eng-kai chiàu hoat-lu̍t kā góa sím-phòaⁿ, lí kèng-jiân ûi-hoat bēng-lēng lâng phah góa!”
Khiā tī Pó-lô piⁿ--á ê lâng kóng, “Lí káⁿ mē Siōng-tè ê tōa-chè-si?”
Pó-lô ìn kóng, “Hiaⁿ-tī ah, góa m̄ chai i sī tōa-chè-si; Sèng-keng ū kì-chài kóng, ‘M̄-thang bú-jio̍k tī-lí jîn-bîn ê tiúⁿ-koaⁿ.’”

Pó-lô chi̍t-ē chai-iáⁿ in tiong-kan ū-ê sī Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng, ū-ê sī Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng, chiū tī gī-hōe hoah kóng, “Hiaⁿ-tī, góa sī Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng, sī Hoat-lī-sài-lâng ê kiáⁿ, góa siū sím-mn̄g sī in-ūi ǹg-bāng sí-lâng ê koh-oa̍h!”
I chi̍t-ē án-ni kóng, Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng kap Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng chiū khí cheng-lūn, gī-hōe mā hun-lia̍t.
In-ūi Sat-to͘-kai-phài ê lâng kóng bô koh-oa̍h, bô thiⁿ-sài, mā bô kúi-sîn, m̄-kú Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê lâng chit saⁿ hāng lóng ū sìn.

Soan-jióng ê siaⁿ ná lâi ná tōa, kúi-nā ê Hoat-lī-sài-phài ê keng-ha̍k-kàu-su khiā--khí-lâi, ke̍k-le̍k khòng-gī kóng, “Goán chhē bōe chhut chit-ê lâng ū sím-mi̍h chhò-gō͘. Káⁿ chin-chiàⁿ ū kúi-sîn á-sī thiⁿ-sài tùi i kóng-ōe ô͘?”

Cheng-lūn ná lâi ná ke̍k-lia̍t, chí-hui-koaⁿ kiaⁿ-liáu Pó-lô hō͘ in thiah-chhùi, chiū bēng-lēng peng lo̍h-khì tùi chèng-lâng tiong-kan kā Pó-lô chhiúⁿ--chhut-lâi, chhōa ji̍p-khì iâⁿ-pâng.

Hit-mî, Chú khiā tī Pó-lô ê sin-piⁿ, kóng, “Tio̍h ióng-kám! Lí í-keng ū tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ūi-tio̍h góa chòe kiàn-chèng, mā it-tēng tio̍h tī Lô-má ūi-tio̍h góa chòe kiàn-chèng.”
Keh-chá-khí, Iû-thài -lâng tàu-tīn kè-bô͘, chiù-chōa nā bô thâi-sí Pó-lô m̄-chia̍h-m̄-lim.
Ū sì-cha̍p gōa ê lâng chham-ka chit-ê im-bô͘.
In khì kìⁿ chè-si-tiúⁿ kap tiúⁿ-ló, kóng, “Goán í-keng chiù tāng-chōa, nā bô thâi-sí Pó-lô lóng m̄ chia̍h!

Hiān-chāi lín kap gī-hōe tio̍h iau-kiû chí-hui-koaⁿ chhōa Pó-lô lâi hō͘ lín, ké-chòe beh khah siông-sè chhâ-mn̄g i ê àn-kiāⁿ; goán ōe chún-pī hó-sè, tī i kàu chia í-chêng kā i thâi-sí.”
Pó-lô ê gōe-seng thiaⁿ-tio̍h chit-ê bâi-ho̍k ê im-bô͘, chiū ji̍p-khì peng-iâⁿ kā Pó-lô kóng.
Pó-lô chiū chhiáⁿ chi̍t ê kun-koaⁿ lâi, kā i kóng, “Chhiáⁿ chhōa chit-ê siàu-liân-lâng khì kìⁿ chí-hui-koaⁿ, i ū tāi-chì beh kā i pò-kò.”

Kun-koaⁿ chiū chhōa siàu-liân-lâng khì kìⁿ chí-hui-koaⁿ, kóng, “Hit-ê hoān-lâng Pó-lô kiò góa lâi, iau-kiû góa chhōa chit-ê siàu-liân-lâng lâi kìⁿ lí, in-ūi i ū tāi-chì beh kā lí kóng.”
Chí-hui-koaⁿ khan i ê chhiú khì piⁿ--á mn̄g i, “Lí ū sím-mi̍h tāi-chì beh kā góa pò-kò?”
I kóng, “ Iû-thài -lâng í-keng kóng hó-sè, ké-chòe beh koh-khah siông-sè tiâu-cha Pó-lô ê àn-kiāⁿ, beh chhiáⁿ lí bîn-á-chài kā i sàng-khì gī-hōe.

Chhiáⁿ lí m̄-thang thiaⁿ in ê ōe, in-ūi ū sì-cha̍p gōa ê lâng bâi-ho̍k teh tán i. In chiù-chōa, nā bô thâi-sí Pó-lô m̄-chia̍h-m̄-lim. Hiān-chāi in lóng chún-pī hó-sè, teh thèng-hāu lí ún-chún.”
Chí-hui-koaⁿ chiū hoan-hù siàu-liân-lâng kóng “M̄-thang tùi lâng kóng lí ū pò góa chai chit-hāng tāi-chì”, jiân-āu kiò i tńg--khì.

Chí-hui-koaⁿ kiò nn̄g ê kun-koaⁿ lâi, kā in kóng, “Khì chún-pī pō͘-peng nn̄g-pah ê, bé-peng chhit-cha̍p ê, kap gia̍h-chhiuⁿ ê peng nn̄g-pah ê, thang tī kim-àm káu tiám chhut-hoat khì Khái-sat-lī-a.
Koh khì chún-pī bé hō͘ Pó-lô khiâ, hō͘-sàng i an-choân kàu Hui-le̍k-su chóng-tok hia.”
Chí-hui-koaⁿ chiū siá chi̍t tiuⁿ phoe án-ni kóng:
“ Khek-lô-tē Lū-se-a kā chóng-tok Hui-le̍k-su kok-hā chhéng-an.
Chit-ê lâng hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng lia̍h--khì, teh-beh hō͘ in thâi-sí ê sî, góa chi̍t-ē chai i sī Lô-má kong-bîn, chiū tòa peng khì kā i kiù.
Góa siūⁿ-beh bêng-pe̍k in khòng-kò i ê lí-iû chiū sàng i khì in ê gī-hōe.
Góa hoat-kiàn i hō͘ lâng kò sī koan-hē in Lu̍t-hoat ê cheng-lūn, pèng bô hoān-tio̍h sím-mi̍h kai-sí á-sī tio̍h koaiⁿ-kaⁿ ê chōe.

Āu-lâi ū lâng kā góa pò-kò Iû-thài -lâng kè-bô͘ beh hāi i, só͘-í góa sûi-sî sàng i khì lí hia, siâng-sî bēng-lēng kò i ê lâng mā tio̍h tī lí ê bīn-chêng kā i khòng-kò.”
Pō͘-peng chip-hêng bēng-lēng, thàu-mî chiong Pó-lô tòa-khì An-thê-phà-tí.
Keh-ji̍t pō͘-peng tńg-khì iâⁿ--ni̍h, hō͘ bé-peng kè-sio̍k hō͘-sàng.
In kàu Khái-sat-lī-a, chiong hit-tiuⁿ phoe the̍h hō͘ chóng-tok, mā chiong Pó-lô kau hō͘ i.
Chóng-tok tha̍k hit-tiuⁿ phoe liáu, mn̄g Pó-lô sī tó chi̍t séng ê lâng, chai-iáⁿ sī Ki-lī-ka -séng ê lâng,
chiū kóng, “Kò lí ê lâng kàu-ūi ê sî, góa chiah chhú-lí lí ê àn-kiāⁿ.” Āu-lâi chóng-tok bēng-lēng chiong Pó-lô khu-liû tī Hi-lu̍t ê kong-sú.

Gō͘ ji̍t āu, tōa-chè-si A-ná-nî-a kap kúi-nā ê tiúⁿ-ló, í-ki̍p chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Thiap-thó͘-lô ê lu̍t-su lâi kàu Khái-sat-lī-a. In tī Hui-le̍k-su chóng-tok bīn-chêng kò Pó-lô.

Pó-lô chi̍t-ē siū tiàu chhut-têng, Thiap-thó͘-lô chiū kā i khòng-kò, kóng: “ Hui-le̍k-su kok-hā, in-ūi lí hiân-bêng ê tī-lí hō͘ goán hióng-siū thài-pêng, só͘ si-hêng ê chōe-chōe kái-kek mā hō͘ kok-ka tit-tio̍h chìn-pō͘. Lí ê tek-chèng hō͘ goán ta̍k-sî ta̍k-ūi kám-siā put-chīn.
Góa m̄-káⁿ tam-gō͘ lí siuⁿ kú, kiû lí khoan-iông lâi thiaⁿ goán kán-iàu ê sin-sò͘.
Goán khòaⁿ chit-ê lâng sī chi̍t ê gûi-hiám jîn-bu̍t, tī choân sè-kài ê Iû-thài -lâng tiong-kan chok-loān, sī Ná-sat-le̍k-tóng ê siú-léng.
I siūⁿ-beh ù-jiám Sèng-tiān, goán chiū kā i lia̍h--khí-lâi.
Lí chhin-sin sím-mn̄g chit-ê lâng chiū ōe bêng-pe̍k goán khòng-kò i it-chhè ê tāi-chì.”
Chāi-tiûⁿ ê Iû-thài -lâng mā lóng chi-chhî chit-ê khòng-kò, kóng sū-chêng khak-si̍t sī án-ni.
Chóng-tok tùi Pó-lô sī-ì, kiò i hoat-giân, Pó-lô chiū kóng: “Góa chai lí tī pún-kok phòaⁿ-àn chin chōe nî, góa goān-ì tī lí bīn-chêng ūi-tio̍h ka-kī piān-hō͘.
Lí tiâu-cha chiū ōe bêng-pe̍k, tùi góa chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kèng-pài kàu kin-á-ji̍t chí-ū cha̍p-jī ji̍t.
Iû-thài -lâng pèng bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa tī Sèng-tiān kap lâng piān-lūn, mā bô khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa tī hōe-tn̂g á-sī chhī-lāi siàn-tōng kûn-chiòng.
In mā bōe-tàng tùi lí thê-chhut hiān-chāi teh khòng-kò góa ê chèng-kù.

Put-kò góa tio̍h tùi lí sêng-jīn chi̍t hāng sū, chiū-sī góa chiàu in khòaⁿ-chòe sī īⁿ-toan ê Tō-lō͘ kèng-pài goán chó͘-sian ê Siōng-tè, siong-sìn Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat kap sian-ti ê chheh só͘ kì-chài ê it-chhè.
Góa tùi Siōng-tè ū khǹg kap in kâng-khoán ê ǹg-bāng, chiū-sī bô-lūn hó-lâng á-sī pháiⁿ-lâng lóng ōe tùi sí koh-oa̍h.
In-ūi án-ni, góa tùi Siōng-tè kap lâng lóng chīn-la̍t pó-chhî chheng-pe̍k ê liông-sim.
“Góa lī-khui Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kúi-nā nî āu koh tńg--khì, sī the̍h chi̍t-kóa chîⁿ beh khì kiù-chè tông-pau, koh hiàn chè-mi̍h.
In tī Sèng-tiān khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê sî, góa í-keng oân-sêng kiat-chēng-lé teh hiàn-chè, hit-sî bô kûn-chiòng, mā bô jiáu-loān,
kan-ta ū kúi-nā ê tùi A-sè-a lâi ê Iû-thài -lâng tī hia. In nā beh khòng-kò góa, eng-kai ka-kī lâi lí ê bīn-chêng kò góa chiah tio̍h.
Nā bô, góa tī gī-hōe sin-sò͘ ê sî, in tio̍h chí-chhut góa ū chòe sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h.
Chí-ū chi̍t hāng sū in ōe-tàng kā góa khòng-kò, chiū-sī góa bat khiā tī in tiong-kan tōa-siaⁿ kóng, ‘Góa kin-á-ji̍t siū lín sím-phòaⁿ, sī ūi-tio̍h sí-lâng ê koh-oa̍h.’”
Hui-le̍k-su tùi chit-ê Tō-lō͘ siong-tong chheng-chhó, chiū soan-pò͘ thè-têng, tùi in kóng, “Thèng-hāu chí-hui-koaⁿ Lū-se-a lâi, góa chiah phòaⁿ-koat lín ê àn-kiāⁿ.”
Jiân-āu Hui-le̍k-su bēng-lēng hit-ê kun-koaⁿ kò͘-siú Pó-lô, hō͘ i ū tām-po̍h chū-iû, koh chún i ê pêng-iú tòa i só͘ khiàm-ēng ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ lâi hō͘ i.
Kúi-nā ji̍t āu, Hui-le̍k-su kap i ê Iû-thài hu-jîn Thó͘-se-la lâi. I chhe lâng kiò Pó-lô chhut--lâi, beh thiaⁿ i káng-lūn koan-hē sìn Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê sū.

Pó-lô kóng-kàu kong-gī, chiat-chè, kap chiong-lâi ê Sím-phòaⁿ, Hui-le̍k-su kám-kak kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, chiū tùi Pó-lô kóng, “Chit-pái kàu chia chiū hó, ū ki-hōe góa chiah koh tiàu lí lâi.”
Siâng-sî i mā ū teh kî-thāi Pó-lô ōe sàng-chîⁿ hō͘ i, só͘-í siông-siông kiò Pó-lô chhut--lâi, kap i tâm-lūn.
Keng-kè nn̄g nî, Pho-kiû Hui-su-to͘ chiap Hui-le̍k-su choh chóng-tok. Hui-le̍k-su ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng hoaⁿ-hí, kè-sio̍k kā Pó-lô koaiⁿ tī kaⁿ--ni̍h.
Hui-su-to͘ chiū-jīm saⁿ ji̍t āu, tùi Khái-sat-lī-a chiūⁿ-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Chè-si-tiúⁿ kap Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-siù tùi i khòng-kò Pó-lô. In chhéng-kiû Hui-su-to͘,
pài-thok i chiong Pó-lô sàng-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng. In kè-bô͘ tī lō͘-tiong bâi-ho̍k beh kā i thâi-sí.
Hui-su-to͘ ìn kóng, “ Pó-lô koaiⁿ tī Khái-sat-lī-a, góa ka-kī mā liâm-piⁿ beh tńg-khì hia.
Só͘-í lín tiong-kan chòe thâu ê lâng thang kap góa chòe-hé khì Khái-sat-lī-a, chit-ê lâng nā ū chòe sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h, in thang tī hia kā i kò.”
Hui-su-to͘ tòa hia chiâⁿ-cha̍p ji̍t, chiū tò-khì Khái-sat-lī-a. Keh-ji̍t, i khui-têng, bēng-lēng lâng tòa Pó-lô lâi.

Pó-lô chi̍t-ē chhut-têng, tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng lo̍h--lâi hiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng óa-lâi khiā tī i ê chiu-ûi, ēng chin chōe giâm-tiōng ê chōe-miâ kā i khòng-kò, m̄-kú the̍h bōe chhut chèng-kù.
Pó-lô ūi-tio̍h ka-kī piān-hō͘, kóng, “Góa tùi Iû-thài -lâng ê Lu̍t-hoat, á-sī Sèng-tiān, á-sī Lô-má hông-tè lóng m̄-bat chòe sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h ê tāi-chì.”
M̄-kú Hui-su-to͘ ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng hoaⁿ-hí, chiū mn̄g Pó-lô, “Lí goān-ì chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tī hia ūi-tio̍h chiah-ê kò-sò͘ chiap-siū góa ê sím-phòaⁿ--bô?”
Pó-lô kóng, “Góa hiān-chāi khiā tī hông-tè ê hoat-têng, tong-jiân tio̍h tī chia siū sím-phòaⁿ. Lí bêng-bêng chai, góa pèng bô tek-chōe Iû-thài -lâng.

Góa nā ū chòe m̄-tio̍h, hoān-tio̍h kai-sí ê chōe, chiū-sī tio̍h sí, góa mā choa̍t-tùi bōe tô-pī. M̄-kú in ê khòng-kò nā bô sū-si̍t, bô lâng ōe-tàng kā góa kau hō͘ in. Góa beh tùi hông-tè siōng-sò͘.”
Hui-su-to͘ kap kò͘-būn chham-siông liáu-āu, ìn kóng, “Kì-jiân lí í-keng tùi hông-tè siōng-sò͘, chiū khì hông-tè hia.”
Kè kúi-nā ji̍t, A-ki-phà -ông kap Pek-nî-ki lâi Khái-sat-lī-a, tùi Hui-su-to͘ piáu-sī kèng-ì.
In tī hia tòa kúi-nā ji̍t liáu-āu, Hui-su-to͘ chiong Pó-lô ê àn-kiāⁿ kóng hō͘ A-ki-phà -ông thiaⁿ. I kóng, “Tī chia ū chi̍t ê Hui-le̍k-su lâu--lo̍h-lâi ê hoān-lâng.
Góa khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê sî, Iû-thài -lâng ê chè-si-tiúⁿ kap tiúⁿ-ló ū kā i kò, iau-kiû góa kā i tēng-chōe.
Góa kā in kóng, chiàu Lô-má -lâng ê koàn-lē, pī-kò iáu-bē kap goân-kò bīn-tùi-bīn tùi-chí, iáu bô ki-hōe ūi ka-kī piān-hō͘, bōe-tàng kā i tēng-chōe.
Só͘-í, in lóng kàu-ūi, góa sûi-sî tī keh-ji̍t khui-têng, bēng-lēng tòa hit-ê lâng lâi.
Goân-kò khiā khí-lâi khòng-kò, m̄-kú só͘ kò--ê bô chi̍t hāng sī góa só͘ siūⁿ--ê hiah-ni̍h pháiⁿ.
In kap i cheng-lūn--ê sī in ka-kī ê chong-kàu būn-tôe, í-ki̍p chi̍t ê kiò-chòe Iâ-so͘ ê lâng ê tāi-chì. I í-keng sí, m̄-kú Pó-lô chú-tiuⁿ I iáu-teh oa̍h.
Chiah-ê būn-tôe góa m̄ chai tio̍h án-chóaⁿ tiâu-cha, só͘-í mn̄g Pó-lô khòaⁿ goān-ì chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng tī hia ūi-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì siū sím-phòaⁿ á bô.
M̄-kú Pó-lô chhéng-kiû kè-sio̍k kā i khàu-liû, thèng-hāu hông-tè chhâi-koat, só͘-í góa bēng-lēng kā i khàu-liû kàu sàng-kau hō͘ hông-tè.”
A-ki-phà kā Hui-su-to͘ kóng, “Góa ka-kī mā ài thiaⁿ chit-ê lâng kóng-ōe.” Hui-su-to͘ kóng, “Bîn-á-chài lí ōe-tàng thiaⁿ i kóng.”

Keh-ji̍t, A-ki-phà kap Pek-nî-ki hui-siông chhia-iāⁿ ji̍p-tiûⁿ, chhōa chí-hui-koaⁿ kap chhī-lāi ê iàu-jîn chìn-ji̍p tōa-thiaⁿ. Hui-su-to͘ hā-lēng, Pó-lô chiū hō͘ lâng chhōa--ji̍p-lâi.

Hui-su-to͘ kóng, “ A-ki-phà -ông kap chāi-chō kok-ūi! Lín khòaⁿ chit-ê lâng! Tī chia kap tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng só͘-ū ê Iû-thài -lâng lóng tùi góa chhéng-kiû, hoah kóng tio̍h hō͘ i sí.
M̄-kú góa chhâ bōe chhut i ū hoān-tio̍h sím-mi̍h kai-sí ê chōe. I kì-jiân ka-kī tùi hông-tè siōng-sò͘, góa chiū koat-tēng kā i sàng--khì.

Koan-hē chit-ê lâng, góa bô khak-si̍t ê chu-liāu thang tùi hông-siōng thêng-chàu. In-ūi án-ni góa chiah kā i chhōa-lâi kok-ūi bīn-chêng, te̍k-pia̍t tī A-ki-phà -ông lí ê bīn-chêng, cha-bêng àn-chêng liáu-āu thang tit-tio̍h chu-liāu thêng-chàu.
In-ūi chiàu góa khòaⁿ, ah-sàng siû-hoān, bô chí-bêng i ê chōe-miâ sī bô ha̍p-lí.”
A-ki-phà tùi Pó-lô kóng, “Chún lí ūi-tio̍h ka-kī piān-hō͘.” Pó-lô chiū chhun-chhiú khai-sí piān-hō͘:
“ A-ki-phà -ông, kin-á-ji̍t ōe-tàng tī lí ê bīn-chêng ūi-tio̍h Iû-thài -lâng khòng-kò góa it-chhè ê sū sin-piān, góa kám-kak bān-hēng.
In-ūi lí tùi Iû-thài -lâng ê koàn-lē kap cheng-lūn ê būn-tôe te̍k-pia̍t cheng-thong, só͘-í góa khún-kiû lí nāi-sim thiaⁿ.
“Góa tùi siàu-liân kàu taⁿ, khí-thâu tī góa pún-kok, āu-lâi tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, choh-lâng án-chóaⁿ, só͘-ū ê Iû-thài -lâng lóng chai.

In í-keng bat góa chin kú, nā khéng, ōe-tàng ūi-tio̍h góa choh-chèng. Góa choh chi̍t ê Hoat-lī-sài-lâng, ū chiàu goán ê chong-kàu siōng giâm-keh kàu-phài ê iau-kiû teh seng-oa̍h.
Hiān-chāi góa khiā tī chia siū sím-phòaⁿ, sī in-ūi góa ǹg-bāng Siōng-tè tùi goán chó͘-sian ê èng-ún ōe si̍t-hiān;

goán cha̍p-jī chi-cho̍k ê tông-pau mî-ji̍t jia̍t-sim kèng-pài mā-sī ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ chit-ê ǹg-bāng si̍t-hiān. Ông ah, ūi-tio̍h chit-ê ǹg-bāng, góa chiah siū Iû-thài -lâng khòng-kò.
Siōng-tè hō͘ sí-lâng koh-oa̍h chit-hāng tāi-chì, lín sī-án-chóaⁿ toàn-tēng bōe-tàng siong-sìn?
“Í-chêng góa pún-sin mā siūⁿ-kóng tio̍h ēng ta̍k-khoán ê hong-hoat lâi hoán-tùi Ná-sat-le̍k -lâng Iâ-so͘ ê miâ.

Góa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khak-si̍t ū án-ni chòe, m̄-nā ū tùi chè-si-tiúⁿ niá-siū koân-pèng lia̍h chin chōe sìn-tô͘ koaiⁿ-kaⁿ, koh tī in siū chhú-sí ê sî mā piáu-sī chàn-sêng.

Góa sî-siông tī kok-tōe ê hōe-tn̂g kā in hêng-hoa̍t, kiông-pek in siat-to̍k chit-ê sìn-gióng, koh ēng pō-le̍k tùi-thāi in, sīm-chì khì kàu gōa-kok ê siâⁿ-chhī kā in pek-hāi.”
“Ū chi̍t piàn, góa tòa chè-si-tiúⁿ ê koân-pèng kap bēng-lēng khì Tāi-má-sū-kek.
Ông ah, tī pòaⁿ-lō͘, tiong-tàu ê sî, góa khòaⁿ-tio̍h pí ji̍t-thâu koh-khah kiông ê kng tùi thiⁿ-téng chiò--lo̍h-lâi, kā góa kap tâng-kiâⁿ ê lâng tà--teh.

Goán lóng poa̍h lo̍h-khì thô͘-kha. Góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t ê siaⁿ, ēng Hi-pek-lâi-ōe tùi góa kóng, ‘ Sò-lô, Sò-lô, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ teh pek-hāi góa? Lí án-ni chòe, chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng kûn-thâu-bú teh cheng chio̍h-sai, ka-kī thó phê thiàⁿ.’
Góa mn̄g kóng, ‘Chú ah, lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?’ Chú kóng, ‘Góa chiū-sī lí teh pek-hāi ê Iâ-so͘.

Khí--lâi, khiā--teh; góa tùi lí hián-hiān sī beh phài lí chòe góa ê po̍k-jîn ūi-tio̍h só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ koan-hē góa ê sū, í-ki̍p chiong-lâi beh tùi lí hián-hiān ê sū choh-chèng.
Góa beh tùi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kap Gōa-pang-lâng ê tiong-kan kā lí kiù--chhut-lâi, chhe-khián lí khì in hia,

khui in ê ba̍k-chiu, hō͘ in lī-khui o͘-àm chìn-ji̍p kng-bêng, lī-khui Sat-tàn ê koân-sè kui-ǹg Siōng-tè, hō͘ in tùi sìn góa tit-tio̍h sià-chōe, koh sêng-siū choh Siōng-tè soán-bîn ê tōe-ūi.’”
“Só͘-í, A-ki-phà -ông, góa bô ûi-pōe tùi thiⁿ lâi ê īⁿ-siōng.

Góa tāi-seng tùi Tāi-má-sū-kek kap Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê lâng, āu-lâi tùi Iû-thài choân-tōe ê lâng, mā tùi Gōa-pang-lâng thoân-tō, khǹg in tio̍h hóe-kái lâi kui-ǹg Siōng-tè, koh tio̍h ēng hêng-ûi chèng-bêng in ū chin-chiàⁿ hóe-kái.
Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê iân-kò͘, Iû-thài -lâng tī Sèng-tiān lāi lia̍h góa, siūⁿ-beh thâi góa.

Kàu kin-á-ji̍t, góa tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê pang-chān, ōe-tàng khiā tī chia tùi chun-kùi kap pi-bî ê lâng chòe kiàn-chèng. Góa só͘ kóng--ê, kap sian-ti í-ki̍p Mô͘-se só͘ kóng--ê kâng-khoán, sī koan-hē chiong-lâi beh hoat-seng ê sū,
chiū-sī Ki-tok it-tēng tio̍h siū-khó͘, chiâⁿ-chòe thâu chi̍t ê tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h--ê, thang chiong chín-kiù ê kng thoân hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng kap Gōa-pang-lâng.”
Pó-lô án-ni ūi-tio̍h ka-kī teh piān-hō͘ ê sî, Hui-su-to͘ tùi i tōa-siaⁿ hoah, “ Pó-lô, lí khí-kông lah; lí ê phok-ha̍k hō͘ lí khí-kông lah!”
Pó-lô kóng, “ Hui-su-to͘ kok-hā! Góa pèng bô khí-kông; góa só͘ kóng ê ōe chin-si̍t koh ha̍p-lí.

In-ūi ông chai chiah-ê tāi-chì, góa chiah káⁿ tōa-táⁿ tùi ông kóng. Góa siong-sìn ông tùi chiah-ê tāi-chì lóng chin chheng-chhó, in-ūi só͘ hoat-seng chiah-ê tāi-chì bô lâng m̄ chai.
A-ki-phà -ông, lí ū siong-sìn sian-ti--bô? Góa chai lí ū.”
A-ki-phà tùi Pó-lô kóng, “Lí kóng kúi-kù-á ōe chiū beh sòe-ho̍k góa chòe Ki-tok-tô͘ o͘h!”

Pó-lô ìn kóng, “Bô-lūn kúi-kù-á ōe á-sī chin chōe ōe, góa kî-kiû Siōng-tè, m̄-nā sī lí, liân kin-á-ji̍t tī chia só͘-ū thiaⁿ góa kóng-ōe ê lâng mā lóng ōe kap góa kâng-khoán, m̄-kú bô chhin-chhiūⁿ góa hō͘ lâng ēng thih-liān liān--teh.”
Ông, chóng-tok, Pek-nî-ki, kap tâng chē ê lâng lóng khiā--khí-lâi.
In thè-chhut liáu-āu hō͘-siōng tâm-lūn kóng, “Chit-ê lâng pèng bô hoān-tio̍h sím-mi̍h kai-sí á-sī tio̍h koaiⁿ-kaⁿ ê chōe.”
A-ki-phà tùi Hui-su-to͘ kóng, “Chit-ê lâng nā bô tùi hông-tè siōng-sò͘, chá chiū thang kā i pàng lah.”
Hui-su-to͘ í-keng koat-tēng goán tio̍h chē-chûn khì Ì-tāi-lī, in chiū chiong Pó-lô kap kî-tha ê hoān-lâng kau hō͘ hông-ka kìm-ōe-kun chi̍t ê miâ kiò Iû-liû ê kun-koaⁿ.

Goán chē chi̍t chiah tùi A-tāi-bí-tiân lâi ê chûn; chit-chiah chûn tú-á beh iân A-sè-a -séng kúi-nā ê káng-kháu khui-chûn. Ū chi̍t ê tùi Thiap-sat-lô-nî-ka lâi ê Má-kî-tùn -lâng A-lí-ta̍t-kó͘ kap goán chòe-hé khì.
Keh-ji̍t goán kàu Se-tùn. Iû-liû chin chhin-chhiat tùi-thāi Pó-lô, chún i khì kìⁿ i ê pêng-iú, siū in chiau-thāi.
Goán tùi hia koh khui-chûn, in-ūi ge̍k-hong, chiū sūn Sài-phó͘-lō͘-su -tó óa siám-hong hit-pêng kiâⁿ.
Goán keng-kè Ki-lī-ka kap Pông-hui-lī-a ê gōa-hái, lâi kàu Lū-ka ê Múi-la.
Tī hia, kun-koaⁿ Iû-liû chhē-tio̍h chi̍t chiah tùi A-le̍k-san-tāi lâi ê chûn beh khui-khì Ì-tāi-lī, chiū kiò goán chiūⁿ hit-chiah chûn.

Liân-sòa kúi-nā ji̍t, chûn kiâⁿ chin bān, bián-kióng chiah lâi kàu Kek-nî-thó͘ ê gōa-hái. In-ūi siū-tio̍h hong ê chó͘-tòng, goán chiū sūn Khek-lí-te̍k -tó lâm-pêng óa siám-hong hit-pêng hōaⁿ kiâⁿ tùi Sat-mô͘-nî -kak kè--khì.
Goán ê chûn sūn hái-kîⁿ kiâⁿ, bián-kióng lâi kàu lī La-se-a bô jōa hn̄g chi̍t ê kiò-chòe An-choân-káng ê só͘-chāi.
Goán í-keng chhiân chin chōe ji̍t, koh in-ūi kìm-chia̍h ê choeh-kî mā kè-liáu, kiâⁿ-chûn gûi-hiám, só͘-í Pó-lô khǹg tāi-ke,
kóng, “Kok-ūi sian-siⁿ, góa khòaⁿ lán kè-sio̍k kiâⁿ-chûn, m̄-nā hè-mi̍h kap chûn, liân lán ê sìⁿ-miā to ōe tú-tio̍h gûi-hiám koh tōa sún-sit.”
M̄-kú kun-koaⁿ lêng-khó siong-sìn chûn-tiúⁿ kap chûn-chú, m̄ thiaⁿ Pó-lô kóng ê ōe.

Koh chit-ê káng-kháu mā bô sek-ha̍p kè tang-thiⁿ, tōa-pō͘-hūn ê lâng chàn-sêng khui-chûn, ǹg-bāng ōe-tàng kóaⁿ-khì Hui-nî-ki kè tang-thiⁿ. Hui-nî-ki sī Khek-lí-te̍k -tó ê chi̍t ê káng-kháu, chi̍t bīn ǹg sai-lâm, chi̍t bīn ǹg sai-pak.
Hit-sî, lâm-hong bî-bî-á chhe--lâi, tāi-ke siūⁿ-kóng ōe sūn-lī kàu bo̍k-te̍k-tōe chiū khí-tiàⁿ, óa Khek-lí-te̍k -tó ê hái-kîⁿ kiâⁿ.
Bô kú ū chi̍t chūn kiò-chòe Iú-la-kek-lô ê tang-pak tōa-hong tùi Khek-lí-te̍k -tó sàu--lo̍h-lâi.
Chûn hō͘ hong sàu, sái bōe kiâⁿ, chiū chhut-chāi i phiau-liû.
Goán lâi kàu chi̍t ê sió-tó kiò-chòe Ko-tāi ê lâm-pêng, siám-hong ê hit-pêng hōaⁿ, bián-kióng chiong kiù-seng-thêng pa̍k hó-sè.

Jiân-āu chúi-siú chiong kiù-seng-thêng thoa khí-lâi chûn-téng, ēng tōa-soh kā i khún--teh. In kiaⁿ-liáu chûn tī Sài-ní-tí ê soa-chiu khò-chhián, chiū lo̍h-phâng, chhut-chāi i phiau-liû.
Pō-hong kè-sio̍k chhe, keh-ji̍t in khai-sí chiong hè-mi̍h tàn-lo̍h hái.
Tē-saⁿ ji̍t, in koh chhin-chhiú chiong chûn-téng ê khì-khū tàn-tiāu.
Chin chōe ji̍t, ji̍t-thâu khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h, chhiⁿ mā khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h; hong-éng kè-sio̍k phah kah chin lī-hāi, chòe-āu goán oân-choân hòng-khì tit-kiù ê ǹg-bāng.

Chèng-lâng chin kú lóng bô chia̍h, Pó-lô khiā tī in tiong-ng, kóng, “Kok-ūi sian-siⁿ, lín chá nā thiaⁿ góa ê ōe, bô tùi Khek-lí-te̍k khui-chûn, chiū bōe tú-tio̍h chit-khoán ê gûi-hiám kap sún-sit.
Hiān-chāi góa khǹg lín tio̍h ióng-kám; lín tiong-kan bô kah chi̍t ê lâng ōe sòng-sit sìⁿ-miā; kan-ta ōe sit-lo̍h chit-chiah chûn nā-tiāⁿ.
In-ūi góa só͘ sio̍k só͘ kèng-pài ê Siōng-tè, chā-àm ū chhe I ê thiⁿ-sài lâi tùi góa
kóng, ‘ Pó-lô, bián kiaⁿ! Lí it-tēng tio̍h khiā tī hông-tè bīn-chêng. Siōng-tè í-keng chiong chûn-lāi lóng-chóng ê lâng kau-thok lí lah.’
Só͘-í, tio̍h ióng-kám, in-ūi góa siong-sìn tāi-chì it-tēng ōe chiàu Siōng-tè kā góa kóng án-ni si̍t-hiān.
Put-kò lán it-tēng ōe tī chi̍t ê tó-sū khò-chhián.”
Kàu tē-cha̍p-sì ji̍t ê àm-sî, goán iáu tī A-tek-lí-a-hái teh phiau-liû. Kàu pòaⁿ-mî, chúi-siú siūⁿ-kóng goán teh-beh óa-kūn lio̍k-tōe,
chiū tàn chhek-liōng-soh lo̍h-khì thàm, thàm-chhut ū sì-cha̍p kong-chhioh chhim; khah chìn-chêng, koh thàm chi̍t piàn, thàm-chhut ū saⁿ-cha̍p kong-chhioh chhim.
In kiaⁿ-liáu chûn lôe-tio̍h àm-chiau, chiū tùi chûn-bé pha sì ê tiàⁿ, pek-chhiat thèng-hāu thiⁿ kín kng.
Chúi-siú siūⁿ-beh pàng-sak chûn tô-cháu, chiong kiù-seng-thêng lūi lo̍h-khì hái--ni̍h, ké-chòe beh tùi chûn-thâu pha-tiàⁿ.
Pó-lô tùi kun-koaⁿ kap peng-teng kóng, “Chiah-ê lâng nā bô lâu tī chûn-téng, lín chiū bô kiù.”
Peng-teng chiū chām-tn̄g kiù-seng-thêng ê soh, hō͘ i lâu--khì.
Thiⁿ beh kng ê sî, Pó-lô khǹg chèng-lâng tio̍h chia̍h. I kóng, “Lín í-keng thèng-hāu cha̍p-sì ji̍t kú lóng bô chia̍h,
só͘-í góa khǹg lín tio̍h chia̍h chi̍t-kóa mi̍h-kiāⁿ chiah ōe-tàng oa̍h--lo̍h-khì. Lín liân chi̍t ki thâu-mn̂g to bōe sit-lo̍h.”
Pó-lô kóng liáu-āu, the̍h piáⁿ, tī chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng kám-siā Siōng-tè, peh-khui, chia̍h.
Chèng-lâng sim chiū tiāⁿ--lo̍h-lâi, the̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ chia̍h.
Kap goán tâng-chûn ê lâng lóng-chóng ū nn̄g-pah chhit-cha̍p-la̍k ê.
Tāi-ke chia̍h pá liáu-āu, chiong be̍h-á tàn-lo̍h hái, hō͘ chûn khah khin.
Thiⁿ-kng ê sî, chúi-siú m̄ bat hit-ê só͘-chāi, put-kò in khòaⁿ-tio̍h ū chi̍t ê hái-oan ū soa-than, chiū siūⁿ-khòaⁿ ōe-tàng chiong chûn sái chiūⁿ-than á bōe.
In kā soh chām-tn̄g, chiong tiàⁿ hiat-lo̍h hái, koh tháu-khui chûn-tōa ê soh, kā chûn-thâu ê phâng tiàu--khí-lâi, hō͘ i chia̍h-hong, hō͘ chûn sái-chiūⁿ than.
M̄-kú chûn lôe-tio̍h soa-phiâⁿ soah khò-chhián; chûn-thâu kā tiâu--teh bōe tín-tāng, chûn-bé hō͘ tōa-éng phah-phòa.
Peng-teng kiaⁿ-liáu hoān-lâng siû-chúi tô-cháu, siūⁿ-beh kā in lóng thâi-sí.
M̄-kú kun-koaⁿ ài-beh kiù Pó-lô, chiū kā in chó͘-chí. I bēng-lēng ōe-hiáu siû ê lâng seng thiàu-lo̍h chúi, siû chiūⁿ-hōaⁿ;
kî-tha ê lâng chiah lī-iōng chûn-pang á-sī chûn ê phòa-phìⁿ chiūⁿ-lio̍k. Chòe-āu, chèng-lâng lóng an-choân chiūⁿ-hōaⁿ.
Goán an-choân chiūⁿ-lio̍k liáu-āu chiah chai hit-ê tó-sū kiò-chòe Má-ní-tha.
Tong-tōe ê goân-chū-bîn tùi goán hui-siông chhin-chhiat, in-ūi lo̍h-hō͘ koh kôaⁿ, chiū khí-hé kā goán chiap-thāi.
Pó-lô khioh chi̍t khún chhâ, hiat-lo̍h hé, hit-chūn ū chi̍t bé to̍k-chôa in-ūi hé sio sô--chhut-lâi, tîⁿ tī i ê chhiú.

Tong-tōe ê goân-chū-bîn khòaⁿ-tio̍h hit-bé chôa tiàu tī Pó-lô ê chhiú--ni̍h, chiū kóng-lâi-kóng-khì, “Chit-ê lâng it-tēng sī sat-jîn-hoān, sui-jiân tùi hái--ni̍h khioh-tio̍h miā, thian-lí bô iông-ún i oa̍h.”
Pó-lô chiong hit-bé chôa hiù-lo̍h hé--ni̍h, lóng bô siū-siong.

Hiah-ê lâng lóng kim-kim teh khòaⁿ i ê chhiú ōe chéng--khí-lâi, á-sī i ōe hut-jiân lek--lo̍h-khì, sí--khì á bōe. In thèng-hāu chin kú, khòaⁿ i lóng bô tāi-chì, chiū tian-tò siūⁿ-kóng i sī sîn-bêng.
Hái-sū ê thâu-ba̍k Pō͘-pek-liû ū chi̍t tè tōe lī hit só͘-chāi bô jōa hn̄g. I hoan-gêng goán tī hia tòa saⁿ ji̍t, chin chhin-chhiat chiap-thāi goán.
Tng-sî, Pō͘-pek-liû ê lāu-pē hoān-tio̍h jia̍t-pīⁿ kap chhiah-lī, tó tī bîn-chhn̂g. Pó-lô ji̍p--khì, kā i hōaⁿ-chhiú kî-tó, kā i i-hó.
In-ūi chit-ê tāi-chì, tong-tōe kî-tha ê pīⁿ-lâng mā lâi, mā lóng tit-tio̍h i-hó.
In sàng goán chin chōe lé-mi̍h; goán beh khui-chûn ê sî, chiong goán su-iàu ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ sàng kàu chûn-téng hō͘ goán.
Saⁿ ge̍h-ji̍t āu, goán chē tùi A-le̍k-san-tāi lâi, miâ kiò-chòe “Siang-siⁿ-á-sîn” ê chûn chhut-hoat. Chit-chiah chûn tú tī chit-ê tó-sū kè tang-thiⁿ.
Goán tī Sū-la-kó͘ chiūⁿ-hōaⁿ, tī hia thêng-liû saⁿ ji̍t,
āu-lâi tùi hia khui-chûn kàu Lī-ki-ong, keh-ji̍t ū thàu lâm-hong, tē-jī ji̍t chiū kàu Pō͘-tiu-lī.
Goán tī hia tú-tio̍h chi̍t-kóa hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, in chhiáⁿ goán kap in tòa chi̍t lé-pài. Āu-lâi goán lâi kàu Lô-má.
Lô-má ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē thiaⁿ-tio̍h siau-sit, chiū lâi A-pí-o͘ -chhī kap Sam-koán gêng-chiap. Pó-lô kìⁿ-tio̍h in chiū kám-siā Siōng-tè, koh-khah ū ióng-khì.
Goán kàu Lô-má liáu-āu, Pó-lô tit-tio̍h ún-chún kap kò͘-siú i ê peng lēng-gōa tòa.

Saⁿ ji̍t āu, Pó-lô chhiáⁿ tong-tōe Iû-thài -lâng ê léng-siù lâi. In chū-chi̍p ê sî, i tùi in kóng, “Kok-ūi hiaⁿ-tī, góa sui-jiân bô chòe ûi-pōe tông-pau ê tāi-chì á-sī chó͘-sian ê kui-lē, m̄-kú tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng siū lia̍h, sàng-kau hō͘ Lô-má tong-kio̍k.
In sím-mn̄g góa, khòaⁿ góa bô hoān-tio̍h kai-sí ê chōe, ū siūⁿ-beh pàng góa;
put-kò Iû-thài -lâng hoán-tùi, góa chiah ko͘-put-chiong tùi hông-tè siōng-sò͘; kî-si̍t góa bô ì-sù beh khòng-kò ka-kī ê tông-pau.
In-ūi án-ni, góa chiah iau-kiû kap lín kìⁿ-bīn, kap lín tâm-lūn. Góa sī ūi-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ ǹg-bāng Hit-ūi chiah siū thih-liān liān--teh.”
In tùi i kóng, “Koan-hē lí ê tāi-chì, goán pèng bô tùi Iû-thài chiap-tio̍h phoe-sìn, mā bô hiaⁿ-tī lâi tùi goán pò-kò, á-sī kóng lí ê pháiⁿ-ōe.
Put-kò goán ài thiaⁿ lí ê kiàn-kái, in-ūi goán chai lín chit-phài ê lâng tī ta̍k só͘-chāi hō͘ lâng hoán-tùi.”

In kap Pó-lô iok-tēng chi̍t ji̍t, kàu sî ū chin chōe lâng lâi Pó-lô tòa ê só͘-chāi. Tùi chá kàu àm, Pó-lô ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè-kok chòe kiàn-chèng, ín-iōng Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat kap sian-ti ê chheh khǹg in sìn Iâ-so͘.
I só͘ kóng ê ōe ū lâng sìn, ū lâng m̄ sìn.
In tiong-kan ê ì-kiàn bô it-tì; in lī-khui í-chêng, Pó-lô kóng chit-kù ōe: “Sèng Sîn thok sian-ti Í-sài-a tùi lín ê chó͘-sian kóng-liáu chin tio̍h!
I kóng: Lí khì kā chit-ê chú-bîn kóng: Lín thiaⁿ koh thiaⁿ mā bōe liáu-kái; lín khòaⁿ koh khòaⁿ mā bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.

In-ūi chit-ê chú-bîn ê sim í-keng tūn, hī-khang tāng, ba̍k-chiu khoeh. Nā m̄-sī án-ni, in ê ba̍k-chiu ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, hī-khang ōe thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, sim ōe bêng-pe̍k, ōe hôe-sim-tńg-ì, góa chiū kā in i-hó.
“Só͘-í, lín tio̍h chai, Siōng-tè chit-ê chín-kiù ê sìn-sit í-keng thoân hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng. In ōe thiaⁿ-thàn!”
Pó-lô tòa tī ka-kī cho͘ ê chhù chiok-chiok nn̄g nî kú. Lâi hóng-būn ê lâng, i lóng kā in chiap-thāi.
I hó-táⁿ soan-iông Siōng-tè-kok ê sìn-sit, koh kà-sī koan-hē Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê sū, lóng bô siū chó͘-tòng.
Góa sī Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê po̍k-jîn Pó-lô, hōng Siōng-tè soán-tiàu choh sù-tô͘, te̍k-phài lâi thoân I ê hok-im.
Chit-ê hok-im sī Siōng-tè chá-chêng thong-kè I ê chèng sian-ti kì tī Sèng-keng ê èng-ún,

teh kóng-khí I ê Kiáⁿ lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok: Tùi jîn-sèng lâi kóng, I sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi; tùi sèng-kiat ê sîn-sèng lâi kóng, Siōng-tè hō͘ I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, ēng tōa lêng-le̍k hián-bêng I sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ.
Goán tùi I tit-tio̍h un-sù choh sù-tô͘, ūi-tio̍h Ki-tok ê miâ beh hō͘ bān-bîn sìn lâi sūn-thàn,
mā pau-hâm lín chiah-ê siū soán-tiàu kui-sio̍k Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê lâng.

Góa siá chit-tiuⁿ phoe hō͘ lín só͘-ū tòa tī Lô-má, Siōng-tè só͘ thiàⁿ, só͘ soán-tiàu choh I sìn-tô͘ ê lâng. Goān lán ê Pē Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sù lín un-tián kap pêng-an!
Tāi-seng, góa thong-kè Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ūi-tio̍h lín chèng-lâng kám-siā góa ê Siōng-tè, in-ūi lín ê sìn-tek í-keng thoân-piàn choân sè-kài.
Góa soan-iông I ê Kiáⁿ ê hok-im, ēng sim-lêng teh ho̍k-sāi hit-ūi Siōng-tè thang kā góa choh-chèng, góa siông-siông siàu-liām lín,
put-sî tī kî-tó tiong khún-kiû Siōng-tè chiàu I ê hó chí-ì kā góa khui-lō͘, hō͘ góa bô kú chiū ōe-tàng sūn-lī khì lín hia.
Góa chin ài kìⁿ lín, thang kap lín hun-hióng chi̍t-kóa sio̍k-lêng ê un-sù, hō͘ lín kian-kiông;
chiū-sī góa kàu lín tiong-kan ê sî, lín thong-kè góa ê sìn-gióng, góa thong-kè lín ê sìn-gióng, hō͘-siōng tit-tio̍h kó͘-lē.

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa chin ài lín chai, góa chin chōe piàn kè-ōe beh khì lín hia, thang kap tī kî-tha Gōa-pang-lâng ê tiong-kan kâng-khoán, mā tī lín tiong-kan siu-sêng chi̍t-kóa ké-chí, m̄-kú kàu taⁿ iáu ū chó͘-tòng.
Bô-lūn sím-mi̍h khoán lâng, khai-hòa á-sī bī-khai-hòa--ê, ū tì-hūi á-sī bô tì-hūi--ê, góa lóng khiàm in ê chè.
Só͘-í, góa pek-chhiat ǹg-bāng mā ōe-tàng chiong hok-im thoân hō͘ lín tī Lô-má ê lâng.
Góa bô khòaⁿ hok-im chòe kiàn-siàu, in-ūi chit-ê hok-im sī Siōng-tè ê tōa lêng-le̍k, beh chín-kiù só͘-ū sìn ê lâng, tāi-seng Iû-thài -lâng, āu-lâi Gōa-pang-lâng.
In-ūi chit-ê hok-im ū khé-sī Siōng-tè ê gī, chit-ê gī tùi thâu kàu bé lóng sī thong-kè sìn lâi tit-tio̍h. Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài, “Gī ê lâng ōe tùi sìn lâi oa̍h.”
Siōng-tè tùi thiⁿ-téng hoat-chhut siū-khì, khiàn-chek só͘-ū put-khiân put-gī ê lâng; in ê put-gī chó͘-tòng lâng bat chin-lí.
In-ūi Siōng-tè ū tùi in hián-bêng I pún-sin, só͘-í in eng-kai tùi Siōng-tè ū chheng-chhó ê jīm-sek chiah tio̍h.

Tùi chhòng-sè í-lâi, Siōng-tè éng-oán ê tōa lêng-le̍k kap sîn-sèng, sui-jiân jio̍k-gán khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h, m̄-kú thong-kè siū-chō ê mi̍h ōe-tàng chheng-chhó khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, só͘-í in lóng bōe-tàng the chek-jīm.
In-ūi in sui-jiân bat Siōng-tè ia̍h bô chun-tiōng I chòe Siōng-tè, mā bô kā I kám-siā; in ê su-siúⁿ hoán-tńg pìⁿ-chòe khang-khang, sim-su gû-gōng, chhiong-móa o͘-àm.
In chū-chheng chhong-bêng, kî-si̍t gû-gōng.
In bô chiong êng-kng kui hō͘ bōe-sí-bia̍t ê Siōng-tè, hoán-tńg khì pài ōe-sí-bia̍t ê lâng, pe-chiáu, khîm-siù, thâng-thōa téng ê siōng.
Só͘-í, Siōng-tè chhut-chāi in thàn ka-kī sim-lāi ê io̍k-bōng khì chòe bô chheng-khì ê tāi-chì, tì-kàu pí-chhú chau-that ka-kī ê sin-thé.
In ēng hu-ké thòe-ōaⁿ Siōng-tè ê chin-lí. In kèng-pài, ho̍k-sāi pī-chō-bu̍t, bô kèng-pài hit-ūi Chō-bu̍t-chú — I chiah eng-kai éng-oán tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn. Amen!

In-ūi án-ni, Siōng-tè chhut-chāi in hòng-chhiòng thang kiàn-siàu ê jio̍k-io̍k: Cha-bó͘-lâng kap cha-bó͘-lâng ēng ûi-hoán chū-jiân ê sèng-koan-hē tāi-thòe kap ta-po͘-lâng chū-jiân ê koan-hē;

ta-po͘-lâng mā kâng-khoán pàng-sak kap cha-bó͘-lâng chū-jiân ê sèng-koan-hē, pí-chhú io̍k-hé-kong-sim; ta-po͘-lâng kap ta-po͘-lâng chòe kiàn-siàu ê tāi-chì, kiat-kó tio̍h siū phian-chha ê hêng-ûi kai siū ê pò-èng.
Kì-jiân in bô beh chin-chiàⁿ jīn-bat Siōng-tè, Siōng-tè chiū chhut-chāi in ê sim-su pāi-hoāi, khì chòe bô eng-kai chòe ê tāi-chì.
In chhiong-móa ta̍k-khoán ê put-gī, pháiⁿ-sim, tham-sim, ok-to̍k, móa-sim oàn-tò͘, bô͘-sat, tò͘-cheng, kan-chà, im-bô͘, kóng ka-chiah-āu-ōe,
húi-pòng, oàn-hūn Siōng-tè, bú-jio̍k lâng, kiau-ngō͘, khoa-kháu, chè-chō sī-hui, ngó͘-ge̍k pē-bú,
bô bêng-lí, bô siú-iok, bô chêng, bô lîn-bín.
In sui-jiân chai, chiàu Siōng-tè kong-gī ê phòaⁿ-toàn, chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì ê lâng eng-kai sí; in m̄-nā ka-kī chòe, sīm-chì mā chàn-sêng pa̍t-lâng án-ni chòe.

Só͘-í, lí chit-ê phoe-phòaⁿ lâng--ê, bô-lūn lí sī sím-mi̍h-lâng lóng bōe-tàng the chek-jīm; lí phoe-phòaⁿ pa̍t-lâng sī teh phoe-phòaⁿ ka-kī, in-ūi lí phoe-phòaⁿ pa̍t-lâng chòe ê tāi-chì, ka-kī mā ta̍k-hāng lóng khì chòe.
Lán chai, chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì ê lâng, Siōng-tè ōe chiàu sū-si̍t kā in sím-phòaⁿ.
Lí chit-ê lâng, lí phoe-phòaⁿ pa̍t-lâng chòe chiah-ê tāi-chì, ka-kī mā khì chòe kâng-khoán ê tāi-chì, lí siūⁿ-kóng lí ōe-tàng siám-pī Siōng-tè ê sím-phòaⁿ sī--bô?
Á-sī kóng lí khòaⁿ-khin Siōng-tè ke̍k-tōa ê jîn-chû, khoan-iông, kap thun-lún. Lí kiám m̄ chai I ê jîn-chû sī beh chhōa lí hóe-kái?
Lí ngī-sim, m̄ hóe-kái, sī teh ūi-tio̍h ka-kī lúi-chek Siōng-tè ê siū-khì; chit-ê siū-khì ōe tī I kong-gī sím-phòaⁿ hit-ji̍t hián-bêng.
Siōng-tè ōe chiàu ta̍k-lâng ê hêng-ûi kā in pò-èng.
Hiah-ê kian-chhî chòe hó-sū, tui-kiû êng-kng, chun-kùi, kap bōe-pāi-hoāi ê sìⁿ-miā ê lâng, Siōng-tè ōe sù in éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Hiah-ê chū-su, bô chun-thàn chin-lí, khì thàn put-gī ê lâng, Siōng-tè ê siū-khì kap hêng-hoa̍t ōe lîm-kàu in.
Só͘-ū chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng ōe siū-tio̍h hoān-lān khùn-khó͘, tāi-seng sī Iû-thài -lâng, āu-lâi chiah Gōa-pang-lâng.
Put-kò só͘-ū chòe hó ê lâng ōe tit-tio̍h êng-kng, chun-kùi, kap pêng-an, tāi-seng sī Iû-thài -lâng, āu-lâi chiah Gōa-pang-lâng;
in-ūi Siōng-tè bô phian-thāi lâng.

Gōa-pang-lâng bô Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat, nā hoān-chōe mā ōe siū Lu̍t-hoat-gōa ê sím-phòaⁿ lâi bia̍t-bông; Iû-thài -lâng ū Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat, nā hoān-chōe ōe chiàu Lu̍t-hoat siū sím-phòaⁿ.
In-ūi, m̄-sī thiaⁿ Lu̍t-hoat ê lâng tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng sī gī-lâng, chí-ū si̍t-hêng Lu̍t-hoat ê lâng chiah ōe hō͘ Siōng-tè soan-phòaⁿ chòe gī-lâng.
Bô Lu̍t-hoat ê Gōa-pang-lâng nā chiàu pún-sèng chun-siú Lu̍t-hoat ê kui-tēng, in sui-jiân bô Lu̍t-hoat, ka-kī chiū-sī lu̍t-hoat;
án-ni piáu-sī Lu̍t-hoat ê iau-kiû ū khek tī in sim-lāi. In ê liông-sim mā chèng-si̍t, in ê sim-su ū-sî ka-kī chek-pī, ū-sî ka-kī piān-hō͘.
Án-ni, tī hit-ji̍t, chiàu góa só͘ thoân ê hok-im, Siōng-tè ōe thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ lâi sím-phòaⁿ lâng ún-ba̍t ê sū.
Án-ni lí leh, lí chū-chheng Iû-thài -lâng, óa-khò Lu̍t-hoat, koh ēng Siōng-tè chòe khoa-kháu.
Lí bêng-pe̍k Siōng-tè ê chí-ì, ū siū-kè Lu̍t-hoat ê kàu-tō, ōe-hiáu hun-pia̍t sī-hui.
Lí chū-sìn ka-kī sī teh kā sit-bêng ê lâng chhōa-lō͘, sī o͘-àm tiong ê lâng ê kng,
gōng-lâng ê tō-su, iù-tī ê lâng ê lāu-su. Lí siūⁿ-kóng kì-jiân ū Lu̍t-hoat, tùi tì-sek kap chin-lí chiū ū pá-ak.
Lí kà-sī pa̍t-lâng, sī-án-chóaⁿ bô kà-sī ka-kī? Lí kà lâng m̄-thang thau-the̍h, ka-kī ū thau-the̍h--bô?
Lí kóng m̄-thang hoān kan-îm, ka-kī ū hoān--tio̍h-bô? Lí iàm-ò͘ⁿ ngó͘-siōng, ka-kī ū chhiúⁿ biō-sī--bô?
Lí khoa-kháu ū Lu̍t-hoat, ka-kī ū hoān-hoat lâi bú-jio̍k Siōng-tè bô?
Sèng-keng ū kì-chài, “In-ūi lín ê iân-kò͘, Siōng-tè ê miâ tī Gōa-pang-lâng ê tiong-kan siū siat-to̍k.”
Lí nā chun-siú Lu̍t-hoat, kat-lé chiū ū kè-ta̍t; lí nā hoān-hoat, ū kat-lé pìⁿ-chòe bô kat-lé.
Bô siū kat-lé ê lâng nā chun-siú Lu̍t-hoat ê kui-tēng, Siōng-tè kiám bô kā i sǹg-chòe ū kat-lé?
Jio̍k-thé bô siū kat-lé m̄-kú ū chun-siú Lu̍t-hoat ê lâng ōe kā lí tēng-chōe, in-ūi lí ū Lu̍t-hoat ê tiâu-bûn koh siū kat-lé, m̄-kú tian-tò ûi-pōe Lu̍t-hoat.
Kî-si̍t, gōa-piáu choh Iû-thài -lâng--ê m̄-sī chin-chiàⁿ ê Iû-thài -lâng; tī jio̍k-thé só͘ siū gōa-piáu ê kat-lé mā m̄-sī chin-chiàⁿ ê kat-lé.

Chin-chiàⁿ ê Iû-thài -lâng sī lōe-chāi--ê; chin-chiàⁿ ê kat-lé sī sim ê kat-lé, sī Sèng Sîn ê chok-ûi, m̄-sī khò Lu̍t-hoat ê tiâu-bûn. Chit-khoán lâng siū chheng-chàn m̄-sī tùi lâng, sī tùi Siōng-tè lâi.
Án-ni kóng, choh Iû-thài -lâng ū sím-mi̍h iu-tiám? Kat-lé ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek?
Tī ta̍k hong-bīn lóng ū chin chōe hó-chhù. Tē-it, Siōng-tè ū chiong I ê ōe kau-thok in.
In tiong-kan nā ū lâng bô sìn-si̍t, in ê bô sìn-si̍t kiám ōe hō͘ Siōng-tè ê sìn-si̍t pìⁿ-chòe bô-hāu?

Choa̍t-tùi bōe! Sīm-chì só͘-ū ê lâng lóng pe̍h-chha̍t, Siōng-tè ia̍h it-tēng sī chin-si̍t. Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài: Lí chek-pī ê sî, hián-chhut kong-gī; lí siū khòng-kò ê sî, ōe sèng-sò͘.
Put-kò, lán ê put-gī nā ōe-tàng hián-bêng Siōng-tè ê gī, lán ōe-tàng kóng sím-mi̍h? Góa chiàu lâng ê siūⁿ-hoat kóng, Siōng-tè tùi lán siū-khì sī put-gī sī--bô?
Choa̍t-tùi m̄-sī! Nā-sī, Siōng-tè ná ōe-tàng sím-phòaⁿ sè-kan?
Góa ê hu-ké nā ōe-tàng hō͘ Siōng-tè ê chin-si̍t koh-khah bêng-hián, hō͘ I koh-khah ū êng-kng, góa ná iáu hō͘ I soan-phòaⁿ chòe chōe-jîn?
Án-ni, ná m̄ kóng “Lán lâi chòe pháiⁿ hō͘ hó-sū si̍t-hiān”? Khak-si̍t ū lâng án-ni kóng lâi kā góa tiòng-siong, in eng-kai siū tēng-chōe.
Nā án-ni, lán Iû-thài -lâng kiám ū khah iâⁿ Gōa-pang-lâng? Bô! Góa í-keng ū chí-chek Iû-thài -lâng kap Gōa-pang-lâng lóng siū chōe koán-hat.
Tú chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài: Lóng bô gī-lâng, liân chi̍t ê to bô!
Bô hiáu-ngō͘ ê lâng; lóng bô lâng chhē-kiû Siōng-tè.
Lâng lóng pōe-poān Siōng-tè, lóng kiâⁿ bê-lō͘; lóng bô lâng chòe hó-sū, liân chi̍t ê to bô!
In ê nâ-âu chhin-chhiūⁿ khui-khui ê bōng; in ê chhùi-chi̍h kan-chà; in ê chhùi-tûn ū to̍k-chôa ê to̍k.
In chhùi-lāi chhiong-móa ok-to̍k chiù-chó͘.
In cháu chin kín, kip beh thâi-lâng lâu-huih;
in cháu--kè ê lō͘ lóng ū húi-bia̍t pi-chhám.
Pêng-an ê lō͘ in m̄ bat,
tùi Siōng-tè, sim bô chûn kèng-ùi.
Taⁿ lán liáu-kái, Lu̍t-hoat it-chhè ê iau-kiû sī tùi tī Lu̍t-hoat-ē ê lâng kóng--ê, hō͘ lâng lóng bōe-tàng piān-kái, hō͘ choân sè-kài lóng siū Siōng-tè sím-phòaⁿ.
Só͘-í bô lâng khò siú Lu̍t-hoat ê tiâu-bûn ōe hō͘ Siōng-tè soan-phòaⁿ chòe gī-lâng; tùi Lu̍t-hoat, lâng chiah chai sím-mi̍h sī chōe.
Hiān-chāi, Siōng-tè í-keng kā lán chí-sī, lán m̄-bián khò Lu̍t-hoat ōe-tàng kap I kiàn-li̍p ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē; Lu̍t-hoat kap sian-ti lóng ūi-tio̍h che chòe kiàn-chèng.
Kap Siōng-tè kiàn-li̍p ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē sī thong-kè sìn Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok. Siōng-tè án-ni tùi-thāi só͘-ū sìn Ki-tok ê lâng, lóng bô chha-pia̍t.
In-ūi só͘-ū ê lâng lóng hoān-chōe, tì-kàu Siōng-tè ê êng-kng tit bōe tio̍h;
put-kò, tùi Siōng-tè só͘ sù pe̍h-pe̍h ê un-tián, thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ oân-sêng ê kiù-sio̍k, lâng thang kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē.

Siōng-tè li̍p Iâ-so͘ choh sio̍k-chōe-chè, thong-kè I ê sí, hō͘ lâng tùi sìn lâi tit-tio̍h sià-chōe. Siōng-tè ēng án-ni lâi hián-bêng I ê gī. Tī kè-khì, I ēng nāi-sim tùi-thāi lâng, khoan-iông in í-chêng só͘ hoān ê chōe,
beh tī hiān-kim chit-ê sî hián-bêng I ka-kī sī gī, koh hō͘ sìn Iâ-so͘ ê lâng kap I ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē.
Nā án-ni, lán iáu ū sím-mi̍h thang khoa-kháu? Lóng bô! Khò sím-mi̍h hoat-chek? Khò hêng-ûi sī--bô? M̄-sī! Sī khò sìn ê hoat-chek.
Só͘-í, goán jīn-tēng, lâng kap Siōng-tè kiàn-li̍p ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, m̄-sī khò siú Lu̍t-hoat ê hêng-ûi, chí-ū tùi sìn.
Siōng-tè kiám chí-ū sī Iû-thài -lâng ê Siōng-tè? I kiám m̄-sī Gōa-pang-lâng ê Siōng-tè? Sī, I mā-sī Gōa-pang-lâng ê Siōng-tè.

Kì-jiân Siōng-tè chí-ū chi̍t ūi, I hō͘ siū kat-lé ê Iû-thài -lâng tùi sìn lâi kap I kiàn-li̍p ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, mā hō͘ bô siū kat-lé ê Gōa-pang-lâng tùi sìn lâi kap I kiàn-li̍p ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē.
Án-ni kóng, lán in-ūi chit-ê sìn soah hō͘ Lu̍t-hoat sit-khì hāu-le̍k sī--bô? Choa̍t-tùi m̄-sī! Lán tian-tò sī teh khak-li̍p Lu̍t-hoat.
Án-ni, koan-hē lán hiat-thóng ê chó͘-sian A-pek-la-hán, lán beh kóng sím-mi̍h?
A-pek-la-hán nā-sī tùi hêng-ûi siū chheng-chòe gī-lâng, i chiū ū thang khoa-kháu, m̄-kú tùi Siōng-tè khòaⁿ, i bô thang khoa-kháu.
In-ūi Sèng-keng ū kì-chài, “ A-pek-la-hán sìn Siōng-tè, in-ūi án-ni, Siōng-tè chiū kā i sǹg-chòe gī.”
Lâng chòe kang tit-tio̍h kang-chîⁿ bô sǹg un-tián, sī eng-kai.
M̄-kú bô khò hêng-ûi, chí-ū sìn hit-ūi soan-phòaⁿ chōe-jîn chòe bô chōe ê Siōng-tè ê lâng, i in-ūi ū chit-ê sìn, Siōng-tè chiū kā i sǹg-chòe gī.
Tāi-pi̍t mā ū kóng-khí bô khò hêng-ûi hō͘ Siōng-tè kā i sǹg-chòe gī ê lâng ū hok-khì. I kóng:
Kè-sit tit-tio̍h sià-bián, chōe-kò tit-tio̍h chhat-siau, chit-khoán lâng chin ū hok-khì!
Chú bô sǹg i ū-chōe--ê, chit-khoán lâng chin ū hok-khì!

Án-ni, chit-ê hok-khì chí-ū hō͘ siū kat-lé ê lâng sī--bô? M̄-sī, mā hō͘ bô siū kat-lé ê lâng. In-ūi lán í-keng ū kóng, “ A-pek-la-hán in-ūi sìn, Siōng-tè chiū kā i sǹg-chòe gī.”
Sī án-chóaⁿ sǹg? Sī i siū kat-lé í-chêng, á-sī í-āu? Sī kat-lé í-chêng, m̄-sī kat-lé í-āu.

Āu-lâi i ū siū kat-lé; chit-ê kat-lé sī chi̍t chióng kì-hō, ìn-chèng i iáu-bē siū kat-lé í-chêng chiū tùi sìn hō͘ Siōng-tè chiap-la̍p chòe gī-lâng. Hiah-ê bô siū kat-lé ê lâng in-ūi sìn, Siōng-tè ū chiap-la̍p in chòe gī-lâng, thang hō͘ A-pek-la-hán choh hiah-ê bô siū kat-lé ê sìn-tô͘ ê chó͘-sian.
I mā-sī siū kat-lé ê lâng ê chó͘-sian; in m̄-nā siū kat-lé, mā ū chiàu lán ê chó͘-sian A-pek-la-hán siū kat-lé í-chêng sìn-sim ê bô͘-hoān teh seng-oa̍h.
Siōng-tè èng-ún A-pek-la-hán kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun beh hō͘ in sêng-siū sè-kài chòe sán-gia̍p; chit-ê èng-ún m̄-sī thong-kè Lu̍t-hoat, sī thong-kè sìn lâi tit--tio̍h ê gī.
Nā chun-siú Lu̍t-hoat ê lâng chiah ōe-tàng sêng-siū Siōng-tè ê èng-ún, sìn chiū khang-khang, èng-ún mā bô lō͘-ēng.
Lu̍t-hoat ōe jiá-khí Siōng-tè ê siū-khì; bô Lu̍t-hoat chiū bô ûi-hoat.

In-ūi án-ni, èng-ún sī ēng sìn chòe kun-kù, beh pó-chèng èng-ún sī tùi Siōng-tè pe̍h-pe̍h ê un-tián, hō͘ A-pek-la-hán só͘-ū ê kiáⁿ-sun, m̄-nā ū siū kat-lé ê lâng, mā pau-hâm hiah-ê kap A-pek-la-hán siâng-khoán ū sìn Siōng-tè ê lâng. I sī lán chèng-lâng ê chó͘-sian;

chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài, “Góa ū hō͘ lí choh bān-bîn ê chó͘-sian.” Chit-ê èng-ún tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng ū-hāu. A-pek-la-hán sìn chit-ūi hō͘ sí-lâng koh-oa̍h, koh hō͘ bô pìⁿ-chòe ū ê Siōng-tè.
I tī bô thang ǹg-bāng ê sî iáu khǹg ǹg-bāng, sìn kóng i ōe chiâⁿ-chòe bān-bîn ê chó͘-sian, chiàu só͘ èng-ún ê ōe kóng, “Lí it-tēng ū chin chōe kiáⁿ-sun.”
I í-keng chiâⁿ-pah hè, siūⁿ-tio̍h ka-kī ê seng-khu ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ sí--khì, Sa-la ia̍h í-keng bōe siⁿ-kiáⁿ, m̄-kú A-pek-la-hán bô in-ūi án-ni sit-khì sìn-sim.
I tùi Siōng-tè ê èng-ún bô hoâi-gî, sìn-sim hoán-tńg ná kian-tēng, chiong êng-kng kui hō͘ Siōng-tè.
I khak-sìn Siōng-tè it-tēng ōe si̍t-hiān ka-kī ê èng-ún.
Só͘-í, A-pek-la-hán in-ūi sìn, Siōng-tè kā i sǹg-chòe gī.
M̄-kú, “Kā i sǹg-chòe gī” chit-kù ōe m̄-sī kan-ta ūi-tio̍h i,
mā-sī ūi-tio̍h lán chiah-ê lâng siá--ê, in-ūi lán ū sìn Siōng-tè hō͘ lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, lán mā ōe siū sǹg-chòe gī.
Ūi-tio̍h lán ê chōe-kò, Siōng-tè chiong Chú Iâ-so͘ kau hō͘ lâng hāi-sí, koh ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lán kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, Siōng-tè ū hō͘ I koh-oa̍h.
Kì-jiân, lán tùi sìn siū chheng-chòe gī-lâng, chiū thong-kè lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok kap Siōng-tè ū hô-bo̍k ê koan-hē.
Lán tùi sìn, thong-kè Ki-tok thang chìn-ji̍p hiān-chāi teh hióng-siū chit-ê un-tián, hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí ǹg-bāng thang hun-hióng Siōng-tè ê êng-kng.
M̄-nā án-ni, tī hoān-lān tiong, lán iû-goân hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí, in-ūi lán chai, hoān-lān siⁿ-chhut jím-nāi,
jím-nāi siⁿ-chhut láu-liān, láu-liān siⁿ-chhut ǹg-bāng,
ǹg-bāng bōe tì-kàu kiàn-siàu, in-ūi Siōng-tè thong-kè sù hō͘ lán ê Sèng Sîn chiong I ê thiàⁿ koàn-ji̍p lán ê sim.
Lán iáu loán-jio̍k ê sî, Ki-tok tī Siōng-tè só͘ chí-tēng ê ji̍t-chí ūi-tio̍h ū-chōe ê lâng sí.
Thòe gī-lâng sí, chha-put-to bô; thòe hó-lâng sí, kiám-chhái iáu ū lâng káⁿ.
Put-kò Siōng-tè tùi lán chèng-bêng I thiàⁿ lán, lán iáu-sī chōe-jîn ê sî, Ki-tok ū thòe lán sí.
Hiān-chāi Ki-tok í-keng ūi-tio̍h lán lâu-huih hi-seng, hō͘ lán kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, I koh-khah ōe kiù lán thoat-lī Siōng-tè ê siū-khì.

In-ūi, lán iáu-kú choh Siōng-tè tùi-te̍k ê sî, I hō͘ ka-kī ê Kiáⁿ thòe lán sí, hō͘ lán kap I koh hô-hó. Kì-jiân koh hô-hó, lán koh-khah ōe in-ūi Ki-tok ê oa̍h lâi tit-tio̍h chín-kiù.
M̄-nā án-ni, lán hiān-chāi í-keng thong-kè Ki-tok kap Siōng-tè koh hô-hó, mā ōe thong-kè lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ēng Siōng-tè chòe khoa-kháu.
Chōe tùi chi̍t ê lâng chìn-ji̍p sè-kan, sí mā tè--ji̍p-lâi; kiat-kó, só͘-ū ê lâng lóng ōe sí, in-ūi só͘-ū ê lâng lóng ū hoān-chōe.
Iáu-bē ū Lu̍t-hoat í-chêng, chōe í-keng tī sè-kan; put-kò bô Lu̍t-hoat, chōe chiū bô sǹg-chòe chōe.

M̄-kú tùi A-tong kàu Mô͘-se hit-tōaⁿ kî-kan, sí teh chi-phòe choân jîn-lūi, liân bô hoān-tio̍h A-tong só͘ hoān ê kè-sit ê lâng mā tio̍h sí. A-tong sī teh-beh lâi Hit-ūi ê ū-piáu.

Put-kò A-tong ê kè-sit kap Siōng-tè pe̍h-pe̍h ê un-sù bōe-pí--tit. In-ūi, nā tùi chi̍t ê lâng ê chōe-kò chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h sí, Siōng-tè ê un-tián, chiū-sī I thong-kè Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok chi̍t ê lâng pe̍h-pe̍h sù hō͘ chèng-lâng ê un-sù, it-tēng koh-khah hong-hù!

Chi̍t ê lâng só͘ hoān ê chōe kap Siōng-tè pe̍h-pe̍h ê un-sù bōe-pí--tit. Chiàu sím-phòaⁿ, liân chi̍t piàn ê kè-sit mā soan-phòaⁿ “Ū chōe”; m̄-kú chiàu pe̍h-pe̍h ê un-sù, chōe-chōe piàn ê kè-sit mā soan-phòaⁿ “Bô chōe”.

Nā in-ūi chi̍t ê lâng ê kè-sit, sí thong-kè chit chi̍t ê lâng chi-phòe jîn-lūi, án-ni, Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok chi̍t ê lâng só͘ sêng-chiū--ê it-tēng koh-khah tōa; só͘-ū niá-siū Siōng-tè hong-hù ê un-tián, chiū-sī pe̍h-pe̍h hō͘ Siōng-tè soan-phòaⁿ bô chōe ê lâng, ōe-tàng thong-kè Ki-tok lâi chi-phòe ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.
In-ūi chi̍t ê lâng hoān-chōe, chèng-lâng lóng siū tēng-chōe; kâng-khoán, in-ūi chi̍t ê lâng gī ê hêng-ûi, chèng-lâng lóng siū phòaⁿ bô chōe lâi tit-tio̍h oa̍h.
In-ūi chi̍t ê lâng pōe-ge̍k, chèng-lâng lóng chiâⁿ-chòe chōe-jîn; kâng-khoán, chi̍t ê lâng sūn-ho̍k, chèng-lâng lóng chiâⁿ-chòe gī-lâng.
Lu̍t-hoat ê chè-tēng hō͘ chōe-kò ke-thiⁿ; m̄-kú chōe ke-thiⁿ, Siōng-tè ê un-tián koh-khah ke-thiⁿ.
Án-ni, chōe thong-kè sí lâi chi-phòe, Siōng-tè ê un-tián sī thong-kè gī lâi chi-phòe, hō͘ lán tùi lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Án-ni, lán beh kóng sím-mi̍h? Lán sī tio̍h kè-sio̍k tī chōe-ok tiong seng-oa̍h, thang hō͘ un-tián koh-khah ke-thiⁿ sī--bô?
Choa̍t-tùi m̄-sī! Lán chiah-ê ǹg chōe í-keng sí ê lâng kiám thang kè-sio̍k tī chōe-ok tiong seng-oa̍h?
Lín kiám m̄ chai, lán lóng siū sóe-lé lâi kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-ha̍p, sī siū sóe-lé lâi kap I sí?
Kì-jiân lán thong-kè sóe-lé kap I sí, chòe-hé bâi-chòng, só͘-í, chhin-chhiūⁿ Ki-tok thong-kè Thiⁿ-pē êng-kng ê koân-lêng tùi sí koh-oa̍h, lán mā tio̍h kè sin ê seng-oa̍h.
Kì-jiân lán kap Ki-tok chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé lâi keng-giām I ê sí, lán it-tēng mā ōe kap I kiat-ha̍p lâi koh-oa̍h.
Lán chai, lán kū ê chū-ngó͘ í-keng kap Ki-tok chòe-hé tèng si̍p-jī-kè, sī beh hō͘ siū chōe khu-sok hit-ê kū ê lâng húi-bia̍t, hō͘ lán bô koh chòe chōe ê lô͘-lē.
In-ūi lâng it-tàn sí--khì chiū tùi chōe tit-tio̍h tháu-pàng.
Kì-jiân lán í-keng kap Ki-tok chòe-hé sí, lán siong-sìn lán mā ōe kap I chòe-hé oa̍h.
Lán chai Ki-tok í-keng tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, bōe koh sí, sí bōe koh chi-phòe I.
In-ūi I ū sí, chi̍t piàn chiū oân-choân kā chōe chè-ap; I hiān-chāi teh oa̍h, sī ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè teh oa̍h.
Án-ni, lín mā tio̍h khòaⁿ ka-kī í-keng kap chōe toān-choa̍t koan-hē, kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-ha̍p, ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè teh oa̍h.
Só͘-í, m̄-thang chiong lín ōe-sí ê seng-khu kau hō͘ chōe chi-phòe, khì sūn-thàn pún-sèng ê io̍k-bōng.

Mā m̄-thang chiong lín seng-khu ê chi-thé kau hō͘ chōe khì chòe put-gī ê kang-khū. Hoán-tńg tio̍h chòe chi̍t ê tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h ê lâng, chiong ka-kī hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè, chiong seng-khu ê kok chi-thé hiàn hō͘ I chòe gī ê kang-khū.
M̄-thang hō͘ chōe kā lín chi-phòe, in-ūi lín m̄-sī oa̍h tī Lu̍t-hoat-ē, sī oa̍h tī un-tián-ē.
Nā án-ni, in-ūi lán m̄-sī tī Lu̍t-hoat-ē, sī tī un-tián-ē, lán chiū thang hoān-chōe sī--bô? Choa̍t-tùi m̄-thang!

Kiám m̄ chai lín nā chiong ka-kī kau hō͘ bó͘-lâng choh lô͘-lē sūn-thàn i, lín chiū-sī hit-ê lâng ê lô͘-lē; án-ni kóng, lín sī choh chōe ê lô͘-lē tì-kàu sí, á-sī choh Siōng-tè ê lô͘-po̍k sūn-thàn I tì-kàu kap I ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē?
Kám-siā Siōng-tè, sui-jiân lín bat choh chōe ê lô͘-lē, hiān-chāi í-keng tùi sim-tóe sūn-thàn hit-ê thoân-siū hō͘ lín chòe tián-hoān ê kà-sī.
Lín í-keng tùi chōe tit-tio̍h tháu-pàng, chiâⁿ-chòe gī ê lô͘-po̍k.

Kiaⁿ-liáu lín bōe liáu-kái, góa ēng it-poaⁿ-lâng ê ōe kā lín kóng. Chhin-chhiūⁿ lín í-chêng bat chiong seng-khu oân-choân kau hō͘ ù-òe kap put-hoat, hō͘ put-hoat ke-thiⁿ, hiān-chāi lín tio̍h chiong lín seng-khu ê ta̍k pō͘-hūn hiàn hō͘ gī chòe sèng-kiat ê lō͘-ēng.
Lín choh chōe ê lô͘-lē hit-sî, lín bô siū gī iok-sok.
Hit-sî lín chòe hiān-chāi khòaⁿ-chòe kiàn-siàu ê tāi-chì, kiat-kó sī-án-chóaⁿ? Kiat-kio̍k sī sí.
Hiān-chāi lín í-keng tùi chōe tit-tio̍h tháu-pàng, chiâⁿ-chòe Siōng-tè ê lô͘-po̍k, hit-ê kiat-kó sī chiâⁿ-chòe sèng-kiat; kiat-kio̍k sī éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
In-ūi chōe ê tāi-kè sī sí, m̄-kú Siōng-tè thong-kè lán ê Chú Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ pe̍h-pe̍h sù hō͘ lán ê un-tián sī éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa sī tùi lín bat Lu̍t-hoat ê lâng teh kóng, lín kiám m̄ chai, lâng oa̍h--teh ê sî chiah siū Lu̍t-hoat iok-sok?
Kú chi̍t ê lē lâi kóng, kiat-hun ê hū-jîn-lâng, tiōng-hu iáu oa̍h--teh chiū siū Lu̍t-hoat iok-sok kui-sio̍k tiōng-hu; tiōng-hu nā sí chiū bô koh siū chit-ê Lu̍t-hoat iok-sok.

Só͘-í, tiōng-hu iáu oa̍h--teh, hū-jîn-lâng nā kap pa̍t-ê ta-po͘-lâng chòe-hé tòa, ōe hō͘ lâng kiò-chòe îm-hū; tiōng-hu nā sí, i chiū bô siū chit-ê Lu̍t-hoat iok-sok, i kap pa̍t-ê ta-po͘-lâng chòe-hé tòa mā m̄-sī îm-hū.

Góa ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, lín kap Ki-tok ê seng-khu kiat-ha̍p kap I tâng-sí, í-keng kap Lu̍t-hoat toān-choa̍t koan-hē, bô siū iok-sok, ōe-tàng kui-sio̍k pa̍t-lâng, chiū-sī hit-ūi tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h ê Ki-tok, hō͘ lán thang ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè kiat ké-chí.
Lán chiàu lâng jio̍k-thé ê pún-sèng teh oa̍h ê sî, lán hoān-chōe ê io̍k-liām siū Lu̍t-hoat kek-khí, tī lán seng-khu ê kok chi-thé ūn-chok, kiat sí-bông ê ké-chí.

M̄-kú, hiān-chāi lán í-keng thoat-lī Lu̍t-hoat, kap hit-ê sok-pa̍k lán--ê toān-choa̍t koan-hē. Án-ni, lán ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè, m̄-sī chiàu Lu̍t-hoat ê kū hong-sek, sī chiàu Sèng Sîn ê sin hong-sek.

Án-ni, lán beh kóng sím-mi̍h? Lu̍t-hoat sī chōe sī--bô? Choa̍t-tùi m̄-sī! Put-kò nā bô Lu̍t-hoat, góa chiū m̄ chai sím-mi̍h sī chōe. Lu̍t-hoat nā bô kóng “M̄-thang tham-sim”, góa chiū m̄ chai sím-mi̍h sī tham-sim.
Chōe lī-iōng kài-bēng chhē ki-hōe tī góa sim-lāi ín-khí ta̍k-khoán ê tham-sim. Bô Lu̍t-hoat, chōe chiū bô chok-iōng.
Í-chêng bô Lu̍t-hoat, góa mā teh oa̍h; kài-bēng chi̍t-ē lâi, chōe oa̍h--khí-lâi,
góa chiū sí--khì. Tùi góa lâi kóng, pún-lâi beh hō͘ lâng oa̍h ê kài-bēng, tian-tò hō͘ lâng sí.
In-ūi chōe lī-iōng kài-bēng chhē ki-hōe khi-phiàn góa, mā lī-iōng kài-bēng hāi-sí góa.
Só͘-í, Lu̍t-hoat sī sîn-sèng; kài-bēng mā-sī sîn-sèng, kong-chèng, koh liông-siān.

Nā án-ni kóng, hit-ê liông-siān--ê hāi-sí góa sī--bô? Choa̍t-tùi m̄-sī! Sī chōe lī-iōng hit-ê liông-siān--ê hāi-sí góa, hō͘ chōe-ok ê pún-chit hián-lō͘; án-ni, chōe lī-iōng kài-bēng hō͘ i ke̍k-kî ok-to̍k ê pún-chit koh-khah hián-lō͘ chhut--lâi.
Lán chai, Lu̍t-hoat sī sio̍k-lêng--ê, m̄-kú góa sī sio̍k jio̍k-thé--ê, í-keng chhut-bōe hō͘ chōe choh lô͘-lē.
Góa bô bêng-pe̍k ka-kī ê só͘-chòe, in-ūi góa ài chòe--ê, bô khì chòe; góa bô ài chòe--ê, tian-tò khì chòe.
Góa nā chòe góa bô ài chòe--ê, chiū-sī sêng-jīn Lu̍t-hoat sī hó.
Án-ni, teh chòe góa bô ài chòe--ê m̄-sī góa, sī tiàm tī góa lāi-bīn ê chōe.
Góa chai, tī góa pún-sèng lāi-bīn bô liông-siān; góa ū chòe hó ê ì-goān, m̄-kú bô chòe hó ê khùi-la̍t.
Só͘ ì-ài ê hó, góa bô khì chòe, bô ì-ài ê pháiⁿ, góa tian-tò khì chòe.
Góa nā chòe góa bô ì-ài--ê, chiū m̄-sī góa pún-sin teh chòe, sī tiàm tī góa lāi-bīn ê chōe teh chòe.
Án-ni, góa ū hoat-kiàn chi̍t ê hoat-chek, chiū-sī, góa siūⁿ-beh chòe hó ê sî, pháiⁿ kā góa tîⁿ--teh.
Góa lāi-bīn ê hit-ê lâng ì-ài Siōng-tè ê Lu̍t-hoat,

m̄-kú góa khòaⁿ-chhut, tī góa ê seng-khu ū lēng-gōa chi̍t ê hoat-chek kap góa sim-su ê hoat-chek teh kau-chiàn, lia̍h góa chòe siû-hoān lâi hâng-ho̍k góa seng-khu lāi-bīn ê chōe ê hoat-chek.
Góa chit-ê lâng ū-kàu chhiⁿ-chhám! Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng kiù góa thoat-lī chit-ê tì-kàu sí ê seng-khu?

Kám-siā Siōng-tè, thong-kè lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok I ū kiù góa! Án-ni, góa ê chhù-kéng, chi̍t hong-bīn sī ēng sim-su sūn-ho̍k Siōng-tè ê Lu̍t-hoat, lēng-gōa chi̍t hong-bīn sī ēng jio̍k-thé sūn-ho̍k chōe ê hoat-chek.
Án-ni hiah-ê kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-liân ê lâng chiū bô siū tēng-chōe.
In-ūi thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘, hit-ê sù oa̍h-miā ê Sèng Sîn ê hoat-chek í-keng ū tháu-pàng lán thoat-lī chōe kap sí ê hoat-chek.

In-ūi lâng ê pún-sèng loán-jio̍k, Lu̍t-hoat chòe bōe kàu--ê, Siōng-tè ū chòe-chiâⁿ: I chhe ka-kī ê Kiáⁿ chhú kap lâng kâng-khoán ōe hoān-chōe ê pún-sèng, soan-phòaⁿ lâng pún-sèng ê chōe chòe ū-chōe, lâi chhú-lí chōe.
Siōng-tè án-ni chòe, sī beh hō͘ Lu̍t-hoat chèng-tong ê iau-kiû ōe-tàng si̍t-hiān tī lán chiah-ê bô chiàu pún-sèng, sī chiàu Sèng Sîn ê ín-chhōa teh seng-oa̍h ê lâng.
In-ūi sūn-thàn pún-sèng ê lâng ì-hiòng pún-sèng ê sū; m̄-kú sūn-thàn Sèng Sîn ê lâng ì-hiòng Sèng Sîn ê sū.
Ì-hiòng pún-sèng, kiat-kó sī sí; ì-hiòng Sèng Sîn, ōe tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā kap hô-bo̍k.
Án-ni, ì-hiòng pún-sèng sī tí-te̍k Siōng-tè, in-ūi bô sūn-ho̍k Siōng-tè ê Lu̍t-hoat; kî-si̍t mā bô hoat-tō͘ sūn-ho̍k.
Sūn-ho̍k pún-sèng ê lâng bōe-tàng hō͘ Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí.
Kì-jiân Siōng-tè ê Sîn ū tiàm tī lín lāi-bīn, lín chiū m̄-sī sio̍k pún-sèng, sī sio̍k Sèng Sîn. Lâng nā bô Ki-tok ê Sîn chiū bô sio̍k Ki-tok.
Ki-tok nā tiàm tī lín lāi-bīn, sui-jiân lín ê seng-khu in-ūi chōe sí, Siōng-tè ê Sîn ōe hō͘ lín oa̍h, in-ūi lín í-keng kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē.

Siōng-tè ê Sîn ū hō͘ Iâ-so͘ tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h; chit-ê Sîn nā tiàm tī lín lāi-bīn, chit-ūi hō͘ Ki-tok tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè, ōe thong-kè tiàm tī lín lāi-bīn ê Sèng Sîn, hō͘ lín ōe sí ê seng-khu tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, án-ni khòaⁿ, lán ū khiàm-chè, put-kò m̄-sī khiàm pún-sèng ê chè thàn pún-sèng teh oa̍h.
Lín nā thàn pún-sèng oa̍h ōe tì-kàu sí; lín nā khò Sèng Sîn tû-bia̍t jio̍k-io̍k ê hêng-ûi chiū ōe oa̍h.
Hō͘ Siōng-tè ê Sîn ín-chhōa ê lâng lóng sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî.

In-ūi lín tùi Siōng-tè niá-siū ê Sèng Sîn m̄-sī beh hō͘ lín koh tò-tńg-khì choh lô͘-lē, iáu seng-oa̍h tī kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ tiong; lín niá-siū ê Sèng Sîn sī beh hō͘ lín chiâⁿ-chòe Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî, khò chit-ūi Sèng Sîn lán thang tōa-siaⁿ kiò, “A-pa, Pē ah!”
Sèng Sîn pún-sin kap lán ê sîn chòe-hé choh-chèng, kóng lán sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî.

Kì-jiân lán sī kiáⁿ-jî, chiū-sī kè-sêng-jîn, sī Siōng-tè ê kè-sêng-jîn, kap Ki-tok pîⁿ-pîⁿ choh kè-sêng-jîn. Kì-jiân lán kap Ki-tok tâng siū-khó͘, sī beh hō͘ lán mā kap I tâng siū êng-kng.
Góa siūⁿ, hiān-kim chit-ê sî ê khó͘-lān kap chiong-lâi teh-beh tùi lán hián-hiān ê êng-kng bōe-pí--tit.
Pī-chō-bu̍t pek-chhiat teh thèng-hāu Siōng-tè chèng kiáⁿ-jî ê hián-hiān.
In-ūi pī-chō-bu̍t bōe-tàng ta̍t-kàu siū-chō ê bo̍k-te̍k, m̄-sī chhut tī in ê pún-ì, sī Siōng-tè ê chí-ì. Put-kò pī-chō-bu̍t iáu-teh ǹg-bāng,
ū chi̍t ji̍t in pún-sin mā ōe siū tháu-pàng lâi thoat-lī ōe pāi-hoāi ê khu-sok, thang kap Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî hun-hióng êng-kng ê chū-iû.
Lán chai, só͘-ū pī-chō-bu̍t kàu hiān-chāi iáu chòe-hé teh thòng-khó͘ ai-kiò, chòe-hé keng-giām chhui-chūn ê khó͘-thàng.

M̄-nā pī-chō-bu̍t, liân lán chiah-ê tit-tio̍h Sèng Sîn choh thâu-chúi ê ké-chí--ê mā teh thó͘-khùi thèng-hāu Siōng-tè chiap-la̍p lán choh I ê kiáⁿ-jî, hō͘ lán kui-ê lâng lóng tit-tio̍h sio̍k-hôe.
In-ūi lán khò chit-khoán ǹg-bāng tit-tio̍h kiù. Khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h ê ǹg-bāng m̄-sī ǹg-bāng. Khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h--ê ná tio̍h ǹg-bāng?
Lán nā ǹg-bāng hit-ê khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h--ê chiū ōe jím-nāi thèng-hāu.

Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, lán loán-jio̍k ê sî Sèng Sîn mā ū teh kā lán hû-chhî; in-ūi lán m̄ chai tio̍h án-chóaⁿ kî-tó, m̄-kú Sèng Sîn ka-kī ēng ōe bōe-tàng piáu-ta̍t ê thó͘-khùi thòe lán kî-kiû.
Liáu-kái lâng lāi-sim ê Siōng-tè bêng-pe̍k Sèng Sîn ê ì-sù, in-ūi Sèng Sîn chiàu Siōng-tè ê chí-ì thòe sìn-tô͘ kî-kiû.
Lán chai, bān-hāng-sū hō͘-siōng ūn-chok, hō͘ hiah-ê thiàⁿ Siōng-tè ê lâng, chiū-sī chiàu I ka-kī ê chí-ì soán-tiàu--ê, lóng ū lī-ek.
In-ūi Siōng-tè ū-sian bat ê lâng, mā ū-sian koat-tēng hō͘ in kap I ê Kiáⁿ ê hêng-siōng saⁿ-tâng, thang hō͘ I ê Kiáⁿ tī chōe-chōe hiaⁿ-tī tiong choh Tōa-kiáⁿ.
Koh I ū-sian koat-tēng ê lâng, I mā kā in kéng-tiàu; I kéng-tiàu ê lâng, I mā kā in soan-phòaⁿ chòe gī-lâng; I soan-phòaⁿ chòe gī-lâng--ê, I mā hō͘ in tit-tio̍h êng-kng.
Koan-hē chiah-ê tāi-chì, lán beh án-chóaⁿ kóng? Siōng-tè nā ūi lán, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng tí-te̍k lán?
I kì-jiân bô sioh ka-kī ê Kiáⁿ, hō͘ I ūi-tio̍h lán chèng-lâng hi-seng, kiám bōe chiong bān-mi̍h mā pe̍h-pe̍h sù hō͘ lán?
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng khòng-kò Siōng-tè ê soán-bîn? Soan-phòaⁿ in chòe gī-lâng--ê sī Siōng-tè!

Nā án-ni, siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kā in tēng-chōe? Bô! Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ í-keng sí, koh Siōng-tè ū hō͘ I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, taⁿ chē tī Siōng-tè ê chiàⁿ-pêng teh thòe lán kî-kiû.
Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng chhiat-tn̄g Ki-tok tùi lán ê thiàⁿ? Sī hoān-lān, sī khùn-khó͘, sī pek-hāi, sī iau-gō, sī sàn-chhiah, sī gûi-hiám, á-sī chhám-sí?
Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài: In-ūi lí ê iân-kò͘, goán kui-ji̍t biān-tùi sí ê ui-hia̍p; lâng khòaⁿ goán chhin-chhiūⁿ beh hō͘ lâng thâi ê iûⁿ.
Lóng m̄-sī! Tī chiah-ê it-chhè ê tāi-chì, lán khò thiàⁿ lán ê Siōng-tè tek-sèng kàu ū-chhun!
In-ūi góa khak-sìn, bô-lūn sī sí, sī oa̍h, sī thiⁿ-sài, sī lêng-kài ê thóng-léng-chiá á-sī koân-le̍k-chiá, sī hiān-kim á-sī chiong-lâi--ê,
sī thiⁿ-téng á-sī tōe-ē ê sîn-lêng, á-sī kî-tha ê pī-chō-bu̍t, lóng bōe-tàng chhiat-tn̄g Siōng-tè thong-kè lán ê Chú Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ tùi lán ê thiàⁿ!
Góa choh chi̍t ê sio̍k Ki-tok ê lâng kóng si̍t-ōe, bô pe̍h-chha̍t; góa ê liông-sim siū Sèng Sîn kám-tōng kā góa choh-chèng:
Góa hui-siông iu-siong, sim-lāi thòng-khó͘ bô-thêng.
Góa ūi-tio̍h tông-pau, góa ê kut-jio̍k chì-chhin, pún-sin nā tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘ kap Ki-tok keh-khui mā kam-goān.
In sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng; Siōng-tè kéng-soán in chòe kiáⁿ-jî, sù in êng-kng, iok, Lu̍t-hoat, lé-gî, kap èng-ún.
In sī cho̍k-tiúⁿ ê kiáⁿ-sun; chiàu hiat-thóng, Ki-tok kap in tâng-cho̍k. Goān chhiau-oa̍t bān-mi̍h ê Siōng-tè tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn kàu bān sè-tāi. Amen!
Án-ni m̄-sī kóng Siōng-tè ê èng-ún bô si̍t-hiān. In-ūi m̄-sī só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng sī Siōng-tè ê soán-bîn.
A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ-sun mā bô lóng sī èng-ún ê kiáⁿ-jî. Siōng-tè bat tùi A-pek-la-hán kóng, “Tùi Í-sat siⁿ--ê chiah thang sǹg-chòe lí ê kiáⁿ-sun.”
Án-ni sī kóng hiat-thóng ê kiáⁿ-jî bô it-tēng sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî; chí-ū tùi Siōng-tè ê èng-ún siⁿ--ê chiah sǹg sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-sun.
In-ūi èng-ún ê ōe sī án-ni kóng, “Sî-ki kàu, góa ōe koh lâi, Sa-la ōe siⁿ chi̍t ê ta-po͘-kiáⁿ.”
M̄-nā án-ni, Lē-pek-ka ê siang-siⁿ-kiáⁿ mā-sī tùi kâng chi̍t ê lâng, chiū-sī lán ê chó͘-sian Í-sat lâi hoâi-īn.

M̄-kú ūi-tio̍h beh piáu-sī Siōng-tè khak-si̍t kun-kù ka-kī ê bo̍k-te̍k lâi kéng-soán lâng, I tùi Lē-pek-ka kóng, “Tōa--ê ōe ho̍k-sāi sòe--ê.” Chit-kù ōe sī tī in iáu-bē chhut-sì, iáu-bē chòe hó á-sī chòe pháiⁿ í-chêng, Siōng-tè só͘ kóng--ê. Án-ni, Siōng-tè ê kéng-soán m̄-sī kun-kù lâng ê hêng-ûi, sī kun-kù I ka-kī ê soán-tiàu.
Chiàu Sèng-keng kì-chài, “ Ngá-kok, góa kah-ì; Í-sò, góa bô kah-ì.”
Án-ni, lán beh kóng sím-mi̍h? Siōng-tè bô kong-tō sī--bô? Choa̍t-tùi m̄-sī!
I bat tùi Mô͘-se kóng: Góa beh lîn-bín góa ài lîn-bín ê lâng; góa beh thé-thiap góa ài thé-thiap ê lâng.
Só͘-í, Siōng-tè ê kéng-soán m̄-sī kun-kù lâng ê ì-goān á-sī lô-le̍k, sī chhut tī I ê lîn-bín.
Sèng-keng kì-chài Siōng-tè ū tùi Hoat-ló kóng, “Góa siat-li̍p lí choh-ông, bo̍k-te̍k sī beh ēng lí lâi hián-bêng góa ê koân-lêng, hō͘ góa ê miâ thoân kàu choân sè-kài.”
Só͘-í, Siōng-tè beh lîn-bín sím-mi̍h-lâng chiū kā i lîn-bín, beh hō͘ sím-mi̍h-lâng sim ngī chiū hō͘ i sim ngī.
Án-ni, lí ōe kā góa mn̄g, “Kì-jiân sī án-ni, sī-án-chóaⁿ Siōng-tè iáu-teh chek-pī lâng? Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng hoán-khòng Siōng-tè ê chí-ì?”
Lí chit-ê lâng, lí sǹg siáⁿ, káⁿ kā Siōng-tè tú-chhùi! Siū sok-chō ê mi̍h kiám ōe tùi sok-chō--ê kóng, “Lí sī-án-chóaⁿ kā góa chō kah án-ni?”
Sio-hûi--ê kiám bô koân thang ēng kâng chi̍t tè liâm-thô͘ chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù chō chi̍t ê kùi-khì ê khì-khū, chi̍t ê chho͘-sio̍k ê khì-khū?
Sui-jiân Siōng-tè beh piáu-sī I ê siū-khì hō͘ lâng chai I ê koân-lêng, iáu-kú ēng chin tōa ê khoan-iông thun-lún hiah-ê jiá I siū-khì eng-kai bia̍t-bông ê lâng.
I ūi-tio̍h só͘ ū-pī lâi chiap-siū I ê êng-kng hiah-ê lâng, chiū-sī I lîn-bín ê tùi-siōng, I koh-khah ōe hō͘ in chai I hong-hù ê êng-kng.
Lán lóng sī I só͘ ho͘-tiàu--ê, m̄-nā tùi Iû-thài -lâng, mā tùi Gōa-pang-lâng tiong-kan ho͘-tiàu.

Chiàu I tī Hô-se-a-su só͘ kóng: Pún-lâi m̄-sī góa ê chú-bîn--ê, góa beh chheng-ho͘ in chòe “góa ê chú-bîn”. Pún-lâi m̄-sī góa só͘ thiàⁿ--ê, góa beh hō͘ in chòe “góa só͘ thiàⁿ--ê”.
Tī hit-ê só͘-chāi, góa bat tùi in kóng “Lín m̄-sī góa ê chú-bîn”; siâng-khoán tī hia, in ōe kiò-chòe “éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî”.
Koan-hē Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, Í-sài-a bat soan-pò͘ kóng, “Sui-jiân Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ-sun chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-soa hiah-ni̍h chōe, m̄-kú chí-ū só͘ chhun ê chió-sò͘ ōe tit-tio̍h kiù,
in-ūi Chú tī tōe-chiūⁿ ōe chin kín koh thiat-tóe chip-hêng sím-phòaⁿ.”
Che sī chiàu Í-sài-a í-chêng só͘ kóng: Nā m̄-sī Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe kā lán lâu chéng, lán chá chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ Só͘-to-má, mā chhin-chhiūⁿ Gô-mô͘-la.
Án-ni, lán beh kóng sím-mi̍h? Gōa-pang-lâng bô tui-kiû kap Siōng-tè kiàn-li̍p ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, khiok tùi sìn kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tui-kiû tùi Lu̍t-hoat hō͘ Siōng-tè jīn-tēng in chòe gī-lâng, hoán-tńg bô tit-tio̍h.
Ná ōe án-ni? In-ūi in m̄-sī tùi sìn, sī tùi khò hêng-ûi. In khì that-tio̍h hit-tè hō͘ lâng poa̍h-tó ê chio̍h poa̍h-tó.
Sèng-keng ū án-ni kì-chài: Khòaⁿ leh, góa chiong hō͘ lâng poa̍h-tó ê chio̍h, hō͘ lâng poa̍h-tó ê tōa chio̍h khǹg tī Sek-an; sìn I ê lâng bōe tì-kàu sit-bāng.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa ê sim jia̍t-chhiat ǹg-bāng, koh tùi Siōng-tè kî-kiû--ê, chiū-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ōe tit-tio̍h kiù.
Góa ōe-tàng ūi-tio̍h in choh-chèng: In tùi Siōng-tè ū jia̍t-sim, m̄-kú m̄-sī kun-kù chèng-khak ê liáu-kái.

In-ūi in bô bêng-pe̍k Siōng-tè ê gī, beh ēng ka-kī ê hong-hoat tui-kiû kap Siōng-tè kiàn-li̍p ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, soah bô sūn-thàn Siōng-tè hō͘ lâng chiâⁿ-chòe gī-lâng ê hong-hoat.
Kî-si̍t, Ki-tok í-keng oân-sêng Lu̍t-hoat ê bo̍k-te̍k, hō͘ sìn ê lâng ōe-tàng kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē.
Koan-hē tùi khò Lu̍t-hoat tit--tio̍h ê gī, Mô͘-se ū án-ni siá, “Siú Lu̍t-hoat ê lâng khò Lu̍t-hoat lâi oa̍h.”

M̄-kú koan-hē tùi sìn chheng-gī, Sèng-keng ū án-ni kóng, “Lí m̄-thang sim-lāi kóng ‘Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe peh-chiūⁿ thiⁿ’ — chiū-sī kóng, sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe chiong Ki-tok chhōa--lo̍h-lâi?
Mā m̄-thang kóng ‘Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe lo̍h-khì chhim-ian’ — chiū-sī kóng, sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe chiong Ki-tok tùi sí-lâng tiong chhōa--khí-lâi?”
Chiah-ê ōe tàu-tóe sím-mi̍h ì-sù? Ì-sù sī: Siōng-tè ê ōe kap lí chin kūn, tī lí ê chhùi--ni̍h, tī lí ê sim-lāi. Che chiū-sī goán só͘ soan-iông ê sìn ê sìn-sit.
Lí nā ēng chhùi soan-jīn “Iâ-so͘ sī Chú”, sim sìn Siōng-tè ū hō͘ I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, chiū ōe tit-tio̍h kiù.
In-ūi lâng sim sìn chiū tit-tio̍h chheng-gī; chhùi soan-jīn chiū tit-tio̍h kiù.
Sèng-keng ū án-ni kì-chài, “Sìn I ê lâng bōe tì-kàu sit-bāng.”
Iû-thài -lâng kap Gōa-pang-lâng lóng bô chha-pia̍t, in-ūi ū kâng chi̍t ūi Siōng-tè sī bān-bîn ê Chú, I ōe hong-hong-hù-hù sù-hok hō͘ só͘-ū kiû-kiò I ê lâng.
In-ūi “Só͘-ū kiû-kiò Chú ê miâ ê lâng lóng ōe tit-kiù.”
M̄-kú in to bô sìn I, ná ōe kiû-kiò I? To bô thiaⁿ--tio̍h, ná ōe sìn I? To bô lâng thoân, ná ōe thiaⁿ--tio̍h?
To bô chhe-phài, ná ōe thoân? Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài, “Thoân-pò͘ hok-im ê lâng, in ê kha-jiah jōa-á-ni̍h súi!”
M̄-kú, m̄-sī só͘-ū ê lâng lóng sūn-thàn chit-ê hok-im. Í-sài-a kóng, “Chú ah, sím-mi̍h-lâng sìn goán só͘ thoân ê sìn-sit?”
Só͘-í, sìn sī tùi thiaⁿ, thiaⁿ sī tùi thiaⁿ Ki-tok ê ōe.
Put-kò góa beh mn̄g, in kiám chin-chiàⁿ lóng m̄-bat thiaⁿ--tio̍h? Tong-jiân bat! Sèng-keng án-ni kì-chài: In ê siaⁿ-im thoân-piàn choân-tōe; in ê ōe thoân kàu thiⁿ-piⁿ-hái-kak.

Góa beh koh mn̄g, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kiám chin-chiàⁿ m̄ chai? Tāi-seng, Mô͘-se thòe Siōng-tè án-ni kóng: Góa beh ēng m̄-sī góa chú-bîn ê lâng lâi ín-khí lín oàn-tò͘, ēng gû-gōng ê chú-bîn lâi kek-khí lín siū-khì.
Āu-lâi Í-sài-a mā chin hó-táⁿ thòe Siōng-tè kóng: Bô chhē góa ê lâng, góa ū hō͘ in chhē--tio̍h; bô kiû góa ê lâng, góa ū tùi in hián-hiān.
M̄-kú koan-hē Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, I ū kóng, “Ngī-sim pōe-ge̍k ê chú-bîn, góa kui-ji̍t chhun siang-chhiú hoan-gêng.”
Án-ni, góa beh mn̄g, Siōng-tè kiám ū pàng-sak I ê chú-bîn? Choa̍t-tùi bô! Góa pún-sin mā-sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, sī A-pek-la-hán ê hō͘-tāi, sio̍k Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k.
Siōng-tè m̄-bat pàng-sak I chá chiū kéng-soán ê chú-bîn. Lín kiám m̄ chai Sèng-keng ū kì-chài, Í-lī-a tùi Siōng-tè khòng-kò Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng,
kóng, “Chú ah, in thâi-sí lí ê sian-ti, thiah-húi lí ê chè-tôaⁿ, chí-ū chhun góa chi̍t lâng, in mā teh siàu-siūⁿ góa ê sìⁿ-miā.”
M̄-kú Siōng-tè án-chóaⁿ ìn-tap? I kóng, “Góa ū ūi-tio̍h ka-kī lâu chhit-chheng ê m̄-bat kūi-pài Pa-le̍k ê lâng.”
Hiān-kim chit-ê sî ê chêng-hêng mā-sī án-ni, Siōng-tè ū lâu ēng un-tián kéng-soán ê chió-sò͘-lâng.
Kì-jiân sī Siōng-tè ê un-tián, chiū m̄-sī kun-kù lâng ê hêng-ûi; nā kun-kù lâng ê hêng-ûi, un-tián chiū m̄-sī un-tián!
Nā án-ni, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bô tit-tio̍h in teh tui-chhē--ê, chí-ū Siōng-tè só͘ kéng-soán ê chió-sò͘-lâng ū tit--tio̍h. Kî-tha ê lâng sim ngī m̄ thiaⁿ,
chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài: Siōng-tè hō͘ in ê sim-lêng bâ-pì, ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ bōe kìⁿ, hī-khang thiaⁿ bōe tio̍h, ti̍t-kàu kin-á-ji̍t.
Tāi-pi̍t kóng: Tio̍h hō͘ in ê iàn-se̍k chiâⁿ-chòe hām-khiⁿ, lô-bāng, hō͘ in poa̍h-tó, chòe in ê pò-èng.
Tio̍h hō͘ in ê ba̍k-chiu hoe, bōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ, hō͘ in ê ka-chiah-phiaⁿ éng-oán khiau-ku.

Án-ni, góa beh kóng, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng tó--lo̍h-khì, kiám lóng peh bōe khí--lâi? It-tēng bōe án-ni! Tian-tò in-ūi in ê kè-sit, chín-kiù lîm-kàu Gōa-pang-lâng, lâi kek-khí Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê oàn-tò͘.

Kì-jiân Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê kè-sit ōe hō͘ sè-kan-lâng tit-tio̍h hong-hù ê chiok-hok, in ê sit-pāi ōe hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng tit-tio̍h hong-hù ê chiok-hok, hô-hòng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng nā choân-sò͘ tit-tio̍h kiù, hit-ê chiok-hok kiám bōe koh-khah hong-hù?
Hiān-chāi góa tùi lín Gōa-pang-lâng kóng. Kì-jiân góa sī Gōa-pang-lâng ê sù-tô͘, góa khòaⁿ góa ê chit-hūn chòe êng-kng,
án-ni thang kek-khí góa ê tông-pau ê oàn-tò͘, lâi kiù in tiong-kan chi̍t-kóa lâng.
Í-sek-lia̍t tông-pau siū khì-sak nā ōe hō͘ sè-kan-lâng kap Siōng-tè koh hô-hó, in koh siū chiap-la̍p kiám m̄-sī chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng tùi sí koh-oa̍h?
Thâu chi̍t tè mī-oân nā sèng-pia̍t kui hō͘ Siōng-tè, kui-sn̂g mā lóng ōe án-ni; chhiū-kun nā sèng-pia̍t kui hō͘ Siōng-tè, ki mā lóng ōe án-ni.
Lâng kā kaⁿ-ná-chhiū-ki chián--khí-lâi, chiong lín chiah-ê iá-seng ê kaⁿ-ná-chhiū-ki chiap--lo̍h-khì, lâi chiap-siū kâng hit-châng chhiū-kun ê êng-ióng-hūn,
lín chiū m̄-thang tùi chián--khí-lâi ê chhiū-ki khoa-kháu. Lín nā beh khoa-kháu, tio̍h chai, m̄-sī kun teh óa-khò lín, sī lín teh óa-khò kun.
Lí kiám-chhái beh kóng, “Chiah-ê chhiū-ki chián--khí-lâi sī beh kā góa chiap--lo̍h-khì.”
Tio̍h! In m̄ sìn chiah siū chián--khí-lâi, lí tùi sìn chiah khiā ōe tiâu. Lí m̄-thang kiau-ngō͘, tio̍h kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
In-ūi Siōng-tè nā bô lâu goân-lâi ê chhiū-ki, mā bô it-tēng ōe lâu lí.

Só͘-í, tio̍h chai Siōng-tè ê chû-ài kap giâm-hat, tùi tūi-lo̍h ê lâng, I chin giâm-hat, m̄-kú lí nā kè-sio̍k óa-khò I ê chû-ài, I chiū ēng chû-ài tùi-thāi lí; nā bô, lí mā ōe siū chián-tn̄g sit-khì I ê chû-ài.
Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng nā m̄-sī kian-chhî m̄ sìn, chiū ōe siū chiap tò-tńg--khì, in-ūi Siōng-tè ōe-tàng koh kā in chiap tò-tńg--khì.

Lín chiah-ê tùi iá-seng ê kaⁿ-ná-chhiū chián--khí-lâi ê chhiū-ki, Siōng-tè to ōe-tàng ûi-hoán chū-jiân kā lín chiap tī hó ê kaⁿ-ná-chhiū, hiah-ê goân-lâi ê chhiū-ki kiám bōe koh-khah eng-kai chiap tò-tńg--khì?

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa ài lín chai chit-ê ò-biāu ê chin-lí, chiah bōe siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī sī chhong-bêng. Chit-ê ò-biāu chiū-sī chi̍t-pō͘-hūn ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chiām-sî ngī-sim, kàu Gōa-pang-lâng kui Chú ê sò͘-bo̍k móa ûi-chí.
Án-ni, só͘-ū ê Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng lóng ōe tit-kiù. Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài: Chín-kiù-chiá ōe tùi Sek-an chhut--lâi, I ōe tû-khì Ngá-kok ê put-khiân put-gī.
Hit-sî góa beh tû-khì in ê chōe; Che sī góa kap in só͘ li̍p ê iok.

Chi̍t hong-bīn, tùi hok-im ê koan-tiám lâi kóng, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng in-ūi lín ê iân-kò͘ chiâⁿ-chòe Siōng-tè ê tùi-te̍k. Lēng-gōa chi̍t hong-bīn, tùi kéng-soán ê koan-tiám lâi kóng, in-ūi in chó͘-sian ê iân-kò͘, in chiâⁿ-chòe Siōng-tè só͘ thiàⁿ ê lâng;
in-ūi Siōng-tè ê un-sù kap kéng-soán bōe kái-piàn.
Lín Gōa-pang-lâng í-chêng bô sūn-ho̍k Siōng-tè, hiān-chāi in-ūi Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng bô sūn-ho̍k, lín chiah tit-tio̍h lîn-bín.
Kâng-khoán, in-ūi lín ū tit-tio̍h lîn-bín, in hiān-chāi bô sūn-ho̍k Siōng-tè, sī beh hō͘ in mā ōe tit-tio̍h lîn-bín.
Siōng-tè chiong só͘-ū ê lâng lóng koaiⁿ tī bô sūn-ho̍k ê chōng-thāi, sī ūi-tio̍h beh lîn-bín só͘-ū ê lâng.
Siōng-tè ê hong-sēng, tì-hūi, chai-bat, jōa-á-ni̍h chhim-tîm ah! I ê phòaⁿ-toàn oh-tit thui-chhek; I ê tō-lō͘ oh-tit chhē--tio̍h!
Sím-mi̍h-lâng chai Chú ê sim-ì? Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng thòe I chhut chú-ì?
Sím-mi̍h-lâng bat seng hō͘ I sím-mi̍h, I tio̍h pò-tap in?
In-ūi bān-mi̍h lóng chhut tī I, óa-khò I, kui tī I; goān I tit-tio̍h êng-kng ti̍t-kàu éng-oán. Amen!

Só͘-í, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, in-ūi Siōng-tè ê lîn-bín, góa khǹg lín tio̍h chiong ka-kī ê seng-khu hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè chòe oa̍h-oa̍h ê chè, sī sèng-kiat, I só͘ hoaⁿ-hí--ê; che sī lín ha̍p-gî ê kèng-pài.

M̄-thang hō͘ sè-sio̍k tông-hòa, tian-tò tio̍h hō͘ Siōng-tè kā lín kái-chō, sim-chì tit-tio̍h keng-sin, hō͘ lín thang piān-pia̍t sím-mi̍h sī Siōng-tè só͘ hoaⁿ-hí, khòaⁿ-chòe hó, koh oân-choân ê chí-ì.
