Khò Siōng-tè hō͘ góa ê un-sù, góa tùi lín ta̍k-ê lâng kóng: M̄-thang chiong ka-kī khòaⁿ siuⁿ koân, tio̍h chiàu Siōng-tè sù hō͘ lín ta̍k-ê lâng sìn-sim ê hūn-liōng sīn-tiōng phêng-kè ka-kī.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t ê seng-khu ū chin chōe chi-thé, ta̍k-ê chi-thé kok ū bô sio-siâng ê kong-lêng.
Sui-jiân lán ū chin chōe lâng, m̄-kú tī Ki-tok sī chi̍t-thé, hō͘-siōng chòe chi-thé.
Chiàu Siōng-tè sù hō͘ lán ê un-tián, lán ta̍k-ê lâng ū tit-tio̍h bô sio-siâng ê un-sù: Soan-káng sìn-sit ê lâng tio̍h hû-ha̍p sìn-sim soan-káng;
ho̍k-sāi ê lâng tio̍h choân-sim ho̍k-sāi; kàu-tō ê lâng tio̍h choân-sim kàu-tō;
khoàn-bián ê lâng tio̍h choân-sim khoàn-bián; chín-chè ê lâng tio̍h khóng-khài; léng-tō ê lâng tio̍h jia̍t-sêng; chòe chû-siān ê lâng tio̍h kam-sim lo̍k-ì.
Thiàⁿ tio̍h sêng-sim sêng-ì; tio̍h oàn-hūn pháiⁿ, kian-chhî hó.
Tio̍h ēng hiaⁿ-tī-ài hō͘-siōng saⁿ-thiàⁿ; tio̍h chin-sim saⁿ kèng-tiōng.
M̄-thang pîn-tōaⁿ; sim-chì tio̍h jia̍t-sêng, kè-sio̍k ho̍k-sāi Chú.
Tio̍h khǹg ǹg-bāng lâi hoaⁿ-hí; tio̍h jím-siū hoān-lān; tio̍h put-sî kî-tó.
Tio̍h pang-chān lín tiong-kan sàn-chhiah ê sìn-tô͘; tio̍h hó khoán-thāi chhut-gōa-lâng.
Tio̍h chiok-hok pek-hāi lín ê lâng; tio̍h chiok-hok, m̄-thang chiù-chó͘.
Tio̍h kap hoaⁿ-hí ê lâng chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí, kap ai-khàu ê lâng chòe-hé ai-khàu.
Tio̍h tâng-sim-ha̍p-ì; m̄-thang kiau-ngō͘; tio̍h chòe pîn-chiān ê lâng ê tâng-phōaⁿ; m̄-thang chū-chok-chhong-bêng.
M̄-thang ēng pháiⁿ pò pháiⁿ; tio̍h chòe chèng-lâng khòaⁿ-chòe hó ê sū.
Tio̍h chīn só͘-ōe kap chèng-lâng hô-bo̍k siong-chhù.

Chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h ka-kī pò-oan, lêng-khó hō͘ Siōng-tè thòe lín siū-khì, in-ūi Sèng-keng ū kì-chài, “Chú kóng: Sin-oan chāi-tī góa, góa ōe pò-èng.”

M̄-kú Sèng-keng mā ū kì-chài, “Lí ê tùi-te̍k nā iau, tio̍h hō͘ i chia̍h, chhùi-ta, tio̍h hō͘ i lim; in-ūi lí án-ni chòe, ná-chún chiong teh to̍h ê hé-thòaⁿ thia̍p tī i ê thâu-khak téng, hō͘ i bīn âng chai thang kiàn-siàu.”
Só͘-í, m̄-thang hō͘ pháiⁿ iâⁿ-kè lín; tio̍h ēng hó khah iâⁿ pháiⁿ.
Ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h sūn-ho̍k tī téng-bīn ê koân-pèng, in-ūi koân-pèng lóng sī tùi Siōng-tè lâi. Chiáng-koân-chiá ê koân-pèng lóng sī Siōng-tè chè-tēng--ê.
Só͘-í, hoán-khòng koân-pèng sī ûi-pōe Siōng-tè só͘ chè-tēng ê chè-tō͘; hoán-khòng ê lâng ōe siū sím-phòaⁿ.

Thóng-tī-chiá m̄-sī beh hō͘ choh-hó ê lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, sī beh hō͘ choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. Lí kiám bô ài chòe chi̍t ê bián kiaⁿ ū koân-pèng ê lâng? Nā ài, tio̍h choh-hó, lí chiū ōe tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn;

in-ūi i sī Siōng-tè ê chhe-ēng, i ê chit-chek sī beh pang-chān lí. M̄-kú lí nā choh-pháiⁿ, tio̍h kiaⁿ i, in-ūi i tòa kiàm m̄-sī bô bo̍k-te̍k. I sī Siōng-tè ê chhe-ēng, sī sin-oan-chiá, beh thòe Siōng-tè hêng-hoa̍t choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h sūn-ho̍k, m̄-sī kan-ta in-ūi kiaⁿ Siōng-tè siū-khì, mā-sī ūi-tio̍h liông-sim ê iân-kò͘.
Lín la̍p-sè mā-sī ūi-tio̍h chit-ê lí-iû, in-ūi i sī ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè ê lâng, teh chip-hêng i ê chit-bū.
Tio̍h tùi chèng-lâng chīn lín ê gī-bū; lín khiàm--ê, tio̍h hêng; eng-kai la̍p--ê, tio̍h la̍p; eng-kai kiaⁿ-ùi--ê, tio̍h kiaⁿ-ùi; eng-kai chun-kèng--ê, tio̍h chun-kèng.
Hō͘-siōng saⁿ-thiàⁿ ê chè í-gōa, choa̍t-tùi m̄-thang khiàm lâng sím-mi̍h; in-ūi thiàⁿ pa̍t-lâng--ê, í-keng ū oân-sêng Lu̍t-hoat ê iau-kiû.

Lu̍t-hoat ê iau-kiû sī: “M̄-thang kan-îm; m̄-thang hāi-sí lâng; m̄-thang thau-the̍h; m̄-thang tham-sim.” Chiah-ê kap kî-tha ê iau-kiû lóng pau-hâm tī “Tio̍h thiàⁿ chhù-piⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī” chit-kù ōe.
Thiàⁿ chhù-piⁿ ê lâng bōe siong-hāi pa̍t-lâng. Só͘-í, thiàⁿ sêng-choân Lu̍t-hoat.
Án-ni, lín chai chit-ê sî-chūn sī lín eng-kai khùn-chhíⁿ ê sî, in-ūi hiān-chāi pí lán tú-tú sìn ê sî koh-khah chiap-kūn chín-kiù.
Mî--sî í-keng chhim, ji̍t--sî teh-beh kàu. Só͘-í, lán tio̍h thǹg-tiāu o͘-àm ê hêng-ûi, chhēng kng-bêng ê chong-pī.
Lán ê hêng-ûi tio̍h toan-chèng, chhin-chhiūⁿ tī ji̍t--sî teh seng-oa̍h. M̄-thang hòng-chhiòng, chiú-chùi; m̄-thang hò͘ⁿ-sek, hòng-tōng; m̄-thang saⁿ-chiⁿ, oàn-tò͘.
Tio̍h chhēng Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok chong-pī ka-kī; m̄-thang chí-ū tô͘-bô͘ jio̍k-thé ê sū lâi boán-chiok su-io̍k.
Sìn-sim loán-jio̍k ê lâng tio̍h kā i chiap-la̍p, m̄-thang kap i piān-lūn ū cheng-gī ê sū.
Sìn-sim kian-kiông ê lâng sìn ta̍k-hāng lóng thang chia̍h, m̄-kú loán-jio̍k ê lâng chí-ū chia̍h chhài-soe.

Ta̍k-hāng chia̍h ê lâng m̄-thang khòaⁿ-khin bô ta̍k-hāng chia̍h ê lâng; bô ta̍k-hāng chia̍h ê lâng mā m̄-thang phoe-phòaⁿ ta̍k-hāng chia̍h ê lâng, in-ūi Siōng-tè í-keng ū chiap-la̍p i.
Lí sǹg siáⁿ, ná káⁿ phoe-phòaⁿ pa̍t-lâng ê po̍k-jîn? I chòe-liáu hó á-sī bô hó, i ê chú-lâng ōe kā i sím-phòaⁿ. I ōe chòe hó-sè, in-ūi Chú ōe kā i pang-chān.
Ū lâng khòaⁿ chit-ji̍t pí hit-ji̍t khah tiōng-iàu; mā ū lâng khòaⁿ ta̍k-ji̍t pîⁿ-pîⁿ tiōng-iàu. Ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h ū ka-kī bêng-khak ê kiàn-kái.

Siú te̍k-pia̍t ji̍t-chí ê lâng sī ūi-tio̍h Chú lâi siú; ū chia̍h-bah ê lâng mā-sī ūi-tio̍h Chú lâi chia̍h, in-ūi i ū kám-siā Siōng-tè. Bô chia̍h-bah ê lâng sī ūi-tio̍h Chú bô chia̍h, i mā-sī ū kám-siā Siōng-tè.
Lán bô lâng ūi-tio̍h ka-kī teh oa̍h, mā bô lâng ūi-tio̍h ka-kī lâi sí.
Lán nā oa̍h, sī ūi-tio̍h Chú teh oa̍h; nā sí, mā-sī ūi-tio̍h Chú lâi sí. Só͘-í, bô-lūn oa̍h á-sī sí, lán lóng sī sio̍k Chú ê lâng.
Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê bo̍k-te̍k Ki-tok ū sí, mā ū koh-oa̍h, thang siâng-sî chòe sí-lâng kap oa̍h-lâng ê Chú.

Án-ni, sī-án-chóaⁿ lí teh phoe-phòaⁿ lí ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē? Sī-án-chóaⁿ teh khòaⁿ-khin lí ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē? In-ūi lán chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h khiā tī Siōng-tè ê sím-phòaⁿ-tâi chêng.
Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Chú kóng: góa sī éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè; ta̍k-ê kha-thâu-u ōe kā góa kūi-pài, ta̍k-ê chhùi ōe soan-jīn góa sī Siōng-tè.
Án-ni, lán ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h chiong ka-kī ê tāi-chì tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng kau-tài chheng-chhó.
Só͘-í, lán m̄-thang koh-chài hō͘-siōng phoe-phòaⁿ, hoán-tńg tio̍h koat-sim bô chòe hō͘ hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē ê sìn-gióng siū chó͘-gāi, poa̍h-tó ê sū.
Góa chai, koh Chú Iâ-so͘ hō͘ góa khak-sìn, ta̍k-hāng mi̍h pún-sin lóng chheng-khì; lâng nā siūⁿ-kóng bô chheng-khì, tùi hit-ê lâng lâi kóng hit-hāng mi̍h chiū bô chheng-khì.

Lí nā in-ūi só͘ chia̍h ê mi̍h hō͘ hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē sim kan-khó͘, lí ê hêng-ûi chiū m̄-sī chhut tī thiàⁿ-sim. Lí m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h ka-kī só͘ chia̍h ê mi̍h hō͘ hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē tì-kàu bia̍t-bông, in-ūi Ki-tok í-keng ūi-tio̍h in sí.
Só͘-í, m̄-thang hō͘ lín khòaⁿ-chòe hó--ê chiâⁿ-chòe lâng ê húi-pòng.
Siōng-tè chú-koân ê si̍t-hiān m̄-sī khò lim-chia̍h, sī khò Sèng Sîn só͘ sù ê kong-gī, hô-pêng, kap hoaⁿ-hí.
Ēng án-ni lâi ho̍k-sāi Ki-tok ê lâng ōe hō͘ Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí, mā ōe tit-tio̍h lâng ê chheng-chàn.
Só͘-í, lán tio̍h tui-kiû hô-bo̍k kap hō͘-siōng chō-chiū ê sū.
M̄-thang ūi-tio̍h chia̍h-mi̍h phò-hoāi Siōng-tè ê kang-chok. Bān-mi̍h lóng chheng-khì, m̄-kú lâng nā in-ūi chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ pa̍t-lâng ê sìn-gióng siū chó͘-gāi chiū m̄ hó.
Khah hó sī bô chia̍h-bah, bô lim-chiú, bô chòe hō͘ hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē sit-khì sìn-gióng ê tāi-chì.
Lí tùi chi̍t hāng sū ê sìn-liām sī lí kap Siōng-tè tiong-kan ê tāi-chì. Tùi ka-kī khòaⁿ-chòe tio̍h ê sū bô chū-chek ê lâng chin ū hok-khì.
M̄-kú sim ū giâu-gî lâi chia̍h ê lâng ōe siū tēng-chōe, in-ūi m̄-sī chhut-tī sìn-sim. M̄-sī chhut-tī sìn-sim lâi chòe--ê lóng sī chōe.
Lán chiah-ê sìn-sim kian-kiông ê lâng eng-kai kā sìn-sim loán-jio̍k ê lâng tàu taⁿ tāng-tàⁿ. M̄-thang kiû hō͘ ka-kī hoaⁿ-hí;
lán ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h kiû hō͘ chhù-piⁿ hoaⁿ-hí, hō͘ in tit-tio̍h lī-ek thang kiàn-li̍p sìn-sim.
In-ūi Ki-tok bô kiû hō͘ ka-kī hoaⁿ-hí, hoán-tńg chhin-chhiūⁿ Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài, “Bú-jio̍k lí ê lâng ê bú-jio̍k lóng kui tī góa.”
Chá-chêng só͘ siá--ê lóng sī ūi-tio̍h beh kà-sī lán lâi siá--ê, hō͘ lán tùi jím-nāi kap Sèng-keng ê an-ùi tit-tio̍h ǹg-bāng.
Goān sù jím-nāi kap an-ùi ê Siōng-tè hō͘ lín tâng sim-chì ha̍k-si̍p Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê bô͘-iūⁿ,
thang tâng-sim tâng-siaⁿ êng-iāu lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê Pē Siōng-tè!
Só͘-í, ūi-tio̍h êng-iāu Siōng-tè, lín tio̍h hō͘-siōng chiap-la̍p, chhin-chhiūⁿ Ki-tok ū chiap-la̍p lín.
Góa kā lín kóng, Ki-tok chiâⁿ-chòe siū kat-lé ê lâng ê chhe-ēng, sī beh hián-sī Siōng-tè ê sìn-si̍t, thang chèng-bêng Siōng-tè tùi lán chó͘-sian ê èng-ún ū si̍t-hiān,

mā beh hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng in-ūi Siōng-tè ê lîn-bín thang kui êng-kng hō͘ I. Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài: Só͘-í, góa beh tī Gōa-pang-lâng tiong-kan soan-jīn lí, chhiùⁿ-koa o-ló lí ê miâ.
I koh kóng: Gōa-pang-lâng ah, tio̍h kap Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí.
I koh kóng: Bān-kok ah, tio̍h o-ló Chú; bān-bîn ah, tio̍h siōng-chàn I.
Í-sài-a koh-chài kóng: Iâ-se ê kun ōe puh-íⁿ, I ōe khí-lâi thóng-tī gōa-pang; Gōa-pang-lâng lóng ōe chiong ǹg-bāng kau-thok I.
Goān sù ǹg-bāng ê Siōng-tè, in-ūi lín tùi I ê sìn-sim, hō͘ lín chhiong-móa ta̍k-khoán ê hoaⁿ-hí kap pêng-an, koh hō͘ lín tùi Sèng Sîn ê lêng-le̍k chhiong-móa ǹg-bāng!
Góa ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa ka-kī khak-sìn lín hui-siông liông-siān, chhiong-móa ta̍k-khoán ê tì-sek, koh ōe-hiáu hō͘-siōng khó͘-khǹg.
M̄-kú góa hó-táⁿ siá chit-tiuⁿ phoe hō͘ lín, kā lín thê-chhíⁿ kúi tiám; in-ūi Siōng-tè ū sù góa te̍k-pia̍t ê un-tián,

thang tī Gōa-pang-lâng ê tiong-kan ho̍k-sāi Ki-tok Iâ-so͘, choh chè-si soan-káng Siōng-tè ê hok-im, thang hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng chiâⁿ-chòe Sèng Sîn só͘ sèng-hòa, Siōng-tè chiap-la̍p ê chè-mi̍h.
Só͘-í, in-ūi Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê iân-kò͘, góa khòaⁿ ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè chòe êng-kng.

Góa m̄-káⁿ kóng pa̍t-hāng tāi-chì, chí-ū beh kóng chit-hāng, chiū-sī Ki-tok thong-kè góa ê giân-gú kap hêng-ûi, ēng sîn-jiah kî-sū ê lêng-le̍k, kap Siōng-tè ê Sîn ê lêng-le̍k, hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng sūn-ho̍k Siōng-tè. Só͘-í tùi Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chiu-ûi it-ti̍t kàu Í-lī-lí-kó͘ tōe-khu, góa ta̍k só͘-chāi khì soan-iông Ki-tok ê hok-im.
Góa koat-ì bô beh tī í-keng thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ki-tok ê miâ ê só͘-chāi thoân hok-im, chiah bōe tī pa̍t-lâng ê tōe-ki téng khí-chhù.
Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài: M̄-bat thiaⁿ-tio̍h I ê tāi-chì ê lâng ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ; m̄-bat thiaⁿ-kìⁿ I ê lâng ōe bêng-pe̍k.
Góa ū chin chōe piàn tú-tio̍h chó͘-tòng, bōe-tàng khì lín hia.
M̄-kú taⁿ tī chiah-ê tōe-khu bô pa̍t-ê só͘-chāi thang khì, koh kúi-nā nî lâi, góa it-ti̍t teh ǹg-bāng ōe-tàng khì lín hia.

Chit-piàn beh khì Se-pan-gâ ê lō͘-tiong, góa ǹg-bāng ōe keng-kè lín hia khì khòaⁿ lín, seng kap lín ū chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan hoaⁿ-hí ê kau-pôe, jiân-āu chiah hō͘ lín kā góa sòng-hêng kè-sio̍k khì Se-pan-gâ.
M̄-kú góa hiān-chāi tio̍h seng khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng kiong-kip hiah-ê sìn-tô͘ ê su-iàu,
in-ūi Má-kî-tùn kap A-kai-a ê kàu-hōe hoaⁿ-hí hiàn chi̍t pit chîⁿ pang-chān Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng chi̍t-kóa sàn-chhiah ê sìn-tô͘.

Che sī in hoaⁿ-hí chòe--ê, kî-si̍t mā-sī in só͘ khiàm ê chè. Kì-jiân Iû-thài sìn-tô͘ ū kap Gōa-pang-lâng hun-hióng sio̍k-lêng ê hok-khì, Gōa-pang ê sìn-tô͘ eng-kai tī bu̍t-chit-siōng pang-chān in.
Thèng-hāu góa chit-hāng tāi-chì chòe hó-sè, chiong koan-bō͘ ê chit-pit chîⁿ kau hō͘ in liáu-āu, chiah keng-kè lín hia khì Se-pan-gâ.
Góa chai góa khì lín hia ê sî, mā ōe chiong Ki-tok hong-hù ê un-tián tòa-khì hō͘ lín.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, thong-kè lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok kap Sèng Sîn só͘ sù ê thiàⁿ-sim, góa chhiáⁿ lín chīn-la̍t kap góa chòe-hé ūi-tio̍h góa kî-kiû Siōng-tè,
hō͘ góa bián siū-tio̍h Iû-thài m̄-sìn ê lâng ê hām-hāi, koh hō͘ góa tī Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng pān-lí kiong-kip ê tāi-chì ōe tit-tio̍h sìn-tô͘ chiap-la̍p.
Án-ni, góa chiū thang hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí chiàu Siōng-tè ê chí-ì khì lín hia, kap lín chòe-hé têng-sin tit-tio̍h khùi-la̍t.
Goān sù pêng-an ê Siōng-tè kap lín tāi-ke tông-chāi. Amen!
Góa tùi lín chhui-chiàn lán ê chí-bē Hui-pí, i sī Kian-kek-lí kàu-hōe ê chip-sū.

Chhiáⁿ lín in-ūi Chú ê iân-kò͘, chiàu sìn-tô͘ ê pún-hūn kā i chiap-thāi. I ū sím-mi̍h su-iàu, chhiáⁿ lín kā i pang-chān. I it-ti̍t jia̍t-sim pang-chān chin chōe lâng, pau-hâm góa pún-sin.
Chhiáⁿ thòe góa kā Pek-ki-la kap A-ku-la chhéng-an; in kap góa sī tī Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ lāi-bīn ê tâng-kang.
In bat ūi-tio̍h góa mō͘ sìⁿ-miā ê gûi-hiám; m̄-nā góa, liân só͘-ū Gōa-pang ê kàu-hōe mā lóng beh kā in kám-siā.
Mā kā tī in tau teh chū-chi̍p ê kàu-hōe chhéng-an. Chhiáⁿ thòe góa chhéng-an góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê Í-pài-nî-thó͘; i sī A-sè-a thâu chi̍t ê kui-sìn Ki-tok ê lâng.
Mā chhéng-an ūi-tio̍h lín siū chin chōe lô-khó͘ ê Má-lī-a.
Koh kā góa ê chhin-cho̍k, kap góa chòe-hé koaiⁿ-kaⁿ ê An-to-nî-kó͘ kap Iû-nî-a chhéng-an; in tī sù-tô͘ tiong sī ū bêng-bōng ê lâng, pí góa khah tāi-seng kui-sìn Ki-tok.
Chhiáⁿ thòe góa chhéng-an Chú-lāi góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê Àm-pek-lī.
Chhéng-an tī Ki-tok lāi-bīn ê tâng-kang Ní-pa-ló͘ kap góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê Sū-tāi-kó͘.
Chhéng-an tī Ki-tok keng-kè khó-giām ê A-pí-lī. Kā A-lī-to-pò͘ ke-lāi ê lâng chhéng-an.
Kā góa ê chhin-cho̍k Hi-lô-thian chhéng-an. Kā Ná-kî-sò͘ ke-lāi sìn Chú ê lâng chhéng-an.
Chhiáⁿ thòe góa chhéng-an ūi-tio̍h Chú siū chin chōe lô-khó͘ ê Thó͘-hui-ná kap Thó͘-hù-sat. Kā só͘ thiàⁿ ê Pí-sek chhéng-an; i bat ūi-tio̍h Chú lô-khó͘ kang-chok.
Chhéng-an tī Chú siū kéng-soán ê Ló͘-hu kap i ê lāu-bú; i ê lāu-bú mā-sī góa ê lāu-bú.
Kā A-sùn-kî-thó͘, Hut-le̍k-kan, Hek-bí, Pat-lô-pa, Hek-má, í-ki̍p kap in chòe-hé ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē chhéng-an.
Kā Hui-lô-lô-kó͘ kap Iû-lī-a, Nî-lī-a kap i ê chí-bē, kap O-lîm-pa, í-ki̍p kap in chòe-hé ê chèng sìn-tô͘ chhéng-an.
Lín tio̍h chhin-chhiat hō͘-siōng chhéng-an. Ki-tok ê chèng kàu-hōe lóng kā lín chhéng-an.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa khó͘-khǹg lín, tio̍h sió-sim thê-hông hiah-ê chè-chō hun-lia̍t, hō͘ lín hoān-chōe, ûi-pōe lín só͘ niá-siū ê kà-sī hiah-ê lâng.
In-ūi chit-khoán lâng m̄-sī choh po̍k-jîn teh ho̍k-sāi lán ê Chú Ki-tok, sī teh kò͘ ka-kī ê pak-tó͘, ēng hoa-giân-kháu-gú iú-he̍k láu-si̍t-lâng ê sim.
In-ūi lín ê sūn-ho̍k, chèng-lâng í-keng lóng chai, só͘-í góa ūi-tio̍h lín hoaⁿ-hí. Góa ài lín tùi hó-sū tio̍h khiáu, tùi pháiⁿ-sū tio̍h gōng.
Sù pêng-an ê Siōng-tè chin kín chiū ōe chiong Sat-tàn ta̍h-chhùi, hō͘ i khut-ho̍k tī lín kha-ē. Goān lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ ê un-hūi kap lín tông-chāi!
Góa ê tâng-kang Thê-mô͘-thài í-ki̍p góa ê chhin-cho̍k Lō͘-kiû, Iâ-sun, Só͘-se-pa-tek kā lín chhéng-an.
Góa Tek-thê, chiū-sī chit-tiuⁿ phoe ê tāi-pit-jîn, tī Chú-lāi kā lín chhéng-an.
Chiap-thāi góa kap choân kàu-hōe ê Kai-iû kā lín chhéng-an. Chit-ê siâⁿ ê kòe-kè-tiúⁿ Í-la-to͘ kap lán ê hiaⁿ-tī Koat-thó͘ mā kā lín chhéng-an.

Goān êng-kng kui hō͘ Siōng-tè! I ōe chiàu góa só͘ thoân ê hok-im, chiū-sī só͘ soan-iông ê Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok, lâi kian-kò͘ lín ê sìn-sim. Chit-ê hok-im sī bān-kó͘ í-lâi só͘ ún-ba̍t ê ò-biāu,
taⁿ í-keng chiàu éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng, thong-kè chèng sian-ti ê chheh hián-bêng--chhut-lâi, beh hō͘ bān-bîn chai, thang sìn lâi sūn-thàn.
Goān êng-kng thong-kè Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok kui tī to̍k-it choân-tì ê Siōng-tè, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán. Amen!
Góa sī Pó-lô, hōng Siōng-tè ê chí-ì siū tiàu choh Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê sù-tô͘. Góa kap lán ê hiaⁿ-tī Só͘-thê-nî

siá-phoe hō͘ tī Ko-lîm-to Siōng-tè ê kàu-hōe, chiū-sī hiah-ê kap tī ta̍k só͘-chāi ho͘-kiò lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ, kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-liân siū tiàu choh sìn-tô͘ kui-sio̍k Siōng-tè ê lâng; Ki-tok sī in ê Chú, mā-sī lán ê Chú.
Goān lán ê Pē Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sù lín un-tián kap pêng-an!
Góa sî-siông ūi-tio̍h lín teh kám-siā góa ê Siōng-tè, in-ūi I thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ sù lín un-tián,
hō͘ lín thong-kè Ki-tok ta̍k-hāng tit-tio̍h hù-chiok, chhiong-móa ta̍k-khoán kháu-châi kap tì-sek.
Ki-tok ê sìn-sit í-keng tī lín tiong-kan kian-kò͘ kiàn-li̍p,
hō͘ lín lóng bô khiàm sím-mi̍h un-sù, thèng-hāu lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok hián-hiān.
I mā ōe hō͘ lín kian-kò͘ ti̍t-kàu chòe-āu, tī lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê Ji̍t bô thang hiâm.
Siōng-tè sī sìn-si̍t, I ho͘-tiàu lín, beh hō͘ lín kap I ê Kiáⁿ lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok kiat-liân.

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa hōng lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ khǹg lín tāi-ke, kóng-ōe tio̍h it-tì; lín tiong-kan mā m̄-thang hun-lia̍t. Tio̍h thoân-kiat, ū siâng-khoán ê siūⁿ-hoat kap kiōng-tông ê bo̍k-phiau.
Góa ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, Kek-lâi in tau ê lâng ū tùi góa kóng-khí lín tiong-kan ū hun-cheng.

Góa án-ni kóng sī in-ūi lín tiong-kan ì-kiàn hun-hun; ū-ê kóng “Góa sio̍k Pó-lô ”; ū-ê kóng “Góa sio̍k A-pho-lô ”; ū-ê kóng “Góa sio̍k Pí-tek ”; mā ū-ê kóng “Góa sio̍k Ki-tok”.
Ki-tok kèng-jiân hō͘ lâng hun-koah lah! Pó-lô kiám ū thòe lín tèng-sí tī si̍p-jī-kè? Lín kiám ū hōng Pó-lô ê miâ niá-siū sóe-lé?
Kám-siā Siōng-tè, Ki-lī-sū-pò͘ kap Kai-iû í-gōa, góa bô kā lín tiong-kan sím-mi̍h-lâng sóe-lé.
Án-ni bô lâng ōe-tàng kóng, lín ū hōng góa ê miâ niá-siū sóe-lé.
Ū lah, góa mā ū kā Sū-thê-hoat-ná chi̍t ke ê lâng sóe-lé, kî-tha ū kā pa̍t-lâng sóe-lé á bô, góa bōe-kì--tit.
Ki-tok bô chhe góa kā lâng sóe-lé, sī beh thoân hok-im, m̄-sī ēng tì-hūi ê giân-sû thoân, chiah bián hō͘ Ki-tok ê si̍p-jī-kè sit-khì hāu-le̍k.
Si̍p-jī-kè ê sìn-sit, tùi hiah-ê ǹg bia̍t-bông teh kiâⁿ ê lâng sī gû-gōng, put-kò tùi lán chiah-ê ǹg tit-kiù teh kiâⁿ ê lâng sī Siōng-tè ê tōa lêng-le̍k.
In-ūi Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Góa beh siau-bia̍t tì-hūi ê lâng ê tì-hūi; góa beh khì-sak chhong-bêng ê lâng ê chhong-bêng.
Án-ni tì-hūi ê lâng tī tó-ūi? Keng-ha̍k-kàu-su tī tó-ūi? Chit sè-tāi ê hiông-piān-ka tī tó-ūi? Siōng-tè í-keng hō͘ chit sè-kan ê tì-hūi pìⁿ-chòe gû-gōng lah!

Kì-jiân sè-kan-lâng bōe-tàng khò ka-kī ê tì-hūi jīn-bat Siōng-tè, Siōng-tè chiū tùi I ê tì-hūi hoaⁿ-hí ēng goán só͘ thoân gû-gōng ê sìn-sit lâi chín-kiù sìn I ê lâng.
Iû-thài -lâng kiû sîn-jiah, Hi-la̍h -lâng chhē tì-hūi,
put-kò goán soan-iông tèng si̍p-jī-kè ê Ki-tok. Chit-ê sìn-sit tùi Iû-thài -lâng sī chó͘-gāi, tùi Gōa-pang-lâng sī gû-gōng,
m̄-kú tùi Siōng-tè só͘ kéng-tiàu ê lâng, bô-lūn sī Iû-thài -lâng á-sī Hi-la̍h -lâng, chit-ê sìn-sit sī Ki-tok; I sī Siōng-tè ê tōa lêng-le̍k, sī Siōng-tè ê tì-hūi.
In-ūi Siōng-tè ê gû-gōng iâⁿ-kè lâng ê tì-hūi, Siōng-tè ê loán-jio̍k pí lâng khah ióng-chòng.

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Siōng-tè ho͘-tiàu lín ê sî, chiàu lâng ê phiau-chún, lín tiong-kan bô jōa-chōe lâng ū tì-hūi, bô jōa-chōe lâng ū lêng-le̍k, bô jōa-chōe lâng sio̍k siōng-liû kai-kip.

Siōng-tè kò͘-ì ēng sè-kan-lâng khòaⁿ-chòe gōng ê tāi-chì lâi hō͘ khiáu ê lâng kiàn-siàu; Siōng-tè ēng sè-kan-lâng khòaⁿ-chòe jio̍k ê tāi-chì lâi hō͘ kiông ê lâng kiàn-siàu.
Siōng-tè ēng pi-chiān--ê, sè-kan-lâng só͘ biáu-sī--ê, khòaⁿ m̄ chiūⁿ-ba̍k ê tāi-chì lâi phò-hoāi lâng só͘ khòaⁿ-tāng--ê;
tùi án-ni, sè-kan chiū bô lâng ōe-tàng tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng khoa-kháu.

M̄-kú Siōng-tè hō͘ lín kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-liân, hō͘ Ki-tok chiâⁿ-chòe lán tùi Siōng-tè lâi ê tì-hūi, chiū-sī hō͘ lán kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, siâng-sî chiâⁿ-chòe Siōng-tè sèng-kiat ê chú-bîn, koh tit-tio̍h chū-iû.
Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài, “Beh khoa-kháu ê lâng tio̍h khoa-kháu Chú!”
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa í-chêng khì lín hia ê sî bô ēng súi ê giân-sû á-sī tì-hūi soan-káng Siōng-tè ê ò-pì.
In-ūi góa koat-tēng, tī lín tiong-kan sím-mi̍h to m̄ kóng, chí-ū beh kóng Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok í-ki̍p I siū tèng-sí tī si̍p-jī-kè ê sū.
Góa tī lín hia ê sî, loán-jio̍k koh kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.
Góa só͘ kóng ê ōe, só͘ soan-káng ê sìn-sit, lóng bô ēng kháu-biāu tì-hūi ê giân-sû, sī khò Siōng-tè ê Sîn ê tōa lêng-le̍k lâi chèng-si̍t,
sī beh hō͘ lín ê sìn-gióng m̄-sī khò lâng ê tì-hūi, sī khò Siōng-tè ê tōa lêng-le̍k.

Sui-jiân sī án-ni, tùi hiah-ê lêng-sèng sêng-se̍k ê lâng góa mā ū kóng tì-hūi, put-kò m̄-sī chit sè-kan ê tì-hūi, mā m̄-sī chit sè-kan chù-tiāⁿ ōe sit-sè ê thóng-tī-chiá ê tì-hūi.
Góa só͘ kóng--ê sī Siōng-tè ò-pì ê tì-hūi, sī tùi lâng ún-ba̍t--ê, sī Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lán tit-tio̍h êng-kng, tī chhòng-sè í-chêng chiū seng koat-tēng--ê.
Chit sè-kan ê thóng-tī-chiá bô chi̍t ê jīn-bat chit-ê tì-hūi, in nā bat chiū bōe chiong êng-iāu ê Chú tèng-sí tī si̍p-jī-kè.
Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài: Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h thiàⁿ I ê lâng chún-pī--ê, sī ba̍k-chiu m̄-bat khòaⁿ--tio̍h, hī-khang m̄-bat thiaⁿ--tio̍h, mā m̄-bat ū lâng siūⁿ--tio̍h-ê.
M̄-kú Siōng-tè í-keng ū thong-kè Sèng Sîn chiong chiah-ê sū tùi lán khé-sī. Sèng Sîn thiat-tóe chai bān-sū, liân Siōng-tè chhim-tîm ê chí-ì mā chai.
Chí-ū lâng ka-kī lāi-bīn ê sîn chiah chai ka-kī ê sū; chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, chí-ū Siōng-tè ê Sîn chiah chai Siōng-tè ê sū.
Lán niá-siū--ê m̄-sī sè-kan ê sîn, sī tùi Siōng-tè lâi ê Sîn, beh hō͘ lán chai Siōng-tè sù hō͘ lán ê un-sù.
Só͘-í, goán tùi sio̍k-lêng ê lâng kóe-seh sio̍k Sèng Sîn ê sū, m̄-sī ēng lâng só͘ kà ê tì-hūi, sī ēng Sèng Sîn só͘ kà ê ōe.

Sio̍k hiat-khì ê lâng bōe-tàng niá-siū tùi Siōng-tè ê Sîn lâi ê un-sù, chiah-ê un-sù tùi i lâi kóng sī gû-gōng--ê, bô hoat-tō͘ liáu-kái, in-ūi chí-ū sio̍k-lêng ê lâng chiah ōe-tàng léng-ngō͘.
Sio̍k Sèng Sîn ê lâng ōe-hiáu phòaⁿ-toàn bān-sū, put-kò i pún-sin ê sū bô lâng ōe-tàng kā i phòaⁿ-toàn.
Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Sím-mi̍h-lâng chai Chú ê sim-ì? Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng thòe I chhut chú-ì? M̄-kú lán ū Ki-tok ê sim-ì.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa kàu taⁿ tùi lín kóng-ōe, bōe-tàng khòaⁿ lín chòe sio̍k Sèng Sîn ê, sī sio̍k-sè--ê, sī Ki-tok sìn-gióng ê eⁿ-á.
Góa ēng lin chhī lín, bô ēng pn̄g, in-ūi lín iáu bōe-tàng chia̍h-pn̄g, kàu hiān-chāi mā iáu bōe-tàng,
in-ūi lín iáu-kú sī sio̍k-sè ê lâng. Lín tiong-kan ū oàn-tò͘, ū hun-cheng; án-ni kiám m̄-sī chèng-bêng lín sī sio̍k-sè--ê, sī chiàu sè-kan-lâng ê hong-sek teh seng-oa̍h?
Lín tiong-kan ū lâng kóng “Góa sio̍k Pó-lô ”; mā ū lâng kóng “Góa sio̍k A-pho-lô ”. Án-ni lín kap sè-kan-lâng ū sím-mi̍h bô kâng-khoán?
A-pho-lô sǹg siáⁿ? Pó-lô sǹg siáⁿ? Goán put-kò sī Siōng-tè ê chhe-ēng, ín-chhōa lín siong-sìn; ta̍k-ê lâng chiàu Chú só͘ hō͘ goán ê chit-hūn teh chòe.
Góa iā-chéng, A-pho-lô ak-chúi, m̄-kú Siōng-tè hō͘ i tōa-châng.
Iā-chéng--ê kap ak-chúi--ê lóng bô tiōng-iàu, chí-ū hō͘ i tōa-châng ê Siōng-tè chiah tiōng-iàu.
Iā-chéng--ê kap ak-chúi--ê lóng kâng-khoán, Siōng-tè ōe chiàu ta̍k-lâng ê kang-chok kā in pò-siúⁿ.
Goán sī Siōng-tè ê tâng-kang; lín sī Siōng-tè ê chhân-hn̂g. Lín mā-sī Siōng-tè ê kiàn-tio̍k-bu̍t.

Chiàu Siōng-tè hō͘ góa ê un-sù, góa choh chi̍t ê gâu ê kiàn-tio̍k-su hē tōe-ki, pa̍t-lâng tī hit téng-bīn khí-chō. M̄-kú ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h khòaⁿ ka-kī án-chóaⁿ teh khí-chō.
In-ūi Siōng-tè í-keng ū hē Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok chòe î-it ê tōe-ki, I í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê tōe-ki.
Tī chit-ê tōe-ki téng, lâng nā ēng kim, gûn, pó-chio̍h, bo̍k-châi, chháu, á-sī tiū-kó khí-chō,
ta̍k-ê lâng kang-thêng ê hó-bái, tī Ki-tok lâi-lîm ê Ji̍t, ōe hō͘ hé kā i lō͘-hiān chhut--lâi, in-ūi hé ōe chhì-giām ta̍k-ê lâng kang-thêng ê phín-chit.
Lâng só͘ khí-chō--ê nā hō͘ hé sio bōe khì, i chiū ōe tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ.
Lâng só͘ khí-chō--ê nā hō͘ hé sio--khì, i chiū ōe sún-sit; put-kò i pún-sin ōe tit-tio̍h kiù, chhin-chhiūⁿ tùi hé-tiong tô-miā cháu--chhut-lâi.
Kiám m̄ chai, lín sī Siōng-tè ê tiān, Siōng-tè ê Sîn tiàm tī lín lāi-bīn?
Nā ū lâng húi-hoāi Siōng-tè ê tiān, Siōng-tè ōe kā i húi-bia̍t; in-ūi Siōng-tè ê tiān sī sîn-sèng--ê, lín chiū-sī hit-ê tiān.

M̄-thang phiàn ka-kī. Lín tiong-kan nā ū lâng ēng sè-kan ê phiau-chún khòaⁿ ka-kī chòe ū tì-hūi, ūi-tio̍h beh chiâⁿ-chòe chin-chiàⁿ ū tì-hūi, i tian-tò tio̍h chòe gû-gōng--ê.
In-ūi chit sè-kan ê tì-hūi, tùi Siōng-tè lâi khòaⁿ sī gû-gōng. Sèng-keng ū kì-chài, “Siōng-tè hō͘ tì-hūi ê lâng tiòng-tio̍h ka-kī ê khúi-kè.”
Pa̍t-ê só͘-chāi koh kóng, “Chú chai tì-hūi ê lâng ê sim-su bô lō͘-ēng.”
Só͘-í, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng lóng m̄-thang ēng lâng chòe khoa-kháu. Kî-si̍t it-chhè lóng sī lín ê:
bô-lūn Pó-lô, A-pho-lô, Pí-tek, chit sè-kài, siⁿ á-sī sí, hiān-chāi á-sī chiong-lâi, che it-chhè lóng sī lín ê;
lín sī Ki-tok ê, Ki-tok sī Siōng-tè ê.
Án-ni, lâng tio̍h khòaⁿ goán choh Ki-tok ê po̍k-jîn, sī Siōng-tè ò-pì ê koán-ke.
Tùi koán-ke ê iau-kiû sī tio̍h tùi chú-lâng tiong-si̍t.
Góa siū lín á-sī pa̍t-lâng phêng-toàn, lóng khòaⁿ-chòe sió-sū; liân góa mā bô phêng-toàn ka-kī.
Góa kám-kak ka-kī ê liông-sim chheng-pe̍k, put-kò m̄-sī án-ni chiū chèng-bêng góa bô chōe. Sím-phòaⁿ góa--ê sī Chú.

Só͘-í, sî-ki iáu-bē kàu, lín m̄-thang phoe-phòaⁿ lâng. Tán kàu Chú lâi-lîm, hit-sî I ōe ēng kng chiò o͘-àm tiong ê pì-bi̍t, kā ún-chông tī lâng sim-lāi ê tōng-ki po̍k-lō͘--chhut-lâi. Hit-sî, ta̍k-ê lâng ōe tùi Siōng-tè tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn.

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, ūi-tio̍h lín ê iân-kò͘, góa chiong chiah-ê sū chòe lē ēng tī góa pún-sin kap A-pho-lô ê sin-chiūⁿ, hō͘ lín thang tùi goán ha̍k-si̍p “m̄-thang chhiau-kè Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài” chit-kù ōe ê ì-sù. Lín tiong-kan bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng to m̄-thang phô͘-tháⁿ chit-ê, khòaⁿ-khin hit-ê.

Sím-mi̍h-lâng hō͘ lí siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī pí pa̍t-lâng khah gâu? Lí só͘-ū--ê kiám m̄-sī lóng tùi Siōng-tè niá-siū? Nā án-ni, lí sī-án-chóaⁿ teh chū-khoa, ná-chún m̄-sī tùi Siōng-tè niá-siū.

Lín í-keng ta̍k-hāng lóng ū! Lín í-keng hù-chiok! Lín kā goán sak tī piⁿ--á, ka-kī choh-ông. Lín nā chin-chiàⁿ choh-ông m̄-chai jōa-á-ni̍h hó leh, án-ni góa mā thang kap lín chòe-hé choh-ông!
Góa siūⁿ, Siōng-tè chiong goán chiah-ê sù-tô͘ pâi tī bé-liu, chhin-chhiūⁿ sí-hêng-hoān hō͘ lâng thoa chhut-lâi sī-chiòng, hō͘ sè-kài, thiⁿ-sài, kap lâng khòaⁿ.
Goán ūi-tio̍h Ki-tok ê iân-kò͘ chòe gōng-lâng, lín khiok kap Ki-tok kiat-liân chòe khiáu-lâng; goán loán-jio̍k, lín ióng-chòng; lín siū chun-tiōng, goán siū khòaⁿ-khin.
Kàu hiān-chāi, goán iáu koh teh chhùi-ta, chhēng phòa-saⁿ, siông-siông hō͘ lâng phah, ta̍k só͘-chāi liû-lōng;
goán khò siang-chhiú thoa-bôa tō͘-oa̍h. Goán hō͘ lâng mē, hoán-tńg kā in chiok-hok; hō͘ lâng pek-hāi, goán jím-siū;
hō͘ lâng bú-jio̍k, goán ēng hó-ōe hôe-tap. Kàu hiān-chāi, goán iáu hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe sè-kan ê pùn-sò, jîn-kan ê che-tái.
Góa siá chiah-ê hō͘ lín, m̄-sī beh hō͘ lín kiàn-siàu, sī khòaⁿ lín chòe ka-kī chhin-ài ê kiáⁿ-jî teh kā lín kà-sī.
Lín sui-jiân ū kui-bān ê kàu-tok ê lâng teh kà lín bat Ki-tok, m̄-kú lāu-pē chí-ū chi̍t ê. Thong-kè hok-im, góa tī Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ chiâⁿ-chòe lín ê lāu-pē.
Só͘-í góa khǹg lín, tio̍h o̍h góa.

In-ūi án-ni, góa chhe Thê-mô͘-thài khì lín hia. Tī Chú ê lāi-bīn i sī góa chhin-ài koh tiong-si̍t ê kiáⁿ; i ōe chiong góa kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-liân ê bô͘-hoān, chiū-sī góa tī ta̍k só͘-chāi ta̍k kàu-hōe só͘ kà-sī ê sū kā lín thê-chhíⁿ.
Lín tiong-kan ū lâng siūⁿ-kóng góa bōe khì lín hia, chiū chū-ko chū-tāi.
Nā-sī Chú ê ì-sù, góa liâm-piⁿ ōe khì lín hia. Hit-sî, góa chiū ōe chai hiah-ê kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng teh kóng sím-mi̍h, mā ōe chai in ōe-tàng chòe sím-mi̍h.
In-ūi Siōng-tè-kok ê si̍t-hiān m̄-sī khò giân-sû, sī khò koân-lêng.
Lín ài tó chi̍t hāng? Góa khì lín hia ê sî, lín ài góa gia̍h chhê-á á-sī tòa un-jiû thiàⁿ-thàng ê sim?
Góa khak-si̍t ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h tī lín tiong-kan ū îm-loān ê sū; chit-khoán îm-loān liân kàu-hōe-gōa mā bô, in-ūi ū lâng kap i ê āu-bú tông-ku.
Án-ni, lín iáu ū sím-mi̍h thang phòng-hong! Lín kiám m̄ eng-kai kám-kak siong-sim, kā chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì ê lâng tùi lín tiong-kan khai-tû?

Sui-jiân góa lâng kap lín saⁿ-lī, sim khiok kap lín chòe-hé. Góa í-keng hōng Chú Iâ-so͘ ê miâ kā chòe chit-khoán khó-ò͘ⁿ ê tāi-chì ê lâng phòaⁿ-chōe lah. Lín chū-chi̍p ê sî, góa ê sim mā kap lín chòe-hé, thang khò lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ ê tōa lêng-le̍k,
chiong chit-ê lâng kau hō͘ Sat-tàn húi-bia̍t i ê seng-khu, hō͘ i ê lêng-hûn thang tī lán ê Chú ê Ji̍t tit-tio̍h kiù.
Lín teh khoa-kháu bô eng-kai! Lín kiám m̄ chai “Chi̍t-sut-á kàⁿ-bú ōe hō͘ kui-oân ê mī-oân hoat--khí-lâi”?
Kū ê kàⁿ tio̍h tû hō͘ chheng-khì, lín chiah ōe chiâⁿ-chòe sin ê mī-oân, sū-si̍t lín sī bô kàⁿ ê mī-oân. Lán Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh ê iûⁿ-ko Ki-tok í-keng hiàn-chòe seng-lé.
Só͘-í, lán m̄-thang ēng ok-to̍k siâ-ok ê kū kàⁿ-bú, tio̍h ēng sûn-choân chin-si̍t ê bô-kàⁿ-piáⁿ chòe chè-mi̍h lâi siú-choeh.
Góa chêng kià hō͘ lín ê phoe ū kéng-kài lín m̄-thang kap îm-loān ê lâng lâi-óng.
Góa m̄-sī chí chit sè-kan hiah-ê îm-loān, tham-loân, chà-khi, kap pài ngó͘-siōng ê lâng; nā m̄-sī lī-khui chit-ê sè-kài chiū bōe-tàng bô kap chiah-ê lâng lâi-óng.

Góa taⁿ án-ni siá, sī kóng m̄-thang kap hiah-ê chū-chheng Ki-tok-tô͘, khiok sī îm-loān, tham-loân, pài ngó͘-siōng, húi-pòng pa̍t-lâng, chiú-chùi, á-sī chà-khi ê lâng lâi-óng; liân kap chiah-ê lâng tâng-toh chia̍h-pn̄g to m̄-thang.

Phoe-phòaⁿ kàu-hōe-gōa ê lâng m̄-sī góa ê tāi-chì; Siōng-tè ōe kā in sím-phòaⁿ. Lín kiám m̄-sī tio̍h phoe-phòaⁿ kàu-hōe-lāi ê lâng? Sèng-keng ū kì-chài, “Tio̍h tùi lín tiong-kan chiong siâ-ok ê lâng khai-tû!”
Lín tiong-kan ū lâng kap pa̍t-ê sìn-tô͘ ū kiù-hun, bô tī sìn-tô͘ bīn-chêng kā i kò, ná káⁿ tùi bô-sìn ê lâng kò i?
Lín kiám m̄ chai sìn-tô͘ beh sím-phòaⁿ sè-kan? Kì-jiân lín beh sím-phòaⁿ sè-kan, kiám bōe-hiáu kái-koat sió-khóa tāi-chì?
Lín kiám m̄ chai liân thiⁿ-sài lán to beh sím-phòaⁿ, chit sè-kan ji̍t-siông ê tāi-chì koh-khah m̄-bián kóng.
Chit-khoán tāi-chì, lín kiám thang kau hō͘ bô siū kàu-hōe chun-tiōng ê gōa-lâng chhú-lí?
Lín si̍t-chāi chin kiàn-siàu! Lín tiong-kan kiám chin-chiàⁿ bô chi̍t ê ū tì-hūi ê lâng thang phòaⁿ-toàn sìn-tô͘ tiong-kan ê sī-hui?
Lín kèng-jiân ū sìn-tô͘ kò sìn-tô͘, sīm-chì kò kàu bô-sìn ê lâng bīn-chêng!
Kî-si̍t lín sio-kò, piáu-sī lín í-keng lóng su lah. Lín ná m̄ lêng-khó siū oan-óng? Ná m̄ lêng-khó siū khek-khui?
Lín tian-tò oan-óng lâng, khek-khui lâng, sīm-chì tùi hōe-lāi ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē mā án-ni chòe!
Kiám m̄ chai put-gī ê lâng bōe-tàng chòe Siōng-tè-kok ê chú-bîn? M̄-thang phiàn ka-kī; bô-lūn sī îm-loān--ê, pài ngó͘-siōng--ê, choh lâm-chhiong--ê, hò͘ⁿ lâm-sek--ê,
chòe chha̍t--ê, tham-sim--ê, chiú-chùi--ê, húi-pòng--ê, chà-khi--ê, lóng bōe-tàng chòe Siōng-tè-kok ê chú-bîn.

Lín tiong-kan ū lâng í-chêng sī án-ni. M̄-kú lín í-keng sóe chheng-khì, í-keng sèng-hòa kui Siōng-tè, í-keng thong-kè Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ, koh thong-kè lán ê Siōng-tè ê Sîn, kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē.

Ū lâng kóng, “Ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì góa lóng thang chòe.” M̄-kú m̄-sī ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì lóng ū lī-ek. Góa mā thang kóng, “Ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì góa lóng thang chòe.” M̄-kú góa bô beh hō͘ jīm-hô tāi-chì khòng-chè.

Ū lâng kóng, “Chia̍h-mi̍h sī ūi-tio̍h pak-tó͘, pak-tó͘ sī ūi-tio̍h chia̍h-mi̍h.” Tio̍h, m̄-kú chit nn̄g hāng, Siōng-tè lóng ōe kā in húi-hoāi. Seng-khu m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h îm-loān, sī ūi-tio̍h ho̍k-sāi Chú; Chú ōe kiong-kip lán seng-khu ê su-iàu.
Siōng-tè ū hō͘ Chú tùi sí koh-oa̍h, I mā ōe ēng I ê tōa lêng-le̍k hō͘ lán koh-oa̍h.
Kiám m̄ chai lín ê seng-khu sī Ki-tok ê chi-thé? Án-ni, góa kiám thang chiong Ki-tok ê chi-thé hō͘ i pìⁿ-chòe ki-lú ê chi-thé? Choa̍t-tùi m̄-thang!
Kiám m̄ chai, kap ki-lú hoat-seng jio̍k-thé koan-hē chiū-sī kap i chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé? In-ūi Sèng-keng kóng, “Nn̄g ê lâng beh chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé.”
M̄-kú kap Chú kiat-ha̍p ê lâng, chiū tī sim-lêng kap I chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé.
Tio̍h kū-choa̍t îm-loān. Lâng bô-lūn hoān sím-mi̍h chōe, lóng bô éng-hióng ka-kī ê seng-khu, put-kò hoān îm-loān--ê sī hoān-chōe hāi-tio̍h ka-kī ê seng-khu.
Kiám m̄ chai lín ê seng-khu sī Sèng Sîn ê tiān? Chit-ūi Sèng Sîn tiàm tī lín lāi-bīn, sī lín tùi Siōng-tè niá-siū--ê. Lín m̄-sī sio̍k ka-kī, sī sio̍k Siōng-tè,
in-ūi lín sī I hù-chhut tāi-kè bóe--lâi-ê. Só͘-í, tio̍h ēng lín ê seng-khu êng-iāu Siōng-tè.
Koan-hē lín tī phoe ê lāi-bīn só͘ siá ê būn-tôe: Ta-po͘-lâng bô chhin-kūn cha-bó͘-lâng khah hó.
M̄-kú ūi-tio̍h pī-bián îm-loān ê tāi-chì, ta̍k-ê ta-po͘-lâng eng-kai ū ka-kī ê bó͘; ta̍k-ê cha-bó͘-lâng eng-kai ū ka-kī ê ang.
Ta-po͘-lâng tùi bó͘ eng-kai chīn choh-ang ê gī-bū; cha-bó͘-lâng tùi ang eng-kai chīn choh-bó͘ ê gī-bū.
Bó͘ tùi ka-kī ê seng-khu bô koân, m̄-kú ang ū; siâng-khoán, ang tùi ka-kī ê seng-khu bô koân, m̄-kú bó͘ ū.

M̄-thang hut-lio̍k tùi-hong ê su-iàu; nā ūi-tio̍h beh choan-sim kî-tó, thang tông-ì chiām-sî hun-khui; chóng-sī í-āu tio̍h koh hôe-ho̍k chèng-siông ê koan-hē, chiah bián in-ūi bōe-tàng khòng-chè ka-kī tì-kàu siū Sat-tàn iú-he̍k.
Góa kóng thang chiām-sî hun-khui, sī bián-kióng tông-ì, m̄-sī bēng-lēng.
Sū-si̍t, góa ài ta̍k-ê lâng lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ góa. M̄-kú ta̍k-ê lâng tùi Siōng-tè niá-siū bô kâng-khoán ê un-sù, chit-ê lâng chit-khoán, hit-ê lâng hit-khoán.
Hiān-chāi, góa tùi bô kiat-hun--ê kap kóaⁿ-hū kóng, nā ōe-tàng chhin-chhiūⁿ góa siú to̍k-sin sī khah hó;
m̄-kú nā bōe-tàng khòng-chè ka-kī, chiū tio̍h kiat-hun. Lêng-khó kiat-hun, pí hō͘ io̍k-hé sio khah hó.
Í-keng kiat-hun ê lâng, góa bēng-lēng lín — kî-si̍t m̄-sī góa, sī Chú ê bēng-lēng: Cha-bó͘-lâng m̄-thang lī-khui tiōng-hu,
nā lī-khui, tio̍h siú to̍k-sin; nā bô, tio̍h koh kap tiōng-hu hô-hó. Tiōng-hu mā m̄-thang pàng-sak bó͘.
Tùi kî-tha ê lâng, góa kóng — m̄-sī Chú kóng--ê: Lâm ê sìn-tô͘ nā chhōa bô sìn Chú ê lâng chòe bó͘, bó͘ tông-ì kè-sio̍k kap i tòa, i chiū m̄-thang kā i pàng-sak.
Nā ū lú ê sìn-tô͘ kap bô sìn Chú ê lâng kiat-hun, tiōng-hu tông-ì kè-sio̍k kap i tòa, i mā m̄-thang pàng-sak tiōng-hu.

Bô sìn Chú ê tiōng-hu ōe in-ūi sìn Chú ê bó͘ tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè chiap-la̍p. Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, bô sìn Chú ê bó͘ mā ōe in-ūi sìn Chú ê tiōng-hu tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè chiap-la̍p. Nā m̄-sī án-ni, in ê kiáⁿ-jî chiū bô sio̍k Siōng-tè; kî-si̍t, in sī sio̍k Siōng-tè.

M̄-kú, bô sìn Chú ê lâng nā beh lī-khui, chiū chhut-chāi i lī-khui. Tī chit-khoán ê chêng-hêng, sìn Chú ê tiōng-hu á-sī bó͘ chiū bô siū hun-in ê iok-sok. Siōng-tè ho͘-tiàu lín, sī ài lín hô-bo̍k khiā-khí.
Tio̍h chai, sìn Chú ê cha-bó͘-lâng kiám-chhái ōe kiù ka-kī ê tiōng-hu. Tio̍h chai, sìn Chú ê tiōng-hu kiám-chhái ōe kiù ka-kī ê bó͘.
Bô-lūn án-chóaⁿ, ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h chiàu Chú pun hō͘ lín ê un-sù, chiàu Siōng-tè kéng-tiàu ê bo̍k-te̍k lâi seng-oa̍h. Che sī góa hō͘ ta̍k-ê kàu-hōe ê kui-tēng.
Kat-lé liáu-āu chiah siū ho͘-tiàu ê lâng, m̄-bián am-khàm kat-lé ê kì-hō; siū ho͘-tiàu ê sî iáu-bē kat-lé ê lâng mā m̄-bián siū kat-lé.
In-ūi ū kat-lé bô kat-lé lóng bô iàu-kín, iàu-kín--ê sī tio̍h chun-siú Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng.
Ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h pó-chhî siū tiàu ê sî ê sin-hūn.
Lí siū tiàu ê sî sī lô͘-lē sī--bô, m̄-bián khòa-ì; put-kò lí nā ū ki-hōe tit-tio̍h chū-iû, tio̍h pá-ak ki-hōe.
In-ūi siū Chú ho͘-tiàu ê lô͘-lē sī Chú só͘ tháu-pàng ê chū-iû-jîn; siâng-khoán, siū Chú ho͘-tiàu ê chū-iû-jîn sī Ki-tok ê lô͘-po̍k.
Lín sī Siōng-tè hù-chhut tāi-kè bóe--lâi-ê, m̄-thang chiâⁿ-chòe lâng ê lô͘-lē.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng pó-chhî siū tiàu ê sî ê sin-hūn.

Koan-hē chāi-sek-lú ê būn-tôe, góa bô tùi Chú tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h bēng-lēng, put-kò chòe chi̍t ê tit-tio̍h Chú ê lîn-bín chiâⁿ-chòe thang sìn-jīm ê lâng, góa thê-chhut ka-kī ê ì-kiàn.
Khó-lū ba̍k-chêng kan-lân ê chhù-kéng, góa siūⁿ lâng pó-chhî hiān-chōng sī khah hó.
Í-keng chhōa-bó͘, m̄-thang siūⁿ-beh chū-iû; iáu-bē chhōa-bó͘, m̄-thang siūⁿ-beh chhōa.

M̄-kú nā chhōa-bó͘, bô sǹg hoān-chōe; siàu-lú nā chhut-kè, mā bô sǹg hoān-chōe. Put-kò kiat-hun ê lâng ōe ke-thiⁿ seng-oa̍h siōng ê thoa-lūi, góa khah ài lín bián tú-tio̍h chit-khoán tāi-chì.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa ê ì-sù sī, sî-kan pek-kūn lah, tùi taⁿ í-āu, ū bó͘--ê tio̍h ná-chún bô bó͘;
teh khàu--ê ná-chún bô teh khàu; teh hoaⁿ-hí--ê ná-chún bô teh hoaⁿ-hí; bóe-mi̍h--ê ná-chún bô tit-tio̍h pòaⁿ-hāng;
chhap sè-kan-sū--ê, ná-chún bô teh chhap. In-ūi chit sè-kan ê hiān-chōng teh kè--khì.
Góa ài lín lóng bô khòa-lū. Bô chhōa-bó͘ ê lâng koan-sim Chú ê sū, khòaⁿ beh án-chóaⁿ hō͘ Chú hoaⁿ-hí.
Chhōa-bó͘ ê lâng koan-sim sè-kan ê sū, khòaⁿ beh án-chóaⁿ hō͘ bó͘ hoaⁿ-hí,

soah hun-sim. Bô kè ê cha-bó͘-lâng á-sī siàu-lú koan-sim Chú ê sū, sī beh hō͘ seng-khu kap sim-lêng sèng-kiat; put-kò kè-ang ê cha-bó͘-lâng koan-sim sè-kan ê sū, khòaⁿ beh án-chóaⁿ hō͘ tiōng-hu hoaⁿ-hí.
Góa tùi lín án-ni kóng sī ūi-tio̍h lín ê lī-ek, m̄-sī beh kā lín sok-pa̍k, sī ài lín chòe ha̍p-gî ê sū, thang choan-sim ho̍k-sāi Chú.

Nā ū lâng tēng-hun liáu koat-tēng bô beh chhōa, āu-lâi in-ūi chêng-io̍k kiông, bōe-tàng khòng-chè ka-kī, ōe tùi bī-hun-chhe chòe-chhut bô ha̍p-gî ê sū, i tio̍h kiat-hun, án-ni chòe m̄-sī hoān-chōe.

Put-kò i nā m̄-sī in-ūi gōa-lâi ê ap-le̍k, sī chhut tī ka-kī ê koat-sim, koh ōe-tàng khòng-chè ka-kī ê ì-chì, koat-tēng bô beh kap bī-hun-chhe kiat-hun, hō͘ i pó-chhî chāi-sek-lú ê sin-hūn, i án-ni chòe sī hó.
Chóng kóng, kap bī-hun-chhe kiat-hun sī hó, bô kap i kiat-hun koh-khah hó.
Tiōng-hu iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî, cha-bó͘-lâng bô chū-iû; tiōng-hu sí-liáu, cha-bó͘-lâng thang chū-iû kap kah-ì ê lâng kiat-hun, put-kò, chí-ū thang kè hō͘ sìn Chú ê lâng.
I nā bô koh kè sī koh-khah ū hok-khì, che sī góa ê ì-kiàn, chóng-sī góa siūⁿ góa mā ū Siōng-tè ê Sîn ê chí-sī.
Koan-hē chè ngó͘-siōng ê mi̍h, lán chai “lán lóng ū tì-sek”. Kî-si̍t tì-sek ōe hō͘ lâng kiau-ngō͘; m̄-kú thiàⁿ-sim ōe chō-chiū lâng.
Ka-kī siūⁿ-kóng ū tì-sek--ê, si̍t-chè-siōng eng-kai chai--ê, i iáu m̄ chai.
Lâng nā thiàⁿ Siōng-tè, i sī Siōng-tè só͘ bat ê lâng.
Só͘-í, koan-hē chia̍h chè ngó͘-siōng ê mi̍h, lán chai, sè-kan ê ngó͘-siōng lóng m̄-sī chin--ê, lán mā chai chí-ū chi̍t ūi Siōng-tè, í-gōa bô pa̍t-ê.
Sui-jiân tī thiⁿ-téng á-sī tōe-chiūⁿ ū só͘-ūi ê sîn-bêng, koh sui-jiân ū chin chōe “sîn” á-sī “chú”,

m̄-kú lán chí-ū chi̍t ūi Siōng-tè, chiū-sī Thiⁿ Pē; bān-iú tùi I lâi chhòng-chō, lán ūi-tio̍h I lâi oa̍h. Lán chí-ū chi̍t ūi Chú, chiū-sī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok; bān-iú thong-kè I chhòng-chō, lán mā thong-kè I lâi chûn-chāi.

M̄-kú, m̄-sī ta̍k-ê lâng lóng ū chit-khoán tì-sek. Ū lâng pài ngó͘-siōng koàn-sì, kàu kin-á-ji̍t chia̍h mi̍h ê sî iáu siūⁿ-kóng sī teh chia̍h chè ngó͘-siōng ê mi̍h; in ê liông-sim loán-jio̍k, siūⁿ-kóng ōe hō͘ hit-khoán chia̍h-mi̍h bak lâ-sâm.
Kî-si̍t chia̍h-mi̍h bōe hō͘ lán khah chiap-kūn Siōng-tè; bô chia̍h bô sún-sit, chia̍h mā bô khah ū lī-ek.
M̄-kú tio̍h sòe-jī, m̄-thang in-ūi lín chū-iû ê hêng-ûi chiâⁿ-chòe loán-jio̍k ê lâng sìn-gióng ê chó͘-gāi.

Nā ū lâng liông-sim loán-jio̍k, khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín só͘-ūi “ū tì-sek” ê lâng tī ngó͘-siōng ê biō-lāi lim-chia̍h, án-ni lín kiám m̄-sī teh kó͘-lē in chia̍h chè ngó͘-siōng ê mi̍h?
Án-ni, chit-ê loán-jio̍k ê sìn-tô͘ mā-sī Ki-tok ūi-tio̍h i sí ê lâng, ōe in-ūi lín ê “tì-sek” lâi bia̍t-bông.
Lín án-ni chòe sī tek-chōe lín ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē, siong-hāi tio̍h in ê liông-sim chiū-sī tek-chōe Ki-tok.

Só͘-í, nā chia̍h-mi̍h ōe hō͘ hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē ê sìn-gióng siū chó͘-gāi, góa choa̍t-tùi m̄ chia̍h chè ngó͘-siōng ê bah, chiah bián hō͘ góa ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē ê sìn-gióng siū chó͘-gāi.
Góa kiám m̄-sī chū-iû ê lâng? Góa kiám m̄-sī sù-tô͘? Góa kiám m̄-bat kìⁿ-tio̍h lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘? Lín kiám m̄-sī góa ūi-tio̍h Chú kang-chok ê sêng-kó?
Tùi pa̍t-lâng lâi khòaⁿ, góa kiám-chhái m̄-sī sù-tô͘, m̄-kú tùi lín lâi khòaⁿ, góa khak-si̍t sī. In-ūi lín kap Chú kiat-liân chiū-sī góa choh sù-tô͘ ê chèng-kù.
Tùi hiah-ê phoe-phêng góa ê lâng, góa án-ni piān-bêng:
Goán kiám bô koân thang chia̍h, thang lim?
Goán kiám bô koân kap kî-tha ê sù-tô͘, Chú ê hiaⁿ-tī, í-ki̍p Pí-tek kâng-khoán, chhōa lú sìn-tô͘ chòe bó͘ chòe-hé lú-hêng?
Kiám kan-ta góa kap Pa-ná-pa it-tēng tio̍h chòe kang chiah ōe-tàng seng-oa̍h?
Kiám ū lâng choh-peng koh teh chia̍h ka-kī? Kiám ū lâng chèng-choh phû-tô-hn̂g bô chia̍h hn̂g-lāi chhut-sán ê phû-tô? Kiám ū lâng chhī iûⁿ bô lim ka-kī ê iûⁿ-lin?
Góa kóng chiah-ê kiám sī kun-kù lâng ê siūⁿ-hoat? Lu̍t-hoat kiám m̄-sī mā án-ni kóng?
Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat kui-tēng, “Gû teh lún ngó͘-kok ê sî, m̄-thang kā i kòa gû-chhùi-lam.” Siōng-tè koan-sim--ê kiám sī gû?

I kiám m̄-sī oân-choân ūi-tio̍h lán kóng--ê? Tong-jiân sī! In-ūi keng-choh ê lâng khǹg ǹg-bāng keng-choh, siu-koah ê lâng khǹg ǹg-bāng siu-koah, in lóng sī kî-thāi tit-tio̍h ngó͘-kok.
Goán nā ū tī lín tiong-kan iā sio̍k-lêng ê chéng-chí, tùi lín tit-tio̍h bu̍t-chit siōng ê kiong-kip kiám ū kè-hūn?

Pa̍t-lâng nā ū koân thang tùi lín iau-kiû, goán kiám m̄-sī koh-khah ū? M̄-kú goán lóng m̄-bat ēng chit-ê koân, hoán-tńg jím-siū it-chhè, chiah bián hō͘ Ki-tok ê hok-im siū chó͘-gāi.
Lín it-tēng chai, tī Sèng-tiān teh kang-chok ê lâng tùi Sèng-tiān tit-tio̍h chia̍h-mi̍h; tī chè-tôaⁿ teh hiàn-chè ê lâng pun-tio̍h tôaⁿ-téng ê chè-mi̍h.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, Chú ū hoan-hù: Thoân hok-im ê lâng eng-kai khò hok-im seng-oa̍h.

M̄-kú góa lóng m̄-bat ēng chiah-ê koân. Góa hiān-chāi siá chiah-ê ōe mā m̄-sī beh cheng-chhú chit-khoán ê koân. Góa lêng-khó sí mā bô ài hō͘ góa só͘ khoa-kháu--ê lo̍k-khong!
Góa thoân hok-im pèng bô sím-mi̍h thang khoa-kháu; góa sī hōng-bēng teh thoân. Góa nā bô thoân chiū ū chai-hō.
Góa nā kam-goān chòe chit-ê kang, chiū ū pò-siúⁿ; góa nā m̄-sī chhut-tī kam-goān, mā tio̍h chip-hêng Siōng-tè kau-tài ê jīm-bū.
Án-ni, góa ê pò-siúⁿ sī sím-mi̍h? Chiū-sī góa thoân hok-im hō͘ lâng pe̍h-pe̍h tit-tio̍h, m̄-kú ka-kī bô beh hióng-siū thoân hok-im eng-kai ū ê koân-lī.
Góa sī chū-iû ê lâng, bô siū lâng ê sok-pa̍k, m̄-kú ūi-tio̍h beh tit-tio̍h khah chōe lâng lâi sìn Chú, góa chiâⁿ-chòe chèng-lâng ê po̍k-jîn.

Tùi Iû-thài -lâng, góa chiū choh Iû-thài -lâng, sī ūi-tio̍h beh tit-tio̍h Iû-thài -lâng. Sui-jiân góa bô siū Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat khu-sok, khiok choh Lu̍t-hoat-ē ê lâng, sī ūi-tio̍h beh tit-tio̍h Lu̍t-hoat-ē ê lâng.

Tùi Lu̍t-hoat-gōa ê lâng, góa chiū choh Lu̍t-hoat-gōa ê lâng, sī ūi-tio̍h beh tit-tio̍h Lu̍t-hoat-gōa ê lâng. Án-ni m̄-sī kóng góa bô chun-siú Siōng-tè ê Lu̍t-hoat; kî-si̍t góa sī siū Ki-tok Lu̍t-hoat iok-sok ê lâng.

Tùi sìn-sim loán-jio̍k ê lâng, góa chiâⁿ-chòe loán-jio̍k, sī ūi-tio̍h beh tit-tio̍h loán-jio̍k ê lâng. Tùi tó chi̍t khoán lâng, góa chiū choh hit-khoán lâng, ēng ta̍k-khoán hong-hoat thang ke kiù chi̍t-kóa lâng.
Góa chòe chiah-ê lóng sī ūi-tio̍h hok-im, bo̍k-te̍k sī beh kap lâng hun-hióng hok-im.

Lín it-tēng chai, tī ūn-tōng-tiûⁿ chham-ka kèng-sài ê lâng lóng lo̍h-khì cháu, m̄-kú chí-ū chi̍t ê tit-tio̍h siúⁿ. Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, ūi-tio̍h beh tit-tio̍h siúⁿ, lín tio̍h phah-piàⁿ cháu.
Ta̍k-ê soán-chhiú lóng ū chiap-siū giâm-keh ê hùn-liān; in án-ni chòe sī beh tit-tio̍h ōe pāi-hoāi ê hoa-koan; m̄-kú lán ài tit--tio̍h-ê sī bōe pāi-hoāi ê hoa-koan.
Án-ni, góa cháu m̄-sī bô bo̍k-phiau, phah-kûn m̄-sī teh phah khong-khì.
Góa giâm-keh chhau-liān ka-kī ê seng-khu kàu ōe-tàng oân-choân khòng-chè, chiah bián góa chiong hok-im thoân hō͘ pa̍t-lâng, ka-kī tian-tò siū kū-choa̍t.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa ài lín ōe-kì--tit, lán ê chó͘-sian lóng kun-tè Mô͘-se, tī hûn ê pó-hō͘-ē kè Âng-hái.
In tī hûn-lāi, tī hái--ni̍h, siū sóe kui tī Mô͘-se.
In lóng chia̍h kâng-khoán sio̍k-lêng ê chia̍h-mi̍h,
lóng lim kâng-khoán sio̍k-lêng ê chôaⁿ-chúi, chit-ê chôaⁿ-chúi sī tùi kap in tâng-kiâⁿ hit-ê sio̍k-lêng ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ lâu--chhut-lâi--ê; hit-ê chio̍h-pôaⁿ chiū-sī Ki-tok.
M̄-kú in tiong-kan tōa-pō͘-hūn ê lâng bô hō͘ Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí, lóng siū húi-bia̍t, tó kah kui khòng-iá.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì hō͘ lán chòe kàm-kài, kiò lán m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ in tham-loân pháiⁿ-tāi.

M̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ in tiong-kan ū chi̍t-kóa lâng khì pài ngó͘-siōng; chiàu Sèng-keng kì-chài, “Chiah-ê chú-bîn chē--lo̍h-khì, tōa-chia̍h tōa-lim; khiā--khí-lâi, tian-kông loān-sńg.”
Lán m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ in ū chi̍t-kóa lâng îm-loān, soah tī chi̍t ji̍t lāi sí nn̄g-bān saⁿ-chheng lâng.
M̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ in tiong-kan ū chi̍t-kóa lâng chhì-thàm Chú, soah hō͘ chôa kā-sí.
M̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ in tiong-kan ū chi̍t-kóa lâng kóng oàn-giân, soah hō͘ Húi-bia̍t-chiá châu-bia̍t.
In só͘ tú--tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì thang chòe pa̍t-lâng ê kàm-kài, koh kì-lio̍k--lo̍h-lâi thang kéng-kài lán chiah-ê oa̍h tī boa̍t-sè ê lâng.
Só͘-í, siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī khiā-chāi--ê tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bōe poa̍h-tó.

Lín só͘ tú--tio̍h ê khó-giām lóng sī lâng ōe tú--tio̍h-ê. Siōng-tè sī sìn-si̍t--ê, I bōe hō͘ lín tú-tio̍h tam-tng bōe khí ê khó-giām. Lín tú-tio̍h khó-giām ê sî, I ōe kā lín khui chi̍t tiâu chhut-lō͘, hō͘ lín jím-siū ōe tiâu.
Só͘-í, chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, pài ngó͘-siōng ê sū lóng m̄-thang chhap--tio̍h.
Góa khòaⁿ lín chòe bêng-pe̍k sū-lí ê lâng kap lín kóng-ōe; góa só͘ kóng--ê lín ka-kī thang phòaⁿ-toàn.
Lán teh lim hit-ê kám-siā ê poe, kiám m̄-sī teh hun-hióng Ki-tok ê huih? Lán teh chia̍h hit-ê peh-khui ê piáⁿ, kiám m̄-sī teh hun-hióng Ki-tok ê seng-khu?
In-ūi piáⁿ chí-ū chi̍t tè, lán sui-jiân chin chōe lâng, iáu-kú sī chi̍t-thé, in-ūi lán chòe-hé chia̍h kâng chi̍t tè piáⁿ.
Ēng Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chòe lē, hiah-ê chia̍h chè-mi̍h ê lâng kap chè-tôaⁿ ū koan-hē.
Án-ni góa teh kóng--ê sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù? Sī kóng ngó͘-siōng ū sím-mi̍h tiōng-iàu, chè-mi̍h ū sím-mi̍h iàu-kín sī--bô?
M̄-sī, góa sī teh kóng, hiàn tī īⁿ-kàu chè-tôaⁿ téng ê chè-mi̍h sī hiàn hō͘ kúi, m̄-sī hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè. Góa bô ài lín kap kúi kau-chhap.
Lín lim Chú ê poe, bōe-ēng-tit koh lim kúi ê poe; lín chham-ka Chú ê iàn-se̍k, bōe-ēng-tit koh chham-ka kúi ê iàn-se̍k.
Lán beh kek Chú oàn-tò͘ sī--bô? Lán pí I khah kiông sī--bô?
Ū lâng kóng “Ta̍k-hāng lóng thang chòe”, put-kò m̄-sī ta̍k-hāng lóng ū lī-ek. “Ta̍k-hāng lóng thang chòe”, put-kò m̄-sī ta̍k-hāng sū lóng ōe-tàng pang-chān lâng.
Ta̍k-ê lâng lóng m̄-thang kiû ka-kī ê lī-ek, tio̍h kiû pa̍t-lâng ê lī-ek.
Chhī-tiûⁿ teh bōe ê bah lóng thang bóe lâi chia̍h, m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h liông-sim ê iân-kò͘ mn̄g-tang-mn̄g-sai.
In-ūi Sèng-keng kóng, “Tōe kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê bān-mi̍h lóng sio̍k tī Chú.”
Nā ū bī-sìn-chiá chhiáⁿ lín chia̍h-pn̄g, lín nā khì, pâi tī lín bīn-chêng ê mi̍h chòe lín chia̍h, m̄-bián ūi-tio̍h liông-sim ê iân-kò͘ mn̄g-tang-mn̄g-sai.
M̄-kú nā ū lâng kā lín kóng “Chiah-ê chia̍h-mi̍h ū chè-kè ngó͘-siōng”, lín chiū ūi-tio̍h hit-ê kā lín kóng ê lâng kap liông-sim ê iân-kò͘, mài chia̍h hit-ê chia̍h-mi̍h.
Góa só͘ chí ê sī hit-ê lâng ê liông-sim, m̄-sī lín ê liông-sim. Kiám-chhái ū lâng ōe mn̄g, “Góa ê chū-iû ná tio̍h siū pa̍t-lâng ê liông-sim phoe-phòaⁿ?
Góa nā kám-siā lâi chia̍h, ná tio̍h in-ūi chia̍h kám-siā ê mi̍h siū húi-pòng?”
Só͘-í, lín bô-lūn sī chia̍h sī lim, á-sī chòe sím-mi̍h, lóng tio̍h ūi-tio̍h êng-iāu Siōng-tè lâi chòe.
Bô-lūn sī tùi Iû-thài -lâng, Gōa-pang-lâng, á-sī Siōng-tè ê kàu-hōe, lín lóng m̄-thang chiâⁿ-chòe in ê chó͘-gāi.
Lín tio̍h chiàu góa só͘ chòe--ê khì chòe. Góa ūi-tio̍h hō͘ tāi-ke hoaⁿ-hí, m̄-bat kiû ka-kī ê lī-ek, sī kiû tāi-ke ê lī-ek, thang hō͘ in tit-tio̍h kiù.
Lín tio̍h o̍h góa, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa o̍h Ki-tok.
Lín put-sî ōe-kì-tit góa, koh chun-thàn góa thoân-siū hō͘ lín ê kà-sī, lín si̍t-chāi thang hō͘ góa o-ló.
Put-kò góa ài lín bêng-pe̍k, ta̍k-ê ta-po͘-lâng ê thâu sī Ki-tok, hū-jîn-lâng ê thâu sī tiōng-hu, Ki-tok ê thâu sī Siōng-tè.
Ta-po͘-lâng tī kong-kiōng tiûⁿ-só͘ kî-tó á-sī soan-káng Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê sî, nā tà thâu-kun sī bú-jio̍k i ê thâu Ki-tok.

M̄-kú cha-bó͘-lâng tī kî-tó á-sī soan-káng Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê sî, nā bô tà thâu-kun sī bú-jio̍k ka-kī ê thâu, chiū-sī i ê tiōng-hu. Chit-khoán ê hū-jîn-lâng kap thâu-mn̂g hō͘ lâng thì--khí-lâi ê cha-bó͘-lâng bô sím-mi̍h chha-pia̍t.
Cha-bó͘-lâng nā m̄ tà thâu-kun, thâu-mn̂g tio̍h chián--khí-lâi; kì-jiân khòaⁿ thì kng-thâu á-sī chián thâu-mn̂g chòe kiàn-siàu ê sū, chiū tio̍h tà thâu-kun.
Ta-po͘-lâng bô eng-kai tà thâu-kun, in-ūi i sī Siōng-tè ê hêng-siōng kap êng-iāu; cha-bó͘-lâng sī ta-po͘-lâng ê êng-iāu.
In-ūi ta-po͘-lâng m̄-sī tùi cha-bó͘-lâng chō--chhut-lâi--ê, cha-bó͘-lâng sī tùi ta-po͘-lâng chō--chhut-lâi--ê.
Ta-po͘-lâng m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h cha-bó͘-lâng chō--ê, m̄-kú cha-bó͘-lâng sī ūi-tio̍h ta-po͘-lâng chō--ê.
Ūi-tio̍h thiⁿ-sài ê iân-kò͘, cha-bó͘-lâng ê thâu eng-kai tà koân-ui ê kì-hō.
Chóng-sī tī Chú ê lāi-bīn, ta-po͘-lâng su-iàu cha-bó͘-lâng, cha-bó͘-lâng mā su-iàu ta-po͘-lâng.
In-ūi cha-bó͘-lâng sī tùi ta-po͘-lâng chō--chhut-lâi--ê, ta-po͘-lâng sī thong-kè cha-bó͘-lâng siⁿ--ê, m̄-kú bān-mi̍h lóng sī tùi Siōng-tè chhut--lâi-ê.
Lín tio̍h ka-kī phòaⁿ-toàn: Cha-bó͘-lâng bô tà thâu-kun tùi Siōng-tè kî-tó ū ha̍p-gî--bô?
Chū-jiân ê pún-sèng kà lán, lâu tn̂g thâu-mn̂g sī ta-po͘-lâng ê kiàn-siàu,
m̄-kú cha-bó͘-lâng lâu tn̂g thâu-mn̂g sī i ê êng-iāu. In-ūi tn̂g thâu-mn̂g thang chòe cha-bó͘-lâng ê jia-phè.
Nā ū lâng ài piān-pok, góa chí-ū ōe-tàng kóng, tī lán kap Siōng-tè ê kàu-hōe pèng bô kî-tha ê kui-kú.
Góa tī chia beh kóng ê ōe m̄-sī beh kā lín o-ló, in-ūi lín ê chū-hōe sún-hāi pí lī-ek khah chōe.
Tē-it, góa ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ kóng, lín tī kàu-hōe chū-hōe ê sî kiat-tóng hun-phài, góa siong-sìn ū chi̍t-pō͘-hūn sī sū-si̍t.
Lín tiong-kan lân-bián ū hun-lia̍t, án-ni chiah ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-chhut sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe thong-kè khó-giām.
Lín chū-chi̍p ê sî, m̄-sī teh chia̍h Chú ê Boán-chhan.
In-ūi lín ta̍k-ê lâng kóaⁿ-kín chia̍h ka-kī tòa--lâi ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ, kiat-kó ū-ê iau, ū-ê chiú-chùi.

Lín kiám bô chhù thang chia̍h, thang lim? Lín sī teh biáu-sī Siōng-tè ê kàu-hōe, ia̍h teh hō͘ bô mi̍h thang chia̍h ê lâng kiàn-siàu sī--bô? Góa beh tùi lín kóng sím-mi̍h? Góa kiám tio̍h kā lín o-ló? Bōe, tī chit-hāng sū góa bōe kā lín o-ló!
Góa tùi Chú só͘ niá-siū--ê, góa mā thoân hō͘ lín: Chú Iâ-so͘ hō͘ lâng chhut-bōe hit-mî, I the̍h piáⁿ,
kám-siā Siōng-tè liáu-āu, peh-khui, kóng, “Chit-ê sī góa ê seng-khu, ūi-tio̍h lín hi-seng--ê; lín tio̍h chòe chit-ê lâi kì-liām góa.”
Chiàu án-ni, chia̍h liáu-āu, I koh phâng poe, kóng, “Chit-ê poe sī sin ê iok, ēng góa ê huih siat-li̍p--ê, lín ta̍k-pái lim ê sî tio̍h chòe chit-ê lâi kì-liām góa.”
Án-ni, lín ta̍k-pái chia̍h chit-ê piáⁿ, lim chit-ê poe, sī teh soan-kò Chú ê sí, ti̍t-kàu I lâi-lîm.
Só͘-í, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng, nā bô ēng ha̍p-gî ê thài-tō͘ chia̍h Chú ê piáⁿ, lim Chú ê poe, sī tek-chōe Chú ê sin-thé kap huih.
Ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h séng-chhat ka-kī chiah thang chia̍h chit-ê piáⁿ, lim chit-ê poe.
Lín chia̍h chit-ê piáⁿ, lim chit-ê poe, nā bô khak-si̍t bêng-pe̍k Chú ê seng-khu ê ì-sù, chia̍h chit-ê piáⁿ lim chit-ê poe sī ka-kī jiá sím-phòaⁿ.
In-ūi án-ni, tī lín tiong-kan ū chin chōe lâng loán-jio̍k, phòa-pīⁿ, mā ū lâng tì-kàu sí.
Lán nā seng séng-chhat ka-kī, chiū bōe tì-kàu siū sím-phòaⁿ.
Put-kò lán siū Chú sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, sī teh siū koán-kàu, hō͘ lán bián tì-kàu kap sè-kan tâng siū tēng-chōe.
Só͘-í, góa ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín chū-chi̍p chia̍h Chú ê Boán-chhan ê sî, tio̍h hō͘-siōng thèng-hāu.
Nā ū lâng iau, tio̍h tī chhù--ni̍h seng chia̍h, chiah bián lín chū-hōe tian-tò siū Siōng-tè sím-phòaⁿ. Kî-tha ê tāi-chì, góa khì lín hia ê sî chiah chhú-lí.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, koan-hē Sèng Sîn ê un-sù, góa ài lín liáu-kái.
Lín chai, lín iáu-sī īⁿ-kàu-tô͘ ê sî chhut-chāi lâng chhōa-khì pài bōe kóng-ōe ê ngó͘-siōng.

Só͘-í góa ài lín liáu-kái, só͘-ū siū Siōng-tè ê Sîn kám-tōng ê lâng, bô lâng ōe kóng “Iâ-so͘ tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘”; nā bô siū Sèng Sîn kám-tōng, mā bô lâng ōe kóng “Iâ-so͘ sī Chú”.
Un-sù ū chin chōe khoán, m̄-kú sù un-sù--ê sī kâng chi̍t ūi Sèng Sîn.
Sū-hōng ū chin chōe khoán, m̄-kú sī sū-hōng kâng chi̍t ūi Chú.
Kang-chok ū chin chōe khoán, m̄-kú pang-chān ta̍k-ê lâng khì chòe ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì--ê sī kâng chi̍t ūi Siōng-tè.
Sèng Sîn tī ta̍k-ê lâng sin-chiūⁿ hián-bêng--ê, sī beh hō͘ tāi-ke tit-tio̍h lī-ek.
Ū lâng thong-kè Sèng Sîn tit-tio̍h thoân sìn-sit ê tì-hūi; ū lâng kun-kù kâng chi̍t ūi Sèng Sîn tit-tio̍h thoân sìn-sit ê tì-sek;
ū lâng tùi kâng chi̍t ūi Sèng Sîn tit-tio̍h sìn-sim; ū lâng tùi kâng chi̍t ūi Sèng Sîn tit-tio̍h i-pīⁿ ê un-sù;

ū lâng tit-tio̍h kiâⁿ sîn-jiah ê un-sù; ū lâng tit-tio̍h thoân Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê un-sù; ū lâng tit-tio̍h hun-piān Siōng-tè ê Sîn kap pa̍t-ê sîn ê un-sù; ū lâng tit-tio̍h kóng lêng-gú ê un-sù; ū lâng tit-tio̍h kóe-seh lêng-gú ê un-sù.
Chiah-ê it-chhè lóng sī kâng chi̍t ūi Sèng Sîn ê ūn-chok, I chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù chiong bô kâng-khoán ê un-sù pun hō͘ ta̍k-ê lâng.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ seng-khu sī chi̍t ê, m̄-kú ū chin chōe chi-thé; seng-khu sui-jiân ū chin chōe chi-thé, m̄-kú seng-khu chí-ū chi̍t ê; Ki-tok mā-sī án-ni.

Bô-lūn sī Iû-thài -lâng á-sī Gōa-pang-lâng, lô͘-lē á-sī chū-iû ê lâng, lán lóng tùi kâng chi̍t ūi Sèng Sîn niá-siū sóe-lé, chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé, koh lán mā lóng lim kâng chi̍t ūi Sèng Sîn lâi tit-tio̍h lūn-te̍k.
Seng-khu m̄-sī chí-ū chi̍t ê chi-thé, sī ū chin chōe chi-thé.
Kha nā kóng “Góa m̄-sī chhiú, só͘-í bô sio̍k seng-khu”, kha m̄-sī án-ni kóng chiū bô sio̍k seng-khu.
Hī-á nā kóng “Góa m̄-sī ba̍k-chiu, só͘-í bô sio̍k seng-khu”, hī-á m̄-sī án-ni kóng chiū bô sio̍k seng-khu.
Choân seng-khu nā lóng sī ba̍k-chiu, beh ēng sím-mi̍h lâi thiaⁿ? Choân seng-khu nā lóng sī hī-á, beh ēng sím-mi̍h lâi phīⁿ?
Án-ni, Siōng-tè chiàu I ê chí-ì chiong ta̍k-khoán chi-thé an-tì tī seng-khu.
Choân-pō͘ nā chí-ū sī chi̍t ê chi-thé, ná ōe-tàng sǹg-chòe seng-khu?
Án-ni, chi-thé ū chin chōe, m̄-kú seng-khu chí-ū chi̍t ê.
Ba̍k-chiu bōe-tàng kā chhiú kóng “Góa bô su-iàu lí!” Thâu mā bōe-tàng tùi kha kóng “Góa bô su-iàu lí!”
Kî-si̍t, lán ê seng-khu hiah-ê khòaⁿ--khí-lâi khah loán-jio̍k ê chi-thé tian-tò khah ū pit-iàu.
Lán khòaⁿ khah m̄ chiūⁿ-ba̍k ê chi-thé, tian-tò khah tio̍h kā in khòaⁿ-tāng; khah pháiⁿ-khòaⁿ ê chi-thé, tian-tò khah tio̍h kā in chng-thāⁿ;
hiah-ê khah hó-khòaⁿ ê chi-thé chiū bô su-iàu chng-thāⁿ. Siōng-tè chiong seng-khu an-pâi hó-sè, hō͘ hiah-ê khah bô tiōng-iàu ê chi-thé tit-tio̍h khah-tōa ê chun-tiōng,
thang hō͘ seng-khu bián tì-kàu hun-lia̍t, tian-tò hō͘ ta̍k-ê chi-thé hō͘-siōng chiàu-kò͘.
Chi̍t ê chi-thé siū-khó͘, kî-tha ê chi-thé chiū chòe-hé siū-khó͘; chi̍t ê chi-thé tit-tio̍h êng-kng, kî-tha ê chi-thé chiū chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí.
Lín sī Ki-tok ê seng-khu, ta̍k-ê lâng sī seng-khu ê chi-thé.

Siōng-tè tī kàu-hōe só͘ an-tì--ê, tē-it sī sù-tô͘, tē-jī sī sian-ti, tē-saⁿ sī kàu-su, koh ū kiâⁿ sîn-jiah--ê, koh ū i-pīⁿ un-sù--ê, pang-chān lâng--ê, koán-lí sū-bū--ê, kóng ta̍k-khoán lêng-gú--ê.
Ta̍k-ê lâng kiám lóng sī sù-tô͘? Kiám lóng sī sian-ti? Kiám lóng sī kàu-su? Kiám lóng sī kiâⁿ sîn-jiah--ê?
Kiám lóng sī ū i-pīⁿ un-sù--ê? Kiám lóng sī kóng lêng-gú--ê? Kiám lóng sī kóe-seh lêng-gú--ê?
Lín tio̍h jia̍t-chhiat him-bō͘ hiah-ê koh-khah tiōng-iàu ê un-sù. Taⁿ góa kā lín chí-sī chi̍t tiâu siōng-hó ê lō͘.
Góa nā ōe-hiáu kóng lâng ê gú-giân, sīm-chì thiⁿ-sài ê gú-giân, nā bô jîn-ài, góa chiū chhin-chhiūⁿ lô teh tân, poa̍h teh hiáng.

Góa nā ū thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê un-sù, ōe liáu-kái ta̍k-khoán ê ò-pì kap ta̍k-khoán ê tì-sek; góa nā ū kàu-gia̍h ê sìn-sim thang î-san-tó-hái, nā bô jîn-ài, góa chiū bô lō͘-ēng.
Góa nā the̍h só͘-ū ê châi-sán khì kiù-chè, á-sī hiàn seng-khu hō͘ hé sio, nā bô jîn-ài, tùi góa lóng bô lī-ek.
Jîn-ài sī khoan-iông; jîn-ài sī chû-pi; ū jîn-ài chiū bōe oàn-tò͘, bōe khoa-kháu, bōe kiau-ngō͘,
bōe chòe kiàn-siàu ê tāi-chì, bōe kiû ka-kī ê lī-ek, bōe khoài siū-khì, bōe khioh-hūn,
bōe ài put-gī, chí-ū ài chin-lí.
Jîn-ài ōe pau-iông it-chhè, tùi it-chhè ū sìn-sim, tùi it-chhè ū ǹg-bāng, tùi it-chhè ū nāi-sim.
Jîn-ài éng-oán chûn-chāi. Thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê un-sù ōe kiat-sok; kóng lêng-gú ê un-sù ōe thêng-chí; tì-sek mā ōe siau-sit.
Lán só͘ bat--ê iú-hān; lán thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê un-sù mā iú-hān.
M̄-kú hit-ê oân-choân--ê chi̍t-ē lâi, hit-ê iú-hān--ê chiū siau-sit.

Góa choh gín-á ê sî, kóng-ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ gín-á, ì-kiàn chhin-chhiūⁿ gín-á, siūⁿ-hoat mā chhin-chhiūⁿ gín-á; góa kì-jiân sêng-jîn, chiū chiong gín-á ê sū lóng pàng-sak.

Lán hiān-chāi chhin-chhiūⁿ chiò-kiàⁿ teh khòaⁿ, bū-bū bô-bêng, chiong-lâi ōe bīn-tùi-bīn khòaⁿ chheng-chhó. Góa hiān-chāi chí-ū chai chi̍t-pō͘-hūn, chiong-lâi ōe oân-choân liáu-kái, chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè oân-choân liáu-kái góa.
Án-ni, sìn, ǹg-bāng, jîn-ài chit saⁿ hāng kè-sio̍k chûn-chāi, kî-tiong siōng tiōng-iàu--ê sī jîn-ài.
Tio̍h tui-kiû jîn-ài; tio̍h jia̍t-chhiat him-bō͘ sio̍k-lêng ê un-sù, te̍k-pia̍t sī thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê un-sù.
Kóng lêng-gú ê lâng m̄-sī teh tùi lâng kóng, sī teh tùi Siōng-tè kóng, in-ūi bô lâng thiaⁿ ū; i sī khò Sèng Sîn teh kóng ò-pì ê sū.
Put-kò thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê lâng sī teh tùi lâng kóng, beh hō͘ in tit-tio̍h chō-chiū, kó͘-lē, an-ùi.
Kóng lêng-gú ê lâng chí-ū chō-chiū ka-kī, put-kò thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê lâng chō-chiū choân kàu-hōe.

Góa ài lín ta̍k-ê lâng lóng ōe kóng lêng-gú, koh-khah ài lín ōe thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit. Kóng lêng-gú nā m̄-sī ū lâng kóe-seh, hō͘ kàu-hōe tit-tio̍h chō-chiū, án-ni, thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit pí kóng lêng-gú khah tiōng-iàu.
Só͘-í, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa khì lín hia, nā kan-ta kóng lêng-gú, bô thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè ê khé-sī, á-sī tì-sek, á-sī sìn-sit, á-sī kà-sī, tùi lín ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek?
Bô sìⁿ-miā ê ga̍k-khì chhin-chhiūⁿ phín-á á-sī khîm, in só͘ hoat-chhut ê im nā bô koân-kē piàn-hòa, lâng ná ōe chai sī teh chàu sím-mi̍h?
Lat-pah ê siaⁿ nā bô chún-khak, lâng ná chai thang chún-pī sio-chiàn?
Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, lín só͘ kóng ê lêng-gú, ì-sù nā bô chheng-chhó, lâng ná ōe lí-kái lín teh kóng sím-mi̍h? Án-ni lín sī teh tùi khong-khì kóng-ōe.
Sè-kan ū chin chōe bô kâng-khoán ê gú-giân, ta̍k-ê lóng ū ì-sù.

Góa nā m̄ bat bó͘ chi̍t ê gú-giân, tùi teh kóng chit-ê gú-giân ê lâng lâi khòaⁿ góa sī gōa-kok-lâng; teh kóng chit-ê gú-giân ê lâng tùi góa lâi khòaⁿ mā-sī gōa-kok-lâng.
Lín mā-sī án-ni, kì-jiân lín jia̍t-chhiat him-bō͘ sio̍k-lêng ê un-sù, tio̍h koh-khah chhut-la̍t tui-kiû hiah-ê ōe chō-chiū kàu-hōe ê un-sù.
Só͘-í, kóng lêng-gú ê lâng tio̍h kî-kiû ōe-tàng kóe-seh ê lêng-le̍k.
Góa nā ēng lêng-gú kî-tó, sī góa ê lêng teh kî-tó, m̄-kú góa ê lí-tì bô chok-iōng.
Án-ni góa beh án-chóaⁿ? Góa beh ēng lêng kî-tó, mā beh ēng lí-tì kî-tó. Góa beh ēng lêng gîm-si, mā beh ēng lí-tì gîm-si.

Nā bô, lín nā chí-ū ēng lêng kám-siā Siōng-tè, chham-ka chū-hōe hiah-ê bô liáu-kái lêng-gú ê sìn-tô͘ m̄ chai lín teh kóng sím-mi̍h, beh ná ōe tùi lín ê kám-siā kóng “Amen”?
Lín ê kám-siā kiám-chhái chin hó, m̄-kú bô hō͘ pa̍t-lâng tit-tio̍h chō-chiū.
Kám-siā Siōng-tè, góa pí lín chèng-lâng kóng koh-khah chōe lêng-gú.
M̄-kú tī kàu-hōe tiong, góa lêng-khó kóng gō͘ kù ū lí-tì ê ōe thang kà-sī pa̍t-lâng, mā bô ài kóng chi̍t-bān kù lêng-gú.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín siūⁿ tāi-chì m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ gín-á; tùi pháiⁿ tāi-chì tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ eⁿ-á, siūⁿ tāi-chì tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-lâng.
Tī Lu̍t-hoat-su ū kì-chài: Chú kóng: Góa beh ēng kóng gōa-kok-ōe ê lâng, ēng īⁿ-pang-lâng ê chhùi-tûn, tùi góa ê chú-bîn kóng-ōe, m̄-kú in iáu m̄ thiaⁿ.

Án-ni, kóng lêng-gú m̄-sī beh hō͘ sìn-tô͘, sī beh hō͘ bô-sìn ê lâng chòe kì-hō. M̄-kú thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê un-sù m̄-sī beh hō͘ bô-sìn ê lâng, sī beh hō͘ sìn-tô͘ chòe kì-hō.
Choân kàu-hōe chū-chi̍p ê sî, tāi-ke nā lóng teh kóng lêng-gú, ū bô liáu-kái lêng-gú ê sìn-tô͘ á-sī bô-sìn ê lâng ji̍p--lâi, kiám bōe kóng lín sī teh khí-siáu?
Tāi-ke nā lóng teh thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit, ū bô-sìn ê lâng á-sī bô liáu-kái lêng-gú ê sìn-tô͘ ji̍p--lâi, thiaⁿ-tio̍h hiah-ê ōe chiū hiáu-ngō͘ chai-chōe,
sim-lāi ê pì-bi̍t hián-lō͘ chhut--lâi, ōe phak lo̍h-khì kèng-pài Siōng-tè, soan-kò kóng, “Siōng-tè chin-chiàⁿ tī lín tiong-kan!”

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, án-ni beh án-chóaⁿ? Lín chū-hōe ê sî, ū lâng chhiùⁿ sèng-si, ū lâng kà-sī, ū lâng soan-káng Siōng-tè ê khé-sī, ū lâng kóng lêng-gú, mā ū lâng kóe-seh lêng-gú. Ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì lóng tio̍h ūi-tio̍h chō-chiū kàu-hōe lâi chòe.
Nā ū lâng kóng lêng-gú, chí-ū nn̄g ê, siōng chōe saⁿ ê lûn-liû kóng, koh tio̍h ū lâng kóe-seh.
Nā-sī bô lâng thang kóe-seh, in tī chū-hōe tiong tio̍h chēng-chēng, chí-ū tùi ka-kī kap Siōng-tè kóng.
Soan-káng Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit, thang hō͘ nn̄g ê á-sī saⁿ ê kóng, kî-tha ê lâng thang phòaⁿ-toàn in só͘ kóng--ê.
Put-kò chāi-chō ê lâng nā ū tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê khé-sī, tú-teh kóng ê lâng tio̍h chēng-chēng.
Lín ta̍k-ê lâng lóng thang lûn-liû soan-káng Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit, thang chòe-hé ha̍k-si̍p, hō͘-siōng bián-lē.
Soan-káng Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê lâng tio̍h ōe-hiáu iok-sok ka-kī ê un-sù,
in-ūi Siōng-tè m̄-sī hūn-loān ê Siōng-tè, sī hô-hâi ê Siōng-tè. Kap só͘-ū Siōng-tè chú-bîn ê kàu-hōe kâng-khoán,
hū-jîn-lâng tī chū-hōe tiong tio̍h chēng-chēng, bōe-ēng-tit kóng-ōe. Chiàu Iû-thài Lu̍t-hoat só͘ kóng, hū-jîn-lâng tio̍h sūn-ho̍k.
In nā ài o̍h sím-mi̍h, tio̍h tī chhù--ni̍h mn̄g ka-kī ê tiōng-hu; hū-jîn-lâng tī chū-hōe tiong kóng-ōe bô thé-biān.
Ná án-ni kóng! Siōng-tè ê ōe kiám tùi lín lâi, kiám kan-ta thoân hō͘ lín?
Nā ū lâng siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī sī thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê lâng, á-sī sio̍k-lêng ê lâng, tio̍h chai góa teh siá hō͘ lín--ê sī Chú ê bēng-lēng.
Nā ū lâng bô khòaⁿ chit-ê tāi-chì chòe iàu-kín, mā m̄-bián kā i khòaⁿ-chòe iàu-kín.
Só͘-í, góa ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, tio̍h jia̍t-chhiat him-bō͘ thoân-ta̍t Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê un-sù, put-kò mā m̄-thang kìm-chí lâng kóng lêng-gú.
Hoān-sū tio̍h kui-kui-kú-kú, chiàu tia̍t-sū chòe.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa beh kā lín thê-chhíⁿ: Góa thoân hō͘ lín ê hok-im lín ū chiap-siū, mā ēng che chòe sìn-gióng ê ki-chhó͘.
Lín nā ū kian-siú góa só͘ thoân ê sìn-sit, m̄-sī khang-khang sìn, chiū ōe khò chit-ê hok-im tit-tio̍h kiù.
Góa í-keng ū chiong góa pún-sin só͘ niá-siū hit-ê siōng tiōng-iàu ê sìn-sit thoân hō͘ lín, chiū-sī chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài, Ki-tok ūi-tio̍h lán ê chōe sí,
bâi-chòng; koh chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài, I tē-saⁿ ji̍t koh-oa̍h;
I ū tùi Pí-tek hián-hiān, koh tùi cha̍p-jī sù-tô͘ hián-hiān.
Āu-lâi I ū chi̍t pái tùi gō͘-pah gōa ê hiaⁿ-tī hián-hiān; hiah-ê lâng ū ê í-keng sí, m̄-kú tōa-pō͘-hūn ê lâng iáu oa̍h--teh.
Āu-lâi I ū tùi Ngá-kok hián-hiān, koh tùi só͘-ū ê sù-tô͘ hián-hiān.
Chòe-āu, I mā tùi góa chit-ê ná-chún bô kàu-ge̍h chiū chhut-sì ê lâng hián-hiān.
Góa sī sù-tô͘ tiong siōng bî-sòe--ê, bōe-kham-tit chheng-chòe sù-tô͘, in-ūi góa bat pek-hāi Siōng-tè ê kàu-hōe.

M̄-kú ū Siōng-tè ê un-tián chiah ū kin-á-ji̍t ê góa, I sù hō͘ góa ê un-tián bô lo̍k-khong. Góa tian-tò pí kî-tha ê sù-tô͘ koh-khah phah-piàⁿ kang-chok, kî-si̍t m̄-sī góa ka-kī, sī Siōng-tè ê un-tián kap góa tông-chāi.
Só͘-í, bô-lūn sī góa á-sī in, che sī goán só͘ teh thoân, lín í-keng ū teh sìn--ê.
Kì-jiân goán só͘ soan-iông--ê sī Ki-tok í-keng ū tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, lín tiong-kan ná ū lâng kóng bô sí-lâng koh-oa̍h chit-khoán tāi-chì?
Nā bô sí-lâng koh-oa̍h, án-ni Ki-tok chiū bô koh-oa̍h.
Nā Ki-tok bô koh-oa̍h, án-ni goán só͘ soan-iông--ê sī khang-khang, lín ê sìn mā-sī khang-khang.

Án-ni goán chiū-sī teh ūi Siōng-tè chòe ké kiàn-chèng, in-ūi goán kiàn-chèng Siōng-tè í-keng hō͘ Ki-tok koh-oa̍h; sí-lâng nā bô koh-oa̍h, Siōng-tè chiū bô hō͘ Ki-tok koh-oa̍h.
Nā sí-lâng bô koh-oa̍h, Ki-tok chiū bô koh-oa̍h.
Ki-tok nā bô koh-oa̍h, lín ê sìn chiū bô lō͘-ēng, lín chiū iáu tī chōe-ok tiong.
Án-ni, hiah-ê sìn Ki-tok liáu-āu sí--khì ê lâng mā lóng bia̍t-bông lah.
Lán sìn Ki-tok ê lâng nā kan-ta tī hiān-sè ū ǹg-bāng, lán sī só͘-ū ê lâng ê tiong-kan siōng thang khó-lîn--ê.
M̄-kú, hiān-chāi Siōng-tè í-keng ū hō͘ Ki-tok tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, thang chòe í-keng sí--khì ê lâng koh-oa̍h ê pó-chèng.
In-ūi sí thong-kè chi̍t ê lâng lâi, sí-lâng ê koh-oa̍h mā-sī thong-kè chi̍t ê lâng lâi.
Tùi A-tong chèng-lâng lóng tio̍h sí, án-ni, tùi Ki-tok chèng-lâng mā lóng ōe koh-oa̍h.
Put-kò ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tio̍h chiàu ka-kī ê sūn-sū koh-oa̍h: Thâu chi̍t ê sī Ki-tok, sòa--lo̍h-khì sī Ki-tok lâi-lîm ê sî sio̍k I ê lâng,
koh-lâi chiah sī boa̍t-kî; hit-sî I ōe siau-bia̍t it-chhè ê thóng-léng-chiá, chiáng-koân-chiá, kap koân-le̍k-chiá, jiân-āu chiong thóng-tī-koân kau hō͘ Pē Siōng-tè.
In-ūi Ki-tok it-tēng tio̍h thóng-tī, ti̍t-kàu Siōng-tè hō͘ it-chhè ê tùi-te̍k lóng khut-ho̍k tī I ê kha-ē.
Chòe-āu siū húi-bia̍t ê tùi-te̍k sī sí.

In-ūi Sèng-keng kì-chài kóng, “Siōng-tè hō͘ bān-iú lóng khut-ho̍k tī I ê kha-ē.” Chin bêng-hián, chia só͘ kóng ê “bān-iú” pèng bô pau-hâm hō͘ bān-iú khut-ho̍k tī Ki-tok kha-ē ê Siōng-tè.
Kàu bān-iú lóng khut-ho̍k Ki-tok ê sî, Kiáⁿ pún-sin mā ōe khut-ho̍k tī hō͘ bān-iú lóng khut-ho̍k ê Siōng-tè, thang hō͘ Siōng-tè oân-choân thóng-hat it-chhè.
Nā m̄-sī án-ni, lâng thòe sí-lâng siū sóe ū sím-mi̍h ì-sù? Nā bô sí-lâng koh-oa̍h ê sū, sī-án-chóaⁿ beh thòe sí-lâng siū sóe?
Goán sī-án-chóaⁿ tio̍h sî-sî-khek-khek mō͘-hiám?
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa hōng lán ê Chú Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ tùi lín chiah-ê góa só͘ khoa-kháu ê lâng hó-táⁿ kóng: Góa ta̍k-ji̍t biān-tùi sí.

Góa tī Í-hut-só͘ kap “iá-siù” tò͘-cheng, nā sûn-chhùi sī chhut tī lâng ê tōng-ki, tùi góa ū sím-mi̍h lī-ek? Sí-lâng nā bô koh-oa̍h, ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng teh kóng, “Lán lâi chia̍h, lâi lim, bîn-á-chài to beh sí lah!”
M̄-thang hō͘ lâng phiàn--khì. “Kau-tio̍h pháiⁿ pêng-iú ōe phò-hoāi phín-tek!”
Tio̍h kak-chhíⁿ, siūⁿ hō͘ chheng-chhó, m̄-thang koh hoān-chōe, in-ūi ū chi̍t-kóa lâng iáu m̄ bat Siōng-tè, góa kóng chiah-ê sī beh hō͘ lín chai thang kiàn-siàu.
Kiám-chhái ū lâng beh mn̄g, “Sí-lâng án-chóaⁿ koh-oa̍h? In ōe ēng sím-mi̍h khoán ê thé lâi?”
Gōng-lâng! Lín iā-lo̍h tōe ê chéng-chí nā bô sí--khì, kiám ōe oa̍h--khí-lâi?
Lín só͘ iā--ê, bô-lūn sī be̍h-á á-sī pa̍t-khoán ngó͘-kok, put-kò sī chéng-chí, m̄-sī āu-lâi tōa-châng ê hêng-thé.
Siōng-tè chiàu I ê chí-ì hō͘ chéng-chí ū hêng-thé; ta̍k-khoán chéng-chí ū ka-kī ê hêng-thé.
Ta̍k-khoán tōng-bu̍t ê jio̍k-thé mā lóng bô kâng-khoán: Lâng ê jio̍k-thé chi̍t khoán, siù-lūi chi̍t khoán, chiáu-lūi chi̍t khoán, hî-lūi koh chi̍t khoán.
Ū thiⁿ-téng ê thé, ū tōe-chiūⁿ ê thé; thian-thé ê kng kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê thé ê kng bô kâng-khoán.
Ji̍t-thâu ū ji̍t-thâu ê kng, ge̍h ū ge̍h ê kng, chhiⁿ ū chhiⁿ ê kng; sīm-chì ta̍k-lia̍p chhiⁿ ê kng to lóng bô kâng-khoán.
Sí-lâng ê koh-oa̍h mā-sī án-ni. Tâi--lo̍h-khì--ê ōe hiú-nōa, koh-oa̍h--ê bōe hiú-nōa;
tâi--lo̍h-khì--ê sī pi-chiān--ê, koh-oa̍h--ê sī êng-iāu--ê; tâi--lo̍h-khì--ê sī loán-jio̍k--ê, koh-oa̍h--ê sī ióng-chòng--ê;
tâi--lo̍h-khì--ê sī hiat-jio̍k ê thé, koh-oa̍h--ê sī sio̍k-lêng ê thé. Kì-jiân ū hiat-jio̍k ê thé, chiū ū sio̍k-lêng ê thé.
Só͘-í Sèng-keng ū kì-chài, “Thâu chi̍t ê lâng A-tong siū-chō chòe ū oa̍h-miā ê lâng”, m̄-kú lō͘-bé ê A-tong sī sù oa̍h-miā ê Sîn.
Tāi-seng ū--ê m̄-sī sio̍k-lêng--ê, sī hiat-jio̍k--ê, āu-lâi chiah ū sio̍k-lêng--ê.
Thâu chi̍t ê lâng sī tùi tōe chhut, sī thô͘ chō--ê; tē-jī ê lâng sī tùi thiⁿ lâi--ê.
Só͘-ū ēng thô͘ chō ê lâng lóng kap hit-ê thâu chi̍t ê ēng thô͘ chō ê lâng kâng-khoán; só͘-ū sio̍k-thiⁿ ê lâng mā kap hit-ê lō͘-bé lâi sio̍k-thiⁿ ê lâng kâng-khoán.
Tú chhin-chhiūⁿ lán ū hit-ê thâu chi̍t ê ēng thô͘ chō ê lâng ê hêng-siōng, mā ōe ū hit-ê lō͘-bé lâi sio̍k-thiⁿ ê lâng ê hêng-siōng.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa kā lín kóng: Hiat-jio̍k ê thé bōe-tàng sêng-siū Siōng-tè-kok; ōe hiú-nōa--ê mā bōe-tàng sêng-siū bōe hiú-nōa--ê.

Góa beh kā lín kóng chi̍t hāng ò-pì: Lán bōe lóng sí, put-kò tī chi̍t-sùn-kan, chi̍t-ba̍k-nih-kú, chòe-āu ê lat-pah chi̍t-ē tân, lán lóng ōe kái-piàn; lat-pah tân, sí-lâng ōe koh-oa̍h, pìⁿ-chòe bōe hiú-nōa--ê, lán mā lóng ōe kái-piàn.
In-ūi chit-ê ōe hiú-nōa--ê it-tēng tio̍h pìⁿ-chòe bōe hiú-nōa--ê, ōe-sí--ê pìⁿ-chòe bōe-sí--ê.
Tng ōe hiú-nōa--ê pìⁿ-chòe bōe hiú-nōa--ê, ōe-sí--ê pìⁿ-chòe bōe-sí--ê hit-sî, Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài ê ōe chiū ōe èng-giām: Sí hō͘ sèng-lī thun--lo̍h-khì lah!
Sí ah, lí ê sèng-lī tī tó-ūi? Sí ah, lí ê to̍k-chhì tī tó-ūi?
Sí ê to̍k-chhì sī chōe, chōe ê ui-le̍k sī tùi Lu̍t-hoat lâi--ê.
Kám-siā Siōng-tè, I thong-kè lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok hō͘ lán tit-tio̍h sèng-lī.

Só͘-í, chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, tio̍h khiā-chāi, m̄-thang tōng-iâu. Tio̍h siông-siông chīn-la̍t ūi Chú chòe kang, in-ūi lín chai ūi Chú tio̍h-bôa chòe kang it-tēng bōe lo̍k-khong.
Koan-hē koan-hiàn pang-chān sìn-tô͘ ê tāi-chì, lín mā tio̍h chiàu góa kā Ka-lia̍p-thài ê chèng kàu-hōe só͘ chí-sī ê khì chòe.
Múi lé-pài ê thâu chi̍t ji̍t, ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h chiàu ka-kī ê siu-ji̍p the̍h chi̍t-kóa khí-lâi khǹg, chiah bián góa khì lín hia ê sî chiah khai-sí bō͘-koan.
Góa kàu-ūi ê sî, ōe chiong kài-siāu ê phoe kap lín ê koan-hiàn kau hō͘ lín ōe sìn-jīm--tit ê lâng, phài in tòa-khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng.
Nā-sī góa mā tio̍h khì khah hó, in ōe kap góa chòe-hé khì.
Góa siūⁿ-beh keng-kè Má-kî-tùn, àn-sǹg keng-kè Má-kî-tùn liáu-āu beh khì lín hia,
tāi-khài ōe tòa lín hia kap lín chòe-hé kè tang-thiⁿ. Án-ni, bô-lūn beh koh khì tó-ūi, lín thang sàng góa chhut-hoat.
Góa bô ài tī kè-lō͘ ê sî chiah sūn-sòa khì khòaⁿ lín; Chú nā ún-chún, góa ǹg-bāng kap lín tòa chi̍t-chām-á.
Góa ōe tī Í-hut-só͘ tòa kàu Gō͘-sûn-choeh.
Tī chia sui-jiân ū chin chōe hoán-tùi ê lâng, m̄-kú mn̂g ūi góa tōa khui, thang chòe ū hāu-kó ê kang-chok.
Thê-mô͘-thài kàu-ūi ê sî, lín tio̍h kā i chiap-thāi, hō͘ i ōe-tàng an-sim, in-ūi i kap góa kâng-khoán teh chòe Chú ê kang.
Lín lóng m̄-thang khòaⁿ i bô khí. Tio̍h sàng i pêng-an lī-khui, hō͘ i thang tńg-lâi góa chia, in-ūi góa teh thèng-hāu i kap hiah-ê hiaⁿ-tī chòe-hé lâi.

Koan-hē lán ê hiaⁿ-tī A-pho-lô, góa ū ke̍k-le̍k khǹg i kap kî-tha ê hiaⁿ-tī khì hóng-būn lín; put-kò i ba̍k-chêng lóng bô àn-sǹg beh khì, nā ū tú-hó ê ki-hōe i chiū ōe khì.
Lín tio̍h kéng-séng, sìn-sim khiā-chāi, tio̍h ióng-kám, tio̍h kian-kiông.
Lín só͘ chòe it-chhè ê tāi-chì tio̍h ēng thiàⁿ-sim khì chòe.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín bat Sū-thê-hoat-ná chi̍t ke ê lâng; in sī A-kai-a -séng thâu chi̍t ke kui-sìn Ki-tok ê lâng, jia̍t-sim ho̍k-bū sìn-tô͘.
Góa khǹg lín tio̍h sūn-thàn chit-khoán lâng, í-ki̍p só͘-ū kap in chòe-hé tio̍h-bôa kang-chok ê lâng.
Sū-thê-hoat-ná, Hok-tô͘-ná-to͘, kap A-kai-kó͘ lâi góa chia, góa chin hoaⁿ-hí. Lín bô tī chia, in thòe lín lâi pang-chān góa.
In hō͘ góa kap lín pîⁿ-pîⁿ tit-tio̍h kek-lē. Só͘-í lín tio̍h kèng-tiōng chit-khoán lâng.
A-sè-a -séng ê chèng kàu-hōe lóng beh kā lín chhéng-an. A-ku-la kap Pek-ki-la, í-ki̍p tī in tau teh chū-hōe ê kàu-hōe, tī Chú ê lāi-bīn beh jia̍t-chhiat kā lín chhéng-an.
Só͘-ū ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē lóng beh kā lín chhéng-an. Lín tio̍h chhin-chhiat hō͘-siōng chhéng-an.
Góa Pó-lô chhin-pit kā lín chhéng-an.
Nā ū lâng bô thiàⁿ Chú, tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘. Chú ah, chhiáⁿ lâi!
Goān Chú Iâ-so͘ ê un-tián kap lín tông-chāi!
Goān góa ê thiàⁿ kap lín só͘-ū sio̍k Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê lâng tông-chāi!

Góa sī Pó-lô, hōng Siōng-tè ê chí-ì choh Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê sù-tô͘. Góa kap hiaⁿ-tī Thê-mô͘-thài siá-phoe hō͘ tī Ko-lîm-to Siōng-tè ê kàu-hōe kap choân A-kai-a -séng só͘-ū sìn-tô͘.
Goān lán ê Pē Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sù lín un-tián kap pêng-an!
Tio̍h chheng-chàn lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê Pē Siōng-tè! I sī chû-pi ê Pē, sù ta̍k-hāng an-ùi ê Siōng-tè.
Tī lán it-chhè ê hoān-lān tiong, I an-ùi lán, hō͘ lán ōe-tàng ēng Siōng-tè sù lán ê an-ùi khì an-ùi hiah-ê tú-tio̍h ta̍k-khoán hoān-lān ê lâng.
In-ūi Ki-tok ūi-tio̍h lán siū chin chōe khó͘-lān, lán mā thong-kè Ki-tok siū hiah-ni̍h chōe ê an-ùi.

Goán nā tú-tio̍h hoān-lān, sī beh hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h an-ùi kap chín-kiù; goán nā tit-tio̍h an-ùi, mā-sī beh hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h an-ùi, ū khùi-la̍t thang jím-siū kap goán só͘ jím-siū siâng-khoán ê khó͘-lān.
Goán tùi lín ê ǹg-bāng bōe iô-tāng; in-ūi goán chai, lín kap goán tâng siū-khó͘, lín mā ōe kap goán tâng siū an-ùi.
