Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, goán ài lín chai goán tī A-sè-a -séng só͘ tú--tio̍h ê hoān-lān. Goán só͘ taⁿ ê tāng-tàⁿ hui-siông tāng, tāng kah taⁿ bōe khí, tì-kàu kiông-beh oa̍h bōe lo̍h--khì.
Goán ka-kī kám-kak ū siū phòaⁿ sí-hêng; án-ni sī beh hō͘ goán bô koh óa-khò ka-kī, chí-ū óa-khò hō͘ sí-lâng koh-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè.
I ū kiù goán thoat-lī sí ê gûi-hiám, mā ōe kè-sio̍k kiù goán. Goán ǹg-bāng I chiong-lâi ōe koh kiù goán.
Lín mā tio̍h ēng kî-tó pang-chān goán, án-ni chiū ū chin chōe lâng ōe in-ūi goán tùi lín chin chōe ê kî-tó tit-tio̍h chiok-hok lâi kám-siā Siōng-tè.

Goán só͘ khoa-kháu--ê sī án-ni: Goán ê liông-sim chèng-bêng, goán tī chit sè-kan ê seng-oa̍h lóng sī chiàu Siōng-tè só͘ sù ê sûn-kiat kap sêng-si̍t, m̄-sī khò sio̍k-sè ê tì-hūi, sī khò Siōng-tè ê un-tián; goán tùi-thāi lín koh-khah sī án-ni.

Goán siá hō͘ lín--ê lóng sī lín ōe-hiáu tha̍k ōe-tàng liáu-kái--ê. Lín kàu taⁿ só͘ lí-kái--ê chí-ū chi̍t-pō͘-hūn, góa ǹg-bāng lín kàu lō͘-bé ōe oân-choân liáu-kái. Án-ni, tī lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ ê Ji̍t, lín ōe chòe goán ê khoa-kháu, goán mā chòe lín ê khoa-kháu.
In-ūi ū chit-ê khak-sìn, góa chiah kè-ōe seng khì hóng-būn lín, thang hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h ka-pē ê chiok-hok;
chiū-sī kè-ōe khì Má-kî-tùn ê lō͘-tiong seng khì hóng-būn lín, koh tùi Má-kî-tùn tò--lâi keng-kè lín hia ê sî, hō͘ lín thang sàng góa chhut-hoat khì Iû-thài.
Chit-ê kè-ōe kiám sī chhìn-chhái chòe--ê? Góa chòe chit-khoán kè-ōe kiám chhut tī chū-su ê tōng-ki, liâm-piⁿ kóng “sī” liâm-piⁿ kóng “m̄-sī”?
Siōng-tè sī sìn-si̍t, góa tùi lín tah-èng ê ōe chiū m̄-sī liâm-piⁿ “sī” liâm-piⁿ “m̄-sī”.

In-ūi Se-la, Thê-mô͘-thài, kap góa thoân hō͘ lín hit-ūi Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok, pèng m̄-sī liâm-piⁿ “sī” liâm-piⁿ “m̄-sī” ê. Chāi-tī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok chí-ū “sī” nā-tiāⁿ.
Siōng-tè it-chhè ê èng-ún tī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok lóng chiâⁿ-chòe “sī”, só͘-í lán chiah thong-kè I kóng “Amen” lâi kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè.
Hō͘ goán kap lín lâi kap Ki-tok kiat-liân, koh soán-phài goán--ê sī Siōng-tè.
I kā goán khàm-ìn, koh sù Sèng Sîn tī goán sim-lāi chòe pó-chèng.
Góa ēng ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā khún-kiû Siōng-tè kā góa choh-chèng. Góa sī thé-thiap lín chiah bô khì Ko-lîm-to.
Goán m̄-sī teh kiông-chè lín tio̍h sìn sím-mi̍h, hoán-tńg sī teh chòe lín ê tâng-kang, hō͘ lín thang hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi lín ê sìn-sim ū khiā-chāi.
Só͘-í, góa koat-tēng bô beh khì lín hia, chiah bián koh-chài hō͘ lín sim kan-khó͘.
Góa nā ū hō͘ lín sim kan-khó͘, lín chiah-ê kan-khó͘-sim ê lâng í-gōa iáu ū sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-tàng hō͘ góa khoài-lo̍k?

Ūi-tio̍h beh pī-bián góa khì lín hia ê sî, hiah-ê eng-kai hō͘ góa hoaⁿ-hí ê lâng hoán-tńg hō͘ góa kan-khó͘-sim, góa chiah siá í-chêng hit-tiuⁿ phoe hō͘ lín. Góa khak-sìn, góa ê hoaⁿ-hí chiū-sī lín tāi-ke ê hoaⁿ-hí.
Góa hui-siông ut-chut koh thòng-sim, lâu chin chōe ba̍k-sái siá hit-tiuⁿ phoe, m̄-sī beh hō͘ lín sim kan-khó͘, sī beh hō͘ lín chai góa jōa-á-ni̍h thiàⁿ lín.
Nā ū lâng hō͘ lâng kan-khó͘-sim, m̄-sī hō͘ góa kan-khó͘-sim — góa khah bô ài kóng kah kè-thâu giâm-tiōng — kàu bó͘ chi̍t ê thêng-tō͘ sī hō͘ lín tāi-ke lóng kan-khó͘-sim.
Hit-khoán lâng siū lín tāi-to-sò͘ ê lâng khiàn-chek í-keng kàu-gia̍h.
Lín tian-tò tio̍h kā i sià-bián, kā i kó͘-lē, chiah bián hō͘ i kè-thâu kan-khó͘-sim soah choa̍t-bāng.
Só͘-í, góa khó͘-khǹg lín, tio̍h hō͘ i chai-iáⁿ lín khak-si̍t ū thiàⁿ i.
Góa chêng siá hit-tiuⁿ phoe sī ài-beh chai lín jōa gâu jím-siū khó-giām, sī m̄-sī hoān-sū goān-ì sūn-ho̍k.
Lín sià-bián sím-mi̍h-lâng, góa mā sià-bián i. Góa nā ū sià-bián sím-mi̍h-lâng, sī tī Ki-tok ê bīn-chêng ūi-tio̍h lín ê iân-kò͘ sià-bián i.
Án-ni chiah bián hō͘ Sat-tàn kā lán phiⁿ--khì, in-ūi lán chin chheng-chhó Sat-tàn ê khúi-kè.
Góa khì Te̍k-lô-a thoân Ki-tok ê Hok-im ê sî, Chú í-keng kā góa khui kang-chok ê mn̂g;
put-kò bô tú-tio̍h góa ê hiaⁿ-tī Thê-to, góa bōe an-sim, chiū kap hia ê lâng saⁿ-sî khì Má-kî-tùn.

Kám-siā Siōng-tè! In-ūi kap Ki-tok kiat-liân, goán sî-siông hō͘ Siōng-tè chhōa-khì chham-ka Ki-tok khái-soân ê hâng-lia̍t. Siōng-tè koh ēng goán khì ta̍k só͘-chāi sàn-pò͘ jīn-bat Ki-tok chiah ū ê phang-bī.
Bô-lūn tī tit-kiù á-sī tîm-lûn ê lâng tiong-kan, goán chiâⁿ-chòe Ki-tok ê phang-bī hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè;
tùi teh-beh tîm-lûn ê lâng sī sí ê chhàu-bī, tùi teh-beh tit-kiù ê lâng sī oa̍h ê phang-bī. Sím-mi̍h-lâng ōe-kham-tit chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì?

Goán bô chhin-chhiūⁿ chin chōe lâng chiong Siōng-tè ê ōe chòe sio̍k-hè phah-bōe, tian-tò sī chòe chi̍t ê sûn-chin ê lâng, siū Siōng-tè chhe-phài, tī I ê bīn-chêng khò Ki-tok soan-káng.
Goán kiám koh teh chhui-chiàn ka-kī? Goán kiám tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t-kóa lâng siá chhui-chiàn-su hō͘ lín, á-sī su-iàu lín ê chhui-chiàn-su?
Lín pún-sin chiū-sī goán ê chhui-chiàn-su, siá tī goán ê sim-lāi, beh hō͘ chèng-lâng chai, chèng-lâng tha̍k.

Chin bêng-hián, lín sī Ki-tok só͘ siá thong-kè goán lâi sàng ê phoe. Chit-tiuⁿ phoe m̄-sī ēng ba̍k-chúi siá tī chio̍h-pán, sī ēng éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê Sîn siá tī lâng ê sim-pán.
Goán thong-kè Ki-tok tùi Siōng-tè ū chit-khoán ê khak-sìn chiah án-ni kóng.
Che m̄-sī kóng goán ka-kī ū châi-tiāu thang chòe chit-ê tāi-chì, goán ê châi-tiāu sī tùi Siōng-tè lâi--ê.
I sù goán ū châi-tiāu thang chòe sin ê iok ê chhe-ēng; m̄-sī ēng bûn-jī siá--ê, sī Sèng Sîn ê iok. Bûn-jī hō͘ lâng sí, m̄-kú Sèng Sîn hō͘ lâng oa̍h.

Ēng bûn-jī khek tī chio̍h-pán ê Lu̍t-hoat pan-pò͘ ê sî, Siōng-tè ê êng-kng ū hián-hiān. Tùi Mô͘-se ê bīn hoán-chiò--chhut-lâi ê kng sui-jiân chiām-chiām teh siau-sit, m̄-kú hit-ê kng iáu chin kiông, tì-kàu Í-sek-lia̍t kiáⁿ-sun bōe-tàng ba̍k-chiu kim-kim kā i khòaⁿ. Hō͘ lâng tì-kàu sí ê sū-kang to ū chit-khoán ê êng-kng,
án-ni Sèng Sîn ê sū-kang só͘ hoat-chhut ê êng-kng kiám bōe koh-khah tōa?
Hit-ê kā lâng tēng-chōe ê sū-kang nā ōe hoat-chhut chit-khoán ê êng-kng, chit-ê kā lâng soan-pò͘ bô chōe ê sū-kang só͘ hián-chhut ê êng-kng kiám bōe koh-khah tōa!
Án-ni, in-ūi hiān-chāi ê êng-kng pí í-chêng--ê koh-khah tōa, í-chêng ê êng-kng soah bô--khì.
Hit-ê ōe siau-sit--ê nā ōe hoat-chhut êng-kng, chit-ê éng-chûn--ê it-tēng ōe hián-chhut koh-khah tōa ê êng-kng.
In-ūi goán ū chit-khoán ê ǹg-bāng chiah chiah-ni̍h ióng-kám.

Goán bô chhin-chhiūⁿ Mô͘-se tio̍h ēng phè tà ka-kī ê bīn. Mô͘-se án-ni chòe, chiah bián hō͘ Í-sek-lia̍t kiáⁿ-sun khòaⁿ-tio̍h i bīn ê êng-kng chiām-chiām siau-sit, kàu bé lóng bô--khì.
M̄-kú in ê sim tūn, it-ti̍t kàu kin-á-ji̍t in tha̍k kū ê iok ê sî, in ê sim iáu hō͘ hit-tè phè tà--teh. In-ūi chí-ū kap Ki-tok kiat-liân, hit-tè phè chiah the̍h--khí-lâi.
Sīm-chì kàu kin-á-ji̍t, in ta̍k-pái tha̍k Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat, hit-tè phè iáu tà tī in ê sim.
M̄-kú, tng in kui-ǹg Chú ê sî, phè chiū the̍h--khí-lâi.
Chit-ūi Chú chiū-sī Sèng Sîn; ū Chú ê Sîn ê só͘-chāi chiū ū chū-iû.

Lán tāi-ke lóng ēng bô tà-phè ê bīn teh hoán-chiò Chú ê êng-kng; chit-ê êng-kng sī tùi Chú, chiū-sī tùi Sèng Sîn hoat--chhut-lâi ê êng-kng, teh kā lán kái-chō chiâⁿ-chòe I ê hêng-siōng, hō͘ lán ū koh-khah tōa ê êng-kng.
Kì-jiân Siōng-tè ū lîn-bín goán, chiong chit-ê chit-bū kau-thok goán, goán bô sit-chì.

Goán pàng-sak it-chhè bô ài lâng chai ê kiàn-siàu-tāi, bô chòe khi-phiàn lâng ê tāi-chì, bô oai-khiok Siōng-tè ê ōe, chí-ū tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng kong-khai hián-bêng chin-lí, lâi kiò-chhíⁿ chèng-lâng ê liông-sim.
Goán só͘ thoân ê hok-im nā ū jia-khàm hō͘ lâng bô chheng-chhó, chí-ū tùi hiah-ê teh-beh tîm-lûn ê lâng jia-khàm nā-tiāⁿ.

In m̄ sìn sī in-ūi chit sè-kan ê sîn-bêng hō͘ in ê sim-ba̍k sit-bêng, bōe-tàng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ hok-im ê kng, chit-ê hok-im teh kiàn-chèng êng-kng ê Ki-tok; Ki-tok sī Siōng-tè ê hêng-siōng.
Goán m̄-sī thoân ka-kī, sī thoân Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sī Chú; goán ka-kī in-ūi Iâ-so͘ ê iân-kò͘ chòe lín ê po̍k-jîn.
Hit-ūi bēng-lēng kng tùi o͘-àm chiò--chhut-lâi ê Siōng-tè, chiū-sī ēng kng chiò lán lāi-sim ê Siōng-tè, hō͘ lán jīn-bat I chiò tī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê bīn hit-ê êng-kng.
Put-kò, goán sī thô͘ chō ê khì-khū, lāi-bīn ū pó-pòe, beh piáu-sī hit-ê chì-tōa ê lêng-le̍k sī sio̍k tī Siōng-tè, m̄-sī tùi goán chhut--lâi.
Goán siông-siông tú-tio̍h ta̍k-khoán khùn-lân, m̄-kú bô khut-ho̍k; tú-tio̍h choa̍t-kéng, m̄-kú bô choa̍t-bāng;
siū-tio̍h khún-pek, m̄-kú bô siū pàng-sak; siū phah-tó, m̄-kú bô tì-kàu sí.
Goán put-sî tòa Iâ-so͘ ê sí tī goán ōe-sí ê seng-khu, hō͘ Iâ-so͘ ê oa̍h-miā mā thang tī goán ê sin-chiūⁿ hián-bêng.
Goán oa̍h tī sè-kan, ūi-tio̍h Iâ-so͘ ê iân-kò͘ sî-siông tú-tio̍h sí ê gûi-hiám, thang hō͘ I ê oa̍h-miā tī goán chit-ê ōe-sí ê seng-khu hián-bêng--chhut-lâi.
Án-ni, sí tī goán ê lāi-bīn teh hoat-seng chok-iōng, m̄-kú oa̍h-miā tī lín ê lāi-bīn teh hoat-seng chok-iōng.
Sèng-keng kóng “Góa ū sìn, só͘-í góa chiah kóng”, kun-kù chit-khoán sìn-gióng ê cheng-sîn, goán mā sìn, só͘-í goán chiah kóng.
Goán chai, hō͘ Chú Iâ-so͘ koh-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè mā ōe hō͘ goán kap Iâ-so͘ tâng koh-oa̍h, koh chhōa goán kap lín chòe-hé kàu I ê bīn-chêng.
Chiah-ê it-chhè lóng sī ūi-tio̍h lín, sī beh hō͘ koh-khah chōe ê lâng tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê un-tián, thang hiàn koh-khah chōe ê kám-siā lâi êng-iāu Siōng-tè.
In-ūi án-ni, goán bô sit-chì. Sui-jiân goán gōa-chāi ê lâng chiām-chiām teh soe-pāi, goán lōe-chāi ê lâng khiok ji̍t-ji̍t teh ōaⁿ-sin.
Goán só͘ siū chit-ê chiām-sî koh sió-khóa ê kan-khó͘ sī beh hō͘ goán tit-tio̍h bōe thang pí, koh-khah tōa, éng-oán ê êng-kng.
Goán só͘ tiōng-sī--ê m̄-sī khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h--ê, sī khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h--ê; in-ūi khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h--ê sī chiām-sî, khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h--ê sī éng-oán.

In-ūi goán chai, lán tī tōe-chiūⁿ teh tòa chit-ê pò͘-pîⁿ ê chhù nā thiah--khí-lâi, Siōng-tè ōe hō͘ lán thiⁿ-téng ê chhù, m̄-sī lâng ê chhiú khí--ê, sī éng-oán ê chhù.
Lán hiān-chāi tī chit-ê pò͘-pîⁿ teh thó͘-khùi, jia̍t-chhiat ǹg-bāng thang khì tiàm thiⁿ-téng ê chhù, chhin-chhiūⁿ saⁿ tha̍h--lo̍h-khì,
nā tha̍h--lo̍h-khì chiū bōe chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé.

Lán iáu tiàm tī chit-ê pò͘-pîⁿ pē tāng-tàⁿ teh thó͘-khùi; lán m̄-sī ài thǹg-khì tōe-chiūⁿ ê thé, sī beh tha̍h sio̍k-thiⁿ ê thé, thang hō͘ oa̍h-miā kā ōe-sí--ê thun--lo̍h-khì.
Hō͘ lán ū chit-ê kái-piàn--ê sī Siōng-tè, I sù Sèng Sîn hō͘ lán, kā lán pó-chèng.
Só͘-í, goán put-sî ū ióng-khì. Goán chai, lán iáu tòa tī chit-ê seng-khu teh oa̍h ê sî, sī kap Chú saⁿ-lī.
In-ūi lán teh oa̍h, m̄-sī khò ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ, sī khò sìn-sim.
Goán ū ióng-khì, khah ài lī-khui chit-ê seng-khu khì kap Chú tòa.
Só͘-í, bô-lūn tī chit-ê seng-khu á-sī lī-khui chit-ê seng-khu, goán ê bo̍k-te̍k sī ài hō͘ Chú hoaⁿ-hí.

In-ūi lán lóng it-tēng tio̍h khiā tī Ki-tok ê bīn-chêng siū I sím-phòaⁿ. Ta̍k-ê lâng lóng tio̍h chiàu ka-kī tī tōe-chiūⁿ ê seng-khu só͘ chòe--ê, bô-lūn sī hó á-sī pháiⁿ, chiap-siū pò-èng.

Kì-jiân goán chai-iáⁿ tio̍h kèng-ùi Chú, goán chiū khó͘-khǹg lâng. Tùi Siōng-tè lâi khòaⁿ, goán sī sím-mi̍h khoán lâng chin chheng-chhó; góa ǹg-bāng tùi lín ê liông-sim lâi khòaⁿ mā chin chheng-chhó.
Goán m̄-sī beh koh tùi lín chhui-chiàn ka-kī, sī hō͘ lín ū ki-hōe ēng goán chòe khoa-kháu, hō͘ lín thang hôe-èng hiah-ê chù-tiōng gōa-piáu bô chù-tiōng lāi-sim ê lâng.
Goán nā jia̍t-kông, sī ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè; goán nā chheng-chhíⁿ, sī ūi-tio̍h lín.
In-ūi Ki-tok ê thiàⁿ chhui-pek goán chòe chit-ê kiat-lūn: Chi̍t lâng ūi-tio̍h chèng-lâng sí, chèng-lâng chiū lóng sí.
I ūi-tio̍h chèng-lâng sí, sī beh hō͘ hiah-ê oa̍h--teh ê lâng bô koh ūi-tio̍h ka-kī oa̍h, sī ūi-tio̍h hit-ūi thòe in sí koh-oa̍h ê Ki-tok lâi oa̍h.
Só͘-í, tùi taⁿ í-āu goán bô koh kun-kù lâng ê phiau-chún bat lâng. Sui-jiân goán bat ēng lâng ê phiau-chún bat Ki-tok, m̄-kú hiān-chāi bô koh án-ni bat I.
Án-ni, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng, nā kap Ki-tok kiat-liân chiū-sī sin chhòng-chō ê lâng; kū--ê í-keng kè--khì, taⁿ lóng pìⁿ-chòe sin--ê.
Chiah-ê it-chhè lóng sī Siōng-tè ê chok-ûi; I thong-kè Ki-tok hō͘ lán kap I koh hô-hó, koh chiong hō͘ lâng kap I hô-hó ê chit-bū kau-tài goán.
Goán só͘ thoân ê sìn-sit sī án-ni: Siōng-tè thong-kè Ki-tok hō͘ sè-kan-lâng kap I hô-hó, bô koh tui-kiù in ê chōe-kò, koh chiong chit-ê hô-hó ê sìn-sit kau-thok goán.
Só͘-í, goán choh Ki-tok ê tāi-sài, Siōng-tè thong-kè goán kā lín khó͘-khǹg. Goán thòe Ki-tok kā lín kiû, tio̍h kap Siōng-tè hô-hó.
Siōng-tè hō͘ bô-chōe ê Ki-tok ūi-tio̍h lán ê iân-kò͘ chiâⁿ-chòe ū-chōe, hō͘ lán thang khò Ki-tok kap Siōng-tè kiàn-li̍p ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē.
Goán choh Siōng-tè ê tâng-kang--ê koh kā lín khó͘-khǹg, lín tùi Siōng-tè niá-siū ê un-tián m̄-thang hō͘ i lo̍k-khong.

In-ūi Siōng-tè kóng: Tī thang siū chiap-la̍p ê sî, góa ū thiaⁿ lí; tī chín-kiù ê ji̍t, góa ū pang-chān lí. Tio̍h thiaⁿ! Chit-chūn sī siū chiap-la̍p ê sî; kin-á-ji̍t sī chín-kiù ê ji̍t!
Ūi-tio̍h goán sū-hōng ê kang-chok bián siū chí-chek, chó͘-gāi pa̍t-lâng ê tāi-chì goán lóng bô chòe,
hoán-tńg ēng siōng-tōa ê nāi-sim, hoān-sū thong-kè hoān-lān, kan-lân, kap khùn-khó͘, piáu-sī goán sī Siōng-tè ê chhe-ēng.
Goán bat siū-tio̍h piⁿ-phah, koaiⁿ-kaⁿ, pō-le̍k ê siong-hāi, lô-khó͘, bô-khùn, bô-chia̍h.
Goán ēng sûn-kiat, tì-sek, khoan-iông, jîn-chû, óa-khò Sèng Sîn, ēng sûn-chin ê thiàⁿ,
thoân chin-lí ê sìn-sit kap Siōng-tè ê tōa lêng-le̍k, ēng kong-gī chòe bú-khì kong-kek tùi-te̍k, pó-hō͘ ka-kī.
Goán siū chun-tiōng, mā siū bú-jio̍k; tit-tio̍h pháiⁿ miâ-siaⁿ, mā tit-tio̍h hó miâ-siaⁿ. Goán hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe pián-sian-á, kî-si̍t goán kóng si̍t-ōe;
ná-chún bô lâng bat, kî-si̍t lâng-lâng lóng bat; ná-chún sí--khì, kî-si̍t iáu-teh oa̍h. Goán sui-jiân siū hêng-hoa̍t, m̄-kú bô hō͘ lâng thâi-sí;
sui-jiân iu-siong, m̄-kú put-sî hoaⁿ-hí; sui-jiân sàn-chhiah, m̄-kú hō͘ chin chōe lâng hó-gia̍h; chhin-chhiūⁿ bô-pòaⁿ-hāng, m̄-kú ta̍k-hāng lóng ū.
Ko-lîm-to ê pêng-iú, goán ê sim-heng í-keng phah-khui, khui-chhùi kā lín kóng lah.
M̄-sī goán tùi lín bô tō͘-liōng, sī lín tùi goán tō͘-tn̂g oe̍h.
Góa khòaⁿ lín chòe ka-kī ê kiáⁿ kā lín kóng: Kap goán siâng-khoán, lín ê sim-heng mā tio̍h phah khah khui leh.
M̄-thang kap bī-sìn ê lâng khan-liân kau-chhap; kong-gī kap put-hoat ū sím-mi̍h koan-liân? Kng-bêng kap o͘-àm ná ōe-tàng kau-óng?
Ki-tok kap Mô͘-kúi ná ōe-tàng hô-ha̍p? Sìn kap bô-sìn ê lâng ū sím-mi̍h koan-hē?

Siōng-tè ê tiān kap ngó͘-siōng ná ōe-tàng pâi chòe-hé? In-ūi lán sī éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê tiān! Chiàu Siōng-tè só͘ kóng: Góa beh kap góa ê chú-bîn chòe-hé khiā-khí, tī in tiong-kan óng-lâi. Góa beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè, in beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn.
Só͘-í Chú kóng: Lín tio̍h tùi in tiong-kan chhut--khì, kap in hun-lī. Bô chheng-khì--ê m̄-thang chiap-chhiok, án-ni góa chiū chiap-la̍p lín.
Góa beh chòe lín ê Pē, lín beh chòe góa ê kiáⁿ, cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ. Choân-lêng ê Chú ū án-ni kóng.

Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, kì-jiân lán tit-tio̍h chiah-ê èng-ún, lán tio̍h kiat-chēng ka-kī, tû-khì it-chhè hō͘ seng-khu kap sim-lêng phah lâ-sâm ê sū, kèng-ùi Siōng-tè hō͘ seng-oa̍h oân-choân sèng-hòa.
Lín tio̍h ēng khoan-tāi ê sim tùi-thāi goán. Goán m̄-bat khek-khui lâng, m̄-bat hāi lâng tūi-lo̍h, m̄-bat phiⁿ--lâng.
Góa án-ni kóng, m̄-sī beh kā lín khiàn-chek. Góa í-chêng bat kóng, goán chin thiàⁿ lín, goān-ì kap lín tâng-sí tâng-oa̍h.
Góa chin sìn-jīm lín, ēng lín chòe khoa-kháu. Góa chhiong-móa an-ùi; tī goán it-chhè ê hoān-lān tiong, góa ū móa-móa ê hoaⁿ-hí.
Goán kàu Má-kî-tùn í-āu, seng-khu bô thang hioh-khùn, hoán-tńg ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì lóng tú-tio̍h khùn-lân, gōa-bīn ū hun-cheng, lāi-bīn ū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
M̄-kú, an-ùi sit-chì ê lâng ê Siōng-tè ū chhe Thê-to lâi, hō͘ goán tit-tio̍h an-ùi;

m̄-nā in-ūi i ū lâi, koh in-ūi i ū kóng-khí lín án-chóaⁿ kā i kó͘-lē ê tāi-chì. I ū kā goán kóng-khí lín ài kìⁿ góa, lín ê sim kan-khó͘, kap lín tùi góa ê jia̍t-chêng, hō͘ góa koh-khah hoaⁿ-hí.
Góa chêng hit-tiuⁿ phoe hō͘ lín sim kan-khó͘, góa bô hō͘-hóe. Sui-jiân chai-iáⁿ hit-tiuⁿ phoe ū hō͘ lín chi̍t-sî sim kan-khó͘, góa bat hō͘-hóe,

chóng-sī hiān-chāi góa chin hoaⁿ-hí, m̄-sī in-ūi lín sim kan-khó͘, sī in-ūi lín ê kan-khó͘-sim ū tì-kàu lín hóe-kái. Siōng-tè ū siān-iōng lín ê kan-khó͘-sim, só͘-í goán só͘ chòe--ê tùi lín bô siong-hāi.

In-ūi Siōng-tè siān-iōng lín ê kan-khó͘-sim lâi hō͘ lín hóe-kái thang tit-tio̍h kiù, goán chiū bô sím-mi̍h thang hō͘-hóe; m̄-kú sio̍k-sè ê kan-khó͘-sim ōe hō͘ lâng tì-kàu sí.

Lín khòaⁿ, Siōng-tè hiah-ni̍h gâu siān-iōng lín ê kan-khó͘-sim, chiah hō͘ lín hiah-ni̍h pek-chhiat piān-bêng ka-kī ê chheng-pe̍k, hiah-ni̍h hùn-khài, hiah-ni̍h ū kéng-kài-sim, hiah-ni̍h ū kî-thāi, hiah-ni̍h jia̍t-chêng, hiah-ni̍h ke̍k-lia̍t khiàn-chek put-hoat; tī ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì, lín í-keng ū chèng-bêng ka-kī ê chheng-pe̍k.

Só͘-í, sui-jiân góa ū siá hit-tiuⁿ phoe, m̄-kú m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h hit-ê kā lâng khek-khui, á-sī hit-ê siū lâng khek-khui ê lâng, sī beh tùi lín piáu-bêng lín tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng tùi goán ê jia̍t-chêng ū jōa chhim.
In-ūi án-ni, goán ū tit-tio̍h an-ùi. Goán m̄-nā tit-tio̍h an-ùi, mā in-ūi khòaⁿ-tio̍h Thê-to ê hoaⁿ-hí koh-khah hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi i ê sim ū tùi lín tāi-ke tit-tio̍h kek-lē.
Góa bat tùi i po-chióng lín, lín bô hō͘ góa làu-khùi. Góa ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì lóng tùi lín kóng si̍t-chāi-ōe, góa tùi Thê-to po-chióng lín ê ōe mā-sī si̍t-chāi.
Só͘-í, i siūⁿ-khí lín tāi-ke án-chóaⁿ sūn-ho̍k i, kiong-kiong-kèng-kèng kā i chiap-thāi, i tùi lín ê thiàⁿ-sim chiū ná chhim.
Góa hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi góa ōe-tàng oân-choân sìn-jīm lín.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa ài lín chai Siōng-tè sù hō͘ Má-kî-tùn chèng kàu-hōe ê un-hūi.
In ū tùi hoān-lān keng-le̍k chin chōe khó-giām, iáu-kú chhiong-móa hoaⁿ-hí; sui-jiân hui-siông sàn-chhiah, iáu-kú hui-siông khóng-khài koan-hiàn.
Góa ōe-tàng kā lín chèng-bêng, in í-keng chīn in só͘-ōe hōng-hiàn, sīm-chì chhiau-kè in ê khùi-la̍t.
In jia̍t-chhiat kiû goán hō͘ in ū chham-ka kiù-chè Iû-thài sìn-tô͘ sū-hōng ê kong-êng.
In án-ni chòe m̄-nā chhiau-kè goán ê kî-thāi, sīm-chì chun-thàn Siōng-tè ê chí-ì tāi-seng chiong ka-kī hiàn hō͘ Chú, jiân-āu kau-thok goán.
Só͘-í goán khǹg Thê-to kè-sio̍k hia̍p-chō͘ lín, lâi oân-sêng i só͘ khai-sí chit-hāng chû-siān ê kang-chok.

Lín ê sìn-sim, kháu-châi, tì-sek, pang-chān lâng ê jia̍t-sêng, í-ki̍p tùi goán ê thiàⁿ-sim lóng hiah-ni̍h hong-hù, goán ài lín tùi chit-hāng chû-siān ê kang-chok mā tio̍h hiah-ni̍h khóng-khài.
Góa án-ni kóng m̄-sī teh bēng-lēng, sī ài lín chai pa̍t-lâng jia̍t-sim teh pang-chān lâng, lâi khó-giām lín ê thiàⁿ-sim sī m̄-sī chin--ê.
Lín chai lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê un-tián: I sui-jiân hù-chiok, m̄-kú ūi-tio̍h lín chiâⁿ-chòe sàn-chhiah, sī beh hō͘ lín in-ūi I ê sàn-chhiah chiâⁿ-chòe hù-chiok.
Koan-hē chit-hāng tāi-chì, góa kiàn-gī lín khah hó chit-sî tio̍h khì oân-sêng kū-nî khai-sí ê bō͘-koan; lín m̄-nā tāi-seng hêng-tōng, koh tāi-seng thê-chhiòng.
Taⁿ, lín tio̍h oân-sêng chit-ê kang-chok, ēng khí-thâu kè-ōe ê sî ê jia̍t-sim, chīn lín só͘-ōe khì chòe lâi oân-sêng.
Lín nā hoaⁿ-hí koan-hiàn, Siōng-tè ōe hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p lín hiàn lín só͘ ū--ê, bōe iau-kiû lín hiàn lín só͘ bô--ê.

Góa m̄-sī beh ke-thiⁿ lín ê hū-tam, hō͘ pa̍t-lâng khah khin-sang. Kì-jiân lín hiān-chāi hù-chiok, tio̍h kiong-kip sàn-chhiah ê lâng. Án-ni, lín sàn-chhiah in hó-gia̍h ê sî, in mā ōe kiong-kip lín. Án-ni chiah ū kong-pîⁿ.
Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài: Chōe--ê, bô chhun; chió--ê, bô khiàm.
Kám-siā Siōng-tè hō͘ Thê-to chhin-chhiūⁿ góa chiah-ni̍h jia̍t-sim pang-chān lín.
I m̄-nā ū hoaⁿ-hí chiap-siū goán ê khún-kiû, koh hui-siông jia̍t-sim chū-goān pang-chān lín, koat-tēng beh khì lín hia.
Goán lēng-gōa phài chi̍t ê hiaⁿ-tī kap Thê-to chòe-hé khì; chit-ê hiaⁿ-tī tī thoân hok-im ê kang-chok ū siū-tio̍h chèng kàu-hōe ê chheng-chàn.

M̄-nā án-ni, i siū chèng kàu-hōe soán-phài chòe goán lú-hêng ê tâng-phōaⁿ, lâi chham-ka goán chit-hāng chû-siān ê kang-chok; chit-ê kang-chok sī beh kui êng-kng hō͘ Chú, koh piáu-sī goán hoaⁿ-hí kam-goān teh chòe.
Goán hui-siông kín-sīn teh chhú-lí lâng khóng-khài hōng-hiàn ê chîⁿ-hāng, chiah bián ín-khí lâng ê phoe-phêng.
In-ūi goán ê tōng-ki kong-bêng-chèng-tāi, m̄-nā tī Chú ê bīn-chêng, tī lâng ê bīn-chêng mā-sī án-ni chòe.

Só͘-í goán beh koh phài chi̍t ê hiaⁿ-tī kap in chòe-hé khì. I keng-kè goán chin chōe piàn ê khó-giām, chai i tī chin chōe tāi-chì jia̍t-sim pang-chān lâng. Hiān-chāi i hui-siông sìn-jīm lín, chiū koh-khah jia̍t-sim beh pang-chān lín.
Kóng-tio̍h Thê-to, i sī góa ê tâng-phōaⁿ, chòe góa ê tâng-kang pang-chān lín; kap i chòe-hé khì hiah-ê hiaⁿ-tī sī ta̍k kàu-hōe chhe-phài--ê, sī Ki-tok ê êng-kng.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h tùi ta̍k-ê kàu-hōe kong-khai chèng-si̍t lín ê thiàⁿ-sim, koh chèng-si̍t goán tùi lín ê khoa-kháu.
Koan-hē chín-chè Iû-thài sìn-tô͘ ê sū, góa m̄-bián koh siá-phoe hō͘ lín.

Góa chai lín kam-sim pang-chān, góa bat ūi-tio̍h chit-hāng tāi-chì tùi Má-kî-tùn -lâng khoa-kháu kóng, “ A-kai-a ê sìn-tô͘ tī kū-nî chiū chún-pī hó-sè.” Lín ê jia̍t-sim ū kám-tōng in tōa-pō͘-hūn ê lâng.

Góa ū chhe kúi-nā ê hiaⁿ-tī khì lín hia, ǹg-bāng lín chiàu góa só͘ kóng--ê chún-pī hó-sè, chiah bián góa tī chit-hāng tāi-chì ūi-tio̍h lín tùi lâng ê khoa-kháu lo̍k-khong.
Nā bô, Má-kî-tùn -lâng nā kap góa khì, khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín bô chún-pī hó-sè, goán ōe in-ūi kè-thâu siong-sìn lín soah chin làu-khùi, lín kiám bōe koh-khah làu-khùi!

Só͘-í, góa siūⁿ eng-kai kó͘-lē hiah-ê hiaⁿ-tī seng khì lín hia, kiò lín chêng tah-èng beh koan-hiàn ê chîⁿ seng chún-pī hó-sè. Án-ni góa kàu-ūi ê sî lín lóng chún-pī hó lah, piáu-sī lín ê koan-hiàn m̄-sī bián-kióng, sī kam-sim lo̍k-ì.
Tio̍h chai: Iā chió siu chió, iā chōe siu chōe.
Só͘-í ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h chiàu ka-kī só͘ koat-tēng--ê lâi hiàn, m̄-thang m̄-kam, mā m̄-thang bián-kióng; in-ūi Siōng-tè thiàⁿ hoaⁿ-hí hōng-hiàn ê lâng.
Siōng-tè ōe chiong ta̍k-hāng un-tián hong-hong-hù-hù sù-hok hō͘ lín, m̄-nā ka-kī ta̍k-hāng kàu-gia̍h, koh ōe-tàng chòe ta̍k-hāng hó-sū.
Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài: I khóng-khài chín-chè sàn-chhiah-lâng; I ê hó hêng-ûi sòa kàu éng-oán.

Kiong-kip chéng-chí hō͘ iā-chéng--ê, koh siúⁿ-sù chia̍h-mi̍h hō͘ lâng chia̍h hit-ūi Siōng-tè, ōe chiong lín só͘ su-iàu ê chéng-chí kiong-kip lín, koh hō͘ chéng-chí ná chōe, mā hō͘ lín jîn-gī ê ké-chí hong-siu.
I ōe hō͘ lín sū-sū hù-chiok, thang sûi-sî khóng-khài si-sià, hō͘ chin chōe lâng thong-kè goán chiap-tio̍h lín ê lé-mi̍h lâi kám-siā Siōng-tè.
In-ūi lín só͘ chòe chit-ê sū-hōng ê kang-chok m̄-nā kái-koat sìn-tô͘ ê su-iàu, mā hō͘ in tùi Siōng-tè ê kám-siā ke-thiⁿ kàu móa--chhut-lâi.

Thong-kè lín só͘ chòe chit-ê sū-hōng chèng-si̍t lín ū sūn-thàn só͘ soan-jīn Ki-tok ê hok-im, í-ki̍p lín tùi in kap kî-tha só͘-ū ê lâng khóng-khài ê koan-hiàn, thang kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè.
Siōng-tè sù lín bû-hān ê un-tián, hō͘ in ōe koh-khah kèng-ài lín, koh ūi-tio̍h lín kî-tó.
Kám-siā Siōng-tè, I ū hō͘ lán bōe-tàng hêng-iông ê un-sù!
Lâng kóng góa kap lín kìⁿ-bīn ê sî kheh-khì, kap lín saⁿ-lī ê sî giâm-hat, m̄-kú góa chit-ê Pó-lô ēng Ki-tok ê un-jiû kap jîn-chû chhin-sin khó͘-khǹg lín.
Góa khì lín hia ê sî m̄-thang pek góa tùi lín giâm-hat; tùi hiah-ê phoe-phêng kóng góa ēng sio̍k-sè ê tōng-ki chòe tāi-chì ê lâng, góa it-tēng ōe tùi in bô kheh-khì.
Sui-jiân goán tiàm sè-kan teh seng-oa̍h, m̄-kú bô chiàu sè-kan ê hong-sek teh cheng-chiàn.
Góa cheng-chiàn teh ēng--ê m̄-sī sio̍k-sè, sī Siōng-tè ū ui-le̍k ê bú-khì, liân kian-kò͘ ê iàu-sài to ōe-tàng phò-hoāi. Goán thui-hoan in ê giân-lūn,
chiong chó͘-tòng lâng jīn-bat Siōng-tè it-chhè ê kiau-ngō͘ lóng kā siau-bia̍t, koh kái-piàn it-chhè ê ì-liām, hō͘ i oân-choân kui-sūn Ki-tok.
Lín oân-choân sūn-ho̍k Ki-tok liáu-āu, goán chiū chhú-hoa̍t ta̍k-ê m̄ sūn-ho̍k ê lâng.
Lín kan-ta teh khòaⁿ gōa-piáu. Nā ū lâng káⁿ kóng i sio̍k Ki-tok, i ka-kī tio̍h koh siūⁿ khòaⁿ-bāi, i sio̍k Ki-tok, góa mā kâng-khoán sio̍k Ki-tok.
Chú hō͘ goán ê koân-pèng sī beh kā lín kiàn-li̍p, m̄-sī beh húi-hoāi. Góa tùi chit-ê koân-pèng nā ū khah khoa-kháu, góa mā bô kám-kak kiàn-siàu.
Góa bô ài hō͘ lín siūⁿ-kóng góa siá-phoe teh kā lín khióng-hat.
In-ūi ū lâng kóng, “ Pó-lô ê phoe giâm-hat koh kiông-ngī, m̄-kú lâng lâi ê sî khiok nńg-chiáⁿ, kóng-ōe bô hūn-liōng.”
Kóng chit-khoán ōe ê lâng tio̍h chai, goán bô tī lín hia ê sî phoe án-chóaⁿ siá, goán kàu lín hia ê sî mā ōe án-ni chòe.
Goán m̄-káⁿ kap gâu tián ka-kī ê lâng pâi-teh saⁿ-pí; in án-ni pí-chhú chhìn-tāng, hō͘-siōng pí-kàu, si̍t-chāi bô tì-hūi.
Liân tī lín tiong-kan ê kang-chok pau-hâm chāi-lāi, goán ê khoa-kháu lóng tī Siōng-tè tēng ê hān-tō͘ lāi, lóng bô chhiau-kè.
Goán bô chhiau-kè hoān-ûi, bô khì lín hia mā kóng ū khì; kî-si̍t, goán sī thâu chi̍t ê chiong Ki-tok ê hok-im thoân hō͘ lín--ê.

Goán pèng bô chhiau-kè hān-tō͘, ēng pa̍t-lâng só͘ lô-khó͘--ê chòe ka-kī ê sêng-chek lâi khoa-kháu. Goán só͘ ǹg-bāng--ê sī lín ê sìn-sim ná cheng-tióng, goán tī lín tiong-kan kang-chok ê hoān-ûi mā ná khui-khoah.
Án-ni, goán chiah thang chiong hok-im thoân kàu lín í-gōa ê tōe-khu, bô ēng pa̍t-lâng tī in ê hoān-ûi ê sêng-chiū chòe khoa-kháu.
Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kóng, “Beh khoa-kháu ê lâng, tio̍h khoa-kháu Chú!”
In-ūi m̄-sī ka-kī chhui-chiàn, sī Chú só͘ chhui-chiàn--ê chiah sī kham-tit siū chiap-la̍p ê lâng.
Chhiáⁿ lín khoan-iông góa sió-khóa ê gû-gōng; chhiáⁿ khoan-iông góa!

Góa thiàⁿ lín, chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè thiàⁿ lín thiàⁿ kah beh khí oàn-tò͘. In-ūi lín chhin-chhiūⁿ sûn-kiat ê chāi-sek-lú, góa ū chiong lín phòe hō͘ chi̍t ê tiōng-hu, chiū-sī Ki-tok.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ Hā-oa hō͘ chôa ê khúi-chà phiàn--khì, góa mā kiaⁿ-liáu lín ê sim-su ōe siū bê-he̍k, soah khì-sak tùi Ki-tok ê sûn-kiat kap chin-sêng.

In-ūi tùi ū lâng khì lín hia thoân kap goán só͘ thoân bô kâng ê Iâ-so͘, á-sī lín chiap-la̍p kap lín chêng só͘ chiap-la̍p bô kâng ê Sèng Sîn, á-sī lín chiap-siū kap lín chêng só͘ chiap-siū bô kâng ê hok-im, lín mā lóng iông-jím.
Kap hiah-ê “chhiau-kip sù-tô͘” pí, góa siūⁿ góa chi̍t-sut-á to bô khah su.
Kiám-chhái góa kóng-ōe khah han-bān, m̄-kú tì-sek bô pí lâng khah su, chit-hāng sū góa í-keng ū ēng ta̍k-khoán hong-hoat, lī-iōng ta̍k-chióng ki-hōe tùi lín piáu-bêng.
Ūi-tio̍h beh kā lín ko-seng, góa kàng-kē ka-kī, chiong Siōng-tè ê hok-im pe̍h-pe̍h thoân hō͘ lín, án-ni kiám ū sǹg hoān-chōe?
Góa tī lín hia sū-hōng ê sî, góa ê só͘-hùi lóng sī pa̍t-ê kàu-hōe kiong-kip. Kóng--khí-lâi, góa sī teh pak-siah pa̍t-ê kàu-hōe lâi kā lín ho̍k-bū.

Góa tī lín hia ê sî, ū sím-mi̍h su-iàu lóng m̄-bat kiû lín pang-chān, kā lín mâ-hoân; it-chhè ê su-iàu lóng sī Má-kî-tùn lâi ê sìn-tô͘ kā góa kiong-kip. Góa í-chêng bô kā lín mâ-hoân, í-āu mā bōe kā lín mâ-hoân.
Góa chí só͘ sìn Ki-tok ê chin-lí kóng, tī choân A-kai-a -séng kéng-lāi, góa lóng káⁿ án-ni tián.
Sī-án-chóaⁿ? Kiám kóng góa bô thiàⁿ lín? Góa ū, Siōng-tè chai!
Góa teh chòe--ê, góa beh kè-sio̍k chòe, sī beh hō͘ hiah-ê siūⁿ-beh kap goán siâng-khoán choh “sù-tô͘” ê bô ki-hōe thang khoa-kháu.
Chit-khoán lâng sī ké sù-tô͘, chòe tāi-chì kan-chà, ké-chòe sī Ki-tok ê sù-tô͘.
Che bô kî-koài, liân Sat-tàn pún-sin mā ké-chòe kng-bêng ê thiⁿ-sài.
Án-ni Sat-tàn ê po̍k-jîn nā ké-chòe gī ê po̍k-jîn mā m̄-sī sím-mi̍h tōa tāi-chì. Chòe-āu in ê hêng-ûi ōe siū-tio̍h èng-tit ê pò-èng.
Góa koh kóng chi̍t piàn, m̄-thang khòaⁿ góa chòe gōng-lâng; m̄-kú nā beh, kā góa chiap-la̍p chòe gōng-lâng, góa chiah thang tián--chi̍t-ē.
Góa chit-chūn teh kóng--ê m̄-sī Chú ê ì-sù, sī chòe chi̍t ê gōng-lâng teh tián.
Kì-jiân ū chiah-ni̍h chōe lâng teh tián sio̍k-sè ê sū, góa mā beh tián--chi̍t-ē.
Lín to hiah-ni̍h khiáu, eng-kai ōe hoaⁿ-hí iông-jím góa chit-ê gōng-lâng chiah tio̍h.
Nā ū lâng kā lín tòng-chòe lô͘-lē chhe-kah, kā lín phiⁿ, kā lín hām-hāi, kā lín khòaⁿ-khin, á-sī kā lín siàn chhùi-phóe, lín to ōe iông-jím.
Chin kiàn-siàu, góa tio̍h sêng-jīn, chit-khoán tāi-chì goán m̄-káⁿ chòe. M̄-kú nā ū lâng káⁿ tián sím-mi̍h, chún-chòe chi̍t ê gōng-lâng lâi kóng, góa mā káⁿ.
In sī Hi-pek-lâi -lâng sī--bô? Góa mā-sī. In sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng sī--bô? Góa mā-sī. In sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ-sun sī--bô? Góa mā-sī.

In sī Ki-tok ê chhe-ēng sī--bô? Góa chún-chòe siáu-lâng lâi kóng, góa koh-khah sī. Góa siū koh-khah chōe lô-khó͘, chē koh-khah chōe kaⁿ, siū sǹg bōe liáu ê piⁿ-phah, chin chōe piàn hiám-hiám-á sí.
Góa gō͘ piàn hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng piⁿ-phah, ta̍k-piàn sì-cha̍p ē kiám chi̍t ē.
Góa saⁿ piàn hō͘ Lô-má -lâng ēng kùn-á kòng, chi̍t piàn hō͘ lâng ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm, saⁿ piàn tú-tio̍h chûn phòa, chi̍t piàn tī hái--ni̍h phiau-liû chi̍t mî chi̍t ji̍t.

Tī lú-hêng tiong góa tú-tio̍h tōa-chúi ê gûi-hiám, chhiúⁿ-kiap ê gûi-hiám, Iû-thài tông-pau kap Gōa-pang-lâng ê hām-hāi; mā ū siâⁿ-chhī ê gûi-hiám, khòng-iá ê gûi-hiám, hái-siōng ê gûi-hiám, kap ké hiaⁿ-tī ê gûi-hiám.
Góa lô-lo̍k thoa-bôa, siông-siông bô khùn, iau-gō chhùi-ta, bô thang chia̍h, bô thang tòa, bô thang chhēng.
Kî-tha ê tāi-chì bián kóng, kan-ta ta̍k-ji̍t ūi-tio̍h só͘-ū ê kàu-hōe khòa-lū í-keng kàu-gia̍h.
Siáⁿ-lâng loán-jio̍k, góa bô loán-jio̍k? Siáⁿ-lâng hoān-chhò sit-pāi, góa bô siū-khì hé-to̍h?
Góa nā tio̍h tián, beh tián góa ê loán-jio̍k.
Lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ ê Pē Siōng-tè — goān I éng-oán tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn — I chai góa bô kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.
Góa tī Tāi-má-sū-kek ê sî, A-lí-ta̍t -ông chhiú-ē ê chóng-tok phài siú-ōe kò͘-siú siâⁿ-mn̂g, beh kā góa lia̍h,
m̄-kú ū lâng ēng tōa ê nâ-á tùi siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ ê thang-á kā góa lūi--lo̍h-khì, hō͘ góa thoat-lī i ê chhiú.
Góa it-tēng tio̍h tián. Sui-jiân bô lī-ek, m̄-kú góa beh kóng Chú hō͘ góa ê īⁿ-siōng kap khé-sī.

Góa chai ū chi̍t ê sìn Ki-tok ê lâng tī cha̍p-sì nî chêng hō͘ Chú chhōa kàu tē-saⁿ chàn thiⁿ. Góa m̄ chai i ê seng-khu ū chiūⁿ--khì, á-sī kan-ta khòaⁿ-kìⁿ īⁿ-siōng, chí-ū Siōng-tè chai.

Góa chai ū chi̍t ê lâng siū chhōa kàu Lo̍k-hn̂g. I ê seng-khu ū siū chiap chiūⁿ--khì, á-sī kan-ta khòaⁿ-kìⁿ īⁿ-siōng, góa m̄ chai, chí-ū Siōng-tè chai. Tī hia i ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ ēng ōe bōe-tàng piáu-ta̍t, ēng chhùi bōe-tàng kóng-chhut ê sū.
Góa beh tián chit-ê lâng; m̄-kú góa ê loán-jio̍k í-gōa, góa bōe ūi-tio̍h ka-kī tián.

Kî-si̍t, góa nā beh tián, mā bōe sǹg sī khong-khám, in-ūi góa beh kóng ê sī sū-si̍t. M̄-kú góa bōe tián ka-kī, chiah bián lâng tùi góa ê phêng-kè chhiau-kè in só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê.

Ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ góa bô in-ūi ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chin chōe ê khé-sī tì-kàu chū-ko tek-ì, tī góa ê seng-khu ū chi̍t ki chhì, chhin-chhiūⁿ Sat-tàn ê sù-chiá teh kā góa khó͘-chhó͘, hō͘ góa bōe siuⁿ chū-ko tek-ì.
Ūi-tio̍h chit-hāng tāi-chì, góa bat saⁿ piàn khún-kiû Chú hō͘ hit-ki chhì lī-khui.

I ìn góa kóng, “Góa ê un-tián ū-kàu thang boán-chiok lí ê su-iàu; in-ūi lí loán-jio̍k ê sî, góa ê khùi-la̍t chiah ōe-tàng oân-choân hoat-hui.” In-ūi án-ni, góa te̍k-pia̍t ài khoa-kháu góa ê loán-jio̍k, thang hō͘ Ki-tok ê khùi-la̍t tiàm tī góa sin-chiūⁿ.
Ūi-tio̍h Ki-tok ê iân-kò͘, góa kā loán-jio̍k, bú-jio̍k, khùn-khó͘, kan-lân, kap pek-hāi khòaⁿ-chòe hó, in-ūi góa sím-mi̍h sî loán-jio̍k, hit-sî chiū kian-kiông.
Góa it-ti̍t chòe gōng-lâng, sī lín kā góa pek--ê; lín tio̍h kā góa po-chióng chiah tio̍h. Sui-jiân góa bô siū tiōng-sī, mā bô khah su hiah-ê “chhiau-kip sù-tô͘”.
Góa tī lín tiong-kan ū ēng siōng-tōa ê nāi-sim kiâⁿ sîn-jiah, kî-sū, kap koân-lêng, chèng-bêng góa sī sù-tô͘.

Góa bô hō͘ lín ki-hōe pang-chān góa í-gōa, góa tùi-thāi lín pí tùi-thāi kî-tha ê kàu-hōe, ū tó chi̍t hāng chòe khah bô kàu? Góa chit-ê “bô kong-tō”, chhiáⁿ lín goân-liōng.

Taⁿ góa tē-saⁿ piàn chún-pī beh khì hóng-būn lín. Góa bōe chiâⁿ-chòe lín ê hū-tam; góa bōe iau-kiû lín sím-mi̍h, in-ūi góa só͘ ài--ê sī lín, m̄-sī lín ê chîⁿ. Eng-kai sī pē-bú ūi-tio̍h kiáⁿ-jî, m̄-sī kiáⁿ-jî ūi-tio̍h pē-bú chek-chū châi-bu̍t.
Góa chin hoaⁿ-hí ūi-tio̍h lín hù-chhut góa só͘ ū--ê, sīm-chì liân góa pún-sin to oân-choân hù-chhut. Kiám kóng góa thiàⁿ lín jú chōe, tit-tio̍h lín ê thiàⁿ jú chió?
Ū lâng kóng góa khúi-kè-to-toan, ēng khi-phiàn lī-iōng lín, góa kiám bat kā lín thoa-lūi?
Góa kiám ū phài sím-mi̍h-lâng khì kā lín phiⁿ?
Góa ū khǹg Thê-to khì lín hia, koh phài chi̍t ê hiaⁿ-tī kap i chòe-hé khì. Thê-to kiám ū phiⁿ lín? Goán kiám bô kâng sim-sîn teh chòe? Kiám bô kâng pō͘-tiau teh kiâⁿ?

Lín it-ti̍t siūⁿ-kóng goán tùi lín teh ūi-tio̍h ka-kī piān-hō͘ sī--bô? M̄-sī! Goán tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng kóng Ki-tok ài goán kóng ê ōe. Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, goán só͘ chòe--ê lóng sī beh hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h chō-chiū.

Góa kiaⁿ-liáu khì lín hia ê sî khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín kap góa só͘ kî-thāi--ê bô sio-siâng; lín khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa kap lín tùi góa ê kî-thāi mā bô kâng-khoán. Góa kiaⁿ-liáu lín ū hun-cheng, oàn-tò͘, pháiⁿ sèng-tē, chū-su, húi-pòng, kóng ka-chiah-āu-ōe, kiau-ngō͘, bô tia̍t-sū.

Góa kiaⁿ-liáu āu-piàn koh khì lín hia ê sî, góa ê Siōng-tè ōe hō͘ góa tī lín bīn-chêng kiàn-siàu. Góa ōe ūi-tio̍h chin chōe lâng thî-khàu, in-ūi in tùi kè-khì só͘ hoān ê chōe, chiū-sī ù-òe, îm-loān, hòng-tōng iáu-bē hóe-kái.
Che sī góa tē-saⁿ piàn beh khì lín hia. Sèng-keng kóng, “Bô-lūn kò sím-mi̍h, tio̍h ū nn̄g ê á-sī saⁿ ê chèng-jîn.”

Tùi hiah-ê í-chêng hoān-chōe kap kî-tha lóng-chóng ê lâng, tī góa tē-jī piàn hóng-būn ê sî góa ū kā lín kéng-kò, hiān-chāi góa bô tī lín hia, beh koh chi̍t piàn kā lín kéng-kò, āu-piàn góa khì ê sî, góa chiū bōe khoan-iông lín;
in-ūi lín só͘ teh chhē Ki-tok thong-kè góa kóng-ōe ê chèng-kù, lín ōe tit--tio̍h. I tùi-thāi lín pèng m̄-sī loán-jio̍k, tian-tò tī lín tiong-kan hián-chhut tōa lêng-le̍k.

Sui-jiân I in-ūi loán-jio̍k siū tèng-sí tī si̍p-jī-kè, m̄-kú I khò Siōng-tè ê tōa lêng-le̍k teh oa̍h. Goán kap I kiat-liân mā pìⁿ-chòe loán-jio̍k, m̄-kú ūi-tio̍h lín, goán khò Siōng-tè ê tōa lêng-le̍k ōe kap I chòe-hé oa̍h.

Lín tio̍h séng-chhat ka-kī, khòaⁿ ū chiàu sìn-gióng teh seng-oa̍h--bô? Tio̍h khó-giām ka-kī. Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tī lín lāi-bīn, lín ka-kī it-tēng chai, khó-giām nā bô thong-kè chiū bián kóng.
Góa ǹg-bāng lín chai, goán khó-giām lóng ū thong-kè.

Goán kî-kiû Siōng-tè hō͘ lín bōe chòe m̄-tio̍h; che m̄-sī beh piáu-sī goán khó-giām ū thong-kè, sī beh hō͘ lín chòe tio̍h ê tāi-chì, sui-jiân goán hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe khó-giām bô thong-kè mā bô iàu-kín.
In-ūi goán bōe-tàng chòe ûi-pōe chin-lí ê tāi-chì, chí-ū ióng-hō͘ chin-lí.
Goán loán-jio̍k, lín kian-kiông, goán chiū hoaⁿ-hí. Goán só͘ kî-kiû--ê sī lín ōe-tàng chiâⁿ-chòe oân-choân.

In-ūi án-ni, thàn góa bô tī lín hia ê sî siá chit-tiuⁿ phoe, chiah bián góa khì ê sî ēng Chú hō͘ góa ê koân-pèng giâm-hat tùi-thāi lín; chit-ê koân-pèng sī beh kiàn-li̍p, m̄-sī beh thiah-húi.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, chhiáⁿ pó-tiōng. Tio̍h tui-kiû oân-choân, hō͘-siōng kó͘-lē. Tio̍h tâng-sim, hô-bo̍k siong-chhù. Goān sù chû-ài kap pêng-an ê Siōng-tè kap lín tông-chāi!
Tio̍h chhin-chhiat hō͘-siōng chhéng-an! Só͘-ū ê sìn-tô͘ lóng beh kā lín chhéng-an!
Goān Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê un-tián, Siōng-tè ê chû-ài, Sèng Sîn ê thoân-khè, kap lín tāi-ke tông-chāi!
Góa sī Pó-lô. Góa choh sù-tô͘ m̄-sī tùi lâng á-sī thong-kè lâng, sī thong-kè Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok kap hō͘ I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h ê Pē Siōng-tè ê ho͘-tiàu.
Góa kap tī chia ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē siá-phoe hō͘ Ka-lia̍p-thài ê chèng kàu-hōe.
Goān lán ê Pē Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sù lín un-tián kap pêng-an!
Ūi-tio̍h beh kiù lán thoat-lī hiān-kim chit-ê siâ-ok ê sè-tāi, Ki-tok ū chiàu lán ê Pē Siōng-tè ê chí-ì ūi-tio̍h lán ê chōe hiàn I pún-sin.
Goān êng-kng kui hō͘ Siōng-tè ti̍t-kàu éng-éng-oán-oán. Amen!
Lín hō͘ góa chin tio̍h-kiaⁿ! Lín kèng-jiân hiah-ni̍h kín chiū pàng-sak hit-ūi thong-kè Ki-tok ê un-tián ho͘-tiàu lín ê Siōng-tè, khì tè pa̍t-ê hok-im.
Kî-si̍t bô pa̍t-khoán ê hok-im. Góa án-ni kóng sī in-ūi ū chi̍t-kóa lâng kā lín jiáu-loān, siūⁿ-beh khiok-kái Ki-tok ê hok-im.
M̄-kú, bô-lūn sī goán á-sī tùi thiⁿ-téng lâi ê thiⁿ-sài, só͘ thoân--ê nā kap goán í-chêng thoân hō͘ lín ê hok-im bô kâng-khoán, i eng-kai siū chiù-chó͘!
Goán bat kóng, hiān-chāi koh kóng chi̍t piàn: Nā ū lâng só͘ thoân ê hok-im kap lín í-keng chiap-siū--ê bô kâng-khoán, i eng-kai siū chiù-chó͘!

Góa chit-chūn án-ni kóng, kiám sī beh tit-tio̍h lâng á-sī Siōng-tè ê chheng-chàn? Góa kiám sī beh tit-tio̍h lâng ê hoaⁿ-hí? Góa nā iáu-teh siūⁿ-beh tit-tio̍h lâng ê hoaⁿ-hí, góa chiū m̄-sī Ki-tok ê po̍k-jîn.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa ài lín chai, góa só͘ thoân ê hok-im m̄-sī lâng siūⁿ--chhut-lâi--ê.
Chit-ê hok-im, góa m̄-sī tùi lâng niá-siū, mā m̄-sī tùi lâng ha̍k-si̍p, sī tùi Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok lâi ê khé-sī.
Lín í-keng ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ góa í-chêng choh Iû-thài kàu-tô͘ ê sî ê só͘-kiâⁿ-só͘-chòe. Góa jōa-á-ni̍h ke̍k-le̍k pek-hāi Siōng-tè ê kàu-hōe, beh thiat-tóe kā i húi-bia̍t.
Góa pí kâng chi̍t pòe ê Iû-thài -lâng koh-khah chek-ke̍k chun-thàn Iû-thài kàu-kui, koh-khah jia̍t-sim chun-siú chó͘-sian ê thoân-thóng.
M̄-kú, tùi Siōng-tè ê un-tián, góa iáu-bē chhut-sì, I chiū koat-tēng kā góa hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi, koh soán-tiàu góa,
tùi góa khé-sī I ê Kiáⁿ, hō͘ góa thang tùi Gōa-pang-lâng soan-iông I ê Kiáⁿ ê hok-im, góa lóng bô kā lâng chhéng-kàu,
mā bô chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng khì kìⁿ hiah-ê pí góa khah tāi-seng choh sù-tô͘ ê lâng. Góa sûi-sî khì A-la-pek, jiân-āu koh tò-khì Tāi-má-sū-kek.
Saⁿ nî āu, góa chiah khì Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng pài-hóng Pí-tek, kap i tòa cha̍p-gō͘ ji̍t.
Chú ê hiaⁿ-tī Ngá-kok í-gōa, kî-tha ê sù-tô͘ góa lóng bô kìⁿ--tio̍h.
Góa só͘ siá--ê lóng sī sū-si̍t; tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng góa bô kóng pe̍h-chha̍t.
Āu-lâi, góa khì Sū-lī-a kap Ki-lī-ka kéng-lāi ta̍k só͘-chāi.
Tng-sî, Iû-thài tōe-khu chèng kàu-hōe ê sìn-tô͘ lóng m̄ bat góa.
In chí-ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h pa̍t-lâng kóng, “Hit-ê í-chêng pek-hāi lán ê lâng, hiān-chāi teh thoân i kè-khì siūⁿ-beh húi-bia̍t ê sìn-gióng!”
In chiū in-ūi góa kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè!
Cha̍p-sì nî āu, góa koh chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, Pa-ná-pa kap góa chòe-hé khì, mā chhōa Thê-to chòe-hé khì.

Góa chiūⁿ Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sī chun-thàn Chú ê khé-sī. Góa ū su-hā tùi hiah-ê léng-siù soat-bêng góa tùi Gōa-pang-lâng só͘ thoân ê hok-im, chiah bián hō͘ góa kè-khì á-sī hiān-chāi só͘ phun-pho phah-piàⁿ--ê lóng lo̍k-khong.
Kap góa chòe-hé khì ê Thê-to, sui-jiân sī Hi-la̍h -lâng, mā bô lâng kiông-pek i chiap-siū kat-lé.

Ū chi̍t-kóa ké sìn-tô͘ pì-bi̍t chǹg ji̍p-lâi lán tiong-kan, chhin-chhiūⁿ cheng-thàm chhàng--ji̍p-lâi, beh thàm lán tùi Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ só͘ tit--tio̍h ê chū-iû, siūⁿ-beh hō͘ lán chiâⁿ-chòe lô͘-lē, sòng-sit chū-iû.
M̄-kú, ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lín thang pó-choân hok-im ê chin-lí, goán chi̍t-si-á to bô tùi in niū-pō͘.

M̄-kú hiah-ê hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe léng-siù--ê, bô-lūn in ê tōe-ūi sī sím-mi̍h, tùi góa lóng bô éng-hióng, in-ūi Siōng-tè bô ēng gōa-māu phòaⁿ-toàn lâng. In pèng bô lēng-gōa hō͘ góa sím-mi̍h chí-sī,
tian-tò liáu-kái Siōng-tè ū chiong thoân hok-im hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng ê jīm-bū kau-thok góa, tú chhin-chhiūⁿ I ū chiong thoân hok-im hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng ê jīm-bū kau-thok Pí-tek.
In-ūi Siōng-tè ū ēng I ê koân-lêng hō͘ góa chiâⁿ-chòe Gōa-pang-lâng ê sù-tô͘, tú chhin-chhiūⁿ I mā ū hō͘ Pí-tek chiâⁿ-chòe Iû-thài -lâng ê sù-tô͘.

Ngá-kok, Pí-tek, kap Iok-hān chiah-ê hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe sī kàu-hōe thiāu-chio̍h--ê, kì-jiân chai-iáⁿ Siōng-tè ū chiong chit-ê te̍k-pia̍t ê sú-bēng kau-tài góa, chiū kap Pa-ná-pa í-ki̍p góa ak chiàⁿ-chhiú piáu-sī lóng sī tâng-kang, koh tông-ì goán tī Gōa-pang-lâng tiong-kan kang-chok, in tī Iû-thài -lâng tiong-kan kang-chok.
In chí-ū iau-kiû goán tio̍h koan-hoâi Iû-thài -lâng tiong ê sàn-chhiah-lâng; chit-hāng tāi-chì tú-tú sī góa it-ti̍t lô-le̍k beh chòe--ê.
Pí-tek lâi kàu An-thê-o ê sî, góa tng-bīn kā i hoán-tùi, in-ūi i ū thang chek-pī ê só͘-chāi.

Goân-lâi ū chi̍t-kóa tùi Ngá-kok hia lâi ê lâng iáu-bē kàu í-chêng, Pí-tek ū kap Gōa-pang-lâng ê hiaⁿ-tī chòe-hé chia̍h-pn̄g, m̄-kú hiah-ê lâng kàu í-āu, i soah siám-pī Gōa-pang-lâng sìn-tô͘, m̄-káⁿ koh kap in chòe-hé, in-ūi kiaⁿ hiah-ê chú-tiuⁿ Gōa-pang-lâng tio̍h siū kat-lé ê lâng.
Kî-tha ê Iû-thài -lâng sìn-tô͘ mā chhin-chhiūⁿ Pí-tek chòe hit-khoán hu-ké ê tāi-chì, liân Pa-ná-pa mā siū éng-hióng khì chòe kâng-khoán bô goân-chek ê tāi-chì.

Góa chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h in bô chiàu hok-im ê chin-lí teh chòe, chiū tī chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng tùi Pí-tek kóng, “Sui-jiân lí sī Iû-thài -lâng, m̄-kú bô chiàu Iû-thài -lâng khiok chhin-chhiūⁿ Gōa-pang-lâng teh seng-oa̍h, lí ná thang kiông-pek Gōa-pang-lâng tio̍h o̍h Iû-thài -lâng seng-oa̍h?”
Lán pún-sin chhut-sì chiū-sī Iû-thài -lâng, m̄-sī “gōa-pang chōe-jîn”.

Put-kò, lán chai lâng ōe-tàng kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē sī khò sìn Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok, m̄-sī khò chun-siú Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat. Lán ka-kī mā sìn Ki-tok Iâ-so͘, sī beh hō͘ lán tùi sìn Ki-tok ōe-tàng kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, m̄-sī khò chun-siú Lu̍t-hoat, in-ūi bô lâng ōe-tàng khò chun-siú Lu̍t-hoat kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē.
Lán nā siūⁿ-beh tùi óa-khò Ki-tok kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, iáu-kú hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-chòe sī chōe-jîn, án-ni Ki-tok sī chōe ê chhe-ēng sī--bô? Choa̍t-tùi m̄-sī!
Góa nā koh khí-chō góa í-chêng só͘ thiah-húi--ê, chiū chèng-bêng góa sī ûi-pōe Lu̍t-hoat ê lâng.
In-ūi, chiàu Lu̍t-hoat góa í-keng sí tī Lu̍t-hoat-ē, sī beh hō͘ góa ǹg Siōng-tè lâi oa̍h. Góa í-keng kap Ki-tok tâng tèng si̍p-jī-kè;

án-ni, hiān-chāi teh oa̍h--ê m̄-sī góa, sī Ki-tok tī góa ê lāi-bīn teh oa̍h. Góa hiān-chāi teh oa̍h, sī khò sìn Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ teh oa̍h; I thiàⁿ góa, ūi-tio̍h góa pàng-sak sìⁿ-miā.
Góa bô hō͘ Siōng-tè ê un-tián sit-khì hāu-le̍k. Lâng nā khò Lu̍t-hoat ōe-tàng kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, Ki-tok sí chiū bô-chhái-kang.
Lín chiah-ê gōng Ka-lia̍p-thài -lâng ah, siáⁿ-lâng kā lín bê-he̍k? Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tèng si̍p-jī-kè ê sū, kiám m̄-sī chin chheng-chhó hián-sī tī lín ba̍k-chiu chêng?
Ū chi̍t hāng tāi-chì, góa kā lín chhéng-kàu: Lín niá-siū Sèng Sîn sī tùi siú Lu̍t-hoat á-sī tùi sìn só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê hok-im?
Lín ná hiah-ni̍h gōng? Lín kì-jiân tùi khò Sèng Sîn khai-sí, hiān-chāi beh khò ka-kī ê khùi-la̍t lâi oân-sêng sī--bô?
Lín ū hiah chōe siū-khó͘ ê keng-giām kiám lóng bô lō͘-ēng? It-tēng ū chiah tio̍h.
Siōng-tè sù lín Sèng Sîn, koh tī lín tiong-kan kiâⁿ sîn-jiah, sī in-ūi lín siú Lu̍t-hoat, á-sī in-ūi lín sìn só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê hok-im?
Sèng-keng án-ni kóng, “ A-pek-la-hán sìn Siōng-tè, Siōng-tè chiū kā i sǹg-chòe gī.”
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h chai, sìn ê lâng chiah sī A-pek-la-hán chin-chiàⁿ ê kiáⁿ-sun.

Sèng-keng sū-sian chiū chai, Siōng-tè ōe hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng tùi sìn kap I ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, só͘-í ū chiong chit-ê hó-siau-sit seng thoân hō͘ A-pek-la-hán, kóng, “Tōe-chiūⁿ bān-bîn ōe in-ūi lí tit-tio̍h chiok-hok!”
Án-ni it-chhè sìn ê lâng mā ōe kap ū sìn ê A-pek-la-hán chòe-hé siū chiok-hok!

Hiah-ê khò siú Lu̍t-hoat ê lâng lóng oa̍h tī chiù-chó͘ ê ē-bīn, in-ūi Sèng-keng kóng, “Bô chun-siú kì-chài tī Lu̍t-hoat ê chheh--ni̍h só͘-ū kui-tēng ê lâng lóng tio̍h siū Siōng-tè chiù-chó͘.”
Án-ni, bô lâng ōe-tàng khò siú Lu̍t-hoat kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē, in-ūi Sèng-keng ū kóng, “Gī ê lâng ōe tùi sìn lâi oa̍h.”
M̄-kú, Lu̍t-hoat m̄-sī ēng sìn chòe kun-kù. Sèng-keng kóng, “Siú Lu̍t-hoat ê lâng khò Lu̍t-hoat lâi oa̍h.”

Ki-tok í-keng ūi-tio̍h lán siū chiù-chó͘, lâi kiù-sio̍k lán thoat-lī Lu̍t-hoat ê chiù-chó͘, in-ūi Sèng-keng kì-chài kóng, “Só͘-ū tiàu tī chhâ-téng ê lâng lóng tio̍h siū chiù-chó͘.”

Ki-tok án-ni chòe sī beh chiong Siōng-tè hō͘ A-pek-la-hán ê chiok-hok thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ sù hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng, mā beh hō͘ lán tùi sìn lâi niá-siū Siōng-tè só͘ èng-ún ê Sèng Sîn.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa ēng chi̍t ê ji̍t-siông seng-oa̍h ê tāi-chì chòe lē lâi soat-bêng. Lâng só͘ li̍p ê khè-iok it-tàn sêng-li̍p, chiū bōe-ēng-tit ke-thiⁿ á-sī hòe-tû.

Siōng-tè ū tùi A-pek-la-hán kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun èng-ún. Sèng-keng pèng m̄-sī kóng “kiáⁿ-kiáⁿ-sun-sun”, chí chin chōe lâng, sī kóng “lí ê kiáⁿ-sun”, chí chi̍t ê, chiū-sī Ki-tok.

Góa ê ì-sù sī án-ni: Siōng-tè ū kap A-pek-la-hán li̍p-iok, koh tah-èng beh siú iok. Sì-pah saⁿ-cha̍p nî āu chiah chhut-hiān ê Lu̍t-hoat, bōe-tàng hòe-tû chit-ê iok hō͘ Siōng-tè ê èng-ún sit-hāu.
In-ūi, sêng-chiap Siōng-tè sù ê sán-gia̍p nā-sī kun-kù Lu̍t-hoat, chiū bô koh khò èng-ún. M̄-kú Siōng-tè sī chiàu I ê èng-ún si-un hō͘ A-pek-la-hán.

Án-ni, Lu̍t-hoat ū siáⁿ lō͘-ēng? Lu̍t-hoat sī ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lâng chai sím-mi̍h sī chōe-kò, thong-kè thiⁿ-sài tùi chi̍t ê tiong-kan-jîn lâi chè-tēng--ê, kong-hāu kàu só͘ èng-ún Hit-ūi “kiáⁿ-sun” lâi-lîm ê sî chiū kiat-sok.
M̄-kú tan-hong chi̍t pêng chòe ê tāi-chì chiū bô su-iàu tiong-kan-jîn, Siōng-tè sī tan-hong chi̍t ê chòe chit-hāng tāi-chì.

Án-ni, Lu̍t-hoat kap Siōng-tè ê èng-ún ū saⁿ tí-chhiok--bô? Choa̍t-tùi bô! In-ūi Lu̍t-hoat pan-pò͘ ê bo̍k-te̍k nā-sī beh hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā, lâng chiū ōe-tàng khò Lu̍t-hoat kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē.
M̄-kú Sèng-keng toàn-tēng choân sè-kài lóng tī chōe-ok koán-hat ê ē-bīn, thang hō͘ Siōng-tè chiong èng-ún thong-kè sìn Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sù hō͘ sìn ê lâng.
M̄-kú “sìn” ê sî-tāi lâi-lîm í-chêng, lán hō͘ Lu̍t-hoat koaiⁿ--teh, siū kàm-sī ti̍t-kàu teh-beh lâi “sìn” ê sî-tāi hián-hiān ê sî.
Án-ni, tī Ki-tok lâi-lîm í-chêng, Lu̍t-hoat chòe lán ê kàm-hō͘-jîn, thang hō͘ lán tùi “sìn” kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē.
Hiān-chāi “sìn” ê sî-tāi í-keng lâi-lîm, Lu̍t-hoat chiū bô koh chòe lán ê kàm-hō͘-jîn.
Lín tāi-ke tùi sìn kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-liân chiâⁿ-chòe Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Lín só͘-ū niá-siū sóe-lé kap Ki-tok kiat-liân ê lâng í-keng chhēng Ki-tok, ū I ê oa̍h-miā.
Án-ni, bô hun Iû-thài -lâng á-sī Gōa-pang-lâng, lô͘-lē á-sī chū-iû--ê, ta-po͘-lâng á-sī cha-bó͘-lâng, tī Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê lāi-bīn lóng chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé.
Lín kì-jiân sio̍k Ki-tok, chiū-sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ-sun, sī Siōng-tè èng-ún ê kè-sêng-jîn.
Góa koh kóng, kè-sêng-jîn sui-jiân sī choân-pō͘ châi-sán ê só͘-iú-chiá, i tī bī-sêng-liân ê sî kap lô͘-lē bô sím-mi̍h chha-pia̍t,
it-ti̍t kàu lāu-pē só͘ tēng ê ji̍t-chí, tio̍h siū kàm-hō͘-jîn kap koán-ke ê kàm-tok.
Lán mā chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, tī lêng-sèng bī-sêng-liân ê sî siū ú-tiū kan ê sîn-lêng chi-phòe chòe lô͘-lē.
M̄-kú sî-kî kàu, Siōng-tè chhe ka-kī ê Kiáⁿ, hō͘ I tùi hū-jîn-lâng lâi chhut-sì, oa̍h tī Lu̍t-hoat-ē,
ūi-tio̍h beh kiù-sio̍k oa̍h tī Lu̍t-hoat-ē ê lâng, thang hō͘ Siōng-tè kā lán siu khí-lâi chòe kiáⁿ-jî.
In-ūi lín sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî, I ū chhe I ê Kiáⁿ ê Sîn ji̍p lín ê sim, hō͘ lín kiò “A-pa, Pē!”
Án-ni, lí bô koh chòe lô͘-lē, sī kiáⁿ-jî; kì-jiân sī kiáⁿ-jî, Siōng-tè chiū hō͘ lí chòe kè-sêng-jîn.
Í-chêng, lín m̄ bat Siōng-tè ê sî, chòe hiah-ê pún-chit m̄-sī chin Sîn ê sîn-bêng ê lô͘-lē, siū in chi-phòe.
M̄-kú hiān-chāi lín í-keng bat Siōng-tè, á-sī kóng hō͘ Siōng-tè bat, sī-án-chóaⁿ lín koh tò-khì chhē hiah-ê bô-la̍t koh bô lō͘-ēng ê sîn-lêng, chòe in ê lô͘-lē?
Lín siú te̍k-pia̍t ê ji̍t, ge̍h, kap nî-á-choeh-á.
Góa kiaⁿ-liáu góa ūi-tio̍h lín só͘ chòe--ê lóng sī pe̍h-pe̍h chòe.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, in-ūi góa í-keng ū chiâⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ lín, góa khún-kiû lín mā tio̍h chiâⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ góa. Lín m̄-bat khek-khui góa.
Lín ōe-kì--tit, góa thâu chi̍t piàn thoân hok-im hō͘ lín ê sî sī in-ūi góa seng-khu ū pīⁿ.

Sui-jiân góa kiān-khong ê būn-tôe chiâⁿ-chòe lín ê tāng-tàⁿ, lín to bô khòaⁿ-khin góa, bô kū-choa̍t góa. Lín tian-tò chiap-thāi góa chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chiap-thāi Siōng-tè ê thiⁿ-sài, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh chiap-thāi Ki-tok Iâ-so͘.
Lín tng-sî ê hoaⁿ-hí boán-chiok ná soah bô--khì? Góa káⁿ kóng, lín tng-sî nā tio̍h kā ba̍k-chiu ó͘ chhut-lâi hō͘ góa mā kam-goān.
Hiān-chāi, góa tùi lín chiàu-si̍t kóng soah pìⁿ-chòe lín ê tùi-te̍k!
Hiah-ê lâng tùi lín jia̍t-chêng pèng m̄-sī chhut tī hó-ì, tian-tò sī siūⁿ-beh thiah-khui lín kap góa ê koan-hē, hō͘ lín thang tùi in jia̍t-chêng.
Hó-sū m̄-sī kan-ta góa kap lín chòe-hé ê sî chiah chòe, tio̍h put-sî jia̍t-sim khì chòe.
Góa ê sòe-kiáⁿ, ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lín ū Ki-tok ê khoán-sit, góa koh chi̍t piàn keng-kè siⁿ-kiáⁿ ê thòng-khó͘.
Góa chin ài chit-chūn chiū khì lín hia, thang ēng bô kâng-khoán ê kháu-khì kap lín kóng-ōe. Góa si̍t-chāi m̄ chai beh án-chóaⁿ tùi-thāi lín!
Lín chiah-ê ài hō͘ Lu̍t-hoat koán-hat ê lâng, kā góa kóng, lín kiám bô beh thiaⁿ Lu̍t-hoat teh kóng sím-mi̍h?
In-ūi Lu̍t-hoat ū kì-chài: A-pek-la-hán ū nn̄g ê kiáⁿ, chi̍t ê sī lú-pī siⁿ--ê, koh chi̍t ê sī chū-iû ê hū-jîn-lâng siⁿ--ê.
Lú-pī ê kiáⁿ sī thong-kè jîn-sèng siⁿ--ê; chū-iû ê hū-jîn-lâng siⁿ ê kiáⁿ sī thong-kè Siōng-tè ê èng-ún.
Che thang ēng ē-bīn ê phì-jū lâi soat-bêng: Chit nn̄g ê hū-jîn-lâng tāi-piáu nn̄g chióng khè-iok. Chi̍t ê sī Hā-kah, tāi-piáu Se-nāi-soaⁿ ê iok, siⁿ ê kiáⁿ choh lô͘-lē.
Hā-kah chí A-la-pek ê Se-nāi-soaⁿ, tāi-piáu hiān-chāi ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng; in-ūi i kap i ê kiáⁿ-sun lóng sī lô͘-lē.
Put-kò thiⁿ-téng ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng sī chū-iû--ê, sī lán ê lāu-bú.

In-ūi Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Bōe hoâi-īn, bōe siⁿ-kiáⁿ ê hū-jîn-lâng ah, tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí! M̄-bat keng-kè siⁿ-kiáⁿ thòng-khó͘ ê hū-jîn-lâng ah, tio̍h tōa-siaⁿ hoaⁿ-hí chhiùⁿ-koa! In-ūi siū pàng-sak ê hū-jîn-lâng pí ū tiōng-hu--ê koh-khah chōe kiáⁿ-jî!
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín chhin-chhiūⁿ Í-sat, sī Siōng-tè èng-ún ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Tng-sî, tùi jîn-sèng siⁿ--ê pek-hāi tùi Siōng-tè ê Sîn siⁿ--ê; hiān-chāi mā-sī án-ni.
M̄-kú Sèng-keng án-chóaⁿ kóng? “Tio̍h kā lú-pī kap i ê kiáⁿ kóaⁿ--chhut-khì, in-ūi lú-pī ê kiáⁿ bōe-tàng kap chū-iû ê hū-jîn-lâng ê kiáⁿ pîⁿ-pîⁿ kè-sêng sán-gia̍p!”
Só͘-í, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lán m̄-sī lú-pī ê kiáⁿ-jî, sī chū-iû ê hū-jîn-lâng ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lán ū chū-iû, Ki-tok í-keng ū kā lán tháu-pàng. Só͘-í tio̍h khiā-chāi, m̄-thang koh siū ap-chè chòe lô͘-lē!
Góa Pó-lô kā lín kóng, tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ: Lín nā siū kat-lé, Ki-tok chiū tùi lín lóng bô lī-ek.
Góa koh chi̍t piàn kā ta̍k-ê kam-goān chiap-siū kat-lé ê lâng kéng-kò, chit-ê lâng ū gī-bū chun-siú choân-pō͘ ê Lu̍t-hoat!
Lín chiah-ê siūⁿ-beh khò chun-siú Lu̍t-hoat tit-tio̍h kap Siōng-tè ū ha̍p-gî koan-hē ê lâng, sī kap Ki-tok toān-choa̍t koan-hē, sit-lo̍h Siōng-tè ê un-tián.
Goán pek-chhiat teh thèng-hāu, ǹg-bāng Siōng-tè hō͘ lán kap I ū ha̍p-gî ê koan-hē; chit-ê ǹg-bāng khò Siōng-tè ê Sîn, tùi sìn chiah ōe-tàng si̍t-hiān.
In-ūi lán nā kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-liân, ū siū kat-lé á-sī bô siū kat-lé lóng bô iàu-kín, iàu-kín--ê sī ū thiàⁿ ê hêng-tōng piáu-hiān--chhut-lâi ê sìn-sim.
Lín í-keng chòe-liáu chin hó; sī siáⁿ-lâng kā lín chó͘-tòng, hō͘ lín bô sūn-ho̍k chin-lí?
Kiò lín án-ni chòe--ê m̄-sī hit-ūi ho͘-tiàu lín ê Siōng-tè.
Sio̍k-gú kóng, “Chi̍t-sut-á kàⁿ-bú ōe hō͘ kui-ê mī-oân hoat--khí-lâi.”
Tī Chú ê lāi-bīn góa siong-sìn lín bōe kap góa ū bô sio-siâng ê siūⁿ-hoat. Hiah-ê teh jiáu-loān lín--ê, bô-lūn sī sím-mi̍h-lâng, it-tēng ōe siū Siōng-tè chek-hoa̍t.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa nā kè-sio̍k thoân tio̍h siū kat-lé, sī-án-chóaⁿ góa iáu-teh siū pek-hāi? Góa nā án-ni chòe, Ki-tok ê si̍p-jī-kè chiū bōe chiâⁿ-chòe chó͘-gāi.
Hiah-ê teh jiáu-loān lín ê lâng lêng-khó ka-kī iam--khí-lâi!

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, Siōng-tè ho͘-tiàu lín sī beh hō͘ lín chū-iû. Put-kò m̄-thang hō͘ lín ê chū-iû pìⁿ-chòe hòng-chhiòng su-io̍k ê ki-hōe. Tio̍h ēng thiàⁿ-sim hō͘-siōng ho̍k-bū.
In-ūi choân-pō͘ Lu̍t-hoat pau-hâm tī “Tio̍h thiàⁿ chhù-piⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī” chit-ê kài-bēng.
Tio̍h sió-sim, lín nā iáu-teh sio-kā sio-thun, ōe hō͘-siōng châu-bia̍t.
Góa ê ì-sù sī: Lín tio̍h chiàu Sèng Sîn ê ín-chhōa seng-oa̍h, choa̍t-tùi m̄-thang kiû boán-chiok pún-sèng ê io̍k-bōng.

In-ūi lâng pún-sèng ê io̍k-bōng tùi-khòng Sèng Sîn; Sèng Sîn tùi-khòng lâng ê pún-sèng. Chit nn̄g ê hō͘-siōng te̍k-tùi, tì-kàu lín bōe-tàng chiàu ka-kī só͘ ài khì chòe.
Lín nā hō͘ Sèng Sîn ín-chhōa, chiū bōe siū Lu̍t-hoat khòng-chè.
Lâng pún-sèng io̍k-bōng ê hêng-ûi chin bêng-hián, chiū-sī îm-loān, ù-òe, hò͘ⁿ-sek,
pài ngó͘-siōng, kiâⁿ siâ-su̍t, te̍k-tùi, tò͘-cheng, chi̍t-tò͘, siū-khì, chū-su, kiat-tóng, hun-phài,

oàn-tò͘, chiú-chùi, hoa-thian-chiú-tōe, téng. Góa í-chêng bat kā lín kéng-kò, chit-chūn koh chi̍t piàn kā lín kéng-kò: Chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì ê lâng bōe-tàng chiâⁿ-chòe Siōng-tè-kok ê chú-bîn!
M̄-kú Sèng Sîn só͘ kiat ê ké-chí sī: Jîn-ài, hoaⁿ-hí, hô-pêng, jím-nāi, jîn-chû, liông-siān, tiong-si̍t,
un-jiû, chiat-chè. Chit-khoán hêng-ûi it-poaⁿ ê hoat-lu̍t bô teh kìm-chí.
Hiah-ê sio̍k Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê lâng í-keng ū chiong pún-sèng kap it-chhè ê siâ-chêng su-io̍k chòe-hé tèng-sí tī si̍p-jī-kè.
Kì-jiân lán khò Sèng Sîn teh oa̍h, lán tio̍h sūn-thàn Sèng Sîn lâi seng-oa̍h.
Lán m̄-thang tui-kiû hu-êng, m̄-thang pí-chhú kek-khì, hō͘-siōng oàn-tò͘.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, nā ū lâng hām-lo̍h kè-sit, lín chiah-ê sio̍k-lêng ê lâng tio̍h ēng un-hô ê sim kā i kiù-chèng. Lín ka-kī mā tio̍h sió-sim, chiah bián siū ín-iú.
Tio̍h hun-tam tāng-tàⁿ, án-ni chòe chiah sī teh si̍t-hiān Ki-tok ê lu̍t-hoat.
Ka-kī bô gâu siūⁿ-kóng chin gâu, sī teh khi-phiàn ka-kī.
Ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h séng-chhat ka-kī ê hêng-ûi; nā ū hó hêng-ûi, i kan-ta thang tùi ka-kī khoa-kháu, m̄-bián kap pa̍t-lâng pí-kàu.
In-ūi ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h taⁿ ka-kī ê tàⁿ.
Ha̍k-si̍p tō-lí ê lâng tio̍h kap kàu-tō i ê lâng hun-hióng ta̍k-hāng hó-mi̍h.
M̄-thang phiàn ka-kī, Siōng-tè sī bōe-ēng-tit bú-bān--ê. Lâng chèng sím-mi̍h chiū siu sím-mi̍h.

Lâng só͘ iā--ê nā-sī ūi-tio̍h boán-chiok ka-kī ê io̍k-bōng, chiū ōe siu-sêng bia̍t-bông; lâng só͘ iā--ê nā-sī ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ Sèng Sîn hoaⁿ-hí, chiū ōe tùi Sèng Sîn siu éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Chòe hó-sū m̄-thang siūⁿ siān; nā bô hoe-sim, sî kàu chiū thang siu-sêng.
Só͘-í, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h sî-chūn, tio̍h pá-ak ki-hōe tùi chèng-lâng chòe hó-sū, te̍k-pia̍t sī tùi sìn-gióng chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ke ê lâng.
Lín khòaⁿ, góa chhin-pit ēng chiah-ni̍h tōa ê jī siá hō͘ lín!
Hiah-ê chù-tiōng gōa-piáu thé-biān ê lâng, siūⁿ-beh kiông-pek lín chiap-siū kat-lé. In án-ni chòe kan-ta sī bô ài ūi-tio̍h Ki-tok ê si̍p-jī-kè siū pek-hāi.
Kî-si̍t, liân hiah-ê siū kat-lé ê lâng pún-sin mā bô chun-siú Lu̍t-hoat. In pek lín siū kat-lé, chiah ōe-tàng khoa-kháu kóng lín ū chun-siú gōa-piáu ê lé-gî.

Góa leh, góa chí-ū beh khoa-kháu lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê si̍p-jī-kè, thong-kè chit-ê si̍p-jī-kè, tùi góa lâi kóng, sè-kài í-keng tèng-sí tī si̍p-jī-kè; tùi sè-kài lâi kóng, góa mā í-keng tèng-sí.
Ū siū kat-lé bô siū kat-lé lóng bô tiōng-iàu; tiōng-iàu--ê sī lán tio̍h chiâⁿ-chòe sin chhòng-chō ê lâng.
Chiàu chit-ê chún-chek seng-oa̍h ê lâng chiū-sī Siōng-tè ê Í-sek-lia̍t chú-bîn. Goān pêng-an kap lîn-bín kap in tông-chāi!
Tùi taⁿ í-āu, bô-lūn sím-mi̍h-lâng to lóng m̄-thang kā góa kiáu-jiáu; in-ūi Iâ-so͘ ū tī góa ê seng-khu khàm-ìn chòe kì-hō, chèng-bêng góa sio̍k I.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, goān lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê un-tián kap lín tông-chāi. Amen!
Góa sī Pó-lô, hōng Siōng-tè ê chí-ì choh Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê sù-tô͘; góa siá-phoe hō͘ tòa tī Í-hut-só͘, sio̍k Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ tiong-sìn ê sìn-tô͘.
Goān lán ê Pē Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sù lín un-tián kap pêng-an!
Tio̍h chheng-chàn lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê Pē Siōng-tè! In-ūi I ū chiong thiⁿ-téng ta̍k-khoán sio̍k-lêng ê hok-khì, thong-kè lán kap Ki-tok kiat-liân, sù hō͘ lán.
Chhòng-sè í-chêng, Siōng-tè í-keng thong-kè Ki-tok kéng-soán lán, hō͘ lán tī I bīn-chêng chiâⁿ-chòe sèng-kiat bô khoat-tiám ê lâng. In-ūi Siōng-tè thiàⁿ lán,
chá chiū koat-tēng beh thong-kè Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok hō͘ lán choh I ê kiáⁿ-jî kui I; che sī I só͘ hoaⁿ-hí--ê, sī I ê chí-ì.
Lán tio̍h siōng-chàn Siōng-tè êng-iāu ê un-tián, in-ūi I ū chiong I só͘ thiàⁿ ê Kiáⁿ bô tiâu-kiāⁿ sù hō͘ lán!
Tùi Ki-tok, thong-kè I ê sí, lán tit-tio̍h chū-iû, chōe-kò tit-tio̍h sià-bián. Siōng-tè ê un-tián si̍t-chāi chin hong-hù;
I ū chiong chit-ê un-tián chhiong-chhiong-chiok-chiok sù hō͘ lán. I ēng ta̍k-khoán ê tì-hūi kap lí-kái,
chiàu I só͘ hoaⁿ-hí ê chí-ì, hō͘ lán chai I chá chiū koat-tēng thong-kè Ki-tok lâi oân-sêng ò-biāu ê kè-ōe.
Chit-ê kè-ōe, Siōng-tè beh tī sî-ki sêng-se̍k ê sî oân-sêng, thang hō͘ thiⁿ-téng kap tōe-chiūⁿ it-chhè ê pī-chō-bu̍t lóng chun Ki-tok choh thâu, liân-ha̍p chòe chi̍t ê.
Bān-iú lóng chiàu Siōng-tè ê kè-ōe kap koat-tēng lâi oân-sêng. Siōng-tè chiàu I tāi-seng koat-tēng ê chí-ì, thong-kè Ki-tok kéng-soán goán lâi sêng-chiap I ê ke-gia̍p.
Án-ni sī beh hō͘ goán chiah-ê tāi-seng chiong ǹg-bāng khǹg tī Ki-tok ê lâng thang siōng-chàn Siōng-tè ê êng-iāu.

Thong-kè Ki-tok, lín mā ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h chin-lí ê sìn-sit, chiū-sī hit-ê hō͘ lín tit-kiù ê hok-im, hit-sî lín ū sìn, Siōng-tè chiū sù lín só͘ èng-ún ê Sèng Sîn, kā lín khàm-ìn chèng-bêng lín sio̍k I.
Sèng Sîn pó-chèng lán thang sêng-chiap Siōng-tè só͘ èng-ún ê ke-gia̍p, ti̍t-kàu hō͘ sio̍k I ê lâng tit-tio̍h oân-choân ê chū-iû, thang siōng-chàn I ê êng-iāu.
In-ūi án-ni, góa chi̍t-ē thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín tùi Chú Iâ-so͘ ū sìn-sim, tùi só͘-ū ê sìn-tô͘ ū thiàⁿ-sim,
chiū ūi-tio̍h lín put-sî teh kám-siā Siōng-tè. Góa tī kî-tó tiong siàu-liām lín,
kî-kiû lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê Siōng-tè, êng-iāu ê Thiⁿ Pē, sù Sèng Sîn hō͘ lín ū tì-hūi kap khé-sī thang jīn-bat I.

Góa khún-kiû Siōng-tè khui lín ê sim-gán, hō͘ lín thang chai I soán-tiàu lín lâi tit--tio̍h ê ǹg-bāng sī sím-mi̍h. I tùi I ê sìn-tô͘ só͘ èng-ún ê chiok-hok jōa-á-ni̍h hong-hù,

tī lán sìn I ê lâng tiong-kan teh ūn-hêng ê koân-lêng jōa-á-ni̍h tōa. I ū ūn-iōng chit-ê khùi-la̍t hō͘ Ki-tok tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, koh hō͘ Ki-tok tī thiⁿ-téng chē tī I ka-kī ê chiàⁿ-pêng,
tī hia chhiau-oa̍t só͘-ū ê thóng-léng-chiá, chiáng-koân-chiá, koân-le̍k-chiá, chú-chèng-chiá, í-ki̍p it-chhè hiān-chāi kap chiong-lâi ōe-tàng chheng-ho͘ ê hâm-thâu.
Siōng-tè hō͘ bān-iú lóng khut-ho̍k tī Ki-tok ê kha-ē, hō͘ I choh kàu-hōe ê goân-siú, thóng-tī bān-iú.
Kàu-hōe sī Ki-tok ê sin-thé, sī chhiong-móa bān-iú ê Ki-tok só͘ oân-choân chhiong-móa--ê.
Í-chêng in-ūi lín hoān-chōe pōe-ge̍k Siōng-tè, lêng-sèng í-keng sí.
Hit-sî, lín thàn sè-kan ê tiâu-liû, sūn-ho̍k khong-tiong ê chiáng-koân-chiá, chiū-sī hiān-chāi teh koán-hat pōe-ge̍k Siōng-tè ê lâng hit-ê siâ-sîn.

Kî-si̍t, goán í-chêng mā lóng kap chiah-ê lâng kâng-khoán thàn pún-sèng ê io̍k-bōng seng-oa̍h, chiàu ka-kī jio̍k-thé ê su-io̍k kap ì-liām teh hêng-tōng. Goán kap kî-tha ê lâng kâng-khoán, chù-tiāⁿ siū Siōng-tè hêng-hoa̍t.
M̄-kú Siōng-tè ū hong-sēng ê lîn-bín, ēng ke̍k-tōa ê chû-ài thiàⁿ lán,
tī lán iáu-teh pōe-ge̍k, lêng-sèng í-keng sí ê sî, I hō͘ lán kap Ki-tok chòe-hé koh-oa̍h; lín sī tùi Siōng-tè ê un-tián tit-tio̍h kiù--ê.
Thong-kè lán kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-ha̍p, Siōng-tè hō͘ lán kap I chòe-hé koh-oa̍h, tī thiⁿ-téng chòe-hé chiáng-koân.
I án-ni chòe sī beh thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ tùi lán hián-sī chû-ài, thang tùi āu sè-tāi piáu-bêng I bû-hān hong-hù ê un-tián.
In-ūi lín sī khò Siōng-tè ê un-tián tùi sìn tit-tio̍h kiù; m̄-sī khò lín ka-kī, sī khò Siōng-tè ê un-sù.
Kì-jiân m̄-sī khò hêng-ûi, sím-mi̍h-lâng to bōe-tàng khoa-kháu.
In-ūi lán sī Siōng-tè chhòng-chō--ê; I thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ chhòng-chō lán, hō͘ lán thang chòe I chá chiū chún-pī ài lán chòe ê hó-sū.

Só͘-í, lín chiah-ê chhut-sì chòe Gōa-pang-lâng--ê, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit lín kè-khì ū hō͘ chū-chheng siū kat-lé--ê, chiū-sī ēng chhiú tī seng-khu kiâⁿ kat-lé ê Iû-thài -lâng, kiò-chòe bô siū kat-lé ê lâng.
Lín hit-sî kap Ki-tok bô koan-hē, bô sio̍k Siōng-tè ê soán-bîn, bô hūn tī Siōng-tè èng-ún ê bêng-iok, tī chit sè-kan bô ǹg-bāng, bô Siōng-tè.
M̄-kú lín chiah-ê í-chêng lī-khui Siōng-tè hn̄g-hn̄g ê Gōa-pang-lâng, hiān-chāi khò Ki-tok Iâ-so͘, thong-kè I ê sí, í-keng kap Siōng-tè chhin-kūn.

Ki-tok chhiok-chìn lán ê hô-pêng; I ū hō͘ Iû-thài -lâng kap Gōa-pang-lâng chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê. I ēng ka-kī ê seng-khu thiah-húi kā in keh-khui ê chhiûⁿ, siau-tû in tiong-kan ê te̍k-tùi.
I hòe-tû Iû-thài Lu̍t-hoat ê kài-bēng kap kui-lē, hō͘ nn̄g pêng thong-kè I thang chhòng-chō chi̍t ê sin ê lâng lâi chhiok-chìn hô-pêng.
Ki-tok thong-kè si̍p-jī-kè siau-bia̍t pí-chhú ê te̍k-tùi, hō͘ nn̄g pêng chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé, thang kap Siōng-tè hô-hó.

Án-ni, Ki-tok lâi sī beh thoân hô-pêng ê hok-im hō͘ só͘-ū ê lâng, pau-koat lín chiah-ê í-chêng lī-khui Siōng-tè hn̄g-hn̄g ê Gōa-pang-lâng kap chhin-kūn Siōng-tè ê Iû-thài -lâng.
Thong-kè Ki-tok, lán nn̄g pêng ê lâng lóng ōe-tàng tùi kâng chi̍t ūi Sèng Sîn lâi chhin-kūn Pē.
Só͘-í, lín Gōa-pang-lâng í-keng m̄-sī chhut-gōa-lâng, m̄-sī kiâu-bîn, sī kap Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn pîⁿ-pîⁿ choh kok-bîn, choh Siōng-tè ke-lāi ê lâng,
kiàn-li̍p tī sian-ti kap sù-tô͘ só͘ hē ê tōe-ki téng, ēng Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ pún-sin chòe siōng tiōng-iàu ê ki-chio̍h,
kui-ê kiàn-tio̍k-bu̍t khò I lâi liân-chiap kiat-ha̍p, chiām-chiām khok-tōa chiâⁿ-chòe sèng ê tiān kui-sio̍k Chú.
Lín kap I kiat-liân, khò Sèng Sîn ê pang-chān, mā chòe-hé siū khí-chō chòe Siōng-tè khiā-khí ê só͘-chāi.
In-ūi án-ni, góa Pó-lô, ūi-tio̍h lín Gōa-pang-lâng choh Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê siû-hoān, thòe lín tùi Siōng-tè kî-kiû.
Lín it-tēng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h, ūi-tio̍h lín, Siōng-tè tùi I ê un-tián ū úi-thok góa chit-ê chit-bū.
Siōng-tè ū chiong I ê ò-pì khé-sī hō͘ góa chai. Góa í-keng ū kán-lio̍k siá chit-ê tāi-chì,
lín tha̍k liáu chiū ōe bêng-pe̍k góa tùi Ki-tok ò-pì ê liáu-kái;
chit-ê ò-pì, tī kè-khì ê sè-tāi bô hō͘ lâng chai, hiān-chāi Siōng-tè thong-kè Sèng Sîn í-keng ū tùi I ê sèng sù-tô͘ kap sian-ti khé-sī.

Chit-ê ò-pì sī án-ni: Gōa-pang-lâng thong-kè hok-im thang kap Iû-thài -lâng pîⁿ-pîⁿ choh kè-sêng-jîn, pîⁿ-pîⁿ sio̍k chi̍t ê sin-thé, kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-liân pîⁿ-pîⁿ sêng-siū Siōng-tè ê èng-ún.
Tùi Siōng-tè te̍k-pia̍t ê un-sù, thong-kè I tōa lêng-le̍k ê ūn-hêng, góa chiâⁿ-chòe hok-im ê chhe-ēng.
Góa tī Siōng-tè só͘-ū ê chú-bîn tiong sī tē-it bî-sòe--ê, I kèng-jiân sù góa un-tián thang chiong Ki-tok sǹg bōe liáu hong-hù ê hok-im thoân hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng,
thang hō͘ só͘-ū ê lâng bêng-pe̍k Siōng-tè án-chóaⁿ si̍t-hiān I ê ò-pì. Chhòng-chō bān-iú ê Siōng-tè tī kè-khì ê sè-tāi ū chiong chit-ê ò-pì ún-ba̍t--khí-lâi,
sī beh tī hiān-kim ê sè-tāi, thong-kè kàu-hōe, hō͘ thian-kài ê thóng-léng-chiá, koân-le̍k-chiá, lóng thang jīn-bat Siōng-tè ta̍k-khoán ê tì-hūi.
Siōng-tè án-ni chòe sī kun-kù I éng-oán ê chí-ì; chit-ê chí-ì í-keng thong-kè lán ê Chú Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ si̍t-hiān lah.
Kap Ki-tok kiat-liân, thong-kè tùi I ê sìn, lán thang chhiong-móa sìn-sim hó-táⁿ chiū-kūn Siōng-tè.
Só͘-í, chhiáⁿ lín m̄-bián in-ūi góa ūi-tio̍h lín siū-khó͘ lâi sim kan-khó͘; kî-si̍t che sī lín ê kong-êng.
In-ūi án-ni, góa kūi-lo̍h, ǹg sù miâ-hō hō͘ thiⁿ-téng tōe-chiūⁿ só͘-ū chong-cho̍k ê Thiⁿ Pē
kî-kiû, chiàu I hong-hù ê êng-iāu, thong-kè I ê Sèng Sîn só͘ sù ê khùi-la̍t, hō͘ lín lōe-chāi ê lâng ióng-chòng--khí-lâi.
Góa mā kî-kiû Ki-tok ōe in-ūi lín ê sìn lâi tiàm tī lín sim-lāi, hō͘ lín tèng-kun hē tōe-ki tī thiàⁿ,

ōe-tàng kap Siōng-tè só͘-ū ê chú-bîn bêng-pe̍k Ki-tok ê thiàⁿ sī jōa-á-ni̍h tn̂g, khoah, koân, chhim, koh keng-giām hit-ê chhiau-kè lâng ê tì-sek só͘ ōe-tàng liáu-kái ê thiàⁿ, hō͘ Siōng-tè ê oân-siān kā lín oân-choân chhiong-móa.
Siōng-tè ōe-tàng ēng I tī lán tiong-kan teh ūn-hêng ê tōa lêng-le̍k, tōa-tōa chhiau-kè lán só͘ kiû só͘ siūⁿ--ê, lâi sêng-chiū it-chhè.
Goān êng-iāu tī kàu-hōe tiong, thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kui hō͘ Siōng-tè, kàu sè-sè-tāi-tāi, bû-kiông bû-chīn. Amen!
Só͘-í, chòe chi̍t ê ūi-tio̍h Chú choh siû-hoān ê lâng, góa khó͘-khǹg lín. Kì-jiân lín siū Siōng-tè ho͘-tiàu, hêng-ûi tio̍h hû-ha̍p I ê ho͘-tiàu.
Hoān-sū tio̍h khiam-pi, un-jiû, jím-nāi, ēng thiàⁿ hō͘-siōng khoan-iông,
ēng hô-pêng hō͘-siōng liân-hê, chīn-la̍t pó-chhî Sèng Sîn só͘ sù ê ha̍p-it.
Sin-thé chí-ū chi̍t ê; Sèng Sîn chí-ū chi̍t ūi; tú chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè tiàu lán beh tit--tio̍h ê ǹg-bāng sī chi̍t ê.
Chú chí-ū chi̍t ūi; sìn-gióng chí-ū chi̍t ê; sóe-lé chí-ū chi̍t ê;
Siōng-tè chí-ū chi̍t ūi, chiū-sī bān-iú ê Pē, I tī bān-iú ê téng-bīn, koàn-chhoàn bān-iú, koh tī bān-iú tiong.
Lán ta̍k-ê lâng lóng chiàu Ki-tok só͘ sù ê hūn-liōng niá-siū un-sù.
Chiàu Sèng-keng só͘ kóng: I seng-koân kàu siōng-koân ê ūi ê sî, tòa chi̍t tōa-tūi siū-lia̍h--ê kap I khì, sù un-sù hō͘ lâng.
“I seng-koân” chit-kù ōe sī sím-mi̍h ì-sù? Chiū-sī: I mā bat kàng-lo̍h kàu tōe-ē siōng-chhim ê só͘-chāi.
Án-ni, “kàng-lo̍h” Hit-ūi chiū-sī kap “seng-koân” kàu chèng-thiⁿ ê téng-bīn lâi chhiong-móa bān-iú Hit-ūi sī kâng chi̍t ūi.
I só͘ sù--ê ū sù-tô͘, ū sian-ti, ū thoân-hok-im--ê, ū bo̍k-ióng--ê kap kàu-tō--ê.
I án-ni chòe sī beh chong-pī Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn thang chòe sū-hōng ê kang-chok, lâi kiàn-li̍p Ki-tok ê thé;
chòe-āu lán lóng thang tùi Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ ū it-tì ê sìn-gióng kap jīm-sek lâi tióng-tāi-sêng-jîn, ta̍t-kàu Ki-tok oân-choân ê thêng-tō͘.
Án-ni, lán chiū bô koh choh gín-á, hō͘ khi-phiàn-chiá phian-chō--chhut-lâi só͘-ū chhò-gō͘ ê ha̍k-soat thoa teh kiâⁿ, phiau-lâi-phiau-khì.
Lán hoán-tńg tio̍h ēng thiàⁿ-sim kóng chin-si̍t, tī ta̍k hong-bīn ēng choh-thâu ê Ki-tok chòe bo̍k-phiau lâi sêng-tióng.
Tùi I, sin-thé ê ta̍k kun-chat hō͘-siōng liân-chiap, saⁿ chi-chhî, ta̍k-ê chi-thé hoat-hui eng-kai ū ê kong-lêng, hō͘ kui-ê sin-thé tióng-tōa, ēng thiàⁿ kiàn-li̍p--khí-lâi.

Só͘-í, góa hōng Chú ê miâ khó͘-khǹg lín, m̄-thang kè-sio̍k chhin-chhiūⁿ Gōa-pang-lâng án-ni seng-oa̍h. In in-ūi bû-ti kap ngī-sim, sim-su o͘-àm, tì-kàu su-sióng khong-tōng, kap Siōng-tè só͘ sù ê oa̍h-miā keh-tn̄g.
In sit-khì liâm-thí ê sim, chīn-chêng hòng-chhiòng chòe ta̍k-khoán ù-òe ê tāi-chì.
Lín pèng m̄-sī án-ni ha̍k-si̍p Ki-tok.
Lín eng-kai ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h I ê tāi-chì, ū tùi I ha̍k-si̍p, in-ūi tī Iâ-so͘ chiah ū chin-lí.
Án-ni, tio̍h thoat-lī í-chêng ê seng-oa̍h, thǹg-khì kū ê lâng, in-ūi kū ê lâng siū su-io̍k ê bê-he̍k teh pāi-hoāi.
Lín ê sim-su ì-liām tio̍h oân-choân ōaⁿ-sin,
chiū-sī tio̍h chhēng chiàu Siōng-tè ê hêng-siōng chhòng-chō ê sin lâng, ēng kun-kù chin-lí só͘ sán-seng ê kong-gī kap sèng-kiat piáu-hiān--chhut-lâi.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h thoat-lī hu-ké, tio̍h tùi chhù-piⁿ kóng chin-si̍t-ōe, in-ūi lán lóng sī Ki-tok sin-thé ê chi̍t-pō͘-hūn.
Lín nā siū-khì m̄-thang tì-kàu hoān-chōe. M̄-thang kàu ji̍t lo̍h iáu-teh siū-khì;
m̄-thang hō͘ Mô͘-kúi ū khang-phāng thang lī-iōng.
Bat chòe chha̍t--ê m̄-thang koh thau-the̍h; tio̍h khò siang-chhiú chhut-la̍t chòe kang tit-tio̍h chèng-tong ê siu-ji̍p, ū-la̍t thang pang-chān sàn-chhiah-lâng.
Pháiⁿ-ōe lóng m̄-thang kóng; tian-tò tio̍h kóng chō-chiū lâng ê hó-ōe, hō͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng tit-tio̍h lī-ek.
M̄-thang hō͘ Siōng-tè ê Sèng Sîn iu-siong; in-ūi Sèng Sîn sī lín sio̍k Siōng-tè ê ìn-kì, pó-chèng lín tī chín-kiù ê Ji̍t tit-tio̍h tháu-pàng.
Tio̍h khì-sak it-chhè ê ok-to̍k, pháiⁿ sèng-tē, siū-khì, soan-jióng, húi-pòng, í-ki̍p it-chhè ê pháiⁿ.
Tio̍h chhin-chhiat jîn-chû saⁿ khoán-thāi, hō͘-siōng sià-bián, tú kap Siōng-tè ū thong-kè Ki-tok sià-bián lín kâng-khoán.
Kì-jiân lín sī Siōng-tè só͘ thiàⁿ ê kiáⁿ-jî, tio̍h o̍h I.
Giân-hêng-kú-chí tio̍h ū thiàⁿ-sim, chhin-chhiūⁿ Ki-tok thiàⁿ lán, ūi-tio̍h lán hi-seng ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā chòe phang-phang ê chè-mi̍h hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè.
Kì-jiân lín sī Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn, it-chhè îm-loān, ù-òe, á-sī tham-io̍k ê sū, tī lín tiong-kan liân kóng to m̄-thang.
Mā m̄-thang kóng siâ-îm, chho͘-sio̍k, á-sī hā-liû ê ōe, hoán-tńg tio̍h kám-siā.
Tio̍h khak-si̍t chai, îm-loān, ù-òe, tham-loân ê lâng — tham-loân sī chi̍t chióng ê pài ngó͘-siōng — Ki-tok kap Siōng-tè ê Kok choa̍t-tùi bô in ê hūn.
M̄-thang hō͘ lâng ēng khong-tōng ê ōe kā lín bê--khì; Siōng-tè ê siū-khì ōe ūi-tio̍h chiah-ê tāi-chì lîm-kàu hiah-ê pōe-ge̍k ê lâng.
Só͘-í, m̄-thang kap hit-khoán lâng kau-chhap.
Lín í-chêng tī o͘-àm tiong, m̄-kú hiān-chāi í-keng chiâⁿ-chòe sio̍k Chú ê lâng tī kng-bêng tiong, kiâⁿ-chòe tio̍h ū kng-bêng kiáⁿ-jî ê khoán-sit;
kng-bêng só͘ kiat ê ké-chí sī ta̍k-khoán ê liông-siān, kong-gī, kap chin-lí.
Tio̍h chhâ-chhut sím-mi̍h sī Chú só͘ hoaⁿ-hí ê sū.
M̄-thang chham-ú tī o͘-àm tiong teh chòe bô lō͘-ēng ê tāi-chì, tian-tò tio̍h kā in po̍k-lō͘--chhut-lâi.
In am-am-khàm-khàm teh chòe--ê, liân kóng to kiàn-siàu!
It-chhè hō͘ kng po̍k-lō͘ chiū hián-bêng--chhut-lâi,

in-ūi kā it-chhè hián-bêng--chhut-lâi--ê sī kng. Só͘-í ū chi̍t kù ōe án-ni kóng: Teh khùn ê lâng, khí--lâi; tio̍h tùi sí-lâng tiong peh--khí-lâi! Ki-tok beh kā lí chiò-kng!
Só͘-í, lín ê hêng-ûi tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang chòe bô tì-hūi ê lâng, tio̍h chòe chhong-bêng ê lâng,
siān-iōng ki-hōe, in-ūi hiān-kim ê sî-tāi siâ-ok.
Só͘-í, m̄-thang chòe hô͘-tô͘ ê lâng, tio̍h bêng-pe̍k sím-mi̍h sī Chú ê chí-ì.
M̄-thang chiú-chùi; chiú-chùi ōe hō͘ lín pāi-hoāi; hoán-tńg tio̍h hō͘ Sèng Sîn chhiong-móa.
Tio̍h ēng si-phian, sèng-si, lêng-koa tùi-chhiùⁿ, tùi sim-tóe chhiùⁿ sèng-si kap si-phian chheng-chàn Chú.
Tio̍h khò lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ, ūi-tio̍h ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì sî-siông kám-siā Thiⁿ Pē Siōng-tè.
Lín tio̍h ēng kèng-ùi Ki-tok ê sim hō͘-siōng sūn-ho̍k.
Choh hū-jîn-lâng--ê, tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ sūn-ho̍k Chú án-ni sūn-ho̍k tiōng-hu.
In-ūi tiōng-hu sī hū-jîn-lâng ê thâu, chhin-chhiūⁿ Ki-tok sī kàu-hōe ê thâu; I pún-sin sī kàu-hōe — I ê seng-khu ê Kiù-chú.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ kàu-hōe sūn-ho̍k Ki-tok, choh hū-jîn-lâng--ê eng-kai mā tio̍h sū-sū sūn-ho̍k tiōng-hu.
Choh tiōng-hu--ê, tio̍h thiàⁿ hū-jîn-lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ Ki-tok thiàⁿ kàu-hōe, ūi-tio̍h kàu-hōe hi-seng ka-kī.
I án-ni chòe sī beh thong-kè I ê ōe ēng chúi sóe chheng-khì lâi sèng-hòa kàu-hōe kui Siōng-tè,
hō͘ kàu-hōe ū êng-kng, lóng bô ù-tiám, bô jiâu-bûn, á-sī kî-tha chit-khoán ê khoat-tiám, chiâⁿ-chòe sèng-kiat bô hâ-chhû thang hiàn hō͘ ka-kī.
Siâng-khoán, tiōng-hu tio̍h thiàⁿ ka-kī ê hū-jîn-lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī ê seng-khu. Thiàⁿ hū-jîn-lâng chiū-sī thiàⁿ ka-kī.
Bô lâng oàn-hūn ka-kī ê seng-khu, tian-tò sī kā i pó-ióng, chiàu-kò͘, kap Ki-tok tùi-thāi kàu-hōe kâng-khoán,
in-ūi lán sī I seng-khu ê chi-thé.
Sèng-keng kóng, “In-ūi án-ni, lâng ōe lī-khui pē-bú, kap i ê bó͘ kiat-ha̍p, nn̄g lâng chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé.”
Chit-ê keng-bûn khé-sī chi̍t ê ke̍k-tōa ê ò-pì; chiàu góa ê lí-kái, che sī teh chí Ki-tok kap kàu-hōe ê koan-hē.
Chóng-sī, che mā sek-iōng tī lín ta̍k-ê lâng: Tiōng-hu tio̍h thiàⁿ ka-kī ê hū-jîn-lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī; hū-jîn-lâng tio̍h kèng-tiōng i ê tiōng-hu.
Choh jî-lú--ê, tio̍h sūn-ho̍k pē-bú, che sī sìn Chú ê lâng eng-kai ū ê pún-hūn.
“Tio̍h hàu-kèng pē-bú”, che sī thâu chi̍t tiâu hù-tài èng-ún ê kài-bēng, “án-ni chòe lín chiū ōe ta̍k-hāng hó-sè, tī chit-ê tōe kú-tn̂g khiā-khí.”
Choh pē-bú--ê, m̄-thang kek lín ê jî-lú siū-khì, tio̍h chiàu Chú ê koán-kàu kap kà-sī kā in pôe-iúⁿ.
Choh lô͘-lē--ê, kap sūn-ho̍k Ki-tok kâng-khoán, tio̍h ēng kèng-ùi kap kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ choan-sim sūn-ho̍k lín tī sè-chiūⁿ ê chú-lâng.
M̄-thang tī lâng ê bīn-chêng kò͘-ì chòe hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ, hō͘ lâng hoaⁿ-hí; tio̍h choh Ki-tok ê lô͘-lē, tùi sim-lāi chun-thàn Siōng-tè ê chí-ì,
kam-sim lo̍k-ì chīn lô͘-lē ê pún-hūn, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh ho̍k-sāi Chú, m̄-sī teh ho̍k-sāi lâng.
Tio̍h chai, bô-lūn sī lô͘-lē á-sī chū-iû--ê, Chú lóng ōe chiàu ta̍k-ê lâng ê hó hêng-ûi kā in pò-tap.

Choh chú-lâng--ê, mā tio̍h ēng kâng-khoán ê thài-tō͘ tùi-thāi lín ê lô͘-lē; m̄-thang kā in ui-hia̍p. Tio̍h chai, lín kap lín ê lô͘-lē lóng sio̍k kâng chi̍t ūi thiⁿ-téng ê Chú-lâng; I ēng kâng-khoán ê phiau-chún tùi-thāi ta̍k-ê lâng.
