Chòe-āu, góa khǹg lín tio̍h kap Chú kiat-liân, khò I ê tōa lêng-le̍k chòe kian-kiông ê lâng.
Tio̍h chhēng Siōng-tè só͘ sù choân-thò ê bú-chong, hō͘ lín khiā-chāi, thang tí-khòng Mô͘-kúi ê khúi-kè.

In-ūi lán m̄-sī kap ū-huih-ū-bah ê lâng teh kau-chiàn, sī kap thian-kài ê siâ-lêng, chiū-sī chit-ê o͘-àm sè-tāi ê ú-tiū thóng-léng-chiá, koân-le̍k-chiá, chiáng-koân-chiá teh kau-chiàn.

Só͘-í, tio̍h ēng Siōng-tè só͘ sù choân-thò ê bú-chong chong-pī ka-kī, thang tī siâ-ok ê ji̍t-chí ōe-tàng tí-khòng tùi-te̍k ê kong-kek, kian-chhî kàu-tóe chhî-siú tīn-tōe.
Só͘-í, tio̍h khiā-chāi, ēng chin-lí chòe tòa hâ, ēng chèng-gī chòe hō͘-heng-kah chhēng,
ēng chún-pī hó-sè ê hô-pêng ê hok-im chòe ôe chhēng.
Tio̍h put-sî ēng sìn-sim chòe tún-pâi, thang phah-hoa Siâ-ok-chiá siā--lâi hé ê chìⁿ.
Tio̍h ēng chín-kiù chòe thâu-khoe, ēng Sèng Sîn chòe kiàm, chiū-sī Siōng-tè ê ōe.
Tio̍h khò Sèng Sîn choân-sim kî-tó, siông-siông kî-kiû. Tio̍h put-sî kéng-séng, sî-siông ūi-tio̍h só͘-ū ê sìn-tô͘ kî-tó;
mā ūi-tio̍h góa kî-tó, kiû Siōng-tè sù góa sìn-sit, thang hó-táⁿ khui-chhùi soan-iông hok-im ê ò-pì.
Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê hok-im, góa hiān-chāi chòe chi̍t ê kòa thih-liān ê tāi-sài. Tio̍h ūi-tio̍h góa kî-tó, hō͘ góa thang hó-táⁿ soan-iông eng-kai kóng--ê.
Lán chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī, mā-sī Chú tiong-si̍t ê chhe-ēng Chhui-ki-kó͘, ōe pò lín chai góa ê tāi-chì kap kūn-hóng.
Góa chhe i khì lín hia, bo̍k-te̍k sī beh pò lín chai goán chia ê chêng-hêng, hō͘ lín ê sim tit-tio̍h kó͘-lē.
Goān Pē Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sù pêng-an, jîn-ài, kap sìn-sim hō͘ chèng hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē!
Goān Siōng-tè ê un-tián kap só͘-ū ēng put-piàn ê thiàⁿ lâi thiàⁿ lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê lâng tông-chāi!
Góa Pó-lô kap Thê-mô͘-thài sī Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê po̍k-jîn. Goán siá-phoe hō͘ tòa tī Hui-li̍p-pí, kap sio̍k Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ lóng-chóng ê sìn-tô͘ í-ki̍p kok-ūi kam-tok kap chip-sū.
Goān lán ê Pē Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sù lín un-tián kap pêng-an!
Góa ta̍k-piàn siūⁿ-tio̍h lín ê sî lóng kám-siā góa ê Siōng-tè;
ta̍k-piàn ūi-tio̍h lín chèng-lâng kî-tó ê sî lóng ēng hoaⁿ-hí ê sim kî-kiû,
in-ūi lín tùi thâu chi̍t ji̍t khí kàu hiān-chāi, lóng ū tâng-sim hia̍p-le̍k teh thoân hok-im.
Góa chhim-sìn hit-ūi tī lín tiong-kan khai-sí chòe bí-hó kang-chok ê Siōng-tè, ōe kè-sio̍k kā hit-ê kang-chok oân-sêng, ti̍t-kàu Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ koh-lâi ê Ji̍t.

Góa siông-siông teh siàu-liām lín, tùi lín chèng-lâng ū chit-khoán ê sim-chêng sī tong-jiân--ê, in-ūi bô-lūn góa hiān-chāi tī kaⁿ-ga̍k lāi á-sī í-chêng ūi-tio̍h hok-im piān-hō͘ kap choh-chèng ê sî, lín lóng ū kap góa hun-hióng Siōng-tè ê un-sù.
Góa ēng Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê thiàⁿ-sim jōa-ni̍h siàu-liām lín tāi-ke, Siōng-tè thang kā góa choh-chèng.
Góa só͘ kî-kiû--ê sī án-ni: Lín ê thiàⁿ ōe ná ke-thiⁿ, lín ê tì-sek kap tùi ta̍k-hāng ê phòaⁿ-toàn-le̍k mā ná chìn-pō͘,
hō͘ lín ōe-hiáu hun-pia̍t sím-mi̍h chiah sī siōng hó, án-ni tī Ki-tok ê Ji̍t lín chiah ōe chiâⁿ-chòe sûn-kiat bô thang hiâm ê lâng,
chhiong-móa khò Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok chiah ū ê hó tek-hēng, thang chiong êng-kng kap o-ló kui hō͘ Siōng-tè.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa ài lín chai, góa só͘ tú--tio̍h ê tāi-chì tian-tò hō͘ hok-im koh-khah chìn-tián,
tì-kàu ông-kiong ê choân-thé kéng-ōe í-ki̍p kî-tha só͘-ū ê lâng lóng chai-iáⁿ góa koaiⁿ-kaⁿ sī ūi-tio̍h Ki-tok ê iân-kò͘.
Chin chōe hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē mā in-ūi góa koaiⁿ-kaⁿ tī Chú lāi-bīn koh-khah khak-sìn, koh-khah hó-táⁿ bô kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ lâi thoân Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit.
Ū lâng thoân Ki-tok sī chhut tī oàn-tò͘ kap hò͘ⁿ cheng-lūn; mā ū lâng sī chhut tī hó ì-sù.
Chiah-ê lâng sī chhut tī thiàⁿ-sim, chai-iáⁿ góa siū jīm-bēng sī beh ūi hok-im piān-hō͘.
Lēng-gōa hiah-ê lâng soan-iông Ki-tok sī chhut tī iá-sim, tōng-ki bô sûn, siūⁿ-beh thàn góa koaiⁿ-kaⁿ ê sî ke-thiⁿ góa ê kan-khó͘.
Án-ni ū sím-mi̍h koan-hē? Sī ké-ì á-sī chin-sim, bô-lūn án-chóaⁿ, Ki-tok siū thoân-khui, góa chiū ūi-tio̍h án-ni hoaⁿ-hí! Tio̍h, góa beh kè-sio̍k hoaⁿ-hí,
in-ūi góa chai, tùi lín ê kî-tó kap Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê Sîn ê pang-chān, góa it-tēng ōe tit-tio̍h chū-iû.

Góa pek-chhiat kî-thāi kap ǹg-bāng--ê, chiū-sī bô chi̍t hāng tāi-chì ōe hō͘ góa kiàn-siàu; góa sî-sî-khek-khek, te̍k-pia̍t sī hiān-chāi, ū kàu-gia̍h ê ióng-khì, sī oa̍h á-sī sí, thang hō͘ Ki-tok thong-kè góa chit-ê lâng tit-tio̍h êng-iāu.
In-ūi, tùi góa lâi kóng, oa̍h sī Ki-tok, sí sī lī-ek.
Nā-sī kè-sio̍k oa̍h--teh ōe-tàng chòe khah chōe ū hāu-kó ê kang-chok, góa soah m̄ chai beh kéng sím-mi̍h.
Góa chìn-thè-lióng-lân. Góa si̍t-chāi chin ài lī-khui chit-ê sè-kan kap Ki-tok chòe-hé, che eng-kai ke hó chiok chōe.
Put-kò, ūi-tio̍h lín ê iân-kò͘, góa koh-khah tio̍h oa̍h--lo̍h-khì.
Tùi chit-hāng, góa khak-sìn; góa chai góa beh oa̍h--lo̍h-khì, beh kè-sio̍k kap lín tāi-ke oa̍h--lo̍h-khì, sī beh hō͘ lín ê sìn-gióng koh-khah chìn-pō͘, koh-khah ū hoaⁿ-hí,
án-ni góa kap lín koh saⁿ-kìⁿ ê sî, lín ōe in-ūi Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ū chhiong-hun ê lí-iû thang ēng góa chòe khoa-kháu.

Bô-lūn án-chóaⁿ, lín ê giân-hêng-kú-chí tio̍h hû-ha̍p Ki-tok ê hok-im. Án-ni, bô-lūn góa ōe-tàng koh khì kap lín saⁿ-kìⁿ á bōe, lóng ōe-tàng thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê tāi-chì, chai lín lóng ēng siâng chi̍t ê sim-chì khiā-chāi, tâng-sim chòe-hé ūi-tio̍h só͘ sìn ê hok-im phah-piàⁿ.
Bô-lūn chòe sím-mi̍h, m̄-bián kiaⁿ hoán-tùi-chiá ê ui-hia̍p, án-ni thang chèng-bêng in ōe sit-pāi, lín ōe tek-sèng; chit-ê tek-sèng sī tùi Siōng-tè lâi--ê.
In-ūi Siōng-tè m̄-nā ū sù lín te̍k-pia̍t ê un-hūi lâi sìn Ki-tok, mā hō͘ lín ūi-tio̍h Ki-tok siū-khó͘,
lâi chham-ú siâng-khoán ê cheng-chiàn; chit-ê cheng-chiàn lín ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa án-chóaⁿ chiàn, hiān-chāi koh thiaⁿ-kìⁿ góa iáu-teh chiàn.

Kì-jiân lín kap Ki-tok kiat-liân ū tit-tio̍h kek-lē; kì-jiân lín tùi I ê thiàⁿ ū tit-tio̍h an-ùi; kì-jiân lín kap Sèng Sîn ū thoân-khè; kì-jiân lín ū keng-giām Siōng-tè ê chû-pi lîn-bín;
lín tio̍h ū siâng-khoán ê sim-chì, siâng-khoán ê thiàⁿ-sim, hô-hâi ê kám-chêng, it-tì ê siūⁿ-hoat, thang hō͘ góa chhiong-móa hoaⁿ-hí.
M̄-thang chū-su-chū-lī, mā m̄-thang tui-kiû hu-êng; hoán-tńg tio̍h ū khiam-sùn ê sim, khòaⁿ pa̍t-lâng pí ka-kī khah gâu.
Lín ta̍k-ê lâng m̄-thang chí-ū kò͘ ka-kī ê tāi-chì, mā tio̍h kò͘ pa̍t-lâng ê tāi-chì.
Lín tio̍h ū Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê sim-chì:
I goân-pún ū Siōng-tè ê sin-hūn, khiok bô lām-iōng kap Siōng-tè pêng-téng ê tōe-ūi.
I hoán-tńg piàⁿ-khang ka-kī, chhú lô͘-po̍k ê sin-hūn, chhut-sì kap lâng kâng-khoán, ēng lâng ê hêng-thé chhut-hiān.
I chū-goān khiam-pi, sūn-ho̍k kàu sí, sīm-chì sí tī si̍p-jī-kè téng.
In-ūi án-ni, Siōng-tè thê-seng I kàu siōng-koân ê tōe-ūi, sù I chhiau-oa̍t bān miâ ê miâ-hō.
Án-ni, ūi-tio̍h kèng-tiōng Iâ-so͘ ê miâ, thiⁿ-téng, tōe-chiūⁿ, tōe-ē, it-chhè ê kha-thâu-u lóng ōe kūi-pài,
ta̍k-ê chhùi lóng soan-jīn, “Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sī Chú”, lâi êng-iāu Pē Siōng-tè.

Só͘-í, chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa tī lín hia ê sî, lín lóng ū sūn-thàn góa; hiān-chāi góa bô tī lín hia, lín koh-khah tio̍h án-ni. Tio̍h kè-sio̍k kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ngia̍uh-ngia̍uh-chhoah lâi oân-sêng lín ê tit-kiù;
in-ūi Siōng-tè sî-siông tī lín tiong-kan teh chòe kang, hō͘ lín ū ì-goān koh ōe si̍t-chián I ê hó chí-ì.
Bô-lūn chòe sím-mi̍h tāi-chì, lóng m̄-thang bâi-oàn á-sī cheng-lūn,
hō͘ lín thang chheng-pe̍k sûn-kiat, tī chit-ê siâ-ok hú-pāi ê sè-tāi choh Siōng-tè bô khoat-tiám ê kiáⁿ-jî. Tio̍h tī in tiong-kan hoat-kng, chhin-chhiūⁿ kng teh chiò sè-kan,
lâi kian-siú sù oa̍h-miā ê sìn-sit, hō͘ góa tī Ki-tok ê Ji̍t thang khoa-kháu kóng ka-kī bô khang-khang phun-pho, bô khang-khang lô-khó͘.
Góa nā tio̍h ēng ka-kī ê huih chòe tiān-chiú-chè lâm tī lín ê sìn-sim só͘ hiàn ê chè-mi̍h, góa mā hoaⁿ-hí, mā beh kap lín chòe-hé hoaⁿ-hí.
Siâng-khoán, lín mā tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí, kap góa hun-hióng hoaⁿ-hí.
Góa ǹg-bāng Chú Iâ-so͘ hō͘ góa ōe-tàng kín chhe Thê-mô͘-thài khì lín hia, hō͘ góa thang thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê siau-sit lâi tit-tio̍h kek-lē.
Chí-ū i ū kap góa tâng-sim chin-chiàⁿ teh koan-sim lín ê tāi-chì.
Chèng-lâng lóng teh tui-kiû ka-kī ê sū, m̄-sī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê sū.
M̄-kú Thê-mô͘-thài ê choh-lâng lín lóng chai, i kap góa chhin-chhiūⁿ pē kap kiáⁿ chòe-hé ūi-tio̍h thoân hok-im teh ho̍k-sāi.
Án-ni, góa chi̍t-ē chai góa ê tāi-chì ū sím-mi̍h kiat-kio̍k, ǹg-bāng ōe-tàng sûi-sî chhe i khì lín hia.
Góa khak-sìn Chú mā ōe hō͘ góa chin kín khì kìⁿ lín.
Put-kò, góa siūⁿ-kóng tio̍h chhe Í-pa-hut-thê khì lín hia; i sī góa ê hiaⁿ-tī, tâng-kang, kap chiàn-iú, tī góa su-iàu ê sî lín ū phài i lâi ho̍k-sāi góa.
I chin siàu-liām lín tāi-ke, mā in-ūi chai-iáⁿ lín ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h i phòa-pīⁿ ê tāi-chì, sim chin kan-khó͘.
I khak-si̍t ū phòa-pīⁿ, sīm-chì hiám sí--khì. M̄-kú Siōng-tè ū lîn-bín i, m̄-nā i nā-tiāⁿ, mā ū lîn-bín góa, hō͘ góa m̄-bián koh ke-thiⁿ iu-siong.
In-ūi án-ni, góa kóaⁿ-kín beh chhe i tńg-khì lín hia, hō͘ lín ōe-tàng koh kìⁿ-tio̍h i lâi hoaⁿ-hí, mā thang kiám-chió góa ê khòa-lū.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h tī Chú ê lāi-bīn hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí kā i chiap-la̍p. Tio̍h chun-tiōng chhin-chhiūⁿ i chit-khoán ê lâng,
in-ūi i ūi-tio̍h Ki-tok ê kang-chok mō͘ sìⁿ-miā ê gûi-hiám hiám-hiám-á sí, beh pó͘ lín chòe bô-kàu--ê, thòe lín lâi ho̍k-sāi góa.
Chòe-āu, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín tio̍h khò Chú lâi hoaⁿ-hí! Góa koh kóng-khí í-chêng só͘ siá--ê, tùi góa pèng bô mâ-hoân, tùi lín khiok ū pang-chān.
Tio̍h chù-ì hit tīn káu, chù-ì hiah-ê choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng, chù-ì hiah-ê ka-kī koah-siong seng-khu ê lâng.
Kî-si̍t, lán chiah sī chin-chiàⁿ siū kat-lé ê lâng. Lán thong-kè Sèng Sîn kèng-pài Siōng-tè, khoa-kháu Ki-tok Iâ-so͘, bô óa-khò gōa-piáu ê lé-gî.
Nā kóng beh óa-khò lé-gî, góa mā ōe; nā ū lâng siūⁿ-kóng i ōe-tàng óa-khò lé-gî, góa koh-khah ōe.

Góa chhut-sì tē-poeh ji̍t chiū siū kat-lé, sī Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng, sio̍k Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k, sī sûn-chhùi ê Hi-pek-lâi -lâng. Tùi siú Lu̍t-hoat lâi kóng, góa sio̍k Hoat-lī-sài-phài;
tùi jia̍t-sim lâi kóng, góa sī kàu-hōe ê pek-hāi-chiá; tùi siú Lu̍t-hoat lâi chiâⁿ-chòe gī ê phiau-chún lâi kóng, góa lóng bô sím-mi̍h thang hiâm.
M̄-kú, í-chêng tùi góa iú-lī--ê, hiān-chāi in-ūi Ki-tok ê iân-kò͘, góa kā i khòaⁿ-chòe sún-sit.

M̄-nā án-ni, góa chin-chiàⁿ khòaⁿ it-chhè chòe sún-sit, in-ūi góa khòaⁿ jīn-bat góa ê Chú Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ chòe siōng pó-pòe. Ūi-tio̍h I góa pàng-sak it-chhè, khòaⁿ bān-sū chòe pùn-sò, sī beh tit-tio̍h Ki-tok,

oân-choân kap I kiat-liân, bô koh ū hit-khoán khò ka-kī siú Lu̍t-hoat lâi tit--tio̍h ê gī. Góa hiān-chāi ū ê gī sī thong-kè sìn-khò Ki-tok, sī kun-kù sìn lâi tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè só͘ siúⁿ-sù ê gī.
Góa só͘ ài--ê sī jīn-bat Ki-tok koh thé-giām I koh-oa̍h ê tōa lêng-le̍k, kap I chòe-hé siū-khó͘, keng-giām I ê sí,
ǹg-bāng ka-kī mā ōe-tàng tùi sí koh-oa̍h.
Án-ni, m̄-sī kóng góa í-keng tit--tio̍h á-sī í-keng ta̍t-kàu bo̍k-phiau; góa kè-sio̍k ti̍t-ti̍t cháu, ǹg-bāng thang tit-tio̍h siúⁿ; kî-si̍t Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ í-keng tit-tio̍h góa.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa bô siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī í-keng tit--tio̍h. Góa chí-ū choan-sim chi̍t hāng, chiū-sī bōe-kì-tit āu-bīn ê sū, phah-piàⁿ tui-kiû thâu-chêng ê sū,
ǹg bo̍k-phiau ti̍t-ti̍t cháu, ūi-tio̍h beh tit-tio̍h siúⁿ, chiū-sī Siōng-tè thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ tiàu góa khì niá-siū hit-ê tùi téng-bīn lâi ê oa̍h-miā.
Só͘-í, lán tiong-kan sêng-se̍k ê lâng tio̍h ū siâng-khoán ê siūⁿ-hoat. Lín tiong-kan nā ū pa̍t-khoán ê siūⁿ-hoat, Siōng-tè mā ōe chiong chit-ê siūⁿ-hoat kā lín chí-sī.
Bô-lūn án-chóaⁿ, lán tio̍h chiàu í-keng cháu--kè-lâi ê lō͘-sòaⁿ kè-sio̍k chiân-chìn.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín lóng tio̍h o̍h góa; tio̍h chù-ì khòaⁿ hiah-ê tè goán ê bô͘-iūⁿ ê lâng án-chóaⁿ teh seng-oa̍h.
Góa í-keng ū kā lín kóng chin chōe piàn, hiān-chāi koh lâu ba̍k-sái kā lín kóng: Ū chin chōe lâng, in ê hêng-ûi hō͘ in chiâⁿ-chòe Ki-tok si̍p-jī-kè ê tùi-te̍k.
In ê kiat-kio̍k sī bia̍t-bông; in ēng pak-tó͘ chòe sîn-bêng; in chiong kiàn-siàu khòaⁿ-chòe kong-êng; in chí-ū koan-sim tōe-chiūⁿ ê sū.
M̄-kú, lán sī thiⁿ-téng ê kong-bîn, jia̍t-chhiat teh thèng-hāu tùi hia lâi ê Kiù-sè-chú, chiū-sī Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok.
I ōe ēng hō͘ bān-iú khut-ho̍k ê lêng-le̍k lâi kái-piàn lán pi-chiān ê thé, hō͘ lán pìⁿ-chòe kap I siâng-khoán êng-iāu ê thé.
Só͘-í, góa só͘ chhin-ài só͘ siàu-liām ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín sī góa ê hoaⁿ-hí, góa ê êng-kng, tio̍h óa-khò Chú lâi khiā-chāi.
Góa khó͘-khǹg Iú-a-tia̍p, mā khó͘-khǹg Sûn-to͘-ki, lín tī Chú ê lāi-bīn tio̍h tâng-sim.

Góa tiong-si̍t ê tâng-phōaⁿ ah, góa mā ài lí pang-chān chit nn̄g ê hū-jîn-lâng, in-ūi in kap Kek-lī-bián í-ki̍p góa kî-tha ê tâng-kang bat ūi-tio̍h hok-im kap góa chòe-hé hùn-tò͘; in ê miâ í-keng ū kì-chài tī oa̍h-miā-chheh.
Tio̍h sî-siông kap Chú kiat-liân lâi hoaⁿ-hí! Góa koh kóng chi̍t piàn, tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí!
Tio̍h hō͘ chèng-lâng khòaⁿ ōe chhut lín ê khoan-iông. Chú teh-beh lâi lah.
Lóng m̄-thang khòa-lū sím-mi̍h. Bān-sū tio̍h ēng kám-siā ê sim kî-kiû kap tāi-tó, chiong lín só͘ kiû--ê hō͘ Siōng-tè chai.
Án-ni, Siōng-tè só͘ sù chhiau-oa̍t lâng it-chhè liáu-kái ê pêng-an, ōe thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ pó-siú lín ê sim-su ì-liām.

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, chóng kóng chi̍t kù, hiah-ê ōe kiàn-li̍p hó tek-hēng ê sū, hiah-ê ta̍t-tit chheng-chàn ê sū, chiū-sī it-chhè chin-si̍t--ê, it-chhè thang chun-kèng--ê, it-chhè kong-chèng--ê, it-chhè sûn-kiat--ê, it-chhè khó-ài--ê, it-chhè thang o-ló--ê, chiah-ê lín lóng tio̍h put-sî khǹg tī sim-lāi.
Lín tùi góa só͘ ha̍k-si̍p koh chiap-siū--ê, thiaⁿ--tio̍h koh khòaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, chiah-ê lóng tio̍h kè-sio̍k si̍t-hêng. Án-ni, sù pêng-an ê Siōng-tè chiū ōe kap lín tông-chāi.

Góa tī Chú ê lāi-bīn hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí! In-ūi kè chi̍t tōaⁿ sî-kan liáu-āu, lín tùi góa ê koan-sim ū koh puh-íⁿ khui-hoe; kî-si̍t, lín ū teh kā góa koan-sim, put-kò sī bô ki-hōe thang piáu-sī nā-tiāⁿ.
M̄-sī kóng góa bô-kàu ēng, in-ūi góa í-keng o̍h ōe-hiáu bô-lūn tī sím-mi̍h kéng-gū lóng ti-chiok.

Góa chai án-chóaⁿ kè sàn-chhiah ê seng-oa̍h, mā chai án-chóaⁿ kè hù-jū ê seng-oa̍h. Sī pá á-sī iau, sī ū-chhun á-sī khiàm-kheh, góa í-keng tit-tio̍h pì-koat, chiū-sī bô-lūn sím-mi̍h sî-chūn sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, góa lóng ti-chiok.
Óa-khò sù góa lêng-le̍k ê Ki-tok, góa ū khùi-la̍t thang khek-ho̍k ta̍k-khoán ê kéng-gū.
M̄-kú, lín ū hun-tam góa ê khùn-lân, án-ni si̍t-chāi chin hó.
Lín Hui-li̍p-pí -lâng ka-kī mā lóng chai, tī góa thoân hok-im ê chho͘-kî, góa lī-khui Má-kî-tùn ê sî, chí-ū lín ê kàu-hōe ū hun-tam góa ê seng-oa̍h hùi-iōng.
Liân góa tī Thiap-sat-lô-nî-ka ê sî, lín ū kúi-nā piàn sàng mi̍h-kiāⁿ lâi kiong-kip góa ê su-iàu.
Góa m̄-sī ài lín sàng mi̍h-kiāⁿ, sī ài lín ū khah chōe ê lī-sûn kì ji̍p-khì lín ê hō͘-thâu.

Che sī lín hō͘ góa só͘-ū mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê siu-kù. Lín hō͘ góa--ê í-keng kàu-gia̍h koh ū-chhun. Góa ū tùi Í-pa-hut-thê siu-tio̍h lín sàng hō͘ góa ê lé-mi̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ hoat-chhut phang-bī, Siōng-tè só͘ chiap-la̍p hoaⁿ-hí ê chè-mi̍h.
Góa ê Siōng-tè ōe chiàu I êng-iāu ê hong-hù, thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ lâi boán-chiok lín só͘-ū ê su-iàu.
Goān êng-kng kui hō͘ lán ê Pē Siōng-tè, ti̍t-kàu éng-éng-oán-oán. Amen!
Chhiáⁿ thòe góa kā sio̍k Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê só͘-ū sìn-tô͘ chhéng-an. Kap góa tī chia ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē mā beh kā lín chhéng-an.
Tī chia só͘-ū ê sìn-tô͘, te̍k-pia̍t sī Khái-sat ông-kiong lāi ê sìn-tô͘, lóng beh kā lín chhéng-an.
Goān Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê un-tián kap lín tāi-ke tông-chāi!
Góa sī Pó-lô, hōng Siōng-tè ê chí-ì choh Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê sù-tô͘; góa kap lán ê hiaⁿ-tī Thê-mô͘-thài
siá-phoe hō͘ tòa tī Ko-lô-se ê sìn-tô͘, chiū-sī kap Ki-tok kiat-liân tiong-sìn ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē. Goān lán ê Pē Siōng-tè sù lín un-tián kap pêng-an!
Goán ūi-tio̍h lín kî-tó ê sî put-sî teh kám-siā lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê Pē Siōng-tè,
in-ūi ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín tùi Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ū sìn-sim, tùi só͘-ū ê sìn-tô͘ ū thiàⁿ-sim.
Chiah-ê lóng sī ēng hit-ê ūi-tio̍h lín khǹg tī thiⁿ-téng ê ǹg-bāng chòe kun-kù; chit-ê ǹg-bāng tong-chho͘ hok-im chin-tō thoân hō͘ lín ê sî, lín í-keng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h.

Chit-ê hok-im m̄-nā thoân kàu lín hia, mā thoân kàu choân sè-kài, kè-sio̍k sêng-tióng kiat ké-chí, tú kap lín í-chêng thiaⁿ--kìⁿ koh chin-chiàⁿ jīn-bat Siōng-tè ê un-tián hit-sî ê chêng-hêng kâng-khoán.
Lín ū tùi chhin-ài ê Í-pa-hut ha̍k-si̍p chit-ê hok-im; i kap goán pîⁿ-pîⁿ choh po̍k-jîn, ūi-tio̍h lín chòe Ki-tok tiong-si̍t ê chhe-ēng,
mā ū tùi goán kóng-khí Sèng Sîn hō͘ lín ū thiàⁿ-sim ê sū.

In-ūi án-ni, tùi thiaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê siau-sit í-āu, goán ū kè-sio̍k teh ūi-tio̍h lín kî-tó, kiû Siōng-tè hō͘ lín ōe-tàng tùi Sèng Sîn tit-tio̍h ta̍k-khoán ê tì-hūi kap lí-kái, chhiong-hun bêng-pe̍k I ê chí-ì,
giân-hêng-kú-chí chiàu Chú só͘ ài, hoān-sū hō͘ I hoaⁿ-hí, koh hō͘ lín chòe ta̍k-hāng hó-sū, kiat hó ké-chí, tùi Siōng-tè ê jīm-sek mā jú ke-thiⁿ.

Goān lín tùi I êng-iāu ê koân-lêng tit-tio̍h kàu-gia̍h ê khùi-la̍t, ū nāi-sim thang jím-siū it-chhè, koh ēng hoaⁿ-hí ê sim kám-siā Thiⁿ-pē, in-ūi I hō͘ lín ōe-kham-tit hun-hióng I ūi-tio̍h ka-kī ê sìn-tô͘ pó-liû tī kng-bêng Kok-tō͘ ê hok-khì.
I kiù lán thoat-lī o͘-àm ê koân-sè, kā lán sóa ji̍p-khì I só͘ thiàⁿ ê Kiáⁿ ê Kok-tō͘;
lán tùi I ê Kiáⁿ tit-tio̍h kiù-sio̍k, chōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Ki-tok sī khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h ê Siōng-tè ê hêng-siōng: I sī Tōa-kiáⁿ, pí it-chhè siū-chō--ê khah chá ū.

In-ūi Siōng-tè thong-kè I lâi chhòng-chō bān-iú, chiū-sī tī thiⁿ-téng kap tōe-chiūⁿ, khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h--ê kap khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h--ê, lêng-kài chē-ông-ūi--ê kap chú-chèng-chiá, thóng-léng-chiá kap chiáng-koân-chiá. Siōng-tè thong-kè I, iā ūi-tio̍h I, chhòng-chō bān-iú.
Iáu-bē ū bān-iú í-chêng I chiū chûn-chāi, bān-iú khò I liân-kiat hó-sè.

I sī kàu-hōe, chiū-sī I ê seng-khu ê thâu. I sī goân-sí, sī Tōa-kiáⁿ; Siōng-tè hō͘ I chiâⁿ-chòe thâu chi̍t ê tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h--ê, thang tī bān-iú tiong chiâⁿ-chòe tē-it.
In-ūi Siōng-tè chiàu ka-kī ê chí-ì, chiong ka-kī oân-chéng ê te̍k-sèng chhiong-móa tī I lāi-bīn.

Thong-kè I ê Kiáⁿ, Siōng-tè hō͘ bān-iú, bô-lūn tī thiⁿ-téng á-sī tōe-chiūⁿ, lóng kap I hô-hó; Siōng-tè thong-kè I ê Kiáⁿ tī si̍p-jī-kè téng lâu-huih sí lâi chhiok-sêng hô-pêng.
Lín leh, lín ū chi̍t sî kap Siōng-tè toān-choa̍t koan-hē, sim-su kap I te̍k-tùi, chòe pháiⁿ tāi-chì.

M̄-kú hiān-chāi, Siōng-tè í-keng thong-kè ka-kī ê Kiáⁿ jio̍k-thé ê sí, hō͘ lín kap I hô-hó, chiâⁿ-chòe sèng-kiat, bô khoat-tiám, bô thang hiâm ê chè-mi̍h hiàn tī I bīn-chêng.

Lín tio̍h kian-chhî sìn-gióng, kian-kò͘ khiā-chāi, hō͘ lín thiaⁿ-tio̍h hok-im ê sî só͘ tit--tio̍h ê ǹg-bāng bô tōng-iâu. Chit-ê hok-im í-keng thoân hō͘ thiⁿ-ē só͘-ū ê pī-chō-bu̍t; góa — Pó-lô chiū-sī chit-ê hok-im ê chhe-ēng.

Taⁿ góa ūi-tio̍h lín siū-khó͘ kám-kak chin hoaⁿ-hí; in-ūi góa jio̍k-thé ê siū-khó͘ sī teh oân-sêng Ki-tok ūi-tio̍h I ê seng-khu, chiū-sī kàu-hōe, siū iáu-bē liáu ê khó͘-lān.
Góa choh kàu-hōe ê chhe-ēng; góa tùi Siōng-tè niá-siū ê jīm-bū sī ūi-tio̍h lín, beh chiong I ê sìn-sit oân-choân thoân-khui.
Chit-ê sìn-sit sī le̍k-tāi í-lâi tùi jîn-lūi só͘ ún-ba̍t ê ò-pì, hiān-chāi í-keng tùi I ê sìn-tô͘ hián-bêng.

Siōng-tè beh hō͘ in chai-iáⁿ, I ūi-tio̍h Gōa-pang-lâng só͘ chún-pī ê ò-pì sī jōa-ni̍h hong-hù koh êng-iāu. Chit-ê ò-pì sī Ki-tok tī lín lāi-bīn, I sī lín hun-hióng Siōng-tè êng-iāu ê ǹg-bāng.

Só͘-í, goán tùi só͘-ū ê lâng soan-iông Ki-tok, ēng ta̍k-khoán ê tì-hūi lâi khoàn-kài koh kà-sī chèng-lâng, thang hō͘ só͘-ū tī Ki-tok lāi-bīn chiâⁿ-chòe sêng-se̍k ê lâng hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè.
Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê bo̍k-te̍k, góa khò Ki-tok tī góa lāi-bīn ūn-chok ê tōa lêng-le̍k chīn-la̍t teh phah-piàⁿ.
Ūi-tio̍h lín kap Ló-tí-ka -lâng, í-ki̍p só͘-ū iáu m̄-bat kìⁿ-tio̍h góa ê lâng, góa ài lín chai góa jōa-á-ni̍h teh phah-piàⁿ.

Góa ê bo̍k-te̍k sī ài in ê sim siū kó͘-lē, ēng thiàⁿ saⁿ kiat-liân, thang tit-tio̍h hong-hù ê lí-kái-le̍k, ū chhiong-hun ê khak-sìn lâi hiáu-ngō͘ Siōng-tè ê ò-pì, chiū-sī Ki-tok;
Siōng-tè ê tì-hūi kap tì-sek ê it-chhè pó-pòe lóng ún-chông tī I lāi-bīn.
Góa án-ni kóng sī ài lín bián hō͘ lâng ēng hoa-giân-kháu-gú kā lín chhōa-ji̍p bê-lō͘.
Sui-jiân góa lâng bô tī lín hia, sim khiok kap lín chòe-hé. Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lín ê seng-oa̍h kui-kui-kú-kú, tùi Ki-tok ê sìn-sim ū kian-tēng, kám-kak chin hoaⁿ-hí.
Kì-jiân lín ū chiap-siū Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ chòe Chú, chiū tio̍h kap I kiat-liân lâi seng-oa̍h,
chiàu lín só͘ siū ê kà-sī, tī I lāi-bīn tèng-kun siū khí-chō, sìn-sim tit-tio̍h kian-kò͘, chhiong-móa kám-siā.

Tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang hō͘ lâng ēng khong-tōng hu-ké ê tiat-ha̍k kā lín bê--khì, in-ūi hiah-ê ha̍k-soat sī kun-kù lâng ê thoân-soat kap chi-phòe ú-tiū ê lêng, m̄-sī kun-kù Ki-tok.
In-ūi Siōng-tè oân-chéng ê sîn-sèng tiàm tī khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h ê Ki-tok ê hêng-thé lāi-bīn,
hō͘ lín kap I kiat-liân chiâⁿ-chòe oân-chéng. I sī goân-siú, chhiau-oa̍t it-chhè lêng-kài ê thóng-léng-chiá kap chiáng-koân-chiá.
Lín mā í-keng ū chiap-siū kap Ki-tok liân-kiat ê kat-lé, m̄-sī ēng lâng ê chhiú, sī thong-kè Ki-tok ê kat-lé chiong lín chōe-sèng ê jio̍k-thé thǹg--khí-lâi.

Tùi sóe-lé, lín ū kap Ki-tok chòe-hé bâi-chòng; koh tùi sóe-lé, thong-kè sìn hō͘ Ki-tok tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè ê tāi-lêng, hō͘ lín mā kap I chòe-hé koh-oa̍h.

Lín í-chêng in-ūi hoān-chōe koh jio̍k-thé bô siū kat-lé, í-keng sí; m̄-kú hiān-chāi Siōng-tè í-keng hō͘ lín kap Ki-tok chòe-hé koh-oa̍h. Siōng-tè ū sià-bián lán it-chhè ê chōe-kò,
thiat-siau tùi lán put-lī koh ū hoat-lu̍t hāu-le̍k ê chioh-kù, kā i tèng tī si̍p-jī-kè téng, hō͘ i sit-hāu.
Siōng-tè ū kái-tû lêng-kài ê thóng-léng-chiá kap chiáng-koân-chiá ê koân-sè, hō͘ in tī Ki-tok khái-soân ê hâng-lia̍t tiong chòe chiàn-hoān sī-chiòng.
Só͘-í, m̄-thang tī lim-chia̍h, siú choeh-kî, chhoe-it, á-sī An-hioh-ji̍t ê būn-tôe hō͘ lâng phoe-phòaⁿ.
Chiah-ê put-kò sī chiong-lâi ê sū ê iáⁿ; Ki-tok chiah sī si̍t-thé.

M̄-thang siū hiah-ê ké khiam-pi, pài thiⁿ-sài ê lâng éng-hióng, hō͘ lín sit-khì èng-tit ê pò-siúⁿ. Hiah-ê lâng óa-khò hoàn-sióng, chiàu lâng ê siūⁿ-hoat, bô-kun-bô-kù chū-khoa chū-tāi,

kap Thâu — Ki-tok toān-choa̍t koan-hē. Tùi chit-ê Thâu, choân seng-khu thong-kè kun kap chat tit-tio̍h êng-ióng, hō͘-siōng liân-chiap, chiàu Siōng-tè ê chí-ì kè-sio̍k sêng-tióng.

Kì-jiân lín kap Ki-tok chòe-hé sí, thoat-lī chi-phòe ú-tiū ê lêng, ná iáu chhin-chhiūⁿ sio̍k chit sè-kan ê lâng teh seng-oa̍h, chun-siú “M̄-thang the̍h”, “M̄-thang chia̍h”, “M̄-thang bong” chit-khoán ê kìm-khī?
Chiah-ê put-kò sī lâng só͘ chō ê kàu-kui kap kà-sī, ēng-liáu chiū bô lō͘-ēng.
Pài thiⁿ-sài, ké khiam-pi, kap khó͘-chhó͘ seng-khu, khòaⁿ--khí-lâi ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ ū tì-hūi, kî-si̍t tùi khòng-chè jio̍k-thé ê chêng-io̍k lóng bô lō͘-ēng.
Kì-jiân lín í-keng kap Ki-tok chòe-hé koh-oa̍h, chiū tio̍h tui-kiû thiⁿ-téng ê sū, tī hia Ki-tok chē tī Siōng-tè ê chiàⁿ-pêng.
Lín tio̍h choan-sim tì-ì téng-bīn ê sū, m̄-sī tōe-chiūⁿ ê sū.
In-ūi lín í-keng sí, lín ê oa̍h-miā kap Ki-tok chòe-hé ún-chông tī Siōng-tè lāi-bīn.
Ki-tok sī lín ê oa̍h-miā; I hián-hiān ê sî, lín mā ōe kap I chòe-hé hián-hiān lâi hun-hióng I ê êng-iāu.
Só͘-í, tio̍h siau-bia̍t lín hiah-ê sio̍k-sè ê io̍k-bōng, chiū-sī îm-loān, ù-òe, siâ-chêng, siâ-io̍k, kap tham-loân — tham-loân sī pài ngó͘-siōng.
In-ūi chiah-ê sū, Siōng-tè ê siū-khì beh lîm-kàu pōe-ge̍k ê lâng.
Lín í-chêng thàn chiah-ê io̍k-bōng teh seng-oa̍h ê sî, giân-hêng-kú-chí mā siū in chi-phòe.
M̄-kú hiān-chāi lín tio̍h khì-sak siū-khì, pháiⁿ sèng-tē, oàn-hūn, húi-pòng, kap kóng lah-sap-ōe, téng.
M̄-thang hō͘-siōng khi-phiàn, in-ūi lín í-keng ū chiong kū ê lâng kap si̍p-koàn thǹg--khí-lâi,
chiong sin ê lâng chhēng--lo̍h-khì; chit-ê sin ê lâng, Chhòng-chō-chú chiàu ka-kī ê hêng-siōng kè-sio̍k teh kā i keng-sin, hō͘ lín thang chin-chiàⁿ bat I.

Án-ni, bô koh hun-pia̍t Hi-la̍h -lâng á-sī Iû-thài -lâng, siū kat-lé á-sī bô siū kat-lé, bī-khai-hòa, iá-bân, lô͘-lē á-sī chū-iû-jîn. M̄-kú Ki-tok sī it-chhè, iā tī it-chhè ê lāi-bīn.
Lín sī Siōng-tè só͘ kéng-soán ê chú-bîn, sī I só͘ thiàⁿ--ê, só͘-í tio̍h ēng lîn-bín, chû-ài, khiam-pi, un-jiû, kap nāi-sim chòe saⁿ chhēng--lo̍h-khì.
Lín tiong-kan nā ū kiù-hun, tio̍h hō͘-siōng khoan-iông, pí-chhú sià-bián; chhin-chhiūⁿ Chú ū sià-bián lín, lín mā tio̍h án-ni saⁿ sià-bián.
Chiah-ê í-gōa, tio̍h koh ke tha̍h thiàⁿ-sim, in-ūi thiàⁿ ōe hō͘ it-chhè liân-kiat, oân-choân hô-ha̍p.
Tio̍h hō͘ Ki-tok só͘ sù ê hô-pêng chi-phòe lín ê sim; ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lín ū chit-ê hô-pêng, lín siū kéng-tiàu chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t-thé. Lín koh tio̍h sî-siông kám-siā.

Tio̍h hō͘ Ki-tok ê ōe hong-hong-hù-hù tiàm tī lín lāi-bīn. Tio̍h ēng ta̍k-khoán ê tì-hūi hō͘-siōng kà-sī, pí-chhú khoàn-kài, chhiùⁿ si-phian, sèng-si, lêng-koa, tùi sim-tóe kám-siā o-ló Siōng-tè.
Lín bô-lūn chòe sím-mi̍h, kóng-ōe á-sī chòe tāi-chì, lóng tio̍h hōng Chú Iâ-so͘ ê miâ lâi chòe, thong-kè I lâi kám-siā Pē Siōng-tè.
Choh hū-jîn-lâng--ê, tio̍h sūn-ho̍k tiōng-hu, in-ūi che sī sìn Chú ê lâng ê pún-hūn.
Choh tiōng-hu--ê, tio̍h thiàⁿ hū-jîn-lâng, m̄-thang kā in pháiⁿ khoán-thāi.
Choh jî-lú--ê, ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì tio̍h sūn-ho̍k pē-bú, in-ūi che sī Chú só͘ hoaⁿ-hí--ê.
Choh lāu-pē--ê, m̄-thang kek jî-lú siū-khì, chiah bōe hō͘ in hoe-sim sit-chì.

Choh lô͘-lē--ê, ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì tio̍h sūn-ho̍k sè-chiūⁿ ê chú-lâng, m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ in hoaⁿ-hí chiah tī in bīn-chêng án-ni chòe, sī in-ūi kèng-ùi Chú sêng-sim chòe.
Lín bô-lūn chòe sím-mi̍h, tio̍h chīn-sim chòe, m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h lâng, sī ūi-tio̍h Chú chòe.
Tio̍h chai, Chú ōe kā lín pò-siúⁿ, hō͘ lín tùi I tit-tio̍h sán-gia̍p; lín teh ho̍k-sāi--ê sī Chú Ki-tok.
Choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng ōe siū pháiⁿ ê pò-èng, in-ūi Siōng-tè bōe phian-thāi lâng.
Choh chú-lâng--ê, tio̍h kong-pêng ha̍p-lí tùi-thāi lín ê lô͘-lē, lín chai, lín tī thiⁿ-téng mā ū chi̍t ūi Chú-lâng.
Tio̍h kè-sio̍k pek-chhiat kî-tó; kî-tó ê sî tio̍h kéng-séng, tio̍h kám-siā.
Mā tio̍h ūi-tio̍h goán kî-tó, kiû Siōng-tè hō͘ goán ū thoân sìn-sit ê ki-hōe, thang soan-iông Ki-tok ê ò-pì; góa sī ūi-tio̍h chit-ê chiah teh chē-kaⁿ.
Tio̍h ūi-tio̍h góa kî-tó, hō͘ góa ōe-tàng chiong eng-kai kóng ê ò-pì kóng chheng-chhó.
Tio̍h siān-iōng ki-hōe, tùi-thāi bī-sìn-chiá tio̍h ū tì-hūi.
Kóng-ōe put-sî tio̍h un-hô, chhin-chhiūⁿ ēng iâm tiâu-bī, chai-iáⁿ tio̍h án-chóaⁿ ìn-tap ta̍k-ê lâng.
Koan-hē góa it-chhè ê tāi-chì, chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī Chhui-ki-kó͘ ōe kā lín kóng; tī Chú ê kang-chok i kap góa chòe-hé choh po̍k-jîn, tiong-si̍t teh ho̍k-sāi.
Góa chhe i khì lín hia, sī ài pò lín chai goán chia ê chêng-hêng, hō͘ lín ê sim tit-tio̍h kó͘-lē.
O-nî-se-bô͘ ōe kap i chòe-hé khì; i sī lín hia ê lâng, sī tiong-si̍t koh chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī. In ōe chiong goán chia it-chhè ê tāi-chì pò lín chai.

Kap góa chòe-hé chē-kaⁿ ê A-lí-ta̍t-kó͘ beh kā lín chhéng-an; Pa-ná-pa ê piáu-sió-tī Má-khó mā beh kā lín chhéng-an. Koan-hē Má-khó, góa í-keng ū kā lín kau-tài, i khì ê sî tio̍h kā i chiap-thāi.

Hit-ê kiò-chòe Iû-sū-to͘ ê Iâ-so͘ mā beh kā lín chhéng-an. Tī Iû-thài -lâng sìn-tô͘ tiong chí-ū chit saⁿ ê lâng ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè-kok teh kap góa tâng-kang, in ū hō͘ góa chin tōa ê an-ùi.

Tùi lín hia lâi Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê po̍k-jîn Í-pa-hut beh kā lín chhéng-an. I sî-siông ūi-tio̍h lín pek-chhiat kî-tó, kiû Siōng-tè hō͘ lín khiā-chāi, choh sêng-se̍k ê lâng, khak-sìn Siōng-tè lóng-chóng ê chí-ì.
Góa thang chèng-bêng, i khak-si̍t ūi-tio̍h lín kap tòa tī Ló-tí-ka í-ki̍p Hi-la-pho-lí ê lâng sin-khó͘ chòe kang.
Chhin-ài ê i-seng Lō͘-ka kap Tí-má beh kā lín chhéng-an.
Chhiáⁿ lín thòe góa kā Ló-tí-ka ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē kap Lêng-hoat, í-ki̍p tī in tau teh chū-hōe ê kàu-hōe chhéng-an.
Chit-tiuⁿ phoe lín tha̍k liáu, tio̍h siat-hoat mā hō͘ Ló-tí-ka ê kàu-hōe tha̍k; lín mā tio̍h tha̍k Ló-tí-ka ê kàu-hōe choán hō͘ lín ê phoe.
Tio̍h kā A-ki-pò͘ kóng, “Lí só͘ niá-siū ho̍k-sāi Chú ê chit-bū it-tēng tio̍h oân-sêng.”
Góa Pó-lô chhin-pit kā lín chhéng-an. Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit góa teh chē-kaⁿ. Goān Siōng-tè ê un-tián kap lín tông-chāi!
Góa Pó-lô, Se-la, kap Thê-mô͘-thài siá-phoe hō͘ Thiap-sat-lô-nî-ka, sio̍k Pē Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê kàu-hōe. Goān lín tit-tio̍h un-tián kap pêng-an!
Goán sî-siông ūi-tio̍h lín tāi-ke kám-siā Siōng-tè, tī kî-tó tiong put-sî siūⁿ-tio̍h lín.

Goán tī lán ê Pē Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng siàu-liām lín khò sìn-sim só͘ chòe ê kang, chhut tī thiàⁿ-sim ê lô-khó͘, kap tùi lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê ǹg-bāng só͘ piáu-hiān ê kian-jím.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, goán chai, lín sī Siōng-tè só͘ thiàⁿ, só͘ kéng-soán--ê,

in-ūi goán thoân hok-im khì kàu lín hia, m̄-sī chí-ū ēng giân-gú, mā khò tōa lêng-le̍k kap Sèng Sîn, í-ki̍p tùi hok-im ū oân-choân ê khak-sìn. Chiàu lín só͘ chai, goán tī lín tiong-kan ê sî choh-lâng sím-mi̍h khoán, lóng sī ūi-tio̍h beh hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h lī-ek.
Koh lín ū o̍h goán mā ū o̍h Chú, sui-jiân tī chin chōe khó͘-lān tiong, lín iáu-kú ēng Sèng Sîn só͘ sù ê hoaⁿ-hí lâi niá-siū sìn-sit.
Tùi án-ni, lín chiâⁿ-chòe Má-kî-tùn kap A-kai-a choân-thé sìn-tô͘ ê bô͘-hoān.
In-ūi Chú ê sìn-sit sī tùi lín thoân-chhut, m̄-nā tī Má-kî-tùn kap A-kai-a, lín tùi Siōng-tè ê sìn mā thoân kàu ta̍k só͘-chāi, só͘-í m̄-bián goán koh kóng sím-mi̍h.
In ka-kī ū kóng-khí, goán tī lín hia ê sî jōa-ni̍h siū lín hoan-gêng, lín án-chóaⁿ lī-khui ngó͘-siōng kui-ǹg Siōng-tè, lâi sū-hōng oa̍h koh chin ê Siōng-tè,
thèng-hāu I ê Kiáⁿ tùi thiⁿ lâi; I hō͘ Iâ-so͘ tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, lâi chín-kiù lán thoat-lī beh lâi ê sím-phòaⁿ.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín ka-kī chai goán khì lín hia hóng-būn m̄-sī bô hāu-kó.

Lín chai goán khì lín hia í-chêng tī Hui-li̍p-pí sui-jiân siū-tio̍h pek-hāi kap bú-jio̍k, iáu-kú ū óa-khò lán ê Siōng-tè hó-táⁿ biān-tùi chin chōe chó͘-gāi, thoân Siōng-tè ê hok-im hō͘ lín.
Goán ê khoàn-bián m̄-sī chhut tī chhò-gō͘ á-sī bô sûn-chèng ê tōng-ki, mā m̄-sī beh phiàn lâng.

Kì-jiân Siōng-tè khòaⁿ goán ōe-kham--tit, chiong hok-im kau-thok goán, goán chiū chiàu án-ni kóng, m̄-sī beh hō͘ lâng hoaⁿ-hí, sī beh hō͘ kàm-chhat goán lāi-sim ê Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí.
Lín chai, goán m̄-bat tùi lín kóng phô͘-tháⁿ ê ōe, mā m̄-bat ū tham-sim ê liām-thâu, Siōng-tè ōe-tàng kā goán choh-chèng.
Goán mā m̄-bat tùi lâng, bô-lūn sī lín á-sī pa̍t-lâng, kiû êng-kng.
Sui-jiân choh Ki-tok ê sù-tô͘, goán pún-lâi thang iau-kiû lín chun-tiōng goán; m̄-kú goán tī lín tiong-kan ê sî un-jiû tùi-thāi lín, chhin-chhiūⁿ lin-bú teh io gín-á.
Kì-jiân goán hiah-ni̍h thiàⁿ-sioh lín, m̄-nā goān-ì kap lín hun-hióng Siōng-tè ê hok-im, liân goán ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā to kam-goān hō͘ lín, in-ūi lín sī goán só͘ thiàⁿ--ê.

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit goán ê sin-khó͘ kap lô-lo̍k; goán thoân Siōng-tè ê hok-im hō͘ lín ê sî, ūi-tio̍h bô ài ke-thiⁿ lín jīm-hô-lâng ê hū-tam, goán mî-ji̍t teh chòe kang.
Lín kap Siōng-tè ōe-tàng kā goán choh-chèng, tùi lín chiah-ê sìn-tô͘, goán ê choh-lâng jōa-ni̍h sûn-kiat, chèng-ti̍t, bô thang hiâm.
Lín chai goán tùi-thāi lín ta̍k-ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ lāu-pē tùi-thāi ka-kī ê jî-lú.
Goán khó͘-khǹg lín, kó͘-lē lín, khoàn-bián lín, ài lín ê giân-hêng-kú-chí ōe-tàng hû-ha̍p Siōng-tè ê chí-ì; I ū tiàu lín chìn-ji̍p I ka-kī ê Kok-tō͘ kap êng-iāu.

Goán mā ūi-tio̍h chit-ê iân-kò͘ siông-siông kám-siā Siōng-tè, in-ūi lín tùi goán thiaⁿ-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê ōe ê sî, bô kā i khòaⁿ-chòe sī lâng ê ōe, tian-tò khòaⁿ-chòe khak-khak-si̍t-si̍t sī Siōng-tè ê ōe; chit-ê ōe tī lín sìn-tô͘ tiong-kan teh ūn-chok.

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín ū tú-tio̍h tī Iû-thài -tōe Siōng-tè ê kàu-hōe, chiū-sī sio̍k Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê kàu-hōe só͘ tú--tio̍h ê tāi-chì. Lín siū-tio̍h ka-kī tông-pau ê pek-hāi, tú chhin-chhiūⁿ in ū siū-tio̍h Iû-thài -lâng ê pek-hāi.
Hiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng thâi-sí Chú Iâ-so͘ kap chèng sian-ti, mā pek-hāi goán. In hō͘ Siōng-tè bô hoaⁿ-hí, mā kap chèng-lâng chòe tùi-te̍k,

sīm-chì chó͘-tòng goán thoân hok-im hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng, hō͘ in thang tit-tio̍h kiù. Hiah-ê Iû-thài -lâng kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe, ti̍t-kàu chōe-ok koàn-boán. Chòe-āu Siōng-tè ê siū-khì lîm-kàu in sin-chiūⁿ.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, goán siū-pek chiām-sî kap lín hun-lī, put-kò sī seng-khu saⁿ-lī, sim khiok bô lī-khui. Goán jōa-ni̍h pek-chhiat ài koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h lín ê bīn.
Goán chin ài khì lín hia. Góa Pó-lô chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn siūⁿ-beh khì hóng-būn lín, m̄-kú Sat-tàn kā goán chó͘-tòng.
Lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ lâi-lîm ê sî, goán ê ǹg-bāng, hoaⁿ-hí, kap siōng khoa-kháu--ê sī sím-mi̍h? Kiám m̄-sī lín?
Lín si̍t-chāi sī goán ê êng-kng kap hoaⁿ-hí.
Só͘-í, goán tán bōe tiâu, koat-tēng kan-ta goán lâu tī Ngá-tián,
chiū chhe goán ê hiaⁿ-tī, mā-sī ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè thoân Ki-tok hok-im ê tâng-kang Thê-mô͘-thài, khì lín hia, lâi kó͘-lē lín, kian-kò͘ lín ê sìn-sim,
hō͘ lín tiong-kan bô lâng in-ūi só͘ tú--tio̍h ê khó͘-lān tì-kàu tōng-iâu. Lín ka-kī chai, lán tú-tio̍h khó͘-lān sī Siōng-tè ê an-pâi.
Goán iáu kap lín chòe-hé ê sî, ū seng kā lín kóng-khí goán ōe siū khó͘-lān, āu-lâi chin-chiàⁿ ū hoat-seng, che sī lín só͘ chai--ê.

In-ūi án-ni, góa tán bōe tiâu chiah chhe Thê-mô͘-thài khì lín hia, ài chai lín ê sìn-sim án-chóaⁿ, chiah bián lín siū Chhì-thàm-chiá bê-he̍k, tì-kàu goán tī lín tiong-kan ê lô-khó͘ lo̍k-khong.

Hiān-chāi Thê-mô͘-thài í-keng tùi lín hia tò--lâi, chiong koan-hē lín ê sìn-sim kap thiàⁿ-sim ê hó siau-sit pò goán chai, koh kā goán kóng lín sî-siông teh siàu-liām goán, ài kap goán kìⁿ-bīn, chhin-chhiūⁿ goán ài kap lín kìⁿ-bīn.
In-ūi án-ni, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, tī it-chhè ê hoān-lān kap khùn-khó͘ tiong goán ū tùi lín ê sìn-sim tit-tio̍h an-ùi.
Lín nā tùi Chú ū kian-kò͘ ê sìn-sim, goán chiah ōe-tàng kóng hiān-chāi ū chin-chiàⁿ teh oa̍h.
Goán tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng in-ūi lín lâi hoaⁿ-hí; tùi che it-chhè ê hoaⁿ-hí, goán tio̍h án-chóaⁿ kám-siā chiah ū kàu-gia̍h?
Goán mî-ji̍t pek-chhiat kî-kiû thang kìⁿ lín ê bīn, lâi pó͘-chiok lín sìn-sim ê su-iàu.
Goān lán ê Thiⁿ-pē Siōng-tè kap lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ kā goán khui-lō͘ thang khì lín hia.
Goān Chú hō͘ lín saⁿ-thiàⁿ kap thiàⁿ chèng-lâng ê sim it-ti̍t ke-thiⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ goán tùi lín ê thiàⁿ ū ná ke-thiⁿ.
Án-ni, I ōe hō͘ lín ê sim kian-kò͘, tī lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ kap I ê chèng sìn-tô͘ lâi-lîm ê sî, tī lán ê Pē Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng sèng-kiat, bô thang hiâm. Amen!

Chòe-āu, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, goán iáu ū ōe beh kā lín kóng, lín ū chiap-siū goán ê kà-sī, chai-iáⁿ tio̍h án-chóaⁿ seng-oa̍h chiah ōe hō͘ Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí, kî-si̍t lín ū chiàu án-ni teh seng-oa̍h. Put-kò goán hōng Chú Iâ-so͘ ê miâ khún-kiû koh khó͘-khǹg lín tio̍h ka-pē lô-le̍k.
In-ūi lín chai goán ū hōng Chú Iâ-so͘ ê miâ kā lín chí-sī sím-mi̍h.
Siōng-tè ê chí-ì sī ài lín sèng-kiat, bô îm-loān,
hō͘ lín ta̍k-ê lâng ōe-hiáu ēng sèng-kiat kap chū-chun ê sim khòng-chè ka-kī ê seng-khu,
bô chhin-chhiūⁿ m̄ bat Siōng-tè ê Gōa-pang-lâng teh hòng-chhiòng chêng-io̍k.

M̄-thang chhim-hāi, mā m̄-thang khi-hū tâng-sìn ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē. Goán í-keng ū kā lín kóng, mā ū giâm-giâm seng kā lín kéng-kò, “Chòe chit-khoán tāi-chì ê lâng, Chú ōe pò-èng.”
Siōng-tè m̄-sī ho͘-tiàu lán kè bô chheng-khì ê seng-oa̍h, sī ho͘-tiàu lán kè sèng-kiat ê seng-oa̍h.
Só͘-í, kū-choa̍t chit-ê kà-sī--ê, m̄-sī kū-choa̍t lâng, sī kū-choa̍t sù lín Sèng Sîn ê Siōng-tè.
Koan-hē hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē saⁿ-thiàⁿ ê sū, bô su-iàu goán siá sím-mi̍h hō͘ lín, in-ūi lín ka-kī í-keng siū-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê kà-sī ài hō͘-siōng saⁿ-thiàⁿ.
Kî-si̍t, lín ū chiàu chit-ê kà-sī tùi-thāi choân Má-kî-tùn ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē. M̄-kú, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, goán khó͘-khǹg lín tio̍h ka-pē lô-le̍k.
Chiàu goán í-chêng só͘ hoan-hù, lín tio̍h li̍p-chì kè an-chēng ê seng-oa̍h, chīn ka-kī ê pún-hūn chhin-chhiú chòe kang.
Án-ni lín chiū ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h hōe-gōa ê lâng ê chun-kèng, bô su-iàu khò pa̍t-lâng pang-chān.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, koan-hē í-keng sí--khì ê lâng, goán ài lín chai, chiah bián chhin-chhiūⁿ hiah-ê bô ǹg-bāng ê lâng án-ni teh pi-siong.
Kì-jiân lán sìn Iâ-so͘ ū sí, ū koh-oa̍h, só͘-í lán mā sìn Siōng-tè ōe thong-kè Iâ-so͘ chhōa hiah-ê í-keng sí--khì ê lâng kap I chòe-hé lâi.

Goán chiàu Chú ê ōe kā lín kóng chit-ê sū, chiū-sī lán chiah-ê tī Chú lâi-lîm ê sî iáu oa̍h--teh ê lâng, bōe pí hiah-ê í-keng sí--khì ê lâng khah tāi-seng kìⁿ-tio̍h Chú.

Bēng-lēng chi̍t-ē chhut, thiⁿ-sài-tiúⁿ ê siaⁿ chi̍t-ē hoah, Siōng-tè ê lat-pah chi̍t-ē hiáng, Chú pún-sin chiū ōe tùi thiⁿ-téng kàng-lîm, hiah-ê sí í-chêng í-keng sìn Ki-tok ê lâng ōe tāi-seng koh-oa̍h,
jiân-āu lán chiah-ê iáu oa̍h--teh ê lâng lóng ōe kap in chòe-hé siū chiap-khì hûn-lāi, tī khong-tiong kap Chú saⁿ-kìⁿ. Án-ni, lán chiū ōe it-ti̍t kap Chú chòe-hé.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h ēng chiah-ê ōe hō͘-siōng kó͘-lē.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, koan-hē chit-ê tāi-chì hoat-seng ê sî kap kî, bô su-iàu siá-phoe kā lín kóng,
in-ūi lín ka-kī chai Chú ê Ji̍t ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chha̍t-á àm-sî thau-thau-á lâi.
Lâng teh kóng “pêng-an bô-sū” ê sî, chai-lān chhin-chhiūⁿ sán-hū chhui-chūn ê thàng-thiàⁿ hut-jiân lîm-kàu in, bô hoat-tō͘ thang tô-pī.
M̄-kú, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín m̄-sī tī o͘-àm tiong, hit-ê Ji̍t bōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chha̍t-á hut-jiân lâi.
In-ūi lín lóng sī kng-bêng ê lâng, sī ji̍t--sî ê lâng; lán m̄-sī sio̍k mî--sî, m̄-sī sio̍k o͘-àm.
Só͘-í, lán m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ kî-tha ê lâng teh khùn, tio̍h chhíⁿ-chhíⁿ, tio̍h kín-sīn.
In-ūi khùn ê lâng lóng sī àm-sî teh khùn; chiú-chùi ê lâng sī àm-sî teh chùi.
Kì-jiân lán sī sio̍k ji̍t--sî ê lâng, tio̍h kín-sīn, ēng sìn-sim kap thiàⁿ-sim chòe hō͘-heng-kah chhēng, ēng tit-kiù ê ǹg-bāng chòe thâu-khoe tì.
Siōng-tè bô an-pâi lán tio̍h siū hêng-hoa̍t, sī beh hō͘ lán thong-kè Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok lâi tit-tio̍h kiù.
Ki-tok thòe lán sí, sī beh hō͘ lán bô-lūn sī sí á-sī oa̍h, lóng ōe-tàng kap I chòe-hé oa̍h.
Só͘-í, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín hiān-chāi án-ni, tio̍h kè-sio̍k hō͘-siōng kó͘-lē, pí-chhú chō-chiū.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, chhiáⁿ lín tio̍h kèng-tiōng tī lín tiong-kan teh tio̍h-bôa, mā-sī Chú kéng-soán lâi chí-tō kap khoàn-bián lín hiah-ê lâng.
Koh tio̍h in-ūi in só͘ chòe ê kang, ēng siōng-tōa ê kèng-ì kap thiàⁿ-sim tùi-thāi in. Lín ka-kī tio̍h hô-bo̍k siong-chhù.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, goán khó͘-khǹg lín tio̍h kéng-kài pîn-tōaⁿ ê lâng, bián-lē bô-táⁿ ê lâng, pang-chān loán-jio̍k ê lâng; tùi chèng-lâng tio̍h khoan-iông.
Lín tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang ēng pháiⁿ pò pháiⁿ, tio̍h put-sî ūi-tio̍h pí-chhú í-ki̍p só͘-ū ê lâng chòe hó-sū.
Tio̍h put-sî hoaⁿ-hí;
tio̍h kè-sio̍k kî-tó;
bô-lūn sím-mi̍h kéng-gū lóng tio̍h kám-siā; in-ūi che sī Siōng-tè só͘ ì-ài, ài lín chiah-ê sio̍k Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê lâng án-ni chòe.
M̄-thang phah-hoa Sèng Sîn ê hé;
m̄-thang biáu-sī sian-ti ê ōe.
Sū-sū tio̍h chhat-giām; hó--ê tio̍h chhî-siú,
it-chhè ê siâ-ok tio̍h khì-sak.
Goān sù pêng-an ê Siōng-tè chhin-sin kā lín oân-choân sèng-hòa, hō͘ lín ê lêng, hûn, kap thé tī lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok lâi-lîm ê sî tit-tio̍h pó-choân, bô thang hiâm!
Ho͘-tiàu lín ê Siōng-tè sī sìn-si̍t, I it-tēng ōe oân-sêng chit-ê sū.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, chhiáⁿ ūi-tio̍h goán kî-tó.
Tio̍h chin-sêng kā lóng-chóng ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē chhéng-an.
Goán hōng Chú ê miâ hoan-hù lín tio̍h tha̍k chit-tiuⁿ phoe hō͘ chèng hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē thiaⁿ.
Goān lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê un-tián kap lín tông-chāi!
Góa Pó-lô, Se-la, kap Thê-mô͘-thài siá-phoe hō͘ Thiap-sat-lô-nî-ka sio̍k lán ê Pē Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê kàu-hōe.
Goān lín tùi lán ê Pē Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tit-tio̍h un-tián kap pêng-an!

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, goán eng-kai put-sî ūi-tio̍h lín kám-siā Siōng-tè; án-ni chòe sī tong-jiân, in-ūi lín ê sìn-sim ū tōa chìn-pō͘, lín chèng-lâng ê saⁿ-thiàⁿ mā it-ti̍t teh ke-thiⁿ.
Só͘-í goán tī Siōng-tè ê chèng kàu-hōe tiong ēng lín chòe khoa-kháu, in-ūi lín siū it-chhè ê pek-hāi kap jím-siū hoān-lān ê sî iáu pó-chhî kian-jím kap sìn-sim.
Che chèng-si̍t Siōng-tè phòaⁿ-tēng lín ōe-kham-tit sêng-siū Siōng-tè-kok sī kong-tō, lín chiū-sī ūi-tio̍h chit-ê teh siū-khó͘.
Kì-jiân Siōng-tè sī kong-tō, I ōe ēng chai-lān pò-èng hiah-ê hō͘ lín tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê lâng,

mā hō͘ lín chiah-ê tú-tio̍h chai-lān ê lâng, tī Chú Iâ-so͘ kap I ū tōa lêng-le̍k ê thiⁿ-sài tī hé-iām tiong tùi thiⁿ hián-hiān ê sî, thang kap goán pîⁿ-pîⁿ tit-tio̍h an-hioh. Hit-sî, I ōe hêng-hoa̍t hiah-ê m̄ jīn Siōng-tè kap m̄ sūn-thàn lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ ê hok-im ê lâng.
In ōe siū éng-oán húi-bia̍t ê hêng-hoa̍t, lī-khui Chú ê bīn-chêng, kap I êng-kng ê khùi-la̍t keh-tn̄g.

I lâi-lîm ê sî ōe tùi I ê sìn-tô͘ tit-tio̍h êng-kng, koh tùi só͘-ū sìn I ê lâng tit-tio̍h chun-chông. Tī hit-ji̍t lín mā ōe tī in tiong-kan, in-ūi lín ū sìn goán tùi lín só͘ chòe ê kiàn-chèng.

Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê bo̍k-te̍k, goán put-sî teh ūi-tio̍h lín kî-tó, khún-kiû lán ê Siōng-tè hō͘ lín ê seng-oa̍h ōe hû-ha̍p I ê ho͘-tiàu, mā sù lín khùi-la̍t lâi si̍t-hiān it-chhè siān-liông ê sim-ì kap sìn-sim ê chok-ûi,
thang hō͘ lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ ê miâ tī lín tiong-kan tit-tio̍h êng-kng, lín mā tùi I tit-tio̍h êng-kng; che lóng sī lán ê Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê un-tián.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, koan-hē lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê lâi-lîm kap lán siū chū-chi̍p khì I hia ê sū, goán iau-kiû lín,
nā ū thiaⁿ lâng kóng goán tī ū-giân, káng-tō, á-sī tī phoe--ni̍h ū kóng-khí “Chú ê Ji̍t kàu” ê sî, lín ê sim m̄-thang tōng-iâu á-sī kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.

Lâng bô-lūn ēng sím-mi̍h hong-hoat, lín lóng m̄-thang hō͘ in phiàn--khì, in-ūi tī hit-ji̍t kàu í-chêng it-tēng seng ū pōe-kàu ê sū, mā ū put-hoat ê lâng, chiū-sī chù-tiāⁿ bia̍t-bông ê lâng, ōe chhut-hiān.
Chit-ê te̍k-tùi-chiá thê-ko ka-kī, chhiau-kè it-chhè chheng-chòe sîn-bêng á-sī kèng-pài ê tùi-siōng, khì chē tī Siōng-tè ê tiān, chū-chheng chòe Siōng-tè.
Chit-ê tāi-chì, góa iáu kap lín chòe-hé ê sî bat kā lín kóng, lín kiám bōe-kì--tit?
Lín lóng chai, hiān-chāi sī sím-mi̍h teh khian-chè hit-ê Put-hoat-chiá; i ê sî nā kàu, i ōe chhut-hiān.
In-ūi hit-ê sîn-pì ê put-hoat sè-le̍k í-keng teh ūn-chok, put-kò tio̍h thèng-hāu kàu teh khian-chè i ê sè-le̍k sóa-khui hit-sî chiah ōe hoat-seng.
Hit-sî Put-hoat-chiá ōe chhut-hiān; Chú Iâ-so͘ ōe ēng tùi I ê chhùi thò͘--chhut-lâi ê khùi kā i thâi-sí, ēng I lâi-lîm ê sî hián-hiān ê êng-kng kā i siau-bia̍t.
Put-hoat-chiá lâi-lîm ê sî ōe ēng Sat-tàn ta̍k-khoán ê koân-lêng kiâⁿ ké sîn-jiah kap kî-sū,
koh tùi bia̍t-bông ê lâng kiâⁿ ta̍k-khoán siâ-ok ê phiàn-su̍t, in-ūi in kū-choa̍t khì ài ōe hō͘ in tit-kiù ê chin-lí.
Ūi-tio̍h án-ni, Siōng-tè hō͘ in sán-seng kiông-lia̍t ê chhò-kak khì siong-sìn hu-ké,
tì-kàu it-chhè m̄ sìn chin-lí, ì-ài put-gī ê lâng lóng siū tēng-chōe.

Chú só͘ thiàⁿ ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, goán eng-kai put-sî ūi-tio̍h lín kám-siā Siōng-tè, in-ūi I tùi khí-thâu chiū kéng-soán lín lâi tit-kiù, tùi Sèng Sîn hō͘ lín chiâⁿ-chòe sèng-kiat ê chú-bîn, koh hō͘ lín khak-sìn chin-lí.
Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê, Siōng-tè thong-kè goán só͘ thoân ê hok-im ho͘-tiàu lín lâi niá-siū lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê êng-kng.
Só͘-í, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, tio̍h khiā-chāi, tio̍h kian-siú goán só͘ kà-sī ê thoân-thóng, bô-lūn sī ēng chhùi kóng--ê á-sī ēng phoe siá--ê, lóng tio̍h kian-siú.
Goān lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok pún-sin kap thiàⁿ lán ê Pē Siōng-tè tùi I ê un-tián, sù lán éng-oán ê an-ùi kap bí-hó ê ǹg-bāng,
lâi an-ùi lín ê sim, hō͘ lín ū khùi-la̍t thang chòe ta̍k-hāng hó-sū, kóng ta̍k-hāng hó-ōe.

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, goán iáu ū ōe beh kā lín kóng. Chhiáⁿ lín ūi-tio̍h goán kî-tó, hō͘ Chú ê sìn-sit ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ tī lín tiong-kan án-ni chin kín thoân-khui koh tit-tio̍h êng-kng.
Mā chhiáⁿ lín kî-kiû Siōng-tè hō͘ goán ōe-tàng thoat-lī choh-ok-choh-to̍k ê lâng, in-ūi m̄-sī ta̍k-ê lâng lóng ū sìn.
Chú sī khó-khò--ê; I ōe hō͘ lín kian-kò͘, ōe pó-siú lín thoat-lī hit-ê Siâ-ok-chiá.
Chú hō͘ goán tùi lín ū sìn-sim, siong-sìn goán kau-tài lín ê tāi-chì, lín hiān-chāi ū teh chòe, āu-lâi mā ōe chòe.
Goān Chú ín-chhōa lín, hō͘ lín ha̍k-si̍p Siōng-tè ê thiàⁿ kap Ki-tok ê thun-lún!

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, goán hōng Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ bēng-lēng lín, nā ū sìn-tô͘ seng-oa̍h sàn-bān pîn-tōaⁿ, bô chun-siú goán thoân-siū hō͘ in ê kà-sī, lín tio̍h siám-khui.
Lín ka-kī mā chai lín eng-kai tio̍h án-chóaⁿ o̍h goán, in-ūi goán tī lín tiong-kan ê sî bô sàn-bān pîn-tōaⁿ.
Goán m̄-bat pe̍h-chia̍h pa̍t-lâng ê pn̄g; hoán-tńg mî-ji̍t thoa-bôa lô-khó͘, chiah bián chiâⁿ-chòe lín ê hū-tam.
Goán án-ni chòe, m̄-sī kóng goán bô koân thang iau-kiû kiong-èng, sī ài ēng goán ka-kī chòe lín ê bô͘-iūⁿ, hō͘ lín thang o̍h goán ê khoán-sit.
Goán tī lín hia ê sî bat bēng-lēng lín kóng, “M̄-khéng choh-kang ê lâng m̄-thang chia̍h.”
Goán án-ni kóng, sī in-ūi goán ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ lín tiong-kan ū lâng pîn-tōaⁿ m̄ chòe kang, chí-ū ài chhap lâng ê êng-á-sū.
Chit-khoán lâng, goán hōng Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ kā in kéng-kò, bēng-lēng in tio̍h an-hūn chòe kang, ka-kī thó-thàn.
M̄-kú, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, chòe hó-sū m̄-thang siūⁿ-siān.
Nā ū lâng m̄-khéng ho̍k-chiông goán tī chit-tiuⁿ phoe só͘ hoan-hù ê ōe, tio̍h kā i kì--teh, m̄-thang kap i lâi-óng, hō͘ i kám-kak kiàn-siàu;
put-kò m̄-thang kā i khòaⁿ-chòe tùi-te̍k, tio̍h khòaⁿ i chòe hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē kā i khoàn-bián.
Goān sù pêng-an ê Chú put-sî ēng ta̍k-khoán hong-hoat chhin-sin sù lín pêng-an! Goān Chú kap lín tāi-ke tông-chāi!
Góa Pó-lô chhin-pit kā lín chhéng-an. Góa tī ta̍k-tiuⁿ phoe lóng ū án-ni chhiam-miâ. Góa lóng án-ni siá.
Goān lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê un-tián kap lín tāi-ke tông-chāi!
Góa sī Pó-lô, chiàu lán ê Kiù-chú Siōng-tè kap chòe lán ǹg-bāng ê Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê bēng-lēng, góa choh Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê sù-tô͘,
siá-phoe hō͘ Thê-mô͘-thài, sìn-gióng siōng góa chin ê kiáⁿ. Goān Pē Siōng-tè kap lán ê Chú Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ sù lí un-tián, lîn-bín, kap pêng-an!
Góa beh khì Má-kî-tùn ê sî, ū khǹg lí tio̍h lâu tī Í-hut-só͘, thang bēng-lēng chi̍t-kóa lâng m̄-thang thoân pa̍t-khoán kàu-gī,

mā m̄-thang lōng-hùi cheng-sîn tī bô-iáⁿ-chiah ê thoân-soat kap lò-lò-tn̂g ê cho̍k-phó͘, in-ūi chiah-ê chí-ū ōe ín-khí piān-lūn, bōe pang-chān lâng ēng sìn liáu-kái Siōng-tè ê kè-ōe.
Chit-ê bēng-lēng ê bo̍k-te̍k sī beh tit-tio̍h jîn-ài; chit-ê jîn-ài sī tùi chheng-khì ê sim, chheng-pe̍k ê liông-sim, kap sûn-chin ê sìn sán-seng--ê.
Ū lâng tùi chiah-ê phian-lī, sit-bê tī khang-hu ê tâm-lūn.
In liân ka-kī só͘ kóng só͘ chú-tiuⁿ--ê to bô lí-kái, koh siūⁿ-beh choh lu̍t-hoat-kàu-su.
Lán chai, lâng nā chèng-khak sú-iōng Lu̍t-hoat, Lu̍t-hoat sī hó.

Lán mā chai, Lu̍t-hoat ê chè-tēng m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h chèng-ti̍t ê lâng, sī ūi-tio̍h put-hoat kap bô sūn-ho̍k, bô kèng-khiân kap hoān-chōe, bô sèng-kiat kap tham-loân sè-sio̍k, thâi-sí pē-bú kap thâi-sí lâng,
îm-loān, hò͘ⁿ lâm-sek, koái-iú lâng, kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, choh gūi-chèng, á-sī ûi-hoán kiān-choân ê kàu-gī chit-lūi ê lâng.
Chit-ê kiān-choân ê kàu-gī hû-ha̍p eng-kai tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn ê Siōng-tè só͘ kau-thok góa hit-ê êng-kng ê hok-im.
Góa kám-siā hō͘ góa khùi-la̍t ê lán ê Chú Ki-tok Iâ-so͘, in-ūi I khòaⁿ góa chòe thang sìn-jīm, chí-phài góa chòe chhe-ēng.
Sui-jiân í-chêng góa pòng-to̍k, pek-hāi, koh kā I bú-jio̍k, iáu-kú tit-tio̍h lîn-bín, sī in-ūi góa iáu-bē sìn m̄-bat ê sî chiah án-ni chòe.
Lán ê Chú sù góa hong-sēng kàu móa--chhut-lâi ê un-tián, hō͘ góa tit-tio̍h kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-liân chiah ū ê sìn kap thiàⁿ.
“Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ lîm-kàu sè-kan sī beh chín-kiù chōe-jîn” chit-kù ōe thang siong-sìn, ta̍t-tit oân-choân chiap-siū. Chōe-jîn tiong góa sī tē-it pháiⁿ--ê.

M̄-kú góa tit-tio̍h lîn-bín sī in-ūi Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok beh ēng góa chit-ê tē-it pháiⁿ ê lâng lâi hián-bêng I bû-hān ê nāi-sim, thang chòe āu-lâi sìn Iâ-so͘ lâi tit-tio̍h éng-oa̍h ê lâng ê bô͘-iūⁿ.
Goān chun-kùi, êng-kng kui tī bān-sè ê Kun-ông, éng-oán chûn-chāi, khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h, to̍k-it-bû-jī ê Siōng-tè, ti̍t-kàu éng-éng-oán-oán. Amen!

Góa ê kiáⁿ Thê-mô͘-thài ah, chiàu í-chêng koan-hē lí só͘ kóng ê ū-giân, góa chiong chit-ê bēng-lēng kau-thok lí, hō͘ lí thang ēng chiah-ê ū-giân khì cheng-chiàn eng-kai iâⁿ ê chiàn-cheng.
Lí tio̍h chhî-siú sìn-sim kap chheng-pe̍k ê liông-sim. Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng pàng-sak liông-sim, tì-kàu sìn-sim chhin-chhiūⁿ chûn khò-chhián,
kî-tiong ū Su-bí-nái kap A-le̍k-san-tāi; góa í-keng chiong in kau hō͘ Sat-tàn, hō͘ in siū kà-sī bô koh pòng-to̍k Siōng-tè.

Só͘-í, tē-it, góa khoàn-bián lí tio̍h ūi-tio̍h só͘-ū ê lâng, kun-ông, kap lóng-chóng ê koaⁿ-oân khún-kiû, kî-tó, tāi-tó, kám-un, hō͘ lán thang kè pêng-chēng an-jiân ê seng-oa̍h, hoān-sū kèng-khiân, toan-chèng.
Án-ni chòe sī eng-kai, sī lán ê Kiù-chú Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí chiap-la̍p--ê.
I ài chèng-lâng tit-kiù, ta̍t-kàu jīn-bat chin-lí.
In-ūi Siōng-tè sī chi̍t ūi, Siōng-tè kap lâng tiong-kan ê tiong-kan-jîn mā-sī chi̍t ūi, chiū-sī choh-lâng ê Ki-tok Iâ-so͘.
I hiàn pún-sin lâi sio̍k-hôe chèng-lâng, chit-hāng sū tī tú-hó ê sî-ki ū tit-tio̍h chèng-si̍t.

Ūi-tio̍h án-ni, góa siū jīm-bēng chòe thoân-tō-chiá, sù-tô͘, kap Gōa-pang-lâng ê kàu-su, hō͘ in siong-sìn Siōng-tè koh jīn-bat chin-lí. Góa teh kóng--ê sī chin--ê, m̄-sī ké--ê.
Góa ài ta-po͘-lâng bô siū-khì, bô cheng-lūn, tī ta̍k só͘-chāi gia̍h-khí sèng-kiat ê chhiú kî-tó.
Góa mā ài hū-jîn-lâng chhēng-chhah toan-chong phok-sò͘ chéng-chôe, m̄-thang ēng kî-hêng-koài-chōng ê thâu-mn̂g-hêng, kim-khì, chu-pó, á-sī chin kùi ê saⁿ chng-thāⁿ ka-kī;
tio̍h ēng hó hêng-ûi chòe chng-thāⁿ, piáu-sī ka-kī sī kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê hū-jîn-lâng.
Hū-jîn-lâng tio̍h tiām-tiām-á o̍h, ēng sūn-chiông ê sim sū-sū sūn-ho̍k.
Góa m̄-chún hū-jîn-lâng kà-sī á-sī koán-hat ta-po͘-lâng; i tio̍h an-chēng.
In-ūi A-tong tāi-seng siū chō, āu-lâi chiah Hā-oa.
Koh A-tong bô siū iú-he̍k, m̄-kú hū-jîn-lâng siū iú-he̍k hām-lo̍h chōe.
Put-kò hū-jîn-lâng nā an-hūn siú-kí, chhî-siú sìn-gióng, jîn-ài, kap sèng-kiat, chiū ōe in-ūi siⁿ-kiáⁿ tit-tio̍h kiù.
Chit-kù ōe thang siong-sìn: Nā ū lâng ài choh kam-tok, i sī him-bō͘ bí-hó ê kang-chok.
Só͘-í, kam-tok tio̍h bô thang hiâm, chí-ū chi̍t ê bó͘, an-hūn siú-kí, chū-chè, toan-chèng, gâu khoán-thāi chhut-gōa-lâng, gâu kà-sī;
bô chiú-chùi, bô hiong-pō, hoán-tńg ài un-hô, bô saⁿ-chiⁿ, bô tham-châi,
gâu koán-lí ka-kī ê ka-têng, kiáⁿ-jî ū sūn-ho̍k, sū-sū toan-chong.
Lâng nā bōe-hiáu koán-lí ka-kī ê ka-têng, ná ōe-hiáu koàn-kò͘ Siōng-tè ê kàu-hōe?
Chho͘-sìn-chiá m̄-thang hō͘ i tam-jīm kam-tok, chiah bōe chū-ko chū-tāi, hām-lo̍h kap Mô͘-kúi só͘ siū kâng-khoán ê sím-phòaⁿ.
I tī kàu-hōe-gōa mā tio̍h ū hó kiàn-chèng, chiah bián siū húi-pòng, hām-lo̍h Mô͘-kúi ê lô-bāng.
Chip-sū siâng-khoán mā tio̍h toan-chong, bô siang-bīn-ōe, bô hò͘ⁿ-chiú, bô tham châi-lī,
tio̍h ēng chheng-khì ê liông-sim kò͘-siú sìn-gióng ê ò-pì.
Chit-khoán lâng mā tio̍h seng hō͘ in chiap-siū khó-giām, nā bô thang hiâm chiah hō͘ in tam-jīm chip-sū.
Lú chip-sū mā-sī tio̍h toan-chong, bô tiòng-siong pa̍t-lâng, an-hūn siú-kí, sū-sū tiong-si̍t.
Chip-sū eng-kai chí-ū chi̍t ê bó͘, gâu koán-lí kiáⁿ-jî kap ka-kī ê ka-têng.
Chip-sū ê kang-chok nā chòe ōe hó, pún-sin ōe tit-tio̍h hó miâ-siaⁿ, mā thang chin hó-táⁿ káng-lūn in tùi Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê sìn-gióng.

Góa ǹg-bāng chin kín chiū ōe khì lí hia, m̄-kú kiaⁿ-liáu khah bān kàu, góa seng siá chit-tiuⁿ phoe hō͘ lí chai lán tī Siōng-tè ê ke tio̍h án-chóaⁿ seng-oa̍h; chit-ê ke chiū-sī chin-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê kàu-hōe, iā chiū-sī chin-lí ê thiāu-chio̍h kap tōe-ki.

Tāi-ke lóng soan-jīn lán sìn-gióng ê ò-pì sī jōa-ni̍h tōa: Ki-tok hián-hiān chòe lâng, Sèng Sîn jīn-tēng chòe gī, tùi thiⁿ-sài chhut-hiān, tī bān-pang tiong siū soan-iông, sè-kan-lâng siong-sìn, siū chiap-la̍p ji̍p êng-iāu.
Sèng Sîn bêng-bêng kóng, tī āu-lâi ê sî-kî ū chi̍t-kóa lâng ōe pōe-sìn, khì thàn bê-he̍k lâng ê siâ-lêng kap kúi-sîn ê kà-sī.
Chit-khoán ê kà-sī sī tùi khi-phiàn-chiá ê pe̍h-chha̍t lâi--ê; in ê liông-sim í-keng hō͘ Mô͘-kúi ēng pû-âng-âng ê thih-ìn ù kì-hō.
In kìm-chí kè-chhōa, kìm-kài chi̍t-kóa chia̍h-mi̍h, chiū-sī Siōng-tè chhòng-chō beh hō͘ sìn koh bêng-pe̍k chin-lí ê lâng ēng kám-siā lâi niá-siū--ê.
In-ūi Siōng-tè it-chhè ê chhòng-chō lóng sī hó, nā ēng kám-siā lâi niá-siū, chiū bô-pòaⁿ-hāng thang kū-choa̍t;
thong-kè Siōng-tè ê ōe kap lâng ê kî-tó chiū chiâⁿ-chòe sèng.

Lí nā chiong ē-bīn ê sū kà-sī hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, chiū ōe tùi só͘ sìn ê sìn-sit kap só͘ sūn-thàn kiān-choân ê kà-sī tit-tio̍h pôe-iúⁿ, chiâⁿ-chòe Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê hó chhe-ēng.
Tio̍h kū-choa̍t chho͘-sio̍k kap khong-tōng bô-iáⁿ-chiah ê thoân-soat. Ūi-tio̍h kèng-khiân ê seng-oa̍h, tio̍h kè-sio̍k chhau-liān ka-kī.
Chhau-liān seng-khu ū tām-po̍h lī-ek, m̄-kú kèng-khiân tùi ta̍k-hāng lóng ū lī-ek, in-ūi ū hiān-kim kap chiong-lâi oa̍h-miā ê èng-ún.
Chit-kù ōe thang siong-sìn, ta̍t-tit oân-choân chiap-siū.
Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê, lán chhut-la̍t tio̍h-bôa, in-ūi lán ê ǹg-bāng chāi-tī chin-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè; I sī chèng-lâng, te̍k-pia̍t sī sìn ê lâng ê Kiù-chú.
Lí tio̍h chiong chiah-ê tāi-chì kā in khoàn-bián kap kà-sī.
M̄-thang in-ūi lí ê siàu-liân hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-khin; tio̍h tī kóng-ōe, kiâⁿ-chòe, thiàⁿ-sim, sìn-sim, sûn-kiat, chòe sìn-tô͘ ê bô͘-hoān.
Tio̍h tì-ì soan-tho̍k Sèng-keng, khoàn-bián, kap kà-sī, ti̍t-kàu góa lâi.
M̄-thang hut-lio̍k lí só͘ niá-siū sio̍k-lêng ê un-sù, chiū-sī thong-kè sian-ti ê sìn-sit kap tiúⁿ-ló-thoân ê àn-chhiú sù hō͘ lí--ê.
Chiah-ê tāi-chì, lí tio̍h choan-sim tì-ì khì chòe, hō͘ chèng-lâng thang khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí ê chìn-pō͘.
Lí ka-kī tio̍h kín-sīn, lí ê kà-sī mā tio̍h kín-sīn; chiah-ê tāi-chì tio̍h kian-chhî khì chòe, án-ni chòe ōe kiù lí pún-sin kap thiaⁿ-thàn lí ê lâng.
M̄-thang chek-pī lāu-lâng, tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ khǹg lāu-pē án-ni kā i khǹg; tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ khǹg hiaⁿ-tī án-ni khǹg siàu-liân-lâng;

tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ khoán-thāi lāu-bú án-ni khoán-thāi lāu hū-jîn-lâng; tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ khoán-thāi chí-bē án-ni ēng oân-choân sûn-kiat ê sim khoán-thāi siàu-liân ê hū-jîn-lâng.
Tio̍h chun-tiōng chin-chiàⁿ bô i-óa ê kóaⁿ-hū.

Kóaⁿ-hū ū kiáⁿ-jî-sun, chiah-ê kiáⁿ-jî-sun tio̍h tāi-seng tī ka-kī ê ka-têng ha̍k-si̍p hàu-sūn ê pún-hūn, lâi pò-tap in ê sī-tōa-lâng, in-ūi che sī Siōng-tè só͘ hoaⁿ-hí--ê.
Chin-chiàⁿ bô-i-bô-óa ê kóaⁿ-hū, chí-ū gióng-bōng Siōng-tè, mî-ji̍t kè-sio̍k khún-kiû kî-tó.
M̄-kú chhia-hoa ê kóaⁿ-hū, sui-jiân teh oa̍h, kî-si̍t sī sí.
Lí tio̍h chiong chiah-ê kā in kà-sī, in chiah bōe siū chek-pī.
Nā ū lâng bô chiàu-kò͘ chhin-chhek, te̍k-pia̍t sī bô chiàu-kò͘ ka-kī chhù-lāi ê lâng, i í-keng pōe-poān sìn-gióng, pí bô-sìn ê lâng koh-khah hāi.
Kóaⁿ-hū tio̍h chhiau-kè la̍k-cha̍p hè chiah thang teng-kì; i tio̍h chí-ū kiat-hun chi̍t piàn,

tio̍h ū chòe hó-sū ê chèng-kù, chhin-chhiūⁿ ióng-io̍k jî-lú, chiap-thāi chhut-gōa-lâng, kā sìn-tô͘ sóe-kha, pang-chān tú-tio̍h hoān-lān ê lâng, choan-sim chòe ta̍k-hāng hó-sū.
M̄-kú siàu-liân ê kóaⁿ-hū m̄-thang kā in teng-kì; in-ūi in chêng-io̍k chi̍t-ē chhiong-tōng lī-khui Ki-tok, chiū siūⁿ-beh kè,
ûi-pōe tong-chho͘ só͘ hē ê goān, tì-kàu ka-kī chhú-chōe.
Koh in o̍h pîn-tōaⁿ, chi̍t-ke kè chi̍t-ke se̍h-thàu-thàu; m̄-nā pîn-tōaⁿ, mā ài kóng lâng ê sī-hui, ài chhap êng-á-sū, kóng m̄ eng-kai kóng ê ōe.
Só͘-í góa ài siàu-liân ê kóaⁿ-hū koh kè, siⁿ-kiáⁿ, liāu-lí ka-kī ê ka-têng, chiah bōe hō͘ tùi-te̍k ū ki-hōe kóng lán ê pháiⁿ-ōe;
in-ūi ū chi̍t-kóa kóaⁿ-hū í-keng lī-khui, khì tè Sat-tàn.

Sìn Chú ê hū-jîn-lâng chhù-lāi nā ū kóaⁿ-hū, tio̍h ka-kī kā in chiàu-kò͘, m̄-thang chiong chit-ê tàⁿ sak hō͘ kàu-hōe, kàu-hōe chiah ōe-tàng chiàu-kò͘ hiah-ê chin-chiàⁿ bô i-óa ê kóaⁿ-hū.
Hiah-ê gâu tī-lí kàu-hōe ê tiúⁿ-ló eng-kai tit-tio̍h ka-pē ê pò-siû, te̍k-pia̍t chīn-la̍t tī káng-tō kap kà-sī--ê koh-khah tio̍h án-ni,
in-ūi Sèng-keng kóng, “Gû teh lún ngó͘-kok ê sî, m̄-thang kā i kòa gû-chhùi-lam”; koh kóng, “Kang-lâng eng-kai tit-tio̍h kang-chîⁿ.”
Khòng-kò tiúⁿ-ló ê àn-kiāⁿ, nā m̄-sī ū nn̄g ê á-sī saⁿ ê chèng-jîn, m̄-thang siū-lí.
Kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe ê lâng tio̍h tī chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng kā in khiàn-chek, hō͘ kî-tha ê lâng tit-tio̍h kéng-kài.

Góa tī Siōng-tè, Ki-tok Iâ-so͘, kap siū soán ê thiⁿ-sài ê bīn-chêng bēng-lēng lí, tio̍h chun-siú chiah-ê chí-sī, m̄-thang ū sêng-kiàn, bô-lūn chòe sím-mi̍h to m̄-thang phian-sim.
M̄-thang sûi-piān kā lâng kiâⁿ àn-chhiú-lé. M̄-thang chham-ú pa̍t-lâng ê chōe; tio̍h pó-siú ka-kī sûn-kiat.
In-ūi lí ê ūi bô hó, siông-siông phòa-pīⁿ, m̄-thang kan-ta lim-chúi, mā tio̍h lim tām-po̍h chiú.
Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng ê chōe chin bêng-hián, iáu-bē sím-phòaⁿ chiū chin chheng-chhó; ū ê lâng ê chōe āu-lâi chiah hián-lō͘.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, hó hêng-ûi mā chin bêng-hián, bô bêng-hián--ê, mā khàm bōe tiâu.
Tī lâng ê koán-hat-ē chòe lô͘-lē--ê, tio̍h khòaⁿ ka-kī ê chú-lâng chòe kham-tit siū chhiong-hun ê chun-kèng, Siōng-tè ê miâ kap tō-lí chiah bōe siū siat-to̍k.

Chú-lâng nā-sī sìn Chú ê, m̄-thang in-ūi in sī Chú-lāi ê hiaⁿ-tī chiū bô kā in chun-kèng; kì-jiân tùi lô͘-lē ê ho̍k-sāi lâi tit-tio̍h lī-ek ê chú-lâng sī sìn-tô͘, mā-sī só͘ kèng-ài ê lâng, lín koh-khah tio̍h un-khûn kā in ho̍k-sāi. Lí tio̍h ēng chiah-ê sū lâi kà-sī kap khoàn-bián:
Nā ū lâng kà pa̍t-khoán kàu-gī bô hû-ha̍p lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok kiān-choân ê tō-lí, bô kun-kù khiân-sêng ê kàu-gī,
chiū-sī phòng-hong chū-tāi, oân-choân bû-ti, hò͘ⁿ piān-lūn, ài tī jī-bīn siōng cheng-lūn; tùi chiah-ê ín-khí oàn-tò͘, hun-cheng, húi-pòng, chhai-gî,
tì-kàu sim-su pāi-hoāi, sòng-sit chin-lí, hun-cheng bô-thêng; in siūⁿ-kóng chong-kàu sī thàn-chîⁿ ê chhiú-tōaⁿ.
Kèng-khiân koh ti-chiok ōe hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h tōa lī-ek.
Seng-put-tài-lâi, sú-put-tài-khì;
ū thang chia̍h, ū thang chhēng, chiū tio̍h ti-chiok.
Siūⁿ-beh hoat-châi ê lâng ōe hām-lo̍h iú-he̍k, hām-chíⁿ, kap chin chōe khoán gû-gōng iú-hāi ê io̍k-bōng, hō͘ lâng tîm-lûn tì-kàu pāi-hoāi kap húi-bia̍t.
In-ūi tham-châi sī bān-ok ê kun-goân; ū lâng tham-ài chîⁿ-châi, siū bê phian-lī sìn-gióng, ka-kī siū-chīn khó͘-thàng.
M̄-kú lí chit-ê sio̍k Siōng-tè ê lâng, tio̍h siám-pī chiah-ê sū. Tio̍h tui-kiû chèng-gī, kèng-khiân, sìn-sim, jîn-ài, nāi-sim, kap un-jiû.

Sìn-gióng ê bí-hó kèng-sài tio̍h chīn-la̍t khì piàⁿ; tio̍h khak-pó éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā; ūi-tio̍h chit-ê oa̍h-miā lí ū siū kéng-tiàu, tī chin chōe kiàn-chèng-jîn ê bīn-chêng soan-jīn bí-hó ê sìn-gióng.
Tī sù oa̍h-miā hō͘ bān-mi̍h ê Siōng-tè, kap tùi Pâng-siu Pí-lia̍p-to soan-jīn bí-hó sìn-gióng ê Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ bīn-chêng,
góa hoan-hù lí tio̍h chun-siú só͘ niá-siū ê bēng-lēng, bô khoat-tiám, bô thang hiâm, ti̍t-kàu lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok hián-hiān ê sî.
Tī sî-ki sêng-se̍k ê sî, hit-ūi eng-kai siū chheng-chàn to̍k-it-bû-jī ê Chú-cháiⁿ, bān-ông ê Ông, bān-chú ê Chú Siōng-tè, beh hō͘ I hián-hiān.

Siōng-tè sī to̍k-it bōe-sí, tiàm tī lâng bōe thang chiap-kūn ê kng-bêng tiong; bô lâng bat khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I, mā bô lâng ōe-tàng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I. Goān chun-kùi kap éng-oán ê chú-koân kui tī I. Amen!

Tùi hiah-ê kim-sè hó-gia̍h ê lâng, lí tio̍h hoan-hù in m̄-thang kiau-ngō͘, m̄-thang chiong in ê ǹg-bāng khǹg tī bōe óa-khò--tit ê châi-bu̍t, tio̍h óa-khò chiong bān-mi̍h hong-hong-hù-hù hō͘ lán ta̍k-ê lâng hióng-siū ê Siōng-tè.
Tio̍h hoan-hù in chòe hó-sū, chòe khah chōe hó-sū, khóng-khài si-sià, kap lâng hun-hióng.
Án-ni chòe sī teh ūi ka-kī ê chiong-lâi khí-chō kian-kò͘ ê tōe-ki, khak-pó chin-chiàⁿ ê oa̍h-miā.
Thê-mô͘-thài ah, tio̍h chhî-siú Siōng-tè kau-thok lí ê chit-chek. Tio̍h siám-pī bô kèng-khiân ê khong-tâm kap ké tì-sek ê cheng-lūn.
Ū lâng chū-chheng ū chit-khoán tì-sek, tì-kàu sìn-gióng sit-lo̍h bo̍k-phiau. Goān Siōng-tè ê un-tián kap lín tông-chāi!
Góa sī Pó-lô, hōng Siōng-tè ê chí-ì choh Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê sù-tô͘, lâi thoân Siōng-tè só͘ èng-ún in-ūi kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-liân chiah ū ê oa̍h-miā.
Góa siá-phoe hō͘ góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê kiáⁿ Thê-mô͘-thài. Goān Pē Siōng-tè kap lán ê Chú Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ sù lí un-tián, lîn-bín, kap pêng-an!
Góa kám-siā góa kap lia̍t-chó͘ kâng-khoán ēng chheng-khì ê liông-sim kèng-pài ê Siōng-tè. Góa mî-ji̍t kî-tó ê sî siàu-liām lí bô-soah.
Góa siūⁿ-tio̍h lī-pia̍t ê sî lí teh lâu ba̍k-sái, chiū chin ài kìⁿ lí, thang hō͘ góa chhiong-móa hoaⁿ-hí.
Góa ōe-kì-tit lí ū sûn-chin ê sìn-sim; chit-ê sìn-sim lí ê gōa-má Lô-í kap lí ê lāu-bú Iú-nî-ki seng ū, góa siong-sìn hiān-chāi lí mā ū.
In-ūi án-ni, góa thê-chhíⁿ lí, góa kā lí àn-chhiú ê sî Siōng-tè hō͘ lí ê un-sù, tio̍h hō͘ i chhin-chhiūⁿ hé koh to̍h--khí-lâi.
In-ūi Siōng-tè hō͘ lán ê m̄-sī kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ê sim-lêng, sī khùi-la̍t, jîn-ài, kap chū-chè ê sim-lêng.

Só͘-í, ūi-tio̍h lán ê Chú chòe kiàn-chèng m̄-thang kám-kak kiàn-siàu, mā m̄-thang in-ūi góa ūi-tio̍h Chú chòe siû-hoān lâi kám-kak kiàn-siàu; tio̍h chiàu Siōng-tè só͘ sù ê khùi-la̍t ūi-tio̍h hok-im kap góa chòe-hé siū-khó͘.

Siōng-tè kiù lán, kéng-tiàu lán chòe I ka-kī ê chú-bîn, m̄-sī kun-kù lán ê hêng-ûi, sī chiàu I ka-kī ê chí-ì kap un-tián. Chit-ê un-tián tī bān-sè í-chêng thong-kè Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ sù hō͘ lán;

chit-ê un-tián hiān-chāi thong-kè lán ê Kiù-chú Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê hián-hiān í-keng si̍t-hiān. Ki-tok í-keng húi-bia̍t sí-bông, koh thong-kè hok-im chiong bōe pāi-hoāi ê oa̍h-miā hián-bêng--chhut-lâi.
Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê hok-im, Siōng-tè jīm-bēng góa chòe thoân-tō-chiá, sù-tô͘, kap kàu-su.

Só͘-í góa chiah teh siū-khó͘. Chóng-sī góa bô kám-kak kiàn-siàu, in-ūi góa bat góa só͘ sìn ê Siōng-tè, mā chhim-sìn I ōe pó-siú I só͘ kau-thok góa--ê ti̍t-kàu hit-ê Ji̍t.
Tio̍h ēng lí tùi góa thiaⁿ--tio̍h hiah-ê kiān-choân ê tō-lí chòe bô͘-iūⁿ, kian-chhî lán kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-liân lâi tit--tio̍h ê sìn-sim kap jîn-ài.
Tio̍h kò͘-siú thong-kè tiàm tī lán lāi-bīn ê Sèng Sîn kau-thok hō͘ lí ê bí-hó ê sìn-sit.
Lí chai, tī A-sè-a ê lâng lóng pōe-poān góa, kî-tiong ū Hui-kiat-lō͘ kap Hek-mô͘-kî-nî.
Goān Chú lîn-bín O-nî-sek-hut chi̍t ke ê lâng, in-ūi i siông-siông kā góa kó͘-lē, bô in-ūi góa kòa thih-liān kám-kak kiàn-siàu,
tian-tò kàu Lô-má ê sî phah-piàⁿ chhē góa chhē kàu tio̍h.
Goān Chú hō͘ i tī hit-ê Ji̍t tit-tio̍h lîn-bín! I tī Í-hut-só͘ hiah-ni̍h gâu ho̍k-sāi góa, lí chin chheng-chhó.
Só͘-í, góa ê kiáⁿ ah, lí tio̍h khò Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê un-tián kian-kiông--khí-lâi.
Lí tī chin chōe kiàn-chèng-jîn bīn-chêng tùi góa thiaⁿ-tio̍h chiah-ê kà-sī, tio̍h kau-thok hō͘ hiah-ê tiong-si̍t, mā ōe-kham-tit kà-sī pa̍t-lâng ê lâng.
Lí tio̍h choh Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê cheng-peng kap góa chòe-hé siū-khó͘.
Ho̍k-ia̍h ê peng nā beh hō͘ koaⁿ-tiúⁿ hoaⁿ-hí, chiū m̄-thang hō͘ seng-oa̍h ê tāi-chì tîⁿ-kha-pòaⁿ-chhiú.
Ūn-tōng-oân nā bô chiàu kui-chek pí-sài chiū bōe-tàng tit-tio̍h koan-kun ê hoa-koan.
Kut-la̍t chèng-choh ê lông-hu tong-jiân seng siu-sêng.
Góa só͘ kóng ê ōe lí tio̍h hó-hó-á siūⁿ, in-ūi Chú ōe hō͘ lí liáu-kái ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì.
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok, I sī Tāi-pi̍t ê hō͘-tāi, Siōng-tè hō͘ I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h; che sī góa só͘ thoân ê hok-im.
Góa ūi-tio̍h chit-ê hok-im siū-khó͘, sīm-chì chhin-chhiūⁿ hoān-lâng hō͘ lâng liān--teh; m̄-kú Siōng-tè ê ōe bô siū khún-pa̍k.
Só͘-í, góa ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè só͘ kéng-soán ê lâng jím-siū it-chhè, hō͘ in mā ōe tit-tio̍h Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê chín-kiù kap éng-oán ê êng-kng.
Chit-kù ōe thang siong-sìn: Lán nā kap I tâng-sí, mā ōe kap I tâng-oa̍h.
Lán nā thun-lún, mā ōe kap I chòe-hé chiáng-koân. Lán nā m̄ jīn I, I mā ōe m̄ jīn lán.
Lán nā sit-sìn, I iû-goân sìn-si̍t, in-ūi I bōe-tàng ûi-pōe ka-kī.
Lí tio̍h thê-chhíⁿ tāi-ke, tī Chú ê bīn-chêng bēng-lēng in m̄-thang ūi-tio̍h giân-sû cheng-piān; án-ni chòe bô lī-ek, ōe hō͘ thiaⁿ ê lâng siū siong-hāi.
Tio̍h chīn-la̍t chòe, thang hō͘ Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe khó-chhú bô kiàn-siàu ê kang-lâng, chèng-khak kóe-seh chin-lí ê tō.
Tio̍h siám-pī chho͘-sio̍k bô lō͘-ēng ê ōe, in-ūi chit-khoán tāi-chì ōe hō͘ lâng ná bô kèng-khiân,
chit-khoán ê ōe ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ to̍k-chhng thòaⁿ-khui. Su-bí-nái kap Hui-lí-tô͘ mā-sī chit-khoán lâng;
in í-keng lī-khui chin-lí, kóng koh-oa̍h ê sū í-keng kè--khì, tì-kàu chi̍t-kóa lâng ê sìn-gióng oân-choân tó-hoāi.
Siōng-tè ê tōe-ki kian-kò͘ bōe iô-tāng, téng-bīn ū khek jī kóng, “Chú bat sio̍k I ê lâng”, koh kóng, “Kiû-kiò Chú ê miâ ê lâng lóng tio̍h lī-khui put-gī.”
Tī tōa keng chhù-lāi, m̄-nā ū kim kap gûn, mā ū chhâ kap hûi ê khì-khū; ū ê chòe iù--ê, ū ê chòe chho͘ ê lō͘-ēng.
Lâng nā kiat-chēng ka-kī, lī-khui chiah-ê chho͘-sio̍k ê sū, chiū ōe chiâⁿ-chòe kùi-khì ê khì-khū, sèng-hòa hō͘ Chú-lâng ēng, thang chún-pī hó-sè chòe ta̍k-hāng hó-sū.
Tio̍h siám-pī siàu-liân lâng ê chêng-io̍k; tio̍h kap hiah-ê ēng chheng-khì ê sim kiû-kiò Chú ê lâng chòe-hé tui-kiû kong-gī, sìn-gióng, jîn-ài, kap hô-pêng.
M̄-thang ū gû-gōng bû-ti ê piān-lūn; lí chai chiah-ê tāi-chì ōe ín-khí oan-ke.
Chú ê po̍k-jîn bô eng-kai oan-ke, tio̍h un-hô tùi-thāi chèng-lâng, gâu kà-sī, gâu jím-siū,
un-jiû khoàn-kài hoán-tùi-chiá, kiám-chhái Siōng-tè ōe hō͘ in hóe-kái, bat chin-lí.
Án-ni in sui-jiân í-keng hō͘ Mô͘-kúi lia̍h-khì sūn-thàn i ê ì-sù, mā iáu ōe chhíⁿ-ngō͘ lâi thoat-lī i ê lô-bāng.
Tio̍h chai, sè-kài ê boa̍t-kî kàu ê sî ōe ū chióng-chióng ê khó͘-lān.
Hit-sî, lâng ōe chū-su, tham-châi, khoa-kháu, kiau-ngō͘, húi-pòng, ngó͘-ge̍k pē-bú, bông-un-pōe-gī, bô sèng-kiat,
bô chhin-chêng, chân-jím, tiòng-siong, hêng-ge̍k, hiong-pō, oàn-hūn hó,
kan-kúi, lām-sám chòe, chū-ko chū-tāi, ài hióng-lo̍k iâⁿ-kè thiàⁿ Siōng-tè,
ū kèng-khiân ê gōa-māu khiok bô kèng-khiân ê si̍t-chit. Lí tio̍h siám-pī chit-khoán lâng.
In tiong-kan ū lâng chhim-ji̍p lâng ê chhù, khòng-chè ì-chì po̍k-jio̍k ê hū-lú. Chiah-ê hū-lú siū chōe-ok ap-chè, hō͘ ta̍k-khoán ê chêng-io̍k chi-phòe;
in put-sî to teh o̍h, khiok bô hoat-tō͘ bêng-pe̍k chin-lí.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ chá-chêng Ngá-nî kap Iông-pò͘-lûi hoán-tùi Mô͘-se, hiān-chāi chiah-ê lâng mā án-ni hoán-tùi chin-lí, tì-kàu sim-chì pāi-hoāi, sìn-gióng bô sûn-chin.
M̄-kú chiah-ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ hit nn̄g ê lâng, bōe ū sím-mi̍h éng-hióng, in-ūi in ê gû-gōng ōe tī chèng-lâng ê bīn-chêng po̍k-lō͘.
Lí ū o̍h góa só͘ kà-sī--ê, góa ê choh-lâng, seng-oa̍h ê bo̍k-phiau, sìn-sim, khoan-iông, thiàⁿ-sim, kian-jím,

í-ki̍p só͘ siū ê pek-hāi kap khó͘-lān, chiah-ê lí lóng chai, chiū-sī góa tī An-thê-o, Í-ko-liām, Lō͘-su-tek só͘ tú--tio̍h ê pek-hāi, góa án-chóaⁿ teh jím-siū; m̄-kú Chú ū kiù góa thoat-lī chiah-ê.
Só͘-ū ài-beh kap Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kiat-liân kè kèng-khiân seng-oa̍h ê lâng, it-tēng ōe tú-tio̍h pek-hāi.
Put-kò pháiⁿ-lâng kap khi-phiàn-lâng--ê ōe ná lâi ná pháiⁿ, in kā lâng phiàn, ka-kī mā hō͘ lâng phiàn.
Chóng-sī lí tio̍h chhî-siú só͘ ha̍k-si̍p só͘ chhim-sìn ê tō-lí, in-ūi lí chai chiah-ê sī tùi sím-mi̍h-lâng ha̍k-si̍p--ê.
Lí mā chai lí tùi sòe-hàn chiū bêng-pe̍k Sèng-keng, chit-ê Sèng-keng ōe-tàng hō͘ lí ū tì-hūi thang thong-kè sìn Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ tit-tio̍h chín-kiù.
Choân-pō͘ Sèng-keng sī Siōng-tè ê Sîn kám-tōng siá--ê, tùi kàu-tō, tùi tok-chek, tùi kiù-chèng, tùi hùn-liān lâng kiâⁿ chiàⁿ-lō͘, lóng ū lī-ek,
hō͘ ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè ê lâng chong-pī hó-sè, thang chòe ta̍k-hāng hó-sū.
Tī Siōng-tè kap teh-beh sím-phòaⁿ só͘-ū oa̍h-lâng kap sí-lâng ê Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ bīn-chêng, koh in-ūi Ki-tok beh hián-hiān lâi choh-ông, góa sīn-tiōng hoan-hù lí:
Tio̍h thoân tō-lí, bô-lūn sî-ki sek-ha̍p bô sek-ha̍p lóng tio̍h kian-chhî khì thoân; tio̍h ēng chòe tōa ê nāi-sim kap kàu-tō lâi khoàn-bián, tok-chek, kó͘-lē.

In-ūi sî-ki teh-beh kàu, hit-sî lâng thiaⁿ bōe lo̍h kiān-choân ê kà-sī, ng hī-khang m̄ thiaⁿ chin-lí, hoán-tńg thàn ka-kī ê su-io̍k, hī-khang chiūⁿ, phèng-chhiáⁿ chi̍t-ê koh chi̍t-ê kàu-su lâi kóng kah-ì thiaⁿ, bô-iáⁿ-chiah ê thoân-soat.
Chóng-sī lí hoān-sū tio̍h kín-sīn, jím-siū khó͘-lān, chòe thoân-tō-chiá ê kang-chok, chīn lí chòe Siōng-tè chhe-ēng ê pún-hūn.
Taⁿ góa hi-seng ka-kī hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè ê sî kàu lah; chit-chūn chiū-sī góa lī-khui sè-kan ê sî.
Bí-hó ê kèng-sài góa í-keng piàⁿ liáu; tio̍h cháu ê lō͘-thêng góa í-keng cháu oân; tio̍h siú ê sìn-gióng góa í-keng kian-siú.

Gī ê hoa-koan hiān-chāi í-keng ūi góa chún-pī hó-sè, Chú — kong-gī ê Sím-phòaⁿ-chiá tī hit-ê Ji̍t beh hō͘ góa; m̄-nā hō͘ góa, mā beh hō͘ lóng-chóng him-bō͘ I hián-hiān ê lâng.
Tio̍h chīn só͘-ōe kóaⁿ-kín lâi góa chia;
in-ūi Tí-má tham-ài hiān-sè, í-keng lī-khui góa khì Thiap-sat-lô-nî-ka; Kek-le̍k-sū mā í-keng khì Ka-lia̍p-thài, Thê-to khì That-má-thài.
Chí-ū Lō͘-ka kap góa chòe-hé tī chia. Lí tio̍h chhōa Má-khó chòe-hé lâi, in-ūi i tùi góa ê sū-hōng chin ū pang-chān.
Góa í-keng phài Chhui-ki-kó͘ khì Í-hut-só͘.
Góa tī Te̍k-lô-a lâu tī Ka-pò͘ in tau hit-niá gōa-saⁿ, lí lâi ê sî tio̍h tòa--lâi, mā tio̍h tòa hiah-ê chheh lâi, te̍k-pia̍t sī hiah-ê iûⁿ-phê ê chheh-kǹg.
Phah-tâng sai-hū A-le̍k-san-tāi kā góa hāi kah chin chhám; Chú ōe chiàu i ê só͘-chòe kā i pò-èng.
Lí ka-kī mā tio̍h tî-hông, in-ūi i ke̍k-le̍k hoán-tùi lán só͘ thoân ê sìn-sit.
Góa thâu chi̍t piàn sin-sò͘ ê sî bô lâng tī sin-piⁿ pang-chān góa, ta̍k-ê lóng kā góa pàng-sak. Goān chit-ê chōe bô kui tī in.

M̄-kú Chú ū khiā tī góa sin-piⁿ, hō͘ góa ū khùi-la̍t thang oân-chéng thoân-iông sìn-sit, hō͘ só͘-ū ê Gōa-pang-lâng lóng thiaⁿ--kìⁿ. Chòe-āu góa ū tùi sai ê chhùi siū kiù chhut.
Chú ōe kiù góa thoat-lī lóng-chóng ê pháiⁿ-tāi, mā ōe kiù góa chìn-ji̍p I thiⁿ--ni̍h ê Kok-tō͘. Goān êng-kng kui I, ti̍t-kàu éng-éng-oán-oán. Amen!
Chhiáⁿ kā Pek-ki-la, A-ku-la, kap O-nî-sek-hut choân-ke chhéng-an.
Í-la-to͘ kè-sio̍k tiàm tī Ko-lîm-to; Te̍k-lô-hui-mô͘ phòa-pīⁿ, góa kā i lâu tī Bí-lī-to͘.
Tio̍h chīn só͘-ōe tī tang-thiⁿ í-chêng lâi. Iú-pò͘-lô, Pò͘-tiân, Lī-ló͘, Kek-ló-tí-a, kap chèng hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē lóng beh kā lí chhéng-an.
Goān Chú kap lí ê sim-lêng tông-chāi! Goān Siōng-tè ê un-tián kap lín tông-chāi!
Góa sī Pó-lô, choh Siōng-tè ê po̍k-jîn kap Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê sù-tô͘, siū soán-phài pang-chān Siōng-tè soán-bîn ê sìn-gióng, hō͘ in jīn-bat ha̍h tī kèng-khiân ê chin-lí;
chit-ê chin-lí hō͘ lán tùi éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā ū ǹg-bāng, chiū-sī bōe kóng pe̍h-chha̍t ê Siōng-tè tī bān-sè í-chêng èng-ún beh hō͘ lán--ê.

I tī sî-ki sêng-se̍k ê sî, thong-kè sìn-sit ê soan-káng chiong chit-ê èng-ún hián-bêng--chhut-lâi. Góa ū siū-thok, hōng lán ê Kiù-chú Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng soan-káng chit-ê hok-im.
Thê-to, góa siá-phoe hō͘ lí, tī lán kiōng-tông ê sìn-gióng lí sī góa chin ê kiáⁿ. Goān Pē Siōng-tè kap lán ê Kiù-chú Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ sù lí un-tián kap pêng-an!
Góa kā lí lâu tī Khek-lí-te̍k, sī beh hō͘ lí chhú-lí iáu-bē pān chheng-chhó ê tāi-chì, koh chiàu góa só͘ chí-sī, tī ta̍k-ê siâⁿ-chhī soán-phài lâng chòe tiúⁿ-ló.
Choh tiúⁿ-ló--ê tio̍h bô thang chí-chek, chí-ū chi̍t ê bó͘, kiáⁿ-jî lóng sī sìn-tô͘, koh bô lâng khòng-kò sī hòng-tōng á-sī m̄ sūn-ho̍k.
Kàu-hōe ê kam-tok, kì-jiân choh Siōng-tè ê koán-ke, it-tēng tio̍h bô thang chí-chek, bô chū-ko, bô pháiⁿ sèng-tē, bô chiú-chùi, bô hiong-pō, bô tham-châi.
Tio̍h gâu khoán-thāi chhut-gōa-lâng, gâu chòe hó-sū, siú-kí, chèng-ti̍t, sèng-kiat, chiat-chè.
I tio̍h kian-siú hit-ê khó-khò hû-ha̍p kàu-gī ê sìn-sit, án-ni chiah ōe-tàng ēng kiān-choân ê kà-sī khoàn-bián lâng, piān-tó hoán-tùi ê lâng.
In-ūi ū chin chōe m̄ sūn-ho̍k ê lâng, te̍k-pia̍t sī hiah-ê chú-tiuⁿ tio̍h siū kat-lé ê lâng, in ài kóng bô lō͘-ēng ê ōe, koh khi-phiàn lâng.
Chit-khoán lâng it-tēng tio̍h kìm-chí in kóng-ōe, in-ūi in ūi-tio̍h beh tham put-gī ê chîⁿ-châi, ēng bô eng-kai kà-sī ê ōe phò-hoāi chi̍t-kóa ka-têng.
In Khek-lí-te̍k -lâng ū chi̍t ê sian-ti bat án-ni kóng, “ Khek-lí-te̍k -lâng ài kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, sī hiong-ok ê iá-siù, tham-chia̍h koh pîn-tōaⁿ.”
I kóng--ê sī sū-si̍t. Só͘-í lí tio̍h giâm-keh kā in chek-pī, thang hō͘ in ū kiān-choân ê sìn-gióng,
