bô thiaⁿ-thàn Iû-thài -lâng bô-iáⁿ-chiah ê thoân-soat kap pōe-ge̍k chin-lí ê lâng ê kui-lē.

Tùi chheng-khì ê lâng lâi kóng, it-chhè lóng chheng-khì; m̄-kú tùi ù-òe kap m̄-sìn ê lâng lâi kóng, bô chi̍t hāng sī chheng-khì, in-ūi in ê sim-su kap liông-ti lóng sī ù-òe.
In kong-khai kóng bat Siōng-tè, khiok ēng hêng-ûi hó͘-jīn I. In khó-ò͘ⁿ, pōe-ge̍k, bōe-tàng chòe sím-mi̍h hó-sū.
Chóng-sī lí, lí ê kàu-tō tio̍h hû-ha̍p kiān-choân ê kàu-gī.
Tio̍h khǹg lāu-lâng ài chiat-chè, ū hó phín-keh, siú-kí, tio̍h ū kiān-choân ê sìn-sim, thiàⁿ-sim, kap nāi-sim.
Lí mā tio̍h án-ni khǹg lāu hū-jîn-lâng hêng-ûi kín-sīn, m̄-thang kóng lâng ê sī-hui, m̄-thang choh chiú ê lô͘-châi, tio̍h ēng hó bô͘-hoān kà-sī lâng,
chiah thang hùn-liān siàu-liân hū-jîn-lâng thiàⁿ tiōng-hu, kap thiàⁿ kiáⁿ-jî,
koh tio̍h siú-kí, cheng-kiat, gâu lí-ke, chhin-chhiat, sūn-ho̍k tiōng-hu, Siōng-tè ê tō-lí chiah bōe siū húi-pòng.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, lí mā tio̍h khó͘-khǹg siàu-liân ta-po͘-lâng siú-kí.
Lí ka-kī hoān-sū tio̍h ū hó hêng-ûi choh hó bô͘-hoān, sêng-khún ún-tiōng kà-sī lâng,
giân-sû toan-chèng, bô thang chí-chek, hō͘ hoán-tùi ê lâng bô thang kóng lán ê pháiⁿ-ōe, ka-kī soah kám-kak kiàn-siàu.
Choh lô͘-lē--ê tio̍h sūn-ho̍k ka-kī ê chú-lâng, sū-sū hō͘ in hoaⁿ-hí; m̄-thang ìn-chhùi-ìn-chi̍h;
m̄-thang thau-the̍h, tio̍h sū-sū tiong-si̍t liông-siān, hō͘ lán ê Kiù-chú Siōng-tè ê kà-sī tī ta̍k hong-bīn koh-khah ū kong-chhái.
In-ūi Siōng-tè í-keng hián-bêng I ê un-tián beh chín-kiù choân jîn-lūi,
hùn-liān lán khì-sak bô kèng-khiân ê seng-oa̍h kap sio̍k-sè ê io̍k-bōng, tī hiān-kim ê sî-tāi kè siú-kí, chèng-ti̍t, kap kèng-khiân ê seng-oa̍h,
thèng-hāu hit-ê chhiong-móa hok-khì ê ǹg-bāng, chiū-sī chì-chun ê Siōng-tè í-ki̍p lán ê Kiù-chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok êng-iāu ê hián-hiān.
Ki-tok ūi-tio̍h lán hiàn ka-kī, sī beh kiù-sio̍k lán thoat-lī it-chhè ê chōe-ok, hō͘ lán chiâⁿ-chòe I sûn-kiat ê chú-bîn kui-sio̍k I, jia̍t-sim chòe hó-sū.
Chiah-ê sū, lí tio̍h kóng, tio̍h khoàn-bián, chhiong-hun ūn-iōng chit-koân chek-pī lâng. M̄-thang hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-khin.
Tio̍h thê-chhíⁿ tāi-ke ho̍k-chiông chip-chèng-chiá kap tong-koân-chiá, thang chún-pī hó-sè chòe ta̍k-hāng hó-sū.
Tio̍h khǹg in m̄-thang húi-pòng pa̍t-lâng, m̄-thang oan-ke; tio̍h hô-khì iú-siān, ēng un-hô ê thài-tō͘ tùi-thāi só͘-ū ê lâng.

In-ūi lán ka-kī í-chêng mā-sī bô tì-sek, pōe-ge̍k, kiâⁿ bê-lō͘, choh chióng-chióng chêng-io̍k kap hióng-lo̍k ê lô͘-lē, tī ok-to̍k kap oàn-tò͘ tiong teh tō͘-ji̍t, hō͘-siōng oàn-hūn, pí-chhú iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
M̄-kú lán ê Kiù-chú Siōng-tè chû-pi jîn-ài hián-bêng ê sî,
I ū chín-kiù lán; m̄-sī in-ūi lán ka-kī ū hó hêng-ûi, sī in-ūi I ū lîn-bín, thong-kè hō͘ lâng têng-sin chhut-sì ê sóe-lé kap Sèng Sîn ê keng-sin chín-kiù lán;
thong-kè lán ê Kiù-chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok Siōng-tè ū chiong Sèng Sîn hong-hong-hù-hù kā lán koàn-ak,
hō͘ lán thang khò I ê un-tián chheng-chòe gī, sêng-siū só͘ ǹg-bāng éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Chit-kù ōe thang siong-sìn. Góa ài lí te̍k-pia̍t kiông-tiau chiah-ê sū, thang hō͘ sìn Siōng-tè ê lâng choân-sim chòe hó-sū; chiah-ê sū lóng chin hó, koh tùi lâng ū lī-ek.
Tio̍h siám-pī gû-gōng ê cheng-lūn, cho̍k-phó͘, hun-cheng, kap Lu̍t-hoat ê cheng-chip, in-ūi chiah-ê lóng bô lō͘-ēng, bô kè-ta̍t.
Chè-chō hun-cheng ê lâng, kā i kéng-kò chi̍t nn̄g piàn í-āu chiū m̄-thang koh kap i lâi-óng.
Lí chai, chit-khoán lâng í-keng pāi-hoāi; i kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe sī teh kā ka-kī tēng-chōe.
Góa chhe A-thê-má á-sī Chhui-ki-kó͘ khì lí hia ê sî, tio̍h kóaⁿ-kín lâi Nî-ko-pho-lí chhē góa, in-ūi góa í-keng koat-tēng beh tī hia kè tang-thiⁿ.
Tio̍h chīn só͘-ōe pang-chān Se-la̍p lu̍t-su kap A-pho-lô lú-thêng ê su-iàu, hō͘ in thang an-sim chhut-hoat.
Tio̍h hoan-hù lán ka-kī ê lâng ha̍k-si̍p chòe hó-sū lâi kiong-kip si̍t-chè ê su-iàu, chiah bián chòe bô lō͘-ēng ê lâng.
Só͘-ū kap góa tī chia ê lâng beh kā lí chhéng-an. Chhiáⁿ thòe goán kā hiah-ê tâng-sìn ê hó pêng-iú chhéng-an. Goān Siōng-tè ê un-tián kap lín tāi-ke tông-chāi!
Góa sī Pó-lô, choh Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê siû-hoān; góa kap lán ê hiaⁿ-tī Thê-mô͘-thài siá-phoe hō͘ goán só͘ thiàⁿ ê tâng-kang Hui-lī-bûn,
goán ê chí-bē A-hui-a, goán ê chiàn-iú A-ki-pò͘, í-ki̍p tī lí ê chhù teh chū-hōe ê kàu-hōe.
Goān lán ê Pē Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sù lín un-tián kap pêng-an!
Góa ta̍k-piàn kî-tó ê sî lóng ū siūⁿ-tio̍h lí, siông-siông kám-siā góa ê Siōng-tè;
in-ūi góa ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h lí tùi Siōng-tè só͘-ū ê chú-bîn ū thiàⁿ-sim, tùi Chú Iâ-so͘ ū sìn-sim.
Góa khún-kiû Siōng-tè, thong-kè goán kap lín hun-hióng sìn-gióng, ōe-tàng chhiok-chìn lán tùi kap Ki-tok kiat-liân só͘ tit--tio̍h it-chhè ê chiok-hok, ū khah chhim ê liáu-kái.
Hiaⁿ-tī ah, lí ê thiàⁿ-sim ū hō͘ góa chin tōa ê hoaⁿ-hí kap kó͘-lē! Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn lóng ū tùi lí tit-tio̍h kek-lē.
Góa khò Ki-tok sui-jiân ōe-tàng hó-táⁿ bēng-lēng lí chòe eng-kai chòe ê tāi-chì,
m̄-kú, in-ūi thiàⁿ ê iân-kò͘ góa lêng-khó kā lí kiû. Góa Pó-lô í-keng nî-lāu, hiān-chāi iáu-sī Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ ê siû-hoān.
Góa thòe O-nî-se-bô͘ kā lí kiû, i sī góa koaiⁿ-kaⁿ ê sî só͘ siⁿ--ê.
I í-chêng tùi lí lóng bô lō͘-ēng, hiān-chāi tùi lí tùi góa lóng chin ū lō͘-ēng.
Hiān-chāi góa sàng i tńg-khì lí hia; i sī góa só͘ thiàⁿ-sioh--ê.
Góa goân-lâi siūⁿ-beh kā i lâu tī sin-piⁿ, thang tī góa ūi-tio̍h hok-im chòe siû-hoān ê tiong-kan thòe lí ho̍k-sāi góa;
m̄-kú bô lí ê tông-ì, góa mài án-ni chòe khah hó, hō͘ lí só͘ chòe ê hó-sū m̄-sī bián-kióng, sī kam-sim lo̍k-ì.
Kiám-chhái in-ūi án-ni, O-nî-se-bô͘ tio̍h chiām-sî lī-khui lí, sī beh hō͘ lí éng-kiú kā i lâu--teh;

bô koh sī lô͘-lē, sin-hūn chhiau-kè lô͘-lē, sī só͘ thiàⁿ ê hiaⁿ-tī. Tùi góa lâi kóng te̍k-pia̍t sī án-ni, tùi lí lâi kóng koh-khah sī án-ni; i m̄-nā sī lí ke-lāi ê lâng, mā-sī Chú-lāi ê hiaⁿ-tī.
Só͘-í, lí nā khòaⁿ góa chòe tâng-phōaⁿ, chiū tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ chiap-la̍p góa án-ni kā i chiap-la̍p.
I nā ū tùi lí chòe sím-mi̍h m̄-tio̍h, á-sī ū khiàm lí sím-mi̍h, sǹg góa ê siàu.
Góa Pó-lô chhin-chhiú siá: Góa hū-chek hêng. Góa eng-kai m̄-bián kā lí thê-chhíⁿ, lí khiàm--góa-ê sī lí pún-sin.
Sī lah, hiaⁿ-tī, in-ūi Chú ê iân-kò͘, kā góa tàu-saⁿ-kāng chi̍t-ē, hō͘ góa ê sim khò Ki-tok tit-tio̍h kek-lē.
Góa siá-phoe hō͘ lí, in-ūi khak-sìn lí ōe thiaⁿ góa ê iau-kiû; kî-si̍t, góa chai lí ōe chòe pí góa kóng--ê koh-khah chōe.
Mā tio̍h kā góa chún-pī chi̍t keng pâng-keng, in-ūi góa ǹg-bāng Siōng-tè ōe thiaⁿ lín ê kî-tó, hō͘ góa ōe-tàng khì lín hia.
Ūi-tio̍h Ki-tok Iâ-so͘ kap góa tâng choh siû-hoān ê Í-pa-hut beh kā lín chhéng-an.
Góa ê tâng-kang Má-khó, A-lí-ta̍t-kó͘, Tí-má, Lō͘-ka mā beh kā lín chhéng-an.
Goān Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê un-tián kap lín ê sim-lêng tông-chāi!
Siōng-tè tī kó͘-chá ū thong-kè I ê chèng sian-ti, chin chōe piàn, ēng chin chōe hong-sek tùi lán ê chó͘-sian kóng-ōe,
m̄-kú tī chiong-boa̍t ê ji̍t-chí, thong-kè I ê Kiáⁿ tùi lán kóng-ōe. Siōng-tè ū chí-tēng I choh bān-iú ê kè-sêng-jîn, koh ū thong-kè I chhòng-chō ú-tiū.

I hoán-siā Siōng-tè ê êng-iāu, sī Siōng-tè pún-chit ê chin-siōng. I ēng I koân-lêng ê ōe hû-chhî bān-iú, sóe-tû lâng ê chōe liáu-āu, chē tī Chì-chun Chì-koân Siōng-tè ê chiàⁿ-pêng.
Siōng-tè ū sù Kiáⁿ pí chèng thiⁿ-sài khah chun-kùi ê miâ, hō͘ I chiâⁿ-chòe pí thiⁿ-sài khah úi-tāi.

Siōng-tè m̄-bat tùi jīm-hô chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài kóng: Lí sī góa ê Kiáⁿ, góa kin-á-ji̍t siⁿ lí. I mā m̄-bat tùi jīm-hô chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài kóng: Góa beh chòe i ê Pē, i beh chòe góa ê Kiáⁿ.
Koh Siōng-tè chhe-khián I ê Tōa-kiáⁿ ji̍p sè-kan ê sî, I kóng: Siōng-tè só͘-ū ê thiⁿ-sài lóng tio̍h pài I.
Koan-hē thiⁿ-sài, I kóng: Siōng-tè ēng hong chòe I ê thiⁿ-sài, ēng hé-iām chòe I ê chhe-ēng.
M̄-kú koan-hē Kiáⁿ, I kóng: Siōng-tè ah, lí ê pó-chō éng-éng-oán-oán chûn-chāi; lí ê Kok ê koân-pèng sī chèng-ti̍t ê koân-pèng.
Lí ì-ài kong-gī, oàn-hūn put-hoat. Só͘-í, Siōng-tè — lí ê Siōng-tè kéng-soán lí, ēng hoaⁿ-hí ê iû boah lí, chhiau-kè boah lí ê tâng-phōaⁿ.
I koh kóng: Chú ah, lí tī khí-thâu kā tōe hē tōe-ki; thiⁿ mā-sī lí chhin-chhiú chhòng-chō.
Thiⁿ-tōe lóng ōe siau-sit, m̄-kú lí éng-oán chûn-chāi. Thiⁿ-tōe lóng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ i-ho̍k chiām-chiām kū,
lí ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ kńg gōa-saⁿ kā in kńg--khí-lâi; in ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ i-ho̍k kái-piàn. M̄-kú lí éng-oán bōe kái-piàn; lí ê hè-siū bû-kiông-chīn.
Siōng-tè kiám bat tùi tó chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài kóng: Lí chē góa ê chiàⁿ-pêng, thèng-hāu góa hō͘ lí ê tùi-te̍k khut-ho̍k tī lí kha-ē?
Thiⁿ-sài lóng sī teh ho̍k-sāi ê sîn, siū chhe-phài khì ho̍k-bū teh-beh niá-siū chín-kiù ê lâng.
Só͘-í, lán it-tēng tio̍h koh-khah tì-ì só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê sìn-sit, chiah bián phian-lī chin-tō.
In-ūi thong-kè thiⁿ-sài só͘ thoân ê sìn-sit nā ū kong-hāu, pōe-ge̍k bô sūn-chiông ê lâng tio̍h siū èng-siū ê hêng-hoa̍t;

án-ni lán hut-lio̍k chiah-ni̍h tōa ê chín-kiù, beh ná ōe-tàng siám-pī tio̍h siū ê hêng-hoa̍t? Chú pún-sin ū tāi-seng soan-pò͘ chit-ê chín-kiù, thiaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng mā ū tùi lán chèng-si̍t chit-ê sū.
Siōng-tè koh ū ēng sîn-jiah, kî-sū, ta̍k-khoán tōa koân-lêng ê chok-ûi, kap chiàu I ka-kī ê ì-sù só͘ hun-phòe Sèng Sîn ê un-sù chòe-hé choh-chèng.
Siōng-tè bô chiong lán só͘ kóng chit-ê chiong-lâi ê sè-kài kau hō͘ thiⁿ-sài koán-lí.
M̄-kú Sèng-keng ū chi̍t ê só͘-chāi choh-chèng kóng: Lâng sǹg sím-mi̍h, lí hiah-ni̍h koan-sim? Sè-kan-lâng sǹg sím-mi̍h, lí hiah-ni̍h chiàu-kò͘?
Lí hō͘ i pí thiⁿ-sài sió-khóa khah kē; lí sù êng-kng chun-kùi chòe hoa-koan kā i tì,

hō͘ bān-iú lóng hâng-ho̍k tī i kha-ē. Siōng-tè kì-jiân hō͘ bān-iú lóng hâng-ho̍k i, chiū bô chi̍t hāng bô hâng-ho̍k i. M̄-kú kàu hiān-chāi lán iáu-bē khòaⁿ-kìⁿ bān-iú lóng hâng-ho̍k i.

Lán khòaⁿ-kìⁿ hit-ūi pí thiⁿ-sài sió-khóa khah kē ê Iâ-so͘ í-keng keng-kè sí ê thòng-khó͘, tit-tio̍h êng-kng chun-kùi ê hoa-koan; án-ni I khò Siōng-tè ê un-tián thang ūi-tio̍h chèng-lâng sí.

Hit-ūi chhòng-chō koh î-chhî bān-iú ê Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h beh chhōa chin chōe kiáⁿ-jî chìn-ji̍p êng-kng, chiah tio̍h hō͘ chín-kiù ê khai-thok-chiá Iâ-so͘ keng-kè khó͘-lān chiâⁿ-chòe oân-choân.

Sū-si̍t, hō͘ lâng chiâⁿ-sèng--ê kap tit-tio̍h chiâⁿ-sèng--ê, lóng tùi kâng chi̍t ê goân-thâu chhut, in-ūi án-ni, Iâ-so͘ chheng-ho͘ in chòe hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē ia̍h bô kám-kak kiàn-siàu.
I tùi Siōng-tè kóng: Góa beh tùi góa ê hiaⁿ-tī kap chí-bē pò-iông lí ê miâ, tī in ê chū-hōe tiong gîm-si o-ló lí.
I koh kóng: Góa beh sìn-khò I; iā kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, góa kap Siōng-tè sù hō͘ góa ê kiáⁿ-jî lóng tī chia.

Kì-jiân chiah-ê kiáⁿ-jî sī ū-huih-ū-bah ê lâng, I pún-sin mā kap in siâng-khoán chiâⁿ-chòe ū-huih-ū-bah ê lâng, thang thong-kè I ê sí húi-bia̍t hit-ê chiáng-koán sí-bông ê Mô͘-kúi,
koh tháu-pàng hiah-ê in-ūi sí-bông ê kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ it-seng chòe lô͘-châi ê lâng.
Tong-jiân, I teh koan-sim--ê m̄-sī thiⁿ-sài, sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ-sun.

Só͘-í, I tī ta̍k hong-bīn tio̍h kap I ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē kâng-khoán, thang tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng choh jîn-chû tiong-sìn ê Tōa-chè-si, thang hō͘ chèng-lâng ê chōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
In-ūi I ka-kī ū siū-khó͘, siū khó-giām, I ōe-tàng pang-chān hiah-ê siū chhì-thàm ê lâng.
Só͘-í, lín tâng siū Siōng-tè soán-tiàu sèng ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín tio̍h siūⁿ lán só͘ soan-jīn hit-ūi choh sù-chiá, choh Tōa-chè-si ê Iâ-so͘.
I tùi chí-phài I ê Siōng-tè chīn-tiong, tú kap Mô͘-se tī Siōng-tè ê ke chīn-tiong kâng-khoán.
Khí-chhù ê lâng pí i khí ê chhù khah chun-kùi; án-ni, Iâ-so͘ pí Mô͘-se eng-kai siū koh-khah tōa ê êng-kng.
Só͘-ū ê chhù lóng sī lâng khí--ê, m̄-kú khí-chō bān-mi̍h--ê sī Siōng-tè.
Mô͘-se choh po̍k-jîn, tùi Siōng-tè ê choân-ke chīn-tiong, ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè āu-lâi só͘ beh kóng ê ōe choh-chèng;
m̄-kú, Ki-tok choh Kiáⁿ tī-lí Siōng-tè ê ke. Tùi só͘ ǹg-bāng--ê, lán nā ēng khak-sìn kap ióng-khì lâi chhî-siú, lán chiū-sī Siōng-tè ke-lāi ê lâng.
Só͘-í, chiàu Sèng Sîn só͘ kóng: Kin-á-ji̍t lín nā thiaⁿ Siōng-tè ê siaⁿ,
m̄-thang ngī-sim, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ê chó͘-sian tī pōe-ge̍k ê sî, tī khòng-iá chhì-thàm I ê ji̍t.
Siōng-tè kóng: Lín ê chó͘-sian sui-jiân ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h góa ê chok-ûi, in iû-goân tī hia chhì-thàm góa, khó-giām góa
sì-cha̍p nî kú. Só͘-í, góa tùi hit sè-tāi ê lâng siū-khì, kóng: In ê sim sit-bê; in m̄ bat góa ê tō-lō͘.
Góa tī siū-khì tiong li̍p-sè, kóng: In choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng chìn-ji̍p góa só͘ sù ê an-hioh.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín tio̍h chù-ì, chiah bián lín tiong-kan ū lâng sim siâ-ok m̄ sìn, tì-kàu lī-khui éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè.
Tio̍h thàn iáu ū hit-ê kiò-chòe “kin-á-ji̍t” ê sî, ji̍t-ji̍t saⁿ khoàn-bián, lín tiong-kan chiah bián ū lâng siū chōe-ok bê-he̍k tì-kàu ngī-sim.
Lán nā kian-siú tong-chho͘ ê khak-sìn kàu lō͘-bé, chiū chiâⁿ-chòe Ki-tok ê tâng-kang.
Sèng-keng án-ni kóng: Kin-á-ji̍t lín nā thiaⁿ Siōng-tè ê siaⁿ, m̄-thang ngī-sim, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín ê chó͘-sian tī pōe-ge̍k ê sî án-ni.
Thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè ê siaⁿ iáu-kú pōe-ge̍k I ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng? Kiám m̄-sī hiah-ê Mô͘-se tùi Ai-ki̍p chhōa--chhut-lâi só͘-ū ê lâng?
Siōng-tè tī hit sì-cha̍p nî kú tùi sím-mi̍h-lâng hoat siū-khì? Kiám m̄-sī hiah-ê in-ūi hoān-chōe sí tī khòng-iá ê lâng?
Hiah-ê pōe-ge̍k ê lâng í-gōa, Siōng-tè kiám bat tùi lâng li̍p-sè kóng, in bōe-tàng chìn-ji̍p I só͘ sù ê an-hioh?
Án-ni, in bōe-tàng chìn-ji̍p an-hioh sī in-ūi in m̄ sìn.
Kì-jiân Siōng-tè hō͘ lâng chìn-ji̍p an-hioh ê èng-ún iáu lâu--teh, lán tio̍h sió-sim, chiah bián lín tiong-kan ū lâng siūⁿ-kóng in tit bōe tio̍h chit-ê èng-ún.
Hok-im pîⁿ-pîⁿ ū thoân hō͘ in, mā ū thoân hō͘ lán; m̄-kú in só͘ thiaⁿ--kìⁿ ê sìn-sit tùi in bô lī-ek, in-ūi in hiah-ê thiaⁿ ê lâng bô ēng sìn-sim niá-siū.

Lán chiah-ê sìn ê lâng ōe-tàng chìn-ji̍p Siōng-tè só͘ sù ê an-hioh, chiàu I kóng--ê: Góa tī siū-khì tiong li̍p-sè, kóng: In choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng chìn-ji̍p góa só͘ sù ê an-hioh! Kî-si̍t Siōng-tè chhòng-chō ú-tiū ê sî, I ê kang-chok í-keng oân-sêng.
Koan-hē tē-chhit ji̍t, Sèng-keng chi̍t ê só͘-chāi ū án-ni kóng, “Siōng-tè tī tē-chhit ji̍t soah I it-chhè ê kang-chok lâi an-hioh.”
Kâng chit-ê só͘-chāi ū koh kóng, “In choa̍t-tùi bōe-tàng chìn-ji̍p góa só͘ sù ê an-hioh.”
Kì-jiân tāi-seng thiaⁿ-tio̍h hok-im ê lâng in-ūi m̄ sūn-thàn bōe-tàng chìn-ji̍p an-hioh, Siōng-tè chiū ūi-tio̍h kî-tha ê lâng pó-liû chit-ê an-hioh.

Chin kú í-āu, tī Tāi-pi̍t ê chheh ū kì-chài, Siōng-tè siat-tēng chi̍t ji̍t kiò-chòe “kin-á-ji̍t”, chhin-chhiūⁿ téng-bīn kóng--ê: Kin-á-ji̍t lín nā thiaⁿ Siōng-tè ê siaⁿ, m̄-thang ngī-sim.
Iok-su-a nā ū hō͘ in an-hioh, Siōng-tè chiū bōe tī āu-lâi koh kóng-khí pa̍t-ê ji̍t.
Án-ni, Siōng-tè iáu ūi-tio̍h I ê chú-bîn pó-liû chi̍t ê An-hioh-ji̍t ê an-hioh.
In-ūi chìn-ji̍p Siōng-tè só͘ sù an-hioh ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ Siōng-tè soah I ê kang-chok, mā soah in it-chhè ê kang-chok.
Só͘-í, lán tio̍h lô-le̍k chìn-ji̍p chit-ê an-hioh, chiah bián ū lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ hiah-ê m̄ sūn-ho̍k ê lâng poa̍h-tó sit-pāi.

Siōng-tè ê ōe sī oa̍h--ê, sī ū kong-hāu--ê, pí it-chhè siang-bīn-lāi ê kiàm khah lāi, ōe-tàng chhah-ji̍p, sīm-chì phòa-khui lâng ê lêng kap hûn, koan-chat kap kut-chhé, koh ōe-tàng phòaⁿ-toàn lâng sim-lāi ê io̍k-bōng kap ì-liām.
Só͘-ū pī-chō-bu̍t bô chi̍t hāng ōe-tàng tùi Siōng-tè ún-ba̍t; it-chhè lóng oân-choân po̍k-lō͘ tī I ê ba̍k-chiu chêng. Lán khiàm I ê siàu lóng tio̍h sǹg chheng-chhó.
Kì-jiân lán ū chi̍t ūi úi-tāi ê Tōa-chè-si — Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘, I í-keng chiūⁿ-thiⁿ kàu Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng, lán tio̍h kian-siú só͘ soan-jīn ê sìn-gióng.
Lán chit-ūi Tōa-chè-si m̄-sī bōe thé-thiap lán ê loán-jio̍k; I tī ta̍k hong-bīn lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ lán ū siū chhì-thàm, put-kò bô hoān-chōe.
Só͘-í, lán tio̍h hó-táⁿ chiū-kūn Siōng-tè un-tián ê pó-chō, thang niá-siū I ê lîn-bín kap un-tián, chòe lán su-iàu ê sî ê pang-chān.
Ta̍k-ê tōa-chè-si lóng sī tùi lâng ê tiong-kan kéng--chhut-lâi, siū chí-phài thòe lâng ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè, ūi-tio̍h in ê chōe hiàn lé-mi̍h kap chè-phín.
Tōa-chè-si, in-ūi i pún-sin tī ta̍k hong-bīn lóng loán-jio̍k, só͘-í ōe-tàng thé-liōng bû-ti kap sit-bê ê lâng.
In-ūi án-ni, i ū gī-bū ūi-tio̍h jîn-bîn, mā tio̍h ūi ka-kī ê chōe hiàn-chè.
Bô lâng ka-kī tit-tio̍h tōa-chè-si chit-ê chun-kùi ê chit-hūn; chí-ū chhin-chhiūⁿ A-lûn, hō͘ Siōng-tè soán-tiàu--ê chiah ōe tit-tio̍h.
Siâng-khoán, Ki-tok mā m̄-sī ka-kī cheng-chhú tōa-chè-si ê êng-iāu, hoán-tńg sī Siōng-tè tùi I kóng: Lí sī góa ê Kiáⁿ, góa kin-á-ji̍t siⁿ lí.
Tī pa̍t-ūi I mā ū kóng: Chiàu Be̍k-ki-sé-tek ê pan-chhù, lí éng-oán choh chè-si.

Iâ-so͘ chāi-sè ê sî bat tōa-siaⁿ âu-kiò koh lâu ba̍k-sái, ǹg hit-ūi ōe-tàng kiù I thoat-lī sí-bông ê Siōng-tè kî-tó khún-kiû. In-ūi I ê khiân-sêng, Siōng-tè ū thiaⁿ I ê kî-kiû.
Sui-jiân I sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ, iáu-kú ū tùi só͘ siū ê khó͘-lān ha̍k-si̍p sūn-ho̍k.
Kì-jiân Siōng-tè hō͘ I ta̍t-kàu oân-choân ê tōe-pō͘, I chiū chiâⁿ-chòe só͘-ū sūn-ho̍k I ê lâng éng-oán tit-kiù ê kun-goân,
hō͘ Siōng-tè chí-tēng I chiàu Be̍k-ki-sé-tek ê pan-chhù choh Tōa-chè-si.
Koan-hē Iâ-so͘ choh Tōa-chè-si ê sū, goán ū chin chōe ōe ài kóng, m̄-kú oh-tit soat-bêng, in-ūi lín hī-khang tūn.
Chiàu kóng, lín chá chiū eng-kai chòe lāu-su lah, m̄-kú lín iáu su-iàu lâng kā lín kà Siōng-tè sìn-sit ê chho͘-pō͘; lín iáu su-iàu chia̍h-lin, bōe-tàng chia̍h-pn̄g.
Chia̍h-lin--ê lóng sī eⁿ-á, iáu bōe-hiáu liáu-kái sī-hui ê tō-lí.
Tōa-lâng chiah chia̍h-pn̄g; in sio̍k-lêng ê sim-khiàu ū keng-kè si̍t-chè ê chhau-liān chiah ōe-hiáu hun-pia̍t hó-pháiⁿ.

Só͘-í, lán m̄-thang thêng-liû tī Ki-tok chho͘-pō͘ ê tō-lí, tio̍h tui-kiû sêng-se̍k; bô koh-chài kan-ta tī thoat-lī sí ê hêng-ûi kap sìn Siōng-tè, kiat-chēng-lé kap àn-chhiú-lé, sí-lâng ê koh-oa̍h kap éng-oán ê sím-phòaⁿ, téng ê kà-sī teh phah ki-chhó͘.
Siōng-tè nā chún, lán beh án-ni chòe.

Hiah-ê lâng bat hō͘ Siōng-tè ê kng chiò, bat tam-tio̍h sio̍k-thiⁿ ê un-sù, bat hun-hióng Sèng Sîn, bat thé-giām Siōng-tè ê ōe ê hó-chhù, mā bat kám-siū teh-beh lâi ê sè-tāi ê koân-pèng. Án-ni, in iáu-kú pōe-sìn! Chit-khoán lâng bô hoat-tō͘ hō͘ in têng-sin hóe-kái kiâⁿ tò-tńg; in-ūi in koh chiong Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ tèng tī si̍p-jī-kè téng, kong-jiân kā I bú-jio̍k.
Thó͘-tōe put-sî teh khip-siu tùi thiⁿ lo̍h--lâi ê hō͘-chúi, seng-sán chhài-soe, tùi choh-sit-lâng ū lō͘-ēng, che sī tùi Siōng-tè niá-siū ê chiok-hok.
M̄-kú thó͘-tōe nā hoat chháu-chhì kap cha̍p-chháu chiū bô lō͘-ēng, liâm-piⁿ ōe siū chiù-chó͘, chòe-āu hō͘ hé sio.
Só͘ thiàⁿ ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, sui-jiân goán án-ni kóng, iáu-kú chhim-sìn lín ê chêng-hêng pí só͘ kóng--ê khah hó, ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h kiù.
Siōng-tè m̄-sī bô kong-tō, I it-tēng ōe-kì-tit lín só͘ chòe ê kang-chok, chiū-sī lín ūi-tio̍h I kè-sio̍k teh ho̍k-bū sìn-tô͘ só͘ piáu-hiān ê thiàⁿ-sim.
Goán chin ài lín ta̍k-ê lâng tùi thâu kàu bé pó-chhî jia̍t-sim, hō͘ lín só͘ ǹg-bāng--ê ōe oân-choân si̍t-hiān.
Án-ni lín chiah bōe pîn-tōaⁿ, chiah ōe o̍h hiah-ê tùi sìn kap thun-lún lâi sêng-siū Siōng-tè èng-ún ê lâng.
Siōng-tè èng-ún A-pek-la-hán ê sî, kì-jiân bô pí I khah-tōa--ê thang li̍p-sè, chiū kí pún-sin li̍p-sè,
kóng, “Góa it-tēng beh sù-hok hō͘ lí, beh ke-thiⁿ kiáⁿ-sun hō͘ lí.”
A-pek-la-hán gâu thun-lún, só͘-í ū tit-tio̍h só͘ èng-ún--ê.
In-ūi lâng sī kí pí i khah-tōa--ê lâi li̍p-sè; mā ēng li̍p-sè chòe tam-pó lâi kái-koat in tiong-kan só͘-ū ê cheng-chip.
Siōng-tè ài hiah-ê sêng-chiap èng-ún ê lâng khak-si̍t chai, I ê kè-ōe bōe kái-piàn, só͘-í ēng li̍p-sè lâi pó-chèng.

I ê èng-ún kap li̍p-sè chit nn̄g hāng lóng bōe kái-piàn, in-ūi I bōe kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, hō͘ lán chiah-ê tô-pī khì kiû I pó-hō͘ ê lâng ōe-tàng tit-tio̍h chin tōa ê kek-lē, thang chhî-siú hit-ê tī lán thâu-chêng ê ǹg-bāng.
Lán ū chit-ê ǹg-bāng, chhin-chhiūⁿ sìⁿ-miā ê tiàⁿ pha tī Sèng-só͘ tiùⁿ-lî ê lāi-bīn an-choân khó-khò.
Iâ-so͘ ūi-tio̍h lán chòe sian-hong í-keng ji̍p-khì hia, chiàu Be̍k-ki-sé-tek ê pan-chhù choh Tōa-chè-si ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.

Chit-ūi Be̍k-ki-sé-tek sī Sat-léng -ông, mā-sī Chì-koân Siōng-tè ê chè-si. A-pek-la-hán thâi-sí hiah-ê ông tńg--lâi ê sî, Be̍k-ki-sé-tek ū kā i gêng-chiap koh kā i chiok-hok.
A-pek-la-hán ū chiong i só͘ tit--tio̍h ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t hō͘ i. Tē-it, Be̍k-ki-sé-tek chit-ê miâ ê ì-sù sī “Chèng-gī ê ông”, i koh sī Sat-léng -ông, chiū-sī “Hô-pêng-ông”.
I bô pē bô bú, bô sè-hē, bô chhut-sì ê ji̍t-chí, mā bô sìⁿ-miā ê kiat-sok. I kap Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ kâng-khoán; i kè-sio̍k choh chè-si ti̍t-kàu éng-oán.
Lín khòaⁿ, chit-ê lâng jōa úi-tāi! Sian-chó͘ A-pek-la-hán to tio̍h chiong chiàn-lī-phín ê cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t hō͘ i.

Ū tam-tng chè-si-chit ê Lī-bī ê kiáⁿ-sun, sui-jiân kap kî-tha Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn lóng sī A-pek-la-hán ê kiáⁿ-sun, pîⁿ-pîⁿ sī hiaⁿ-tī, iáu-kú hōng bēng-lēng chiàu Lu̍t-hoat tùi jîn-bîn siu cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t.
Be̍k-ki-sé-tek m̄-sī sio̍k Lī-bī ê sè-hē, m̄-kú i ū tùi A-pek-la-hán chiap-siū cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t, koh kā tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè èng-ún ê A-pek-la-hán chiok-hok.
Sī-sòe siū sī-tōa chiok-hok sī lí-só͘-tong-jiân.
Chi̍t hong-bīn, chiah-ê siu cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t--ê lóng sī ōe sí ê lâng; lēng-gōa chi̍t hong-bīn, hit-ūi siu cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t--ê, Sèng-keng ū chèng-si̍t i iáu-teh oa̍h.
Án-ni mā thang kóng, tùi lâng siu cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t ê Lī-bī í-keng thong-kè A-pek-la-hán tùi Be̍k-ki-sé-tek la̍p cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t.
In-ūi Be̍k-ki-sé-tek gêng-chiap A-pek-la-hán ê sî, Lī-bī iáu tī i ê sian-chó͘ A-pek-la-hán ê seng-khu lāi.

Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê Lu̍t-hoat sī kun-kù Lī-bī ê chè-si chè-tō͘ pan-hoat--ê, chit-ê chè-tō͘ nā ōe-tàng hō͘ lâng oân-choân, ná ū su-iàu m̄-sī chiàu A-lûn ê pan-chhù, sī chiàu Be̍k-ki-sé-tek pan-chhù siat-li̍p ê lēng-gōa chi̍t ê chè-si?
Kì-jiân chè-si chè-tō͘ kái-piàn, Lu̍t-hoat mā tio̍h kái-piàn.
In-ūi chiah-ê sū só͘ chí Hit-ūi sī sio̍k pa̍t-ê chi-cho̍k; chit-ê chi-cho̍k m̄-bat ū lâng tī chè-tôaⁿ chêng sū-hōng.
Lán ê Chú bêng-bêng sī Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k ê kiáⁿ-sun; koan-hē chit-ê chi-cho̍k, Mô͘-se m̄-bat kóng-khí chè-si ê sū.
Taⁿ, góa teh kóng ê tāi-chì koh-khah chheng-chhó, in-ūi ū lēng-gōa chi̍t ūi chhin-chhiūⁿ Be̍k-ki-sé-tek ê chè-si í-keng chhut-hiān.
I choh Chè-si m̄-sī kun-kù lâng ê tiâu-lē kui-chek, sī kun-kù bōe húi-bia̍t ê oa̍h-miā ê koân-lêng.
In-ūi Sèng-keng ū án-ni choh-chèng: Chiàu Be̍k-ki-sé-tek ê pan-chhù, lí éng-oán choh chè-si.
Chi̍t hong-bīn, kū ê tiâu-lē in-ūi bô-la̍t, bô lō͘-ēng, soah siū hòe-bô,

in-ūi Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat sím-mi̍h tāi-chì to bô hoat-tō͘ sêng-choân. Lēng-gōa chi̍t hong-bīn, ū chi̍t ê khah hó ê ǹg-bāng í-keng chún-pī hó-sè, hō͘ lán thang thong-kè chit-ê ǹg-bāng chhin-kūn Siōng-tè.
Koh chit-ê ǹg-bāng ū keng-kè soan-sè. Lī-bī hē-thóng ê chè-si bô keng-kè soan-sè;
chí-ū chit-ūi Iâ-so͘ choh Chè-si ê sî ū keng-kè soan-sè; I ê Siōng-tè tùi I kóng: Chú ū soan-sè, bōe kái-piàn sim-ì; lí éng-oán choh chè-si.
Chiū-sī in-ūi án-ni, Iâ-so͘ chiâⁿ-chòe koh-khah hó ê iok ê pó-chèng.
Lī-bī hē-thóng ê chè-si ū chin chōe, in-ūi sí ê chó͘-gāi in bōe-tàng kè-sio̍k chòe;
chí-ū Iâ-so͘ m̄-bián chiong chè-si-chit kau hō͘ pa̍t-lâng, in-ūi I éng-oán oa̍h--teh.
Án-ni, thong-kè I lâi kàu Siōng-tè bīn-chêng ê lâng, I ōe-tàng kiù in kàu-tóe, in-ūi I éng-oán oa̍h--teh teh thòe in kî-tó.
Chit-khoán Tōa-chè-si tú-tú ha̍h lán ê su-iàu; I sèng-kiat, bô siâ-ok, bô lâ-sâm, tùi chōe-jîn tiong siū hun-pia̍t--chhut-lâi, ko-seng kàu pí thiⁿ khah koân.

I bô su-iàu chhin-chhiūⁿ kî-tha ê tōa-chè-si ta̍k-ji̍t tio̍h seng ūi-tio̍h ka-kī, āu-lâi ūi-tio̍h jîn-bîn ê chōe hiàn-chè. I hiàn pún-sin chòe chè-mi̍h, chi̍t piàn chiū oân-sêng.
Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat jīm-bēng bô oân-choân ê lâng choh tōa-chè-si; m̄-kú ū Lu̍t-hoat í-āu, Siōng-tè ēng soan-sè jīm-bēng I ê Kiáⁿ éng-oán choh oân-choân ê Tōa-chè-si.
Lán só͘ teh kóng siōng iàu-kín--ê sī án-ni: Lán ū chit-khoán ê Tōa-chè-si, I chē tī thiⁿ-téng Chì-tōa Siōng-tè pó-chō ê chiàⁿ-pêng.
I tī Sèng-só͘, chiū-sī chin ê tiùⁿ-bō͘, teh sū-hōng; chit-ê tiùⁿ-bō͘ m̄-sī lâng, sī Chú só͘ tah--ê.
Ta̍k-ê tōa-chè-si lóng sī ūi-tio̍h hiàn lé-mi̍h kap chè-phín jīm-bēng--ê; só͘-í chit-ūi Tōa-chè-si mā it-tēng tio̍h ū sím-mi̍h thang hiàn.
I nā tī tōe-chiūⁿ chiū bô choh chè-si, in-ūi í-keng ū chè-si chiàu Lu̍t-hoat teh hiàn lé-mi̍h.

In só͘ chòe ê ho̍k-sāi put-kò sī thiⁿ-téng tiùⁿ-bō͘ ê hù-pún kap iáⁿ-siōng, tú chiàu Mô͘-se beh khí-chō hōe-bō͘ ê sî, Siōng-tè ū kā i chí-sī, kóng, “Lí tio̍h kín-sīn, it-chhè tio̍h chiàu tī soaⁿ-téng kā lí chí-sī ê bô͘-sek lâi khí.”
M̄-kú hiān-chāi Iâ-so͘ í-keng tit-tio̍h koh-khah chun-kùi ê sū-hōng, choh khah hó ê iok ê tiong-kan-jîn; chit-ê iok sī ēng khah hó ê èng-ún chè-tēng--ê.
Thâu chi̍t ê iok nā bô khoat-tiám, chiū bô su-iàu li̍p tē-jī ê iok.
M̄-kú Siōng-tè kā in chí-chek kóng: Chú kóng: Khòaⁿ leh, ji̍t-chí teh-beh kàu, góa beh kap Í-sek-lia̍t -ke kap Iû-tāi -ke li̍p sin ê iok.

Chit-ê iok bô chhin-chhiūⁿ góa í-chêng kap in ê chó͘-sian só͘ li̍p--ê, chiū-sī khan in ê chhiú, chhōa in chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sî só͘ li̍p--ê; in-ūi in bô kè-sio̍k siú góa ê iok, só͘-í góa m̄ chhap in.

Chú koh kóng: Hiah-ê ji̍t í-āu, góa kap Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng só͘ beh li̍p ê iok sī án-ni: Góa beh chiong góa ê Lu̍t-hoat khǹg tī in ê náu-lāi, siá tī in ê sim-lāi. Góa beh chòe in ê Siōng-tè; in beh chòe góa ê chú-bîn.
In lóng bōe koh kà-sī in ê tông-pau, á-sī ka-kī ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē kóng: Tio̍h jīn-bat Chú, in-ūi in tùi siōng-sòe kàu siōng-tōa--ê, lóng ōe jīn-bat góa.
Góa beh sià-bián in ê put-gī, bōe koh kì-tit in ê chōe-ok.
Kì-jiân kóng-kàu sin ê iok, Siōng-tè chiū hō͘ thâu chi̍t ê iok pìⁿ-chòe kū--ê. Hit-ê chiām-chiām kū teh soe-thè ê iok liâm-piⁿ chiū siau-sit.
Thâu chi̍t ê iok mā ū lé-pài ê kui-tēng kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê sèng-só͘.
Ū chi̍t ê tah hó-sè ê tiùⁿ-bō͘, thâu-chêng-keng kiò-chòe Sèng-só͘, lāi-bīn ū teng-tâi, toh, kap hiàn-chè ê piáⁿ.
Tē-jī ê tiùⁿ-lî ê āu-bīn-keng kiò-chòe Chì-sèng-só͘,
lāi-bīn ū kim-hiuⁿ-tôaⁿ kap choân-pō͘ ēng kim pau ê iok-kūi, kūi-lāi ū tóe má-ná ê kim-ô͘, A-lûn hit-ki puh-gê ê koáiⁿ-á, kap nn̄g tè iok ê chio̍h-pán.
Kūi-téng ū êng-kng ê thiⁿ-sài ki-lō͘-pek, in ê si̍t jia-khàm si-un-chō. Koan-hē chiah-ê sū, hiān-chāi góa bōe-tàng siông-sè soat-bêng.
Chiah-ê mi̍h-kiāⁿ chiàu án-ni an-pâi hó-sè, chè-si chiū ta̍k-ji̍t ji̍p-khì tiùⁿ-bō͘ ê thâu-chêng-keng kú-hêng lé-pài gî-sek.

Āu-bīn-keng chí-ū tōa-chè-si chiah thang ji̍p--khì, m̄-kú ta̍k-nî chí-ū chi̍t piàn, ta̍k-piàn tio̍h tòa huih ji̍p--khì, ūi-tio̍h pún-sin í-ki̍p bîn-chiòng bô-ì-tiong hoān ê chōe lâi hiàn.
Tùi chiah-ê an-pâi Sèng Sîn ū bêng-bêng piáu-sī, tiùⁿ-bō͘ ê thâu-chêng-keng iáu chûn-chāi, chìn-ji̍p Chì-sèng-só͘ ê lō͘ chiū iáu-bē khui.
Tiùⁿ-bō͘ ê thâu-chêng-keng phì-jū hiān-sè, sī kóng, só͘ hiàn ê lé-mi̍h kap chè-phín bōe-tàng hō͘ lé-pài ê lâng ê liông-sim chheng-pe̍k.
Chiah-ê kan-ta sī koan-hē lim-chia̍h kap ta̍k-khoán ê kiat-chēng-lé, sī sio̍k gōa-piáu ê kui-lē, chí-ū sek-iōng kàu Siōng-tè keng-sin bān-mi̍h ê sî.
M̄-kú Ki-tok í-keng lâi, choh Tōa-chè-si, ū si̍t-hiān hó-sū. I ū keng-kè khah-tōa, khah oân-choân, m̄-sī lâng ê chhiú só͘ tah, m̄-sī sio̍k chit sè-kan ê tiùⁿ-bō͘.
I chí-ū chi̍t piàn chìn-ji̍p Chì-sèng-só͘, m̄-sī ēng soaⁿ-iûⁿ ê huih kap gû-á ê huih, sī ēng ka-kī ê huih ūi-tio̍h lán sêng-choân éng-oán ê kiù-sio̍k.
Soaⁿ-iûⁿ kap gû-káng ê huih, í-ki̍p gû-bú-á ê kut-hu nā hiù tī bô chheng-khì ê lâng to ōe hō͘ in sèng-hòa chheng-khì,

hô-hòng Ki-tok thong-kè éng-oán ê Sîn hiàn I bô hâ-chhû ê pún-sin hō͘ Siōng-tè, I ê huih kiám bōe hō͘ lán ê liông-sim koh-khah chheng-khì, thoat-lī sí ê hêng-ûi, lâi ho̍k-sāi éng-oa̍h ê Siōng-tè?

In-ūi án-ni, Ki-tok chòe sin ê iok ê tiong-kan-jîn, sī beh hō͘ Siōng-tè ho͘-tiàu ê lâng ōe-tit niá-siū I só͘ èng-ún éng-oán ê sán-gia̍p, in-ūi Ki-tok í-keng ēng I ê sí sio̍k-hôe in tī chêng ê iok ê sî só͘ hoān ê chōe-kò.
Koan-hē ûi-chiok, it-tēng tio̍h seng chèng-si̍t li̍p ûi-chiok ê lâng í-keng sí.
In-ūi ûi-chiok it-tēng tio̍h li̍p ûi-chiok ê lâng sí chiah ū-hāu. Li̍p ûi-chiok ê lâng iáu oa̍h--teh, ûi-chiok chiū bô-hāu.
Án-ni, liân thâu chi̍t ê iok mā-sī ū ēng huih lâi sêng-li̍p.

Mô͘-se chiàu Lu̍t-hoat chiong it-chhè ê kài-bēng tùi jîn-bîn soan-pò͘, jiân-āu phâng gû-káng kap soaⁿ-iûⁿ ê huih chham chúi, ēng chu-âng-sek ê iûⁿ-mn̂g kap gû-chhek-chháu hiù tī hit-pún chheh ê téng-bīn kap choân-thé jîn-bîn ê sin-chiūⁿ,
kóng, “Che sī Siōng-tè kap lín li̍p-iok ê huih.”
Siâng-khoán, Mô͘-se mā chiong huih hiù tī tiùⁿ-bō͘ kap lé-pài ê sî só͘ ēng it-chhè ê khì-khū.
Chiàu Lu̍t-hoat, chha-put-to só͘-ū ê mi̍h lóng ēng huih kiat-chēng; bô lâu-huih chiū bô sià-chōe.

Chiàu thiⁿ-téng ê khoán-sit só͘ hóng-chō ê mi̍h su-iàu ēng cheng-siⁿ ê huih lâi kiat-chēng; m̄-kú thiⁿ-téng ê goân-mi̍h su-iàu ēng pí chiah-ê khah hó ê chè-mi̍h lâi kiat-chēng.

Ki-tok ji̍p--khì-ê pèng m̄-sī lâng ê chhiú chō ê Sèng-só͘, che put-kò sī chin Sèng-só͘ ê hù-pún; I sī ji̍p-khì thiⁿ-téng ê chin Sèng-só͘. I hiān-chāi ūi-tio̍h lán chhut-hiān tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng.
Ki-tok m̄-bián chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn hiàn pún-sin, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chè-si tio̍h ta̍k-nî kè-sio̍k tòa cheng-siⁿ ê huih ji̍p-khì Chì-sèng-só͘.

Nā tio̍h chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn hiàn, tùi chhòng-chō sè-kài í-lâi, Ki-tok tio̍h chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn siū-khó͘. M̄-kú hiān-chāi tī chit-ê sè-tāi ê lō͘-bé, I chí-ū chhut-hiān chi̍t piàn, chiong pún-sin hiàn chòe chè lâi tû-khì chōe.
Chiàu só͘ chù-tiāⁿ, lâng tio̍h chi̍t piàn sí, sí-āu tio̍h siū Siōng-tè sím-phòaⁿ.

Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, Ki-tok í-keng ū chi̍t piàn hi-seng lâi tam-tng chèng-lâng ê chōe; I ōe tē-jī piàn hián-hiān, m̄-sī beh tùi-hù chōe, sī beh chín-kiù pek-chhiat teh thèng-hāu I lâi ê lâng.

Kì-jiân Lu̍t-hoat m̄-sī teh-beh lâi hó-sū pún-sin ê chin-siōng, sī hó-sū ê iáⁿ, só͘-í bōe-tàng chi̍t nî kè chi̍t nî kè-sio̍k ēng siâng-khoán ê chè-mi̍h hō͘ chhin-kūn Siōng-tè ê lâng tit-tio̍h oân-choân.
Nā-sī ōe, hiàn-chè ê sū eng-kai í-keng thêng-chí ah, in-ūi kèng-pài ê lâng chi̍t piàn chiū oân-choân tit-tio̍h kiat-chēng, bô koh ū chōe ê ì-sek.
Kî-si̍t, ta̍k-nî só͘ hiàn ê chè-mi̍h chí-ū ōe hō͘ lâng siūⁿ-khí in ê chōe;
in-ūi gû, iûⁿ ê huih bōe-tàng tû-khì lâng ê chōe.
Só͘-í, Ki-tok lâi kàu sè-kan ê sî ū kóng: Chè-sū kap lé-mi̍h, lí bô ài; m̄-kú lí ū kā góa chún-pī seng-khu.
Sio-hòa-chè kap sio̍k-chōe-chè, lí bô kah-ì.
Hit-sî góa kóng: Siōng-tè ah, góa lâi lah; góa lâi sī beh si̍t-hêng lí ê chí-ì. Góa ê sū ū kì-chài tī chheh--ni̍h.
Góa téng-bīn ū kóng, “Chè-sū kap lé-mi̍h, sio-hòa-chè kap sio̍k-chōe-chè lí bô ài, mā bô kah-ì; chiah-ê sī chiàu Lu̍t-hoat lâi hiàn--ê.”
I sòa lo̍h-khì kóng, “Khòaⁿ ah, góa lâi sī beh si̍t-hêng lí ê chí-ì.” Án-ni, Siōng-tè hòe-tû chêng--ê, sī beh kiàn-li̍p āu--ê.
Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok si̍t-hêng Siōng-tè ê chí-ì, chí-ū chi̍t piàn hiàn I ka-kī ê seng-khu chiū kàu-gia̍h hō͘ lán tit-tio̍h sèng-hòa kui Siōng-tè.
Chè-si ta̍k-ji̍t khiā-teh ho̍k-sāi Siōng-tè, chi̍t-piàn koh chi̍t-piàn hiàn siâng-khoán ê chè, éng-oán bōe-tàng tû-khì lâng ê chōe.
M̄-kú Ki-tok chí-ū chi̍t piàn hiàn sio̍k-chōe-chè, jiân-āu chē tī Siōng-tè ê chiàⁿ-pêng,
thèng-hāu Siōng-tè hō͘ I ê tùi-te̍k chòe I ê kha-tiam.
Ki-tok thong-kè chi̍t piàn ê hiàn-chè, hō͘ sèng-hòa kui Chú ê lâng éng-oán oân-choân.
Sèng Sîn mā ū tùi lán choh-chèng. I ū kóng:
Chú kóng: Hiah-ê ji̍t-chí í-āu, Góa kap in só͘ beh li̍p ê iok chiū-sī án-ni: Góa beh chiong góa ê Lu̍t-hoat khǹg tī in ê sim-lāi, siá tī in ê náu-lāi.
Jiân-āu I koh kóng: Góa bōe koh kì-tit in ê chōe-ok kap kè-hoān.
Kì-jiân chōe í-keng tit-tio̍h sià-bián, chiū m̄-bián koh hiàn sio̍k-chōe-chè.
Só͘-í, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lán khò Iâ-so͘ lâu-huih sí ōe-tàng ū khak-sìn kap ióng-khì chìn-ji̍p Chì-sèng-só͘.
I thong-kè tiùⁿ-lî, chiū-sī ka-kī ê seng-khu, kā lán khui chi̍t tiâu sin koh oa̍h ê lō͘.
Lán í-keng ū chi̍t ūi úi-tāi ê Chè-si teh tī-lí Siōng-tè ê ke,
lán tio̍h ēng chin-sêng ê sim, kian-koat ê sìn, chheng-khì bô khui-khiàm ê liông-sim kap chheng-chúi sóe--kè ê seng-khu lâi chhin-kūn Siōng-tè.
Lán tio̍h kian-koat chhî-siú só͘ soan-jīn ê ǹg-bāng, in-ūi èng-ún lán ê Siōng-tè khó-khò.
Lán tio̍h hō͘-siōng koan-sim thang kek-lē saⁿ-thiàⁿ kap chòe hó-sū.
Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng thêng-chí chū-hōe, m̄-thang o̍h in ê si̍p-koàn, tian-tò tio̍h hō͘-siōng khoàn-bián; kì-jiân lín chai Chú ê Ji̍t teh-beh kàu, koh-khah tio̍h án-ni.
Lán jīn-bat chin-lí í-āu iáu kò͘-ì hoān-chōe, chiū bô koh ū thang sio̍k-chōe ê chè-mi̍h,
chí-ū ēng kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ê sim thèng-hāu sím-phòaⁿ kap teh-beh sio-bia̍t te̍k-tùi Siōng-tè ê lâng ê lia̍t-hé.
Ûi-hoān Mô͘-se ê Lu̍t-hoat--ê, kun-kù nn̄g ê á-sī saⁿ ê lâng choh-chèng chiū thang kā i chhú-sí, lóng bô khoan-sià.
Án-ni, thún-ta̍h Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ, biáu-sī hō͘ in sèng-hòa kui Chú ê iok ê huih, koh bú-bān si-un ê Sèng Sîn ê lâng, lín siūⁿ in eng-kai siū ê hêng-hoa̍t ōe ke jōa tāng?
Lán chai, kóng “Sin-oan chāi-tī góa, góa ōe pò-èng”, koh kóng “Chú beh sím-phòaⁿ I ê chú-bîn” hit-ūi sī sím-mi̍h-lâng?
Hām-lo̍h éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê chhiú si̍t-chāi chin thang kiaⁿ!
Lín tio̍h ōe-kì-tit kè-khì ê ji̍t-chí. Lín siū Siōng-tè ê kng chiò í-āu, ū jím-siū tōa cheng-tò͘ ê khó͘-lān;
ū sî lín kong-jiân siū bú-jio̍k, ge̍k-thāi; ū sî lín kap pa̍t-lâng tâng siū ge̍k-thāi.
Lín kap siû-hoān tâng siū-khó͘; lín ê châi-bu̍t siū chhiúⁿ-toa̍t mā kam-goān jím-siū, in-ūi chai lín ka-kī ū koh-khah hó koh éng-oán chûn-chāi ê sán-gia̍p.
Só͘-í, m̄-thang sit-lo̍h ióng-khì; chit-ê ióng-khì ōe hō͘ lín tōa ê pò-siúⁿ.
Lín tio̍h ū nāi-sim chiah ōe-tàng si̍t-hêng Siōng-tè ê chí-ì, niá-siū I só͘ èng-ún ê hok-hūn.
In-ūi koh chi̍t-sî-á kú, Hit-ūi teh-beh-lâi--ê ōe kàu, bōe iân-tî.
M̄-kú sio̍k góa ê gī-lâng ōe tùi sìn lâi oa̍h. Nā ū lâng tiû-tû thè-āu, góa chiū bô kah-ì.
Lán leh, lán m̄-sī thè-āu tì-kàu tîm-lûn, sī tùi sìn tì-kàu sìⁿ-miā tit-tio̍h pó-choân.
Sìn sī tùi só͘ ǹg-bāng ê sū ū pá-ak, tùi bô khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê sū ōe-tàng khéng-tēng.
Kó͘-chá-lâng in-ūi chit-ê sìn tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè jīn-tēng chiap-la̍p.
Tùi sìn, lán chai ú-tiū sī tùi Siōng-tè ê ōe chhòng-chō--ê; án-ni khòaⁿ ōe tio̍h--ê sī tùi khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h--ê lâi chō--ê.

Tùi sìn, A-pek pí Kai-ún hiàn khah hó ê chè-mi̍h hō͘ Siōng-tè; tùi chit-ê sìn, i tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè jīn-tēng chòe gī-lâng, chiap-la̍p i ê chè-mi̍h. Sui-jiân A-pek í-keng sí, thong-kè chit-ê sìn, i iáu-teh kóng-ōe.

Tùi sìn, Í-lo̍k bô keng-giām sí, siū chhian-sóa khì Siōng-tè hia. Lâng bô koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h i, in-ūi Siōng-tè kā i chhian-sóa--khì; Í-lo̍k siū chhian-sóa í-chêng í-keng hō͘ Siōng-tè jīn-tēng chiap-la̍p.
Bô sìn chiū bōe-tàng hō͘ Siōng-tè hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi chhin-kūn Siōng-tè ê lâng it-tēng tio̍h sìn Siōng-tè ū chûn-chāi, koh sìn I ōe hō͘ chhē-kiû I ê lâng tit-tio̍h pò-siúⁿ.

Tùi sìn, Ná-a tùi iáu-bē khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê sū ū thiaⁿ Siōng-tè ê kéng-kò, chûn kèng-ùi ê sim, chō chi̍t chiah tōa-chûn kiù i choân-ke. Tùi chit-ê sìn, i tēng sè-kan-lâng ê chōe, koh kun-kù chit-ê sìn, i chiâⁿ-chòe gī ê kè-sêng-jîn.
Tùi sìn, A-pek-la-hán siū tiàu khì teh-beh sêng-siū chòe sán-gia̍p ê tōe ê sî, sui-jiân m̄ chai beh khì tó-ūi, iáu-kú i ū sūn-thàn chhut--khì.
Tùi sìn, i kià-ku tī èng-ún ê tōe, ná-chhin-chhiūⁿ tiàm tī gōa-kok, kap chòe-hé sêng-siū kâng èng-ún ê Í-sat, Ngá-kok tòa tī pò͘-pîⁿ;
in-ūi i kî-thāi Siōng-tè só͘ siat-kè kap khí-chō hit-ê ū tōe-ki ê siâⁿ.
Tùi sìn, A-pek-la-hán sui-jiân í-keng lāu, Sa-la mā í-keng chhiau-kè seng-sán ê nî-hè, i iáu ōe-tàng choh lāu-pē, in-ūi khak-sìn èng-ún i ê Siōng-tè sī sìn-si̍t.
Só͘-í thang kóng, tùi chi̍t ê teh-beh sí ê lâng ū siⁿ-thòaⁿ kiáⁿ-sun, chhin-chhiūⁿ thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ hiah-ni̍h chōe, chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-piⁿ ê soa sǹg bōe liáu.

Chiah-ê lóng sī kàu sí it-ti̍t ū sìn-sim ê lâng; in bô tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè kā in èng-ún--ê, m̄-kú tùi hn̄g-hn̄g khòaⁿ--kìⁿ chiū hoaⁿ-hí, sêng-jīn ka-kī put-kò sī tōe-chiūⁿ ê chhut-gōa-lâng, sī kià-ku--ê.
Kóng chiah-ê ōe ê lâng piáu-sī in sī teh chhē chi̍t ê ka-hiong.
In nā-sī teh hoâi-liām lī-khui ê só͘-chāi, iáu ū ki-hōe thang tò--khì.

Put-kò, hiān-chāi in teh him-bō͘--ê sī thiⁿ-téng hit-ê koh-khah hó ê só͘-chāi. Só͘-í, Siōng-tè bô in-ūi in chheng I chòe Siōng-tè lâi kám-kak kiàn-siàu. I sīm-chì í-keng ūi-tio̍h in chún-pī chi̍t ê siâⁿ.
Tùi sìn, A-pek-la-hán siū khó-giām ê sî hiàn Í-sat chòe chè-mi̍h, chiū-sī sêng-siū èng-ún ê A-pek-la-hán hoaⁿ-hí hiàn i ê ko͘-kiáⁿ.
Siōng-tè ū tùi i kóng, “Tùi Í-sat siⁿ--ê chiah thang sǹg-chòe lí ê kiáⁿ-sun.”
A-pek-la-hán siūⁿ-kóng Siōng-tè ōe-tàng hō͘ Í-sat tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, só͘-í thang phì-jū kóng Í-sat sī sí koh tò-tńg--lâi.
Tùi sìn, Í-sat ūi-tio̍h chiong-lâi ê sū kā Ngá-kok kap Í-sò chiok-hok.
Tùi sìn, Ngá-kok lîm-chiong ê sî kā Iok-sek ê kiáⁿ chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê chiok-hok; i khò tī koáiⁿ-á-thâu kèng-pài Siōng-tè.
Tùi sìn, Iok-sek lîm-chiong ê sî ū thê-khí Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng chhut Ai-ki̍p ê sū, koh hoan-hù koan-hē i ê kut-hâi bâi-chòng ê sū.
Tùi sìn, Mô͘-se chhut-sì í-āu, i ê pē-bú khòaⁿ-tio̍h eⁿ-á chheng-siù, m̄ kiaⁿ ông ê bēng-lēng, chiong i chhàng saⁿ ge̍h-ji̍t kú.
Tùi sìn, Mô͘-se tióng-tōa í-āu, kū-choa̍t lâng kā i chheng-chòe Ai-ki̍p kong-chú ê kiáⁿ,
khah ài kap Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn tâng siū khó͘-lān, bô ài hióng-siū chōe tiong chi̍t-sî-á kú ê khoài-lo̍k.
I khòaⁿ ūi-tio̍h Ki-tok siū lêng-jio̍k pí Ai-ki̍p ê châi-pó khah pó-kùi, in-ūi i gióng-bōng chiong-lâi ê pò-siúⁿ.
Tùi sìn, Mô͘-se m̄ kiaⁿ ông ê siū-khì lī-khui Ai-ki̍p; i kian-chhî kàu-tóe, in-ūi i ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lâng khòaⁿ bōe tio̍h ê Siōng-tè.
Tùi sìn, Mô͘-se siat-li̍p Pôaⁿ-kè-choeh, hoan-hù tio̍h hiù huih tī mn̂g--ni̍h, chiah bōe hō͘ Châu-bia̍t-chiá kha̍p-tio̍h Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê tōa-kiáⁿ.
Tùi sìn, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng kè Âng-hái chhin-chhiūⁿ teh kiâⁿ ta-tōe; Ai-ki̍p -lâng mā siūⁿ-beh kè, soah hō͘ chúi im-sí.
Tùi sìn, Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng se̍h Iâ-lī-ko -siâⁿ chhit ji̍t, siâⁿ-chhiûⁿ chiū tó--lo̍h-khì.
Tùi sìn, chhiong-ki Lat-ha̍p chhin-chhiat chiap-thāi cheng-thàm, só͘-í bô kap hiah-ê m̄ sūn-ho̍k Siōng-tè ê lâng chòe-hé bia̍t-bông.
Góa kiám tio̍h koh kóng? Góa bô-kàu sî-kan thang thê-khí Ki-tiân, Pa-la, Chham-sun, Iâ-hut-tha, Tāi-pi̍t, Sat-bó-ní, kap chèng sian-ti ê sū.
Chiah-ê lâng khò sìn-sim thâi-iâⁿ lia̍t-kok. In thui-hêng chèng-gī, niá-siū Siōng-tè ê èng-ún. In hong-ba̍t sai ê chhùi,
phah-hoa lia̍t-hé, tô-thoat to-kiàm ê sat-hāi. In loán-jio̍k pìⁿ-chòe kian-kiông, tī chiàn-tiûⁿ pìⁿ-chòe ióng-béng, phah-iâⁿ gōa-kok ê kun-tūi.

Ū chi̍t-kóa hū-jîn-lâng ū chiap in ê chhin-lâng tùi sí-lâng tiong tò-tńg--lâi. Mā ū chi̍t-kóa lâng ūi-tio̍h beh koh-oa̍h, tit-tio̍h khah hó ê oa̍h-miā, kū-choa̍t tháu-pàng, kam-goān siū khok-hêng kàu sí.
Ū chi̍t-kóa lâng siū hì-lāng, piⁿ-phah; mā ū chi̍t-kóa lâng siū khún-pa̍k, koaiⁿ-kaⁿ.

In hō͘ lâng ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm--sí, ēng kù-á kù--sí, ēng to thâi--sí. In chhēng mî-iûⁿ á-sī soaⁿ-iûⁿ ê phê, ta̍k só͘-chāi phun-pho, jím-siū khiàm-kheh, pek-hāi, ge̍k-thāi.
Chit sè-kan bô ta̍t-tit in khiā-khí; in tī khòng-iá, soaⁿ-niá, chio̍h-tōng á-sī tōe-hia̍t, sì-kòe liû-lōng.
Chiah-ê lâng thong-kè in ê sìn lóng ū tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè jīn-tēng chiap-la̍p, m̄-kú bô tit-tio̍h só͘ èng-ún--ê,
in-ūi Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h lán ū khah hó ê an-pâi; I ê chí-ì sī ài chiah-ê lâng kap lán ū-hūn tī chit-ê an-pâi, án-ni só͘ sìn--ê chiah ōe-tàng oân-choân si̍t-hiān.

Kì-jiân ū chiah-ni̍h chōe ê kiàn-chèng-jîn chhin-chhiūⁿ hûn kā lán pau-ûi teh, lán tio̍h pâi-tû it-chhè ê chó͘-gāi kap it-ti̍t teh tîⁿ-pòaⁿ lán ê chōe, kian-jím pháu-cháu thâu-chêng ê lō͘-thêng.

Tio̍h chù-sîn khòaⁿ Iâ-so͘, I sī sìn ê chhòng-sí-chiá kap oân-sêng-chiá. I ūi-tio̍h pâi tī thâu-chêng ê hí-lo̍k, bû-sī lêng-jio̍k, jím-siū si̍p-jī-kè ê khó͘-lān, hiān-chāi í-keng chē tī Siōng-tè pó-chō ê chiàⁿ-pêng.
Tio̍h siông-sè siūⁿ chit-ê lâng ê só͘-chòe, lín chiah bōe hoe-sim sit-chì. I án-chóaⁿ jím-siū chōe-jîn tùi I ê ngó͘-ge̍k.
Lín kap chōe-ok tò͘-cheng iáu-bē tí-khòng kàu sí ê thêng-tō͘.
Lín kiám bōe-kì-tit Siōng-tè khó͘-khǹg lín chhin-chhiūⁿ teh khó͘-khǹg kiáⁿ-jî. I kóng: Góa ê kiáⁿ ah, m̄-thang khòaⁿ-khin Chú ê koán-kàu; siū I chek-pī mā m̄-thang hoe-sim.
In-ūi Chú koán-kàu I só͘ thiàⁿ ê lâng, piⁿ-phah I só͘ chiap-la̍p ê ta̍k-ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Tio̍h jím-siū koán-kàu. Siōng-tè khoán-thāi lín chhin-chhiūⁿ kiáⁿ-jî. Kiám ū kiáⁿ-jî bô siū pē-bú koán-kàu?
Lín nā bô siū só͘-ū ê kiáⁿ-jî só͘ siū ê koán-kàu, lín chiū-sī su-seng-chú, m̄-sī chin-chiàⁿ ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Siū jio̍k-thé ê pē-bú koán-kàu, lán to chun-tiōng in, hô-hòng siū lêng-sèng ê Pē koán-kàu, lán kiám m̄ eng-kai koh-khah goān-ì sūn-chiông lâi tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā?
Jio̍k-thé ê pē-bú chiām-sî kú chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù koán-kàu, m̄-kú Siōng-tè ê koán-kàu sī beh hō͘ lán tit-tio̍h lī-ek, bo̍k-te̍k sī beh hō͘ lán ū-hūn tī I ê sèng-kiat.
Lán ta̍k-piàn siū koán-kàu bōe kám-kak hoaⁿ-hí, hoán-tńg iu-siong; m̄-kú keng-kè koán-kàu thoàn-liān liáu-āu, ōe kiat hô-pêng ê ké-chí, kiâⁿ-chòe chèng-ti̍t.
Só͘-í, lín chiah-ê kha-sng-chhiú-nńg ê lâng tio̍h kian-kiông--khí-lâi.
Tio̍h siu-ti̍t lín beh kiâⁿ ê lō͘, chiah bián hō͘ pái ê kha thu̍t-lûn, hoán-tńg tit-tio̍h i-hó.
Tio̍h lô-le̍k kap chèng-lâng hô-bo̍k, kè sèng-kiat ê seng-oa̍h; nā bô, bô lâng ōe kìⁿ-tio̍h Chú.
Tio̍h kín-sīn, chiah bián ū lâng sit-khì Siōng-tè ê un-tián; chiah bián ū to̍k-chháu hoat--khí-lâi, chō-sêng gûi-hāi, tì-kàu chin chōe lâng siū ù-jiám;
chiah bián ū lâng îm-loān, bô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, chhin-chhiūⁿ Í-sò ūi-tio̍h chi̍t-tǹg-chia̍h chhut-bōe tōa-kiáⁿ ê bêng-hūn.
Lín chai, āu-lâi i ài tit-tio̍h chiok-hok ê sî siū kū-choa̍t; sui-jiân i lâu ba̍k-sái khún-kiû mā bô tit-tio̍h, in-ūi i chhē bô ki-hōe thang hóe-kái.
Lín m̄-sī lâi kàu hit-ê bong ōe tio̍h ê Se-nāi-soaⁿ, tī hia ū hé-iām, ba̍t-hûn, o͘-àm, kap pō-hong,
koh ū lat-pah ê hiáng-siaⁿ kap kóng-ōe ê siaⁿ. Thiaⁿ--kìⁿ ê lâng khún-kiû Siōng-tè m̄-thang koh tùi in kóng-ōe,
in-ūi in bōe-tàng jím-siū bēng-lēng in ê ōe, kóng, “Liân cháu-siù nā kha̍p-tio̍h soaⁿ mā tio̍h ēng chio̍h-thâu tìm--sí.”
Hit-ê kéng-siōng hui-siông thang kiaⁿ, tì-kàu Mô͘-se kóng, “Góa kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.”
M̄-kú, lín sī lâi kàu Sek-an-soaⁿ, éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê siâⁿ, thiⁿ-téng ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng, tī hia ū chheng-chheng-bān-bān ê thiⁿ-sài chū-chi̍p khèng-chiok.

Lín lâi kàu Siōng-tè ê tōa-kiáⁿ chū-chi̍p ê hōe-só͘; in ê miâ í-keng kì tī thiⁿ-téng. Lín lâi kàu sím-phòaⁿ bān-lâng ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng, kàu í-keng tit-tio̍h kái-chō chiâⁿ-chòe oân-choân ê gī-lâng ê lêng-hûn hia.
Lín lâi kàu sin ê iok ê tiong-kan-jîn Iâ-so͘ ê bīn-chêng, kap só͘ hiù ê huih hia, chit-ê huih pí A-pek ê huih só͘ piáu-ta̍t--ê koh-khah hó.

Tio̍h kín-sīn, m̄-thang kū-choa̍t teh tùi lín kóng-ōe Hit-ūi. Hiah-ê kū-choa̍t tī tōe-chiūⁿ kéng-kài in hit-ūi ê lâng to bōe-tàng thoat-lī chōe, lán nā kū-choa̍t tùi thiⁿ-téng kéng-kài lán Hit-ūi, koh-khah bōe-tàng thoat-lī.
Hit-sî I ê siaⁿ iô-tāng tāi-tōe, m̄-kú taⁿ I ū èng-ún kóng, “Koh chi̍t piàn, góa m̄-nā hō͘ tōe, mā beh hō͘ thiⁿ iô-tāng.”
“Koh chi̍t piàn” chit-kù ōe chí-bêng, hiah-ê siū chō ê mi̍h siū iô-tāng, siū chhian-sóa, sī beh hō͘ hiah-ê bô siū iô-tāng--ê lâu--lo̍h-lâi.
Só͘-í, lán tio̍h kám-siā, in-ūi lán ū tit-tio̍h hit-ê bōe siū iô-tāng ê Kok-tō͘. Lán tio̍h chiàu Siōng-tè só͘ hoaⁿ-hí--ê, ēng khiân-sêng kap kèng-ùi lâi ho̍k-sāi I,
in-ūi lán ê Siōng-tè sī thun-bia̍t ê hé.
Tio̍h kè-sio̍k saⁿ-chhin saⁿ-thiàⁿ.
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit hó khoán-thāi chhut-gōa-lâng. In-ūi ū lâng án-ni chòe, bô-ì-tiong chiap-thāi tio̍h thiⁿ-sài.
Tio̍h koan-hoâi siū koaiⁿ-kaⁿ ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ kap in teh tâng siū koaiⁿ; tio̍h koan-hoâi siū ge̍k-thāi ê lâng, chhin-chhiūⁿ lín pún-sin teh siū ge̍k-thāi.
Hun-in lâng-lâng tio̍h chun-tiōng; tio̍h pó-chhî sûn-kiat ê hu-chhe koan-hē, in-ūi Siōng-tè ōe sím-phòaⁿ su-thong kiâⁿ-îm ê lâng.
M̄-thang tham-châi, ka-kī só͘-ū ê tio̍h ti-chiok, in-ūi Siōng-tè ū kóng, “Góa bōe lī-khui lí, mā bōe pàng-sak lí.”
Só͘-í lán ōe-tàng hó-táⁿ kóng: Chú sī góa ê pang-chān, góa bōe kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, lâng ōe-tàng kā góa án-chóaⁿ?
Tio̍h siàu-liām ín-chhōa lín, thoân Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit hō͘ lín ê lâng, chù-ì khòaⁿ in ê seng-oa̍h kap kiat-kio̍k lâi ha̍k-si̍p in ê sìn.
Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok chā-ji̍t, kim-ji̍t, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán lóng bōe kái-piàn.

Lín m̄-thang hō͘ ta̍k-khoán kî-īⁿ ê kàu-gī chhōa bê-lō͘, in-ūi sim-lêng khah hó tio̍h khò Siōng-tè ê un-tián lâi kian-kò͘, m̄-sī khò chia̍h-mi̍h. Khò chun-siú chia̍h-mi̍h kui-lē ê lâng lóng bô tit-tio̍h lī-ek.
Lán ū chi̍t ê chè-tôaⁿ, téng-bīn ê chè-mi̍h tī hōe-bō͘ lāi ho̍k-sāi ê lâng bô koân thang chia̍h.
In ê tōa-chè-si tòa cheng-siⁿ ê huih chìn-ji̍p Chì-sèng-só͘ ūi-tio̍h jîn-bîn sio̍k-chōe, cheng-siⁿ ê seng-khu khiok tī iâⁿ-gōa sio.
Só͘-í, ūi-tio̍h beh ēng ka-kī ê huih hō͘ jîn-bîn tit-tio̍h kiat-chēng, Iâ-so͘ mā tī iâⁿ-gōa hi-seng lâi sí.
Án-ni, lán tio̍h chhut-khì iâⁿ-gōa, khì I hia, kap I tâng siū lêng-jio̍k.
In-ūi tī chia lán bô éng-kiú ê siâⁿ; lán sī teh chhē hit-ê teh-beh lâi ê siâⁿ.
Só͘-í, lán tio̍h thong-kè Iâ-so͘ kè-sio̍k chiong chheng-chàn ê chè hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè, che sī soan-jīn Chú ê miâ ê lâng ê chhùi-tûn só͘ kiat ê ké-chí.
Tio̍h ōe-kì-tit chòe hó-sū, hō͘-siōng pang-chān, in-ūi che sī Siōng-tè só͘ hoaⁿ-hí ê chè-mi̍h.

Tio̍h ho̍k-chiông ín-chhōa lín ê lâng, thiaⁿ-thàn in ê ōe, in-ūi in put-sî teh khòaⁿ-kò͘ lín ê lêng-hûn, thang hō͘ in tùi Siōng-tè kau-tài chheng-chhó. Lín tio̍h hō͘ in hoaⁿ-hí kang-chok, bô thó͘-khùi; nā bô, tùi lín bô lī-ek.
Tio̍h kè-sio̍k ūi-tio̍h goán kî-tó; goán khak-sìn ka-kī ū chheng-pe̍k ê liông-sim, ì-ài hoān-sū chiàu-khí-kang seng-oa̍h.
Góa khún-kiû lín tio̍h te̍k-pia̍t ūi-tio̍h góa kî-tó, kiû Siōng-tè hō͘ góa thang khah kín khì lín hia.

Siōng-tè í-keng hō͘ lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h. I thong-kè Iâ-so͘ só͘ lâu ê huih khak-li̍p éng-oán ê iok, hō͘ Iâ-so͘ chiâⁿ-chòe iûⁿ-kûn ê Tōa-bo̍k-chiá. Goān chit-ūi sù pêng-an ê Siōng-tè hō͘ lín tī ta̍k-hāng hó-sū oân-choân lâi kiâⁿ I ê chí-ì, thong-kè Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tī lán tiong-kan sêng-chiū I só͘ hoaⁿ-hí ê sū! Goān êng-kng kui hō͘ Siōng-tè, ti̍t-kàu éng-éng-oán-oán. Amen!
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, góa hō͘ lín ê phoe bô jōa tn̂g, góa khǹg lín nāi-sim thiaⁿ góa khoàn-bián ê ōe.
Góa ài lín chai, lán ê hiaⁿ-tī Thê-mô͘-thài í-keng chhut-ga̍k; i nā khah chá lâi, góa ōe sûi-sî kap i chòe-hé khì khòaⁿ lín.
Chhiáⁿ thòe góa kā lín só͘-ū ê léng-tō-chiá kap lóng-chóng ê sìn-tô͘ chhéng-an. Tùi Ì-tāi-lī lâi ê sìn-tô͘ mā beh kā lín chhéng-an.
Goān Siōng-tè ê un-tián kap lín tāi-ke tông-chāi. Amen!
Góa Ngá-kok sī Siōng-tè kap Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê po̍k-jîn, beh kā só͘-ū hun-sòaⁿ tī ta̍k só͘-chāi Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn chhéng-an.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín tú-tio̍h ta̍k-khoán chhì-liān ê sî, tio̍h siūⁿ-chòe sī thang hoaⁿ-hí ê tāi-chì,
in-ūi chai-iáⁿ lín ê sìn-sim keng-kè khó-giām ōe sán-seng jím-nāi.
Lín tio̍h jím-nāi kàu lō͘-bé chiah ōe-tàng ta̍t-kàu oân-choân koh oân-chéng, lóng bô khoat-tiám.
Lín tiong-kan nā ū lâng khiàm-kheh tì-hūi, tio̍h tùi Siōng-tè kî-kiû, I ōe sù hō͘ lín, in-ūi Siōng-tè ōe chin khóng-khài bô pó-liû sù hō͘ lóng-chóng ê lâng.
Put-kò, lín tio̍h khò sìn-sim kî-kiû, m̄-thang giâu-gî; giâu-gî ê lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ hái-éng hō͘ hong sàu, khí-khí-lo̍h-lo̍h.
Chit-khoán lâng sam-sim-lióng-ì, só͘ chòe bô tēng-sèng, bián siūⁿ-beh tùi Chú tit-tio̍h sím-mi̍h.
Sàn-chhiah ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè thê-seng, tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí;
hù-jū ê lâng siū Siōng-tè kàng-kē, mā tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí. Hù-jū ê lâng ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu hoe siā--khì.
Ji̍t-thâu chi̍t-ē chhut, sio-hong chi̍t-ē chhe, chháu ta--khì, hoe siā--khì, i ê súi chiū siau-sit. Hù-jū ê lâng mā-sī án-ni, ōe tī bô-êng phun-pho ê tiong-kan siau-sit.
Jím-siū chhì-liān ê lâng chin ū hok-khì; in-ūi i ū keng-kè khó-giām, ōe niá-siū Siōng-tè èng-ún hō͘ thiàⁿ I ê lâng oa̍h-miā ê hoa-koan.
Lâng siū ín-iú ê sî, m̄-thang kóng “Góa hō͘ Siōng-tè ín-iú”, in-ūi Siōng-tè bōe siū siâ-ok iú-he̍k, I ka-kī mā bōe ín-iú lâng.
Lâng siū ín-iú, sī hō͘ ka-kī ê io̍k-bōng ín-iú hām-hāi.
Io̍k-bōng hoâi-īn chiū siⁿ-chhut chōe-ok; chōe-ok sêng-se̍k chiū sán-seng sí-bông.
Chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, m̄-thang siū khi-phiàn.
It-chhè bí-hó ê siúⁿ-sù kap it-chhè oân-choân ê un-sù sī tùi thiⁿ-téng kng-bêng ê Goân-thâu só͘ sù. I bô kái-piàn, mā bô thian-thé tńg-se̍h ín-khí ê iáⁿ.
I chiàu ka-kī ê chí-ì ēng chin-lí ê tō lâi chō lán, hō͘ lán tī siū-chō ê bān-mi̍h tiong ū siōng tiōng-iàu ê tōe-ūi.
Chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, tio̍h chai! Ta̍k-ê lâng tio̍h kip beh thiaⁿ; m̄-thang kip beh kóng; m̄-thang kip beh siū-khì;
in-ūi lâng ê siū-khì bōe-tàng si̍t-hiān Siōng-tè kong-gī ê iau-kiû.
Só͘-í, tio̍h siau-tû it-chhè lâ-sâm ê si̍p-koàn kap koàn-boán ê siâ-ok; tio̍h ēng un-jiû ê sim chiap-la̍p hit-ê chèng tī lín sim-lāi ōe-tàng kiù lín ê tō.
Tio̍h si̍t-hêng tō-lí, m̄-thang phiàn ka-kī kóng kan-ta thiaⁿ tō-lí chiū hó.
Nā ū lâng thiaⁿ tō-lí bô si̍t-hêng, i chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng chiò-kiàⁿ khòaⁿ ka-kī ê bīn-siòng,
siông-sè khòaⁿ liáu-āu, chi̍t-ē lī-khui, sûi-sî bōe-kì-tit ka-kī siⁿ-chòe siáⁿ-khoán.

M̄-kú ū teh siông-sè chhâ-khó hō͘ lâng tit-tio̍h chū-iû hit-ê oân-chéng ê Lu̍t-hoat, koh ū teh kian-siú ê lâng, i ê só͘-chòe it-tēng ōe tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè sù-hok, in-ūi i ū si̍t-chāi khì si̍t-hêng, m̄-sī thiaⁿ-liáu chiū bōe-kì--tit.
Nā ū lâng siūⁿ-kóng ka-kī chin kèng-khiân, m̄-kú bô khòng-chè ka-kī ê chhùi-chi̍h, sī teh khi-phiàn ka-kī, chit-ê lâng ê kèng-khiân lóng bô lō͘-ēng.

Chiàu-kò͘ khó͘-lān tiong ê ko͘-jî kóaⁿ-hū, koh pó-siú ka-kī bô jiám-tio̍h sè-sio̍k ê hú-pāi, tùi Pē Siōng-tè khòaⁿ--khí-lâi, che chiah sī sûn-choân bô khoat-tiám ê kèng-khiân.
Góa ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, kì-jiân lín sìn lán êng-kng ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok, tio̍h m̄-thang ēng gōa-piáu tùi-thāi lâng.
Nā ū chi̍t ê kòa kim chhiú-chí, chhēng súi-saⁿ ê hó-gia̍h-lâng ji̍p-lâi lín ê hōe-tn̂g, koh ū chi̍t ê chhēng phòa-saⁿ ê sàn-chhiah-lâng ji̍p--lâi,
lín kan-ta chù-ì hit-ê chhēng súi-saⁿ--ê, tùi i kóng “Chhiáⁿ lâi chē tōa-ūi”, tùi hit-ê sàn-chhiah-lâng kóng “Lí khiā tiàm hia”, á-sī kóng “Chē góa ê kha-tiam piⁿ”,
án-ni lín kiám m̄-sī phian-sim, ēng pháiⁿ ê tōng-ki teh phòaⁿ-toàn lâng?

Chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, tio̍h thiaⁿ! Siōng-tè ū kéng-soán sè-kan ê sàn-chhiah-lâng, hō͘ in tī sìn-gióng siōng hù-chiok, thang sêng-chiap I èng-ún hō͘ thiàⁿ I ê lâng ê Kok-tō͘.
M̄-kú lín bú-jio̍k sàn-chhiah-lâng! Ap-pek lín, thoa lín chiūⁿ hoat-têng--ê, kiám m̄-sī hiah-ê hó-gia̍h-lâng?
In chiah sī húi-pòng lín só͘ niá-siū chun-kùi ê miâ hiah-ê lâng!
Lín nā chun-thàn Sèng-keng só͘ kì-chài “Tio̍h thiàⁿ chhù-piⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ thiàⁿ ka-kī” hit-ê Siōng-tè-kok ê Lu̍t-hoat, án-ni chiū tio̍h.
M̄-kú lín nā khòaⁿ gōa-piáu tùi-thāi lâng chiū-sī hoān-chōe, siū Lu̍t-hoat phòaⁿ-chòe hoān-hoat.
Lâng nā bô siú Lu̍t-hoat tiong ê chi̍t tiâu kài-bēng, chiū-sī bô siú choân-pō͘ ê Lu̍t-hoat.
In-ūi Hit-ūi bēng-lēng “M̄-thang hoān kan-îm” ê, mā kóng “M̄-thang hāi-sí lâng”. Sui-jiân lí bô hoān kan-îm, lí nā hāi-sí lâng chiū-sī ûi-hoān Lu̍t-hoat.
Kì-jiân lín teh-beh siū hō͘ lâng chū-iû ê Lu̍t-hoat sím-phòaⁿ, tio̍h chiàu Lu̍t-hoat ê iau-kiû kóng-ōe, chòe tāi-chì.
In-ūi, bô ēng chû-pi tùi-thāi lâng--ê, tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê sî, Siōng-tè bōe ēng chû-pi tùi-thāi i; chû-pi iâⁿ-kè sím-phòaⁿ.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, nā ū lâng kóng i ū sìn, m̄-kú bô ēng hêng-ûi lâi chèng-bêng, ū siáⁿ lō͘-ēng? Hit-khoán ê sìn kiám ōe kiù i?
Lín tiong-kan nā ū hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē bô saⁿ thang chhēng, saⁿ-tǹg bô thang chia̍h,
lín kan-ta tùi in kóng, “Chiok lín pêng-an, tio̍h chhēng hō͘ sio, chia̍h hō͘ pá!” M̄-kú bô kiong-kip in jio̍k-thé só͘ su-iàu ê mi̍h, ū siáⁿ lō͘-ēng?
Só͘-í, chí-ū sìn-sim, nā bô hêng-ûi, sī sí--ê.
M̄-kú ū lâng beh kóng, “Lí ū sìn-sim, góa ū hêng-ûi; chhiáⁿ lí hō͘ góa khòaⁿ bô hêng-ûi ê sìn-sim, góa chiū ēng hêng-ûi hō͘ lí khòaⁿ góa ê sìn-sim.”
Lí sìn Siōng-tè chí-ū chi̍t ūi, án-ni chin tio̍h; liân kúi mā sìn, sīm-chì kiaⁿ kah phi̍h-phi̍h-chhoah.
Lí ná bōe-hiáu siūⁿ, lí ài-beh chai--bô? Bô hêng-ûi ê sìn-sim bô lō͘-ēng.
Lán ê chó͘-sian A-pek-la-hán hiàn ka-kī ê kiáⁿ Í-sat tī chè-tôaⁿ téng, kiám m̄-sī tùi chit-ê hêng-ûi hō͘ Siōng-tè kā i chheng-chòe gī-lâng?
Khó-kiàn, sìn-sim kap i ê hêng-ûi chòe-hé ūn-chok; sìn-sim thong-kè hêng-ûi chiah oân-chéng.
Che sī èng-giām Sèng-keng só͘ kóng, “ A-pek-la-hán sìn Siōng-tè, in-ūi án-ni, Siōng-tè chiū kā i sǹg-chòe gī”; i mā chheng-chòe Siōng-tè ê pêng-iú.
Khó-kiàn, lâng siū chiap-la̍p chòe gī-lâng sī tùi hêng-ûi, m̄-sī kan-ta tùi sìn.

Ki-lú Lat-ha̍p ê chêng-hêng mā-sī án-ni. I chiap-la̍p Í-sek-lia̍t -lâng ê sù-chiá, pang-chān in tùi pa̍t-tiâu lō͘ tô-cháu, án-ni i kiám m̄-sī tùi hêng-ûi siū chiap-la̍p chòe gī-lâng?
Seng-khu bô khùi sī sí--ê; sìn-sim bô hêng-ûi mā-sī sí--ê.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín tiong-kan m̄-thang ū chin chōe lâng choh kàu-su. Lán chai, lán choh kàu-su ê lâng ōe siū khah giâm-keh ê sím-phòaⁿ.
In-ūi lán tāi-ke lóng siông-siông hoān chin chōe chhò-gō͘; kóng-ōe bô chhò-gō͘--ê sī oân-choân ê lâng, i ōe-hiáu khòng-chè ka-kī.
Lán ēng bé-kā-kiuⁿ tàu tī bé ê chhùi--ni̍h, hō͘ in sûn-ho̍k, thang khòng-chè kui-chiah bé ê hêng-tōng.

Koh khòaⁿ, chûn sui-jiân hiah tōa chiah, hō͘ tōa-hong chhe, phah, chí-ū ēng chi̍t ki sòe-sòe ê chûn-tōa kā i khòng-chè, sái-chûn ê lâng chiū ōe-tàng chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù sái.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, chhùi-chi̍h sī sòe ê khì-koan, iáu-kú ōe kóng tōa-ōe. Koh siūⁿ-khòaⁿ leh, chi̍t-tiám-á hé-chhiⁿ mā ōe hō͘ kui-ê chhiū-nâ lóng sio--khì.

Chhùi-chi̍h sī hé. Tī lán ê chi-thé tiong, chhùi-chi̍h sī siâ-ok ê sè-kài, ōe ù-jiám lán kui seng-khu. Chit-ê hé sī tùi tōe-ge̍k tiám-to̍h--ê, ōe hō͘ lâng kui-ê jîn-seng sio-bia̍t.
Lâng ōe-tàng chè-ho̍k ta̍k-chióng iá-siù, pe-chiáu, thâng-thōa, kap hî-lūi; kî-si̍t mā í-keng kā in lóng chè-ho̍k lah.
M̄-kú, bô lâng ōe-tàng chè-ho̍k chhùi-chi̍h; chhùi-chi̍h sī bô lâng khòng-chè ōe tiâu ê siâ-ok, chhiong-móa tì-miā ê to̍k.
Lán ēng chhùi-chi̍h o-ló Chú lán ê Pē, mā ēng chhùi-chi̍h chiù-chó͘ chiàu Siōng-tè ka-kī ê hêng-siōng só͘ chō ê lâng.
Kám-siā kap chiù-chó͘ ê ōe lóng tùi kâng chi̍t ê chhùi chhut. Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, án-ni sī bô eng-kai!
Tùi kâng chi̍t ê chôaⁿ-goân kiám ōe chhèng-chhut tiⁿ--ê kap khó͘ ê chúi!
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, bû-hoa-kó-chhiū kiám ōe siⁿ kaⁿ-ná? Phû-tô-chhiū kiám ōe siⁿ bû-hoa-kó? Kiâm ê chúi-goân mā bōe chhut tiⁿ ê chúi!
Lín tiong-kan sím-mi̍h-lâng ū tì-hūi, ū kiàn-sek? Nā ū, tio̍h ēng khiam-pi kap tì-hūi, thong-kè ka-kī ê hó phín-hēng piáu-hiān--chhut-lâi.
Lín sim-lāi nā ū ok-to̍k, oàn-tò͘, kap chū-su, chiū m̄-thang khoa-kháu, kóng pe̍h-chha̍t tí-te̍k chin-lí.
Chit-khoán tì-hūi m̄-sī tùi thiⁿ-téng lâi--ê, sī sio̍k tōe-chiūⁿ, sio̍k hiat-khì, sio̍k Mô͘-kúi.
In-ūi ū oàn-tò͘ kap chū-su chiū ū hūn-loān kap ta̍k-hāng pháiⁿ hêng-ûi.
Tùi téng-bīn lâi ê tì-hūi, thâu chi̍t hāng sī sûn-kiat, koh-lâi sī hô-pêng, un-hô, ū tō͘-liōng, chhiong-móa chû-pi, koh gâu kiat hó ké-chí, bô phian-su, bô hu-ké.
Kong-gī sī chhiok-chìn hô-pêng ê lâng ēng hô-pêng iā ê chéng-chí só͘ kiat ê ké-chí.
Lín tiong-kan ê tò͘-cheng kap cheng-chip tùi tó-ūi lâi? Kiám m̄-sī tùi lín chi-thé tiong-kan put-sî teh cheng-chip kap tò͘-cheng ê io̍k-bōng lâi?

Lín siūⁿ-beh tit--tio̍h, tit bōe tio̍h, chiū beh thâi-lâng. Lín io̍k-bōng móa-móa, m̄-kú bōe-tàng boán-chiok, chiū cheng-chip tò͘-cheng. Lín tit bōe tio̍h só͘ ài--ê, in-ūi bô tùi Siōng-tè kiû.
Lín kî-kiû, m̄-kú tit bōe tio̍h, in-ūi lín ê tōng-ki m̄ hó, só͘ kiû--ê kan-ta sī beh boán-chiok ka-kī ê khoài-lo̍k.
Lín chiah-ê m̄-sìn ê lâng ah, kiám m̄ chai kap sè-kan choh pêng-iú chiū-sī kap Siōng-tè choh tùi-te̍k?
Sèng-keng kóng, “Siōng-tè chhim-chhim ì-ài I khǹg tī lán lāi-bīn ê Sîn”, lín siūⁿ Sèng-keng só͘ siá chit-kù ōe bô ì-sù sī--bô?
Put-kò Siōng-tè sù lán ê un-tián koh-khah tōa. In-ūi án-ni, Sèng-keng ū kóng: Siōng-tè te̍k-tùi kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng, si-un hō͘ khiam-pi ê lâng.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h sūn-ho̍k Siōng-tè, hoán-khòng Mô͘-kúi, Mô͘-kúi chiū ōe tô-cháu lī-khui lín.
Tio̍h chhin-kūn Siōng-tè, Siōng-tè chiū ōe chhin-kūn lín. Chōe-jîn ah, tio̍h sóe lín ê chhiú; bô tēng-sèng ê lâng ah, tio̍h kiat-chēng lín ê sim.
Tio̍h pi-siong, ai-thòng, thî-khàu; tio̍h hō͘ lín ê khoài-lo̍k pìⁿ-chòe pi-ai, hoaⁿ-hí pìⁿ-chòe iu-chhiû.
Tio̍h tī Chú ê bīn-chêng khiam-pi, I chiū ōe kā lín ko-seng.

Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, m̄-thang hō͘-siōng kóng pháiⁿ-ōe. Kóng hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē ê pháiⁿ-ōe, phoe-phòaⁿ hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē, chiū-sī kóng Lu̍t-hoat ê pháiⁿ-ōe, phoe-phòaⁿ Lu̍t-hoat. Lí nā phoe-phòaⁿ Lu̍t-hoat chiū m̄-sī Lu̍t-hoat ê chun-siú-chiá, sī Lu̍t-hoat ê phoe-phòaⁿ-chiá.
Lu̍t-hoat ê chè-tēng-chiá kap sím-phòaⁿ-chiá chí-ū chi̍t ūi, I ōe chín-kiù, mā ōe húi-bia̍t. Lí sī siáⁿ-lâng, ná káⁿ phoe-phòaⁿ lí ê chhù-piⁿ?
Eh, lín thiaⁿ góa kóng. Ū lâng kóng “Kin-á-ji̍t á-sī bîn-á-chài goán beh khì bó͘ chi̍t ê siâⁿ, tī hia tòa chi̍t nî, chòe seng-lí thàn-chîⁿ”.
Lín liân bîn-á-chài sìⁿ-miā ōe pìⁿ án-chóaⁿ to m̄ chai! Lín ká-ná bông-bū chhut-hiān chi̍t-ē-á kú liâm-piⁿ chiū siau-sit.
Lín eng-kai án-ni kóng, “Chú nā goān-ì, goán chiū ōe oa̍h, thang chòe chit-hāng chòe hit-hāng.”
Lín hiān-chāi káⁿ kiau-ngō͘ chū-tāi; chit-khoán ê kiau-ngō͘ lóng sī siâ-ok.
Só͘-í, lâng chai-iáⁿ tio̍h chòe hó-sū, bô khì chòe chiū-sī hoān-chōe.
Eh, lín chiah-ê hó-gia̍h-lâng, chù-ì thiaⁿ, tio̍h ūi-tio̍h teh-beh siū ê chai-lān ai-siong thî-khàu!
Lín ê châi-hù í-keng pāi-hoāi, lín ê i-ho̍k í-keng hō͘ chiù-thâng kā-phòa.

Lín ê kim, gûn siⁿ-sian, chiah-ê sian ōe chiâⁿ-chòe khòng-kò lín ê chèng-kù, koh ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ hé sio-bia̍t lín ê seng-khu. Lín ūi-tio̍h chiong-boa̍t ê ji̍t-chí chek-chū chîⁿ-châi.

Tī lín ê chhân-hn̂g ūi lín chòe kang kā lín siu-koah ê lâng, lín bô kang-chîⁿ hō͘ in. Tio̍h thiaⁿ in kiò-khó͘ ê siaⁿ! Hiah-ê siu-koah ê kang-lâng ho͘-kiò ê siaⁿ, Chú — Bān-kun ê Thóng-sòe í-keng ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h.
Lín tī tōe-chiūⁿ hióng-siū chhia-hoa iàn-lo̍k. Lín ka-kī chia̍h kah pûi-chut-chut, teh tán hō͘ lâng thâi ê ji̍t.
Lín kā bû-ko͘ ê lâng tēng-chōe, kā i sat-hāi, i mā bô kā lín tí-khòng.
Só͘-í, hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, tio̍h jím-nāi kàu Chú lâi-lîm. Lín khòaⁿ, lông-hu án-chóaⁿ thèng-hāu chhân--ni̍h pó-kùi ê siu-sêng; i nāi-sim thèng-hāu chhun-lîm chhiu-ú.
Lín mā tio̍h jím-nāi. Lín ê sim tio̍h kian-tēng, in-ūi Chú ê lâi-lîm kūn lah.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, m̄-thang hō͘-siōng bâi-oàn, chiah bián siū Siōng-tè sím-phòaⁿ. Lín khòaⁿ, Sím-phòaⁿ-chiá khiā tī mn̂g-kháu lah.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, tio̍h ēng hiah-ê hōng Chú ê miâ kóng-ōe ê sian-ti chòe jím-siū khó͘-lān ê bô͘-iūⁿ.

Hiah-ê thun-lún kàu-bé ê lâng, lán khòaⁿ in chòe ū hok-khì. Lín bat thiaⁿ-kìⁿ Iok-pek ê jím-nāi, chai Chú chòe-āu ū án-chóaⁿ kā i chiàu-kò͘, in-ūi Chú chhiong-móa lîn-bín kap chû-ài.

Góa ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, siōng tiōng-iàu--ê chiū-sī, m̄-thang kí thiⁿ, tōe, á-sī sím-mi̍h mi̍h-kiāⁿ chiù-chōa. “Sī” chiū kóng “sī”, “m̄-sī” chiū kóng “m̄-sī”; án-ni lín chiah bián siū Siōng-tè sím-phòaⁿ.
Lín tiong-kan ū thòng-khó͘ ê lâng bô? Nā ū, i tio̍h kî-tó. Lín tiong-kan ū hoaⁿ-hí ê lâng bô? Nā ū, i tio̍h chhiùⁿ chheng-chàn ê si-koa.
Lín tiong-kan ū phòa-pīⁿ ê lâng bô? Nā ū, i tio̍h chhiáⁿ kàu-hōe ê tiúⁿ-ló thòe i kî-tó, hōng Chú ê miâ kā i boah-iû.
Ū sìn-sim ê kî-tó ōe kiù pīⁿ-lâng; Chú ōe hō͘ i koh hó--khí-lâi, i só͘ hoān ê chōe mā ōe tit-tio̍h sià-bián.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h hō͘-siōng jīn-chōe, saⁿ-thòe kî-tó, thang hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h i-hó. Gī-lâng ê kî-tó ū tōa kong-hāu.
Í-lī-a kap lán pîⁿ-pîⁿ sī lâng. I pek-chhiat kî-tó m̄-thang lo̍h-hō͘, kó-jiân ū saⁿ nî pòaⁿ kú tōe-chiūⁿ bô lo̍h-hō͘.
I koh kî-tó, thiⁿ kó-jiân lo̍h tōa-hō͘, thó͘-tōe chiū seng-sán ngó͘-kok.
Góa ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín tiong-kan nā ū lâng phian-lī chin-lí, ū lâng koh kā i chhōa tò-tńg--lâi,
lín tio̍h chai, hō͘ sit-bê--ê tò-tńg--lâi hit-ê lâng ōe kiù chōe-jîn ê lêng-hûn thoat-lī sí-bông, hō͘ i chin chōe ê chōe tit-tio̍h jia-khàm.
Góa Pí-tek sī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê sù-tô͘, góa siá-phoe hō͘ siū kéng-soán hun-sòaⁿ tī Pún-to͘, Ka-lia̍p-thài, Ka-phà-to-ka, A-sè-a, Pì-chhui-nî téng só͘-chāi kià-ku ê lâng.

Lín siū kéng-soán sī chiàu Pē Siōng-tè ū-tēng ê chí-ì, tùi Sèng Sîn chiâⁿ-chòe sèng-kiat, thang sūn-ho̍k Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok, koh tùi I ê huih tit-tio̍h kiat-chēng. Goān Siōng-tè hong-hong-hù-hù sù lín un-tián kap pêng-an!

Tio̍h chheng-chàn lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê Pē Siōng-tè! Kun-kù I bô-hān ê jîn-chû, thong-kè Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, Siōng-tè ū hō͘ lán têng-chhut-sì thang tit-tio̍h oa̍h-oa̍h ê ǹg-bāng,
lâi sêng-siū I ūi-tio̍h lín pó-chûn tī thiⁿ--ni̍h hit-ê bōe hiú-nōa, bōe phah lâ-sâm, bōe siau-sit ê hok-khì.
Che sī beh hō͘ lín chiah-ê thong-kè sìn siū I ê tōa lêng-le̍k pó-siú ê lâng, thang tit-tio̍h chún-pī tī chiong-boa̍t ê sî-ki ōe si̍t-hiān ê chín-kiù.
Ūi-tio̍h án-ni, sui-jiân lín hiān-chāi chiām-sî iáu tio̍h siū chióng-chióng ê chhì-liān sim kan-khó͘, lín tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí.

Che sī beh chèng-bêng lín ê sìn-sim kham-tit siū khó-giām, pí hō͘ hé liān--kè iáu ōe pāi-hoāi ê kim koh-khah pó-kùi, thang hō͘ lín tī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok hián-hiān ê sî tit-tio̍h chheng-chàn, êng-kng, kap chun-kùi.
Lín sui-jiân m̄-bat khòaⁿ-tio̍h I, mā thiàⁿ I; hiān-chāi bô khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I, iáu-kú sìn I. Lín ū ēng giân-gú bōe-tàng piáu-ta̍t ke̍k-tōa ê hoaⁿ-hí,
in-ūi lín ōe tit-tio̍h sìn ê kiat-kó, chiū-sī lêng-hûn ê tit-kiù.
Koan-hē chit-ê chín-kiù, ū-giân lín ōe tit-tio̍h un-tián hiah-ê sian-ti í-keng ū gián-kiù koh siông-sè cha-khó.

In tit-tio̍h tī in sim-lāi Ki-tok ê Sîn tùi in ê chí-sī, cha-khó koan-hē Ki-tok ê siū-khó͘ kap āu-lâi tit-tio̍h êng-kng chit-ê ū-giân ōe tī sím-mi̍h sî, ōe án-chóaⁿ si̍t-hiān.

Siōng-tè ū kā in khé-sī, hō͘ in chai in ê sū-hōng m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h ka-kī, sī ūi-tio̍h lín. Chiah-ê sū hiān-chāi í-keng ū khò tùi thiⁿ lâi ê Sèng Sîn, thong-kè hok-im ê sù-chiá thoân hō͘ lín; chiah-ê sū liân thiⁿ-sài mā pek-chhiat teh thèng-hāu ài chai.
Só͘-í, lín ê sim-chì tio̍h chún-pī hó-sè, tio̍h kéng-séng, choân-sim ǹg-bāng Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok hián-hiān ê sî só͘ beh sù lín ê un-tián.
Tio̍h chòe sūn-ho̍k ê kiáⁿ-jî, m̄-thang chiàu lín í-chêng m̄ bat Siōng-tè ê sî teh hòng-chhiòng su-io̍k.
Ho͘-tiàu lín ê Siōng-tè sī sèng-kiat, lín tī it-chhè ê hêng-ûi mā tio̍h sèng-kiat.
In-ūi Sèng-keng ū kì-chài, “Lín tio̍h sèng-kiat, in-ūi góa sī sèng-kiat.”

Lín kì-jiân kiû-kiò ēng kâng chi̍t ê phiau-chún, chiàu ta̍k-lâng ê hêng-ûi sím-phòaⁿ lâng Hit-ūi chòe Pē, chiū tio̍h ēng kèng-ùi ê sim tī sè-kan ê ji̍t-chí choh kiâu-bîn seng-oa̍h.
In-ūi lín chai, lín siū sio̍k-hôe thoat-lī chó͘-sian lâu hō͘ lín hit-khoán bô lō͘-ēng ê thoân-thóng, m̄-sī ēng ōe pāi-hoāi ê kim-gûn,
sī ēng hit-ūi bô khoat-tiám bô ù-tiám ê iûⁿ-ko Ki-tok só͘ lâu ê pó-huih.
Ki-tok tī chhòng-chō ú-tiū í-chêng seng hō͘ Siōng-tè kéng-soán, tī chit-ê boa̍t-kî chiah ūi-tio̍h lín hián-hiān.
Lín thong-kè Ki-tok sìn hō͘ I tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h koh sù I êng-kng hit-ūi Siōng-tè; án-ni, lín ê sìn kap ǹg-bāng lóng chāi-tī Siōng-tè.
Lín í-keng tùi sūn-thàn chin-lí lâi kiat-chēng ka-kī, ū sûn-chin ê chhiú-chiok-chi-chêng, chiū tio̍h ēng chheng-khì ê sim tùi sim-tóe jia̍t-chhiat saⁿ-thiàⁿ.
Lín têng-chhut-sì, m̄-sī tùi ōe pāi-hoāi, sī tùi bōe pāi-hoāi ê chéng-chí, chiū-sī thong-kè Siōng-tè oa̍h-oa̍h, éng-oán bōe bô--khì ê ōe.
In-ūi Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Lâng lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu, in ê êng-hôa lóng chhin-chhiūⁿ chháu hoe; chháu ōe ta, hoe ōe siā,
chóng-sī Chú ê ōe éng-oán chûn-chāi. Che chiū-sī thoân hō͘ lín ê hok-im ê sìn-sit.
Só͘-í, tio̍h khì-sak it-chhè ê pháiⁿ, it-chhè ê khúi-chà, ké-hó, oàn-tò͘, kap it-chhè ê húi-pòng.
Tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ tú chhut-sì ê eⁿ-á chin ài sûn ê sio̍k-lêng ê lin, hō͘ lín thang sêng-tióng kàu tit-tio̍h kiù;
in-ūi lín í-keng ū tam-tio̍h Chú ê jîn-chû.
Tio̍h chhin-kūn Chú, I sī oa̍h-chio̍h, sui-jiân hō͘ lâng khì-sak, m̄-kú siū Siōng-tè kéng-soán khòaⁿ-chòe pó-kùi.

Lín mā tio̍h choh oa̍h-chio̍h, hō͘ Siōng-tè ēng lâi khí-chō sio̍k-lêng ê tiān, koh choh sèng-kiat ê chè-si, thong-kè Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok hiàn Siōng-tè só͘ hoaⁿ-hí sio̍k-lêng ê chè-mi̍h.
In-ūi Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Khòaⁿ leh, góa beh tī Sek-an hē chi̍t tè chio̍h, sī siū-kéng pó-kùi ê chhù-kak-chio̍h; sìn I ê lâng choa̍t-tùi bōe sit-bāng.
Chit-tè chio̍h tùi lín chiah-ê sìn ê lâng sī pó-kùi--ê, m̄-kú tùi m̄-sìn ê lâng, Khí-chhù sai-hū só͘ khì-sak ê chio̍h, í-keng chiâⁿ-chòe siōng tiōng-iàu ê ki-chio̍h!
Tī pa̍t-ūi ū kì-chài: Chit-tè sī poàn-kha-chio̍h, sī hō͘ lâng poa̍h-tó ê chio̍h. In m̄ sūn-thàn tō-lí lâi poa̍h-tó sī Siōng-tè ê an-pâi.

M̄-kú lín leh, lín sī siū kéng-soán ê chióng-cho̍k, ông-ka ê chè-si, sèng-kiat ê kok-tō͘, Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn, beh hō͘ lín thang soan-iông Siōng-tè úi-tāi ê chok-ûi; chit-ūi Siōng-tè ū tiàu lín chhut o͘-àm lâi ji̍p tī I chhàn-lān ê kng-bêng.
Sèng-keng kóng: Lín chêng m̄-sī Siōng-tè ê chú-bîn, hiān-chāi sī I ê chú-bîn; lín chêng bô tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê lîn-bín, hiān-chāi tit-tio̍h I ê lîn-bín.

Chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín tī sè-kan choh kiâu-bîn, choh kià-ku--ê, góa khǹg lín m̄-thang hòng-chhiòng jio̍k-thé ê chêng-io̍k; chit-ê chêng-io̍k put-sî teh kong-kek lêng-hûn.

Lín tī bī-sìn-chiá ê tiong-kan tio̍h ū hó hêng-ûi, hō͘ hiah-ê húi-pòng lín sī pháiⁿ-lâng ê lâng thang khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lín ê hó hêng-ûi, tī Chú lâi-lîm ê Ji̍t kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè.
Ūi-tio̍h Chú ê iân-kò͘, lín tio̍h sūn-thàn lâng it-chhè ê chè-tō͘, bô-lūn sī tùi chòe ko ê thóng-tī-chiá kun-ông,
á-sī tùi kun-ông só͘ phài-lâi chióng-lē chòe hó ê lâng, hêng-hoa̍t chòe pháiⁿ ê lâng ê koaⁿ-tiúⁿ lóng tio̍h án-ni.
In-ūi che sī Siōng-tè ê chí-ì; I ài lín chòe hó, hō͘ bô tì-sek ê gōng-lâng bô ōe thang kóng.
Lín choh chū-iû ê lâng, m̄-thang ēng chū-iû chòe siâ-ok ê chià-kháu, tio̍h choh Siōng-tè ê po̍k-jîn.
Lín tio̍h chun-tiōng só͘-ū ê lâng; tio̍h thiàⁿ hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, chun-kèng kun-ông.
Lín choh po̍k-jîn--ê, tio̍h kiong-kèng sūn-thàn lín ê chú-lâng, m̄-nā tùi siān-liông un-hô ê chú-lâng, liân khek-po̍k--ê mā tio̍h án-ni.
Tú-tio̍h bô eng-kai siū ê thòng-khó͘, nā liáu-kái sī Siōng-tè ê ì-sù lâi jím-siū sī thang chheng-chàn--ê.
Lín nā chòe m̄-tio̍h hō͘ lâng phah lâi jím-siū thòng-khó͘, ū sím-mi̍h thé-biān? M̄-kú lín nā choh-hó lâi jím-siū khó͘-lān, che sī Siōng-tè só͘ chheng-chàn--ê.
Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê, Siōng-tè ho͘-tiàu lín; in-ūi Ki-tok mā ū ūi-tio̍h lín siū-khó͘, lâu bô͘-iūⁿ hō͘ lín, beh hō͘ lín thang tè I ê kha-pō͘.
I bô hoān-chōe; I ê chhùi mā bô khúi-chà.
I siū lóe-mē, bô mē tò-tńg; siū ge̍k-thāi, mā bô kā lâng ui-hia̍p; chí-ū chiong ka-kī kau-thok hō͘ hit-ūi kong-gī ê Sím-phòaⁿ-chiá.
Ki-tok tī si̍p-jī-kè téng chhin-sin tam-tng lán ê chōe, hō͘ lán ǹg chōe sí, ǹg gī lâi oa̍h; tùi I ê siū-siong, lín tit-tio̍h i-tī.
Lín í-chêng chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ bê-lō͘, hiān-chāi í-keng tńg-lâi kui tī lín lêng-hûn ê Bo̍k-chiá kap Kàm-hō͘-chiá.

Siâng-khoán, lín choh hū-jîn-lâng--ê tio̍h sūn-ho̍k ka-kī ê tiōng-hu. Án-ni, in tiong-kan nā ū lâng bô sūn-thàn tō-lí, ōe tùi lín ê hó phín-hēng siū kám-hòa; lín lóng m̄-bián kóng pòaⁿ-kù ōe,
in-ūi in ōe khòaⁿ-chhut lín ê seng-oa̍h sûn-kiat koh kèng-khiân.
Lín m̄-thang khò pīⁿ thâu-mn̂g, kòa kim-khì, chhēng súi-saⁿ téng chng-thāⁿ,
tio̍h khò lōe-chāi ê súi, ēng un-jiû kap an-chēng ê sèng-chêng chòe bōe pāi-hoāi ê chng-thāⁿ; che tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng sī siōng pó-kùi--ê.
In-ūi chá-sî gióng-bōng Siōng-tè hiah-ê sèng-kiat ê hū-jîn-lâng mā-sī án-ni chng-thāⁿ ka-kī, sūn-ho̍k in ê tiōng-hu;
chhin-chhiūⁿ Sa-la sūn-chiông A-pek-la-hán, chheng-ho͘ i chòe “Chú-lâng”. Lín nā chòe hó-sū, bô siū khióng-hat tì-kàu kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, chiū-sī Sa-la ê cha-bó͘-kiáⁿ.

Kâng-khoán, lín choh tiōng-hu--ê tio̍h kap ka-kī ê hū-jîn-lâng chòe-hé seng-oa̍h, thé-thiap in jio̍k-thé siōng khah loán-jio̍k. Tio̍h kā in chun-tiōng, in-ūi in mā kap lín pîⁿ-pîⁿ sī hun-hióng Siōng-tè un-sù ê oa̍h-miā ê lâng. Án-ni, lín ê kî-tó chiah bōe siū chó͘-gāi.
Chóng kóng, lín lóng tio̍h tâng-sim, tâng-chêng, saⁿ-thiàⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, ū jîn-chû, sim chûn khiam-pi;
bô ēng pháiⁿ pò pháiⁿ, á-sī ēng bú-jio̍k tùi-hù bú-jio̍k; tian-tò tio̍h ēng chiok-hok hôe-pò, in-ūi lín sī ūi-tio̍h chit-ê siū ho͘-tiàu, hō͘ lín thang sêng-siū hok-khì.
In-ūi Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Lâng nā ài sìⁿ-miā, ài kè hó ji̍t-chí, tio̍h kìm ka-kī ê chi̍h bô kóng pháiⁿ-ōe, kìm-chí chhùi-tûn bô kóng khúi-chà.
Tio̍h kū-choa̍t pháiⁿ, chòe hó-sū, jia̍t-sim tui-kiû hô-pêng.
In-ūi Chú ê ba̍k-chiu khòaⁿ-kò͘ gī-lâng, I ê hī-khang thiaⁿ in ê kî-tó; m̄-kú I ōe tùi choh-pháiⁿ ê lâng pìⁿ-bīn.
Lín nā jia̍t-sim choh-hó, siáⁿ-lâng ōe hāi lín?
Chóng-sī lín nā ūi-tio̍h gī siū-khó͘, chiū ū hok-khì. M̄-bián kiaⁿ lâng ê ui-hia̍p, mā m̄-bián tio̍h-kip put-an.
Tio̍h chun-chông Ki-tok chòe Chú. Nā ū lâng mn̄g lín sim-tiong ê ǹg-bāng, tio̍h put-sî chún-pī hó-sè thang tùi in piān-bêng.

Put-kò tio̍h ēng un-hô kap chun-tiōng ê thài-tō͘ lâi hôe-tap. Tio̍h ū chheng-pe̍k ê liông-sim, thang tī lín siū bú-jio̍k ê sî hō͘ hiah-ê bú-jio̍k lín ê lâng khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lín khò Ki-tok só͘ piáu-hiān ê hó phín-hēng kám-kak kiàn-siàu.
Siū-khó͘ nā-sī Siōng-tè ê chí-ì, choh-hó lâi siū-khó͘ pí choh-pháiⁿ lâi siū-khó͘ khah hó.

In-ūi Ki-tok mā bat ūi-tio̍h chōe siū-khó͘, chi̍t piàn chiū oân-sêng; gī ê lâng thòe put-gī ê lâng siū-khó͘, sī ūi-tio̍h beh chhōa lín kàu Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng. Tī jio̍k-thé, I siū chhú-sí; tī lêng, I ū koh-oa̍h.
Thong-kè I ê lêng, I mā ū khì tùi hiah-ê tī kaⁿ-lāi ê lêng thoân-tō,

chiū-sī Ná-a chún-pī tōa-chûn ê sî, Siōng-tè ū nāi-sim thèng-hāu hiah-ê m̄ sūn-ho̍k I ê lâng. Tng-sî chìn-ji̍p tōa-chûn ê lâng bô kúi ê, chí-ū poeh ê, in ū tùi chúi--ni̍h tit-tio̍h kiù.

Chit-ê chúi ū-piáu sóe-lé, m̄-sī beh sóe-tû lín seng-khu ê lah-sap, sī beh hō͘ lín ū chheng-pe̍k ê liông-sim thang tùi Siōng-tè koat-chì; chit-ê sóe-lé thong-kè Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê koh-oa̍h hō͘ lín tit-tio̍h chín-kiù.
I í-keng chiūⁿ-thiⁿ, hiān-chāi tī Siōng-tè ê chiàⁿ-pêng teh chiáng-koán chèng thiⁿ-sài í-ki̍p lêng-kài ê chiáng-koân-chiá kap koân-le̍k-chiá.
Ki-tok kì-jiân tī jio̍k-thé siū-khó͘, lín mā tio̍h ēng kâng-khoán ê sim-chì lâi chong-pī ka-kī, in-ūi tī jio̍k-thé siū-khó͘ sī kap chōe-ok toān-choa̍t koan-hē.
Án-ni, lín tī sè-kan só͘ chhun ê ji̍t-chí chiū bô koh chiàu lâng ê chêng-io̍k, sī chiàu Siōng-tè ê chí-ì lâi oa̍h.

Lín ū lōng-hùi kong-im chòe bī-sìn-chiá só͘ ài chòe ê sū, îm-loān, sek-io̍k, chiú-chùi, iàn-lo̍k, tōa-chia̍h tōa-lim, kap khó-ò͘ⁿ ê ngó͘-siōng chông-pài téng, í-keng kàu-gia̍h lah.
In khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lín bô koh kap in kè hòng-tōng bô chiat-chè ê seng-oa̍h, chiū kî-koài soah kā lín húi-pòng.
In tio̍h tùi teh-beh sím-phòaⁿ oa̍h-lâng kap sí-lâng ê Siōng-tè kau-siàu.

Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê iân-kò͘, hok-im sīm-chì mā ū thoân hō͘ sí--khì ê lâng, hō͘ in ê jio̍k-thé sui-jiân tio̍h chiàu it-poaⁿ-lâng ê khoán siū sím-phòaⁿ, m̄-kú in ê lêng ōe-tàng chiàu Siōng-tè ê khoán lâi oa̍h.
Bān-iú ê chiong-kio̍k kūn lah! Só͘-í, tio̍h kín-sīn siú-kí, thang kéng-séng kî-tó.
Siōng iàu-kín--ê, sī tio̍h jia̍t-chhiat saⁿ-thiàⁿ, in-ūi thiàⁿ ōe jia-khàm chin chōe chōe-kò.
Tio̍h hō͘-siōng hó khoán-thāi, m̄-thang bâi-oàn.
Choh Siōng-tè só͘ sù ta̍k-hāng un-sù ê hó koán-ke, tio̍h chiàu ta̍k-ê lâng só͘ tit--tio̍h ê un-sù hō͘-siōng ho̍k-bū.
