Kóng tō-lí--ê, tio̍h kóng Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit; sū-hōng--ê, tio̍h chiàu Siōng-tè só͘ sù un-sù ê le̍k-liōng lâi sū-hōng, hō͘ Siōng-tè thong-kè Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tī bān-sū tit-tio̍h êng-iāu. Goān êng-kng koân-pèng lóng kui I, ti̍t-kàu éng-éng-oán-oán. Amen!
Chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín tú-tio̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ hé ê chhì-liān, m̄-thang ná-chún tú-tio̍h kî-koài ê sū;
hoán-tńg tio̍h in-ūi ū hun-tam Ki-tok ê khó͘-lān lâi hoaⁿ-hí, hō͘ lín tī I êng-iāu hián-hiān ê sî mā thang hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k.
Lín nā ūi-tio̍h Ki-tok ê miâ siū lêng-jio̍k, lín chin ū hok-khì, in-ūi ū Siōng-tè êng-kng ê Sîn tiàm tī lín sin-chiūⁿ.
Lín tiong-kan m̄-thang ū lâng in-ūi thâi-lâng, choh-chha̍t, choh-pháiⁿ, á-sī ài koán pa̍t-lâng ê tāi-chì lâi siū-khó͘.
Nā in-ūi choh Ki-tok-tô͘ lâi siū-khó͘, m̄-bián kiàn-siàu, hoán-tńg tio̍h in-ūi ū chit-ê miâ kui êng-kng hō͘ Siōng-tè.

Sím-phòaⁿ ê sî kàu lah! Siōng-tè ê ke tio̍h tāi-seng siū sím-phòaⁿ; nā tùi lán khai-sí, hiah-ê m̄ sìn-thàn Siōng-tè hok-im ê lâng ê kiat-kio̍k kiám bōe koh-khah giâm-tiōng?
Sèng-keng ū kóng: Gī-lâng tit-kiù to chin oh, bô kèng-khiân ê lâng kap chōe-jîn kiám bōe koh-khah khùn-lân?
Só͘-í, hiah-ê chiàu Siōng-tè ê chí-ì siū-khó͘ ê lâng, tio̍h chiong ka-kī kau-thok hō͘ hit-ūi thang sìn-khò ê Chō-bu̍t-chú, kè-sio̍k chòe hó-sū.
Góa choh tiúⁿ-ló, koh choh Ki-tok siū-khó͘ ê kiàn-chèng-jîn, ū-hūn tī I teh-beh hián-hiān ê êng-kng, góa kā lín tiong-kan pîⁿ-pîⁿ teh choh tiúⁿ-ló ê lâng khó͘-khǹg.

Tio̍h bo̍k-ióng Siōng-tè kau-tài lín ê iûⁿ-kûn, kā in koàn-kò͘, m̄-sī bián-kióng, sī chiàu Siōng-tè ê chí-ì kam-sim lo̍k-ì; m̄-sī ūi-tio̍h tham-châi, sī chū-goān jia̍t-sim lâi chòe.
Kau-tài hō͘ lín ê iûⁿ-kûn, m̄-thang ēng koân-ui koán-hat, tio̍h chòe in ê bô͘-iūⁿ.
Án-ni, lín tī Tōa-bo̍k-chiá hián-hiān ê sî ōe tit-tio̍h éng-oán bōe sit-khì kong-chhái êng-kng ê hoa-koan.

Siâng-khoán, lín siàu-liân-lâng tio̍h sūn-ho̍k tióng-pòe. Lín tāi-ke tio̍h khiam-pi saⁿ tùi-thāi; in-ūi Sèng-keng ū kì-chài: Siōng-tè te̍k-tùi kiau-ngō͘ ê lâng, si-un hō͘ khiam-pi ê lâng.
Só͘-í, lín tio̍h tī Siōng-tè tōa khùi-la̍t ê chhiú-ē khiam-pi, I kàu sî chiū ōe kā lín ko-seng.
Lín tio̍h chiong it-chhè ê khòa-lū kau hō͘ Siōng-tè, in-ūi I koan-sim lín.
Tio̍h kín-sīn, tio̍h kéng-séng, in-ūi lín ê tùi-te̍k Mô͘-kúi chhin-chhiūⁿ teh háu ê sai, sì-kòe kiâⁿ teh chhē thang thun-chia̍h ê lâng.
Tio̍h khò kian-tēng ê sìn-sim lâi tí-tng i, in-ūi lín chai choân sè-kài ê chèng hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē lóng teh keng-le̍k siâng-khoán ê khó͘-lān.

Sù it-chhè un-tián ê Siōng-tè, chiū-sī thong-kè Ki-tok lâi ho͘-tiàu lín chìn-ji̍p éng-oán ê êng-kng Hit-ūi, tī lín chiām-sî siū-khó͘ í-āu, it-tēng ōe chhin-sin kā lín têng-sin kiàn-li̍p, sù lín khùi-la̍t, hō͘ lín kian-kò͘, khiā-chāi.
Goān koân-lêng kui hō͘ I, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán. Amen!

Thong-kè tiong-si̍t ê hiaⁿ-tī Se-la, góa siá chit-tiuⁿ té-té ê phoe hō͘ lín, lâi bián-lē lín, koh kiàn-chèng che sī Siōng-tè chin-si̍t ê un-tián. Tio̍h tī chit-ê un-tián téng-bīn khiā-chāi.
Tiàm tī Pa-pí-lûn kap lín pîⁿ-pîⁿ siū kéng-tiàu ê kàu-hōe kā lín chhéng-an. Góa ê kiáⁿ Má-khó mā kā lín chhéng-an.
Tio̍h chhin-chhiat hō͘-siōng chhéng-an. Goān pêng-an kui tī lín só͘-ū sio̍k Ki-tok ê lâng!

Góa Se-biān Pí-tek sī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê po̍k-jîn kap sù-tô͘, góa siá-phoe hō͘ hiah-ê khò lán ê Siōng-tè kap Kiù-chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê gī, kap goán chòe-hé niá-siū kâng-khoán pó-kùi sìn-gióng ê lâng.
Goān lín thong-kè jīn-bat Siōng-tè kap lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ tit-tio̍h Siōng-tè só͘ sù hong-hong-hù-hù ê un-tián kap pêng-an!

Siōng-tè ū ēng I ê lêng-le̍k chiong kèng-khiân ê seng-oa̍h só͘ su-iàu ê it-chhè sù hō͘ lán; che sī thong-kè lán jīn-bat tiàu lán lâi hun-hióng I ê êng-kng kap liông-siān hit-ūi Siōng-tè lâi--ê.

Án-ni, I ū chiong ke̍k-tōa koh pó-kùi ê èng-ún sù hō͘ lán, hō͘ lín thong-kè chiah-ê èng-ún thang thoat-lī sè-chiūⁿ ê io̍k-bōng só͘ chō-sêng ê hú-pāi lâi hun-hióng Siōng-tè ê pún-sèng.
Ūi-tio̍h chit-ê, lín tio̍h chīn-la̍t phah-piàⁿ, hō͘ lín ū sìn-sim koh ū tek-hēng, ū tek-hēng koh ū tì-sek,
ū tì-sek koh ū chiat-chè, ū chiat-chè koh ū jím-nāi, ū jím-nāi koh ū kèng-khiân,
ū kèng-khiân koh ū chhiú-chiok-chi-chêng, ū chhiú-chiok-chi-chêng koh ū jîn-ài.
Chiah-ê sī lín só͘ su-iàu ê phín-tek. Chiah-ê lín nā lóng ū, koh ná chhiong-si̍t, ōe hō͘ lín koh-khah chek-ke̍k, koh-khah iú-hāu jīn-bat lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok.
Lâng nā bô chiah-ê tek-hēng, sī toán-sī, sī sit-bêng, bōe-kì-tit i í-chêng ê chōe í-keng ū sóe chheng-khì.
Só͘-í, góa ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, lín tio̍h koh-khah lô-le̍k lâi chèng-bêng Siōng-tè tùi lín ê ho͘-tiàu kap kéng-soán sī khak-si̍t--ê; lín nā án-ni chòe chiū bōe tūi-lo̍h.
Án-ni, Siōng-tè ōe tōa-tōa sù-hok hō͘ lín thang chìn-ji̍p lán ê Chú — Kiù-chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok éng-oán ê Kok-tō͘.
Só͘-í, sui-jiân lín í-keng chai chiah-ê tāi-chì, koh kian-tēng chip-siú lín só͘ niá-siū ê chin-lí, góa iáu-kú beh put-sî kā lín thê-chhíⁿ chiah-ê tāi-chì.
Góa siūⁿ, góa iáu oa̍h--teh ê sî, tio̍h kā lín thê-chhíⁿ.
Lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok í-keng ū chheng-chhó kā góa chí-sī, hō͘ góa chai bô kú chiū ōe thoat-lī chit-ê ōe pāi-hoāi ê seng-khu.
Góa beh chīn-la̍t siūⁿ pān-hoat, hō͘ lín tī góa lī-khui sè-kan í-āu put-sî ōe-kì-tit chiah-ê tāi-chì.
Goán tùi lín só͘ kóng Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tōa koân-lêng lâi-lîm ê sū, m̄-sī kun-kù lâng lia̍p-chō--chhut-lâi hu-ké ê thoân-soat; goán ū chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I ê chun-êng.
I tùi Pē Siōng-tè niá-siū chun-kùi kap êng-iāu ê sî, hit-ūi Chun-giâm ê Êng-kng — Siōng-tè chhut-siaⁿ kóng, “Chit-ê sī góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê Kiáⁿ, I, góa chin ì-ài.”
I tī sèng-soaⁿ ê sî goán mā tī hia, ū chhin-sin thiaⁿ-kìⁿ tùi thiⁿ-téng chhut--lâi chit-ê siaⁿ.

Só͘-í goán tùi sian-ti só͘ soan-pò͘ ê sìn-sit koh-khah ū khak-sìn. Lín tio̍h chù-ì thiaⁿ, in-ūi chit-ê sìn-sit chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t pha teng tī o͘-àm ê só͘-chāi teh chiò, chiò kàu thiⁿ-kng, kàu khé-bêng-chhiⁿ chhut-hiān tī lín sim-lāi ê sî.
Siōng iàu-kín--ê tio̍h chai, Sèng-keng só͘-ū ê ū-giân m̄-thang chiàu ka-kī ê ì-sù kóe-seh.
In-ūi ū-giân m̄-sī chhut-tī lâng ê ì-sù, sī lâng siū Sèng Sîn kám-tōng kóng-chhut tùi Siōng-tè lâi ê sìn-sit.

Í-chêng mā ū ké sian-ti tī bîn-kan chhut-hiān; kâng-khoán, hiān-chāi mā ū ké kàu-su ōe tī lín tiong-kan chhut-hiān. In àm-tiong chiong hō͘ lâng bia̍t-bông ê īⁿ-toan tòa--ji̍p-lâi, sīm-chì m̄ sêng-jīn hit-ūi sio̍k-hôe in ê Chú-cháiⁿ, tì-kàu ka-kī chin kín chiū bia̍t-bông.
M̄-kú iáu ū chin chōe lâng o̍h in îm-loān ê seng-oa̍h, tì-kàu chin-lí ê Tō-lō͘ in-ūi in siū húi-pòng.
Chiah-ê ké kàu-su in-ūi tham-sim, ōe ēng liap-chō ê kò͘-sū pián lín ê châi-bu̍t. Tùi chit-khoán lâng ê tēng-chōe chá chiū koat-tēng; in chin kín chiū bia̍t-bông.
Siōng-tè bô khoan-iông hoān-chōe ê thiⁿ-sài, kā in tàn-lo̍h tōe-ge̍k, koaiⁿ tī o͘-àm ê Chhim-khiⁿ, thèng-hāu sím-phòaⁿ.
Siōng-tè mā bô khoan-iông kó͘-tāi ê sè-kài, ēng tōa-chúi im-bia̍t bô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê sè-kan-lâng, chí-ū kiù soan-iông kong-gī ê Ná-a kap kî-tha chhit ê lâng.
Siōng-tè chhú-hoa̍t Só͘-to-má kap Gô-mô͘-la ê siâⁿ-chhī, ēng hé húi-bia̍t in, hō͘ bô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng chòe kéng-kài.
Siōng-tè ū kiù gī-lâng Lô-tek, in-ūi Lô-tek ūi-tio̍h siâ-ok ê lâng îm-loān ê só͘-chòe chhau-sim.
Hit-ê gī-lâng Lô-tek tiàm tī in tiong-kan, ta̍k-ji̍t ū thiaⁿ--kìⁿ koh khòaⁿ-tio̍h hiah-ê siâ-ok ê tāi-chì, i chèng-gī ê sim hui-siông thòng-khó͘.

Chú chai án-chóaⁿ kiù kèng-khiân ê lâng thoat-lī chhì-liān, mā chai kā put-gī ê lâng lâu kàu Sím-phòaⁿ ê Ji̍t siū hêng-hoa̍t, te̍k-pia̍t sī hiah-ê hòng-chhiòng jio̍k-thé ê chêng-io̍k kap biáu-sī Siōng-tè koân-ui ê lâng. Chiah-ê ké kàu-su tōa-táⁿ koh kiau-ngō͘, sīm-chì káⁿ bú-jio̍k chun-kùi ê chèng thiⁿ-sài.
Hiah-ê thiⁿ-sài ê khùi-la̍t kap lêng-le̍k sui-jiân pí ké kàu-su khah tōa, mā bô tī Chú ê bīn-chêng ēng bú-jio̍k ê ōe kā in khòng-kò.

M̄-kú, chiah-ê lâng kap chhut-sì chiū thàn pún-lêng teh oa̍h, beh hō͘ lâng lia̍h-khì thâi ê iá-siù kâng-khoán, in húi-pòng ka-kī m̄-bat ê sū; iá-siù húi-bia̍t, in mā ōe án-ni siū húi-bia̍t,

siū-tio̍h ka-kī put-gī ê hêng-ûi èng-tit ê pò-èng. In khòaⁿ tī ji̍t--sî tîm-bê tī chêng-io̍k chòe hióng-lo̍k. In kap lín chòe-hé lim-chia̍h ê sî, tōa-chia̍h tōa-lim, hòng-chhiòng iàn-lo̍k, oân-choân sit-thài.
In ê ba̍k-chiu chí-ū ài khòaⁿ siâ-îm, bô hoān-chōe tòng bōe tiâu. In ín-iú ì-chì po̍k-jio̍k ê lâng. In ê sim chí-ū siūⁿ tham-châi. In sī Siōng-tè chiù-chó͘ ê lâng!
In lī-khui chiàⁿ-lō͘, kiâⁿ bê-lō͘, kiâⁿ Pí-ní ê kiáⁿ Pa-lân só͘ kiâⁿ ê lō͘. Pa-lân tham-ài put-gī ê chîⁿ-châi,
ūi-tio̍h só͘ hoān ê chōe siū chek-pī. Chi̍t chiah bōe kóng-ōe ê lû-á kèng-jiân ēng lâng ê siaⁿ chó͘-chí sian-ti Pa-lân hong-kông ê siūⁿ-hoat.
Chiah-ê lâng chhin-chhiūⁿ ta--khì ê chúi-chôaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ hō͘ tōa-hong chhe-sòaⁿ ê hûn-bū; Siōng-tè í-keng ū kā in tī o͘-àm ê chhim-ian lâu chi̍t ê só͘-chāi.
In kóng khong-tōng ê gōng-ōe, ēng bōe-tàng khòng-chè ê jio̍k-thé ê chêng-io̍k, ín-iú í-keng thoat-lī sit-bê seng-oa̍h ê lâng.
In tah-èng hō͘ lâng chū-iû, m̄-kú ka-kī chòe hú-pāi seng-oa̍h ê lô͘-lē; in-ūi lâng siū sím-mi̍h khòng-chè, chiū chiâⁿ-chòe hit-ê ê lô͘-lē.

Lâng jīn-bat lán ê Chú — Kiù-chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok thoat-lī sè-kan ê hú-pāi í-āu, nā koh hō͘ hú-pāi ê sè-le̍k tîⁿ--teh koh ap-chè, chit-khoán ê kiat-kio̍k ōe pí í-chêng koh-khah bái.
In jīn-bat kong-gī ê Tō-lō͘, jiân-āu lī-khui só͘ thoân-siū hō͘ in sîn-sèng ê kài-bēng, án-ni lêng-khó tùi khí-thâu chiū m̄ bat khah hó.
In ê chêng-hêng tú chhin-chhiūⁿ sio̍k-gú só͘ kóng “Káu oa̍t tńg-lâi chia̍h ka-kī thò͘--chhut-lâi ê mi̍h”, á-sī “Ti sóe chheng-khì í-āu sûi-sî koh khì kō lō͘-kô͘-bê”.
Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, góa hiān-chāi siá hō͘ lín--ê sī tē-jī tiuⁿ phoe. Góa siá chit nn̄g tiuⁿ phoe sī beh thê-chhíⁿ lín lâi kek-khí lín sûn-kiat ê sim-chì.
Góa ài lín ōe-kì-tit kó͘-chá ê sèng sian-ti só͘ kóng ê ōe, kap lín ê sù-tô͘ só͘ thoân Chú — Kiù-chú hō͘ lín ê bēng-lēng.
Siōng iàu-kín--ê, lín tio̍h chai, tī chiong-boa̍t ê ji̍t-chí ū chi̍t-kóa thàn su-io̍k seng-oa̍h ê lâng ōe chhut-hiān, kā lín thí-chhiò
kóng, “Chú èng-ún beh lâi-lîm, taⁿ án-chóaⁿ? I tī tó-ūi? Lán ê chó͘-sian lóng sí--khì, m̄-kú tùi chhòng-sè í-lâi it-chhè lóng kâng-khoán.”
In kò͘-ì bû-sī chit-ê sū-si̍t, chiū-sī tī kó͘-chá thiⁿ tùi Siōng-tè ê ōe siū chhòng-chō, tōe sī tùi chúi, mā ēng chúi lâi hêng-sêng.
Tng-sî ê sè-kài sī hō͘ chúi im-ba̍t lâi húi-bia̍t.
M̄-kú hiān-chāi ê thiⁿ kap tōe mā kâng-khoán tùi Siōng-tè ê ōe tit-tio̍h pó-liû kàu sím-phòaⁿ kap put-khiân ê lâng hō͘ hé húi-bia̍t ê ji̍t.
Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, ū chi̍t hāng tāi-chì chhiáⁿ lín m̄-thang bōe-kì--tit, chiū-sī tùi Chú lâi khòaⁿ, chi̍t ji̍t ná chi̍t-chheng nî, chi̍t-chheng nî ná chi̍t ji̍t.
Ū lâng siūⁿ-kóng Chú iân-tî I tah-èng beh chòe ê sū, kî-si̍t I m̄-sī teh iân-tî, sī teh iông-jím lín, bô ài ū lâng bia̍t-bông, ài ta̍k-ê lâng lóng hóe-kái.

M̄-kú Chú ê Ji̍t ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chha̍t-á hut-jiân lâi. Tī hit-ê Ji̍t, chiah-ê thiⁿ ōe tī tōa ê hiáng-siaⁿ tiong siau-bia̍t, thian-thé hō͘ hé siau-iûⁿ, tōe kap tōe-chiūⁿ it-chhè ê pī-chō-bu̍t lóng siau-bia̍t.
Kì-jiân chiah-ê it-chhè ōe án-ni húi-bia̍t, lín tio̍h án-chóaⁿ choh-lâng? Lín ê seng-oa̍h tio̍h sèng-kiat, kèng-khiân,
thèng-hāu koh chhui-pek Siōng-tè ê Ji̍t kóaⁿ-kín lâi-lîm. Tī hit-ji̍t, chiah-ê thiⁿ ōe hō͘ hé sio-bia̍t, thian-thé ōe hō͘ hé sio-iûⁿ.
M̄-kú lán teh thèng-hāu ê sī Siōng-tè só͘ èng-ún sin ê thiⁿ sin ê tōe, tī hia kong-gī éng-oán tit-tio̍h kiàn-li̍p.

Só͘-í, chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, kì-jiân lín teh thèng-hāu chiah-ê tāi-chì, tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng tio̍h chīn-la̍t tui-kiû hō͘ ka-kī bô khoat-tiám, bô thang chí-chek, thang kap I hô-hó.
Tio̍h chiong lán ê Chú ê khoan-iông khòaⁿ-chòe lín tit-kiù ê ki-hōe, che mā-sī lán chhin-ài ê hiaⁿ-tī Pó-lô ēng Siōng-tè sù hō͘ i ê tì-hūi siá-phoe só͘ khoàn-bián--ê.

I só͘-ū ê phoe lóng ū kóng-khí chiah-ê sū. I ê phoe ū chi̍t-kóa oh lí-kái ê ōe, hiah-ê gû-gōng bô tēng-sèng ê lâng ōe kā i khiok-kái, tú kap in teh khiok-kái kî-tha ê keng-bûn kâng-khoán; kiat-kó, in ka-kī thó bia̍t-bông.

Só͘-í, chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, lín kì-jiân tāi-seng chai chit-ê tāi-chì, tio̍h kín-sīn chiah bián hō͘ pháiⁿ-lâng ēng chhò-gō͘ ê giân-lūn chhōa-khì kiâⁿ chhò-gō͘ ê lō͘, lī-khui lín kian-kò͘ ê li̍p-tiûⁿ.
Tio̍h tī lán ê Chú — Kiù-chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê un-tián-ē kap tùi I ê jīm-sek kè-sio̍k chìn-pō͘. Goān êng-kng kui hō͘ I, tùi hiān-chāi ti̍t-kàu éng-oán. Amen!

Goán beh kā lín soat-bêng chhòng-sè í-chêng chiū chûn-chāi hit-ê oa̍h-miā ê Tō; chit-ê Tō goán ū thiaⁿ--tio̍h, ū chhin-ba̍k khòaⁿ--tio̍h, ū siông-sè khòaⁿ--tio̍h, mā ū chhin-chhiú bong--tio̍h.

Chit-ê oa̍h-miā í-keng hián-hiān; goán ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, hiān-chāi chòe kiàn-chèng, koh tùi lín soan-pò͘ goân-lâi kap Pē tông-chāi koh í-keng ū tùi goán hián-hiān chit-ê éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.

Goán khòaⁿ--tio̍h koh thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, hiān-chāi mā tùi lín soan-pò͘, sī beh hō͘ lín mā thang kap goán ū thoân-khè; chit-ê thoân-khè sī goán kap Pē kap I ê Kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tiong-kan ê thoân-khè.
Goán siá chiah-ê sī beh hō͘ lán ū oân-boán ê hoaⁿ-hí.
Goán tùi Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ thiaⁿ--tio̍h, hiān-chāi thoân hō͘ lín ê sìn-sit sī án-ni: Siōng-tè sī kng, tī I oân-choân bô o͘-àm.
Lán nā kóng lán kap I ū thoân-khè, iáu-kú kè-sio̍k tī o͘-àm tiong seng-oa̍h, sī kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, bô si̍t-hêng chin-lí.

M̄-kú, Siōng-tè tī kng-bêng tiong, lán nā chiàu án-ni tī kng-bêng tiong seng-oa̍h, lán chiū hō͘-siōng ū thoân-khè, I ê Kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘ ê huih ōe kè-sio̍k sóe-chheng lán lóng-chóng ê chōe.
Lán nā kóng lán bô chōe, sī phiàn ka-kī, chin-lí bô tī lán lāi-bīn.
Lán nā sêng-jīn lán ê chōe, Siōng-tè sī sìn-si̍t kong-gī, beh sià-bián lán ê chōe, sóe-chheng lán lóng-chóng ê put-gī.
Lán nā kóng lán m̄-bat hoān-chōe, sī kā Siōng-tè khòaⁿ-chòe pe̍h-chha̍t, I ê tō bô tī lán lāi-bīn.
Siàu-liân-lâng, góa siá chiah-ê sī beh hō͘ lín bōe khì hoān-chōe. Nā ū lâng hoān-chōe, lán ū gī-lâng Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tī Pē ê bīn-chêng chòe lán ê Piān-hō͘-jîn.
I ūi-tio̍h lán ê chōe, m̄-nā lán ê chōe, mā ūi-tio̍h choân sè-kài ê chōe, choh sio̍k-chōe-chè.
Lán nā ū teh chun-siú Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng, chiū chai lán chin-chiàⁿ bat Siōng-tè.
Nā ū lâng kóng “góa bat Siōng-tè”, m̄-kú bô teh chun-siú I ê kài-bēng, chit-ê lâng sī pe̍h-chha̍t, i lāi-bīn bô chin-lí.

M̄-kú lâng nā chun-siú Siōng-tè ê tō, Siōng-tè ê thiàⁿ chiū chin-chiàⁿ tī i sin-chiūⁿ oân-choân si̍t-hiān. Lâng nā kóng i tiàm tī Siōng-tè lāi-bīn, eng-kai chiàu Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê giân-hêng seng-oa̍h. Án-ni chiū chai lán ū tī Siōng-tè lāi-bīn.
Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, góa siá hō͘ lín--ê m̄-sī sin ê kài-bēng, sī lín tùi khí-thâu chiū niá-siū hit-ê kū ê kài-bēng, sī lín bat thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê sìn-sit.
Chóng-sī góa siá hō͘ lín ê kài-bēng mā thang kóng sī sin--ê, che tùi Ki-tok kap tùi lín lóng sī chin--ê; in-ūi o͘-àm teh kè--khì, chin kng í-keng teh chiò.
Lâng nā kóng i tī kng-bêng tiong, m̄-kú oàn-hūn hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē, sū-si̍t i iáu-kú tī o͘-àm tiong.
Thiàⁿ hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē ê lâng sī tī kng-bêng tiong teh seng-oa̍h, bōe tì-kàu hō͘ lâng poa̍h-tó hoān-chōe.
M̄-kú oàn-hūn hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē ê lâng sī tī o͘-àm tiong, tī o͘-àm tiong teh seng-oa̍h, m̄ chai beh khì tó-ūi, in-ūi o͘-àm hō͘ i ê ba̍k-chiu bô khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Siàu-liân-lâng, góa siá-phoe hō͘ lín, in-ūi khò Ki-tok ê miâ lín ê chōe í-keng tit-tio̍h sià-bián.

Hū-ló sī-tōa, góa siá-phoe hō͘ lín, in-ūi lín jīn-bat tùi khí-thâu chiū chûn-chāi Hit-ūi. Chheng-liân-lâng, góa siá-phoe hō͘ lín, in-ūi lín í-keng ū iâⁿ-kè hit-ê Siâ-ok-chiá.

Sòe-kiáⁿ, góa siá-phoe hō͘ lín, in-ūi lín jīn-bat Pē. Hū-ló sī-tōa, góa siá-phoe hō͘ lín, in-ūi lín jīn-bat tùi khí-thâu chiū chûn-chāi Hit-ūi. Chheng-liân-lâng, góa siá-phoe hō͘ lín, in-ūi lín ióng-chòng, Siōng-tè ê tō tiàm tī lín lāi-bīn, koh lín í-keng ū iâⁿ-kè hit-ê Siâ-ok-chiá.
M̄-thang tham-ài sè-kan á-sī sè-kan ê mi̍h. Nā ū lâng tham-ài sè-kan, i chiū bô thiàⁿ Pē.
In-ūi it-chhè sio̍k sè-kan--ê, chhin-chhiūⁿ jio̍k-thé ê io̍k-bōng, ba̍k-chiu ê io̍k-bōng, tián ka-kī ê châi-hù, téng, lóng m̄-sī tùi Pē lâi, sī tùi sè-kan lâi--ê.
Chit sè-kan kap sè-kan ê io̍k-bōng lóng teh kè--khì, chóng-sī si̍t-hêng Siōng-tè chí-ì ê lâng éng-oán seng-chûn.

Sòe-kiáⁿ, che sī chiong-boa̍t ê sî. Lín ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h Ki-tok ê Te̍k-tùi-chiá teh-beh lâi, hiān-chāi í-keng ū chin chōe Ki-tok ê te̍k-tùi-chiá chhut-hiān; tùi án-ni, lán chai che sī chiong-boa̍t ê sî.
In lī-khui lán, in-ūi in m̄-sī lán ê lâng; in nā-sī lán ê lâng, ōe kè-sio̍k kap lán chòe-hé. M̄-kú in lī-khui, piáu-sī in lóng m̄-sī lán ê lâng.
Lín í-keng ū niá-siū Sèng Sîn, lín lóng chai.
Góa siá-phoe hō͘ lín, m̄-sī in-ūi lín m̄ bat chin-lí, sī in-ūi lín bat chin-lí, koh chai it-chhè ê hu-ké m̄-sī tùi chin-lí lâi.
Sím-mi̍h-lâng sī pe̍h-chha̍t--ê? It-tēng sī kū-choa̍t Iâ-so͘ sī Ki-tok hit-ê lâng! Kū-choa̍t Pē kap Kiáⁿ ê chiū-sī Ki-tok ê Te̍k-tùi-chiá.
Kū-choa̍t Kiáⁿ ê bô chiap-la̍p Pē; soan-jīn Kiáⁿ chiū-sī chiap-la̍p Pē.
Tio̍h kian-siú lín tùi khí-thâu só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê sìn-sit. Lín nā kian-siú tùi khí-thâu só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê sìn-sit chiū ōe kè-sio̍k oa̍h tī Kiáⁿ kap Pē ê lāi-bīn.
Che chiū-sī Ki-tok hō͘ lán ê èng-ún, sī éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Góa siá chiah-ê hō͘ lín, sī koan-hē siūⁿ-beh bê-he̍k lín ê lâng ê sū.

Tùi lín lâi kóng, lín tùi Ki-tok niá-siū ê Sèng Sîn tiàm tī lín lāi-bīn, chiū bô su-iàu pa̍t-lâng kā lín kà-sī, in-ūi chit-ūi Sèng Sîn beh kà-sī lín ta̍k-hāng tāi-chì; I ê kà-sī sī chin--ê, m̄-sī ké--ê. Án-ni, tio̍h chiàu Sèng Sîn kà-sī lín--ê, tiàm tī Ki-tok lāi-bīn.
Taⁿ, siàu-liân-lâng, tio̍h tiàm tī Ki-tok lāi-bīn, án-ni tī I hián-hiān ê sî, lán tī I bīn-chêng chiah ōe hó-táⁿ, bōe in-ūi I ê lâi-lîm kám-kak kiàn-siàu.
Lín nā chai I sī kong-gī, eng-kai chai si̍t-hêng kong-gī ê lâng chiah sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Lín siūⁿ-khòaⁿ leh, Pē jōa-á-ni̍h thiàⁿ lán, hō͘ lán thang chheng-chòe I ê kiáⁿ-jî; sū-si̍t lán chiū-sī. Sè-kan-lâng m̄ bat lán, in-ūi in m̄ bat Siōng-tè.

Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, hiān-chāi lán sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî, chiong-lâi ōe án-chóaⁿ iáu-bē bêng-hián. M̄-kú lán chai, Ki-tok hián-hiān ê sî, lán ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ I, in-ūi lán ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I ê chin-siōng.
Ki-tok sī sûn-kiat, só͘-í tùi Ki-tok ū chit-khoán ǹg-bāng ê lâng ōe ka-kī pó-chhî sûn-kiat.
Lâng hoān-chōe sī ûi-pōe Siōng-tè ê Lu̍t-hoat, in-ūi chōe sī ûi-pōe Siōng-tè ê Lu̍t-hoat.
Lín chai Ki-tok hián-hiān sī beh tû-khì lâng ê chōe, m̄-kú I pún-sin bô chōe.
Kap Ki-tok pó-chhî bi̍t-chhiat koan-hē ê lâng bōe kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe; kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe ê lâng m̄-bat khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Ki-tok, mā m̄ bat I.
Siàu-liân pêng-iú, m̄-thang siū bê-he̍k. Ki-tok sī gī-lâng, só͘-í si̍t-hêng kong-gī--ê chiah sī gī-lâng.
Kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe ê lâng sio̍k Mô͘-kúi, in-ūi Mô͘-kúi tùi khí-thâu chiū hoān-chōe. Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ hián-hiān ê bo̍k-te̍k sī beh phò-hoāi Mô͘-kúi ê chok-ûi.
Tùi Siōng-tè siⁿ--ê bōe kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe, in-ūi Siōng-tè ê oa̍h-miā tī in lāi-bīn; in bōe kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe, in-ūi in sī tùi Siōng-tè siⁿ--ê.
Tùi án-ni, sím-mi̍h-lâng sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî á-sī Mô͘-kúi ê kiáⁿ-jî chin chheng-chhó: Bô si̍t-hêng kong-gī, bô thiàⁿ hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē--ê, m̄-sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Lán tio̍h saⁿ-thiàⁿ; che sī lín tùi khí-thâu só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h ê sìn-sit.
Lán m̄-thang chhin-chhiūⁿ Kai-ún; i sio̍k Siâ-ok-chiá, ū thâi-sí ka-kī ê sió-tī. I ná ōe thâi-sí sió-tī? In-ūi i ê hêng-ûi siâ-ok, m̄-kú sió-tī ê hêng-ûi chèng-ti̍t.
Hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, sè-kan-lâng nā oàn-hūn lín, lín m̄-bián kî-koài.
Lán chai, lán í-keng chhut-sí-ji̍p-oa̍h, in-ūi lán ū thiàⁿ hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē. Bô thiàⁿ--lâng-ê sī tiàm tī sí ê koán-hat-ē.
Oàn-hūn hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē chiū-sī thâi-lâng; lín mā chai, thâi-lâng--ê, éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā bô tiàm tī i lāi-bīn.
Ki-tok ūi-tio̍h lán hi-seng sìⁿ-miā, tùi án-ni lán chai sím-mi̍h sī thiàⁿ; án-ni lán mā ài ūi-tio̍h hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē hi-seng sìⁿ-miā.
Nā ū hó-gia̍h-lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē ū khiàm-kheh ia̍h bô tông-chêng lîn-bín, ná ōe-tàng kóng i ū thiàⁿ Siōng-tè?
Siàu-liân pêng-iú, saⁿ-thiàⁿ m̄-thang chí-ū ēng ōe á-sī ēng chhùi kóng, tio̍h si̍t-si̍t-chāi-chāi si̍t-hêng.

Tùi án-ni lán chai lán sio̍k chin-lí. Lán nā siū liông-sim chek-pī, tī Siōng-tè ê bīn-chêng lán ōe-tàng an-ún chū-chāi, in-ūi I ê sim pí lán ê sim koh-khah khoan-tāi, I ta̍k-hāng lóng chai.
Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, lán ê liông-sim nā bô kā lán chek-pī, lán tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng chiū thang ióng-kám m̄-bián kiaⁿ.
Lán bô-lūn tùi I kiû sím-mi̍h lóng ōe tit--tio̍h, in-ūi lán chun-siú I ê kài-bēng, tī I bīn-chêng chòe I só͘ hoaⁿ-hí ê sū.
I ê kài-bēng sī án-ni: Lán tio̍h sìn I ê Kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê miâ, mā tio̍h chiàu I hō͘ lán ê bēng-lēng saⁿ-thiàⁿ.
Chun-siú Siōng-tè kài-bēng ê lâng tiàm tī I lāi-bīn, I mā tī in lāi-bīn. Tùi Siōng-tè sù hō͘ lán ê Sèng Sîn lán chai Siōng-tè tiàm tī lán lāi-bīn.
Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, m̄-thang siong-sìn ta̍k-ê sîn; tio̍h chhat-giām chiah-ê sîn sī tùi Siōng-tè lâi á m̄-sī, in-ūi ū chin chōe ké sian-ti í-keng chhut-hiān tī chit sè-kan.
Lín thang ēng án-ni lâi jīn-bat Siōng-tè ê Sîn: Soan-jīn Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok chiâⁿ-chòe lâng lâi sè-kan hit-ūi Sîn sī tùi Siōng-tè lâi--ê;
m̄ soan-jīn Iâ-so͘ hiah-ê sîn m̄-sī tùi Siōng-tè lâi--ê. Che sī Ki-tok ê Te̍k-tùi-chiá ê sîn, lín ū thiaⁿ-tio̍h i teh-beh lâi, hiān-chāi í-keng tī sè-kan.
Siàu-liân pêng-iú, lín sī sio̍k Siōng-tè, koh í-keng iâⁿ-kè ké sian-ti, in-ūi tiàm tī lín lāi-bīn ê Sèng Sîn pí tiàm tī sè-kan-lâng lāi-bīn ê sîn khah kiông khah tōa.
Ké sian-ti sī sio̍k sè-kan, kóng sè-kan sū, só͘-í sè-kan-lâng ōe thiaⁿ in.
Lán sī sio̍k Siōng-tè. Bat Siōng-tè ê lâng ōe thiaⁿ lán; bô sio̍k Siōng-tè ê lâng m̄ thiaⁿ lán. Tùi chit-ê, lán jīn-bat chin-lí ê Sîn kap bê-he̍k lâng ê sîn.
Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, lán tio̍h saⁿ-thiàⁿ, in-ūi thiàⁿ sī tùi Siōng-tè lâi. Ū thiàⁿ ê lâng sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî, mā bat Siōng-tè.
Bô thiàⁿ ê lâng m̄ bat Siōng-tè, in-ūi Siōng-tè sī thiàⁿ.
Siōng-tè chhe I to̍k-it ê Kiáⁿ lâi kàu sè-kan, beh hō͘ lán tùi I tit-tio̍h oa̍h-miā; tùi chit-ê, Siōng-tè ê thiàⁿ hián-bêng tī lán tiong-kan.
M̄-sī lán thiàⁿ Siōng-tè, sī I ū thiàⁿ lán, chhe I ê Kiáⁿ chòe sio̍k-chōe-chè lâi sio̍k lán ê chōe. Che chiū-sī thiàⁿ.
Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, Siōng-tè nā hiah-ni̍h thiàⁿ lán, lán mā tio̍h saⁿ-thiàⁿ.
Bô lâng bat khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè, lán nā saⁿ-thiàⁿ, Siōng-tè chiū tiàm tī lán lāi-bīn, I ê thiàⁿ thong-kè lán oân-choân si̍t-hiān chhut--lâi.
Siōng-tè í-keng ū chiong I ê Sèng Sîn sù hō͘ lán, tùi chit-ê lán chai lán tiàm tī Siōng-tè lāi-bīn, I mā tī lán lāi-bīn.
Pē chhe I ê Kiáⁿ lâi chòe sè-kan ê Kiù-chú, goán ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h, hiān-chāi chòe kiàn-chèng.
Soan-jīn Iâ-so͘ sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ ê lâng, Siōng-tè tiàm tī i lāi-bīn, i mā tī Siōng-tè lāi-bīn.
Só͘-í, lán chai koh sìn Siōng-tè ū thiàⁿ lán. Siōng-tè sī thiàⁿ, ū teh si̍t-hêng thiàⁿ ê lâng tiàm tī Siōng-tè lāi-bīn, Siōng-tè mā tiàm tī i lāi-bīn.
Tùi án-ni, thiàⁿ tī lán tiong-kan oân-choân si̍t-hiān chhut--lâi, hō͘ lán tī Sím-phòaⁿ ê Ji̍t thang ióng-kám m̄-bián kiaⁿ, in-ūi lán tī chit sè-kan kap Ki-tok kâng-khoán.
Ū thiàⁿ chiū bô kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ; oân-choân ê thiàⁿ kóaⁿ-chhut kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ. In-ūi ū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ chiū ū hêng-hoa̍t; ū kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ ê lâng, thiàⁿ iáu bô oân-choân si̍t-hiān chhut--lâi.
Lán tio̍h saⁿ-thiàⁿ, in-ūi Siōng-tè ū tāi-seng thiàⁿ lán.

Nā ū lâng kóng “Góa thiàⁿ Siōng-tè”, m̄-kú oàn-hūn hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē, i sī pe̍h-chha̍t. In-ūi, bô thiàⁿ ū khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē, ná ōe thiàⁿ bô khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê Siōng-tè.
Thiàⁿ Siōng-tè mā tio̍h thiàⁿ ka-kī ê hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē, che sī lán tùi Ki-tok niá-siū ê kài-bēng.
Sìn Iâ-so͘ sī Ki-tok ê lâng lóng sī Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî. Thiàⁿ pē-bú, mā ōe thiàⁿ in só͘ siⁿ ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Lán nā thiàⁿ Siōng-tè koh chun-siú I ê kài-bēng, án-ni chiū chai lán ū teh thiàⁿ Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî.
Chun-siú Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng chiū-sī thiàⁿ Siōng-tè. I ê kài-bēng m̄-sī oh chun-siú.
In-ūi Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî lóng ōe-tàng khah iâⁿ sè-kan; hō͘ lán khah iâⁿ sè-kan--ê chiū-sī lán ê sìn.
Khah iâⁿ sè-kan--ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng? Kiám m̄-sī sìn Iâ-so͘ sī Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ ê lâng?
Chit-ūi Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok chiū-sī thong-kè chúi kap huih lâi--ê; m̄-sī chí-ū thong-kè chúi, sī thong-kè chúi kap huih. Sèng Sîn chòe kiàn-chèng, in-ūi Sèng Sîn sī chin-lí.
Ū saⁿ ê chòe kiàn-chèng,
chiū-sī Sèng Sîn, chúi, kap huih; chit saⁿ ê kiàn-chèng lóng it-tì.
Lâng ê kiàn-chèng lán to chiap-siū, Siōng-tè ê kiàn-chèng koh-khah ū-hāu. Chit-ê sī Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h I ê Kiáⁿ só͘ chòe ê kiàn-chèng.

Sìn Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ ê lâng, tī i sim-lāi ū chit-ê kiàn-chèng; m̄ sìn Siōng-tè ê lâng chiū-sī khòaⁿ Siōng-tè chòe pe̍h-chha̍t, in-ūi i m̄ sìn Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h I ê Kiáⁿ só͘ chòe ê kiàn-chèng.
Chit-ê kiàn-chèng chiū-sī: Siōng-tè í-keng ū sù lán éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā, chit-ê oa̍h-miā sī tùi I ê Kiáⁿ lâi--ê.
Lâng ū Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ chiū ū oa̍h-miā; bô Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ chiū bô oa̍h-miā.
Góa siá chiah-ê sī beh hō͘ lín sìn Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ ê lâng chai, lín ū éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Lán tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng ióng-kám bô kiaⁿ, in-ūi lán nā chiàu I ê chí-ì kî-kiû, I ōe kā lán thiaⁿ.
Kì-jiân chai I ōe thiaⁿ lán ê kî-kiû, chiū chai lán tùi I só͘ kiû--ê í-keng ū tit--tio̍h.

Nā ū lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h hiaⁿ-tī á-sī chí-bē hoān-tio̍h bōe tì-kàu sí ê chōe, tio̍h kî-kiû Siōng-tè, Siōng-tè ōe sù i oa̍h-miā; góa sī chí hiah-ê hoān-tio̍h bōe tì-kàu sí ê chōe ê lâng teh kóng. Mā ū ōe tì-kàu sí ê chōe, góa kóng “Tio̍h kî-kiû”, pèng m̄-sī chí chit-ê.
It-chhè put-gī ê hêng-ûi lóng sī chōe, m̄-kú mā ū bōe tì-kàu sí ê chōe.
Lán chai, Siōng-tè ê kiáⁿ-jî bōe kè-sio̍k hoān-chōe, in-ūi Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ teh kā in pó-siú, Siâ-ok-chiá kha̍p in bōe tio̍h.
Lán chai, lán sī sio̍k Siōng-tè, m̄-kú choân sè-kài siū Siâ-ok-chiá koán-hat.

Lán mā chai Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ í-keng lâi-lîm, koh hō͘ lán ū hiáu-ngō͘ ê sim thang jīn-bat hit-ūi chin Sîn Siōng-tè. Lán kap chin Sîn Siōng-tè kiat-liân, in-ūi lán kap I ê Kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok kiat-liân. Chit-ūi chiū-sī chin Sîn Siōng-tè, sī éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Sòe-kiáⁿ, lín tio̍h siám-khui ngó͘-siōng.
Góa tiúⁿ-ló siá-phoe hō͘ siū kéng-soán ê hu-jîn kap lí ê kiáⁿ-jî: Góa chin-sim thiàⁿ lín, m̄-nā góa, liân só͘-ū jīn-bat chin-lí ê lâng mā thiàⁿ lín;
in-ūi chin-lí tiàm tī lán lāi-bīn, ōe éng-oán kap lán tông-chāi.
Goān Pē Siōng-tè kap Pē ê Kiáⁿ Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok sù lán un-tián, lîn-bín, kap pêng-an, hō͘ lán ê seng-oa̍h chhiong-móa chin-lí kap jîn-ài!
Góa hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí, in-ūi góa hoat-kiàn lí ê kiáⁿ-jî tiong-kan ū lâng chun-thàn Pē ê kài-bēng, si̍t-hêng chin-lí.
Hu-jîn ah, góa iau-kiû lí, lán tio̍h saⁿ-thiàⁿ. Góa teh siá hō͘ lí--ê m̄-sī sin ê kài-bēng, sī lán tùi khí-thâu chiū niá-siū--ê.
Lán chiàu Siōng-tè ê kài-bēng seng-oa̍h, chiū-sī thiàⁿ. Chit-ê kài-bēng sī lín tùi khí-thâu só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê, tio̍h chiàu chit-ê kài-bēng seng-oa̍h.
Ū chin chōe bê-he̍k-chiá í-keng lâi kàu chit sè-kan; in m̄ kong-khai sêng-jīn Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok chòe lâng lâi sè-kan. Chit-khoán lâng sī bê-he̍k-chiá, sī Ki-tok ê Te̍k-tùi-chiá.
Tio̍h sió-sim, lín só͘ chòe ê kang chiah bōe lo̍k-khong, hoán-tńg ōe tit-tio̍h chhiong-chiok ê pò-siúⁿ.
Phian-lī bô kian-siú Ki-tok kà-sī ê lâng bô kap Siōng-tè kiat-liân. Kian-siú kà-sī ê lâng chiah ū kap Pē í-ki̍p Kiáⁿ kiat-liân.
Nā ū lâng khì lín hia, só͘ thoân ûi-pōe chit-khoán ê kà-sī, m̄-thang chiap-la̍p i ji̍p lín ê chhù, mā m̄-thang kā i chhéng-an,
in-ūi kā i chhéng-an chiū-sī chham-ú i ê pháiⁿ hêng-ûi.
Góa iáu ū chin chōe ōe ài siá, m̄-kú bô ài ēng chóa-pit; góa khah ǹg-bāng khì lín hia, tng-bīn kap lín kóng, thang hō͘ lán ê hoaⁿ-hí chhiong-móa.
Kap lí pîⁿ-pîⁿ siū kéng-soán hit-ê chí-bē ê kiáⁿ-jî beh kā lí chhéng-an.
Góa tiúⁿ-ló siá-phoe hō͘ chhin-ài ê Kai-iû; lí sī góa chin-sim só͘ thiàⁿ--ê.
Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, góa chiok lí bān-sū heng-thong, mā chiok lí sin-thé kiān-khong, chhin-chhiūⁿ lí ê sim-sîn hiah-ni̍h ióng-chòng.
Ū kúi ê sìn-tô͘ lâi, kā góa chèng-si̍t lí tùi chin-lí tiong-sêng, sū-si̍t lí it-ti̍t ū teh si̍t-hêng chin-lí, góa hui-siông hoaⁿ-hí.
Thiaⁿ-tio̍h kóng góa ê kiáⁿ-jî ū teh si̍t-hêng chin-lí, bô chi̍t hāng pí che koh-khah hō͘ góa hoaⁿ-hí.
Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, lí ū tiong-si̍t chiap-thāi sìn-tô͘, te̍k-pia̍t sī chhut-gōa-lâng.
In bat tī hōe-chiòng bīn-chêng chèng-si̍t lí ê thiàⁿ-sim. Chhiáⁿ lí chiàu Siōng-tè só͘ hoaⁿ-hí--ê, pang-chān in kè-sio̍k in ê lú-thêng.
In-ūi in ūi-tio̍h Ki-tok ê iân-kò͘ chhut-gōa thoân-tō, lóng bô tùi bī-sìn-chiá chiap-siū sím-mi̍h.
Só͘-í lán ū gī-bū chiap-thāi chit-khoán ê lâng, hō͘ lán thang ūi-tio̍h chin-lí chiâⁿ-chòe tâng-kang.
Góa bat siá-phoe hō͘ kàu-hōe. Khó-sioh, ài-beh chòe kàu-hōe léng-siù ê Te̍k-te̍k-hui m̄ chiap-la̍p góa.

Só͘-í, góa nā khì, beh kóng-khí i só͘ chòe ēng pháiⁿ-ōe húi-pòng kong-kek goán ê tāi-chì. M̄-nā án-ni, i pún-sin m̄ chiap-thāi sìn-tô͘, sīm-chì chó͘-tòng goān-ì chiap-thāi ê lâng, koh kā in kek-chhut kàu-hōe.
Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, m̄-thang o̍h pháiⁿ, tio̍h o̍h hó. Choh-hó--ê sio̍k Siōng-tè; choh-pháiⁿ--ê m̄-bat khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Siōng-tè.
Chèng-lâng lóng chheng-chàn Tí-bí-te̍k; chin-lí pún-sin mā ūi-tio̍h i choh-chèng. Goán mā ūi-tio̍h i choh-chèng; lí chai goán ê kiàn-chèng sī chin-si̍t.
Góa iáu ū chin chōe ōe ài siá, m̄-kú bô ài ēng chóa-pit.
Góa ǹg-bāng bô kú ōe kìⁿ-tio̍h lí, lán chiah tng-bīn lâi kóng.
Goān lí pêng-an! Lí ê pêng-iú lóng kā lí chhéng-an. Chhiáⁿ thòe góa kā lán ê pêng-iú chi̍t-ê chi̍t-ê chhéng-an.
Góa sī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê po̍k-jîn, Ngá-kok ê hiaⁿ-tī Iû-tāi, góa siá-phoe hō͘ hiah-ê siū Siōng-tè soán-tiàu, tit-tio̍h Pē Siōng-tè ê thiàⁿ, siū Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok pó-iū ê lâng.
Goān Siōng-tè hong-hong-hù-hù sù lín lîn-bín, pêng-an, kap chû-ài!

Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, góa chá chiū it-ti̍t ài-beh siá-phoe hō͘ lín, kap lín tâm-lūn lán lóng ū-hūn ê chín-kiù. Góa kám-kak chit-chūn su-iàu sûi-sî siá-phoe kā lín kó͘-lē, ài lín ūi-tio̍h góa chòe-āu chi̍t piàn thoân-siū hō͘ sìn-tô͘ chit-ê sìn-gióng kè-sio̍k hùn-tò͘.

In-ūi ū chi̍t-kóa bô kèng-ùi Siōng-tè ê lâng thau-thau-á chǹg ji̍p-lâi lán tiong-kan, lī-iōng lán ê Siōng-tè ê un-tián chòe hòng-chhiòng ê chià-kháu, koh m̄ jīn î-it ê Chú-cháiⁿ lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok. Chin chá í-chêng Sèng-keng chiū ū-giân chiah-ê lâng it-tēng tio̍h siū hêng-hoa̍t.

Sui-jiân lín chai chiah-ê it-chhè ê sū, góa iáu-kú beh kā lín thê-chhíⁿ, Chú chi̍t piàn chiū oân-choân chiong Í-sek-lia̍t jîn-bîn tùi Ai-ki̍p tōe kiù--chhut-lâi, āu-lâi húi-bia̍t hiah-ê m̄-sìn ê lâng.
Koh hiah-ê bô siú pún-hūn, lī-khui pún-ūi ê thiⁿ-sài, in hō͘ só-liān éng-oán liān tī o͘-àm ê chhim-ian; Siōng-tè kā in koaiⁿ tī hia, thèng-hāu sím-phòaⁿ ê tōa Ji̍t-chí.

Tòa tī Só͘-to-má, Gô-mô͘-la, kap hù-kūn siâⁿ-chhī ê lâng, mā kap hiah-ê thiⁿ-sài siâng-khoán îm-loān, hòng-chhiòng hoán chū-jiân ê sèng-io̍k, siū-tio̍h éng-oán bōe hoa ê hé ê hêng-hoa̍t, chòe chèng-lâng ê kéng-kài.
Siâng-khoán, chiah-ê khong-su-bōng-sióng ê lâng mā sún-hāi ka-kī ê seng-khu, biáu-sī Siōng-tè ê koân-ui, bú-jio̍k thiⁿ-téng hiah-ê chun-êng-chiá.
Thiⁿ-sài-tiúⁿ Bí-ka-le̍k ūi-tio̍h Mô͘-se ê ûi-thé kap Mô͘-kúi cheng-lūn ê sî, mā m̄-káⁿ ēng húi-pòng ê ōe chek-pī, chí-ū kóng, “Chú khiàn-chek lí!”
M̄-kú chiah-ê lâng húi-pòng in só͘ bô liáu-kái ê sū; in chhin-chhiūⁿ iá-siù khì chòe chiàu pún-lêng só͘ chai ê tāi-chì, kiat-kó siū húi-bia̍t.
In chhám ah! In-ūi in kiâⁿ Kai-ún ê lō͘, koh ūi-tio̍h chîⁿ-châi hām-lo̍h tī Pa-lân ê chhò-gō͘. In kap Khó-la siâng-khoán, in-ūi pōe-poān lâi bia̍t-bông.

In m̄-chai kiàn-siàu, tōa-chia̍h tōa-lim, ka-kī kò͘ chia̍h, lâi phò-hoāi lín ê ài-chhan. In chhin-chhiūⁿ hûn hō͘ hong chhe-lâi chhe-khì, lóng bô lo̍h-hō͘; chhin-chhiūⁿ chhiū kàu chhiu-thiⁿ ia̍h bô kiat ké-chí, hō͘ lâng liân kun khau--khí-lâi, sí kah ta-khok-khok.

In mā chhin-chhiūⁿ pho-lōng phùn-chhut chúi-phe̍h, lō͘-chhut ka-kī ê kiàn-siàu; chhin-chhiūⁿ lī-khui khúi-tō ê chhiⁿ lak ji̍p-khì Siōng-tè ūi-tio̍h in éng-oán pó-liû hit-ê o͘-àm ê chhim-ian.
A-tong ê tē-chhit tāi sun Í-lo̍k ū-giân chiah-ê lâng kóng, “Lín khòaⁿ! Chú ū chhōa chheng-chheng-bān-bān ê sèng thiⁿ-sài lâi,

beh sím-phòaⁿ só͘-ū ê lâng, hêng-hoa̍t it-chhè bô kèng-khiân ê chōe-jîn, in-ūi in ēng bô kèng-khiân ê hong-hoat chòe it-chhè bô kèng-khiân ê sū, koh kóng siat-to̍k Siōng-tè ê ōe.”
Chiah-ê lâng put-sî nga̍uh-nga̍uh-liām, bâi-oàn, thàn su-io̍k chòe tāi-chì, kóng tōa-ōe, ūi-tio̍h lī-ek phô͘-tháⁿ pa̍t-lâng.
Chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê sù-tô͘ ū-giân ê ōe.
In ū kā lín kóng, “Tī boa̍t-kî, ū chi̍t-kóa thàn ka-kī bô kèng-khiân ê io̍k-liām chòe tāi-chì ê lâng ōe chhut-hiān, in ài thí-chhiò pa̍t-lâng ê sìn-gióng.”
Chiah-ê sī chè-chō hun-cheng, siū pún-sèng chi-phòe, bô kap Sèng Sîn kiat-liân ê lâng.
Lín leh, chhin-ài ê pêng-iú, tio̍h chiong ka-kī kiàn-li̍p tī lín chì-sèng ê sìn-gióng téng-bīn; tio̍h khò Sèng Sîn kî-tó.
Tio̍h tiàm tī Siōng-tè ê thiàⁿ pó-siú ka-kī, gióng-bōng lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê lîn-bín, ti̍t-kàu tit-tio̍h éng-oán ê oa̍h-miā.
Tùi chi̍t-kóa sim chûn giâu-gî ê lâng, tio̍h lîn-bín in;

ū chi̍t-kóa lâng, tio̍h tùi hé-tiong kā in kiù--chhut-lâi; koh ū chi̍t-kóa lâng, tio̍h lîn-bín in, m̄-kú tio̍h ka-kī kéng-kài, liân in hō͘ chêng-io̍k bak--tio̍h ê saⁿ to tio̍h iàm-ò͘ⁿ.
Siōng-tè ōe pó-hō͘ lín bōe tūi-lo̍h, hō͘ lín bô khoat-tiám, hoaⁿ-hoaⁿ-hí-hí khiā tī I êng-iāu ê bīn-chêng.

Goān to̍k-it ê Siōng-tè — lán ê Kiù-chú, thong-kè lán ê Chú Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok tit-tio̍h êng-kng, chun-giâm, lêng-le̍k, kap koân-pèng, tùi bān-kó͘ kàu hiān-chāi, ti̍t-kàu éng-oán. Amen!

Che sī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê khé-sī. Siōng-tè hō͘ I chit-ê khé-sī, ài I chiong it-tēng sûi-sî ōe hoat-seng ê tāi-chì chí-sī Siōng-tè ê chèng po̍k-jîn. Ki-tok ū chhe-khián I ê thiⁿ-sài khì chí-sī I ê po̍k-jîn Iok-hān.
Iok-hān ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit kap Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok ê kiàn-chèng, chiū-sī i só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê it-chhè lâi choh-chèng.
Tha̍k chit-pún chheh ê lâng chin ū hok-khì; thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chit-ê ū-giân koh chun-siú chheh--ni̍h só͘ kì-chài ê lâng chin ū hok-khì; in-ūi sî-ki kūn lah.

Góa Iok-hān siá-phoe hō͘ A-sè-a ê chhit ê kàu-hōe, kóng: Goān hiān-chāi chûn-chāi, kè-khì chûn-chāi, chiong-lâi mā chûn-chāi ê Siōng-tè, kap I chō-ūi chêng ê chhit ê sîn, í-ki̍p Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok, sù lín un-tián kap pêng-an! Ki-tok sī tiong-sìn ê kiàn-chèng-jîn, thâu chi̍t ê tùi sí-lâng tiong koh-oa̍h, sī tōe-chiūⁿ bān-ông ê Chú-cháiⁿ. I thiàⁿ lán, ūi-tio̍h lán lâu-huih hi-seng lâi tháu-pàng lán thoat-lī chōe,
hō͘ lán chiâⁿ-chòe chi̍t ê kok-tō͘, choh chè-si lâi ho̍k-sāi I ê Pē Siōng-tè. Goān êng-kng kap koân-lêng kui tī Iâ-so͘ Ki-tok, ti̍t-kàu éng-éng-oán-oán. Amen!

Lí khòaⁿ, I chē-hûn teh lâi, chèng-lâng ōe khòaⁿ-kìⁿ I, liân ēng chhiuⁿ chha̍k I ê lâng mā ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ. Tōe-chiūⁿ bān-cho̍k lóng ōe in-ūi I thî-khàu. Chit-ê sū it-tēng ōe hoat-seng. Amen!
Hiān-chāi chûn-chāi, kè-khì chûn-chāi, chiong-lâi mā chûn-chāi ê Choân-lêng ê Chú Siōng-tè kóng, “Góa sī A-ní-hoat, sī A-bí-ka.”

Góa sī Iok-hān, sī lín ê hiaⁿ-tī, kap lín chòe-hé hun-tam Iâ-so͘ ê hoān-lān kap thun-lún, koh ū-hūn tī I ê thóng-tī. Ūi-tio̍h thoân Siōng-tè ê sìn-sit kap Iâ-so͘ ê kiàn-chèng, góa bat tòa tī chi̍t ê miâ kiò-chòe Poa̍t-mô͘ ê hái-tó.
Ū chi̍t ê Chú-ji̍t, góa siū Sèng Sîn kám-tōng, thiaⁿ-kìⁿ tī góa ê āu-bīn ū tōa ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ lat-pah teh hiáng,

kóng, “Lí tio̍h chiong só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê siá chòe chheh, kià hō͘ Í-hut-só͘, Sū-múi-ná, Pia̍t-ka-mô͘, Chhui-ngá-chhui-lat, Sat-te̍k, Hui-la-thiat-hui, kap Ló-tí-ka chit chhit ê kàu-hōe.”
Góa oa̍t-tńg-sin beh khòaⁿ tùi góa kóng-ōe--ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng, chi̍t-ē oa̍t-tńg-sin, ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chhit ki kim teng-tâi.
Teng-tâi ê tiong-ng ū chi̍t ūi chhin-chhiūⁿ Jîn-chú, chhēng chi̍t niá sûi-lo̍h kàu kha ê tn̂g-phàu, heng-khám hâ kim-tòa.
I ê thâu kap thâu-mn̂g chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ-mn̂g hiah-ni̍h pe̍h, chhin-chhiūⁿ seh hiah-ni̍h pe̍h; I ê ba̍k-chiu chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-iām.
I ê kha chhin-chhiūⁿ kè hé-lô͘ thoàn-liān kng-liāng ê tâng; I ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi teh chhiâng ê siaⁿ.
I ê chiàⁿ-chhiú the̍h chhit lia̍p chhiⁿ; I ê chhùi thò͘-chhut siang-bīn-lāi ê kiàm; I ê bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ iām-jia̍t ê ji̍t-thâu hoat-kng.
Góa chi̍t-ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h I, chiū phak tī I kha-chêng chhin-chhiūⁿ sí--khì ê lâng. I ēng chiàⁿ-chhiú hōaⁿ góa, kóng, “M̄-bián kiaⁿ! Góa sī khí-thâu--ê, mā-sī soah-bé--ê.
Góa sī oa̍h--ê. Góa ū sí, hiān-chāi teh oa̍h, ōe éng-éng-oán-oán oa̍h--teh. Góa ū sí-bông kap Im-hú ê só-sî.
Só͘-í, lí tio̍h chiong só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ-ê, í-ki̍p hiān-chāi só͘ teh hoat-seng, kap í-āu ōe hoat-seng ê tāi-chì lóng siá--khí-lâi.

Lí só͘ khòaⁿ--tio̍h góa chiàⁿ-chhiú the̍h hit chhit lia̍p chhiⁿ kap chhit ki kim teng-tâi ê ò-biāu sī án-ni: Chhit lia̍p chhiⁿ sī chhit ê kàu-hōe ê thiⁿ-sài; chhit ki teng-tâi sī chhit ê kàu-hōe.”
“Lí tio̍h siá-phoe hō͘ Í-hut-só͘ ê kàu-hōe ê thiⁿ-sài, kóng, “‘Chiàⁿ-chhiú tháⁿ chhit lia̍p chhiⁿ, tī chhit ki kim teng-tâi ê tiong-kan teh kiâⁿ Hit-ūi án-ni kóng:

Góa chai lí ê só͘-chòe; lí án-chóaⁿ teh lô-khó͘ kap thun-lún. Góa chai lí bōe iông-jím pháiⁿ-lâng; lí mā bat khó-giām hiah-ê chū-chheng sī sù-tô͘ kî-si̍t m̄-sī ê lâng, khòaⁿ-chhut in sī pe̍h-chha̍t--ê.
Lí ū thun-lún, bat ūi-tio̍h góa ê miâ jím-siū kan-khó͘, lóng bô ià-siān.
M̄-kú, ū chi̍t hāng tāi-chì góa beh kā lí chek-pī, chiū-sī lí í-keng pàng-sak lí tong-chho͘ ê thiàⁿ-sim.
Só͘-í, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit lí tùi tó-ūi tūi-lo̍h; tio̍h hóe-kái, chòe lí tong-chho͘ só͘ chòe ê kang-chok. Nā bô, góa ōe khì lí hia, chiong lí ê teng-tâi tùi goân-ūi sóa-khui.
Put-kò, lí iáu ū chi̍t hāng khó-chhú ê sū, chiū-sī lí mā kap góa kâng-khoán oàn-hūn Nî-ko-la-tóng ê hêng-ûi.

“‘Ū hī-khang ê lâng lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ Sèng Sîn kā chiah-ê kàu-hōe kóng ê ōe. “‘Tek-sèng ê lâng, góa beh hō͘ i chia̍h Siōng-tè ê Lo̍k-hn̂g tiong hit-châng oa̍h-miā-chhiū ê ké-chí.’”
“Lí tio̍h siá-phoe hō͘ Sū-múi-ná ê kàu-hōe ê thiⁿ-sài, kóng, “‘Khí-thâu--ê kap soah-bé--ê, sí ū koh-oa̍h Hit-ūi án-ni kóng:

Góa chai lí ê hoān-lān kap sàn-chhiah; kî-si̍t lí sī hó-gia̍h. Góa chai lí ū siū-tio̍h chū-chheng Iû-thài -lâng ê lâng ê húi-pòng; kî-si̍t in m̄-sī Iû-thài -lâng, sī Sat-tàn ê chi̍p-thoân.

M̄-bián kiaⁿ lí teh-beh siū ê khó͘-lān. Lí khòaⁿ, Mô͘-kúi teh-beh chiong lín tiong-kan kúi-nā lâng koaiⁿ-lo̍h kaⁿ, beh kā lín khó-giām, lín ōe siū khó͘-lān cha̍p ji̍t. Lí tio̍h chīn-tiong kàu sí, góa ōe sù lí oa̍h-miā ê hoa-koan.
“‘Ū hī-khang ê lâng lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ Sèng Sîn kā chiah-ê kàu-hōe kóng ê ōe. “‘Tek-sèng ê lâng choa̍t-tùi bōe siū-tio̍h tē-jī piàn sí ê chai-hāi.’”
“Lí tio̍h siá-phoe hō͘ Pia̍t-ka-mô͘ ê kàu-hōe ê thiⁿ-sài, kóng, “‘Ū siang-bīn-lāi ê kiàm Hit-ūi án-ni kóng:

Góa chai lí tòa tó-ūi, chiū-sī ū Sat-tàn ê chō-ūi hia. Lí ū kian-siú góa ê miâ, sīm-chì góa tiong-si̍t ê kiàn-chèng-jîn An-thê-phà tī lín tiong-kan, chiū-sī Sat-tàn tòa ê só͘-chāi, siū sat-hāi ê sî, lí mā bô hó͘-jīn tùi góa ê sìn-gióng.

M̄-kú góa ū kúi-nā hāng tāi-chì beh kā lí chek-pī: In-ūi tī lí hia ū lâng chip-siú Pa-lân ê kà-sī, chit-ê Pa-lân ū kà Pa-le̍k khì ín-iú Í-sek-lia̍t ê kiáⁿ-sun, hō͘ in chia̍h chè ngó͘-siōng ê mi̍h, koh kiâⁿ kan-îm.
Chhin-chhiūⁿ án-ni, lí hia mā ū lâng chip-siú Nî-ko-la-tóng ê kà-sī.
Só͘-í, tio̍h hóe-kái. Nā bô, góa liâm-piⁿ ōe khì lí hia, ēng góa chhùi-lāi ê kiàm kap in kau-chiàn.

“‘Ū hī-khang ê lâng lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ Sèng Sîn kā chiah-ê kàu-hōe kóng ê ōe. “‘Tek-sèng ê lâng góa beh chiong pó-chûn--khí-lâi ê má-ná hō͘ i, koh beh hō͘ i chi̍t tè pe̍h-chio̍h, chio̍h ê téng-bīn ū siá sin ê miâ; chit-ê miâ, niá-siū ê lâng í-gōa, bô lâng bat.’”

“Lí tio̍h siá-phoe hō͘ Chhui-ngá-chhui-lat ê kàu-hōe ê thiⁿ-sài, kóng, “‘Siōng-tè ê Kiáⁿ, chiū-sī ba̍k-chiu chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-iām, kha chhin-chhiūⁿ kng-liāng ê tâng Hit-ūi án-ni kóng:
Góa chai lí ê hêng-ûi, lí ê thiàⁿ, sìn-sim, ho̍k-sāi, kap thun-lún; koh chai lí chòe-kūn ê só͘-chòe pí khí-thâu--ê khah hó.

M̄-kú, ū chi̍t hāng tāi-chì góa beh kā lí chek-pī, chiū-sī lí iông-ún chū-chheng choh sian-ti ê hū-jîn-lâng Iâ-sé-phek; i kà-sī koh bê-he̍k góa ê po̍k-jîn khì hoān kan-îm koh chia̍h chè ngó͘-siōng ê mi̍h.
Góa ū hō͘ i sî-kan thang hóe-kái, m̄-kú i m̄-khéng hóe-kái lī-khui îm-hēng.
Khòaⁿ ah, góa beh hō͘ i kan-khó͘ tó-chhn̂g; hiah-ê kap i hoān kan-îm ê lâng nā bô hóe-kái, thêng-chí in kap i ê îm-hēng, góa mā beh hō͘ in siū tōa khó͘-lān.

Góa beh thâi-sí hiah-ê tè i ê lâng. Án-ni lóng-chóng ê kàu-hōe chiū ōe chai góa sī kàm-chhat lâng ê sim-su ì-liām--ê, góa beh chiàu lín ta̍k-ê lâng ê hêng-ûi kā lín pò-èng.

“‘Chóng-sī lín chiah-ê kî-tha ê Chhui-ngá-chhui-lat -lâng, lín bô siū chit-khoán kàu-tō, m̄ bat só͘-ūi Sat-tàn ê ò-pì ê lâng, góa kā lín kóng, góa bōe ke-thiⁿ pa̍t-khoán ê tāng-tàⁿ hō͘ lín.
M̄-kú, lín tio̍h kian-siú lín í-keng ū--ê, ti̍t-kàu góa lâi.
“‘Tek-sèng koh kè-sio̍k ūi-tio̍h góa chòe kang kàu lō͘-bé ê lâng, góa beh hō͘ i koân-pèng thang tī-lí bān-kok;
i beh ēng thih-koáiⁿ tī-lí in, chhin-chhiūⁿ kòng-chhùi hûi-khì;
góa mā ū án-ni tùi góa ê Pē niá-siū koân-pèng. Tek-sèng ê lâng, góa mā beh hō͘ i khé-bêng-chhiⁿ.
“‘Ū hī-khang ê lâng lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ Sèng Sîn kā chiah-ê kàu-hōe kóng ê ōe.’”

“Lí tio̍h siá-phoe hō͘ Sat-te̍k ê kàu-hōe ê thiⁿ-sài, kóng, “‘Ū Siōng-tè ê chhit ê sîn kap chhit lia̍p chhiⁿ Hit-ūi án-ni kóng: Góa chai lí ê hêng-ûi, lâng kóng lí teh oa̍h, kî-si̍t lí sī sí.
Tio̍h chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, ka-kiông teh-beh bô--khì ê khùi-si-á, in-ūi góa khòaⁿ, tī góa ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng, lí ê hêng-ûi iáu bô oân-choân.

Só͘-í, tio̍h ōe-kì-tit lí só͘ niá-siū, só͘ thiaⁿ--tio̍h-ê; tio̍h chun-siú, tio̍h hóe-kái. Lí nā bô chhíⁿ--khí-lâi, góa ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ chha̍t lâi; lí it-tēng m̄ chai góa sím-mi̍h sî ōe lâi kàu lí hia.
M̄-kú, tī Sat-te̍k iáu ū chi̍t-kóa lâng in ê saⁿ bô phah lâ-sâm, in ōe chhēng pe̍h-saⁿ kap góa chòe-hé kiâⁿ, in-ūi in ōe-kham--tit.
“‘Tek-sèng ê lâng siâng-khoán ōe chhēng pe̍h-saⁿ; góa it-tēng bōe tùi oa̍h-miā-chheh kā i tû-miâ. Góa ōe tī góa ê Pē kap hiah-ê thiⁿ-sài bīn-chêng kong-khai jīn i ê miâ.
“‘Ū hī-khang ê lâng lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ Sèng Sîn kā chiah-ê kàu-hōe kóng ê ōe.’”

“Lí tio̍h siá-phoe hō͘ Hui-la-thiat-hui ê kàu-hōe ê thiⁿ-sài, kóng, “‘Sèng-kiat koh chin-si̍t, chiáng-ak Tāi-pi̍t ê só-sî, khui chiū bô lâng ōe-tàng koaiⁿ, koaiⁿ chiū bô lâng ōe-tàng khui Hit-ūi án-ni kóng:

Góa chai lí ê hêng-ûi, lí khòaⁿ, góa í-keng tī lí ê bīn-chêng kā lí khui chi̍t ê mn̂g, sī bô lâng ōe-tàng koaiⁿ--ê; góa chai lí kan-ta ū tām-po̍h khùi-la̍t, khiok ū siú góa ê tō-lí, m̄-bat hó͘-jīn góa ê miâ.

Lí khòaⁿ, Sat-tàn ê chi̍p-thoân, in chū-chheng Iû-thài -lâng, kî-si̍t m̄-sī, sī hiah-ê kóng pe̍h-chha̍t--ê; lí khòaⁿ, góa beh hō͘ in lâi phak tī lí ê kha-chêng, in chiū chai góa ū thiàⁿ lí.

In-ūi lí ū chun-siú góa ê tō-lí thun-lún kàu lō͘-bé, góa mā beh pó-siú lí thoat-lī hit-ê chhì-liān ê sî, chit-ê sî teh-beh lîm-kàu choân sè-kài, lâi khó-giām tòa tī tōe-chiūⁿ ê lâng.
Góa liâm-piⁿ kàu; lí só͘-ū--ê tio̍h kian-siú, chiah bián ū lâng kā lí ê hoa-koan the̍h--khì.

“‘Tek-sèng ê lâng, góa beh hō͘ i chiâⁿ-chòe góa ê Siōng-tè tiān-lāi ê thiāu; i éng-oán bōe koh lī-khui. Góa beh chiong góa ê Siōng-tè ê miâ, í-ki̍p góa ê Siōng-tè ê siâⁿ, chiū-sī tùi thiⁿ-téng góa ê Siōng-tè hia kàng-lo̍h sin ê Iâ-lō͘-sat-léng ê miâ, kap góa sin ê miâ, lóng siá tī i téng-bīn.
“‘Ū hī-khang ê lâng lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ Sèng Sîn kā chiah-ê kàu-hōe kóng ê ōe.’”
“Lí tio̍h siá-phoe hō͘ Ló-tí-ka ê kàu-hōe ê thiⁿ-sài, kóng, “‘Hit-ūi Amen, tiong-sìn koh sìn-si̍t ê kiàn-chèng-jîn, Siōng-tè chhòng-chō ê kun-goân, án-ni kóng:
Góa chai lí ê hêng-ûi, lí bô léng bô sio. Góa khah ài lí khòaⁿ sī sio á-sī léng.
Kì-jiân lí la-lûn-sio, m̄-chiâⁿ sio m̄-chiâⁿ léng, góa teh-beh tùi góa ê chhùi kā lí phùi--chhut-khì.
In-ūi lí kóng: Góa hó-gia̍h, í-keng tōa hoat-châi, lóng bô khiàm-kheh. Lí khiok m̄ chai lí pi-chhám, khó-lîn, sàn-chhiah, sit-bêng, koh chhiah-sin-lō͘-thé.

Góa khǹg lí tùi góa bóe keng-kè hé thoàn-liān ê kim, thang hō͘ lí hó-gia̍h; koh bóe pe̍h ê saⁿ khì chhēng, chiah bián hō͘ lâng khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí thǹg-theh ê kiàn-siàu; mā bóe io̍h-ko boah lí ê ba̍k-chiu, hō͘ lí ōe khòaⁿ--kìⁿ.
Góa só͘ thiàⁿ ê lâng, góa lóng kā in chek-pī kap koán-kàu. Só͘-í, tio̍h jia̍t-sim, tio̍h hoán-hóe.
Lí khòaⁿ, góa í-keng khiā tī mn̂g-gōa teh phah-mn̂g; thiaⁿ-kìⁿ góa ê siaⁿ lâi khui-mn̂g ê lâng, góa beh ji̍p-khì chhē i, kap i chòe-hé chia̍h, i mā kap góa chòe-hé chia̍h.
“‘Tek-sèng ê lâng, góa beh hō͘ i kap góa chòe-hé chē tī góa ê pó-chō, chhin-chhiūⁿ góa í-keng tek-sèng kap góa ê Pē chòe-hé chē tī I ê pó-chō.
“‘Ū hī-khang ê lâng lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ Sèng Sîn kā chiah-ê kàu-hōe kóng ê ōe.’”

Āu-lâi góa koh khòaⁿ, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ thiⁿ-téng ū chi̍t ê khui-khui ê mn̂g. Góa ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ hit-ê thâu chi̍t piàn tùi góa kóng-ōe ê siaⁿ, chhin-chhiūⁿ lat-pah teh hiáng, kóng, “Khí-lâi chia, góa beh chí-sī lí í-āu it-tēng ōe hoat-seng ê tāi-chì.”
Góa chiū sûi-sî siū Sèng Sîn kám-tōng, khòaⁿ-kìⁿ thiⁿ-téng ū chi̍t ê pó-chō, ū chi̍t ūi chē tī pó-chō.
I ê bīn-māu chhin-chhiūⁿ phek-ge̍k kap âng-pó-chio̍h; pó-chō ê chiu-ûi ū khēng, khòaⁿ--khí-lâi chhin-chhiūⁿ le̍k pó-chio̍h.
Pó-chō ê chiu-ûi ū jī-cha̍p-sì ê chō-ūi, ū jī-cha̍p-sì ê tiúⁿ-ló chē tī chō-ūi, in chhēng pe̍h-saⁿ, thâu-khak tì kim ê hoa-koan.
Tùi pó-chō ū hoat-chhut sih-nà, hiáng-siaⁿ, kap lûi; tī pó-chō chêng ū chhit ki tiám-to̍h ê hé-pé, chiū-sī Siōng-tè ê chhit ê sîn.
Pó-chō chêng ū chhin-chhiūⁿ chúi-chiⁿ hiah-ni̍h thàu-bêng ê po-lê-hái. Pó-chō ê chiu-ûi ū sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h, in ê seng-khu chêng-āu lóng ū ba̍k-chiu.

Thâu chi̍t ê oa̍h-mi̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ sai, tē-jī ê oa̍h-mi̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ gû-káng-á, tē-saⁿ ê oa̍h-mi̍h ê bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ê bīn, tē-sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h chhin-chhiūⁿ teh pe ê eng-chiáu.

Chit sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h ta̍k-ê lóng ū la̍k ki si̍t, chiu-ûi kap lāi-bīn kui seng-khu ū chin chōe ba̍k-chiu. In mî-ji̍t bô-thêng teh chhiùⁿ: Sèng--chài! Sèng--chài! Sèng--chài! Choân-lêng ê Chú Siōng-tè; kè-khì chûn-chāi, hiān-chāi chûn-chāi, chiong-lâi mā chûn-chāi.
Ta̍k-piàn oa̍h-mi̍h chiong êng-kng, chun-kùi, kám-siā, kui hō͘ chē tī pó-chō, éng-éng-oán-oán oa̍h--teh Hit-ūi ê sî,
jī-cha̍p-sì ê tiúⁿ-ló chiū phak lo̍h-khì kèng-pài chē tī pó-chō, éng-éng-oán-oán oa̍h--teh Hit-ūi. In chiong hoa-koan hiat tī pó-chō chêng, kóng:
Goán ê Chú, goán ê Siōng-tè! Lí eng-kai tit-tio̍h êng-iāu, chun-kùi, kap koân-lêng, in-ūi lí chhòng-chō bān-iú; tùi lí ê chí-ì, bān-iú siū-chō, seng-chûn.
Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chē tī pó-chō Hit-ūi ê chiàⁿ-chhiú ū chi̍t kńg chheh, lāi-bīn gōa-bīn lóng ū siá-jī, ēng chhit ê ìn hong--teh.
Góa koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t ê ū tōa khùi-la̍t ê thiⁿ-sài, tōa-siaⁿ soan-pò͘ kóng, “Sím-mi̍h-lâng ū chu-keh thang thí-khui hit-kńg chheh, thiah-khui chheh ê hong-ìn?”
Tī thiⁿ-téng, tī tōe-chiūⁿ, tī tōe-ē, lóng bô lâng ōe-tàng thí-khui á-sī tha̍k hit-kńg chheh.
Chhē bô chi̍t ê lâng ū chu-keh thí-khui á-sī tha̍k hit-kńg chheh, góa chiū tōa-siaⁿ khàu.

Tiúⁿ-ló ê tiong-kan ū chi̍t ê tùi góa kóng, “M̄-thang khàu. Lí khòaⁿ, tùi Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k chhut--lâi ê Sai, Tāi-pi̍t ê Kun, í-keng tek-sèng, ōe-tàng khui hit-kńg chheh kap hit chhit ê hong-ìn.”

Āu-lâi góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Iûⁿ-ko khiā tī pó-chō chêng, ū sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h kap hiah-ê tiúⁿ-ló kā I ûi--teh. Iûⁿ-ko ká-ná bat siū sat-hāi, ū chhit ki kak, chhit lúi ba̍k-chiu, chiū-sī siū chhe-khián khì phó͘-thiⁿ-ē Siōng-tè ê chhit ê sîn.
Iûⁿ-ko chiū chìn-chêng, tùi chē tī pó-chō Hit-ūi ê chiàⁿ-chhiú the̍h hit-kńg chheh.

I the̍h--tio̍h ê sî, hit sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h kap jī-cha̍p-sì ê tiúⁿ-ló lóng phak tī Iûⁿ-ko ê bīn-chêng, ta̍k-ê ū the̍h khîm kap tóe-móa hiuⁿ ê kim-lô͘; hiuⁿ chiū-sī sìn-tô͘ ê kî-tó.

In gîm chi̍t siú sin ê si, kóng: Lí ū chu-keh the̍h hit-kńg chheh, thiah-khui i ê hong-ìn; in-ūi lí ū siū sat-hāi, ēng lí ê huih tùi ta̍k-ê cho̍k-kûn, ta̍k-chióng gú-giân, ta̍k-ê bîn-cho̍k, ta̍k-ê pang-kok sio̍k-hôe lâng kui Siōng-tè.
Lí hō͘ in chiâⁿ-chòe kok-tō͘ kap chè-si lâi ho̍k-sāi lán ê Siōng-tè; in ōe tī tōe-chiūⁿ chiáng-koân.
Góa koh khòaⁿ, góa ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chheng-chheng-bān-bān thiⁿ-sài ê siaⁿ-im. In lóng ûi tī pó-chō, oa̍h-mi̍h, í-ki̍p tiúⁿ-ló ê chiu-ûi,
tōa-siaⁿ kóng: Siū sat-hāi ê Iûⁿ-ko eng-kai tit-tio̍h koân-lêng, hù-jū, tì-hūi, khùi-la̍t, chun-kùi, êng-kng, kap chheng-chàn.

Góa koh thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, tī thiⁿ-téng, tī tōe-chiūⁿ kap tōe-ē, hái--ni̍h kap ú-tiū tiong it-chhè ê pī-chō-bu̍t lóng kóng: Goān chheng-chàn, chun-kùi, êng-kng, koân-sè, lóng kui hō͘ chē tī pó-chō Hit-ūi kap Iûⁿ-ko, tāi-tāi-bû-chīn!
Hit sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h ìn kóng, “Amen!” Hiah-ê tiúⁿ-ló chiū phak lo̍h-khì kèng-pài.
Iûⁿ-ko khui chhit ê hong-ìn ê chi̍t ê ê sî, góa koh khòaⁿ, góa ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h ê chi̍t ê, i ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ lûi ê siaⁿ, kóng, “Lâi!”
Góa khòaⁿ ê sî, ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chiah pe̍h-bé, khiâ-bé ê lâng gia̍h keng; i niá-siū hoa-koan chhut-hoat, ūi-tio̍h beh pek-chiàn-pek-sèng.
Iûⁿ-ko khui tē-jī ê hong-ìn ê sî, góa ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ tē-jī ê oa̍h-mi̍h kóng, “Lâi!”

Hit-sî ū pa̍t-chiah bé chhut--lâi, sī chhiah-sek--ê; khiâ-bé ê lâng ū niá-siū koân-pèng thang tùi tōe-chiūⁿ chhiúⁿ-toa̍t hô-pêng, hō͘ lâng hō͘-siōng chân-sat; i ū koh niá-siū chi̍t ki tōa-ki kiàm.
Iûⁿ-ko khui tē-saⁿ ê hong-ìn ê sî, góa ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ tē-saⁿ ê oa̍h-mi̍h kóng, “Lâi!” Góa khòaⁿ ê sî, ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chiah o͘-bé, khiâ-bé ê lâng chhiú the̍h chhìn-á.

Góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ ká-ná ū siaⁿ tùi sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h tiong-kan hoat-chhut kóng, “Chi̍t ji̍t ê kang-chîⁿ chí-ū thang bóe chi̍t kong-seng sió-be̍h; chi̍t ji̍t ê kang-chîⁿ chí-ū thang bóe saⁿ kong-seng tōa-be̍h; kaⁿ-ná-iû kap chiú m̄-thang phah-sńg.”
Iûⁿ-ko khui tē-sì ê hong-ìn ê sî, góa ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ tē-sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h kóng, “Lâi!”

Góa khòaⁿ ê sî, ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h chi̍t chiah hé-hu-sek ê bé, khiâ-bé ê lâng miâ kiò-chòe Sí-bông, Im-hú tè tī āu-bīn; in ū niá-siū koân-pèng thang koán-hat tōe-chiūⁿ sì-hūn-chi̍t ê thó͘-tōe, ēng to-kiàm, ki-hng, un-e̍k, kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê iá-siù khì sat-hāi lâng.
Iûⁿ-ko khui tē-gō͘ ê hong-ìn ê sî, góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chè-tôaⁿ ē ū ūi-tio̍h Siōng-tè ê ōe kap ūi-tio̍h chòe kiàn-chèng siū sat-hāi ê lâng ê lêng-hûn.
In tōa-siaⁿ âu-kiò kóng, “Sèng koh chin ê Chú-cháiⁿ ah, tio̍h koh jōa kú lí chiah beh sím-phòaⁿ tōe-chiūⁿ ê lâng, thang ūi-tio̍h goán só͘ lâu ê huih sin-oan?”

Ta̍k-ê lâng chiū niá-siū chi̍t niá pe̍h-saⁿ, koh ū siaⁿ kā in kóng, tio̍h koh thèng-hāu chi̍t-sî-á kú, kàu pîⁿ-pîⁿ chòe po̍k-jîn ê lâng í-ki̍p in ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē, chiū-sī teh-beh kap in siâng-khoán siū sat-hāi ê lâng ê sò͘-bo̍k móa ê sî.

Āu-lâi góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Iûⁿ-ko khui tē-la̍k ê hong-ìn ê sî, hut-jiân tōe tōa tín-tāng, ji̍t-thâu pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ o͘ môa-pò͘ hiah-ni̍h o͘, ge̍h kui-ê pìⁿ-chòe chhin-chhiūⁿ huih hiah-ni̍h âng;
thiⁿ-téng ê chhiⁿ tūi-lo̍h tōe, chhin-chhiūⁿ bû-hoa-kó-chhiū hō͘ tōa-hong sàu tín-tāng, iáu-bē sek ê ké-chí lóng lak-liáu-liáu.
Thiⁿ siau-sit, chhin-chhiūⁿ chi̍t kńg chheh kńg--khí-lâi; soaⁿ kap hái-tó lóng sóa lī-khui goân-ūi.
Tōe-chiūⁿ ê kun-ông, thóng-tī-chiá, chiòng-léng, ū-chîⁿ--ê, ū-sè--ê, it-chhè chòe lô͘-lē--ê, kap chū-iû--ê lóng khì bih tī tōng-lāi kap soaⁿ-giâm tiong-kan ê phāng.
In ǹg soaⁿ-niá kap soaⁿ-giâm hoah kóng, “Tó lo̍h-lâi kā goán khàm--teh, hō͘ goán thang siám-pī chē tī pó-chō Hit-ūi ê bīn kap Iûⁿ-ko ê siū-khì.
In-ūi in siū hêng-hoa̍t ê tōa Ji̍t-chí kàu lah, sím-mi̍h-lâng khiā ōe tiâu?”
Āu-lâi, góa ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ sì ê thiⁿ-sài khiā tī tōe ê sì kak-thâu, chiong tōe sì-bīn ê hong cha̍h--khí-lâi, hō͘ hong bōe chhe-tio̍h tōe, hái, kap it-chhè ê chhiū-ba̍k.

Góa koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lēng-gōa chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài the̍h éng-oa̍h Siōng-tè ê ìn, tùi ji̍t chhut ê só͘-chāi chiūⁿ--lâi; i tùi ū niá-siū koân-pèng thang siong-hāi tōe kap hái hit sì ê thiⁿ-sài tōa-siaⁿ hoah,
kóng, “Goán iáu-bē tī Siōng-tè po̍k-jîn ê thâu-hia̍h khàm-ìn í-chêng, m̄-thang siong-hāi tōe, hái, kap chhiū-ba̍k.”
Góa thiaⁿ--kìⁿ, tī Í-sek-lia̍t ta̍k-ê chi-cho̍k tiong siū khàm-ìn ê lâng lóng-chóng ū cha̍p-sì-bān sì-chheng.
Sio̍k Iû-tāi chi-cho̍k siū khàm-ìn ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng; sio̍k Lū-piān chi-cho̍k ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng; sio̍k Ka-tek chi-cho̍k ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng;
sio̍k A-siat chi-cho̍k ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng; sio̍k Ná-hut-tha-lī chi-cho̍k ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng; sio̍k Má-ná-se chi-cho̍k ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng;
sio̍k Se-biān chi-cho̍k ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng; sio̍k Lī-bī chi-cho̍k ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng; sio̍k Í-sat-ka chi-cho̍k ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng;

sio̍k Se-pò͘-lûn chi-cho̍k ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng; sio̍k Iok-sek chi-cho̍k ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng; sio̍k Piān-ngá-bín chi-cho̍k siū khàm-ìn ê lâng ū chi̍t-bān nn̄g-chheng.

Āu-lâi, góa koh khòaⁿ, ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t tōa-kûn lâng, bô lâng ōe-tàng kè-sǹg in ê sò͘-bo̍k, sī tùi ta̍k-kok, ta̍k cho̍k-kûn, ta̍k bîn-cho̍k, kóng ta̍k-khoán gú-giân ê lâng lâi--ê, lóng khiā tī pó-chō kap Iûⁿ-ko ê bīn-chêng, chhēng pe̍h-saⁿ, chhiú gia̍h chang-chhiū-ki.
In tōa-siaⁿ hoah: Goān chín-kiù kui tī chē tī pó-chō ê lán ê Siōng-tè, mā kui tī Iûⁿ-ko!
Só͘-ū ê thiⁿ-sài lóng khiā tī pó-chō, tiúⁿ-ló, kap sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h ê chiu-ûi, in tī pó-chō chêng, bīn phak lo̍h-khì kèng-pài Siōng-tè,
kóng: Amen! Goān siōng-chàn, êng-kng, tì-hūi, kám-siā, chun-kùi, koân-lêng, khùi-la̍t, kui tī lán ê Siōng-tè, kàu éng-éng-oán-oán. Amen!
Tiúⁿ-ló tiong ū chi̍t ê mn̄g góa kóng, “Chiah-ê chhēng pe̍h-saⁿ--ê sī sím-mi̍h-lâng? In tùi tó-ūi lâi?”
Góa ìn kóng, “Sian-siⁿ, lí chai.” Āu-lâi i kā góa kóng, “Chiah-ê lâng sī keng-kè tōa chai-lān chhut--lâi-ê, in ū sóe in ê saⁿ, ēng Iûⁿ-ko ê huih sóe kàu pe̍h.
Só͘-í, in tī Siōng-tè ê pó-chō chêng, mî-ji̍t tī I ê sèng-tiān ho̍k-sāi I; chē tī pó-chō Hit-ūi beh pó-hō͘ in.
In bōe koh iau, bōe koh chhùi-ta; ji̍t-thâu kap iām-jia̍t lóng bōe siong-hāi in.
Tī pó-chō tiong ê Iûⁿ-ko beh chòe in ê bo̍k-chiá; I beh chhōa in kàu oa̍h-miā-chúi ê chôaⁿ-goân; Siōng-tè beh tùi in ê ba̍k-chiu chhit-khì lóng-chóng ê ba̍k-sái.”
Iûⁿ-ko khui tē-chhit ê hong-ìn ê sî, thiⁿ chēng-chēng iok pòaⁿ tiám-cheng kú.
Āu-lâi góa ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chhit ê thiⁿ-sài khiā tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng, in ū niá-siū chhit ki lat-pah.

Koh ū chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài lâi, chhiú the̍h kim hiuⁿ-lô͘ khiā tī chè-tôaⁿ chêng, niá-siū chin chōe hiuⁿ, thang kap chèng sìn-tô͘ ê kî-tó chòe-hé hiàn tī pó-chō chêng ê kim chè-tôaⁿ téng.
Hiuⁿ ê ian kap sìn-tô͘ ê kî-tó tùi thiⁿ-sài ê chhiú chhèng kàu Siōng-tè bīn-chêng.
Jiân-āu, thiⁿ-sài the̍h hiuⁿ-lô͘, tóe-móa chè-tôaⁿ téng ê hé, kā i hiat-lo̍h tōe, sûi-sî ū tân-lûi, hiáng-siaⁿ, sih-nà, kap tōe-tāng.
Gia̍h chhit ki lat-pah ê chhit ê thiⁿ-sài chún-pī hó-sè beh pûn.

Thâu chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài pûn i ê lat-pah, sûi-sî ū pha̍uh kap hé, chham huih hiat-lo̍h tōe; tōe ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t sio--khì, chhiū-ba̍k ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t sio--khì, só͘-ū chhiⁿ-chhùi ê chháu lóng sio--khì.
Tē-jī ê thiⁿ-sài pûn i ê lat-pah, sûi-sî ū chhin-chhiūⁿ hé teh sio ê tōa-soaⁿ hiat-lo̍h hái; hái ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t pìⁿ-chòe huih;
hái--ni̍h ê oa̍h-mi̍h saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t sí--khì; chûn-chiah ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t sún-hoāi.

Tē-saⁿ ê thiⁿ-sài pûn i ê lat-pah, sûi-sî ū chi̍t lia̍p tōa lia̍p chhiⁿ tùi thiⁿ-téng lak--lo̍h-lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ teh to̍h ê hé-pé lak tī saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t ê kang-hô kap só͘-ū ê chúi-chôaⁿ.
Chit-lia̍p chhiⁿ ê miâ kiò-chòe Khó͘-hiāⁿ. Saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t ê chúi pìⁿ khó͘, chin chōe lâng in-ūi chit-ê chúi sí--khì, in-ūi chúi pìⁿ khó͘.

Tē-sì ê thiⁿ-sài pûn i ê lat-pah, ji̍t ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t, ge̍h ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t, chhiⁿ ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t lóng siū kong-kek, tì-kàu ji̍t, ge̍h, chhiⁿ ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t pìⁿ àm, ji̍t--sî saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t bô kng, mî--sî mā saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t bô kng.

Āu-lâi góa khòaⁿ, ū thiaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t chiah tī khong-tiong teh pe ê eng-chiáu tōa-siaⁿ kiò kóng, “Chhám ah! Chhám ah! Tòa tī tōe-chiūⁿ ê lâng chhám ah! In-ūi kî-tha ê saⁿ ê thiⁿ-sài teh-beh pûn lat-pah lah.”
Tē-gō͘ ê thiⁿ-sài pûn i ê lat-pah, góa ū khòaⁿ-tio̍h tùi thiⁿ-téng lak lo̍h-lâi tōe-bīn hit-lia̍p chhiⁿ; chit-lia̍p chhiⁿ ū niá-siū bô-tóe-chhim-khiⁿ ê só-sî.
I khui bô-tóe-chhim-khiⁿ, chiū ū tōa hé-lô͘ ê ian chhèng--khí-lâi. Ji̍t-thâu kap thài-khong in-ūi Chhim-khiⁿ ê ian chiū pìⁿ o͘-àm.
Chháu-meh tùi ian ê lāi-bīn chhut-lâi hioh tī tōe-bīn; in niá-siū koân-pèng chhin-chhiūⁿ tōe-chiūⁿ ê giat-á-thâng ū ê koân-pèng.
In siū kau-tài m̄-thang siong-hāi tōe-chiūⁿ ê chháu, ta̍k-chióng ê chhiū-ba̍k, kap it-chhè chhiⁿ-chhùi ê mi̍h, chí-ū thang siong-hāi thâu-hia̍h bô khàm Siōng-tè ê ìn ê lâng.

Chháu-meh bô tit-tio̍h koân thang thâi-sí chiah-ê lâng, chí-ū thang hō͘ in siū thòng-khó͘ gō͘ ge̍h-ji̍t kú; in ê thòng-khó͘ chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng hō͘ giat-á-thâng kā--tio̍h ê thòng-khó͘.
Chiah-ê ji̍t ê tiong-kan, lâng ōe kiû sí mā bōe tit sí, ài sí mā sí bōe khì.
Chháu-meh ê hêng-chōng chhin-chhiūⁿ chún-pī beh chhut-chiàn ê bé; in ê thâu-khak téng tì chhin-chhiūⁿ kim ê hoa-koan; in ê bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ lâng ê bīn;
in ê thâu-mn̂g chhin-chhiūⁿ hū-jîn-lâng ê thâu-mn̂g; in ê gê chhin-chhiūⁿ sai ê gê;
in ê heng-khám chhēng chhin-chhiūⁿ thih ê hō͘-heng-kah; in ê si̍t hoat-chhut ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ chin chōe chiàn-bé thoa-chhia phun-pháu beh khì kau-chiàn ê siaⁿ.
In ū bé-liu chhin-chhiūⁿ giat-á-thâng ê bé-liu ū chhì; in ê bé-liu ū lêng-le̍k thang siong-hāi lâng gō͘ ge̍h-ji̍t kú.
In ê ông sī koán-hat bô-tóe-chhim-khiⁿ ê thiⁿ-sài; i ê miâ Hi-pek-lâi-gú kiò-chòe A-pa-tùn, Hi-la̍h-gú kiò-chòe A-po-lûn, ì-sù sī Húi-bia̍t-chiá.
Thâu chi̍t ê chai-hō í-keng kè--khì; iáu ū nn̄g ê chai-hō teh-beh lâi.
Tē-la̍k ê thiⁿ-sài pûn i ê lat-pah, góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ ū siaⁿ tùi Siōng-tè bīn-chêng ê kim chè-tôaⁿ hit sì ki kak chhut--lâi,
kā gia̍h lat-pah ê tē-la̍k ê thiⁿ-sài kóng, “Lí tio̍h chiong koaiⁿ tī Iù-hoat-la-tí-hô hit sì ê thiⁿ-sài pàng--chhut-lâi.”
Chit sì ê thiⁿ-sài siū tháu-pàng, sī chá chiū an-pâi hó-sè, tī tiāⁿ-tio̍h ê nî, ge̍h, ji̍t, kap sî beh sat-hāi jîn-lūi ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t.
Góa ū thiaⁿ-kóng bé-peng ê sò͘-bo̍k lóng-chóng ū nn̄g-ek.

Tī īⁿ-siōng tiong, góa só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ ê bé kap khiâ-bé ê lâng sī án-ni: In chhēng ū hé-iām, nâ-pó-chio̍h, kap liû-hông ê sek-tì ê hō͘-heng-kah. In ê bé ê thâu chhin-chhiūⁿ sai ê thâu, tùi in ê chhùi thò͘-chhut hé, ian, kap liû-hông.
Jîn-lūi ê saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t hō͘ bé ê chhùi thò͘--chhut-lâi ê hé, ian, kap liû-hông chit saⁿ hāng chai-hāi húi-bia̍t.
Chiah-ê bé ê lêng-le̍k sī tī in ê chhùi kap bé-liu; in ê bé-liu chhin-chhiūⁿ chôa ū thâu, ēng chiah-ê thâu siong-hāi lâng.

Kî-tha só͘ chhun--ê chiū-sī chiah-ê bô siū chai-hō sat-hāi ê lâng. In iáu bô hoán-hóe, bô pàng-sak in ê chhiú só͘ chō ê ngó͘-siōng; in chiàu-siông pài chiah-ê kúi, kap hiah-ê bōe khòaⁿ, bōe thiaⁿ, bōe kiâⁿ, ēng kim, gûn, tâng, chio̍h, chhâ chō ê ngó͘-siōng.
In mā bô hoán-hóe, bô pàng-sak in hiong-sat, siâ-su̍t, îm-loān, thau-the̍h ê hêng-ûi.

Góa khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lēng-gōa chi̍t ê tōa khùi-la̍t ê thiⁿ-sài tùi thiⁿ-téng lo̍h--lâi; i ēng hûn choh saⁿ chhēng, thâu-khak téng ū khēng, i ê bīn chhin-chhiūⁿ ji̍t-thâu, kha chhin-chhiūⁿ hé-thiāu.
I ê chhiú ū the̍h chi̍t kńg thí-khui ê sòe-kńg-chheh. I chiàⁿ-kha ta̍h hái, tò-kha ta̍h tōe.
I tōa-siaⁿ hoah, chhin-chhiūⁿ sai teh háu, hit chhit ê lûi chiū chhut-siaⁿ ìn.
Chhit ê lûi chhut-siaⁿ liáu-āu, góa tú-beh siá, thiaⁿ-kìⁿ tùi thiⁿ ū siaⁿ kóng, “Chhit ê lûi só͘ kóng--ê, lí tio̍h hong--khí-lâi, m̄-thang kì-lio̍k.”
Āu-lâi, góa só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ kha ta̍h hái kap tōe hit-ê thiⁿ-sài gia̍h chiàⁿ-chhiú kí thiⁿ,

kí hit-ūi éng-éng-oán-oán oa̍h--teh ê Siōng-tè, chiū-sī chhòng-chō thiⁿ kap thiⁿ-téng ê mi̍h, tōe kap tōe-chiūⁿ ê mi̍h, hái kap hái--ni̍h ê mi̍h--ê, soan-pò͘ kóng, “Bōe koh iân-tî lah!
Put-kò tē-chhit ê thiⁿ-sài teh-beh pûn i ê lat-pah, lat-pah ê siaⁿ tân ê ji̍t, Siōng-tè tùi I ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti só͘ soan-kò ê ò-biāu ōe si̍t-hiān.”

Āu-lâi, góa chêng só͘ thiaⁿ--kìⁿ tùi thiⁿ lâi hit-ê siaⁿ koh chi̍t piàn tùi góa kóng, “Lí khì, khì the̍h kha ta̍h hái kap tōe hit-ê thiⁿ-sài chhiú-tiong hit-kńg thí-khui ê chheh.”

Góa chiū khì thiⁿ-sài hia, chhiáⁿ i chiong hit-kńg sòe-kńg-chheh hō͘ góa; i kā góa kóng, “Lí the̍h--khì, chia̍h--lo̍h-khì, tī pak-tó͘ lāi ōe khó͘, m̄-kú tī chhùi-lāi ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ bi̍t hiah-ni̍h tiⁿ.”
Góa chiū tùi thiⁿ-sài ê chhiú the̍h hit-kńg sòe-kńg-chheh lâi chia̍h; chhùi-lāi kó-jiân chhin-chhiūⁿ bi̍t hiah-ni̍h tiⁿ, m̄-kú thun lo̍h-khì pak-tó͘ lāi chiū pìⁿ-chòe khó͘.
Thiⁿ-sài koh kā góa kóng, “Lí tio̍h koh soan-pò͘ Siōng-tè koan-hē chin chōe bîn-cho̍k, pang-kok, gú-giân, kap kun-ông ê ū-giân.”

Góa ū niá-siū chi̍t ki chhioh, hêng chhin-chhiūⁿ koáiⁿ-á, koh ū siaⁿ tùi góa kóng, “Khí--lâi, khì niû Siōng-tè ê sèng-tiān kap chè-tôaⁿ, koh sǹg tiān-lāi kèng-pài ê jîn-sò͘.
M̄-kú, sèng-tiān gōa-kháu ê tiâⁿ m̄-thang niû, in-ūi gōa-tiâⁿ í-keng kau hō͘ Gōa-pang-lâng; in ōe thún-ta̍h Sèng-siâⁿ sì-cha̍p-jī ge̍h-ji̍t kú.
Góa beh chún góa nn̄g ê kiàn-chèng-jîn chhēng môa-saⁿ, ū koân thoân-tō chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah la̍k-cha̍p ji̍t kú.”
Chit nn̄g ê kiàn-chèng-jîn chiū-sī khiā tī choân-tōe ê Chú bīn-chêng ê nn̄g châng kaⁿ-ná-chhiū kap nn̄g ki teng-tâi.
Nā ū lâng beh hāi in, in ōe tùi chhùi thò͘-chhut hé, chiong tùi-te̍k sio-bia̍t; nā ū lâng beh hāi in, it-tēng ōe án-ni siū sat-hāi.

Chit nn̄g ê kiàn-chèng-jîn ū koân thang koaiⁿ thiⁿ, hō͘ in thoân-tō ê kî-kan bô lo̍h-hō͘; in mā ū koân chiáng-koán chúi, hō͘ i pìⁿ-chòe huih; koh chiàu in só͘ ài thang put-koán-sî kàng ta̍k-chióng chai-hāi kong-kek tāi-tōe.
In kiàn-chèng oân-sêng liáu-āu, tùi bô-tóe-chhim-khiⁿ chiūⁿ--lâi hit-chiah siù ōe kap in kau-chiàn, chiong in cheng-ho̍k, kā in thâi-sí.
In ê sin-si ōe tó tī tōa siâⁿ-chhī ê koe-lō͘; chit-ê siâⁿ-chhī lâng kā i pí-phēng chòe Só͘-to-má á-sī Ai-ki̍p; in ê Chú mā tī hia hō͘ lâng tèng si̍p-jī-kè.
Saⁿ ji̍t pòaⁿ kú, tùi ta̍k-ê bîn-cho̍k, ta̍k-ê cho̍k-kûn, ta̍k-khoán gú-giân, ta̍k-ê pang-kok, ū lâng ōe lâi khòaⁿ in ê sin-si, m̄-chún lâng kā in bâi-chòng tī bōng--ni̍h.
Tòa tī tōe-bīn-chiūⁿ ê lâng ōe in-ūi in ê sí lâi hoaⁿ-hí khoài-lo̍k, kau-ōaⁿ lé-mi̍h; in-ūi chit nn̄g ê sian-ti ū hō͘ tōe-chiūⁿ ê lâng siū-tio̍h khó͘-chhó͘.
Saⁿ ji̍t pòaⁿ kè-liáu, tùi Siōng-tè hia ū oa̍h-khì ji̍p-khì in lāi-bīn, in chiū peh khí-lâi khiā; khòaⁿ--tio̍h ê lâng tōa kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ.
In nn̄g lâng thiaⁿ-kìⁿ tùi thiⁿ lâi tōa ê siaⁿ tùi in kóng, “Khí-lâi chia!” In chiū tī tùi-te̍k ê bīn-chêng chē-hûn chiūⁿ-thiⁿ.

Tú hit-sî ū tōa tōe-tāng, hit-chō siâⁿ tó cha̍p-hūn-chi̍t; in-ūi tōe-tāng sí--khì-ê ū chhit-chheng lâng; kî-tha ê lâng tōa kiaⁿ-hiâⁿ, kui êng-kng hō͘ thiⁿ-téng ê Siōng-tè.
Tē-jī ê chai-hō í-keng kè; tē-saⁿ ê chai-hō liâm-piⁿ kàu.

Tē-chhit ê thiⁿ-sài pûn i ê lat-pah, thiⁿ-téng ū tōa ê siaⁿ, kóng: Sè-kan ê kok chiâⁿ-chòe lán ê Chú kap I só͘ siat-li̍p ê Ki-tok ê kok; I beh éng-éng-oán-oán choh-ông chiáng-koân.
Tī Siōng-tè bīn-chêng chē tī in ka-kī chō-ūi ê jī-cha̍p-sì ê tiúⁿ-ló, bīn phak lo̍h-khì kèng-pài Siōng-tè,
kóng: Hiān-chāi chûn-chāi, kè-khì chûn-chāi Choân-lêng ê Chú Siōng-tè, goán kám-siā lí; in-ūi lí í-keng chiáng-ak tāi-koân; lí í-keng choh-ông chiáng-koân.

Gōa-pang tōa siū-khì, lí mā hoat siū-khì; sí-lâng siū sím-phòaⁿ ê sî-ki kàu lah. Lí ê po̍k-jîn chèng sian-ti, lí ê sìn-tô͘, kap kèng-ùi lí ê miâ--ê, bô-lūn tōa--ê sòe--ê, lí pò-siúⁿ in ê sî-ki kàu lah. Pāi-hoāi tōe--ê, lí pāi-hoāi in ê sî-ki kàu lah.
Siōng-tè tī thiⁿ-téng ê sèng-tiān chiū khui; tī sèng-tiān lāi I ê iok-kūi khòaⁿ-hiān-hiān; hut-jiân ū sih-nà, hiáng-siaⁿ, lûi tân, tōe-tāng, kap tōa-pha̍uh.
Āu-lâi, tī thiⁿ-téng ū chi̍t ê tōa kéng-siōng chhut-hiān: Ū chi̍t ê hū-jîn-lâng sin chhēng ji̍t-thâu, kha ta̍h ge̍h-niû, thâu tì cha̍p-jī lia̍p chhiⁿ ê hoa-koan.
I hoâi-īn beh siⁿ-kiáⁿ, teh chhui-chūn, thàng-thiàⁿ, âu-kiò.
Tī thiⁿ-téng koh ū chi̍t ê kéng-siōng chhut-hiān: Ū chi̍t chiah tōa chiah chhiah-sek ê ok-lêng, i ū chhit ê thâu, cha̍p ki kak; chhit ê thâu tì chhit téng ông-koan.

I ēng bé-liu kā thiⁿ-téng saⁿ-hūn-chi̍t ê chhiⁿ sàu-lo̍h tōe. Hit-chiah ok-lêng khiā tī teh-beh siⁿ-kiáⁿ ê hū-jîn-lâng ê bīn-chêng, thèng-hāu i ê kiáⁿ siⁿ--chhut-lâi thang kā i thun--lo̍h-khì.
Hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng siⁿ chi̍t ê ta-po͘-kiáⁿ, chit-ê kiáⁿ beh ēng thih-koáiⁿ tī-lí bān-kok. M̄-kú, i ê kiáⁿ hō͘ lâng chiap-khì Siōng-tè bīn-chêng, kàu I ê pó-chō hia.
Hit-ê hū-jîn-lâng tô-cháu khì khòng-iá, tī hia Siōng-tè ū kā i pī-pān chi̍t ê só͘-chāi, hō͘ i thang tit-tio̍h chiàu-kò͘ chi̍t-chheng nn̄g-pah la̍k-cha̍p ji̍t.
Āu-lâi tī thiⁿ-téng ū chiàn-cheng. Bí-ka-le̍k kap i ê sù-chiá khì kap hit-chiah ok-lêng kau-chiàn, ok-lêng mā kap i ê sù-chiá khí-lâi èng-chiàn.
Ok-lêng thâi su, i kap i ê sù-chiá tī thiⁿ-téng chiū bô só͘-chāi thang tòa.

Hit-chiah tōa chiah ok-lêng chiū siū hiat--lo̍h-khì; i chiū-sī hit-bé lāu-chôa, kiò-chòe Mô͘-kúi, Sat-tàn, choân jîn-lūi ê bê-he̍k-chiá; i siū hiat-lo̍h tōe, i ê sù-chiá mā lóng kap i chòe-hé siū hiat-lo̍h tōe.

Āu-lâi góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ tī thiⁿ-téng ū tōa ê siaⁿ kóng: Hiān-chāi lán ê Siōng-tè ê chín-kiù, koân-lêng, kap chú-koân í-keng si̍t-hiān! I í-keng hián-sī I ê Ki-tok ê koân-pèng! Hit-ê mî-ji̍t tī lán ê Siōng-tè bīn-chêng khòng-kò lán ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē--ê í-keng siū hiat--lo̍h-khì.
Lán ê hiaⁿ-tī chí-bē khò Iûⁿ-ko ê huih, kap in só͘ kiàn-chèng ê sìn-sit í-keng khah iâⁿ hit-chiah ok-lêng; in sīm-chì kàu sí to bô sioh ka-kī ê sìⁿ-miā.

Só͘-í, chiah-ê thiⁿ kap tiàm tī hit tiong-kan--ê, lóng tio̍h hoaⁿ-hí! Chóng-sī, tōe kap hái chhám ah, in-ūi Mô͘-kúi í-keng khì-phut-phut lo̍h-khì lín hia, i chai-iáⁿ ka-kī ê sî bô kú lah.
Hit-chiah ok-lêng chi̍t-ē chai ka-kī í-keng siū hiat-lo̍h tōe, chiū khì jip hit-ê siⁿ ta-po͘-kiáⁿ ê hū-jîn-lâng.

Hū-jîn-lâng ū tit-tio̍h tōa chiah eng-chiáu ê nn̄g ki si̍t thang pe-khì khòng-iá, kàu i ka-kī ê só͘-chāi, tī hia tit-tio̍h chiàu-kò͘ saⁿ nî pòaⁿ kú, bô siū-tio̍h lāu-chôa ê kong-kek.
Hit-bé chôa tī hū-jîn-lâng ê āu-bīn, tùi chhùi thò͘-chhut chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-hô ê chúi beh kā i chhiong-cháu
M̄-kú, tāi-tōe pang-chān hū-jîn-lâng, khui-chhùi kā hit-chiah ok-lêng thò͘--chhut-lâi ê hô-chúi thun--lo̍h-khì.

Ok-lêng chiū tùi hū-jîn-lâng hoat siū-khì, khì kap hū-jîn-lâng kî-tha ê kiáⁿ-sun kau-chiàn, chiū-sī hiah-ê chun-siú Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng í-ki̍p chhî-siú Iâ-so͘ ê kiàn-chèng ê lâng.
Āu-lâi, hit-chiah ok-lêng khì khiā tī hái-phiâⁿ ê soa-téng.

Āu-lâi, góa ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ chi̍t chiah siù tùi hái--ni̍h khí--lâi; i ū cha̍p ki kak, chhit ê thâu; cha̍p ki kak ū tì cha̍p téng ông-koan; ta̍k-ê thâu-khak téng lóng ū pòng-to̍k Siōng-tè ê miâ-hō.

Góa só͘ khòaⁿ--kìⁿ hit-chiah siù chhin-chhiūⁿ pà; i ê kha chhin-chhiūⁿ hîm ê kha, chhùi chhin-chhiūⁿ sai ê chhùi. Hit-chiah ok-lêng chiong ka-kī ê lêng-le̍k, ông-chō, kap tōa koân-pèng kau hō͘ hit-chiah siù.

Siù ê chi̍t ê thâu-khak chhin-chhiūⁿ ū siū-tio̍h tì-miā ê tāng-siong, m̄-kú i ê tì-miā-siong ū tit-tio̍h i-hó. Thong sè-kài ê lâng lóng kám-kak chin hi-kî, khì tè tī siù ê āu-bīn.

In lóng pài hit-chiah ok-lêng, in-ūi ok-lêng ū chiong i ê koân-pèng kau hō͘ siù; in mā pài siù, kóng, “Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kap chit-chiah siù saⁿ-pí? Siáⁿ-lâng ōe-tàng kap i kau-chiàn?”
Āu-lâi, chit-chiah siù ū tit-tio̍h chi̍t ê kóng tōa-ōe kap siat-to̍k ê chhùi; i tit-tio̍h ún-chún thang chip-hêng koân-pèng sì-cha̍p-jī ge̍h-ji̍t kú.
I khui-chhùi siat-to̍k Siōng-tè, siat-to̍k I ê miâ kap I ê pò͘-pîⁿ, chiū-sī hiah-ê tah pò͘-pîⁿ tī thiⁿ-téng ê lâng.

I mā tit-tio̍h ún-chún thang kong-kek sìn-tô͘, kā in cheng-ho̍k; i koh tit-tio̍h koân thang tī-lí ta̍k-ê cho̍k-kûn, ta̍k-ê bîn-cho̍k, ta̍k-ê pang-kok, kap kóng ta̍k-khoán gú-giân ê lâng.
Só͘-ū tòa tī tōe-chiūⁿ ê lâng, tùi chhòng-chō sè-kài í-lâi, in ê miâ bô kì tī siū thâi Iûⁿ-ko ê oa̍h-miā-chheh--ê, lóng ōe pài hit-chiah siù.
Ū hī-khang--ê lóng tio̍h thiaⁿ:
Hit-ê eng-kai siū lia̍h--ê tio̍h siū lia̍h; hit-ê eng-kai siū sat-hāi--ê tio̍h siū to sat-hāi. In-ūi án-ni, sìn-tô͘ tio̍h ū nāi-sim kap sìn-sim.
Āu-lâi, góa koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ ū chi̍t chiah siù tùi tōe--ni̍h khí--lâi; i ū nn̄g ki kak chhin-chhiūⁿ iûⁿ ê kak, kóng-ōe chhin-chhiūⁿ ok-lêng.

I tī thâu chi̍t chiah siù ê bīn-chêng chip-hêng thâu chi̍t chiah siù ê koân-pèng. I kiò tōe kap tòa tī tōe-chiūⁿ ê lâng khì pài thâu chi̍t chiah siù, chiū-sī siū-tio̍h tì-miā-siong koh tit-tio̍h i-hó hit-chiah siù.
I kiâⁿ tōa kî-chek, tī lâng ê bīn-chêng kiò hé tùi thiⁿ kàng-lo̍h tōe;
koh ēng siū ún-chún tī siù ê bīn-chêng kiâⁿ ê kî-chek lâi bê-he̍k tōe-chiūⁿ ê lâng, hoan-hù in tio̍h kā hit-chiah siū to-siong iáu oa̍h--teh ê siù chō chi̍t chō siōng.
I koh siū ún-chún chiong oa̍h-khì pûn ji̍p-khì siù ê siōng, hō͘ siù ê siōng ōe kóng-ōe, koh sat-hāi só͘-ū bô pài siù ê siōng ê lâng.
I mā kiông-pek chèng-lâng, bô-lūn tōa-sòe, hó-gia̍h sàn-chhiah, chū-iû--ê choh lô͘-lē--ê, tī in ka-kī ê chiàⁿ-chhiú á-sī thâu-hia̍h khàm-ìn chòe kì-hō.
Bô khàm siù ê miâ, á-sī bô tāi-piáu i ê miâ ê sò͘-jī--ê, chiū bōe-tàng bóe-bōe.
Tùi chit-ê tāi-chì tio̍h ū tì-hūi. Chhong-bêng ê lâng tio̍h sǹg-chhut siù ê sò͘-jī, in-ūi sò͘-jī tāi-piáu chi̍t ê lâng ê miâ, chit-ê sò͘-jī sī la̍k-pah la̍k-cha̍p-la̍k.
Āu-lâi góa koh khòaⁿ, ū khòaⁿ-kìⁿ Iûⁿ-ko khiā tī Sek-an-soaⁿ, ū cha̍p-sì-bān sì-chheng lâng kap I chòe-hé; in ê thâu-hia̍h lóng ū siá Iûⁿ-ko ê miâ kap I ê Pē ê miâ.

Góa thiaⁿ-kìⁿ ū siaⁿ tùi thiⁿ-téng chhut--lâi, chhin-chhiūⁿ tōa-chúi teh chhiâng ê siaⁿ, koh chhin-chhiūⁿ chhè-lûi ê siaⁿ; góa só͘ thiaⁿ--kìⁿ chit-ê siaⁿ chhin-chhiūⁿ khîm-su teh tôaⁿ khiā-khîm ê siaⁿ.

In tī pó-chō kap sì ê oa̍h-mi̍h í-ki̍p chèng tiúⁿ-ló ê bīn-chêng chhiùⁿ chi̍t siú sin ê koa, chit-siú koa tû-liáu tùi tōe-chiūⁿ sio̍k-hôe hit cha̍p-sì-bān sì-chheng lâng bô lâng ōe-tàng o̍h.

In sī m̄-bat chhin-kūn lú-sèng ê chāi-sek-lâm. Iûⁿ-ko bô-lūn khì sím-mi̍h só͘-chāi, in lóng tè kàu hia. In sī tùi jîn-lūi tiong-kan sio̍k-hôe chhut-lâi chòe khí-thâu-se̍k ê ké-chí hiàn hō͘ Siōng-tè kap Iûⁿ-ko ê.
In m̄-bat kóng pe̍h-chha̍t, lóng bô khoat-tiám.

Góa koh khòaⁿ-kìⁿ lēng-gōa chi̍t ê thiⁿ-sài tī pòaⁿ khong-tiong teh pe; i ū éng-oán ê hok-im beh thoân hō͘ tiàm tī tōe-chiūⁿ ê lâng, hō͘ ta̍k-ê pang-kok, ta̍k-ê cho̍k-kûn, ta̍k-ê bîn-cho̍k, kap kóng ta̍k-khoán gú-giân ê lâng.
I tōa-siaⁿ kóng, “Tio̍h kèng-ùi Siōng-tè, kui êng-kng hō͘ I! In-ūi I sím-phòaⁿ jîn-lūi ê sî kàu lah; tio̍h kèng-pài hit-ūi chhòng-chō thiⁿ, tōe, hái, kap chúi-goân ê Chú.”
Lēng-gōa ū tē-jī ê thiⁿ-sài sòa lo̍h-khì kóng, “Tó--lo̍h-khì lah! Hō͘ bān-kok lim i îm-loān ê lia̍t-chiú ê tōa Pa-pí-lûn tó--lo̍h-khì lah!”
Lēng-gōa ū tē-saⁿ ê thiⁿ-sài sòa lo̍h-khì tōa-siaⁿ kóng, “Nā ū lâng pài hit-chiah siù kap siù ê siōng, thâu-hia̍h á-sī chhiú ū khàm-ìn,

hit-ê lâng mā tio̍h lim Siōng-tè siū-khì ê chiú, chiū-sī thîn tī Siōng-tè siū-khì ê poe ê sûn-chiú. I ōe tī sèng thiⁿ-sài kap Iûⁿ-ko ê bīn-chêng siū-tio̍h hé kap liû-hông ê khó͘-chhó͘.

Khó͘-chhó͘ in ê hé-ian chhèng-chiūⁿ koân, éng-oán bô-thêng. Hiah-ê pài hit-chiah siù kap siù ê siōng, í-ki̍p ū khàm-tio̍h siù ê miâ ê ìn ê lâng, mî-ji̍t lóng bōe-tàng an-hioh.”
In-ūi án-ni, chun-siú Siōng-tè ê bēng-lēng koh kian-chhî sìn Iâ-so͘ ê sìn-tô͘ tio̍h ū nāi-sim.
